eng_Latn: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu gā ɔlɛ́ ā, é le ɛhi kú uwā kpó gē lɛ ɔ́ ipú inu, anɔ́ɔ é túkpɛɛ́ klla lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um, lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfú kú ācɛ olɔnɔɔtū mɛ́mla mla ācɛ oyɔ́dābɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa kú ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ kú iháyí ɔ́migwáahānɛ nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Unebúsāradan, ɔ̄cɛ o nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā dúú ā le tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gāa kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ nū ɔhá glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū klla géē je mlanyi nū.

eng_Latn: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujísɔ̄si le pɛ́ wā abɔ́ɔ á. É háyi iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō da ɔ́ ka aá tíne ō má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá inu eyīpú fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Ó lɛ ɔwɛ nēé ī yɛ ga ipú nū ā mīya. Olipú kú nū wɛ umíta éyi, ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛtá, ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū āyā dóódu kē wɛ umíta ɛtá ce āyā.

eng_Latn: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi le tá ipú ɔtū kú Ujúdasi nēé hi ka Iskáriyɔ̄ti, nōo wɛ éyi kú ayíkpó ā á.

eng_Latn: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yá ká ádā uwā ā kóō lɛ ejé gwá otú ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gaá gwutá mla anú á. Ulɔ́tu í klla jé eko nōó wā gaá gwutá mla anú mla eko nōó cāŋjɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ejé le ɔ́ kwú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si jéeyī gicō má ayíkpó kú nū anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ ācogbɛhá ā, ákú aá lɔhi. Ohígbū ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō wɛ ákú aá!.

eng_Latn: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō híī tá ádā mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ayíkpó kú nū hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛwa nēe bá nyā gē tū um eyīnyinyi ohígbū ka uwá húmáyī bá pī um ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá yɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, é kē lé ɔdōlé dúúmā ŋ́. Ń tíne ō da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ ipú áncā ŋ́, ohígbū kē lɔfú gbayibó ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Uresín mɛ́mla Unekóda mɛ́mla Ugásam.

eng_Latn: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛlā ka, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́wá kú aíju nōbí mɛ́mla aɛ́lá le tū wā í le mu odúúdú ajɛ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ oyēeyi kú ācɛ ohéjulúgwu ā lɛ á. Obé kú ācɛ ohéjulúgwu ā gē wɛ ikwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá keé bá ī ka iŋīnī ka abɔ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū aá eyījii ā yá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó aá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú aá ú kpó tū ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ā, kéē lɛ aá kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ akwuna ákú uwɔ ā wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kwu uwɔ bá ɔ̄ ka a pīya akwuna ŋ́. Ācɛnyīlɔ í gē cíla uwɔ ulé ŋ́, amáŋ awɔ ā gē cíla uwá ulé ka e wā ī gbo mla uwɔ á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a wɛ ɛdɔ akwuna ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gbóó.

eng_Latn: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá, dúú, í tútū ohígbū ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í wā eko nɛ̄ aá í leyīce ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ a kē gē bī ɔna le tū um ufi, klla í bī ɔna obɔ̄bí le tū um ufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ a géē lɛ igbīhāajɛ ā gáā nwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
idu_Latn: Ulāban hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ā ka Ujɛga-sahadúta, Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu hī ɔ̄ ka Ugálīīdi.

eng_Latn: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācoyúklɔ́ kú nū kéē lɛ ofu kú aɔ́dā néē hī ka aúcérōbim ā yá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ugóolu ma plla uwá iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú uwā ú kpó ce ɛga nēe tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ka lɛ ā, Ɛcɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nōo bá ipú nū ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā wā í lā ipú ajɛ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. O géē í wɛ ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī aá. Ɔkpɛtā í klla gáā ŋmó ayí uwā gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Óndú kpaakpa ipú ajɛ ā wɛ ācɛ ojīlīmā Ɛlā uwā he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
idu_Latn: Ussɛfatíya, Uhátilu, Upókereti, Uhasebáyīm mɛ́mla Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú um, ka n̄ géē jɔ́nyɛ klla má abahi kú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla agbénú kú ɛcɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ má ɔdā nōo lɔhi ipu oyēeyī ā, amáŋ n má ka ɔ́ɔmā wɛ áncā dúú.

eng_Latn: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
idu_Latn: Igbɛ alɛwa ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ gā um kú um wā ɛgiyí aá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla yēeyī iháyí úla ɛpa ce igwó ɛhɔ̄ kpɔ́ á. Ó le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhā dúú.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka.

eng_Latn: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe nwū ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā wɛ ācɛ o yúulā nēe klla wɛ ācɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā í gē gbɛlá ɔdā olɔhi ō yá gbóógbōō ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ odúúdú alɔ mágwōnū bá ajɛ ā, n pó ɔkɔ éyi nōo da um ɔkɔ Uhíbru ka, Usɔ́lu, Usɔ́lu, ɔdíyá nāa ī yá um ŋmó ā? Ó í lɔnɔ tū uwɔ nɛ̄hi ká ā bɛyí kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya táajɛ ā n.

eng_Latn: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ápátɛ́cɔ̄ hɛ́bū ipú ígbíli le éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ uwá gwá ŋmá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
idu_Latn: Ó kōō aɔ́dā ō bī gwííjē, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpancílé ámāŋ ka ɛ̄ngwū ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ í gwō ɔ́ lɔhi ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā jé ɔdā nēé ī gwō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā italā, klla í tá ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ kóō lɛ ɛdɔ ōwē nēé géē yá ācɛ o leyī ɛpa ā yá ɔ̄. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó géē jikwū í hīla aīnu.

eng_Latn: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá kéē híī nā anúɔ tɔ́ɔwɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄cī éyi ó géē je hábɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nā ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔwɛ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá ɛ̄nyā mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Kwú ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbɛ́ɛna kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā mɛ́mla omlede kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔbɛ́ɛna ā wɛ ákú ɛya kú íne ō bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ omlede ā wɛ ákú ɛya kóō je yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá uwɔ ká ā lɛ ɔtū olɔfú mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú lɛyíkwu uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ a, nɛ̄ á gáā cɛ̄ mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá géē tá uwá owu, owu kē ī je uwá kpó nyɔ̄. Owu nɛ̄hi géē je uwá pahīla bónū. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē gwéeyē ohígbū um. Aá klla ī cɛ̄tra ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um ā.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Urissa.

eng_Latn: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́tam wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á. Ó kē ce ɔcɛ́ iháyí igwɛ́hīlī Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tōoji bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā ŋmá ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɔkɔ kú nū gbakpáabana ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ kéē jíliyē. Amáŋ, Óndú ā géē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá unwalu.

eng_Latn: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her, and shall remain in thine house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month: and after that thou shalt go in unto her, and be her husband, and she shall be thy wife.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kwú úwé ɔhá í kpó wiyē. Ó ka ɔnyā ā cíkā ō klá ɔlɛ́ nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yīinīkwū kú ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ɔyā éyi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú lɛ ɔ́ igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā glá.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ussélūmīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúríssadāyi leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú ígwu kú Usímīyɔn á.

eng_Latn: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ba, ɔyí Úri wɛ igbómína kú Ugílɛ̄di, nɛ̄ Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan tɛtɛ gbō ā á. Ugbómína éyi yɔ̄ nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwō aóhile nēe bá ā tā, nōo gē leyīkwu odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛlísa ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ukénan nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo hile ā.

eng_Latn: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N húmáyī klá cíí gbojī ɛɛ́. N le iyī um kwútū cíí. Amáŋ, eko gā nɛ̄ n gáā dɛ̄gba wɛ̄ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm, klla í tíifu bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā, ɛ̄cī nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā, aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō lɛ opo tá odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
idu_Latn: N da uwá kahíníi, Aá wɛ ācɛ otīīhɔ kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ odúúdú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla aócíbú kú ugóolu nēe wɛ ɔdā ɛya nēé kpó gé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɔtū éékpó kú uwā ā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
idu_Latn: N géē nyāŋjɛ kú n̄ ga ɛgiyí ádā um, kú um gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Adá um, n le íne kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ákú uwɔ bīya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ufáyin, klla í lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā lɛ̄ īkpō kú nū ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá ejé ŋmá anú ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛkɔ̄ géē je ɔ́ lé ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá ī yá, ka aá lé ɔdōlé ámāŋ gwá ɔdā dóódu, aá yá ɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō le abɔ̄ gbɔtū lɛyíkwu ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔkpáncō ā dúú. Ó lɛ ɛya nēé gē gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄cī dóódu ā ci. Ó klla kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ú tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ā, Usámsin le yɛ nyɔ̄ gáā kpó ije ɔnyā ā. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ó le nyā ce ɛga nōó ŋmó ágábá ā tá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó má ka ɛnwú ɔ́ɔ le tū tū okwū kú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda da ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn kéē wā mɛ́mla aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ukénan nēe bá ipú ajɛ nēé je lɛ aá ā. É ka aá géē nyɔ̄ mla uwá í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú uwā ā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn ā le yɛ mla.

eng_Latn: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
idu_Latn: Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalumúna bá Ukákɔ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā. Ipú odúúdú ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ígbíli ā, ācɛ o lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā ofu igwo ahātá ce ula igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ hile mɛ́ɛ̄ á. É lɛ aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ cē igwó kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umíkimāsi ā wɛ, ofu ɛhīlī ce ɛpa .

eng_Latn: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá á. Ó kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nōo lɛ ɔcí ufígi ipú ɛhɔ̄ īkpɔ̄cí kú nū. Ó nyɔ̄ ɔkwu ɔcí ā gaá dɔɔ̄kā ikpō ufígi, amáŋ ó má odóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Usólómɔ̄n kahíníī, Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, a jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Userúya yá um ā. Anú kpó aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛpa, Ábna, ɔyí kú Unɛ́ɛ mɛ́mla Amása, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́ta ŋmó eko ɛbɔ́, yɔ̄ ī cílá óluma kú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú āá. Ācɛ nōo yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ nōó ŋmó á, amáŋ abālɔbányā ɛfiyɛ kú ɔdā nōó yá ā ce um ɛyí.

eng_Latn: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ fīyɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka inu ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú ɛpá kú ikpó éyi ce āyā ú tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aflá ā mɛ́mla ɔdɔ ā, jīla tá. Lɛ ipú nū hɛ́ ɛga ɛtá ce ɔhá icō bɛ̄ɛka ɔda kú icīīcō, ɔda kú icō mɛ́mla ɔda kú ɛháajɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔwɛ ú tá áklō kú nū.

eng_Latn: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ ɛnɛ bá nɛ̄ iyāwu kú uwā lɔhi ō má eyī.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Óndú ā je lɛ Árɔ̄ni, o hile ā wɛ ákú aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo hí ɛhɔ̄ ā géē bī o hile kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, eko nɛ̄ ó le ɔdā ɛ̄gbā je lɛ Óndú ā a.

eng_Latn: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, nɛ̄ oklóbīya awɔ lɛ ohi tá ŋmá ipú inu kahíníī, Ā je unwalu ga um ŋ́! Ɔwɛ ā le gwu ɛɛ́, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla um bá agōdō, ń nyāŋjɛ gaá je ɔdā dúú ga awɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɔfu cɛnɛ ā wɛ Uromamtiyésa.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī ga Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ bū ɔlɛ́ kú ɛjī nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usamérīya mɛ́mla Ugálīli ā.

eng_Latn: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, anɔ́ɔ é má ka ōcē kú ɔfiyɛ ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
idu_Latn: Aá géē má Ɔdōtuufi ā nōo géē háyi ɛga nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā . Ó lɛ ā, ācɛ nēe lā Ujudíya ā, kéē le pɛ́ kwu ga ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
idu_Latn: lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū ma lɛ ɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ ayí ohile ā le kpó jɛ̄ ā, é le Ujɛ́futa nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́. É da Ujɛ́futa ka ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ úgwū kú ɔdā dúúmā kú ádā aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyí kú ɔnyā ɔhá nōo wɛ akwuna.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mofu kú ɔyā ɔ́mpa kú iháyí ɔ́mpa ā, ŋmíífi nɛ̄ ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ojuja ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ gē yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō ā, alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛhi je lɛ aá ŋmá lɛ eyīnyinyi kú nū ɛɛ́ mā, aá kóō bī ɛhi ɔ́ɔmā yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔ́ɔmā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bá ī gwu ede ā yēŋēē, klla í je ɔ́ gā um kóō le pīya ákú um.

eng_Latn: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛlísaa kɔ̄ aígwu igwɛ́ɛhīlī. Ó klla lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Utáma kɔ̄ aígwu ahātá. Aígwu kú Usádɔ̄ku nyā í lɛ ɛwa ŋ́, ohígbū ka uwá í nyīla bɛ̄ɛka ayí kú Ɛlísaa á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, a gē ményinyi klla ī je íne ō bīya yɛ́ɛhi, nááná nɛ̄ alɔ le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ú wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɔcɔ́nyɔ́kpá, lɛ ɔ́ gbo mla igbogbo kú ahilíki, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ í gwutá ipú unóji nēé bū tá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ okwū dúú tá ipú nū jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ugóma ā wɛ Asskɛ́nāsi mɛ́mla Urífāti mɛ́mla Utogáma.

eng_Latn: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya da Ohóliba ka ohígbū ɔdā nōo yá ā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛnyā da ɔ́. Kahíníī, Eyī kú ācɛ nēe gē cikpó uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā le cā uwɔ ɛɛ́, amáŋ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, géē yá kéē le cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwɔ, klla wā í le jīla tū uwɔ biílí.

eng_Latn: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ācɛ kú Ujúda géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɔmpanū ŋmó klla í pīya anú tū. Ayípōklóbīya í gáā lɛ ojīlīma ce anyākwɔ́cɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ayípɛ̄ ɛflɛ́ɛfu ā géē leyīgwū aɔ́kpani uwā bónū.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ, aá gwííjē lɛ Óndú ā. Aá kɔ̄kā olɔhi tá ɛcɛ eko dóódu ka Óndú ā lɛ alɔ nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú íjééyī lipú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ aólíla gē jɛ́yí nū. Aólíla í gē má ɛlā dúú ō ka, eko dúú nēé gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yí ɛyí ɔpu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ka anúɔ nū ācɛ nēe wā í je ɔlɛ́ anúɔ yɔlá tāajɛ ā nyɔ̄ kɛ̄ɛ? Ó klla dɔɔ̄kā ō jé ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ lɔfú kwú uwā glá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́? Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kɔ́ɔ̄ nū uwā nyɔ̄, kɔ́ɔ géē kwú uwā klla í mīyɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēé kpó yɔ̄ī nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya klla da ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ n yá uwɔ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kwú um, je um tá agbá ā?.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
idu_Latn: amáŋ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ka ɔdí nɔ́ɔ yá ā? Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ācɛ ɛ́ɛ bá ī kwu gwū anúɔ tá, ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ kē wā eko nɔ́ɔ ka ka anúɔ gē wā ā ŋ́. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya ɛ́ɛ bā gē túblá Umíkmāsi ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
idu_Latn: n kwú pīya olíla bɛ̄ɛka álá ā, ohígbū ka ń jíípú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ éyi kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú aálagbá kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ alɔ kpɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā kwúcē gaá lā abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nwū ācɛ ā íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.
idu_Latn: Unaómi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka iní nɔ́ɔ yā īkpɔ̄dā ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā āa? Ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔnyɛ nɔ́ɔ húmáyī ī yúklɔ́ ā? Ó da ɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ Urútu da ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū, Unaómi ka anúɔ húmáyī yúklɔ́ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi, nēé hī iyē kú nū ka Ubówāsi ā.

eng_Latn: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī jé ka alɔ lā ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó kē lā ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla alɔ á. Ó wɛ oŋmá lɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ kú nū nɛ̄ ó je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔ́da je, cɛ́ɛ́ kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā gbɔɔ́ ō tá úgbagwú. Ó gē bī ojuja wā ŋmá odúúdú aɛ́ga nɛ̄ ɛcɛ tá kwɛjī ā. Ó yá ká ɔwɔ kóō límanya abɔ̄ ɔwɔ ā yɔ̄ ī yā ā, klla ī bī owu wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nōó ī kpó ɔ̄ tū ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kwú ɔkpá nɛ̄ n gē je gā uwɔ nyā ú lé mulɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka á nyɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē tū owu nɛ̄hi olɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā gé le uwá. Ami abɔ̄yī um yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔfú éyi le ɔkɔ cɛyí yɔ̄ gē dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔnyɛ lɛ íkwu kóō lɛ ɔja ā fō ŋmá ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ nwūla á.

eng_Latn: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
idu_Latn: É le ɛcɔ̄ nēe bī lɛ gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gbā ŋmá ɛga ogbā ɛcɔ̄. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í pó uya kú omútāgā mɛ́mla āgā mla oje eko nēé bá í gwó ɔ̄ ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
idu_Latn: Kwu odúúdú ɔpɛ́ nēé gē nyi okwū klla í kpó īmū tū ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ɔkpá kú Ukídrɔn ā jāā gáā kwu okómpinu kú ɔnya ā, nōo kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, géē wɛ ákú um abɔ̄yī um. É klla gáā wúla igelī á tāajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē je ɔ́ yíífi igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā kwúcē le pɛ́ tá ɔkpáncō ā, ācogbāálá ā da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ le yɛ tá Ubɛ́tlɛhɛm abālɔbányā gaá lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá kú ālɔ̄ le jé nyā má.

eng_Latn: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya kɛlā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Kpái! Óndú, a géē yɛ í lɛ ɔkpáncō yíla kú ā ga ajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ aɛ́fu kéē gbɔɔ́ ō jíliyē iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, o ŋmá ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ gaá kwu ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi. É ka, anú wɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ hī ka Ɔfú nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā lɛ inya kwu bōōbū gāá da ɔbá nū kóō wā gaá má ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā ɛgiyí anúɔ ícílɔ ā klla gā igbɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā ā bá yɔ̄ á, Umesóbābu, Ujámlɛ̄ki, Ujóssa, ɔyí kú Amásīya.

eng_Latn: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā le ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ó wɛ Umósīsi ī je igbō nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō lɛ aá ā ŋ́, amáŋ Ádā um je igbo ɔkwɛ̄yi ā lɛ aá ŋmá ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔyínɛ́ aá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ámōōmɛ ā bī gé um. Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē je ka aá wɛ ācɛ o bɔkwu ajɛ tayínū ŋ́, amáŋ ka aá wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú ɔyínɛ́ aá ú tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú tɔ́hí ipú ajɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē tíne ō lɛ itene abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí gē tá unwalu bá ajɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wɔ́tū ómíci ō mīyɛ lé, géē yēeyī gbojī ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um húmáyī wɛ ɔdā ocābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa. Ohígbū ka awɔ húmáyī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō um klla ī lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē á.

eng_Latn: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ tá kéē je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá, nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī wā ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla le Ubálam, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ nēe ŋmá Upétɔ, ipú Umɛsopotémīya ā plá, kóō lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō géē nya odo kú um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ikwū. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē mīyɛ um.

eng_Latn: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ádām le iyē kwu Íifu nōo wɛ ɔnyā nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma á. É kwú iyē ú ce ɔyí ā ka Ukéni Ohígbū ka ó kahíníī, Óndú ā tá um abɔ̄ le ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi ma ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúú í gáā yá kú alɔ pīya ɔtū kú alɔ eyī glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka alɔ jé ka ohígbū eyīnyinyi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē yá ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó jé úklɔ́ o yá piíí nyā lɛ alɔ kú alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ o héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kú ācɛ nēe gekwú ā pó ā, ācɛ ōhī le ɛhɛ yɛ tū ɔ̄, amáŋ ɔhá kahíníī, Alɔ klla géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ igbɔhá ohígbū ɛlā nyā ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā. É kpó aígelī ɛpa lɛ uwá ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā bá yɔ̄ á, Utáánāki mɛ́mla Ugátrīmɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nɛ̄ ofu gē ŋmó nɛ̄hi ā, nōo klla wɛ eko kú ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ō je tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
idu_Latn: É gbā aɔ́kpá ofu kú ɛháajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa ā. Aá gē je éyi kú ipú igwó kú aɔ́dā nēe nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú bɛ̄ɛka aépu nēé hī ka umínt mɛ́mla udíll mɛ́mla ukúmin ā. Amáŋ aá lɛ eyī gwū ɛlā ocɛgbá kú íne ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi mɛ́mla ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā tá. Aá cíkā ō je o kɔ̄ ɛga ogwó kú ɔdā dóódu kú aá, amáŋ aá cíkā ō lɛ eyī gwū ɛlā ocɛ́gbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá í yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ē tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ɛcá nɛ̄ ācɛ cá aá ā, le pīya ɛcá kú um.

eng_Latn: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔ́da je lɛ aóbócí ā kéē lɛ ɛcí nya okwū kú ádā nū iyē kóō bīya ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ɔdōlé nyā ú kpó ce abɔ̄ kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, kéē jíla anú iyē ipéyī Óndú ā, kóō wɛ ɛya nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ó lɔnɔ lɛ olagbénú kóō ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
idu_Latn: Yɔ̄ ī yíihɔtū eko dóódu tá odúúdú ācɛ nēe jé uwɔ ā. Je ɔdā olɔhi kú uwɔ lɛ ācɛ nēe le yéŋēē ipú ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ a yɔ̄ ī yɛhɛ tū uwā, Óndú, a yɔ̄ ī yá aéwɔhá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā lé ɛbɛ́ kú ucɛ ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé mla igbō nēé lɛ ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lé igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ lé, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ hápáápa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yá uwā ōwē bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yēeyī ā, ucɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ī lé ā, géē tú uwā ɛlá kwu ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
idu_Latn: N ge cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ka anú gē nwū um ɛlā á. Ahāpōtú nɛ̄hi, ɔtū kú um gē gbɛlá ɔwɛ okpaakpa nɛ̄ n cíkā ō lā oyēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā éyi nōo yɔ̄ gē hóóyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa, yɛ igbīhi nū gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ogwu kú úwé kú nū.

eng_Latn: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ cíkā ō yíhɔtū tá ɔnyā nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú nū he ɔ́ ɔtū lɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōo yíhɔtū tá ɔnyā nū kē he iyī nū ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka anúɔ kwú agbá kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn hɛ́ ŋmá aá ɔkɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhówāsi gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɛgiyí únóji kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ aá ka, Ó hile ɔyā ɛnɛ kú eko ō cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō yá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N̄ da aá ka, aá má ɔ̄, aá jeyī gicō kú aá má ɛhɔ̄. Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ le jé kú ācɛ kéē cē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú bī ɛfú wā í kpó ācɛ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ŋmó bónū.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.
idu_Latn: Ā bēhé ga ipú inu dúúmā nēé bá ī jikwū okwū klá yēkwu ŋ́. Ā yá ɔtūnōbí kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́. N klla gáā hɔ́hā ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē lɛ ɛbɔ́, mɛ́mla ihɔtū mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ugomóra mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ádma mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Usebɔyíim mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ubéla le bɛ̄cɛ ga ɔgbɛ́fú kú ɔpɛ́ kú Usidím ā gaá le ɛfú kpó tá.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
idu_Latn: A gē yúklɔ́ ídáagó lɛ aókwū nɛɛ? Aókwu gē cāŋjɛ í cɛ̄tra awɔ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá blakwu ɛ̄cī nyā, nɛ̄ aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ aá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū lɛ kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ á. Aá híī lé igbō dúúmā nōo gē nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
idu_Latn: Unátan klla da ɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, anúɔ géē bēhé wā í kɛlā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó yá lɛ ā igbɛ ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔdée ā ú gicō igbo ékpónú á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā kú uwɔ dóódu nēé kā um ā, ń cɛ̄ odúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um gaá lɛ ɔ́ má eyī. Ń klla pó āyā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n gaá ma eyī abɔ̄yī um nyā ŋ́. A jéeyī fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
idu_Latn: Ukénan kwú pīya ádā kú ācɛ Usídɔn, nōo wɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú nū ā, mɛ́mla Uhɛ́ti.

eng_Latn: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ɛ̄cī alɛwa yá abɔ́ɔ, gbéeko nɛ̄ iyāwu ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ga ɛgaligbó ā kē gbɔɔ́ ō tūūfi, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ é gwōkónu ā le gla ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu le abɔ̄ pi uwá ahɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwēyī kpó tū ācɛ nē gē yá um ŋmó ā ɛyí, amáŋ Óndú, lɛ um nyatá. Lɛ uwá ipú gbogodo ipú ufi, amáŋ ā tū um ufi ŋ́. Lɛ ámíyā bī wā í klá uwá ká ā kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Lɛ uwá ca tāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ.

eng_Latn: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ o kpó wu agada gē bī iyɔ̄lā wā. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó yúklɔ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó gē yá ŋ́ mā, ɛmiyɛ géē je ɔ́ ŋmó tónū icííci.

eng_Latn: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
idu_Latn: N kpó uwá tayínū abɔ́ɔ gē gbēyī eko kú unwalu, nɛ̄ ācɛ ī nuunu klla ī kpɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
idu_Latn: Aólagwú alɛwa bá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko kú Ɛláyíssa, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Nááná Ɛláyíssa í hɛ́ odúúmā kú uwā tá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ Unéman ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
idu_Latn: Anú ōfōōfūnū, yá ɔkpáncō kwu ɛga nōó kwu ā, klla ī kwú úgbagwú kú ísu tū cíí á.

eng_Latn: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó aɛ́cɔ̄ o gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā kwu ɔ́: émɛrādi, usafíya mɛ́mla udáyímɔ̄ndu kwu ɔgba ɔ́mpa ā.

eng_Latn: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá aólɛlā kú nū, nēe wɛ ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm ā lé, klla í je ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm pīya agbénú kú nū. Amáŋ éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē yɔ̄ ī yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé piyóó.

eng_Latn: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
idu_Latn: Ádā aá Ébrahām gwéeyē kóō géē má eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē lɛ ɔ́ má, ɔtū kē he ɔ́.

eng_Latn: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ nēe í wā ā ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi, ka ɛ́ɛ gáā ményīnyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ŋ́, kwu ayípɛ̄ kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ.

eng_Latn: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, a kwú ínoōbīya kú uwɔ í tayínū, á gáā jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dúúmā nāa lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, klla kwú igbīhi í cē kwu ɔ́, Ɔwɔicō kē í ményinyi nū.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í lɛ abɔ̄ fú umu kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā kú eyī ō kpóce ā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔnyā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú gicō, lɛ ɔ́ jíliyē iyɔ̄bu ede kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú bī wā ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē kpó uwā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, Ébrahām yɛ gɔbū lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú Unégēbu, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lā otāhɛ̄ kú Ukádɛss mɛ́mla Ussɔ́ klla le yɛ tá Ugɛ́ra á.

eng_Latn: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē bī obɔ̄bí le cílá um ulé olɔhi nɛ̄ n yá lɛ uwá ā, wɛ aólɛlā kú um, ohígbū ka n gē yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka, eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá nyā.

eng_Latn: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō nōo hī aá igwú kú aá wā í pīyatɔ̄há mla ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, nōo wɛ Óndú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nōo le lé ligbó gaá gebí ā, amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo wɛ ogbāálá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o gbō odo ká aá ā, abālɔbányā, lɛ aá kpó kwúcē igbīhi wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɛcɔ̄ ā ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Ujísɔ̄si jeyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ádā, n tá uwɔ ahínyá ohígbū ka a gē jāhɔ̄ gā um.

eng_Latn: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yúklɔ́ nū ipú ɛcɛ, klla móōwɛ̄ nū ā, í tīile dóódu gā um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ká n géē kwú hɛ ūwā tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í mīyɛ ɔkwu um ā.

eng_Latn: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni lɛ ɔ̄kā kú úklɔ́ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá pó ipú agbá ā, o lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ayíkpó kú nū fu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
idu_Latn: Hɔ́ɔhā ce ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ, Ɔwɔicō. Ɔcɛ́ nāa fu ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
idu_Latn: Ācoyúklábɔ̄ kú Usólōmɔn nēé kpó ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ úlā ofɛtá cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu da ɔ̄cɛ ā ka anúɔ í gáā kpó eko bónū ɛgiyí nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le óbō ɛtá kpó, le uwá tá gwū Ábsālɔm ɔtū, eko nōó yēeyī playicō ɔcí, nēé hī ka ɔcí kú óoku ā á.

eng_Latn: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
idu_Latn: É kē ī yá olɔhi lɛ alɔ íbí ó. É gē je unwalu lɛ alɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā kú alɔ gē bī eko nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipácí mla uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi aá jé ka ācɛ alɛwa gē kweyī kú inya ō kwu á, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ōfōōfūnū gē yálé á. Aá kwinya, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá lɔfú yálé glá ā.

eng_Latn: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū alɔ gā ajɛ Usídɔn. Ujúliyɔ̄si gbonɛnɛ lɛ Upɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí aóklóbīya nū kéē leyīkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ka aádáádā aá da aá ka eko tɛtɛ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ tíne ō jé odée olɔhi lɛyíkwu unwalu kú nū nɛɛ, ɛ́ɛ gē da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ébɛ̄lu ā gaá mīyɛ ɛlā ō nwū lɛyíkwu unwalu kú uwɔ. Ó ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē ka unwalu kú uwā gwó á.

eng_Latn: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā má Ádā ā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ mla Ádā ā, anú má Ádā ā á.

eng_Latn: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ le ɔ́ yɛjīla tá, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú ɔ́kɔ gaá yāajɛ á. Odúúdú ācɛ ā báajɛ ɔ́kɔngɔ ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
idu_Latn: Ó géē fú ahɔ̄lá tū aklɛ ŋmá ɛyí ede ā mɛ́mla omōōmū abɔ̄ ɛpa kú ɔtulalī umuumu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwā kpó wā ipú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ɔnyā awɔ ōfōōfū nū nāa géē yíihɔtū tú ɔ̄ klla í cikpó nū á.

eng_Latn: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ru gā ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá lā Usalumóna.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka, abɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ, ágábá éyi ɔ́ɔ géē je ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū āa, ágábá jīla anú ɔwɛ le ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ fíyɛ́ ka ojiji kóō gicō ikpó igwó. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō ga igbīhi ikpó igwó.

eng_Latn: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é géē kwúcē wā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka, a lɛ eyīyōce kú ɛcɔ̄bū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ̄cɛ nōo hayi pī ɔ̄ ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nēé géē yá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó, nōo kwú uwēyī nyā ú ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí ā? Ohígbū ka, ɔnyɛ̄ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya, o lufíyé nyā ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ó gē ca aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi le ikpó kú ɔnyā kú ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔhá dóódu ce, é géē kpó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ɔnyā ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔkwɛ̄yī ā wɛ ka alelékwū nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄cɛ gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jéeyī ā wɛ owu kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú nū géē wɛ ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhánɔn lɛ aócɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi ā kpó kwú, lɛ uwá ɔnwāgba āyā éyi kpó wā, mā āyā ɔhá tá kwu ɔ́, klla le īlī kpó hīla tū uwá ɔkwu, lɛ uwá nū.

eng_Latn: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ā le yá ká ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kóō le yá jīla. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ayíkpó ā habɔ̄ ɔ́ tá le pɛ́ kwu á.

eng_Latn: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nēé kɔ̄ ā wɛ aójibó kú okóohō nēé le oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ma plá uwá iyē nɛ̄ aácá kú nū wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ugóolu gē ceyī ŋɛɛ́ŋɛɛ́ ā. nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú aá gaá bá inú álá eko nēé bá gē kpɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nōo ī yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa, géē ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, odúúdú aá nōó yá ā. N bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odo kú um le cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Ábna mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ɔhá kú Íssbɔ̄sseti, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā, ŋmá Umáhānēyim ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugíbēyɔn.

eng_Latn: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, ācɛ géē bá ī kahíníī, N le iyɔ̄lā gbō le héyī, iyɔ̄lā kē lɛ um ɔnyɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛgbá nōo gē ce ɔ̄cɛ jé ɛɛ́, n lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá ā jé dúú ɛ́ɛ́. N le nwū le jé ka āhɔ̄ dúú nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā jɛ̄ um. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ n má iyī um, ɛpléeko dúúmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ n lɛ ā jɛ̄ um. Ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō má nwuné lé ōō ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛmiyɛ kōō ī ŋmó um, ń jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú nū ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō lɛ aɔ́dā alɛwa ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ń kōō lɛ jɛ̄ ō bī le yá ɛgbá kú um ŋ́, ń jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé ka ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kwú he ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛyá ā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú ɛcí ā kpó le yɛ mɛ́mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n jé cāā ka ɔdā dúú í gáā hɛ́ alɔ ŋmá ihɔtū kú nū glá ŋ́. Alɔ kōō gekwú ámāŋ ka alɔ yēeyī, ámāŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄, ámāŋ aígbómína, ámāŋ aɔ́dā nēe lɛ ɔfú kú ɔkpáncō í hɛ́ alɔ ŋmá ihɔtū kú nū glá ŋ́. Ɔdā nēe bá ī yá abālɔbányā mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo í yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā í gáā hɛ́ alɔ ŋ́má ihɔtū kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī leyī táajɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ ācɛ olagbénú yɔ̄ ī le tá ipú ikpati ɛhi ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ā kpó hīgwú wā í le jīla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le da odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɛ́ɛ le jīla anúɔ eyī Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma, aótrɛ̄yí kú aígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe ī cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā, ācɛ nēe ī leyīkwu agbénū mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí kú nū ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā gaá jīla anú eyī Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
idu_Latn: Ami, Ondú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu tɛtɛ cokónu ka, ipɔ́ɔnū mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um piyóó á, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó gáā lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, n géē lɛ ojīlīma ce ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīma ce um ā. Ācɛ nēe leyī gwū um bónū ā, n géē leyī gwū uwā bónū dúú.

eng_Latn: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
idu_Latn: o yá ɛɛ́ ká ajɛ ā ká ō je gicō igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́ má, ka é klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa kpó lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ unwalu ā, n le ikwū je klá Óndú, ó le ɔkɔ kú um pó, Ó kē wā í le um hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gbɛlá ka aá lɛ odée jé nɛ̄hi tū iyī uwā, í gē tíne kú ojéeyī kóō nwū uwā ɛlā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Uhássum wɛ ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō gbɛlá ka ikpó kú alɛɛcɛ, ámāŋ ka aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ɛ́ɛ ca ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū okónu ísu ā, bá ī tíne éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá. Ohígbū keé lɔfú gwá éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu kú Unáyilu ā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
idu_Latn: Aá le ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi yá gā um klla le oyēeyī kú um nyatá ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɛfu ā le ligbó nɛ̄hi ŋmá amānyā. Ámíyā géē yá um, nɛ̄ n géē kwú gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká n gaajɛ abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ n gekwú.

eng_Latn: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ enyi amɛ̄ wīya lɔfú, a géē má anɔ̄ ŋmá anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ enyi amɛ̄ wīya lɔfú lɔfú anɔ̄ gē bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú. Ɔ́dāŋ nāa lɛ akwū tū ɔ̄cɛ ɛnwū, ó gē pɛ́ oyī, ó klla i lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄cɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ nāa lɛ ɔ̄cɛ yá cɔ̄nū, ikpɛ́lá mɛ́mla unwalu géē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ ge tū ɔyínɛ́ éyi ɛhɔ̄ mla anú! Ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ odúúdú icɔ́ɔci gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ohígbū úklɔ́ kú ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi nōó gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi, nōo gboce Unáfutāli ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le bū ipú ísu ā, ɛyí ajɛ íkpākplā abɔ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ māháyi icō kpaakpa abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa āa.

eng_Latn: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔkpá nyā ú lɛ Ɛlása, ɔyí kú Ussafán mɛ́mla Ugemáriya, ɔyí kú Uhílīkiya, nɛ̄ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda yɔ̄ ī tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpá ā ka ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
idu_Latn: Ulában da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā ka ɛ́ɛ́. N le jé ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ n hímáyī má ā ka, Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce um ohígbū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ka ɛ̄cī dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le yɛ gla ɔkpá kú Ukídrɔn ā, ɔ́ɔ géē kwú, anú ɔ́ɔ kē yá iyī nū á.

eng_Latn: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu, lɔfú má ka ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī nááná gē kwú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔdāhá mɛ́mla aólíla ā gē kwú dúú ā. É klla í habɔ̄ agbénú kú uwā tá igbīhi lɛ ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí ɔhá nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Udéfīdi ā, lɛ ō ka ga awɔ kú ojīlīmā nɛ̄ a le ce ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā? A jé um mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, N géē kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō. Ó klla kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, mla ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó gā um ā.

eng_Latn: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka n géē fu aótrɛ̄yí nēe géē gbō uwā, nēe klla géē leyīkwu uwá. É gáā yúúfi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā gē tū uwá ufí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúmā kú uwā í kē gáā bī ŋ́. Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai's name.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó le ka lɛ ɔcányā, Ésta. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta gaá le ɔdā nōó pó ā ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ aá kpó wā ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan, Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Uhám mla ācɛ Ujébūsi ā, nɛ̄ ó cokónu kú nū lɛ aádáádā āá. Ajɛ nōo gē gbo iyē nɛɛɛ ā, aá géē yá ucɛ nyā ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔya aflɛ́yí kú iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúsāradan kwú odúúdú ācoyúklábɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga abɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile ā ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
idu_Latn: Óŋmá lɛ ɔhā nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, é le nyīla nɛ̄hi. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aɛ́na kú uwā mɛ tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahíja da ɔnyā Ujérobōwam ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ ɛgiyí ɔbá nū. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka obōōbū nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū ɔ́ɔ gaá daajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīla nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē doōcē ā géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā le gwá ŋmá ipú íkókwū nyā dúu. N le je lɛ Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
idu_Latn: Ádā um nōo kpó odúúdú uwā gā um ā, anú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē lɔfú nū uwā ŋmá abɔ̄ Ádā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ gē nyí anúɔ ojīlīmā, eko nēé gē ka ka ede kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ́ wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ gē je ɔdōlé nɛ̄ uwā abɔ̄yī ūwā í cē lé ŋ́ mā gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukayínān, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Áfāsadi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussɛ́m, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unówa, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ulámēki.

eng_Latn: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ igbīhi ce kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ nū a bɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú nū ā. Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ uwā kpó, ŋmó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā má tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
idu_Latn: ēkwō, ɔŋáŋáa.

eng_Latn: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o he um ɔtū, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpá ɔmpá nɛ̄ n tá fu aá yɔ̄ mɛɛ á. Ipú aɔ́kpá ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā n cēyītīkwū lɛ ɔtū oyēŋēē kú aá héyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tá aá ɛlā kwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā.

eng_Latn: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
idu_Latn: Aá wā í má ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā ooo. Úklɔ́ ōhídáagó nɛ̄ ó yá ɔtāhɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kwu abɔ̄ kú igelī nyā ú kwu ɔtū ka ń gáā yá olɔhi lɛ ɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ n géē je ɔ́ yíífi. N géē je ɔ́ tá abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, ó kē í je ɔ́ yɔlá tū ajɛ.

eng_Latn: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē lé aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá ā: ɛna, álá, ɛwū.

eng_Latn: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si kéē ményinyi aá, kéē yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
idu_Latn: Ujéyɔsi, Usákīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́ma. Odúúdú ayí nū ā kwu kpó pīya ádā kú aípɔ́ɔma kú abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And all the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je ka, odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācoyúklɔ́ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Uháman, ŋmá lɛ o túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā gāá lɛ okwúukwu kwaajɛ lɛ ɔ́, amáŋ, Umɔ́dɛkāyi tá kóō túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛwa kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le fíyɛ́ ɛwa kú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā, ofu igwɛ́ɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛtá ā, a géē fūla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí ohile ā.

eng_Latn: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
idu_Latn: Aá kōō ī bī ɛcɛ gbɛka ŋ́, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔdōlikpó ce ɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ā híīī bī Ujerúsālɛm gbɛka ŋ́, ohígbū koó wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi āa.

eng_Latn: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tá ɔwɛ gbóóló igbīhi nū ipú ísu mɛ́mla ūwū pɛ̄ɛtúu. Ó klla ī je ísu pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ūwū.

eng_Latn: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa kpó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɛna éyi ú lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ubáalu kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, kéē lɛ ɔ́ wā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó klá ɛyí ɛfú, amáŋ é híī lɛ ɔlá kwu ɛfú ā ŋ́. Anúɔ kē í ŋmó ɛna ɔhá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ klla í wā ɔbá ɛna ákú anúɔ ā, kē í kpó ɔ̄ ce ɛyí ɛfú lɛ ā dúú. Anúɔ í gáā le ɔlá kwu ɛfú ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du da Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄kā alɛwa, amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si í cíla odóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujékɔ̄pu nēe wā Íjīpiti mɛ́mla anú ā. Urúbɛn, ɔ́kplá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le má ka, íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ je bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ā ɔ́ɔ ka, eko kú uce kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā, ācɛ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ.

eng_Latn: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ōhī má, nēé hī alɔ igwú kā ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ mla uwá ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛdɔ kú iyāwu nɛ̄ alɔ yɛ gaajɛ Uróm á.

eng_Latn: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, kéē yíihɔtū tá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā háyi pī um, ó kē je ɔfú gā um, ká n̄ tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ odúúdú aílɔ́wá kéē le pó. Óndú ā lɛ um hɛ́tá, ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā kɛpɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmó tū um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī gē lɛ okónu kú uwā klá cíí lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé jé ā, amáŋ, olíla gē bī ogwuda kú nū tɔ́ɔna.

eng_Latn: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi ā í kpɔ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá, kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɔɔ́ ō tíne ō yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Óndú ā le má kéē gē hɛ́pɔ kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ tíkpa kú ádā nū, Ujɛhóyākim, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdōbɔ̄bí mla íne kú Óndú ā bīya á.

eng_Latn: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
idu_Latn: Oklobīya éyi le inya kwu gaá le ka lɛ Umósīsi, ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɛ́ldādi mɛ́mla Umédādi yɔ̄ ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄, nōo gē nya uwá tá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Usídɔn lā ligbó hɛ́ uwā tá. É klla lɛ ɛma mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē tá iyē kwu ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Udáni lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā túgwó klla má lā anú.

eng_Latn: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā eko nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā le pó ka Usamérīya mīyɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā, é le Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá.

eng_Latn: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ahɔ̄lá nyā bá um okónu, anɔ́ɔ ó ka amíyɔ̄ má ɔ̄ ɔhɔ̄lá ā ɔ́ɔ má bá um ákpókónu ɛɛ́. Ó ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ kwú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ amiyɔ̄ yá ā í yá um ɛhi ɛɛ́. Ó ka amiyɔ̄ í lɛ́pɔ̄bí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alɔ kwú ɔyí um ú ŋmó, kwú ɔ̄ ú he lé. Amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ n da ɔ́ ka ālɔ̄ kwú ɔyí nū ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ je ɛbɛ́ nū he lé ā, ó kwú ɔyí nū ú gaá tayínū.

eng_Latn: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā gbɔbū kú enyi kóō kpó ɛcɛ ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé, bá gē gwá. Ācɛ bá gē lɛ ɔbá, é bá gē lɛ ɔnyā, jāā gaá kwu ɛ̄cī piíí nɛ̄ Unówa ga ipú úgbéenyi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ enyi gē wā ī kpó odúúdú uwā ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācɛ nēe wɛ ipú ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēe géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi! Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abāābɔ̄yī nū. Ikwū ɔ́mpa ā í gáā lɔfú ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, é géē je pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá. É kē í cɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla anú iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó.

eng_Latn: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kóō híī nū aá ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó nū ācopɛ̄cí nēe tɛtɛ lā ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī móówē ipú agbá yɔ̄ á. Amáŋ n yúufi ŋ́ ohígbū ka n lɛ ɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, n ke jé cāā ka ó lɔfú gbo olɛhɔ̄ kú ɔkōolɔhi nɛ̄ ó lɛ tū um abɔ̄ ā jāā gbó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā glá.

eng_Latn: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē mīyɛ ɔfú kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, amáŋ, ó géē gbō ācɛ oyólɔhi ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ í yá ā yɔ̄ gē nyīla nwuné fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ɛwa kú ācɛ gē pɛ̄ wā ɛgiyí nú cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, kóō kē hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá ōcē dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ je ɛ̄cī ɛtá lɛ anúɔ kú anúɔ leyī yɛ ɛlā nɛ́ɛ ka ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē wā ɔmɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā kwúcē le pɛ́ tá ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ o he um ɔtū, abɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ bá gē gbēyī ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá cēyītīkwū ká aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ipú eyī nū eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í wā ā ŋ́, aá bá ɛbɔ́ mla anú.

eng_Latn: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā cāŋjɛ lɛyīkwu um ɛɛ́, é klla bá ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bá um.

eng_Latn: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́njamīn nōo wɛ ipɔ́ɔma nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ā, géē wā aflɛ́yí á, cɛ́ɛ́ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ígwu kú uwā kē yɛ ce uwá Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli kéē gbo ce Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
idu_Latn: Agbénú kú aá géē je gblífi, ɛha kē í kpó īlī ká aá lé.

eng_Latn: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa géē ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí kú ajā nēé gbo ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé ŋmó ā, ohígbū ka uwá gē gbaajā, é kē lɛ ācɛ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
idu_Latn: Ulé kú ācɛ ojéeyī wɛ agbénú, amáŋ ulé kú aólíla wɛ íla tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɛ̄ ā le jɛ, kwú yá ijímkpa ɔkpiye mla ipú alelékwū. Ó lā ipú ígbíli jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nōó wā ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú Uféro da ɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā géē junwalu lɛ alɔ í kwu ā? Mā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tá kéē nyɔ̄, kéē gáā gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɛ̄gbā n̄. Á jé ka Íjīpiti le yíífi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ úlā ce ofu igwó ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄. Eko nēé ga ɔkpá kú Ubésɔ ā, ācɛ ōhī kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi má bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Upɔ́lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Átɛnsi, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Ukɔ́rīnti.

eng_Latn: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí kú ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔcí kú ufígi ā kwú ŋmɔ́lá ɛɛ́, odúúdú ɔcí ō gwíīkpó, kwu Upómɛ̄gránāte, alī, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔcí ɔhá ā, kwú kpó wúla ēpū klla le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́, éeyē kú ācɛ ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And see, if it goeth up by the way of his own coast to Bethshemesh, then he hath done us this great evil: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that smote us: it was a chance that happened to us.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīkwu ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka, ó gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ lɛyíkwu igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ubɛti Usɛ́mɛ̄ssi, ayíka, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē tū ōcē obɔ̄bí ā mla ákanya ā klá alɔ á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ó kē yɛ lɛyíkwu abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, alɔ kē í jé ka ó wɛ anú tū ōcē obɔ̄bí ā wā í klá alɔ ā ŋ́, ɛ́mba ɔdā kú ámíyā kú abɔ̄yī nú nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le uwā bī wā ipú inu, anɔ́ɔ ó le éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ikpó kpó na. Ó kōō le ɔdōlé kpó lɛ aíjakī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó gē pi gwá ā wɛ ɛ́fa kú ogwiji. Ɛ́fa ā kē ī je ɔ̄ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo klla wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú um ā, jāhɔ̄ káā pó ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je ā, ohígbū ka awɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔcí olɔhi o nwuné nɛ̄hi ā kpó gē um.

eng_Latn: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Uhɔ́ri, nēe lā ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā á. É wɛ Ulótan, Ussɔ́balu, Usíbīyɔn, Ána.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā ka, Ɔnyɛ géē nyɔ̄ í plla Áhābu ga ɔgbɛ́fú kú Urámɔtu nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ā? Aóhī kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kɛlā éyi, ɔhá kɛlā ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ācɛ Umówābu yálé, lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá kpó kwú. Ó le ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɛtá kú uwá kpó ŋmó. Ó cɛ̄ le aálagbá kú ɛfú ā ké má gwutáajɛ le eyí pīya kláajɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kpó ācɛ ɛpa ŋmó ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɛtá á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Umówābu gaá bá ɛháajɛ kú nū klla gbɔɔ́ o téélí lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
idu_Latn: Óndú, géē yá uwā italā ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā piíí. Ó géē je uwá kpó yíífi, ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ géē kpó uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko gē wā nɛ̄ Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē je ojīlīmā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe géē hile ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfulā kú ododó ā klá uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujékɔ̄pu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú aéwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
idu_Latn: É gē pi alɔ bɛ̄ɛka, ijakī ámāŋ ka inyankwūlūmī ā, ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ alɔ, é kē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le bá lɛ Udéfīdi ajaajɛ ā, ɔlɛɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ gē lɛ Usɔ́lu ka ɔ́ɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ páápá, ācɛ Ufilístiya lɛ ɔfú kpó wā í gwō ɔlɛ́ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
idu_Latn: Alɔ leyīkwu áncā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú alɔ je kpó yíífi á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú ī gwéeyē ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā gɛ ŋ́.
