eng_Latn: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ, jíliyē, abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu má kwu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá kahíníī, Áa lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo húmáyi kɛlā gā um ā, gā igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le um jíleyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā nēé yá nyā má ā, ó le má ka, é habɔ̄ ucē ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ā tá ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ á. Ó le eyīnyinyi uwā má, anɔ́ɔ ó je uwá kpó yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
idu_Latn: okónu kú um í gāa kɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dúúmā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē plla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā fu Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, yɔ̄ ī da ɔ́ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā ka ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usenakérīibu, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā kwú yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu kwúcē ga Unínīfɛ á.

eng_Latn: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
idu_Latn: Yúufi ɔcɛ́ nōo le cɔ̄nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a í yúufi ágábá nōo yɔ̄ ī tū oji ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔtū bīya, le iyī nū ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú aá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nōo lā ipú alácɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
idu_Latn: Cɛ̄ lɛ ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa alɔ kéē lɛ ɔda olɔhi éyi bī abɔ̄ gē yá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī le yá ɛgbá ícíícɛ kú uwā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē tīīle lɛ iyí uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
idu_Latn: Ishár ma ayí ɛtá: Ukóra, Unefɛ́gi mɛ́mla Usíkri.

eng_Latn: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
idu_Latn: A le ɛga yá ga um cɛ́ɛ́ kú aólɛlā kú um kéē kwú um ŋ́. Ń kē plla gwōnū jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́, abɔ̄ dúúmā í gáā kwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī ge jé eko mɛ́mla ɔwɛ o yá odée.

eng_Latn: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kē lɔfú ícɛ nyā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ lɛ eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi tū um ɛhɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ ā. N kē lɔfú kpɛ́fú ámāŋ ka o yá ɛdɔ ɔdā ɔhá glá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ gbonɛnɛ klla ī ményinyi alɔ. Ó géē nya alɔ tá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɔ kú ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī gē fíyajɛ ī nū obū ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
idu_Latn: Upíta le ācɛ ā hīgwú wā inu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ uwá kéē le gbo pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄. Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ó nyāŋjɛ le yɛ mla uwá, ayínɛ́ ōhī nēe bá Ujɔ́pa ā lɛ ɔ́ bíyē nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá má tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́. É kwú igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá ā ú kpó tɔ̄lá ɛɛ́. Aá leyīkwu cɔɔɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ éwɔhá mīyɛ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá klla le ɔdā dúúmā nēé má ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú ācɛ nōo lɛ eyī ā géē nwūla anú í mɛ́ɛbɛ. Ācɛ nōo lɛ ahɔ̄ ā kē í jāhɔ̄ ā í pó ɛlā.

eng_Latn: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá á. Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá ā gē je oyēeyī kú nū kwɛyí ákú aálá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá ɔkpancílé tū aá, amáŋ aá kē jījē ŋ́. Alɔ kē gwíijē ɛyíkwū, aá kē jikwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá ācɛ Ujíyu ā, Ɔwɔicō le alɛɛcɛ ɔhá kú ɛcɛ kagwó mla iyīnū. Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, eko nēé í mīyɛ uwá ā. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyēeyī lɛ ācɛ nōo gekwú āa.

eng_Latn: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
idu_Latn: A gē dɛ̄gba tū ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ gē pi uwá ahɔ̄, lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ojuja kú ɔlá ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, Umíriyam kwú gbo agwú, kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ fíyɛ́ áfū. Árɔ̄ni pīyeyī má Umíriyam, anɔ́ɔ ó má koó kwú gbaagwú.

eng_Latn: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɔ́dɛkāyi lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá nyā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́, mɛ́mla áluka kú ije nɛ̄ Uháman cokónu ka anúɔ géē gbā lɛ ɔcɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.
idu_Latn: ohígbū koó lɛ alelékwū olɔhi kú íjééyī, ɔdōōjé, ɛbɛ oōmá, ɛyí ɔ̄na ō ka, mɛ́mla unwalu ō ŋmúla dóódú yɔ̄ ipú Udánīyɛlu nyā nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ hī ka Ubɛ́ltɛssása ā. Lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ Udánīyɛlu hīīgwú gé lɛ uwɔ. Ó í da uwɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛyí ɔkpá nyā wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo gē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya nyā ā géē je ɔ́lé ɛga otīihɔ éyi, ipú eyīpú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwu oje ā ú cīgbīhi lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū á. Ó le ɛkpa ɛpa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā kpó lɛ onɔwá éyi. Ó le ojibó ā gbā ŋmá ɔcí éyi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ma plá anú á. É kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ipú inu ɔlɛ́ Umíka.

eng_Latn: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n gē gbɛ̄gbā á, abɔ̄ uwɔ gē kwú um. N yɔ̄ ī yúnwū uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ajɛ íkpākplā kú ɔnɔ̄ gē yúnwū éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ijēenyi kú n̄ lɛ uwɔ má eyī gē ŋmó um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ijēenyi éŋkpɔ̄ gē ŋmó um ā.

eng_Latn: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu éyi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄ ŋmó, ó le ɛpɔ̄ nū cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdée fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti ā le ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyābu, Ujɛ́rōham mɛ́mla Ɛlkána.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā ā koó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ anúɔ ká anúɔ gwá, ohígbū ka ijēēnyi ɔ́ɔ gáā je anúɔ ŋmó ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔjá kú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā nwūla, lɛ enyāmɛ̄ ɛna hɛ́ ŋmá anú lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɛ̄nyā le yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Ó yá ede kú oje udɔ ā, ɔdā nēé le oje udɔ wúlá wúlá pla tū ipú nū ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyó kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ɔyínɛ́ kú ɔnyā nū, Uhɔ́bābu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́tro, ɔ̄cɛ kú Umídiyan ā kahíníī, Alɔ gáā ga ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ka anúɔ géē je lɛ alɔ ā ɛɛ́. Wā mla alɔ, alɔ géē yá uwɔ lɔhi. Óndú ā cokónu kú ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kpó ŋmó kú a lɛ uwá kpó hɛ́ ɔkɔ. Ákú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn mɛ ɛɛ́. Eko ō yá uwá italā ga ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ká alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo hɛ́ um tá ŋmá obɔ̄bí dóódu ā, kóō hɔ́hā ce ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ nyā. Ká iyē kú um mɛ́mla iyē kú ádáádā um, Ébrahām mɛ́mla iyē kú Áyísīki, ádā um kéē yɔ̄ ī gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū oŋmá ɛgiyí ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ nēe bá ā! Kéē ma ayí lɛwa, kéē lɛ ayááyí alɛwa ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā yá odée ā le bá ɛɛ́. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī kú ojuja odobū mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī unwalu lɛ éwo dóódu.

eng_Latn: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yúklɔ́ kú ɔdōlé nōo gē bīya ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ɔdōlé nōo gē je oyēeyī opiyóó, nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē je lɛ aá ā. Ohígbū ɛnyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā ā.

eng_Latn: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū kú ācɛ kéē kpɔ́tūce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi je ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ācogbāājɛ nēe gwū ɔwɛ tū alɔ ipú agbá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́tuce Ujísɔ̄si nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ā mafú.

eng_Latn: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ igelī, nōo kwu okónu ísu klla ītá ɔ́su mla ācɛ nēe lā aókónu ísu ā. Le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā da ɔ́. Da ɔ́ kahíníī, Utáya, a gwō kú ɔhi nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó kē habɔ̄ iyī nū tá icííci nōó lɛ ijáalí ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū kóō gē ma ogbonɛnɛ kú nū fú ŋmá lɛ ɔwɔ nōo ī yā ŋmá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ ō yá eko kú uwā. Ó kē je ɔdōlé lɛ aá klla ī yá ká ɔtū kóō he aá.

eng_Latn: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n má ā ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ajɛ ɔfiyɛ mɛ́mla um ā á.

eng_Latn: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kéē géē lé ɔdōlé klla í nū ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, nōo í yá kéē tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ahínyá, ohígbū ajɛ o yá ɔdɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n le ɛlá gbo kwu Ɔwɔicō, n le owu hīlatá huumm. Eko nɛ̄ n le ɛlá gbo kwu ɔ́ nɛɛ, ɔtū kú um kwú gbenyi.

eng_Latn: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔkɔ kú nū pó ā, n le hɛ́kwú tá ajɛ kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ́, lɛ eyī pīya kláajɛ.

eng_Latn: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka ā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi lɛ ācɛ olɔhi kéē le nyatá, ɔdí kē í yá ācobīyíne nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
idu_Latn: Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú uwɔ ā le uwɔ plla ɛɛ́, awɔ nōo gwó ɔlɛ́ wu ɛplá ápátɛ́cɔ̄, awɔ nōo lā ɛyí ɛfu généé ā, anɔ́ɔ a gē da iyī uwɔ ka, Ɔ̄nyɛ pi um wāajɛ glá āā?.

eng_Latn: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla le ka ɛgɔhá kahíníī, A wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya piyóó, bɛ̄ɛka Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki ā.

eng_Latn: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
idu_Latn: Ugóma klla le ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyínɔ̄nya éyi ma. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Uhosíya kóō kwú iyē í ce ɔyí ā ka, Eyinyinyi í yɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɛyí kú iyē ā wɛ Ń ményinyi uwɔ ŋ́. Ó ka ohígbū ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā ményinyi ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je obɔ̄bí kú uwā yá uwā ɛhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé ma ŋmá ɔkpíyē wɛ ɔkpíyē, ɔdā nēé ma ŋmá Alelékwū ā wɛ ákú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a le hídáagó ā? N géē da uwɔ ɛyí kú ɔdā otayínū lɛyíkwu ɔnyā ā mɛ́mla ákú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nōo lɛ īkpɛ̄yí ahāapa mɛ́mla ajī igwó, nōo bī ɔnyā ā.

eng_Latn: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Úklɔ́ kú ayí kú Ukɔ́hāti ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nāa géē lɛ ŋmá ikwū kú um ā? Itene nyá nāa géē lɛ ɔ́dāŋ ka n gekwú ā? Ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ glá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? É géē bá ī kɛlá ɔkwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ ɛcɛ nōo yɔ̄ icō kú alɔ ámāŋ ɛcɛ nōo nɛ̄ yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú alɔ ā, ámāŋ ɔdā dúú nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé yá ā, í lɔfú hɛ́ alɔ ŋmá ihɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō nōó mafú lɛ alɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, Óndú alɔ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Unówa, Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla Ujóbu lā abɔ́ɔ nááná, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā ɛ́ɛ́ gáā nyā ayí abɔ̄yī uwá tá glá ŋ́. Ka olɔhi kú uwá ɔ́ɔ géē nya oyēeyī kú iyī uwá tá ofōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔ̄ ɔtū kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá odiyɔ kú nū, amáŋ nɛ̄ó he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́. Ádā nū kóō lɛ ɔ́ fūla, é gáā je ɔ́ lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ílɔ́wá ŋ́ ohígbū ka óndú ɔfiyɛ ā le okónu nēé ce ā nyílá.

eng_Latn: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ī cokónu olɔfú mɛ́mla ācɛ alɛwa, iháyí ahāapa. Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɛtá ce ɔyā ɛhīlī gaá le gla, ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ gwɛ́ɛya ámāŋ bī ɔdā ɛgbā wā í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É géē je ɔdā kú ɛbɛ ohéyī ɔ́ɔmā háyi ɛga o licō fíyɛ́ dúú kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Ó ī ce abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ɔ́ ce abɔ́ɔ ā ú yíífi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ miya ɔ́ táajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le nyīla nɛ̄hi, klla le uwá yá lɔfú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wu úlā igwáahāapa cofigwó, mɛ́mla aínyankwūlūmī úlā ahāapa cofigwó, mɛ́mla aɛ́na úlā ɛpa cofigwó mɛ́mla aíjakī úlā éyi cofɛhɔ̄. Ó klla lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ alɛwa. Anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, nōo lɛ agbénú fíyɛ́ dúú ipú odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú um á, ká aá yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yíihɔtū tū aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
idu_Latn: Awɔ le ɔfú tū alɔ iyē nɛ̄ alɔ yá aólɛlā kú alɔ lé á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le íne tá ohígbū ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kahíníī, Oŋmá ícɛ nyā Uféro lɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ aá géē cē ā á. É ī lɛ íne nyā tū jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā. Ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ōfōōfūnū í yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Uféro gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka gā uwɔ bū okónu kú um ā, nɛ̄ ó yá uwɔ abɔ́ɔ á. Ó kwú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ klla kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Udéfīdi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayááyí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le nyīla klla kwú lɛwa nɛ̄hi. É klla kwú lɔfú nɛ̄hi dúú. É le agbénú nɛ̄hi klla le fāajɛ ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kahíníī, É lɛ uwɔ nyatá ɛɛ́ ohígbū ka a lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō. Nyɔ̄ mla ɛbɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gā ɛgiyí um gē jāhɔ̄ ī pó ɛlā ā nōó klla ī bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́, n géē ma ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōó gbla ā fú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ ka lɛ uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ í yɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwá lé.

eng_Latn: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ a bī okónu kú uwɔ ā ka nɛ̄ n pó ahɔ̄ abɔ̄yī um ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
idu_Latn: klla yúklɔ́ idáagó ipú ajɛ kú Uhám ā. Ó klla yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛhɔ̄ kú uwā gā Ugíbēya, ɛga nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lā ā, é lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ, eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ā le ɛlā ā pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, Ujósuwa, ɔyí kú Unún, gekwú eko nōó wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwó ā.

eng_Latn: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ Usáyɔn túgwó, ó géē ma ɛgahi kú nū fú lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ébrahām, Áyísīki ā ma ayí ɛpa, Ísɔ mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í gáā je ɛya otīīhɔ tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā nyā le kpó hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. É klla kahíníī, Ó gē yá ɔdā dóódu kú nū lɔhi. Ó kōō lɛ odahɔ̄ yá kóō páhɔ̄, ó klla lɛ odokónu yá kóō kɛlā dúú.

eng_Latn: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá keé kōō fu aícɔ́ɔ́ja nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Asírīya dúúmā iyē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, nááná nɛ́ɛ kē ī leyīce ācɛ Íjīpiti kéē lɛ úgbɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnya tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ obū kwú du odúúdú ajɛ ā oŋmá oje igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā jāā gbó oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ á.

eng_Latn: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú áluka kú aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū nēe kē ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ipú iháyí ékpónú piyóo, ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ukɛ́da ā géē mɛ ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá aɔ́cɛ́ kú aólɛla kú uwā lé. Ó kéē géē kpó uwā ŋmó, jāā gbéeko nēé kwú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ gā um lɛ ɛlá wu aɔ́dā icííci kú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá olɔhi gā um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ uwá má ā, ó lɛ uwá hīgwú, é habɔ̄ ádā uwá mɛ́mla aólufa tá ipú ɔ́kɔ, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu á.

eng_Latn: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
idu_Latn: Ukayáfāsi wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo da ācɛ Ujíyu ka ó cɛgbá ká ɔ̄ce éyi kóō gekwú ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī yá uwɔ italā ohígbū ka ucē ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ a yá ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ a yá ā kē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n le ohi tá ɔ̄ ka ɔ́dāŋ ká ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ lɛ ā ŋ́, ɔ́ɔ géē kwú piíí.

eng_Latn: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ɔtū le wú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdí nōó gē kpó ɛ̄nyā bónū ā mɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
idu_Latn: Aá klla í je opī éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú ínoōbīya, cɛ́ɛ́ aá bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú ācɛ ā yá dúú.

eng_Latn: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu tá ohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu, nōo ŋmá Utásɔsi ipú Usilísiya, ɔ̄cɛ kú igelī ocɛgbá nɛ̄hi. N gē ba uwɔ kā ā lɛ ɛga je gā um ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, lɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti ā gbaáluka.

eng_Latn: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwá géē bēhé wā Ujerúsālɛm ā. É klla kē í lɛ ɛdɔ íkwu kú ɔcɛ́ ɛdɔ nɛ̄ Údéfīdi lɛ ā. Uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm bú ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla ɔnya ō ce. Igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm kē mu mla ācɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō kú ɛbɔ́, kwú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cogbāálá nɛ̄hi kú álá ā í héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ohígbū kóō kwú ikwū ɛya nēé je ɔ̄ gwó ā, o ŋmá lɛ ikwū nyā ó kwú ɛka nōo í yɔ̄ piyóó ú kwajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yāwu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, okómpīinu nēé hī ka ákú Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, olagbénú éyi ŋmá Arimatéya gā. Iyē nū wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu, ó kē wɛ ɔyíkpó kú Ujísɔ̄si dúú.

eng_Latn: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ, klla gē bɔ̄bíipú, gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā, Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ajɛ ŋmá ɔcɛ́, ɛga kú ojīlīmā kú nū hɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a gē yíhɔtū tá ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē yá tá ācɛ nēe yíhɔtū uwɔ ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́ yá tɛ́ɛcɛ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā péee ka aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ohile ā, í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ka anúɔ klla le jé ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā pée ka ɔ́ɔ géē he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ɔ́dáŋ ka Ábsālɔm ɔ́ɔ yēeyī nɛ̄ odúúdú aá ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó í pīya yɛ ɛháajɛ ga ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gaá kwu ísu ɔmā ā. Ɛga nēe bá nyā géē wɛ ɔkíkā ɛnɛ kú ajɛ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́srɔn ma ayí ɛtá nēe lé ka, Ujɛ́ramīilu, Urám mɛ́mla Ukálēbu.

eng_Latn: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɔkɔ gbā gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ, awɔ gē gbō ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛcɛ á. A lɔfú klla nwuné, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ gbla awɔ glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kōō bɛ́yíkwu uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nɔ̄na tɔ̄há otú ékpónú, ɔ̄na kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kē lɛyí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
idu_Latn: Ó ka, Nyɔ̄ gaá ka lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā. Aá géē pi ahɔ̄ ŋlēŋlē í jāhɔ̄, amáŋ aá gáā jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā dúú ŋ́, aá géē pléeyī kwɛcɛ nɛ̄hi, amáŋ aá gáā má ɔdā dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi fíyaa. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú eyī ú pīya klá ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācobɔbíipú í gáā lā ɛbɔ́ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le cɔ̄nū mla awɔ, ɛhi ō yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tayínū ā géē tú ɔ̄ ɔtū wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
idu_Latn: É le nyīla klá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ aálá kú uwā géē má ácí lé mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɔpɛ́ kú ɛga nēe kwú lɛ iyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, n géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka okónu ɔhá nɛ̄ a ce lɛ ádā um, Udéfīdi ka ka ɔyí nū éyi ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī cɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ yɛce anúɔ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú anúɔ kpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá ā, tū.

eng_Latn: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra uwɔ Ɔwɔicō, ā híī yɔ̄ cíí gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ lɛ odée yá mɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū Alelékwū nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lɔtūce ɔ́ ā géē mīyɛ ā. Ohígbū ka jāā kwu eko ɔ́ɔmā é je Alelékwū ā lɛ ācɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū keé je Ujísɔ̄si gicō ipú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ tútū ohígbū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá nōo ī wā ā, aá híī gwutá mla anyā aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si jé ka é gáā kwú ɔ̄ abɔ̄fú kéē je ɔ́ lé ɔ̄cɛ́ ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ lɛ tá ɛyí ɛfu, ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Ugáálu lɛ ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm kpó ga ɛcɛ í kpɛ́fú tá Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
idu_Latn: Igbō kú aflɛ́yí nēé géē yá ŋmá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú alɔ iháyí dóódu ā, alɔ géē bī gē lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, iháyí dóódu mɛ́mla ɛhi kú īkpɔ̄dā, ejé, anɔ̄ kú ólīfu mɛ́mla ɛdɔ īkpɔ̄cí ɔhá dóódu. Ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipíigwó kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú alɔ dóódu, alɔ géē je kpó gé lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe gē mīyɛ ɛhi nyā igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú alɔ dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, á mā uwā tá ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka a gē méyīnyinyi nɛ̄hi. Á kē je ojuja mɛ́mla ɔlá nēe gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jé ɔwɛ otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā, ŋmá ɛgiyí uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔnyā nɛɛ? Ayíka ā híīī nū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Á lɛ ɔnyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ayíka a híīī dɔɔ̄kā ɔnyā ká ā lɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, Ugolíyāti gē wā í cá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛcá.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo gē bī iyó kú alɔ ɛ̄cī dóódu ā. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē nya alɔ tá á.

eng_Latn: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā lɛ ɔkɔ nyā pó ā, ufi kē yá uwā nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí éyi eko nɛ̄ Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan cēenyi klá ɛcɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é kē le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā gaá kwú ācɛ nēe lā ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú kpó pahīla, kwu ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya um mɛ́mla áncɛ́nyā um, o he um ɔtū, Ɔwɔicō lɛ okónu ce lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Ká alɔ lɛ aɔ́dā nēe ī yá kú ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla odo kú alɔ kéē blínyī ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ lā oyēeyī ōtīihɔ ohígbū ka alɔ ī yúúfi Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
idu_Latn: Īlī nɛ̄hɛ́, īlī odufā, īlī ɔgalúlā, īlī nɔwā, mɛ́mla īlī kú ɔnwū ɛwū.

eng_Latn: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
idu_Latn: N tá ɔkpá nyā gé lɛ ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ipú Ukɔ́rīnti ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū fu kéē wɛ ācɛ otīihɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū keé le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɛɔ́nyɛtá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdu ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu nēe gē gbā Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo wɛ Óndú uwā mɛ́mla Óndú alɔ dúú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū hīīgwú kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ íbɔm cē tū Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ukéyīla.

eng_Latn: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
idu_Latn: Anú lóofu fíyɛ́ dúú ipú Aícɔ́ɔja ofu cigwó ā á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú uwā. Amáŋ ó lóofu gāajɛ Aícɔ́ɔja ɛtá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī tayínū ŋmá īkpēyī kú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe lɛ oyēeyī ipú ɛcɛ ā. Aígbáanɔ nēe gē wu icō nááná í kōō má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ékpónú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, anú fíyɛ́ ɛ̄cī úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ɛga ɔhá dóódu á. Ó gēe lɔhi gā um fíyɛ́ ká n̄ háyi okónu ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú um, fíyɛ́ ō nyɔ̄ í lā ɔlɛ́ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Mīyɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú ɔtulalī nɛ̄ n gwó gā uwɔ ā. Mīyɛ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n je gicō ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nēé gē gwó ā.

eng_Latn: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ŋmá ipɔ́tū nɛ̄ ɛlá obɔ̄bí, ɔ̄cɛ ōŋmó, ajā ōgbo, uwī ōwī, ibéenú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō cɛ̄, mɛ́mla iyē ō bīya ācɛ anú gē bɛ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií nōo yɛ ā, nɛ̄ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ uwɔ tá á, amáŋ oŋmá lɛ ihɔtū nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n lɛ gā uwɔ ā, n géē je uwɔ kwucē wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kú Ujúda, n cɛ̄ lɛ aá lɛ ejé ohɔ́nɔ kú italā kú um gwá ŋmá ipú ikókwū kú um ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú um. Amáŋ odúúdú aéwo nēe yɛ jīla aá tá ā géē gwá ejé kú italā ɛ̄nɛ̄ o hɔ́nɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. É géē gwá, géē bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí, cɛ́ɛ́ é gebí tāajɛ icííci.

eng_Latn: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le íne bīya ɔdā nōo tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā wɛ ikwū, amáŋ ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī je alahá ā wɛ oyēeyī nōó ī mɛ ŋ́ ipú o pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ka anúɔ húmáyī cɛ́ɛ́cá klla ī yókónu lɛ ā āa? Ami kɛ̄ɛɛ? Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō lɛ gbla um ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ a lɔtū nwūla okónu gē yá um aflūmā á kɛ̄ɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛlā kú únɛ́pɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ā, mafú ka aá le yá bɔ̄bí ɛɛ́. Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kéē pīya aá tū ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kéē hɛ́ aá éjulúgwu ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lɛ abɔ̄ da ɔ́mpa aá ɛyí tū ajɛ ŋ́ ámāŋ nú ɔdā dóódu kú nū abɔ̄fú ŋ́. Aá híī bī ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo yúklɔ́ lɛ aá ā otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛga dúú nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ̄ ā, eyīpɔ́lɛ́, igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, aɔ́lɛ́ kú ɛhɔ̄, ācɛ gē kpó ācɛ odoōcē kú ɔlɛ́ uwā gā ɛga ōlihī anɔ́ɔ é gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ odoōcē ā kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okónu ogwu kú úwé kú nū kénékēē, anɔ́ɔ ōcē kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā mɛ á.

eng_Latn: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yá kpɛ́mm, cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla wā ī háyi iyɔ̄bū um, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú ami abɔ̄yī um ā, gē ka ka, Ɔdā dóódu o bɔ̄bí í gáā yá alɔ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla bá ī yá aɔ́dōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā nēe ī wú um ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ágábá í wā gaá kwú álá nōó ī yúúfi ámāŋ lɛ ɛlá wu ɛgba nɛ̄ ígwu kú ācogbāálá ī dɛ̄ mɛ́mla uya kú uwā ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē wā í kpɛ́fú ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn á.

eng_Latn: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ádā alɔ oŋmá éko tééko piyóó. Aamí.

eng_Latn: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Usenakéribu, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā gaá le ɔfú kpó kwu odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda nēé hí igá tū ɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ uwá abɔ̄fú á.

eng_Latn: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
idu_Latn: Aálá kú um gē pó ɔkɔ kú um, n kē jé uwā, é kē í yɛce um.

eng_Latn: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ, ó gáā lɔfú yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi lɛ inya kwu wā ɛgiyí Ujóbu gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ bī aɛ́na kú uwɔ ā bā í hɛ́hɔ̄, aíjakī ā kē bā í lé ácí kwu uwá ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N gē tū owu okwɔ́la nɛ̄hi klá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá nyī ā, kóō lɛ uwá kpó yíífi, amáŋ, aá pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Uhamáti, ɔcɛ́ kú Ápāadi, ɔcɛ́ kú Uséfabeyim, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́na mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ífa nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kpó yíífi ā bá āa?.

eng_Latn: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.
idu_Latn: É ka amáŋ ede nɛ̄ aá gwó ā wɛ ɔdā ocābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, mɛ́mla aɛ́gɔ́ kú ācɛ nēe í wā igbīhi aá, ka, aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ɔkwɛ̄yi ipéyī nū. Aá bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ ɔ́. Ɛ̄nyā í klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ayááyí uwā kéē dá ayááyí aá ka ɔdā dúú ɔ́ gbo ákú aá mla Óndú ā ō gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má Ɔwɔicō īkpēyī jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa alɔ, Ɔwɔicō lā ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla alɔ, ihɔtū kú nū le yá jīla ipú ɔtū kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔkwu ɛlā ā bū ā, é le má ka ɛlā ā wɛ okwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ é kwu ācɛ nēe tū ujɔ̄ nyā ú kpó tōōlī playiicō á. Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nyā tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya.

eng_Latn: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā, aá kwu īlī ekwu ú kpó wiiyē ká aá jikwū klla tɛ̄gíkwū. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi da alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujúda ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, iháyí ɔ́mɛta yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á nɛ̄ n gē wā amānyā gē dɔɔ̄kā ikpo ufígi, ŋmá ɔcí ufígi nyā ā. Ń kē má ikpó dúúmā ŋ́. Lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ! Ɔdí yá nōó yɔ̄ ī mīyɛ ajɛ kú ɔcí ɔhá tābɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: anú mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ɛbéenyi kú ipú ísu ā géē pɛ kwú. Ísu ā í níípī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti í gáā lɔfú hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá anú gwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā gē yá ká ā lɛ oyēeyī olīkpō mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbū piyóó.

eng_Latn: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
idu_Latn: Anátōtū, Unóbu, Ananíya.

eng_Latn: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī ga ɔwɛ nōo pīyeyī kwú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
idu_Latn: A klla í je ɔgbanjɛ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɛga ō háyi kú nū ā tū Óndú ā abɔ̄, ó ŋmá lɛ o mí anɔ̄ ō tīihɔ klá anú.

eng_Latn: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pó ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛɛ́. Ó klla le ahɔ̄ jē le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da aá ka, aá lɛ um má ɛɛ́, nááná aá kē cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ ā. Ó kwú ɔ́wá kú aíju ā ú kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro, aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Iju ékpónú í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī lé ɔdōlé ā, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ā, é le ígwu kú ācɛ kú Íssmɛ̄lu nēe ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di bá ī yɛ ga Íjīpiti ā má. Aínyankwūlūmī kú uwā bī iyó kú anɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu abɔ̄yīnū gáā klá pī okónu ɔwɛ nōo bū ɛyí ɛfú kú Uhakíla ā. Udéfīdi kē klá ígbíli ā kpɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ ó le jé ka Usɔ́lu ɔɔ́ gaá yɔ̄ ī tíne anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū géē gbenyi lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwā. Ufi nɛ̄hi géē kwú ācōgwɛ́ɛya ā, eyījii nɛ̄hi géē yá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
idu_Latn: Ujaásīya ma ayí ɛtá: Ussóham, Usáku mɛ́mla Íbri.

eng_Latn: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ íne kú uwɔ nyílá klla tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka lɛ alɔ ā. Alɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, a le okónu ō tá nēé tá tū ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā tá lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē tá aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū, alɔ kē ka lɛ aá lɔfúlɔfú kú aá lā oyēeyī kú aá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū géē he Ɔwɔicō nōo hī aá igwú kú aá lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú nū ā lɛ.

eng_Latn: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ Óndú ā, húmáyī gbō um ŋmá unwalu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ ā á. Awɔ gē yá nɛ̄ n gē yá aólɛlā kú um lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú um lɛ ojīlīmā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū dúúmā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um á, ícɛ nyā n le pīya Ádā uwɔ ɛɛ́ ŋ Amáŋ eko nyá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu kahíníī, N géē wɛ ádā nū, ó géē wɛ ɔyí um ā?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
idu_Latn: ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛhícō ɛga oligbó ā. Ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi ŋmá aéwɔhá alɛwa, nēe cē aɔ́nya ɛfú kú uwá géē wā mɛ́mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le okónu ce le Ébrahām ka ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya ádā kú éwo alɛwa ā, Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́tūce nááná nōó lɛ ɔdā nōó í kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ŋ́ mā. Ɔwɔicō klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ayááyí kú uwɔ géē lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le uwá kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu ŋmá igelī ā jāā ga Ubɛ́tāni á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó je abɔ̄ kú nū gicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ujóbu, nɛ̄ atufú ō ka í lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó ge gwá āa.

eng_Latn: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
idu_Latn: A lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ami āa? Ɔkɔ kú uwɔ gē gbo akpáabana bɛ̄ɛka ákú um ā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka é háyi ójīla kú um ɔkpáncō nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í lɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú um cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É kē í yɛ í lɛ uwá pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé ī yá ā, mɛ́mla ucē ɔ́bíipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛwa ā nū nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ā, ó le tá ɛyí ɛfu ōfūnū kóō nyɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, ó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ōfūnū.

eng_Latn: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē ɔ́bíipú ɛmulá nɛ̄ n yá ā? Lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ń lɛyítáajɛ ga uwɔ ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n yá bɔ̄bí ā mafú gā um.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ó gaá ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā, ó kwú ācɛ ɛpa nēe ŋmó ádā nū ā ú kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa le ayí Ulífāyi ā yá yēŋēē, klla lɛ uwá iyē gwu, é géē yúklɔ́ gā um ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɔtūce Íjīpiti kéē tá aá abɔ̄ nɛɛ? Ɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka, o lɛ ɔnji yá ɔcí ō kwaajɛ, ó kē í je yíla í bū tū uwɔ abɔ̄. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti lɛ, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le ɔtū kpóce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu í gbā gā awɔ ā pó, eko dúúmā nēé lɛ eyī pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi amānyā. Kócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ í gbā ɔ́ɔmā pó ɔkpáncō kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ alɔ bī ā í yá alɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
idu_Latn: É kwú aólíla ú kpó ce ɛga kú ojīlīma nɛ̄hi, klla kwú aólɔdu ú kpó bá ɛháajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá he ɔ́ ɔtū, yɔ̄ mla ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, é kē gáā yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú kóō bīyíne ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
idu_Latn: Uríya nōo ŋmá Uhɛ́ti ā. Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú ā wɛ ofu cigwáahāapa.

eng_Latn: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ kwú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga okónu ɔwɛ nēé hī ka Ɔwɛ kú Ɔnya ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
idu_Latn: N bī íkwu kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ī da ācɛ nēe bá ā lɔfúlɔfú kéē yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é cíkā ó yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ kéē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdōōwiyē nēé cɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
idu_Latn: É le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá únóji, igbīhi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwu ā, é le pɛ́ tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā, ācɛ alɛwa kē má uwā.

eng_Latn: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi ā lɛ ɔ́ bī gicō, lɛ odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ nyā mafú lɛ ɔ́ ipú eyī ō cēbeé á.

eng_Latn: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ācɛ a da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú oyēeyī kú alɔ ú, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, alɔ í yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ ka ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ hímāyī yá ā ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú ajɛ nyā ú lɛ alɔ, alɔ géē yá uwɔ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ í je mlanyī eko kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cabá ā ipú ajɛ nyā, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā nōo gaá kwúcē eko ɔ́ɔmā ā géē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá géē je aá yíífi, é géē ŋmó aá bónū ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá piíí ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā blakwu aá, ɔhá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā géē tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, eko nyá nɛ̄ alɔ má uwɔ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwɔ nɛ̄ alɔ je ɔdōlé gā uwɔ āa? Amáŋ nɛ̄ ijēēnyi yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwɔ nɛ̄ alɔ je éŋkpɔ̄ gā uwɔ ā gwá āa?.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē da uwɔ ka, n géē kpó aícɔ́ɔja nēe bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá. É klla í kpó ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ le lé jɛ̄ iyī uwā. Iwili kú ɔdōlé ā nōo hile nɛ̄ ayíkpó kpó ŋmá ajɛ ā wɛ ómbilí ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ewo wu klá ɛyí, klla le awulú kú nū ā híla tū iyī nū iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú abɔ̄ ú pīya klá eyī ipú uwēyī, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū lɛyíkwu ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Unebúkádinēsa ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, ka anúɔ klla gáā yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú nū kóō gbō anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ipú ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔyā igwó kú iháyí ɔ́mahāanɛ nɛ̄ Usedekíya ce ɔcɛ́ ā, Unebúkádinēsa le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā kpó wā Ujerúsālɛm, gaá le íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄. Ó le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛ́fú kú uwā cēce eyiyɛ̄cɛ kú igá kú Ujerúsālɛm. Ó klla le úbɔ̄ kú íbɔm o licō nɛ̄hi ma yɛ ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā jīla tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kóō híī bū uwā abɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē mī oyī kú nū klá ɛyí ede ā ipéyī Óndú ā, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, klla í je ijē kú nū yɔlá, ká ocu kú nū kóō he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Bethcar.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Umísipa abɔ́ɔ, gbɔɔ́ ō nū ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya inya. É ŋmó uwā jāā ga ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛ́tíkā.

eng_Latn: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka alɔ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nááná nɛ̄ odúúdú ɛcɛ kē yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bípú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
idu_Latn: Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n je uwēyī lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ɛga otīihɔ kú um ā á. N klla kwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í tá kéē lɛ uwá kpó yíífi, kéē klla je uwēyī lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú aígbáanɔ dóódu gē gwó ɔlɛ́ uwá ce ābɔ̄ nū, aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí klla ī wā ī ma ayí uwā obobowú kú nū. Aéwo kú ɛcɛ ī wā í mulɛ́nyɔ́ ɔkwu nū.

eng_Latn: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ géē pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ, é géē yá ɔdōcābɔ̄, é kē í yá ɔdōhídáagó, o yá kéē plla ācɛ nēé fu ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníi, Lɛ aɛ́wā gbā ŋmá ɛcɔ̄ kú uflínti, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé hɛ́ apī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, apī kpó hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē yá ká odúúdú aéwo ā ká ē má onwuné kú ɛgahi kú um, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n géē bī ɔfú kú um le kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā klla í yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tɛtɛ gáā gwū ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú aá tá ā, géē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó mu ácí lɛ a. Amáŋ n géē yá ka aá hɛ́hɔ̄ anú kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī kú ɔpɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ Ulɔ́tu lā ā yíífi ā, ó le blakwu Ébrahām, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Ulɔ́tu le kwu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá abɔ̄yī aá, le odée dɔɔ̄kā lɛ uwá kéē lé. É da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, A dɔɔ̄kā kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ikpēégo ofigwó ŋmó tū igbō nɛ̄ alɔ í je lɛ uwá í lé ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá mɛ́mla ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kóō lɛ Upɔ́lu bī hīlatá gé lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gáā téeyī tū ɛpɔ̄ kú nū lɔhi fíyɛ́ gɔbū ā. Alɔ géē tútū ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō wāajɛ amānyā.

eng_Latn: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā abɔ̄yī nū mla alelékwū kú alɔ cɛ̄ ijáalí ka ālɔ̄ ā wɛ ayí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si ka gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔtūce um, ó wɛ ami nɛ̄ ó lɔtūce ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó lɔtūce ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóyākim, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā lɛ ɛlā kú nū ɔ́ɔmā pó. Abɔ̄ é le pó ā, é tíne kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó. Amáŋ Uríya le pó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kwu ga ajɛ Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, aá wɛ ɔkɛ̄lā kú odúúdú ācɛ ā nɛ. Aá gekwú, íjéeyī géē kwú mɛ́mla aá dúú, ohígbū ka aá ōfōōfū aá lɛ íjéeyī āá.

eng_Latn: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aɔ́dōtāabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ole klá ɛyí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛɛcɛ gē gbɛlá ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā wɛ ɔdā ɔkwɛ̄yi tū iyī nū, amáŋ Óndú ā gē jila ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bī ɔtū ā á.

eng_Latn: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá bla ka Ɔwɔicō le ācɛ okpaakpa ā fubá ɛyɛ́ɛyí lɛ iyī nū ɛɛ́. Ó kē í pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n hī ɔ̄ igwú.

eng_Latn: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ gē gbēyī uwā Átɛnsi ā, eko nɛ̄ ó le má ka igelī ā ɔ́ɔ le mu mla ɛcí ā, ɔtū kú nū le bīya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā í gwó kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n klla tíne kú n jé odée fíyɛ́ kpɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nōó gbla aɛ́bɛ́ ɛtá ɔhá ŋ́ ma, nōo bī ūkwū kú nū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ ā mɛ́mla aīnu oje kú nū, le aólɛlā kú nū fā klá ajɛ ā. Ó klla lɛ ikpó da uwá bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si gā ajɛ kú Usísarīya Ufílipāyi ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ka ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ inu nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ gwó kwu ɔdɔ ā eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ, yɛ ɔdɔ ā jīla tá biílí, kwu eyīpú kú inū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā dúú. Ó klla lɛ inu icō ɛtá gwó kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā icō. Olicō kú éyééye kú inīīcō ā wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abíssāyi le Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī gbō ɔcɛ́ ɛyí ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ohile ā kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gbɔɔ́ ō nū Usséba á inya á.

eng_Latn: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
idu_Latn: É klla lā ɛga ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kpɔ́: Étam, Áyin, Urímɔn, Utócɛn mɛ́mla Ássan.

eng_Latn: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
idu_Latn: N má ka ɛ̄cɔ̄bū kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ákanya í gáā yɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā yɔ̄ mla uwá, É ka anú ɔ́ wɛ Ɔcɛ́ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um, ohígbū ka n gē yá ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā okpaakpa. N klla lɔtūce uwɔ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu kahíníī, Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le tá Ukéyīla nyɔ̄ gaá le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ kú Ufilístiya á. Udéfīdi le uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú ŋmá ajɛ klla le aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā kpó. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ācɛ kú Ukéyīla hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gbagbénú lɛ, ó gáā nya ɔ́ ŋmá ikwū glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē kwú bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da uwɔ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́, ayíka é lɛ ɔ́ ma mla éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla Alelékwū.

eng_Latn: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
idu_Latn: Ucérūbim éyééye kwu okónōgwu éyééye kú ɔ̄wū ā ā. Ó le uwá yá kwɔhá kéē wɛ oje éékpó mla ɔ̄wū ā.

eng_Latn: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔtū yɔ̄ ī wú um nɛ̄hi. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um ma um wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā āa? Ń yɔ̄ ī gbapɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī táafú mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́. N kplá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ije ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī lɛ ije kplá um ŋ́, nááná é ba ī lɛ um pīya olɛlá.

eng_Latn: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí géē wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ nōo géē mafu ka anúɔ géē lɔfú iyē klla géē ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndū ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da Árɔ̄n mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ohile ā, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Itáma kahíníī, Aá kwú odée kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo hile ŋmá ɛya kú ɔdōlé nēé je lɛ Óndú ā, ká aá lɛ igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā, yá ŋmá anú, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú lé ɛgiyí ede ā, ohígbū ka ɛya nyā tīihɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú ajɛ le jíliyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ gaá lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā míya ŋmá okónu únóji ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má yājɛ ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ n gē jé ā, ī je íjééyī gā um, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ucē kú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu í he um ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
idu_Latn: N géē je igelī wúlātāajɛ dúúdú, nōó géē wɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bá ī tɔ́ɔcɔ́ ohígbū n̄u. Ɔ̄cɛ̄ dúúmā nōo gáā yɛ pī ɔ̄, okónu í gāa hɛ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄ ŋ́, ó klla í yɔ̄ ī leyī tónū.

eng_Latn: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nōo le mu mla opo kú ɛfú nēé géē yɔ̄ ī tá nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja í bá ī dɛ̄gba kú ɛfú, lɛyíkwu aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi hɛ́ tū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔyípɛ ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá tíne ɔyī nɛ̄ um tá ā. Abɔ̄ ɔyí ā yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ó le ɔyī tá gla anú ɛyí.

eng_Latn: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
idu_Latn: N le uwá gwō ajɛ, é klla cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́. N lɛ uwá yálé, é gbo bá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū um icííci.

eng_Latn: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Olɛlā éyi yá ɔdā nyā á. Anɔ́ɔ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A tíne ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ácí ā fu ŋmá ipú ikpɔ̄dā ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
idu_Latn: Unwū ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla akwuna nāa húmáyī yá ŋmá ajaajɛ, eko nāa yɔ̄ Íjīpiti ā, géē mɛ. Á klla gáā má aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā ɛbɛ cīkpɔ̄ɔkɔ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē gbɛlá kwu Íjīpiti gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē wā í má um kú ōcē ā, é bī ɔkwɛ̄yi ipú ŋ́. É ī wā kē wā í bla ɔ̄kā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu um, amáŋ ipú kú uwā wɛ ogwiji lɛyíkwu um. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko dúú nēé le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí um nɛɛ, é gē ka ɔ̄kā obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Alɔ le ɔ́ pó, alɔ kē tɔ́ɔna kú nū lɛ aá. Anú yɔ̄ á, Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔlá-ofíyajɛ, ajoodobū í yɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū fúlufúlu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā géē cīgbīhi kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔnyā nōo ī yá ɔma ā lɛ ɔyí ma. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe hile bá ajɛ kú aéwɔhá ā pīyɛyí wā í pīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ híī lé oyī kú nū ŋ́, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ oyī kú nū fu klá ajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē cē éŋkpɔ̄ klá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɔfu ā wɛ Ɛlíyāta.

eng_Latn: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā tɛtɛ da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tíne ká ā háyi kpaakpa, nyɔ̄ gaá kwú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a lɛ ā ú kpó lá, ká ā lɛ ije nū kɔ̄ lɛ aógbɛhá. Ɔ́ɔmā ā géē yá ká ā lɛ agbénú ɔkpáncō. Cɛ́ɛ́ a wā ká ā gaá yɛce um.

eng_Latn: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú ayípōklóbīya gē hɛ́ ācɛ eyī fuú, ācɛ kē ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce īnyīlɛ̄yí nɛ̄hɛ́ kú aókplícī.

eng_Latn: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Upíta mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa kú Usébēdi ā ú. Ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́, ɔtūnōbí kē gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā kú ɛka, nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka ɔ́ɔ le gbo mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ipú ajɛ kú Umówābu ā. Odúúdú nū tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛka ɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ gbo mla uwá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ híī gwō icííci ŋ́, ámāŋ ka o yá ɔ́mpa alɔ cɔ̄nū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē mímálanyī ɔ́mpa alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí ɔhá nɛ̄ ami, Udéfīdi ā géē ka ga uwɔ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ gɛ? Ohígbū ka a jé ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
idu_Latn: É tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yá obɔ̄bí ŋ́ nɛɛ, alɔ í gáā bī ɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
idu_Latn: N gē hī uwɔ igwú eko kú unwalu, ohígbū ka a í pó ɔkɔ ōgbā kú um.

eng_Latn: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā.

eng_Latn: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
idu_Latn: Ó le īkpō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nōo kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, kwu aínu nēe kwu okómpinu kú nū ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa ā kpó miyo. Ó wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó. Inu nōo kwu okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛga otīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ɛga nōo tīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā gaá tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā lɛ alɛɛcɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛ̄nyā, nɛ̄ alɔ gē jé ka alɔ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi á, ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ í lɔtū ékpó ɛgiyí nū glá á.

eng_Latn: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má abahi klla yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ā, n ka, É gáā yá um lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá! Ohígbū koó yá kú alɔ lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú oyálé kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ dúú. Ɔwɔicō bī alɔ le yúklɔ́ kú alɔ bī olɛhɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá le tɔ́ɔna. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā okpóocu lɔhi nōo ī mīyɛ ɛga dóódu tābɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ó géē má ile kú ōwē mɛ́mla ɔnɔ kú nū ā, ɔtū kē í he ɔ́. Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ ɛlā nū kē he um ɔtū ā, géē móōwē ohígbū ācɛ alɛwa, cɛ́ɛ́ ohígbū nū ā, n géē je odōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa yá ā yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hí igá tú ā bá yɔ̄ á, Usidím, Usá, Uhámmāti, Urákāti, Ucínāreti.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, a géē ka odúúdú ɛlā nēe bá nyā lɛ ācɛ ā, amáŋ é gáā jāhɔ̄ ga awɔ ŋ́. A géē hi uwā igwú, amáŋ é gáā tá uwɔ ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
idu_Latn: Unwalu mɛ́mla ōwē kú ācɛ okpaakpa ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi, amáŋ, Óndú ā géē nya uwá tá ŋmá ipú odúúdú aúnwalu ā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔtū ce á. Uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú ācɛ nē e kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā. Uwá géē bī táajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iyē nēé tá tū ipú úmúlá gē nya ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ohígbū kéē lɛ igbīhi ce kwu uwɔ Óndú ā, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi nōo ī hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ijēenyi ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ gē lɔfú lɛyíkwu ayíkpó kú Óndú ā kóō le uwá kpó ŋmó. Ó le tá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóssāfati tá ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ amānyā, nōo géē cā alɔ da Óndú ɔ̄kā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́, Ujóram ā, tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɛláyíssa, ɔyí kú Ussáfati yɔ̄ amānyā. Anú í tá Ɛláyíja abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu le hídáagó. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā jɔ́kpá lɛ ā dúú ā, ó kē nyɔ̄ ínɔ́kpá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kahíníī, Óndú blakwu um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá um abɔ̄, ká n̄ lɛ ɔ́ci gwō ācɛ nēe bá i yá um ŋmó ā. Ā lɔ́tū lé mla uwá jāā gbéeko nēé kwú um u ŋmó gɛ ŋ́. Bla ka, ohígbū iyē kú uwɔ, nēé bá ī cá um ɛcá á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Usímīyɔn. Ó lā Ujerúsālɛm. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa, klla ī le ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō. Ó kē yɔ̄ ī gbēyī kú Ɔwɔicō kóō wā í lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá. Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
idu_Latn: Uhossáya mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujúda ā, nɔwɔ tá ācogwíijē ā igbīhi.

eng_Latn: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ má háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔkpancō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ lɛ Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī bī abɔ̄ gáā je Ujerúsālɛm yíífi. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lɛ īlī ekwu wiyē ā túkpɛɛ́, li eyī pīya klla ajɛ pɛtɛɛ á.

eng_Latn: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwā lɛ eyī ɛnɛ, acá ɛnɛ, mɛ́mla ɔdā nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛháajɛ éyééyé acá kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
idu_Latn: Aámɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā héyīfuú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayí ɔblá nēe wɛ áplɛ́ ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka ɛ̄cī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō yɔ̄ gbóógbóō ŋ́, ohígbu kóō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ um ma gaá tá ipú unwalu nyā ā.

eng_Latn: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
idu_Latn: N má ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Kwu aígbáanɔ ā le pɛ́ wu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
idu_Latn: Eko kpíii, nɛ̄ n lɛ ōwē je la aá mɛ ɛɛ, n gēe je uwá kpó yá ífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
idu_Latn: Ɛlnátan, mɛ́mla Udéláya mɛ́mla Ugɛmaríya gbɔ̄ɔkɔ tá ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ híī je ɔkpá ā yɔɔlá ŋ́ nááná ā, ɔcɛ́ ā í kē jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
idu_Latn: Árɔdu, mɛ́mla Arɛ́li.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ olɛlā kú aá nōo bɛ́yíkwu aá á. abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka lɛ á. N géē kpó aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú kú aá yɔlá. N géē je aícɔ́ɔja kú aá kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔhá ā, n géē je ɔ́ kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Ɛcɛ í gáā póofu ɔfú kú aá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú um kwú ŋmó flōōflōō bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ kú eko kú olugbaagbaa ā. Ígblɛ́nyī kú um kwú jíla gaá bá um akpakó ɛɛ́. A ma um tá gwutá úmúlá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ikwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, olɔhi mɛ́mla okpaakpa kú uwɔ ā, yɛ jāā ga ɔkpáncō. A yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi alɛwa, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ŋ́.
