eng_Latn: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ uwá tá bá ɔcókónpinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú alɔ le ɔ́ hɛ́ wāajɛ klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tū ɔlá ɛɛ́. Lɛ ɔkɔnyɔ má uwā mla ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ, kú ā lɛ uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā, é le jīla ɔpɛ́ kú Uberáka gaá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nēé hī ɔpɛ́ ā ka Uberáka ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ujáala mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Udárkɔn mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ugídelu.

eng_Latn: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu ce ɛtá nɛ̄ Ujówāsi, lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, nɛ̄ Ujɛ́hōhasi, ɔyí kú Ujéhu lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu Usamérīya iháyí igwáahāapa.

eng_Latn: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ úklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kéē nwū ācɛ ā ɔdā nēé jé lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā. Ācɛ kéē ga ɛgiyí uwā gaá klɔ́ɔcɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya lɛ uwá ā. Ohígbū ka é wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ami nōo wɛ Óndu, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi le tá ɛgiyí Ɛ́sra gaá kllɔcɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā gē nwū ā.

eng_Latn: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
idu_Latn: N géē da aá abālɔbányā, ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú um ā. N géē je igá nɛ̄ n cē tū ɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí ujē ā hɛ́ bónū, ka aɛ́bɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó gwó lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla bī ikpó kwú ɔ̄ ú da tāajɛ. N gēe je ɔdɔ nɛ̄ n gwó kóō gbō ɔ̄ ā catāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aɛ́bɛ́ ā kéē bī ikpó kwú ɔ̄ ú da tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le iyī uwɔ nyatá ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kwú ɛcɔ̄ éyi ú anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwaajɛ kóō lɛ pīya ɔdōblatū á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
idu_Latn: Aá géē ma ugóolu klá icō, odúúdú ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú nū ā mɛ́mla ajī kú nū. A géē ma ugóolu cíla okónōgwū nū biílí.

eng_Latn: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa gē jɛ̄ gɔbū, odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā gē gwéeyē, amáŋ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ́bíipú gekwú, ācɛ gē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ɔ kú ɔdā dúúmā ká ɔ̄ já uwā má gaá gbā ámāŋ cɛ̄ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má ɔkpáncō ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɛnɔ, ɔyā, mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ. Ó ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpó lɛ aéwo ohile kú ipú ɛcɛ ā kéē gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
idu_Latn: n géē je ɛlá gwō hɛ́ uwɔ tá dúúdú, klla í je aá, mɛ́mla igelī nyā nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā ā kpó nū ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá ā Ujérobōwam mla odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma igwó kú ɛhícō ā kwú pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ gaá da Udéfīdi ka n géē je ɔdā ɛtá lɛ ɔ́, kóō kwú éyi ú ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ aá ka Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔwɛ nōo cíkā ā. Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá bū ipú nū ā, aá nēe cíkā ō ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ohígbū nū nɛ̄ aá bá gē móōwē ā.

eng_Latn: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
idu_Latn: N géē tū alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ɛhɔ̄ kóō gbɔbū lɛ aá, ó géē nū ācɛ kú Ukénan, ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Upɛ́risi, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛlā nēé tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, É gē wɔ́tū um icííci ā kóō le yá jīla ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Udéfīdi lɛ ɛfú kpó tú ācɛ kú Ufilístiya klla lɛ uwá yálé. Ó mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugáti mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cāŋjɛ ekeeko gaá háyi ɔwɛ nēe yɛ ga okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nōó tíne kú Ágábáidu Udéfīdi kóō ka uwá gwó nɛɛ, Ábsálɔm gē hī ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā igwú ga okónōgwu cɛ́ɛ́ ó gē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kú ɛga nōó ŋmá āa. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā le ipɔ́ɔma nōó ŋmá ā ka lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
idu_Latn: Ubásilīti, Uméhīyada, Uhássa.

eng_Latn: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
idu_Latn: aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ástārɔtu mɛ́mla Édrēyi ā kpó yálé ā.

eng_Latn: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó tá kóō pó ɛlā kú uwā ā, le da ācɛ icɔ́ɔci. Ɔ́dāŋ koó tá ɛlā kú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kpɔ́, ayíka a je ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka opɛ̄cí ā ámāŋ odɔlɛ́ obɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ nōo ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā géē ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ádā uwā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄, kóō pó ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú oyēeyi ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú lɛ aá, anú nōo wɛ Ádā kú aá ā. Ó gē kwú ŋ́, ó yēeyī piyóó. Ó je oyēeyī lɛ aá ŋmá ɔfú kú ɛlā kú nū nōo yēeyī nōo klla ī yɔ̄ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ iyó ajɛ kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā kpó gé lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā gwó á.

eng_Latn: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī dóódu é gē nyɔ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tɔ̄há, gē bī ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ mla ɔtū ogbonɛnɛ gē lé ɔdōlé.

eng_Latn: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é le aɔ́dā ā má abɔ̄ nēé wɛ oōnyi ajɛ, nɛ̄ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā, tá ɛháajɛ nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o ka lɛ ā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe jɛ́ɛ́yí odée kpaakpa glá ŋ́ mā, géē gbɔɔ́ ō jɛ́ɛ́yí odée eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ācɛ nēe kē bá ī ka iŋini eko dóódu ā géē gbɔɔ́ ō pó ɛlā nēé ī nwū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
idu_Latn: Náaná ó wɛ ɔtū kú Óndú ā ka ōwē nēé í yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kóō kwú pīya ɛya nēé í gwó nōo í yá kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā í yá alɔ ɛhi. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó géē má ayááyí nū, ó géē yēeyī ligbó, ó kē í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā miya ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā je okwutɛ kú ɔfú ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujúda glá ŋ́, Ayááyí nū í cɔcɛ́ eko dóódu. Ācɛ kú aéwo géē bī ɛ̄gbā gé lɛ ɔ́. É klla í túkpɛɛ́ í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá kē gɛcɛ gaá má āa? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ úwé omɛnɛ́mɛnɛ́ wiiyē ā nɛɛ? Ācɛ nēe ī le úwé omɛnɛ́mɛnɛ́ wiiyē ā kē ī bá ɔlɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā kú Usamérīya ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ awɔ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā ī ba éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ̄ um nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā kú Usamérīya ā? Ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu í gē yá ɔdā dúúmā tɔ̄há mla ācɛ Usɛmérīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
idu_Latn: Ádā ɛhɔ̄ ā klla le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. É yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ alɛwa ɔwɛ ékpó ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú, é ŋmó ācɛ ōhī kú uwā ijē, é kē ŋmó aóhī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā habɔ̄ ɛtɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū ā tá, le tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gaá da ācɛ ā ka.

eng_Latn: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú alɔ, nōo kē ī yɔ̄ mla alɔ eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yɔ̄ ī piyatɔ̄há mla um, nɛ̄ ɛlā kú um kē yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú aá, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá tíne, é géē yá ɔ̄ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Uhábakūku, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gbā lɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ ó cīíbɔm tū Usamérīya ā, ó le Usamérīya yálé klla mīyɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄fú. Ɔ̄da nyā yá ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛhīlī nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, nōo klla wɛ iháyí ɔ́maháanɛ nɛ̄ Uhósīī ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ gā um eko nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ ɛbɛ́ gwɛ́ɛya gā um ŋ́. Ā híī lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú ucɛ kú onyatá kú um ā tū gbɔ́ɔ̄ci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
idu_Latn: Upíta le blakwu ɔdā nōo yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Má ɔ̄ Itíca, ɔcí ufígi nāa tokónu lɛ ɔ́ ā gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá ígbíli nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ ɛhícō kú ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā á. Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācokwɛyí uwā nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ iyó agbénú mɛ́mla aɔ́dā otīile kpó ce aíjakī mɛ́mla aínyankūlūmī igbīhi. É le bū ipú ajɛ obɔ̄bí, ɛga nɛ̄ aágábá mɛ́mla ogwiji mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí bá ā. É gē kpó aíyó ā gē lɛ ācɛ nēé tū uwā abɔ̄ dúúmā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
idu_Latn: Ámiyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ugɛmáli ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán.

eng_Latn: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
idu_Latn: Áá mɔ́ɔ̄, n yɔ̄ gē cokónu mɛ́mla aá mɛ́mla ayááyí aá.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ kóō le lɛ ā, ɔyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā géē ma ā, ɛ́ɛ géē je ɔ́ ka ɔyí kú okwūmā ā nɛ. Ó yá kú ɔkwu kú okwūmā ā kóō bí ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
idu_Latn: Ayípōklóbīya kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe lé ka Uhɛliyōpɔ́lis mɛ́mla Ububástisi ā géē pɛ́ kwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā, é klla í kpó aóhile kú ācɛ ā aálagbá kú ɛfú.

eng_Latn: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi nōo hī ɔ̄ igwú ā le ɔdā nyā má ā, ó gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í lɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī kpabɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ iyē nyā jé, nōó géē yɛ í le jé koó wɛ akwuna.

eng_Latn: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ, ɔwɛ ékpó nɛ̄ aá móōwē ā nɛ̄ ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nēe bá Ujudíya ā móōwē lɛ dúú ā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá cɛ̄ lɛ aá móōwē ɔwɛ ékpó nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujudíya cɛ̄ lɛ aá móōwē ā.

eng_Latn: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó aɛ́cɔ̄ o gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā kwu ɔ́: utɔ́kwɔ̄isi, ágēti mɛ́mla amítēsti, kpó kwu ɔgba ɔ́mɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ígwu ɔhá ā le yá lɛ ā. Odúúdú uwā bī ɛmu o kwɔlá abɔ̄lúfīyē mɛ́mla opo abɔ̄lɔ́ná. É klla le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka Ɔkpácaŋgeli kú Óndú mɛ́mla ɔkpáncaŋgeli kú Ugídīyɔn.

eng_Latn: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
idu_Latn: O nyɔ̄ í lā ajīlɛ̄yí inu lɔhi fíyɛ́, ō lā ipú inu ékpónú mla ɔnyā ō yá ikpɛ́lā nōo klla gē ka ífulá nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
idu_Latn: lɛ Óndú ā ɛga ɔhá gwū okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā tá, é gáā je ɔ́ koó wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
idu_Latn: É gē fu otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya dóódu kéē je ɛhi mɛ́mla o gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ó cɛgbá ká otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nyā kóō lɛ odée nōó géē yá piíí.

eng_Latn: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
idu_Latn: É gā ipú ajɛ ā gáā mīyɛ ajɛ ā, amáŋ é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā, ámāŋ́ é bī íne nɛ̄ a tū ā yúklɔ ŋ́. É yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a da uwá kéē yá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ámíyā nyā le yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka n gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ń dɔɔ̄kā ŋ́ mā ā, ayíbɛ, ó wɛ ami abɔ̄yī um ī yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ínoōbīya nōo yɔ̄ ipú um ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
idu_Latn: Aá jikwū, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ncɛ́nya nɛ̄ ó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, nōo gē yēkwu kú ikwū nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā nēe wɛ aólajógbe kú nū ā kwú iyē ú ce ɔyí ā ka Óbɛ̄di. Anɔ́ɔ é yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kéē le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ Unaómi ɛɛ́. Óbɛ̄di nyā wɛ ádā kú Ujɛ́se, nōo wɛ ádā kú Udéfīdi ā á.

eng_Latn: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urúbɛn le cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí obugā ā, nōó má Ujósɛ̄fu ipú nū gɛ ŋ́ mā, ó le īlī kú nū hīla ohígbū ɔtū nōo bīya lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá ā gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ̄ gē bī abɔ̄ kú aá le yá abahi nɛ̄ aá ɔ̄ gē má ā á. Amáŋ ń cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛjī ā klla yɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu abɔ́ɔ gaá bū njɔlɔ kú Unéfutɔ̄wa, ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá bɛ̄cɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe kwu ɛfu kú Ɛ́frɔn ajaajɛ ā. Ɛjī ā klla leyī pīya biílí ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Ubáala ámāŋ kú Ukíriyati Ujeyarim.

eng_Latn: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú odúúdú aɔ́kplá kú aá ú kéē wɛ ācɛ o tīihɔ gā um. Ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu, kwu ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú uwā dóódu, wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujérīko le āyā ɔhá nōo gbo ce ɔ́ ā gwó. Usákɔ, ɔyí kú Ímri, gwó āyā ɔhá nēe gboce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Ujassóbeyam nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhákmɔn ā. Anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú Aícɔ́ɔja Ɛtá ā á Ó bī óbō kú nū le nuunu tá ācɛ ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ó le uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú ɔgbɛ́fú ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ɔ̄kā kahíníi, Ɔdí gē tū uwɔ ɔnū ā? A gē doōcē nɛɛ? Má eyī kú uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́? Ɔtū í hi uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ábna mɛ́mla ācɛ ofu gā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ā, Udéfīdi lɛ ucɛ yá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, āyā éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bā í ma ɔdɔ, āyā kú uwá ɔhá kwāajɛ, le úwé ɔkplɛ́fú wu iyē bī óbó, ɔkplɛ́fú, mɛ́mla ɔtā mla ɔyī. Aótrɛ̄yí le okwúukwu kwu.

eng_Latn: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
idu_Latn: Ó kwú uwā iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā éyééye kahíníī, Óndú, ami nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Uréhobōwam ā, Óndú ā le italā yá uwā ohígbū kēé lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ ā. Ussíssāki, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti gaá le ɛfú kpó tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɛgiyí akpa kú ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ kú nū, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē yúúfi nū ā, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́.

eng_Latn: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú ācɛ kú uwā, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ kpó ŋmó. Ó klla le aálá, aɛ́na, aíjakī, aínyankwūlūmī mɛ́mla īlī kú uwā kpó.

eng_Latn: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo ī ŋmá ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā ī je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē na īlī kú nū dóódu, ó klla í wā ɔnwū kú nū, í gwīiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē. Ó lɔfú wā ipú ɔlɛ́ ā, amáŋ ó gáā lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū ŋ́ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ijakī ā, le alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā má kpɔ́ ā, ó má gwutáajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam le cɔ̄nū ŋmá ɛyí nū gbɔɔ́ ō fīyɛ̄ ijakī ā ɔcí á.

eng_Latn: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ká n̄ lɛ ɛga éyi má ipú ígbíli nɛ̄ n géē nyɔ̄ í tayínī ŋmá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É kpɔ́tūce Óndú ā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī pīyeyī má aɔ́wɔ ɔhá kpɔ́. É klla wɛ ígwu kú ācɛ nēe ī yá ibīyāajɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And the ark of the LORD was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā lɛ ɔyā ahāapa yá ajɛ kú Ufílīstiya ā.

eng_Latn: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
idu_Latn: A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ unwalu yɔ̄ ī yá um lɛ ā. A kē jé áluka kú agīje kú um, kɛ̄ɛ ka á tá uwā tū ɔkpā ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ācɛ nēé tɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá Ujábes wā a ká ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ gāá da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ka, gbɔbū kú ɛnɔ kóō wɛ̄ɛyí oŋmɔ́ɔcī nū ā, ɛ́ɛ géē hɛ́ uwā tá. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujábes mīyɛ ɔlɛɛhɔ̄ nyā, é gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ íjééyī nōo ī tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ ā kpó tū lɛ ācɛ okpaakpa ā. Anú klla wɛ ɔkplɛ́fú ká ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā á.

eng_Latn: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka kpɔ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujúdasi, éyi kú ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā wā á. Ɛwa kú ācɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwā wā mla anú, bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla ogbló.

eng_Latn: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄? Úklɔ́ ī yá kéē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, ó wɛ o ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá híī tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Uyáwɛ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā, nɛ̄ aá tá ō bá ajɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá í wā ā, é lɛ Ujóbu má ŋmá ɛcɛɛcɛ ā, é jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ jé ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō jikwú tāāā, lɛ īlī kú uwá kpó híla kéē ma ɔtūnōbí kú uwā fú. É lɛ ewo tá gicō klla lɛ ɔ́ wu klá īyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uya kú ɔkɛ̄lā kú uwā ā, gbɔɔ́ ō jíla etikpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā iyē, anɔ́ɔ ódūdū le mu ipú odúúdú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā nēe lé iyē kwu um ā wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. N kē yá uwā kéē yá ká ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra um. Ami bī abɔ̄ kú um yá ɔ́na kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yíihɔtū lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá, nɛ̄ aá je ɔ́ nyi ā.

eng_Latn: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá ā, lɛ ɔdōlé olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ejé kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpó ŋmá ɛgiyī Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō je ēpū mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī ō jé lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔfú nɛ̄hi ō lɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā kē lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú á.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá ā í kōō jé ɔdā dúú ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔhá ā dúú nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ɔdā dúú nōo ŋmá ɛcɛ ga ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tēelihɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ da uwɔ ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ tóohɛ́ɛwa āa? A lɛ īkpō ɔcí nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ka ā híī lé ŋ́ má lé nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenáya le tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Óndú ā gaá da Ujówābu ka ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je ka ɔ́ɔ le bɛ̄cɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu tá klla tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē kwú abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ubenáya kwúcē ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gaá le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujówābu ka ā ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
idu_Latn: Otú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī otú ɔ́migwɛ́nɛ ā, owu nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ úgbéenyi kú alɔ ga ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ísu kú Umeditarénīyan. Ɛplá ahāpōtú, ācopúgbényi ā lɛ eyī ce ka aá le bá lɛ ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ ipú unwalu ā, é nuunu tá um, amáŋ Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le abɔ̄ kwu um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ɔdā nōo kwu um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ɔkɔ nɛ̄ um gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, wɛ ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú nya uwá tá glá ā!.

eng_Latn: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka eko gē wā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kpɔ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kú éwɔhá nēé bá ā. Ó ka anúɔ klla í je ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā, kwúce lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ o jāā gaá kwu ícɛ nyā piíí ā, Ɔwɔicō le um tábɔ̄, n kē yēeyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ háyi amānyā ká n̄ cɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ijáalí, ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɛdɔ ékpó mɛ́mla ɔdā piíí nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla Umósīsi le ka koó géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,
idu_Latn: Uhafarém, Usíyɔn, Anahárāti.

eng_Latn: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
idu_Latn: Le túgɛcɛ ŋmá ɛlā icííci mɛ́mla áafú olíla kú ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, ohígbū ka ó gē nū ācɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.
idu_Latn: Éeyē le mu odúúdú ācɛ ā ipú. Abɔ̄ é kwú Atálīya ú ŋmó ŋmá agbla ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá igelī nɛ̄hi ā má bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Alelékwū ā le um hɛ́tá, o ŋmá lɛ opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, ŋmá íkwu kú ínoōbīya mɛ́mla ikwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kwu lɛyíkwu ga ɛgiyí aɛ́cí nēé gē pā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā gē kwu ga ɛgiyí aódiyɔ̄ kú nū ā. Amáŋ ó gáā kwú uwā ŋ́. Ó géē tíne uwā, amáŋ ó gáā má uwā ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó ī ka ka anúɔ géē cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí ɔbá aflɛ́yí kú anúɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Ó í ka ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ mla anú ā, ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ anúɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu uwɔ. Ɔdā nāa gē yá mɛ́mla ɛga nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā. N jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu um lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā í yā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlífāasi, ɔ̄cɛ Utémān ā tá Ujóbu ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
idu_Latn: N má ɛga nēé nyɔ̄ í nyi okwū kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú éyi. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ í nyi okwū kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nyā, bá ī wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá únóji ā, ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄tra ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú ā ipɔ́lɛ́ piíí nōo yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ulɔ́tu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Usɔ́dɔm ā, ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛcōwō yā ŋmá ɔkpancō wāajɛ klá ācɛ ā le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aɔ́wá kú aótrɛ̄yí ɔhá ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tū igbómína kú Uróm abɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ́kpá á.

eng_Latn: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígabɔ̄, ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō bīya íne kú Óndú ā. É gbɔɔ́ ō gbla uce kú aéwɔhá ā ipú íne kú Óndú ā ō bīya mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí ō yá kú uwā. É kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nēé yá tīihɔ ā ú nyílá.

eng_Latn: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó klla le aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó dúú, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ odúúdú uwā yá jōōnjīlɛ̄. Olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛtá, ōlɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú um iyē, n kē híjémā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá aá ífi lɛ ā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá bá ajɛ nyā kpɔ́, n géē je aá gicō, ń gáā tū aá wā ajɛ ŋ́, n géē bū aá tū, ń gáā fu aá ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ úmúlá nōo ī kwɔ́lá bɔɔɔ ā géē je pīya ókpoó. Ajɛ nōo le ŋmóklīklī ā géē je bū njɔlɔ ɛbɛɛbɛ. Ɛga nɛ̄ aéwō ipácí tɛtɛ lā ā géē je pīya ajɛ ɔ́tɔ́ɔ́tɔ nɛ̄ ácí mɛ́mla igwɛ̄bɛ́ mɛ́mla ekpo géē bū anú.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá géē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔkɔ kú um, nɛ̄ aá klla lɛ íne mɛ́mla okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla aá ā tū. Aá géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Odúúdú ɛcɛ wɛ ákú um, amáŋ aá géē wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ um fu á.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofɛhīlī ce ɛpa ā á.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí ā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā kwɛyí, ɛ́ɛ géē fu aógbēnjūwā nēe géē leyīkwu ācɛ ā ígwíígwu.

eng_Latn: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu ga ɛgiyí Usámūwɛ̄lu, okónu igá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
idu_Latn: Lɛ eyī yɛ úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, kú ā má ɔ̄. Ɔdā dúúmā nōo le pú ā, ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá gē yá ɔ̄ kóō lɛ nā kpaakpa glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ íne nɛ̄ olɔhi ŋ́, mla ɔ́da nɛ̄ ó gē bī oyēeyī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́ mā je lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá, ɔlɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu kē géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú Ísɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí ō ŋmókókó ā. É í je uwá yɔlá klla í je uwā yíífi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā hile ɔlɛ́ kú Ísɔ ā ŋ́. Ami, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwú ɔtū ú ce odo kú iyī nū wɛ olíla. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī íjééyī yá ɔdā dóódu kú nū géē nyatá.

eng_Latn: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú uwā dɔɔ̄kā ā í gáā yá ɔdā dúú nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā kóō lɛ aá yá tīihɔ ɔwɛ dóódu, kóō lɛ odúúdú oyēeyī kú aá, kwu alelékwū, odo, mɛ́mla ɔkpíyē kú aá tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ géē wā igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko le yɛ bɛ̄ɛka áwa éyi ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá klla ka lɔfú lɔfú kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ mla Ujísɔ̄si dúú gbóó, ohígbū koó ke wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ugálīli dúú.

eng_Latn: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔci blibli kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu le ujɔ̄ tū lɛyí kwu Ujísɔ̄si kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
idu_Latn: N géē yɛ í kwú odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwā ú yálé fíyaa, klla í lɛ uwá yá ōwē.

eng_Latn: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ le ɔ́bíipú bī tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nū, Ɔwɔicō gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ nū klla í je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Amáŋ, ɔnyɛ̄ géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bɔ́bíipú tū Óndú ā? Amáŋ é jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlá nɛ̄ ádā uwā da uwá ā ŋ́, abɔ̄ Óndú ā le tútū kóō kpó uwā ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́ gā ipú ajɛ ā iháyí ofɛpa. Anɔ́ɔ otínīyɛlu gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujówābu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujehóyāda ā, kē leyīkwú ācɛ nēe gē gbō Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́ ámāŋ ka aótrɛ̄yí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ejé mɛɛ ā, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ejé kú uwā mɛɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da ádā nū kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ŋ́, ádā um, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ́kplá á, kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō fu ɔ̄cɛ oo, ó fu ɔ̄cɛ nóo, ó gbolóce ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ɔdā nōó yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō ī dɔɔ̄kā ō ményinyi nū nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
idu_Latn: Óndú, a géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe tá iyī uwā wāajɛ ā gē gbā gā awɔ ā. A klla ī tú uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū, ī lɛ ɔfú tū uwā iyē.

eng_Latn: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kpó ɔtá ŋaaŋa ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ígblɛ́nyi kú uwā lɛ ā á. É le tútū ō kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ eko dóódu. Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēé gē bī le lɔfú ipú ajɛ kú uwā á. Ó wɛ ka uwā le kpaakpa ŋ́. Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bá ī yá ɔdōōbɔ́bí éyi ga ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔhá. É kōō cɛ̄ jé ka amíyɔ̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
idu_Latn: Aá gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ kéē jé ka aá wɛ ogwuda ŋ́. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka olobócí, nōó nya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
idu_Latn: Kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, abɔ̄ kú italā nāa gē yá um ā, wu um iyē. Ɔfú kwú ŋmó ŋmá um iyē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ī ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɔnɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upɛ́lɛ̄gi wɛ iháyí ofuciigwó ā, ó le ɔyí éyi nōo hī ka Uréyu ma.

eng_Latn: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī yɛɛ ā, ayínɛ́ ā le mŋmóō tū uwā lɛ uwá tū nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
idu_Latn: Uháran gekwú gbɔbū lɛ ádā nū, Utéra, ipú ajɛ nēé ma ɔ́ ā, ipú Ɔ́ɔru, ajɛ kú ācɛ Ucáldii.

eng_Latn: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ lɛ aíne kú Ɔwɔicō tū, alɔ ī jé kpɔ́cíí ka alɔ jé ɔ̄ okwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ ā kóō gbāajɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
idu_Latn: Aá gbēyī cíí, ká aá leyī kwɛcɛ, olɛlā ká aá ebilíi ā yɔ̄ gē gicō gaajɛ ī tōoji bɛ̄ɛka ágábá, nōō gē tíne ɔ̄cɛ nōó géē kwú lé ā.

eng_Latn: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka ā, kóō le yá jīla. Ó kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ̄nyɛ mīyɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ nēé kē ma ɔfú kú Óndú ā fú lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ɔdī nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī má yɔ̄ āa? Eko nyā ɛ́ɛ klla le ɔdā ékpónū nēe yá Asírīrya ā yá Ubábīlɔn dúú ɛ́ɛ́. É le aá kpó nyɔ̄ ī cɔ̄fiyɛ abɔ̄fú. É kē gbā ɔdā dúúmā ikpɛ̄yí kú aá ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ācɛ nēe gē yá ōwē ā, gē gwō klla ī leyī gwū um bónū.

eng_Latn: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ā kwú wúla wāajɛ, ācɛ géē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ wɛ itene kú áfū nāa kpó plla anú āa.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
idu_Latn: ó géē kpó abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɔ́ ɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē mī oyī kú nū klá ɔkíká ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
idu_Latn: Ó ka abɔ̄ nōó le lɛ ā, Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í da Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ka anúɔ je ɔ́ ŋmá ipácí ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī gbāálá ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ je ɔ́ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.
idu_Latn: Umálɔn mɛ́mla Ucílīyɔn le pɛ́ gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá hile Unaómi ōfōōfūnū á. Ɔbá nū mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā le pɛ́ gekwú hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá.

eng_Latn: So it came to pass, when the king's commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king's house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú nū ā je ā, nēé bā í kpó ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā alɛwa ga Usúsa ā, Ɛ́sta wɛ éyi kú uwá dúú. É klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Uhégāyi nōo gē leyīkwu ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Awɔ, Óndú ā je ɛnɔ kwu ɔkpáncō á, amáŋ, a cɛ̄ ka anúɔ í wā gaá lā ipú ojuja mɛ́mla obū.

eng_Latn: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó gáā yēeyī lɛ uwá wiíyē ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa éyi gáā le wiíyē á. Ācɛ nēé ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā, gáā je ije kú nū ā kpó kɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ajī nɛ̄ncɛ́ éyi le bū ŋmá ipú éyi kú ajī ɛnɛ kú nū nyā ā. Ɔfú kú ajī nyā yɛ lɛyī kwu ɛháajɛ, mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ó klla yɛ lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú okónu ō ce ā.

eng_Latn: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ dɔɔ̄ka ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō ga abɔ́ɔ āa? Ayínɛ́ aá nēe ga abɔ́ɔ ā, le aá ɔtū gbenyi ka ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ɛ́ɛ lɔfú fíyɛ́ aá á. Ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ aɔ́báagwu klla jɛ̄ nɛ̄hī fíyɛ́ aá. É ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ayí kú Ánāki . Ɔdɔ nɛ̄ uwá hɛ́ jīla ɔlɛ́ uwá tá ā, ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okwáhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o yújulu, wɛ ɔdā ékpó mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ obīyɔ̄da nɛ.

eng_Latn: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
idu_Latn: Aá je ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋmá ipú odúúdu ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā, nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā ó le tá ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ éyi gaá klá abɔ́ɔ otú ɔ́ɔma gbɔ́ɔcī. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō gā abɔ́ɔ gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛláyíja, ɔdí nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī yá amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le ayí kú Ujósɛ̄fu má ā, ó dɔɔ̄ka kahíníī, Ayí kú ɔ̄nyɛ bá yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ í lā Ujúda mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Āɔ́glɛɛjí mɛ́mla ācogbāálá mɛ́mla álá kú uwá í bá abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
idu_Latn: ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛhɔ̄, ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū kē wɛ umíta ɛpa ce āyā áklō kú nū dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ inu ā abɔ̄yī nū ā mīya. Īkpō kú nū wɛ umíta ofu, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta igwó.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔnya ɔgalúlā á. Iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɔnya ā lé ka Ikwū, anɔ́ɔ ɔlékwū kē yɔ̄ ī tú ɔ̄ ɔkwu ajaajɛ á. Ɔwɔicō lɛ íkwū je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ āyā éyi kóōkɔ ɛga ɛnɛ kú ācɛ ɛcɛ kpó ŋmó bū ɔwɛ kú ɛfú okpó, ɔkpɛtā, ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí.

eng_Latn: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo tɛtɛ ī yɛ lɔtūce īyī nū ā ī yāwu cécécéé abālɔbányā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī gwōnū ŋ́. Ɛlā nōo ī nwū ācɛ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ má gwōnū ipú ojuju nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa ā gē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi, é géē lā ɛga nāa yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛka nɛ̄ n gbō lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ā, n cokónu ka n géē je oyēeyī olɔhi lɛ uwá. N je ɛ̄nyā lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é kē le ojīlīmā ce um klla yúufi um.

eng_Latn: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Íjīpiti lɛ uwɔ má, é géē ka, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔnyā nū á, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú um ŋmó. Amáŋ é géē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ yēeyī.

eng_Latn: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le ācɛ ā yáwa á. Anɔ́ɔ é le kabɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú aéwo nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gaá je uwēyī ga um ā, gbɛlá lɛyíkwu um ā kwú um iyē nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɛla ā nwū ācɛ ā kwɛyí ā, ó da Usáyímɔ̄ni kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́kɔ ā pɛ́ ga ɛga oliipú kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ awɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa awɔ lɛ ɛ́yá kú aá tá ga ipú éŋkpɔ̄ kú aá kwú ɛbéenyi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da um kahíníī, Odúúdú ɛlā nēe bá nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ n. É kē tōō lɔtūce. Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je Alelékwū kú nū lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔdā nōo í yá piíí eko kpiíí nōo í wā ā mafú lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ Umósīi le jɛ̄ ā, nōó tá kéē hī ɔ̄ ka ɔyí kú adá kú Uféro ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámáŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnya dúúmā le okónu ce ka anɔ́ɔ í wɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā a nɛ̄ ó lɛ iyī nū fō tá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwú Ugalíyo ú yá igbómína kú ajɛ kú Akáya ā, odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu le pīyatɔ̄há le Upɔ́lu kwú, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bī ga inɛ́pɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: É klla géē bī aá ga iyɔ̄bū kú aígbómína mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ohígbū ka aá wɛ ayíkpó kú um. Aá géē bī ɛga ɔ́ɔmā le tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔkóolɔhi lɛyíkwu um lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ éwɔhá.

eng_Latn: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ gbōmgbōm ka, Lɛ ɔcí ā hɛ́ wā ajɛ, lɛ īkpō mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú nū kpó gwó, ká ā lɛ ɔ́ fíyákátā klá ɛcɛ. Lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kpó nū ŋmá ɔkwu nū, ká ā lɛ aígbáanɔ kpó nū ŋmá ābɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā gē wā ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó ŋmó. É kē cɛ̄ lɛ anyā uwā yēekwu kú uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ɔdāhá, mɛ́mla ɔyí nɛ̄ ó jé ɔdā uwēyī ŋ́, gē yá ádā nū ōwē klla ī nū ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ, kwu aólɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi jōnjīlɛ abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ɔfiyɛ í klla yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔkpani nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
idu_Latn: Ā kpɔtūcē ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ŋ́. Ó kē í kwú. Ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōo géē tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ujɛ́ɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā, kwu odúúdú ɛyí ajɛ kú Ágobu, ā ú. Ajɛ ā yɛ jāā kwu ɛjī kú ɛyí ajɛ kú Ācɛ Ugɛ́ssɔ mɛ́mla Umáaka. Ó kwú iyē kú anú abɔ̄yī nū ú ce aípɔ́lɛ́ ā. É hī aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ka aípɔ́lɛ kú Ujɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: É húmáyī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē je ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā pīya alácɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli. Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gē yá lɔhi ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lɛ ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū. Ɛ̄nyā he odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́lu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔcí pílópíló nōo tɛtɛ kwu ɔdɔ kli ā í jíliyē klla í je fu táajɛ. Eko nɛ̄ ɔcí pílópíló ā kwú fu táajɛ ɛɛ́, ɔdā dóódu nōo playi anú ā géē je yíífi? Óndú ā ka anúɔ le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
idu_Latn: É le ofu kú ɛna kú oje udɔ ɔgba ɛpa ma, kwu ɛháajɛ kú ahɔ̄ biílí kú utánki ā. Ijā nēé he nyā wɛ ɔgba ɛpa, ɔgba éyi ce ɛyí ɔgba ɔhá. É kē le uwá ma tɔ̄há mla ɛga ohile kú utánki ā.

eng_Latn: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu aínyankwūlūmī ā wɛ Óbilu, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssmɛ̄lu ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu aíjakī ā wɛ Ujɛdɛ́ya, ɔyí kú Umérōnɔtu, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wū ā wɛ Ujásīsi, nōo ŋmá Uhágrī ā.

eng_Latn: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
idu_Latn: Ó le aɔ́dā kú ɛhi ā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gbɔbū, anɔ́ɔ ó le gbo ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā otú ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aídibo kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcányā, Ɛ́sta ā, le ɔdā nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi yɔ̄ ī yá ā, ka lɛ ɔ́ ā, ó junwalu lɛ Ɛ́sta nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ īlī kpó tɛhɔ̄ fu Umɔ́dɛkāyi, kú ɔ̄ le kpó wiiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gā. Amáŋ ó tá kóō mīyɛ īlī ā.

eng_Latn: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
idu_Latn: Ogbɛhá éyi kē yɔ̄ dúú, nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Ulásārɔ̄si nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú nū kē wɛ ámata ámata. É gē je ɔ́ wā í tá okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ olagbénú nyā ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa le ɔ́ má, anɔ́ɔ ó dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ádā um. ádā um, a lɛbɛ̄ɛka úgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, a klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú ā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa kwú úwé kú nū ú híla ɛpa wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō bī íkwu nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kóō lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe ī gbō uwɔ ɛ̄gbā kpó kwú mla iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔnyā kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā géē je uwɔ tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ācɛ nēe tá īyī uwā wāajɛ ā gicō á. Anú klla í je éeyē lɛ ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ekwu mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí á.

eng_Latn: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
idu_Latn: É klla le ijā kú ucérūbim mɛ́mla ododó nōo le nwūla mɛ́mla ɔcí kú alī he tū ɔdɔ kú eyīpú ā biílí.

eng_Latn: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ á cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ í yā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu, le ɔ́bíipú bī tū uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é le pīyabɔ̄ kwú eyī í pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nyā, lɛ ɔkɔ gbā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcányā kú Ussɛ́ba nyā dɔɔ̄kā ā, Usólōmɔn le kpó lɛ ɔ́, mɛ́mla ɛhi alɛwa ɔhá. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwúcē ga Ussɛ́ba á.

eng_Latn: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔkpá tá ga uwɔ ɛga okɛpɔ̄ kóō mīyɛ úwé ɛhícō kú uwɔ, kwú úwé ɛháajɛ kú uwɔ lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi o hile ā gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe gē kpó iyó úklɔ́ ā. É klla gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe gē yá ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā. Ayí kú Ulífāyi ōhī wɛ aɔ́málɛ o tɔ́ɔkpá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kē wɛ ācogbāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē mī oyī kú ɛwū mɛ́mla oyī kú ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla ewo kú ɔyí ɛna o pá ɔlá dúúdú klá ācɛ nēe kpúúgla ā iyē, ɔdā nēé yá nyā gē le uwá gwu ŋmá úgla nēé kpó ā.

eng_Latn: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā aɔ́dā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Alɔ ā kōō lɛ íkwu fíyɛ́ kú alɔ yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ ń kē bī íkwu nyā le yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ó yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā alɔ lɛ ɔtū kwu ōwē dóódu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ā kóō híīī le ɔdā nōo ī ŋmɔ́ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mahāapa wɛ Uhákosi, ɔ́mahātá wɛ Ábīja.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ ádáádā uwā, Ébrahām, Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ nōo lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi nēé gwó abɔ̄yī uwā ŋ́ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ tá ágēnégēne kú ɛfu kú Upísga ā ká anúɔ gaá má ajɛ ā ga ɛhíícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ má ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ gē má ā lɔɔlɔhi, ohígbū ka anúɔ í gāá bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā ga ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ācɛ nōo fu gē gwííjē ipú Agblīihɔ kú Óndú ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ī kpó ɔ́lá lá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī lɔ́lá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ á. Ó lɛ Utéblu kú ācɛ ohīla ije abɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɔcí oyājɛ kú ācɛ nēe ī je oklɛ́bɛ́tɛ lá ā cēgwōnū.

eng_Latn: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí kú ígbíli, nōo ge jɛ̄ ipú igbíli gē je ŋmɔ́la tū ajɛ ɔnɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ajɛ ka ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í jɛ̄ anú glá ŋ́ mā, ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā í gáā yá lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
idu_Latn: Ɔgba gaá ce Ɛ́sta, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Abíhēlu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ kú Umɔ́dɛkāyi nōó bī jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí abɔ̄yī nū ā, kóō ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe má Ɛ́sta ā bá ī hɔ́kɔ nū. Eko nōó gáā nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā, īlī nɛ̄ Uhégāyi nōo gē leyīkwu ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā, mafú lɛ ɔ́ ā, anú nōó kpó wiiyē, le yíifa ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofɛpa nēé bá ipú ígbíli ā, a yá ɛgbá kú uwá dóódu lɛ uwá. Īlī kú uwá mɛ́mla áblákpá kú uwá í gbɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē híla ŋ́. Ikpó kú uwā í kē mi ipú iyāwu kú uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, eko nɛ igbómína ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kú ācɛ ɛpa ā nɛ̄ aá tíne ká n̄ hɛ́tá lɛ aá ā? E kahíníī, Ubárābasi.

eng_Latn: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
idu_Latn: Ó hī iyē kú ɔyí nū ɔ́mpa ā ka, Ɛ́frem, Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ gā um le ma nyīla ajɛ kú ōwē kú um.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ nēé yá uculo kú ɔnyā ō lɛ kú uwā ā, Otínīyɛlu da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ajɛ o bī hɛ́hɔ̄ ba ádā nū kpɔ́. Ó le hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí ijakī ā, anɔ́ɔ Ukálɛ̄bu le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ ce ɔ́ ɛgbá āa?.

eng_Latn: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō fíyɛ́ igbeékpónú eko nɛ̄ n cɛgbá kú ācɛ kéē bī ije wā í le tá um abɔ̄ ajɛ kú Utesalóníka ā, aá kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um.

eng_Latn: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā kwú ŋ́, amáŋ n géē yēeyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ wu oyī kú ɔbɛ́ɛna, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá iyɔ̄bū ɔ̄wū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, klla í mī ɔ̄ klá iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka ā igbahāapa.

eng_Latn: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ohígbū uwɔ nēé bá ī ŋmó alɔ eko dóódu á. Nēé bá ī yá alɔ bɛ̄ɛka álá nēé gáā bī nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogbāājɛ ā klla le ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le tá ajɛ ɛgiyí uwā, amáŋ ɔ́ kwúcē wā ŋ́. Ó klla ka ɔwɛ nēé yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya ā lɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ́ɛka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ujéhu, ɔyí kú Unímissi ɔ́ɔ gē pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū ā nɛ̄ n. Ó ka ohígbū ka úgbɔ́ɔnya ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kwinya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́tro gwéeyē ohígbū odúúdú olɔhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ká a da uwá kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ olɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
idu_Latn: N géē je ōwē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ uwá klla ī gwō uwá ɔ́ci dúúdú. É géē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ícɔnū kú um lɔnɔ lɛ aā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, uwá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le yēŋēē, nɛ̄ó ga iyāāwu oligbó ŋ́, nɛ̄ó lé ucɛ kú onyatá nyā ŋ́, ń gáā je ɔ̄ ka ó wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū kaó wā í gwɛ́ɛya gā um eko kú nú ŋ́. Ó géē lɛyíkwu ɔdā dúúmā nōo tá íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē kpo aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá yíífi. Cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
idu_Latn: Óndú, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā. Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ifu nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tá ā.

eng_Latn: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
idu_Latn: Enyi o tɔ́pɛ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā géē yɛ í lɛ alɔ kpó bí ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔyí álá ā lɛ ɔja ɔ́mɛnɛ ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā á. N pó ɔkɔ kú ɔdā oyēeyī ɔ́mɛnɛ ā kahíníī, Gāa.

eng_Latn: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ Ubɛ́tani ɔlɛ́ Usáyímōni olagwú ā. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē lé ɔdōlé ā, ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi bī oli kú ɛcɔ̄ olabásta nɛ̄ anɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́la nɛ̄hi kú unáadi yɔ̄ anú ā. Ó lɛ ɔkɔ kú oli ā ca, lɛ ɔ́ nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó le anɔ̄ ā pīya klí Ujísɔ̄si ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá kpó tū ipú ómbilí cɛ́ɛ́ a kwu uwā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya gā um eko nāa géē je ɔbɛ́ɛna mɛ́mla omlede ɛpa ā gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā.

eng_Latn: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
idu_Latn: Aá ācɛ o līkpɛ̄yí ōlɔfú, aá tá ka aá mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, aá klla kwú ahɔ̄ kú aá ú gwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō bónū! Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aádā aá. Aá abɔ̄yī aá gē tá ɛlā Alelékwū Ihɔ ojigógó dúú.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya da Ayisáya kahíníī, Ɔdi géē wɛ ɔdā ocābɔ̄ ka Óndú ā géē hɛ́ um tá, nɛ̄ n klla í ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ɛ̄cīhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ kwú um anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ um bī ga ipú ígbíli éyi á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n má ɔnyā éyi cīīce ɛyí ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɔ̄wá yōōō éyi. Ɛbɛ́ ā lɛ iyē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēe wɛ atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō nēe tá tū ɔ̄ ɔkpíyē ɛbɛɛbɛ kpɛ́mm. Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nyā lɛ īkpɛ̄yí ahāapa mɛ́mla ajī igwó.

eng_Latn: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
idu_Latn: Ugolíyāti le bɛ̄cɛ yɛ lɛyíkwu Udéfīdi, mla ɔ̄cɛ ó bī iyɛ́fú kú nū ā tá iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa í wā, lɛ otógwō kú um nɛ̄ n kpo bá ɔlɛ́ Ukápusi ajɛ kú Utrɔ́wasi ā kpó wā gé um. A klla í kpó aɔ́kpá ā wā dúú n, ofúlufúlu aɔ́kpá kú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ āa.

eng_Latn: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubatissɛ́ba le pó ka ɔbá anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gekwú ā, ó jikwū nū klla yēkwu kú nū.

eng_Latn: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē gwéeyē eko dúú nɛ̄ alɔ le gbagbafú, amáŋ nɛ̄ aá le lɔfú. Anɔ́ɔ alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ dúú kú aá yɔ̄ gē je pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nēe í yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā olɔhi gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
idu_Latn: Oyíbīyājɛ ā tɛtɛ le ɔdōcābɔ̄ éyi je lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n géē lɛ ɔtū má ɔ̄ ɔtū ā wɛ Ujísɔ̄si á. Aá lɛ ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aéfūma le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ódūdū ā wā ipú ɛcɛ. É le ɛdɔ kú ɔfú nɛ̄ ɛna o cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā lɛ ā je lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyī īkpō tū ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
idu_Latn: Ádā kú ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū le kpó hídáagó ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Usímīyɔn ka lɛyíkwu ɔyí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti tɔ́ɔna ka, Aá lɛ ɔkplɛ́fú kú aá tútū ká aá ga ɔgbɛ́fú!.

eng_Latn: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ācɛ Umówābu, aá ka aá lɔfú fíyɛ́ um á nɛ. N géē da aéwɔhá kéē lɛ ejé je lɛ Umówābu kóō lɛ ɔ́ kwú. Cɛ́ɛ́ Umówābu géē yɔ̄ ī míya ipú agba kú nū nōo gba bá ajɛ ā, kú ācɛ kéē bá ī yɛhɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
idu_Latn: Unáhum kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, n má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyī yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu mla ɔ̄kā olɔhi. Ó yɔ̄ ī wā gaá ka lɛ ācɛ Ujúda ka é le yálé ɛɛ́. Ācɛ Ujúda, aá lé ucɛ kú áa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kpó ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá cokónu ō je lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í wā gáā nuunu tū aá ipú ajɛ kú aá glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka é kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
idu_Latn: Ó le tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ācɛ Ubɛ́tɛlu, Uráma, ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujátɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ Ujíyu ā le pīyabɔ̄ nēé kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, ó géē je uwá kwúcē í kwu ɔcí ɛga nēé kwu gbɔbū ā. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɔfú yá lɛ ā glá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla kɛlā kahíníī, N géē kɔ̄kā kú ɔdōōlɔhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē yá lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohígbū keé he ɔ́ ɔtū piyóó. N géē cɛ̄tra anú kú ɔdōōlɔhi nɛ̄hi nōo yá lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohígbū kóō ī méyīnyinyi uwā mɛ́mla ihɔtū nōo ī mafú lɛ uwá piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
idu_Latn: É gbɛlá koó yɔ̄ mla igwú kú ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ncɛ́ kú Unásārēti ohile ā nɛ̄ n, anɔ́ɔ é yāwu ɛ̄cī odumkúlu ā, anɔ́ɔ e gbɔɔ́ ō tíne nū ipú aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe jé uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
idu_Latn: Gbō um ŋmá ɛgiyí ukpa nēé kpla táajɛ gbēyī um ā Ohígbū ka awɔ gē gbō um ŋmá ipú unwalu á.

eng_Latn: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kéē kwú ācobīyíne ā kpó yíífi, ká ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kéē bá gɛ ŋ́. N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
idu_Latn: Á cɔ̄nū mla uwá gɛ ŋ́, a klla le ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ kwú tū.

eng_Latn: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya le jé ka, Usénākéribu ɔ́ɔ le miya ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ í kpɛ́fú tá Ujerúsālɛm dúúā.

eng_Latn: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
idu_Latn: Aá gwó aɔ́lɛ́ kú aá lā ipú uwā. Aá hɛ́hɔ̄ kú aá lé ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá géē hí ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔdūúgwū kú aá piyóó. Ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú aá, lɛ ayí ma ipú aá ā géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ ákú uwā ipú ajɛ ā eko nāa géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā dúú. Aá géē yá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄yī nū ā. Uwá klla í tá ūlī ká ē je ajɛ kú uwā lɛ uwá mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā dúú.

eng_Latn: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄, é tayínū yɔ̄ ī gbēeyī um kéē lɛ um ŋmó. Ācɛ olɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi ā lɛ īyī uwā túbá tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu um. Ó kē wɛ ka, n bīyíne dúúmā, amáŋ ka n yá uwá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ á, Árɔ̄ni kwú ɔ̄ ú ce iyɔ̄bū ikpati kú Okónuō ce, kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē yɔ̄ gbēyī ayí igbīhi ā.

eng_Latn: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, LORD God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā lɛ aácá ɛhīlī. Aíkpēyī bá ɛga dóódu kú iyē kú uwā, kwu ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú aácá ā dúú. Kwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ kwu otú, é bá gē gwíije piyóó. É gē gwó kahíníī, Ihɔ, Ihɔ, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfu fíyɛ́ dúú ā tīihɔ̄. Anú yɔ̄ tɛtɛ ikée á, anú yɔ̄ abālɔbányā á, anú kē í wā ɛcɔ̄bū á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, N géē je aɛ́cí mɛ́mla aójibó nēe bá Umemfisi ā yíífi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄, nōo géē gbāajɛ kú Íjīpiti gɛ ŋ́. N kē í tū odúúdú ācɛ ā ufi.

eng_Latn: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi kwú lɛ ɔ́. Ó ka amáŋ ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ, Udéfīdi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ dúúdú, klla le odúúdú íne kú anúɔ tū ā ŋ́. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla yá ɔdā nōo he anúɔ ɔtū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the kingdom is the LORD's: and he is the governor among the nations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ á. Anú gē gbō odúúdú aéwo á.

eng_Latn: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ocɛ̄tra kú ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ obene ā, a kē lɛ ɔlɛ́ ō lɛ ɔdɔ olɔfú gwó lɛ iyī uwɔ. Ó kē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ má bá cíí, odúúdú ācɛ nēe bɛ́yíkwu uwɔ ā í má okónu kɛlā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ācɛ kú Ámɔn mɛ́mla Umówābu nyá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā, é lɛ ije cílá Ubálam kóō lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ kwú okónu nōó tá ɔ́ɔmā ú pīya ɔhā lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
idu_Latn: Ācokpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ aá nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɔgbɛ́fú ɛɛ́! Ujonátan gekwú tá ɛyí aɛ́fu kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, gwó kwu ɛyí ɛfú otīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ā géē yɛhɛ tū ífi mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtá. Á klla gáā yúufi kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyā géē wɛ oōgwū piyóó, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nwūla anú ŋ́. Ɔlɛcɛ dúúmā í gáā bū ɔwɛ nyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le bū ɔ̄ɔ̄ wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔwɛ ā géē wɛ oōgwū piyóó.

eng_Latn: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē ka ā, kú aá pó ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim ā gbo úklɔ́ kú nū jāā kwu abālɔbányā ā, é hímáyī ī yá abɔ̄fú kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híī cɔcɛ́ ŋ́, ācɛ oyɔ́dābɔ̄fū kē bá ī yá kóō le lɛ ā abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le okónu ce mla uwá klla le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá tɛtɛ ka, Aá híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Aá híī túkpɛɛ́ lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē je ɔdā dúúmā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíije ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ Óndú. Aá gwō ɛ̄ngwū kú aá gwíijē kú éeyē ō cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gā Utɛ́l Abíbu, nōo kwu áklō kú ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, Ubábīlɔn ā. N klá abɔ́ɔ mla uwá ɛ̄cī aháapa. Okónu í hɛ́ um, ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n má klla pó ā le fíyɛ́ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
idu_Latn: Ká ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ka, ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya olɛlā kú nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka īcíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, Adónīja ɔ́ɔ le yɛ gaá le aɔ́bɛ́ɛna, aálá, mɛ́mla ayí ɛna o tījē kpó gwɛ́ɛya. Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ka Adónīja ɔ́ɔ le odúúdú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, mɛ́mla Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, kpó hīgwú ga ɔnū ucɛ ā. Ó klla da Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ka ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ bá ī lé ucɛ mla anú klla bá ī tá ɔ̄ ɔ́gbá ka Ágábáidu, Adónīja, ɔcɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́hōhasi gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi Usamérīya á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɛhówāsi lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú nū lé á.
