eng_Latn: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Kwú iyó a u kpó ce ɔkɔ ajɛ odobū ɔ́ɔmā ká a nyɛ̄. Lɛ eyī kú uwɔ gbō cɛ́ɛ́ ka á má ɛga nāa gē nyɔ ā ŋ́. N kwú uwɔ ú yá ɔ̄dōōcābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ga, é géē cīlɛ́fú tū Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka uya kú ísu nɛ̄hi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ pīyeyī má ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, obū mɛ́mla ákanya nōó géē má á. Ojuja odobū géē je ajɛ dobū kpímm ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē yá ojuju obɔ̄bí ā, ī má ɔdā nēé leyīce ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛbɔ́ kóō le yɔ̄ ā, géē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
idu_Latn: Aá gē hī Ɔwɔicō ka ádā eko nɛ̄ aá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́. Anú nōo gē ka ɛdɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yá ā, ó gē méyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó ī lɛ ā, aá lɛ ojīlīma cɛ Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɛpléeko nōo hile lɛ aá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yíikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā ŋ́. Aá kéē híī yúufi kú ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā ŋ́, o yá uwā lé í tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī je lé ā. Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ, ó kōō tá alɔ abɔ̄ le aɔ́wɔ nēe gē gbō uwā ɛyí ā kpó yálé ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
idu_Latn: N da ɔ́ kahíníī, Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka ā kwú ɛplɛ̄ɛ̄pa kú ɔkpá kú ajɛ nēe bá nyā í kpó, kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ é gwū mla ɔja ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é gwū ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú uwā í kpó tū ipú ɔjá kú ɔmɛ, kéē géē bá gbojī.

eng_Latn: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le odúúdu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā kpó ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó cɛgbá kéē bī oyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ le gwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe bá ipú nū ā nēe kōō wɛ omágbla kú aɔ́dā nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā á. Amáŋ aɔ́dā okpɔ́cíí nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā cɛgbá ɛya nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ oyī kú aɛ́bɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicā gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm ā ka n géē je uwá yíífi klla í jē odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú nū kpó ŋmó. N géē je ɔlɛ́ ā tá alácɛ̄ ŋmá igelī nēé hī ka Utéman jāā ga ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hī ka Udɛ́dan ā, ɛfú kē í kpó ācɛ ā lé.

eng_Latn: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ akpáabana nōo gē gbo ŋmá okónu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
idu_Latn: Upássɔ, ákú uwɔ ā, é géē kpó awɔ mɛ́mla aíkonó kú uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā gaajɛ Ubábīlɔn. A géē kwú abɔ́ɔ, é kē í nyi uwɔ abɔ́ɔ. É géē nyi uwɔ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú aóklóbīya uwɔ nɛ̄ a húmáyī kā uwā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
idu_Latn: Unebúsāradan klla kwú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Usedekíya ɛhɔ̄ nēe gē nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu iyó kú ɛfú ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi ofɛtá ɔhá ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
idu_Latn: Ó le ajī yá kwu icō kú ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú nū ā. Ó yá uwā ā éékpó kwɔhá mla ede ā. Ó le ugóolu ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī mīya ogbɛnú kú iyó kú aá mɛ́mla ɔ́lá nū ā bá yɔ̄ á. Ugɛ́rā ofu wɛ usɛ́kɛlu éyi. usɛkɛlu ofɛtá géē wɛ umína éyi.

eng_Latn: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ómblí, kwú ɔ̄ ú bī gla ɛyí ɔ́gba kú igelī ā wā ajɛ otú éyi.

eng_Latn: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
idu_Latn: Oje mɛ́mla ɔmɛ nɛ̄ ā má wu īyī ūwā ipú ā, cābɔ̄ ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē ŋmá áájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ō pīyatɔ̄há oŋmá lɛ ō lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ iyī ūwā. Amáŋ ó gáā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ uwá ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oje mɛ́mla ɔmɛ í pīya tɔ̄há kéē je pīya ɔdā ékpónú glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā ɛgiyí ayíkpó ā gaá da uwá kahíníī,Aá ī gbɔlā klla ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Aá má ɔ̄, eko ā gā nēé géē je Ɔyínɔnlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ tū ācobīyíne abɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I and my Father are one.
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla Ádā ā wɛ ékpó.

eng_Latn: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
idu_Latn: N géē lā mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwa.

eng_Latn: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
idu_Latn: É gē jīla tɔhā ojigógó gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ mla ɔtū ékpó. Umerí ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujísɔ̄si, ayínɛ́ kú Ujísɔ̄si nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā mɛ́mla ācɛnyā ōhī wɛ ipú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, aóklóbīya um, alɔ í lā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō da alɔ lɛ piíí ā, ó wɛ o lā kú ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ayínɛ́ um, abālɔbányā alɔ lɔtū lɛ ká alɔ nyɔ̄ ipú inu eyīpú otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā o ŋmá lɛ ikwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, á cíkā ō yúufi um ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē gbɛlá ka amíyɔ géē lɛ abɔ̄ da anúɔ ɛyí tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Kwú aɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi í ká a kwú uwā í nyi ipú ɔmɛ tū ipú aɔ́blɔ́ɔkwu nēé le yá ɛga nēé ī lɛ ikpó cē ɔ́ ga okónpīinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Uféro, nōo yɔ̄ Utapánhes ā. Yá ɔ́ lɛ ā ipéyī ācɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N kwú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó dóódu, nɛ̄ ācɛ bī gé um ā í lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ulé kú eyī nēé gē le kwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
idu_Latn: Gbō ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé leyīce ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ mā ɛyí. Kɛlā kwɛyí uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
idu_Latn: gē ka kahíníī, Ó kwú īyī nū ú gboló ce Óndú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Óndú ā, í nya ɔ́ tá gɛ ŋ́ mā? Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá mɛ́ɛnɛ, ɔ́daŋ ka ó yíihɔtū tú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wā igbīhi um ā, nɛ̄ ń yá lɔhi jɛ̄ ō cíkā ō wī ɔ́ŋgbá kú áblákpá kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó gā, ó géē mafú lɛ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ka é jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ínoōbīya ŋ́, é klla jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Upatrusím mɛ́mla Ukasluhím mɛ́mla Ukaftorím.

eng_Latn: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla Ujérobōwam bá yɔ̄ gē kpɛ́fú eko nēé cɔcɛ́ ā tú īyī uwā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
idu_Latn: A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā nwuné lɛ āa? Tá um ohi, ɔ́dāŋ ka a jé n?.

eng_Latn: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka íla kú Ɔwɔicō ā jéeyī fíyɛ́ íjééyī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ á. Ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ahi kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔfú kú ɔlɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔkōōlɔhi ā mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ācɛ cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí nū ɔwɛ okpaakpa nōo cíkā ā. Aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yá ohígbū ka ācɛ ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū ka ó cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā géē yēeyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le uwá yálé, klla kwú ajɛ kú uwá ú lɛ ayí kú Urúbɛ̄n, mɛ́mla Ugádi mɛ́mla éyi kú āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi Áyíjālɔn ipú ajɛ kú Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
idu_Latn: A má ohi dúúmā, a tá um mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ a gáā ka ā tútū, ka a háyi iyɔ̄bū um kɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ ga óókpoó kú Ugálīli, ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nēe ŋmá ɛga dóódu ā tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu. É ŋmá Ugálīli, é ŋmá Ujudíya.

eng_Latn: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā pó anɔ́ɔ ó tū uwa ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔbɔ́lā í cɛgbá olobócí ŋ́, amáŋ odoōcē ā ī cɛgbá olobócí á. Ń wā gaá hī ācɛ olɔhi igwú ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ nēé leyī gwu uwā bónū ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yá kóō kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔdōtūufi ā, géē míya tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā, ukpa ā kē í kwú ɔ̄. Ɔkpáncō le nwūla bɛ̄ɛka uwíndo ā ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ kē í yā klá ɛcɛ ŋmá anú á. Ɛcɛ kē í jīliyē jāā kwu etikpa kú nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o hile kú uwá wɛ, Upárōssi Urámīya, Ísiya, Umálikīja, Umijámin, Ɛlísa, Umálikīja mɛ́mla Ubenáya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upárōssi.

eng_Latn: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ufi yɔ̄ ī yá um ā, n gbɛlá ka ó lɛ um nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ɛɛ́ nɛ. Amáŋ, ó le ikwū nɛ̄ n je klá anú kóō tū um abɔ̄ ā pó.

eng_Latn: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
idu_Latn: N géē wā í gwɛ́ɛya gā uwɔ mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, Óndú. N géē yɔ̄ í tá uwɔ ahínyá eko dóódu, ohígbū ka a lɔhi.

eng_Latn: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē yā ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā ŋ́ mā, kwu ipú ígbíli nōo wɛ áncā āa?.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya, ɔyí kú Ásibūku, otrɛ̄yí kú āyā kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ubɛ́tūsɔ, ma ɔdɔ nōo gboce ɔ́ á. Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā gaá kwu Únóji kú Udéfidi, mɛ́mla njɔlɔ ā mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja.

eng_Latn: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bá okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko kú uculo kú abɔ̄ ō le ce aá ɛyí ā le jíla.

eng_Latn: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú ɔbá ɛna ú gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú, ámāŋ ɛya ó yá okónu ō ce jīla, ámāŋ ɛya kú olétɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi háyi ɛyí ɛnɔ. Ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba hī odúúdú aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu iciico ā kahíníī, Aá wā gaá le túbá ohígbū ucɛ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá ā!.

eng_Latn: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ikwū lɛ um ŋmó, nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ aólɛlā kú awɔ, Udéfīdi kpó yíífi kwɛyí, ā híī mlanyī ó yá olɔhi nyā lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
idu_Latn: É le okwū kú Ujósɛ̄fu nēé bī ŋmá Íjīpiti ā nyi Ussɛ́kɛm ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu lá ŋmá ɛga ayí kú Uhámɔ, ádā kú Ussɛ́kɛm, ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛhɔ̄ ā. Ajɛ nyā nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛfu lé úgwū nū á.

eng_Latn: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
idu_Latn: Ábūdɔn, Usíkri, Uhánan.

eng_Latn: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ yá Óndú ā ɔdā iwɔ́tū, nōó le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, nōo tine ō je uwá kpó yíífi dúú eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ɛgiyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
idu_Latn: Oje udɔ nōo kē pīya cíla uwá icō ɔtāhɛ̄ ā, olikpō kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄, é lɛ ijābɔ̄ kú oje udɔ kú īkpɔ̄cí kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti he tū ɔ́.

eng_Latn: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aípɔ́ɔ́nū ɔhá nēe hile ā mɛ́mla anyā ūwā géē bá ī yēkwu kú ūwā ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka wɛ ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa tá ūlī kwú nɛ̄ ó je ajɛ lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
idu_Latn: Kóō yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna ihɔtū kú uwɔ nāa ī mafú eko dóódu ā. mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tōō lɛ ɔtuce uwɔ ā otú dóódu.

eng_Latn: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Óndú kéē da ɔ́ ɔka kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni ka ka a gē wā á nɛɛ kɛ̄ɛ kā ālɔ̄ leyītáajɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú Áhābu ā, Uhíyɛ̄lu ŋmá Ubɛ́tɛlu gaá lɛ Ujérīko tū gwó. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú Ujósuwa, ɔyí kú Unún lɛ ā, ɔ́kplá kú Uhíyɛ̄lu, Abiram gekwú eko nōó gaá le ikpíinu kú Ujérīko táajɛ ā. Ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhɔ́ma ā klla gekwú, eko nōó le odūngwɔ́wɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko gwó kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le da uwá ka, odúúdu uwā géē pɛ́kwú ipú ígbíli, ayíka Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unún, ōfōōfū uwā ɛ́ɛ géē ga ajɛ ā á, amáŋ odúúdu ācɛ o hile ā ɛ́ɛ géē pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n le da aá ā, ɔtū le bīya lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, le ɔ́ nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ídɛn ā, kóō gaá hí ajɛ nēé yá ɔ̄ ŋmá āa.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le ka lɛ Árɔ̄ni ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ka eko nōo le kpaakpa ā ōfōōfūnū nōó géē ga igbīhi ukɔ́tin ā ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ n gē wɛ̄ɛcɛ ipú ojuja ɛyí ɔwū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka ā á. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛyítáajɛ ŋ́, ó géē kwú.

eng_Latn: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi í je ajɛ dúúmā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka, ukpɛ̄ kú uwá ɔ́ɔ gē ŋmá ipú ɛya nēé ī gwó lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ eyīyōce nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā je lɛ alɔ ā kwɛjī ipú ɛcɛ nyā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔdā ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ayíka alɔ tēyīnyinyi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ ádā nū Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū dóódu kpó wā. É wɛ ofɛtá cigwó.

eng_Latn: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nōó kóō jɛ̄ jāā gaá kwu ɔkpáncō nááná, nɛ̄ ɛyí kú nū gaá kwu ojuja.

eng_Latn: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó uwā wā ɔlɛ́, ŋmá Íjīpiti mla Asírīya, N géē kpó uwá gaá lā Ugílɛ́di mla Ulɛ́bānɔn dúú, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú ajɛ ā kwú mu mla ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛbɛ́ nōo wɛ ɔdā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú nū ā ŋmó. Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū le oyī kú nū bī gé lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya tū ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɔkwu kú ede ā á.

eng_Latn: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nū ā jikwū iyɔ̄bū nū ɛ̄cī ahāapa, nɛ̄ eko kú ucɛ ā yɛ í kwu ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, abɔ̄ ɔnyā ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ó le ɛyí ita ā ka lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā le ka lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya á.

eng_Latn: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
idu_Latn: Kwú okwutɛ kú uwɔ ā ú gicō kú ā lɛ ɔ́ nā kwu eyī kú ísu ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ ā í je kɔ̄ ɛpa. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē yɛ ajɛ oŋmókókó bū ipú ísu ā ga ogbeé ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ubéla wɛ, Áda, Ugɛ́ra, mɛ́mla Abíhudu.

eng_Latn: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
idu_Latn: É wɛ, Ésa, Obadáya, Ɛlíyābu.

eng_Latn: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
idu_Latn: Utáhāti, Uríyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
idu_Latn: Ibinɛ́ya, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́rōham, Ɛ́la, ɔyí kú Úsi, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umíkri, Uméssūlam, ɔyí kú Ussefatíya nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Uréwɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ibiníja ā.

eng_Latn: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú éwɔhá ī wā ī túkpɛɛ́ɛ́ gā um. É gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
idu_Latn: É bī aɛ́na ofɛtá cigwó, aálá ofɛhɔ̄, mla aómlede ofigwó wā í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɛhīlī, aá géē hɛ́hɔ̄ anú klla í nyi, í cē īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
idu_Latn: Ujaním, Ubɛti Utápūwa, Áfēka.

eng_Latn: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya le ede mɛ́mla aíkpɛ́cí nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ma kwu ajɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu á, nōo yá ka ɔtú kóō wú Óndú ā kpó ca tāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le uwá kpó tū ɔlá. Kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá Ubɛ́tɛlu ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄sī da ayíkpó kú nū ā kahíníī, Aá jɛ́yí odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ā? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ́ ohi kahíníī, Īī.

eng_Latn: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé ī yá ā, é géē yɔ̄ ī tá agbénú kú uwā tū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpíinu olɔhi nēé le táajɛ kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē lɔfú lɛ abɔ̄ bī oyēeyi nōo wɛ oyēeyi ɔkwɛ̄yi aā.

eng_Latn: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā bī íwɔ́tū kú nū le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū uwā. Ó klla ī bī ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú nū le tū uwā ufi gē da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ka lɛ Userúbábɛ̄lu, ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussiyatíyɛlu nōo wɛ igbómína kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujɛhosādaku nōo wɛ otrɛyí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ohile ā.

eng_Latn: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ussɛlá wɛ iháyí ofuciigwó ā, ó lɛ ɔyí éyi, nōó hī ka Ɛ́ba ma.

eng_Latn: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n kē í yá okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ aádáádā uwá, ka n géē je ajɛ nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdāajɛ ā lɛ uwá. Ajɛ ā nēé kē lā anú ícɛ nyā á. Anɔ́ɔ ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā tóohi ka, Abɔ̄ ó lɛ á, Óndú.

eng_Latn: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó cíkā o lɛ ɛcá dóódu ŋ́. Ó cíkā ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ánya ŋ́, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ o gwá ejé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ o kpɔ́tūfúlú ŋ́, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ o yúnwū ije ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
idu_Latn: le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ubálam, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ ajɛ kú Upɛ́tɔ, nōo kwu ísu kú Uyúfrétīsi ajaajɛ ipú ajɛ kú Ámɔn ā. É le ɛhɔ̄ kú nu cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ ewo éyi dúúdú le pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā í yɔ̄ ī nyīla tāajɛ. É klla yɔ̄ ī tútū kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ tābɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
idu_Latn: A kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī kú aéwɔhá í wúlatāajɛ klla lɛ aɛ́ga olɔfú nēé ī kwu tayínū ā catāajɛ. Aɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ā í klla yɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É klla gáā tá uwā gwó gbóógbóō ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ nēe gekwú ŋ́. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī. Aá nyíleyī íbí.

eng_Latn: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī gwɔ̄ɔ́ci abɔ̄yī uwɔ ŋ́. Mabɔ̄ ɔ́ci ōgwō tá lɛ Ɔwɔicō, anú géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ pīya tū ipú ɔgbanjɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō na ikpó kú ayíkpó kú nū á. Eko nōó le uwá ikpó na kwɛyí cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ogōdōgōdō nɛ̄ ó le gbō ɛ́nyɔ́ ā le ikpó ā nya.

eng_Latn: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú íne nyā wɛ ka, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē bī ɛbɛ́ nēé tɛtɛ gē ŋmó ɛcɛ pélúú ā gé lɛ Óndú ā abālɔbányā. É géē bī uwā wā gē lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, kéē ŋmó ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ nēé gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā yúúfi ŋ́, Umerí, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kahíníī, O ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, n géē ma īyī um fú lɛ Áhābu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī tíne kóō ŋmó ā. Aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nīinya ā. Okwū ewō icííci, iju icííci.

eng_Latn: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ɛga ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛjī kú nū, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á. Ipú ajɛ ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda lā á.

eng_Latn: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Ɔyinɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ gē tū ayínɛ́ ɛtá ɛhɔ̄ fu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī aá gwō kú um kóō le pīya ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kú Umasɛdónīya, ká aá le tútū ā.

eng_Latn: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācobɔ̄bíipú í gáā gbiyɔ̄lā glá ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí éyi yá ámāŋ kēé lɛ odée yá ɔ̄cɛ éyi piíí.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kóō kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā ú gē lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ɔyí ā ŋmá abɔ̄ nū á. Ó kwú ɔyí ā ú bī ga inīīcō, ɛga nōó gbɔga ɔlɛ́ ɔnyā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ú gwutá agōdō.

eng_Latn: And he said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi tá Urútu ohi ka, Óndú ā kú ō hɔ́hā ce ɔ́. Ka, ucē olɔhi nɔ́ɔ mafú nyā klla lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá tá ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū ā á. Abɔ̄ ɔ́ kwu tá ɔyípōklóbīya nōo lɛ ɔdu ámāŋ ogbɛhá ɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ mla anú ā túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ olɛhɔ̄ bī gé um wɛɛlɛ. Ó kɛlā ŋiniŋini nɛ̄ um pó ŋ́ igbō.

eng_Latn: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le kpaakpa lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yɛ ce uwɔ kpaakpa ā. A klla lɔhi dúúdú lɛ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛlā kú ɔcɛ́ kwajɛ kli, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tá ɔ̄ áafú glá ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í ka ka ɔdā nōó yá ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́tam le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ iháyí ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ujɛrússa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛna lɛ ajī gwū ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā, óndú ɛna ā géē gbā ije o lɛbɛ̄ɛka égō ofu cigwó lɛ óndú kú ɔfiyɛ ā. É kē í bī ɛcɔ̄ lɛ ŋmó ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā ka kwɛyí ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ugálīli. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ajɛ kú Ujudíya, ogbeé ɔhá kú Ujɔ́dan ā á.

eng_Latn: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā le iyī uwā tútū, aígabɔ̄ ā kē le jīla tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu Óndú ā mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
idu_Latn: Ń gē lé ɛbɛ́ ɛna ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō ī gwá oyī kú ɛwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Ábna lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gáā nyɔ̄ í da Udéfīdi ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin cɛ̄ ka aá ɔ́ɔ gáā yá ā á.

eng_Latn: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā, ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ bá ɛcɛ gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē kɛlā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
idu_Latn: Tā anyākwɔ́cɛ ā ukɔ́ kéē gbēyī gɔɔ, kéē tohilīpú, kéē ce iyī uwā bī glá, kéē háyi kpaakpa kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, kéē yíihɔtū kéē lɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
idu_Latn: É ka aá géē mā uwá tá kéē bá ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ aá ce lɛ uwá ā, ámāŋ, ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
idu_Latn: Inu nōo pīyeyī kwú ɛhícō ā wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe gē yúklɔ́ ɛyí ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya nyā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usádɔ̄ku. Uwá ofōōfū uwā nēé je ɛga lɛ uwá ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ká ē nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā nyɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
idu_Latn: je kpó yíífi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Ulífāyi, o ŋmá lɛ o túbla aɔ́dā o tīihɔ nēe bá nyā ŋ́. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī kwú ŋ́ mā, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū géē ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá je ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā í bī ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
idu_Latn: Ami háyi okónu obugā ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛnyā kú igelī ā gē wā í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla anyā uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā háyi iyɔ̄bū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ ɔnyā éyi nōo lɛ īkpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó, anɔ́ɔ ékpónú gebí ɔdí nōó í yá ā? Ó í hɛ́ ɔlá kwu agege, lɛ inu ɔlɛ́ nū gwu wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Ó í dɔɔ̄kā nū lɔɔlɔhi ɛga dóódu jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔnya nū wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó le yɛ ce íkpá kú ɔ́bíipú ō bí tū Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Áhābu, ohilí nū ā. Ó kē le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga dóódu nēé pahīla nyɔ̄ ā, kwúcē wā Ujúda á. É ga ɛgiyí Ugɛdalíya Umíspa. Abɔ́ɔ ā, é gaá lɛ ejé mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí túbá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bá ī pó uya kú ɛfú nēé bá ī kpó ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ī yá ɔdéē ífi ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi kwú īkpō kú ɔcí nēe hī ka umɔ́sitáadi, īkpō nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ nyi ipú ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Their heart cried unto the LORD, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ piíí ā jikwū klá Óndú ā, Agīje kú uwɔ kóō pɛ́ otú mɛ́mla ɔ́lɛ́ɛnɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ísu gē pɛ́ ā. Ikwū ō je mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí ō yá kóō lɛ aá gbagbafú.

eng_Latn: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
idu_Latn: Oje ɔlamu nēé bī le yá aíkpó kú nū á. É bī oje mɛ́mla ɔmɛ wīya tɔ̄há le yá aíkpó ō daajɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aínɔ̄ɔda ɔkplɛ́fú kú aá kpɛ́m ā, géē je pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ufíg nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū le pīya. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛ ɔcí ufígi ā jíliyē, īkpō ā í hɛ́ wā í tá ipú okónu kú ācɛ nēe jíla ɔ́ iyē ā glá.

eng_Latn: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ klla tū uwā ukɔ́ kú aɔ́dā ohile dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, alɔ tíne ō mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
idu_Latn: Anú yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla ísu, mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú uwā á. Ó gē yá ɛlā nōó ka ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aá cíkā ō yúufi ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ kpɔ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
idu_Latn: Anú gē yá odúúdú ɛgbá kú n gā um á, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ hīla ŋ́, kú n̄ klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ nēé hī okpé ā.

eng_Latn: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa ā kē í cīce bá ī lé ɔdōlé tɔ̄há ɛyí utéblu ékpónú, amáŋ ɔtū kú uwá kē bɔ̄bí lɛ iyī uwā. É géē bá ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ iyī uwā. Amáŋ é gáā lɛ ɔdā nēé gē tíne ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko kú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā í wā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ. Yíhɔtū tū oladóogbe kú uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka īyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
idu_Latn: Aá da ācɛ nēe gē ga iyāwu ā ɔ̄kā jéejéē ɛɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá jé ɔdā nēé gē ka ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é gba ācɛ kú Ulífāyi áluka tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́da lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔnyā ā yɔ̄ í cīla ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ā, ó le okónū abɔ̄yīnū cɛ̄lā nɛ̄ Ugɛ́hási ka ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le igabɔ̄ kú nū éyi hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í kwú ajɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú agbénú kú ɔnyā ā mɛ́mla ije dóódu nēé lá ŋmá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, ífī iháyí ahāapa nɛ̄ ɔ́ yɔ̄ ŋ́ má ú kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó nwū uwā ɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ikwu ā. Ó gbla ācɛ nēe ī nwū uwā íne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
idu_Latn: É gē bī ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo wɛ ocīkpó ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū wā í táajɛ ɛ̄cī dóódu okómpīinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Okómpinu Ohéyifuú ā, kóō gaá ba ɔdā ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ nēe ī bēhé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ úwé kú oje udɔ nōo gbɛnú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi wiyē. Ó klla le ɔkpú kú oje udɔ kwu ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umówābu gē lɛ ɔyí álá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá Iselá, ipú ácí, ɛga nɛ̄ uwá kwu gāa lā a.

eng_Latn: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le inya kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú alɔ. É le iyɔ́fú mɛ́mla ɔdā nēe wɛ ákú alɔ ā kpó.

eng_Latn: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú nū le hɔ́ɔgba mɛ́mla ígwíígwu kú āpū nēe lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú ā. É klla kwu ɔhá klá īyī uwā, le jé bɔ́há bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu gbɔɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ iyāwu kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó klla gaá jīla Ujónādabu, ɔyí kú Urékabu ɔwɛ. Ujéhu le okónu hɛ́ tā ɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ mɛ́mla um gē gbɛlá ékpónú úū? A géē yɛce um m? Anɔ́ɔ Ujónādabu cɛ̄ ka anɔ́ɔ géē yɛce ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ abɔ̄ je lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú abɔ̄ ú fúlá tū iyī uwā abɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu kwú abɔ̄ ú tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ wā ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya klla da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛba ɔlá ofíyajɛ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ á. Ɔlɛ́ nēé gwo ce ɛyí ɛfu í gáā tayínū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:
idu_Latn: Ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ anúɔ bī īgbō aflɛ́yí kú ɔdā kú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je lɛ anúɔ ā wā gé lɛ óndú á. Umósīsi da uwá kéē kwú ómbilí ā í háyi ajɛ ipéyī kú Óndú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ ī má ɔ̄ ā, ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi éyi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, le cē ŋmá icō ɛfu abɔ̄yīnū gaá gɔ́ ikpó ō daajɛ nēé yá mla oje mɛ́mla ɔmɛ nēé wīya tɔ̄há ā, le uwá ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ.

eng_Latn: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ajɛ kú Ugílííd ɔ́ɔ wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo le mu mla ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ oŋmó ācɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
idu_Latn: Ó le um yá ká n̄ lā ipú obū bɛ̄ɛka obū nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe kwú gbojī ɛɛ́ mā lā a.

eng_Latn: The LORD was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka olɛ̄la ā, ó kwú Ísrɛ̄lu u yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Ó kwú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdɔ olɔfú ō gwutayínū ā ú pīya alácɛ̄. Ó lɛ ɔtūnōbí, íwɔ́tū mɛ́mla agīje nɛ̄ ó lɛ oōmɛ ŋ́ mā, bī wā í klá ācɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā í wɛ íne nɛ̄ n gē je lɛ aá ā ŋ́, amáŋ n gē bī ɔtū ōcaca kú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú Umasɛdónīya le yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ aá. N yɔ̄ gē je ɛga nyā lɛ aá ká aá mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ihɔtū kú aā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si pīyɛyí ga abɔ̄ ɔhá kú okpoó ā, ācɛ ā mīyɛ anú, ohígbū ka odúúdú uwā húmáyī gbēyī nū.

eng_Latn: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
idu_Latn: Ussɛmída mɛ́mla Uhɛ́fa.

eng_Latn: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nāńdaa. Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ abɔ̄ ā nāŋ́daa, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú yá lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
idu_Latn: kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā mɛ́mla ákú aádáádā uwá ā piíí. É lɛ aɛ́cí pā ɛyí aɛ́fu klla lɛ āflūmā yá um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē yá uwā italā kú ɔdā nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
idu_Latn: É nuunu tá um lɔfúlɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé gáā yá um lé ā, amáŋ, Óndú ā wā í le abɔ̄ tá um.

eng_Latn: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nɛ̄ aá má nyā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé kwú ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛpɔ̄ nōó ī ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó klla le kpaakpa. Ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū akwuna nɛ̄hi nōo bī ajā nōó ī gbo ā le odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ kpó bīya ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō lɛ italā yá ɔ̄ ohígbū koó ŋmó ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ klla le odúúdú ācɛ kú Unɔ́bu, igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó ŋmó. Kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, kwu ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí olugwulugwu, kwu aɛ́na, aíjakī, mla aálá dúú.

eng_Latn: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klla kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ɔhá géē bī ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi, nōó cíkā kóō lé ɔcɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē wā igbledū mla ula, í wā ī mīyɛ ɔcɛ́ ā lé abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
idu_Latn: A wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔbíipú í he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́. Ācobɔ̄bíipú í klá ɛgiyí uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Uhílɛn, Udɛbi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati nōo kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn ga Íjīpiti ā le ɔ̄kā ā pó ā, ó kwúcē gā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si tíne kóō téeyī olɔhi kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, da Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ó he uwɔ ɔtū ká ā nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ɔdā alɛwa nēé kpó ce uwɔ ā ka abɔ́ɔ iyɔ̄bū um m.

eng_Latn: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yɛ ipú Ugálīli ŋmá igelī éyi ga ɔhá. Ó dɔɔ̄kā ō yɛ ipú Ujudíya ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu tíne kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
idu_Latn: Ó ka aígelī nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú kwu nyɔ̄ ɔ́dāŋ nōó jégēdē ŋ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ olɛlā kú nū ŋ́ ŋmó. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɔfú kwu nyɔ̄ éyi kú aígelī ā glá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ ŋmó gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú īyī uwā igbɔhá kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ i yɛ gaá le ɛfú kpó tú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā. Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nēé bá gē kpɛ́fú ā, ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, n klla le ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ má ipú ɔ̄na kú um ā kpɔ́. Ɛbɛ́ nyā bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi klla tūufi ō má nɛ̄hi. Ó lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ó klla bū aīnu oje nōo nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ó gē je aólɛlā kú nū catāajɛ, klla ī lɛ ikpó da uwá bá ajɛ. Ɛbɛ́ nyā lɛ aájī igwó, ó kē wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū aɛ́bɛ́ ohile ā tá.

eng_Latn: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá le uwá kpó kwú oyēeyī. É le uwá kpó kwú, anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu kwú uwá ú kpó ŋmó ɛgiyí ɔ̄gɔ̄ éyi nōo kwu abɔ́ɔ ajaajɛ ā. É wɛ ācɛ ofɛpa ce ɛpa, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó kē lɛ ɛlā kú nū ka lɛ aípɔ́ɔnū kú Ujékɔ̄pu ɛɛ́, ó klla je íne lɛ uwá, ó klla le ukɔ́ tū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé kē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ nēe gē lā oyēeyī kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tíne ā, kéē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ipéyī Óndú ā. Ó gáā gwá ejé ɔlamu ámāŋ ka ejé olɔfú dóódu ŋ́. Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kōō ma ɔ́ ā ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ géē mu ɔ́ iyē.

eng_Latn: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu, ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ɛhɔ̄. Aá wɛ éwo nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū kéē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́, aá wɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ōfūnū. Anú ā hī aá igwú ŋmá ipú obū kú ínoōbīya ga ipú kú ɔlá ofiyajɛ nōo nya aá tá ā á. Ó fu aá ká aá ka ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄ ó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
idu_Latn: da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, géē kpó ɔcí nōo kwɛyí Ísrɛ̄lu kwu ɔhá mɛ́mla ɔcí nōo kwɛyí Ujúda. Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā géē je pīya ɔcí ékpónú, nɛ̄ n géē bī ipú abɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ álá bī wā í le gwɛ́ɛya nyā á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Umanásɛ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ássa ga Umícimēta, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Usɛ́kɛm. Ɛjī kú nū yɛ ɛháajɛ gā ipú ācɛ kú Ɛntápūwa.

eng_Latn: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le utánki okokolo kú oje udɔ o bī éŋkpɔ̄ yá. O ŋmá okónu éyi ga okónu ɔhá kú nū wɛ ikpó igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. O lipú kú nū wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā, anɔ́ɔ o pīya biílí kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu ɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú īyī aá ú tá alahá ŋmá lɛ ō yɛce aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā. Íjīpiti géē je uwēyī lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Asírīya je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē bī okónū awanda kú nū le pi ācɛ ɔhá wāajɛ, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔdāhá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ō tū ohílīpú mɛ́mla ojɔ́dā gē lɛ okónu klá cíí.

eng_Latn: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
idu_Latn: Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ohígbū ka, ajɛ nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu lā a, í jɛ̄ uwā ŋ́. É lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ uwá kéē bá tɔ̄há glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn bī ɔcí nyā le gbā ɔdōcīce kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, klla bī le yá ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla úmōlō kú ācogwíjē ā. Ɛ̄nyā lɔhi fíyɛ́ odúúdú ɔcí nēé hī ujúnīpa nēé húmáyī kpó wā Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ɛdɔ nū dúúmā ɔhá í klla yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dúúmā nāa gáā kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú uwɔ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ géē cɛ̄ í fu iyī uwā tá uwɔ ɔkwu kéē kpɛ́fú. Ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ géē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ bɛ̄ɛka ébú kú ofúlɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mla odúúdú ācɛ nēé lā Usamérīya a géē jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ̄nyā á. Abālɔbányā a, é ba ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ klá í gɔ̄ ɛɛ́, klá í ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
idu_Latn: Aígbómína dóódu nēe bá gbɔbū gā um ā húmáyī lɛ iyó ce ācɛ ā. É klla í da ācɛ ā kéē je ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛpa lɛ aá ɛ̄cī dóódu, kú aá le lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ō le gwá ejé. Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwá klla ī yá ācɛ ōwē dúú. Amáŋ ucē kú um í lɛ ā ŋ́, n wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, ohígbū ka n gē yúufi Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá je odée kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā lé ɛga otīihɔ ŋ́ mā? Ó tīīhɔ nɛ̄hi, Óndú ā kē kwú ú lɛ aá, o yá kóō yá kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā í kpó yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú. Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō gwíijē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ. Ó lɔhi klla kē cíkā kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Umanásɛ í lɔfú nū ācɛ nēe lā aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā bɛ̄cɛ glá ŋ́. Ācɛ Ukénan lā abɔ́ɔ mla uwá jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Ujohánan, ɔyí Ukaréya mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja, nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ā hīgwú á, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā, ŋmá ɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ga ɛnɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔfiyɛ ā í gē lā ipɔ́ɔnū piyóó ŋ́, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ gē lā ipɔ́ɔnū piyóó.

eng_Latn: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aá mīyɛ odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā, ŋmá Arówɛ nōo yɔ̄ kwu okónu ísu kú Ánɔn ā, mɛ́mla aígelī nēe bá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔpɛ́ ā, jāā í kwu Ugílɛ̄di ā. Ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē bī ɔlɛ́ ā háyi glá ŋ́. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aá mīyɛ uwá kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Igbɛ alɛwa é jé Ɔwɔicō má klla bī íwɔ́tū gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɛfíbōssɛ̄ti tá Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā ohi ka Usíba ka ɔ́ɔ̄ bī odúúdú agbénú ā mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ka ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ wā ɛbɔ́ ā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ anúɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔcɛ́ ka Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ Unátan le bēhé ga ipú inu gaá túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄nyɛ géē lɔfú lɔtū ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ó í wā ɔ́ɔmā glá ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú yēeyī ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ó í wā ā glá āā? Ohígbū ka ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukwɔ olɔfú nōo ī na īlī yēēŋēē ā, ámāŋ ka ɔlá nōo gē na oje yɔ̄ŋɔ̄ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ ɔlá kwu agege klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ɛháajɛ ɔgālā ŋ́, amáŋ é gē je ɔ́ ce ɛyí ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́, kóō fíyáajɛ lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe bá ipú inu ā.

eng_Latn: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Árābu, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú ígbíli ā le gwá.

eng_Latn: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usipóra kwū ɛcɔ̄ ō lulé ú, le ufíyé kú apī kú ɔyí nū hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ kwu Umósīsi ikpó. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Umósīsi kahíníī, A wɛ ɔbá um ipú oyī nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ma ka ɛwa kú ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ yɛjīla tá ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kéē nyɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā kú Áyísīki, ɔyí kú Ébrahām yɛ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū da ɔ́ ka, Ágábáidu, aá kóō lɛ ɔ́yípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā éyi tíne lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō leyīkwu ɔ́, klla bēē gbo pī ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ iyē hɔ́lá.

eng_Latn: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācɛ nēe lɔtūce um kpɔ́ ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cotɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ oklɔ́ɔcɛ́ yá lɔɔlɔhi kú ō bī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó jé ā le yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ olɔhi dóódu.

eng_Latn: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
idu_Latn: a kē jé lɔɔlɔhi ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ō bī aópeyī jé ɔwɛ, nāa kē wɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ajoodobū ā.

eng_Latn: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kéē le jé ka úklɔ́ kú uwā í gáā lɛ ile dúú lɛ uwá ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē tīile lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā. Abɔ̄ é kɛlā lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá pó abālɔbányā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācotɛ̄hɔ̄, nēe bī ɔfú kú Alelékwū ihɔ nēé tɛhɔ ŋmá ɔkpancō ā, le ka ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá ā. Aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tíne lɔfúlɔfú kéē lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā jé.

eng_Latn: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó kē le kpaakpa ŋ́, ɔlá kóō bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki gaá lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kú Ussɛ́kɛm mɛ́mla Ubɛtimílo yi tāajɛ. Ɔlá kóō kē ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛnyīlɔ kú Ussɛ́kɛm mɛ́mla Ubɛtimílo gaá lɛ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í gáā lɛ ɔdōnīgbō dúúmā ɔlɛ́ nū ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɛbɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í ŋmó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā ú lé ŋmá ajɛ, kéē híī cɛ̄ lɛ odúúmā kú nū hile gbó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Unáhāssi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn ā gekwú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Uhánɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔkpá gwá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé fu ɔ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka, Óndú alɔ le ɔkpá gbo, ó gáā pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ ŋ́, A wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ odúúdu aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn, kwu Uhɛ́ssbɔn, mɛ́mla aígeli nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ̄ nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīlatá ā. É klla má lā anú.

eng_Latn: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ owu gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɛmɛɛma ŋmá ɛháajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ācopúgbényi ā gbɛlá ka aá lɔfú yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tɛɛtɛ miya táajɛ ā, é le ánkɔ kú úgbéenyi ā pi gicō ŋmáajɛ anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ úgbéenyi bá ogwoogwu ɔ́kɔŋgɔ̄ kú Ukrɛ́ti á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú um húmáyī bɔ̄bí ŋmífī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um ma um ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um kōō yīipú kú um ā, ucē kú um í lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē nuunu tá ācɛ ā ohígbū íne nēé bīya nyā, klla í yá ūwā italā. Ó klla ka aéwo ɔhá ɛ́ɛ géē túbá tɔ̄ɔ̄há lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nēé géē yá uwā italā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā éyi nɛ̄ a ka ā, wɛ ɛcá ga um. Amáŋ abɔ̄ n jé odée ā, n jé ohi nū, nɛ̄ n gēe tá uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
idu_Latn: Ń yɛ í gekwú eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í yɔ̄ í mlɛ́nyɔ́ abālɔbányā ɛɛ́. N klla yɛ í yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā, yɔ̄ í mlɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í gē piyɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōó le fu klla le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko ā gaá da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a má ɔ̄ lɛ ā, igelī nɛ̄hi nyā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, amáŋ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū bɔ̄bí, ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
idu_Latn: N le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú um ka, N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ, kú ā lɛ ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá lɛ ācɛ ā cíla um.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā Usámsin nyɔ̄ gaá má ɔnyā nū eko nēé gē cē īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛwū bī gé lɛ ɔnyā nū ā. Ó da ádā ɔnyā nū ā ka anúɔ tíne ō gwutá mla ɔnyā anúɔ ipú inu ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ, ádā ɔnyā nū ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ igbīhi nū bɛ̄ɛka, ɔ̄cɛ oyúklɔ́ mla anú ā. Ami yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē gwéeye ɛ̄cī dóódu á. Ɔtū gē he um eko dóódu nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n le ikpó ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ce, ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ínē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ō kpó. Ó wɛ ɛdɔ íne ō kpó néē ī bī íne le yá ɔ̄cɛ italā kú nū.

eng_Latn: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛlā ka ɛɛ́. Anú nōo gē gbō Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ɛlā ka gā um kahíníī: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó kē ī gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó yá ɔkpáncō klla je ɔ́ nāndaa ā klá ɛga nōo kwu nyā á. Ɛ́ɛ́ kóō kpó aínyílɔ́wɔ kwu ɔkpáncō ā, n yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɛce odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam bī ā kpɛ́mm. É habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ nōo gē cɔ̄ɔ̄wɔ kú ɔdā nēé í ka ā ŋ́, ayíka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ācɛ nēe gē ka ucē ɔhá ā kóō yɔ̄ cíí cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kɛlā lɛ iyī nū mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
idu_Latn: Áfim, Upára, Ófra.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
idu_Latn: Aá híī tɛ́yíkpɛɛ́ lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Aá kóō híī wɛ ipú ɛ̄gbā ō gba ɔwɔ kú uwā ŋ́. Aá lɛ aɔ́wɔ mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú ɛcí kú uwā kpó ca bónū.

eng_Latn: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ɔdā éékpó mɛ́mla ɔbɛ́ɛna nyā ɛ́gɛ́ ɔdā nōó yá mla ɔbɛ́ɛna nēe gē gwu íne nēé bīya ā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó géē le gwɛ́ɛya kóō je yɛ́ɛhi kú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya á. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cíla um ulé olɔhi nyā, ohígbū ka n yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa. Ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce um, ohígbū ka ń lé ɛpɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ipú aɛ́cī ɔ́ɔmā nááná ā, ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwáahāapa wɛ Uhésɛ̄ɛ, ɔ́migwáahātá ā wɛ Uhapísesi.

eng_Latn: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uríya lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ka ā yá á.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, É le okónu nēé tá lɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā tá tū ɔ̄. É tá ɔ̄ tū eyī éyi kú nū ka, é géē je odúúdú aúwī kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā. É tá tū eyí ɔhá ā ka, é géē kpó ācɛ nēe le ɛka gbo ka aá géē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi, nēe klla nyɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā, yíífi ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwá kéē lɛ ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi míya gwū okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācɛ fu kéē gbō abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kōō Utáyítɔ̄si nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ mla um ā, nááná nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ugríisi ā, é pi ɔ́ abɔ̄fú kóō lɛ apī hɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā géē bī ɔnyā nū ā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā géē bī umu okoolo éyi nēé géē bī le gwɛ́ɛya, amáŋ ó gáā pīya anɔ̄ kú ólífu tū ɔ̄ ámāŋ o lɛ ɔtulalī dóódu ce ɔ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó wɛ ɛya nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔbá nōo kpéyīce ɔnyā nū, nēé gwó kóō lɛ ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
idu_Latn: Uwá nááná ā géē nyɔ̄ ɔlékwū mɛ́mla anú ga ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ le ŋmó ɛɛ́ mā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā obobowu kú nū ā géē je pahīla tū ipú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
idu_Latn: Umátītīya, ɔ́kplá kú Ussálum ā gē yá igbō-ō-bákánjɔ̄ kú ɛya á.

eng_Latn: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ékpó ŋmá ipú ije nēé cē bá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́, nōo yá ká igbómína ā kóō le hídáagó nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā yá.

eng_Latn: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um, nɛ̄ aá gbɔɔ́ ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aá ka aá yá ā, n géē je aá kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm ɛga nɛ̄ n je ka aá géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā. Nááná nɛ̄ aá le fíyákátā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ ā, n géē je aá kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da uwá ɔ̄kā kā, Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ ó yā? É klla lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm fíyɛ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí kú aá kpó bōnū. Aá habɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n má aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā tá.

eng_Latn: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ojuju kú ɔdā alɛwa ipú ɔtū kú nū, amáŋ Óndú ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó miya ā í yá glá á.

eng_Latn: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá iyī nū ɛbɛ́ ipú ɔtū kú nū ka, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ gáā pīyɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ anúɔ bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ gē ŋmó anúɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
idu_Latn: Otábɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ Íjīpiti gē yá ā í tīile dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gē hī Íjīpiti ka, ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nōó yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
idu_Latn: Umíka ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, Upítɔn, Uméleki, Utérēya mɛ́mla Áhāsi.

eng_Latn: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó igwó ohile ā le pó ā, ɔtū le wú uwā lɛyíkwu ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oyī kú ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla ɛwū í na ínoōbīya glá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
idu_Latn: Ipú inu nōo kwu okómpinu nyā, autéblu ɛnɛ bá abɔ́ɔ. Aútéblu ɛpɛɛpa bá āyā ɛpa kú inu ā. Ɛyí aútéblu ɔ́ɔmā nēe gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nēé ī yɔlá dúúdú, mɛ́mla ɛya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī gē gwó ā, mɛ́mla ɛya nēé ī gwó kéē cíla ulé ā.

eng_Latn: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, klla ī cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄, é géē lā oyēeyī kú uwá ipú ɛbɔ́, klla ī jɛ̄ gicō í gbagbénú.

eng_Latn: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ áblákpá wu ikpó, amáŋ aá híī bī úwé ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ o hídáagó nɛ̄ ó lɔfú yá abɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ā wɛ ka o lɛ abɔ̄ ce ācɛ odoōcē ōhī ɛyí lɛ uwá hɛ́tá. Ó yúklɔ́ o hídáagó ɔhá dóódu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ékpó nōo wā ajɛ ā, anú piíí ga icīīcō le gla ojuja, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́ a dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
idu_Latn: Áhāsi ma Ujára nōo ma Áleméti, Asmáfɛ̄ti mɛ́mla Usímri á. Usímri ma Umósa.

eng_Latn: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
idu_Latn: Opī ā kwɛyí ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ugríísi. Ajī nɛ̄hi nōo kwu ɛplá eyī ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nū ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ aflɛ́yí kú Ugríísi ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔcí ufáyin géē tá ɔkɔ klá odúúdú ɛfu ā dúúdú, ɛna géē bá ɛyí ɛfu dóódu, éŋkpɔ̄ kē í yɔ̄ odúúdú ɔ́kpá kú Ujúda ā. Ɔkpá éyi géē pɛ́ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ussítim.

eng_Latn: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
idu_Latn: Ubúki wɛ ɔyí kú Abíssuwa, Abíssuwa wɛ ɔyí kú Ufínēhasi, Ufínēhasi wɛ ɔyí kú Ɛlísaa, Ɛlísaa wɛ ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le pɛ́ gekwú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ŋ́, lɛ alɔ mɛ́mla ajɛ kú alɔ lá kóō wɛ omafula kú ɔdōlé lɛ alɔ. Alɔ géē je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú Uféro, ó kē í je pīya óndú ajɛ kú alɔ. Lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ je lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ lé o yá ká ālɔ̄ yēeyī. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ká alɔ tū ɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ, kú ajɛ kú alɔ kóō táncā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō kéē gwéeyē abɔ̄ é le yálé ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla gwíijē kú éeyē, ɛyi agōdō kú uwā otú gbó ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé tá tū iléta nɛ̄ ó bī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ á, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Unáaman otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ um á, lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá agwú kú nū ā gā um.

eng_Latn: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Usámsin le tá Utímna, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā kú ācɛ Ufilístiya éyi má abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā ca ācɛ Íjīpiti gwutá ɔlékwū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɛgba kú ācɛ o yá ɛfu lé ámāŋ ka ikwū kú ācɛ nēé le yálé ŋ́. Ɔkɔ kú ijē ō gwó nɛ.

eng_Latn: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ kéē kwú ɛgɔ̄ ú gbō playi anú ɔkɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú tá tū ipú ísu, ikɔkɔ ɛdɔ kú italā nēe géē yá ɔ̄ ohígbū koó lɛ éyi kú aɛ́nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé bá nyā yá kéē lɛ íne bīya ā.

eng_Latn: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
idu_Latn: É le Usedekíya bī gé lɛ Unebúkádinēsa, nōo yɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uríbila eko ɔ́ɔmā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa le ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n mīyɛ ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gē hɛ́hɔ̄ anú ā ŋmá abɔ̄ aóndú nū ā uwī.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ. Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu gē gbō alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gē nyɔ̄ ā, ayíkpó kú nū wā ɛgiyí nū, gē tá ɔ̄ ɛlā kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ ofu kú nū ca klɛ́ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
idu_Latn: Aá tɛtɛ pó bā é ka, Ā híīī cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá nōó wɛ ɔnyā uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my LORD be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Óndú, lɛ ɔfú kú uwɔ mafú, ká ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu ka.

eng_Latn: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
idu_Latn: Uwá gē kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā eko dóódu á. Ɛpɔ̄ nōo le lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi ā, nɛ̄é gē bī gé lɛ Umósīsi á. Ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔhá ā, é gē ka abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ísɔ le inya kwu gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, lɛ ɔ́ kwú bɔ́tū. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umáyíka kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdā nyā ā, n géē yēkwu klla í tɛ̄gíkwū, í lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ klla í tóóhɛ́ɛwa yɔ̄ ī yɛ kú n ma ɔtūnōbí kú um fú. N géē yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú ā, klla í jikwū bɛ̄ɛka okońkofí ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
idu_Latn: Lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá ikpati okónu ōce ā.

eng_Latn: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ kú Óndú ā kē bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ipéyī nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo tá ɛgba ga ipú ajɛ íkpakplla ā. Ó jóklōbīya ŋ́. Ó klla lɛ ojīlīmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ kōō gē má ɔ̄ kú alɔ̄ jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōo lɔhi ō má iyē kú nū ɛ́ɛ́, nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ he alɔ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
idu_Latn: Ó ī kɛlā Ɔwɔicō gē táafú mla ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla Ācɛ Ugríisi ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu, yɔ̄ ī yá kéē cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
