idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ da Ayisáya ka ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔ lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛcá cá Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā ɛɛ́. Ka ɔ́ɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ī gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛcá ā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ italā yá ācɛ kú Asírīya ohígbū ɛcá nēé cá ɔ̄ ā. Ká ɔ̄ klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ hile ā.

eng_Latn: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā, ó géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu cigwó.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nā kwu ɔkpáncō, ká ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ kóō yā klá odúúdú ācɛ, kwu ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔcí kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔdɔ nɛɛ alɔ géē yɛ í lɛ inɔɔ̄da kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ gwó kwu ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó kē wɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ nɛɛ, alɔ í yɛ í lɛ ápɔ́tɔ́cí kú ɔcí usɛ́da gbā gwū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ gaá lā ɛyí ɛfu kú Uséyɛ. Ísɔ lé ka Ɛ́dɔm á.

eng_Latn: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū gē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ í lɔtūlé mla ɔ̄cɛ. Ó gē yá ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɔtūce ɔ̄cɛ. Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō leyīce odée. Ó klla gē cīibū kú ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá má ɔdā nōo yá aá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá géē gbɔɔ́ ō tú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um gwó ā.

eng_Latn: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ɛhi mɛ́mla ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā. wā ipú inu okpíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tū ā igbɔhá kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins.
idu_Latn: Kɛlā mɛnɛɛ lɛ ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá tá uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū ká á ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá ka úklɔ́ ōwē nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ húmáyī yá ā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Kɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā í yá uwa ɛhi ɛɛ́. Ka n kē lɛ ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā cílā uwā fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā ā bá ī tū um iyē ŋmá abɔ̄lɔ́ná, cɛ̄ gā um gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya. É bá ī fīyɛ̄ um odée gē tíne ō ŋmó um.

eng_Latn: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi gbāajɛ abɔ̄ dúú klla mīyɛ ije élí ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kú aflɛ́yí āá.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛpa ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lā ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, ka ɛ́ɛ yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ōcikpó kú Ukálɛ̄bu éyi nōo lé ka Ɛ́fa ā ma Uháran, Umósa, mɛ́mla Ugásesi lɛ ɔ́ á. Uháran ma ɔyí éyi dúú. Iyē kú nū lé ka Ugásesi.

eng_Latn: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi tá ō je ɔ́ ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Amáŋ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ɔlɛ́ kú Obɛ́dɛdɔm, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ugáati ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔ̄cɛ éyi wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Itíca, ɔdā olɔhi nyá nɛ̄ n géē yá ká n̄ lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa he Óndú ā ɔtū á. Ó gē kwu hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā tá ŋ́. Ó gē gbo uwá piyóó. Amáŋ ó gē nū ayááyí kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ɔpɛ́ kú Asiríya ā, ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō ciikpó ayínɔ̄nyā kú ācɛ Umówābu. É gbɔɔ́ ō je iyī uwā iyē tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu klla le ɔ̄na ɔhá nā kpɔ́. Ó klla le da ayínɛ́ nū kahíníī, N le ɔ̄na ɔhá nā, nɛ̄ n má ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ igwóléyi bá ī túkpɛɛ́ gā um.

eng_Latn: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā ka ā le he odúúdú ɛwa ā ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Usitífin, ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú klla le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā fu mɛ́mla Ufílīpu mɛ́mla Uporokórɔ̄si mɛ́mla Unikánɔ mɛ́mla Utáyímɔn mɛ́mla Upámēnāsi mɛ́mla Uníkɔ̄lɔsi kú Ántiyɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cɛ nōo je pīya tá ɔwɛ o gbā ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā kú ācɛ Ujíyu dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram mɛ́mla Unáhɔ le anyā lɛ á. Iyē kú ɔnyā kú Ébram wɛ Usárāyi. Iyē kú ɔnyā kú Unáhɔ kē wɛ Umílka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uháran, nōo wɛ ádā kú Umílka mɛ́mla Íska āa.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da éyi kú ācɛ nēe ī gbō ɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔyí nōo yēeyī ā yíla ɛpa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ kwú āyā kú nū éyi ú lɛ ɔnyā éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ kē kwú āyā kú nū ɔhá ā ú lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
idu_Latn: Iyɔ̄bū kú éyééye kú aínu kú ācɛ ogbō ɔwɛ ā, ɔdɔ otū wā ajɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, olicō kú nū wɛ āyā kú umíta. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū wɛ āyā kú umíta. Ipú kú éyééye kú aínu ā kē wɛ umíta ɛtá ɔ́kīkā ɛnɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ újí, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔtū ce uwá glá ŋ́, ohígbū kēé wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í kpɔ́tūce uwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yúufi ŋ́, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ pī aá, ká n géē hɛ aá tá. N géē je odúúdú aéwo nɛ̄ n pa aá hīla nyɔ̄ ipú uwá ā kpó yíífi dúúdú. Amáŋ N gáā je aá yíífi dúúdú ŋ́. N géē lɛ itali kwu aá ɔkwu pííi, amáŋ n gáā yá ɔ̄ɔ̄ fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ! N lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kpó ka lɛ aá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ ā tá kwɛyí ipú Upɛ́ga ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá Atálīya á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kwú ɔlɛɛcɛ nōó yá ā ú tá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ídɛn ā kóō hí ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kóō klla leyīkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ī bɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōó lé ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó uwā eko nēé lé ā, ohígbū ká ucē kú uwā í yɛ ŋmá ɔtōkpóce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nōó kē yɛ ŋmá ɔtōkpóce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā wɛ ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá kwú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ú kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú ō wiiyē ká aá ú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híī jɛga lɛ ɔkpíyē ká aá kóō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó tíne ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, únóji kú ɔlíkɔtɔ lɛ okónu kú nū nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ yɔ̄ ī gbēyī uwā. Ó kē í je aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīma, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlamu nēe ī yúuya nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó mlɛ kpɔkɔ́.

eng_Latn: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā ohígbū ka ācɛ ā le íne kú anúɔ bīya ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yá kú anúɔ le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ŋmá eko nɛ̄ anúɔ kpó aádáádā uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá Ōndú ā klla le ɛlā ka ga um.

eng_Latn: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, nááná, aá kóō híī bīyíne ŋ́. Aá nyɔ̄ í gwutá, agōdō kú aá cíí, ká á gbɛlá lipú lipú lɛyíkwu ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
idu_Latn: Lɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄ a ī má ā tá táajɛ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Aɔ́dā nēe bá ī yá abālɔbányā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēe kē í yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā.

eng_Latn: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá Uríssa ā, é gaá lā Ukeheláta.

eng_Latn: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
idu_Latn: A wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo le yēŋēē klla le kpaakpa nɛ, a kē ī já ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī gbɛlá mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tíne ā má. Lɛ ɔbíipú kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ci. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ulé cílá ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujéhu je ɛ̄gbā ō gbā kú ubáalu mɛ́mla ubáalu abɔ̄yī nū gwu bónū ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
idu_Latn: É nwú ācɛ ā ɔdā nēe le kpaakpa ā, é nwū uwā ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́. É lā ɛbɔ́ mla um. Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā gē yá ɔdā olɔhi ā, é klla gē tá ācɛ alɛwa abɔ̄ kéē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kɛlā aflɛ́yí bū okónu kú Uhosíya ā, ó da ɔ̄ kóō nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ akwuna nōó gē gbaajā lɛ. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ké í ma ayí nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā lɛ ɔ́. Óndú klla ka ka ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū gaá gbaajā tú ācɛnyīlɔ ɔhá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ gaá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, eko yɔ̄ ī wā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē ka kahíníī, Ācɛnyā nēé ma ayí jéjéē ɛ́ɛ ŋ́, ɔgɔ̄ma nōó bī ɔyí jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mɛ́mla amɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔyí í gwá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ma gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
idu_Latn: Aá le jīla ɛ̄cī ɔ́maahāapa kú ɔkɔ ō gbā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́maahāapa ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōŋmɔ́wɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfu nɛ̄hi géē mɛ tāajɛ dúúdú iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. A géē tú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó. Eko nāa í je ɛcɔ̄ ámōōmɛ ce ɛga nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō ce ā, ācɛ géē bá ī dɛgba ka ó héyifuú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le eyī kú Ubálam nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā má mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ, kwú eyī ú pīya klá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ ó fu á, Usáyímɔ̄ni ;.

eng_Latn: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ uwɔ ahɔ̄ éyi, lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ abɔ̄ ɔhá ā dúú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú lɛ awulú kú uwɔ kpó, lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ úwé kú uwɔ kpó dúú.

eng_Latn: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si ā bá tɔ̄há piyóó, kē kɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī ā, nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, isú mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ipú uwā á. Anɔ́ɔ n mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛ̄cī ómahāapa á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɛ̄cī ómahāapa ā, klla le ɔ́ yá tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
idu_Latn: Woó, Óndú, jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó, klla má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā. A pó odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Usenakérīibu, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya, yɔ̄ ī ka, ī cá awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́yī kú uwɔ le bū otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā bēhé, eko nēé wā bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi ā, kéē je alɔ fíyákátā ā. É bá ī gwéeyē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nōo ī lɛ abɔ̄ da ācogbɛhá ɛyí báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le ɔda nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ācɛ ā yɔ́tūnōbí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo hī aá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa igwú ā, lɔfú wā í tá uwɔ, í ka ga awɔ kahíníī, Lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā kóō má cīce amānyā. Uwēyī géē kwú uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ā nyɔ̄ gaá cīce ɛga nōo tū wāajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: É nū alɔ inya maálá bɛ̄ɛka ucē nōo ī wu ŋmá icō wāajɛ í je ugwū ā. É nū alɔ jāā ga ɛyí ɛfu. É lɛ alɔ kwú igbledū ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá géē tá opo ā eko nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē, mɛ́mla eko kú ucɛ kú aá, mɛ́mla ohútu kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú aá. Aá géē tá opo nyā, eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́. N géē tá aá abɔ̄. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú nū í gē yúufi ŋ́, í klla ī pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nēé ī le yá ɛgɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
idu_Latn: É le ofu kú ucérūbim mɛ́mla aálī mɛ́mla aágábá hijā tū oje plákátá, ɛgā pēē nōo táajɛ ipú nū ā. É klla le ofu kú ēpū ōjílatɔ̄há hijā tū ɔ̄ jīla tá.

eng_Latn: And when they arose early on the morrow morning, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold; only the stump of Dagon was left to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmɔ́ɔ̄cīnū kpɔ́, é klla má ka ɛcí kú uwā Udágɔn ā klla má gwōnū iyɔ̄bū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā. Igbɛ́ ɛ̄nyā ā, ɔkɔ kú Udégɔn mɛ́mla abɔ̄ ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nú kwú kpó cē ŋmá anú bá okómpinu kú inu ɛcí ā, anɔ́ɔ igbuntulu kú Udégɔn ōfōōfūnū hile tāajɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
idu_Latn: ó géē bí tāajɛ dúúdú piyóó bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá áncā ā. Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ jé ɔ̄ ā, í gaá jé ɛga nōó nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé lɛ odúúdú ɔdā dóódu kpó yálé kwɛyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā, nōo wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē bī iyīnū wā ɛháajɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo kpó odúúdú odée bá ɛháajɛ nū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē lé ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā géē gwíijē, klla í jīijē kahíníī, Ipú Usáyɔn ā, nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔhā kú alɔ ŋmá á.

eng_Latn: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ á. Eko nēé le iyāwu yɛ jāā ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā, éŋkpɔ̄ kú uwá mɛ, kwu ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ í má éŋkpɔ̄ dúúmā gwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ lɛ uwá dúú ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ, Ubɛ́sa, Ujáhāsi.

eng_Latn: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi tū iyī nū ā nū bɛ̄cɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ikpɛ́la, áafú mɛ́mla ɛcá ō cá ācɛ ɔhá kē í mɛ.

eng_Latn: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
idu_Latn: Ā híī kɛlā Ɔwɔicō Ubɛ́tɛlu amānyā gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka amānyā wɛ ɛga otīihɔ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú éwo nyā gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka awɔ gē gbō um ŋmá ɔfú kú ikwū á. Á kē gáā mā ami nōo ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú ā tá ɔlékwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le yɛ ga ɛgiyí ɔnyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ ɔhá géē mīyɛ uwɔ ojīlīmā. Ācɛ nēé gē ményinyinyi ācɛ ŋ́ mā géē ŋmó uwɔ agbaagbɔ.

eng_Latn: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
idu_Latn: Ujése le ɛhɔ̄ tū í lɛ ɔ́ bī wā. Ó joklóbīya klla wɛ ɔyípɛ̄, eyī kú nū kwu mlémlé. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, Anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā á, cāŋjɛ ká ā lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko kú ucɛ ā le yá ā, ó lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aúgbɔga ā kahíníī, Aá wā, é lɛ ɔdā dóódu tútū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá ī yá ɛnyā ā, aá géē yá kú ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce aá. Aá kē gáā gbolóce ācɛ kéē yá ɛgbá dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
idu_Latn: Aéwo éyi géē cāŋjɛ héyī kwu éwɔhá, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éyi géē héyī kwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔhá. Ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ajɛ o jíliyē klla hɛ́ wulu géē bá ɛga alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kwú eyī kú uwɔ ú hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ka á mā ɔɔ̄ tá cíí mɛ́ɛnɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē má abahi kpií gbéeko nōó le eko kú nū yá kwɛyí lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ ɔgwū nōo ī yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī kú nū mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka eko nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe jé ɔ̄ kpɛ́fú kpɛ́mm ā le pɛ́ gekwú ŋmá ipú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū kéē kwú pīya ayí ōbɔdā bɔ́lɔ́lɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú alácɛ̄ kú ádā uwā nēé lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussafán kwúcē wā gaá da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ije nōo yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, n kwú kpó ŋmá ipú ikpati ā lɛ ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu oōgláyá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē má uwā ā géē ŋmó uwá. Aólɛlā kú uwá géē ka ka, É lɛ ɔbíipú bī tá Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ ɛga olúlé ɔkwɛ̄yi kú uwā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo je eyīyōce lɛ aádáádā uwā ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ yá uwá nááná í bɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄cɛnyā yá ŋmá ikpokwú kú íkélí nōó je ŋmá ákló kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄cɛnyā ā í bī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhīlī ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔgwu aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya ā jāā ga Ujɔ́dan, anɔ́ɔ é má īlī, ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdā nēe hɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ bá ajɛ ɔwɛ ā, mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú kú uwā nēé je kpó bónū eko nēé bá yɔ̄ ī kwinya ágágā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí gaá le ohi kpó lɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ōcē kú Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ o lɛ ijē nyā tá kóō cɛ̄tra Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjipiti nēe ŋmá aígelī nēé hī ka Umémfīs mɛ́mla Utapánhes ā le uwá ɛyí kpó yíla.

eng_Latn: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ pó klla jé ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ ka lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, bōōbū igbīhāajɛ kú eko kú ōwē nɛ̄ ācɛ géē má nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, ɛnɔ géē je dobū, ɔyā í gáā fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō bī ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá glá ā le gwō ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā, ɔdā dóódu yɔ̄ kóō tīile lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ō wu iyē nēé géē gɔ́ ā yɔ̄ á, ɛkpa kú ɔtū, ɛ́fɔ̄du ōjīlīmā ō playi ɔtū, ukafután, úwé nēé lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄, ɔláwonī, mɛ́mla īlī ō gbō ɛ́nyɔ́. É géē gɔ́ īlī otīihɔ, nēe bá ā lɛ Árɔ̄ni, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kēé yúklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó gā um.

eng_Latn: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
idu_Latn: A je ɔ́da lɛ eyī ka ɔ́ɔ le nyā péee ipú ɛcɛ, ka ācobɔ̄bíipú ka ɛ́ɛ̄ le pɛ́ kwú ŋmá ɛga otayínū kú uwá jéejéé ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ifulá ka tū aígabɔ̄ ā klla le uwá ahɔ̄ pí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ eyī tá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ŋ́ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ācɛ ācogwíijē mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ā ú kwúcē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka aá mīyɛ odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ó kōō lɛ igelī kú ɔlɛ́ nū dúú nɛ̄ aá í mīyɛ ŋ́ nɛ ŋ́. Ó ka aígelī ofɛtá nēé bá ɛyí ajɛ kú Ágōbu, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan ā, aá ɔ́ɔ mīyɛ.

eng_Latn: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le da Ujékɔ̄pu ka ɔyí nū, Ujósɛ̄fu ɔ́ɔ wā gaá mā ɔ̄ ā, ó bī odúúdú ɔfú kú nū má cīce ɛyí agōdō.

eng_Latn: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛríya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɛ́brɔn á. Ipú iháyí igwɛ́ɛnɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi cɔcɛ́ ā, é lɛ ɔkwu ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɛ́brɔn ā bū, anɔ́ɔ é má ka aklōgō kú aícɔ́ɔ́ja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá ōhī ɔ́ɔ lā Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ, aá jāhɔ̄! N géē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ífi ohígbū ojuju obɔ̄bí nēé húmáyī ī yá ā. N géē yá uwā itolā ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū ka é jāhɔ̄ lɛ ukɔ́ nɛ̄ um tū uwá ā ŋ́, é klla tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá igelī nɛ̄hi ā, le pɛ́ wā kéē gaá kpɛ́fú ā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ái le má ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛ aá yɛ jīla tá ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le uwá kpó ŋmó á. Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ái dúúmā í hile oyēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da um kahíníī, Lɛ umu kú igwu, ocikāpā, eje,ágwúgwú mla eglīngli pīya tɔ̄há. Ká ā le igbō yá ŋmá uwá le iyī uwɔ. Igbō ɔ́ɔmā nāa gaá lé ɛ̄cī ofu igwáahānɛ ce igwó nāa géē gwutá ce āyā abɔ̄lúfīyē kú uwɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu hī iyē kú ɔ́kplá nū ā ka, Umanásɛ, ohígbū kóó kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le yá kú n̄ kwú mlanyī odúúdú ōwē kú um, mɛ́mla ákú ɔlɛ́ ádā um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú bēé, anɔ́ɔ n má ka, é lɛ ifotó kú aɛ́gwā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ elihɔ ɔhá, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu ɔhá nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá gē gbā ā kpó bā ɔdɔ ā ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ é géē bá ī yɛ ga ajɛ gicō ipú ajɛ ā, eko nēé lɛ ikpokwú kú ɔ̄cɛ má tá ajɛ, é géē je ɔdōcābɔ̄ kwu ajɛ pī ɔ. É ī yá ɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ onyi okwū ā ká e géē wā í kwú uwā í kpó nyi Ɔpɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ugɔ́gu.

eng_Latn: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāadaa ce ɔyípōklóbīya ā ɔkɔ gbaala. Ó klla le ɔ́ kwú bɔ́tū, lɛ okónu kwu ɔ̄ okónu, leyīkwu ɔ́ eyī, da ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́kpá ā fu aá, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú um lɛ aá jámá cɛ́ɛ́ ka n le jé ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le tútū ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfúlɔfú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpɔkplɔ nɛ̄hi nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ahɛ nōó yɔ̄ ī bū ā yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ágbōyī ā.

eng_Latn: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē lɛ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā kpó hīīgwú gé lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ɛlā ā ka kéē pó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ajɛ kéē wɛ ijáalí ce uwá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
idu_Latn: A kwu owu mla ofúlutu ú pīya ɔdā ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ. A klla le ɔwolímanya pīya ɔdā ō cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
idu_Latn: É kwú mlanyī Ɔwɔicō, ōlɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo nya uwá tá ā, anú nōo je oyēeyī lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
idu_Latn: Aá híī kpɔ́tūce ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī ka ka, Abɔ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ amānyā ā, Óndú ā lā amānyā.

eng_Latn: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta kahíníī, Ehée, Óndú. Ohígbū ka ń lé ɔdēelihɔ ámāŋ ɔda oblinyi jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
idu_Latn: É le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí Umósīsi, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ tíne ō lɛ inu kpó gwó lɛ aɛ́na, aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aálá kú alɔ. Ká ālɔ̄ klla lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ō lɛ ɔdɔ olɔfú kpó gwó lɛ anyā mɛ́mla ayí alɔ gbɔbū ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n tɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū kú um í kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ācɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā ŋ ámāŋ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nēé yá ɔ̄ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā ŋ́. N tɔ́kpá ā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le jé ka Ɔwɔicō jé ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú kú ugóolu éyi kú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo géē le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ānyɛ bá lɛ awulú nɛ̄hɛ́ wiyē yɔ̄ ā. Ini nēé kē ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ń fu aá igwɛ́ɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá í wɛ ebilíi ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ipú ɔkpá kú Uhosíya kahíníī, Ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́ mā ā, N géē hī ūwā ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Éwo nēé kē he um ɔtū ŋ́ mā ā, n géē hī ɔ̄ ka éwo o he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā ŋmá ōwē nōó ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ī bū ipú nū ā. Ó klla gē bī ákanya gē nwūla ɔ̄cɛ ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ a géē bī iyē kú aípɔ́ɔmā ā le tá ūlī kóō lɛ kɔ̄ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nāa dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ, Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti? Á wā amānyā ká ā kpó alɔ yíífi nɛɛ? N jé ɔ̄cɛ nāa wɛ ā, a wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ otīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. N géē je ajɛ kú Íjīpiti tá ipú abɔ̄ kú Unebúkádinēsa. Ó géē kpó iyó kú uwā wu, klla í je odúúdú agbénú kú Íjīpiti kpó, ka ɔ́ɔmā ká o wɛ ulé nɛ̄ ó géē cíla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
idu_Latn: Le héyī, le héyī, Udɛbɔ́ra! Le héyī, le héyī, kú ā lɛ ijē éyi gwó. Cāŋ́jɛ, Ubárāki, ɔyí kú Abínōwam! Lɛ aálagbá kú ɛfú kú uwɔ kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɛwa ā mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛnya dóódu nōo gē yá ɔhɛ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī kwu um ká ā ményinyi um. Lɔfú tū um iyē ká ā lɛ um nyatá, ohígbū ka awɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um gbā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Aá híī yá ucē mɛ́mla aúculo kú aéwɔhá ŋ́. Aá híī lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá ā ká aá bá gē yúúfi aɔ́dōyéyījii nɛ̄ aá ī má ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
idu_Latn: Ɔtú he odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka é le ɛka gbo mla Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā. Ó he uwá ɔtū kéē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu. Óndú ā mīyɛ uwá klla le ɛbɔ́ je lɛ uwá ŋmá ābɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ojuju ā he ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
idu_Latn: Anú gē tá um abɔ̄ klla gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ um á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: ācɛ ɔhá ā kē bá ɛháajɛ kú Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ nū, leyīkwu ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
idu_Latn: Igbɛ alɛwa é gē pla ācɛnyīlɔ ŋmá ɛga oligbó wā, ācɛnyīlɔ ā kē pɛ́ wā. Ayínɛ́ ɛpa nyā gē gwīiyē klla í kpo ɛwɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔtanjilé mɛ́mla ukpamkéeke tū eyī kú uwá, klla í kpó agbá otɔ̄ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā otābɔ mɛ́mla ɔdōplahɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛnwū tū iyē.

eng_Latn: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ubákibūku mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Uhakúfa, ayí ɔlɛ́ Uháhɔ.

eng_Latn: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū kahíníī, Abɔ̄ n le yálé ā, n géē je Usɛ́kɛm kɔ̄, klla í je ɔpɛ́ kú Usúkɔ̄tu ka tū ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpáni, ɔdíyá nāa klla yɔ̄ ī nū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā? Ɔdí nɛ̄ um yá uwɔ ā? Ɔdōobɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ um yá ā?.

eng_Latn: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, odúúdú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄, kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ é lɛ wīya mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ámāŋ ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ o wɛ umuumu, wɛ ákú odúúdú ayínɔ̄nīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni nēe wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. É kē í kɔ̄ jōnjīlɛ̄ mɛ́mla iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛ ujɔ̄ tū lɛ iyī uwā gbō tɔ̄há ŋmá ɛka nɛ̄ uwá gwá ka aá gáā lé ámāŋ o kōō gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá lɛ Upɔ́lu ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā tá uwá ohi kahíníī, N le ɔtū kú um ŋmótá ɛɛ́, ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá ka ɔ̄na ā klla ka ɛyí nū ā gā um glá ŋ́, é géē je aá kpó fā ŋmá ayíkābɔ̄ ga ɔtīkpó kú aá. N klla ī je ɔlɛ́ aá kpó yíífi, í je uwá tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú inu o kpíyó tū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé cíkā ō kpó ɔdā ɛya kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī, aíyó nēé lɛ yá uculo ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū ā, mɛ́mla éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú aíkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé gē hī ka ólīfu nēé le kpó lɛ aúlífāyi, ācogwíije, mɛ́mla ācogbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū ā ú lɛ Utobíya.

eng_Latn: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ aóklóbīya um ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ íne kú um tū.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
idu_Latn: Ubálam tóohi kahíníī, N lɛ íne bīya ɛɛ́, ń jé ka a háyi ɔwɛ kú ā lɛ um iyāwu ci ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka a má ka ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bí gā um, ká n̄ nyɔ̄ mla ācɛ ā ŋ́, n géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōo ī ŋmá okónu kú nū ā wɛ ɛlā ogbonɛnɛ kú íjééyī. Anú nɛ̄ ó gē bī lɛ nwū ācɛ ɛlā á.

eng_Latn: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
idu_Latn: Ami ā gē bī éŋkpɔ̄ yá aá Ubaptísim kóō cābɔ̄ ka aá le pīyabɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē wā igbīhi um, nōo fíyɛ́ um kɔ́ɔ́. Ń kōō yá ɔdā olɔhi dúú jɛ̄ nɛ̄ n kōō ī bī áblákpá kú nū ŋ́. Anú ā géē bī Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla ɔlá le yá aá Ubaptísim á.

eng_Latn: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ujísɔ̄si ka, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aítíca kú íne ā gē ka ka Ɛláyíja ɔ́ɔ géē wā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō wā ā.

eng_Latn: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aákā nyā lɔfú ga ɛga dóódu kú ābɔ̄ ɛnɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi da uwá kéē híī hágágá kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kpó lɛ aá ā ŋ́. Ó klla ka Óndú ā lɛ aá gbō ɛbɔ́, ɔ́ɔ klla cɛ̄ lɛ aá le ācɛ nēe wā í je ɔlɛ́ aá wu ā yálé.

eng_Latn: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā nēe bá ā eko nɛ̄ ó gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi pī ikpati o lɛ ije tá ɔ̄ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kwú ɔ̄ abɔ̄fú glá ŋ́ ohígbū ka eko kú nū í yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi kwú īkpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ú pīya kláajɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ iyī nū tōlī á.

eng_Latn: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe je otúta kú ɔdā ocēabɔ̄ kú nū ga icō ka o mafu la odúúdú ɛcɛ, ka anúɔ gēe tá aóhile kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu a bá ŋmá ɛga dóódu, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mla Ujúda a pahīla nyɔ̄ a kpɔ ɛɛ́; klá í kpó uwá cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋmá ɔ́kíkā kú ɛcɛ ɛnɛ a.

eng_Latn: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
idu_Latn: Ahɔ̄lá kóō le pīya klá uwá. Kéē lɛ uwá tá tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé gáā bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú gbóógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ákú ācɛ nēé fu ā, ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá, olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, nōo wɛ ɔfú mɛ́mla íjééyī kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
idu_Latn: Unówa le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ā kpó yá.

eng_Latn: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
idu_Latn: Awɔ je ísu nɛ̄hi ā ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ, klla tá ɔwɛ bū ipú nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī nyatá ā kéē le bēhé á.

eng_Latn: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō ligbó ŋmá ɛcɛ lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ ɔwɛ kú um ligbó hɛ̄ ɔwɛ kú aá tá lɛ ā á. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ā ligbó ŋmá ákú aá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
idu_Latn: É lɛ iyē tátū awulú mɛ́mla át á kwū abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū. Iyē ā lé kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ kú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla Óndú kú aóndú.

eng_Latn: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti nōo tɛtɛ yá ká ācɛ kéē cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu igɛ́mɛ́nti klla kē kpó ācoŋmácɛ úlā igwó ga ipú ígbíli ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
idu_Latn: A géē yá uculo kú abɔ̄ ō lɛ ce Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɛyí ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n mafú gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
idu_Latn: É le eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla inu ɛga otīhɔ nɛ̄hi ā plā mla ugóolu . É klla lɛ agbá kú oje ɔdɔ playi ɔwɛ kú inu eyīpú, nēé plla mla ugóolu ā.

eng_Latn: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Odúúmā kú alɔ í lɛ īlī dúúmā klá eyī gɛ ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ má ɛgahi kú Óndú ā klla ī ma ɔ́ fú á. Anɔ́ɔ ɛgahi ɔ́ɔmā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Alelékwū ā, yɔ̄ gē pīya alɔ abɔ̄ piyóó ā. Alɔ yɔ̄ ī pīya bɛ̄ɛka anú ā fíyɛ́ ŋmá ɛgahi onwuné éyi ga ɛ̄nɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ka ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ géē yá uwā. Ɛfú géē lé uwā. Ewo géē yɔ̄ ī pi okwū kú uwā ajɛ. Aígbáanɔ í bá ī lé ɛbɛ́ okwū kú uwā. Aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí í je ohile kú okwū kú uwā a kpó lé.

eng_Latn: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yálé ā wɛ Uhadadésa, ɔcɛ́ kú Usóba nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Usiríya, lɛyíkwu Uhámáti ā. Uhadadésa yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ kóō gaá mīyɛ ajɛ nōo kwu ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi ɛhícō ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya ga ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ō nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Amáŋ é kwú uwā glá gɛ ŋ́. É kwu gaá tū aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā abɔ̄, ɛga ɛplɛ́ɛpa. Anɔ́ɔ Ísrɛ̄lu le uwá kpó yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ujówāsi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé eko nōo wɛ iháyí ahāapa ā. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda iháyí ofɛpa. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Usíbīya nōo ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ā.

eng_Latn: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n je íne lɛ uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ ga um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, kéē kē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. N da uwá kéē yá ucē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n da uwá kéē yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔdā dóódu kóō lɔhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́bíipú kú aá lɛ aá hɛ́ ŋmá egiyí Ɔwɔicō kú aá, íne nɛ̄ aá ī bīya ā, í klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú eyī kú nū ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ī pō ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī gbā ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Urécɛ̄lu, ɔnyā kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā wɛ: Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában da ɔ́ kahíníī, Īī, ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ami mɛ́mla awɔ wɛ oyī ékpónú nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mla anú ɔyā éyi á.

eng_Latn: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gwɔ̄ɔ́ci ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛmiyɛ í ŋmó olɛlā kú uwɔ, je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ijēēnyi ī ŋmó ɔ̄, je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́. Ohígbū ka o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá ī yá, í cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī í kwú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
idu_Latn: Iháyí nɛ̄ Usíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwú ā, obócádēde kwú um anɔ́ɔ n le Óndú ā má cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū icō kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á. Anɔ́ɔ aflɛ́tɛ́ kú awulú kú nū mīyɛ ɛga dóódu kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um tēelihɔ mla ɔdā īcīci mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí kú aá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yēeyī lɛ ā, n géē ŋmó aá bónū. N kē gáā ményinyi aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Abíssāyi, ɔyí kú Userúya ā, wā í le abɔ̄ tá Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le agwu ā ŋmó á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ka áa gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ga ɔgbɛ́fú mɛ́mla aá gɛ ŋ́. É da ɔ́ ka anú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́tūce bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mɛ́ɛbɛ ā á. É ka aá í tíne ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔlá ɔ́ɔmā gemí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄i klla yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ uwá kpɔ́, É géē tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔkōolɔhi ā lɛ odúúdu éwo dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ oŋmɛyí kú ɛcɛ gā.

eng_Latn: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā aá, nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú otɛtɛ ā cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um lɛ uwá kéē kwúcē ŋmá ipú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé bá yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Amáŋ, é pó ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
idu_Latn: Ó gbo ɔkpá cokónu lɛ ádáádā alɔ, Ébrahām.

eng_Latn: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si leyī kwu uwá cíí, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā í tōō yá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó tōō yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ō yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ígwu kú anúɔ ā lɛ opo kú uwā tá, kéē gbɔɔ́ ō tá ákú uwā, biílí ipú odúúdú ɛgiyí aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛ́fú kú aólɛlā ā. Ó klla kéē dɛ̄gba ka, Akú Óndú ā mɛ́mla Ugídīyɔn.

eng_Latn: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo kwu alɔ ɔtū ā í wɛ ka alɔ lɛ aá kwú tabɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā o mīyɛ cɛ̄ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá háyi lɔɔlɔhi ipú ɛlā nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ cɛ̄ ā lɔɔlɔhi. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā alɔ tíne ō yúklɔ́ mla aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō he aá nwuné fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi yá ipú ɔtū kú ācɛ Ujúda abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɔtū kú uwā yéékpó kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū je ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híīī plá aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ményinyi alɔ ká ā lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce alɔ. Má alɔ mla eyī ogbonɛnɛ ká ā cɛ̄ɛhɛ mɛɛ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā nōo le pīya aflɛ́yí ipú ajɛ ā, nēé géē bī wā gé lɛ Óndú ā, géē wɛ ákú uwɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le yēŋēē inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā lɔfú lé glá.

eng_Latn: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujɔ́pa ā, obócádēde kwú um ú, anɔ́ɔ n má odée yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka idɔngwu nɛ̄hi nēé bī ɔ̄ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá māhayi ɛgiyí um á.

eng_Latn: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā le miya ka aá lɛ aálagbá a kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúú kú uwā kóō híī tágwā kwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ipí ā le mi, le tá ɔ́wá klla wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, ayíka ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka agwú kú ɔkpíyē ā yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛyí fakpá ā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ami ā, ayínɛ́ um, ń nwū aá ɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɔfú nwū ācɛ nēe lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā ɛlā ā glá ŋ́. N gē kɛlā lɛ aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā, bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe wɛ ayípɛ̄ nɛŋ́cɛ́ ɛgiyí ɛyí kú ɔtū ōce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ō jé ā.

eng_Latn: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; even a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the LORD thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.
idu_Latn: Ka amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ tū iyī nū ɔtū le oji cē, ka ɛ́ɛ má ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ oji ā yá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú agbénú nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā alɔ ā, wɛ ákú alɔ mɛ́mla ayípɛ́ ɔlɛ́ alɔ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Yá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da uwɔ ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū pi kwaajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfu, ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kwu ā. Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ nyā géē kwú ōfōōfūnū, nōó gáā má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ eyī klá ámāŋ tá ɔ̄ okónu bī eko nōó géē kwú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ uwá kpó kwú oyēeyī, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kōō wā í kpɛ́fú, amáŋ wā í yá ɛbɔ́ náaná.

eng_Latn: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō tá uwā abɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nēé ga ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ɛ̄cī éyi kú ipú ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ kú iháyí ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á. Ó kahíníī, N géē cē íkpɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ɔcí kú Usedar éyi ŋmá ágēnēgēnē kú nū. N géē tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛpa ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ iháyí éyi Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ dóódu kú Ujerúsālɛm le ɔdā nōo yá Ujúdasi ā pó, anɔ́ɔ é hī ajɛ ā ka, Akelidáma okónu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Ajɛ kú Oyī.

eng_Latn: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahatá ā, ó géē bī ɔyí álá ɛpa, nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ mɛ́mla ɔyí álá nɔ̄nyā kú iháyí éyi nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, okoolo nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ lígíí.

eng_Latn: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ iyɔ̄bu aá eko nɛ̄ aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔn ɛpa nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ussíhɔn mɛ́mla Ógu nɛ̄ aá je kpó ŋmó dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tɔ́kpá nyā fu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō mla ayínɛ́ alɔ, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe háyi kpaakpa, nēe bá Ukólōsi ā. Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ kóō ményinyi aá, kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Usamérīya alɛwa nēe ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ a lɔtūce ɔ́ ohígbū ɛlā kú ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā nōo cīijáalí kahíníī, Ó da um ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā.

eng_Latn: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ ō gbā kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, gē wú ɔ̄ ɔtū ō pó ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi da Urútu ka anúɔ lɛ ɛlā éyi nwū uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī ga ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá í yā īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ gwō ɛga nɔ́ɔ wā nyā gɛ nóó. Ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ klá abɔ́ɔ mla ācɛnyā kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
idu_Latn: N le ācɛ nēe bá nyā fu kéē leyīkwu ínu o kpíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū ā: Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o jé íne nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla Upedáya, ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi. Uhánan, ɔyí kú Umɛtánīya klla géē tá uwá abɔ̄. N lɔtūce ācɛ nēe bá nyā ka é géē kɔ̄ Ukpɛ̄ kú ɛhi ā mla ācoyúklɔ́ ɔ́mpa uwá ohile ā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe géē lā gboce ipɔ́ɔma nyā ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɛ́būlɔn. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā wɛ Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́lɔn.

eng_Latn: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a gē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō í tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ipú alelékwū yɔ̄ gē ka ucē ɔhá ōfōōfūnū, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlamu nēe bá ipú ojīla ā í jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ā. Ɔwɛ nyá nēé í cɛ̄ Aamí lɛ ɔkɔ kú ahínyá nɛ̄ a gbā ā?.

eng_Latn: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū trɛ̄yí á. Otabɔ̄ dúúmā í ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́wɔ ɔhá wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
idu_Latn: É le da Ujówābu ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī jikwū klla yēkwu kú Ábsālɔm.

eng_Latn: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ lā abɔ́ɔ aflɛ́yí ā le kwu gaá lā Ugítāyim. É kē lā aúgbɔga abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
idu_Latn: Da uwá kéē géē lé ɛbɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔja klla í gwá oyī kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ā, nɛ̄ n géē kpó ŋmó lɛbɛ̄ɛka aómlede, ayí álá, aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna ojɔ̄kwū ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujɛhóyāda í tíne kéē je ɔ́ ŋmó ɛgiyí Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja hɛ́ ɔgba ɛpa bá gē gbāajɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē wā ka anúɔ gaá nya ɔ́ tá ā, aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā le Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu ŋmó, ipú ígbíli eko nēé gwó ɔlá nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ ŋ́ mā lɛ Óndú ā, ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā. Abɔ̄ é lɛ ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́ mā, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Utáma yúklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú dóódu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdōlé ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
idu_Latn: O ŋmá o tábɔ̄ kú ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa nēe bá nyā ā, Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni.

eng_Latn: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ nɛ̄ n wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ī wā ɛgiyí um ā, ka ká ɛ́nɛ́ kú Óndú um táaha wā í má um ā?.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je ɔdā nōo ī hɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gwónū tá iyɔ̄bū ācɛ nēe bá nyā kéē lɛ ikpó gbo ɔ́ kéē gwōnū. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā, kwú aádā mɛ́mla ayí, kwu ayípōklóbīya, ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aóladógbe géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
idu_Latn: Ami yá ɔlá ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla obū á. Ami gē ce abahi klá ɔ̄cɛ á, ami klla kē ī bī ífi gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á.

eng_Latn: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóram lé ɔcɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛpa ā, ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ahātá.

eng_Latn: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīkwu iyī aá mɛ́mla odúúdú aálá, nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ yá aá ká aá wɛ ācɛ oleyī kwu uwá ā, kú aá bī icɔ́ɔci kú Óndú ā, nōó bī oyī kú ɔyí nū lá ā.

eng_Latn: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
idu_Latn: Ó je alɔ bɛ̄ɛka aílɔ́wā āa. Ó kwú alɔ ī kpó lá, abālɔbányā ó kē kwú ije nēé kpó tū alɔ ā í kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ŋmó ɛna ā abɔ́ɔ, iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni, nēe wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, géē mīyɛ oyí kú ɛbɛ́ ā géē je lɛ Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú c­e klá odúúdú ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
idu_Latn: É lɛ iyī uwā túbá nyɔ̄ ī tayínū, bá ī gbō ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ um ī yá ā gɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú um ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ ɛpa Ujósɛ̄fu nēé hī ka Ubasábasi nɛ̄ iyē ádā nū wɛ Ujɔ́sitɔ̄si, mɛ́mla Umatáyāsi, kpó kwɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ bī um háyicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce aíne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
idu_Latn: Uháman, ɔyí kú Uhammedáta, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ágāgi, olɛlā kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, le ɛbā anwa gwó cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē jé ɛ̄cī nēé géē je ācɛ Ujíyu kpó yíífi. Ó lɛ ujɔ̄ tū nēe géē je ācɛ Ujíyu kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
idu_Latn: É klla le da alɔ ka, ɔ́dáŋ ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ tíne ká ālɔ̄ lā ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan ā piyóó, nɛ̄ alɔ í je ajɛ ā kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú ayí alɔ piyóó, ayíka alɔ kóō híī lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipú aéwo ɔhá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ɔ́ɔ gē je ayí alɔ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú éŋkpɔ̄ bu tá ipú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī lɛ kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē je uwēyī lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī je īyī uwā gicō ā. Ó klla í tá uwā wāajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī gbla ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gē ka ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ami ɔ́ɔ ī yá ā ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa ŋ́. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ŋmá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Umanásɛ gbā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya klla kwú Umanásɛ ú kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá ce ɔcɛ́ kú nū abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́ á. Ɔdā nōo yá nyā, yá kú Umanásɛ kóō cɛ̄ kóō klla le jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
idu_Latn: O yá ká ā cābɔ̄ íbɔm ō cē tū ɔ̄ɔ ā, lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí, lɛ ajɛ ma gicō yɛ igá kú nū tá biílí, lɛ aádɛ́fú kpó gwó yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí, ká ā klla lɛ aɔ́dā o le ca ɔdɔ yá kwu odūngwɔ̄wɛ mɛ́mla ɔdɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
idu_Latn: Ɛfu kóō kpó aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú kú nū. Ɛfú kóō kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú aéwɔhá nēé plla wā í tá uwá abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ā. É géē je kwáahi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyā ā. Ɛfú kóō kpó agbénú kú uwá, kéē kwú uwá ú uwi.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gaajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē je lɛ aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ aá ā. Aá géē yɔ̄ ī lé ucɛ kú onyatá nyā piyóó kóō wɛ oblatū.

eng_Latn: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ɛtá ɔ́ɔmā lā abɔ́ɔ nááná, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā, uwá í gáā lɔfú dúúmā nyā ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ amáŋ ayí nɔ̄nya kú abɔ̄yī uwā tá glá ŋ́. Oyēeyī kú uwá ofōōfūnū nɛ́ɛ gaá nyatá glá á, amáŋ odúúdú ajɛ ā géē je pīya alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkwu ɛpa kú ugóolu yá, mɛ́mla eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó playi ɔ́kíka ɛpa kú ɛhícō kú ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā.

eng_Latn: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí aá aflɛ́yí kóō hɔ́hā ce aá ŋmá lɛ o yá kú éyééye ká aá kóō leyī pīya ŋmá íne nōó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Uramɛ́sisi gaá lā Usúkɔ̄tu.

eng_Latn: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
idu_Latn: N da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ujɛhóyācin nyā kwú yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔjá nōo kwú ca, nēé kwú tá tónū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tíne nū ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nēé kpó anú mɛ́mla ayí nū gaajɛ ewɔhá, nɛ̄ uwá í jé jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛlā ka gā um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyí uwɔ nyā nōo kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ije kú uwɔ í ŋmó tū aákwuna ā, eko nōó kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ā, ā lɛ ɛna ojɔ̄kwū ŋmó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla Áyi wɛ ofu igwóléyi ce ɛtá .

eng_Latn: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ayínɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa, ɔkpani, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan. Ɔyínɛ́ alɔ éyi gekwú ɛɛ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ō wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
idu_Latn: Énɔ̄ku nōo wɛ ayááyí ɔ́maahāapa ŋmá Ádām ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo mɛ́ɛbɛ lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe bá nyā á. Ó kahíníī, Óndú ā géē wā mla úlúúlā kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ō tīihɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mɛnɛ: Ásāhɛlu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu wɛ otrɛ̄yí á. Ɔyí nū Usebadíya kwɛyí nū ipú ígwu nyā igbīhāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū kú Uféro yá lɔfú kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ ŋ́ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m ā, eko nɛ̄ Umerí í ma ɔyí ā le yá.

eng_Latn: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ayí kú Ujówɛ̄lu ŋmá ayááyí éyi ga ayááyí ɔhá á: Ussémāya, Ugɔ́gu, Ussímēyi.

eng_Latn: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé gē je oyēeyī mɛ́mla ɔbɔ́lā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛyí nū jé.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú kú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo wɛ oōmu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔfú tū Ujóssuwa iyē ka ɔ́ɔ yúufi uwā ŋ́, ka anúɔ tɛtɛ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ uwā yálé ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ɔ́ gáā háyi iyɔ̄bū Ujóssuwa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó hímáyī lɛ iháyí ofu dúúdú nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla uwɔ ā á. N yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ iháyí igwɛ́ɛnɛ ká n lɛ ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ɛpa ā kpó lɛ. N klla kē yúklɔ́ iháyí ɛhīlī ohígbū aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ. Nááná a pīya ulé kú um abɔ̄ igbigwó.

eng_Latn: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ le da kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka alɔ da ŋ́? Amáŋ abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ula kú uwā ā jé ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā kú aá já um má ā mɛ́ɛ? Aá lɛ īkpīije éyi bī gé um kú um má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
idu_Latn: Olɛɛhá nōo bī ɔkwɛ̄yí mɛ́mla okpaakpa kú nū ā, lɔhi fíyɛ́ olɔdu nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔyí ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɔyínɛ́ dúúmā ŋ́ mā, náaná ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú úklɔ́ ɔdā ō tíne í kē jɛ̄ ɔ̄ ŋ́. Eyī kú nū kwu agbénú ō tíne eko dóódu. Ó kē ī da īyīnū ɔ̄kā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē yúklɔ́ nyá bá lɛ ɔ́ ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ í jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú īyī anúɔ glá ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā dúú ā wɛ áncā mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kū ōwē.

eng_Latn: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í má Ɔwɔicō jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ofōōfūnū nōo kwu ádā ā ajaajɛ ā, ma ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā ā wɛ ā fú á.

eng_Latn: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
idu_Latn: Ufínɛ̄hasi, ɔyí kú Ɛlísa ā, gē leyīkwu odúúdú uwā ɛpléeko éyi á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē nú iklííkpó ɛpa ámāŋ ka ahɔ̄ kú álá ŋmá ɛgiyí ágábá nōo kwú ɔ̄ lé ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē nya ācɛ Usamérīya tá mla āyā éyééye kú agōdō ámāŋ ka úgādā ácakpō kú uwā nēe kpó cē ā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē bī uwā yúklɔ́ mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um.

eng_Latn: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
idu_Latn: Aá le ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ mɛ́mla oyólɔhi ā híhó, amáŋ aá dɔɔ̄kā kéē habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā tá lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ɔ́ɔ ka ɛ́ɛ híī gbɛlá ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wā í kpɛ́fú tú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā icííci ŋ́. Amáŋ ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ ka anúɔ gaá kpɛ́fú tú uwā, ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā í yíífi á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híīī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ iyī aá gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō kɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ ɔ́mpā nū ohígbū ka odúúdú alɔ wɛ āyā kú ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā ɛga dóódu á. Óndú ā kē yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ mla uwá klla cɛ̄ uwā ijáalí ku ɛlā ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ŋmá lɛ ɔdā ō hídáagó nēe yá ā. Aamí.

eng_Latn: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē dɔ̄ɔ̄ka ā, koó géē lɔhi lɛ uwá piyóó. É géē lé īkpō kú ɔdōlɔhi nēé ī yá ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ n géē da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kócōō lɛ ɔjá kú uwɔ túkpɛɛ́ gā um kú um lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ gwá káá, nōó géē ka kahíníī, Gwá. N kōō í bī éŋkpɔ̄ gé lɛ aínyankwūlūmī kú uwɔ dúú ā, ɔyínɔ̄nyā ɔ́ɔmā kóō kwú pīya ɔnyā nɛ̄ a fu lɛ Áyísīki, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā le yá lɛ ā, n géē jé ka a le okónu nɛ̄ a ce lɛ ɔkpani um ā yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ igbeékpónú ká ā má ɔ̄. Á klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ igbō ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka á gáā mlānyi unu nōó ī nu tú uwɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēe bá nyā, wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu kpó aólɛlā kú uwā ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ á. Ɔyā nyā géē yɛ í wɛ ɔyā kú ɔtūnōbí, ikwū ō je, mɛ́mla ekwu ō yɔ̄, amáŋ ó kwú pīya ɔyā kú éeyē mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ucɛ ō lé. É da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛ̄cī nēe bá ā tū géē yɔ̄ ō gwéeyē klla bá ī yá ucɛ. Ká ē bá ī kɔ̄ ɔdōlé gé lɛ aɔ́mpa uwā mɛ́mla ācogbɛhá.

eng_Latn: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
idu_Latn: Ɛlikána, Ɛbíyāsafu, Ássɛ.

eng_Latn: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ā ohígbū ka um yɔ̄ ī hī odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe lā ɛhícō ā igwú. Odúúdú uwā géē pɛ́ wā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aéwo ā kē í je akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū kwaajɛ Okómpinu kú igá kú Ujerúsālɛm. É kē í gaá cīíbɔm tū ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā biílí klla í kpɛ́fú tú odúúdú aígelī ɔhá kú ajɛ Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ācɛ Ujíyu abɔ̄ ā, eyī yá um ká Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kóō lɛ okónu tá gā um cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ híī wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ gɛcɛ ŋmá ipū úgbéenyi ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, awɔ mɛ́mla ɔnyā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ mɛ́mla anyā ūwā.

eng_Latn: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ gē nwū ɔdée péee ŋmá ɔdā nēé miya bá nyā ka é nwūla ɔwɛ o yɛ ga Ɛga otīhɔ dúú ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú iyɛ̄cɛ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá pó ikwū nēé bá ī je ipú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn. É bá ī jikwū kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
idu_Latn: N jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé ā dúú. Ń nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ aá ɔwɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú ɛcɛ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé bī ajɛ le yá ɔ̄ ā. Ācɛ nēe kē wɛ ákú ɔkpáncō ā kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ cāŋjɛ ɔ̄nɔ̄nɛ̄ fulufulu, le tá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Usiríya, eko nēé gā okónōgwu kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā, é pó ofu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
idu_Latn: Ɛlam wɛ, úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, N gēe tū ɛfú la ācɛ Íjīpiti mla īyī wā. Ɔyínɛ́ gēe bū ɛyí kwu ɔyinɛ́ nū. Aóladógbe gēe bū ɛyí kwu īyī wā. Ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Íjīpiti éyi gē kpó ɛfú tá ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ɔhá. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwá gē ba ī yá ikpóɛlá ohígbū ɔcɛ́ oolé.

eng_Latn: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi iyɔ̄bū kú Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Káā lɛ ka lɛ uwá abɔ́ɔ ka anú ɔ́ɔ kwɛyí anúɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ bá ī cālɛ́ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, é lɛ ɛga okpátá éyi má, ajɛ kú Ussína. Anɔ́ɔ é má lā abɔ́ɔ á.
