idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá Ugudugɔ́da, klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá Ujɔtubáta, ajɛ nōo lɛ áyɔ́kpá alɛwa ā.

eng_Latn: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
idu_Latn: N da ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācoyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, Aá híī yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī gɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ um géē yá Ujerúsālɛm nyā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tūwɛ̄lu tóohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nyā wā ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā nɛ, alɔ í lɔfú ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí gā uwɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ékpónú yɔ̄ á, anú ā kē wɛ Ádā kú odúúdú ācɛ ā. Ó klla wɛ Óndú nōo yɔ̄ ī gbō odúúdú ācɛ, ó gē bī odúúdú ācɛ le yúklɔ́, ó kē lā ipú ódúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
idu_Latn: É le ubatísim yá odúúdú aá, anɔ́ɔ aá yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, abālɔbányā aá le pīya bɛ̄ɛka Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yīnū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā Udíbɔn ā, aá wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛga ōjīlīma kú aá cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá gáā cīce ajɛ ipú ewo. Ācɛ nēe gáā je Umówābu yíífi ā ga gaá kpɛ́fú tú aá ɛɛ́. É kē í kpó aínɔ̄ɔda o lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ n le he uwɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, n gē yɛ púúlú wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ glá. N klla kē wā í gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ glá.

eng_Latn: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
idu_Latn: Unaómi le ɔyí ā fō, ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛ́nɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ bī jɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
idu_Latn: kwú igbō ɛdɔ éyééye ú ŋmá ipú ómbilí kú igbō nēé je gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā. Igbo nēé yá tɔ̄há mla anɔ̄ kú ólífu ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ anɔ̄ í yɔ̄ anú ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla égblú pétéké-pétéké ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa ā, anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya kwú ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú.

eng_Latn: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
idu_Latn: Óndú kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ɔdí nɛ̄ n yá aá? N húmáyī wɛ iyó ogbɛnú ce aá nɛɛ? Aá tá um ohi.

eng_Latn: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ lɔfú lé īkpō kú ɔcí dóódu kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā glá.

eng_Latn: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ inu agbá ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ inu agbá mla uwá ā. Aá kē gbɛlá kwu ācɛ nēé gē yá ōwē ā bɛ̄ɛka aá nēé yɔ̄ ī yá ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not kill.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó hī um igwú, n géē tá ɔ̄ ohi, eko nōó yɔ̄ ipú unwalu, n géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá, klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nōó wɛ á nɛɛ? Usádrāki, Uméssaki mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo, aá gē túkpɛɛ́ ká aá gbā ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ n ma kwaajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ ɔkwɛ̄yi i?.

eng_Latn: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
idu_Latn: A le ohi tá alɔ oŋmá lɛ ō cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yá aólɛlā kú alɔ lé. A klla yá ɔdā idáagó alɛwa nɛ̄hi nōo nya alɔ tá. Alɛɛcɛ nēe lā kwu aísu nɛ̄hi nēe yɔ̄ ɛga oligbó ā lɔtū kpóce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda ā pīyeyī biílí ā, anɔ́ɔ é má ka aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le ɔgba hɛ́ jīla tū aá oklo ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō wā í tá uwā abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le opo tá.

eng_Latn: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ́bíipū nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā, gē túblá um ajaajɛ, é ī lɛ ɛlá wu íne kú uwɔ fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī tá ā le lɔfú iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ɔfú kú Usɔ́lu klla gɔbū fíyɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɛ nōó gē mafú ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá cēyī gēdēē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo yá kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá Udamásikɔ̄si ā kéē má ɛlā dúú ka mla anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú um ā, ɛfu nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, nɛ̄ odúúdú aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā á. Ɔtū ī he um mla aá, n klla í lɛ eyī ce aá ō bī ɛya mla ɛ̄gbā olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú mɛ́mla ɛhi otīihɔ ā gē um.

eng_Latn: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ kahíníī, Ká n mabɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́um ōhī nēe bá nyā tá, kéē bá pī uwɔ. Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu tóohi kahíníī, Ó cɛgbá gɛ ŋ́. N tíne kú ɔtū kú uwɔ kóō gāajɛ ōfōōfūnū nɛ, ɔkpani um.

eng_Latn: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
idu_Latn: Usesekíya tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Kócōō lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ, ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, Unebúkádinēsa le aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó wā gáā gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú alɔ ɛɛ́. Ekōhī Óndú ā géē ya éyi kú úklɔ́ idáagó kú nū ā lɛ alɔ, nōo géē yá kú Unebúkádinēsa kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ alɔ tá abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kóocōō, kwú odo ojɔ́dā mɛ́mla íjééyī i ga um nɛ̄ n géē bī le gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Odo nɛ̄ n géē bī le jé ɔdā olɔhi ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí tá. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nōó lɛ ā ŋ́, abɔ̄ n gáā gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā glá ā.

eng_Latn: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, A klla géē má uwá bá ī yá aúcē ɛbí ɔhá nēe fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi a, é le inu gwó abɔ́ɔ, kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú háyi anú.

eng_Latn: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
idu_Latn: Icɔ́ɔ́ja kú Usiríya éyi í jé ŋ́ le ɔyí tá fúuu icííci gaá le Áhābu ɔtū ɛga nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwā í lɛ iyē kwu iyí uwā ā kwú. Anɔ́ɔ o da ɔ̄cɛ nōó gē pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū ā kahíníī, É lɛ um yá ágbe ɛɛ́, le pīyeyī ká ā kwu um ú ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
idu_Latn: É kpó ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ā lɛ ācɛ ohile kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerári ŋmá ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn, Urímóno mɛ́mla Utábɔ.

eng_Latn: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um yēeyī eko nɛ̄ íne dúú í yɔ̄ nēe ī da um ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ híī yá ɔdā ōhī ŋ́ mā, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n gaá le íne ā jé ā, ínoōbīya le kwu um ɔtū nwuné.

eng_Latn: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n má abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ le nāndaa wā ɛgiyí um bī ɔkpá éyi nēé le hā tū.

eng_Latn: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cokpaakpa lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī, okpaakpa kú nū dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá tɛtɛ ā í gáā nyā ɔ́ tá glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú mā ɔ́bíipú kú nū tá, é gáā yá ɔ̄ italā ŋ́. Okpaakpa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cokpaakpa ā tɛtɛ yá ā í gáā nyā oyēeyī kú nū tá eko nɛ̄ ó gbɔɔ́ ō bɔ̄bíipú ŋ́. Ó géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá gē yá um ōwē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē yá um ā? Aá yá um ɔdā olɔnɔ jɛ̄ ɛ́ ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
idu_Latn: Aéfūma ā gē nuunu bɛ̄ɛka ācokpɛ́fú ā. É gē tīīcō ɔdɔ bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja ā. É bá ī yɔ̄ ī nɔwɔ gɔbū kpaakpa, é fōbeé ŋmá ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú le ɛlā ka lɛ Ujóna igbo ɔhá ka.

eng_Latn: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
idu_Latn: Éwo dóódu nɛ̄ ó lɛ ācɛ o nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ŋ́ gē je yíífi, amáŋ ɔlɛ́ dúúmā nōo lɛ ācɛ o nwū ɔ̄cɛ ɛlā alɛwa ā, ɔdá dúú í gáā yá ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá Ubábīlɔn, aá géē bá ī gwéeyē. É kē ī kpó aá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛbɔ́. Ɔkɔ kú ɔga nɛ̄ aá géē yɔ̄ ī tá ā géē cɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá iyɔ̄bū aá ā. Aɔ́cí kē ī bá ī mīyɛ ɔkɔ kú abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá gē yɔ̄ ī gwō ā.

eng_Latn: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu gɔkɔ gicō anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ mɛ́mla aádā um, aá jāhɔ̄ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gáā kɔɔkɔ kú um iyɔ̄bū aá abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
idu_Latn: É lɔfú tá okónu gā um glá, amáŋ a gē hɔ́hā ce um, Óndú. Óndú, lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō le he ami, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú omlede ɔhá ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, nōo wɛ omlede kú abɔ̄ ō le ce ācogwɛ́ɛya ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni ā mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū le abɔ̄ kpó ce omlede ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ulɛ́ya le má ka anúɔ í ma ɔyí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ó kwú ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú nū nū, Usílpa ú lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ɔbá nū kóō lɛ pīya ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
idu_Latn: É gē tū ɔka tū ɛga nɛ̄ aísu hútu ŋmá ā, klla ī bī ɔdā nōo tayínū ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ péee kéē má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā cāŋjɛ mɛ́mla aíkonó kú nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa ka ā, gaá lā ajɛ kú Ufilístīya iháyí ahāapa á.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi koó wɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ ajɛ kú Umówābu, ámāŋ ka ó wɛ ajɛ kú Ámɔn ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ amáŋ okóhō ā gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ā lɛ ɛfú cē, aádā ā lɛ ɔlá gwó, ācɛnyā lɛ umu nwū klla lɛ ɔ́ ma, kéē yá igbō lɛ ɛcí nɔ̄nyā nēé hī ka, Ɔcányā kú ɔkpáncō ā. É bá ī lɛ enyi mɛ́mla ejé fu ajɛ lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bīya um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
idu_Latn: Ó dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdínyá nɛ? É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā nēé yá Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄hi, aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi nōó yá mɛ́mla ɛlā nōó ka ā mafú ka Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū dúú.

eng_Latn: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ dóódu géē bá ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, ācɛ kē ī lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í gáā tū uwā ufi ŋ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo da Usáyīrɔsi kahíníī, anú géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo géē gbō ajɛ ga um á. Ka ɔ́ɔ kē í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ka ɔ́ɔ yá ā á. Ami kē da ɔ́ kóō kē je ɔ́da kéē lɛ Ujerúsālɛm túgwó igbɔhá á, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ikpó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú táajɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
idu_Latn: Upíta pīyeyī biílí anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyíkpó nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yíihɔtū nū ā nōo cīce bayi ce ɔ́ ɔtū eko ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ó klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ̄nyɛ géē je uwɔ lá ā? A má yɔ̄ gē yɛce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í jikwū klla í yēkwu kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi. Ó ka anú ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujérobōwam nēé géē nyi únóji á. Ó ka ohígbū ka anú ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā olɔhi éyi nōo he Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔtū ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam á.

eng_Latn: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
idu_Latn: É bá agbá gbojī ajɛ nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ɔ̄cogbāajɛ ā kwú uwā ú kpó tū Ujósɛ̄fu abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū fu kú n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɛɔ́nyɛtá ā, mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ alɔ, Usostɛ́nes tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
idu_Latn: Unikɔdímɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā ɛgiyí nū otú ā gā dúú. Ó bī ocēkplá kú ɔdā nēé hī umáar mɛ́mla álo nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka okolo ofɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú opīyatɔhā mla anú ā yá nɛ̄ alɔ yēeyī, klla gē yɛ, nɛ̄ alɔ klla lɛ oyēeyī á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ otɔ́kpá ōhī kú aá ka ā, Alɔ wɛ ayí nū dúú nɛ.

eng_Latn: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
idu_Latn: É géē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe dɔɔ̄kā o lā oyēeyī olɔhi kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā ōwē piíí.

eng_Latn: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī ɔ̄cɛ opīyatū gwó ɔlɛ́ nū, nōo klla ī bī ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó le kpaakpa ŋ́ gwó inīcō ce ɔ́ ā le jī ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōo ī yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē yúklɔ́ áncā, nōó cíla uwá ulé kú úklɔ́ nēé yá ā ŋ́ má le jī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā obɔ̄bí í gē yá ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔkpaakpa ŋ́, amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í lɛ ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā gwū unwalu tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka ā da uwá, amáŋ é jāhɔ̄ ŋ́. É klla le ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ipú ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ kú uwā, ɛ́ɛ le yɛ tá ipú ajɛ kú ɛfu ā á.

eng_Latn: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ um, kú aá lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɛ olɛhɔ̄ ō tá ācɛ ɔtū kwu ɔtū nɛ̄ n tá tū ipú ɔkpá kpií nɛ̄ n tá nyā a.

eng_Latn: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usɔ́lu kē lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ɔhá, iyē kú nū kē lé ka Umáyíka. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú he Umáyíka ɔtū nɛ̄hi á. Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ɔtū he ɔ́ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu da otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ nēe bá ā í yɔ̄ ipú úgbéenyi ā ŋ́, ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā í gáā hɛ́ aá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. É géē yúklɔ́ kú uwā ā ɛháajɛ kú Utáma ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lé ɔdōlé, amáŋ é gáā nū ipú ŋ́. É géē bá ī gbā aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ ó cíkā ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā, nááná é kē nyila ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ le igbīhi cēkwu anúɔ nyɔ̄ í gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gbonɛnɛ klla ī yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, géē lɛ́ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ kē í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ klla í yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ gē kɛpɔ̄ ká alɛɛcɛ á. Óndú, lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um, ohígbū okpaakpa kú um. Ohígbū ka ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yíihɔtū í gē yúufi ŋ́, amáŋ ihɔtū nōo le jɛ̄ jīla ī nū ufi nyɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yúufi, ohígbū nēé í yá alɔ italā, ayíka é yíihɔtū kóō jɛ̄ jīla ipú ɔtū kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē yá uculo kóō le ínyílɔ́lɛ́ gwu ŋmá ɛyí ede, o ŋmá lɛ ō lɛ oyī kú ɛbɛ́ nēé ŋmó kwɛyí íne nēé bīya ā, kwu ajī ɛnɛ kú ede ā. Aá í yá ɛ̄nyā iháyí dóódu gbéeko nɛ̄ó gē mɛ ŋ́ piyóó. A í lɛ ede nyā tīihɔ dúúdú lɛ ami Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okwáhi mla ɔ̄cɛ oyújulu nōo tá ō yúklɔ́ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá nū gekwú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa nēé lɛ iyī uwā ā. Ó lɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ cɛnɛ yá ɛɛ́ nōó húmáyī wɛ ɔnyowkú yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ó gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́. Kwu otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ó gē gwōkónu ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ klla ī gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
idu_Latn: Akpá gaá le fīyɛ̄ Udéfīdi ahɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ í tútū kóō wā gāá kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Abíyāta kú ɔ̄ lɛ īlī ō klá ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā kpó wā.

eng_Latn: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ébú gē mɛ tāajɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobīyíne ā gē bí tāajɛ ga ɔlékwū á.

eng_Latn: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le igá kú ɔdɔ hɛ́ tū aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Utádimɔ ipú ígbíli mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó gwó Uhamáti gē kpó aíyó kú nū tū ā.

eng_Latn: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ pīyeyī má éŋkpɔ̄, ó géē má ofu kú iyī nū. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kē gbafíyóó lɛyíkwu ɛlá nɛ̄ ó ī gbo mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā, ó géē jé ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kōó lɛ ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyilɔ dúúmā ŋ́, ɔmáapú nū nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ fíyɛ́ ā, géē lé úgwū kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbāājɛ ā le ɔkɔ nā wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ka lɛ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi á. Ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū, ɛ́mba ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi wā nɛ. Okwinya ā le tú wā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla da Ujerúsālɛm kahíníí, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yēeyī ā, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ Usódom mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú nū ā í yá ɛdɔ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwɔ ā yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda tá ohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá ā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kē ī lɛ íjéeyī ŋmá ā? Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kē ī jɛ́yí odée ŋmá āa?.

eng_Latn: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ɔfiyɛ ā, aá tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ aɔ́kpani aá kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā, kú aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá dúúdú ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú. Aá géē yá ɔdā nēé da aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá da aá.

eng_Latn: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ka anúɔ bī ɔkpá nɛ̄ Uhilikíya ɔ́ɔ je lɛ anúɔ ā abɔ́ɔ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkpá ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, a jé um. A má ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, klla jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū kú um lɛ lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā. Lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe bá nyā kpó nyɔ̄ abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé ī pi nyɔ̄ gáā hɛ́ ɔkɔ ā. Lɛ uwá tútū jāā gbéeko nēé kpo uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā jāhɔ̄ tá ojuju nɛ̄ n tū lɛyíkwu igelī kú Ubábīlɔn, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n mīya ka n gáā yá ācɛ ā a. É géē kpó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwá pi nyɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā kē í tá áncā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ga ipú aɔ́dāajɛ ā, ká ā lɛ ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛwū ɛpa bī wā. Ká n̄ lɛ ɛdɔ ɔdōlé, nōo he ádā uwɔ̄ ɔtū ā yá.

eng_Latn: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ o cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēe lɛ íjééyī nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ yēŋēē, é lɛ ɛbɔ́, é gbonɛnɛ, é i pó ɛlā ɔ̄cɛ, é ī ményinyi ācɛ, é lɛ eyīyɛpa ŋ́, é wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ ɛpa géē bá ɛhɔ̄, é géē kwú éyi ú, cɛ́ɛ́ é habɔ̄ ɔhá tá.

eng_Latn: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
idu_Latn: Óndú alɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɔtūce aá á, alɔ jé kpɔ́cíí ka aá yɔ̄ ī yá, aá kē géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ nwū aá ā.

eng_Latn: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, nēe wɛ aádā ā, ohígbū ka aá jé anú nōo yɔ̄ ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā. N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, ayípɛ̄ oklóbīya, ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
idu_Latn: É le uwá kpó ŋmó, oyī kú uwā kē le pɛ́ klá ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē nyi okwū kú uwá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n gē gwéeyē ohígbū ōwē kú um ohígbū aá, anɔ́ɔ ipú ōwē kú ɔkpíyē kú um nyā n lɛ ōwē ohile kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ohígbū ɔkpíyē kú nū, nōo wɛ icɔ́ɔci ā, má.

eng_Latn: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ a je lɛ ɔ́ ā nōó je ga awɔ kwúcē ɛ́ɛ má. Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú je ɔdā dúúmā nōó lɛ ā o yá kóō yēeyī glá.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Aá mɛ́mla aíkonó kú aá géē je o hile ā lé ɛga dóódu. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nyā, ó lɛ ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi nēé mafú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N jé ka ɛla nēe bá nyā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā.

eng_Latn: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le okóohō tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ kóō má ɔ́dāŋ ka éŋkpɔ̄ ā le ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gbɔlā nóó, ohígbū koó lɔfú wā eko nɛ̄ aá leyī ce ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi ma, anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Udáyína.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ukóhati ɔ́mɛtá ā, Uhɛ́brɔn ma ayí ɛnɛ: Ujɛríya, Amárīya, Ujɛhásīyɛlu mɛ́mla Ujɛkaméyam.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gā um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú alelékwū Ihɔ, nōo lā ipú alɔ ā, lɛ aɔ́dā ocɛgba nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó tū uwɔ abɔ̄ ā tū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usára le ɛhɛ yɛ tū īyī nū kahíníī, Abālɔbányā nɛ̄ n le hīla kpó nyā, nɛ̄ ɔbá um kē le hīla ā, alɔ jɔ́ɔ́nyɛ kóō gwutá kú ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā glá ɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ámíyā lɛ ācɛ nēe yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ ŋmó acígilí, Ɔwɔicō gē yɛhɛ tū uwā ipú ákanya kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ohi kahíníī, Aá jé ŋmá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā Ɔwɔicō yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔma, n lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ gā uwɔ abɔ̄ a le he um ɔtū ā. Ami Upɔ́lu yá ɛ̄nyā nááná nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔnyakwɔ̄cɛ okwɛyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, n kē klla yɔ̄ agbá ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujónādāabu le ɔ̄kā da Ámnɔn ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ eyī kú ɔyí-ɔ́cɛ́ ɔ́ɔ le ŋúlóŋúló klla le kwányíhí ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ámnɔn tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Utáma, ɔyíné kú ɔyí ádā anúɔ Ábsālɔm, ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō dóódu gē cɛ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kplɛ́fú kú ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ í kwu tayínū ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɛlā pó, ó gē jīla anú kóō má ɔkwɛ̄yi amáŋ ka ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú ɛlā ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okónu gē jé ohɔ́ɔnɔ amáŋ ka olɔnyɛ kú ɔdōlé ā.

eng_Latn: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē gbō ŋmá unwalu ā kéē gwéeye. É kéē bá ī gwíijē kú éeyē eko dóódu. Óndú, gbō ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā awɔ he uwá ɔtū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā nāa yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ olɛlā kú uwɔ lɛ ikpó gbo ajɛ, má gwōnū. Ā gwéeyē ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ikwū je klá Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá mla ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā? É le tútū kéē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī gaajɛ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā wā í da Usámsin ka, ɛyí ita ā yɔ̄ á, Ɔdí lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ ɛnwú āa? Ɔdí kē lɔfú fíyɛ́ ágábá āa? Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin tá uwā ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē húmáyī ī je unwalu lɛ ɔnyā anúɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í jɛ́yí ita ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ úcɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔja pó bá ī yɛ ɛyí ɔcí ā, ayíka a gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka n géē gbɔbū nyɔ̄ ga awɔ, gaá yá uwā lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ofɛnɛ faajɛ ŋmá Ussɛ́kɛm, mɛ́mla Ussílo, mɛ́mla Usamérīya. É lɛ ɔnwāgba kú uwā wā, lɛ īlī kú uwá kpó híla, lɛ ewo wu klla ɛyí. É yá lɛ ā kéē mafú ka aá yɔ̄ ɔtūnobí. É bī īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī gáā le gwɛ́ɛya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: N tíne ká n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, o ŋmá lɛ okpaakpa kú uwɔ ā, lɛ oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ je gā um.

eng_Latn: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni Oyúbatísīm mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīsi bá gē gwōkónu. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī wā i da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔ́díyá nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú ācɛ Ufárisīsi ge gwōkónu ā. Amáŋ ayíkpó kú uwɔ í gē gwū ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛwa le jīla gbɔɔ́ ō da Upáyílēti kóō lɛ ɔdā olɔhi nōó ge yá lɛ uwá ojígógó ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, é kwú pɛ́ ga ɛcɛ le yɛ gaá kwāajɛ ígbíli nōo kwu Utékōwa ajaajɛ ā. Abɔ̄ é bá ī gɛɛcɛ ā, Ujɛhósāfati da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá le ɔtūce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, aá háyi ká. Aá le ɔtū kpó ce ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka lɛ aá ā ká aá le yálé.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan da ɔyípóklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ka aá lɛ beé ga ádɛ́fú kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, ācopɛ̄cí nēe bá ā. Eko ōhī Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú tá aá abɔ̄ glá, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ tá aá, ɔ́ɔ kē í cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá ācɛ ā lé piíí, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá nyɛ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nū da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá yá ɔdā dúú nōó da aá ā.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ɔbá ɛna éyi, álá éyi mɛ́mla omlede éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɛkaríya lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó le hɛ́gilígilí mla ufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ká ā ma ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá tá. É tū ōwē nɛ̄ a gē má ā klá uwɔ ká ā híī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka odúúdú aá nēe bá ā wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē yá lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōo yá āa?.

eng_Latn: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔnyōkwū nyā í cɛ̄ gā um lɛ enyi gwá lɛ uklló ce ɛtɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ń géē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú nū hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ó géē yɔ̄ ī wā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī le cé um.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō tíne um āa? Aá jé ka n cíkā o yúklɔ́ ipú inu ɔlɛ́ Ádā um ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
idu_Latn: Ó kwu ikwū ajaajɛ, ɔlékwū klla kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū kú Ayisáya kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá odúdɔ̄lɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, N gbɛlá ka ń gáā má eyī kú uwɔ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ nɛ. Amáŋ, mɔ́ɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō klla cɛ̄ ká n̄ lɛ ayí uwɔ má dúú.

eng_Latn: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
idu_Latn: Owu í gē kpó uwā bónū bɛ̄ɛka ácí ā ŋ́. Ofulúutu í wā wɛɛlɛ gaá je uwá ŋmá ajɛ nyɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka igbóngbō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ igwo hile ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ékpónú ā nɛɛ, é géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á, eko nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ kú um nāndaa klá uwá, lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
idu_Latn: Ɛwa ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É tá ipú ɔkpá kú íne kú alɔ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē yēeyī piyóó. Ɔdí yá nāa ka ka é géē je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ gicō piíí āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uríspa, ɔnyā ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu éyi, nōo wɛ adá kú Áya ā, bī īlī ekwu le áklɔ̄kpɛ gwó lɛ īyī nū ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ aókwū ahāapa ā bá āa. Ó klá abɔ́ɔ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ eko oōce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gbɔɔ́ ā jāā gbéeko ɔgwā kú iháyí ɔhá. Ó gē nū aígbáanɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí aókwū ā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē ī nū aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí ŋmá ɛgiyí aókwū otú.

eng_Latn: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
idu_Latn: Ó géē lā mla aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ olufa lɛ aá ā jāā gbéeko iháyí kú ɔdā o je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā.

eng_Latn: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É klla géē yɛ Ujerúsālɛm jīla tá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe yɛ ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ jīla tá bá ī gbō ɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɛhīlī kú iháyí ɔ́mɛhīlī nēé kpó alɔ ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn abɔfú ā, Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujúda nēe bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā cīce mla um ɔlɛ́ um. Igbēékpónú ɔfú kú Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ga iyē kú um.

eng_Latn: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa cāŋjɛ, pīya ipú inu ā bilíbilí, anɔ́ɔ ó klla gaá lɛ īyī nū nāŋ́daa klá ɔyí ā kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí ā le ácihóo tá igbo ahāapa á, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú eyī nwūla á.

eng_Latn: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ agege ahāapa yá lɛ ɔdā o lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā. Ugóolu nɛ̄ó bī le yá oflēnjē ō kpó éwo bónū mɛ́mla álápā ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɔ̄cɛ géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū piíí.

eng_Latn: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ, kóō je ɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo kwú ɔtú kú nū ú ce ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo klla lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ucē kú olíla nāa yá yɔ̄ á, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, a géē yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú o ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
idu_Latn: Olíla í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó jɛ́yí odée ámāŋ ka ó jɛ́yí nū ŋ́. Ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛgbá kú nū ā wɛ, kéē lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ákú nū ka ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
idu_Latn: Īnyīlɛ̄yí kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ācɛnyā ā. Ayīnu kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ o le cɛyí hokónu tū oklóbīya uwɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli ā, wɛ ɔdā ékpónú mla okónu ō tá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā dúú kwú iyī nū ú táajɛ lɛ ɛbɛ́ kóō lɛ ikpó nū ce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī cikpó ɔnyā ā. É géē kpó ɔnyā ā mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ā ŋmó. Ɛfiyɛ kú ikwū kú uwā ce iyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ bōōbū kéē lɛ ɔ́ má, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ piíí ā jé. Ó da uwá ka é klla lɛ ācɛ nēe má ɔ̄ īkpēyī abɔ̄yī uwā abɔ́ɔ piíí ā jé, ohígbū ka anúɔ pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ lɛ ula nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá da ācɛ Ujíyu ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ká iyē kóō lɔfú lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, da aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā, kéē nwū uwɔ lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya bá ī kwinya fíya fíya, bá ī lɛ āpīice kú uwā da ajɛ gligligli.

eng_Latn: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá géē je īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gwɛ́ɛya ā, aá géē je ɔyí álá kú iháyí ékpónú nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya dúú.

eng_Latn: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ijēēnyi yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é ba gē ka iŋini tá Umósīsi kpɔ́ á. É kahíníī, Ɔdíyā nāa kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā? Ká ā gaá kpó alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ mɛ́mla anyā alɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá bá kú ijēēnyi kóō kpó alɔ ŋmó nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yɛce Óndú ā kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, eko kú unwalu kú uwā dóódu. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ unwalu lɛ cēnyi ī pɛ́ wā kwūū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpá gē cēnyi ī pɛ́ kwūū ā, ó gáā gaajɛ uwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ɔdā otīihɔ ā, ɛga otīīhɔ. Ayí ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwɔ ōfōōfū uwa géē lé glá á. Je uwa ɔdā otīihɔ nɛ̄hi piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ igwó á, yɔ̄ gē da uwā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá lɛ ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ le kpó hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
idu_Latn: Ipú íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi je lɛ alɔ ā, é ka ālɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ̄ tá ɛcɔ̄ klá ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Ɔdí nɛ̄ awɔ ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bī ɔ̄ yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ā, Upáltīyɛlu yɛce ɔ́ yɔ̄ í jikwú jāā ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ubahurím. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ábna lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ā, ó kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá leyī kwɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú abɔ̄ a lɛ iyī aá, gē yá ɔdā dúú nōo he aá ɔtū ā, ɔ́ɔmā kóō yá kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā í lɔfú ipú ɔtū nēé kpóce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā kéē gwōtū ínoōbīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nōo he aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā ɔtū ā nēé gē nyɔ̄ á. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aákā ā kē í nyɔ̄ mla uwá dúú á. Ohígbū ka aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā gē bī uwá yá ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
idu_Latn: Ufɛdɛ́ya, mɛ́mla Upénūwēlu.

eng_Latn: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ā? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo cīce kóō lé ɔdōlé ā kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo cīce kéē cē ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ̄. Amáŋ ami ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú aá ā.

eng_Latn: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
idu_Latn: É géē bí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo le ŋmókókó ā. É géē kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo le wúla ēpū ā.

eng_Latn: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́ nēé gē tū ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēé gē nwū ā, géē gbō uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí anyā obɔ́bí ā, mɛ́mla ɛlā o pi ɔ̄cɛ ga ipú unwalu kú anyā ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ īlī nēé hī ka Ulínim ā ŋmá Íjīpiti, nēé nɛ̄ é bī le hīijā tū ɔ̄, nēé bī le yá īlī ōklá aflá kú uwɔ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā géē je ɔ́ ŋmá ɛga oligbó bōōbū ka ɔ́ ŋmá Íjīpiti. Īlī nōo ī gbo obobowú ce ɔ̄cɛ kú uwɔ ā, e yá ɔ mla īlī nɔ̄wá nōo ŋmá idɔ nēé hī ka Usáyíprɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anyākwɔ́cɛ ofucɛnɛ nēe cīīce aúgādā ɔcɛ́ kú uwā iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā má gbo klá ajɛ, lɛ eyī pīya kláajɛ, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um yɔ̄ ī gwō kin kin kin, abɔ̄ le hɛ́ um iyē ɛɛ́. Eyī kú um í klla mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, awɔ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ gboló ce glá á.

eng_Latn: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ó wú nyɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ā le abɔ́ɔ mafú lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ tá ga abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ īkpɛ̄yí āgā ā kwú nū ce eyī enyi á.

eng_Latn: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
idu_Latn: Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya cāŋjɛ lɛyí bú kwu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ Uménāhɛm. Anɔ́ɔ Uménāhɛm, le ɛkpa kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu igwáahāapa kpó lɛ Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa kú ɔ̄ mā anúɔ tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā kú ɛhi ā bá yɔ̄ á. Anyā ɛwū ofigwó mɛ́mla opī ofu, aálá ofigwó mɛ́mla omlede ofu.

eng_Latn: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
idu_Latn: Uhána móōwē ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi, o ŋmá lɛ okónu nɛ̄ opú nū gē yá ɔ̄ klla ī bīya anú ɔtū, ohígbū ka, Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ɔma kú nū gwū, nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka iní nɛ̄ Umɛfíbōssɛti, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú ɔkpáni uwɔ, Usɔ́ɔlu yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ Usíba tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ kpéyīce ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ gáā je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ádā nū, Usɔ́ɔlu, ā lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a gē je eyī kú uwɔ tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí um klla í je um bɛ̄ɛka olɛlā kú uwɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
idu_Latn: je pīya ákú Ébrahām ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti nēe bá ɔɔ́pu abɔ́ɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
idu_Latn: Urékɛm, Íripīli, Utárāla.

eng_Latn: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu ī ka olɔhi kú Udɛmɛ́trīyɔ̄si, ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā kē ī ka olɔhi kú nū dúú. Alɔ kē ī cījáalí nū dúú, a kē jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ iyī alɔ mafú ka alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō oŋmá lɛ oyēeyī oyēŋēē nɛ̄ alɔ lā ā, Ɔdōojé kú alɔ, ɔtōōlé kú alɔ, ogbonɛnɛ kú alɔ, oŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ, mɛ́mla ihɔtū ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ gekwú mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, alɔ cɛ̄ ka alɔ géē yēeyī mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū ɛhi nɛ̄ okónu í ka ɔ́ glá ŋ́ nōó je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, O ŋmá ajɛ nyā piíí ā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tá okónu lɛ ɔ́ ā, ɔyí nyā géē je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ alɔ ŋmá úklɔ́ olɔfú kú alɔ dóódu á. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Unówa.

eng_Latn: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ó gē bī ita eko dúú nɛ̄ ó ī kɛlā lɛ ɛwa, amáŋ eko dúú nɛ̄ anú mla ayíkpó kú nū gaá bá ōfōōfūwā, ó gē ka ɛyí kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá Abróna ā, é gaá lā Ɛ́siyɔngɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
idu_Latn: Íne kú ɛya ō gwó ékpónú ā yɔ̄ lɛ aá mɛ́mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Nááná, é bá yɔ̄ ī bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́. É kē yíikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Ɔwɔicō ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú Ámɔn le ujɔ̄ tū tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
idu_Latn: Ɛhá géē kwú ācɛ ogwéjé mla aóléwulu lé kpɔkɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔdā nāa jé ōfōōfū nū ā wɛ, o yɔ̄ ī lé, yɔ̄ ī gwá klla yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā piyóó, ó gáā gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ nāa géē gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ áhingílí wu iyē ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yīipú, je ɔyí ma acígilí nōó yɔ́ɔma dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
idu_Latn: N bī aá gwō lɛ ɔ́, aá kē cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú um ŋ́. Alɔ í kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ aá jéjēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ō gwō nɛ̄ alɔ bī aá gwō ipeyī Utáyítɔ̄si ā le kpaakpa ā á.

eng_Latn: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī da uwá kahíníī, Aólíla, eko nyá nɛ̄ aá géē lííla gaá kwu ā? Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá géē yá ɔdōōjé ɛbɛ́ gaá kwu ā? Ń ba aá í gáā tíne kú aá jé ɔdá dúúmā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā wɛ ka, Ohi nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá um ā? Amāŋ, Ɔdí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da um ā.

eng_Latn: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó hile ligií kóō kwú oyēeyī kú nū í tónu ohígbū úklɔ́ nōó yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ó yá odúúdú ɛ̄nyā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá um abɔ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá abɔ̄yī aá í tá um abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le alɔ tū oyēeyī, ipu kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā, ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú alɔ yá alɔ lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Itiyópiya lɛ ga um mā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, nɛ̄ n bī ācɛ Ufilístiya bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ukáfutɔ, klla bī ācɛ Usiríya bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ukɛ́ri dúú á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya klla yɛce ɔwɛ mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú klla yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati nɛ̄ ó yá klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
idu_Latn: Ōwē nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gē tíne ō yá ācɛ olɔhi ā, géē kwúcē gé lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ kóō híī yā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá, kú aɔ́kpá kú uwā kéē kwú kpó ŋmó. Ubábīlɔn wɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ ācɛ nēe ī pā aɛ́cí alɛwa, Aɛ́cí ā kē húmáyī lɛ ācɛ ā yá aólíla.

eng_Latn: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé aɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ dóódu nōo gē pi yɛ ajɛ ā ŋ́. É wɛ ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
idu_Latn: É géē nū uwɔ ŋmá ipú ācɛ, gaá lā ipácí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí. A kē í yɔ̄ ī lé ácí mɛ́mla ēpū bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā, iháyí ahāapa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a le jé ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ gē gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú alɛɛcɛ á. Ó klla gē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā pīyeyī má iyī uwā, bá gē gbɛlá ɔ̄cɛ nōó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo je Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā lā ipú aá, anú nōo je Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, géē je oyēeyī lɛ ɔkpíyē kú aá nēe ī kwú ā dúú, ŋmá lɛ Alelékwū kú nū nōo lā ipú aá ā.

eng_Latn: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ í lɛ uwá hɛ́tá á. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyā wɛ Éhūdu nōó gē yá abɔ̄lúfīyē ā. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú Ugɛ́ra nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le Éhūdu tɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛhi gé lɛ Églɔn ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
idu_Latn: Aá híī juwēyī lɛ iyē otīihɔ kú um ā ŋ́. N tíne kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄ ka n tīihɔ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā nōo le aá tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
idu_Latn: N gbēyī Óndú cíí kóō tá um abɔ̄. Ó kē le ahɔ̄ jē gā um, klla le ikwū nɛ̄ n je ā pó.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɛ́būlɔn ā wɛ: Usɛ́rēdi, Ɛ́lɔ̄n mɛ́mla Ujalīīlu.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
idu_Latn: Utiyófílɔ̄si, ɛ́jílá, ācɛ alɛwa lɔfú tīyē lɛ aɔ́dā nēe yá ɔtāhɛ̄ ālɔ̄ kpɛ́mm ā tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
idu_Latn: Ó wā gaá da ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ olɛhɔ̄ ā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō gbogwú, anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Uhɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛcɔ̄ bī gé lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó má cīce ɛyí nū á. Anɔ́ɔ é bī ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kwiicō, ɔ̄cɛ éyi bī abɔ̄ éyi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá bī abɔ̄ ɔhá. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ kú nū kwiicō jāā gbó ɛnɔ ogajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛwa ā dɛ̄gba tū uwā kéē bá cíí. Amáŋ é dɛ̄gba fíyɛ́ kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi, ményinyi alɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko géē wā, nɛ̄ n géē yá aɛ́cí kú Ubábīlɔn italā. Uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú éwo ā, é kē í kpó odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
idu_Latn: Ami gē kpó uwā trɛ̄yí, klla ī da uwā ɔdā nēé ī yá ā á. N lá ipú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ ipú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā. N gē tū uwā ɔtū lé bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tū ācɛ nēe bá eyíkwū ɔtū lé ā.

eng_Latn: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
idu_Latn: N géē nyí aá ɔdōlé, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛnyā igwó géē bá ī yá igbō ikpó acɔ̄lá ékpónú ā. É kē í yá éyééye éyééye. Eko nɛ̄ aá kē kwú odúúdú nū ú lé, nááná ɛmiyɛ géē ŋmó aá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
idu_Latn: É le Ucɛ́rūbim ɛpa gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú ólíifu. É kwú uwā ú ce ɛyí kú ɛga nōo tīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí odokónu éyi tɛ́ɛ́cɛ, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le bɛ̄cɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ odokónu ā gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā. Ɛwa kú ācɛ ā le kpó hídáagó.

eng_Latn: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n géē pīya éŋkpɔ̄ klá ajɛ nōo le ŋmó ā. Aɔ́kpá klla í cēenyi ipú ajɛ íkpākplā. N géē cē ɔfú kú um mɛ́mla ɔhā kú um klá ayí aá, mɛ́mla ayááyí aá.

eng_Latn: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
idu_Latn: Éwo ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jámá hé ɔ̄ eyī glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hɔ́hā ce Ísrɛ̄lu, é géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tókónu lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, é géē tókónu lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
idu_Latn: Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko géē wā nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa géē ŋmá ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi alɛwa wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
idu_Latn: ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bīya ú yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ uwá kpó kwúcē wāajɛ nāa je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ aɛ́na onyinyi gányá gányá ā, kwú aɛ́na ojɔ̄kwū ā ú kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā á.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Umerí! Ó pīyeyī da ɔ́ ɔkɔ kú Uhíbru kahíníī, Rabonáyi! .

eng_Latn: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka lɛyíkwu aíyó ohile nēé mā uwā tá bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, Ujerúsālɛm ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya le ɔgba hɛ́ ɔ́kíkā ɛtá kéē kpɛ́fú. Ígwu éyi yɛ lɛyíkwu Ofára ipú ajɛ kú Ussúwalu.

eng_Latn: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā le yá jīla ā. Ó kahíníī, Anɔ́ɔ é le ikpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofucígwó ā kpó ŋmá ajɛ, áluka kú ije nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu cɛ̄ ka aá ī gbā ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú lɛ abɔ̄ kwɔtū kóō nya oyēeyī kú nū tá, ó le lɛ ā, ó gáā lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú kwú oyēeyī kú nū ú tónū ohígbū um, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē lɛ oyēeyī opíyóó.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ómri yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
idu_Latn: Anú yá nɛ̄ alɛwa kú uwā cɛ̄ á. Alɛwa kú ācɛnyā ōcɛgbá nɛ̄hi kú Ugríisi mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ kú Ugríisi cɛ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
idu_Latn: Áá leyī kwɛcɛ ohígbū aútíca kú íne ā, nɛ̄ awulú ōkwajɛ áncā ō wiiyē kéē yɛ ipú olihi biílí he uwá ɔtū ā. Ó wɛ ɔdā ō he uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ kéē túkpɛɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ kéē hókónu tū uwā. Ācɛ nōo cīce ɔcí iyɔ̄bū ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɛga ojīlīmā eko kú ucɛ gē he uwá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ī mīyɛ ācɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū keé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, ó wɛ ohígbū úklɔ́ nēé yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu gbɔɔ́ ō mímálānyī nū fíyɛ́, amáŋ ádā nū yɔ̄ gē gbɛlá odúúdú ɛlā nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n le eyīnyinyi uwā má. Ń tíne ō kpó uwá ŋmó ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
idu_Latn: Ábīja gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́, Ujerúsālɛm igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Ása le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á. Ācɛ kú Ujúda bá ɛbɔ́ iháyí igwó eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ása ā.

eng_Latn: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya mɛ́mla áncɛ́nyā um, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá dúú ka anúɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ ó yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo í ma ɔ́ fú ŋ́, ɔdí wɛ ile kú nū ā? Ɛdɔ kú ɛlā ō cɛ̄ ɛgɔ́ɔmā hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá glá ā?.

eng_Latn: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwēyī lɛ aólɛlā kú nū, amáŋ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā géē yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbū, í yɔ̄ ī gbagbénú.

eng_Latn: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ lɔfú jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Umósisi mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tá ā. Uwá kéē lɔtū tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kpó aíne nēe bá nyā lɛ Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
idu_Latn: Uméssūlam wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́sra á. Ujehónānan wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Amaríya á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Eko kpíii ā, ɔkpáncō kwú dobū kpímm mla ojuja. Owu gbɔɔ́ ō tá, anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō yā á. Áhābu le tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō ga Ujɛsiríili á.

eng_Latn: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
idu_Latn: Ó le īlī ifa ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kpó lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá, amáŋ ó le īlī ifa ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ije kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó lɛ Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́futa kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu trɛ̄yí iháyí ɛhīlī, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á. É le ɔ́ nyi Ugílɛ̄di ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi, Udéfīdi bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō le okónu ce mɛ́mla uwá Uhɛ́brɔn abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é le anɔ̄ tū Udéfīdi ɛyí kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gē jīla ígwu ā, ɔdōlé nɛ̄ aá gē lé ā í wɛ ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ihɔ ŋ́, ɔdā ɔhá nɛ̄ aá ī lé á.

eng_Latn: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla uwá ā, Urécɛ̄lu, nōo gē gbō aálá kú ádā nū ā gā mla aálá āa.

eng_Latn: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛɛcɛ í le kpaakpa ipéyī Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ í le yēŋēē ipéyī ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ejé kwú cá ŋmá ɔɔ́ eyī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā dóódu nōo yá kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú nū kwú wu gicō bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ oŋmɛ́ɛŋmɛ́ɛ le ɔ́ kwú, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó kú nū kwú kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā le okwutɛ bī gé lɛ ɔ́, kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ uwā. Okwutɛ ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛpa. Okwutɛ kú Árɔ̄ni yɔ̄ ipú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da aéwɔhá ā kahíníī, Abālɔbányā ā, n gáā jegicō ká n̄ yá odée ɛɛ́. N géē mafu lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɔfú lɛ ā. Ācɛ kē í cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gáā nuunu tá ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ Ukénan ā, aá géē pɛ́kwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Óndú ā í gáā yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá tá ká aá yɛce Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɔdā nōo yá nyā Ujóbu yēeyī iháyí ofahāapa. Ó lɛ ayí kú ayí nū mɛ́mla ayááyí kú ayí nū má.

eng_Latn: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um, nɛ̄ ī wɔ́tū um nááná nɛ̄ ń yá ūwā ɔdā dúúmā mā, le um kwú ukpa bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the asses of Kish Saul's father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
idu_Latn: Aíjakī kú Ukíssi, ádā kú Usɔ́lu le pɛ́ gebí. Anɔ́ɔ Ukíssi da Usɔ́lu ká ɔ̄ kwú éyi kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ú, kéē nyɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā aíjakī ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ itali kú ɔ́ŋgba ōjíla yá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na nū ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bá ɛcɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ije kú ācɛ ofūla ije abɔ̄ ā pīya bónū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ítéblu kú uwā cē gwōnū á.

eng_Latn: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo géē yá ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi nōo gē ka ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ka aá lɔfú, aá klla kē jɛ̄ iyī aá yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. É gē gbɛlá lɛbɛ̄ɛka, uwá ōfōōfū uwā yɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ɔlɛ́ ā géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ ipácí géē lā klla í mlɛ́nyɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wā í gwō ɔ̄ tá géē tɔ́ɔcɔ́ klla í mī ɛyí jigijigi.

eng_Latn: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, N lɔfú jɛ́ɛyi nū glá ŋ́, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔwɔ nū cɛ̄ gā um? Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ufílīpu kóō wā icō gaá cīce pī anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you; and the LORD will not hear you in that day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā, aá géē jikwū klá Ɔwɔicō ā kóō lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ aá tíne ā. Amáŋ, Óndú ā í gáā pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá í gbā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔya éyi ā, aá géē bī ɛna nōo lɛ ɛ̄nyā dúúmā ŋ́ mā le gwɛ́ɛya kú aá le gwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛfú kpó tá aólɛla kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔkɔ gbā gā awɔ ɛga dúúmā leyī pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gwó gā uwɔ nyā, koócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nēé gbā ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō kɛpɔ̄ tū Ujóbu jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɛlā nōó ka ā jila má kwɛyí. Ohígbū koó ī táafú mla Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a kwú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā í yálé, nēé kōō hile ācɛ nɛ̄ a yá ágbe ā bá áklɔ̄kpɛ ōfōōfū uwā á, ācɛ nēe yá ágbe bá áklɔ̄kpɛ ā, klla géē cāŋ́jɛ kpɔ́ gaá je igelī nyā tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ Upúlu, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya gaá mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, kwú uwá í kpó wu, klla kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā í kpó ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú uwā gaá lā Uhála, Uhábɔ, Uhára mɛ́mla okónu ísu kú Ugósan piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
idu_Latn: Ubɛti Árāba, Usɛmárem, Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwu ɔkplɛ́fú oje kú ɛfú kú nū ú kpó wu Udéfīdi iyē. Ó kwú ɔkpú kú oje udɔ ú klá anú ɛyí, kwú úwé oje ú klá anú iyē.

eng_Latn: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ocɛ̄tra kú ācɛ he uwá ɔtū fíyɛ́ ocɛ̄tra kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
idu_Latn: Ujúda, ayínɛ́ uwɔ géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ. A géē yá aólɛlā kú uwɔ lé. Ayínɛ́ uwɔ géē tūkpɛɛ̄ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā je ɔkɔ gicō bī iyē kú Óndú ā le ɔkpá gbo ka ɛka nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ gbo lɛ Óndú ā, aá ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ ɔ́ tū. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛgba dɛ̄ klla le opo tá tālúúú á.

eng_Latn: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí je ɔ́ kwú lé á, nɛ̄ ó lɛ āyā o hile kú ɛbɛ́ ā bī wā, kóō wɛ ijáalí, ó gáā gbā ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí je kwú lé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tá ifu ipu ɔtū nobí ohígbū Umówābu mla Ukɛ́ hɛ́rɛs.

eng_Latn: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́cí ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ā kwú pīya ɔdā icííci tɔ̄há. É nya īyī uwā tá glá ŋ́. É kē lɛ aɛ́cí mɛ́mla ācɛ ā kpó kwú ga ajɛ éwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
idu_Latn: Utánki kú oje udɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́na igwɛ́ɛpa kú oje udɔ nōó yá utánki ā cɛyí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā le ɔ̄kā kú íjééyī kú Usólōmɔn ā pó kpɛ́mm. É klla í tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú alɔ le kpií ā ā, alɔ í jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ alɔ gē lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā le kpiíí bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē cē eyī beé ā.

eng_Latn: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka agbénú nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lúúgwū nū ŋmá ɛgiyí aádáádā uwā ā. Ó gē tīile piyóó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je ɔ́da kú nū lɛ aá lɛ ā ipú ɔyā nēé hī Abíbu nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Ɛplá ɛ̄cī aháapa nɛ̄ aá géē le lé ucɛ ā, aá gáā lé igbō nēé le ɔdōnigbō tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō tá abɔ̄ áncā wā í gbā um ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ā kéē yāajɛ ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gwutá ipú inu ā ámāŋ ka o lé ɔdōlé ipú inu ā géē na īlī kú nū.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ahínyá! Ó gā ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gáā nya uwá nyatá.

eng_Latn: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbú kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá nā abɔ̄ daa kwiicō lɛyíkwu um gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um oŋmá abālɔbányā gɛɛ, n géē je eyī kú um tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, Ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ aá kōō gbɔ̄kɔ nɛ̄hi lɛ, náaná, ń gáā tá aá ohi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācōŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
idu_Latn: Ó he um ɔtū ká n̄ yɔ̄ mla aá abālɔbányā ká n̄ kē lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pīyabɔ̄, ohígbū ka ɛlā kú aá le kwú um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ́kɔ ā, ācɛ le Ujísɔ̄si jéjúuma bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
idu_Latn: N géē gbɛka mɛ́mla uwá, nōo géē yá kú uwá kéē lā ɛbɔ́ piyóó. N géē bū uwá tū, klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwā nyīla nɛ̄hi. N klla í je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā kwu ipú ajɛ kú uwá piyóó.

eng_Latn: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
idu_Latn: N géē lɔfú tū ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ jɛ́ uwā ā iyē, klla í je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā.

eng_Latn: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: N gee ya abɔ́ɔ ka o kwu pīya ajɛ kú ɛbɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛgbɛ́ a, klla i je ajɛ a pīya ōkpoō kú éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. N gēe je uwā ya ífi bónū. Abɔ̄ Óndú āka lɛ a.

eng_Latn: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti nɛ̄ n gáā je tá alácɛ̄ fíyɛ́ dúú, ipú odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā. Iháyí ofɛpa ā, aígelī nɛ̄hi kú nū géē tá alácɛ̄, fíyɛ́ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá dúúmā nēé je tá alácɛ̄ ā. N géē je ācɛ kú Íjīpiti yá ācɛ nēe ī kwinya ɛfú ga ajɛ éwɔhá. Uwá géē kwu nyɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ éwo dóódu nyɔ̄ ī lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ ga ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú fu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ipéyī Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ ā, kéē lé ukpɛ̄ kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé, anɔ̄, mɛ́mla ayí aflɛ́yí kú ɛna mɛ́mla álá kú uwā. Ó da uwá kéē yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ nwū ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ŋmá íne kú Umósīsi kahíníī, Ā híīī gbō ɛna okónu eko nōó yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɛyí ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō wú ɔ̄ ŋ́. Abālɔbányā, ɛlā kú ɔbá ɛna kwú Ɔwɔicō ɔtū á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbɛlá lɛyíkwu éeyē ō gwó piyóó wɛ olíla. Ɔ̄cojéeyī ī gbɛlá lɛyíkwu ikwū.

eng_Latn: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
