idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá ācɛ italā yɔ̄ ī wā ɛ́ɛ́. Ó ka ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ í yá piíí.

eng_Latn: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ita nyā kwu lɛ ācɛ ā á. Ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nōo le ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin hí. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá olufa lɛ ācɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá iyāwu ɛga oligbó á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ oŋmá eko nyā gɔbū, ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, á gáā kpó ācɛ lé klla cɛ̄ lɛ ayí kú ācɛ nēe lā ipú uwɔ ā kéē pɛ́kwú ŋmá uwá abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ī ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nēé je ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔyā ahāanɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mla Ubénjamīn mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā, gaá le jīla Ujerúsālɛm iyɔ̄bū eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Ɔwɔ yɔ̄ í yá eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iyē hīlaŋdɔ́ lɛ ā mɛ́mla ogbɛnú kú ɛlā nōo kpó uwā wā í jīla ā, odúúdú uwā bā í fīyégbúlú kpákpákpá.

eng_Latn: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yɛ ɔwɛ ā, gē je ɔ́ iyō kpó uwī ɛɛ́, aɔ́mpa nū dóódu gē yɛhɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya ā gē wā ɛɛ́, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī yɔ̄ ī pīyeyī mlámlá! Óbō yɔ̄ ī yɛ fíyo fíyo! É le okwū tīkwū klá ajɛ! Okwū ā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́. Ācɛ bá ī gwōnū klá okwū ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɔ́kpa ɛpa kú ɔ́kíkā kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū wā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, A jé ka ɔtū wú ācɛ Ufárisīi eko nēé pó ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka āa.

eng_Latn: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
idu_Latn: Ńááná nɛ̄ ń yá ɔdā dúúmā bɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā, ń lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā nōo í yá um ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ka ɛcɛ, é gáā má ɔdā dúúmā gwū unwalu mɛ́mla obū mɛ́mla ákanyā mɛ́mla igbájí tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
idu_Latn: Upíta yɔ̄ ī gbafíyóó kú ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí ɛbɛ nyā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ da ɔ́ kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, ācɛ ɛtá bá gē dɔɔ̄kā awɔ.

eng_Latn: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, ɔkpani nū ā géē lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ó géē bī ɔ̄ wā Okómpinu kú ɛga nēé gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔɔ́ ahɔ̄ bū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū piyóó.

eng_Latn: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
idu_Latn: Lɛ úklɔ́ idáagó yá lɛ alɔ Óndú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá, eko nāa bī alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
idu_Latn: Unatánīyɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nāa jé um ŋmá ā? Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ofíílí kú Ufílīpu kóō hī uwɔ igwú, eko nāa yɔ̄ útū ɔcí Ufígi ā, n le uwɔ má.

eng_Latn: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le ɔdā nēé yá nyā pó ā, ó lɛ Ujówābu mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó tɛ̄hɔ nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā da Ufílīpu kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ká ā lɛ ugbɔ́nya nyā kwú cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tīkpó mla anú.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā lɛ aá, ɔ́dāŋ ka iyāwu kú aá ā géē lɔhi lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú aá í kē gáā tū ile ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ajɛ kú aá í gáā yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcí ō gwíikpō kú aá gē gwíikpō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
idu_Latn: Īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka owú otutú ā. Īkpéyī kú nū yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā da ɔ́ kóō lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ ɔ́ ā tá tū ɔkpá.

eng_Latn: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
idu_Latn: Ipú ōjíla nɛ̄hi ā, n géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ, kú ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā. N gwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄ n cókónū ka n gē gwó ā gā awɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛwa nɛ̄hi le jīla bá ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɛya o yɔlá kú um, nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá á. Ó tīihɔ nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé ā.

eng_Latn: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá eko nēé gē je ɛya nēé gē gwó kú ɛ̄cī dóódu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ci ā, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka, oŋmá eko nēé géē je ɔdā kú ɛbɛ ohéyī ā ce ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā, ɛ̄cī úlā ɛtá cofɛnɛ cigwó ā géē wā í yɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le Upɔ́lu bī iyɔ̄bū aɔ́cɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ágirīpa da Upɔ́lu kahíníī, É je ɛga ga awɔ ká ā kɛlā kú uwɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu je abɔ̄ gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɔko kú iyī nū ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā á.

eng_Latn: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ odúúdú ɔkplɛ́fú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó lɛ aá ā kpó tū iyē cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē lɔfú nunu tá ebilíi mla ula kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ɛbɛ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛɛ́ mā, Upelátīya, ɔyí kú Ubɛnáya ā gekwú wā ajɛ wɔɔlɔ. N má gwutá ajɛ gblugudu lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ lɛ íbá dɛ̄ kahíníī, Eléélelé! Óndú, ā gáā je odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó ŋmó nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofu ahāapa ce úlā ahātá ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
idu_Latn: Kwu ayí nēé ma ɔlɛ́ aá, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ aá bī ije lá ā, é géē hɛ̄ uwā apī. Ɛ̄nyā géē wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ ɔkpíyē kú aá ka ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mɛ́mla aá géē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé nēé gē kpó wā ɛyí ítēbulu ɛga nēé gē lé ɔdōlé kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā má. Ɛga nɛ̄ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū lā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yúklɔ́ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ īlī ɛdɔ ékpónú wiiyē ā, mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú nōó gē gwó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Ɛ́nyɔ́ le hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā má ā. Okónu í kōō hɛ́ ɔ̄ ɛɛ́, nōó gē má ɔdā dúúmā ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔnū kú Uhɛ́ba mɛ́mla Umálkīyɛlu wɛ ayí kú Ubɛríya.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū, gaá le pīya tɔ̄há mla ɔnyā nu, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá kwú pīya ɔkpíyē ékpónú á.

eng_Latn: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
idu_Latn: Ubássa, ɔyí kú Ahíja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka le ībīyājɛ yá tū Unádābu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ ŋmó á, eko nɛ̄ Unádābu yɔ̄ í kpɛ́fu kóō mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugibɛ́tɔn, ajɛ kú Ufilístiya ā.

eng_Latn: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
idu_Latn: A géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū wɛ Usɛ́kɛlu ofu kú ɔdōlé ɛ̄cī. Ɔ́ɔmā kē í bī uwɔ gbó oŋmɔ́ɔcī nū.

eng_Latn: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eyī yá um ká ɛyí kú um kóō wɛ obugā kú éŋkpɔ̄, ké eyī kú um kóo wɛ njɔlɔ ká agīje. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē yɔ̄ ī jikwú kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēé kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unáhɔ wɛ iháyí ofu ce ahāanɛ ā, ó le ɔyí éyi nōó hī ka Utéra ma.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, a le mu mla ɔbɔ́cɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, le ɛyí bú kwu uwɔ ɛɛ́! Eko gā nɛ̄ n géē yá uwɔ italā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ jé ɔ̄ le ɔ́ má abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í yá ɛ̄nyā ā, é da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí yá ɔyí kú Ukíssi yɔ̄ ā? Usɔ́lu wɛ ipú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā dúú nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko kpií igbīhi nɛ̄ Uhananíya kwú úkplākā ú hɛ́ ŋmá ɔkɔ kú ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā, Óndú ā gáā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
idu_Latn: Aá géē nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, amáŋ, aá gáā cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́. Aá géē pí anɔ̄ ŋmá īkpō kú ólīfu, amáŋ, aá gáā má anɔ̄ dúú ŋ́. Aá géē yá ejé ŋmá īkpō kú Ufáyin, amáŋ, aá gáā má ejé gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā kú Umanásɛ nōó lɛ ŋmá Áram ā ma ayí ɛpa lɛ ɔ́. Iyē kú uwā wɛ Asrīyɛlu mɛ́mla Umakíyɛ. Umakíyɛ wɛ ádā kú Ugílɛdi á.

eng_Latn: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
idu_Latn: Ɔgɛ́ɛji nōo yúklɔ́ lɔfú ā cíkā ō lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí nēé ī ce á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā bɛ̄ɛka ojuja nɛ̄hi nōo háyi pī okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo bī uwɔ ŋmá Ɔ́ɔru ajɛ kú ācɛ Ucáldii ā, ká n je ajɛ nyā gā uwɔ ká ā lā anú, kóō wɛ ákú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí lɔhi lɛ ɛdɔ kú ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú ɔdā olɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nyā yɔ̄ lɛ uwá ā. Ɛyí lɔhi lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ ā dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aíne nyá ā? Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ā híīī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ā híīī cikpɔ́nyā ɔhá ŋ́. Ā híīī wūwī ŋ́. Ā híīī cībéenú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔwɛ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔ̄dōbɔ̄bí ā dobū fiyuu bɛ̄ɛka otú ā. É gē gwōnū, amáŋ é jé ɔdā nōo hɛ́ uwā gwōnū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Ujóssuwa da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kéē le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ísu Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
idu_Latn: Ó yá uwā ɔdā ōlɔnɔ nɛ̄hi ŋmá lɛ íwɔ́tū mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ánya kú nū nēe wā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé tū kéē wā í ŋmó ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ka ami ɔ́ ka ā, nɛ̄ n géē ka ōfōōfū nū á.

eng_Latn: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū íne nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn ɔ́ɔ bīya ā. Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi italā, amáŋ ó ka ɔ́ɔ gáā yá uwā italā píyóó lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ géē bɔkwu ɛlā ā lɔɔlɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cē ije bá ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔ́mpa nū ā.

eng_Latn: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka anú gē gbō Ujerúsālɛm klla gē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá bá gē lɛ íne kú um tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n tū aá ukɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
idu_Latn: Ije nōó géē lɛ ŋmá ɔ́sú kú nū ā, géē je kpó pīya ákú Óndú ā. Ó gáā kpó ije kú nū ā tayínū ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ nōo gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā géē kpó ije ɔ́ɔmā le lá ɔdōlé mɛ́mla īlī cabácabá lɛ īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ wī ɔ̄ ā, aóndú nū da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī wī ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō géē lɛ ɔhā nɛ̄ ó cokónu ō hɛ́ ce Ébrahām ā hɛ́ ce aílɔ́wá o ŋmá lɛ opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, cɛ́ɛ́ o ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ó lɔfú yá kú Alelékwū Ihɔ nɛ̄ ó cokónu ō je lɛ alɔ ā kóō wā í bī alɔ tá glá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ámɔn le bɛ̄cɛ wā í kwāajɛ ɛfú pī okónɔɔwɛ kú Urábba, igelī nɛ̄hi nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ohile kú Usiríya mɛ́mla Utóbu mɛ́mla Umáaka ā kē má kwāajɛ ipácí á.

eng_Latn: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayí aflɛ́yí kú aɛ́na, aálá, aɛ́wū ā, é gáā fūla uwá ŋ́. É wɛ ákú um, a géē je uwá gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ oyī kú uwā tá klá ede ā, a klla í je ijē kú nū yɔlá lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū gē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kɛ́tɛ̄kɛtɛ wā ŋmá Ássa, Umanásɛ, mɛ́mla Usébulun ōfōōfú uwā wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
idu_Latn: Ámɔ̄n mɛ́mla Ujosíya.

eng_Latn: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Uháman tōolī playi ákanaba ɛpa, nɛ̄ ó bū tū, lɛ ogbló pīya cíla anú ɛyí ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó tútū kóō le ŋmó Umɔ́dɛkāyi ā, kwú pīya ɔdā nōo ŋmó anú abɔ̄yīnū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú ɔcɛ́ kwú gbo á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū aá á. Alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ kóō lɛ aá yá ɛdɔ ācɛ nēe cíkā lɛ ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī nōó dɔɔ̄kā kú aá lā ā. Alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá kú aá yá odúúdú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá tíne ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
idu_Latn: Eko kú oyéeyī kú um dúúdú yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, Óndú. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
idu_Latn: gaá lɛ ohi kpó lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka kahíníī, N klla géē bī ɛdɔ kú okónu ō tá nēé tá ipú ɔkpá kú íne nēé jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā le yá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm italā.

eng_Latn: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛnyā yá ā, é lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā je lɛ īyī uwā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā, ohígbū ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī kpó aɛ́bɛ́ nēé cíkā ō yɔlá ɛyí ede dúúdú yɔlá mla ijē kú uwā, ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī gbó otú. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ipú úklɔ́ kú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
idu_Latn: Olíla gē kɛlā alɛwa nááná nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ɔdā nōo gáā yá igbɔhá ŋ́ mā. Ɔnyɛ lɔfú jé ɔdā nōo í yá ɔ̄ igbīhi ikwū kú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um, ohígbū ka n le kwu wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ká ā gbō um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛlā kú um um ā nwū uwɔ ɛɛ́. N kē kwú uwɔ ú tayínū ipú abɔ̄ kú um ɛɛ́. Ami nā ɔkpáncō da klá icō, le ikpó kú ɛcɛ táajɛ á. N kē da ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Áá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa ā wɛ, aflɛ́yí, Usáyímɔ̄ni, nēé hi ka Upíta ā mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ándru, Ujémīsi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni, ɔyínɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í klla ī bī ɛlā kú awɔ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā yúklɔ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a je tá ajɛ lɛ alɔ bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Kú ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ, nōo yēeyī ā, ń lɛ igbō dúúmā gɛ ŋ́. N lɛ umu lígíi, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ lígíí kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā. Anú hile ipú oli kú anɔ̄ kú um mɛ́ɛ̄ á. N wā amānyā gaá cē ɛfú ká n̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔdōlé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ami mɛ́mla ɔyí um ká ālɔ̄ le lé, ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛmiyɛ kóō géē je alɔ kpó ŋmó mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Ohígbū ka ɔdōlé ámōōmɛ kú alɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ó klla géē kpɛ́fú tá Íjīpiti kpɔ́, amáŋ igbɛ́nyā ā, ó gáā kwú ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó leyī ce ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan cɛ̄ lɛ Udéfīdi le ɛka gwá kéē yíihɔtū tá iyī uwā, ohígbū ka anú Ujonátan abɔ̄yī nū yíihɔtū tá Udéfīdi ŋmá ɔtú kú nū péee.

eng_Latn: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ a má ikpó ō daajɛ, nɛ̄ ɛga ōhī kú nū wɛ oje nɛ̄ ɛgɔhá wɛ ɔmɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā nɛ̄ āyā ōhī gē lɔfú, āyā ɔhá ī kwáahi á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
idu_Latn: Uféro lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū, í le Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Igbɛ́nyā n le íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya ɛɛ́. Óndú ā lé ɛpɔ̄hi á. Ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé.

eng_Latn: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um jámá ká a má ɔdā nēé wɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē já oje má ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
idu_Latn: Le anyā um mɛ́mla ayí um, nɛ̄ n kwɛ̄hɔ̄cī ohígbū uwā gā uwɔ ā kpó gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n nyɛ̄ɛ̄. A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yúklɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi gā uwɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī omlede nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ō gbā cīgbīhi lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔ́lá nū í ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́lá kú ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
idu_Latn: Igbɛ alɛwa é gē yíkpɛyí olɔfú tá ɔ̄ klla ī yá ɔ̄ ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēe bá ā yá ajɛ kú Ubɛ́tāni, ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, ɛga nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni yɔ̄ gē yá ācɛ ubatísim ā.

eng_Latn: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā, ojuja gā gaá klá uwá. Ufi lɛ uwá kwú abɔ̄ ācɛ ɛpa ā le pɛ́ tá ipú ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Áyísīki da ɔyí nū kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a má ɛbɛ́ ā ŋmó fíyaa lɛ āa, ɔyí um? Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu tóóhi kahíníī, Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā, bī ɛbɛ́ gé um á.

eng_Latn: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó, géē lɔfú pɛ́kwú pī uwɔ glá, ācɛ ulá ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ nēe pɛ́kwú ā lɔfú le uwɔ yɛ jīla tá bíílí nááná, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, kahíníī, Ícɛ nyā, Óndú ā le okónu nōo ce ā yá jīla ɛɛ́. Ami wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí ádā um á. N kē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ɛga o gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɛ̄gbā ā gwó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: É hútu iyāwu kú uwā ŋmá ɔ́da nɛ̄ Óndú ā je bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le yá kú aá le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ācojéeyi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á. Anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī alɔ wā ipú ɛma okpaakpa mla Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ō lɛ alɔ fūla, kwú alɔ pīya ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abāābɔ̄yīnū á.

eng_Latn: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā géē je oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā nya ɔcí odūngwɔ̄wɛ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā mɛ́mla ɛhícō kú Okómpinu ɔwɛ kú inu nēé lé ɛbɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú odúúdú ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ó má ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla ákú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú iyō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā ú kpó ga Usamérīya. Ó klla le ācɛ ā kpó kwú kéē wɛ aálagbá kú ɛfú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umahālálɛ̄ɛlu wɛ iháyí ofɛtá ce ɛhɔ̄ ā, ó le ɔyīnɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ nōo lé ka Ujárɛ̄ɛdi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔyí um, a yɔ̄ mla um eko dóódu, ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ákú um ā kē wɛ ákú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú Ācɛ Ufárisīi nēe bá abɔ́ɔ mla anú ā le ɛlā nyā pó. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ peyī dúú nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ugása bá gē yá ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ kú Áskɛ̄lɔn í kē mókónu kɛlā ŋ́. Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilítiya nēe hile ā géē yēkwu gáā kwu āa?.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bī ɔnyā ā wā í háyi iyɔbū ede kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɛ̄nyā ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá í ka ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Ɔ̄cɛ ōhī ī ka kahíníī, N gē yɛce Upɔ́lu. Ācɛ ɔhá kē ī ka kahíníī, N gē yɛce Apólɔsi. Ācɛ ɔhá gē ka kahíníī, N gē yɛce Upíta. Ācɛ ɔhá klla gē ka kahíníī, N gē yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ɛyí kú ɔ̄na ā lɛ alɔ lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó kē le yá kpɛ́mm á. A le um cīgbīhi wā āhɔ̄ kú um, anɔ́ɔ é kē le otrɛ̄yí kú ācōyíigbō ā tū olī á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū éyi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Unáaman kwú cɔ̄nū klla nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō da iyī nū kahíníī, N gbɛlá ka ó géē wā gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū um, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ iyē kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū hī, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū ma um iyē, ɛgiyí agwú kú um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká agwú kú um ā kóō mɛ nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
idu_Latn: É da um kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ gwōkónu, nɛ̄ á cēē má alɔ ŋ́ mā mɛ́ɛ̄? Alɔ yéyīnyinyi í cēē lé ɔdōlé ŋ́, nááná á cēē lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́. N gē tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo yá ā wɛ ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá ī gwōkónu ā, aá gē yá ɔdā nōo he aá ɔtū ā. Aá klla í lɛ abɔ̄ da ācoyúklɔ́ lɛ aá ɛyí tū ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́ kē yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá. Ɔfú mɛ́mla ɔhi le mu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū.

eng_Latn: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé mā uwā tá ipú ajɛ ā, wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ukénan, Usídɔn, mɛ́mla Uhám nēe lā ikpɛ́fu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn, oŋmá ɛfu kú Ubaalu Uhámɔn jāā kwu Uhamát ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le tútū ō kɛpɔ̄ tū aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó kpɛ́lācē uwá kahíníī, Aá je ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú um yíífi á. Aá klla le ɔlɛ́ aá tū mu mɛ́mla aíyó nɛ̄ aá kpó wu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aógbɛhá ā.

eng_Latn: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É le ayí kú Ulífāyi aɔ́mpa uwā túbá. Anɔ́ɔ é le īyī uwā mɛ́mla odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá iye gwu á. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ da uwá kéē yá ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō yá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tīihɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú íne kú Óndú ā, kéē yá ɔ̄ tīihɔ eko nēé le ɔ́ nyílá ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
idu_Latn: É géē bī aɔ́dā o tū ɛgahi mɛ́mla agbénú kú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā wā ipú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā tá áncā, ajɛ ā yɔ́tūnōbí ohígbū ka é kwú igwu ā ú kpó yíífi, ɔcí ufáyin kwú ŋmɔ́lá, ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ā kwú ŋmɔ́lá ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē gɔ́ uwɔ abɔ̄, awɔ ɔdɔ nēé bī áfū le púla anú! Awɔ cīce ká ā hɛ́pɔ̄ kú um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ā lɛ ā, nááná a le íne bīya abɔ̄ a le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ um ā.

eng_Latn: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, abɔ̄ Óndú ā yíhɔtū tá uwā nōó klla dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ ɛka nōó gbo mla ádáádā uwā tū ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū nya uwá tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ ipú abɔ̄ kú Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú ācɛ Ugɛ́bālu. Odúúdú ajɛ kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, mɛ́mla ajɛ nōo ŋmá Ubaalgádi, nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Uhɛ́mɔn ga Uhámati ā.

eng_Latn: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔnyā ā kóō háyi okómpīinu abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ gē wā í dɔɔ̄kā ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō da ɔ́ ka ehée.

eng_Latn: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnya ɔhá nōo wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá yōō gā ɛcɛ á. É kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nɛ̄hi éyi ú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɔnya ā, lɛ íkwu je lɛ ɔ́ kóō kwú ɛbɔ́ ú ŋmá ɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kpɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ŋmó ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ebilíi ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a ŋmá? Ebilíi tá Ɔwɔicō ohi kahíníī, N wā ŋmá ō yɔ̄ í yɛ ga ajɛ gicō ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
idu_Latn: Ó le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ lɛ Ujémīsi, igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā ó lɛ iyī nū mafú lɛ odúúdú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú ɛdɔ kú ācohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lɛ ā ú kpó ce lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ eko aflɛ́yí ā. Igbīhāajɛ ā, é géē hī aá ka ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō lɛ ɔ́ gwēyī ŋ́. Aá tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kóō yɛ gɔbū ipú iyāwu kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gā ɛgiyí um ɛbɔ́ ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ī leyī tɔ́ɔwɛ kú anú mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ ohile kéē pīyɛyí.

eng_Latn: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó jíkpó ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ó kē nya mla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníī, Lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ kpó, káā nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Ái. Aá híī yúufi ācɛ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū ge gbenyi lɛ aá ŋ́. N géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá í yá ɔcɛ́ kú uwā lé ɔgbɛ́fú. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú nū mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū géē je pīya ákú aá.

eng_Latn: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ubárāki, ɔyí kú Abínōwam nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ukɛ́dɛssi, ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu je ɔ́da nyā gā uwɔ á. Lɛ ācɛ úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu kú Utábɔ.

eng_Latn: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le Uhádādēsa, ɔyínɔ̄yīlɔ kú Uréhɔ̄bu, ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ Usóba ipú ajɛ kú Usiríya yálé, abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ajɛ ɛhícō kú ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi tābɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, gē bī okónu kú nū je ɔ́mpa nū yíífi. Amáŋ íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé kú ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa gē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhána da Ɛ́lāyi ka ɔkpani ɔ́ɔ blakwu anúɔ ɛ́ɛ̄? Ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ wɛ ɔnyā nɔ́ɔ má abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā lé jīla tɔ̄há ā, é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, a géē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kwúcē gé lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu eko nyā āa.

eng_Latn: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔya ɔ́migwó kú iháyí ɔ́mahāanɛ nēé kpó alɔ abɔ̄fú ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú le ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
idu_Latn: O yá ɔda olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā okpaakpa ā, he Óndú ɔtū fíyɛ́ ō gaá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē pɛ́ uwɔ ā lɛ uwɔ bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ wā ɔtāhɛ̄ ísu ā, owu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kwú uwɔ ú gbayibó ɛga nōo ligbó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā bá ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu uwɔ mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu aɔ́mpa uwɔ nēe bá ipú ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, Ubábīlɔn ā. É gē ka ka, Ācɛ nɛ̄ bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā le ligbó fíyɛ́ ɔdā nēé ī gbā Óndú ɛgbā. Ó kwú ajɛ nyā ú lɛ alɔ kú ɔ wɛ ákú alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, é gaá lā ipú alácɛ̄ kú Abarím ipú ígbíli kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ajɛ kú ācɛ Umówābu.

eng_Latn: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, n da aá ka aá cɛ̄ lɛ ikpó ká aá kóō le kpó plla, kú ipú ɔkɔ ká aá kóō le ŋmó flōflō ŋmá lɛ inya nɛ̄ aá bá ī kwu tíicō ga ajɛ yɔ̄ ī tíne ɛcí nɛ̄ aá ī pā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá tá kahíníī, Ehé! Alɔ í cīgbīhi glá gɛ ŋ́. Aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aéwɔhá gē pā he alɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Alɔ í yɔ̄ ī pā uwā.

eng_Latn: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi gā Unɔ́bu ɛgiyí Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛyá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki wā í jīla Udéfīdi ɔwɛ yɔ̄ ī fīyēgbúlú, yɔ̄ ī da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ gē yɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɛ mla awɔ ŋ́ má ā.

eng_Latn: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī páhɔ̄ ayíkā ō pó ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ācɛ nēe yúklɔ́ kú ijē ōgwó nyā bá á: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhati: Otrɛ̄yí kú uwā wɛ Uhɛ́mān, ɔyí kú Ujówɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɛma kú uwā yɛ jāā gaá kwu Ujékɔ̄pu ā.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ɛlā lɛyíwu ɔwɔ o hɛ́ɛnɔ nɛ̄hi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
idu_Latn: Eko tɛtɛ ā, ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, é gē hī ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka omɛ́ɛbɛ. Eko dúú nēé tíne ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ, é gē kahíníī, Wā kú ālɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí omɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā aá le um jámá, nááná nēé lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá lɛ uwá ā má ā.

eng_Latn: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ugíbiyɔn ɛga nɛ̄ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ yɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gā Ujerúsālɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ ó gē gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cí ufáyin le ŋmɔ́lá ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ejé kē gbɔɔ́ ō ŋá ɛɛ́. Ɔtū í klla he ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔtū tɛtɛ he ɔ̄ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ka ka anúɔ jé ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aíne kú nū tū ŋ́ mā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi dúúmā ipú ɔtū kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n lɛ úklɔ́ kú um yá kwɛyí, aá géē yá aólɛlā kú aá lé. É kē í je pīya bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá nɛ̄ aá lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá ce ohɛ́ɛpa kú ɛ̄cī éyi le yá ā, owu kú oyēeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō le tá ipú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é nyāŋjɛ háyicō ā. Ufi le odúúdú ācɛ nēe má uwa ā kwú.

eng_Latn: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī gbō aójibó kú ɛcí nēé tū ile ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā ā, kwúcē ŋmá ō ɛyí ō le táajɛ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
idu_Latn: Uwá le bēhé ɛjī ga ba í gbo iyēɔlā Ugɛ́ba. Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Iráma a kwú gbogodo ipu ufi ɛɛ́. Ācɛ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ugíbɛ̄-a, ɔlɛ kú Usɔ́ɔlu ɔcɛ́ a kwú pɛ́ kwu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, ācɛ kú Ámɔn nyɔ̄ gáā kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ o ŋmá ɔ́kíkā éyi kú ɛcɛ ā ga ɔ́kíkā ɔhá ā ɛ́ɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ka ɛga dóódu, ācɛ ɛ́ɛ gē fú ɔtulalī tū ɔlá lɛ anúɔ, ɛ́ɛ klla gē gwɛ́ɛya ɛdɔ ɛya nēe he anúɔ ɔtū ā lɛ anúɔ. Odúúdú ūwā ɛ́ɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
idu_Latn: Éwo dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā í gē ma ɔdā nōo géē bī ācɛ jé ɔwɛ ā, fú lɛ uwá ŋ́, ācɛ géē bá ī hábɔ̄ ga ɛga dúú nōo he uwá ɔtū. Amáŋ ɔhā yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ íne kú Óndú ā tū.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer unto Ashdod.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufílīstiya mīyɛ ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, é kwu ɔ̄ ú ŋmá Ebɛnésa gaá háyi ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā nēé hī ka Ássīdɔdu ā.

eng_Latn: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce ga uwɔ nyā tū lɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí kú uwɔ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, kóō wɛ okónu ō ce nōo géē yɔ̄ piyóó. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú ayááyí kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ ɔ̄kā da bá ɔnyā ā iyē. Anɔ́ɔ é wā í le da ɔ́ ka ɔnyā ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ubatissɛ́ba, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ɛlíyam, nōo wɛ ɔnyā kú Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ kú Uhɛ́ti ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o cījáalí nōo lɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka, gē nya oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi tá, eko dúú nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka. Eko nɛ̄ ó kē lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā, ó le ībīyājɛ yá tū ācɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
idu_Latn: N gē yá olɔhi lɛ uwá, amáŋ obɔ̄bí nēé bī le cíla um ulé á. N gē yíihɔtū tá uwā, amáŋ é ī wɔ́tū um.

eng_Latn: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
idu_Latn: Ó jé ile kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā, ó kē ī yúklɔ́ jāā gbó otú.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da uwā kahíníī, Aá lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ kú aá kpó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē je ɔdōlé kwɛyí nū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́fu ā kē í je ja wā ɛháajɛ ikpó kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔja nōo tá ipú ɔlá ā. É kē í pɛ́ wā aɔ́pɛ́ kú ɛfu ā bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu wāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugád ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō híī lé ɛbɛ́ dúúmā nēé fu oyī kú nū bónū ŋmá anú ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Aá híī yúklɔ́ imabɔ̄ ɛ́dɔ dúúmā ka ɔhɛ ō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ipú ɔ̄na ó le ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Ananíyāsi ā má abɔ̄ ó bēhé gáā le abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō klla lɔfú mɛ́ɛbɛ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla iyī uwā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ipú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ ícɛ nyā ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká aá le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ ā, abɔ̄ kú um í yɔ̄ ipú oyī kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníi, N géē je Ujérīko mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ olɔtū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
idu_Latn: Ádā, ɛnyā wɛ ɔdā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó yɔ̄ ɛcɛ nɛɛ, ó gáā wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya fúlufúlu ŋ́, ohígbū ipú ɛcɛ amānyá, é gē fu ācogwɛ́ɛya kéē gwɛ́ɛya o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klla da um ka n̄ lɛ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka ācɛ kú igelī kú nū géē gbagbénú nɛ̄hi klla í jɛ̄ gicō kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ka anúɔ í fu Ujerúsālɛm kɔ́ɔ̄ wɛ igelī kú anúɔ kpɔ́ klla í tá ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔtū lé.

eng_Latn: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ a le ɔ́da nyā je klla le ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpá, le eliká kú nū nɛ̄ ó ī bá ɔkpá plla ŋmá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ Uháman ɔyí kú Uhamedáta, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ágāgi, olɛlā kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā.

eng_Latn: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
idu_Latn: Ébram le gwutá mla Uhága, anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ á. Eko nōó le má ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ipú ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ, klla le eyī gwū Usárāyi, ɛ́nɔ́lɛ́ nū, bónū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Kwú ede kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí nū ā ú haajɛ iyɔ̄bū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami, nɛ̄ iyē um lé ka Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē nya uwá tá. N kē lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ami abɔ̄yī um géē cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ uwā. N klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɛbɔ́ yɔ̄ odúúdú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā kpɔ́. Amáŋ n géē bī unwalu gé lɛ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Kwu ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, nōo gē le okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōo gē yɛ ɔwɛ kú íne kú nū kpaakpa mla ɔtū ékpónú ā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le má ka ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá gɛ ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛ̄gba dā kahíníī, Ukpɛ̄ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udɛ́fīdi gɛ? Alɔ í lɛ úgwū dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí ayí kú Ujése ŋ́. Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō yáwaa ga ɔlɛ́ nū ooo. Ayí kú Udɛ́fīdi, aá leyīkwu ipú inū kú aá ooo. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nɛ̄ n gē jikwū klá uwɔ á. Ohígbū ka odúúdú ácí mɛ́mla ɔcí kwú kpó ŋmɔ́lá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔlá je uwá kpó yi tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, We give thee thanks, O LORD God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
idu_Latn: É kahíníī, Alɔ tá uwɔ ahínyá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Awɔ yɔ̄ abālɔbányā, awɔ kē tɛtɛ hímáyī yɔ̄ á! Ahínyá,ohígbū ka a bī íkwu nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, wā gaá cɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm le da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ka ɛ́ɛ̄ leyī táajɛ eko nɛ̄ Ámnɔn ɔ́ɔ lɛ ejé gwá nɛ̄hi. Ó le lɛ ā eko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔ́da je, ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ híī yúúfi ŋ́, ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛfiyɛ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í je Alelékwū lɛ aá klla yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó ɔtāhɛ̄ ohígbū ka aá le ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ā yá ŋ́, ikɔɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó je Alelékwū lɛ aá klla yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó ɔtāhɛ aá ohígbū ka aá le Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā pó klla mīyɛ ɔ́ cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ohi kú iyāwu kú uwá pó ā, ipú kú uwā le nū, anɔ́ɔ é le cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō á. É klla gbɛlá ō nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla ācɛ Umanásɛ nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kéē je ajɛ kú uwá yíífi ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cojéeyī ā tíne ɛlá ō tɔ́tūlé, amáŋ ɛlā nōó tá tāajɛ ā wɛ ɛlā ɔwɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mafú kéē gē je ācɛ nēe pɛ́ kwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ɛga nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpíihɔ lɛyíkwu ɔlá nōo cɛyí ácí amáŋ nōó kē yi ácí ā ŋ́ mā, ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí ádā uwā ā, ó le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá wā fíyaa ícɛ yɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
idu_Latn: Anú fu ajɛ nɛ̄ alɔ lá anú nyā lɛ alɔ á. Alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
idu_Latn: Yá ká ɔtū ká o he ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā nēe ma uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
idu_Latn: Ó má ɔ́kɔ ɛpa nēé pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ bá okónu okpoó ā, ɔ́kɔ ā táŋca ohígbū ka aóndú uwā bá gē na ɛ́yá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu ipú úláyi ā, é bá ī kɛlā kú um, ācɛ nɛ̄ ejé kwú ā klla bá gē tū um ijē.

eng_Latn: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ipú yɔ̄ kpɔ́, le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá ma. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Igbɛ́ɛ̄nyā ā n géē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Ujúda Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ma ɔyí ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
idu_Latn: Óndú nɛ̄ n lɔtūce ɔ́ kóō gbō um á. Ɔdíyá nāa gē da um kahíníī, Le kwu ga ɛyí aɛ́fu bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
idu_Latn: Da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔdā nāa yá ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ hídáagó nɛ̄hi. Abɔ̄ kú uwɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, aólɛlā kú uwɔ bá ī yúufi ī túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwú ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ohile ā í kpó kwúcē ga ɛga nēé gē bá ā. Ɔcɛ́ ā le Umɔ́dɛkāyi fu kóō wɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó gē nyɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgīyī Userúbābɛlu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā, gaá da uwá kahíníī, Alɔ wā gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mla aá dúú. Alɔ mɛ́mla aá gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ékpónú ɛ̄gbā á. Alɔ kē húmáyī í gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā dúú ŋmíífī nɛ̄ Esahádɔn, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya kpó alɔ wā í lā amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
idu_Latn: Oyī kú uwɔ géē pɛ́ klá ɛfu ga ɔpɛ́ jāā gbéeko nōo kwú cēenyi tū ipú aɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
idu_Latn: Oyī kú uwā géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ŋmá ɔkɔ́ kú ɔyī kú um wāajɛ. N géē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um le ŋmó odúúdú ācɛ, nēe gē bɛyíkwu um ā. Ń gáā mā ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī bɛyíkwu um tá ŋ́. Kwu ācɛ nēé yá ágbe mɛ́mla aálagbá kú ɛfú ā géē pɛ́ kwú dúú.

eng_Latn: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le wú Ujóna nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le cɔ̄nū á.

eng_Latn: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā é lɛ ojibó éyi ma bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛna ā, anɔ́ɔ é gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ojibó ā, bá ī yá ucɛ ī gwéeyē lɛ ɔdā nēé bī abɔ̄ kú uwā ma ā á.

eng_Latn: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ī ka kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄! ó yɔ̄ amānyā ŋ́! amáŋ Ó yɔ̄ ánūmā ŋ́. Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ ipú aá.

eng_Latn: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya gaá le īkpīije ā kpó yā ŋmá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ó cíkā kéē je ijē nyā tá ɛga nēé gē lɛ ije tū ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka íne kú alɔ í cɛ̄ ŋ, abɔ̄ ó wɛ ɔ́lá kú oyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka é pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē ka ā. Da uwá ka n géē kɛlā lɛ aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā, klla lɛ aɔ́glɔ́ ā mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́ ā. Ka n géē tū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī éyi ɛhɔ̄ wā í je ɛga dóódu kú uwā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē pā ɛcí anú ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, da ɔ̄cɛ̄nyā ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a yá ɛ̄nyā āa? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kahíníī, Ɛgwā ā plla um tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄ n lé á.

eng_Latn: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ í gáā yúúfi, klla cɛ̄tra iyē kú uwɔ ŋ mā, Óndú? Awɔ ōfōōfūwɔ tīihɔ ā. Odúúdú aéwo ā géē wā í gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā, ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ má úklɔ́ okpaakpa kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
idu_Latn: Umíssmána, Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē má ɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí kú ufáyin kú Unábɔ̄tu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má ɔ́mpānū, ɛ́ɛ́ nē é ī mɛ́ɛbɛ cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛga nē é bá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ā gēdēē.

eng_Latn: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ukéni nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, gaá lā ajɛ kú Unɔ́du, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ídɛn á.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ, kwú ipoto kú uwɔ ú ká ā yāwu.

eng_Latn: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛhíícō kú nū géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛjī kú Umeditarénīya ā ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ru.

eng_Latn: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ulɔ́tu le ufi yá ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Usówa, gaá lā ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
idu_Latn: N gē tá aɔ́cɛ́ abɔ̄ kéē gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwā. N klla kē ī tá aógbāajɛ abɔ̄ kē tū aíne olɔhi.

eng_Latn: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
idu_Latn: Aá kē wā ɛgiyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ glá ā ŋ́, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔlá yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄, ɛga odobū, ɛga nɛ̄ ofúlutu gē tá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yá eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī je íne lɛ uwá ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Á gaá kpó uwā ŋmó ŋ́. A géē ŋmó ācɛ nāa kwú oyēeyī nēe kwú pīya aálagbá kú ɛfú nɛɛ? Lɛ ɔdōlé je lɛ uwá kéē lé, káā klla je odée lɛ uwá kéē gwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē igbīhi ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá odúúdú ɛgbá kú ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā, ó gē pó ɔkɔ nēé gē gbā, ó kē gē nya uwá tá.

eng_Latn: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, aá cāŋjɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú lɔfú tīyē igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, igelī kú Ɔwɔicō ā, aá kwú īlī kú aá nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā í kpó wiiyē. Aílɔ́wá nēe wā í nyíla ɔlɛ́ ā í gáā bēhé wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ aá wā í junwalu lɛ aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū alɔ. Alɔ jé péee ka ɔtū kú alɔ í ŋmá alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, ohígbū ka alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi nwū Ɛ́sta lɛ ā, ó ka lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́maháanɛ ā wɛ Umatánīya.

eng_Latn: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ n gē lɛ abɔ̄ pi uwɔ ahɔ̄, n gē tū uwɔ ukɔ́ olɔhi ká ā lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdōōjé kú um lɛ.

eng_Latn: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ nōo límanya iyɔ̄bū nū ā tá ahɔ̄lá wɛ̄ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū nū kátáá.

eng_Latn: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yíimabɔ̄ kú Íjīpiti ā í hayi iyɔ̄bū Umósīsi glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ipí ínálēgbé ā. Ohígbū ka ínálēgbé ā ce uwá abɔ̄yī uwā dúú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ce odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
idu_Latn: Unátan da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ tíne kóō lɛ oyēeyī kú anú mɛ́mla ákú ɔyí nū Usólōmɔn nyatá, ayíka ɔ́ɔ wā ká anúɔ lɛ ɛlā nwū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nēé háyi igbīhi mɛ́mla aálá ā? Kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ācogbāálá abɔ̄ é gē hī aálá igwú nɛɛ? Urúbɛ̄n le kɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi, é jé ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ kéē géē wā, ámāŋ nēé gáā wā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɛdɔ ɔcí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ipú ígbíli. Kwu aɔ́cí nēé ī hī ka usɛ́da, akésīya, umɛ́tu mɛ́mla ólīifu ā. Ajɛ ikpākplā ɔ́ɔmā géē je pīya ūpū, nɛ̄ aɔ́cí nēé hī ka usáyīprɛsi, ujúnīpa mɛ́mla upáyin ā géē jɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ owu kú uwā mɛ, é kwúcē ga ipú ajɛ, ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ojuju kú uwā dóódu mɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
idu_Latn: Aá yɛ í bēhé ga ipú igelī kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, gaá yá uwā okónu ɛ̄cī nēé bá yɔ̄ ī móōwē ā ŋ́, aá yɛ í mīyɛ agbénú kú uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu abɔ̄fú, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ufu cē uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū lɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔdā ō je lɛ ācɛ ámāŋ ka aɛ́bɛ́ kú úklɔ́ nēé yá í kōō yɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ŋmá aólɛlā kú nū gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kéē lɛyí gbɛyí mla ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā da ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, N géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ aá, kē í yá ka aólɛlā kú aá kéē cílá ulé kú ɔdā dóódu nēé yá aá ā. N gēe je ísu mɛ́mla aɔ́kpá kú Ubábīlɔn dóódu ā kpo ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko gē wā, eko ā kē gā ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ ācɛ nōo géē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɔkwɛ̄yi géē gbā Ádā ā ɛ̄gbā ipú alelékwū mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ohígbū ka Ádā ā gē dɔɔ̄kā ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í klla gáā tá uwā abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá, abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í gbā aɔ́wɔ kú aéwɔhá ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā, jāā ga ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ kú ucɛ ā, é bā í jé āyā éyi kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī dóódu. É lé ucɛ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, é le túbá tɔ̄há le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipú ɔkpá kú íne kéē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ Ahíkam, ɔyí kú Ussafán le ɛpɔ̄ Ujeremíya cɛ̄ ā, é je Ujeremíya lɛ ācɛ ā kéē ŋmó ɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
idu_Latn: N le abɔ̄ kú um nā daa, kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō tá um abɔ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́. Óndú ā le aálajógbe kú um piíí ā pīya aólɛlā kú um, ó klla le uwá tū kla um, ŋmá ɔ́kíkā dóódu. Aólɛlā kú um ā gē yá um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ um le tēelihɔ iyē ā, nēé lɛ abɔ̄ kwu um glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu aótrɛ̄yí kú aá nēe kɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá ā. Aá gbɛlá kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yēeyī klla kwú lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é kpɔ́tū Ɔwɔīcō lɛ ā yá.

eng_Latn: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unátan da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, a le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Adónīja kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí uwɔ ɛɛ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
idu_Latn: Kwú um ú bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú agbá nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tá uwɔ ahínyá. Ācɛ okpaakpa ā, kéē cɛ̄tra awɔ tɔ̄há mla um, ohígbū ka a le ɔdā olɔhi yá gā um.

eng_Latn: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tá Ɛláyíja ohi kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, ń le jé ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, Óndú kē ī kɛlā bū okónu kú uwɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó ā mɛ, é géē hɛ́ Usétan tá ŋmá agbá.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá le nyíleyī ohígbū ka aá jé ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī jé ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
idu_Latn: O gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ gwá ejé cābɔ̄ bá ŋ́, ó híī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdā abɔ̄fú ŋ́, amáŋ ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ogbonɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɔ́. Ó gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o héyīfuúfuú kú ije ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō yá uwēyī ohígbū aɔ́dā īcíci nɛ̄hi nēé yá ā. Amáŋ é yá uwēyī dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō jé ɛyí ō le kwū ajɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ohile nēe géē kwú ā. Eko nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā italā ā, n géē kpó uwā yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú kwú ɔdā ō ɔdōōcabɔ̄ kú ɛ́kplá nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ ā ú kwúcē, ámāŋ kwú ɔdā nōo je uwī ā ú kwúcē igbīhi, nōo mā ɔ́bíipú kú nū tá klla yɔ̄ ī yɛce íne nɛ̄ n je, nōo gē je oyēeyī ā. Ó lɛ ā, ó gáā kwú ŋ́ amáŋ ó géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
idu_Latn: Umerí Umagdalíni, mɛ́mla Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu, mɛ́mla ɔnyā kú Usébēdi, nōo wɛ ɛnɛ kú Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
idu_Latn: Urebéka yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ abɔ́ɔ á, kwú ɔ̄ ú ká ā nyɔ̄. Kóō wɛ ɔnyā kú ɔyí ɔkpani uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu le ádā nū nyi kwɛyí ā, ó pīyɛyí wā Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ ɛyíkwū kú ádā nū mɛ́mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éwɔhá dúúmā nōo lā ɛga oligbó, lɛ ónwuné mɛ́mla ofāajɛ kú iyē kú uwɔ pó, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛlá gbo ka, eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, klla gē lé ucɛ iháyí dóódu Ussílo ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wā eko kpií ā.

eng_Latn: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā ka kwɛyí ā, ó je eyī gicō leyī pīya kwu ɔkpáncō anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ádā, eko ā gā ɛɛ́, le mafú lɛ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ wɛ idáagó lɛ āa, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɔfú mafú lɛ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a wɛ idáagó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū le he um. Óndú, ohígbū ɔdā nāa yá ā, n géē yɔ̄ í gwíijē kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
idu_Latn: Aá géē hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin tá ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Usamérīya kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Aɔ́glɛ́ɛjí nēe nyi īkpō ufáyin tū aɛ́hɔ̄ ā kē í wɛ ācɛ nēe ī lé īkpɔ̄cí ā á.

eng_Latn: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu anyākwɔ́cɛ ahāanɛ ā, Ɛlíyēsa, Aríyɛlu, Ussɛmáya, Ɛlinátan, Ujárību, Ɛlinátan, Unátan, Usekaríya mɛ́mla Uméssūlam mɛ́mla aítíca ɛpa. Iyē kú uwā lé ka, Ujóyārību mɛ́mla Ɛlinátan.

eng_Latn: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ gē gbēyī Ɔwɔicō ka o lɛ ayí nū mafú.

eng_Latn: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka, abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ aádā aá jé um má, nááná nēé le ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá iháyí ofɛpa ā má āa.

eng_Latn: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
idu_Latn: N lɛ okónu kú um nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔkpá ā ú ga um ká n lé á.

eng_Latn: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa klla ī yēŋēē ā, he Óndú ɔtū á. Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā gē má ihɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ lɛ uwá ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Ulásārɔ̄si, gā ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ kú aá híīī je eko kú aá táajɛ lɛ o yɔ̄ ī lé ucɛ mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ī gwá ejé mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu unwalu kú oyeeyi ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā ŋ́ ɛ̄cī ā géē wā eko nɛ̄ aá leyīce ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
idu_Latn: Itíca, íne nyá cɛ́gbá fíyɛ́ odúúdú aíne āa.

eng_Latn: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō, aá kahíníī, Ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ kú Ubénjamin le pɛ́ ŋmá odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā, wā í le túbá Ugíbɛya cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā.

eng_Latn: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n géē nwū aá ɛlā kú íjééyī nɛ̄ odúúmā kú aólɛlā kú aá í kōō gáā táafú ámāŋ má ɔkɔ ka mla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
idu_Latn: A híī kpéko bónū ká ā hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēé bī nyɔ̄ gáā ŋmó icííci tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē tíne nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú alɔ yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíyē kú alɔ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ í gáā yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē í gáā klá alɔ iyē ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ kú um dúúmā nōó gwá īkpō ŋ́, ó géē gwó ɔ̄ tónū, abɔ̄ dúúmā nōo ī gwá īkpō, ó géē tá ɔ̄ hɛ́ yēŋēē kóō gwá īkpō fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ wā gaá kpɛ́fú, Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ukénan wā í kpɛ́fú Utáanāki, nōo yɔ̄ pī ɔkpá kú Umegído ā. Amáŋ é je oje nɛ̄hɛ́ dúúmā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yá ɔ̄cɛ italā á, lɛ ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ mafú.

eng_Latn: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
idu_Latn: Ísu dóódu gē pɛ́ ga ipú ítekwú, amáŋ ítekwu í kē mu ŋ́. Ó klla gē pé kwúcē ga ɛga nōó ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Unátan kwú anɔ̄ ú tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ njɔɔlɔ kú ga Ugíhɔn á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
idu_Latn: Aá kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi eko dóódu únɛ́pɔ̄ eko nēé yɔ̄ ī hɛ́pɔ̄, ó kōō wɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ, bá gē cīijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nááná, aá híī wɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
idu_Latn: É gē kɛlā obíipú lɛyíkwu uwɔ, é klla ī ka ucē obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu iyē kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é kahíníī, Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá gē dɔɔ̄kā awɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē cɔcɛ́ gē gbō éŋkpɔ̄ ō cēnyi klá ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi á. Ó cɔcɛ́ gē gbō odúúdú ācɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ujabín, ɔcɛ́ kú Ukénan nōo gē gbō Uhásɔ ā kóō lɛ uwá yálé. Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujábín lé ka Usisɛ́ra, nōo lā Uharōssɛt-hagoyím ā.

eng_Latn: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Ujɛhówāsi, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóhāsi lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Amásīya ɔyí kú Ujówāsi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé dúú.

eng_Latn: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
idu_Latn: Náána nɛ̄ ń yɔ̄ mla aá abɔ̄yī um ŋ́ mā, alelékwū kú um yɔ̄ mla aá, bɔ̄ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ā. N bī iyē kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū wu ōyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔ́ kwu aájī nēe kwu ɔ́kíkā kú ede ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú oyī ohile ā ú pīya tū ɔkwu kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi cɛ̄ ɛlā nēé ka ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā ɛga olɔhi nōó géē yíbīyājɛ tū Ujísɔ̄si lɛ uwá wɛɛlɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ í gáā jɔ́ɔkwu nū ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
idu_Latn: Alɛɛcɛ ohile ā nɛ̄ aɔ́dā ámíyā nɛ̄hi ɛtá nēe bá ā í kpó ŋmó ŋ́ mā, tá ō mabɔ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá ā tá. É pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɛ̄gbā ō gbā aébilíi, mɛ́mla aɛ́cí nēé yá aójibó kú uwā ŋmá ugóolu, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje udɔ, ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí ā. Aɔ́dée mbá ā í kē mɛɛbɛ glá ŋ́, é páhɔ̄ ŋ́, é kōō yāwu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
idu_Latn: Ádā ā le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔ́mpa ā. Ó gaá da ɔ́ ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔmā tóohi kahíníī, N géē nyɔ̄, ɔkpani. Amáŋ ó nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu kwú okwū ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ gbo īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ oyēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu, nāa ke lɔtūce íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā, nāa kē ī gwō ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā le yɛ gaá lɛ odúúdú ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujówābu tū fu Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ ɔ́da kú Usáyírɔ̄si, Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya á. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō ā, kwú um ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ó klla le úklɔ́ je gā um ka ami ɔ́ lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ anúɔ Ujerúsālɛm ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɛga ogbā ɛ̄gbā ā le ligbɔ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā nɛ̄, á kpó éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú uwā nyɔ̄ glá ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le tá Ukápānɔm, igelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ éyi kú Ugálīli gaá le ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nwū ācɛ ā ɛ̄cī usábāti.

eng_Latn: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
idu_Latn: Ije í gáā jɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá unwū kú ije ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ agbénú mla itene he ɔ́ ɔtū, ó gáā jē ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ dúú. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
idu_Latn: A kwú iyɔ́fú kú nū ú pīya ɔdīcííci, klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ yálé ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Íssbɔ̄ssɛti mīyɛ Umáyíkalu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔbá nū, Upáltīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Uláyiss ā.
