eng_Latn: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɛbɛ́ éyi yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ísu á. Ó lɛ ajī igwó mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí ahāapa. Ó lɛ ukata eyééye kwu aájī igwó kú nū ā. Iyē éyééyē nōo ī bīya iyē kú Ɔwɔicō bá éyééye kú aíkpɛ̄yí kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
idu_Latn: Ámram lɛ Ujókēbɛ̄di, ɔyínɛ́ kú ádā nū Ukɔ́hāti ā lɛ. Ó ma ayí ɛpa lɛ ɔ́. É wɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi. Ámram wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī ce igwáahāapa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú á.

eng_Latn: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
idu_Latn: Ayípācɛnyā nēé jé ācɛnyīlɔ ŋ́ mā wɛ úlā ofu ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɔfiyɛ le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí óndú nū, wā ɛgiyí uwā gaá tayínū, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī je ɔ́ nū cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí óndú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ó klla géē bī okóho ɛpa ámāŋ ka oklɛ́bɛ́tɛ ɛpa. Éyi wɛ ákú ɛya kú íne ō bīya, ɔhá ā kē wɛ ákú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn cɔcɛ́ ā, ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu bá ɛbɔ́ ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú uwā, gē hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ɔcí kú ufáyin mɛ́mla Ufígi kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɔlóhɔ́nyɛtá ékpó mla aá ipú opīyatɔhá mla Óndú ā. Aá le ojīlīmā ce odúúdú ācɛ nēe yá ɛdɔ kú ɔdā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ odée bī gé lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɛɛ mɛ́ ŋ́, nēé kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti nōo gbo alɔ iyē nɛɛ, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdōlé kpɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kpó alɔ ŋmó ipú ígbíli amānyā nɛɛ? A klla lɛ iyī uwɔ yá ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
idu_Latn: N tíne ká aá lɛ ɔ́ jé ayínɛ́ ka, ɔkōōlɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú nū ā í hútu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, Adónīja kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́, nááná nɛ̄ Ágábáidu í kē jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā Usámūwɛ̄lu yɔ̄ Ussílo yɔ̄ gē cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄. Ó gē le īlī ōgbō-ɛ́nyɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gbō ɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they remembered his words,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyā ā le blakwu ɛlā nōó ka ā á.

eng_Latn: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the LORD Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu ōhī nēe gē yɛ ɔlɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ gē nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ ā, tíne ō bī iyē kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si ā le yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú á. É gē ka lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā kahíníī, N je ɔ́da lɛ aá ŋmá iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu gē tɔ́ɔna nū ā.

eng_Latn: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o bī ɛnū hɛ́hɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔbā gē tá áncā, amáŋ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o hɛ́hɔ̄ olɔfú yɔ̄, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ gē le kpɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ odo kú aá pīyabɔ̄, ohígbū ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō le kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī géē cēyītīkwū kóō yá kú ɔtū kóō he ɔcɛ́, ohígbū ka, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le cɔ̄nū, ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú kwú glá.

eng_Latn: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
idu_Latn: Áyin, Ujúta, mɛ́mla Ubɛti Ussímɛ̄ssi, mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí kú uwā. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ahāanɛ nēé kpó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Usímiyɔ̄n á.

eng_Latn: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
idu_Latn: ka uwá nɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, tá ɔdā olɔhi ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aólɛlā kú uwā géē nū uwā inya.

eng_Latn: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ yēeyī ā. Amáŋ é gē yá aólíla italā ohígbū ucē íla kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ Ámɔn kpó yálé. Ujóssuwa le ɛlā ka lɛ Óndú ā ipéēyī kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɛnɔ, háyi cíí icō Ugíbeyɔn. Ɔyā háyi cíí ɔpɛ́ kú Áíjālɔn.

eng_Latn: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ohile ā gā ɛga aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā á. Ācɛ kú Óndú ā ga ɛgiyí nū, le tútū kéē kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi da ɔ́ kahíníī, A ī cījáalí lɛ iyī uwɔ, ijáalí kú wɔ í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Ujosíya le odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā yá le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tútū ā, Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó nyɔ̄ kéē gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ukákēmissi okónu ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya lɔfú tīiyē kóō lɛ uwá anú ci á.

eng_Latn: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ó le da alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā yá kú aá yíhɔtū tá alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
idu_Latn: Ācogbāálá kú Ugēra ā yíkpɛ́lā tū ācogbāálá kú ɔlɛ́ Áyísīki ka éŋkpɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú aá. Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki kwú iyē ú cē obugā ā kahíníī, Ɔdīkpɛ́lā.

eng_Latn: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu jīla aɔ́máapú kú Ahasíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ōhī ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ānyɛ nɛ̄ aá wɛ ā? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ɔmáapu kú Ahasíya, alɔ yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ga Ujésiríili gaá má Ujésēbɛ̄lu, ɔcányā mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, Ujóram mɛ́mla Áhābu.

eng_Latn: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nēé nwū aá ā. Aá jíjééyī, aá lɛ eyī gwō íjééyī bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni lɛ ā má ā, é klla le jé kéē jɔ́kpá ŋ́ klla kē wɛ aógwuda ā, é le kpó hídáagó. É le jé ɔkwɛ̄yi kú uwā tɛtɛ yɔ̄ pī Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá le pɛ́ gā ɔlɛ́ uwā á. Udéfīdi le tá ɔlɛ́ nū gaá mlɛ́nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dúú.

eng_Latn: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a bī odúúdú ɔtū kú uwɔ cɛ̄, ó géē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ glá. Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, N cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubíldāadi, ɔ̄cɛ Ussúwa ā tá Ujóbū ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi géē wɛ ɔŋgbá obī le miya odée kú ikpíinu ā á. Ɛcɔ̄ ɔwɔ géē je ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá kpɔtūce ɔ́ɔmā kpó gwubónū. Éŋkpɔ̄ ocēenyi nɛ̄hi klla í je ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ká ɔ́ɔ ī gbō aá catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ má. Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu ā, ó le um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū gē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ odo kú um á. Anú gē nya um tá á.

eng_Latn: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu le ɔ̄cɛ ā má bī ipoto kú nū ā, é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī usábāti, ó kē wɛ íne ō bīya ká ā bī ipoto kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ujúda le tíicō ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Woó, ɔkpani um, cɛ̄ kā n̄ lɛ ɛlā éyi ka gā uwɔ. Ɔtū kóō híī wú uwɔ lɛyíkwu um ŋ́, ohígbū ka a lɛbɛ̄ɛka Uféro ā abɔ̄yī nū nɛ.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gaá lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ayisáya á.

eng_Latn: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛhɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ á, Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í gáā yēeyī ŋ́. Amáŋ, ācɛ okpaakpa ā géē yēeyī, ohígbū ka é cɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī éyi lɔfú mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi éyi nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja bá anú nɛ̄hi, tābɔ̄ glá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔdɔ olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ ā, nēé kpɔ́tūce ā wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú ācɛ nēe gē yá uwɔ ŋmó ā, géē wā í túkpɛɛ́ ga awɔ, kéē lɛ ojīlīma ce uwɔ Odúúdú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ lɛ eyī gwó uwɔ bónū ā, géē wā í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. É géē hī uwɔ ka Igelī kú Óndú ā. Usáyɔn, nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uyáwe, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ pī um, kē ī tá um abɔ̄, n kē í yá aólɛlā nēe ī wɔ́tū um ā lé pií.

eng_Latn: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nōo í pɛ úgbéenyi ā gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, gbɔɔ́ ō je ikwū klá ɔwɔ kú uwā kóō tá uwā abɔ̄. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ jikwū klá ɔwɔ kú nū. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ka úgbéenyi ā kóō dēē cē fékéé ā, é lɛ iyó nēe bá ipú úgbéenyi ā kpó tá tū ipú éŋkpɔ̄. Amáŋ eko nyā ā, Ujóna le yɛ tá ɛháajɛ kú ipú úgbéenyi ā yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā lipú lipú.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo kē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdā nōó cīce anú ā, géē na īlī kú nū, klla í gwīiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Itekwú mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, kéē yúuya. Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū ā, aá gwíijē.

eng_Latn: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú ajɛ nōó lá ā ú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ámāŋ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um le ka ka, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā, n géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ nū italā.

eng_Latn: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ ó hī ayíkpó ā fu á. Ó da uwá kahíníī, N lɛ aá fu kú aá yɔ̄ mla um. N géē tū aá ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ kú aá nyɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi.

eng_Latn: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aólɛlā kú um kéē le jé, ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ nya um tá á.

eng_Latn: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō ce ɔ̄cɛ piyóó. Aamí.

eng_Latn: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɔdā dóódu lɔhi fíyɛ́ ohútú kú nū á. Ɔtōōlé mɛ́mla ogbēyī cíí, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔbɔ́cɛ ō yá á.

eng_Latn: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, kwú otú ɔ́ɔmā ú ŋmónyí ŋmá ipú aɛ́cī kú iháyí. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā kóō klla wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé gē gbaáluka tū ipú aɛ́cī gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā ā géē wā í kpɛ́fú tú Ubósra lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgɔ nōo ī wu fíyoo wā í je úgwū ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́dɔm ā géē bá ī yúúfi bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú é má odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā nōo wā í lɛ iyī nū kɔ̄ ce éyééye kú uwā ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
idu_Latn: Umósīsi wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbēyī cíí, klla tá iyī nū wāajɛ fíyɛ́ odúúdu ācɛ nēe lā ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi éyi ā géē da ācɛ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ka, Ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá gbā Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ Ujerúsālɛm, kóō lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce alɔ.

eng_Latn: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my God, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, Udánīyɛlu, nɛ̄ n lɛ īye kú ɔwɔ kú um, Ubɛtessása ce ɔ́ ā, gā ɛgiyí um. Anú nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tīihɔ ā yɔ̄ mla anú ā. Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔ̄na ā ka lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó um, ɔdā nōo ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā nēé gē je gā um á. Eko nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó um, ɔdā nōo le mákáká ā, nēé gē je gā um á.

eng_Latn: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í yá aílɔ́wá italā eko nē é le íne bīya, nááná nɛ̄ ó wɛ uwá nēé je íne kú Umósīsi lɛ uwā ŋ́ mā. Ɔwɔicō klla kē í bī íne ā le hɛ́pɔ̄ o lɔnɔ tū ācɛ Ujíyu eko nēé le íne bīya, ohígbū ka uwá nēé je íne ā lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: É géē bá ī gwéeyē klla bá ī gwíjē, amáŋ aá ā, ɔtū géē bīya lɛ aá nōo í yá kú aá géē bá ī jikwu.

eng_Latn: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ okónu ce mla Ébram kahíníī, N géē je ajɛ nyā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ísu kú Íjīpiti ā jāā ga ísu nɛ̄hi kú Uyúfrētīisi.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
idu_Latn: Wā, Óndú, wā í kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú um, ká ā lɛ uwá yálé. Bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwɔ, káā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
idu_Latn: É gbō uwɔ abɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nēé gbō uwɔ ikpó ŋ́, nááná ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ kē le uwɔ ŋmó. Ācɛ ā klla jikwū Ábna ɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ oyá ɔdōlɔhi ā bá gē kwú, ācɛ nōo le ɔtū tá ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā bá gē pékwú gbɔbū lɛ eko kú uwā icííci, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē jé ɛyí nū ŋ́. É ké yɔ̄ gē je ācɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā ŋmá ipú ōwē mɛ́mla ámíya.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá Umósīsi ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā ce ɔfú kú um abɔ̄ bá nɛɛ? Abālɔbányā, aá géē má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā géē yá jīla, ámāŋ koó gáā yá jīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gbɛlá ka, ó cíkā kéē hī Ɔwɔicō ɔdée ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú uwā ú lɛ ɔtū nōó ī gbɛlá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cíkā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é kē yá ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gáā lɛ ā gā agblɔ̄cɛ́ ɛɛ́. Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó jɔncɛ́nyā háyi mámlama klla héyīfuú ō má lɛ ā ɛ́! Owú kū ugóolu nēé bī le tá īlī kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Uféro í gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú úklɔ́ ōhídáagó kú um ā kóō le nyīla ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū kú olɛhɔ̄ kóō ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ wā ā, Uréhābu le ācɛ ɛpa ā kpó tayínū icō kú ɛyí inu ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛháajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó kpó ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ bá ā.

eng_Latn: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da Ugɛhási kahíníī, Kwú okwutɛ kú um, káā nyɔ̄ fíya. Ā māháyi ɔwɛ hókónu tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ okónu hɛ́ tū uwɔ, ā híī kpó eko bónū káā cɛ̄ okónu kú nū ŋ́. Nyɔ̄ bōōbū ga ipú inu ā, ká ā bī okwutɛ kú um ā kwu īkpɛ̄yí kú ɔyí ā.

eng_Latn: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō wɛ úgādā ɔcɛ́ kú um á, ɛcɛ wɛ uka ō lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ kú um. Inu nyá nɛ̄ ā géē gwó gā um ā, Óndú ā ka á, ámāŋ iní wɛ ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ́ kú um?.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
idu_Latn: Alɛwa kú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm. Eko nēé gā a, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ le tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú nū. Uwá mɛ́mla aíkonó kú uwá húmáyī í lā Ubábīlɔn ŋmá ífī nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó uwá abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka alagbá kú ɛfú ŋmá Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm gā abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the LORD, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
idu_Latn: Umerí Umagidalíni nyɔ̄ gaá le da ayíkpó ā kahíníī, N lɛ Óndú ā má ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka anú ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ɔdā nēe bá ā á.

eng_Latn: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
idu_Latn: amáŋ, eko nēé gaá lɛ ɛyí olɔnɔ lɛ ipú ɔ́hí obɔ̄bí éyi nēé tá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ agbénú ɔ́ɔmā kwú kpó yíífi, nēé klla má ɔdā dúúmā ō le tá ajɛ lɛ ayí uwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ kú oblatū nɛ̄ n le kwaajɛ nyā géē wɛ ɛga nēé géē gbō uwɔ ɛ̄gbā. N kē géē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ a kpó gā um ā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ukɔ́ nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tū uwā ā kpó ka lɛ Upíta mla aɔ́mpa nū á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū le uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kéē bī olɛhɔ̄ otīihɔ nōo ī nya ācɛ tá nōo gē je oyēeyī opiyoo lɛ ācɛ ā gaá ka lɛ alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́kpa kú ɔcí kú akésiya gbā lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāndaa lɛ ɔ́ pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔtū ō kpóce Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ nyɛ́ íbí. Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔtū bɛ́ɛpa āa.

eng_Latn: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Le tá gé lɛ Ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Usimɛ́ɛ́na ā ka ami nōo wɛ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ámōōmɛ, nōo gekwú klla le héyī kpɔ́ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
idu_Latn: Umíssma, Udúma, Umása, Uháda, Utéma.

eng_Latn: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, n lɔfú ō yá ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū mla aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ge yá mla ɔmɛ ā. Aá bá ipú abɔ̄ kú um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔmɛ gē yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó kwú ikpokwú ábáa kú ijakī ā ú tá tónū. Ɔdā nyā yá Urámati Uléhi.

eng_Latn: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá ɛyí ŋ́ mā, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ukrispɔ́si mɛ́mla Ugáyɔ̄si ōfōōfūuwā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔncɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka ɔbá nū tá ɔ̄. Amáŋ, Óndú ā lɛ uwɔ hīgwú cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí nū yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
idu_Latn: Uhadóram mɛ́mla Úsalu mɛ́mla Udíkla mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
idu_Latn: Ó kéē bla ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo le kpaakpa á. Kóō gē lɛ ɛka nōó gbo ā tū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla í yihɔtū opiyóó tū ayááyí ɔ́muúlúúlā kú ācɛ nēe yíhɔtū tá ɔ̄ klla lɛ aíne kú nū tū ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā lɛ okónu ce ga um iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, ka á gáā plla ami mɛ́mla ayípɛ́ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayááyí um ŋ́. N bī ɔtū okpaakpa yá ɛma mɛmla uwɔ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔkpá gbo ka a géē yá kpaakpa lɛyíkwu ami mɛ́mla ajɛ nɛ̄ a lā anú nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá aádáádā aá italā klla je igelī nɛ̄hi nyā yíífi ā yɔ̄ á. Aá klla bā í tíne kú Ɔwɔicō kóō cɔ̄nū mla alɔ, o ŋmá lɛ o nyíla Usábāti kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka eko géē wā nɛ̄ n géē yá mɛ́mla aɛ́cí kú Ubábīlɔn, klla í yá ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ágbe nɛ̄ é géē bá éē tíifu ɛbɛɛbɛ, ipu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ o tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú nū ŋmá ipú odo kú um ā wɛ ijáalí kú um ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɔwɔicō kē jé ka n yɔ̄ ī blakwu aá eko dóódu nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm ká n̄ ményinyi ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́. É géē tú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā gílayá, klla í tú igelī ā gwó kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
idu_Latn: ācɛ Udén mɛ́mla Ugríisi kpó oje ɔlamu ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī le cílá uwɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ācīije nyā lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin hi, ó lɛ igá cē tū ɔ̄ okokolo, ó lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ géē pí ejé ā bū ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā. Ó lɛ ɔda ce ipú nū lɛ adá gwó ce ɔ́. Ó kwú ɛhɔ̄ ā ú tá olufa lɛ ācɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá iyāwu á.

eng_Latn: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n ka tɛ́ɛcɛ aflɛ́yí lɛ ācɛ nēe bá Udamásikɔ̄si, n kē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujudíya. N ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú aílɔ́wá ā kéē pīyabɔ̄ kéē kwú eyī pīya tá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, kéē yúklɔ́ nōo géē mafú kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cohumɔtū, da um mɛ́ɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ a géē kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ nyɔ̄ í lúlé ícɛ ā. Iní nēé géē nyɔ̄ í mlɛ́nyɔ́ olɛ́ɛnɔ ā? Ká n híī yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ gē tíne uwɔ, ipú aálá kú ɔ̄cogbāálá ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda nēe lā Íjīpiti ā, aá pó oji nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā cē ā. N gbo īyī um ka ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá, ācɛ Ujúda nēe lā Íjīpiti ā, bī iyē kú um le cooji ɔhá gbóógbóō ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í gáā lɛ okónu hɛ́ ɔ̄ ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi géē ka kahíníī, É yá ɔdōlé lɛ ipú, ipú kē yɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōlé. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ ɛ̄cī éyi Ɔwɔicō géē bīya uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa tāajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ í cíkā ō bī ɔkpíyē kú nū le gbaajā ámāŋ bī ɔ̄ le cikpɔ́nyā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó cíkā ō bī ɔ̄ le cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄. Óndú ā gē bī ɔkpíye ā yúklɔ́ lɛ iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē kpɛ́fú gaá gwū Ujerúsālɛm. Ó ka anúɔ géē yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá klla í cīíbɔm tū ɔ̄. Ó ka anúɔ í ce ɔda bá ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā iyē gicō.

eng_Latn: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
idu_Latn: Ikoko ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nōo hile ā wɛ o yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ɛpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ipú ufi, mla ɔlá manya-manya nōo gē yi ācɛ nēe ī bɛ́yíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdée nēé le oje udɔ wúlá wúlá pla tū ipú nū ā yá, kwú ɔ̄ ú wu ɛháajɛ kú okónōgwu kú ede ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú o yɛ ga ɛhícō kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ gwutá ajɛ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yá ā, ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le abɔ̄ kwu ɔtū ka anúɔ géē je uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá ka tayínū ā, é géē pó ɔ̄ ɛcɛ gēdēē. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá ka tū iyī aá ahɔ̄ ipú inu ā, é géē bī ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna ŋmá ɛyí inu.

eng_Latn: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, Umérōdaku Ubaládan, ɔyí kú Ubaládan le pó ka, Uhɛsɛkíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gē doōcē, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkpá tá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú uwā da uwá ā, gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú uwā dɔɔ̄kā ā, amáŋ ācɛ nēe ī yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ da uwá ā, gē lɛ ɔtū kú uwā kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔ́na kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛ aá ā, alɔ yɔ̄ ī nyī ikpɔ̄dā kú alelékwū tū ipú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í kɛla ā. Ó wɛ ɔdā onwuné íbí ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ cɛgbá ɔdā kú eyī cāā áncā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdɔ hɛ́ tū um, klla le agbá kpó kwu um báajɛ, n kwú pīya olagbá nɛ̄ ó kwu gbógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē lɛ ɔlá kwu ɔ́ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu kóō yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ jāā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī iy­­ɔ̄bū Óndú ā, eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ukɔ́tin iyɔ̄bū kú ɛga nikpati kú Ɛka háyi ā, nōo háyi ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Aá géē lɛ íne nyā tū jāā gbéeko nōo ī wā a.

eng_Latn: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu ce igwáahātá nɛ̄ Ussíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Usɛkaríya, ɔyí kú Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú ajɛ kú Usamérīya ɔyā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa éyi ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū, kwú ije kú óndú nū ā ú otayínū ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛháajɛ kú Ugádu ā géē yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ ŋmá Utáma ga aɔ́kpá kú Umɛ́rība Ukádes, gáā bū njɔlɔ kú Íjīpiti ga ɛga ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya.

eng_Latn: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íkwu kú ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā le yúklɔ́ ipéyī ɔ́mpa ā. Ó pi odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā abɔ̄fú kéē gbā ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ ágbe kú nū jé ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā nōo yɔ̄ Ɔkpáncō ā yɔ̄ ī yɛhɛ tū uwā klla yɔ̄ ī yá uwā okónu ŋmá ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā da uwá kahíníī, Ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, ka n géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ gáā bī Unebukádinēsa, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā, wā amānyā. Ó kē í je akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū háyi ɛyí aɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄ a nyī nyā, klla í je áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū kwu ɛyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá abɔ̄ aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ elihɔ ká Ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu kóō pīya tɔ̄há mla ɔ̄cɛ aílɔ́wá ámāŋ ka o ga ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le mafú gā um ɛɛ́ kā n̄ híī hī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ̄cɛ elihɔ ámāŋ obɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kú Ujísɔ̄si ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N lɛ úklɔ́ olɔhi alɛwa mafú lɛ aá ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā ā. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyá kú ipú úklɔ́ nēe bá ā, nɛ̄ aá tíne ká aá tá ɛcɔ̄ klá um ā.

eng_Latn: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ í gē bī úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá yá nōó yɔ̄ ipú ɛjī kú alɔ ŋ́ mā gwō ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ leyīce ka ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Óndú ā í nwuné, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ lɔfú yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɔtāhɛ̄ aá glá, alɔ gē yúklɔ́ eko dóódu ipú ɛjī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aá géē bī le yúklɔ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ń lɛ ɛga ó kpó odúúdú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um tū ŋ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá āa?.

eng_Latn: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ lɛyí bū kwu oōnyɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ. Ó ka é géē jikwú ohígbū iyó kú úkplākā ogbɛnú nōo wu uwā ɔkɔ ā, amáŋ é gáā má ācɛ dúúma je ɔ́ ŋmá uwá ɔkɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá ka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ olɔhi, nōo klla nwuné nēé géē gbā kú etikpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbɔɔ́ otú gaá le tayínū ipácí lɛ īyī uwā hɛ́ ígwu ɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
idu_Latn: Á géē yɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ eyī kú ɛ̄cī nēé ma um ā nyā fúlufúlu ŋ́. Eyī yá um kú ācɛ ké ē bla kwu ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um ma um ā dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́! Eyī yá um kú ācɛ kéē kwú mlanyī ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um ma um ā, kéē kōō blakwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔkpíyē kú um wɛ ɔdōlé ɔkwɛ̄yi. Oyī kú um kē wɛ ɔdōgwá ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
idu_Latn: Ukóra, Ugátam mɛ́mla Ámālɛki.

eng_Latn: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD's.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yálé kpɛ́mm ā, é géē tīīcō ga ɛfu kú Usáyɔn gaá gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ísɔ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū gaá cɔcɛ́ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lɛ ikpó da aólɛlā kú uwa ɛyi tāajɛ, É klla í je aóhile kú uwā ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ nēe bá ā tɛtɛ bá ɛháajɛ kú Ukedɔlayóma iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa. Amáŋ ipú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛtá ā, é cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī ipú ɛwa ā dɛ̄gba je ɔkɔ gicō, ācɛ ɔhá dɛ̄gba je ɔkɔ wā ajɛ. Ohígbū ka útú nɛ̄hi le hɛ́ ipú ójila ā, alɛwa kú uwā í kōō je ɔdā nōo yá nēé jīla tɔ̄há ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ Uféro má. N le ɔtū kú nū mɛ́mla ákú aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā yá lɔfú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɔfú yá aɔ́dā ōhídáagó nēe bá ā ipéyī ūwā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ kú ugóólu yá. A géē bī ugóólu lɛ īkpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ɔkwu nū ā yá plákátáa. Lɛ ɔ́ yíifa lɔɔlɔhi mla ɛdɔ ododó ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, odúúdú nū kóō kwu ɔhá mla ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
idu_Latn: n géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ a bá ā ga awɔ. N géē je odo ojéeyī mɛ́mla odo ojɔ́dā gā uwɔ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā igbīhi uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
idu_Latn: Osém mɛ́mla Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogbāājɛ ā gā a, é má uwā ipú agbá gɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē wā gaá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko nēé gáā lé ɔdōlé ā le yá ā, Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó ā gaá cīce kéē lé ɔdōlé.

eng_Latn: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú cīgbīhi klá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla odúúdú iyéfú kú uwā, nēé bī gē nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu inyā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú kú uwā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
idu_Latn: Owu nōó gē fu ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī cēenyi nɛ̄hi, nōo gē kpó ɔdā dóódu ī je ācɛ mlɛ gaá kwu ɔkɔ ā. Ó géē fō aéwɔhá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí í kpó uwā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Ó klla ī pi odúúdú uwā nyɔ̄ í pɛ́ bí.

eng_Latn: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú nū lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ ɛnwú á. Amáŋ ɔ́bíipú wɛ omōōmu ipú ɔtū kú nū. Ɛlā kú nū gbɔtū nɛɛ bɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ó lulé nōo lɔfú hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄wā ā glá.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
idu_Latn: Aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á. ka aá tá ō yá íne kú um klla tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um. Ka ikoko ɔ́ɔmā aá yɔ̄ ī yá ucē kú aéwɔhá nēe lā kwu aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē ma īyī nū fu la ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, uwá kē í jé Óndú ā klá í gba ɔkɔ la ɔɔ, klá í bī ɛya oogwo mla ɛgba gē la ɔɔ. Uwá gēe ce okónu la Óndú ā klá í yá okónu nēe ce la Óndú ā jīla.

eng_Latn: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
idu_Latn: Kwu ayí obene nááná gē yá um okónu. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n cāŋ́jɛ gáā nyɔ̄ nɛɛ, é gē yá um okónu.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ le ɛpɔ̄ hɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɛpɔ̄bí gɔ́ nɛ, ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ ā géē da ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ́pɔ̄bī ā ɛpɔ̄bí ā ká ɔ̄ gwutá le eyī pīya klá ajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ gɔ̄ igbaáluka nɛ̄ íne kú ɔdā nɛ́ ɔ́ɔ yá ā ka ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó kú nū igwɛ́ɛpa ā hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ, kéē kē yá ká ācɛ o lɛ ōcē dóódu mɛ́mla unwalu kú ōcē dóódu kéē mɛ.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá yɔ̄ āa? Éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā lɔfú gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyā uwɔ ā glá. A kē í yɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé.

eng_Latn: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ o yúklɔ́ diili ā gē je ɔ́ yá otrɛ̄yí á. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ okwáhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ujulu ā géē wɛ ɔfulajɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Urécɛ̄lu, Ubílha klla le ipú yɔ̄ igbɔhá kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔ́mpa ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, blakwu ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka gā uwɔ ā. Ā híī mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ká ā yá ā ŋ́. Lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā, pīya agbénú kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē tūkɔ́ kéē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ émúká mɛ́mla úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ anú ā na. Ó géē kpó ɔ̄ bá ɛgée ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Umáta, Umáta! A yɔ̄ í gicō gajɛ lɛyíkwu ɔdā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
idu_Latn: Ayíka, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō kwú ígblɛ́nyī kú nū ú táajɛ hɛ́ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā tá. Kóō lɛ okónu kú nū táajɛ ŋmá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā.

eng_Latn: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
idu_Latn: Aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú kú uwā bá ī kwinya fíyo fíyo bū ipú aúláyi ā. É bá gē nwúleyikwū yɔ̄ ī kwinya fíyo fíyo gicō gaajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ipú igelī ā. É gē cɛ̄ nyaá nyaá bɛ̄ɛka ɛmu nēé lɛ ɔlá kwu ɔ́ ā. É klla yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ manya bɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā.

eng_Latn: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi lé ka Ɛ́lāyija. Ó ŋmá Utíssbe, ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di. Ɛ̄cī éyi ó gaá da Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Oŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicó kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo yēeyī nɛ̄ n gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā, ɔwɔ í gaá yá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ ébú gē cē ŋ́, iháyí ɛpa ámáŋ ka ɛtá nēe ī wā ā. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n klla le ka ka ɔwɔ kóō yā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɛya gwó gā um. Mīyɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā dóódu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū miya lɛ ɔ́ kóō je ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó lɛ abɔ̄ fúlá tū ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati bī, klla le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó kpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dóódu kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɔfú lé ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya otīīhɔ nyā glá.

eng_Latn: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɔfú kú nū le ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mā hɛ́ gwāajɛ gblugudu, má wúlaklá uwá, le uwá cā tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
idu_Latn: N gē yá ɛ̄nyā kú ebilíi kóō híīī lɔfu ɛgiyí alɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka alɔ jé ɔdā nōó bī ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
idu_Latn: Oyī kú Ábna kóō ce Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛyí. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujówābu kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe í lɛ ōcē ɛcí ɔnyā mɛ́mla agwú piyóó. Kéē lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ nēe í bá yúklɔ́ ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe í kwú ɔgbɛ́fú mɛ́mla aɛ́nēe í kwú ɛhá piyóó.

eng_Latn: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:
idu_Latn: Aá je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā. Aá klla yá ɛgbá kú ācɛ nēe cɛgbá otábɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá géē gbɔɔ́ ō fíyajɛ ipú obū nōo klá aá ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɔ o yɛ̄ɛyí gē fíyajɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
idu_Latn: Aá tá Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ádā alɔ ā ahínyá eko dóódu ohígbū ɔdā dóódu, ohígbū Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
idu_Latn: A le ayɔ́kpá yá kéē pɛ́ ɔpɛ́ kú aɛ́fu, ísu kē yɔ ī pɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mla aɔ́pɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, yɔ̄ ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu le tá ɛgiyí Ákisi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugáti ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē je ɔdā nɛ̄ aéwɔhá miya ā pīya áncā. Ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá ɔdā nēé tū ujɔ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú eko nyā ā, gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōcābɔ̄ á. É gáā je ɔdōcābɔ̄ dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ɛdɔ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú lɛ Ujóna ōfōōfūnū nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄, habɔ̄ uwā tá á.

eng_Latn: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó dɛ̄gba hī aícɔ́ɔja kú Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ábna igwú kahíníī, Ábna, a pó ɔkɔ kú um mm? Anɔ́ɔ Ábna ka ɔ̄nyɛ gē dɛ̄gba ī kpó aá héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā?.

eng_Latn: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! N le íkwu kpó lɛ aá ɛ́ɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ ikpó da ɛgwā mɛ́mla ɛna ocɔ̄cɛ. N lɛ ikwú je lɛ aá kú yá odúúdú ɔfú kú olɛlā ā lé ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dúú í gáā yá aá ágbe glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okónu nōó ce ka alɔ géē nyɔ̄ ɛga nōó í je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ alɔ ā kē yɔ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, alɔ leyī kwɛcɛ, yɔ̄ ī yúufi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í gaá je omlɛ́nyɔ́ nōó cokónu kú nū ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
idu_Latn: Umánōwa da ɔnyā nū ka aá géē kwú piíí, ohígbū ka aá le Ɔwɔicō má eyī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
idu_Latn: Ussɛkaníya, Uréhum, Umérēmɔtu.

eng_Latn: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ása ā wɛ, ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ , nēe wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja.

eng_Latn: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka anúɔ le ɛlā nwū ogwuda, klla lɛ ohílīpú mafú gā um ɛɛ́ m déēē?.

eng_Latn: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ je okwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū gicō lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta cāŋjɛ anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē jé ka ɔfú kú Óndú ā nwuné, nɛ̄ aá géē lɛ ojīlīma ce anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ipú ɛcɛ nyā piyóó.

eng_Latn: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
idu_Latn: Usákɔ, Ussiyɛbíya, Ussebaníya.

eng_Latn: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē tíne kéē ŋmó um ā, uwēyī kóō lɛ uwá kwú ká ā lɛ uwá yálé. Ācɛ nēe gē tū ujɔ̄ tū um ā, lɛ uwá kpó cīgbīhi, kéē lɛ uwá kpó gbájí.

eng_Latn: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aíkpɛ́cí gwó lɛ Ubáalu, ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Umólɛ̄ki. N da uwá kéē yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō gē gbɛlá nū, ka é í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ucē ɛbí ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ujúda lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lé.

eng_Latn: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
idu_Latn: Usárāyi ɔnyā kú Ébram í mɔyí dúúmā lɛ Ébram ŋ́. Amáŋ o lɛ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā éyi ŋmá Íjīpiti nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Uhága.

eng_Latn: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yá nōo ī wu um ɔtū ā, n géē yá aá ōwē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá aá jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ n kē gáā yá aá gbóógbóō ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Ufi nɛ̄hi le ācɛ nōo gē pɛ́ ugbéenyi ā kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é dɔɔ̄ka kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa yá yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okweyī kú ijā dúú nōo yɔ̄ ge kweyī mla ācɛ ɔhá í gáā miyɛ ɛhi nēe ge je lɛ ācɛ nēe yálé ā ŋ́, ń táafu ŋ́, ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íne kú ijā ā tū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya lɛ ukɔ́ nyā tū Ubárūkú á. É cɛ̄ ga um ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm le blakwu, aɔ́dā nēe he uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi íkée ā, eko nēé bá ī móōwē, ákanya mla ɔnɔ ō jé mɛ́mla eko kú ɔtūnōbí kú ūwā. Eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm yá ūwā lé ā, é má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá lɛ uwá abɔ̄ ŋ́. Aólɛlā nēe yá ūwā lé ā bá gē yɛɛhɛ tū ūwā, ohígbū abɔ̄ nōo je nyɛ́ lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
idu_Latn: É le íjééyī dóódu kú ācɛ Íjīpiti kpó nwū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ipú ɛlā nōó ī ka mɛ́mla ipú ɔdā nōó ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi eyī nɛ̄ n má ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Usamérīya bá ī yá. É gē bī iyē kú ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā lɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ, klla le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kpó nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛlá kwu iyī uwā o yá kéē híī je mlanyī aɔ́da nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má eyī eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yēeyī gaá kwu ā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ nwū ayááyí uwā.

eng_Latn: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a tá alɔ piyóó ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Á gáā ga ɔgbɛ́fú mla aícɔ́ɔja kú alɔ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi tú īyī uwá á. É lɛ Ábna mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yálé.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú italā kú ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá lé ā, ú ŋmá aá ɛyí ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ aólɛlā kú aá kpó nū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ɛɛ́. Óndú, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá. Aá gáā yúufi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ɔka kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá. Aɔ́cɛ́ ō kɛpɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwā ā ī dɔɔ̄kā ō mīyɛ ómíci ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ lé. Ācɛ nɛ̄hi ā gē da uwá ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā ā, anɔ́ɔ é gē yá ojuju kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si tá nɛ̄ alɔ le tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄nyā í wɛ ɔkpá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi bī ɔdā otɔ́kpá tá tū usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɔkpá nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá bī Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā tá tū ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kwɛyí ā, ó cāŋjɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū ede, ɛga nōó kwōkwū húmáyī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kú nu kwicō ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwā ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā kóō tá um abɔ̄ ā pó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yá mɛ bōōbū ā, Usámūwɛ̄lu gā ajɛ. Usɔ́lu le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipū ā í lɛ ɛlá wu Óndú ŋ́, ó ka Ɔwɔicō í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ. Aá hayi ɔwɛ kú alɔ ŋ́. Aá da alɔ ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ mā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ ā, aa géē kpó ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna igwɛ́ɛtā, mɛ́mla aómlede ɛpa, mɛ́mla ayí omlede igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ únóji ā gwū lɔfú ŋmá lɛ ɛcɔ̄ nēé míya ce ɔ́ ā, klla lɛ ācogbāājɛ fu kéē gbō ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ása ā kahíníī, Ása nēé hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ fíyɛ́ aípɔ́ɔma ohile kpɛ́mm ā á. Kóō le pīya ɔyí ō cɛ̄ kú ayínɛ́ nū. Ajɛ kú nū kóō lɛ mu mla agbénú kú īkpɔ̄cí ō bī lɛ yá anɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi da anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile ɔhá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ka odúúdú uwā ɛ́ɛ wɛ ijáalí kú anúɔ ícɛ nyā, ka anúɔ lɛ ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ákú Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki, Ucílīyɔn mɛ́mla Umálɔn ā lá ŋmá ɛgiyí Unaómi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But if this thing be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel:
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, nɛ̄ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ dóódu í yɔ̄ ka ɔyí ā í jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ga ɔlɛ́ ɔbá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ɔ̄kā ka ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ amíyɔ wɛ ā. N kē da ɔ́ ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdú iyó mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ācɛ kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó lɛ īyī uwā. Amáŋ é lɛ ācɛ ā kpó ŋmó dúúdú, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ń yá aɔ́dā ō hídáagó nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í yá jééjé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ipéēyī ūwā ŋ́ nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā, é le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā má, nááná é gē wɔ́tū ami mla Ádā um.

eng_Latn: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
idu_Latn: Le kwu ŋmá ucē ɔ́ɔmā tá. Le nyā ŋmá anú, ká ā je ɔwɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɔkpá nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é gē ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, nōo yá uwá ā ŋ́. Anú gē je eyīyōce lɛ uwá, eko nēé bá ipú unwalu ā á.

eng_Latn: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
idu_Latn: Ohóō yɔ̄ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo le mu mla ācɛ o ŋmó ācɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā. Ɛga nēé ɔ́ tū mu mla agbénú nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá géē wā í wu klla í kpó ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō, awɔ nōo lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī oyēēyī ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú le íne kú uwɔ bīya, a gē cɔ̄nū mla odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla ka kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka agbénú nēé le tayínū ipácí ā. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ajɛ tá klá anú á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū he ɔ́ lɛ ā ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá kwú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā ú kpó lá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ agbénú ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ ā lá á.

eng_Latn: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya ɛpa gē ma ihɔtū fú lɛ iyī uwā. Ɔdī wɛ ile kú aɔ́máapú ā, ɔdāŋ ka ó wɛ ka o tábɔ̄ eko kú ɛgbá ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
idu_Latn: Á gēe tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Áa jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndū ā gē nwū aá ā. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ācogwɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ anjɛnū á ŋ́, ɔdā dóódu nēé gē ka lɛ aá ā, í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo géē yá aá lɔhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujóbābu gekwú, Uhússam ŋmá ajɛ kú Utéman má cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ kwú, lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ka tū ɔ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ kéē ŋmó icííci. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē lɛɛlá wu ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú álá ā kwú um ú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo í gbō aálá nēé gáā kpó ŋmó ā. N lɛ okwutɛ ɛpa kpó. N hī éyi ka Ɛhi, ɔhá ā kē lé ka opīyatɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ n kē leyīkwu aálá ā.

eng_Latn: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó wɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā wɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ā ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aá kóō le pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē wɛ otrɛ̄yī kú aá kóō kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Oŋmífī eko kú Usámūwɛ̄lu, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, é lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lé ɛ̄nyā ā ŋ́. Odúúmā kú aɔ́cɛ́ otɛtɛ ā, í lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujosíya, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda, Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ā lé ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū fíyaa kú ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā dúúmā í yá ɔbá nū mɛ́mla ɔyí nū ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le tá ɛgiyí ɔnyā ā, ó da Ugɛ́hási ka ɔdā dúúmā ɔ́ yá ŋ́, ka, aá bá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: N da aá ka ācɛ alɛwa géē wā ŋmá odúúdú ɛcɛ gaá cīce kéē lé ucɛ mɛ́mla Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē gaá cɔcɛ́ gbɔɔ́ ō gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ̄ nū ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā kahíníī, N géē nya aá tá ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um. N géē lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔtū kpóce um bá cíí. Amáŋ aá tá ō yá ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
idu_Latn: É le áhingílí, mɛ́mla áblákpá nēe le hɛ́, nēé lɛ ɔ́ kpó gɔ́ ā, kpó wu ikpó lɛ ifa yá. Igbō nɛ̄ uwá bī mla īyī uwā ā, le ŋmó klla í témúká.

eng_Latn: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ámnɔn í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Abɔ̄ ó le lɔfú fíyɛ́ Utáma ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ báajɛ le ikpónū ce abɔ̄fú á.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Óndú ā ī cíla um ulé olɔhi nyā, ohígbū koó jé ka ń lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā kahíníī, Le héyī, owu kú ɛhícō kú ɛcɛ! Wā, owu kú ɛháajɛ kú ɛcɛ! Aá gaá tá klá ɛhɔ̄ kú um, ka aá cɛ̄ lɛ ocu kú nū kóō pɛ́ klá ɛga dóódu. Ohumɔtū, kóō wā ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū wā í lé ɛdɔ īkpɔ̄cí nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kóō.

eng_Latn: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ tū ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Ujúda ā ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ kóó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anɔ́ɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́tāni yɔ̄ kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukilómīta ɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kwú piíí. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ ɔlá kwú ābɔ̄ kú nū nōo yɔ̄ ī lu ā í yi ā. Owu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē fu klá anú ā kē í je ɔ́ kpó bónū.

eng_Latn: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
idu_Latn: É bī owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā, owú nɔwā, īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ olɔɔlɔhi mɛ́mla owú ugóolu le ɛ́fɔ̄du o wiiyē kla awulú ā gɔ́.

eng_Latn: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ɔ́da nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má Igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā, yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. É lɛ ɔ́ tútū bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo lɛ ifa yá gē gbēyī ɔbá nōo gáā lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē ɛɛ́. Alɔ géē bī ɛ̄ngwū kú um le gwíijē bá ī cɛtra uwɔ. ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ gé kwú.

eng_Latn: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
idu_Latn: Aá ā, aá ma ayí alɛwa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ayááyí kú aá kéē mīyɛ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nāa gē yɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúmā nāa gē yá ā, Óndú ā, gē má uwɔ.

eng_Latn: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ayíkpó kú nū alɛwa kwúcē igbīhi í klla yɛ mla anú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
idu_Latn: Ede kú ugóolu ā, anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ, ɔtulalī umuumu ōkpóocu ā mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin o klá ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
idu_Latn: ayípōklóbīya ā gē má um, gē je ɛga gā um. Anyākwɔ́cɛ klla ī cāŋjɛ háyi icō jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n gaá cīce, kéē le ojīlīmā ce um.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ tííkpa kú aádáádā nū Udéfīdi, le ɔdā nōo lɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū yá.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
idu_Latn: Ahíja klla da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā géē je ɔcɛ́ ɔhá ce, nōo géē je ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujérobōwam kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɛ um jīla ɛɛ́, a kē jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ipú unwulu anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā lɛ yá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ í cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frēm ā wɛ Ɛlíssāma, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdu. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ Ugamálīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Upɛdásu.

eng_Latn: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
idu_Latn: Igbɔ ɔ́mpa, ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā le yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā jīla tá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛ́tɛ́ hɔ́ɔgba yɛ lɛ, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā. Ígwu éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja gbɔbū, ācogwɛ́ɛya ahāapa nɛ̄ ē bī opo ā gboce uwá bá í tá opo ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bī ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā kē tū ɔ́mɛtá. Aícɔ́ɔja o hile ā kē bá igbīhi uwā. Eko nyā kpɛ́mm ā, opo yɔ̄ í kɛlā.

eng_Latn: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
idu_Latn: Aíne kú uwɔ wɛ ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū á. Aíne ā gē nwū um ɛlā klla í ma ɔwɛ fú gā um.

eng_Latn: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
idu_Latn: Eko kú ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú onyatá dóódu, Upáyílēti gē hɛ́ alagbá éyi tá lɛ uwá piíí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóram lɛ Ujéhu má ā, ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A wā ɛbɔ́ kɛɛ, Ujéhu? Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu le ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ géē yɔ̄ lɛ glá, nɛ̄ ɔhɛ ō yá mla ɛcí ō pā kú ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ Ujésɛbɛlu le nwuné klla le nyīla tāajɛ nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
idu_Latn: Íne ékpónú gē gbō ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé mɛ́mla ákú ɛya kú ɔdā ō gbā cīgbīhi á. Ɛbɛ́ ā wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo gē gwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
idu_Latn: Usélɔ̄miti mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā gē leyīkwu odúúdú iyó ɛ̄gbā nēé kpó gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ígwíígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kpó wā Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi í je lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi oŋmɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ, Ábsālɔm le ɔ́gbá tá Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ tá Uhɛ́brɔn gaá le okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ ce lɛ Óndú ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔdā nōo kwu ɔ́ ɔtū ā je lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́. A klla le ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ ó ba uwɔ ā je lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a lɛ íjéeyī ba, nɛ̄ á ba oyēeyī olīkpō, ámāŋ agbénú, amáŋ ikwú kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
idu_Latn: Uwá ā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma nēe ŋmá ayí kú Uládan ā á. Ussíméyi ma ayí ɛtá: Ussélōmɔtu, Uhásīyɛlu mɛ́mla Uháran.

eng_Latn: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, kwu Usedekíya ámāŋ aígabɔ̄ kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē ka bū okónu kú Ujeremíya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī nyɔ̄ í cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná ɛga ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, abɔ́ɔ nōó mīyɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō Ádā nū cokónu o je lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī má klla yɔ̄ ī pó nyā wɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ Ádā ā cokónu nū ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka okónu ékpónú nēé tá á nɛɛ, ótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē í jīla awɔ eyī.

eng_Latn: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá lɔfú cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ, éyééye, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē jé odée kéē klla lɛ uwá ɔtū tū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
idu_Latn: Ɛna ā wɛ úlā ofu ahāanɛ .

eng_Latn: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá, é géē yá uwɔ italā lɔɔlɔhi. A géē kwú ɔ́dāŋ ka tá kéē híī nā uwɔ tá ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā wɛ aólíla. É jé um ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayí olíla nēé jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí ofōōfūnū nēé jé ō yá á, amáŋ é yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo lɔhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ, aá wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ okpaakpa iyɔ̄bū ācɛ, amáŋ eyīɛpa o lɛ mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú le mu aá ipú.

eng_Latn: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Alɔ lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū ɔ́ɔmā éyi kú uwā kwinya nyɔ̄ gaá kwú isosō ú lɛ ɔ́ wu ejé ohɔ́nɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú gbō bá ɔcí anɔ́ɔ ó le je lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá á.

eng_Latn: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ipí ā kwú nyīla tū ɔkpíyē ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka ka ɔ́ɔ le tēelihɔ, ohígbū koó lɛ ōcē.

eng_Latn: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
idu_Latn: É géē yúklɔ́ gá uwɔ, mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, amáŋ, é gáā lɛ iyē kwu ɔdā otīīhɔ dúúmā kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛ iyē kwu ɔ̄, uwá mɛ́mla awɔ géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī ményinyi nɛ̄hi ā nōó nya aá tá á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ágbe kú aá ā í tōō tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ágbe ā í kē gáā jé glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō aúgbɔga, nēe lā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā á. Anú gē tá ayókwū mɛ́mla anyōkwū abɔ̄ á. Amáŋ ó ge je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gē yá ā pīya ífi lɛ uwá. Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyípōklóbīya éyi nōo lɛ ahilíki ōfōōfūnū klá iyē yɔ̄ ī tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu. É tíne ō lɛ ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo le ɔyí ma, ó géē tēelihɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ eko nōó gē nyílá ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā ā.

eng_Latn: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
idu_Latn: N pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē bī iyē um kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā gē ka ka amíyɔ̄ tū aá ɛhɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄na ā.

eng_Latn: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ī yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa nū ŋ́, í jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō wɛ ihɔtū.

eng_Latn: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ālɛ ɛ̄nyā yá la uwá a, é gēe yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn okónu klá í yá ɔɔ ɛbɛ́ kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kú ɔ́bíipú a má gwōnū ɛɛ́, ó klá gāa yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋmó glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛga olɔfú nɛ̄ n gē kwu tayínū ipú nū ā. Ó kē le yá ká n lā oyēeyī kú um ɛbɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā, n má aɔ́dā nēé i gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā ā, n má ede éyi, nēé tá ɔkpá tū ɔ̄ ka, Ákú ɔwɔ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ i jé ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ aá jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ n gē tɔ́ɔna nū abālɔbányā lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú ɛcɛ ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú. Ó kē le abɔ̄ klá aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā eyī, í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō yá ɛnyā á. Ó wɛ anú ŋ́, ɔnyɛ kē yá ɛnyā āa?.

eng_Latn: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā dóódu yīipú otú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um yīipú ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla ī tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē ipú nū ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Óndú, le tútū ká ā tá um abɔ̄ eko dóódu, ohígbū ka n le tútū ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
idu_Latn: Ó gē nyɔ̄ ī dɔ̄ɔka ɔdōlé kóō bī wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɛga oligbó, bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o tá ɔ́hí nēe gē kpó iyó tū ipú úgbéenyi ŋmá ɛga oligbó wā ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɛlā ā ka lɛ ācɛ ā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī á. Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnyā um gekwú. Oŋmɔ́cī nū n le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ā.
