eng_Latn: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ kú um ā, alelékwū kú Óndú ā klla kwú um cīgbīhi wā Ubábīlɔn, ɛgiyí ācɛ nɛ̄ bá ajɛ kú ɔfīyɛ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ ā mɛ ŋmá eyī kú um péee á.

eng_Latn: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n klla kahínīī, Ɔdā nōo fū um fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ka, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā í tá alɔ abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū í he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ipú ajɛ oyá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā; ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tá ɔga, ɛɛ́ nōó gē gwó ijē ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔci Ufáyin a ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔcɛ dúúmā í wú ikpo kú ɔci Ufáyin a le yá ejé ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔga kú éeyē dóódu ootá a, gāa mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kóō yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
idu_Latn: Ádā ɔnyā nū, Ujɛ́tro ā gā ɛgiyí nū mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū, mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛpa ā, ɛga nɛ̄ó yɔ̄ ipú ígbíli ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ éyééye kú alɔ mīyɛ ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí nōo mafu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá jɛ́ɛla nwuné lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
idu_Latn: N gáā gbēyī ō kɛlā gā uwɔ ohígbū keé má ɔdā dóódu ō ka gā uwɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī yá ojibó dúúmā lɛ īyī uwā ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ ɛ́gbla kú ɔdā dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, ámāŋ ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ɛcɛ, ámāŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nááná ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ile kú ɛcí nɛ̄ aá gē pā ā? Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ɔ̄ ā le ɔ́ yá kwɛyí, ó ka ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ōfōōfū nū ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gēe kpó ɔtūce ɔdā nɛ̄ ó bī abɔ̄ kú nū yá ā? Ɔwɔ nɛ̄ ó kōō kɛlā glá ŋ́ mā!.

eng_Latn: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā, amáŋ, Óndú ā í tá ɔ̄ ohi ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄na, ámāŋ ákú ɔdā nēé ī bī lɛ jé ɔtū kú nū ā, ámāŋ o ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
idu_Latn: Ábáa kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī ŋmá mulɔ́mulɔ́mulɔ́ ipú īlī ō kléeyī kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
idu_Latn: É bá ī ka atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ohígbū ámata kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔnɔ nēé yɔ̄ ī má ā. Amáŋ é habɔ̄ ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yá odúúdú ɔda dóódu á, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, é kéē yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́. Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ŋmá eko tá eko. Aamí.

eng_Latn: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē ba ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō cɛ̄ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó kú nū ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ í je lɛ anúɔ. Kóō híī lɛ ɔtōbɛ́ɛpa ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lɛ ɔtōbɛ́ɛpa ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ga ɛga dóódu, gē tá ɔ̄ gicō, gē tá ɔ̄ wāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā géē yɔ̄ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nōo géē yá kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ayípɛ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ŋmó lé.

eng_Latn: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le jé ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du ī gbō ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ tū gé lɛ Uhérɔ̄du, nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́da je ka, ācɛ nēe gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā cíkā ō mīyɛ ulé kú uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
idu_Latn: A gē bī oyéeyī kú alɔ wā oŋmɛ́yí igbledū. Oyēeyī kú alɔ le kpií bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄na nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī nā ā, alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo le bū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
idu_Latn: Wā kú ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ tɔ̄há, ká ālɔ̄ kɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ géē kpó ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le da Ulában ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtā ka Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ́ɔ le kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā gboce uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Ugamálīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Upɛdásɔ.

eng_Latn: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aíne kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gēe gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ō táajɛ kú ɔlɛɛhá géē lɔfú yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ́ glá, amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́hɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le alelékwū kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi ā kwúcē mla uwēyī le tá Asírīya á. Ɛ̄cī éyi, ó klá ipú inu ɛcí kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ayí nū ōhī bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gāa kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ í yá ā má ā, é tíne kéē kwú kwu ŋmá igelī ā otú. É kwú bū ɔwɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, bū okómpinu nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ɛpa ā gaá jīla ɔhá ā. É bá í kwu ga ɛgiyí ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord was, till it was light.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔɔ̄cī ā, odiyɔ̄ ā wā gaá fīyajɛ okómpīinu kú ɛga nɛ̄ ɔbá nū yɔ̄ ā. Ó gwutá abɔ́ɔ í jé īyī nū ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gā ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛna lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā dúúmā iyē catāpū, nɛ̄ó gekwú, é géē bī ɛcɔ̄ lɛ ŋmó ɛna ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā lé ɛbɛ́ kú nū ŋ́, amáŋ é gáā yá óndú kú ɛna ā italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, he is before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for there is a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, é tá uwā ohi ka, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. É klla da uwá kéē má ɔ́, ka anú ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yɛ iyɔ̄bū uwā abɔ́ɔ á. É da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ fíyaa, ohígbū ka ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā nɔ́ɔ wā igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā á, ohígbū ka, ācɛ gáā gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá lɛ ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ ó jé ācɛnyīlɔ jéjé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ayípāncɛ̄nyā ā kpó wā ɔlɛ́ lɛ iyī aá.

eng_Latn: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ofíílí kóō o wā, Ujɔ́ni le ɔna tá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ubatísim yá uwā.

eng_Latn: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kē kpó Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla Ísɔ lɛ Áyísīki á. Anú klla je igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́dɔm ā lɛ ísɔ á, amáŋ ádā uwā, Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla ayí nū lɛ pɛ́ ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā géē wɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú Ugamálīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Upɛdásu á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
idu_Latn: Ukénasi ma ayí ɛpa, Otínīyɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Useráya. Otínīyɛ̄lu kē ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá ā: Uhátāti mɛ́mla Umeyonótāyi.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ámɔn yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛbɛ́ gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ā. Ó klla le īkpɔ̄dā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ā dúú. Ó klla le enyi umu fu ɛyí ede ā abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó pīya oyī klá ɛyí ede ā dúú kā ɔ̄ wɛ ɛya kú olétɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó yājɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú olífu ā, ayíkpó kú nū wā ɛgiyí nū ɛkwūbá gaá kahíníī, Da alɔ eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá ā géē yá ā. Ɔdí géē wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú eko nɛ̄ a géē wā ā mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā géē mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
idu_Latn: N le pīya olɛlā kú aá abālɔbányā ohígbū ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n ka lɛ aá ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, cīce icō ɛyí inu kú ɔlɛ́ nū ōfōōfūnū ā, Éhūdu le tá ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, cāŋjɛ háyicō á.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, tá uwá ohi ka ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ ā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó māháyi okómpinu kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bá ī nɔwɔ ga ɔgbɛ́fú ígwíígwu kú úlā ɛpa cofigwó mɛ́mla ígwíígwu kú ofɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
idu_Latn: N le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá aólɛlā kú um lé lɛ ā má ɛɛ́. N klla le ikwū mɛ́mla ɛgba kú ācobɔ̄bíipū ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe bá ipú ūpū, bī āgā ī tū ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eyī kwu iyɔ̄bū kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yī mɛ́mla okpaakpa. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú uwɔ ká ā lɛyí plaajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
idu_Latn: Éwo dóódu, nēe tá kóō nyɔ̄ ī gbā Óndú, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ɛ̄gbā, ɔwɔ í gáā yā ajɛ kú éwo ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyī kú nū kpó gwó ɛ́fa bá ajɛ ɛɛ́. Ó klla kwú ɔyī ú kwu ɔtā yɔ̄ ī kpó abɔ̄ ɔtā ŋanaa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, ōcē ā yɔ̄ ī bɔ̄bí gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū jāā iháyí ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ɔnɔ kú ōcē ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó á. Amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū í gwɔ́ɔlá nɛ̄hi kú ikwū ō yá kú nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gwó eko kú aádáádā nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú áluka kú agbénú kú ɛfú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó wā ɔlɛ́ ā wɛ, úlá bá ɛga úlā ɛnɛ ce úlá ofu ahātá ce ahāapa, ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
idu_Latn: Óndú pīyeyī má um kú ā pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā. Ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbā, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ ohígbū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Alɔ mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ wɛ ācobīyíne nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ háyi iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ikpɛ́fu kú Usáyínāyi eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū ā. Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ tíne kéē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gē nwū kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yēeyī gaá kwu ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nwū ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ kéē yá ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyí kú Usólōmɔn kóō lɛ ipɔ́ɔma éyi tū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n géē lɛ éyi kú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, nōo géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ipú Ujerúsālɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bá ī gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúu lɛ apī hɛ́ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō á nɛ̄ɛ, óō híīī ka ka anúɔ gē pīya anú abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó hɛ́ apī ɛ́ɛ́ nōó mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, kóō híīī nyɔ̄ gáā hɛ́ apī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n jé ka a ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ aógbɛhá, a klla ī hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú ipú inu ā plla mla ugóolu , kwu ede nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛga nōo tīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
idu_Latn: Okónu ɔwɛ kú igá nōo yɛ ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā piíí ā, ó yɔ̄ ī hīgwú gbōmgbōm kpɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ jé ɔ́dāŋ́ ka odo kú ɔ̄cɛ gē gicō nɛ̄ ákú ɛbɛ́ gē gaajɛ á ā?.

eng_Latn: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, gwíijē lɛyíkwu ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin.

eng_Latn: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́máapú um, n lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aá péee lɛyíkwu ádā alɔ nɛ̄hi Udéfīdi. Ó gekwú, é lɛ ɔ́ nyi, únóji kú nū kē yɔ̄ pī alɔ jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɛɛcɛ gekwú, é klla lɔfú iyē dúúmā gɛ ŋ́. Eko nēé gekwú, iní nēé kē yɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
idu_Latn: É klla géē ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ le ísu kú Ujɔ́dan tū ɛjī lɛ aá mla uwá. É lɔfú ka ka aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi ā, í lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ō yá mla Óndú ā ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ayááyí uwā í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ayááyí aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ ga ɔkpáncō wā ajɛ jéjéē ɛɛ́? Ɔ̄nyɛ kwú owu tū ipú abɔ̄ kú nū jéjéē ɛɛ́? Ɔ̄nyɛ gbō éŋkpɔ̄ ipú īlī kú nū jéjéē ɛɛ́? Ɔ̄nyɛ yá odúúdú oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a jé ɔ̄, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā? Iyē kú ɔyí nū kē lé ka ɔ̄nyɛ?.

eng_Latn: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
idu_Latn: Íkwu dóódu nōó lɛ ɔlɛ́ nyā nɛ̄ n lɛ dúú á. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā tayínū gā um ɔlɛ́ nyā ŋ́. Ń táafú ŋ́, awɔ nōo wɛ ɔnyā nū ā. Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n géē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya āā?.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī bī iyē kú anúɔ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā hijā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā mā ɔ̄cɛ dóódu, nōo gē bī iyē kú anúɔ hijā tá icííci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē bī ɔfú kú nū je ācɛ Asírīya kpó yíífi. Ó géē je igelī nɛ̄hi kú Unínīfɛ pīya alácɛ̄, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ipú ūpū, nɛ̄ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
idu_Latn: Aá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka inu nēé gwó cɛyí ikpíinu nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ le táajɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ Ujíisɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yīnū ā.

eng_Latn: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, ācɛ alɛwa géē yá ɛdɔ kú ucē obɔ̄bi nɛ̄ aítíca ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā ge yá ā, ohígbū ucē obɔ̄bi nēé gē yá ā, ācɛ géē gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
idu_Latn: É kwu Olkɛ́dɛssi nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, nōo yɔ̄ Ugálīli ā, nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɛfu kú Unáfutālī ā, mɛ́mla Ussɛ́kɛm ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem ā, mɛ́mla Uhɛ́burɔn kú ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā ú táajɛ ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
idu_Latn: N lɛ okónu tá lɛ aá ohígbū ánya kú aá, ohígbū koó nwuné íbí. N tokónu lɛ aá ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ aá le cɔ̄nū, aá lɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi. N géē je ayááyí kú aá fíyákātā bá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. N géē yá kú aá lā wu ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú.

eng_Latn: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tá ō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄, óócí n géē bī ɔwa kú efūma wā í klá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē kɛlā ékpónú igbalɛwa nááná ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú nū nōó gē ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā klla lɛ ɔ́ yá tīihɔ, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nyā nōó mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpāncō nōó yá ā á.

eng_Latn: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je ajɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm, ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n bī ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔkpacaŋgelī mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ā, ga uwɔ á. Ó wɛ ayínɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, Ujerúsālɛm! Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gē ŋmó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ klla gē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ uwá ā, igbɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ n tíne ká n̄ lɛ ayí uwɔ túbá tɔ̄há ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ugwū gē tū ayí nū bá ɛháajɛ acá kú nū á, amáŋ á kē cɛ̄ ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī ka ka ojíbó kú aɛ́cí wɛ ɔwɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔdōlé nēé je lɛ ɛcí ā wɛ ɛya ōgwó kú ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Ehée!.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
idu_Latn: N gē bɛ́yíkwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē kɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú abɔ̄yī uwā, gē ka ka ami ɔ́ɔ ka á ā.

eng_Latn: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄, abɔ̄ aá le pīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā, aá tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ ádā aá mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ aá, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá á.

eng_Latn: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
idu_Latn: Otábɔ̄ kú alɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo yá ɔkpáncō mla ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
idu_Latn: Ó le jé lɔɔlɔhi ka ohígbū ímálanyi Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya gē má ā yá, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kwú ɔ̄ gé le anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ alɔ má uwɔ yɔ̄ ī doōcē ámāŋ ka a yɔ̄ agbá nɛ̄ alɔ wā ɛgiyí uwɔ gaá jila uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Ma ihɔtū kú uwɔ fú lɛ alɔ eko dóódu, Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ alɔ tábɔ̄, ká ā klla lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
idu_Latn: N gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi nɛ̄ɛnɛ̄hi, klla gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlu. Odúúdú iyē kú um kē yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlu kpákpákpá.

eng_Latn: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá tíne ká ācɛ kéē yá lɛ aá ā, aá yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwá dúú. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka á.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi kú Óndú alɔ jísɔ̄s Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō yɔ̄ kwu aá kpɛ́m. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God, even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)
idu_Latn: É da Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kahíníī, Kóocō, alɔ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ̄ ga uwɔ ká ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ a ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā lɛ alɔ. Alɔ nēe le lígíí nɛ̄ a má nyā wɛ ācɛ nēe hile ŋmá ipú ɛwa ā. Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ kē má lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá, aá gáā cē ɔ̄ ga okónōgwu kú ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́. Aá híī cīgbīhi wā í cē ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá le gwɔ̄ tá ŋ́. Aá mā ɔ́ɔmā tá lɛ aógbɛhá mɛ́mla aúgbɔga. ami, Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē da uwɔ ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā, nōo jɛ̄ jāā lɛyí kwu ojuja ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó jɛ̄ gicō lɛ a, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔbɔ́cɛ kú nū jɛ̄ lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā, géē wɛ ɛ̄cī ō blatū nɛ̄ aá géē mlɛ̄nyɔ̄. Aá géē wā í jīla ká aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā eko nēé lɛ opo tá.

eng_Latn: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka oŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ayí kú Ulífāyi fu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē leyīkwu ikpati kú ɛka kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛ̄hɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ ācogwɛ́ɛya, kéē klla bī iyē kú Óndú ā le hɔ́hā ce ācɛ.

eng_Latn: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi tɛtɛ wɛ éyi kú alɔ, ohígbū kéē lɛ ɔ́ fu kóō yúklɔ́ nyā tɔ̄há mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔ́nu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm eko ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ úlā cofigwɛ́ɛnɛ cigwó. Otrɛ̄yí kú ayááyí kú ɔyí Ujúda, Upéresi ā wɛ, Utáyi, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdu, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ómri mɛ́mla Ímri mɛ́mla Ubáni.

eng_Latn: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
idu_Latn: Ó le ugóolu ma plá icō kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ókíkā ɛnɛ kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ajī ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ugóolu yá tū okónōgwu nū biílí.

eng_Latn: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
idu_Latn: Kwu aɔ́máapú abɔ̄yī uwɔ, ācɛ kú ipú inu kú uwɔ piíí ā, lɛ ibīyāajɛ yá tū uwɔ ɛɛ́. É nyɔ̄ í le pīya tū ipú ācɛ bá ī kpɛ́fú tú uwɔ. Aá lɔtūce uwá ŋ́, náāná nēé ī kɔkɔ olɔnyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
idu_Latn: ga ogbeé kú ísu kéē nyɔ̄ í tɔ́sú kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, nōo gē jɛ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá tɔ́sú mɛ́mla éwo dóódu.

eng_Latn: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī aá gwō ipú aícɔ́ɔci ɔhá kú Ɔwɔicō á. Alɔ gē bī aá gwō ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá háyi kpaakpa klla yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ɛlā Ɔwɔicō gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū kpɔ́ ɛpléeko nēé bá yɔ̄ ī junwalu lɛ aá, bá gē yá aá ōwē nɛ̄hi āa.

eng_Latn: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kwú ayááyí kú Ísɔ ā í tóohɛ́ɛwa dúúdú, klla kwú ɛga otayínū kú uwá í tɛ́ɛcɛ, nēé klla gáā má ɛga dúúmā ɔhá o tayínū ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā í kpó yíífi ɛɛ́. Odúúmā kú uwá í hile gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔ gáā ŋá uwá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ ī kpla uwá ɛhá ŋ́. Ó ka ɛcɔ̄ oje ɔ́ɔ bá ipú ajɛ ā, kéē lɔfú bu oje udɔ ŋmá aɛ́fu kú ipú ajɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē gbō uwɔ. Amáŋ n géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ nōo tá ajɛ gē hɛ́ ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu gwónū. N klla géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa nōo gē kwú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, é kē gáā ca ɔ́ tāajɛ gbóógbóō glá ŋ́. Ofúlɔ̄cī blibli ā, ó géē wā ipú ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó gáā yɔlá glá ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla oje udɔ, aá géē lɛ ɔ́ gla ɔlá, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē kɛlā ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ɛka kú aflɛ́yí ā í tīile gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā nōó tīile ŋ́, nōo klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbo ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄, le bá oōmɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é yá unwū ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi ipú ígbíli, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le Ɔwɔicō jámá ipú ígbíli á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā klla lɛ ikókwū kú éŋkpɔ̄ ɛpa miya, nāa géē yɔ̄ ī gwá ɛ̄cī dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí dúúmā nōó gwá īkpō olɔhi ŋ́, é gē hɛ́ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ɔlá.

eng_Latn: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a tá alɔ klla le alɔ yálé ɛɛ́. A húmáyī ī cɔ̄nū mla alɔ, amáŋ abālɔbányā, le cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí alɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ kpó kwú le uwá kpó tū olī, É klla lɛ ojīlīma dúúmā cɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
idu_Latn: Yá ɔdā dúú nāa yá glá ká ā le piya ɔ̄cɛ o tū Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄di ɔkwu nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū oyēeyī nɛ̄ ó lɛ oōmɛŋ́ mā. Oyēeyī wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu kú nū gā awɔ eko nōo hī uwɔ igwú nāa ka tɛ́ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ijáalí alɛwa ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Itíca, ɔ̄nyɛ bīyíne ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā peyī ā, ɔ̄cɛ ā kɛ̄ɛ ka ācɛ nēe ma ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
idu_Latn: Ɔhā yɔ̄ lɛ ewo dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄yīnū nōo ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa, nɛ̄ aígabɔ̄ kú nū gē lé, gē gwá eko nōo cíkā, nēé gáā wīyā ejé ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je uwēyī lɛ ádā uwɔ o ŋmá lɛ ō cikpó ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ le aá kú aá le ɔdā otayínū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō jé, amáŋ ó lɛ ā lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú aɔ́kplá kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú Íjīpiti dóódu ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī yúúfi aólɛlā kú aá ŋ́. Aá híīī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá kwu ŋ́, ó géē wɛ ocābɔ̄ lɛ uwá kéē yá aá lé glá ŋ́. Aá géē yálé ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē yá uwā lé á.

eng_Latn: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwū ɔkpá kú Ugíhɔn klla je ɔ́ bū gaá yɛ ipú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm á. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya yá ā le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
idu_Latn: Ó géē jɛ̄ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó wɛ ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́. Ó géē bīya ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ó kē í yálé ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó géē yá ā. Ó géē je ācɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā kpó yíífi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū fu ga iyɔ̄bū, gaá lā ɛga aɔ́cí nēé hī ka óoku kú Umámre, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Uhɛ́brɔn ā. Ó le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, kwu pīya ācɛ abɔ̄yī uwā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ujúda jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā á. Eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulíbina klla kwú hɛ́ ŋmá Ujúda dúú, ohígbū ka Ujɛhóram kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā nū ā.

eng_Latn: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híī dɛ̄gba tū ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ kɛlā lɛ uwa bɛ̄ɛka ádā awɔ āa. Yá mla ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ bɛ̄ɛka ayínɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bā í cōkónu ga um gbɛdɛɛ. É le pīya tɔ̄ɔhá lɛyíkwu um klla bá ī tū um ɛ̄bɛ̄ kéē yá um ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu alɔ yɔ̄ ī kwú ɛdɔ̄ ikwú nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si kwú ipú iyē kú alɔ ŋmá lɛ ōwē nɛ̄ alɔ ī má ā. Alɔ ī yá ɛ̄nyā o yá ka alɔ kē lā ɛdɔ oyēeyī kú Ujísɔ̄si ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gáā le jīla ká ē pó ɛlā nāa bī gáā ka ā á, amáŋ é gáā yá ɔdā nāa da uwá ká ē yá ā ŋ́. É bī okónu kú uwā áncā ī le mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yíihɔtū tú um lɛ ā, amáŋ ɔtū kú uwā tá eyī ō kwu ɔdā nēé ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
idu_Latn: Le da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō lɛ aɔ́dā ō bī yíifa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ákú ugóolu ba ŋmá ɛgiyí oladógbe kú nū, ācɛnyā í ba ŋmá ɛgiyi ācɛnyā ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú uwá nɛ̄hi ā kwú pīya ɔda ufi nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔtū yɛ anú glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ lɛ ɛka nēé gbo ā mɛ́mla okónu nēé ce ā kpó bīya dúúdú ɛɛ́. É kē lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ géē he aá nɛ̄hi kú aá kpó ɔdōplahɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔ́. É lɛ īlī nāńdaa, klá ajɛ ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ gāá lɛ ɔdōplahɔ̄ nōó kpó ā kpó tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ce oje abɔ̄ gla ŋ́, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, oje kú ācɛ ɛhícō nēe yá mla udɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ cíka ō ka iŋini, eko dúúmā nēé le alɔ yá italā ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya āa?.

eng_Latn: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
idu_Latn: N̄ pi aá ahɔ̄ kpɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́, ó í wɛ o piíí kóó lɛ odúúdú íne ā tū.

eng_Latn: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
idu_Latn: É le ígwu ōhī kú Ulífāyi nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā kpó nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
idu_Latn: Ó géē cɔcɛ́ í gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó. Ó géē cɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ pī ɔyí ā, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ā. Ó lā ipú ígbíli kú Upáran anɔ́ɔ ó le pīya ofītɛ́ nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā ō lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nāa ba yɔ̄ á, amáŋ a géē mīyɛ, ɔ́dáŋ ka a géē má um abɔ̄ é géē je um ga ɔkpáncō ŋmá ɛgiyī uwɔ ā. Ɔ́dáŋ ka á má um ŋ́, á gáā mīyɛ alelékwū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ma ayí ɛpa ɔhá ŋmá īye kú Uhússim. É wɛ, Abítūbu mɛ́mla Ɛ́lpaalu.

eng_Latn: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē pīyeyī má ɛcɛ, ɛcɛ gē gbɔɔ́ ō jíliyē. Óndú le abɔ̄ kwu aɛ́fu, aɛ́fu ā gē gbɔɔ́ ō tó ódūdū.

eng_Latn: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma á. Ɔyí nōó ma ā gáā bī ogbló kú oje le gbō odúúdú aéwo á. Amáŋ gbɔbū ka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā kóō í kwú ɔyí ā, é lɛ ɔyí ā nú ga ɔkpáncō gaá lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛgiyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Usára yɔ̄ ī yúúfi ā, ó le híhó kahíníī, Ń yɛhɛ nóó. Amáŋ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yɛhɛ gbóó.

eng_Latn: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī gbiyɔ̄lā otú, Ɔwɔicō gē kɛlā lɛ uwá ipú ɔ̄na nēé ī nā ā.

eng_Latn: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
idu_Latn: N le okónu gwū, le īyī um tū wāajɛ. Ācɛ kē gbɔɔ́ ō cá um ɛcá.

eng_Latn: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā, é kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ igwɛ́ɛtá lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn, oŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nu éyi ga ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɔhá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ísāka, Ássa, Unáfutāli mɛ́mla Ubassán kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
idu_Latn: É gbo úklɔ́ ā ŋmá ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ā jāā ga ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā piíi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú úklɔ́ ō yá tīihɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú yá mɛ á. É klla kwú aínu kú ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā í yá tīihɔ kpɔ́ dúú. É klla gbɔɔ́ ō je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yá tīihɔ kpɔ́, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā jāā ga ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhīlī kú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tútū nɛ̄ ācɛ lɔfú gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ipú nū glá.

eng_Latn: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É gáā tá ágbe kú Usamérīya kóō jé gbóógbóō glá ŋ́. Ujúda kē gáā móōwē ɔwɛ éékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú ɛɛ́. Ífi gāajɛ okónu igá kú Ujerúsālɛm abɔ̄yīnū, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lā ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́hīlī ā wɛ Uhananíya.

eng_Latn: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
idu_Latn: N ka a má uwá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ká ā lɛ uwá tú wāajɛ. Ká ā lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā catāajɛ bōōbū nyā.

eng_Latn: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́hási, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɛláyíssa, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā da īyī nū kahíníī, Má ɔ ɛ́ɛ́, ɔkpáni um lɛ Unáaman, ɔ̄cɛ Usiríya nyā hɛ́tá, ó kē mīyɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ipú ɛhi nɛ̄ ó bī wā ā ŋ́. Kɛ́lā Ɔwɔicō, n géē nū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ká n̄ gaá mīyɛ odée ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ n gē ba Ɔwɔicō á. Ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n tíne á. Ká n̄ lā ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā odúúdú oyéeyī kú um, ká n̄ hídáagó kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ klla ba ɔ́, kóō bī um jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uríya í ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le gbo mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo gē gbō ɔwɛ kú okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ Ujɛhósāfati má ā, é gbɛlá ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á, anɔ́ɔ é kwú eyī ú pīya kwu ɔ́ ōfōōfūnū, bá gē kpó ɔfú kwu ɔ́. Amáŋ Ujɛhósāfati lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Ń wɛ Áhābu nóó. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nēe kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ aá wɛ ɔfiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aídengéli ā tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka anú ā jégéé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ācīije nēe bá nyā tá kwɛyí ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le pīya ékpó mla anú dúúdú. Ń wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa eyī Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ka n yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka kā n̄ yá ā gɛ ŋ́. N le kpaakpa iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō abālɔbányā ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ n kpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ́ɛ́ n le kpaakpa iyɔbū nū á, ohígbū ka n kpɔ́tū ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
idu_Latn: Urúbɛ̄n, Usímīyɔn, Ulífāyi, mla Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu lā ajɛ kú Ukénan ɛga nɛ̄ ádā nū tɛtɛ lā ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
idu_Latn: Aā gbo kláajɛ gblugudu iyɔ̄bū ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ká aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ó lɛ ŋ́, ó í cɔ̄nū fíyaa, nɛ̄ aá géē je pɛ́ kwú gbɔ̄bū lɛ eko kú aá. Amáŋ ákú ācɛ nēe ī kwu ga ɛgiyí nū kóō gbō uwā ŋmá unwalu ā kwú lɔhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, n lɛ eyī bū uwíndo kú inu ɔlɛ́ um yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé klla le okónu gwū lɛ ɔkɔ gbā kwɛyí ā, é lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. Ami gē tá ísu nɛ̄hi ā úgbagwú ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē yúuya kwūūū á. Iyē kú um kē wɛ Uyáwe nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cokónu nū lɛ Óndú ā, yá jīla lɛ ɔ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ íne ōbīya kú ɔ̄cɛ ká ɔ̄ híī yá okónu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ce ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
idu_Latn: Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, n le ifotó kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá kpó tū ɔtābɔ kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ híī mlanyī aá ŋ́. N kē yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu aá piyóó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ, Ujerúsālɛm nōo kwú pīya akwuna ā, pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ge ka ā.

eng_Latn: For many are called, but few are chosen.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé hī ācɛ alɛwa igwú amáŋ ācɛ lígíí nēé fu á.

eng_Latn: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
idu_Latn: N géē nū ācɛ nēe ŋmá ɛhícō ā, ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ligbó, n géē nū ācɛ ōhī kú uwá ga ipú ígbíli. N géē nū aígwu ō gbɔbū kú uwā ā ga ipú ísu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, n klla í nū aɛ́nɛ̄ e tá igbīhi uwā ā ga ísu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Okwū kú uwā géē wā báajɛ géē yɔ̄ ī níípī. N géē je uwá yíífi ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá aá ā.

eng_Latn: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī le ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kpó ce uwá ɛyí cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá. Amáŋ ayíkpó ā le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū uwā.

eng_Latn: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
idu_Latn: É géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ámāŋ, é géē tá ɔyī cē ɔ̄, kwu ɔ̄cɛ amáŋ ɛbɛ́ nōo lɛ ikpó bá ɛfu ā, í gáā yēeyī ŋ́. Eko nēé lɛ opo tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá kú ɔyā kú Áda ā, kú iháyí ɔ́mɛhīlī nɛ̄ Udáyírɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́ ā, é kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú gwó mɛ.

eng_Latn: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ífi lɔfú ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, wā í klá ɛdɔ kú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā igbledū glá.

eng_Latn: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ācɛ nēe ī tíne kéē lɛ um ŋmó ā, lɛ uwá gbájí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ uwá yálé. Ācɛ nēe bá ī gwéeyē tū um ohígbū unwalu kú um ā, lɛ uwá cīgbīhi ŋmá ɛgiyí um ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
idu_Latn: Á cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú alɔ le alɔ yálé, le ikpó da alɔ ɛyí tāajɛ. Alɔ móōwē bū ipú ɔlá mɛ́mla ipú éŋkpɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛcɛ. Amáŋ a kē le alɔ bī wā ɛga nɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu cabá anú ā.

eng_Latn: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
idu_Latn: Otú kú ícíícī ɔ́ɔmā alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā le tá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asírīya kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā gaá le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá úlā bá ɛga úlá éyi cofɛtá cɛpa, cofigwó kpó ŋmó. Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, é má úlúúlā kú okwū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā klá ajɛ bɛɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
idu_Latn: N le jé ka ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo lɔhi lɛ alɛɛcɛ fíyɛ́ o bá ī má abahi kú oyēeyī mɛ́mla o bá ī gwéeye, klla bá ī yá ɔdā nēé yá glá eko nēé yēeyī kpɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said it.
idu_Latn: Ami ā, n kē í yɔ̄ ī gwō abɔ̄ kú um dúú. Cɛ́ɛ́ ícɔ̄nū kú um ū í mɛ. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
idu_Latn: Ó kahiníi, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ ga um yɔ̄ dúú! Ó kwú um ŋmá uwēyī mɛ́mla ɛcá kú ɔdɔma ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ācɛ nēe lɛ anyā éwɔhá ā ahɔ̄ pi lɔɔlɔhi, lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá, cá uwá ɛcá, klla ŋmó uwá ijē. N le uwá īnyīlɛyí kpó fu ŋmá īkpɛ̄yí. Anɔ́ɔ n cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō le ɛka gbo ka, uwá mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā í klla gáā lɛ anyā éwɔhá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
idu_Latn: A ī je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī kú unwalu, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū kéē lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipū ā kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
idu_Latn: Ayí uwā í kē bá ɛbɔ́ glá ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōó gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ayí uwā ɛga okɛpɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ká n̄ lɛ Utímōti tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí aá piíí á. Ń lɔtū yājɛ icííci nɛ̄ ń póofu aá ŋ́ nɛɛ glá ŋ́ anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bá ī yɛ gɔbū ipú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. N yɔ̄ gē da iyī um ɔkā, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ebilíi i kpōō wā í lɛ ojámá yá aá cɛ́ɛ́ ká úklɔ́ nɛ̄ alɔ yá abɔ́ɔ ā kóō le bīya nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā kú Utekówa da Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ka ɛfiyɛ kú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē yá ā ká ɔ̄ ce anúɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɛyí. Ka ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, í gáā lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
idu_Latn: yɔ̄ ī hī ācɛ dóódu nēe gē wā í yɛ ā igwú. Ācɛ nēe bá ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú uwā kpaakpa ī nyɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ó gē hīīgwú kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
idu_Latn: Alɛwa kú ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ nōo gbɛnú bɛ̄ɛka ukílōgram ofɛpa cigwó ā, bá ī míya wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā í ce ācɛ báajɛ. Ācɛ kē bá ī ka atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ámíyā nɛ̄hi kú ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā, ohígbū koó bɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
idu_Latn: Anyɔcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā lɔfú wɛ ofɛtá, nɛ̄ aódiyɔ kú nū lɔfú wɛ ofɛnɛ, amáŋ ayípáncɛ́nyā ɔlɛ́ nū í lɛ ō gbaáluka glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēé gē cá aá ɛcá, klla gē yá aá ōwē, klla gē kā ɛdɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ obɔ̄bí dóódu ce aá ohígbū um ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ujehóyāda gē je ije ā lɛ ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú oōgllayá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ɔ̄ le pla ācɛ ogbɛ̄cɔ̄, ācogbɔ̄cí, ācɛ oyúklɔ́ oje mɛ́mla acogwínu, kéē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gílayá.

eng_Latn: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kéē bá ī yá ucē kú ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti gekwú anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi únóji kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɛhóram, le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um nyā, í lɛ ɛnyá ipu ɔdā nōó gē yá ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lɛ ɔtū ce ɛlā kú nú kpɔ́ɔ́cíí. Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kplɛ́fú ā lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe tíne kóō gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
idu_Latn: Arístākɔsi, olagbá ɔ́mpa um hokónu tū aá. Umáki nōo wɛ ɔyínɛ́ ɛpa kú Ubánābasii ā hokónu tū aá dúú. É lɛ ukɔ́ tū aá ɛɛ́, ka eko nɛ̄ Umaki gā, aá mīyɛ anú.

eng_Latn: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Urebéka le ojuju kú Ísɔ, ɔyí nū ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā, jé. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujékɔ̄pu kóō ga, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, Ísɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ojuju kóō lɛ uwɔ ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ci gwō.

eng_Latn: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le um má, é ī yɛhɛ tū um, klla ī mī ɛyí jigijigi.

eng_Latn: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
idu_Latn: Kpái, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kē í yɛ í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā. Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā í kē yɛ í lɛ ohi tá um. N lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Eyī yá um kéē lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī bɛyíkwu um ā tū bá um ā tá tū ɔkpá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔgba ɛnɛ kú ɛcɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi kpó kwu ɔ́. Lɛ ɛcɔ̄ nēé hī usadín, utópāsi éyi, mɛ́mla ugánɛ̄ti éyi kpó kwu ɔgba kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Usámūwɛ̄lu hápápá le bɛ̄cɛ gaá tíne ɛga nɛ̄ ó í má Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le da Usámūwɛ̄lu ka, Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ le tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Ukámɛ̄lu, ɛga nōo gwó inu ō blatū lɛ īyī nū ā. É klla ka ɔ́ɔ le tá Ugílgalu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
idu_Latn: Wōō, Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ áā? Anú nōo tɛtɛ le mu mla ācɛ āa, tá áncā ōfōōfūnū céé abālɔbányā yɔ̄ áā? Anú nōo tɛtɛ nwuné klla lɛ ojīlīmā ipú aéwo dóódu ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyōkwū nōo yēkwu ōfōōfūnū ā abālɔbányā. Anú nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi dóódu ā, klla kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ícɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí Óndú ā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā, gē nyɔ̄ ī tayínū á. Ó wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ gē kwu tayínū eko kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda he um ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn nēe hɛ́yīfuuú mɛ́mla ácí mɛ́mla ɔcí cɔɔɔ́ ā. Nááná n géē je ɔ́ yíífi nōó í je pīya áncā bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ámāŋ ka aígelī nēe tá alácɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú igbō ahāapa mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi ā ú, ó lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó le igbō mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi kpó lɛ ayíkpó kú nū á. Ayíkpó ā kē le kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ āa.

eng_Latn: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
idu_Latn: Le jé ka ācɛ Ubábīlɔn géē ŋmó ācɛ nēe géē nuunu tú uwā ā, klla ī kpó aókwū uwā tīkwū klá īyī uwā ipú aɔ́lɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā. é géē ŋmó ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū da uwá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. N kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu igelī nyā, ohígbū odúúdú ucē ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yíifa mla ɛcɔ̄ ō gbó ɔlá mɛ́mla ugóolu nɛ̄ ó kpó ŋmá Upafáyim ā.

eng_Latn: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ n gē tayínū anú á. Ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a wɛ ā, kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú um cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā bī um jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ tá Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ ádā kú Óndú ālɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ahínyá, ohígbū kóō gē ményinyi nɛ̄hi, ó kwú oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú lɛ alɔ o ŋmá lɛ ō je Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ɛnya yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ lɔtūce ɔ́ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
idu_Latn: E gbɛlá ka aá bá ī bīya um ɔtū icííci nɛ. Amáŋ é bá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, klla bá ī kpó uwēyī tū īyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ŋmá ipú kú ɛbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
idu_Latn: Lɛ inu ugbɔga tútū gbēyī um, ohígbū ka n leyī ce ka Ɔwɔicō í pó ɔkɔ nāa gē gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ um hɛ́tá lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā ī má ɛlā ō ka ŋ́ klla ī kpó okónu kú uwā klá.

eng_Latn: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ ka lɛ ā, ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō kpó odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ nɛ̄hi ā ŋmó, amáŋ ɔɔ́ le ɛga yá lɛ anúɔ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mlá anú. Ó ka anúɔ ɔ́ lɛ íkwu ō dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ágábáidu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá mlɛ́nyɔ́ cíí. Aá yúúfi ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō kú aá, Ɔwɔicō kú ádā ā, lɔfú je ije ā kpó tū ipú ɛkpa kú aá lɛ aá á. N mīyɛ ije nɛ̄ aá cílá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le Usímīyɔn bī gé lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔ́da je lɛ Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú nū kpó tɔ̄kwu cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ ga odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu, oŋmá igelī nēé hī ka Udáni, nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō ā, jāā ga igelī nēé hī ka Ubiyɛssɛba, nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá gbaáluka. Ó ka anúɔ tíne ō je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛwa lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
idu_Latn: Le da uwá kéē híī bīya ɔ́mpa uwā iye ŋ́, amáŋ kéē bá ɛbɔ́, kéē le saá saá mla ācɛ, kéē ke gbonɛnɛ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a í gáā jāhɔ̄ ga uwɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka é tútū ō jāhɔ̄ gā um ŋ́ dúú. Ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔtū olɔfú mla īkpɛ̄yí-olɔfú.

eng_Latn: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔfú kú aɔ́nya ā yɔ̄ ipú okónu mɛ́mla ipú ugbé kú uwā. Ugbé kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́gwā nēe lɛ aíkpɛyí ā. É gē bī ugbé ā le yá ācɛ ágbe.

eng_Latn: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya ɔhá dóódu lɛ ɔ́, ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú uwā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā kú okónu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē ce ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā oŋmá ɔtū éékpó mɛ́mla ákú ayí aflɛ́yí kú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Udɛbɔ́ra mɛ́mla Ubárāki, ɔyí kú Abínōwam gwííjē nyā.

eng_Latn: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔ́ ŋmó á. Ó kwú ōhī kú oyī kú nū ā ú kwú ogene kú akpáhɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ɔcígbɔ̄du kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū mɛ́mla ocígbɔ̄ndu kú ayíkīkpó kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū.

eng_Latn: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwá nɛ̄hi kú ókóme bá ajaajɛ abɔ́ɔ, é bá gē lúlé ɛháajɛ ɛfu. Anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ka, Lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ kú alɔ le pɛ́ ga ipú aókóome nēe bá ánūmā a! Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛga je lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ gē da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú jégédē lɛ olɛ̄lā kú nū éyi ŋmó, le inya ɔ̄ci kwu nyɔ̄ ga ipú éyi kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá fɛ̄ɛga tá gā um kú um le pīya ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ á. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú um lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī éwo kpɛ́mm kpó kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
idu_Latn: Ulában le yɛ gaá wá aálá kú nū ɔnwū, anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu kwú ɛka ocɛyí kú ɔlɛ́ ádā nū ú uwī á.

eng_Latn: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ugbɔga ipú ɛcɛ nɛ, ā híī je íne kú uwɔ tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Uféro, ká ā da ɔɔ́ ka, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Uhíbru ā ka á, mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá kéē nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɛ̄gbā gba um.

eng_Latn: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ujē gē tá kpákpá ipu ɔlá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛhɛ ō yɛ kú olíla lɛ á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ áncā, ó lɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
idu_Latn: Uhádādi le pó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́, Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ɔ́ɔ klla gekwú dúú ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Uhádādi le tá ɛgiyí Uféro, ɔcɛ́ ā, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ká n kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē jāhɔ̄ gā um, kéē klla lɛyítáajɛ gā um.

eng_Latn: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
idu_Latn: Kwú odúúdú unwalu kú um ú ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú um cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú odúúdú ákanya kú um.

eng_Latn: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nɛ̄ a kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nēe lɔnɔ tū uwā iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú útuló, ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi le yá ikpɛ́lā tú um nɛɛ? Ŋ́ŋ, ó géē jāhɔ̄ gā um, í pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n géē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ́ nōó wɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ébrahām ā kē wɛ ayí Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ó ŋmá iyē kú Áyísīki nāa géē lɛ ayááyí nɛ̄ n cokónu ō je gā awɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yá ɔ̄ lɛ éyi kú aɛ́nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú nēe bá ā ŋ́ mā ā, ami nɛ̄ aá yá gā um ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
idu_Latn: Olīkpō kú acá kú Ucérōbim nōo nwūla acá gaá kwu ɔdɔ kú ipú inu ā wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā. Acá ɔhá ā nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā ā kē le nāŋdaa nyɔ̄ í le iyē kwu acá ō nāŋdaa kú Ucérōbim ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ɛga nēé lā ā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le túbá, le ɛyí bú kwu Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni.

eng_Latn: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú igelī ā kwú hútú ɛɛ́. Ācɛ bá ī dīíbáā, ācɛ ōhī klla bá ī tɔ́ɔga. Ācɛ ɔlɛ aá nēe kwú ā, í bá ī nuunu ɛ́ nēé kwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā ŋ!.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú da um ka.

eng_Latn: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ācɛ igwáahātá kú Usílōwam nēe pɛ́ kwú eko nɛ̄ inɔ̄ɔda ogbāajɛ nɛ̄hi ā wúla klá uwá ā? Aá gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka uwá wɛ ācɛ nēe bīya íne fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá kú Ujerúsālɛm á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē je ɔbɛ́ɛna ā gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya, nōo géē yá kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū bīya ā kpó yá uwā ɛhi ā.

eng_Latn: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ klla í kwu nyɔ̄ í tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ipú ajɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́gɛ̄cɔ̄, ohígbū ícɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ojīlīma mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Óndú ā, eko nōó géē cāŋjɛ wā í jīla ɛcɛ iyē ā.

eng_Latn: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ óbō, ɔkplɛ́fú, ɔtā, ɔyī, ítū mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú ítū, mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú dóódu kpó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ɔkplícī ā kwú okwū ā ú ce ijakī kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā Ubɛ́tɛlu á. Ó le ikwū nū je klla le ekwu kú nū yɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú okwu ā ú nyi Ubɛ́tɛlu abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yá um klla je oyēeyī gā um á.

eng_Latn: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du lɛ ɔkā ā pó ā, ó kahíníī, Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim nɛ̄! N cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́, amáŋ ó le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó ā gbɛlá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛnyā ā ka ā wɛ ɛlā iciíci. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uwā ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
idu_Latn: N jikwū klá uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um. A kē le ɔkɔ kú um pó le um tabɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlíyākim, Ussɛ́bina, mɛ́mla Ujówa tá aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā ohi kahíníī, Aá ka Aramáyīki lɛ alɔ, ɔkpani. Alɔ jɛ́ɛyí nū. Aá híī ka Uhíbru lɛ alɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā bá ɛyí ɔdɔ ā bá yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Uhólɔn, Udébiyɛ.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī ā, n gē pi aá ahɔ̄ ka, ipú ícɔ̄nū kú um, n géē bī abɔ̄ olɔfú kú um le gbō aá.

eng_Latn: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē nyīla ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú aá. É klla í ma ayí alɛwa. Ācɛ ā géē lā abɔ́ɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lā ā. N géē yá kóō lɔhi lɛ uwā, é klla géē gbagbénú fíyɛ́ otɛtɛ kú uwā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi, odúúdú ācɛ cíkā ō cɛ̄tra ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā jājīlīmā nwuné lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jɛ́yí nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
idu_Latn: Ussíyɛ̄lu ma ayí ɛtá dúú: Umíssɛ̄lu, Ɛlsáfan mɛ́mla Usíkiri.

eng_Latn: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfūnū ŋ́, é géē lɔfu je piya ācɛ újuulu, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē gbɔɔ́ ō bɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ éyi ga ɔlɛ́ ɔhá géē yɔ̄ gē yúúwɔ́ɔkɔ, ge gwōtū ipú ɛlā kú ācɛ ɔhá, gē ka ɔdā nēé cíkā ō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Umósīsi ɔ́ɔ jɛɛga lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō tɔ́kpá ɔnyā ō tá, ɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá ɔnyá nū.

eng_Latn: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kwú Ákan ú mla, īlī, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla ogbló kú ugóolu ā, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ákan, aɛ́na, aíjakī mɛ́mla aálá kú nū, ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó ga ɔpɛ́ kú unwalu á.

eng_Latn: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
idu_Latn: Aá gbla ucē kú Ɔwɔicō yá abɔ̄ aá wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ unū ā.

eng_Latn: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ gē ka ā ka, Abɔ̄ aá lɛ ācɛ alɛwa kú ɔlɛ́ aá piíí ā kpó ŋmó, klla le iyī aá íye tēelihɔ mla ɛcí nɛ̄ aá ī pa ā, eko ōwē kú aá gē wā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā ó le yɛ tá Ukapánɔm mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū. É gbojī abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō géē je uwɔ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ piyóó. Ó géē kwú uwɔ klla í je uwɔ nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Ó géē fu uwɔ ikpó ŋmá ajɛ kú ācɛ o yēeyī ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
idu_Latn: É géē yá ka ācɛ alɛwa kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ka aá cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ alɛwa géē yá ibīyājɛ tū ɔ́mpa uwā, ācɛ ōhī í wɔ́tū ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dā nēe yá nēe bá ā, n gbɛlá ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um mɛ́ɛnɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ odée jé ŋmá odúúdú italā nɛ̄ n yá uwā a. Amáŋ, eko kpií é gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē obɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usísɛ́ra le pó ka, Ubárāki ɔ́ɔ le tá Utábɔ ā.

eng_Latn: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ohígbū ka ó wɛ o piíí kéē géē pó piíí ka a gā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujówābu ā gaá háyi pī okwū kú Amása. Ó yɔ̄ ī ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɛce Ujówābu mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ɛ́mba ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō yɛce Ujówābu nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ŋmá ɛháajɛ, ami ā ŋmá ɛhícō. Aá ŋmá ɛcɛ nyā, ami ā ń ŋmá ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
idu_Latn: Upíta le bēhé tá ipú ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi le ɔlá gwó odúdɔ̄lɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ Upíta nyɔ̄ gaá cīce mɛ́mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ŋmá ipú odúúdú úklɔ́ mɛ́mla ákanya kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ó gē má ipú ɛcɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ē gbā ɔcí kú uwɔ ā, klla ī glla uwɔ yá ā wɛ ācɛ nēé nwū je ŋmá Ubáyíblɔsi. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yɛ ipú úgbéenyi ā gē tá ɔsú ipú aɛ́ga o je odée lā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu lɛ ā. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú unwalu kú um, ohígbū ka a lɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
idu_Latn: Ó ka igelī nēé hī ka Ubɛ́sa nōo cɛyí ɛfu éyi ipú ígbíli ā, wɛ ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n. Ó ka igelī nēé hī ka Urámɔ̄tu, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā wɛ ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi á. Ó ka Ugólan, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ubássan ā wɛ ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ á.

eng_Latn: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā nɛ̄ é géē tú ācɛ nēe ī yɔ́ɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ ɛyí wāajɛ. É klla kē í bī oōgɔ̄ kú alɛɛcɛ wā oŋmɛ́yí piíí. Óndú ā ofōōfūnū nēé gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kpɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ kwú igbīhi í pīya kwu ɔ́, nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Óndú ā gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ í gáā jé ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ? Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ gaá le ka lɛ Áhābu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gā, nōó má ɔ̄ ŋ́, ka ɔ́ɔ géē je anúɔ ŋmó. Ó ka anúɔ gē yúúfi Ɔwɔicō klla í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
idu_Latn: Ń yɛ í le íne bīya ɔ́dāŋ ka ń yɛ í lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ká olɛlā kú um kóō gekwú. Amáŋ ń yá lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frēm wɛ ípɔ́ɔ́nū kú, Ussutɛ́lah, Ubɛ́ka mɛ́mla Utáhan.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔ́dā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Áhāsi yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mla Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.
idu_Latn: Aá dɔɔ̄kā ɔcɛ́ á, Óndú ā kwú ɔcɛ́ ā ú lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gáā yá kú ɛgahi nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aólɛlā wā í je ɔlɛ́ uwā wu ŋmá ajɛ ā, kóō cīgbīhi gé lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, a kē yɔ̄ í pi uwá ahɔ̄ Awɔ gē je ɔfú lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ kéē kɛlā lɛ uwá á, amáŋ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ wɛ aódahɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ a cɛ̄ lɛ aéwɔhá kéē lɛ uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ um abɔ̄ ō le kwu aá ci ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɔ́dāŋ ka á wā fíyaa gāá jīla um ɔwɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ, odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Unábalu géē yɛ í le pīya aókwū ɛ́ɛ́, kú eyī kú óócí kóō nyā.

eng_Latn: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le tútū ō ga ajɛ kú Ái mɛ́mla odúúdu aícɔ́ɔja kú nū á. Ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū nēe wɛ, úlā ofɛtá cigwɛ́hɔ̄ ā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú otú.

eng_Latn: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ukífasi táaha wā Ántiyɔ̄ku ā, n ka ífulá tū ɔ̄ lɔfú lɔfú ipú eyī odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá lɛyí kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā, ohígbū koó yá ɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Let all your things be done with charity.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ dóódu nɛ̄ aá í yá ā, aá yá ɔ́ ipú ihɔtū.

eng_Latn: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ lɛ okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ koó géē yēeyī kóō lɛ ohɔ́ɔnyɛtá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ka anúɔ géē tɛ̄hɔ wā ā má.

eng_Latn: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
