idu_Latn: Ɔjá mɛ́mla ɛtɛ́ dúúmā kú ipú inu ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔdā ō ce okónu nū ŋ́ mā kwú tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a gē cɔ̄nū da Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ a gē lɔtū kɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋmá okónu kú uwɔ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu le má ka Ábsālɔm ɔ́ɔ tá ɛlā nōó nwū ɔ̄ ā, ó le odée kpóce ɛyí ijakī kú nū kóō cīce ɛyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū Ugílo á. Abɔ̄ ó le ɛlā ámōōmɛ kú nū kpó ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwɛyí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le iyī nū tōōlī á. É kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ipú únóji kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū.

eng_Latn: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gāá ŋmó aɛ́nɛ́ ámāŋ aádā ācɛ dúúmā kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ayí uwā yá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē ŋmó ayí kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aɛ́nɛ́ ámāŋ aádā uwā yá ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū yá ā glá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
idu_Latn: Mīyɛ ije nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ká ā ŋmó ɔ̄ tū úklɔ́ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄gbā nyā géē kwɛyí ulé kú oyēeyī kú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē bla ka n̄ gbō uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, aálelékwū nēe bá ójīla kú ɔkpáncō gē yúufi uwɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ ga ogbeé ɔhá. Anɔ́ɔ ó gā ajɛ igelī nōo lā á.

eng_Latn: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā, nɛ̄ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma éyi géē da ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lɛ ɔdōtōhí ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdu unwalu kú ɔlɛ́ ā kóō má ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā, lɔfú jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā dóódu glá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ŋ́ mā í kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wā í lɛ ɔfú tū Ɛláyíja iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó le úwé kú nū kwú wu ɛ́nyɔ́ anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu le hɛ́ Áhābu ɔbū, le tá Ujɛsríli á.

eng_Latn: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
idu_Latn: Ó le mīya ŋmá ɔdɔ kú igbīhi inu éyi ga ɔdɔ kú igbīhi inu nōo pīyeyī kwu ɔɔ́ abɔ̄ ɔhá kú ɛplá nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ā. Ó wɛ umíta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
idu_Latn: É ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka é tɛtɛ má Utrofímɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi mɛ́mla Upɔ́lu ipu igelī, anɔ́ɔ é kpéyīce ka Upɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ kē le ɔ̄ bī wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
idu_Latn: Oōmiya kú odúúdú ajɛ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ nyā nēé géē hɛ́tá ajɛ ā géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa cē āyā, abɔ̄ ɛnɛ kú nū ā. Āyā nɛ̄ igelī ā kwu ā géē yɔ̄ anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
idu_Latn: O í jíla nú iyē iyɔbū ede kú Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɛya nēé gwó lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká Óndú ā kóō mīyɛ aá. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē jíla ɔ́ iyē igbīhi kú ɛ̄cī Usábáti ā.

eng_Latn: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si da ɛwa ā kahíníī, Aá bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla ogbló wā gaá kwú um bɛ̄ɛka n wɛ ɔ̄cohɛ́julúgwu ā nɛɛ? Ɛ̄cī dóódu n yājɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gē nwɛ̄lā, aá kē kwú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udɛbɔ́ra da Ubáraki kóō nyɔ̄ ka Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú í bī ɔ̄ tá. Ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ Usisɛ́ra yálé ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ubárāki gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Utábɔ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofu-cɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ olɔhi ɛga o lúúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ nyā kóō gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, wɛ uyádi ofɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́kíkā éyééye, cɛ́ɛ́ igelī nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta má kwōkwū iyɔbū ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́, klla le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá á. Ó da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ odée yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ojuju obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ujɔ̄ kú ikwū nɛ̄ Uháman, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ágāgi, miya tū ācɛ Ujíyu ā ci.

eng_Latn: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
idu_Latn: É gē yá aólíla italā ohígbū ɛlā kú íla nēé gē ka ŋmá okónu ā. Amáŋ ɛlā okónu kú ojéeyī gē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé kéē lɛ oyēeyī otɛtɛ kú alɔ ā nyɔ́kpá mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔfú nōo gē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ ī bīyíne ā yíífi, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ híī wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ínoōbīya gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ohile ā gāá kwú okwū kú nū ú cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā, gaá le ɔ́ nyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usóra mɛ́mla Ɛ́ssitāwol, ipú únóji kú ádā nū, Umánōwa. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofu.

eng_Latn: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē je ɔ́ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he anú nōo wɛ Ubasíllāyi ɔtū ā lɛ ɔyí ā. Ɔcɛ́ klla ka ka anúɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ba anúɔ ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu le aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēe jé ō kpɛ́fú fíyɛ́ dúú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó, anɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō tíne Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ipú ɛcɔ̄ nēé hī ka Ɛwū kú ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō wɛ ogbɛhá amáŋ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, fíyɛ́ ō wɛ olíla nōo gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ā, ɔyā le gla ɔnyā ā ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi ka anúɔ yīipú á.

eng_Latn: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n géē yá ɛ̄nyā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo géē kwú ŋmá ipú ífi ā géē wā ī ka uwɔ ɔ̄kā nū.

eng_Latn: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ ámāŋ ɔnɔ̄wá yōōō le mafú ipú īlī ā, ó kóō wɛ ɛdɔ īlī dóódu, ayíka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká nōo ī nyíla yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. É í ma ɔ́ fú lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
idu_Latn: Óndú, eko le yá nāa géē yá odée ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ le íne kú uwɔ ā tányílá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā le Abíyāta nū ŋmá úklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó lɛ Óndú á. Ɛ̄nyā le yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka Ussílo lɛyíkwu Ɛ́lāyi, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayááyí nū ā kóō le yá jīla ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
idu_Latn: É géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó klla í jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ é géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ō hágágā kú ije ō lɛ italā piíí.

eng_Latn: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
idu_Latn: Ó géē mɛ ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄na nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē nā eko nōó gē gbiyɔ̄lā ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē má ipú ɔ̄na ā.

eng_Latn: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛyītáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, ā híī cīgbīhi kwu um ŋ́ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ā wɛ Ahiyésa, ɔyí kú Ammíssadāyi.

eng_Latn: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
idu_Latn: Īkpɛ̄yí ahāapa ā kwɛyí aɔ́cɛ́ ahāapa dúú. Ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́. Éyi kú uwā cɔɔcɛ́ abālɔbányā, ɔhá ā í kē hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́ ŋ́. Eko nōó gā ó gáā cɔɔcɛ́ gbojī ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
idu_Latn: Ń kōō gáā lɛ okónu kwu aɔ́dā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́, iyó kú ɔtū nɛ̄ n gē bī ɛ̄cī dóódu ā wɛ ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo kwu aícɔ́ɔci ā.

eng_Latn: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi, ó cɛgbá kéē gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ínoōbīya gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā, o ŋmá eyīnyinyi kú nū, ó lɛ um fu céé ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ ó le ɔ́ miya.

eng_Latn: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
idu_Latn: Ó gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā, ó klla gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā. Óndú ā gē hɛ́ alagbá tá ŋmá agbá á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyá he Óndú ɔtū fíyɛ́ ā, ɛyí ō táajɛ kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka aɛ́ya ō gwó mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ɔ̄? Ó wɛ aɛ́ya kú álá nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ō gwó lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ɔ̄, ce ɔ́ ɛgbá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɛyí ō táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ he ɔ́ ɔtú á. O lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú lɔhi fíyɛ́ ijē kú omlede ō je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá gwó ɛya gā um klla gbā um ɛ̄gbā iháyí ofɛpa nɛ̄ aá bá ipú ígbíli ā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu?.

eng_Latn: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ bōōbū á. Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ odée je lɛ ɔ́ kóō le.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli wɛ, Upɛdahɛ́lu, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdu.

eng_Latn: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
idu_Latn: Ó le lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicó nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē gbɔɔ́ ō yá káā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi. A klla géē je eyī kú uwɔ gicō má Ɔwɔicō mla ɔtū péee glá.

eng_Latn: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ Upɔ́lu hīgwú ā, Utatúlɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́ ka, Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ Igbómína ojīlīmā, Ufélīsi. Abɔ̄ a wɛ otrɛ̄yí ojéeyī nɛ̄hi ā, alɔ bá ɛbɔ́ gbojī ajɛ nɛ̄hi, a klla yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōlɔhi ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ocɛgbá alɛwa ohígbū olɔhi kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhósāfati le ije mɛ́mla ojīlīmā lɛ nɛ̄hi ā, ó lɛ ojuju yá kóō lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áhābu éyi lɛ lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ mɛ́mla Áhābu kéē kwú pīya ohilí.

eng_Latn: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
idu_Latn: N gwéeyē nwunééné ohígbū ka n má ka ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ōhī gē yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ íne ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya ce ɔcɛ́, nōo kē wɛ iháyí ɔ́mahāapa nɛ̄ Uhósīī wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ussalimanɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya cāŋjɛ kwú ɛyí ú hɛ́ kwú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le íbɔm cē tū Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ācɛ Ujíyu ā wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ. A bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi mla íkwu kú uwɔ ā, le uwá hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā géē je ɛbɛ́ lɛ aá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ klla í je igbō lɛ á ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ aá géē lé klla í nū ipú. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le iŋini nɛ̄ aá ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā pó ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ alɔ ā? Aá ka iŋini tá alɔ ŋ́, amáŋ aá ī ka iŋini tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, nɛ̄ ipí ā kwú lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā, ó lɛ ā, agwú bɛ̄cɛ ipú ágbē kú ɔlá nɛ̄ yi ɔ̄cɛ ā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu nōo wɛ igbómína kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā gē je ɔ́lá lá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ayínɛ́ nū gā gaá túkpɛɛ́, leyī pīya kláajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gē lɛ ɔtū plicō ohígbū oyēeyī kú nū, ɔ́ɔmā í gáā yá kóō jɛ licō lígii fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō gbonɛnɛ lɛ aá, kóō méyīnyinyi aá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, anúɔ í gáā nū ācɛ nēe hile bá abɔ́ɔ ā bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó kéē géē wɛ aólɛlā kú uwā. Ó klla ka ka ɛ́ɛ kéē géē pi uwá tū ɛ̄gbā ō gbā aɔ́wɔ kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ukpa nōo ī kwú ɛbɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: A le ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ka anúɔ ī yá alɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú alɔ ā yá piíí. A le italā yá Ujerúsālɛm fíyɛ́ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú yɔ̄ ipú aá nōo jééyī klla jɔ́ɔ́dā ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō le mafú kú anúɔ jééyī klla tōhílīpú o ŋmá lɛ ucē olɔhi nɛ̄ ó ī yá ā. Ó kē ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ olɔfu nɛ̄ ó ī yá ipú ɔtū otúwāaje mɛ́mla íjééyī ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je éyi kú aígbáanɔ ā gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔhá ā ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā le uculo kú iyē ō gwu yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu lɛ iyē kú Óndú ā hī, ó géē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kéē cílá ulé kú íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla óbíipú nēé bī ā ɔ́klá ɛpa. Ohígbū kéē kwu ajɛ kú um ú tēelihɔ o ŋmá lɛ aɔ́wɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́cí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ohile nēé yēeyī ŋ́, nēé kpó bá ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā.

eng_Latn: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
idu_Latn: Ussɛmáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā le tá ɛga Uréhobɔ̄wam mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe jīla Ujerúsālɛm, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Ussíssāki ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛnyā wɛ ɔlɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā Aá le igbīhi ce kwu um, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ igbīhi ce kwu aá, kwú aá ú kpó tū Ussíssāki, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Aá le otúta je gicō kú aá cābɔ̄ kéē kpɛ́fú tú ɔdɔ kú Ubábīlɔn. Aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kpó gbāajɛ fíyɛ́. Aá lɛ ácɔ́ɔja nēe ī gbāajɛ kpó kéē bá ī gbō igelī ā gɛɛɛ. Aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kpó kwāajɛ tayínū ipácí. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya ka n géē yá Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō je ɛhi kú eyīnyinyiy lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Íkwu nyá nāa lɛ ō cɔ̄nū ohígbū ɔcí nyā ā? Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna tóohi kahíníī, N lɛ íkwu ō cɔ̄nū, ká n̄ cɔ̄nū ká n̄ gekwú.

eng_Latn: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um le bīya, ohígbū ka é kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ú bīyatāajɛ. N yɔ̄ ekwu, ɔtū kú um le gbenyi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ óbō gwū ɔ̄ áklō, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā oyī mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tū ɔ̄, klla le anú abɔ̄yī nū ɔtū bīya. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwā klla gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu tū uwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛka kú Óndú gbo mɛ́mla odúúdú uwá nēe wā ɛgiyí nū Uhɛ́brɔn ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ īkpō ɔkɔ cē ŋmá abɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ ú bī nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ nɛ̄ ī tɔ́sú. Ó kē kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu igelī kú ɔlɛ́ ācɛ o tá ɔ́sú.

eng_Latn: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
idu_Latn: Ogbɛnú kú ɛcɔ̄ mla ɔjɛ í gbɛnú gaajɛ unwalu nɛ̄ íla gé hɛ́ táajɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nāa lɛ eko nāa wɛ ɔyípōklóbiya ā, kóō he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
idu_Latn: Ádā kú Usɔ́lu Ukíssi mɛ́mla Únɛ́ɛ ádā kú Ábna ā wɛ ayí kú Abīyelu.

eng_Latn: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla ācɛ nēe le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhāsi le tá Udamáskɔ̄si gaá má ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi, Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa ā, ó le ede nōo yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛdɔ nū piíí ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Uríya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le blakwu ɔ̄na nōó nā lɛyíkwu uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá wɛ ācobɔkwu ɔdā tayínū nɛ. Aá wā gaá má ahi kú ajɛ nyā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kɛlā gā um igbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā odúúdú aá cíkā ō jé, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu cíkā ō le jé, kéē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū aá ā tá, o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú Unásārēti nɛ̄ aá nyɔ́kpá, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē jé héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́ kahíníī, Ícɔ́ɔ́ja ɔkwɔ̄ɔkwɛ̄yi gē gwó ī kokónu eko nōó le ɛfú yálé, ó wɛ eko nōó gáā kpɛ́fú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu Urebéka, ɔnyā nū, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔdɔma. Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nōó gbā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ Urebéka, ɔnyā nū, le ipú yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ipú ákanya nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ n hī Óndú ā igwú kóō wā í tá um abɔ̄ ā, ó kē le ɔkɔ kú um pó ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Ó klla jáhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū kú otábɔ̄ nɛ̄ n je ā pó.

eng_Latn: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ í ma īyī nū fú lɛ Áhābu á. Eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ īkpɔ̄tū kú ɔkpɛtā ajɛ kú Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
idu_Latn: Ā yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá má ɔ̄, Ɔcɛ́ ká aá ī wā yɔ á, ó yɔ̄ ī ce ɔyí ijakī.

eng_Latn: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ ikwū kú ɔyí nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā pó, anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō éyi hī Uhága igwú ŋmá ɔkpáncō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Uhága, ɔdí gē je unwalu gā uwɔ ā a? Ā yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ ikwū kú ɔyí nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā pó ŋmá ɛga nōó yɔ̄ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
idu_Latn: Ubɛnabínādabu wɛ igbómína kú ajɛ kú Udɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɔwá kú okómpinu ā mīya á. Odúúdú nū wɛ umíta ɛhīlī ce āyā. Ɛplá nōo tá ŋmá ɛga ɔwɛ ā wɛ umíta ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán wɛ, Ubúki, ɔyí kú Ujógli.

eng_Latn: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ ɔ́da kú Usáyírɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya á. Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō kwú um pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ó klā le úklɔ́ je gā um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ anúɔ Ujerúsālɛm ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. Abālɔbányā, odúúdú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Óndú ā, aá kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá kóō yɔ̄ mla aá, abɔ̄ aá géē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔdā otīīhɔ nɛ̄hi nēé yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ŋ́ mā, aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā wɛ ákú uwɔ: ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛya kú íne ō bīya, mɛ́mla ɛya kú ulé ō cílá. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé kpó gā um kóō wɛ ɛya otīihɔ gā um ā í wɛ ákú uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā. Aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ uwā bá yɔ̄ ā: Ugíbiyɔn, Ucēfɛra, Ubéerɔ̄tu, Ukɛrīyat, Ujeyarím.

eng_Latn: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
idu_Latn: Ó gē bī ojuja le klá úgādā ɔcɛ́ kú nū, kóō tayínū.

eng_Latn: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā ōhī bá yɔ̄ ī cokē nū ŋmá ɛga oligbó. Aóhī kú uwā wɛ Umerí Umagadalíni, Umerí ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujémīsi nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mla Ujósɛ̄fu, mla Usalómi.

eng_Latn: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō í gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā kwu ɔ́ ɔkɔ ŋ́. Ó gē gwɔ̄ aólɛlā kú nū ɔ́ci. Ó gē yá aólɛlā kú nū italā.

eng_Latn: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó habɔ̄ uwā tá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le ɔ̄kɔ gbā igbo ɔ́mɛtá, yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ékpó ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó kwúcē wā īlī igbɔhá kpɔ́, nōó gbɔɔ́ ō nyīla kpɔ́, óndú īlī ā í je ɔ́ yɔlá.

eng_Latn: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ipú aígelī kú ɛyí ɛfu, mɛ́mla aóci, mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda nēé hī ka unɛ́gɛ̄bu, mɛ́mla ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjāmin, mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá yɛ jīla Ujerúsālɛm tá biílí ā, ācogbāálá klla í bá ī gbo aálá kú uwá áluka kpɔ́ ɛ́.

eng_Latn: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔtū mɛ́mla odo ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá. N géē je odo olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋmá ɔtū kú aá, klla í je ɔtū nōo ī lɛyítáajɛ ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɔ́ɔ gbla ā? Usɔ́lu klla le ɔ̄kā da ɔnyā kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā ka ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ á. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā le awulú wiyē. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu nɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó tukpɛɛ́ le okónu hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ ayípɛ̄ gē ma ɔdā nēé wɛ ā fú, ŋmá lɛ ɛdɔ ucē nēé gē yá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú jé ɔ́dāŋ ka ayípɛ̄ ā lɛ ucē olɔhi klla wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi glá.

eng_Latn: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā yɔ̄ ī kɔkɔ gɔbū ka otú éyi, ɔnyā ɔhá ā ɔ́ɔ má gwutá ce ɔyí nū, kwú ɔ̄ ú da ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa gē tíne kéē téeyī olɔhi kú ɔcɛ́. Amáŋ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kú ɔ̄cɛ gē ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
idu_Latn: Ehée, ɔkpani um, jāhɔ̄ gā um. N kwú ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ipú nū ā ú gā uwɔ ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Nyi okwū kú uwɔ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ōcē kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛnyi gē pɛ́ ŋmá agada ā mɛ, ó gē gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ īlī kú nū kpó na, klla lɛ iyē gwā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ o yēŋēē nōo gē pɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
idu_Latn: Óndú, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ká ā yá ɔdā nēe le kpaakpa ā. Jáhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n gē gbā gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é í ŋmá abɔ́ɔ bá ī nyɔ̄ ā, é géē má aókwū kú ācɛ nēe yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um á bá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī ā. Aɛ́kɔ̄ nēe gē bá ī kpó aókwū kú uwá lé ā, í gē kwú gbóógbóō ŋ́. Ɔlá nōo ī yi uwā ā, í gē nyī gbóógbóō ŋ́. É géē wɛ ɛbohéyī lɛ odúúdú alɛɛcɛ nēe géē má uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ igwu í hile ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ ɔcí ufáyin í hile ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔcí kú ufíg, í gwá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, nááná, o ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, n géē hɔ́há ce aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ aéwɔhá kéē híī lé ɛbɛ́ dóódu nēé fu oyī bónū ŋmá anú ŋ́ má yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: But he spake of the temple of his body.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā nū ā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa ɛga okɛpɔ kú alɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ kōō gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā túbla abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gē lé ɛpɔbí ɔɔ́pu á. É kōō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā wā abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ī kɛlā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É yɛce ɔ́ eko nōó yɔ̄ Ugálīli ā. É gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ dúú. Ācɛnyā alɛwa ɔhá nēe wā Ujerúsālɛm mla anú ā, bá abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɛyí ɛfu gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ abɔ́ɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛga je lɛ Ujɛhóyākim kóō lɛ īlī kú agbá kú nū púla, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ā ɛplá eko ohile kú oyēeyī kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛtá ā lɛ opo kú nū tá. Anɔ́ɔ ínyílɔ́wɔ éyi nōo yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄ɔlá bɛ̄ɛka ɛmu ā le míya ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā í tá āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú aísu mɛ́mla aŋ́jɔɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ āá.

eng_Latn: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpanī nū ā le má ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla anú. Ka anú ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó klla le abɔ̄ nāŋ́daa kóō yá uwā italā ɛɛ́. Ɛfu le jíliyē. Okwū kú aɛ́nɛ̄ e kwú ā kē bá úláyi bɛ̄ɛka īmū ā. Nááná, ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā í mɛ ŋ́ kpɔ́. Abɔ̄ kú nū kē le nāŋ́daa ō yá uwā ōwē kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti le ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka ā pó ā, ó cēyītīkwū kóō lɛ ɔwɛ éyi má kóō lɛ Ujísɔ̄si hɛ́tá. Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá, ayíka á wɛ ɔyā kú Usísa gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ iyī nū pīya ɔcɛ́ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o bɛ́yíkwu ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄ nōo lɛ̄ ajɛ dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
idu_Latn: Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé bī le yá aígbóoje-otáajɛ éyééye á kú Agblīhɔ mɛ́mla ákú ukɔ́tin ā nwuné nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ó tōō miya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, alɛwa kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gwíijē í cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó gé lɛ anú nōo wɛ Ábsālɔm, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē bī ɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gē lɛ ɔbá nū āa Ó ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā kwu ācɛ ohile ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mla Árɔ̄ni í má ka, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā lɛ odúúdú úklɔ́ kú uwā yá, kéē klla bī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
idu_Latn: kē bī ɛ̄nyā gē lɛ uwɔ á. A le pīya akwuna lɛ aéwɔhá ā, klla kwú īyī uwɔ iyē ú tēelihɔ mla ɛcí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú ukpɛ̄ nōo wɛ ákú Óndú ā ú lɛ Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu kwú Usáyílāsi ú bíyē, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ igbīhi nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kwú uwá ú kpó tū ipú abɔ̄ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
idu_Latn: Uhúkóku mɛ́mla Uréhōbu mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kpó lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔkpá mɛ́mla ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmó ā ú lɛ Uhátāki. Umɔ́dɛkāyi le da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔkpá ɔ́ɔmā bī gē lɛ Ɛ́sta kɔ́ɔ̄ klla lɛ odúúdú ɛlā ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ da ɔ́ dúú, kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō ményīnyinyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, ācɛ Ujíyu ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔcí ō le bī ɔdée kú akésiya yá, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ oje udɔ ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛlu ma ayí ɛpa: Ujówɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ábīja.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē wā ŋmá ɛga otīihɔ kú nū. Ó géē wā ajɛ, klla í yāwu ɛyí aɛ́fu ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Usílpa, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú Ulɛ́ya ā wɛ Ugádi mɛ́mla Ássa. É ma ayí mbáā lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ajɛ kú Umɛsopotámīya.

eng_Latn: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujonátan í pó ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛka gbo tū ācɛ ā ká ɛ́ɛ lé ɔdōlé ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó nā ɔcí nɛ̄ ó bī ā daa le ɔ́ wu ɛnwú ā, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá okónu, anɔ́ɔ eyī gbo ɔ́ gɔɔ á.

eng_Latn: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ ī gbɔɔga ɔlɛ́ um ā kwú mlanyī ɛɛ́. Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú um í gē tɛ́yíwāajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú um gɛ ŋ́. É gē má um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ um wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi éyi yɔ̄, nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Unikɔdímɔ̄si. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi wā gaá le da Ujɛhósāfati ka aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa kú Ɛ́dɔm le pɛ́ ŋmá ogbeé kú ísu nēé hī ka ísu ɔmā ā wā gaá kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄. É da ɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ Uhásāsɔn, Utáma dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N lɛ ɛlā éyi nɛ̄ n gáā ka lɛyíkwu aéwɔhá nēe lā kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ācɛ nēe gwō tū ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. N géē fu ācɛ obɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē fu ácí ŋmá ajɛ ā. N kē í nya ācɛ Ujúda nēe lā ipú uwā tá ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
idu_Latn: Aá kla géē jé ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā kē í nya aá tá.

eng_Latn: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá kwú obɔ̄bi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú yá aá ā ú yɛ́ɛhi, n kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi dúú. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ n kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā dúú kōō yɔ̄ nɛ̄ n cíkā ō je yɛ́ɛ́hi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi n gē je yɛ́ɛ́hi iyɔ̄bū Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo wɛ ijáalí kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ili nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē klla bī ɔdōtɔ́kpá ā lɛ ohi kpó lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, N lɛ úklɔ́ mla ɔ́da kú uwɔ, nāa je ā yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the LORD of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú kú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā, le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gbɔbū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da Unátan ka anúɔ le óbíipú nɛ̄hi bī tū Óndú ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ɔ́ bī ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ɛɛ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ gáā kwú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, Ɔwɔicō le ɛlā ka ga um. Eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ iháyí ɔ́migwó nɛ̄ Usedekíya ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, anú kē wɛ iháyí ɔ́migwáahatá nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn dúú á.

eng_Latn: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛnyā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē cɛ̄ lā mɛ́mla alɔ, kéē géē jē pīya ācɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla alɔ á. Kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kú alɔ dóódu kóō lɛ apī hɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwá ī hɛ apī ā.

eng_Latn: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó má ɛwa āa, é le tū ɔ̄ eyīnyinyi ohígbū keé bá ī móōwē, í klla má otábɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ogbō uwā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le cɔ̄nū mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ bī iyī uwɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ī bīyíne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ā í mabɔ̄ ɔnū nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ ā tá gbɔbū lɛ ɛnɔ o gaajɛ.

eng_Latn: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojiji kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nōo ī bí tāajɛ eko nɛ̄ otú kwú bī ā. N klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo kwú ŋmōkókó ā.

eng_Latn: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi éyi lɔfú yɔ̄ nōo le kpaakpa klla wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī fu ɛjī ajɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla olajógbe kú uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le kwu ajɛ gbojī ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
idu_Latn: ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka lɛ aá ícɛ nyā ā, aá kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ɔtū kú aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá nwū ayí aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwá kéē kllɔcɛ́ ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
idu_Latn: Ákisi tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Ɛyí nāa le táajɛ gā um ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Amáŋ aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá ohile ā le ka ka á gáā ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā mla alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofuciigwóléyi nɛ̄ Ása lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ómri kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa. Iháyí ɛhīlī aflɛ́yí nōó lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Utɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
idu_Latn: N géē gwíijē ga uwɔ, Óndú, lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, klla kē ī hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
idu_Latn: ka n géē tū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um ulé, n géē je ɔkpacaŋ́gelī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n má kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ka. N géē gwō aólɛlā kú um ɔ́ci, klla í yá ācɛ nēe gē tū um eyījii ā italā.

eng_Latn: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, anyākwɔ́cɛ, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda, aá jāhɔ̄. Ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā yá jéjée eko kú aá, ámāŋ ka eko kú aádáádā aá āā?.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Uménāhem yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka igbɔhá kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá yá yēŋēē ŋmá odúúdú ɔ́bíipú kú aá, n géē yá ka aá lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú aá igbɔhá kpɔ́. Aá klla í tá alácɛ̄ kú uwā ā gwó ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú Alelékwū Ihɔ ú tá ipú ɔtū kú alɔ kóō wɛ ɔdā aflɛ́yí nōó le kwajɛ ŋmá ipú aɔ́dā ohile nōo í kpó lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɛlā kú uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī ka lɛ anúɔ ā pó. Ó ka ɛlā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
idu_Latn: Ámɔn wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛpa ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ɛpa. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Umɛssúlɛ̄mɛti ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uhárusi nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujótiba ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ipú ajɛ kú uwá ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú tēelihɔ oŋmá lɛ ucē nēé ī yá ā mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nēé lā oyēeyī ā. N je ucē nɛ̄ uwá yá ā ká o wɛ ɔdēēlihɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ōnyílá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
idu_Latn: É dɔɔ̄kā kéē lé ɛbɛ́, ó le ɛwá kpó gé lɛ uwá. Ó klla lɛ ɔdōlé nēé hī ka umaná je lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhádādēsa, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ Usiríya nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi ā, anɔ́ɔ é le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kpó wā í le jīla Uhélamá. Ussóbāki, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhádādēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Usóba, kpó uwā trɛ̄yí á.

eng_Latn: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ihɔtū nɛ̄ a ī mafú eko dóódu lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ayí ká alɛɛcɛ géē wā ī tayínū ɛháajɛ acá kú uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayí ugwū ī tayínū ɛháajɛ ɛ́nɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá nɛ̄ eko le gla bɛ̄ɛka áwa ɛtá ā, ɔ̄nya nū nōó jé ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, le bēhé wā ipú inu.

eng_Latn: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
idu_Latn: N géē yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ kpaakpa eko dóódu. Okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla anú ā kē í yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá nááná í kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́. Īnyī mɛ́mla ɛ́kla ā í yɔɔlá bónū ŋmá anú dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
idu_Latn: Ó le hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā í lɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le tá aéyīpɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ abɔ́ɔ biílí ā yɔ̄ ge nwū ācɛ ā ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ nōo gē pi uwá anú ā, klla ī je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ́ ka, aá lɛ ɔ̄kā da, ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā gē yá aá ɛɛ́, nēé kwú aá ba ajɛ, abɔ̄fú gē yá aá ōwē á, ó wɛ ohígbū obɔ̄bi kú aá nɛ̄, ohígbū ka aá bīya íne klla yá obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ opeyī ā kwú úwé kú nū ú púla bónū, lɛ ómbili tá gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā ā géē wɛ olɛlā kú īyī aá. Ɔyí kú nū mɛ́mla ákú uwɔ klla í wɛ olɛlā kú īyī ūwā. Ɔyí kú nū ā géē ca uwɔ ɛyí tāajɛ piyóó, a kē géē kwú ɔ́ ayīnu amīyɛ ikpó.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le yá, odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe yá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛflɛ́ɛfu ā, o dúúmā í klla gáā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ujē nōo gē bū tū ɔ áklō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ, wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ikpó wú aíkpɔ̄cí ufáyin ā ipú ɛga o yá ejé nōo yɔ̄ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī ā. Oyī nōo bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú ā pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ukilómīta ofigwo ā. Olipú kú nū kē wɛ umíta ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ n kwú ɔkpá kú ajɛ nyā í kpó lɛ Ubárūku, ɔyí kú Unérīya ā, n le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá nū ā jé, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ éyi í wā í háyi pī iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
idu_Latn: Aópeyī ɛpa nēe báajɛ okónu ɔwɛ ā pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ gáā yɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi, ményinyi alɔ.

eng_Latn: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, alɔ géē kpɛ́fú tá uwā otú, ká alɔ kwú aɔ́lɛ́ kú uwā nēé gwó lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā ú wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le ije kplá ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ um dóódu, nōo wɛ ogbɛhá. Aá da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ije tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu lɛ aá ŋ̄.

eng_Latn: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá bá gē bīya íne kpɔ́, aá mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú aá géē je kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú aá, kóō wā, ka aá gaá kɛlā nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ ka ā kpɔ́. Ń kē gáā má ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī dúúmā ipú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ n wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē ga ɛgiyí Uféro, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō í kpó ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
idu_Latn: nēe hile ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá, nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu í kpó yíífi ŋ́ mā, Usólōmɔn le uwá kpó tū úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú kú nū. Úklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā nēé gē yá jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla gaá le ɛlā ka gā um igbo ɔ́mpa kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī má āa? Anɔ́ɔ n tóohi kahíníī, N má ɛ̄hī nōo ce ɔlá le nwula tɔ́ɔtɛ́ leyī pīya kwu ɛgɔhá ŋmá ɛhícō. Ó kē yɔ̄ ī wú juújuú.

eng_Latn: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɔfú nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ cíkā ō yúufi nū. Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɛbɔ́ gē yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, ɛga nōó ī gbō ā.

eng_Latn: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
idu_Latn: É bá ī yɛ ipú ajɛ kú Ufrayigíya mɛ́mla Ugalésīya ohígbū ka Alelékwū Ihɔ ā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ ā ajɛ kú Ésīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
idu_Latn: N le jé ka ɔdā dóódu lɛ ɛjī klla lɛ ɛnyá, amáŋ, íne kú uwɔ í lɛ ɛjī, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī leyīkwu ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin ā wɛ Ussiméyi, nōo ŋmá Uráma ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kpó ejé ā tū ā wɛ Usábdi, nōo ŋmá Usséfam ā.

eng_Latn: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usíhɔn í cɛ̄ ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē bū ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tútū kéē kpɛ́fu tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Ujahási gaá le ɔfú kpó kwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
idu_Latn: ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá da Udéfīdi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ anú ɔ́ɔ gáā gwó ɔlɛ́ lɛ anúɔ kú anúɔ̄ lā ipú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá ī gbā ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú aflɛ́yí ā ɛ̄gbā ohígbū koó kwú odúúdú íkwu kú nū í kpó lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā. É bá ī gbā ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā ɛ̄gbā dúú, bá ī ka kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpā ā gɛ? Ɔ̄nyɛ nuunu tú ɔ̄ glá gɛ?.

eng_Latn: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā, é géē kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō dúú. É klla gáā mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ é géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
idu_Latn: n géē kpó aólɛlā obɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi, wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ. É géē kpó odúúdú ɔdā ohéyīfuú kú uwɔ nāa lɛ ŋmá íjééyī mla ɔdōōjé kú uwɔ ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ alɛwa nɛ̄hi. Eko nēé le má ka ajɛ kú Ujása mɛ́mla Ugílɛ̄d ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ olɔhi lɛ ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Íjīpiti yá uwá ōwē nwuné lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé nyīla bá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā lɛ á. Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā bá gē yúufi kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu leyī hɛ́ kwu ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā glīglī anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, ɔtū kú um í bɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu oyēēyī kú um ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ jāā kwu ícɛ nyā a.

eng_Latn: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ obuga kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā yɔ̄ á. Abɔ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá iyāwu nōó yɛ ā, ó má yājɛ ɛgiyí obugā ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛplá oje igwɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtú nɛ̄hi. Ó yɛce ɔwɛ mɛ́mla íkpā kú aádáádā nū Udéfīdi, klla lɛyítáajɛ kpaakpa lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō dóódu.

eng_Latn: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi bī nyíleyí nɛ̄ ó nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá, awɔ piíí ā gáā gwō tū ipú ukpa nāa je ɔ́ɔmā á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā géē mīyɛ ulé ɔlɔhi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da Ujóssuwa ka.

eng_Latn: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Usáyímɔ̄n le má kéē gē je Alelékwū Ihɔ ā ŋmá lɛ abɔ̄ ō le ce ācɛ ɛyí kú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ó kwú ije ú kwu uwá eyī anɔ́ɔ ó ka.

eng_Latn: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo ī yíihɔtū kú um ā, kwú abɔ̄ í bū ɛplá ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um ā, Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō piyɔtū nū á.

eng_Latn: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ a bī iyē kú Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā cɛ̄ lɛ Unábalu á. É bá abɔ́ɔ bá ī gbēyī ohi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka, ācɛ Usírīya ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ le pīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ufi lɛ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō fīyɛ̄gbúlú gē jíliyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ owu gē jīliyē ipú ūpū ā.

eng_Latn: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
idu_Latn: odúúdú aódōbɔ̄bí nēe bá āa ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá eyīpú kú ɔ̄cɛ. Anú gē je ɔ̄cɛ tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ijakī kú ipácí. Ó géē bɛ́yíkwu ācɛ, ācɛ kē í bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́. Ó géē lā ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū aɔ́máapú nū tá.

eng_Latn: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɛ́ya kahíníī, Ɛyí um lɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Ugádi.

eng_Latn: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
idu_Latn: Ehée, ipú ɔdā dóódu nēe yá alɔ nēe bá ā kpɛ́mm ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíihɔtū tá alɔ ā le yá kú ālɔ̄ le yálé.

eng_Latn: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da anyā ā kahíníī, Aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka n jé ka aá gē tíne Ujísɔ̄si nēé nyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
idu_Latn: Útuló yɔ̄ ī kplá ɔlá nɛ̄hi nááná, īmīyōjó nōo bá ipú nū ā í ja bónū ŋmá anú ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ um tíne ō yā āobɔ̄bíipú ā ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nááná, ó tōō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Uwá abɔ̄yī uwā cíkā ō mīyɛ italā kú īyī uwā á. Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kóō le cɔ̄nū lɛ italā yá uwā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔtū le lé ucɛ kú igbō nóō gē nū ŋ́ mā ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Éeyē le mu uwá ipú, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yá kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya nōo gē gbāajɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Asírīya dúú ā, kóō le eyīnyinyi uwā má. Ó klla tá uwā abɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé tūgwó igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō klla lɛ ɔdā nōó ka ā yá. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ɔnwū ā wɛ oōŋmó, amáŋ ébú lɛ cē klá ajɛ ā yɛ ɔnwū álá ā jīla tá biílí.

eng_Latn: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
idu_Latn: É klla gáā lé ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ oyī yɔ̄ anú ámāŋ ka ɔdōlé elihɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú uwā ā géē je kpó pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ipɔ́ɔma éyi kú Ujúda ā ipú eyī kú um. Ācɛ kú Ékrɔn géē je pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujébusi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́ tū mu mla ɔfú kú nū, ó klla je ɔdā ímlɛ́ ō yá, íjééyī, mɛ́mla ɔdā o jé, kú úklábɔ̄ dóódu lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ákpláka kú ɔdā o le hɛ́hɔ̄ kú um tɔ̄ɔtɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bī, iyó kú um kē le fékéé ā.

eng_Latn: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ nōo gē nuunu tá um nyā yálé, ká ā lɛ uwá yíífi. Lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ācɛ nēe ī dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ō yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
idu_Latn: N da iyī um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔtū bīya gā um nɛ̄hi lɛ āa? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔtū kú um playicō lɛ āa? N géē leyīce Ɔwɔicō, n klla géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú um nōo ī hɛ́ um tá ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nēé kōō kwú ɛgwā ú ŋmáajɛ, ámāŋ kéē kōō lɛ ɔdā ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá gwá nááná, ó gáā yá uwā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É géē lɛ abɔ̄ ce ācɛ o doōcē ɛyí, ōcē kú uwā kē í mɛ.

eng_Latn: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú í jé alɔ ŋ́, amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ kē jé alɔ. Alɔ gē lɛyí ce ikwū, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá má ɔ̄ ā, alɔ yēeyī kpɔ́. Nááná nēé yá alɔ italā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, é kē ŋmó alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɛpa nɛ̄ ó doōcē ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ í bī ɔdā dúúmā wā ipú ɛcɛ ā ŋ́! Ɔdi nɛ̄ alɔ í je ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ āa. Ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: N cokónu lɛ aá ka, aá géē lā abɔ́ɔ, amáŋ, odúúdú aá í gáā lā abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka Ukálɛ̄bu mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa ōfōōfū uwā nɛ.

eng_Latn: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
idu_Latn: Ododó kwú hépu klɛ́ɛcɛ ɛɛ́, eko kú ijē ōgwó gā ɛɛ́, alɔ kē bā ī pó ɔkɔ ijē kú okóho ɔkpɔkpɔ̄ ipácí kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
idu_Latn: Aá gē bī okónu nɛ̄ aá ī gwū ā le yíkpɛ́lā klla gē nuunu. Aá gbɛlá ka ɛdɔ kú okónu ō kwū ɛ́gɛ́nyā géē yá ká n pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, tá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi abɔ̄ kéē le jɛ̄ lɔfú. Ká ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá géē yá ā kóō he uwɔ ɔtū Óndú. Lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā catāajɛ, kéē klla cāŋjɛ igbɔhá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
idu_Latn: Aá géē dɔɔ̄kā um, amáŋ aá gáā má um glá ŋ́. Ɛga nɛ̄ n kē yɔ̄ ā, aá gáā lɔfú wā abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kwú abɔ̄ u kwu okwū ɔhá dúúmā, ó kwu īyī nū iyē ú tēelih. Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ iyē gwu, ó í gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō je yá yéŋéé.

eng_Latn: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ɔ́ á, Ayááyí uwɔ géē lā ajɛ éwɔhá ɛga nēé géē yá uwā ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā iháyí úlā.

eng_Latn: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
idu_Latn: Ó bī iyē kú Óndú ā bī ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa nyā lɛ ede gwó. Ó klla le ɔ́glɔ́ nōo géē bī ɔgālā kú éŋkpɔ̄ ɛnɛ glá bū jīla ede ā tá.

eng_Latn: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ā kóō yúklɔ́ o hɛ ācɛ idáagó iyɔ̄bū ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́mpa ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā plla cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō. Ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ā da ācɛ ā kéē lɛ ojíbó gbā gbla ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́mpā nēé bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī yá ɔ̄ ágbe amáŋ nōo yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nōo wā gé lɛ Émɔ̄si ā kē yɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka, Óndú ā le ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba ŋmá ɛfu kú Usáyɔn bɛ̄ɛka oji nɛ̄ ágábá gē tū eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛbɛ́ má gáā kwú lé ā, ó dɛ̄gba ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gblágádáá bɛ̄ɛka akpáabana ō gbo ā. Anɔ́ɔ ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ gē lé ā kwú ŋmɔ́lá tāajɛ yéwú, ácí kú ɛfu nēé hī ka Ukámɛ̄lu ā kwú wúlēpū booloo, klla le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi nɛ̄ ikpo mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú nū le kpó mi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odūngwɔ̄wɛ playi ɔwɛ gē nwūla klla ī je gwū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o yújulu ā gē pīyeyī agōdō kú nū lɛ á. Ó bɛ̄cɛ ga ɛga dúú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ōyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛcɛ ā géē túkpɛ́ɛ iyɔ̄bū nū. Odúúdú alɛɛcɛ dóódu géē túkpɛ̄ɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́, ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú uwā í kē yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uréhobōwam wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ nwū tū ɛwa ā ipú kéē cɛ̄ Upáyílēti kóō lɛ Ubárābasi hɛ́tá lɛ uwá ikɔkɔ Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō lɛ ipú piyajɛ ā, le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔwú ā, ígwíígwu kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɛ́gbla kú nū yá, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo kwú anɔ̄ ā ú tū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ŋ́ ɛyí, é gáā je ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Asárīya, ɔyí kú Uhosáya mɛ́mla Ujohánan, ɔyí kú Ukaréya mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe ī yá aflūmā ā da Ujeremíya kahíníī, A gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ íbí. Ɔwɔicō í tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu alɔ, ká ālɔ̄ ɔɔ́ híī ga ajɛ Íjīpiti ŋ́ nɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi ā géē wā í kpó uwā bá ɔlɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú uwā ā. Ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcí ufáyin yɔ̄ nɛ́ɛ géē yá ejé, mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ igbāmkpa yɔ̄ nɛ́ɛ géē yá igbō. Ó wɛ ajɛ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú nū ā mɛ́mla ɛnwú. Ó da uwá kpɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ka á yá, ɛ́ɛ́ gáā kwú ŋ́. Ó da uwá kɛ́ɛ̄ híī cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā plla uwá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē wā í nya uwá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko dúúmā nāa le tá ipú unwalu, n géē yɛhɛ tū uwɔ nɛ̄hi klla í yá uwɔ ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he uwá nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ é le pó ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ ka aá géē je ije lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā eko nōó í lɔhi nɛ̄ ó í yá ibīyājɛ tū Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ígbíli kú Ínoobīya. Anɔ́ɔ é yɔ̄ gē yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē je ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ ā. É gaá lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ cē ci Urefidím, amáŋ éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gé gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, ka ɛbɛ obɔbí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ísrɛlu nēe bá ī kɛlā kú odo mɛ́mla ɛlá ōgbo kú ɔtū kú uwā áncā ka aá gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Da uwá kéē pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: Uhátussi ɔyí kú Ussɛkaníya ŋmā ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi. Usekaríya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upárōssi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū ā, wɛ ofaahāapa ce igwó.

eng_Latn: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ádām le pīya iháyí ɔfu ɛhīlī ce igwó ā, ó le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá nōo kē gbla anú ā ma. Ó le iyē ce ɔ́ lé ka Usɛ́ti.

eng_Latn: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda kahíníī, Ká ɔnyā ā kóō bī aɔ́dā ā kéē kwú pīya ákú nū mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ń dɔ̄ɔ̄ka kú ācɛ amānyā kéē yɛhɛ tū alɔ ŋ́. N tíne ká n̄ lɛ ulé cíla ɔ́ amáŋ á kē má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ uwēyī nēé je lɛ aá ā mɛ́mla ɛyí okwaajɛ kú aá ā, aá géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ ɛga ɛpa klla í lā, í má abahi ipú ajɛ kú abɔyī aá. Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um í lɛ ukpɛ̄ ɛga ɛpa ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā dúú á. É kē í gwéeyē piyóó.

eng_Latn: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
idu_Latn: Náaná nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi klla ī lɛ́ɛcɛ kpɔ́ ā, N jé ka, ó géē lɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yúufi Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
idu_Latn: A géē lā ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn, ɛga nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ̄, ayí kú ayí uwɔ, aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú aá, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā, géē kwu um ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: N kwú ikpáti kú Ɛka nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbo mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu ā, nɛ̄ usiléeti nɛ̄ íne bá ipú nū ā ú hayi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
idu_Latn: Owu nyā ī tá klá anú mɛ́mla odúúdú ofú kú nū abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nya ō kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Aótrɛ̄yí ā kwú ɔkpá ā ú tá ipú inu kú Ɛlíssāma ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le tá agblɔ̄cɛ́ gaá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpá ā kpó ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya le ɔtū kú nū yéékpó kóō bī odúúdú ɔfú kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aícɔ́ɔja kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū wā. O yá kóō lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú olɛlā kú nū yíífi ā, ó géē wā í yá ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla anú cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyā nū. Amáŋ ojuju kú nū ɔ́ɔmā ī gāa kwú ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla da um kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā bá ī tū ujɔ̄ tū um.

eng_Latn: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā, a klla ī hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
idu_Latn: É jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē lā ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī yá ucē ɔkwɔɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́. Odúúdú ɔdā nēé ī yá ā í le kpaakpa ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɛce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yá ucē ā, í kē gáā lɛ ɛbɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā le omlede ŋmó fíyaa, anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ umu fú lɛ igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā yá fíyaa.

eng_Latn: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ālɔ̄ gā ɛgiyí nū eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwēyī nōo kwú ɔ̄ ā kóō lɛ ālɔ̄ kwú dúú.

eng_Latn: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ubássa gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ ú nyi Utɛ́sa á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, Ɛ́la le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɔkpacaŋgelī kú um le ŋmó odúúdú ācɛ kwu ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ŋmá ɛháajɛ jāa ga ɛhícō kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi pīyɛyī ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ó ŋmó Ugolíyāti ā, Ábna le ɔ̄ bī gé lɛ Usɔ́lu, ó lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú Ugolíyāti ce abɔ̄ gɔɔlii.

eng_Latn: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɛbéenyi ōnwū ú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā tínē kóō lɛ Upɔ́lu hɛ́tá ā, ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá ɔdā nēé miya ā ŋ́. Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ aálagbá nēe jé ō tágwā ā kéē lɛ ómbli tá tū enyi aflɛ́yí cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le agwā tá gɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
idu_Latn: Ó kwu pīya bū ɛhícō gaá bū Ɛnssemɛssi ga Ugɛlílōtu nōo pīyeyī kwu Adumím ā. Ɛjī ā gaá bū ɛcɔ̄ kú Ubóhan.

eng_Latn: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
idu_Latn: Alɔ gbla aá yá kú ālɔ̄ híī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ŋ́, kú ālɔ̄ bá ī lɛ anyā éwɔhá mɛ́ɛnɛ ɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā kéē cīce ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ igbō ahāapa ā kpó, ó lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, ó lɛ uwá kpó cē, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ ayíkpó kú nū kéē kɔ̄ lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwɔ tɛ́cɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ajɛ áncā, klla í kpó odúúdú aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ wā í je okwū uwɔ wu lé ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
idu_Latn: Óndú le yá kú ɛlā obɔ̄bí nōo í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú um ā, kóō le jī wu um ɔkɔ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī kɛlā.

eng_Latn: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
idu_Latn: Ofúlutu mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi ā le fu ŋmá ɛháajɛ kwūūū. Ofū nōo kē ī kwu tū iyē nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɛhícō.

eng_Latn: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ hí nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá gē cē ā í nwuné ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔdōlé, amáŋ ó nwuné jɛ̄ nōo ī nū aá ipú ŋ́. Aá lɛ ejé nɛ̄ aá ī gwá, amáŋ ó nwuné jɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī gwá kóō kwú aá ŋ́. Aá lɛ īlī ō klá iyē amáŋ ó jɛ̄ nōo ī ci ofū ō ŋmó aá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ o yúklɔ́ kú ipú aá gē mīyɛ ijē amáŋ ó gē bī ije ā le yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
