idu_Latn: Ó le bɔ̄bí lɛ aá nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́, ācɛ kú Umówābu, Aá nēe ī gbā Ukémɔ̄si, ɔwɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā ɛ̄gbā ā. É lɛ aá kpó yíífi ícɛ nyā. Icɛ̄bɔ̄ kú aá cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá kwú pīya alagbá kú ɛfú ɛɛ́. Ācɛnyā kú aá kwu pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le mu ā, ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ pi wā ɔ́kɔngɔ ɔkpá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é yāajɛ lɛ aɛ́béenyi olɔhi ā yā tū ipú úkpám á. Amáŋ é lɛ obɔ̄bí ā kpó tá bónū.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔfú ō kpɛ́fú kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yíífi ɔpɛ́ kú Ujésiríilu.

eng_Latn: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛhīlī ā lɛ opo kú nū tá á. N pó ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede kú ugóolu nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um plicō ohígbū nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá kú um tá aá abɔ̄ ā kóō le pīya áncā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
idu_Latn: Uféro da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ úklɔ́ kú aá āa? É da Uféro kahíníī, Alɔ nēe wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, wɛ ācogbāálá, ɔkpani, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
idu_Latn: Aá le odúúdú ācɛ o gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ā kpó hīgwú wā, kwu odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú nū ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā kóō híī hile táajɛ ŋ́. N gáā gwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄hi lɛ Ubáalu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó yɔ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, n géē jé ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ula nɛ̄ Ujéhu yá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō kwú odúúdú ācɛ o gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ú kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka í jé, awɔ nōo yá ācɛ ɔhá lé ā, géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ o bī ulé. Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla gbɔɔ́ ō mīyɛ ije o ce ɔ́ ɛyí ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ abɔ̄fú. Aólɛlā kē í wā í tū uwɔ ufi, nāa í fīyēgbúlú. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ú wu.

eng_Latn: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā ka anúɔ wā í ka unwalu kú anúɔ ā lɛ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī yúufi ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ gē yá anúɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ anúɔ da iyī anúɔ ka anúɔ géē kɛlā lɛ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā ipú eyīyōce ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā glá.

eng_Latn: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
idu_Latn: Ayípōklóbīya, aá jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyéeyī kú aá. Aá gwéeyē eko kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú aá. Aá yɛce ɔwɛ kú ɔtū kú aá, mla ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ eyī kú aá má ā. Amáŋ, aá le jé ka, Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ kú odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā tū aá.

eng_Latn: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
idu_Latn: Ó wā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū. Ó klla bī iyó, aɔ́dā oōlɛ ɔdōlé lɔnyɛ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ kpó gbō cīgbīhi aínyankwūlumī kú nū. Eko nōó gā ā, ɛdɔ ɔ̄kā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú nū ā, ó le kpó da Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya éyi le hɛ́ wā í yɔ̄ ī wúlatū ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā. Amáŋ eko nōó lɛ ɔnyīlɔ ā má ā, ó kwú cēbla abɔ̄ ɔhá kú ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó ka nyā kē le yá lɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī eko nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn cāŋjɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔnwū álá ā pí, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ kú ébú nōo pɛ́ ŋmá nú wā ajɛ ā le nwuné jɛ̄ nōó lɔfú mu ocíbú glá á.

eng_Latn: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n le okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ī yá ɔdā nōo he uwá ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ uwā gē bī ā gē he uwā ɔtū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɛna ŋmó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya gā um, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ nēé ŋmó ā tū um ā. Ɔ́dāŋ nēé bī ɔyí álá le gwɛ́ɛya gā um, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé bī ewō le gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā. Ɔ́dāŋ nēé lɛ ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ bī wā gaá gbā um ɛ̄gbā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyī kú ókóome nēé bī wā í gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛ ɔtulalī fú tū ɔlá gā um, ó kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛcí nēé bá ī pā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ka, anɔ́ɔ é kōō jɛ́ɛyí nū ŋ́ kpɔ́ áā?.

eng_Latn: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī gɔbū ī nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó yɛ bū aípɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla aígelī alɛwa yɔ̄ gē nwū ācɛ ā ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
idu_Latn: É klla le ɔláwoni mɛ́mla ɔdokwɛyí, ikakí kú īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ gɔ́.

eng_Latn: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī nya odo kú aá tá, ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ ɛyí kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá cāŋjɛ kú aá yá aólɛlā kú aá italā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē wú igwu ā. N géē je ɔfú lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔbɛ́ɛna nōo lɛ ajī oje, nɛ̄ āpīice kú nū wɛ oje udɔ ā. Aá géē ca ācɛ alɛwa tāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú agbénú kú uwā ú kpó kéē kwú pīya ákú ami nōo wɛ Óndú kú odúúdú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
idu_Latn: Aá má ka, aá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō kē í bī le yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, kpó lɛ uwá, o yá kóō híī cɔ̄nū du um, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē cɔ̄nū mla aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá kú alɔ nēe géē lé igbīhi um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
idu_Latn: Ɔdānyā cɛgbá ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō jééyī klla jɛyí ɛlā ɛ́ kóō jɛ́yí nū. Īkpɛ̄yí ahāapa ā kwɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ahāapa nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā cīīce ɛyí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
idu_Latn: N dɛ̄gba kahíníī, N gáā kwú ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ihɔtū kú uwɔ nāa ī mafú eko dóódu ā bī um háyi icō á.

eng_Latn: The LORD's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā kú íjééyī ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō yúufi Ɔwɔicō. Óndú ā hī aígelī nɛ̄hi ā igwú, Aá jāhɔ̄, aá ācɛ nēe jīla tɔhā ipú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dúúmā nēé gē pīyatū mɛ́mla ācɛ o bī ulé, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū í he uwá ŋ́ mā, le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi. Ācɛ nēe bá mla anú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ulá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka Ustifánāsi mɛ́mla Ufɔtunátūsi mɛ́mla Akáyícɔ̄si gā amānyā ā, é húmáyī tábɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ kú aá tá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ ga um fu owu ŋ́, amáŋ, ó cɛ̄ gā um yɔ̄ ī móōwē ipú oyēeyī kú um.

eng_Latn: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn mīyɛ ɔkwu ɔcɛ́ kú ádā nū, Udéfīdi á. Ó kē kwú ikpó ú kwajɛ ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū lɔfú lɔfú.

eng_Latn: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
idu_Latn: Aóladógbe kú alɔ kē má ɔdā nāa yá alɔ nyā, anɔ́ɔ é yɛhɛ tū alɔ, klla yá alɔ ɛbɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
idu_Latn: Upáliti, ɔyí kú Uráfu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú uwá le jīla kwɛyí ā, ayí kú Ulífāyi kwú ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yi kú icɔ́ɔci í cíkā ō lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́, ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ō lɛ ɔnyā ékpónú, ó í gbēyī cíí, ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cīīyīnū bī glá. Ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o miyɛ ugbɔga tū ɔlɛ́ glá. Ó klla cíkā ō jé ō nwū ācɛ ɛlā glá.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujési, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Óbɛ́di, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubówāsi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usálmɔ̄n, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unáhssɔn.

eng_Latn: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
idu_Latn: Ó da um kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, lɛ ɔkpá nyā gwū cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔja he klá anú, jāā gbó oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ. Abālɔbányā ā, ācɛ alɛwa géē bá ī kpó iyī ūwā eko bónū bá ī tíne kéē jɛ́ɛ́yí ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um, Ábsālɔm, yɔ̄ lɔhi? Anɔ́ɔ Ahímāasi le ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, ɛwa jīla bá abɔ́ɔ bá ī yúuya, amáŋ ń jé ɔdā nōó wɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē gbagbénú ŋmá íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ gē bīya ā, ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é gē dɔɔ̄ka kéē bīya íne kú anúɔ fíyɛ́ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have told you before.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, n tɛtɛ le da aá táajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yúnwū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ́mpa aá ŋ́. Aá híī yúnwū kú ɔnyā nū ŋ́, aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū, aɛ́na kú nū, aíjakī kú nū ámāŋ ka ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ákú nūŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé wɛ ayípɛ̄ ā, é lā Íjīpiti. Eko ɔ́ɔmā é lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ jé, klla kwú pīya aákwuna.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, ó yɔ̄ ī pā ɛcí ipú inu kú ɛcí kú nū nēé hī ka Unísiroki ā. Ayí abɔ̄yī nū ɛpa, Adramélēki mɛ́mla Usáresa bī ɔkpacaŋgelī lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú pɛ́ kwu ga ajɛ kú Árāratu. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū ɔhá Esahádɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē nwū ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ɔwɛ nēé géē yíihɔtū tá aɔ́bá mɛ́mla ayí uwā.

eng_Latn: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, n géē tū ɔlá gaá je igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú Urába yi tāajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē bá ī dīíbáa ɛ̄cī nēé gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú ā. Ekwukwu kú ācɛ nēe gē kpɛ́fú ā géē dɛ̄ kwuuu bɛ̄ɛka ofúlutu nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Cāŋjɛ, Ó! Óndú ā, ká ā kɛpɔ̄ kú uwɔ, ká aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kéē pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa nēe bī aámíyā nɛ̄hi ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á. É lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ oceyī wiyē, anɔ́ɔ é klla lɛ īlī kú ugóolu kwú ɔtū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā gboce uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔni, Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Usselúmīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúríssadāyi.

eng_Latn: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛnyā nēe jé ō tá īlī ā le owú kú ɔgalúlā, owú odufā, mɛ́mla owú nɔwā nēé tá ā kpó wā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɛpa le yɛ ā, Uféro le ɔ̄na nā abɔ̄ ó háyī okónu ísu kú Unáyilu ā.

eng_Latn: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā, aá yúufi Óndú ā. Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kahiníīī, Aá abɔ̄yī aá í jɛ́yí ɛlā ā ŋ́ dúú nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka igelī nɛ̄hi ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā lɛ ligbó nɛ̄hi, aɔ́máapu kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó jégēdē ŋ́ ŋmó ā lɔfú gwɔɔ̄ci kú ɔmápú uwá nēé ŋmó ā glá. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúú ŋ́ ŋmó icííci. Ohígbu ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ kē jégēdē ŋmó ɔ́mpānū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ olɛlā kú nū ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
idu_Latn: n géē blatū ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mla Ujékɔ̄pu, Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ébrahām ā. N klla géē je okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla uwá ka n géē je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá ā héyī.

eng_Latn: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá wā, ācɛ nēe gē nwū odée ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā, aá jáhɔ̄ gā um, n géē nwū aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū géē bī éŋkpɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó.

eng_Latn: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gē hī uwɔ igwú ká ā tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ŋcɛ́nyā ā le inya kwu ga ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nū gaá le odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ oyá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nyā ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛyí kú ita nyā wɛ ā. Da uwá ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn gā Ujerúsālɛm gáā lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā kpó kwúcē ga Ubábīlɔn mla anú.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē pa aá hīla bɛ̄ɛka ácí nɛ̄ owu gē je kpó ga ɛga dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá nɛ̄ anúɔ ka aígelī nɛ̄hi ā kéē wɛ ɛtá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ ī ka mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī bīyíne cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō yɔ̄ ī ményinyi alɔ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Usɔ́lu í klla nū ācɛ kú Ufilístiya inya ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́srɔn wɛ ádā kú Urám, Urám wɛ ádā kú Amínādabu.

eng_Latn: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ācɛ ā abɔ̄yī uwā jɛ̄ klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ó keé wɛ aɔ́báagwu. Ka ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ̄kā kú uwá pó, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ gē fū uwá iyē ŋ́ mɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Īī, n yá ká aá jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo habɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū tá, ámāŋ ka ɔnyā nū ámāŋ ka ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ámāŋ ka ayí nū tá ohígbū ō je pīya ɔ̄cɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
idu_Latn: Aítíca ōhī nēe yɛ ɔgwu kú íjééyī kú Epikúrīn mɛ́mla Usitóyīki wā í táafú mla Upɔ́lu dúú. Anɔ́ɔ aóhī kú uwa kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ogwuda nyā bī gáā ka mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Aɔ́há kē kahíníī, Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē tɔ́ɔna lɛ ɔwɔ kú aílɔ́wá ā. É ka lɛ ā, ohígbū ka Upɔ́lu kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kú nū.

eng_Latn: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
idu_Latn: A nū alɔ inya, le alɔ kpó ŋmó. Á kwú eyīnyinyi kú uwɔ ú tayínū ipú íwɔ́tū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ádā, ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ā cɛ̄, kwú ikókwū kú ōwē nyā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Amáŋ a híīī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ awɔ dɔɔ̄kā á kóō le yá.

eng_Latn: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kwú Óndú ā iyē nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ nū o yá ucē okpaakpa gēkwú.

eng_Latn: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
idu_Latn: A híī kpɔ́tūce oladóogbe ámāŋ ka oklóbīya uwɔ ŋ́. Lɛ ɛlā kwu ɛlā okónu kú uwɔ, kwu ɛlā nāa í ka lɛ ɔnyā uwɔ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ, úlā ofu ahātá ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ó fu ā kpó bɛ̄cɛ, anɔ́ɔ é bá yɔ̄ ī gwíijē kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nōo odée nɔ̄wá hɛ́ kwú uwɔ īlī ɛbɛɛbɛ yōōō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī da aíkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin kóō yá ejé āa.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
idu_Latn: aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ nēe bá ī yɛce ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ī yɛce Udéfīdi ā gbojī ajɛ. Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í lɔfú tōotɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ɔfú kú inu kú ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu yɔ̄ í mɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcí nēé hī ka ufáyin ā tá uwā ohi koó lɛ ā, anúɔ í klla gáā yá ejé nōo gē yá ká ɔtū kóō he aɔ́wɔ mɛ́mla alɛɛcɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
idu_Latn: É gē yá ɔ̄cɛ nāa yá italā ā ŋmó, é géē yá awanda lɛyíkwu italā nēé yá ɔ̄cɛ nāa yá ɔ̄ ágbe ā.

eng_Latn: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ā ŋmó ācɛ ofu igwáahātá ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ábna mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin.

eng_Latn: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ okónu kú uwá klá símm, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í tá ohi ékpónú ŋ́, ohígbū ka Uhɛsɛkíya ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá ka Aá tá ɔ̄ ohi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ géē mɛ, amáŋ ɛlā kú um í gáā mɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
idu_Latn: Usérahīya, Umeríyōtu.

eng_Latn: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
idu_Latn: Náaná ā, ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um í je ɔdā dúúmā ga uwɔ gla ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ klla lɛ ā wɛ ɛhi ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ nɛ. Ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú uwɔ ā nɛ̄ alɔ je ga awɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nēe jīla Ujerúsālɛm ā, lé ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā mla éeyē, ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, ācɛ Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya gwííjē ō cɛ̄tla Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔfú kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
idu_Latn: Amínādābu kpó ācɛ ofɛhɔ̄ cigwɛ́ɛpa ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Úsíyɛ̄lu wā.

eng_Latn: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
idu_Latn: Umáhili, Umússi, Umérári, mɛ́mla Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔnyīlɔ ā, lɛ ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ tū ágbe kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ gbō á. Ó kwú ɔnyīlɔ ā ú ce ɛyí ijakī kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ bī ga inu kú aúgbɔga á. Ó leyīkwu ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um klla kahíníí.

eng_Latn: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá oyēeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, a kē le oyēeyī ōlīkpō nɛ̄hi je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa kahíníī, Wā gaá gbā um ɛ̄gbā. N géē tá uwɔ ohi kahíníī, N géē wā Óndú.

eng_Latn: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú Adónīram ú kóō leyīkwu uwá. Ó lɛ uwá kpó kɔ̄ igwíígwu kú úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄ . Ígwu éyééye ā gē nyɔ̄ í yá ɔyā éyi Ulébānɔn, klla í yá ɔyā ɛpa ɔlɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē nyɔ̄ igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, eko nɛ̄ alɔ lā ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī nɛ̄ alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā, íne ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gē yúnwū kú ínoōbīya. Ó gē yá ābɔ̄ kú iyē ká alɔ dóódu kóō yúnwū ɔdā obɔ́bí ō yá, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ī ŋmɛ́yí tá ikwū.

eng_Latn: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō kú ɔdōlé ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ī ŋmó um okónu lɛyíkwu ɔdōlé nɛ̄ n lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū ā?.

eng_Latn: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
idu_Latn: Ó tū kpɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó má īlī ahilíki nɛ̄hɛ́ ā bá ajɛ, amáŋ ó bēhé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le da um, ɛ̄nyā wɛ odúúdú ije nɛ̄ aá je ɔdā agbénú ā lá ā? Ó tóohi kahíníī, Īī, odúúdú ije ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ kú aá tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ iyī aá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō lɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī uwā wā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú okóohō ā ú gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā aflɛ́yí. Ó géē je ɔ́ ɔkɔ nya gbiíli, amáŋ ó gáā fu īkpɛ̄yí kú nū ŋmá ɔkɔ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um ā ŋ́, é géē yá aá italā.

eng_Latn: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
idu_Latn: Ń gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga uwɔ ohígbū ayíkpó nēe bá ā ofū uwā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ nēe géē lɔtūce um ŋmá olɛhɔ̄ kú uwā nēé í cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe gē wā mɛ́mla anú ā, gēe wā í kpɛ́fú tá ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi ā, klla í wā í klá anú kpímmm bɛ̄ɛka ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
idu_Latn: Ótínīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Ukɛ́nāsi, ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ukálɛ̄bu ā, mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā abɔ̄fú. Anɔ́ɔ Ukálɛ̄bu kwú Ákīsa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū á.

eng_Latn: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ ācɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū keé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ̄nyā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ohígbū ka ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí í yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa nyā, é le yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā jīla tá kpɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é píyɛyí wā í mlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā á. É kē yá ɛ̄nyā lɛ ā ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ aɛ́cí kú Uhamáti, Ápāadi, mɛ́mla Uséfābeyim ɛ́ɛ bá āa? Ka aɛ́cí kú Usamérīya ɛ́ɛ lɛ Usamérīya nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā āa?.

eng_Latn: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ tá ɔ̄, klla le eyī gwō ɔ̄ bónū. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū í he ɔ́ ŋ́ eko dóódu, nɛ̄ ōwē le jé ɔ̄ iyē. Alɔ kwú eyī tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí nū klla kwú igbīhi í cē kwu ɔ́ klla kwú eyī gwō ɔ̄ bónū bɛ̄ɛka ɔda nōó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ wɛ Umálkīja, ɔ́mɛhīlī wɛ Umíjāmin.

eng_Latn: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amásīya kwú ācɛ nōo pūla ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú kpó nū ga ɔlɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ uwā mla ɔtū nōbí nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla íwɔ́tū kú ācɛ Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē bī ɔ̄ ga ipú ígbíli igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ abɔ́ɔ ā, anúɔ géē kɛlā ihɔtū lɛ ɔ́ nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔdā ɛgɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔ yá āa? É ka ɔdíyā nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi gáā mɛ ŋmá ipú Ísrɛ̄lu ā?.

eng_Latn: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o jéeyī gē ka ā, gē bī ojīlīmā gé lɛ ɔ́, Amáŋ, ɛlā nɛ̄ olíla gē ka ā, ī bī ikwū gē lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si cāŋjɛ háyicō anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ owu kahíníī, Mā uya. Anɔ́ɔ ó da úgbagwú kahíníī, Yɔ̄ cíí! Owu ā mā biyoo, ó klla tá gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɛga dóódu yɔ̄ hímm á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɔgba ɛhɔ̄, nōo yɔ̄ ī pīyeyī má igbīhi ojígógó í gáā tíile lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le uwá eyī kpó pu, klla lɛ ɔtū kú uwā yá lɔfú, kéē híī bī ikpēyī kú uwaā le mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, kéē híī bī ɔtū kú uwā le jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí um ká n̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā nēe le okwutɛ̄ kwaajɛ ohígbū ka é kwú hīla ɛɛ́ mā, géē cīce aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
idu_Latn: Ka eko nyā nɛ̄ odúumā kú aɛ́cí kú aéwo ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ nya ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ā? Ka ɔ́ɔ ī lɛ ā, ɔdí yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ uwá ɔ́ɔ gē gbɛlá ká Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē nya aá tá glá ā?.

eng_Latn: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
idu_Latn: Otú gē bī uwá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, uwá klla bá í lɛ abɔ̄ ma ajɛ ɛnoyɛ̄yí bɛ̄ɛka otú ā.

eng_Latn: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācogbāálá gē leyīkwu aálá kú uwā ā. Óō híī lɛbɛ̄ɛka é pī uwá bá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Óō kē wɛ ohígbū ije nōo géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú ā ŋ́, amáŋ óō ŋmá ɔdā nēé tíne ō yá ŋmá ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā le ipú tū ɔ̄ fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔwú ā ce eyī nū dēē á.

eng_Latn: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
idu_Latn: Ā híī kpó eko bónū ō itali gɔ́ ɔyí uwɔ ká ā nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔ́ gɔ́ nááná, ó gáā kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
idu_Latn: é géē yɛ í kwú alɔ ú kpó mulɛ oyēeyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgwā ī je odée mulɛ ā, eko nēé cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi, nēe kē wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ abɔ̄yī uwā ā, tá uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū kē lɔfú tū uwā iyē ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā.

eng_Latn: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí álá ā nyɔ̄ gáā mīyɛ ēpɔ̄kpá oōha ā ŋmá abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo cīīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ugóólu le yá odúúdú nū.

eng_Latn: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lé ka Ulásārɔ̄si, ó lā ɔlɛ́ éyi nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tāni. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔlɛ́ kú Umerí mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā Umáta dúú á. Ɛ̄cī éyi Ulásārɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē.

eng_Latn: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka kéē lɛ agege bī wā, anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu fíya ga eyīpú, le okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ gblugudu iyɔ̄bū Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi gē yúufi ī fīyégbúlú kpákpákpá.

eng_Latn: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ísu u pīya ajɛ oŋmókókó, aádáádā alɔ le yɛ ikpó bēhé ísu ajɛ olamu. Abɔ́ɔ ā, alɔ gwéeyē kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē pi uwɔ ahɔ̄ ka á plíīyī uwɔ ka ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛ́ɛ́ gáā wā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ nɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka é géē cīgbīhi wā kpɔ́ ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla Ujúda ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
idu_Latn: Anú abɔ̄yī nū í wɛ ofíyajɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó wā gaá cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ ofíyajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó lɔfú yá glá ā, nōó yá yɔ̄ á. Anɔ̄ nēé géē le nya um iyē eko nēé géē nyi um ā, nōó hɔ́bū tá le nyi um iyē yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā má ā, é dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ ɔkpacaŋgelī gɔ̄ ācɛ mɛ́ɛnɛ ɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá lɔfú lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla aógwɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē ka ɛyí ɔ̄na mɛ́mla ācoyímabɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá. Amáŋ aá híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēe gē ka lɛ aá ka aá ɔ́ɔ́ gáā gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā ŋ́ má ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, Ahímāasi mɛ́mla Ujonátan le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú obugā ā, le yɛ gaá lɛ ɛlā ā kpó ka lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. É le yɛ í le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu mīya lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ kpɛ́mm. Anɔ́ɔ é klla da ɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ le kwu fíyaa cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú bēhé ísu ā á.

eng_Latn: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé, n géē kpó aɛ́hi ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔ́. N klla géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū, Ó kē í wɛ ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́. Aá lɛ ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ kpó bá ajɛ ká aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄! Lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄! Lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá! Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá nyɔ́kpá nɛɛ? Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ í lɛ ɔcɛ́ dúúmā ŋ́ ayíka Usísa ōfūnū nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni gā iyɔ̄bū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā ɛbɔ́, ayíka ó wɛ Óndú ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ o hile ā wɛ ijáalí kú ɛlā nɛ̄ um ka nyā ā.

eng_Latn: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ í gáā fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́, í cɛ̄ lɛ ajɛ í je dobū, ɔyā géē je pīya ɔnɔ̄wá gɔɔ bɛ̄ɛka oyī ā. Aɔ́dā nēe bá ā géē yá gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kóō wā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kwú ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ō je gā um ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔ́mpa um wā í kpó ohi lɛ ɔ́ ā ú gā um abālɔbányā. Alɔ wā í da aá ka, ayí kú aɔ́báagwu nēé hī ka Ánākin ā bá abɔ́ɔ. Kéē lɛwa klla lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé le igá kú ɔdɔ o lɔfú hɛ́ tū uwā. Eko ōhī, Óndú ā kē yɔ̄ mla um nɛ̄ n í nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um í kpɛ́lā ce um ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā í mafú ka ń je ɔkwu ɔdā dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Óndú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kɛpɔ̄ tū um á.

eng_Latn: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, ācɛ ɔhá tɛtɛ gbō alɔ ɛɛ́, amáŋ, awɔ ofōōfū uwɔ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ka a wɛ Óndú alɔ á.

eng_Latn: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
idu_Latn: N má aɔ́fíyɛ́ bá ī ce ɔnya, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ayí kú ɔcɛ́ kē bá ī yɛ ikpó bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
idu_Latn: N géē bī álá wā í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede kú uwɔ. N gē bī aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna wā í gwɛ́ɛya gā awɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ódūdū kú nū gē ŋmá ajɛ ga ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ācīije nyā lɛ uwá, amáŋ é jɛ́yí ɔdā nōó da uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí nū otú, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ ɔkɔ nāa gbā ā pó ɛɛ́. N kē miyɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nāa gwó gā um ā, kóō wɛ ɛga nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya gā um.

eng_Latn: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
idu_Latn: Ó pi uwá ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, aá klla leyī kwɛcɛ ohígbū ɔdōnīgbo kú ācɛ Ufárisīi mla ákú Uhérɔ̄du.

eng_Latn: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū géē he um nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī pó abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kú íjééyī.

eng_Latn: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō ā ó lɛ aá nyatá, o ŋmá le ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwáhātá ā wɛ Uhanáni.

eng_Latn: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ̄bɛ́ kú uwā wɛ ákú uwɔ, amɛ̄ mɛ́mla átákwū abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɛbɛ́ ā nāa jíliye lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɛya nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ákú uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa má ka, ācɛ o hile ā mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tɔ̄lá ɛɛ́ mā, é kwúcē igbīhi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ācɛ kú Ái.

eng_Latn: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ mɛ́mla uwá ga Ubála ipú ajɛ kú Ujūda gáā nyɔ̄ í bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō, nóō lé iyē kú Óndú ā. Óndú ā cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ɛhícō nū ɔtāhɛ̄ ɛyí Aúcérūbim ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ a í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́ má. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā yá kú ɛ̄nyā kóō le yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú Ahíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā lɛ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati ā kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā nāa géē da uwá ā yɔ̄ á, Ayíkābɔ̄ kú um cɔkpɛ́nú fíyɛ́ ohí kú ádā um á.

eng_Latn: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔyí álá ā lɛ ɔja ɔ́mɛtá ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā. N pó ɔkɔ kú ɔdā oyēeyī ɔ́mɛtá ā kahíníī, Gāa! N jééyī gicō anɔ́ɔ n má ɔnya nōbí á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɔnya ā bī ɔdōōmiya ɔdā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aá nēé yá odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā á. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú nū lɛ ācɛ alɛwa fíyɛ́ nyatá ā, é géē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá klla í cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
idu_Latn: Olɔhi kú um, mɛ́mla okpaakpa kú um kóō lɛ um tū, ohígbū ka n kpɔ́tūce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
idu_Latn: Ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā pīyeyī lɛ ɔ́ má, le inya kwu, ísu kú Ujɔ́dan kwú hɛ́, í pɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya kwú gbo agbénú nɛ̄ ācɛ dóódu gbɔɔ́ ō ce ɔ́ ojīlímā nɛ̄hi ā, ó lɛ inu ō kpó iyó tū kú agbénú kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, ije nɛ̄hɛ́, ɔtángbéde, anɔ̄, ɔkplɛ́fú, mɛ́mla ɔdā kú ojīlīmā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔhá ā gwó.

eng_Latn: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā géē lā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya eko ɔ́ɔmā ā gekwú, ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē kwúcē īgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da Umósīsi kóō lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kpó lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi kéē lā anú. Kóō klla kwú ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē lúlé ipú nū glá ā ú lɛ aá yɛ jīla aígelī nɛ̄hi ā tá.

eng_Latn: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ ayí nū ā, ayíbɛ ó géē hɔ́hā nōó le tū gbēyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā ce alɔ, alɔ mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū gbēyī nū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ móōwē mla anú alɔ kē í lɛ ɛgahi mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā oŋiniŋini kú aójéeyī lɔhi ō pó fíyɛ́, ɛgba kú ɔcɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ aígabɔ̄ nēe wɛ aólíla á.

eng_Latn: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
idu_Latn: Ó le blakwu okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā ohígbū uwā, abɔ̄ é kē he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
idu_Latn: Óndú, blakwu okónu nōó cē gā uwɔ ā. Blakwu ɔkpá nɛ̄ ó le ce iyí nū gā uwɔ, nōo wɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Étam, le cīgbīhi wā Upihahírɔ̄tu, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ubaal-séfɔn ā gaá lā kwu Umígidɔlu ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
idu_Latn: Ó kpɛ́fú yá aéwo alɛwa lé nɛ̄hi, ó klla lɛ ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki yálé dúú. Ó lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē kpɛ́fú wā í gwū uwā.

eng_Latn: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɛláyíssa ā cāŋjɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ó má aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya o bī kpɛ́fú, mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú le íbɔm cē tū uwā jīla tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɔkpáni um, ákú alɔ mɛ ɛɛ́ n, ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá ā gɛ.

eng_Latn: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu kú ipú ajɛ ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā tū fu uwá, klla lɛ ɔ́ tá okónu ucē dóódu kahíníī, Ɔbá dóódu géē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ nū, anú klla í lɛ íkwu ō ŋmɛ́lā dóódu ɛyí ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē lā ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anúɔ í kē gáā je mlanyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ nēé la okónu ɔpɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ufilístiya a, gēe da ɔka, kahíníī, Ɛnyā wɛ ɔdā nōo yá ācɛ nɛ̄ alɔ kpó eyī ce ka alɔ gēe v ga ɛga īyī uwā kéē wā í tá alɔ abɔ̄, eko kú unwalu kú alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya a? Iní nɛ̄ alɔ gēe kwu nyɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ.

eng_Latn: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ofúlutu ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā klla í je uwá kpó nyɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā uwēyī nēé jé ŋ́, gē nyɔ̄ ī pā ɛcí ā, lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le ɔkɔ gbā á. Anɔ́ɔ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā le akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ tū wāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi Óndú mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
idu_Latn: Ó hɛ̄ abɔ̄ da awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā Ugálīli ā, ācɛ Ugálīli mīyɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōó yá Ujerúsālɛm, eko kú ucɛ ā má ā. Ohígbū ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā gā ɛgiyí ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ obōōbū nɛ̄ ó ga ajɛ Uróm amānyā a, o gbɔɔ́ ō tíne um jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó lɛ um pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ aádáádā aá bá ícɛ nya āa? Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, béeyī piyóó nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cīnū, Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā, ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cí jāā gbó otú.

eng_Latn: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɔfú ŋmó um icííci glá ŋ́. Ami abɔ̄yī um cɛ̄ ka n gē kwú á. N lɔfú cɛ̄ ō kwú, n kē lɔfú nɛ̄ n gē yēeyī igbɔhá glá kpɔ́. Ami miyɛ ɔ́da ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā um á.

eng_Latn: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
idu_Latn: Á jé ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ákú uwɔ gē wā ā ŋ́. Lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbéenyi nɛ̄ ɛ́yá gē kwú acígilí ā, ámāŋ ka ígbáanɔ nɛ̄ ukpa gē kwū acígilí ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī obɔ̄bí mla ikwū gē je ukpa tá ajɛ gē gbēyī ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú alɔ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá yɔ̄ mla uwá gē yúklɔ́ mla uwá, ohígbū kóō gē yá ije o bī lá ɔdōlé kú nū ŋmá áklɔ̄kpɛ īlī nōó gē gɔ́ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gē yá dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā nyā oōka lɛɛyí kwu ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Utáya. Eko nēé géē bá ī yá aá lé klla í ŋmó aá ā, íbá nɛ̄ aá géē bá ī dɛ̄ ā géē tū ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu ā ufi, mla íbá kú ācɛ nēé bá ī hɛ́ ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko dúúmā nōó cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kwinyā, a géē lɔfú hī ɔnya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɔnyā dúúmā igwú gaá cɛ́cá.

eng_Latn: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
idu_Latn: Kwú átákwū mɛ́mla abɔ̄, nōo wɛ ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɛbɛ́ ā í kpó tū ɔ, mɛ́mla aíkpokwú nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi bá yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, ācɛ ā le uwá plla ɛ̄cī usábāti ɔhá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kɛlā lɛ uwá kpɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ ka gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ísu cēenyi je um kpó ŋ́, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ísu nōo lipú nɛ̄hi je um mulɛ ŋ́. A kē híī cɛ̄ lɛ únóji je um lé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá, ācohumɔtū, aá kóō yɔ̄ gē bī iyī aá jɛ̄ ipú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū ā. Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ī bī aá jɔ́ɔwɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā éyi nōo lé ka Umerí nōo cīce pi ikpó kú Ujísɔ̄si. Ó yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ í nwū ā.

eng_Latn: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó ā. Ó le mu mla otulalī.

eng_Latn: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī yá lɛ ā géē lā ɛga nɛ̄ abɔ̄ dúúmā í gāa kwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ó géē lā ɛbɔ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó lā ɔlɛ́ olɔfú nēé gwó kwu ɛplá kú ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ó kē í má lé, klla ī má gwá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo lɛ ɔ̄kā kú uwēyī kú aá pó ɛɛ́. Ācɛ dóódu kē le ikwū nɛ̄ aá je ā pó ɛɛ́. Aícɔ́ɔja gwōnū klá īyī uwā, odúúdú uwá kē má gwōnū tɔ̄ɔhá.

eng_Latn: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛpa éyi lɔfú yɔ̄. Éyi kú uwā gekwú eko nōó lɔhi iyē lɔɔlɔhi. Ó yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ í kē yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ɔnyā nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jéjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɔda nɛ̄ n gē gbɛlá nū wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ákú aá tá, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yá odée kú um ā kē wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwú ákú aá tá.

eng_Latn: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ga Ujɔ́pa ká ā gaá dɔɔ̄kā Usáyímɔ̄ni nēé hī ka Upíta ā. Ó gbɔga ɔlɛ́ Usáyímɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cɛ oyúklɔ́ ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ okónu ísu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, Umósīsi le Árɔ̄ni, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīīgwú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɛcá cá Ɔwɔicō géē móōwē nū.

eng_Latn: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
idu_Latn: Le nwū alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī le kpií lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ le íjéeyī jé.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
idu_Latn: É le Ujɔ́ni kwú tá agbá. Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le pó ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujudíya le tá Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄gbā ā. Anú ōfōōfūnū gē yá ɔdā idáagó á.

eng_Latn: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ yá oklóbīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádā alɔ tɛtɛ yá oklóbīya tá īyī uwā ā. N bī ugóolu, oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nyā wā í yá uwɔ ɛhi. Le oklóbīya kú uwɔ mɛ́mla Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā abɔ̄yī uwā klla bá ī yɛ ga ajɛ gico fíyá fíyá bɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā.

eng_Latn: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ um gē ka ā ŋmá ɔtū okpaakpa, n kē í ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ péee.

eng_Latn: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
idu_Latn: Lɛ icō aɛ́fu kú Abarím, nēe bá ipú ajɛ kú Umówābu, nōo pīyeyī kwu Ujérīko ā tū. Le tá icō ɛfu kú Unébo ā, ká ā lɛ ajɛ kú Ukénan nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka abɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kú ewo, ayíka ɛ́kpā bɛ̄cɛ iyē kú nū á, ɔ̄cɛ ā le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ejé gwá nɛ̄hi ā, é gbo akwuna ō yá. Uwēyī he uwá ɔtū fíyɛ́ ojīlīma mla ocɛ̄tra á.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ehée, ɔkpani ālɔ, alɔ wā gaá lá ɔdōlé ōfōōfūnū nɛ u.

eng_Latn: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
idu_Latn: Uhánan, ɔyí kú Umaáka, Ujɛhóssāfāti ŋmá Umítan.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
idu_Latn: Ujedáya, ɔyí kú Uharúmāfu ma ɔdɔ kú āyā kú ɛga nōo lā ā gboce ɔ́ á. Uhátūsi, ɔyí kú Uhassabinéya ma āyā ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
idu_Latn: Ó hī ɔyí nū ā iye kahíníī, Íkābɔdu nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ó kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā nēé mīyɛ ā, mla ikwū kú ɔbá nū mla ádā ɔbá nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le bīya lɛ ayínɛ́ ohile ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú úwé kú uwā í kpó híla ipú ɔtūnōbí, le iyó kú uwá kpó ce ɛyí ijakī, kwúcē ga ipú igelī kú Íjīpiti ā á.

eng_Latn: Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.
idu_Latn: É géē má ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yá ā eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā gaá lɛ ɔ́ mafú. Ohígbū keé géē bī ɔlá le jé úklɔ́ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ má cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ́ɔ́ja nōo yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, ge dɔɔ̄kā kóō yá ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔtu í he otrɛ̄yi kú nu, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó gáā nyɔ̄ í je iyi nu wu ipú unwalu kú ācɛ ɔlamu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
idu_Latn: Íkōtō gē kwú ígbáanɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ikpó wu ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ukpa gē tá icííci, ɔ́dāŋ ka odée í lɛ ikpó wu ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, abālɔbányā alɔ wɛ ayí Ɔwɔicō, ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ í wɛ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā í tá péee ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ kē jé ka eko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá gā, alɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā, ohígbū ka alɔ géē má ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlá gbo kwu aá nɛ̄, ɔtū kú um gē wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́. Ó le kpaakpa kú um gbɛlá ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛyíkwu aá. Ohígbū ka aá tá um abɔ̄ ipú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ményinyi um je gā um ā, kwu abālɔbányā nēé kwú um tá agbá ā mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ n lɛ iyī um gē tá ācɛ nēe gē ka ɔdōōbɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ohi o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú um yá kú ācɛ kéē mīyɛ ɛlā kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā cɛ̄ kpɔ́cíí.

eng_Latn: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ fíyaa! Kwinya nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ! N gaá yá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ gbéeko nɛ̄ aá i tá abɔ́ɔ. Ohígbū ka Ulɔ́tu hī ipɔ́lɛ́ ā ka ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, iyē kú ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya Usówa.

eng_Latn: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō gáā je ɛbɛ́ nū lɛ ɔyí nū dóódu ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kōō í je lɛ ɔnyā nū nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, ámāŋ je odóódu kú nū lɛ ayí nū nēe hile ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
idu_Latn: Usáyɔn, ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō a, ɔdā ooŋmó ɔ̄cɛ mla ɔdā oobɔ̄bí dúúmā í gāa yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́. Íjééyī kú Óndú āoōjé, mla Óndú āoōjé kú ācɛ a gēe wɛ omuōomu kú ɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄, ísu gē cēenyi mu ɔgba kú nū lɛ a.

eng_Latn: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa ā: Uhɛ́ldāyi, ŋmá Unétófa, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ótnīyɛlu ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
idu_Latn: Ukóra ma ayí ɛtá: Ássɛ, Ɛlkána mɛ́mla Abíyāsafu. Uwá wɛ aádáádā kú ipɔ́ɔnū nēé lé iyē kwu Ukóra á.

eng_Latn: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi je ɔ́da lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Áá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ójīla a cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā ā á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā túkpɛɛ́ klla je ojīlīmā lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ayínɛ́ um ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hīgwú dúú ā! Aá gbɛlá kwu Ujísɔ̄si, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō le pīya Otrɛ̄yí kú Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú otōkpóce nɛ̄ alɔ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
idu_Latn: É bá yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba gē jíla úwé kú uwā icō klla gē tá úmlá gicō.

eng_Latn: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn, ɔtū he aá abɔ̄ aá je acɛ ɔlɛ um wúlatāajɛ ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā aá yɔ̄ ī tóómbli bɛ̄ɛka ɛna nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɛyí igwú, yɔ̄ ī wū igwú a. Aá klla bá ī yúuya bɛ̄ɛka ɔbá ɔnya ā.

eng_Latn: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
idu_Latn: Bɛ́yíkwu ācɛ nēé bɛ́yíkwu um ā, Óndú. Óndú, nuunu tá ācɛ, nēe gē nuunu tá um ā.

eng_Latn: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔ̄cōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi gaá le da Ágábáidu, Udéfīdi ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í yɛce Ábsālɔm ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
idu_Latn: Bī um tá ipú ɔwɛ nāa ka n̄ yɛ ipú íne kú uwɔn ā, ohígbū ka ó he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, anúɔ géē je ɔ́ tū Óndú ā abɔ̄. O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā jāa gɔbū, eko nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú ɔyí ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ gāá kwu ā, ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ákú Óndú Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
idu_Latn: A klla í yá eliká kú ugóolu ɔhá, nāa géē kpó kwu ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ɔ́ŋgbá ácábɔ̄ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā, kóō kwu ɛga nēé gɔ́ īlī ā kwɔhá ɛhícō kú ɔdōkwɛ́nyɔ́ nēé wu lɔɔlɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēe lɛ ɔkɔ gbā kwɛyí ā, ɛga nēé jīla tɔ̄há ā le jíliyē, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā le tū mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ, anɔ́ɔ é lɔtu lɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā Ɔwɔicō pāālā á.

eng_Latn: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o lɛ ɛlá kwu iyī uwā ōfōōfū uwā ā, gē hágágā kú ije ō lɛ mla agbénú, amáŋ é kē jé eko nɛ̄ ɛhá í wā gáā klá uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
idu_Latn: A le jī ɛɛ́! Awɔ nōo gē yá kú aéwo nēe yɛ jīla awɔ tá ā, kéē gwá ejé ŋmá íkókwū kú uwɔ nōo kwɛyí ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ ā. A lɛ uwá yá kéē ga ɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ejé le uwá kwú ā, anɔ́ɔ aá klla gbɔɔ́ ō gwéeyē abɔ̄ aá le má keé lɔfú gɛ ŋ́ klla bá ipú uwēyī ā.

eng_Latn: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne kéē yá ā, géē kpɔ́tūce um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yēeyī, Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā kwúcē igbīhi ɔtū kú um í gáā lɔhi ɛgiyí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɔhá nōo gboce Ujúda ā, é géē je ɔ́ tá cíí kú úklɔ́ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí. Ɔwá kú nū ŋmá ɛhícō ā ga ɛháajɛ ā géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā. Īkpō kú nū ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, géē wɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla īkpó kú odúúdú ajɛ nēé kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma ā. Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā géē kwu ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
idu_Latn: Umerí blakwu odúúdu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ ɔ́ kpó tū ɔtū kú nū gē gbafíyóó kwu uwá.

eng_Latn: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú, awɔ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gē jé ācɛ má cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā jé ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo le kpaakpa á. A jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ɔtū mla odo kú ācɛ. N kwú ɛlā kú um í tū uwɔ abɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n tíne ō má ka a lɛ ɔ́ci gwo ācɛ ā gā um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ ā tóohi kahíníī, O ŋmífi nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ā nɛ̄ n lɛ odúúdú aíne nēe bá nyā tū ŋmá á.

eng_Latn: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ē kwú ɔkpá nyā ú tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ á. Ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā yɔ̄ á, Alɔ, ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ, ayínɛ́ aá, hokónu tū ayínɛ́ alɔ nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá, nēe ī bá ajɛ Ántīyɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Usiríya mɛ́mla Usilísīya.

eng_Latn: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upɔlu yɔ̄ gē kɔkɔ kú nū ā, Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Upɔ́lu, a gē jɛɛ́lɛ́! Ɔdōjé nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī je uwɔ jɛɛ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
idu_Latn: Ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā í wɛ, umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé le anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū ɔ̄ ā. Okoolo ɛtá kú umu mla ɔbá ɛna dóódu, okoolo ɛpa kú umu mɛ́mla omlede éyééye.

eng_Latn: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī je gblífi, klla yɔ̄ í wā tā ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo gē wā tāajɛ ā. N yɔ̄ í je gblífi, bɛ̄ɛka īlī nɛ̄ ɛha ī je lé ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya mīyɛ ɔkpá kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā klla le ɔ́ jé ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkpá ā nwūla tá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, kóō blakwu ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ alɔ ba ícɛ nyā eko dóódu. Óndú ā kóō méyīnyinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwā eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgbá kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ uwíndo nēe lɛ ɔwá fíyɛ́ eyīpú.

eng_Latn: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ aádā ā, eko nɛ̄ ɔyí aá lɛ ɛbéenyi ba ŋmá abɔ̄ aá, aá géē je ɛgwā lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
idu_Latn: É bá gē gwííjē nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō, gwó ā. É bá ī gwíijē nɛ̄ Ɔyí álá ā gwó ā dúú É bá ī gwó kahíníī, Óndú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, aɔ́dā nɛ̄ a gē yá ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, klla wɛ ɔdīīdáagó! Ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú aéwo, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a gē yá odée kú uwɔ āle kpaakpa, klla wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
idu_Latn: É kwú ácí mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ú kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Gbɔbū kéē wā í kpó ɔfú kwu ajɛ ā, ó lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ kú Ídɛn ā, amáŋ igbihi ō wā kú uwā ā, ajɛ ā kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ íkpākplā kú ígbíli ā. Ɔdā dúúmā í hɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ táajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá gaá le jīla eko kú ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī oŋmɔ́ɔcī nū, Ubálam cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nɛ̄ Ubálāki tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā tá ka ami ɔ́ɔ́ gáā nyɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ācɛ Ufilístiya yálé. É gbo ɛfú ō kpó ŋmá Umíkmāsi jāā ga Áíjālɔn. Eko nya, ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwā nɛ̄hi, ɛmiyɛ klla yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ka ɛ́ɛ bī āyā dúúmā kú ijē nyā le yá íkókwū, aógo, opo, iyó ō bī le yúklɔ́ kú aágege ámāŋ íyó ɔhá kú oje ɔdɔ mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le ka lɔhi, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō yá héyīfuú kú ugóolu nōo wu ipú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ lɔfú tá ɔnya tū gē gbēyī ɛfú ō kpó glá, amáŋ, Óndú ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gē yálé ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a klla kwú pīyeyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā ī yá ɔ̄ igbledū āa? Bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nēé lɔfú dúúmā kóō tá ācɛ abɔ̄ ŋ́ māa? Ɔkwɛyí nɛ̄, Óndú, ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ. Alɔ wɛ ācɛ kú uwɔ nɛ̄, ā cē ɔkwu kwu alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gekwú, eyīyōce kú nū dóódu gekwú mla anú. Eyīyōce kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ma wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ klla ī gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ācɛ o yá ɔdā olɔhi ipéyī kú Óndú ā, kē í cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ta ɔnyā nū ohi ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ gē wú anúɔ ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ Unábɔ̄tu ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ā. Ó ka anúɔ da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ kwú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū, nōo kwu ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ajaajɛ ā ú lɛ anúɔ, ká anúɔ kwú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin ɔhá nɛ̄ ɔ́ lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ú lɛ ɔ́, ámāŋ ká anúɔ lɛ ije nū cíla lɛ ɔ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ í gáā je lɛ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú. Aá yá ucē olɔhi cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lā ipú ajɛ ā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mɛhili: Íra, ɔyí kú Ikéss, nōo ŋmá Utékōwa.

eng_Latn: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ede kú uwá kpó ca tāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ō kwaajɛ kú ɛcí kú uwā gba ŋinii. Ó da uwá kéē kwú ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra ā ú yɔlá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ dúúmā kóō híī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā gbóógbóo gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
idu_Latn: Ubinúwi, ɔyí kú Uhenádādi ma ɔdɔ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Asárīya gaá kwu ɔ́kíkā kú ɔdɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le ɛhɔ̄ tū cīgbīhi gaá fu ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: Then Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā, klla le ɔ́ má abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā ékpékpó ā ka lɛ ācɛ nēe māhayi abɔ́ɔ ā kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ó wɛ éyi kú uwā.

eng_Latn: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
idu_Latn: Igelī ā tá alácɛ̄, é kē kwú odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igá kú nū ú ca bónū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō lɛ eyīnyinyi nu má ɛci ámōmɛ ā! A kē jé lɔɔlɔhi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ga um ajɛ kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Uhíburu ōhī nēe tɛtɛ yɛ āyā kú Ufilístiya ā kwú eyī í pīya gaá kwú pīya tɔ̄ɔ̄há mla Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ujonátan.

eng_Latn: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
idu_Latn: Ábáa kú nū lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɛdɔ ēpū dóódu mɛ́mla ɔcí ɔtulalí yɔ̄ anú ā. Akpókónu kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ododó nōo le dɛ̄ sɔɔɔ mla ɔtulalī kú Umáari ā.

eng_Latn: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ bī uwā bɛ̄cɛ fíyaa lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ fíyaa lɛ á. Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɛ́ɛ bá ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ubáal, klla bá ī yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ aɛ́cí ā.

eng_Latn: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú uwá kwú nyíleyī tɔ̄há. Odúúdú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí jónjīlɛ̄ tɔ̄há. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í yɔ̄ ipú uwā nōo gē yá ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú aɛ́wū kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dāajɛ ɔhá nōó lɛ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú agbénú kú nū nōó lɛ Umɛsopotámīya ā, kpó kóō gā ajɛ Ukénan, ɛgiyí ádā nū, Áyísīki á.

eng_Latn: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ gaá tū ɔ̄ iyē, lɛ ɔ́ yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ ó le odúúdú iyɔ́fú kú nū nōó lɔtūcē ā kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, lɛ ɔ́ agbénú kpó kɔ̄ ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the LORD, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ géē tū ɛgíkwū ɛyí ɔɔ́pu, ācɛ klla kē í jikwū odúúdu úláyi kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, géē yɔ̄ ī ka, Eléélelé! Eléélelé. É klla ī hī aɔ́glɛ́jí igwú kéē gáā jikwū tɔ̄há mla ācɛ nēe gbā ije lɛ uwá kéē jikwū ā.

eng_Latn: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā ā wɛ igbō nēé yá ipú ɔdōyígbō nɛ̄, ó í wɛ igbō nēé lɛ ɔdōnīgbō tū ŋ́. Ó lɔfú wɛ igbō ō cɔkpɛ́nú nēé ŋmá umu nēé lɛ anɔ́ kú ólīifu tū ɔ̄, ó kē lɔfú wɛ égblú nēé lɛ anɔ́ nya ɔ́ iyē.

eng_Latn: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
idu_Latn: A le tá ɔlɛ́ kú aéwɔhá olufíyé gaá le gbɔga, a kōō le ɔdōlé lé mla uwá.

eng_Latn: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā lɔfú ipú ajɛ ā, é klla kē í hɔ́hā ce ayááyí kú ācɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ācɛ okpaakpa ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ayí kú Árɔ̄ni nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ oyī ā kwu uwá ogene kú akpáhɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄ɔdu kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná mɛ́mla ɔcígbɔ̄du kú ayíkīkpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú ohile kú oyī ā ú pīya klá ɔkíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā á.

eng_Latn: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
idu_Latn: Uhassābīya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhílikīya á. Unetánɛ̄lu kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujedáya ɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
idu_Latn: N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ŋmá lɛ ō je igbīhi ce kwu um ā. É gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí, klla ī gbā aójibó nēé bī abɔ̄ kú uwā le yá ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá bá gē da alɔ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú aá yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
idu_Latn: Aóladógbe kú nū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ má ɔ̄ eko nōó wɛ obɔdā ā kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ yāajɛ gē ba ɔdā ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, nōo géē bī Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Óndú alɔ le hɛ́ um táā! Āhɔ̄ kú um ā yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ami abɔ̄yī um gē bī ɔtū kú um ī lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū, amáŋ n kē bī ɔkpíyē kú ɔlɛcɛ kú um gē lɛ ínoōbīya tū.

eng_Latn: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka ó cíkā ká n̄ yɔ̄ gē tá aá ɛlá kwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā abɔ̄ n yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ámata nōó gáā jé gbóógbóō ŋ́ mā ce uwá ikpó. Ó klla da uwá ka inálēgbé ɔ́ɔ géē ce uwá oŋmá icō wāajɛ kú ɔkpíyē kú uwā.
