eng_Latn: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nōó géē bɛ̄cɛ, ŋmá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā kóō je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kú nū tēelihɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anɔ̄ ihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kú nū yɔ̄ ɔɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyínɛ́ ádā uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ŋ́, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔmáapú ádā uwɔ ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um ō bɔ́bíipú ā. Ká ā klla lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aéwɔhá, nēé ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi gbógbóō ŋ́, ācɛ nēe klla ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nááná nēé le ɔkpá gbo ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu le da odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū mɛ́mla Ujonátan, ɔyí nū ā kéē lɛ Udéfīdi ŋmó. Amáŋ Udéfīdi he Ujonátan ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka eyī kú uwɔ yá ká ā bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō á nɛɛ, lɛ ɔ́ wú ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Ó géē lɔhi gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ká ā lɛ eyī éyi ká ā lā oyēeyī opiyóó, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ a géē lɛ eyī ɛpa nēé géē kwú uwɔ ú tá ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ.

eng_Latn: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
idu_Latn: É jīla Ujerúsālɛm ipú ɔyā ɔ́mɛtá kú iháyí igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ása ce ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ, Umáciru, ɔyí kú Umanásɛ nōo wɛ ádā kú Ugílɛ̄di ā mɛ́mla ayí kú aípɔ́ɔnū nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
idu_Latn: Aá tá opo kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔyā gā ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ubánābasi mla Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, le pó á, é lɛ úwé kú uwā híla, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, bá yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ka.

eng_Latn: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aójibó kú aɛ́cí kú uwā ɛ̄gbā. Ucē nyā kwú pīya ukpa lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá ā miya ipú ɔtū kú um. N le odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, klla da uwá kahíníī, Aá gē pīya ācɛ Ujíyu, ayínɛ́ aá tū. N le odúúdú ācɛ ā kpó hīgwú í jīla um eyī, ká n̄ yá kú unwalu ā kóō mɛ ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Udáyína, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla Ulɛ́ya, le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá má ācɛnyā kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
idu_Latn: Óndú, eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē yēeyī gaá kwu lɛ ā? Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē kwú ā? Le da um eko nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú um géē ŋmɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
idu_Latn: Ka abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū kóō tá ɛháajɛ ɛyí kú um, ká n lɛ ɛyí ce ɔ́, ká abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū kóō yɔ̄ ī yɛ um iyē.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
idu_Latn: Uwá géē wā ŋmá ɛhícō wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ, mla aícɔ́ɔja lɛwa lɛwa, nēe bī aúgbɔ́nya okpɛ́fú mɛ́mla okpíyó alɛwa. É bī ɔdā okwɛyí kú oje mla ɔkplɛ́fu gbō iyī uwā, é géē wā ī jīla tū uwɔ. N géē je uwɔ tá ipú abɔ̄ uwā, uwá kē í bī íne kú uwá le kɛpɔ̄ tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú odúúdú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú aá ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā. Eko nɛ̄ aá géē gbo aɛ́bɛ́ ā áluka ā, éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú uwā wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ í hɛ́ kɔ, kllá í je yíla kátáāā.

eng_Latn: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nāa lɛ iyī uwɔ mafú lɛ aólɛlā kú um, é géē kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí um, géē gwōnū gblugudu klla í pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā í wɛ ɔfú kú ɔnya, ámāŋ aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
idu_Latn: É le ɛ̄gbā gbā ɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm á. Éeyē le mu uwá ipú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu gekwú ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ádā uwá kwú á. É ma ayí dúúmā ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ é kwú ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlísaa mɛ́mla Utáma kwú pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya á. Udéfīdi lɛ ayí kú Árɔ̄ni kɔ̄ ígwíígwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Úklɔ́ kú uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kɔ̄ ígwíígwu á. É gaá tū aólɛlā iyē, anɔ́ɔ é le aólɛlā ā kpó yálé á. Ó nū uwā inya jāā ga Uhɔ́bā, ɛhícō kú Udamáskɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bɛ́yíkwu uwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
idu_Latn: Usálu, Ámɔ̄ku, Uhílikīya, mɛ́mla Ujedáya. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔ́mpa uwā eko kú Ujessúwa á.

eng_Latn: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti lɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛna nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā, amáŋ olɛlā éyi géē wā ŋmá ɛhícō gaá kpɛ́fú tú ɔ̄ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iju gē hɛ́ ɛna lé ā.

eng_Latn: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
idu_Latn: aígbáanɔ, mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōo lā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ a le īyī uwɔ fu ce, gē yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ɛgiyí Óndú kú Ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ íkókwū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ɔ́ɔmā kpó wā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ awɔ, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ, anyā uwɔ mɛ́mla anyā ō cikpó kú uwɔ gē gwá ejé ŋmá anú á. Aá klla ī cɛ̄tra aɔ́wɔ nēé yá ŋmá oje ɔdɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje udɔ, ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄, nōó mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nēe gē pó ɛlā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēe gē jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ á lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ owu kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ nū ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ipú inu eyīpú otīihɔ, nōo wɛ ipú áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi, nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ gwó ā, nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ bī abɔ̄ gwó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
idu_Latn: O tútū kú aá gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú ɛbɔ́ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka áblákpá o wikpó kú aá.

eng_Latn: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
idu_Latn: Igelī ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, aá géē kpó uwá yíífi lɛ Óndú ā. Urēhábu akwuna ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nōo bá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū mla anú ā nɛ̄ aá géē hɛ́tá á. Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ alɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í jīla ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ācɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce ā, alɔ géē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú ɔdā dóódu yɔ̄ ipú oyī kú nū. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka kéē lɛ odúúdú oyī ā pīya klá ɛyí ede á, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya í yá uwā ɛhi ā. ā gē yá kéē kpó íne ō bīya yɛ́ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sta he Uhégāyi ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ɔdōlé olɔhi mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō nyīyē nēe gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ héyīfuú gé lɛ ɔ́ fíyafíya á. Ó klla lɛ ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyá ahāapa fu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā nēe gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Ó klla le anú mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kpó ga ɛga nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛnyā kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ī bá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē cíla Ujówābu óluma kú ācɛ nēe yá ɔdā okpaakpa fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ nōó kpó ŋmó ā. Ohígbū ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ jíkpó ikwū kú Ábna, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unɛ́ɛ, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Amása, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujéta, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó ŋmó áncā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ, hīlatá, ká ā nyɔ̄ mla uwá, ā híī bíkpáajɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ami da uwá kéē wā á.

eng_Latn: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
idu_Latn: N gē yúúfi uwɔ ohígbū ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi. A gē je ɔdā nōó wɛ ákú uwɔ ŋ́, a kē ī cē ɔdā nɛ̄ á nyi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the LORD, and see how they do.
idu_Latn: Eko le gla yɛɛ ā, Upɔ́lu da Ubánābasi kahíníī, Wā, ká ālɔ̄ cīgbīhi gaá jila ayínɛ́ nēe bá ipú igelī dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā kú Óndú lɛ uwa ā, ká ālɔ̄ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá lɛ.

eng_Latn: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú géē nyīla cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ alɛwa í gáā yíhɔtū tá ācɛ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé, odúúdú ācɛ gē gwéeyē. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé, ācɛ kwú pɛ́ kwu tayínū.

eng_Latn: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ anɔ́ɔ o kwúcē le tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ayíkpó kú nū tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā géē nya uwɔ tá piyóó, klla í lɔfú tū uwɔ iyē á.

eng_Latn: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, a géē je uwá ce ɛga nōo gē plla nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú plla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá kwú yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kū Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ka, aá jé ka alelékwū obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā wā í yá ɔ̄ italā á.

eng_Latn: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
idu_Latn: Ń je ɛga lɛ ācɛnyā dúúmā kéē lɛ ikwu īkpɛ́yí ācɛnyīlɔ ŋ́, ámāŋ́ ka o nwū ɔdā dúú ipú icɔ́ɔci ŋ́. Kéē bá cíí ipú icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, N lɛ okónu cɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú um ícɛ.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um, ká ā habɔ̄ aókwū tá kéē nyi aókwū ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ n le tá ipú unwalu ā, odúúdú uwā bá ī gwéeyē. Odúúdú uwā le jīla tū um bá yɔ̄ ī yá ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó lɛ oōmɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
idu_Latn: Aítíca kú íne ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīsi gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ í ka ɛbí yɔ̄ āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú jé íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi glá āa? Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū je íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bīya ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi glá á.

eng_Latn: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le cɔ̄nū abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó leyī yɛ uwá jīla biílí ā, amáŋ nááná ā ɔtū kú nū le bīya ohígbū ɔtū olɔfú mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ naŋ́daa. Ó lɛ ɔ́ naŋ́daa anɔ́ɔ ó le yá lɔhi iyínū á.

eng_Latn: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
idu_Latn: É kē jé ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā gaá lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā á.

eng_Latn: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā cānjɛ le yɛ gaá lɛ ka lɛ Ubálāki ka Ubálam ɔ́ɔ tá ka anúɔ í wā mla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da Udóyēgu ka ɔ̄ lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ Udóyēgu le uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú á. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó ŋmó ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā nēe gē bī ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā glá ā ofɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Da Árɔ̄ni kóō kwú okwutɛ kú nū ā ú nāndaa ce eyī ísu, áyɔ́kpá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, njɔlɔ mɛ́mla obugā, kéē tū abaná klɛ́ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
idu_Latn: N hi Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Jísɔs mɛ́mla aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ ā ijáalí kú ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n gáā tū uwɔ nyā a. N dɔɔ̄kā ká ā lɛ ukɔ́ ā tū ká ā híī yúufi eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ámāŋ́ ka o gwó ɔwɛ ce abɔ̄ éyi, ipú ɔda dúúmā nāa ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, awɔ wɛ ádā alɔ á. Alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔmɛ ā, a kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ma ɔmɛ a. Awɔ yá alɔ á.

eng_Latn: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
idu_Latn: Ā géē yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, É tū um ɛ̄bɛ̄, ó kē lɛ ɔnɔ tū um ŋ́. É ŋmó um ijē, amáŋ ń lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́. Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā? N klla í nyɔ̄ í gwá ejé igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
idu_Latn: Ń kōō má odúmā kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ o hile ā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ujémīsi ɔyínɛ́ kú Óndú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhámɔ, ádā kú Ussɛ́kɛm le tá ɛgiyí Ujékɔ̄pu gaá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā Leɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
idu_Latn: Aínu nēe bá ɛhícō fíyɛ́ dúú ā nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ aínu kú ɔtāhɛ̄ mɛ́mla ákú ɛháajɛ kú nū ā, ohígbū ka uwá tú ga igbīhi fíyɛ́ aɔ́há ā.

eng_Latn: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā wɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā á. Abālɔbányā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē nū otrɛ̄yí kú ɛcɛ nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.
idu_Latn: Ó mīyɛ ajɛ kú Uhámati mɛ́mla Usóba.

eng_Latn: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le íne nēé bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó le ubatísim yá uwā.

eng_Latn: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī ɔfū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā le ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā yálé ā, é le ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi ce Óndú ­­ā fíyɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔtū ú ce Óndú ā mla Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄. Ó le ikwū nɛ̄ alɔ je ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄, anú ó le alɔ kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á. Abālɔbányā alɔ bá ígbíli kú Ukádɛssi, ɛga nōo yɔ̄ okónōgwu kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā le jīla ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
idu_Latn: Ádām wɛ ádā kú Usɛ́ti á. Uséti wɛ ádā kú Ɛ́nɔ̄ssi á, Ɛ́nɔ̄ssi kē ma.

eng_Latn: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kwú ogbló ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kú aɔ́cí nēé hī ka upɔ́pla mɛ́mla álmɔ̄ndi mɛ́mla uplén ā ú í, le uwa gwāpū. Anɔ́ɔ ɛga óhī kú uwā wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, ɛga ɔhá kē wɛ onōbí.

eng_Latn: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ kéē kpó iyó kú uwā wu ŋmá ajɛ. É má aɛ́na, aíīlī, ɔdōlé mɛ́mla agbénú alɛwa ɔhá. É kpó iyó ā ɛ̄cī ɛtá nááná ā, iyó ā nwuné nɛ̄hi nēé kpó ɔ̄ mɛ ɛ̄cī ɛtá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aólɛlā kú aá géē cīíbɔm tū ajɛ kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú aá ú kpó ca tāajɛ, lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú inu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā kpó wu.

eng_Latn: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gā um gɔbū ka amíyɔ̄ ka lɛ Ujerúsālɛm. Ó kahíníī, Ujerúsālɛm ācɛ géē bá ī kwu uwɔ ita nyā, ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē kú ɛ́nɛ́ lɛ ā nɛ̄ ákú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ nēe bá Ulístra mɛ́mla Ikoníyɔm ā ka olɔhi kú nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda géē kwúcē wā í bá ī jikwū, ī tíne ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ ádā nū i yá ŋ́ mā. Ó gē pá ɛcí klla ī lé ɔdōlé kú ɛya nēé gwó lɛ ɛcí, klla í cikpó anyā ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ gā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ nū ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ́ ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ka anúɔ í gáā bēhé wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū le bɛ̄cɛ gaá le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kóō le bēhé wā ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
idu_Latn: Ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lā āyā kú Ujerúsālɛm nēé hī ka Ófelu ā. Usíha mɛ́mla Ugísipa gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni le ta ɛga otīihɔ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ó géē lɛ ɛkpa īlī o bɔ́ɔ́tū nēé tá iyē kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu tū nyā wiiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ami nōo wɛ Óndú géē blakwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ojigógó.

eng_Latn: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhásenaa gwó ɔwɛ kú Ɛbéenyi á, é kwú ɔcí ō cíla ɔwɛ ā ú cíla anú, kwú odūngwɔ̄wɛ mɛ́mla oje nēé gé bī le gwū ɔwɛ ā kpó kwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
idu_Latn: Usɛmérīya í yā āyā éyi kú ɔ́bíipú nāa yá ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é le ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ayá ā miya ákú ayínɛ́ uwɔ, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
idu_Latn: ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ ónīisi, ɔ́mɛhili ā wɛ ukanélīyan, ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ ukrísōlayíti, ɔ́mahātá ā wɛ ubɛríili, ɔ́mahāanɛ ā wɛ utɔ́pāasi, ɔ́migwó ā wɛ ukalsedɔ́ni, ɔ́migwóléyi ā wɛ utɔ́kwɔ̄yisi, ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa ā kē wɛ amétísiti.

eng_Latn: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ iháyí ahāapa kú ɔkpɛtā gbɔɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu ka ā. Ɔkpɛtā ā yɔ̄ ajɛ dóódu, amáŋ ɔdōlé yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
idu_Latn: É kē géē nyɔ̄ gaá móōwē piyóó, amáŋ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā géē nyɔ̄ í yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā, Umósīsi lɛ abɔ̄ kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí, le ka lɛ odúúdu ācɛ ā ka Ujóssuwa ɔ́ɔ kwɛyí anúɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
idu_Latn: Éwo éyi, ī yá éwɔhá ŋmó, igelī nɛ̄hi éyi gē lɛ abɔ̄ da igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ɛyí tāajɛ. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī bī unwalu mɛ́mla ífi wā í klā uwá.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ eko ā le yá ā, é géē tá opo gbōō hī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu igwú ŋmá Asírīya mɛ́mla Íjīpiti, ɛga nēé kpó uwā nyɔ̄ abɔ̄fú ā. Uwá í wā í gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā Ujerúsālɛm, ɛyí ɛfu kú Óndū ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
idu_Latn: A géē yá oflēnjē nē ewo kú ijē ɛbɛ́ géē pɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ā. A klla í yá ussɔ́bɛ̄lu, aócíbú, ojotíhī mɛ́mla aɔ́dōfɔ́lá. A géē bī oje udɔ lɛ yá aíyó nɛ̄ bá nyā a.

eng_Latn: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
idu_Latn: Okoolo kú umu géē jōnjīlɛ mɛ́mla ɛtɛ́-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú enyi. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē le miya ɔ́ ā í wɛ ógo ocɛyí. Okoolo igwó kú umu ámāŋ ɛtɛ́-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú enyi géē wɛ ógo ocɛyí éyi ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
idu_Latn: Umerí da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ɛ̄nyā géē yá lɛ glá ā? Ń kē jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dóódu jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔwɔ le hɔ́gwā ipū ɔkpáncō, n géē má ɔ̄ klla í blakwu okónu opiyóó nɛ̄ n ce mla odúúdú aɔ́dā oyēeyī, nōo yɔ̄ ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
idu_Latn: Anú je odúúdú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā, yá um ɛhi klla le um nyatá ŋmá ipú odúúdú ōcē nɛ̄ n du kpɛ́mm āá.

eng_Latn: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbāājɛ ā da ɔcɛ́ ka anúɔ má ka ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yī ā gē kwinya bɛ̄ɛka Ahímāasi, ɔyí kú Usádɔ̄ku ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi nɛ, ɔ́ɔ kē í bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi wā.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
idu_Latn: Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda í gáā kwu glá ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn géē kwú ɔ̄. Ó kē ī má ɔ̄ lɛ eyī kweyī mla anú, klla í kɛlā mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā, gē kɛlā kú íjééyī. Ó kē ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋmá okónu eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu tínē ká Utímōti kóō yɛce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́ á, ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá igelī abɔ́ɔ ā jé ka ádā nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jégēdē ŋ́ le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, nááná nōó jé ŋ́ mā, ó le ɛpɔ̄bí lé kpɔ́. Ó géē cílá ulé kú ɔdā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
idu_Latn: kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ó kwíyē lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā íbí! Anú nōo tɛtɛ gē bī īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ ŋmlɛ́ ŋmlɛ́, mɛ́mla otōmbíyē mɛ́mla īlī nɔ̄wá yōōlō ā le yíifa, klla gē bī ugóolu mɛ́mla ɔká mɛ́mla íhō le yíífa ā!.

eng_Latn: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ yɔ̄ ī plla ɔ́mpā nū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí ŋ́. É le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ōkā kllɔcɛ́ lɔɔlɔhi. É kē mā ɔ́bíipú ō yá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nēé le opo kú ɛfú tá, aɔ́nya ā gē dɛ̄gba. É gē hí ípī ɛfú ŋmá ɛga oligbó ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ga ajɛ ɔgbɛ́fú ā. É klla ī pó ɔ́da kú ɛfú nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā gē je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā.

eng_Latn: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le yɛ ipú úgbéenyi gɔbū i tá Assósi, ɛga nɛ̄ ó miya ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í tá ɔ̄ ā, ohígbū ka ó gáā yɛ ajɛ wā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ita nyā kwú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā. Da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Kwú ɛ̄hī ú ce ɔlá ká ā lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ omōōmu.

eng_Latn: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ó le oji nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū hɛ́ ā pó, nɛ̄ ó ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū hóoji nū ā, ɔnyā géē yá ɔ̄ jīla lɛ Óndú ā piíí. Ohígbū ka ó pó oji nɛ̄ ɔnyā hɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kē ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē je abɔ̄ kú um ŋmá eyī kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē má igbīhi kú um, amáŋ á gáā má eyī kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn í jé ɔdā ō yá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má, ohígbū kéē le jé ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gáā je aá kpó yífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
idu_Latn: É gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ, nēé wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā, aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā í jé ŋ́ mā, aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ma.

eng_Latn: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kɔ ɔhá ŋmá Utibérīyasi wā í bá pī ɛga nēé lé igbō eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta ka le ɛka gbo ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi! Ɔwɔicō ká ɔ̄ lɛ italā yá anúɔ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ í jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Ami Usénākéribu, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā da aá ka, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aá bá Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
idu_Latn: Aá gē hī um ka, Itíca mɛ́mla Óndú ā. Ɔ́ɔmā le kpaakpa lɛ ā, ohígbū ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n wɛ á.

eng_Latn: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí ā, a géē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā kwajɛ.

eng_Latn: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ unwalu kú um má, nāa le blakwu um, nɛ̄ á tá ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú uwɔ tónū ŋ́, nāa lɛ ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi je gā um, n géē je ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā lɛ awɔ nóo wɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ákú uwɔ piyóó, odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū. É gáā wá ɔ̄ ɛyí gbógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, áluka kú ubulɔ́kwu nēé í ma ā, í gáā nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ áluka nēé tɛtɛ gē ma ā ŋ́. Abɔ̄ é lɛ úklɔ́ ō yá ŋ́ mā nēé gē da uwá kéē da um kahíníī, Mā alɔ tá kú ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gáā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ká alɔ á.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā gáā gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú ajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ alɔ ka, alɔ wā Ujerúsālɛm cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ le kwú ŋmá abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla Usiríya. Oŋmífi ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ lā Ujerúsālɛm jāā kwu ícɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
idu_Latn: amáŋ ohígbū ɔtunwulanwula kú oyēeyī, é gē piyɔtū kú agbénú kú ɛcɛ, mla ɛdɔ kú únwū ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí le mu ipú ɔtū kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā jɛ̄ ipú odo kú uwā ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ é gwá īkpō ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, ń gáā yɔ̄ mla aá gbojī ajɛ gɛ ŋ́. Aá géē dɔɔ̄kā um, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n da ācɛ Ujíyu ka, Ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ā, aá wā abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gē da aá abālɔbányā á.

eng_Latn: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɛ̄nyā ā, n kē le jé ka n he uwɔ ɔtū, nɛ̄ á cɛ̄ kú aólɛla kú um kéē yá um lé ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
idu_Latn: N géē je ācɛ kú Íjīpiti pahīla klá ajɛ kú aéwo dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá nyā ŋ́. Aá kōō híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwú kú uwā ŋ́. É wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é lɛ ācɛ kpó kéē leyīkwu aɔ́dā nēé gē da wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Uwá klla gē leyīkwu ɛhi kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí nēé gē cē ā, mɛ́mla ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nēé cē iháyí dóódu ā. Ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā klla ī mīyɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ā. É gē mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ nyā ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ nēe kwu aígelī nɛ̄hi ajaajɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ka lɛ ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi bá gē yá ā he odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ukóhati ɔ́mpa ā, Ísiha ā ma ɔyí éyi: Ussélɔ̄miti, nōo klla wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā.

eng_Latn: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ɛ̄cī dóódu ācɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gē wā ī wɛ ipú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi. Ɛ̄nyā yá kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kóō kwú nwuné nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó cokónu kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē yɔ̄ ī yá piyóó ipéyī um ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē yɔ̄ lɛ ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ gē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ká alɔ ka ā, ohígbū ka ó cɛ̄ ka anúɔ lɔtūce alɔ glá, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó je úklɔ́ kú ɔna ō tá kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ alɔ á. Alɔ í yɔ̄ gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ tíne ká alɔ yá ā icííci ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō, nōo jé ipú ɔtū kú alɔ ā, tíne ká alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu nɛ̄ Ujɔ́tam, ɔyí kú Ussíya ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Uhósīī, ɔyí kú Ɛ́la le ujɔ̄ tū, tū Upéka, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔcɛ́ kú Upéka lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
idu_Latn: Uhilkíya ma Asárīya nōo ma.

eng_Latn: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɛ́būlɔn ā wɛ Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́lɔn.

eng_Latn: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú alɔ ā gā igelī kú Udáni nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō ā ɛɛ́. Alɔ bá ī pó ɛgba kú aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā. Odúúdú alɔ nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā bá ī fīyégbúlú ohígbū ufi eko nɛ̄ aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā bá ī yúuya ā. Aólɛlā ā wā gáā je ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā kpó yíífi. Kéē jé igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ujerúsālɛm ā mɛ́mla odúúdú alɔ nēe lā ipú nū ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kwú ije nēé le tū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú ō gílayá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu uwá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ abɔ̄ kwu um, ohígbū ka n jé ɔ̄ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ ɔfú nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gɛcɛ ŋmá um iyē ā.

eng_Latn: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
idu_Latn: É bī ɛdɔ ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí le yá ikpíinu nēé ma ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā cɛyí uwá ā ifa. Ɛcɔ̄ aflɛ́yí kú ikpíinu ā wɛ ujáspa, ɔ́mpa ā wɛ usáfāya, ɔ́mɛtá ā wɛ ágēeti, ɔ́mɛnɛ ā wɛ ɛ́mɛ̄rāadi.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
idu_Latn: kahíníī, N je uwɔ eko nɛ̄ ā wɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā, kwú uwɔ ú cɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ a gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ́bíipú tū um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam bī tū um ā ā? A klla le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ikpó kpó tū íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a bīya ā dúú. Íne kú um nēé bīya ā le um yá cɔ̄nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ámālɛ̄ki gāá gbēyī ɔpɛ́ kú ɔtɔ̄kpá nɛ̄ ó le éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄, ācɛ kú Ubénjamīn, aá gbɛlá ka Udéfīdi géē je ajɛ mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin lɛ odúúdú aá, klla í je aá yá aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi lɛ úklɔ́ lɛ o yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ō yá ɛdɔ úklɔ́ dóódu kwu ācoyúklábɔ̄ ā bá í gbēyī mɛ́mla ɔtūcaca kéē tá uwɔ abɔ̄. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá ā kē bá ɛháajɛ ɔ́da kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Even men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
idu_Latn: Kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ogbāājɛ kú Ubábīlɔn mā ɔ̄ tá pī Ugɛdalíya, ɔyi kú Ahíkam, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ussafán, kwu Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā mɛ́mla Ubárūku, ɔyí kú Uneríya.

eng_Latn: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
idu_Latn: N jé péee keé lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ dúú ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ, abɔ̄ aá le pīya ācɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā, é lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā nwū aá dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam le aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú oje udɔ ɔhá yá kwɛyí nū, klla kwú uwā í kpó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbāajɛ okómpinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō bī ɛya ōgwó gé lɛ Óndú cɛ́ɛ́ kéē tá ɔ́ ahínyá. Kéē gwíijē kú éeyē kéē ka odúúdú ɔdā nōó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a le tútū kú ā kɛpɔ̄ tū Ohóla mɛ́mla Ohólība ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Le ɛlā kú ucē ɛbí nēé yá ā kpó ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā má ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ipú nū ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá inu nyɔ̄ í le ɔdōlé lé klla le ɔdée gwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá má ka aá kwú okwū kú ɔnyā nēé le okónu tá lɛ ɔ́ nyā ú nyi, ohígbū koó wɛ ádā kú ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔyā éyi ga iháyí ɛhɔ̄, ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛhɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā, ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ oyī kú um nēé pīya bónū ohígbū ācɛ alɛwa, ōyī kú um nōo hɔ́ɔhā klá ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ oyúklɔ́ ī lɛ ŋmá odúúdú úklɔ́ kú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú ɔdā nēe yá ɔ̄ nyā, Ujóbu í bīya íne ŋmá lɛ ō da Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔgbanjɛ̄ ō bī na abɔ̄ ā ú háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ede mɛ́mla Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó tū ɔ̄ omōōmu á.

eng_Latn: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, aá le jī ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo le bīya mla ucē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ō yá. É klla gē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛcí kpó ma kwaajɛ ɛga dóódu kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm. Ó klla le ikpɛ́cí kpó gwó tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda gē gwɛ́ɛya klla gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú aéwɔhá á. Ó le iwɔ́tū kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā nū pi klá īyī nū.

eng_Latn: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
idu_Latn: Aá mafú lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā kéē he aá ɔtū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔci nēe tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ā kéē le jé. Ɛ̄nyā géē mafú lɛ uwá ka obī aá gwō kú alɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya bū wā ā, nōó gáā bū nyɔ̄ á. Ó gáā bēhé wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nyā glá gbóógbóō ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndū ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
idu_Latn: N gē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ayááyí úlúúlā ā tū. N kē ī je ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ínoōbīya yɛ́ɛhi, amáŋ n gē yá ayí mɛ́mla ayááyí ga ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́mɛtá mɛ́mla ɔ́mɛɛnɛ italā ohígbū íne kú um nɛ̄ aádā uwā bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn kē cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ācɛ ā iyē nɛ̄hi lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ōpīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ, n bī íkwu kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ī da aá ká aá lɛ iyī aá fō gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí odúúdú ayínɛ́ nēe tá ka aá yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, kē tá kéē bī ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ nwū uwā ā le yúklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
idu_Latn: É tū ɔ̄ ulé ká ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, é tū ɔ̄ ulé pálúú kóō ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā. Éeyē dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um a i jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ dúúmā nɛ̄ n pi uwá anú ā mɛ́mla itali nɛ̄ n le kwu uwá ɔkwu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ayí aflɛ́yí kú aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú aá gā um. Ɔyí ɛna ámāŋ ɔyí álá a géē yɔ̄ mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé ma ɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ̄mahātá ā, aá géē kpó uwā gā um.

eng_Latn: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā igbo ɔ́mpa kahíníī, Usáyímɔ̄ni, ɔyí Ujɔ́ni, a yíihɔtū um? Ó cīla kahíníī, Īī, Óndú a jé ka n yíihɔtū uwɔ. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Gbō aálá kú um.

eng_Latn: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ fíyaa le icō ijakī kú nū tū. Anú mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ nū ɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi ā, gāá kwu pīya ɔnyā kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī gē háyi ɛga ogēdēē mɛ́mla ɔnyɛ̄ɛpa kú ɔwɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ ŋmá aigelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla eyīpɔ́lɛ́ éyi ga ɔhá, yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā nyɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɔtūce Óndú ā, anú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú kú alɔ nōo ī tá alɔ abɔ̄ klla nya alɔ tá á.

eng_Latn: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú aá le pɛ́ kwu ā, aólɛlā ā í kōō tá ɔyī ékpónú ɛ́ nēé kpó aótrɛ̄yí kú aá kwú ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, ó lɛ ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígbómína kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Aícɔ́ɔja kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya bá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla aígbómína kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ ojīlīmā kú Upɛ́sīya ā.

eng_Latn: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le táajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, ó le yá kú aínyankwūlūmī ā kéē lɛ okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ ɛgiyí obugā iyɛ̄cɛ kú igelī ā, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ācɛnyā ī wā gaá hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
idu_Latn: É klla bī ɔnwū ɛwū ā le tá owú.

eng_Latn: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ mla uwá ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kéē lɛ aá iyē gwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uculo ā lɛ ā, ká ā lɛ ije kú uwā gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛyí púla ó i lɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ géē le jé ka ɔdā nēé da uwá lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā, wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, amáŋ ka awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ gē yēeyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe hile, nēe lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔtū wā í lā Íjīpiti ā, n géē je uwá yíífi dúúdú. Odúúdú uwá, kwú ayípɛ̄, kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ, kwu ācɛnyā géē pɛ́ kwú ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ɛfú í lé uwā, ámāŋ́ ɔkpɛtā í kpó uwá ŋmó. É géē wɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī lɛ ācɛ. Ācɛ géē bī iyē uwá le tókónu lɛ ācɛ, klla í yá uwā okónu.

eng_Latn: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e géē bī Assíma nōo wɛ ɔwɔ kú Usamérīya gbo ɔkpá ka, N bī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú Udán, ámāŋ ka n bī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ā géē gwōnū, anɔ́ɔ é kē gáā cāŋjɛ igbɔhá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
idu_Latn: O ka ɛfú ɔ́ɔ géē wā ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ūwā, ka odúúdú inɔ̄ɔda ɔkplɛ́fú kú ūwā ɔ́ɔ géē je kpó yíífi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ussáman je ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Ubɛtábɛ wúlatāajɛ eko nɛ̄ ó kpɛ́fú tú ūwā ā, nēé je aɛ́nɛ́ mla ayí ūwā kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá da ācɛ nēe lā ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Ássidɔ̄du ā, kéē le túbá ɛyí ɛfu nēe yɛ Usamérīya jila tá ā, kú aá má ígbájí mɛ́mla ɔbíipú nɛ̄ ācɛ bá gē bī ā.

eng_Latn: And having an high priest over the house of God;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ le ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄hi o leyīkwu ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá lɛ ɛɛ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
idu_Latn: Agege alɛwa bá inīcō ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ jīla tɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Óndú le ɔlá ōfíyajɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā í bī um jé ɔwɛ. Lɛ um bī kwúcē wā Usáyɔn ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú uwɔ ā, mɛ́mla ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, ɛga nāa lā ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éwo alɛwa gáā le jīla, ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē kwú uwɔ mla ɛ́yá kú um klla í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pi uwɔ mla ɛ́yá ɔ́ɔmā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ le okónu kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā ce ipú Ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ō tū Ihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ gāá jikwū klá aɛ́cí nēé jé, gē pā ūwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá unwalu ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā. Ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ujeremíya ka lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cokónu igbɛ alɛwa lɛ Ébrahām mla ɔyí nū. É ka ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ka ka awɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí uwɔ ā ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ alɛwa ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó ka ka awɔ mɛ́mla éyi kú ayí uwɔ, ó kɛlā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le bá lɛ Ujérīko ā, ó lɛ opeyī éyi nōo cīce okónu ɔwɛ yɔ̄ ī ba ɔdā.

eng_Latn: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aógbɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ eyīnyinyi ā hɛ́tá, lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
idu_Latn: ɛga nɛ̄ ó géē pīya yɛ lɛyíkwu ɔpɛ́, ɛgiyí ɛjī kú Íjīpiti ā, gaá ŋmɛ́yí ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā.

eng_Latn: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.
idu_Latn: É le ɔkpá nyā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ klla lɛ ɔ́ kpó bá ɔdɔ ɛga dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē le tútū táajɛ gbēyī ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
idu_Latn: Gbō um bɛ̄ɛka ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄ nōo gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ nōo tayínū ɛháajɛ nū ā. Gbō um bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú nū lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā. Awɔ gē gbō um, klla wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n gē tayínū á.

eng_Latn: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nēe nyi aíkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ klla cē ā, gáā lé aíkpō uwā klla í tá Óndú ā ahínyá á. Aá nēe kē nyī ikpō kú ufáyin klla lɛ ɛlá kwu uwā ā, gáā gwé ejé nēé í yá ŋmá anú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá gē le pīya aólɛhá ɔ̄cɛ tū, klla mīyɛ anyōkwū mɛ́mla ayókwu ɔdā nōo cíkā ō wɛ ákú uwá á.

eng_Latn: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
idu_Latn: usínāmɔn, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ okpóocu, mɛ́mla utulalī, mɛ́mla umáar, mɛ́mla ufránkīnsɛns, mɛ́mla ejé, mɛ́mla anɔ̄, mɛ́mla umu, mɛ́mla uwíiti, mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá, mɛ́mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya ō bī iyó, mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé kwú ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī le hɛ́ Uhɛsɛkíya mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Usénākéribu, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya mɛ́mla odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwá ohile á. Ó yá ka ācɛ kú Ujúda kéē lā ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú aóladógbe kú uwá dóódu.

eng_Latn: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kéē ga ipú ɔ́kɔ kéē bēē nyɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ anúɔ ga ogbeé kú ísu ā, abɔ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē da ɛwa kéē ga ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka n tíne ō tá aá abɔ̄. Ń yɔ̄ gē ŋmá ɔwɛ tū aá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā n tíne ká aá yá ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā okpaakpa, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú iyī aá ú lɛ úklɔ́ kú Óndú ā dúúdú kú ɔdā dúú kóō hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé klla í gwá tɔ̄hā mla um ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um, aá klla géē ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ká aá gbō ipɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ omlede kú ɛya o yɔlá ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ á. Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwā kpó klá omlede ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há kahíníī, Ɛlā nēe bá ā í wɛ ɛlā kú ojɛɛ́lɛ́ nóo. Alelékwū obɔ̄bí lɔfú nwūla eyī kú opeyī glá āā.

eng_Latn: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ̄ dúú ā, aígabɔ̄ ā gē pɛ́ ipú inu ɛga nɛ̄ Ágábáidu, Udéfīdi yɔ̄ ā ī tá ɔ̄ ɔ́gbá, gē kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ kóō le yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú Usólōmɔn kóō lɛ ofu lé fíyɛ́ uwɔ. Ká Usólómɔ̄n kóō gbagbénú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ákú uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā tú ɛyí kpɛɛ́ ɛyí agōdō kú nū le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú nū wɛ ísu Ɔmā ā, ó yɛ jāā ga ɛhícō ɛga nɛ̄ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan pɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. É le ɔ́ jámā, klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
idu_Latn: Okómpinu éyi yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú aínu nōo yɔ̄ āyā ɛháajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ Usísarīya, nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ́wá aícɔ́ɔja nēé hī ka Ɔ́wá kú Ítāli.

eng_Latn: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nyā, aá géē wɛ ayí kú Ádā aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. Ohígbū ka ɛnɔ kú nū gē cɛ̄ klá ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi. Ɔwɔ kú nū gē yá klá ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē lɛ íne tū mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bīya íne.

eng_Latn: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔfú kú ajoodobū nēe ī gbō alɔ ā, klla kwú alɔ ú ɛbɔ́ ga ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā yɔ̄ ī gbō ā.

eng_Latn: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ā géē bá ī ka kahíníī, Aá tútū ká ālɔ̄ kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm! Aá tútū! Ālɔ̄ kpɛ́fú tá uwā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Ámāŋ é klla géē ka kahíníī, Elé, eko le gla ɛɛ́, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ɛɛ́, otú le bá ō bī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tɛtɛ wɛ aólɛlā kú nū, amáŋ ó kwú alɔ í pīya aóklóbīya nū, o ŋ́má lɛ ikwū kú ɔyí nū. Abālɔbányā nɛ̄ alɔ le pīya aóklóbīya Ɔwɔicō ā, ó géē nya alɔ tá ohígbū ka ó yēeyī!.

eng_Latn: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N le yá ká ā kwú pīya ádā kú aéwo alɛwa. Ókónu nēé ce ā lɔhi ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē kpó ācɛ nēe pɛ́ kwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, nōo klla ī je ɔ́da ká ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ mā kéē le yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē ce aínyankwūlūmī ī ga iyāwu ipú ígbíli ā gē nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ ī tíne éŋkpɔ̄. É gebí ipú ígbíli, cɛ́ɛ́ é le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyā ɛnɛ nēé lɛ ɔbá ŋ́, nēe kē ī mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
idu_Latn: n gēe yɔ̄ í yúufi kú odúúdú ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ā géē yá um kpɔ́. Ohígbū ka n jé ka awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā í gáā cɛ̄ ka amíyɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē bla ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ gē yá uwā italā ígbɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā kú ipú ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū italā ā.

eng_Latn: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
idu_Latn: Kóocōō mīyɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ n bī gé lɛ uwɔ ā. Ɔwɔicō le eyīnyinyi um má nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe ce um ɛgbá kpɛ́mm ā ga um má. Abɔ̄ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ mīyɛ á.

eng_Latn: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ efūma mɛ́mla ɛdrɔ́ kú efūma nōo tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ tū klá uwá.

eng_Latn: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi éyi kwú ɛcɔ̄ nōo nwuné bɛ̄ɛka ɛgɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ tɛ́cɔ̄ í gwōtū ipú isu yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé gáā je Ubábīlɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi ā yíífi abɔ̄fú lɛ ā á, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā má ɔ̄ ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le íjééyī mɛ́mla ohílīpú nɛ̄hi je lɛ Usólōmɔn nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔ́ mīya ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kwu ita nyā lɛ ācɛ nēe je iyī uwā ka aá wɛ ācɛ o yá ɔlɔhi, nēé kē je ācɛ ɔhá odée ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
idu_Latn: kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ó gē gbāálá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ɔ̄cogbāálá kú ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbō aálá ā.

eng_Latn: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā olɔhi nāa gē yá gā um ā mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi um nɛ̄ a gē má ā géē yɛce um ipú odúúdú oyēeyī kú um. N kē géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú inu kú Ɔwɔicō piyóó.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n nōo wɛ ɔ́kplá kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Ohígbū ka Urúbɛ̄n le ikpó ɔnyā nɛ̄ ádā nū, Ujékɔ̄pu ā, gē cíkpó nū ā ce ā, ádā nū mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔ́kplá kú nū ŋmá abɔ̄ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu, ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
idu_Latn: N gē hī Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā igwú. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yá odúúdú ɛgbá kú um gā um á.

eng_Latn: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē yɛ ā, ohígbū ka, aá yɛ ɔwɛ amānyā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ, aá híī túblá ikpati kú okónu ōce ā ajaajɛ ŋ́. Aá lɛ hɛ́gigbīhi ligbó hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá bɛ̄ɛka āyá kú umáyilu ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlá nēé gbo ā jé ā, ó kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī gbɛlá obɔ̄bí ipɔ́tū kú aá āa?.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ̄, nɛ̄ aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, ó géē bɛ́yí kwu aá mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
idu_Latn: Ó da Ujérobōwam kahíníī, Lɛ ɛga igwó kpó lɛ īyī uwɔ. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē da uwɔ kahíníī, N géē mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn, n kē í kpó aípɔ́ɔma igwó kú uwā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ tá ɔnyā nū, nɛ̄ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔbá ɔhá lɛ, ɔbá nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā í gáā kwúcē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā igbɔhá glá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kōó nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā lɛ kpɔ́, ayíka ó kwú ajɛ ú tɛ̄ɛlihɔ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um nyɔ̄ í bá ī pā aɛ́cí alɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī gbajā tá ācɛnyīlɔ alɛwa ā. Anɔ́ɔ á kē bá ī tíne ō kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ Umídīya ā cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba klla bá í kwu á.

eng_Latn: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōo ŋmá okónu kú uwā ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ. É gē kɛlā obɔ̄bí ŋmá okónu.

eng_Latn: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í yá ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híīī yá alɔ italā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Usɛliféhādi, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́fa, ɔyí kú Ugílɛ̄di, ɔyí kú Umákɛ, ɔyí kú Umanásɛ, í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ŋ́, ayíka ayínɔ̄nyā ōfōōfūnū. Iyē kú uwa kē le ka, Umála, Unówa, Uhógla, Umilíca, mɛ́mla Utirísa.

eng_Latn: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ugedɛ́rɔ̄tu, Ubɛtidágɔn, Unaáma, mɛ́mla Umakɛ́da. Aígelī ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛhīlī mɛ́mla aígelī nɛŋ́cɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
idu_Latn: A lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo gé gbaajā tá aúgbɔga, ikɔkɔ ɔbá nū ō gwutá mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū ā, ka anúɔ pi uwá ahɔ̄. Nááná ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ nyɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ gē jē ukpa gbēyī anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ā. Ó kōō ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ā, ācɛ ā kwú pīya aólɛlā kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a dɔɔ̄kā āa? Ɛ́nɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cɛ̄ ká ayí um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa nēe bá ā ka éyi kóō yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ, ka ɔhá kóo kē yɔ̄ abɔ̄lúfīyē kú uwɔ eko nɛ̄ a gaá cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔyí kú Upárūwa wɛ Ugbómína kú Ísāka.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā hī Ébrahām igwú ŋmá ɔkpáncō igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a gáā má ā tá tū ɔkpá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔkpá ā ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga aícɔ́ɔci nēe bá ipú aígelī ahāapa nēe bá nyā. Iyē uwā wɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi, Usimɛ́ɛ́na, Upɛ́gámum, Utiyátira, Usádisi, Ufiladɛ́fiya, mɛ́mla Ulawodésiya.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ ijakī kú anɔ́ɔ tútū lɛ anúɔ. É le ijakī ā tútū lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ icō nū tū gbɔɔ́ ō nū ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ujúda ā nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ inu ɔ́ɔmā mīya, ó má ka ipú nū ɔ́ɔ wɛ umíta ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
idu_Latn: Ogbɛnú kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ Uhíram le tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Usólōmɔn kóō le yúklɔ́ ɔlɛ́ ā wɛ igbo oje ɔdɔ ofɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, le odúúdú ɛhi nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ nēe tɛtɛ yɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā, Ujɛhósāfati, Ujɛhóram, mɛ́mla Ahasíya kpó lɛ Óndú ā, mɛ́mla ákú abɔ̄yī nū dúú ā kpó tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ugóolu nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o bá ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ Uhaɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Usiríya. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū eyī ú pīya ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka aá le eyī pīya, anɔ́ɔ aá gbo iyāwu kú aá ga ipú ígbíli lɛyíkwu okónū ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ anúɔ ā. Ó ka aá bá gē ga amu ga anú ajɛ aɛ́fu kú Ɛ́dɔm ā ɛ̄cī alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ uwā kwú ā, ó le ɛlā nyā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ áafú ŋ́, ācɛ o kɔ ígwíígwu ā géē yɔ̄ ipú aá piíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ā jé.

eng_Latn: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī má ɔkpáncō ka á má ɔ̄. Ɔnyɛ yá aínyílɔ́wɔ āa? Anú gē kpó uwá trɛ̄yí wā ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja ā á. Ó jé aluka kú uwá, ó kē jé iyē ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwa. Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ odúúmā kú uwa í kē ī bī gbógbóōō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
idu_Latn: Umáta mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla Ulásārɔ̄si he Ujísɔ̄si ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujúda wɛ: Ɛ́ri, Ónan, Ussɛ́la, Upéresi mɛ́mla Uséra . Ayí kú Upéresi wɛ: Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Uhámulu.

eng_Latn: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sra kwú ɔkpá ā ú wā ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛnyā, ācɛnyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ nōo dē jé odée gílá ā, jīla tɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ikwú má, ufi gē kwú ɔ̄, owu ī mɛ lɛ ɔ́, ó klla ī gwōnū wɔɔlɔ wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
idu_Latn: É le ɛhi kú uwā tútū kéē je lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu eko nōó gā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ohígbū ka é le jé tɛtɛ ka aá géē lé ɔdōlé kú ɔlɛ̄ɛnɔ ā mla anú.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń da uwɔ ka igbo ahāapa ŋ́, amáŋ igbo ofɛtá cigwó ɛga ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.
idu_Latn: Igbo ɔ́mahāapa ā, eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le tútū ō tá opo ā, Ujóssuwa da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá dɛ̄gba, ohígbū ka Óndú ā kwu igelī nɛ̄hi ā ú lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ aá háyicō lɛ ɔkɔ gbā, kwú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yá aá ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ádā aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, géē je ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ā yá aá ɛhi dúú.

eng_Latn: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, lé ɛnwú, ohígbū ka ó lɔnyɛ́. Ɛ́ gɛ́nɛ̄ enyi kú āgā kú ɛnwū ā kē lɔnyɛ tū uwɔ okónu íbí ā.

eng_Latn: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lé úgwū kú ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā nū glá, amáŋ Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū gē je ɔnyā ō lɛ ohílīpú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
idu_Latn: Umɔ́dɛkāyi kwúcē le tá agblɔ̄cɛ́, anɔ́ɔ Uháman páápá le abɔ̄ pīya klá eyī mla uwēyī le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
idu_Latn: Ɔlékwū bī um bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ŋgbá nōo le jíla tū um ɔkɔ ā. Unóji kē tá iyɔ̄bū um bɛ̄ɛka ukpa nēé jē tá ɔwɛ ī gbēyī um ā.

eng_Latn: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ ohígbū ka a gē yíihɔtū tú um eko dóódu. Ɔtū kú um géē yɔ̄ í gwéeyē ohígbū ka a le um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔcí ā géē nyɔ̄ ɔlékwū ā, n géē yá ka éŋkpɔ̄ kú ipú ajɛ ā kóō pɛ́ klá anú. Ɔ́ɔmā kē í wɛ ocābɔ̄ kú ekwu kú nū. Kwu ísu mɛ́mla aɔ́kpá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, n gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pɛ́ ga ɛcɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔcí ā gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, n géē bī obū wā í klá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn klla í je odúúdú aɔ́cí kú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn a kpó ŋmɔ́lá ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ca tāajɛ. Ɛhɔ̄ dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yɛ wā í ce ɔ́ nɛɛ, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā gē tá ɛcɔ̄ éyééye tū ipú nū, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ mīya ajɛ ā tāabɔ̄ dúúdú. É le aɔ́cí ō gwíikpō dóódu kpó wúla wāajɛ klla le ɔ̄gɔ̄ njɔlɔ dóódu nēé yɛ ce ɔ́ ā kpó gwū. Igbīhāajɛ ā, igelī kú Ukɛ́ Uhɛ́rɛssɛti hile mɛ́ɛ̄ á, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ o tá ɛcɔ̄ ā le íbɔm cē tū ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔfú kpó kwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ uwā ofōōfū uwā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ gē gbɛka ā mla uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
idu_Latn: N bī iyē kú Óndú ā ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ká aá lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ayínɛ̄ alɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā lé koó wɛ ohígbū ɔtū kú uwɔ ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ɔtū kú ācɛ ɔhá. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū í lɔfú ŋ́ mā ī gwu ɔwɛ tū um ká n̄ híīī yá ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yúklɔ́ olɔhi fú gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ n kē í ma ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ nōo cíkā ō cɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā fú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
idu_Latn: Aá gáā cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō, kú aá kɛpɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu yálé ɔgbɛ́fú, ohígbū kéē lɛ íne kú uwɔ bīya, nēé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pīyeyī gā ɛgiyí uwɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi amānyā, yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ka ā kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā í yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācɛ ohile ā, ami abɔ̄yī um ka ɛ̄nyā á, ó wɛ Óndú ā nóó ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā éyi lɛ ɔnyā éyi nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā cɛ̄ ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ mla anú, ɔbá ā kóō híīī tá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú iyó kú ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla udɔ mɛ́mla ukɔ̄ ɔhá dóódu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé kpó lɛ Ussɛssibássa mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nōo pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā, wɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛtá ce ofigwó.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú, nōo gbō um ā, nōo klla nwū um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē kpɛ́fú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ása gekwú anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi únóji kú aɔ́cɛ́, igelī kú Udéfīdi, Ujerúsālɛm ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɛhóssāfati lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ owɛ́cɔ̄ nyā lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cí kú ajɛ kú uwā kpó bīya.

eng_Latn: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
