idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um yɔ̄ í wā oŋmɛ́yí fíyaa, ń kē lɛ eyīyōce dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ipú alelékwū kú um, n klla géē bī odo kú um le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ. Ámāŋ n géē bī alelékwū kú um gwííjē, n ke í bē odo kú um le gwííjē dúú.

eng_Latn: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi nyā hútu ŋmá eyīyōce ká oyēeyi opiyóó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó ge kɛmgbɛ ŋ́ mā cokónu nū lɛ alɔ gbɔbū nɛ̄ ó yá ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
idu_Latn: ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ Umósīsi ā fú.

eng_Latn: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ kú éwo dóódu, kú aá yá kéē le pīya ayíkpó kú um. Aá yá uwā ubatísim ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ádā ā, mɛ́mla ɔyí ā, mɛ́mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
idu_Latn: O gbɔɔ́ kú ɛma nōo ŋmá Usém ga Ébram ā wɛ, Usém, Aápākssadi, Ussɛlá.

eng_Latn: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔtōōce nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko je ca tāajɛ eko nɛ̄ Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le yɛ jīla anú tá ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mā ikwū ō je, ká ā lɛ agíje nya ŋmá eyī mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka a géē mīyɛ ulé úklɔ́ nɛ̄ a yá ohígbū ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā. Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kē í pɛ́ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aólɛlā kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ɔyínɛ̄ nū ā gāajɛ lɛ owú nɔ̄wá kwábɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú nū ka Uséra.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ije lé kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bī dúúmā ŋ́ ŋmó. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā .

eng_Latn: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
idu_Latn: é géē ka lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ nyā ā. Ācɛ ā kē tɛtɛ le pó ka awɔ, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla alɔ ɛɛ́, é kē ī má uwɔ yēŋēē eko nɛ̄ ojuja kú uwɔ gē wā ajɛ ɛgiyí alɔ ā. A klla ī bī alɔ tá ipú iyāwu kú alɔ mla ojuja ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, mla ojuja kú ɔlá otú.

eng_Latn: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
idu_Latn: Óndú, nááná nāa le cɔ̄nū ā, ā híī ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ā híī bī ɔnū nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ ā lɛ yá um italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá gē je íne nēé bīya tayínū, amáŋ ń lɛ abɔ̄ klá ákú um jéejéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
idu_Latn: Kéē kwú ogbló ā í wu ipú eliká nēe playi áklō ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
idu_Latn: N géē bī okónu kú um tá Óndú ā ahínyá nɛ̄hi, n klla í cɛ̄tra anú ipéyī ācɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ugbɔga dúúmā yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá nōo dɔ̄ɔka kóō lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā, o géē lɛ odúúdu íne kú ucɛ ā tū. Íne kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā wɛ ékpónú lɛ ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
idu_Latn: A yá alɔ bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́béenyi kú ācɛ kéē kwú alɔ, klla ŋmó nɛɛ? Alɔ klla kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ o lɛ ipú piyajɛ nēé lɛ otrɛ̄yi nōo ī gbō uwā ɛyí ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā ŋ́ mā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
idu_Latn: wɛ awɔ nɛ, ɔcɛ́. Awɔ jɛ̄ klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi á. Onwūnē kú uwɔ yɛ jāā gaá kwu ɔkpáncō, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ kē yɛ ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
idu_Latn: Áa kwú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ú ga ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɛga nɛ̄ aá lā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe pó abɔ̄ ó cɛ̄ɛ̄cā ā géē kpó abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí kéē lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ kóō le ɛpɔ̄bí lé. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ójīla ā lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá anú, kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū kwú okwū kú nū ú ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɛgiyí únóji kú aɔ́cɛ́, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le uwɔ bī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ákanya, klla kwú uwɔ ú bī wā ɛga nōó géē leyīkwu uwɔ í yá ɛgbá kú uwɔ dóódu gā uwɔ ɛɛ́. Ó klla lɛ itébulu nēé ī kpó ɔdōlé ce gā uwɔ ká ā lé ā tū mu mla ɔdōlé ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ gónóó.

eng_Latn: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔnyā ā ka anúɔ gáā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā éyi, ɔ́ɔ kē í da anúɔ odúúdú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɛlā piií. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā tá Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ɛdɔ ɔ̄kā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
idu_Latn: O lɛ ɔtōōce wɛ o jé kpɔ́cíí kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó wɛ o jé cāā ka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ í má ŋ́ mā ā kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
idu_Latn: Ugwū enyi, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ēpū dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uróm ā le ɔdā nōo yá ā mā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá ā yɔ̄ gē tíifu ī jɔ́ɔnɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɔnɔ kú ɔyí ō ma ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami nōo gē kɛlā gā uwɔ ā, ami wɛ anú á.

eng_Latn: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
idu_Latn: Ó gē lɔfú tū ācɛ okwáahi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwá ā iyē.

eng_Latn: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ kpɔ́tūce á. Abɔ̄ é kē le ɔtū kpóce uwɔ ā, a kē le uwá hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa nēe pó ɛlā nyā lɔtūce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔ kóō lɛ Ágábáidu ɛyí tāápátɛ́cɔ̄. Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū géē he um glá ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ádā um, Ujerúsālɛm ɛga nɛ̄ aádáádā um lā ā, tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ igá mɛ́mla aɔ́wɛ kú nū nɛ̄ ɔlá je gbliífi ā, le gblífi tá ipú alácɛ̄ kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
idu_Latn: Aúwī ā í wā ohígbū ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ń tá áafú ŋ́ kéē gaá wūwī, kéē ŋmó, kéē kla gáā bīya ɔdā tāajɛ. Amáŋ ami ā wā kéē lɛ oyēeyī, kéē klla lɛ ɔ́ nwuné nwuné.

eng_Latn: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
idu_Latn: Alɔ má ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ugbālū, gē cɛ̄ le ācɛ Ujíyu kéē cīlɛ̄fú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ nyā, ó klla kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ɔwá Unásarín.

eng_Latn: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aláadi éyi kú uculo kú ɔnyā ō lɛ yá mla ɛ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ a klla kwɛ̄hɔ̄cī iháyí ahāapa ɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú Urécɛ̄lu ú gā uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā jɔfú lɛ alɔ ka, N kwú uwɔ ú ce ká ā wɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ lɛ aílɔ́wá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē le nyatá.

eng_Latn: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;
idu_Latn: Udárīyɔs le aígbómína ofɛhīlī fu kéē leyīkwu odúúdú ajɛ kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ nēe da Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā ká ɔ̄ mā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá kéē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cí Usɛ́da kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā wɛ aɔ́cí kú Óndú abɔ̄yī nū nōó tū á. Ó kē ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
idu_Latn: Owu ā le yá kú úgbéenyi ā kóō jíliyē nɛ̄hi, é cēyītīkwū kéē le úgbéenyi ā eyī pīya tá ɔwɛ kú owu ā, alɔ má mlɛ́nyɔ́ le ɛga je lɛ owu ā kóō pɛ́ úgbéenyi kú alɔ nyɔ̄ icííci.

eng_Latn: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
idu_Latn: É klla da uwá ɔ̄kā iyē kú ācɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kpɔ bá bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā. Ɔcí kú Usɛ́da kpɔ bá bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ɔlamu kú usíkamɔ ŋmá Useféla ā.

eng_Latn: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urúbɛn le ɛlā nēé ka ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó lɔfú tīyē kóō lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu nyatá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ híī ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó mīyɛ ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ā, aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ofucɛnɛ ā má gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ɔyí álá ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā bī ogwúmogwú mɛ́mla ocíbú ugóolu nēe le ɔtulalī tū ɔ̄ omoomu. Ɔtulalī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔkɔ nɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá gē gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyā ŋ́, ayínɛ̄ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā géē lé úgwū kú nū.

eng_Latn: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē nuunu tá ūwā bɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nēé kwú ayí nū ú kpó uwī ā. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē je uwá ipú kpó yíla, ka anúɔ klla géē je uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ágábá gē je ɛbɛ́ híla lé ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
idu_Latn: Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe kōō lɔfú klla nwuné nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aítíca nēe bá nyā ā, í bī ɛcá ō cá le kpó ɛlā ce uwá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā nóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ da aá kóō bī aɔ́dā nēe bá ā wā gé um eko nɛ̄ aá ī gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ da aá kú aá bá ī tāglīyɛ gicō gaajɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um āa?.

eng_Latn: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
idu_Latn: É cɛ̄ lɛ aógbɛhá yá ɔdā nēé lɛ íkwu ō yá ā ŋ́. É klla cɛ̄ lɛ ódúudú aógbɛhá kú ipú ajɛ ā le pɛ́ kwu nyɔ̄ í tayínū.

eng_Latn: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
idu_Latn: É bá ī fu ɔcí mɛ́mla ácí kú ígbíli ŋmá ajɛ, gē lé. É kōō ī lé ɛgba kú ɔcī kú ufiye dúú.

eng_Latn: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umáta da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka a yɔ̄ amānyā nɛɛ, ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā í yɛ í kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le okónu kú ijakī ā nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ijakī ā da Ubálam kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n yá uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nāa fīyɛ̄ um ɔcí igbo ɛtá nyā a.

eng_Latn: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
idu_Latn: N gebí ɛɛ́! Ɔ̄nyɛ géē hɛ́ um tá ŋmá ɔkpíyē nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ká um gekwú ā?.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
idu_Latn: Uféro le ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yá ā da, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɛbɛ́ ékpónū kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā í kwú ŋ́. Amáŋ Uféro le ɔtū kú nū yá lɔfú kpɔ́, ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ okwū kú Amása nōo wɛ oyōōyī cɛnyi ā gwutá ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔwɛ kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujówābu ā le má ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo má okwū ā gē māháyi pī ɔ̄ ā, ó le okwū ā pi ŋmá ɔwɛ gaá tá ipácí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú áto ú tá klá anú á.

eng_Latn: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ ī ka mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Íne ā abɔ̄yīnū wɛ ínoōbīya nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́! Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō wɛ íne ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í jé ínoōbīya ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka íne ā í kahíníī, Á híī leyīkwu ɔdā ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í jé ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī ō kwu ɔdā ɔ̄cɛ wɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya klla kahíníī, Aá túblá um ajaajɛ kú aá jāhɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá pó ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā. Ŋmá ajaajɛ ā n gē kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ péēē lɛ aá. N klla kē yɔ̄ amānyā eko nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā gbɔɔ́ ā. Abālɔbányā, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kwú ɔfú kú nū ú gā um klla lɛ um tɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ɛ́lāyi ā jīla, ŋmá aflɛ́yí ga ámōmɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ojīlīmā kú nū tū wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō jāā gɛjī nōó gekwú á. Ikwū ūwēyī nōó kōō kwú ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá á.

eng_Latn: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ō yá ī lɔnyɛ tū ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnwú ī lɔnyɛ ipú okónu kú nū ā. Ó kē lɛ ɔ́ tá ɛháajɛ ígblɛ́nyī kú nū.

eng_Latn: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē má o jɛ̄ gɔbū kú ācɛ kú uwɔ nāa fu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóō he ami mɛ́mla uwá tɔ̄há. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwéeyē mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nāa je gicō ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
idu_Latn: Ɛpláko nēé bá gē lé ɔdōlé ā, Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N da aá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi éyi, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá nōo yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé mla um ā géē yá ibīyājɛ tū um.

eng_Latn: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú tīyē cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ lɔtūlé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúúfi uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ mla uwá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gáā plla uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē já uwā kwu ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
idu_Latn: Ā híī ma iyī uwɔ fú lɛ ɔcɛ́ ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ocɛgbá nɛ̄hi, ámāŋ ka o je iyī uwɔ gicō eko nāa háyi iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
idu_Latn: Lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá ede kú ɛya kú ɔdā ō pá ɔlá dúúdú mla odúúdú iyó kú nū, ɔgbanjɛ̄ ō bī na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛga ō háyi kú nū.

eng_Latn: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyi ɔ́ ā, ó wɛ iyē ɔlamu. Eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ā, ó géē wɛ iyē kú alelékwū. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ iyē ɔlamu yɔ̄, ayíka iyē kú alelékwū kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō ékpó nōo kahíníī, Aá híī gbaajā ámāŋ́ o cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá ŋ́ mā kē ka ka, aá híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́ dúú á. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá kōō gbajā ŋ́, amáŋ nɛ̄ aá kē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, aá kwú pīya ācɛ o bīya íne ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
idu_Latn: Aólūhī gē lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ tāajɛ, aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí klla í wúla anú tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi aá kē ī yíhɔtū tá odúúdú ayínɛ́ nēé bá odúúdú Umesadónīya ā. Nááná alɔ yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ alɔ, ká aá yá lɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
idu_Latn: Ɛlísaa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā da ācɛ nēe ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú je lɛ Umósīsi á.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
idu_Latn: Ubénjamīn mɛ́mla Uhássūbu ma ɔdɔ kú igybū ɔlɛ́ uwá á. Asárīya, ɔyí kú Umaásēya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ananíya ma ɔdɔ kú igbū ɔlɛ́ uwā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ í yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū ká ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā nōo í yá kú ācɛ kéē bá ɛbɔ́ mla iyī uwā mɛ́mla o yá ɔdā nōo í tá ɔ́mpa uwā abɔ̄ kéē le lɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fú ŋmá āyā kú Íssbɔ̄sseti mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin, kéē kweyī mɛ́mla ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa ŋmá āyā kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
idu_Latn: É bá abɔ́ɔ bá ī lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā mɛ́mla ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā, ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
idu_Latn: É ma aá ācɛ Ujíyu ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā gē hī aá ka ācɛ nēé hɛ́ api ŋ́ ohígbū ka uwá ā lɛ apī hɛ́. Ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu yá ɔkpíyē ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ, gē cōkónu cúúu kwu uwɔ. É klla ī cōkónu gbɛdɛ le ɔcɔ́ tá gē ka, alɔ kwú ɔ̄ í yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́, Aháa. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ alɔ húmáyī gbēyī á. Ó gā ɛɛ́, alɔ kē le ɔ́ má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
idu_Latn: N géē je uwɔ pīya ádā kú éwo nɛ̄hi. N géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ. N géē yá kú iyē kú uwɔ kóō lóofu nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔhā lɛ ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔcí kú Usída, mɛ́mla uháyísɔ̄pu, mɛ́mla ɔ́ŋgbá nɔ̄wá ú tá ga ipú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
idu_Latn: Ó le Ubɛ́njamīn kwú bɔ́ɔ́tū, gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū. Ubɛ́njamīn kē jikwū abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu kwú ɔ̄ bɔ́ɔ́tū ā.

eng_Latn: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubíldāadi, ɔ̄cɛ Ussúwa ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄ kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ gē ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā.

eng_Latn: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kplá ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ije kpɔ́ nááná nɛ̄ iháyí ɔ́mahāapa nēé gē ŋmó ulé nyí kōō le bá ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɛlá obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wā ipú kú uwā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ tá kóō kplá ɔyínɛ́ uwā nōo gbɛhá ā ijē, ɔ́ɔ géē jikwū tɛ́ɛcɛ klá Óndú ā lɛyíkwu uwá, Óndú ā kē í ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa ā wɛ Uhássábīya.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. N géē bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí wā í klá awɔ, n klla í je uwɔ gwu bónū ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu. N klla í je odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, kwu ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ, kwu ɔfīyɛ mɛ́mla ɔyí ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And ye are witnesses of these things.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ijáalí kú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á.

eng_Latn: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká Ɔwɔicō, Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kéē yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛ aá, kéē yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ Ubɛ́njamīn má mɛ́mla uwá ā, ó da ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔdōlé kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, Lɛ ācɛ ā bī wā inu, ká ā lɛ ɔdāajɛ éyi ŋmó ká ā lɛ ɔ́ tútū, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā géē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla um ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
idu_Latn: Ikpēyī klá uwá iyē, igbīhi, abɔ̄ acá, mɛ́mla akā kú uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n pó ɔlɛ́ um ohígbū íjééyī mɛ́mla ohílīpú kú uwɔ ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛɛ ōō.

eng_Latn: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ugbɔga, aá leyīkwu um ŋ́. N tóohɛ́wa, amáŋ aá lɛ īlī tū um ohí ŋ́. N yɔ̄ gē doōcē klla yɔ̄ agbá, amáŋ aá wā gaá má um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá kú aá lɔtūlé, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá klla géē mīyɛ ɔdā nōó cokónu ō je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
idu_Latn: Useráya, eko nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé lɛ ācɛ ā kwɛyí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔkpá ā gbo tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ga ipú ísu kú Uyúfrétīisi.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ami wɛ igbō kú oyēeyī á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā ɛgiyí um, ɛmiyɛ í gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ fúlufúlu ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē lɔtūce um, ijēēnyi í kē gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
idu_Latn: Ń kē yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ka n lɛ agbénú lɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unábɔ̄tu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Ɔwɔicō ká ɔ̄ ŋmó ɔwɛ nū, ká anúɔ je ɔdā úgwū kú aádáádā anúɔ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú aɔ́cí usɛ́da kú Ulɛ́bānɔn nēe jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi ā yíífi ŋmáajɛ. Ó klla géē kpó aɔ́cí nēé hī ka óoku kú Ubássan nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā yíífi dúú.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ abɔ̄ fú iyɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā, lɛ ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede, igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā ā lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ ā gwá.

eng_Latn: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē yúufi uwɔ, kéē klla lɛyítáajɛ gā awɔ odúúdú eko nēé lā ipú ajɛ nāa je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Uprísila mɛ́mla Akwíla, ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ ō cɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si mla um.

eng_Latn: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
idu_Latn: Otɔ́tūlé, nōo wɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ, nɛ̄ Ádā ā géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ ohígbū ka aá wɛ ákú um ā, géē nwū aá ɔdā dóódu, ó géē blatū aá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n da aá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gɔbū, ká aá yɛ jīla igelī nɛ̄hi ā tá, aícɔ́ɔja kéē gbɔbū lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ahāapa nēe bī opo iyɔ̄bū kú ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si leyīkwu ɔ́ cíí ó le he ɔ́ ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā ékpónú hile gā awɔ kpɔ́, nyɔ̄ gaá kwú odúúdú ɔdā nāa lɛ ā í kpó lá, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ije nū í kpó lɛ ācɛ ogbɛhá, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ agbénú lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ a wā í tū um ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ayí kú Uséra ā wɛ Ujéwēlu.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla da ɔ́ ka anú, mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛ́ɛ géē hí ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔkpani nū Usɔ́ɔlu, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ bī ɔdōlé ŋmá anú lɛ uwá. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka amáŋ Umefíbōssɛ̄ti abɔ̄yī nū ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī wā í lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla anúɔ ojigógó.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umeléya, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uménna, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umɛtáta, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unátan, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó jé ɔwɛ dóódu nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā. Eko nōó lɛ um jámá kwɛyí, n géē le yēŋēē bɛ̄ɛka ugóolu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, A jé ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka ā, ā híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, ā híī cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá ŋ́, ā híī wūwī ŋ́, ā híī ce ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ŋ́, ā híī pīya ɔ̄cɛ dúú tū ŋ́, lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā uwɔ mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í wɛ ācɛ ékpónú mla ācɛ Ujíyu dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ayí alɔ í lɔhi klla wɛ ayí bɛ̄ɛka ayí uwā ŋ́ nɛɛ? É kwú ayínɔ̄nyā kú alɔ ōhī ú kpó lá ɔfiyɛ ɛɛ́. Alɔ í kē lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nōo í tá alɔ abɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka é kwu ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú alɔ ú kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ.

eng_Latn: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kɛlā gɔbū ka, N cokónu lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ka Alelékwū kú um í yɔ̄ mla aá. N kē yɔ̄ mla aá kpɔ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oóhɔ́nyɛtá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ géē wɛ̄ɛcɛ, é kē í ma ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā idáagó fú kéē plá ācɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ kóō tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛ, é géē plá ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu abɔ̄yī nū ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ kú ōwē ā gē ŋmó aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ijē klla ī dā uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē ma ubulɔ́kwu kú aá jīla ɛ̄cī dóódu bɛ̄ɛka eko otɛtɛ ā gɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
idu_Latn: N kwú iyó ogbɛnú ā ú ŋmá aá igbīhi ɛɛ́, n klla lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá úklɔ́ olɔfú ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō, nōo jé ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ uwá ŋmá lɛ ōje Alelékwū Ihɔ lɛ uwá dúú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
idu_Latn: Ussalimanɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya wā í le ɛfú kpó tá ɔ̄. Uhósīī cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā abɔ̄fú iháyí dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the LORD hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta lɛ iyī nū jé ā, ó kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, n le jé cāā ka Óndú ā tū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛhɔ̄ kóō wā gaá hɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ Uhérɔ̄du mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu leyīce kóō í yá ā.

eng_Latn: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
idu_Latn: Mla ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ɛga opéee kú ajɛ ā. N géē yá ka aólɛlā kú aá kéē lɛ agbénú kú aá kpó, ohígbū ínōbīya kú aá ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abālɔbányā é lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá íne ā ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka alɔ gekwú ɛgiyí ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ tū alɔ agbá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ lɛ íne ō tá tāajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ká ālɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ipú oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Alelékwū Ihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí ā le yɛ tɛ́ɛcɛ í lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ocíbú kú nū ā cē klá ɛcɛ. Ámata obɔ̄bí olɔnɔ wā í ce klá ācɛ nēé fukɔ̄ lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā udɔ̄bū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gbā ojíbó kú nū ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄ je abɔ̄ kú nū ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa gicō lɛ ɔ́ pīya kwu ɔkpáncō, klla le okónu ce ipú iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī piyóó ā kahíníī, Ó géē wɛ iháyí ɛtá ce ɔyā ɛhīlī, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ōwē mɛ́mla oyáŋmó kú ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā géē mɛ á. Odúúdú ɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē le yá i yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ō yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ̄ í túblla awɔ ajaajɛ glá ŋ́. A gē wɔ́tū odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipū.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā da Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a kwú ɔtú kú uwɔ ú pīyabɔ̄ ɛɛ́ mā, nɛ̄ á kē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla uwɔ ā tū ŋ́, nɛ̄ á klla lɛyítáajɛ le íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú um ŋ́ mā. N géē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ ā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwɔ piíí. N klla í je ɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, nōo wɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ocīlɛ̄fú kú ācɛ ā mɛ tāajɛ ā, Upɔ́lu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛlā otɔtūlé ka lɛ uwā ā, o lɛ uwá tá mŋmóō. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ i tá Umasɛdónīya á.

eng_Latn: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
idu_Latn: Aá jīijē kú aá cɛ̄tra ɔ́, aá gwó uba mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū le cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
idu_Latn: Ó cíkā ō jɛ̄ kú ɔyíkpó kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka itíca kú nū āa. Ó kē cíkā ō jɛ̄ ká ɔfiyɛ kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka óndú nū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ lɛ ádā ɔlɛ́ hī ka Ubéélsēbul , Ó lɛ ā é géē hī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū iyē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú ijē kú nū ā, ŋmá anú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é kpó ŋmá ɛbɛ́ kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú olétɔ̄há ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē je ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede, kóō ocu kú nū kóō he Óndú ā ɔtū. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bī ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā le gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú íne nōó bīya ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
idu_Latn: Ó gē bī abɔ̄ kú nū kwú Ɔwolímanya, klla í je íkwu lɛ ɔ́ kóō gbo akpáabana klá ɛga nōo tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ géē yá lɛ a! Ká Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ā, kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le yá lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Upéka yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōo tá ɔnyā nū nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá lɛ, ayíka ikpɔ́nyā ɔhá nɛ̄ ó gē ce á.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujósɛ̄fu, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bī bɛ̄cɛ bōōbū ŋmá agbá. Eko nōó le ɔnwū agba plla klla le īlī kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ā, ó gā iyɔ̄bū kú Uféro.

eng_Latn: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka iyó kú úklɔ́ nēé kpó wā ā, le cabá ō bī le yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī úklɔ́ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
idu_Latn: Oje udɔ nēé kpó lɛ Óndú ā klla nwuné nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ó tōō miya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa tíne ká n̄ yá ga awɔ ā. Opeyī ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Itíca, n dɔɔ̄kā ká n̄ mɛ́ɛbɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá, eko nōó má ka ɔfú kú uwā mɛ. Ó géē ményīnyi kú ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, eko nōó le má kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í tá uwā abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá mīyɛ ajɛ nēe yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, ajɛ nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ísu kú Ánɔn ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɛ́mɔn eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my son.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɛ́nɛ́ nū ka ɔ́ɔ blakwu eko nēé kpó oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú nū ɛkpa igwóléyi uwī, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tókónu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā ɛ́ɛ̄? Ó ka anúɔ pó abɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ tá okónu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō má ɔ̄, ka anúɔ bī oje ā á. Ó klla ka anúɔ je ije ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ nū da ɔ́ɔ ka Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce anú nōo wɛ ɔyí anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā pó lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́, ufi kē c­ɛ̄ le abɔ̄ hɛ́ alɔ iyē. Alɔ bá ī jɔ́ɔnɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
idu_Latn: Aá í gwɛ́ɛya kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé le anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū ɔ̄ mɛ́mla okoolo ɛtá kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna ā. Okoolo ɛpa kú umu mɛ́mla omlede ā.

eng_Latn: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
idu_Latn: É le ijā kú ucérūbim, ɔcí kú alī mɛ́mla ododó kú ɔcí he tū odūngwɔ̄wɛ ɛpa ā, é klla lɛ ugóolu ma plla anú.

eng_Latn: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú uwā, Ukayáfāsi, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ga ipɔ́lɛ́ éyi kú ācɛ Usamérīya nōo yɔ̄ ɔbū ā kéē lɛ inu nōó í gbɔga tútū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā cɛ ɛwa ā piíí piíí kéē cɛ̄ kóō lɛ Ubárābas hɛ́tá, amáŋ kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē yá ɔtūcaca kú aá je ɛhi lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ɛhi nɛ̄ aá je ā géē he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ka aá gē je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā. Ɔwɔicō ī leyīce aá kú aá je ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɛɛ gicō ŋmá ɛyí aɔ́dā oōlɛ acá oōbī wu ā, ɛga nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ ga ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā hī ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ili nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē, nōo bī ɔdōtɔ́kpá ā igwú.

eng_Latn: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́ɔbū lɛ ɛyínɛ̄hi aɛ́gɔ́ um kɔ́ɔ́ gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā a. Ɔtū kú um kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ nwū alɔ ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō lɛ ulé kú álá ā cílá ɛga ɛnɛ, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ákanya géē wā ā, aá géē bá ī tíne ɛbɔ́, amáŋ aá gáā mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And charged them that they should not make him known:
idu_Latn: Ó tū uwā ukɔ́ kéē híīī yá ká ācɛ ɔhá kéē jé kwu anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
idu_Latn: A klla í yá ogbló ɛpa kú ɔ́kíkā kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
idu_Latn: Kóócōō kwú íne kú uwɔ nēé bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a cɛ̄ ŋ́, ɛńba a lɛ iyē kú um ŋmónyí ŋmá ipú ɔkpá nāa tá iyē kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú álá éyi, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipū nū gaá mlɛ́nyɔ́ á. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kē bá eyīpíípú kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē kwúcē gā ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
idu_Latn: A le ɔwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō le yá klá ajɛ ká ā mafú ka anúɔ lɛ ɛlá kwu alɛɛcɛ. A klla le ajɛ yá lɔhi kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ yá. Ísu kú uwɔ le mu mla éŋkpɔ̄, a le ajɛ yá lɔɔlɔhi kóō yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, a klla le ɛcɛ tū mu mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá ɔ̄ kē yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n gbɛlá kóō lɔhi ká n̄ lɛ olagbá tɛ̄hɔ, ká n̄ kē tá ɔdā nōó yā ā ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
idu_Latn: Óndú a í klla lɛ ɛlá wu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anú abɔ̄yī nū pa uwá hīla á. Ó klla lɛ ojīlīma cɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú alɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá kóō kɛlā kpɔ́ɔ́kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti le hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
idu_Latn: É géē wā í kpɛ́fú tá aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā lɔfú-lɔfú, klla í je odūngwɔ̄wɛ nɛ̄hi kú igá kú uwā ā kpó ca. Ó ka ɛfú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kpó yíífi ohígbū ka é gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā īkpēyī kú iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmó Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā húmáyī yá alɔ ōwē. É lɛ Ɔwɔicō yá cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi! Ɛlā ācɛ dúú í he uwá ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ bá mla aá ā, alɔ gē da aá ka, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó yúklɔ́ ŋ́, í cíkā ō lé ɔdōlé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ohí kú nū gicō, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ ī ceyī ŋaáŋaá lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ nōo tá ipú ɔlá ā. Oŋmá ohí kú nū wā ajɛ, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī yi ā, klla yɔ̄ ī fíyaajɛ mɛ́mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahímāasi klla tá ɔ̄ ohi ka nááná anúɔ tíne ká anúɔ nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ahímāasi le inya kwu bū ɔwɛ nōo yɛ gaá bū ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ó kōō le inya kwu le gwú ɔ̄cɛ Ukúss ā.

eng_Latn: When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ekōhī ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔnyā lɛ, nɛ̄ igbīhāajɛ nōó he ɔ́ ɔtū gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ odée má ɛgīyí ɔnyā ā nōó he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔkpá ɔnyā-ō-tá je lɛ ɔnyā ā, kwú ɔnyā ā ú nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ Ulífāyi ā kahíníī, Áá lɛ īyī aá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá iyē gwu yēŋēē cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gaá kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ú wā ɛga nɛ̄ n tútū lɛ ɔ́ Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ lɛ ā, aá tú iyī aá wā ɛgiyí nū, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdōcīce kpó ce ɛyí ijakī kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Ákisi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugáti gaá tíne aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū á. Ó lɛ uwá má klla le uwá kpó kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan le ɛka gwá mla Udéfīdi, ohígbū ka ó he ɔ́ ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka iyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé wɛ ayí kú ācɛ opɛ̄cí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayī kú akwuna nɛ̄ ó jé ɔdā uwēyī ŋ́ mā lɛ ā. Ɔnyā ka anúɔ géē ga ɛgiyí aɔ́ya anúɔ nēe gē je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ gwá ā. Ó ka ācɛ gē kpó īlī ewulu mla īlī inyaŋgbɛ, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu mla ejé lɛ anúɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
idu_Latn: Ó ka nááná ā, ɛ́ɛ bā ī pā ɛcí Ugílɛ̄di kpɔ́. Ó ka ācɛ nēe pā ɛcí ā géē kwú. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ bá ī je ɛna gwɛ́ɛya Ugígalu, amáŋ, ɛyí ede kú abɔ́ɔ ā géē je pīya otīkwū kú ɛcɔ̄ nōo bá ipácí ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gwó lɛyíkwu ɔfú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī ka ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɔfú lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā, úwé kú nū kē tɛ́hɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka áfū á.

eng_Latn: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwú inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ú gā um, mɛ́mla odúúdu oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla Ugóolu nēe bá anú ā, ń gáā tá ɛlā kú Óndú ā nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdā abɔ̄yī um ŋ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka gā um ā ōfōōfū nū nɛ̄ n géē ka á.

eng_Latn: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ géē bī agbénú kú ugóólu , agbá kú Ugóolu , eliká kú ugóolu , ɔdōplahɔ̄ kú ugóolu , agbá ō tɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ugóolu , nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ je ā. Alɔ kwú aɛ́nē e bá ɔ́ɔmā ú gbā Óndú ā, kóō wɛ ulé nɛ̄ alɔ cílá kwɛyí oyēeyī kú alɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē gbō oyēeyī kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ, awɔ nōo gē gbō Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cogbāálá ā. Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ā, awɔ nōo gē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ uwɔ tɔ̄ɔkwu bɛ̄ɛka aálá ā.

eng_Latn: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
idu_Latn: N gē kɛlā kú íjééyī, ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ā kē cēyīgēdēē.

eng_Latn: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhérɔdu hī ācojéeyī ā igwú ga ɛkwūbá, yá ɛmɛɛma, le jé ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā eko nɛ̄ ínyílɔ́wɔ ā bɛ̄cɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si leyīkwu uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛgiyí ɔlɛɛcɛ ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nōó tū ō yá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔdā dóódu tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ō yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
idu_Latn: A yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ īyī uwɔ lé ipú ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ icííci. Ɔ́ɔmā í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛcɛ ohígbū uwɔ ŋ́. Ó kē gáā kpó aápátɛ́cɔ̄ fu ŋmá ɛga nēé kwu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā gē jíla ɔcí nēé hī ka Óoku ā kanyáá, ó klla ī je ēpū wúla ŋmá icō ɔcí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, odúúdú ācɛ géē bá ī dɛ̄gba kahíníī, wóofu ɛgahi kú Óndú.

eng_Latn: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlífāasi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Utémān ā da Ujóbu kahíníī.

eng_Latn: In his days Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Ujosíya, ɔcɛ́ ā, Uféro Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti le aícɔ́ɔja kpó ga okónu ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi kóō gaá tá ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya abɔ̄. Ujosíya ī cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ā gaá bū Umegído ŋ́, amáŋ Unéko, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú Ujosáya ú ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na kú uwā gē yīpú eko dóódu nɛ̄ ɔbá ɛna lɛ uwá ce. É gē ma ɔyí, í klla ī plla ɔyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔhi nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, odúúdú aéwo bá ī pó ofu uwɔ. Ohígbū ka ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá uwɔ jɛ̄ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nyā á. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā, gaá kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō géē gbɔɔ́ aflɛ́yí ŋmá ācɛ ɔlɛ nū. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛpɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ, ɔdí kē í wɛ oŋmɛ̄yi kú ācɛ nēé jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya kahíníī, Ipú iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ n wɛ igbómína kú Ujúda ā, o ŋmá ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi ce ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, jāā gaá kwu iháyí ɔ́mofu ce igwɛ́ɛpa ā, ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, amáŋ ka aɔ́mpa um dúúmā í lé ɔdōlé nōo cíkā ō wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ami nōo wɛ ígbómína ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umadmena mla Ugɛ́bim, ba ī kwu inya kú oyēeyī kú uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe jé ō gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ ā, nēe lā ipú ɔlá ofíyajɛ kú iyē kú uwɔ ā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó kwú okwū ā ú pi ŋmá ɔwɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ wā í le yɛce Ujówābu kéē nū Usséba, ɔyí kú Ubíkiri inya.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
idu_Latn: Áa híī yá ɔnyōkwū ámāŋ ɔníōkwū dóódu obɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū wā ɛgiyí nū í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a gē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā ipú ācīije ā mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́da ā je kéē lɛ odúúdú ācojéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó ŋmó á, kwu Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa nū.

eng_Latn: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
idu_Latn: Ó le agbla gwó lɛ Ubáalu ipú ajɛ kú Usamérīya. Ó klla le ede kú Ubáalu gwó klla kwú ɔ̄ ú gaá tá ipú agbla kú Ubáalu ā.

eng_Latn: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
idu_Latn: Ó móōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛhi ipú abɔ̄ kú aólobócí. Ɛ̄nyā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ije kú nū ú ŋmó tū ōcē ā, amáŋ ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ōcē kú nū ā í tētēyi ā, ó yɔ̄ ī bɔ̄bí tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla eko dóódu nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā, ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā mɛ́mla ucɛ ɔhá dóódu ā. É le íne tū kú áluka kú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe géē yúklɔ́ ɔgbɔɔgba, igbo áluka nēé cɛgbá ā. Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā gē yúklɔ́ kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Óndú ā eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
idu_Latn: Ésa wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubílhan, Usááfan, mɛ́mla Ákan á.

eng_Latn: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
idu_Latn: oje ɔdɔ , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu. Gbo úklɔ́ ā ō yá mɛ́ɛnɛ. Óndú ā kóō yɔ̄ pī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄kā ā pó á, ó le tá ipú ɔkɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá ɛga céé éyi nōó í yɔ̄ ōfūnū. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le pó ā, é le yɛ ɔwɛ ajɛ yɛce ɔ́ ŋmá aígelī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ le yá ā, n cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ n húmáyī cīce ā. N klla le áhingílí wu iyē kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ n má kwōkwū le okwúukwu kwaajɛ, le abɔ̄ kú um nāŋda kwu Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.
idu_Latn: N pó abɔ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī jikwū gē ka kahíníī, Óndú, alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛna nɛ̄ é nwū ɔ̄ ɛyí ō táajɛ ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ a kē lɛ ɛlā nwū alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ le jé ɛɛ́. Lɛ alɔ kpó kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ. Alɔ le tútū ō wā í gbā awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā ɛ̄gbā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
idu_Latn: Urábīti, Ukísiyɔn, Ébɛsi.

eng_Latn: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le yɛ tá ɔwɛ dóódu, lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēé má ā, kwu ācɛ o yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔdā olɔhi hīgwú á. Inu ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ɔ́ɔmā le mu mɛ́mla aúgbɔga ā.

eng_Latn: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
idu_Latn: Óndú, yá olɔhi lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, ká n̄ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da Uféro kahíníī, Ɛyí kú ɔ̄na ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā wɛ ékpónū. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá ā nōó mafú á.

eng_Latn: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó klla lā iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwáahāanɛ. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ɔkpɛtā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó nɛ̄hi ajɛ kú Usamérīya. É gbɔɔ́ ō je īkpɛ̄yí ijakī ékpónú lá ikpīje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛnɛ. É gē je okoolo kú emī kú okóohō lá ikpīje nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aílɔ́wá mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā, lɛ ujɔ̄ tū kéē lɔfú kpó kwu Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi. É klla kē le miya kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá kla uwá ā dúú.

eng_Latn: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. N lā Usáyɔn, ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú um ā. Ujerúsālɛm kē í wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi otīihɔ, nɛ̄ aílɔ́wā í klla gáā mīyɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
idu_Latn: Ukpɛ̄ nāa je gā um ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Ɔdā nāa kpó gā um ā lɔhi fíyábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú aɛ́cí. Ó ka é mā uwā tá kéē nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
idu_Latn: Umágdíyɛlu mɛ́mla Íram.

eng_Latn: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá yá aá ā yá uwa ɛhi ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō Ádā aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, í gáā je ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ā yá aá ɛhi ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n le ka kú ācɛ kéē lā ɛbɔ́ nɛɛ, uwá ā bá ī dɔɔ̄ka kú ācɛ kéē kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, aá géē jikwū, klla géē tɛgíkwū, amáŋ ɛcɛ ā géē gwéeyē. Aá géē bá ipɔ́tū nōbí, amáŋ ɔtūnōbí kú aá géē je pīya ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā kōō yá ɔ̄ okónu dúú. É le tá ɛgiyí nū le ejé omákáká bī gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá alɔ ohi ka aá wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ. É klla ka aá kē bá ī tú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gwó, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi tɛtɛ gwó lɛ Óndú ā, klla kpó iyó tū ɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā iháyí alɛwa nēe gaá yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú igbómína ā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si bī ga ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ohile hīgwú tɔ̄há iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ ā wɛ Umátátīya.

eng_Latn: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kú Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ uwá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔbá ɔhá lɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔlɛ́ lɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Unaómi lɛ ɔtū má uwá ɔtū, le úŋmóō tá uwā. Amáŋ, é gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ odée ā Ɔwɔicō géē je lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ó kōō wɛ oligíi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā, é géē mīyɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā í gáā má ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bī ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujúda yá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n géē je yá ācɛ nɛ̄ n yá kéē wi ā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ ká ɔdā nɛ̄ aá pó ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā kóō yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá pó ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú aá, aá géē yēeyī eko dóódu ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā mɛ́mla Ádā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu gaá bá ɛháajɛ kú Églɔn bá gē cɔ̄ɔfīyɛ kú nū iháyí igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ipú ācɛ kú Ujábɛssi ā, Anɔ́ɔ é má ayípáncɛ́nyā úlā éyi nēé jé ācɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ipú ācɛ kú Ujábɛssi. É lɛ uwá kpó wā Ussílo, ajɛ kú Ukénan, ɛga nēé jīla ā.

eng_Latn: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nāa lɛ ukɔ́ nyā tū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa awɔ kwɛyí, a géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ-ocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si. Lɛ iyi uwɔ tū lɔfú ipú alelékwū abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ ī kllocɛ́ ɔwɛ kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe cɛ̄ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā. Lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ nwū uwɔ nāa kē húmáyī ī yɛce ɔ́ ā lɔfú.

eng_Latn: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ gé lɛ aá ohígbū ɔdā nyā, kóō da aá ɛlā kú āhɔ̄ kú alɔ kóō kē tū aá ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olufa ā lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwú lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíjē, klla le ɔ́ nū nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ áncā.

eng_Latn: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ tútū nɛɛ, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú opo, ɛ̄ngwū ogalúmpɛ̄ mɛ́mla áma, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɔdā ō bī gwíije dóódu ɔhá pó, aá í túkpɛɛ ká aá gbā ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ n ma kwaajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā, ó kē í lɔhi. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gáā gbā ojibó kú um ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ayíka é géē je aá kpó tá tū ipú ɔlá bōōbū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n má ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔmā nōo géē wā gaá nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú um glá ā.

eng_Latn: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó gáā bēhé ga ipú eyīpɔ́lɛ́ éyi ā, ācɛ olagwú igwó gáā jīla anú ɔwɛ. É háyi ɛcɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
idu_Latn: Aá yɛhɛ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, mla Úus. Ɔtū kú aá kóō wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ ɔtū he aá lɛ ā, ífi ká aá géē wā dúú nɛ. Aá géē bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí, tá ohɛ́ɛwa mla uwēyī dúú.

eng_Latn: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛcɛ ɔ́mɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ kwu igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Utáya ajaajɛ āá. Ó le bēé tá ipú inu éyi, anɔ́ɔ o kē tíne kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō jé ka anúɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, amáŋ ó kē otayínū ɛga dóódu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n tíne ō lɛ aá má, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɛhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Alelékwū Ihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā kɔ̄ mla aá, kóō lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē.

eng_Latn: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ō he um ɔtū, aá híī gwɔ̄ɔ́ci ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɛga je lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛpɔ̄bí. Ohígbū kéē tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ami í gwō ɔ́ci á, n géē cíla ulé, abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si je ɔkɔ gicō lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄, Ádā um, n kwú odo kú um tá uwɔ abɔ̄! Ó le ɛ̄nyā ka anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō nāa gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwɔ ŋmá ā, eko dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kē le pó, é bá hímm.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē bla ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gē je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē je gbagbénú á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ ā, ohígbū koó lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛka nōó gbo mla ádáádā uwā ā kwu eko ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
idu_Latn: Ádā oyēeyī tū um ɛhɔ̄ á, ohígbū koó yēeyī ā n kē yēeyī dúú. Ɔwɛ ékpó ā ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔkpíyē kú um lé géē yēeyī ohígbū um.

eng_Latn: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi ká ālɔ̄ gbēyī cíí, yɔ̄ i gbēyī Óndú ā kóō lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu, nēé ma Utásɔsi ipú Usilísiya, amáŋ é bī um jɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi nyā, n ke jɔ́kpá abɔ̄ kú Ugamálīyelu. É kē nwū um ɛlā ká n̄ yɛce īkpɛ̄la dóódu kú ipú íne kú aádā alɔ ā, n gē ya ɔtū caacaa kú ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú aá gē yá ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā le tá inu ā gaá kwú ojibó nēé gbā, le oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ma plá anú ā, mɛ́mla aójibó ɔhá ā, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā háyi ɔwɛ kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ úlā cofigwó ā.

eng_Latn: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄kā nōo gē nwū odée. Ohígbū ka anyā nēe bá a kwɛyí ɛka ɛpa. Éyi ŋmá ɛfu kú Usayínāyi, yɔ̄ gē ma ayí aɔ́fiyɛ. Iyē ɔnyā ā wɛ Uhágalu.

eng_Latn: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō géē cíla ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwa ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn ā wɛ, Ɛlíyāda, ó gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja, úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛhɔ̄ . É le iyē kwú mla ɔkplɛfú mla óbō, ɔtā mla ɔyī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
idu_Latn: Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpā um, aá jé kpɔ́cií ka ń gbɛlá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka abɔ̄ kú um lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā ékpó nɛ̄ n gē yá nááná ā wɛ ka, ń lɛ ɛlá wu aɔ́dā nēe bá igbīhi ā gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ inya ā kwu gaajɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ iyɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā cē kwɛyí, kéē bī ɛ̄cī ahāapa le lé ucɛ kú aáklɔ́kpɛ ipú ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
idu_Latn: Uhásɔ géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄ piyóó, nɛ̄ aɔ́gwú géē lā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā lā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka é gáā lɛ ejé fu ajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ajɛ kú éwɔhá ā glá ŋ́. É kōō gáā gwɛ́ɛya kú ūwā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ dúú. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ igbō kú uwā ā lé, géē je iyī nū tēelihɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lé ɔdōlé kú ɛyíkwū ā. É géē lé ohígbū ɛmiyɛ kú uwā ōfōōfūnū. É gáā bī igbō ā gé lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
idu_Latn: N ka ɔdā nēe bá ā lɛ aá, ká aá lɛ ɛbɔ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yɔ̄ ī piyatɔ̄há mla um. Ācɛ kú ɛcɛ géē yá ká aá móōwē. Amáŋ aá lɛ ɔtū lɛ! Ohígbū ka n lɛ ɛcɛ yálé mɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
idu_Latn: Acígilí ɔyí ā gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Īkpɛ̄yí nɛ, īkpɛ̄yí nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ádā nū da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ í yɛ ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū jīla glá ŋ́. É le okónu nū ā cēwɛ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ákú íkókwū, ámāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ododó gē nwūla wɛɛcɛ ā. Utánki ā lɔfú bī ɔjá kú éŋkpɔ̄ úlā ofu cofigwó glá.

eng_Latn: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
idu_Latn: Aúpíla ɛpa mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛpa nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ocíbú nōo ce ikpɛ́yí nū ā. Kwu agbá nēé jílatɔ̄há nēé le yá aúpíla ā ifa ā.

eng_Latn: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
idu_Latn: Awanda lɔnyɛ nɛ̄hi. Ó kē lɔnyɛ tū alɔ ō je mule nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ahasíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu cɛ̄ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujɛhóssāfāti kéē yɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ aúgbéenyi kú anúɔ, amáŋ Ujɛhóssāfāti tá.

eng_Latn: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔdāhá éyi n­ōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin, nēé hī ka Usséba, ɔyí kú Ubíkiri, yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Ó nyɔ̄ í lɛ opo tá klla kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔdā dúú í wɛ ɛlā alɔ mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, ɔyí kú Ujése ŋ́. Alɔ í kē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō ga ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aá lɛ íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā. Aá lɛ éwɔhá dóódu nōo lā ipú ajɛ kú aá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú anyā éwɔhá nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā kpó nū ŋmá ipú aá.

eng_Latn: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ uwá nū ga ɛgiyí aókóome ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le pɛ́ tū ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá mla anú ā le kpó hídáagó ohígbū áluka kú ɛbéenyi nɛ̄hi nēé kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn klla le aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā tūgwó dúú, ɛhíícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛti Uhórɔn, ó klla le igá kú ɔdɔ mɛ́mla ákú oje hɛ́ tū uwā mla aódūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Umɔ́dɛkāyi kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́. Ó klla yɔ̄ í lɔfú tōotū ɔ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lāyija nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ gaá klá okónu áyɔ́kpá kú Ucérīti, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ɛgiyí Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ádā nū ā Ása. Amáŋ ó je aíkpɛ́cí kpó catāajɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ bá ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí klla bá gē yi ɔtulalí ɔlá lɛ ɛcí abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā klla le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka Usámsin, ācɛ Ufilístiya ɔ́ɔ gē pɛ́ wā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin le héyī, gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka otɛtɛ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Amáŋ ó jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, nyɔ̄ gāá da Uhananíya ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ ka úkplākā kú ɔcí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ á, amáŋ n géē yá úkplākā kú oje kwɛ́yí nū.

eng_Latn: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
idu_Latn: Ubárūku tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ujeremíya ka odúúdú ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā gā um ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n bī ɔdōtɔ́kpá le tá ɔ̄ tū ɔkpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
idu_Latn: Oyɛ ɔwɛ ga ipú ɔwɛ ā, ɔwɛ ō yɛ ga eyīpú éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ aínu kú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ ā ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá bá ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa kú nū. Éyééye kú aínu ā lɛ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ jonjilɛ nēe wɛ umíta ɛtá āyā dóódu. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú aɔ́dɔ nēe tá ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā ā wɛ umíta ɛpa ce āyā. Igbīhi kú aínu kú ācɛ ogbō ɔwɛ ā, ɛplá éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ olɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛtá nōo yɛ ga ipú inu o yɛ ga eyīpú éyi, nōo pīyeyī kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá ipú ūpū ā wɛ ákú um. Aɛ́na ulúúlā nēe bá ɛyí ɛfu ā kē wɛ ákú um dúú.

eng_Latn: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
idu_Latn: A gē pi uwá ahɔ̄ kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nāa gē nwū ā, amáŋ ipú ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ mɛ́mla oōgɔ̄ kú uwá ā, é tá kéē bī íne kú uwɔ yúklɔ́. Náaná íne kú uwɔ ō le tū, gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ yēeyī ā. Ipú īkpɛ̄yī olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtú olɔfú kú uwá ā, é tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔlɛ́ aá tá alácɛ̄ piyóó, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu í gáā lɛ ɔnyā nōo tɛtɛ wɛ akwuna ámāŋ ɔnyā nōo tɛtɛ le ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jé ɛɛ́, ámāŋ ɔnyā nōo tɛtɛ lɛ ɔbá gbɔbū nēé tá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujábesi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ lɛ ɛ̄cī ahāapa je lɛ aá, ká aá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ga odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē tá aá abɔ̄, hɛ́ aá tá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú īyī aá ú kpó gaá lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ lɛ aá īkpēyī kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná ā kpó ŋmúla.

eng_Latn: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu Umɔ́dɛkāyi gē wā í yɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Ɛ́sta klá ā, kóō klla má ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
idu_Latn: A le ɛlā ka gā um, n kē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā dóódu nāa ka gā um ā. N wɛ ákú uwɔ nɛ̄, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú. Ɛlā kú uwɔ wɛ omōōmu ɔtū kú um mla éeyē.

eng_Latn: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú fu ā kahíníī, N géē ka ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ā tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó da um kahíníī, Ícɛ nyā, a kwú pīya ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um ɛɛ́, n kē kwú piya ádā uwɔ ɛɛ́.
