eng_Latn: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
idu_Latn: O yá kóō mafú ka aá wɛ ayí nū ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ipɔ́tū kú alɔ, alelékwū, nōo yɔ̄ ī yá kú ālɔ̄ dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ádā, Ádā um.

eng_Latn: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nēe plla mla ɛcɔ̄ ā yɛ ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ tá biílí jīla. Eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā tū wā ajɛ fíyɛ́ ipɔ́ɔnū eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔ́dāŋ kéē da aá ka, Aá má ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ ígbíli, aá híīī nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ keé da ka, Aá má ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ inu eyīpú, aá híīī cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
idu_Latn: A kwú ɛcɛ ú kwu ikpó kú nū nāa le táajɛ ā kli, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ī gáā fu ɔ́ ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá kwú éŋkpɔ̄ ú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛga éyi kú Ujɔ́dan jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá le bēé ísu ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá yá ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ bēé ā.

eng_Latn: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
idu_Latn: N jé ka a yɔ̄ ī bī um lɛyíkwu ɔlékwū, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ gē jīla piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
idu_Latn: Ussɛ́fa wɛ ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ á. Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka ɛ́ɛ híī je unwalu ámāŋ kpɛ́fu tá ācɛ kú Umówābu nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ulɔ́tu ā ŋ́. Óndú ā ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ kú Ári ā ú lɛ uwá ɛɛ́, ka anúɔ í kōō gáā je āyā dúúma kú aje ā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú n jé ka aá wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá géē yɔ̄ agbá nēé kpó aá bá tɛtɛ ā. Ācɛ ohile kú aá kéē le īkpɔ̄dā bī gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
idu_Latn: É le aúgbéenyi ā pɛ́ ga ajɛ kú Ófɛ̄ru gaá le oje ɔdɔ ɔhá bī gé lɛ Usólōmɔn. Áluka kú nū wɛ igbó oje ɔdɔ úlā éyi ce ofu .

eng_Latn: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
idu_Latn: Ólīkpō kú inu ā wɛ ikpó ahāanɛ, ɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ahāanɛ, olicó kú nū kē wɛ ikpó ahāanɛ. É klla lɛ ugóolu ma plá anú dúúdú. Ɔcí nēé hī ka usɛ́da ā nēé bī le gwó ede ā á.

eng_Latn: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gwéeyē abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē móowē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá má ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū géē he aá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá géē má ɔfú kú nū eko nōó géē wā igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
idu_Latn: Ohépu kú ododó éyééye kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú abɔ̄ kú nū dóódu.

eng_Latn: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ úwé, odokwɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdōkwɛyi gɔ́ lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni. Kóō je ojīlīma mɛ́mla o lɛ uwá jōklóbīya.

eng_Latn: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
idu_Latn: A kwú alɔ í píya ɛyétutulu kú odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kwú odúúdú ojibó kú Ubáalu mɛ́mla Ástārɔtu ú kpó bónū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É gē gbō ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ nēé ī cē igá tū igelī ā ca ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī nyɔ̄ gáā tá ɔdɔ ā gwó ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ísrɛlu í tōō gbō eko kú ɛfú nōo ī wā ɛcī nɛ̄ um gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā, é da ɔnyā kú Usámsin ā kóō lɛ ɔbá nū plá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛyí ita kú nū ā ka lɛ aá. É da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá da ɔ́ ā ŋ́, aá géē je anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā anú kpó yɔlá. É klla da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́ɔ hī aá igwú wā abɔ́ɔ gaá yá aá ɛbɛ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔlá ō mafú ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ɛgée ā wā gaá le yɛ. N géē je uwɔ hayi ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ abɔ̄ klá awɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n gaá lɛ yɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ uwá kpó wā ā, é lɛ uwá kpó háyi iyɔ̄bū ójīla okɛ̄pɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya da uwá ɔ̄kā ka.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń tɛtɛ da uwɔ ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a cɛ̄, a géē má ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ í ka kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ā, Ujonátan, ɔyí kú Abíyāta ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā faajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Adónīja da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ le bēhé, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi nɛ, ɔ́ɔ klla bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi wā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɔdā dóódu nōo gekwú abɔ̄yī nū, ɛ́ɛ híī lé ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē kwú lɛ aéwɔhá nēe lā ɔlɛ́ uwā ā kéē lé, ámāŋ ɛ́ɛ kwú lá lɛ uwá, ohígbū ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ ācɛ otīīhɔ lɛ Óndú ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛwū ámāŋ álá dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē gwá amɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū, ɛ́ɛ híī he odúúmā kú uwā ipú enyāmɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō ā kóō ményinyi uwā, ohígbū ɔdōtayínū nyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ mafú lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je anú mɛ́mla uwā kpó ŋmó tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācojéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
idu_Latn: Ipú oyéeyī kú um kpií ipú ɛcɛ nyā, nɛ̄ n wɛ ugbɔga ā, íne kú uwɔ wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ um gē gwíijē lɛyíkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
idu_Latn: Anú nōo ī dɛ̄gba tū aéwɔhá ā, ó gaá yá aótrɛ̄yí obɔ̄bí kú alɔ ā italā gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anú nōo gē nwū odúúdú ɛlā ā, ó lɛ ā, ó klla jé ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ icííci ā tóohī kahíníī, Ɔdā olɔhi nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɔfú yá lɛ alɔ glá ā? É leyī gwū ɔ́ bónū, anɔ́ɔ é bī ɛhi dúúmā gē lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayí ɛhīlī kú Ujɛ́dūtɔn ā: Ugɛdalíya, Uséri, Ujésáya, Ussímēyi, Uhassábīya mɛ́mla Umátītīya. Ádā uwá gē leyīkwu ígwu nōo gē gwííjē mla ɛ̄ngwū kéē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, klla cɛ̄tra anú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā á.

eng_Latn: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu kwú anɔ̄ ú le tū Udéfīdi ɛyí ipéyī ayínɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā í klá Udéfīdi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū á. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá Uráma á.

eng_Latn: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nōo í wā ɔ́ɔmā, aólɛlā géē kpó aíkpokwú kú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla aíkpokwú kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, mɛ́mla ákú odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā bū klá ɛcɛ ŋmá aúnóji kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
idu_Latn: Ó tū uwā ukɔ́ kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ eyīpɔ́lɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū kú aá ā. Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ aá le tá abɔ́ɔ ā, aá géē má ijakī nēé lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū ɔ̄ wū ɔcí, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ce jejee ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔ́ wī wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ o jāā kwu ícɛ nyā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í gē lé ícɛ̄bɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ɛgiyí ákwúta kú ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ nēé lɛ abɔ̄ kwu Ujékɔ̄pu á.

eng_Latn: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē yá ā, a gē leyīce Ɔwɔicō kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne ā nɛɛ? Awɔ gáā je ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne á. Ó wɛ ami gáā je gā awɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo jéeyī bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā í gē bī ɛlā nɛ̄hi nōó lɛ ɛyí ŋ́ tóohi kú ɛlā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó ā, Ahiyesa ɔyí kú Ammíssadāyi, ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán géē bī:.

eng_Latn: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Utímōti, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, bá gē tɔ́kpá nyā á. Alɔ tɔ́kpá nyā fu odúúdú aá nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe lā Ufílipāyi ā, ācɛ nēe pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, kwu aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci mɛ́mla ācotáācɛ-abɔ̄ ipú icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ugɛ́hási yɔ̄ í da ɔcɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa gē hɛ́ okwū eyī lɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ ɔcɛ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛhási da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Má ɔnyā nyā nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa je ɔyí nū nōo háyi pī nyā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á.

eng_Latn: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwā bɔ̄bíipú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ Ugomóra ā, é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ufáyin nōó gē gwá īkpō ohɔ́ɔnɔ nōo lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da uwá kahíníī, Aá kē lɛ ācɛ nēe gbō aá, aá lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄ kú aá gaá lɛ ɔ́ yá lɔfú lɔfú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɔfú glá.

eng_Latn: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄! N yɔ̄ gē tū aá ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ayí álá nēé tū ga ipú aɔ́gwú ā.

eng_Latn: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aídengéli ā kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi ā, anɔ́ɔ é da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bī ɔ̄ wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄kɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, awɔ nōo jé ɔtū kú ācɛ dóódu ā, lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi fu lɛ alɔ ŋmá ipú ɛpa nēe bá āā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
idu_Latn: Aá géē jīla tɔ̄ɔ̄há kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔyā ɔ́maahāapa. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lé ɔdōlé ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō, Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ̄ á. Ā híī yúúfi ō ga Íjīpiti ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n géē yá ká ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ kéē kwú pīya éwo nɛ̄hi abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ipú aéwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā á. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka eko ō cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, nēé kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ í kpó gwō ŋmá ɔcí kú olīifu dúúdú, nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄cí kú ɔcí ufáyin dúúmā í hile kwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gā gáā má ayíkpó ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā bá í gbiyɔ̄lā. Ó ka lɛ Upíta ka, Usáyímɔ̄ni, aá bá ī gbiyɔ̄lā nɛɛ? Aá lɔfú yēeyī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ó kōō áwa ékpónú glá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aítíca kú íne kú Umósīsi ā ka ka Ɛláyíja géē wā gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
idu_Latn: Á kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú uwɔ géē wɛ óócí ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Oyēeyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú nōo yɔ̄ eko kpii nōo klla gē mɛ táajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mahātá ā wɛ Ujɛssáya.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, mɛ́mla álá éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, A ŋmá Ugálīli dúú nɛɛ? Jila ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō, a géē má ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúúmā í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ugálīli ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ú le kwu ohígbū oyēeyī kú nū ga Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda á. Anɔ́ɔ ó mabɔ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
idu_Latn: N kē í ma ɔdā ōcābɔ̄ ōhídáagó kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā fú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ. É géē kpó ɛfú tá aá, kē kpó ācɛ ŋmó, ɔlá géē yi mla ódūdū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó tá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu. Ó klla kē fu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ odúúdú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó wā kéē lɛ gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Umósīsi. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ gē kpó ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú uwā wā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɔdā nōo yá aá gbɔbū lɛ eko nyā ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi aflɛ́yí ā, aá móōwē nɛ̄hi, nááná oōnya ā í yá alɔ lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
idu_Latn: Aógbɛhá ā géē lé ɔdōlé kllā í nū ipú. Ācɛ nēe géē wā ɛgiyí Óndú gaá gbā ɛ̄gbā géē cɛ̄tra anú. Kéē le lɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū á, ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíihɔtū tū Ɔwɔicō ā kóō yíihɔtū tū ɔyínɛ́ nū dúú.

eng_Latn: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú nēé í kpó ā í cɛ̄ lɛ okwū í bá ipú aúláyi. Ɔdūufi géē yá ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛga dóódu. Ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā géē pɛ́ kwú. Ikwū ā í gáā tɔ́ɔ́cí ayí olugwulugwu mɛ́mla aókplícī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
idu_Latn: aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā ā, nēe gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe gba ācɛ áluka ā.

eng_Latn: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka iyō ogbɛnú nēé le ce uwá ɔkɔ mla ákpláka kú oje kú oóyá ŋmó kú uwā ā, á lɛ odúúdú nū kpó ca bɛ̄ɛka eko kú ɛfú kú Umídiyan ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ujúdasi, a le ɔtū má um ɔtū o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ú tū aólɛlā kú um abɔ̄ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɔ̄nū gbojī ajɛ ŋ́, ó gē yá ɔdā olɔhi piyóó. Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú jikwū otú glá. Agīje lɔfú pɛ́ otú gbō ɔ̄cī glá, amáŋ éeyē géē gbɔɔ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, bī ula le tá Ussɛ́kɛm mɛ́mla ádā nū Uhámɔ, ohi ohígbū keé le ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā, Udáyína iyē nyílá.

eng_Latn: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē gwu uwá iyē yēŋēē ā yɔ̄ á, lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nēé gē lɛ yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā, mī klá uwá. A klla í da uwá kéē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔnwū kú iyē kú uwā wā, cɛ́ɛ́ é klla lɛ īlī kú uwā na, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ iyī uwā tū yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ń lɛ eyīyōce gɛ ŋ́ mā, ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ um ŋmó nááná, ó klla lɛ ɔdā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ n géē ka ɔkɔ kú um ipéyī nū, abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ijē gwó lɛ Ondú ā kahíníī, N géē gwííje lɛ Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó le aólɛlā kú nū yálé ɔgbɛ́fú nɛ̄hi éyi, ó le ācɛ o cɔɔnya kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla aɔ́nya kú uwā kpó tá tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
idu_Latn: Da Ujehóyákim, ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, A kwú ɔkpá ā ú yɔɔlá ɛɛ́, a klla da Ujeremíya ka ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ɔɔ́ gē ka ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ɔ ī wā í je ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ yíífi klla kpó ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ŋmó ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, A géē kpó odúúdú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ Áhābu ā yíífi piíí. A klla í je odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú Áhābu ā, kwu aɔ́fiyɛ, kwu ayí nū abɔ̄yīnū kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē blakwu ɔdā uwēyī nɛ̄ aá yá, eko nɛ̄ aá je īyī aá iyē tēelihɔ ā. Aá kē í tū īyī aá uwēyī kú aɔ́dā otīihilɛ nɛ̄ aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
idu_Latn: Ɛma kú aóklóbīya ámāŋ ka aɔ́ncɛ́nyā ōhī í gē gbojī ŋ́. Amáŋ aóklóbīya ōhī kwu ɔ̄cɛ ajaajɛ fíyɛ́ ɔyínɛ́ ipú ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ukiriyatéyim, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tgamúl, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tmeyɔn.

eng_Latn: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔtū tá ita ō kwu, N kē yɔ̄ ī ka ɛyí ita ā, abɔ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū ā.

eng_Latn: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū, ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé bá ī gbɛ̄la nū piyóó á. Ɛ̄lā obɔ̄bí kē ī ŋmá okónu kú uwā piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
idu_Latn: É yɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú éwo éyi ga ajɛ kú éwɔhá, ŋmá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éyi ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ ohígbū úklɔ́ nōo yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla da ācɛ éwɔhá nēe kwú īyī uwā í lɛ ɔ́, gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, gē yíhɔtū nū, gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ ā, klla ī lɛ ɛka kú nū tū ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
idu_Latn: Ó le cāā ka Ɔwɔicō í gáā hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ā ŋ́. Ohígbū keé tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū koó lɛ ɔtū kpóce ɔ́ ā géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
idu_Latn: Ɛya opá yɔɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ā ámāŋ ka ɛya ō gwó ká kpó íneōbīya nyɔ̄ ā í kē he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usénākeribu mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū bá Ulákisi ā, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uhɛsɛkíya mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mla Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ ɔfucɛnɛ ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā má gbo klá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō nōo cīīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔ̄cɛ ā á. É kahíníī, Aamí! Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
idu_Latn: Ó ka abālɔbányā, anúɔ géē gbo ɛka lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ híī cɔ̄nū mla aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo í ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, Ɔwɔicō í lá ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ó kē í lā ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Umanásɛ lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ubɛ́tissan, Utáánāki, Umegído mɛ́mla Udɔ́ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla ā. Ɛga nēe bá nyā wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ayí kú ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu, Ɛ́frem ā lā á.

eng_Latn: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD's servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nēé mīyɛ ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan nɛ̄ Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú aá je lɛ uwá ā. Eko, nēé mīyɛ ajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é kē má bá anú ɛbɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ́ aá géē je cīgbīhi wā í lá ipú ajɛ kú aá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan, nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā je lɛ aá ā kllɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
idu_Latn: Ugɛdalíya da uwá kahíníī, Aá híī yúufi ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ŋ́, aá lā amānyā kú aá gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó í lɔhi lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Upɛ́nūwɛlu ma Ugídɔ nōo ma Ésa, Ádā kú Uhússa á. Uhɔ́ɔ nōo wɛ ɔ́kplá kú Ɛ́frāti ā wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
idu_Latn: N géē je alelékwū éyi tá ipú nū, nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ pó uwɔ́ɔkɔ nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā géē yá kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
idu_Latn: Anú gē je ɔ́da ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē gwō á, Ó kllla ī bī ojuja wā ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú odúúdú ɛcɛ. Anú yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē límanya eko ɔwɔ á. Anú klla ī tá owu nɛ̄hi wā ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nōo ī kpó ɔ̄ tū ā á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ukúss wɛ, Ussɛ́ba, Uháfīla, Usábta, Uráama, mɛ́mla Usabtɛ́ka. Ayááyí kú Uraáma wɛ ācɛ kú Ussɛ́ba mɛ́mla Udɛ́dan.

eng_Latn: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́cí ā da ɔcí nēé hī ka ufígi ā kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tīyē ká ā gā ɛgiyí um fíya.

eng_Latn: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó ce ɛga yōōlō kú ɛhícō kú agbá kú aúpíla ā á. Ó le īkpɔ̄cī kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ofigwó ɔgba ɛpa hijā tū éyééye kú ɔ́nɔ́ŋgblɔ ā, ofɛhɔ̄, bá ɔgba éyééye.

eng_Latn: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ɔ̄málɛ éyi wā gáā já Ujísɔ̄si má. Ó dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Utíca, ɔdí nyá nɛ̄ n géē yá piíí ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ oyēeyī nōó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄dāajɛ kú nū nōo yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé ipácí ámāŋ ka ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ugrépu, le hábɔ̄, le tá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá gaá kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ú lé. Óndú kú ɔdāajɛ ā géē je ɔdɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú nū le gbā ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ ā je kpó lé ā, lɛ óndú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
idu_Latn: Ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ucɛ ā Ujísɔ̄si le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá nwɛ̄lā.

eng_Latn: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le úklɔ́ ā jila, anɔ́ɔ ó le má ka ɛ́ɛ le ɔ́ yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú cābɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwá á.

eng_Latn: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ufi kú ɔ̄kā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ ī pó ā í gáā yá ɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔtū kú nū kē yɔ̄ ɛga ékpónú. Ó klla lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka odúúdú aákpá ōbū efū wɛ ɔdēelihɔ. Óhígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, wɛ iyē nū á.

eng_Latn: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka igbīhi nɛ̄ aá le Usihɔn ɔcɛ́ ŋmó ā, Alɔ le eyī pīya, kwú ɛyí kwu ɛhícō, lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú Ubássan ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ okpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ wā í kpɛ́fú tá alɔ ajɛ kú Édrēyi á.

eng_Latn: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā kwu ŋmá ipú ikwū nyā a géē je fíyákátā gaá lā ajɛ aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ádā aá, nōo wɛ ebilíi ā nɛ. Aá kē ī tíne ká aá yá ɔdā nōo he ádā aá ɔtū ā. Ó wɛ ɔbáyitɔ ŋmá ohútu. Ó gē wɔ́tū ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ohígbū ka ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi dúúmā ipú ŋ́. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ka, ó gē ma ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā fú icííci nɛ̄. Ohígbū ka ó wɛ ɔ̄cokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ádā kú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ le aá kpó wā ɛga nɛ̄ aá bá ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā á. Ka ɔ́ɔ kwú ajɛ nōo lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā ú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu kú ipú ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í bá ī tá abɔ̄ kéē kpó uwá nyi. É kē í je ojīlīmā lɛ uwá ohígbū otábɔ̄ nyā, ipú ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ācɛ í má ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi onwuné kú um ā. Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē lɛ obūdeyī tū klá ācɛ nēe bɛ́ɛcɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī jé ɛgiyí ɔwɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē lɛ īlī wu ácí kú ipácí iyē á. Ácí nēe yēeyī icɛ nɛ̄ óócí nēé le uwá kpó ŋmó, lɛ uwá kpó tū ɔlá ā. Aá gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō géē lɛ īlī wu aá iyē fíyɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Ɔwɔicō ā í nwuné ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó híhó klla gbo ɔkpá kahíníī, Ń jé ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umáati, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umɛtɛtíyasi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɛmɛyin, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujósēki, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujóda.

eng_Latn: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛpléeko nɛ̄ ó í wɛ átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā, ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
idu_Latn: É hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ Ébrahām, ádā alɔ ohígbū úklɔ́ eko nɛ̄ ó je Áyísīki ɔyí nū ce ɛyí ede kú ofidaka ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N le jé ka a wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhússāyi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛl nwū uwɔ igbɛ́ɛ̄nyā í lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam klla le aíkpɛ́cí kpó gwó ɛyí aɛ́fu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācogwɛ́ɛya kpó fu ŋmá aípɔ́ɔma, nēé wɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá lɛ ɔ̄kā kú nū pó, klla lɛ ukpa kpla lɛ ɔ́, le ɔ́ kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é bī uwɔ kwú ɔ ú pi ga Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa mɛ́mla aéwo nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā géē wā í gbā Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛ̄gbā Ujerúsālɛm. É klla kē í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ le tá Ugéssɔ gaá lɛ Ábsālɔm bī wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: É géē lā abɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́, géē gwó inu klla í hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin. Odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe lā kwu uwá, nēe yá uwā kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu ā, n géē kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā klla ī yá uwā italā. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kē ī bá ɛbɔ́, ɔtū kú uwā í gáā plicō gɛ ŋ́. É géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú klla le ɛlā ka gā um igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā kú Ujérobōwam ā kwúcē ga Utɛ́sa. Abɔ̄ ó le bēhé wā ɔlɛ́ bōōbū ā, ɔyí nū ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
idu_Latn: N kwú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ n fu ā í ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́, ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɛfu otīihɔ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
idu_Latn: amáŋ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō yēeyī piyóó. Ɛlā nyā wɛ Ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le má ka ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ́ ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ō yɔ̄, nɛ̄ ajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ kē gbiiyē nɛɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó gē tá igbīhi kú nū wāajɛ kéē kpó iyó ce ɔ́. É le ɔ́ pi abɔ̄fú kóō yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na ojɔ̄kwū ahāapa ā mɛ́mla ɛyí kú igwu o cɛyí nɛ̄hi ahāapa ā, wɛ iháyí ahāapa. Ɔnā ā le ɛyí ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā kóō já ɔ̄ má, ohígbū ka anú abɔ̄yī nū jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gáā yá ā á.

eng_Latn: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé hī abɔ́ɔ ka Ubókim ā yɔ̄ á. É le ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
idu_Latn: nōo gē je éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmó ŋmá ɛcɔ̄ kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ ā, nōo klla gē je éŋkpɔ̄ kú eyī isú kwú bá kóō ŋmó ofū nɛ̄hi āa?.

eng_Latn: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami ā í tīile ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú odúúdú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ á. É kōō cíkā ō hī um tū ipú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́ dúú, ohígbū ka n yá icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō ōwē.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not kill.
idu_Latn: Aá híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
idu_Latn: Umálakāyi kahíníī, Odúúdú alɔ í lɛ ádā ékpónú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō ékpónú ā yá alɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē bīya okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce lɛ iyī alɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla ka gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko gē wā nɛ̄ n géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu, uwá kē í wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
idu_Latn: Ó géē wī ɛyí kú ɔnyā a klla í je iyɛ́ɛya kú umu ā ce ɔ́ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í bī aklɛ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ, nōo géē bī okónu ō tá wā ā, abɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
idu_Latn: Ipú icɔ́ɔci dóódu eyī yúm ka ācɛnyīlɔ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō á. É í wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe lɛ eko kú uwā táajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō piíí, é í je abɔ̄ kú uwā gicō kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ nōó gáā cɔ̄nū ámāŋ ka o gbaáfú ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔ́da kú um je lɛ uwá klla lɛ íne kú um, nōo i bī oyēeyī gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēe géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā nwū uwā.

eng_Latn: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, N nɔ̄na má ɔcí kú ufáyin éyi kwu iyɔ̄bū um.

eng_Latn: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: É klla kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ōhī mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá ipú ɛjī kú Umanásɛ ā lɛ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem dúú.

eng_Latn: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í je mlanyī Unówa mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ipú ɔwú ā ŋ́. Ó le yá kú owu nɛ̄hi kóō tá, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā gbo ɔ́ ō wúla á.

eng_Latn: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka anú abɔ̄yī nū yɔ̄ ipú aádáádā nū, Ébrahām, eko nɛ̄ Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki jīla Ébrahām ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
idu_Latn: N yá ká n̄ jɛ́yí unwalu nyā, amáŋ ó lɔnɔ tū um ō jɛ́yí nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ka ŋmá okónu ā, lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá, ó kē lɔfú nya ɔ̄cɛ tá glá. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā ō ka nwuné he uwá ɔtū ā, géē lɛ ɔdā nōo tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā.

eng_Latn: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
idu_Latn: Aá bī īkpō kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú mɛ́mla agbénú kú aá ohi wā í lɛ gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā kú ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔ̄wū ā ú klá ikpati kú Okónu ō ce ā.

eng_Latn: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
idu_Latn: Igbómína kú Íjīpiti kɛlā lɔfú lɔfú lɛ alɔ, ó klla le ɛlā kpó ce alɔ ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācɛ ō bɔkwu kú ajɛ tayínū.

eng_Latn: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú yēeyī ɔ̄cɔɔ̄cī, nɛ̄ ofíilí kú otú kóō bī ā, nōó lɔfú kwú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í jé ka ɔ́ɔ kwú ŋ́ glá.

eng_Latn: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Áyíjālɔn, mɛ́mla Ugatrímɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
idu_Latn: É lɔfú je ɔtulalī nyā lá ije nɛ̄hi glá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ije ā ú lɛ aógbɛhá.

eng_Latn: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
idu_Latn: N jé abɔ̄yī um ka n lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ um gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi ga um nōo yēeyī. Anú kē gē hɛ́pɔ̄ ámōōmɛ ipú ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, ó wɛ aíne ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ n tá tū ɔkpá fu aá ā ŋ́, amáŋ aíne nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā. Aíne nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ le pó ɛɛ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
idu_Latn: Éyééye kú aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ɛnɛ nyā lɛ eyī ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛnɛ. É lɛ eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ iyɔ̄bū, eyī kú ágábá kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná, eyī kú ɛna kwu abɔ̄lúfīyē, eyī kú idu kwú igbīhi.

eng_Latn: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ le eyī nwūla, amáŋ ó má ɔdā dúúmā gla ŋ́. É le abɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ga Udamásikɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú alɔ kwú gblífi tāajɛ dúúdú nɛ̄ alɔ í má uwā gɛ ŋ́. A kwú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ú kpó catāajɛ. Ācɛ kwú mlanyī uwā dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ádā uwɔ í má um ɛgiyí ucɛ ā ŋ́, nōo gbɔɔ́ ō da ɔ̄kā um. Da ɔ́ ka, ami ɔ́ɔ mīyɛ ɛga ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ kú n̄ lɛ inya kwu ga Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm fíyaa, ɔnū-ɛya kú odúúdú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gaá háyi ɛga nōo píbá kú ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gaá nyā ga ɛga dúúmā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá yá tīihɔ ŋmá lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ nāa í nwū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ ā, ɔ́ɔ kwúcē ga ɛga nēé da ɔ́ kóō híī lé ɔdā dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā gaá le ɔdōlé lé klla le odée gwá dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ ka ohígbū ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó. É kéē gáā nyi okwū kú nū ipú únóji kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
idu_Latn: n géē je ɛdɔ kú íkwu nɛ̄ Ádā um je ga um ā lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu aéwo ā. Ó géē bī ogblo kú oje le gbō uwā, klla í ca uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛtɛ́ gē ca putuu ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ukérɔ̄si mɛ́mla Usiyáha mɛ́mla Upádɔn.

eng_Latn: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
idu_Latn: Olíla, īkpō nɛ̄ a nyī ā gē kwú ipú ajɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.
idu_Latn: Uhússāyi da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi fíyaa, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le bēhé ísu ā otōōtú ɔ́ɔmā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ le ka lɛ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī gbo ɛga ō bēhé ísu kú ipú ígbíli ā otú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. O yá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ híī lɛ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó kwú klla lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
idu_Latn: Uwá lɛ Úklɔ́ kú ɔcí ō kwaajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ mla ogbló, mɛ́mla ɔcí okwaajɛ mɛ́mla ɔ́ŋgbá ō bī gba ɔlɛ́ kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
idu_Latn: Ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú nū kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gāá hi ācɛ igwú wā. Ɛga nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú kú eyīpɔ́lɛ́ ā, nēé ce bá ī hī ācɛ igwú ŋmá á. É bá ī kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ofɛtá ce igwó fu, ká ā lɛ uwá kpó gé um ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē háyi abɔ́ɔ mla uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
idu_Latn: Ó kpó aúgbáajɛ kú ɔbá ɛna ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna ahātá lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerári, kéē yúklɔ́ kú uwā dóódu ɛháajɛ kú Utáma, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni.

eng_Latn: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
idu_Latn: A gáā lɛ ɔ́ tū ācɛ ɔlamu ɛyí ŋ́. Á kē gáā bī ɔwɛ éékpónú nāa le wīya ɔ̄ tɔ̄há ā lɛ yá ɛ́gbla kú nū ŋ́. Ó tīihɔ, aá kē í je ɔ́ kóō tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaohhophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka n géē je Uféro Uhɔ́fra, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā tá ipú abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú nū, nēe tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je Usedekíya tá ipú abɔ̄ kú Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, olɛlā kú nū, nōo tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú. Aá tá Óndú ahínyá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔhi, ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
idu_Latn: Da ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ká n̄ lɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ éyi mafú ga awɔ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā, n géē yá ɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi. A lɔfú ka ɔdōcābɔ̄ kóō lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō bī ɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄lékwū ámāŋ ka icīīcō ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le odúúdú ije nɛ̄ ācɛ bī wā ī le lá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā túbá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú odúúdú nū ú kpó ga agbla kú Uféro á.

eng_Latn: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, a géē gwutá agōdō ikwū kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī tíifu. Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla iyē kú uwɔ gē yɔ̄ ī je wa ŋmáajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā gē yá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka omágbla mɛ́mla ofu kú ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpáncō ā. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi gáā gwó áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, Ɔwɔicō le ukɔ́ tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, Má ka a lɛ ɔdā dóódu yá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ é mafú gā awɔ ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
idu_Latn: Ulɛ́ya kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ulé kú um cíla um ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka n kwú ɔfiyɛ kú um lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú ɔyí nū ā ka Ísāka.

eng_Latn: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Uféro ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ga ísu kú Unáyilu ā, kwú okwutɛ kú uwɔ nōo je pīya ɛgwā ā ú bī abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā gáā gbēyī nu okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē wɔ́tū ācɛ oyá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Amáŋ Óndú ā lɔtūce ācɛ oyēŋēē mɛ́mla ācɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le pɛ́ i yɛ tá Íjīpiti á. Anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú wā í le jīla ɛga éyi.

eng_Latn: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá bī ɔkɔ ogbonɛnɛ mɛ́mla ojīlīmā le tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ohi. Aá yá ucē nɛ̄ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá cíkā ō yá ā. O yá kú ɔtū kú aá kóō ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ ɛcá cá aá klla lɛ obɔ̄bī kú ucē olɔ̄hi kú aá nēe gē yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ka, uwēyī géē kwú uwā.

eng_Latn: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má lā ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá Uhɛ́brɔn á.

eng_Latn: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá í ga ipú Ɛga otīihɔ nēé bī abɔ̄ gwó nōo wɛ omágbla kú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó le tá ipú ɔkpáncō abɔ̄yī nū, ɛga nɛ̄ ó ī nyɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tá ohi kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, ɔdā nāa tíne ká n̄ yá kpɛ́mm ā, bá ipú ɔkpá nōo ī nwū ukɔ́ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
idu_Latn: Ujése ma ayí ahāapa. O kpó kwu ɔgbɔɔgba kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ma uwā lɛ ā wɛ, Ɛlíyābu, Abínādābu, Ussáma.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ahasíya yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
idu_Latn: Acá kú okokonkofí lɔfú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka acá mɛ́mla éfú kú omlɛgwá ā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ okónu nāa ce lɛ ádā um ā yá jīla. A kwú um ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwá í tōō gba áluka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
idu_Latn: N klla kwú ácí mɛ́mla ēpū ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ú kpó lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ nēe ī yɛ ajɛ ā, mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ ubatísim nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni yá ā ŋmá āa? Ó ŋmá ɔkpáncō kɛ̄ɛ koó ŋmá abɔ̄ alɛɛcɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō miya ɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ īyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ ka, Ó ŋmá ɔkpáncō, ó géē da alɔ ɔ̄kā ka, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kē kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄hi ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le yá kú ɔtū kóō he uwá. Anɔ́ɔ é gwéeyē nɛ̄hi á. Kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā bā í gwéeyē dúú. Ācɛ pó uya kú éeyē nēé bā ī gwó ā, ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kɛlā kú Óndú ɔ́ɔmā lɛyíkwu Ubássa mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ubássa bī tū Óndú ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū. Ó wɛ ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nōó bī tū Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam bī ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū koó le odúúdú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Ujérobōwam kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nyā le yɛ ā, ɔnyā nū, Ɛlísābēti lɛ ipú yɔ̄. Ó kē le kwu tayínū ipú ínu ɔyā ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Uhíram ā wɛ ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó ce igwáahāpa.

eng_Latn: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti tá kéē lé ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā, ōcē obɔ̄bí ā géē je uwá kpó ŋmó. Óndú ā klla í tū ōcē obɔ̄bí ā klá éwo dóódu nōo tá ō nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
idu_Latn: Okónɔɔwɛ ɛtá yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ éyééye kú abɔ̄ ɛnɛ ā. Ɛtá bá ɛnɔɔ̄cī, ɛtá bá ɛnɔɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛtá bá ɛhícō, ɛtá kē bá ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
idu_Latn: Ɔdāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā má gwutá mla ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá le ɔ̄kā nū da táajɛ ka anúɔ gē lɛ, é géē yá uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa italā ofōōfūnū, nááná nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā í gbā ije kú ɔnyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. É gáā ŋmó uwā ŋ́, amáŋ é géē bɔ̄kwu ɔdā nōo yá ā ohígbū ka ɔnyā ā wɛ ɔfiyɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī gbɔɔ́ ō má ímálānyī kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nōo wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛcɛ nyā í mɛ. Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē yá odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú lé, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú íkwu kú ɔcɛ́ nōó lé ā ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, ɔ̄cogwíije éyi ā gwííjē ka, Wā Uhɛ́ssbɔn, ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔcɛ́ Usíhɔn. Alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō má ɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ gwó igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Íssmɛ̄lu le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Umíspa gaá jīla uwá ɔwɛ á. Ó yɔ̄ ī jikwū abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā. Eko nōó ga ɛgiyí uwā ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ŋŋŋmá, aá wā gaá má Ugédalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam.

eng_Latn: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Ufilólōgɔsi mɛ́mla Ujulíya, mɛ́mla Unɛréwusi mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nya, mɛ́mla Olímpāsi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nēe bá pī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
idu_Latn: É wā kéē pó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋmá ɛgiyí nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō klla hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá ōcē.

eng_Latn: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā kéē bēē gwíijē ígwíígwu ɔgbɔɔgba mla opo, ɛ̄ngwū, ɔgalúmpɛ̄ mɛ́mla oké.

eng_Latn: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ofōōfūnū géē nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gáā lé ɔdōlé ipéyī um abɔ́ɔ glá ā. Amáŋ ɔwɛ kú inu nɛ̄ kwu oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛplá nōo yɛ ga ipɔ̄nū eyīpú ā, nɛ̄ ó géē bū wā abɔ́ɔ, klla í yɛ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má aájī kú nū igwó ā, n klla má ajī nɛ̄ncɛ́ ɔhā klla yɔ̄ ī bū kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ aájī kú nū ā. Ajī nɛŋcɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ī bū nyā le aájī ɛtá nēe tɛtɛ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā kpó fu ŋmá ɛga nēé tɛtɛ kwu ā. Ajī nɛ̄ncɛ́ ā lɛ ikpēyī bɛ̄ɛka īkpēyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, ó klla lɛ okónu nōo yɔ̄ ī gwō kú ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ālɔ̄ géē bá ī tɔ́ɔga, ohígbū ka a le yálé klla yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē, yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nāa gē ba ɔ́ ɛ̄ba kú nū ā je gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu nyɔ̄ gaá le da Ándru, anɔ́ɔ Ándru mɛ́mla Ufílīpu nyɔ̄ gaá le da Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛɛlɛwa nēé wɛ ācɛ Umasɛdónīya ámāŋ kú ācɛ Ugríisi ŋ́ ma, lɛ olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā pó ɛɛ́ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu ā yɔ̄ ī pó ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā. Ó lɛ ā, alɔ í lɛ ɔdā dóódu ɔhá nɛ̄ alɔ ī ka gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ n klla leyīce ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ, Óndú? Awɔ nɛ̄ n lɔtūce á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
idu_Latn: Lɛ umɛ́dālu kú ugóolu yá, kú ā lɛ otīhɔ lɛ óndú tá tú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē nya uwá tá lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
idu_Latn: Ɛcí éyi Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ í yɛ okónu ókpoó kú Ugálili ā, ó má ācokwɛ́bényi ɛpa, Usáyímɔ̄n mla Ándru ɔyínɛ́ nū bī ɛ́yá yɔ̄ ī le kwú ɛbéenyi.

eng_Latn: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
idu_Latn: Otú gbɔ́ɔcī abɔ̄ uwɔ yɔ̄ ī kwū um, odo kú um kē yɔ̄ ī tíne uwɔ nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ɛcɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ géē jé ɔdā nōo i kpaakpa á.

eng_Latn: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ugádi kahíníī, Áa cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo je ajɛ nɛ̄hi lɛ uwá ā. Ugádi, gē gbēyī bɛ̄ɛka ágábá nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, nōo gē gbēyī kóō je ikpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla abɔ̄ fa lé ā.

eng_Latn: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ gā um yɔ̄ ī fu owu, nɛ̄ n le oyēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
idu_Latn: Acogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ā le pɛ́ ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wā Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá líla íbí, ɔdíyá nōó lɔnɔ tū aá kóō cɛ̄ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka ā?.

eng_Latn: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
idu_Latn: Ó le ācɛ ōhī kpó bá ipú inu ɔhá bá ī gbēyī ɔdā nōó gaá yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka Usámsin, ācɛ Ufílístiya gē wā ɛɛ́! Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin kwú ɔ́ngbá ā ú kpó hɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔlá je ɔ́ yi ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é jé ɛga nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū yɔ̄ á ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
idu_Latn: Aá gē bī ɛ̄ngwū le gwííjē ahi, nɛ̄ aá tū abɔ̄yī aá ā. Aá gē tū ijē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ klla gē bī ɛ̄ngwū lɛ gwó ɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ́ Udéfīdi gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubɛ́lssása lɛ ɔ́da je, kéē kwú awulú nɔ̄wá ú wu Udánīyɛlu iyē. Ó kéē klla kwú agbá oje ɔdɔ ú tū ɔ̄ ɔkɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛtá kú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Aá wɛ ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, klla bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla gaá kwu ā? Eko nyá nɛ̄ n kē í cīibū aá kwɛjī āa? Lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā bī wā gé um amānyā.

eng_Latn: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
idu_Latn: Ó yīīpú, le bá ō mɔyí. Ɔnɔ kú ɔma cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī jikwū.

eng_Latn: If any man take a wife, and go in unto her, and hate her,
idu_Latn: Ó ka ekōhī ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú lɛ ɔnyā lɛ, le gwutá mla anú, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je cā ɔ̄ eyī glá.

eng_Latn: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ofu kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá ā le yɛ fíya fíya í tá ɛga dóódu mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔlɛ́ nēe bá ajɛ kú Ugálīli ā á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
idu_Latn: A cíkā ō nwū uwā íne ā, kú ā klla yá kéē jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄é gé yɛ mla ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ í gē gwá ejé ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aádáádā alɔ, Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu ā je íne lɛ alɔ ka alɔ ámāŋ ka ayááyí alɔ dúúmā kóō gwá ejé gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ ɛdɔ kú ɔtángbédē dóódu á. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē dɔɔ̄kā nōo tōō lɛ miya íjééyī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō ékpó nōo le um yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ga ɛgiyí aílɔ́wá ā, je Upíta pīya ɔ̄cotɛhɔ̄ kú nū ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu dúú á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá kwu eko nɛ̄ n tū aá ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ ā. N le ukɔ́ tū aá ka aá kóō híīī bī alítā, ɛkpa ámāŋ ka áblákpá ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu ŋá aá ā? É kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā í ŋá alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
idu_Latn: Ikōhī ŋ́, Onesímɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ eko kpií o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kó ō cīgbīhi wā ī yɔ̄ mla uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohūtū ā, Ɔwɔicō le ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ yá.

eng_Latn: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n gā ɛgiyí obugā ícɛ nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ n le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpanī um, Ébrahām. kóocōō lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá nyā yá lɔhi gā um.

eng_Latn: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ eyī táajɛ gbóógbó, bá ī gbēyī Óndú ā kóō wā í tá alɔ abɔ̄, ó kē wā ŋ́. Alɔ bá ī gbēyī éwɔhá nɛ̄ ó tá alɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā, kéē wā í tá alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odúúdú aɔ́kplá kú aípɔ́ɔnū dóódu kú ācɛ Íjīpiti kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Uféro tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā ohígbū um óócí Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē gbɔ̄kɔ ohígbū uwɔ óócí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúúmā í gla Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú iyē ú ce obugā ā ka, Ussɛ́ba. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ igelī nēé hī ka Ubiyɛssɛ́ba a lɛ iyē nū á.

eng_Latn: Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú um ka kpaakpa. Ó géē má ka ń lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
idu_Latn: Kéē bī oje le yá odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú aígelī kú nū. Nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā bēhé wā anú gla ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je mlanyi íjééyī ŋ́, ó gē gbō uwɔ ɛbɔ́. Lɛ abɔ̄ bī íjééyī ká, kóō gbō uwɔ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ kōō kahíníī, Ohígbū ka ń wɛ eyī ŋ́ mā, ń wɛ ákú iyē ā gɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄nyā í yá kóō híīī wɛ āyā kú iyē ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ koó i lɛ ā, ācɛ kú Íjīpiti géē ka ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ uwá ā glá ŋ́. É géē ka ɔ́ɔ kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā wā ipú ígbíli cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, ohígbū kéē he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwa kpó nyi áklō éyi kú ipú únóji kú Ukissi, ádā kú Usɔ́ɔlu, Uséla, ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjāmin. É le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ka ā yá jīla. Anɔ́ɔ igbīhi ɔdā nōo yá nyā ā, Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nēé gbā ohígbū ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā pó á.

eng_Latn: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dáŋ ka uwá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ka ɔ́dáŋ ka ɛ́ɛ yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā, lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē je gbagbénú nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ kwú pīya éwo kú ācɛ nēe lɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ó ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, géē hɔ̄hā ce uwá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ uwá gáā nyɔ̄ í míyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le owu nōo yɔ̄ ī tá nɛ̄hi ā trá, kóō yɔ̄ cíí. Anɔ́ɔ úgbagwú kú ísu ā má yɔ̄ cíí á.

eng_Latn: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, á jé ŋ́ ó tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ éyi ámāŋ ka ɛga ɔhá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka Udéfīdi lɛ ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo géē pó ā, géē ka ka Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yálé.

eng_Latn: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a gē tíne ō piyɛ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ um yá ipú oyēeyī kú um, nɛ̄ a ī bɔkwu um ká ā piyɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ um yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
idu_Latn: É lɛ ābɔ̄ ōhī kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu nēé hí ā gwó bónū, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ābɔ̄ kú ólīifu kú ipácí hɛ́ kwu ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ābɔ̄ ā kóō lū ŋmá enyi ō pi ŋmá ipú ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcí ā. Aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ólīfu kú ipácí ā, abālɔbányā ā lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛ dúú ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
idu_Latn: É lɔfú tīiyē kéē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nya aílɔ́wá tá ā lɛ uwá ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ámōōmɛ kú odúúdú íne kú Ɔwɔicō nēé ge bīya ojigógó á. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ olɔnɔ tū uwā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm cīce ajɛ lɛ abɔ̄ ca agba cíí ba ī mɛ́ɛbɛ. É lɛ ewo wu klá ɛyí klla le īlī ekwu kpó wu iyē. Ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú Ujerúsālɛm le okwúukwu kwaajɛ, túkpɛɛ́, le údɔ̄bū kwaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō le igwú hī ɔ̄ ŋmá ɔkpáncō kahíníī, Ébrahām! Ébrahām! Ó tóohi kahíníī, Eé, ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē jé ɔ̄ dúúdú. Alɔ í kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lé ɛcɛ lɛ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nāa ī ka ā lipú bɛ̄ɛka itekwú ā. Awɔ gē hɛ́ ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ tá, klla ī lɛ ɛlá kwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Árɔ̄ni kwú ayí Ulífāyi ā ú lɛ Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya ojíliyē ā nɛ̄ó cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le pīya ācoyúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mīyɛ ɔkplɛ́fú kú ugóolu nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Uhádādesa bī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó ga Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā éyi: Ujassobéyam, ɔyí kú Usábudíyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄n tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N gbɛlá koó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó je ijē nɛ̄hi yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ā. Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, A le ɔ̄kā ā cīla lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya ma ayí ɛnɛ. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á: Ujohána, Ujɛhóyākim, Usedekíya mɛ́mla Ujowáhāsi.

eng_Latn: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú miya ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gáā yá ā ipú ɔtū kú nū, amáŋ Óndú ā gē miya ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í nyɔ̄ ā fú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe bá āa í dɔɔ̄kā ō jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, é kē kwú odée ú gwu ahɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pó ɛlā ŋ́. É kē le eyī kú uwā kpó klá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, ahɔ̄ kú uwā í kē pó ɔdā dúú ŋ́, ɔtū kú uwā í kē gáā jɛ́ɛyí nū ŋ́, é cɛ̄ pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí um ká um lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlá nēé gbo ā jé ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ dúúmā nōo le iyī nū kɔ̄ ígwíígwu bá gē nuunu tá īyī uwā í je catāajɛ. Igelī ámāŋ ɔlɛ́ dúúmā nōo lɛ īyī nū kɔ̄ ígwíígwu bá gē nuunu tá īyī uwā géē je fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́! Alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka okwū ā ɛgiyí íneōbīya mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ gē yēeyī yɔ̄ gē bīyíne kpɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í yúufi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, ó gáā lɔhi lɛ uwá glá ŋ́. Oyēeyī kú uwá í gáā yɔ̄ ligbó fíyɛ́ ojiji kú ɔdée glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a ŋmó olíla ijē jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́kwú, nááná, á gáā ŋ́mó íla kú nū ā ije ŋmá ɔɔ́ iyē wɛ̄ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔdāŋ́ ka ipí ámāŋ ka ínālēgbé ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔkpíyē, ámāŋ iyē kú nū le hɛ́mi, nōó géē je pīya ōcē obɔ̄bi kú ɔkpíyē glá, kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā bī gé lɛ Árɔ̄ni, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ámāŋ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
idu_Latn: v éyi kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi a gēe lé ɔcɛ́; ó gē gbō ācɛ a mla Ihɔtū ogbéegbé ɛcɛ mla okpaakpa. Ó gēe ya ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa a fíyaa, ó gēe má kéē ba ī yá ɔda ookpaakpa a ipú ajɛ a.

eng_Latn: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
idu_Latn: Ń kē da aá ka aá lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um, ámāŋ ka aá lɛ um lá kwúcē ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī pīya um tū jéejéē ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahímāasi da Ujówābu ka ɔdā dúú nōo yá ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛlā anúɔ ŋ́, ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā bī nyɔ̄ dúú. Ujówābu le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄hɔ̄ āa? Ka ɔ́ɔ kē gáā lɛ itene dúúmā ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé lɛ Umósīsi ɔtū bīya, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā ka ipú ánya á.

eng_Latn: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cogbɔ̄cí ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wɛ Umerí wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Usáyímɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Ujúdasi í wɛ ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí Ébram, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N géē je ajɛ nyā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ébram le ede gwó abɔ́ɔ lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:
idu_Latn: Eko nyā ā, ɔ̄conɔwá dúúmā í yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ Ufílīstiya í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Uhíburu nwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē na ɔkpacaŋ́gelī amáŋ ka óbō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ó le íkwu, ojīlīmā, ofu mɛ́mla ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú éwo dóódu, ucē dóódu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma dóódu kéē cē ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Íkwu kú nū nyā kē yɔ̄ piyóó. Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ī kē gāa mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
idu_Latn: Ó le ede kú ɛcí kú éwɔhá mɛ́mla íkpɛ́cí mɛ́mla aɔ́kpa nēé bu tāajɛ ā kpó ca bónū. Ó klla kwú ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra, ɛcí nēé ma ā ú ca dúú.

eng_Latn: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēe fu um ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla otɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ aílɔ́wá, ká n̄ nwū uwā ɛlā ɔkwɛyi mɛ́mla ɛlā ō cɛ̄ kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá. N yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā nɛ̄ n, ń kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nóó.

eng_Latn: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōo gē yá ā, é tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ́ mīya táajɛ gbojī ɛɛ́. Alɔ kē jé ka, ɔ̄cɛ í táafú mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū koó lɛ Utáyítɔ̄si yá kóō lɛ ɔtucaca kóō tá aá abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā!.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, je igbō nyā lɛ alɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ Uhágāyi mɛ́mla Usekaríya bā í lɛ ɔfú tū aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu ā iyē, é bā í gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gɔbū lɔɔlɔhi. É kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú gwó kwɛyí, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla Usáyírɔ̄si, Udáyírɔ̄si mɛ́mla Átasásɛsi aɔ́cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya je ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
idu_Latn: Ubaalhánan ɔyí kú Ácībɔ gekwú anɔ́ɔ Uháda kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū. Iyē kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kwú pīya Upɔ́wu. Iyē kú ɔnyā nū lé ka Umehɛtābɛ́lu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Umátrēdi, ɔyí kú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Umésahābus.

eng_Latn: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si gā ā, ó le jé ka é kwú ɔ̄ nyi ipú únóji ɛ̄cī ɛnɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
