idu_Latn: É je Ugólan, Ubássan mɛ́mla Ástārɔ̄tu, mɛ́mla ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā ŋmá ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eliká ɛnɛ kú ugóólu nēé géē bī le je ɔ́ yá kwu ákló ɛnɛ kú ikpó ɛnɛnɛ́ɛnɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor discover his father's skirt.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ɔ́ɔ híī je uwēyī lɛ ádā nū, ŋmá lɛ ō gwutá mlá anyā ádā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe líyē kwu um ā, tíne ō má eyī kú um, lɛ īyī wā tū wāajɛ, lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ga um, anɔ́ɔ é le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú kú uwá, eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē pó ɔkɔ nēé gbā gā um ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō. N klla í je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi klla í yá kú ajɛ kú uwā kóō kwú lɔhi kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du le ɔ́da je kéē dɔɔ̄kā Upíta, amáŋ é má ɔ̄ ŋ́, ó le ɔ̄kā da ācogbāājɛ ā lɔɔlɔhi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Uhérɔ̄du nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujudíya le tá Usísarīya gaá klá abɔ́ɔ lígíí.

eng_Latn: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Óndú, eyī mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ kú uwɔ kóō le nwūla ká a jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ géē gbā amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
idu_Latn: Usánbālat, Utobíya mɛ́mla ācɛ Árābu, Ámmɔn mɛ́mla Ássidɔ̄du le pó ka, úklɔ́ kú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gɔbū. É klla yɔ̄ gē je ɛpá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tá ɔdɔ ā hegwū. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú um á. Awɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yálé á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a bī um wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um ā? Ó géē yɛ í he um ɔtú ɔ́dāŋ ka ń yɛ í gekwú ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō má um.

eng_Latn: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé ma uwɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hɛ́ uwɔ údūlō ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gé gwá uwɔ iyē, lɛ ɔmā nya uwɔ iyē, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī pīya īlī klá uwɔ iye ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, ká aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ɛyí ɛfú otīihɔ kú nū. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ī yá ucē ā pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá obɔ̄bí ga olɔhi. Aá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu īyī aá.

eng_Latn: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ lā ipú ɔkpíyē nyā ā, ɔtū í he alɔ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ alɔ yɔ̄ ī tíifu ka ɔkpíyē ɔhá, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā he alɔ ɔtū mɛ́ɛ̄ á, kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú wu alɔ iyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé ā.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujówāsi yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ, aá jāhɔ̄! Odúúdú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā, aá wā í jīla amānyā ka aá jāhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ ā he um ɔtū, ń gaá je odúúmā kú nū mlanyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yɛ pi um, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ń kōō jé kóō yɔ̄ pi um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
idu_Latn: Awɔ tū ɛjī kú ɛcɛ á, awɔ yá ɔnɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔgwā á.

eng_Latn: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi ā gbɔɔ́ ō wā lɛ ā ŋmá ipú ɔyā ɛtá. É klla kpó wā lɛ ā jāā ɔyā ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram kahíníī, Ákú alɔ mɛ ɛɛ́, Óndú ā kpó aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá nyā í tū abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Umówābu kéē kpó alɔ ŋmó nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē gbō uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu, ó gē lɛ oyēeyī kú uwɔ tū ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
idu_Latn: Anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nɛ̄ é hī olifu ā, aá géē bī ɔgālā le mīya anú . Ó géē wɛ éyi ŋmá oōkɔ̄ ɛga igwo kú ɛtɛ́-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ŋmá ɔgālā éyi. Ɔgālā éyi wɛ ɛtɛ́-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ igwó, ó kē wɛ ɔdā ékpónú mɛ́mla ógo ocɛyí éyi.

eng_Latn: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū kéē kwú pīya ayókwū ká ɔnyā nū kóō kwú pīya ɔnyōkwū.

eng_Latn: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olɔhi gē cīgbīhi kwu ucē obɔ̄bí, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá leyīkwu ɛga nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ó lɔfú nya oyēeyī kú aá tá glá.

eng_Latn: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka éwɔhá éyi nōo lā mla aá kwú gbagbénú, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa aá kwú gbɛɛhá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyī nū ú ce éwɔhá ā abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ éwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
idu_Latn: Ohi nēé ī tá īyī uwā ā géē wɛ ka, Ohígbū ka é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɛka nɛ̄ Uyáwɛ, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ uwā ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, cē mla uwā tá, klla nyɔ̄ í bá ī gbā aɛ́cí ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
idu_Latn: mɛmla ācɛ Uhám mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Áki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Usíni mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔcányā kú Ussɛ́ba le ofu kú ijéeyī mɛ́mla ɔfú kú Usólōmɔn pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ jāā wā Ujerúsālɛm bī ɔ̄kā o lɔnɔ ō cīla nɛ̄hi gaá le já Usólōmɔn má á. Ācɛ alɛwa yɛ ce ɔ́ wā. Ó klla bī aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aínyankwūlūmī kú nū nɛ̄ ó gbō iyó kú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā ce uwá igbīhi: ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú aépū dóódu dúú. Eko nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla Usólōmɔn gaá le jīla ā, odúúdú ɔ̄kā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtú kú nū ā, ó le kpó da Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā le gbagbénú, amáŋ é klla yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú kpɔ́, é lé ɔdōlé klla kwú jɔ̄kwū mlɔ́mlɔ́ ā. É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá uwá ā tá. É klla tá Ɔwɔicō, ōlɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo nya uwá tá ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le Ulában, ɔ̄cɛ Áram ā plla abɔ̄ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jé ka anúɔ gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yá aɔ́dā o cābɔ̄ alɛwa igbɔhá iyɔ̄bū kú ayíkpó kú nū nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Italā nāa yá um ā lɔhi gā um, ohígbū ka ó cɛ̄ gā um lɛ íne kú uwɔ jé.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú ákánjɔ̄ kú oje udɔ ú lɛ ɔ́ na kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔdā ō lɛ klá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó ī ményīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, wɛ olíla nōo bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ itene ō lé ɔwɛ o pīya ācɛ tū icííci í he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́, géē lɛ́ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ójila kú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā le kābɔ̄ ā, ācɛ Ujíyu alɛwa mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá alɛwa nēe je pīya tá ɔ́wá kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, kwúce Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi. Ayíkpó ā le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔfú tū uwā iyē klla da uwá kéē yɔ̄ ī gboló ce olɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And God spake all these words, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ī hɔ́hā ce aá, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔtū lé ipú ōwē nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō má ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē má, ohígbū ka aá le miya ka aá géē yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
idu_Latn: Otū piíí kú ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du ī tínē kóō bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ ācɛ ā, Upíta yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aícɔ́ɔja ɛpa, agbá ɛpa kē kwu ɔ́, ācogbāājɛ kē bá ī gbō okómpīinu kú ināgbá ā.

eng_Latn: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
idu_Latn: ācɛ í gáā gbonɛnɛ gɛ ŋ́, é kē gáā ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ācɛ o bī ācɛ ɔhá iyē, ācɛ o yíkpɛ́lā eko dóódu, ācɛ nēe lɛ cē ōcɛ ɔhá táajɛ i tútū kéē yíkpɛ́lā eko dóódu, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔdā olɔhi í he uwá ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni da ɔ́ kahíníī, itíca, alɔ má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo bī iyē kú uwɔ yɔ̄ gē le nū alelékwū tɛ́ɛcɛ, alɔ da ɔ́ kóō mā ohígbū ka ó wɛ éyi kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu ɔyí kú Ujosíya, Ujɛhóyākim, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. É gáā yēkwu kú nū ŋ́. Aɔ́máapú nū í gáā jikwū nū ŋ́ mā aa, ācɛ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā í gáā jikwū nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da um ka amíyɔ̄ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ádā um ā, anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ka, A géē ma ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ ā fú gā um, oŋmá lɛ ō da ācɛ kú ɛga dúú nɛ̄ alɔ géē nyɔ̄ ā ka amíyɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhíram le ɛdɔ ɔcí nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn tíne ā kpó hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā fu aá ohígbū ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī plla aá ā.

eng_Latn: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú otūufi nɛ̄hi kú ísu ā. Ɔdā uwēyī ō yá kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ūwū oblínyī nɛ̄ úgbagwú ī kpó bá okónu ísu ā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ nēé lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga nōo dobū fíyɛ́ dúú ā tū gbēyī uwā kéē bá abɔ́ɔ piyóó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú áafú nōó tá lɔfú lɔfú mla ācɛ Ujíyu ɔgbɔ́ kú ójīla ā, ó le mafú lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā í tá alácɛ̄ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā. É géē je odúúdú igelī ā yíífi, í je ɔ́ɔ tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, N gee cāŋjɛ la ɛyi kwu uwa, ka n lɛ iye kú Ubábīlɔn mla ɛdɛɛdɔ kú uwa, mla ooga ɔbu kú wā u hɛ ŋma ipu ɛcɛ pioo.

eng_Latn: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:
idu_Latn: ɛ̄nɛ̄ o lɛ ēpū olɔhi klla gwá īkpō nɛ̄hi nōo lɔfú jɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā ɔdōlé glá ā, nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí gē wā ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɔkwu nū, nɛ̄ aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō gē gwó ɔlɛ́ ce ābɔ̄ nū ā.

eng_Latn: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka anúɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla gē yīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú lɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā eko nɛ̄ anúɔ kōō yēeyī nááná ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ í yá fíyɛ́ eko nɛ̄ anúɔ gekwú.

eng_Latn: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
idu_Latn: Ɔlékwū tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ipéyī Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tóohɛ́ɛwa nōbí nōbi ā, ó kē ī má odúúdú nū.

eng_Latn: When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: but he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ, ka ɛ́ɛ híī pi ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ga ɔgbɛ́fú ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ɛcɛ dúúmā iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ klá ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū ká ɔtū ká ɔ̄ he uwá tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá kóō nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdōlé ā túbá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lé lɛ glá ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō kpó okoolo ɛpɛɛpa kú ɔdōlé ā, īkpɛ̄yí ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā Usúsa ā kwú ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda ɔ́ɔmā ú pīya ɛ̄cī omulɛ́nyɔ́, ohígbū kéē bī ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛtá mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā ā le kpó aólɛlā kú uwā ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya klla ka aígwu ɔhá kahíníī, Alɔ gē kplá ije ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē le gbā ije ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ije kú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ijakī ā le alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā má háyi ɔwɛ le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī pi ce abɔ̄ ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ ga ipácí. Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam lɛ ɔdée fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄, lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛyī tá ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ aúcē nēe bá nyā lɛ, nēé kē yɔ̄ gē nwuné nwuné, é géē yá ká aá yúklɔ́ olɔhi nōo géē gwá īkpō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé ā, ó kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛga dóódu. Ācɛ kú Umówābu, Ámmɔn, mɛ́mla Ɛ́dɔm. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usóba mɛ́mla Ufilístiya. Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ó kpɛ́fú ā, ó le yálé.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Umósisi kóō da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu, ámāŋ éwɔhá nōo bá ipú uwā, nōo gáā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ámāŋ ɛdɔ kú ɛya dóódu.

eng_Latn: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbóngbō ocikāpā nɛ̄ owu gē gwu bónū ā, abɔ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī nu uwā inya ā.

eng_Latn: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é híīī hī aá ka Itíca ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá lɛ Itíca ékpó, odúúdú aá kē wɛ ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, é cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī le igelī nɛ̄hi ā yɛ jīla tá igba ahāapa ɔwɛ nēé tɛtɛ yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ōfōōfūnū nēé yɛ igeli ā jīla tá igbo ahāapa á.

eng_Latn: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū uwā a, o klla le uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔfú kú aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
idu_Latn: N le tútū ká n̄ cokónu mla uwɔ ɛɛ́. Alɔ lɛ ɛcɔ̄ túbá ɛgiyí éékpó kóō tá alɔ ɛlá kwu okónu nɛ̄ alɔ í ce āa.

eng_Latn: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ íne ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gaá le jīla ɛga éékpó nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́, ó géē tá uwɔ ohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a le okónu nɛ̄ a ce ā yá jīla lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ujeremíya kahíníī, A le kweyī inya mla alɛɛcɛ, ɛjɛ kē le jɛ̄ uwɔ. Ó lɛ ā a lɔfú kweyī inya mla aɔ́nya glá āa? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a gē gwōnū ega nōo tá ɛcɛ péee, ó lɛ ā abɔ̄ a géē yá lɛ ipú ūpū nōo tá okónū ísu kú Ujɔ́dan āa?.

eng_Latn: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka é géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Ó ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ kú ɛcɛ klla í yá ūwā italā ā, anúɔ géē ményinyi ūwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē ményinyi ɔyí nū nōo gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā le ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá kú Onīsi, mla ɛcɔ̄ ɔtángbédē mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá ɔhá nēé gē kpó kwu ɛ́fɔ̄du ō bɔ́tū mɛ́mla īlī ō klá acá kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú ajɛ mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwá ú pīya ɔdā úgwū kú alɔ, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī he eje ā, Ísɔ pīyɛyí ŋmá ɔtɛ́ ipácí. Ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɔ̄kā da á. Ó kahíníī, Ɔcí ufáyin nyā í yēeyī klla í jɛ̄ gílú ā a? Idu ká aflɛ́yí ā í gáā fu ɔ̄ ŋmá aje tɛgba tɛgba klla kpó īkpō nū wúla ŋmá anú, lɛ abɔ̄ nū wúla cɛ́ɛ kóō kwú ŋmaɔ́lá ŋ́ nɛɛ. Aewo o lɔfú í kō gáā cɛgbá ɔfú nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́ kéē fu ɔ́ ŋmá aje ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ā ɔ́ɔ gē kɛlā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu ŋmá okónu, klla ī cokónu nēé gē yá ŋ́. É klla ī gwɔ́kpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ó klla ka ka ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɛpɔ̄ újí bɛ̄ɛka ɔha nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nēé le hí ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í ŋmó uwá ŋ́, ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā bī iyē kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ce mla uwá ā. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛ̄pɔ̄ kú ɛlā nyā kpó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí ā.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá gwó ijē kú ocɛtla la Óndú a, ohígbū ka, ó yá ɔda oolɛɔhi la alɔ íbí. Aá yá ka ɛcɛ ka ō lɛ odúúdú ɛ̄nyā jé.

eng_Latn: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gāājɛ Usísarīya ā, é kwú ɔkpá ā ú lɛ Igbómína ā, anɔ́ɔ é kē kwú Upɔ́lu ú tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɛ́nɛ́ aá mɛ́mla ádā aá. Aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cī Usábāti kú um ā tū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je íne kú nū lɛ ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya kē da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya ō bī kpɛ́fú ofu cigwɛ́ɛpa ā kahíníī, Áá híī nuunu tá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, n táafú ŋ́ Áhābu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā le mu ede ā klla ī pɛ́ yɛ ɔ́glɔ́ nōó bū jīla ede ā tá ā.

eng_Latn: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo yá uwɔ ā wɛ ɔbá uwɔ á. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ má. Anú kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
idu_Latn: N géē gbɛka mɛ́mla uwá nōo géē yɔ̄ piyóó. N gáā mā ō yá olɔhi lɛ uwá gbóógbóō ŋ́. N géē yá uwā kéē yúúfi um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka, Ami yɔ̄ á, n wā gaá yá ɔtū kú uwɔ nɛ̄ n Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá lɛyíkwu um ipú ɔkpá kú íne lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
idu_Latn: É kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔcɛ́ nōo Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ā! Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, ofu kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je mlanyī aóklóbīya kú uwɔ ámāŋ ka aóklóbīya kú ádā uwɔ ŋ́. Eko dúúmā nāa yɔ̄ ipú unwalu, ā kwu gāá hī ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ igwú, kóō wā í tá anúɔ abɔ̄ piíí ŋ́. Oladógbe kú uwɔ nōo lā kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ligbó hɛ̄ uwɔ tá á.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ā lɛ ɛlā wu ɔ́ ŋ́, nyɔ̄ gaá yá ɔdōlé kú uwɔ, amáŋ le igbō yá ŋmá umu ā gē um lígíi gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē nyɔ̄ í yá ákú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔyí uwɔ, ká aá géē lé.

eng_Latn: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
idu_Latn: É le ɔtū ce Ɔwɔicō kú uwā anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā pó, klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yálé dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
idu_Latn: É í yá ede nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí nū ā mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū. É klla í yá ogbanjɛ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɔkwu kú nū, nēé gē lɛ ɔ́ ce ā.

eng_Latn: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
idu_Latn: Tá ohi kú íla kú ōkā íla nɛ̄ olíla da āa, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ o da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ɔ́ɔmā géē jé ka anúɔ í jééyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ gbɛlá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ulá ce ofu igwó kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā le tá ɛgiyí Ákisi, ɔyí kú Umáyɔ̄ku, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugáti.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Áyísīki wā gaá le ɔ̄kā kú obugā nēé bu ā ka ɔ̄ kahíníī, Alɔ le éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi má ipú obugā ā.

eng_Latn: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le abɔ̄ nāndaa kwu ɔ́ iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N cɛ̄, le yá yēŋēē mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā agwú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔnyīlɔ ā iyē.

eng_Latn: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó kwu ɛcí ō pā ú ci ajɛ kú Ujúda klla kwú ɛcí mɛ́mla ikpɛ́cí ú kpó ca ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujúda, eko nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā, ajɛ kú nū yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ɛga oligbó ā géē wā í tá abɔ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā oōgwó igbɔhá. Eko nēé lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tūgwó igbɔhá ā, aá géē jé ka Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu aá. Ɛnyā géē yá ɔ́dāŋ nē aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá.

eng_Latn: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
idu_Latn: ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá má ɛnyā gā um ɛ́! Ɔ̄cɛ Uhíbru nyā nɛ̄ ɔbá um bī wā ɔlɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī cá alɔ ɛcá. Ó wā ipú inu ɛgiyí um gaá hɛ́ um báajɛ, anɔ́ɔ n le ɔkɔcɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú um jɛ̄ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú jé ŋmá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ lɛ únwū olɔfú kéē bīyíne, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ ɔtū kpóce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋmá ɔtoce ipú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
idu_Latn: gaá le odúúdú ojibó kú ubáalu ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ piyóó ā. Ojuja klá anú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, otú ā, ojuja kwú yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
idu_Latn: É ka ɔ́ɔ kē le odúúdú aíyó kú ugóolu , oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú nōo kwu Ujerúsālɛm ā, gaá bá inu ɛcí kú nū, Ubábīlɔn ā kpó kwúcē lɛ aá. É ka Usáyírɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ kwú odúúdú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó lɛ Ussɛssibássa, igbómína kú Ujúda nɛ̄ ó fu ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
idu_Latn: nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Uréhobōwam, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn mɛ́mla Ujúda ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó klla géē ka igbɔhá kahíníī, N jé aá ŋ́. Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ klá Ujerúsālɛm amānyā kpɔ́, ɛfú géē lé ɔ̄, ámāŋ ɔkpɛta ámāŋ ka ōcē obɔ̄bí ɛ́ɛ́ géē ŋmó ɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le tá ɛcɛ gáā cɔ̄nyā lɛ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, é gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. É í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yēeyi.

eng_Latn: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ háyi abɔ́ɔ ā, kwu ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kwu ɔ̄cɛnyā ámāŋ odúúmā kú uwā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī cīgbīhi kwu Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá nyɔ̄ í gbā ɛcí kú aéwo ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛgba ɔcí nōo le jɛ̄, kwú pīya ɔcí ohɔ́ɔnɔ klla ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
idu_Latn: A bī ɔfú kú uwɔ le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu ā nyatá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú nū ā, Óndú ā mīyɛ owu kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
idu_Latn: Ó gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē kpaakpa kóō gbō uwā. Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gbāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cɛ́ ā. Ó klla í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gē lɛ ojīlīmā piyóó.

eng_Latn: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aólufa ā le ɔ́ má ā, é da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔyí kú ádā ɛhɔ̄ ā á. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ úgwū kú ádā ā le pīya ákú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ā kpɛ́fú tá aéwo dúúdú klla le uwá kpó yálé. É hɛ́pɔ̄ olɔhi, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ā. É le okónu kú aágábá gwū abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
idu_Latn: Íkée ā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ aádā alɔ ɔwɛ alɛwa ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nēé wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá āa? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ācɛ Ujúda ā ohi ka aá wā í kwú Usámsin, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ō yɛ tá iyɔ̄bū aínu bɛ̄ɛka ákú āyā kú ɛhícō ā. Omiya kú nū mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gwó ɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ a klla mɛ́mla okómpinu kú nū ā wɛ ɛdɔ ékpónú mɛ́mla ákú ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kahíníī, N lɛ ɔbá ɛna o le hɛ́hɔ̄ igwó lá, n kē yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ká n̄ jé uwā má ɔ́dāŋ kéē í yúklɔ́. Kócōō lɛ ɛga je gā um.

eng_Latn: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin da ɔyípɛ̄ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā kóō yá ká anúɔ lɛ abɔ̄ bī ákanaba ɛplɛ́ɛpa nēe bī inu ā háyi ā. Ó ka anúɔ tíne ká anúɔ bayi ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
idu_Latn: nááná jé ka Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ācɛ ŋmá lɛ ɔtōkpóce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ó wɛ o ŋmá lɛ o yá ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō yá ā ŋ́. Alɔ abɔ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ alɔ kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō bū ipú ɔtōkpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ó wɛ o ŋmá lɛ o yá ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ka alɔ yá ā ŋ́ má. Ohígbū keé gáā hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā o ŋmá lɛ o yá ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí ɛ́nɛ́ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ká ā tá iyī uwɔ wāajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá géē wɛ éwo nēé je gā um, éwo nēe géē gwɛ́ɛya gā um kwɛyí aéwo ɔhá. Umósīsi, ɛlā nyā nāa gáā ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā kú Udéfīdi nyā í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ abɔ̄ kwu Usɔ́lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ má. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɛfú, ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí le nū uwā inya, klla í je uwá pīya ɔdā nōo ī tū ódúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā ufi. Ācɛ kē í bī ɔdā nōo yá uwā ā le tokónu lɛ ācɛ ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ n géē nū uwā nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo pūla olíla ámāŋ ka ogwéjé kú úklɔ́ ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka otɔ́ɔyī nōo gē tá ɔyī cē ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wā í yɛ ɔwɛ ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
idu_Latn: Nwū um ká n̄ yá ɔdā nāa tíne ā, ohígbū ka awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á. Gbonɛnɛ gā um, bī um jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n géē yɛ ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ ɛpɛɛpa. Ó je íkwu lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu aálelékwū obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
idu_Latn: É yá odúúdú ɔdā dóódu ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ɔ́ táajɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē yá ā. Ɔwɔicō le alɔ fu ká ālɔ̄ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ohígbū ka alɔ le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā oŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nōó cɛ̄ ka anúɔ ī yá ŋmá ajaajɛ ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the LORD out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
idu_Latn: Ó gbo inya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga ɛgiyí Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta mɛ́mla ɔyíkpó ɔhá nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yíihɔtū nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, É kwú Óndú ā ú ŋmá únóji ɛɛ́, alɔ í jé ɛga nēé lɛ ɔ́ tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
idu_Latn: Óndú, aɛ́ga olipú kú itekwú nɛ̄hi ā gē yúuya, ó gē yúuya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
idu_Latn: N géē gɔbū mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya táajɛ ka ń gáā mīyɛ otábɔ̄ kú ije ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ŋ́. N tíne ō le mafú lɛ ācɛ nēe ka aá wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ dúú ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híīī lɛ ɔdā nēé géē lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ ka ami mla uwá ɔ́ɔ gē yúklɔ́ ɛdɔ ékpó nú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ. Aá cɛ̄tra ɛgahi kú nū mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná klla kwú ɔ̄ ú cāŋjɛ. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ā, ikpó mɛ́mla oŋmíkpālī kú nū kwú lɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́futa le bēhé ísu kóō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ámɔ̄n á, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le yálé á.

eng_Latn: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
idu_Latn: Ɛcá nēé yɔ̄ ī cá um ā lɛ um iyē catīipú, abɔ̄ é bá ī dɔɔ̄kā eko dóódu kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu wā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nēe ī kwúcē wā ɛga olúlé kú uwā ā. É géē lé ɔdōlé nōo jɛ̄ ɛyí ɛfu kú ukámɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ubássan ā. É géē lé ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū, nēé ī jɛ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
idu_Latn: Inu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú géē je yíífi fíyaa, amáŋ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa gáā lɛ́ɛcɛ fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛlā ka fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cíkā ō ka ā dúú ɛɛ́. Ń klla gáā ka ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
idu_Latn: É lɛ odúúdú ācɛnyā kú uwā kpó kwú yɔ̄ī ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. É ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ é le odúúdú uwā kpó kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó yɔ̄ ī ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa tá um ā, Óndú? Ɔdíyá nāa cīgbīhi kwu um ā?.

eng_Latn: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, aá géē bī ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aá cē ā wā gé lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Aá híī he ɛbɛ́ kú ɔyí álá, ámāŋ ka opī ipú enyi amɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka aólɛlā kú uwā géē kpɛ́fú tá aígelī dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, je lɛ uwá ā. Ó da uwá igá olicō nɛ̄hi kú aígelī kú uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɔtūce ā, géē je wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú Usamérīya iháyí ofu ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kéē wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá, ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla aá nɛ̄ aá tá nyílá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le túbá ipú igelī kú aá, ka ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá aá glá gɛ ŋ́, n géē tū ōcē nōó lɛ ɛcí ŋ́ klá aá. Ó géē pi aá abɔ̄fú kú aá cɔ̄nyā lɛ aólɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
idu_Latn: Ussámɛ̄ɛ, ɔyí kú Umíka, ɔyí kú Usíyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ipí ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnwu kú abɔ̄ kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, nɛ̄ ipí ā le lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē abɔ̄yī nū ā. Ó le lɛ ā, ayíka ó wɛ ōcē kú agwú nɛ̄, ayíka ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ oblínyī nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ulé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ō yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa aá. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yíihɔtū tá odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ íne ā tū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́da je, klla le ɔna tá ga odúúdú kú ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, jāā ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ga Udán ka ācɛ kéē wā í jīla Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ucɛ nēé lé gɛ ŋ́ iháyí alɛwa ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā cɛ̄ le okónu nyā ce, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú aá tá, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla gáā bī uwā ɔfiyɛ kú uwá ɛ́ɛ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā nū bīya, nɛ̄ ó klla bī ɔ́bíipú tū Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
idu_Latn: Uméssūlam, Ábīja, Umijámin.

eng_Latn: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́tam gekwú anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi ikpámīlī kú aɔ́cɛ́, ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Áhāsi le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā má úgbéenyi éyi kú Alesáŋdrīya nōo gē yɛ ī nyɔ̄ Ítāli, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú alɔ ú kpó tā ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó yɔ̄ í yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ā, ɛwa kú ācɛ bá ɛcɛ bá yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, aá cíkā ō yɔ̄ ī yúúfi um. Aá cíkā ō bá ī fīyégbúlú ɛgiyí um. Ami bī úmúlā le tū ɛjī lɛ ísu, nɛ̄ ísu ā í glá anú glá ŋ́ má. Ó kōō cēenyi klla tá úgbagwú nɛ̄hi nááná, ó bū ɛjī ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔyínɔnyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyā ā bī iyē Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ɔ̄bɔ̄yī nū ā le ɛcá cá. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bī wā ɛgiyí Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ma ācɛ nēe kwú ā, kwu ācɛnɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, māháyi iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. É lɛ aɔ́kpá ā nwūla. É klla lɛ ɔkpá ɔhá, nōo wɛ ɔkpá nɛ̄ iyē kú ācɛ oyēeyī ā bá ipú nū ā, nwūla. É lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ācɛ nēe gekwú ā oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ yá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú aɔ́kpá ā lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī tá ō lɛ iyē kwu iyī aá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́, ayíka aá ɛplɛ́ɛpa cɛ̄ tɔ̄há kú aá mlɛɛnyɔ̄ eko kpíi, ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ eko táajɛ le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Amáŋ aá kóō kwúcē gbɔɔ́ ō gwutá mla iyī aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō lɛ ā. Aá í yá ɛ́gɛ́nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá jɛga lɛ ebilíi yá aá ojámá ŋ́ ohígbū nɛ̄ aá gáā cē iyī aá bī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
idu_Latn: Aá kē kwú mlanyī ami nōo wɛ Óndū ā nōo yá aá ɛɛ́. Ami nā ɔkpáncō daa klá ɛhícō, klla lɛ ikpó kú ɛcɛ nyā táajɛ á. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bá gē yúúfi eko dóódu ā? Ohígbū nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē yá aá ŋmó ā géē cɔ̄nū nɛɛ? Kɛ̄ɛ ka ohígbū nēe le tútū kéē kpó aá yíífi ā nɛɛ? Ícɔ̄nū kú uwá í kē gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu aá gbógbóō glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
idu_Latn: Áa híī lɛ eyī gwū um bónū, ohígbū óbí kú um ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛnɔ cɛ̄ um, je um tá óbí fiyuu á. Ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ le cɔ̄nū mla um, anɔ́ɔ é kwú um ú tá yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin kú ācɛ ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ n má ɛga leyīkwu iyī um gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā yá kwɛyí ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tēelihɔ lɛ ā mɛ́mla oŋmá íne nēé bīya ā. Ó í yá ɔdā éékpó ā mla Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ohígbū koó kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ā lā nōo le tēelihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kɛlā ŋmá ɔkpáncō gblágádáá bɛ̄ɛka akpáabana ā. É kē le ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā pó.

eng_Latn: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā lɛ ɛnyā pó ā, é le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda kahíníī, Aá lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā yá lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛka kú Óndú ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīsi bī ɔnyā éyi nōo gbaajā wā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi ɔtāhɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ācɛ ā da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo háyi ɛhíícō kú ísu ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyā nɛ̄ ɛbɛ ohéyī mɛ́mla ɔdā ō hídáagó nyā géē yɔ̄ gaá kwu āa.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī le hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá oyēeyi icííci nɛ̄ aádáádā aá tɛtɛ lā ā, nēé kē kpó tū aá abɔ̄ ā, ó wɛ ije nōo gē yíífi ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī le hɛ́ aá tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ísu hɛ́ lugwú lugwú gicō ohígbū owu nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī tá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛhīlī ā, é le ɔdōlé ā kpó lɛ iyī uwā fíyɛ́ ɛga ɛpa. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kpó okoolo ɛnɛɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gaá le ka lɛ Umósīsi á.

eng_Latn: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ajɛ hɛ́bū Uléhi abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú á. Usámsin le éŋkpɔ̄ ā gwá. Ijēēnyi kú nū mɛ. É hī éŋkpɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ka Ɛn-hákɔ́ɔ. Ó yɔ̄ Uléhi abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nēé le Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni hɛ́tá ā, é kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí aɔ́mpa uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā da uwá ā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
idu_Latn: Ujáyɛ gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ nyi Ukámɔn á.

eng_Latn: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ubábīlɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ n bī abɔ̄ olɔfú kú um gwó kóō wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n géē lā kóō mafú ɔfú mɛ́mla ojílímā kú um fú ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka Lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yá ācɛ ā lé ā tá táajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē blakwu ɔ́. Le ka lɛ Ujóssuwa kahíníī, N géē je ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki yíífi ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā í gáā blakwu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū íla kú um ā, ipí kú um yɔ̄ ī nyīla tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ klla le wā, yɔ̄ ī nípī fiyúu.

eng_Latn: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
idu_Latn: Óbō kú nū ā cɔkpɛ́nú bɛ̄ɛka ogbló kú ɔcí ō tíīlī ā. Oje kú īkpɛ̄yí óbō ā gbɛnú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ícɔ́ɔ́ja éyi gē yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū nū gē bī ɔkplɛ́fú kú nū á.

eng_Latn: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú kú um nōo gē gbō um á, ó kē ī nya ācɛ nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ kpaakpa ā tá.

eng_Latn: Grace be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō ma ihɔtū mɛ́mla ogbonɛnɛ kú nū ā fú lɛ aá. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ í kwú ā gā ɛɛ́. Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwá kóō jé ipú ɔtū kú nū ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā le ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nōó cokónu nū lɛ uwá ā kpó yá lɛ uwá ɛɛ́. Okónu dóódu nōó ce a, ó lɛ ɔ́ tū. Ó koó je odúúmā táajɛ ŋmá anú nōó yá ɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó kwúcē igbīhi gaá lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā má, ó le yēŋēē, ɔdā dóódu bá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu lɛ ācɛ ulá ahāapa ce ofu igwó kpó ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ulá ɛhɔ̄ bá pī ɔ̄ Umíkmāsi ɔlɛ́ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā, ulá ɛpa ce ofu igwó bá ɛgiyí Ujonátan Ugíbēyi ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn. Ó le ācɛ nēe hile ā cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā tá ká aá mīyɛ anú ŋ́, ohígbū kéē le jé péee kóō yɔ̄ ī ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, gēe hɛ́ ɔhā ce uwá kahíníī, N gēe hɛ́ ɔhā ce uwɔ Íjīpiti, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um; Awɔ, Asírīya nɛ̄ n yá a; mla Awɔ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ n fu a. Ɔhā ka o yɔ̄ la aá.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá kú aá kóō lɔtūlé eko kú ōwē ā yá ā, n géē lɛ aá tū ŋmá eko kú ojámá nōo géē wā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ujérīko, Ubɛti Uhɔ́gla, Ɛmɛ́ki kɛ̄sisi.

eng_Latn: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá lɛ agbénú tū lɛ īyī aá ɔkpáncō. Ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ ā, ɛha ámāŋ ɛ́kla í gē bīya ɔdā dúú ŋ́. Ācɛ owūwī ī kē gē ca ɔwɛ gaá kpó uwī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n tíne ō kɛlā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. N tíne ō kɛpɔ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ ká n le mafú lɛ ɔ́ ka ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n le jé ka awɔ gáā wɛ ɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu háyi abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka é bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú mla aá glá ŋ́, é géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú Ukénan ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn í je ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄yī uwá dúúmā yá ɔfiyɛ ŋ́. Ó lɛ uwá kpó tū aícɔ́ɔ́ja, kwú uwā ú yá aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔ́ja o pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o ce ɔnya kú ɛfú.

eng_Latn: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu le tá Ujerúsālɛm. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ó wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi. É gaá le ɔfú kpó kwu ācɛ igelī ā iyē.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá híīī bī ɔdā dúúmā ga iyāwu nyā ŋ́. Aá híīī bī ɔcí ō kwajɛ ámāŋ ka alítā ŋ́. Aá híīī bī igbo ámāŋ ka ije ŋ́. Aá kōō híīī bī úwé ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ uwɔ ofɛpa ce igwó yá ŋmá ugóolu cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú wu íkōtō ā kóō má kwɔhá mla īlī ō klá odée o hile ā.

eng_Latn: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
idu_Latn: N géē pīya uwɔ eyī ŋmá ɛga nāa tɛtɛ leyīkwu ā, í pi ɔ ŋmá ɛga oligbó kú ɛhícō ā, géē bī ɔ wā gaá kpɛ́fú tú ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta kahíníī, Ananíyāsi, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Usétan le mu uwɔ ɔtū ká ā kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā, ká ā kē je āyā kú ɔlá kú ɔdā agbénú ā tayínū ā?.

eng_Latn: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
idu_Latn: Ubɛtisɔ́ɔ, Usóko, Adulám.

eng_Latn: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhátāki le tá ɛgiyí Umɔ́dɛkāyi, eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú okómpīinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ āa.

eng_Latn: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēé je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā kwaajɛ ā, ojuja wā í klá anú, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā otú gbóɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
idu_Latn: Ikɔɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, amíyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ, ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kú amíyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔnyā lɛ lɛ ɔyí anúɔ.

eng_Latn: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, É ma uwɔ ipú ínoōbīya pélúú, anɔ́ɔ a gē nwū alɔ ɛlā abālɔbányā áā? Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nū tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ ɔmɛ́tá nyā yá ɔdā o hídáagó nɛ̄hi. Ó kōō yá kú ɔlá kóō wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ipú ɛcɛ ipéyī kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta nwūla okónu kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n le jé ka Ɔwɔicō í má eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhérodiyasi gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́tū Ujɔ́ni, ó tíne kóō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, amáŋ ó ŋmó ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ ohígbū Uhérɔ̄du.

eng_Latn: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
idu_Latn: a klla lɛ aíkpɛ́cí gwó ce icō úláyi mɛ́mla ɔ́ɔpu dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu ōfōōfūnū klá igbīhi gbɔ́ɔcī mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi wā í nunu tú ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī hile líígí kóō nyā.

eng_Latn: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, é tá ɔkpá nyā ipú iyē kú ɔcɛ́, Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si. É klla le eliká kú nū gbo ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ o ce ɔnya kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kpó kéē lɛ ɔkpá nyā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu uwɔ. N jé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a gē yá mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a gē nyɔ̄ ā. N kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū wú uwɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛfú nɛ̄ ācɛ gē kpó tá aɔ́mpa uwā ā ci ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā. Ó le ɔtā kpó cē bónū klla le aóbō kpó yíífi bónū. Ó klla le aɔ́kplɛ́fú kpó tū ɔlá bónū.

eng_Latn: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā ī kɛpɔ̄ tū alɔ klla ī yá alɔ italā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híīī ŋ́mó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí tɔ̄hā mla ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
idu_Latn: N géē miya tū kú ɛfú kóō lɛ aá lé. Ohígbū ka aá cɛ̄ um igwú eko nɛ̄ n hī aá igwú ā ŋ́. Aá klla kē jāhɔ̄ pó ɛlā kú um eko nɛ̄ n kɛlā lɛ aá ā ŋ́. Aá jégēdēē bá ī yá aɔ́dōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá jé cāā keé he um ɔtū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē gicō kú inu, yɔ̄ ī túkpɛɛ́ í gbā ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ ɛ̄gbā ā kpó yíífi. N géē je ācɛ nēe gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā, amáŋ nēe klla ī bī iyē kú ɛcí nēé hī ka Umílikɔm ā gē le gbɛka ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ācɛ kú aájɛ nēe bá ɛga oligbó okónu ísu ā, áa lɛ okónu klá hímm, ka aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. Aá le tútū ka aá ī wā í ka ɔkɔ kú aá. Aá wā í kɔɔkɔ kú aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ kɛpɔ̄ ka alɔ má ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ákú nū le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá pīya akwuna kú īkpɛ́cí dúúmā ŋ́ ohígbū nōó í je pīya ɔdūwēyī lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́kplá dóódu wɛ ákú um, o ŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n ŋmó aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, n lɛ aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu, kwu ákú aɛ́bɛ́ kú aá, wɛ ákú um. Ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
idu_Latn: É gā Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ga ipú inīcō ɛga nēé gbɔga ā á. Ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā yɔ̄ á: Upíta, Ujɔ́ni, Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ándru, Ufílīpu mɛ́mla Utɔ́mɔ̄si, Ubatɔlɔ́mi mɛ́mla Umátiyu, Ujémīsi ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Álifīyɔsi mɛ́mla Usáyímɔ̄n, ɔ̄cɛ kú ɔ́wá Usílɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Ujúdasi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujémīsi.

eng_Latn: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
idu_Latn: É lɛ odée kwu ogwu kú ɛyí autéblu ā biílí nɛ̄ ɔwá kú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā wɛ umilímīta ofɛtá cigwɛ́hɔ̄. É le odúúdú ɛbɛ́ nēé bī gáā gwɛ́ɛya ā kpó ce ɛyí autéblu ā.

eng_Latn: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
idu_Latn: Ācogbāājɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ, Ussálum, Ákūūbu, Utálmɔn mɛ́mla Ahíman. Usálum wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ Alelékwū nōo gē mafú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ abāābɔ̄yī nū ā fú á. Ācɛ kú ɛcɛ í lɔfú mīyɛ ɔ́ ga ipú ɔtū kú uwā glá ŋ́, ohígbū kéē má ɔ̄ ŋ́, é klla jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. Aá jé ɔ̄, ohígbū kóō lā mla aá, ó klla géē yɔ̄ ipú aá.

eng_Latn: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
idu_Latn: Okónōgwu kú inu lɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lā fíyɛ́ o lā ipú inū ékpónú mla ɔnyā ō kiífulá á.

eng_Latn: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi táafu lɔfúlɔfú mla ācɛ ā lɛyíkwu ɛlā nēé ka ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ miya kú Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō kú Ántiyɔ̄ku ōhī kéē ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ ayíkpó ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ má lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lé iháyí ofu ɛhīlī, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú á. Ó kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyipɛ oklóbīa ā kpɔ́, īkpēyī kú nū kwu jáálíí jāā gbéeko nōó kwú.

eng_Latn: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ā kóō lɛ owu kú oyēeyī fu tū ojíbó ā kóō lɔfú kɛlā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá kéē lɛ ācɛ nēé gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ mā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ obɔ̄bí ka lɛyíkwu ádā nū ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū géē kwú piíí.

eng_Latn: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ íne bīya, ó yá Ɔwɔicō ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí igbalɛwa nááná, ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
idu_Latn: Lɛ alɔ kwúcē wā ɛgīyī uwɔ, Óndú, lɛ alɔ bī cīgbīhi wā ɛgīyī uwɔ. Lɛ ɔhi, ocɛtla, ɛgahi, mɛ́mla ojīlīma kú alɔ tɛtɛ ā je lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, a le tútū kú ā kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā ɛɛ́? Ayíka a lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū uwā. Tá uwá ɛlá kwú aúcē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dúúmā nɛ ɔ̄cɛ le pīya tá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, é gē je īlī ā kpó ŋmá ɔ̄ eyī.

eng_Latn: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
idu_Latn: oŋmá lɛ o gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ámāŋ ka ɛnɔ, ámāŋ ka aínyílɔ́wɔ ɛ̄gbā klla ī cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄, nōo wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
idu_Latn: Ká aéwo kéē wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā wɛ ɔkpani ayínɛ́ uwɔ. Ayínɛ́ uwɔ kéē tú wāajɛ gā uwɔ. É géē tókónu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo tókónu gā uwɔ. É géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo hɔ́hā ce uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kahíníī, N yíihɔtū tū Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ nɛ̄ ó kē ī wɔ́tū ɔyínɛ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó ī yíihɔtū tū ɔyínɛ́ nū nōó gē má eyī ā ŋ́, ó gáā lɔfú yíihɔtū tū Ɔwɔicō nōó má eyī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē je ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā wúlātāajɛ, í je ɔ̄ tá alácɛ̄. Ó í wɛ ɔdā nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ í bá ī tɔ́cɔ́ ohígbū nū, nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bá í leyī gwō ɔ̄ bónū piyóó. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē wā í yɛ pi ɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, ó géē yá uwā eyījii nēé ī yɔ̄ ī mīyɛ̄yí jigijigi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ kú Abíssɔ, Unádābu ā ma ayí ɛpa nēe lé ka Usélēdi mɛ́mla Apayím. Amáŋ Usélēdi í ma ɔyí dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si pīyeyī biílí anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ó géē lɔnɔ lɛ ācɛ o lɛ agbénú kéē ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɛyí kú ɔ̄na kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ á. Aómbilí ɛtá ā wɛ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujóssuwa lɛ Uréhābu akwuna ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū hɛ́tá, ohígbū ka ó le ācobɔkwɛ̄lā tayínū nɛ̄ ó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Ujérīko ā kpó tayínū. Ipɔ́ɔma kú nū lā Ísrɛ̄lu jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn, wɛ Ussɛ́lumīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Ammíhūd.

eng_Latn: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā wɛ ocíbú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ce igwó, mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó ā. Ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa kú nū géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
idu_Latn: Ubatísim nēé yá alɔ ā, wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ ka alɔ gekwú mla anú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ alɔ nyi tɔ̄há mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ádā ā je Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú lā oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām kwú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā ú kpó lɛ Áyísīki.

eng_Latn: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
idu_Latn: N le iyī um kwú cíí ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ugádi wɛ: Usífiyɔn, Uhági, Ussúni, Ésbɔn, Ɛ́ri, Árɔ̄di mɛ́mla Arɛ́li.

eng_Latn: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
idu_Latn: Ukénan wɛ ádā kú ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi, ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri, ācɛ kú Ugígāssi.

eng_Latn: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ukénan nēe wɛ ācɛ o tá ɔ́sú, nēe gē hɛ́ ācɛ lé mla ɔdā ō le miya ɔdā kú újí ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú um ú ga inu eyīpú kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ɛgiyí ɔwɛ kú ɛga otīihɔ ā, ɛplá ede mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yɛ ā, ācɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bá abɔ́ɔ. É lɛ igbīhi kú uwá pīya kwu ɛga otīihɔ ā, lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɛnɔɔcī bá ī tū kpɛɛ́ bá ī gbā ɛnɔ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā yɛ kpɔ́ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Ugati Uhéfa mɛ́mla Etukasín. Ó kwu nyā ga ābɔ̄ kú Unéya ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Urímɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó yɔ̄ lɔhi? É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó yɔ̄ lɔhi. Kōō má Urécɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā éyi yɔ̄ ī wā mɛ́mla aálá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Arébīya mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ukɛ́da ā kpó aómlede, aálá, mɛ́mla aɛ́wū le cílá uwɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ nēé lá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma, ipɔ́ɔma, oŋmá lɛ o tá ūlī. Ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄hi ā kéē lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́, ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kéē lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ Ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ūlī gaá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú kwú, abɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nōó ka ā, ācɛ ōhī í kē cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lā ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɛ́siríili ā le pó ka aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ le inya kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā, ka Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛ́ɛ́ le pɛ́ gekwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā, é kē kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya wā gaá mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kwú aíne nɛ̄ n bīya íkííkēe mɛ́mla onyíleyē nɛ̄ n yá eko nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ oklóbīya ā í yá um ɛhi. Blakwu um ohígbū ka a ī yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ eko dóódu. A klla gē yá ɔdā lɔhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
idu_Latn: Aéwo ɔhá a ba ī wā kwūūū, amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pī lɛ uwá kwúcē, lɛ uwá kpó owu bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá kú ɛfu mla elūbi ā.

eng_Latn: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ipú alácɛ. Ó kē tá alácɛ iyɔ̄bū um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yékwú ā. Odúúdú ajɛ ā kwú tá alácɛ amāŋ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nɛɛ, é gē bī ɔkplɛ́fú ā nyɔ̄ mla anú. Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔkɔ gbā mɛ nɛɛ, é kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó cīgbīhi wā í bá ɛga o kpíyó tū ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ gē fu ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō alɔ á. Awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, je ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ lɛ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya ā da Udéfīdi ka, N wɛ ewō nɛɛ, nāa lɛ ɔcí wu abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu um ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó bī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú nū lɛ okónu tá lɛ Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nāa géē lɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā fíyɛ́ ugóolu dóódu á. Anú klla í fíyɛ́ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nōo tɛɛ́hɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urécɛ̄lu le jé ka anúɔ ɔ́ í mɔyí dúúmā lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ŋ́ mā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō má ɔyínɛ́ nū ímálānyī. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Yá ká n lɛ ipú yɔ̄ ká n lɛ ɔyí ma, ámāŋ n géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē nyɔ̄ ipácí, ɛ́ɛ bī ɔcí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē bī lɛ bu ɔ̄gɔ̄ ō ga ipácí tū ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ɔ lɛ ajɛ gwu klá anú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, n géē tū alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ɛhɔ̄ kóō gbɔbū lɛ aá, kóō gbɔ̄ aá ɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá bī wā ɛga nɛ̄ n tútū lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ɔ̄kā da lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé yá mla opī kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le jé keé kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔlá. Ɛ̄nyā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le cɔ̄nū mla Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Itáma, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka abɔ̄ nēé nyīla lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé bīya íne kú anúɔ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ á. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ojīlīmā kú ūwā pīya uwēyī.

eng_Latn: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usiríya gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, Ɛláyíssa le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, lɛ uwá eyī kpó pu Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ uwá eyī kpó pu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó cɛgbá kú n nyɔ̄ ayíka, é lɔfú nyɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n nyɔ̄ í le lá klla kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔ́ɔgɔndu á.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ó cɛgbá kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́. Aá je odée lɛ uwá kéē lé.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ɔhá ā géē móōwe kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ aá yá lɛyíkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Amáŋ, awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ géē móōwe kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ aá ya lɛyíkwu ɛya ō gwó ā.

eng_Latn: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ́ ɔyípōklobīya nōo gē bī iyɔ́fú kú nū ā, le má ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā. Ó le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū bī kwu ajɛ, má gwōnū klá anú gekwú mla Usɔ́lu dúú.

eng_Latn: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā, anɔ́ɔ ó má ka, ɔ̄na nɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ nā á. Ó kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū ikpati kú kú ɛka kú Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ gwó, klla le ucɛ yá lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
idu_Latn: Mla ɔkpá omlede otɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔwā, mɛ́mla ɔkpa ɛbɛ́ ɔhá, mɛ́mla ɔcí kú akésiya.

eng_Latn: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ācɛ ōhī kú Ufarisīi mla ācɛ o nwū íne kú Umósīsi wā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gaá jīla Ujísɔ̄si eyī.

eng_Latn: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
