idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā oblínyī otū uwēyī ɛgiyí ɔdōlé ō lé tɔ̄há ipú ihɔtū kú aá, abɔ̄ é bá gē wīyā ā. É gē je ɔdōlé lɛ iyī uwā ōfōōfū uwā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojuja nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ī yɛ icííci nōó gē yā ɔwɔ ŋ́ mā ā. É klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōó gē gwá ikpō ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ eko ɔgwā nááná. Ɔcí nēé lɛ uwá fu tɛgba tɛgba nēe gekwú dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá híī lé inyankwūlūmī ŋ́. Ó gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ amáŋ āpīicɛ kú nū í kɛ̄ɛpa ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne mɛ́mla ɔ́da nɛ̄ n tá lɛ aá ā. Aá gaá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ̄gbā ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aá kōō ī yúufi uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
idu_Latn: Óŋmá lɛ eyinyinyi mɛ́mla ɔhā kú awɔ Ɔwɔicō, n má téeyī olɔhi kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́kákwu kú nū. Ɔwɔicō kú um, a klla lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, é klla cɛ̄ ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm mla um.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī yúnwū ɔdā kú ɔ́mpa uwā ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ anyā uwa, ámāŋ ɔlɛ́ uwā, ajɛ kú uwā, aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ámāŋ aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú uwā, ámāŋ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aíjakī kú uwā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá kéē héyīfuúfuú kú ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ákú ɔ́mpā kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
idu_Latn: N jé ka ɔtū kú um í jɛga gā um kú um yá ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ipú ɔtū kú um, n dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ɔdā olɔhi, amáŋ ń kē lɔfú yá ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla Ujónādabu le tá eyīpú kéē gaá gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Ubáalu. Ó le ācɛ ofɛnɛ kpó kwāajɛ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú agbla kú Ubáalu ā, ó le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá le odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ā kpó ŋmó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ékpónú kú uwā le kwu, n géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó kwɛyí ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwu ā.

eng_Latn: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā ā í gē kɛlā ojigógó ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe gē gbeyī cíí ā, gē mɛ́ɛbɛ akplata.

eng_Latn: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ aá le aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā má yɔ̄ ī yá, aá géē jé ka eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í wā gaá gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā le bá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
idu_Latn: É da Umósīsi kóō túblá Ɔwɔicō ajaajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē ka lɛ ɔ́ ā kóō ka lɛ aá. É ka aá í pó klla í bī ɛlā ā yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
idu_Latn: Ɔgɔ, ucē okwáapa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā dóódu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le bēhé isu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ géē je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá kéē lā anú. Koó géē gbō uwā ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwā nēe bá ɛga dóódú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú omlɛ́nyɔ́ ú lɛ uwá, kéē má lā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi igwó lɛ ipɔ́ɔma ohile kú Ukóhāti ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, Udán, mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka Óndú ā nɛ̄ aá ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā gbɛka mla aá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi.

eng_Latn: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.
idu_Latn: É da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gā abɔ́ɔ, ɛ́ɛ géē má ka ācɛ ā í gáā leyīce ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Éwo ā ɔ́ɔ nwuné nɛ̄hi. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē cɛgbá ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ. É ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɛ́ɛ́ kóō jéeyī āa? Ɔnyɛ gē nwū ɔ̄ odée ɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé ɔdā okpaakpa āa? Ɔnyɛ kē gē nwū ɔ̄ ɔwɛ nōó gē le yá ɔdā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi āa?.

eng_Latn: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
idu_Latn: É le ɔflā kú ɔcɛ́ kú ujē tá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú klá anú ɛyí á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú onugbo ú wu ɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ okwúukwu kwāajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū yá ɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ gē kahíníī, Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
idu_Latn: É ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo ī je íjééyī lɛ alɔ fíyɛ́ aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ dóódu ā á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
idu_Latn: Ó gē wā í yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu okónu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ Udéfīdi, Ussiméyi kwú ɔ ú ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umáyíkɛ̄lu nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í kōō bɔ́tū bī ɛcá le ŋmó ebilíi ɛpɔ̄bí eko nēe yɔ̄ gē nya klla ī yá ikpɛ́lā ce okwū kú Umósīsi ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
idu_Latn: Ó gē lɔnɔɔtū lɛ ayí nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ayí ā í wɛ ákú nū ŋ́ mā. Ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ōwē nōo má tá ayí nyā le pīya áncā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ofu ɛhīlī kú uwā le kwu ga ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Urímɔn ā. É bá abɔ́ɔ ɔyā ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
idu_Latn: Kwu ofu kú ododó nēé le yá inu ā ifa ā, agege mɛ́mla alápā ō je ahɔ̄lá ŋmá ɔlá.

eng_Latn: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
idu_Latn: N géē bī aá wā Usáyɔn, ɛyí ɛfu nōo wɛ ákú abɔyī um ā. N klla géē yá ka ɔtū kóō he aá ipú inu nēé ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ā. N klla í mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gē gwó gā um ɛyí ede kú um ā. É géē hī Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā ka, inu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú odúúdú aéwo géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um.

eng_Latn: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ā ī yá ɔdā dúúmā, aá híīī kiŋini ŋ́ ámāŋ ka o yɔ̄ gē táafu mla iyī aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ācɛ okpaakpa ofɛpa ce igwó má Usɔ́dɔm, n gáā je igelī ā yíífi ŋ́ ohígbū uwā.

eng_Latn: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
idu_Latn: Ó bī ēpɔ̄kpá éyi nōo le nwúla abɔ̄. Ó lɛ ikpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná ce eyī ísu, ó kē lɛ ikpó abɔ̄lúfīyē ce ɛyí ajɛ.

eng_Latn: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
idu_Latn: É gwá ejé bá gē cɛ̄tra aɔ́wɔ nēé bī ɛcɔ̄, oje ɔdɔ, oje udɔ, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Íkwu nyá nāa lɛ ō cɔ̄nú ā.

eng_Latn: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó géē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe géē wā í yɛ pī ɔ̄ ā eyījii cɛ́ɛ́ é géē dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mla ajɛ kú nū ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā a?.

eng_Latn: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ó gekwú anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ́ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Áhāsi le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oŋmá ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ, o ŋmá ipú odo kú ɔ̄cɛ, nɛ̄ ɛlá obɔ̄bí dóódu nōo gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē ŋmá á. Éjulúgwu ō hɛ́, ācɛ ō ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ í gē lɛ́ɛ́cɛ ŋ́, ɔkwɛ̄yí lɛbɛ̄ɛka ohi kú íkínábɔ̄ ā nɛ, ó kē tōō pīyeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aígwu kú ayí kú Árɔ̄ni á. Árɔ̄ni ma ayí ɛnɛ: Unádābu, Abíhu, Ɛlísaa mɛ́mla Utáma.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kōō gáā bēhé wā ipú Ujerúsālɛm dɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē tá ɔyī ékpónú wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́. Aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá dúúmā í gáā bī ɔkplɛ́fú túblá igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛ́ɛ́, nōó gē ma úbɔ́ kú íbɔm bá igá kú nū biílí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
idu_Latn: Á gēe ka ipúɔtū kú uwɔ ka, N gēe tū icō ga ɔkpáncō, ɛhícō kú aínyílɔ́wɔ kú Ɔwɔicō a, N gēe je akpa ɔcɛ́ kú um kwu icoicō abɔ́ɔ, klá í cīce bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ a, ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛhíícō, ɛga nɛ̄ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá gē jīla ā.

eng_Latn: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
idu_Latn: N má ɔkpáncō le nwūla, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔnya nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi háyi abɔ́ɔ á! É hī ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛyí ɔnya ā lé ka Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tōō lɔtūce mɛ́mla Ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɔwɛ okpaakpa nōo gē le hɛ́pɔ̄ klla ī le kpɛ́fú kú nū á.

eng_Latn: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga kóō yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, amáŋ íla kú nū ā í je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ó ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí nēé gáā ma, nōo tá kóō wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū, nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā í má abahi dóódu jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó lā oyēeyī klla kwú ipú ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā hīgwú kú ālɔ̄ da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ɔwɔicō, a kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ɛɛ́. Ohígbū kéē gē yá ucē kú imabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbā ō gwó kú ācɛ aéwo nēe ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla Ufilístiya ā.

eng_Latn: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é nū ācɛ kú Ukɛ́na nēe lɛ Ugɛ́sa ā ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ukɛ́nan lā ipú ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem jāā kwu ícɛ nyā. Amáŋ é le uwá yúklɔ́ kéē yá abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ eko kú ɔkpɔkplɔ nɛ̄hi lɛ anyā nēe yīīpú mɛ́mla anyā nēe bá ī je amɛ̄ lɛ ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ ōhī kú aá gē tú īyī aá tū, gē kwu ɔgba ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ ɛga nēé ī pɛ̄cí ā. Aá klla ī lé ɛbɛ ókóome, ɛbɛ́ ifú, mɛ́mla ɛbéelihɔ ɔhá. N géē kpó odúúdú aá yíífi tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛbɛ́ kú omlede kú abɔ̄ ōcɛyí kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ he ɛga otīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá pó! Aótrɛ̄yí ā bá gē tɛ̄gíkwū. Ɛgahi kú uwā le yɛ ɛɛ́. Aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá pó oji nɛ̄ ágábá tū ā. Ohígbū ka ɔlɛ́ uwā kú ipú ūpū kú okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā kwú yíífi ɛɛ́!.

eng_Latn: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
idu_Latn: Eyī ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, Ujúda, géē yɔ̄ ī yá aá, amáŋ áa gáā má ɔ̄ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá gāa pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka éŋkpɔ̄ kwú ŋmó, uwá wɛ aflɛ́yí nēe ī kwú á, nááná nēé jɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē hɛ́ uwā le yá ɔdā dúúmā ɛɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi aákwuna ɛpa lɛ iyī uwā kpó wā iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofahāapa ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā wɛ, aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄, mɛ́mla aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Ɛlísu, ɔyí kú Ussɛdéwu á.

eng_Latn: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ alɔ nū ŋmá ipú uwā, ayíka lɛ alɔ nū ga ipú ɔ́wá kú aókóome ā.

eng_Latn: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ éyééye. É gbɔɔ́ ŋmá anyākwɔ́cɛ jāā ga ayípōklóbīya. Anɔ́ɔ é habɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ōfūnū mɛ́mla ɔnyā ā tá háyi á.

eng_Latn: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
idu_Latn: Ó géē je īkpɛ̄ɛcɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo bá ipú nū ā kpó bónū ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ede ā, ɛga nēé pīya ewo bá ā.

eng_Latn: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ áafú ā le gbɛlá ā, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi kéē gée je lɛ Upɔ́lu fā ŋiniŋini, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kéē le pɛ́ gaajɛ gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā, kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Éwo éyi mɛ́mla Éwo ɔhá géē kpɛ́fú tá iyī uwā. Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éyi géē kpɛ́fú tú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā da Upáyílēti kahíníī, Ā híī tá ka, Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ŋ́, amáŋ ka, Anú ɔ́ɔ ka ka anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu á.

eng_Latn: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
idu_Latn: A gē gwō ka anúɔ jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ a gē yá kú ācɛ kéē nyí Ɔwɔicō ojīlīmā, o ŋmá lɛ íne nāa gē bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nɛ̄ okómpinu yɔ̄ ā, olɔwá kú ukɔ́tin kú nū wɛ uyádi ofucɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá Umáyíkalu ohi kahíníī, N yɔ̄ í jīijē lɛ Óndú ā nōó je um fíyɛ́ ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ipíinu kú nū ā. Óndú ā klla lɛ um pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē yɔ̄ í gwéeyē klla í yɔ í jīijē lɛ Óndú ā gbóó.

eng_Latn: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā lɛ īnyīlɛ̄yí ogwā līkpō lɛ, ó wɛ ɔdā ɔhi kú nū. Ohígbū kéē je īnyīlɛ̄yí ogwā līkpō ā lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō klá ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo leyī gwō ɔ́mpānū bónū wɛ ɔ̄cobīyíne. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gbonɛnɛ lɛ aógbɛhá géē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú um kwu Óndú ā eko dóódu kóō tú um abɔ̄. Ó kē le um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú unwalu mɛ́mla ukpa.

eng_Latn: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
idu_Latn: Olíla nōo gē kwu ita lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú nōo, yɔ̄ ī tíne kóō fu ujē ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ipú ínōbīya bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nōo bá ajoodobū ā, lɛ onyatá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī wā ā má bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo ī fíyáajɛ ā ɛɛ́. Ɔlá ɔ́ɔmā géē fíyáajɛ klá uwá nááná nēé lā ɛga nōo bɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ajodobū kú ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ōcikpó kú nū éyi yɔ̄ Usɛ́kɛm. Ɔnyā ā mɔyí éyi lɛ ɔ́, nōó hī ɔ̄ ka Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
idu_Latn: N le ɔ́ má. N ke cɛ̄ ijáalí ka anú wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á. Lɛ italā yá uwā ohígbū ka alɔ í lɔfú yá ɔdā dúúmā tá ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi nyā glá ŋ́. Alɔ í kōō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ í yá ā ŋ́. Óndú, amáŋ alɔ leyī kpó klá uwɔ káā tá alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá koó wɛ ɔdā olɔhi ga um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le máfu lɛ aá ɔdā ohídáagó mɛ́mla ɛlōome nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā yá gā um ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā ó ka anúɔ géē bī ɔcí ujē lɛ cē igá tū ɔ̄. Ó ka anúɔ klla í ma ɔdɔ yɛ jīla ɔ́ tá kóō lɛ ɔwɛ ŋmó tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdí nēé tá ipú ɔkpíihɔ āa? Ó kahíníī, Lɛ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ā mla ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nū tɛ́ɛcɛ, ohígbū ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā a í gáā lɛ āyā kú úgwū kú ádā uwā mla ɔyí kú ɔnyā nōo lɛ iyī nū ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā eko dúú nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɛga, alɔ yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ dóódu, o fíyɛ́ dúú ālɔ̄ yá lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛlā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá tɔ̄há mla alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They have belied the LORD, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Óndú ā le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā ɛɛ́, kahíníī, Óndú ā í gáā yá alɔ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Óndú ā í gáā je unwalu dúúmā lɛ alɔ ŋ́. Ɛfú dúúmā í gáā kpó alɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtá dúúmā ī ŋmó alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n géē yɔ̄ ī gwíijē eko dóódu lɛyíkwu úklɔ́ kú ihɔtū nāa gē yá eko dóódu ā. N gē tɔ́ɔna piyóó ka, a tōō lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
idu_Latn: Igbɛ́ɛ̄nyā ā, aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā klla le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ugíbɛ̄ya, klla le aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu úlā ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄ ŋmó kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ gē je ɔdōlé lɛ aɔ́tágláma, eko nɛ̄ ayí uwā gē jikwū tū um kú ɔdōlé, eko nɛ̄ abɔ̄ le hɛ́ uwā iyē ohígbū ɛmiyɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá lɛ ojīlīma ɔkwɛ̄yi ā ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ipú ɔtū ká aá ohígbū ka anú wɛ Óndú aá á. Aá le tútū eko dóódu ká aá cīla ɔ̄kā kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē jɛ́yí kú eyīyōce nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛ ā le kpó yíífi ɛɛ́, ɔlá kē kwú ɔdā dóódu nēé gwū ɔ̄ tá ā ú kpó yi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Īī, n géē kpó uwā wā Ujerúsālɛm, géē gwɔ́ɔ́lá kwu uwá ɔkwu, kllá ī je uwá kpó ja bónū ipú íwɔ́tū kú um abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utɔ́yi, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhámati le pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhadadésa yálé dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Aá klla géē je opī gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ɔyí omlede ɛpa kú iháyí éyi ígwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
idu_Latn: Aá géē hɛ́ ufíyé kú aá, ó géē wɛ ɔdā ō cābɔ̄ mafū kú ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mɛ́mla aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄, le tá aéyīpɔ́lɛ́ nēe kwu ajɛ kú Usísarīya Ufilipayi ajaajɛ ā. Abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwá kahíníī, Aá da um ɛ́, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ka n wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ācɛ-Ugálīli, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá háyi gē pléeyī tū ɔkpáncō ā? Ujísɔ̄si nyā nēé je ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ga ɔkpáncō ā, géē wā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá má ɔ̄ gē nyɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ínoōbīya he ɔ́ ɔtū, ayíka unwalu he ɔ́ ɔtū abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē lɔ̄ɔ̄fú eko dóódu, yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā unwalu nɛɛ n.

eng_Latn: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē ca odúúdú áafú nɛ̄ ācɛ o ka ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ í tá nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā tāajɛ. Alɔ gē bī iyɔ́fú nyā gē le ca ɛlóōgbo dóódu nōo gē bɛyíkwu ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā tāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ nwū uwā kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ okónu nōó ce lɛ uwá ā tū. mla ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū tū.

eng_Latn: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā Árōwɛ ā, aá gáā háyi ɔwɛ kú aá gbēyī. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ī kwu ā wā gáā yɛ, aá da uwá ɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
idu_Latn: Kwú isiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ā ú kpó tū ipú ikpati ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄wū ú klá ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nāa gē nwū ā cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ugóolu nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Anú lɔ̄nyɛ fíyɛ́ enyi ɛnwū nōo yɔ̄ ī wúla wāajɛ ŋmá āgā ɛnwú á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyínɛ́ kú ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ŋ́. Ɔmáapú ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ ajaajɛ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, ó géē bī okóhō ɛpa mɛ́mla ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
idu_Latn: Nááná, ā maabɔ̄ alɔ tá ipú aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bī nyā, nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá alɔ abɔ̄ ŋ́. A klla habɔ̄ alɔ tá ipú obū juu.

eng_Latn: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpíhɔ ka, Gwéeyē ɔdɔma nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyí ŋ́. Le yíla bɛ̄cɛ ká ā dɛ̄gba, awɔ nɛ̄ ó móōwē kú ɔma ɔyí ŋ́ mā a. Ohígbū ka ayí kú ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔbá tá ɔ̄ ā géē lɛwa fíyɛ́ ayí kú ɔnyā nōo lɛ ɔbá ā á.

eng_Latn: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kē cɛ̄ uwá ijáalí oŋmá lɛ ō yá ɔdā ocābɔ̄ mɛ́mla úklɔ́ ō hídáagó ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, mɛ́mla o kɔ̄ ɛhi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ lɛ ācɛ nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ugóma wɛ Áskɛ́nāsi, Udífāti, mɛ́mla Utogáma.

eng_Latn: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jégēdē ŋ́, lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdēelihɔ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu, ɛdɔ ɔdēelihɔ dúúmā, ó le ɛpɔ̄bí lé ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó le ɔdā nōó yá ā jé ā.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē wā ajɛ mɛ́mla úgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɔlá bɛ̄ɛka ofúlutu ā. Ó géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi klla kē í bī ɔlá le yá aólɛlā kú nū italā.

eng_Latn: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí aflɛ́yí nɔ̄nyīlɔ dóódu kú aá mla ákú ɛna mla álá kú aá wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú da um ā á. Abɔ̄ n bī ɛlā okónu kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, n gbɔɔ́ ō pó uya kú aíkpokwú bá ī fīyɛ̄ iyī uwā ā. Aíkpokwú ā gáā gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ kwɔhá. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ nyɔ̄ ī kwu ikpokwú kú iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi Ujɛ́futa ā, Íbisan nōo ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛ̄hɛ̄m ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō yēeyī, ó klla lɔfú, anú kōō lulé fíyɛ́ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nōo lɛ eyī ɛpa ā á. Ó ī gwū ɔ̄cɛ jāā ga eyīpú gaá kwu odo mla eko mla ogó kú ikpokwú kú nū, ó klla jé únwū ɔdā kú ɔtū mla ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbo ipú ɔtū kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ āa cīce le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ Upɔ́lu abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā. Upɔ́lu le má ka ó cɛ̄ɛ̄lā, ka ɔ̄cɛ kē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá glá, anɔ́ɔ ó le eyī plla tū ɔ̄ eyī glīglī.

eng_Latn: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
idu_Latn: Óndú um, abālɔbányā, okónu nɛ̄ a ce ā, a le ɔ́ yá ɛɛ́, mabɔ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ tā kóō gekwú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Usém wɛ, Ɛlam, Ássɔ, Aápākssadi, Ukúdu, Áram, Úusi, Uhúlu, Ugɛ́ta mɛ́mla Umésēki, Umá wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ nēe lé iyē kwu uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
idu_Latn: N kwú ojīlīmā nēé je gā um ā ú lɛ uwá ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le pīya ékpó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla awɔ wɛ ékpó ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujése kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyí uwɔ, Udéfīdi, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o gē gbō álá ā, tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé um.

eng_Latn: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ oyá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā tú wāajɛ ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ igelī olɔfú nɛ̄hi nēé lā anú ā yíífi ɛɛ́. Ó klla kwú ɔdɔ kú nū ú wúla klá ajɛ, lɛ ɔ́ gbā munuu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē ka kahíníī, Ɔnyīlɔ nyā gbɔɔ́ ō gwó inu, amáŋ ó gwó ɔ̄ gaajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, otú dóódu, mɛ́mla oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ācɛ ā bá ī yúklɔ́ kú aígbáanɔ ō kwú. É ī kwú nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ utín ofɛpa cigwó ŋ́. É le uwá kpó bá ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu kú ɛga nēé lā ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla īlī o gbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ kú īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ o lɔɔlɔhi nēé bī owú odufā, ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá wu ā. É klla bī inyilá le ijā he tū ɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ íne kú ɛya kú ɔdā ō gbā cīgbīhi, nēe tīihɔ nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Iwili kú ācɛ gāa hile Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ísrɛ̄lu gēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ɔda, nēé kwú Odúúdú oōgwá kú nū u kpó hɛ́ gāa hile ikpō éyi, amáŋ ɛpa kwu īcoicō kú ɔcí a, amáŋ iwili nēé ma abɔ̄ ta kwu abɔ̄ kú ɔcí a ɛháajɛ a. Ami Óndú a, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu a lɛ ɛnyā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛyā, Unɔ́bu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
idu_Latn: Ó le um nū ga ipácí klla le um hɛ́ klá ajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó habɔ̄ um tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī ɔdā nɛ̄hi le lá aá, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híīī je pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ācɛ ɔlamu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
idu_Latn: Ó géē jila ɔ́wɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā yɔ̄ ­ī lé ga ipú ɔdɔ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔmā tū ɔdā dóódu kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ aá géē bī wā gé lɛ Óndú ā. Ohígbū ka ɔmā kwɛyí ɛka nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbo mla aá á. Ɔmā géē yɔ̄ ipú odúúdú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
idu_Latn: É í yá anɔ̄ otīihɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔtulalī umuumu ōkpóocu kú ɛga Otīihɔ ā. É géē yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā í má abɔ̄ ō je okóohō ɛpa ámāŋ ka oklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa ā ŋ́, ó géē bī okoolo kú umu éyi kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne nōó bīya ā. Ó gáā lɛ anɔ̄ kú ólīifu, ámāŋ ka ɔtulālī umuumu dóódu tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛya kú íne ō bīya nōó wɛ á, ó wɛ ɛya kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Otú mā piíí ā odúúdú aá géē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Ohígbū kéē lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N géē ŋmó ɔ̄cogbaálá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́wá kú aálá kú nū ā kē í fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
idu_Latn: Aá lā oyēēyī nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō yíhɔtū tá aá. Aá gbēyī ɛhi kú oyēeyī nōó gē mɛ ŋ́ nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē je lɛ aá ohígbū koó gē méyīnyinyi ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
idu_Latn: Ɔlékwū ā, ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, í gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Abɔ́ɔ, ācoyúklɔ́ ɔfú nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwá ā kē ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ cíí.

eng_Latn: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā gē kwu hɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí tá. Amáŋ, ɔwɛ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, gē bī ɔ̄cɛ bí.

eng_Latn: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Ā mlanyī ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē kwúcē ŋmá anú ŋ́. Jéeyī ká ā klla jɛ́yí kú ɔdā.

eng_Latn: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
idu_Latn: É dɔɔ̄kā ō gwutá mla ɔnyā dúú nɛ̄ ikpēyī kú uwā má ā. É gē jē ukpa lɛ ācɛ nēé lɔfú iyē ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ íne bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú yíífi. Ɔtū kú uwā gē kweyī ɔ̄dā eko dóódu. Ɔwɔicō géē yá uwā italā piíí.

eng_Latn: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Ujówāsi kóō lɛ ɔyí nū bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, ohígbū kóō lɛ ede kú Ubáalu ā wúlatāajɛ, klla lɛ ɔcí kú ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra nōo kwu igbīhi ede ā hɛ́ klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ōwē nɛ̄ aá má ā wɛ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá lɛ ce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā jé. Ó kōō wɛ ugóolu nōo wɛ oje nōo lɔfú je yíífi glá ā, é gē bī ɔlá le jé ɔ̄ má dúú, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é géē jé ɔtōoce kú aá nōo gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ ugóolu ā má dúú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē le jé ka aá cībū glá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē cɛ̄tra aá, lɛ ojīlīmā ce aá eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá gā.

eng_Latn: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ucɛ kú Onyatá ā yá piíí ipú ɔyā nēé hī ka Abíbu ohígbū ka otú éyi, ipú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ nya uwá tá ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti, iháyí alɛwa nēe wā í yɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n kwú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ge bī gé um ā í lɛ uwá kóō wɛ ákú uwā ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n da uwá ka é gáā lɛ agbénú kú abɔ̄yī uwā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ái pīyeyī má igbīhi ā, é má ódūdū kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ɔkpáncō. Ɔwɛ dóódu í yɔ̄ lɛ uwá néē gē kwu gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ī kwinya ā, kwú pīyeyī gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá uwā.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
idu_Latn: ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó ga iháyí ofu ɛpa ce igwo, nēe géē yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ glá ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ń kɛlā ā ŋmá ɔfú kú um ŋ́, amáŋ Ádā nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, je ɔ́da kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē ka ā gā um á.

eng_Latn: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ, aá gē je ɔ́ ga iyɔ̄bū ācɛ nēé wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ ipú icɔ́ɔci ā ŋ́ mā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túba okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ísɔ pīyeyī le ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayí ā má ā, ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ānyɛ bá mɛ́mla uwɔ yɔ̄ ā? Ujékɔ̄pu tóohi kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ayí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō méyīnyinyi um kpó gā um ā bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Ayisáya kóō da Áhāsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā yúufi ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe bá mla alɔ ā fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe bá mla uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēe tá iyē kú nū tū ɔkpá kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā ŋ́, é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ga ipú ókpoó kú ɔlá.

eng_Latn: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɔfú kú ɔlɛɛcɛ, amáŋ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ yɔ̄ mla alɔ. Anú gaá kpɛ́fú lɛ alɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú ācɛ ā le tū kwu ɔtū, ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ka lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́da je ga um ka amiyɔ́ nyɔ̄ í ka lɛ ācɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a bī lɛyíkwu odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā. Agīje géē cēenyi ŋmá um eyī, otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ohígbū ka é le ágbe o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ yá ācɛ éwo kú ɔlɛ́ um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya kwú odúúdú aɔ́wɔ nēe wɛ ɔdēelihɔ̄ ā ú kpó ŋmá ipú ajɛ nōo wɛ á kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó klla le yá kú odúúdú ācɛ kéē gbā Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ɛ̄gbā. Eko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī gaá kwu ā, ācɛ ā í kwúcē ŋmá ō gbā Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ í má ɔdōlé nōo í jīla ācɛ nēe bá ā? É klla ka ɛga nɛ̄ aá bá ā kē wɛ ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi eko dóódu. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā ɛlā nɛ̄ alɔ ka lɛ aá ā í wɛ, Īī mɛ́mla ehée ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ úklɔ́ kú nū yá kwɛyí ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ eko gbɔɔ́ ō túblá ajaajɛ kú okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce lɛ Ébrahām ā kóō le yá jīla ā, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō nyīla lɛwa lɛwa ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, A gbɛlá ka n tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē tá ɔnyā nū ā nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā iní nɛ̄ ɔkpá nɛ̄ n je lɛ ɔ́ kóō mafú ka n tá ɔ̄ ā kē yɔ̄ āa? Aá gbɛlá ka n je aá lá le cíla ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē je ɔfiyɛ lá ā nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā, ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ n bī ɔ̄ ulé ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kpó aá lá lɛ ɔ́ āa? Ó lɛ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú aá, nēé kpó aá lá á.

eng_Latn: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē ga ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Asíriya gaá ba ɔdōlé o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōlé má lé, cɛ́ɛ ká ālɔ yēeyī.

eng_Latn: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɛfulɛ́ɛfu, ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú, yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ī yɛ.

eng_Latn: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yúúfi nū ā yɔ̄ ī yá um. Ɔdā nōo kē í tū um ufi nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ī yá um.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
idu_Latn: N le eko tū nɛ̄ n géē kpó ācɛ Ánatɔ̄ɔtu yíífi. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ga, odúúmā kú uwā í gáā hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka Óndú ā í je yá um ɛhi, eko nɛ̄ n nyɔ̄ mla ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ um ga agbla kú ɛcí kú Urímmɔ̄n, ɔwɔ kú Usiríya gaá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā. Óndú ā kē í je yá um ɛhi piíí.

eng_Latn: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
idu_Latn: É da aá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka aá híī pā aɛ́cí ɔhá dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ka aá ɔ́ɔ híī yá Ɔwɔicō cɔ̄nū ŋmá lɛ ō gbā ɛcí nɛ̄ aá bī abɔ̄ kú yá ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ. Ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā yá aá ɔdōōlɔnɔ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó le nyīla ga ipú ɔkpíyē ā, ó klla cɛgbá o leyī táajɛ ɔnwū odo ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka ó le tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā le ukpa kpla gbēyī um ā, ń gwɛ̄lá hī íne kú uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā da uwá kahíníī, N nɔ̄na nōo gē je unwalu gā um nɛ̄hi, ń kē gbɛlá kwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
idu_Latn: É le ɛdɔ ijā kú ucérūbim mɛ́mla ɔcí alī mɛ́mla ododó nōō le nwūla he tū ɔ̄ klla le ugóolu ma plla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá amānyā ā, ɔtū le bīya gā um, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n le blakwu uwɔ, ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujɔ́dan mɛ́mla Uhɛ́mɔ̄n, mɛ́mla oŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Umísa.

eng_Latn: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja nōó lɛ ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi nēe tōō gbaáluka ŋ́? Ɔlá kú nū gē fíyajɛ ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
idu_Latn: N lɛ Usamérīya yíifi mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́cí kú nū ɛɛ́, n kē í yá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla aɛ́cí nēé gē pā ā ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ó le ikókwū, ukɔ̄, ɔgbanjɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔjá nēé géē bī le yúklɔ́ eko nēé gáā gwɛ́ɛya kú ejé ā kpó yá.

eng_Latn: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
idu_Latn: É kwú Umówābu ú yíífi ɛɛ́. Jāhɔ̄ kú ā pó ayípɛ̄ bá ī jikwū.

eng_Latn: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
idu_Latn: Eko kú oyēeyī otīihilɛ kú akwuna nāa yɔ̄ ī lā ɔ́ɔmā, á blakwu eko kú ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwɔ nāa tá ohɛ́ɛwa nōbí nōbí yɔ̄ ī míya ipú oyī kú uwɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ŋmó ɔbáagwu nɛ̄hi éyi kú Íjīpiti nōo bī óbō. Ubenáya ga ɛgiyí nū bī ogbló abɔ̄, ó le ogbló fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ óbō ā wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú óbō ā ú, bī óbō kú ɔ̄cɛ ā piíí le ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō le Usɛkaríya ɔkɔ nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā, gbɔɔ́ ō tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá á.

eng_Latn: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ híla anú ŋ́, amáŋ ālɔ̄ lɛ ūlī tá, ká ālɔ̄ jé ákú ɔ̄cɛ nōó géē wɛ ā. Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, É le aúwé kú um kpó kɔ̄ lɛ iyī uwā, anɔ́ɔ é le ūlī tá ce awulú kú um á, kóō le yá jīla. Aícɔ́ɔja ā kē le yá tá ɔdā nēé tá nyā yíílí.

eng_Latn: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Uteliméla, Utelihása, Ucérūbu, Ádɔn mɛ́mla Ímma pīyɛyí mla uwá dúú, amáŋ abɔ̄ uwá í jé ɛma kú uwá gɛ ŋ́ mā, é je uwá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le aálá ahāapa, aómlede ahāapa, mɛ́mla aɛ́wū ahāapa kú ɛya ō gwó kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, kú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ō bī le gwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēe tēelihɔ ā. Ó le aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kpó gé lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Árɔ̄ni ā kéē kwú aɛ́bɛ́ ā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ébrahām kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Usára yɛhɛ klla ka kahíníī, N mɔyí glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛɛ, eko nɛ̄ n le hīla ɛɛ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
idu_Latn: Ń jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yá ā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ō yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nōo ī wú um ɔtū ā nɛ̄ n gē yá á.

eng_Latn: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi ká ācɛ Ujíyu le jé ká Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ á. Ó wɛ ohígbū kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ kéē lɛ Ulásārɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ nōó je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā má dúú.

eng_Latn: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
idu_Latn: Áhābu gaá le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja yá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó bī ɔkpacaŋgelī je odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔwɔ nēé hī ubáalu ā kpó ŋmó lɛ ā kpó ka lɛ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu, ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: But we believe that through the grace of the LORD Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó cíkā ō wɛ ā ŋ́, alɔ cɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le alɔ nyatá o ŋmá lɛ ogbonɛnɛ kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si lɛ alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ uwá dúú ā.

eng_Latn: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Áyísīki hɔ́hā kú ɔdā nōo í yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā ce Ujékɔ̄pu mla Ísɔ á.

eng_Latn: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē ka nyā wɛ ka alɔ lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ alɔ húmáyī ka ā, nōo cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú úgādā ɔcɛ́ kú Ágábáidu ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyípōklobīya ā plla mla ɔhi kú nū á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklobīya ā klla cɛ̄ ɛlā olɔnyɛ kú ɔnyā ā, nɛ̄ ó ka ā.

eng_Latn: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔhā hé ce awɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí kú uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ce Ébrahām ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā mīyɛ ajɛ nyā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Ébrahām ā. A lā anú bɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó ce ijakī kú nū wā ɛga o foó bá ɛfu iyē ā, ó gaá le gbɛyí mla Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū abɔ̄ é bá gē wā ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu ce igwáahāapa nɛ̄ Ujówāsi lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ujɛhówāsi, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóhāsi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé dúú. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya, iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ká ā lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
idu_Latn: Ífi kóō wā í klá uwá acígilí ukpa nēé kpla ā kóō lɛ uwá kwú. Ké ē má gwōnū tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ífi kú uwā.

eng_Latn: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ka amáŋ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujówābu ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ ā wɛ o yá kú anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ bī eyī ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ lɛ ɛlā má, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ yátū. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ jééyī bɛ̄ɛka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ klla jé ɔdā dóódu nōo gē yá ipú ajɛ āa.

eng_Latn: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Óndú ā le Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni tɛ̄hɔ̄ gā Íjīpiti mla unwalu nɛ̄hi nōó bī í klá ācɛ Íjīpiti. Amáŋ ó le uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ígal, ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka.

eng_Latn: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
idu_Latn: N ka ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú bī áafú olɔnyɛ kú nū lɛ plla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛnyā dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ī nyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā nōo lɛ iyē kwu ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī nyílá, le tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
idu_Latn: Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí olíla, é lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēe gē nwū uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si gɔ́ mla itali.

eng_Latn: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ aláadi dóódu ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā nōó lɛ ā kpó tū piíí. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híīī lɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é géē gbɔɔ́ ō mīyɛ ɛhi ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ eko nɛ̄ n gā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá habɔ̄ odúúdu anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā tá kéē yēeyī nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi klá Usíklagi, ɛga nōó kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ ā, ācɛ olɔfú nēe jē ō kpɛ́fú nɛ̄h nēe bá ā wā gaá bá mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ wɛ ācɛ o yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ yéékpónú, yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū aflɛ́yí āa.

eng_Latn: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēé géē je Ɛ́dɔm yíífi ā, uya kú nū géē nwuné bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ odúúdú ɛcɛ yɔ̄ í jíliyē ā. Ācɛ géē pó uya kú ikwū nēé í je ā jāā kwu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú um, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, n jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī ka mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
idu_Latn: É gbā aɔ́kpá ɛhīlī kóō kwu igbīhi kú ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam le tútū, kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á, anɔ́ɔ Ubálāki kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa ā, le gbō mla awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é cīce eyīyɛ̄cɛ, ɛga o wíīkpɔ̄dā kú okónu igá kú Usamérīya ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā bá ī mɛ́ɛbɛ gē ka ɔdā nēé má tɛ́ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū uwá á.

eng_Latn: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa da ɔnyā nōo lā Ussúnɛm, nēé je ɔyí nū héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā ka, Óndú ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī tū ɔkpɛtā wā ipú ajɛ ā. Ó ka ɔkpɛtā ā ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmó iháyí ahāapa. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔyí nū ga ɛga ɔhá kéē nyɔ̄ í lā.

eng_Latn: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
idu_Latn: Óndú n le ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ójīla kú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, ka a le alɔ nyatá ɛɛ́. A jé, Óndú, a jé ka ń gáā klá okónu tū ō ka ɛ̄nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū ā cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ klla í je ɔpɛ́ nēé í hī ka unwalu ā pīya ɔwɛ kú eyīyōce. Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄lā kú anúɔ abɔ́ɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā a. Eko nɛ̄ ó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ákú ohumɔtū ā nɛ̄, ami ké he ɔ́ ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo klla wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā klla kahíníī, Ācɛ Ujúda, kwu ɛya nɛ̄ aá ī yi ɔlá dúúdú ga um ā mɛ́mla aɛ́dɔ ɛya ɔhá ā, ú kpó tɔ̄há, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú kpó lé abɔ̄yī aá.

eng_Latn: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo miya ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hīgwú ā kéē lɔfú mīyɛ ɔhā nōo yɔ̄ piyóó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je ā glá. Ɛ̄nyā yá glá ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá gekwú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ hɛ́tá ŋ́má ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá eko nɛ̄ ɛka kú aflɛ́yí ā tīile kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba ka, Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ Ubárābasi nɛ. Ubárābasi wɛ ɔ̄coyíkpala.

eng_Latn: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
idu_Latn: Kɛ̄ɛ ka Ɔwɔicō wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ujíyu ōfōōfū uwā? Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aílɔ́wá dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Īī gbóó, ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aílɔ́wá dúú nɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nēe bá ā, Uféro géē je odōōbɔ̄bí kú uwɔ yá uwɔ ɛhi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú uwɔ ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá agbá, klla kwú uwɔ̄ ú ce āhɔ̄ kú uwɔ tɛtɛ ā ɔlɛ́ nū. A géē yɔ̄ ī je ejé lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā tɛtɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ń gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka n wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ɔtū kú um nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ gē gbō ā, da um mla ɔtū ékpó lɔfú lɔfú ka ń yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā, Ɛláyíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, le túblá ede ā gáā gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu. kóocōō yá kéē le jé ícɛ nyā ka awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ka amíyɔ̄ kē wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ á, ka n kē yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋmá lɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ ā je ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: É géē jé ka ami wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nōo kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɔfú lā mla uwá. Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā pó á. Ó le uwá tá abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú Ukénan ā yálé á. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le uwá mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā kpó yíífi dúúdú, klla kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ ka Uhɔ́ma.

eng_Latn: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Ijē kú um ā kē í cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā piyóó. Odúúdú ācɛ kē ī bá ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā gbéeko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ īlī kú nū híla, má gbo klá ajɛ, kwú eyī í pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄. Anú mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, lɛ ewo wu klá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
idu_Latn: Ámōōmɛ ā, aá géē je kpó yíífi ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá. Aá klla í mɛ tū ipú ajɛ kú aólɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ācɛ okpaakpa ā géē gwéeyē, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nyā. É klla í kpɔtūce ɔ́ kóō gbō uwā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe le kpaakpa ipú ɔtū ā kē í cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu lɛ inya kwu gā ɛgiyí nū, ó kē pó abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í jɔ́kpá kú Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A jɛ́yí ɔdā nāa í jé ā déē.

eng_Latn: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwá nɛ̄ ó gē gbō ajā tá uwá ā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa. É jōklóbīya, le gbo héyīfuú héyīfuú, klla ī ce aɔ́nya.

eng_Latn: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi cīce ɛplá nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú okómpinu kú eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ mɛ́mla okómpinu kú eyīpú kú igelī ā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbāājɛ ā le yɛ tá icō ɔdɔ kú igá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá háyi ajílɛyí kú okómpinu kú igelī ā á. Ó je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ gē kwinya í wā ōfōōfūnū á.

eng_Latn: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma igwó ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú kóō je ínoōbīya kú aádáádā nū mlanyī ŋ́ Ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ī je ínoōbīya kú ɛ́nɛ́nū yɛ́ ɛhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.
idu_Latn: Ó lé ɔcɛ́ nyā eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ iháyí ofu ā. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī. Ó yɛ tá íkpa olɔhi kú Udéfīdi aádáádā nū ā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ó yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó he Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá tá alácɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā anú ŋ́. Ó le pīya ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī le tá okónu lɛ īyī uwā, ohígbū ka Óndú ā ī leyīkwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā kpɔ́ glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
idu_Latn: A le um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfū ā. A kwú um pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú aéwo. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ń jé ŋ́ mā, kwú pīya ācɛ o cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram klla kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, abɔ á je ɔyí dúúmā gā um ŋ́ mā. Ɔfiyɛ nēé ma ɔlɛ́ um ā géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā lúgwū kú um á.

eng_Latn: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ ó fu ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ka abɔ̄ anúɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ ɔhá nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bī gē lɛ anúɔ ā, ɔ́ɔ kwú kwu á. Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, A lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū īyī uwɔ ɛɛ́, a géē cíla anú ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo je kwu ɔ́ɔmā piíí.

eng_Latn: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ olɔhi ā, le pɛ́ gebí ga ɔwɛ kú Ubálam ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubéyɔ, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ije ō lɛ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bī ō yá le he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
idu_Latn: N kē í bī uwɔ wā ipú inu kú ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nōo ma um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ihɔtū nwū um. N kē í je ejé ō kpóocu kú um gā uwɔ, mɛ́mla ejé kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti kú um.

eng_Latn: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja ā le Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ́kpá kwɛyí ā, é kwú úwé kú nū ú púla lɛ ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ āyā kú nū éyééye á. É le awulú kú nū nōó lɛ ɛgɔ́ dúúmā ŋ́, nēé tá ŋmá icō jāā wā ajɛ ā kpó dúú.

eng_Latn: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá ī lɛ īlī ŋ́ mā, é gē tóohɛ́ɛwa gbiyɔ̄lā otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ipú ofu.

eng_Latn: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ó lɔhi. Ó yɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú aá, ɔdā dúúmā nōo he aá ɔtū ā, aá yá mla anú. N gáā ci aá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá tíne ō yá mla anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá le yá kú aátámɔ̄kpá ā, kéē gwá ejé, aá klla le ɔ́da je lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kéē híī cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka anúɔ hī ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ajɛ igwú kéē wā cījáalí ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ lɛ íne ā bīya. Ka ɛ́ɛ gáā lā gbojī ipú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú Ujɔ́dan nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bēhé nyɔ̄ gáā mīyɛ kéē lā ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpó uwā yíífi dúúdú ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ā lɛ ā, ɔ́ɔmā lé kéē gē le oyī gwu ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kéē le tīihɔ. É gē je íneoōbīya yá ācɛ ɛhi ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē le oyī kú ɛbɛ́ fu bónū.

eng_Latn: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ o tá ɔyī olulé cɛ̄ aá, mɛ́mla o bī ahɔ̄lá lɛ yi aá ɔlá.

eng_Latn: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
idu_Latn: Uharífi, Ánatōtu, Ubébāyi.

eng_Latn: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ tū ipú iháyí igwáahātá kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujosíya ā.

eng_Latn: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: É háyi abɔ́ɔ bɛ̄ɛka áwa ɛtá ā, abɔ̄ nēé bā í jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá ā. Ipú áwa ɛtá ɔhá ā, é le íne nēé bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ anɔ́ɔ é le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si pīyeyī kwu Upíta, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga igbīhi um, Usétan! A wɛ ɔdā o ŋmɔ́ɔwɛ tū um, ohígbū ka ɛlá nɛ̄ gbo nyā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, amáŋ ɛgiyí ɔlɛɛcɛ nɛ.

eng_Latn: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé nyi īkpɔ̄dā kú unwū kú ɔdā kú ɛcɛ, é géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ikwū, ɔ́dāŋ keé nyi ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō, é géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú oyēeyī opiyóó ŋmá ɛgiyí alelékwū.

eng_Latn: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá ikwū nɛ̄ n gē je ā n kwú pīya ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ́ kú aógbo, mɛ́mla oklóbīya kú aókokoŋ́kofí.

eng_Latn: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ajɛ ɔlamu nōo yɛ igelī kú uwā jīla tá ā, é gáā je ɔ́ lá gbóógbóō ŋ́. Ó wɛ agbénú kú uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō lɛ ɔ́ tū gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ujɛrússa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usádɔ̄ku.

eng_Latn: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cotɔ́sū nōo gē tínɛ aɛ́cɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nēe héyīfuú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka eko ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú kahíníī.

eng_Latn: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n le pó abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú cokónu ka aɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā géē tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā ipú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ iyī alɔ gbō lɔfú ŋmá le ɛka nɛ̄ alɔ gwá ka alɔ í gáā lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tū ɔdōlé dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ Upɔ́lu ŋmó.

eng_Latn: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ hile ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla odúúdú aéwo nēe tɛtɛ wɛ ákú um kpó yálé. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ɛlā ka ɛɛ́, ó kē í yá piíí.

eng_Latn: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí o jéeyī kú ācɛ ā géē tá ācɛ alɛwa abɔ̄ kéē jɛ́yí ɔdā nēé jé ā. Amáŋ eko kpíii ā, é géē ŋmó ācɛ ōhī kú uwá ɔgbɛ́fú, ámāŋ o je ācɛ ōhī kú uwā yɔlá ga ɔlékwū. É kē í hɛ́ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā éjulúkwu klla í je uwá pīya aálagbá.

eng_Latn: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi kpó wā ajaajɛ iyɔ̄bu kú Árɔ̄ni kú é lɛ pīya ācɛ nōo í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Brethren, pray for us.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
idu_Latn: É géē tómbili pla uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm lɛ ācɛ kpó kwū ajɛ ipácí ɛyí ɛfu ā gē gbēyī Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gáā bū ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā, é gē wī ɔ̄ uwī. É le ɔdā ā ka lɛ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá, é kē í kpó uwá ŋmó, nōo kē wɛ ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ uwá ā. É tá aókwū kú uwā ɛcɔ̄ táipú úlíyi kú Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū ka ācɛ ípɔ́ɔnū kú uwā nēe cíkā o nyi okwū uwā kē le pɛ́kwú eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ o nyi okwū uwā í gáā yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu igwó ā le yɛ tá Íjīpiti gaá lá īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
idu_Latn: Ukálɛ̄bu ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ tɛtɛ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nyā, mɛ́mla obugā mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, n gēe tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ohígbū ka a lɛ ɔ́ yá ɛɛ́. N géē yɔ̄ ī bī iyē kú uwɔ tɔ́ɔna ipú ójila kú ācɛ kú uwɔ ohígbū ka a lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛlā nēé gē nwū uwɔ ā, í tú uwɔ abɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́. Ká ācɛ nēe jé odée lɛyíkwu aínyílɔ́wɔ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, nēe klla gē miya ɔkpáncō ígwíígwu, gē da uwɔ ŋmá ɔyā ga ɔyā ɔdā nōo gáā yá uwɔ ā, kéē wā í lɛ uwɔ nyatá mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó má mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó pó ā, nōó cīijáalí kú nū á, nááná ā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē mīyɛ ijáalí kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpó uwā yíífi. Umósīsi ka anúɔ ī pi uwá ahɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ka ɛ́ɛ gáā lɛ́cɛ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú Ujɔ́dan nɛ̄ uwá nyɔ̄ gáā mīyɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí, aígabɔ̄, aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla odúúdú ayí kú Udéfīdi ohile ā, cokónu ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je odúúdú ijē kú nū ā yɔlá ɛyí ede ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē je ijē kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú olétɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ ā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí ā bīya ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú íne nōó bīya ā ú yá ɔ́ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ikpēyī kú uwɔ í cɛ̄ gā awɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́, lɛ ɔ́ wú tónū! O lɔhi ga awɔ fíyɛ́ ká ā le tá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɛga nāa géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó mla ikpēyī ékpó, ikɔkɔ nāa géē bī ikpēyī ɛplɛ́ɛpa, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú uwɔ ú tɛ́ɛcɛ ga ipú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ fu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífayi ŋmá odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ piyóó á.

eng_Latn: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umála, Utirísa, Uhɔ́gla, Umílika, mɛ́mla Unówa, lɛ ɔbá lɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
idu_Latn: É bī ɛlā nēe bá ā ɔkābɔ̄fú le ɛya nēé gáā gwó lɛ uwá ā ci.

eng_Latn: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔtū yɔ̄ í wú um nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔtū le bīya gā um nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú anyā ōcɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā ú kpó bá ɔbū. Ulɛ́ya mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū kwúcē uwá, Urécɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu tá ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a gē gbā Ɔwɔicó ā, a cíkā ō lɔtūce ɔ́. Abɔ̄ a kē ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā, a cíkā ō leyīce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.
idu_Latn: Aá pó, aálagbá mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɛ̄ aá kpó kwú ŋmá Ujúda ā wɛ ayínɛ́ aá nɛ̄ n. Aá mā uwā tá kéē kwúcē ga Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm, ámāŋ Óndú ā géē bī íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi lɛ yá aá italā.

eng_Latn: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ alɔ kē tá uwɔ ohi ka ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā í habɔ̄ ádā nū tá wā glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ koó le yá lɛ ā, ádā nū í kwú.

eng_Latn: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe bá nyā, ma āyā alɛwa kú ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā dúú. Uréhum, ɔyí kú Ubáni ma ɔdɔ gboce Unehemíya, Uhasábīya, otrɛ̄yí kú āyā éyi kú ajɛ Ukeyíla ma āyā kú ɔdɔ kwɛyí ācɛ ipɔ́lɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ ā ka, eko ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ tɛtɛ da uwá ka, anúɔ ōfōōfū anúɔ í bī uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
