idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ īkpɔ̄cí olɔhi āa, a géē lɛ ɔcí olɔhi. A géē lɛ īkpɔ̄cí obɔ̄bí ɔ́dāŋ ka lɛ ɔcí obɔ̄bí. É gē jé ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcí ŋmá ɛdɔ īkpō nōó gē gwá ā.

eng_Latn: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
idu_Latn: Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Ubáasēya, Umálkīja.

eng_Latn: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nɛ, ó ī ŋmō ācobɔ̄bíipū ɛ̄pɔ̄bí eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da alɔ ka alɔ híī gwó inu ŋ́, hɛ́hɔ̄ ŋ́, hɛ́hɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin ŋ́. Amáŋ aá kóō lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ piyóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē yēeyī ligbó ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá wɛ aúgbɔga ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
idu_Latn: Usára le ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ Ébrahām eko nōó le hīlókplīcī ā. Ó mɔyí ā eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ka ɔ́ɔ géē ma ā.

eng_Latn: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
idu_Latn: N gáā je igbō amáŋ éŋkpɔ̄, amáŋ ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ um ŋmó kú ɔnwū álá ō wā kú um ā lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ń jé ɛga nēé ŋmá ā ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the LORD, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da alɛɛcɛ kahíníī, Ojīlīmā ō le ce Ɔwɔicō wɛ íjéeyī á. Ucē obɔ̄bí ō mā ɔ̄ tá ō yá kē wɛ ɛyí odée ō jé á.

eng_Latn: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ā gā Ujerúsālɛm kóō kpó ācɛ abɔ́ɔ ŋmó ā, Óndú ā le ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ lɛyíkwu italā ō yá ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Mā uwá tá. Ó jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klá ɛga nēé í wú igwu kú Arawúna, ɔ̄cɛ Ujɛ́būsi ā.

eng_Latn: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔtū kú um pīya kwu ká n̄ jé ɔdā mɛ́mla o kllɔcɛ́ ɔdā ō jé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n jéeyī. N klla lɛ ɔ́ pīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛlā kú alɛɛcɛ. N le má ka ɔ́bíipú wɛ ɔdāhá, íla kē wɛ ɛ́lɛ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le tá ipú ɛga nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ é tíne ō gā ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, é géē je odúúdú úwé mɛ́mla īlī kú Ɔwɔicō nēé gē bī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā kpó pla bá ipú aínu nyā piíí. É í kpó īlī ɔhá wiiyē gbɔbū kéē ga ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ jīla bá eyīyɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ayááyí ɔ́mɛtá kú ācɛ aéwo ɔ́ɔmā, nyɔ̄ ɔbū ā, ka ɛ́ɛ géē gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá wɛ ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛhīlī ā wɛ Ubukíya.

eng_Latn: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn bī úklábɔ̄fú le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū. Ó klla bī úklɔ́ ā le kpó ajɛ tū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla bī uwā le tū ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhásɔ, Umegído mɛ́mla Ugɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ igbō ā bī gē lɛ anúɔ ɛgiyí agōdō kú anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le tá anúɔ okónu abɔ̄yīnū. Anɔ́ɔ Utáma kwú igbō ú le tá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tú alɔ ɔtūlé ipú odúúdú unwalu kú alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ lɔfú bī ɛdɔ kú ɔtū otúlé ɔ́ɔmā le tú ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá ipú ɛdɔ kú unwalu dóódu ā ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā le pɛ́ cīgbīhi anɔ́ɔ é le inya kwu lɛyíkwu ɛgiyí ɛcɔ̄ kú Urímon ā. Ísrɛ̄lu le ācɛ ulá igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofigwó kú uwā ŋmó ɔwɛ. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nū uwā inya jāā ga Ugídɔm, klla le úlā ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā ŋmó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aísu ā í pīya oyī, ohīgbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ kú Íjīpiti í má éŋkpɔ̄ gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, eko nɛ̄ Ébrahām gbā éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā, ācɛ Ulífāyi nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā mīyɛ éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā kē gbā ɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nāa lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu kéē gaá lɛ ɛfú kpó tá aólɛlā kú uwā, eko nēé leyī pīya kwu igelī nɛ̄hi a nɛ̄ a fu ā mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gwó gā uwɔ nyā, ɛga dúúmā nēé kōō bá nááná.

eng_Latn: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
idu_Latn: Ɔnɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī jé ā í cɛ̄ gā um háyi icō kpaakpa glá ŋ́. N yɔ̄ ī jikwū eko dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yēkwu ā.

eng_Latn: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Ulában le ka kahíníī, Odúúdú aɛ́wū ohíkākā ā géē wɛ ulé kú uwɔ á nɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aɛ́wū ā gē ma ayí ohíkākā. Ɔ́dāŋ koó klla ka, Aɛ́wū ōtína cílɛ́cílɛ́ géē wɛ ulé kú uwɔ á nɛɛ, odúúdú aɛ́wū ā kē í ma ayí otína cílɛ́cílɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ogbló fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛyí, é tá ahɛ klá anú, é lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
idu_Latn: yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ā kahíníí, Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá má ayí kú Ulífāyi ācogwɛ́ɛya ā nēe bī ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā, kwū ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ajɛ, aá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɛ cɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔyí uwɔ nɛ, wā gaá tá um abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Usírīya nēe bá yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́fú kwu um ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi le anyākwɔ́cɛ fu ipú icɔ́ɔci dóódu, anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le okónu gwū le ɔkɔ gbā le Ɔwɔicō ā, é le ācɛ ā kpó tū Ondú nēé lɔtūce ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, abālɔbányā a gē kɛlā pélúú, nɛ̄ ó kē wɛ ācīije gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū oŋmɔ́cī ɔ́mɛtá, anɔ́ɔ ó le yá kóō lɛ iyī nū mafú.

eng_Latn: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē já āyā éyi ŋmá ipú ɛtá kú uwā nēe hile ā má. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē na uwá péee bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nēé gē bī ɔlá le na oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ móōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ bī ōwē ɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwá yá yéŋēē. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó ka é géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ anúɔ, anúɔ kē í tá ūwā ohi. Ó ka anúɔ géē da uwá ka é wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē lɛ okónu cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ akpáŋdēde ɛhɔ̄ nēé gē je lá ɔkɔ́bɔ ɛpa ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Náána Ɔwɔicō í mlanyī ō leyīkwu éyééye kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
idu_Latn: Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, ogbló kú nū, ɔdā ō klá anú ɛyí, mɛ́mla ɛga ocīce kú eyīnyinyi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwúcē ga ígbíli kú Udamáskɔ̄si, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ bēhé ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ anɔ̄ tū Uhásɛ̄lu ɛyí kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya.

eng_Latn: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla alɔ ā, alɔ géē yálé piíí. Ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yá aólɛlā kú alɔ lé.

eng_Latn: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ̄ ucē kú ɔyínɛ uwɔ nāa ī yá á, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē bī okoolo kú ōwē nɛ̄ n miya lɛ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ā i miya gā uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ikpɛ̄cí kú Umɔ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔwɔ Uréfan nɛ̄ aá kpó nyɔ̄ á, aójibó kú ɛcí nɛ̄ aá yá ká aá gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā á. Ó lɛ ā, n géē nū aá ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā, aá nēé lɛ aá na yēŋēē ā, aá kē gbɔɔ́ ō yíihɔtū ɔkwɛ̄yi tá ayínɛ́ aá dúú ɛɛ́. Aá yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa aá ŋmá ɔtū ékpó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú aá jɛ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aɔ́dā ɔhá nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe ī pi ajɛ dúú ā wɛ ɔdēelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē wɔ́tū ɔkpíyē kú nū ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó gē bī iyē kú nū lɔɔ́lɔhi klla gē leyīkwu ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē yá mla icɔ́ɔci yíílí á.

eng_Latn: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ijaló, yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē da uwá kéē yá mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Oklóbīya um, abɔ̄ ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a wā amānyā nɛ̄ a kē lɛ úwé kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā wiyē ŋ́ mā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
idu_Latn: N gē jikwū ācɛ kú Usíbma fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú Ujésa. Igelī kú Usíbma, ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin, nōo tá ābɔ̄ gla ísu kú ɔmā ā jāā gáā kwu Ujésa ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī bīya odée ā kwú odúúdú īkpɔ́cí kú uwɔ í yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
idu_Latn: nā á lɛ ɛlá wu ɛlā dúúmā nɛ̄ n gē nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kōō ī cɛ̄ gā um nā uwɔ tɔ́ɔwɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔcɛ́ éyi bī aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofucɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gáā kpɛ́fú tá ɔcɛ́ ɔhá nōo bī aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofɛpa cigwó, ɔ́cɛ ɔ́ɔmā cīce aflɛ́yí cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ miya kóō le jé ɔ́dāŋ ka aícɔ́ɔja kú nū lɛwa jɛ̄ ō leyī méyī mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ ɔhá ā glá.

eng_Latn: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le pó keé le adá kú anúɔ iyē nyílá klla le uwēyī je lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ ohígbū ka ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū bá ipácí mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ ā, ó tíne ō ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nēé le pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ayí omlede mɛ́mla ayí ɛwū ā kpó ŋmó ā, ācɛ Ulífāyi ā le ɛbɛ́ ā kpó wā, klla le ɔkpá tá ŋmá aɛ́bɛ́ iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú oyī kú uwā í mī klá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ ā le jɛ̄ ā, Ísɔ kwú pīya ofītɛ́ nɛ̄hi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ipácí eko dóódu. Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yɔ̄cíí, nōo gē klá ɔlɛ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
idu_Latn: Étīni, Uséra, Adáya.

eng_Latn: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó wɛ awɔ, da um ká n̄ yɛ eyī éŋkpɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Íkwu kú Umówābu ā mɛ ɛɛ́. Ó kē lɔfú dúúmā gɛ ŋ́. É kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi ɛɛ́. Ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ŋgbá ácá ɛpa gɔ́ kwu ɛ́fɔ̄du ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó kwu aáklō kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō playi anú glá.

eng_Latn: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe he um ɔtū, nɛ̄ n gē dɛ̄gba tū uwā, klla gē yá uwā italā dúú á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá cēyītīkwū ká aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá ī bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
idu_Latn: Ó le eyīpú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā yá mla ukɔ́tin nɛ̄hɛ́. Ābɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ ā, olīkpō kú ukɔ́tin ā wɛ uyádi ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn cɛ̄ lɛ uwa bī oje ɔdɔ le hijā tū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā dúú. Ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla ɛga nēé gē lɛ igbō kú ɛya nēé gē gwó ā ce ā wɛ ugóolu.

eng_Latn: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔkɔ kú opo a yɔ̄ ī gɔbū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, Umósīsi lɛ ɛlā ka, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō bī akpáabana le ohi tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́nɛ́ um kóō ma um ā, Óndú ā lɛ um fu. Ó kwú um ú pīya ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēe pahīla klá ɛcɛ ā, kpó kwúcē igbīhi wā gé lɛ ɔ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ojīlīma ce um, kllá lɛ ɔfú kú nū tū um iyē á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā yá íkpékwīija kú aɔ́wɔ dóódu lɛ iyí aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ nyɔ̄ í da uwá kéē é kwúcē ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ōfíyajɛ kú um. Anú klla ī nya um tá á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ń gáā yúufi ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
idu_Latn: Aígelī ɛhīlī nyā í wɛ ɛga o kwinya-ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ kú aá, mɛ́mla aéwɔhá mɛ́mla aúgbɔga nēe lā mla aá. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í jégēdēē ŋ́ le ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ó géē kwu nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú cɔ̄nū mla uwá. Ó le aɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ayípōklóbīya olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kú ípɔ́ɔnū kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
idu_Latn: É kpó ɔtā mɛ́mla ōbō mɛ́mla ɔkpacāŋ́gelī tū abɔ̄. É lɔnɔɔtū, í klla í ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. É ce aɔ́nya kú uwá bá ī wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu ā. É le tútū ɛfú ō kpó tú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko gē wā nɛ̄ n géē gbo ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu gbɛlá ka ɔ́ lɔhi ō bī ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwúcē igbīhi hī aá tá Upamfilíya, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá yúklɔ́ mla aá ŋ́ mā tɔ́ɔkwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bī ɔ̄ wā ɛyí ede ā, lɛ ɔ́ ɔkɔ nya gbiílí, lɛ ɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí fu cáa. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú īkpɛ̄yí ā ú yɔlá ɛyí ede ā. É géē pī oyī kú nū klá ákló kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)
idu_Latn: Ó je ɔnyā yá kóō je héyīfuú nɛ̄hi kóō kwú jɔ̄ɔ̄nyā kwɛyí ā, gē je iháyí odunkulu. É gē lē anɔ̄ kú umáari nya ɔ́ iyē ɔyā ɛhīlī. É kē ī lɛ anɔ̄ kú ubásam nya ɔ́ iyē, ɔyā ɛhīlī kpɔ́. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē je ɔ̄cɛnyā éyééye gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, kóō je ɔ̄cɛ nōo jɔ́ncɛ́nyā fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋmá ipú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄cɛnyā ɔ́ɔmā ú yá ɔcányā kú nū.

eng_Latn: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá Ujanówa wā ajɛ, ó gaá bū Atárɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Unáara, bū Ujérīko gaá ŋmɛ́yí Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aɔ́nya o tína poópoó ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, é bá ī nwúleyīkwū kéē nyɔ̄ í jila ɛcɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛcɛ jila. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ nyɔ̄ í le ɛcɛ jila á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. le ɔlɛɛcɛ ā ŋmíyɔ̄lā lipú lipú. Eko nōó yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā, Ɔwɔicō kwú ikpokwú kú íkélí kú nū éyi ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgiyí nū gwū mɛ́mla ícɛ̄bɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn wɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ubɛ́la, Ássibɛ́lu mɛ́mla Ahíram.

eng_Latn: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē kpó aólɛlā kú aá kwúcē wā ŋmá Ubássan. N géē kpó uwá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɔkɛkɛlɛ kú itekwū.

eng_Latn: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
idu_Latn: Aíkpēyī kú nū klla lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka, aókóho ɛpa nēe le iyē gwá ipú enyāmɛ̄ nēe bá pī ɔkpá nōo yɔ̄ í pɛ́ wulɛ́wulɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi nēe ŋmá ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā wɛ úlā ofu ɛpa ce úlā igwáahāapa ce ofu igwó . É le uwā kɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí hī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā tá, ohígbū kaé gáā je ajɛ lɛ uwá ipú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
idu_Latn: Usisɛ́ra kwú okwúukwu í kwu ajɛ, má gwōnū pī ikpō kú ɔnyā, anɔ́ɔ ó má tá cíí gekwú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē ka ka n géē yá kéē móōwē nɛ̄hi, nēé kē gáā kwu ŋmá anú glá ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, eko nēé ī jikwū klá um kú otábɔ̄, n gáā tá uwā ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá í lé ŋmá ipú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe lā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ á. Ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú éŋkpɔ̄, nōo lɛ acá mɛ́mla āpū, aá géē lɔfú lé.

eng_Latn: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
idu_Latn: Le da uwá ka, ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ká n géē ŋmó ita ɔ́ɔmā ɛyí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā kwu ita ɔ́ɔmā Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ le ka lɛ uwá ka eko ā gā ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ dóódu nēé má ā géē cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
idu_Latn: Aá pó ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī ményinyi ācɛ lɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Épafrāsi, ocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpā alɔ, nōo wɛ ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ kú ɔtōōkpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwɛyí alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
idu_Latn: Awɔ je ɔfú ga um ká n kpɛ́fú tú aólɛlā kú um á. Awɔ kē je ɔfú ga um ká n bū ɔdɔ kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ uwā bēhé á.

eng_Latn: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
idu_Latn: Ba ɛ̄ba ŋmá ɛgiyí um, n kē í je odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nyā gā uwɔ ká ā gbō uwā, odúúdú ɛcɛ kē í je pīya ákú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
idu_Latn: É gē lɛ ikpó da ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mla ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ɛyí tāajɛ. É klla gē kwu aógbɛhá ga okónu ogwu ŋmá ɔwɛ hīli iyī uwā. Ádā mla ɔyí gē cikpó ɔfiyɛ nɔnya ékpónú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ é le uwēyi je lɛ iye otīīhɔ kú um ā á.

eng_Latn: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ lɔfú kwú kpó wúlatāajɛ glá, ihɔtū kú um lɛyíkwu uwɔ í gáā mɛ gbóógbóō ŋ́. N géē le okónu nɛ̄ n ce mɛ́mla awɔ ka n géē je ɛbɔ́ ga uwɔ ā tū piyóo. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo yíihɔtū uwɔ ā ka ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
idu_Latn: Ā híī mīyābɔ̄ ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka anɔ́ɔ géē cílá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Umówābu, aá blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá kpó Uwúuu tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu āa? Aá yá uwá ōwē bɛ̄ɛka aúwī nēé kwú bá ī wūwī ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
idu_Latn: A bī ojuja le bī uwá tá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. A klla bī ɔlá ofíyajɛ le ma ɔwɛ fú lɛ uwá otú.

eng_Latn: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhússāyi oklóbīya Udéfīdi ā kwúcē ga ipú igelī ā, eko nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ ī wā ipú igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm bōōbū ā á.

eng_Latn: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī gɛcɛ ā, e má ɔ̄cɛ Usayiríni éyi, nēé hī ka Usáyímɔ̄ni. É lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú kóō bī ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
idu_Latn: Blakwu ɛka kú nū piyóó. Ɛlā dúú nōó ka ā háyi piyóó.

eng_Latn: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tīkpó mla anú ā le tá ipú úgbéenyi ŋmá Upáfɔ̄si gā Upága, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Upamfilíya, ɛga nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni habɔ̄ uwā tá, klla kwúcē le tá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
idu_Latn: N géē je ayígodó kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō gā uwɔ. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ a le gbō ɛcɛ nyā, é géē gbō ɔ̄ ɔkpáncō. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ā kē le wī ɛcɛ nyā, é géē wī ɔ̄ ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
idu_Latn: Átasásɛsi le aɔ́kpá nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́kpá nɛ̄hi ā. Ó jé odée lɛyíkwu íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú Óndú nōó je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo le wulɔwulɔ, í kē kwɔ́lá ŋ́ ámáŋ kē hīlaŋdɔ́ ŋ́ mā, n géē tá aá tónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē tá éŋkpɔ̄ nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
idu_Latn: Ó le bēhé ga ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā igbo ékpó ōfōōfūnū, ó bī oyī kú ɛwū mɛ́mla ákú ɔbá ɛna gaá le gwɛ́ɛya ŋ́. Ikɔɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú oyī kú abɔ̄yī nū ú gwɛ́ɛya, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā nōó yá ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō le alɔ nyatá piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú ɔlɛ́ ā le tá ɛcɛ ɛgiyí uwā gaá da uwá ka, ehée, aóklóbīya anúɔ kéē kóocōō kéē híī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ugbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó tū ile ŋ́ mā ú tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú obū. Ó géē jikwū í hīla aīnu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi je le Usólómɔn, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē le hídáagó kú nū. Óndú ā klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le lóofu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛgahi fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔbá nū, Ujósɛ̄fu, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ íne tū ā nááná ā, ó tíne ō juwēyi lɛ Umerí ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó tíne ō tá ɔ̄ wɛɛlɛ á.

eng_Latn: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ipú ɛcɛ ā, aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;
idu_Latn: O lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nōo tū aá ɛhɔ̄ ā, ɛlā nɛ̄ ami Óndú, Ɔwɔicó kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ā yɔ̄ á, a le ɛlā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā pó.

eng_Latn: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nōó cāŋjɛ, kwu aɔ́wɔ ā géē yúufi. É klla ī je kwu hɛ̄ ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ofɛpa le yɛ ā, ó má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá nōo gē yi ɛyí ácí ipú ígbíli pī ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi.

eng_Latn: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá ígbíli kú Usíni ā gaá lā Udɔ́fka.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ olíla nēé má ɔdā dúúmā ŋ, amáŋ yɔ̄ ī ka ákú odo kú uwā ā le jí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ayí kú Ukɔháti ā géē gbɔɔ́ kéē nyɔ̄ mla aɔ́dā otīihɔ nēé bī ā. Ɛ́ɛ́ kéē wā ajɛ ɛga ɔhá nēé gáā lā ā, é géē lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gwó kwaajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ éyi kú uwá yɔ̄ í hɛ́ ɔcí ā, āgā kú nū kwú wú ga ipú enyi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá ā, n kē ba āgā nyā ŋmá ɛga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtū tá odúúdú aíne kú uwɔ, uwēyī í gáā kwú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dúúmā nāa kwú owu kú uwɔ ú lɛ uwá nɛɛ, a klla lɛ uwá yá kú oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kóō klla gbo ɔ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
idu_Latn: Ó le aícɔ́ɔja kpó bá aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda nēé hɛ́ igá o lɔfú tū uwā ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ádā nū nú ŋmá abɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī má um ká ā ményinyi um. Ká ā lɛ um nyatá ohígbū ihɔtū kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ó ī cá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu lā ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā nū. Ujósɛ̄fu wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ cigwó.

eng_Latn: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka anúɔ kpó uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti á, ó ka anúɔ klla hɛ́ uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá dóódu nēe bá gē pīya uwá tū ā.

eng_Latn: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē nyi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá gē cē.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Le da uwá ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ɔ́ɔ géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ede o je tū Óndú abɔ̄ ā, wā ɛ̄cī éyééye ipú ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔ̄cɛ yā gbla īyī nū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū lɛ ā nōó yá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā ā gbla á.

eng_Latn: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā dúúmā nōo le jɔ̄nyā klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ókóme nēé lɛ eliká kú ugóolu wu ɔ́ ɛnwū ā.

eng_Latn: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú nū klla le aɔ́dāajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā da lɛ ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi kéē lé dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē leyīkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, Uhilkíya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, Usekaríya, Ujɛ́hīyɛlu, le aálá úlā ɛhīlī cofigwó mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó lɛ ācɛ kéē bī le yá ucɛ kú ɛya ōgwó ā.

eng_Latn: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá gbla ucē kú um yá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gbla ucē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́wá kú ācɛ o hɛ́ éjulúgwu nēe gē bá ī gbēyī ācɛ ɔhá ɔwɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kōō ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ yɛ ga Usɛ́kɛm ɛga otīihɔ ɔ́ɔmā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ jégēdē bá gē yá ɛdɔ ɔdā ōbɔ̄bí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́dā je kéē lɛ Ujeremíya gɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú agbá ú kwu ɔ́ wāajɛ ɛgiyí okómpinu kú Ubénjamīn kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā otūufi í wā í klla anú wuu bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī kpó ɔlɛ́ ā. Ofulúutu nɛ̄hi géē wā í je ɔ́ nyɔ̄ otú.

eng_Latn: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā le ɔ́ hɛ́tá, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá agbá.

eng_Latn: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō le ɔwɛ nōó í mīyɛ alɔ wā ɛgiyí nū ā mafú ɛɛ́. Íne ā í lɛ ɔdā dúú ō yá mla ɔwɛ ā ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā wɛ ijáalí kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ eko nēé géē je Ujísɔ̄si gicō ga ɔkpáncō ā yɔ̄ gē wā ajaajɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔtū kú nū yéékpó ka anúɔ géē ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohī kú aá, ácí olɔhi nɛ̄ aá gē lé ā, í jɛ̄ aá ŋ́, amáŋ aá gē lɛ ikpó da aɛ́nɛ̄ aá lé ŋ́ mā tāajɛ. Aá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ oyēŋēē gwá klla kwú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo hile ā í bū gbɔdɔɔ.

eng_Latn: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
idu_Latn: ācɛ Ujúda gaá le ɛfú kpó tɔ̄há ta ācɛ Ukénan ā á. Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ācɛ Ukénan mɛ́mla ācɛ Upɛ́risi kpó yálé. Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ ulá ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā yálé ipú ajɛ kú Ubɛ́sēki.

eng_Latn: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, aá híī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē ka ka aá lɛ alelékwū ā ŋ́, amáŋ aá lɛ uwá jámá, ká aá jé ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alelékwū nēe lɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ alɛwa le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
idu_Latn: É le eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa ɔhá yá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kwu ɛháajɛ kú iyɔ̄bū kú ɔ́ŋgbá acá ɛpa kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā. Ó kwu ɛga nēé gɔ́ īlī ɛpa kwɔhá ā, nōo yɔ̄ icō kú ɔdōkwɛ́nyɔ́ nēé tá lɔɔlɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
idu_Latn: Alɔ í cīgbīhi kwu uwɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē bīya íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há hábɔ̄ tá ɛyí ajɛ olɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ é gwá īkpō, aóhī ofɛhɔ̄, aóhī ofɛtá, ɔhá kē wɛ ofucigwó.

eng_Latn: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í hī alɔ igwú kú alɔ gwutá mla ɔnyā ɔhá gwū ɔnyā alɔ tá ŋ́, amáŋ ká alɔ lā oyēeyī ō tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
idu_Latn: Ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā tá uwā ohi ka oyá ɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ géē gbō uwā glá ā, ayíka anúɔ í gáā yá anɔ̄ kú anúɔ̄ nēé gē bī le je ojīlīma lɛ aɔ́wɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā, glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu bá ícɛ nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā kú uwɔ ka lɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ɔdā dúúmā nēe bá ā gē ce uwɔ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
idu_Latn: Íbha, Ɛlíssūwa, Unéfɛ̄gi, Ujáfīya.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ká ɛ́ɛ lé ucɛ ā mɛ́mla ayí uwā, ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi, aéwɔhá ayókwū mɛ́mla anyōkwū nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō gē gbo akpáabana nōo ī hí idáago ō pó. Ó gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɔ í jɛ́yí nū dúúdú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú yá nyā tá tū ɔkpá gbēyī ayí igbīhi nēe ī wā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ayááyí nēé ma ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, géē cɛ̄tra Óndú.

eng_Latn: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɔfú kú um lɛ yá uwā italā bū ipú aɔ́dōōbɔ̄bí ō tūufi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n géē yá abɔ́ɔ ā. Igbīhi nū ā, ó géē cɛ̄ kú aá nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla aɛ́ga olipú kú itekwú, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ubatísim yá Ujísɔ̄si kwɛyí ā, ó le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú éŋkpɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔkpáncō le nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó má Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ gaá ce ɔ́ ɛyí lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í je ōhī kú anɔ̄ kú ólīifu ā cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ tū ɔtābɔ̄ kú abɔlúfīyē.

eng_Latn: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ka lɛ uwá bū okónu kú Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, kwú yá jīla. Ajɛ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú aá géē tá alácɛ̄ iháyí ofɛtá cigwó, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ kú usábāti nɛ̄ aá húmáyī í je lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mā lɛ.

eng_Latn: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
idu_Latn: N gē gwutá, amáŋ ń gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́. N klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ nōo ce ajīlɛ̄yí inu ōfōōfūnū ā.

eng_Latn: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā nāa í mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwá yɔ̄ á, ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, N géē je íjééyī kú ācojéeyī gbliífi. N kē í tá ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ojɔ́ɔda jé ā.

eng_Latn: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔtūlé jāā ga ámōōmɛ ā nēé géē nyatá á.

eng_Latn: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔlɛcɛ, awɔ ā kóō pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ga uwɔ ā. Ā yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā ŋ́. Lɛ okónu kú uwɔ nwūla cɛ́ɛ́ ká a lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā je gā uwɔ nyā lé.

eng_Latn: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ éeyē kú ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí í gē gboji ŋ́ lɛ ā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá gáā mīyɛ ɔkwu uwā.

eng_Latn: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ó kōō cē tíne kóō jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɛyíkwu ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gē gwō kú ɔdā nēé yá ā, n géē yá lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujohánan da ɔ́ wɛɛlɛ kahíníī, N nyɔ̄ gaá kwú Íssmɛ̄lu ú ŋmó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ alɔ géē je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō kwú uwɔ ú ŋmó āa? Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā géē cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe túbá jīla uwɔ tá nyā je kpó pahīla kpɔ́. Ɔ́ɔmā kē ī cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile Ujúda ā je yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujonátan mɛ́mla Ahímāasi le pɛ́ tayínū okónu ɔkpá kú Enrōgɛlu, nōo yɔ̄ okónōgwu kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. É bɔ́tū tá īyī uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ uwá má yɔ̄ gē béhé ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́. Ó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā éyi nōo gē bī ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ā gé lɛ uwá ojigógó, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē nyɔ̄ ī ka lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kpɛ́fú tá uwá Ubaalperásim, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá yálé. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō bī um le bū olɛlā kú um ipú bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē cēenyi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka, Ubaalperásim á.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ íne bīya, ŋmá lɛ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne kéē híī yá ŋ́ mā, nōó jégēdē bīya íne ā ŋ́. Ɔdā nōó géē yá ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā kóō yɛ ɔkwu ká alɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā ká alɔ cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū a kahíníī, Lɛ Umikáya kwú, káā kwú ɔ̄ ú gé lɛ Ámɔn igbómína kú Usamérīya mɛ́mla Ujówāssi, ɔyí ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī je ɛbɔ́ ā kóō lɛ odúúdú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá cɛgbá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔdā nōó tíne kú aá yá ā kpó lɛ aá. Ká Ujísɔ̄si kóō tá aá abɔ̄ ká aá yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā. Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si o ŋmá eko tá eko. Aamí.

eng_Latn: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
idu_Latn: Áluka iháyí dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yēeyī gāá kwu lɛ, óō gwéeyē kú odúúdú nū, kóō tá ahínyá. Amáŋ, aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ka eko nāa gáā yɔ̄ ɔlékwū ā ligbō klla lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɛ̄cī kú oyēeyī á. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá ipú ūpū kú Ulɛ́banɔn ā í jɛ̄ ō le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú alɔ ŋ́. Odúúdú aɔ́cí kú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā le nyɛ́ ō bī gwó ɔlá kú ɛya ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N wɛ Ujɔ́ni ɔyínɛ̄ aá. Bɛ̄ɛka aá, n wɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe ī móōwē klla ī lɔ́tū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ō ī yá ācɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. É kwú um tá idɔ kú Upátīmɔsi, ohígbū ka n cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ, klla kē ka ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ otɔ́sú kú Ussɛ́ba, Udɛ́dan géē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ka, A lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ túbá ká ē nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ācɛ, wúla ɔlɛ́ uwā tāajɛ ká ē kpó uwā iyó wu ɛɛ́? A gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē kpó ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, aɔ́dāajɛ mɛ́mla agbénú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔgwā le gbo ā, Unebúkádinēsa gaá le Ujehóyākim kwú ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga agbá Ubábīlɔn. Ó klla le odúúdú agbénú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ga ɔlɛ́ nū Ubábīlɔn. Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa kwú Usɛdɛkíya ɔmáapú ádā kú Ujehóyākim ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ínyílɔ́wɔ ā lé ka ɛ́lɛ. Anɔ́ɔ āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā gbɔɔ́ ō hɔ́ɔnɔ á. Ācɛ alɛwa nēe gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā le pɛ́ gekwú ohígbū kóō le hɔ́ɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɔhi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ, ó klla ī ményīnyi kú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá ka, ó géē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ uwá fíyaa fíyaa. Amáŋ Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē má ācɛ nēe lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́ eko nōó kwúcē wā aa.

eng_Latn: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: É géē bī éŋkpɔ̄ nyā le na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ámāŋ eko nēé túblá ede, kéē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdōlé lɛ Óndú ā, é géē kwú.

eng_Latn: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kú Ɔwɔicō gē je íjééyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á. Ɔdōjé mɛ́mla o jɛ́yí kú ɔdā ŋmá okónu kú nū nɛ.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá tútū lɔhi ká aá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā icííci lɛbɛɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē hí ajɛ nōó húmáyī hí ŋ́ o yá kóō híī nyī ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tū ipú ácí ujē áncā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔyī kú nū tá kwu um iyē kli.

eng_Latn: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ó cíkā ká ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra uwɔ Usáyɔn gbóó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce ā yá jīla gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā í wɛ ákú um ŋ́, amáŋ ákú Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
idu_Latn: Aá nya cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɔ̄ gē pīyatɔ̄há mla iyī aá kpɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yá ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ aá oŋmá lɛ ɛbɔ́ nōó je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ aá gáā kɔ́ anyā kú Uhíbru dúúmā ɔma, nɛ̄ aá má ka ɔyí ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ, aá le ɔ́ ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā, aá mā ɔ̄ tá kóō yēeyī.

eng_Latn: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le mafú lɛ odúúdú aéwɔhá ā ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā ŋ́ mā, n géē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋmá ipú ajɛ aéwɔhá mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwá lā ā.

eng_Latn: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā géē jé odée nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ɔfú kú Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē mu ísu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā, gē bū ɛdɔ aɔ́cí o gwíīkpō ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, é géē bá ī jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ kú aɔ́cí nēé hī upɔmegrɛ́nēeti nōo ī gwá īkpō olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Īkpō kú Uhéna mɛ́mla Unádi í gáā ŋá abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ úklɔ́ kú um ká n̄ kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Ācɛ nōo bá ipú icɔ́ɔci ā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā á.

eng_Latn: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ussɛ́ba mɛ́mla Uráma kpó aɛ́cɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá, ugóolu mɛ́mla aɔ́tulalī ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ le cílá uwɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ nēé lá ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɔ̄kā ka, Aɔ́wɔ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá lɔtū ce ā bá iní gɛ.

eng_Latn: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó géē tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N gáā hɛ́ aá tá glá nóó. Ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um, í kē lɛ́ ɔdōlé ámāŋ ka īlī ŋ́ dúú. Aá kóō híī je um yá otrɛ̄yí kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Adónīja da ɔ́ kahíníī, A jé ka ami géē yɛ í lɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á, odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu kōō leyīce lɛ ā dúú. Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā miya ɔ́ lɛ ā, ɔcɛ́ le pīya yɛ í ce ɔyínɛ́ um anɔ́ɔ ó kē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
idu_Latn: Udéfidi klla ma ayí ahāanɛ ɔhá. Iyē kú uwā kē bá yɔ̄ á: Ibíha, Ɛlíssūwa, Ɛlipélēti.

eng_Latn: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile nēe bá gē lé ɔdōlé ā gbɔɔ́ ō da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ā, nōo kōō ī je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi glá ā.

eng_Latn: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
idu_Latn: Ká ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, ɛdɔ kú okónu ō ce ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá kú úgwū ō tá ā. Ɛ̄nyā lɛ ā ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔkpá kú úgwū ā géē kwú gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔkpá kú úgwū ā kóō lɔfú tīile glá.

eng_Latn: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
idu_Latn: Ucē okpaakpa ō yá gē je éwo dóódu gicō, amáŋ ínoōbīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú wɛ uwēyī lɛ ācɛ kú éwo dóódu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó gaá le íbɔm cē tū Usamérīya jila tá.

eng_Latn: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛta ā wɛ Uhárim, ɔ́mɛɛnɛ wɛ Usórim.

eng_Latn: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.
idu_Latn: Umíka da ɔ́ kóō lā mɛ́mla anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ o nwū anúɔ ɛlā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú anúɔ. Ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē cíla ɔ́ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó ipú iháyí. Ka anúɔ klla í kpó īlī mɛ́mla ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le obugā nēé bū eko kú Ébrahām nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya kpó gwū eko nɛ̄ Ébrahām gekwú ā, kpó bu kpɔ́. Iyē nɛ̄ ádā nū tɛtɛ kpó ce aóbugā ā nɛ̄ Áyísīki kpó ce uwá dúú á.

eng_Latn: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
idu_Latn: Ɛhá géē wā í klá awɔ bɛ̄ɛka uwī ā. Úkpa géē bī uwɔ ká, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ohéjulúgwu ā.

eng_Latn: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
idu_Latn: A le um yá lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛyī ā, a klla le ɔhā hɛ́ ce um mla éeyē.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
idu_Latn: É le ikwū je klá Óndú, ipú unwalu kú uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú ákanya kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a le alɔ jámá, le alɔ na ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá ge jé oje nɛhɛ́ má ā.

eng_Latn: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá ā le kpaakpa klla le yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tíne lɛ ā, ohígbū ka, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ó yá ohígbū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, lɛyíkwu íne ō le tū mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā nēé gbā Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
idu_Latn: N klla jɛ́yí ɔdā fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī nwū um odée ā, ohígbū ka n gē gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gē gbā ije nyā kwɛyí oyēeyī kú uwā ā, ɔ̄cɛ o gbagbénú í gáā gbā fíyɛ́ ŋ́ mā a, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ogbɛhá kē gáā gbā nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
idu_Latn: Kwú ukɔ́tin ā ú playi ɛháajɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ uwɔ ā hɔ́gba ɛyí agbalú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Kwú ikpati kú Okónu ō ce nɛ̄ isiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ nēé tá íne tū ɔ̄ ā ú háyi igbīhi ukɔ́tin ā. Ukɔ́tin ā géē kɔ̄ ɛga nōo tíihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋmá ɛga o tīihɔ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ahímɔ̄tu mɛ́mla ayí kú ayí uwā wɛ, Ɛlkána, Usófāyi, Unáhāti.

eng_Latn: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá le jé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Óndú ā, aá yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe le pīyatɔ̄há mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
idu_Latn: É géē yá íkókwū ifa bɛ̄ɛka ohépu kú ododó kú ɔcí nēé hī álumɔ̄ndu mɛ́mla oōnwūla kú ododó kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú yá Ɔwɔicō ɛhi gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō í cíla ɔ̄ ulé nū ā.

eng_Latn: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ālɔ̄ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá dóódu ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ā kóō gbō alɔ, ó géē gbɔbū ɛfú lɛ alɔ í kpɛ́fú lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aígabɔ̄ kú Uféro lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é cɛ̄tra anú ka ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō wɛ ɔnyā kú Uféro. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔnyā ā ú wā ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Uféro á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
idu_Latn: Uhábakūku ka, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ohi tá anúɔ ka, Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā mafú gā uwɔ nyā tá tāajɛ péee tū usiléti kú ɔmɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ eyī gla anú bōōbū, í jé ɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ pó ɛlā kú Uhɛsɛkíya ŋ́. Ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔ kéē cɔ̄nyā lɛ anúɔ ka odúúdú uwā ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú igelī wā ɛgiyí anúɔ. Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́, ɔ́ɔ géē je ɛga lɛ uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lé ikpo ufáyin mɛ́mla ikpó ólīifu ŋmá ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔcí ólīifu kú īyī uwá. Ɔ́ɔ klla í cɛ̄ ka ɛ́ɛ gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá obugā kú īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, nōó yɔ̄ gē nwɛ̄lā ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwā ā gā ɛgiyí nū gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Íkwu nyá nɛ̄ a bī gē yá ɔdā nēe bá ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ je íkwu nyā gā uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hile nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni í gbo ɔ́ áluka eko kú ācɛ ō gbaáluka kú aflɛ́yí ā ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan kwu ɔtá mla ɔyī ā ú kpó lɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ā kóō le kpó ga ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
idu_Latn: Ujéssáya ɔyí kú Atálīya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́lam, mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛtá ce igwó.

eng_Latn: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā jé ɔbɔ́cɛ́ kú uwá mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī gɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī gwó ɔ́ɔmā wɛ áncā, é yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē má ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōo gē yá ɛga dóódu ā. Kwu ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá ā, ó yɔ̄ ī má alɔ.

eng_Latn: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ uwā kpó bū ipú ísu nɛ̄hi ā bēhé. É yɛ ipú nū, é kē gwonū ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā gē kwinya ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
idu_Latn: N cāŋ́jɛ le tá ɔpɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ má ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛgahi kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ n má okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba á. N má gbō klá ajɛ gblugudu kwú eyī ū pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Unehemíya ɔyí kú Uhalkalíya yá á. Ipú ɔyā kú Ukíslefu, kú ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi wɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya ā, ami nōo wɛ Unehemíya ā yɔ̄ Usúsa nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē bī odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ uwá ā le yúklɔ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī je ɔdā dóódu kú abɔ̄yī uwā tá ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ kē híī je ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔnyā dúúmā eko nōó yɔ̄ ī nyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā kú nū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka iyē kú nū le tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
idu_Latn: Aá da um, ācɛ ōhī kú aá nēe tíne ka íne ā kóō yɔ̄ ī gbō uwā ā, aá pó ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā ka ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā gaá kpɛ́fú nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbɔbū nū ā, nɛ̄ aá lɔfú mīyɛ ajɛ ā, ó lɛ ā aá kwú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā ú lɛ uwá kóō wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
idu_Latn: kahíníī, Aá yá ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu ā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, aá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
idu_Latn: Udéfídi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī hólígbō klla bá ī tá opo ce Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, abɔ̄ é bá ī je ɔ́ ga Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kóō lɛ.

eng_Latn: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū lɛ ɔkɔ pɛ́ hɛ́ ókpoó igbó le tá ajɛ kú Ugɛrásɛnesi nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ kú ogbeé ɔhá nōo pīyeyī kwu Ugálīli ā.

eng_Latn: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā le yá, ohígbū ká ācomɛ́ɛbɛ le íne bīya anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā klla le ɛpɔ̄bí lé ohígbū ācɛ nēé lɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, nēé ŋmó icííci ā.

eng_Latn: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu kwúcē ŋmá Umɛsopotámīya ā, Ɔwɔicō gā ɛgiyí nū igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ugíbɛ̄ya lɛ ācɛ úlá ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nēe gē yá abɔ̄lúfīyē fu. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā lɔfú tá ɛcɔ̄ lɛ īnyīlɛyí ékpónú nōó gáā tá ɔ̄ ablɛ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyākin mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū, ayí nū, anyā nū, aígabɔ̄ kú nū, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, cɔ̄nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn á. Ipú iháyí ɔ́mahātá nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, ó le Ujɛhóyākim kwú tū agbá.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n da aá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā tū, ó gáā kwú gbóógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔfú kú um lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā klla í lɛyítáajɛ gā um. Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ka.

eng_Latn: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu, bá ī gwō uba, bá ī tá opo, bá ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū, bá ī jīijē bá ī yúuya, klla bá gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi. Uya kú uwā ā le ajɛ hɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya le pó ka, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla bá Umísipa ā, aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ufílīstiya gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ kéē kpɛ́fú tá uwā abɔ́ɔ. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi ācɛ Ufílīstiya ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ipú ayíkpó kú nū, Ándru ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usáyímɔ̄ni nēé hī ka Upíta, da ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu yá ɛ̄nyā lɛ ā iháyí ɛpa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ kú Ésīya ā, ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá, kéē lɛ olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Óndú ā pó.

eng_Latn: In your patience possess ye your souls.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔtūlé, yɔ̄ ī lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ oyēeyí opiyóó lɛ.

eng_Latn: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
idu_Latn: Náana, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ka ipú Ɔkpíihɔ̄ ā, Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má jéjéēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ámāŋ pó jéjéēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gbɛlá koó gáā yá glá ŋ́ mā, wɛ ɔdā piíí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tútū lɛ ācɛ nōó he uwá ɔtū ā á.

eng_Latn: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ géē je ŋmó tí iyē, okwúukwu kú uwá klla í yɔ̄ ī fíyégbúlú.

eng_Latn: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ géē má ɔ̄ eyī abɔ̄yī uwā ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ géē tá iyɔ̄bū uwā í kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɔwɛ kú nū ā yɔlá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá kú ácí ugba gē yi ɔdā dóódu tāajɛ ā. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé iyɔbū uwā, abɔ́ɔ é géē bá ī wā igbīhi ā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē nū aólɛlā kú uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā, klla í kpó uwā yíífi fíyaa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka īlī ā wɛ ɔdā ō klíiye ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ó lɛ kóō lɛ klá iyē á. Ɔdí ɔhá nyá nɛ̄ ó géē bī le klá iye gbo iyɔ̄lā ɛ́ɛ́ mā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó lɛ ikwū je wā ɛgiyí um, n géē nya ɔ́ agīīje, ohígbū ka n gē meyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá le gla kú eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu cokónu lɛ uwá ā, é le jé ka ācɛ ā ɔ́ɔ lā kwu aá ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄n, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī je imélí kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla Ujúdasi Iskáriyɔ̄tu, nōo je ɔ́ lá ā.

eng_Latn: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kóō he aéwo dóódu, kéē gwíijē kú éeyē, ohígbū ka a gē kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú aéwo mla ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa. A klla ī bī aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā jɔ́ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, ɔkwɔɔkwu nēé gā ajɛ kú Ádām ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ le okónu nɛ́ɛ ce mla anúɔ ā bīya klla tá kéē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú italā ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
idu_Latn: Idu ɔhá nōo nwuné nɛ̄hi klla yɔ̄. Acá mla ēfū kú nū nwuné nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcí ufáyin nyā gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɛgba lɛyíkwu ɛgiyí nū klla ī pīya ēpū kú nū lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā. Ɔcí ufáyin ā leyīce ka ɔ́ɔ gē je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ fíyɛ́ okónu éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ kwu yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da īyī um ka, ɔdā nōo yá olíla ā gáā yá um dúú á. Ó lɛ ā, ɔdí wɛ ile kú íjééyī nɛ̄hi kú um ā? N tá īyī um ohi ka, íle dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú íjééyī kú um ā ŋ́. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū lɛ aólɛlā kú uwá, nēe tíne ō ŋmó uwā ā. Aólɛlā ɔ́ɔmā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn. Obōōbū nyā, é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ aá tá ɛ́.

eng_Latn: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
idu_Latn: É tá odúúdú īlī ā jōnjīlɛ̄, olīkpō kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛtá, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū piyóó ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōo géē yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba tū uwā piyóó ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ményinyi kú Usáyɔn kú ā tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄. Lɛ ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm túgwó igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le yɛ tá Agblīihɔ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le pó ka īkpɔ̄dā yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ó lɛ aádā alɔ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ iyāwu aflɛ́yí kú uwā ga abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ā ci céɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē má ɔdā nōo yá glá ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ nyɔ̄ ga ɔkpá mɛ́mla áyɔ́kpá dóódu kú ālɔ̄ gaá tíne ácí nɛ̄ aɔ́nyā kú alɔ géē lé. Ekōōhī, alɔ géē má ácí nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ ā géē lé nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ í gáā je uwá kpó ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nōó le lɔhi gā uwɔ, gwéeyē. Eko dúúmā nōó kē le bɔ̄bí, blakwu Ɔwɔicō nōo yá eko éyi ā, anú klla kē yá eko ɔhá ɔ́ɔmā dúú á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ í jé ɔdā dúúmā ohígbū óócí kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká alɔ í yēeyī lɛ iyī nū ōfūnū ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē gekwú, ó kwú lɛ iyī nū ōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwā ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ɔ́ɔ gē pī uwá ahɔ̄ ka ɛ́ɛ cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ kú uwá ā, pla uwá ŋ́. Ka Uhɛsɛkíya ɔ́ɔ gáā nya uwá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ odée kplá anú ā, kóō mīyɛ odúúdú agbénú kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aúgbɔga kéē lɛ ɔdā nōó móōwē nū ā kpó wu.

eng_Latn: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ īlī nōo hɛ́ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā igbó ā kwu híla ŋmá icō wāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄kā da ācɛnyīlɔ kú Usɛ́kɛm ka, ɛ̄nyá kú ipú ayí ofɛtá cigwó kú Ugídīyɔn ā, he uwá ɔtū fíyɛ́, ipú odúúdú ayí ā kóō gbō uwā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú kɛ̄ɛ ka odúúdú uwā. Ó kéē bla ka Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki wɛ oyī mɛ́mla ɔkpíyē kú uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā nēé bī le hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ Urehábu, akwuna ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔwɔicō le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ o ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́, ohígbū koó mīye ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, lɛ uwá bī yɛ ɔwɛ ɔhá le pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā tūufi. Anú wɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi nōo ī gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amása le yɛ gáā hī ācɛ ā igwú, amáŋ ó le eko kpóbónū fíyɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not yet eaten of it? let him also go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man eat of it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla í ka kpɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ufáyīn, amáŋ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ īkpō nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kóō le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɛfú ɔ́ɔ géē lé ɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ géē yá ejé ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ācɛ aéwɔhá kwú gbenyi, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē wā ɛgiyí um bá gē fīyégbúlú ŋmá ɛga nēé tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nāa gáā hī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu igwú tɔ̄ɔ̄há, a géē tá opo ā ɔkɔ olikpō.

eng_Latn: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, ɔ̄cɛ kē cíkā ō cɛ́tra anú nwuné lɛ ā dúú. Anú cíkā ō le ojīlīma ce ɔ́ mɛ́mla ufi fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
idu_Latn: É kwú iyé í ce abɔ́ɔ ka Umása mɛ́mla Umɛ́rība, ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka iŋini klla jé Óndú ā má eko nēé dɔɔ̄ka ka ka, Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ kɛ̄ɛ, ka ó yɔ̄ mla alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
idu_Latn: Aá má īkpɛlā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n bī le tɔ́kpá fú aá abɔ̄yī um ā.

eng_Latn: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū ā wɛ ákú um, n kē wɛ ákú nū. Ó yɔ̄ ī je ɔdōlé lɛ aálá kú nū ipú ododó ā.

eng_Latn: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú úgbéenyi ā lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, ɔdí nɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ā nɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ kú ɔ̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔwɔ kú nū, eko ōhī ɔ́ɔ géē ményinyi aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ aá nyatá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá í yíífi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábāti éyi ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú Ufárisīi éyi lɛ Ujísɔ̄si hīgwú kóō wā í le ɔdōlé lé ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā yɔ̄ ī gbō Ujísɔ̄si gɛɛ kéē má ɔdā nōó géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Óndú ā, ɔ̄cɛnyā í yɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ tá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kē ī yɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā tá ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ iyē kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ anyā éwɔhá ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ā á. Ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ɔkwu kú Ujessúwa mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū Ujehósādaki ā, é wɛ Umaásēya, Ɛlíyēsa, Ujárību mɛ́mla Ugédalīya.

eng_Latn: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ̄ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ aá kú aá yúklɔ́ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá oŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū mɛ́mla oŋmá lɛ o móōwē ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
idu_Latn: Asárīya.

eng_Latn: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
idu_Latn: N jikwū klá uwɔ Óndú, ŋmá ɔkɛklɛ kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛhɔ̄ ā le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe bá nyā kpó ka lɛ ɔkpani nū kpɛ́mm. Ɔkpani ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Páápá, nyɔ̄ ga uláyi mɛ́mla ɔwɛ ɛkwūbá kú ipú igelī ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ aógbɛhá, ācodɔgwu ajɛ mɛ́mla aópeyī mɛ́mla ācocīkpó kpó wā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, É lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, Ā híīī yá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā ojámá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Úma ā wɛ Uhanáni mɛ́mla Usebadíya.

eng_Latn: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a lɛ abɔ̄ ka aá kwu ɔ́ gē yá, aá klla kē í yēeyī gbojī ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā le ɛ̄hɔ̄ tū fu Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Óndú, má ɔ̄, oklóbīya uwɔ yɔ̄ ī doōcē.

eng_Latn: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
idu_Latn: Wā kú ālɔ̄ yá kú ádā alɔ kóō lɛ ejé gwá, kú ālɔ̄ gaá gwutá mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ayí ma ŋmá iyē kú ádā alɔ.

eng_Latn: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā héjulúgwu le uwá iyó kpó abɔ̄fú ɛɛ́. É lɛ ɔwɛ kpó gwū tū ācɛ ɔlɛ nū ipú agbá ɛɛ́. É klla le uwá kpó tayínū ipú ijaló. É le uwá héjulúgwu klla mīyɛ uwá iyó abɔfú. É kē má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔfú wā í tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ áma kú ugóolu kpó playi ɛ́plá īkpō kú upomégránēeti okónōgwu kú awulú ā biílí.
