eng_Latn: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
idu_Latn: Ó le utánki ā ma cɛyí aɛ́na kú oje udɔ́ igwɛ́ɛpa. Ɛtá kú uwá lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ɛtá ɔhá kē leyī pīya kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛtá ɔhá leyī pīya kwu ɛhícō, ɛtá ɔhá ā leyī pīya kwu ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ oōgbō kú nū a, aólɛlā ɛga dóódu ge la tɔ̄há bɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o gee wɛ ɔda idáagó ka, Odúumu mla álá kā e lā tɔ̄há ɛbɔ́ ka ɛjɛ ka ɔ gwutá pīɛ ɔyí ɛwū obene cíí, ka ágábá mla ɛna kā e ba ī lé ule tɔ̄há ɔyí obene kā e bī odúúdú uwá ga ɔnu ulé oōlé á.

eng_Latn: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ ipú aá, nááná nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē ká aá géē kwú ohígbū ínoōbīya ā, alelékwū ká aá yēeyī ohígbū kéē le aá kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
idu_Latn: Aá pó ijē kú éeyē kú oyálé ŋmá ipú aádá kú ācɛ okpaakpa kú Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā le ɔdā nɛ̄hi yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā tū ɔ́kplá kú nū ɛhɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā ó klla kahíníī, Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā piíí.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ eyī pīya kwu ajɛ Ámɔn ká a ka ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwú éwo ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
idu_Latn: Agīje kú um géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nɛ̄ ó gē ŋmó ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé ī bī le jé ayí Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ayí ebilíi á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó ī yá ɔdā nōó lɔhi ŋ́ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ nū í he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́, ayíka ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō mā ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
idu_Latn: Eko gēe wā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti gēe ba í yá ufi klá í fīyégbúlú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyā a. Eko nēé le má ka Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a ɔɔ lɛ abɔ̄ nandaa gāa je ōwē la uwá a, é kwu gbogodo klá ajɛ ipu ufi.

eng_Latn: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
idu_Latn: Únóji kú uwā wɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā piyóó mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Abɔ́ɔ nēé gáā lā piyóó ŋmá eko kú ɛ́gɔ́ éyi ga ɔhá á. Nááná nēé tɛtɛ lɛ ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
idu_Latn: Yá ká n̄ lɔfú kɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ eko dóódu, ohígbū ka n lɔtūce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī kɛpɔ̄ kú uwɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aódée ā gē yɛ, uwá í gē pīyeyī ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yɛ ga ābɔ dóódu nōo hi uwá ɔtū ā ŋ́. Ābɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ e tíne ō nyɔ é gē nyɔ tɔɔhá, í cɛgbá ō pīyeyī ga ābɔ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
idu_Latn: Ábna mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ nū yɛ gaá bū ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan, gāa bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī otú ɔ́ɔmā. É yāwu jāā gbó ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ é ga Umáhānéyim á.

eng_Latn: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aíne kú ōcē ōbɔ̄bí kú ɔkpíyē dóódu á. K wiyē o wú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, é gē cíla anú ulé lígíí ká ɔ̄ bī le yá ɛgbá kú nū, ó kē mīyɛ ije nyā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
idu_Latn: É kōō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē gbā ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ó je uwī ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó lɛ ɔdā abɔ̄yī nū dóódu ŋ́, é géē je ɔ́ lá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ gbā ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ó je uwī āa. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ó je uwī ā wɛ, ijaki, ámāŋ ka ɛna, ámāŋ ka álá, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā pīyɛ oyēeyī abɔ̄ kú nū, ó géē gbā ulé nū ɔ́klá ɛpa. Ɔ́dāŋ kaé le uwī kwú abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ca ɔdɔ ga ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ otú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. É gáā ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ā ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó wɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ nɛ̄ó ŋmó ɔ̄ á, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā. eko géē wā nɛ̄ n géē tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā í je ɔ̄ pīya klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ejé ā ŋmá aɔ́já kú nū. É klla géē je aɔ́já ā kpó ca.

eng_Latn: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Umíkimāsi ā wɛ ofɛhīlī ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
idu_Latn: Uhádadi kwú pīya oklóbīya kú Uféro, anɔ́ɔ Uféro kwú ɔyínɛ́ ɔnyā nū ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔnyā ā kwú pīya ɔnyā kú Uhádādi á. Ɔcányā nēé je ɔyínɛ́ nū lɛ Uhádādi ā le ka Utápénsi.

eng_Latn: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ukéríyɔtu, mɛ́mla Ubósra. N géē yá odúúdú aígelī kú Umówābu ā italā nyā, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ligbó mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ ē kwu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
idu_Latn: Oyī mɛ́mla ijē kú uwá í klá ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú Óndú ā cɔkpɔɔɔ, lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyī kú aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wū ā, klla mɛ́mla ijē nōo ī klá íkplí kú aómlede nēé ī je kpó gwɛ́ɛya ā. Óndú ā géē ŋmó ācɛ ipú igelī nēé hí ka Ubósra ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó kē í ŋ́mó ācɛ nɛ̄hi nyā ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ igbīhi cē kwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí ká ā yá olɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ayááyí aá géē lā ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
idu_Latn: Ondú ā le ɔfú tū um iyē á, anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwííjē á. Anú nya um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um á. Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um, n kē í cɛ̄tra anú klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádā um. N géē gwííjē í bī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā gwō.

eng_Latn: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Lɛ ɛbɛ nyā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú uwā ká ā da uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā géē kɛlā gbōm ŋmá ɔkpáncō bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ágábá gē tōoji ā. Ó í je ɔkɔ kú nū gicō ŋmá ɛga otīhɔ nōó lā ā. Ó í dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā. Ó klla géē dɛ̄gba klá odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ɛcɛ ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī yá ejé gē dɛ̄gba ā.

eng_Latn: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
idu_Latn: Aá bla ka eko ɔ́ɔmā aá jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Aá í wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā ŋ́, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá wɛ ācɛ éwɔhá nēé wɛ ɛka nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbo lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nōo ŋmá okónu nōó ce mla uwá ā ŋ́. Aá leyīce ka ɔdā olɔ̄hi dúú ɔ́ɔ géē wā gē lɛ aá abɔ̄ aá lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́. Aá kē jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro da aá ka, Aá lɛ ɔdā idáagó yá ká n̄ jé ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɛlā kú aá. Da Árɔ̄ni kó ō lɛ okwutɛ kú nū tá fīyajɛ iyɔ̄bū Uféro, kóō lɛ pīya ɛgwā.

eng_Latn: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō hī aá igwú wā ipú ɛ̄nyā bū ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔna kú nū lɛ aá ā. Ó hī aá igwú kú aá mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɛgahi kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá cíí gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā cokónu ɔdā dóódu lɛ Ɔwɔicō. A lɔfu hīíjémā nū igbīhāajɛ glá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ, nōo wɛ Umósīsi ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
idu_Latn: . Aíne nēe bá nyā nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá á, ka aá yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa aá.

eng_Latn: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
idu_Latn: Cēyītīkwū ká ē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cōlóhɛ́nyɛtá o yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ uwēyī i gáā kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́. Nwū ācɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔwɛ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: ɔbá ɛna éyi, álá éyi, mɛ́mla omlede éyi kú iháyí éyi kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a gē yá ɔdōlɔhi ā, a da uwá ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ā. A je umaná lɛ uwá lé klla je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá gwá.

eng_Latn: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ géē lā igelī nɛ̄hi ā jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú nū ka. Ó klla í klá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya eko ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ́ɔ gekwú, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ó kwu ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le ɔdā nɛ̄ Uríspa yá ā pó āa.

eng_Latn: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ā hīgwú tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
idu_Latn: Ufi nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī yá um. Ufi kú ikwū gaá le um kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
idu_Latn: Usekaríya klla ka Óndú ā le Ujóssuwa, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mafú lɛ anúɔ, abɔ̄ ó háyi iyɔ̄bū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi háyi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ujóssuwa, le tútū kóō kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nāa wɛ ā, n lɔfú tū uwɔ ukɔ́ kú ā yá ɔdā nāa cíkā ō yá ā glá ohígbū ka alɔ wɛ ayínɛ́ ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a gē pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbā ā, klla gē tá ɔ̄ ohi. Odúúdú ācɛ ɛga dóódu géē wā í gwɛ́ɛya gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le aá kwú ga ɔgbɔ́ ɛpɔ̄, aá híīī lɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē ka ā ŋ́, amáŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē ka ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, é géē je ɛlā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō ka ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ísrɛ̄lu, awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um á. Ugbɛ kú Ébrahām, nōo wɛ oklóbīya um ā, nɛ̄ um fu a.

eng_Latn: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē híī pīyatɔ̄há mla ācɛ kú ajɛ ā nēe hile ipú aá ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī hī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú uwá ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē gbā ɔwɔ kú uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē bī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú uwá i gbɛka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ikwū yíífi piyóo. Óndú ā ī nyā agīje ŋmá eyī kú ācɛ dóódu. Ó kē í je uwēyī nōo kwú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ ɛcɛ ā kpó ŋmá uwā ɛyí. Óndū ā le ka ɛɛ́.

idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā páápá kwú úwé kú nū ú plla bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú Ujéhu klla le opo tá kahíníī, Ujéhu lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé, Ujéhu wɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ opo tá, obōōbū nɛ̄ ācɛ ā lɛ opo ā pó ā, é le ɛgba dɛ̄ nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kwú wúla wā ajɛ gidiimm. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja ā le bēhé bōōbū ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, gaá mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā tābɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ aá bá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu ā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ aá ka, aá ɔ́ɔ le lā gbojī ɛyí ɛfu ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ Umídiya ā, kwú ije nēé gáā lɛ cíla ulé kú okónu ō tá ā ú, anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgiyí Ubálam, le ɛhɔ̄ kú Ubálāki ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā n pīyeyī, n má ɛga nōo tīihɔ̄ fíyɛ́ dúú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā le nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́.

eng_Latn: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā géē má ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, nōo tū ɔlá nyā á, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nyí ɔlá nyā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō uwɔ á. Ó yɔ̄ pī uwɔ ajaajɛ kóō gbō uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um kéē lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē ka lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā tá tāajɛ nɛɛ! É géē yɛ í lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpá nōo ī lé ɛcɛ gbojī!.

eng_Latn: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń yɔ̄ ī ka ka okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce ā kóō yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū kóō wɛ odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ma ā ōfōōfūwā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
idu_Latn: Da ūpū kú ɛháajɛ, nēé hī ka Unɛ́gɛbu ā, kóō pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ā. Da ɔ́ ka n yɔ̄ ī tū ɔlá ɛɛ́, ó kē í je ɔcí dóódu, kwu oōŋmó kwu ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kú ipú nū ā kpó yi. Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā mí ɔlá ɔ́ɔmā ā glá ŋ́. Ɔlá ā í nyīla ŋmá ɛháajɛ ga ɛhícō, ohɔ́lá kú ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā kē í fu ɔ̄cɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē cɔ̄nū dā ācobɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu nɛ̄hi gē kpó odée ā.

eng_Latn: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā í gbajā kóō je iyī nū tēelihɔ ŋ́, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū lɛ yēŋēē, ɛka í gáā kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó géē lɔfú yīipu klla ma ɔyí glá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ aɔ́dā alɛwa kpó lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ bī lɛ hɔ́hā ce uwá ā. Ó kōō wɛ álá, īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé.

eng_Latn: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
idu_Latn: Iyó kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā bá yɔ̄ á, īlī ukɔ́tin kú nū, ɔdā ō klá anú eyɛ̄cɛ, uwɔ ō bī ɔcí kú nū, ɔcí ogblógbló kú nū, aɔ́kpá mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Ācojéeyī, aójɔ́dā, aógwɛ́bā, mɛ́mla aɔ́hɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo lɔfú ka ɔ̄na nyā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū lɛ ɔcɛ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umárɔ̄ti bá ī gbēyī mla ɔtū kpoókpoó kéē wā í lɛ uwá hɛ́tá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ífi bī gaá kwu Ujerúsālɛ̄m ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē fu aótrɛ̄yí kú Ássidɔ̄di mla Ássikēlɔn ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ. N géē yá ācɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ékrɔn itala. Odúúdú ācɛ Ufilístiya nēe hile ā géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
idu_Latn: A gē gbō aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nēé hī ka ɛ́nɛ́ ugwū layílayí bá ɔhá, klla wī ɔdā nōo gbō ogbɔ̄lɛ́ gbēyī ɔyā ā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ gaá lá ɔdōlé.

eng_Latn: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
idu_Latn: N géē yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ eko dóódu, klla í yá ucē kpaakpa lɛyíkwu ɔ́. N géē yá kóō yá aólɛlā kú nū lé eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó ayípōklóbīya kú uwā ŋmó ipú aúláyi kú igelī ā, klla í kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ujosíya yá ā, é lɛ uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū Ujísɔ̄si le tútū kóō nyɔ̄ Ugálīli. Ó lɛ Ufílīpu má, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um.

eng_Latn: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ujúda, é bī ɔdōtɔ́kpá ō lɛ ɔkɔ́ oje le íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā tá ajɛ. É klla kē bī ɔdā o lɛ ɔkɔ́ olɔfú le ɔ́ pi tū ipú ɔtū ká aá. É kē klla le ɔ́ tá tū ɔ́kíka kú ede ká aá.

eng_Latn: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē lɛ agbénú kú nū ŋmá ije o kplá ācɛ kéē lɛ ije nɛ̄hi tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu, agbénú nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē je pīya ákú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbonɛnɛ lɛ aógbɛhá ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔkɛ̄lā kú uwɔ. Anú géē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā kwɛyí uwɔ á. Cɛ́ɛ́ a géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō ā, a géē da ɔ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó í ka ā.

eng_Latn: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da eko nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ɛcɛ ā ka ɔlá ofíyajɛ kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajodobū. Ɔwɔicō ékpó nyā yá kú ɔlá kú nū kóō fíyajɛ ipú ɔtū kú alɔ á. Ofíyajɛ nyā yá kú alɔ jé ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō nōo ī fíyajɛ ŋmá eyī kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlíyākim, Ussɛ́bina mɛ́mla Ujówa lɛ īlī kú uwá kpó híla ipú íwɔ́tū gaá lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya wā gaá ka ā kpó ka lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔdā okpaakpa he ɔ́ ɔtū, éwo kú ɔlɛ́ nū gē háyi lɔfú. Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ ómíci ō mīyɛ lé he ɔ́ ɔtū, éwo nōo gē gbō í je yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
idu_Latn: Ó klla tū um wā ajaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo gē ceyī ŋaáŋaá bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ ā. Ó bī ɔ́ngbá ōmiya ajɛ, mla ɔcí ōmiya ajɛ abɔ̄ māháyi Okómpinu kú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usamérīya le wu klɛ́cɛ gaá je aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Usiríya kpó wu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā. Okoolo kú īkpɔ̄dā ɛtá, mɛ́mla ákú umu ɛhīlī wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā ā í ga ipú odo kú uwā lipú ŋ́, ɛlā ā í klla yɔ̄ ipú odo kú uwa gbojī ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ unwalu mla oyáŋmó gā ohígbū ɛlā ā, é kwúcē igbīhi bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
idu_Latn: Aá kpó ɛfú ā wā í tū ɔlá, ká aá mu owu tū ɔlá ā. Lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā ce ɔlá ā kóō le he lɔɔlɔhi. Lɛ ɔ́ ce ɔlá jāā nɛ̄ ó kwú kpó yɔɔlá bónū.

eng_Latn: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā, wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ wɛ ɔdā nōo ī wú um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aígbáanɔ-enyi nɛ̄hi jé eko kú iháyi nēé ī wā mɛ́mla eko nēé ī pīyɛyí nyɔ̄ ɛga nēé ŋmá ā. Aókóōhō ɔkpɔkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla Aákpáŋdēde jé eko ō pīyɛyí ga ɔlɛ́ uwā dúú. Amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā í jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne kéē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfu nōo kpó odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ yíífi ā. Amáŋ ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, wɛ ɔlɛlā kú uwɔ. N géē lɛ abɔ̄ bī uwɔ í je uwɔ míya ŋmá icō ɛga nɛ̄ a ce ā. Eko nɛ̄ n le yá mɛ mla uwɔ, a géē je pīya ewo áncā klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Umerí wā ɛga nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó má kwōkwū ajɛ iyɔbu kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka a yɔ̄ amānyā nɛɛ, ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā í yɛ í kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
idu_Latn: Ɔhi kú ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kóō híī jé uwɔ má ŋ́. Eyī ɔ̄hi ō yá kú ɔnyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō híī jé uwɔ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ alɔ ŋmá ɔtū kú aá! Alɔ í yá ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ŋ́, alɔ í kē bī ɔ̄cɛ dúú bí ŋmá ɔtū nōó le ce Óndú á ŋ́, ámāŋ pīya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ācɛ Usádusīi ōhī, nēe ka ka ācɛ í gáā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū gɛ ŋ́ mā, le tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
idu_Latn: nēe wɛ ācɛ Uhíbru ā tá ā. Kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā. É yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī bī ɔ̄cɛ Ubíhuru, ɔmpanū ɔfiyɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, alɔ géē yɔ̄ ī bī ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí kú alɔ gé lɛ Óndú ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Alɔ géē bī ikpɔ̄cí kú alɔ dóódu nōo géē pīya aflɛ́yí ā wā dúú.

eng_Latn: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe wɛ otrɛ̄yi nēe kē yúklɔ́ kú uwā lɔɔhɔhi ā, acíkā ō leyī yɔɔ́ ka é cíkā ō miyɛ ulé ɔ́klá ɛpa, ofíyɛ́ dúú aá ɛ̄nɛ̄ e gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi mɛ́mla o nwū ācɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú Ujúda ā ú kpó ga Ubálīlɔn gaá yúklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ lɛ uwá, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ Upɛ́sīya gaá mīyɛ uwá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn.
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, nēé gē bī le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī jikwū klla gē yɔ́tūnōbí, ohígbū ka é gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
idu_Latn: olɛhɔ̄ nēe ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē yá odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ íne nēé tá tū ɔkpá ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nēe gē yá ɔdā ékpó piíí nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá yá nɛ̄ aá ŋmá uwā okónu ā, í gáā kwu ŋmá ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í ka tū aá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
idu_Latn: Ami Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka n géē tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tú uwā. Ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí klla í ŋmó uwā. N géē je uwá yá bɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka īkpɔcí ufígi nōo kwú wā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lé glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ācocɔnya kpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā úlā ɛnɛ ce ofɛhɔ̄ kpó kwú. Ó klla lɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe yɛ īkpó kú nū úlā ofɛpa cigwó kpó kwú dúú. Ó lɛ ɔnya kú uwá nōo géē jɛ̄ úgbɔ́ɔnya ofɛhɔ̄ glá ā kpó bá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpó kú aóhile ā kpó cē á.

eng_Latn: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, lɛ ɔbá ɛna ahāapa, mɛ́mla omlede ahāapa kpó gē lɛ Ujóbu, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ ɛya gwo ohígbū īyī aá. Ujobu gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū aá. N kē í pó ɔkɔ nōó ī gbā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ń gáā je uwēyī lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā lɛ aá lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóbu ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka, odúúdú italā kú odúúdú ācɛ nēé kpó ŋmó kpɛ́mm ā géē wā í ce ācɛ kú eko mā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
idu_Latn: Urúbɛn, awɔ wɛ ɔ́kplá kú um á, awɔ wɛ ɔfú kú um á. Awɔ wɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú um oŋmá eko nɛ̄ n je pīya ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā. Awɔ le ojīlīmā klla lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛnyā kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ géē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcányā Ufássiti yá nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ é klla gáā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aɔ́bá uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É géē bā í ka ka, Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɔcányā, Ufássiti, hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū, ó tá kóō nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄, nōo yɔ̄ í ŋmó ācɛ ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ami lɛ́pɔ̄bí á. Ami klla yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí á. Ācɛ nēe bá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá ā, nɛ̄ n kē wɛ ɔ̄cogbō uwā ó. É kē yá ɔdā dóódu ŋ́. Ami mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ a cíkā ō yá italā á.

eng_Latn: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú nū ā glá ŋ́. Ɔ́da kaníníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ nōó kōō wɛ ɛbɛ́ le iyē kwu ɛfu ā, é í tá ɛcɔ̄ klá anú jāā gbéeko nōó gekwú.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ íne nēé géē lɛ tū piyóó ā ipú ɛcɛ nyā á. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔyā ɔ́migwáahāapa ā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wā nēe bá mɛ́mla uwá í gwōkónu. É kē gáā yúklɔ́ dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayínɛ́ ōhī nēe wɛ ígwu nēé hī ka Ufárisīi ā cāŋjɛ kahíníī, Ó cɛgbá kéē lɛ uwá apī hɛ́ kéē klla da uwá kéē lɛ íne kú Umósīsi tū.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ígwu kú nū ā le inya kwu nyɔ̄ í gbō okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ígwu ɛpa nēe hile ā, le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ ohile ipácí, le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ aá tayínū ā, wā í mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ā. Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá géē je igelī nɛ̄hi ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, é ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja kú Umówābu bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄ ā . Ɔ̄cɛ Umówābu dúúmā í kwu hɛ̄ uwā abɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla Aítíca kú íne kú ācɛ ā túbá āa, ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nēé géē ma Ohɔ́nyɛtá āa.

eng_Latn: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
idu_Latn: Ujámutu, Adulám, Usóko, Asɛ́ka.

eng_Latn: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: É gē lā ɔlɛ́ ā klla ī cālɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ uwá lɛ ā. É géē lɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē je lɛ uwá bū okónu kú Umósīs ā tū.

eng_Latn: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ucē elihɔ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ géē wú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ka ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē nū aéwo nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá aúce ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā bɛ̄ɛcɛ hila uwá abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá gē yɛ lɛyíkwu uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
idu_Latn: Ó lá ɛgiyí únóji, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í ce ɔ́ odó glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The same was in the beginning with God.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ā yɔ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé yá ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
idu_Latn: ó géē lɛ iyī nū tū ŋmá ɛgiyí ejé ɔlamu mɛ́mla ejé olɔfú ō gwá. Ó gáā gwá ɛdɔ ejé dóódu nēé yá ŋmá ɔcí kú ufáyin ámāŋ lé īkpō kú ufáyin ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ámāŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o le ŋmókókó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka é kwú ɔláwonī oyéŋēē ú kpó gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú úwé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú kpó wu ɔ́ iyē, abɔ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā háyi abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi ā má ā, ímálānyī le mu uwá ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ é le áafú tá tū ɛlā nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu ka ā klla le ɛcá cá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm abɔ̄yī uwā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Usɛ́ru nēe bá nyā: Ulótan, Ussóbalu, Usíbīyɔn, Ána, Udíssɔn, Ésa, mɛ́mla Udíssan.

eng_Latn: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ācɛ nēe bá mla um gaajɛ eko kú unwalu kú um á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
idu_Latn: Ujáflēti ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Upasáki, Ubímhálu, mɛ́mla Ássufāti.

eng_Latn: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
idu_Latn: Uhimɛnáyɔsi mɛ́mla Alesáŋda wɛ ocabɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā. N kwú uwā ú tū Ebilíi abɔ̄ kú ō yá uwā itala ohígbū obɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō nēé ge ka ā.

eng_Latn: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú gbɛlá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ gē yá ā ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa, amáŋ Ondú ā gē jila, klla jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ō yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú īlī ɔnyōkwū kú nū ú plla ŋmá iyē, kwú īlī ɔhá ú wiyē, klla kwú īlī ú pīya klá eyī. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá cīce ɔwɛ kú Ɛ́nēm, ɔlɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ujúda gaá yɛ ga Utímna ā. Ɔyí kú Ujúda Usséla ā le jɛ̄ ɛɛ́, amáŋ é je Utáma ɔnyōkwū ā lɛ ɔ́ ɔnyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu gekwú, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla le ikwū kú nū yá tɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ í nyi Uráma, ɔlɛ́ nū á. Igbīhi ɔdā nōo yá nyā, Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ígbíli nēé hī ka Upáran ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
idu_Latn: Kwu eko nɛ̄ ācɛ o kwɛyí ācɛ Ubábīlɔn wā gaá dɔɔ̄kā ohígbū ɔdā idáagó nōo yá ipú ajɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya le yɛ ɔwɛ kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō má ucē mla ohílīpú kú nū.

eng_Latn: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nēé géē tá ɔyī cɛ̄ ɔ̄, bū ipú odo kú nū bēhé. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ āpāana gē ga ipú ukpa, nɛ̄ ó jé ŋ́ mā, ɔ̄cɛ ā í jé ka ɔ́ɔ gáā ŋmó anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhasɛ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ō yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē lɔfú yá ɔdā nyā glá ā? Ń kē wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óndú ā le mafú gā um ka, awɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya á.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē kpó abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɔ́ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɛna á ŋmó okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē mī oyī kú ɛna ā klá ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le ācɛ ɛpa fu kéē wɛ igbómína kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm. Ó ka é wɛ anúɔ, Uhanáni mɛ́mla Uhananíya gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nēé le igá olɔfú cē tū ɔ̄ á. Ó ka Uhananíya ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔtū ce ɔ́ glá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla ī yúufi Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛ́gɔ́ nū í gbɛɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ahɔ̄ jē eko dúú nēé lɛ ɛlā nwū uwɔ, ayíka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī.

eng_Latn: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē pɛ́ kwú ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Ujóbu. Ó lā ipú ajɛ nēé hī Úusi Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í yá ucē kpaakpa, mɛ́mla ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ó gē le ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō, ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, í klla gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā gē gbonɛnɛ klla ī ményīnyi uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Uhasɛ́lu je uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋ́ má. Amáŋ ó gē tá uwá abɔ̄ ohígbū okónu nōo ce mla Ébrahām, Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Ó je mlanyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ī yāwu mla anú ā háyi í lɔfú kɛlā ŋ́, abɔ̄ é le ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ pó nēé kē má ɔ̄cɛ dúú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ̄kā da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ jɛɛga lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ yá ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā? Ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō yá ɔdōlɔhi kɛ̄ɛ kóō yá odōbɔ̄bí, ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō nya oyēeyī tá kɛ̄ɛ kóō lɛ ɔ́ yíífi? Amáŋ é ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā géē lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n géē yá kú aá jɛ gɔbū, n klla í yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́ cííí. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ gaá lɛ Ujerúsālɛm yíífi, amáŋ ó klla lɛ ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ klla da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Má ɔ̄ tá mɛ́nɛ! Ó jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā māháyi ɛgowíigwu kú Arawúna, ɔ̄cɛ Ujɛ́būsi ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē bī Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū í wā kwūū í kpɛ́fú tú Ujúda, bɛ̄ɛka ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi nōo gē tá úgbagwú nɛ̄hi ā klla gē cēenyi klá odúúdú okónu nū ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ aɔ́kɔ kú uwā kpó pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ kwɛyí ā, é habɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu tā gbɔɔ́ ō tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
idu_Latn: Aá gɔbū mla úklɔ́ ā, ká aá lɛ ɔ́ yá kwɛyí! Aá bī ɔtū ōcaca nɛ̄ aá le hútu úklɔ́ ā lɛ ɔ́ yá kwɛyí, aá bī ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ abālɔbányā ā le yá ɔ̄ kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó bēé ga ipú ɔtū kú nū ŋ́. Amáŋ ipú úklo nōó nyɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyē á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
idu_Latn: Awɔ bī ikpokwú mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ le tá iyē kú um bɔ́ɔhá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē tá īlī ā, klla je ɔkpíyē klá anú á.

eng_Latn: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aá nyā nɛ̄ n da ācɛ dóódu á, aá leyí kwɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ɔtūce uwɔ, n klla í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra awɔ fíyɛ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
idu_Latn: Aá yá uce bɛ̄ɛka alɔ mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ yá aá ōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi igbalɛwa ā, aá mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ ā mla éeyē nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Alelékwū Ihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú pɛ́ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kéē yá ɔ̄ tīihɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēe le tēelihɔ nēé tīihɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā kpó wā í bá ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ayí kú Ulífāyi kwú uwā ú kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ukídirɔn.

eng_Latn: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le íkwu je lɛ alɔ kā ālɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ cījáalí ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ oyēeyī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē tū ɔ̄ ōcē, n kē í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe ī gbaja mɛ́mla anú ā móōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɔ́dāŋ́ nēé pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí nēé yá mɛ́mla anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú cɔ̄nū mla Umósīsi, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Árɔ̄ni ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ŋ́ nɛɛ? N jé kóō jé ɔ̄ kɛlā lɔhi. Ó yɔ̄ ī wā gáā jīla uwɔ ɔwɛ dúú ɛɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ó ī má uwɔ ā, ɔtū géē he uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujóbu, ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔdā nōó gē kɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɔlɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da ācɛ Ukéni kéē le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ámālēki ohígbū nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kpó uwā yíífi mla uwá. Ó ka anúɔ í dɔɔ̄kā ō kpó uwā yíífi mla uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko nēé bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ukéni le kpó kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki á.

eng_Latn: And many more believed because of his own word;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usamérīya alɛwa cɛ̄ ohígbū ɛlā nōó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ikwū. Á klla cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā ā yá um lé ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla um gē gbō um, n kē yɔ̄ ipú ɔlá ofíyajɛ nōo gē je oyēeyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɔdōcābɔ̄ je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ede ā géē je ca kláajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ewo nōo yɔ̄ ɛyí nū ā géē je fíyákátá kláajɛ.

eng_Latn: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
idu_Latn: Ó géē leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē leyīkwu kwu aálá kú nū ā. Ó gē tú ayí aálá kú nū bá, kllá í kpó uwá ce abɔ̄ kú nū. Ó klla ī kpó aɛ́nɛ́ nēe bī ayí ā trɛ̄yí ɛmɛɛma.

eng_Latn: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɛfú klá aá í je aígelī kú aá yíífi. N klla í nū aá bēhé ɔlɛ́, í fíyá aá ākátā tū ipú aéwɔhá ā. Ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá géē je tá alácɛ.

eng_Latn: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛhi kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō jɛ́ɛyí ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdōtayínū, nɛ̄ n lɔfú lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n lɔfú da ɛfu kóō le fu glá, amáŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í he um ɔtū ŋ́, ó lɛ ā ń wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nōo ī leyīkwu ɔwɛ ā yɔ̄ í tá igwu owu, amáŋ abɔ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ ɔ̄ ā, ó kwu iyɔ̄lā ú gbo. Anɔ́ɔ Urécabu mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ubaána, le plā ga inu ā á.

eng_Latn: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ka anúɔ géē yá kú ācɛ nēe gē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ŋmó ā, kéē gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó aɔ́mpa uwā. Oyī kú aɔ́mpa uwā nēé géē ŋmó ā géē gbɔɔ́ ō yá uwā ígoíi gē yá uwā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ géē jé ka amí ɔ́ɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, le aá nyatá klla le aá hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. É kē í jé ka amī ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, aá nyɔ̄ ga Ugílɛ̄di nyɔ̄ í da ɔ̄kā ɛcí. Amáŋ odúúdú ɛcí alɛwā nɛ̄ aá ī le tá īyī aá abɔ̄ ā, odúúmā kú uwá í hɛ́ aá tá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ádā um, lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú um kú agbénú kú uwɔ je ga um abālɔbányā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyīlɔ ā le agbénú kú nū kɔ̄ lɛ ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
idu_Latn: Eko gēe wā, nɛ̄ Óndú a, Ɔwɔicō nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a gēe mīyɛ ɛhi mla ɔda oogwo ɛya, ŋmá ɛga īyī ācɛ nɛ̄ ísu lɛ ajɛ kú uwá kpó kɔ̄ a, ācɛ oolɛɔfú nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, aɔ́báagwu, nēé jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ dóódu kú ɛcɛ gē yá ufi uwá ɔ́ɔmā; uwá gēe wā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a yɔ̄ a, gaa gbā ɔkɔ la Óndú a.

eng_Latn: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sra le yá kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, ācɛ Ulífāyi, aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɛka gbo ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ussɛkaníya ɔ́ɔ je tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si hɛ́ ācɛ alɛwa odoōcē tá ŋmá ɛdɔ kú ōcē dóódu, ó je ɔ́da lɛ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí kéē le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ācɛ. Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ aálelékwū ā ka ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ ohígbū ka é jé ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ō bá inīkwu kú nū le gla ā, Ujósɛ̄fu da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Uféro kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tá um abɔ̄ glá, aá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Uféro gā um.

eng_Latn: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aéwo ɔhá nɛ̄ á pó ɔ̄kā uwa jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, géē pó ɔ̄kā kú ífi kú uwɔ nyā ā, ó géē je unwalu lɛ uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka anúɔ géē je uwɔ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē wú uwɔ ɔtū, nɛ̄ eyī uwā klla le cá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ cɛ̄ únɛ́pɔ̄, é géē yá ɔ̄ italā piíí. Á kú nū mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú owu nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō tá, anɔ́ɔ úgbagwú nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō tá éŋkpɔ̄ ga ipú ɔ́kɔ ā á. Ó hile ligií kú éŋkpɔ̄ kóō le mu ipú ɔ́kɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
idu_Latn: Ukálāyi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usálāyi á. Éba wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ámɔ̄ku á.

eng_Latn: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōo yēeyī ā, kóō cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Áá túblá um. Anɔ́ɔ é le túbla anú á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja le ede kú Óndú nēé tɛtɛ je catāajɛ ā tū gwó á.

eng_Latn: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ háyi ɛcɛ, é kē tíne kéē má uwɔ.

eng_Latn: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíigbō kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā le má ka ɛyí ɔ̄na kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ gwá ā, ɔ́ɔ le lɔhi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, N nɔ̄na dúú. Ɔ̄na kú um ā kē yɔ̄ á. N bī aómbilí ɛtá kú igbō cɛyí.

eng_Latn: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ bá abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī alɛwa ā, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi nēé hī ka Ágābɔsi gā ŋmá Ujudíya.

eng_Latn: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ oje nēé ī bī le na aíkwúsa mɛ́mla aba ō bī yá ɔwɛ kpó lɛ uwá. Ó klla kpó oje udɔ nɛ̄hi nōo gbɛnú kú nū í lɛ o gbaáluka ŋ́ lɛ uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ n dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ka, ɔdí wɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē gbɛlá kwu ɔ́ dúú ā, ámāŋ ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔyí kú ɔlɛɛcɛ wɛ ɛ́ɛ́, nāa gē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
idu_Latn: Ānyɛ wɛ ācɛ nēe pó ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ é bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́ ā? Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu ŋmá Íjīpiti ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
idu_Latn: É le anyā ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ɛpa ā, Ahínōwam mɛ́mla Abígɛ̄lu ā kpó kwú nyɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kpo wā icō ga ipú inu nɛ̄hi ā, ó le ɛga ocīce yá lɛ uwá ɛga ojīlīmā, ɛyí utébulu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ofu cigwó tɛtɛ cīce, ɛɛ́ nēé wā ā.

eng_Latn: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
idu_Latn: Ása le odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn kpó hīgwú, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, Umanásɛ mɛ́mla Usímīyɔn nēe húmáyī lā ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā, ohígbū ka ācɛ alɛwa ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́kwu wā ɛgiyí nū eko nēé le má ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aá, é géē je Usáyɔn hɛ́hɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ o hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā. Ujerúsālɛm géē pīya ɛyétutulu kú ífi, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kē géē je pīya ipú ūpū.

eng_Latn: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá kéē lɛ ɔnyínɔ̄nyā kú Ébrahām nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí gbō báajɛ iháyí igwáahātá ā hɛ́tá ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
idu_Latn: Aúklɔ́ ohɛkɛhɛkɛ mɛ́mla olɔnɔ ā nēé géē bá ī yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá lɛ ɔtū kpó ce Óndú ā, ŋmá eko nyā jāā ga eko nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔnɔ̄ yɔ̄ a ŋ́ nɛɛ? N géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kó ō lɛ akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ tū wāajɛ abālɔbányā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá, aá géē jé ka, aá lɛ íne kú Óndú ā bīya nɛ̄hi, o ŋmá lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ aá tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.
idu_Latn: Unaómi lɛ ɔmáapu ɔbá éyi nēé hī ka Ubówāsi. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔdu nɛ̄hi, ó klla wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū, Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le cɔ̄nū mla anúɔ, nōo wɛ Umósīsi ā ohígbū uwā dúú. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ ɔ́ gáā ga ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ācɛ ā bá ī kpó iyó kú úklɔ́ ā wā fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cɛgbá ō bī yúklɔ́, nɛ̄ Óndú ā da alɔ ka ālɔ̄ yá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ugídīyɔn ka anúɔ géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá klla í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá ācɛ Umídiya lé mla ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, nēe lɛ abɔ̄ hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ tū okónu gwá ā. Ó da ɔ́ kóō da ācɛ ohile ɔhá kpɛ́mm ā kéē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ um, kú aá leyī kwɛcɛ ohígbū ācɛ nēe ī yá ká aá le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yá kú ācɛ kéē le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā. Ācɛ nēe gē nwū ɔdā ɔhá gwū ɔdā nɛ̄ áa jé ā tá. Aá híī tíyē kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ nɛŋ́cɛ́ nēe jīla bá ɔɔ́pu ā. Ígwu éyi lɛ ɔkɔcɛyí da ígwu ɔhá ā kahíníī, Alɔ tá ɛ́mula kú ijē olɔnyɛ tū aá, aá kē jīje ŋ́! Alɔ gwííjē ɛyíkwū lɛ aá, nááná aá kē jikwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɔdā nōo gē yá eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛfú bī wā ipú ajɛ ā. Ācɛ kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā fu ká ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ogbāājɛ.

eng_Latn: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ayí kú Ulífāyi ōfōofū uwā géē bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā á. Ohígbū ka uwá nɛ̄ Óndú ā je úklɔ́ nyā lɛ uwá kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyēsa ma ɔyí ékpónú: Uréhabīya. Amáŋ, Uréhabīya ma ayí alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ gē túgagá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā gē túgagá otú. Ó ka anɔ́ɔ géē je Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́nɛ́ uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ ī lé ɔdōlé nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó bónū ipú úláyi á. Ācɛ nēé tɛtɛ bī jɛ̄ ipú abahi ā bá ī nyā ɔdōlé lé ŋmá ɛyétutulu.

eng_Latn: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
idu_Latn: . Umósīsi ka ɛcɔ̄ nēé bī lɛ gbā ikpati ōkwū kú nū á, oliīkpō kú ikpati ā wɛ umíta ɛnɛ. Olɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē mīya odée kú uwā lɛ ā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú má ikpati ā ipú igelī kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nēé hī ka Urába ā glá ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ɛ́dɔm ka, N géē tá uwɔ wāajɛ ipú aéwo ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē lɛ eyī gwō uwɔ bónū dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā géē bī ɔdā kú ɛya gé lɛ Óndú ā, ó kōō wɛ ákú oji ō cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā ámāŋ ákú o je ŋmá ɔtū kú nū, ɛbɛ́ ā í gáā lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā iyē kú nū ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ koó tíne kú Óndú ā kóō mīyɛ ɛya kú nū.

eng_Latn: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú odúúdu ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā wɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kwúcē gā ɔlɛ́ ádā nū. Ó yɔ̄ ɛga oligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ádā nū má ɔ̄ á. Ó le tū ɔ̄ eyīnyinyi, anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú bá ɔtū lɔɔlɔhi á.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔn ā le jé ka aá ɔ́ɔ kwú Udéfīdi í pīya olɛlā kú uwā ɛɛ́ mā, é le yɛ gaá le aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya úlā ofɛpa cigwó plla ŋmá Ubɛ́trēhobu mɛ́mla Usóba. É klla gaá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofuciigwó plla ŋmá Utóbu. É klla plla aícɔ́ɔja úlā ɛpa cofigwó ŋmá ɛga ɔcɛ́ kú Umáaka.

eng_Latn: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā mɛ́mla Ujɛhóyāda, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ o hile ā, le ɔcɛ́ bītá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā wā agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā á. É le bēé ɔwɛ okpaakpa kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā gaá cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá bī ɔ̄cɛ ā gē um anɔ́ɔ aá ka kóō yɔ̄ ī wu ɔtū kú ācɛ klíico kéē cīlɛ̄fú. Abālɔbányā, n le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄ ipéyī aá amānyā. Ń kē má ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúú ō bī le ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá kpó ce ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā ka Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú Uríya ú kwāajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛfú lɔfú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ le yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
idu_Latn: Ācogbāálá ā kwúcē ī tá ipácí ɛgiyí aálá kú uwā, bá gē gwíijē ī kɛlā ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɔdā nēé pó mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é má ā, ó lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ da uwá kpɛ́mm ā.

eng_Latn: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábna da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Ágábáidu,n géē nyɔ̄ ká n lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó gé lɛ uwɔ. É géē gbɛka mɛ́mla uwɔ ká ā kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a húmáyī tíne ā. Udéfīdi le uŋmóōō tá Ábna ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ábna kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
idu_Latn: Ukérosi, Usíya, Upádɔn.

eng_Latn: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm yá, eko nēé yá Ujerúsālɛm lé ā. Blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá í da aólɛlā ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔlá dúúdú. Aá lɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔlá dúúdú! Aá lɛ ɔ́ ca tāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ bī ōhī kú ɔcí ā gē le gwɔ́ɔ́lá, ī le pá ɛbɛ́ lé, klla gē jɛ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó gē kahíníī, Aháa! Ofū kú um mɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔlá ā lɔhi ō má íbí.

eng_Latn: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ Asspɛ́nāsi le eyīnyinyi kú Udánīyɛlu má klla le ɛlā kú nū pó á.

eng_Latn: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā le ācɛ nōo gē leyīkwu aɔ́fiyɛ fu kéē leyīkwu uwá, kéē klla yá uwá ōwē. Ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu gwó aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Upíto mɛ́mla Urámēses ɛga nɛ̄ Uféro ī kpó iyó kú nū tū ā á.

eng_Latn: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu le yēŋēē tū ācɛ nēe le yēŋēē abɔ̄yī uwā ā, ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu í le yeŋēē tū ācɛ nɛ̄ íne ō bīya le ɔtū kú uwā bīya ā ŋ́. É klla cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yi glá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛlā ōgbo mla ɔtū kú uwā í le kpakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
idu_Latn: Unwalu nɛ̄ ń gbaáluka glá ŋ́ mā le yɛ um jila tá biílí. Íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā le um kwú klla cɛ̄ gā um mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi glá gɛ ŋ́. Íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā lɛ ɛwa fíyɛ́ īnyīlɛ̄yí kú um. Abɔ̄ kē le hɛ́ um iyē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā le aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya dúúmā nōó nuunu tá ɔ̄ ā ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usiríya le pɛ́ kwu, anɔ́ɔ Ísrɛ̄lu kē le nū uwā bīī á. Amáŋ, Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Usiríya ā le icō ɔnya kú nū tū le kwu mɛ́mla ācokpɛ́fɔ́nya ōhī.

eng_Latn: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ í cɔ̄nū dɛ̄gba tū ɔ̄ kú ucē obɔ̄bí ɛ̄cī ékpónú jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó kē jē oklóbīya nɛ̄hi. Anú wɛ ɔmace kú Ábsālɔm á.

eng_Latn: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
idu_Latn: É géē je odúúdú ɛga o hile kú ɛbɛ́ ɛna ā, mla ɔkpá kú nū, mɛ́mla oyī mɛ́mla iyó ipú kú nū ā, kpó yɔlá ipéeyī kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, ɔ́dāŋ ka n le mlanyī uwɔ, nɛ̄ ń blakwu kwu uwɔ ka awɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwéeyē ā ŋ́, ayíka ígblɛ́nyī kú um kóō le kwu í bá akpakó kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú um gwíijē glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le cɔ̄nū mla Urécɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ń wɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō yá nɛ̄ á ma ɔyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú um tīīye ipú ɔgbínya ā, n lɛ inya ā kwu gaajɛ ɛɛ́, n le ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ī nwū ā tū gajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛ̄nyā ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ aá jé ka eko nɛ̄ aá ī héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā lɛ yá ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē nya alɔ tá ā má kwajaajɛ abālɔbányā fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ eko nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla Ɛlísa, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, géē kɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu nēé kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Aá géē kɔ̄ ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́.

eng_Latn: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
idu_Latn: Aá géē pɛ́kwú ipú ígbíli nyā. Okwū kú aá í wɛ o pahīla klá ajɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ. Ohígbū iŋini nɛ̄ aá ka ā. Odóódu kú aá nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū ā í gáā ga ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ úwé kú nū kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ gbɔɔ́ ō ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá, tɛ́ɛ́hɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɔfú na ɔ́ tɛ́ɛ́hɛ́ lɛ ā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄ uwá gē tíne ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kéē lé á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́ɔ̄ má ɔ̄, anúɔ géē lɛ ɔnwū álá tá ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aá gē wú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ ébú ɔ́ɔ le cē klá ɔnwū álá ā, nōó lɛ iyē kwu ajɛ ā ŋ́, anúɔ géē jé ka ɔ́ɔ géē bī anúɔ le hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá.

eng_Latn: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
idu_Latn: Ó le aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kpó lɛ ɔ́ ā túgwó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó í lā ipú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛlu kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛyíkwu ācɛ nɛ̄ ē lā Ujerúsālɛm ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. Uwá géē le ɔdōlé kú uwá ipú ɔtū ō hɛ́ko, klla í gwá éŋkpɔ̄ apīicē. É géē je odúúdú ajɛ kú uwá yíífi tá áncā ohígbū ucē ɔnɔɔtū kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
idu_Latn: É cīce mɛ́mla Ujóbu ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ. Okónu í hɛ́ odúúmā kú uwá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúmā kú uwá gē kɛlā ŋmá okónu glá ŋ ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ohígbū ka uwá bá ī má ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ujóbu yɔ̄ ī jé ā.

eng_Latn: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ oyēeyī kú uwɔ tū, é kē gáā ŋmó uwɔ ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka a géē wi, ohígbū ka a lɛ ɔtū ce um.

eng_Latn: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ abɔ̄yī nū géē yɔ̄ í túgagá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā gē ga ɔwɛ ga ácí ā. Ó kē í jíliyē bɛ̄ɛka inu ácí nɛ̄ ofulútu yɔ̄ ī kpó gajɛ gicō ā. Ɔbíipú kú alɛɛcɛ yɔ̄ ī pi ɛcɛ wā ajɛ á. Ɛcɛ géē wūlatāajɛ nēé kē gáā kpó ɔ̄ gicō gbóógbóō glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yēeyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā, ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí gbōō le ikwū je nɛ̄hi mla agīje, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá ŋmá ikwū. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nōó gbā a pó ohígbū kóō gbonɛnɛ klla lɛ iyī nū túwāajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū géē lā iyɔ̄bū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. É géē yúklɔ́ ɛga otīihɔ ā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ɔhá nōo dɔɔ̄kā ō gbla uwá yúklɔ́ ā, é cíkā ō kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, nyɔ̄ ká ā lɛ ācɛ ā kpó trɛ̄yí ga ɛga nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ā. Le jé ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um géē bī uwɔ tá, amáŋ eko gē wā nɛ̄ n géē yá ācɛ nēe bá ā italā ohígbū íne kú um nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā, nōo gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa eko dóódu, nōó bīya íne ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: É lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihlɔ gwó. Ipú inu eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú nū ā, nēé hī ka Ɛga o tīhɔ. Ipú nū ā nēé kpó ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ mla ítéblu mla igbō kú Iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā bá á.

eng_Latn: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eyī kú um kwu uwɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, awɔ gē gbō um á. A híī mabɔ̄ um tá kéē lɛ um ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
idu_Latn: É ī bī ígblɛ́nyī kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋgelī nēé le tūlé ā. É gē tá ɛlā obɔ̄bí ŋmá okónu wɛ̄ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ofītɛ́ nōo gē tá ɔyī ɛ́fa ā.

eng_Latn: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɛhícō ā ú hī Ɔkpāncō á. Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī, nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa á.

eng_Latn: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Aá cēyītīkwū ojigógó kú aá lɛ ɛdɔ odo nyā lɛyíkwu iyī aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a dɔɔ̄ka lɛ ā, n jé uwɔ lɔɔlɔhi, ɛlā kú uwɔ klla he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa ā géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwá, í kpó ɔkpacaŋgelī le ŋmó uwā, í kpó ayí uwā ŋmó, klla í tū ɔlɛ́ uwá ɔlá.

eng_Latn: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gbɛlá kóō wɛ ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā, lɔfú bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū glá.

eng_Latn: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ń ka íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā tɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, abɔ̄ kwú hɛ́ um iyē, ohígbū ikwū nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī je ɛ̄cī odunkwulu ā.

eng_Latn: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ó má háyi icō kpaakpa anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá bá ī móōwē. Aá kē bá gē túgagá gɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ejé lɛ aá kwú ā, nááná nɛ̄ aá kē gwá ejé ŋ mā.

eng_Latn: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāssi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le tá ɛfú mla Amásīya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. É gaá le jīla ɔpɛ́ kú Ubɛti Ussémessi ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
idu_Latn: Awɔ gē yá nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ gē yálé ɔgbɛ́fú á. Awɔ klla kē hɛ́ Udéfīdi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā tá ŋmá ikwū á.

eng_Latn: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā alɛwa mla oje udɔ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í miya uwá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé jé onwuné kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā ɔyí ā dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ igbeékpónú kahíníī, N cɛ̄, amáŋ ó nwuné jɛ̄ ŋ́. Tá um abɔ̄ ká n̄ cɛ̄ fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ahāapa kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cabá ā le ŋmɛ́yí ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí kú ipú ūpū, kéē gwíijē ohígbū éeyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā Ohígbū ka aá jé ka Óndú ā gē wā í kɛpɔ tū odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
idu_Latn: N gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, ohígbū ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ um wɛ ā. Ń gáā cɛ̄ kéē je uwɛ̄yī gā um ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ka ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā gē kɔ̄ owófu nōo cíkā ō wɛ ákú um ā mla um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ō cē lɛ Óndú ā, eko kú ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē ā. Aá géē túbá kú ɔkɔ ō gbā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
idu_Latn: Ugolíyāti háyi cɛ́ɛ́, ó gē dɛ̄gba tū odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá bá í yá abɔ́ɔ ā? Aá le kwāajɛ ɛfú klla le ɔgba ɛɛ́. N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya, aá kē wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Usɔ́lu. Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi fu ŋmá ipú aá kóō wā í nuunu tá um.

eng_Latn: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú igbō nēé kpó gé lɛ Óndú ā í kpó ce ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
idu_Latn: Ɛlá ō gbo kwu ɔnɔ kú um, mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ń lɛ ŋ́ má, hɔ́ɔnɔ tū um bɛ̄ɛka ɛcí ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce ɔ́ géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Ukóhati ɔgbɔɔgba ā wɛ, Ammínādābu, Ukóra, Ássɛ.

eng_Latn: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ɔ́mpa aá nēe bá Ubábīlɔn amānyā ā ka n̄ hókónu tū aá, Umáki, ɔyí um hókónu tū aá dúú.

eng_Latn: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
idu_Latn: A le ɔlɛɛcɛ yá kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɛga nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ákú uwɔ lígíí ōfōōfūnū. A kwú ɔflā kú ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛgahi ú kwu ɔ́ ɛyí.
