eng_Latn: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛga nɛ̄ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ā, ewō í kōō gaá fu ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ámāŋ ka aɛ́bɛ́ dúúma kú uwā ɔnū ŋ́. Abɔ́ɔ ā, aá géē jé ka ami Óndú ā le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu fō ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā tá.

eng_Latn: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aóklóbīya um, nɛ̄ n kpɔ́tūce fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē wɔ́tū um. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā kwú pɛ́ kwu hɛ̄ um tá.

eng_Latn: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ɔbɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī cē ijáalí tū uwā. Ó ka ipú odóódu ɔdā nēé yá uwā ā, é cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā gaá dɔɔ̄ka anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Lord GOD, which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, nōo kē bī ācɛ ɔlɛ nū wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ éwɔhá ā ka anúɔ lɛ okónu ce ka anúɔ géē bī ācɛ ɔhá wā í kwu uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔyí álá ā nōo klá ɔtāhɛ̄ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā, géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē yá aálá ā. Ó kē í gbō uwā ga njɔɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē je oyēeyī. Ɔwɔicō kē géē nya odúúdú agīje ŋmá uwā eyī.

eng_Latn: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána, Ujɛ́rōham, Ɛlíyēlu, Utówa.

eng_Latn: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ í da aá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ācɛ ōhī bá amānyā nēe géē yēeyī cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō má.

eng_Latn: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ijē, cɛ́ɛ́ uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ kwú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
idu_Latn: É bī ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔlá nēé hī ka Ujáspa ā le yá ɔdɔ kú nū. Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ugóolu nōo le péee bɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā nēé bī le gwó ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú igelī ā abɔ̄yī nū á.

eng_Latn: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu í klá gāa má ímálānyī kú Ujúda ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ Ujúda gē bī ɛlā mla Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé gē bá tɔ̄há mla ācɛ ɔhá glá ŋ́ mā, wɛ ācɛ nēe ī lɛ ɛlá kwu īyī uwā, ōfōōfū uwā. É gáā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yí dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ka lɛ uwá ā gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔpá nɛ̄hɛ́ lā, kwú okwū ā ú wā ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔpá nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ú hā tū ɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ í gwutá ipú únóji nēé yíla tá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛcɔ̄ míya gaá gwū okónu únóji ā á.

eng_Latn: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
idu_Latn: nōo lɛ ɔyí nɔ̄nyā kú Ulífāyi, nōo lé ka Ujókɛ̄bɛdi, nēé ma ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ó má ayí ɛpa lɛ Ámram, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi, mɛ́mla ɔyí nɔ̄nyā éyi nēé hī ka Umíriyam.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, É yá Usábāti kóō tīile lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. É yá ɔ̄cɛ kóō tīile lɛ Usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ká ɛlā ɔkwɛyi ā, n̄ da aá, ka anyōkwū alɛwa bá Isrɛ̄lu eko kú Ɛláyíja, nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í yá ŋ́ iháyí ɛtá ce ɔyā ɛhīlī ā, nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā nɛ̄hi ŋmó ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔyí ā kahíníī, Ehée! Iyē kú nū í wɛ Ujɔ́ni.

eng_Latn: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ánya gē bī áafú wā, Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ ogbēyī cíí gē bī ɛbɔ́ wā.

eng_Latn: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā lɛ ocíbú ahāapa nēé le ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī piyóó ā tū uwā omōōmu ā, kpó lɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō miya ɔ́ mla iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í ka ā? Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ ka koó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ó géē da alɔ ka Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ujɔ́ni ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
idu_Latn: Á tíne ɛhi kú aɔ́dā kú ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, á klla kē cɛgbá ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ámāŋ ka ɛya kú ínoōbīya ŋ́. Amáŋ a le ahɔ̄ je gā um, ká n̄ pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Amānyā ā dúú, ɔwɛ éyi yɔ̄ ga ipɔ́ɔnū eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɛplá nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ŋmá okómpinu kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ga okómpinu ɔ́mpa nōo tá ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā mīya ā. Ó wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
idu_Latn: N le lā gbojī nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ í he uwá ɔtū ŋ́ mā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ewo obɔ̄bí nyā géē hile, nēe ī lā ipú aájɛ nɛ̄ n gáā pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ikwū géē he ācɛ nēe í hile ɔ́ɔmā ɔtū fíyɛ́ oyeeyī á. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kwúcē fíyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, Ohɔ́nyɛtá í je ojīlīmā kú igabɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya lɛ iyī nū ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um á, ícɛ nyā n le pīya Ádā uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛbɛ́ ā, ámāŋ igbō ā hile gbɔ́ ɔ̄cī, kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔlá. Ó gáā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ī lé igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū kaó tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um igbɔhá ka um kwú úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogbāálá ú kpɔ́, ka um yá bɛ̄ɛka ācogbāálá ɛflɛ́ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe cīgbīhi kwu uwɔ ā, Óndú, géē je kpó yíífi piíí. A géē je ācɛ nēé yɛ ce uwɔ kpaakpa ŋ́ mā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
idu_Latn: N má ka aá gē jɛɛga lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe gē wā ɛgiyí aá ā. Aá ī cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú uwā lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si nááná nōó wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɛ̄nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔna nū lɛ aá ā. Aá kē ī mīyɛ alelékwū mɛ́mla ɔ̄kōolɔhi nēé kē wɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ ŋ́ mā ā!.

eng_Latn: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi nōó da uwá ā kpó yá á.

eng_Latn: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le da uwá kéē lɛ iyē gwá éŋkpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi, ó lɛ ācɛ ɛpa nēe pɛ́ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi wɛ Ufárisīi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā wɛ odɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ Asspɛ́nāsi nōo wɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kóō lɛ ōhī kú ayípōklóbīya kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́nū kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
idu_Latn: N jé kpɔ́cī ka aá jé ŋmá ipú íne kú Umósīsi ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ɛ́ɛ ī bīya íne ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu, amáŋ é kē lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ, ká aá kē bla ka ɛplá iháyí ɛtá, ń mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́, n bī otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ le nwū éyééye kú aá ɛlā, n klla kē bī ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi le yúklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ihɔtū nāa lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā mafú gā um ká ā lɛ um ɔtū túlé, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo géē gbā anú mɛ́mla ɔyí nū klla mɛ́mla ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí nū ɛ̄gbā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko ga nēé ī je éwo kú nū yíífi ā. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ga, cɛ́ɛ́ aéwo nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi géē kpó ācɛ éwo kú ɔlɛ́ nū yá aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwā yɛ jāā ga Árōwɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔpɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛfu nēe ŋmá Umédēba ga Udíbɔn ā.

eng_Latn: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ gē bī ɔ̄ wā ajɛ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ otá īyī nū wāajɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, aá híīī lā ɛdɔ oyēeyī nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lā nōo cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá ɛdɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá lā ā yɔ̄ ī kpó aá yíífi, ohígbū koó gé cɛ̄ lɛ aá yúnwū kú ɔdā nōo gē kpó aá yíífi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le íne ā tá tāajɛ kwɛyí, ó klla le má ka anúɔ í je ɔdā dúú táajɛ ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Umáta le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī wā, ó le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ. Amáŋ Umerí yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kahíníī, Túkpɛɛ́ kú ā lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ ugbé kú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi túkpɛɛ́ kwú ugbé ŋmá ajɛ á, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya okwutɛ abɔ̄ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
idu_Latn: Ó gēe je pīya ɔlɛ́ kú aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipúací a, mla ɔlɛ ogwugwu; oko okonfiló. Ɔwá mla ɔblá gēe lā abɔ̄ mɛɛ á. Klá ba ī yɛ alácɛ̄ kú nū jila mɛɛ á.

eng_Latn: But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā béhē ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́, ayíka ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ayí Ulífāyi nɛ̄ Óndú ā gwu uwá iyē ohígbū úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Amáŋ, ācɛ o hile ɔhá ā géē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā kéē bá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
idu_Latn: Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya tɛtɛ wɛ oklóbīya kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. Eko nōó le pó ka, Usólōmɔn ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí ádā nū Udéfīdi ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā ka lɛ ācɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le anyākwɔ́cɛ ofɛtá ce igwó ā fu, kwú uwā ú kwu ɔgba biílí ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ucɛ kú ojīleyī kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā kú uwā ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra iyē ō tū ɛgahi kú Óndú ā. Aá túkpɛɛ́ lɛ anú nōo tīihɔ ā, eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ɛgahi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya klla lɛ úklɔ́ kú ācɛ Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó kɔ́ lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yá tɛtɛ ā. Úklɔ́ ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú, ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mla ijē ō gwó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mla ahínyá nēé ī tá ipú ijē mla ocɛ̄tra mɛ́mla ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ɔhá dóódu kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
idu_Latn: É wā mla éeyē, ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, gáā ga agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē kpó ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ŋmó bónū, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ujē nōó tīile dúúmā ŋ́, nēé ī fu bónu ā. Amáŋ ācɛ í lɔfú lɛ abɔ̄ áncā kwu uwá glá ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ujē ā, ohígbū keé tūufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Ukéni da Ébɛ̄l kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ ga ipácí káá Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ i yɛ á. Eko nɛ̄ é bá ipácí ā, Ukéni tū Ébɛ̄l, ɔyínɛ́ nū iyē le ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
idu_Latn: Ɔtū í he um eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um ī móōwē, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he um eko nɛ̄ ífi gbo ce uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ɛ̄cī kú aá le bá kóō mɛ ɛ́ɛ́, otú géē bī da aá nɛ̄ aá gáā mɛ́ɛbɛ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bī nyíleyī. Aá klla gáā lɔfú mɛ́ɛbɛ kú ócí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Aá gáā lɔfú ka ɔdā dúú kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ka gā um lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā ofōōfūnū nɛ̄ n jé á. Amáŋ, abālɔbányā ā, n bī īkpēyī abɔ̄yī um lɛ uwɔ má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa kú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ alɔ bá ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo kwú ɔdonūigbō ú lɛ ɔ́ wīya tɔ̄hā mla ámú kú igbo ɛtá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ámú kú igbo ā kwú nū dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ayí aá lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí kú ɛcɔ̄ nyā a.

eng_Latn: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le tá agbla kú Ubáalu ā lɛ ɔ́ gblla wā ajɛ kwú ɔ̄ ú ca, nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ mɛ́mla ojibó kú Ubáalu ā. É klla kwú Umátan, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ubáalu a ú ŋmó iyɔ̄bū ede kú Ubáalu ā. Ujɛhóyāda kwú ācɛ ú kpó gbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú icɔ́ɔci í cíkā ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo pīya ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū nōo géē nū pitīī ipú ɔbɔ́cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē ŋmó ɔ́ ɛpɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ebilíi ā.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa ā má ɔ̄, ɔtū kē he uwá, amáŋ é kwú odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā okónu ú klá.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Ujése ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Odúúdú ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ bá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, ɔ́ɔ hile ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā éyi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gbō álá ipácí ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujése ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ hīīgwú wā. Ó ka aá í gáā cīce ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɔ́ɔ ga.

eng_Latn: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.
idu_Latn: Ohí le hɛ́ lɛ Udánīyɛlu nēé hī ka Ubɛltessása ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kɛlā glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ubɛltessása, ɔ̄na ā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ō ka ā, kóō híī tū uwɔ ufi ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óndú um, eyī yá um kú ɔ̄na nyā mɛ́mla ɔwɔ ō cɛ̄ kú nū kóō yɔ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ, kóō híi wɛ awɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
idu_Latn: Ukenánīya gē leyīkwu ijē dúúdú ā á ohígbū koó jɛ́yí ijē ō gwó nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé bī ajɛ le yá ɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɛ̄cī éyi á.

eng_Latn: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka íne kú uwɔ í wɛ ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í kwú yíífi ipú ōwē kú um ā.

eng_Latn: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, tá okónu oōhɛ́ tū aá nyā mla abɔ̄ kú um á. Aá blakwu agbá nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō ményinyi aá.

eng_Latn: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gā ajɛ ɛgiyí ācɛ ā gaá le ka lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gā Éngēdi gāá lā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n cɛ̄ lɛ uwá i pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ ipú áncā, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā lɔfú hɛ́kwú ɔwɛ glá, ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī kú uwā ŋmá ɛga oligbó.

eng_Latn: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
idu_Latn: amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá háyi okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Ó ka amíyɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna ɛlā nyā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe gē bēhé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, nyɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ujɛ́futa le okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ lɛ ācɛ kú Ámɔn yálé.

eng_Latn: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú uwā tá, ācɛ í jīla awɔ eyī okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
idu_Latn: Oyéeyī kú um le mu mla unwalu mla ɔtū ōplicō, amáŋ, íne kú uwɔ ā wɛ ɔdā nōo gē cɛ̄ gā um jééyī á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro lɛ aá hīgwú, nōó lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá ka, Ɔdí wɛ úklɔ́ kú aá āa.

eng_Latn: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo mīyɛ éyi kú ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ohígbū um, kē mīyɛ um dúú.

eng_Latn: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɛka gbo, klla le okónu ce lɛ Usɔ́lu á. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ á. Amáŋ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ ga ɛga ō tayínū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka éŋkpɔ̄ kú uwɔ ká ō kwú gbēyī péee, ká ísu kú uwɔ ā ká ō tá hímmyɔ̄ ī pɛ wulɛ́wulɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anɔ̄ ólifu gē pɛ́ ā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le cɔ̄nū mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nōó lɛyí ŋ́, é géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ dúú. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo da ɔyínɛ́ nū ka, A wɛ olíla, é géē bī ɔ̄ wā ɔgbɔ́ ójīla kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē ka, Ɔdāhá, é géē je ɔ́ tá ɔlá kú ɔlíkɔtɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Íni nɛ̄ a ŋmá āa? Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi tá Óndú ā ohi kahíníī, N wā ŋmá ō yɛ ga ajɛ gicō ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ gā ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó le anyā ɔlɛ́ nū igwó nōó habɔ̄ uwā tá bá ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā, kpó tū ɛgéyi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācogbāajɛ fu kéē gbō ūwā á. Ó gē yá ɛgbá kú uwá dóódu lɛ uwá, amáŋ ó gwutá kú ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā mla odúúmā kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É bá bɛ̄ɛka anyōkwū ā jāā gbéeko ikwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da uwá kahíníī, Óndú kɛlā gā um ka.

eng_Latn: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ okónu tá lɛ ádā nū ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó piíí.

eng_Latn: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
idu_Latn: É kwū ajɛ yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ācɛnyīlɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ohéjulúgwu ā, anɔ́ɔ é gē yá kú ācɛnyīlɔ alɛwa kéē cikpó ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔnyā uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ ɔtū kú nū yéékpó glá ŋ́, gē pīya ɔtū abɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ó ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
idu_Latn: Ujése cɛ̄ lɛ Ussáma wā í yɛ, Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā í fu ɛ̄nyā ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nyā nōo tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ɛbɛ́ ī lā anú ŋ́ nyā, ipú odúúdú ipɔ́lɛ́ a, ácí klla í bū anú ɔhá kpɔ́, nɛ̄ ācogbāálá géē kpó aálá kú uwā nyɔ̄ í lúlé.

eng_Latn: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é da Ulɔ́tu kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ, a wɛ ílɔ́wá, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē da alɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá āa? Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ, ámāŋ alɔ géē yá uwɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ uwā. É le Ulɔ́tu kwu ga igbīhi, anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgiyí ɔwɛ ā kéē ca ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé géē je oyēeyī ahāapa gwɔ̄ɔ́cī kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ Ukéni ŋmó, ayíka ákú um géē wɛ ofɛtá ce igwáahāapa nēé géē bī lɛ gwɔ̄ɔ́ci á.

eng_Latn: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ mla anú ā kahíníī, Alɔ í lɔfú nɛ̄ alɔ ī mīyɛ ajɛ ā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ kú ajɛ ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
idu_Latn: Óndú alɔ, Ɔwɔicō, ācɛ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú klla lɛ ɛgahi lɛ ā, ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā. É bá í cɛ̄tra uwɔ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛháajɛ ā géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Utáma jāā ga ɛga aɔ́kpá kú Ukadesi, klla ga ɛgiyí ɛjī ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya ā.

eng_Latn: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, awɔ nōo gē héyī tū ɔ̄cɛ ā, ɔ́dáŋ ka n lɛ íne bīya, ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē yá uwɔ ā? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī fīyɛ̄ um odée igbalɛwa ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Abɔ̄ ó lɛ nɛ̄ um klla kwú pīya iyó ogbɛnú ga uwɔ ā mɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ácí nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā ɛ́ɛ í lé ā ɔ́ɔ í kpɔ nɛ̄hi. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ í lɛ ɔdōlé dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
idu_Latn: N gbeyī ká n̄ pó ɛlā nɛ̄ aá gáā ka ā, klla jāhɔ̄ ká n̄ pó ɛlā íjéeyī kú aá abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī tíne ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ī kɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó lɛ ayīnu éyi kú ɔfiyɛ kú nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ā fu tónū, ó géē hɛ́ ɔfiyɛ ā tá kóō nyɔ̄ icííci kwɛyí ayinu éyi kú nu nōo fu ā.

eng_Latn: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le da um kéē le ujɔ̄ tū tū ɔ̄ ā, n le miya ka n̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwɔ bōōbū. N kē le da ācɛ nēe kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́ ā, kéē wā í lɛ ɛlā kpó ce ɔ́ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔcɛ́ Uhérɔdu lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó junwalu lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm dúú á.

eng_Latn: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá cíkā ō gwéeyē, ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo wā í klá ayínɛ́ aá nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujúda ā ŋ́. Aá yɛ í yɛɛhɛ tū ācɛ Ujúda ipú ɛ̄cī nēé je uwá kpó yíífi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū géē he ádā kú ɔyí olɔhi mla ɔyí ō yá ucē okpaakpa dóódu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɔyí ojéeyī ma, ɔtū gē he ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Ujóna, ɔyí kú Amítāyi ká ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ipú ícɔ̄nū kú anúɔ, anúɔ le aɔ́cɛ́ kpó lɛ uwá. Amáŋ ipú íwɔ́tū kú anúɔ, anúɔ le aɔ́cɛ́ ā kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí ūwā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛ ocābɔ̄ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā ɛga ahāapa lɛ ā tá tāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ūlī tá ká anúɔ má ɔtū kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔwɛ nāa ī kɛpɔ̄ ā, le kpaakpa, a yá um italā, ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nāa gē yá ā le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unówa le héyī, nɛ̄ ejé le cá ŋmá ɔ̄ eyī, ó klla le ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔyí nū nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā yá ā jé.

eng_Latn: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si! Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú Udéfiidi! ményinyi um.

eng_Latn: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Uhadadésa má ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛ aá yálé ā, é lɛ ɛbɔ́ yá ɔtāhɛ́ kú uwā mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, anɔ́ɔ uwá kwú pīya ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi á. Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā ā, ācɛ kú Usiríya í tíne ō cɛ̄ kéē tá ācɛ Ámɔ̄n abɔ̄ gbógbóō gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
idu_Latn: Emī oŋmókókó kú ācɛ, nāa géē bī gwɔ́ɔ́lá kú igbō nyā á. Lɛ igbō ā yá ɔlá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lé ipéyī ācɛ dóódu. Ka é má uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ aéwɔhá gē wā í tūkpɛɛ́ gā um. Eko nēé le ɔ̄kā kú um pó, é gē lɛyítáajɛ gā um.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
idu_Latn: ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ Udéfīdi ā, á híī tá ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ nāa le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā kɛlā gā um ipú ɔ̄na kahíníī, Ujékɔ̄pu! N tóóhi ka, Ēē, ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ gē lɔtūce kú alɔ í mīyɛ ɔhā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū gbēyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ó kpó uwā bá ɔkpáncō ɛga nēé gáā wā ŋ́, é kē gáā bīya ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē cá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ okpaakpa alɛwa tíne kéē lɛ ɔdā nēe bá ā má, ámāŋ é kē má uwā ŋ́. É kē tíne ō lɛ ɔdā nēe bá ā pó, amáŋ é kē pó glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kéē yá, é géē kpó aá kwú géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, géē kpó aá tāgbā. É géē bī aá wā iyɔbū aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbómína ohígbū olɛhɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛfu kú Óndú ā, é yāwu ɛ̄cī ɛtá. Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā gē gbɔbū lɛ uwá eko dóódu kóō mafú ɛga ɔhá nēé géē lā ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
idu_Latn: Éyi géē ma ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga igelī kú ācɛ Ámɔn nēé hī ka Urabbá ā fu lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn. Ɔhá gē ma ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nēé lɛ igá cē tū ɔ̄ ā fú lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ n gē yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnɔ ipú odo kú um gaá kwu āa? N géē yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔtū nobí ɛ̄cī dóódu lɛ ā piyóó nɛɛ? Eko nyá nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um í yá um lé gaá kwu āa?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí igwólée ā, ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyā, nēe kpó alɔ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄fú ā. Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
idu_Latn: O yújulu mɛ́mla okwáahi í gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu glá ŋ́, é gē dɔ̄ɔka ɔdā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é gē kahíníī, Ágábá klá ɔwɛ, ágábá klá úláyi dóódu.

eng_Latn: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ijē kú ɛbɛ́ nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā lé, Ɔwɔicō í gáā ka ɔ́ tū ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
idu_Latn: É le uwá cīce lɛ eyī pīya kwu Ujósɛ̄fu, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔ́kplá ā ga ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā. Eko nēé le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ uwá cīce lɛ ā má ā, é pīyeyī má iyī uwā le kpó hídáagó.

eng_Latn: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwū kú Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n nōo gē tá Umósīsi abɔ̄ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ā kóō lɔhi, ɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā í tá ācɛ ɔhá abɔ̄ fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
idu_Latn: Kwú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ú kpó ga okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔdōwiyē kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kpó, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ mɛ́mla ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbɛ́ɛna kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā, mɛ́mla aómlede ɛpa ā mɛ́mla ómblí kú igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ eko nɛ̄ncɛ nōo yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now the LORD hath brought it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā, ɔdā nōó ka ɔ́ɔmā le yá ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dóódu ā yá aá lɛ ā, ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, klla tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nōo ka ā.

eng_Latn: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú á, ó má kéē bá í kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan A cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ yálé. A je ɔfú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē yá ɔdā dóódu nōo hi uwá ɔtū mla aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ajɛ Ukénan ā.

eng_Latn: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī gē gbɛlá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē kɛlā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛlā nɛ̄ ó géē ka ā gē ga ācɛ iyē.

eng_Latn: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
idu_Latn: N da Óndú ā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á. Óndú um, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n gē ba ā.

eng_Latn: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií le gla, ācɛ nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā wā gaá da Upíta kahíníī, Kú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú uwā dúú, ohígbū ɔkɛ̄lā ōka kú uwɔ, mafú cāā.

eng_Latn: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ́ é géē je Ɛ́dɔm yíífi bɔ̄bí lɛ ā, géē wɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī, nōo géē yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gáā gla anú eyījii.

eng_Latn: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kpó yálé. Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubɛ́njamīn úlā ofu ɛtá ce ulá ɛpa ce ofɛhɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛfu kú Abarím ā gaá lā ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu kwu Ujɔ́dan ajaajɛ, lɛyíkwu Ujɛ́rīko ā.

eng_Latn: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo tū m ɛhɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ mla um. Ó habɔ̄ um tá ōfōōfū um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú nū ā nɛ̄ n gē yá eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kwú abɔ̄ ú klá ɔnyīlɔ ā eyī kpɔ́. Eko nyā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ó pléyī kú nū lɔfú lɔfú anɔ́ɔ ō gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā dóódu má péee á.

eng_Latn: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
idu_Latn: É géē na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó kú uwā piíí ohígbū nēé géē kwú. Ɛ̄nya wɛ íne nɛ̄ uwá mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā géē le tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyi, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nya īyī nū tá glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔfú cíla Ɔwɔicō ulé kú oyēeyī kú nū glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ó géē cílá ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā ɛga ahāapa. Ó géē je odúúdú iyó kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó cílá ulé ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā, N géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ kú ā kɛlā, n kē í dā uwɔ ɛlá nāa í ka ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le ɛ̄nyā ka bōōbū ā, ayí kú Udéfīdi kwú pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō jikwú. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū klla gbɔɔ́ ō jikwú gbōmgbōm mɛ́mla uwá.

eng_Latn: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
idu_Latn: N géē je odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nōo bá ajɛ kú aá kpó yíífi, klla í kpó aínɔ̄ɔda kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú aá ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā tóohi kahíníī, N da aá ka, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe lɛ odée ā, é kōō í je lɛ uwá fíyɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ó kōō wɛ oligíí nōó lɛ ā, é géē mīyɛ ɔ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
idu_Latn: Aá klla géē gbɛlá kwu otɛtɛ nɛ̄ aá ī yúúfi ācɛ nēe ī miyɛ ije ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē da lɛ aéwɔhá ā. Amáŋ é kē gáā bá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā le yá gaá i yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ, ákú ugóolu glá ā le bī gé lɛ Óndú ā. Ācɛ dóódu nēe lɛ ɔcí kú akésiya ā le uwá kpó wā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
idu_Latn: Igbɔ́mahāapa ā, ó pīyɛyí wā í ka ka anúɔ má ojuja nōó nwuné fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ísu. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ í da Áhābu kóō lɛ úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū tútū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ gbɔ̄bū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔwɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ hɛ́ ɔ̄ tū ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í da Ɛláyíja kóō nyɔ̄ í gbɔga ɔlɛ́ ɔnyōkwū ɔhá dúúmā gwū ɔnyōkwū kú Usárefāti, ipú ajɛ kú Usídɔn ā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ōwē nōó í má mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ikɔkɔ nōó géē má abahi kú ɔdā olɔnyɛ kú íneoōbīya nɛ̄ ó gē gbojī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá nɛ̄ abɔ̄ ā tá tū ɔdɔ ā yɔ̄ á: É lɛ ɔ́ gbaáluka ɛɛ́, é lɛ ɔ́ miya ɛɛ́, é le ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le Udéfīdi má ā, ó lɛ ɔ́jiji tēyī nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ó má ka ó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄nɛ̄ncɛ́, ó klla joklóbīya ō má eyī.

eng_Latn: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā ayínɛ́ um, ohígbū eyīnyinyi ce eyīnyinyi alɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō má ā n gē lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá, ká aá kwú iyī aá ú bɛ̄ɛka ɛya nēé gwó oyēeyī lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ká aá kwú ɔtū ká aá ú tá ká aá cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ɔwɛ nōo í he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām lā ajɛ kú Ufilístiya yɛɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē lā ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā aá. Aá géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē ī wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá āa.

eng_Latn: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: É le má ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kwú ɛcɔ̄ nēé míya kwū okónu únóji gbɔbū ā ú míya ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɔ́ mla eyīnyinyi kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe í bī ɔdā nēé nwū nyā le yúklɔ́, ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Ísrɛ̄lu kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē gbā ulé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú nū le bū ipú ɔlá nōó yi tāajɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ayisáya ka ā le cɛ̄ ɛyí uwā. Ó kahíníī, Aá géē pó, amáŋ aá gáā jɛ́yí ɔdā nɛ aá pó ā ŋ́. Á kú ɛbɛ ā, aá géē má, amáŋ aá kē gáā jɛ́yí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
idu_Latn: É da uwá kéē blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ákan, ɔyí kú Uséra tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā ohígbū ɔdēelihɔ kú ífi ā. Óndú ā le odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá italā ohígbū nū. Ó wɛ Ákan ofōōfūnū kwú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄tra iyē kú Óndú ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kē géē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ ā í gáā wɔ́tū aá glá ŋ́, amáŋ ó gē wɔ́tū um ohígbū ka n cījáalí ka úklɔ́ kú nū wɛ obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā, ami, Unebúkádinēsa cɛ̄tra, klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔkpáncō. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī úklɔ́ kú nū le kpaakpa, ɔwɛ kú nū dóódu lɔhi. Ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā, ó gē tá uwā wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbō ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē kpaakpa lɛyíkwu ɔ́mpa uwā ā. Ó klla ī gbō ācɛ nōo ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, káā le bēé nyɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā kéē lɛ aá má.

eng_Latn: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le ɛbɛ má kwɛyí, klla le ijē jē mɛ ā, ó le tá ɛyí ede kú ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ í klla ī wīyā ejé, ī gwíjē ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ejé ā kwú mákáká tū uwá okónu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛtá ce úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛtá ce ofu igwɛ́ɛpa cigwó .

eng_Latn: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācohumɔtū, aá híīī pɛ̄cí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
idu_Latn: O má eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ā gē fíyáajɛ bɛ̄ɛka o má eyī kú aɛ́cɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nēé hī ka ujáspa mɛ́mla Ukanéliyan ā. Ɔwohɔgwa nōo yɔ̄ ī fíyáajɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́mɛ̄radi lɛ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā yɛjīlatá.

eng_Latn: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati klla gbāajɛ ipú ɛbɔ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɛbɔ́ je lɛ ɔ́ klla lɛ ɔ́ gbō ŋmá unwalu āyā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Udéfīdi klá ɛyí ɛfu, nēé le igá olɔfú hɛ́ tū ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ōhī gaá mīyɛ Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m tābɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gbɔbū kú ɛwa ā le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ kóō yɔ̄ cíí. Amáŋ ó kōō dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛɛcɛ fíyɛ́ ka, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfiidi! Ményinyi um.

eng_Latn: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔkpani, ɔ́dāŋ ka n kwúce ga ɛgiyí ádā um nɛ̄ n bī ɔyí ā nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó le jé ka ɔyí ā í yɔ̄ mɛ́mla um ŋ́, ó géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a má ikpó kú ojibó ā, nɛ̄ ɛga ōhī kú ikpó ō daajɛ ā wɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ̄ āyā ɔhá ā wɛ oje ā. Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē je kɔ̄ ɛpa. Éyi kú nū géē lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka oje ā ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a má ipú ɔnā lɛ ā oje mɛ́mla ɔmɛ wīya tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔ́da je lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Aá da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā kahíníī, N lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ aá kú aá lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔ̄nyɛ ɔ́ɔ géē yá ká anúɔ jé ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā nū lɛ ohi kú ícɔ̄nū tá ɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka lɛ uwá ā. É le aɔ́dā o bī yíifa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu mɛ́mla oje udɔ mɛ́mla īlī kpó ba ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ a gē je oyēeyī kú alɔ tónu, klla gē kwu ikwū ajaajɛ eko dóódu ā?.

eng_Latn: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛnwú ā kla tū abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó lé tú ɔwɔɔwɛ nyɔ̄ á. Ó le je lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū. Anɔ́ɔ é le lé, amáŋ ó da uwá ɛga nōó bī ɛnwú ā ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
idu_Latn: É le ujɔ̄ tū ipú Ujerúsālɛm kéē lɛ Amásīya ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó le jé, kwú kwu ga igelī kú Ulákissi. Amáŋ aólɛlā kú nū ā nū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gaá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka odúúmā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nyā í háyi ipú ójīla kú um ɔkpáncō jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kóō pó ɛlā kú um klla jɛ́yí nū ŋ́. Odúúmā kú uwā í kē jāhɔ̄ kéē pó ɛlā kú um jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ agbénú kú ɛbɔ́ɔ́lɛ́, ígwu alɛwa mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā gbɔɔ́ ō má ɔ̄ imálānyī á.

eng_Latn: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, eko nya nɛ̄ a géē mā ɛlā nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī ka ā tá ā? Ɔ́dāŋ ka a ī gbo ohílīpú lɔɔlɔhi, alɔ lɔfú kɛlā mɛ́mla uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin nēé tū kwú okónu ɔkpá ā. Abɔ́ɔ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā, ɔcí ufáyin ā yɔ̄ ī lū ēpū klla ī gwá īkpō lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā le kpó hídáagó, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō da iyí uwā kahíníī, Ɛlā okónu kú nū lɔfú klla lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi. Ɔ́nyīlɔ nyā bī ikwu mɛ́mla ɔfú í le dɛ̄gba tū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí, é kē ī bɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Urefáya, ɔyí kú Uhɔ́ɔ, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú āyā éyi kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ma ɔdɔ kú nū gboce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
idu_Latn: lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā ā. Aá lɛ ojíleyī kú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci hī. Ɔfú kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē yɔ̄ mla aá abɔ̄ aá géē jīla ā. N kē géē yɔ̄ mla aá ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
idu_Latn: É gē jé ufi ō yá ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē kwu ŋmá ɔnɛ́fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā géē mīyɛ ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā. Ó géē kpó agbénú kú uwa tɛ́cɔ̄ tū ipú ísu. É kē í je igelī nɛ̄hi ā yɔlá tā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ ga um, aá nēe jé ɔdā okpaakpa, nēe klla bī íne kú um ɔtū ā. Aá kóō híī yúúfi eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ī cá aá ɛcá, klla ī ŋmó aá okónu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
idu_Latn: N má ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā wu abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú anú nōo cīīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. É lɛ ɔkpá tá tū abɔ̄ ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ɔkpá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔja hɛ́ bá ɔ̄ ɛga ahāapa á.

eng_Latn: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko eyī Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lɛ Upássɔ, ɔyí kú Umalkíya mɛ́mla Usefaníya, ɔyí kú Umaaséya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, tɛ̄hɔ̄ fú um. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kē le ɛlā ka gā um lɛyíkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā kú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa yálé le tá ahɔ̄ kú Ujábin, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhásɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujóbābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Umádɔn, mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ussímrɔn, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ kú Ákissāfu.

eng_Latn: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ipéyī ācɛ ka aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, n kē géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā keé wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcányā kú Ussɛ́ba ba ŋmá ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn ā, ó le kpó lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwúcē le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aórɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nyā, le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Ugɛdalíya, ipú ajɛ kú Umíspa mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ uwá ā. Aótrɛ̄yí ā wɛ Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Unɛtánīya, mɛ́mla Ujohánan mɛ́mla Ujónátan, ayí kú Ukaréya, mɛ́mla Useráya, ɔyí kú Utanhúmēti, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ɛfāyi nōo ŋmá Unétofa ā, mɛ́mla Ujɛsaníya, nōo ŋmá Umáaka ā.

eng_Latn: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
idu_Latn: Inu kú okómpinu o yɛ ga eyīpú nū á, mɛ́mla aúwíndo, mɛ́mla aífotó kú alī nēé kpó tū ɔ̄ ā wɛ ékpónú bɛ̄ɛka ákú okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, agidigbé ikpó ahāapa yɛ ga okómpinu ā. Ipú inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā yɔ̄ oŋmɛ́yí lɛ eyī pīya kwú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
idu_Latn: É tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwá, é bī usɔ́ɔ le uwá hɛ́ ɛpa, é bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī le uwá kpó ŋmó. É bá ī yɛ lɛ ɔkpá ɛwū mɛ́mla ɔkpá álá tū ohí. É bá ipú ɛhá mɛ́mla ɛ́kɛma, é klla yá uwā ōwē.

eng_Latn: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā géē má ɛ̄nyā, é géē cɔ̄nū, í hīlayīnu, ɔtū í wú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ é klla gekwú. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē leyīce í gē yá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ōwē nɛ̄hi géē yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɛdɔ nū í yɔ̄ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ŋmá eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ gbɔɔ́ ā jāā kwu abālɔbányā, nōó kē gáā yɔ̄ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
idu_Latn: O yɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, ɔnyīlɔ éyi le Upíta má anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, A wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ō yɛce Ujísɔ̄si dúú! Amáŋ Upíta tóohi kahíníī, N wɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄ uwɔ eyī míyámíyá ā, ó lɛ ɛlá obɔ̄bí éyi gbō ipú ɔtū kú nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ī yíihɔtū klla ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ, ó gē cɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́, ó klla le mu mla ihɔtū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē nɛ̄ ó lɛ alelékwū ŋ́ gekwú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ō cɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó lɛ úklɔ́ ŋ́ kwú lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā bɔ̄bí ŋ́. Amáŋ aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá.

eng_Latn: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó wɛ igbō nēé gē yá ipú ákánjɔ, é géē bī umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ le yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē bīya um ojīlīmā ɛgiyí aéwo nēe má um kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, n yá lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ olɔhi lɛ ɛna, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ kē lɛ ɛna nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe tá Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kē tá ádā ā dúú. Ācɛ nēe mīyɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kē mīyɛ Ádā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɛpa wā í le gla, anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ í wā ɔnwū kú aálá kú nū, Ubaalu Uhásɔ nōo kwu Ɛfrēm ajaajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú ayí-ɔ́cɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kpó hīgwú wā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛga oligbó. Ó yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi. Ɔlá mɛ́mla ódūdū nɛ̄hi kē le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá. Ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ɛlā kú nū ā kē ī yi odée tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fenced cities, and of country villages, even unto the great stone of Abel, whereon they set down the ark of the LORD: which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua, the Bethshemite.
idu_Latn: Ifú kú ugóolu ɛhɔ̄ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kē kwɛyí aígelī nɛ̄hi éyéeye nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufilístiya gē gbō ā. Kwu aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aéyīpɔ́lɛ́ nēé hɛ́ igá tū ɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é hɛ́ iga tū ŋ́ mā. Ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ujóssuwa nōo lā Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi nēé je ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ce ā kwu abɔ́ɔ jāā kwú ícɛ nyā, kóō wɛ ɔdā ijáalí lɛ alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ̄nyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cohumɔtū, a jɔ̄ɔncɛ́nyā klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ihɔtū yá kú eyī kú uwɔ kóō yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
idu_Latn: É kwú utébulu ā ú háyi ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɛhícō ukɔ́tin ā.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā nmúleyīkwū tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā fíya. É kahíníī, Odúúdú alɔ géē pɛ́ kwú ɔ́dāŋ ka aá pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa ā. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka únóji nēé bī áfū le nya ɔ́, nɛ̄ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú nū lɔhi ō má, amáŋ nɛ̄ ikpokwú kú okwū mɛ́mla ɔdōblínyī dóódu le mu eyīpu nū ā.

eng_Latn: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Anú ōfōōfūnū gē yá ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄hi dóódu á, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ kú nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
idu_Latn: N tíne ō ka kpɔ́ ka-é je ɔyí nōo í lúgwū agbénú kú ádā nū ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔyí obene kpɔ́ ā, nááná nɛ̄ anú kōō wɛ óndú kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī agbénú ā a.

eng_Latn: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
idu_Latn: Uséra mɛ́mla Ussɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nū lé ka, Ahínōwam, adá kú Ahímāas. Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū wɛ Ábna, ɔyí kú Únɛ́ɛ́, ɔmáapu ádā nū.

eng_Latn: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɔkplɛ́fú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó lɛ aá a kpó tū iyē abālɔbányā! Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī obɔ̄bī ā gā, aá gáā kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔlɛlā nōo kpɔ́fú kwu aá ā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ unu nu kwɛyí nɛ̄ aá géē háyi glá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ɔtūnōbí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jikwū eko nāa lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó, aá nēe lā ɛháajɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ohígbū ka odúúdú ācotɔ́sú nēe gē miya oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ ācɛ ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɛlá kwu aíne kú uwɔ, klla ī leyī yɛ ɔdā nāa yɔ̄ ī nwū ā.

eng_Latn: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ gē nwū ɔ̄cɛ nōo le tútū ō pó ā gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu mɛ́mla ayīnu adāgbá á.

eng_Latn: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ācɛ le ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kpó gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá, amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū da ācɛ ā kéē wā í junwalu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ tá ipú igelī ā gaá lɛ ɔdā dóódu má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da uwá ā kpɛ́mm. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú onyatá ā tútū abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ń kē lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ɔdā dúúmā abɔ̄yī um ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē hápápá nyɔ̄ í tayínū gbēyī umŋ ā.

eng_Latn: After these things the LORD appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odée nyā le yá kwɛyí ā, Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ nēe yɛce ɔ́ ofɛtá cigwó ɔhá fu, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá ɛpɛɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ gɔbū ga igelī mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu nōó miya ka anúɔ gáā nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da Udéfīdi ipácí abɔ́ɔ ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ijáalí kú aá abɔ́ɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɛlā kú nū ā da ádā anúɔ óócí ámāŋ ɛ̄cīhɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ́ kɛlā olɔhi lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́, anúɔ géē tɛhɔ̄ fu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō ka iŋini, da iyi uwá ɔ̄kā ka Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē gwá āa.

eng_Latn: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō lɛ ācoyímabɔ̄, aɔ́hɛ, ācɛ nēe ī bī aínyílɔ́wɔ lɛ jé ɔdā nōo ī yá ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācojééyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó wā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da ācojééyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔkpá nēé tá tū ɔdɔ nyā jé, nōó klla lɛ ɛyí nū ka ga um, n géē je awulú nɔ̄wá kú ɔcɛ́ wu ɔ́ iyē, n klla í lɛ agbá oje ɔdɔ tū ɔ̄ ɔkɔ. Anú klla géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ipú ajɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um á.

eng_Latn: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā gaá lɛ úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā má ā, ɔtū he ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɔfú tū odúúdú uwā iyē kéē háyi kli lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá ɔtū ékpó.

eng_Latn: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ um ka gē yi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Ó klla lɔfú lɛbɛ̄ɛka omútāgā, nōo gē ca aɛ́cɔ̄ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá má gwōnū tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé bū ā ɛɛ́. Ukpa nēe jē ā le uwá kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō má ka, ofíyajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla obū kɔ̄ hī uwā tá á.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ íne ékpónú bīya, ó lɛ ā odúúdú íne ā nōó bīya dúú á.

eng_Latn: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uharím wɛ, ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
idu_Latn: Aá gbā ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ā lɛ uwá. Aá gbā ɛdɔ ijɔ̄lɛ́ dúú nēé da aá ka aá gbā ā, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce odúúdú uwā.

eng_Latn: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dóódu nɛ̄ Umósīsi le tá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, ó gē kpó īlī ā ŋmá eyī, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ó gā ɛcɛ. Eko nɛ̄ó gā ɛcɛ, ó gē da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ɔ́ kóō ka ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn tá Óndú ā ohi ka ɔ́ɔ ma ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā fú lɛ Udéfīdi, ádā anúɔ, eko dóódu. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ yá ucē okpaakpa lɛyíkwu ɔ̄, ɔ́ɔ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ klla lɛ ɔtū ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ipú ɛma kú nū mla anú. Usólōmɔn da Óndú ā kpɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ma ihɔtū nōo ī pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́ mā fú lɛ ádā anúɔ gɔbū, oŋmá ō je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ ɔ́ kóō cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
idu_Latn: Ó í je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū nōo wɛ omlede kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyi ohígbū íne nɛ̄ó bīya ā. Ó klla í bī omlede kú iháyí éyi ɔhá kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, Ujóssuwa, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla aá ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔ́mpa nū, nēe ī yúklɔ́ ɛhájɛ nū ā, aá wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú ɔdā olɔhi nōo géē yá ɛcɔ̄bū á. N géē mafú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nēé hī ka Ābɔ̄ ā!.

eng_Latn: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ n gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī gē hɛ́ce iyɔ̄bū alɔ kóō tíne ɛga nɛ alɔ géē yɛ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ géē cē áklɔ́kpɛ́ kú alɔ ce cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ mlɛ́nyɔ́, ā ó ka ɔ́ɔ gē gbɔ̄bū lɛ alɔ bɛ̄ɛka alɔ́ ofíyajɛ nɛ̄hi ā otú mɛ́mla bɛ̄ɛka ojuja nɛ̄hi ā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
idu_Latn: Lɛ okónu nāa ce lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā, yá lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ipú ɛbɛ nōó má ā, ó gaá lɛ odúúdú nū kpó ka lɛ Udéfīdi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n hī uwɔ igwú ā, a le ohi tá um, a klla le ɔfú tá um iyē ŋmá lɛ ɔtū nāa le tū um ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ igbo ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ayíkpó ā yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, ŋmá eko nēé je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, lɛ ācɛ ōhī tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Ujɔ́pa, kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Usáyímɔ̄n Upíta ā hīgwú wā. Iyē nū ɔhá lé ka Upíta.

eng_Latn: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá tá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ipú unwalu abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ aá yɔ̄ ī yá íne nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nwū ā gajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́kɔ kú ayíkpó kú nū ā yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Úgbagwú yɔ̄ i junwalu lɛ ɔ́, ohígbū ka owu yɔ̄ gē tá lɛyíkwu ɛga nēé ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī ga iyāwu nyā ōhī ŋmá Utéma, é kē bá ī tíne éŋkpɔ̄. Aɔ́há kú uwā ŋmá Ussɛ́ba, é klla bá ī leyīce ka aá géē má éŋkpɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.
idu_Latn: Aá jégédē tū um ɛhɔ̄ ka amíyɔ̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Uyáwɛ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, ohígbū aá, ka ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā ɔ́ɔ ka ā, nɛ̄ aá géē yá á. Amáŋ onyíleyī nōo ī ŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá yá á.

eng_Latn: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛbɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ aá lɔfú lé ā gekwú, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú nū, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ipú ācɛ kú Ukénan, Uhɛ́ti, Ámɔ̄ri, Upɛ́risi, Uhám, mɛ́mla Ujɛ́būsi á.

eng_Latn: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔkpani nū je ɔnyā lɛ ɔ́ á nɛɛ, nɛ̄ó le ayínɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ á nɛɛ, ɔnyā ā mɛ́mla ayí nū ā géē wɛ ákú ɔkpani nū ā. Ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ōfōōfūnū géē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
idu_Latn: Ofu nū ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ɔlékwū ā pó ā.

eng_Latn: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔ́da kú nū, ó kwú uwā í kwu aɛ́ga nēé kwu piyóó nēé kē gáā tá ɔ́da ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ mla abɔ̄fú mɛ́mla íkwu kú nū, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó wɛ ucē kú ɛna ā, tɛtɛ kóō lɛ ajī tū ɔ̄cɛ, nēé le ka lɛ óndú kú ɛna ā, igbo alɛwa, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú ɔ̄ wāajɛ ŋ́ má, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋmó, é géē bī ɛcɔ̄ le ŋmó ɛna ā, é klla géē ŋmó óndú kú ɛna ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ cɛ lɛ ɔ́ yá uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kpɔ́tūce Óndú ā ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē nya aá tá ŋ́. Ámāŋ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē ci aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya o wā ī yá igelī nyā lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī ka gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā da aá ka, Má ɔ̄, Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ amānyā, ámāŋ má ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, aá híī cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɔ́dɛkāyi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gāá le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɛ́sta ka ā kpó yá á.

eng_Latn: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
idu_Latn: É le aálá, aɛ́na, aíjakī mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā kpó wu.

eng_Latn: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
idu_Latn: Ń má Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi dúúmā ipú igelī ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá ā kwɛyí Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá kú okónu nēé gwū nyā, Ɛ́sta le ifa kú ɔcɛ́nyā kú nū yá le tá ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́, gaá háyi lɛ eyī pīya kwu akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpaakpa. Ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ipú inu, cīce ɛyí akpa kú nū, leyī pīya kwu ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le yá ká odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kéē lɛ okónu ce kéē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛka nēé gbo mla Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ā tū.

eng_Latn: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú nū yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú ígbíli á. Aá lɛ ɔwɛ ā gllágwó lɛ Óndú ā. aá lɛ ɔgwu kú nū nā kpaakpa kóō yɛ.

eng_Latn: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
idu_Latn: Ucē alɛwa ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā, nááná ó lɛ ucē dúú nōó lɛyí ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā kē le Uhɛ́ssbɔn, Ɛlíle, Ukɛnyatéyim.

eng_Latn: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da iyī nū kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ā yɔ̄ á. N géē ca aɔ́bā kú um tāajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ aɛ́nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ uwā kpó gwó. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ n géē kpó ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɔhá kú um tū á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā, ɛ́ɛ gwó abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gwɛ́ɛ́ya nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē lé ɛbɛ́ kú nū klla géē pīya oyī kú nū bá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
idu_Latn: Utáánāki, Umegído.

eng_Latn: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú aájɛ éwɔhá ā mɛ́mla aájɛ nēe bá ɛga oligbó ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā má ɛɛ́. Ufi nɛ̄hi kē lɛ uwá kwú, é kē bá ī fīyégbúlú. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú uwá le jīla klla gē wā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ga um á. Ayí nū géē bá í lé ɔcɛ́ igbīhi nū piyóó, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ í gáā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
idu_Latn: Bla kwu Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo ŋmá ipú ɔ́mā kú Ɔcɛ́ Udéfīdi āa, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna nū ka lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
idu_Latn: Ujohánan ɔyí kú Uhákātan ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Asigádi mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwó.

eng_Latn: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je uwá pīya ācɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ódúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nōó yá ā. Ka ɔ́ɔ í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ojīlīmā, ocɛ̄tra, mɛ́mla ɛgahi. Ka uwá ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā abɔ̄yī nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā. Ífi nyā nōó miya kéē ŋmɛ́yí ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ aá géē lɛ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔtū lé eko nɛ̄ ɔkpani aá lɛ aá ŋmíje ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bī nɛ̄ aá yá ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔkpani aá lɛ aá ŋmíje ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yá, Ɔwɔicō géē hɔ́hā ce aá.

eng_Latn: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um nōo he um ɔtū ā yɔ̄ á, ɛlā kú nū kē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛnyā ā, é hī iyē kú abɔ̄ ka Ubábɛlu, ohígbū kā abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ucē nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ yɔ̄ ī ka ā gbájí á.
