eng_Latn: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla Udéfīdi tū ujɔ̄ tū anúɔ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī lɛ ɔ́ ā? Ɔdíya nɔ́ɔ da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā lɛ ɔ́ āa? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka o ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya lɛyíkwu anɔ́ɔ klla gē dɔɔ̄kā ɛga nɔ́ɔ géē je anúɔ ŋmó ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā kú Abíssɔ́ɔ wɛ Abíhēlu. Ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa lɛ ɔ́. Aában mɛ́mla Umólidi.

eng_Latn: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔtū kú alɔ í ŋmó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, alɔ lɔtū ékpó iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kwú dobú tū uwɔ nɛ̄ á klla mɛ́ɛbɛ glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi klla le cēenyi kwú uwɔ mulɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē kwú aá bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ ewɔhá. Ɛmiyɛ géē kpó aótrɛ̄yí kú aá ŋmó. Ijēēnyi ké ī kpó ācɛ ohile kú ɔlɛ́ aá ŋmó.

eng_Latn: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é jāhɔ̄ gā um ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú uwā da uwá kéē yá ā nēé bá ī yá á. É kwúcē hɛ́ um tá klla kwú igbihi ú cē kwu um.

eng_Latn: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
idu_Latn: Okolo nɛ̄ n le miya igwu lɛ Usamérīya ā, nɛ̄ n klla le miya igwu lɛ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ayááyí nū ā, nɛ̄ n géē lɛ miya igwu lɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm dúú á. N géē kpó ācɛ nyā ŋmá ipú Ujerúsālɛm péee ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī īlī ī le nya ocíbú péee klla ī pīya ɔ́ eyī kláajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Ádā alɔ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gē yá alɔ italā eko kpií, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o he uwá ɔtū lɛ ā, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō gē yá alɔ italā o yá kóō le lɔhi lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá ká ālɔ̄ tīihɔ bɛ̄ɛka anú ā.

eng_Latn: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
idu_Latn: Ó gē mīyɛ íjéeyī kú aótrɛ̄yí hɛ̄ uwá abɔ̄ tá. Ó klla ī je aɔ́cɛ́ jɛɛ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
idu_Latn: Aá kócōō lɛ okónu ce gā um, ācɛnyā kú Ujerúsālɛm, Aá lɛ ɔkpá gbo oŋmá lɛ iyē kú īkpɛ̄ɛnū mɛ́mla ulúu, ká aá í gáā junwula lɛ alɔ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔnyɛ kú ihɔtū kú alɔ jé kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ujóssuwa kwú omlɛ́nyɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce uwá okónu ō je ā ú lɛ uwá nɛɛ, Ɔwɔicō í géē yɛ í kɛlā igbīhāajɛ ohígbū ɛ̄cī ā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ eko kú Unówa ā nōó gáā lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā ā á.

eng_Latn: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssmɛ̄lu lā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Uhavíla mɛ́mla Ussɔ́ɔ, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Íjīpiti, ɔwɛ o yɛ lɛyíkwu Asírīya. É lā ɛgɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ébrahām ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ uwá piyóó, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ulɔ́tu le igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ bákánjɔ̄, ó le ucɛ yá lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é le lé á.

eng_Latn: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, ɔtū he um, n klla yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē, ɔdā dúúmā í kē gáā yá um glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
idu_Latn: Ubálam da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ede ahāapa gwó gā um amānyā, kú n̄ lɛ ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla omlede ahāapa kpó wā.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki le ɛhɔ̄ tū, lɛ Áyísīki hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔnyā uwɔ nōó wɛ á. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a ka ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ anúɔ nɔ̄nyā āa? Áyísīki tóohi kahíníī, N gbɛlá keé géē ŋmó um, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n ka koó wɛ ɔnyā um.

eng_Latn: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā pó. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yúúfi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kú uwā í gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
idu_Latn: É le bla ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ī gbō aá á, ka anú ɔ́ɔ klla nya aá tá á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu wɛ iháyí ofucigwó eko nōó gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ Uféro kú Íjīpiti ɛhɔ́ ā. Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá agbla kú ɔcɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kpó jila bilíbilí á.

eng_Latn: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē gwō Ɛ́dɔm ɔ́ci gā um piíí, é í yá ka Ɛ́dɔm ā ká ō jɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ícɔ̄nū kú um lɔnɔ lɛ aā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ɛ́dɔm géē jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ká n̄ gwū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ci ā. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá gē gwɛ́ɛya ɛga ɔhá ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū nēé bā ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō um lɔfúlɔfú á, n kē lɔtūce ɔ́. Ó gē tá um abɔ̄ klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he um. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē gwíijē kú éeyē í cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le pó kóō gē kɛlā lɛ uwá ɔkɔ kú ucē kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, é bá cíí fíyɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
idu_Latn: Ujókím, nōo wɛ ádā kú ācɛ nēe lā Ukóséba mɛ́mla Ujówāsi mɛ́mla Usárafu nōo lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá Umówābu, nōo gaá lā Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin ā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ āa? N géē tū ɔyí ékpó kú um nyɔ̄. É géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ piíí.

eng_Latn: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔyípōklóbīya ā má ka Usɔ́ɔlu ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ ma, ó le īyī nū tá gwū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú abɔ̄yī nū klla le īyī nū ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jégēdē lɛ íne bīya, ó kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ-ɔlɛ́ ámāŋ éwɔhá, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ eyī gwō Óndú ā bónū, é géē je ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é le ɔ́ yáágbe ohígbū ɔbíipú nɛ̄ alɔ bī ā. É le ɔ́ iyē ca tāpū ohígbū ucē obɔ̄bí kú alɔ. Italā nēé yá ɔ̄ ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɛbɔ́ á. Itali nēé gɔ́ ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kē hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá ōcē á.

eng_Latn: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɛ ɔdā nōo gē yá ā má ɛɛ́. Ā lɛ okónu klá gɛ ŋ́. A híī yɛ ligbō hɛ́ um tá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore saith the LORD, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ aá kwú pīya aólɛlā kú um ɛɛ́ mā, n géē bī ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú um lɛ gwū aá ɔ́ci piíí.

eng_Latn: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli kú oŋmɔ́cī nū, é le aɛ́bɛ́ ōhī kpó wā kéē wɛ ɛya o yiɔlá dúúdú, anɔ́ɔ é le aóhī ā he lé kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɛbɔ́. Ācɛ ā má báajɛ pɛtɛɛ kéē lé ucɛ. Ucɛ klla kwú pīya tá ejé ō gwá mɛ́mla ikpɔ́nyā ō ce.

eng_Latn: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Ujóssuwa le ɔ́da je lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā kahíníí.

eng_Latn: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka uwá ī nyɔ̄ iyāwu ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū iyē kú anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. É kē mīyɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ opɛ́cí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō í habɔ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu, nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ō tū ā tá ŋ́, aá gbɛlá ka ó géē habɔ̄ aá tá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe je pīya ɔ̄cɛ oogbō álá kú ācɛ mla ɔcɛ́ ɔlɛ nū á, uwá kē ī lā ɛbɔ́. Amáŋ Óndú āgēe tū ɔkpɛtā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi klá aá, Ufilístiya. Ó kē gāa mā abɔ̄ Odúúmā kú aá tá oyēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dúúmā í gáā lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú um ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄coleyīyɛpa í gáā yɔ̄ ɛgiyí um ŋ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
idu_Latn: Ɔhā yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, klla í yá uce okpaakpa eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācohumɔtū, eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ā, aá mīyɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē nwū ā. Ó kōō cɛgbá fíyɛ́ kú aá lɛyítáajɛ gā um abālɔbányā nɛ̄ ń yɔ̄ mla aá gɛ ŋ́ mā ā. Aá bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dúúmā kóō hile ŋmá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē yá ā ŋ́, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō dúúdú abɔ̄ aá gē yá ɛ̄nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tíne ō jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā ɔhá, amáŋ, ń má ɛyí nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N lɔfú má ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ékpónú ŋmá ipú ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwo nɛ̄ n lɔfú lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ glá. Amáŋ, ń má ɔ̄cɛnyā ékpónú ŋmá ipú ulá ɛpa ce ofigwó dóódu nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
idu_Latn: Eléélelé! Ɛ̄cī kú Óndú ā le kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē kpó aɔ́dā dóódu yíífi.

eng_Latn: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú iyāwu kú uwā ā, eko dóódu nɛ̄ ojuja ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā nɛɛ, é gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
idu_Latn: Aá má aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō. É gē nyi ŋ́, é gē cē ŋ́, é kē ī kpó tū ɔbá ŋ́. Nááná Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, gē je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá. Ó wɛ aá tīle fíyɛ́ uwá ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka abɔ́ɔ ā, ɛ́ɛ géē gbā aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ páhɔ̄ ámāŋ lé ɔdōlé ámāŋ hípī glá ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá ŋmá ɔcí ámāŋ ka ɛcɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu gē kɛlā alɛwa nōo wɛ áncā. Ó kē ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdā alɛwa nōó jɛ́yí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó gē je ojuja bá ɔkpáncō, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē nwūla ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ísu kóō pɛ́ ā, n yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
idu_Latn: Aá má abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó kú um, kú aá jé koó wɛ ami abɔ̄yī um nɛ. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu um kú aá má ɔ̄. Aá géē jé ka n lɛ ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla ikpokwú cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē cɛ̄ ka ami nɛ. Ń wɛ inambo ŋ́. Ohígbū ka inambo í gē lɛ ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla ikpokwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é lɔfú lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō gbla ɔcɛ́ éyi nōo tíne kóō gbo ije kú nū nōo bá abɔ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā áluka.

eng_Latn: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá ipú inu kú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gaá le igbō nēé ī le ce iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā kpó lé. Ó kē wɛ íne ō bīya kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú kóō lé, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ācogwɛ́ɛya ōfōōfū ūwa cíkā ō lé á.

eng_Latn: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu lɛ ɔ̄na nyā nā kwɛyí ā, alɔ le tútū ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ Umasɛdónīya, Ohígbū ka alɔ le ɔ́ ŋmótū ka Ɔwɔicō hī alɔ igwú ká ālɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ géē túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū. Odúúdú aéwo klla í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
idu_Latn: É klla kwú usɔ́bɛ̄lu mla ɔdā ō gwu ewo kú ɛyí ede tū ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́, mɛ́mla ocíbú nēé gē hɛ́ oyī kú ɛbɛ ɛya ōgwo nōo gē wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ede ā tū ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ocíbú o yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ipú nū, mɛ́mla íyó kú oje udɔ ɔhá dóódu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ayí aá italā klla í lɛ ácílubu kú ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē bī le gwɛ́ɛya ā nyā aá eyī. N klla géē nū aá bɛ̄cɛ ga ɛga nēé gē pīya ácílubu kú ɛbɛ́ bónū ā.

eng_Latn: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ō yá jīla kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɛ ga odúúdú ajɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ógu, nōo wɛ ámōōmɛ kú ewo kú ācɛ Urɛ̄fém, nɛ̄ ó gē gbō Ássitárɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Ɛ́dreyi. Umósīsi tɛtɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā yálé, le uwá nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
idu_Latn: amáŋ, igbīhāajɛ kú nū ā hɔ́ɔnɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́lɛ á. Ó klla í lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄cɛ fíyɛ́ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ō le gwū ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí kú Ɛ́dɔm ā tá alácɛ̄, klla í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gáā bū ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nōó tá igbō ā blla okónu kú Ámnɔn ā, ó kpákli bī ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā í gwutá mɛ́mla anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
idu_Latn: Kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ká ā nyɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá gā awɔ ā. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā le yɛ bū ipú igelī ā yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
idu_Latn: Ujíyɛ, ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanasɛ éyi klla nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛfú kpó tú aígelī nɛ̄hi ōhī klla mīyɛ uwá, kwú iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ í kpó ce uwá ka aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujíyɛ.

eng_Latn: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ī cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ um á. Ɔwɔicō kú um ī gbo um á.

eng_Latn: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwóléyi ā, Upagíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ɔ́kran ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa géē bī aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā nēe bá ā:.

eng_Latn: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, aá nēe gē gbō ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Aá gē je ɛlā kú Óndú ā ka ɛflɛ́ɛfu eko dóódu. Óndú ā gē ka ka.

eng_Latn: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ nyā nōo le íjééyī nyā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ keé le jé nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í je Óndú nōo lɔhi klla tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā nyɔ́kpá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í nū ācɛ kú Ugɛ́ssɔn mɛ́mla Umáaka bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. É lā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́ jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā.

eng_Latn: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ kú igelī ɔ́ɔmā kpó kéē gaá hɛ́ ɔcí, gbā ɛcɔ̄, klla hɛ́hɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó yá mla odúúdú ācɛ kú aígelī kú Ámɔ̄n ɔhá á. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ācɛ nēe mīyɛ anú, nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā, ó le ɔfú je lɛ uwá kéē le pīya ayí kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
idu_Latn: Ó nwū ācɛ ɛlā ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú uwā, ācɛ kē bá ī cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é jé ka, ogboló ce aéwo ɔhá kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔfú kú uwā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka eko kú uwā ipú ɛcɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɛ́ ɛɛ́, amáŋ é kē jé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔgba ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā wɛ, Ubɛríli, ukáneliyan mɛ́mla ujáspa. É le uwá kpó kwu ɔkwu kú ugóolu .

eng_Latn: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ á. Ó gē kɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū keé lɛ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nōó lɛɛjī ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, tíne otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Tíinalegwu lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
idu_Latn: Ká ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwɔ ā, kéē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ipéyī kú uwɔ ojigógó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ úwé wiyē ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kú uwɔ kéē gwéeyē kéē tɔ́ɔga.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē bī ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Ujɔ́dan, nēé kwú íkpó kú uwā bá ajɛ ōŋmó kú okónōgwu Ujɔ́dan ā, éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan kwúcē wā ɛgiyí nū iyí nū, klla kwú cēenyi klá ɛga nōo tɛtɛ cēenyi klá ā.

eng_Latn: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ohígbū ɛhi ā á.

eng_Latn: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛtá ámāŋ ka ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, yá um eyījii nɛ̄ ń jɛ́yí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
idu_Latn: Ekōōhī ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Ujúda lɛ odúúdú ífi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gáā yá kéē yá uwā ā pó, é géē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwɔ̄ ú lá gā um gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
idu_Latn: N bī uwɔ le ca ācɛ tāajɛ, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄, kwu ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
idu_Latn: Usálma wɛ ádā kú Ubówāsi.

eng_Latn: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ka ɛ́ɛ géē bī odúúdú ije ā le cíla ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ā ulé mɛ́mla oōbī le lā iyó nēé géē bī le glla odée yá ā.

eng_Latn: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ gē nyíleyī ojigógó. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nyíleyī eko nɛ̄ ó ī kɛlā ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā le jōjīla, ó kē klla í lɔfú í kwú odúúdú iyē kú nū tū glá.

eng_Latn: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
idu_Latn: N tá Óndú ā ahínyá klla cɛ̄tra anú, ohígbū ka ó tá ɔkɔ oōgbā kú um, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē mā ō yíihɔtū tū um eko dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu klla kahíníī, N le íne bīya, amáŋ lɛ ojīlīmā ce um iyɔ̄bū kú anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kócōō, lɛ cīgbīhi mla um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka n bī ɛbɔ́ wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛɛ? Ehée, ń bī ɛbɔ́ wā ŋ́, amáŋ n wā í yá kú ācɛ kéē le kɔ̄ hɛ̄ iyī uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
idu_Latn: Ami, nōo wɛ Ujɔ́ni ā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo pó klla má aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aɔ́dā mbá ā pó klla lɛ uwá má ā, n má gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ma aɔ́dā nēe bá ā fú ga um ā. N gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā dúú.

eng_Latn: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū kú eyī kóō nyā ɛplá ofúlɔ̄cī āa, ó gā ɛgiyí uwā, yɔ̄ gē yāwu eyī ísu.

eng_Latn: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu le tá ɛgiyí Áriyɔ̄ku nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je ɔ́da lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ācojéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn kpó ŋmó ā, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á híī je ācojééyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó ŋmó gɛ ŋ́. Lɛ um bī ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́, n géē ka ɔ̄na ā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le miya kóō le yɛ úgbéenyi gla ajɛ kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī kpéko bónū ajɛ kú Ésīya ŋ́. Ó yɔ̄ ī ŋmúleyīkwū kóō gāājɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, ɔ́dāŋ kóō tɔtɛ́, ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú Upɛ́ntīkɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí ā, Ɔcɛ́ ágábáidu, n má ɔlá ōfíyajɛ nōo fíyajɛ fíyɛ́ ɛnɔ, ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó le cɛ̄ klá ami mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ī yɛ tɔ̄há mla um ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
idu_Latn: Bēē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā, da uwɔ ka ā yá ā. Lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúmā nōó tū uwɔ ukɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ nēé tá tū ipú íne kú Umósīsi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā jɛ̄ gɔbū lɔhi ipú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ a í yá ā mɛ́mla ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ a í nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he Óndú ā ɔtū kóō yá kéē nyīla īkpācɛ kéē klla le gbagbénú lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē he ɔ́ ɔtū ká ɔ́ɔ̄ kpó uwā yíífi lɛ á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē fú uwá tɛgba tɛgba ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā je lɛ uwá kéē lā ā.

eng_Latn: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
idu_Latn: N lɔfú cokónu lɛ ɔ̄cokpaakpa kóō géē yēeyī glá. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɛlá ka okpaakpa nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ ɛɛ́, gbɔɔ́ ō bɔ̄bíipú á. N gáā blakwu ɔdōlɔhi dúúmā nōo yá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó géē kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe ī ŋmó ācɛ ɔhá okónu ā, Ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛ̄ aá wɛ, á lɛ ɔdā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ aá le ācɛ ŋmokónu, anɔ́ɔ aá abɔ̄yī aá kē le ɔdōbɔ̄bí ékpó piíí nēé yá nɛ̄ aá ŋmó uwā okónu ɔ́ɔmā yá, aá yɔ̄ ī ŋmó iyī aá okónu dúú.

eng_Latn: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ aá fu um ā ŋ́, amáŋ ami fu aá á. N je ɔfú lɛ aá ká aá nyɔ̄ gaá gwá īkpō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká īkpō kú aá kóō lɛ́ɛcɛ. Ká ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá abɔ̄ Ádā um o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú um ā, ō géē je lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísaa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni ā lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Upútíyɛ̄lu lɛ. Ó ma Ufínɛ̄hasi lɛ ɔ́. Aɛ́nyā wɛ aádáádā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ulífāyi á.

eng_Latn: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: lɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla ɔdā ō bī le gwɛ́ɛya kú uwā bī gé lɛ Óndú ā. Úgbáajɛ ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aɔ́bá ɛna igwɛ́ɛpa gē pi ā, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka úgbáajɛ éyi wɛ ákú aótrɛ̄yí ɛpa, ɔbá ɛna éyééye wɛ ákú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aótrɛ́yí ā. Eko nēé kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ Óndú ā iyɔ̄bū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ɛyí īnyī kú ɛ̄hī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ucē ɔdā icíci mɛ́mla ajā nɛ̄ aá gbo ā, nōo kwú aá iye í tēelihɔ ɛɛ́ mā. Nááná nɛ̄ n yá ká n lɛ aá na yēŋēē ā, aá le nyíliyē kpɔ́. Aá klla gáā le yēŋēē gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ ōwē yá aá jɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō le nwuné ipú ajɛ ā. Aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē le jɛ̄ klá aɛ́fu nēe í gwá īkpō bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛga nēé hī Ulɛ́bānɔn ā. Ācɛ kéē nyīla tū aígelī nɛ̄hi ā bɛ̄ɛka ácí nēe ī bū tá ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā dɛ̄gba tū ísu ā, ó kwú ísu ā ú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ klōōlō nɛ̄ ɛháajɛ kú nū gaá tɛ́ɛcɛ. Owu nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛnwū kú nū ā, etikpa kú ɛcɛ má tɛ́ɛcɛ áncā péee.

eng_Latn: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le ɔ́da je lɛ Ujówābu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ohile ā kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ga odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ká aá gaá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbaáluka. N tíne ō jé áluka kú uwá.

eng_Latn: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɔfú kú um mafú gā uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ kéē lɛ ofu kú ɔfú kú um pó ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ habɔ̄ uwɔ tá yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wɛ Alelékwū, ācɛ nēe í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú alelékwū mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, le ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi lé ā, aólɛlā kú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm nēe lā mla uwá abɔ́ɔ ā, lɛ ɔkpá tá ce uwá ga ɛgīyī ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ogbénjūwā kú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ofu cigwó ā, amáŋ ó yɔ̄ ipú Aícɔ́ɔjā Ɛtá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú um le jɛ̄ aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Aá kē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ga Umáhāneyím ā, ó gaá jīla Ussóbi, ɔyí kú Unáhāsi nōo ŋmá Urábba, igelī kú Ámɔn ā mɛ́mla Umákīyɛ, ɔyí kú Ámmīyēlu, nōo ŋmá Ulódēba mɛ́mla Ubásīlāyi nōo ŋmá Urogélim ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le aɔ́wɔ kú uwá kpó tū ipú ɔlá, ohígbū kēé wɛ ɔwɔ ŋ́, amáŋ íkpékwīja kú ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nōo wɛ úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ícííci nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
idu_Latn: Wā ɛgiyí um ohumɔtū, wā fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka ɔblá, bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɔblá nōo gē wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu, wā ɛga nɛ̄ ácí gē jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ébram kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ipú aɔ́máapú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ga ajɛ nɛ̄ n géē mafú gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
idu_Latn: Ń tá ihɔtū ogbonɛnɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmá lɛ o lɛ íne tū nɛɛ, ó lɛ ā ayíka Ohɔ́nyɛtá gekwú tónū icííci.

eng_Latn: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka a jé ohi ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ uwɔ ma eko nɛ̄ n yá ɛcɛ ā ɛɛ́ mā. N gbɛlá ka a le ɛcɛ lé nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́ n déē?.

eng_Latn: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú oyēeyī kú nū í tónū o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ odúúdú ācɛ hɛ́tá ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā. Ó kwú iyī nū ú gwɛ́ɛya kó ō le mafu ka eko okpaakpa nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tine kó ō nya odúúdú ācɛ tá.

eng_Latn: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú aá yɔ̄ ī doōce, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu anyākwɔ́cɛ kú icɔ́ɔci, kéē wā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ anɔ̄ kú ólīfu nya ɔ́ iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: While the word was in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar , to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔkpáncō kahíníī, Woó, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ awɔ nɛ̄ ɔkɔ nyā gē kɛlā gā uwɔ á. Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ­a nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá lɛ opo kú ɛfú pó, aá wā gaá le jīla ɛgiyí um, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ géē kpɛ́fú lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ohígbū ka a lɔfú, Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú. Olɔhi nāa yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ōfōōfūnū ā nɛ̄ n géē bī tóokónu yɔ̄ ī ka á.

eng_Latn: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Umówābu, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá hī īyī aá ka aɔ́békwū kú ɛfú ā, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū nōo wɛ ɔka kú ɛfú ō kpó ā mɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ ācɛ Udédan, Utéma, Ubús mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī plla áklō ɛyí kú uwā ā le gwá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācogwíijē kú Ulífāyi ā le pɛ́ ŋmá ɛga dóódu nēé lā jīla Ujerúsālɛm tá mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe yɛ Unétōfa jīla tá ā gaá le jīla ipú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ Uhádadi, ɔyí kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu Usólōmɔn á.

eng_Latn: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū le tá ɔgbɛ́fú ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufilístiya, ɛga nēé bá ī kpɛ́fú tá īyī uwā klla bá í ŋmó īyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin gwéeyē klla gwííjē ka, N bī ikpokwú ágáa kú ijakī, le ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó kpó ŋmó. N bī ikpokwú ágáa kú ijakī, n le okwū kú uwā tīkwū klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
idu_Latn: Áaa, Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnya nɛ̄ ó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ŋ́ mā, má gwōnū ɛɛ́ oo! Ācɛ kē kwú pɛ́ kwu hī ɔ̄ tá ɛɛ́. Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ó kōō má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ je ɔ́ cāŋjɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, and a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the LORD thy God is with thee, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tú aólɛlā kú uwá, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ aɔ́nya o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛwā fíyɛ́ uwā má, ó da uwá kéē híī yúúfi uwā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ pī uwā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
idu_Latn: Aá géē fu aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛtá ŋmá ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, mɛ́mla ɛtá ɔhá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ede kú oje udɔ nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó, ɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó dúú, olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ yá.

eng_Latn: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
idu_Latn: Ugáyōsi nɛ̄ n gbɔga ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ɛ̄nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā gē jīla ɔlɛ́ nū ā, gē hokónu tū aá. Erástɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ-o-bīije kú igelī ā, mɛ́mla Ukwátɔ̄si ɔyínɛ́ alɔ gē hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
idu_Latn: Umahárāyi ŋmá Unetófa, Uhɛ́lɛdi, ɔyí kú Ubaána ŋmá Unétófa.

eng_Latn: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
idu_Latn: Aíta nēe bá ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ̄ kéē jé odée lɛyíkwu íjééyī, mla ɛlā olɔhi nēé nwū uwā ā, mɛ́mla o cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kéē jɛ́yí kú ɔdā lipú lipú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó le italā yá uwá, anɔ́ɔ kwú uwā ú kpó tū aólɛlā ōbɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi abɔ̄, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó le uwá kpó nū ŋmá eyī nū piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a kpɛ́lā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ce alɔ ā, ɔkpani? Alɔ gbɔkpá ka alɔ í yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si pīyeyī le uwā má bá gē yɛce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gē tíne ā? Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nāa lā ā? Urábāyi? .

eng_Latn: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ojuju kú aá ā le uwēyī bī gé lɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ɛɛ́. aá le ífi bī gé lɛ iyī aá, o ŋmá lɛ ō je aéwo alɛwa kpó yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko okpaakpa ā le yá, Ɔwɔicō géē yá kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō kwúcē wā. Anú ōfōōfūnū lɛ ojīlīmā á, ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ ékpónú ā, ɔcɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́, Óndú kú aóndú.

eng_Latn: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu tóohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā, o jikwū ɛ́gɛ́nyā kú aá bīya um ɔtū nɛɛ? N le tútū, ó kóō lɛ um tū agbá ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ká n̄ gekwú dúú ipú Ujerúsālɛm ohígbū iyē kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: I AM the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔkpá nyā á. Ami klla wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá italā nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ ó cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi aā.

eng_Latn: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄cī nēé í yá ācɛ italā nōo wɛ eko nēé géē mīyɛ ulé kú ɔdā nēé yá ā ɔ́ɔ gā ɛɛ́. Ó klla ka ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le yá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ géē jé ɔ̄. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē ka ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo gē kɛlā nyā ā wɛ olíla. É í ka ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ alelékwū ī kɛlā bū okónu kú nū nyā wɛ ojɛɛ́lɛ́. Ó ka ācɛ géē wɔ́tū anúɔ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka íne nɛ́ɛ bīya ā nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
idu_Latn: N tíne kú ā kwú ɔtū kú uwɔ ú kpóce Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī nwū uwɔ ɛlā kú íjééyī nēe bá ā ícɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le bū ipú ɛwa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɛga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
idu_Latn: aɔ́yī kú ācɛ nēe gē ce uwá ā ī yúuya ipú ahámgbā. Aóbó kú uwā kē bá ī ceyī ŋaáŋaá.

eng_Latn: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú aéwo ā hīgwú ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē le jīla. Ɛ̄nyá a kú aɛ́cí kú uwā ā ka ɔdā nōo í yá ɛcɔ̄bū glá ā, klla ka ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ alɔ glá ā? Kéē lɛ aíjáalí kú uwá kpó wā, kéē wā í cījáalí lɛ uwá kɛ́ɛ ka lɛ ā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā ká ā gāá lɛ ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki kpó yíífi dúúdú. Ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā, lɛ uwá yíífi. Ā mā ɔdā dúúmā tá ŋ́. Kwu ācɛnyā kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, kwu ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é bī abɔ̄ gē gwá amɛ̄, kwu aɛ́na mɛ́mla álá, aíjakī mɛ́mla aínyankwūlūmī, lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú káā lɛ uwá yíífi.

eng_Latn: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hɛ́ ikpɛ́lā gé lɛ aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ nū, í gáā lé úgwū ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Olíla gē wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ojéeyī piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, aá kē lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā yálé ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka Alelékwū nōo yɔ̄ ipú aá ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ alelékwū nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ákú ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujudíya mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ dóódu nēe bá kwu Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
idu_Latn: É gē nya ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa tá, amáŋ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā géē je yíífi acígilí.

eng_Latn: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ, ipú ɔkpáncō ámāŋ ka ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́. A gē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ a ce mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā tū, a klla gē ma ihɔtū nōó gē mɛ ŋ́ fú lɛ ācɛ nēe gē bī ɔtū éékpónú ī lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu le má ka ɛfú ɔ́ɔ gáā lé anúɔ ɛɛ́ mā, ó le aóklóbīya o bī ɔkpacaŋgelī úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó , cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le ɔwɛ ca bū ɔgbɛ́fú kú aólɛlā kú uwā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ipú ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya, amáŋ ó tōō yá lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
idu_Latn: Upíta tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óndú, n le tútū ká n̄ ga agbá mla awɔ, ká n̄ kē kwú mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔhá nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō gē kpó īyī uwá í jīla iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā, ebilíi klla tá ipú uwá wā iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicó dúú.

eng_Latn: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
idu_Latn: N lɛ eko kpií hile ō yēeyī mɛ́ɛnɛ. Mā um tá ká n̄ jɔ́ɔnyɛ īyī um lígíí.

eng_Latn: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ɛtá wɛ ijáalí á, Alelékwū mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla oyí ā. Ijáalí kú aɔ́dā ɛtá aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā kē wɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā kɔ̄, lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ ā je lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá ɛɛ́. É í lā ipú ajɛ ā gbógbóó, ó kē í je pīya ákú uwá piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛ̄nyā yɔlá ɛyí ede kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla Ujósɛ̄fu, klla le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́. Ó le yá kú ɛlā kú Ujósɛ̄fu kóō he otrɛ̄yí kú aálagbá ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́mɔn, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ujówɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ásāfu, ɔyí kú Ubɛrɛkíya mɛ́mla ayí kú Umérāri, Étan ɔyí kú Ukúsáya.

eng_Latn: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ije ámāŋ ka ɔdée tū ɔ́mpa nū abɔ̄, nɛ̄ uwī gaá kwú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔ́mpa nū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kaé le uwī ā kwú, ó géē cíla ulé nū ɛga ɛpa.

eng_Latn: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ádām nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá aflɛ́yí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó yá Ífu á.

eng_Latn: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
idu_Latn: Ń kwú nyinyi gaá hile aɔ́kpá klá ikpokwú ōfōōfūnū. Ó hile ligíí ká n̄ gēkwú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yēeyī kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé tá ō mīyɛ íkókwū nyā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kéē gwá, le da uwá ka amíyɔ̄ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ɔ́ ka, Aá géē gwá piíí.

eng_Latn: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛga nɛ̄ agbénú kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ gē tá á.

eng_Latn: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le bɛ̄cɛ, le ɔkɔ nwūla yɔ̄ ī kpáákpá, cɛ́ɛ́ idɔlá nɛ̄hi kú ɛnɔ ā lɛ ɔcí ā yi tāajɛ, ododó kú nū kē le kpó wúla wāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔhi kú nū kē mɛ. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ olagbénú géē mɛtāajɛ ābɔ̄ ō yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ímma ma āyā ɔhá kú ɔdɔ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ussɛmáya, ɔyí kú Ussɛkáníya, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō Ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ma āyā ɔhá kú ɔdɔ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ɔlɛ́ nū ā á.

eng_Latn: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
idu_Latn: Yá ka ɔcɛ́ kóō hɛ̄pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ aólɛhá. Kóō hɛ́ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā tá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ācɛ ŋmó ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu le tá Usúkɔ̄tu, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ inu gwó lɛ iyī nū klla le ɛga o kpó aɛ́bɛ́ kú nū tū gwó á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nēé hī abɔ́ɔ ka Usúkɔ̄tu á.

eng_Latn: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó pó ɔkɔ nōo da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ Upíta, ŋmó ká ā klla lé.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ajɛ nɛ̄ alɔ nyɔ̄ gaá jila ā wɛ ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá, ācɛ Ufarísīi! Ɛga ocíce olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, mɛ́mla okónu ojīlimā nēé ī hɛ́ tā aá ɔɔ́pu ā ī he aá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yá ka ojuja kóō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī yā ɔwɔ āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ kē mafú lɛ ébú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī ce āa?.

eng_Latn: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔnyā ā, anú wɛ ɔbá ɔnyā á. Amáŋ oklóbīya kú ɔbɔ́nyā ā nōo háyi kóō pó ɔkɔ kú ɔbɔ́nyā, gē gwéeyē nwuné eko nōó le ɔkɔ kú ɔbɔ́nyā pó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ajɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ hí lɛ iyī nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō lɛ īkpō kú ucē okpaakpa ō yá nyi tū ɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ īkpō kú ɔhā nōo ī bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛyí ō lɛ táajɛ lɛ anúɔ ā cē. Ó ka eko ɔ́ɔ le yá nēé géē kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí anúɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā ɛɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ yā ɔhā wāajɛ kla uwá.

eng_Latn: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, Udéfīdi kwú Ámōni mɛ́mla Umɛfíbōssɛ̄ti, ayí ɛpa nɛ̄ Uríspa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áyah ma lɛ Usɔ́ɔlu ā. Ó klla le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛhɔ̄ kú Umérābu, adá kú Usɔ́ɔlu, nōó ma lɛ Adríyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ubásīliya nōo ŋmá Umēhōla ā kpō dúú.

eng_Latn: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā le éŋkpɔ̄ nōo nwuné bɛ̄ɛka ísu ā gba ŋmá okónu lɛyíkwu ɔnyā ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú enyi ā kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú.

eng_Latn: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
idu_Latn: Acɛ kú Ásimāfɛ̄ti wɛ ofɛpa cɛpa.

eng_Latn: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
idu_Latn: Eyīyōce nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó āa?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe ī yīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā ka, Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ ka ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi kú uwá nēé gē yá ā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, kéē nyɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā uwā gbɔbū kéē gwū odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. É tíne uwā jāā ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ bēhé Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, ɔ́ gáā kpó eko bónū kóō yá ācɛ nēe gē tū ɔ̄ eyījii ā italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɛ́lāyi da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá gwutá, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó lɛ uwɔ hīgwú igbɔhá, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú um, kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ó gē jāhɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ gāá gwutá ɛga ōgwutá kú nū ā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā yá ācɛ nēe ī ga iyāwu ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá yá um dúú á. Aá bá ī má ɔdā ufi nōo yɔ̄ í yá um ā, anɔ́ɔ aá klla bá ī yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu hɛ um tá á.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Adá kú nū ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ le okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā, koó kwú anúɔ ú yá ɔdā nōó ka anúɔ géē je anúɔ yá ɔ̄ ā lɛ Óndú ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le ɔ́ci gwō aólɛlā kú aá, ācɛ Ámɔn, klla le uwá yálé ā.

eng_Latn: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ gē pīyɛyí ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, wā Usíkilagi ā, aícɔ́ɔja nēe ŋmá Umanásɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ā bá á: Ádna, Ujósābadi, Ujɛdíyɛ̄lu, Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Ujósābadi, Ɛlíhu, mɛ́mla Usilétāyi. Odúúdú uwá tɛtɛ wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ígwíígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja, úlā ɛpa cofigwó .

eng_Latn: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē nwū ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā, ɔwɛ nēé cíkā ō yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah's house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon's princes, and those women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away back.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ má um ā, n má odúúdú ācɛnyā kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā abɔ̄ é lɛ abɔ̄ tū uwá abɔ̄ gé lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā. Eko nēé bá ī nyɔ̄ ā, ācɛnyā bá ī ka kahíníī, Aóklóbīya kú uwɔ nēe kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ ā lɛ uwɔ bī nyíleyī. É kē le fíyɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄. Abɔ̄ aíkpó kú uwɔ le hɛ́ wu ɔ́tɔ̄ ɛɛ́ mā, aóklóbīya uwɔ ā nyɛ̄ hɛ̄ uwɔ tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā miya ā géē yɔ̄ piyóó á. Amáŋ ɛlá nɛ̄ ó gē gbo ipú ɔtū kú nū ā gē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔfiyɛ icííci gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó lɛ nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔfiyɛ kɔ́ɔ́ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó kwú pīya ɔyínɛ́ ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛɛ́. Ó tīile gā um nɛ̄hi, ó kē tīile gā awɔ nwuné nwuné fíyɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔfiyɛ ā mɛ́mla eko nyā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔyínɛ́ ipú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā í le ɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Ássikɛ̄lɔn, lɛ ācɛ ofu cigwó kú uwa kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó le otóngwō mɛ́mla īlī nēé yíifa tū ɔ̄ kú uwā ofu cigwó kpó. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó gē lɛ ācɛ nēe ka ɛyí ita kú nū ā á. Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi le tá ɔlɛ́ ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu alɛwa le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si klla lɔtūce ɔ́ ohígbū Ulásārɔ̄si nōó je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwá da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ mla aá, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi ōhī ā gē gwííjē ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi á. Aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔ́nū ā lā ipú aínu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É lɛ úklɔ́ ɔhá dúúmā ō yá ŋ́, ohígbū ka uwá gē leyīkwu odúúdú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā otú kwu ɛnɔ á.

eng_Latn: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā wā ɛgiyí aá, nɛ̄ ó kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nēé nwū nyā wā ŋ́, aá híī mīyɛ ɔ́ wā ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́, aá kōō híī hokónu tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: É géē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla odúúdu ojila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā wɔ́tū ɔ́mpa nū lɛ ɛ̄wā gwū ɔ̄, ámāŋ ka o hɛ́bayi ɔwɛ gbēyī nū, le odée fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ wāajɛ, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, ámāŋ nɛ̄ ó lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi iháyí ɔ́migwáahātá nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Abíjam le ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujúda lé.

eng_Latn: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
idu_Latn: Aá híī plla iyī aá ŋ́. É gē yá Ɔwɔicō ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nyi ā, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó gē ce á.

eng_Latn: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu lɛ ɔwɛ, mla eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ɔ̄, náaná nɛ̄ unwalu kú nū ce ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi mɛ́mla ācɛ alɛwa ɔhá bá Ántīyɔ̄ku gē nwū ācɛ klla ī kɛlā kú Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ami ā, ó lɛ ɔhi gā um nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n kwu Ɔwɔicō ajaajɛ, nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ī gbō um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm.

eng_Latn: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ lɛ íne kú uwɔ bīya, nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā lɛ uwá kpó alagbá kú ɛfú gaajɛ éwɔhá, ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɛ kú éwɔhá ā kōō wɛ ɛga o ligbó.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ ā ú, le ɔ́ mī klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó bí ɔwɛ nyā le ɔdā dóódu kpó tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, ācɛ kú Ísmɛ̄lu, ācɛ kú Umówābu, ācɛ kú Uhágiri.

eng_Latn: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
idu_Latn: Íne kú Ɔwɔicō le mu ɔ́ ɔtū. Ó gē nyā ŋmá íne kú Ɔwɔicō tá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā ā ú kpó lá ká ɛ́ɛ kwú ije kú nū ú ga ɛga ogbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má gwutá ɔkwu alī gbɔɔ́ ō gbiyɔ̄lā. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gaá le abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le héyī ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lé ɔdōlé.

eng_Latn: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: É tá kóō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā é cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. É gē gbā aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā ɛ̄gbā, klla ī cɛ̄ ūwā ɛhɔ̄, ikɔkɔ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá aódée ā abɔ̄yī nū ā, nōo cíkā kéē cɛ̄tra anú piyóó ā! Aamí.

eng_Latn: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Agbénú kú nū í gáā yɔ̄ gbojī ŋ́. Agbénú kú nū í klla gáā yɔ̄ piyóó ŋ́. Kwu anú mɛ́mla ojuju kú nū géē bī tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
idu_Latn: Unaómi da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ ŋmá amānyā ā, anúɔ wɛ omōōmu, amáŋ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄ áncā. Ó ka ɔdíyá nēé gē hī anúɔ ka Unaómi kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí klla le unwalu bī wā í klá anú ā?.

eng_Latn: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N gáā habɔ̄ aá tá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n ge ményinyi aá ŋ. N géē je ōwē kú ɔdā ɛbí nɛ̄ aá yá ā lɛ aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
idu_Latn: É géē tá aá ohi kahíníī, É lɛ Umówābu yálé ɛɛ́. Aá jikwū ohígbū ka uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɛɛ́. Aá tɔ́ɔna okónu ísu kú Ánɔn kahíníī, É kwú Umówābu ú yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
idu_Latn: Ā mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, tá lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā, nēe lɛ ɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ā je mlanyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēé bá í yá ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's house.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā í bēhé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá gwɛ́ɛya glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔlá ōfíyajɛ kú ɛgahi kú Óndú ā le mu ipú inu ā.

eng_Latn: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n gē yúufi Ɔwɔicō ā, kóō í cɛ̄ lɛ ámíyā yá um ā, ń yá ɛdɔ ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ɔdā nēé gē yá eko nɛ̄ eko kú ucɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú Óndú ā le yá ā?.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē tū ɔlá klá ɔdɔ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáya, cɛ́ɛ́, ó kwú yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā gaá háyi pīyɛ̄ ede kú Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le okónu ce iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē bī odúúdú ɔtū mɛ́mla odo kú anúɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā. Ó klla ka anúɔ í lɛ aíne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū tū. Ó klla cokónu ka anúɔ í bī ɔdā nēe bá Ɛka kú Óndú ā iyē ā le yúklɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ɔkpá ā lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā le okónu ā ce mla anú dúú á.

eng_Latn: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usedekíya lɛ okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ wɛɛlɛ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá alɔ ā yɔ̄ ā, n gáā ŋmó uwɔ ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ n géē je uwɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō je uwɔ ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
idu_Latn: Uhádādi, Utɛ́ma, Ujɛ́tɔ, Unáfissi, mɛ́mla Ukedɛ́ma.

eng_Latn: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
idu_Latn: É da īyī wā kahíníī, Onɔ̄ɔ̄na kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā ī wā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē nyi īkpō ā, aóhī hábɔ̄ tá ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ aígbáanɔ wā gaá kwú uwā ú kpó tá le á.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi nyɔ̄ í kwú okwutɛ ā ú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unátan le tá ɛgiyí Ubatisséba, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Usólōmɔn gaá da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ pó ka Adónīja, ɔyí kú Uhágiti kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā nū, amáŋ ádā nū ɔ́ɔ kē jé ɛ́ɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ géē háyi iyɔ̄bū odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujɛrúsālɛm, ká n̄ da uwá, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ā. N gē gwéeyē ohígbū ka a lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā ahɔ̄ pi ká ɔ̄ bɔ̄bíipú ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ í bɔ̄bíipú gɛ ŋ́, ó í yēeyī kpɔ́. Ɛ́mba a kē lɛ īyī uwɔ nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
idu_Latn: É géē cíla akwuna ulé kú úklɔ́ kú nū, amáŋ awɔ ā gē je ɛhi mɛ́mla omíci lɛ aɔ́ya uwɔ kéē ŋmá ɛga dóódu wā í gwutá mla uwɔ alahá.

eng_Latn: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pó ɔkɔ kú nū ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ipú ɛcɛ ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ɔlá ōtīhɔ kú nū má, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē pīya, anyōkwū, ayókwū mɛ́mla aúgbɔga tū, í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mīyɛ ɔdā nōo cíkā ō wɛ ákú uwā ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá Óbōtu gaá lā Iye-abárim, ajɛ kú Umówābu.

eng_Latn: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā le aólɛhá pīyatū, í klla lɛ ɛlá wu uwá ŋ́. Ó klla mīyɛ inu nōo wɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá tū ɔkwu áncā.

eng_Latn: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá um ohi ka ami í jé ɔ̄da nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ka, ehéee, Óndú.

eng_Latn: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abālɔbányā, aá nēe wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kwú eyī ú pīya ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī nwū ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛɛ́. Aá le ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mla aá ā nyílá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ipí ā le nyīla igbīhi nēé le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayí ofɛpa, klla lɛ ayí kú ayí ofu cigwó, nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā gē ce aíjakī ofɛtá cigwó. Ábudɔn gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ahātá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayí kú Ulífāyi ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi da uwá ā á. Ācɛ nēé ŋmó ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ úlā ahāapa ce ofu igwó ā.

eng_Latn: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
idu_Latn: Ó má ɔkpáncō bā ó le nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó má odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka idɔngwu nɛ̄hi nēé bī ɔ̄ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ ā yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é ka kahíníī, Ācɛ ōhī ka Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim, amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá ka Ɛláyíja. Ācɛ ɔhá klla ka ka Ujeremíya, ámāŋ éyi kú ipú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mīyɛ anú ŋmá abɔ̄ ūwā le ɔ́ kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede ā, kóō wɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú abɔ̄ ō le ce ɛyí. Ocu kú nū ā gē he Óndú ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ítāyi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N gbo Ɔwɔicō, mɛ́mla awɔ nōo wɛ Ágábáidu ā, n géē ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a í nyɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla uwɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ kōō cɛ̄ ikwū nááná n le tútū ō kwú mɛ́mla uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe má ɔ̄ ā gbɔɔ́ ō ko kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā le yɛ ga ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cobīyíne gáā gbɔga.

eng_Latn: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē gbāajɛ ā gē bɛ́yíkwu ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nɛɛ? Aá gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kpó aálá mla aɛ́na ŋmá ipú ɔdāajɛ kú nū lɛ uwá kéē le gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla gē kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū lɛ uwá kéē bī le gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄cī Usábāti mɛ́mla ákú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú uce ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ipú iháyí dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ipú íne kú Óndú ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
idu_Latn: Umélatíya ŋmá Ugíbeyɔn mɛ́mla Ujádɔn nōo ŋmá Umérónɔtu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn, Umísāti, klla le āyā kú ɔdɔ nɛ̄ gboce uwá ā ma jāā ga ɔlɛ́ igbómína kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfaretīisi ā.

eng_Latn: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
idu_Latn: Inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā pīyeyī kwú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. É le aífotó kú alī kpó tū aɔ́dɔ kú ɛplá nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yɛ ā dúú. Agidigbé ikpó ahātá yɛ gicō ga okómpinu nyā dúú á.

eng_Latn: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā ɔ́ɔ géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi lɛ anúɔ á. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē yá ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā kóō yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu, nōo wɛ ádā kú ayí nū ɛpa ā, Umanásɛ mɛ́mla Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ijáalí kú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē bī le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka ijáalí kú ācɛ ɛpa ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá kóō mafú ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé á.

eng_Latn: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā wɛ ákú alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā eko kpií nōo yɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ aólɛlā kú alɔ kē kwú ɔ̄ ú catāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
idu_Latn: Ó géē nya Ujerúsālɛm tá, klla í tú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda gwó. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū í lā abɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́, é klla í lé úgwū kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
idu_Latn: ó le ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ háyi icō kpaakpa! Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyīlɔ ā le ómbli tá gicō kpá, gbɔɔ́ ō yāwu.

eng_Latn: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í mīyɛ ákú Ukéni ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ukéni kwú cɔ̄nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ikpēyī kú nū kwú kplá gɔɔ.

eng_Latn: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ipú aá a, ācɛ bá i lé ómíci ce oyī kú ācɛ ɔhá oōpiya bónū, iyē kú aá lɛ itene abɔ̄ ɔfú ō lé jé ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ́mpa aá ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ aá kwú mlanyī um á. Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ōnwū kú ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī wɛ njɔlɔ kú oyēeyī. Ó géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ ká ā kwu hɛ ikwū tá.

eng_Latn: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí mla Ɛ́sra wā Ujerúsālɛm ā bī ɛhi alɛwa wā í le gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Uwá bī aɔ́bɛ́ɛna igwɛ́ɛpa kú odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, omlede ofɛnɛ ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī, ɔyí álá ofɛtá ce igwáahāapa le gwɛ́ɛya kú odúúdú íne nēé bīya ā. É le odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá nyā kpó yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu úlā ofɛtá ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ túbá.

eng_Latn: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā aá kú aflɛ́yí ā le ɔ́bíipú bī. Aótrɛ̄yí kú aa kē lɛ íne kú um bīya.

eng_Latn: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi keé tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ī bīyíne ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je íne lɛ Umósīsi á. Amáŋ ɛga nɛ̄ íne í yɔ̄ ŋ́, é gē tá íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
idu_Latn: Olicō kú éyééye kú uwá wɛ ikpó ɛnɛ ce abɔ̄ ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa gbā, bɛ̄ɛka ákú aflɛ́yí ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, ó le uwá kpó le tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔdā lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Utɔ́mɔ̄si, éyi kú ipú aíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā nēé hī ka Áplɛ́ ā, í yɔ̄ mla uwá eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si wā abɔ́ɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ɛɛ́, ayíka uwēyī gáā kwú ɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ iyī nū tú wāajɛ, ayíka ó jéeyī.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Aá le jé kpɔ́cíí ka ācɛ nēe yēeyī abālɔbányā í gáā pɛ́ kwú gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kéē yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
idu_Latn: A le ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú itekwū nēé hī ka Ulébīyātan ā ŋmó klla kwú ɛbɛ́ kú nū ú lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ígbíli kéē kwú lé.

eng_Latn: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu í jɛ́yí ɛlā nōo ī ka ā ŋ́. Ɛlā nōo ī ka ā í lɛ ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kōó le ɛlá gbo kwu okónu otīihɔ nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Ébrahām.

eng_Latn: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ um pīyɛ, kē lɛ oyēeyī pīyɛ. É kē í he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ Ɔwɔicō má ɔ́ɔmā, ó géē pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n géē ka ā, ohígbū ka ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī kɛpɔ̄ tū um ā géē hɛ́ um tá piyóó ka amíyɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
idu_Latn: Aá tá opo, kú aá tá ɛ́mula, kú aá tɔ́ɔga lɛ Óndú nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú uwā, Usédekīya, ɔyí kú Ukénāana lɛ ajī kú oje yá, anɔ́ɔ ó da Áhābu kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ka ā yɔ̄ á, A géē bī ajī nyā le kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Usírīya klla í yá uwá lé dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ɔ́kíkā ō jōnjīlɛ̄ ɛnɛ, klla í wɛ ō cēbá ɛpa. Ó géē līkpō fíyɛ́ ɔwá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulótan, ɔkplá ā, wɛ, Uhóri mɛ́mla Uhómam. Ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Ulótan wɛ Utímna ā.

eng_Latn: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā géē tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, eko nɛ̄ aá yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā lɛ odúúmā kú ayínɛ́ um, ó kōō wɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cɛgbá ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ami nɛ̄ aá yá gā um á.

eng_Latn: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne o bīya! Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yá lɛ ā ŋ́, n géē wā fíyaa gaá bī ɔkpcaŋgelī nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú um ā nuunu tú ācɛ nēe ī yá aɔ́dée ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
idu_Latn: kwú ācɛ nɛ̄hi, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kwu aógbɛhá kwu aólagbénú.

eng_Latn: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ alɔ he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā, ó le miya táajɛ gbɔbū ka alɔ í wɛ ayí anúɔ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā. Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ɔdā ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
idu_Latn: Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá klla kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū. Ācɛ kú Ujúda gbɔɔ́ ō cílá ɛkpa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu cigwɛ́ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɛkpa kú ugóolu ofu cigwɛ́ɛnɛ lɛ Unéko iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnɛ̄ le gbo ā, Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
idu_Latn: Eyī le gbɛnú gā um ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n húmáyī gbēyī ɔdā nāa cokónu nū ā. N dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nāa gáā tá um ɔtū lé ā.

eng_Latn: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
