idu_Latn: N ga ajɛ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí álmɔ̄ndi, ká n̄ má aɔ́cí nēe bá ī jɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ā, ká n̄ má ēpū ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nēe bá ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá aɔ́cí ufáyin ā, ká n̄ klla má ohéepu kú aɔ́cí upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī je mlamyī ka uwá tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ŋ́. Ó ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je ɔ́da ā lɛ uwá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, aá jé ka, ó tíne kú ádā nū kóō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, amáŋ é le ɔ́ nū Ohígbū kóō má ɔwɛ dúúmā nōó géē lɛ ɔdā nōó yá ā pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó bī agīje le tíne ɛga nōó géē pīyabɔ̄, nááná ó má ɛga ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le má ka ɛwa kú ācɛ ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wā gáā yɛ jīla ɔ́ tá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí odahɔ̄ mla odokónu ā, n je ɔ́da lɛ aá kú aá le pɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔyínɔnyīlɔ nyā ká aá híī kwúcē ga ipú iyē kú nū gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛnɛ ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ocíbú kú nū ā cē klá ɛnɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛnɔ le kwɔ́lá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ idɔlá ā gbɔɔ́ ō yi ācɛ iyē ɔlá á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
idu_Latn: Uneríya ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Ɛliyonáyi, Uhískīya mɛ́mla Asríkam.

eng_Latn: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla lɛ anyā ɔhá lɛ tū anyā nū tɛtɛ ā, nēe klla ma ayí alɛwa lɛ Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi yɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ ipú Agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, Ubigitána mɛ́mla Uterési, aídibo ɛpa nēe bá ī gbō okónɔɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́ɔtū ɔcɛ́ Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ é le ujɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki kahíníī, Ń jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɛ̄nyā ā ŋ́, ícɛ klɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī pó yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā lā klla yúklɔ́ kú uwá eko kú Ujóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujessúwa, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ujehósādaki mɛ́mla eko kú Unehemíya, igbómína, mɛ́mla Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o jé íne nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā lé āyā dúúmā ŋmá ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya gwó ā ŋ́. É géē je odúúdú nū yɔlá.

eng_Latn: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā gaá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ā, Ufássiti tá ō wā. Ɔdā nōó yá nyā tū ɔcɛ́ íwɔ́tú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ka lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú nū, nōo gē gbā Ojibó kú ubáal kú Upéyɔ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ nōo ī yá ɛcɛ lé gwū ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā tá ā?.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū da Ússa, le ɔ́ ŋmó bōōbū abɔ́ɔ á. Ohígbū abɔ̄ nōó le kwu Ikpati ā á. Ó gekwú pi Ikpati kú Ɛka ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá le he alɔ ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, alɔ le tútū ká ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ aá jé odée lɛyíkwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā. Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ le tútū ō kwú lɛ aá dúú. Aá he alɔ ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Usírīya í lɛ ɛwa ŋ́ nááná a, Óndú ā bī uwā le ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda yálé. Óhígbū ka é kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí anú nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ā. Ɔwɛ nyā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī le yá Ujówāsi italā á.

eng_Latn: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ajɛ kú Ukénan. Anɔ́ɔ Ébram le tá Íjīpiti gaá lā abɔ́ɔ á, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā nōo yɔ̄ Ukénan ā nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
idu_Latn: Ugáálu lɛ inya kwu. Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki nū ɔ̄ inya. É yá ācɛ alɛwa ágbe okónu igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɛ̄ unɔ́kpá í gē nwuné fíyɛ́ utíca kú nū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔyípɛ unɔ́kpá dóódu nōo le odúúdú ɔdā nēe nwū ɔ̄ ā jé lɔɔlɔhi géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka utíca kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce éyi yá ŋmá ugóolu . Ó le ɔkwu nū mɛ́mla ɔcí ɔtāhɛ̄ nū yá ŋmá ugóolu ō cabɔ́há mla omútāgā. Ó klla le ɔ́ yíifa mla ododó mɛ́mla ohéepu mɛ́mla oōnwūla kú ododó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ pīya ɔdā ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū obɔ̄bí éyi gē je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um nyā ojígógó gē yá kóō hɛ́ ɛgba dɛ̄ icííci. Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ajikpáakpáa ī je ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ūwū gē kwu ɔ́ okónu. Ó gē yá ɔ̄ ágbe piyóó, ó kē dɔɔ̄kā ō mā ɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɛbéenyi, nōó géē je ɛgwā lɛ ɔ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī leyī tá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu ī tá lɛ ámāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō lɛ ā í gáā nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í kē gáā cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū gē cɛ̄tra anú, ɔbá nū kē ī cɛ̄tra anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Unówa kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu klla kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Uféro kwú iyē kú ācɛ Íjīpiti éyi ce ɔ́, nōo lé ka Usafénāt Upanéya. Ó klla kwú Asɛ́nāt, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Upɔtiféra, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ipú igelī kú Uheliyopólisi ā ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya, Uhíram kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ tɔ́hí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tá mla ádā um Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, nāa kē kpó aígbɔ́cí nēé hī ka usɛ́da lá lɛ ɔ́ kóō be le gwó agbla ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií, ācɛ le hútú gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba ɛga dóódu kú igelī ā. Egidi ā nyɔ̄ gaá le Ugayíyɔsi mɛ́mla Arístākɔsi ācɛ Umasɛdónīya ɛpa nēe bá yɔ̄ ī yɛ mla Upɔ́lu ā kpó kwú, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó pi abɔ̄fú fíya ga ɛga ōjīla kú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
idu_Latn: Ɔgba nōo ŋmá Átāyi ga Ɛlíssāma ā wɛ: Átāyi, Unátan, Usádi.

eng_Latn: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Okoolo éyi kú umu kóō wā mla ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyi eko dóódu. Ocu kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú nyā géē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
idu_Latn: Anú gē gɔ̄ īlī kú iyī nū abɔ̄yīnū nū á. Īlī kú nū wɛ ɔnɔ̄wā mɛ́mla ɔgalula mɛ́mla odo mɛ́mla odufā hilóhiló ā.

eng_Latn: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó í tū aɔ́cɛ́ nēe bá gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ wāajɛ, klla géē tū aɔ́cɛ́ nɛ̄hi ufi.

eng_Latn: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ā má, aá jé ka eko ā le bá ajaajɛ kwu okónɔɔwɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ ikpala ā bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, ó kē í gbojuju obɔ̄bí eko dóódu. Ó gē tū ujɔ̄ kóō lɛ ācogbɛhá bīyatāajɛ mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nōó ī kā ā kéē híī hɛ́ epɔ̄hi lɛ uwá ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ uwá yɔ̄ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
idu_Latn: Ń mīyɛ ijáalí okwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu um ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ n ka ɔdā nēe bá ā kéē lɛ aá nyatá nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í yá Ísrɛ̄lu italā nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka aólɛlā kú uwá jéjée ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē kwú bɛ̄ɛka ákú aólɛlā kú uwá ā ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīkwu iyī aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ húmáyī yúklɔ́ ohígbū nū ā kóō híī hɛ́ aá abɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ aá géē mīyɛ ulé úklɔ́ ká aá jōōjīla.

eng_Latn: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lé ogbēnjūwā kú ɛfú ā, nēe cē ācɛ Ijípiti kpɛ́fú ā, géē bá ɔlékwū bá ī yá ācɛ Íjīpiti omáaba wā ɔlékwū. É tɔ́ɔga ka, Ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé kpó ŋmó ɛfú ā gā amānyā dúú ɛɛ́. Uwá gwutá bɛ̄ɛka aá ā.

eng_Latn: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā tɛtɛ le ɛfú kpó tú Ugɛ́sa, mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, le ācɛ ā kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le igelī ā tɔ̄lá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū éyi ɛhi eko nɛ̄ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
idu_Latn: Óndú kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú téeyī olɔhi kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ je Umósīsi ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
idu_Latn: Ónam ma ayí ɛpa. Ussamáyi, mɛ́mla Ujáda: Ussamáyi ma ayí ɛpa dúú. É wɛ Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíssɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu klla lɛ ācɛ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ Udéfīdi má cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ anúɔ ɛyí agōdō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ tííkpa kú ádā nū ipú ɔdā olɔhi nōo he Óndú ā ɔtú. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá gbla ádā nū ŋ́ mā wɛ ka ó yi ɔtulalī ɔlá abɔ̄yi nū ɛyí ede kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ujúda bá gē bīya íne kú Óndú ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā bī íjééyī lɛ ɛcɛ yá. Ó bī ɔdā ōjé mɛ́mla ohílīpú kú nū lɛ ɔkpáncō yá dúú.

eng_Latn: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
idu_Latn: A lɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yēeyī gaá kwu lɛ ā tū tāajɛ ɛɛ́. A lɛ aɔ́yā nōó ī lé ā tū lɛ ɔ́ nōó gáā glá anú nyɔ̄ ɔbū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, lɛ ɛbɔ́ je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Anú abɔ̄yī nū, Óndú ā í lā Ujerúsālɛm piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Uhága ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú Usárāyi, iní nɛ̄ a ŋmá, iní nɛ̄ a kē í nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́futa tá uwā ohi ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔ̄ni ɛ́ɛ bī ɛlā nɛ̄hi, ka anúɔ hī uwā igwú, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ tá ō wā í hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le abɔ̄ wu Ébrahām, ɔkpanī nū, agada, le ɛka gbo kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ébrahām da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɛ́brɔn ā, Uhassabíya mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū úlā ɛnɛ cofɛhɔ̄ ā gē leyīkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gé gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ī lā mɛ́mla īyī uwā lɛ ā, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā á.

eng_Latn: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ā lɛ eyī gwū ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū uwɔ mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó gē pi uwɔ anú ā bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ úbɛ̄ ā tū kwɛyí, ó gē nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ɔ̄. Ó lɔfú nyi ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí tū ɔgbɔɔgba. Ó lɔfú nyi ēpū ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí tū ɔ̄ɔ̄. Ó kē lɔfú nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé hī ka uwíti ámāŋ ka ɛdɔ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hī ka ubáli ā tū ɔ̄ ɔgbɔɔgba ɛga nōo cíkā ā. Ó klla kē lɔfú nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tū áklō kú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú um ú ga ɛgiyí Okónpinu ɔwɛ, nōo yɛ wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, gáā lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ éyi nōo tá ɔdɔ abɔ́ɔ ā mafú gā um.

eng_Latn: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ bī wā Ántīyɔ̄ku. Ipú iháyí odunkwulu é gē jīla tɔ̄há mla icɔ́ɔci, gē nwū ācɛ alɛwa ɛlā. Ajɛ Ántīyɔ̄ku nēé hī ayíkpó ā ka ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Le anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ ā ōhī kpó ká a nyɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū kú ācɛ ā, kwú okwutɛ kú uwɔ nāa miya kwu ísu kú Unáyilu ā ú.

eng_Latn: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gwéeyē klla tá ɔga eko nēé je Ísrɛ̄lu catāajɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gáā je ɛfu kú Uséyɛ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm catāajɛ je ɔ́ɔ pīya alácɛ̄ á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ dóódu géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē pó ɛ̄gbā nōo í dɛ̄ ā kwu ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ō kpó ce odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ. Ó kē í kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú ācɛ, klla í je ācobɔ̄biipú ā kpó ŋmó. Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Éwo éyééye gē gbā ɛcí kú uwā ɛgbā klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá, amáŋ, alɔ ā géē gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, klla lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi, ayíka ɔlá kóō ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ, gaá kwú awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ú kpó yi. Anɔ́ɔ obōōbū ɔlá ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ajɛ gaá kwú uwá ú kpó yi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta nōo bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā, lɛ ɔ́ pi ŋmá apɛ́, lɛ ahɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā hɛ́. Iyē kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lé ka Umálikɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā bá ī yá alɔ, nááná alɔ í kē gwɛ̄lá awɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ kōō ī nyílá okónu nāa ce mla alɔ ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ka aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā kahíníī, Īī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi! N géē wā ānāānā! Kóō le lɛ ā. Wā, Óndú Ujísɔ̄si!.

eng_Latn: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, nááná nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí alɛwa ā, alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ kē wɛ ābɔ̄ kú ɔ́mpā nū, nēe cɛgbá ācɛ ohile.

eng_Latn: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
idu_Latn: N bī otú leyī yɛ ɛlā nyā. N gbɛlá klla jila īyī um, anɔ́ɔ n da īyī um ɔ̄kā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnya ā kahíníī, N pó ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cohumɔtū ā, ó yɔ̄ ī kwinya ŋmá ɛyí ɛfú, yɔ̄ ī wúla aɛ́fu ā tū lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwo ɔhá dóódu ā, ó tū ile ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ácakpō ɛtɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
idu_Latn: Unóga, Unɛ́fɛ̄gi, Ujáfīya.

eng_Latn: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayí nēe bá ā lɛ Ébrahām: Usímran, Ujɔ́kssan, Umédan, Umídiyan, Íssbāk mɛ́mla Ussúwa.

eng_Latn: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ó gē mafú eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá le tēelihɔ ámāŋ eko nēé kē tēelihɔ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú agwú mɛ́mla ɔ́wɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká á.

eng_Latn: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
idu_Latn: É géē tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ, nēe klla gē gɔ̄ ā, wāajɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā le yá. Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū nēé gáā lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɔ́, okónu kú ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄ a hɛ́ ā kóō yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka Ádā ā kwú odúúdú ɔfú ú kpó tū anúɔ abɔ̄. Ó klla kē jé ka anúɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, anúɔ klla yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le uwá má ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Amānyā wɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛfú kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɔwɔicō á. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ā ka Umahāném.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
idu_Latn: Á gáā yúufi gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka a lɛ eyīyōce. Ɔwɔicō klla géē gbō uwɔ, nɛ̄ a klla í yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
idu_Latn: Nááná, Ujérobōwam ɔyí kú Unébāti le ikpɛ́yí olɔfú yá tú ɔkpanī nū Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ɔkpá nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tá ā jé kwɛyí ā, otrɛ̄yí kú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwá kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɛlā ō tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔtūlé dúúmā lɛ alɔ, ayíka aá ka mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú, le yá kú ɔtū kóō he odúúdú ācɛ nēe wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwéeyē. Yá kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ō tá uwɔ ahínyá, ohígbū ka a le uwá nyatá ā, kéē bá ī ka eko dóódu kahíníī, Ondú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, tá um ohi eko dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā. Tá um ohi ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, ohígbū ka a le okónu nāa ce ka anúɔ í tá um abɔ̄ ā tū.

eng_Latn: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō éyi yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō nōo gē ma ɔdōtayínū fú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. Ó le ɔdā nōo gaá yá igbīhāajɛ ā mafú lɛ Ágábáidu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā jé.

eng_Latn: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā má, klla pó ɔdā oyéyījii ɛ́gɛ́nyā jéjée ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? É ma éwo dúúdú dúúmā ɛ̄cī ékpónú ámāŋ igbeékpó jéjée ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Amáŋ Usáyɔn í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ nōo gbo ɔma bōōbū kwú ɔyí ma ā. Éwo ā géē gbɔɔ́ igbeékpó bōōbū.

eng_Latn: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
idu_Latn: N túkpɛɛ́ pīyeyī kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ n le ahínyá tá uwɔ, ohígbū ka a ī ma ihɔtū fú lɛ alɔ eko dóódu, a klla ī yá ɔdā nāa ka ā. Ohígbū ka a le íkwu je lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu kú uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ kwú, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú ga okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú aɔ́nya ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ cíka ō mīyɛ ɛ́gɛ́ ɔdōlé ɛdɔ ékpónú nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ohile ā gē mīyɛ ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú bī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ le tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ayíkpó ōhī má, anɔ́ɔ alɔ bá abɔ́ɔ mla uwá ɛ̄cī ahāapa. É bī ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ le da Upɔ́lu kóō nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔɔ́ jila, nɛ̄ ɔnwū nobí le bū abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ ipí ā kwú jé, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka k ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
idu_Latn: É gáā tá ɔyī dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwinya glá ŋ́. Ɛcɔ̄ dúúmā nēé le tá lɛ ɔ́ ā ó gē yá ɔ̄ iye yiili áncā.

eng_Latn: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā wɛ ka ɔdā nēé le gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú ācopɛ̄cí ā wɛ ákú ebilíi nɛ̄ n, ó wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ń kē tíne kú aá báana ɔdā dúú mɛ́mla ebilíi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
idu_Latn: Olɛlā kú um le um nū inya, ó klla le um yálé dúúdú ɛɛ́. Ó kwú um ú tá ipú agbá nōo dobū, nɛ̄ n le pīya bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nōo gekwú gbojī ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
idu_Latn: Aá je ēpū lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ lé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ í gwá ōfōōfūnū. Ká ā lɛ alɔ jámá ɛ̄cī igwó ōfōōfūnū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcí nɛ̄ ācɛ ī pā ā ŋ́. Ācɛ ī yá ojíbó kú ɛcí á. É kē ī ma ɔ́ ŋmá oje udɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī na oje ā le oje ɔdɔ na plla ɔ́ klla lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ bī yá ɔ̄ ifa plla anú iyē.

eng_Latn: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n kē lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá, aá kē gáā cīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, odúúdú ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ nyā yá kóō wɛ ɔdā o bī cābɔ̄ lɛ alɔ, kóō pi alɔ ahɔ̄ ká alɔ yúnwū ɔdā obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwá yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usɔ́lu nēé hī ka Upɔ́lu dúú ā, le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā, ó leyīkwu oyímabɔ̄ ā eyī glīglī.

eng_Latn: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Uféro ká ā da ɔ́ kōó mā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá kéē le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um. Aá cɛ̄ lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ kú aá ce ɔnyā ɛdɔ ɔhá gwū ɛdɔ kú iyí uwā tá ŋ́. Aá kóō híī nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛpa tū ipú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ éékpónú ŋ́. Aá kóō híī lɛ úwé nēé bī ɛdɔ kú īlī ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛpa le gɔ́ ɔ̄ ā wiyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
idu_Latn: Woó, Óndú, ó lɛ ā abɔ̄ ó gbo nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ kú uwɔ āa? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ lɔfú nɛ̄ alɔ í cɛ̄ ō lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā āa? Kóocōō, le odo kú uwɔ pīyabɔ̄ lɛyíkwu alɔ ohígbū ka alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a kpó kú alɔ wɛ ákú abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le Urécɛ̄lu kwú bɔ́ɔ́tū, yɔ̄ ī jikwū kú éeyē gbōmgbōm.

eng_Latn: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla lɛ aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ uwá kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛcá cá ádā nū ámāŋ ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā bī ikwū gē lɛ iyī nu á.

eng_Latn: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa, aá gbonɛnɛ, aá ményinyi ayínɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe géē wi ŋmá ɛfú, í kwúcē nyɔ̄ Ujúda ā géē le lígíi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda nēe hile wā í lā Íjīpiti ā géē jé ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lé ā, ka ɛlā kú uwá nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ ka ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
idu_Latn: N da uwɔ ka, nyāŋjɛ, kwú ipoto kú uwɔ ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ga ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa yēeyī gaá kwu ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā lɔɔlɔhi. Igbīhi nōó gekwú ā, é gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā jāā gaá kwu eko nɛ̄ ɔnyākwɔ̄cɛ nēe má aɔ́dā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá eyī ā le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ gaá lɛ ijakī éyi má, é lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū ɔ̄ wū ɔcí kú okómpīinu kú inu éyi kú úláyí ā. Abɔ̄ é gbɔɔ́ ō wī ijakī ā ŋmá ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le odúúdú ācɛ ā hīgwú lɛ uwá gbaáluka Utélem. Aícɔ́ɔja ikpó ā wɛ, ulá ba ɛga ulá ce ulá ofɛnɛ , mɛ́mla ācɛ ulá ofu ce ulá ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ā, é le lɛwa fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄ ō gbaáluka. Ká ɛ̄cī oyēeyī kú um kóō lɛ ŋmɛ́yí bɛ̄ɛka ákú ācɛ okpaakpa kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā. Ká n̄ gekwú ɛbɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe lé ɛpɔ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
idu_Latn: Īī gbóó, n kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū Usitefánasi mɛ́mla aíkonó kú nū ɛyí. Amáŋ ń gbɛlá ka n kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú ɛyí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo gē jɛ̄ okónu ɔkpā ā. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē yá ā, gē yɛ lɔhi, ó klla gē jɛ̄ gɔbū, bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā nōo gē gwá īkpō eko kú nū, nɛ̄ ēpū kú nū í gē wúla ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́ má ɛgiyí éŋkpɔ̄ kú ipú ígblí, nōo yɔ̄ ɔwɛ kú Ussɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
idu_Latn: É kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄nɔɔ̄nɛ̄ eko dóódu lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tɛ́ɛcɛ bá ī wú ahɛ bɛ̄ɛka ewō nēe bá ī yɛ gicō gajɛ ipú úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
idu_Latn: Upíta le tá ɛcɛ gaá jikwū lɔfúlɔfú.

eng_Latn: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
idu_Latn: Ícícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, é le áluka kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó Usúsa ā ka lɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD's people; between the king also and the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda cɛ̄ lɛ Ujówāsi, ɔcɛ́, mɛ́mla ācɛ ā le okónu ce mla Óndú ā ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ācɛ kú nū. Ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā le okónu ce mla īyī uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Ujóbu? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́. Ó gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa, í klla gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́. Abɔ̄ a tū um okónu lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɔ́ yíífi áncā nááná ā, ó hayi ipú ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ́yi kú nū ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
idu_Latn: Alɔ í mīyɛ otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ í gbā ulé nū ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ lɛyí nyaajɛ yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Alɔ yúklɔ́ eko dóódu cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ híīī wɛ iyó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ipú ajɛ kú aólɛlā kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā, nēé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwá ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ é leyī pīya kwu ajɛ nɛ̄ a je lɛ aádáádā uwā mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gwó gā awɔ nyā.

eng_Latn: The sower soweth the word.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔgílɛjí gē nyi ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
idu_Latn: É géē nuunu tá uwɔ mm, amáŋ é gáā yá uwɔ lé glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ pī uwɔ ká n̄ hɛ́ uwɔ tá.

eng_Latn: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si í wā ipɔ́lɛ́ ā dúúdú ɛ́ɛ́ nóo, amáŋ ó yɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ Umáta jīla anú ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ā híī yá iyī uwɔ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúdú alɔ bá amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
idu_Latn: Ó le ācohɛ́pɔ̄ fu lɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi éyééye kú Ujúda nēé le igá hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū ā, ācɛ ɛhīlī kwú bēé ŋmá ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwā bī iyɔ́fú. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ mla uwá nōo lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē, klla bī ɔdōtɔ́kpá. Odúúdú uwā wā gáā māháyi ɛgiyí ede nɛ̄é yá ŋmá oje udɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka óócí, anúɔ géē tū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ wā kéē lɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū wu. Ó ka ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ nōo le he uwá ɔtū ā, ɛ́ɛ géē kpó uwā gé lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ébram le pó kéē lɛ ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ kwú abɔ̄fú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācokpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó hīgwú á. Odúúdú uwā wɛ ācɛ ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce igwáahātá . Anɔ́ɔ ó nū aɔ́cɛ́ ɛnɛ ā inya jāā ga Udáni á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi da ɔɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Urútu tá ɔ́ ohi ka anúɔ Urútu nɛ̄, ɔkpani. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ubówāsi ka ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō leyīkwu anúɔ, abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔmáapu ɔbá anúɔ ajaajɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ lɛ ɔnyā nū mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn í lɛ ɛlá wu ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujɛ́futa tū fu ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu aéwɔhá nēe gē gbo ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā. N kē í yá uwā italā. Ācɛ kú Ujúda ā wɛ ákú um. Ami Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gē leyīkwu uwá á. N géē yá uwā kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́nya o bī kpɛ́fú kú um nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a má ɔdā nɛ̄ aótrɛyí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tayínū amānyā bá i yá ā? É bá ī gbā ɛdɔ ojibó dóódu ɛ̄gbā ipú inu ā. Ɔdā nēé gē lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ā lé ka, Óndú í má alɔ ŋ́ mā. Ó kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɛlā nyā kpó ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, amáŋ é jahɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eyī le cúúwā ohígbū ōwē kú úklɔ́ ɔfiyɛ nēé bá ī má ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ úwé kú Árɔ̄ni wu mla īlī nɛ̄hɛ́, kú ā lɛ ɔláwonī kú nū wu mla īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī inyilá lɛ ijā abɔ̄ he tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ā nāńdaa gáā bī um inyīlɛ̄yí. Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í má ā, Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō kwú um ú ga icīīcō ipú owu, klla kwú um ú bī ga Ujerúsālɛm. Ó kwú um ga inu eyīpú kú ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛga nɛ̄ ɛcí nōo gē wú Óndú ɔtū nɛ̄hī ā yɔ̄ á ā.

eng_Latn: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó leyī pīya tá ɔ̄cɛnyā ā anɔ́ɔ ó da Usáyímɔ̄n kahíníī, Á má ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā nyā hímáyī yá ú? N wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, á je éŋkpɔ̄ ō na ikpó gā um ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā nyā bī agīje kú nū le um ikpó na, ó klla bī inyīlɛyí kú nū lɛ ɔ́ nyā.

eng_Latn: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá kú alɔ móōwē lɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é cá alɔ ɛcá ipú igelī kú Ufílipāyi gbɔbū kú alɔ wā ɛgiyí aá, Utesaloníka ā. Nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa kōō cēyītīkwū kéē bɛ̄yíkwu alɔ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔtū tū alɔ ɔtū cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ lɛ ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā tá lɛ aá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ohɔ́nyɛtá kú uwā lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ó géē cē uwā kɛpɔ̄ kú awɔ mla uwá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛbɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ āpīice kú nū í kɔ̄ ɛpa ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kē ī lé ɔdōlé mlɛ, í ce ɔ̄ wā ipú okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ híī lé ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé aínyankwūlūmī, aíyɛ́ɛjī, mɛ́mla ákótō ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē lé ɔdōlé mlɛ, í ce ɔ̄ wā ipú okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́, amáŋ, āpīice kú uwā í kɔ̄ ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kwú uwī, káo je ɔ́ lá, ámāŋ kóō lɛ ɔ́ tá ɔlɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī alɛwa gaá le yɛ ā, Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ īlī ā kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti gā ŋmá Umasɛdónīya ā, Upɔ́lu kwú eko kú nū ú táajɛ yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si, klla yɔ̄ ī mafú péee lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla Ācɛ Ugríisi ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ géē kpó ígbɔ́cí ā ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn ga okónu ísu, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ uwá kpó gbō bɔ́há kwú uwā ú kpó ce eyī éŋkpɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ceyī enyi wā ɔgblɛga, ɛga nɛ̄ a géē kpó uwā ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ í kpó aígbɔ́cí ā kpó wī abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ uwá kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka ɔdōlé ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ eko nēé géē yúklɔ́ nyā lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ukénan nēe lā aígelī kú Ugésa ā, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem í nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́ jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā. É lā mla uwá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
idu_Latn: É gáā fu ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā ikpó ŋmá ajɛ ā glá ŋ́, amáŋ Óndú ā géē je ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya klla kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, awɔ nōo gē nyā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī je īyī nū tayínū.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔdāajɛ kú nū éyi ŋmó anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya ɛyi ɛfu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū hīgwú kéē wā gaá lé ɔdōlé. Eko nēé le lé kwɛyí ā, é le gbo ɛyí ɛfu ā otú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi gaá bī um, kwú um ŋmáajɛ, cɛ̄ gā um le okwúukwu mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kpó kwaajɛ. N kōō yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpaakpa ā lɔfú má aógbló ɛpa nēé le bī ɔ̄ wā ā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í lɔfú má ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛga ɔhá glá ŋ́. Aógbló ɛpa nyā bā abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and one.
idu_Latn: Aíjakī ā wɛ, úlā ofɛtá ce igwó ɛhīlī ce ofɛhɔ̄ . Ákú Óndú ā kē í wɛ ofɛtá ce éyi ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gwéeyē fíyɛ́ ohígbū kéē lɛ iyē kú aá tá tāajɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá í gwéeyē ohígbū ka alelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwú eyī hɛ́kwu Udéfīdi ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū á.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
idu_Latn: Ugéyulu, ɔyí kú Umɛ́ki ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi.

eng_Latn: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
idu_Latn: É géē wā í mīyɛ ɛga dóódu tābɔ̄, kwu aɔ́pɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛfu mɛ́mla aɔ́gɛ̄cɔ̄, kwu ipú ácí kú ujē mɛ́mla odúúdú ipácí nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ gē lúlé ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, N géē mafú gā uwɔ, ɔdā nōo tá ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwu ā. Ɛbɛ nɛ̄ a má nyā lɛyíkwu eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá nēe ī nwū íne ā! Aá gē kpó aɔ́dā ogbɛnú nɛ̄hi kú íne ā ce ācɛ kóō wɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā kéē lɛyītáajɛ lɛ uwá, amáŋ aá abɔ̄yī aá í gáā yá aíne ā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lígíí lɛ uwá kéē lɛyītáajɛ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
idu_Latn: Ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú nū lɔhi glá. Ó klla kē í bī ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū lɔɔlɔhi ɔwɛ nēé í lɛyi táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ glá.

eng_Latn: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá uwɔ ahínyá Ɔwɔicō, alɔ tá uwɔ ahínyá. Alɔ gē bī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú lɛ ā tɔ́ɔna. Alɔ klla ī ka odúúdú uklɔ́ idáagó nāa yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ klla le okónu cā lɛ Urebéka kahíníī, Awɔ, ɔyínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyā ā, ká ā kwú pīya ɛ́nɛ́ kú ācɛ úlúúlā igbíngbídi! Ayááyí uwɔ kéē mīyɛ aɔ́lɛ́ kú aólɛlā kú uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú, ɔdā nɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā kóō je lɛ uwá ā, wɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ma nōo ī plla ɔyí mɛ́mla amɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó lɛ enyi nɛ̄ ɔyí gē gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fu kú nū úlā ɛpa cofigwó , ācɛ o cɔnya kpɛ́fú úlā igwáahāapa cofigwó mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o yɛ ikpó kpɛ́fú úlā ofɛpa cigwó kpó kwú ŋmá abɔ̄ nū. Ó lɛ aɔ́nya nēe gē jɛ̄ aúgbɔ́ɔnya ofɛhɔ̄ glá kpó báajɛ, anɔ́ɔ́ ó le aóhile ā ikpó kpó ce á.

eng_Latn: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
idu_Latn: Le tá ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ā. Eko nē a le tá abɔ́ɔ ā, n géē da uwɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ a géē ka lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, Ujóssuwa le tútū, anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō tīīcō ga icō ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō āa.

eng_Latn: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ tɔ́kpá nyā ā. Igwú nēé hī um ka n̄ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá mla Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā, nōo je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aá bá Ukádiss abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī alɛwa á.

eng_Latn: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi cɛ̄ ka anúɔ lɔfú lé ɔdā dóódu glá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɔfú ipú ɔtū nōó kpóce ā ŋ́ mā ī lé ēpēēpū.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄, kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ī ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā! Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé, n géē je umaana nēé le tayínū ā lɛ ɔ́. N klla géē je ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hɛ́ nēe tá iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā. Iyē nēé tá tū ɔ̄ ā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú í já ɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́mba ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ā ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi lɛ ɛlā ka mla ācɛ ā kwɛyí ā, ó kwú īlī ú klá eyī.

eng_Latn: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ áafú ŋ́ aá pó lɔɔlɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɛhi kú úklɔ́ kú nū nyā gā um kú n̄ yá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le lɔhi lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nāa lɛ okónu ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō, a híī kpéeko bónū ō yá okónu nāa ce ɔ́ɔmá jīla ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, okónu ō ce kú olíla í he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ŋ́. Lɛ ɔdā nāa cokónu nū ā yá.

eng_Latn: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
idu_Latn: Tá alɔ abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu aólɛlā kú alɔ ohígbū ka odúúdú otábɔ̄ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ wɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ má odúúdú ɔfu kú ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ ā jéjée ɛɛ́? Ɔ̄nyɛ jé ɛdɔ ufi nɛ̄ ɔnū ō ce kú uwɔ gē bī wā ā?.

eng_Latn: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
idu_Latn: Ɛlihórēfu mɛ́mla Ahíja, ayí kú Ussíssa ā wɛ aɔ́málɛ otɔ́kpá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á. Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔyí kú Ahilúd gē leyīkwu ɔkpá nēé gē tá tāajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
idu_Latn: Iháyí alɛwa le gla, eko nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi wɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́siya ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi lé ka Ɛ́sra. Ó le ɛma kú nū ka jāā gaá kwu Árɔ̄ni otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ɛma kú nū nōó ka ā yɛ lɛ ā, Ɛ́sra wɛ ɔyí kú Useráya, Useráya wɛ ɔyí kú Asárīya, Asárīya wɛ ɔyí kú Uhílikáya.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń yá lɛ a ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē bīya um ojīlīmā ipú aéwo nēe má um, kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
idu_Latn: Ɛpláko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le tá ipú inu ā, ayíkpó kú nū lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ wɛɛlɛ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ í nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yɛ āa, n pó ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ekwukwu nɛ̄hi kú ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ipú ɔkpáncō. É bá gē ka kahíníī, Álɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō! Anú ī nya alɔ tá ā. Ó lóofu klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi!.

eng_Latn: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ a yúklɔ́ lɛ ā, á gáā má ɔdōlé ɔmɔɔmlɛ ŋmá anú ŋ́. A géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ílákpá nōó lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́, yɔ̄ ī gicō gajɛ piyóó ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī jikwū kú uwɔ, Ujonátan, ohígbū ka a he um ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ̄ um ā. A he um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ihɔtū nɛ̄ a yá tū um ā lɔhi ŋmá ipíípú fíyɛ́ ihɔtū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā ī yá tū ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a yá alɔ ka alɔ nya klla dɛ̄gba bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
idu_Latn: Ɔlá ō fíyajɛ kú ɛnɔ lɔnyɛ, ó klla he eyī ɔtū oōmá.

eng_Latn: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛ́hási le ɔgwu Unáaman tá á. Eko nɛ̄ Unáaman le ɔ́ má abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kwinya ce ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī wā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le hilatá wāajɛ ŋmá ugbɔ́ɔnya kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Ɔdée le yá nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū unwalu nōo yɔ̄ abālɔbányā ā, n gbɛlá koó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ō yɔ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá mīyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā le ɔ́ kpó catāajɛ. Ó ka aá klla le odúúdú ācɛ, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄nɛ́ncɛ́ kú uwā kpó ŋmó ŋmáajɛ dúúdú. Ka aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Ujékɔ̄pu le má ka Ulɛ́ya nōó je lɛ anúɔ á, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ulában ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá um yɔ̄ ā? Ń yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ ohígbū Urécɛ̄lu ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a plla um āa.

eng_Latn: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā eko nɛ̄ óndú kú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin ā gā, ɔdí nōó géē yá ācɛ olufa nēe bá abɔ́ɔ āa.

eng_Latn: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń yá lɛ ā ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē leyīkwu Ɔwɔicō eyī glá? Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē da Ɔwɔicō eko nōó gaá gbɔɔ́ ō da um ɔ̄kā?.

eng_Latn: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla o wúlatū wā ajɛ kú aɔ́pɛ́ nōo tágɔbū ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Áru. Ó klla yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛjī ajɛ kú Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō ī tūwēyī nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé gē yá tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le lé, é kē lɛ ipú nū. É lɛ iwili nēe hile ā túbá, ó kē le mu ómblí igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
idu_Latn: Aá le jé ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kōō wɛ ɔfiyɛ o, ó kōō wɛ ɔfiyɛ nóo, Ɔwɔicō gē gbā ulé kú úklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
idu_Latn: N géē wá okwū uwɔ klá ɛfu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ dóódu.

eng_Latn: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī gbɛlá ka, abɔ̄ Ujúdasi gē bī alítā kú ije ā, ka Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nōo ce uwá ɛgbá kú ucɛ ā lá, ámāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ je odée lɛ aógbɛhá.

eng_Latn: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
idu_Latn: É kwú igbīhi í cē kwu um. Nááná n húmáyī nwú uwá klla nwū uwá ā, é tá ō jāhɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nēé gē pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē nwū uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi je ɛgwā gicō ipú ígbíli ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ gicō piíí á.

eng_Latn: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ kú Umasɛdónīya bū ipú ojámá mɛ́mla eko unwalu nɛ̄hi náána ɔtū gē he uwá nɛ̄hi. É klla gbɛhá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛhi, amáŋ é wɛ ācɛ nēe ī nwūla abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ojīlīma kú Óndú ā aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ óndú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ ofú kú nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aúwi lā ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛbɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē je unwalu lɛ ɛbɔ́ kú ācɛ nēe ī yá Ɔwɔicō cɔ̄nū ā ŋ́. Ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī uwā wɛ ɔwɔ nēé ī gbā á.

eng_Latn: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
idu_Latn: Ɔcányā kú Ussɛ́ba ā lɛ íjééyī kú Usólōmɔn ā pó ahɔ̄ abɔ̄yi nū klla le agblɔ̄cɛ́ nōó gwó ā má.

eng_Latn: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
idu_Latn: N kē í cokónu mla uwá nōo géē yá kéē yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. N géē je odúúdú ɛbɛ́ ipácí oŋmácɛ ā kpó nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aálá kú um ké ā lúlé ɛbɔ́ ipácí, klla gbɔlā ɛbɔ́ ipú aúpū ā.

eng_Latn: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Le tá fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Usádisi ka ami nōo lɛ íkwu ɛyí kú aálelékwū ahāapa nēe ī cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ahāapa ā kahíníī, N jé ucē nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā. Aá lé iyē ka aá yēeyī amáŋ aá gekwú ɛɛ́!.

eng_Latn: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛlam wɛ, úlā ɛtá ce ofu ɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ɛgiyí Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta ā, Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú a gáā na um ikpó nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eyī kwu ɔcí ō gwá īkpō lɔɔlɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ īkpō má lé ŋmá anú. Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo gē leyīkwu ɔkpani nū lɔhi, géē mīyɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
idu_Latn: Okónu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ce ā, wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄. Ó kē wɛ okónu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ glá. Ó wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi bɛ̄ɛka oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé bī ɔlá le na ɔ́ igbo ahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ la uya kú ācɛ, ɛyí ɛfu a, uya kú ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ mla aéwo dóódu nēe ba ī wā í túbá tɔ̄há kú ɛfu ookpo abɔ́ɔ ā. Óndú kú ɛfú a yɔ̄ ī tá aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tū kú ɛfú ookpó.

eng_Latn: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
idu_Latn: Ó le abaná tū klá ajɛ kú uwā, jāā kwu ipú inu o gbɔɔlā kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: kóō le da Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā kahíníī, Aá híī juwēyī lɛ iyē ōtīihɔ kú um ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá le ojīlīmā ce ɔdā ɛ̄gbā ōtīihɔ kú ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē je gā um ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄kā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔbá nū kahíníī, Ɔfiyɛ kú uwɔ, ɔ̄cɛ Uhíbru nɛ̄ a bī wā ɔlɛ́ ā, wā inu ɛgiyí um gaá cá um ɛcá.

eng_Latn: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nwū Ɔwɔicō íjééyī glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anú gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú aálelékwū nēe ī cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā á.

eng_Latn: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
idu_Latn: Ó je ɔ́da nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nɛ̄ ó nuunu tá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. N pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ń jé ŋ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā nōo Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ le wú anúɔ lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá le bá abɔ̄ ká aá lɛ ɔfú ŋmó klla le oyēeyī tū glá. Ka anúɔ géē kpó aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā wī ŋmá uwā abɔ̄, klla ī hɛ́ ācɛ nɛ̄ uwá kwú klla lɛ ɔfú lɛyíkwu uwá ā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosíya, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka ga um.

eng_Latn: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
idu_Latn: Igelī ā í cɛgbá ɛnɔ, ámāŋ ka ɔyā kéē fíyáajɛ ipú nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛgahi ofíyajɛ nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō gē fíyáajɛ ipú igelī ā, Ɔyí álá ā kē wɛ agege kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Ujasíílu mɛ́mla Ugúni.

eng_Latn: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo lɛ āpīice, nɛ̄ āpīice kú nū le kɔ̄ ɛpa, nēe gē lé ɔdōlé mlɛ, í ce ɔ̄ wā ipú okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
idu_Latn: Ó le ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā lá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ayí kú Uhámɔ, nōo wɛ ádā kú Ussɛ́kɛm ā, īkpō kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aótrɛ̄yí kú aá mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ítāli ā hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ígbɔhá Óndú ā klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le iŋini ka tú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Aá le ācɛ kú Óndú ā kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
idu_Latn: Ubatisséba da Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ ɛjɛ le tá ɔtɛ́, ɛ́ɛ géē je anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔyí anúɔ, Usólómɔ̄n bɛ̄ɛka ācoyíbīyājɛ ā.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó í bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, mɛ́mla álá éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utɔ́mɔ̄si, nēé hī ka Áplɛ́ ā da ayíkpó ɔ́mpa nū kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ dúú ká ālɔ̄ kwú mla anú.

eng_Latn: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé kwú agbá ú kwu ɔ́ abɔ̄ ā, é lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄ gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Upáyílēti, igbómína ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ uwá ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē ka nyā a: Eko nɛ̄ n fu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, N lɛ okónu ce lɛ uwá. N lɛ īyī um mafú lɛ uwá Íjīpiti klla le ka lɛ uwá ka ami, Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā ka. N géē cɛ̄ ijáalí tū aá, Ísrɛ̄lu. Ami Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū uwɔ nēé gē cē um ɛcá nɛ̄ n tá ipú uwēyī yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ádā nū ohi ka anúɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄, ohígbū ka ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je lɛ anúɔ ā í lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ukálɛ̄bu kwú njɔɔlɔ kú ɛhíícō mɛ́mla ákú ɛháajɛ ā ú kpó lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the LORD? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya le ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācoyímabɔ̄ kú uwá kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá mla ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú nyā ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, alɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛga nɛ̄ ó ŋmá ā, ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē je tɛ̄hɔ̄ búla anú nyɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
idu_Latn: Ussóbālu wɛ ádā kú Uríya nōo wɛ ádā kú Ujáhāti nōo ma Ahúmāyi mɛ́mla Uláhādi á. Aɛ́nyā wɛ aádáádā kú ācɛ nēe lā Usóra ā.

eng_Latn: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
idu_Latn: Ŋmífī nɛ̄ n kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, jāā kwu ícɛ, n húmáyī yɔ̄ ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ. Ń lā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ n húmáyī lā, ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Igbō ɛmulá nɛ̄ aá bī ā? É tá ɔ̄ ohi ka igbō ahāapa nɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n tíne kú aá le jé ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ī bītá í gáā lɔfú ka kahíníī, N tókónu lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú ka kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Óndú ā glá ōfōōfūnū ɔ́dāŋ ka Alelékwū ihɔ yɔ̄ ī bī ɔ̄ tá.

eng_Latn: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
idu_Latn: N géē tá iyē ācɛ Íjīpiti, ācɛ Ubábīlɔn, ācɛ Ufilístiya, ācɛ Utáya mɛ́mla ācɛ Itiyópīya eko dúú mā nɛ̄ n gē tá iyē kú aéwo nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ gā um ā. N géē gbo uwá áluka tū ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
idu_Latn: Ujótam klla da uwá ɔ̄kā kéē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛ īyī uwā eko nēé je Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki lé ɔcɛ́ nyā ā? Ó klla da uwá kéē blakwu ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ugídīyɔn klla lɛ ojīlīma ká ɔdā nōó yá lɛ uwá ā ce ɔ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄?.

eng_Latn: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā ka nyā, awɔ nōo ī kahíníī, Ícɛ ámāŋ ka ócí n géē ga igelī nɛ̄hi nyā ámāŋ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ká n̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ iháyí éyi ká n̄ tɔ́ɔ́sú, ká n̄ yá ije nɛ̄hi. ā.

eng_Latn: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
idu_Latn: Ujássūbu mɛ́mla Ussímrɔn.

eng_Latn: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le hīlókplícī ipú ajɛ ā klla lɛ ayí ma, nɛ̄ ayí uwā lɛ ayí ma, nááná ɛ́ɛ híī bīya íne kú Óndú ā, oŋmá lɛ o yá ɛ́dɔ kú ojibó dúúmā lɛ iyī uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Kwú ede kú ugóolu o yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ɛyí nū ā ú háyi iyɔ̄bū kú Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ú playi anú.

eng_Latn: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya mɛ́mla Umakibannáyi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
idu_Latn: Ahāpōtú ā, Ubówāsi le héyī, pīyeyī kpánáá. Anɔ́ɔ ó hɛ́gilígilí ka ɔnyā éyi ɔɔ́ gwutá ablīkpó kú anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, alɔ da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, alɔ í wɛ ācɛ o bɔkwu ajɛ tayínū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ka anúɔ wɛ ā? Íkwu nyā nɛ̄ a lɛ ō bu únóji lɛ īyī uwɔ tá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú áklō kú ɛfu ā?.

eng_Latn: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā nɛ̄ aá lɛ Ɔwɔicō jé abɔ̄yī aá ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā, kɛ̄ɛ kā n̄ ka, abālɔbányā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá jé ɛɛ́ mā a, ɛ́gɛ́nyá nɛ̄ aá klla tíne ō kwúcē ga ɛgiyí aálelékwū nēé ī gbō ɛcɛ nyā āā, nēé lɔfú ŋ́ í klla tīile ŋ́, kú aá kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā igbɔhá āa?.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páahɔ̄, kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā! Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé, ikwū igbɔɔ́mpa, nōo wɛ ikwū opiyóó ā, í gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō nɛ, kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ɔ́dāŋ koó tíne ō nya ɔ́ tá. Ohígbū koó ka, Ami ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ oyī kú ɛka nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbo mɛ́mla aá kú aá le tū á.

eng_Latn: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɛ́gbla kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gē má ŋ́ mā á, anú kē wɛ aflɛ́yí á nēe fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
idu_Latn: Awɔ húmáyī wɛ ɛga otayínū olɔfú kú aólɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ á. Awɔ wɛ ɛga otayínū kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ī ce uwá eko kú ákanya kú uwá á. Awɔ kē wɛ ɛga omlɛnyɔ̄ kú uwā ŋmá ipú ɔwɔ mɛ́mla ɛnɔ á. Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē nuunu tú alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ otá owu nɛ̄hi gē yā klá ɔdɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
idu_Latn: Umíka ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Upítɔ̄ni, Umélēki, Utáréya mɛ́mla Áhāsi.

eng_Latn: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú ācɛ kú Ujíyu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā nōo bá Ubábīlɔn, nōo pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm mla Ɛ́sra eko nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā jɛga lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́ɔkpá nyā fú Utímōti ɔyí um o he um ɔtū ipú ocɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, Óndú alɔ kéē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, kéē gbonɛnɛ gā uwɔ, kéē klla je oōgbɛhi ipú alelékwū gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ ī yɛ gɔbū ipú iyāwu kú alɔ, ŋmá Utáya gā ajɛ Utolɛ́māyisi, ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ okónu hɛ́tū ayínɛ́ ā klla yɔ̄ mla uwá ɛ̄cī éyi.

eng_Latn: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔtū kú odúúdú aá kóō híīī gbenyi abālɔbányā ŋ́. Aá yúklɔ́ nyɔ̄, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ mla aá. Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō, nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukɛ́nan mɛ́mla ācɛ Umeyára ɛ̄nɛ̄ wɛ ákú ācɛ Usídɔn ā jāā ga Áféki nōo kwu ɛjī kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄n ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cī usábāti kú um ā tū, aá klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī ka anú nɛ. Amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá kē tá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ anú ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ o gbla ɔ̄cɛ icííci nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ anú abɔ̄yī nū ka anúɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē nyɔ̄ ɛcɛ í kpó iyɔ́fú nɛ̄ ācɛ ā kwú hɛ̄ uwā tá bá ajɛ ā le gwɔ́ɔ́lá. É géē kpó ɔ́kplɛ́fú, ɔtā, ɔyī, obō mɛ́mla ogbló kú ācɛ ā le gwɔ́ɔ́lá. É kē ī bá ī bī iyó nyā gwɔ́ɔ́lá iháyí ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ma ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo yíihɔtū tá ádā ɔyí, géē yíihɔtū tá ɔyí ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
idu_Latn: Le ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē tíne ká n̄ lɛ́pɔ̄hi ā, kéē gwéeyē klla tɔ́ɔga, kú ɔtū kóō he uwá, nēé géē yɔ̄ ī ka tɛ́ɛcɛ eko dóódu kahíníī, Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Anú nōo gé lɛ ɛlá kwu ō yɔ̄ lɔhi kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēe pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā wɛ, Usíha, Uhásūpa, Utábāwɔtu.

eng_Latn: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
idu_Latn: N cīce abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔtūnōbí jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā kē yá ā. Ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō jīla tū um, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ācɛ nēe jé klla bā í yúufi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka lɛyíkwu ɛdɔ kú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ nōo pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ bōōbū nyā bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le yá ká ācɛ kéē lɛ odée nyā jé gbojī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le bēhé Ujɔ́dan ā, Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníī.

eng_Latn: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.
idu_Latn: Óócí, é géē kpó ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kú aá wā iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā í fu ā géē wā iyɔ̄bū nū ipɔ́ɔnū ipɔ́ɔnū nɛ̄ n kē í je ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyééye géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ɔ́ɔmā wā iyɔ̄bū um.

eng_Latn: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ Ɛláyíssa hīgwú wā gé lɛ anúɔ. Ɛláyíssa yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, nēe gaá má ɔ̄ ā, ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā wā á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, le ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā kóō lɛ um ŋmó ɛɛ́ n. Okwɔɔkwu nyā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā gā amānyā, aá lɛ ɔwɛ gwū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá bī ɔ̄ ká. Ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū ā tá ɔ̄ igbīhi gē wā.

eng_Latn: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gwó ā le pɛkɛpɛkɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ ɔlákápá ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē klá anú ī gbo ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu kú Umówābu kwu ɛyí inu mɛ́mla ɔɔ́pu kú nū, odúúdú ācɛ ā bá ī yɔ̄tūnōbí. Ohígbū ka n kwú Umówābu ú ca klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔjá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tíne gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n gē mafú ihɔtū eko dóódu lɛ úlúúlā kú ācɛ nēe ma ihɔtū kú uwā fú gā um klla lɛ íne kú um tū ā.

eng_Latn: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó géē bɔ̄bí nɛhí lɛ anyā nēe yīīpú mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e gē je amɛ̄ lɛ ayí gwá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lɔtūce ɔ́ ā, é gáā ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ācɛ nēé lɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, é le ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó uwā ɛɛ́, ohígbū keé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, mā aálá ā tá mla ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō leyīkwu uwá gbēyī nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyó ā ú le yɛ tá ɛga nɛ̄ ádā nū, Ujése tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ā. Udéfīdi gā aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā eko nēé bá gē hɔ́ɔgba kéē kpɛ́fú ā, é kē bá ī dɛ̄gbōgwú kwaáá kwaáá.

eng_Latn: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē blakwu ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī mlanyī ŋ́. Ka Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō, ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ á. Ó ka ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gwu ɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē blakwu ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ le yá ī gla ɛɛ́ mā ŋ́. Ācɛ kú ɛcɔ̄bū í klla gáā blakwu ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá abālɔbányā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ, Árɔ̄ni kē wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ce ɛtá, eko nēé kɛlā lɛ Uféro ā.
