eng_Latn: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le opo tá ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ka ɛ́ɛ nū aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu inya ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ ɛfú ā mɛ á.

eng_Latn: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, nēe mɛ́ɛbɛ ka ka Ɔwɔicō géē nya aá tá ā, tíne klla dɔɔ̄kā lɔfú lɛyíkwu ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
idu_Latn: Éhūdu lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nōo lɛ eyī ɛpa, na lɛ iyī nū. Olīkpō kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó éyi ce āyā ā. Ó lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā gbō bá ɛ́nyɔ́ abɔ̄lɔ́ná ipú ɔdōwīyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī ka ā pó ā, ó kwúcē ŋmá Ujudíya le tá Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā bá yɔ̄ ī jikwū, é kē lɛ ɔtū má Upɔ́lu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ayíkpó ā kahíníī, Ɔtū kú aá kóō lɛ unwalu ŋ́, aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla kē lɔtūce um dúú.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
idu_Latn: Ámɔ́si kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ɔ́da je, é géē je aínu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aínu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kpó ca ŋiniŋiniŋini.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
idu_Latn: N da aá ka igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, ń gáā gwá ejé īkpō ufáyin nyā gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wā í cɔcɛ́ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ abālɔbányā dúú á. Ó lɛ ācɛ olígíí nēe hile nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ohígbū kóō ī ményinyi íbí.

eng_Latn: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
idu_Latn: É lɛ Uríya bī ŋmá Íjīpiti wā gē lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔcɛ́ ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwā bī ɔkpacāŋ́gelī lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. É kwú okwū kú nū ú tá tá ɛga nēe gē nyi ācɛ nēé wɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē kwu ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā le gbenyi ā ajaajɛ. Ó klla gē nya ācɛ nēé lɛ eyīyōce ŋ́ mā tá.

eng_Latn: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē kwú ga ɔlékwū, ohígbū ka ó kwú iyī nū tū glá ŋ́. Íla kú nū géē bī ɔ̄ ga ipú únóji piíí.

eng_Latn: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
idu_Latn: Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aádáádā aá, aá kwú pīyeyí ŋmá ɔwɛ kú um, klla i lɛ íne kú um tū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Aá le pīyeyī wā ɛgiyí um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ kē lɛ pīyeyī wā ɛgiyí aá. Amáŋ aá gē dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ pīyeyī wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō kōō lɛ āgā tútū kóō le hɛ́ aɔ́cí tɛgba tɛgba ɛɛ́. Ɔcí dúúmā nōó gwá īkpō ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ŋ́, ó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ wāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla le lóofu nɛ̄hi eko nōó pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛfú nōó kpó ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm úlā ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄ ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a, Óndú āgēe bī ífi gē la uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú a, lɛ íkwu mla ɔ́da dóódu a ka lɛ a.

eng_Latn: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le hídáagó eko nōó lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ā. Ó le eyī pīya tá ɛwa kú ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N da aá ka ń má ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ o lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ɛdɔ ɛ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, n kōō má ɔ̄cɛ dúú ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛbɛ́ dúú nōo hile gbó ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá ā, é géē je ɔ́ yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le ojibó kú ɛcí ma ŋmá anú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ í ce igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū Ɔ́fra. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Ɔwɔicō gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ojibó kú Ugídīyɔn ɛ̄gbā á. Ɛ̄nyā kwú píya ukpa lɛ Ugídīyɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ odúúdú iŋini ā pó ā, n kwú cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔdā ɔfú nɛ̄ɛ, Ɔwɔicō géē cɛ̄ ɔfú. Ɔ́dáŋ koó wɛ ɔdā ō bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔnu ɛpɔ̄ nɛɛ, ɔnyɛ géē hɛ́pɔ̄ ka ami mɛ́mla anú ā?.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī kpó ɔdā dúúmā tū ɔ́da nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kōō í je ŋmá anú ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne ā céé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī le hɛ́tíipú lígíí ācɛ nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā le jīla tɔhā, é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ofu ɛhīlī ā, anɔ́ɔ Upíta cāŋjɛ kóō kɛlā lɛ uwá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá kwú ajɛ ú lá, ɛga kú óndú ajɛ ā kóō lɔfú lá ɔdāyīnū cīgbīhi glá ā cíká ō yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin, nōo kwu ɛga nēé hī ka, Ubaalu Uhámɔn ā. Ó kwú ɛhɔ̄ ā tá olufa lɛ aɔ́glɛ́ɛjí. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá gē cílá īkpīije úlā ɛpa cofigwó kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
idu_Latn: N lé ɔdōlé ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ dúúmā ŋ́. Ń lé ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ń gwá ejé dúúmā ŋ́. Ń klla kōō lɛ anɔ̄ nya iyē ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē fíyɛ́yí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú o je yɛ́hi kú íne nēé bīya ā, lɛ Óndú ā kwɛ́yí odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. É kē í je yá uwā ɛhi, ohígbū ka é jégēdē nyíleyī ŋ́. É kē lɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne nēé bīya ā bī wā gé lɛ Óndú ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā gaá má lā Ugáti á. Anyā ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ɛpa ā bá mla anú. Ahínōwam nōo ŋmá Ujesiríili ā, mɛ́mla Abígɛ̄lu ɔnyā okwūmā kú Unábalu nōo ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē bīya um ojīlīmā a, n yá lɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ipéyī kú ācɛ nēé lā ipú uwā ā, n lɛ ɔna tá lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ka n géē kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhosíya ka anúɔ gáā le ɔnyā ā fūla mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, mla okolo ofu ahāapa ce igwó kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ugóolu nēé je ohígbū úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɔtū éékpó ŋmá ipú agbénú kú uwá ā, géē lɔfú gbo ɛkpa ije ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé je dúú ā, géē gbo ɛkpa ije ofu igwáahātá ce igwó. É klla kpó awulú kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ofɛhɔ̄ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And if the man like not to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɔyínɛ́ ɔbá nū ā ɔ́ɔ tíne ō je ɔ́ ɔnyōkwū ŋ́, ɔnyā ā kóō le tá ɛgiyí anyākwɔ́cɛ kú igelī ā gaá da uwá ka ɔyínɛ́ ɔbá anúɔ ɔ́ɔ tá ō yúklɔ́ kú nū, o ŋmá ō je anúɔ ɔnyōkwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔkwu kú ɔyínɛ́ nū kóō híī bí ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú aá túbá! É le íbɔm cē tū alɔ lɛ alɔ yɛjīla tá biílí ɛɛ́! É yɔ̄ ī nuunu tá aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
idu_Latn: ācɛ o cē ijáalí nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ eko dóódu, mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo gē hɛ́ ikpɛ́lā tá ajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ayínɛ́ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é pīyɛyí le ɛyí plaajɛ í kɛ́lā ŋ́ jāā wā igelī nɛ̄hi ā, bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nēe pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú nɛ̄ uwēyī gē kwú uwā ā á.

eng_Latn: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábāti alɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī ā le tá okónu ísu ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce ka ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu gē túbá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā yɔ̄ ā. Alɔ má báajɛ le ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛnyā nēe wā í jīla tɔ̄há abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
idu_Latn: Ó wā ɛgiyí Upáyílēti gaá le ba ɔ́ kóō kwú okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ú lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti le ɔ́da je kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD; for ye have compassion on me.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da uwá ka Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbonɛnɛ lɛ anúɔ klla kē ményinyi anúɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, aá híīī gbɛlá bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ncɛ ā ŋ́. Aá le pīya ogwuda bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ncɛ ā ɛgiyí ínoōbīya. Amáŋ aá le pīya ijímkpa ipú ɛlá nɛ̄ aá ī gbo ā.

eng_Latn: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufárisīi ā.

eng_Latn: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa ŋmó klla kpɛ́fú alɛwa ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó le ka ka amíyɔ̄ í gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ajaajɛ kú okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá ɛga nɛ̄ Udánīyɛlu yɔ̄ ā, ó da Udánīyɛlu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu eee! Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo yēeyī ā! Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu ā, lɔfú lɛ uwɔ nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aágábá glá ā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da Upíta kahíníī, Kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwɔ ú wu apɛ́. A gbɛlá ka ń gáā mā ɛdɔ kú ōwē nɛ̄ Ádā um miya gā um ka n̄ má ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔni Upíta, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔyíkpó kú Ujísɔ̄si tɔ́kpá nyā fu ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēe gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa yá kéē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ nōo lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ákú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
idu_Latn: Gbō um ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipū nēe ī tíne ō je um yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā. Aólɛlā nēe le um yɛjīla tá, ī tíne ō ŋmó um ā.

eng_Latn: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɛ̄nyā alɔ jé ka alɔ ī yíihɔtū tū ayí Ɔwɔicō eko nɛ̄ alɔ ī yíihɔtū tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū, klla gē lɛ íne kú nū tū.

eng_Latn: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí mɛ́ɛ́nɛ? Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í má ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ígwu olígíí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā le ɔ́ pīyɛ̄, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ ohile ā ahɔ̄ du, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pó igwú kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
idu_Latn: É le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nyɔ̄ í gbɔga ɛháajɛ kú Árōwɛ, igelī nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔpɛ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ugádi ā. É ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá Ujása.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan lɛ Udéfīdi hīīgwú lɛ ɛlā dóódu nēe bá nyā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́, klla lɛ ɔ́ bī wā iyɔ̄bū Usɔ́lu gāá yɔ̄ āyā nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ ī cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācoyúufi, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kwúcē ŋmá ō yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē ɛbí, mɛ́mla ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī cikpó ɔnyā nōo wɛ ɔnyā uwā ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ācoyíimabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́hɛ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ géē ŋmɛ́yí ipú ókpoó nɛ̄ ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛcōwō bá ī yi ipú nū ā. Ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ ikwū ɔ́mpa ā á.

eng_Latn: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā. Ó lɛ alɔ wā, klla kwú alɔ í kpó lé. Ó kwú agbénú kú alɔ í wu lé, nɛ̄ alɔ gaá tá áncā bɛ̄ɛka ɔja nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ anú ŋ́ mā. Ó kwú ɔdā dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ohile ā í ú kpó bónū.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, ɔyí um jāhɔ̄ ká ā lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā da uwɔ nyā pó.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā! Ɔdí nāa í dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā? N bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga awɔ, ā híī yá um itala ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, a je ɔ́da lɛ eyī ka ɔ́ɔ le nyā, nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ jéejéé ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa ŋmá aɔ́lɛ́ okwúbɔ́há kú Ujudíya mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni kéē pó ɛlā kú nū. É lɛ íne nēé bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ubatísim yá uwá ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ nɛ̄ ó wɛ Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda kéē lɛ aólɛlā ā yálé aflɛ́yí, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áā cɛ̄tra ipɔ́ɔmā kú Udéfīdi klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ā, kóō híī fíyɛ́ ákú ācɛ Ujúda ohile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū awɔ nōo wɛ Usáyímɔ̄n ā ɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ a le ce ɔ́ ā kóō tɔ́ɔlá ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ a kwúcē igbīhi wā í tá um kpɔ́, tá ayíkpó aɔ́mpa awɔ abɔ̄ kéē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā le abɔ̄ flá tū Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni ipú okómpīinu kú Usólōmɔn nēé cē áklɔ̄kpɛ ce ɔ́ ā. Ó le hɛ́ ācɛ ā idáagó nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ é le inya kwu ga ɛgiyí uwā á.

eng_Latn: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ayááyí uwɔ kéē cɔcɛ́ eko dóódu ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ n géē yá kéē bá ī cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka anúɔ géē yá kú okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ tá nyā kóō lɛ aúwī mɛ́mla ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu kwú. Okónu ā í yɔ̄ ī kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó lɛ uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē híla ɔmpā nū wɛɛlɛ ā yíífi. Ń gáā cībū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ klla ī gɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
idu_Latn: Obugā nɛ̄ ayí-ɔ́cɛ́ bū ā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ, bī okwutɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́cí ō kwajɛ kú uwā bu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ā, le yɛ tá Umɛtána.

eng_Latn: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā ɛjī ā le pīya lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ga Asínɔtu Utábɔ. Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Uhúkɔku gaá lɛ iyē nya ɛháajɛ kú Usɛ́bulɔn, mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ása, klla mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ɛgiyí Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwu óbō mɛ́mla ɔjá kú éŋkpɔ̄ nēe bá ɛga īkpɛ̄yí kú Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā ajaajɛ ā ú kpó, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má uwā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī jé ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í kōō héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le uwá ŋmíyɔ̄lā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá kwú īlī ekwu ú kpó wiiyē ká aá jikwū klla míya ajɛ. Aá yēkwu bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yēkwu kú ɔyí ékpónú kú nū ā. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wā í je aá yíífi ā, í wā í kpɛ́fu tú aá acígilí.

eng_Latn: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ubɛ́tɛlu, nēé kē dēē ligbó ŋmá Ɛ́frāti ā, ɔma le Urécɛ̄lu kwú. Unwalu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kē tá ɔma ā ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā, ó kē í ŋmó opī kú ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya ā. Ó géē bī oyī kú nū wā ipú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá ɔ̄wū mɛ́mla Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá mla oyī kú ɔbɛ́ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔkpacańgelī le yá ācɛ kú Asírīya lé klla í mīyɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā nōo wɛ ákú Unímrɔ̄du ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Asiríya, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Asírīya lɛ ikpó bá ɛjī kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ klla le behé wā ipú ajɛ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
idu_Latn: ocíbú ofu kú ugóolu nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū wɛ ukílōgram ahāanɛ ā mɛ́mla aócíbú ɛpa kú oje udɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ugóolu ā lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā alɔ lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ o mafú ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ pī uwā ā ipú ígbíli. É yá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kɔ́ɔ̄ yá ɔ̄ gbla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ mafú lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū dóódu ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwá lɛ ā, gē tá ūlī kéē jé ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé gáā gbō ā.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ le ɛka gwá klla le okónu ce iyē kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́ mā, nɛ̄ alɔ klla kē lɛ Óndú ā hī ijáalí kú alɔ ā. Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú um mɛ́mla ákú uwɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á, Ujonátan kē kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
idu_Latn: Umíssma ma Uhámūwɛlu, Usáku, mɛ́mla Ussímēyi á.

eng_Latn: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń lɛ ɛlá wu ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, Óndú ā í géē yɛ ī jāhɔ̄ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ klla kahíníī, Kpái! Ujerúsālɛm, awɔ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī móōwē nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í tá uwɔ ɔtūlé dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́ má. N géē bī ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi le ikpó kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ táajɛ klla í gwó uwɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ákanya, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtūnōbí yēeyī kpɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Opī ā géē kpó odúúdú íne nēé bīya ā ga ipú ígbíli ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
idu_Latn: Uya nɛ̄ acá kú aɔ́dā ōlɛ acá oōbī wu ā bá ī yá ā, é pó jāā kwu eyīyɛcɛ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Uya ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē tá ō yá ɛ̄nɛ̄ o nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú íne ā, nōo klla nwū ācɛ kéē yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō géē lɛ ɔ́ jiji tēyī ipú ajɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ íne ā tū, klla nwū ācɛ ɔhá kéē yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ hágāgā ŋmá odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm le jīla cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gaá da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nēé géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ká aá lɛ aálá ofɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwā le lé gebí á. Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í yá ā? Ó í habɔ̄ aálá ofɛnɛ cigwáahāanɛ ohile ā bá ipácí, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā ékpó nōo bí ā jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Ubɛ́lssása, cɔcɛ́ Ubábīlɔn ā, n klla le ɔ̄na ɔhá nā kpɔ́, nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ɛ̄nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ nā ā tá.

eng_Latn: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɛ́sra le okwúukwu kwaajɛ iyɔ̄bú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ klla yɔ̄ ī jikwū nɛ̄hi klla yɔ̄ í ka íne nēé bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ gāá le jīla tū ɔ̄ biílí klla bá í jikwū, bá í tɛ̄gíkwú mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō ga ɛyíkwū ikɔkɔ ō ga ɔlɛ́ nēé yá ucɛ klá ɛcɛ, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā cíkā ō blakwu iyī ūwā ka ikwū yɔ̄ ī gbēyī odúúdú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
idu_Latn: Otóótú ɔ́ɔmā, Uféro le Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá le bɛ̄cɛ, aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um, kú aá nyɔ̄ gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ka ā.

eng_Latn: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
idu_Latn: Ka anúɔ da uwá ka anúɔ wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nēé ī gbā á. Ka anúɔ da uwá kéē híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lā ipú ajɛ kú uwā ā. Amáŋ, é jāhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
idu_Latn: Umakíyɛ le ɔnyā éyi lɛ lɛ Uhɔ́ppim. Ó kē lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá lɛ lɛ Ussɔ́pim. Ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā ā wɛ Umáaka. Ɔyí kú Umakíyɛ ɔ́mpa ā wɛ Usélōphedádi, nōo ma ayínɔnyā ōfōōfūnū ā.

eng_Latn: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyūdi ma Ɛlísa, Ɛlísa ma Umátan, Umátan ma Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gicō ā, nēe lɔfú ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ɛɛ́ mā gbaáluka ipɔ́ɔma ipɔ́ɔma.

eng_Latn: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kē le ɔkɔ gbā gā uwɔ ā, a le ɔkɔ kú um pó.

eng_Latn: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
idu_Latn: Po ɔkɔ kú uwá bá ī hɛ́ áganá tū ɛnwū tá ɔwɛ nōo yɛ gicō lɛyíkwu Uluhíiti ā. Ikwū kú ákanya nēé bá ī je, ī nyɔ̄ Uhoronéyim abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ka n géē wɛ olɛlā kú ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti. N klla í kpó abɔ̄ kú nū ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā cē kpɔ́. Kwú abɔ̄ kú nū olɔhi mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kwú cē ɛɛ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā hɛ́ ɔɔ́ abɔ̄ tá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda lɛ ācɛ nēe ŋmó Ámɔn ā kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ujosíya, ɔyí kú Ámɔn ú lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ohi kú ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā le mu um ipú hile, nɛ̄ ń kwú ɔ̄ tū ipú kú um glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubássa lɛ ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ í yá nyā pó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó mā igá nōó yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ tū Uráma ā tá. Ánɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tā Utɛ́sa á.

eng_Latn: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
idu_Latn: Óndú, blakwu okónu nɛ̄ a ce ā, ká ā leyī gwō alɔ bónū gɛ ŋ́. Ā híī je uwēyī lɛ ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ɛgiyí akpa kú ɛgahi kú uwɔ ā gɛ ŋ́ A je okónu nɛ̄ a ce mla alɔ ā bīya gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, aá wā kú ālɔ̄ lā ŋmá lɛ ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
idu_Latn: N da aá ka, aá gáā má um gɛ ŋ́ ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá géē kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē wā ŋmá Íjīpiti fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka aígbáanɔ ā. É klla í wā ŋmá Asírīya bɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē cē uwá cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ uwā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
idu_Latn: Ubálam da Ubálāki kahíníī, Háyi pīyɛ̄ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú uwɔ ā amānyā, ká n̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um má.

eng_Latn: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a lē tútū ō kɛpɔ̄ tū igelī nɛ̄ ācoŋmócɛ wɛ omōōmu nū ɛ̄ɛ̄? Lɛ odúúdú ucē ɛbí nēé yá ā ka lɛ uwa.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhárim ā wɛ, Umaaséya, Ɛláyíja, Ussɛmáya, Ujéhīyelu, mɛ́mla Usíya.

eng_Latn: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nɛ̄ uwēyī gáā kwú mɛ́ɛ̄ ā ohígbū ka ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ayínɛ́ uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka é yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā. Le tútū uwēyī ō kwú uwɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka a yá ka ayínɛ́ uwɔ kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka é le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ā ɔwɛ ɔlamu é ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔnyā nōo lɛ iyī nū ā ŋmá lɛ okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce ā.

eng_Latn: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpáni, n ba ɔyí ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ɔɔ? Ń tɛtɛ da uwɔ ka ā yá ká n̄ híī leyīce ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā le pó ā, ó hɛ́ uwā idáagó fíyábɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é dɔ̄ɔkā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kē í nyatá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla le igwú hī ɔ̄ igbɔhá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Usámūwɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu klla cāŋjɛ le tá ɛgiyí Ɛ́lāyi klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, awɔ kē hī um igwú á. Amáŋ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń hī uwɔ igwú ní, ɔyí um. Nyɔ̄ gaá gwutá.

eng_Latn: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɔfú mīyɛ cɛ̄ ka ɔdā ōnwū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi dúúdú. Ó wā ipú ɔkpíyē kú ɔ̄cɛ ipú ɔkpíyē kú alelékwū é le ɔ́ mafú ka ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, é tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú nū lɛ éwo dóódu. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ɛcɛ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū. É kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō kú ō nyɔ̄ í yɔ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
idu_Latn: Okónu kú awɔ, abɔ̄yī uwɔ ī ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí á. Ó wɛ ami ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ā ŋ́. Ɛlā nɛ̄ a gē ka ā gē cīijáalí tū uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka, Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ āa? Ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ubɛ́tūwɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Unáhɔ nɛ̄ Umílka ma lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú eliká ā ú wu ɔ́ ɛnwū klla kwú oje o tābɔ̄ ú tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ajɛ kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Uhélefu gaá kwu ɔcí kú Óku ipú ajɛ kú Usaananím, ga Adaminákēbu, ga Ujɔ́mīna jāā ga Ulákúm gaá ŋmɛ́yí Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo cɛ̄ nēé lɛ ubatísim yá ɔ̄, é géē nyā ɔ́ tá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ ŋ́, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí ɛ̄cī nēé géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ukóhati ɔ́mɛnɛ ā, Usíyɛ̄lu ma ayí ɛpa: Umíka mɛ́mla Íssīya.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa aá lé ŋ́. Aá yúufi Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
idu_Latn: Lɛ íkōtō ofɛpa ce igwó flá tū ígwu kú ukɔ́tin aflɛ́yí ā. A klla í flá íkōtō ofɛpa ce igwó tū ɛgɔ́ kú ígwu ɔ́mpa kú ukɔ́tin ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le jōōnjīlɛ mla ígwu kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ lɛ olɛlā kú nū má, ó géē má ɔ̄ tá nyɔ̄ icííci nɛɛ? Óndú ā kóō bī olɔhi le cíla awɔ ulé, ohígbū ɔdā nāa yá gā um ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Amásīya gaá ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, ó le aígabɔ̄ kú ádā nū ɛpa, nēe je ádā nū Ujówāsi, ŋmó ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujeremíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ tīile lɛ ācɛ alɛwa, amáŋ, íla kú aólíla ā gē ŋmó uwā á.

eng_Latn: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
idu_Latn: A má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ācɛ aéwɔhá bá ī ka kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō fu Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda á. Amáŋ ó tá aípɔ́ɔma ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é gē leyīgwō uwá bónū, klla í je uwá kéē wɛ ewo dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
idu_Latn: N géē da aá, Ó géē wā í lɛ aólufa ā kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin ā ú lɛ ācɛ ɔhá. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō ŋmɔ́wɛ nū.

eng_Latn: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
idu_Latn: Aá mā ō ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí áncā. Aá kóō cɛ̄ ka ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, Ébrahām je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ́ɔ má ŋmá ɛcɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nōó le ā, ācɛ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔwɔicō, o ŋmá lɛ olɛhɔ̄ ā nēé pó ā, olɛhɔ̄ ā kē wā ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ nēe pɛ́ kwu ā géē bá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɛfu ɔ́ɔmā klla í wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē lɛ ajɛ nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ébrahām kahíníī, Awɔ ā, a géē le okónu nɛ̄ n ce mɛ́mla uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayááyí kú uwɔ nēe géē wā ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā tū.

eng_Latn: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ Ujaasáníya, nɛ̄ ádā nū wɛ Ujeremíya, nɛ̄ ádáádā nū kē wɛ Uhábasínīya ā kpó mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ayí nū, klla mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔ́ma kú Urécābu ā hīgwú á.

eng_Latn: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ a kē wɛ ā, a wɛ Ɛláyíja nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ń wɛ Ɛláyíja nóó. A wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ehéee.

eng_Latn: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umɛlkísɛ̄dɛki lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā. Ébrahām nōo wɛ ádā nɛ̄hi nōo lóofu nɛ̄hi, nááná ā, lɛ ɔdā nōó bī ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kɔ̄ ɛga igwó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛga éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ú kpó lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka úklɔ́ nyā nɛ̄ aá yá ā, í yá ɛgbá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ofōōfú uwā ŋ́, ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ gē bá ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá.

eng_Latn: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aólɛla kú Udanīyɛlu le má ka ɔ́ɔ gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
idu_Latn: N le nyɛ́, ń klla wɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kōō ī lɛ ɛlá wu um ŋ́, náaná ń leyī gwō íne kú uwɔ ā bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
idu_Latn: Agidigbé kú úbɔ́ ɛhilī yɛ gicō akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. É bī ugóolu le ɛga ō kpó ikpó ce yá tū ɔ̄ dúú. Ó lɛ ɛga o kpó abɔ̄ ce dúú. Ó klla lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú ágábá yá kwu abɔ̄ kú nū ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
idu_Latn: Ó ī jɛ́lā lɛ aógbɛhá nɛ̄hi. Ogbonɛnɛ kú nū í gē mɛ ŋ́. Ó géē lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla í lɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gaá lā ɔpɛ kú Userédi.

eng_Latn: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
idu_Latn: Ó gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá klla ī nya ɔ̄cɛ tá. Ó ī yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ klla ī yá ɔdā ōhídáagó ipú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō Anú ā, nya Udánīyɛlu tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ágábá á.

eng_Latn: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ayínɛ́ ā mīyɛ alɔ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī wā ɛgiyí nū, bī ɛdɔ ɔ̄kā nyā wā í le jé ɔ̄ má. É da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Da alɔ, íne kú alɔ jɛɛga lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō tá ɔnyā nū ū.

eng_Latn: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ kóō yá ɔdā nōo í lɔhi lɛ ɔ́mpā nū mɛ́mla o yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
idu_Latn: Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ igbɔhá le gla Ujɔ́dan, le tá ɛga nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni tɛtɛ ge yá ācɛ ubatísim ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú ɛtá nyā ā nuunu bū ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā abɔ̄fú púúúlú gaá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ ŋmá obugā ā gé lɛ Udéfīdi. Amáŋ Udéfīdi í gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya klá ajɛ kóō kwú pīya ɛya nōó gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Átasásɛsi ā, Ɛ́sra gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn mla ígwu kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla aúlífāyi, mɛ́mla ācogwíijē mɛ́mla ācogbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ oyúklɔ́ ɔhá kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ kú ā lɛ ācɛ kú Umídīyan ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū jīla anú ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ le ɔbɔ́lā lɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipú ɔnɔ bá ī dɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā o yá ɔma ā, Amáŋ alɔ í ma ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ipú ŋ́. Alɔ ī bī oyálé dúúmā gé lɛ ācɛ ɛcɛ ŋ́ māaa, alɔ í kē ma ācɛ dúúmā kéē mīyɛ ɛcɛ tābɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
idu_Latn: Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu nēé le yá aójibó kú aɔ́wɔ kú uwā á. Úklɔ́ kú abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu nēé wɛ á.

eng_Latn: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe jīla bá gē cokē ā le ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, é kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ yɔ̄ gē tɛgíkwū.

eng_Latn: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó le yá ká alɔ lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je ɛhi lɛ alɔ alahá lɛ ā má. Alɔ gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka alɔ jé cāā ka alɔ géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a má ɔ́ɔmā āa? A klla géē má ucē ɛbí obɔ̄bí nōo fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā yúklɔ́ kú ɔdɔ ō ma ɛga alɛwa. Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá aɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla Ujerúsālɛm tá ā ma ɔdɔ kú āyā nēe gboce ɔlɛ́ Ɛlíyāssibu ā.

eng_Latn: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
idu_Latn: O gwó ɔwɛ ce abɔ̄ éyi eko kú ɛpɔ̄ ō ka í lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
idu_Latn: Le da uwá ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yēeyī ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ka nɛ̄ n pó ā nɛ̄ n géē yá aá á.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá ā. Aá géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um oŋmá lɛ ō mabɔ̄ ajɛ tá cíí, nɛ̄ aá í gáā hɛ́hɔ̄ anú ŋ́, iháyí ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔtā mla ɔyī kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔtā mla ɔyī kpó á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
idu_Latn: A tɛtɛ lā ipú Éden, ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. A klla ī lɛ ɛdɔ ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá dóódu wu iyē. Aɛ́cɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá ɔ́ɔmā wɛ aɔ́dīfa mɛ́mla aɔ́tángbédē nēé hī ka, Utɔ́pās, Ubɛrili, Ukanélīyan,Ujáspa, Usáfaya, ɔká mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́tangbédē ɔhá dóódu ā. A klla lɛ aɔ́dīfa kú ugóolu . É yá ɔdā dóódu nēe bá nyā gā uwɔ, ɛ̄cī nēé yá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta háyi ɛcɛ pī okómpīinu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyíkpó ɔhá ā nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā jé ā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔnyā nōo ī gbɔ̄ɔwɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Upíta bī wā inu á.

eng_Latn: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ tíne ō kɛpɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú, Ɔwɔicō lɔfú dɔɔ̄kā úlúúlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā cīla glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: N da aá kpɔ́ ka, ó tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ inyankwūlūmī kóō bū ɔ̄gīinyilá fíyɛ́ olagbénú kóō je pīya ɔ̄cɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ōgbɔtū nɛɛ, gē bī ɛbɔ́ wā ipú odo, amáŋ, ɛlā kú ɛcá mɛ́mla ɛlā ō ka nyáŋká gē bī íwɔ́tū wā.

eng_Latn: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ klla gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ aéwo ā bá ī yá uwɔ ɛbɛ́ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē kpó uwēyi tū uwɔ ɛyí gɛ ŋ́. Ajɛ í kē gáā yá ká ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū kéē je kpó yíífi igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, Ulában cāŋjɛ, le ayí nū nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayááyí nū kwú bɔ́tū anɔ́ɔ ó le ŋ́ŋmóō tú uwā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
idu_Latn: É klla tá kahíníī, É géē bī uwɔ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dúú kóō híīī yá uwɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ nɛ̄ a kōō le ikpó gbo ɛcɔ̄, í fu ikpó ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubatisséba le tá ɛgiyí Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, gaá le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ kwɛyí Adónīja á. Ɔcɛ́ cāŋjɛ gaá jīla ɛ́nɛ́ nú ɔwɛ, tūkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá má cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔdōcīce bī gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nú á, anɔ́ɔ ó má cíce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le tá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá yɔ̄ ā? Ábna gā ɛgiyí uwɔ, a kē mā ɔ̄ tá le yɛ áncā?.

eng_Latn: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ jééyī nwune lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ lɛ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nāa lɛ ɔtūnɔ̄bí lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú ayí kú Íssmɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nē é ma uwá lɛ ā á: Unɛ́báyɔ̄tu, Ukɛ́da, Adbíil, Umíbsam.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ í gē je īkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin ō gwā lɔhi cúkpɔ́ɔ́ yíífi ŋ́, nɛ̄ ikoko ɔ́ɔmā nēé gē je ɔ́ yá ejé ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ń gáā je odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um yíífi ŋmáajɛ ŋ́ lɛ á. Amáŋ n géē nya ācɛ nēe gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā tá.

eng_Latn: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipū ā ī ka ā yɔ̄ á. É lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi eko dóódu, é klla ī lɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
idu_Latn: Ó le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú nū ā, wúla tāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī ca áklɔ̄kpɛ nēé cē ce ipú ɛhɔ̄ tāajɛ ā. Ó lɛ ɛ̄cī kú usábāti, mɛ́mla ucɛ otīihɔ kú nū ipú Ujerúsalɛm ā bī wā oŋmɛ́ɛyí ipú ícɔ́nū nɛ̄hi kú nū. Ipú ícɔ̄nū kú nū ā, ó kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ le bɛ̄cɛ abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ ŋmá Upɛ́nīyɛlɛ̄ ā, ó yɔ̄ ī túkeŋgé ohígbū ɔ́kwu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
idu_Latn: É le kwāajɛ bá ī gbēyī kéē le um ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aágábá gē kwāajɛ gbēyī ɛbɛ́ kéē ŋmó, je ɛbɛ́ nū fā lé ā.

eng_Latn: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
idu_Latn: Ujáhāsi, Ukedemɔ́ti, Umɛ́fāati.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Eko nāa géē kwu nyɔ̄ inu eyīpú gaá tayínū ā wɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugébríyɛlu wā gaá háyi pī um, anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ n má gwōnū klá ajɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ɔyí kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɛyí kú ɛbɛ nyā jé. Ɛbɛ nyā yɛ lɛyíkwu eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā í mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ōhī le ɛga má kéē má ācɛ Ujíyu ímálānyī ā, le ɛlā tū ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.
idu_Latn: O ŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Usɔ́lu le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó kɔ̄ ígwu ɛtá, ofúlɔ̄cī ā é le pɛ́ ga ádɛ́fú kú aólɛlā kú uwá gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ācɛ Ámɔn. Gbɔbū kú ɛnɔ kóō wɛ̄ɛyí ā, é lɛ ācɛ Ámɔn kpó ŋmó, lɛ uwá pahīla, nɛ̄ iwili kú ācɛ Ámɔn nēe hile ā í gbo ɛpa nēé gē bá tɔ̄ɔ̄há glá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā yɔ̄ gē kwinya ga amu ga anū.

eng_Latn: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
idu_Latn: A ce um ɛgbá nɛ̄hi, a lɛ ojīlīma ɛgiyí um nɛ̄hi, n klla yíhɔtū uwɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo kwɛyí uwɔ, ká n̄ le fūla oyēeyī kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nōó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, aá lɔfú yá uwá lé glá ŋ́. Á jé ní, aá géē yɔ̄ ī bɛ́yíkwu Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyí ádā uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ŋ́. Ó kē wɛ ɔyínɛ́ abɔ́yī uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū tóohi kahíníī, A má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ yɔ̄ ī jīla tū uwɔ lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nāa ī dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkayi pi Ɛ́sta ahɔ̄ lɛ ā, Ɛ́sta lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́, eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aígabɔ̄ ā í jé ɛga nɛ̄ n nyɔ̄ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í yá ā ŋ́. N kōō ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ɔ́mpa um ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Kwu ācogwɛ́ɛya oo, kwu aótrɛ̄yí oo, aígabɔ̄ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā nōo lɔfú yúklɔ́ ā glá ā, ń ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, é gē jé íne kú Umósīsi tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu ŋmá íkííkée, e kē ī bī ɛlā kú nū le tɔ́ɔna ipú igelī dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le Urebéka hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, A dɔɔ̄kā ō nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ āa? Ó cɛ̄ kahíníī, Īī, n géē nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
idu_Latn: Ubérīya ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá ā: Uhɛ́ba mɛ́mla Umálkīyɛlu nōo wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́sāyit ā.

eng_Latn: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, cīce ipú obū cíí. É klla gáā hi uwɔ ka ɔcányā kú aéwɔhá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔwɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nwūla lɛ alɔ ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī, ŋmá lɛ ō le ukɔ́tim ā híla lɛ alɔ, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ oŋmá lɛ ɔkpíyē kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
idu_Latn: É le aíkpɛ́cí gwó lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kwu ɛyí ɛfu dóódu. É klla le ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra kpó ma kwu ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Usɔ́lu í ka ɔdā dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó gbɛlá ka Odée ɔ́ɔ le yá ɔ̄, nɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ má, ɔdɔɔmā yá nɔ́ɔ wā í lé ɔdōlé ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujáfɛ̄ti wɛ, Ugóma, Umágɔ̄gu, Umádāyi, Ujafán, Utúbalu, Uméssɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Utírasi. Uwá wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ nēe lé iyē kwu uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
idu_Latn: Ebilíi tóohi da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ujóbu gē le ojīlīmā ce uwɔ áncā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, ālɔ̄ yíihɔtū tū iyī alɔ, ohígbū ka ihɔtū wɛ ɔdā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄, Ɔwɔicō ma ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa nū á, ó kē jé Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nōo yá Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomora mɛ́mla aígelī nēe bá kwu uwā ajaajɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ n je uwá kpó yíífi ā, anú gáā yá Ubábīlɔn á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā lā Ubábīlɔn ɔhá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le da ācɛ kú Usídɔn ka ɔtūnɛ̄hɛ́ kú uwā ā mɛ ɛɛ́. É klla bá ī yá ācɛ ɔlɛ uwɔ ŋmó. Ɔ́dāŋ ka uwá le kwu ga Usáyiprɔs nááná, uwá í gáā lā ɛbɔ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē géē lɔfú cēyītīkwú kéē pɛ́kwu í tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, amáŋ Óndú ā géē cē ufi tū uwā iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē yá ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū nū he ɔ́ ā itala, ó klla gē pi ācɛ nōó mīyɛ ka ayí ɔlɛ́ nū ā ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
idu_Latn: Olagbénú ā dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ádā um, Ébrahām, n yɔ̄ ipú ɛ́kɛma nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ amānyā ā! Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ményinyi um cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā da Ulásārɔ̄si kóō lɛ ɔyíkabɔ̄ kú nū wu ipú éŋkpɔ̄ wā í le tū um ɔkɔ kóō lɛ um ígblɛ́nyī bɔ́.

eng_Latn: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī unwalu mɛ́mla ɔtōplicō ká aá kpó ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū kóō gē lɛ ɛlā wu aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ɔtū nwula nwula yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu odúúdú ācoyímabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācojēeyī kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ó le ɔ̄na nōó nā ā kpó ka lɛ uwá. Amáŋ odóódu kú uwā í ka ɛyí ɔ̄na ā lɛ ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī má abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um, amáŋ, ń má ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo í tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē gbō um ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī lɛ ɛlá wu um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ ā kéē lɛ iyī uwā tīihɔ, ohígbū ka óócí, é géē lɛ ɛbɛ́ nēé í lé. Ohígbū kēé le ikwū je klá Óndú ā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ ɔ́ɔ géē je ɛbɛ́ lɛ aá lé ā? Aá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ aá Íjīpiti fíyɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je ɛbɛ́ lɛ uwá nēé géē lé.

eng_Latn: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
idu_Latn: kócōō, ɔkpani, alɔ wā gaá lá ɔdōlé aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, je aɔ́cɛ́ kpó fíyákátā wāajɛ ā, é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú nōo yá wāajɛ klá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usálumɔn kwɛ́mm ā.

eng_Latn: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nēe gē kwú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ iyē ojigógó ā bá abɔ́ɔ á. Ádā kú aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā tɛtɛ jé ka aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ce aá ɛgbá.

eng_Latn: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá mbaa í tū um eyīnyinyi ohígbū ka é húmáyī bá pi um ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, é kē lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé ī lé gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
idu_Latn: É bá gē ka lɛ iyī uwā ka, ɔ́ɔ ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka aá í lɛ igbo dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔkpaŋ́gelī le ŋmó ōhī, é géē kpó ācɛ ɔhá aálagbá ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Aílɔ́wá ā kē géē leyīkwu Ujerúsālɛm jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko kú uwā mɛ.

eng_Latn: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá kōō móowe ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yá ā, ákú aá le lɔhi ɛɛ́. Aá híī yúufi ācɛ nēe gē yá aá ōwē ā ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɛla wu ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Iyɔ̄bū odúúdú ojīla abɔ́ɔ ā, Udéfīdi cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Óndú ā, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ, Ujékɔ̄pu ā, alɔ géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra awɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ oŋmɛ́yí kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ɔyí kú ɔlɛ́ Ujése gbā á.

eng_Latn: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
idu_Latn: É klla le Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, éyi kú aóhile kú aágwu nēé hī ka Uréfēyím nōo lā Ásitārɔtu mɛ́mla Ɛ́dirēyi yálé.

eng_Latn: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla áklō kú nū mafú lɛ uwá. Ayíkpó ā gwéeyē eko nɛ̄ uwá lɛ Óndú ā má ā.

eng_Latn: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóyākim gekwú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɛhóyākin lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya gwutá anɔ́ɔ ó kwú eyī í pīya tá ɔdɔ kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ɛcɛ á, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa: Uhɛ́lɛsi, ŋmá Upelóna kú Ɛ́frem ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu nyā á.

eng_Latn: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.
idu_Latn: ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū gāá pi Ɛ́sta ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Ā gbɛlá ka abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, abɔ̄ í gáā kwu uwɔ glá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Abɔ̄ géē kwu uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu ɔhá ā dúú.

eng_Latn: O LORD, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē ka ā, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ inya kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí olɛlā kú uwā ā?.

eng_Latn: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Udíbɔn gēe tū icō ɛfu nyɔ̄ í je ikwū ipú inu ɛcí kú uwá a. Ācɛ kú Umówābu ba ī tū ɛgíkwū klá alácɛ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Inébo, mla Umédēba; é lɛ ɛyí kú uwá mla ɔnwū agba kú uwá plá ipú ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla kɛlā lɛ uwá gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ācɛ o gbɛ́há ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ipú uwā piyóó. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anúɔ je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē jɛ́lā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔyínɛ́ um, Ísɔ. N gē yúúfi koó yɔ̄ ī wā gaá kpɔ́fú kwu alɔ kóō kpó odúúdú alɔ yíífi, kwu aɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí dúú.

eng_Latn: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́yī, aá le hɔ́ɔgba kú ɛfú yɛ Ubábīlɔn jīla tá biílí. Aá tá odúúdú aɔ́yī kú aá klá Ubábīlɔn, ohígbū ka éwo ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔbíipú bī lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔdōcābɔ̄ ā gā ɛcɛ. Ódūdū gbɔɔ́ ō gicō ŋmá ipú igelī ā bɛ̄ɛka ojuja ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ubɛ́njamīn ā pīyeyī má igbīhi, le kpó hídáagó bá í má ódūdū ā, ɔlɛ́ uwā yɔ̄ ī yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔna tá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄, nōo kē wɛ ɔtū kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi kú igelī kú uwá, kéē wā í le jīla tɔ̄há amānyā.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujɛhósāfati yá, ŋmá ohútu kú eko nɛ̄ ó wá í ce ɔcɛ́ ā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú nū ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú Ujéhu, ɔyí kú Uhánām nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ífi gā, nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le pahīla ā, ó ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ɔ́ɔ géē tū uwā bá klla í kpó uwā nyi ajɛ kú Umémfisi. Ó ka agbénú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mla ɛga nɛ̄ inu kú ūwā tɛtɛ kwu ā, ácí ɔ́ɔ géē je mu tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
idu_Latn: nōo gwō kahíníī, Alɔ géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā kóō kwú pīya ákú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kɛlā hī iyē kú ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáal ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anú ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n lɛ nōo lɛ ɛlá wu olɔhi kú aá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka Óndú ā kóō yá kú aá yíhɔtū tá ɔ́mpa aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nwuné nwuné cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ihɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ yá tá aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ɛbɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gēe je pīya ɔla; Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ kú Israɛl a gēe je pía ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá, nōo gēe je ɔdā dóódu kpó yi ŋmá ajɛ ɛ̄cī ékpónú, kwu ácí kwu ujē a.

eng_Latn: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā Ujówābu yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú tú Urábba, igelī nɛ̄hi nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ámɔn ā gɔbū kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nāa yɛ mla íjééyī, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā háyi ɔwɛ kú uwɔ glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kōō yɔ̄ ī kwinya, á gáā lɛ ikpó gbo ɛcɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he must needs go through Samaria.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó géē yɛ bū Usamérīya piíí.

eng_Latn: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da aá eko ɔ́ɔmā ka aá cāŋjɛ kú aá gbo īyāwu kú aá, ká aá le bēhé ísu kú Ánɔn ā. Ka anúɔ kwú Usíhɔ́n, ɔ̄cɛ Ámɔ̄ri, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ú kpó tū aá abɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ka aá kóō kpɛ́fú tū ɔɔ̄ ka aá mīyɛ ajɛ ā ákú aá.

eng_Latn: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔhá a í jé uwɔ ŋ́ mā, a klla kwinya nyɔ̄ ī gbajā tá ācɛ kú Asírīya. A wɛ akwuna kú uwá, uwá gwutá mla uwɔ nááná o kē jɛ̄ uwɔ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē je ajɛ kú Ukénan gā uwɔ, kóō wɛ ukpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā úgwū kú ayááyí uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē yɔ̄ ī jikwū ipú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin. Ɔdā nyā géē yá pií, ohígbū ka n géē wā gaá yá aá italā.

eng_Latn: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Adin wɛ, úlā ce ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, nɛ̄ aá kwúcē wā ɛgíyi um ŋ́ mā? Aá lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū aɛ́cí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ká aá ká, bá ī gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā. Anɔ́ɔ aá tá ō kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú ádā aá ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, je kpó gā um á.

eng_Latn: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
idu_Latn: Ɛfu ɛpa nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā, bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan, nēe lā ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā. É bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, klá ligbó ŋmá aɔ́cí nēé hī ka óoku kú Umɔ́re nōo kwu Ugílgal ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
idu_Latn: É lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēe gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō í ka uwá gwó mla iyī nū ohígbū keé le ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ka ā yá gaajɛ. Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú ɔkpá kú íne ā tū ojigógó ŋ́ mā ŋmɛ́pɔbí.

eng_Latn: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Atárɔ̄tu, Udíbɔn, Ujása, Unimára, Uhɛ́sbɔn, Ɛlíyāle, Usébam, Unɛ́bo, mɛ́mla Ubéyɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē mīyɛ ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ ō lé, klla í bī ɔfú ɔ́ɔmā piyóó.

eng_Latn: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ŋmá Upɛ́sīya, Ulídīya, Ulíbīya, wɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ dúú. É kpó ɔkplɛ́fú mla ɔdā okwɛyí kú ɛfú kú uwā, pla ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Uwá ā wɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ gā uwɔ lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā le Ujísɔ̄si bī tá nyɔ̄. Ó bī ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú nū gɛɛcɛ ga ɛga nēé hī ka Ɛga kú Ákōklɔ̄ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
idu_Latn: Ń kllɔcɛ́ kú íjééyī jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
idu_Latn: Á tɛtɛ húmáyī jé ŋ́ ka ŋmífī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicó yá ɔlɛɛcɛ tū ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And his daughter in law, Phinehas' wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed; for her pains came upon her.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ɔyí kú Ɛ́lāyi, ɔnyā kú Ufínīhasi ā yīipú eko ɔ́ɔmā. Eko nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō ma ɔyí ā má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā le pó ka, ɛɛ́ mīyɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, ka ádā ɔbá nū mɛ́mla ɔbá nū, ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ gekwú ā, ɔma ekpūkpūlū le ɔ́ kwú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyí ma á.

eng_Latn: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām le ɔcí nēé hī ka Utamaríski ā tū Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ā, anɔ́ɔ ó Le ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō piyóó ā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
idu_Latn: Aádáádā uwā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá ā, ācɛ éwɔhá dúúmā í kē yá nɛ̄ uwá gē cīgbīhi kwu Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ayí kú Ugɛ́ssɔm ā wɛ Ussébūwelu.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
idu_Latn: Aá híī bī ɛlā kú ɔyínɛ́ aá tɔ̄ɔ̄tū ŋ́. Amáŋ lɛ ɔdā dúú nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá ā kagwó mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ íne bīya ohígbū nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si ā, é kahíníī, Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim tū alɔ ɛhɔ̄ ká alɔ da uwɔ ɔka ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó ka a gē wā á nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka alɔ leyītáajɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ŋ́ ŋmá eko nōo yɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ ka abālɔbányā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?
idu_Latn: Umíka tá uwā ohi da uwa ka ɔdí nēe gbɛlá ā, ɔdí wɛ unwalu kú uwā ā? Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú anúɔ mɛ́mla ojibó nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ā ú kpó, klla nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Ó ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ hile ɛ́ɛ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dā nēe yá nyā, alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le okónu ce klla le ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpá klla le abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ícɛ nyā, anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ, ācɛ Ulífāyi kú alɔ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú alɔ le ɔja kú uwā ja klá ɔkpá ā á.

eng_Latn: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Awɔ ī je ɔfú lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ yá aólɛlā kú alɔ lé á. Ipú ihɔtū kú uwɔ nāa ī cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yálé á.

eng_Latn: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. N hī Óndú ā igwú kóō tá um abɔ̄. Ó kē lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
idu_Latn: Ipú íwɔ́tū ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā kē í nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya klla í kpó anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kwú.

eng_Latn: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
idu_Latn: É gáā je um wu ipú ōwē nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ wu éŋkpɔ̄ kú ubatísim ā. Ó wɛ iyó o gbɛnú nɛ̄hi gā um jāā gbéeko nōó le yá ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
idu_Latn: yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. É kē he odúúdú ācɛ ɔtū. Óndú ā kē ī ka ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ ī hɛ́tá ā tū ipú ɔ́wá kú uwā ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē nwūla abɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ gē lɛ odée kplá uwá, nɛ̄ ó ī yúklɔ́ ije kú nū ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā, ákú nū kwú lɔhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi odúúdú ācɛ kú Usáyɔn! Aá dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm, aá, nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā! Má ɔ̄, ɔcɛ́ kú aá gē wā ɛgiyí aá ɛɛ́. O le yálé klla yɔ̄ ī gbogwú wā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ó lɛ iyīnū tú wāajɛ klla gbonɛnɛ, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ce ijakī wā a. Ó ce ɔyí ijakī.

eng_Latn: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ ohīlaŋdɔ́ nōo gē yā klá ɛyí ɛfu ā gē jɛ̄ uwā. É gē kwu gaá lɛ iyē bá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú iyē kóō kwɔ́lá lɛ uwá ohígbū ka uwá í lɛ ɔlɛ́ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā, aá géē kpó ɔdōnīgbō dóódu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ā lé, é gáā je ɔ́ koó wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ í kwú ohígbū kéē ŋmá iyē Ádām ā. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, é í héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ohígbū ɛma kú uwā mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n má ká um gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́kwú ā, n lɛ blakwu uwɔ, le ɔkɔ gbā gā uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ a le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā gā uwɔ ā pó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ōhī klla kwúcē wā gaá bá ī kpɛ́fú tá uwā ɔpɛ́ abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó klla má igbogbo nēé lɛ gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí ā. Ó bá pī īlī ahilíki nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ŋ́, Amáŋ ó le hā bá ajɛ ɛgɔhá kú nū céé.

eng_Latn: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛhi ā bī gé lɛ Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, nōo jɔ̄kwū nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ugɛdalíya da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka lɛyíkwu Íssmɛ̄lu nyā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yí ŋ́.
