idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ɔ́ɔ le yá, ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā kú ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kéē kwú īlī nɛ̄ oyī hɛ́ kwú ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔyí uwā gwutá mla ɔbá nū ā ú, mafú ɔgbɔ́ kú ɛpɔ̄ lɛ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā ɔ́ɔ jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ga ɔlɛ́ ɔbá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu lɛ ɔtū kú ācɛnyā aílɔ́wá mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā wu klíicō. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō bɛ́yíkwu Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi, é klla lɛ uwá nū ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
idu_Latn: É géē pɛ́ kwu ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ. Aá le jé kpɔ́cíí ka aá gáā má um gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá géē ka kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo Ɔwɔicō tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē yá eko nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā, wɛ ka oyá ká ācɛ kéē jé ka é kwú odée kú uwā ú lá, amáŋ ka ofūlabɔ̄ kú agbénú kú uwā ā, yɔ̄ á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je odée kú nū lá ā, géē je ikpó áblákpá kú nū éyi plá ŋmá ikpó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē lá odée ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā. Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē mafú ka aá kwú odée kú aá ú lá, amáŋ o kwú ɔ̄ ú fūlabɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Uhosíya kóō kwú iyē ú lɛ ɔyí ā ka Ujésiríilu. Ɔwɔicō ka iye ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ohígbū ka, eko kpií anúɔ géē yá ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu italā ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā Ujéhu kpó ŋmó ajɛ kú Ujésri ā Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔcɛ́ ō lé ŋmá ɔgba ɔcɛ́ kú nū gwū.

eng_Latn: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ únóji bu tá lɛ Umówābu, ohígbū ka é géē je ɔ́ yíífi ānāānā. Aígelī kú nū ā géē je pīya alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā kú nū í yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá cɛ̄ ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anú ā abɔ̄yī nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ iyē kwu okwū kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ géē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe bī uwá wā í klá ajɛ wuu bɛ̄ɛka abɔ̄ ɔcí nɛ o fā ŋmá icō wā ajɛ a. Ɔcɛ nōo gē yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ kú uwá fíyɛ́ dúu a, Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, gēe gɔ̄, klá ajɛ ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gā ajɛ ipú ojuja, anɔ́ɔ ó gáā háyi pī Umósīsi abɔ́ɔ ɛyí ɛfu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le iyē otīihɔ kú nū ā hī ka Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ā klla le jɛ̄ nwuné fíyɛ́, klla kwú lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Īkpɛ̄yí kú ɔcí ā gaá kwu ɔkpáncō, ācɛ lɔfú má ɔcí ā ŋmá ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nāa tīipú mla uwá ā, le uwɔ plla ɛɛ́. É kē lɛ uwɔ nū ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ bá ɛbɔ́ mla uwɔ ā le ɔfú kpó kwu uwɔ ɛɛ́, aóklóbīya uwɔ nāa lɔtūce ā lɛ ukpa kpla tá ajɛ gā uwɔ, é gē ka, Ini nɛ̄ odúúdú íjééyī kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ gɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú ohɛ́ɛpa kú oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā ú pīya tū aócíbú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú áyā ɔhá ā í cē klá ede ā.

eng_Latn: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɛdɔ ede ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā gwó Ujerúsālɛm, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Áhāsi pīyɛyí ŋmá Udamáskɔsi á.

eng_Latn: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
idu_Latn: Óŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú nū, ó yá ká owu kóō tá ŋmá ɛháajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aígbáanɔ nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛwá ā, kpó gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē kwú lé á.

eng_Latn: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ágábáidu gwutá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā, a nɔ̄ɔna kú ɔdā nōo géē yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē ma ɔdōtayínū fú ā, le ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā mafú gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ opo tá ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Usáyɔn, aá lɛ agidigbé gwō ɛyí ɛfu otīīhɔ kú Óndú ā. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā kéē fīyégbúlú! Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī wā, ó kē má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɛgowíikpɔ̄dā kú uwɔ ú lá ga um, ká n̄ lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ōcē obɔ̄bí nyá ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ alɔ. N géē cílá ulé kú nū gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ Assarɛ́la.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si ka, Īī, ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ó tá awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ɔtɛ́! Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu gē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtōōce ā.

eng_Latn: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ajɛ, aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā.

eng_Latn: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka íne kú Óndú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gē nwū ā kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ ā. O nā tá ɔwɛ kú nū gē nwū uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē yēeyī lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi, anú klla wɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá kwu eko otɛtɛ ā, klla blakwu iháyí alɛwa nēe le yɛ ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ mla anú ā le ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti éyi má, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ kwú gé lɛ Udéfīdi. É le ɔdōlé kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú ācɛ Ulífāyi nōo lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ Ússi, ɔyí kú Ubáni, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhassábīya, ɔyí kú Umɛtánīya mɛ́mla Umíka. É kē wɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu, ipɔ́ɔma nēe gē gwíijē ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā eko nēe kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ í yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú tá alɛɛcɛ ɔhá ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ gē kpɛ́fú tá aálelékwū obɔ̄bíipú nēe bá ipú ojuja, nēe gē gbāājɛ ā. É lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú kú alelékwū obɔ̄bí nēé gē pā eko kú ajodobū nɛ̄ alɔ bá anú nyā ā.

eng_Latn: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ yɔ̄ á, gbō ɔ̄ otú mla ɛnɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ. A le okónu ce ɛɛ́ ka amānyā nɛ́ɛ géē gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā á, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko dóódu nɛ̄ n kwú eyī ú pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔkɔ gbā gā awɔ, kócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā pó.

eng_Latn: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka ojuja odobū ɔ́ɔ gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ má ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, eko nōó gē yāwu ɛga nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ jīla ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā tū yēŋēē ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ kóō gbō uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwā yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī yá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄ í cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā cīgbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Ujɔtibáta.

eng_Latn: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē jé ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīma kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō lɛ ɛga éyi iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē ga ɔwɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā plla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
idu_Latn: Ébrahām da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōo wɛ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, nōo gē leyīkwu ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ébrahām lɛ ā kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ wu um agada ká ā lɛ ɔkpá gbo gā um.

eng_Latn: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúú le ka ka ami Usára, ɔnyā kú Ébrahām géē ma ɔyí glá, ɔ̄nyɛ í cɛ̄ āa? Nááná, ami kē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ lɛ ɔ́ eko nōo le hīlókplícī yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī gicō gaajɛ ipácí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi le ɔ́ má á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī tíne āa.

eng_Latn: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, ɔcɛ́ í gbiyɔ̄lā glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ odúúdú ɔkpá nē é ī tɔ́kpá kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi ā tū ā kpó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɔ́ɔmā ā, Umósīsi le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄n ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le aúwé wuulu kpó wu uwá iyē, le uwá ɛ́nyɔ́ gbō klla lɛ uwá ɛyí gbo mɛ́mla ɔláwonī, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú je íne lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ gbɛlá ka Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, ɔ́ɔ géē pó ɔkɔ kú anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ nyatá ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe tíne ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kpó ŋmó ŋmá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū āa.

eng_Latn: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Ka Óndú ā ká ɔ̄ɔ pīyeyī má ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō, ɛga otīīhɔ kú nú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anú, Ísrɛ̄lu, kóō klla lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je lɛ aá ā ā dúú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ aádáádā aá ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
idu_Latn: A yá lɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá alɔ italā lɛ ā. A húmáyī í yá mla alɔ kpaakpa, nááná nɛ̄ alɔ gē bīya íne kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
idu_Latn: É ka, ó gáā wɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē cīlɛ̄fú.

eng_Latn: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā géē wɛ āyā kú Ɔwɔicō ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā nēé hɛ́tá lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā nēé géē gwó aɔ́lɛ́ uwá mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kwu á.

eng_Latn: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
idu_Latn: É géē wɛ ācɛ otīīhɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā. É gáā je uwēyī lɛ iyē kú Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū kú é gē je ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄gbā gwɛ́ɛya gā um á. Ó le lɛ ā, é géē tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā n má ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu ā. Ajɛ tá pálúúú ohígbū ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka alɔ kōō í kɛpɔ̄ tū aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā, alɔ cíkā o kɛpɔ̄ tū aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ nyā fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ē ī lɛ óci le pɛ́ ɔwú kú uwɔ ā ŋmá Usídɔn mɛ́mla Aáfādi. Ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ uwɔ piíí ā wɛ ācɛ o jé ō pɛ́ úgbéenyi kú Utáya ā.

eng_Latn: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
idu_Latn: Otú nɛ̄ ajɛ wɛ ō dobū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, nɛ̄ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā á. N yɛ bū ɔwɛ kú ɔpɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ alɔ yɛ ga ɛháajɛ bū obuga kú anyaká klla yɛ ga ɔwɛ kú útrīmū ā. N le igá kú Ujerúsālɛm nēe catāajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdūngwɔ̄wɛ kú nū nɛ̄ ɔlá je yi tāajɛ ā kpó jila.

eng_Latn: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā wɛ ɛbɛ nɛ̄ Obadíya má á. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛyíkwu Ɛ́dɔm ā. Óndú ā le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ipú aéwo ɛɛ́, alɔ kē le olɛɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā pó ɛɛ́. Ó ka, Aá lɛ tútū, ká alɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kóó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō móōwē ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nōó yá ā, ikɔkɔ ō móōwē ohígbū obɔ̄bí nōó yá ā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ká ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē kpó agbénú kú aéwɔhá gé lɛ aá láyíí bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu nōó gē ŋmó ŋ́ mā ā. N klla ī kpó agbénú kú aéwɔhá ā gé lɛ aá cabácabá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpá gē cēenyi klá okónu nū ā. Aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ̄ obene nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū le bī abɔ̄ klla í lɛ aá ce ikpó.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Upéresi, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
idu_Latn: Ujúda ma ayí ɛhɔ̄. Ɔnyā nū Ubátssúwa nōó lɛ ŋmá Ukénan ā, ma ayí ɛtá. Iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Ɛ́ri, Ónan mɛ́mla Ussɛlá. Ɔkplá kú nū, Ɛ́ri ā le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōō wɛ olɛhɔ̄ ka alɔ ā wɛ ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī ka alɛɛcɛ gwó mla iyī nū ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā. Ó kwú íne nēé bīya í yá uwā ɛhi icííci, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ɔtū kú nū á. Ó kē kwú olɛhɔ̄ ā ú lɛ alɔ nēe wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ka alɔ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ɔwɔicō ī dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kagwó mla iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Ujudíya, le hɛ́ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan igbó. Ɛwa kú ācɛ wā í klá anú kpɔ́ɔkpɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó nwū uwā ɛlā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī yá ojigógó ā.

eng_Latn: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā gē yɛ ɔwɛ nōo le pú kɔgɔ́ɔ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ́pɔ̄hi ā gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ōfōōfūnū gē nyɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɔ́mpa á. Ó gē nyɔ̄ igbo éyi ipú iháyí. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō bī oyī nōó géē le gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ínoōbīya kú iyī nū mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā ŋ́, ó gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je aáyā nēe bá nyā yɔlá mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā. Ocu kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé nyā gē he Óndú ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujówābu á. É le aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ōhī kpó ŋmó. Uríya wɛ éyi kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í koō lɔtūce ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū kú ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́. Ó klla í má ɛnyá kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē je uwēyī lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ. Ó klla ī je ɛga nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú lā ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Áa leyī kwɛcɛ, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú plla aá ŋ́. Ācɛ alɛwa géē bī iyē kú um wā, géē yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ami ā wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á! mɛ́mla Eko ā kē gā abālɔbányā ɛɛ́! Aá híīī yɛce uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: A í je ācɛ kú Ulífāyi gā um, Ami wɛ Óndú á, ikɔkɔ ayí aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ákú aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā ā, kwú ācɛ Ulífāyi ú kpó gā um kwɛyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛtá ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ocíbú kú nū ā pīya tū ipú aísu nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pīya oyī á.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, da um kahíníī, Aítekwú alɛwa nɛ̄ a má akwuna ā cīīce ɛyí uwā ā kwɛyí aɛ́wa kú ācɛ aéwo mɛ́mla aúcē ōka alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ojuja ā ma klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gbojī nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, é géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā klla lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ gē leyī gwō uwā bónū í klla je uwá kéē wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́ mā, wɛ ācɛ piíí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu á. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe ka aá wɛ odée ā pīya ācɛ nēé wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ipú ígbíli ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó bī uwá ɛbɔ́ jāā wā ɛga nēé bá ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē je ɔyí nū ce ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ ī gwéeyē ohígbū ɛ́kɛma nɛ̄ alɔ ī má ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ jé ka ɛ́kɛma í yá ká ālɔ̄ le ɔtū lé ā.

eng_Latn: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ okónu ce mla ācɛ ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā Ussɛ́kɛm á. Ó lɛ íne mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nēé géē yɛce ā kpó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a yɔ̄ í tá ɔkpá kú ɛpɔ̄ ka amíyɔ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá nɛ̄hi. Ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ a gē bī le cíla um ulé kú ucē ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ n yá eko ɔyípōklóbīya kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ā pó ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Óndú ā gaá bī aájī kú ɔ́kíkā kú ede ā á.

eng_Latn: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nyá ɔhá nɛ̄ n klla géē ka ā? Eko í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ n géē kɛlā ohígbū Ugídiyɔn, Ubárāki, Usámsin, Ujɛ́futa, Udéfīdi, Usámūwɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpani ā da ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ɔwɛ eyīpɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔgwu ā ká ā lɛ ācɛ kpó pī wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ um kóō le mu.

eng_Latn: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Atálīya le ɛ̄gbā kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ bá gē dɛ̄ ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu fíya gaa Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛwa jīla bá ā.

eng_Latn: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū alɔ dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛga olɔhi je lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú nū lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ohígbū ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā yá nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ agbá abālɔbányā á.

eng_Latn: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
idu_Latn: Ucē okpaakpa ō yá géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī lā oyēeyī olɔhi. Amáŋ ínoōbīya gē bī ikwū gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ í jɛ̄ uwā nɛ̄ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa gē lā tɔ̄há glá gɛ ŋ́ má. Ohígbū ka uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa lɛ agbénú kú ɔdāajɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kwu ɔdā nōó le gbēyī ā ú híla ŋmá eyī, anɔ́ɔ Áhābu lɛ ɔ́ jé ka, ɔ́ɔ wɛ éyi kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā géē tá um, klla leyī gwū um bónū í kwu ā? Eko nyá nēé géē tá kéē kpɔ́tūce um í kwu ā, nááná, nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá aɔ́dā ō hídáagó ipéyī uwā a?.

eng_Latn: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɔdōlé ɔ́nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ lé kwɛyí ā, ó kwú ikókwū kú ejé ā ú, yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ikókwū nyā wɛ okónu ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēé bī ōyī kú um nōo géē cēbónū ohígbū aá.

eng_Latn: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
idu_Latn: É gē yá uce bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé pó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ ɔdā nēé gē yá ā, ī mafu ka é wɛ ɔdā nēé ka ka aá wɛ ā ŋ́. Aá lɛ tú gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛdɔ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ Ébrahām wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū úklɔ́ nōó yá ā nɛɛ, Ébrahām géē yɛ í lɛ ɔdā ō bī lɛ gwō, amáŋ ó lɛ ɔdā ō bī gwō iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu í gáā wā ɛyí kú nū ámāŋ ɔnwū agba, ámāŋ pi ína dóódu tū ɔkpíyē kú nū, kóō mafú koó yēkwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Áhāsi kpó ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ipú iháyí nōo kwúcē hɛ Óndú tá ā, é ka aá ɔ́ɔ kwú uwā ú kpó kwúcē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́. É ka odúúdú uwā ɛ́ɛ bá iyɔ̄bú ede kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Usɔ́lu wɛ, Ujonátan, Íssīfi, mɛ́mla Umálíkīsuwa. Adá kú nū ā lé ka, Umérabu, Ɔyí nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɔ̄nyā ā lé ka, Umíkalu.

eng_Latn: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
idu_Latn: ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, Ujerúsālɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ gē bī aɔ́dā ɛhi gē lɛ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
idu_Latn: Aúpíla kú oje udɔ ɛpa, ogbló ō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgbanjɛ ɛpa o ce ɛyí aúpíla ā.

eng_Latn: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, a híī ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú lɛyíkwu ɛ̄nyā ŋ́. Amáŋ nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kóō lɛ uwɔ jila, cɛ́ɛ́ a nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɛya nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka ā gwó, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē le jé ka a le yá yēŋēē ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ nū nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Aá tá ɛlā kú ebilíi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ká n jé ŋmá abɔ̄ aá á. O ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ kú íne nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ wā ipú oyēeyī kú aá nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ ka aá le Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā pó anɔ́ɔ aá kē mīyɛ ɔ́ cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú italā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá íne kú Umósīsi ā nɛ̄ a yá alɔ á. Ó kōō kwu abālɔbányā nááná, Óndū ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, alɔ í kōō hútū ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ í kē kwúcē ŋmá íne nɛ̄ alɔ gē bīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ yɛce ɔwɛ nōo le kpaakpa ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbā ā nēé bī le gwó odúúdú aínu nēe bá ā mɛ́mla Agbla Ɛgohɛ́pɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla aóhile ā á, o ŋmá ikpíinu jāā gicō kú uwā. É gbā ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é miya uwá lɛ ā, kwu eyīpú kwu eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú nū. É bī usɔ́ɔ le áklō kú ɛcɔ̄ ā kpó yá mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ahínyá nēé gē tá Óndú ā, aá géē yɛce aíne kú nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mīyɛ ɔdā kú ɛya ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwúcē wā í le ɔdā nēé má ā da Ujéhu ā, ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ó ka bū okónu kú Ɛláyíja ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū kahíníī, Aéwō géē je okwū kú Ujɛ́sēbɛlu lé ipú ajɛ kú Ujésiríili ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ ɔjá ā ca iyɔ̄bū ācɛ nēe wā abɔ́ɔ mla um ā.

eng_Latn: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
idu_Latn: Leyīkwu ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā lɔhi, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ oyóbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ abɔ̄ da um ɛyí tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka ń táafú ŋ́, aá le pīyabɔ̄ klla kwú yá bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā, aá gáā ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, ɔ́dáŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɛlā ka gā uwɔ, a géē cɔ̄nū? Amáŋ, ń klá okónu tū ɛlā ā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyā ā í cɛ̄ koó yɛce uwɔ̄ ŋ́, ayíka ɛka kú um géē wú uwɔ tá. Amáŋ, ɔdā dóódu kóō yá ká ā je ɔyí um kwúcē ga abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yúklɔ́ lɛ ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā cíla anú ulé á.

eng_Latn: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā ka ka é wā kú aá kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nááná nɔ́ɔ le aá iyē catāpū ā, anú ɔ́ɔ gáā hɛ́ aá tá á. É ka ɔ́ɔ le aá yá ágbe, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ géē tá aá ágbe ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā gē lá aɔ́nya ŋmá Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Usilísīya. É kē í lá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́lá kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
idu_Latn: klla mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā ōyēeyī nēe bá pi aá ā, kwu aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí, nēe bá pi aá ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɛ́nɛ̄ e bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú úgbéenyi mɛ́mla aá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í gáā mā ācɛ olɔhi tá lɛ ɛmiyɛ ŋmó uwā ŋ́, amáŋ, ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛ ɔdā nēé cɛgbá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka eko ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ le ukɔ́ nōo bá ā tū uwā ka, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ɔ́ɔ kwú ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú lɛ uwá kéē lā anú. Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē lɛ iyɔ́fú kpó lɛ ācɛ o kpɛ́fú kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɔbū kéē lɛ bēhé Ujɔ́dan gbɔbū lɛ aípɔ́ɔma ohile kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē tá uwā abɔ̄ kéē mīyɛ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mɛtá: Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé nwū ɔ̄ ā, gē jɛ̄ gɔbū lɔhi. Ɔtū ī he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ obɔ̄bí ámāŋ olɔhi, alɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, nɛ̄ alɔ gē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū ā. Alɔ í yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le lɔhi lɛ alɔ, abɔ̄ alɔ í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya lɛ uwá má á, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufilístiya ā da uwá kéē má ācɛ ōhī kú Uhíburu ā gbɔɔ́ ō bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nɛ́ɛ húmáyī tayínū ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da Udéfīdi ká ɔ̄ wā kú aá ga ipácí. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa le tá ipácí á.

eng_Latn: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī tú Ujerúsālɛm gwó, ó klla yɔ̄ ī tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá kéē kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n lɛ aólɛlā alɛwa. Aólɛlā alɛwa bɛ́yíkwu um.

eng_Latn: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
idu_Latn: Ó da um kahíníī, N géē je ayí alɛwa gā uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē je pīya aéwo alɛwa. N géē je ajɛ nyā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ kóō wɛ ákú uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
idu_Latn: Ɔkpani um cɛ̄ gā um le ɛka gbo ka n lɛ ɔ́da kú nū tū. Ó ka amíyɔ̄ híī lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɔyí anúɔ ŋmá ipú áncɛ́nyā kú Ukénan, nɛ̄ anúɔ lā ajɛ kú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi ā nēe bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, bá abɔ́ɔ pī Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, dúú. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú háyi ajɛ, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ nēe tá ɔcɛ́ ɔkwu ā, le pɛ́ wā ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
idu_Latn: Aá tíne Óndú ā, eko nɛ̄ aá géē lɔfú má ɔ̄ glá ā. Aá hī ɔ̄ igwú, eko nōó kwu aá ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le aɔ́cí ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ō gwá īkpō nyi tū abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔcí nōo ī je oyēeyī mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ī yá ɔ̄cɛ kóō jé ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí kwu ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
idu_Latn: O fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ede kú oje udɔ nɛ̄ Ubɛsálelu, ɔyí kú Úri, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhɔ́ɔ ma ā yɔ̄ Ugíbēyɔn abɔ́ɔ iyɔ̄bū kú áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe wā mla anú ā le ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro le pó ka ayínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu ɔ́ɔ gā ā, ó le he Uféro mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ācɛ ŋmá Usífu gā ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu, Ugíbēyi, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ tayínū ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhakíla, okónógwu kú ígbíli kú Ujudéya.

eng_Latn: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
idu_Latn: Ulíbīna, Ɛ́ta, Ássan.

eng_Latn: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Uríyawɛ́lu wɛ, Unáhāti, Uséra, Ussámma, mɛ́mla Umísa.

eng_Latn: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé nyɔ̄ gaá je okwū kú nū nyi ā, é má ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka ákōklō ɛyí mɛ́mla ikpokwú kú ikpó mɛ́mla ɔtābɔ̄ kú nū nēé má mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
idu_Latn: Aá jámá ká aá yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há mla ācɛ nēé cɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā í yá glá ŋ́. Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɔdā okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há glá āa? Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɔlá ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla obū lā tɔ̄há glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, akpáabana gbɔɔ́ ō gbo mla ɔwolímanya nɛ̄hi, ojuja nɛ̄hi gaá klá ɛfu ā, é le ɔkɛlā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú opo pó. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi gē fīyégbúlú ɛga nēé bá ā.

eng_Latn: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. N tíne ō lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó nōo Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā gē yɔ̄ piyóó, nōo gē wɛ ɛga ōlɛ ikpó ce kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. N le tútú ká n̄ lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ Óndú ā, nōo gē géē wɛ ɛga o je ojīlīma lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ɔdā nōó tíne ā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē ci ɔ́ anú glá ŋ́. Ɔnyɛ géē lɔtū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a gē yá yɔ̄ ā glá āā?.

eng_Latn: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kā ɛgiyí ipí ā yɔ̄ ɛga nōó yɔ̄ ā kpɔ́ nōó nyīla ga ɛga ɔhá kú ɔkpíyē ā ŋ́, amáŋ nōó le mi bɛ̄ɛka ohígbū ɔlá nōo yi ɔ̄cɛ ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka ká ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē ohígbū ka ofu ipí kú ɔlá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē je ōwē lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ó kwú odúúdú uwá, kwu aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá u kpó yífi, ŋmá icō wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N kē gā ɛɛ́, ó lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka gā um ka ami ɔ́ ka ā nɛ̄ n géē ka ga uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Ami wɛ Uféro á, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti nōo í je abɔ̄ ámāŋ ka ikpó gicō nōó gáā mīyɛ ɛga ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ gbɔbū ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
idu_Latn: Oyá kóō le lɔhi ga um ā, nɛ̄ n je ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā á. Amáŋ ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ a lɛ ga um ā, a cɛ̄ ga um bí ga ɔlékwū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka a klla kwú ɔ́bíipú kú um yá um ɛhi klla kwú mlanyī.

eng_Latn: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
idu_Latn: Ó ka italā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɔ́ɔ wā í da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔdā éékpónú.

eng_Latn: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū ā kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda, aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ami mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú um nyā hɛ́ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
idu_Latn: Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ń yɛce uwɔ abālɔbányā glá ŋ́ mā ā? N géē je oyēeyī kú um táajɛ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē jé ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā gā ɛɛ́, ó kē le ɛyí kú ɔdōjé je lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ā jé. Alɔ kē yɔ̄ ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, mɛ́mla ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā mɛ́mla oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ, aá gwō abɔ̄. Aá gwéeyē kú ā gwíijē tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá Álmon-deblatém ā, é gaá lā ɛyí ɛfu kú Abarím.

eng_Latn: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ Upíta má abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ɔlá ā, ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā leyīkwu ɔ́ eyī kpaakpa anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, A tɛtɛ yɔ̄ mla Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti dúú.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má owu nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī tá kwūūū, ŋmá ɛhícō ā. Ɔwɔ yɔ̄ ī límanya ŋmá ipú ojuja nɛ̄hi éyi. Ɔkpáncō abɔ́ɔ kē yɔ̄ cɛ̄ maámaá. Ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɔ yɔ i límanya ā, n má odée yɔ̄ ī ceyī ŋaáŋaá bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔyí uwɔ ŋ́. Ɔda ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā géē wɛ ɔdūwēyī gā uwɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
idu_Latn: É gɔ̄, yá īkpɛyí olɔfú klla yá aɔ́dā nēe gē wú um ɔtū ā. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwá í yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ jé dúú ā.

eng_Latn: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
idu_Latn: Ó le um bī ga ɛga odobū nɛ̄hi klla cɛ̄ ga um yɛ ɔwɛ nōo dobū nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔlá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lé ɔdōlé gɛ ŋ́ gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ā, Upɔ́lu gā iyɔ̄bū ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aɔ́kpani, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pó nɛɛ, nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ukrɛ́ti ŋ́ nɛɛ, aá géē yɛ í lɛ ámíyā mla ífi nēe bá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Óndú ā, gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ um á. Lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā pó, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ā. Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu ā, a le um hɛ́tá. Abālɔbányā ā, méyīnyinyi kú um ká ā pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ yɔ̄ ī gbā gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu le jɛ̄ gɔbū nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ Udárīyɔsi cɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si, cɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya ā á.

eng_Latn: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
idu_Latn: Ɔdōlé ɔgbɔ ī lɔnyɛ ō lé ŋ, amáŋ ɛga ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kú ipú ayi ugwū ā í lɔnyɛ ŋ́ fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi māháyi lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē klla lɛ ɔkpá ō kwɛ́nyɔ́ kú oje ɔdɔ kwu ɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá, aá yá kéē lɛ ɔ́ jé ipú icɔ́ɔci kú Ulayodísīya dúú. Aá klla yá kú aá lɛ ɔkpá nōo ŋmá Ulayodísīya ā jé dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujɛhósāfati klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ da aá, Ɛláyíja gā gbɔbū ɛɛ́, é kē yá ɔ̄ ōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees , and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu le jé ka āyā éyi ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācɛ Usádusīsi, āyā ɔhá ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācɛ Ufárisīi ā, ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄ nɛ̄hi ɔtāhɛ̄ ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ami abɔ̄yī um wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi, ɔyí nɛ̄ ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ ācɛ Ufárisīi. Ohígbū eyī nɛ̄ n le ce ka ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ā nēé gē kɛpɔ̄ tū um á.

eng_Latn: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mla ɔtā, óbō, ɛ̄wā mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwá wā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ā wɛ, úlā ofu igwáahātá .

eng_Latn: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi nyā kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, nēé ma bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ wā ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ le ɔtū lé, ká abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kóō le lɔfú. Ohígbū kēé géē cíla awɔ ulé kú úklɔ́ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā í cíkā ō lɛ ɛcá dóódu ŋ́, ó í lɛ ɔnyā ékpónú, ayípɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nū cíkā ō wɛ ācɛ o pó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ācɛ í gáā lɛ okónu oyēeyī obɔ̄bí kwu uwá iye ŋ́. É gáā wɛ ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tú ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi ā tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ó lɛ aá bī bī dúú nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Áklɔ̄kpɛ o kpó aúgbɔ́nya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya kú Usólōmɔn abɔ̄yī nū bá ā gē bī aúgbɔ́nya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya úlā igwó . Ó klla lɛ ācɛ o ce ɔnya úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofu igwó, nɛ̄ ó kpó bá ipú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛga o kpó aúgbɔ́ɔya bá kú nū. Ó klla kē kpó ācɛ o ce ɔnya ōhī bá ipú Ujerúsālɛm dúú.

eng_Latn: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
idu_Latn: Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ koó kōō wɛ ka n̄ gekwú mla uwɔ náana, ń gáā híhó ka n jé uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ayíkpó ohile ā ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
idu_Latn: Ó ka abɔ̄ é tá ɛlā kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ é bēhé ga ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayí efūma mɛ́mla aéfūma gē tīkwū klá aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ í kpó ēpū uwā lé dúúdú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē tīkwu klá iyó kú uwā í je uwā kpó wu ā.

eng_Latn: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, kē í má ɛ̄nyā, ufi kē í kwú uwā. É klla í yɛhɛ tū uwɔ í kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ nū Usséma ā ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā dúú, Uróga, Ujɛ́hūba, mɛ́mla Áram.

eng_Latn: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā lɛ ɔdōnīgbō tū igbō kú īkpɔ̄dā dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē bī gé lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́. Aá í gáā lɛ ɔdōnīgbō ámāŋ ka ɛnwú tū ipú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá í je lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe gē jɛ́yí ɔ̄na ā, le okónu hɛ́ tū ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā okónū Aramáyīk, Ágábáidu, ɔwɔ kóō lɛ uwɔ ɛyí tápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄. Lɛ ɔ̄na kú uwɔ ā ka lɛ alɔ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, alɔ í ka ɛyí nū gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ íyɛ́fú dúúmā nēé bī wā gaá le nuunu tá uwɔ nōo géē lɔfú yá uwɔ ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē kpɛlāce uwɔ ā, a géē má ohi nɛ̄ a géē tú uwā. Ɔdā nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ācocɛ̄hɔ kú um ā yɔ abɔ́ɔ á, n kē í cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um klla í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá koó cɛgbá ká n̄ lɛ Epafrodítɔ̄si, ɔyínɛ́ alɔ ɔ̄cɔlóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ́mpā alɔ tɛhɔ̄ fu aá. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yúklɔ́ ohígbū ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā. Ami mɛ́mla anú yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā kóō mɛ ŋ́. Anú ā klla wɛ ɔ̄cotɛhɔ̄ kú aá nōo wā í tá um abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi yɛce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá nyatá ŋmá ōcē abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ oyī kú um nēé pɛ́ bónū ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō géē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi á. Oyī nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le gbɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: A géē bī ugóolu , oje udɔ, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú um géē je yá Óndú ɛhi ā. A géē je kpó nyɔ̄ í bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bī oyī kú nū wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ŋ́ mā ā, aá géē yɛ í kwú ɔ̄ ú lé abɔ́ɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ nōó bɛyíkwu Usólōmɔn ā yɔ̄ á. Usólōmɔn yɔ̄ ī kpó ajɛ tū ipú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujerúsālɛm ā klla yɔ̄ í tū ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú ádā nū, Udéfīdi ā gllayá.

eng_Latn: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, Uhɛsɛkíya gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē nɛ̄hi gáā kwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔdā ocābɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́ ká, ɔ́ɔ géē nyatá ŋmá ipú ōcē ā.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn.

eng_Latn: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛnɛ kú ucɛ ā, aá géē kpó aɛ́drɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna igwó, aómlede ɛpa, aómlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ igwɛ́ɛnɛ gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
idu_Latn: É kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í jé glá ŋ́, anú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, í gáā jɔ́ɔkwu alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé yɔ̄ gē wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ pi uwá ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Aá híīī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá má ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ Ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā géē bá ī cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ piyóó, bá ī gwɛ́ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú, bá ī yi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔlá ga um, klla bá ī gwɛ́ɛya gā um piyóó.

eng_Latn: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔcí nēé hī ka óoku ŋmá Ubássan ā le gbā óci o pɛ́ ɔwú kú uwɔ. Ɔcí nēé hī ka upáyin ŋmá Usáyíprɔsi ā nēé le yá ajɛ kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ī bá ī pɛ́ úgbéenyi á. Anɔ́ɔ é klla le ayīnu adāgbá pla tū ɛyí aɔ́cí ā, kú ō ceyī gllóglló.

eng_Latn: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm gē ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú igbīhi í ce kwu aá, klla kwú ɛlá kú aá ú gwō ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
idu_Latn: A kē lɛ uwá yá kéē le pīya éwo kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ī cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ɛhɔ̄. É kē í cɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
idu_Latn: Aápākssadi wɛ ádā kú Ussɛ́lá á, Ussɛ́la kē ma Éba á.

eng_Latn: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nōo táajɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, le oji hɛ́ Óndú ā ká anúɔ í yá odée lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām da ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ ā ka Usára ɔnyā nū ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ nɔ̄nyā. Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́ra ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū gāa kwú Usára ú wā ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
idu_Latn: O kɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ācɛ ohile ā géē bá okónɔ̄ɔwɛ kú igá kú Ussúru, o kɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ācɛ ɔhá í bá okónɔ̄ɔwɛ igá nōo yɔ̄ igbīhi kú ācogbāājɛ ā É géē bá ī gbō ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔyā ɔ́migwó kú iháyí ɔ́mahāanɛ nɛ̄ Usedekíya cɔcɛ́ ā, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó tɔ̄kwu gaá gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm. É le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā kpó cēce eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī ā. É klla le ɔdɔ ɔhá hɛ́ tū igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā jīlatá biílí.

eng_Latn: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
idu_Latn: Aá géē da uwá kahíníī, Alɔ bá ī ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛ̄cī onyatá nyā o yá kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó le hɛ́gla ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kpó ŋmó, amáŋ ó habɔ̄ alɔ tá. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le okwúukwu kwu ajɛ anɔ́ɔ é le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄nya ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, gaá hī ɔbá uwɔ igwú wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, wā í yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ̄ italā á.

eng_Latn: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kahíníī, Íne nyā wɛ ákú aá.

eng_Latn: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɔdā dóódu lé cabá nááná, ó gáā lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́. Ó géē móōwē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nāa ī yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā italā ā, Óndú, le italā yá ācɛ nēé gē lɛyítáajɛ gā awɔ ŋ́ mā dúú. Ɛbɔ́ kā o yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
idu_Latn: Ahínyá nɛ̄ aá í tá ā kóō wɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gē gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cokónu nū lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ ā gáā fīyɛ̄ um wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu nɛ̄hi, ó klla gáā ce um báajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ nēe lɛ agbénú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ká e híī yá ɔbɔ́cɛ ŋ́, kéē kóō kpɔ́tūce ije kú uwā nōo géē mɛ ānāānā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ da uwá kéē kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ɔdā dóódu lɛ alɔ āa.

eng_Latn: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í gaá lé ŋ́ ōfōōfūnū ā wɛ ɛbɛ́ nēé ŋmó nēé fu oyī kú nū bónū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N lɛ ɛ̄nyā ci ohígbū ka oyī wɛ oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú ā le nyīla kwu ɛga dóódu. Ācɛ nēe kwú ipú ūpū ā fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe kwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā á.

eng_Latn: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhússāyi gā ā, Ábsālɔm le ɛlā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu nwū ā da ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka aá yɛce ɔ́ kɛ̄ɛ? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ ka aá kóō yɛce ɔ́ ŋ́, ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ō ka lɛ aá ā?.

eng_Latn: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujówābu mɛ́mla Abíssāyi gbɔɔ́ ō nū Ábna inya. Ɔ̄nɔɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, é ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Ámmah, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ugíya, ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga ígbíli kú Ugíbeyɔn ā.

eng_Latn: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu da aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ɔ́mpā nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá géē yɛce um, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō kwu ŋmá ipú alɔ nyɔ̄ í pi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú ajɛ kú Ujésiríili ahɔ̄ nóó n.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ uwá ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, le tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá ka lɛ uwá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Itíca, Umósīsi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ gekwú, nōó lɛ ayí dúú bá ɛcɛ ŋ́, ó lɛ ā ayíka ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ géē lɛ ɔnyā nū lɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ ayí ma lɛ ɔyínɛ̄ nū ā.

eng_Latn: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ipú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ alɔ kpó ā, n má īlī kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn, īkpō oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofigwó, mɛ́mla ogbló kú ugóolu nōo gbɛnú bɛ̄ɛka ákú īkpō ugóolu ofɛpa cigwó ā. É le he um eyī fuú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwā ú kpó á. N le uwá kpó nyi ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā tá ɛháajɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
idu_Latn: É gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kwɛyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é miya anú lɛ ā, ipú ɔyā ahātá kú ɔyā kú Ubúlu, ipú iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ Usólómɔ̄n lé ɔcɛ́ ā. Ó je Usólōmɔn iháyí ahāapa ɛ́ɛ́ nōó je inu ā gwó kwɛyí á.

eng_Latn: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gā um gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nēé géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma dóódu ā, é géē je āyā kú ajɛ ā éyi tá ajɛ gā um. Īkpō kú ajɛ kú Óndú ā ɔ́ɔmā kē í wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā, ɔwá kú nū kē í wɛ ukilómīta igwó. Odúúdú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
idu_Latn: Ó gē lé ɔdōlé kú nū ɛyí aɛ́fu ā abɔ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ɔhá ā bá ī hijā abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo nyā aá tá ā. Ó lɔfu lɛ aá tū cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híīī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá o kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ó klla kē lɔfu yá nɛ̄ aá gáā lɛ ɛnyá ŋ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá bī wā ɛgiyí nū nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā. Aá kē gē bá ī gwéeyē nɛ̄hi iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ lé ucɛ kú ɛya o lé tɔ̄há abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ gwéeye iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ kú um nyā wɛ kú um yá kú ācɛ kéē má ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɔdā nōó miya tayínū ā. Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɔdā dóódu ā, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú jé ɔdā nōó le tayínū ŋmá īkííkée nōo yɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī lā ipú ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ipú obū kpúm, é wɛ alagbá nēé le agbá kwu uwá.

eng_Latn: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
idu_Latn: É gáā gwó inū ka ācɛ ɔhá kéē wā ī lā anú ŋ́! É kē gáā nyi ɔcí ufáyin lɛ ācɛ ɔhá kéē wā í lé ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā géē lɛ́ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí gē lɛ́ɛcɛ ā. Ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu ā, ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ aɔ́dā nēé yúklɔ́ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
idu_Latn: Ó mīyɛ um agbénú nɛ̄ n lɛ ā, klla kwú iyē olɔfú kú um nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce um ā ú.

eng_Latn: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
idu_Latn: Étan, Usíma, Ussímēyi.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, n géē tá uwɔ ahínyá ipéeyī aéwo ā. N klla í cɛ̄tra awɔ ipéeyī aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ ɛpa ipú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ofigwó mɛ́mla ācokpɛ́fɔ́nya ofɛtá cigwó mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o bī ɔ́kpa ofigwó tútū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá le tútū ō gbɔɔ́ oje ahāanɛ kú otú mā ga ajɛ kú Usísarīya.

eng_Latn: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
idu_Latn: Ahínyá nɛ̄ aá gē tá ā wɛ ɛya, nōo gē je ojīlīmā ga um ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ gā um ā, n géē nya uwá tá piíí.

eng_Latn: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
idu_Latn: N gē ba uwɔ ká ā mīyɛ ɛlā kú okónu kú um, mɛ́mla ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ipú ɔtū kú um ā. Óndú um, awɔ gē gbō um á, awɔ kē ī nya um tá á.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē mla ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla úmōlō kú aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē pīyeyī kwu aá klla í yá aá italā nōo í lɔfú fíyɛ́ ákú otɛtɛ ā igbahāapa.

eng_Latn: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú uwā wɛ ācɛ nēe ī gbajā mla o cikpɔ́nyā ācɛ ɔhá. Ó ka íwɔ́tū kú ūwā ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfú nēé kpó tū útuló nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ oyá-igbō ā, í wīya ɔ́ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó gáā kpó igbō tū ipú nū.

eng_Latn: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó īlī ekwu wu iyē klla ī bá ī fīyégbúlú ŋmá icō wā ajɛ. É géē Plla ɛyí, uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú uwá.

eng_Latn: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ é lɛ ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā lé kwɛyí ā, ó kwú ikókwū ā ú anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ikókwū nyā wɛ ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, nēé le abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ mla oyī kú um ā. Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ gwá, aá yá lɛ ā ká aá bī le blakwu um.

eng_Latn: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú ā kóō blakwu ínoōbīya kú uwā eko dóódu, ámāŋ kéē kwú uwā abɔ̄yī uwā ú mlanyī dúúdú.

eng_Latn: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka anúɔ í kpó ayááyí uwā pahīla tū ipú aéwɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú pɛ́kwú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda nēé hɛ́ igá tū ɔ̄ ā. Ó le yɛ jāā ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā alɔ ohi ā í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā kpaakpa ŋ́. É le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá Óndú ā klla kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ɛga nɛ̄ ó lā ā.

eng_Latn: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
idu_Latn: N má ɛdɔ kú opīyatū dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā bá ī jikwū. Amáŋ, é má ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwá ɔtūlé nōo klla í tá uwá abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe bá ī pīya uwá tū ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, ó le ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā tīkwū bá ajɛ gónóó láyíí bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄. Ó klla le yá kú ɔcí nēé hī ka usɛ́da ā kóō bá ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī ka usikāmɔ nēe gē jɛ̄ bá ɔkwu ɛfu ɛga dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbō oyēeyī kú ācɛ nēe gē yá okpaakpa ā, amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā géē bí tāajɛ ipú obū. Ohígbū ka, ɔ̄cɛ í bī ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī nū yá unu dúúmā lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usímri le plla tá inu wɛɛlɛ le Ɛ́la ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū á. Ɔdā nyā yá ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu cahāapa nɛ̄ Ása wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí i yá nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú uwɔ gē bīya uculo nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ habɔ̄tá lɛ alɔ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ohígbū keé gē na abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é cíkā ō yá ā ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lé ɔdōlé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cí kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ba í gwéeyē ohígbū oōgwōnū kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn a dúu, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē hɛ́ uwá wā ajɛ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ enyi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū ā cīce anú, í je tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛ yá lɛ ā. Ācɛ ōhī kpó nwuné fíyɛ́, ācɛ ōhī kē kpó nyɛ́ fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ipú ojīlīmā ō ce iyē nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lé ā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ o bá ipú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ e bá ɛga nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ɛcɛ ā, géē lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ, eko nēé le iyē ɔ́ɔmā hī.

eng_Latn: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā gɛ ŋ́, Óndú! Á kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe hile ā bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Ā híī yɔ̄ gē cɔ̄nū piyóó ŋ́, amáŋ, ó wɛ ɔdā ō hī uwɔ ɔtū ká ā yɔ̄ ī ma ihɔtū opiyóó kú uwɔ ā fú lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú wā í háyi ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ukɔ́tin í playi icō á. Ɔwɛ nyā ukɔ́tin ā má gwū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɛ́lā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ce ɔ́mpa uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī bī ula le ɛpɔ̄ gbájí lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā géē je kpó yíífi. Ācɛ nēe gē cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi kéē híī le ɛpɔ̄hi ŋ́ mā, géē je kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé tá ɛma kú Urúbɛ̄n tāajɛ ā, aɛ́nyā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā á: Ujɛ́yɛ̄lu, Usékarīya.

eng_Latn: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā éyi nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā, lɛ ɔ̄kā pó lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ ó gā gaá lɛ okwúukwú kpó tāajɛ iyɔ̄bū nu bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ gē yá ikpɛ́lā eko dóódu ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ gē táafú gē nuunu eko dóódu ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ odée gē hɛ́ ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄ ágbe klla ī yá ɔ̄ eko dóódu ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ eyī kú nū gē tɔ́ɔ́wá yóó eko dóódu ā?.

eng_Latn: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ úgbéenyi gaá gbo ɛfu kú ɔjɛ ipú éŋkpɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le hɛ́ wāajɛ á. Abɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū kú úgbéenyi ā le hɛ́ tāajɛ í kē jíliyē glá ŋ́ mā ā. Úgbagwú kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī ca klá ɛgiyí ɔkwu kú úgbéenyi ā le ɔ́ ca nyɛ́ŋɛ̄nyɛŋɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko tɛtɛ nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ nááná ā, awɔ gē kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu trɛ̄yí ga ɔnɛ̄fú klla í yálé á. Óndú ā kē cokónu ga uwɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā ka ɛ̄cī éyi awɔ ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ Ísrɛ̄lu, klla í leyīkwu alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē gbō aálá ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē gboló ce Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, nōo géē yɔ̄ ī jé ɔtū kú um oŋmá lɛ o tá ūlī kú Úrim mɛ́mla Utúmim Ɔwɛ nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɛlísa géē bī Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu jé ɔdā dóódu nēé gáā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā lɛ ɛyí tɛ́ɛcɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ áncā bá ī yɛ ŋ́; ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yēkwu klla í jikwū ŋ́. Aá géē je kpó nyinyi ŋmá ajɛ, klla í ba ī tíifu ɛga īyī aá, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si nēé má kóō gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, é cē ikpó kú nū dɛ̄ɛ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ klla cíkā ō leyī gwū íne kú uwɔ bónū igbɔhá, gaá lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipú ācɛ aéwɔhá obɔ̄bíipú nēe gē bīya íne kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā a? Ɔ́dáŋ ka alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yá lɛ ā kpɔ́, ayíka a í cɔ̄nū mla alɔ, í je alɔ kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó géē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ká n̄ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ohígbú uwɔ. Amáŋ kwú eko nɛ̄ n géē gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ Óndú ā ohígbū uwɔ, aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ aábaná í mɛ ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ odóódu í gáā hile gɛ ŋ́ ayíka ipú ísu kú Unáyilu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ n pó ipú ɛbɛ ā cɛ̄ lɛ iyē yɔ̄ ī lɔnɔ tū um nɛ̄hi. Iyē yɔ̄ ī lɔnɔ tū um bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yíipú ā.

eng_Latn: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
idu_Latn: Aá yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ pi aá. N gēe kpó ayí aá wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. N klla í tá uwá bá ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ, úlā ofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ le ɔlɛ́ nū gwó kwu ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ le ikpó kú nū táajɛ ɛyí ɛcɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ le ɔkpáncō yá klá ɛyí kú ɛcɛ á. Ó le éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu hīigwú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ cē klá ɛcɛ gbɔɔ á. Ó ka iyē kú nū ɔ́ɔ lé ka Óndú ā!.

eng_Latn: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā dúúmā wɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ ó lɛ anyōkwū ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ nū, ó géē leyīkwu uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kó ō je iyó ā ce icɔ́ɔci ŋ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú icɔ́ɔci kóō mɛ́ɛga leyīkwu anyōkwū nēe bá ōfōōfū uwā nēé lɛ ācɛ nōo géē leyīkwu uwá ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aólíla ā da aójéeyī ā kahíníī, Aá je anɔ̄ kú aá ōhī lɛ alɔ ohígbū ka agege kú alɔ gē nyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛlā ce ɔ́ bōōbū bá gē ka kahíníī, Alɔ kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā abɔ̄ yɔ̄ gē yá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ kéē cīlɛ̄fú, yɔ̄ ī da uwá kéē híīī dɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi, Usísa ŋ́. Ó klla ka ka anúɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɛɛcɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí ā, Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛgahi kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ododó kú ipácí ā. Ácí le pɛ gekwú anɔ́ɔ ododó ā le kpó wúla wāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
idu_Latn: Ayí mɛ́mla ayááyí kú Usólōmɔn nēé gboce īyī uwā, ŋmá ádā ga ɔyí ā bá yɔ̄ á. Uréhobōwam, Ábīja, Ása, Ujɛhóssāfāti.

eng_Latn: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā géē pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó nōó wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Ó klla ī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔtū kóō je ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō gē gbā ɔ̄ ā bīya. Ó géē yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwúcē i tá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú um nɛ̄ n fu ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ucē nɛ̄ aúcē ɔhá le kɔ̄ klá ɔɔ́ bá ī tū ɔ̄ ɔkɔ́ ŋmá āyā dóódu ā tū um. Lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ā hīgwú wā kéē wā í lé ɛbɛ́ kú okwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a í má īkpɔ̄ɔjɛ nōo tá ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ikpēyī ā nɛ̄ á kē lɛlá wu ígbɔ́ɔcí nōo tá awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ikpēyī ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma igwó o hile ā kē nyɔ̄ mla Ufínēhasi dúú.
