eng_Latn: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda da Ónan, ɔyínɛ̄ kú Ɛ́ri ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá le gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyōkwu kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ. Kwú ɔ̄ ú ɔnyōkwū cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ma ayí lɛ okwūmā ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú iyē kú nū kóō híī bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
idu_Latn: É i yá ɔdā ihilɛ mla ɔnyā ɔ́mpa uwā, ācɛ ōhī i yá unwū ɔnyā tá ɔyí ádā uwā nɔ̄nyā, aɔ́há í gē tēelihɔ anyā ayí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si tū alɔ ɛhɔ̄ á. É klla kahíníī, Ó wɛ ācɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu gē ka olɔhi nū ā. Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo tīihɔ ā da Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ, ōyá olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o yúufi Ɔwɔicō ā, kóō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwɔ ká ā wā ɔlɛ́ nū, kóō pó ɔdā nāa géē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē nwū íne ā da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, A cíla ɔ̄kā ā lɔhi íbí Itíca! Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ka Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gwū ɔ̄ tá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ā, aá kē jé ɔwɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé le tá ɔgbɛ́ɛ́fú nɛɛ, Óndú ā gē bɛyíkwu uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ tū uwā ukɔ́ ka anúɔ géē yá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ uwá bā ipú ákanya nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛ̄gbā ā wɛ igbō nēé gbā ɛgɔ̄ nɛɛ, ó géē wɛ ákú umu mlɛ́mlɛ́ nēé lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄, amáŋ é híī lɛ ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
idu_Latn: Okónu ō tá ɔ́ɔmā, kóō klá anú iyē bɛ̄ɛka átu nɛ̄ ó le klá iyē ā, mla ɔkpá nɛ̄ ó le kwú ɛ́nyɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ogbló nēé í lɛ bī ɔ̄ ā yá ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ugóolu ma plá ɔ́ iyē.

eng_Latn: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ŋmá ojuja wāajɛ, ɔwɔ yɔ̄ ī límanya maá-maá, akpáabana gbo gblágádáá ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
idu_Latn: Lɛ íne kú um tū ká ā yēeyī. Lɛ eyī kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ n nwū ɔ ā gɛɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē leyīkwu īkpēyī kú uwɔ gɛɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le ɔkpá nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī jé lɛ ɔ́ ā pó ā, ó le īlī kú nū híla ipú ɔtū nōbí.

eng_Latn: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa ā, é le pɛ́ tá ɔnū ucɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ka ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo le ɔ̄kā ɔnyā da gáā lɛ ɛɛ́ ká ɔ̄ le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nēé géē je ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá í je ɔnyā ā lɛ.

eng_Latn: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá gáā kɛlā abɔ̄yī aá ŋ́, alelékwū kú Ádā ā gáā kɛlā bū okónu kú aá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé gē ce ɛyí ejé gbojī ā nɛ, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe klla gē nyɔ̄ ī jé ejé olɔfú ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ dóódu má ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ubábīlɔn kahíníī, É lɛ Ubábīlɔn nɛ̄ odúúdú ɛcɛ gē cɛ̄tra anú ā ú yálé ɛɛ́. Ubábīlɔn le pīya ɛbɛ ohéyī lɛ odúúdú aéwo.

eng_Latn: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ Unásārēti, habɔ̄ alɔ tá cíí, ɔdí nɛ̄ a tíne ō yá alɔ ā gɛ? A wā amānyā gaá kpó alɔ yíífi nɛɛ? N jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ ā. Awɔ wɛ Ɔ̄cɛ ōtīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu odúúdú ɔdā nāa yá ā. N klla í yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá tū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
idu_Latn: A gē wɔ́tū ācɛ nēe gē pā aɛcí ā, amáŋ ami ā lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ uwā le túbá. É le túbá kéē kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛyí ɔnya nɛ̄hɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n wā gáā yɛ, lɛ uwɔ má yɔ̄ ī nyā ipú oyī kú uwɔ nōo klá uwɔ iyē cɛkpɛɛ ā. Amáŋ, ń cɛ̄ gā uwɔ kwú ŋ́. N da uwɔ ka ā yēeyī.

eng_Latn: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má lɛyíkwu ajɛ ācɛ Árābu. Ācɛ kú Udɛ́dan, aá nēe ī kpó aínyankūlūmī okpíyó kú aá gáā lā ajɛ ikpakpla kú Arébīya ā.

eng_Latn: The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ Usádusīis, nēé ī cɛ̄ ka ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā, wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ yēeyī kú uwā ipú obū, ā, ákanya, ícɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ōcē.

eng_Latn: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
idu_Latn: Umánōwa tá ɔɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ iyē kú nū hī lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ eko nɛ̄ ɛlā kú nū le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ̄ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ogbɛhá, nōó bī ɔdā nēe bá nyā glá ŋ́, ó géē bī omlede éyi kú ɛya nēé í gwó kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé, nēé í jíliyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó géē bī okoolo nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ólīifu lígíí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwóléyi, kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ alɔ bá ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā aá mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du, ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī yá ā pó, ohígbū ka ācɛ yɔ̄ ī pó ofu kú úklɔ́ o hídáagó nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī yá ā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ kú ugálīli ā. Ācɛ ohi yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́! Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lɔfú yá aɔ́dā o hídáagó nyā glá á.

eng_Latn: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é kpéyī klá uwɔ ā, lɛ ɔdɔ kú inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ a hɛ́bū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká a lɛ iyó kú uwɔ kpó bū ɔ ga ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, N gáā yá odée ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo géē hɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe í pó ā ohí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohútu ā, eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yá ɛcɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ yá uwā ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mla ɔ̄cɛnyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá tɛtɛ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó mafú lɛ aá ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛyi ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Utímōti mɛ́mla ami lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí mɛ́mla ádā nū ā, alɔ yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ alɛɛlɛwa kéē lɛ ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā pó.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ géē wɔ́tū aá ohígbū iyē kú um. Amáŋ é géē nya ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔtūlé jāā ga onmɛ́yí ā tá.

eng_Latn: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yɛ nyɔ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o dɔlɛ́ éyi má, Ulífāyi ɔyí kú Álfīyɔsi cicee inúklɔ́ kú nū. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um. Anɔ́ɔ Ulífāyi nyāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛbɔ́ yá mla Ɔwɔicō ká ā le pīya oklóbīya nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē gbɔɔ́ ō je ɔdōōlɔhi gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí um á. N le ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū um kpɛ́mm ākpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipū ā, le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwā pi ŋmá apɛ́, lɛ ɔtā kú uwa túce kéē ŋmó aólɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá nɛ̄hi ā, kéē klla lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ámɔn ā, le má ka ācɛ Usiríya yɔ̄ ī kwinya ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā, uwá abɔ̄yī uwā le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Abíssāyi kwāajɛ ɛfú ā. É kwúcē ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu kwúcē ŋmá ɔnɛ́fú o kpó tú ācɛ Ámɔn ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
idu_Latn: Aá híī bī ɔ̄kā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ le yá awanda gē yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá ŋ́. Aá híī cīījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ɛco ogbɔɔ́lá nēé hī ka Utɔ́pāsi nēé bī ŋmá Itiyópīya ā, mɛ́mla ugóolu nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā í tōō bī le gbla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan, ajɛ kú Umówābu ā, nɛ̄ Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō ka íne ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē lɛ jīla ɔpɛ́ kú Ɛlā. É gaá kwāajɛ ɛfú le ɔgba hɛ́ leyī pīya kwu ācɛ Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɔtūce aá ɛgiyí ɔdā kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá glá ŋ́, ɔ̄nyɛ kē í je ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú aá tū aá abɔ̄ āa?.

eng_Latn: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
idu_Latn: É ka iŋini tū Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā í pɛ́ kwú ipú ígbíli ā? Ɔdōlé í yɔ̄ amānyā ŋ́, éŋkpɔ̄ í klla yɔ̄ ŋ́. Alɔ í lé ɔdōlé obɔ̄bí nyā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujése cɛ̄ lɛ ayí nū ahāapa ā gaá le pɛ́ yɛ iyɔ̄bū Usámūwɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da Ujése kahíníī, Óndú ā í fu odúúmā kú aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā ŋ.

eng_Latn: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn bá í tōoji bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, kllá bá í tíifu bɛ̄ɛka ayí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú uwá wɛ eyī ékpónú mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ n má okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú odée ā le yɛ kpaakpa nyɔ̄ ɔbū.

eng_Latn: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā, wɛ ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, mla ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce ihɔtū nōó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā lɛ ācoyúklábɔ̄ abɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi kú oje udɔ, ugóolu , mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔlamu, mɛ́mla ācotíīlī kú odufā, ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla ɔnɔwá kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ mla ācoyúklábɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm nɛ̄ ádā um, Udéfīdi fu bá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Urúfɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā, kú aá kē hokónu tū ɛ́nɛ́ nū nōo kē ī yá mla um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ um ā.

eng_Latn: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
idu_Latn: É le olɛhɔ̄ ɛfú tū fu aógbēnjūwā ā ɛɛ́. É bēē gwōnū, abɔ̄ nēé bá ī nyɔ̄ ā. Aólɛlā ā hápápā lɛyíkwu ɔdɔ kú igá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkplɛ́fú ɔda nēé gē ce ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ca ɔdɔ ā tútū á.

eng_Latn: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
idu_Latn: Ámōōmɛ ā ó le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ gā um dúú, nááná nɛ̄ n lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí nēé hɛ́ma ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ayínɛ́ nū ā jéjúuma, amáŋ ó yá mla uwá bɛ̄ɛka aúgbɔga ā. Ó du uwá ɔ̄kā lɔfú lɔfú kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ aá ŋmá? Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ukénan wā gaá lá ɔdōlé.

eng_Latn: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ kú aá híīī yá ɔdā olɔhi kú aá iyɔ̄bū ācɛ o yá ká ācɛ kéē má ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá ī yá lɛ āa, aá gáā mīyɛ ulé dúúmā ŋmá abɔ̄ Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us: for his hand is sore upon us, and upon Dagon our god.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ássīdɔdu gbɔɔ́ ō má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá nyā, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, í gáā yɔ̄ mla alɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ohígbū nū nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē yá alɔ mla Udégɔn, ɔwɔ kú alɔ ā italā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī je ígbáanɔ gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú nɛɛ, ígbáanɔ ā í wɛ okóohō ámāŋ ka ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n da aá ka, aá híīī junwalu lɛ īyī aá nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu oyēeyī kú aá, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē lé mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē gwá ā ŋ́. Aá híīī junwalu lɛ īyī aá, ohígbū īlī nɛ̄ aá géē le wiyē ŋ́. Ó wɛ oyēeyī fíyɛ́ ɔdōlé ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Iyē í kē fíyɛ́ īlī ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
idu_Latn: Īī gbóó, alɔ í bɔ́tū ka iyī alɔ tū ipú ācɛ ōhī nēe je iyī uwā gicō nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́, ámāŋ lɛ iyī alɔ gbla uwá ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je iyī uwā lɛ̄ ā, nēé gē lɛ iyī gbla anú á. É lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ híī bū ipú itɛ ŋ́. Gbō um ɛbɔ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro ā, é jīla Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nēe bá ī gbēyī uwā ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si cīce ɛgiyí ikpati okpije tū ɔ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī má abɔ̄ ācɛ yɔ̄ ī wā lɛ ije tá ɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ācɛ o lɛ ije nɛ̄hi wā í lɛ ije nɛ̄hi tá ipú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ úwé kú Ɛláyíja ā fíyɛ́ eyī ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ɛláyíja yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ úwé ā fíyɛ́ eyī ísu ā igbɔhá kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ísu ā kwú hɛ́ ɛpa waa! Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa kwú bū ɔtū ísu ā ɛyí ɔjɛ, le bēé á.

eng_Latn: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā tá ɔnyā ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Óndú ā í tá uwɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē bī le tá uwɔ abɔ̄ glá ā? N lɛ īkpɔ̄dā ámāŋ ejé dúúmā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
idu_Latn: Owu eyī le tá fee klá um, ɛyí yá um waaaa. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́kpā ofū ce tū um iye á.

eng_Latn: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cojéeyī, ɔyí Udéfīdi gbafíyóó lɛyíkwu ɔ́ á. Ɔ̄cojéeyī nyā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
idu_Latn: Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwú um tá agbá abɔ́ɔ. Ó kpó ɛlā ce um ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ amíyɔ tɔ́ɔna ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn miyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nyā a.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne mɛ́mla ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo nwū ā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
idu_Latn: Ubáfāyi, ɔyí kú Uhenádadi otrɛ̄yí kú āyā éyi kú ajɛ́ Ukeyíla, ma āyā ɔhá kú ɔdɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
idu_Latn: Ipú ikwū ɛ́gɛ́nyā a, ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē kɛpɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ́mpa mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā, nɛ̄ ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ā kéē gwɔ́ɔ́ci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ ā ɛpɛɛpa, ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā, le pɛ́ tá ipú úgbéenyi ā mɛ́mla Unówa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra iyē kú awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā piyóó. A jééyī, a klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
idu_Latn: O ŋmífi nɛ̄ ācɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō gbāajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lé ucɛ nyā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Usɔ́lu kahíníī, Ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō gbenyi ŋ́, n géē nyɔ̄ í nuunu tá ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ dúúdú mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō lɛ ipú piyajɛ géē yúúfi kú aá. N le uwá kpó bá ɛháajɛ ɔfú kú aá.

eng_Latn: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
idu_Latn: Ukálɛ̄bu lɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ánāki agwu ā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla le ipɔ́ɔma kú Usséssāyi, Ahíman, mɛ́mla Utalimáyi nū ŋmá ajɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
idu_Latn: Ó kē í ma inīīcō ogbādā éyi nēé le ɔ́ tútū ā fú lɛ aá. Aá lɛ ɔdōlé ā tútū abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé lɛ āyā dúúmā kú ɛbɛ́ nēé le gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā lé ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá, Óndú ā í gaá mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā gwó ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó kwu pīya ɔdēelihɔ ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lé ā, í mīyɛ ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
idu_Latn: amáŋ é má okwū kú nū ŋ́. É kwúcē wā ī da alɔ ka aá le aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa má nēe da aá koó le héyī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
idu_Latn: Eyōōnyā gē je aɛ́fu mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́ tú kwu ɛcɛ péee, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īlī gē cē bá nukwunukwu ā.

eng_Latn: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm mla ɛgba ogwú kwaáá kwaáá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā yálé, klla lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
idu_Latn: Aá le pó keé ka, Yíhɔtū tū oladóogbe kú uwɔ, ká ā kē wɔ́tū aólɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le ɔ̄kā kú ɛfú mɛ́mla eko kú ɔkpɔkpllɔ, aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́. Aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā géē yá aflɛ́yí piíí, amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā í cābɔ̄ ka eko ā má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá le tá ɔkpancō nyɔ̄ í yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó géē yɔ̄ ī gbō ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā miya ɛ̄nyā á. Ó miya cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ kú uwá bī wā oŋmɛ́yí ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá yá ā. Ó yá kóō klla lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lɛ ojīlīma ce uwā ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábna je ɔkɔ gicō da Ujówābu kahíníī, Alɔ géē bá í kpɛ́fú gbóógbóō nɛ? A jé ka igbīhāajɛ kú nū, alɔ í gáā lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́, ayíka ɛlā ō bī ɔtū lɛyíkwu īyī alɔ icíici nɛɛ. Alɔ wɛ ācɛ éwo ékpónú nɛ. Ó jɛ̄ nɛ̄ a gē da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē híī nū alɔ inya gɛ ŋ ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
idu_Latn: aákā ā gē fu mla uwá. Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ acá nāńdaa ge wu nɛɛ, akā a gē yɛ mla uwá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
idu_Latn: Le da ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bī ikpati kú okónu ōce ā ka, eko nēé gā okónu ísu ā, é géē māháyi cíí okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je ɔyí aá dóódu gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ icɛ̄bɔ̄ nēé hī ka Umɔ́lɛ̄ki ā ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā gē je uwēyī lɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le bá lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, é gā Ubɛ́tfég ɛyí ɛfu kú Ólīfu ā. Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
idu_Latn: mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛpa, nɛ̄ ó hī iyē kú uwā lé ka, Ugássɔm, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, N wɛ ugbɔga ipú ajɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ɛcí nɛ̄hi kú aá nēé hī ka, Ápīisi ā gwōnū āa? Ɔwɔicō lɛ odée gɔ́ ɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ ka alɔ he Óndú ā ɔtū, ó géē bī alɔ wā ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā klla í je ɔ́ lɛ alɔ. Ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōo lɔhi gbiyē nɛɛ, nɛ̄ ɔdōlé kpɔ anú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ nēe bá íkée eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi kē mu mla ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ klla lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá kwu ɔ́ biílí ā. Ācɛ klla mu aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, Ágrīpa mɛ́mla Ubénisi gā mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é le bēhé mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā wā ipú agbla ōjīla kú ójila. Anɔ́ɔ Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ Upɔ́lu bī wā.

eng_Latn: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
idu_Latn: Eko ōhī é cá aá ɛcá klla yá aá ōwē ipéēyī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ. Ekōhī aá kwú iyī aá ú kpó tū ipú ācɛ nēé gē yá uwā lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce ācɛnyā mīyɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā oyēeyī nēé héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. É yá ācɛ ōhī ɛ́kɛma nɛ̄hi, amáŋ é tá kéē híī hɛ́ uwá tá ŋ́, ohígbū kéē leyīce ka aá géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ga ipú oyēeyī olɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da ádā nū kahíníī, N wɛ Ísɔ, ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú uwɔ ā nɛ. Ɔdā nɛ̄ a da um ā, n le ɔ́ yá ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá leyī kwɛcɛ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gé lā oyēeyī lɛ ā, aá híīī yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka aógwuda ā ŋ́, amáŋ aá yɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe jééyī ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka.

eng_Latn: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, LORD, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki í túbla anú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú, ń jé ɔkwu ɔdā dúúmā nóó, a géē je um yíífi mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um icííci nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ aádáádā aá. Odúúdú ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ oyíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā, aá kllá lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā a, ācɛ Uhám, Ámɔn, Upɛ́risi, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, mɛ́mla Ujébūsi.

eng_Latn: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le bēhé wɛ̄ɛcɛ, lɛ ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́, nēé bī ujē tá ā, kwu ɛyí, mɛ́mla awulú ɔgalúlā bllábllá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da uwá kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ iyó kú uwɔ gwó ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ bɛɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ga éwɔhá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbɔɔ́ ō ga ɛga ɔhá ipéēyī uwā ka é má uwɔ. Eko ōhī, é lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú náaná ā, e géē jé ɔdā nāa yá nyā.

eng_Latn: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ígwu kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe le yēŋēē ā ɛpɛɛpa ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā ɛga ahāapa kpó. Amáŋ a géē kpó ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā ígwu ékpónú kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēé le yēŋēē ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú ɛlā nēé ka kahíníī, Ó gicō ā? Ɛyí ɛlā nyā lé ka gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō gicō ā, ó gajɛ le tá ɛhɛ́ɛ́háájɛ ɛga olipú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyí ɛna kú iháyí ɛtá, ɔnyā ɛwū kú iháyí ɛtá, omlede kú iháyí ɛtá, okóohō mɛ́mla ɔklɛ́bɛ́tɛ kpó wā gé um.

eng_Latn: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
idu_Latn: Ɔtūnōbí lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛhɛ oōyɛ á. Ó lɔfú bīya ɔtū kú uwɔ glá, amáŋ ó gē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ géē jé ɔdā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
idu_Latn: amáŋ ka ɔ́ɔ gē gbɛka ā mla odúúdú aá nēe háyí abɔ́ɔ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, mɛ́mla ayááyí kú aá nēé ma ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bēhé ga inu ɔlɛ́ Umíka ā, í je ɛcí ā kpó ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá abɔ́ɔ?.

eng_Latn: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛlā ka mla Umósīsi kwɛyí ɛfu kú Usínāyi ā, ó kwú usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū tá íne igwó tū ɔ̄ ā ú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú aflɛ́yí nōo wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá, odúúdú ɔkpíyē kú nū wɛ ɔnwɔ̄ɔ̄nwū bɛ̄ɛka awulú ō lɛnwū ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Ísɔ.

eng_Latn: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ī nya um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um. Óndú, a cɛ̄ ga um le lɔfú fíyɛ́ aólɛlā kú um. A klla gbō um ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá yá ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá í yá ā gbla um.

eng_Latn: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má ka Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ɔ́ɔ gekwú ā, é le pɛ́ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔdu mla agbénú kú uwā ā, é gē hɛ́ ācɛ lé klla ī wūuwi. É gē yá aógbɛhá ɔdōbɔ̄bí klla í pīya aéwɔhá tū.

eng_Latn: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
idu_Latn: Idɔlá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú ɛnɔ ā yɔ̄ ī yi ācɛ iyē ɔlá. É kē bá ī ka atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛ íkwu bī aámíyā mbá ā gé lɛ uwá ā. Amáŋ é kē cɛ̄ ō pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kwú igbō ā ú, lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ ó je ɔ́ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ajɛ ā. Ó yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā mla ɛbéenyi ā dúú. Ó je ɔ́ lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tíne lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uhananíya jāhɔ̄ ká a pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ga uwɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ Usɔ́lu kwɛyí ā, Usɔ́lu da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔkɔ kú uwɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á nɛɛ Udéfīdi, ɔyí um? Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu je ɔkɔ gicō le ikwū je nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō gbla anú ā? Ita nyá nɛ̄ alɔ í kwu o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē jɛ́ɛyí nū ā?.

eng_Latn: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
idu_Latn: Ɔbá ɛyī géē cɛ̄ ō yúklɔ́ ga uwɔ glá āa? Ó géē cɛ̄ ō gbo ɔlɛ́ ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú uwɔ otū gbɔ́ɔ̄cī glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé iyɛ́jī ŋ́. Ó gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ amáŋ ó lɛ āpīicɛ ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
idu_Latn: ācogbɔ̄cí, ācominu, mɛ́mla ācoplíinu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le lá ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ádā mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā, kéē ményinyi alɔ. Kéē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ alɔ ipú ihɔtū mɛ́mla ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
idu_Latn: É géē yúklɔ́ mla uwɔ, géē cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í gáā túblla uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɛga nēe i kwú ɛbéenyi enyi, géē na ɛ́yá daa ká ō ŋmó ā, nɛ̄ n gáā habɔ̄tá á. É klla gáā gwó ipɔ́lɛ́ nyā igbɔhá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
idu_Latn: Uwá í gáā lā ipú ajɛ kú aá ŋ́, ohígbū nēé géē yá aá, kú aá bīya íne kú um. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔkɔ lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ā, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa kú ikwū ā lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí kē wɛ ile nɛ̄ aá lɛ ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá nɛ̄ abālɔbányā nōó ī tū aá uwēyī ā? O ŋmɛ́yí kú aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ikwū.

eng_Latn: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usárāyi da Ébram kahíníī, Awɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Uhága gē leyī gwō um bónū á. Ami je ɔ́ gā uwɔ á, amáŋ o ŋmá eko nōó le jé ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ipú ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō leyī gwō ūm bónū. Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ami mɛ́mla awɔ hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā bī ofúlutu nɛ̄hi le je Ɛláyíja ga ɔkpáncō ā, Ɛláyíja mɛ́mla Ɛláyíssa, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugígalu.

eng_Latn: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū nɛ̄hi ohile ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ásāhɛlu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu, Ɛlhánan, ɔyí kú Udódo ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m.

eng_Latn: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú yɔ̄ ī lé, lɛ ipú nū kwu ɔkɔ cii. Ɔwɔicó géē cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla anú í yá ɔ̄ɔ̄ italā. Ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō ā géē yā klá ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdōlé nōó gē lé ā.

eng_Latn: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔnyā kú aá iyē ɛfú gbō ka aá gaá ce uwá. Aá gáā kwu ɔgbā kú aá kwú aódōkwɛyí kpɛ́fú í kpó kwu ɛyí. Aá lɛ óbō kú aá tūlé, ká a á lɛ úwé oje nēé ī bī le kpɛ́fú ā kpó wiyē..

eng_Latn: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
idu_Latn: Odo kú um gē nīpú bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lé ucɛ olɔhi nɛ̄hi ā. N kē í gwéeyē í gwíijē í cɛ̄tra uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhám nōo wɛ ádā kú Ukénan ā má ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ tóohɛ́ɛwa ā, ó le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá le da ayínɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔyí kú Ujosíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, nōo lé ka Ussálum, nōo lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwɛyí ádā nū ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā é le ɔ́ kwú ŋmá Ujérúsālɛm. Ó ka, ó gáā pīyɛyí gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat, thou shalt destroy and cut them down; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee, until it be subdued.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú hɛ́ aɔ́cí ohile glá lɛ gwó ɔdā ō bī lɛ cé íbɔm, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ébrahām le ɔtūkpóce Ɔwɔicō ā, ó lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ɔ́. Ɛ́mā nɛ̄ ó hɔ́hā ce odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā á.

eng_Latn: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔcí ōmiya ajɛ ú lɛ āyā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú nū mīya. Ó wɛ umíta ofu igwáhāpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi jikwū aidɔ kú Ábna kahíníī, Ɔdí yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Ábna cíkā ō kwú bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā?.

eng_Latn: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ yéékpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ gā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ō gbonɛnɛ. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó géē méyinynyi alɔ, klla í tá alɔ abɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ alɔ cɛgbá otábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe béeyī eko mā ā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā. Ń lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ámaŋ ka ajɛ nōo dobū klla tūufi nɛ̄hi ā lɛ aá jéjéēē ɛ́ ŋ́. Aá cíkā ō ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔdā nōo he aá ɔtū ā ŋ́. Aá kē cíkā ō ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ gáā kwúcē wā í gbā um ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá móówē mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ipú agbá ā, eko nɛ̄ aábɔ̄nōlajɛ kpó agbénú kú aá ŋmá ɛgiyí aá abɔ̄fú ā, aá cɛ̄ mla ɔtū ékpó, ohígbū ka aá jé ka aá abɔ̄yī aá lɛ agbénú nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́, nōo gē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
idu_Latn: O má eyīgoo je ɔ̄cɛ éyi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā í lɔhi ŋ́. Amáŋ aɔ́cɛ́ ōhɛpɔ̄ ōhī gē má eyīgoo ohígbū ómíci lígíí nēé je lɛ uwá lé ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā géē lɔfú. Éyi kú aógbēnjūwā kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā, géē lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gē gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄hi nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
idu_Latn: N kē jé eko dóódu ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla um. Ó yɔ̄ kwu um ajaajɛ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā dúúmā í jíla um iyē glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó kē je ɔcí onyɔ́kpá kú nū kóō yɛ tíikpó kú um ŋ́, ó cíkā ō wɛ ákú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɔ́ ŋmó, lɛ oyī kú nū cē klá ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā biílí.

eng_Latn: O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
idu_Latn: Elééé, Ɔwɔicō, aéwɔhá gā ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ ɛɛ́. É le ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā tēelihɔ ɛɛ́. É kwú Ujerúsālɛm ú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
idu_Latn: Ó kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ufilístiya klla le uwá yálé ŋmá Ugása jāā kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā nēé hí igá tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ obɔ́tū kú nū ɛpa kpó hīgwú, mɛ́mla ícɔ́ɔ́ja éyi nōo gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ŋmá ipú aɛ́nɛ̄ o gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
idu_Latn: anyā inyankwūlūmī ofu cigwó nēe bá ī je amɛ̄ lɛ ayí uwā, aɛ́na ofɛpa, mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna igwó, anya ijakī ofu mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ijakī igwó.

eng_Latn: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē yá ā, lɛ ojīlīma mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú ɔcɛ́. Ó gē yá olɔhi lɛ ācɛ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ōcikpó ɔhá kú Ukálɛ̄bu ā wɛ Umáaka. Ó ma Uséba mɛ́mla Utɛ́hána lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔ́ yá héyīfuú mla abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tá lɛwa nɛ̄hi ā. Anú nɛ̄ ɔcí dóódu ɔhá kú ɛhɔ̄ kú Éden kú Ɔwɔicō ā géē yá eyī fuúfuú ō lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā wɛ ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó nōo le mu mla umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
idu_Latn: É gē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu, kú ɔdā nōó gē yá ā. Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā cíkā ō cɛ̄tra anú piíí dúú.

eng_Latn: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
idu_Latn: Aólagwú ɛnɛ éyi nēe bá iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú okónpíinu kú igá kú Usamérīya, bá gē ba ɔdā ā, da īyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ géē bá amānyā ká ālɔ̄ le pɛ́ gekwú bónū ā.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
idu_Latn: Unatánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúwa leyīkwu ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka.

eng_Latn: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá eko nɛ̄ n bī aádáádā aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā jāā gaá kwu ícɛ nyā, n húmáyī pi aá ahɔ̄ eko dóódu, ka aá lɛyítáajɛ gā um.

eng_Latn: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔdɔ kú nū, ká aá lɛ eyī bī ɛga olɔfū kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē ka lɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú alɔ ɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le bū ɔwɛ okónōgwu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Unóba mɛ́mla Ujógbéha nyɔ̄ í fu uwá wɛɛ́ igbledū, gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú uwā.

eng_Latn: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í mīyɛ ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́, ayíka ɛ̄nɛ̄ é je lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
idu_Latn: Useráya, nōo ma Ujɛhósādaki ā.

eng_Latn: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, eko nɛ̄ n gē jikwū klá uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄. Mɛ́mla eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n je abɔ̄ kú um gicō lɛyíkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́da ékpónú nyā nōó je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa, ɔ́mɛɛtá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū ā á. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í da Ísɔ eko nɛ̄ aá jīla anú ɔwɛ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, nɛ̄ n géē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Udéfīdi, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka inu nōo le ca tāajɛ ā, gwó kwicō iyínū kpɔ́. N géē je abɔ́ɔ nōo kwú pīya ipálácɛ̄ ā, pīya ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ í lā kpɔ́. N klla géē ma ɔdɔ kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ íkée ā.

eng_Latn: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī piyɔtū kú oyēeyī kú uwā, géē kwú. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē tū oyēeyī kú nū eyījii, géē lɛ ɔ́ tū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ í pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī tū ɛ̄wā kú nú ulé ó kē lɛ ɔtā kú nū tū ce ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ Ugíbēyɔn ā, Amása wā í jīla mɛ́mla uwá. Ujówābu le gbō kú ícɔ́ɔ́ja lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū wu apɛ́ bá ɛ́nyɔ́. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í wā iyɔbū ā, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā kwú plā ŋmá apɛ́ wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá wɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nya aá tá ā, ayínɛ́ um. Oŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē miya ɔdā kú uwā lɛ ā, ācɛ alɛwa kú áa í jééyī ámāŋ lɔfú nɛ̄hi ámāŋ ma tū ipɔ́ɔnū kú olɔdu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ń yɔ̄ ŋ́ iháyí alɛwa ā, n pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm mla ije nɛ̄ n bī gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ géē lɛ ɛya gwó dúú.

eng_Latn: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē héyī kwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Ó klla gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū koó kwú ɔyí nū ú gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Umɔ́lɛ̄ki, cɛ̄ lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā kwú tēelihɔ. Ó klla le uwēyī je lɛ iyē ōtīihɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
idu_Latn: É le íbɔm cē tū uwā le uwá hɛ́tū lɛ ā, jāā gbó iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ Usedekíya cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ Uhɛ́brɔn ā, ígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa kwú pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū klla gaá tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Usɔ́ɔlu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Umikáya, ɔyí kú Ímla. Amáŋ ó gē tū um eyījii, ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ olɔhi dúúmā lɛyíkwu um jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú um nōó gē má piyóó á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóssāfāti da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā ka lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
idu_Latn: A yá ká aólɛlā kú um kéē kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí um. N kē le ācɛ nēe ī wɔ́tū um ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Adonizedec king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Adonisédēki lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uhɔ̄ham, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́brɔn, Upíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujamútu, Ujáfiya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ulákisi mɛ́mla Udébiri, ɔcɛ́ kú Églɔn, kéē.

eng_Latn: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Lɛ iyē kú uwɔ hī gā um. Amáŋ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a tíne ō jé iyē kú um ā a? Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Úla wɛ, Ára, Uhánīyɛlu mɛ́mla Urísīya.

eng_Latn: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ka n ka ucē ɔhá ojigógó fíyɛ́ odóódu kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ ā unwū kú odōōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē yá kú aá lā ɛdɔ oyēeyī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramothgilead:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Ɛláyíssa le éyi kú ígwu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, kwú oli kú anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu nyā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ga Urámɔtu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
idu_Latn: Ó gē pi owú, klla gē bī abɔ̄ kú nū le tá īlī.

eng_Latn: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ lígíi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o yá olɔhi ā lɛ ā, béyī fíyɛ́ agbénú kú ɔ̄cɛ ōbɔ̄bíipú á.

eng_Latn: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
idu_Latn: ohígbū kóō le ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ nɛ̄ ń ka lɛ aá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kpó wā dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ukafután ā ú kpó wu uwá iyē.

eng_Latn: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le iyī nū tú wāajɛ, yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔdōlé má lé ā, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú īyī nū ú ce icō, tá ka anúɔ í yúklɔ́ ŋ́, nōo kē yɔ̄ ī kwú ɛmiyɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
idu_Latn: Ogbló, ɔcí ō kwu ajɛ, ígbóoje-otáajɛ, ápíyɛ́kɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ́ŋgbá mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ohile dóódu ā. A géē mafú iyó nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē bī ā fú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kōō lɛ ācɛ ulá ofucɛhɔ̄ nēe gē nwū aá ɛla ipú oyēeyī kú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, náána aá kē lɛ ádā ékpónú. Amáŋ n le pīya ádā kú aá ohígbū ka ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ n kā lɛ aá ā yá nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á.

eng_Latn: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ita éyi kwu lɛ ayíkpó kú nū kóō nwū uwā kéē cíkā ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ojigógó, kéē híīī gbagbafú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
idu_Latn: Á híī je ɛlá um gwó ŋ́, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a híī yɔ̄ ligbō hɛ́ um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē bá ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, n kē í yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ojājīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɛyí nū lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ Ujáyɛ̄lu, ɔnyā kú Uhɛ́ba, ɔ̄cɛ Ukéni ā. Anú nɛ̄ ɛyí nū lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú, ipú anyā nēe lā áklɔ̄kpɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n le ikwū nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu, je ā po ɛɛ́. N le ōwē mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti bá ī pīya uwá tū lɛ ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
idu_Latn: A géē yá eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā ú kpó playi okónōgwu kú ɛhícō kú ɛkpa ō bɔ́ɔ́tū ā.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ofu mɛ́mla iyē kú ɔ̄nyɛ bá īkpīje nyā ā.

eng_Latn: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
idu_Latn: É kwú mlanyī Óndú, nōo nya uwá tá ā. Anú nōo yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi lɛ uwá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ Ugídēyɔn, Ubárāki, Ujéfuta mɛ́mla am tɛ̄hɔ̄, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú aá, eko ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Anɔ́ɔ aá lā ɛbɔ́ ícɛ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā í kē gáā fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́, aínyílɔ́wɔ í kē gáā fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
idu_Latn: É gē kɛlā ɔwɛ nōo gē bī ɛbɔ́ wā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, é gē kā ɛdɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu ce ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ ī he uwá ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔyí álá ā lɛ ɔja ɔ́mpa ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā á. N pó ɔkɔ kú ɔdā oyēeyī ɔ́mpa ā kahíníī, Gāa.

eng_Latn: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
idu_Latn: Ujése ma Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ āa. Udéfīdi ma Usólōmɔn ŋmá iyē kú ɔnyā nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ɔnyā kú Uríya ā.

eng_Latn: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ nōo wɛ Umósīsi ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́da je lɛ Ujóssuwa, kú anúɔ klla lɛ ɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē, ohígbū ka anú ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ otrɛ̄yí nōo gáā kpó ācɛ ā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ má ā á.

eng_Latn: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú obugā ā. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, é kwú Ujeremíya ú tá ipú inu éyi kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya kwú ɔkpá ɔhá ú lɛ Ubárūku, ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le odúúdú ɛlā nōó ka lɛ ɔ́ ā tá tū ajɛ igbɔhá á. Ó lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ɔkpá kú aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā kpó tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ wɛ Óndú kú Usábāti á.

eng_Latn: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē yá odée nōo í kwá ācɛ iyē nɛ̄hi. Ó géē yá aá italā pií.

eng_Latn: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔyɛ kú alɔ géē kɔkɔ kú iyī nū lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ onwūlabɔ̄ ā géē lɛ ije mɛ́mla agbénú tū ɔ̄ gɔbū. Tá ācɛ ɔhá abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ é kē í tú uwɔ abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, é gē lɛ ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ipú ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ piíí!.

eng_Latn: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú ācojéeyī ká aá nēe ī cɔ̄ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ufi géē kwú uwā, é klla í kpó uwā kwú í je pīya ɔfiyɛ. Abɔ̄ é tá ɛlā kú um ɛɛ́ ā, é lɛ íjééyī ɔhá dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
idu_Latn: A í jē ɔdōlé ā lɛ uwá, é kē ī lé ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔmā, klla ī nīīpú.

eng_Latn: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ é kwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá í gwɛ́ɛya ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá. Ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ó kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ú yá alɔ ɛhi. Ɔwɔicō yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ alɔ íbí.

eng_Latn: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ opeyī ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛɛ́, ācɛ ocīkpó kē ī yāwu, aólagwú le yá yēŋēē, ācɛ odahɔ̄ ī páhɔ̄, ācɛ nēe gekwú ā le héyī, é kē ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aólɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cīce okónu ísu kú Ubábīlɔn ā, alɔ gē jikwū eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ le blakwu Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō ékpónú yɔ̄ á, ó ke lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo bī ācɛ jé ɔwɛ ga ɛgiyí nū, iyē kú nū kē wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kóō gbō uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ okwutɛ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó gā uwɔ. Éyi kóō ŋmá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma dóódu. Lɛ iyē kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ tá tū okwutɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
idu_Latn: N géē je igelī nōo lé ka Upátrosi, nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā tá alácɛ̄, klla í je ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hī ka Usóyan nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō ā tū ɔlá. N géē yá ɔlɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ nōo lé ka ufébēsí ā italā.

eng_Latn: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú opo, mɛ́mla ɔkɛ̄la kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le ɔkɔ ā pó ā, ē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī pó ɔkɛ̄lā ā igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
idu_Latn: É le ɔkɔ kú nū ā wu lɔfúlɔfú mla owú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō híi je híla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
idu_Latn: Anyā alɛwa, nēe tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu ŋmá Ugálīli, kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā, bá abɔ́ɔ bá ī má ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛga oligbó.

eng_Latn: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú āyā kú iyē ā kéē híīī kɔ̄ hɛ̄ īyī uwā tá ŋ́, amáŋ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ká āyā dóódu kéē leyīkwu iyī uwā jōnjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔyí nū yēeyī ā, abɔ̄ ó piyɔtū ɔyí nū, da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Kóocō ō óndú um, ó lɛ ā, kwú ɔyí oyēeyī ā ú lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá ā, ā je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔnyā ɔ́mpa ā tóohi kahíníī, Ó gáā wɛ ákú um ɛɛ́ nōó gē wɛ ákú nū ŋ́, lɛ ɔyí ā yíla ɛpa lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
idu_Latn: A leyīce ɔ́ kóō kwúcē klla gaá kpó aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ a cē ā ga ɛga nɛ̄ a ī fīyɛ̄ uwā ā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le tútū ō kɛpɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ó kē le tútū ō kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ Ujése hīgwú wā ɛga nāa gáā gwɛ́ɛya ā, n géē da uwɔ ɔdā nāa géē yá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n géē mafú gā uwɔ ā nāa géē lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe bá nyā lā Ujerúsālɛm á! Ussamáya, ɔyí kú Uhássūbu, ɔyí kú Asríkam, ɔyí kú Uhássábīya, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri.

eng_Latn: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
idu_Latn: Óndú, ā tá alɔ, ācɛ Ujúda ā piyóó nɛɛ? A gē wɔ́tū ācɛ kú Usáyɔn ā nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a yá alɔ ágbe nɛ̄hi nyā, nōó gáā jé glá ŋ́ ma? Alɔ leyī táajɛ ká ɛbɔ́, amáŋ ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā í wā ɛgiyí alɔ ŋ́. Alɔ leyī táajɛ kéē lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnɔ mɛ́mla ífi, mɛ́mla ágbe wā í ce alɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī, Asárīya, ɔyí kú Ujehóhānan, Ubɛrɛkíya, ɔyí kú Umésilemɔtu, Ujɛhiskíya, ɔyí kú Ussálum mɛ́mla Amása, ɔyí kú Uhádilayi klla le ucē nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó ɛpɔ̄bí dúú.

eng_Latn: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ācɛ Ufílīstiya mɛ́mla ācɛ Árābu kú Ugɔ́baalu, mɛ́mla Umeyúnīte ā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
idu_Latn: Ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nu blublu. Īmū ɔlá kē ī tá kátáá ŋmá ɔɔ́ okónu.

eng_Latn: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛna nēé le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī wú īkpɔ̄dā lɛ ā nwū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi ā. Ó ka anúɔ kwú úkplākā kú ɛnū ɔcí ō bī hɛ́hɔ̄ ā ú wu ɔ́ ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yúklɔ́ olɔfú. Ó ka anúɔ cɛ̄ lɛ Ujúda pí úkplākā ɔcí ō bī lɛ hɛ́hɔ̄ ā ajɛ. Ísrɛ̄lu géē yɔ̄ ī pi úkplākā ō bī le hɛ́hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ abɔ́ɔ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔnyā nū ā, ó da uwá kóō wɛ ɔyínɛ anúɔ nɔ̄nyā nɛ. Ohígbū koó le ufi ō ka ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔnyā anúɔ ā yá ohígbū koó gbɛlá ka ācɛ abɔ́ɔ géē ŋmó anúɔ kéē kwú Urebɛ́ka ú. Ohígbū ka Urebéka jɔ̄ŋcɛ́nyā nɛ̄hi klla lɔhi ōmá eyī.

eng_Latn: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ īkpɔ̄cí ufígi da pitɛpitɛ ka ɛ́ɛ kwú bá ínálēgbé nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ínálēgbé kú nū ā géē mɛ, nɛ̄ iyē géē lɔfú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ijé kú ɛya kú ɛbɛ́ kú íne ō bīya ā yɔlá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā kahíníī, Lɛ okónu tá lɛ Umérósi. Le okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā. É wā gaá tá Óndú ā abɔ̄ ŋ́, é wā í kpɛ́fú lɛ ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā, ó géē héyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ ɛwa ā ohígbū Ujɔ́ni kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ga ígbíli gaá má āa? Ácí nɛ̄ owu gē jíliyē ā kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa fīyɛ̄ ijakī kú uwɔ ɔcí igbo ɛtá lɛ ā? Ami wā í háyi ɔwɛ ká n lɛ iyāwu kú uwɔ ā ci á. Ohígbū ka á cíkā ō ga iyāwu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ kéē hī anúɔ mɛ́mla Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ámāŋ ka Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda ámāŋ ka Usólōmɔn igwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā kwɛyí nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā yá. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā gwó.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, A géē jé eko nɛ̄ a géē kwu ga ipú inu eyīpú gaá je īyī uwɔ tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛlā kú um nōo gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú um wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā lɛ á. Ó gáā kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um áncā ŋ́ amáŋ ó géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā, klla ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kóō yá ā ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
idu_Latn: Ujésa mɛ́mla Ussílɛm.

eng_Latn: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:
idu_Latn: Ka oŋmá ɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla abɔ̄ olɔfú kú nū ā, ɔ́ɔ le aá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla yā ɔdā ohídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdā ōyéyījii, mɛ́mla ɔdōtūufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ tá ɛgiyí nū lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. Ohígbū ka n jé koó géē kwú piií ohígbū ágbe nēé yá ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́ ú ŋmá ɛyí kú nū mɛ́mla ɔká kú ɔcɛ́ nōó le wu abɔ̄ ā. Aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n kpó wā gé lɛ uwɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɛga nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā le yúklɔ́ olɔhi, ohígbū ka eko obɔ̄bí yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔīcō ā da um kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kpó klá ɛyí, ká ā lɛ ikpó tāajɛ, ká ā jikwū ipú ɔtūnōbí, ohígbū odúúdú ɔ̄dōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi o tū íwɔ́tū nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá ā. Ɛfú mla ɔkpɛtā mla ōcē obɔ̄bí gē je uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
idu_Latn: A gēe pīyeyī má ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ami ā kɛ̄ɛɛ, Ɔwɔicō? A gē bī um ga ɔnɛ̄pɔ̄ gaá kɛpɔ̄ tū um kɛ̄ɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kē cɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. N gē gbō Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ ɛ̄gbā o ŋmá lɛ ō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nēé ka kóō wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā. N klla kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēé tá ipú íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔdā ō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā, Ujísɔ̄si dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Ɛ́lāyi, Ɛlāyi, lamá sabaktáni? Ɛyí ɛ̄nyā wɛ, Ɔwɔicō kú um, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔdíya nɛ̄ a habɔ̄ um tá ōfōofū um ā.

eng_Latn: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Ubɛ́njamīn, Ɛ́frem, mɛ́mla Umanásɛ ā pīyɛyí wā í lā Ujerúsālɛm dúú.

eng_Latn: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
idu_Latn: N cokónu nyā ohígbū ka uwá tá íne kú um, lɛ ɔ́da mla Usábāti kú um tá nyílá. Ɛcí he uwá ɔtū ō pā fíyɛ́ ō yɛce um á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ dóódu, yɔ̄ gē nwɛ̄lā ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú uwā. Ó kla gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Ó kē yɔ̄ gē hɛ́ ācɛ nēe gē du ɛdɔ ōcē dóódu mla ɔ́fú dóódu tá.

eng_Latn: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
idu_Latn: Obɛ́dɛ́dɔm lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛháajɛ ā, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ayí nū ī gbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú ɛga o kpíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū aá.

eng_Latn: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ abɔ̄, áganá ā habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ, gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ɔdōlé gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwá nēé bī le mīyɛ ajɛ á ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé bī ɔfú kú abɔ̄ uwā le yálé ŋ́. Amáŋ o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú uwɔ nɛ̄, ohígbū ka é jé lɔɔlɔhi ka a yɔ̄ mla uwá, ohígbū ka é he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
idu_Latn: A géē gbo ɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nāa gā ɔkwu ɔcí elihɔ kú Utábɔ ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, a géē jīla mla ācɛ ɛtá nēe bá ī nyɔ̄ gaá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō Ubɛ́tɛlu. Éyi kú uwā géē bī ayí ɛwū ɛtá, ɔhá í bī igbō ɛtá, ɔhá ā í bī ejé omōōmu ɔjá kú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́.

eng_Latn: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje udɔ mɛ́mla iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā kú ɛhi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū kpó wā kú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kpó miya. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú odúūdú nū ú kpó lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya á.

eng_Latn: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo í kɛlā okónu ucē ɔhá ā, í kɛlā lɛ alɛɛcɛ ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú í gē jɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōó ī ka ā ŋ́. Ohígbū koó bī ɔfú kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ í ka ɔkwɛ̄yi otayínū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu í jɛ́ɛyí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lā Umówābu kpɔ́ ā, Unaómi le pó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, o ŋmá lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā nōo yá nɛ̄hi nēé klla cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tútū ō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Umówābu mla anyā ayí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka, Aá híī yúufi ŋ́, amáŋ ɔtū kóō he aá kú aá gwéeyē, ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā yā lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó lɔfú bēhé ga ipú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú igbīhi nōó le ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbɛ́ɛna bī wā kú odée kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla omlede kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu le eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ubówāsi, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛlā kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ iyē yɔ̄ dúú ā? Ɔdíyā nɔ́ɔ gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi lɛ anúɔ, ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá yɔ̄ dúú ā?.

eng_Latn: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
idu_Latn: Á jé um tá ipú abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um kéē lɛ um kwú ŋ́. Amáŋ, a lɛ um wútá ká n ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ n tíne ká n̄ nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le tá ɛga éyi nēé hī ka Ugɛtsɛ́mēni ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aá báajɛ amānyā ká n̄ gɔbu gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma ɛpa nyā lɛ ācɛ otrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, úklɔ́ dúúmā gā, nēé gáā yá nɛɛ, é lɛ ūlī tá kéē má ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē nyɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú, a wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī ményinyi klla ī yíihɔtū. A gbonɛnɛ, a klla gbēyī cíí klla tōō lɛ ɔtūce.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a má ɔ́ɔmā a? Aúcē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujúda ī yá kpɛ́mm ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda bá ī yá ajɛ í jɛ uwá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um nyā piíí ā, nēé gē wā í yá aɔ́dōbɔbí ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́ɛ̄ á ká ē yá um cɔ̄nū fíyɛ́ á. A má ɛdɔ ɛcá nɛ̄hi nēé cá um ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um āa?.

eng_Latn: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú aá kpó wā, odúúdú aá kóō kpó ɛyí kwɔhá ka aá ga ojuju. Ɔ̄nyɛ ka ɔdā nōo yá nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ īkée āa? O wɛ ami Óndú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa, klla gē nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá á. Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gwū um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
idu_Latn: Ó le lé kwú jɔ̄kwū ŋmá lɛ agbénú nōó lɛ ā. Ó klla kwú pīya ɔdāhá, le jɔ̄kwū tū ipú nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aítíca kú íne nēe wɛ Ufárīsisi ā, le má ka Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē lé ɔdōlé mla ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé leyi gwū uwā bónū ā, anɔ́ɔ é da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ó ī lé ɔdōlé mla ɛdɔ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔwɔ í yá ŋ́, ajɛ a kwú ŋmó. Aɔ́glɛ́ɛjí ā bá ī du ōcē ipú odo, klá lɛ abɔ̄ pīya klá eyī ipú ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya kú uwá wɛ, úlā ce ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī. Aɛ́na kú uwā wɛ, ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
idu_Latn: Yá mla ācɛnyā nēe dēē hīla ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ aā, bī ɔtū oyēŋēē yá mla ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyā bɛ̄ɛka ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā āa.

eng_Latn: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ācɛ nēé le uwá apī hɛ́ ā ōfōōfū uwā ī gwéeyē ɛdɔ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ācɛ nēé ī hápī ŋ́ mā ī gwéeyē dúú. Alɔ le ka ŋmá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ ó kpóce Ɔwɔicō ā, ó mīyɛ anú wā ɛgiyí nū.
