eng_Latn: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē nyīla lɛwa. Ācɛ géē pɛ́ í tú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú aá nēé je wúla tāajɛ ā gwó klla í lā uwá.

eng_Latn: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo dɔɔ̄kā gē mīyɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē tíne, gē pīyɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔwɛ, é géē nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce anyākwɔ́cɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ­aá tɛ́yíwāajɛ lɛ uwá. Aá kóō yúúfi ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ ɔhá pīyeyī kwu okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā, okómpinu ɔhá klla yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Ɔ̄cɛ a lɛ ɛplá nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔwɛ ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā mīya, ó kē wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī ā kpó yíífi, kwu odúúdú ɔpɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú aígelī ā klla mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe gē jɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɛka gbo lɛ ɔ́ ka O ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yá ɔ́ italā ohígbū ɔdā nɔ́ɔ gáā yá lɛ anúɔ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gāá kpɛ́fú tá igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛga je lɛ uwá aflɛ́yí kéē cɔ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si gwutá ipú igbīhi ɔ́kɔ ā lɛ ɛyí ce upílo yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā. Ayíkpó ā lɛ ɔ́ héyī, Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Itíca, Ɔ̄conwɔ̄kpá, ó wɛ unwalu kú uwɔ ka alɔ gáā bī ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
idu_Latn: Ujárɛ̄di wɛ ádā kú Ɛ́nɔ̄ku nōo wɛ ádā kú Umetúsēla á. Umetúsēla wā ádā kú Ulámɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī mīyɛ ulé ohígbū keé yɔ̄ ī tū īkpō kú oyēeyī opiyóo bá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo cē ā kē í gwéeyē tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, a lɛ alɔ nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ. A klla le ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū alɔ ā kpó yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ádā nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā yɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kpɔ́. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī wā ɔlɛ́ ā, eko nōó le bá lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā, ó pó bā ācɛ bá ī gwíijē klla bá í jīije.

eng_Latn: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cokpaakpa ā mā ɔdā okpaakpa ō yá kú nū ā tá, klla gbo ɔ́bíipú ō bī, ó géē kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ā, gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ kú Usiríya, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usiríya ā gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya á.

eng_Latn: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
idu_Latn: Udáni géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛgwā nōo tá ɔwɛ ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ogwiji kú okónu ɔwɛ, nōo gē kwú ɔnya ikpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ce ɔnya ā le pīyɔcíkōtō.

eng_Latn: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ísɔ le má ka ācɛnyā kú Ukénan í he Áyísīki ɔtū ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛgba nɛ̄ ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya, mɛ́mla ācotɔ́yī ā géē dɛ̄ ā, géē cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kwinya nyɔ̄ í tayínū. Ācɛ ōhī géē kwinya gā ipú ūpū, aɔ́há géē kwinya gicō ɛyí aápátɛ́cɔ̄. Odúúdú aígelī ā géē je tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā, aá lɛ ɔtū lɛ kú aá le tútū. Aá leyī kwɛcɛ, kú aá leyī kpóce ɔhā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā hɛ́ ce aá dúúdú ā eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si í wā ā.

eng_Latn: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi ā kwú pīya ígbíli. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā le wúlatāajɛ, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ n géē nyɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ glá ā? Ámāŋ iní nɛ̄ n gēe kwu nyɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ nyɔ̄ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kwú bɛ̄cɛ ā, N má okwu kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ ɛfú lé ā bá ajɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ. Eko nɛ̄ n le tá igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ɔkpɛta le uwá kpó gbɛɛ̄mā. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ ogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī yá óbé ije kú uwā. Amáŋ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā í jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā lɛ íne bīya oŋmá lɛ o nyɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aɛ́na nyā Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla Udáni á.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n kwú abɔ̄ kú um ú gicō gē yá uwɔ italā ɛɛ́, n yɔ̄ ī je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔhā nɛ̄ n hɛ́ ce uwɔ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. N kwú uwɔ ú tá ipú abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ ucē icííci kú uwɔ gē tū uwā ihilɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ ga ɛháajɛ gaá kwú bū ɔpɛ́ kú Ukídrɔn, yɔ̄ í jila igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, abɔ̄ n ce ɛyí ijakī yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n kwúcē bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n bū nyɔ̄ ā, gaá le bū ɔwɛ kú ɔpɛ́ ā ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
idu_Latn: N géē ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí kú ajā ōgbo mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó. N géē bī ícɔ̄nū mla ánya kú um le ikwú cíla uwɔ ulé.

eng_Latn: They shall not dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Óndú ā. Ācɛ ōhī ká uwā géē ga Íjīpiti, aɔ́há géē ga Asíriya kéē lé ɔdōlé elihɔ.

eng_Latn: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ébú á mɛ ā, odée bɛ̄ɛka iwili pétépété kú ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ klá ajɛ ipú ígbíli ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ó ka igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ ɛbɔ́ nēe kē háyi kpaakpa ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī tíne ō je igelī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ ā ipu Ísrɛ̄lu yíífi. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ tíne ō je ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Óndú ā yíífi nɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nɛ̄ n fu ā, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí á, ami kē wɛ ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, aóklóbīya uwɔ nyā í má ɛlā ō ka gɛ ŋ́. É má ohi dúúmā tá uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kóō pi ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ahɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔdēelihɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nōó yɔ̄ nōo kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛga nēé lā ā nyílá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ keé le yá lɛ ā, é géē je uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n tá kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ā yá ká n̄ cɛ̄hɔ̄ nyā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ bá ī ka iŋini ka ami ɔ́ɔ géē kɛlā ipú ita mla ācīije eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi cɛ̄ mīyɛ ije ohile kú ayí aflɛ́yí nēe cabá nyā.

eng_Latn: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
idu_Latn: Unwū kú íne kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó odo kú um eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce á, Óndú. Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á.

eng_Latn: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ágágā kú aítíca ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēe bá nyá, é géē ka ɔ̄kā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēé miya táajɛ ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ije ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Ɔwɔicō lɛ uwa ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bi klla le ikwū miya tū uwā gbojī ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō í gē gbɔlā ŋ́, ó kē í yá uwā italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄, nēé hī ɔ̄ ka Usáyímɔ̄n, nōo tɛtɛ gē yá imabɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ó kē ī yá ɔdā nōo hɛ́ ācɛ kú Usamérīya idáagó, ó ī gwō ka anúɔ abɔ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi éyi nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla omlede ā wā Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a da Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē tū ōcē obɔ̄bí alɛwa wā í klá uwá, oce kú iyē ōmi mɛ́mla áganá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla géē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā yíífi mla ɔwɔ o hɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla owu o kwɔ́lá ō tá klá uwá. Ó ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe bá ā géē yɔ̄ í yá uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
idu_Latn: Ó gē hī ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō igwú kéē wā í pó ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó gáā ka tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ukɔ́ nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, tū aá ā. Aá kōō híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ ámāŋ kōō hī iyē kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla tá ō lɛ aíne kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, ka odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá nyā géē yá uwā.

eng_Latn: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
idu_Latn: A kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í pīya ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ piyóó, awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā kē kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, a le ka ka anúɔ géē je amānyā yíífi píii, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ɔɔ́ gáā lā anú gɛ ŋ́, kwu ācɛ, kwu aɛ́bɛ́. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla géē tá alácɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
idu_Latn: Adónīram kē leyīkwu úklɔ́ ō yá abɔ̄fú á. Ujɛhósāfāti, ɔyí kú Ahilúdu, kē lɛ úklɔ́ kú ɔdā ō tá tū ɔkpá á.

eng_Latn: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā í kē lɛ ɛwa ŋ́, é wɛ ugbɔga ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu, Ɔwɔicō kú aádā alɔ ā cɛ̄tra Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū. Amáŋ aá kwú ɔ̄ ú tū ācɛ abɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, aá klla le híhó ka aá jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ ipú eyī Upáyílēti nōo tíne kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá ā.

eng_Latn: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Amáŋ ācɛ nēe gbɔbū abālɔbányā géē wɛ ācɛ igbīhāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa nēe bá igbīhi abālɔbányā géē wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ o yá ɔdā olɔhi ā í gē yúufi ācɛ o gbāājɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē yúufi ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbāājɛ á. Ó lɛ āa ayíka, aá yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē cɛ̄tra aá.

eng_Latn: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, a yɔ̄ ī móōwē nōo cíkā lɛ italā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú cíkā ō mīyɛ ā ɛ̄ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
idu_Latn: Uwá yúklɔ́ nyā ɔyā ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔnyā éwɔhá ā kpó jé á.

eng_Latn: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, é géē blakwu um. É klla ī blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je uwēyī ga um bīya um ɔtū lɛ ŋmá lɛ ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú uwā nɛ̄o cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá ohígbū ka aójibó nēé ī gbā ā he uwá ɔtū fíyɛ́ um á. Uwá í tū īyī uwā íwɔ́tū ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí mla uwēyī mla ɔdā ō tá ɔ̄cɛ wā ajɛ nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
idu_Latn: Urútu yā īkpɔ̄dā ā jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó yá ā wú ā, ó wɛ omōōmu ómbilí nɛ̄hi éyi.

eng_Latn: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
idu_Latn: O cɛ̄tra olíla klla ī ce ɔ́ ojīlīmā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ nēé le gbō bá ítū gáā tá ā.

eng_Latn: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɛya nyā yá ɛya kú ahínyá ō tá Ɔwɔicō, ó géē bī ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nēé gáā le gwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā kú igbō ō gwɛ́ɛya nēé lɛ ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó lɔfú wɛ igbō ōcɔkpɛ́nú nēé bī umu nēé le wīya mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ólīifu ā, ámāŋ ka égblú nēé yá mla umu nēé wīya mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ólīifu ā.

eng_Latn: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ Áhāsi lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Uhósīī ɔyí kú Ɛlā le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu Usamérīya, iháyí ahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nɛ̄ aójibó otīihilɛ kú aɛ́cí he uwá ɔtū ō gbā ā, n géē je ōwē lɛ uwá. N géē je ōwē kú ɔdā nēé yá ā lɛ uwá. Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā i ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kā, alelékwū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ alɔ ī yá kú ālɔ̄ yúufi ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ yá ācɛ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gē yíihɔtū ta ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa alɔ, o klla gē yá ká ālɔ̄ cīyī alɔ bī glá.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā éyi ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka, anúɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ī nya uwá tá ā, géē wā Ujerúsālɛm gáā nyā odúúdú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā nēe ma ínoōbīya kú uwā tá ā tá.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyīnɛ uwɔ ā bī ula wā gaá mīyɛ ɔhā kú uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ísu kú aflɛ́yí ā lé ka Upíssɔn. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ísu nōo ī pɛ́ ipú ajɛ kú Uhafíla nōo lɛ ugóolu á.

eng_Latn: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ inya kwu ga ɛgiyí Ɛ́lāyi gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, awɔ hī um igwú á nɛɛ? Amáŋ Ɛ́lāyi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ń hī uwɔ igwú nóó, nyɔ̄ gaá gwutá kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ gaá gwutá kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
idu_Latn: Uwá gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyā éyi kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ɛlísa ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyi ga ɔhá ā wɛ, Ufínēhasi, Abíssuwa.

eng_Latn: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī lɛ unwalu má yɔ̄ ī wā, ó gē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, amáŋ olíla ā gē nyɔ̄ cuúcuú gaá wu ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gbɔɔ́ ō hīíjémā igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
idu_Latn: N géē gwó piíí, nááná nōó tīile dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Abālɔbányā, n géē kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Óndú mafú gā um mā ā.

eng_Latn: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
idu_Latn: Itébulu kú oje udɔ ā le akā ɛnɛ mɛ́mla aóje udɔ gblógbló nɛ̄ akā ā wu ɔ́ ā. Ɔdā ō lɛ ocíbú ce yɔ̄ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛnrɛ́ɛnɛ kú nū, é kē le ofu kú ēpū ojíla tɔ̄há yá ikpó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é le ɔ́gbá tá ɔ̄. Amáŋ aóhī kú uwā yɔ̄ ī táafú ipú ɔtū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē yá ojuju obɔ̄bí klla ī nwū ācɛ igelī nyā ɔdōbɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá ī dɛ̄gba ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā gbɔɔ́ ō kwu, kú ajɛ ā kóō je uwá mulɛ mla ācɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
idu_Latn: N gē ba uwɔ ka á hɔ́hā ce ayááyí um, cɛ́ɛ́ ka uwá kéē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ piyóó. Ohígbū ka n jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ cē ɔ̄, kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ kú ɔhā piyóó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ocíbú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā le owu nɛ̄hi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga eyī ísu ā, owu ā gbɔɔ́ ō tá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi bā ɔdā nɛ̄ úgbéenyi ā gáā je pīya tū enyi ā.

eng_Latn: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔ́kɔ ga okónu ókpoó ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi nōo ŋmá igelī ā wā í jila ɔ́ ɔwɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí. Ó tóohɛɛwa, í klla lā ɔlɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ gbojī ɛɛ́. Ɛga o nyí okwū wɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
idu_Latn: Ayí obene í gáā kwú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ í lɛ́ɛcɛ lɔɔlɔhi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gekwú iháyí ofɛhɔ̄, é géē jé ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kwú agbaagbɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōó kē gekwú gbɔbū lɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā géē je ɔ́ ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā yá nɛ̄ um tókónu lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ayí kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anyākwɔ́cɛ ohile kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ɔ̄kā da ka ācɛnyā ɔ́ yɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ anyā lɛ lɛ ācɛ ohile kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, nēé lɛ anyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā āa?.

eng_Latn: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ um ā? Ānyɛ wɛ ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gē je ācɛ éyi fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá ohígbū o má eyī kú uwā, ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ ka aá lɛ íne bīya ɛ́ɛ́, aá wɛ ācɛ o bīya íne ā.

eng_Latn: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
idu_Latn: Ó géē nya ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā le gbenyi ā tá. Ó klla kē í tá ágbe kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi otayínū nyā. Ó wɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɔ gáā kwú ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɔ géē je pīyabɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujéhu gā ɛcɛ ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú aɔ́cɔ́ɔja ɔ́mpa nū ā, é le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka unwalu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ŋ́ mɛ́ ŋ́? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ olíla ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wā ɛgiyí nū ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kē jé ɔ̄ mla ɛlā nɔ́ɔ gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónpīinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ga ɛhícō kú aodée ɛnɛ o yēeyī nēe lɛ acá oōbī wu ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē géē da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ le aá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ le aá kpó wā amānyā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ abɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ cokónu lɛ ádáádā abɔ ka anúɔ géē je lɛ abɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka Ujówābu ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ ipú iyāwu kú nū ā nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā ka ákú ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ohígbū nū ā, ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ á. Ka Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ɔ́ɔ cē ɛlā tū anúɔ ipú kú anúɔ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
idu_Latn: é gē da ɔ́ kóō ka ka Ussíbbɔ̄lɛti. Amáŋ ó gē ka ka Usibɔ́lɛti, ohígbū koó gáā hī ɔ́ lɔhi glá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē jé koó wɛ aá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ kwú le ɔ́ ŋmó, ɛgéyi nēé bēhé Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem nēé ŋmó ā wɛ ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Then took I the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú íkókwū ā ú ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō le bī gé lɛ odúúdú aéwo nōó tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ n le je lɛ uwá gwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu tá uwá ohi mla ɔkpá ɔhá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yɛce um, nɛ̄ aá í yɛce ɔ́da kú um, aá lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú odúúdú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú Áhābu kpó hɛ́ gē um Ujesiríili, eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā óócí. Ayí kú Áhābu ofɛtá cigwó kē bá ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ojīlīmā éyi kú Usamérīya. Ó yɔ̄ gē bī uwá jɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
idu_Latn: Ejé í kwú ācɛ nēe bá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá leyīce ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ oje ahāanɛ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kllɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
idu_Latn: Ujétɔ, Unáfīsi, mɛ́mla Ukédēma. Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Íssmɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N yɔ̄ gē yá ɔkpáncō ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄. É kōō gáā gbɛlá kwu aɔ́dā nēe bá gbɔbū ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé í blakwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē ka ka ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɛhícō mɛ́mla ipú odúúdú aéwo, nōo nū uwā nyɔ̄ ā yɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā, é géē lā ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
idu_Latn: É í je aá tá ōwē, é géē ŋmó aá, odúúdú ācɛ í wɔ́tū aá ohígbū iyē um.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Áa má ɔ̄, Óndú ā le Ubɛ́sālelu, ɔyí kú Úri, ɔyí kú Uhɔ́ɔ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā, hīīgwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ómri gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ nyi Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Áhābu lɛ ɔcɛ́ le kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ Ísɔ mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú nū í he anúɔ ɔtū ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ kwú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú nū ā gblífi, klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ má tá alácɛ̄ lɛ ɔgwú kú ipú ígbíli kéē lā anú.

eng_Latn: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ɛ̄cī kú ícɛ tá tāajɛ, ohígbū ka ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn gáā gbɔɔ́ ō ce íbɔm tū Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī í kōō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā wā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ glá ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le ɔdā nōo yá ā pó ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwá kéē bá Ujérīko jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔnwāagba kú uwá ɔ́ɔ̄ le bū.

eng_Latn: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufilístiya lɛ ɔgba ɛfú hɛ́ le eyī pīya kwu iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā cɛ̄ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɔhi kú aá lɛ ācɛ fu ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ aá, kú aá lɛ uwá tū mla Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi nyɔ̄ Ántīyɔ̄ku ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Ujúdasi nōo lé ka Ubasábasi dúú ā fu.

eng_Latn: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
idu_Latn: N géē hɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla igelī nēé hī ka Ujerúsālɛm nyā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya. N gē yɔ̄ ī gbō igelī nyā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
idu_Latn: nōó ma Unówa ā á. Unówa ma ayí ɛtá. Iyē uwā wɛ Usɛ́m, Uhám mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
idu_Latn: Āpū éyi kwu ɔhá ká, sɔɔɔ́ nɛ̄ ɛga dúúmā ī yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwá nɛ̄ owu gē bū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ācɛ ojīlīmā kú ajɛ Ésīya nēe wɛ aóklóbīya nū ā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́ gē ba ɔ́ kóō jámá nyɔ̄ í kɛlā le ójila ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um, nōo kē lɔtūce ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, lɛ oyēeyī opiyóo. É gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bī ŋ́, amáŋ ó le gla ikwū le tá ipú oyēeyī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, é lɛ ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ tū ɔkɔ bɛ̄ɛka agbá ō tɔ̄ɔkɔ ā. É klla lɛ ɔnɔɔtū wiyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé ā.

eng_Latn: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
idu_Latn: Ɔdāŋ ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā gā kpɔ́ igbīhi nēé lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā fu, lɛ inu ā pla igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
idu_Latn: Ó kwú íwɔ́tū kú nū tū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō gē nya uwá tá ŋ́. Amáŋ ó lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó mla ōcē obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é géē hī um igwú, amáŋ ń gāa cɛ̄ ŋ́. É géē bá ī tíne um nɛ̄hi, amáŋ é gáā má um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ le jīla gaá kwú odúúdú njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla áyɔ́kpá dóódu nēe gē pɛ́ bū ipú ajɛ ā kpó gwū. Anɔ́ɔ é ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya gē wā í má éŋkpɔ̄ gwá ā.

eng_Latn: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa yɔ̄ ɛga oligbō ā, Óndú? Ɔdíyá nāa je iyī uwɔ tayínū, eko nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ipú unwalu kú alɔ ā, Óndú?.

eng_Latn: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
idu_Latn: Ujarɛssíya, Ɛláyíja mɛ́mla Usíkri.

eng_Latn: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
idu_Latn: Umijámin, Umaádīya, Ubíliga.

eng_Latn: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kóō tá cāā ka Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá hɛ́ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ Ébrahām tá, ó wɛ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nōó wā í hɛ́tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá ŋmá, ipú odúúdú unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
idu_Latn: N kpɔ́tūce ɔkōōlɔhi ā dúúdú, ohígbū ka ó wɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nōó gē nyā ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā tá. Aflɛ́yí, ācɛ Ujíyu, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ Ugríisi dúú.

eng_Latn: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si leyī pīya kwu uwá kpaakpa anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí kē wɛ ɛyí ɔdā nēé tá ipú ɔkpíihɔ nyā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācogwíinu tá tónū koó lɔhi ŋ́ mā, le pīya ɛcɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, inu éyi yɔ̄ nēé gwó kwú ɛhícō kú okómpinu kú eyīpú ā ajaajɛ. Ó nwūla ga inu nōo kwu okómpinu pīyeyī kwu ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, nēé ī nā aókwū aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɛya nēé gē je yɔlá dúúdú ā á.

eng_Latn: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ɛcí mɛ́mla ikpɛ́cí, mɛ́mla ojibó kú ɔwɔ nēé hī Ássɛ̄ra ā ú kpó ca tāajɛ ŋmá Ujúda. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɔfú tū iyē gē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n lɛ igwú hī, nā á jāhɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ nāańdaa gā uwɔ, nɛ̄ á wā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, a gē je íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bīya ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē yúufi uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ, ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi í kē má ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā gbɔbú ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó klla miya táajɛ gbɔbū ka anúɔ géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā í kē tɛtɛ wɛ olɛlā kú nū ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá, anɔ́ɔ ɛcɔ̄ ā gaá fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
idu_Latn: Ubenáya, Ubedéya, Ucelúhi.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu upíla mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ aókpómōlóolo mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō kpó odée ce ɔ́ nēe lɛ akā ā mɛ́mla aíyó ohile nēé mā ɔ̄ tá bá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi gaá da uwá kahíníī, Má, ācɛ nɛ̄ aá kpó tū agbá ā bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gē nwū ācɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu n gē yɔ̄ ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ mla aá gē nwū ɛlā, aá kē kwú um ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔdā nēé tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā géē yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá ɛ̄nyā ā, ɛga kú ipú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nēé kahíníī, Ɔdā nēé yá ācɛ obɔ̄bí nēé yá ɔ̄ dúú ā, le cɛ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya wɛ iháyí ofu ce éyi, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa je ɔ́ ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwóléyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhamūtálu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujeremíya nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulíbīna ā.

eng_Latn: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá géē bā í yá um ɔdā olɔnɔ, klla bá ī bī ɛlā okónu kú aá yá um agbe gaá kwu lɛ ā a?.

eng_Latn: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, n yɔ̄ ī pó ɔkɔ kú ajī nɛ̄ncɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī gwō klla ī jókónu pléplé kpɔ́. Abɔ̄ n kē yɔ̄ ī má ɔ̄ cíí ā. É lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú okwū kú nū í tá ga ipú ɔlá, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá kwú ɔ̄ ū yi ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lā ipú ajɛ kú alɔ ā í gáā ka ka anúɔ ī dōōcē ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē kwú odúúdú ɔ́bíipú kú alɔ í yá alɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā kú nū ŋmɛ́yí abɔ̄ nōó kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛɛcɛ kú aá le tútū, ohígbū kú aá jé ɛ̄cī ā ámāŋ eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē kwúcē wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bī īkpɔ̄dā aflɛ́yí kú ɛhɔ̄ kú aá, nɛ̄ aá géē ce ŋmá ajɛ ā wā inū kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Aá híī he ɔyí álá, ámāŋ ɔyí ɛwu dóódu ipú enyi amɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híīī kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɔbū lɛ eko kú ɛpɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ɛpɔ̄ ámōōmɛ nēé í ka ā géē gbēyī jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si í wā í kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdu ācɛ ā. Ó géē kpó aɔ́dā nēe tayínu ipú ajɛ odobū ā bá ɛcɛ péee cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbo tayínū ipú ɔtū kú nū ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō géē cɛ̄tra ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā é kwú pīya okwū gwutá ipú úmúlá lɛ eyī tóbí fiyuu bɛ̄ɛka ɔkwu ɛ̄hī ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla jé uwā glá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔkpíyē kú uwá kwú ŋmó bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ōŋmókókó ā, ó klla kwú ŋmó ɔkpá bá ikpokwú kú uwá kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi í ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ojuja nōo klá anú ā.

eng_Latn: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si pīyeyī má ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū Upíta kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, Ebilíi, ɛlá nāa gbo ā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, amáŋ ó ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ucɛ ā mɛ ā, Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Umerí gbɔɔ́ ō ga ɔlɛ́, amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si, nōo wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā, le hɛ́tá igbīhi ipú Ujerúsālɛm. Ádā mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū í jé ka ɔyípɛ̄nɛ̄ncɛ́ ā le hɛ́tá igbīhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
idu_Latn: A jé ɔ́da nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi dɔɔ̄kā ká ā yá ā. Ā híīī cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá ŋ́. Ā híīī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ā híīī je odée kú ɔ̄cɛ uwī ŋ́. Ā híīī cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū ācɛ ŋ́. Lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā,odúúdú aá mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ̄ um, Ubɛ́njamīn kē le má ka n wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ um ŋmó tá ajɛ éwɔhá, ɛga nōo ligbō ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú gáā wā í ŋmó ami nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔdá dúúmā ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka iju ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ó gē tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́ kóō lɛ um ŋmó bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ aígbáanɔ kú ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō ācɛ kú nū á. Ó gbō ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu ā klla ī nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
idu_Latn: Anú yá aɔ́dā ō cābɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā idáagó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á, kóō yá Uféro mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū italā.

eng_Latn: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́mpa nū ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ayíka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nōo wɛ Ugídīyɔn, ɔyí kú Ujówāsi ā nɛ. Ó kóō gáā wɛ ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́. Ka Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ācɛ kú Umídiya mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú alɔ kpó yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā nōo ŋmá okónu ā ŋmá ipɔ́tū. Ɛ̄nyā kē ī bīya ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ olɔhi le ɔkɔ gbā, Óndú ā le pó, amáŋ ó gē le ahɔ̄ gwō ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gbā ā bónū.

eng_Latn: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ ā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si bī nyɔ̄ ipú ígbíli ká ebilíi kóō já ɔ̄ má.

eng_Latn: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ géē yɛ ce anúɔ Ó ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ géē tōoji bɛ̄ɛka ágábá lɛyíkwu aólɛlā kú uwā, é géē ŋmúleyīkwū ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ wā í yɛ ce anúɔ.

eng_Latn: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
idu_Latn: É bá ī yá um cɔ̄nū ipéyī um cāā eko dóódu. É bá ī pā ɛcí ipú ɛhɔ̄ nēé le tū ō pā ɛcí ā. É klla bá ī gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí aéde nēé bī ublɔ́ɔku le gwó ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ ī lɔtū eko dóódu. Alɔ jé ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lā ipú ɔkpíyē nyā kpɔ́ ā, alɔ í yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā Udéfīdi. Amáŋ akpá klla gaá le fīyɛ̄ Udéfīdi ahɔ̄ kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le pó ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wā, anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu ga ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú ígbíli kú Umáyɔn ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá klá abɔ́ɔ á. Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō tíne Udéfīdi kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā pīyɛyí anɔ́ɔ é lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ Ujísɔ̄si á. Ó lɛ uwá kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu, anɔ́ɔ é le plla wɛɛlɛ lɛyíkwu igelī kú Ubɛtsáyída á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, aá géē jé ka Óndú ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā í yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá ā á, ka ń yá ɔdā dúúmā abɔ̄yī um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ klla ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ, ó gē cɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́, ó klla gē yíihɔtū eko dóódu cabá cabá.

eng_Latn: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ gbɔɔ́ ō pīyɛyí ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā gā Uséyɛ, ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ása í je odúúdú ɛcí mla ikpɛ́cí kú ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā kpó ca tāajɛ dúúdú ŋ́ nááná ā, ó lɛyítáajɛ klla yɛce Óndú ā jāā gbéeko ikwū kú nū.

eng_Latn: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū Íjīpiti, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā nōo lā okónu ɔkpá ā. Lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū aéwo nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́bá ɛna mɛ́mla ayí ɛna kú uwā ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú uwā túkpɛɛ́, kwú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú uwā ú gā uwɔ. Lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛfú ō kpó he uwá ɔtū ā fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá cá um ɛcá klla yá um okónu ŋ́, ohígbū ka n gē le íne kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Áfim nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā, .

eng_Latn: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
idu_Latn: Ń da aá ka aá yá um ɛhi jéjée ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē da aá, ka aá lɛ omíci je lɛ ācɛ kwɛyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā kéē gbɔɔ́ ō bēé ga Ujɔ́dan ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bī ikpati kú okónu ōce ā bá iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
idu_Latn: N gēe tá awɔ mɛ́mla aóklóbīya uwɔ nēe bá pī uwɔ nyā ohi kú ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā.

eng_Latn: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
idu_Latn: Ubílha le ipú yɔ̄ le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
idu_Latn: Ɛka nyā wɛ ɛka piíí nɛ̄ n gbo mɛ́mla aádáádā uwā eko nɛ̄ n kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā á. Ajɛ Íjīpiti kwɔ́lá tū uwā iyē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá kú útuló gē kwɔ́lá tū oje í je ɔ́ ja ā. N da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ ga um kéē klla yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n da uwá kéē yá ā. N da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka é bá ī yá lɛ ā, é géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yēeyī nɛ̄ Óndú ā klla yēeyī ā, ń gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū uwɔ tá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ mla ɔnyā ā á.

eng_Latn: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɛlā ka ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū kahíníī, Abɔ̄ n le yálé ā, n géē je Usɛ́kɛm kɔ̄ klla í je ɔpɛ́ kú Usɔ́kɔ̄tu kɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
idu_Latn: Óndú géē gbō uwɔ ŋmá ámíyā dóódu nōo tayínū ī gbēyī uwɔ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ abālɔbányā, tɛtɛ yɔ̄ dúú ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nōo lɔfú yɔ̄ glá ā, kē tɛtɛ le yɔ̄ gbɔbū ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō ī yá kú ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ā kóō le yɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, É le uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́ ohígbū ka a lɔtūce. A lɔfú nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hī iyē kú ɔdōlé nyā kahíníī, Umaná. Ó le lígíi bɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dā nɛ̄hɛ́ ā, ó kē lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka āmplā nēé bī ɛnwú le yá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dáŋ ka aéwɔhá le īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, amáŋ ka ɔdɔ̄há dúúmā bī wā í je lá lɛ alɔ ɛ̄cī Usábāti, alɔ í gáā lá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwá ŋ́. Ipú iháyí ahāapa dóódu, alɔ géē je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ, alɔ í gáā hí ɔdā dúúmā ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bī alɔ ulé ā, alɔ géē je kpó yá uwá ɛhi ipú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā kwɛyí ā, Urebéka fajɛ le ɔjá nōó ī hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ce ɔkɔ. Ó wɛ adá kú Ubɛ́tūwɛlu, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔyínɛ́ Ébrahām, nēé hī Unáhɔ, nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū kē wɛ Umílka ā.

eng_Latn: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ le aɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tá tū ipú usiléeti kú aflɛ́yí piíí ā tá ipú aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá abɔ́ɔ ā dúú. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le aíne igwó nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɔlá ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá jíla anú eyī ɛyí ɛfu ā tá tū ɔ̄. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú usiléeti ā ú kpó lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā kú nū ā dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ā, ɔ̄nyɛ nēé kē í nyatá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, N géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu cigbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄ iyī um ŋmá ipú ajɛ aéwo dóódu nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā. Odúúdú aéwɔhá ā kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ tīhɔ. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kē ī lā ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā, nɛ̄ n je lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cókónū ā ú lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ unwalu ā ú lɛ ɔ́. Ɔwɔicō géē yá ācɛ kéē yúufi nū. Aéwo nēe kwu ajaajɛ ā, aá bī ɛhi gē lɛ anú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ cíkā ō yúúfi nū ā.

eng_Latn: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ge yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
idu_Latn: É bá ī gbā um ɛ̄gbā ɛ̄cī dóódu, klla bá ī yá bɔ̄ɔdā nēé gē yɔ́tū kpoókpoó kéē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aíne kú ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā tū. É da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ nwū aá ɛlā ɔkwɔɔkwɛ̄yi. É ka ɔ́ɔ klla he aá ɔtū kú aá kwu um ajaajɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔtū kú alɔ le alɔ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔtū kú alɔ á, ó kē jé ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ācɛ kú Ukéyīla géē je anúɔ lɛ Usɔ́lu nɛɛ? Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ɔ ohi ka é géē je ɔ́ lɛ Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Éhūdu bī abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā pi ŋmá apɛ́ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, le ɔ́ gwū ɔcɛ́ ā ipú plū.

eng_Latn: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá wɛ ācɛ olɔfú īkpɛ̄yí, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n le yɛ mla aá lígíí, n géē kpó aá ŋmó. Abālɔbányā, aá lɛ aɔ́tángbédē kú aá plla, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n miya ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá mla aá.

eng_Latn: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu á nɛɛ? Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Awɔ ka ka ami á n.

eng_Latn: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ká ālɔ̄ yɛ gɔbū, ga ɔdā nēé ī nwū aíjínkpa ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ kwú igbīhi kú alɔ ú cē kwu ɔdā aflɛ́yí nēé nwū ācɛ o hútu ō jé olɛhɔ̄ kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ŋmá ajɛ ā. Alɔ í cíkā ō hútu ō nwū aá ŋmáajɛ olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ocīgbīhi ŋmá úklɔ́ icííci, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, n kē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ aá gbēyī ā, igbīhāajɛ, ó klla le tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ aá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɛga má kú aá mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ō tá um abɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ń yɔ̄ gē ka ka aá dɔɔ̄kā ō tá um abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ó lé ka aá má ɛga mafú gā um ka aá dɔɔ̄kā ō tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
idu_Latn: Aá má ka Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó kē le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā yá á, anɔ́ɔ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ ā le jōjīla á.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ da Udéfīdi ka anúɔ, ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá ije ɔnyā dúúmā nōó ī kpó lɛ anúɔ ŋ́, ayíka ikpɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ofɛhɔ̄, nēé le ŋmó bá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ci gwō aólɛlā kú anúɔ. Usɔ́lu gbɛlá ka ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya géē je Udéfīdi ŋmó mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
idu_Latn: Urútu klla da ɔ́ ka ɛga nɔ́ɔ géē kwú ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kwú dúú ā. Ɛga nēé géē nyi ɔ́ ā, abɔ́ɔ nēé géē nyi anúɔ dúú á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā kóō yá anúɔ italā fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔdā ɔhá fíyɛ́ ikwū ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ kɔ̄ hī ɔ̄ tá.

eng_Latn: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká oyī kú ācɛ okpaakpa dúúdú nēé ŋmó ɛcɛ ā kóō ce aá ɛyí. Oyī kú ācɛ okpaakpa ŋmá ákú Ébɛ̄lu, jāā kwu ákú Usɛkaríya, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubɛrakíya nēé ŋmó ɔtāhɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
idu_Latn: Ami Ujɔ́ni yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aícɔ́ɔci ahāapa nēe bá Ésīya nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā á. Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ abālɔbányā, nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ŋmá ikée, nōo klla ī wā ɛcɔ̄bū ā, mɛ́mla aálelékwū ahāapa nēe bá iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā kéē je ɛhi ŋmá lɛ ihɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū íne nɛ̄ Áhāsi, ɔcɛ́ bīya ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Usiríya kwú ɔ̄ ú yálé ɔgbɛ́fú. Ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujúda kpó ga Udamáskɔ̄si kéē wɛ aálagbá kú ɛfú. Óndú ā klla cɛ̄ le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔ́ yálé klla le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū alɛwa kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udɛlíla da Usámsin ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ tíne ō kwú ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔ́ gbō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ lɔfú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó géē yá lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú tū ɛgahi lɛ ā, aá bī ɛhi mla iyó ɛya nɛ̄ aá ī gwó ā wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ohi tá ɔ̄ ka ɛnyā ɔ́ɔ gbo ákú anúɔ mɛ́mla anū mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ujówābu, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō junwalu lɛ anúɔ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā? Ka anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔ́ɔ gáā ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā gaá le odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó da Ébram, ɔ̄cɛ Uhíbru nōo lā kwu ɔcí óoku kú Umámre, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri ā. Umámre mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ Ɛ́sskɔl mla Ánɛ wɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄tɔ̄há mɛ́mla Ébram.

eng_Latn: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nōó tɛtɛ fu táajɛ mīya ɔdā tū lɛ uwá ā, nōó kē hīgwú dúú ā. Ācɛ nōo kē hīgwú ā, ó kē le uwá kagwó mla iyī nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú nū ú lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu le ayínɛ́ nū jéjúuma ā, é í jé ɔ̄ éjúuma ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unówa wɛ iháyí úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ ā, ó le ayí ɛtá nēé hī ka, Ussɛ́m mɛ́mla Uhám mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam le tá Ussɛ́kɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu jīla bá kéē je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
idu_Latn: Usáyɔn he ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ɔtū, nááná nōó kwú yíífi ɛɛ́ mā. É géē ményinyi nū, nááná nōó tá alácɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if thou have no delight in her, then thou shalt let her go whither she will; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money, thou shalt not make merchandise of her, because thou hast humbled her.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyā ā í he ɔtū gɛ ŋ́, ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú wú ɔ̄ tá kóō nyɔ̄ áncā.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N le ɔ̄kā éyi da aá. Aá da um.

eng_Latn: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔdā nēé bá yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá nū ipú ɔtū kú uwā ā jé, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, ipɔ́lɛ́ dúú nōo le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu yɔ̄ gē nunu tá iyī uwā, í gáā lɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́. Ipɔ́ɔ́nū dúú nōo kē le kɔ̄ ī bɛyíkwu iyī uwā í gáā yɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá ede mɛ́mla aíyó kú nū ā igbahāapa. Ó klla lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá ɔgbanjɛ̄ nēé ī na odée anú ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nōó ce ɛyí nū ā, o yá kóō kwú uwā í kpó tū Óndú ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ujɛ́sēbɛlu ā kahíníī, Ewō gēe je okwu Ujésēbɛlu lé ipú igelī kú Ujésiríili.

eng_Latn: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ Udéfīdi ka anúɔ géē mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú nū klla í je lɛ Udéfīdi, klla í je Udéfīdi yá ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu kwu ajɛ kwu icō. Ŋmá Udan jāā ga Ubiyɛssɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Udéfīdi da Ugolíyāti kahíníī, A wā ɛgiyí um mla ɔkpacaŋgelī, óbō mɛ́mla ɔ́kpa, amáŋ n bī iyē kú Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā wā ɛgiyí uwɔ. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu nāa gē lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔ́ ɔtū, klla í cá ɔ̄ ɛcá á.

eng_Latn: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka anúɔ wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ lɛ uwā. Ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā yá aá dúú á. Ká ē géē ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, é kē í kwú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ōhī ā lā Ubássan jāā ga ɛhícō kú Ubaal-hámɔn, Usénīri, mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfú kú Uhámɔn. É le nyīla nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē tá opo nyā á. A í lɛ aíne nēe bá nyā tū opiyóó.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: kóō le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ucɛ kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa, ó kē géē yɔ̄ jāā ɛ̄cī ahāapa Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
idu_Latn: nōo wɛ ádā kú Umáwon á. Umáwon wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́tsɔ.

eng_Latn: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē gwō ɛ̄ngwū ká n̄ cɛ̄tra uwɔ. N gē cɛ̄tra okpaakpa kú uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō kú um. N géē gwō ɛ̄ngwū klla í gwíijē olɔnyɛ lɛ awɔ, Ɔwɔicō nōo tīihɔ nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nɛ̄ ɔtū kú aá le yá ékpó klla le péee ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka aá géē bá ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ā í má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔfú nōó í bī le yá kú ɔdā dóódu kéē bá ɛháajɛ nū ā, le ɔkpíyē kú alɔ nōo le gbɛnɛkɛɛ nōo klla ī kwú ā pīyabɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ákú nū, nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le abɔ̄ tū ūwā abɔ̄ ipú eyīnyinyi mla ihɔtū. Ó ka anúɔ kwú uwā bɔ́ɔ́tū, le ábáa bá uwā ábáa, Ó klla ka anúɔ túkpɛɛ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
idu_Latn: Óndú, otú dóódu, n gē gbɛlá kwu uwɔ, n klla ī gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
idu_Latn: É lɛ íne kú Umósīsi ā tá tū ɛcɔ̄ usílēti, anɔ́ɔ eko nēé je ɔ̄ ā, ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ī ceyī nɛ̄hi ā le bɛ̄cɛ ā. Ɛgahi ā cɛ̄ lɛ eyī kú Umósīsi ceyī nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ nááná nɛ̄ ɛgahi ā gbɔɔ́ ō ca ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í leyīkwu ɔ̄ eyī gbojī ajɛ glá ŋ́ má. Ɛgahi o ceyī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō le bɛ̄cɛ eko nēé yɔ̄ ī je íne nōo gē bī ikwū wā gé lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó īlī ɔhá wiiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ewo ā ú kpó ga ɛga oyēŋēē kú eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔ́lɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu á, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í klla yɔ̄ ipú alɔ bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó klá Uhébrɔn ā ó gbō ācɛ Ujúda iháyí ahāapa ce ɔyā ɛhīlī. Igbīhāajɛ ó kē klá Ujerúsālɛm gbō odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
idu_Latn: N géē hɛ́ ācɛ kú um tá ŋmá ipú aɔ́lɛ́ kú ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, nēé kpó uwā nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ŋmó ɔ́ɔmā, aá klla lɛ iyē kú aá tēelihɔ ohígbū ɛcí nɛ̄ aá gē pā ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā eko nēé í kpó aá yíífi ā gē wā ɛɛ́. Eko nēé je lɛ aá mɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nōo ya ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú aéwɔhá géē yá aá okónu klla ī cē okónu tá aá gbɛdɛɛ ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
idu_Latn: É géē yá uwá ágbe nēé géē pɛ́ kwú ipú aúláyi kú ipú aígelī kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Umówābu ā ka Oyī nɛ! Eko ōhī aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá, aólɛlā kú alɔ ā le ɛfú kpó tá īyī uwā le īyī uwa kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́. Alɔ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ iyó kú aáklɔ̄kpe kú ɛfú kú uwā wu.

eng_Latn: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ɛlā kú uwɔ ā gáā le cɛ̄, ohígbū ka ó kē í cɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá le jé ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔ húmáyī lā ipú uwá.

eng_Latn: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Uhɛsɛkíya ɔ́ɔ gē kpɔ́tūce Íjīpiti. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔcí ekpo kwajɛ gē hī ɔ̄ɔ̄ ka ɔkpá ole kwajɛ ā. Ɔ́ɔ kē í je cē, kllá í bū tū ɔ̄ɔ̄ ɔtābɔ̄. Ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ɔ́ɔ lɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūcɛ ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīma ce ádā aá mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yēeyī līgbō ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú gaá háyi inu eyīpú, ɛga nōo tīhɔ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɛháajɛ acá kú ucérūbim ā á.

eng_Latn: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó he ɔcɛ́ ɔtū nɛɛ, n tíne ka Ágábáidu mɛ́mla Uháman kéē wɛ aúgbɔga kú um ícɛ nyā ɔnū ucɛ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Uháman ɔlɛ́ um ā.

eng_Latn: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi géē bī ɛhi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé, anɔ̄ kú ólīfu, gāa kpó tū ipú inu ɛga o kpó iyó kú úklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū, ɛga nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya gē bá ī yúklɔ́ ā. Ɛga nɛ̄ ācogbō okómpíinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācogwíije klla lā ā. Alɔ í gáā lɛ eyī gwū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā nááná gē klá okónu dúú.

eng_Latn: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā le jé kéē lɛ anúɔ tá wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō nū ɔnyā nōo ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā inya.

eng_Latn: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ń gáā tá uwā abɔ̄ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ má ɔdā nōo géē yá ācɛ nōo gē yá ikpɛ́yí olɔfú, nōó klla í yɛce um kpaakpa ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a gē méyīnyinyi ācɛ íbí ā, á habɔ̄ uwā tá nāa kōō í je uwá yíífi ŋ́. A wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yíihɔtū klla ī méyīnyinyi ācɛ.

eng_Latn: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe kwu Ássīdɔ̄du ajaajɛ ŋmá Ɛ́krɔn ga ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā yɔ̄ anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And, behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Ubówāsi, abɔ̄yī nū gā ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm. Ó da ācoyúklɔ́ ā ka Óndú ā ká ɔ̄ hɔ́hā ce uwá. Anɔ́ɔ é tá ohi ka Óndú ā kóō kē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, A kē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya yɔ̄ í yá aéwo dóódu nōo dɔɔ̄kā ō kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ā. A gbɛlá ka a géē nyatá glá tū īyī uwɔ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ eko dóódu, ohígbū ká ā lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā nwū um.

eng_Latn: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan klla yɔ̄ ī kɛla gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ā je iyē kú ami, Ujonátan hɛ́ ŋmá ipú inu kú awɔ, Udéfīdi ŋ́, Óndú ā kóō gwō aólɛlā kú uwɔ ɔ́ci.

eng_Latn: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Usenakéribu kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ú kpó kwúcē ga Unínīfɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
idu_Latn: Ó le ogbló kú ɔcí kú akésiya nēé géē le je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā gbā, le ugóolu ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
idu_Latn: N cíkā ō je ɔnyā nɛ̄ ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mla iyī um ipú iyāwu kú um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ohile mɛ́mla ayínɛ kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla Upita gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
idu_Latn: Kwú ohi kú oyī kú ɔbɛ́ɛna ā ú, lɛ ayíkabɔ̄ wu ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ́ kwu ajī kú ɛyí ede ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú oyī o hile ā ú pīya tū ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é le ābɔ̄ ālī hɛ́ anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ gɛcɛ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, bá yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔga lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō! É lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wā ŋmá iyē kú Óndú ā, nōo géē gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
idu_Latn: Aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, aá wā ɛgiyí nū mla ijē kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛpa lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ nɛɛ n. Ó ka ijáalí kú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔ́ jɛ̄ nēé gē le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyɔ̄ gaá lɔ́lá ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ, gē da ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔ́lá odée ɔ́ɔ lɔnɔ íbí, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ o gbo ɔ́ gwéeyē ka ɔ́lá afa nɛ̄ anúɔ lá á.

eng_Latn: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: ajɛ yɔ̄ í jīliyē, ɔkpáncō pīya ɔwɔ wāajɛ. Ohígbū ka awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gā, awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú kú Usáyínāyi ā gā.

eng_Latn: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔyípɛ ā ga ɛga nɛ̄ Ujonátan tá ɔyí ā nyɔ̄ ā, Ujonátan da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyī ā tá ánáánūmā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɛfú, mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtā, mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí le yá ācɛ nēe lā Íjīpiti ā italā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, abɔ̄ Ujérobōwam yɔ̄ ī yɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gē ga iyāwu ā, anɔ́ɔ Ahíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā gaá le gbɛyí mɛ́mla anú ōfōōfūnū ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá nyɔ̄ í bá ī pā aɛ́cí lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū nyɔ̄ ī yɔ̄ ī gbajā ā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é bī iyē kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ubatísim yá uwā.

eng_Latn: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
idu_Latn: amáŋ ó lɛ ahilíki ā kpóbónu tóohɛ́ɛwa le kwu.

eng_Latn: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gbɛlá koó cɛgbá kú alɔ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ayínɛ́ nēe bā nyā kéē gā ɛgiyí aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔdā ɛhi nɛ̄ aá cokónu ō je ā tútū báajɛ gbɔbū ká n̄ wā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, ɔdā ɛhi ā géē le tútū báajɛ eko nɛ̄ n géē wā ā. Aá géē je ohígbū ka aá tíne ō je, ó híīī wɛ kéē pi aá bá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú uwā, nēé hī ka Usedekíya, ɔyí kú Ukénāana le ajī kú ɛbɛ́ kú oje yá, anɔ́ɔ ó da Áhābu kahíníī, Óndú ā ka a géē bī ajī nyā le kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Usiríya klla géē yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
idu_Latn: É le aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofɛtá cɛhɔ̄ hīīgwú wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu ohile gē yɛce íne nēé mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ aádáádā uwā. É gē lɛ abɔ̄ na ɔwɛ okpaakpa gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lé ɔdōlé á.

eng_Latn: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
idu_Latn: Íne ékpónú nyā yɔ̄ lɛ ayí-apī kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla éwɔhá nēe lā ipú aá ā á.

eng_Latn: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē yɛ ipú obū ā lɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄hi ā má ɛɛ́. Ɔlá ā kē le fíyajɛ klá ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ odobū nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔ́bíipú ā géē kwú á. Ɔyí í gáā móōwē kú ɔ́bíipú kú ádā nū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ádā gē móōwē kú ɔ́bíipú kú ɔyí nū ŋ́. É géē cílá ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ulé kú olɔhi kú nū, ɔ̄cōbɔ̄bíipú ā géē mīyɛ ulé kú ɔ́bíipú kú nū.

eng_Latn: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
idu_Latn: É kōō kwu aɛ́cí elihɔ kú uwá ɔ́ɔmā í kpó ce ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú abɔ̄yī uwā, kē lɛ ɔ́ nyílá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
idu_Latn: N gē cɛ̄tra awɔ, Óndú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā, ohígbū ka a le um hɛ́tá. Ā cɛ̄ le aólɛlā kú um gwéeyē tá um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yēeyī glá eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ cɔ̄nū ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā glá, eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ cɔ̄nū ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí a? Ápátácɔ̄ gē ca putuu kwú pīya úmúlá, eko nɛ̄ ó le cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī ka ka aɔ́wɔ alɛwa bá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ. É kē cɛ̄ ka aɔ́wɔ alɛwa bá, ka aóndú alɛwa kē bá.

eng_Latn: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā ā, n géē je ɔdā icííci oyá ŋmɛ́yí ŋmá ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā. Odúúdú ācɛnyā í nwū ɛlā ŋmá ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ odúúmā í klla gáā gbaajā bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, ká ā cɛ̄ lɛ ije pllá uwɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī omíci le já uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ aá géē jé ka, Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā yɔ̄ mla aá á. Abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ í wā ā, ó géē nū ācɛ Ukénan, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Uhám, Upɛ́rísi, Ugígāsi, Ámɔn, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi bɛ̄cɛ hīla aá piíí.

eng_Latn: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
idu_Latn: É bá ī lɛ abɔ̄ ma ajɛ ipú obū, í má ɛbɛ ŋ́. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.
