eng_Latn: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔdā olɔhi fíyɛ́ tútū lɛ uwá mla alɔ dúú. Ɔdā nōo kwu Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā wɛ kóō lɛ uwá yájōjīla, ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē lɛ alɔ yájōjīla dúú.

eng_Latn: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ahi í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́hɔ̄ ɔgwā ŋ́ mā, í gáā má ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ce ɔnɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
idu_Latn: Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu lɛ ɔ́da, je lɛ ayááyí nū kéē gwá ejé ŋ́, é kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ɔ́ɔmā jāā kwu ícɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é ī gwá ejé ŋ́. Amáŋ, n kɛlā lɛ aá, klla ka lɛ aá, nááná aá gáā lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́wá kú ācocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā bī ɔtū ékpónú mɛ́mla odo ékpónú, odóódu kú uwā í ka ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā wɛ ákú anúɔ ōfōōfū anúɔ ŋ́, amáŋ é gē kɔ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé lɛ ā mla ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le jīla bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛka gbo lɛ Ujówāsi, ɔyí kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Ujɛhóyāda, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ɔyí kú okwūmā ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ á. Kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ka ipíinu kú Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ géē lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
idu_Latn: N gáā wɛ ojuju o yá tayínū kú aá ŋ́! N kē gáā wɛ ipú ojīla kú uwā ŋ́. Ohígbū keé gē ŋmó ācɛ eko nēé le cɔ̄nū. Ijā ō he kú uwā wɛ ka o cē ɔbá ɛna ikpó.

eng_Latn: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
idu_Latn: O fíyɛ́ dúú ā, aá bla ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cɔ̄ɔ̄wɔ kú ɛbɛ oōmá kú ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, mɛ́mla abɔ̄ o lɔfú mla íkwu nɛ̄hi kú um ā. Ami nɛ̄ aá géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā klla í gwɛ́ɛya gā um á.

eng_Latn: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi le ɔ́ bī ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ágēnégēne kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á, lɛ ómbli tá ŋmá amānyā gajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
idu_Latn: Umíka lɛ ɛga o gbā ɛ̄gbā kú nū lɛ. Ó le ojibó kú nū ma klla le ɔdā ō bī gwɛ́ɛ́bā éyi yá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú éyi kú ayínɔ̄nyilɔ kú nū ú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya á.

eng_Latn: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ucē okpaakpa nááná, ile nyā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē tū lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú āa? Ɔdí nōó ī lɛ ŋmá anú ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ á lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ācɛ ɛtá kú ipú aícɔ́ɔja ofu cigwó, aólɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, le tá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ kú ɛfu, ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi klá kwu ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú Ádullam ajaajɛ ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ Ufilístiya kē bá ipu ɔpɛ́ kú Urefém ā.

eng_Latn: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla géē kpó aógbēnjūwā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja, mɛ́mla ācohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi klla lɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́siya lé ā, Ubísilam, Umítirédati, Utábīyɛlu mɛ́mla aígwu kú uwā ā, le ɔkpá tá ce ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm ga ɛgīyī ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi É tá ɔkpá ā okónu kú Aramáyīki, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē cɛ̄ ɔwɔ kú nū eko nēé gēe jé ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofɛpa. Ó kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ajɛ kú Uhɛ́brɔn iháyí ahāapa ce ɔyā ɛhīlī, ó klla kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ipú Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ádā nū, Ujékɔ̄pu bī wā iyɔ̄bū Uféro, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Uféro á.

eng_Latn: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ń le ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē tá aá abɔ̄ tayínū lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ aá ɔlɛ́ aá mɛ́mla ɔgbɔ́ kú ójila ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á le eyī gwū ɛlā kú ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā bónū, nɛ̄ a gaá yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā ipéyī um āa? A jégēdēē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. A cɛ̄ le ācɛ Ámɔn lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ a kwú ɔnyā nū ú á.

eng_Latn: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ eko kú ɛfú nēé lɔfú cɛ̄tɔ̄há mla aólɛlā kú alɔ, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tá alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ é le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ. Ālɔ̄ tíne ɔwɛ ɔhá nōo í yá kéē híī nyīla glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
idu_Latn: n kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ísu kú Unáyilu ā ɛɛ́. N géē je odúúdú Íjīpiti yíífi í je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄, ŋmá igelī nōo lé ka Umígdɔl ɛhícō ā, jāā ga ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hī ka Ásiwan ɛháajɛ ā, klla jāā gaá kwú ɛjī kú ajɛ Itiyópīya ā.

eng_Latn: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō tá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ahínyá ohígbū koó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ́ ɔ́da kú ɔkpani nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
idu_Latn: Ubésāyi wɛ ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú aógwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā cē ije bá ɔ̄ ā, ó tóohi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gā ɛyí ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwúcē wā Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā géē bī uwɔ abɔ̄ kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́ nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ká ɛlā nōó tɛtɛ ka ā kóō le yá jīla, O ŋmá ipú ācɛ nāa kpó gā um ā, ɔ̄cɛ odúúmā kú uwā í héyībí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū, Áyísīki, da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú uwɔ, Ísɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
idu_Latn: kéē gbō eko kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú ipú ɛcɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bá ī mafú ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla ajodobū. Ɔwɔicō kē le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le he Uhɛsɛkíya mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō tá uwā abɔ̄ lɛ úklɔ́ ā yá mɛ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé géē bī úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ mbá ā. Ń kē gáā nya iyē nū ŋmá ɔkpá kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā ŋ́. N géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū kú Ádā um mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá géē bī ákánjɔ̄ kú nū, lɛ ahɔ̄lá fú tū ɔ̄, lɛ umu kú ɔtulalī tū ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɛyí ede, Árɔ̄ni wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɛlā nɔ́ɔ da aá ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́, kɔ́ɔ̄ kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā lɛ aá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka gā um ā yɔ̄ á. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ lɛ anɔ̄ tū um ɛyí ká n̄ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ ɔ́ má, abɔ̄ eyī kú nū yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ gē ceyī ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi ō túbla Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú aógbló ā ú kpó wu aéliká kú ɔ́kíkā kú Ikpati kú okonū ōce ā ká ācɛ kéē je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ glá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le inya kú oyēeyī kú uwā kwu ŋmá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā, ofúlɔ̄cí. É habɔ̄ áklɔ̄kpɛ, aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aíjakī kú uwā tá bá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
idu_Latn: Ó tá ipú ɔkpá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɛ̄cī kú okónu ōgwū tū, kéē lɛ ācɛ kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɛga ocīce kú ojílímā ú lɛ Unábɔ̄tu.

eng_Latn: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
idu_Latn: Ádā um lɛ ɔdā dóódu kpó tū um abɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ádā ā nɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē jé Ádā ā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā nɛ. Ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔ̄yínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā cɛ̄ ō mafú Ádā ā lɛ uwá ā géē jé ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ó bīya ā. Ó klla í je ɔhá gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ iyē gwu ŋmá iyē nɛ̄ó tēelihɔ ohígbū iyē nɛ̄ó lɛ kwu okwū ā. Ó klla géē je īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū yá tīihɔ kpɔ́ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá má ɔ̄, n géē tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ ojéeyī mɛ́mla aítíca ɛhɔ̄ fu aá piíí. Aá géē ŋmó aóhī kú uwā, géē kpó uwá nyɔ́kpá, géē gɔ́ aóhī ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú aá, aá klla ī nū uwā ŋmá igelī éyi ga igelī ɔhá.

eng_Latn: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
idu_Latn: Eko ōhī nēé da uwɔ kahíníī, Wā kú ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tɔ̄há nyɔ̄ í kwāajɛ ɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmó tónū icííci nááná nɛ̄ ó yá alɔ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
idu_Latn: Igbīhaajɛ nɛ̄ eyī gbo ɔcɛ́ gɔɔ ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá kwu ucē nɛ̄ Ufássiti yá ā, mɛ́mla íne nōó tá ohígbū nū ā.

eng_Latn: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē da ɔ́mpā nū kahíníī, Alɔ í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ga ɛhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē jámá yɛ ɔwɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aólɛlā kú alɔ bī iyɔ́fú. É kē bá ī wā í yá alɔ unwalu ŋmá ābɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n da aá ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá wā kóō tá ācɛ Ujíyu abɔ̄ kóō le mafú ka Ɔwɔicō í yá ɔdā nōó cokónu lɛ aádáádā uwā ka anúɔ ī yá ā, kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
idu_Latn: Inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā pīyeyī kwu Ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. É lɛ aífotó kú alī yá tū ɔdɔ kú ɛplá nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yɛ ā dúú. Agidigbé ikpó ahātá yɛ gicō ga okónɔɔwɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ofɛ̄hɔ da um ka ami ɔ́ da Usɛrúbábɛlu ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔfú kú aícɔ́ɔja ámāŋ ka ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ nāa gáā le yá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ o ŋmá alelékwū kú ami nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í yá aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É le Ɔwɔicō má eyī, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdōlé lé klla le gwá tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú. É gē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā nōo klla gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aɔ́da nōó je ā.

eng_Latn: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Ɔnyīlɔ, ń jé ɔdā nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́! Anɔ́ɔ ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ ó bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka ā, ɔbúgwū le ogwú tū.

eng_Latn: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
idu_Latn: Alɔ klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛdɔ ɔfú nɛ̄hi ō hídáagó kú nū tū aá iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɔfú gbeyīcíí, lɔtūlé klla ī gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le lé ā, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā eyī kú uwā kwú nwūla. Anɔ́ɔ é le jé ka aá ɔ́ɔ tóohɛ́ɛwa á. É le ēpū kú ɔcī nēé hī ufígi ā hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ gɔ́ kwɔhá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ú tū ohí á.

eng_Latn: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aá lɛ iyī aá yá tīihɔ ohígbū ka n kē tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
idu_Latn: Ó í klá ɔkpáncō jāā gbéeko nēé tū kéē lɛ aɔ́dā dóódu yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ otīihɔ nēe yɔ̄ íkée ā.

eng_Latn: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā kwú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́lɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í kpó tū ɔlá. É klla kwú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ú wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́la ā ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛta. É wɛ, Uséreti, Íssha mɛ́mla Étīnan.

eng_Latn: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
idu_Latn: Á híī jāhɔ lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ka ā ŋ́, ohígbū nāa géē pó abɔ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ í yɔ̄ ī cá uwɔ ɛcá.

eng_Latn: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā le ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbo ipú ɔtū kú nū ā jila, klla le ɔ́ jámá kú um jé ɛlá nēé ī gbo ā. N géē yá mla ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o lā lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɔ́dā nōó i yá ā.

eng_Latn: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú éŋkpɔ̄, nōó lɛ acá mɛ́mla āpū ŋ́, aá híī lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
idu_Latn: É nū aébilíi alɛwa ŋmá iyē kú ācɛ, é kē lɛ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka olīifu ā nyā ācɛ alɛwa o doōcē iyē, anɔ́ɔ ke lɛ uwá hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ akpándēde mɛ́mla ícɔ́ɔlɔ́ gē gwó ɔlɛ́ kú uwā á. É gē hɛ́ ɔyí tū abɔ́ɔ kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ, kwu ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú um.

eng_Latn: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔkpɛtā nɛ̄hi ŋmó ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ɛtá. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā lɛyíkwu ɔkpɛtá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ācɛ ō ŋmó lé ohígbū ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ Átɛ̄masi ámāŋ Utayikíkɔ̄si tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwɔ, lɔfú tīyē ká ā gā ɛgiyí um Unikɔpɔ́lisi, ohígbū ka n lɛ ɔ́ kaŋmó ɔtū kú um ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ofu ā mā á.

eng_Latn: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ahɔ̄ pi ipú ɛgíkwū otu lɔfú lɔfú, lɛ olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí um nyā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́. Da ɔ́ kahíníī, A gē yá uc­ē bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ipú odúúdú aéwo ā, amáŋ a gbla íkwu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ísu, ī tágwā ā fíyɛ́. A gē lɛ gē bī ikpó kú uwɔ í yɛ ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā gē bú ɔ̄ gbɔɔdɔɔ.

eng_Latn: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n géē je oyēeyī nōó ī mɛ ŋ́ lɛ uwá á. É kē gáā yíífi ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nū uwā ŋmá abɔ̄ um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ído, otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ukasifíya gaá da anú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū kéē lɛ ācɛ o yúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe géē cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ.

eng_Latn: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔnya ɛpa kpó lɛ ācɛ ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá le tá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya ā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā má.

eng_Latn: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hile, klla lɛ ayí nū nyatá, Óndú ā ká ɛ́ɛ má uwá eko nēé gā ɛgiyí uwā. Ɛ́ɛ géē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē kú uwá ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bí lɛ a, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē ma ka italā nɛ̄ anúɔ bī wā í klá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
idu_Latn: N le cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, N yá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé wɛ ákú um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ n le uwá kpó tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ. Á kē méyīnyinyi uwá ŋ́. Kwu aókplícī kú uwá ā nááná, a yá uwā ōwē lɔfú lɔfú.

eng_Latn: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
idu_Latn: Hī um igwú eko kú unwalu, n gē nya uwɔ tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka á cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
idu_Latn: N géē yá odúúdú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā italā mɛ́mla ámíyā nɛ̄ n ka bū okónu kú Ujeremíya ka n géē tū klá aéwɔhá ā. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ odúúdú aámíyā nēe tá tū ipú ɔkpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Ukíbīsem mɛ́mla Ubɛti Uhórɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ewo ɔhá dóódu, ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ nwuné lɛ, í lɛ ɔwɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ kwu ācɛ ā ajaajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ kwu uwá ajaajɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ dɛ̄gba hɔ̄ɔ̄ kú ɔ̄ wā í tá uwā abɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó le lá aá ā nwuné íbí, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá bī ɔkpíyē kú aá le je ojīlīmā lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ uwá gē bá ī nyɔ̄ ā, ó ka anúɔ géē nā ɛ́yá daa, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ lɛ uwá kwú bɛ̄ɛka aígbáanɔ ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē yá ūwā italā ohígbū ɔdā ōbɔ̄bí, nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā n gē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛɛ́. N le aɔ́dā alɛwa kpó ka lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóō he uwá dúúdú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū he um dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā gē yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfu piyóó, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ikwū olɔnɔɔtū nōó ī ményīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́ mā géē wā í yá mla anú.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Amásīya yá ā, é le uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra iyē kú Óndú ā ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā ga ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé ī ka wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá okónu ā lɛ ɛ́fa bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́fa kú ogwiji ā. É lɛ ahɔ̄ kú uwá gwū kpɔ́kɔ́ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ahɔ̄ kú idu ɔbá ɛgwā.

eng_Latn: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó je eyī gicō, le Ubɛ́njamīn, ɔyínɛ́ nū má, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, nɛ̄ aá gē kɛlā nū ā yɔ̄ á nɛɛ? Ɔwɔicō koó hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ klla í je ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyākim, Ujɛhóyācin, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile nēé kpó ɔfiyɛ ŋmá Ujúda ā kpó wā ɔlɛ́. Ó ka anúɔ géē je agbá kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn hɛ́ ŋmá aá ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
idu_Latn: Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja á. Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú éwo nēe kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, géē wā Ujerúsālɛm iháyí dóódu gaá gbā Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ɛ̄gbā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wā í lé ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ.

eng_Latn: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ahāapa kú eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ísu pīya oyī ā le yɛ.

eng_Latn: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n le ka ka, ń lɛ ɛlá wu unwalu kú um gɛ ŋ́, ká n̄ lɛ eyī um pīyabɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɛ kwu aīnu.

eng_Latn: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ɔdā dúú kóō kwú aá ɔtū ŋ́. Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ, aá ba Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄ba kú ɔdā nōo ce aá ɛgbá, amáŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá kē lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā. Aá yɔ̄ gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá eko dúú nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē ba ɔdā dúú ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka igbō kú Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō, nōo gē je oyēeyī lɛ ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ ɔtūce Óndú, fíyɛ́ o lɛ ɔtūce ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɛfu nēé hī ka Ólīifu ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
idu_Latn: Obadáya ɔyí kú Ujéhīyɛlu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ofigwó ce igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó kē yɔ̄ mla uwá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó tū uwā ukɔ́ kahíníī, Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́, amáŋ aá gbēyī ɛhi nɛ̄ Ádā um cokónu ō je lɛ aá nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ kɛlā ohígbū nū lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikpati kú ɛka kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́. Ó yɔ̄ ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gwó lɛ ɔ́ eko nɛ̄ ó je ɔ́ ŋmá Ukiriyati Ujeyarím ā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, tá ohi kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ tū um ɛhɔ̄, ó ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ yá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ɔ̄ jé ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ tū um ā ŋ́. Ɛ̄jīkwɛjī lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, n le ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ géē jīla ā da uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
idu_Latn: Uhásabíya, Amásīya, Uhilkíya.

eng_Latn: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
idu_Latn: Kwú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ɛlísa ú ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ owu lɛ um hɛ́ kpá, klla kwú um ú ce ɛyí nū yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄. A cɛ̄ lɛ owu nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī tá um gicō gajɛ.

eng_Latn: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
idu_Latn: Ísāka ā lɔfū bɛ̄ɛka ijakī ā, nōó gwutá ajɛ ohígbū ogbɛnū kú ɛkpa kú iyó nōó bī ā.

eng_Latn: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu kú ipu ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā, ó géē yɔ̄ ī kpó aɛ́na ahāapa mɛ́mla aómlede ahāapa nēe lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Ó kē í yɔ̄ ī je opī éyi gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ɛ̄cī dóódu kú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā nyā ka ga um.

eng_Latn: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Unínīfɛ lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó cāŋjɛ ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū lɛ awulú kú nū plla, kwú īlī ekwu ú wiyē, anɔ́ɔ ó má cīce ipú ewo á.

eng_Latn: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāálá ā gā, aá géē mīyɛ ɔfulā kú ɔfú nōó gē cá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
idu_Latn: Ó kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ámɔn klla le uwá kpó yálé. Óhígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, ācɛ kú Ámɔn gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɛkpa ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu ce igwɛ́nɛ mɛ́mla ɛkpa kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó mɛ́mla ɛkpa kú umu kú ubáli úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó le da ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwā lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gɔ̄ ɔfiyɛ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔ́ ahɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná hɛ́ táajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī omɛhīlī ā, ɔdōlé ɔ́klá ɛpa kú ɛ̄nē é gē kpó ɛ̄cī dóódu ā nēé géē kpó klla í tú ɔ̄ tū á.

eng_Latn: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
idu_Latn: N tíne ká ā kwú um ŋmá Íjīpiti cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú um í nyi ɛga o nyi okwu kú aádáádā um. Ká n̄ gwutá mɛ́mla uwá abɔ́ɔ. Ujósɛ̄fu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
idu_Latn: N géē ményinyi aá, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ményinyi aá, klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ aá kwúcē ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́tam, Áhās mɛ́mla Uhɛsɛkíya wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda gboce iyī uwā ā, Óndú ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū Umáyíka nōo ŋmá igelī kú Umɔréset ā lɛyíkwu Usamérīya mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛnyā ma ā, o fíyɛ́ Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Nááná ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā gbéeko dóódu, aá géē bá ī je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nyā lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwúcē ga Ubɛ́tɛlu ipú Áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Óndú ā, nyɔ̄ í jikwū. É lé ɔdōlé ŋ́ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. É le ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And there was great joy in that city.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usamérīya gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ igbō kú oyēeyī nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ igbō nyā lé, ó géē yēeyī piyóó. Igbō nɛ̄ n géē je ohígbū oyēeyī kú ɛcɛ ā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā gē ka ka aá lɛ ɔdu, aá lɛ agbénú tútū lɛ iyī aá ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ nōo gē ŋmá aá ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá bī le lɛ agbénú kú aá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá bī ɔdā ō gwutá mɛ́mla ɔdōlé kú aíjakī kú aá, ka aá klla bī ɔdōlé nɛ̄ aá abɔ̄yī aá géē lé dúú. Ó da ɔ́ ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cɛgbá ā, aá bī.

eng_Latn: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú nū kē le jɔ̄kwū lɔɔlɔhi ohígbū ɔdōlé olɔhi nōó lé ā. Ikpokwú kú nū kē le sɔɔɔ bɛ̄ɛka eko nōó wɛ ɔyípōklóbīya ā.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko nyā nɛ̄ n gēe yá ɛ̄nyā í kwu āa? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá um ohi kahíníī, Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aígelī nɛ̄hi ā kwú kpó tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā ipú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó klla ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ́ lā ipú ɔlɛ́ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú ajɛ ā kwú tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka oŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Kéē híī yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú um. Ísrɛ̄lu, eyī yá um kú aá jāhɔ̄ gā um.

eng_Latn: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɔfu cɛpa ā wɛ Ugidálti.

eng_Latn: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
idu_Latn: Ā híī mlanyī obɔ̄bí nēé bī nyā ŋ́, ā kē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi ŋ́, ohígbū keé le ɛcá cá alɔ nēe bá yɔ̄ ī ma ɔdɔ kú igá ā.

eng_Latn: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔyíkpó í gē fíyɛ́ itíca kú nu ŋ́. Ɔfiyɛ í kē gē fíyɛ́ óndú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu wɛ iháyí ofu cigwó ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gbɔɔ́ ō gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofɛpa ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
idu_Latn: Alɔ í he ɔ́ ɔtū gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó gáā yá okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ alɔ ā jīla gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
idu_Latn: Ma ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gwōnū ŋmá ɔkpáncō lɛ āa? Ɔtaɛ́bɛ́ Ínyíláɔuwɔ kú ɔciɔcī nōo gē fíyɛ́ ajɛ nɛ̄hi a, Awɔ nōo tɛtɛ gēe yá aéwoɔhá ŋmó a, é lɛ uwɔ hɛ́ wā í klá ajɛ gblugudu ícɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ācɛ néē mīyɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋmá ɛgiyí Aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ á, amáŋ aá lɛ ɔ́ tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ owu géē kwu alɔ nyɔ̄ í kwu okónu ísu kú ɔlíidɔ éyi piíí.

eng_Latn: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́máapú uwā nēe lā kwu uwá ā gē cɛ̄ uwá yúklɔ́ nyā á. É gē yá fūlabɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔnyā nū, é géē kpó uwā ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá yɔlá dúúdú. Ohígbū ka ɔdā uwēyī nɛ̄hi nēé yá á. Aá híī yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ipú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he arose, and departed to his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā cāŋjɛ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ulífāyi ɔhá ā gē leyīkwu ejé, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā, ɔtulalī, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō le odée kpóocu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwū kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa kú Árɔ̄ni nēe túblá Óndú ā ajaajɛ nōó kpó uwā ŋmó ā, Óndú ā le ɛlá ka lɛ Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
idu_Latn: Ɛna amáŋ ɛwū dóódu nɛ̄ ikpó amáŋ abɔ̄ kú nū le fíyɛ́ ɔhá, aá lɔfú je ɔ́ gwɛ́ɛya o je ŋmá ɔtū lɛ Óndú ā glá, ámāŋ é gáā mīyɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kú ɔdā kú ɛya kú oji ō cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛlā kú íjééyī ofu cīgwó, nɛ̄ ɛlā ō nwū ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ipú nū ā, tá tāajɛ gā uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi da aɔ́máapú nū ā ka abɔ̄ Unaómi ɔ́ɔ pīyɛyí ŋmá Umówābu ā, ó dɔɔ̄kā ó je ajɛ kú Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔmáapú aá ā lá.

eng_Latn: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá yá kú n̄ gwɔ̄tū eko nɛ̄ n gā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́! N jé ka n lɔfú gwɔ̄tū lɛ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ gē ka ka alɔ ī yá ɔdée bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé jé Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa kú ɔya ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū ācɛ nēe géē bɔ̄bíipú nēé jégēdē ŋ́ mā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá géē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū yēŋēē gā um á.

eng_Latn: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
idu_Latn: É ka ɛ̄nyā kéē jē ɔ̄ má, kéē má ɔdā nēé géē bī kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́. Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔkpá tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gā ɛgiyí ayíkpó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má kéē lɛ iyɔ̄lā kpó gbo. É kōō lɛ eyī kú uwā kwɛcɛ glá ŋ́. É jé ohi nēé í tá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí ɛbɛ́ nēe bá nyā géē wɛ ákú Óndú ā: ijē kú nū, ugbé mɛ́mla útūgbé kú nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ijē nōo klá iyíípú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um piíí, ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā ŋ́, n géē tókónu lɛ aá. Cɛ́ɛ́, aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá gē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí um kóō tá aá abɔ̄ ā, kóō híī tīile lɛ aá gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá je íne kú um koó wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aálá kú um, ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ī da aá ka n géē jila ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá, géē yā aólɔfú ŋmá ipú aɛ́nɛ̄ e lɔfú ŋ́ mā, klla í yā aálá ŋmá ipú aɛ́wū.

eng_Latn: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
idu_Latn: É le iyē kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyééye kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā tá tū ɛcɔ̄ éyééye igwɛ́ɛpa ā, ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwɛyí aípɔ́ɔmā igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla iyē kú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayí ahāapa: Usekaríya, Ujɛdíyɛ̄lu, Usébadíya, Ujátiníyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ icɔ́ɔci nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā lɛ ofu ɛlā kú uwā nyā pó ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ubánābasi tū nyɔ̄ Ántīyɔ̄ku á.

eng_Latn: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
idu_Latn: Ūlī ō tá gē hɛ́pɔ̄ ká ācɛ o táafú nɛ̄hi ɛpa á.

eng_Latn: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄, nōo ŋmá igēlī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Umáyɔn. Ó kē lɛ ajɛ nōo kē kwu igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Ukámɛ̄lu ā ajaajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ aálá ulá ahāapa ce ofu igwó mɛ́mla aɛ́wū úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó.

eng_Latn: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: A géē pi ogbló ā ɔkɔ́ okónu ɛpa o yá kóō wu ɔ́mpa nū gílá. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nāa géē yá mla odúúdú aógbló o hile á.

eng_Latn: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū lɛ eko nyā ā, ē gē hī Uhɛ́burɔn ka, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Aába. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́ kē gā ipú ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē mla ācɛ nēe gē gwéeyē, aá jikwū mla ācɛ nēe ī jikwū ā.

eng_Latn: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔdɔ kú Udamáskɔ̄si ɔlá, klla í tū aágblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ubenhádādi, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
idu_Latn: Urebéka kwú úwé kú Ísɔ olɔɔlɔhi, nōo yɔ̄ inu ɔlɛ́ nū ā ú wu Ujékɔ̄pu, ɔyí nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, iyē.

eng_Latn: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā tū ayípōklóbīya ukɔ́ kéē lɛyí táajɛ.

eng_Latn: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo mīyɛ éyi kú ayí nēe bá nyā iyē kú um, kē mīyɛ um dúú. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē mīyɛ um, ó wɛ ami ofōōfū um nōó mīyɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām kahíníī, Kócōō, ā híī cɔ̄nū ŋ́, Óndú, n géē kɛlā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ofuciigwó nɛ̄ ā má abɔ́ɔ á bɛ́ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, N gaá je ɔ́ yíífi ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ācɛ ofuciigwó má abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
idu_Latn: Ujúda le ɔnyā lɛ lɛ ɔ́kplá kú nū, Ɛ́ri. Iyē ɔnyā ā lé ka Utáma.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD: because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da éyi kú ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔ̄, nōo kē háyi pī ɔ̄ ā kóō lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā ŋmó. Ka anú mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, ɛ́ɛ le ujɔ̄ tū tū anúɔ, ɔ́ɔ klla cɛ̄ le Udéfīdi le kwu. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ō gbō ɔ̄ ā tá kóō bī abɔ̄ kú nū lɛ ŋmó ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyilɔ ā, Unádābu, Abíhu, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Utáma kpó hīgwú wā ɛgiyí uwɔ. A géē fō uwā ŋmá ipú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um.

eng_Latn: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔmáapu ádā nū ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kpɔ́ ka ɔdí nɔ́ɔ da uwá ā?.

eng_Latn: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií nōo ī wā ā, ācobɔ̄bíipū kē í bí tāajɛ. Á jé ŋ́, a géē yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā uwā, amáŋ á gáā pīyɛ̄ uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtu ā yɔ̄ í kɛlā ga um kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā wā ohumɔtū, ohumɔtū wā mla um.

eng_Latn: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
idu_Latn: Aá mā ayókwū kú aá tá gā um, n géē lɛ eyí kwu uwá. Anyōkwū kú aá kē lɔfú gboló ce um.

eng_Latn: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā nāa lɔfú yá ká ā yēeyī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu je eyī gicō má uwíndo ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nōo yɔ̄ āyā kú um ā? Ɔnyɛ nɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēé le uwá búdá ɛpa ámāŋ ka ɛtá pīyeyī bū uwíndo le ɔ́ má.

eng_Latn: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ācɛ ipú aá nēe yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ ígwu nōo ī yɛce Uníkōlāwusi ā gē nwū ā á.

eng_Latn: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú Usádɔ̄ku ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kéē lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó klla da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ opo tá ka, Usólōmɔn, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmá ā, n géē kpó aɔ́nya kú aá ŋmá ɛgiyí á, klla í kpó aúgbɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú aá yíífi.

eng_Latn: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ása lɛ odúúdú oje ɔdɔ nēe hile ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó, kwú uwá ú kpó lɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, lɛ ɔ́ kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ubɛnhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Udamáskɔ̄si mɛ́mla Usírīya ā. Ó tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ fu Ubɛnhádādi, ɔyí kú Utábrīmɔn, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhɛ́siyɔn mɛ́mla olɛhɔ̄ nyā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ mīya ajɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubásan, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔhá kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Utíca, alɔ jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ a gē ka mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ a gē nwū ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Alɔ jé ka á gē má eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú ŋ́, amáŋ a gē nwū ɛlā ɔkwɛyí lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā kahíníī, Igbɛ ékpónú, piyóó, n géē yá ka odúúdú éwo ā kéē le lɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu kú um jé. É í jé ka amíyɔ̄ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
idu_Latn: Wā kú ā gaá gwutá mla um ícɛ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ɔtū géē he alɔ ɛplɛ́ɛpa gbéēyī ōnyā.

eng_Latn: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
idu_Latn: Ń lɛ íkwu kú n gwō ohígbū ka n gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ŋ́. É kōō pi um bá ɔ̄ kú n̄ yúklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā. Ó géē bɔ̄bí gā um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɔ́dāŋ ka n tá ka ń tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú alɔ géē lā ipú ajɛ ā ɛbɔ́, a géē yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu ayááyí uwā, nēé géē bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
idu_Latn: Aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nōo bá ɔkpáncō kwú gwō wāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īkpō kú ɔkpɔ́ɔmā í gwō wāajɛ eko nɛ̄ owu lɛ ɔcí nū jíliyē ā.

eng_Latn: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N ge je Íjīpiti cílá anú ulé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ó yá ga um ā. Ohígbū ka ami nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū bá ī yúklɔ́ ga um á. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɔdōlé lé klla le odée gwá kwɛyí ā, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā lɛ ijakī kú nū ā tútū lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɛyí tū ápátɛ́cɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú oje kú nū úlā-ɛpa-ce-ofɛhɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá Uharōssɛt-hagoyím, ga Ísu kú Ukíssɔn.

eng_Latn: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ bī aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n nwū nāa pó iyɔ̄bū ācɛ alɛwa nēe wɛ ijáalí, lɛ aɔ́dā ā kpó tū ācɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi abɔ̄, ācɛ nēe géē nyɔ̄ gaá nwū ācɛ ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka uwá í cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uwɔ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ō ī hɛ́ ācɛ idáagó kú áflɛ́yí ā í cɛ̄ uwā eyīgēdēe ŋ́, úklɔ́ ōhídáagó ámōōmɛ nyā géē pī ɔtū kú uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Iye-abárim gaá lā Udíbɔn-gádi.

eng_Latn: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Íssbɔ̄ssɛti kahíníī, Kwú ɔnyā um, Umáyíkalu ú gā um. Ufíyé kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya ofɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ n bī cíla ulé nū le lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔkpani nū ā géē wā eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ī leyī táajɛ nū ŋ́ mla eko nōó jé ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā italā. Ó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ācɛ nēe lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā le yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́bá, aá yíhɔtū tū anyā aá. Aá híīī lɔnɔɔtū lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
idu_Latn: É géē je ja ŋmá ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oje gē je ja ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā; eko ɔ́ɔmā, uwá géē jé ka aá bá ī jɛ̄ ɔlá kú íwɔ́tū kú um.

eng_Latn: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: A je odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú kú ɛcɛ ā, bɛ̄ɛka īmū ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, íne kú uwɔ ā he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: A géē mīyɛ ɔdōlé ā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede īkpɛ̄yí kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú ɔdōlé n­ē é je gā um ā. Ocu kú ɛya nyā he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔ́bíipú nōo bī ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Ó géē yēeyī ohígbū ka ó lɛ ɔdōlɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú uwā ā, abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā lɔ́tū ɛmiyɛ eko kú íbɔm ō cē tū igelī ā glá ŋ́ mā, ɔ́ɔ í ŋmó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū ōhī lé.

eng_Latn: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
idu_Latn: Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gē gbɛlá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Ó gē yá ojuju ō bī unwalu gē lɛ ācɛ, ó klla ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmá, ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka, abɔ̄ a gē kɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā, n kwú ɛyí bú kwu aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ nōó géē bī le yá ede nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ipú nū ā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó géē bī le yá úgbɔ́ɔnya nōo géē bī aúcɛ́rōbim kú ɛyí kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́da nyā géē gbɔɔ́ kóō yúklɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛtá kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda ā, nōo wɛ ɔyā igwɛ́ɛpa ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā nēé tū kéē kpó ācɛ Ujíyu ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a le um plla le kwu wɛɛlɛ, nɛ̄ á ka gā um ŋ́ mā ā? Ɔ́dāŋ ka á yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá nyā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í lɛ uwɔ bītá mɛ́mla uce mɛ́mla ijā ō he nɛ̄hi. É kē í yɛ í lɛ uba mɛ́mla íyōyō gwō tá aá ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
idu_Latn: Ó le ifa kú ohépu kú ododó kú ɔcí nēé hī álumɔ̄ndu mɛ́mla oōnwūla kú ododó kú nū yá kwu éyééye kú abɔ̄ ɛhīlī kú íkókwū ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
idu_Latn: Ígwu kú ayí kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe lā Ubɛ́tɛlu ā gaá le ɔ̄kā da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, A jé ka Óndú ā gáā je ɔkpáni uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ícɛ déē? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá uwá ohi kahíníī, N jé gbóó, aá bá cíí mɛ́ɛnɛ, ālɔ̄ kɛlā ga abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ iyē kú ayí kú Ísɔ nēe wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwā lɛ ā mɛ́mla iyē nɛ̄ ɛga nēé lā lé kwu uwá āa. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā ā wɛ: Utímna, Álfa, Ujɛ́tɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um gáā tū um iyē kéē ŋmó um nɛɛ, é le ikpó gbaajɛ má gwōnū.

eng_Latn: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
idu_Latn: É géē gbo odúúdu nū mɛ́mla iyó kú nū mɛ́mla ɔkpɛ́ɛwū olɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ í ce ɔcí ō le bī ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā nyā le yɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ayíkpó ā, ka ɔyíkpó ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ gáā kwú gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si í da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ gáā kwú ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n tíne ka ó yɔ̄ ī yēeyī jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n wā, ɔdí wɛ ɛlā uwɔ gɛ.

eng_Latn: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussimēyi tá Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, ɔdā dúúmā nōó ka ā, anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Ussímēyi má lā Ujerúsālɛm yɛɛ á.

eng_Latn: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ géē yá agbá ōtɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ojē ɔdɔ ī kpó ɛ́cɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ga uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
idu_Latn: n géē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ádā uwɔ, Udéfīdi ka ayí nū géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó ā tū.

eng_Latn: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, é géē hī Ujerúsālɛm ka Akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Óndú ā. Odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā géē jīla abɔ́ɔ kéē gbā um ɛ̄gbā. É kē gáā yá ɔdā ɔtū olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú uwā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N jé ka Umɛsáyíya ā gē wā, nōo wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, eko nōó gā ó géē nwūla ɔdā dóódu eyī péee lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
idu_Latn: É lɛ uwá bī gé lɛ ācohɛ́pɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá ā wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu, é yɔ̄ ī junwalu ipú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ.

eng_Latn: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó wɛ okló ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ó wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á nɛɛ, ó gáā bī ɔnyā dúú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá eko nɛ̄ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ó le ɔnyā lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ó wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á nɛɛ, ó lɔfú je ɔnyā nū nyɔ̄ mla iyī nū glá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods, and images of your mice that mar the land; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel: peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.
idu_Latn: Aá géē ma ojibó kú ugóolu kú ōcē obɔ̄bí nyā, mla ákú ifú nōo gē je ajɛ kú aá cē nyā. Aá kē í lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Eko ōhī, ó géē mā ō yá aá mɛ́mla aɔ́wɔ kú aá mɛ́mla ajɛ kú aá italā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá igbīhi nɛ̄ anúɔ le ɔyí ma ā, ɔnyā ɔhá ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔyí ma dúú á. Ó ka aá lā ōfōōfū aá. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ kē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
idu_Latn: Usisɛ́ra le kwu gaá tayínū ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ujáyɛ̄lu, ɔnyā kú Uhɛ́ba, ɔ̄cɛ Ukéni ā. Ohígbū ka ɛbɔ́ yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ujábin, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhásɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Uhɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni ka, kwú ákánjɔ̄ ofɔ́ɔ́lá kú uwɔ ú, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ahɔ̄lá fú tā ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛyí ede, kú ā lɛ umu kú ɔtulalī fú tū ɔ̄, kú ā ga ɛgiyí ācɛ ā fíyaa kú ā lɛ ɛya kú iyē ō gwu gwó kwɛyí uwā, ohígbū ka ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā ga ɛɛ́, ōcē obɔ̄bí kē gáā bɛ̄cɛ dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā, óndú kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, da alɔ kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n géē bī le jé ka aá wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā yɔ̄ á. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla um. Ācɛ ohile kú aá í bī īkpɔ̄dā gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄tra ɔ́ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā. Ohígbū ka eko nōó gáā kɛpɔ̄ tū alɛɛcɛ ā le yá ɛɛ́. Aá gbā anú nōo yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla ísu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ká ɛgwā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kwú ɛɛ́, o tá ɛgwā ā ɔtū wāajɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ glá ā, í tīile lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛgwā kwú ā ɔwɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, mɛ́mla omlede kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya nēé í yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ n má ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nōo bī ikpó igbīhi kú nū háyi icō bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā. Ó le ikpokwú íkélí ɛtá kpó kwu aīnu. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā nyɔ̄ í lé ɛbɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́ dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká aá yɔ̄ ī yíhɔtū tá iyī aá nwuné nwuné cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɔfú jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo í yá kú aá kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa glá.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ā, ahínyá, ohígbū ka ó lɔhi. Ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du klla le ɔdōōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ aódōōbɔ̄bí ɔhá nōo yá ā yá, ŋmá lɛ ō je Ujɔ́ni tá agbá.

eng_Latn: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ā, kpó tayínū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ái mla Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
idu_Latn: Ɛmiyɛ mla ijēēnyi ŋmó uwā, é leyī ce ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ íjééyī ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ohílīpú kú ɛyí ɔdā ō jé. N klla lɛ ɔdā ō jé mɛ́mla eyī ō yɛ ɛlā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā wɛ ka, é lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí nēé gē ce nōo kwɛyí ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēé géē je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Uhíram ā, wɛ ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ālɔ̄ híī ŋmó iyī alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí gɛ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kaŋmó ipú ɔtū kú alɔ ká alɔ í gáā yá ɔdā nōo í yá kú ɔ́mpā alɔ kóō bīyíne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī gbɛlá ka ɛ̄cī éyi ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔhá á, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ā kē gbɛlá ka ɛ̄cī dóódu ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ékpónú. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō lɛ ɔtū kú nū yéékpó lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī gicō gaá cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Ācɛ ā bá ī tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē, bá ī tá opo pōōpōō.

eng_Latn: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā ŋ́. É gbɔɔ́ ō pɛcí bɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā hīla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū, nōó klla gē gbō uwā. Ó gē gbō uwā ɛ̄cī dóódu. Ó kē lā ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, otú éyi, Ɛ́lāyi nɛ̄ eyī kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō pū ɛ́ɛ́ mā, nɛ̄ ó kē mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi gɛ ŋ́ mā, gwutá ɛga éyi yɔ̄ í gbɔlā.

eng_Latn: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú ajɛ ā lɛ eyī gwū ɔdā nōó yá ā tá, nēé ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
idu_Latn: Ó gē jikwū nɛ̄hi ɔtú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, agīje le ɔ́ ɔtū gwā cɛnyi, ipú aɔ́ya nū ā, odúúmā kú ūwā í yɔ̄ nēe gē tá ɔ̄ ɔtū lé gɛ ŋ́, aɔ́ya nū ā le ibīyajɛ yá tū ɔ̄. É kwú pīya aólɛlā kú nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um wā gaá le ɛya kú olétɔ̄há gwó, ɔkɔ́kllɔtū mɛ́mla átákwū kú nū ā wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ ācɛ yá ami, Óndú ā á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n le ŋmó tū nɛ̄ó lɛ opīyabɔ̄ gɛ̄ ŋ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ī hɔ́hā ce ajɛ nōo ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ɔwɔ nōo ī yá tū ɔ̄ ojigógó ā kóō yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo í tīile lɛ ācɛ nēé hí lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ húmáyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
idu_Latn: Ń bī ācɛ nēe bá nyā ōfōōfū um glá ŋ́, unwalu kú uwā le ce um bá.

eng_Latn: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ubábīlɔn kōō lɛ icō tū ga ɔkpáncō gāa lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó, lɛ igá nɛ̄hi ce tū ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nááná, n gēe tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gaá je uwá yíífi. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á.

eng_Latn: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, Óndú ā, cɛ̄ ká n̄ gekwú mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ó lɔhi gā um fíyɛ́ ká n̄ gekwú fíyɛ́ ō yēeyī.

eng_Latn: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē yíhɔtū tū ācɛ nēe yíhɔtū tū aá ōfōōfū uwā, ɔdí wɛ ulé kú aá āa? Aódɔlɛ́ nááná gē yá lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhananíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, kwú úkplākā nɛ̄ um le wu ɔkɔ ā ú púla klla kwú ɔ̄ ú ca á.

eng_Latn: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɛyí ɛpa ɔhá kú agbá ā í gbō tū ɔkwu ɛpa ā, anɔ́ɔ é bī ɔwɛ nyā kwú uwā ú kpó kwu iyɔ̄bū ɔ́ŋgbá ácá kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, so ye shall observe to do.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí kú ɔkpíyē má iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ kéē lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ulífāyi í ka lɛ uwá ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, abālɔbányā oyēeyī kú alɔ le lɔhi ɛɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá háyi kpaakpa ipú oyēeyī kú aá ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
idu_Latn: Aá cēyītīkwū, aá híī kwáahi ŋ́. Aá cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄ mla ɔtū ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ īkpēyī kú nū kwú pīya ɔnɔ̄wá ohígbū ícɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu Ussádrāki, Uméssaki mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɔlá kú útuló ā túgwó igbo ahāapa fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē kplá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
idu_Latn: Áyísīki mɛ́mla Íssmɛ̄lu, ayí nū le ɔ́ nyi ikpámílī kú Umákpēla ipú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umámre nōo wɛ ákú Éfrɔn, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ha, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā.

eng_Latn: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
idu_Latn: N gebí bɛ̄ɛka álá nōo gebí ā ɛɛ́, wā gaá tíne ami, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, Óndú, ohígbū ka ń gwɛ̄lá hī íne kú uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yíihɔtū tū um, ó géē lɛ ɛlā kú um tū, Ádā um klla géē yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄, alɔ kē géē wā ɛgiyí nū, alɔ géē lā mla anú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá le gla ā, ó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā hīgwú tɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le jīla ā, ó da uwā kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, ń kē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ámāŋ ucē kú aádā alɔ ŋ́, nááná é kwú um ú bɛ̄ɛka olagbá ā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm í tā ācɛ Uróm abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le odúúdú ɔdā nōó lɛ kpɛ́mm ā gwó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, gaá lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádā nū, Áyísīki á.

eng_Latn: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne kú Umósīsi ā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Eko gā ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ idáagó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD's.
idu_Latn: N géē tū aólɛlā ɛhɔ̄ wā í je ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā wúlatāajɛ, amáŋ kéē híī kpó odúúdú aɔ́cí ufáyin ā yíífi ŋ́. N géē da uwá kéē kpó ābɔ̄ ā gwó bónū, ohígbū ka ābɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ákú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē tá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ tá tū usiléeti kú aflɛ́yí piíí nɛ̄ ɔ́ je ca tū ɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ tá ipú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛlā nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla awɔ ka ā, mɛ́mla okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce ā, Óndú ā wɛ ijáalí kú ami mɛ́mla awɔ á.

eng_Latn: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi nōo húmáyī hóóyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa yɔ̄ ipú ɛwa ā. Ó kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī agbénú nōó lɛ ā í kpó ŋmó lɛ aólobócí kpɛ́mm, amáŋ odóódu kú uwā í hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā n le tá ajɛ kú Usiríya mla Usilísīya.

eng_Latn: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā gekwú, íne ā í nā um tɔ́ɔwɛ glá gɛ ŋ́, íne ā yá um lɛ ā á, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yēeyī ká n̄ yúklɔ́ lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka n gekwú mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú ɔdēelihɔ nēe bá ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dōōbɔ́bí nɛ̄hi yá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ajɛ ā ú tēelihɔ á. Amáŋ aá híī yá aɔ́dā nēe yá ā ŋ́. Odúúdú aá, ó kōō wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ámāŋ aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú aá, géē lɛ aíne kú ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tū piíí.

eng_Latn: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāanɛ kú ɔyā ɛnɛ kú ipú iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ Usedekíya ce ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔkpɛtá nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó. Ɔkpɛtā ŋmó gbóógbó, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda gē lé gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
idu_Latn: Ɛcí éyi, Ɛláyíssa le tá Ussúnɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔnyā olɔdu éyi lā ā. Ɔnyā a le ɔ́ hīgwú kɔ́ɔ̄ wā í le ɔdōlé lé ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, eko dúú nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa le tá Ussúnɛm, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ó gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́, ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gáā kpó aéwo nɛ̄ bá iyɔ̄bū uwā yíífi abɔ̄ é géē yɔ̄ ī yɛ gɔbū ā ā.

eng_Latn: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nōo bá nya wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ayí kú Ulífāyi ɔhá nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipú inu kú ɔlɛ́ ádáádā uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hīyē nēe bá ā wɛ ayí kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ádáádā uwā, nēe gbagbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
idu_Latn: Aópeyī géē mɛ́ɛbɛ, aódahɔ̄ kē í páhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ɛkwɛ bɛ̄ɛka aómlede ā, aɛ́fu nɛ̄ncɛ́ ā kē hɛ́ɛkwɛ bɛ̄ɛka ayí álá ā.

eng_Latn: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ayīnu kwá akpókónu ká, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá je ōwē kú aá bɛ̄ɛka italā nɛ̄ ádā gē yá ɔyí nū ā. Ōwē nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī má ā gē mafú ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá aá ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Ó lɛ ɔyí dúú nōo yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ádā nū í yá ɔ̄ italā jéjéee ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
idu_Latn: A lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé lɛ ɔ́ yágbe nɛ̄ ɛcí nōo lɔfú jé ágbe kú nū í yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ágbe ā í kē gáā jé gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɔ̄kā kú ífi kú uwɔ ā, gwéeyē klla tɔ́ɔga nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ka ucē kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, í cē ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ohɔ́nyɛtá kú um, n gē jikwū tū uwɔ eko dóódu, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
idu_Latn: Ubesáyi, Uméyúnim, Uméfūsésim.

eng_Latn: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipū gē yá ā, yɔ̄ ī gɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ɔwɛ dóódu. Ó jɛ́ɛ́yí ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ kú nū ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ́bíipú ā yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́nwū klla ī cɛ̄nwū lɛ aólɛlā kú nū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔtū nēé bīya aá anú ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ā gē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō le pīya ga ɛgiyí nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ nyatá. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē ī híjémā kú ɔtūnōbí ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔtūnōbí nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n tá ā jé, aá géē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɔtū lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná, eko nēé bá ajɛ kú aólɛlā kú uwā kpɔ́, ń gáā cīgbīhi kwu uwá dúúdú ámāŋ je uwá yíifi dúúdú ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā géē je ɛka nɛ̄ n ce lɛ aá ā kpó bīya. Ami kē wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ocíbú kú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó, nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ opɛ́ úgbéenyi mɛ́mla ákú óndú úgbéenyi ka ā le nū otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā ipú, anɔ́ɔ ó leyī gwū ɛlā kú Upɔ́lu tá.
