eng_Latn: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, N géē wā ipú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n kɛpɔ̄ tū aá. N géē cɛ̄ ijáalí tū ācoyíimabɔ̄, ācɛ ogbaajā, ācɛ ocīijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū ācɛ ɔhá, ācɛ nēe gē hɛ́ ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ lɛ uwá lé ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē pīya anyōkwū mɛ́mla ayókwū tū ā. Mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá aúgbɔga ɔdōbɔ̄bí, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēé lɛ ojīlīmā ce um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe jééyī kú úklɔ́ ímlɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā gwó. É yá ɔ̄ ŋmá ohí kú īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó nēé wu tɔ̄há mla owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā, klla lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄ mla ifotó kú Ucérūbim.

eng_Latn: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Inu nōo ce inu kú ɛháajɛ ā icɔ̄ ā, ípú inu bá odúúdú īkpō kú inu a dúúdú.

eng_Latn: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
idu_Latn: Ujelemiya ka, N pīyeyī má ɛcɛ, ó le ŋmíkpākplā klla tá alácɛ̄. N klla má ɔkpáncō, ó kē le dobū.

eng_Latn: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si gekwú klla le héyī kpɔ́ ā, alɔ klla kē cɛ̄ dúú ka eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si í kwúcē wā kpɔ́ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē kpɔ́ ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ā wā mla anú.

eng_Latn: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ́ ú tá agbá kú ɛháajɛ kú inu ā. Ó tá agbá abɔ́ɔ gbojī ajɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛtɛ́ dúúmā ī ma lɔhi ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ā kwú ɔ́ ú ca, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔmɛ kú nū í ma ɛtɛ́ ɔhá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
idu_Latn: Ó géē fīyɛ̄ aá kpɔ̄kpɔ̄kpɔ̄ igbalɛwa, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu. Unwalu ā géē yɔ̄ ī yá aá kwu otú kwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Olɛhɔ̄ nōo géē ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā géē wɛ ɔdōōtūufi nɛ̄hi lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
idu_Latn: N géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ícɔ̄nū kú um géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ō cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o í kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu yitāajɛ ā. Ó géē yi jāā ga ɛháajɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ, gaá kwú ɛgba kú ɛfu dóódu í yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
idu_Latn: É gē leyīkwu ajɛ kú ācɛ ɔhá cíí, é mīyɛ abɔ̄fú. Eko nɛ̄ inu kú ācɛ he uwá ɔtū á nɛɛ, é mīyɛ uwá abɔ̄fú. Agbénú kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tá cíí lɛ ɔwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu gekwú acígilí ɛgiyí nū, nɛ̄ó cɛ̄ lɛ iyē otīihɔ kú nū ā kwú tēelihɔ, ó géē gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ó í je yá yēŋēē ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó géē plla ɛyi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu bī ákánjɔ̄ kú ɛtɛ́, cīce ipú ewo yɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ wā īyī nū iyē.

eng_Latn: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
idu_Latn: Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Unátan, Umíbiha, ɔyí kú Uhágri.

eng_Latn: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé olicɛ́cɛ́ ŋ́. Ó gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́, amáŋ, ó lɛ āpīicɛ ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ yíihɔtū tá Óndú ā nɛ̄ alɔ klla cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, ó géē je íne kú nū nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā yá alɔ ɛhi. Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ kē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, ó géē gbō alɔ ŋmá unwalu.

eng_Latn: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
idu_Latn: É géē kwú piíí bɛ̄ɛka álá ā, ikwū kē í gbō uwā nyɔ̄ únóji bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogāálá ī gbō álá ā. Únóji nēé géē nyɔ̄ bōōbū á. É géē je wā tāajɛ ipú únóji nōo je pīya ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nēé lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ īlī kú nū kpó híla ŋmá iyē kóō mafú ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā ā kwú ɔ̄ iyē lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú īlī ekwu ú kpó wiyē, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
idu_Latn: N géē na ɛ́yá kú ofítɛ̄ daa í kwú ɔ́. N géē je ɔ́ ga Ubábīlɔn nyɔ̄ í je ōwē lɛ ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ, ohígbū ɛyí nɛ̄ ó le tá ajɛ ga um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lɔtūce aótrɛ̄yí kú alɛɛcɛ, nēé tá aá abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aínyankwūlūmī ā le éŋkpɔ̄ gwá kwɛyí ā, ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú eliká kú ugóolu , nōo gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā ú wu ɔ́ ɛnwū. Ó klla kwú oje otābɔ̄ ɛpa kú ugóolu , nōo gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā í tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó gē je aógbló kú ɔcí ā tá iyɔ̄bū kú aɛ́nɛ̄ é lɔfū ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Eko kpií Ulában lɛ odúúdú ɔdāajɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mā mɛ́ɛ̄ á, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kē lɛ aɛ́nɛ̄ e lɔfú āa.

eng_Latn: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usíba da Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ, anúɔ géē yá. Anɔ́ɔ Umefíbōssɛ̄ti gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka éyi kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ébram kahíníī, Le jé ka ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē wɛ ugbɔga ajɛ kú éwɔhá. É géē wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ abɔ́ɔ, é géē lɛ ikpō da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ iháyí úlā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu má ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í yá lɔhi gɔbú nɛ̄hi ā, ó klla yúufi nū fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ā lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́, í lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Alelékwū nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā wā ŋmá ɛgiyí olɛlā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Aá pó koó géē wā, anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā ó kē yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ ā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē gbō uwɔ, eko nāa gē ga ɛcɛ mɛ́mla eko nāa gē wā ɔlɛ́, ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā kwu eko nōó gē mɛ ŋ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwíijē, ayí kú Ulífāyi dúú ā wɛ, Ɛlíyāssibu. Ipú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, é wɛ, Ussálum, Utélem mɛ́mla Úri.

eng_Latn: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ nēé cē tá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ɔ́ɔmā ā, é géē hɛ́ ajɛ tá lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá ipú ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū ā, nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā, ɔwá kú nū kē ī wɛ ukilómīta igwó.

eng_Latn: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ keé bī iyē kú um lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, n géē hɔ́hā ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɔfú fíyɛ́ Usamérīya nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ́ kú uwā glá ŋ́. Ɔfú lígíí nɛ̄ Usamérīya lɛ ā kē wɛ ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū, Upéka. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá í cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um dúúdú glá ŋ́, ń gáā gbō aá ŋmá ífi nōo ī wā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ukálɛ̄bu da ācɛ ā nēe gbɔɔ́ ō ka iŋini tú Umósīsi ā kéē lɛ okónu klá cíí, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, Ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ajɛ ā bōōbū, ohígbū ka alɔ lɔfú nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ajɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
idu_Latn: Alɔ abɔ̄ alɔ kē wɛ ijáalí kú ɔdā nēe bá nyā. Alelékwū Ihɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū ā ke wɛ ijáalí dúú.

eng_Latn: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa gē je ɔdā lɛ aógbɛhá, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka a yɔ̄ ī lɛ odée kplá Óndú ā nɛ. Óndú ā gē cílá awɔ ulé nū igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cī usábāti kú um ā tū, aá klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, n-oo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō yá ɛcɛ ā, ó lɛ alɔ fu kú ālɔ̄ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ohígbū ka alɔ le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ le yēŋēē, kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛnyá dúú iyɔ̄bū nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, ó gā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gaá lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō. Ó klla le ɛlā ka ohígbū ɔyí obene ā lɛ odúúdu ācɛ nēe bá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm nyatá ā.

eng_Latn: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, aá géē jīla kú aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Aá gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē lé ā ōfōōfūnū ā nɛ̄ aá géē yá á.

eng_Latn: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ocɔkpɛ́nú kú ɔdɔ kú eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mīya. Ó wɛ umíta ɛtá. É lɛ aínu lígílígí nɛ̄ ɔwá kú uwá wɛ umíta ɛpa ā gwó kwu ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā biílí.

eng_Latn: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam ga Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn nēe lɛ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā, úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛpa cigwó hīgwú kéē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú, kéē lɛ aípɔ́ɔma igwó kú ɛhícō ā kwúcē wā ɛháajɛ íkwu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ bī íkwu nɛ̄hi nōo fíyɛ́ íkwu kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo lɔfú gbāājɛ ɔkpáncō glá ā gē le gbāājɛ. Iyē nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá lé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi kú nū ā nwuné nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɛdɔ kú iyē ɔhá dóódu nōo yɔ̄ abālɔbányā ámāŋ ka eko ɔhá kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔyípōklobīya nōo gē bī iyɔ́fú kú nū ā káɔ̄ lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú pi kɔ́ ɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aólufíyé, opɛ̄cí kú Ufilístiya ā kéē híī wā í yá anúɔ ɛbɛ́ klla hólígbō ce anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́, kéē ŋmó anúɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ o bī iyɔ́fú kú kú nū ā í lɔtū yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ka ā glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ó gē yúufi nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū pi kwu ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó má gwōnū klá anú le iyī nū ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é jāhɔ̄ gā um, eko nɛ̄ n gē kɛlā lɛ uwá ā ŋ́ mā, ń ke jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá eko nēé gbā um ɛ̄gbā klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ā gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá kú ɔgwā iháyí ɔhá ā, Ubenhádādi le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tútū, anɔ́ɔ é yɛ lɛyíkwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Áfēki gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ ɛpa tīīkpó glá, ɔ́dāŋ ka é tɛtɛ lɛ ɛga nēé í jīla ā miya gbɔbú ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ kú igelī ā, nɛ̄ īkpō kú odúúdú nū wɛ umíta úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa cigwó ā . Aókómpinu ɛtá í bá abɔ́ɔ. É géē lé iyē ka, okómpinu kú Usímīyɔn, okómpinu kú Usáka, mɛ́mla okómpinu kú Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ā? Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē gbɛlá kwu ɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
idu_Latn: Ugílɛ̄di wɛ ákú um, Umanásɛ wɛ ákú um. Ɛfrēm lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpú ō kwɛyí kpɛ́fú kú um ā. Ujúda lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú um á.

eng_Latn: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubésāyi wɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ɛtá .

eng_Latn: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
idu_Latn: Ményinyi um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yéeyī, ohígbū ka íne kú uwɔ ā, wɛ ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɛ̄cī ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá kpɔ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gáā je yá yēŋēē ŋmá oyī nōo ŋmá ɔ̄ iyē ā á. Ó gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdā ōtīihɔ dúúmā ŋ́, ámāŋ ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko nēe ī gwu ɔ́ iyē ā le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwēyī kpó tū uwá ɛyí, ká ā yá kéē lɔfú kú uwɔ jé.

eng_Latn: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um yíihɔtū tá um eko dóódu. Ó kē ī wā ɛgiyí um. Ó kē ī yá ká n̄ má ɔ̄ eko nōó ī yá aólɛlā kú um lé ā.

eng_Latn: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēé cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā dóódu, ɔcɛ́ ā géē bī ayí álá ɛhīlī mɛ́mla omlede éyi, nēé lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā, wā í gwɛ́ɛya ōyɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwā yɛ ga Árōwɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ okónogwu kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ánɔn ā mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔpɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ o plákátá kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Umedéba.

eng_Latn: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā a le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ā mafú gā um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka a tá ō je um ŋmó, nááná nɛ̄ Óndú ā kē kwú um ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yá ká ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm kéē móōwē kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujótam ɔyí kú Ugídīyɔn da uwá eko nōó tá okónu lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
idu_Latn: Aá háyi ká aá gbɛlá ɛ́ɛ́. Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō yá ɔma lɛ ɔyí ma bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā ā glá āa? Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n gē má odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ le abɔ̄ kwú ipú bī, le kɔ́ kɛnɛbɛɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ikpēyī kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ pīya ɔnɔwá gɔɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
idu_Latn: Óbɛ́di, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā nōo lā Usamérīya ā, jīla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔwɛ, abɔ́ɔ é bá ī wā ɔlɛ́ mla aálagbá kú ācɛ Ujúda nēe kpó kwú ŋmá Ujúda ā. Abɔ̄ é gáā bēé ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá le cɔ̄nū mla Ujúda, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó cɛ̄ lɛ aá lɛ uwá yálé. Amáŋ Óndú ā kē pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bī íwɔ́tū le ŋmó ācɛ alɛwa kú uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le okónu ce klla lɛ ɛka gbo lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ka alɔ géē kpó anyā éwɔhá nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ayí wā nū ga ɔlɛ́ uwá. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe gē pó ɛlā kú Óndú ā, klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā, da alɔ ka alɔ yá, alɔ géē yá ɔ́. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ka ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, alɔ géē yá ɔ̄, klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
idu_Latn: N gwéeyē nwunééné eko nɛ̄ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ōhī wā gaá da um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ a kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a kē yēeyī ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí géē mīyɛ ulé kú odōōbɔ̄bí nōó yá ā. Ɔwɔicō í kē ī má eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́. Ā híī túblla ācɛ dúúmā nēe ī yīkpɛ̄yí ɔlɔfú tá uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Íma wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlkána kwú cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ nū Uráma á. Amáŋ ɔyí nu Usámūwɛ̄lu ā má klá Ussílo abɔ́ɔ pī Ɛ́lāyi ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Aá cíkā ō yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋmó ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē pīya aógbɛhá tū ŋ́. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
idu_Latn: Ígwu ɔhá kú ācɛ nēe gē tá ahínyá ā, yɛ lɛyíkwu abɔ̄lúfīyē kú ɔdɔ ā. N yɛce ígwu éyi kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Alɔ yɛ gaá bū ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda kú útuló ɛgiyí ɔdɔ nēé hī ka ɔdɔ ō cɔkpɛ́nú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kóō je yá tīihɔ kú ede nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu bī wā ɛ̄cī nēé géē je ede ā tīihɔ ā. Ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa, ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa. Ocíbú kú ugóolu igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
idu_Latn: Aá géē má um. N géē je olɔhi kú aá cīgbīhi lɛ aá. N kē í kpo aá cīgbīhi ŋmá odúúdú aéwo nɛ̄ um cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kpó aá nyɔ̄ ā. N géē kpó aá cīgbīhi wā ɛga nɛ̄ n kpó aá ŋmá ā. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ɔfú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asírīya lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú aá ā kóō má kwɛjī.

eng_Latn: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
idu_Latn: Umérɛ̄mɔtu ɔyí kú Uríya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhákosi ma ɔdɔ kú nū gboce uwá á. Umɛssúlam, ɔyí kú Ubérekíya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umɛssɛ́sābɛlu ma ɔdɔ kú nū gboce Umérēmɔtu á. Usádɔ̄ku, ɔyí kú Ubaána klla ma āyā nōo gboce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umerí háyi eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú únóji ā yɔ̄ ī jikwū. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē jikwū ā, ó feyī kpeé ga ipú únóji ā.

eng_Latn: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē pi aá abɔ̄fú kú aá lɛ apī hɛ́ ā, wɛ ācɛ nēe gē bī ɔkpíyē kú uwā gwō ā, kéē híī yá uwā ŋmó ohígbū keé gē tɔ́ɔna kú ikwū kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēé nyɔ́kpá playi ɔcí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
idu_Latn: Ífíífi nɛ̄ n géē je Ujerúsālɛm yá ā. Amáŋ ɛ̄nyā í gáā yá ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n fu ká ō je ōwē lɛ igelī ā gā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je igelī ā lɛ ɔ́, ka ó je ɔɔ́ yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya mīyɛ ɔkpá ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ jé á. Ó le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gaá kwú ɔkpá ā í nwūla ce ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā kóō mɔ́ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aúgbéenyī nɛ̄hi nēé ī le tɔ́ɔ́sú kú Utássissi, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e héyīfuú ā ca tū enyi ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
idu_Latn: N klla kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, olɛlā ā kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú nū bá ī wā wuuu bɛ̄ɛka ojujā ā. Aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú kú uwā bá gē wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka ofúlutu nɛ̄hi ā. Aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā kwinya fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígbáanɔ okpé gē wu á. Alɔ gebí ɛɛ́, ákú alɔ mɛ ɛ́ɛ́!.

eng_Latn: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū ŋmá Utáya, amáŋ ó tɛtɛ wɛ ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ nɛ̄hi dúú. Ɛ́nɛ́ kú Uhúram ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli. Uhúram jē úklábɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó cīgwú nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn hī ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá mīyɛ úklábɔ̄ kú oje udɔ o yá tū ɔlɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ ikwú o da aá kú aá tá alɔ abɔ̄, amáŋ alɔ í yá lɛ ā ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā alɔ lɛyí báajɛ yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá géē yɛce glá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
idu_Latn: Lɛ anwa kú Úrim mɛ́mla Utúmmin kpó tū ipú ɛkpa o bɔ́ɔ́tū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ Árɔ̄ni géē bī uwā eko nɛ̄ ó ī wā ɛgiyí um. Eko ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ó í lɛ ɛkpa īlī o bɔ́ɔ́tū nyā wiiyē ojigógó, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé olekwu kú um lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
idu_Latn: A tá alɔ piyóó nɛɛ? Ɔnū kú uwɔ í lɛ ɛjī ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɛhi nɛ̄hi kú nū nōó je lɛ alɔ icííci, ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka.

eng_Latn: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū ɔ́ɔmā gē nwū alɔ ká ālɔ̄ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá oyēeyī obɔ̄bí ō lā mɛ́mla únwū obɔ̄bí kú ɛcɛ nyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lā oyēeyī nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú cē iyī alɔ bī glá, oyēeyī okpakpa. O yɔ̄ gē lā bɛ̄ɛka ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ā ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛcá cá alelékwū ihɔ, é gáā je íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ɔ́ɔmā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ŋ́, ohígbū ka ínoōbīya nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í gē je yɛ́ɛhi ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ ó bīya á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú. Kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ, aótrɛ̄yí, aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka anúɔ le hīla nɛ́hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī kú Ɔwɔicō nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɔlékwū á. Á lɔfú nɛ̄ a ī jɛ́yí nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le íne nyā je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ayí kú ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ayí nū nɔ̄nyā mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú ayí nū, nōo wɛ odúúdú aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ nū nōó kpó wā Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
idu_Latn: É kwú īkpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ nēé hɛ́ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ā ú kpó lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
idu_Latn: É géē pīya īlī odufā ā klá ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ āa mɛ́mla agege kú nū ā, mla alápā ō bī je ahɔ̄lá mɛ́mla aóflēnjē mɛ́mla oli kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu.

eng_Latn: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɛcɔ̄ ū mīya gwū okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ōhɛ́pɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé ī bī ī le abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá ā kú uwá gbo okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdā dúúmā kóō híī pīyabɔ̄ ohígbū Udánīyɛlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá gē gbō aókóome ā le kwu nyɔ̄ ga ipú igelī gaá lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā dóódu nōo yá ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é hɛ́ ācɛ nēe lɛ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā tá ā kā.

eng_Latn: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu ā gaá bū ipú ígbíli obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ uwá ɛ́ɛ móōwē ɔwɛ ā, ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Ámɔ̄ri. Ó klla ka aá gā Ukɛ̄díss Ubánéya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je ɔ́da lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádɔ̄lɛ́, nōo bɛ̄cɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli gaá dɔɔ̄kā ācɛ nōó géē ce ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú nū lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe gē gwíijē, Ásāfu, Uhɛ́mān, mɛ́mla Ujɛdútɔn, ayí uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́máapu uwā lɛ úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ kpó wiyē kpɛ́mm, anɔ́ɔ é bī aɔ́dā ō bī gwííjē kú uwá dóódu ā, anɔ́ɔ é háyi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ede ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ofu ɛhīlī nēe bá yɔ̄ ī tá opo klla í tá ɛ́mula ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛ aíne ā gbō bá ácábɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla údɔ̄bū kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yɔ̄ ī blakwu aíne ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú um ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ɛɛ́. Ó kwú um ú lɛ uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́fla, Óbɛ́di.

eng_Latn: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām mɛ́mla Usára le kpó hīla nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́. Usára í kē má onyílá kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cōbɔ̄bíipú ā gē tū ujɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi klla ī má ɔ̄ ɔkɔnyɔ̄ obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn gekwú anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Uréhobōwam lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
idu_Latn: Aéwo ā géē tútū piíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wā ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɛhósāfati, abɔ́ɔ ā, ami Óndú ā géē cīce kú n kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú éwo nēe yɛ jīla aá tá ā.

eng_Latn: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū gaá le ɛdɔ ɔ̄kā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā da kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ohi ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā tá ɔ̄ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄ ā da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī lɛ uwíndo kú ɔkpáncō nwūla nááná, ɔdā nāa ka nyā í yá glá ŋ́ Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, A géē bī īkpēyī abɔ̄yī uwɔ má ɔ̄, amáŋ á gáā lé ɔdā dúú kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī ka olɔhi kú alɔ, ācɛ ōhī kē ka obɔ̄bí kú alɔ. Ācɛ ōhī ca alɔ ɛcá, ācɛ ōhī kē cɛ̄tra alɔ. Ācɛ ka ka alɔ wɛ ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄, amáŋ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ alɔ gē ka á.

eng_Latn: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
idu_Latn: Ń tá ɛ̄nyā fu aá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú uwēyī kóō lɛ aá kwú ŋ́, amáŋ n tíne ō nwū aá ɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ayí um ā.

eng_Latn: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
idu_Latn: Aá jikwū ká aá tɛ̄gíkwū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā, aá nɛ̄ wɛ aɔ́cí nēé hī ka usáyíprɛ̄si ā, ohígbū ɔcí nēé hī ka óoku kú Ubásan ā. É le ūpū nōo dobū nɛ̄hi ā hɛ́ wā ajɛ ícɛ ɛɛ́. Aɔ́cí nēe tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā kwú kpó yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
idu_Latn: Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ɛtá. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Umayikɛ́ya, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Úríyelu nōo ŋmá Ugíbeya ā. Ɛfú le tū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ábīja mɛ́mla Ujérobōwam.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó géē kpó ācobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin ā ú lɛ aólufa ɔhā nēe géē je īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū lɛ ɔ́ eko nōo cíkā.

eng_Latn: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ inu ɛga okpíyó tū gwó kwu ɛgiyí Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ okóohō ā pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Unówa ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, le ēpū ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólifu ā kwu ɔkɔ́ á. Unówa le jé ka éŋkpɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ le ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Ujehósāfati nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ó yɛce ɔwɛ kú ádā nū, Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. Ó pā ɛcí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda gē yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé, bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē lɛ ikpó da aólɛlā kú uwā ɛyí tū ɔ́tɔ̄ ipú úláyi ā. É géē kpɛ́fú ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla uwá. É klla géē yá ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya alɛwa kú aólɛlā kú uwā ā lé.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
idu_Latn: Alɔ hī ācɛ nēe lɔtūlé ipú ōwē ō má ā ka ācɛ nɛ̄ ákú uwā lɔhi. Aá kē pó ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóbu lɔtūlé lɛ ā. Aá kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ, klla kē ī méyinyinyi ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ alɔ í tíne ká ācɛ nēe bá ā kéē cɔ̄nū ŋ́ mā ā, ga okónu ísu ā. ká ā gaá lɛ uwɔ tá. Ɛbéenyi nɛ̄ a í kwú aflɛ́yí ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Eko nɛ̄ a lɛ okónu kú nū nwūla, a géē má īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi. Kwú ɔ́ɔmā ú kú ā lɛ ijɔɔlɛ́ kú alɔ gbā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka odúúdú alɔ nēé yá alɔ ubatísim wā ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, eko nēé yá alɔ ubatísim ɔ́ɔmā ā, alɔ gekwú ɔwɛ ékpó bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ā klla yɛ bɛ̄cɛ gɔbū ga ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛhícō kú Ɛ́krɔn. Ó klla leyī pīya ga Usíkɛ̄rɔn, le yɛ gla ɛfu kú Ubáala. Ó le yɛ bɛ̄cɛ ga Ujaminíya, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá ŋmɛ́yí ísu kú Umeditarénīya á.

eng_Latn: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
idu_Latn: N má ɔda éyi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka akpa kú ɔcɛ́ nēé bī ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi le yá ɔ́ ā ce icō kú odée yɔɔlɔ ɔ́ɔmā. Ɔdā nōo cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ulída í ligbó lɛ Ujɔ́pa ŋ́ mā, eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā le pó ka Upíta ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā. É le ācɛ ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́, kéē le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ kɔ́ɔ̄ wā fíya fíya.

eng_Latn: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi ú, mɛ́mla omlede éyi, aómlede ahāapa kú iháyí nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū í he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ukpo pi yɛ jīla ɛfu ā tá, nɛ̄ ācɛ dóódu í gáā gla anú gɔbū gaá lɛ ikpó bá ɛyí ɛfu ā glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ikpó bá ɛfu ā géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
idu_Latn: Umálūci, Uhárim mɛ́mla Ubaána.

eng_Latn: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ācɛ nēe gē yí īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, klla gē yá ucē ɔ́bíipú ā, ŋmá ipú aá. N géē kpó uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ aéwɔhá, ɛga nēé lā abālɔbányā ā. Amáŋ n gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwúcē wā ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kɛlā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu, ká ā da uwá ka, ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N gē je aúnóji kú aá kpó nwūla. N géē kpó aá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú aúnóji ā, klla í kpó aá kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ aá, ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā yɔ̄ ī wā ā, alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɔ́ tá fíyaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ajikpáakpáa gbɔɔ́ ō je ɔ́ á. Ujísɔ̄si le ɛgba dɛ̄ ta alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iye kú ɔyí ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyí ā hɛ́tá á. Ó kwú ɔyí ā ú kwúcē lɛ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ń gaá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá kpó yíífi ŋ́. Ɔcí kú ufáyin kú aá géē gwá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, n géē je ɔyí ga uwɔ ŋmá iyē kú Usára. N géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́, ó kē ī je pīya ɛ́nɛ́ kú aéwo. Ayááyí nū ōhī géē wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo.

eng_Latn: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú, klla gē tá iyī nū wāajɛ, Óndú ā gé gbō ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋmá unwalu dóódu.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Udíyūwɛlu leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugád á.

eng_Latn: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Áhābu da Unábɔ̄tu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū ā ú lɛ anúɔ ká anúɔ lɛ ɛ́hɔ̄ kú ēpū hí ipú nū, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ kwu ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ajaajɛ. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū, anúɔ géē cíla ije nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya le íne bīya nōo yá kéē lɛ ācɛ ā ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí á nɛɛ, ó géē bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna, nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nōó bīya ā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ussímēyi ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ igwɛ́ɛhīlī mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɛhīlī, amáŋ ayínɛ́ nū ɔhá ā í ma ayí lɛwa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ípɔ́ɔmā kú uwā gē nyīla lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ákú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka aéwo nɛ̄ nwuné klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, Óndú ā lɛ uwá kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā ɛɛ́. Ka odúúmā kú uwā í lɔfú háyi iyɔ̄bū uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kóō he aá cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá jīije kú éeyē eko nēé lɛ aɔ́dā nēé bá abɔ́ɔ ā yá aá, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ulé nɛ̄hi tū ɔkpáncō gbēyī aá. Aá bla ka aádáádā uwā yá aɔ́dā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā tá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
idu_Latn: É bī owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔwā lɛ hijā kú īkpō ɔcí kú upomégránēeti tū okónōgwu kú nū.

eng_Latn: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ipí ā, ɔ́dāŋ koó nyīla ga ɛgɔhá ŋ́, nōó kē gbɔɔ̄gɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka k ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē. Ó géē na īlī kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
idu_Latn: Aá géē cɛ̄ mla um, ka ń wɛ iyó ɔwɛ dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī géē ka ka n bī ula gē le pīya aá tū.

eng_Latn: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá ipú ajɛ ā, nɛ̄ aá géē gbiyɔ̄lā nɛ̄ aá gáā yúúfi kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā otú ŋ́. N géē je aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí dóódu kú ajɛ ā kpó ŋmō. Aá kē gáā kpɛ́fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē lɛ awulú nyā wiiyē eko nɛ̄ó yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya. Eko nɛ̄ó géē wā iyɔ̄bū um, ɛga otīihɔ ā, mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ó géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā. Ācɛ géē bá ī pó uya kú áma nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ɔyínɛ́ Apólɔsi, n le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ lɔfúlɔfú ka anú mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ ohile kéē lɛ aha tá wā í le aá má. Amáŋ ó tútū ō wā ɔkwɔɔkwu nyā ŋ́. Ó géē wā í má aá eko dúú nōó lɛ ɛga má.

eng_Latn: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kwu ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ú ká ā le tá tū ɔ̄ ka, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda. Kwu ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ɔhá ú, ka á le tá tū ɔ̄ ka, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kwɔɔkwɛ̄yi, Ɔwɔicō lɔhi lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó kē lɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā mla ɔtū ékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á. Alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɛlá kwu alɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē lɛ ɛlá kwu aálá kú nū ā. Jāhɔ̄ ícɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ka ā.

eng_Latn: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú, gwu Usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa ā tá ŋ́. Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tá íne kú nū tū ɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi, ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛbu, eko nēé bá ī ŋmá Íjīpiti wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ɔ abɔ́ɔ, kwú bū ɔwɛ kú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, é klla kwú pīya bá ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā í lɛ ɔtūlé gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń gáā mā ō yíihɔtū tá Udéfīdi ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē tá ō yá okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi má lā abɔ́ɔ klla le iyē ɛ̄pɛ̄pɛ̄ ce ɔ́ ka igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó jīla anú tá ŋmá Umílo wā eyīpú á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú Óndú ā ú tá tónū, ka ɔ́ɔ géē bī ōwē, mɛ́mla unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya wā ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ā, gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú gblífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Túbla ede ā, ká ā lɛ ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú gwó cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwā bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi. Cɛ́ɛ́ a klla lɛ ɛya ɔhá gwó ká ā lɛ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya ā í kpó nyɔ̄, ígbɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wā ŋmá ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm. Īīī, n ka Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ mā gē wā ŋmá aɛ́fu kú Upáran ɔwɛ ajɛ Ɛ́dɔm ā. Ɛgahi kú nū klá odúúdú ɔkpáncō! Ācɛ dóódu kú ɛcɛ nyā bá gē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā gē yɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔbíipú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā gē yɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔbíipú ā. Aá gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ alelékwū nōo gē gbō aálelékwū nōo gē gbō ācɛ nēe tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ obɔ̄bí ā le um yɛ jīla tá, bɛ̄ɛka ígwu kú aéwo nēe lɛ ɛbɛ́ hɛ́tū gáā kwú ɔ̄ ā. É bá ī fā um ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a nɔ̄na igbɛpa gboce iyī uwā ā wɛ ka Ɔwɔicō le ɔdānyā miya táajɛ gbɔbū ɛɛ́, ó kē í má kóō le yá piíí ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nōó ligbó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ pi kéē híī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ eko dóódu nɛ̄ ó ī ka lɛ ā, ācɛ gē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá tɛ́ɛcɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the famine was sore in the land.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā kú ajɛ kú Ukénan le nwuné tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ a kwú ajɛ nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔdāajɛ mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nyā nɛ̄ a cokónū nū lɛ aádáádā uwá ā ú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that, after they had carried it about, the hand of the LORD was against the city with a very great destruction: and he smote the men of the city, both small and great, and they had emerods in their secret parts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ bī ga abɔ́ɔ ā, Óndú ā gbɔɔ́ ō yá ācɛ kú Ugáti italā nɛ̄hi nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kwú hútú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ōcē kú apú wā í klla odúúdú ācɛ Ugáti, kwu ayípɛ̄ kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ.

eng_Latn: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le abɔ̄ hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ tū okónu gē gwá bɛ̄ɛka ewō ā á. Ācɛ ohile ɔhá dúú ā lɛ okwúukwu hɛ́ tū ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gwá éŋkpɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
idu_Latn: Ádā uwā, Ɛ́frem ā yɔ́tūnōbí kú uwā ɛ̄cī alɛwa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ uwā tá ádā uwá ɔtū lé á.

eng_Latn: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
idu_Latn: Acá kú ucérūbim ā klá Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla aógbló nēé le bī ɔ wā ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá je lɛ Usísa ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Usísa, aá je lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō. Ohi nōo tá nyā le hɛ uwā idáagó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú um ú tá ga ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ísu ā kóō mā oō tá úgbagwú, ohígbū ka n jé ka ohígbū um nɛ̄ owu ā yɔ̄ ī tá ísu úgbagwú á.

eng_Latn: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú uwā le kpó nyīla, ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā le nyīla klla kwú nwuné.

eng_Latn: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, O ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī í kwu ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ n le abɔ̄ kú um nāńdaa ká n̄ mīyɛ ācɛ nēe ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tū um klla ī bɛ́yíkwu um ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó da Umósīsi eko ɔ́ɔmā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ijē éyi tá tāajɛ. Ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nwū uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ géē wɛ ijáalí kú anúɔ mɛ́mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ícɛ gɔbū ā, ācɛ kú Ulífāyi géē leyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú nū mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Íne nyā géē yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdu ipɔ́ɔma kú aá. Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā í kē gáā lɛ agbénú kú abɔ̄yī uwā ipú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ jé ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nyā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī nɛ̄ iyī uwā lɛ ɛcí o pá jé jāā kwu abālɔbányā ā, ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛ ɛdɔ ɔdōlé ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lé, é gē gbɛlá kpɔ́ koó wɛ ɔdōlé nōo wɛ ákú ɛcí kpɔ́. Ɔtū kú uwā í lɔfú ŋ́ cɛ́ɛ́ eko nēé lɛ ɛbɛ́ nēé le ŋmó lɛ ɛcí lé nɛɛ, é gē gbɛlá ka aá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ opɛ̄cí ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É klla tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíihɔ keé géē tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ācɛ kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēe ī bīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō í je yá uwā ɛhi. É géē tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ nyā aflɛ́yí ipú Ujerúsālɛm cɛ́ɛ́ é í tɔ́ɔna lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā jīla bɛ́yí kwu Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ā, é le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é má ɛgahi kú Óndú ā le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ipú ojuja ā klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsɔ̄lɔm le kwu ga Ugéssɔ, ó kē klá abɔ́ɔ iháyí ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, géē bī ɔ̄ le gwɛ́ɛya nōo géē gwu ɔ́ iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kwú íne nōó bīya ā ú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ébrahām le Usára, ɔnyā nū nyi ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú ajɛ kú Umakipéla, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umámre, ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
idu_Latn: A le ajɛ ā jīliyē, klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú hɛ́ wulu kwú okónu ú tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ɛɛ́. Lɛ ɛga nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ hegwū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō je catāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
idu_Latn: Uwá wɛ ācɛ nēe tá um ɔtū kwu ɔtū nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū ā. Aá lɛ ojīlīmā nōo cíkā ā ce ɛdɔ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le lɔfú fíyɛ́ alɔ abɔ̄ nōo tōō tūblá ɔ́ ŋ́ mā. Ó lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ó kē ī yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔdā nōo cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
idu_Latn: Unebusárādan lɛ uwá kpó gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn nōo klá Uríbla.

eng_Latn: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō húmáyī wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aá gē tayínū á. Abɔ̄ kú anú nōó gē kwú ŋ́ mā kóō bī aá háyi piyóó. Ó géē nū aólɛlā kú aá tɛ́ɛcɛ hīla aá, abɔ̄ aá géē yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Ó klla ī da aá kahíníī, Aá lɛ uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe má um ā gē yá um okónu. É gē cē okónu tú um gbɛdɛɛ klla ī jílɛyí jigijigi.

eng_Latn: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ n yíihɔtū tú uwā, nɛ̄ n klla ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū uwā ā. Nááná, é lɛyí bū kwu um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le tēelihɔ nááná mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kē le yēŋēē, ɔ́ɔ lɔfú lé ɛbɛ́ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē lé ɛbɛ́ īkpɛ̄ɛnū ámāŋ ulúu ā.

eng_Latn: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ŋgbá kú ikwū le gbájí tū um. Únóji le ukpa kú nū kpla tá ajɛ gbēyī um.

eng_Latn: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ gē yɛ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé īkpō kú ufáyin kú nū ā glá, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā hɛ́ tū ɛkpa ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nɛ̄ a má ā wɛ igelī olɔfu nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú nū gē gbō aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá kú ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
idu_Latn: Ó kwúcē wā ɛgiyí ayínɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔyí ā í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́! Ɔdí nɛ̄ n gaá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
idu_Latn: Leyī kwɛcɛ lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā gē gbɛlá lɛ ā, ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ a gē gbɛlá nū ā gē mīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú uwɔ gē lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ń klla gáā ményinyi ācɛ kú Ujúda ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ami abɔ̄yī um géē yá kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ūwā kóō héyī kwu ɔ́mpa nū, klla í kpó ūwā tū aɔ́cɛ́ kú ūwā abɔ̄. Aɔ́cɛ́ nēe bá ā géē je ajɛ ā yíífi. Ń kē gáā nyā ācɛ ā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
idu_Latn: É le nyɔ́nyí klla le ligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́, amáŋ n géē gbɔɔ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mla ācɛ nōo hile ā. É géē je pīya éwo olɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ami Óndú ā kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn ŋmá abālɔbányā ga eko nōó gē mɛ ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó le ayí Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīmā kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ōhī fu, kéē wɛ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē bīyíne mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ kú ɔdā nōo le gbo áafú lɛ ācɛ nēe lā igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɔyínɛ́ aá ú dúú, kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
idu_Latn: Ami je ipú ígbíli mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ácí í gē bū ŋ́ mā lɛ uwá kóō wɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
idu_Latn: É lɔfú yēeyī nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í yá uwā ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ alɔ má uwā ā glá, amáŋ é géē kwú ga ɔlékwū eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ocɛ̄bí cɛ̄bi yá uwā kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gaajɛ ipú ojuja gaá le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ōhī kú alelékwū ú ŋmá ɛgiyí Umósīsi, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú uwā. Eko nɛ̄ó kwú Alelékwū ā ú tá ipú uwā ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā, amáŋ, é ka gɔ́bū fíyɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛyítáajɛ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī inu ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ ó lɛyítáajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nɛ̄ n, anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē kɛlā lɛyíkwu uwá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā é habɔ̄ ɛ́yá kú uwā tá ipú ɔ́kɔ, anɔ́ɔ é má tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile ɔhá ā nū ga ɔlɛ́, gāá hile ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū á. Amáŋ é mīyɛ odúúdú iyɛ́fú kú ācɛ ā, mɛ́mla opo kú uwā ā. Aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Umídiya yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú wā ɔpɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ofu yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, nɛ̄ n hímáyī yɔ̄ pī uwɔ, aálá kú uwɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú uwɔ í plla ɔyí ŋ́. Ń kē lé ɛbɛ́ omlede kú uwɔ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tá alɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ ā. Alɔ kē lɔtū kú alɔ kpóce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ oyólɔhi mɛ́mla okpaakpa gē lɛ ɛlá wu oyēeyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā ī lɔnɔɔtū lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
idu_Latn: Ipú aá ā, ācɛ ōhī bá ī cikpó ɔnyā kú ádā uwá, aōhī klla bá ī cikpó anyā nēe bá eko oōnyílá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
idu_Latn: É géē ka lɛyíkwu Usáyɔn ka, odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo ā, wɛ ācɛ Usáyɔn, Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ ā géē je ɔ́ yá lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, ó kwú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó bī uwā bēhé, ɛyí ajɛ íkpākplā bɛ̄ɛka ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī yá aɔ́dā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nyā abalɔbányā. É kē wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɔfú ka ka aá jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu uwá jééjé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā nɛɛ, aá géē yɛ í ka ka aá jé odée lɛyíkwu ɔ̄ tɛtɛ.

eng_Latn: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ kócōō lɛ eyī gwū ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúú nɛ̄ n yá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ a nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ŋmá odo kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Ami ā ń jé koó wɛ anú ŋ́ kpɔ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ká n̄ bī éŋkpɔ̄ yá ācɛ ubatísim ā, da um kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nāa géē má Alelékwū Ihɔ wā gaá ce ɔ́ ā, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē bī Alelékwū Ihɔ yá ācɛ ubatísim á.

eng_Latn: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
idu_Latn: É géē je aínu kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tū ɔlá, klla í yá uwɔ ōwē ipéēyī anyā alɛwa. N klla géē yá ka a yá akwuna ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē ci uwɔ o je ɛhi lɛ aɔ́ya uwɔ ká ē wā í gbo mla uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔkpíyē kú nū klla géē je pīya ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔyípɛ̄nɛ̄ncɛ́ ā. Ó klla géē je lɔfú iyē bɛ̄ɛka eko kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá bá ipú unwalu nɛ̄ aá hī um igwú ā, n le aá nyatá. N tá aá ohi ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ n gē tayínū ipú owu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla akpáabana ā. N jé aá má okónu ɔkpá kú Umɛ́rība.

eng_Latn: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipū géē yɔ̄ í leyī gla Ɔwɔicō, klla yɔ̄ ī gwō ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í gáā yá um italā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ugóolu ma plá iyēpú mɛ́mla iyɛ̄cɛ kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ oje ɔdɔ tíína tū ɔ̄ biílí.

eng_Latn: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
idu_Latn: Usádi, Ussútéla. Igbīhi Usútéla ā, Ɛ́frem klla ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá ā, Ésa mɛ́mla Ɛlídi nēé je kpó ŋmó eko nēé kpó aɛ́na kú ācɛ Ugáti uwī ā.

eng_Latn: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tóohi dúú glá gɛ ŋ́ má. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē lɔtū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā dúúmā ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce Usáyɔn, í kpó ɔdā dóódu nōo cɛgbá ā lɛ ɔ́ cabá cabá, n klla í je ɔdōlé lɛ aógbɛhá kú Usáyɔn kéē lé nū ipú.

eng_Latn: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā le ohi kú ɔkpá kú uwā ā tá gē lɛ uwá kahíníī, Uréhum igbómína kú Ujúda, Ussímssāyi, ɔmálɛ o tɔ́ɔ́kpá, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú uwā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ dóódu nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Usamérīya mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā, n hɛ́ okónu tū odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na mɛ́mla aíjakī nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛnū playi uwá ɔkɔ gē hɛ́hɔ̄ lɛ aá ā géē lé ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé lɛ ɔ́ tóowu ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si hī uwā igwú wā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ka aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá gē gbō uwā mla abɔ̄ olɔfú. Ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú uwā kē ī bī íkwu nēé lɛ ā yúklɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
idu_Latn: A yúklɔ́ idáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōōcābɔ̄ alɛwa nɛ̄hi Íjīpiti īkée. A kē yɔ̄ í yá lɛ ā Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla odúudu ɛcɛ ícɛ kpɔ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ lɛ uwɔ jé lɔɔlɔhí ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛnyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu géē ga ɛgiyí ācɛnyā kú Íjīpiti ɔ́mpa uwā, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā kú Íjīpiti dóódu nēé lā ɔlɛ́ uwā āa, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē ba uwá ugóolu , oje nɛhɛ́ mɛ́mla īlī. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a géē bī ɔdā nēe bá ā le yá ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā ifa. É klla í kpó agbénú kú Íjīpiti kpó nyɔ̄ mla iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔtū kú uwā ɔ́ɔ ī plla uwá. Ka é géē móōwē kú íne nɛ́ɛ bīya ā. Ó klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je ɔ́kpa kú ɛcɔ̄ kú ūwā nɛ́ɛ gē gbō ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɔ́ɔmā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, habɔ̄ um tá cíí. Ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla uwá, n kē í kpó uwā yíífi. Cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú awɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí uwɔ ú pīya éwo nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ijē ā yɔlá ɛyí ede ā. Amáŋ amɛ̄ ā géē wɛ ákú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ígbíli mɛ́mla ajɛ íkpākplā ā géē bū éŋkpɔ̄, í bū ɔcí mɛ́mla ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄. Ígbíli ā kē í bū ododó ɛbɛɛbɛ kpúmm.

eng_Latn: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yúúfi kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ŋ́. N jé ka aá ī yúúfi nū. Aá kóō le jé ka n géē yɔ̄ pī aá, í gbō aá, klla í nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtū kú uwā yá ékpónú lɛ ɔtū kpóce uwɔ ā tū ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
idu_Latn: N géē klá Ɛ́fēsɔsi amānyā jāā gbéeko kú Upɛ́ntīkɔsi.

eng_Latn: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ahasíya wɛ ocɛ̄ɛma kú Áhābu bū ɔwɛ kú ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ nū ā, ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Áhābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
idu_Latn: A cíkā ō kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā? Óndú nū ōfūnū lɔfú ka kóō yá lɔhi, amáŋ ka ó yá lɔhi ŋ́ má, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔfú í má kéē lɛ ɔdā olɔhi yá á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā da uwɔ kā tīkpó mɛ́mla anú abɔ̄fú ukilómīta éyi, yɛ mɛ́mla anú ukilómīta ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō lɛ ɔdā ō plahɔ̄ nēé kpó ā kpó gé lɛ anúɔ. Ācɛ kú Umídiya gē le ɔdōplahɔ̄ kú ugóólu pla ahɔ̄ ohígbū keé wɛ ācɛ Íssmɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ka ɛbɛ tɛ́ɛcɛ ká ā tɔ́ɔna kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ā. Tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā nyā gbōmgbōm ka, Ɛ̄cī otūufi nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī wā ɛɛ́!.

eng_Latn: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Umósīsi da uwá kéē bī wā ā, é le kpó wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le túbá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá le Ɛlíyākim nōo ī leyīkwu agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ussɛ́bina nōo wɛ ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄si ā. Odúúdú uwá lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiyē dúú.

eng_Latn: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú oje o pi áklɔ̄kpɛ kwu ajɛ ú bī abɔ̄ éyi, klla kwú omútāgā ú bī abɔ̄ ɔhá. Ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tū Usisɛ́ra ɛyí, le ɔ́ ákōklō-ɛyí ca, lɛ ɔ́ bū kwu ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔnyōkwū mɛ́mla ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔbá nū tá ɔ̄, nōó lɛ ɔyí ŋ́, nōo le cīgbīhi wā í lā ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, géē lé ɔdōlé otīihɔ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya gē miyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ipú oyēeyī áncā kú um nyā, n lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nyā má ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ o le kpaakpa nááná ā gē yíífi ipú ucē okpaakpa kú nū glá, ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā gē yēeyī ligbó ipú ɔbíipú kú nū glá.

eng_Latn: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ácɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ukénan, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Upɛ́risi, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi nēe lā ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ Uhám ɛháajɛ kú Uhɛ́mɔn ipú ajɛ kú Umíspa.

eng_Latn: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā le hɛ́ um idáagó! Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ eko kpií nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo yíihɔtū tá aá klla ményinyi aá lɛ aá hīgwú cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ oyēeyī nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā kɔ̄ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, nɛ̄ aa i ī nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ o lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí éyi le bēhé wā ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó dɛ̄gba ka.

eng_Latn: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upéka, ɔyí kú Uremálīya lɛ Áhāsi yálé klla le aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda nēe lɛ ɔtú nɛ̄hi ā, úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó ɛ̄cī ékpónú. Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ujúda kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usedekíya cāŋjɛ gaá lɛ ɛbɛ́ tū Umikáya ahɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ŋmífī nyā nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Óndú ā gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um gaá kɛlā ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
idu_Latn: Ujówɛ̄lu ā kpó ācɛ ofɛhīli cigwó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn wā.

eng_Latn: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi kú ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá ā ga ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē gáā hayi pīyēyī kwu ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō kú um ahínyá eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ogbagbénú kú aá gē hɛ́ aógbɛhá lé, odúúdú aá kpɛ́mm klla gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā le ukpa kpla tá ajɛ gā um, Amáŋ, ó ci um ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kwú ācɛ nēe bá ā ú tá uwā abɔ̄, nēé le uwá yálé, kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Ó da uwá kéē híī cokónu dúúmā mla uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē ményīnyi uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē á. Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛ́bɛ nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄ɔsi ā wā gaá má ɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tútū lɔhi lɔhi ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ gáā bū ōcē ā glá ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ géē kwú.

eng_Latn: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo kwu um ɔtū nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla eyīyōce kú um ā wɛ ka n̄ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá ā ojigógó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɔfú lɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi eko dóódu, ofíyɛ́ dúú abālɔbányā kú n̄ kɛlā nɛ̄ ń gáā yúúfi ɔ̄cɛ dúú ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ā, n géē yá kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ó kōō oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yá abɔ̄ n yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ámāŋ eko nɛ̄ n gekwú.

eng_Latn: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī éŋkpɔ̄ ō ocēenyi klá ɛcɛ ā lɛ ɛcɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú mā obɔ̄bí kú nū tá, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōlɔhi mla ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā, ó géē nya oyēeyī kú nū tá.

eng_Latn: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
idu_Latn: N tíne ō da aá ka ɔyínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyā Ufííbe wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛyi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú icɔ́ɔci nōo yɔ̄ Ukenkírīya.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá gaá lɛ ucɔ hɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú kú ayíkpó ā í lɔtū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ŋ́? Ohígbū kéē jé ka ó wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ā í je kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, n lɛ ācɛ kpó kwāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā. É bī ɔtā, ɔyī, óbō, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú ɔhá dóódu.

eng_Latn: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n da aá ka, Aá géē kwú ipú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā, ayíka aá cɛ̄ ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ka n wɛ ā, ámāŋ aá géē pɛ́ gekwú ipú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē gā ajɛ kú ɛfu kú Ámɔ̄ri, nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ je lɛ aá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
idu_Latn: Awɔ yá odúúdú āyā kú iyē kú um á, awɔ kē kpó āyā kú iyē kú um kwɔhá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
idu_Latn: Aá tá ɔga, aá gwéeyē, ka aá gwó ijē, ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́, otīīhɔ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo yɔ̄ ɔtuāhɛ̄ aá a nwuné nɛ̄hi.
