eng_Latn: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ ga ɛhícō ga Ubɛti Uhɔ́gla, gaá bū óci nōo lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ó yɛ gaá bū ɛgiyí ɛcɔ̄ kú Ubóhan.

eng_Latn: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ Urebéka, ɔyínɛ́ uwā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā nōo ī leyīkwu Urebéka ā, kóō nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe wā mɛ́mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi da Usɔ́lu ka anúɔ nɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kē le unu nu mla ágábá mɛ́mla aɔ́gwú eko nɛ̄ anúɔ gē gbāálá kú ádā anúɔ ā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔdā nēé gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú uwā ā jé anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá í gbɛlá aɔ́dā ɛ́gɛ́nyā āa?.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
idu_Latn: A le n nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ikwū. N kwú ikpó ú ce únóji. Amáŋ a le um pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ je gā um.

eng_Latn: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá kú aá lɛ agbénú nōo géē jɛ̄ aá, nɛ̄ aá kē géē yɔ̄ í je lɛ ācɛ eko dóódu. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ alɛwa géē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū ɛhi nēé mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo habɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū tá, ámāŋ ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā, ámāŋ ádā nū, ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, ámāŋ ayí nū, ámāŋ ajɛ ohígbū um, géē lɛ uwá fíyɛ́ igbo ofɛhɔ ce iyi uwā. Ó klla géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɔcɛ́ oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ, ācɛ gē jé ɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɛdɔ úklɔ́ kú ɔfú nōó gē yá ā, ó wɛ oŋmá ɛlā nōó gē ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
idu_Latn: Amí! Ɔwɔicō koó cɛ̄ kóō le yá lɛ ā! Ɔwɔicō kóō ya ká ɛlā kú uwɔ ā, kóō le yá jīla, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēé kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ éwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔ́da je ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá kóō kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū ú, kóō ga ipú ɔlɛ́ ā ŋmá okómpinu nyā ga ɔhá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō ŋmó ayínɛ́ nū, aóklóbīya nū, mɛ́mla aóladógbe kú nū.

eng_Latn: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
idu_Latn: Eyīpú kú ābɔ̄ ɛhíícō kú nū ā lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā í je pīya ipú alácɛ̄. Uya kú ācɛ nēe bá ī gwéeyē géē mɛ ŋmá ipú aígelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm. Uya kú éeyē kú ɔnyā mɛ́mla ɔbá ōlɛ ā géē mɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmó aɔ́dāajɛ le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā. Aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kpó gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú le Óndú ā wɛ aɛ́na úlā ɛpa cofigwó , aómlede úlā ɛpa cofigwó , aálá úlā ɛpa cofigwó . É kwú odúúdú uwā í kpó gwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɛyá kú ejé nēe ī bla uwā iyē ā. É ŋmó aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lé dúú.

eng_Latn: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
idu_Latn: N kē ī yá ká ē lā ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ Íjīpiti, ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī uwā ā piíí nēé tɛtɛ lā ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é géē wɛ éwo nɛ̄ ó lɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
idu_Latn: Ísu gē ŋmó, ɔkpá klla ī je ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ jé odée lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si, nɛ̄ eko kpií Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́ yá nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ohígbū eyīnyinyi alɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō má icííci ā, kóō gekwú ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ. Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔfulā kú ofú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā í kwu ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
idu_Latn: Ó he um ɔtū ká n̄ lɛ aíne kú uwɔ ā tū fíyɛ́ ō lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
idu_Latn: Kéē klla da ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ̄kā, ka aá ɔ́ɔ̄ yá ɔtū nōbí ohígbū ō catāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá klla gwū okónu ipú ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ húmáyī yá iháyí alɛwa nēe yɛ āā?.

eng_Latn: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú nū ɛháajɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá okónōgwu kú Ukɛriyat Ujēyarím gaá ga ɔkpá kú Unéfitówa.

eng_Latn: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ é ké lɛpɔbí lé, ohígbū ka okónu nēé ce aflɛ́yí ka aá gáā lɛ ɔbá ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú bīya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā ɛháajɛ kú Ɛ́lāyi. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, olɛhɔ̄ ō ŋmá ɛga Óndú ā bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ gē ŋá nɛ̄hi. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ī má ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, í yɔ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ Ɔdā dúúmā í tayínū ŋmá idɔlá kú nū ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ ucē otūwēyī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yá tayínū ā kpó bónū ɛɛ́, alɔ í kē yá kú alɔ plla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, alɔ í kē pīya ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō wɛ ijáalí kú alɔ ka alɔ gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ gēdēē. Abɔ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ gē yá ɛ̄nyā ā, alɔ leyīce ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē bī ɔdā olɔhi ɔtū lɛyíkwu alɔ.

eng_Latn: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
idu_Latn: N yɛ í kwú uwā í klá ácábɔ̄ kú um bɛ̄ɛka īlī, ámāŋ kwú uwā í klá ɛyí bɛ̄ɛka ɔfulā ā.

eng_Latn: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú Isóan mla Uméfis wɛ aólíla. Uwá cíkā o bī éwo a tá a; Amáŋ é lɛ aá bī nyīla eyī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a géē yɔ̄ ī nwū um ɔwɛ nāa ī hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpaā, n géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ŋmá ɔtū oyéŋēē.

eng_Latn: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Umáaka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Utálmāyi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́ssɔ ā. Adónīja nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhágīti ā.

eng_Latn: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā n gē bī ɛhi nēé da ohígbū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē ŋmá ajɛ gicō, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō nōo kē ī yá okónu kú nū jīla lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē pīyeyī má ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ágábáidu gē tíne nyā lɔnɔ, ɔlɛɛcɛ dúúmā í yá ɔ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ glá ŋ́, ayíka aɔ́wɔ ōfōōfū uwā nɛ̄ n. É kē lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā le ɛgbā dɛ̄ oŋmá lɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu ede ā kahíníī, Ede, ede, Óndú ā keé géē ma ɔyí éyi ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Udéfīdi nɛ̄ iyē nū géē le ka Ujosíya. Ó géē kpó ācogwɛ́ɛya piíí nēe gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛcí ā ŋmó ɛyí uwɔ. Ó klla géē kpó aíkpokwú kú alɛɛcɛ yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n géē yá ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu italā, ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā, n géē je ede kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā yíífi. Odúúdú ɔ́kíkā kú ede ā géē je ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ɛ́lim, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɔ́mpa nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, é gā ígbíli kú Ínōōbīya, nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ɛ́lim mɛ́mla Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ ge gbēyī ɛ̄cī éeyē nɛ̄ eyīyōce ká alɔ yɔ̄ anú ā, eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō olɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ohɔnyɛtá kú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si, géē mafú ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū nōo géē bī nya alɔ tá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, cɛ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó yálé, klla mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
idu_Latn: Igelī éyi géē yɔ̄ kwú abɔ̄ ajaajɛ nēé géē hī ɔ̄ iyē kwu aícɔ́ɔja ā. Oŋmá lɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ í je odúúdú ajɛ ā yá yēŋēē igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ Utigati Upilinésa, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya í tá Áhāsi abɔ̄ ā, ó kwú ɛyí bú kwu ɔ́ klla kwú ɔ̄ tá ipú unwalu fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
idu_Latn: A yá ka aúnjɔlɔ mɛ́mla ɔkpá kéē pɛ́. A kē cɛ̄ lɛ aísu nēé gē ŋmó tɛtɛ ŋ́ mā kéē kwú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
idu_Latn: Ákan, ɔyí kú Ukámi, éyi kú ayí kú Uséra ā, bī ífi wā í klá Ísrɛ̄lu eko nōó kpó aɔ́dā nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú nēé kē kwú kpó bá lɛ Óndú ā, uwī á.

eng_Latn: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā i tá ɛga ācogwɛ́bā nyɔ̄ í le ɛbā gwó, ámāŋ koó le tá ɛgiyí aɔ́hɛ kéē nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā, n géē bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́. Ó kē gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɛláyíja tá otrɛ̄yí kú uwá ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɔlá kóō ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā í kwú awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ú kpó yi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔlā ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ, í kwú anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ofɛpa ce igwó ā ú kpó yi á.

eng_Latn: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛ̄hi lɛ inyaklumi kóō bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú inyilá, fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ agbénú kóō ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyí nɛ̄ ó le hī Ń ményinyi ŋ́ mā, le amɛ̄ hɛ́ ā, Ugóma klla le ipú yɔ̄ igbɔhá kpɔ́, ó lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá ma.

eng_Latn: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kóō nyɔ̄ gaá pīyeyī má ɛga ísu ā. Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le yɛ gaá lɛ ɔ́ má, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔkpani nū ka ɔdā dúúmā ɔ́ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Igbahāapa odumkwulu nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í má abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka Ɔwɔicō le Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla ɔfú kpó lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti. Ó gē yɛ ga ɛbɛɛbɛ, yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ, ó klla gē há ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ebilíi bībáajɛ ā tá, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nōó lɛ abɔ̄ ce ayípɛ̄ ā ɛyí le ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwá kwɛyí ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá kwú ɔtū kú aá ú kwu ɛhi ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ɛ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
idu_Latn: Ó le n tɛ̄hɔ ká n̄ klla tɔ́ɔna ka iháyí nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē méyīnyinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā, mɛ́mla eko nōó géē gwō aólɛlā kú nū ɔ́ci ā, gā ɛɛ́. Ó le n tɛ̄hɔ̄ ká n̄ tá ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ekwu ā ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwɛcɛ nɛ̄hi ipú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ofu cigwó ā, amáŋ ó gaajɛ Āícɔ́ɔja Ɛtá ā ŋ́. Udéfīdi kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē gbō anú abɔ̄yī nū ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le kpaakpa, ɛpɔ̄ kú uwɔ klla le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
idu_Latn: Ń kpó eko bónū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gbɔɔ́ ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim yɔ̄ gē da Uhérɔ̄du koó lɔhi kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔnyā kú ɔyínɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔ́kplá kú nū ā wɛ, Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū ɔ́mpa ā lé ka, Ábīja. Uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa gē hɛ́ɛpɔ̄ Ubiyɛssɛba.

eng_Latn: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
idu_Latn: Ó gē nya ɔ̄cɛ tá ŋmá ikwū klla ī je éeyē kú oyēeyī igbɔhá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Abíssāyi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Usiríya le lɔfú fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄ nɛɛ, a wā í tá um abɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄n le lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ nɛɛ, n géē wā í tú uwɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō híīī ŋ́mó aá okónu ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ɔwɛ ékpó nɛ̄ a bī le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá okónu āa. Ɔdā nɛ̄ a bī le ŋmó ācɛ ɔhá okónu ā, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā nēé géē bī le kɛpɔ̄ tū uwɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubatisséba túkpɛɛ́ wāajɛ lɛ ɔ́gbá tá ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, abɔ̄ nōo lɛ ajɛ, yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé lɛ ā, n kē yɔ̄ mla aá. N géē wā ɛgiyí aá í nya aá tá. N géē yá italā, amáŋ ó gáā lɔfú nɛ̄hi ŋ́. N géē kpó aéwo nɛ̄ n pa aá hīla bá ipú uwā ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Amáŋ ń gáā kpó aá yíífí dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
idu_Latn: Aá le jé lɔɔlɔhi ka, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē yá gbɔbū nɛ̄ ācɛ kú eko nyā nēe yēeyī abālɔbányā géē pɛ́ kwú ŋmá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
idu_Latn: Ōhī kú īkpɔ̄dā ā le pɛ́ bá ɛplá ɔcí ujē. Ujē ā le jɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ e lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kpó ŋmó á. É gwá īkpō dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
idu_Latn: Ákú aflɛ́yí ā wā gaá ka kahíníī, Ɔkpani, n le ikpīije ugóolu igwó ɔhá lɛ itene būla ɛ̄nɛ̄ a je ga um ā.

eng_Latn: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé nwū uwɔ ā kóō gbō uwɔ eko dúúmā nāa gē yāwu. Eko dúúmā nāa gwutá, ó géē gbō uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācogbāajɛ ā ɛyí ā eko nāa ī gbiyɔ̄lā otú. Eko dúúmā nāa le héyī, ó géē kɛlā mla awɔ bɛ̄ɛka oklóbīya uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa yɔ̄ ī yá ikpokwú kú um, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē kpó um kwɔhá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um ā, nɛ̄ n tayínū abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í jɛ̄ ā, a kē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le iyē gwā ɛɛ́ mā le yá yēŋēē dúúdú ɛé cɛgbá kéē gwīīyē dúú gɛ ŋ́. Ayíka ikpó kú uwā ōfōōfūnū nēé í na mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Odúúdú aá le yēŋēē ɛɛ́, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tóohi ka, Ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā nōo gáā yá á. Ó ka anúɔ géē nuunu tá aólɛlā kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kwú je pīya aálagbá kú ɛfú ā hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā olɔfú nēe klla bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi ā. É klla í nú iyó nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū í lɔtūce uwá ŋ́, ohígbū koó jé ɔ̄cɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄, ká ā lé ɔdōlé kú uwɔ mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, ká ā gwá ejé kú uwɔ mla éeyē, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ kú ā yá á.

eng_Latn: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?
idu_Latn: Ɔbá nū, Ɛlkána da ɔ́ kahíníī, Uhána, ɔdíya nāa gē jikwū ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á le ɔdōlé ŋ́ mā a? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔtū gē wū ɔ̄ ā? Ń fíyɛ́ ayí igwó gā uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó ācɛ Íjīpiti lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēe bá í wúla ūpū nɛ̄hi tāajɛ ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā yá uwā á nááná, nɛ̄ uwā lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ūpū nɛ̄ aɔ́cí kú nū lɛwa nɛ̄hi le jíla tɔ̄há tulúu ā. É lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɛwa kú aéfūma, é kē tōō gbaálūka mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gē gwá īkpō nwuné nwuné, aá gē mafú ka aá wɛ ayíkpó kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē mafú lɛ ācɛ ka Ádā um wɛ idáagó.

eng_Latn: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ Unáhum nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ɛukóssiā má lɛyíkwu Unínīfɛ.

eng_Latn: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ anúɔ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā le obugā nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ádā nū, Ébrahām, bu eko nōó yēeyī ā kpó gwū á.

eng_Latn: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛpa le pɛ́ ga ipú ūpū gáā cē ɛfú, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ɛfú, anɔ́ɔ āgā kú nū le wú gaá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nū ā ŋmó. Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ āgā kú nū wú nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā, géē kwu inya ɔ́ci ga éyi kú aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ lɛ iyī nū nyatá.

eng_Latn: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
idu_Latn: Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, kwú abɔ̄ kú ɛ̄nyā u kwu ɔtū ɛɛ́; ó lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāndaa gāa je ōwē la uwá ɛɛ́; ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē ci ɔɔ anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
idu_Latn: Aá wā ɛgiyí um, ɔdúúdú aá nēe gē yúklɔ́, nɛ̄ iyó le jɛ̄ aá, n géē je omlɛ́nyɔ̄́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn gbō ajɛ ā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi ɛgiyí Utífisa ā jāā ga Ugása. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú abɔ́ɔ ā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́, klla bá ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gē yíihɔtū tá iyī aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ géē jé ka aá wɛ ayíkpó kú um.

eng_Latn: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ujósɛ̄fu kōō yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, anú wɛ igbómína nōo gē gbō ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu pó ā le hɛ́ ɔ̄ idáagó. Ó kōō cɛ̄ ɛlā kú uwā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má ācɛnyā ɛpa bá ī wu wā ɛgiyí um mla acá nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ákú ígbáanɔ nɛ̄hi, bɛ̄ɛka ucē nōo wu gáā je ugwū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ómbilí ā ú ŋmá ajɛ le wu nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n le ɔ̄kā ɔdā nāa yá ā pó ɛɛ́. Ufi kú uwɔ kē i mu um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Abālɔbányā, lɛ ɔdā idáagó kú uwɔ ā yá eko kú alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ yá ā. Kóocōō, méyīnyinyi kú alɔ, nááná nāa yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū tū alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ má ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ā, é le ɔdā nōo í ŋmó ūwā ā miya táajɛ lɛ uwá, ó géē bī ayí nū ga ɛga nēé ŋmó ūwā ā.

eng_Latn: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
idu_Latn: Agīje húmáyī wɛ ɔdōlé kú um kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ á. Eko dóódu aólɛlā kú um bá gē da um ɔ̄kā ka, Iní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! Aá pó uya nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī yá igelī ā mɛ́mla ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā āa? Uya ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛgba nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī yá aólɛlā kú nū italā nōo cíkā lɛ uwá ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ āa ayíka ɔdí nɛ̄ Íne nēé je lɛ Umósīsi ā cíkā ō yá mɛ́ɛ́ āa? É le íne ā katū ɛka ā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō mafú lɛ ācɛ ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé bá ī yá ā wɛ íne nēé bá ī bīya ɔkwɛ̄yi á. Ɔwɔicō yá íne ā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō ī tīile jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔyí kú Ébrahām ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ ɔ́ ā gā. Ɔwɔicō lɛ íne ā tū aálekékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fu Umósīsi nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ otá-ɔtāhɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Usɛdɛkíya gbɔɔ́ ō yá īkpɛ̄yī olɔfú tá Unebúkádinēsa nɛ̄ ó pi ɔ́ abɔ̄fú ká ɔ̄ gbɛka lɛ ɔ́ iyē kú Óndú ā, ka anúɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tū ɔ̄ ipú ō tá ka anúɔ í pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ā híī ka ka anúɔ wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ a géē ga ɛgiyí odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ n géē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá ā. Ɛlā dúúmā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ka ā da uwá ā, nɛ̄ a kē í ka lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka iháyí ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu húmáyī bī Uhɛ́ssbɔn, mɛ́mla Árōwɛ mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú uwā, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā nēe bá okónu ogwu kú ísu kú Ánɔn ā. Ɔdíyá nɛ́ ɛ́ɛ húmáyī mīyɛ uwá ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā gē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Udamáskúsi mɛ́mla Uháwuran gaá kwu ɛjī kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, nōo wɛ ɛjī ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā mɛ́mla Ugílɛ̄di nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Ó géē tá jāā gáā kwu Utáma ɛgiyí ísu kú ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú uwɔ le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá uwɔ, kwú igbīhi í cēkwu íne kú uwɔ. É le ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe pi uwá ahɔ̄ ɔ̄ ā kpó ŋmó, ācɛ nēe da uwá kéē lɛ cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ā. É gē cá uwɔ ɛcá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, É géē je uwēyī lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē pā ɛcí ā, é klla í yá kú ɔtū kú uwā kóō kwú gbájí. Uwēyī kē í kwú odúúdú uwā.

eng_Latn: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ayínɛ́ ɛpa lā tɔ̄há, nɛ̄ éyi gekwú nōó mɔyí dúúmā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ cɛ̄ kú ɔnyā kú ɔyínɛ́ nōo kwú ā kóō nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔbá ɔhá ŋmá ɛgɔhá gwū ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū tá ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá ka ɔyínɛ́ ɔbá nū ká ɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú ɔnyōkwū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
idu_Latn: A klla í je omlede ɔhá, ɛ̄nɛ̄ é bī lɛ yá uculo kú abɔ̄ ō cɛyí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a da Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛbéenyi ōhī nɛ̄ aá kwú ānāānā ā bī wā.

eng_Latn: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gē leyī yɛ ohi kú ɛlā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē tá á. Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā gē tóohi ɛlā ɔkwɔɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ unwalu kwu ɔ́ ɔkwu bōōbū.

eng_Latn: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
idu_Latn: Óndú, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ nāa je ŋmá eko íkée ā, ó gē tú um ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le da ɔ́ kahíníī, O ŋmá iyē kú Áyísīki nāa géē lɛ ayááyí nɛ̄ n cokónu ō je gā uwɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
idu_Latn: Usíkilāgi, Ubɛti Umaracábɔtu, Uhása, Usúsa.

eng_Latn: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ikpó ɔnyā ádā nū ce, le uwēyī je lɛ ádā nū ɛɛ́. É géē kpó anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā ádā nū ā ŋmó. Ɛfiyɛ kú ikwū kú uwā ce īyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa tíne ō gbiyɔ̄lā nɛɛ, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka agōdō ā lɛ akā gē yāwu ā. Ó klla géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka a yɔ̄ gē túnēē gɔbū gigbīhi ɛyí agōdō kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
idu_Latn: Ufi lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kwú, anɔ́ɔ é tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá á. É kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄hi éyi le bɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ alɔ ɛɛ́! Ɔwɔicō gā kóō nya alɔ, nōo wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō da Uféro ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ipú ɔkpá ɛlā kú nū kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ um bī ɔtū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n je uwɔ lé ɔcɛ́ á, ohígbū ká n̄ bī uwɔ le ma ɔfú kú um fú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ofu kú iyē kú um kóō le nyīla ga odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ami ɔ́ɔ má āā? Ó ka anúɔ tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ má ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ̄ kú ugóolu . Ocíbú éyi nɛ̄ anɔ̄ yɔ̄ ipú nū ā ce ɛyí nū. Agege ahāapa nɛ̄ éyééye kú nū lɛ okónu ahāapa nēé gē lɛ owú bū ɔ̄ ā, klla ce ɛyí nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: É le ɔda ce lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi kéē ce ɛyí nū. Ujéssuwa, Ubáni, Ukádimíyelu, Ussébanīya, Ubúni, Usérebīya, Ubáni mɛ́mla Ukénāni ce ɛyí ɔda ā dúú. É le ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú uwá gbōmgbōm.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā ā, ayínɛ́ alɔ, aá lɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ahāapa fu ŋmá ipú aá, ɛ̄nɛ̄ e le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla ohílīpú, nɛ̄ alɔ géē je úklɔ́ nyā tū uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kpó ŋmó klla kwú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í wā mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā gaá cɔcɛ́ ā, eko ɔ́ɔmā ó géē yājɛ ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda, aá lɛ ɛyí kpó wá kú aá yēkwu ohígbū ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe he aá ɔtū ā. Aá lɛ ɛyí kú aá fakpá bɛ̄ɛka ákú epu ā, ohígbū ka é géē kpó ayí aá ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, ga ajɛ éwɔhá abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
idu_Latn: Anú yá nɛ̄ alɔ tū Ujúdasi mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi, ācɛ nēe géē da aá ɛlā nēe bá nyā abɔ̄yī uwā ŋmá okónu kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē gwó aínu klla í lā ipú nū. É géē tū aɔ́cí ufáyin klla í lé aíkpō nū.

eng_Latn: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
idu_Latn: É bá ī kɛlā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu um áncā, é klla bá ī nuunu tá um áncā.

eng_Latn: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwu ewo ā bá ā, géē na īlī kú nū, ámāŋ ó géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Íne nyā géē yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla aéwɔhá dóódu nēe lā mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú um tū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā le iyāwū kú um ā yá lɔhi ɛɛ́ ā, ká n̄ nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔkpani um.

eng_Latn: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ń yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, o yá cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um. Ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ohile ā ka ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú. É da Áhābu ka, Nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Urámɔtu kú ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, a í yá uwā lé. Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ ga uwɔ yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwá géē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kpó lé, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e jɛ̄ ipú ujē ā dúú. Ācɛ nēe ī yá ūnwū ɔdā nɛ̄hi ā gē je uwá agbénú kpó lé.

eng_Latn: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ká aá yá ɔdā olɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aógwuda mɛ́mla aólíla ā kéē má ɛga ka obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
idu_Latn: Lɛ opo ɛpa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ na káā bī ɔ̄ lɛ hī ācɛ igwú tɔ̄ɔhá, mɛ́mla o bī lɛ da ācɛ kéē tútū ō cālɛ́.

eng_Latn: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā ícɛ, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā kú Abíbu.

eng_Latn: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
idu_Latn: N géē je ipɔ́ɔnū kú Áhābu ā yá bɛ̄ɛka ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔcɛ́ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unɛbāti, mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ubássa, ɔyí kú Ahíja ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu tóohi kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī tíne ayínɛ́ um nēe bá ī gbāálá amānyā ā. A lɔfú da um ɛga nēé bá ā.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɛ́mān ā wɛ Ujéhúli mɛ́mla Ussímēyi. Ācɛ nēe kē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujɛdútɔn ā wɛ Ussemáya mɛ́mla Usīyelu.

eng_Latn: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé yɔ̄ gē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá Usitífin ā, ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka, Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, mīyɛ alelékwū kú um.

eng_Latn: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
idu_Latn: N gáā jíla ɛcɛ mla ɔkpáncō iyē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
idu_Latn: Unɔ́ba le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ kú Ukénāti, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú hí iyī nū á.

eng_Latn: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le kwu ga ɛgiyí Usámūwɛ̄lu Uráma á. Ó le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu yá ɔ̄ ā kpó ka lɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ í lā Unáyōtu á.

eng_Latn: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā klla da uwá ka ɔwɔ kú éwɔhá dúúmā ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ éwo dúúmā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya kú é pó jéjée ɛɛ́ ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mpa ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā. Ó ka, Yíhɔtū tū ɔ́mpa uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a he iyī uwɔ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n lɛ aólɛlā alɛwa. Bī um jɔ́ɔwɛ ká n̄ yá ɔdā nāa tíne ā. Lɛ ɔdā nāa tíne kú n̄ yá ā yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ péee gā um.

eng_Latn: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, aá lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé lɔhi lɔhi ka o ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si nēé cɛ̄ olɛhɔ kóō o je yɛ́ɛhi kú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā ɔ́dāŋ ka éwo ámāŋ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ dúúmā í gbā Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, n géē bī ɛfú mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtá mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí le yá éwo ɔ́ɔmā italā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ lɛ Unebúkádinēsa kwú éwo ɔ́ɔmā ú yíífi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē bī ɛbɛ́ lɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ anúɔ, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gē je ɛbɛ́ ā lé á. Amáŋ Óndú ā ka ucɛ kú ūwā ɔ́ he anúɔ ɔtū ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ í gáā je íne nēé bīya ā yá ūwā ɛhi ŋ́, amáŋ anúɔ géē yá ūwā italā. Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ūwā cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é lɛ ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā iyē gwu ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ínoōbīya gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛya dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gwó ā kē mɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔyípōklóbīya géē lɛ oyēeyī kú nū tū yēŋēē glá ā? Oŋmá lɛ ɛyí ō táajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ oyēeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā ŋmó, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, alɔ kē wɛ ijáalí kú ɛ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ā ahínyá, ohígbū ka ó lɔhi. Ohígbū ka ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ka odúúdu íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ, klla í cílá ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ó yá ā dúúdú. Ó klla í cíla úle kú nū, ɛga ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ fíyɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ó yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔtū le nɛ̄hi, aá cíkā o jé ka ɔtū nōo lé nyā wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó je lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá nyatá á. Ɔyínɛ́ alɔ ohe alɔ ɔtū, Upɔ́lu, bī íjééyī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ā le tá ɔdā ékpó nyā ipú ɔkpá nōo tá fu aá dúú.

eng_Latn: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
idu_Latn: Aókplícī nōo bū inyīlɛ̄yí nɛ̄hɛ́ nwū alɔ íjéeyī á. Ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā lé ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ lɛ ádā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nyā pó ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwá kéē bá Ujérīko jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔnwāgba kú uwá ā le kpó bū.

eng_Latn: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ā, ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū gā igelī kú Ukapánɔm, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī aláadi ó le bēhé ga ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, gbɔɔ́ ō nwū ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēe bá ī yá ɔtūnōbí abālɔbányā ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, Ɔwɔicō géē tū aá ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda ā kpó ŋmá igelī ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā ahāapa nēe bá ipú igelī ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpó okónu ce otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, nōo kē gē leyīkwu ɔkpá kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ kpɔ́cí kpɔ́cí ofɛtá ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ūlī ɔ́mpa nēé tá ā le ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔ̄n kwú. Ajɛ nēé je lɛ uwá ā yɛ gaá kwu ɛjī ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
idu_Latn: É habɔ̄ um tá ipú aálelékwū, n klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé le ŋmó, kwú okwū nū í nyi únóji, nāa kwú mlanyī nū dúúdú ā. Nɛ̄ otábɔ̄ dúú í wā lɛ ɔ́ glá gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ka ohígbū nū ā yɔ̄ á, Usenakéribu, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm gē yɛhɛ tū uwɔ klla ī leyī gwū uwɔ bónū.

eng_Latn: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ebilíi lɛ Ujísɔ̄si jámá ɔwɛ dóódu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá gbéeko ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ó kōō wɛ agōdō, ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā ā cīce anú, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cí nū nōo wɛ igbīhi kú otútū kú ɛ̄cī usábāti ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi lɛ iyī uwā kpó wā í le jīla iyɔ̄bū Upáyílēti, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ōwē má ɛ́ɛ́ mā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ojámá yá ɔ̄ ɛɛ́ mā, ó lɔfú tá ācɛ nēe ī yá uwā ojámá ā abɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū ō kpóce ɔfú kú ɔnya kú ɛfú ō yálé wɛ áncā icííci nɛ̄ n. Ɔfú nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ ā í nya ɔ̄cɛ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
idu_Latn: N jé ka íne kú nū gē bī oyēeyī opiyóó wā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka, n ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā je gā um ká n̄ ka lɛ ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔlá tū klá um ŋmá icō, nōo yɔ̄ ī yi um ŋmá ikpokwú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, bɛ̄ɛka iyē ōkwɔ́lá kú eko nɛ̄ ɔfú gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ó lɛ ukpa jē tá ajɛ gbēyī um, lɛ um kwú, klla le um hɛ́ wāajɛ gblugudu, le um kwúcē igbīhi. Ɔwɔicō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū um tá, anɔ́ɔ n yɔ̄ ipú ɔnɔ piyóó á.

eng_Latn: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōó wɛ ā yɔ̄ á, íne ā ka ɔnyā olɔbá géē yɔ̄ mla ɔbá nū piíí, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔbá nū yēeyī ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔbá nū gekwú, ó le hɛ́tá ŋmá íne ā.

eng_Latn: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ejé wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá yɔ̄ ī wú saa ipú íkókwū, nááná, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ já uwɔ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔnyɛ kú nū gē plla ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Alelékwū Ihɔ géē nwū aá eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í ka ā.

eng_Latn: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.
idu_Latn: N klla tíne ō jé odée lɛyíkwu aájī kú nū igwó nēe kwu ɔ́ ɛyí ā mɛ́mla ajī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔhá nōo bɛ̄cɛ̄ wā ī je aájī nɛ̄hi kú nū ɛtá otɛtɛ ā kpó fu ā. Ajī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nyā lɛ ikpēyī mɛ́mla okónu, nōo yɔ̄ ī gwō. Anú tū um ufi fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Kwú okwutɛ kú Árɔ̄ni ú cīgbīhi ga iyɔ̄bu kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā. Ó géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ kóō wɛ ahɔ̄ ō pi lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ācɛ o yíikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā géē kwú ɔ́dāŋ ka é mā iŋini ō ka ā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi eko nɛ̄ Ujóbu lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ohígbū aóklóbīya nū ɛtá ā kwɛyí ā, Óndū ā klla kwú aágbénú kú Ujóbu í kpó kwúcē lɛ ɔ́ ɔhá kpɔ́. Óndú ā klla lɛ odúúdú agbénú kú nū ā kpó cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ́ ɛga ɛpa.

eng_Latn: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aúwī gā ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ otú, ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā ā nēé gē je á. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le oōpīya kú ɔcí ufáyin kpó gbúlla, é gē habɔ̄ ōhī tá kwu ɔcí icō piíí. Amáŋ, aólɛlā kú uwɔ lɛ uwɔ kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
idu_Latn: Óndú, cāŋjɛ ipú íwɔ́tū kú uwɔ lɛyíkwu aólɛlā nēe bá ī bɛ́yíkwu um ā. Óndú, cāŋjɛ ká ā wā í tá um abɔ̄, ohígbū ka okpaakpa nāa tíne á.

eng_Latn: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
idu_Latn: Ōcē obɔ̄bí gē je ɔ́ ɔkpíyē lé, ōcē oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kē ī je ɔ́ ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kpó lé bónū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē bī ɔ́ngbá nēé le gbō ɔdā dúú jéejée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, lɛ anúɔ gbō, anúɔ géē je kwáahi bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī dúúmā ámāŋ ka ɛdɔ óbō dúúmā, ámāŋ ɔdájī dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī yá ɔ̄ ágbe glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kwú Uféro mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā ú kpó ŋmó ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujúdasi nōo yíbīyājɛ tū ɔ̄ ā le má kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, ó le íjéma hī, kwú īkpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofucigwó ā ú kwúcē gē lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ kú Ulístra ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nōo wɛ ocīkpó ŋmá ipú. Ó kē yāwu jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
idu_Latn: eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofahāapa ce igwó ā, ó gekwú.

eng_Latn: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
idu_Latn: Ó da ádā nū, Ussɛ́kɛm kóō lɛ Udáyína lɛ lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē leyī kwɛɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je mlanyī ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe lā ajɛ kú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
idu_Latn: aá géē lɛ íkwu kú aá nú ebilíi tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
idu_Latn: N le gbagbafú ɛɛ́, Óndú, ményīnyinyi um. Ohígbū ka odúúdú iyē kú um le catīpú.

eng_Latn: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ nɛ̄ éyééye kú alɔ kē pó ɛlā kú uwā okónu ucē kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ nēé ma alɔ tū ipú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā wɛ Abídan, ɔyí kú Ugídón.

eng_Latn: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ nɛ̄ a má ā, n géē je lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
idu_Latn: Ussímēyi, ɔyí kú Ɛlā wɛ Ugbómína kú ajɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn á.

eng_Latn: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híīī lɔtū plico yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ɔdōlé kú um géē ŋmá ā? Ámāŋ iní nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē gwá ā í ŋmá ā? Ámāŋ iní nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē le wiiyē ā í ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
idu_Latn: Aá í yíihɔtū tá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔtū kú aá, ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odo kú aá, ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlá nɛ̄ gē gbo ā, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú aá!.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá géē da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ó klla ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɛpɔ̄bí kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā? Ɔ̄nyɛ í tá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē je ayí lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á. É kē wɛ ɔhā nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɛ́ ce ācɛ nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
idu_Latn: É géē yá ācɛ obɔ̄bí ā italā piíí, amáŋ ācɛ ō yá olɔhi mla ācɛ okpaakpa ā í gáā móōwē ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu le hídáagó klla bá ī ka kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni í kílokónu tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ péee kahíníī, Ó wɛ ami Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, n lɛ ācɛ kpó gbāajɛ ɛyí ɔdɔ kú igá kú ɔlɛ uwɔ ɛɛ́. Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ uwá géē bá ī yá ā wɛ kéē géē bá ī blatū Óndú ā okónu nōó ce ā. Kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, é gáā klá okónu gbógbóōō ŋ́. Aá nēe gē blatū Óndú ā, okónu nōó ce ā, kóō híī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔhá í táafú tū ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ā ŋ́, ayíka Ujonátan ɔyí kú Ásāhɛlu mɛ́mla Ujásēya ɔyí kú Utíkifa mɛ́mla Uméssūlam mɛ́mla Ussabetáyi ācɛ ɛpa kú Ulífāyi nēe yɛ ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gaá gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, amáŋ ó da um kahíníī, Á híīī yá lɛ ā ŋ́! N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka awɔ mɛ́mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa awɔ, nēe lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā. Gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā! Ohígbū ka ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā gē je ɔfú lɛ ācɛ nēe ī kɛlā Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō ā, é lɛ Ussiyɛbíya ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā nɛ̄hi éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umáli, ayí nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū igwáahātá klla yɛce ɔ́ wā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ ā kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ igbo ɔmpa kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ó le yēŋēē, ā híī hī ɔ̄ ka ɔdēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
idu_Latn: Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú óndú nɛ̄ usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ nēé tá íne tū ɔ̄ ā, aógbló mɛ́mla ɔ̄wū ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya klla kwúcē wā í bá ɔpɛ́ kú Urefém le tútū ɛfú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ lɛ ɔtūlé, alɔ kē í ce ɔcɛ́ mla anú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ piyóó. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ híhó ka alɔ í jé ɔ̄ ŋ́, ó kē í híhó ka anúɔ í jé alɔ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
idu_Latn: Ussálum, ɔyí kú Uhálōhessi, ɔ̄cogbāajɛ kú āyā éyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ma ɔdɔ gboce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
idu_Latn: Adá uwɔ wɛ Usamɛ́rīya nōo yɔ̄ ɛhíícō ā mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú nū ā. Ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú nū ā wɛ Usódom nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō je ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi lɛ odúúdú aá nēe yíhɔtū tá Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā oŋmá eko tá eko ā.

eng_Latn: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ń gáā lɛ okónu klá ŋ́, n géē yɔ̄ í gwíijē, yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ. Óndú, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á. N géē tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mla agbla kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla inu ojīlīmā ɔhá dóódu nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā ú kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā da Amása ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda hīgwú wā í jīla anúɔ eyī ɛ̄cīhɔ̄. Ó da Amása abɔ̄yīnū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú nū géē kpɔ́fú kwu ɔ́ lɔfú lɔfú. É géē nū ɔ̄ inya í tá ɔyī lɛ ɔ́ í wū ɔ́ ɔtū klíicō.

eng_Latn: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tū ácí ā bá klla lɛ uwá tɔ̄lá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó géē lɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ á.

eng_Latn: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nāa ī gbēyī nū abālɔbányā kpɔ́ gɛ? Cāŋjɛ kéē lɛ ubatísim yá uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nāa bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi o ŋmá lɛ o gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ ga ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, alɔ le mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī ā anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipú ígbíli á. Ācɛ alɛwa gbɔɔ́ ō tíne nū, eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kóō híīī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
idu_Latn: É kwú iyɛ́fú kú nū ā ú kpó playi ikpɛ́cí kú uwá éyi, klla kwú īkpɛyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu ú playi ikpɛ́cí kú uwá nēé hī ka Udégɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā eko nēé klla le pó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gā ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu, klla lɛ ōwē kú uwā má ɛɛ́ ā. É túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya kláajɛ le ɛ̄gba gbā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
idu_Latn: Ó le anɔ̄ nēé ī le fu ɔ̄cɛ ā tū Árɔ̄ni ɛyí, le ɔ́ fu kóō kwú tīihɔ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
idu_Latn: N blakwu íkée ā, klla gbɛlá kwu odúúdú ɔdā, nāa tɛtɛ yá ā. N gbafíyóó lɛyí odúúdú úklábɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
idu_Latn: Uculo kú aéwɔhá ā nēé ī bī le gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā í tīile dúúmā ŋ́. Ācɛ le tá ipú ūpū nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ wāajɛ kéē gbā ojibó ŋmá anú. Ɔ̄cogbɔ̄cí bī ɔdu ō gbɔ̄cí kú nū lɛ ojibó ā gbā.

eng_Latn: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
idu_Latn: É kē lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ kú íne ō bīya, anɔ́ɔ aá kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú Ɔwɔicō o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú yá ɔdā olɔhi.

eng_Latn: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē je odúúdú aɔ́lá nēe ī fíyāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā kpó nyí, cɛ́ɛ́ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá ipú obū kpímmm. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Aéwo mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ géē kpó agbénú kú uwā leyīkwu uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dúúmā kóō kpla aá ɛhá ŋ́. A kē í jé ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nya uwɔ tá, klla hɛ́ uwɔ tá á. A klla kē í je ka ami ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.
idu_Latn: É géē bá ī yɛ ŋmá ísu kú ɔmā éyi ga ísu Umeditarénīya, cɛ́ɛ́ é klla yɛ biílí ŋmá ɛhíícō ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. É géē bá ī kwinya ga ajɛ, gicō kéē dɔɔ̄kā ɛlā Ɔwɔicō kéē pó. Amáŋ, é gáā má ɔ̄cɛ nōo í ka lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā da ācɛ ā ka abɔ̄ nɛ́ɛ le iyē gwu, kwú yá yēŋēē klla kwú tīihɔ ɛɛ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ í gwó ɛya kú ahínyá ō tá Óndú ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄lā kú ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī kú uwá le ɛbɛ́ bī wā í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ Ujówābu yɔ̄ í cīíbɔm tū igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwú Uríya ú tá ɛga nōó jé ka ācɛ o lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kú aólɛlā ā bá ā.

eng_Latn: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ ká ā kwú ɔyí ā ú, ká ā lɛ ɔ́ túbi, ohígbū ka n géē je ayááyī nū pīya éwo nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, awɔ wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá kú um á. Lɛ n hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwíijē ŋmá ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ka a lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá gwó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ci ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō yɔ̄ ī wɔ́tū nū ŋ́. Amáŋ aá yíhɔtū tá ɔ́mpā aá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá abɔ̄yī aá ā gē yíhɔtū tá iyī aá ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
idu_Latn: Aíjakī wɛ úlā ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kahíníī, Ubéélsēbulu, otrɛyí kú aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā je ɔfú lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ī nū uwā tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi wɛ Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukóhati, mɛ́mla Umerāri.

eng_Latn: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Óndú yɔ̄ ī kpó alɔ ga ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā? É géē je alɔ kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú klla í je anyā alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ kpó kwú, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú uwā ú yá aɔ́fiyɛ. Ó géē lɔhi fíyɛ́ lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ le cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ iyē kú uwɔ pīya ɔdōbɔ̄bi mɛ́mla ɔdā kú okónu ō tá ɔtāhɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Kóō yá kú agada kú uwɔ kóō gebí tāajɛ, ká ipú kóō le nū ce uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔyá ahāapa ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá gaá le jīla Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ācɛ o pɛ́ ugbéenyi ā cēyītīkwū kéē lɛ úgbéenyi ā pɛ́ wā ajɛ okónu ísu ā, amáŋ ó tɔ́ɔtɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka owu ā yɔ̄ ī tá lɔfú fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce úklɔ́ kú uwā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē tū ɔbā kú uwā mu mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce uwá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aóhī kú ipú uwā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufárisīi, gaá le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá ā ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī yá kéē gé ē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, olɛhɔ̄ le táajɛ ahɔ̄ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ɔ́wá kú aícɔ́ɔja ka ācɛ ɛ́ɛ bá yɔ̄ ī cīlɛ̄fú ipú odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛla lɛyíkwu ɔ̄ eko nōó ka, Odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ ā, géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tīihɔ lɛ ā piíí. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kē í wóofu um piíí. Amáŋ, Árɔ̄ni í ka ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
idu_Latn: Umádɔn, Uhásɔ.

eng_Latn: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
idu_Latn: Usekaríya, Ásīyɛ̄lu, Usemīrámɔ̄tu, Ujéhīyɛlu, Úni, Ɛlíyābu, Umaásēya mɛ́mla Ubenáya gē gwō ɛ̄ngwū ā á.

eng_Latn: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu má gwōnū, má gwutá abɔ́ɔ kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ, ipú ufi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ā. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ ɔ̄, ohígbū ka ó lé ɔdōlé ŋ́ jāā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē bla ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kpɛ́fú lɛ uwá, klla le ɛyí cikwū le uwá nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Umídiya ā.

eng_Latn: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
idu_Latn: Awɔ ā kóō nwū alɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Ohígbū ka ɔtū kú alɔ ā wɛ áncā, alɔ í kē jé ɔdā ō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā, ohígbū ka ɛbɛ kú uwā í gáā cɛ̄ gɛ ŋ́. É géē lɛ okónu klá cíí ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í gáā tú uwā ohi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā kéē kwú odúúdú aíyankwūlumī mɛ́mla ɛna kú uwá í kpó. Ācɛ nēe géē wā aáklō kú ɛyí kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā, n géē pa uwá hīla ga ɛga dóódu. N kē í yá kú ífi kóō yá uwā ŋmá ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ɔwɛ kú idáagó nōó bī le ma ihɔtū fú gā um eko dóódu, mɛ́mla eko nēé le íbɔm cē tū um klla ī kpɛ́fú tá um ā.

eng_Latn: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ísɔ lɛ ɛlā kú ádā nū pó ā, ɔtū kwú bīya lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō tɛ́gíkwū nɛ̄hi á. Ó klla da ádā nū kahíníī, Kóocō, lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ami ā dúú, ádā um.

eng_Latn: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ á jé ɔwɛ kú owu ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nāa gē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyí gē yá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū lɛ ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ á gáā jé ɛyí kú úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɔdā dóódu ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
idu_Latn: Ká aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ɔkpani uwā kóō wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɔnū ucɛ kú ɔnyāōlɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ kéē le tútū lɛ ahɔ̄ coge, é géē lɔfú nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ eko nōó lɛ abɔ̄ gbɔ̄ɔwɛ bōōbū ā.

eng_Latn: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛgiyí ínálēgbé ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ó le lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā, nɛ̄ ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, ó géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ka ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ agwú. Ó bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ínálēgbé ā.

eng_Latn: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔwɔ olímanya tū klá ajɛ kú uwā ikɔkɔ ɔwɔ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
idu_Latn: Ó klá í bī okoolo éyi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ blla omlede dóódu. Ó kē í bī ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nɛ̄ ohe ɔ́ ɔtū blla álá dóódu wā.

eng_Latn: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
idu_Latn: N mɛ ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ɛɛ́, ń kōō jé ɔdā dóódu gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū unwalu nɛ̄ n tá ipú nū nyā.

eng_Latn: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó nōó jégēdē ŋmó ɔ ŋ́, géē kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ohígbū nēé géē ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
idu_Latn: A le ikpó da ísu nɛ̄hi ā bá ajɛ mla aɔ́nya ɛfú kú uwɔ, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ísu nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā kóō gbɔɔ́ cūūwū.

eng_Latn: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umálakāyi ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē má ɛ̄nyā eyī abɔ̄yī uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē ka kahíníī, Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ō kōō ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ nááná.

eng_Latn: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū Ujɔ́ni má Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī wā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá má Ɔyálá kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo gē kpó íne nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ bīya nyɔ̄ ā!.

eng_Latn: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ce ɛyí inu ɔlɛ́ nū, kóō kpó eko bónū wāajɛ nyɔ̄ í je ɔdā dúú ŋmá ipú inu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.
idu_Latn: Unátan da Udéfīdi ka amáŋ, abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ kwú eyī í gwū Óndú ā bónū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nɛ̄ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔ ma ā ɔ́ɔ géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má. Ɛháajɛ ikpó kú nū wɛ ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ubɔ́ nēé ma mla ɛcɔ̄ o gbɔɔ́lá nēé hī usáfāya nōo wɛ ublúu bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die: because she hath wrought folly in Israel, to play the whore in her father's house: so shalt thou put evil away from among you.
idu_Latn: ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā bī ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛnyīlɔ kú igelī ā kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔ́, kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ohígbū ká ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, oŋmá lɛ ajā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gbo ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū ā. Ó da uwā ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ géē nū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ɔ̄ ú ce ɔkɔ, gē bī ɔ̄ ī yɛ. É kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ajɛ ɛga nēé yá lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó hayi abɔ́ɔ, ó kē fu ikpo ŋmá ɛga nēe lɛ ɔ́ hayi ā glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́, ó tóohi glá, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē nya ɔ́ tá ŋmá unwalu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, é kwúcē wā Ufilístīya, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufilístīya le pɛ́ ga Ujɛ́siríilu á.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
idu_Latn: Aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ kú nū nēe lɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi ā, aá nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne kú nū, klla gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú nū ā, kóō cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā túkpɛɛ́ le okwúukwu kwaajɛ, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá, Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú alɔ géē yɛhɛ tū uwɔ gaá kwu ā? É géē bá ī cá uwɔ ɛcá piyóó mɛ́ɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā ŋmá ɔgba ékpó kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú Ujísɔ̄si ā kā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, a géē yɔ̄ í leyīkwu um ɔwɛ dóódu. Amáŋ á gáā yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɛlá kwu ucē ɔ́bíipú dúúmā nɛ̄ n yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɔ́dɛkāyi bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, le awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū wiyē. Awulú ā ína nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla odufā. Ó klla lɛ ijɛɛlɛ kú ɔcɛ́ ce ɔkɔ. Ó klla le ɔflā kú ugóolu kú ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí. Odúúdú uláyi kú Usúsa le hútú. Ācɛ bá ī dɛ̄gba klla bá ī tɔ́ɔga.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, É tū um ɛhɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí aálá kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe bī ā nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Lɛ awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ, nɛ̄ awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ gē le wu iyē ā kpó wu ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ́da je kéē kwú ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ nēé lɛ ɔflā kú ɔcɛ́ kwu ɔ́ɔ ɛyí ā ú bī wā.

eng_Latn: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa le odúúdu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbaáluka klla le iyē kú uwā tá tū ɔkpá ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu, okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā ŋmá Ujɛ́rīko.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ede dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í gwó lɛ Óndú ā, ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī oje le gbā ɛcɔ̄ dúú nēé gáā le gwó ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Unówa wɛ iháyí úlā ce ofigwó ce éyi ā, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā éyi ā, Unówa lɛ ɔwú ā nwūla, ó le eyī pīya má ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le má ka ajɛ ɔ́ɔ le ŋmó ɛɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ anú nɛ̄ n géē lɔtūce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
idu_Latn: Aá gbla uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ádā ā jé ɛgbá kú aá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka aá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā nū.

eng_Latn: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
idu_Latn: Le héyī odo kú um, lɛ héyī ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla ɔkpānā. N klla géē héyī gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú eyī kóō nyā.

eng_Latn: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi kóō je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ipú ɔpɛ kú Umówābu, okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ujɛ́rīko ā á.

eng_Latn: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō í gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ācobīyíne ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā, klla gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó tíne, ó gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
idu_Latn: Wā í tá alɔ abɔ̄. Ohígbū ka a gē yíihɔtū tá alɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí, ami kē wɛ ámōōmɛ ā. Ami yɔ̄ abālɔbányā á, ami tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ŋmá ikée á, ami kē í wā ɛcɔ̄bū á.

eng_Latn: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Da um, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ āa? Inu yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ lɛ alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ géē gbɔga anú glá āa.

eng_Latn: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
idu_Latn: N géē je éyi kú ayí kú Udéfīdi pīya ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi, Usáyɔn abɔ́ɔ. N kē í yá ká ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ n fu ā kóō cɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nū wā gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A bī ucē okpaakpa ō yá kú uwɔ nyā kpɔ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄? Lɛ atufú ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō ká ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ ogbɛhá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē pīya anú tū ā lɛ tɔ̄há ā, wɛ ka, Óndú ā je īkpēyī lɛ uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ é kwú ɔdōlé nɛ̄ é bī ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ú lé kwɛyí ā, ádā uwā da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ igbɔhá kú aá lɛ ɔdōlé lígíí lá wā gé lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa kwu áklō kú nū ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa nēé géē lɛ ogbló ō lɛ bī ɔ̄ wu ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá uwá, nɛ̄é lɛ ikwū je wā ɛgiyí um, n géē nya uwá agīje piíí.

eng_Latn: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
