idu_Latn: Ami, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā kwú iyī um ú kwɛyí ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń bī ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́, n géē bī ɛpɔ̄bí nēé í ŋmó um ā ɛyí ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī oyēeyī kú um.

eng_Latn: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔyí ā ú gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nú á. Ó bī ɔyí ā bɔ́tū jāā gbó ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí ā gekwú á.

eng_Latn: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile nēe lā āyā ɔhá kú ɔpɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e lā ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan ā má ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le inya kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ayí nū le pɛ́ gekwú á, é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā tá le pɛ́ kwu. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufilístiya wā í lā ɔlɛ́ uwā nēé kwu hɛ ɔ̄ tá ā á.

eng_Latn: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú tíifu amáŋ ā cɛ̄ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ō pó ŋ́. Ā híī mā ɛyí kú uwɔ tɛ́ɛcɛ klla lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ yɔ̄ ī mafú ka anúɔ yēkwu ŋ́. Ā lɛ īlī klá okónu ɛ́ɛ́ nāa ge lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ācɛ o yēkwu gē lé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
idu_Latn: Eko kpiíí le gla, Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé ɔlɛ́ kú Ulífāyi. Ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé leyī gwu uwā bónū dúú ā bá gē tū Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā wā í lé ɔdōlé tɔhā mla anú mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā Óndú ā géē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwáahi ipú uwā fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka Udéfīdi ā eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi géē kpó ūwā trɛ̄yí bɛ̄ɛka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā Alelékwū wā í tá alɔ nēe le gbagbafú ā abɔ̄. Ohígbū ka alɔ í jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ cíkā ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ Alelékwū abɔ̄yī nū ā í má okónu kɛlā ŋ́ gē tíifiifu gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū alɔ.

eng_Latn: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō yɛhɛ tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kpó nū gɛcɛ, kwú ádā mla ɛ́nɛ́ ɔyí mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū ɛtá á ú, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá ipú inu ɛga nɛ̄ ɔyí ā gwutá ā.

eng_Latn: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
idu_Latn: Ahíyēsa mɛ́mla Ujówāsi, ayí kú Ussémaa nōo ŋmá Ugíbēya ā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā á. Ācɛ ohile ā wɛ, Ujésīyelu mɛ́mla Upéleti, ayí kú Asmáfɛ̄ti, Uberáka mɛ́mla Ujéhu nōo ŋmá Ánatɔ̄ɔtu ā.

eng_Latn: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
idu_Latn: Ń yɔ̄ gē ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka n gbɛlá ka ācɛ í leyīkwu um ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka n le nwū jé ka, ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ n lɛ ā jɛ̄ um, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó nyɛ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da um kahíníī, Lɛ ɛ̄nyā tá tāajɛ. Ákú ācɛ nēe hīgwú wā ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ kú Ɔyí álá ā lɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ o klla da um kahíníī, Aɛ́nyā wɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm nōo tá alácɛ̄ ā, gwéeyē ká ā tɔ́ɔga bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlamu ā mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nyatá, klla le igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū hɛ́tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
idu_Latn: aá kwú o cē iyī ɔ̄cɛ bī glá ú búla ɔdōōjé. Aá kwú ɔtōōlé ipú ōwē ú búla o cē iyī ɔ̄cɛ bī glá. Aá klla í je oyēeyī kú ɔtū ō tá Ɔwɔicō ō gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā búla ɔtōōlé ipú ōwē.

eng_Latn: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
idu_Latn: N kwú mlanyī ɔdā nɛ, ɔbɔ́lā, éeyē mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
idu_Latn: Ajɛ yɔ̄ ī jíliyē abɔ̄ é bá gē wā ā, ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú, ɛnɔ mla ɔyā kwú dobū kpúm. Anɔ́ɔ aínyílɔ́wɔ í klla fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Umósīsi ka aá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wā.

eng_Latn: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú aá téeyī olɔhi kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gáā tábɔ̄ áncā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ká ā gaá gbēyī Uféro ɛga nɛ̄ ó wā ī yɛ ga ɔkpá ā, kú ō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā yɔ̄ á, mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá kéē nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā um ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nyā lɔfú lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ eyí. Ɔyī nyā lɔfú má odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ádā nū yá ā. Amáŋ ó yɛce ucē kú ádā nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā kú nū ŋmɛ́yí yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká aá í gáā wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um glá ŋ́, ń taafu ŋ́ ó habɔ̄ odúúdú ɔdā nōó lɛ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
idu_Latn: É klla gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nōo nya uwá tá ŋmá ɛgiyí odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwā nēe yɛ uwá jīla ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn miya Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó gwó ā á. Īkpō kú ō táajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó gwó ā wɛ ikpó ofɛɛnɛ ce igwó, ɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó.

eng_Latn: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dáŋ ka ó he Ágábáidu ɔtū nɛɛ, ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ odúúdú uwá kpó ŋmó. Ɔ́dáŋ ka ɔcɛ́ cɛ̄ lɛ ā, nēé lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, n géē yɔ̄ ī cílá ɛkpa kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu igwáahāapa tū ɛga o kpó ije tū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je anɔ̄ nōo hile ipú abɔ̄ kú nū ā tū ɛyí kú ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ɔwɛ nyā nōó géē yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu á, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne o bīya ú yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, abɔ̄ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ igbo ɔ́mpa ā, ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kahíníī, Ádā um, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā í gla um glá ŋ́ ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka n lɛ ɔ́ gwá nɛ, ká ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne ā kóō le yá.

eng_Latn: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ̄ kú ɔ̄ mā okónu, ka anúɔ géē da ɔ́, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ anúɔ otú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄ ka nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: É ka Fíyaa, kwinya ohígbū oyēeyī kú uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ogbo-ofaka ā.

eng_Latn: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē je ikpɔ̄dā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō nyī á, anú klla ī je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́ kóō lé á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō géē kpó odúúdú ikpɔ̄dā nɛ̄ aá géē nyi glá ā lɛ aá. Ó kē í yá kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kóō jɛ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā le yá kú ɛhi nɛ̄ aá je nwuné nwuné ā kóō lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē jīla mla uwɔ, n kē í je odúúdú aíne kú um lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá icō kú ɔ̄wū, ɛplá kú Ucérūbim ɛpa nēe háyi ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
idu_Latn: Lɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gwó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n mafú gā uwɔ ɛyí ɛfu nyā a.

eng_Latn: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
idu_Latn: Aóladógbe ā le kpó hídáagó, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nyɔ̄ gaá yɔ̄ ī da aɔ́mpa uwā ɛga dóódu kú ɔlɛ́ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ujudíya ā.

eng_Latn: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú uwā ú kpó kwu ɔkpāncō kéē fíyajɛ wā ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya ga gaá da Uhɛsɛkíya ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ŋmá wā āa? Ɛlā nyá nɛ̄ uwá kē wā í ka ga uwɔ āa? Uhɛsɛkíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É ŋmá ɛga oligbó nēé hī ka Ubábīlɔn ā wā.

eng_Latn: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi, ka aá pó ɛyí ɛlā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abíssāyi, ɔyí kú Userūyah da Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ā, ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ tīle ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka okwū ewō ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cá ɔ̄ ɛcá āa? Ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́.

eng_Latn: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē bla kwu ācɛ ojéeyī ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō ī bla kwu aólíla ŋ́. Eko kpií nēé géē je mlanyī odúúdú ūwā á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ojéeyī gē kwú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ olíla gē kwú dúú á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a géē da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Uhíbru ā, tū um ɛhɔ̄ ká n̄ da uwɔ kaā mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá kéē nyɔ̄, kéē gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā ɔ̄ ipú ígbíli. Á jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ā ŋ́ jāā kwu abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nyā le yá yɛɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó mɛ́mla ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ le yɛ tá igelī nēé hi Unéyin ā.

eng_Latn: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ucáldii, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lā ajɛ kú Uháran. Eko nɛ̄ ádā nū gekwú ā, Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wā ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aá lā abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē mi īkpɔ̄dā klá ɛhɔ̄ ā, ōhī kú īkpɔ̄dā ā le pɛ́ bá ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ aígbáanɔ le pɛ́ wā í lɛ uwá kpó tá lé ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, le ɛlā nɛ̄ n géē ka ā nwū um ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka n jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē ka nōo í lɔfú tū ācɛ nēe gbagbafú ā iyē. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, ó gē hɛ́ um eyī klla lɛ ɔtū kpoókpoó je gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ pó ɔdā nōó gáā nwū um ā.

eng_Latn: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ucē kú Upɔ́lu ā, ó le yɛ tá Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛplá Usábāti ɛtá ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá gē je ɛlā ŋmá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla odúúdú ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ ga ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ o le kwu ga igelī nɛ̄hi ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ cíla ije kwɛyí nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú eko ɔ́ɔmā ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ ipácí ā gē tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́ iyī aá klla gē kwú iyī aá lé, ayíka aá leyī kwɛcɛ, ámāŋ aá géē je iyī aá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwá géē cé íbɔm tū aígelī kú uwā ā, ka ɔkpɛtá ɔ́ɔ í ŋmó uwā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo í yá kéē gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ayí nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, je lɛ uwá ā ŋmó lé.

eng_Latn: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ɔhá yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Ojuja nōó le wiyē kú úwé ā, ɔwɔ le hɔ́gwā yɛ ɔ́ ɛyí biílí, eyī kú nū gē ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā, aíkpó kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka aúpíla kú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ōcē obɔ̄bí géē je uwá kpó ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ nōo ge jikwū uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nōo ge kpó okwū kú uwá nyi ŋ́. Okwū kú uwá géē tīkwū klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛmī ɛna ā. É géē kpó uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, ámāŋ ɛmiyɛ géē kpó uwā ŋmó. Okwū kú uwā géē wɛ ɔdolé kú aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipú ácí.

eng_Latn: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúú nɛ̄ okwu tá ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ aépū gē túbá á.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Énɔ̄si, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɛ́ti, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ádām, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
idu_Latn: Unáaman klla kahíníī, Ó wɛ ísu kú Abāna mɛ́mla Ufápa kú Udamáskɔ̄si ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ odúúdú ísu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā yɛce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛbɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ɛ́la yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nū opī ā ga ipú ígbíli gé lɛ Asásɛ̄lu ā géē na īlī kú nū klla í gwīiyē ɛ́ɛ́ nōó í cīgbīhi wā ipú ɛga nēe lā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe kē lā aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā í lɔfú gɛ ŋ́, klla le gbájí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. É kwú yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo ī bū kwu ɛyí inu ā. Ámāŋ ka aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī bū ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ipú ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gē je nmɔ́lá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ocíbú kú nū ā cē klá akpa ɔcɛ́ kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā. Ajɛ kwu dobū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí aflɛ́yí ā. Ācɛ bá ī lɛ aīnu kwú akpókónu ohígbū ɔnɔ nēé yɔ̄ gē jé ā.

eng_Latn: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá tá Udéfīdi ohi ka ikpɛ́lā kú aá mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Usɔ́ɔlu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ ī bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ugóolu le ka ɔ́ gwó glá ŋ́. É ka aá í kōō tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā da uwá ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tíne ká anúɔ yá mɛ́ɛ́ ā á?.

eng_Latn: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā lígíi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ipú ufi kú Óndú ō yá ā, lɔhi fíyɛ́ agbénú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ̄, nɛ̄ unwalu kwu ɔ́ ɔkwu á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amíyɔ̄ da uwā kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka aá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē yá ucē ā pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá obɔ̄bí ga olɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́, n géē cɛ̄ ká aá lā amānyā gɔbū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ohi kahíníī, N da aá ka ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá gē tíne á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó wɛ ami nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā á nɛɛ, ayíka aá cɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ā kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le pó ka Uríya ɔ́ɔ ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Ó lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ iyáwu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya um, aá gbɛlá kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú eko nɛŋ́cɛ̄ nēe cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, kéē wɛ ocābɔ̄ kú ɔtōolé ipú ōwē ō má lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā dóódu nōo gē gwɛ́ɛbā klla gē yá ɔhɛ, é géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá anú kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ɛfiyɛ kú ikwū kú nū géē ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ Usénākéribu tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klla kɛlā obɔ̄bí ɔhá nɛ̄hi klá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Uhɛsɛkíya kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ kē i ba, alɔ ī mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, ohígbū ka alɔ ī lɛ íne kú nū tū, kē ī yá ɔdā dóódu nōo ī he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē fu ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa éyi ŋmá ɔkwu kú Udéfīdi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ gē lū ŋmá ɔcí ā. N géē je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ nōó géē bī íjééyī le gbō uwá. Ó géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa klla í yá ɔdā okpaakpa ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō wā ɛgiyí Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ipú ɔ̄na otú, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, A le iyī ūwɔ ŋmó ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ɔnyā nɛ̄ a le tá ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá klla le íne kú Óndú bīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim yá lɛ kpɛ́mm ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
idu_Latn: A géē kpó ede mɛ́mla aíyó kú nū dóódu ā tū Óndú ā abɔ̄, ó ŋmá lɛ o mī anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ klá anú mɛ́mla aíyó kú nū dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɔfú tū anúɔ iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ācɛ ā, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwā túbá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɔkpá kú iyē kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā dóódu jila. Ó klla ka anúɔ le ɔkpá kú iyē kú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn aflɛ́yí wā ɔlɛ́ ā má ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ má ipú ɔkpá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ géē cɛ̄tra awɔ, Óndú. Ohígbū keé le okónu nāa ce ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā ā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó iháyí ɛpa kllɔ́dɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā. Íháyí ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kōō hile kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā hɛ́hɔ̄ glá ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ le lɛ ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ede mɛ́mla ɛga nēé gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ā kpó wúlatāajɛ, kéē klla lɛ ojibó mɛ́mla aójibó ɔhá kú ācɛ ā kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā uwɔ géē ma ayí alɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin nōo ī gwá nɛ̄hi ā. Ayí uwɔ nēe géē jīla tū uwɔ biílí ā géē lɛwa.

eng_Latn: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nóō yɔ̄ ipú nū ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ Óndú kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ā, ó gē lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gwó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā jé eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nyá alɔ ukpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó je lɛ alɔ ā ipéyī nū.

eng_Latn: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
idu_Latn: Aá í gɔ́ ɛgɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kú ukɔ́tin ā kwɔhá kóō le pīya ígwu éyi, a klla í yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā mla aɛ́hɔ̄ o hile ā.

eng_Latn: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔfú iyē gɛ ŋ́, n kē le bá ō kwú ɛɛ́. É kē lɛ únóji kú um bu tá ī gbēyī um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm bá ī tíifu abɔ̄ nēé bá ī tíne ɔdā nēé í lé ā. É bá ī kpó agbénú kú uwā cabɔ̄ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔdōlé má kwú lé. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú yēeyī. Má um Óndú ā, káā klla má um ɛ́ɛ́, má um ipú ákanya mɛ́mla ōwē kú um.

eng_Latn: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkpá tá bá ɔcɔ́nyɔ́kpá kú nū kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu á.

eng_Latn: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē jāhɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tíne ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā kéē klla yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nōó da uwá ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yíhɔtū tá ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nāa gwutá, á gáā yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. A í gbiyɔ̄lā kú uwɔ ɛbɔ́, iyɔ̄lā klla í lɔnyɛ tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔfiyɛ dóódu nɛ̄ aá lá mla ije ā, géē lé eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā gbɔɔ́ ō da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā kéē jé ɔ̄nyɛ kú ipú uwā nōo gáā yá ɔdā nyā ā.

eng_Latn: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó jé ikpó odée ŋ́ ɛpɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō kwu hɛ ɔdōōtūufi ā tá géē je mīya tá ɔ̄gɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē lɛ icō tū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā, ukpa í kwú ɔ̄. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ eko nēé í je Umówābu yíífi ā tū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛ̄hɔ̄ kpó, anɔ́ɔ é le kwu nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí uwā. Abɔ̄ é kē lɛ otrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā má ā, é mā ijē ō ŋmó Upɔ́lu tá.

eng_Latn: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni ma ayí ɛnɛ, Unádābu, Abíhu, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Utáma.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ikpokwū kú Ujófɛ̄fu kpó, ohígbū ka Ujófɛ̄fu cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛ ɛka gbō kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē wā ɛgiyí aá gáā kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ā, aá géē kpó ikpokwú kú okwū kú um nyɔ̄ mla iyī aá ŋmá amānyā.

eng_Latn: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka alɔ tá ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē tá ayí abɔ̄yī nū abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Aá kwú ɛcɔ̄ nyā ú míya ŋmá amānyā. Umáta, ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú ā, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, abālɔbányā ó gē hójújá mla ípī mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī ɛnɛ nɛ̄ ó kwú yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō nēe ŋmá éwo dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɛcɛ ā wā í lā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlákápá í gáā tíīlī nɛ̄ ɔcɛ ī le klá iyē glá ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ ɔdā nēé gē yá ɔ́ɔmā í gāa tīile dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: At his day thou shalt give him his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he is poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he cry against thee unto the LORD, and it be sin unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ije kú uwā gbā lɛ uwá ɛcī dóódu gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka otú kóō bī. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ ā ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá ije ā, kē kwú eyī í kpó ce ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ gbā ije ā lɛ uwá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ géē jikwū klá Óndú ā, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá yá ā cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú íne kú Óndú ā ō bīya.

eng_Latn: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ nɛ̄ ikpankini nū kwu ajɛ, eyīyōce yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ̄ɔ̄ gē gbɔɔ́ ō lu kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Kwú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ú cīgbīhi í wu awulú ā kpɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ipú awulú ā, ó le má ka, ó kwú yá lɔhi mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛga o hile kú ɔkpíyē kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā íwɔ́tū mla ɔdā íwɔ́tū nɛ̄ oklóbīya uwɔ yá uwɔ ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ihɔtū nɛ̄ olɛ̄lā kú uwɔ le yɛ uwɔ ɔkɔ gbaala á. Leyī kwɛɛcɛ n.

eng_Latn: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nōo doōcē iháyí ofu cigwáhātá.

eng_Latn: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
idu_Latn: É gē lɛ ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā, klla ī pā aɛ́cí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ gē ŋmó um, amáŋ aá je ɔdōlé gā um ŋ́. Ijēēnyi yɔ̄ gē ŋmó um, amáŋ aá je ɔdōōgwá gā um gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu agōdō kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ odúúdú ajɛ nōó cokónu nū lɛ aádáádā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É má lā ajɛ eko nēé mīyɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
idu_Latn: Ufaníya, Umérēmɔtu, Ɛlíyāssibu.

eng_Latn: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū lɛ ā mafú lɛ alɔ, oŋmá lɛ ō tū Ohɔ́nyɛtá wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā kóō gekwú ohígbū alɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ācobīyíne kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ acá mɛ́mla āpū ŋ́ nēe lā ipú éŋkpɔ̄, wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu he ɔ́ ɔtū ā mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu nōo kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, géē jīla. Ísrɛ̄lu nōo lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē lɛ ɛbɔ́ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa gē kwú iyī uwā bɔ́tū ā.

eng_Latn: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ó jé ka ń lɛ ɛnyá iyɔ̄bū nū ŋ́, n kē lɛ īyī um hɛ́ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá.

eng_Latn: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka anú, abɔ̄yī nū ā í blakwu kóō gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó gē yá aógbɛhá, ayókwū, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ipú ɔtūnōbí ŋmó. Ó klla ī kpó uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Ɔwá kú iyɔ̄bū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā mɛ́mla odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ nēe kwu ābɔ̄ ɛpa ā wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ō hɛ́tājɛ mɛ́mla ɔ́ŋgbá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
idu_Latn: É géē hābɔ̄ aógbló ā tá wu ipú aéliká. É gáā pi ɔ́ ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ̄ nyi ipú ajɛ kú nū Utimínāti Uséra, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem, ɛhícō kú ɛfu kú Ugáássi.

eng_Latn: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, eko nɛ̄ ɔmáapú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ā lɛ ɔ́ má, ó lɔfú ŋmó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa kóō nyīla ga ɛbɛɛbɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā í yēeyī ā. Ká ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla agbénú kóō yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ajɛ kú nū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔyā í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ le itekwú nɛ̄hi ā kwú ŋmō ŋmá ajɛ. Itikpa kú ɛcɛ gaā tɛ́ɛcɛ, eko nɛ̄ awɔ, Óndú ā, cɔ̄nū klla dɛ̄gba tū aólɛlā kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kɛlā nyā lɛ ami Usekaríya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le gbenyi gā um, ɛnɔ í kē cɛ̄ kóō tū um ɔtū lé ŋ́. N cāŋjɛ ipú ójīla yɔ̄ ī jikwū kú otábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da, Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu lɛ Ébrahām, Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu, ka n géē je lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā á. N cɛ̄ gā awɔ lɛ ɔ́ má eyī ɛɛ́, amáŋ, á gāá bēhé ga ipú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá ɛcɛ ámāŋ ka ɛfú ā, a wɛ Ɔwɔicō eko nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́, a klla í wɛ Ɔwɔicō ga opiyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
idu_Latn: Wā káā gaá lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā gā um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛwa ce alɔ abɔ̄ bá ā. Ekōhī n géē lɔfú yá uwā lé glá klla lɛ uwá kpó nū. Ohígbū ka n jé ka, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nāa lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, ó géē bá ɔ̄ iyē, ɔ̄cɛ nāa kē lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ́, ó kē í bá ɔ̄ iyē.

eng_Latn: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ mla anúɔ ga ɛga nɛ̄ áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ipú ajɛ kú Ugíbēyɔn ā. É le pɛ́ ga abɔ́ɔ ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nɛ̄ Umósīsi gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū, ipú ígbíli ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́bá ɔnya nēe le ipú nū lɔɔlɔhi,ī tíne ɔnyā ō ce ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá gē yúnwū ō cikpó ɔnyā ɔ́mpā nū á.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ géē je ɔdōōcābɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, nōo géē mafú lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu nū ā.

eng_Latn: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú nū í gáā yá ɔ̄ lé gbóógbóō glá ŋ́, ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í gáā yá ɔ̄ lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm gē ŋmó ācɛ ipú igelī ā. É gē pīya oyī kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ā bá ajɛ ɛga nēé géē tá úmúlá klá ɔɔ́ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ é mā oyī ā tá ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ í má ɔ̄ cāā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aɔ́kpani um, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá le yɛce ɔlɛ́ um. Aá lɔfú lɛ ikpó kú aá na cɛ́ɛ́ aá le gbo gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī aá lɔfú nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ī nyɔ̄ āa. Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehée, alɔ géē gbo ɔɔ́pu.

eng_Latn: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni le tá ɛyí ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛdrɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛna nōo wɛ ákú ɛya kú íne ō bīya kú nū ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
idu_Latn: N da Ɔwɔicō nōo gbō um ā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa je mlanyī um ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɔtūnōbí piyóó, ohígbū ōwē nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um nēe bá ī yá um ŋmó ā, gē je gā um ā.

eng_Latn: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
idu_Latn: Bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ekwu kú oklóbīya um, ámāŋ ɔyínɛ́ um ā. N yɔ̄ ī yɛ le ɛyí playi ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ekwu kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ nēe bá ā gē ka āa? Ujísɔ̄si tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Īī. Aá jé ŋmá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ ka, A le nwū ayípɛ̄ obene mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ogwámɛ̄ kéē cɛ̄tra awɔ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá pīyabɔ̄ igbīhi italā nēe bá nyā ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá bá gē tá ɛlā kú um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yɔ̄ lɛ ā da uwā kahíníī, Aá le ɛlā ka gā um lɛyíkwu ádā aá nōo wɛ ókplícī ā. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ lɛ ā? Ó yēeyī klla yɔ̄ lɛhi kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ gbɔ́ɔ ō yá, aá ī ka ka, Ó géē wɛ ɛ̄cī olɔhi, ohígbū ka ɔkpáncō wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ɔnyīlɔ éyi da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N géē kwúcē uwɔ ga ɛga dúú nɛ̄ a ī nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú Udéfīdi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí abɔ̄ ó le okónōgwu ikpó kú awulú kú ɔcɛ́ hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm kē yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, n le ɔ̄na nā.

eng_Latn: And, lo, he hath given occasions of speech against her, saying, I found not thy daughter a maid; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́ɔ le ije cē bá ɔyí anúɔ ā ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīnlɔ jé ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́ anúɔ á. Amáŋ ɛ́ɛ má īlī agōdō nɛ̄ oyī ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ kwú ɔ̄, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anú mla ɔbá nū gwutá kú aflɛ́yí ā. Ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ géē mafú lɛ uwá ka ɔyí anúɔ í jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ga ɔlɛ́ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ gajɛ kú ālɔ̄ gaá lɛ ucē nēé ī ka ā gbájí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī pó ɛlā kú īyī uwā igbohá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le omlede ā wā ā, ó kwú īkpɛ̄yí kú nū, ijē kú nū mɛ́mla ícɛ̄bɛ́ nōó wá nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ā ú kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
idu_Latn: Aá tíne ká aá lɛ ɔ́ bī wāajɛ ŋmá ipú ɛga ojīlīmā nɛ̄ ó ce ā ōfōōfūnū. Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ wɛ ɔdā nōo he aá ɔtū á. Aá bī akpokónu ká aá gē hɛ́ ɔhā ce ācɛ, amáŋ aá bá ī tókónu lɛ ācɛ ipú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ a gwutá ɔlɛekwu ipú abahi mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlā okónu kú aólɛlā kú um gbájí, Óndú. N má ācɛ bá ī yá ucē ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ikpɛ́lā igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ opo ā tá ɔkɔ éyi, ācɛ nēe lā ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī a géē cālɛ́.

eng_Latn: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ā ká ē lɛ iyē kú um nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá dúúmā í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā jé píii. Ń klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā je uwēyī lɛ iyē kú um igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwɔhá ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā á.

eng_Latn: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɔbá ɛna ā ŋmó ā, é kwú ɔyí ā ú gé lɛ Ɛ́lāyi.

eng_Latn: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ í yá ká ɔ̄ gbɛlá ka anúɔ fíyɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu aɔ́mpa nū ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ híī yíkpɛ́yí olɔfú tá aíne kú Óndú ā ɔwɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ géē cɔcɛ́ iháyí alɛwa. Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū klla í cɔcɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ayááyí eyi ga ayááyí ɔhá, iháyí alɛwa nēe gē wā a.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó nɛ̄ Umósīsi le ɛlā ka mɛ ā, ajɛ ɛga nēé háyi ā kwú hɛ́ ɛpa kɔ.

eng_Latn: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā klla kahíníī, Alɔ le má ka ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he uwá á. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē jɛ̄ gɔbū á. Eko dúúmā nēé le Ɔwɔicō jámá nɛɛ, ɔdā dúúmā í gē yá uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā klla le otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ɔhá mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ofɛpa ce igwó ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá da Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔcɛ́ ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ̄ gā.

eng_Latn: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yēeyī ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú um lɛ mu odúúdu ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mpa: Udódāyi, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ahóhi. Umíklɔtu kpókónu ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō lā áklɔ̄kpɛ ipú ígbíli, fíyɛ́ ō lā inu mla, ɔnyā ikpɛ́lā nōo klla ī ka ífulá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ lɛ tá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ aɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi túbá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī áfū lɛ ɔ́ plla.

eng_Latn: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá habɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ dúúmā bīya ā tá lɛ uwá ayíka é habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá lɛ uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá habɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā tá lɛ uwá ŋ́, ayíka é habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔbúgwū le ogwú tū eko ɔ́ɔmā á, anɔ́ɔ Upíta le blakwu ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si tɛtɛ da ɔ́ kahíníī, Gbɔbū kú ɔbúgwū kóō tōgwú igbo ɛpa ā, a géē híhó igbo ɛtá ka anúɔ í jé um ŋ́. Ó fōtíikwū kpóo, ó jikwū ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le pīyeyī gáā nyɔ̄ ā, Usɔ́lu bī okónōgwu kú awulú kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú híla tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
idu_Latn: Ó le eyī plla tū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú ufi anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ, Óndú um? Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkɔ nāa gē gbā mɛ́mla ɛhi kú uwɔ nāa gē je ā le tíicō iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ɛɛ́, ó kē yɔ̄ ī tá uwɔ ohi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú alɔ ipú ɛcɛ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ nōo yɔ̄ í tíne obobowú ō lɛ ɛyí kwu ɔ̄ ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yúklɔ́ ɔ́gwū nōo ī gbēyī ulé kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo cījáalí ā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē tá ɛcɔ̄ aflɛ́yí fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ aá, ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ ohile kéē gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɛcɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā á. Ó ka ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā bī le nū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu úklɔ́ idáagó nōó yá ā, ɔdā idáagó mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú hɛ́ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
idu_Latn: Nááná, ɔ́dāŋ́ keé lɛ olófi dúú hɛ́ óndú ɛna ā, ó géē gbā ɔ̄ kwɛyí oyēeyī kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ oyēeyī kú nū fūla.

eng_Latn: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
idu_Latn: Ményīnyi um, Ɔwɔicō, ményinyi um. Ohígbū ka awɔ gē lɛ ɛlá kwu um á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ugwū gē lɛ acá klá ayí nū ā, nāa gē gbō um, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ owu nɛ̄hi kú ífi ā le tá gaá le yɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ le lɛ ā, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā kóō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú, kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ācɛ nēe cíka ō gwō ɔ́ci kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó ŋmó ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá hɛ́, ká aá bī gé lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ucɛ ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. É le éŋkpɔ̄ ā hɛ́ bī nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
idu_Latn: Awɔ gē mafú ɔdā ō lipú mɛ́mla ɔdōtayínū nɛ̄hi ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á. A jé ɔdā nōo tá ipú obū ā. Ɔlá ō fíyajɛ kē lɛ ɔ́ uwɔ yɛ jīla tá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā, géē bī āyā kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú nū gē lɛ Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: In any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down, that he may sleep in his own raiment, and bless thee: and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛ́ɛ bēē kpó īlī ā gē lɛ ɔ́ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ le klá iyē gbiyɔ̄lā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ yá lɛ ā, ɔtū ɔ́ɔ géē he ɔ̄cɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū uwā ɔ́ɔ géē he Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō kóō le yá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ɔdā nōó tɛtɛ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jé ŋ́ mā jé, ɛlā nōó le tū lɛ ucē dóódu, ɛlā kú oyéyījii ɔkwɛ̄yi nēé tɛtɛ jé ŋ́. Ɔdōtayínū ā wɛ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú aá, ɛ̄nyā kē í yá kú aá géē báana ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō mla anú.

eng_Latn: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā bá ī tá opo gboce uwá á: Usekaríya, ɔyí kú Ujonátan, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ussɛmáya nɛ̄ aádáádā nū wɛ, Umataníya, Umíkāya mɛ́mla Usákɔ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu ā, mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ámālēki lā Unégēbu, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Ujébūsi, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔn lā ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ācɛ kú Ukénan lā pīya ísu kú Umeditarénīya mɛ́mla okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā á.

eng_Latn: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ī gē yúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, amáŋ é ī yúklɔ́ ohígbū ɔdā nēé í lé. É gē bī ɔkɔ-olɔnyɛ mɛ́mla ɛlā ō yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɛ́ gē wɔ́tū kú ācɛ nēe wɛ ogwuda kú ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nōo yɔ̄ eko nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá Ugálīli gā ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni kóō lɛ Ubatísim yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú um nɛ̄ n je á. Awɔ gē yá odúúdú ɛgbá kú um gā um á. Ɔdā dóódu kú um yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aódungwɔ̄wɛ nɛ̄hi ā nwūla. Aá lɛ aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú íkée ā nwūla foóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā, kóō lɛ bēhe wā inu.

eng_Latn: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
idu_Latn: Aá tū iyī aá wāajɛ eko dóódu, aá gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ, aá lɔtūlé. Aá ma ihɔtū kú áa fú o ŋmá lɛ ībū kú ɔ́mpa aá nɛ̄ aá gē cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ ohígbū olɔhi kú aá. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ayíka aá yúufi uwā, ohígbū ka ɔfú nēé je lɛ uwá kéē le yá ācɛ italā ā í wɛ icííci ŋ́. É wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nēe gē yá ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí italā kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíja le tá Usárefāti, abɔ̄ ó gā okómpinu kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, ó má ɔnyōkwú éyi yɔ̄ í ce ɛfú. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ je ga um ká n̄ gwá.

eng_Latn: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō gā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá. Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú agbénú kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ú cīgbīhi lɛ uwá, ɔtū kóō he Ujékɔ̄pu, Ísrɛ̄lu kóō gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo bī aócíbú ahāapa nɛ̄ aámíyā nɛ̄hi ámōōmɛ ā bá ipú uwā ā, gā ɛgiyí um yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Wā cɛ́ɛ́ ka n lɛ ɔnyā nɛ̄ Ɔyí álá ā gáā lɛ ā mafú ga awɔ.

eng_Latn: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ami ā gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo gē cɛ̄tra awɔ, klla í ka ka ɔfú kú uwɔ le yálé ga uwɔ ɛɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dúúmā kwú pīya akwuna. Ó le uwēyī je lɛ ádā nū ɛɛ́. É géē je ɔyínɔ̄nyā ɔ́ɔmā yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
idu_Latn: Íne nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu bīya ā le yá kéē lɛ ɔhā nɛ̄hi hɛ́ce ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ, ogwōnū kú uwā kē le yá kéē lɛ ɔhā nɛ̄hi hɛ́ ce aílɔ́wá. Ó i lɛ ā ɔhā ā í nwuné nɛ̄hi eko nēé lɛ odúúdú áluka kú ācɛ Ujíyu ka tū ipú ācɛ nēé le nyatá ā!.

eng_Latn: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ipú ufuufi ipú oyēeyī kú uwā piyóó, otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
idu_Latn: É kwú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ bōōbū, é klla le pɛ́ ga ɔlíkɔtɔ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū Ujerúsālɛm á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ̄ wā kú aá kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá Usáyɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā, ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi da ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cīīce ɛyí ojuja ā kahíníī, Kwú ɛwa o cɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ú ká ā cɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ohígbū ka eko nēé ī cɔ̄dɛhɔ ā le yá ɛɛ́. Ɛcɛ le pīya kéē cē ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó lɛ uwá kɔ̄ ígwu ɛtá, má tayínū ipácí bá ī gbēyī uwā. Eko nōó má ācɛ ā bá í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī ā, ó gā ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nōó tayínū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
idu_Latn: É ka aá gbɛlá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yúufi nū ā le yá ɔkwɛ̄yi, ayááyí aá lɔfú da ayááyí uwā glá ka, éē má ɔ̄ wɛ́ɛ́, ka aádáádā aá gwó ede nōo wɛ ɛ́gblá kú ákú Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú ō gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ámāŋ ka ogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā anú ŋ́. Amáŋ ó wɛ ɔdā ō blakwu ɔdā nōo yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ɔhá ā gē leyīkwu ijē kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɛ́hi ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī gé lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú Aícɔ́ɔja ofu cigwó ā bá yɔ̄ á. Ásāhɛlu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu. Ɛlhánan, ɔyí kú Udódo nōo ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m ā.

eng_Latn: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú yá ā. N yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē ohígbū ka ó le um hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
idu_Latn: É le aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofu cigwó ɔhá kpó kwú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ nēé kpó kwú ā kpó ga ɔ́kɔngɔ̄ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ussɛlá ā, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wā í ca klá ɛcɔ̄ ɛháajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū gē wú um nɛ̄hi eko dúú nɛ̄ n gbɛlá kwu ācobɔ̄bíipú, nēe bá ī bīya íne kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu kéē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nēé lɛ tá ajɛ kú Ukénan ā á.

eng_Latn: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
idu_Latn: A híī cɔ̄nū tū alɔ piyóó jāā ga ajaajɛ ŋ́? Amáŋ abɔ̄ aá gē kɛlā lɛ ā nááná, aá bá gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ aá fū ɔ̄ iyē yá glá ā.

eng_Latn: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
idu_Latn: ka abahi mɛ́mla éeyē kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ eko kpíí ōfōōfūnū ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ō yá olɔhi ā gē mīyɛ ulé kú nū ɛcɛ amānyā, a cíkā ō jé ka, é géē yá ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācobīyíne ā italā kú ɔdā nēé yá ā ipú ɛcɛ nyā piíí.

eng_Latn: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ jé odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ádā anúɔ, Udéfīdi kpɛ́mm ā. Ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔ̄ italā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, ogbɛhá ā gekwú, anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kwú odo kú nū ú ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kóō gáā yɔ̄ mla Ébrahām á. Olagbénú ā gekwú, é kē lɛ ɔ́ nyi.

eng_Latn: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
idu_Latn: N géē gbɔ́ɔ ō gbāajɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nɛ̄ ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja yɛ ipú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛ abɔ̄ da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛyí tāajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um móōwē lɛ ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le ɔ́da je lɛ Ɔwolímanya, kóō límanya, Ó gē kwúcē wā í da uwɔ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ a tū um ā, n le ɔ́ yá kwɛyí ɛɛ́. Iní ɔhá nɛ̄ n géē nyɔ̄ āā?.

eng_Latn: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā mɛ́mla Umɔ́dɛkāyi mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu ā kahíníī, Áa má ɔ̄, n kwú Uháman ú tōolī, ohígbū ojuju obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ujɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tū tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɛɛ́. N klla kwú odúúdú agbénú kú nū ú kpó lɛ Ɛ́sta ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
idu_Latn: É gáā má ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n̄ gē je le ádā uwā ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēe leyī gwō um bónū ā í gáā bēhé ga ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō lɛ oyéeyī tū ɔ̄ gā uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ayááyí kú uwɔ má. Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ a, ācɛ ookwuɛyí ācɛ gēe wā ŋmá abɔ̄ wā ísu kú Unáyilu ipú úgbéenyi nēé bī ɔcí mla ɔŋma gwo a. Aócɛ̄hɔ̄, aá kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ aá fíyaa, Aá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ a kwúcē nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ la ācɛ ajɛ kú aá, nɛ̄ ísu lɛ ɔɔ kpó kɔ̄ a. Aá nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ a la ewo oolɛɔfú nɛ̄hi kú aá a, mla aɔ́báagwu kú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá nēe jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi a, uwá nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ gē yá ufi uwá a.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā kahíníī, Ó gáā ŋmó iyī nū nɛɛ? Ɔdí nōó bī ɔtū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ka, Ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ā, aá wā abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
idu_Latn: Óndú, ó lɛ ɔdā ɛpa nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā kú ā yá gā um ɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ kwú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndū a kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ayisáya, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um tóohɛ́ɛwa lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ iháyí ɛtá, tá ipu ɔlɛ a yɔ̄ í yɛ a, wɛ ɔdā ocēabɔ̄ kú ɔdā nōo gāa yá Íjīpiti mla Itiopīa.

eng_Latn: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
idu_Latn: Ó wā kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nɛ̄ íne ā ī gbō ā nyatá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ le pīya ayí kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ igbīhi ú cē kwu uwá, habɔ̄ uwā tá kéē gbō aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ̄gbā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ɔkpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ó wɛ ami nɛ̄ aá ŋmó ɛbɛ́ le gwɛ́ɛya gā um ipú ígbíli iháyí ofɛpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
idu_Latn: Uréhobɔ̄wam lɛ úklɔ́ kpó kɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú ayí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ uwá kpó bá odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn ā. Ó leyīkwu uwá lɔhi klla lɛ anyā alɛwa kpó lɛ lɛ odúúdú uwá.

eng_Latn: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya ā má cīce icō gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā á anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ bītá ga ɛgiyí ɛ́nɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, aótrɛ̄yí kú inu kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe gē wɔ́tū ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa klla gē je ɔdōlɔhi pīya ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ Ɔwɔicō gbla anú glá āa? Ɔdí nɛ̄ a géē ka ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā?.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urebéka da Áyísīki kahíníī, Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú anyā kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti nɛ̄ Ísɔ lɛ le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ujékɔ̄pu lɛ éyi kú ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ɔhá lɛ gɛɛ, ayíka n géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá wā í yɛce um, n géē nwū aá kú aá le pīya ācɛ o kwú ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ámɔn nyā, aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujɛrúsālɛm, Uhɛ́brɔn, Ujamútu, Ulákisi mɛ́mla Églɔn, le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā pīya tɔ̄há le ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ Ugíbeyɔn yɛ jīla tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tá uwā.

eng_Latn: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ébram mɛ́ɛbɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó pó ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō wā í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā yúúfi ŋ́, ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbō uwɔ á, n géē gbā ulé nɛ̄hi ga uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔwɛ nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú alɔ í yɛ ā mīya táajɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ɔdā nōo í yá ɔ̄ ā, abɔ̄ Óndú ōfōōfūnū gē jé ɛga nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ī nyɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
idu_Latn: Ōhī kú ikpɔ̄dā ā le pɛ́ bá ipú ujē. Ujē ā le jɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ujē ā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jɛ̄ glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
idu_Latn: Amásīya le ojuju yá mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujɛhówāssi ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́hōhassi, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ujéhu kɔ́ɔ̄ wā kú aá kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nya nēé fu ā, hokónu tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaohnechoh.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyākim gē mīyɛ ije kú ɛ̄gbā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ujúda ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ agbénú kú uwá lɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē má ije le cílá ulé ɛ̄gbā kú abɔ̄fú lɛ Uféro Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla āyā kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ɔ́ bītá, jāā gā Ugíligalu á, Ucímham kē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ kwú ŋmókókó klla kwu ŋmɔ́lá ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́. Kwu ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō le ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄, nōo hímáyi kɛlā mla um ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ́dí bá yɔ̄ ā, Óndú um.

eng_Latn: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
idu_Latn: A ke jé ka ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa gwō tū ipú ínōbīya nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó iyīnū dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ lɛ ɛgahi kú abɔ̄yīnū, ɔyā lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɛgahi ɔhá, aínyílɔ́wɔ kē lɛ ɛdɔ ɛgahi ɔhá. Ɛgahi ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kōō yɔ̄ ipú aínyílɔ́wɔ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá nēe lé ka Ubábīlɔn, nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ aá ā, é géē je uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ klla í tá ɔ̄ wā ajɛ. Ubábīlɔn géē wɛ éwo nōó cɛgbá ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ó kē géē je ŋmíkpākplā, í je pīya ígbíli.

eng_Latn: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú uwɔ le ɔlɛ́ uwā gwó abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ̄ ā lɔhi ā, a le ɔdā nɛ̄ aógbɛhá cɛgbá ā je lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ó lɛ odée nōó cɛ̄ lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yá abālɔbányā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, aá kē jé ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā. Ɛpléeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kóō le kpaakpa ā, Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā ī bī iyī nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
idu_Latn: Eko kú iháyí ahāapa kú ɔdōlé ō cabá nɛ̄hi ā, ajɛ ā yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Óndú tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ijakī ā mɛ́mla ɔyí nū kpó wā. É lɛ úwé kú uwā kpó klá uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó má ce ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le tá ɛgiyí Umeri, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N hokónu tū uwɔ! Ɔwɔicō kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ nōo téeyī olɔhi kú nū ā. Ákú uwɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛnyā á.

eng_Latn: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da um kahíníī, Kɛlā cɛ̄ lɛ aíkpokwú nyā, ká ā da uwá ká ē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á. Amáŋ ɔhá kahíníī, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē ŋmá Ugálīli nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lɛ ɔtūce uwá glá ŋ́, ācɛ nēé lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ le mu uwá ipú hile, ācɛ nēe géē piyɔtū abahi fíyɛ́ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, aɛ́pa kú uwā wā iyɔ̄bu gaá ka kahíní, Ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, N lɔfú ca Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā tāajɛ, kú n̄ klla gwó ɔ̄ ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá glá.

eng_Latn: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ádā uwɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ ā, anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōo ka ɛ̄nyā gā uwɔ ŋ́ má. Ohígbū ka ó jé ka ɔtū géē wú uwɔ nɛ̄hi. Ɔkwɛ̄yi n da uwɔ ka, ikpó ékpónú tá ɔtahɛ̄ ami mla ikwū abālɔbányā á.

eng_Latn: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ukɔ́ kú um ā wɛ o yá kú alɔ yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa alɔ ŋmá ɔtū oyēŋēē, mla ɔtū nōó gáā ŋmó alɔ ɛ̄pɔ̄bí kú ɔdobɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́ mɛ́mla o yá kú aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ɔwɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū nyɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī usábāti nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ma ajɛ klla nwūla eyī kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é lɛ alagbá olɔfíikpó éyi yɔ̄, nēé hī ka Ubárābasi.

eng_Latn: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm í ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ Amnɔn ŋ́. Amáŋ ó wɔ́tū Ámnɔn nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ohígbū Utáma, ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā, nɛ̄ Ámnɔn hɛ́báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ idáagó ká aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá Ukéna kú Ugálīli á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgahi mɛ́mla ɔfú kú nū mafú, o ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā á. Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
idu_Latn: Aá bī aálá kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú aá, gé um ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē bī ɛya ōgwo kú aá le ojīlīma ce um ŋ́. Ń kē je unwalu lɛ aá, ŋmá lɛ ō da aá ka aá kpó aɔ́da ɛ̄gbā gé um ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je unwalu kú ɔtulalī otu ɔlá lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛɛnɛ ce úlā ahātá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
idu_Latn: N gē yɛce ɔ̄ ɔwɛ ɛga nōó gē yɛ ā. N gē yɛce ɔwɛ kú nū nōó mafú gā um ā kpaakpa, í kē nyā ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛbéenyi kú ísu ā le pɛ́ gekwú. Ísu ā gbɔɔ́ ō níípú nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū gwá glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Oyī ā yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
idu_Latn: Ó le áblákpá kú oje wu ikpó, klla le óbō nɛ̄hi éyi cíla ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́wá kú efūma le ɔfú kpó kwu ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛɛ́, é lɔfú nɛ̄hi, é klla lɛwa nɛ̄hi nēé tōō gbaáluka ŋ́. Ayīnu kú uwā lulé bɛ̄ɛka ayīnu kú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛcɛ ā géē je pīya ígbíli ohígbū ɔbíipú nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nōo lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
idu_Latn: nyɔ̄ ga Unínīfɛ, ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔna tá lɛ ācɛ ā ka anúɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bɔ̄bíipú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ lɛ tá ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ géē fu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē kpó odúúdú iyó kú ɛya nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ā nyɔ̄ á. Ɛya kú uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē kpó yɔlá dúúdú, éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛhi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cokónu kú nū lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē je ɔdɔ kú aɛ́ga olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Umówābu catāajɛ í je uwā gbā munuu le pīya úmúlá.

eng_Latn: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gaá le jila iyɔ̄bū ikpáti kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ é bī álá mɛ́mla aɛ́na nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwā í tōō gba áluka ŋ́, le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe géē hile ā géē gwéeyē klla gwíjē kú éeyē. Ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ géē cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
idu_Latn: Aá gēe bā í gwó ijē ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ka, N gēe tá uwɔ ahínyá pióo, o Óndú! Náaná nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ cɛ̄ ɔnū mla um a, íwɔ́tū mla ɔnū oōcē kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ ɛɛ́, Á kē lɛ um ɔtū tū kwu ɔtu ɛɛ.

eng_Latn: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n cījáalí kú iyī um, ijáalí ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Abram; the same is Abraham.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ébram .

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu í gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā da ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā kahíníī, Íkókwū nɛ̄ ejé wɛ omōōmu nū nyā kwɛyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛ ā. Mīyɛ íkókwū ā ká ā le bī gé lɛ odúúdú aéwo nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá kéē le gwá ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā tá Ujóssuwa ohi kahíníí, Ɔdā dúúdú nɛ̄ a da alɔ ā, alɔ géē yá ɔ̄. Ɛga dúúmā nāa tū alɔ nyɔ̄, alɔ géē nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé ī hɛ́pɔ̄ kú nū, kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé. Kwú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó géē gbā ú pīya ínoōbīya ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ um ā kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū aóklóbīya nū ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ cíí. Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ŋmá iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, ká ā da alɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
idu_Latn: Lɛ oyēeyī ōlīgbō je lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yēeyī nyɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ, ka iyē kú nū kóō híī bī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gwéeyē tá uwá, n géē yá ka aéwo kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā ká e wā í lɛ aá yálé. É géē kwú aádɛ́fú kú uwá ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá klla í bá ipú aá abɔ́ɔ. É géē je īkpɔ̄cí mɛ́mla amɛ̄ ɛna nōo cíkā o wɛ ákú aá ā kpó lé, klla kwú gwá.

eng_Latn: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ussílo ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan ajaajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ bá abɔ́ɔ ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Elísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
idu_Latn: N jé ka n le kpaakpa, ń kē gáā cɔ̄nyā koó lɛ ā ŋ́ gbóōgbóō ŋ́. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ajɛ klá um, ɔtū kú um í gáā ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
