idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram yɔ̄ ī yɛ ga iyɔ̄bū, nyɔ̄ ga ɛháajɛ kú Ukénan, lɛyíkwu ɛga nēé gē hī ka Unégēbu ā á.

eng_Latn: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
idu_Latn: Aá kóō lɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n le íne ce ɔ́ kú aá kóō híī yúklɔ́ anú ŋ́ mā tū kóō wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ. Aá yá ɔdā abɔ̄yī aá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Aá kóō jé ile kú ɛ̄cī ō tīihɔ kú um ā, ka aá kē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ oŋmá lɛ o klá ɛgéégée cíí, í ga iyāwu ŋ́, ka aá yúúklɔ́ dúúmā ŋ́, ka aá kē gwó abɔ̄ waagada yɔ̄ ī kɔ̄ɔ̄kā icííci ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá cɛ̄ lɛ iyɔ̄ɔnɔ kwú uwɔ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbó uwɔ ā, í gē gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē lɔhi nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ óndú nū gā ā, ó má ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nōó da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le ācɛ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā pi abɔ̄fú ka ɛ́ɛ̄ bī ɔdu mɛ́mla āgā mɛ́mla usɔ́ɔ kéē le yúklɔ́ kú ublɔ́kwu ō mā. Ɔdā éékpó ɔ́ɔmā nōó yá mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi ohile kú ācɛ Ámɔn á. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwúcē le tá Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
idu_Latn: ɔdōlé dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē má ipú ajɛ á, ó géē wúla klá anú gbɔɔ́ ō lé, amáŋ ó kē gáā nū ɔ̄ ipú ŋ́. É kllá gbɔɔ́ ō je ayí uwā kpó lé dúú, náaná ɛmiyɛ kú uwá í kē gáā mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔdā okpaakpa éyi nɛ̄ aá ī yá. Ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ígwu nōo ī yɛce Uníkōlāwus ā gē yá ā gē wu aá ɔtū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē wu um ɔtū ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
idu_Latn: Ā híī yá oklóbīya tá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ánya mɛ́mla ɔtū ōkpúúlú obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē yɛ mla ɔ̄cɛ ocɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí nēé hí ka ólíifu kú uwā géē yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ɛga dóódu ipú ajɛ ā, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā yá anɔ̄ ŋmá anú glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka īkpō kú nū géē je kpó wū bónū.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo yá ā yɔ̄ á. Óndú ā yá ká ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā kéē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gā awɔ. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū le ífi miya tū uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛlā ka mɛ́mla Ébrahām kwɛyí ā, ó le yɛ tá ɔkpáncō ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
idu_Latn: N gē fíyá odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá pī ɔɔ ā ákátā ga ɛbɛɛbɛ. Kwu aígab kú nū, ācɛ o nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē gbō ɔ ɛyí ā. N klla í fu ācɛ kwu uwá kéē tíne uwā kéē ŋmó uwā.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Erán wɛ ayí kú Ussutéla.

eng_Latn: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
idu_Latn: Eyīyōce nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ekli o kwajɛ kú oyēeyī kú alɔ ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le jé kpɔ́cíí ka alɔ le nyatá, ó le alɔ bī bū īlī ō hókómpinu igbó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú ɔkpáncō nēé ī bēhé nū ga ɛgotīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ lɔfú yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū nū. A híī klá ɛga obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko gē wā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá aólɔfú nēe bá ɔkpāncō ā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ nēe ī gbāājɛ ɛcɛ ā italā.

eng_Latn: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
idu_Latn: Aígbáanɔ, aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō lɛ ipú piyajɛ ɛpɛɛpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā lɛ ā géē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ uwā tū oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nēé le nwū ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī, ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō jéeyī fíyɛ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nēé le nwū ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa, ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jé odée fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gāajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le Umósīsi hīgwú ga ɛyí ɛfu ā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le tíicō ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ipú ɔyā odunkwulu jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ ā gbɔɔ́ ō cē bla aá ɛnwū, nɛ̄ó kwú cá aá eyī. Ɔdā nyā géē yá ohígbū ka aá tá Óndú ā nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ā, gē jikwū kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi éyi nēé hī ka Ugamalīyelu, itíca kú íne, ɛ̄nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, cāŋjɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ uwá nū gɛɛcɛ eko lígíí ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɔkpá kú ajɛ nyā ɛpa ā ú á, kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ é tá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je ajɛ ā lá lɛ ā tū ɔ̄, lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gwu mla ɔja ā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é gwu mla ɔja ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ n miya ka n géē nya aá tá ā le yá, n géē tá aá abɔ̄. N géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú nū ā lɛ aá. N kē le aá fu cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bī okónu nɛ̄ n ce ka aéwɔhá géē leyī ōce dúú ā bī nyɔ̄ í ka lɛ uwá. N géē yá ka aá gaá lɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nōo tá alácɛ̄ ā túgwó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē pɛ́ wā í lā ipú ajɛ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: A géē kwú ɛbɔ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kē yá uculo kú ikwū kú aádā uwɔ, aɔ́cɛ́ nēe tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū ga uwɔ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē yá ga uwɔ klla í jikwū uwɔ, géē yēkwu kú uwɔ dúu á. É géē dɛ̄ kahíníī, Eléélelé! Ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ gekwú ɛɛ́! Ami abɔ̄yī um cokónu nyā á.

eng_Latn: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
idu_Latn: A bī íjééyī yɔ̄ ī tá ɔ́sú klla yɔ̄ ī lɛ itene. Agbénú kú uwɔ ā cɛ̄ ga uwɔ ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ́ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujése ka, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū, kú ɔ̄ yɔ̄ mla anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
idu_Latn: N le yɛ tá Ujerúsālɛm. N yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gāājɛ ɔlɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, ó má útú nɛ̄ ō hɛ́ abɔ́ɔ ā. Ó pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ bá gē tɛ̄gíkwū, klla bá gē jikwū gbōmgbōm lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ, Usálu, ɔyí kú Uméssūlam, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ujówēdi. aádáádā nū ohile wɛ, Upedáya, Ukoláya, Umáaséya, Itíyɛlu mɛ́mla Ujessáya.

eng_Latn: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ bá ipú ajɛ ā, klla í yá kéē jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nēé gē yá ā. Ó klla ka ácɛ nēé hī ka Ń ményinyi uwɔ ŋ́ mā, ka anúɔ í ményinyi uwā. Ka ācɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ hī ka É wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́ mā, géē pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Ó klla ka ācɛ ā géē tóohi ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi gaá le ugóolu kpó ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, agblɔ̄cɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ú kpó gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya á. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā nááná í kōō cē unwalu kú nū ā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá á, n jé álá kú um, álá kú um kē jé um. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā je um ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n kē jé Ádā ā á. N géē je oyēeyī kú um kwɛyí ákú aálá kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́cí nū, igbīhi nɛ Upássɔ le Ujeremíya hɛ́tá ŋmá agbá ā, Ujeremíya da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā í hī uwɔ ka Upássɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ iyē nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ga uwɔ ā lé ka, Ɔdōtūufi le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí.

eng_Latn: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: A klla gēe kpó odúúdú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nāa géē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ajɛ kú um ā, mɛ́mla ɛhi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya géē je lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, ga Ujerúsālɛm. A géē kpó uwā bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
idu_Latn: Ɛlam gwutá ipú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ipú ɛfú ā. Únóji kú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū le jīla tū ákú nū. Odúúdú uwā í wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, é kē kpó uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. Eko nēé yēeyī ā, é ī tū ācɛ ufi amáŋ é gekwú uwēyī kē lɛ uwá kwú ɔlékwū ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nōo gē yá ācɛ nēé ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā, yá uwā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
idu_Latn: Odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī ā géē je ca tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kōtōō ā. Igelī ā abɔ̄yī nū géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā nēé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíjē, ma ɔ̄ tá tá ohɛ́ɛwa, nōo yājɛ ajɛ yɔ̄ ī jikwū, klla ī yá ɔtūnōbí ā.

eng_Latn: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umánōwa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka eko nɛ̄ ɛlā kú nū ā ɔ́ le cɛ̄, ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɔyí ā gáā wɛ āa? Ɔdí nōó géē yá ā. Ɛdɔ oyēeyī nyá nōó géē lā āa?.

eng_Latn: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɛfu áncā a, aa je otúta ga icɔ̄, aá dɛ̄gba gbōm gbōm, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá hī aícɔ́ɔja igwú cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá jé abɔ̄ kú aá gā icō ka ō wɛ ɔdā oōceabɔ̄ kú ookpó ācɛ okpo a ɛfú wā ípu igá kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú ācɛ ooya ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ a.

eng_Latn: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwā, da uwá kahíníī, Aá cāŋjɛ, aá yúúfi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī hī um ka, Óndú, Óndú, náána nɛ̄ áa kē ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aá ā ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū, nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yúnwū nū ā yɔ̄ ī mɛ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē ī yá ɔdā nōo ŋmá ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō ā géē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēé yá ōwē icíci ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yá āa lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō wɛ ákú aá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ó da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, cāŋjɛ háyi icō. N tíne ō kɛlā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú iyē gɛ ŋ́, o ŋmá ɔtīkpó kú aá jāā gaá kwu īkpɛ̄yí kú aá wɛ ágbáágbe, ínálēgbē-ínálēgbé mɛ́mla ámáámata. É kōō lɛ anōlé tū ɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō liiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ifu pí bónū ŋmá anú ŋ́. É kōō na ágbe ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō ī kɛlā ō lɛ ɛcí tū ɔ̄ dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ge nwū ācɛ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí kéē lɛ ɔbá ámāŋ ka o lɛ ɔnyā. É ka ācɛ kéē híī lé ɛdɔ ɔdōlé ɔhi ŋ́ dúú. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdōlé ká ācɛ kéē lé, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā wā í bá tɔ̄há lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ é le jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kpó anɔ́ɔ áwa ɛpa nááná é bá ī dɛ̄gba yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ékpó ā kahíníī, Átɛ̄misi kú ācɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi nwunééné á.

eng_Latn: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, n jikwū klá awɔ, amáŋ á tá um ohi ŋ́. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ̄ gā uwɔ, amáŋ á jāhɔ̄ ga um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɔhi klla le kpaakpa ā, ó ge nwū ācobīyíne ɔwɛ nōo cíkā kéē yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n bī iyē otīihɔ kú um lɛ okónu ce ɛɛ́ ma ka ń gáā kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ Udéfīdi gbóógbóō ŋ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ géē leyīkwu aá bɛ̄ɛka é wɛ aádā kú aá ā. Aɔ́nyɔ̄cɛ́ kē ī téyī tá aá bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́nɛ́ nēe ma aá ā. É géē túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū aá, kllá í lɛ ojīlīma nɛ̄hi ce aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka amí ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī lɔtūce um, uwēyī í gáā kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka é kōō lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bu jāā ga ɔlékwū, nááná, n géē kwú uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. É kōō le icō tū ga ɔkpáncō, nááná n géē pi uwá wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikpííkpo ɔ́ɔma oyī nɛ̄ ō yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ā mɛ. Ó kē le jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iyē kú nū mɛɛ lɛ ā, ka anúɔ le hɛ́tá ŋmá unwalu kú anúɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɔ̄cí kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ofɛnɛ cigwɛ́ɛhīlī yɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū dóódu. Opīyatɔ̄há kú odúúdú aíkpɔ̄cí upɔmegrɛ́nēeti nēé bī hijā tū ɔ̄ ā wɛ ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
idu_Latn: Lɛlá kwu ɔdā nāa ī ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbō oyēeyī kú uwɔ ŋmá unwalu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ge lɛ ɛlá tū ipú ŋ́, gē kɛlā daála, géē je iyī nū yíífi nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwu āgā ú ce ɛgba kú ɔcí kóō hɛ́ ɔ̄ wāajɛ ɛɛ́. Ó géē hɛ́ ɔcí dúúmā nōó gwá ikpo olɔhi ŋ́ ma cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ kpótū ipú ɔlá.

eng_Latn: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī gbēyī jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ aólɛlā kú nū yá ɔdā ōlikpó ce ɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔnyōkwū éyi nōo lā ipú igelī ékpó ɔ́ɔmā. Ó gē wā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ ā gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ hɛ́ lɛ anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ í yá anúɔ ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
idu_Latn: géē jé ɔnɔ kú italā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū géē yá ɔ̄ ohígbū ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gwá ejé olɔfú nēé lɛ ɔdā dúú pū ɔ̄ ipú ŋ́ mā. É géē bī ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ōwō le yá ācɛ nēe bá nyā ōwē ipéyī aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ipéyī Ɔyí álá ā.

eng_Latn: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá ucē gbla ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́, amáŋ je ɛga lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a gē gbɛlá ā pīyabɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ a géē jé odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe lɔhi klla he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē yɔ̄ ī jikwú gbōmgbōm ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nɛ̄ ɛdɔ nū í yɔ̄ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɛdɔ nū í klla gáā yɔ̄ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá kéē nwū aá ɔdā dúú lɛyí ubatísim gɛ ŋ́, abɔ̄ ō lɛ ce ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí, ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kú ācɛ nēe gekwú, mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í ka tū ācɛ nōó lɛ ō pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
idu_Latn: N gaá gwū ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ okwáhi mɛ́mla oyújulu tá.

eng_Latn: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unaómi da Urútu kɔ́ ɔ̄ lɛ iyē gwā, kɔ́ ɔ̄ lɛ ɔtulalī tū iyē, kɔ́ ɔ̄ klla lɛ īlī kú nū nɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā kpó wu iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ Ubówāsi ɔ́ɔ gē tá īkpɔ̄dā owu ā. Ó da ɔ́ ka amáŋ, ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jé ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdōlé lé, klla le enyi gwá.

eng_Latn: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
idu_Latn: Ujóna kahíníī, Ipú ɛ́kɛma kú um, Óndú ā, n le igwú hī uwɔ, A kē cɛ̄ igwú kú um. O ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɔlékwū o lipú, N le ɔkɔ gbā gā uwɔ ká ā tú um abɔ̄, a ké lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pó.

eng_Latn: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā nōo wɛ okoolo ɛtá kú umu mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛpa kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu.

eng_Latn: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú yɛce ɔwɛ kú ɛcí ōpā kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó kwú ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū éyi ú ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɛcí. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā gbla ucē kú aéwo ɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ hīla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ gē pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubɛ́tani ga Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɛmiyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔyí omlede éyi ā ú gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ a klla kwú ɔhá ā ú gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń gáā mīyɛ odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn ŋ́. Ń klla gáā yá ɛ̄nyā eko nōó yēeyī nyā ŋ́, ohígbū Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ um fu, nōo kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú um ā.

eng_Latn: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
idu_Latn: A mīyɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, a klla lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. A klla kwú ɔflā kú ugóolu ú kwu ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō aálekwu kú ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā gē fīyégbúlú kú ufi ɔlékwū, nōo yɔ̄ ipú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá pó ɛlā kú um ŋ́ mā ā? Ohígbū ka aá jɛ́yí ɛlā kú um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó gwū, klla kwú ɔlá kú agege kú Óndú ā ú nyí. É yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
idu_Latn: N da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ajɛ ā je catāajɛ klla má táncá bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɛ anú glá ŋ́ mā? Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í jéeyī jɛ̄ nōo ī jé ɔdā nōo yá ā glá ŋ́. Á ka ɛyí nū lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó gē ka lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu kú uwā í bī gɛ ŋ́. Udéfīdi mīyɛ odúúdú ayí, anyā mla iyó kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ācɛ Ámālēki kpó ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Uféro, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ádā ɔbá nū kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā wɛ ákú nū ā, anú nɛ̄ n yīipú lɛ ɔ́ á. Aá má ɔ̄ káá, ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ ɔdā ō plɔkɔ nɛ̄ iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ anú mɛ́mla ɔ́ngbá kú nū mɛ́mla okwutɛ nēe bá ā wɛ ákú nū āa.

eng_Latn: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi géē tá abɔ́ɔ, nēé géē hī ɔ̄ɔ̄ ka, Ɔwɛ īkpāndrā kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā í gáā yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́. Ɔwɛ ā géē wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Olíla dúúmā í gáā nyīleyī gaá yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā le āhɔ̄ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi je lɛ Udánīyɛlu klla le ɔdā kú ɛhi alɛwa kpó lɛ ɔ́ á. Ó kwú Udánīyɛlu í pīya otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú Ubábīlɔn. Anú klla wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú ācojɔ́dā mɛ́mla ācójéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka odúúdú ācɛ le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, ń gáā kwu gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó he ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú Umasɛdónīya mɛ́mla Akáya ɔtū kéē da ɔdā ohígbū ācɛ ogbɛhá nēe bá ipú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū wɛ ocíbú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ éyi nē ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó ā. Odúúdu nū géē wɛ oōmu mla umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
idu_Latn: Uhága le ɔyí ma lɛ Ébram, anɔ́ɔ Ébram hī ɔ̄ ka Íssmɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu alɛwa wā gaá tū Umáta mɛ́mla Umerí ɔtūlé ohígbū ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ nōo kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ámáŋ nɛ̄ itekwū kwú cēnyi klɛ́ɛcɛ yɔ̄ ī túgbagwú mɛ́mla uya nɛ̄hi wulúwulú, nɛ̄ ɛfu kē yɔ̄ ī jíliyē lɔfú lɔfú.

eng_Latn: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄, klla lɛ eyī yɛ ɔ́. N le ɛlā éyi jé ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū nyā.

eng_Latn: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā, nōo wɛ ɛgwā kú ígblé ɔ́ɔmā, nōo wɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí nēé hi ka ebilíi ámāŋ ka Usétan ā, kwú abɔ̄fú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwu agbá ā ú kwu ɔ́, nōó ī yɔ̄ lɛ ā iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄wū nōo klá ómbilí ā ú ŋmá anú, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔnyā éyi cīce ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
idu_Latn: Ó da um kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄ oo, aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā le cē gbɔɔ ŋmá ɛhícō yɔ̄ ī wā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē cenyi yɔ̄ ī wā ā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo le cēenyi nɛ̄hi gē kpó ɔlɛ́ ā. É géē mīyɛ ajɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú aá mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú uwā ā tābɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ enyi nɛ̄hi gē cēenyi í kpó ɔlɛ́ klla gē kpó ācɛ ā. Ācɛ géē dɛ̄gba kú ācɛ kéē wā í tá uwā abɔ̄. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā géē bá ī jikwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí uwā klla wɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ulíbīni, Uhɛ́brɔn, Umáhli, Umússi, mɛ́mla Ukɔ́ra. Ukɔ́hāti wɛ ádā kú Ámram.

eng_Latn: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má lɛyíkwu Ɛ́dɔm. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gbá hī um ŋmá Ɛ́dɔm, yɔ̄ ī da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cogbāājɛ, eko nyā nɛ̄ otú ā gáā mɛ ā? Eko nyā nɛ̄ eyī gáā nya ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ kpií ā, Ujówāsi le tútū o glá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá.

eng_Latn: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔyípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ nū éyi hīīgwú, da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya ɔ́ɔmā le ɛ̄wā gɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ā, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú um bīya. É lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā, mɛ́mla íne nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā bīya. É le ɔdēelihɔ nēé cíkā ō kpó yíífi ā kpó kú abɔ̄yī uwā. É kwú uwā ú kpó uwī klla le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā lɛyíkwu ɔ́. É klla kwú ɔ́ ú kpó tū ipú iyó kú uwá.

eng_Latn: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó yɔ̄ pí um ŋ́, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ī bɛyíkwu um ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ gé um ŋ́, ayíka ó yɔ̄ gē fíyɛ́ uwā ákátā.

eng_Latn: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā í nyɔ̄ lɔhi ipú ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ alewa bá ī ŋmó ācɛ klla bá ī yá ikpala ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Ufilístiya má ā, ufi le ɔ́ kwú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ikwū nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī je Usáyɔn ā. É bá ī dɛ̄ kahíníī, É kwú alɔ í yíífi ɛɛ́. Uwēyī kē lɛ alɔ kwú dúúdú ɛɛ́. Alɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ piíí, ohígbū ka aólɛlā kwú aɔ́lɛ́ alɔ í wúlatāajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ō ka ífulá lɛbɛ̄ɛka, ɔwɔ nōo gē mí wílíwílí eko nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ ɛ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā má kwōkwū ajɛ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Óndú, lɛ ɔtūlé gā um, n géē cíla uwɔ odúúdú nū.

eng_Latn: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú bī ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla Ulífāyi ohile ā kwú áklɔ̄kpɛ nēé le ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā háyi ipú nū gbɔbū ā mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū ú kpó ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
idu_Latn: Aá le pīyabɔ̄ kú aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú nū le kɔ̄ ɛga ɛpa á. Ɔ̄cɛnyā nōó lɛ ɔbá ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jééjēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ gē lɛ ɔtū kú nū tá úklɔ́ kú Óndú ohígbū koó dɔɔ̄kā ō kwú iyī nū ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō, tu ɔkpiyē mɛ́mla alelékwū kú nū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo lɛ ɔbá gē lɛ ɔtū kú nū tá aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ, ohígbū koó dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ɔdā nōo í he ɔbá nū ɔtū.

eng_Latn: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ aá kwú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aá bī ga únɛ́pɔ̄, ɔtū kú aá kóō plicō ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē ka gbɔbū lɛ eko ā ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ eko le yá kú aá kɛlā, aá kɛlā dúú nōo wā okónu kú aá ā, ohígbū ka ɛlā nɛ̄ aá gáā ka ā í ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, amáŋ ɛgiyí Alelékwū Ihɔ géē je ɛlā ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, tíifu ipú ɔtūnōbí. Ohígbū ka é tū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā ulé lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nɛ. É gēe kpó uwá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile ā ŋmó. Lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔtū ŋmá lɛ ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō yá uwēyī ohígbū aɔ́dā īcííci nɛ̄hi nēé yá ā. Amáŋ é yá uwēyī dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō jɛ́yí ō le kwaajɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ohile nēe géē kwú ā. Eko nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā italā ā, n géē kpó uwā yíífi dúúdú. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unáfutāli wɛ Ujásīilu, Ugúni, Ujésa, mɛ́mla Ussilém.

eng_Latn: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú nū kwu yōōlō bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé le oje ɔdɔ yá ɔ̄ ā, klla lɛ eliká nēé lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ō ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá kpó wu ɔ́ ā. Ɔkpíyē kú nū le mulɔ́mulɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nēé gē kpó wu īlī nyɛɛ́nyɛɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo kē yɔ̄ ɛɛ́ mā le ligbó nɛ̄hi lɛ alɔ, ó lipú, klla lipú nɛ̄hi lɛ alɔ, ɔnyɛ̄ lɔfú pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Uféro ká ā da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā kahíníī, Mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá kéē nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā um.

eng_Latn: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā Alelékwū Ihɔ ā lɛ ɔ́ bītá ga ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē yɔ̄ ī kɔ̄kā olɔhi mɛ́mla okpaakpa kú uwɔ piyóó. N klla í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, awɔ ā kóō kɛlā kú uwɔ aflɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n tá uwɔ ohi. Ámāŋ n̄ kɛlā kú um aflɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ ka á tá um ohi.

eng_Latn: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aókwū í klá ajɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe géē hile ā le jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
idu_Latn: é le tá ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ɔhá kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gaá da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kwu aótrɛ̄yí kwu aéwɔhá, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé ma ɔlɛ́ uwá, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwā, ācɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwá háyi áklō eyī kú ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, iyɔ̄bū kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē bī ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā. Āyā ɔhá kú uwā háyi iyɔ̄bu kú ɛfu kú Ugɛ́rīsim, āyā ɔhá háyi iyɔ̄bū ɛfu kú Ɛ́balu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā tɛtɛ je íne lɛ uwá lɛ ā. Kéē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ abɔ̄ klá ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, gē hɛ́ unwalu tá ajɛ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ka ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā gē bī ɛbɔ́ wā.

eng_Latn: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
idu_Latn: Agidigbé ikpó ahāapa yɛ gicō ga okómpinu ā. Inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā yɔ̄ oŋmɛ́yí kú nū lɛ eyī pīya kwu ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ifotó kú alī bá ɔdɔ nōo kwu ɛplá nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya je ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ ā, é lɛ ije da kéē le gbā ulé lɛ ācogwínu mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄cí. É le ɔdōlé mla ɔdōgwá, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nɛ̄ é hī ólífu ā, kpó fūla ɔcí kú Usɛ́da cédar ŋmá ɛgīyī ācɛ Usáyídɔn mɛ́mla Utáya, nēé gēe kpó gé lɛ uwá ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn bū eyī ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
idu_Latn: Upíta mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tóohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ géē pó ɛlā kú nū fíyɛ́ ákú alɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē ka ohígbū ɔdā dóódu nēé yá ā mɛ́ɛ̄ a? Alɔ klla tá kā o lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ igbɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
idu_Latn: Ohóō lɛ ācogbāálá ɛfulɛ́ɛfu nōo gē kwu hī aálá ā tá. Ká ɔfú kú nū kóō mɛ ɔgbɛ́fú. Abɔ̄ kú nū kóō lɛ ŋmó tíiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú eyī abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū kóō kwú pu.

eng_Latn: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́cí mɛ́mla ácí mɛ́mla aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí gbɔɔ́ ō bū ŋmá ajɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó je mlanyī alɔ eko nēé yá alɔ lé ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ abɔ̄ alɔ ā tɛtɛ líla, lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú, alɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ kpaakpa ŋ́. Alɔ wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔdā ōtíne ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ nyā. Alɔ le eko táajɛ ge má ācɛ ímálānyī, bá gē hɔ́kɔ kú ɔdā kú ācɛ. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ gē wɔ́tū alɔ, alɔ kē ī wɔ́tū uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe hɛ́ uwá klá ajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bī ɛwa gēe je ūpū wúla tū ajɛ a. Ɔci Uloko nōo jɛ fíyɛ́ dúu a gēe gwōnū.

eng_Latn: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
idu_Latn: Ami ā wā kwɛyí Ádā um, amáŋ aá mīyɛ um ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá gā ŋmá iyē kú abɔ̄yī nū, aá géē mīyɛ anú.

eng_Latn: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ojéeyī gē pó ɛlā kú ádā nū, amáŋ, ɔyí olíla ā, í páhɔ nēé gē pi ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kóō le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yúúfi, kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aá ā ke í bá ɛfu abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ úlā ofɛpa-cigwó le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ á. É gāá hile ācɛ úla ofu-cɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ efūma tɛ̄hɔ̄ í kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ú kpó lé klla kwú aɔ́dā nēe hile ā kpó bīya.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā kē wɛ úlā ofu ahāapa ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī bí gaajɛ ga ipíípú ɔ́tɔ̄ ɛɛ́, ń má ajɛ olɔfú dúúmā, nɛ̄ n gē lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́. N yɔ̄ ɛga olipú kú īsu ā ɛɛ́, úgbagwú kú ísu ā kē gáā je um nyɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōonīgbō lígíí gē nū odúúdú ámú kú igbō á.

eng_Latn: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ uwá kahíníī, É tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, É géē hī Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā ka inu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um. Amáŋ aá kwú ɔ́ ú pīya inu o tayínū kú aúwī.

eng_Latn: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
idu_Latn: Ká ā kwú íkókwū kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú um ā ú ce ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā okónu ɛkpa kú ɔyí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú uwā mɛ́mla ije kú nū nōó bī wā í lá īkpɔ̄dā ā.

eng_Latn: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n le má ka uwá í yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā lɛ ā ŋ́ mā ā, n da Ukífasi ipéēyī odúúdú ācɛ o hile kahíníī, Awɔ nēé ma ɔ̄cɛ ujíyu ā habɔ̄ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu tá húmáyī lā bɛ̄ɛka aílɔ́wá ā, á yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka Ɔ̄cɛ újíyu ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nāa í pi aílɔ́wá ā abɔ̄fú kéē yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Ujíyu glá ā.

eng_Latn: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
idu_Latn: Ubálāki da Ubálam kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á wā eko nɛ̄ um tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwɔ aflɛ́yí ā ŋ́ mā ā? A gbɛlá ka amíɔɔ í cíla anúɔ ulé glá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
idu_Latn: Aálagbá nááná gē lā ɛbɔ́ ɔlékwū dúú. É klla gáā pó ɛgba mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú ācɛ nēe ī yá uwā ōwē ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɔgɔ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó bū lɛ īyī nū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā. É bī anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī le nya okwū kú nū iye ɛ́ɛ́, nēé je ɔ́ nyi á. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔlá tū ɛgiyí únóji kú nū nɛ̄hi ocābɔ̄ ekwu ō yɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
idu_Latn: É ka aá í ka ka íkwu kú Ujɔ́ni ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ glá ŋ́. É ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka é gē yúufi ācɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ cɛ̄ ka Ujɔ́ni wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n leyīce ā wɛ oō kwú, kéē le um nyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē gwutá abɔ́ɔ ipú obū.

eng_Latn: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ikpó kú uwɔ géē da ɔ́ ā, n géē je ɔ́ gā uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cokónu lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:
idu_Latn: É le ije nyā kpó lɛ ācɛ ɛtá nēe gē leyī kwú úklɔ́ ō gílayá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē je lɛ.

eng_Latn: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
idu_Latn: Aá gwō ɛ̄ngwū, ká aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Aá gwō ogwúmogwú o lɛ owú igwó kú aá gwíijē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ōhī da ɔ́ ɔka kahíníī, Alɔ ā bɛ́ɛ? Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í yá ā? Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá mīyɛ ije ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ dúú abɔ̄fú ŋ́ ámāŋ cīije bá ɔ̄cɛ dúú ŋ́. Ije ulɔ́yá nɛ̄ aá í mīyɛ ā kóō jɛ̄ aá.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a jé ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē da uwɔ ka, Je éŋkpɔ̄ gā um ká n̄ gwá ā nɛɛ, a géē yɛ í lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́, ó géē yɛ í lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi je gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú lɛ ɔyí ɛna mɛ́mla aálá ɛpa ōfōōfūnū tū oyēeyī glá ā.

eng_Latn: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
idu_Latn: N tínē ká ā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um túbá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔgllɛjí gē wū ikpɔ̄cí kú nū gē tú ɔ̄ bá ɛgéégéyi ā. Amáŋ é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin ámāŋ ka ɔcí Ufíigi nōó gwá ikpō ŋ́ mā a. Ēpū kú kú ɔcí ā náánā kwú kpó wúla dúúdú ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n le ɛga je lɛ aéwɔhá kéē mīya ajɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ɛcɔ̄ ā tá ɛhícō kú ɔwɛ opíbá ā leyīkwu Umíkmāsi, ɔhá ā tá ɛháajɛ leyīkwu Ugéba.

eng_Latn: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayínɛ́ um, aá í bá ipú ajodobū kú ogwuda kú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ŋ́, ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛci kú Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔmā kóō híī hɛ́ aá idáagó bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cowūūwī gā wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosíya, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ, kú ɔyā igwóléyi nēé hī ka Usɛ́bāti ā, iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Udáriyɔ̄si ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́siya ā, Óndú ā kɛlā gā um ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má otú éyi.

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔkpáni uwɔ ā? Iní nāa ŋmá ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Íjīpiti. Anúɔ kē wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ Ámālēki éyi. Ɔkpáni anúɔ ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū anúɔ tá ícɛmɛtá ŋmá eko nēé kwú anúɔ ā, ohígbū ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī doōcē.

eng_Latn: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá gē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gē lā ā. Aá gē má iyī aá ímálānyī, aá klla gē yíkpɛ́lā tá iyī aá. Ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka aá yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, klla gē yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu gē yúufi Udéfīdi, ohígbū ka, ó jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla anú, amáŋ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ anúɔ tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníi, Alɔ géē yá ɔdā dóódu nāa ka āa. Alɔ géē je iyó mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwā kpó cīgbīhi lɛ uwá. É klla gāá cílá alɔ ulé gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Unehemíya ka anúɔ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó hīgwú wā, klla cɛ̄ lɛ aótrɛ̄yí ā le ɛka gbo iyɔ̄bū uwā ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ é cokónu nū ā, ká ē lɛ ɔ́ yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ néē lɛ ɔtū obɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu um ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
idu_Latn: Ojuju obɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá lɛyíkwu Óndú a? Ó géē kpó aá yíífi. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gē bɛ́yíkwu Óndú ā igbɛɛpa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
idu_Latn: Íra mɛ́mla Ugárebu nēe ŋmá Ujátɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: N da uwá ká ē kwú aɛ́cí nēé ī pā ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ka uwá ká e je īyī uwā iyē tēelihɔ mla aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú Íjīpiti ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ami Óndú á wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
idu_Latn: Usílla, ɔnyā kú Ulámɛ̄ki ɔ́mpa ā, ma Utūbal-kēēni á. Anú ā wɛ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ nēe gē nɔwá īyúklɔ́ dóódu kú oje, ŋmá oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu á. Utūbalkēēni lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā éyi nōo lé ka Unaáma.

eng_Latn: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ācɛ o yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nēé nyɔ́kpá mla anú ā cá ɔ̄ ɛcá kahíníī, Ó wɛ awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Lɛ iyī uwɔ mla alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, tá ohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē cíla ulé ajɛ ā. Ń gáā lɛ ɔdá dúúmā nɛ̄ ń lɛ ije kwu ɔ́ ŋ́ mā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛpa cigwó lɛ ɛga o wú īkpɔ̄dā ā mɛ́mla aɔ́bɛ́ɛna ā kpó lá ŋmá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
idu_Latn: Óndú klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛyítáajɛ gā um kpaakpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi lɛyítáajɛ gā um ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ aíne kú um tū nɛ̄ a kē í yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ukɔ́ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Ukɛ́dɛ̄mɔtu, mɛ́mla Umefaati mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
idu_Latn: Ó le inu nēé hī ka agbla kú Ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā gwó dúú. Olīkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofahāapa cigwó. Olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ofɛtá cigwɛ́hɔ̄. Olicō kú nú wɛ ikpó ofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄. É le aɔ́gba ɛtá kú akanába kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ɔcí usɛ́da kú ulɛ́bānɔn kpó kwu ɔ́. Aákanaba ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nēe bá ɔgba éyééye. É le ɔcí nēé hī ka usɛ́da ā kpó ce aákanaba ā ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
idu_Latn: Ayí ɛhīlī nēé ma lɛ Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn ā bá ā. Iyē kú uwá wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ma uwá ɔgbɔɔgba lɛ ā. Ámnɔn, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ahínōwam nōo ŋmá Ujɛsiríili ā.

eng_Latn: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki lɛ Urebéka bī wā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū lā gbɔbū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɔnyā nū á. Urebéka he Áyísīki ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anú tá ɔ̄ ɔtulé ipú ikwū kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ kpó wā iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā ipɔ́ɔma éyééye á. Anɔ́ɔ é le ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda fu.

eng_Latn: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōbɔ̄bī dúúmā nēé gē yá ā í gē tū uwā uwēyī gɛ ŋ́. É ce iyī uwā bī ŋmá ínoōbīya nōo gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ blínyī ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́fiyɛ nēe bá gē gbō alɔ nyā wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aólɛla kú alɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ nōo kē hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aígwu ɔhá kahíníī, Alɔ gē kpó ajɛ kú ɛhɔ̄, ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ alɔ cābɔ̄, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔkpɛtā kóō kpó alɔ ŋmó ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a má āa, Ujeremíya? N tá ɔ̄ ohi ka īkpō ufígi nō o lɔhi ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla obɔ̄bí a bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
idu_Latn: Ó gē nwū um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē kpɛ́fú lɛ ā. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ó klla yá ká n lɔfú bī ɔtā kú oje udɔ le kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nēé lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā yá ā, ācɛ Ujúda nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo ī gbajā dúú ā, lɛ ula yá ká aá ɔ́ɔ kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfí fíyɛ́ dúú ā ohígbu koó gē ma īyī nū fú kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ā ŋmá lɛ ucē okpaakpa nōó gē yá ā mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nōo gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
idu_Latn: Ubaána, ɔyí kú Ahilúdu ā wɛ igbómína kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáánāku, Umegído mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ nēe kwu igelī kú Usáretan ajaajɛ ā, ɛháajɛ kú Ujɛsiríili jāā ga igelī kú Ébɛl Umɛhóla mɛ́mla Ujokmēyam ā.

eng_Latn: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā ká ācɛ kéē má ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cá odahɔ̄ ɛcá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ ɔdā ō hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ gwōnū tá ɔwɛ lɛ ópeyī ŋ́. Aá lɛyítáajɛ gā um. Ami wɛ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú alɔ le pɛ́ gekwú ipú ajɛ ohɔ́lá. Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē kpó tū ŋ́. Ɔbā kú alɔ nōo táncā ā kwú ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ísɔ le iháyí ofɛpa lé ā, ó gaá le anyā ɛpa kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti lɛ. Anyā lé ka Ujúdīt, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ubiyeri, mɛ́mla Ubásɛ̄māti, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ɛ́lɔn.

eng_Latn: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ébrahām ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ ī wā ɛgiyí alɔ ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ɔkpani um nɛ, Anɔ́ɔ Urebéka kwú adíko kú nū ú pīya klá eyī á.

eng_Latn: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwúcē ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā gaá tá Ábsālɔm, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ da ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ cɛ̄ ádā nū ɛhɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā dóódu nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu géē nwū Ábsɔ̄lɔm ā pīya tá ɔdā ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí ā le opo kú nū tá, anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ owɛcɔ mɛ́mla ɔlá yɛce ɔ́, pīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla oyī le yā klá ipú ɛcɛ á. Āyā éyi ŋmá okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ɛcɛ le yi tāajɛ. Odúúdú aɔ́cí mɛ́mla aácí mɛ́mla aɛ́pū nēe bá āyā éyi ŋmá okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ipú ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔmā le kpó yɔɔlá tāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔkpacaŋgelī kú uwá le odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɔlɛ́ ā kpó ŋmó, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ, é le aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla aíjakī kú uwā kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛpléeko nyā icɔ́ɔci lɔfú yá kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe gē gbāājɛ nēe lɔfú ipú ojuja ā kéē nwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō jéeyī ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔlá le na ɔ̄cɛ dóódu yēŋēē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē bī ɔmā le yá ɛbɛ́ nēé le gwɛ́ɛya kóō le yēŋēē ā.

eng_Latn: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ā wɛ ka n̄ lɔfú tū aá iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kē lɔfú tū um iyē ipú ɛ̄lā ā nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ahāapa nɛ̄ Ujéhu lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ujówāsi, ɔyí kú Ahasíya ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, ipú Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi iháyí ofɛpa. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū lé ka Usíbīya, nōo ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií igbīhi nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá ā, Ɔwɔicō le Ébrahām jámá. Ó le ɔ́ hīgwú kahíníī, Ébrahām! Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām tóohi kahíníī, Īī, ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí ā nyɔ̄ gaá le Upɔ́lu kwú, le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ agbá ɛpa kpó kwu ɔ́. Ó le ɔ̄kā da ójila ā ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu wɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
idu_Latn: É gē yēeyī ī má ayí uwā le jɛ̄, le ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī uwā lɛ. É klla ī má ayí kú ayí uwā bá ī jɛ̄ ipéyī uwá.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē híī bī ojibó dúúmā nōo wɛ ɔdēelihɔ ā wā ipú inu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ Óndú ā í tá ɛdɔ ókónu nōó tá lɛ ojibó ā lɛ uwá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ í lɛ eyī gwū uwā bónū piíí, ohígbū kéē wɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kpɔ́ ka uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe lā mɛ́mla uwá ā, géē lé aɔ́dā ā ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, fu ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō gwéeyē ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yá klla lé abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ a lé kā Unábalu, iyē kú ɔnyā nū lé ka Abígɛ̄lu. Ɔnyā nū ā kē jɔ̄ncɛ̄nyā klla lɔhi ō má eyī nɛ̄hi. Ó klla lɛ ohílīpú. Amáŋ ɔbá nū nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukálɛ̄bu ā í lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́. Ó klla lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi. Ɛ̄cī éyi, ó yɔ̄ í wá ɔnwū kú aálá kú nū igelī kú Ukámɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ka ā, Ɔ̄nyɛ jé ɔtū kú Óndú glá? Ɔ̄nyɛ nwū ō ɛlā glá ā? Alɔ ā jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā gē gbɛlá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ̄ lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé hɛ́ apī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, apī kpó hɛ́ ɛga nēé hī ka, Ugibīti hāārálōtu, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū lé ka ɛfu kú apī ō hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, jáhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā, kwú mlanyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú uwɔ dóódu.

eng_Latn: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma ŋmá ɛgiyí Ébrahām jāā ga Udéfīdi ā wɛ ayááyí igbo igwɛ́nɛ. Ŋmá eko kú Udéfīdi ga eko nēé kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ga Ubábīlɔn ā wɛ ayááyí igbo igwɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ o ŋmá eko nēé kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ga Ubábīlɔn ga eko nēé ma Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā wɛ ayááyí igbo igwɛ́ɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ Ɛ́lāyi á. Ó je ɔdā dúúmā tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́lāyi tóohi kahíníī, Anú wɛ Óndú á, kóō yá ɔda dúúmā nōo lɔhi tū ɔ̄ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē gbā ulé kú éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gwá āa. Alɔ gē lá ɛfú nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le gwó ɔ́lá ā.

eng_Latn: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē pīya ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ipú óhi kú ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ejé ā géē je óhi kú ɛbɛ́ ā ca, anɔ́ɔ ejé ā mɛ́mla óhi kú ɛbɛ́ ā í kpó yíífi. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, óhi kú ɛbɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nēé gē pīya ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
idu_Latn: N kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo le ŋmókókó, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī da báajɛ kwɛɛ́kwɛɛ́ ā ɛɛ́. Ɔdōlé dúúmā í klla ŋmó um unwū ō lé gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
idu_Latn: ó kōō wɛ ɛ́gbla kú ɔdā ō lɛ ipú piyaajɛ ámāŋ ka ɛbényi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā, Umósīsi le iyē kú ɛga éyééye nɛ̄ māháyi cē áklɔ̄kpɛ ce lā kpɛ́ɛ́m ā tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
idu_Latn: Ófɛ́ri, Uháfíla, mɛ́mla Ujóbābu. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā wɛ ayí kú Ujóktan.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú íbí, Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu í lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ gwū uwɔ tá ŋ́. Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ pó lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá bá yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú ipú ajɛ kú áa, yɔ̄ ī gbāajɛ kú aá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú aá nēe wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá, lɛ opo nēe bá nyā tá kéē hī ācɛ igwú wā í kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú aá, nēe wā í nuunu tá aá. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā géē nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
idu_Latn: Umésa, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu lɛ aálá nɛ̄hi. Iháyí dóódu ó gē je aálá úlā ofu igwáahāapa ce úlā igwó gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄gbā, mɛ́mla ɛkpa kú ɔnwū kú álá ulā ofu igwáahāapa ce igwó gbā ɛ̄gbā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī tá ɔgwɔɔgwu kú ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin kú aá ká aá yá īkpō nōo hɛ́ aá abɔ̄ wāajɛ ámāŋ ka aɛ́nɛ̄ e hile igbīhi nɛ̄ aá le ákú aá kpó wū ŋmá anú ā ŋ́. Aá habɔ̄ aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá abɔ́ɔ ā tá lɛ aógbɛhá mɛ́mla aéwɔhá. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á ka á.

eng_Latn: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
idu_Latn: Óndú, yɔ̄ mla Ujóssuwa. Éwo dóódu pó ɔ̄kā kú Ujóssuwa.

eng_Latn: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ le yá ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēe klla tá ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́ mā ōwē.

eng_Latn: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, ɔ́wá kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uróm mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā mɛ́mla aídengéli kú ācɛ Ujíyu lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú, lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ gbō.

eng_Latn: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yá ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛnyā yá ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nōo húmáyī yá ŋmá eko éyi ga eko ɔhá ā gē yá āa? Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nɛ. N yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋmá ohútu ā, n kē í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko nōó í ŋmɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú áluka kú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā wɛ úlā ofu igwáahātá ce igwáahāapa ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwo . É géē kwáajɛ gboce ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā.

eng_Latn: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.
idu_Latn: Udelíla klla da ɔ́ kpɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī plla anúɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó kē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā lɛ anúɔ ŋ́. Ká ɔ̄ da anúɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē kwú ɔ̄ klla í gbō ɔ̄ āa. Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ocucu ōgwá kú īnyīlɛyí kú anúɔ ahāapa ā yá, lɛ oje-oyɛ́yí kpó wu ɔ́ bá ajɛ. Anúɔ géē je kwáhi bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mahāanɛ ā: Abíyɛ̄sa ŋmá Ánatɔ̄ɔtu, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú igwu nyā á.

eng_Latn: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá lɛ ikwū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā, ó le yá kú ācɛ kéē wɛ olɛlā kú iyī uwā gɛ ŋ́. Oŋmá lɛ ikwū kú ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá, ó lɛ aéwo ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛpa ā bī wā í le pīya ācɛ ékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá kwúcē gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō tíne ká aá lā oyēeyī ɔwɛ nōo géē mafú ká aá kwú iyī aá ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō dúúdú. Aá kóō cikpɔ́nyā ɔhá ámāŋ ka o gbajā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ákú abɔ̄yīnū fu kéē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí kú nū, mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ebilíi mɛ́mla ɛcí nēé ma lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dúú nɛ̄ aá le tá ipú igelī éyi nēé mīyɛ aá ŋ́, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ipú uláyi kú ɔlɛ́ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā ōfōōfū uwā gē cɛ̄tra awɔ á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í cɛ̄tra uwɔ nyā ā. Aádā gē ka ayí uwā ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a le kpaakpa lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
idu_Latn: Ujē mɛ́mla ácí kwú bū tū ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ɛɛ́. Aá jikwū ohígbū ka aínu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gwéeyē ipú nū ipú igelī nɛ̄ ācɛ tɛtɛ wɛ omōōmū nū bá ī gwéeyē ā, kwú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ká ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka lɛyíkwu ami, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um ā, kóō le yá lɛ ā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ahāanɛ yɛce uwá nyɔ̄ dúú, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ɛpa. Ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe nyɔ̄ ā wɛ, Ussɛmáya, Unetánīya, Usebadíya, Ásāhɛlu Ussemírāmɔtu, Ujehónātan, Adónīja, Utóbīja mɛ́mla Utobadónīja, anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ɛpa ā wɛ, Ɛlíssāma mla Ujɛhóram.

eng_Latn: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dā nēé nyi tū ipú ajɛ olɔhi ā. É lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā pó, é mīyɛ ɛlā ā, anɔ́ɔ é le īkpō gwá, ōhī gwá īkpō ofucigwó, aɔ́há gwá ofɛtá, ōhī klla gwá īkpō ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
idu_Latn: Ujóbu klla gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā nyɔ̄ ɔbū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
idu_Latn: Ulámɛ̄ki lɛ anyā ɛpa, Adá mɛ́mla Usílla.

eng_Latn: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu yúklɔ́ mla uwá jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā cē kwɛyí. Urútu kē lā mla ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū Unaómi kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
idu_Latn: É cɛ̄ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ayisáya ka igbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin kwú abɔ̄ ú bī ákanaba ɛpa nēe bī odúúdú inu ā hayi. Abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū bī ákanaba éyi, abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū bī ákanaba ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ̄ ɛ́nyɔ́ kú aá gbō, ká aá le tútū eko dóódu kú úklɔ́. Agege kú aá kóō yɔ̄ i cɛ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ícɛ nyā Ɔwɔicō le ipɔ́ɔnū nyā nyatá ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ɔnyīlɔ nyā, wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ébrahām dúú.

eng_Latn: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ó le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū hīīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyā ā pi tá ɛcɛ ŋmá eyī kú anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ gwū.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile dóódu nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
idu_Latn: Aá tɛ̄gíkwū, aá nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācogbāálá kú um ā. Aá jikwū, ká aá lɛ īyī aá míya ajɛ. Eko le yá nēé gáā kpó aá ŋmó, klla í hɛ́ ɛbɛ́ aá nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē wá ɛbɛ́ omlede ā nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.
idu_Latn: Obōobū nēé kwú bēhé wā igelī ā, Íssmɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ igwó ā, lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó lɛ okwū kú uwá kpó tá tū ipú obugā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ɛyí, ɔkɔ́kllɔtū mɛ́mla átákwū kú omlede nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí ā, a í kpó uwā gā um kóō wɛ ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ɛhi ɔhá tá, nēé í fō tá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́, aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, omlede ɛhɔ̄, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Unássɔn, ɔyí kú Ammínādabu á.

eng_Latn: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utekówa ma ɔdɔ ɛga ɔ́mpa kpɔ́. É ma ŋmá ɛga éyi nōo pīyeyī kwu inɔ̄ɔda nōo gē gbō Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, gaá kwu ɔdɔ nōo kwu ófɛlu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā lé, nɛ̄ aɔ́glɛjí nēe hɛ́hɔ̄ ā bá ɛmiyɛ.

eng_Latn: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Aólɛlā a lɛ Ái yálé ɛɛ́, é le bū Umígrɔn ɛɛ́! E ma abɔ̄ ɔdōlé mla iyó kú uwá tá Umíkmās.

eng_Latn: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń gáā yá mla ācɛ kú um, nēe hile nēé kpó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄fú ga ɔfiyɛ ŋ́ mā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n yá mla ācɛ otɛtɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
idu_Latn: A jé ka ije nɛ̄ alɔ má okónu ɛkpa kú alɔ ícílɔ ā, alɔ le ɔ́ kwúcē igbīhi wā gé lɛ uwɔ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ukénan. Abɔ̄ ó yā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ géē je oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ oje ɔdɔ uwī ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔkpani alɔ ā a?.

eng_Latn: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛlā ka lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi, nēe gē leyīkwu Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā eko nōó le yá kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, eko nāa le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu um ā, ń wā mla ɔtū ōbɛ́pa ŋ́. N̄ da aá ɔ̄kā abālɔbányā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fú um ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú oyī kú nū ú cē klá ɔ́gɔgɔ́ ɛnɛ kú ede ā biílí.

eng_Latn: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
idu_Latn: Ā híī yɔ̄ ge gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ōfūnū gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ gwá ejé ligii dúú kóō tá ipú kú uwɔ abɔ̄ kú ɔdōlé ká o wī tū uwɔ ipú fíyɛ́, abɔ̄ nāa ge doōcē ojigógó ā.

eng_Latn: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ámɔn wɛ iháyí ofu cɛɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá jégēdē ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá lɛ íne ā bīya, nɛ̄ ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í jé ŋ́, odúúdu ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē je ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū gē he Óndú ā ɔtú. Mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ klla mɛ́mla ɛya kú ejé. É klla géē je opī gwɛ́ɛya kú íneōbīya.

eng_Latn: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya kwú ikpɛ́cí nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati gwó Ubɛ́tɛlu nɛ̄ ó kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ínoōbīya ā ú kpó ca tāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛcɔ̄ kú nū ú kpó ca, le ɔ́ gbā umu putuu á. Ó klla kwú ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra nēé ma kwu ajɛ ā ú kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kwú okwū kú Ásāhɛlu ú gaá nyī únóji kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m. Anɔ́ɔ é yɛ otú ɔ́ɔmā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ é ga Uhɛ́brɔn ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ okónū ká ācɛ nōo gē yá ācɛ ɛbɛ́ ā gwū, kú okónu ká ācɛ nōo gē gwō ā kóō le klá.

eng_Latn: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū yɔ̄ ī wú Uhána nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ yɔ̄ ī jikwū klá Óndú ā. Ó jikwū nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí ā le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā gáā da ɔ́ kahíníī, É cíkā ō kwú Ujeremíya ā ú ŋmó. Ɛdɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ ó gē ka igelī nyā ā gē yá ká aícɔ́ɔja ā kéē yúúfi cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔtū kú uwā kóō gbenyi. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī yá odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī ā ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā. Ó tú ācɛ abɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ obɔ̄bí kú uwā nōó yɔ̄ ī yá á.

eng_Latn: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ áluka kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn nēe wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó gɔbū, nēe géē yúklɔ́ ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā glá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
