idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā, N géē tū aólɛlā wā í je Usamérīya catāajɛ, nōó géē je pīya ɛyétutulu kú ɔlɛ́ ō catāajɛ, nōo í tɛ́ɛcɛ péee, ɛga nōo í lɔhi ō nyi ɔcí ufáyin ōfōōfūnū. N géē kpó īmū kú ɔlɛ́ ō catāajɛ ā tū ipú ɔpɛ́ ā, n kē í je aíkpíinu ā táncā.

eng_Latn: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
idu_Latn: N klla le má ipú ɛcɛ nyā ka ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa géē yɔ̄ ā, ɛlá ocēbá mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ újí gē yɔ̄ á. Ɛga nɛ̄ ɛlā okpaakpa gē yɔ̄ ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ obíípū mɛ́mla alācī bá á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
idu_Latn: N géē tú ācɛ ā bá ŋmá ipú ajɛ dóódu, nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛnɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwā ā. N géē kpó uwá cīgbīhi wā amānyā, n kē í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá í lā amānyā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ikɔɔkɔ nōó í bī Urécɛ̄lu gé lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ā, ó gbēyī kú ajɛ kóō kwú dobū kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Ulɛ́ya ú bī gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu kpó lɛ uwá kéē nū odúúdú aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē dóódu.

eng_Latn: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ācɛ ā odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ā ipú ācīije. Ó tū ɔdā dúúmā nōó da uwá ŋmá ipú ācīije ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu kahíníī, N háyi únɛ́pɔ̄ kú Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Uróm, ɛga nōo cíkā kéē ka ɛpɔ̄ kú um ā. Ń yá ācɛ Ujíyu ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ jé lɛ ā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
idu_Latn: Unɛ́ɛ wɛ ádā kú Ukíss nōo ma Usɔ́ɔlu ā á. Usɔ́ɔlu ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Ujonátan, Umálkīssūwa, Abínādābu mɛ́mla Essbáalu.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla Usólōmɔn nɛ̄hi, ohígbū koó kwú ɔtū kú nū ú pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, nōo kē wā ɛgiyí nū igbo ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ɛcɛ í gáā má um glá gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ aá géē mā um. Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ n yēeyī ā, aá géē yēeyī dúú.

eng_Latn: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Usékaríya, ɔyí kú Umésselēmiya wɛ ɔ̄cogbājɛ kú ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ gē pu ɔ́ eyī klla kwú ɔ̄ glá āa? Ámāŋ, ɔ̄nyɛ gē kwú ɔ̄ ukpa, klla le odée bū ɔ̄ ɛnwú bēhé glá?.

eng_Latn: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá gā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ikpīije ugóolu éyi kú uwɔ ā yɔ á. N le ɔ́ gbō tayínū ipú adíko nɛŋcɛ́ éyi.

eng_Latn: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú aá kóō wuklíicō eko nɛ̄ aá le pó keé yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú ámāŋ eko nɛ̄ aá le ofu kú ɛfú pó ŋ́. Aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē yá piíí, amáŋ eko ámōōmɛ ā í wā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ. Ká ā lɛ ācɛ ā iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ uwá tútū, gbó óócí, ohígbū ka, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka á. Ɔdēlihɔ yɔ̄ ipú aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gáā māháyi iyɔ̄bū aólɛlā kú aá glá ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá kwú ɔdēlihɔ ā ú ŋmá ipú aá.

eng_Latn: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá, ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ kú Umówābu ā, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá kú aá gáā lā ɛyí ɛcɔ̄. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóho nōo gē gwó ɔlɛ́ nū ce icō áklō ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka íne ā ī cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō cɔ̄nū, amáŋ ɛga nɛ̄ íne í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ācɛ í kē gáā bīyíne ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē wóófu iyē kú uwɔ piyóó klla í ka ka, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu, piyóó á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ami, Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, géē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, aá kōō lɛ ɛbɛ́ yá Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú ɛdɔ kú ɛhi ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ú lɛ ɔ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá téeyī olɔhi kú nū. Aá gbɛlá ka ó géē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ aá mɛ́ɛ̄ nɛɛ? Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ka anúɔ í gáā yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o bī ɔtā kpɛ́fú kú aá, í gáā háyi glá ŋ́, ācɛ o kwinya nɛ̄hi ā, í gáā kwu glá ŋ́. Ācɛ o kpɛ́fu ɔnya, í gáā kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ikwū nōo í ŋmó uwā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛpa ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ lɛyíkwu Usɔ́dɔm, amáŋ Ébrahām māháyī abɔ́ɔ pī Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je īyī uwɔ ŋmó ohígbū agbénú ōgla bá ajɛ lɛ īyī uwɔ ŋ́. Lɛ íjééyī jé ká ā lɛ iyī uwɔ cēbī.

eng_Latn: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kōō inyīlɛ̄yí kú aá ékpó í gaá bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kōō le uwá pahīla ga ɛga oligbó fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɛcɛ ā nááná, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā géē tū uwā bá klla géē kpó uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔyípōklóbīya éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi, nōo húmáyī lā Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m, igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē pó kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu íne ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē le lɔhi lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē je pīya ewó nɛ̄hi kéē géē lā ipú ajɛ olɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri nēe lā ɛyí ɛfu abɔ́ɔ ā, wā í nuunu tá uwā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́wá kú ɛnwú nēe ī nū ācɛ inya nɛ̄ ī kwúcē ŋ́ mā. Ó kéē nū aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, inya jāā ga Uhɔ́ma, le aá nōo wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā yálé, ɛyí ɛfu kú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ cē ɔkpanī um, Ébrahām, nɛ̄hi, ó kē kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ aálá, aɛ́wū, aɛ́na, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ, aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, aínyankwūlūmī mɛ́mla aíjaki.

eng_Latn: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɔfú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu, a kē lā ɔkpáncō. A kē í bī ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ é cīije bá Ujísɔ̄si ka.

eng_Latn: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nōo lɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú nōó ī yúúfi ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, géē gbɔ́ɔ ō yúúfi, ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī kú Ísrɛ̄lu jé ka ádā uwɔ wɛ āklōgō kú ícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi. É klla kē jé ka ācɛ nēe bá pī ɔ̄ ā wɛ eŋīnīŋīnbī kú ācɛ o jé ō kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɔ̄ŋ̄cɛ́nyā í gē je mlanyī agbá ōtɔ̄ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɔdōōwabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdōplahɔ̄ klla mɛ́mla ɔdōleyíifa ɔhá kú nū ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄nyā nōo yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔbá í gē je mlanyi īlī ifa nōó bī gáā lɛ ɔbá ā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ, aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā gē mlanyī um iháyí alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhābu lɛ Ɛláyíja má ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Olɛlā kú um, a klla lɛ um pīyɛ tɛcɛ ɛɛ́ gɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N lɛ uwɔ pīyɛ tɛcɛ ɛɛ́ gbóó, ohígbū ka a kwú īyī uwɔ ú lá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú ō bī tū Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ ācɛ ojéeyī, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla jé ɔdā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ fu ŋmá ipú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ kwú uwā ú pīya aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nɛ̄ Áhāsi, ɔyí kú Ujótam nōo wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Usíya ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujúda ā, anɔ́ɔ Uresín ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya mɛ́mla Upéka ɔyí kú Uremalíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, le pɛ́ tá Ujerúsālɛm kéē í kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā á. Amáŋ é yá ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnɔ kú ɔma kwú nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, ɔnyōkɔ́ma ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā yúúfi ŋ́, Urécɛ̄lu, ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá nɛ̄ a gáā ma kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé pūla ɛplá oje ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ ā gā ā, é le ɔkɔ́bɔ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ gbā lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
idu_Latn: Ámōōmɛ ā, o le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ayíkpó igwóléyi eko nēé bá gē lé ɔdōlé ā. Ó le ífulá ka tū uwā, ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā ŋ́, é klla lɛ ɔtū olɔfú nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá, cɛɛlā kú ācɛ nēé má ɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó le héyī ŋmá ɔlekwu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
idu_Latn: Kócōō, ā híī yá alɔ ōwē ohígbū íne nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ bīya ā gɛ ŋ́. Lɛ eyīnyinyi kú alɔ má fíya mɛ́ɛ̄, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ hɛ́ alɔ iyē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ fú ewo ŋmá ɛga o pá ɛtɛ́ ā. Umósīsi gaá lɛ abɔ̄ fú ɔ̄ gicō ipéyī Uféro á.

eng_Latn: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le yɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ ā lígíí ā, Ujósɛ̄fu da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī, Páápá ká ā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ācɛ ā kwú. Eko nɛ̄ a lɛ uwá kwú ū, da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá le obɔ̄bí cíla ulé kú olɔhi nɛ̄ n yá lɛ aá ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá je íkókwū kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú ɔkpani um ā a?.

eng_Latn: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
idu_Latn: Ukpɛ̄ nōo wɛ ákú ācɛ o hile kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēé ga ɔgbɛ́fú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā í bī bēhé wā igelī kú Udéfīdi ā, Umáyíkalu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā, feyī kpeé bū uwíndo, anɔ́ɔ ó má Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í jīijē, yɔ̄ í tóómbili gicō lɛ ákpá fōōfūnū kwu ɔkwu á. Ó lɛ opiyɛ́ɛlɛ́ tá leyī gwū ɔ́ bónū ipú ɔtū kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ā wā gaá yá ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ohi kahíníī, É wā gaá tū aéwo nēe je ajɛ kú Ujúda pahīla ufi. É klla í je uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ma ɔ́ ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ jé kóō wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú alɔ, nɛ̄ alɔ klla ma ɔ́ opeyī ŋmá ipú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
idu_Latn: Lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyilɔ ā bī wā okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ iyē gwā.

eng_Latn: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá jé lɔɔlɔhi ka aá cíkā ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā. Alɔ cēyītīkwū yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ mla aá ā.

eng_Latn: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee, or if thou know him not, then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house, and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka, óndú nū ɔ́ɔ lá ɛga oligbó, ámāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ā ŋ́, ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā, ɛ́ɛ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka óndú nū gā, ɛ́ɛ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē lé ucɛ kú onyatá kú alɔ mla ɔtū oyēŋēē mɛ́mla ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nɛ̄ ɔdōnīigbō í yɔ̄ anú ŋ́ mā. Alɔ híīī wɛ ipú ínōobīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nɛ̄ ɔdōnīigbō yɔ̄ ipú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya dúú klla le yɛce ucé kú ɔ́bíipú mla ɛ̄cī ō pā kú Ujérobōwam nɛ̄ ó kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko o wū īkpō gā ā, ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ olufa ā gáā mīyɛ ukpɛ́ kú īkpō ā nōo wɛ ákú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo húmáyī hóóyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī wúla jāā gbó ɔyā igwó. Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā igwó ā, īkpɛ̄yí kú aɛ́fu ā gbɔɔ́ ō kwɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōó ka nyā le he ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā ɔtú. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdā nōó ka nyā yá á.

eng_Latn: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
idu_Latn: Ó húmáyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ ó gbɛlá ka anúɔ le jōnjīlɛ̄ abɔ̄fú mla Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n̄ le da aá gbɔbū kóō géē yá, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nōó le yá kú aá géē cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ uwá, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu nēé je lá ga ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
idu_Latn: Aá wā gaá lé ɛbɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú aógbēnjūwā, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔja, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú ācɛ nēe ī cɔnya ā, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ, kwu aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lɛ īyī uwā ā, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́.

eng_Latn: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kē tɛtɛ lɛ ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā kɔ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma ɛpa ce āyā ɔhá ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi í lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Ukpɛ̄ kú uwā yɔ̄ ipú ɛya kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ipí wá ɔ̄cɛ jila le má koó gbɔ̄ɔ̄gɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɛga ɔkpíyē ohile ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔnwū nobí í yɔ̄ anú ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
idu_Latn: É le ayí ɛpa ma lɛ Ɛ́ba. Iyē kú éyi kú ayí ā wɛ Upɛ́lɛ̄gi, ohígbū ka eko kú nū ā nēé kɔ̄ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyéyí á. Iyē kú ɔyínɛ́ nū lé ka Ujɔ́ktan.

eng_Latn: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
idu_Latn: Ó le kpaakpa ká Ɔwɔicō, nōo yá odúúdú aɔ́dā dóódu klla lɛ uwá tū ā, cíkā ō lɛ Ujísɔ̄si yá kpaakpa oŋmá lɛ ōwē ō má nɛ̄hi, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ alɛwa nēe ī yɛce ɔ́ ā bī wā kéē lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔfú kú nū lɛ. Ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si le uwá tɔ́ɔkwu ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nya uwá tá á.

eng_Latn: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ n géē da uwɔ ā wɛ ka ā gbɔ̄ɔka lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ. Ba Ɔwɔicō kóō yá aɔ́dā olɔhi dóódu lɛ uwá, kóō klla tá uwā abɔ̄. A klla í tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū éyééye kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá nyā, Óndú ā kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī miya kú n̄ bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí wā í klá aá, anɔ́ɔ aá kē gáā kwu glá ŋ́. Aá géē má iyī aá ipú unwalu nɛ̄ ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá yawu ipú ɔ́bɔ́cɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū koó wɛ anúɔ tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ́ uwá bī iyē kú nū bá ī cɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ á. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔdā nēé ī ka ā yá, ka anúɔ géē kpó awɔ mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe bá ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēe bá nyā ga uwɔ ā kpó nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
idu_Latn: Koócōō, lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ géē gbā eko dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ eyī pīya kwu inu nyā ā pó. Lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ í gbā ā pó ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ alɔ bī ā í yá alɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō hī ofíyajɛ kú ɔlā ā kahíníī, Ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kē hī obū ā kahíníī, Otú. Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī, nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
idu_Latn: Aá gwííjē lɛ ɔ́, kú aá cɛ̄tra anú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ka úklɔ́ idáagó kú nū tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi klla le ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ Óndú da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ Ukéyīla, gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ufilístiya, ka anúɔ géē yá kéē lɛ uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je ācogwɛ́bá mɛ́mla aɔ́hɛ kpó nū ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī jē ukpa lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ anúɔ ŋmó ā?.

eng_Latn: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú alɔ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka, akpa kú ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwu ɛga nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ŋmá eko nēe gwó ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā lɛ ɔdā nōó ka ā yá kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe hɔ́hā ce uwɔ ā, n kē géē tókónu lɛ ācɛ nēe tókónu gā uwɔ ā. O bū ipú uwɔ ā, nɛ̄ n géē hɔ́hā ce odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ami ā, Óndú ā le um tūmu mla ɔfú kú alelékwū kú nū. Ó klla je íjéeyī kú ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ō ka mɛ́mla ɔtū ō lɛ ká n̄ kɛlā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyíkwu íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam kwú eyī í gwū ɛlā nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ nwū ɔ̄ ā bónū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ohi obɔ̄bí tá uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi wɛ ayí ɔdāhá, nēe tū ile dúúmā ŋ́. É klla lɛ ɛlá wu Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā mīya. Ābɔ̄ kú nū dóódu ā wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó. Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kwú abɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, ede ā kē kwu iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā hɛ́hɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ éwɔhá nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā, géē yúúfi kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ le pɛ́ kwu ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú gā ɛgiyí nū, ó wā í háyi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ede ō yi ɔtulali ɔlá ɛyi nū ā.

eng_Latn: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
idu_Latn: Nááná nōó lɛ ɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi kú ɔyípōklóbīya kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó géē kwú, é kē í je ɔ̄ nyi.

eng_Latn: Yet ye say, The way of the LORD is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá gē da um ka, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ge yá nyā í kpaakpa ŋ́. Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Aá gē gbɛlá ka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yá odée kú um ā, í le kpaakpa ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔwɛ kú aá a í kpaakpa ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó lɛ ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ádā nū kpó gwu ā, kpó nwūla, klla le ɔwɛ ā kpó gílayá.

eng_Latn: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
idu_Latn: Ɔmā lɛ ɔhi, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔmā í lɔnyɛ gɛ ŋ́, á gáā yá ɔ̄ kóō lɔnyɛ glá ŋ́. Aá lɔnyɛ tū iyī aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔmā ā, aá bá ɛbɔ́ mla iyī aá.

eng_Latn: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā ō kpó yíífi ā tū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ákan ɔyí kú ukámi, ɔyí kú Usábādi, ɔyí kú Uséra nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā, kwú ɔdēelihɔ ā ú kpó. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ohóliba í kwɛjī abɔ́ɔ nó ŋ. Ó klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá eko nōo wɛ ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā, nɛ̄ ó wɛ akwuna ajɛ Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya tá ɔ́ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n lɛ ɔkwɛ̄yí ā da uwɔ, á gáā je um ŋmó ŋ́ŋ? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n kē lɛ ɛlā nwū uwɔ, á kē gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, le íjééyī jé, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóō he um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē má ohi ōtá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ okónu kwu um iyē.

eng_Latn: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú īkpɔ̄dā kú nū ā ú le tá ɔlɛ́, gaá le ɔ́ mafú lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū. Ó klla kwú igbō nōó lé hile ā ú lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
idu_Latn: A híī yá unwōdōlé olɔhi nɛ̄ ó gē je gā uwɔ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó lɔfú yɔ̄ ī jé uwɔ má glá.

eng_Latn: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛ̄hī udɔ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ ā yɔɔlá ŋmá anú, nōo tá áncā ɔ́ɔmā ú ce ɔlá ká ō le kwɔ́lá yōō. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká īnyī mɛ́mla ɛ́kla kú nū ā kéē le ja bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
idu_Latn: Ā híī yɛ mla ācɛ ōgwéjé nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, n tū aá ɛhɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēe bá ipú aɔ́gwú ā. Aá kóō jéeyī bɛ̄ɛka ɛgwā āa, klla gbonɛnɛ bɛ̄ɛka okóohō aā.

eng_Latn: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lā igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Unásārēti ā á. Ɛnyā le ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka ā yá jīla. É kahíníī, É géē hī ɔ̄ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Unásārēti.

eng_Latn: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī tīile fíyɛ́ ugóolu mɛ́mla ogigo nōo lɔhi ā á. Anú klla tīile fíyɛ́ aɔ́ká nēe gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Óndú, í gáā mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋ́, ó gáā cīgbīhi kwu ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ogbeé kú ísu ā bá ī gbēyī ká n̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́tá. N lɔfú klla le tútū ɛɛ́. Eko kpiíí n géē wā í nya uwá tá klla í wā í gbō odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nyā abɔ̄yī um.

eng_Latn: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ā híī mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́. Blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ka ā yá ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpó nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le gwō ā, nɛ̄ alɔ kē jé lɔɔlɔhi ā wɛ ka alɔ gē yá uce olɔhi, ofíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛma kú alɔ mɛ́mla aá, oŋmá ɔtū oyēŋēē mɛ́mla ɔtū ékpó nōo wɛ ucē nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī dɔɔ̄kā ā. Ó wɛ íjééyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu í bī alɔ jɔ́ɔwɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kócōō lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ucē olɔhi í kē yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā í tōō má ipú alɛɛcɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɛfú, ámāŋ ōcē obɔ̄bí, ámāŋ ɛdɔ kú ámíyā dóódu, ámāŋ ka ɔkpɛtā gaá ce uwá kóō wɛ italā kú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kpó uwá yíífi, é lɔfú wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, ɛga nēé gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā. É lɔfú gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū unwalu kú uwā, a géē pó ɔkɔ nēé gbā gā uwɔ ā, a klla í nya uwá tá ŋmá unwalu kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
idu_Latn: A le tá ɔbā nɛ̄ n kpó ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ mɛ́mla ébú tayínū anú ā jéejéé ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū Adónīram, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú ā, fu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. Odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛcɔ̄ tá fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ kwú ɔ ú ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam le kwu gaá ce ɛyí úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū le kwu ga Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá pīyabɔ̄ igbīhi italā nēe bá nyā ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē tá ɛlā kú um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó cíkā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔkpá tá fu uwá ká ālɔ̄ da uwá kéē tá ɔdā dóódu nēe lɛ iyē kwu ɛcí mɛ́mla ikpɔ́nyā ōce mɛ́mla ajā ōgbo mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ nēé ŋmó ŋmá o lɛ ɔ́ ɔkɔ jílacē mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ oyī yɔ̄ anú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ɔdā kú úgwū kú uwā. Ó le ɔ́ kɔ̄ lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā má mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá ɛfú ō kpó á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa le bá lɛ Ujérīko ajaajɛ ā, ó je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi háyi iyɔ̄bū nū, lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī pi bī abɔ̄. Ujóssuwa le tá ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A wɛ éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja kú alɔ kɛ̄ɛ, ka a wɛ olɛlā kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aádā alɔ tá ka aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú nū ŋ́; é klla lɛ igbīhi cē kwu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ eyī yá uwā ipú odo kú uwā kéē kwúcē ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ujóssuwa mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwúcē wā Ugígalu.

eng_Latn: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá má ɛna ámāŋ ijakī kú olɛlā kú aá yɔ̄ ī bī, lɛ ɔ́ kwú cīgbīhi gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a he iyī uwɔ ɔtū, le jéeyī. Gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nāa jé ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē gbagbénū.

eng_Latn: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
idu_Latn: Óndú klla ka kpɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ubássa dóódu nōo gekwú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ewō géē je okwū kú nū lé. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dóódu nōo gekwú ipácí aígbáanɔ nōo ī wu icō géē je okwū kú nū lé.

eng_Latn: And he took it, and did eat before them.
idu_Latn: ó mīyɛ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ́ ú lé iyɔ̄bu uwā á.

eng_Latn: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,
idu_Latn: Upássɔ, Amárīya, Umálikīja.

eng_Latn: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
idu_Latn: Olīkpō mɛ́mla ɔwá kú ɔwɛ o bū ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó, nōo jónjīlɛ mla ɔwá mɛ́mla īkpō kú nū ā. Olicō kú nū ŋmá ajɛ gicō wɛ ikpó ofu ahāanɛ. É le ipú nū plla mla oje ɔdɔ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ nōo hī ɔ̄ igwú ā kahíníī, Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a lɛ ucɛ yá klɛ́ɛcɛ, ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ámāŋ ka ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, a híīī hī aóklóbīya ámāŋ ka ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ka aɔ́máapú uwɔ ámāŋ ka aóladógbe kú uwɔ nēe lɛ agbénú ā igwú ŋ́. Ohígbū kéē géē hi uwɔ igwú wā ɔnū ucɛ dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó ī wɛ óluma nɛ̄ a tū uwā ā nēé cíla awɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔkpáncō le gbɛka, bī akpa ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō nōo yājɛ ɛyí nū ā gbɛka dúú.

eng_Latn: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosáya, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ubárūku le odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka lɛ ɔ́ ā tá tū ɔkpá. Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
idu_Latn: Udíssɔn, Ésa mɛ́mla Udíssan. Aɛ́nyā wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú ayí kú Uhɔ́ri ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ajɛ kú Uséyɛ ā .

eng_Latn: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ɔdā nēe he Óndú ā ɔtū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō je aɔ́dā nēe he aá ɔtū ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ nēé tíne kéē ŋmó ā yálé. Ká ā klla lɛ uwá gbájí. Lɛ ācɛ nēé bá ī gwéeyē tū um ohígbū unwalu kú um ā, kwúcē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwēyī je lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ce ɔhá ā, a géē yɔ̄ ī bī ɛwū, ɛna, mɛ́mla omlede le gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔ́bíipú gā um. Odúúdú uwā í gáā lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
idu_Latn: Aógbɛhá ā bá yɔ̄ ī nya kéē lɛ odée piyóó, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla éeyē ā yɔ̄ ī jɔ́nyɛ kú oyēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayááyí kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unówa nēe lé ka Ussɛ́m mɛ́mla Uhám mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti ā á. Ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā ma ayí igbīhi kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo kpó ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
idu_Latn: A bɔ̄kwu ká ā jé aɔ́dā lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó tōō jé ŋ́ mā glá ā? Á bɔ̄kwu ká ā jé ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā nɛ̄ ó tōō jɛ́yí nū ŋ́ mā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ágábá le oji tū, ɔnyɛ í gáā yúufi ŋ́ māā? Óndú, Ɔwɔicō le elā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ í gáā nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ māā.

eng_Latn: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti wɛ ádā kú ācɛ Ulúdīya, Anam, Uléhābu, Unáfutu.

eng_Latn: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō hī aá igwú ohígbū ōwē ō má ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n, ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū kē móōwe ohígbū aá, ó i lɛ ā, aá géē gbla anú yá ɔwɛ nōó lɔtū lé ipú ōwē kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ īkpɔ̄dā tū ɛkpa kú uwā omōōmu yíílí, kéē kwú ije kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ú tá ipú ɛkpa kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le ɔdōlé nɛ̄ uwā ɔ́ɔ í lé ɔwɛ ā je lɛ uwá. É le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, odúúdú aá wɛ iyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá wɛ āyā kú iyē ā.

eng_Latn: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū cokónu ka anúɔ géē gbō igelī ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ kú ɔlá nōo yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla ka anúɔ géē lā ipú abɔ́ɔ mla odúúdú ɛgahi kú anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
idu_Latn: N jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ɛlā kú aá dúúdú, amáŋ odúúmā kú aá í mafú lɛ Ujóbu ka anú ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā ŋ́. Odúúmā kú aá í tá ɔ̄ ohi kú ɛlā nōó ka ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄, n lɔtūce ka n géē tū Utímōti ɛhɔ̄ fu aá eko kpiíí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bá lɛ nōó géē kā um ā í yá kú ɔtū kú um kóō gāājɛ.

eng_Latn: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
idu_Latn: Aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi wɛ ācɛ nēé je íkwu ō cɔ̄wɔ kú íne kú Umósīsi ā lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ ā wɛ ɔ́wá kú ɔkpíyē kú nū nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe le kpaakpa ā, aá gwíijē kú éeyē gbōmgbōm, kú aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā. Ó cíkā ká ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, kéē cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan nyɔ̄ í le cɛ̄tra Udéfīdi lɛ ádā nū kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kóō híī bɔ̄bíipú tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Udéfīdi ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ó bɔ̄bíipú dúúmā tū uwɔ ŋ́. Úklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ ó húmáyī yá mla uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce ā wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe ī lɛ íne ā tū ā nɛɛ, ó lɛ ā ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ā í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce ā kē wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And they of Bethshemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley: and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi bā í ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔpɛ́ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ igbeékpónú, é je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ é má ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā. É gwéeyē kú ɛbɛ o yéeyi jii nēé má ā.

eng_Latn: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aífotó kú alī mɛ́mla ucérūbim kpó hɛ́ tū odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú ɛga otīihɔ ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá tū ɔdɔ ā. É lɛ ɔcí gbā gwū icō kú okómpinu kú inu nōo kwu Okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí gē wā ŋmá ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ kpúmmm bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū ā, nōo yɔ̄ ī kpóocu kwūūū mla umáari mɛ́mla ufránkīnsɛnsi, ɛ́dɔ kú ɔtulalī ōkpóocu nɛ̄ ācɛ otɔ́sú ī je lá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī īlī nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bī ɛdɔ owú ɛpa le tá ɔ̄ wiiyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī igwó ā gaá le glá ā, ó má ka Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa kú nū ɛtá ɔhá ā, kwú jɔ̄kwū klla lɔhi iyē fíyɛ́ odúúdú ayípōklóbīya ohile ɔhá nēe gē lé ɔdōlé olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ klla ī gwá ejé kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē ka ā. N géē gwū éeyē ō gwó mɛ́mla ijē ō gwó kú uculo kú ɔ̄nya ō lɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Ācɛ amānyā géē lā géē yēeyī kéē bī eyī kú uwá le má ɛ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
idu_Latn: É gáā móōwē eko obɔ̄bí ŋ́, amáŋ é géē lɛ ɔdōlé cabɔ̄ bá eko kú ɔkpɛtā.

eng_Latn: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēé gē cɛ̄hɔ̄, amáŋ Óndú ékpó ā nēé gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka íneobīya kú nū le tīkwū ŋmá ajɛ jāā ga ɔkpáncō Ɔwɔicō í kē je mlanyi ucē ɔbíipú kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
idu_Latn: É tóohi kahíníī, Cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si cɛ́ɛ́ é géē lɛ uwɔ nyatá, awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je obū kú ɔlékwū ā tɛ́ɛcɛ péee, klla ī bī ofíyajɛ wā ajɛ nōo dobū fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
idu_Latn: nōó bī ɔ̄ wā okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ó le íne bīya. Ó le oyī pīya bónū ɛɛ́, é kē gáā je ɔ́ kóō wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ije ámāŋ ɔdōlé kplá ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ ije tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ Assɔbanípalu kpó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā gaá lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá dóódu nēe lā ajɛ ɔhá dóódu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā.

eng_Latn: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kóō je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó miya ɔ́ ŋmá ɔtū kú nū lɛ ā. Kóō híīī je ɔ́ yɔ̄ gē híjémā ŋ́, ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ gē kwu ɔ́ bá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ɛhi mla éeyē ā, ī he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā ɔhá mafú gā um. Anɔ́ɔ ipú ɛbɛ ā, ó yɔ̄ ī tútū kóō bī ɔlá le yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū italā. Ɔlá ā kwú éŋkpɔ̄ kú itekwú ú yi ŋmá ɛháajɛ kú ɛcɛ kpatáá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ā gbɔɔ́ ō je ajɛ áncā yi dúú á.

eng_Latn: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
idu_Latn: Igbómína kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā da uwá keé gáā lé ɔdōlé kú ɛya nēé gē gwó lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bī anwa kú Úrim mla Utúmmim lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔɔ́, kú aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aádā aá hútu ā yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū, apī nɛ̄ aá hɛ́ ā tīile lɛ aá. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ íne ā tū ŋ́ apī nɛ̄ aá hɛ́ ā í tīile lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛga éyi yɔ̄ ɛgiyí um, nāa géē mahayi ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ā;.

eng_Latn: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
idu_Latn: É je ɛga lɛ aéfūma ā kéē ŋmó ācɛ nēe bá ā ŋ́, amáŋ kéē yá uwā owe olɔnɔ ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ ofōōfūnū. Ɔnɔ kú owe nēé ī yá uwā nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnɔ kú ɛna o cɛ ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī nɛ̄ Amásīya, ɔyí kú Ujówāsi lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa, ɔyí kú Ujɛhówāsi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, Usamérīya iháyí ofɛpa ce éyi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
idu_Latn: Aá ka obɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē cá aótrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ aá ɛcá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
idu_Latn: N dɔɔ̄kā kú aá lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé lɔɔlɔhi ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo da ɛfu nyā, kóō lɛ iyī nū fu ŋmá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú iyī nū ú tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ í kwu ipú ísu, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā í lɛ ɔtū kú nū bɛ́ɛpa ŋ́, amáŋ nōó cɛ̄ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā í yá, ó kē í yá lɛ ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
idu_Latn: Ulífāyi ma ayí ɛtá. É kē wɛ Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukóhāti mɛ́mla Umérāri.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē je aá tá ipú abɔ̄ aéwɔhá, nēe géē wī aá uwī klla í je aá iyó kpó wu. N géē je aá yíífi dúúdú, nɛ̄ a á klla gáā wɛ éwo kú abɔ̄yī aá gbóógbóō ipú ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī híla ɔdā yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī gɔ́ ɔdā kwɔhá kē yɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī lɛ okónu klá cíí yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le da uwá pélúú kahíníī, Ulásārɔ̄si gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
idu_Latn: N géē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi. Ń kē gáā blakwu íne nēé bīya ā gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbā ɛcí ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē pā ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā ā, uwēyī géē kwú uwā. Ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe ma aójibó kú ɛcí ā wɛ alɛɛcɛ áncā nɛ̄. Odúúdú uwá kéē wā í háyi mɛ́mla anú ɔnū ɛpɔ̄. Ufi nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla uwēyī kē géē kwú uwá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ piíí.

eng_Latn: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é tá ádā uwā ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā leyīkwu kpɔ́ kéē yá ɔyínɛ́ alɔ odée bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé kwúcē ŋmá ō yɛcɛ ɔ́, í klla lɛ ɛlā wu ɔdā nōó da uwā kéē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n gē hī uwɔ igwú, ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú um ŋ́. Lɛ uwēyī kpó tū ācobɔ̄bíipū ā ɛyí. Lɛ uwá okónu gwū ká ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
idu_Latn: Adorám, Ulákissi, Asɛ́ka.

eng_Latn: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ Óndú, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ, aá gwíijē lɛ Óndú.

eng_Latn: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n le uwá kpó lɛ iyī um kwɛyí ayí áflɛ́yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, é kē wɛ ákú um ōfōōfū um.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu a géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ā ga eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ipu ɔlɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
idu_Latn: Ka odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ ké gekwú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usisɛ́ra kwú ā, Óndú. Amáŋ ayípōklóbīya ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā! Ɛbɔ́ yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
idu_Latn: Óndú klla da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú anúɔ klla yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú anúɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā nū, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ yá ā, ka anúɔ í je oyēeyī ōlīkpō lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ge tū fu Ísrɛ̄lu ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá. Da uwá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá ā, ó wɛ ohígbū uwā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū iyē kú um nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá dúúmā í tōō gbla anú ŋ mā nēé ge je uwēyī lɛ ɔ́, ɛga dóódu nēé nyɔ̄ ipú aéwɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ká ācɛ nēe gē bɛ̄yíkwu aá ā, kéē yúufi um. N géē bī ígbájí wā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē nuunu tá aá ā. N géē yá odúúdú aólɛlā kú aá, kéē lɛ igbīhi cē kwu aá, kéē lɛ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
idu_Latn: Unwalu ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔbɔ̄cɛ ō yá gē tū táajɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ ō pīya ɔ́ tā ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
idu_Latn: N géē héyītū aá ká n̄ yá aá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. N gáā yá aá lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛfú géē lé aá, ámāŋ́ ɔkpɛtá géē kpó aá ŋmó jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujúda nēe lā Íjīpiti ā le pɛ́ gekwú mɛ.

eng_Latn: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
idu_Latn: Ōwē o ligii nɛ̄ alɔ ī má nyā nōo gáā gbojī ŋ́ mā, le nyɛ́ lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Ohígbū kéē géē bī ɔdā nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ nōo í yɔ̄ piyóó gé lɛ alɔ, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ oyēeyī opiyóó mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin, nɛ̄ aíkpō nū gē gwō bónū gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē pīya ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú olīfu nɛ̄ ohéepu kú nū gē gwō bónū ā.

eng_Latn: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
idu_Latn: Aá le ɔtū kú aá yéékpó ká aá híīī lɛla wū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē kɔkɔ kú iyī aá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o hile nɛ̄ Unebúsāradan kpó kwú nyɔ̄ ā wɛ Useráya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla Usefaníya nōo kpó okónu ce ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ o kpɔ́cíkpɔ́cí ɛtá ɔhá nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, odúúdú āce kú ɛcɛ gē wā ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu gaá lá igwu, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā ā yɔ̄ odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
idu_Latn: Aá ɛpɛplɛ́pa jé ka n yúklɔ́ lɛ ádā aá ŋmá odúúdú ɔfú kú um.

eng_Latn: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
idu_Latn: Da uwá kéē le ɔdōlé kú aíháyí olɔhi nēe yɔ̄ ī wā ā kpó, a klla í je íkwú lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔdɛ̄hīcō kpó tū ipú inu ipú aígelī cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbō ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí gē nuunu tá um áncā, amáŋ íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ n gē yúufi nū ōfōōfūnū á.

eng_Latn: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɔdā ocɛgbá nɛ̄hi nōo yá nēé tɔ́ɔna nū ɛbɛɛbɛ kú Ujudíya, ó hútu ŋmá Ugálīli igbīhi olɛhɔ̄ ka ācɛ kéē le pīyabɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ubatísim yá uwā nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, alɔ géē je ayí alɔ nɔ̄nyā lɛ aá, alɔ kē í lɛ ayí aá nɔ̄nyā. Alɔ géē lā mla aá, kú ālɔ̄ kwú pīya ācɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ tɛtɛ gēe gwō ɛ̄ngwū gēe gwó ijē kú ojīlīma ga uwɔ, ícɛ a, a gaa v ɛɛ́; nyɔ̄ gāa gwutá agōdō kú ɛkɔ̄ mla inyílɔ́, ká a lɛ īlī kú inyílɔ́ mla íkplɛ́ klá iyē.

eng_Latn: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
idu_Latn: N gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi abālɔbányā ohígbū ka n lɔtūce aá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū dóódu ā mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ gē nyɔ̄ í tū ūlī kú úklɔ́ kú uwá kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́máapu uwá húmáyī yá ŋmífī Árɔ̄ni ā. Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā wɛ ijáalí kú ɔdā dóódu nōo bá nyā á.

eng_Latn: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
idu_Latn: Kóocōō ɔkpani um, gbɔbū ká ā bēē nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ n tá uwɔ ɔkwu ɛmɛɛma, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú bī ami mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ā lɛ glá ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ gaá le jīla tɔ̄há ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ohile ā ú kpó tū Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ nū ā abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Abíssayi kwú uwá eyī ú pīya kwu ācɛ Ámɔn á.

eng_Latn: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ucē okpaakpa ō yá wiiyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé ɔkplɛ́fú kú oje ā. Ó kē í lɛ ɔfú ō nya ācɛ tá kwɛyí bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpú ā. Ó kē ī lɛ ɔ́ci mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū wiiyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé mɛ́mla īlī wuulu ā.

eng_Latn: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā gaá lɛ ede ā gwó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ugádi da ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwɔtū kóō lɛ oyēeyī kú nū nyatá, ó gáā lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo kwú oyēeyī kú nū ú tónū, ó géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um ipú ígbíli ā dúú. É tá ō lɛ íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú um, nēe ī bī oyēeyī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá ā tū. É klla lɛ aɛ́cī nɛ̄ uwā í cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ mā tá tēelihɔ dúúdú. N le tútū ō yá uwā italā ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
idu_Latn: Iháyí ofu nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn bī le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū mɛ á.

eng_Latn: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ é yá ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋmá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā, ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, abālɔbányā ɔ̄cɛnyā gē ma ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mɛ́ɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ pi kwu icō agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ Ábsālɔm. Anɔ́ɔ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ péee ipéyī kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ábsālɔm le tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā gaá le ikpó anyā ɔlɛ́ ádā nū kpó ce kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó ɔfú kwu ajɛ olagbénú nɛ̄hi ā igbledū, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aádáádā nū í yá ŋ́ mā, nōó gē yá á. Ó kē í kɔ̄ agbénú nōó kpó uwī ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ gē yɛce ɔ̄ ā. Ó géē tū ujɔ kóō nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú ga ɛga o lɔfú ō tayínū kú igelī ā, amáŋ eko kú nū géē mɛ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔtū gbā ɛdɔ ɔkɔ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ga awɔ, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ohígbū ka awɔ ma odúúdú nū fú gā um, klla da um ka, ayááyí um géē lé ɔcɛ́ igbīhi um má.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ ɛlā nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū.

eng_Latn: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, A géē nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di mla um? Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami mɛ́mla awɔ wɛ ācɛ ékpónú nɛ̄, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kē wɛ ācɛ ékpónú. Alɔ mɛ́mla aá gáā bá ɔgbɛ́fú abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ā, n māháyi okónu ísu nɛ̄hi kú Utígrīsi.

eng_Latn: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ á. Ɔyí ā kē le hɛ́tá ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ má ka ɛ́ɛ tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, ōŋmá lɛ ojibó kú oje nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛna nēé ma lɛ īyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā kē gbɔbū lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá ī tá opo ā, ācɛ o hile ā kē bá igbīhi kú ikpati kú okónu ōce ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kē bá yɔ̄ ī tá opo ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
idu_Latn: Cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Cɛ̄tra anú ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā ga opiyóó. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ a kahíníī, Kóō le yá lɛ ā .

eng_Latn: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi yɛce ɔ́, ohígbū kéē má ocābɔ̄ nōó ó yá iyē kú ācɛ odoōcē ā.

eng_Latn: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo líla gaá mīya abɔ̄ ugbɔga, cíkā nēé ī kpó iyó kú ɔlɛ́ nū kóō wɛ ɔdā ō cabɔ̄, gbéeko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ulé ā gbā kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā wɛ ofɛtá cigwó. Ujófɛ̄fu ā tɛtɛ yɔ̄ Íjīpiti ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē gbō uwɔ. É gáā je uwɔ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ a géē yúufi uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu iyē kú ɛga nɛ̄ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ŋmá eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kpó uwā trɛ̄yí ŋmá Íjípiti ā.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan lɛ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla okwúukwu kwu ajɛ le icō kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nēé bī le ŋmó ɔwɛ ā tū, ɔyípóklóbīya ā kē yɛce ɔ́. Ujonátan gē nuunu tá ācɛ Ufilístiya gē hɛ́ uwā fīyāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔyípóklóbīya ā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā.

eng_Latn: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē cīce ɛyí ijakī nɛ̄hɛ́, ɛyí īlī nēé o cɔkpɛ́nú nēe ī le klá anú ā, mɛ́mla aá nēe gē yɛ íkpó ga ɛga dúú nɛ̄ aá gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā ī yɛ ga ajɛ gicō, gē hayi ɛga ékpónú klla ī wu nɛɛ, aákā ā kē ī yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ayí ofɛtá cigwó, ohígbū koó lɛ anyā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
idu_Latn: Aá aílɔ́wá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ābɔ̄ ɔcí ólīfu kú ipácí nēé hɛ́ kwu ɔcí kú ólīfu nēé tū abɔ̄yīnū ā, nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwō ɔdūwā tá ā. Ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ólīfu nēé tū ā. Ó géē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́ kóō kwú ābɔ̄ nēé hɛ́ ā ú kwúcē í kwu ɔcí abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ uwá klla géē tóohi kahíníī, Óndú, eko nyá nɛ̄ alɔ má uwɔ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwɔ, ámāŋ ka ijēēnyi gē ŋmó uwɔ, ámāŋ ka a wɛ ugbɔga, ámāŋ ka a tóohɛ́wa, ámāŋ ka a yɔ̄ gē doōcē, ámāŋ ka a yɔ̄ agbá, nɛ̄ alɔ í leyīkwu uwɔ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
idu_Latn: A kwú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu nɛ̄ n kpó gā uwɔ ā í kpó ma aójībó kú ācɛnyīlɔ, klla yɔ̄ ī gbaajā tú uwá.

eng_Latn: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá uwā abɔ̄, gē tá uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū, ó klla í tá uwā ɔtū lé.

eng_Latn: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
idu_Latn: N kpó íkpɛ́lā kwu ācɛ o yɛ ɔwɛ nyā ā kōō yá kéē lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā kpó ŋmó dúú, n gē kwú ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā kú ɔwɛ nyā, gē kpó uwā tū agbá.

eng_Latn: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ā, ɛgbá ije ce um, amáŋ ń junwalu lɛ aá ká aá tū um abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ayínɛ́ nēe ŋmá Umasɛdónīya ā lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe ce um ɛgbá kpɛ́mm ā kpó gé um. Ń kē kwu aá bá ɔ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, n kōō gáā kwu aá bá ɔ̄ kú aá tá um abɔ̄ abālɔbányā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Áfādi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Usémá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Uhámati. Igbīhāajɛ ā ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ Ukénan le nyīla ga ɛga ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔyí um, ɛ́mba a lɛ ɛfiyɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā hɛ́ ɛɛ́, amáŋ ɔwɛ nāa í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú ā yɔ̄ á. Páápá nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú okónu nāa ce gbɔbū ɔ́ɔmā ú ŋmónyí.

eng_Latn: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔnyā dúú ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ipú ayípáncɛ́nyā kú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́ nɛɛ, ámāŋ ka ipú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́ nɛ̄ɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ufilístiya nōo wɛ aólufíyē āa? Amáŋ Usámsin da ádā nū kóō lɛ ɔ́ lɛ lɛ anúɔ, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tóohi ka, A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄, Óndú? Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka, Ami wɛ Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti nāa gē yá ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ úklɔ́ yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Óndú ā, abɔ̄yī nū géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā kahíníī, N tá uwɔ ahínyá, Ádā, Óndú kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ. Ohígbū ka a lɛ ɔdā nēe bá āa tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí aójéeyī mɛ́mla aójɔ́dā, klla lɛ uwá mafú lɛ ācɛ nēe jé odée ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɛ́cī kú ucɛ kú uwá ā le yá í yɛ nɛɛ, Ujóbu gē hī uwā igwú gaá gwu uwá iyē kéē le yá yēŋēē. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli ā, Ujóbu gēe cāŋjɛ klla í gwɛ́ɛya ooyi ɔlá éyééye kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā. Ohígbū kóō gē gbɛlá ka, ekōōhī ayí anúɔ ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lɛ íne bīya ŋmá lɛ ɛcá ō cá Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔtū kú uwá ɛɛ́. Ujóbu kwú ɛnyā ú pīya ucē kú nū nōó gē yá ohígbū ayí nū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le pó ā, ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá egéégéyi, le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ɛgiyí uwā gaá kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ kú Usiríya kpɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tú uwā ā, é kē gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu tú ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
idu_Latn: N lɛ aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā, mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, é kllá ma ayí ɔfiyɛ alɛwa ɔlɛ́ um. N lɛ agbénú kú ɔdāajɛ fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū gā um Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ gāá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā Usúsa ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le okónu gwū ɛ̄cī ɛtá, kwu otú kwɛɛnɔ kú aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū um. Ɛ̄cī ɛtá ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ami mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ um géē gwōkónu, klla í bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū aá dúú. Igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē nyɔ̄ gaá má ɔcɛ́. Náaná nɛ̄ n jé ka italā kú nū wɛ ikwú ā, n géē nyɔ̄ kpɔ́. Ó wɛ ikwū nɛɛ ayíka n gekwú.

eng_Latn: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a gē yá ucē kpaakpa nááná, á je ɔdā dúúmā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jégēdē ŋ́, lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdēelihɔ dúúmā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka okwū kú ɛbɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kwú īyī nū tēelīhɔ. Ó kē lɛ ɛpɔ́bí lé ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó le ɔdā nōó yá ā jé ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōó lɛ ā ŋmó bónū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpɛtā nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó kē lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōó í lé gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe ī ka ɛdɔ kú ɛla nēe bá nyā pllá aá ŋ́. Ohígbū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ucē olɔhi tá ipú ɔ́wá kú ācɛ nēe yá ucē obɔ̄bí, é gē bīya ɔ́.

eng_Latn: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ŋmá lɛ eyīnyinyi ā Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá eyī á. Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, é gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ, anɔ́ɔ é kē gbɔɔ́ ō yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ámōōmɛ á, ami kē wɛ ohútu mɛ́mla oŋmɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu le héyī á, ó le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā da ɔ́ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le Umerí lɛ ɔnyā á.

eng_Latn: And Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tóohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
idu_Latn: Ulífāyi ma ayí ɛtá, Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukɔ́hāti mɛ́mla Umerári ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá mla ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā? Ó ta cāā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā kéē lɛ ɔdā ō hídáagó ojēyī nɛ̄hi yá ɛɛ́, alɔ í kē híhó kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka á, alɔ yɛ gɔbū kú alɔ yɛce ɛdɔ kú íne ékpó nɛ̄ alɔ yɛce jāā kwu abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ ō bī gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā wɛ ɛdrɔ́ kú aɔ́bá ɛna ofu ce ɛnɛ, aómlede ofɛtá, aópī ofɛtá, álá kú iháyí éyi ofɛɛtá. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya kóō je tīihɔ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
idu_Latn: Uhásɛ̄lu le ɛdɔ iyó olɔhi dóódu kú Udamákɔ̄si gbō ce aínyankwūlūmī ofɛpa igbīhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa á. Eko nɛ̄ Uhásɛ̄lu le ɔ́ má ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, Ubēnhádādi, ɔcɛ́ ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā í da uwɔ ɔ̄kā, ɔ́dāŋ́ koó géē wī ŋmá ōcē kú nū ā, ámāŋ ka ó gáā wī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka iyɔ̄bū odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō ka ɔwɛ ékpónú nyā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē je agbá kú Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn hɛ́ ŋmá ɔkɔ kú odúúdú aéwo ipú iháyí ɛpa nēe ī wā ā. Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, n nyɛɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé ā bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá ka aá mla ɔcɛ́ ōfōōfū aá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu aá á nɛɛ? Ehée, n yɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ ācɛ nēe cīce ɛyí ɔdɔ ā, nēe géē lé emī kú uwā klla í gwá encílé kú iyī uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē gwá ákú aá ā.

eng_Latn: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nēé le ejé gwá, é lɔfú je mlanyī íne nēé tū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é nyí aógbɛhá ɔdā nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó pó ɛlā kú uwɔ ŋ́, a klla kwú ɔ̄cɛ éyi ú, ámāŋ ācɛ ɛpa ú tɔ́ɔkwu, kóō ŋmá okónu kú ācɛ ocījáalí ɛpa ámāŋ ɛtá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā dóódu kóō lɛ ibéenú lɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ká ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ Ufínēhasi, ɔyí kú Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn, Ugádi mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔyí nēé ma ɔwɛ ɔlamu ā, gē yá ɔyí nēé ma ŋmá lɔfú kú Alelékwū ā ŋmó, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ abālɔbányā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ɔ́ŋgbá mɛ́mla agbá nēé ī le gbō īlī nēé ī le pla ɛhícō úgbéenyi kú owu kóō pɛ́ tɔ̄ɔ̄ kóō kwu úgbéenyi gɔbū ā wɛ áncā. Īlī ɔ́ɔmā kú úgbéenyi kú aólɛlā í gáā nwūla glá ŋ́. Alɔ géē mīyɛ̄ odúúdú aíyó agbénú kú aólɛlā kú alɔ abɔ̄fú. Aíyó agbénú ā kē í nwuné nɛ̄hi nēé í kɔ̄, nɛ̄ ācɛ oŋmíkpó nááná géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ ŋmá anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá nōo bī ocíbú ugóolu kú ɔtulalī abɔ̄, gaá hayi pī ede ā. É lɛ ɔtulalī fú lɛ ɔ́ láyí kóō fú tū ipú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō gē gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú ugóolu nōo kwu iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
idu_Latn: Usélēki ŋmá Ámɔn, Unahárāyi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī iyɛ́fú kú Ujówabu ā, ŋmá Ubéerɔtu.

eng_Latn: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ anúɔ kōō leyīkwu aálá ku ɔnyīlɔ ā ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ā? Ɔdā dúúmā kú nū ɔ́ bī ŋ́. Ɔwɛ nɔ́ɔ lɛ cílá anúɔ ulé kú abɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ tá ɔ̄ yɔ̄ á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
idu_Latn: Aá je ɔdōlé kú aá lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā. Aá mīyɛ aólɛhɔ́cɛ nēé lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā wā ɔlɛ́ aá kéē lā mɛ́mla aá. Aá je īlī lɛ ācɛ nēé má īlī dúúmā le wiiyē ŋ́ mā. Aá kē híī tá ō tá aɔ́máapú aá abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ugɛ́hási le yɛ gaá kwú okwutɛ kú Ɛláyíssa ā ú miya kwu ɔyí ā īkpɛ̄yí, amáŋ ɔdā dúúmā í yá ŋmá anú ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā í le da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɔyí ā í héyī nóó.

eng_Latn: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ɛwa ā da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Utíca, da ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ kóō lɛ úgwū kú ádā alɔ kɔ̄ mla um.
