eng_Latn: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
idu_Latn: É í je ɔnyɔɔnyɛ héyī eko okpaakpa kú nū, ɔgbace ɔgbace. Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí á, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nɛ̄ wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē gboce ɔ́ eko nōó í kwúcē wā kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaohnechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
idu_Latn: Uféro Unéko, le Ujehowáhāsi kwú ɔgbɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya alagbá kú ɛfú á. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ kú Uríbila nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Uhámāti ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda le ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ugóolu ofu ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ gbā iháyí dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ ɛ̄gbā néē géē gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē gwō aéwɔhá ā ɔ́ci, kéē klla yá ācɛ éwɔhá italā.

eng_Latn: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā tōō kpɔ́tūce, ó kē géē lɔfú tū aá iyē, í klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ oyá ɔdōōbɔbí ā yá aá odée ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpā nū ŋmó, nɛ̄ ó jégēdēē ŋmó ɔ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó kē tɛtɛ wɔ́tū nū táajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Ubenaya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda, mɛ́mla Unátan ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla Ussíméyi, Uréyi, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē gbō Udéfīdi ɛyí ā í yɛce Adónīja ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ oōmá, Ɔwɔicō kwú um ú ga ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gáā kwú um ce ɛyí ɛfu olicō nɛ̄hi éyi. Anɔ́ɔ n má odée ɔwɛ ɛhícō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ alɛwa bá anú ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou steal.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī wūūwī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔbá nū ā tá ká ɔ̄ híī cē oji ā ŋ́ nɛ, ayíka ó gáā cē ŋ́. Óndú ā í je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
idu_Latn: Ubáalam ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ, ɔ̄cogwɛ́bā ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā Óndú da Ugídīyɔn kóō kwú ɔbá ɛna kú ádā nū, nōo wɛ iháyí ahāapa ɔhá ú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ede kú ɛcí nēe hī ka Ubáalu kú ádā nū ā ú catāajɛ. Ó klla da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔcí ojibó kú ɛcínɔ̄nyā, nēé hī ka Ássɛ̄ra ā hɛ́ klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni nōo lɛ agwú ámāŋ nōo gē tíyē ŋmá agada icííci, í gáā lé ɔdōlé otīihɔ kú um ā ŋ́, gbéeko nōó lɛ iyē gwu le yá yēŋēē. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu géē je tēelihɔ ɔ́dāŋ nōó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdēelihɔ bɛ̄ɛka okwū ámāŋ yɔ̄ ī tíyē icííci ŋmá agada.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujówābu ka anúɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne ā á. Ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í lɛ Ábsālɔm bī wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Amānyā ā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ɛbɛ kú ɛya nēé gwó ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é ī le cílā ulé ā ce ɔlá á. Amānyā nēé géē yá igbō kú umu kú ɛya ā dúú á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ē hii bī ɔdā otīihɔ kú ɛya ā dúúmā ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ŋ́ ohígbū nēé í kpó ɛbí tū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ o gwíinu tá koó tīile dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ mā, klla kwú pīya ɛcɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú kú inu ō gwó mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe géē hile ipú Ujúda ā géē tíikpó kwajɛ, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo gē tá ɛgba ga ajɛ lipú lipú, klla ī gwá īkpō nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
idu_Latn: Ó da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē híī yá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o pā ɛcí eko nɛ́ɛ ī gwéeyē ī lé ucɛ kú ūwā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē pā ɛcí ɛga dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā gē gbajā tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛnyīlɔ ā. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ gē jɔ́nyɛ kú ɔdā nēé ī mīyɛ ŋmá anú ā.

eng_Latn: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ i kɛlā cāā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú kē da ɔ́ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Aótrɛ̄yí ká alɔ i kpōō le jé ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nōo í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, le ikwū je klá Óndú. Ó kē le ɔkɔ kú nū pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ nyatá ŋmá ipú odúúdú unwalu kú nū á.

eng_Latn: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu gekwú tá ipú inu, ācɛ nēe bá ipú inu eko ɔ́ɔmā, mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu nēe ga ipú inu ɛga nɛ̄ ó kwú tá ā géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána, Isssíya, Asárɛlu, Ujowésa mɛ́mla Ujassobéyam ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóra.

eng_Latn: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi lɛ īyī uwā iyē gwu yēŋēē. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ulífāyi lɛ odúúdú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā kpó ŋmó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nōo pīyɛyí ā. É klla le ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ákú īyī uwā kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
idu_Latn: Ɔtōce ɛ́gɛ́nyā yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu íkée ā á.

eng_Latn: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔcí Ufígi éyi má ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí nū á. Amáŋ ó má īkpō dúúmā ābɔ̄ nū ŋ́, amáŋ ēpū ōfōōfūnū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Á gáā gwá īkpō gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcí ā gekwú kwú wúla ēpū bōōbū á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄gbā nēé gē gbā um ā í ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā ŋ́. É gē nwū ācɛ kéē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne nēé wɛ ákú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
idu_Latn: Nááná, odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ kē í pó olɛhɔ̄ kú uwā, jāā kwu ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Ɔwɔicō le ɔlɛ́ gwó lɛ ɛnɔ ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛnɔ ú kwu abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū nɛ̄ Umósīsi gbaáluka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā, wɛ úlā ofɛpa ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá bī iyē kú um ba, n géē yá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kóō yá kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā wɛ idáagó lɛ ā má.

eng_Latn: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nōó pó ka Akélɔ̄si ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujudíya ā kwɛyí ádā nū, Uhérɔ̄du ā, Ujósɛ̄fu yúúfi ō nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ukɔ́ tū ɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄na ā kóō le tá ajɛ kú Ugálīli á.

eng_Latn: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē ca ɛcɔ̄ ā, ɛcɔ̄ ā lɔfú yá ɔ̄ ágbe glá. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē í yíla ɛfú ā, ɛfú lɔfú yá ɔ̄ ágbe glá.

eng_Latn: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cōbɔ̄bíipú mā ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bī ā tá, nɛ̄ ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōlɔhi mla ɔdā okpaakpa, ó gáā kwú ŋ́ amáŋ ó géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó lɔfú kwu ga odóódu kú uwā fíyaa glá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ īyī nū ɛyí nyatá glá.

eng_Latn: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ n géē leyīkwu ɔ́dāŋ kéē le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kpó yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ anú nōo bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā le hɛ́ ísu nɛ̄hi ā ɛpa eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi jé abɔ̄ gicō ā yɔ̄ āa? Ó kē lɛ ɔwɛ tá yɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ísu ā le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ kéē híī je mlanyī ɛka nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā gbo mla uwá ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá kéē híī yá ojibó dúúmā lɛ iyī uwā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í kōō wā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ ó wā í cɛ̄ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gekwú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ alɛwa nyatá.

eng_Latn: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē jé ohi okpaakpa ō tá eko okpaakpa kú ɛlá dóódu ā gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
idu_Latn: Óbɛ́dɛ́dɔm yɔ̄ ipú uwá dúú. Ɔwɔicō hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ je ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahātá nyā lɛ ɔ́ ā: Ussémāya, Ujɛhósābadi, Ujówa, Usáka, Unetánɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɔyí álá māháyi ɔtāhɛ́ kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā le yɛjīla anú tá. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ā. Ó lɛ ajī ahāapa. Ó kē lɛ aíkpēyī ahāapa. Aíkpēyī ā kē wɛ aálelékwū ahāapa kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
idu_Latn: É tíne kéē kwú ɔ̄ ā, amáŋ ufi ācɛ ā gē yá uwā, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā je ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si pi uwá ahɔ̄ kéē híī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu anúɔ nóó.

eng_Latn: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā le miya ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ká ɔ́ɔ géē lɔfú tīyē, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū jɛ̄ lɛ ā, kóō lɛ ɔdā nēe í le tá ayínɛ́ nēe lā Ujudíya abɔ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá.

eng_Latn: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
idu_Latn: yá jīla lɛ alɔ nēe wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā, oŋmá lɛ ō je Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú Aíjē olɔhi ɔ́mpa ā ka, Awɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um á, ícɛ nyā n le pīya ádā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
idu_Latn: Je ugóolu nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ áncā, ámāŋ ka aɛ́cɔ̄ kú ipú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ ī móōwē, ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtūlé ká alɔ cīce cíí.

eng_Latn: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ede le gbɛka, bī ɔ̄ le gbɛka, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɛyí nū ā dúú.

eng_Latn: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
idu_Latn: Nááná nōó yá aɔ́dā ō hídáagó alɛwa ipéyī uwā ā, é lɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usedekíya leyīkwu ca ā, é kwú ayí nū ú kpó ŋmó ipéeyī nū. Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa kwú ɛ̄wā ú le ɔ́ eyī kpó nwūla, klla kwú agbá ú kwu ɔ́ abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ bī ga Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛlíyēsa, ɔyí kú Udódāfahu nōo ŋmá ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Umárēssa ā le ukɔ́ tū Ujɛhósāfati kahíníī, Ohígbū okónu nāa ce, mla oklóbīya uwɔ Ahasíya ā, Óndú ā géē je ɔdā nāa gwó ā wúla tāajɛ klla í je ɔ́ kpó yíífi. Anɔ́ɔ aúgbéényi ā kwú gbayibó, í klla cāŋjɛ gbóógbóō glá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ ā mɛ́mla Ɔnyā nɛ̄ Ɔyí álá ā gáā lɛ ā da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Wā! Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē pó ɛlā nyā ā kéē da Ujísɔ̄si dúú kahíníī, Wā! Wā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛ̄ íjéényī ī ŋmó ɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo tíne kóō wā í mīyɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī je oyēeyī ā alahá.

eng_Latn: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí nū igbɔhá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ wā ɛgiyí nū Ugíbēyɔn ā.

eng_Latn: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwéeyē ā, ó gáā lɛ ɔtū plicō kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī le kpíí lɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā kú ɛhi ō bī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, géē nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō nyɔ̄ í má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
idu_Latn: É le ɔlá nōo cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi nyí, le bū ikwū kú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī acá. É le lɔfú ipú ahi, klla kwú pīya ācɛ olɔfú ipú ɛfú nɛ̄hi, klla le aícɔ́ɔja kú aéwo ɔhá yálé.

eng_Latn: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ ā, Óndú, géē pɛ́kwú, a klla í yá odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā lé.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Ujóbu jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda le ācɛ nēe ŋmó Ámɔn ā kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔyí nū Ujosíya ú ce ɔ̄cɛ kwɛyí Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
idu_Latn: Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kpɛ́fú tá īyī uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: So Job died, being old and full of days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu gekwú eko nōó kwú hīla ókplící nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ Ujóna, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Unínīfɛ ā, nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔnyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú eko nyā á.

eng_Latn: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
idu_Latn: Ó he um ɔtū kú n̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Unwū ká n̄ yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú gē ŋmó um. N gē gwíijē kú éeyē mɛ́mla odúúdú odo kú um lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
idu_Latn: Aá híīī kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híīī kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ŋ́. Aá híīī ŋmó ācɛ ɔhá okónu ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híīī ŋmó aá okónu ŋ́. Aá je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ yá ā yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē je ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá yá ā yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá lɛ odo kú aá na yēŋēē ŋmá ɔ́bíipú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē le nyatá. Aá géē bá ī gbo ohílīpú obɔ̄bí piyóó mɛ́ ŋ́ŋ̄?.

eng_Latn: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;
idu_Latn: gē gbɛɛka ícɛ ka odúúdú alɔ géē lā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ a, íne nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ alɔ bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ā ka ɛka í kwú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ íne ā nyílá. Alɔ klla cokónu ka alɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ je lɛ alɔ ā. Alɔ kē í lɛ odúúdú íne ā mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū dóódu tū, klla í yá odúúdú nū.

eng_Latn: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ olɔhi kú uwɔ ā, a gē gbō um bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛfu yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí ā. Amáŋ a kwú iyī uwɔ ú tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí um, anɔ́ɔ n kē gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi á.

eng_Latn: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɔfú je ɔdā nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Anɔ́ɔ aá gáā lɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā iyē ŋ́, é ke gáā yá ɔdā dúúmā nēé géē bī le ŋmó aá okónu ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē ā lé ipú ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ŋmá lɛ ō je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá ɔtū éékpó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɔ́hā ce uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
idu_Latn: Aá, ācoleyī ɛpa, Ayisáya kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu aá nōó ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ iyī nū mafú lɛ Upíta mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ igwɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ gē yá ucɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá ɔgbɔɔgba. É kē ī hī ayínɛ́ uwá nɔ̄nyā ɛtá ā gaá lé ucɛ nyā mɛ́mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! N yɔ̄ ī wā bɛ̄ɛka uwī ā! Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ, í gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́, nōo kē lɛ úwé kú nū tútū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híīī tóōhɛ́ɛwa yɔ̄ gē yɛ ipéyī ācɛ kú uwēyī kóō kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɔhí.

eng_Latn: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
idu_Latn: Awɔ je oyēeyī ga um klla gē yíihɔtū tū um eko dóódu á. A kē lɛ ɛlá kwu um, klla le um tū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Ujéhu kwú ɔdā ō bī gwɛ́ɛya ā ú ce ɛyí ede kú Ubáalu ā, ó da ācɛ a kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá kwu ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkpacaŋgelī kpó pi ce wu abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é le tá ipú agbla kú Ubáalu ā, gaá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ é le okwū kú uwā kpó ga ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é le tá eyīpú kú agbla kú Ubáalu ā.

eng_Latn: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū géē yɔ̄ piyóó bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō í yɔ̄ ā. Ayááyí nū gē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó á.

eng_Latn: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā. Kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá tayínū, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ alɔ yá tɛ́ɛcɛ, kwu aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔdā olɔhi. Ɔwɔicō gáā kɛpɔ̄ kú ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ukássiya. É miya ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē miya odée ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ lɛ ā. Lɛ ɛlɛm ofu ce ɛnɛ kú anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu ā tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā kéē yēeyī līgbō ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ cokónu ka anúɔ ī je lɛ ádáádā uwā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lā abɔ́ɔ piyóó, eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í yɔ̄ í kwu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
idu_Latn: N tá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā fu aá nēe lɔtūce iyē kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jé ka aá lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó lɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ō yá olɔhi ā gē he Óndú ā ɔtū á, amáŋ Óndú ā gē ŋmó ācɛ oyá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā ɛpɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
idu_Latn: N jé ka ihɔtū kú uwɔ gē yɔ̄ eko dóódu. Ka ā kē tōō lɛ ɔtūce piyóó bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo í wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā í gáā lɛ ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú alɛwa lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti gáā lá ɔnya ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā í tíne kéē kwúcē ga Íjīpiti igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
idu_Latn: Īkpō kú nū oŋmá okómpinu ɛcɛ ā jāā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú inu nōo yɔ̄ ɛga kú ɛplá ā wɛ umíta ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Bla ka oŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ obene kú uwɔ, nāa jé ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō otīīhɔ ā nōo lɔfú je íjééyī nōo mafú ɔwɛ nāa géē nyatá ā fú gā uwɔ o ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛ uwá kpɔ́ ka aúgbɔga nēe lá ajɛ kú uwā ā, géē bá ī lɔfú tōotū ɔ̄, amáŋ ɔfú géē yɔ̄ í hɛ́ uwā ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa ā wɛ Upagíyɛlu, ɔyí kú Ɔ́ciran.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ íne nyā tányílá, Ɔwɔicō í gáā ka ɔ́ tū ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī nwū ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi ɛlā gbóógbō ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ó géē wɔ́tū uwɔ. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɛlā nwū ojéeyī, ó géē lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi éyi nōo yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ oligbó kéē je ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá í wā a, Óndú cɛ̄ le ɔtū kú uwā kwú wuklíicō, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ámɔn ɛpa ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá. Anɔ́ɔ aádáádā alɔ í kē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla ɔtā mla ɔyī kú uwā yúklɔ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le mafú lɛ ācɛ ké í lā ɛbɔ́ mla anúɔ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nē é cē igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu Ébrahām abālɔbányā; ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ ó kpóce Ɔwɔicō ā, ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
idu_Latn: Aá géē kwu gaá bū ɔpɛ́ nōo kɔ̄ ɛfu ā ɛpa ā. Aá géē kwinya ohígbū oyēeyī kú aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā á kwu eko nɛ̄ ajɛ hɛ́ wulu eko nɛ̄ Usíya wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, géē wā, ó í kpó odúúdú aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā wā mla iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī bī uwā ga inu ā, é yɔ̄ ī yúúfi, anɔ́ɔ é gbɛlá ka, É yɔ̄ ī bī alɔ wā amanyā ohígbū ije nēé je kwúcē tá ipú ɛkpa kú alɔ eko aflɛ́yí ā. É lɔfú tū alɔ iyē igbledū glá, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ aíjakī kú alɔ kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ alɔ kpó pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í bī iyī alɔ le tɔ́ɔna ŋ́. Alɔ tɔ́ɔna ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nyá nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne āa? Ɔdí nɛ̄ a jé ŋmá anú āa.

eng_Latn: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ka lɛ Ujéhu kēé le īkpɛ̄yí kú ayí kú Áhābu ā kpó wā ɛɛ́ mā, ó da uwá ka ɛɛ́ le uwa tīkwū bá okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā jāā gbó ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɔ́ɔcī nū.

eng_Latn: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ éyi ŋmá Ujudíya wā Ántiyɔ̄ku, é kē bá ī nwū ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā ɛlā, kahíníī, N táafú ŋ́ ayíka é lɛ aá apī hɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uculo kú Umósīsi lɛ ā, é gáā hɛ́ aá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa ā le yá klá uwá gē dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ Unábɔ̄tu da ɔ́ ā. Ó gaá gwutá agōdō kú nū lɛ eyī pīya tá ɔdɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ ō lé ɔdōlé dúúmā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā um je íkwu gā um kú um gbō ācɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n je íkwu lɛ aá dúú á.

eng_Latn: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n jé ucē obɔ̄bí kú um. Ɛlá kú um kwu íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
idu_Latn: ka anúɔ géē nya alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ, ŋmá abɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī wɔ́tū alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́wá kú aókóome éyi bá gē lúlé kwu ɛga nēé bá ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā kú ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe le yēŋēē mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é le yēŋēē ŋ́ le pɛ́ ga ipú úgbéenyi á.

eng_Latn: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le aá kpó kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kú aéwɔhá, ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛhícō, mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
idu_Latn: Ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēēnyi í gáā ŋmó uwā gɛ ŋ́. Ɛnɔ ámāŋ ka iyē okwɔ́ɔlá í kē gáā je unwalu lɛ uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: É le ɛcɔ̄ nēé hī ukanéliyan gbā, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó kwu ɔkwu kú ugóolu . É gbeyī cíí le iyē kú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔgba kú oōma kú uwā lɛ ā tá tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē yá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ŋmá ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋ́, amáŋ é yá ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋmá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired himthat he would shew them a sign from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Usádusīis ōhī le pɛ́ gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si kéē jé ɔ̄ má. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kóō le ɔdōcābɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō mafú lɛ uwā á.

eng_Latn: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā le pó ka ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ulákiss nyɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú tú igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ulíbīna, nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā le tá abɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gáā le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ a jé ka Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ujonátan ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya le ɔkpá tá fu alɔ Ubábīlɔn ka eko nɛ̄ alɔ géē bá aɔ́fiyɛ amānyā ɔ́ɔ géē gbojī kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ó da alɔ ka alɔ̄ gwó ɔlɛ́, ká ālɔ̄ lā anú. Ka ālɔ̄ klla hɛ́hɔ̄, ká ālɔ̄ lé īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó aílī kú uwɔ híla ŋmá uwɔ iyē, klla í je agbá ōtū ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā ōtū abɔ̄, mɛ́mla ɔdōplahɔ̄ kú uwɔ kpó.

eng_Latn: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubówāsi lɛ ɔdōlé lé klla le enyi gwá kwɛyí ā, ɔtū le he ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛga nēé tá ácí kú īkpɔ̄dā ā bá ā, gaá gwutá kóō gbiyɔ̄lā. Anɔ́ɔ Urútu le plla ga abɔ́ɔ wɛɛlɛ, je īlī nɛ̄ Ubówāsi le klá iyē ā gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó má gwutá pī yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́frem géē lɛ ukpɛ́ éyi, nōo gboce Umanásɛ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
idu_Latn: Óndú, wā í tá um abɔ̄ fíyaa. Eyī le cá um ɛɛ́. Ā je iyī uwɔ tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí um gɛ ŋ́, ámāŋ n géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
idu_Latn: Idáhandā ā gaá lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ɛlā nyā kpó lɛ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ufi yá uwā abɔ̄ é le pó kéē wɛ ācɛ ajɛ kú Uróm ā.

eng_Latn: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́yī kú uwā wɛ aklógō kú aícɔ́ɔja nēé gē ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya géē nyɔ̄ í tá aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā bá. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɛfú ā le yá ā, ó géē kwúcē mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa nɛ̄hi mla ɛdɔ kú iyó ō bī kpɛ́fú olɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í kpɛ́fú nyɔ̄ í tú ācɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ uwá ā dúú, klla ī ŋmó ācɛ úlúúlā igwíígwó kú uwā. Amáŋ, aéwo kú Ɛ́dɔm, Umówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe géē hile kú Ámɔ̄n ā géē kwu ŋmá abɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
idu_Latn: O yá ka uwá kéē bāahɛ ŋ́ mā, uwá géē lɛ īlī ogbɛ̄yí kú ulínin gbō ɛyí mɛ́mla ikakí ogbɔ̄lɔ̄ kú ulínin wu ikpó.

eng_Latn: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwá ka, Igbō ɛmulá nɛ̄ aá lɛ āa? Aá nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ́ má. Eko nēé gaá lɛ ɔ́ jila, lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Igbō ɛhɔ̄ mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa.

eng_Latn: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá abɔ̄yī aá, aá leyí kwɛcɛ ohígbū keé géē kpó aá wā iyɔ̄bū ójīla o kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ, é géē ŋmó aá ijē ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ. Ohígbū ka aá wɛ ayíkpó kú um, é géē kpó aá wā iyɔ̄bū aígbómína mla aɔ́cɛ́ kéē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē má ɛga í tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, é le ɔlɛ́ aá catāajɛ, ó kē tá alácɛ̄. Amáŋ é géē wā í tá ɔ̄ gwó. Abālɔbányā ó kē í je nyɛ́ lɛ áluka kú ācɛ nēe pɛ́ wā gáā lā anú ā. Ācɛ nēe je igelī nɛ̄hi ā catāajɛ klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄ ā, gē tú gɛcɛɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. É kóō gáā túbla aá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amásīya wɛ iháyí ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu, nēe tíne kéē gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɛ̄gbā ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú ā, gē tɔ́ɔgwu ayí kú Ulífāyi ā wā Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā kwɛyí uwā glá.

eng_Latn: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā, a je umaná lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Eko nɛ̄ ijēēnyi ŋmó uwā ā, a je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋmá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kéē gwá. A da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le gla ācogbāājɛ kú aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɔ́mpa ā, é gā odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú oje nōo yɛ ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó le nwūla lɛ uwá abɔ̄yī nū, anɔ́ɔ é le bɛ̄cɛ á. É le yɛ bū ipú úláyi éyi, anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ Upíta tá á.

eng_Latn: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Uhúram yá aútéblu igwó nōo lɛ akā ā á. É yá odúúdú uwā jōnjīlɛ̄, é klla lɛ ɔ́gɔgɔ́ ɛdɔ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, pīyeyī má ɛhícō. N pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n má ɛcí nōo ī wā Óndú ɔtú nɛhi kwu ɛgiyí ede ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bá gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī ā, é gaá háyi pī ɔlɛ́ ámōōmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:
idu_Latn: É lɛ odúúdú ācojééyī mɛ́mla ācojɔ́dā kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó wā, kéē lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla lɛ ɛyí nū ka gā um, amáŋ é jé ɔ̄ glá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ka ɛyī nū gā um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ga okónu ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi ā ká ā gāá kwu īlī ā ú kpó tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je pahīla tū odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ō cīla mɛlíí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ úmúlá ā í nyɔ̄ ā, ó géē je pīya ipí ínálēgbé nōo géē je pīya ipí o lokónu. Ó í ce ācɛ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ dóódu kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
idu_Latn: É le ipíinu kú Usábi kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ipíiniinu, anɔ́ɔ é le abɔ̄ kwu Ákan ɔyí kú Ukámi mɛ́mla ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Usábi, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔkɔ cɛyí yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ le jīla bá.

eng_Latn: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nyā, gbɔɔ́ ō mímálānyī ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyilɔ, Ujósɛ̄fu, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú lá ga Íjīpiti. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu aíyó agbénú kú Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɛbɛ́ ɔhá ɔ́mɛ́tá nōo bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ á. Ó lɛ ajī ɛpa bɛ̄ɛka ajī kú omlede ā, ó kē kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi éyi ā.

eng_Latn: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā gē tɔ́ɔna ā ŋmá lɛ ihɔtū. Ohígbū kéē jé ka Ɔwɔicō kwú úklɔ́ u gā um ká n̄ yá kú ācɛ kéē le jé ka ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, mā ɔ̄ tá. Abɔ̄ ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē hile lɛ glá ā, é lɛwa ŋ́, é klla kē lɔfú ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá á. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi éyi yɔ̄ nōo lɛ ajɛ nōo yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
idu_Latn: ālɔ̄ túblá Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔtū ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla ɔtū ékpó mɛ́mla ɔtū nēé le gwu yēŋēē ŋmá ɔtū ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɛpɔ̄bí mɛ́mla iyē nēé le na mla éŋkpɔ̄ oyēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā géē yá odúúdú ācɛ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá ācɛ ā nōó í yá ācogwɛ́ɛya ā á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá aɔ́fiyɛ ā nōó í yá aóndú uwā á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá ayíyɔlɛ́ nɔ̄nyā ā nōó í yá ɛ́nɔ́lɛ́ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá ācojɔlálá ā nōó í yá ācolɔ́lá á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá ācɛ o lɛ ijē kplá ācɛ ā nōó í yá ācɛ nōo ī kplá ɛ́kplá á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá aólɔdu ā nōó í yá aólɛhá á.

eng_Latn: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
idu_Latn: É cɛ̄lā kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā ŋ́ ohígbū ka ebilíi, ɔwɔ obɔ̄bíipú kú ɛcɛ nyā lɛ uwá odo kpó gwū. É má ɔlá nōo ī fíyajɛ ce uwā eyī ā glá gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ofíyajɛ nōo wā ŋmá ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu ɛgahi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo gbla Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔnyɛ kú ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ ɔdā abahi bɛ̄ɛka ejé, ɔdōlé olɔhi he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi géē je gbɛhá.

eng_Latn: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lā pī aá gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ anúɔ í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ í yɔ̄ ī yɛ mla anúɔ bliíblií āa. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ í kōō jé ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ gē nyɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ cīgbīhi. Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ méyīnyinyi uwā klla yíihɔtū uwā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛhīlī je kéē wɛ ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka a bī okónu kú uwɔ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ Óndú á, nāa kē cɛ̄ ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ ka Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á, Ɔwɔicō géē nya uwɔ tá.

eng_Latn: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
idu_Latn: Óndú pií gáā nya ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá, ŋmá ipú odúúdú íné nēé bīya á.

eng_Latn: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ lɔhi lɔhi ā, ɔcí ā kē le jɛ fíyɛ́ aɔ́cí ɔhá dóódu kú ipú ūpū ā. Ó kē lɛ ābɔ̄ okpɔ́cíi mɛ́mla olīkpō kwu.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ayí kú Ubílha nɛ̄ Ulában je lɛ Urécɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā ā á. É wɛ ācɛ ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ ā tútū. Gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā géē lā ā tútū.

eng_Latn: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ijē gwó kwɛyí ā, é le pɛ́ tá ɛyí ɛfu nēé hi ka Ólīfu.

eng_Latn: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bā yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwú igbō ú lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɔ́ cē kwú lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó ka, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú um.

eng_Latn: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
idu_Latn: N le aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kpó ka lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛdɔ ká ɔtū nōo he um ā kóō he aá dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gwéeyē gajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam lɛ Uhádōram nōo leyīkwu úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á. Abɔ̄ Uréhobōwam lɛ ɛ̄nyā má ā, ó kwú kwu ga ipú úgbɔ́nya kú nū gā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé nwū nyā yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ í wóófu iye nū piíí ā, je tū n abɔ̄ ka n̄ le tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya í lɛwa jɛ̄ nēe gē ŋmó klla wā aɛ́wū ā glá ŋ́ mā, ayí kú Ulífāyi tá uwā abɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ úklɔ́ ā mɛ. Eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā ācogwɛ́ɛya alɛwa le iyē kpó gwu dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla odúúdu aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá jīla uwá ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nyā Ujékɔ̄pu le jé ka īkpɔ̄dā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bá ī má iyī aá eyēēyī icííci ā?.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya klla da Uhɛsɛkíya kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā géē wɛ ɔdā ocābɔ̄ ga uwɔ á. Ɛyí mā mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛ́há, a géē yɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé nōo jɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ abɔ̄yī nū nɛ̄ ó wɛ aá hí ā ŋ́. Amáŋ iháyí ɔ́mɛtá ā, aá géē hɛ́hɔ̄ kú abɔ̄yī aá klla í nyi ɔcí ufáyin kú aá tāajɛ klla í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a bī ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ɛpa nyā kwú uwā í kwu ɔhá mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ékpónú ā ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā klla yɛ ga Ugílɛ̄di, mɛ́mla ɛyí ajɛ kú Ugɛ́ssɔ mɛ́mla Umáaka, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛfu kú Uhámɔn, mɛ́mla odúúdú Ubássan jāā ga Usélika.

eng_Latn: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ nɛ̄ aá he uwá ɔtū ā ōfōōfūnū he aá ɔtū á, ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí nyá nɛ̄ aá yá nēé ī hɔ́hā ce aá ohígbū nū ā. Ācobīyíne ā nááná kōō ī yíhɔtū tá ācɛ nēe ī yíhɔtū tá uwā ā dúú!.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N géē wā gaá hɛ́ ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti ā.

eng_Latn: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyínɛ́ kú Urebéka mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū kahíníī, Ká ɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā kóō yɔ̄ mɛ́mla alɔ lígíí, ɛ̄cī igwó ōfōōfūnū ɛ́ɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɔfú nyɔ̄ igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jikwú kú Usɔ́ɔlu, anú nōo gē kpó īlī nɔ̄wá ohéyīfuú nɛ̄hi lɛ aá, klla í kpó aɔ́dā o bī le yíifa kú ugóolu gé lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gekwú ā, éwo kú Umówābu tá ka aá bá ɛháajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É klla kwɛ́yí ú bū kwu Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ācɛ Ujíyu gē nyɔ̄ Ɛga otīīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú iháyí dóódu mɛ́mla oyī kú ɛbɛ́. Amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá í bēé ga ipú nū gaá je iyī nū gwɛ́ɛya igbo alɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ iyī nū je gicō nɛ̄hi, Ɔwɔicō géē tá ɔ̄ wāajɛ. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu nēe tá iyī uwā wāajɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē lɛ uwá pīya ācɛ ocɛgba nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
idu_Latn: Uséla Ukíriyati, Ujerúsālɛm, Ugíbeya, mɛ́mla Ukɛriyat Ujēyarím. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛnɛ, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
idu_Latn: Ipú ijē kú éeyē nɛ̄ acɛnyā gwó ā, é kahíníī, Usɔ́lu ŋmó ācɛ úlúulā, amáŋ Udéfīdi ŋmó ācɛ úlúulā ɛga igwó.

eng_Latn: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā bī ula mɛ́mla ɛ́plla le yá kú ācɛ nēe le igbīhi cē kwu ɔwɛ o gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɛɛ́ mā kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe jé Ɔwɔicō kú uwā kpaakpa ā géē pīyeyī kwu ɔ́, géē nuunu tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá kú ɛyí ede ā í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ eko dóódu kpɔ́. Ó híī nyí ŋ́. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē kpó ɛfú tū ɛyí kú ede ā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā ú kpó ce ɛyí nū. Ó í je ijē kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā yɔlá ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā kli, ó géē nya aá tá. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ kli gɔbū ŋ́, ayíkā ɔtōōce kú aá wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā ga Ubɛ́tɛlu, ɛga nɛ̄ n géē gwó ede lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo tú um abɔ̄ eko kú unwalu kú um ā. Anú klla hímáyī yɔ̄ mla um ɛga dúú nɛ̄ n nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aéwo, aá jāhɔ̄ ká aá pó ɛlā kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá bī ɛlā ā tɔ́ɔna ga ogbeé kú ísu ā. Ami nōo je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu fíyákátā ā, géē tú uwā bá. N géē gbō uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē gbō aálá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā cíkā ō gekwú ohígbū ka ó ŋmó um ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um gbɔbū kóō ma um ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um géē yɛ í kwú pīya únóji kú um.

eng_Latn: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō á. Ó bī ɔyígodó kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōó lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla agbá nɛ̄hi éyi abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
idu_Latn: É le Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū hīigwú dúú.

eng_Latn: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ujóssuwa pi ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yá kóō lɛ Ujérīko túgwó igbɔhá, Óndú ā í tókónu lɛ ɔ́ Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwu ikpó inu kú Ujérīko ú táajɛ, ɔ́kplá kú nū géē kwú. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igá kú nú túgwó, ɔyí ōhɔ́ma kú nū géē kwú.

eng_Latn: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú aá le nyílá ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ī ŋmó ā. Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ka ā klla cɛ̄ lɛ okónu kú aá kwú nyílá dúú.

eng_Latn: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
idu_Latn: O jīla olíla nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ucē íla ɔwɛ, tūufi fíyɛ́ o jīla ɔgwú nēé lɛ ɔyí nū kpó uwī ā á.

eng_Latn: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī plla ígwu kú aéwo olɔfú nɛ̄hi ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō kéē wā í kpɛ́fú tá Ubábīlɔn. É géē hɔ́ɔ́gba kú ɛfú lɛyíkwu ɔ́ klla í yá ɔ̄ lé. Ɔyī kú uwā í gē tááblɛ̄ ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cotɔ́yī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔyī kú nū gē cē ɔdā dóódu nōó tíne ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú gē ka ohígbū ipɔ́lɛ́ kú utáya á. N kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwɔ̄ ɛɛ́ géē kpó aéwo alɛwa wā í kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄, uwá géē wā í klá nú bá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ísu ā wuu.

eng_Latn: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú igbō ā ú kpó lɛ Ámnɔn ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lé, amáŋ ó tá kóō lé igbō ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Utáma ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔhá dóódu kpó nū ŋmá ipú inu ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɛcɛ nyā nēé gē le gbla anú ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nōó gē yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔlɛcɛ, ka ɛbɛ obɔbí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu uwá. Ka ɛbɛ obɔbí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō tokónu klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbo ɔkpá kahíníī, Ń jé ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́. Ɔkwɔkwu ɔ́mā ɔbúgwū lɛ ogwú tū.

eng_Latn: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔnyā nū ā í lɛ oklóbīya nū, nōo tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu eko kú ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ihɔtū á, ká ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da alɔ ka ālɔ̄ yá ipú íne ā. Ɔdā nōó ka ālɔ̄ yá ā wɛ ka ālɔ̄ yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ pó ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá kpɔ́, eko nɛ̄ ɔyí kú Ujosíya, Ujɛhóyākim, ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Igbīhi ɛnyā, Óndú ā klla kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá kpɔ́ igbalɛwa jāā ga ipú iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ Usɛdɛkíya, ɔyí kú Ujosíya ce ɔcɛ́ ā. Ipú ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā nēé kpó ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ɔfiyɛ ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá á.

eng_Latn: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē kwú eko kpiíí ā, anúɔ kē jé ka ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ɛ́ɛ̄ gáā lɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é le kpaakpa ŋ́ mā gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē tá ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō géē nyɔ̄ í lā ɛdɔ oyēeyī ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɛ̄nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ká ɛ̄ɛ lā ā tá. Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā géē cɔ̄nū cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔ le yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
idu_Latn: É le cɔ̄nū ohígbū ka ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa ā yɔ̄ gē nwū ācɛ ā ɛlā gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka ācɛ nēe pɛ́ kwú kpɛ́mm géē héyī.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā lɛ odúúdú ɛla nyā ka lɛ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
idu_Latn: N jé uwɔ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yá uwɔ tá ipú ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ á. Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ ma uwɔ ā, n lɛ uwɔ fu ɛɛ́. N lɛ uwɔ fu ká ā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo.

eng_Latn: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta yɔ̄ ijaló ā, ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Óndú um, amáŋ aéwo nēe bá ɛháajɛ itéblu kē ī lé iwilli kú ɔdōlé kú ayípɛ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn dóódu kéē wā í yɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā éyééye. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ipíinu kú Umátiri ú á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyééye kú ipíinu kú Umátiri ā kéē wā í yɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú Usɔ́lu, ɔyí kú Ukíssi ú á. É tíne nū, amáŋ é má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔnyɛ kú ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó ā, kwú ákánjɔ̄ kú uwā ú kpó, le ahɔ̄lá fú tū ɔ̄, le ɔtulalī tū ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá māháyi okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni.

eng_Latn: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
idu_Latn: Anú bīya okónu nēé ce mla anú klla tá ɔkpá nōo gwá ā je ɔ́ tēelihɔ á. Ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá nyā, ó gáā kwu hɛ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je uwēyī lɛ ádā nū oŋmá lɛ ō gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyā ádā nū dúúmā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē kpó ohile kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēe le pahīla ā ŋmá ipú odúúdú aéwo nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ āa. Cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ uwá kpó kwúcē wā ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā. É kē géē ma ayí alɛwa klla í nyīla lɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄! Ɔkpacaŋgelī ɛpa bá yɔ̄ á, Óndú! Ó tū uwā ohi ka ɔ́ɔmā jɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:
idu_Latn: eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú opo, áma, ɔgalúmpɛ̄, ɛ̄ngwū, úmōlō mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɔdā ō bī gwíijē dóódu pó, odúúdú aá géē tú wāajɛ géē gbā ojibó nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, ma kwu ajɛ nyā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tū owu nɛ̄hi wā í ca um tū ɔkpá, klla í yá um ágbe áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne mla ɛlā nāa gē nwū ā, ó kē í he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
idu_Latn: A géē gbā ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kwɛ́yí īkpɛ̄yí kú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyōkwū nōo yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū nōó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́, ke kwú eyīyōce kú nū ú ce Ɔwɔicō, gē ga icɔ́ɔci ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ojigógó klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɔtú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
idu_Latn: Ulɛ́ya mɛ́mla ayí nū le pɛ́ wā ajaajɛ klla túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ dúú. Ācɛ ámōōmɛ ā wɛ Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla Urécɛ̄lu. É le pɛ́ wā ajaajɛ klla le túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: N kllá le má ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē cēyītīkwū gē yúklɔ́ kóō le lɔhi lɛ uwá ā, wɛ ohígbū ímálānyī kú aɔ́mpa uwá nɛ. Ɛ̄nyā dúú ā wɛ áncā, mɛ́mla owu oōnū inya nɛ.

eng_Latn: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ó wɛ omlede nɛ̄ aá bī gwɛ́ɛya á nɛɛ, aá géē bī okoolo ɛpa kú umu nēé lɛ ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ce ohɛ́pa kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū ɔ̄. Anú wɛ ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā kú aá á.

eng_Latn: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, ó wɛ ohígbū ka aá jé ɔkwɛ̄yi ā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ká aá jé ɔ̄, ohígbū ká aá klla kē jé ka ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔdā nōó miya tayínū ā mafú gā um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tá ɔ̄ tū ɔkpá lígíí ā.

eng_Latn: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ipú ikpɛ́lā dóódu lɛyíkwu agbénú, ó kōō wɛ aɛ́na, aálá, aíjakī, aíīlī ámāŋ ka ɔdā dúúmā nōo gebī ā, é géē bī ācɛ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā wā Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, géē cíla ulé ā ɛga ɛpa lɛ ɔ́mpa nū.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ ī gbēyī ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu nū ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
idu_Latn: ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N cɛ̄ gā awɔ le okónu ce ipéyī Óndú ā ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́. N klla pi uwɔ ahɔ̄ ka, ɛ̄cī dúú nɛ̄ a nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le bɛ̄cɛ, a géē kwú piíí. A kē cɛ̄ ka anúɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ gā um.

eng_Latn: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā le tɛ́ɛcɛ le ɔ̄kā da ɛ́nɛ́ nū ka, ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ géē ba ɔ́ ā? Ɛ́nɛ́ nū tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, īkpɛ̄yí kú Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim.

eng_Latn: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá. Ó kē í nya uwá tá piyóo. Uwēyī í klla gáā kwú uwā gbógbóō igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
idu_Latn: Nááná a kē tīihɔ, a klla ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anúɔ le aótrɛ̄yí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ anyakwɔ́cɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ ojéeyī nɛ̄hi ā kpó fu ŋmá aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā. Anúɔ kwú uwā ú pīya aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē leyīkwu uwā ipú ígwíígwu kú uwā, úlúúlā, aóhī ígwu kú ofɛhɔ̄, ōhī ofɛpa ce igwó, ōhī wɛ igwó. Ó ka anúɔ klla le aígabɔ̄ ɔhá kpó fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujérobōwam da ɔnyā nū ka ɔ́ɔ le odée kpó tū iyē, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā jé ɔ̄ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ga Ussílo, ɛgiyí Ahíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aɔ́máapú um Ísrɛ̄lu, n jé cāā ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá Ujísɔ̄si ā, aá yá ɔ̄ ipú ɔdā-á-jé-ŋ́ nɛ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú aá kē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō, nōo gē tá ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔdā nēe gē kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā abɔ̄ ā, bī ōwā kú Utáyítɔ̄si le tá alɔ ɔtū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā nēé nyi Ébrahām mɛ́mla Usára, ɔnyā nū á. Abɔ́ɔ ā nēé nyi Áyísīki mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū Urebéka á. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ n kē nyi Ulɛ́ya á.

eng_Latn: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
idu_Latn: Ujówɛ̄lu, Ujéhu.

eng_Latn: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
idu_Latn: É gē yá odúúdú úklɔ́ kú uwā ká ācɛ kéē má uwā. Aá má aɔ́dā nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkpɔ́yí ɛkpa nēé tá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō tā ɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē le bá údɔ̄bū mɛ́mla ácábɔ̄ kóō mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ákú uwā nwuné lɛ ā. É gē le ajaŋja o playi awulú kú uwā yá līkpō klla le ɔ́ yá lɔwá fongoo.

eng_Latn: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kē bá yɔ̄ ī ka ka Ɛláyíja ɔ́ɔ hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ á, nááná ācɛ ɔhá ka ka éyi kú ipú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ncɛ ā ɔ́ɔ le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ abɔ̄ bī um háyi icō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yēeyī. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú um ŋ́ ohígbū ka n leyīce ka, a í nya um tá.

eng_Latn: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔyí ā ma, kóō híī lɛ igwu kwu ɔ́ ɛyí ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, oŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē ma ɔ́ ā, é géē je ɔ́ tū céé lɛ Óndú ā abɔ̄ ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé ī hī ka Unásāreti ā, Ó ka ɔ́ɔ í gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ kóō hɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó í lɛ ōhī kú oyī ā kwu aájī kú ede kú ɔtulalī umuumu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Ó géē pīya ohile kú oyī ā tū ɔkwu kú ede kú ɛga o yi odée ɔlá ɛyí nū ā. Ede nyā yɔ̄ okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā í gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, olíla í lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi dúúmā ō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ gē mafú ka alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ā. Alɔ lɔtulé nɛ̄hi ipú unwalu, ipú ōwē mɛ́mla ipú ɛdɔ ɛ́kɛma dóódu.

eng_Latn: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ā í tíne ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú nū ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā, kwú odiyɔ̄ kú nū ā ú tá ɛcɛ lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ odiyɔ̄ ā báajɛ éyééye jāā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á. Abɔ̄ eyī gbɔɔ́ ō nyā ā, é ma ɔnyā ā tá.

eng_Latn: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n tíne ká n̄ jé ɛlā nēé kpóce ɔ́ ā, n lɛ ɔ́ bī wā iyɔ̄bū ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wā ŋmá ɛyí ɛfú kú Usáyínāyi mla úlúúlā kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú wā ɛga otīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí gbo, ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nyá nōó yá āa? Amáŋ é dɛ̄gba fíyɛ́ kahíníī, Kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yɛhɛ tū um ā kwú.

eng_Latn: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ī bī ugóolu nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ámāŋ ɛcɔ̄ nōo gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ dúú ā le kwū ɔ́lá nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ ā le yá lɛ ā, Ujówābu le tá ɔlɛ́ Ábsālɔm gaá le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nyɔ̄ gaá je igwu kú anúɔ tɔ̄ɔlá āa?.

eng_Latn: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
idu_Latn: N gē gwōkónu ɛ̄cī ɛpa ipú aláadi éyi. N gē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n lɛ ā gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá, nɛ̄ ágbe kú apī kú uwā wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujékɔ̄pu ɛpa, Usímīyɔn mɛ́mla Ulífāyi, ayínɛ́ kú Udáyína nɔ̄nyīlɔ, kwú ɔkpacaŋgelī ú kpó, le pɛ́ tá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í leyī ce ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ ā kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu le yɛce ɛlā kú Umɔ́dɛkāyi ā, anɔ́ɔ ucɛ nyā kwú pīya ɔdā kú iháyí dóódu ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu Ujísɔ̄si gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, aútíca kú íne mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā dɔɔ̄kā kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le Ujúda tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔbū ga ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu kóō da Ujósɛ̄fu ká ɔ́ɔ wā í jīla anúɔ ɔwɛ Ugóssɛn. Eko nēé gāajɛ kú Ugóssɛn ā.

eng_Latn: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ojéeyī gē ka ā, gē nwū ācɛ ɔhá kéē jé ɔdā.

eng_Latn: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu aɛ́na nēe bá ajɛ kpátáá kú Ussárɔn ā wɛ Usítrāyi nōo ŋmá Ussárɔn ā. Ussáfati, ɔyí kú Ádlāyi kē leyīkwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ɔpɛ́ kú Ussárɔn ā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ, ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nāa kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā le íne kú um bīya klla tá um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
idu_Latn: É lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ó je lɛ uwá ka kéē híī pā ɛcí ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó he ɔcɛ́ ɔtū nɛ̄, ó géē he um ɔtū cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Uháman kéē klla wɛ aúgbɔga kú ucɛ nɛ̄ n géē yá lɛ aá óócí ā kpɔ́. Ɛgiyí ucɛ ā mɛ́mla eko ɔ́ɔmā ā nɛ̄ n géē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne klla cɛgbá ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ádáádā nū bī tū Óndú ā. Ó klla le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ kpó wu ipú ɔ́bíipú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ipéeyí aúgbɔga ā, ó tá ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā ka ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwinya fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā, í gáā kwu ga ɛga dúú glá ŋ́, ɔfú géē hɛ́ ācɛ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja í kōō gáā nya oyēeyī kú iyī uwā tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Énesi, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́, cāŋjɛ ká ā lɛ agōdō kú uwɔ yá. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó cāŋjɛ.

eng_Latn: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá uwɔ klla tá ō gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā. Alɔ klla tá ka alɔ í yɛce uwɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā ŋ́. Alɔ bá í yá kéē pīya ācɛ tū, klla yá kú ācɛ kéē híī yɛce uwɔ ŋ́. Ɛlá nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbo ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́. Alɔ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋmá okónu piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam wɛ oklóbīya nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi, abɔ̄ Usólōmɔn le má kóō lɔfú uklɔ́ ō yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú ācoyúklɔ́ abɔ̄fú kú nū ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ á.

eng_Latn: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā tɛtɛ yēeyī, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó yēeyī gɛ ŋ́. Eko kpiíí ā, ó géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōó lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ yíífi píyóó. Ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ nēé tá iyē kú uwā tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú oyēeyī gbɔbū lɛ eko nēé yá ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā géē hídáagó abɔ̄ é lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā má ā. Ó tɛtɛ yēeyī, abālɔbányā ó yēeyī gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó kē í hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ohígbū ka aá cɛ̄ kpɔ́cí ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔ̄ glá ŋ. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɔtū kpóce Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ olígíí bɛ̄ɛka īkpō umɔ́stāād ā, aá géē da ɛfu nyā kahíníī, Le fu ŋmá amānyā gā ánūmā ā. Ó kē í fu. Ɔdā dúú í gáā lɔnɔ tū aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.
idu_Latn: Le aíne lɛyíkwu ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā ka Árɔni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É géē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú íne ō bīya ā ɔ́kíkā kú ɛhícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɛga nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya nōo tīihɔ nɛ̄hi o je lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Awɔ, kwinya gicō gajɛ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aúláyi mɛ́mla aɔ́pu kú Ujerúsālɛm. Leyīláajɛ ká aá tíne, ɔ́dāŋ ka a géē má ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú nōo ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa klla ī tíne ō yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā glá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā má, ayíka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā í gáā yá ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm italā kú ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó yɔ̄ ī yá ɔma ā, ɔyí éyi kwú abɔ̄ kú nū ú kwɛɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyōkɔ́ma ā, kwú owú nɔ̄wá ú gbō ɔyí ā abɔ̄, ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gbɔbū á.

eng_Latn: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ pī alɔ ā, alɔ géē yálé piíí. Ó géē yá aólɛlā kú alɔ lé lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
idu_Latn: Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā ká ā gaá tayínū ɔkpá kú Ucérīti, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā í má Ujísɔ̄si gɛ ŋ́ mā, amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū ōfōōfū ūwā ā, uwá abɔ̄yīwā le pɛ́ tá ipú aɔ́kɔ ā, le tá Ukapánɔm kéē tíne Ujísɔ̄si.
