eng_Latn: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi da uwá kahíníī, N gbo Ɔwɔicō nōo nya um tá, ŋmá ipú unwalu dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kwúcē ga okónu óókpoó kú Ugálīli ā kpɔ́. Ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi le pɛ́ wā í tá ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nwū uwā ɛlā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ujɔ tū mla ācɛ ā, ó da ācogwíijē ā kéē lɛ úwé kú ijē ō gwo kú uwā kpó wiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le yɛ ga iyɔ̄bū kú aícɔ́ɔja kéē yɔ̄ ī gwííjē kahíníī, Óndú alɔ cɛ̄tra awɔ, ihɔtū kú uwɔ yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō jē ka eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ īkpō kú ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā ā lé, eyī kú aá géē jē nwūla nɛ̄ aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō ā, nɛ̄ aá géē jē ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla obɔ̄bí dóódu Anú yá nōó da aá ka aá híī lé ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī pi aá anú ā. Ámāŋ n géē cīgbīhi kwu aá. Ámāŋ n géē je igelī nɛ̄hi ká aá tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
idu_Latn: Ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, tókónu ka abɔ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, n géē kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā nēe lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́wá kú efūma ā, wā í kpɛ́fú tú aá, ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. É klla í tɔ́ɔga ka aá le Ubábílɔn yálé ɛɛ́, ipú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Ujehóyāda gekwú ā, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda je unwalu lɛ Ujówāsi jāā gbéeko nōo gbɔɔ́ ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé gē nwū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā le lé le ipú nū jɛ̄ iyī uwā. Iwili nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā túbá ā wɛ omōōmu omblí igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄, aá géē jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ipí ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa igbɔhá ā kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛga nɛ̄ ōcē ā yɔ̄ ā le kwú turuturu, nōó nyīla ga ɛga ɔhá ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka ká ɔ̄ le yēŋēē, ka ipi kú ɔkpíyē ɔlamu icííci nɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē na īlī kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō ményinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ kú Onesífɔ̄rɔsi, ohígbū ka ó tū um ɔtū kwu ɔtū igbo alɛwa. Ó yúwēyī kú um ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ agbá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
idu_Latn: Ubengéba wɛ igbómína kú Urámɔtu ipú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujɛ́ɛ, ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ nēe bá ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ágɔ̄bu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Ubássan ā. Odúúdú uwā wā aígelī nɛ̄hi ofɛtá nēé le igá hɛ́ tū uwā klla lɛ ogbló kú oje udɔ nēe ī le cílá okómpīinu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
idu_Latn: Ipú iyɔ̄lā kú um, otú alɛwa ɛyí agōdō kú um, N yɔ̄ í nā ɔnā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū ā. N yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū ā, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄ ŋ́. N hī ɔ̄ igwú, amáŋ ó cɛ̄ igwú kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā nyā ka ā, ɔnyā éyi lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí lɛ ɛlā ka ŋmá ipú ɛwa kú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ákú ɛ́nɛ́ nōo ma uwɔ klla bī uwɔ jɛ̄ ā lɔhi íbí oo n.

eng_Latn: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ofucɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā kú Ɛ́lulu ā, eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ úklɔ́ yá ɛ̄cī ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa ɛɛ́ mā, odúúdú úklɔ́ ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
idu_Latn: Aá gē ka kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ yɔ̄ eko kú aádā alɔ ā nɛɛ, alɔ í géē yɛ í yɛce uwá kpó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛlā kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ācɛ nēe kwú glá gē mīyɛ éyi ŋmá ipú igwó á, amáŋ ipú ɛlā kú Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki ā, é je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yēeyī piyóó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu da ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī yā īkpɔ̄dā mla ācoyúklɔ́ lɛ anúɔ jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā cē kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
idu_Latn: Akpáabana gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛdɔ ɔwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nááná kē jé ka ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔ ī wā.

eng_Latn: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ónan le jé ka ɔyí ā í gáā wɛ ákú anúɔ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ eko dúúmā nōó le gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyōkwū kú ɔyínɛ́ nɛɛ, ó cɛ̄ le iyē nōó gē tá ā kóō lɛ pɛ́ wāajɛ. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō ma ɔyí dúúma lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: wā í tá anúɔ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ kpɛ́fú tá Ugíbeyɔn, ohígbū ka, ācɛ abɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ le ɛbɔ́ yá mla Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
idu_Latn: É pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā ŋ́, le pɛ́ ga ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. É faajɛ gaá lā igelī nēé hī ka Utapánhes ā.

eng_Latn: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
idu_Latn: É yá ɔ̄cɛ kú aflɛ́yí ā ŋmá úmúlá kú ajɛ áncā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa ā ŋmá ɔkpánco.

eng_Latn: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ umíta úla ce ofɛhɔ̄ ɔhá mīya gɔbū, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā gáā kwú um okwúukwu á. Ó klla lɛ umíta úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ ɔhá miya gɔbū kpɔ́, éŋkpɔ̄ ā gáā kwú um ohí.

eng_Latn: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n yɔ̄ ī kwú ɛmɛɛma ɛɛ́. Ōwē nɛ̄hi bī um kli ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gaá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú Uhɛsɛkíya cɛ̄ lɛ Ayisáya ā.

eng_Latn: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
idu_Latn: Ó le ijā kú ágábá, ɛna, ucérūbim he tū ipú oje oplákátá ā. Ɛplá kú ɛga nēé kpó ofu kú ɛna mla ágábá mla ucérūbim tū ipú ofúlēnjē ā, ó le ijā kú ɔdā okɛnɛ́kɛnɛ́ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí he tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ayí kú Ussɛ́m, mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā, mɛ́mla ucē nēé ī ka ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ mɛ́mla aéwo kú uwa á.

eng_Latn: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū kóō wā ā, ó géē móōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ācɛ kú eko nyā kéē í tá ɔ̄ tónū.

eng_Latn: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
idu_Latn: É yá Usamérīya lé ohígbū kēé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā da uwá ā ŋ́. É klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ okónu oōce kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
idu_Latn: Ayíka ɔcɛ́ kú Ái nēé kwú oyēeyī je gé lɛ Ujóssuwa ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó cɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi ā, iháyí ofu cɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ nū lé ka Asúba, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ussílhi.

eng_Latn: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujudíya ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Usɛkaríya. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ígwu kú Ábīja. Ó lɛ ɔnyā, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya dúú. Iyē kú ɔnyā ā lé ka Ɛlísābēti.

eng_Latn: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó gbojī ŋ́ owu olɔfú nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Oŋmá abɔ̄lúfīyē kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā gbɔɔ́ ō tá ŋmá ɔlíidɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ubósra ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā yɔ̄ ā? Ó le īlī nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi wiiyē nɛ̄ odée nɔ̄wá le ɔ́ kwú ɛbɛɛbɛ yōōō. Ó kē yɔ̄ ī nɔwɔ wā mla ɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tóohi kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ō nya ācɛ tá ā nɛ. N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna ka n le ɛfú ā yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, lɛ ɔtū ce Óndú ā piyóo, ohígbū ka Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē gbō alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu géē wɔ́tū aá ohígbū um. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔtū lé jāā ga oŋmɛ́yí, é géē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n má gwutá, n gē gbiyɔ̄lā ɛbɔ́, ohígbū ka awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē gbō um ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.
idu_Latn: É ka aá géē fu ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē bī ɔdōlé lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ohile ā kéē nyɔ̄ í le italā yá ācɛ kú Ugíbɛya ohígbū ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nēé yá ipú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ aíjáalí ɛpa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lɔtūce uwā glá kpó kéē cɛ̄ um ijáalí á. É wɛ Uríya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla Usekaríya, ɔyí kú Ujɛbɛrɛkíya.

eng_Latn: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́da nɛ̄ Udéfīdi je lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ohígbū inu kú ɛga ókpíyó tū kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, Usólōmɔn má ka é lɛ odúúdú nū tū.

eng_Latn: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
idu_Latn: Ɛcá kwú um ɔtū ú bīya, ɔtū kú um kē kwú gbenyi ɛɛ́. N leyīce ka n géē má ɔ̄cɛ nōo í ményinyi um, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́. N má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī tá um ɔtū lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ayíkpó ā wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō āa.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ujeremíya abɔ́ɔ ó klá Utapánhes ā ā.

eng_Latn: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le hɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nēe fíyɛ́ ulá cofɛhɔ̄ igbeékpónú á. Ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā kē béeyī kpɔ́ ɛɛ́, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
idu_Latn: Iháyí alɛwa le gla, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó nōó jé Ujófɛ̄fu ŋ́ mā, le ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ Íjīpiti lé.

eng_Latn: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō, nōo je um ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ádā um mɛ́mla ajɛ ɛga nēé ma um ā, nōo cokónu gā um ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ nyā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú um ā, géē tū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛhɔ̄ gbɔbū ga abɔ́ɔ. Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í yá cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē lɛ ɔnyā ā lɛ Le ɔyí um ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ túbá ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ahāapa kú aá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā. Aá í yá ucɛ nyā lɛ Óndú ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
idu_Latn: Ukéni da Óndú ā kahíníī, italā nɛ̄ a yá gā um nyā le fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
idu_Latn: É jé Ɔwɔicō nááná ā, é í le ojīlīmā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā ce ɔ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā é gē gbɛlá ɔdā nōó ī tīile ŋ́, ɛ̄nyā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú uwā gbɛlá kpaakpa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
idu_Latn: É gē cɛ̄tra ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó jéeyī nwuné lɛ ā, amáŋ ācɛ gē lɛ eyī gwō olīla bónū.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɔfiyɛ kú uwā lɔfú í dɔɔ̄kā kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwā le he ɔ́ ɔtū,anɔ́ɔ ó kē tíne kóō klá á.

eng_Latn: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwī, nɛ̄ ó gāa lɛ uwī wī, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē le má lé, nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ kwú, é géē mā ɔ̄ tá nyɔ̄ áncā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
idu_Latn: É lɛ úklɔ́ kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla itébulu, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla aéde ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya géē bī yúklɔ́ ɛga otīīhɔ ā, mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin kú okómpīinu kú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Uwá lɛ úklɔ́ dóódu nōo lɛ iyē kwu āyā ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
idu_Latn: Ádā, cɛ̄tra iyē kú wɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔkpáncō kahíníī, N le cɛ̄tra anú ɛɛ́, n klla géē cɛ̄tra anú ɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē kwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ɔ́ lɛ ā, amáŋ ó géē bɔ̄bí lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yíbīyājɛ tū um ā.

eng_Latn: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja aólɔtū ɛtá ā le bū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ufílístiya gaá le éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ ŋmá obugā kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m ā gé lɛ Udéfīdi á. Amáŋ Udéfīdi tá ka anúɔ í klla gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya klá ajɛ kóō kwú pīya ɛya nōó gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ awɔ ɔcɛ́ ā je ɔ́da ka, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔkɔ kú opo, ɔkpānā, ɔgalúmpɛ̄, ɛ̄ngwū, ajī ɛbɛ́, ɛ́mula, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō bī gwíije dóódu pó, kéē túkpɛɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbā ojibo nɛ̄ anúɔ le kwu ajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um nēe cīíbɔm tū um ā yá um lé ŋ́. Le yá ka ɔfú nēé ka lɛyíkwu um ā kóō kwú pīya klá uwá.

eng_Latn: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔ̄kā o hile kú Ujówāsi ā, kwu ɛbɛ nēé má lɛyíkwu ɔ́, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gwó lɛ ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄kā kú aɔ́cɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Amásīya lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú ɔdā oyēeyī dóódu yɔ̄ ipú oyī kú nū, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē híī lé ɛbɛ́ dúúmā nēé fu oyī kú nū bónū ŋmá anú ŋ́ má. Ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le lé, é gáā je ɔ́ koó wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
idu_Latn: Okwū kú ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā géē pahīla klá ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ í kōō gáā jikwū uwā glá ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō gē kɛlā ō kpó okwū uwā nyi ŋ́. Okwū kú uwá géē tīkwū klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka imu kú ɛyétutulu ā.

eng_Latn: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
idu_Latn: N géē pīya anú eyī biílí, í je uwɔ wu ɔ́ alagba, klla í je anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó pi nyɔ̄. aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēe ī lɛ ɛdɔ īlī ékpónú wiiyē gē ce ɔnya ā, aɔ́nya ɛfú kú nū ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi. Odúúdú uwā bī Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwá kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn klla gwó aúgbéenyi alɛwa bá Ɛ́siyɔngēba nōo kwu Ɛ́lāti ajaajɛ okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́, ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā.

eng_Latn: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
idu_Latn: N géē bī Usisɛ́ra, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujabín ā, wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ okónu Ísu kú Ukíssɔn. Ó géē bī aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛfú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, amáŋ n géē yá ká ā lɛ ɔ́ yálé.

eng_Latn: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin nōo ī gwá īkpō nɛ̄hi, nōo bū kwu ɔkpá ajaajɛ ā. Ó kē ī tábɔ̄ gla ɔdɔ kú igá ā.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
idu_Latn: Ó tá péee ka Ɔwɔicō le ɛdɔ ɛhi ékpó nōó kpó lɛ alɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kpó lɛ aéwɔhá nēe bá mbá ā dúú ɛɛ́, ó lɛ ā, ɔnyɛ wɛ ami nɛ̄ n lɔfú tá Ɔwɔicō áafú glá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ɔdā nōó nwū ā le hɛ́ ācɛ idáagó.

eng_Latn: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ Usiséra nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyɔ̄lā ú gbo bōōbū á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujáyɛ̄lu kwú omútāgā ú mɛ́mla oje nēé gē bī le pi áklɔ̄kpɛ kwu ajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí nū ɛmɛɛma, le oje ā hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ŋmá āyā éyi ga ɔhá gaá kwu ajɛ á. Ó gekwú tá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ɛtá ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ lā abɔ́ɔ náaná, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ ā yēeyī ā, ɛ́ɛ gáā nyā ayí abɔ̄yī uwā tá glá ŋ́, ayíka īyī uwá ofōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī pi ɛmɛɛma nyā géē je pīya ijē elihɔ̄ kú ɛyíkwū. Ācɛnyā kú aéwɔhá ā géē bá i gwííjē nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká e jikwū klla yēekwu kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ákú odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa ā yá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ Udamáskɔ̄si mɛ́mla Uhámati lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
idu_Latn: Usébulu tá ɔ̄ ohi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ ɛlā ōkā nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ā gɛ? Ó da ɔ́ ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki á. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē cá uwā ɛcá ā ɔ́ɔ bá abɔ́ɔ á, koó nyɔ̄ gɛcɛ í kpɛ́fú tá uwā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá iyɔ̄bū nū mla ācɛ nēe tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu igbīhi ā, gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba ka, Aá wóófu Ɔwɔicō! Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́ɔhā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā ŋmá iyē kú Óndú ā!.

eng_Latn: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā igbo ékpónú, n kē húmáyī pó ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā igbo alɛwa ka Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū lɔfú á.

eng_Latn: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
idu_Latn: N géē ka íne kú uwɔ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aɔ́cɛ́, nɛ̄ ń kē gáā yá uwēyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le bū ipú ísu ā ɛyí ajɛ íkpākplā ā gɛɛcɛ, bū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔdɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo háyiicō kpaakpa abɔ̄ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
idu_Latn: N tɛtɛ lɛ okónu ce lɛ ɔkpá gwá lɛ aádáádā aá ka n géē je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá. Abālɔbányā ā, aá lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ lɛ īyī aá jōonjīlɛ̄ ká ō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwá.

eng_Latn: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá jééjē ŋ́ yá, nɛ̄ ajɛ lɛ okónu nwūla kwú ācɛ ā ú mulɛ mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā, nēé lɛ tá ɔlékwū oyēeyī, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē jé ka ācɛ nēe bá nyā tá Óndú ā, klla leyī gwō ɔ̄ bónū.

eng_Latn: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si leyipīya lɛ ɔ̄ má, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Adá um, lɔtūlé, ɔtōkpóce kú uwɔ lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā le hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē kú nū ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā kpó yálé. Ujérīko, Ái nōo kwu Ubɛ́tɛlu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
idu_Latn: Lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú kú uwɔ ōhī kpó lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
idu_Latn: Kwú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā ú yá um ɛhi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí kú um ā ú kpó ŋmá um iyē.

eng_Latn: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ okwutɛ kú nū miya kwu icō á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, le ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɛ̄ mɛ́mla akpáabana tū kóō gbo wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
idu_Latn: Épafrāsi, olagbá ɔ́mpā um ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā ī hokónu tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nēé bá yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ā é da iyī uwā ɔ̄kā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ ɔ́ɔ géē míya ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋmá okónu únóji ā lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wā í kpɛ́fú tú ajɛ Íjīpiti. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ōcē obɔ̄bí cíkā ō ŋmó ā, ōcē obɔ̄bí í ŋmó uwā. Ācɛ dúú nɛ̄ é cíkā ō kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ ɔhá ā, é géē kwú uwā nyɔ̄. Ācɛ nɛ̄ é kē cíkā ō kwú ipú ɛfú ā, é géē ŋmó uwā ipú ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
idu_Latn: N kē í je ɔ́da lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā ká ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɛ́sra ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, ɔ̄cɛ o jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō nɛ̄hi ā tíne ā, kéē le kpó lɛ ɔ́ bōōbū.

eng_Latn: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā cāŋjɛ le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, o ŋmá lɛ anyā kú éwɔhá nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā, aá le ɛpɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō bī wā í klá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí ɛɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ í gáā lɛ itene dúúmā ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ nōó lɛ odúúdú ɛcɛ lɛ nōó yēeyī ŋ́. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē le fūla oyēeyī kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.
idu_Latn: Ása le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Kócōō, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ gā awɔ ká ā lɔfú tá aícɔ́ɔja okwáhi mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o lɔfú nɛ̄hi iyē glá. Tá alɔ abɔ̄ abālɔbányā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, ohígbū ka alɔ lɔtūce uwɔ. Iyē kú uwɔ nɛ̄ alɔ bī wā gáā kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja o lɛwa nɛ̄hi nyā má. Awɔ kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á, ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú yá uwɔ lé ɔgbɛ́fú glá ā.

eng_Latn: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ nēe cɛ̄ ā le omlɛ́nyɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī ka kahíníī, N le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ okónu tá ka, É gáā ga ipú ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n géē yɛ í je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ uwá ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ̄nyā nááná nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú nū mɛ ŋmá eko nōó yá ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔ́ tá ohɛ́ɛwa ipéeyī aɔ́ya nū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í gáā nya ɔ́ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú anúɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya bá í kwinya ŋmá ɛfú ga ɔlɛ́ uwá ā, é kwú aójibó kú ɛcí kú uwá í kpó mlanyī bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi je ɔ́da lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ɛcí ā kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá géē lɛ odúúdú aíne kú um nyā tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ukénan nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī kpó aá nyɔ̄ anú ā kóō híī bɔ̄bí lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ka anúɔ wɛ ā, ɔlɛɛcɛ icííci, nɛ̄ ā ī tá Ɔwɔicō áafú glá ā? Ɛtɛ́ kú ɔmɛ lɛ íkwu ō da ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ma ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa ma um lɛ āā? glá ā.

eng_Latn: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
idu_Latn: Aítíca ōhī nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā, gbɛlá ipú odo kú iyī uwā ka.

eng_Latn: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ogblógbló ɔhá kú ɔtāhɛ̄ ā, nōo tū gicō kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ogbló ā cíkā ō yɛ ŋmá okónōgwu éyi ga okónōgwu ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā kóō híī cikpó ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́mpānū ŋ́. Ucē ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Umídiya, Ámālɛ̄ki, mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā le jīla, lɛ bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, gāá bá ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɛsríli á.

eng_Latn: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ gē gwɛ́ɛya ā, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ahítōfɛlu, ɔ̄cɛ Ugílo, nōo wɛ igabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ā. Ibīyāajɛ nɛ̄ Ábsálɔm yá tú ɔcɛ́ ā le fāajɛ nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē yɛce ɔ́ bá gē lɛwa tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uhádād gekwú, Usámla ŋmá ajɛ kú Umásrɛ̄ka mīyɛ ɔkwu nū.

eng_Latn: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú inu kú nū ú lɛ Óndú ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē tá ɔ́lá nū ā kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔhi ámāŋ koó bōbí lɛ ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔlá nū géē wɛ á.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ammínādābu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Admín, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Áni, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uhɛ́sron, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Upéresi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
idu_Latn: Aá le je kpócíí ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā lɛ eko nɛ̄ uwī í wā ā jé nɛɛ, ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwī ca ɔwɛ ga ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka īkpɔ̄cí mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá kéē gwá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtá í klla gáā je uwēyī lɛ aá ɛga aéwɔhá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
idu_Latn: Apayím ma Íssi á, Íssi ma Ussɛ́han á, Ussɛ́han ma Álāyi á.

eng_Latn: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ása nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó gaá le ɛfú kpó tá Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó lɛ uwá yálé klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā: Íjɔn, Udán, Ébɛ̄lu Ubɛti Umaáka mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Unáfutāli nēé gē kpó iyó tū ā.

eng_Latn: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ ó í tū lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ nyā lɛ, amáŋ nɛ̄ á yēeyī ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ? Ó lɛ itene dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, aá kɛlā cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé géē bī íne nēé bī le hɛ́ uwā tá piíí le kɛpɔ̄ tū aá.

eng_Latn: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū hī ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ka Óndú, ó i lɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ohɔ́nyɛtá ā í ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Udéfīdi kpɔ glá āā?.

eng_Latn: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
idu_Latn: É kē bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ iyī uwā lɛyíkwu odúúdú aɔ́dā nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā wɛ, Unatánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúwa, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka ā.

eng_Latn: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ba ɔ́ kóō tá aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū, kóō lɔfú tū aá iyē kú aá lɔfú bá ī kɛlā olɔhi klla bá ī yá ɔdā olɔhi.

eng_Latn: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ géē yá lɛ uwá nɛ̄hi. É géē hí ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā nyi. Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā géē yá lɔɔlɔhi. É géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ɛbɔ́. Ɔcí ufáyin kú uwā géē gwá. N géē kpó odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nēe hile ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, N húmáyī yɔ̄ mla aá gbojī gbojī ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ aá jé um ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má ā, Ufílīpu? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ um má, lɛ Ádā ā má ɛɛ́. Ɔdíyá nāa klla ka, Ma Ádā ā fú lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utássīss, aá nyɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ajɛ kú Utáya tū abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ísu nēé hī ka Unáyilu ā gē cēnyi ī mīyɛ okónu nū tū abɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ge ci aá anú ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
idu_Latn: Otú ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Abíssāyi le tá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó le Usɔ́lu má abɔ̄ ó gwutá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ɔtāhɛ̄ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú nū lɛ óbō kú nū kwaajɛ pī īkpɛ̄yí kú nū. Ábna mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ohile gwutá jīla anú tá bā ī gbiyɔ̄lā dúú.

eng_Latn: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ kwú Usɛkaríya anɔ́ɔ ó gboō cɛ̄ ɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō á kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Unádābu yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ācɛ ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm gāá bū Akrabím ɛhícō kú Usíla.

eng_Latn: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔnya kú ɛfú mɛ́mla iyó ɛfú kú uwā, nū uwā inya jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ uwá kwú, ɛga nēé bá okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́, iyɔ̄bū kú Upihahírɔ̄tu, ajɛ kú Ubaal-séfɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nōó lɔnɔ tū aá nēe bá amānyā ká aá cɛ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō je ɔ̄cɛ héyi ŋmá ɔlékwū glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔkplɛ́fú ō bī abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fu ō wu iyē kú uwɔ ú kpó, ká ā wā í tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛga je gā um cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le bū ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá. Alɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā í gáā nyā ga ipú ajɛ, amáŋ, ipú ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú aá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́, alɔ géē kwu ɔwɛ kú alɔ gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé odée, ó jɔ́ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā kóō jé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aútéblu ɛhɔ̄ ā ú kpó háyi ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Óle ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kwú ābɔ̄ ɛhícō. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú utánki nēé hī ísu nɛ̄hi ā ú háyi ɛplá kú ābɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
idu_Latn: N pó ka īkpɔ̄dā yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá lɛ īkpɔ̄dā lá gé lɛ alɔ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ o yá kú ɛmiyɛ kóō ŋmó alɔ ga ɔlékwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú úgbɔ́nya ā le má ka, ɔ́ɔ́ wɛ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ ó nū ɔ̄ inya gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ujásin kē mīyɛ uwá tū ɔlɛ́ nū. Odúúdú uwā bá yɔ̄ ī bīya íne kú Usísa, yɔ̄ ī ka ka ɔcɛ́ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄, nēé hī ka Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lāyi wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ce igwáahātá, ó mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi eko ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ olɔdu mɛ́mla ogbɛhá lɛ tɔ̄há ā, wɛ ka Óndú yá uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa á.

eng_Latn: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ibīyāajɛ tū aóklóbīya nū ohígbū ije ā, ayí nū géē móōwē kú nū piíí.

eng_Latn: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ leyīkwu uwá ipú ígbíli, ajɛ íkpākplā á.

eng_Latn: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó gaá mīyɛ ɔkpá ŋmá abɔ̄ nū kóō bī nyɔ̄ Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Udamásikɔ̄si, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī yɛce ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā má, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ kwu ācɛnyā, kóō lɛ uwá kpó wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aólɛlā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tíne ká n̄ gbō uwá dúú nɛ̄, ayíka ē wā í lɛ ɛbɔ́ yá mɛ́mla um. Īī, ē wā í yá ɛbɔ́ mla um.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka ó híī yúufi ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́, ka anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá anú mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mla ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū lé. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā ɔdā nēé yá Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, Uhɛ́ssbɔn ā.

eng_Latn: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
idu_Latn: Aójéeyī ā tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ó gáā jɛ alɔ mɛ́mla aá glá ŋ́. Ó í lɔhi lɛ aá fíyɛ́ kú aá nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe gē je lá ā, kú aá lɛ ōhī lá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē je ga uwɔ āa? Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ kahíníī, A gáā gbā ulé dúúmā gā um ŋ́. N géē yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ kpɔ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka a í cɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́miigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, ucɛ kú igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā gbɔɔ́. Aá híī lé igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yá eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpāncō á. Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ bōōbū ā.

eng_Latn: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó ayí aá nɔ̄nyā kéē wɛ ācɛ o jijē lɛ ɔ́, mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔdōlé kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
idu_Latn: O lɛ um ikpó yá lɔfú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwinya bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū ā. Ó le um tū céé ɛyí ɛfu ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
idu_Latn: Ɛlífɛ̄lɛti, Ujéyúwelu mɛ́mla Ussɛmáya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Adónīkam mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛtá. Uwá ā, pīyɛyí igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmɔ́ɔci nū ā, Umósīsi da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Áa le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ abālɔbányā n géē ga icō ɛfu ā ɛgiyí Óndú ā kpɔ́, ekohī n géē yá kóō habɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā tá lɛ áa glá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wā klla yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ nyɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū má ɛga lé ɔdōlé ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ ga ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ géē bá ōfōōfū alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le mlɛ́nyɔ́ lígíí.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā. Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔyí nū le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Ánātɔ̄tu, mɛ́mla Álimɔn, mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
idu_Latn: Nááná n yɔ̄ ī ka ífulá lɔfú lɔfú lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá um italā kpɔ́ nááná nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tíifu ā.

eng_Latn: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
idu_Latn: É cāŋjɛ klla má māháyi icō, ɛga nēé tɛtɛ háyi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe bá nyā gbɔɔ́ ō cɔ̄ɔwɔ kú íne ā lɛ uwá. É wɛ Ujéssuwa, Ubáni, Ussiyɛbíya, Ujámin, Ákūb, Ussɛbetáyi, Uhódīya, Umaaséya, Ukélíta, Asárīya, Ujósābadi, Uhánan mɛ́mla Upeláya.

eng_Latn: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.
idu_Latn: Ó keé kē má odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwá yá aéwo ɔhá iyɔ̄bū uwā ā. Ó ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ húmáyī nuunu lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é da uwá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le aúgbɔ́ɔnya kpó lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Uféro ka ā. Ó klla le ɔdōlé kú iyāwu ā kpó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
idu_Latn: Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin kú nū, mla ɔkpɛ́ɛwū olɔhi nōo klá icō kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin kú ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a cīce ce ɛlā nyā bá ajɛ, nɛ̄ á ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Otábɔ̄ géē wā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ŋmá ɛga ɔhá, amáŋ a í kwú, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔkwu kú inu kú ádā uwɔ mɛ ŋmá ajɛ. Ɔ̄nyɛ jé, ó lɔfú ohígbū eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā nāa lé ɔcányā kú Upɛ́sīya á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
idu_Latn: Ami, Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka ɛnyā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēé kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Ubábīlɔn ā á.

eng_Latn: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū hɛ́tá ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō leyīkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú ɔdā nōo ŋmó um glá ā. Ó hɛ́ um tá, ohígbū ka ɛlā um he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce aɛ́cí klla gē hī uwā ka aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka āyā éyi kú iyē ī móōwē, ayíka odúúdú āyā ohile ā gē móōwē dúú. Odúúdú āyā kú iyē ā ī gwéeyē ɔ́dāŋ kéē ī cɛ̄tra āyā kú iyē éyi.

eng_Latn: If a man have two wives, one beloved, and another hated, and they have born him children, both the beloved and the hated; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ, ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ anyā ɛpa, nɛ̄ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ma ayí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ ɔ́kplá kú nū ā í wɛ ɔyí kú ɔnyā ōcɛ̄ kú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya le pó kéē lɛ anɔ̄ tū Udéfīdi ɛyí, kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ é le pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō wā kéē gaá lɛ Udéfīdi kwú. Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le pó ā, ó le tá igelī, ɛga nēé cē igá tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú aá lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi nōo yɔ̄ í hɛ́hɔ̄ ámāŋ koó yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu aálá. Eko nōó pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛhɔ̄, ó gē da ɔ̄ kóō yá fíyaa cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gáā cīce kóō lé ɔdōlé nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubatisséba le tá ipú inu eyīpú ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ á. Udéfīdi le hīla nɛ̄hi eko nyā ɛɛ́. Abíssāgi nēe ŋmá Ussúnɛm ā, yɔ̄ í leyīkwu ɔ́ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā bɔ̄bíipú lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlá nēé gē gbo ā bɔ̄bí eko dóódu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
idu_Latn: kéē lɛ ācokɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɔdāhá ɛpa kpó kéē lɛ ije cē bá Unábɔ̄tu ka ɔ́ɔ le ɛcá cá ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwū ɔ̄ ú ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá anú kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā géē kpó uwā ga ipú ajɛ nēé gáā mīyɛ kéē lā anú ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē nū aéwo alɛwa ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ó ka abɔ̄ é bá gē wā ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē nū aéwo ahāapa nēe lɛwa klla lɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā ā, bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá. Aéwo ā bá yɔ̄ á: ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Ugígāssi, Uhám, Ámɔ̄ri, Ukénan, Upɛ́risi, Ujɛ́būsi.

eng_Latn: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛnyā kóō lɛ ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú nū nōo nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cābɔ̄ nū glá ŋ́ mā mafú lɛ odúúdú ācɛ oŋmá eko nyā tá eko ɔhá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, o ŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ nōó yíihɔtū tá alɔ ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
idu_Latn: A gē leyíkwu uwā lɔɔlɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí nēé le tū, nēe le ɛgba tá tū ipú ajɛ, le jɛ̄ klla le īkpō gwá ā. É bī okónu kú uwā gē ka olɔhi kú uwɔ piyóó, amáŋ ákú ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, é lɛ ɛla wu uwɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔjá kú ejé omákáká háyi abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le isosō wu ejé omákáká ā, é lɛ ɔ́ gbō bá ɔcí, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ kwu ɔ̄ okónu á.

eng_Latn: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ede nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gwó kéē gwɛ́ɛya nōo ī yá kéē kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ede ɛga o bīyíne kú uwā lɛwa lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō je íjééyī mɛ́mla ohílīpú ga uwɔ ká ā gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu kóō lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɛlā kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō ga ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é lɛ áafú tá gbojī ajā, Upíta cāŋjɛ anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, aá jé ka o ŋméko nōo yɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ um fu ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ká n̄ tɔ́ɔna ká Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ aílɔ́wá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le pó kéē klla mīyɛ cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
idu_Latn: Ukóra, ɔyí kú Ísar, ɔyí kú Ukɔ́hāti, ɔyí kú Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla Udátan mɛ́mla Abíram, ayí kú Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Upélɛ̄ti, ayí kú Urúbɛ̄n, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó .

eng_Latn: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú úwé mɛ́mla awulú ā ú wu Árɔ̄ni iyē, lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́nyɔ́ gbō īlī ōle gbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́. Ó klla kwú úwé kpií nēé hī ka ɛ́fɔ̄du, nēé ī le wiyē ce ɛyí awulú ā ú wu ɔ́ iyē. Ó klla kwú ɔdōgbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā nēé wu lɔɔlɔhi ā ú gbō ɔ̄ ɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
idu_Latn: Ɔmálɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ményinyi nū ā nɛ̄. Ujísɔ̄si tóóhi kahíníī, Ayíka a nyɔ̄ í yá ɛ́gɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā yá mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ ma íkpékwīja ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ɔwɔ fúlufúlu ŋ́. Ikpēkwīja kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ Usamérīya ɔ́ɔ ge gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɔ́ɔmā, í je ca putuu.

eng_Latn: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā géē gwíijē tá um ahínyá. É klla í gwéeyē bá géē yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔga. N géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ma ayí alɛwa cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyīla. É gáā le kɛ́tɛ̄kɛtɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē yá kú ācɛ ɔhá kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da um kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, Ɔwɔicō yíhɔtū tá uwɔ nɛ̄hi. Cāŋjɛ ká ā jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā. É tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu uwɔ. Eko nōó le ɛ̄nyā ka ā, n cāŋjɛ háyiicō klla yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Óndú āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē háyi Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū āa?.

eng_Latn: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
idu_Latn: Aá Abɔ̄yī aá wɛ ɔkpá nɛ̄ alɔ tá bá ɔtū kú alɔ nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē má klla ī jé ā.

eng_Latn: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá ā wɛ ákú ābɔ̄ ɔhá, ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá wɛ ákú ābɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é le kpó cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwú īyī uwā iyē ú tēelihɔ mla aɔ́kplá kú uwá nēé ī kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí ā. N yá ɔ́ɔmā ká n je ōwē lɛ uwá, ká n̄ mafú lɛ uwá ka ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú, abālɔbányā, yá ka ɔkpɛtá kóō lɛ ayí kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó ŋmó. Yá kéē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Ācɛnyā kú uwá ka é kwú pīya anyōkwū, ayí uwā kéē kwú pɛ́ gekwú dúú. Ōcē obɔ̄bí kóō lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ ā kpó ŋmó. Ayípōklóbīya kú uwā kée kwú pɛ́ gekwú ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si ā, Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ó lɔhi abɔ̄ alɔ bá amānyā ā! Alɔ géē lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛtá cē ce. Éyi wɛ ákú uwɔ, éyi wɛ ákú Umósīsi, cɛ́ɛ́ éyi wɛ ákú Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le bū ipú nū bēhé, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ōcē nɛ̄hi kú abɔ̄yīnū ā má, nɛ̄ Ujúda kē lɛ ágbe kú abɔ̄yīnū máā, anɔ́ɔ Ísrɛ̄lu le tá Asírīya kóō dɔɔ̄kā otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí igbómína kú abɔ́ɔ, amáŋ ó gaá hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá ōcē mla ágbe kú uwā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
idu_Latn: É ka ɛ́ɛ tá kéē yɛce Óndú ā mɛ́nɛɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɛ́ɛ tá kóō yɛ ce Óndú ā ícɛ, ɔ́ɔ géē cɔ̄nū mla odúúdú ācɛ Chile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ócí.

eng_Latn: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé kwú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá í yá uwā ɛhi gwéeyē, ācɛ nēé kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi ā gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ma aɔ́dā nēe bá ā fú lɛ uwá kéē le jé kpɔ́cíí ka Óndú ā, ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɔ̄ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ aá le tá ɛgiyí nū, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē je lɛ ɔ́ ā? Ó da ɔ́ ka igbō nɛ̄ aá kpó tū ipú ɛkpa ā í mɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ka aá í lɛ ɔdā kú ɛhi dúúmā ō bī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ajɛ Usalámisi ā, é tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā. Ujɔ́ni Umáki kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ī tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá abɔ̄yī aá, aá kóō yúufi ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá ācobɔ̄bíipú italā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá le jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá kwu íjééyī mɛ́mla íla kú alɛɛcɛ. Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ éyi géē yá fíyɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔhá nōo gbɔbū lɛ ɔ̄ ā, í tɛtɛ yá ŋ́ mā a?.

eng_Latn: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
idu_Latn: é jikwū kú otábɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ajɛ odobū í tá ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Íjīpiti. Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ísu ā le kɔ́ ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ é le bū ɔ̄ ɛyí ajɛ oŋmókókó. Amáŋ ó le yá kú ísu ā kóō kwú okónu ú klá tū ācɛ kú Íjīpiti eko nēé nū aádáádā alɔ ga ipú ísu ā. Aá kē jé ɔdā nōó yá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ó keé kē lā ipú ígbíli iháyí alɛwa.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ, ó gáā tá alɔ piyóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ dóódu kpó hīgwú wā ŋmá ɛga dóódu ká ē wā í lé ɛbɛ ɛya, nɛ̄ n gáā gwó lɛ uwá ā. Ó géē wɛ ucɛ nɛ̄hi ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēé géē lé ɛbɛ́ klla í gwá oyī ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɛ̄nyā n gē lɔtūlé lɔhi ipú ōwē dóódu ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu āa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwá kéē lɛ nyatá ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si nōo ī bī ɛgahi mɛ́mla ocɛ̄tra opiyóó wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛ́ɛ lɔfú da anúɔ ka aá ɔ́ɔ gē kpɔ́tūce Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā. Amāŋ ka óo wɛ aíkpɛ́cí kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya ɔ́ɔ je kpó ca bónū ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā, klla da ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm ka ɛ́ɛ gaá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ede ékpónú ōfōōfūnū ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ái ŋmó ācɛ ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī kú uwá klla nū uwá inya ŋmá okónɔɔwe kú igá kú Ái jāā ga Ussɛbárim. É klla ŋmó uwá ɔpɛ́ kú ɛfu abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ufi cɛ̄ le ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú kpó gbenyi bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́wɔ kú aéwɔhá dóódu ā wɛ ɛcí nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ yá nɛ. Amáŋ Óndú ā yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
idu_Latn: É bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā, abɔ̄ é bā ī nyɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónu úgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú ɔlá nɛ̄ ɔnya kú ɔlá yɔ̄ í pi ā gaajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ofúlutu kwú Ɛláyíja ú ga ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ká ō géē je yɔɔlá náaná a, o lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́. Abɔ̄ ɔlá klla lɛ ɔ́ yi, le pá fiyuu ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó klla tū ile ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
idu_Latn: Agbénú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí ā, gē bī ikwū gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. Ó klla ī mɛ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ dúúmā nōo le kwú, é gēe gwu ɔ ɛ̄wā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
idu_Latn: É da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá alɔ ā. Nɛ̄ aá je alɔ tá eyī obɔ̄bí kú Uféro mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, nɛ̄ aá klla kwú ɛ̄wā ú tú ūwā abɔ̄ kéē lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka anúɔ kē húmáyī yíihɔtū tá uwā. Amáŋ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɔ́ɔ yíihɔtū tá aá lɛ ā? Óndú ā tá ūwā ohi ka Ísɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujékɔ̄pu ŋ́ nɛɛ? Nááná Ujékɔ̄pu nɛ̄ anúɔ yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gáā bēhé isu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā ɛɛ́. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ajɛ ā, má lā anú.

eng_Latn: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá kú aá lā ɛbɔ́ mla odúúdu ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔbɛ́ɛna mɛ́mla omlede kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā. É í jé uwá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā. É géē yá ɛ̄nyā piíí ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē ma īyī nū fú lɛ uwá ícɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ, nōo wɛ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ da aá ka ayí aá, nēe wɛ ayípɛ̄ obene eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, nēé jé ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla olɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā gáā ga ipú ajɛ ā á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ ka ayí uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ka aólɛlā kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē mīyɛ uwá abɔ̄fú ɔwɛ ā, anúɔ géē je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá. É kē í lā anú.

eng_Latn: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ífi ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí kóō yá ācɛ, ɛdɔ nōo géē yá kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō yɔ̄ ī yāwu bɛ̄ɛka opeyī ā. Ohígbū keé le ɔ́bíipú bī tū um klla le íne kú ami Óndú ā bīya. Oyī kú uwā géē pɛ́ klá ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā. N géē kpó okwū kú uwā bá ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wā bɛ̄ɛka emī ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ okwū ɛbɛ́ ā lé, ó géē na īlī kú nū, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī okwū ā géē na īlī kú nū, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
idu_Latn: Aá híī kiífilá tū iyī aá ŋ́, ayínɛ́ um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ujísɔ̄si le tá ipú ɔ́kɔ mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ le hɛ́ ókpoó ā igbó ga ogbeé ɔhá kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Ujése da Udéfīdi ká ɔ̄ mīyɛ okoolo igwó kú āmplā mɛ́mla igbō igwó nyā kɔ́ ɔ̄ le bī gé lɛ ayínɛ́ nū ɔgbɛ́fú fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū uwā kwúcē fu ɔɔ́. Ó ká ɛ́ɛ da ɔkpani uwā ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gē da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛcá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā tū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū wā í cá um ā je unwalu gā uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ádā nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Iyē kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū lé ka Ussɛlōmiti, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Udíbri, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni ā. Ó le tá ɛcɛ ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi lɛ ikpɛ́lā yá ipú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lā ā á.

eng_Latn: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
idu_Latn: Aá cíkā o je alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, nēé kwú ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi otayínū kú Ɔwɔicō ú tā uwā abɔ̄ kéē tɔ́ɔna tɛ́ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka ɔdā nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ amānyā.

eng_Latn: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ í yá ɔdā dúú nōo gē pīya odo kú nū abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ má, alɔ habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá, kē kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā ā kóō le yá.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nōó wɛ, aá yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka aá tá um abɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú nwalu ā.

eng_Latn: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
idu_Latn: Ije ō cē bá ɔ̄cɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ō le gwu ɔ̄cɛ, ámāŋ ɔyī ō cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ, ámāŋ ka ogbló ō lɛ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēe gē ményinyi ācɛ ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē ményinyi aá.

eng_Latn: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kpó wā ī jīla iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, ká ā gbō uwā ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofaahāapa ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
idu_Latn: É le nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ kú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá mīyɛ cɛ̄ ā bīya tū uwā iyē. É bá gē ka ka ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kú ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá í wɛ ɔdā nōo géē ya ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā nōo le yá le yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja o wúla ɔdā tāajɛ bá ɛfu dóódu kú ipú ígbíli bá ī pɛ́ wā kéē kpó ācɛ yíífi ɛɛ́. N le ācɛ tū kéē wā í lɛ ɛfú kpó tá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔdā dóódu kú ajɛ ā ú kpó yíífi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā í yá ɔdā dúúmā abɔ̄yīnū glá ŋ́, ayíka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó má Ádā nū gē yá ā nɛ̄. Ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ā, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā géē yá ɔ̄ glá dúú.

eng_Latn: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
idu_Latn: A híī cɛ̄ kú okónu kú uwɔ kóō cɛ̄ gā uwɔ bīyíne ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē da ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī hiijā nɛ̄ ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nāa yá ka Ɔwɔicō kóō cɔ̄nū mla awɔ ā? Ɔdíyá nāa ī yá ká Ɔwɔicō, kóō je ɔdā nāa yúklɔ́ nū ā yíífi ā?.

eng_Latn: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ kú aá pó. Ācɛ nēe ī gbō igelī kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā bá ī gwéeyē, yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔga tɔ̄há. É géē bī īkpēyī kú abɔ̄yī uwā í má Óndú ā abɔ̄ ó í pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ācɛ igwó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ ka é nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Unábalu igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ukámɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē bī iyē kú anúɔ lɛ ɔ́gbá tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
idu_Latn: Aá le ɛga ō kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū gwó tá ɛpá nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ aɔ́dɔ ɛpa ā, nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā ī wā í pɛ́ tū. Amáŋ, aá lɛ ɛlá wu Ɔwɔicō nōo tɛtɛ miya ɔdānyā tá ajɛ ŋmá íkée, nōo yá kóō kē le yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu gā ɛgiyí ádā nū Áyísīki, Umámre ámāŋ Ukiriyatába nōo lé ka Uhɛ́brɔn dúú ā. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki lā ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ó kwú ɛ̄wā ú le okwū kú odiyɔ̄ kú nū wā le ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛga igwɛ́ɛpa. Ó le āyā kú nū éyééye tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Lɛ alɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́, Óndú, ményinyi alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ācogwíje kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu ā wɛ ofahāapa ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā ŋmá icō ā, fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ajɛ ā wɛ ákú ajɛ, ó kē ī kɛlā kú ajɛ. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá icō ā, anú fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Á jé abɔ́ɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔnyā nōo jɔ̄ɔ̄ncɛ́nyā fíyɛ́ anyā dóódu ā? Nyɔ̄ ká ā gāá yɛce aálá ā, ká ā tíne ácí lɛ ayí aɛ́wū, ɛgiyí aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɔ̄cogbāálá ā.

eng_Latn: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā nōo lé ka Ágābɔsi ā cāŋjɛ le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ ka ɔkpɛtā nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmó odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ɔdā nyā le yá eko kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi Uklɔdíyɔsi.

eng_Latn: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ a klla lɛ Ussádrāki, Uméssāki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo je gicō āhɔ̄ onwuné fíyɛ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
idu_Latn: Ocíbú nɛ̄hɛ́ kú ugóolu wɛ, ofu cigwó, ocíbú nɛ̄hɛ́ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ wɛ, úlā cigwó, iyó ɔhá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí bɛ̄ɛka, ukɔ̄, ɛ̄wā mɛ́mla aíkókwū ā wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó.

eng_Latn: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó má ācɛ ce aɔ́nya bá ī wā ɛpɛɛpa, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ce ɛyí aíjakī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ce ɛyí aínyankwūlūmī, ayíka ó lɛ ɔna tá ka ācɛ ā kéē le tútū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka iháyí dóódu, uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā géē lé ɛbɛ́ kú aɔ́dāajɛ ā ɛga nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā ipéyī nū.

eng_Latn: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko kpií, ɛ́ɛ́ gáā má īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu mɛ́mla ejé, nōo í jɛ̄ ūwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
idu_Latn: Ɔmlɛgwā, okpé mɛ́mla udɔ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
idu_Latn: Īkpɛ̄ɛnū kú ipú ácí ā, le kwu hɛ̄ ɔyí nū obene ā tá, ohígbū ká ácí ī yɔ̄ nōó gē lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ká ɛ́ɛ híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya ŋ́. Ka ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya gē da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kɛ́ɛ̄ wā gaá cɔ̄nyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lé īkpō ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla īkpō ufígi kú uwā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ klla í gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá obugá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā, aá nēe gē yúufi Óndú ā klla ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ācɛ ōhī kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá gē wɔ́ɔtū aá ohígbū ka aá gē yɛce um kpaakpa. É gē yá aá ɛbɛ́ ī da aá ka, Ka Óndú ā kóō bī ɔfú kú nū le nya uwá tá mɛ́ɛnɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gwéeyē ká alɔ mɔ́ɔ̄. Amáŋ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā nɛ̄ uwēyī gáā kwú á.

eng_Latn: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
idu_Latn: Áa híī ŋmó ɛ́nɛ́ ɛna mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, ámāŋ ka álá mɛ́mla ɔyí nū ámāŋ ka ɛwū mɛ́mla ɔyí nū ɛ̄cī ékpónú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á wɛ iháyí ofɛpa cigwó ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, a kē le Ébrahām má ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
idu_Latn: Ó le obobowú kú nū tá klá ɛyí ɛfu ā, klla le tá klá ɔcí ulōko nōo gbagwu nɛ̄hi ā icō, le gbobobowú ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē má ɛdɔ agbénú dóódu, nɛ̄ alɔ géē kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā í bá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ alɔ.

eng_Latn: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
idu_Latn: A le ɔyā yá kwu, ká ālɔ̄ bī le jé ɛ̄cī nōo ī yá ipú ɔyā a. Ɛnɔ kē ī gaajɛ eko nōo cíkā ō gaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ɛmɛɛma kóō nā ācɛ nēe gē kwu uwá ɛyí ā tɔ́ɔwɛ. Eko ohi Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī je ɛga lɛ uwá kéē le pīyabɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔkwɛyi kú ɛlā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā jé.

eng_Latn: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ákú Ujerúsālɛm kpó hīgwú.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhli ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ujósuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n le ijē ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē le pó.

eng_Latn: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
