idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi nēe dɛ̄gba kɛlā ŋmá ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, Ɔwɔicō géē nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá! Abālɔbányā, ó géē bī ɔfú kú nū gbō ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ ā. Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōó fu ā kē í bī íkwu kú nū le gbō ɛcɛ abālɔbányā! Ohígbū ka ebilíi nōo gē hayi iyɔ̄bū ɔwɔicō ī kpɛ́lāce ayínɛ́ alɔ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká ā lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɔtōoce nāa lɛ ā kɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛyí kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔhā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā jé.

eng_Latn: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
idu_Latn: É le oje ō kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū ā yíifa bɛ̄ɛka íkókwū nēé yá gbla oōnwūla kú ododó kú ɔcí nēé hī álumɔ̄ndu mɛ́mla ohépu kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussɛ́m mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti lɛ īlī kpó, kwú īlī á ú pīya klla ɔkɔ kú uwā ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa. Anɔ́ɔ é yāwu igbīīgbīhi gaá le īlī ā pīya klá ádā uwā iyē á. É le eyī kú uwā pīya tá ɛga ɔhá kéē má ohɛ́ɛwa kú ádā uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā ā lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ōhɔ́ɔnɔ ā gwá, ɔ́dāŋ kaó lɛ ajā gbo, le iyī nū iyē tēelihɔ, éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ nōo ga ɔ́ ipú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ipúkpánū yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Iyē kú nū géē je mi, ipú klla géē nū ce ɔ́ ɔtū. Agada kú nū í je wútū. Ɔnyā ā í je pīya ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bī le kwiitá.

eng_Latn: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
idu_Latn: Ɔyī kú Ujonátan í ge táamblē ō ŋmó ācokpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi kú aólɛlā ā ŋ́. Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú Usɔ́ɔlu í kē í tá abɔ̄ áncā ŋmá aólɛlā ō ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le igwu ā tīkwū bá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú okónū ísu ā. Ó kpótū jāā gbéeko nōó tōō miya igbīhāajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
idu_Latn: Ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je ká ā tá um abɔ̄ ā, kóō gā ɛgiyí uwɔ, Óndú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tá ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbɔ́ɔ ō yá ula bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé gē kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā a, jāā gbéeko nēe lɛ uwá já wā ajɛ íkpákplā.

eng_Latn: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
idu_Latn: É wɛ úlā ofu ce éyi, ce ofu ahāanɛ .

eng_Latn: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú ā, n tɛtɛ le jé ŋmá ɔlɛ́. A má ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n lɔfú tīyē kú n le kwu ga Utásīsi ā yɔ̄ á. N jé ka, a wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī ményinyi nōo klla lɛ ihɔtū. A klla gbeeyī cíí, klla ī gbonɛnɛ, ī pīya ɔtū kú uwɔ abɔ̄ eko dóódu. A klla le tútū eko dóódu ká ā pīya ɔtū kú uwɔ abɔ̄ ŋmá o yá ācɛ italā.

eng_Latn: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
idu_Latn: Ígblɛ́nyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcɛ kú ɔfú obɔ̄bí nōo gē bī odúúdú ɔkpíyē ohile kú ɔ̄cɛ yúklɔ́. Ó kē lɔfú bī ɔlá nōo ŋmá ɔlíkɔtɔ abɔ̄yīnū je odúúdú ɔlíkɔtɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ tɔ̄lá glá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
idu_Latn: A géē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu, í mīyɛ ajɛ tū abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ojuja nɛ̄hi nōo ī klá ajɛ kpímm ā. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā le yá, n géē tū uwɔ nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tú ajɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n le mafú lɛ odúúdú aéwɔhá ā kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā ŋ́. N géē yá lɛ ā oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
idu_Latn: Okwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ó tá ā, Ujóram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Usamérīya gaá le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá.

eng_Latn: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aúcɛ nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé ba ɛ̄cī Usábáti, ɛya kú eko dóódu ā, ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú oji nēé wā í cɛ̄, mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya nɛ̄ aá je ŋmá ɔtū kú aá lɛ Óndú ā iyē.

eng_Latn: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛga kú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēé ka ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē ka aílɔ́wá gwó mla iyī nū ohígbū keé le ɔtūkpóce ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔkōōlɔhi ā kā Ébrahām gbɔbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē bī uwɔ le yá kú ō lɛ ogbonɛnɛ kú nū mafú lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā lɛ gwutá mɛ́mla anú eko nōó yɔ̄ ī nyílá ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kwú iyī nū tēelihɔ ŋmá oōnyílá kú ɔnyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā géē tēelihɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Agōdō dúúmā nēé gwutá anú ā le pīya ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ ó nú aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá uwá iyē ā ī nyɔ̄ mla anú dúú. Ācɛnyā ā wɛ Umerí nɛ̄ é nū aálalékwū obɔ̄bí ahāapa ŋmá iyē nū ā.

eng_Latn: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Umósīsi le ijē ā tá tāajɛ, le ɔ́ nwū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si pīyɛyí ŋmá ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛga nēé yá ɔ̄ Ubatísim ā. Alelékwū Ihɔ le mu ɔ́ iyē nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā le ɔ́ bī ga ipú ígbíli á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa lɛ Ái tɔ̄lá klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tá alácɛ̄ jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɛcɔ̄ éyi nōo lɛ ɔ́kíkā ahāapa tá iyɔ̄bū Ujóssuwa. Ó ka anúɔ géē tɔ́kpá tū ɛyí nū. Ipú ɛ̄cī ékpónú ā, n géē kpó íne nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā bīya ā bónū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ugídīyɔn ka ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā, le lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá ācɛ Umídiya ā lé. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē le lɛwa lɛ ā, ɛ́ɛ géē gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ yá ɛfú ā lé abɔ̄yī aá á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ohi nɛ̄ a cīla ā lɔhi íbí. Bī ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ā le yúklɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ā géē yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā géē da aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū ā kahíníī, Aá gā, aá nɛ̄ Ádā um hɔ́hā ce aá kú aá lúgwū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nēé tútū lɛ aá ŋmá ohútu kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Aá le ɔcí kú ipú úpú kú Ulɛ́bānɔn hɛ́ bá ajɛ ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā ā, é géē kpó aá abɔ̄yī aá hɛ́ bá ajɛ dúú. Aá lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kú nū kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́, aɛ́bɛ́ ā kē í bá ī tū aá ufi. Ɛ̄nyā géē yá aá ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ŋmó ā, mla ucē obɔ̄bí mla obíipú nɛ̄ aá bī lɛyíkwú aéwo kú ɛcɛ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gā ɛgiyí um, gē lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄ n gē je lɛ ɔ́ ā jāā gbéeko nōó le ipú nū.

eng_Latn: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē géē le ojīlīma ce uwɔ eko dóódu ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ a je lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ eko nɛ̄ Usɔlu wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́ mā, ú wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé gbɔɔ́ ō tá opo kú ɛfú, é ī mahayi cíí glá ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. é gbɔɔ́ ō hápápá kwinya nyɔ̄ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā bī í yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā jīla tá igbo éyi. É le yá lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é gaá mlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá gē yúúfi āa? Aá wɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō nwuné ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ, lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔwu mɛ́mla úgbagwú kú ísu āa. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú ɛga dóódu gaá yɔ̄ hímm á.

eng_Latn: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, le ijakī kú nū tútū, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umówābu á.

eng_Latn: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔyí kú Ujése gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ámíyā géē yá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ī wā ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ā bá ī lɔnɔ ɔtū lɛ ɔ́mpā uwā ɛbɛɛbɛ. Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú uwā kē le fíyɛ́ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Ami jééyī fíyɛ́ aókplícī á, ohígbū ka n gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
idu_Latn: Alɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ā nōo wɛ Ádā kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Abɔ̄ alɔ le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛdɔ ɔhā kú alelékwū dóódu nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā hɛ́ ce alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
idu_Latn: Óndú á da Umósīsi kahíníī, Da Árɔ̄ni kóō kwú okwutɛ kú nū ā ú kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāńdaa klá eyī éŋkpɔ̄ kú Íjīpiti ā. Kwu ísu, áyɔ́kpá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kwu obugā ká uwā kéē kwú pīya oyī. Oyī ā í yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, kwu éŋkpɔ̄ kú ipú ɛtɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛ̄hī mɛ́mla ɔjá kú uwā a.

eng_Latn: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Ujása kéē lɛ ɔkwu kú ɔwɛ nōo í tɔ́ɔtɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá géē kpɛ́fú tú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujása ā bū. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛfú kpó tū uwā klla mīyɛ aípɔ́lɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā jīla ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú Ámɔn nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā kpó nū á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, aá kwú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā í yá um ɛhi. Ó kōō igbeékpónú nyā ōfōōfūnū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, kóō kwú italā ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nyā í ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ nū le yɛ tá ɔ̄nū ucɛ ā, anú abɔ̄yī nū le yɛ dúú. Ó nyɔ̄ cāā ŋ́ amáŋ ó nyɔ̄ tayínū.

eng_Latn: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
idu_Latn: N géē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ile nyá nɛ̄ ó lɛ ŋmá ōwē nōó yɔ̄ ī yá um ā, ŋmá ō tá ɔdā nōo bī abɔ̄ kú nū yá ā tónū ā. N klla í da ɔ́ ka ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ojuju ula kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall say unto the elders of his city, This our son is stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, and a drunkard.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū géē da uwá ka ɔyí aá ā ɔ́ɔ gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá aá. Ka ɔ́ɔ tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aá, ɔ́ɔ klla gē ŋmó ije bónū klla í gwá ejé nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mla ɛcɛ gē jīlaiyē, klá í jīlaiyē jāa kwu etikpa kú uwá, ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ ami Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a gēe ma iwúɔtū kú um fú a.

eng_Latn: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
idu_Latn: Aá ka ka ayíkpó kú nū wā otú eko nɛ̄ aá bá gē gbɔlā ā gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú uwī.

eng_Latn: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
idu_Latn: Á híī je odée ka ojuju obɔ̄bí ohígbū ka ācɛ je ɔ́ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā ŋ́. Ɔdā nōo gē tū uwá ufi ā, kóō híī tū uwɔ ufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ka ā, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo dɔɔ̄kā ō lā oyēeyi olɔhi kóō má abahi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóo he ɔ́, ayíka óō le kwu ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá mɛ́mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā.

eng_Latn: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Kwu ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā í yá ucē kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. N le uwá kwú bá ī yá ucē ɔ́bíipú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kɛlā lɛ Ujeremíya igbīhi nɛ̄ Usedekíya mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm le okónu ce ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ aɔ́fiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ kéē gbāajɛ otú, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á, ményinyi um. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga uwɔ ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kwu otú, ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó tá ō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā nū. Ó klla tá kóō lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicó kú Ísrɛ̄lu tū.

eng_Latn: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄kā kú ipɔ́nū kú Ujékɔ̄pu. Ujósɛ̄fu eko nōó wɛ iháyí igwáahāapa ā, anú mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nēe wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubílha mɛ́mla Usílpa ā gē leyīkwu aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wu kú ádā uwā. Ó gē kpɛ́pɔ̄ kú odōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ nū bá ī yá ā lɛ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ, alɔ tíne ká aá lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔdā nōo géē yá da ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́ mā jé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɔ̄ ipú ɔtūnōbí bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔdā ō leyice ɔ́ ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Usɔ́lu tá uwā ohi ka é gáā ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu tá á.

eng_Latn: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
idu_Latn: Ufúta, Ássīna, Unésību.

eng_Latn: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
idu_Latn: Aíkpō ufíigi nēe bá ipú ómbilí éyi ā le lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄hi, bɛ̄ɛka aíkpo ufíigi nēe ī pīya aflɛ́yí ā. Aíkpō nēe bá ómbilí ɔhá ā le bīya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nēe tōō lé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ká ajɛ kú uwā ā kóō le mu mla ɔdā olɔhi dóódu, ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́. Anú, nōo kɛlā ŋmá ipú ɔlá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu ā. Kóō hɔ́hā nyā ce Ujósɛ̄fu, ohígbū ka, anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ayínɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ tū oyēeyī kú uwɔ gā uwɔ. N klla í hɛ́ awɔ mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya, N klla í cɛ̄pɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ohígbū iyē kú um mɛ́mla ákú Udéfīdi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ayí dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē hile ɔlɛ́ nū nōó tɛtɛ lā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɔ́kɔ ā tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́gbá kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, awɔ ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n gā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gáā jé ɔkpá o mafú lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ aá géē fu āá, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū uwā kéē lɛ ɛhi kú aá kpó ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́kpá ā gé lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū nēe bá Uróm ā, nēé kē hīgwú kéē wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā. N yɔ̄ ī ba Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú ā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kéē ményinyi aá.

eng_Latn: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú nū kóō gaá jīla ádā nū ɔwɛ Ugóssɛn. Eko nēé le jīla ā, Ujósɛ̄fu le ádā nū kwú bɔ́tū le abɔ̄ kpó ce ɔ́ ɔkɔ, jikwu gbojī ajɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ uya gē yɔ̄ ī yá kpɔ́, ŋmá ɛhícō kú odée yɔɔlɔ nōo yɔ̄ icō kú aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
idu_Latn: N géē ka ga uwɔ, ɔdā nōo géē yá ayí nēé ma amānyā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ádā uwā a.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
idu_Latn: Aéwo ā géē má ɛ̄nyā, é kē í je gbájí, nááná nēé lɔfú ā. Ufi géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá í klá okónu kú uwā. É klla í je ɔcí gwū ahɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
idu_Latn: ɔfú nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni bī le yá ācɛ ubatísim ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō kɛ̄ɛ ka ɛgiyí alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
idu_Latn: Ikpó kú nū fíyáajɛ bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ nēé na ŋmá útuló klla lɛ ɔ́ nya péee ā. Ɔkɔ kú nū kē ī kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá nɛ̄hi nōo gē pɛ́ wāajɛ ŋmá icō ā.

eng_Latn: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
idu_Latn: Aá aólíla nōo wɛ aópeyī, ɛ̄nyá nwuné fíyɛ́ ā? Ugóolu ā kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo yá ká ugóolu ā kóō le tīihɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ éyi o lɛ agwú ga ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a cɛ̄, a lɔfú yá um yēŋēē glá.

eng_Latn: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ kē í yá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mla ɔcí ufáyin, mla ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu ā, ɔpɛ́ nēé hī Ujésiríilu ā.

eng_Latn: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yí kú um, ɛlā ɔlamu mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yí gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú um á.

eng_Latn: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā klla le ācɛ ɔhá nēe yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí bītá gɛɛcɛ kéē géē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó mla Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē wɛ ɔcányā ā piyóo. Á kē gbɛlá lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē gbɛlá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú nū gáā ŋmɛ́yí lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abíssāyi da Udéfīdi ka Ɔwɔicō kwú olɛlā kú anú nōo wɛ Udéfīdi ā ú tá ipu abɔ̄ kú nū otú ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ lɛ óbō kú nū abɔ̄yī nū ā gwū ɔ̄ bá ajɛ igbeékpónú. Ó ka anúɔ í gáā gwō ɔ̄ igbo ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū nēé géē je ɔtū kú ayí uwā pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, gāá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá kú uwā ɛ̄gbā. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ le yá lɛ ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ í cɔ̄nū mla uwá klla í kpó uwā yíífi bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō le tɔ́ɔna, ó cɔcɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔkpáncō kē ī mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwá wɛ Uhɛ́brɔn kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ lɔfú lúlé anú glá nēe yɛ jīla igelī ā tá ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ulɛ́ya wɛ, Urúbɛn, Usímīyɔn, Ulífāyi, Ujúda, Ísāka mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
idu_Latn: Aá le pó keé da ācɛ íkée kahíníī, A híīī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, é géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ odée yá ká n lɛ ojīlīmā kú um tū a, aá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, géē jé ka, ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á. Ohígbū ka ń yá mla aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́bíipú kú aá lɛ ā ŋ́, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē obɔ̄bí kú aá cɛgbá ā ŋ́. Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ úlā ā kpó hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Urámɔtu kú ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, kɛ̄ɛ kā n̄ nyɔ̄ ŋ́? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Mā ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ a ī yá ā tá, ká ā yá kú ācɛ nēe bá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kéē gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
idu_Latn: Īlī ukɔ́tin kú ókómpinu abɔ̄yī nū ā, olīkpō kú nū ā géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ahāanɛ, nēé yá mla īlī odufā, īlī ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla īlī nɔ̄wá nēé le ijā he tū ɔ̄. Ó í lɛ ogbló ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ nēe í bī ɔ̄ háyi.

eng_Latn: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ohi obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ohi ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bī gé lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ajɛ ā í gáā yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo géē jɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lā anú ā glá ŋ́, odúúdu ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā wɛ aɔ́báagwu klla jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ īlī kú nū plá klla gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ ipéyī Usámūwɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó gwutá tá ohɛ́ɛwa nobínōbi, ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gbó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū. Ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ kpó akwukwú kahíníī, Usɔ́lu wɛ ipú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā dúú nɛ.

eng_Latn: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tīyē ká ā le yá kú Usínāsi Ulɔ́ya ā mɛ́mla Apólɔ̄si kéē gā fíya fíya. Lɛ ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā kpɛ́m ā kpó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le tɛ́ɛcɛ, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kóō mīyɛ owu. Ó je eyī gicō anɔ́ɔ ó le aínyankwūlūmī má bá yɔ̄ ī wā á.

eng_Latn: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu nōo gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā, géē lɛ ɔkpá kú ɛ́bɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
idu_Latn: N hī Óndú ā igwú eko nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ipú unwalu. N hī Ɔwɔicō igwú kóō wā í tá um abɔ̄. Ó kē lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Ó le āhɔ̄ jē le ikwū nɛ̄ n je kóō wā í tá um abɔ̄ ā pó.

eng_Latn: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā le yá, anɔ́ɔ aá klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um ŋ́ kpɔ́, n géē yá aá italā ɔ́klá ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpokónu ce ɔ́ ā, wɛ, Ujehósābadi nōo gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛpa ce igwó ā . Odúúdú uwá le iyē kwú kéē kpɛ́fú eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa kwú cɔ̄nū mla anú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, A géē yɛ í lɛ ɔyī ā tá gbo ajɛ igbɛhɔ̄, ɛhīlī, ámāŋ ka ahāapa, cɛ́ɛ́, á géē yɛ í lɛ ācɛ Usiríya yálé dúúdú, ámāŋ, igbɛ ɛtá piyóó nāa géē yá ācɛ Usiríya lé mɛ́ɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ga ɛcɛ gaá má ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Aá gaá má ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kɛ̄ɛ? Īī, ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ n̄ da aá ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá nyɔ̄ í má fíyɛ́ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
idu_Latn: Ojuja ā yɔ̄ ī yɛ mla uwá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ɔ́kpa kú ɔlá ōfíyajɛ ā í gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā otú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
idu_Latn: N yá ɔ́ɔmā lɛ a, ohígbū ka é tá ō yá íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú um, lɛ aɛ́cī nɛ̄ n kéē yúklɔ́ ŋ mā tá nyílá, klla bá ī pā aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá gē pā ā.

eng_Latn: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ísu lɛ uwɔ má ā, ufi lɛ ɔ́ kwú, eyīpíípú kú ísu yɔ̄ ī fīyēgbúlú bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yúufi ā.

eng_Latn: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛhi kú ɔdā ō jé mɛ́mla ɛbɛ ō má kú alɔ í jīla dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
idu_Latn: N má omlede ā yɔ̄ ī yɛ ī gwōgli mla ɔfú kú nū, yɔ̄ ī kwinya ga ɛhícō, ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ga ɛháajɛ yɔ̄ gē lɛ aájī kú nū tū aɛ́bɛ́ dóódu nēe háyi ɔwɛ kú nū ā. Ɛbɛ́ dúúmā ī kwú ɔ̄ tū glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā lɔfú jɛ̄ nōo gē nyatá ŋmá ɔfú kú nū glá ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, nōó gē yá á. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī lɔfú tōōtɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For this is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē gwō aólɛlā kú nū ɔ́ci. É géē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ŋmó ācɛ jāā gbéeko nōó le jɛ̄ uwā. Oyī kú ācɛ í pɛ́ klá ɔkpacāŋ́gelī cakpaa jāā gbéeko nōo ī yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ kótó kótó wā ajɛ. Ɔwɔicō géē je uwā kpó ŋmó le gwɛ́ɛya, ɛhícō, kwu ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá ká aá gwá ejé nēé le yá ɔdōlé ihɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá klla nyɔ̄ í gwá ejé ɛga nēé ī yɔ̄ í lé ɛbɛ́ ɛcí glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá híī fu ɔkpíyē kú aá ukɔ̄ ámāŋ tíína tū ɛga dúúmā kú ɔkpíyē kú aá kóō mafú ka aá yēekwu kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú ā ŋ́. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
idu_Latn: A géē kpó ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nāa cɛgbá ohígbū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā le tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá lɛ ɔ́ héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Ɔkpani, Ɔkpani! Alɔ gáā pɛ́ kwú ɛɛ́ n! Ujísɔ̄si cāŋjɛ háyi icō anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū owu mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ úgbagwú yɔ̄ ī tá ɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ é mā, nɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ má tá siimm á.

eng_Latn: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
idu_Latn: Ujosíya ma Ujekoníya mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ eko nēé kpó uwā aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ga ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
idu_Latn: Aóje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā nwuné nɛ̄ó tōō miya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm géē bī ēeyē gé um klla í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ í cɛ̄tra um klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce um. Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú odúúdú aéwo géē pó odúúdú ɔdōōlɔhi nɛ̄ n yá lɛ uwá ā, mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n géē je lɛ uwá ā, ufi géē kwú uwā nōo klla í cɛ̄ le uwá fīyégbúlú.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ kwú ōhī kú īnyīlɛyí mɛ́mla ɔnwū ā ú kpó tayínū ipú ābɔ̄ īlī kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíja lɛ úwé kú nū plla, le ɔ́ hā gblógbló, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ fīyɛ̄ eyī ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, anɔ́ɔ ísu ā kwú kɔ̄ ɛpa waa! Anɔ́ɔ é kwú bū ɔtāhɛ̄ ajɛ kú ɔtū ísu ā bēé á.

eng_Latn: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔtū kwu ɔdā olɔhi ō yá, é géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tíne ikpɛ́lā ā, ikpɛ́lā nɛ̄ ó gáā má á.

eng_Latn: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛdalíya da uwá kahíníī, N géē da aá ka aá yúúfi ō cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ŋ́. Aá lā ajɛ amānyā, kú aá gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛ̄gbā. Ó kē í lɔhi lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ ipácí dúúmā í gē yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ágábá nááná í kōō ī bū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Uhóri tɛtɛ lā Uséyɛ tɛtɛ dúú, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ayááyí kú Ísɔ nū uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, le éwo ā kpó yíífi, anɔ́ɔ uwá abɔ̄yī ūwā gaá lā abɔ́ɔ á. Ó ka ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ gáā nū aólɛlā kú uwā ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nēe ī wā ā, Uféro géē je uwɔ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́, klla géē je okwū kú uwɔ playi ɔcí. Aígbáanɔ géē je ɛbɛ́ uwɔ wá lé.

eng_Latn: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā yá ā, í lɔhi ŋ́. É kwú Ujeremíya ú tá ipú obugā. Ɛmiyɛ géē ŋmó ɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdōlé dúúmā í yɔ̄ igelī ā gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ á. Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú nū kē bá amānyā mla opo nēé le tútū kéē tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hī alɔ igwú wā ɔgbɛ́fú mla awɔ ɛɛ́. Ísrɛ̄lu, aá híī kpɛ́fú tá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá yá lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ŋ́, alelékwū dóódu í yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō nōo bá gā awɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú, gbō alɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Gbō alɔ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ obɔ̄bí kú eko nyā.

eng_Latn: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe tɛtɛ lé ligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ abālɔbányā, é lɛ aá bī wā kú aá bá tɔ̄há mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá piyóó. É le aá bī wā ajaajɛ ɛɛ́ ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēé je nyɔ́kpá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū klla gā Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́. Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā blibli ā, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, aítíca kú íne ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ka anúɔ wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nēé wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu kwúcē ga inīcō klla le igbō cē lé ā, ó kɔ̄ɔ̄kā mla uwá gbojī ajɛ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
idu_Latn: Anú ŋmó īyī nū á, ohígbū ka ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ nēé pi ɔ́ anú ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó jāhɔ̄ klla pó nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í lɛ oyēeyī kú īyī nū nyatá.

eng_Latn: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
idu_Latn: Ayí ohile kú ipɔ́ɔma ā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Umésúlam, Ussɛ́ba, Ujórayi, Ujákan, Usíya mɛ́mla Éba.

eng_Latn: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ó má ācɛ nēe bā gē je aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla ɔklɛ́bɛ́tɛ lá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ī fūla ije abɔ̄ bá ulɔ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē lɛ Ɔwɔicō, aá gwíijē ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Aá gwíijē lɛ anú nōo ce ɛyí ojuja bɛ̄ɛka ɔnya ā. Iyē kú nū wɛ Óndú ā, aá gwíijē ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ nwū aá ka Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē kwúcē wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, ó wɛ ɔ̄cā nɛ̄ alɔ ca lɛ aá ā ŋ́. Alɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ gē ka lɛ aá ā, ohígbū ka alɔ bī ikpēyi abɔ̄yī alɔ lɛ ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū má.

eng_Latn: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ oyī kú nū ōhī mī klá áklō kú ede ā. Ó géē pīya oyī ohile ā tū ɔkwu kú ede ā. Ɛya nyā gē kpó íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā bónū.

eng_Latn: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
idu_Latn: Ahíya, Uhána, Ánan.

eng_Latn: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ anúɔ í ba ŋmá ɛgiyí nū eko ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī tá ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā ba ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ubatsséba tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ da anúɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú abɔ̄ ú ce Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unún, ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɔtūlé, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɔfú tīyē, ká ɔtū kú nū ká ɔ̄ le fúlá ká, ohígbū ka anú ɔ́ɔ gáā kpó ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ā á. Ó ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ōcē tū klá ācɛ ā, ohígbū ka é cɛ̄ lɛ Árɔ̄ni lɛ ojibó kú ɛna kú ugóolu ma lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
idu_Latn: Asírīya klla gaá wɛ mla uwá dúú, kwú pīya ācɛ aɔ́mpa ācɛ kú Ámɔn mɛ́mla Umówābu ayí kú Ulɔ́tū ā nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
idu_Latn: Ugílɛ̄di wɛ ákú um, Umanásɛ kē wɛ ákú um dúú. Ɛ́frɛm lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpú ō kwɛyí kpɛ́fú kú um á. Ujúda kē wɛ okwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú um á.

eng_Latn: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísiha ā, Ukénanīya mɛ́mla ayí nū leyīkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú úklɔ́ nēé cíkā ō yá lɛ ā á. Uwá gē tá ɔdā dóódu tá ajɛ klla í ŋwúla áafú dóódu kú odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā á.

eng_Latn: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, alɔ tíne ō tá aá ɛlá kwu ōwē nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɔ má ipú ɔlɛ́ okwúbɔ̄há kú Ésīya ā. Ōwē ā le nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɔ gbɛlá ka alɔ í kōō gáā yēeyī glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dáŋ ka Ágábáidu habɔ̄ uwā tá, nēé lɛ igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm ā gwó, klla lɛ ɔdɔ kú nū ā gwó, é klla gáā cɛ̄ tá élí gā uwɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā, ije nāa í lɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú uwɔ ā kē í tū wāajɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī ɔ̄mɛtá nɛ̄ Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si ga Usísarīya gaá mīyɛ ɔkwu Ufílīsi, ó le yɛ tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka, ohígbū ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya á. Ó gáā wā igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō gē tá ɔyī ékpónú lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋ́. Aícɔ́ɔja dúúmā nēe bī ɔ́kplɛ́fú ā í gáā túblá igelī nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī mīyɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄fú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe wā í mīyɛ ajɛ abɔ̄fú ā géē wā ipú úgbéenyi ŋmá Usáyíprɔ̄si. É géē yá ācɛ kú Asírīya mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Éba lé. Amáŋ, igbīhāajɛ ā, é géē je uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ Umósīsi ā kpó ka lɛ uwá klla lɛ odúúdú ɔdā ō hídáagó ā kpó yá ipéyī uwā.

eng_Latn: The earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā wɛ ákú Óndú. Ajɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū ā wɛ ákú nū.

eng_Latn: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ádā alɔ, alɔ gē bla klla gē ka lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cēyīkīkwū yúklɔ́ lɔfú lɛ ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si he aá ɔtū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá leyīce yɔ̄ ī leyī táajɛ lɔfú lɔfú kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō wā ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le Unatánīyɛ̄lu má lɛyíkwu ɔ́ gē wā, anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu nū kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔkwɛ̄yi, nōó gē plá ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā lé ɛbɛ́ dúú nōo gekwú abɔ̄yī nū ámāŋ ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́. Ó géē je ɔ́ tēelihɔ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
idu_Latn: Umerí tóohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā nɛ. Óndú ā kóō yá mla um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá igbɔhá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ami lɛbɛ̄ɛka okómpīinu nɛ̄ aálá gē bū á.

eng_Latn: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
idu_Latn: Olīkpō kú ogbló éyééye ā, géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛnɛ. Olɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛtá ce ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú ā, kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā, nōo klla yá Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. Aá lɛ íkwu o da um ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī da um ɔdā nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá ŋ́. Kɛ̄ɛ ka aá gē je ɔ́da ga um ohígbū úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú um glá?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
idu_Latn: A kē í bī okwutɛ nyā abɔ̄, nāa géē bī yá ɔdā ō hídáagó.

eng_Latn: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe wā mla Upíta ā le kpó hídáagó, ohígbū keé lɛ ɛhi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ kpó lɛ aílɔ́wá dúú.

eng_Latn: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati gekwú, é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyí ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Ujɛhóram lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́ɔ wɛ āa? Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄nyɛ nōó wɛ a? É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá le Udátan mɛ́mla Abíram hīīgwú klla lɛ ayí kú Ɛlíyābu hīīgwú, amáŋ é kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka é le okónu tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛɛ? Óndú ā kwú ɔtōōlé kú nū ú tónū nɛɛ? Ó géē yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Ó wɛ anú kɛlā ɔkɔ ogbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Utobíya mɛ́mla Usánbālati yá um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā géē lɛ italā yá uwā. Lɛ ɛlā kwú Unowadíya ɔnyā omɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔmā, mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá nēe yá kéē tū um ufi ā dúú, ká ā lɛ italā yá uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
idu_Latn: N pó ɔkɔ kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo gē leyīkwu éŋkpɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Italā nɛ̄ a yá ācɛ ɛcɛ ā le kpaakpa. Awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō otīīhɔ ā yɔ̄ abālɔbányā, awɔ kē tɛtɛ hímáyī yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ejé mla anú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n géē je uwɔ tá alácɛ̄ ā, odúúdú ɛcɛ géē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ogbō-alagbá ā le héyī kē le má bā odúúdú ɔwɛ kú ināgbá ā le kpó nwūla ā, ó lɛ ɛ̄wā kú nū pi ŋmá apɛ́ kóō gaá ŋmó iyī nū, abɔ̄ ó gbɛlá ka aálagbá ā é le pɛ́ kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
idu_Latn: Aá klla í bī okoolo éyi kú umu mla omlede éyééye mɛ́mla ɛ̄jīla kú ejé nōo cɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá, klla lɛ uwá ɔtū yúufiifi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra kahíníi, N cɛ̄tra awɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ. A le yá ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kóō cɛ̄ klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, Óndú ā, nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ utébulu gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya. Olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛnɛ ce ahātá, olɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛpa ce ɛnɛ. Olicō kú nū kóō kē wɛ ofɛtá ce ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ nāa je lɛ alɔ bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā tɛtɛ da alɔ ka ajɛ nɛ̄ alɔ ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ í lā anú ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā, bá í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. É klla bá yɔ̄ ī bīyíne kú uwɔ ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n gwutá agōdō otú, n gē gbɛlá uwɔ, otú gbó ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔkɔ kú Upíta jé ā, ohígbū éeyē nōo yɔ̄ ī gwó ā, ó nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ glá ŋ́, amáŋ ó le inya kwu kwúcē ga inu gaá da uwá ka Upíta ɔ́ɔ háyi okómpinu á.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
idu_Latn: Óndú le ɔkpá gbo ɛɛ́, ó kē gáā pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́. Ó kahíníī, A géē wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya piyóó ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ Umɛkísɛ̄dɛki wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ, ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī ga ɛháajɛ ā. okómpinu ɔhá kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Ó lɛ ɔ́ mīya, ó kē jōnjīlɛ̄ mɛ́mla aókómpinu ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū wu oyí kú ɛbɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔ́ kwu aájī kú ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede kú ɛya o je yɔlá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú oyī ohile ā ú pīya tū ɔkwu kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá kpó cīgbīhi wā Ísrɛ̄lu, ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n géē je lɛ aádáádā aá ā, eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka abālɔbányā ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ le yá jīla ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ o yá kú ɛlā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kóō le yá jīla ā, Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ijēēnyi gē ŋmó um.

eng_Latn: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ oplla ācɛ alɛwa le pɛ́ tú ipú ɛcɛ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ oplla ācɛ nēé cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ̄ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā ŋ́ mā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ oplla ɔ̄cɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ obɛ́yíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kwú iyī nū ú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɔlamu ā, kwú īlī ɔlamu ú kpó wiyē. Anɔ́ɔ otú éyi, ó le yɛ mla aígabɔ̄ ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ nū, gaá má ɔnyā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā a ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄kā da alekwu kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ anúɔ géē hi iyē lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nēé lɛ ɔgba kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā fūlabɔ̄, ofūlabɔ̄ gē yɔ̄ ipú íne ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka, amáŋ, anúɔ gē ma ihɔtū kú anúɔ nōó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā fú lɛ ayááyí ɔ́muúlúúlā kú ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tá anúɔ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
idu_Latn: Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ lɛyítaajɛ lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ohile á. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ klla wɛ ohilí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ. Anú ɔ́ɔ klla wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē gbō ɔ̄ á. Ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígabɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ó má ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛpa bā gē gbapɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó tíne kóō lɛ uwá kagwó á. Anɔ́ɔ o kahíníī, Anyīlɔ, aá wɛ ayínɛ́ nɛ. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī yá ikpɛ́lā tá iyī aá.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ lɔfú ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú uwā, kéē lé ɛga dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū glá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé áluka kú aɔ́dāajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā. Kwu ācɛ otelihɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé tēlihɔ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé ɛbɛ́ kú ɛbɛ́ īkpɛ̄ɛnū ámāŋ ka ulúu ā.

eng_Latn: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē cokónu ɛhi nēé gē yá ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka, ɔwɔ nōo le tū kpúmm mla owu kwūūū nɛ̄ ó yá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
idu_Latn: Égilɔn, Ugésa.

eng_Latn: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi da Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ gáā bēhé wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ Udéfīdi mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ nēé lɛ igá olɔfú hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ nēé hī ka usáyɔn ā abɔ̄fú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
idu_Latn: N lɛyítáajɛ lɛ īne kú Óndú ā, ń kē kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, Óndú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um Ukálɛ̄bu ā, ohígbū alelékwū ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí nɛ̄ó lɛ nɛ̄ó klla yɛce um kpaakpa ā, n géē bī ɔ̄ wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ó nyɔ̄ í jila má ā. Ipɔ́ɔma kú nū klla í lé úgwū kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā kpó bēhé ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá kú omlede o tɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔwā nōo le ŋmó, ɔkpá ɛwū, ɔcí kú akésiya.

eng_Latn: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ohile ā géē lɔfú jɛ́ɛyí kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ihɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá tū aá ā lɔwá, līkpō, licō klla lipú nwuné lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ínoōbīya ā, aá le nwūla ŋmá o yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
idu_Latn: É kē kɛmgbɛ jééjé ɛ́ ŋ́, é kē lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm dóódu ka ije kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ lɛ uwá ipú ígbíli ā, ɛ́ɛ́ le bī wā í kpó tū ipú ikpati kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ɔ̄cobīyíne ā cīgbīhi ŋmá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bi kú nū aá, géē nyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tá ŋmá ikwū opiyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ó klla í yá kéē je íne alɛwa nōó bīya ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ je Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ hī ɔ̄ ka Óndú āa? Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ alɔ géē lá igbō nwuné ŋmá ígbíli nyā, nɛ̄ ɛwa mbá ā géē lé kéē lɛ ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī Usábāti, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aláadi le bá ā, Umerí Umagdalíni mɛ́mla Umerí ɔhá ā le pɛ́ i yɛ kéē gáā má únóji ā.

eng_Latn: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
idu_Latn: Īī, aá lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nyā jé dúú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ o gwo inu tá tónū ā, le pīya ɛcɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú kú inu ā.

eng_Latn: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ī gáā blakwu uwɔ ɔlékwú gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ŋmá únóji glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī Ébrahām cāŋjɛ le ɛfú nēé géē bī lɛ gwɛ́ɛya ā hɛ́, ó le ɔ́ gbó ce ijakī, anɔ́ɔ ó le Áyísīki mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa kpó blá iyīnū á. É gbɔɔ́ ō ga ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ āa.

eng_Latn: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Asigādi wɛ ācɛ, úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
idu_Latn: Ujɛdíyɛ̄lu ma ɔyí éyi nōó hī ka Ubílhan. Ubílhan ma ayí ahāapa nēe bá ā: Ujéyuss, Ubɛ́njamīn, Ehúdu, Ukénāāna, Usétan, Utássiss mɛ́mla Ahíssāha.

eng_Latn: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, É pla eyī klla pla eyī nááná, é má ɔdā dúú ŋ́, é lɔfú jāhɔ̄ klla jāhɔ̄ nááná, é pó ŋ́, é kē jɛ́ɛ́yí ɛlā ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛyí nū jé, é géē pīya ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwa ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ó le ɔtū tū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ipú odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le táajɛ Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ híī lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ukén, nōo wɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā, nōo je ɔyínɛ́ nū ŋmó ā ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nōó ŋmó ɔ̄ ā? Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū yá ā bɔ̄bí, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ̄ nū kē yá ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
idu_Latn: Ó le Utímōti mɛ́mla Erástɔ̄si, nēe wɛ ācɛ ɛpa kú ācɛ nēe gē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Umasɛdónīya, anú abɔ̄yī nū klá Ésīya ɛ̄cī alɛwa kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ācɛ géē tá okónu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ kú éwo ā klla í wɔ́tū nū.

eng_Latn: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cīgbīhi gaá pɛ̄cī ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē yá ojíbó dóódu lɛ iyī aá ŋ́. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
idu_Latn: Aá pīya aúgbɔga mɛ́mla ayókwū mɛ́mla anyōkwū tū ŋ́. Aá kē híī ŋmó ācɛ nē é jíkpó ɔdā dúúmā ɛpɔ̄bí cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó amānyā ŋ́. Aá híī nyɔ̄ í pā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā géē kpó aá yíífi.

eng_Latn: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said unto him, Behold the man whom I spake to thee of! this same shall reign over my people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu le Usɔ́lu má ā, Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n kɛlā nū gā uwɔ, ka anú géē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ā, yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
idu_Latn: Aá kē yá kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá lé ā kóō lɛ aá bī gajaajɛ, kóō híī kwɛjī ɔwɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aā le jōōjīla, ɔdā dúú kóō hile lɛ aá ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē dɔɔ̄kā oyēeyī kú nū géē je ɔ́ tónū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú oyēeyī kú nū ú tónū ohígbū um, géē pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn gē lá ɔnya ŋmá Umúsiri mɛ́mla ajɛ éwɔhá dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ī tíne kéē wā í pó kéē klla má ɛdɔ íjéeyī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í yɛ ga Usífrɔn, cɛ́ɛ́ ó i ŋmɛ́yí Uhasa Ɛ́nan.

eng_Latn: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ alɛwa géē wā í ka ka aá wā ŋmá iyē um géē ka kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē plá ācɛ alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya alɛwa. Aúgbɔ́nya kú nū wɛ úlā ɛtá ce ofu igwó , ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya kú nū kē wɛ úlā ofu ce igwó . Ó le aóhī kú uwā kpó bá Ujerúsālɛm. Ó kē le aóhile ā kpó bá aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kɛlā ga um gɔbū ka, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu cīgbīhi kwu um dúú ā, é béyī fíyɛ́ ācɛ Ujúda, nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī gbajā ā.

eng_Latn: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
idu_Latn: Udelíla da Usámsin ka ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ plla le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā lɛ anúɔ, klla le anúɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē kwú ɔ́ lɛ, klla í gbō ɔ̄ ā ka lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
idu_Latn: Aá dɛ̄gba ogwú yɛ igelī ā jīla tá. Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn cɔ̄nyā ɛɛ́. É kwú ɔdɔ kú igá nēé cē tū ɔ̄ ā ú wúlatāajɛ ɛɛ́. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ ī gwō Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ci. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá gwō ɔ̄ ɔ́ci dúú. Aá yá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn yá ācɛ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gbɛka ā mla ádáádā aá ōfōōfū uwā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ cokónu ā mla aá nēe béeyī eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka anúɔ géē je úkplākā kú oje nyā wu odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā ɔkɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛhɔ̄. É kē í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. N klla í yá ka aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ā kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ opeyī abɔ̄ ŋmá eyīpɔ́lɛ́ ā ga eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú nū. Eko nōó lɛ ahɛ tá tū ɔ̄cɛ ā eyī, Ujísɔ̄si kwu abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A lɔfú má ɔdā dóódu glá āā.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí ádā nū, Ása. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔtā kú nū túce lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ nēe tɛtɛ wɛ ákú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ó mīyɛ uwá kwúcē lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ŋmá Uhámati, gaá bū ɛhícō kú ísu ɔmā ā ɛháajɛ. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ́da mɛ́mla okónu nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ce táajɛ bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ujóna, ɔyí kú Amítāyi, nōo ŋmá Ugatéfa ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ tū gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ó kwú wā klla le gbɛkɔ̄ yɔ̄ i nú ípī fiyúu. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le cɔ̄nū mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
idu_Latn: Aá híī ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ ajɛ Íjīpiti. Ka aá ɔ́ɔ gáā kpɛ́fu abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ámāŋ pó opo kú ɛfú ŋ́. Ka ɛmiyɛ ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔ kē gáā ŋmó aá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē tú ɔ̄cɛ kwu ɔwɛ, ō ŋmá lɛ ō tū ōcē klá anú nōo gē cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú iyē lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
idu_Latn: É jégēdē le Ɔwɔicō jámá oŋmá lɛ ō dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōlé nōo ŋmó uwā unwū ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú odúúdu okwutɛ ā ú kpó mafú lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, é le ɔdā nōo yá ā má, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kwu okwutɛ kú nū ú ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le má ka ɛcɛ le bīya ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ucē obɔ̄bí kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɛɛcɛ kwú uwā í kpó bīya ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ɔdā nyā le yá ā, ācɛ ā bá gē bīyíne kpɔ́. É kpɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ kpɔ́, nááná nɛ̄ ó le aɔ́dā idáagó nɛ̄hi yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē je ɛcɛ yíífi, í je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄. Ó géē je ajɛ kú ɛcɛ bīya kpɔ́gɔ̄kpɔgɔ̄, géē je ācɛ nēe lā anú ā kpó fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, ífi gē yɔ̄ ī yá ŋma éwo éyi ga éwo ɔhá bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī tá kwūūū ŋmá ɔ́kíkā kú ɛcɛ éyi ga ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ gáā je úwé kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú Unebúkádinēsa le tákplá caŋ́jɛ māháyi icō le hídáagó nɛ̄hi. Ó le ɔ̄kā da aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Ó wɛ ācɛ ɛtá nɛ̄ alɔ kpó tá tū ipú ɔlá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ ɛtá gbóó, ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
idu_Latn: Ka amáŋ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce anúɔ klla í yá ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ádā anúɔ, Udéfīdi kóō yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
idu_Latn: Ó í lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū olɛhɔ̄ ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ é nwū ɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄nyā í yá kó ō lɔfu tū ācɛ ɔhá iyē bū ipú ɛlā ɔkwɛyi nɛ̄ ó ge nwū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kó ō ma ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ o táafú ā gwōnū ā fú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
idu_Latn: Ó tayínū abɔ́ɔ iháyí ɛhīlī eko nɛ̄ Atálīya ce ɔcɛ́ kú nū Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu ōhī kē má uwā ímálānyī, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu nēe kē bɔ̄bíipú ā kpó ŋmá ipú úláyi, anɔ́ɔ uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu le túbá kéē hútú. É le yá ká odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī ā kéē cīlɛ̄fú. Anɔ́ɔ é le cɛ̄tū ɔlɛ́ Ujásin kéē dɔɔ̄kā Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó pi wā gé lɛ aígabɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gɔbū kpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú um ahāapa ā, géē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda kú ā gaá lɛ uwá má, ɔ́dáŋ ka é bā í lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicó kú aá nōó je lɛ aá tū klla í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ̄ ipú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nēé bī ugóolu mɛ́mla oje udɔ yá ā, é kwú kpó nyɔ̄. Kwú aócibú nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, mɛ́mla aócíbú obī fú ɔlá ā, kwu aócíbú nēe gē bī oyī kú ɛya nēé gē gwó ā. Kwu aɔ́dā ōle Aágege ce ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla aócíbú kú ɔtulalī, mɛ́mla aócíbú nēé gē bī pīya ejé klá ɛyí ede ā, é kwú kpó nyɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fu kéē wɛ aígbómína kú ɛga igwɛ́ɛpa kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōó kɔ̄ ā. É géē bá í bī ɔdōlé ŋmá ɛga kú uwā wā ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá gē bī ɔdōlé wā ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ɔgbace ɔgbace, ɔyā dóódu.

eng_Latn: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?
idu_Latn: Ujonátan ka ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɔ́ɔ géē lɔhi fíyɛ́ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ā lɛ ɔdōlé nɛ́ɛ kpó, eko nēé yá ācɛ Ufilístiya lé ā lé āa. Ó ka é géē yɛ í lɛ ɔfú lɛ kéē lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya ŋmó fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ŋmó ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú āyā kú okómpīinu ā ge leyīkwu odúúdú aípíinu kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla aíyó nēé gē kpó tū uwā ā á.

eng_Latn: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā nēé ka ā pó ā, ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe lɔfú iyē ā í cɛgbá obócí ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ o doōcē ā cɛgbá obócí á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
idu_Latn: Ó da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, aíkpokwú nēe bá nyā géē yēeyī igbɔhá kpɔ́ glá ɛ́ɛ́? Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ofōōfū uwɔ géē cīla ɔ̄kā ɔ́ɔmā glá á.

eng_Latn: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: É le anɔ̄ tū uwā ɛyí klla le abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí kéē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa nyā lɔfú lɛ ɔyí, nɛ̄ o gē wūwī klla í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, ámāŋ ka ó gē yá odúúmā kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú kú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó, nōo wɛ oōmu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nōo yúklɔ́ o hídáagó ipēeyī nū ā kpó kwú. Úklɔ́ o hídáagó nyā nōó bī le plla ācɛ nēé fukɔ̄ lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gbā ojíbó kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā ɛ̄gbā ā á. É lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú nū tɛ́cɔ̄ oyēeyī tū ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ nōo gē yi mla ɛcōwō ā.

eng_Latn: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, aá klla gáā jikwū ɔhá ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ. Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ikwū je klá anú, kóō tá aá abɔ̄, ó géē tá aá ohi.

eng_Latn: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
idu_Latn: É klla kē tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā, aá gwéeyē mla ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā.

eng_Latn: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cē alelékwū ihɔ ā klá alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo hɛ́ alɔ tá ā.

eng_Latn: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ a cíkā ō ka ā wɛ ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ɛɛ́, alɔ géē yēeyī, alɔ kē í yá ɛ̄nyā, alɔ kē í yá ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, n kwú pīya ɔdā uwēyī ipú ójīla ɛɛ́. Ń klla wɛ ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē da ayí uwā ā ka aá tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bī abɔ̄ olɔfú kú nū lɛ aá kpó bɛ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā ó géē kpó ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, mɛ́mla aálá ɛhīlī nēe lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā, gáā gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla Udéfīdi bá ī kpɛ́fú gɔbū ā, Ábna yɔ̄ í lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, ipú ācɛ nēe ī yɛce Usɔ́ɔlu ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ńŋmóó tá anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi, anɔ́ɔ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á. Úgbéenyi ā le yɛ kpaakpa i tá ɔlíidɔ kú Ukósi. Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū alɔ gāājɛ Uródesi, anɔ́ɔ o ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā alɔ gāājɛ Upátāra.

eng_Latn: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá, nōo he Óndú ā ɔtú nɛ̄hi ā. Udéfīdi lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́, ó klla bīya íne kú Óndú dúúmā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ɔ́bíipú nōó bī tá Uríya ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ n.

eng_Latn: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm bá ī yúufi, ācogbāājɛ kú Umówābu bá ī fīyégbúlú ipu ufi. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ kú Ukénan ā lɛ ja piyontoo ipú ufi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ ahāapa bá ipú alɔ. Ákú aflɛ́yí ā lɛ ɔnyā lɛ, ó gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́ mā ā, ó habɔ̄ ɔnyā nū tá lɛ ɔyínɛ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ayíkpó kú uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Uhérɔ̄du tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ kahíníī, Utíca, alɔ jé ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. A kē ī nwɛ̄lā kú ɔwɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi. Á kē lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī gbɛlá ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka á kē ī méyīgo kú ācɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
idu_Latn: N le yɛ gaajɛ, jāā ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɛfu abɔ̄yī nū gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ā, ga ajɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ kú nū le gwū eko dóódu ā Amáŋ, awɔ, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a lɛ um bī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɔ́ɔmā wɛ̄ɛcɛ oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá ā bɛ́ɛ? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá ka n wɛ ā? Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
idu_Latn: Adá, ɔnyā aflɛ́yí kú Ísɔ ā ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi nōo lé ka Ɛlífāasi lɛ Ísɔ.
