eng_Latn: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóram le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū kpó ga Usɛ́ru ɛga nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́dɔm cē ibɔm tū uwā ā. Amáŋ otú ā, anú mɛ́mla úgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū le ɛga éyi má pēēleē, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pɛ́ kwu á, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwú fíyákátā le pɛ́ kwu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ ā géē bī omlede kú ɛya kú ɛpɔ̄bí gé lɛ um okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā kú ɛya ōgwó kú ine o bīya mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé kú nū.

eng_Latn: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya wɛ iháyí ahātá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cigwóléyi.

eng_Latn: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubatisséba tá ɔ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, anúɔ géē kɛlā lɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
idu_Latn: N tóohɛ́wa, aá kē lɛ īlī tū um ohí. N yɔ̄ gē doōcē, aá wā gaá má um. N yɔ̄ agbá, anɔ́ɔ aá wā ɛgiyí um gaá jila um á.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛmiyɛ klla yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū ka, Usɔ́lu lɛ ɔkpá ce uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā kóō lɛ okónu bá ɔdōlé dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ci gwō aólɛlā kú anúɔ. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lé ɔdōlé ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi: Uhassábīya, ɔyí kú Ukémūwɛlu. ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄n: Usádɔ̄ki, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na onyinyi gányá gányá ahāapa ā mɛ́mla ɛyí kú igwu ahāapa nēé cɛyí ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ owu kú ipú ígbíli je ɔ́ pīya igbóngbō ā wɛ iháyí ahāapa kú ɔkpɛtā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Odúúdú aá géē pɛ́kwu hī um tá, ohígbū kéē tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ́ tá táajɛ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, Ɔwɔicō géē je ogbāalá ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ aálá kú nū kē í fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ācɛ igwó nɛ̄ n hɛ́tá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Iní nɛ̄ ācɛ ahāanɛ ohile ā bá ā?.

eng_Latn: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔdā ɔhá nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ cíkā ō tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá. Eko nɛ̄ alɔ wā í da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ alɔ ka ālɔ̄ ka lɛ aá ā, aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ da aá ā pó, anɔ́ɔ aá ke cɛ̄ɛla ā bɛ̄ɛka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo kē wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā. Ɔwɔicō kē bī ɛlā ā yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ ipú aá nēe cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
idu_Latn: Aíta nɛ̄ aá ī kwu ā wɛ áncā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ewo ā. Ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá ī ka ā í hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ aá glá ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú kú ɔmɛ í gbō ɔ̄cɛ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ālɔ̄ habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá lɛ ā, ācɛ dóódu géē lɔtūcɛ̄ ɛlā nū, ó lɛ ā, ācɛ Uróm géē wā gaá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mla ɔpu kú alɔ ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki le Ébrahām hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ā yá alɔ yɔ̄ āa? Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ n yá uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ā bī ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā wā gé um mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um ā a? Ɔdā nɛ̄ ā yá um ā í cíkā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ɔ́mpānū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
idu_Latn: Kwu ācɛ mla ɛbɛ́ dúúmā í gáā bū ipú nū ŋ́. Iháyí ofɛpa, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā lā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o bīyíne ń jé nóo. Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ n jé ā wɛ ka n tɛtɛ peyī, abālɔbányā n gē mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.
idu_Latn: Anú ā klla bɔ̄bíipú tū Óndú ā fíyɛ́ ódúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ nēe gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
idu_Latn: Lɛ iyē kú uwā nya ŋmá ipú ɔkpá kú oyēeyī. Ā tá iyē kú uwā tū ipú ɔkpá nāa tá iyē kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tū ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
idu_Latn: A kpó ayí nēe lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā lɛ uwá. A cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mīyɛ ajɛ alɛwa nāa cokónu nū ō je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ é klla má lā ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le tútū ɛ̄cī ɔmɛɛtá ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā n géē wāajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ā lɔfú má um glá.

eng_Latn: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá kwú pɛ́ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Uwá mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí Ulífāyi, aólɔdu, mɛ́mla aólɛhá, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú ajɛ ā bá iyɔ̄bū odúúdú uwā abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ le odúúdú ɔkpá kú íne nēé pīyɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá gbōmgbōm abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyīlɔ ɛpa ā má cīce le ɔdōlé lé tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ádā odiyɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kéē klla lɛ gbo abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú īyī uwā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ cāā lɛ ayíkpó kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ Upíta lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ayíkpó ohile ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛ̄gba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔdā ō jé he ɔ́ ɔtū, gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē da ɔ́ ɛga nɛ̄ ó nyíleyī ā. Olíla ōfōōfūnū gē tá kéē nā anúɔ tá ɔwɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá uwɔ ahínyá nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
idu_Latn: Ā ga ɛga nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ā kē híī gbla ucē kú ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔcɛ́ ā kwú ajɛ dúúmā ú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄, ajɛ ā klla í je pīya ákú ɔcɛ́ ā kpɔ́, eko nɛ̄ iháyí kú ohīla kú ajɛ ā gā ā. Ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ayí nū ā nɛ̄ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā géē wɛ ákú uwá piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
idu_Latn: Ussíya ŋmá Asstārɔ̄ti, Usámma mɛ́mla Ujɛ́yɛlu, ayí kú Uhótam, ŋmá Árōwɛ.

eng_Latn: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Uréhābu, nōo wɛ akwuna ā, í kwú mla ācɛ nēe lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó mīyɛ ācɛ nēé tū kéē gaá jila ajɛ uwūūwī ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujóra wɛ ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē yúklɔ́ tayínū ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó dɔɔ̄kā kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ ī yá ā jé. Abɔ̄ nāa yɔ̄ ī yá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, lɛ iyī uwɔ mafú lɛ ācɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwɔ jé. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔdā nēe bá ā yá, lɛ iyī uwɔ mafú lɛ alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
idu_Latn: Ɛtɛ́ ɛhīlī nēé bī ɛcɔ̄ yá bá abɔ́ɔ ohígbū ka uwá nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu gē bī le yá uculo kú iyē o gwu ācɛ anú á.

eng_Latn: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
idu_Latn: Aflɛ́yí ā, é géē kpó ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā ŋmá anú gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ajɛ ā kóō le mlɛ́nyɔ́ dúúdú. É géē yá uwā italā ohígbū keé tá íne nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ō ka fíyɛ́ ā, N kwú íne nɛ̄ a bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi, kɛ̄ɛ ka, Cāŋjɛ ká a yāwu.

eng_Latn: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni gbaáluka ipɔ́ɔma kú Umɛrári ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń da aá, nēe ī pó ɛlā kú um ā ka aá yíhɔtū tá aólɛlā kú aá. Aá yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe ī wɔ́tū aá.

eng_Latn: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
idu_Latn: É géē pá ɛbɛ́ ā otú ɔ́ɔmā klla í je ɔ́ lé mla ēpū ohɔ́ɔnɔ mla igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um ka, āmíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ā lɛ ā tá tū ɔkpá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē wɛ ijáalí tá ajɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́! Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kéē le uwá cīgbīhi cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pīyabɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka é yɔ̄ ī je Ɔyínɔ̄yīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nyɔ́kpá igbɔhá kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó uwē tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ipéyī ójila igbɔɔ́mpa kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɔ́ yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Usiríya ipú iháyí ɛtá ce īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla ka tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, N da aá ka Ujɔ́ni cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā nōo wā ipú ɛcɛ nya ɛ́ɛ́ má. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā nwuné fíyɛ́ Ujɔ́ni á.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
idu_Latn: Akanyā dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé bá ī móōwē gɛ ŋ́. Ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfūtāli ipú Ugálīli nēé tɛtɛ je uwēyī le uwá ā, géē je pīya ajɛ nēé ī lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ́. Ajɛ ā tá okónu ísu kú Umeditarénīya, lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā ga āyā ɔhá kú Ujɔ́dan á. É hī ɔ̄ ka Ugálílii, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ éwɔhá lā ā.

eng_Latn: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a yɔ̄ āhɔ̄ kú um ā nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í lɔfú kɛlā lɛ ā lɛyíkwu uwɔ dúú nɛ. Ń géē yɛ í lɔfú jíla ɛyí iyē lɛyíkwu uwɔ, klla kɛlā láyíí klá uwɔ ɛyí dúú nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
idu_Latn: Ujáyɛ̄lu wā í jīla Usisɛ́ra ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka, Ɔkpani, le bēhé wā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú um, ā híī yúúfi ŋ́ á. Ó le bēhé ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū igbīhi ukɔ́tin kú ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
idu_Latn: Úmósīsi le igá cē tū Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ede tá biílí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ukɔ́tin ā ú playi icō kú okómpinu kú igá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú odúúdú úklɔ́ ā í yá mɛ á.

eng_Latn: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔtū, kú um jé ɔdā nōo ī yá ipú ɛcɛ ā, N le má ka ɔ̄cɛ gē yēeyī otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī leyīkwu ɛcɛ cɔ́ɔ́ ohígbū ɛnya ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwā ā wɛ, Uhelíkāti, Uháli, Ubɛ́tɛn, Ácisāfu.

eng_Latn: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā le tá igelī nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tāni ā, gaá gbɔga abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ása le ugóolu , oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka.

eng_Latn: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
idu_Latn: Ōwē nɛ̄ ó má abɔ́ɔ ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ īyī nū túwāajɛ, Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū, klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,
idu_Latn: É klla lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujéssuwa, Umólāda, Ubɛtipɛ́lēti.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ í gē nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔkpani nū ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ nēe tɛ̄hɔ̄ í kē gē nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́ m.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N gaá je ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá nyā tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí Ébrahām ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ ɛlā nyā tá tāajɛ, ohígbū ka o ŋmá ɛlā nēe bá nyā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɛka lɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Urécɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī mā owu ā, ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔyí ā ka Ubɛnóni Amáŋ, ádā nū hī iyē kú nū ka Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē bī īlī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ le gɔ́ bá ɛga o híla kú īlī nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka īlī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā í wutū í je īlī nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā híla cɛ́ɛ́ ó le ɔ̄gɔ̄ o lɔwá fíyɛ́ hɛ́ tá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ le tá ɛgiyí Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ébrahām, gaá le ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū, Umahálati, nōo wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Unɛ́báyɔ̄tu lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá ce aɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo gē bī ikpáti ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ, Ahíja, ɔyí kú Íkābɔdu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ahítūbu, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ufínīhasi ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ɛ́lāyi, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā Ussílo ā. Ācɛ í jé ka Ujonátan ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ú ca behé, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn le íbɔm cē tū igelī nɛ̄hi āa. Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm bá ī pɛ́ kwu otú ɔ́ɔmā. É kwu bū ɔwɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɔ́ɔ́cɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ɛpa lɛyíkwu ɔhá ā. É kwu lɛyíkwu ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ahínyá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔhi, ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛɛcɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū kē tá ohɛ́ɛwa, amáŋ é kē yúwēyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ kú aógbɛhá. Ó klla ī nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó uwā gáā kpó uwā ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kɛlā lɛ Ujerúsālɛm gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī, N géē yá uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā gā uwɔ ā, ohígbū ka a kwú mlanyī okónu oōce kú um, klla lɛ ɔ́ bīya.

eng_Latn: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu klla ka ipú ɔkpá ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ācɛ ogbāajɛ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí, kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá, ká aá le tútū ō yá ɔdā olɔhi ɔwɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, ń kē gáā yúufi gɛ ŋ́. N géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cokónu nū gā um ā. Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ áncā yá um glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā kɛlā mla aá ligbó gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā gē wā ɛɛ́. Ó kē lɛ ɔfú dúúmā ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi géē kpó ɔlɛ́ nū dúúdú, eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicó í cɔ̄nū géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
idu_Latn: ɛga nɛ̄ Ubálāki ŋmó ɛna mɛ́mla álá lɛ Ubálam mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ōhī nēe bá mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
idu_Latn: Ussáálubim, Áyijālɔn, Ítīla.

eng_Latn: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, abɔ̄ é le ucɛ lé, klla le odée gwá Ussílo ā, Uhána cāŋjɛ. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ɛ́lāyi cīce okómpíinu kú Agblīihɔ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi kú nū ā géē klá igelī ā ŋmá idɔlá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Ɛgahi ā klla í je igelī ā pīya ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í lā ɛbɔ́. Ó géē wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē kwu tayínū nɛ̄ ɔwɔ mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi í gáā je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ujerúsālɛm í lɛ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tū um uwēyī ká alɔ cɛ̄ ka alɔ í lɔtū yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́. N gáā yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwō kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá gē bī le gwō ā.

eng_Latn: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ Amásīya kpó nū ga ɔlɛ́ ā le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛfú kpó tá aígelī kú Ujúda nēe bá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usamérīya mɛ́mla Ubɛti Uhórɔn ā. É le ācɛ kú Ujúda úlā ahāapa ce ofu igwó kpó ŋmó klla kwú iyó kú uwá ú kpó wu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nōo gē wɔ́tū uwɔ ā, uwēyī géē kwú uwá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ abɔ̄. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē nuunu tú uwɔ ā, géē pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um dúú, n klá yɔ̄ ī yúufi nɛ̄hi. N hímáyī gbēyī ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kóō yá, amáŋ ó klla le pīya ɔdā otūufi nɛ̄hi ga um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔkɔnyɔ̄ má ɔnyā ɔhá dúúmā, nōó le ɔkɔ nū hɛ́, le ikpó nū ce ipɔ́tū kú nū dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ̄tra Óndú. Usáyɔn, cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
idu_Latn: Óndú nwū um ɔwɛ kú uwɔ, lɛ ɔwɛ kú uwɔ mafú gā um.

eng_Latn: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
idu_Latn: Nááná, awɔ Óndú ā bī um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um má. Awɔ húmáyī leyīkwu um ŋmá obene kú um má.

eng_Latn: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī má aɛ́fu, é kē bá ī jíliyē. Aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kē bá ī túwɔɔ́ɔ́ yɛɛ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ éyi ga abɔ̄ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwú ayí Ulífāyi ā ú fu céé kéē gwɛ́ɛya ojíliyē nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā gā um. Ká ā kwú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ú kéē leyīkwu ayí Ulífāyi ā.

eng_Latn: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage.
idu_Latn: É kwú ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ú kpó lá lɛ ikwū ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé kwú alɔ ú kpó lá kú ɔfiyɛ nɛɛ, ń gáā lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē je unwalu lɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ é gáā je alɔ kpó ŋmó dúúdú ɛɛ́. É klla géē je alɔ kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwolímanya í límanya gē hɛ́ ɔkpáncō igbó ī fíyajɛ gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ tá péee ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ péee eko nōó géē wā ā á.

eng_Latn: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
idu_Latn: Ohóō yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́ nēe bá gē miya ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā! Ācɛ nēe gē nyɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nēé miya otú ā eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā bōōbū ohígbū ka ɔfú yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka Óndú ā da ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Aéwɔhá ā géē tú ɔdɔ kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā gwó. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwá ā kē í wā í gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā. N le cɔ̄nū tū uwɔ, le italā yá uwɔ, amáŋ abālɔbányā, n géē méyīnyinyi uwɔ ohígbū ka n gbonɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū géē je éyi wā. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa bá gē nyɔ̄ tɔ̄há gɔbū á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔ̄ glá, ohígbū ka anúɔ géē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄. Ó klla da ɔ́ kóō géē yá ācɛ Umídiya lé bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛdɔm tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā cɛ̄ kú aá bū ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá jé ɔ̄ má, alɔ géē bɛ̄cɛ í nuunu tá aá.

eng_Latn: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ í mímálānyī kú ācɛ nēe ī gɔ̄ ā, eko nɛ̄ n má ka ó yɔ̄ ī lɔhi lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
idu_Latn: Aá géē mōowē kú íne nēé bīya ā iháyí ofɛpa. Iháyí éyi kwɛyí ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɛ̄cī ofɛpa nɛ̄ aá bī le jila ajɛ ā. Aá í jé ícɔ̄nū kú um eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
idu_Latn: É tɛtɛ le ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā nwū ɔ̄, ó bī ɔtūcaaca le tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō klla kē nwū ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si. Amáŋ ubatísim kú Ujɔ́ni ōfōōfūnū nōó jé á.

eng_Latn: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē hī um ka, Óndú, Óndú ā, géē ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ádā um, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, tíne ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā húmáyī cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá uwá ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá nyā, le hɛ́ ācɛ idáagó. Ó klla le tū uwā ufi. Aá bī īkpēyī abɔ̄yī aá le odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá ā má lɔɔlɔhi dúú.

eng_Latn: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ā klla yɛ ga ɔpɛ́ kú ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ga Atárɔ̄tu-áda, gaá bū ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛ́ti Uhórɔn.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ó gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á. É lɛ ɔ́ iyē gwā, kwú ɔ̄ ú ga inīcō.

eng_Latn: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá le jé ka Ɔwɔicō géē gbā ulé nōó le tū gbēyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā lɛ aá, ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ Óndú aá nɛ̄ aá gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē bá ī tá alɔ abɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū alɔ ā. Ācɛ alɛwa gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū alɔ, Ɔwɔicō géē po ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce alɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ alɛwa géē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá kú ɔhā nōo hɛ́ ce alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā kahíníī, Eyī yá um ká ā wā í mú um ɔtū klla ā lɛ okónu kwu um okónu, ohígbū ka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ ā, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ejé ī je lɛ ācɛ nōo ī gwá ā.

eng_Latn: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
idu_Latn: Nwū um íjééyī, ká n̄ jɛ́yí ɛlā, ohígbū ka n kpɔ́tūce íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, é gáā nyi okwú éyi, é le ígwu éyi kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā má, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā kwú okwū nēé gáā nyi ā ú tá ga ipú únóji kú Ɛláyíssa, anɔ́ɔ é le kwu á. Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ okwū ɔ́ɔmā gaá kwú iyē ú kwu ikpokwú kú Ɛláyíssa ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú ā le héyī klla cāŋjɛ háyi ikpó abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā ohígbū um, ohígbū ka akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ nyā jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. N géē cɛ̄ kú aá nyɔ̄. N gáā kwú aá klá ajɛ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
idu_Latn: Ubúni, Asigādi Ubébāyi.

eng_Latn: If a bird's nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree, or on the ground, whether they be young ones, or eggs, and the dam sitting upon the young, or upon the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔlɛ́ kú ígbáanɔ má, nɛ̄ ígbáanɔ ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔtū klá ayí kú nū, ámāŋ ó lɛ ayí hɛ́ tū ɔɔ̄, lɛ ɔtū klá anú, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī kwú ɛ́nɛ́ ígbáanɔ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
idu_Latn: Olila nɛ̄ ó gē gbɛlá lipú ŋ́ mā, ōfōōfūnū gē da iyī nū kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ ŋ́ má Ucē ká ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā í lɔhi ŋ́. É klla í yá ɛdɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya tɛ̄hɔ̄ le ɛlā ā ka gbōmgbōm okónu Uhíbru, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe ce ɛyí ɔdɔ bá ī jāhɔ̄ ā kéē pó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kú uwā kóō gbenyi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Asírīya kóō géē mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā fíyaa.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá ka, ŋmá abālɔbányā ń gáā gwá ejé kú īkpɔ̄cí ufáyin nyā gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē gwá ɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla aá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ádā um ā.

eng_Latn: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nēé bū wā pií ā, nēé gáā bū kwúcē ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm á. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, é gáā lɛ ɔnyā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē je ɔnyā lɛ ɔbá gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ é géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā kú ahínyá kú um nɛ̄ n tá aá ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá je ga um ā. Ɛhi ā kōō le nwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ n cɛgbá ā! N lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā lɛ ɛɛ́, abālɔbányā nɛ̄ Epafrodítɔ̄si lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ aá le tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fu um ā kpó gā um ā. Aɔ́dā ɛhi ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú ɔdā okpóocu nēé gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, nōó mīyɛ, nōo kē he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
idu_Latn: Kóo lɛ odó ce anúɔ ikpó, klla yɔ̄ ī gbō ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ gē yá ā gɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɛce Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ga Ujerúsālɛm bá ī tɔ́ɔga, bá ī tá opo nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, bá ī gwō anwa kú oje mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ wōō á.

eng_Latn: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
idu_Latn: É géē nwū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú uwɔ ā. É kē í lɛ ɔtulalī gwɛ́ɛya gā uwɔ ɛyí ede kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
idu_Latn: Ā híī mímálānyī kú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ obɔ̄bí gē lɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē yá oklóbīya mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔ́nɔ́ngblɔ kú oje udɔ ɛpa ma. Olīkpō kú ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kú uwā wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē je kpó pīya ce ɛyí aúpíla ɛpa kú aflɛ́yí nōó ma ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú ubatísim nēé yá aá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Ubatísim nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni gē yá ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛlā nōó ka ā.

eng_Latn: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī gbō um gɛɛ ā? Ń kē wɛ ísu nɛ̄hi amáŋ ka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipú ísu nɛ̄hi ā ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē gbō um gɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, óŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ́ɛ le aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umídiya, Órēbu mɛ́mla Usíibu kpó ŋmó. Ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá nōo fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā? Eko nōó le ohi tá uwā lɛ ā ā, é klla cɔ̄nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cí éyi, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni ɛhíícō kú Ubiyɛssɛ́ba nēe bá ɛháajɛ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ulífāyi ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā le jīla tɔ̄há iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā Umíspa.

eng_Latn: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ ā klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Kɛ̄ɛ ka, aá gē da um ka, aá gē lɔtūce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Ó wɛ aíkpɛ́cí mɛ́mla aéde kú nū nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya je kpó ca tāajɛ, yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm kéē pɛ́ ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
idu_Latn: É le aúpíla ā kpó kwaajɛ okómpíinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Éyi kwu ɛháajɛ, ɔhá ā kē kwu ɛhícō. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kwu ɛháajɛ ā, ó hī ɔ̄ ka, Ujakín, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kwu ɛhícō ā, ó hī ɔ̄ ka, Ubówāsi.

eng_Latn: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
idu_Latn: Áwa ékpó ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, ogbō-alagbá ā le uwá kpó, le uwá ágbe na. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ubatísim yá anú mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, alɔ nēe yēeyī ā, géē tá Óndú ahínyá, o ŋmá eko nyā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ayí kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó cíkā nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ íkpékwūja kú ugóolu ámāŋ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ gbɛlá nū klla bī abɔ̄ kú uwā le yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā alɔ gē tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ dóódu ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá, gē bī ɛlā íjééyī dóódu nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ alɔ ā le pi uwá ahɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ŋ́, kla gē nwū uwā ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá, o yá kéē wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō glá, nɛ̄ íjéeyī dúúmā í gáā kpla uwá ɛhá ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe le yá ijímkpa ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛplá iháyí úlā ce ofɛpa cigwó. Ó je aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ uwá jāā gbéeko kú Usámūwɛ̄lu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka anúɔ géē je iyē kú aɛ́cí ā ŋmónyí ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā dúúdú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā blakwu uwá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo je iyī nū ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄ alelékwū ōbɔ̄bí ɛhɔ̄ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná ā, ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā le pahīla bá gē yɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔkōolɔhi.

eng_Latn: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛlā kpó ce aá, ɔcɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo í kɔɔkɔ lɛ aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ágbe kú aá í kē lɛ ɛcí ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo í nya aá tá dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukénan kwú odúúdú ije kú uwā ú lá ɔdōlé ŋmá ajɛ ā, ācɛ kú Íjīpiti gā ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ije kú alɔ mɛ ɛɛ́. Je ɔdōlé lɛ alɔ! Ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ kwú ɛmiyɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ó gáā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo íkée mla aádáádā uwā, eko nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ tū uwā abɔ̄ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ŋ́. Náāná nɛ̄ n lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔbá uwā ā, é kē le ɛka ɔ́ɔmā tá nyílá.

eng_Latn: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le gwō ajɛ Ujɛ́busi tá gɔbū. Ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī ga ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé wā ajɛ Ugíbɛ̄ya, ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, n wā gaá yá ɔtū kú uwɔ nɛ̄ n. Ó le odúúdú ɛya nēé ī gwó nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā ŋmónyí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛya kú Ujísɔ̄si ā í kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
idu_Latn: N géē cēyītīkwū ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, ohígbū ka awɔ ī yá ká n̄ jɛ́ɛyí íne kú uwɔ fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔ́ pīya ɔ́kplá kú um anú klla í lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā ā, kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di, kɛ̄ɛ kā n̄ híī nyɔ̄ ŋ́? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō géē cɛ̄ gā awɔ yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí gē gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ó kwú eyī ú tónū ɛɛ́, ó kē gaá má ɔdā nɛ̄ um yá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē je Umówābu pīya ocíbú ō le na abɔ̄, n klla í tá áblákpá kú um fíyɛ́ Ɛ́dɔm, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé ka amiɔɔ ɔ̄ Óndú kú nū á. N géē gbogwú ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufilístiya, kóō mafú ka n le uwá yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
idu_Latn: Éwo dúúmā nōó gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, géē je yíifi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá kú ɛbɛ́ nōó lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā iyē ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ Óndú ā í mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá ā le kpó wā í kpó tū ɛga ō kpó agbénú kú oōgwó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū ā, ipú abɔ̄ kú Ujɛ́hīyɛlu, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ugɛ́ssɔn, nōo gē leyīkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú aɔ́dā nēé nwū nēe bá nyā, n cɛ̄tra aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ojīleyī kú aá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā gē bī ɔbɔ̄bí wɛ̄ɛcɛ fíyɛ́ olɔhi.

eng_Latn: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá ī ka alakpɔ̄ tū uwā ā kahíníī, Ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwú.

eng_Latn: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Áhābu wā gaá yɛ ā, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā le ɛgba dɛ̄ hī ɔcɛ́ ā igwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka Ágábáidu, anúɔ nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ ícɔ́ɔ́ja éyi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé kwú ɔgbɛ́fú ā bī wā anɔ́ɔ ó da anúɔ ka anúɔ leyīkwu ɔ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ anúɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā le kwu ɔwɛ dúúmā, oyēeyī kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ géē kwɛyí oyēeyī kú nū, ámāŋ anúɔ géē gbā íne kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ahāapa cofu igwó lɛ anúɔ ɔ́dāŋ koó le kwu.

eng_Latn: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēé ma ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá nēé kpó uwā nyɔ̄ abɔ̄fú ā, géē da aá ɛ̄cī éyi kahíníī, Ajɛ nyā le nyɛ́ lɛ alɔ, alɔ cɛgbá ɛga onwuné fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
idu_Latn: Gbō um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē gbō īkpēyí kú īyī uwɔ ā. Kwú um ú tayínū ɛga nɛ̄ abɔ̄ í gáā kwu um glá ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ugwū gē kpó ayí nū bá ipú acá kú nū gē lɛ ɔtū klá uwá báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
idu_Latn: A géē kpó ɔdōwiyē kú Árɔ̄ni ā lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū eko nɛ̄ó gēkwú. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ wiiye eko nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Igbō ɛmulá nɛ̄ aá lɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Ahāapa mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe lɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwā piíí ɔ́ɔmā, nēé géē bī le ŋmó uwā á. É klla í kpó ɔtā kú uwā cē kwaákwaá bónū ŋmá uwá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka éwo dúúmā lɛ ɔbíipí bī, nēé yɛce um kpaakpa ŋ́, n géē na abɔ̄ kú um daa gáā je ɔdōlé kú uwá kpó yíífi. N géē tū ɔkpɛtā klla uwá klla í je ācɛ ā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ dóódu ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
idu_Latn: A híī lɛ ɔnyā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē ma ayí dúúmā ɛga ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
idu_Latn: Opī éyi kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayí uwɔ ɛpa, Uhófīni mɛ́mla Ufínēhasi ā gekwú ɛ̄cī ékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō mafú gā uwɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka ga uwɔ nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā gáā ma ɔyí, ó gē jé ɔnɔ ohígbū ka eko nōó gē jɔ́ɔnɔ ā gā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔyí ma, ó klla blakwu ɔnɔ kú nū gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū éeyē kú ɔyí nɛ̄ ó ma wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā nɛ̄ ɔ́bíipú kú uwɔ gēe yá ɔ̄ odée glá ā. Ámāŋ nɛ̄ okpaakpa kú uwɔ tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ glá á.

eng_Latn: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le bēhé ísu ā oyá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpó bēhé. É kē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ dɔɔ̄kā kéē yá ā. Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, yɔ̄ ī tútū kóō bēhé ísu ā, Ussímēyi, ɔyí kú Ugɛ́ra gaá wúla klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
idu_Latn: Aá le ŋmótá ipú ɔtū kú aá ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe gē pā aɔ́cí mɛ́mla aɛ́cɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā í gáā yá glá gbógbóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō úmlá kú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ aá nōo bá alɔ ikpó ā, alɔ lɛ ɔ́ gwōbónū kóō ce ijáalí tū aá. Amáŋ aá le jé ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō má kwu aá ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́ba ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Ujáflɛ̄ti, Ussóma mɛ́mla Uhótam, mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nya éyi, nɛ̄ iyē nū wɛ Ussúwa.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD's.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛ̄nyā yɔlá ɛyí ede ā kóō wɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ocu kú nū gē he Óndú ā ɔtū. Ódúúdú ijē ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛpa mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɛ̄ yɛ jīla uwá tá ā yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ā dúú. Aōhī kú aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛpa ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ukáta, Unáhalu, Ussímīrɔn, Udála mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m.

eng_Latn: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu í cɛgbá tū um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gē kpó ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú yíífi ɔwɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Íssbɔ̄ssɛti, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu, le pó keé lɛ Ábna ŋmó Uhɛ́brɔn ā. Ɔtū kú nū kwú gbenyi. Ufi nɛ̄hi kē gbɔɔ́ ō yá odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ Íjīpiti nōó gē tá abɔ̄ glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, kwu ɔcɛ́ kwu ofulajɛ, aólɔdu kwu aólɛhá, kwu ācɛ dúu nēe ce ɛgbá a, í tá abɔ̄ glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, even all the spoil thereof, shalt thou take unto thyself; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú kpó anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, aɔ́dāajɛ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā glá. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū mla aɔ́dā nēe wɛ ákú aólɛlā kú uwā glá ohígbū ka Óndú ā le uwá kpó lɛ uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
idu_Latn: N jé ɔ̄cōbɔ̄bíipú éyi nōo lɔfú ikpó nɛ̄hi. Ó le fíyɛ́ ācɛ dóódu abɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usɛ́da gē jɛ̄ fíyɛ́ aɔ́cí ɔhā dóódu ipú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, Abɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin fíyɛ́ aɔ́cí ɔhá lɛ āa? Olɔhi nyá abɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin lɛ ɔ́dāŋ nāa lɛ ɔ́ gbla abɔ̄ kú ɔ́cí ɔhá ipú kú ūpū ā.

eng_Latn: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɔ̄ku létɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō lɔɔlɔhi, anɔ́ɔ ó gebítāajɛ á, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í le tiiti ō yá okónu nōó ce ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī gē gbɛlá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó kē ī lɔtū ɛgiyí aá ohígbū kóō tíne kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō le yíífi ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē tíne ka odúúdú uwā kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli ā, é kpó Ukédessi kú Ugálīli, Uhámɔn mɛ́mla Ukɛriyatéyim lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Íssmɛ̄lu nɛ̄ Uhága, ɔ̄cɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ma le Ébrahām ā, yɔ̄ ī hiijā mɛ́mla mla Áyísīki ɔyí kú Usára.

eng_Latn: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
idu_Latn: é klla bī aɔ́bá ɛna úlā ce ofu igwó , mɛ́mla aálá úlā ahāapa ce ofigwó wā í le yá ofídākā lɛ ācɛ ā kéē lé.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
idu_Latn: Otū piíí ɔ́ɔmā, alelékwū ɔtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā le tá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Asírīya bá ádɛ́fú kú uwā ā, gaá le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛtá cɛ̄hɔ̄, ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó. Ɔŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, é má okwū bá ajɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī pīya tū ipú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kē tīile ō cē klá ɛyétutulu ŋ́. Ācɛ í cē ɔ̄ bónū icííci. Aá jāhɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ahɔ̄ ō bī pó ɛlā.

eng_Latn: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā wɛ úlā ofu ɛpa ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce ofu igwɛ́ɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛtá .

eng_Latn: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
idu_Latn: Ujehóhānan nōo kpó okónu ce ɔ́ ā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ gē yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ mɛ́ɛlɛ́ ɛgiyí uwɔ glá, n kē kpɔ́tūce odée ŋmá ipú ɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā cāŋjɛ otú klla le da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, N géē da aá ɔdā nɛ́ ācɛ kú Usiríya yá ā. Abɔ̄ é le jé ka ɛmiyɛ ɔ́ɔ gē ŋmó alɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é je pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwá gaá tayínū ipácí á. É gbɛlá kahíníī, Eko dúúmā nēé kwú bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ lɛ uwá kwú oyēeyī klla mīyɛ igelī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn , ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ Uhánɔ̄ku, mɛ́mla Upálu.

eng_Latn: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ í tíne ká n̄ má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lɔfú hɛ́ ɔdɔ, nōo géē māháyi ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ je wúla wā ajɛ ā, nōo géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ajɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ ɔnū mla íwɔ́tū kú um gáā je ajɛ ā yíífi. Amáŋ ń má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
idu_Latn: Aá le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɛna nɔ̄wá nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó yúklɔ́ jéjéje ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, bī gé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
idu_Latn: Aá habɔ̄ uwā tá kéē jɛ tɔ̄há jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n géē ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄. Eko o cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā n géē da ācɛ ocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kéē lɛ ácí ā ŋmó gbɔbū kéē lɛ uwá gbō ɛ̄wɛ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá tɔ̄lá kéē le yi ɔlá. Amáŋ kéē lɛ ikpɔ̄dā ā cē tū ɔbā kú ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔyí ā kwú abɔ̄ ā ú pi ga ipú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɛ́ nū gā ɛcɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyōkɔ́ma ā kahíníī, Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tū wɛ̄ɛcɛ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó hi iyē kú nū lé ka, Upéresi.

eng_Latn: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ Utiyófīlɔs, ipú ɔkpá aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ n tá ā, n lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úklɔ́ dóódu nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó nwū ŋmá eko nɛ̄ ó gbo úklɔ́ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yá lɔhi íbí, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ cíkā ō lɔtūce. A lɛyítáajɛ ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, n géē je uwɔ ú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo í leyīkwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi. Wā í gwéeyē mɛ́mla um.

eng_Latn: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ ā, ami nōó mīyɛ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōó tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá, ami nōó tá á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo kē tá um, Ɔwɔicō nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nōó tá á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n húmáyī kɛlā nū, eko nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka, Eko géē wā nɛ̄ n géē bī ɔ̄cɛ éyi wā í kpɛ́fú tá Ísrɛ̄lu. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄ ká um nyi okwū kú ɔnyā um amānyā, ayíka aá le da Éfrɔn, ɔyí kú Usóha.

eng_Latn: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
idu_Latn: Ijáalí nēé cɛ̄ ā yɔ̄ á, Ɔwɔicō kwú oyēeyī nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā ú lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́, oyēeyī nyā kē tɛ́ɛgba ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Be merciful, O LORD, unto thy people Israel, whom thou hast redeemed, and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel's charge. And the blood shall be forgiven them.
idu_Latn: É í da Óndú ā kóō kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu, nōó kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, yá ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Kóō kwú yá aá ɛhi, kóō híī bī ikwū kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó icííci ā bá uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ ŋmá okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛga éyi gwó nɛ̄ alɔ géē lā. Anɔ́ɔ. Ɛláyíssa da uwá ka Aá nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gā ā, é le má ka é lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá tɔ̄lá, é klla lɛ ācɛnyā kú uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā kpó ŋmá ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá īyī nū yēŋēē mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú oōyá yēŋēē ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́maahāapa, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmá ɔcī nū, Óndú ā lɛ yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ā. Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā le pɛ́ gekwú. Amáŋ, ɛbɛ́ ékpónú kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā í kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
idu_Latn: Óndú ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ nēe pahīla bá ɛga o ligbó gwū ísu kú Itiyópīya tá ā, géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā gé lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā í tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ŋ́. A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n líla lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa ā. Ohígbū ka aá gē ma aúnóji kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú eko nɛ̄ncɛ̄ āa. Aá klla gē yá únóji kú ācɛ okpaakpa ā ifa.

eng_Latn: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
idu_Latn: Ó le bēé ga ipú inu, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá í wu iyī aá ɔtū klíicō ī jikwū ā? Ɔyí ā í kwú ŋ́, ó yɔ̄ ī gbyɔ̄lā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí lɔhi lɛ anyā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ íbí. Uwá nēe gē bá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ gē pó ɛlā kú íjééyī kú uwɔ nyā eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
idu_Latn: gē ba ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōlɔhi nyā yá lɛ aá ŋmá ō lɛ Upɔ́lu tū wā Ujerúsālɛm. É kē le miya ka aá géē ŋmó ɔ́ ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
idu_Latn: É tá kéē lɛyítáajɛ gā awɔ É kwú mlanyī odúúdú úklɔ́ idáagó nāa yá lɛ uwá ā. Ipú ɔbɔ́cɛ kú uwá ā, é lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú abɔ̄yī uwā éyi fu, kóō lɛ uwá kpó kwúcē ga Íjīpiti, ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ nāa kpó uwā ŋmá ā. Amáŋ a wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je odōbɔ̄bí yá ācɛ ɛhi. A klla gē yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. A gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi, á klla gē cɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́. A wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē méyīnyinyi ācɛ nɛ̄hi. Á kē cīgbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ bá ɔpɛ́ kú Ɛlā, bá ī nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó okwū klá ɛyí aɛ́fu ā bɛɛ́ɛ̄, okwū kú odúúdú ācɛ nēé gē ŋmó ɛfú ā kē géē bá aɛ́fu nɛŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́ ā ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ā kwú hɛ́ ce ŋmá ajɛ. Ó jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi ŋ́, o kwú kwu ābɔ̄, kwú pīya ugrépu. Ābɔ̄ kú nū le jɛ̄ lɛyíkwu ɛgiyí idu ā. Ó kē le ɛgba ta lipú nɛ̄hi. Ufáyin nyā kwu ābɔ̄ klla lɛ ēpū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú inu ā, ojuja gaá le mu inu ā kpúmm.

eng_Latn: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyāda kwú pīya iháyí ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó ā, ó gekwú.

eng_Latn: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlá ɛ̄nyā, aá nōo gē lɛ eyī gwō um bónū ā, ohígbū nɛ̄ n géē kpó aá yíífi. Nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo géē nya aá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā kú Usámsin ā le ikwū je ga iyɔ̄bū Usámsin gaá da ɔɔ́ kóō gē wɔ́tū anúɔ. Ka anúɔ í he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ le ita kwú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ, ɔ́ɔ kē da anúɔ ɛyí kú ita ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin tá ɔnyā nū ā ohi, da ɔɔ́ ka anúɔ í kōō ka ɛyí ita ā lɛ ádā anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ ī ka lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ anúɔ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā anúɔ géē ka lɛ ɔ́ kɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔlɛɛcɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, N le úcɛ́ kú uwɔ pó ipū ɛhɔ̄ ā, ufi le um kwú, abɔ̄ n tóohɛ́ɛwa ā. Anɔ́ɔ n le kwu tayínū á.

eng_Latn: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
idu_Latn: Ubɛrɛkíya mɛ́mla Ɛlkána gē gbō ɔwɛ kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu le abɔ̄ kú nū pīya gla ɔhá, kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū ú ce Ɛ́frem nōo wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ ā ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū ú ce Umanásɛ nōo wɛ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
idu_Latn: Íne nyā yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú ayááyí kú aá ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ aá lā.

eng_Latn: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nyā fū Ása nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá. Anɔ́ɔ o ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, Ása gbɔɔ́ ō yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
idu_Latn: É lɛ okónu, amáŋ é kɛlā glá ŋ́, é lɛ īkpēyí, amáŋ é mɛ́ɛbɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛga nɔ̄wá dóódu le bɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛyí fakpá ā, agwú yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛyí fakpá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ayínɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā, aá bá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ká áá lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū.

eng_Latn: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá ā ú lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ éwɔhá móōwē tū ɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa hɛ́ uwā apī ā yɔ̄ á. Odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā nēe bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, nēe kpɛ́fú ipú uwā glá ā le pɛ́ gekwú ipú ígbíli, igbīhi nēé bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī wu gicō gaajɛ bɛ̄ɛka okóohō nōo wɛ olíla ā. Aflɛ́yí, ó le tá Íjīpiti nyɔ̄ gaá dɔɔ̄kā otábɔ̄. Igbɔhá ā, ɔ́ɔ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga í tá Asírīya dúú.

eng_Latn: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le gbo mla Urécɛ̄lu dúú á. Ihɔtū nōó lɛ lɛ Urécɛ̄lu ā fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ Ulɛ́ya á. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwɛ̄hɔ̄cī lɛ Ulában iháyí ahāapa ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
idu_Latn: N klla ī ka igbɔhá kpó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō gbɛlá ka n wɛ olíla ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō wɛ olíla nááná, aá kōō í yɛ í mīyɛ um lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē bī gwō lígíí lɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri ā wɛ ayí kú Umáhili mɛ́mla Umússi.

eng_Latn: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, a le da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ wā í yá nyā, ɛka nāa cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gbo nyā í gáā kwú alɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú á nēé lɛ ɔ́ jéjúuma, anɔ́ɔ ó gebí tāajɛ ŋmá ipú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
idu_Latn: Ígwu kú ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā í gáā lɛ ayááyí ŋ́. Ɔlá klla í je ɔlɛ́ nēé gwó ŋmá omíci nēé mīyɛ lé ā kpó yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú Óndú ā bīya igbɔhá kpɔ̄. Oŋmá lɛ o pā ojibó kú Ubáalu, Ásitātesi, mɛ́mla ɛcí kú ācɛ Usiríya, Usídɔn, Umówābu, Ámɔ̄ri, mɛ́mla ojibó kú ācɛ Ufilístiya. É le igbīhi ce kwu Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Náaná ā Ujɛhóyākim, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā lɛ Ɛlinátan, ɔyí kú Ákbɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti kéē gaá lɛ Uríya bī wā.

eng_Latn: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujɛhósɛ̄ba, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujóram, ɔyí ádā kú Ahasíya kwú Ujówāsi, ɔyí kú Ahasíya ú tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí Atálīya. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ipú inu eyīpú, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ Atálīya í ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:
idu_Latn: Ussímēyi gbɔɔ́ ō cílokwúlu tā ɔ̄ gē da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ Nyōō nyɔ̄ɔ̄, ɔ̄coŋmɔ́ɔcɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔdāhá.

eng_Latn: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ uwɔ bī wā ɔlɛekwu, ɛga nōo lipú klá du obu fíyɛ́ dúu kú ɔlékwū a ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá dúúmā í gáā hile ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ ā géē je odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmó ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
idu_Latn: É hɛ́gilígilí, ufi le uwā kwú nɛ̄hi. É yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ka inambo nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī má á.

eng_Latn: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔtū kú ācɛ Ujúu mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne je gicō. É wúla klá Usitífin lɛ ɔ́ kwú ga iyɔ̄bū kú ójīla ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le má ka Árɔ̄ni cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā kéē le hāābɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é le iyī uwā pīya olíla iyɔ̄bú aólɛlā kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā. Anú gē tá aá abɔ̄ klla ī gbō aá á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdée nēé le oje udɔ wúlá-wúlá pla tū ipú nū ā yá, cɛ́ɛ́ a klla le eliká kú oje udɔ nē é géē lɛ bī ɔ̄ ā yá playi ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ɔ́mpa kú iháyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ í jégédē ŋ́, lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpā nū nōó wɛ olɛɛlā kú nū ŋ́ ŋmó, ɔ́ɔ lɔfú kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ga odóódu kú aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā glá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ le nyatá.

eng_Latn: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
idu_Latn: Ami ōfōōfū um má ɛbɛ nyā á. Ācɛ nēe bá pī um ā, í má ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ufi nɛ̄hi le uwá kwú, anɔ́ɔ é le kwu gaá le pɛ́ tayínū á.

eng_Latn: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
idu_Latn: Gbō ācɛ nāa fu ā, ká ā lɛ éwo nāa yá kéē lɔfú ā tū.

eng_Latn: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ pɛ́ ŋmá ipú ojuja, lɛ odúúdú alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú aá tɛtɛ lɛ ā dúú. Amáŋ é lɛ aá na ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā, kwú aá ú kpó pīya ákú Ɔwɔicō ɛɛ́. É lɛ aá kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mɛ́mla Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yá ā.

eng_Latn: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ó kpɛ́fú ābɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi tá ācɛ kú Ufilístiya, Upas Dámmin ā. Ó klá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé hī ka ubáli ā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufílístiya á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, Uféro lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē bī ɔlá mɛ́mla ɔkpacaŋgelī le kɛ̄pɔ̄ tū odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ó kē í kpó ācɛ alɛwa ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɔtūlé, aɔ́kpani! ohígbū ka n lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō kóō géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó da um ā jīla piíí.

eng_Latn: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá le odúúdú aígelī ā kpó yíífi klla le odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ, ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kpó ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yá ipú aígelī nēe wɛ ákú Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá kú ayí alɛwa kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyípɛ̄ obene gē yúnwū amɛ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, aá yúnwū ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka amɛ̄ oyēŋēē nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ī je ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka amɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā jé, aá géē jɛ̄ lɔhi, ó kē í nya aá tá.

eng_Latn: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ācɛ abɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kē kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́da je lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi ŋmá Ujúda kóō nyɔ̄ Ubɛ́tɛlu. Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gā ajɛ abɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam hāyi iyɔ̄bu ɛyí ede gáā gwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka á cɔ̄nyā ŋ́, é géē je igelī nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn, é kē í je ɔ́ yɔɔlá tāajɛ. Á gáā kwu ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
idu_Latn: ayíka ɔnyā um kóō lɛ pīya ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, ī yá ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́, ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kóō kē cíkpó ɔnyā um.

eng_Latn: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gáā cikpɔ́nyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ, í gáā nyɔ̄ áncā ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē móōwē nū piíí.

eng_Latn: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
idu_Latn: É gbā aɔ́kpá ofu kú ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka anúɔ jéeyī fíyɛ́ Udánīyɛlu á, ka ɔdā dúúmā í tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nōó lɛ uwá kpó nū gɛcɛ ā, ó le tá ipú inu anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ abɔ̄ je ɔyínɔ̄nyā gicō, anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā cāŋ́jɛ á.

eng_Latn: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō le íkwu je lɛ ɛkɔ̄ éyi kóō kwú ɔcí ā í lé, anɔ́ɔ ɔcí ā gekwú á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú icō ɛfu oōnyɔ̄ í tū, í gbā ɔkɔ la ɛ̄cī kú Umówābu, ipú inu ɛcí a, le jɛ̄ ācɛ kú Umówābu ɛɛ́. Ōwē nēé ba ī je la īyī uwā abɔ́ɔ á, ó gāa lɛ ile dúúmā la uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
idu_Latn: Aá tū ɛgíkwū ka aá dīíbá, aá nēe lā okónu ísu ā. Aá kóō yá ka aá le kwu ga ajɛ nēé hī ka Utássīssi ā!.

eng_Latn: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu tá Uféro ohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ami ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē lɔfú ka ɛyí nū gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ācɛ Ujíyu gbɔɔ́ ō yá ikpɛ́lā tá Ujísɔ̄si, ohígbū koó nya ɔ̄cɛ tá ɛ̄cī usábāti.

eng_Latn: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Da alɔ, awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á nɛɛ? Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka n le ka lɛ aá, aá gáā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le íne nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā ŋmónyí, ohígbū kóō lɔfú iyē ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō tīile gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ ō yá imabɔ̄ kú Íjīpiti ā, le abaná tū wā í klá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti dúúdú fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni yá ā.

eng_Latn: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē wīya ɔ́ tɔ̄há mɛ́mla anɔ̄ a, kéē lɛ ɔ́ he ɔlá klla lɛ ɔ́ ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā nɛ̄ ocu kú nū í he Óndú ā ɔtú ā.

eng_Latn: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éeyē le mu ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ɔtū cabá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē kwú Udánīyɛlu ū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú aágábá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Udánīyɛlu ú bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú aágábá ā á. Ágábá í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē yá ɔ̄ ɛdɔ ágbe dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū koó lɛ ɔtū ce Ɔwɔicō kú nū.

eng_Latn: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ ká ā ga Usárefāti, ajɛ kú ācɛ Usídɔn, ká ā nyɔ̄ í lā abɔ́ɔ. N le da ɔnyōkwū éyi nōo lā abɔ́ɔ kóō je ɔdōlé gā uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
idu_Latn: N lɔhi ō má eyī bɛ̄ɛka ododó nēe ī jɛ̄ bá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ussárɔn, mɛ́mla ododó kú ɔpɛ́ kú ɛfu á.

eng_Latn: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī nōo géē wā ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē tá ɛgba kwú ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ā. É klla í lu, í héēpū bɛ̄ɛka alemú ā. É ī gwá ikpō klá ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwu odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē hī ɔ̄ igwú ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí géē gwá īkpō, ɛhɔ̄ géē yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, ācɛ dóódu géē lā ɔlɛ́ uwá ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā. Eko nɛ̄ n kwú agbá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ú hɛ́, kwú uwá u hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe bī uwá ɔfíyɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
idu_Latn: Uwá géē yá ɛ́fɔ̄du o lɛ playi ɔ̄tū kú owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā, owú nɔwā mɛ́mla owú kú ugóolu , mɛ́mla īlī nɛ̄hɛ́, nēé lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū inu ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usímón, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujudási, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujónam, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ulayákim.
