eng_Latn: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Óndú, awɔ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ń tēelihɔ iye jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Oŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú um jāā kwiícɛ nyā, ń lé ɔdā dúúmā nōo gekwú abɔ̄yī nū amáŋ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí ŋmó ā ŋ́. Ɛbɛ́ elihɔ dúúmā í ga ipú okónu kú um jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
idu_Latn: Ó gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi Upírātɔn ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki á.

eng_Latn: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúdasi kwú ɔ́wá kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uróm mɛ́mla aídengéli nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi tɛ̄hɔ̄ āa. É wā abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla ulámpu mɛ́mla ɛmu mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú.

eng_Latn: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam le igá hɛ́ tū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ussɛ́kɛm, ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛfrēm ā. Ó lā abɔ́ɔ eko kpií ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ igá hɛ́ tū Upénūwɛlu á.

eng_Latn: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ipú iháyí ofɛpa ā, īlī kú uwā ɔ́ɔ je gbo ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ je híla ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ikpó kú uwá ɔ́ɔ mi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn ā í wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́. Amáŋ é wɛ igwú kú ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu cokónu ka aá géē leyīkwu uwá klla gbō uwā ɛyí. Amáŋ Usɔ́ɔlu cēyītīkwū kóō lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ, ohígbū ɔtucaca kú nū lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ka ācɛ ōhī í gáā mīyɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēé gē nwū ā gɛ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ō mīyɛ ā, é géē mīyɛ ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ ebilíi o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā gē bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
idu_Latn: É le utébulu o lɛ akā kú oje udɔ igwó yá. Ɛhɔ̄ bá ɛháajɛ, ɛhɔ̄ klla bá ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É klla le ocíbú kú oje ɔdɔ ofɛhɔ̄ yá dúú.

eng_Latn: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
idu_Latn: Aéwo opɛ̄cí ā í gáā kpó uwā ɔlɛ́ wu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí oŋmɔ́cɛ ā í klla gáā kwú uwá kpó ŋmó lé gɛ ŋ́. É géē lā ɛbɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā tū uwá ufi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
idu_Latn: Hī um igwú, n géē cɛ̄ uwɔ igwú, klla í da uwɔ ɔdā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdōōtayínū nɛ̄ á jé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
idu_Latn: Urúbɛn géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi, nōo gboce Ɛ́frem ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄ kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ gē ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā!.

eng_Latn: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ka ā da Udéfīdi ā. O ka ka Udéfīdi í je pīya ohilí kú ɔcɛ́ ā he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ̄cī ō lɛ ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ tū ā kóō gla ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
idu_Latn: O gwu inu ā iyē kóō le yá yēŋēē ā, ó géē bī aígbáanɔ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛpa, ɔ̄cí usɛ́da, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú uháyísɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ dóódu kú aá hī ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ aá má ā igwú kéē wā ɛgiyí ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
idu_Latn: Aígelī kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā tá cákpáá bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā. Ujerúsālɛm le yíífi má tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Amásīya tá kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujɛhówāsi ka lɛ ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ ga ɛcɛ kéē leyí méyī ɔgbɛ́fú kú Ubɛ́ti Ussémēssi kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ń gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́, ohígbū koó yá um bɛ̄ɛka n yɔ̄ í gwá oyī kú ācɛ nēe lɛyí ce ikwū nyɔ̄ í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ā gé um ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ō gwá á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ ɔtū ō lɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja ɛtá ā á.

eng_Latn: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ n le bɔ́há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, n gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē kwúcē wā ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāpá ā kóō lɛ inu ā jila kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā le nyīla.

eng_Latn: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛlā kú ɔcɛ́ ā pó ā, uwá gbo iyāwu kú uwā. Abɔ̄ é bá ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, é le ínyílɔ́wɔ ékpó piíí nēé má ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā má kpɔ́. Ó gaá gbɔbū lɛ uwá jāā gbéeko nōó gaá māháyi ɛga nɛ ɔyí ā yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī lɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā, ó le inu kú nū gwó, le ákanaba ahāapa kpó kwu ɔ́ kwaajɛ.

eng_Latn: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
idu_Latn: É géē yíífi, amáŋ a géē yɔ̄ eko dóódu. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā géē je gbɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka úwé ā.

eng_Latn: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ ɛ̄wā ocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tá ga ipú ɛcɛ, lɛ alítā kú aíkpɔ̄cí ufáyin ā hɛ́ ŋmá ɔcí ufáyin ā. Ó lɛ uwá kpó tá tū ɛga nɛ̄hi kú ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō nēé gē da uwá, ī yá ejé ŋmá uwá ā. Ɔ́ɔmā kwɛyí ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri, ámāŋ ācɛ kú Umówābu, kwu ayááyí ɔ́migwó kú uwá nááná í gáā wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ kē gāa ɛɛ́. Ó gē lé ɔdōlé klla gē gwá. É ka ɔ́ ɔ kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o le ɔdōlé nwuné mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o gwéjé nwuné, mɛ́mla oklóbīya kú ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācobīyíne. Amáŋ ācɛ géē má ka íjéeyī kú Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa o ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
idu_Latn: Āyā kú ajɛ ā ɔhá ā í tá ajɛ lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É géē gwó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwá abɔ́ɔ nēé géē lā.

eng_Latn: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
idu_Latn: É kōō kpó adíkonyeyī mla īlī úklɔ́ nōo lɛ iyē kwu ɔ́ iyē ce ācɛ odōcē ā iyē. Ōcē kú uwā ā kē ī mɛ, aálelékwū obɔ̄bí kē le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ɔlɛ́ kú Ujérobōwam lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, yá cɔ̄nū, o ŋmá lɛ íne nēé bīya ā. É klla le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ kpó wu ipú íne nēé bīya ā dúú.

eng_Latn: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā yēeyī nōó ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ igbɔhá nōo ī nwuné bɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ ólīifu nōo í pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ísu ā ŋ́. Ó kē gáā má abahi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka enyāmɛ̄ɛna mɛ́mla ɛnwú nōo ī pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ kú aɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā hīlaŋ́dɔ́, ébú kē le cē klá uwá kpímm.

eng_Latn: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ nēe hile Ísrɛ̄lu ā, í gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka é gáā plla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka é géē bá ī jɛ̄ gɔbū, klla í lā ɛbɔ́. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā tū uwā ufi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔmahāapa ŋmá ícɛ, n géē tū ɔwɔ ɛhɔ̄ gaá yā klá ɛcɛ. Ó ī yā ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, kwu otú mɛ́mla ɛnɔ. Ɔdā oyēeyī dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā, kē géē je kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá ā wɛ aíjáalí kú um á. Aá wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ n fu á, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ um jé, lɛ ɔtū kpó ce um, klla le jé ka ami ōfōōfū um wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gbɔbū ga um, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā gē yɔ̄ igbīhi kú um.

eng_Latn: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da ɔ́ kóō blakwu ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu, kóō lɛ ɛlá wu ɔtū olɔfú, ɔtū obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔtū ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ɛháajɛ kú aákā nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú aɔ́dā ō lɛ acá oōbī wu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ahɔ̄lá fú tū abɔ̄ omōomu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ pahīla klá odúúdú igelī ā. N mā ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄ ā. amáŋ, ó géē je odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú a kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó uwá ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá, í tá uwá bá, klla í kpó uwá wā ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā. N géē bī uwá cīgbīhi wā ɛyí aɛ́fu mɛ́mla aɔ́kpá kú Ísrɛ̄lu, klla í kpó uwá nyɔ̄ í lúlé ipácí olɔhi.

eng_Latn: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa bá. Ákú aflɛ́yí ā le ɔnyā lɛ, ó gekwú í ma ayí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá, ācɛ Ufarísīi! Aá gē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú aépū ligiligi ō lɛ ɔdōlé kpócu lɛ Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ aá leyī gwō o yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ aɔ́mpa aá tá. Aá klla leyī gwō íne kú ihɔtū o yá tū Ɔwɔicō tá. Aá yá aɔ́dā olɔhi nēe bá nyā, amáŋ, aá leyī gwō ohile bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ. Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu gē gbō alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā, wɛ Oholíyābu, ɔyí kú Ahísamāki, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ā. Ó wɛ ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄, ó jé ō tá īlī, mɛ́mla ō bī owú nɛhɛ̄, owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá wu ɛdɔ kú īlī dóódu.

eng_Latn: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ká Óndú ā kóō yɛ ɔkwu alɔ ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ? Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá tóohi ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá kú nū gē fíyajɛ klá ācɛ okpaakpa ā, éeyē mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ kē í fíyajɛ klá ācɛ olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ, n géē tú igelī nyā gllayá, klla í hɛ́ ācɛ kú igelī ā tá ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ā. N géē hɛ́ uwá tá klla ī yá kóō lɔhi lɛ uwá, kéē klla lā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú, Ɔwɔicō klla le íne kú nū bīya bɛ̄ɛka aéwo ɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ajɛ ā. É klla yɛ tíkpa kú ɛcí nɛ̄ aéwo ɔhá gē pā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu abālɔbányā, é cīgbīhi kwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa uwā ŋ́. Ó keé húmáyī ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka alɔ̄ má ɔ̄, ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Ó ka ālɔ̄ bēhé ga ipú nū gāá mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ cokónu nū lɛ ádáádā alɔ, Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ ā lɛ aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ayááyí kú aá.

eng_Latn: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
idu_Latn: Aílɔ́wá ā géē ŋmó aá nōo wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā okónu ohígbū ka aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā í lɛ íne ā tū ŋ́, nááná nēé lɛ íne tá tū odée lɛ aá, klla le aá apī hɛ́ ā. Amáŋ uwá ā lɛ íne ā tū nááná nēé hɛ́ apī ŋ́ mā, ohígbū ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ucē kú ɔlɛ́ uwā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó í bī ɔyí ɔbá ɛna éyi, álá éyi, ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ í hɔ́hā ce uwá ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī wā ānāānā. Lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā lɔfúlɔfú cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híīī nú ukata nɛ̄ n géē je ga uwɔ ka a le yálé ɛɛ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n pó gbɔbū yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā klla lɛ ɛlā ka ga um kpɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ēpɔ̄kpá nōo yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo hayi eyī ísu mɛ́mla ɛyí ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
idu_Latn: a kē í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ká ā bī um jé ɔwɛ. A kē klla í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ká ā tú um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ācɛ ā ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ, fu Umósīsi, mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni á, anú kpó aádáádā aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, ɛwa nēe bá okónu aóbugā ā bá ī yúuya ā, é bá ī kɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā hímáyī yálé ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ́ ācɛ nēe wɛ aófulajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yálɛ́ ā! Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Óndú ā nɔwɔ wúlatū wā ŋmá aígelī kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
idu_Latn: Igelī nyā í gáā gbō aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ̄hī gē gbō ɛbɛ́ nēe bá ipú nū ā ŋ́. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ aá géē bá ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, n yá aá italā.

eng_Latn: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ uwá lɛ ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ le ɛbɔ́ je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa uwā ɛɛ́. Ó kéē le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ ipú ajɛ nōo wɛ ákú uwā nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan, nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ aá tútū kú aá gbō ɔlɛ́ aá lɛ, náaná, é géē kpó aá yɔlá ga ɔlékwū. É géē kpó aá yíífi ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ aéfūma je kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ ā. Aá kōō le nyīla bɛ̄ɛka aéfūma ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka aíkpaŋgā ā, nááná, é géē kpó aá yíífi ŋmá ajɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le jīla tɔ̄ɔ̄há Ubésēki ā, ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu wā ā wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó bá ɛga ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , aá ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ŋmá Ujúda ā wɛ ulá ɛpa ce ofigwó bá ɛga ofu ce igwó .

eng_Latn: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
idu_Latn: É kē pɛ́ ga ipú úgbéenyi ā ɔbá mla ɔnyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da Unówa ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔwú ā gwū á.

eng_Latn: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ aógbɛhá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dóódu gē yá lɔhi lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛyí ō jé ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō má áā?.

eng_Latn: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ka abɔ̄ anú abɔ̄yīnū í lɔfú ipú ɔtū ŋ́ mā, ó cɛgbá kóō lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ó wɛ ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bīya ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ákú anú abɔ̄yīnū dúú.

eng_Latn: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka igbómína lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó, alɔ géē ka ɔdā nōo géē nū ɔ̄ ipú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híīī lɛ unwalu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í yɛ ga ɛháajɛ ga Uríbla, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Áyin, ga ɛyí ɛfu nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú okónu éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú ka ka, Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka á. Ó le lɛ ā, a da ɔ́ ka abɔ́ɔ ó le ka ka Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka á ā nááná nɛ̄ n da ɔ́ kóō híī ka ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
idu_Latn: Kwu aícɔ́ɔja nēé kpó ŋmá ɛga ɔhá nááná í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛna nōó tá ɛ́nɛ́ nū abɔ̄ nū iju dúúmā glá ŋ́ mā. Odúúmā kú uwā í háyi kpɛ́fú glá ŋ́, odúúdú uwā lɛ igbīhi pīya lɛ inya kwu le yɛ. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ámíyā géē yá Íjīpiti, nɛ̄ n klla ī yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, A le oyēeyī kú alɔ nyatá ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó he ɔkpani ɔtū, alɔ géē wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Uféro.

eng_Latn: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
idu_Latn: Eko aflɛ́yí ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ lɛ ucē ékpónú mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄lā ékpónú nēé gē ka.

eng_Latn: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nōó wɛ ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ má. Ɔkpíihɔ kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔma nū ŋmá ipú aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá agege ahāapa cɛ ɔ́. A géē lɛ agege nēé yá mla ugóólu ā tū gicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō fíyajɛ ga iyɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā í kpó aíyíípú kú nū mɛ́mla aíklíkpó kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya ā, géē kpó odúúdú íyɛ́ɛya ā yɔlá. Ocu kú ɔdōlé nyā g­ē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ahāapa kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā, Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Unetaníya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ɛlíssāma, éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, nōo kē wɛ éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā le tá Umíspa mɛ́mla ācɛ igwó gaá má Ugɛdalíya. Eko nēé bá í lé ɔdōlé tɔ̄ha á.

eng_Latn: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyī kú nū tá gaá lɛ aólɛlā kú nū fíyákátā. Ó kōō bī ɔwɔ olímanya maá, le nū uwá inya dúú.

eng_Latn: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōó mɔyí jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, gwííje ká ā klla dɛ̄gba kú éeyē gbōmgbōm. Awɔ nōó jé ɔma kú ɔyí ō ma jééjéē ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, gbɔɔ́ ō gwíjē ká ā tɔ́ɔga mɛ́ɛnɛ. A géē ma ayí alɛwa eko nyā fíyɛ́ ɔnyā nōo húmáyī yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔbá, yɔ̄ ī ma ayí ā.

eng_Latn: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a gē je ɔtū gicō ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ eyī kú uwɔ le pīya gɔɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpó ɛhi lɛ ācɛ á. Ó fu ācɛ ōhī kéē wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄, ó kē fu ācɛ ɔhá kéē wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ó fu ācɛ ɔhá kéē wɛ ācotɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi bɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lɛ́, ó kē fu ācɛ ɔhá kéē wɛ ācɛ nōo ī gbācɛ bɛ̄ɛka álá ā, mɛ́mla aítíca nōo ī nwū ācɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ abālɔbányā ā alɔ í jé nóo. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nwūla anú eyī ā alɔ í jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. Aá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, ó le jɛ̄ kwɛyí ɛɛ́. Ó lɔfú kɛlā abɔ̄yī nū glá.

eng_Latn: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu lɔnɔ tū Ɔwɔicō ō yá ā a? Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka lɛ ā, ɔyā ahāanɛ ŋmá abālɔbányā n géē pīyɛyí, Usára kē í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi.

eng_Latn: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a lɔhi klla ī yá ɔdā olɔhi ā, nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ga odúúdú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kéē da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nēé yá yɔ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwú óbō kú nū ú le tá lɛ Ujonátan, anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan le jé ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ le tútū ō ŋmó Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē leyīkwu Umósīsi eyī gē kɛlā mla anú bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ mla oklóbīya nū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ Umósīsi le pīyɛyí wā ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ o hile bá ā. Amáŋ ɔyípōklóbīya éyi, Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n nōo gē tá Umósīsi abɔ̄ ā, gē klá igbīhi ɛgiyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
idu_Latn: N kwú Udéfīdi ú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aéwo alɛwa, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbō uwā. N kē bī ɔ̄ le ma ɔfú kú um fú lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
idu_Latn: É le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā hɛ́tá ŋmá íne nēé bīya nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi í hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá anú glá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ í tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwɔ ohígbū úklɔ́ olɔhi ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ɛbí ō ka, ohígbū ka awɔ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ iyī uwɔ pīya Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uhásɔ, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē pi aá ahɔ̄ ka aá kwinya nyɔ̄ í tayínū ɛga oligbó. A le jé ka Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, lɛ ujɔ̄ nɛ̄hi tū tū aá ɛɛ́. Ó yá ojuju tū aá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je aéwo ōhī pīya ɛnɛ̄hi, klla í je uwá piíí ɔ́ɔmā pīya ɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́. Ó gē je aéwo ōhī yá aéwo nɛ̄hi, ó klla kē ī je aéwo ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛhási da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá í yá nóo. Ɔkpani um tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu uwɔ ka, obōōbū nāa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā aúgbɔga kú ɔ́wá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛpa ɛ́ɛ gaá ce anɔ́ɔ ŋmá Ɛ́frem. Ka āwɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ahāapa ce ofu igwú je gā um mɛ́mla otóngwō ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū wā, gaá je lɛ Óndú ā, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā kú okoolo éyi kú umu nēé lɛ ɔ́ wīya tɔ̄há mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu.

eng_Latn: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe bá nya lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí nēe gē gbɛlá ŋ́ mā, é ma uwá kéē kwú uwá í ŋmó icííci, é gē ka ɛlā obɔ̄bí ká ɔdā dúú nēé jé ɛyí nū ŋ́ mā. É géē kpó uwā yíífi bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
idu_Latn: A ka lɛ ācɛ kéē híī cikpó ɔnyā ācɛ, amáŋ a kē ī cikpó ɔnyā ācɛ ɔhá. A gē ŋmó ɛcí nɛ̄ ācɛ ī pā okónu, amáŋ a kē kpó odée uwī ŋmá ikpɛ́cí.

eng_Latn: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔgbɔ̄cí ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wɛ anú wɛ ɔyí Umeri ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wɛ anú wɛ ɔyínɛ Ujémīsi mla Ujósɛ̄fu, mla Ujúdasi mɛ́mla Usáyímɔ̄ni ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ayínɛ́ nū nɔnya í lā amānyā ŋ́ nɛɛ? É tá ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɔɔlɔhi gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tóohi ɛlā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka á yá lɛ ā ŋ́, olíla mɛ́mla ɔdāhá nāa wɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛtá kú ɔyā ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ é hī ka Áda ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ́da nēé je kéē ŋmó ācɛ Ujíyu ā cíkā ō gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ á. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā leyīce ka, aá géē kpó uwā ŋmó á. Amáŋ ikɔkɔ nēé géē kpó ācɛ Ujíyu ŋmó ā, ācɛ Ujíyu klla le aólɛlā kú uwā kpó ŋmó, klla le uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛnɛ ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ fu Umɔ́dɛkāyi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipééyī uwá abɔ́ɔ, n jé ɔ́da nyā lɛ Ubárūku.

eng_Latn: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
idu_Latn: Awɔ ā dúú, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yúklɔ́ mla um lɔɔlɔhi ā. N dɔɔ̄kā kú ā lɛ ācɛnyā ɛpa nēe bá nyā kagwó. Ohígbū ka ami mɛ́mla uwá gē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi tɔ̄há yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ alɛwa. Alɔ mɛ́mla Uklɛ́mɛ̄nti mɛ́mla ācoyúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā ɔ́mpā um, nɛ̄ iyē kú uwā yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kóō he aá, ká aá gwéeyē piyóó ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gáā lā Ujerúsālɛm ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá ā géē gwéeyē, ɔtū kē ī he uwá.

eng_Latn: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le awulú ā kpó wiiyē kwɛyí ā, Ujéhu le tá ipú inu kú Ubáalu ā mɛ́mla Ujónādabu, ɔyí kú Urékābu gaá da uwá kahíníī, Aá má ka ācɛ nēe gē gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ā ōfōōfū uwā géē wā amānyā á, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā kóō híī yɔ̄ amānyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna le tá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú igelī ā gaá cīce. Ó le áklɔ̄kpɛ cē ce lɛ iyīnū, anɔ́ɔ ó má cīcē obobowú kú nū, yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ɔdā nōo gáā yá Unínīfɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó kwu ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya le ikpó bá ajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā, ɛcɔ̄ ā kē bá abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu géē yɔ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú nū.

eng_Latn: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka abɔ̄ anúɔ hímáyī yɛ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ka anúɔ da otrɛ̄yí kú uwā dóódu ámāŋ ka ācɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ fu kɛ́ɛ̄ gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka álá á, kɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ Agblīihɔ kú ɔcí usɛ́da gwó lɛ anúɔ jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
idu_Latn: Aá gē wūwī, gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, ī gbaajā, ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá le ɔkpa gwá nááná ā, gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā, klla ī pā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ jé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó hī ɔyí ádā nū, Usólōmɔn ámaŋ ka Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ámaŋ ka Ubenáya ámaŋ ka aígabɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi ohile ā igwú wā ɔnū ucɛ kú ɛya nōó gwó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n lɛbɛ̄ɛka odahɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó pó ɛlā dóódu gɛ ŋ́ mā, n lɛbɛ̄ɛka odokónu nɛ̄ ó kɛlā glá gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
idu_Latn: Ɛyilɔ, é lɔfú ŋ́, amáŋ é gē kpó ɔdōlé kú uwá tū ɔnɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɛ́ɛ kē da aá ka, aá kóō wā ipú aá, nɛɛ, aá géē nyɔ̄, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā géē cābɔ̄ lɛ aá ka Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ aá géē yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ ōhī ka, a wɛ Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim, ācɛ ɔhá ka, a wɛ Ɛláyíja, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā ka a wɛ éyi kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
idu_Latn: É géē je ajɛ tá ajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo í yɔ̄ ī gbāajɛ ā. Ajɛ ā í gbó ɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄jī ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛga kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ gaá kwu ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā. Ó kē ī ŋmá ɛ̄jī ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛga kú Ɔwɔicō ā gáā kwú ɛ̄jī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ajɛ ā. Īkpō kú nū ká ō wɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla ákú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ aá géē je nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo hí ɛhɔ̄ géē je ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ cāŋjɛ gbúlu, le tɛ́ɛcɛ ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā gaá māháyi cíí. Abɔ̄ Uháman le má ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔ klla í yá anúɔ italā piíí ā, ó le tá ɛgiyī Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā ā, gaá yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ̄ ohígbū oyēeyī kú anū abɔ̄yīnū.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yá um ōwē nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó mā um tá kú n̄ kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gē wɔ́tū ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē pī ācɛ tū ā.

eng_Latn: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācɛ ōhī kú alɔ nēe ŋmá Ukrɛ́ti mɛ́mla ācɛ Árábu. Nááná alɔ pó abɔ̄ ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā okónu ucē kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ, é bá ī kɔ̄ɔ̄kā kú úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá kéē kwú ɔyí oyēeyī ā ú lɛ ɔnyā kú aflɛ́yí ā. Ó kéē híī ŋmó ɔyí ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔnyā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔyí ā á.

eng_Latn: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú, abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́kpá tū ɔdɔ kú Agblɔ̄cɛ́. Abɔ̄ ā ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ agege háyi gē fíyajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ɔcɛ́ ā kē le abɔ̄ ā má eko nōó yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā dóódu nōo le úgwū agbénú kú ajɛ lé ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyi kú Ísrɛ̄lu, géē lɛ ɔbá ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔmā piíí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔwɛ nyā, odúúdú ācɛ géē lé úgwū kú agbénú kú ajɛ kú aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayí kú Uhám nēe lā ipú ajɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú aípɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla aéwo kú úwā ā á. Igwú éyééye yɔ̄ ī ka ucē kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Unibɔ́han igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔmā ā mɛ́mla Ɛ́ngēdi bá ipú ígbíli dúú. Odúúdú wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛhīlī mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ɔcɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ó jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu Ujósɛ̄fu ŋ́ mā wā í cɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń gáā cɛ̄ gā uwɔ má eyī kú um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ um má eyī géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
idu_Latn: É yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lā ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri, ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā, ōwē iháyí igwáahātá, ohígbū ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híīī yúúfi uwā ŋ́. Ohígbū koó tū ɔdā dúúmā nēé le ácí ŋmó klá anú, nēé gáā je ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ó tū ɔdā dúúmā nēé le tayínū, nēé gáā jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
idu_Latn: Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówabu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi á. Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔyí kú Ahilúdu gē leyīkwu ɔdā o tá tāajɛ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ dúú ā ka alakpɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ wɛ, Uhánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Éfɔ̄du.

eng_Latn: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka pīyatɔ̄há, é wɛ úlúúlā ce úlā igwáahāapa cofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í gáā wɛ ɔfiyɛ piyóó glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Óndú ā. Anú kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá a.

eng_Latn: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí olíla wɛ ífi lɛ ádā nū. Ɔnyā ō ka ífulá nōo klla gē je unwalu lɛbɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē nū bónū trétrétré ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan ma ayí ɛpa: Upéleti mɛ́mla Usása.

eng_Latn: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
idu_Latn: Nááná nēé le fíyákátā tū ipú aéwɔhá ā, amáŋ ka o bá ɛgaligbó ɔ́ɔmā ā, nááná, é géē blakwu um. Uwá mla ayí uwā géē hile, klla géē pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ tɔ̄ɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abālɔbányā ā, n yɔ̄ ī tútū ō hɔ́hā ce ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mla Ujúda. Aá yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɛyí inu, kóō híīī wāajɛ gaá je iyó ŋmá inu kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
idu_Latn: Uféro í gáā jāhɔ̄ gā uwɔ ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā n géē yá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti italā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú hɛ́ ɔcí kú Usɛ́da, ámāŋ uloko, ámāŋ Usáyíprɛ̄si, ŋmá ipácí glá. Ámāŋ ó lɔfú lɛ ɔcí nēé hī ka Upáyin ā tū, gbēyī eko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ lɛ ɔ́ jɛ̄ nōó le jɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ kóō hɛ́ ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, é bī ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ō gē yá ɔdā kú ɔtū uwā. É klla ī pā aɛ́cí nēé hī ka ubáalu ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā nwū uwā kéē pā ā.

eng_Latn: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó gē pīyeyī má ajɛ gē má odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā. ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó cīce ā.

eng_Latn: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ka eko nyá nɛ̄ aɔ́wɔ kú aéwo nɛ̄ ó cɔ̄ɔ̄cí mbá ā, hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kū ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya kú ɛ̄ pó āa? Ó da uwá ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gbɛlá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē nya Ujerúsālɛm tá glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ álá bī wā kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya nɛɛ, ó í wɛ ɔnyā álá nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi mla ocɛ̄tra kú Ɔwɔicō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu, ohígbū ka é mīyɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má ce ɛyí nū gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ á. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ágábá gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, le ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ ágábá ā mɛ́mla ijakī kú nū ā má háyi pí okwu kú nū á.

eng_Latn: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
idu_Latn: Lɛ alɔ tūmu mla ihɔtū nāa ī mafú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔtū kóō he alɔ, ká alɔ bá ī gwíijē ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī eko kú oyēeyī kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn, Ugádi mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ohile kú ayí kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ, úlā ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nēe lɛ iyɛ́fú dóódu.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n̄ da aá keé géē je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya mɛ́mla ɛlā ɛbí dóódu nēé ka ā yá uwá ɛhi. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í gáā je ɛlā obɔ̄bí nēé ka lɛyíkwu Alelékwū Ihɔ ā yá uwā ɛhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: a le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kpó ŋmó ipu ígbíli ohígbū, ka á lɔfú bī uwā ga ajɛ nāa cokónu ka anúɔ géē je lɛ uwā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je unwalu gā uwɔ, ɔhā nɛ̄ n gáā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē tū uwɔ ímálānyī. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ nōo géē hīla ókpílícī ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n géē gwō piíí ayíka aɔ́dā nōo gē mafú ka ń lɔfú ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ n cíkā ō bī gwō á.

eng_Latn: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, mɛ́mla Ugádi mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā hīgwú tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā, ó lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā tū gaá nwū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛlā mɛ́mla íne kú Óndú ā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda dóódu ā. Ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ubenhéyilu, Obadáya, Usekaríya, Unatánīyɛlu mɛ́mla Umikáya.

eng_Latn: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je kú otábɔ̄ ā, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ le hɛ́ um iyē ɛɛ́. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā, ohígbū ka é le lɔfú ce um bá.

eng_Latn: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī yá ɛ́gbla kú ɛbɛ́ ámāŋ ka igbáanɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujúda le ɔ́ má ā, ó gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ akwuna éyi nɛ̄, ohígbū ka ó le īlī pīya klá eyī.

eng_Latn: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ahi nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kwú ā, í kōō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bī abɔ̄ kú uwā je ɔdōlé tá okónu kú uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
idu_Latn: Ukpɛ̄ kú ācɛ nēe ga ɔgbɛ́fú ŋmá ipú odúúdu uwa ā wɛ, aálá úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛpa ce úlā ofɛpa ce igwó ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á, n géē tá uwɔ ahínyá, Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á, n géē da ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ka a lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: When thou buildest a new house, then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof, that thou bring not blood upon thine house, if any man fall from thence.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ inu ɛ̄pɛ̄pɛ̄ gwó, ka ɛ́ɛ bī odée lɛ igá hɛ́ tū okónōgwu kú ɛyí nū biílí, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē míya ŋmá anú nú í gāá gekwú, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē lé ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń gáā yá ka aólɛlā kú uwā kéē bī ɔ́ɔmā le gwō ka aá ɔɔ́ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um yálé ɛɛ́ ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó wɛ ami abɔ̄yī um ca uwá tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
idu_Latn: N má ka a ódée nyā wɛ odée ōlɛ acá oōbī wu pií nɛ̄ n má ɛháajɛ kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ā á.

eng_Latn: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
idu_Latn: Adáya, Uberáya mɛ́mla Ussímráti.

eng_Latn: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́lɛ́ ɛtá nēe ce ɛyí īyī wā icō nyā ce ɛyí úbɔ́ kú īyī uwā. Upíla dúúmā í kwu uwá ká ō bī uwā háyi, bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá kú odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛdɔ ɔdōlé dóódu nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla uwá géē lé glá ā kpó tū ipú úgbenyi ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja klla da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ami ōfōōfū um hile nōo wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Amáŋ, ubáalu lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya úlā cofɛpa cigwó. .

eng_Latn: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā géē hɔ́hā ce ajɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi iháyí ɔ́mɛhīlī ā nōo lɔfú bī aá iháyí ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
idu_Latn: Ɔtūnwula nwūla yá Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄hi igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá únóji ā. Únóji ā wɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ áklō kú ɛfu, nēé lɛ ɛcɔ̄ gwū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
idu_Latn: Ígwu ɔ́mpa ā wɛ Usekaríya, Ujaásīyɛlu, Usémīramɔtu, Ujɛ́hīyɛlu, Úni, Élīyabu, Ubenáya, Umaásēya, Umatatíya, Ɛlífɛ̄lɛhu mɛ́mla Umiknéya, mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ, Obédēdom mɛ́mla Ujɛ́yɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu, ɔnyā nū le tá ɛgiyí nū, gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛ āa, nɛ̄ ɔtú ɔ́ɔ gē wú ɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ lé ɔdōlé glá ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, tá ifu bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔtūnobí le nwuné fíyɛ́ uwɔ abɔ́ ā. Tá ifu ipú ɔtūnōbí, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ a géē má uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛnɛ ā wɛ Uséri.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lɛ ɔdōwiyē wu ácí nēe bá ícɛ, nɛ̄ óócí nēé bá gɛ ŋ́, nēé le uwá kpó tɔ̄lá ipú útuló ā iyē á. Ó lɛ āa, Ɔwɔicō í gáā lɛ ɔdōwiyē wu aá iyē fíyɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ɔwɔicō ā nyɛ́ íbí!.

eng_Latn: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Íssbɔ̄ssɛti da Ábna ka ɔ́ɔ gē cikpó Uríspa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áya, ɔnyā nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu gē cikpó nū ā.

eng_Latn: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ i cē ɔ́ á, ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ ba ɔ́ ɔdā dóódu nōo tá ɔ̄ ɔtū, ó gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū kahíníī, N géē je awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ pīya ɔdōtūufi lɛ īyī uwɔ, mɛ́mla ɔdōtūufi lɛ aóklóbīya uwɔ. A kē í má abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā í kpó odúúdú uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. N géē je odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda kpó tū abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn. Ó géē je ācɛ ōhī kú uwā kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ga Ubábīlɔn, ó kē í kpó ācɛ ohi ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: N lɛ Usáyírɔsi je gicō kóō lɛ ɔdā okpaakpa kú ɔtū kú um ā yá. N klla géē yá ka ɔwɛ dóódu nōó ī yɛ ā kóō tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ́. Ó géē tú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ um nōo lé ka Ujerúsālɛm ā gwó. Ó klla í hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ aéwɔhá ā tá, ó gáā mīyɛ ije ámāŋ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kɛlā nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ácábɔ̄ éyi kú omlede ā, eko nɛ̄ó le jé mɛ́mla igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ éyi ŋmá ipú ómbilí, mɛ́mla igbō ō bákánjɔ̄ nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwá kpó ce abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā, eko nɛ̄ó le ɛyí kú nū wā ā.

eng_Latn: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ unwū ɔdā kú nū le nwuné nɛ̄hi ā, ɔdā dúúmā í gē hile eko nōó le lé kwɛyí ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, abahi kú nū í gáā gbojī ō mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
idu_Latn: Ábna da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā nū um inya ŋ́. Nyɔ̄ í nū éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja ā inya, ka á mīyɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ uwá bī ā. Amáŋ Ásāhɛlu yɔ̄ í nū ɔ̄ inya kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔtū he aá dúú á ā? Ācɛ dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka aá ā ŋ́, aá wɛ éwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā le hɛ́tá ā. Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū gē tá aá abɔ̄ í gbō aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī le tá īyī nū abɔ̄ ā á. Anú kē ī kpɛ́fú í yálé lɛ aá, bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī bī le kpɛ́fú ā á. Ó géē nuunu lɛ aá klla í cɛ̄ lɛ aá yálé. Aólɛlā kú aá géē wā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá ká aá méyīnyinyi uwā. Amáŋ aá géē lɛ ikpó da uwá ɛyí tū ajɛ.

eng_Latn: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
idu_Latn: É tíne kéē lɛ alɔ kpó yíífi dúúdú. É lɛ ɛga otīihɔ dóódu kú ajɛ ká alɔ ā kpó tū ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
idu_Latn: Ubúki, Úsi.

eng_Latn: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɛcí nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kpó ce kéē gwɛ́ɛya klla yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛcí ɛyí ede kú uwā ɛga dóódu kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe yɛ Ujerúsālɛm jīla ā kpó bá ajɛ ŋmá úklɔ́ kú uwá. Odúúdú uwā wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ubáalu, Ássɛ̄ra, ɛnɔ, ɔyā, ínyílɔwɔ mɛ́mla ɔ́dā ɔhá dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ā híī cɔ̄nū mla um ŋ́, ɔkpani um. A kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ge labɔ̄ kwɔtū kéē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo húmáyí bī um jé ɔwɛ ā lɛ um bī kwúcē ga Okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔkpá éyi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛháajɛ kú nū ā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā pīyeyī kwú ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ŋmá ɛháajɛ kú āyā ɛháajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bū ɛháajɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohe um ɔtū, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tū alɔ nwuné ɛ́gɛ́nyā, ó cíkā ká ālɔ̄ yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa alɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá lā ɛga dúú nɛɛ, Umósīsi gē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā nyɔ̄ gáā kwu ɛcɛɛcɛ ɛga oligbó ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ o hile lā ā. Ó gē hī ɔ̄ ka Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo dɔ̄ɔ̄ka Ɔwɔicō gē ga ɛgiyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó háyi ā.

eng_Latn: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Le tá fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Ulawodésiya ka ami nōo wɛ Aamí, nōo ī cījáalí kú ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō ā kpaakpa ā ka ɛlā nyā á. Ami nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
idu_Latn: Ācohumɔtū, ó hímáyī kwu um ɔtū kú n̄ lɛ ɔkpá tá fu aá ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ nyatá tɔ̄há, eko nɛ̄ n má koó cɛgbá kú n̄ lɛ ɔkpá tá fú aá yɔ̄ gē lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kóō nunu cɛ̄pɔ̄ ɔtōōkpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū igbɛ ékpónú, nōó kē pīyabɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka ā híī nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wɛ ayínɛ́ uwɔ á ŋ́. Odúúdú aá kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́. Ɔdā nōo yá ā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā miya táajɛ ā nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ é klla nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ujérobōwam gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ká ɛ́ɛ híī je ɛcɔ̄ kú ɛcí ō pá dúú ma kwu ajɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē tū ucē ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā eyījii.

eng_Latn: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔbá ɛna ɛpa, mɛ́mla omlede éyi, mɛ́mla álá ahāapa kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́ mā, gwɛ́ɛɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
idu_Latn: Áhāsi, Uhɛsɛkíya, Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ka, ohígbū ohi nɔ́ɔ tá ɔ́ɔmā, ká ɔ̄ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́, ɔ́ɔ géē má ka alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔyí nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo tīihɔ bɛ̄ɛka Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, Óndú. Ápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī leyīkwu ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
idu_Latn: Uséfatīya nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Abitalu ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mɛhīlī ā wɛ Itréyam nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū Égla ma ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ nū, Uséra ā má ayí ɛhɔ̄. Ayí ā wɛ, Usímri, Ɛ́tan, Uhɛ́mān, Ukálkolu mɛ́mla Ukámi.

eng_Latn: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
idu_Latn: Uhódīya, Uhássum, Ubésa.

eng_Latn: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
idu_Latn: Īlī mlɛ́mlɛ́, lɔɔlɔhi, īlī odufā, īlī ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla īlī nɔwā, mɛ́mla īlī nɛ̄ uwá yá ŋmá ɔnwū kú ɛwū.

eng_Latn: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
idu_Latn: Ubálam tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ń tɛtɛ da uwɔ ka, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ā nɛ̄ n géē ka ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
idu_Latn: Obɛ́dɛ̄dɔm, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́dūtun, mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛtá cahātá ɔhá gē bá ī gwíijē nyā tá uwā abɔ̄ dúú. Uhósa mɛ́mla Obɛ́dɛ̄dɔm géē bá ī gbō ɔwɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
idu_Latn: N klla ī kpɔ́tūce kpɔ́, nááná nɛ̄ n da iyī um kahíníī, N jɔ́ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi, ā.

eng_Latn: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je agbénú kú oje ɔdɔ otayínū kú Íjīpiti ā, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla oje udɔ ā kpó ga ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó géē yá Ulíbīya mɛ́mla Usudán lé klla í mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ igá olɔfú hɛ́ tū uwā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le aógbénjūwā kpó cɛ́ɛ́ kéē leyīkwu aígelī nɛ̄hi. Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā nɛ̄ ó gē kpó aíyó kú ɔdōlé kú nū bɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu, ejé.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē bī akpáabana mɛ́mla ajɛ ojīliyē nɛ̄hi le hɛ́ aá tá. Ó klla gē tū oflúutu mɛ́mla ɔlá nōo géē yɔ̄ ī yi nɛ̄hi ā gaá hɛ́ aá tá.

eng_Latn: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā, ó í cíla ɔ̄cɛ nōo lá ajɛ ā okónu kú ije nōo í kwɛyí eko nōo hile kéē je ajɛ cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā piíí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó mīyɛ ajɛ kú nū cīgbīhi.

eng_Latn: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā cēenyi ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā le nwuné nɛ̄hi, cɛ̄ lɛ úgbéenyi ā kóō má ceyī nū á.

eng_Latn: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Udɛ́dan bī īlī uka kú ɔnya le cílá ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ nāa je lá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā cokónu dóódu mla uwá, ámāŋ ka aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá kē jé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ō yá olɔhi ā, aá jé cāā ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo yá ɔdā olɔhi ā wɛ ɔyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le akpa nɛ̄hi kú ɔcɛ́ gbā lɛ ɔ́. Ɛga ōhī kú nū wɛ oje ɔdɔ , āyā ōhī kú nū wɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utɔ́yi, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔyí nū Ujórām tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá je Udéfīdi abōgwú gicō, ohígbū koó le Uhádādēsa nɛ̄ anú nōo wɛ Utɔ́yi ā húmáyī kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄ ā yálé. Ujóram bī ɛhi kú ugóolu, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje udɔ gē lɛ Udéfīdi dúú.

eng_Latn: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Unówa jāhɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄ ukɔ́ ohígbū ɔdā nōó gáā yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nōó lɔfú má ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā á. Ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō anɔ́ɔ ó le úgbéenyi gwó nōo cɛ̄ le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē le nyatá. Oŋmá lɛ ɛ̄nyā ó lɛ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ŋmɛpɔ̄bí, nōó kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū ohígbū ɔtū nōó le ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
idu_Latn: Ā géē je odúúdú ɔdōlé kú nū nāa lé ɔ́ɔmā gba bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ocɛ̄tra nɛ̄ a cɛ̄tra ɔ́ kpɛ́mm ā, kwú pīya eko o kpó bónū.

eng_Latn: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD's temple was laid, consider it.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī ofu cɛnɛ kú ɔyā ahāanɛ, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá lɛ ikpínu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tá ajɛ kwɛyí nyā. Aá géē má ɔ́dā nōo géē yá ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn bá ī kpɛ́fú ta Ujerúsālɛm, le íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄. É kē lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū um ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ ācogbāājɛ gē bá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ aá lɔfú bī le gɔ̄ glá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá cíkā ō yɔ̄ ipú ɔtūnōbí cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā nū ŋmá icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē tá kéē lɛyítáayɛ lɛ íne kú um gaá kwú ā?.

eng_Latn: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā um le iyó ogbɛnú ce aá nɛɛ, n géē gbō iyó ogbɛnú fíyɛ́ ce aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka itali ɔlamu nōó bī le gɔ́ aá á nɛɛ, ami ā géē bī itali nōo lɛ ujē le gɔ̄ aá.

eng_Latn: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
idu_Latn: Aá, ācɛ kú Ugalésīya, aá lɛ ikpɛ̄yí ō bī gbɛlá ŋ́! Ɔ̄nyɛ yá aá ɔhɛ āa? Iyɔ̄bū aá nɛ̄ n yá ocābɔ̄ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nyɔ́kpá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ássīdɔdu mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Udégɔn ā í gē lɛ ikpó da abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yɛ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, jāā kwu ícɛ nyā ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá ī bēhé ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, háyi ɛyí ajɛ oōŋmó ɔtahɛ́ kú ísu a jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ a le pɛ́ bēhé ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And then the LORD's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ le yá lɛ ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē cɔ̄nū mla uwá nɛ̄hi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ajɛ kwú ŋmó nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā í gáā yá gla gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē pɛ́ kwú fíyaa, ipú ajɛ olɔhi nōó jē lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á pó ka ami ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ le ojuju kú ɔdā nāa yā ɔ́ɔmā yá táajɛ á ŋ́ nɛɛ? N kē lɛ ɔ́ yá jīla ɛɛ́. N je ɔfú gā uwɔ ká ā kwú igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hɛ́ igá tū ɔ̄ ā ú pīya ɛyétutulu.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ n gē leyīkwu uwá ā wɛ úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛtá ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ . anɔ́ɔ a ka ami ɔ́ɔ géē je ɛbɛ́ lɛ uwá ɔyā odumkulu á ā?.

eng_Latn: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
idu_Latn: Nááná, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔmā piií ā kē kpó agbénú nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ ā lɛ uwá á. Amáŋ ń jɛ́yí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ujeremíya,eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā, ámāŋ ācomɛ́ɛ́bɛ, ámāŋ ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwɔ ka, Ɔdí wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka āa? Da uwá ka, Aá wɛ unwalu kú Ɔwɔicō á. Ó kē í kpó aá tá bónū.

eng_Latn: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo kwu alɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ka éyééye ká aá kóō lɛ ɔtūcaaca kú nū bī gaajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī leyīce ɔ́ ā kóō le yá ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ɔyí álá ā le ɔja ɔ́mɛhīlī ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā, ajɛ le jíliyā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ɛnɔ kwú pīya onōbí fiyuu bɛ̄ɛka īlī ekwu ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔyā kwú pīya ɔnɔ̄wá dúúdú bɛ̄ɛka oyī ā á.

eng_Latn: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.
idu_Latn: Aájī igwó ɔ́ɔmā, wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ igwó nēe gáā gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ɔcɛ́ ɔhá kē ī wā, ó kē ī wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ohile ā tá. Ó kē í je aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá ā kpó nū wā ajɛ ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ, nōo wɛ Umósīsi ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le lɔhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī okoolo éyi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ le blla ɛna mɛ́mla omlede dóódu ā. Ó í bī ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū blla ɔyí álá dóódu ā. Ó géē bī ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ olífu le gwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi yá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da nōó je ā píii. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā le yɛ odúúdú ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gaá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbaáluka, pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
idu_Latn: Tú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛlá kwu ɔdā nyā, lɛ uwá ɔhɔ̄ pi lɔɔlɔhi iyɔ̄ɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, ká ē híī yíkpɛ́lā ohígbū ɛlā ŋ́, ohígbū ka o túile dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ó i ŋmó alelékwū tū iye kú ācɛ nēe i jāahɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
idu_Latn: Íssbɔ̄ssɛti í da Ábna ɔdā dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū kóō gē yúúfi nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ocɔkpɛ́nú kú ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā má ŋmá eyīyɛ̄cɛ, ó gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ékpónú ŋmá ajɛ jāā kwu icō. É lɛ agidigbé ɛpa gwó kwú ɔdɔ kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛcɛ kú aínīcō nyā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē yɛ ŋmá inīcō éyi ga inīcō ɔ́mpa mɛ́mla ɔ́mɛtá ā gláá.

eng_Latn: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
idu_Latn: N géē ga Íjīpiti mɛ́mla uwɔ, n kē í bī ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ cīgbīhi wā ipú ajɛ nyā. Ujósɛ̄fu géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwɔ eko nɛ̄ ā í kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā nēe kwúcē Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá Ugálīli ā le yɛ mla Ujósɛ̄fu gaá le únóji ā má mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si gwutá anú lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā o hile nɛ̄ a lɛ bá ɛcɛ ā kpó tū ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ. Ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛ́cɛ̄ í yā klá aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá ɛcɛ nēé kpó wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā, odúúdú uwā géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla aá, aá klla í jé ka ami Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. Ɔwɔ ɔhá í yɔ̄ gwū um tá ŋ́ má. Uwēyī í klla gáā kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā í lɛ ā ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ɔtāhɛ̄ aá, ó géē cɛ̄ ācɛ ohile ɛhɔ̄ piíí.

eng_Latn: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ aá gā ɛga nɛ̄ ɛɛ́ bá, Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn mɛ́mla Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gáā le unu nu tá aá. Ó ka amáŋ aá lɛ uwá kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu ma Ujósɛ̄fu ɔbá kú Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ Ujísɔ̄si. Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔmā nēé hī ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Umósīsi ka, Ɔwɔicō, Óndú ā géē tū ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ipú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tū ami abɔ̄yī um ɛhɔ̄ ā. Aá géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōó géē da aá ā.

eng_Latn: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔwɛ nyá nēé í je ācɛ nēe tá ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá gɛ ŋ́ mā cīgbīhi kéē le pīyabɔ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā? Ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ ka olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, ācɛ nēe lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tū ɛhi kú ɔkpáncō klla mīyɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nōo bɛyíkwu Usólōmɔn ā wɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébāti nōo ŋmá Usérēda, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ā. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ ɔnyōkwū éyi nēé hī ka Usérūwa ā.

eng_Latn: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ ágábá ā gbēyī jāāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó má ka anúɔ ɔ́ lɛ eyīyōce lɛyíkwu ɔɔ́ gɛ ŋ mā. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɔyí nū ɔhá bī jɛ, ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔyí ā ú ga inīīcō kú Ɛláyíssa, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwutá agōdō kú Ɛláyíssa le ɔwɛ gwū tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi eko nēé gekwū, nēé kwú uwā í nyi.

eng_Latn: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Udɛbɔ́ra, ɔnyā kú Ulápīdɔ́tu ā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́. Anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí klla wɛ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
idu_Latn: É klá gāa ga ɛga īyī ede nēé bī abɔ̄ kú wā ma a, ka ɔɔ tá aá abɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē kpó ɔtū ce úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú uwá a, mla icɛ̄bɔ̄ mla ɛ̄cī kú Ássɛ̄ra mla ede nēé ge lɛ ɔtulalī kwu ɔlá la ɔɔ a ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
idu_Latn: ká ācɛ o hile ā kéē dɔɔ̄kā Óndú ā, uwá mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá dóódu nēé bī iyē kú um hī uwā igwú ā.

eng_Latn: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ī má ka ɔkwɛ̄yi ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄, o ŋmá lɛ ō je ɛlā ká ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā yɛ́fulɛ́fu tū uwā okónu.

eng_Latn: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá yálé kú ufi kóō lɛ uwá kwú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ké ē le pɛ́ gekwú ipú uwēyī kú uwā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ímálānyī, olɔhi o cē kwu iyī ɔ̄cɛ ōfūnū yɔ̄, ɛdɔ kú ikpɛ́lā, ácɛ̄tɔ̄há ŋ́ mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí dúúdu gē le kpɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ōmá, mɛ́mla ɛbā ō kpó ācɛ nyíleyī kú aá ɔ́ɔmā mɛ ɛɛ́. N géē hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā māháyi ɛháajɛ kú odée yɔɔlɔ ā, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ lɛ acá ɛpa kú nū nańdaa kwú ɔ́mpānū nōo gboce ɔ́ ā. É klla kwú aácá ɛpa ɔhá ā í cē klá iyē kú uwā.

eng_Latn: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú úklɔ́ kú ō bī ijē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā nyā ú tū Ásāfu mɛ́mla Ulífāyi aɔ́mpānū abɔ̄ ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā. Uwá géē bá í gwííjē nyā iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
idu_Latn: Ó kwū ābɔ̄ ɛtá. Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ēpū kú nū le lū ā, ohépu kú nū gɛ̄ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le gwá klla le pīya á.

eng_Latn: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē yá aólɛlā nēe cīíbɔm tū um ā lé. N géē lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí í tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n géē ga ipú Agbliihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū gaá gwɛ́ɛya ā. N géē bī ɔkɔ ō lɔnyɛ í gwíije í cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya ā da ɔ́ kóō gbēyī ɛ́ɛ́, kéē wā í tá aá nɛɛ, ɛ́ɛ géē bá ɛga nɛ́ɛ bá ā.

eng_Latn: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ alɛwa nēe gbɔbū ā abālɔbányā ā, géē gaá tíigbīhi. Ācɛ nēe kē tíigbīhi ā, géē gaá gbɔbū.
