eng_Latn: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú ágēnégēne kú ɔfú kú nū ā, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū í je kɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ. Ɔcɛ́ nōó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú nū ŋ́ mā géē lé kwɛyí nū, amáŋ ó gáā lɛ ɛdɔ ɔfú nōó lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛháajɛ kú nū miya. Ó kē wɛ ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híīī bī aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ mla iyī uwɔ ŋ́, ohígbū kú Óndú ā í yɔ̄ mla ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ ɛhícō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛhɔ̄ lɛ kú ā klla lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā gwó inu, kú ā lɛ ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī uwɔ lɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ a le jé kpɔ́cí ka ɔdā ō bī yábɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā ŋá anúɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
idu_Latn: Áhābu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Éyi yɔ̄ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́, Umikáya, ɔyí kú Ímla. Amáŋ ó he um ɔtū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ olɔhi dúúmā lɛyíkwu um jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú um ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ó gē má á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhósāfati tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ā ka lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē cíla ulé kú ɔdā otīihɔ nōó je lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́ mā piíí. Ó klla géē gbā ɛga ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ kú nū. Ó géē je ɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú ɛbɛ́ ā ú gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú íne nōó bīya ā í yá ɔ́ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ahāapa hile nēé lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ajɛ kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ī ka ka aá jé odée ā, é kwú pīya aólíla.

eng_Latn: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ī gáā plá ɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛyí kú uwá gē gwā nɛ̄hi ŋ́. É géē bá ī wā ɛyí kú uwá tá eko nū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
idu_Latn: N le tá cāŋjɛ nyɔ̄ gáā nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́. Umáari klá um abɔ̄, enyi nū kē yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ŋmá um ayíkābɔ̄, abɔ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛga onwūla ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í kpéeko bónū ŋ́ nɛɛ, alɔ í géē le yɛ pīyɛyí igbɛɛpa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
idu_Latn: Aíta lɔfú je ogwuda pīya ojéeyī nɛ̄hi glá. Ó klla lɔfú nwū aɛ́drɔ́ kéē yá ɔdā nōo í tá iyī uwā abɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā alɛwa ō ka gā awɔ, amáŋ ń tíne ō tá ɔ̄ tū ɔkpá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
idu_Latn: N lɛ odée lígíí tá tū ɔkpá fu ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā lɛyíkwu ɛlā ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Udiyotrɛ́fīsi nōo tíne ō le pīya otrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā í gáā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
idu_Latn: otɛ́yí wāajɛ, ogbēyīcíí. Íne dúú í yɔ̄ nōo ī ci ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ucē ɔwɛ dúúmā nēe bá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
idu_Latn: Aá klla géē mīyɛ odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā nēé hɛ igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi tū ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá dúúmā nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Aá klla í mīyɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá, í je īkpɔ̄cí kú uwá kpó hɛ́ wāajɛ. Aá klla í kpó ɛcɔ̄ gwu klá ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō kwú bīya.

eng_Latn: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
idu_Latn: Uklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ Udánīyɛlu gē yá ā kwú ɔ̄ ú kwɛɛcɛ péee ka anú ɔ́ɔ fíyɛ́ aɔ́mpa nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aígbómína ofɛhīlī ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā le ŋmótū ka anúɔ géē je ɔ́ yá otrɛ̄yí dúúdú kú odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī, Alɔ cēyītīkwū kú alɔ tá ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn abɔ̄ amáŋ ó tōo yá gɛ ŋ́. Ālɔ̄ mabɔ̄ uwā tá kú ɔnyɔ̄ɔ̄nyɛ kóō nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛnɛ. Italā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn le nwuné fíyɛ́ abɔ̄. Ó kōō tōō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenáya le tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā gaá le Ujówābu ŋmó abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyī ɔlɛ́ nū ipú ígbíli á.

eng_Latn: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
idu_Latn: Aá híī hɛ́pɔ̄ ohígbū eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ aá ka ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɛpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nōo yá íkííkée ŋmífí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ācɛ wā ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ jila ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ó da uwá ka ɔdā nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́ɛnyā yá jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā pó ka ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́ɛnyā yá jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ íne kú Umósīsi bīya, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa ámāŋ ācɛ ɛtá lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ tū ɔ̄, eyīnyinyi dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄ piíí.

eng_Latn: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Aá híīī bīya ɛcɛ, ámāŋ ísu nɛ̄hi ā ámāŋ aɔ́cí ɛ́ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
idu_Latn: Ó gē mī oyī ā klá ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ agwú kú nū mɛ ā igbo ahāapa. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka agwú kú nū mɛ ɛɛ́, kóō le yá yēŋēē ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā je ígbáanɔ̄ nōo yēeyī ā tá gicō kóō kwú wu ga ipácí.

eng_Latn: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé lɛ ā, ohígbū kú ayínɛ́ um mɛ́mla aóklóbīya um ā, n yɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ Ujerúsālɛm eko dóódu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ ā.

eng_Latn: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
idu_Latn: Owu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē fu ā gē je éŋkpɔ̄ kwú bá ɔhá kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó kwú pīya ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ kɔ́ŋgɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá híī yúufi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō wā gaá já aá má, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá kú aá yɔ̄ ī yúufi nū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bīya íne kú nū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú nū ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, úklɔ́ ohídáagó nōó yá ā klla nwuné dúú. Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó. Ó géē cɔcɛ́ o ŋmá ɛ́gɔ́ éyi ga ɛ́gɔ́ ɔhá gbógbóō.

eng_Latn: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó nɛ̄ ó kwú abɔ̄ kú nū í gicō ā, aícɔ́ɔja nēe húmáyī ī tayínū ā, le bɛ̄cɛ fíya gaá mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, klla kwú ɔlá ú hɛ́ kwu ɔ́ bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ūwā, nōo kpó ūwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔhá gwū anúɔ tá gɛ ŋ́. Ka anúɔ ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá kú ūwā á.

eng_Latn: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ alɔ pó ā, alɔ í mlɛ́nyɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū aá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Alɔ gē ba Ɔwɔicō kóō le yá kú aá lɛ ɔdā nōó dɔɔ̄kā ā jé lɔɔlɔhi, kú aá jéeyī klla jɛ́ɛyí odée ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú nū ī je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
idu_Latn: Usílpa klla le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
idu_Latn: Gbɛlá kwu aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā, ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē je ɔfú gā uwɔ ká ā jɛ́yí ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔnyā uwɔ géē je pīya akwuna ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ɛfú géē lé ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mla ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nya piíí. É kē í miya ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kē í je ɔ́ kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá. Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ kē í kwú ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ opɛ̄cí. É kē í kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄fú ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā gaá lā ipú éwɔhá piíí.

eng_Latn: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ nyi ipú āyā nōo wɛ ajɛ kú nū ā, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Utímatisɛ́ra, ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem, ɛhíícō kú ɛfu kú Ugáassi ā.

eng_Latn: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, abɔ̄ Óndú ā nɛ̄ o lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kwú cɔ̄nū ā, ōwē kú nū nɛ̄ ó je lɛ ācɛ ā, yɔ̄ í yi bɛ̄ɛka ɔla ácí úgbá ā, ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā, é géē je ācɛ dóódu kpó yífi.

eng_Latn: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
idu_Latn: nōo géē kpó uwā trɛ̄yí eko nēé í kpɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ójila kú ācɛ kú uwɔ ā kéē híī lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbo uwā ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the captain of the LORD's host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ áblákpá kú uwɔ plla, ohígbū ka a háyi ɛga o tīihɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá eko nōó ŋmá Ujudíya wā Ugálīli á.

eng_Latn: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā pó ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ lɛ uwá ŋmá ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ, Umíssalu, Ábudɔn.

eng_Latn: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bā gē kpɛ́fú ā, ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti éyi lɛ ɔyī tá gaá gbo Ujosíya kli. Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kéē kwú anúɔ í ga ɔlɛ́ ohígbū kée le ágbe yá anúɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé, n géē je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō cɔɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla um ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ɔfú kú ebilíi lé, kē cɔɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ádā um akpa kú ɔ̄cɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka unwalu mla ífi kóō yɔ̄ lɛ uwá, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ klla kwú ɛyí í bú kwu anúɔ. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpó ūwā yíífi. Ó klla ka anúɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō nya uwá tá dúú, amáŋ é le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā bá anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usenakérīibu yɔ̄ ī pā ɛcí ipú ikpɛ́cí kú nū nēe hī ka, Unisrɔ̄ku ā. Ayí abɔ̄yī nū ɛpa, nēe le ka Adramɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Usarésa bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gaá kwú ádā uwā nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ú ŋmó tá abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú pɛ́ kwu ga ajɛ kú Árārati á. Ɔyí Usenakérīibu ɔhá nōo lé ka Esarhádɔn ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā a gēe cīíbɔm tū igelī ā kéē kpó ācɛ kú igelī ā ŋmó. Íbɔm nɛ̄ aólɛlā ā gāa cē tū uwā ā géē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá igelī nɛ̄hi ā géē bá ī cē īyī uwā lé klla gē bá ī kpó ayí uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā, kwúcē ga Usamérīya mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ɛlá ōgbo á.

eng_Latn: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē je ɔdōlé nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ aá lé nīipú. N klla í je ɛnwú kú ipácí lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kɛlā gē táafú mla ācɛ Ujíyu nēe ī ka Ugríiki ā, amáŋ é dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nēé géē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ŋgbá kú owú odufā otíkōtō gɔ́ tū okónōgwu ikpó kú nū eyɛ̄cɛ mla eyīpú.

eng_Latn: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ kú okómpinu ā, lɛ ukɔ́tin nɛ̄ olɔwá kú nū wɛ uyádi ahāapa ce āyā mɛ́mla ɔ́kpa ɛtá mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ o wu ɔ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ó da ācɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ka ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā gáā yá ūwā ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi nēé bī ā. Ó klla ka ka ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ́ɛ géē gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú ā, ɛ́ɛ géē je ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄l ŋmó.

eng_Latn: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu gaá le ɛlā nwū tū um otū ohígbū nū, gē ba ká amíyɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
idu_Latn: É le íbɔm ā cē tū ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ā jāā gbō ipú iháyí ɔmigwóléyi nɛ̄ Usedekíya ce ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī wā iyē kú nū ā. Alɔ géē hɔ́hā cɛ aá ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikpíinu olɔfú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le táajɛ ā háyi kli, é lɛ ɛlā nēe bá nyā tá tū ɛyí nū, Óndú ā jé ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú nū āa. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ka ka anúɔ wɛ ákú Óndú ā kóō le kwu ŋmá íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛháajɛ Ujérīko ā, é mīyɛ Ubɛ́sa, ɛyí ɛfu ā, Ujása.

eng_Latn: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́njamīn lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú obɔ̄bí ā. Ó gē lé ɛbɛ́ nōó ŋmó ā ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ó kwú ɛbɛ́ nōo hile ā ú kɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
idu_Latn: Āyā éyi kú Ugílɛ̄di wɛ ipú ajɛ kú uwā, mɛ́mla Ássitārɔtu mɛ́mla Ɛ́drēyi, ɔlɛ́ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan ā. É kwú odúúdú ajɛ nyā ú lɛ āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ nōo wɛ ákú ɔyí kú Umákɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kwú ipú ajɛ nēé kwú ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā. Ó klla gáā má ajɛ kú Ujúda ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Alelékwū le ɛdɔ íjééyī nɛ̄hi je lɛ Usitífin ka eko nɛ̄ ó le ɛlā ka, é má ɔdā dúú ka mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nū ā lɛ ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ ɔ́ á, eko nɛ̄ ó má ka ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ɔyā ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ í jé ɛga nōó ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Úlam gē kpɛ́fú klla gē tá ɔyī nɛ̄hi. Úlam lɛ ayí mɛ́mla ayí kú ayí ofɛpa cigwó. Odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma nēe bá ā wɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ígbíli ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɛ ŋmá ajɛ éyi ga ajɛ ɔhá ɛbɔ́ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka unwalu yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin ka igbɛ́ɛ̄nyā, anúɔ í gáā lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá ācɛ kú Ufílístiya ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā, N má Óndú ā cīce ɛyí akpa kú nū ɔkpáncō, odúúdú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū bá mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
idu_Latn: Italā nēé yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā fíyɛ́ ákú ācɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm nēe kwú ikwū acígilí abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō náāná ā.

eng_Latn: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ í nū ācɛ nēe lā aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. Aígelī ā wɛ Ubɛtíssán, Utáánāki, Údɔ, Ublím, Umegído mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe kwu uwá ajaajɛ ā. Ācɛ kú Ukénan lā abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Uróm lɛ ɔfiyɛ éyi nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ɔfiyɛ ā yɔ̄ gē doōcē gáā kwú.

eng_Latn: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, í gáā gwá ejé ámāŋ ka ejé olɔfú dúúmā gbɔbú ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Aá géē kwú ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ yá lɛ ā. Odúúdú ayááyí uwɔ géē lɛ íne nyā tū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nā kwu ajɛ kú Íjīpiti kú efūma kéē wā í klá ajɛ ā. É géē kpó ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nēe hile ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā lé ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka iyē mɛ́mla áluka kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā wɛ, Ujedáya, ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujéssuwa wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofahātá ce igwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
idu_Latn: É lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó hīgwú wɛ̄ɛcɛ kéē í nū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu inya. Abɔ̄ nēé kē bá í nū Ujóssuwā inya ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé bá ī yɛ ligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwá ɛmɛɛma lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e tayínū ā lɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ je lɛ īyī uwā ka eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ódūdū nɛ̄hi má yɔ̄ ī gicō bɛ̄ɛka ojuja ā, ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aíyó kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm wā ā, é géē je uwá kpó kwúcē ga ɛgiyī nū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujérīko wɛ, ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō kú ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā, n géē yá uwā italā. É bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le aɔ́máapú uwā ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, kpó ŋmó. É kē ményinyi uwā ŋ́. Ánya kú uwā í kē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú uwā gbo fíyaa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa lɛ ā nɛ̄ ó yá kpɛ́mm. Ó lɛ aɔ́nya kú uwá ikpó kpó cē, klla lɛ úgbɔ́ɔnya kú uwá kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
idu_Latn: Lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne kú ɔcɛ́. Ā híī ŋmúleyikwū ká ā cokónu lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
idu_Latn: Aúnóji le kpó nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō alɛwa nēe tɛtɛ kwú ā le kpó héyī á.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa, wɛ Ahihúdu, ɔyí kú Usɛlɔ́mi.

eng_Latn: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kú abɔ́ɔ ā lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usɛ́kɛ̄m cɛ̄ ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē yɛce Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔmáapú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó lɛ ā lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Umósīsi ŋ́. N kwú odúúdu ɛwa kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ú tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn tá Ujɛ́futa ohi ka eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú anúɔ ŋmá ísu kú Ánɔn ga ísu kú Ujábɔ̄ki, mɛ́mla ísu kú Ujɔ́dan. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ anúɔ abālɔbányā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā le yá gaá yɛ ā, Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā kahíníī, N lɔfú kwúcē ga igelī kú Ujúda dúúmā mɛ́ nɛɛ? Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, A lɔfú nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Igelī nyā nɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ Uhɛ́brɔn á.

eng_Latn: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe ŋmó ācɛ klla lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū ipú ɛfú nyā a, géē yɔ̄ eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá mɛ́mla ɔ́mahāapa, aá lɛ iyī aá mɛ́mla anyā nɛ̄ aá kwú ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā iyē gwu.

eng_Latn: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ kōó lɛ ɔkpá je gā um gé lɛ aígbómína kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarētīisi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛga je gā um ka n ga Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, é géē mā ɛcí ōpā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ē lɛ okwū kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kpó fu ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é le ɔ́ɔmā yá, n géē lā ipú uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā ōgbla ɔdā je lɛ aá ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá lɛ aá nyā.

eng_Latn: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá bá ī yá īkpɛ́yī olɔfú tá anúɔ piyóo, í klla tōō lɔtūce ŋ́. Ka ée klla tá ō pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ aá pó ɛ̄nyā. Aá jáhɔ̄, odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, abɔ̄ ami nōo, we Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ, Óndú nōo yēeyī ā á, n gbɔkpá ka, Umówābu mɛ́mla Ámɔn géē je kpó yíífi bɛ̄ɛka Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra ā. Ācɛ kú Ámɔn géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka uwá ā. É géē je piya ajɛ ɔmā mla ífi piyóó, ajɛ nɛ̄ ácí le mu tū ɔ̄. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe hile ā, géē je uwá ɔlɛ́ wu klla í mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í fu alɔ kóō lɛ alɔ ŋmɛpɔ̄bí cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ italā yá alɔ ŋ́, amáŋ ó dɔɔ̄kā ō yá kóō lɛ alɔ nyatá ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
idu_Latn: Ɛfu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛfu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, ɔcí ogwá īkpō, mɛ́mla ūpū, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
idu_Latn: Eko tɛtɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ Ɛfrēm le ɛlā ka, ācɛ gē fīyégbúlú. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile le eyī kpóce Ɛfrēm. Amáŋ, ó le íne bīya, o ŋmá lɛ Ubáal nɛ̄ ó pā ā. É géē pɛ́ kwú ohígbū íne nēé bīya nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā cɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ, aá yíihɔtū tá ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō. Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄ nōo lɛ ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú íne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā je tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ó da uwá kéē kllɔcɛ́ uwā, kéē lɛ uwá tū dúú. Ó klla da uwá kéē bī íne ā le yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā he Ádā nū ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ Ádā le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī yá abɔ̄yīnū kpɛ́mm ā kpó mafú lɛ ɔ́. Ó klla géē ma úklɔ́ nōo fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e bá ā fú lɛ ɔ́, kóō hɛ́ aá idáagó.

eng_Latn: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um í gáā jāhɔ̄ ga um ŋ́, Ísrɛ̄lu í gáā lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában le tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ujékɔ̄pu, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ulɛ́ya, mɛ́mla ákú aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ɛpa ā. Amáŋ ó má ɛka ocɛyí kú nū ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Urécɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo lɛ ɔ̄na nā, kóō ka ka anúɔ nɔ̄na. Amáŋ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ um lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́, kóō kē kɛlā kú um ā tɛ́ɛcɛ kpaakpa. Ohígbū ka igbóngbō wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ īkpīgwu tá.

eng_Latn: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɔ̄kā káā má ɔ̄, é kē í ka gā uwɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ wā ɛ̄cī nāa yɔ̄ ī yá ucɛ ā, ményinyi alɔ ká ā lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nāa má glá ā je lɛ alɔ mla ɔyí uwɔ Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti le tɛ́ɛcɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́, klla le da ɛwa ā kahíníī, Aá mā ɔ̄, n gē bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ aá, ká aá lé je ka ń má ɔdā ō bī le ŋmá ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé kpó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄ ā cāŋjɛ háyi icō ā, é kē kpó ɛdɔ ɛlā obɔ̄bí ce ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n kpéyīce ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā wā ɛgiyí nū gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ó wɛ īkpɔ̄dā olɔhi nɛ̄ a nyi ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Iní nɛ̄ ácí kē ŋmá wā āa.

eng_Latn: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
idu_Latn: Ulákissi, Ubosíkāti, Ɛ́glɔn.

eng_Latn: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē kpɛ́fú lɛ ā nwū um. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɔfú bī ɔtā nōo kōō lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le kpɛ́fú glá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó nwū ā, ó kahíníī, Aá lɛlá kwu ācɛ onwū íne nɛ̄ awulú nɛ̄hi gē he uwá ɔtū ō tá klá iyē kéē yɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē túkpɛɛ́ ī hokónu ojīlīmā tū uwā ipú olíhi ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le tútū kóō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛga nēé géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú anú abɔ̄yīnū ā.

eng_Latn: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gɛɛcɛ gé lɛ ācɛ kú Unínīfɛ ka, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ, kwu aɛ́na mɛ́mla álá í gáā lé ámāŋ ka o gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē je opī nɛ̄ ulī kú Óndú ā kwú ā, gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
idu_Latn: A jé ɛga nɛ̄ ɔlá ofíyajɛ gē ŋmá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā a? A klla je ɛga nɛ̄ obū gē du ŋmá ā āa?.

eng_Latn: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ igwó yá ce ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɛhɔ̄ bá ɛháajɛ, ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá bá ɛhícō.

eng_Latn: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
idu_Latn: Ó géē ŋmó omlede ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ōhī kú oyī ā ú kwu akpáhɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, ocúgbɔ̄du abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄du abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ikpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū.

eng_Latn: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī líla ŋ́, amáŋ dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tíne ká ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɔwɛ ɛlā ōhī nɛ̄ uwá táafú mla anú ohígbū ɔwɔ ōgbā kú uwā mɛ́mla ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si éyi nōo gekwú, amáŋ Upɔ́lu kē ka lɔfú lɔfú ka ɔ́ɔ yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam lé ɔcɛ́ ā, Ussíssāki, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti wā í le ɛ́fú kpó tú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ nyā nēé géē gbā ŋmá ɔtū ékpó klla cɛ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ le pó ɛɛ́ mā, géē cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú hɛ́ odoōcē ɔ́ɔmā tá ŋmá ōcē kú nū. Ó kē í je íne dúú nōó bīya ā yá ɔ́ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
idu_Latn: Aá, ācɛ nēe gē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nyā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē gwō āa? Ɔfú kú aá yɔ̄ ī mɛ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce ágbénú kú aá, gē ka ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔɔ́ kpɛ́fú tú aá glá ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: É bī owú odufā lɛ ɔ́ gbō bá ɛhíícō kú ɔláwonī ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gáā pó ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka lɛ alɔ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usíhɔn tá, klla le odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ í le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ajɛ kú Ujáhasi.

eng_Latn: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mahāapa ā lɛ opo kú nū tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya tayínū ā le yá jīla kwɛyí, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óbō kú uwɔ yɔ̄ á. Lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄, kóō wā í lɛ uwá kpó gé lɛ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ kú odúúdú aɔ́dā oyēeyī kú ipú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla ɔlékwū mɛ́mla ipú aísu, kwu odúúdú aɔ́dā oyēeyī nēe bá ɛga dúúdú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā á. É bá gē gwííjē kahíníī, Aá cɛtra anú nōo cīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá ā. Ká aá je ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ofu lɛ uwá, klla cɛ̄tra ɔfú iyē kú uwā eko dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa kpó tú aɔ́cɛ́ ā ligbó ajɛ nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ó le uwá kpó kwú klla le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
idu_Latn: Aísu, aá gwāabɔ̄, aɛ́fu, aá gwíijē ká aá gwéeyē tɔ̄há ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔmáapu ádā nū mɛ́mla ɔmáapu ɛ́nɛ́ nū géē fūla anú, amáŋ eko nōó lɛ ije tútū jɛ̄, ó géē fūla iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā mā aéwo ōhī tá ipú ajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī uwā le já ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ Ukénan ŋ́ mā má.

eng_Latn: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
idu_Latn: Ānyɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē tokónu lɛ uwá kéē gáā nyɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɛga nōó je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā a? É wɛ ācɛ nēe bɛ́yí kwu ɔ́ ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé má uwā gɛ ŋ́ mā a, é lɛ Ujásin mɛ́mla ācɛ ōhī kú ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā kpó pi wā iyɔ̄bū aígabɔ̄ kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā, ge hɛ́ unwalu táajɛ ɛga dóódu nēé nyɔ̄ ā! Abālɔbányā é kē gā ɔlɛ́ alɔ amānyā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: a le pīyabɔ̄ klla le īyī uwɔ tū wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā. A klla lɛ īlī kú uwɔ híla yɔ̄ ī jikwū, eko nāa le pó ka n géē yá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm italā piíí ā. N klla ka ka n géē je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī le tókónu lɛ ācɛ ɔhá. Amáŋ n le ɔkɔ nāa gbā ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um gbō ŋmá ipú ukpa nēé kpla tá ajɛ gbēyī um ā. klla lɛ um gbō ŋmá egbudu kú ācɛ o yódōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́. Aá lɔfú gwá íkókwū nɛ̄ n géē gwá ā glá ā? É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ lɔfú gwá glá.

eng_Latn: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
idu_Latn: Eko nōo gē wā ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē jé ka ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. É klla í jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá ā, ohígbū ka n kē yɔ̄ amānyā.

eng_Latn: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
idu_Latn: ó da uwá kahíníī, Lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú um kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú Usólómɔ̄n ú ce ɛyí ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ kú um ga njɔlɔ kú Ugíhɔn.

eng_Latn: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
idu_Latn: Le mafú lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cɔ̄nū nwuné lɛyíkwu ucē kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Ujeremíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni cē ijáalí lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɔkɔcɛyí kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ka, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wā igbīhi um ā fíyɛ́ um á, ohígbū ka anú yɔ̄ gbɔbū gā um á.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt in any wise let the dam go, and take the young to thee; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú kpó ayí kú ígbáanɔ ā glá, ámāŋ, ɛ́ɛ habɔ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwā tá kóō nyɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwā ā kéē yēeyī likpō ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ákisi lɔtūce Udéfīdi nɛ̄hi klla í ka kahíníī, Ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ gē tū ɔ̄ eyījii nɛ̄hi. Ɛ̄nyā gē yá kóō yúklɔ́ gā um kú ō klla gbā um ɛ̄gbā eko nɛ̄ ó géē yēeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ajɛ kú um tá dúúdú ga uwɔ á, lā ɛga dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá géē wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēe géē nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ ajɛ kú éwɔhá á. Cɛ́ɛ́, ucɛ kú aá kpɛ́mm ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ n mīyɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ɔ́da ŋmá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ga ajɛ Udamásikɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
idu_Latn: Alɔ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ lɛ alɔ nōo gē gbō alɔ ā nɛ. Ó kwú ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó ce alɔ eyī gēdēē ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi gekwú ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka odúúdú ācɛ gekwú mla anú ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
idu_Latn: Ísu éyi yɔ̄ nōo ī pɛ́ klla ī bī éeyē wā igelī nɛ̄hi, kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
idu_Latn: Ɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄ncɛ́nyā nāa jɛ̄ ā gē yá kú ɔcɛ́ ā kóō yúúnwū uwɔ. Ɔcɛ́ ā wɛ ɔkpani uwɔ á, ó lɛ a, a géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ piíí.

eng_Latn: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā tá uwā ikpó ga ɔwɛ, abɔ̄ é bū Ufinísīya mɛ́mla Usamérīya, é kɛlā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aílɔ́wá pīyeyī tū Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā. Ɔ̄kā nyā yá kú odúúdú ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā kéē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
idu_Latn: É lɛ Adonibɛ́sēki má Ubɛ́sēki, anɔ́ɔ é le unu nu tá ɔ̄ á. É le ācɛ Ukénan mɛ́mla ācɛ Upɛ́risi yálé abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ kú Usisɛ́ra le eyī bū uwíndo nēé yíifa ā. Ó leyīkwu ɔwɛ. Ó ka, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ úgbɔ́ɔnya ā í pīyɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ úgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú nū í wā fíyaa ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ī piyatɔ̄há mla um ŋ́, é í je ɔ́ hɛ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ābɔ̄ ɔcí ā, ó géē je ŋmókókó, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ lɛ uwá túbá, klla lɛ uwá kpó tɔ̄lá cɛ́ɛ́ é le kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Aá je ɔfú nyā gā um dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ kóō mīyɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi alɛwa gē pɛ́ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi éyi ga ɔhá, gē dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ɛga nēé leyīce ka aá géē má éŋkpɔ̄ gwá nōo lɔfú híjēnyi kú uwā glá. Nááná, aá cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ gbɛlá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ jé abɔ̄ aá wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwā klla je ɔlɛ́ uwā ca tāajɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū ɔ́ɔ jɛga lɛ aá kú aá wā í kpɛ́fú tū uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú uwā í kpó yíífi á.

eng_Latn: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā yēeyī ā, anúɔ jé ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē ŋmó Usɔ́lu, ámāŋ ɔ́ɔ kē í kwū ikwū ɔwɔ nū, ámāŋ é kē í ŋmó ɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā pīyeyī má ajɛ ŋmá ɛga otīihɔ kú nū ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla iyī uwā, bá gē ka, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá í ka āā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá ká íkwu ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ó géē da aá ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄lā kú Ujɔ́ni ŋ́ māā?.

eng_Latn: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛga nōo tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, inu éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Īkpō kú nū wɛ umíta ofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta ofu cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú ɔdɔ kú nū ā wɛ umíta ɛpa ce āyā biílí.

eng_Latn: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubánābasi tíne ō bī Ujɔ́ni, nōo lé ka Umáki ā, nyɔ̄ mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gē wā ɛgiyí ɔlá ofíyajɛ, kéē le jé keé yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā kē lɛ ucē okpaakpa. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ucē okpaakpa mla ucē olɔhi kē he ɔ́ ɔtū á. Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā kē í má Óndú ā eyī.

eng_Latn: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint them for himself, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and some shall run before his chariots.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nōo géē gbō aá a géē yá aá klla í gbō aá lɛ á. Ó géē je ayí aá nɔ̄nyīlɔ kpó pīya ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnya kú nū, é klla í bá ī kwinya tá iyɔ̄bū aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ūlī tá kóō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī lɛyíkwu uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ajɛ o hile ā kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma o hile dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó ā á.

eng_Latn: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ ɔ́ɔ gē bī ojuju obɔ̄bí le plla ɔcɛ́, mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aá nyɔ̄ ga ɛyí aɛ́fu kú aá hɛ́ ɔcí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le kpó wā í lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā tūgwó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū le he um, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā um ɛ̄gbā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā kwú abɔ̄ ú kwú úwé kú Ujósɛ̄fu, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Wā í gwutá mla um. Amáŋ, Ujósɛ̄fu tá, le úwé ā plla wu ɔ́ abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu á.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
idu_Latn: Unéko kwú Ɛlíyākim ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujowáhāsi ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda klla kwú iyē kú nū ú pīyabɔ̄ ga Ujehóyākim. Anɔ́ɔ Unéko kwú Ujowáhāsi ú ga Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
idu_Latn: Ubígifāyi wɛ ācɛ úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofɛtá ce ahāapa.

eng_Latn: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɛ́fu ā lɛ uwɔ má ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi éŋkpɔ̄ kē gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō, éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ɛcɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō cēnyi wɛ̄ɛcɛ, klla gbɔɔ́ ō túgbagwú nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ gicō lógólógó.

eng_Latn: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā kahíníī, Āgā lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ, nōo bī āgā gē yúklɔ́ ā glá ā? Kɛɛ ka ɛ̄wā lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ, nōo bī ɔɔ yɔ̄ í hɛ́ ɔcí a? Lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔda nɛ ɔci ge je ɔ̄cɛ ga icō gla. O lɛ a gla ŋ.

eng_Latn: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyɔ̄ gáā lá anɔ̄ ā, ɔ̄cɛ olɔnyā ā gā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe tútū ā le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā mɛ́mla anú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔwɛ gwū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā tū, oŋmá lɛ ō yá ɔdā nēé ka ipú aíne ā mɛ́mla ufi Óndú ā ō yá.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N wɛ̄ɛcɛ ká n̄ hɛ́pɔ̄, ká ācɛ nēé mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ, ká ācɛ nēe mɛ́ɛbɛ ā kéē lɛ pīya opeyī.

eng_Latn: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
idu_Latn: A ka nááná Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í tíne ɛga kóō yá anúɔ ōwē kpɔ́, klla yá anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka olɛlā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
idu_Latn: N pó ɔdā nōó ka ā, amáŋ ń jɛ́ɛ́yí nū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ɔwɛ nyá nōó géē ŋmɛ́yí āa.

eng_Latn: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ onwū ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā kéē le eko kú uwā taajɛ yɔ̄ ī cā ɔcā mɛ́mla o le ka ɛma nɛ̄ ó lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́, aɔ́dā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ī bī áafú wɛ̄ɛcɛ. É kē lɛ ɔdā dúú olɔhi o yá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ lɛ alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú jé ŋmá o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, alɔ le pɛ́ i gla Usáyíprɔ̄si ābɔ̄ eyī igbīhi owu. Ó lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ owu nōo yɔ̄ ī tá ā géē lɛyíkwu alɔ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si má ɔ̄ gē jikwū, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu nēe wā mla anú ā bá gē jikwū dúú ā, ó yɔ̄ gē hīlifu ipú ɔtū kú nū. Ó le kwú ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ugádi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi, kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá da Udéfīdi ka n géē kpó ɔwɛ ɛtá nɛ̄ um géē yá ɔ̄ italā bá lɛ ɔ́ kóō je éyi ŋmá ipú uwā. N géē yá ɔ́ ɔwɛ dúúmā nōó í je ā. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɔ́cī nū, igbīhi nɛ̄ Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ ŋmá agōdō ā.

eng_Latn: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu bī le fíyɛ́ aílɔ́wá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Amáŋ ɔdā olɔhi nyá nɛ̄ apī nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu hɛ́ ā yá lɛ uwá ā?.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe wɛ ayí óndú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm abɔ̄yī nū ā wɛ aípɔ́ɔma ɛpa. É ka ɛma kú uwā í kwu ipɔ́ɔma nēe bá ajɛ kú Uséyɛ, ācɛ Uhɔ́ru. Ulótan, Ussóbalu, Usíbīyɔn, Ána.

eng_Latn: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ má kéē gáā wā ŋ́ mā, anúɔ kwɛyí cikwū le bēhé gāá le ɛfú kpó tá aólɛlā ā. Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ lɛ ācɛ ā yálé. Ɔdíyá nēé gē wā í kpɛ́fú tá anúɔ ā gɛ?.

eng_Latn: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
idu_Latn: É géē yá oje kú ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū ifa mla íkókwū nēé yá gbla ohépu kú ɔcí nēé hī álmɔ̄ndu mɛ́mla ododó oōnwūla kú nū.

eng_Latn: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛ̄cī ékpónú, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwu kú ɔcɛ́ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ nū gaá kwú ŋmɛ́yí ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu kwú Upúrim nyā ú pīya íne lɛ īyī uwā mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā. Ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī kú Upúrim nyā gā, iháyí dóódu, é gēe lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā tū klla í ya ucɛ kú nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi tá ɔkpá kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ odúúdú ācotɔ́yī nɛ̄hi ā, kéē gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. Aá le yɛ igelī ā jīla tá biílí, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Aá cílá anú ulé kú odúúdú ɔdā nōó yá ā. Aá yá ɔ̄ ɔdā nōó yá ācɛ ɔhá ā, ohígbū koó yá ɔbɔ́cɛ, lɛ aflūmā yá lɛyíkwu ami, Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō gbla um, nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛ̄cī nēé í má mla Upɔ́lu ā tū, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ lɛwa kú uwā le pɛ́ wā ɛga nōó lā ā. Ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō klla nwū uwā ɔdā lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá lɛ o bī ɛlā ŋmá ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ipú aɔ́kpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gbó otú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N géē yá abɔ̄ lɛ aéwo ā cɛ́ɛ́, é kē í kpó ayí aá nɔnyīlɔ ce ɔkɔ, wā ɔlɛ́ gé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
idu_Latn: Ayí Ulífāyi kú ipú ācogwííjē nēe gē cɛ̄ ijē ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ubakibukíya, Úno, mɛ́mla aúlífāyi ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
idu_Latn: Yá ká n̄ lɛ ɔwɛ kú íne kú uwɔ jé, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gbɛlá kwu úklɔ́ idáagó kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
idu_Latn: É kwúcē gaá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɛdɔ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá yá ā ɛɛ́. É tá ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā, klla bá ī pā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā. Kwú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda le ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mɛ́mla aádáádā uwā ā ú tēelihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le pīyabɔ̄ kwú ɔtū ú cē Ɔwɔicō, ó géē je uwɔ pīya ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ wɛ ā igbɔhá kpɔ́. Ā cɛ̄ kéē yá ucē obɔ̄bí ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhúram klla le utánki kú oje udɔ ma. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó nwuné lɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Oŋmá okónū ogwu éyi ga ɔhá ā wɛ ikpó igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Oŋmá okónu ogwu kú nū ga ɛháajɛ kú nū wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā. Oŋmá áklō kú nū éyi ga ɔhá yɛjīlatá biílí kú nū wɛ ikpó ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Anyā, aá tɛyí wāajɛ lɛ ɔbá aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá i tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē gbō um á. Ɔdíyá pií nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī móōwē nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá yɔ̄ ī yá um ā piyóó ā?.

eng_Latn: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwā eyī nwūla kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ́ á. Ujísɔ̄si pi uwá ahɔ̄ lɔfúlɔfú kahíníī, Aá híīī yá ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō jé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔmáapú okwū ā, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í nyi okwu ā, géē je okwū ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú inu. Cɛ́ɛ́, ɔmáapú okwu ā, géē hī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hile ɔlɛ́ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā igwú ka, Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā hile yɔ̄ ipú inu mla awɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Ɔ̄cɛ ā í tóohi kahíníī, Ehéee. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔmáapú okwū ā í da kóō, Yɔ̄ cíí! Ālɔ̄ leyī kwɛcɛ, kú ālɔ̄ híī hī iyē kú Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka éŋkpɔ̄ géē yɔ̄ lɛ aá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá í nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nōó géē yá. Ácí kē í yɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄ aíjakī mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú aá í bá ī lúlé abɔ̄yī uwā ī yɛ.

eng_Latn: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
idu_Latn: Aá je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā lɛ Óndú ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe dɔ̄ɔ̄ka kéē je ā, kéē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ámāŋ ka oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n kwú ɔ́ ú lɛ ācɛ Asírīya, nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū ō gbajā tá uwá nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi lɛ ɔdā dóódu nēé tá tū ipú íne ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā, ó kwú oyī kú ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla ɛwū í wīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔnwū álá nɔ̄wá mɛ́mla Uhísɔ̄pu lɛ ɔ́ mī klá ɔkpá kú íne ā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
idu_Latn: Ujúda ma Upéresi mɛ́mla Usára ŋmá iyē ɛ́nɛ́ uwā nōo lé ka Utáma ā. Upéresi ma Uhɛ́srɔn. Uhɛ́srɔn ma Áram.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā? Amáŋ é le kpó hídáagó, ufi klla le uwá kpó kwú. É ka lɛ iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ yɔ̄ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū owu mɛ́mla úgbagwú, é kē lɛ ɛlā kú nū pó.

eng_Latn: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Uwá gē leyīkwu áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū á. É klla í tá ayí kú Árɔ̄ni ā abɔ̄ ipú úklɔ́ kú ɛya nēe ī gwó lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu ā, gaá da ɔ́ ka, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi ā ka ā yɔ̄ á, N le ɔkɔ nāa gbā ā pó ɛɛ́, n klla le agīje kú uwɔ má ɛɛ́. Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nōo yɔ̄ nyā ōcē kú uwɔ ā géē mɛ. A klla í ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ odúúdú ajɛ kú Éfrɔn, mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cí kú nū nōo yɔ̄ Umakipéla, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umámre ā.

eng_Latn: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ tɔ́ɔkpá ā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā wɛ: Ujéssuwa, ɔyí kú Asánīya, Ubinúwi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhenádadi, Ukádimīyɛlu, Ussebaníya, Uhódīya Ukélīta.

eng_Latn: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
idu_Latn: Aá le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, kú aá lɔfu tū ɔdā nōo hile lɛ aá ā iyē ohígbū nōo géē kwú dúúdú. Ohígbū ka n le má ka aá í yá aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā gaajɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ uwá ka ami, Óndú ā nɛ̄ o wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē pi uwá ahɔ̄, ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ácakpō kú aígelī nɛ̄hi ā, ɛfú géē lé uwā. Ācɛ nēe lā aípɔ́lɛ́ eyīyɛcɛ, aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí géē je uwá kpó kwú lé. Ācɛ nēe kwú í tayínū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛyí aɛ́fu ā, ōcē obɔ̄bí géē je uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ, nɛ̄ a he ɔ́ ɔtū nōó je uwɔ cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyā ā. Abɔ̄ Óndú gē yíhɔtū tá Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwɔ ú ce ɔcɛ́ ká ā hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá ká ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa éyi kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi. Ó géē yá ɔdā okpaakpa klla í hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá éwo nēé í cɛ̄ɔfiyɛ lɛ uwā ā italā. É géē kpó agbénú nɛ̄hi ŋmá ajɛ ewɔhá ɔ́ɔmā eko nēé géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ ā kē cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ alɔ dúú. Eko aflɛ́yí ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā, yɔ̄ cíí ipú ɔdā dóódu, lɛ ɔtū lé ipú ōwē nāa géē má ā, yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tɔ́ɔna, yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nāa cíkā ó yá ā dúúdú abɔ̄ nāa wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dúúmā, nāa lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū éŋkpɔ̄ ā, ó kwú pɛ́ nyɔ̄ fíyaa, eko nēé lɛ ɛgba kú ɔ́da kú uwɔ pó, é gē pɛ́ kwu nyɔ̄ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē tá uwɔ ahínyá ipú ójīla kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. N géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ipú ójila kú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu ā, é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, eko nyá nāa wā amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, óndɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ufáyin ā da otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú nū ā kahíníī, Hī ācoyúklɔ́ ā igwú ká ā gbā ulé kú uwā lɛ uwá. Gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ācɛ igbīhāajɛ ga ācɛ ogbɔbū.

eng_Latn: And his return was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē cīgbīhi wā Uráma ɛga nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Uráma nɛ̄ ó gē gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá á. Ó kē le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā Uráma dúú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ayínɛ́, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá le jīla tɔ̄há gáā lé ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Óndú ā nɛɛ, aá gbēyī ɔ́mpa aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Kwú īlī nēe bá nyā ú wu Árɔ̄ni, ɔyínɛ uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí nū iyē. Kú ā lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwa ɛyí kú ā lɛ anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū uwa ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá úklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya gā um.

eng_Latn: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Ulámɛ̄ki yēeyī iháyí úlā ce ofahāanɛ ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, íjééyī, ɔdā ōjé mɛ́mla ɛyí ɔdā ō jé cíkā nāa ī lɛ, amáŋ eko nāa le lɛ, ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
idu_Latn: N géē tóohi ɛlā ā piíí, ka ɔtū kóō cɛ̄ um fóó. N géē nwūla okónu í tóohi ɛlā piíí.

eng_Latn: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ klla í kpó ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ pīya otrɛ̄yí kú uwā. Ó ka anúɔ í kpó ayípɛ̄ obene pīya aɔ́cɛ́ nōo í gbō uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
idu_Latn: Ícɔ́ɔ́ja nyá yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ klla gē gbā ulé lɛ iyī nū ā? Ɔgɛ́ɛji nyá í gē lé īkpɔ̄cí ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin kú nū ŋ́ mā? Ogbāálá nyá í gē gwá enyāmɛ̄ kú aálá kú nū ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ujérīko ā, ɛwa nɛ̄hi yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsalɛmú tɔ̄lá kwú ɔ̄ ú wúla tāajɛ. Ó kwú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda ā ú yɔlá tāajɛ klla kwú aíyó ocɛgbá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ú wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le bēhé tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nū ācotɔ́hí ā bɛ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
idu_Latn: Ó kóō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū wɛ Umerí. Ɔnyīlɔ éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā cokónu ka anúɔ í lɛ Umerí.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó kahíníī, Aá lɔfú lé odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe gē yɛ ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
idu_Latn: A í bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ le yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ ofɛpa, ɛpɛɛpa géē yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ogbló éyééye.

eng_Latn: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
idu_Latn: É kwú ajɛ olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā ú lɛ iyī uwā, é kwú ukpɛ̄ kú aótrɛ̄yí ā ú lɛ uwá. É lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú Óndú ā, eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla tɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le tá ɛyí ɛfu ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Óndú ā hī ɔ̄ igwú ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā kahíníī, Ɛlā nāa géē ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu á yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ajɛ ō gbō kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔ̄cɛ í yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu íne kú ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdā ō gwá ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu o yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā, o bá ɛbɔ́ mla anú, mɛ́mla o lɛ ɔtūnɛhɛ̄ nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ī je ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́, Ahasíya kú Ísrɛ̄lu má gwōnū ŋmá agbalú kú ɛyíinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū nōo yɔ̄ Usamérīya ā. Ágbe kē le yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá da Ubáalsébubu, ɔwɔ kú Ékrɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ufilístiya ɔ̄kā, ɔ́dāŋ koó géē yēeyī ámāŋ ka ó géē kwú. Ohígbū ágbe nōo yá ɔ̄ ŋmá ogwōnū kū nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Yɔ̄ amānyā gbēyī um, ohígbū ka Óndú le um tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ísu kú Ujɔ́dan. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa klla tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Abɔ̄ Óndú ā yēeyī ā, nāa kē yēeyī dúú ā, ń gāa cīgbīhi gwū uwɔ tá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa bá ī yɛ gɔbū kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N le ɔkɔ kú aá pó eko nɛ̄ n tíne ō tá aá abɔ̄ ā. N tá aá abɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n tíne ō nyā aá tá ā ga ā. Aá jāhɔ̄! Abālɔbányā wɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī tá aá abɔ̄ á! Ícɛ nyā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī nyā aá tá á.

eng_Latn: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú aógbɛhá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā í tútū ō jé ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
idu_Latn: N klla nɔ̄na má ɛyí kú igwu o cɛyí nɛ̄hi ahāapa nēe yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ŋmá ɔcí igwu ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ apī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, í gáā lé ŋ́. Ɔ́dáŋ ka éwɔhá lā ipú aá, nōo dɔɔ̄kā kóō lé ucɛ nyā mla aá. Aá géē hɛ́ odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe bá ɔlɛ́ nū ā apī. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē je ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí-ápī kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɔfú lé ucɛ ā mla aá.

eng_Latn: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē je ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ɔlékwū ŋ́, ayíka é kē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ówɔ́da kú nū abɔ̄ kóō le tá īkpɔ̄dā kú nū owu, géē jíla nú ɛga o wíīkpɔ̄dā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū cē tū ɔbā, amáŋ ó géē tá igbómgbō ā tū ipú ɔlá nōó gē nyī ŋ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋmá íkííkée ā, géē pó ɔkɔ kú um klla í yá aólɛlā kú um lé. Ohígbū ka é tá kéē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā. É klla yúufi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó da um ka amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í pīyeyī kwu ɛhícō kú amíyɔ̄ da Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nēé ī gbā um kpaakpa ŋ́ mā, aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um. N gáā cɔ̄nū da aá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka n gē ményinyi. Ń gáā klá ī cɔ̄nū da aá piyóó gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urebéka kahíníī, Gwá, ɔkpani Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔjá kú nū ā kpɛɛ́ le éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́ le gwá á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
idu_Latn: Lɛ igbō ā ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ká ā lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛlā kú Óndú ā ka lɛ anú mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄hi ā, géē lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄hi. Ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā, kē í lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
idu_Latn: Aá klá ɔlɛ́ ɛga ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, yɔ̄ ī lé yɔ̄ ī gwá ɔdā dúú nēé je lɛ aá ā, ohígbū ka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ cíkā ō mīyɛ ulé kú nū. Aá híīī yɔ̄ ī yɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ga ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú usiléti ɛpa kú ɛcɔ̄ nēé tá aíne tū ɔ̄, nɛ̄ n géē kpó gā uwɔ̄ ā í kpó tū ipú nū.

eng_Latn: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unówa wɛ iháyí úlā ce ofigwó ā. Ipú ɛ̄cī igwáahāapa kú ɔyā ɛpa kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā, enyi gbɔɔ́ ō ca klɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛbɛɛbɛ. Ɔkpáncō kē le nwūla ka ɔwɔ kóō yā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
idu_Latn: Ondú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ kɛlā cɛ̄ klá Ugɔ́gu, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aéwo kú Umessɛ́ki mɛ́mla Utúbalu ká ā da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka, Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ olɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Lɛ otrɛ̄yí éyééye fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kóō tú uwɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla omlede kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́lɔn á.

eng_Latn: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́wɔ kú éwo kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugósan, Uháran, mɛ́mla Urésefa, Ubɛ́teden mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Utelása, nɛ̄ ádā um jē kpó yíífi ā, lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya glá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛlíyāmasi ɔ̄cɛ oyímabɔ̄ ā dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ Igbómína ā eyī pīya kú ō híī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usáyímɔ̄ni lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, ó má gbo kláajɛ iyɔ̄bu Ujísɔ̄si anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um Óndú! Ohígbū ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ó bīya íne.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Áwa igwɛ́ɛpa ī yɔ̄ ipú ɛ̄cī éyi ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ gē yāwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ó gáā gwōnū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó kéē kpó iyó kú úklɔ́ ā wā. Ó le ācɛ úlā ofigwó kpó kéē ca ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ō gbā. Ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ ā wɛ úlā ahāanɛ .

eng_Latn: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, igbīhi iháyí ɛ̄nyā ā, iháyí ahāapa kú ɔkpɛtā géē gbɔɔ́, nɛ̄ ācɛ géē je mlanyī odúúdú iháyí kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cabá ā ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā ā géē je ajɛ kú Íjípiti yíífi.

eng_Latn: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kóō kahíníī, Ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
idu_Latn: Óndú, yá olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá olɔhi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
