idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anúɔ yɔ̄ gē da uwá kéē kwú ikwū ámāŋ ka oyēeyī ú. Kéē kwú ɔhā kú Ɔwɔicō ú ámāŋ okónu ō tá kú nū ú. Ó ka anúɔ hī ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ajɛ ijáalí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē je ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kwú oyēeyī ú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tá ɔwɛ yɛ ipú ísu, klla hɛ́ ɔwɛ bū éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, é hī aá igwú kú aá le pīya ācɛ ō lɛ iyī aá, ó lé ka aá híī bī iyī aá ō le ā lɛ je ɛga lɛ unwū kú ɔkpíyē kóō gbō aá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá jɛga lɛ ihɔtū kóō cɛ̄ lɛ aá tá iyī aá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu nyā gē pɛ́ lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, gaá bū ɔpɛ́ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ísu nɛ̄hi kú ɔmā ā. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó le pɛ́ ga ísu nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, ó í je ɔmā kú ísu nɛ̄hi kú ɔmā ɔ́ɔmā na ŋmá anú klla je éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū yá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ācɛ kú Ukaftorím nēe ŋmá Ukaftɔ́ ā, le ācɛ kú Áffim nēe tɛtɛ lā aípɔ́lɛ́ jāā ga Ugása ā kpó yíífi. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ gaá lā ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ okónu Ísu kú Umeditaréníya ā, jāā ga Ugása á.

eng_Latn: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ īkpō kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólíifu ā kpó wū ŋmá ico, ka ɛ́ɛ nyɔ̄ gaá wū aɛ́nɛ̄ e hile ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá lɛ ayókwū, anyōkwū mɛ́mla aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔcɛ́ kú Usamérīya géē je yíífi bɛ̄ɛka āpū kú ɔcí lígíí, nōo ce eyī éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
idu_Latn: Óndú, pīyeyī má um, ká ā ményīnyi um. Ohígbū ka n klá cíí ōfōōfū um, í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́. É klla bá ī yá um ōwē.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
idu_Latn: Aá pó abɔ̄ n da aá kahíníī, N géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄, n klla géē wā ɛgiyí aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yíihɔtū tū um nɛɛ, aá géē gwéeyē, ohígbū ka n gē nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ádā ā, Ádā ā kē nwuné fíyɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ɔkpɔ́ɔmā gwá īkpō kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ā glá ā, kɛ̄ɛ ka alemú gwá ikpō ɔkpɔ́ɔma glá? Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā éŋkpɔ̄ ɔmā í yɔ̄ gbóógbó lɔfú je pīya éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi ō gwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Á gáā hɛ́ ɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́. É géē kwú uwɔ klla í bī ɔ̄ gé lɛ ɔ́. A géē bī eyī kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ má ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, klla í kɛlā mla anú abɔ̄yī uwɔ. Ó kē í bī ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ Ubábīlɔn mla anú.

eng_Latn: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē kwú ulé dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔ bī uwā ā í yá uwā ɛhi ipú iháyí ɔ́mahāapā ā.

eng_Latn: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da Useráya kahíníī, Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a le tá Ubábīlɔn, yá kú ā lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n tá tū ɔkpá ɔ́ɔmā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm lɛ ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja ɔlɛ́ nū nēe lɔfu fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔgbɛ́fú. Aóhile kú uwá ā géē kpó pahīla klá ɛga dóódu. Eko ɔ́ɔmá ā géē jé ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.
idu_Latn: É da ɔcɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ aá, ká aá tíne ɔ̄cɛ nōo jé ɔ̄ gwō ɛ̄ngwū, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā, wā í yɔ̄ ī je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō bēē gwííjē lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú eyī kóō gbo ɔ́ gɔɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ klla kwú lɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ abɔ̄ alɔ í lɔfú habɔ̄ ō yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ má ā klla pó ā tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ íne nɛ̄ aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ, nēe tá ɛlā kú um klla bɛ́yíkwu um ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umówābu gēe je ikwū ohígbū ōwē nɛ é gāa má a; Uwá gē je ikwū eko dúúmā nēé le blakwu ɔdōlé oolɛɔhi nēé tɛtɛ gē lé ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ukɛ́ hɛ́rɛs a. Ɔtū gēe wú uwá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā ā jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā. Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā, anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dóódu cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ujeremíya, nyɔ̄ gāá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ okónu igá kú ɔlɛ́ ācɛ nē é hī ka Ubɛ́njamīn ā, Okómpinu, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda gē bū ga ɛcɛ klla ī bū wā inu ā. A klla í ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gāá cɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ okónu igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō, nōo ī má ipú ɔtū kú ācɛ ā, jé ɛlā nɛ̄ Alelékwū ā yɔ̄ ī ka ā, ohígbū ka Alelékwū ā gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú ohígbū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔwɛ nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō gáā yá, ó gē lɛ da ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū gbɔbū.

eng_Latn: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ éyi da um ka amíyɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna gbōmgbōm. Anɔ́ɔ n dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔna kú ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē tá āa? Ɔkɔ ā kahíníī, Tɔ́ɔna ka odúúdú alɛɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo ī gbojī ō kwú ŋ́ mā. Ɔhi kú ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ododó kú ácí nōó gē lɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī géē má unwalu yɔ̄ ī wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ olíla ā, ī wā gɔɔ́gɔɔ́ í gwōtū ipú unwalu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gbɔɔ́ ō hīíjémā igbhihājɛ.

eng_Latn: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya da Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwɔ nɛɛ, ɛlā nɛ̄ a gē ka ā, kē ī wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi eko dóódu á. Nááná n géē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā. Ɔdíyá nōó gē lɔhi lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā dúú āa? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā gē má abahi dúú ā?.

eng_Latn: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
idu_Latn: Alɔ má ka uwá í nyɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ā glá ŋ́ ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ugídīyɔn gā abɔ́ɔ ā, ó pó abɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ gē da ɔ́mpa nū ɔ̄na nōó nā ā ka, anúɔ nɔ̄na, abɔ̄ igbō le míya wā ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛ́fú kú aá, gāá ce áklɔ̄kpɛ éyi, lɛ ɔ́ catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá okónu nɛ̄ n cē mla uwɔ eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā. N kē í cokónu nōo gē yɔ̄ piyóó ā mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
idu_Latn: Éwo ɔhá dúúmā í pīya aɛ́cí nēé pā ā abɔ̄ jéjēē ɛ́ ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ ɛcí kú uwā í wɛ ɔdā ɔkwɛ̄yí ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kwú ami nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ī lɛ ojīlīimā mɛ́mla ɛgahi ā ú hīlabɔ̄ mla aɛ́cí nēé gáā tīile dúúmā lɛ uwá glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aógbɛhá ā lā ipú ígbíli bá ī yɛ bá ī tíne ɔdōlé ipú ígbíli lɛbɛ̄ɛka aíjakī ipácí ā. Ɔwɛ nyā ōfōōfūnū nēé gē má ɔdōlé je lɛ ayí uwā lé ā.

eng_Latn: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ī yá kú īkpō kóō bū klla jɛ̄ á. Ó lɛ ɔpílɔ́ tá wɛ̄ɛcɛ aflɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā ā le bɛ̄cɛ ámōōmɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́, ámōōmɛ ā, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le cɛyí mla īkpō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛlísaa í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ɛɛ́ nōó kwú ā ŋ́. Ayínɔ̄nyā ōfōōfū uwā nōo ma á.

eng_Latn: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
idu_Latn: É gē yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ó je íne kú nū ipú ɛyí ō tāajɛ mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni gē wā gáā tú agege ā tū ā, ó géē fú ɔtulalī ōkpócu tū ɔlá ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
idu_Latn: N lɛ aálá ɔhá, nēé wɛ ákú ipú igá nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N géē kpó uwā wā inu piíí. É géē pó ɔkɔ kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē je pīya ɔ́wá kú aálá éékpónú mɛ́mla ogbāálá éékpónú.

eng_Latn: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó nɛ̄ Ussíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Upekāhiya, ɔyí kú Uménāhem le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ipú Usamérīya iháyí ɛpa.

eng_Latn: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
idu_Latn: Aá í yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ikwū le bū uwíndo ká alɔ wā ipú aɔ́lɛ́ ká alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gwó lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Ikwū yɔ̄ í kpó ayípɛ̄ ŋmó ŋmá aúláyi ā. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī ŋmó aɛ́drɔ́ ŋmá aɔ́pu ā.

eng_Latn: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ ē bī ikpati kú okónu ōce ā, ga okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, nɛ̄ ikpó kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bī ikpati kú okónu ōce ā, má wu éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je aá tɛ́cɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aá nyā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá, amáŋ ka aádáádā aá í jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́ ma. Abɔ́ɔ, aá gē gbā ɔwɔ kú éwɔhá ɛ̄gbā kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, N gáā méyīnyinyi aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ācɛ nēé tɛtɛ da uwá táajɛ ā hīgwú wā ɔnū ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā. Amáŋ uwá í dɔɔ̄kā ō wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ígwu kú ācɛ ɔhá nōo ī mímálānyī ā, í tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋmá ɔtū o yēŋēē ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ɔdā nēé gē dɔɔ̄kā lɛ iyī uwā ofūnū. É gbɛlá ka aá géē yá kú um móōwē fíyɛ́, abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ agbá amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi ka, ācɛ nōo pīyɛyí ā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ o hile ā, ɛ́ɛ má lā ɔlɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́, amáŋ é lā ipú ákanya mɛ́mla uwēyī nɛ̄hi. Aéwɔhá nēe lā kwu uwá ā í kē je uwá kéē wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É klla keé da um ka, igá kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla aɔ́wɛ kú nū le kpó ca tāajɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. É ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā jéjée ŋmífī nēé je ɔ́ yɔlá tā ajɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka iyē kú aá wɛ agbla kú Alelékwū Ihɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ aá, nōo kē lā ipú aá ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá kē pó ŋ́ nɛɛ? Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ piyóó á. Anú yá odúúdú ɛcɛ á. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ í gē jɛ̄ ɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ gē gbogwú lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē jɛ́yí odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā jé ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ īkpāpī kú nū le ca, ámāŋ keé lɛ ɔ́ búdá, aá híī je ɔ́ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ipú ajɛ kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ahasíya lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nyā má ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō kwu lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ kú Ubɛ́tihāgan. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu nū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga abɔ́ɔ klla da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ágbe yá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū ga ɔwɛ kú Ugɔ́ɔ nōo kwu Ibílim ajaajɛ ā. Amáŋ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ kpɔ́ jāā ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Umegído gaá gekwú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
idu_Latn: Ufi géē yá kú ɔtū kú ācɛ alɛwa kóō gbenyi abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī má ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɛcɛ ā, ohígbū keé géē jíli odúúdú ɔfú kú ipú ɔkpancō iyē.

eng_Latn: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ géē nya alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́wɔ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nyā ā? Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aɔ́wɔ nēe kpó ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
idu_Latn: Ami tɔ́kpá kú okónu ō hɛ́ nyā abɔ̄yī um á.

eng_Latn: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ le īlī kú nū híla ipú ɔtūnōbí klla lɛ īyī nū tá fīyɛ̄ ajɛ. Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēé bá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla anú ā le īlī kú uwá híla tū īyī uwā iyē dúú.

eng_Latn: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
idu_Latn: Ā híī gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɛ íjééyī jé tū iyī anúɔ nɛ̄hi ŋ́. Yúufi kú Óndú ā ká ā kwúcē ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá.

eng_Latn: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā ó yɔ̄ ge leyī táajɛ kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā jé.

eng_Latn: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī yá ká ālɔ̄ bá ɛbɔ́ ā kóō yɔ̄ kwu odúúdú aá. Aamí.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ŋmá abālɔbányā ga eko nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́. Aamí, aamí.

eng_Latn: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ipéyī ōjīla kú ācɛ kú nū, aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō odúúdú ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: N jé ka n géē yēeyī, kē í má olɔhi kú Óndú ā ipú oyēeyī nyā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya nōo yɔ̄ Ulákisi ā kahíníī, Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá á, kócōō ā kpó ɔfú kwu um gɛ̄ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdā dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā, n géē gbā ga uwɔ kwɛ́yí nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya da Uhɛsɛkíya ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɛkpa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ofu igwáahāānɛ ce igwó , mɛ́mla ɛkpa kú oje ɔdɔ igwó gbā lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ ācɛ ɛtá ō cījáalí lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
idu_Latn: Aíne kú uwɔ ā, nwū um aɔ́dā nēe tīile gā um piyóó ipú oyēeyī kú um. É gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he um ká n̄ gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ayíkpó ɛplɛ́ɛpa kpó wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ aá yá nɛ̄ ocīkpó ā gbɔɔ́ ō yāwu ā? Ɔfú nyá nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā, ámāŋ ka iyē kú ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá bī le yúklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
idu_Latn: Ń gē lé ɛdɔ ɔdōlé ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ um lé gē tū um agba.

eng_Latn: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó lɛbɛ̄ɛka aá gekwú mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛɛ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ é kē kwú oyēeyī kú aá ú tayínū mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ipú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄ aá le má, klla kē le pó kóō wɛ ajɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ajɛ Ésīya dúúdú nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu yɛ gē pīya ācɛ alɛwa ɔtū klla lɛ uwá kpó gē da uwá ka ɔwɔ nēé bī abɔ̄ yā ā, í wɛ ɔwɔ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti klla lɛ aúgbéenyi gwó nōo gē yɛ ga ajɛ kú Ófɛ́ri ohígbū oje ɔdɔ . Amáŋ uwá kwú gbayibó Ɛ́siyɔngɛ́ba, é klla yɛ glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umánōwa le jé ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū kwu eyī í pīya klá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é klla má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
idu_Latn: Bla ka a yá um ŋmá ɔmɛ. A gáā je um gbā, ká n le pīya úmúlá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē kú aá, eko nɛ̄ aá gáā cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá. Oŋmɛ́yí kú iháyí ā, Aá géē lé ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ, eko nɛ̄ aá gē kpó īkpō nōo ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin ā mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ īkpɔ̄cí kú aá bá ɛgéégée.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
idu_Latn: A géē ma ayí alɛwa. Ɛwa kú ayí uwɔ klla í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nēe ī bū ɛbɛɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aótrɛ̄yí kú aá kéē wā Usísarīya mla um cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ɛlā kpó ce ɔ́ ɔdāŋ́ kóō le ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu yá.

eng_Latn: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē lɛ ɔdā o miya ɔdā kú újí miya odée lɛ ɔ́mpa nū ā. Amáŋ ɔtū kú ācɛ nēé gē lɛ ɔdā o miya odée kú újí miya ɔdā lɛ ācɛ ŋ́ mā gē he Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ nɛ̄ aá gē má mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo géē yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nɛ̄ aá gē ka ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Aá bɔ́bíipú, klla ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ɛ̄cī nēé í ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí klla í yá aá italā kē yɔ̄ ī wā ɛɛ́. Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī wā gáā je āa ɔkɔ hɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔyí álá ā lɛ ɔja ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā á. N má aódo kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ohígbū keé tɔ́ɔna kú ɛla kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔtū ékpónú kpaakpa ā bá ɛháajɛ ede ā.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ubálam tá Ɔwɔicō ohi kahíníī, Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu, tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ fu um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ákú uwɔ nɛ, lɛ um nyatá. N kē húmáyī cēyītīkwū kú n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá yɔ̄ ī yɛ eyī enyi ipú úgbéenyi, bá ī tá ɔhí kéē má ɔdōlé lé.

eng_Latn: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, a wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́. Awɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō je yá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi klla je ɔfú, ɔfú iyē mɛ́mla ofú gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Uróm le Ujísɔ̄si bī ŋmá agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Upáyílēti, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, é jīla ɔnyīlɔ kú Usayírini nōo ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī ga igelī ā ɔwɛ. É le ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú, kwú ɔcɔ́nyɔ́kpá ú ce ɔ́ ɔkɔ kóō bī ɔ̄ tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā pó ā, ó kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó má yāajɛ ɛyí úgādā ɛpɔ̄ ɛga nēé hī ka úbɔ́-ɛcɔ̄, ɛ̄nɛ̄ é hī ka Ugabáta, okónu kú Uhíbru.

eng_Latn: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá da, Unáhāsi ka, Óócí, aá géē cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ yá aá ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, Ujerúsālɛm ohe um ɔtū, ɔdí nɛ̄ n gē ka ohígbū uwɔ āa? Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n lɔfú tá uwɔ ɔtūlé glá āa? Ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nēe jé ācɛnyīlɔ ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ itekwú ī cēnyi klɛ́ɛcɛ gē je úkɔngɔ̄ kú nū lé ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ífi kú Ujerúsālɛm lɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tú uwɔ gwó glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn le pó ka, ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā, gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
idu_Latn: N jé ka a le kwu ohígbū ka ɔtū nwula nwula ká ā cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ yá uwɔ nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a je ɛka ocɛyí kú um uwī ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá kú uculo kú iyē o gwu kú nū ā, ó géē bī uwā wā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
idu_Latn: É le ojibó kú ɛna kú ugóolu ma ikpó ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú kú uwɔ mafú oŋmá lɛ ō hɛ́ ācɛ odoōcē tá, je ɔfú lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó oŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ Otīhɔ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
idu_Latn: Ohílīpú gē bī ojīlīmā mɛ́mla olɔhi gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. Amáŋ, ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ nēé lɔtūce ɔ́ glá ŋ́ mā, wɛ ikwū.

eng_Latn: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
idu_Latn: Ó yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā kóō le yá jīla. Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka kahíníī, N géē bī ācīije le kɛlā lɛ uwá. N géē ka ɔdā nēe le tayínū ŋmá ohútu kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N tɛtɛ da aá, aá pó ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá tíne ká aá pó gɛ? Aá tíne ká aá pīya ayíkpó kú nū nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō ɛna bɛ́ɛ, ó kē jé óndū nū, ijakī kē jé ɛga nɛ̄ óndū nū gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́ lé ā. Amáŋ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, í jé um ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō jɛ́yí ɔdā dóódu fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o ŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū nōo wɛ ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛtá kú ɔyā ahāapa ā, Usólōmɔn lɛ ācɛ ā kpó yáwa ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ɔtū he uwá nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Aá gwííjē ká aá gwéeyē lɛ Ujékɔ̄bu. Aá tɔ́ɔga lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nōo jājīmā fíyɛ́ éwo dóódu ā. Aá cɛ̄trā Óndú ā, ká aá je ɔkɔ gicō cɛ̄tra anú ka, Ɔwɔicō le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ohile ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ísrɛ̄lu mla Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Asírīya gēe je pīya tɔ̄há. Aéwo ɛtá nyā ī wɛ ɔhā nɛ̄hi la Odúúdú aéwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ a.

eng_Latn: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
idu_Latn: Ācokpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ aá nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́! Aíyɛ́fú ā kwú kpó yíífi áncā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, wherewith they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da ɔ́ ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ́ɛ yá anúɔ, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti jāā gaá kwu ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ je mlanyī anúɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ā, ó da ɔ́ ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄ eko nyā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Serving the LORD with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
idu_Latn: N le iyī um tū wāajɛ dúúdú, n bī ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ojámá nōo wā ɛgiyí um ŋmá lɛ ujɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu tū tū um ā le cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kóō lɛ ɛ̄cī éyi tū, kóō bī ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōó fu ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ka tū odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā. Ó kē le mafú lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ā oŋmá lɛ ō je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōó le catāajɛ, ɔ̄cɛ í tū ɔ̄ gwó glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó kwú tá agbá, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá ŋmá agbá ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛlā kú uwā ú kpó tū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ, ká ā híī je uwá mlanyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem ā, ó lɛ opo kú ɛfú tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē wā í kpɛ́fú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó trɛ̄yí wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí aɛ́fu abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ayí kú Ébrahām, alɔ í kē wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá ka, É géē nya aá tá ā.

eng_Latn: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
idu_Latn: Ɛlíhu klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, aípɔ́ɔma nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ā géē háyi ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugɛ́rīsim, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē ka ɔhá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. É wɛ, aípɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn, Ulífāyi, Ujúda, Ísāaka, Ujósɛ̄fu, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka oŋmá lɛ o yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā, ɔ́ gáā bī ikwū kú ɔ̄cɛ ā bá uwā ɛyí ka uwá ɔ́ɔ ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
idu_Latn: Ó gē ga ɛcɛ nyɔ̄ ī jila ajɛ nōo lɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ije kú abɔ̄yīnū lɛ ajɛ ā lá. Ó klla gē bī ije nɛ̄ ó yá le hí ɛhɔ̄ kú ucí ufáyin.

eng_Latn: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ anú, nɛ̄ Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kɛlā kú nū kahíníī, Ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú ígbíli kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā gllagwó, aá lɛ ɔwɛ kú nū nā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó wɛ odúúdú uwā cɛ̄ ɔkōōlɔhi ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ayisáya kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ̄nyɛ cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó pó ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē kú alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ alɔ lā anú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā. Amáŋ alɔ jé ka eko nēé lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ alɔ lā anú nyā catāajɛ ipú ɛcɛ amānyā, Ɔwɔicō géē lɛ ɔlɛ éyi tū lɛ alɔ ipú ɔkpáncō kú alɔ lā ipú nū, ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū gwó nōo géē yɔ̄ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú oje ā ú cīgbīhi lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ka oyá ɛ́ɛ́ kú okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ tá ā kóō híī kwú ɔyí anúɔ ŋ́ mā, anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ géē je oje ā tá Óndú ā ahínyá. Kéē géē bī ɔ̄ kéē lɛ ojibó kú ɔcí gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ma plá anú. Ó ka abālɔbányā, anúɔ géē je ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ā kwúcē lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Náaná nɛ̄ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu wɛ ayínɛ́ iyī uwā a, Ísrɛ̄lu le ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ kú Ujúda úlā ba ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛhɔ̄ kpó kwú kéē wɛ aálagbá kú ɛfú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā Usamérīya. Ó klla le iyó kú Ujúda kpó wu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā Usamérīya dúú.

eng_Latn: And he will take your menservants, and your maidservants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla ɔnya kú aá nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Ó géē je uwá kpó tū úklɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
idu_Latn: Ń yɛ í gekwú tū ipú ɛ́nɛ́ um eko nōó ma um ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Ámāŋ ń yɛ í gekwú obōōbū nōó ma um wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
idu_Latn: N nyɔ̄ ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le mafú gā um ká n̄ nyɔ̄. Ipú ojīla tɔ̄há nɛ̄ ami mla aótrɛ̄yí ā lɛ ōfōōfū alɔ ā, n le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔ́na kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛ aílɔ́wá lɛ ā kpó ka lɛ uwá. N yá ɛ̄nyā ká n̄ le jé lɔɔlɔhi ka úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá ā kóō híī bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ā yúúfi ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē gbenyi gā awɔ ŋ́. Gbo úklɔ́ ā, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā kwú úklɔ́ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ōgwó ā tū ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā kóō ci uwɔ anú ŋ́. Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, géē yɔ̄ pī uwɔ. Ó gáā pīyigbīhi kwu uwɔ ŋ́, ó géē yɔ̄ pī uwɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a lɛ úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ō gwó kú nū nyā yá mɛ.

eng_Latn: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
idu_Latn: N géē wā í nya aá tá eko kpií nōo ī wā ā. Eko ā í ligbó fúlufúlu ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó gáā gbojī fúlufúlu ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ń gáā kpó eko bónū ŋ́. N géē nya ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm tá, ohigbu ka Ísrɛ̄lu we ācɛ nɛ̄ n gē bī gwō á.

eng_Latn: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
idu_Latn: Kócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nēé í gbā ā pó, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwā nāŋdaa kwú ɔkpáncō ipú ɔtūnōbí, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ga uwɔ leyīkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā.

eng_Latn: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í ga ɔgbɛ́fú mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ufilístiya kóō gaá kpɛ́fú tá Usɔ́ɔlu ā, aícɔ́ɔja ōhī ŋmá Umanásɛ wā í kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi. Amáŋ Udéfīdi í kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ufilístiya bá gē yúúfi ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ í je ɔkwu cē kwu aá klla í gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá aá lɛ ɔkpani nū, Usɔ́ɔlu nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nū ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
idu_Latn: É ka ɔlɛ́ kú aflɛ́yí nyā eko nɛ̄ Ukwirínīyɔ̄si wɛ igbómína kú Usiríya ā.

eng_Latn: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé ókóome ŋ́. Ó lɛ āpīicɛ o kɛ̄ɛpa náaná ā, ó gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmá ɔ̄cī nū, alelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō wā í klá Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ í dɛ̄gba ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū bɛ̄ɛka ojɛɛ́lɛ́ ā. Udéfīdi kē yɔ̄ í gwō ɛ̄ngwū lɛ ɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē yá eko dóódu ā. Usɔ́lu kē lɛ óbō wu abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
idu_Latn: Ami ā náana ā, lɔfú kpɔ́tū kú um ce ɛdɔ aɔ́dā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔfú kpɔ́tūce uculo kú ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyé nɛɛ. Ami ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá lɛ ā fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā kwu ɛhá nɛ̄ɛnɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā otú ipú ígbíli, nēé kē ī lé ɛgba kú ɔcí nōo le ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwá nēe gē lé ɔdōlé mla um ā, wɛ ofu ahāapa cigwó. Aéwɔhá nēe gē wā ɛgiyí um ā, í wɛ ipú áluka nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
idu_Latn: Da Ussɛmáya, ɔ̄cɛ Unehɛ́lam ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyīlɔ gē gbolóce ɔkpani nū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā gē gbolóce ɛ́nɔ́lɛ́ nū á, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ eyī kú alɔ kwu uwɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, jāā gbéeko nāa lɛ eyīnyinyi alɔ máá.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwú ɔ̄wū ú ŋmá okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄, ámāŋ kaó lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū, nɛ̄ó gwū ɔ̄ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɛna ámāŋ ka ijakī kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá mágwōnū tá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
idu_Latn: Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ klla í yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ ɔ́ ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aínu kú anúɔ ā piyóó. Ó ka anúɔ kē í je íkwu lɛ ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ wā iyɔ̄bū anúɔ ɔwɛ ékpónú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bá nyā gē wā iyɔ̄bū anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā alɔ cíkā ō kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ abɔ̄ alɔ gē yíhɔtū tá ɔ́mpa alɔ ā. Alɔ géē jɛ̄ ɔwɛ dóódu bɛ̄ɛka Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo wɛ Otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ńŋ́móō tá ācɛ ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɛyí ɛfu éyi kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ alɛwa géē wā, é kē géē bī ācɛ alɛwa nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
idu_Latn: É le pɛ́ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ, anɔ́ɔ e gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu ā lɛyíkwu Ukapánɔm. Amáŋ abɔ̄ obū le du ā, nááná Ujísɔ̄si í wā ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hi ka Usáyímɔni má, ó ŋmá eyīpɔ́lɛ́ yɔ̄ ī wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ ɔ́ pi abɔ̄fú kóō bī ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú Ujísɔ̄si. .

eng_Latn: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
idu_Latn: É lɛ Ujísɔ̄si bī ga ɔlɛ́ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne ā le jila bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ajɛ Ujúda. N géē bī ícɔ̄nū kú um í kpó ācɛ, aɛ́bɛ́, aɔ́cí mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ yíífi. Ícɔ̄nū kú um ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nyi ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā okónu kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ó bī le yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā á.

eng_Latn: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá bī otúta kú Óndú ā kwu icō. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā géē kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki ŋmá ayááyí ga ayááyí.

eng_Latn: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ gā um gwō tū ipú ucē obɔ̄bí ipú ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kóō ī cɛ̄ gā um kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́. Ményīnyi kú um ká ā nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ tá abɔ́ɔ á. N má ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī mɛtɛ́ ɛyí akā nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɔmɛ ce ɔ́ ī pīya ɔ́ eyī kóō ma ɛtɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
idu_Latn: Tɔ́ɔna, ká a kɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ gē ka ā. Eko nɛ̄ aéwɔhá ā gáā kwú aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu í catāajɛ, kwú uwā í tá alácɛ̄, klla kwú uwā í pīya ákú uwā ā, odúúdú uwá bá gē cá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛcá.

eng_Latn: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
idu_Latn: N ka n géē lɛ icō kú ódó nyā tū gaá lɛ abɔ̄ bī aíkpō kú ódó nyā. Amɛ̄ kú uwɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú um, le mlómló bɛ̄ɛka oōgwá cukpɔɔ kú īkpō ufáyin ā. Owu kú okónu kú uwɔ gē kpóocu bɛ̄ɛka oōgwá kú ɔcí ódó ā.

eng_Latn: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
idu_Latn: N géē mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔyí kú Usólōmɔn, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú aípɔ́ɔma igwó ú kpó gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā lɛ ɔkpacaŋgelī kú um pi ɛɛ́, ka ń kē gáā je ɔɔ́ wu apɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tá ācɛ kú Ujúda ohi ka aá ɔ́ɔ lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, fíyɛ́ uwā ɛga igwó, nááná nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɔmáapú uwā ā. É klla dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē leyīgwū aá bónū āa? Ka ɛ́ɛ̄ je mlānyī ka aá wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nɛ́e gbɛlá ō nyɔ̄ í bī ɔcɛ́ ā wā ɔlɛ́ á. Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ujúda ā kɛlā lɔfú-lɔfú lɛyíkwu ɛlā ā fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ abālɔbányā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ āyā dóódu kpó tū ipú iyē ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tíne kéē wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
idu_Latn: É má ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā yá uwā lé ā ŋ́, é jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōo yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníí.

eng_Latn: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é le íne nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu bīya ā tá tāajɛ, é klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya klla bɛ́yí kwu uwɔ, Óndú, anɔ́ɔ á kē je yá alɔ ɛhi ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa kpó alɔ wā ígbíli nyā, ká alɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ kú ālɔ ká ālɔ̄ le lɛ pɛ́kwú ā?.

eng_Latn: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD's release.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í yá ɔ̄ ā wɛ ka, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ulé nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa uwā bī uwā ā ŋmónyí. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ije ā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū le ulé ā ŋmónyí.

eng_Latn: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdā nāa yá Órebu mɛ́mla Usíibu ā yá uwā. Ká ā lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā ā kpó yálé, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usálumūna.

eng_Latn: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ámōōmɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya gā ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā géē kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā géē bī odúúdú ɔfú mɛ́mla odúúdú iyɛ́fú kú nū, aɔ́nya kú ɛfú, aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla aúgbéenyi kú nū lɛ kpɛ́fú tú ɔ̄. Ó klla í nyɔ̄ í kpó aéwo alɛwa wu, bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ō cenyi klá ɔ̄cɛ wuu ā.

eng_Latn: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
idu_Latn: É yɔ̄ gē pi um ŋmá abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa, ó kwu um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú um yɔ̄ ī yēeyī kpɔ́ ipú ɛcɛ amānyā gɛ ŋ́, n tíne cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gaá yɔ̄ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
idu_Latn: N jé ka ń yá ucē ɔbíipú dúúmā ŋ́. N kē ī plla ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Īī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó habɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ámāŋ ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū ámāŋ ka ádā nū ámāŋ ka ɛhɔ̄ kú nū tá ohígbū um mɛ́mla ohígbū ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi oōtá ā.

eng_Latn: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
idu_Latn: N pó abɔ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu bá ī kɛlā tū aɔ́mpa uwā ahɔ̄, klla bá gē kahíníī, Ācɛ bá ipú ufiifu ɛga dóódu. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā tū ce ɔ́. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kpɛ́pɔ̄. Kwu aóklóbīya um nááná ā bá ī yɔ̄ ī leyī táajɛ ká n̄ le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā. É bá gē kahíníī, Ekōhī alɔ lɔfú plla anú glá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú, kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ci gwō ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́mpa kú ipu iháyí ɔ́mpa, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ipu ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē jikwū ā kéē ya bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū í wú uwā ŋ́ mā. Ācɛ nēe gē yɛhɛ ā kéē yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū í he uwá ŋ́ mā ā. Ācɛ nēe gē lá ɔlá ā kéē yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ ɔdā nēé lá ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ tū eko nēé bī ɛya gáā gwó lɛ Óndú ā á. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kwú ɛbɛ́ ú gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ó lɔfú wɛ éyi kú aɛ́na, amáŋ aálá ámāŋ aɛ́wū kú nū.

eng_Latn: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla da um ka amíyɔ̄ da ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā kahíníī, Aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ gico ɛgiyí okónɔɔwɛ kú okónu obugā nōo yɛ ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā. É klla le yɛ bū agbla kú Udéfīdi gaá le yɛ tá okónɔɔwɛ kú éŋkpɔ̄, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu klla yɔ̄ ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ce íne nōó ī bīya ā icō. Ipú alɔ cāā, ó yɔ̄ í tá Ɔwɔicō opiyɛ́lɛ́ klla yɔ̄ í kɛlā layí lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́da je lɛ anúɔ kā anúɔ híī lé ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ anúɔ gē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē kwúcē bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ yɛ nyɔ̄ Ubɛ́tɛlu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
idu_Latn: Áá híīī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɛnyá ŋ, Aá híīī lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tū ɔ́ɔmā ā ŋ́, Aá híīī lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā géē wɛ ocíbú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó, nōo wɛ oōmu mla umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā.

eng_Latn: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa kú uwɔ yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma ā, ŋmá eko tá eko, a kwú ɛcɛ ú kwu ajɛ, ó kē kwu ɛga nāa le ɔ́ kwu ā kli.

eng_Latn: So Paul departed from among them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ āā, Upɔ́lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
idu_Latn: Akpókónu kú ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá lɔfú lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā glá, okónu ō kwu ɔ̄cɛ okónu kú nū lɔfú lɔnyɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
idu_Latn: ɔnyā éyi wā ɛgiyí nū bī úkpe kú ɔtulalī nōo gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé ā.

eng_Latn: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā gē mafú ka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Óndú gē yá ɛlā ā le kpaakpa. Anú nōo gē leyīkwu um ā, gē gbō um ā í lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo géē cābɔ̄ lɛ aá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛyi ā wɛ ka, aá géē má ɔyí obene éyi nēé lɛ īlī ogbo ayí obene gbō ɔ̄ iyē gwutá ipú ikpati o lɛ ɔdōlé kú ɛbɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ̄ɔmā piíí ā, Ujékɔ̄pu cāŋjɛ, kwú anyā nū ɛpa ā ú, aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú nū ɛpa ā, mɛ́mla ayí nū igwóléyi ā ú kpó. Anɔ́ɔ é le hɛ́ ɔkpá kú Ujábɔ̄ku ā bēhé á.

eng_Latn: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī yɛ ŋmá igelī éyi ga igelī ɔhá yɔ̄ ī da ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō kéē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā yātū lɛyíkwu aíne ā tū.

eng_Latn: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ána wɛ Udíssɔn mɛ́mla Oholībáma.

eng_Latn: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē le Ujabín, ɔcɛ́ kú Ukénan yálé.

eng_Latn: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.
idu_Latn: A kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu, ú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ piyóó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka awɔ, Óndú ā kóō kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nɛ̄ Ugamáliyel ka ā. É le ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā hīgwú wā inu, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá gɔ́, le ukɔ́ tū uwā kéē bī iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é habɔ̄ uwā tá kéē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō yɔ̄ ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla úmōlō.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó gé lɛ Ujóssuwa á. Ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí nēe ga ɔgbɛ́fú mla anú ā kpó hīgwú. Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ikpó da aɔ́cɛ́ ā ɔkɔ báajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ē le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɛ̄ba kú ɔdā dúú ba ɔ́, aá cɛ̄ ka aá mīyɛ odée ā ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, eko nyá nāa géē yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ á gáā pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gē gbā gā awɔ ā ŋ́, gaá kwu ā?.

eng_Latn: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē lipú bɛ̄ɛka ísu ā. Íjééyī gē pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú okónu bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá.

eng_Latn: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū igwó kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ā yá á. Abɔ̄ ó gē yúufí kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá kú ipɔ́lɛ́ ā, ó yá ɔ̄ olɛ́ɛnɔ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ yá otú á.

eng_Latn: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā gē yá ɛlā kú nū ā le kpaakpa. Ó gē yá okónu nɛ̄ ó gē ce ā ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú nōo gē gbō ācɛ dóódu nēe kwu ga ɛgiyí nū ā ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá kwú ɛna éyi ú, lɛ ɔ́ tútū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ é gbo ɔ́ ō hī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú uwá á. É hī iyē kú ubáalu ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā kwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, bá gē ka Ubáalu, kóocōō, lɛ ohi tá alɔ. Amáŋ é pó ɔkɔ dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē pó ohi dúúmā ŋ́. É jījē klla tómbili gicō iyɔ̄bū ede kú ubáalu nēé gwó ā, amáŋ, ubáalu í tá uwá ohi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujónādāabu da ɔ́ koó lɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ula yá ka anúɔ í doōcē, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í gwutá agōdō. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ wā gáā má ɔ̄ ā, ɔ́ɔ da Ágábáidu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī cɔ̄nū ŋ́, ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ Utáma, ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā í lɛ ɔdōlé je lɛ anúɔ lé. Ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ tíne ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā í lɛ ɔdōlé ā yá ipééyī anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ ɔdōlé ā tū anúɔ okónu kú anúɔ lé.

eng_Latn: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ olɛhɔ́ ékpó lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla Ācɛ ugríisi, ka ó cɛgbá kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ eyī pīya ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, kéē klla cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ewō nōo yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔdōlé ā, nōo klla ī fɔɔnū ɔ́dāŋ ka ó má ɔdōlé lé nū ipú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō má ka ɛka ā í yá ɛgbá ŋ́ mā, nōó da ācɛ Ujíyu kahíníī, Óndú ā ka ɛ̄cī ā géē wā, nɛ̄ n géē gbo ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda.

eng_Latn: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɛ ga Ásimɔ̄n, yɛ bá ɔkpá nōo yɔ̄ ɛjī kú ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā iyē, gaá kwu ɛjī abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ɛjī kú ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ajɛ ā í gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Uhasa-Ɛ́nan ga Usɛ́nfam.

eng_Latn: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ aá, ó kē mīyɛ um dúú. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē mīyɛ um, ó kē mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
idu_Latn: N géē da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɔdā nāa yá nyā. N géē cɛ̄tra awɔ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ le jīla bá kē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ pīyatū, ucē kú olíla nōó yá abɔ́ɔ á. Ómíci nɛ̄ ācɛ gē mīyɛ lé ā gē bīya ucɛ̄ olɔhi. Ó klla ī bīya ɔ̄cɛ iyē.

eng_Latn: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ɔdā dóódu nāa yá ā tīihɔ. Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í lɔfú nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka awɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔdā dúú lɛ um kwútū, ɔkpá nyā í mafú gā awɔ ucē nɛ̄ alɔ nēe wɛ otrɛ̄yí cíkā ō ya ipú icɔ́ɔci kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ yēeyī piyóó á. Icɔ́ɔ́ci wɛ ákanaba nōo gē bī ɛlā ɔkwɛyi kú Ɔwɔicō yáyi kli á.

eng_Latn: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ bá ī bīya íne ā gɔbū kpɔ́, o ŋmá lɛ íkpékwīja kú oje nēé yɔ̄ ī ma ā, mɛ́mla ɛcí kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé yá ŋmá ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā gbo, nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ klla bī abɔ̄ yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ klla géē ka ka aá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá. Ó ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔ bá ī lɛ okónu kwu ojibó kú ɛcí nēé yá ɛ́gbla ɔbá ɛna ā okónu ā.

eng_Latn: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, aá lɛ ɔtūlé gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē wā. Aá má ɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔglɛjí gē lɔtūlé gē gbēyī ajɛ kú nū kóō yá īkpō ōgbɔɔ́lá kú nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā. Ó gē gbēyī ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɔwɔ kú igbīhāajɛ ā kéē yá klá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, n géē nwū uwɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ojéeyī ka ā. Kllɔcɛ́ ɔdā nēé ī nwū ā.

eng_Latn: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko kpií igbīhi nɛ̄ Usedekíya, ɔyí kú Ujosíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aéwɔhá nōo lā ajɛ éwɔhá ā le pó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā, mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é gā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā gaá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛhícō ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
idu_Latn: Eko le gla yɛ ā, abɔ̄ áluka kú ayíkpó ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyīla ā, ācɛ Ujíyu nēe ī ka ucē kú Ugríisi ā gbɔɔ́ ō ka iŋini lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe ī ka Uhíbru ā, ohígbū kéē lɛ ɛlā kwu anyōkwū kú uwā ipú ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī dóódu nēé ī kɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Umerí, ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo yúklɔ́ lɛ aá nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
idu_Latn: N yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ōhī italā, amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā í yá aá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Aá cɛ̄ gā um pī aá tá ɔwɛ ŋ́. Aá bá ī ŋmó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ um tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, yɔ̄ ī ŋmó aɛ́bɛ́ bónū ā.

eng_Latn: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N le ɛcá, nɛ̄ ācɛ Umówābu mɛ́mla Ámɔn bá ī cá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ī gwō ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujówābu le má ka aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā ɛ́ɛ má kwāajɛ kú ɛ́ɛ̄ kpɛ́fú tū aá ŋmá iyɔ̄bū mɛ́mla igbīhi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpó nyɔ̄ í lɛ eyī pīya kwu ācɛ Usiríya ā.

eng_Latn: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó le aícɔ́ɔja o lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ulá bá ɛga ulá, ce ofɛpa ce igwó kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há. Ó le tútū ō gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá cīgbīhi wā ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ga um kahíníī, Lɛ ɛ̄nyā tá tāajɛ. Ákú ācɛ nēe géē kwú ohígbū keé bá ī yɛce Óndú ā kpaakpa ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Alelékwū Ihɔ ā tóohi kahíníī, Īī, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi! É géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú abahi ŋmá ipú ōwē nēé má ā, ohígbū ka úklɔ́ nēé yá ā géē yɛce uwá, géē cījáalí lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
idu_Latn: Ó cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ú otóótú ɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ajɛ Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
idu_Latn: Ami, Ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā, ī hokónu tū ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄nya nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū ācɛ nēe he um ɔtū kú ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó wɛ ami ōfū um ŋ́, amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ nēe jé ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
idu_Latn: Ekōōhī é géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō klla í pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā fɔɔnū kú ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācoyúklɔ́ kú Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla ācoyúklɔ kú Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ŋmá igelī kú Ugɛ́balu ā lɛ ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí ō le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tútū.

eng_Latn: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu bī lɛ gbo agbénú á. Ó lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ alɛwa, mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla aínyākwūlūmī mɛ́mla aíjakī.

eng_Latn: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā hī íjééyī ā wɛ ɔdāhá ipéyī Ɔwɔicō. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ka ā, Ɔwɔicō gē jē ukpa lɛ ācojéeyī kóō kwú uwā ipú íjééyī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ aádáádā aá ka ka n yá uwā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um āa? É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ í bá ī gbā aɛ́cí nēé tīle dúúmā ŋ mā ɛ̄gbā, anɔ́ɔ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā kwu pīya aɛ́flɛ́ɛfu á.

eng_Latn: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ula nɛ̄hi le aádā alɔ plla, ó klla yá uwā ōwē nɛ̄hi. Ó le uwá pi ɔbɔ̄fú kéē lɛ ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gaá le yɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ami Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi, n kē ī méyīnyi, ń kē ī cɔ̄nū fíya ŋ́. N klla gē ma ihɔtū nɛ̄hi fú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛɔtūce um.

eng_Latn: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n gē tíne eyīyōlɔhi kú ācɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Ó lɔwɛ ŋ́! Ɔdā nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā wɛ ka n téeyī-olɔhi kú Ɔwɔicō? Kɛ̄ɛ ka n̄ gē tíne ká n yá ká ɔtū um kóō he ācɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ ka n gē dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ká ɔtū kóō he ācɛ kpɔ́ nɛɛ, ó lɛ ā ń cíkā ká n̄ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā ā géē mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ Ujúda tābɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē cēenyi klá ɛbɛɛbɛ, jāā kwu ɔkɔ ā. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ pī alɔ .

eng_Latn: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā. Ā cīgbhīhi kwu ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ba ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē tá iyē kú odúúdú ācɛ ka é wɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujése le Abínādabu hīgwú wā í yɛ iyɔ̄bū Usámūwɛ̄lu, Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ka, Óndú ā í fu ɛ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán, amáŋ ádā nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Utáya. Ó jé ō yá ɔdée mla ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔlamu, ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí nɛ̄hi. Ó klla lɔfú bī odufā, ɔgalúlā, mla ɛ̄tū ɔnɔ̄wá le yúklɔ́ glá. Ɛdɔ ijā dóódu nāa da ɔ́ kóō he tū ɔdā dóódu gā awɔ ā, ó géē yá ɔ̄ glá. Jɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō yúklɔ́ mla ācoyúklábɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ācoyúkláɔb nōo gē yúklábɔ̄ kú ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ má gwōnū, ń ka é gē cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ gebí ŋmá ɔwɛ nōó yɔ̄ ī yɛ ā, nōó le jé, ń koó gē kwúcē wā ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujáfan ā wɛ Ɛláyíssa mɛ́mla Utássīisi mɛ́mla Ukítim, mɛ́mla Udodánim.

eng_Latn: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya o pá ɔlá ā kɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū ipɔ́ɔnū kú ācɛ ɔlamu kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē yá ucɛ kú onyatá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú je íne kú nū lɛ uwá bū íne kú Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je unwalu dúúmā lɛ uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā néē bā í gwó ā gɛ ŋ́. Aá mā igbómína kú Ujúda, mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu tá, kéē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā gwó kwu ɛga nōo tɛtɛ kwu gbɔbú ā.

eng_Latn: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussíssāki gā Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ iyó kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda. Ó kwú odúúdú iyó ú kpó, kwu ɔkplɛ́fú kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn yá ā.

eng_Latn: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ádā alɔ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ lɔhi, ó yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɛna ā ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ōhī kú oyī kú nū ā ú. Ó le ayíkābɔ̄ wu oyī kú ɛna ā le kwu ajī kú ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú uwā ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú oyī ohile ā ú pīya tū ɔkwu kú ɛyí ede ā á. Ɔwɛ nyā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ klla le ɔ́ yá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwɔhá ā géē jé ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́ɛ ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā nɛ̄. Ka abɔ̄ uwā í yá ucē kpaakpa ŋ́ mā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n je igbīhi cē kwú uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā yá uwā lé klla kpó uwá ŋmó ɔgbéfú á.

eng_Latn: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ gbā ā lɛ ɔ yá tiihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Udáni ā le ācɛ okpɔ́cíkpɔ́cí ɛhɔ̄ fu ŋmá ipú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔ́nū kú aípɔ́ɔma ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Usóra mɛ́mla Essitawol, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gāá lɛ ajɛ ā jīla wɛɛlɛ. Eko nɛ̄ é gā Ɛ́frem ā, é bá ɔlɛ́ Umíka.

eng_Latn: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
idu_Latn: Le yá cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwéeyē, kú ɔtū kóō he um. Ká iyē kú um nāa catīīpú ā kóō gbo um nɛɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kú um kóō kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
idu_Latn: Umu ā í mɛ ŋmá oto ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anɔ̄ gē mɛ ŋmá oli ā ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a gē yá ɛhi, ā híīī lɛ ɔ́ tɔ́ɔna ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ oleyī ɛpa gē yá ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ mla ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔwɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra uwá ā ŋ́. Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, uwá mīyɛ ulé kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
idu_Latn: Ubenhádādi mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Áhābu eko nōó yɔ̄ í gwá ejé mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da aícɔ́ɔja ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í kwāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá Usamérīya. Anɔ́ɔ é má kwāajɛ le tútū kéē kpó ɔfú gwō igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ gaá lɛ uwá kpó trɛ̄yí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu ō je lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
idu_Latn: A géē da uwá ka é wɛ ewo nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nēé ī gbā ā ŋ́. Italā nē é yá uwā ā, í gē nwū uwā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kōō cēē lɛ okónu hɛ́ ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
idu_Latn: Usíkilāgi Umadimána, Usansána.

eng_Latn: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ, n gē cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ā. A lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ikwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá ohile nēe bá Utiyatíra í yɛce ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ Ujésɛ̄bɛl ī nwū nyā ŋ́. Aá kē je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī yɛce ɔ́ ā gē hī ka ɔkwɛ̄yi otayínū nɛ̄ ebilíi gē mafú ā ŋ́! Aá ā, ń gáā je úklɔ́ dúú ɔhá wu aá ɔkɔ fíyɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
idu_Latn: N géē ga ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā nyɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ uwá. Ohígbū ka uwá ā cíkā ō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ī tíne á. Amáŋ uwá nááná ā tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íkwu kú Óndú ā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
idu_Latn: N jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi, amáŋ aá kɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyi ŋ́ Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í hiíjémā kú ɔ́bíipú nōo bī ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē ka ka, Kpáyii, má ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā oo ŋ́. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ká aá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ gɔbū ipú ucē nōo ī yá ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔnya kú ɛfú nōo yɔ̄ ī kwinya gā ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko kú Ujonátan ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ɛlíyāssību klɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ nēé tá iyē kú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ é bá ī ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ géē lɔtū ō kpɛ́fú tá uwā. Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, Upúra le yɛ tá okónōgwu kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú aólɛlā kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā jɔ̄ɔ̄ncɛ́nyā kwajɛ kputúkputú, mamlamaa gblɔgɔdɔɔ lɔɔlɔhi bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū ā. O jɔ́nyā nɛ̄hi kú ɔnyā uwɔ ā kóō he uwɔ ɔtū, kóō klla jɛ̄ uwɔ eko dóódu. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā jɔ́nyɛ kú ihɔtū kú nū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka iháyí nōo hile gbɔbū le iháyí kú ohabɔ̄ odée tá ā lɛwa, ɔlá kú ajɛ ā géē nwuné. Ɔ́gāŋ nɛ̄ iháyí ā kē le lígíí, ɔ́lá kú nū géē lɛ lígíí. Ohígbū ka ɔ́lá kú ajɛ nēe yɔ̄ í je lá nyā ŋmá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ce ŋmá ajɛ ā glá nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó cē iyī nū bī.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka n gē bɛ́yíkwu odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē kpó ɛlā ŋmá ɛgíyī ɔ́mpā uwā nēé gbɛlá ka ɔ́ cíkā ō pó ɛlā ŋmá ɛgiyí um, bá ī ka ka olɛhɔ̄ kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
idu_Latn: Ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú Ássa mɛ́mla Ísáka ā, Umanásɛ kē lɛ Ubɛt Ussán mɛ́mla Úbilim mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā, mɛ́mla Udɔ́ɔ , mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā. É klla lɛ Ɛ́ndɔ, Utáánāki, Umegído mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ í jé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā wɛ ka, ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō le tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aílɔ́wá mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu kéē mīyɛ ɔhā ŋmá abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō. É kwú pīya ɔ́wá kú ɛdɔ ɔkpíyē ékpó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ uwá bū ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā á.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nú ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ká ɔ́ɔ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam ɔyí kú Unébāti bī tū Óndú ā nɛ̄ ó klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ á. Ó kē habɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá tá ŋ́.
