eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa kú ucɛ ā, ɛga kú Udéfīdi tá áncā kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da Ujonátan ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔyí kú Ujése ā í wā í lé ɔdōlé kú ucɛ ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɔdā olɔhi ā géē nya ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī acɛ nēe pīyabɔ̄ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwutá ipú únóji ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú nū, nōó bū tá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā. Ó le ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi míya gwū okónu únóji ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū bá ī pɛ́ yɛ gaá bū iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ā. Ācogbāajɛ kú ɔcɛ́ nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔja úlā ce ofiigwó nēe yɛce ɔ́ ŋmá Ugáti ā, pɛ́ wā gáā yɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gaá gbɔbū uwā.

eng_Latn: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
idu_Latn: Ɛka ɔ́ɔmā nōó gbo mla Ébrahām, anú nōó kē gbɔkpá ce lɛ Áyísīki á.

eng_Latn: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ je ɔfú nɛ̄ n gē le kpɛ́fú nyā gā um á. Awɔ gē cɛ̄ gā um yá aólɛlā kú um lé á.

eng_Latn: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ kóō ka iŋini ohígbū unwalu kú uwā. Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le iŋini nēé ka ā pó ā, ó le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔlá tū í klá ācɛ ā á. Ɔlá ā kwú ācɛ nēe lā ogwu éyi kú ɛga nēé lā í yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
idu_Latn: Íjééyī nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le tɔ́ɔna ā wɛ íjééyī kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔlɛɛcɛ, amáŋ ɛnɛ ó le fu táajɛ lɛ alɔ gbɔbū nōó yá ɛcɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ lɔfú lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ogbō-alagbá ā lɛ ɛlā ā da Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū wā kéē lɛ aá hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, aá le bɛ̄cɛ kú aá nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́ nyi ɔpɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Umówābu, nōo leyīkwu Ubɛtapéyɔ ā. amáŋ, jāā kwu ícɛ nyā a ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɛga nɛ̄ únóji kú nū yɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla óbō mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú tū á. Ɔwɛ nyā ó bī le kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn bá ɛháajɛ ɔfú kú iyī nū á.

eng_Latn: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
idu_Latn: A híī cɔ̄nū kú ɔdā dúúmā fíyaa ŋ́. Ohígbū ká olíla gē kpó ɛlā tū ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe wā mla Umerí, nēe kē má ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā, lɔtūce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí gwíijē ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Kéē klla bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā abɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā olɔhi alɛwa abɔ̄ dóódu. Ohígbū ka aflɛ́yí, Ɔwɔicō kwú olɛhɔ̄ ā ú le ācɛ Ujíyu kéē le ɔ́ tū.

eng_Latn: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī yá ucē kú ɛcí ōpā kú uwā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔyí álá, umu mɛ́mla anɔ̄ olífu ā le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
idu_Latn: Umérɛ̄mɔtu, ɔyí kú Uríya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhákōsi ma āyā ɔhá kú ɔdɔ nōo yɛ gaá ŋmɛ́yí ɔlɛ́ kú Ɛlíyāssibu á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá gā Usamérīya bōōbū ā, Ɛláyíssa le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, lɛ eyī kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā nwūla kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le uwá eyī nwūla, anɔ́ɔ é má ka aá bá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya ā.

eng_Latn: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó wɛ ɛ̄cī éékpónú ɛgiyī uwɔ é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ̄ nōo wā í le yɛ ɛɛ́ mā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka eko kpií kú otú ā.

eng_Latn: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
idu_Latn: Ufi gē yá um ohígbū ka, eko nɛ̄ n gā abɔ́ɔ, ekōhī aá lɔfú le pīya ācɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tíne kú aá wɛ ā tá. Ekōhī aá kē í má ka n le pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tíne ká n̄ wɛ ā tá glá. Ufi gē yá um ohígbū ka n lɔfú gáā má aá yɔ̄ í yíkpɛ́lā mla iyí aá glá, bá gē má iyī aá imalanyi, bá gē kpó ɔtū fúulu lɛyíkwu ɔ́mpa aá, bá gē pīya olɔhi kwu iyī aá ofūnū, bá gē cá iyī aá ɛcá, bá gē yá awanda tū īyī aá, bá gē yɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, klla bá í lɛ íne tū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛfú, le bū ɔwɛ kú Uhɛ́rɛss ā.

eng_Latn: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
idu_Latn: N je eko lɛ ɔ́ kóō le pīyabɔ̄, amáŋ ó tá ō pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá aúcē obɔ̄bí nōó ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le bá lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɛgiyí owulatu kú ɛfú kú ɔcí olífu ā, ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nēe gē yɛce ɔ́ ā gbɔɔ́ ō tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, bá gē gwéeyē í jɔkɔ gicō ge cɛ̄tra iyē nū ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi ohídáagó nēé má ā.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú alelékwū kú Óndú ā, wā gaá kwú ɔfú ú tū Usámsin iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó bī abɔ̄ áncā le ágábá ā fā bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛwū ā. Amáŋ ó da ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū ɔdā nōó yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wɛ ɔkpáni kú oyēeyī kú nū ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔfú ō yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ oyēeyī gáā lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú nū kē yɔ̄ á: É le ɔ́ gbaáluka ɛɛ́ mā wɛ ka Ɔwɔicō le ɛ̄cī kú ajɔɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ gbaáluka, klla lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́yí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē wā í gbō aógbɛhá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tíne ā, ohígbū kéē bá ī pīya uwá tū, klla bá ī yá uwā ōwē, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bá ī tíifu.

eng_Latn: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā aá lé umaná ipú ígbíli, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú aéwo á. Odúúdú ācɛ cíkā ō je ojīlīmā ga uwɔ. Ohígbū ka awɔ cíkā nēé ī le ojīlīmā ce uwɔ á. Odúúmā kú ācɛ ojéeyī mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo kú odúúdú ɛcɛ nyā í tōō le gbla awɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
idu_Latn: É lɛ agbá kwu ɔ́ ikpó, klla lɛ agbá kú oje kwu ɔ́ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔbá nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā, géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō oŋmá le opīyatɔ̄ha kú nū mla ɔnyā nū. Ɔnyā nōó kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū opīyatɔ̄há kú nū mla ɔbá nū. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā í lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛ̄ɛ, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā géē yɛ í le pīya ayípɛ̄ nēe kwú tēelihɔ, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā, ayípɛ̄ ā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
idu_Latn: Ubɛnhésedi wɛ igbómína kú Áruboti, mɛ́mla Usóko mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Uhɛ́fa.

eng_Latn: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ami, abɔ̄yī um géē wɛ ɔ̄cogbálá kú álá kú um á. N ke í tíne ɛga omulɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ uwá. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā le yɛ tá ogbeé ɔhá ā, é kwú mlanyī ō je igbō.

eng_Latn: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
idu_Latn: N je ɔ́da nyā lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔnyā ámāŋ nēe lɛ ɔbá ā. Ɔ́da nyā í ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́, amáŋ ó ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú. Ɔnyā í gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ ɔbá nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
idu_Latn: N piyɔtū kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm nɛ̄hi. Ihɔtū nɛ̄ n yá tú ācɛ ā, gē cɛ̄ gā um ī cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é hápáápá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá únóji ā ipú ufi mɛ́mla éeyē nɛ̄hi á. É le inya kwu nyɔ̄ gaá le da ayíkpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, uwēyī lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú alɔ mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ kwú ícɛ nyā, ohígbū ka alɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya.

eng_Latn: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī gē je íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú onwuné fíyɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o jéeyī, fíyɛ́ ɔfú kú aɔ́cɛ́ igwó nēe bá ī gbō igelī ékpónú.

eng_Latn: The posts went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ɔ́da je, kéē lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé klla lɛ ɔ́ tá bá ɛcɛ lɛ odóódu Usúsa nōo wɛ ɔlɔ́tāhɛ̄ ā. Eko nɛ̄ Usúsa le hútú klla le gbájí ohígbū ɔ́da kú ɔkpá kú ɔcɛ́ nyā ā, Uháman mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ā gáā bá ī gwá ejé.

eng_Latn: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ n le okónu nɛ̄ a hɛ́ ā pó ā, ɔyí nōo yɔ̄ ipú kú um ā, le jíliyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū éeyē.

eng_Latn: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔdā ɔhá nēé yá ā, wɛ o le ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā mu mla agīje. Ó ka é klla bá ī jikwū, ī tɛ̄gíkwū, ohígbū ka Óndú ā í mīyɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā, nēé bī wā ā, ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ūwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā tɔ́ɔna, Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú um. N géē yɔ̄ ī tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
idu_Latn: ka ɔ́ɔ géē tū ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ōcē kú olɔkwukwɔkwu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ɛcí ŋ́ mā klá uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā.

eng_Latn: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, ā híīī kɛlā cɔhá icō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ō pɛ̄cí ā gē yá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka uwá gbɛlá keé géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwā ohígbū ɛlā alɛwa nēé ī ka ā.

eng_Latn: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
idu_Latn: N gē kɛlā mla anú leyī kwu eyī, klla ī kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ péee. Ó wɛ ɛla nɛ̄ n ka ipú ita ŋ́. Ó klla ī má eyī kú ami Óndú ā. Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá yúufi ō ka obɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Umósīsi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Uhérɔ̄du má ka ācɛ ojéeyī ā lɛ ɔ́ púla ā, ɔtū wú ɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aícɔ́ɔja tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ayípɛ̄nɛ́ŋ́cɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ dóódu nēe wɛ iháyí ɛpa wāajɛ nēe bá igelī nēé hī ka Ubétlehēm mɛ́mla ajɛ nēe bá kwu ɔ́ ā kpó ŋmó. Ó leyī bī eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ojéeyī da ɔ́ ka ínyílɔ́wɔ ɔ́ɔ bɛ̄cɛ ā wɛ iháyí ɛpa.

eng_Latn: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ okónu ɔhá ce lɛ uwá abɔ́ɔ, lɛ ɔkpá gbo, ka n géē pa uwá hīla tū ipú aéwo ɔhá kú ipú ɛcɛ ā piíí á.

eng_Latn: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
idu_Latn: Uwá gēe wā ŋmá ɛga olɛigbó nɛ̄hi kú ooŋmáɛyí kú ɛcɛ a. Ipú íwúɔtū mla ánya a, Óndú āgēe wā í jē odúúdú ewo kú aá kpó yá ífi, je uwa wúla tū ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā wɛ Unássɔn, ɔyí kú Ammínādabu.

eng_Latn: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú ācɛ má uwɔ, eko nāa nɔwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ícɔ́ɔja nōo le ɛfú yálé ā, ɔwɔ ō na kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔcɛ́ kú um mla ɛwa kú ācɛ ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
idu_Latn: Umáta ā yɔ̄ ī gicō gaajɛ yɔ̄ í yá odée, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó kwú uwɔ iyē abɔ̄ ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā habɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu tá ce um abɔ̄ kú um yá odúúdú úklɔ́ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Da ɔ́ kóō wā í tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī gbēyī um bɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nōo gē gbēyī ɛwū a, Ó le wu gaá kwu um kwaá, bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛtá mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɔ̄cɛ ā ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ jila. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ōcē ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé wā amānyā a, ń kpéeko bónū ŋ́, amáŋ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī piíí ā n gaá cīce kú um kɛpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ n le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Upɔ́lu bī wā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ukorásin, aá le jí ɛɛ́! Ācɛ Ubɛtsáyída, aá le jí ɛɛ́! Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aúklɔ́ idáagó nēé yá ipú aá ā, kéē lɛ uwā yá ajɛ Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í le pīyabɔ̄ báajɛ ipú ewo le īlī ekwu wiiyē gbojī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
idu_Latn: Ɛyínɛ̄hi kú ɛwa ā lɛ úwé kú uwā nā bá ɔwɛ. Amáŋ aɔ́há lɛ ābɔ̄ ɔcí hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó klá ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyípōklóbīya éyi háyi abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī pó ɛlā nēé bá ī ka ā. Iyē kú nū le ka Ɛlíhu, ɔyí kú Ubárākelu, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Urám, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔmā kú Ubúsi ā. Ó le cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu Ujóbu nɛ̄hi, ohígbū koó yɔ̄ ī hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ īyī nū, klla yɔ̄ ī ŋmó Ɔwɔicō ɛpɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā le túblá Ábsālɔm kóō gaá túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ Ábsālɔm gē wā ɛgiyí nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gaá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kwú bá ɔtú.

eng_Latn: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa nēe gē yɛ ce ɔ́ ā, lɛ ɛlā nyā pó, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔdā nēé nwū nyā lɔnɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō jɛ́yí nū. Ɔ̄nyɛ pó glá ā.

eng_Latn: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ oyá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā ka anúɔ nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá uwā kú ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ukéyīla nyatá.

eng_Latn: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.
idu_Latn: Okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi ā, n géē lɛ ɔ́ tū. Okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ayí nū géē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Usúkɔ̄tu klla gaá lā Étam, nōo yɔ̄ ogwu kú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā kē pó abɔ̄ Ujeremíya yɔ̄ ī ka ɛlā nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛ̄nyā, a géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Óndú ā géē cílá awɔ ulé.

eng_Latn: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛlā kú ɔcɛ́ nōó dɔɔ̄kā kóō lé ā miya mla Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Ussɛruya, mɛ́mla Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. É cɛ̄ klla le yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
idu_Latn: nōo ma Ubɛtráfa, Upásɛ mɛ́mla Utehína á. Utehína wɛ ádā kú ācɛ kú igelī kú Unahāssi á. Uwá wɛ ipɔ́ɔma nōo lā igelī kú Uréka á.

eng_Latn: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nōo géē he uwɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ŋmá ipú uwā ā ú pīya ɔcányā kú uwɔ. Ɔcɛ́ ā má ka ɛlā olɔhi nɔ́ɔ nwū anúɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛce ɛlā nōó nwū ɔ̄ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
idu_Latn: É le agbá kú ugóolu abɔ̄yí nū nēé jíla bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ŋgbá kóō bī ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā playi ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, Udéfīdi nuunu tá uwā jāā ga ɔ̄nɔɔ̄nɛ̄. Ayíka ayīpōklóbīya úlā nēe tū icō aínyakwūlūmī je pɛ́ kwu ā ōfōōfū wā nɛ̄ n, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kú uwā í klla kwu glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um géē je lɛ ɔ́ ā gwá, ijēēnyi í gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ piyóó. Amáŋ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um géē je lɛ ɔ́ ā géē je pīya njɔlɔ ipú nū, nōo géē pīya éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi opiyóó.

eng_Latn: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
idu_Latn: Ó kwū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ kú ācɛ nɛ̄hi ɔhá dóódu kú Ujerúsālɛm ú kpó tū ɔlá.

eng_Latn: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
idu_Latn: Udánīyɛlu le ka gwó ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ í gáā je īyī anúɔ iye nyílá mla ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ejé nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ī gwá ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le da Asspɛ́nāsi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ tá anúɔ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī pi anúɔ abɔfú kú anúɔ lé ɔdōlé, klla gwá ejé nēe í je anúɔ iyē nyílá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Ulífāyi ā ípú íne kú Umósīsi ā kéē mīyɛ éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ, o ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, nááná nēé wɛ ayááyí kú Ébrahām dúú ā.

eng_Latn: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē tóohi ákú um dúú, n géē da uwɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ā.

eng_Latn: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ klá mla anúɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ó klla da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ híī yúufi ŋ́, ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ká ɔ̄ je anúɔ mla anú kpó ŋmó, amáŋ abɔ̄ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gáā kwu ɔ́ ɛgiyí anúɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yíihɔtū tū um, aá lɛ íne kú um tū.

eng_Latn: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
idu_Latn: Eko nōo da ɔ́ ā wɛ eko nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn bá ī kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla aígelī, nēe hile Ujúda, nēé hī ka Ulákīs mɛ́mla Asɛ́kah ā. Aɛ́pa ɔ́ɔmā wɛ aígelī nēé du igá tū uwā ofōofūnū nōo hile Ujúda mɛ́ɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwu alɛɛcɛ, aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí, aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aébéenyi kú ísu. N géē je ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kpó yíífi. N géē je alɛɛcɛ kpó yíífi ŋmá ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ odúúmā kú uwā í gáā hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú íkókwū nɛ̄ ejé o mōōmu nū ú, lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá mīyɛ íkókwū nyā kú aá lɛ ɔ́ kɔ̄ mla iyī aá.

eng_Latn: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja ā. É klla géē gwéeyē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe bá ī gwá ejé ā. Ayí kú ɔlɛ́ uwā géē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádā uwā bá ī gwéeyē lɛ ā. Ɔtū géē he uwá, é klla í cɛ̄tra Óndú ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ahɔ̄ opɛ́ɛla, kóō pó ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Uhérɔ̄du lɛ Ujɔ́ni kwú, lɛ ɔ́ gbō klla kwú ɔ́ ú tá agbá. Ó yá lɛ ā ohígbū Uhɛrodíyas, ɔnyā ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ufílīipu.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
idu_Latn: O lɛ ā, da alɔ, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ ā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ohi nɛ̄ alɔ géē bī gé lɛ ācɛ nēe tū alɔ ɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ. Ɔdí nāa ka lɛyíkwu iyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni.

eng_Latn: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā kwu Umówābu ajaajɛ ā, aá jikwū nū. odúúdú aá nēe tɛtɛ pó ofu nū ā, aá ka ka, Ó tɛtɛ gē gbā ācɛ ɔhá mla íkwu nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā í yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ācɛ ā ka amáŋ Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aá bū ajɛ kú nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū kú nū kwúfúlá ká. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá mīyɛ ajɛ kú nū, nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ bá anú kwu eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
idu_Latn: N géē cɔ̄nū í je aá kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. Cɛ́ɛ́ anyā aá kwú pīya anyōkwū, ayí aá kwú pīya ayókwū.

eng_Latn: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a cɔ̄nū kpó ami mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíigbō ā tū agbá ɔlɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
idu_Latn: ékpó nōó bī le hé Ujísɔ̄si eyī ŋmá ɔlékwū klla kwú ɔ̄ ú cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lā ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu ɛháajɛ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, le eyī pīya kwu Ujɛ́rīko kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ka lɛ ā á. Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, oŋmá abālɔbányā aá géē má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ ó yājɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, klla géē kwúcē wā ɛyí ojuja kú ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́gɔ́ nū nōó jɛ̄ mɛ́mla uwá ā da ɔ́ kóō da uwá kahíníī, Ayíkābɔ̄ kú um jɔ̄kwū fíyɛ́ ohi kú ádā um á.

eng_Latn: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ wɛ ācoyúklɔ́ tɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ aá ā kē wɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō á. Aá ā kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka inu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gwó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
idu_Latn: Awɔ yá ɛɛ́ nēé gē tómbili bɛ̄ɛka efūma, klla ī tū ācɛ ufi mla owu nēé ī fu ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú bū ɛnwū kú uwā āa?.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá géē gwá íkókwū kú um ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ ń lɔfú fu ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yājɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná mɛ́mla abɔ̄lúfīyē kú um glá ŋ́. Amáŋ aɛ́ga ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ákú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ádā um le abɔ́ɔ tútú lɛ uwá ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Usitífin klla kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le pīya iháyí ofɛpa ā, ó le ɔ̄ ŋmótū ipú ɔtū kú nū kóō le aha tá gaá má ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ayínɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ odoōcē ā tóohi kahíníī, Óndú, ń lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo géē je um tá ipú ókpoó ā eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ jīliyē ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ n gbɔɔ́ gē nyɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá le gbɔbū gā um le tá ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
idu_Latn: Kwú iyī uwɔ ú tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄. Le ɔtū kpóce ɔ́, ó géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ í yá ɔdā nōo ce uwɔ ɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yá ojuju tū um á nɛɛ? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í da um ka ɔyí um ɔ́ɔ lɛ ujɔ̄ tū mla Udéfīdi ŋ́. Ɛlā kú um í kwú odúúmā kú aá iyē ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī ka gā um ka, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í tíne ɛga nɛ̄ ó géē lɛ um ŋmó ŋ́. Ɔyí um klla lɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē kóō lɛ um ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō yá ācɛ o yɔbɔ́ɔcɛ italā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aógwuda kéē kllɔcɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā jéeyī, ó géē jé odée eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ nā tɔ́ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu nēe wā gbɔbū gā um ā wɛ uwī mɛ́mla ācohéjulúgwu. Aálá ā í kē gáā pó ɛlā kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá bá amānyā mɛ́mla ijakī ā. Ami mɛ́mla ɔyí nɛ́ŋcɛ́ ā géē ga ánūmā gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ pīyɛyí wā í tá aá.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū, ɔ́ɔ́mā ó da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ó klla da uwá kéē yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ka ɛ́ɛ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Usímri le ɔcɛ́ lé ā, ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Ubássa kpó ŋmó. Kwu odúúdú aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla aóklóbīya nū nɔnyīlɔ dóódu ā, ó lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ nyā le aúgbɔga ā má ɛyɔ́pu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ɛga nēé ŋmá mɛ́mla ɛga nēé gē nyɔ̄ āa?.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le héyī ŋmá ɔlekwu ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aláadi ā, ó lɛ iyīnu mafú aflɛ́yí lɛ Umerí kú Umágāda, ɔ̄cɛnyā nōó nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ahāapa ŋmá ipú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na mɛ́mla aɔ́dā olɔhi ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmá Ái ā, é bī ákú īyī uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, n wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n gē ba ícɛ nyā yá ga um.

eng_Latn: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ lɛ, amáŋ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nu gebí ámāŋ kéē kwú ɔ̄ í yíífi!.

eng_Latn: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nya mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, n tíne ō tá aá ɛlá kwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna nū lɛ aá, nɛ̄ aá le pó klla lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ ā. Anú ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā aá lɛ ɔyí omlede ɛpa kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ mā kpó gwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla okoolo ɛpa kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé le ɔ́ wīya mla anɔ̄ kú ólīfu kóō wɛ ɛyá kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ɛya kú ejé.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kpó aá trɛ̄yí lɛ ɛɛ́. Ami ā le hīla klla lɛ īnyīlɛyí nɛ̄hɛ́ bū ɛɛ́, ayí um bá mla aá. N húmáyī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ otrɛyí kú aá ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ oklóbīya kú um jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɔɔ̄kā kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko kú nū í yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo ce ojuja bɛ̄ɛka ɔnya ā, ɔkpáncō nɛ̄ ó yá ŋmá íkííkée ā. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ká aá tɔ́ɔga tɔ̄há nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
idu_Latn: N géē pla ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Ó géē wu wāaje fúuu bɛ̄ɛka ucē nōo wā gáā je ugwu ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya ā yá. N lɛ ɔ́ ka ɛɛ́, n kē í yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Ebenezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yɛ gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya. É le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā cē kwu ɛga nēé hī ka Ebɛnésa ā, ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya kē lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā cē kwu Áfēki.

eng_Latn: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ojuju kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ámāŋ ka ācɛ o hápáápá nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ abɔ̄ du ācɛ ɛyí tāajɛ, é gē tíifu, klla ī bá ī jikwū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe lɔfú ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Éhūdu wɛ, Umáama, Ahíja mɛ́mla Ugɛ́ra.

eng_Latn: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aɔ́dā ku aágbénú otīile nēe bá eyepiipu ɛga odobu mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é kpó tayínū ā ga uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le jé ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā hī uwɔ iyē abɔ̄yī uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā kwú ā ɔ́ɔ má kwajaajɛ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ Ujóssuwa hīīgwú, kóō le ɔ́ bī wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ka anúɔ le ukɔ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
idu_Latn: N le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ī yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ōwē ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā má ɛɛ́. N kē lɛ ifu nēé yɔ̄ ī tá ā pó ɛɛ́, n gā ajɛ gaá hɛ uwa ta ɛɛ́. Wā abālɔbányā, n géē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ obū gē du gɛ ŋ́. Ɛnɔ géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ eko dóódu. Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū jé ɛlpléeko nɛ̄ ɔdā nyā géē yá á.

eng_Latn: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ī yá odúúdú ɔdā nyā á. Anú ka alɔ gwó mla iyī nū ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā. Ó klla kwú úklɔ́ ú lɛ alɔ ka alɔ yá kú odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá kéē le kagwó mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ ōtūufi mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɔ̄ itɛ kú ikwū. Ó kwú um ú ce ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄, klla le um ikpó bū tū kli.

eng_Latn: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
idu_Latn: Ó he uwɔ ɔtū, a lɛ abɔ̄ kpó wu agada, ká ā gbɔlā lígíí, ká ā mlɛ́nyɔ́ ká ā má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
idu_Latn: Ó yá kóō nyīla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, amáŋ alɔ lɛ ɔ́ kwú gáā kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ lɛ abɔ̄ kwɔtū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá ɔdā nōó tíne ō yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā lɛ pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ŋmá ipéyī ɔcɛ́ ā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gba ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu álūka á.

eng_Latn: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē pɛ́ kwu ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugása dúúdú. Ásikɛ̄lɔn géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄. É géē nū ācɛ kú Ássidɔ̄du ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí. É kē í je ācɛ kú Ékrɔn kpó nū ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, N géē cē Alelékwū kú um klá ācɛ dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá géē kɛlā kú um tɛ́ɛcɛ, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá kē í nɔ̄ɔ̄na, ayípɛ̄ oklóbīya kú aá kē í má ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī ɔlamu í má glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Umakpéla, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umámre ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan, nɛ̄ Ébrahām lá ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɛ́frɔn, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā. Ó ka abɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɛga o nyi okwū kú anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le um tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā amānyā gbɔbū lɛ aā kú n̄ lɛ ajɛ tútū lɛ aá ɔwɛ oyéyīji nyā, o yá kú aá mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú aá kóō yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
idu_Latn: É le má ka ayíkpó kú nū bá gē lé ɔdōlé nēé na abɔ̄ gbɔbū ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā lé kéē na abɔ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufarisīi dɔɔ̄kā kú ācɛ kéē na abɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ kú ā lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā yá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n cābɔ̄ gā uwɔ ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí obugā kú ācɛ kú Ujaákan, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ le tá Umɔséra á. Ó ka Árɔ̄ni ɔ́ɔ gekwú abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ nyi á. Ɛlísaa ɔyí nū kwú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá nēé hɛ́ uwī ā lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ á. Igbō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ je uwī ā klla lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ aá gáā kpɛ́fú nyā ŋ́, ákú aá lé ka, aá má kwū ajɛ ɛfú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbēyī. Aá gēe má Óndú ā abɔ̄ ó géē yá kú aá lɛ ɛfú nyā yálé ā. Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá híī piikpó ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yúufi ŋ́. Aá nyɔ̄ ɛcɛ gaá kpɛ́fú ā, Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uháman nyɔ̄ gaá le awulú mɛ́mla ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpó, le Umɔ́dɛkāyi ɛyí gbō kú ɔcɛ́, klla le ɔnya ā yíifa, kwú Umɔ́dɛkāyi ú ce ɛyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ Uháman klla gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ̄ yɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usúsa bilíbilí yɔ̄ í kahíníī, Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē cíla ɔ̄cɛ nōó tíne ó lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ulé lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aítíca kú íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, alɔ tíne ō má ɔdōcābɔ̄ eyī ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussɛkaníya, ɔyí kú Ujéhīyɛlu nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́lam ā da Ɛ́sra kahíníī, Alɔ le íne bīya klla le okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce mla Ɔwɔicō ā tányíla ɛɛ́, o ŋmá lɛ anyā kú éwɔhá nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā. Nááná alɔ leyīce ka ó géē lɔhi glá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ulisíyāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, gaá lɛ ɔ́ nú abɔ̄fú ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nēe kpó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄ ā kéē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū caca kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ ī yi um ɔlá nɛ̄hi. Odúúdú ɛcá nēé ī cá uwɔ ā, wā í klá um dúú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ɛláyíja ka ɔ́ɔ̄ da Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka anúɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, A lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó klla gaá mīyɛ ajɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā úgwū kú nú dúú ɛɛ́? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ ka lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛga nɛ̄ ewō pla oyī kú Unábɔ̄tu nyɛ̄ ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ewō géē pla oyī kú uwɔ nyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, N húmáyī ī tíne ká ami mɛ́mla aá kú ālɔ̄ lé ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú onyatá nyā gbojī ɛɛ́, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē ŋmó um!.

eng_Latn: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū nōó géē je lɛ alɔ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā géē nwuné lɛ ā í tōō ka ŋ́. Ɔfú nyā nōó géē je lɛ alɔ ā wɛ ɛdɔ ɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya gēe kpó ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ga ɔlɛ́ nū, klá í kpó ācɛ kú Itíopīa aɔ́fiyɛ ga ɔlɛ́ nū dúu á, kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ kwu ayípɛ̄ gēe tóohɛ́ɛwa áncā, í gāa lɛ ɔdā dúúmā klá ɔkwu ŋ, ipú uwēyī Kú Íjīpiti a ga ajɛ kú ɔfíyɛ́ a.

eng_Latn: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
idu_Latn: É gáā yá ami ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce uwɔ ā lé glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ nēé gē yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá uwɔ ā nē é yálé glá á.

eng_Latn: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
idu_Latn: Aádā nɛ̄hi gē bī ayááyí uwā gwó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayááyí kē ī bī ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā uwā gwó ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē hɛ́ álá kú um ā tá, ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwā móōwē igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū álá kú um dóódu, klla í yā olɔhi ā ŋmá ipú obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Adónīja mɛ́mla aúgbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā bá í lé ucɛ ā kwɛyí ā, anɔ́ɔ é pó uya kú éeyī ō gwó á. Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu le ɔkɔ kú opo ā pó ā, ó le ɔ̄kā da ka uya kú ɔdí nyá háyi ipú igelī kwūūū āa?.

eng_Latn: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā yɔ̄ pi um, ī nuunu gā um bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cokpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔtū túblla anú glá ŋ́ mā a. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē tíne ō yá um ŋmó ā géē gwōnū í lɛ okónu nya ajɛ. É kē gáā yá um lé glá ŋ́. Uwēyī géē kwú uwá piyóó, ohígbū kéē gáā yá ɔdā n­ɛ̄ é gē tíne ō yá ā glá ŋ́. Ācɛ í gáā mlanyī uwēyī nōo gáā kwú uwā ā gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla da Umósīsi kahíníī. Uculo nāa géē yá kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū fu céé gā um, kéē kwú pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya gā um ā yɔ̄ á. Kwu ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi ú mɛ́mla omlede ɛpa, nēe lɛ ɛnya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā kú Ussúlam, kwúcē wā, kwúcē wā, ká ālɔ̄ má uwɔ,igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá tíne ō yɔ̄ ī má um, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ussúlam ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔgbɔ́ yɔ̄ ī jījē nɛ̄ ɛwa bá ābɔ̄ kpééyī klá anú ā?.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya kwú odúúdú ugóolu mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ákú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā ú kpó lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya.

eng_Latn: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
idu_Latn: Ɔhā nāa hɛ́ ce ɔ́ ā kóō yɔ̄ mla anú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Éeyē le mu ɔ́ ipú ohígbū koó yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo kpó ɛcɛ ā, Unówa lā iháyí ofigwáahāapa ce igwó.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ Óndú kú Usábāti aā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
idu_Latn: Ó le ukɔ́ tū uwā kahíníī, N tíne ká aá lɛ olɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Ísɔ ɔkpanī um. Ami Ujékɔ̄pu ɔfiyɛ kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ kllɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ ɛɛ́. N hímáyī lā mla Ulában jāā kwu abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
idu_Latn: Gbeyī cíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā gbēyī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yá ā. Ā híī je unwalu lɛ iyī uwɔ ohígbū ācɛ nēe ī jāgbénū fíyafíya ā, ámāŋ ka ācɛ nēe ī yá lɔhi ipú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé gē miya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá abālɔbányā ga eko nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ gbógbóō ŋ́ mā. Odúúdú ācɛ kéē kahíníī, Aamí. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú.

eng_Latn: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ aá gáā lé ŋ́. Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ aá lā ā, aá gáā lé igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ um bī bilíbilí ga ɛga dóódu kú ɔpɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ n má ka aíkpokwú kú ācɛ bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ lɛwa nɛ̄hi, é kē le ŋmókókó nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufilístiya ā kē le jīla kéē gāá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúú. Úgbɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnya kú uwá wɛ ulá igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwa lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā. É le pɛ́ ga Umíkmāsi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ubɛ́táfen gāá lɛ aāklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú gwó kwu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
idu_Latn: Aólɔfú kú uwā nōo lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛyī ā, kwu ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, géē pɛ́ kwú mɛ́mla ācɛ ohile ā dúú. Oyī géē kwú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā yōōō, ijē kē ī kwú ajɛ ā cɔkpɔɔɔ.

eng_Latn: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn nēe bá ī kpɛ́fú tú igelī nyā ā géē je ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔlá. É géē je yi ɔ́ ɔlá tāajɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú aínu nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gē yá um ícɔ̄nū ɛyí uwā ŋmá lɛ ɔtulali nēé ī yɔɔlá lɛ Ubáalu, klla ī lɛ ejé fu ajɛ lɛ aɛ́cí kú aáwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú íne nēé bīya ā tá tāajɛ. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ukpɛ̄ dúúmā ipú onyatá kú uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ipú yɔ̄ kpɔ́ anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá ma á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú ā klla kwú ɛ̄nyā ú gā dúú, ohígbū koó le pó ka ɔbá um í yá ihɔtu tá um ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Usímīyɔn.

eng_Latn: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē yá fíyaa, kéē kwinya gā Ujerúsālɛm, uwá nēe lā Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
idu_Latn: Eko nōo yɔ̄ nyā ā, ɔyí géē yá ádā nū bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā, ayínɔ̄nyā géē tā ɛlā kú ɛ́nɛ́ uwā. Ɔnyā ɔyí gē yíkpɛ́lā mla ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū, aólɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ wɛ éyi kú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ nū piíí.

eng_Latn: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
idu_Latn: Ilíbna, Adulám.

eng_Latn: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
idu_Latn: Aá yēkwu, ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm. Aá lɛ īnyīlɛyí kú aá plla bónū. Aá tū ɛgíkwū, ɛyí ɛfú dóódu ohígbū ka aá nēe béeyī eko nyā ā lɛ ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā yá cɔ̄nū, nɛ̄ n tá aá klla kwú igbīhi í cē kwu aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
idu_Latn: N tíne ká ācɛnyā kéē bī ohílīpú le yíifa ukpɛ̄nū ukpɛ̄nū, kéē yíífa ɔwɛ okpaakpa. Óō híī wɛ ɛyi ō gbō jūū ŋ́, ámāŋ́ ka, ugóolu, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ōgbɔɔ́lá dóódu ō kpó kla iye ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn gekwú anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi igelī kú ádā nū, Udéfīdi á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Úréhōbōwam kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā nū, Usólōmɔn á.

eng_Latn: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɛ́lāyi, le Usámūwɛ̄lu hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ kwúcē ga Ujudíya kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
idu_Latn: ­Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē je anɔ̄ nōo hile ā pīya tū ɔtābɔ̄ kú nū ā, ó géē lɛ ɔ́ tū ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da ɔ̄kā ka, é pó olɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ɛ? É i pó gbóó. Ohígbū kéē tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɛlā nēé le ɔkɔ cɛyí tɔ́ɔna kú nū ā le tá ipú ahɔ̄ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ɛlā kú uwā kē le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe bá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um gekwú ɛɛ́, cāŋjɛ abālɔbányā, ká awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ká aá lɛ bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ipú ajɛ, nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́dā dóódu nōo yá ā géē ŋmɛ́yí tá lɛ ā miya táajɛ gbɔbū ɛɛ́. Ó kē le ɔ́ miya táajɛ ka, é géē je ɔ̄cɛ obɔ́bíipú ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Igbo ɔ́mpa ā, eko nēé bá ī gwá ejé ā, ɔcɛ́ da Ɛ́sta kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā nāa tíne ā, da um. N géē yá ɔ̄ gā uwɔ. Ó kōō wɛ āyā éyi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um nááná, n géē je gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá tū mu mla íjééyī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ɛdɔ úklábɔ̄ dóódu, mla ijā abɔ̄ ō he dóódu kú odufā, ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla ɔnɔwā, īlī nɛhɛ̄ ō tá ígbíngbli, amáŋ īlī ō tá, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ímlɛ́ kú ācɛ ō hijā tū aɔ́dā dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Ó le Ágāgi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ā kwú oyēeyī. Ó bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī le ācɛ ohile kpó ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Ubálāki kwú Ubálam ú gicō kú Ubamɔtubáal, ɛga nɛ̄ ó lɔfú má ācɛ ōhī kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
idu_Latn: Eko ga kpɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɛlkána mla odúúdú aíkonó kú nū gáā ga Ussílo gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kéē klla gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yá iháyí dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cokónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
idu_Latn: Óndú, blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā klla yɛce uwɔ lɛ ā. N klla lɛyítáajɛ ga uwɔ kpaakpa. Ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ká n̄ yá ā, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gē yá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá icō ga ɔkwu kú ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́ ā, ugóolu nēé bī le yá ɔ̄ á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā mafú lɛ Umósīsi kéē yá ɔ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ obɔ̄bí ā í lɛ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū dúúmā ŋ́. Oyéeyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nōo géē je nyí ānāānā ā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ójíla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, je ɔkɔ gicō nɛ̄hi jikwu otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gā, ó géē bī aá tá ga ipú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi dóódu. Ohígbū ka, ó gáā kɛlā ŋmá ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā dóódu nōó pó, nōó géē ka á, ó klla géē da aá aɔ́dā nēe gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
idu_Latn: Udíssɔn, Ésa mɛ́mla Udíssan.

eng_Latn: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
idu_Latn: Aá tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ fu Ujɔ́ni, ó kē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, ipú ɔ̄na nɛ̄ a nā ā, a má ojibó nɛ̄hi éyi. Ojibó nyā nwuné, ó gē fíyajɛ klla ī ceyī. Ó māhayi iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. Ó tūufi ō má nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
idu_Latn: Ó lé ɛ̄cī tū ipú lígíí, Ɔcɛ́ Ágrīpa mɛ́mla Ubénisi fu ajɛ Usísarīya gaá blla Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔcí ā ú tá iyɔ̄bū kú aɔ́dāajɛ ā ɛga nēé gē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ó le aógbló kú ɔcí ā kpó bá abɔ́ɔ, ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ á gē ce iyī ūwā eko nēé ī wā ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ í gē mīyɛ ijáalí kú ɔ̄cɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ, ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyī yɛ ɛlā ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē ka ā, nēé gē mīyɛ ákú nū á.

eng_Latn: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó yɔ̄ gē je éyi kú ɛna kú nū gwɛ́ɛya kóō yɔlá dúúdú. Ó géē bī ɔbɛ́ɛna nōó lɛ ɛnyá dóódu iyē kú nū ŋ́. Ó í je ɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nū kóō le he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tá tū ɔkpá fu um lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔbá ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ācɛ nēé le ɔnyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā. Ń mīyɛ íne dúú ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ŋ́. Amáŋ Óndú ā ipú eyīnyinyi kú nū ā lɛ íjééyī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔtūce ɔ́ glá je gā um, n kē í kɔ̄ ɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Kwú aɔ́dōwīyē kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ú kpó wu Árɔ̄ni iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔwɛ̄ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā a kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō yúklɔ́ ká ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya gā um glá.

eng_Latn: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cíla um ulé nyā ohígbū ka n gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa. Ó gē hɔ́hā cē um, ohígbū ka ń lɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ Ujíyu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ocābɔ̄ ɔdí nāa tínē ká ā mafú lɛ alɔ ŋmá ɔdā nāa gē yá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ́bíipú gē tíne ɔwɛ nēé géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Ɛlā okónu kú uwā gē je odée yɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā ékpónú nyā nɛ̄ aá ī dɔlɛ́ á, ohígbū ka ācɛ ogbāajɛ ā bá gē yúklɔ́ lɛ Ɔwɔicō eko nēé lɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā yá gaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ó ka Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um gáā gwɛ́ɛya ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ayínɛ́ um o hile ā ka ami ɔ́ɔ gā. Anɔ́ɔ ó ba um ka ami ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ ká anúɔ gáā lɛ ayínɛ́ anúɔ má. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó wā í lé ɔdōlé mla ɔcɛ́ ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
idu_Latn: Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe wɛ ɔfiyɛ ā géē je aɔ́kpani uwā ka ācɛ nēé cíkā ō lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwā a piíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ ká ē kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú iye kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē nwū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā bū ígbíli obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā nɛ̄ aɛ́gwā obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla aɛ́na o cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bá ā. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ yá kú éŋkpɔ̄ kóō lɛ tū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uhána da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ehée, óndú um, ń gwá ejé dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē wīyā ejé ŋ́. Amáŋ, n wɛ ɔnyā nōo lɛ unwalu nɛ̄hi, n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ yɔ̄ ī ka ákanya mɛ́mla unwalu kú odo kú um lɛ Óndú um nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
idu_Latn: É gā Ukapánɔm, ɛplá nɛ̄ ó le tá ipú inu ā, Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄kā da ayíkpó kú nū ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ gē táafú nū ŋmá ɔwɔɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
idu_Latn: Aá bī ije ɛga ɛpa fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bī nyɔ̄ aflɛ́yí ā, aā kwú ije nēé je tá ipú ɛkpa kú aá ā ú bī nyɔ̄, eko ōhī é je mlanyī tá ipú ɛkpa kú aá nɛ ū.

eng_Latn: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
idu_Latn: Aá cēyītīkwū kú aá yíhɔtū. Aá kwú ɔtū kú aá ú kwu aɛ́hi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛhi kú olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ō ka tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā. Ó klla jégēdē le íne kú Óndú ā bīya. Ikwū kú nū ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó le íkpékwūja ma kwú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā, ipú Ujerúsālɛm amānyā, wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n fu ŋmá ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. N koó í wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ géē wā í gbā um ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si pīyeyī lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū uwā kahíníī, Aá jé ɛdɔ kú alelékwū nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami, Ɔyínyɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í wā í kpó oyēēyī kú ācɛ yíífi ŋ́, amáŋ n wā gaá nya uwá tá.

eng_Latn: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔdée fīyɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ámāŋ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú nū eyī, nɛ̄ eyī ā kwú pu, ó géē hɛ́ ɔfiyɛ ā tá kóō nyɔ̄ icííci kóō kwɛyí eyī kú nū nōo pu ā.

eng_Latn: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā le yá í yɛ ā, Óndú ā le ɔdīpú tū klla Ujɛhóram, anɔ́ɔ ajīlīpú kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō wā á.

eng_Latn: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī ō lɛ ā wɛ ɔdā ō cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ɔdā dóódu nāa lɛ nááná, má ka a lɛ ohílīpú ō jɛ́yí odée lɛ.

eng_Latn: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá je uwá bɛ̄ɛka éyi kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu aɔ́mpa aá. Aá yíhɔtū tá uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá í yíhɔtū tá iyī aá ā. Aá bla ka aá abɔ̄yī aá tɛtɛ wɛ éwɔhá ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī gwá ejé ŋ́ ámāŋ ejé olɔfú ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē lé ɔdōlé elihɔ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
idu_Latn: É géē bá í kɔ̄kā kú nū lɛ ayááyí nēé ma ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nyatá.

eng_Latn: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gēe je pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Isirīya ogbéegbé ɛcɛ. Ó gēe je bū ácí mla ēpū la álá mla ɛna, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gāa yɔ̄ nōo gē nū uwá ŋmá Anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, N géē je ōwē lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe cīgbīhi hɛ̄ um tá mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gáā bá ī pā ɛcí ā.

eng_Latn: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ámnɔn gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́ɔtū Utáma nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi á. Íwɔ́tū kú eko ɔ́ɔmā ā klla nwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kōō ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yíhɔtū nū eko aflɛ́yí ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔya ɛhɔ̄ kú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipú ajɛ ɔfiyɛ ā. Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā wā gaá da um ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tíne kú ē yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é má cīce iyɔ̄bū um á.

eng_Latn: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ejé ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēé ī gwá ā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jéeyī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
idu_Latn: Ubéka ma ayí ahāanɛ nēe bá ā: Usémíra, Ujówāssi, Ɛlíyēsa, Ɛliyónāyi, Ómri, Ujɛ́rɛ̄mɔtu, Ábīja, Anátɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Aleméti.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, N gēe tá ācɛ kú Umedes abɔ̄ la ɛyí kwu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka e wā í kpó ɛfu gwó Ubábīlɔn. Ācɛ Umédes a í kē lɛ ɛlá uwɔ ije nɛhɛ́, amáŋ ije ɔdɔ mla udɔ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēe gāa hɛ́ uwá eyī fuú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usádɔ̄ku, Unátan, Ubenáya mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ā, gaá kwú Usólōmɔn ú ce ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ bī ga Ugíhɔn á.

eng_Latn: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
idu_Latn: Ó le ka ɛɛ́, ka ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ oŋmɛ́yí mɛ́mla ukpɛ̄ ká aá á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nōó ka anúɔ géē yā mla aá á, ohígbū ka aá kwú mlanyī nū klla lɛ ɔtū kpó ce ɔwɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi je eyī gicō kwu ɛgiyī Ɔwɔicō igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Óndú, ɔdíyá nāa gē yá ācɛ nēe bá ā ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā? Ɔdíyá nāa tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā amānyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō híī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ményinyi aígelī nɛ̄hi ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó je uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka o pó íbá kú ɔnɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ géē yɔ̄ ī jé ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, mɛ́mla íbá nɛ̄ ācɛ géē yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ ka ɛfú ō kpó ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe yɛce Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ ayí Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Á pó ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá eko nɛ̄ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu yɔ̄ ī kpó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā ŋmó ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N le ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā ofɛhɔ̄ kpó tayínū ígwíígwu kú ofɛpa cigwó ofɛpa cigwo ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄. N klla ī je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yá ucē icíci ā, mɛ́mla ācoyíimabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔhɛ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī cikpo ɔnyā nōó wɛ ɔnyā uwā ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, mɛ́mla ācopɛ̄cí, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ he ɔ́ ɔtū nōo kē ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā géē bá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igá kú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ eko yɔ̄ gbóógbó ā, óndú kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́, gaá lɛ ije ā gbakwú mla uwá.

eng_Latn: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
idu_Latn: A kwú alɔ ú pīya ɔdā ɛhɛ, ipú aéwɔhá ɛɛ́. É gē leyī gwū alɔ bónū klla ī cōkónu tá alɔ gbɛdɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
idu_Latn: A híī mlanyī ɛgba kú ícɔ̄nū kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ mɛ́mla uya nɛ̄ é bá ī yá piyóó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
idu_Latn: É bá gē yá ojuju obɔ̄bí tayínū lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. É bá ī tū ujɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe gē gbá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
idu_Latn: Ɛlífɛ̄lɛti, ɔyí kú Ahasbáyi nōo ŋmá Umáaka ā. Ɛlíyam, ɔyí kú Ahítōfɛlu nōo ŋmá Ugílo ā.

eng_Latn: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
idu_Latn: Ohéyīfuú kú ɔ̄cɛnyā lɔfú plla ɔ̄cɛ glá, ɔhi kē lɔfú céyī glá. Amáŋ ācɛ cíkā ō cɛ̄tra ɔnyā nōo gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú, í klla gē héyī gɛ ŋ́ má. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú í gáā cāŋjɛ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā kú nū ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
idu_Latn: Aíkpō kú ɔcí kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti úlā éyi nēé yá playi ɔgba ɛpa kú aágbá ā. Ɔ́ɔmā lé ka aíkpō kú upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ofɛhɔ̄ nēé yá tū agbá éyééye nēé hā ɔgba ɛpɛɛpa kú nū tū icō kú aúpíla ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Upárōssi wɛ, úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofu ahātá ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amásīya kwú ɔtú kú nū ú yéékpónú anɔ́ɔ ó le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó gaá kwāajɛ ɔpɛ́ nēé hī ka ɔpɛ́ kú ɔmā á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, é le ɛfú kpó tá aólɛlā kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́dɔm úlā ofu cigwó .

eng_Latn: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ oŋmá ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō ā, n wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ ícɛ nyā ā. Ihɔtū nōó mafú gā um ā lɛ úklɔ́ yá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ í leyīce ŋ́ mā, ami yúklɔ́ nwuné fíyɛ́ odóódu kú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ohile á, nááná nōó wɛ ɔfú kú ami abɔ̄yī um ŋ́ mā. Ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī tá um abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī bī le je ɛhi lɛ ācɛ alahá ā wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ā bīyíne ā. Íne nɛ̄ Ádām bīya ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēe ŋmó ācɛ ɛpɔ̄bí á. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa le íne bīya ā, Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā nēé leyī ce ŋ́ mā yá lɛ uwá, o ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nōó ka kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi lé.

eng_Latn: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kwú oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yá ā, ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, é í je ācɛ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yá ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N le da aá, aá kē cɛ̄ ŋ́. Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá ŋmá iyē kú Ádā um ā gē cījáalí kú um á.

eng_Latn: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
idu_Latn: Aá híīī bī unwalu gé lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu, aílɔ́wá ámāŋ ka icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
idu_Latn: É bá ī ka kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ejé tíne cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ̄ gwá gáā kwu ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ gwá kwu glá ā. Óócí kē í lɔhi fíyɛ́ ícɛ ɛ́ɛ́ má.

eng_Latn: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā gbɔɔ́ ō ce ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tū Uhásɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je á.

eng_Latn: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ Upíta kwú ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ígwu ɛnɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja kéē gbō ɔ̄. Ó bī ɔ̄ ɔtu kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá agbá gé lɛ ójīla ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā igbīhi uculo kú onyatá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó. Ācɛ nēe gē pɛ̄cí ā, géē je kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
idu_Latn: É géē hī aá ka, Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū, Ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le uwá nyatá ā. É kē ī hī Ujerúsālɛm ka, Igelī nɛ̄hi nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū, Igelī nɛ̄hi nōo he ācɛ ɔtū kéē lā, mɛ́mla Igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ í gē ŋá ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
idu_Latn: Ó tá péee ka ācɛ nēe kɛlā lɛ ā, yɔ̄ ī leyīce éwo nēé í hī ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄ īyī um gēe lɛ itali kú um gɔ uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, le gɔ́ ācɛ kú Umídiyan, ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú Orebu á. N gēe je ōwē la Asírīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je ōwē la Íjīpiti a.

eng_Latn: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujɛ́futa,ádā nū ā, koó mā anúɔ tá ɔyā ɛpa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ ga ɛyí ɛfu gāá yá ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa anúɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā kwú, nɛ̄ anúɔ í jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo jɔ̄ɔ̄nyā fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛnyā ā, Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā nyɔ̄ ā? Ka lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ uwɔ tíne nū.

eng_Latn: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē bī ɔ́ngbá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ahāapa nēé le gbō ɔdā dúú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, nōó kē ŋmó kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, lɛ anúɔ gbō, anúɔ géē je kwáahi bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Utɔ́mɔ̄si kahíníī, Lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú uwɔ wu amānyā, ká ā má abɔ̄ kú um. Ká ā klla lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ wu áklō kú um, a híī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ŋ́, amáŋ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɛbɛ́ dóódu o yēeyī nōo wɛ ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā kpó wā ipú úgbéenyi ā. O yá kú ugbɛ kú uwā kóō mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
idu_Latn: Ɛ́frem ma ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nōó hī ka Ussɛ́ɛra. Anú gwó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛti Uhórɔn mɛ́mla Ussɛ́ɛra á.

eng_Latn: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
