idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le pó ā, ó kahíníī, Ōcē nyā í gáā ŋmó Ulásārɔ̄si ŋ́, ɛ̄nyā le yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Ó klla í wɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bī le cɛ̄tra Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu le aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda yálé, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda kwú pɛ́ kwu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abālɔbányā abɔ̄ le hɛ́ alɔ iyē ɛɛ́, ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé gwū umaná nyā nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé ɛ̄cī dóódu nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ā, Uhána le ipú yɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma á. Ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ kahíníī, Usámūwɛ̄lu ohígbū ka, ó ka anúɔ ba ɔyí ā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
idu_Latn: N gē yá ojuju, klla ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya ka n gē yá ā. N lɛ ohílīpú kú ɛyí odée ō jé. N kē klla lɔfú.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū kahíníī, N géē ga ɛgiyí Uféro, ká n̄ gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um mɛ́mla ádā um mɛ́mla aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um nēe bá ajɛ kú Ukénan ā gā ɛgiyí um ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gbō Uhɛ́brɔn iháyí ahāapa ce ɔyā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ōhī gē ŋmó ije kú uwā tū ācɛ ɔhá nɛ̄hi, nááná é kē yɔ̄ ī lɛ ije tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ōhī gē yá ukpɛ́ nɛ̄hi, nēé ŋmó ije tū ācɛ ɔhá glá ŋ́, nááná é kē bá yɔ̄ ī gbɛhá tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
idu_Latn: Unaómi tá uwá ohi kéē le cīgbīhi, ayí anúɔ. Ó da uwá ka ɔdíyá nɛ́ɛ tíne ō wā mla anúɔ ā? Ó ka anúɔ lɔfú ma ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ, nēe géē wɛ ɔbá uwá glá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā Umósīsi le íne je lɛ aá ká lɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá apī hɛ́. , anɔ́ɔ aá gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ apī ɛ̄cī usábāti á.

eng_Latn: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, klla ī yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ le pɛ́ gɛcɛ kéē má ɔdā nōo yá ā. Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si ā, é le ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aálelékwū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyē kú nū ā má abɔ̄ ó cīce pī ikpó kú Ujísɔ̄si, lɛ úwé wiiyē, eyī klla le gbo ɔ́ gɔɔ. Ufi le odúúdú ācɛ ā kwú.

eng_Latn: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
idu_Latn: Ɔbá um í yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Ó le yɛ tá iyāwu.

eng_Latn: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Aá í nwū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu odúúdú íne nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi kóō je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le jé ka, unwalu ɔ́ɔ gā lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ Uféro le da uwá ka, uwá géē ma áluka ubulɔ́kwu nēé tɛtɛ gē ma ɛ̄cī ā kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ ī leyī ce ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ í má ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, alɔ gē lɔtū lé ī gbēyī nū.

eng_Latn: And they shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver, and give them unto the father of the damsel, because he hath brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel: and she shall be his wife; he may not put her away all his days.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla géē hɛ́ ɔbá kú ɔnyā olóofī kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛhɔ̄, nōó géē gbā lɛ ádā kú ɔnyā ā, ohígbū ka ó lɛ uwēyī kpó tū ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi ɛyí. Ó ka ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ í wɛ ɔnyā nū kpɔ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla gáā tá ɔ̄ɔ gbóógbóō igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē yēeyī gáā kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, a lā ipú ācɛ ō yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú. É lē eyī amáŋ e má ɛbɛ ŋ́, é lɛ ahɔ̄, amáŋ é pó ɛla ŋ́, ohígbū ka é wɛ ācɛ oyá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú.

eng_Latn: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka itene nɛ̄ ó gáā lé ŋmá ɛ̄nyā ā, fíyɛ́ itene kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ á. Ile kú nū klla fíyɛ́ ákú ugóolu á.

eng_Latn: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ odúúdú agbénú kú uwɔ kɔ̄ ɛga ɛpa kwú āyā kú nū éyi ú gā um nááná, ń gáā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla awɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n kōō ī lé ɔdōlé ámāŋ gwá ɔdā dúúmā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyá nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ā? N wā í lɛ aá yá italā nɛɛ, kɛɛ ka n wā mla alelékwū kú ihɔtū mɛ́mla ogbonɛnɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ussaróyim, Aditéyim, Ugɛdɛ́ra, mɛ́mla Ugɛdɛ́rōtēm. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛnɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā.

eng_Latn: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
idu_Latn: Awɔ yá ajɛ kú ɛhícō mla ajɛ kú ɛháajɛ á. Ɛfu kú Utábɔ mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Uhámɔn gē gwíijē kú éeyē gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka inu olɔfú nɛ̄ ācɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā gē nyɔ̄ ī tayínū ipú nū, kéē bá ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n jé ka, Ɔwɔicō gē tú um abɔ̄ á. Ɔwɔicō gē gbō oyēeyī kú um á.

eng_Latn: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
idu_Latn: Unínīfɛ, awɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ Utébīsi, nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Íjīpiti á nɛɛ? Ísu kú Unáyilu le igá hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā kú aá gbō ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa mla odúúdú ɔtū kú aá. Aá blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo mla ádáádā uwā, eko nɛ̄ n ma ɔfú kú um fú lɛ aéwo kú odúúdú ɛcɛ, ŋmá eko ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, yá ɛ̄yipɛ̄. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ananíyāsi le ɛlā nēe bá nyā pó ā, ó má fíyɛ́ ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɔdā nōo yá ā yúufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, Óndú, ká ā jáhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n gē je ā. Wā ī tá um abɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī jikwu ā. N wɛ ugbɔga kú uwɔ ipú ɛcɛ nyā bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā um ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú íkókwū kú Usólōmɔn nōó gē gwá odée ŋmá anú kpɛ́mm ā wɛ ákú ugóolu . Oje ɔdɔ nēé bī le yá odúúdú ɔdā ōbī yá ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ole lé ɔdōlé kú Agbla kú Ūpū kú Ulébānɔn ā dúú á. Odúúmā kú nū í wɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko kú Usólōmɔn ā, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ í wɛ ɔdá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Umídiya yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá klla kahíníī, Á tíne ɛya ōgwó mla ɛhi mɛ́mla ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya ōgwó ohígbū íne ōbīya ŋ́. É klla wɛ ɔdā ō he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ̄nyā nááná nōó jé kéē gē gwɛ́ɛya nēe bá ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú géē lé odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe bīya íne kú um ā. Aɛ́nɛ̄ e gē ka ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā í gáā yá aá glá mā, ɛfú géē lé uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
idu_Latn: Iháyí alɛwa igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā gekwú. Amáŋ, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bá ī hīla ayīnu ipú ōwē kú úklɔ́ ɔfiyɛ nēé bá ī yá ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Ɔwɔicō kóō tá uwā abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ikwū nēé je ā pó á.

eng_Latn: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: É géē mu inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla inu ɔlɛ́ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla inu kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ɛ̄nyā ā í bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ádā aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá í kōō má jééjéē ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le pīyeyī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo je ɔ́ tēelihɔ ā bá īlī kú nū piyɔlɔɔ klla tɛ́ɛcɛɛcɛ cāā nɛ̄ ācɛ ī má ɔ̄ pélúú, amáŋ ó kōō lɛ ɛlá wu ɛga nɛ̄ ó gáā ŋmɛ́yí tá ā ŋ́. O yálé nēé yá ɔ́ lé ā bɔ̄ɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, ó kōō má ɔ̄cɛ dúú wā í tá ɔ́ ɔtū lé ŋ́. Aólɛlā kú nū le ɔ́ yálé ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō ményinyi nū.

eng_Latn: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ ikpɛ̄cí gwó lɛ ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó ayí uwā gwɛ́ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔ́. Ń je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛlá kú nū kōō gē wā ipú ɔtū kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
idu_Latn: Ń gē kɛlā lɛ aá ka aá lɛ ugoolu nēé bī ɔlá le na lá ŋmá abɔ̄ um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá le gbagbénú ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. Aá lɛ úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ lá kú aá le wiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá tóohɛ́ɛwa ɛ́ nɛ̄ uwēyī gē kwú aá gɛ ŋ́. Aá lɛ anɔ̄ otēeyī lá dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá le tū eyī kú aá mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
idu_Latn: Aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō híīī nū uwā ga ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
idu_Latn: Uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa le okónu ce ipéyī Óndú ā. Udéfīdi má klá Uhóresi abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā é géē ma Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā fú, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē wā, ó géē ŋmó ɔ́ mla owu nōó í fu ŋmá okónu kú nū ā. Ó géē je ɔ́ yíífi mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó í wā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ tá uwɔ abɔ̄ jé ō kɛlā lɔhi lɛ ā dúú? Ohílīpú kú ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ a bī le kɛlā ŋmá okónu yɔ̄ dúú ā?.

eng_Latn: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
idu_Latn: Éfrɔn cīce mɛ́mla ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá Ébrahām ohi ipéyī kú odúúdú ācɛ, nēe bá okónɔɔwɛ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í gáā mlanyī ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā gbógbóō ŋ́. Ó gáā leyī gwō eyī ō ce kú ogbɛhá bónū piyóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ka olɔhi mɛ́mla okpaakpa kú uwɔ kóō fíyajɛ pélúú bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le tá inu ɛgiyí ádā nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ádā um. Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á. A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ, ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
idu_Latn: Bī aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ká ā lɛ ɔtulalī umuumu o fú tū ɔlá, okpóocu lɔɔlɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ɔtulalī ā yá. Lɛ ɔmā tū ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá yēŋēē kóō klla lɛ ɔ́ yá tīīhɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū da uwá nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwā fu ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwá, lɛ uwá tɛ́ɛ́cɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ uwá bá eko ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō da Ébrahām kahíníī, Ɛlā nyā kóō híī kwú uwɔ iyē ohígbū ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Usára da uwɔ ā, yā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da uwɔ ā, ohígbū ka oŋmá ɛgiyí Áyísīki nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē lé iyē á.

eng_Latn: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Óndú Ujísɔ̄si ā, n jé cāā ka ɔdōlé dúúmā í bɔ̄bí abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ka ɔdōlé ōhī ɔ́ɔ ī bɔ̄bí, ó lɛ ā ó kē í bɔ̄bí lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
idu_Latn: É má ajɛ olɔhi lɛ aálá kú uwā abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄hi nēé le nyīla klá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ kú Uhám lā abɔ́ɔ gbɔbū lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi le ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi Ákisi, ɔ́cɛ kú Ugáti ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ, ohígbū ka aá jé ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú aá ā gáā wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nōo lɛ ohílīpú gbeeyī cíí ā, géē lɛ ojīlīmā, amáŋ, uwēyī géē kwú ɔnyā dúú nɛ̄ ó lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ okwáhi, nōo klla ī yá újulu, í gáā lɛ ije gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
idu_Latn: Aá jé kpɔ́cíi ka ācɛnyīlɔ nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú agbla nɛ̄hi ā gē lɛ ɔdōlé kú uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Ācɛ nēe gē gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā gē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ŋmá ɔdā nēé bī wā í le gwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛka ā kwú bīya ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā á. Anɔ́ɔ ācotɔ́su álá nēe bá ī má um ā jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bī ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī já Ɔwɔicō má ŋmá lɛ ō lɛ iyó ōgbɛnú nɛ̄ aádā alɔ ámāŋ alɔ abɔ̄ alɔ í bī glá ŋ́ mā ce ayíkpó ā ɛyí ā?.

eng_Latn: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
idu_Latn: Ń yɔ̄ gē je ɔ́da lɛ aá lɛyíkwu ɛ̄nyā ŋ́. Amáŋ n yɔ̄ ī nwū aá ɛlā icííci nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
idu_Latn: Ádām, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ̄ ā kwú iyē ú ce ɔnyā nū ka Íifu, ohígbū ka anú wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ kú odúúdú alɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
idu_Latn: Kóocōō, a híī pó ɛlā kú Unábalu ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē lɛ ɛlá wu ucē íla mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ icííci nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó wɛ olíla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛyí kú iyē nū lɛ ā nɛ̄ n. Ń yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ācōcɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ wā ā nóó.

eng_Latn: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó lɛ ā, nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú mɛ́mla Itíca kú aá ā, lɛ ikpó kú aá na, ó lɛ ā aá cíkā ō na ikpó kú ɔ́mpa iyī aá.

eng_Latn: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya klla le aíkpɛ́cí nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn gwó kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujerúsālɛm, ɛháajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfú kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ā nyílá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē gbā ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā nēé hī kā Ásitāte, ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā kú Usídɔn, Ukɛ́mɔ̄si ɔwɔ kú Umówābu, mɛ́mla Umílikom ɔwɔ kú Ámɔn ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ aóklóbīya um kwú pɛ́kwu gwū um tá, a kwú um ú pīya ɛbɛ ohéyī lɛ uwá. É le um gwō tū, anɔ́ɔ ń kē kwu bɛ̄ɛcɛ glá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kéē je ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́ nɛɛ, ayíka é kē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
idu_Latn: N cɔ̄nū je igbīhi cē kwu uwɔ eko kpií nɛ̄ n. Amáŋ n géē yíihɔtū uwɔ klla ī méyīnyinyi uwɔ piyóo. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo gē nya uwɔ tá ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field, and the man force her, and lie with her: then the man only that lay with her shall die:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔyípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā hɛ́ bá ajɛ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ ipú igelī ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā ōfōōfūnū, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́t-mákābɔtu, Uhasásúsim, Ubɛtibíri mɛ́mla Ussaárayim.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi, nēé hī ka Ujáríyɔ̄si gā á. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī leyīkwu ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú igelī abɔ́ɔ. Ó túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kóō gā ɔlɛ́ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
idu_Latn: Igelī nēé ce igá kú ɔdɔ tū ɔ̄ ā tá alácɛ̄. Ācɛ kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá anú bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā. Ó kwú pīya ɛga olúlé mɛ́mla ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ̄ kú aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá.

eng_Latn: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē, ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō. Ísu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu, nēe bá ipú nū ā, kéē tá úgbagwú kéē yá uya.

eng_Latn: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ígwu átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā géē wā ɛyí kú nū okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, klla í je īnyīlɛ̄yí ā kpó tū ɔlá kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ olicō kú ɔdɔ kú igá ā miya, anɔ́ɔ ó wɛ umíta ofɛtá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ gē miya odée ā.

eng_Latn: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.
idu_Latn: N le okónu tá lɛ odúúdú aá. Ohígbū ka odúúdú aéwo ā bá ī pīya um tū.

eng_Latn: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ ā leyīce ka Ɔwɔicō géē ka alɔ gwó mla iyīnū, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gbēyī nū ŋmá lɔfu kú alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ɛlā nū nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
idu_Latn: Aá géē pó ofu kú ɛfú ōkpó mɛ́mla ɔ̄kā kú ɛfú. Aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā nēe bá ā géē yá piíí, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ ā í wā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
idu_Latn: N húmáyī tū aíkonó kú um, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ɛhɔ̄ fu aá. É da aá ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá kóō mā ɔ́bíipú nōó ī bī ā tá, kóō lɛ ucē kú nū pīyabɔ̄. Aá híī pā ɛcí kú aéwɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē gbā uwá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē yēeyī ligbó ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā ā. Amáŋ aá jāhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē pó ɛlā kú um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
idu_Latn: Ohi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ō tá wɛ ocābɔ̄ mafú kú ɔtu oyēŋēē nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nēe bá nyā, ŋmífī nɛ̄ n pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce Óndú Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá he aá ɔtū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla aítíca: Ubánābasi, Usáyímɔ̄ni , Ulúsīyɔsi , Umánɛn mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ ofu kú aɔ́dā nēe géē wā ā, amáŋ ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ owu nɛ̄hi ŋmá ipú ígbíli wā ī fíyɛ́ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú inu, nēé bá ipú nū bā í lé ucɛ nyā, kwu inu ā ú wúla klla uwá bá ajɛ gbuduum á. Odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ gekwú. Ami ōfōōfū um kwu wā gaá da uwɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm géē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Ɔtū kē he um nwunééné ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú um yá ā. Ohígbū ka onyatá nōó nya um tá ā wu um iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ īlī yíifa ā. Ɛpɔ̄hi nōó hɛ́ gā um ā kē wu um iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ úwé wuulu wiiyē ā. Ó lɛ um yíifa bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípōklóbīya nōo yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔnya ɛ̄pɛ̄pɛ̄, nōo ī lɛ ɔdōōkwɛyí yíifa kwɛyí bɛ̄ɛka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā nōo yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔbá nōo ī kpó aɔ́dōleyíifa pla iyē ā.

eng_Latn: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kwú ɔnya ú le yɛ í jīla anú ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wɛ ɛbɔ́ kɛ̄ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa lɛ ō yá mla ɛbɔ́, wā gaá tá um igbīhi, Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ o gbāājɛ ā le ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nāa tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le tá ajɛ ɛgiyí uwā, amáŋ ó kwúcē wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ í je ōcē obɔ̄bí dóódu nōo gē tū ā ŋ́má ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ owu gbɔɔ́ ō tá ŋmá ɛháajɛ, aá ka iyē gáā kwɔ́lá ɛɛ́. Iyē kē ī kwɔ́lá ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí ede dóódu, ācɛ gē gwutá ɛyí īlī nēé miyɛ̄ cabɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aógbɛhá nēe bī uwā ulé ā. É klla gē gwá ejé nēé nú abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe bī uwā ulé ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ lɛwa ipú ajɛ ā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá gaá bá ī pā ɛcí. Okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá ā cɛ̄ lɛ ajɛ ā le ŋmíkpākplā. Aácí kē le kpó ŋmó. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā bá ī yá ucē obɔ̄bí, klla ī bī ɔfú kú uwá ī yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ede kú ɛcí mɛ́mla aójibó nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó nyɔ̄ í bónū ɔpɛ́ kú Ukídirɔn.

eng_Latn: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce aá, kóō lɛ aá tū.

eng_Latn: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
idu_Latn: É le uwá acá kwu acá ɛga otīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Acá kú uwā kwu īyī uwā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛga nēé ce ā. Acá kú uwá ɛpa ɔhá ā gaá kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú inu ā.

eng_Latn: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, é le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nyi, klla le ɔcí Ufáyin tū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ā kē le yá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yá ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ ipú íne ā, ó wɛ ɔdā ékpó fúlufúlu mla eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipú ɔkpíihɔ ka lɛ ā Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne ā géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ nōo cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá lɛ alɔ nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ á. Eko nēé gā Ujɔ́dan ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ ɔcí abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū ō yéékpó kú ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú gbō ɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī doōcē glá. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ɔtū kú nū yéékpó gɛ ŋ́, ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛpa ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á. Ó kē ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda iháyí ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā yɛ kwu ajɛ kú odúúdú ācɛ Usídɔn ɛ̄nɛ̄ o lā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn mɛ́mla Umísrēfotameyim ā. N géē nū odúúdú ācɛ ā ŋmá ajɛ ā, abɔ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ gē wā ā. Ó da Ujósuwā kóō lɛ ajɛ kpó kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ tū ɔ̄ ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
idu_Latn: le ka lɛ Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Áyááyí kú uwɔ dúúmā nōo le nyɔ́nyí í gáā gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɔdōlé ɛ́dɔ dúúmā gā um ŋ́. Íne nyā í yɔ̄ jāā gbéeko ɛcɔ̄bū nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka lɛ aéwɔhá ā kahíníī, Aá wā bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipú ūpū, aá wā í kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lé!.

eng_Latn: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
idu_Latn: Aá nɛ̄ ucē kú aá le kpaakpa ā, aá gwéeyē, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Aá nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā, aá gwéeyē ká aá tɔ́ɔga.

eng_Latn: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
idu_Latn: Ó yá kú ajɛ kóō yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, ó klla gē je ɔdōlé nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā gā uwɔ ká ā lé nū ipú.

eng_Latn: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yēeyī ɛ́ɛ́ mā, lɛ eyīyōce. Ohígbū ka, ewō nōo yēeyī ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ ágábá nōo gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da uwá ka aá ga Ugílgalu igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, kú aá klla kwú Usɔ́lu ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú aá igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā je yá ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɛhi ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ í cɔ̄nū da ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tá tū ɔkpá ā géē wā í klá anú jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu abɔ̄yī nū gā Uráma gaá háyi pī obuga éyi Uséku, anɔ́ɔ ó dɔɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ bá ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka é bá Unayótu ajɛ kú Uráma.

eng_Latn: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ɔhi kú Ujerúsālɛm wɛ ɔdā kú íkée mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ebóo, nɛ̄ ó má ɔdōlé lé ŋ́, nōo yɔ̄ ī kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí aófītɛ́ nēe bá ī nū ɔ̄ inya ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū le oyī kú ɛna ā bī gé lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ayíkābɔ̄ wu ɔ́, kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu aájī kú ede ā á. Ó kwú ohile kú nū ú pīya tū ɔkwu kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Nyɔ̄ mla ācɛ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ, amáŋ, ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē ka gā uwɔ ā nāa géē yá á.

eng_Latn: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtūlalī kú aá kpó tū iyē nyɔ̄ gaá pɛ̄cí nēé hī ka Umolɛ̄ki ā. Aá gē tíne ɛcí nɛ̄ aá géē pā ga ɛga dóódu, jāā kwu ɔlékwū dúú.

eng_Latn: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē bī īkpēyī kú um má ɔ̄ á. Ó kē í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n jé bɛ̄ɛka oklóbīya um ā. Eyī kú eko ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ ī ce um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ anúɔ ī gbā ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ dúúmā í yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
idu_Latn: Ubálāki klla le aótrɛ̄yí alɛwa fíyɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ o le ojīlīmā fíyɛ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ubálam igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa túblá okómpinu kú útuló ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ussádrāki, Uméssaki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, aá bɛ̄cɛ ká aá wā amānyā. Anɔ́ɔ ayípōklóbīya ɛtá ā kwú pɛ́ wɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlá ā á.

eng_Latn: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
idu_Latn: Ujówɛ̄lu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā, Usáfam kpokónu ce ɔ́ á, Ujánāyi mɛ́mla Ussáfati wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubássan á.

eng_Latn: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ īyī aá kɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ ká aá kéē bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā eko dóódu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē tá ipɔ́ɔnu éyééye kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī le nyīla ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́ mā, ālɔ̄ lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi kéē kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛyíkwu iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
idu_Latn: Aá gwó aŋma kú oje, kú aá cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
idu_Latn: Ífulá ō ka klá ɔ̄cɛ, ɛcɛ péee, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ihɔtū ō tayínū ipú á.

eng_Latn: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛlā nēé ka ipú ɔkpíihɔ nyā le yá jīla ipéyī aá ícɛ nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ á pó abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n jé ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ nyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhasɛ́lu kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ubenhádādi nōo da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa ka lɛ ɔ́ɔ ā? Uhasɛ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ géē wi piíi.

eng_Latn: And last of all the woman died also.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, odúúdú uwā, kwu ɔnyā ā dúú le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhágāyi kahíníī, Óndú ā ka, ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú éwo nyā á, mla ɔdā dóódu nēé yá ā á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔdā dóódu nēé bī wā ɛyí ede ā kwú tēelihɔ ohígbū ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā kwú tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn bī ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā le agidigbé ō yɛ ga icō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gbā. Ó klla bī ɔcí ā le gbā agidigbé kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū, ó le ɔ́ yá ɛ̄ngwū, úmōlō, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā oōbī gwííjē ɔhá dóódu. Nɛ̄ ɛdɔ nū í yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
idu_Latn: Aútéblu ɛnɛ ɔhá bá ɛcɛ kú inu nyā. Ɛpɛɛpa bá āyā ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa kú okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā.

eng_Latn: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ kwu īkpeyī kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ó le yá lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá kú Inímrim kwú ŋmó ɛɛ́, ácí kú nū kwú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ dúu ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dúúmā í wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ abɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
idu_Latn: Unehemíya ka aá kwú ɔdɔ ā ú gwó kwɛyí, klla kwú odúúdú ɔcí kú ɔwɛ ā ú kpó kwú ɛga nēé tɛtɛ kwu ā. Ó ka é le úklɔ́ otɛtɛ kú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ācogwíije ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi o hile ā kpó kwúcē lɛ uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā dóódu, aá lɛ ɔyí ɔbá ɛna ɛpa, omlede éyi, mɛ́mla aálá ahāapa kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā, kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá mɛ́mla anú bá ī gbō Ujísɔ̄si ā, lɛ ajɛ nōo jíliyē mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, úfi le uwá kwú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ n.

eng_Latn: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, fīyégbúlú, abɔ̄ a géē yɔ̄ i lé ɔdōlé ā, ká ā yɔ̄ ī fīyɛ kpákpákpá ohígbū ufi, abɔ̄ a géē yɔ̄ ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ikwū je klá Óndú ā ipú unwalu kú uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú unwalu mla ákanya kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka aá le aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā kpó klla le aɔ́dā dóódu nēe ca aá ɛgbá kpɛ́mm ā kpó wu ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ámōōmɛ kú um yɔ̄ á: ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō junwalu gā um fíyɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ofu ágbe nōo bá um ɔkpíyē ā mafú ka n wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Ébrahām ā le inya kwu gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Kócōō je éŋkpɔ̄ gā um lígíí kú um gwá ŋmá ɔjá kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
idu_Latn: É géē kpó odúúdú ijē kú nū, ijē kú ugbé mɛ́mla ijē nōo klá iyíipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
idu_Latn: A géē wá ijē ŋmá omlede ā ugbé, iyē kú nū mɛ́mla ijē nōo gē klá iyíípú, anyī, aíkplí ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā mɛ́mla o ŋmá átákwū abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū.

eng_Latn: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ jégēdēē, bī oje, ámāŋ ɔcí le fīyɛ̄ ɔ́mpa nū le ɔ́ ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ. É géē je ɔ́ ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā da Ɔwɔicō ɔdā nōó géē yá ā glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē cīje kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá bá ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ gē mīyɛ aɔ́nya nēé gē kpó ŋmá Umúsiri mla Usílísiya ā kpó lá lɛ ācɛ ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
idu_Latn: N wā gaá tū ɛcɛ ā ɔlá, eyī yá um ka ɔlá kóō kōō gbɔɔ́ ō yi mɛ́ɛ̄!.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nēé le ŋmó, ámāŋ okwū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú abɔ̄yī nū, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ikpokwú kú okwū ámāŋ ka únóji, o géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóram gekwú anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɛgiyí únóji kú aɔ́cɛ́ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Ahasíya le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
idu_Latn: Gbō um ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ujɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ le jīla tɔ̄há ipú agbla kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēé hī ka Ukáyāfasi ā.

eng_Latn: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɛ̄ yá lɛ ɔ́. Umáta yɔ̄ gē cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄, Ulásārɔ̄si wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú ācɛ nēe bá gē lé ɔdōlé mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā um í he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́, ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā kóō le yá.

eng_Latn: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: N géē lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ lā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ yɛ kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aótrɛyí lɛ aá nēe géē lɛyítáajɛ gā um. É kē í bī íjééyī mɛ́mla ɛyí ɔdōōjé le gbō aá.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko kpií ā, n géē jíla ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ajɛ mɛ́mla ísu iyē.

eng_Latn: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām le ayí álá ahāapa kpó fō ŋmá ipú aálá kú nū.

eng_Latn: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu ka anúɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ tá ō hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kéē je ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ogbonɛnɛ kú uwā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō bī Alelékwū kú nū lɛ ɔdōtayínū kú nū ā mafú lɛ alɔ. Alelékwū ā gē jila ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu, ó kōō wɛ ɛlá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbo tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
idu_Latn: Ó tɛtɛ lɔhi gā um, amáŋ acígilí Óndú ā lɛ um oyēeyī fíyákátā. Ó lɛ abɔ̄ wu um ɔkɔ ká, le um fīyāajɛ lɛ um ca bɛ̄ɛka aklɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū, a jɔ̄ɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, á lɛ ɛcá ámāŋ ɔ́nyí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
idu_Latn: A gē lā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛbɔ́. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a jila aálá kú uwɔ, odúúdú uwā géē bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ba, í yɛhɛ tū um eko dóódu. N klá kwu pīya ɔdā ō bī hijā kú odúúdú ūwā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka aá le jé ka ācɛ klla géē lá aɔ́lɛ́, mɛ́mla aájɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́hɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin ipú ajɛ Ujúda nyā igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá Umítīka ā, é gaá lā Uhassmóna.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ācɛ ā yá uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nāa cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bīya íne obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔtū géē yɔ̄ í wú um lɛ āa? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n gē yɔ̄ ī lɛ unwalu nɛ̄hi lɛ āā? N géē lɛ ɔtū kú um ce, Ɔwɔicō. N klla géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú um nōo ī hɛ́ um tá ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
idu_Latn: Nááná alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā cɛ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō ékpó yɔ̄ á, nōo wɛ Ádā, nōo yá odúúdú aɔ́dā dóódu ā. Alɔ kē yēeyī lɛ ɔ́. Óndú ékpó kē yɔ̄ á, anú kē wɛ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, anú yá odúúdú ɔdā dóódu á. O ŋ́má ɛgiyí nū ā nɛ̄ alɔ yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá lɛ anɔ̄ okpócu nyā nōó le nya um iyē, ó ke lɛ um tútū gbēyī eko nēé í nyi um ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ n kahíníī, Éléélelé! Ákú um mɛ ɛ́ɛ, n gebí ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kɛlā obɔ́bí ŋmá okónu kú um, n klla kē lā ipú ācɛ nēe gē kɛlā obɔ̄bí ŋmá okónu kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ n bī ikpēyī ābɔ̄yī um le ɔcɛ́, Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā má.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɔ́ yɔlá mɛ́mla anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī umuumu kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ oblatū kú ɛ̄gbā ō yɔlá lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: N gēe jē ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kpó la ācɛ oobíɔbíipú nɛ̄hi, a, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbó uwá. Ami Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
idu_Latn: Ka aá í dɔ̄ɔkā ō jíkwú má ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔlá ā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú kpó aá ŋmó glá ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō pó igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
idu_Latn: Leyī kwu aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwɔ lɔɔlɔhi, ká ā jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄n má bá ācɛ kú Usiríya bá ī kwinya ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya ŋmá iyɔ̄bū Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu, ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
idu_Latn: Ubákibūki, Uhákūpa, Uháhɔ.

eng_Latn: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ kéē je pīya ɛga ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛtá nēe bá ā: Ubɛ́sa ipú ajɛ o plákátá kú ɛyí ɛfu kú ígbíli nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísú kú Ujɔ́dan, mɛ́mla Ujérīko ā, ajɛ kú Urúbɛ̄n, Urámɔ̄tu kú Ugílɛ̄di ipú ajɛ kú Ugádi ā, mɛ́mla Ugólan kú Ubássan ipú ajɛ kú Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nyā dúú ā, Ujérobōwam lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ōhī kpó gaá kwāajɛ igbihi aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Ujúda ɛɛ́. Aícɔ́ɔja ohile kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē bá leyī pīya kwu aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
idu_Latn: A jé eko nɛ̄ aɛ́wū kú ipácí gē ma ayí uwā āa? A má īkpɛ̄ɛnū yɔ̄ ī ma ɔyí jéejéé ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aɔ́cí ā da ɔcí olujē ka ɔ́ɔ wā í lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá lé.

eng_Latn: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
idu_Latn: Ó leyī ɛpa gē je íwɔ́tū kú nū tayínū ipú ɛlā olɔnyɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú um dúú cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā dúúmā nōo cíkā ā n géē cíla aá. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú lá lɛ ācɛ Íssmɛ̄lu nēe bá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ yá ɔ̄ ágbe ŋ́. Ó kē wɛ ayínɛ́ alɔ, klla wɛ ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla oyī ékpó mɛ́mla alɔ nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ayínɛ́ nū ā cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ jé Ɛfrēm, ka anúɔ kē jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu ɔ́. Ó klla ka ka abɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ō lɛ ɔbá nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ ī yɔ̄ ī yá akwuna nɔ́ɔ gē je iyīnū tēelihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá dóódu nyɔ̄ mla anú gɛ ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Upíta mla Ujémīsi mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ Ujɔ́ni.

eng_Latn: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í klla gáā gbɛnú ce uwá kú otábɔ̄ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā nōo gē yá Íjīpiti ā géē mafú lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ obɔ̄bí ō lɛ kéē nyɔ̄ ī gbɛnú ce ācɛ Íjīpiti kú otábɔ̄ a. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
idu_Latn: Ayí um, n tá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā fu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híī bīyíne gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ íne bīya, alɔ lɛ ɔ̄cokɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ alɔ iyɔ̄bū ádā ā, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, olɛ́pɔ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da óndú um kahíníī, Cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n kwú aólɛlā kú uwɔ ú yá uka ō lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
idu_Latn: É lɛ tútū mla ɔtā mɛ́mla ōbō kú uwā. É lɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi, í klla ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. É ce ɛyí aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā bá ī wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu ā. É le tútū ɛfú lɛyíkwu aá, ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á jé ka Ubáalīsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔ̄ri, lɛ Íssmɛ̄lu tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō gaá kwú uwɔ ú ŋmó ŋ́ nɛɛ? Amáŋ Ugɛdalíya í cɛ̄ ɛlā nēé ka nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubɛ́lssása yɔ̄ gē gwá ejé ā, ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē gaá lɛ íkókwū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nēé bī oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla oje udɔ yá uwā nɛ̄ ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kpó ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm wā ā, kpó wā ká anúɔ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú anúɔ, anyā anúɔ, mɛ́mla anyā ō cikpó kú anúɔ, kéē bī uwā le gwá ejé.

eng_Latn: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjathjearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD; come ye down, and fetch it up to you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ kú Ukɛriyati Ujéyarím kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya kwu ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ɛɛ́, aá wā kú aá gāá kwú ɔ̄ ú.

eng_Latn: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
idu_Latn: Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū, wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé hɛ́ ɔ̄ apī á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da aá ka, ami abɔ̄yī um géē tíne aálá kú m klla í leyīkwu uwá mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā wā í klá Usɔ́lu nɛɛ, Udéfīdi kwú ɛ̄ngwū kú nū ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gwō ɔ̄ lɛ Usɔ́lu, cɛ́ɛ́ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá, cɛ́ɛ́ iyē kē kwu lɔfú lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla kwu pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú, Óndú ā da Umósīsi, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umíriyam kahíníī, Aá ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā, kéē wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā le pɛ́ tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwáahāapa kú ɔyā ahāapa ā, úgbéenyi ā gaá cɛyí aɛ́fu kú Árārati.

eng_Latn: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ócē obɔ́bī tū klá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ úlā ofahātá cuúlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le pɛ́ gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá ō pó ikwū kóō tá abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ogbɛhá gē je ā, eko nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū gáā jikwū ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu tóohi kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, ń jé kóō wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ŋ́, ohígbū kéē lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, Ā híī ka obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ ogbāājɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si pīyɛyí wā Ugálīli, ó kē le ɔfú kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ofu kú nū le nyīla le tá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
idu_Latn: Ikpíikpó ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ā jé, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá í gbɛlá ɛdɔ kú ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ɔhá kpó fu ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā je lɛ uwá ā. Ó klla ka ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ cíka ō hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Óndú ā kahíníī, Ahāpōtú n géē yɛ bū ipú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
idu_Latn: Ó géē pīya aádā mɛ́mla ayí ūwā tɔ̄há igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ā ŋ́, n géē wā í kpó ɔlɛ́ kú aá ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
idu_Latn: Ukɛ́dɛssi, Uhásɔ, Utánan.

eng_Latn: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníi, Ń wɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kwu gāá tayínū ā nóó. A gbɛlá ka ami ɔ́ɔ gē nya oyēeyī kú um tá ŋmá lɛ ō nyɔ̄ í kwu tayínū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛɛ? Ń gáā yá ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ.

eng_Latn: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
idu_Latn: Nááná, a gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ, a gē gwō. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛdɔ kú oōgwō ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ kú ɔyā éékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla, le okónu gwū klla lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wu iyē klla le ewo gwu klá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā abɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ny­ā wɛ Ɛlíssāma, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdu.

eng_Latn: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ó jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó bī le yá alɔ ā, ó klla le bla ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ɛfú kóō kpó ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. Ɛfú kóō kpó ācɛ nēe lā igelī nēe lé ka Ubábīlɔn ā. Ɛfú kóō kpó aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aójéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhābu le ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja ka ā pó kwɛyí ā, ó kwú īlī kú nū ú híla klla kwú īlī ekwu ú kpó klá iyē, klla le okónu gwū, bī īlī ekwu wiiyē yɔ̄ ī yɛ tuútuú mla ɔtúnōbí.

eng_Latn: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ajɛ cē tū ajɛ kú uwā lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé ɛbɛ́ eko dúú nōo he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
idu_Latn: Ó í lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔkpani nū wā í má abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nōó da ɔ́ kóō yá eko nōó pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā!.

eng_Latn: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́da je klla le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kahíníī, Áa nyɔ̄ ga ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kú aá gaá hɛ́ abɔ̄ kú alī, ēpū ɔcí kú ólífu, ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí nē é hī ka Umɛ́tulu mɛ́mla aɔ́cí ō lɛ ēpū jugwujugwu dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kpó ce ɛcɛ, kú aá lā ipú nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ odúúdú aéwo ɔhá nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā gbaáluka. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛdo kú ācɛ o gbaáluka nɛ̄ ádā nū Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ gbaáluka ā. Odúúdú aéwo ɔhá nēe lā ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ, úlā ofu igwáahānɛ ce ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he um mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ mɛ́mla éeyē ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú!.

eng_Latn: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú ācɛ ipú ɛcɛ nyā lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi lɛbɛ̄ɛka úklɔ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja gē yá abɔ̄fú ā. Ó klla lɔfú tū iyē lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyēeyī kú ācɛ nēe ī yúklɔ́ ɔ́gwū nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, kócōō, Ɔwɔicō kú um, méyīnyinyi uwā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔkɔ nēé í gbā gā awɔ ā pó. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yá ā í yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa ā géē lé úgwū kú ajɛ ā, klla í lā ipú ajɛ ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ka, n kwú pīya olɛlā kú aá ɛɛ́. N géē kpó aálá kú um ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, aá gáā wɛ ācogbāálá kú um ā gɛ ŋ́. Ń klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá bá ī lɛ ɛlá kwu iyī aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē hɛ́ aálá kú um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aá, n gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá je uwá kpó ŋmó lé ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā gbo iyāwu kú uwā ŋmá Uhasɛ́rɔ̄tu abɔ́ɔ gaá lā ígbíli kú Upáran á.

eng_Latn: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda le ikpati gbā, lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́bū ɛyí nū, kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɛyí ede abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo géē yɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, géē je odúúdú ije nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē wā í gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā gē bī wā í le tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ɔ̄ ā í kpó tū ipú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
idu_Latn: Ikpíkpó nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ géē móowē ā mɛ, ɛnɔ géē je dobū, ɔyā í kē gáā fíyajɛ glá ŋ́, aínyílɔ́wɔ í fō ŋmá ɔkpáncō, Ɔwɔicō í jíla ɔfú kú ɔkpáncō iyē.

eng_Latn: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú agbénú nōó lɛ ā géē kpó yíífi. Ɔlá nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ í tū ŋ́ mā géē je ɔ́ yi tāajɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nōo lā ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú a yɔ̄ ī ka a ka lɛ ācɛ ā. Da uwā ka, É lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī éyi tūlé klla lɛ ɔ́ nya pálúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
idu_Latn: É bī agbá ō jíla tɔ̄há le yá ifa tū icō kú ogbló ā. É klla bī oje udɔ le ija kú ofu kú ohéepu kú ɔcí nēé hī ka upomégraneeti ofu ɛhɔ̄ he tū ɔ̄ É kē le uwá kpó gɔ́ tū agbá ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām le yɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī le tá ɛga nōó māháyi iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄, eko nēé ma Áyísīki lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ iyī alɔ mafú ŋmá olɛhɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔna nū ā, mɛ́mla ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nōo húmáyī bī alɔ yúklɔ́ ā. Alɔ bī oyēeyī okpaakpa nɛ̄ alɔ lā bɛ̄ɛka iyɔ́fú ā. Alɔ ī bī ɔ̄ le nuunu, klla ī bī ɔ̄ le gbā iyī alɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
idu_Latn: Étam ma Ujɛ́siríili, Íssma, Ídibāssi mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā Uháselelipóni á.

eng_Latn: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
idu_Latn: Ami, Ujɔ́ni pi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe ī pó olɛhɔ̄ kú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ um má klla tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá nyā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔdā dúú ɔhá ka tū ipú nū, Ɔwɔicō géē ka aámíyā nɛ̄hi nēé cābɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá nyā ā tū italā kú nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
idu_Latn: É yɔ̄ ī yāwu kpɔ́ ŋmá Upága gā Ántīyɔ̄ku kú Upisidíya. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā é le pɛ́ tá ipú Ɛgogbɔɔkɔ gaá yāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔhá géē bá ī ŋmó aɛ́na kú uwā ipéyī uwā piíí ā, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā má ɛbɛ́ kú nū dúúmā lé ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ācɛ ɔhá géē bá ī pí aíjakī kú uwā nyɔ̄ ipéyī uwā, ɛ́ɛ kē gáā mīyɛ uwá cīgbīhi glá ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpó aálá kú uwá lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo géē tú uwā abɔ̄ kóō mīyɛ uwá bá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nwūla, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú, yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwá ā dúú lɛ ejé gwá, ó lɛ uwá kwú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí á. Ejé lɛ uwá kwú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é jé ɔdā nēé bá ī yá ā gɛ ŋ́ mā. Abɔ̄ ejé lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kwú ā, é klla jɛ́ɛyí ɛbɛ dúúmā nōo ŋmá ɛgīyī Óndú ā gɛ ŋ́. Abɔ̄ ejé kē lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kwú nɛ̄hi ā, é klla kɛpɔ̄ hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa lɛ ācɛ nēe gē kpó ɛpɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí uwā ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō, aá lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā. Anú gē tá aá abɔ̄ klla ī gbō aá á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ádi mɛ́mla Unaámani wɛ ayí kú Ubɛ́la.

eng_Latn: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá, aóklóbīya um, aá híīī yúúfi ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔkpíyē ŋmó, amáŋ é lɛ ɔdā ɔhá nēé yá glá gɛ ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́wá kú ācɛ o héjulúgwu géē kpɔ́fú gwū Ugádi, amáŋ Ugádi géē pīyeyī tū uwā, géē nū uwā inya ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Umanásɛ yá ā mla íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
idu_Latn: ācɛ nēe jé ŋmá ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ jé ka ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, ācɛ nēe pó ofu kú ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nōo í wā í cɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
idu_Latn: Olɛlā ámōōmɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yálé ā géē wɛ ikwū.

eng_Latn: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aá ipú ajoodobū ā, aá ka ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Ɔdā nēé kē ka tū aá ahɔ̄ ā, aá tɔ́ɔna nū ɛyí inu.

eng_Latn: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē ma ɔdōōcābɔ̄ fú lɛ aéwo ŋmá ɛga oligbó. Ó géē hī uwā igwú ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ kéē wā. É kē í bá ī kwinya fíyaa bá ī hápápá wā.

eng_Latn: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlímā ā gwó gā uwɔ ɛɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ a géē lā piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
idu_Latn: Ikwū nɛ̄ a ī je kú otabɔ̄ ā í gáā tá uwɔ abɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́. Odúúdú ɔfú kú uwɔ, í kē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ abālɔbányā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi nōo bá nyā pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla uwá dúú. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujéssuwa, mɛ́mla Ukadmíyelu, ayí kú Uhodafíya ā wɛ, ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
idu_Latn: nōo géē jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ipí ā kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kpɔ́, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ ā le yēŋēē, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
idu_Latn: É kē ī kɛlā dúúmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ í kɛlā ŋmá okónu kú uwā ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kōō ī pó ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árādi ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ukénan nɛ̄ lā Unégēbu ɛhájɛ kú ajɛ ā le pó ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ bá ī wā gaá bū ɔwɛ kú Atarím ā, é le ɔfú kpó í kwu uwá, le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
idu_Latn: É ŋmó alɔ ijē klla cá alɔ ɛcá nááná, alɔ mīyɛ odúúdú ijē mla ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aá ŋmá ipú igelī nyā í kpó aá tū ipú abɔ ācɛ aéwɔhá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ē lɛ aá yá ōwē kú ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n ŋmó aá ā.

eng_Latn: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko kpií ā, ācɛ ā géē bá ī ka ka aá í lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá í yúufi Óndú ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, é ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kōō í yá lɛ aá ɛ́ɛ́ māa?.

eng_Latn: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
idu_Latn: Uhesekíya ma Umanásɛ, Umanásɛ ma Émɔ̄si, Émɔ̄si kē ma Ujosíya.

eng_Latn: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá kú Ujúda ā ú kpó wā Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú ede kú ɛcí nēé gē kpó aódée gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɛyí uwā ā kpó tēelihɔ ɛga dúúmā nēé kwu kpɛ́mm ā. Ó klla le ede nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa, igbómína kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, gwó lɛ anjɛnū ā, nōo kwu abɔ̄lúfīyē kú okónɔɔwɛ nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bāé ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, kpó ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, géē bá ī cɔ̄nū kpɔ́. Ɔwɔicō kōō yɔ̄ ī yá uwā italā nááná, é gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
idu_Latn: Ā híī yíkpɛ́lā, ámāŋ ka o táafú mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó yá uwɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n jé kpɔ́cíí ka ohígbū ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē gbā ā mɛ́mla ohígbū otábɔ nōo ī ŋmá ɛgiyí Alelékwū kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, é géē hɛ́ um tá.

eng_Latn: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
idu_Latn: Ó bī aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ahāapa abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī o leyī ɛpa nōo lulé nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū. Eyī kú nū ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ofíyajɛ kú ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ nēe bá nyā nēé kpó lɛ uwá á, Ussɛ́kɛm, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó kē wɛ éyi kú igelī nɛ̄hi ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā. Aɔ́há wɛ, Ugɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá gē lɔnyɛ tū uwā, ācɛ nēe gē gwéeyē eko nēé bá ī bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄ ó lɛyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɛ́nɛ́ nū nɛ̄hi, Umáaka ú ŋmá āhɔ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcányā, ohígbū ka, ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā lɛ ojíbó kú Ássɛ̄ra ma lɛ iyīnū. Ása kwú ojibó kú ɛcí kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā ú wúlatāajɛ klla kwú ɔ́ ú kpó yɔlá ɔkpá kú Ukídrɔn.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā pó ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú íne nēé bīya ā ú yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā nwū uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a klla lɛ ɔwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wāajɛ kú uwā, Óndú. Ajɛ kú úgwū opiyóó nāa je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kóō wɛ ɔdā kú úgwū kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nwū ā ŋmá íne ɛpa nyā.

eng_Latn: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ wɛ Ubílga, ɔ́migwɛ́hīlī wɛ Íma.

eng_Latn: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ó cɛgbá ká n̄ tɔ́kpá fu aá lɛyíkwu eko piíí nɛ̄ Óndú géē wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō eko nɛ̄ alɔ gā Umasɛdónīya, alɔ í má ɛga mlɛ́nyɔ̄ ŋ́. Unwalu yɔ̄ gē wā ɛgiyí alɔ ŋmá ɛga dóódu, ācɛ ɔhá bá gē yíkpɛ́lā tū alɔ, ɔtū kú alɔ le wuklíicō.

eng_Latn: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aálá, aɛ́wū, mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú aá kpó kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Kú aá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā klla lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce um dúú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá ā kpó lɛ Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
idu_Latn: Uwá jé ka íne kú Ɔwɔicō ka ācɛ nēe yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā, ikwū yɔ̄ ī gbēyī uwā, nááná é mā ō yá ɔdā nēe bá nyā ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ é gē ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā dúú.

eng_Latn: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
idu_Latn: Ayí ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya ā géē tútū kéē kpɛ́fú. É klla í tū aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa bá nēe géē pɛ́ wā wūū bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá ō cēenyi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gaá lɛ ɔfú kpó kwu íga olɔfú nōo ī gbō ɔlɛ́ kú olɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī má ɔdā dóódu nēé bá ī yá ā. Ɔdā dúúmā nēé bá ī yá í tayínū ŋmá eyī kú um ŋ́. Íne dúúmā nēé bīya í gla um eyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ɛ̄nyā wɛ ka alɔ lɛyí ce ikwū, amáŋ ɛ̄nyā le pīya oyēeyī opíyóó lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyā ā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í yɔ̄ nōo gē gbō ɔlɛ́ aá eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú aá lɛ ɔfú kpó kwu aá ŋ́. Ɔlá kwú ogbló ō gwɔ̄wɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá í yíífi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́tam le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó le yɛ gaá háyi ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugɛ́rīsim, anɔ́ɔ ó dɛ̄gba le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ, ācɛ kú Usɛ́kɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá!.

eng_Latn: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya kú uwā kwinya fíyaa fíyɛ́ ɛjɛ á, É tūufi fíyɛ́ ɔgwú nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄ ā. Ācɛ okpɛ́fú-ɔnya kú uwā ce ɔnya wā ŋmá ɛga oligbó. Ɔnya kú uwā gē wu kwu olɛlā kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ucē ō je ugwū ā.

eng_Latn: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɛlá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ísɔ kwú ígwu éyi ú kpó yíífi, ígwu ɔhá nōo hile ā lɔfú kwu glá.

eng_Latn: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nēe bā nyā nēé le yá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄, nɛ̄ usiléti ɛpa nēé tá aíne igwó tū ā bá ipú nū ā. Umósīsi je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē bī áluka iyó ā wā á. Ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe yúklɔ́ ɛháajɛ kú Itáma, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā nɛ̄ Umósīsi da uwá kéē bī áluka kú ɔdā nēé ŋmó tū úklɔ́ ā wā á.

eng_Latn: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄nyā yá ā, ācɛ o doōcē o hile kú ɔlíidɔ ā le pɛ́ wā, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó nyatá.

eng_Latn: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ekōhī Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú lɛ eyīnyinyi anúɔ má lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce anúɔ kwɛyí ɛcá nɛ̄ Ussímēyi ɔ́ɔ cá anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā ígbíli kú Usíni, nōo wɛ Ukádɛssi ā.

eng_Latn: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
