idu_Latn: Ihɔtū mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ nɛ̄ ó gē tɔ́ɔlá ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, ɔ́dāŋ ka n kwú mlanyī uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um ú ŋmó tá um iyē ká n̄ má abɔ̄ le gwō ɛ̄ngwū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ɛnɔ ámāŋ ínyílɔ́wɔ í bɛ̄cɛ ipú ɛ̄cī alɛwa ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ úgbagwú ā kē yɔ̄ ī tá alɔ nɛ̄ɛnɛ̄hi ā, alɔ kwú ɔtū ú ŋmá eyīyōce ka alɔ í lɛ ohɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ami nɛ, aá lɛ ɔtūlé, aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn ŋmó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu alɛwa, ó kē ŋmó ācɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ɛcɛ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē je Ubábīlɔn yíífi á.

eng_Latn: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi géē lɛ ajɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí dúú ɛháajɛ kú ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, klla í wɛ ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɛhícō ga ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo í kɛlā okónu ucē nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá í jɛ́ɛyí nu ŋ́ mā, gē tá iyīnu abɔ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ka olɛhɔ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ā gē tá ācɛ icɔ́ɔci abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ije mɛ́mla agbénú í gē gbojī ō mɛ ŋ́. Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ piyóó glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ híī je mlanyī Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá kéē má kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú, amáŋ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó yá í bɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ákú ádā nū, Áhābu mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū Ujésēbɛlu ā ŋ́. Ikpékwīja kú Ubáal nɛ̄ ádā nū ma ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
idu_Latn: Obugā nɛ̄ Íssmɛ̄lu kpó okwū kú ācɛ nōo ŋmó ā tū ɔɔ́ ā wɛ ɛnɛ̄hi. Anú wɛ obuga nɛ̄ Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda tɛtɛ, bū eko nɛ̄ Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄ ā á. Íssmɛ̄lu le obugā ɔ́ɔmā mu mɛ́mla aókwū ā.

eng_Latn: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, aá le héyī, aá le héyī kú aá cāŋjɛ. Ōwē nɛ̄ aá má ohígbū ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Aá lɛ ōwē ā má jāā ga ajaajɛ nɛ̄ aá háyi kpaakpa glá ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwá ejé ŋmá ipú íkókwū jāā gbéeko nōó kwú odúúdú nū í gwá nōó lɛ ɔ́ kwú gē túgagá gɔwɛ ga ácí ā.

eng_Latn: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
idu_Latn: Aá cāŋjɛ ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄. Aá mɔ́ɔ̄ oyíbīyājɛ tū um ā yɔ̄ ajaajɛ amānyā.

eng_Latn: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD's anointed?
idu_Latn: Ofíílí kú ɔcɛ́ kóō tá ɔ̄ ohi ā, Abíssāyi, nōkónu da ɔcɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō lɛ Ussímēyi ŋmó, ohígbū ka anú ɔ́ɔ cá ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu ā ɛcá á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu má gbo klá ádā nū, yɔ̄ gē jikwū klá yɔ̄ ī le ɛyí nya ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo ī yá tá alɔ eko dóódu ā nwuné. Ó gē yá okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ā nū jīla piyóó. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, í tōō le gbla ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ŋ́ mā, ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ a gēe yúufi nū á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayí kú Ujɛhóyākim ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nēé kwú alagbá kú ɛfú ga Ubábīlɔn ā. Ó ma ayí ahāapa. Iyē kú uwā wɛ, Ussēyáltīyɛlu.

eng_Latn: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tá ō je ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ yá aá ā yá uwá ɛhi, Ádā aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, í gáā je ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ā yá aá ɛhi ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ ā lɛ ācɛ obɔ́bíipū ā ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbóngbō nɛ̄ owu gē gwu bónū ā.

eng_Latn: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si! Ɔkpani! ményinyi alɔ!.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ ábáa. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nēé gē tá otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ohi ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í je ihɔtū kú alɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ŋ. Aá wɛ ācɛ nēe je ihɔtū kú aá ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ayínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu le yɛ tá Ussɛ́kɛm gaá gbō álá kú ádā uwā.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛlā ka ga um igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā, Uhɛsɛkíya yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo he Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔkpáncō yíla ɛpa gā ajɛ. Ojuja kwú dobū nɛ̄hi kpímm ɛháajɛ ikpó ōdajɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ nōo māháyi iyɔ̄bū óndú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē kɛlā ga uwɔ glá āa? Ɔfú dúúmā ī yɔ̄ ipú um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú aá nɛ̄ n yá nēé kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
idu_Latn: Āa híī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ aá géē kwú, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le anɔ̄ tū aá ɛyí, le aá fu. Anɔ́ɔ é le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi da uwá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú géē je uwá lé. Aɔ́gwú géē kpó aókwū kú uwā lé.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ohígbū ádáádā nū, Udéfīdi ā, Óndú ā klla kwú Ábījam, éyi kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ú cɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda igbīhi nū. Ó klla le Ujerúsālɛm tú kwaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā ga ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si glá ŋ́ ohígbū ɛwa kú ācɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛyí inu ɛga nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si klá piíí ā hɛ́ bū. Eko nēé lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ hɛ́ jɛ̄ nɛ̄ ákplata nōo bī ɔ̄cɛ ā í bū ɔ̄ glá ā, é kwu ɔ̄cɛ ā ú bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā wāajɛ mla ákplata nɛ̄ ó gwutá anú ā.

eng_Latn: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá ká n̄ tɔ́kpá fú aá lɛyíkwu ihɔtū o yá tá ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yíhɔtū tá ɔ́mpa aá nwū aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nēé hi ka Ugádi ā wā í da Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ klá ɛga nɛ̄ ó tayínū ā ŋ́, amáŋ kú ɔ̄ kwu ga ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le kwu ga ipú ūpū kú Uhéreti á.

eng_Latn: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka alɔ pó ka ācɛ ōhī kú aá tá kéē yúklɔ́, amáŋ é kē ī gwōtū ipú ɛlā kú ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ā? Ālɔ̄ klla gbɔɔ́ ō bīyíne kpɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gē bī eyīnyinyi nɛ̄hi kú nū gē lɛ gbō alɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ uwā kóō kwú pīya alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā hile nōo géē lā inu ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔfú nɛ̄ n gē yá uwɔ odée glá, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ pi um ahɔ̄ ka n̄ híī fu uwɔ ɔnū ɔwɛ dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ká ohílīpú olɔhi nāa lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nāa yá ícɛ nyā, nāa lɛ um ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó mla ɔ́ci ō gwō ci ā.

eng_Latn: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
idu_Latn: É géē lɛ ɛnɔ yá kóō le dobū, é kē í yá ɔyā kóō le tɔ́wá bɛ̄ɛka oyī ā. Gbɔbū ká ɛ̄cī kú Óndú ā kóō wā ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī olɔfú ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
idu_Latn: O má ɔdā dúúmā kú oyēeyī ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī lɛ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, nááná ā, ó kē lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ujɔ́ni da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó wɛ íne ōbīya ká ā lɛ Uhɛrodíyas ɔnyā.

eng_Latn: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ita kú Usólōmɔn, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Uhɛ́sɛkíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda tá tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísāka ā wā mɛ́mla Udɛbɔ́ra. Ācɛ Ísāaka wā, Ubárāki kē wā dúú. É yɛce ɔ́ ga ipú ajɛ ɔpɛ́ ā, Amáŋ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n le kɔ̄, é jē ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ kéē géē wā nɛɛ ámāŋ kéē gāá wā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujohánan mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, kwú ācɛ ā kpó kwúcē ŋmá Ugíbēyɔn. Ācɛ ā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Íssmɛ̄lu kwú aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá Umíspa eko nōó lɛ Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé lɛ uwá búdá nēe wɛ aígabɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kpó ŋmó ā á.

eng_Latn: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Asírīya ā. Abɔ̄ dóódu nōó í le fīyɛ̄ uwā ā, ó géē wɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā géē bá í gwíijē mla uba mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū ā.

eng_Latn: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo klla lɛ uce olɔhi, géē lā oyēeyī nōo í tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ́, amáŋ ucē obɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gē je ɔ́ yíífi á.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu gēe je kpó ŋmó bá ɔtū; ɔtū kē í je gbenyi la ɔ̄cɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu, pó íbáa nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ uwɔ ā bá ī dɛ̄ eko nēé bá ī bī ipú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá yá ká ācɛ ā kéē má bá ajɛ. Ohígbū ka ácí yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā má bá ajɛ á. Áluka kú uwā ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā igwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó ā .

eng_Latn: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī Usábáti ā tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ yá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubáni ā wɛ, Uméssūlam, Umállūci, Adáya, Ujássūbu, Usíili, mɛ́mla Ujérēmɔtu.

eng_Latn: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú igbō ú lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛyí ede á, ohígbū ka igbō nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā, wɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é gē je ŋmá ɛyí ede ā klla gē je ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gwū ɔkwu nū bōōbū ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa kú ipú Aícɔ́ɔja Ɛtá ā wɛ Ɛlísaa, ɔyí kú Udódo nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Áhoh ā.

eng_Latn: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
idu_Latn: A le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ohígbū ka a mīyɛ ayínɛ́ uwɔ odée kwɛyí ije nɛ̄ a le kplá uwá, nēé gbā glá ŋ́ mā. A klla lɛ uwá īlī plla, mā abɔ̄ uwā tá tóohɛ́ɛwa.

eng_Latn: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ́bíipú gē yá awanda, klla gē hɛ́ unwalu táajɛ. Ó klla ī je aóklóbīya ɛpa hɛ́ hī iyī uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū Umíriyam eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɛga nēé bá ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa á. Ācɛ ā í yɛ gɔbū glá ŋ́, gbéeko nēé le Umíriyam bī wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri le tútū ɛfú lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. É gāá lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛ́fú cē ce Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Umósīsi kɔ̄ ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujérīko mɛ́mla Ujɔ́dan eko nɛ̄ó yɔ̄ ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu ā á.

eng_Latn: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
idu_Latn: Ōwē kú um nwuné nɛ̄hi, Óndú, lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ó le yɛ tá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē ka ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, uwēyī í gáā kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ iháyí ɔ́mofɛpa cigwó ā fō tá, nɛ̄ aá géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā, keé le hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Odúúdú agbénú nēé kpó lá kpɛ́mm ā, é í je uwá kpó kwúcē igbīhi lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ aflɛ́yí ā, ámāŋ ka ayááyí kú ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēé je lá ɔfiyɛ ā géē kwúcē igbīhi ga ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū.

eng_Latn: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umánōwa gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí ɔnyā ā ipú ɛhɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔbá nū í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla ka kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n kɛlā nū ā géē wā piíí, ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā kē í yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
idu_Latn: Ipácí nɛ̄ ayí uwā gē jɛ̄ lɔfú iyē á. É gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga aɛ́nɛ́ uwá, é klla ī cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā mla usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa nɛ̄ íne igwó yɔ̄ anú ā, eyī kú nū yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ gē ceyī, ohígbū ka ó húmáyī kɛlā mla Óndú ā, anú abɔ̄yī nū í jé ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi je okwutɛ ā gicɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ fīyɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ā igbɛɛpa. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpá ku éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kwú yíla á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā gbɔɔ́ ō gwá á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu, ádā uwā ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá le odúúdú ayí um kpó ŋmá ɔtū kú um ɛɛ́. Ujósɛ̄fu le yɛ ɛɛ́, Usímīyɔn le yɛ ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā aá tíne kú aá je Ubɛ́njamīn nyɔ̄. Ami wɛ ō móōwe á.

eng_Latn: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka odúúdú íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā je lɛ anúɔ ka anúɔ nwū uwā ā ɔ́ɔ bá yɔ̄ á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ bī aíne ā lɛ yúklɔ́, kéē yɛce ɔdā nēé ka ipú aíne ā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ kéē lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nū Ábna inya. Ó yɔ̄ í nū ɔ kpaakpa, í klla nú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔkpíyē kú um lé, klla lɛ oyī kú um gwá, lā ipú um, n kē lā ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
idu_Latn: Ubɛti Ulēbáyōtu mɛ́mla Ussarúhɛn. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛtá mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si í yɛ ipú ācɛ Ujíyu cāā glá gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá ipɔ́lɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ kwu ígbíli nēé hī ka Ɛ́frem ā, abɔ́ɔ nōó yɔ̄ mla ayíkpó kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufarisīi mla ācɛ onwu íne kú Umósīsi lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú uwɔ í gē yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ nwū klla kpó tū alɔ abɔ̄ ā ŋ́ māā? Amáŋ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā é gē na abɔ̄ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī lé ɔdōlé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
idu_Latn: A jé eko nɛ̄ n gē cīce klla ī cāŋjɛ ā. Nááná nāa yɔ̄ ligbó ā, a jé ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ā.

eng_Latn: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá kpɔ́ Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō nwū ɛlā Ɔwɔicō okónu óókpoó kú Ugálīli. Ɛwa kú ācɛ nēe jīla tū ɔ̄ le nwuné nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ gaá cīce á. Ɔ́kɔ ā yɔ̄ ipú éŋkpɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā bá okónu éŋkpɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
idu_Latn: Ɔwolímanya kú nū ī fíyajɛ klá ɛcɛ, ɛcɛ kē ī gbɔɔ́ ō jíliyē.

eng_Latn: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū wɛ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí nēé lé ɔdōlé nōo jɛ̄ ajɛ kú Ukénan á. Īkpɔ̄da ōŋmɔ́lá mɛ́mla igbō nēé lɛ ɔdōnīgbo tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔyíkpó kú nū éyi da ɔ́ ka itíca, má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ mla inu nyā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ ā oo!.

eng_Latn: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ayínɛ́ nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá mla alɔ ā gē tɔ́ɔna kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ ācɛ ohígbū ímálānyī alɔ. É wɛ ācɛ o yíkpɛ́lā tá ācɛ ɔhá, amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá ā gē tɔ́ɔna kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋmá ɔtū ékpó.

eng_Latn: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē yúufi Óndú ā, aá cɛ̄tra anú. Odúúdú ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, aá wóófu iyē kū nū. Odúúdú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, nōó cɔ̄nū tū alɔ, yá alɔ ōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, klla cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ má ɔnɔ kú ɛfú á. Ícɔ̄nū kú nū yɔ̄ ī yi odúúdú ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Amáŋ, alɔ í jɛ́yí ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́. Ó yɔ̄ ī yi alɔ, naaná alɔ í kē nwū ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Upátīya mɛ́mla ācɛ Umɛ́dīya mla ācɛ Ɛlam mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Umesopotémīya, mɛ́mla Ujudíya mla Ukapadósīya, Upɔ́ntɔ̄si mɛ́mla Ésīya.

eng_Latn: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kōō jé áluka kú inyilɛyí nɛ̄ a lɛ ɛyí kú aá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá yúúfi ŋ́, aá jē Ɔwɔicō eyī nɛ̄ɛnɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ akpáŋdēde alɛwa á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ īkpɛ̄lā éyééye kú aíne kú Óndú ā, tá tɛ́ɛcɛ péee tū ɛga kú ɛcɔ̄ ā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bī áfū plla ā.

eng_Latn: One shall say, I am the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa géē ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú Óndú ā. Aóhī kú uwā géē ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ugbɛ kú Ujékɔ̄pu. Aóhī kú uwā géē tá iyē tū abɔ̄ kú īyī uwā ka aá ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú Óndú ā. É klla í lé iyē nōo í cābɔ̄ ka uwá ɛ́ɛ wɛ éyi ipú ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó awulú kú úklɔ́ kú uwɔ ā wu ɔ́ iyē, géē gbō ɔ̄ ɛ́nyɔ́, klla í je íkwu nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ lɛ ā lɛ ɔ́. Ó gē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádā ā lɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda.

eng_Latn: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe he um ɔtū ā í lɛ íkwu dúúmā ō wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka é bá ī yá ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. É gbɛlá ka aá géē bī oji nēé ī hɛ́ ā ámāŋ aɛ́bɛ́ nēé ī le gwɛ́ɛya ā le ci uwá ō je yíífi glá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛhɔ̄ le gla ā, Ananíyāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ācɛ ōhī kú anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ulɔ́ya, ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Utatúlɔ̄si le pɛ́ wā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔkwɛ̄lā kú uwā nēé kpó ce Upɔ́lu ā ka báajɛ iyɔ̄bū Igbómína ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Kwú ɔjá ú, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ okolo kú umaná ɛpa pīya tū ɔ̄, kú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ce iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú ā, kóō ce gbēyī ayááyí igbīhi kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwú ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā í cíkā ō lā lɛ iyī uwā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ é cíkā ō lā lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo kwú, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ohígbū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā wɛ, Ujéssuwa mɛ́mla Ukádimiyelu, ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhódafīya wɛ ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
idu_Latn: N da Óndú ā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Óndú um á. Ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nɛ̄ n lɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā jɛga lɛ ínoōbīya kóō gbō aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē gbō ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō gē gbō aá mɛ́ɛ̄ á, ó wɛ íne gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Usíya gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi únóji ɔlamu, ohígbū ōcē kú agwú nōo yá ɔ̄ ā. É nyi ɔ́ okwū ɔcɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɔ́tam lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
idu_Latn: É kwú mlanyī odúúdú aíne kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é klla le ojibó kú ɛna, Ássɛ̄ra mɛ́mla ubáalu kpó ma lɛ iyī ūwā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nēé tá tāajɛ lɛyíkwu alɔ ā ŋmónyí mla íne nōo kwú alɔ ā. Ó lɛ íne a pīya áncā abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ tū ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ nēe lā Udébiri ā.

eng_Latn: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
idu_Latn: odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe lɛ oyēeyī géē pɛ́ kwú igbeékpónú. Alɛɛcɛ kē í je kpó pīya úmúlá kwúcē.

eng_Latn: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā lɛ odúúdú ɔdā olɔhi nyā kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn wɛ Ɛlídād, ɔyí kú Ukíslɔn.

eng_Latn: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ n le pīyɛyí wā í tá aá kpɔ́, aá géē lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ aá géē bī Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si gwō ohígbū ɔdā nōó yá gā um ā.

eng_Latn: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú ɔdā dóódu yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō, owu nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ yēeyī ā, yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Art thou that Daniel, which art of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le Udánīyɛlu bī wā iyɔbū ɔcɛ́ ā bōōbū. Ɔcɛ́ ā da Udánīyɛlu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Udánīyɛlu ɔ́ɔmā, nōo wɛ éyi kú aálagbá kú ɛfú, ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu nɛ̄ ádā um, ɔcɛ́ ā bī ŋmá Ujúda wā amānyā á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó le inya kwu ga iyɔbū ɛwa ā gaá le icō ɔcí Usíkāmɔ tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ Ujísɔ̄si nōo gáā wā í yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā má.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ŋmá okónu kú uwɔ piíí ā nɛ̄ n gáā le kɛpɔ̄ tū uwɔ á. A jé ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔnɔ. N gē je ɔdā nōó wɛ ákú um ŋ́, n kē ī cē ɔdā nɛ̄ ń nyi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwú Ujísɔ̄si ā lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ɔlɛ́ Ukayáfāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ɛga nɛ̄ aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ jīla tɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē cokónu mla odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā, nēé gáā yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ka anúɔ géē kpó iyó ɛfú dóódu ŋmá ajɛ ā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, kwu odúúdú ɔkpacaŋgelī mla ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā bī aɔ́kplɛ́fú nɔ̄wá, é klla lɛ úwé kú ícɔ́ɔja nɔ̄wá wiyē. É bá ī tútū kéē kpɛ́fú. Aúgbɔ́nya o kpɛ́fú kú uwā gē hɛ́ manyamanya bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá! Aɔ́nya kú uwā bá gē hɛ́ɛkwɛ!.

eng_Latn: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le abɔ̄ nādaa wā ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpancō gaá le um pī ŋmá itekwū ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Utáya le igá o lɔfú kú ɔdɔ hɛ́ yɛ jīla iyī uwā tá. É le oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu tīkwū bá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úmúlá gē bá ajɛ ipú úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
idu_Latn: Ń tū aá ɛhɔ̄ ká aá gaá cē ɔdá nɛ̄ aá yúklɔ́ nū ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔhá lɛ úklɔ́ olɔfú ā yá ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ aá gáā cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā icííci á.

eng_Latn: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Ayí uwɔ ɛpa nēé ma gā uwɔ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí uwɔ amānyā ā, wɛ ákú um. Ɛfrém mɛ́mla Umanásɛ géē wɛ ákú um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Urúbɛn mɛ́mla Usímīyɔn wɛ ákú um ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
idu_Latn: Usekaríya ka anúɔ má Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo húmáyī kɛlā lɛ anúɔ ā, yɔ̄ ī gɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá wā í le jīla mla anú.

eng_Latn: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ɔmáapú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā, lɛ ɔ́ má lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ɛ̄nya wɛ ɔ́ci nɛ̄ ó gwō á. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ó géē wɛ éyi kú aá igwɛ́ɛpa ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ wu ócíbú mla um ā.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Ujówāsi lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá le odúúdú ije nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, kwu ije nēé hɛ́ lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō gba ā, mɛ́mla ije kú ɛ̄gbā, mɛ́mla ije kú ahínyá nēé gē wā í tá Ɔwɔicō ā mɛ́mla ije kú okónu ō ce ā kpɛ́mm ā kpó tayínū ɛgéégée.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
idu_Latn: Aá le pó keé ka, Eyī éyi kóō kwɛ̄yí eyī éyi. Ayīnu éyi kóō kwɛ̄yí ayīnu éyi.

eng_Latn: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlúúlā bá ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɛhósāfati. Ɔpɛ́ kú ɛpɔ̄ ōhɛ́ ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā í hɛ́pɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī wā fíyaa á.

eng_Latn: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ije nēé cē bá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā tá playi icō ikpɛ̄yí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
idu_Latn: N géē bī odúúdú ɔfú kú um le kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ ohígū ka n le cɔ̄nū mla ánya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Userúbābɛlu mɛ́mla Ujessúwa mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubénjamīn ā tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í cɛgbá ō tábɔ̄ kú aá, ɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ŋ́. Alɔ géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā abɔ̄yī alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya ā je ɛga klla da alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōo le pú ɛɛ́, í tōō nā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nōó yɔ̄ ŋ́, í gáā tōō gbaáluka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā klla le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ kéē kpɛ́fú tá uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é le uwá já ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. É klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmó ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Ugíbɛya ā. É ŋmó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka ofu cigwó ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdōlé yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm jɛ ācɛ gɛ ŋ. Ɔtū géē yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ācɛ ā ko klla ī wu klíicō lɛ uwá abɔ̄ é géē bá ī miya ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lé klla gwá ā.

eng_Latn: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā géē túgagá í gwōnū. Amáŋ, alɔ géē cāŋjɛ háyi kli.

eng_Latn: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ kahíníī, Aá da ācɛ nēé tɛtɛ da uwá táajɛ ā ka ucɛ kú um ā le tútū ɛɛ́. É lɛ aɔ́bá ɛna mɛ́mla ayí ɛna ojɔ̄kwū kú um ā ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dóódu le tútū ɛɛ́. Aá wā ɔnū ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē yá Ujúda, ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá Ísrɛ̄lu ā. N géē je ācɛ kú Ujúda kpó nū ŋmá ɛgiyí um. N klla géē tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm, klla í cīgbīhi kwu ɔ́. Igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n fu, nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um kwu ɔ́ ā. Ɛga nɛ̄ n ka n géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ kú ācɛ kéē wā í gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaajɛ kú ā gaá pi ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ kéē híī gla ɛjī ā wā gaá má um ŋ́. ɔ́dāŋ́ kaé le bēhé, alɛwa kú uwā géē pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
idu_Latn: Ŋmífī nɛ̄ n bī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ń je igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó gā um ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ iyē kú um gē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ká e gbā um ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ń kē je ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā wɛ ílɔ́wá, nēé ma ajɛ kú Ufinísīya kú Usiríya. Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā nū tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔ́ má ā, é da iyī uwā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí yɔ̄ ā? Ohígbū keé jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ aá kú aá lé á.

eng_Latn: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
idu_Latn: É bá ī yúuya ipácí yáwúyáwú bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ā, klla bá ī kwu bá īyī uwā kú ofū kóō ŋmó uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ukɔ́ra mɛ́mla ígwu kú nū ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī óócí, Óndú ā géē mafú ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ákú nū ā lɛ alɔ. Ó kē í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ákú nū ā, nɛ̄ ó kē fu ā, kóō túblá anú.

eng_Latn: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
idu_Latn: A le ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nēé hī ka Uráhābu ā ŋmó, a klla bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ le aólɛlā kú uwɔ kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le yɛ gaá lɛ odúúdú aíne mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū ā kpó ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā bī ɔkɔ ékpó le tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ géē yá odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā.

eng_Latn: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aá géē yúklɔ́ á. Amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā kóō wɛ ɛ̄cī ō tīihɔ, ɛ̄cī ihɔ kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ nēé je táajɛ lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo le úklɔ́ yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ē géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ipú ɔcí ujē ā kwɛyí ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā ā, amáŋ unwalu mɛ́mla agbénú mɛ́mla abahi kú oyēeyī nyā lɛ ɛlā ā kwu bá, anɔ́ɔ é jɛ̄ gajɛ ō gwá ikpō ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó le ijē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nwū um kú n̄ gwó, ijē kú ocɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ. Ācɛ alɛwa nēe géē má ɔdā nyā ā, í yúufi, klla í kpɔ́tūce Óndú.

eng_Latn: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla yēeyī iháyí úlā ce ofigwáahāanɛ ce ɛpa ɔhá kpɔ́ á. Ó le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bī ɛlā kóō kpó ce ācɛ kú Ujúda. Ó klla géē yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu italā dúú, ohígbū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gē yá ucē lɛ ā. Ó géē cíla uwá ulé kú ɔdā nɛ́ɛ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ukɛriyati Ujéyarím gāá kwu ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú ga ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Abínādabu, nōo lā ɛyí ɛfu ā. É kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔyí Ɛlísa éyi ɛyí klla kwú anɔ̄ ú tū ɔ̄ ɛyí dúú, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō leyīkwu ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē bī n gbɛka ka, amíyɔ̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɛhícō mɛ́mla ipú odúúdú éwo nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā. N géē kpó uwā cīgbīhi wā ewo kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā uwā a. Ami Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
idu_Latn: É pīyɛyí ŋmá unóji ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōo yá ā da ayíkpó igwóléyi ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ohile ā.

eng_Latn: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aólufa ā le ɛlā ka lɛ iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔyí ádɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ á. Aá wā, kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ agbénú kú nū le pīya ákú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ká aá gaá da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā gā um, ohígbū ācɛ ohile nēe bá Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛyíkwu ɛlā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá nyā ā. Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla alɔ, ohígbū ka aádáádā alɔ í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā ŋ́. Ɔdā nēé tá ipú íne kéē yá piíí, é kē yá uwā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya yá ā, kwu ɔ̄gɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó bū Ujerúsālɛm mla ɔdā ɔhá ā, é lɛ uwā tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
idu_Latn: Ícɔ̄nū bɔ̄bíipú klla ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, amáŋ ímálānyī bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, eko kpíii nyā, aá le pɛ́ kwu ga ipú inū ɔlɛ́ aá ka aá gaá lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū īyī aá. Aá kwú īyī aá í tayínū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔnū kú Óndú ā gaá le gla.

eng_Latn: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
idu_Latn: N má, ácí mɛ́mla ujē le mu tū odúúdú ɛhɔ̄ ā. Ácí klá odúúdú ajɛ ā kpúúmm, ɔdɔ kú ɛcɔ̄ kú nū klla kwú wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
idu_Latn: īkpēyī kóō kwɛyí īkpēyī, ayīnu kóō kwɛyí ayīnu, abɔ̄ kóō kwɛyí abɔ̄, ikpó kóō kē kwɛyí ikpó.

eng_Latn: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí dúú nōo gē lɛ íne tū, wɛ ɔyí ojéeyī nɛ̄, amáŋ ɔyí dúú nōo gē yá oklóbīya mla ācɛ ɛfulɛ́ɛfu wɛ uwēyī lɛ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le bá lɛ Ubɛ́tifégi mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tani, ɛgiyí ɛfú kú ɔcí kú ólīifu ā, ó le ayíkpó ɛpa kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpáncō gebí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ēpɔ̄kpá nēé ī hā ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ɛfu mɛ́mla idɔ dóódu le fu ŋmá ɛga nēé tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔ́da je lɛ ayí nū kahíníī, Abālɔbányā n gáā ga ɛgiyí aádā um ɔlékwū ɛ́ɛ́. Aá lɛ um nyi mɛ́mla aádáádā um, ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ɛ́frɔn, ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ā.

eng_Latn: How weak is thine heart, saith the LORD GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á. Ó kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɛdɔ odo icííci nāa lɛ ā nó ŋ! A ī yá ɔdā dóódu nyā bɛ̄ɛka akwuna nōo lɛ uwēyī dúúmā ɛyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ bū okónu kú odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ géē móōwē ā, ó bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ ɔ́ yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aá má ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn Unáhāsi yɔ̄ ī wā gáā kpɛ́fú tá aá ā, nááná nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá. Anɔ́ɔ aá da um kahíníī, Eko nyā wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, lɛ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ alɔ nōo géē gbō alɔ.

eng_Latn: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.
idu_Latn: Uháman gaá gbo klá ɔdōcīce kú Ɛ́sta pī ɔ̄, yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́, kóō ményīnyinyi anúɔ. Eko nɛ̄ Ágábáidu pīyɛyí ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā. Abɔ̄ nōó le ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā má ā, ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ. Ó gáā hɛ́ ɔcányā ā báajɛ, kóō gwutá mla anú ipéēyī um, agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú um amānyā kɛ̄ɛ? Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ɛlā nyā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú ɔcɛ́ ā, aídibo gaá bī Uháman báajɛ, kwú īlī ú pi wu ɔ́ ɛyí gblu.

eng_Latn: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le tá ipú nū á. Amáŋ é má okwū kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ācɛ kú ípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ā. Ajɛ ā yɛ ga ɛháajɛ jāā ga okónu ígbíli kú Usín, nōo wɛ ɛjī kú Ɛ́dɔm ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
idu_Latn: n géē yá uwɔ italā o ŋmá lɛ o tū ōcē obɔ̄bí klá odúúdú ɛbɛ́ kú aá. Kwu aɔ́nya, aíjakī, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá, aínyankwūlūmī mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú aá.

eng_Latn: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá ā géē bī ɔdā ō bī yúklɔ́ kú oje ámāŋ ka ogbló kú óbō abɔ̄. É kē í kpó aújē ā yɔɔlá ŋmáajɛ dúúdú abáábɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā lɛ okónu nɛ̄ó ce kóō je iyī nū tū ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā le yá jīla, é géē bī ɔ̄ wā Okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
idu_Latn: Áyísīki da ɔ́ kahíníī, N le hīla ɛɛ́, n lɔfú kwú eko dóódu glá.

eng_Latn: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā obɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gē je ɔ́ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Amáŋ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gē gbō ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ mɛ́mla ébú gē yā ŋmá ɔkpāncō wā ajɛ. É kē ī kwúcē gicō gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ éŋkpɔ kpó tāajɛ klla cɛ̄ lɛ ácí, ēpū mɛ́mla ɔcí le bū ŋmá ajɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ. É klla í yá ikpɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī nyi ɔ́ tū ipú ajɛ ā. Ó klla ī je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aólɛlā ā le odúúdú iyó kú ācɛ Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla iyó kú ācɛ Ugomóra ā kpó le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
idu_Latn: É kwú Aúsɔ́bɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aócíbú nēé gē bī gwu éwo kú ede ā ú kpó dúú. Kwú ɔdā dóódu nēé gē bī yúklɔ́ kú agege kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla aócíbú nēé gē bī pīya oyī kú ɛya nēé ī gwó tū ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla aócíbú kú ɔtulalī nēé ī le kwu ɔlá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyo kú oje ɔdɔ ɔhá dóódu nēé gē bī yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
idu_Latn: Aá gē kllɔcɛ́ ɔdā kú ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ka aá gbɛlá ka aá géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóo ŋmá ipú uwā. Amáŋ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kē ī cījáalí gā um.

eng_Latn: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ gē yíhɔtū lɛ aā, ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá mā ɔ̄ tá ā. Aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē ɔ́bíipú ɔ́ɔmā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ ī yá eko aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, n géē wā ɛgiyí aá cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú ɔdā o lɛ agege ce kú aá ú ŋmá ɛga nōo gē hayi ā.

eng_Latn: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aófulá nēé ī le wu ɛyí ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́kpɔwu nēé ī le wu abɔ̄, klla ī le gbɛ̄ɛnyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
idu_Latn: Ujóyāda wɛ ɔyí kú Ɛlíyāssibu, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya amáŋ, éyi kú ipú ayí kú Ujóyāda ā lɛ adá kú Usánbālati lɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ubɛtórɔn, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n kwú anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū ā ú nū ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
idu_Latn: Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ō he um ɔtū, abālɔbányā aá yɔ̄ gē móowē olɔnɔ nɛ̄hi, nōo yɔ̄ gē jé ɔtōkpóce kú aá má. Óō híī hɛ́ aá idáagó ŋ́, aá kē gbɛlá ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā oyēyījii ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I said, I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka ń klla gáā má Óndú ā ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ oyēeyī lā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ nɛ. Ka n klla gáā yɔ̄ pi ācɛ oyēeyī, má uwā ipú ɛcɛ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
idu_Latn: N géē tū aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu hayi kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Aá géē kpó aɔ́dā ō bī jīījē ká aá cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá jīījē mla éeyē.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki da Áyísīki kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ, ohígbū ka a le fíyɛ́ alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú gwɛ́ɛya kú olétɔ̄há kóō yá oji nōó ce lɛ Óndú ā, ámāŋ kóō wɛ ɛya nōó je ŋmá ɔtū kú nū. É gáā je odúúdú lé ɛ̄cī nēé gwɛ́ɛya ā piíí ŋ́, āyā dóódu kú nū nōo hile gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, é lɔfú lé ɔŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū glá.

eng_Latn: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ɔkpá gbo. Aá lɛ okónu ce gā um ka eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá bī ga ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē je okwū kú um nyɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā, ká ā lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú nū, ó géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce aá, klla í je ajɛ ā lɛ aá. A kē í má ācobɔ̄bíipú ā abɔ̄ é géē nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ijē ā yɔlá ɛyí ede ā kóō wɛ ɔdōlé kú ɛya ō je lɛ Óndú ā. Ó wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɔdā ō gbā cīgbīhi.

eng_Latn: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nēé le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, é gáā lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́ māa, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ ɔbá ŋ́. Amáŋ é géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa je lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwá ā bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛ īyī uwā kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá dóódu nōo lā ipú ajɛ kú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é háyi abɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō ka íne nɛ̄ uwá mɛ́mla aádáádā uwā bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ábsālɔm ā yɛce ɔdā nōó da uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ é le Ámnɔn ŋmó á. Ayí kú Udéfīdi ohile ā le icō aɔ́nya kú uwá kpó tū anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ kwu á.

eng_Latn: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ōhī fu kéē lɛ ɛwá kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kpó ŋmá ɛga nēé kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú Ulákiss ā, ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá da Uhɛsɛkíya ka ɔ̄ɔ̄ cɔ̄nyā lɛ aá. Aícɔ́ɔja ā gaá mīyɛ ɔwɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī na īlī ā gē bá ɛgiyí ɔ́glɔ́ nēé na nōo ī bī éŋkpɔ̄ wā okpóo kú ɛhíícō ā.

eng_Latn: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Uféro má ka, akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ mɛ ā. Ó klla le íne bīya kpɔ́. Anú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū le ɔtū kú uwā yá lɔfú kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū kéē ma uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɔdā olɔhi ŋmá obɔ̄bí ā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ Urebɛ́ka kahíníī, Ɔyí uwɔ ɔ̄nyākwɔ́cɛ ā í cɛ̄ ɔyí uwɔ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā mafú ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē fu ā í ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ miya táajɛ ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é géē yēeyī, í lūgwū ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ klla í lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī ka ɔlífu ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpóocu kwūū bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī ka Usɛ́da kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ajɛ kú Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó le eyīnyinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū má.

eng_Latn: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n leyīce ā géē mɛ tāajɛ mɛ́mla um ɔlékwū nɛɛ? Ami mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n leyīce ā géē ga ajɛ tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa gbā bɛ̄ɛka á kú aflɛ́yí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n tá tū ákú aflɛ́yí nāa ca ā tá tū ɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋmá owú olɔɔlɔhi, owú odufā, owú ogalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔwā. A géē hijā tū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú háyi ɛga dóódu nɛɛ, ó gē kahíníī, Pīyɛyí Óndú, wā ɛgiyí ācɛ úlúúlā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ klla kwú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhɛ́burɔn ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú nū.

eng_Latn: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī ɛ́gɛ́nyā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ipú ɛcɛ amānyā nɛ̄ ó ŋmá á. Ó ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɛcɛ o bīya íne nɛ̄, ó klla ŋmá ɛgiyí aálelékwū obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ nēé māháyi iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū á. Anú nōo cīīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā géē yɔ̄ pī uwā klla í gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gɔbū kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kóocōō lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ a cokónu nū lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, Udéfīdi, ádā um ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄gɔ̄ olipú nēé bū tayínū ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Akésiya, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ācɛ ā. Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yá odúúdú uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ɛfú gbo ɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ufilístiya Ugɛ́sa. Eko nyā nɛ̄ Usíbēkayi nōo ŋmá Uhússa ā ŋmó ɔbáagwu éyi nēé hī ka Usípāyi á. É kē le ācɛ Ufilístiya yálé.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya, mla ɔyí nū Ubenhádādi bá gē yá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lé ɔgbɛ́fú eko éyi tá eko ɔhá piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó nū Ujékɔ̄pu ɛ̄cī ahāapa jāā gbéeko nēé le ɔ́ kwú ɛfu kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Usíya le ɔfú lɛ nɛ̄hi ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ, nōo wɛ ɔkwu kú ífi kú nū ā. Ó le Óndú, Ɔwɔicō iye tēelihɔ o ŋmá lɛ oō nyɔ̄ í yi ɔtulalī ɔlá abɔ̄yī nū, ɛyí ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, alɔ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ yéékpó ka alɔ gáā kwú ɛɛ́. Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ gbolóce iyī alɔ ŋ́, amáŋ ka alɔ gbolóce Ɔwɔicō nōo ī je ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nyā da uwá, é géē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ alɔ géē móōwē í jé ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nyā a. É géē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyá nēé yá lɛyíkwu Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū kú Uféro yá lɔfú kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī bī ā jé klla mā ɔ̄ tá ō yá ɛɛ́ mā, ó géē yēeyī gbóó, ó gáā kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn kwú kwu ŋmá ɛfú gáā tayínū ɛɛ́. É kwú gbogodo ipú ufi bɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyā ā. Aólɛlā ā kwu odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī kú uwā ú ca ɛɛ́. É klla kwú aɔ́lɛ́ uwā ú tū ɔlá.

eng_Latn: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī tɛtɛ má ɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ nū, í klla gáā má ɔ̄ɔ̄ igbɔhá gbóōgbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ká ā ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí. Le ka lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gáā je ōwē lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó le pó ŋmá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā, ka ɔ́ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti cɛ̄ ka Ujósɛ̄fu kóō kwú okwū ā ú mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya le ɔkpá tá fu odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda, mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ kéē wā Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā tū.

eng_Latn: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kwú iyē í ce abɔ́ɔ ka Ɔwɔicō géē je. Ó jāā kwu eko nēé yɔ̄ ī tá ɔkpá nyā ā, ācɛ gē hī abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo géē je.

eng_Latn: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔkpá ā wí, lɛ ɔ́ nwula, anɔ́ɔ n má ka ābɔ̄ ɛplɛɛpa kú nū, é lɛ ɛlā kú ikwū oōje, mɛ́mla ekwu ōyɔ̄ mɛ́mla íbáā tá tū ɔ̄ dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē bī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí anúɔ. Ó ka anúɔ géē yíihɔtū tú ūwā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú anúɔ. Ó ka anúɔ í klla gáā cɔ̄nū mla uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
idu_Latn: N nū aólɛlā kú um inya, jāā gaā lɛ uwá kpó kwú. N māháyi ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ, nōo wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi kú ucɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si háyi lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄ kóō wā ɛgiyí um gaá gwá éŋkpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka aá kóō lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bū ūlī ō tá. Ó kē da aá dúú, ka aá kóō kwú ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ɔmáapú alɔ Usɛlofɛ́hādi ā ú lɛ ayí nū nɔ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
idu_Latn: Ufi géē kwú ācɛ kú Asírīya nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ é í pó ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ uwá klla í mɔ́ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ōwē nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú nū lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é le kpó hídáagó anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ nɛ̄ ɔcí ufígi ā ŋmó bōōbū ā.

eng_Latn: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
idu_Latn: Uhásɔ, Uhádāta, Ukeríyɔ̄tu, Uhɛ́surɔn.

eng_Latn: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ a le pīyabɔ̄ klla le iyī uwɔ tú wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū um á. A le īlī kú uwɔ híla klla yɔ̄ ī jikwū, eko nāa le pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gaá yá ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm italā lɛ ā. N le ɔkɔ nāa gbā ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄ci blibli ɛ̄cī ɔhá, abɔ̄ é bá í yɛ ɔwɛ ā, é má abɔ̄ ɔcí ufígi ā le ŋmó ŋmá icō jāā kwu ɛgba.

eng_Latn: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn klla kahíníī, Ádā um, Udéfīdi le ojuju yá ka anúɔ í gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ɛga nēé géē gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ tá tā ajɛ, ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ó í yá jīla ā í yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ó í yá jīla ā géē wā fíyaa. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n mafú gā uwɔ nyā géē yá jīla. Ó géē yá uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ó yɔ̄ ī pi ɔkwu ajɛ ā. Amáŋ gbēyī eko nɛ̄ ó í yá ā. Ó géē yá jīla piíí, ó gáā ligbó ɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá jīla gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, útú nɛ̄hi le hɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja ā ohígbū ɔdā nōo lɔfú yá Upíta ā glá ā.

eng_Latn: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,
idu_Latn: Umɛssɛ́sābɛlu, Usádɔ̄ku, Ujádúya.

eng_Latn: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
idu_Latn: ka anúɔ géē hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ híīī yúúfi ŋ́, abɔ̄ alɔ í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ipí ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ɔ́dāŋ koó le má ka ipí ā lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā, nōó nyīla fíyɛ́ ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā klla géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄ ipú inu ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: É kwú ukɔ́tin ā ú playi okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ aá gekwú ɛ́ɛ́ ohígbū íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā mɛ́mla ohígbū ka aá wɛ aílɔ́wá nēé lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le yá kú aá yēeyī mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ó kwú odúúdú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ koó tá ō nya alɔ tá nááná, ɔcɛ́, le jé kpɔ́cíí ka alɔ í gáā gbā ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ a ma kwaajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa bī ɔkpacańgelī le ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki kpó wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD.
idu_Latn: ede kú ɔcí ā. Olicō kú nū wɛ umíta éyi ce āyā, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta éyi. É yá ɔ́kpa kú ɔ́kíkā kú nū ā, ɛháajɛ kú nū mɛ́mla áklō kú nū ŋmá ɔcí. Ɔ̄cɛ ā da um kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Itébulu nōo ī háyi ipéyī Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ Ákissi le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka, iní nɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í kpó ɛ̄nyā ŋmá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ó gē tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda amáŋ, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujérāmiili, ámāŋ, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ukéni lā ā.

eng_Latn: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācocījáalí ɛpa ā wɛ aɔ́cí kú olīifu ɛpa mɛ́mla aɔ́dā o le agege ce uwá ɛpa nēe hayi iyɔ̄bū Óndú kú ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu kahíníī, N le unu nɛ̄hi nu mla ɔyínɛ́ um, n kē le yálé ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hi iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
idu_Latn: A gē dɛ̄gba tū ɔ̄cɛ, klla gē yá ɔ́ italā ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ó gē bīya ā. A gē je ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā bīya tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛha nōo ī bīya ɔdā ā. Ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu áncā ā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā le ulé olɔhi cílá um, ohígbū ka n yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi klla le kpaakpa. Ó kē jé ka amiɔ̄ɔ́ í lɛ́pɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ a háyi abɔ́ɔ ā, Usólōmɔn le eyī pīya kwu uwá, lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔtū le he ācɛ, é gē yɛhɛ, amáŋ eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔtū le bīya lɛ uwá nɛɛ, eyī kú uwā kwú kwányíhí.

eng_Latn: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ása gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ kéē kpɛ́fú á. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa kwu ɔgba kéē kpɛ́fú ɔpɛ́ kú Uséfāta nōo kwu Umárēssa ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ɔdā nāa cokónu nū ā gā um. Óndú ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā yɔ̄ piyóó. Ā híī gwó ɛlá ācɛ nɛ̄ a bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu kwú hīla ā, ó kwu ayí nū ú pīya aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ í lɛwa nɛ̄hi ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi éyi gaá le ɔfú kpó kwu ɔ́. Ó le íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Émɔ̄si klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛyíkwu aá ā, lɛyíkwu odúúdú éwo nɛ̄ ó bī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé í hī Ujósɛ̄fu, ó ŋmá Arimatéya, igelī éyi kú Ujudíya. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ó yɔ̄ ī gbēyī eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í wā ī lé ɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔwɛ hɛ́ bū ipú ísu, lɛ uwá kpó bū ipú nū, ó yá kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā kóō háyi bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ ā abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔnyīlɔ kú Urám, ɔ́kplá kú Ujɛramīīl ā, wɛ Umáasu, Ujamín mɛ́mla Éka. Ujɛramīīlu lɛ ɔnyā ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Atára. Ó ma Ónam lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n má ka a lɔnɔ ɔtū íbí, ínoōbīya kē lɛ uwɔ gbō.

eng_Latn: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka iyē ékpónú, nōo lɛ āyā alɛwa ā. Ó kē wɛ iyē ékpónú kpɔ́ nááná nōó lɛ āyā ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā kú Águr, ɔyí kú Ujáke, nōo ŋmá umása. Ó kahíníī, N jé ka Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ mla um ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ mla um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē je Ujerúsālɛm wúlatāajɛ í gaá hile ɛcɔ̄ kú aɔ́lɛ́ kú nū nēe í tīkwū klá īyī uwā icííci ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɛga nɛ̄ aéwo ipácí gē lā. N géē yá kú aígēlī kú Ujúda ā kéē le kpó pīya ipú alácɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā ipú uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
idu_Latn: Ugádi klla lɛ ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan nōo kē yɛ ga Ubɛtháram, Ubɛtinímra, Usúkōtu mɛ́mla Usáfɔn, mɛ́mla o hile kú ajɛ kú ɔcɛ́ Uhíhon kú Uhɛ́ssibɔn ā. Ɛjī kú ajɛ kú uwā lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan jāā gaá kwu ɛhícō kú ókpoó kú Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī lé ɔdōlé ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwú igbō ú, ó lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, ó lɛ ɔ́ ce, anɔ́ɔ ó le je lɛ ayíkpó kú nū yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Aá mīyɛ kú aá lé. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú um á.

eng_Latn: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
idu_Latn: É lɛ um ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ɔdānyā kóō híī tayínū ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō ci um ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa hɛ́ ga um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ményinyi aá lɛ ā. Ó lagbénú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ohígbū aá ā, ó kwú gbɛhá. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le gbagbénú ŋmá ɛhá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú uwā nēe ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā, gā Ujerúsālɛm gaá le jīla ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā dóódu nēe pīyɛyí ā, je ɔdā kú ɛhi ŋmá ɔtū éékpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā túgwó igbɔhá ɛga nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ kwu ā.

eng_Latn: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
idu_Latn: Olíla gē cɔ̄nū tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ɛwa, amáŋ ojéeyī ā ī kwú iyī nū cíí.

eng_Latn: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔdā dóódu ō yá kú uwɔ, le pīya ocābɔ̄ kú ucē olɔhi ō yá, ɛlā ōnwū kú uwɔ kó ō wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Kwú ɔ̄ ka ó wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ipú yɔ̄ igbɔ́hɔ́ le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá ma, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā géē gbō ami mɛ́mla ɔbá um bɔ́há ká mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka n le ayí nɔ̄nyilɔ ɛtá ma lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā ga gáā lɛ ikpó nū ce. É ce ikpó nū gbóógbó, klla le ɔ́ iyē tēelihɔ gbóógbó gbéeko nɛ̄ uwá kwú ce ɔ̄ eyī.

eng_Latn: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nōo ī mafú ɔdā nōo ī yá eko nyā a. Odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā mafú ka ɛhi mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā í lɔfú yá ɔtū kú ācɛ o gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā kóō le jōjīla glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
idu_Latn: anú gáā gbɛnú fíyɛ́ ɔjɛ nēe bá okónu ísu nɛ̄hi á. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē kɛlā fáa ŋmó okónu ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ n lɔfú yá ká ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē kpópú aílɔ́wá ā glá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā hɛ́tá ohígbū úklɔ́ kú um.

eng_Latn: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛnyīlɔ kú Ɛ́nēm ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ akwuna nōo ī cīce ɔwɛ amānyā ā yɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Akwuna dóódu ī yɔ̄ amānyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ nēe ī lɔnɔɔtū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé je Ɔwɔicō ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā géē pɛ́ kwú. É géē je odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī tíne ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ācogbɛhá ipú aá eko dóódu, amáŋ ami ā í gáā yɔ̄ pi aá eko dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ Ugɔ́gu á. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā ā, a géē yɔ̄ ī gbo ojuju obɔ̄bí éyi.

eng_Latn: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ā ó kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ ga Unégēbu, klla yɛ gɔbū gicō ɛfu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.
