idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda lɛ okónu nēé ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā nyílá ɛɛ́. É klla lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ ā. É klla lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā nyílá. Ācɛ klla le anyā nēe ī gbā ɔwɔ kú aéwo ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ā kpó lɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gē wú um ɔtū, amáŋ íne kú uwɔ kē he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
idu_Latn: A gē yɛ bū ipú úgbagwú kú ísu klla ī hɛ́ ɛga olipú kú nu ā bēé. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ í má ikpó kú uwɔ bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je éyi kú omlede ā mɛ́mla anɔ̄ lígíí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya. Ó géē jíla anú iyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ ɛya nōo cɛgbá lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ódūdū kú ɔtulalī nōo yɔ̄ gē yɔɔlá ā le tíico mɛ́mla ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɔlɔ́ɔwɔicō gē gbā ā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe hayi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Īkpati ā ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ kú Abínādābu nōo kwu ɛyí ɛfu ā, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya okpíyó ɛ̄pɛ̄pɛ̄ á. Ússa mɛ́mla Ahíyo, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Abínādābu bā ī pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya ā nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ikpō kú ije ɔdɔ úlā cofigwó ɛhīlī gbā lɛ Arawúna kú ɛgowíīkpɔ̄dā kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Īlī dóódu ámāŋ ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ iyē nēé tá ā gaá kwu ɔ́, é géē na ɔ́ éŋkpɔ̄, ó kē í wɛ ɔdēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmá le ka lɛ aɔ́mpa uwɔ nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ mla awɔ ā ka, ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū uwā nyɔ̄ ipú ajɛ oligbó ā, klla pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ipú aájɛ aéwɔhá á. Nááná ɛplá ɛko nēé gaā bá abɔ́ɔ ā, n géē yɔ̄ mla uwá ipú ajɛ nēé nyɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
idu_Latn: Awɔ kē í bī alɔ hayi kpaakpa kli eko dóódu kú alɔ á. Óndú, a gē nya alɔ tá eko dóódu, klla í je ɔdōōjé mɛ́mla íjééyī lɛ alɔ. Agbénú kú alɔ nōo tīile fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ojīlīma ō le ce uwɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka nyā, Ɛdɔ kú íne ékpó nāa bī le kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē bī le kɛpɔ̄ tū uwɔ dúú á. Ɛpɔ̄ kú uwɔ kōō í lɔnɔ fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ī gbō aókóome ā le ɔdā nōo yá ā má, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ kwu ga ipú igelī mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ ā gaá lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó ca klɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
idu_Latn: Ā fu ɛjī kú ajɛ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwɔ tū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Usólōmɔn tíne kóō lɛ Ujérobōwam ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ Ujérōbōwam le kwu ga Íjīpiti, ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ Ussíssāki kú Íjīpiti á. Ó gaá klá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn gekwú.

eng_Latn: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le yɛ bū ajɛ kú Upisídīya ā, é gā ajɛ kú Upamfílīya.

eng_Latn: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
idu_Latn: É géē hayi ɛcɛɛcɛ ohígbū kéē gē yúúfi ōwē nōí yɔ̄ ī má ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛgba hɛ́ uwā okónu kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ɛ̄nyā bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi! Ubábīlɔn, awɔ nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā! Ipú eko kpiíí ōfōōfūnū, é le italā yá uwɔ.

eng_Latn: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n cɛ́gbá awɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īkpɛɛnū gē tíne éŋkpɔ̄ ō hīlaŋdɔ́ kú ɔkpá nōo yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ kú ɔyí ā, Umíriyam gaá hāyi ɛgoligbó lígíí ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔyí ā kóō má ɔdā nōo gaá yá ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tá ō pó ɛlā nēé gē nwū ā, īyī uwɔ nāa gē yágbe abɔ́ɔ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɛlā nēé nwū ā mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ nēé pi ɔ́ ā pó, ayíka o yɔ̄ ī jééyī tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu le pɛ́ gekwú eko nēé je ɔlá nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ ŋ́ mā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kwú igbeékpónú piíí, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā igbīhi ikwū ā.

eng_Latn: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um bī wā ɛga nōó ī yá ucɛ kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kē le ihɔtū kú nū mafú ga um bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ otúta kwu kē ma odée fú á.

eng_Latn: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ uwá ka ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, ikwū kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ī he um ɔtū ŋ́. Ó géē he um ɔtū cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō kwúcē ŋmá ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó ī bí ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō yēeyī. Ísrɛ̄lu, aá mā ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā tá. Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá tíne ō kwú āa?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ odúúdu ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā, gbaáluka kú ā lɛ iyē kú uwā tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī kú ɛya ō gwó ā, n géē yá aígabɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē kú aéwɔhá ā italā.

eng_Latn: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
idu_Latn: O nādaa kú acá kú aúcérōbim ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā kē wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó. Aúcérōbim ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa ā háyi ikpó abɔ̄yī uwā leyī pīya kwu ipú inu nɛ̄hi kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ádā nū gē hɛ́ ācɛ lé, ī wūwī ā, klla ī yá ācɛ dóódu ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ádā nū gekwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ádā ā abɔ̄yī nū bī ā.

eng_Latn: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kahíníī, Amānyā wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ á. Amānyā wɛ ede nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē bá ī gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ mɔ́ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, ācɛ ā wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nōó fu cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wɛ ákú nū. É wɛ ācɛ nōó kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú awulú ohéyīfuú mɛ́mla úwé okwajɛ, mɛ́mla uwé kpií, mɛ́mla ɛkpa o pla acá kú uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Ubálam le jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ dɔɔ̄kā ká anúɔ hɔ́hā ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla nyɔ̄ gaá tíne kóō má eyī kú Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē yá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó le eyī pīya kwu ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú aá lɔfú lɛ anyā ŋmá éwɔhá glá, nēe lɔfú yá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um gɛ ŋ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ í gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ̄ɛ̄cí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā ú kpó bá ɔlɛ́ uwā, Udamáskɔ̄si abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīya ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō télí lɛ ɔ́ á. Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kpɛ́fú ā, Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le yálé.

eng_Latn: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́lɛ́ kú Ugálīli dúúdú yɔ̄ gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ, yɔ̄ gē nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá iye kú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú. N géē tá Óndú ahínyá mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um, ipú ōjīla kú ācɛ okpaakpa kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɛdɔ ohi nyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tíne ká anúɔ tá ācɛ nēe wā gaá da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ iyó nɛ̄ ádā anúɔ gbōce uwá ā yá fékéé lɛ uwá ā?.

eng_Latn: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄ alɔ gē ka lɛyíkwu ɛ̄nyā, amáŋ ó lɔnɔ ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō ka ɔ́ yēŋēē ohígbū ka aá bū ahɔ̄ ga ipú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ nyá yɔ̄ ipú aɔ́wɔ ā, bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā, ipú ɛgahi mɛ́mla otīihɔ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ yúklɔ́ idáagó bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe hile ā ŋmá ipéeyī um, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú uwā ú kpó tū aólɛlā kú uwā abɔ̄, aólɛlā nēe géē yá uwā lé ɔgbɛ́fú klla í je uwá kpó pīya ɔdā úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwinya, le ɔkpá ā kpó ga ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā. Ɔ́da nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā wɛ ka, ɛ̄cī éyi, ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛtá kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda ā, kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu, kwu ācɛnyā, ācɛnyīlɔ, ayípōklóbīya, anyākwɔ́cɛ, mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ obene, kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā ményinyi ō kpó uwá ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ aá le uwá kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú agbénú kú uwā ú kpó.

eng_Latn: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄trā Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo yá nɛ̄ a yá aólɛlā kú uwɔ lé ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ébram kwú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú odúúdú agbénú nōó kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kpó lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
idu_Latn: Ó géē gwīiyē ɛga otīihɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú úwé kú nū ú wiyē. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ó le bɛ̄cɛ gaá lɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú gwó lɛ Óndú ā kóō lɛ íne nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
idu_Latn: É géē ca inu ā tāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɛcɔ̄ kú nū, aɔ́cí kú nū, ɔdā nēé le plla ɔdɔ kú inu ā í kpó bónū ɛga nēé gē kpó imu tū eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
idu_Latn: Áhābu mīyɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā, le aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú uwā kpó kwú klla le Usiríya yálé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō cɛ̄ɛ̄pɔ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ́bíipú ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē nyí ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ, Urécɛ̄lu. Eko nɛ̄ n ŋmá Umɛsopotámīya ā, ó gekwú ajɛ kú Ukénan, ɛga nōo kwu Ɛ́frāti ajaajɛ ā. Ɔtū le bīya gā um nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā nōo yá ā. N kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɔwɛ kú Ɛ́frāti abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
idu_Latn: É gē wā kwūūū gaá klá ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka owu okwɔ́lá nōo ī tá nɛ̄hi ɔnɔ̄ ā. A lɛ uya kú ācɛ éwɔhá ā kwú klá ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ojuja gē kwú idɔlá kú ɛnɔ klá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í gwíijē ka aá lɛ alɔ yálé glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú uwɔ lɛ ɔnyɛ tū um nɛ̄hi, anú lɛ ɔnyɛ tū um fíyɛ́ ɛnwú á.

eng_Latn: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ́ má, nɛ̄ ó le jé ka ɔ́ɔ doōcē gbojī ɛɛ́ mā ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī A tíne kéē lɛ uwɔ nyatá āā.

eng_Latn: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ɔdí nēé má ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É lɛ ɔdā dóódu kpó má ɛɛ́. Ó tū ɔdā dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ipú aɛ́ga okpíyó tū kú um nɛ̄ n mafú lɛ uwá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
idu_Latn: É ŋmó ācɛ Ufilístiya jāā ga ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛ́tāfen. Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́tá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
idu_Latn: Umíka, Uréhōbu, Uhassábīya.

eng_Latn: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū ɛ́dɔ obɔ̄bí ā mla odúúdú ācɛ aéwo kú ɛcɛ klla mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ uwá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí kéē je uwá kpó yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Udáni ā da ɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ ka ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka ɔ́ɔ tíne ō yá ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kéē cɔ̄nū cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔdéyi yá ɔ̄. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je lɛ Uhilkíya, Ahíkam ɔyí kú Ussafán, Ábudɔn ɔyí kú Umikáya, mɛ́mla Ussafán ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá mɛ́mla Asáya ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́, Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, ā le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ahāapa tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔcányā, Ufássiti kóō wā, amáŋ ó tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ā. Ɔdí nɛ̄ íne ā ka, kú ālɔ̄ yá ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛ́futa yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ nū Umíspa ā. Adá kú nū nōo wɛ ɔyí nū ékpónú ōfōōfūnū nōó ma ā, wā ɔwɛ yɔ̄ ī jīījē, yɔ̄ ī gwō ɔjá mɛ́mla íyōyō í jīla ádā nū ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú tíicɛ, kú aá yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je ayókwū lɛ aá, kéē le pīya aɔ́fiyɛ ká aá. Aá kē lɔfú je aóklóbīya aá fíyɛ́ dúú lá, ká aá le gbo agbénú.

eng_Latn: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka odúúdú iyē kē wɛ īkpēyī éyi nɛɛ, ɔwɛ nyá nōó ī páhɔ̄ ā? Ɔ́dāŋ nōó kē wɛ ahɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū, ɔwɛ nyá nōó í hípī odée glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
idu_Latn: Lɛ íkōtō kú īlī odufā ofɛpa ce igwó tá kéē bá okónōgwu kú ígwu kú ɛgɔ́ kú ukɔ́tin éyi, íkōtō ofɛpa ce igwó o hile ā í bá ígwu kú ɛgɔ́ ukɔ́tin ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki lā ajɛ kú Ugɛ́ra á.

eng_Latn: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā ɛ́ɛ kē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kē ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā nēe gbā Úbáalu kú Upéyɔ ɛ̄gbā lɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
idu_Latn: Kpáyi! Ɔwɔ kóō yā klá aɛ́fu kú Ugílibōwa ŋ́, ébú kóō kōō híī cē klá uwá ŋ́. Aájɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú abɔ́ɔ kóō híī yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé ī je ɛhi lɛ Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú kú ɔ̄cɛ o lɔfú táajɛ le blínyī, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē yɔ̄ ō nya ɔkplɛ́fú kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kéē lɛ ɛwa kpó wā í tū uwá ufi klla hɛ́ uwā éjulúgwu.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
idu_Latn: Uféro kwú eliká nōo ī bī le bá ɔkpá ā ú plla ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú wu Ujósɛ̄fu abɔ̄, klla kwú awulú ahilíki ú wu ɔ́ iyē, kwú agbá kú oje ɔdɔ ú tū ɔ̄ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugádi nyɔ̄ í le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā da Udéfīdi, kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyá nɛ̄ a géē je ŋmá anú ā?.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu agōdō kú nū géē na īlī kú nū klla í gwíiyē, ó kē í je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔhā yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú uwā le yēŋēē nōo ī lā oyēeyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
idu_Latn: A klla le ɔlá ofíyajɛ klá iyē bɛ̄ɛka īlī ā. A lɛ ɔkpáncō nándaa bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī nā ipoto daa klá ɛyí inu ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Unébo ā wɛ, Ujéyēlu, Ujówɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ubenáya.

eng_Latn: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé, obɔ̄bí gē nyīla. Amáŋ ācɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa géē yēeyī jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ōgwōnū kú ɔcɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā má.

eng_Latn: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ufɛ́līsi, abɔ̄ ó kē jé ɛlā kú ɔwɛ ā lɔhi ā, ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā pi tá kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Ulisíyāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā gā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē hɛ́pɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má abɔ̄yī uwā, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Udáni kwú ojibó ā ú kpó kwu ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á. Ujonátan, ɔyí kú Ugássɔm, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umósīsi ā wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni á. Ayí nū gē yúklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā jāā gbéeko nēé je uwá kpó ga ajɛ kú ewɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē tū aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tá um. É bá ī tútū ō wā í nuunu tú um ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ̄cɛ nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔcɛ́ ā ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kā ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ igbo ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ n gáā wā í má aá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ka ā, Ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɛlā dóódu gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ijáalí kú ācɛ ɛpa amáŋ ka ācɛ nēe fíyɛ́ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́mān mɛ́mla Ujɛ́dūtun nēé fu kéē bá í gwíijē cɛ̄tra Óndú ohígbū ihɔtū kú nū nōo yɔ̄ piyóó ā, bá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
idu_Latn: Óndú gē pó ɔkɔ kú otábɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gbā ā, ó kē mīyɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
idu_Latn: Usíbīyɔn lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa: Áya mɛ́mla Ána. Ána nyā pīyɛ njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ō kwɔ́lá eko nōó yɔ̄ ī gbō aíjakī kú ádā nū, ipú ígbílí ā á.

eng_Latn: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, bī ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā le yúklɔ́. Ā kē híī mlanyī ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā, n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi ce ɛyí ɔnya nɔ̄wá éyi. Ó gaá māháyi ipú aɔ́cí nēé hī ka umɛ́tulu ā, ɔpɛ́ kú ɛfu éyi, aɔ́nya ɔhá nēe wɛ, ɔnɔ̄wá, ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ bá igbīhi ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Umakéda mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú nū ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Ó kē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kpó ŋmó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í hile ŋ́. Ɛdɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā, nɛ̄ ó yá ɔcɛ́ kú Umakɛ́da dúú á.

eng_Latn: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: É gáā cɛgbá ō ce ɛfú ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē hɛ́ ɔcí ŋmá ipú ūpū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aíyɛ́fú nēe kwu hɛ̄ uwā tá ā géē bá cabácabá lɛ uwá ō le gwɔ́ɔ́lá. É géē wu aíyó kú ācɛ nēe kpó aíyó kú uwā ā. É klla í kpó aíyó kú ācɛ nēe kpó aíyó kú uwā ā. Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
idu_Latn: Aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ bá ī nuunu ŋmá ɔkpáncō, abɔ̄ é bá ī wu ŋmá ābɔ̄ éyi ga ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú ɔkpáncō ā, é le unu nu tá Usisɛ́ra.

eng_Latn: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
idu_Latn: Oje udɔ ā nɛ̄ó bī le yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú eyīpú mɛ́mla okómpinu kú eyīpú ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdōpiɔ́ŋgbá kwajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā nē é le híígá tū Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, nɛ̄ ó lɔhi lɛ uwá fíyɛ́ alɔ nēe yēeyī ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe bá nyā, Ujéssuwa, Ukádimíyēlu, Ubáni, Uhássibinēya mɛ́mla Upétahīya kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā trɛ̄yí nēé gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā á. É da ācɛ ā kahíníi, Aá cāŋjɛ kú aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tá ɔ̄ ahínyá. Aá cɛ̄tra anú kú aá wóófu iyē kú nū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ. Odúúdú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra iyē otīīhɔ kú nū nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ í kōo má okónu ō bī le cɛ̄tra anú gaajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
idu_Latn: Uhása Ugáada, Uhɛ́simɔn, Ubɛ́tipéleti.

eng_Latn: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā, ohígbū ka ó lɛlá wu aógbɛhá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó wɛ uwī nōo gē bī alítā kú ije kú ayíkpó ā nɛ̄ n. Ó kē ī le abɔ̄ wu ɔ́ ī je ije ŋmá anú ojigógó.

eng_Latn: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́ssibɔn, mɛ́mla Ujása mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujówābu igwó ɔhá wā í lɛ Ábsālɔm tū ŋmó tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ oŋmɛ́yí kú uwā le bá ā, é géē bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi, nōo í yá kéē lɛ italā yá uwā. É géē wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ nēé pó ahɔ̄ ŋ́. É géē lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú, í bɔ̄bíipú klla í wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ō plla ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi wɛ aípɔ́ɔnū kú, Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukɔ́hāti mɛ́mla Umerári.

eng_Latn: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le úbɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í ce ɛyí nū glá éyi ma mla oje udɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Īkpō kú úbɔ́ ā wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā, ɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā, anɔ́ɔ olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛnɛ ce āyā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá kwú okwúukwu ú kwajɛ ɛyí nū ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ lɔfú má ɔ̄ glá, anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ̄ naŋ́daa kwu ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya gekwú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nú Umanásɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ wɛ itene nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ ŋmá ipú odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ōwē nɔ́ɔ gē má ipú ɛcɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ odóódu kú ɔdēelihɔ nēe bá nyā yá, í gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ le uwá le alɔ kpó hɛ́ ɔkɔ bɛ̄ɛka álá ā. A lɛ alɔ pahīla tū ipú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli, anɔ́ɔ é wā gáā le áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛ́fú kú uwá kwu pī igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugíbɛ̄ya á.

eng_Latn: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ɔ̄nyɛ géē bī um wā ɔlɛ́ nēé ce igá tū ɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē bī um tá ga Ɛ́dɔm ā?.

eng_Latn: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ācɛ gbaáluka kwɛyí ā, ɔtū kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí, anɔ́ɔ ó da Óndú ā kahíníī, N le ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi bī ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá nyā ā. Kócōō kwú yá um ɛhi. Ucē kú olíla nɛ̄ n yá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú agbénú kú iyó ɔ́sú kú uwɔ ā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú uwɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ ī pɛ́ uwɔ ā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔcí kú uwɔ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔ́sú kú uwɔ, mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ipú uwɔ ā, odúúdú uwá kwú kpó yíífi, eko nɛ̄ awɔ nōo wɛ úgbéenyi nyā gbayibó ipú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cīije bá ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Aá kē híī ŋmó ācɛ ipú áncā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɛpɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī kwú ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ámāŋ ko cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yéeyī piyóó glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíhu gbēyī uwā kéē le ɛlā ka kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ kóō kɛlā lɛ Ujóbu ohígbū ka uwá wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
idu_Latn: N jikwū gbōmgbōm, klla dɛ̄gba kú otábɔ̄, amáŋ Óndú ā tá kóō pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā a.

eng_Latn: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā le uwá kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā kpó na ŋmá um iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um iyē gwu yēŋēē ŋmá ipú odúúdú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā.

eng_Latn: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le pɛ́ i yɛ gaá le ābɔ̄ kú aɔ́cí kpó, anɔ́ɔ é gaá le áklɔ̄kpɛ kpó cēce icō ɛyí inu kú uwā, ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ uwā, mɛ́mla ódúúdɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú uwā mɛ́mla okónu Ɔwɛ kú Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, kwú ínoōbīya kú um ā ú yá um ɛhi, kú ā kwúcē wā mla um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
idu_Latn: É ka aá gwó ede ā ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ aá gwó ɔ̄ kú aá bī ɔ̄ lɛ gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ámāŋ ka o bī ɔ̄ je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā lɛ Óndú ā ɛyí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumbling-block before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka igbɔhá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa kwúcē ŋmá okpaakpa ōyá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. N géē kpla ukpa lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ á pi ɔ́ ahɔ̄ ŋ́, ó géē kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú nū. N gáā blakwu Odúúdú okpaakpa mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa kú nū ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N kē í je oyī kú nū ce uwɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nú nyɔ̄ í le ɛfú kpó tá uwá acígilí okónu éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umérɔma.

eng_Latn: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?
idu_Latn: Náaná ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá nyā kōō wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ īpéeyī uwɔ kpɔ́, woó, Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō. A klla lɛ okónu ce lɛyíkwu ayááyí kú um kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicó ī yá ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ɛyí nū glá ŋ, ó klla ī yá ɔdā idáagó alɛwa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í ka áluka nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Ujɛ́hūdi lɛ āyā ɛtá, ámāŋ ɛnɛ kú ɔkpá ā jé mɛɛ ā, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú ɔkpá āyā ɔ́ɔmā ú hɛ́ ɛ̄wā, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó tá ga ipú ɔlá. Ó hɛ́ ɔkpá nyā tū ɔlá kléklé jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔkpá nyā kwú yɔɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, N géē gwɔ̄ɔ́ci kú ācɛ kú Ujúda nēé kpó ŋmó ā. Ācɛ nēe lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ācɛ o ŋmó icííci ā, ń gáā mā uwā tá nyɔ̄ icíící glá ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā je Ujerúsālɛm pīya ɛga nɛ̄ n géē lā piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda kwú ɔyí kú Amásīya Usíya nōo wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī ā ú cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa kú ucɛ ā, aá géē je ɛdrɔ́ kú aɔ́bá ɛna igwɛ́ɛpa, omlede ɛpa, omlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, igwɛ́ɛnɛ kpó gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa, aá géē lé igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā. Ɛ̄cī ɔmahāapa ā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le Otínīyɛlu tɛ̄hɔ̄ gāá lɛ uwá hɛ́tá á. Otínīyɛlu nyā wɛ ɔyí kú Ukɛ́nāsi nōo wɛ ɔyínɛ́ kú Ukálɛ̄bu ā.

eng_Latn: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwáahānɛ ā wɛ Upétahíya, ɔ́mofu ā wɛ Ujɛhɛ́sikɛlu.

eng_Latn: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú aá kpó tūlé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ gbō bá ɛ́nyɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le yá lɛ ā á. Udéfīdi kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū ú, bá ɛ́nyɔ́ dúú. Ó lɛ ācɛ ulá kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó mā ofu igwó ta bá ɔlɛ́ kéē leyīkwu iyó kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó géē fu aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kóō gbo uwɔ ɛga dúúmā nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n lɛ ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛhɔ̄. N tíne kóō nyɔ̄ í lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nōó lɛ, kéē híīī wā ɛga kú ɛ́kɛma nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, ācɛ Íssmɛ̄lu ā kwú Ujósɛ̄fu ú ga Íjīpiti. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú lá lɛ Upɔ́tīfa nōo wɛ igabɔ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, nōo klla wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāajɛ kú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ká ɛlá ōgbo kú um ā kóō kē he Óndú ɔtū, ohígbū ka ɔtū nɛhɛ́ mɛ́mla éeyē kú um ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ ā gē tū alɔ ufi, ánya kú uwɔ ā ī kpó alɔ yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
idu_Latn: Le da uwá kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ héyīfuú fíyɛ́ ācɛ aéwɔhá dóódu á nɛɛ? Aá géē ga ɔlékwū, nyɔ̄ ī gwutá abɔ́ɔ pi ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya cɛ̄tra ācɛ Ulífāyi ā nɛ̄hi ohígbū ijē éeyē kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nēé bī ācɛ tá lɛ ipú ijē ō gwó mɛ́mla ɔkɔ ōgbā lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lé ɔdōlé kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa á. Ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā, é bá ī gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ klla bá ī tá Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aádā uwā ahínyá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɛbéenyi ā ká ɔ̄ lɛ Ujóna gba tɛ́ɛcɛ okónu ísu. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ gba tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Éhūdu abɔ̄yī nū, kwú pīyeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛcɔ̄ nēé gbā kwaajɛ Ugílgalu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí Églɔn á, gaá lɛ Ágábáidu tá ɔ̄ á. Ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ōtayínū éyi nɛ̄ anúɔ gaá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Églɔn da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kéē lɛ pɛ́ gɛcɛ. Odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ gɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē fula ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā. N klla í hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā, nēe lɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa le gbɛlā, é gē wā ɛgiyí um, cɛ́ɛ́ n gē da uwá ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā kú nū le kpaakpa ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ n klla gē da uwá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ɔkpá ce ɔnyā, anɔ́ɔ ó géē hɛ́ ɔhɛ̄nɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka á gbo ajā tá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ā le iyē kú uwɔ tēelihɔ eko nāa yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔbá uwɔ ā ŋ́, a géē lé ɛpɔ̄hi kú okónu ō tá nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ nyā géē bī wā ā.

eng_Latn: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ce ŋmá ajɛ, aá híī cē aɛ́nɛ̄ o kwu okónōgwu ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Aá kē gáā kwúcē igbīhi gaá tɔ́ɔpla ce aɛ́nɛ̄ ohile ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ kwú um, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú um ga ɛyí ɛfu olicō nɛ̄hi éyi á. Ó lɛ Ujerúsālɛm, Igelī kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā mafú ga um abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwɔ le gwō ka, aá géē nū alɔ inya, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ alɔ kwú lɛ agbénú kú alɔ kpó kɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɔdā nōo he aá ɔtū ā yá alɔ. É ka aá géē pi ɔkpacaŋgelī kú aá ŋmá apɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
idu_Latn: Umússi ma ayí ɛtá: Umáhli, Éda mɛ́mla Ujɛ́rɛ̄mɔtu.

eng_Latn: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n da ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ka ó géē kwú piíí. Ó géē kwú ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ á kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ká ā pi ɔ ahɔ́, ka ó pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ ká ɔ́bíipú kú nū, ká ō nyā oyēeyī kú nū tá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā gekwú lɛ ā ipú ɔ́bíipú kú nū, n géē je oyī kú nū ce uwɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussɛfatíya wɛ ofu igwáahātá ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
idu_Latn: Uhádīdi, Usebáyim, Unebálāti.

eng_Latn: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
idu_Latn: Wā í lé ɔdōlé kú um, ká ā klla gwá ejé kú um nɛ̄ n kpó aɔ́dā alɛwa o le ejé lɔnyɛ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ ohile kú ācɛ Ugílɛ̄di ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú Ubássan, ɛga nɛ̄ Ógu wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ágōbu ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ. .

eng_Latn: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ka é bá ī ka klla bá ī cɛ̄nwū lé lɛ anúɔ. É ka aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, le jɛ̄ aá ɛ̄jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Óndú ā ka, é gē bī aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kpó uwī ámāŋ aɛ́nɛ̄ o gē doōcē mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄, wɛ o cīikpó ā, wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ anúɔ. Ó ka ka ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē mīyɛ ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋmá ɛgiyí ūwā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ aá bá ī móōwē mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí eko dóódu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lé ɔdōlé. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mlá aá yɔ̄ ī nwū aá ɛlā. Aá géē má ɔ̄ɔ̄. Aá klla gáā bá ī tíne nū ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
idu_Latn: A gā ajɛ ɛgiyí uwā ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɛyí ɛfu kú Usayínāyi ā. A kɛlá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ abɔ́ɔ. A klla je íne ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ uwá. A klla nwū uwā ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
idu_Latn: Ifīlmɛ́rɔ̄daki gbonɛnɛ lɛ ɔ́ kllla lɛ āhɔ̄ kú ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi je lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá nēe bá aɔ́fiyɛ Ubábīlɔn pī ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ géē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā. É kē í lā ajɛ ā, ó kē í wɛ ákú uwá piyóó. Ohigbū ka ami yá uwá, klla kē bū uwá tū ipú ajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē bu ɔcí tū ajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ma ɛgahi kú um fú á.

eng_Latn: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
idu_Latn: N kwú odúúdú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bī gé um ā ú gā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce gā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí uwɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ ń gáā nyíla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā da um kahíníī, Ujeremíya, abɔ̄ ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ka ka ɛlā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔ wɛ áncā ā, n géē je ɛlā kú okónu kú uwɔ yá kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. N klla í je ācɛ ā yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ā. Ɔlá kē í je uwá yi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ í da ɔcɛ́ ā ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anú ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ gáā wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí agōdō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē kwú ɛyí agōdō ɔ́ɔmā piíí. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū ā pó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ajɛ ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā í bá ɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā í tíne ō je Ujúda yíífi ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ó lɛ okónu ce lɛ Udéfīdi ka ayí nū ɔ́ɔ géē lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācogwɛ́ɛya kéē pó ɛlā nyā. Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē jāhɔ̄, ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, aá jāhɔ̄. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ūwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa nēé tá ajɛ Umísīpa, é klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́yá nēé tá klá ɛyí ɛfu kú Utábɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ohígbū ucē nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā yá ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ka anúɔ gbo Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā cíkā ō gekwú.

eng_Latn: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́ nōo kwu ojibó kú Umólɛ̄ki ɛyí ā í fu ŋmá ɔ́ ɛyí Ogbɛnú kú ɔfulā ā wɛ ukílōgram ofuciigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔlá nɛ̄hi éyi yɔ̄ anú dúú. Udéfīdi kwú ɛcɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ɔfulā kú nū á. Ó klla kpó iyó mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hi ŋmá igelī ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú nū géē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um piyóó. Ohígbū kēé cɛ̄ ká ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ó klla cɛ̄ gā um kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu, bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyēlu, ɔ̄cɛ Umáhāfa Ujɛ́ribāyi, mɛ́mla Ujossafíya, ayí kú Ɛlnáām, mɛ́mla Ítúma ɔ̄cɛ Umówābu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm ɔyí kú Udéfīdi ā lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā éyi nōó lɛ ɔbá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Iyē kú nū lé ka Utáma. Utáma ā jɔ̄nnyā klla héyīfuú nɛ̄hi. Ɔyí ádā kú Utáma éyi kē yɔ̄. Iyē kú nū lé ka Ámnɔn. Utáma kē kwú he Ámnɔn ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ bla ka, ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā hɛ́ uwá tá icííci á. Ó ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je íne ā lɛ uwá yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí ī tū unu mɛ́mla ɛfú ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ā? É ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔdā abahi nɛ̄ aá gē tine ā nōo yɔ̄ gē nuunu ipú aá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē kú alelékwū nyā nōó bī nyɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔ́na kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ aálelékwū kú ācɛ nēe bá ɔlékwū ā á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ Utáma í mɔyí ā le yá ā, ó le áplɛ́ ma.

eng_Latn: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
idu_Latn: Olɛlā ká alɔ ā, bá yɔ̄ ī kwāajɛ gbēyī alɔ, alɔ í kōō yāwu ipú ɔlɛ́ ā glá gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ̄cī kú alɔ mɛɛ́, ikwū gā ɛɛ́, oŋmɛ́yí kú alɔ ga ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ okónu nōó ce lɛ aádáádā alɔ ā tū, anɔ́ɔ ó wā gaá lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe ī cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā tábɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō ményinyi odúúdú aá, ayínɛ́. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
idu_Latn: É gáā yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā uwā, nēé lɔtūcē Ɔwɔicō lɔfú ŋ́, nēé klla yɛce ɔ́ kpaakpa ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā gbaáluka gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla inu kú aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá gē bī wā ī le gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā le cúmeyī ɛɛ́. Ɔtulalī nɛ̄ aá gē fú tū ɔlá ā gē hɔ́yí tū um ɛnwū. Ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ákú usábāti, mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ aá gē jīla tɔ̄há ká aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā ɔ́ɔmā le cúmeyī dúú ɛɛ́. Ń háyi má ɔ́bíipú kú aá ɔ́ɔmā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
idu_Latn: Lɛ iyi uwɔ tugɛcɛ ŋmá áafú nɛ̄ ólila mɛ́mla aógwuda gē tá āa. A jé ka áafú ā gē ŋmɛyí tá ikpɛ́ɛla.

eng_Latn: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ í tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá piíí! Ohígbū ka otɛtɛ ā aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ kú ínoōbīya, amáŋ abālɔbányā aá bī ɔtū kú aá kwú ɛyí ú táajɛ lɛ ɔdā nēé nwū aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ le lɛ ā, Ágábáidú ɔcɛ́ ā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ohile kú nū kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mīyɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄yīnū. Ohígbū ka anúɔ í tíne ka ācɛ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ ka ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ mīyɛ igelī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
idu_Latn: É gē je ācɛ Asírīya kpó ŋmó klla í kpó uwā yíifi ɔgbɛ́fú, amáŋ ó wɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ gáā ŋmó uwā ā ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Asírīya géē kwinya ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú, é kllá í je ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó pīya aɔ́fiyɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye looked for much, and lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīce ka aá í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nwuné nɛ̄hi, amáŋ, ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá má cē mɛ́ɛ̄ ā le lígíí ā. Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ɔmā bī wā ɔlɛ́ ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ owu mu ɔɔ́ bónū. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n yá lɛ ā? Ohígbū ka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um le catāajɛ, nááná nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá yɔ̄ ī yɛ tāajɛ kóō lɛ ɔlɛ́ nū túgwó ā.

eng_Latn: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
idu_Latn: É ka iŋini tá Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ó géē yɛ í lɔhi lɛ alɔ fíyɛ́ kú alɔ le pɛ́ gekwú ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ikɔkɔ ō wá í pɛ́ kwú ipú ígbíli amānyā.

eng_Latn: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā, ācɛnyā kú Usamérīya. Aá nēe jɔ̄kwū bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́na kú Ubássan ā. Aá nēe gē yá ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mā ɔdōbɔ̄bí, klla ī lɛ abɔ̄ da aógbɛhá ɛyí tāajɛ ā. Aá nēe gē da aɔ́bá aá kéē bī ejé wā kú aá gwá.

eng_Latn: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á, leyī mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ kú uwɔ nwūla kwu ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ī gbā gā awɔ ā. Ká ā pó ɔkɔ nēé í gbā eko dúú nēé lɛ ikwū je klá awɔ ká ā tá aá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í yíihɔtū tá Ɔwɔicō ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔtū kú alɔ, ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlá nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbō ā, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú alɔ. Ɔ́mpa kú alɔ í he alɔ ɔtū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ he iyī alɔ ɔtū ā. Ó cɛgbá nɛ̄hi kú ālɔ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne ɛpa nēe bá nyā fíyɛ́ ō bī aɛ́bɛ́ wā í le gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
idu_Latn: Alɔ pó abɔ̄ ó ka, N géē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ bī abɔ̄ gwó ā ca tāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ í bī abɔ̄ kú nū gwó ŋ́ mā, gwó ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
idu_Latn: Eko ōhī, ami, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá géē pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce aá, o ŋmá lɛ o je īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú gwɛ́ɛya kú igwu mɛ́mla ejé gā um.

eng_Latn: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka eyī kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ yá ká ā yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí, lɛ ɔ́ wú, ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Ohígbū koó géē lɔhi gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ká āyā éyi kú iyē kú uwɔ kóō le bīya, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ odúúdú iyē kú uwɔ géē ga ipú ɔlá kú ɔlíkɔtɔ.

eng_Latn: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā ayí uwā bá ī yá um okónu. N klla kwú pīya ɔdā ō yá ɛbɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka onyílá kú ɔ̄cɛnyā dúúmā le pɛ́ ɛ̄cī alɛwa gla eko kú ōnyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā kú nū ā, ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka oyī ā yɔ̄ gē pɛ́ gɔbū kpɔ́ fíyɛ́ eko ōnyílá ɔlamu kú nū, ó géē tēelihɔ kpɔ́, ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ oyī ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ gɔbū ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ eko kú ōnyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā kú nū á.

eng_Latn: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ekōhī, odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bī íjééyī mla ohílīpú kú nū yá ipú ɛcɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ géē mā ɔ̄ tá lɛ aólúgwū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé yúklɔ́ nū ŋ́ mā, kéē jɔ́ɔnyɛ nū. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā mla ɔdā obɔ̄bī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ukéni ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ébɛ̄l, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ Ukéni da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ń jé ŋ́. Ami cíkā ō leyīkwu ɔyínɛ́ um á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī yɔ́bɔ́nyā aá lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyílɔ jéjéé ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ n je kwelúbi le Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, kóō wɛ ɔbá ékpó kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le aálá ā kɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aɛ́wū ā. Eko nēé gáā ce iyī ūwā, ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le eyī pīya kwu ɛga nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ nēe tína cílɛ́cílɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e híkākā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí kú ɔlɛ́ Ulában bá ā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó yá nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū je nyīla nɛ̄hi á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá kpó bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyí hɛ̄ ákú Ulában tá á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Umósīsi bī abɔ̄ kú nū kwiicō, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē yálé, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó kwu abɔ̄ ú wāajɛ, ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki gbɔɔ́ ō yálé.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá mīyɛ ɛlā kú alɔ ŋ́, alɔ géē je ɔyínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, Ujúda le ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú Ukénan éyi nɛ̄ iye kú ádā nū lé ka Ussúwa má. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
idu_Latn: Óndú gē nya ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā tá. Ó klla ī gbō uwā eko kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é pó ɔkɔ ŋmá ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú um nōo he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi á, ɛlā kú uwɔ he um ɔtu.

eng_Latn: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá uwā italā ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu kú Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ jé glá ā, tá péée lɛ uwā, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō tá péee lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ īkpō nēé nyi ipú ujē āa, kwɛyí ācɛ nōo pó ɛlā ā, amáŋ unwalu kú ɛcɛ nyā mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ agbénú kú ɛcɛ nyā ī plá ɔ̄cɛ lɛ āa, lɛ ɛlā ā nyaŋmó, ó gwá īkpō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yɛ ā, ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nē eyī kú nū le pu ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyēlu klla kpó ācɛ ofɛnɛ wā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɛ́brɔn.

eng_Latn: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ ílī kú uwá híla kéē ma ɔtūnōbí kú uwā fú.

eng_Latn: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú iyē nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū nōó gē je lɛ īkpō ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó gē je ɔkpíyē nōo cíkā lɛ īkpō dóódu ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
idu_Latn: Īī, n tɛtɛ le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ā jé ɛɛ́ nɛ. Amáŋ, ɔlɛɛcɛ í kɛpɔ̄ klla lé ɛpɔ̄hi ka anúɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalmúna da Ugídīyɔn koó wā í lɛ aá kpó ŋmó abɔ̄yī nū. É da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́ɔ gē yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn le uwá kpó ŋmó, le ɔká nēé tū aínyankwūlūmī kú uwá ɔkɔ ā kpó plla á.

eng_Latn: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, eko nɛ̄ aálelékwu-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ī kpó īyī uwá wā í jīla iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ebilíi tá ipú uwá, wā iyɔ̄bú Ɔwɔicō dúú á.

eng_Latn: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē da iyī uwā kahíníī, Alɔ gē bī ɛlā kú okónu kú alɔ gē le lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo he alɔ ɔtū. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē yɔ̄ nōo ī da alɔ ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ī blakwu ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ Ufínéhasi yá nyā, é kéē ī blakwu ɔ̄ ŋmá eko tá eko, ŋmá aɛ́gɔ́ éyi ga aɛ́gɔ́ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá bā ī tómbli ɛyí aɛ́fu ā, ikpó kú uwā gē yúuya nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka úgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú ā. Uya kú uwā gē wā wūūū bɛ̄ɛka uya kú ɔlá kú ipú ūpū nɛ̄hi nōo ī je ácí ō hɛ́ kwaajɛ dóódu kpó yi ā. É le hɔ́ɔ́gba bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi nēe gáā kpɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó ca ikpɛ́cí kú ācɛ o pā ɛcí ā tāajɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ ā bá gē pā ɛcí klla gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí. É klla bá gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛcí kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔnyā ā ohi ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ aɔ́já nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ uwā ŋ́ mā ā ba ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́mpa nū lɛwa lɛwa.

eng_Latn: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
idu_Latn: Ó le utébulu gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya. Olikpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛtá, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó éyi ce āyā anɔ́ɔ olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Aá lɛ okónu kú aá nwūla gbādāa, kú n̄ je ɔdōlé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ŋmá Usámūwɛ̄lu jāā gaá kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ o wā igbīhāajɛ ā, kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nēé yá ipú ɛ̄cī nēe bá nyā.

eng_Latn: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
idu_Latn: Aá wā amānyā ka aá gaá ka ɔdā nōo géē yá ɛcɔ̄bū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ le jé eko nōó gáā yá ā. Aá lɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ yá íkée ā ka lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ kē lɛ eyī yɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nēé le bákánjɔ̄ ɛyí acɔ̄lá ā, ámāŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é yá ipú ɔdōŋmó odée ɔlá, ámāŋ ipú ákánjɔ̄ dóódu ā géē wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, nōo gwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um í yɔ̄ mla ŋ́ nááná ā, alelékwū kú um yɔ̄ mla aá yɔ̄ gē gwéeyē klla yɔ̄ gē má abɔ̄ aá le flá tɔ̄há ká nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í fō aá ŋmá ɔhá glá ŋ́ ipú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ipú ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu, okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nōo leyī pīya kwu Ujérīko ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē je alɛɛcɛ, aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nɛ̄ n yá ā kpó yíífi bónū ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ. Ohígbū koó kwú um iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n yá uwā ā dɛ̄ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā cāŋjɛ tɔ̄há, tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá nōo yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, í gáā kwúcē ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ámāŋ ka inu ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́ga kú ɔkpáncō nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, aá cɛ̄tra anú. Aísu nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ɔkpáncō, aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
idu_Latn: Ígwu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe lā Ujérīko ā gaá da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, A jé ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ gáā je ɔkpáni uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ícɛ ɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tū uwá ohi kahíníī, N jé gbóó, Aá bá cíí mɛ́ɛnɛ, ālɔ̄ kɛlā ga abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nyā ka kwɛyí ā ó le hɛ́ tá iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ā lɛyíkwu Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā géē háyi ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī ka ólīfu nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē je ɛfu kú ólīfu ā kɔ̄ ɛpa ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɔpɛ́ nɛ̄hi géē tá ɔtāhɛ̄ nū. Āyā éyi kú ɛfu ā géē kwu kiili ga ɛhíícō, āyā ɔhá géē kwu kiili ga ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
idu_Latn: Lɛ otúta je gicō kú ɛfú kóō gbɔɔ́. Lɛ opo tá kú éwo dóódu kéē pó. Lɛ aéwo ā tútū kéē kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. Da aɔ́cɛ́ kú Árārati, mɛ́mla Umíni, mɛ́mla Áskɛ́nāsi kéē wā í kpɛ́fú ā dúú. Lɛ otrɛ̄yí éyi fu kóō wɛ ogbēnjūwā kú ɛfú ā. Lɛ aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kpó wā lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka efūma ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ka ācɛ nēé fu kéē gbō aílɔ́wá ā gē gbō uwā abɔ̄fú, aótrɛ̄yí ā, lɛ ācɛ ā kwú tābɔ̄ gē gbō uwā abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
idu_Latn: N tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ gā awɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ odúúdú ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔdā nēé nwū uwɔ ā jé.

eng_Latn: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayí kú Umósīsi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā í wɛ ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ŋ́, amáŋ é wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛlā nēé ka ka, Lɛ ɔcɛ́ je lɛ alɔ kóō gbo alɔ. nyā wú Usámūwɛ̄lu ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
idu_Latn: Anyā ɛpa géē bá ī gbā ɔdā ɛgɔ̄, é géē je éyi, é kē í habɔ̄ ɔhá tá.

eng_Latn: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú aá gē gɔ̄ ohígbū ka aá gbɛlá ka ń gáā wā í jila aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā kahíníī, Ó lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí, ó klla ī jɛɛ́lɛ́. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔkpɛtá mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí le tū ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ ohɛ́ɛnɔ ámāŋ ka efūma gaá kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ú kpó bīya. Amáŋ ka aólɛlā kú uwá lɛ ɛfú kpó tū uwā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kpó bīya, ámāŋ ka ōcē obɔ̄bí yɔ̄, ipú ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ācɛ nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Ipú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, ó kpó ācɛ úlā ahāapa ce ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce ācɛ ɛtá .

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkɔ ō gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō mla okónu ō gwū ōfōōfūnū lɔfú nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá á.

eng_Latn: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
idu_Latn: Ó gē je aógbɛhá cāŋjɛ ŋmá úmúlá klla ī je ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā ŋmá ɛyétutulu.

eng_Latn: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka n lɛ iyi um, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í wɛ ɔkpani um ŋ́. Amáŋ n je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ka ɔkpani um, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú um lɛ ācɛ bī gé lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔmpa ā, le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, Á yúúfi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ? É ŋmó uwɔ ɛdɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ékpó mla anú.

eng_Latn: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ódúúdú ugóolu nēé kpó lɛ Óndú kéē bī le yúklɔ́ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōo ŋmá ɛcɛ yɛ ga ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú je ɔ̄ tēelihɔ kóō híī lɔfú gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā glá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ ā gē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō je teelihɔ kóō lɔfú gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, íne dóódu nēé le tū ipú iyē kú ɔcɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ klla kwú abɔ̄ ú bá ɔ̄ ɛɛ́, é gáā je íne ɔ́ɔmā pīyabɔ̄ gbóógbóō glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ a lɔfú bī iyē kú um, mɛ́mla eliká kú um le tɔ́kpá fu ācɛ Ujíyu ā glá. Ɔdā dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā nāa géē tá á.

eng_Latn: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm le tá ɛgiyí ádā nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ bá ī wá aálá kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔnwū. Ó ka anú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛ́ɛ́ wā í lé ucɛ mɛ́mla anúɔ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ɔwɛ ā kwɛyí ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā ā, amáŋ ebilíi le yá, kéē kwú mlanyi ɛlā nēé pó ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híīī mīyɛ ɛlā ā cɛ̄ dɛ̄ɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kōō ī nya uwá tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ā géē kpó aɛ́na mɛ́mla aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā lé, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpɛtā í ŋmó uwā ga ɔlékwū. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gáā mā ɔdōlé kú uwá dúúmā tá lɛ uwá ŋ́. Ó klla ka ɛmiyɛ ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmó uwā ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
idu_Latn: Aá híī gwó aɔ́dīfa nɛ̄hi klá iyē o yá ká aá héyīfuú tū ācɛ ŋ́. Aá híī bī aɔ́dā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ō gbɛ̄yi, agbá ogbɔɔ́la nɛ̄hi o kpó tū iyē mɛ́mla īlī ogbɔɔ́la nɛ̄hi o tū ohí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si mɛ́mla aúkánsulu le ahɔ̄ bá ahɔ̄ āa, ó tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ ā ka anúɔ i yá apíili ga ɛgiyí Usísa á, ɛgiyí Usísa nāa géē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kwú ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ú, kéē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú iyí nū.

eng_Latn: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɛláyíja géē wā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyi gbɔbū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu tútū. Nááná ɔdíya nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka ka Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē móōwē nɛ̄hi, ācɛ kē í tá ɛlā nū ā?.

eng_Latn: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
idu_Latn: N le īyī um pi kpaa lɛ oje ɔdɔ úlúúlā, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ úlúlúúlā, mɛ́mla oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū í lɛ ō ka ŋ́ kpó tū ga awɔ ká ā géē le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. N lɛ aígbɔ́ɔcí mɛ́mla aɛ́cɔ̄ kpó bá ajɛ dúú ɛɛ́, amáŋ a géē tíne kwu uwá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
idu_Latn: Aá, dúú, géē cījáalí kú um, ohígbū ka aá bá mla um ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ɔtū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ ámāŋ lɔfú je abɔ̄ kú aá gicō gla eko nɛ̄ n le yá kweyí mla aá glla āa? Ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́, n ke i yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
idu_Latn: Eko nōó má ka, Ujósɛ̄fu le úwé kú nū plla wu ɔ́ abɔ̄ klla le kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu ā.

eng_Latn: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi tá tū ipú ɔkpá lɛyíkwu o kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō nōo ŋmá lɛ o lɛ íne ā tū kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, ɛlā nāa ka wɛɛcɛ mɛ́mla okónu nāa ce ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa nāa jē tá ajɛ lɛ iyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
idu_Latn: É kwú ajɛ ohile kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ nēe hile ā. É wɛ, Abíyɛ̄sa, Uhɛ́lɛ̄ki, Ásrīyɛlu, Usɛ́kɛm, Uhɛ́fa, mɛ́mla Usémīda. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayínɔ̄nyílɔ kú Umanásɛ, ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu á. É wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
idu_Latn: Ijakí kú ipácí gē klá cííí, eko nōó yɔ̄ ī lé ácí. Ɛna kē ī yɔ̄ cííí eko nōó gē lé ácí.

eng_Latn: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ í ga Uhɛ́brɔn ā, ó lɛ ācɛ ofu igwó plla kɛ́ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ mla anú. É kē le yɛ mla anú icííci, amáŋ é kē jé ɔdā dúúmā nōó yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú ɔhá Ugáti. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ agwu éyi nōo lɛ aíkābɔ̄ ɛhīlī mɛ́mla ayíkīkpó ɛhīlī ā yɔ̄ á. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔbáagwu kú íkée ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā. É bī aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ mā, le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
idu_Latn: Urabisáke, igabɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó le pó ka ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔɔ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ulákissi le yɛ gaá yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú tá Ulíbina. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá abɔ́ɔ gaá miya ɛlā mla anú.

eng_Latn: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, aá kwinya ŋmá ipú Ujerúsālɛm nyɔ̄ í tayínū! Aá lɛ opo tá Utekówa, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɔlá gwó Ubét Uhácērem kóō cābɔ̄ ka ámíyā nɛ̄hi ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō gáā wā í kpó aá yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā bá gē yá ā, é lɛ ācɛ odoōcē kpóbá ɛyí agōdō mɛ́mla ákplata lɛ uwá kpó gaá bá ɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká eko nɛ̄ Upíta gaá yɛ ā, ká ofu kú nū kóō ce aóhī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔbíipú í gbō ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ɛyí ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā oyēeyī okpaakpa ā, géē kwaajɛ kli bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo lɛ ɛgba tá ga ipíípú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í jíla anú iyē glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ufínɛ̄hasi, ɔyí kú Ɛlísa, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔ́ má ā. Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ójila gaá kwú óbō ú.

eng_Latn: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi he odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda ɔtū, ohígbū koó gē kpó uwā trɛ̄yí ga ɔgbɛ́fú gē yálé.
