eng_Latn: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
idu_Latn: géē da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ī kwu tayínū á, awɔ gē gbō um ɛyí á. Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce á.

eng_Latn: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N cɛ̄, n géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā n cokónu lɛ uwá ka n géē kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n géē je lɛ uwá ā. Ajɛ nōo lɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mla ɔdāajɛ oōbī fíyɛ́ odúúdú ajɛ ɔhá ā, nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
idu_Latn: Okwū kú Ujésēbɛ̄lu í tá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka emī ɛna ā, ipú ajɛ kú Ujésiríilu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú ɔlɛ́ ā í gaá kahíníī, Má okwū kú Ujésēbɛlu yɔ̄ á glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
idu_Latn: A yɔ̄ ī tá ɔ́sú nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ́sú ā kē ga ɔbū gā uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ a gbɔɔ́ ō lɔnɔɔtū, anɔ́ɔ a lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī á. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwɔ ú nū abɔ̄ɔfú ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú um ā, anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo gē gbō uwɔ ā kwú uwɔ ú nū ŋmá ipú aɛ́cɔ̄ nēe ī fíyaajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā, a gebí ipú ísu ɛɛ́, A gebí i tá ɔkɛkɛlɛ kú ísu ɛɛ́. Odúúdú iyó kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ē ge yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ ā, gebí ipú ísu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu tá Usɔ́lu ohi kahíníī, Ń gáā kwúcē igbīhi mla awɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ a tá ɛlā kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́ mā, Óndú ā kē tá ka awɔ ɔ́ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū klá Óndú ā kahíníī, Kóocōō, Óndú, pó ɔkɔ oōgba kú um, káā lɛ ɔ́ nyatá.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
idu_Latn: Kócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gbā gā uwɔ ā pó ŋmá ɔkpáncō ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Awɔ ōfōofū uwɔ jé ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē gbo ipú ɔtú kú nū á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
idu_Latn: Ó kē ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um je gbenyi, nɛ̄ é klla í bá ī gwōnū. N géē bī ɛ̄wā nōo lulé, ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā, klla ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā géē le tū igelī kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ufi.

eng_Latn: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n leyī yi ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, ɔyā mɛ́mla inyílɔ́ɔuwɔ nāa kpó kwu ɔkpáncō ā mla odúúdú úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā cíí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī alɛwa le gla ā, ipú iháyí ɛtá kú ɔwɔ ohɛ́ɛnɔ ā, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ īyī uwɔ mafú lɛ Áhābu cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɔwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é kwú ɛbɛ́ ā ú uwī, ɔ̄cɛ ā géē gbā ulé nū lɛ óndú nū.

eng_Latn: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ɛlā nōo ŋmá okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he odo kú nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdōlé gē cɛ̄ lɛ ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ gē nū ā.

eng_Latn: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
idu_Latn: N lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá, ācɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō mla um, abɔ̄ aá wɛ ugbɔga mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá nēé gáā lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā gbojī ŋ́ mā ā, aá le kwu ŋmá únwū kú ɔkpíyē nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka aólɛlā nēe bá gē nuunu tá odo kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́hāti, ɔyí ɔ́mpa kú Ulífāyi ā ma ayí ɛnɛ: Ámram, Ishar, Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Ussíyɛ̄lu. Ukɔ́hāti wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī ce igwɛ́ɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú á.

eng_Latn: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
idu_Latn: N géē wā í kɛlā mla uwɔ abɔ́ɔ. N géē je alelékwū ōhī nɛ̄ n je gā uwɔ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē bá ī bī iyó ákanya kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā mla uwɔ, nɛ̄ á gáā bī iyó ā ōfōōfū uwɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē jāhɔ̄ ā, igēlī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō, ká ā pó ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi nēé ka lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unówa ɛtá ā wɛ aádáádā kú odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
idu_Latn: Olɔdu jééyī tū īyī nū, amáŋ ogbɛhá nōo jɔdā klla tōhílīpú ā kē í je ɔkwu nū tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usefaníya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé lɛ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nááná gē gbolóce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé gē cē ā.

eng_Latn: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛɛhɔ̄ mla ɛhɔ̄ nēé bī tá ɔna, eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ Áhās kwú a a.

eng_Latn: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki yēeyī iháyí ofahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō táahɛ klá anú eyī, tū ɔ̄ akwū á. Ācɛ ōhī fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ahɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu da Ubídika, ɔ̄cɛ o tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Kwú okwū kú nū ú tá ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Unábɔtu. Blakwu eko nɛ̄ ami mla awɔ gē ce ɔnya tá ádā nū, Áhābu ɔkwu ā, Óndú ā kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu Áhābu ka.

eng_Latn: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ ayí Ulífāyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerári gbaáluka, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla inu kú aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni kwú ijē kú ɛna mɛ́mla omlede ā, ijē kú útūgbé ā, ijē nōo klá iyíipú ā, íkplí, mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā ú.

eng_Latn: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhána da ɔ́ ka, kú anúɔ má eyī olɔhi kú nū eko dóódu mɛ́ɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le ɔdōlé lé. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla cɔ̄nū gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ géē má ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōo gē yá ācɛ o le kpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo í yá ācɛ o cɛ̄ anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé gē cɛ̄ anúɔ ɛhɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gāājɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nū odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá gē lá ɔlá mɛ́mla ācɛ okpó ɔlá lá ā bɛ̄cɛ á. Ó lɛ itéblu kú ācɛ ofla ije abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí oyājɛ kú ācɛ o je ɔklɛ́bɛ́tɛ lá ā kpó pīyeyī kláajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si gē pi alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā ahɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi kéē ka lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe bī ɔ́bíipú dóódu gē le pīya aógbɛhá tū cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ agbénú.

eng_Latn: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
idu_Latn: N géē lɔfú kɛlā alɛwa ga uwɔ nēe ī tá uwɔ ɔtū lé. Ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ga uwɔ ā gē gbo uwɔ ɔtū nɛɛ, klla ī tá uwɔ ɔtú kwu ɔtú.

eng_Latn: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔkwu olɛhɔ̄ ā bū kú aá le jé ɔ́dāŋ nōó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá bī ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā le yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le okónu ce mla ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú, klla lɛ íne tū lɛ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ɛpa nēe ī wú Óndú ā ɔtū ā bá yɔ̄ á, ɔdā ō miya odée kú újí, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō miya kú újí.

eng_Latn: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
idu_Latn: Ó gwō, klla kokónu lɛ uwā nɛ̄hi. Ó gwō kú agbénú, áluka ayí nōó ma, āhɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú nū, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ojīlīmā klla fāajɛ fíyɛ́ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ ohile kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ āa.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwo ga iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó, nēe lɔfú yúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ glá ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ ɛ̄cī ɛpa, ɔyā éyi, iháyí éyi, ó kōō fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ojuja ā klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, é géē lā abɔ́ɔ, amáŋ eko dóódu nɛ̄ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄, é géē cālɛ́.

eng_Latn: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā géē bá ī jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ácí ā, ācɛ nēe kē ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā kē lɔfú bá ī má olɔhi mɛ́mla oō jɛ̄ gɔbū. Nááná é géē kpó uwā yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
idu_Latn: Udílēyan, Umísīfa, Ujókitíli.

eng_Latn: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā kplá ɔ̄cɛ, ka ɛ́ɛ híī ga inu ɔlɛ́ nū nyɔ̄ gaá kpó īlī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā kpó ce uwá abɔ̄ kwɛyí ɛ́kplá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
idu_Latn: ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. Aá hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa, kú aá klla yá ucē okpaakpa. Aá hɛ́ ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē yá uwā ŋmó ā. Aá yá ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe wɛ aúgbɔga ɔlɛ́ aá ámāŋ ayí okwū, ámāŋ anyōkwū ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Aá kē híī ŋmó ācɛ nēé yá ɔdā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā amānyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
idu_Latn: A le jī ɛɛ́, awɔ nōo gē kpó ācɛ ɔhá yíífi, nēé je awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ yíífi ɛɛ́ ŋ́ mā. A le jī ɛɛ́, awɔ nōo gē yíbīyajɛ tū ācɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá í yíbīyajɛ tū uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Eko kú uwɔ géē wā, eko nɛ̄ a mā ō kpó ācɛ yíífi klla yá ācɛ ibīyajɛ, é géē je uwɔ yíífi klla í yá uwɔ ibīyajɛ.

eng_Latn: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a kahíníī, Amānyā géē wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n géē lā piyóó á, amānyā nɛ̄ n gáā ce ɔcɛ́ á, ohígbū ka ó he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɛ̄ gāa, anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū ā le tá okónu kú ókpoó ā.

eng_Latn: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kwú igbīhi í cē kwu Ɔwɔicō, é le nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo jɔ̄ɔ̄nyā fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛnyā ā, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo he uwɔ ɔtū nyā wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ ohile ā tá ā? Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a ge da alɔ ka alɔ yá ɔdā nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
idu_Latn: É le ile dúúmā ŋ́, é kē wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ cíkā ō leyī gwū uwā bónū. É géē je kpó yíífi, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē kɛpɔ̄ tú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ó le yɛ tá Asírīya gaá le Unínīfɛ mɛ́mla Uréhōbot Íri mɛ́mla Ukála.

eng_Latn: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aa géē lɛ ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ mā tū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je ɔ́da lɛ aá ā. Aá lé igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ mā ɛ̄cī ahāapa ipú ɔyā kú Abíbu, ohígbū ka ipú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ mla aá. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, aá kē í wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ucɛ yá klɛ́ɛcɛ, lɛ ācogbɛhá, ācodɔgwu ajɛ, aócīkpó mɛ́mla aópeyī hīgwú.

eng_Latn: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ayááyí kú ɔlɛ́ aá géē pīyɛyí wá í tú igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá gwó fíyaa fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je ɔ́ catāajɛ ā. Ācɛ nēe kē je ɔ́ catāajɛ klla je ɔ́ yíífi ā géē kwúcē igbīhi ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébāti nōo kwinya kú Usólōmɔn gā Íjīpiti ā lɛ pó ā, ó kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
idu_Latn: Usekaríya da ācɛ kahíníī, Aá ba Óndú ā ɛ̄ba kú ɔwɔ kóō yá eko ɔgwā ā. Anú gē yá nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ī tū klla ī yā wā ajɛ á. Anú gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē yá lɔhi á.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohígbū ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi ā, ń gáā yá ɛ̄nyā eko nɛ̄ a yēeyī ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē yá eko nɛ̄ ɔyí uwɔ wā í cɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le uwá gbaáluka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ a nyatá ā, géē kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm bá ī gwíjē kú éeyē tá ɔwɔɔwɛ. É kē í bá ī gwéeyē piyóó. Ɔtū géē he uwá, ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ikwū ō je í kē gáā yɔ̄ lɛ uwá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
idu_Latn: Nááná nēé má ɔdā dúúmā nōó yá, nēé géē bī lɛ kɛpɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā, é da Upáyílēti kóō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
idu_Latn: Ká ajɛ kú uwā kóō gwá aíkpɔ̄cí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛnɔ ī je uwá pīya ā, mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú eko kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ gē hī uwā ka ācɛ Urefém bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Ánāki ā dúú. Amáŋ ka ācɛ Umówābu ɔ́ɔ gē hī uwā ka Émim.

eng_Latn: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ í hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē glá ā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ucē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí glá ā ŋ́ ámāŋ kōō lɔfú cɔ̄ɔ̄wɔ kú ɔdā nēé ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu éyi lā Usúsa nēé hī iyē nū ka, Umɔ́dɛkāyi, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́ɛ. Ó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn mɛ́mla ɔkwu kú Ukísi mɛ́mla Ussiméyi.

eng_Latn: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
idu_Latn: O je ɛlá obɔ̄bí tayínu igbīhi ɛlā olɔnyɛ ō ka bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé ma plá iyē kú ɛtɛ́ ɔmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbāajɛ ŋmá ɛfu kú Uhɛ́mɔn mɛ́mla Uséleka, mɛ́mla odúúdú Ubássan nōo tū ɛjī kwu ācɛ Ugɛ́ssɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ Umaáka mɛ́mla ohɛ́pa kú Ugílɛ̄di gaá kwu ɛjī kú Usíhɔn ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sibɔn.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka ɔdā nēé miya ɔ́ɔmā í gáā yá gbógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ikwu nyá nāa bī le yá ɔdā nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tēelihɔ ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ agwú ā yɔ̄ ɔkpíyē kú nū ā. Ó kē í lā eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ lā ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā alɔ, aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú alɔ ā, í lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū ŋ́. Alɔ í jahɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́da kú uwɔ ŋ́. Alɔ í kē le ɛlá wu ahɔ̄ nāa gē pi alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú da um ā á. N kwú iyó kú um ú gwó ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ̄ bɛɛka ɔcɛ nōo ī ga ajɛ ɔfiyɛ ā. Ɔ̄nɔ̄nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā n bī abɔ̄ kú um lɛ ɔdɔ ā hɛ́bū kwú iyó kú um ú kpó bū ɔ́ ga ɛcɛ klla kwú uwá u kpó ce acá ipéyī uwá.

eng_Latn: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
idu_Latn: Elé, n le jī ɛɛ́! N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄, nɛ̄ ó má īkpō ɔcí dúúmā kwu ɔcí kóō lé ŋ́ mā. É kwú īkpō ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla īkpō ufígi nōo lɔnyɛ ā ú kpó wū ŋmá ɔcí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Óndú ipú unwalu kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú ákanya kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni bī ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí le tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛ ācɛ ā, ó klla kɛlā lɛ uwá kéē le ɔwɛ kú uwā pīyabɔ̄ ga ɔwɛ olɔhi.

eng_Latn: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́kplá kú Obɛ́dɛ́dɔm, Ussémāya ā ma ayí ɛhīlī nēe wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄hi ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá, ohígbū ɛhi kú ɔdōjé nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá uwā. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, aɛ́pa kú igbīhāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá Ussílo ā, nɛ̄ n géē yá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú abɔ̄yī um nyā nɛ̄ aá kpɔ́tūce piíí nyā á. Ajɛ nyā nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā aá mɛ́mla aá, n géē yá ɔ̄ɔ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá Ussílo ā.

eng_Latn: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga Ussílo nyɔ̄ í kwú ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú bī wā ā. Ikpati ā, kwɛyí akpa kú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ɔfú mla ojīlīmā kú Óndú ā á. Ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi ɛpa ā, Uhófīni mɛ́mla Ufínɛ̄hasi bī ɔ̄ wā á.

eng_Latn: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ Ábsālɔm nōo wɛ ɔ́kplá ā í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā, Adónīja nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhágiti ā, kwú pīya ɔ́kplá kú Udéfīdi nōo í lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Udéfīdi mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ɛ̄cī éyi, ó gaá le úgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācɛ o ce ɔnya mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo ī gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí ofɛpa cigwó plla lɛ īyī nū.

eng_Latn: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā gaá le jīla ipɔ́lɛ́ kú ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem. Ábīja le tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usemaréyim, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ujérobōwam hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ jāhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē wɔ́tū nū, nōo gaá lɛ ɔbá lɛ. Ɔyí ɔlɛ́ nɔ̄nyā nōo mīyɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nū ɔbá.

eng_Latn: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni gbaáluka ŋmá lɛ o tábɔ̄ kú aótrɛ̄yí igwɛ́ɛpa kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā á.

eng_Latn: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄na nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nā otú, kwú mlanyī nū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Óndú eko dúúmā nāa cāŋjɛ abɔ̄yī uwɔ, é gebí tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aólɛlā kú um nēé dɔɔ̄kā ká n̄ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ŋ́ mā, á lɛ uwá bī wā amānyā abālɔbányā ká aá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó iyɔ̄bū um.

eng_Latn: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Óndú ā, aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ kpaakpa eko dóódu. Aá lɛyítáajɛ le íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yá ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
idu_Latn: ohígbū nāa géē kllɔcɛ́ ucē kú nū, nɛ̄ á gáā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā ú ŋmá okónu kú um. Ā cɛ̄ gā um lɛ ije nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ámāŋ ka o kwɛ́há nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋ́. Je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdōlé nōo géē jɛ̄ um ā gā um.

eng_Latn: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
idu_Latn: le jɛ̄ klla le héepū, nēe kwú ŋmɔ́ɔ́lá klla gekwú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
idu_Latn: É géē kwúcē ŋmá oōjāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛyi kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēé ge nwū āa, cɛ́ɛ́ é gbɔɔ́ ō jāahɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā icííci.

eng_Latn: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
idu_Latn: Ɔtōce yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ébrahām gáā je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū Áyísīki gwɛ́ɛya eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɔ̄ ojámá ā á. Ébrahām wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ ɔ́ á, nááná ó le tútū kóō je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú nū gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
idu_Latn: nēe wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó ga iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó nēe géē ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā gaá yúklɔ́ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jéeyī, kóō gbɛlá tū ɛlā nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ eyī yɛ ihɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ī mafú eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū um icííci ā, lɛ ɛwa fíyɛ́ īnyīlɛyí kú um á. Aólɛlā kú um gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bá um. É lɔfú, é klla tíne ō je um ŋmó. É mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ń je uwī ŋ́ mā ŋmá ɛgiyí um, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ācɛ nēe tú wāajɛ ā gicō, amáŋ ó géē tú ācobɔ̄bíipú wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá le odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nēe ca aá ɛgbá kpɛ́mm kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ā kpó wu ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
idu_Latn: Ígalu, ɔyí kú Unátan nōo ŋmá Usóba ā. Ubáni nōo ŋmá Ugádi ā.

eng_Latn: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
idu_Latn: Ó le ogbló kú ɔcí ō le bī Utébulu ā gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, anɔ́ɔ ó le ugóolu ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ubɛrótaa mɛ́mla Usibréyim nēe bá ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Udamáskúsi mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Uhamáti. Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā ga igelī nēé hī ka Utíkɔn nōo kwu ɛjī kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Uháwuran ā.

eng_Latn: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
idu_Latn: Ákú uwɔ mɛ ɛɛ́. É lɛ uwɔ catāajɛ ɛ́dɔ obɔ̄bí ā. Odúúdú ācotɔ́hí kú ɛcɛ ā bá ī yúufi ā, lɛ okónu nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ohígbū ɔdā nɔ́ɔ yá uwɔ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla kahíníī, Óndú ā géē kpó aá ga ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan, nōó cokónu ō je lɛ aádáádā aá. Eko nōó kwú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
idu_Latn: Ohi nōó tá nyā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī lɛ ācɛ nēe bɛyíkwu ɔ̄ ā kwú. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā ō hídáagó nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá ā á.

eng_Latn: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
idu_Latn: Urákalu, mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujérāmiilu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukéni.

eng_Latn: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī bítāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ojiji kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā. N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfūma nēé gwō bónū ŋmá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔyí kú ɔnyɛ nāa wɛ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ wɛ ɔyí kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Ujése, ɔ̄cɛ Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ gáā gwó inu ā lɛ anúɔ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔyí nū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē ma lɛ ɔ́ ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā gwó inu ā lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā í dɔɔ̄kā ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ŋ́, ó wā ɛga nɛ̄ ɔlá ī fíyajɛ glá ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ācɛ géē má ɔdā nōó gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda da Utáma, ɔnyā ɔyí nū kahíníī, Kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā wɛ ɔnyōkwū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔyí um, Usséla le jɛ̄. Ohígbū ka Ujúda yɔ̄ ī yúúfi, ohígbū nɛ̄ Usséla géē kwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ nū kwú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Utáma kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā otú éyi ā, n le ɔ̄na nōo tūufi nɛ̄hi nā. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ó kē cɛ̄ ufi tū um iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
idu_Latn: Ífi iháyí ofucɛtá, ŋmá eko kú iháyí igwɛ́ɛtá nɛ̄ Ujosíya, ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄ri lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, jāā gāá kwu ícɛ, Ɔwɔicō ā húmáyī kɛlā gā um, n kē húmáyī ka ɔdā nōó gā um ā lɛ aá eko dóódu. Amáŋ aá jāhɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nōo jéeyī ā gē gwó ɔlɛ́, amáŋ ɔnyā nōo wɛ olíla ā gē ca ɔlɛ́ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ɔcí kú usɛ́da ā, mɛ́mla ígbáanɔ nōo yēeyī ā, mɛ́mla owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú uháyísɔ̄pu ā wu ipú oyī kú ígbáanɔ nēé ŋmó ipú aklɛ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ yɔ̄ anú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá inu ā igbahāapa.

eng_Latn: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔtū lɛ kú ālɔ̄ nuunu bɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyīlɔ ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ, mɛ́mla aígelī kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ. Ká Óndú ā kóō le ɔdā nōó tíne ā yá.

eng_Latn: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kwú Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́fiyɛ nēé ma ɔlɛ́ nū ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ ó lá mla ije ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Ébrahām ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá apī hɛ́ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛfu yɛ Ujerúsālɛm jīla tá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɛ ācɛ kú nū jīla tá eko dóódu ŋmá abālɔbányā ga eko nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ úlā ofɛɛhīlī ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o yéyījii géē yá ɔkpáncō, ɔdōcābɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ipú ɛnɔ, ɔyā, mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ. Ufi kú ekwukwu mɛ́mla uya nɛ̄hi kú úgbagwú kú ísu géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū wogodo lɛ ācɛ kú aéwo kú ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udáyírɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́da je kéē gbɔɔ́ ō jila ɔkpá ɔ̄kā kú íkée kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn nēé tá tāajɛ klla kpó tū ɛga éyi ā.

eng_Latn: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ɛyí ɛlā nēé ka ā jé, amáŋ é kē jé lɛ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ɔwɔ lɛ anú mɛ́mla uwá.

eng_Latn: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
idu_Latn: Ijē nyā í he Usɔ́lu ɔtū ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le cɔ̄nū yɔ̄ ī ka kée gwííjē ka Udéfīdi ŋmó úluulā ɛga igwó, amáŋ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ ŋmó ācɛ úlúula ōfōōfūnū. Ó klla ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ klla hile fíyɛ́ o kwú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú anúɔ ú lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
idu_Latn: ami abɔ̄yī um géē héyīkwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēé pīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla anú, kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um gɛ ŋ́, nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā umɔ́lɛ̄ki ɛ̄gbā ā. É í gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
idu_Latn: Ácí ujē mɛ́mla ácí kú okónu ɔkpá ā gē gbo obobowū klá ɛga otayínū kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ń pó ucē nēé ka ā ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī ka ucē ā wɛ éwɔhá tū um, n kē wɛ éwɔhá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú aá nōo yɔ̄ okónu ísu ā géē je pīya ipácí, mɛ́mla áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ācogbāálá mɛ́mla ɛga o kpó aálá kú uwā tū.

eng_Latn: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
idu_Latn: O ka tū ɔ̄ ipú ā, Ɔwɔico le ɔkpá gbo, amáŋ ó kē gbo ɔkpá eko nɛ̄ ó fu ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔhá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Adónīkam wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛtá ce ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā géē le kpaakpa ɔ́dāŋ ka gē yíhɔtū ta iyī aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yíhɔtū tá alɔ lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā oyēeyī kú nū wɛ ɛhi okpóocu mɛ́mla ɛya nēé gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō kwɛyí alɔ nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō tíne eko olɔhi nōó géē yá ibīyājɛ tū Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
idu_Latn: ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā a, ɔcɛ́ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujɛ́si ɔ́ɔmā gēe ma ɔdā oocēabɔ̄ fu la odúúdú éwo kú ɛcɛ. Ācɛ gēe ŋmá ɛga dóódu wā í tíne nū, ɛga oolā ipɔ́lɛ́ a kéē jē ojīlīma mla oocɛ̄tla la ɔɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́daŋ́ ka abɔ bī ɔwɛ okpaakpa lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ abɔ ā, ɔtū kú abɔ ɔ́ɔ géē he ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā géē mɛ ā, gáā kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá cē iyī aá bī kú aá klla leyī kwɛcɛ cíí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɔfú gbɔ̄ɔkɔ glá.

eng_Latn: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogbɛhá í gē he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔtū ŋ́, ó kōō he oladógbe kú nū ɔtū ŋ́ dúú. Amáŋ, ācɛ olagbénú lɛ aóklóbīya alɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Ujóna ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ka lɛ alɔ, ɛgí ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ɔdobɔ̄bí nyā ŋmá wā í klá alɔ ā? Úklɔ̄ nyá nāa gē yá ā. Iní nāa ŋmá ā, a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma nyá.

eng_Latn: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n jé ojuju nɛ̄ n lɛ lɛyíkwu aá ā. N lɛ ojuju ō yá kóō lɔhi lɛ aá. Ó wɛ ojuju ō yá aá obɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ojuju ō je eyīyōce kú ekɔ̄bū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ka anúɔ wɛ ɔmáapu ɔbá nū ajaajɛ, nōo klla cíkā ō je ɔ́ ɔnyōkwū. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo wɛ ɔmáapu ɔbá nū ajaajɛ fíyɛ́ anúɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú uwā í gē ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́; é tōō lɔtūce ŋ́, é lɔnɔ ɔtū, é ī ményinyi ācɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da Umáyíka kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa pllā um lɛ ā, nāa cɛ̄ lɛ olɛlā kú um je kwu ā? Anɔ́ɔ Umáyíka tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ó gaá nyɔ̄ ā, ó ka anúɔ géē ŋmó um ɔ́dāŋ ka ń cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛɛcɛ í yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó le yēŋēē ā glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē le kpaakpa ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá nēe lā gboce ipɔ́ɔma nyā ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Ahíra, ɔyí kú Ɛ́nan.

eng_Latn: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ olɛhɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu ɔ́ pó ā, ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo yá kéē lɛ aá nyatá ā. Aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ nōó cokónu ō je lɛ aá nōo cābɔ̄ ka aá wɛ ákú nū ā kpó lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē fu odée kú nū ukɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
idu_Latn: Unáfutāli lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpɛ̄ɛnu nēe yɔ̄ ī kwinya gē yɛ icííci ā, nōo gē ma ayí olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí utéblu kú um ā, é géē lé ɛbɛ́ aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācɛ oce aɔ́nya ā, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ okpɛ́fú. Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nɛ̄ n géē je ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipíinu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwɔ kpó ŋmó, nɛ̄ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā yɔ̄ ipíinu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gbɛlá kahíníī, Ɛdɔ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔyí um, Usólōmɔn gáā gwó ā, í nwuné klla í tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi nōó í lóofu odúúdú ɛcɛ. Amáŋ ó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄, í klla jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē lɛ iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tútū lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛyínɛ̄hi ā tútū, ɛɛ́ nōó kwú á.

eng_Latn: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla Ujúda gā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ipú ígbíli ɛga nōó yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē mla ufáyin ō ŋmó. Lɛ um owu tú kwu ɔhá mla īkpɔ̄cí nēé hī ka ápu ā, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ le hɛ́ um iyē ohígbū ihɔtū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɔfú lɔfú, klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá uwa ɛlā bɔ̄bí bɔ̄bí. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī le kwu í tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄, aɔ́há le kwu í tayínū ɛplɛ́cɔ̄, ámāŋ ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú obugā.

eng_Latn: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē ményinyi Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn fíyɛ́ aá ɛ̄cī nēe géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ Uhána he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, āyā ékpónú kú ɛbɛ́ ā nōó gē je lɛ ɔ́ á, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ɔma kú nū gwū.

eng_Latn: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ipɔ́lɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ aá le yɛ, dɔɔ̄kā abɔ́ɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kē ba abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā géē gwéeyē ohígbū kéē lɛ ācocījáalí ɛpa nyā kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́. É géē yá ucɛ klɛɛcɛ, géē tū ɔdā ɛhi gé lɛ aɔ́mpa uwā. Ohígbū ka ācocījáalí ɛpa ā yá alɛɛcɛ ōwē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā ā, aá lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́. Anú gē tá aá abɔ̄ klla gē gbō aá á.

eng_Latn: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra ce ɛyí ede kú ɔcí nēe gwó ohígbū kú ojīla nyā ā. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā māhayi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, Umáttitīya, Uséma, Anáya, Uríya, Uhílikīya mɛ́mla Umáasēya. Ācɛ nēe bá ā kē háyi abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū, Upedáya, Umíssāwɛlu, Umálikīja, Uhássum, Uhássabadána, Usékaríya mɛ́mla Uméssūlam.

eng_Latn: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔbɛ́ɛna le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā ŋmó, íne ɛdɔ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā géē kwú ɔ̄ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú okpó ɔhá í klla yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú nū gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbó iháyí ɔ́mofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú eko nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, a tá alɔ, a klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le alɔ yálé ɛɛ́. Á klla kē ga ɛfú mla aícɔ́ɔja kú alɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
idu_Latn: É í pīya īlī odufā ā klá itébulu kú igbō nēé je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, klla í kpó ocíbú mɛ́mla ógo kú ɔtulāli ā, mla ógo nēé gē bī lɛ gwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ɔjá kú ejé kú ɛya ā kpó ce ɛyí itébulu ā. Igbō ā géē cɛyí itébulu ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kahíníī, Aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n ka bá í kōō wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔcányā, Ɛ́sta í yá ucɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā jéejée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ayíka ami mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ā ōfōōfū alɔ. Oócí, alɔ klla í nyɔ̄ ɔnū ucɛ ɔhá, ɔlɛ́ nū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tū ujɔ̄ nyā ā fíyɛ́ ācɛ ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū le ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ mɛ́mla ojuju kú uwā fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya da uwá kahíníī, Aá mā únóji ā ta kwu ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā cííí, é gáā kpó ikpokwú kú nū ŋmá ipú únóji ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kpó ikpokwu kú nū, ámāŋ ka ákú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Usamérīya ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ayíkpó ā nōo he Ujísɔ̄si ɔtū nɛ̄hi, cīce pī Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
idu_Latn: Owú tígbígbili nya géē yɔ i blatū aá eko dóódu. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ má, aá géē blatū odúúdu íne kú um klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ̄ ɔ́. Aá klla gáā cīgbīhi ŋmá ɔwɛ kú um, ga ī yá ɔdā nōo he aá ɔtū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
idu_Latn: É le ajɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó lɛ Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujefúne.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ ayí nɛ̄ Urécɛ̄lu ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu á. É wɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ijaki kú nū wū ɔcí ufáyin. Ó géē lɛ ejé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó lɔfú lɛ ejé ā na īlī kú nū.

eng_Latn: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
idu_Latn: Ó tū īyī nū wā ajɛ pīyabɔ̄ klla kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā nū yá ā ŋ́. Anú ā kōō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ā híīī lɛ ɛlā kú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ a má tá ipú ɔkpá nyā tayínū lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nyā géē yá ā má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ miya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nwuné lɛ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ kē bī ɔ́ŋgbá le miya ɔwá mɛ́mla īkpō kú nū āa? A jé ohi nū?.

eng_Latn: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
idu_Latn: Aóhī kú aá gē cīije bá ācɛ ɔhá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú e lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó bónū. Ācɛ ōhī kú aá gē lé ɔdōlé nēe le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛ̄cī ā, aíkpɛ́cí ā. Aɔ́há klla ī yúnwū ī cikpó iyī uwā ɔwɛ nōo lɔhi ŋ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
idu_Latn: Awɔ akwuna nēé kwu mlanyī uwɔ ɛɛ́ mā, kwú ɛ̄ngwū kú uwɔ ú ka aá yɛ jīla igelī ā tá biílí. Gwō ɛ̄ngwū kú ā gwííjē, o yá ká ācɛ kóō kwú bla kwu uwɔ igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unáaman tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Miyɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , ó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mīyɛ piíí, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ije ā gbō ɛkpa ɛpa lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla otóngwō ɛpa ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó ce ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛpa ā ɛyí á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá tū gɔbū lɛ Ugɛ́hási á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu hápápá nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ohígbū ka ihɔtū kú ɔyínɛ̄ nū ā le mu ɔ́ ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá inu ɔlɛ́ nū gaá le ikwū je ohígbū koó bī iyī nū glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
idu_Latn: Óndú, bī italā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ pīya tá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē bī itali le nū aálá tá ɔwɛ ā. Amáŋ a híī yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ŋ́. A kē híī bī ícɔ̄nū le yá alɔ italā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā géē kpó alɔ ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ āa le hídáagó ohígbū keé má ācɛ odokónu gē kɛlā, mɛ́mla ācɛ onyɔ́nyí le hɛ́tá, ācɛ ocīkpó gē yāwu, ācɛ opeyī kē ī mɛ́ɛbɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
idu_Latn: Ísu ā wɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á. Ācɛ nēe gwó uwɔ ā lɛ uwɔ gwó bɛ̄ɛka úgbéenyi olɔhi nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ kōō yēeyī, alɔ yēeyī lɛ Óndú ā, ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ gekwú, alɔ kwú lɛ Óndú ā. Ó lɛ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ kōō yēeyī ámāŋ nɛ̄ alɔ gekwú, alɔ wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
idu_Latn: É pīya anú tū, klla yá ɔ̄ ōwē nááná ó nwūla okónu ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí álá nēé bī nyɔ̄ gáā hɛ́ ɔ̄ ɔkɔ ā. Ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka álá nōo klá iyɔbu ācɛ nēé gáā wá ɔ̄ ɔnwū ā.

eng_Latn: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá um, nɛ̄ ó klla mīyɛ ɛlā kú um ŋ́, ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú nū. Ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā, géē kɛpɔ̄tū ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi klla lɛ ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Aá tū uwā iyē ŋmá iyɔ̄bū kpaakpa ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ aá le yɛ igbīhi uwá ka aá tū uwā iyē ŋmá āyā ɔhá, ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́cí nēé hī ka Ubálsam ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da odúúdú ācɛ ā ka ɛcɔ̄ ā géē wɛ ijáalí kú aá á. Ó ka ɛcɔ̄ ā kē lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ uwá ā pó ɛɛ́. Ó géē wɛ ijáalí ce uwá ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá tū ŋmá o yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē bī uwā ga ipú ajɛ olɔhi, ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔkpá mɛ́mla njɔɔlɔ bá anú, mɛ́mla ajɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē pɛ́ ŋmá ɛháajɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ga ipú aɔ́pɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́.

eng_Latn: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
idu_Latn: Aócɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé gēe wā ɛgiyí alɔ ŋmá Ufilístiya a, abɔ̄ alɔ gēe tá uwá ohi lɛ a? Alɔ gēe da uwá ka Óndú ākwú Usáyɔn u kwu ajɛ ɛɛ́ kɛɛ, ka, ācɛ kú nū nēe hímáyī móōwē a má la ɛbɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ákú ɛcɛ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń wɛ ákú ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ahāapa kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā pīíí ā, Uhananíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: N géē je aá pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Aá géē jé ka ami, Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī cɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē hī um igwú, klla í wā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um. N kē í jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛka kú aflɛ́yí ā í lɛ unwalu ŋ́ nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í cɛgbá kéē je ɔ́mpa gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
idu_Latn: Ā híī fu ɔcí kú ɛjī ká ajɛ ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē mīyɛ ajɛ kú ayókwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú uwɔ ā klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé le igá o lɔfú nɛ̄hi hɛ́ tū uwā. Ajɛ olɔhi, inu nōo le mu mla agbénú. Obugā nēé tɛtɛ le bu táajɛ, ɔcí kú ólīfu, ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄cí o lé. É lé ɔdā dúúmā nōo he uwá ɔtú ā anɔ́ɔ é le ipú nū klla le kpó jɔ̄kwū. É jɔ́nyɛ kú ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nāa kpó lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ipú ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī, ɛ́ɛ géē lé igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ɛ́ɛ le jīla tɔ̄há kéē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ipú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē tū ɔ̄ iyē, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le jɛ̄ ɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū ɔ́ɔ klla le gbenyi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ufi ɔ́ɔ lɛ́ ɔ́ kwú nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ kwu. Ó ka anúɔ géē ŋmó Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ yɔ̄ ipú Ísrɛ̄lu dúú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aítíca ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kē géē bɛ̄cɛ ipú aá ā. É géē bī ɔdā ōnwū ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēe géē ŋmó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō tāajɛ glá ā wā í nwū aá, nɛ̄ aá gáā jé obɔ̄bi kú nū fíyaa ŋ́. É géē tá ɛlā kú Ujísɔ̄si nōo nyā uwā tá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é géē bī ífi wā gé lɛ iyī uwā fíyaa.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔtūce um ā.

eng_Latn: And the men of Bethshemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? and to whom shall he go up from us?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ubɛti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ géē háyi mla Óndú, Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ nyā glá āā? Iní nɛ̄ alɔ géē tū ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kóō gāá kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ āa.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka á, Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā, nāa gē tɛhɔ̄ gaá da Ubáalsébubu, ɔwɔ kú ācɛ Ékrɔn ɔ̄kā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, á gaá wā ajɛ ŋmá agōdō ōcē kú uwɔ nyā ŋ́, amáŋ a géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da Óndú ā kahíníī, Le yá kú alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō nwuné fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ulíbna gā Ulákisi, le ɔ́ yɛ jīla tá, klla le ɛfú kpó tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ka ka alɔ lɛ olétɔ̄há mla anú, nááná nɛ̄ alɔ kē ī yɛ ipú ajoodobū kpɔ́, ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ ī kā á, alɔ í kē yēeyī ɔwɛ nōo wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ hile ukpɛ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā ofōōfūnū. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ī klla ī gbāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o he uwá ɔtū ā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kē tíne ká ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ī yá ā kóō lɛ ā. Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nyā le pīyɛyí tá, ɔdí nēé géē yá ā gɛ.

eng_Latn: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō le yɛce ɛlā nēé nwū ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ mla Ujóram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá kpɛ́fú tá Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya. É kpɛ́fú ā ajɛ kú Urámɔtu ipú Ugílɛ̄di, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ujóram yá ágbe ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā bī úwé ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔbá nū gā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
idu_Latn: Ó nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā bī gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ nū le ɛdɔ ɔdōlé nōo ī he ádā nū ɔtū ā yá lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti le ɛpɔ̄bí nēé tíne ā ŋmó Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
idu_Latn: É géē kla ewo kú anāānɔ̄ ā ŋmá ede ā, klla í kpó īlī odufā ā pīya klá anú.

eng_Latn: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ ohile ā je āyā oligíí ŋmá ipú agbénú nēé lɛ hile ā. Amáŋ anú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ogbɛhá lɛ nááná ā odúúdú ɔdā nōó ī bī le lá ɔdōlé ā nōó je ŋmáajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ uwá hīgwú ga ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó tá ācīije lɛ uwá kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá nɛ̄ Usétan lɔfú nū Usétan tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
idu_Latn: Alɔ le ɔ̄kā da aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka, ɔnyɛ je ɔ́da lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé bá í gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā klla í kpó iyó kú nú tū ipú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
idu_Latn: Ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā í wɛ umu nēé le anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū ɔ̄, okoolo ɛtá kú umu mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna éyi, okoolo kú umu ɛpa mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede ā.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
idu_Latn: Wā Óndú, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ lɛ uwɔ yálé ŋ́! Lɛ odúúdú aéwɔhá ā kpó wā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ uwá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó habɔ̄ ācɛ ogbɛhá nēé lɛ agbénū dóódu ŋ́ mā tá Ujúda. Ó le uwá kpó bá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́ɛ́hɔ̄ kú ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā, ayínɛ́ um, n bī Apólɔsi mɛ́mla ami abɔ̄yī um le yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú odúúdu ɔdā nɛ̄ n tɔ́kpá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛyí kú ɛlā nēé ka ɔ́ɔma jé. É kahíníī, Aá lɛ ine okpaakpa ā tū. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú aá kóō bī ɔ̄cɛ éyi le kɔbɔ́ɔcɛ klla leyī gwō ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ācíije tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aópeyī ōbī aópeyī jɔ́ɔwɛ ā. Aá gē cīla íkítíkpī tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá éŋkpɔ̄ amáŋ aá kē ī je inyankwūlūmī mlɛ!.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, É géē jila Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú iyē tɛnɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācɛ nēe hile ā kpó yíífi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ gē jila ɔcí ufáyin iyē lɔɔlɔhi igbɔɔ́mpā kéē lɛ ikpō dóódu nēe hile ā kpó wū nɛ̄ īkpō dúúmā í gáā hile anú ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli, ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga ísu, nōo yɔ̄ abɔ̄ ɔhá kú ísu kú Újɔ́dan ā. Ugálīli, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ aílɔ́wá lā ā.

eng_Latn: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
idu_Latn: Eyī í lɔfú da abɔ̄ kahíníī, Ń cɛgbá awɔ ŋ́ glá ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ īkpɛ̄yí gē da ikpó kahíníī, Ń cɛgbá awɔ ŋ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ōhī kahíníī, Aá jé ŋmá ipú ɔkpíihɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ Udɛ́fīdi mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū yá eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ ŋmó uwā ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, eko dúúmā nēé ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō pó, aá híī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā aá yá eko nēé bɛ́yí kwu Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
idu_Latn: Ondú, kóocō lɛ um hɛ́tá, Ondú, wā ī tá um abɔ̄ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāssi le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Amásīya kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔcí ujē kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ulébānɔn le ɛhɔ̄ tū fú ulóko kú ipú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ka, Kwú ɔyí uwɔ ú gā um ká n̄ le lɛ lɛ ɔyí um. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ́ ipácí nɛ̄hi gaá yɛ kwú ɔcí ujē ā ú da tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o cījáalí ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi í gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ o cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ā, n lɛ ɔtū kú um yéékpó ka n kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā ɔhá dóódu í kpó mlanyī, ɔcí tɔ́cí Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mɛ́mla ikwū kú nū ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, ó géē bī okóohō ɛpa ámāŋ ka ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o yá olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa dóódu nōo cɛ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛbɛ̄ɛka, obugā, ámāŋ ka ɔkpá nēé lɛ emī kwū tū ɔ̄ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɛpllá nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ nyā, aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā bā í tɔ́kpá fu Utobíya eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú é gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú ɔkpáncō. Otrɛ̄yí kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄, Umáyíkɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó kpó trɛ̄yí ā bá ī nuunu tú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó kpó trɛ̄yí ā kē nuunu tū uwā kwúcē á.

eng_Latn: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ī tíne kéē pīya ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā abɔ̄ ā bá ī cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi kéē lɛ ɔtū kú aá pīya tá ɛgiyí uwā, amáŋ ɔdā nēé tíne ō yá ā í lɔhi lɛ aá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔdā nēé tíne wɛ o lɛ yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛyítáajɛ ga um gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā kú uwā kóō kwú aá iyē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ákú um gē kwú aá iyē aā.

eng_Latn: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
idu_Latn: É gwó kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, ɛga olicō fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā uwā hī ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā íbí īī? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō lɛ ɛlā nōo gē ka ā kwútū, ámáŋ ó ī yá iyīnū bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ó gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ā kwú pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā glá ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó géē da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔdōlé ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú um yá ga um, cɛ́ɛ́ ā le iyī uwɔ tútū ká ā le ɔdōlé je ga um, cɛ́ɛ́ ā háyi cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le lé, le gwá kwɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā a lɔfú lé ɔdōlé kú uwɔ igbīyājɛ glá.

eng_Latn: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
idu_Latn: É le anɔ̄ pīya tū otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ɛyí, klla kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí kóō lɛ ɔdōwiyē kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā wiiyē ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó gáā híla úwé kú nū ámāŋ mabɔ̄ ɛyí kú nū tá kwiicō kóō híī fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́, nōo í mafú koó gē yēekwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá kéē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí anúɔ, amáŋ é bī ɛlā ā yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bá ī dɛ̄gba tū uwā kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, kēé wɛ ācɛ nēe le iyī ūwā iyē tēelihɔ. Ké ē híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī yɛ ŋmá éwo éyi ga éwɔhá, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē cɛ̄ mīyɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kɔ́ɔ̄ wā í tá anúɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé ī tú iyī uwā wāajɛ ā géē lā ipú ajɛ ā. É klla í jɔ́ɔnyɛ gɔbū ipú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī je lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔtōōce í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔwɛ í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē yá ɔdā ō he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē túblá Ɔwɔicō géē cɛ̄ kóō yɔ̄, kóō géē cíla ācɛ nēe dɔɔ̄kā nū ā ulé.

eng_Latn: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé le íne nōó bīya ā mafú lɛ ɔ́, iyɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā nōó géē bī wā ā wɛ, opī nōó lɛ ɛnyá dúú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
idu_Latn: Upagíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ɔ́kran ā gē leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa á.

eng_Latn: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
idu_Latn: Lɛ okoolo kú ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ umu kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ miya, lɛ ɔ́ wīya tɔ̄há mla ɛlɛm ɛhīlī kú ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ anɔ̄ kú ólīfu, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú anú mɛ́mla omlede kú aflɛ́yí ā ú gwɛ́ɛya gā um. A í je ɛlɛm ɛhīlī kú ejé gwɛ́ɛya ga um dúú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, ācotɛ̄hɔ̄, ayókwū, ācɛ ulífayi, aéwɔhá, mɛ́mla anyōkwū nēe lā pī uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ gwéeyē ipéyī kú Óndú ā. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gā ɛga nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā mla ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú uwā, kéē gwéeyē iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yá ɔdānyā ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā fú kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɛ̄lā kú Óndú ā lɔfú. Ó lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ oō yá jīla kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō ka táajɛ bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ahíja lɛ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati ā yá jīla á. Anú yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam je eyī gwū ɛlā kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā bónū á.

eng_Latn: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó nyi únóji, ká ā lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū uwā ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka ɔkpani ā géē je odúúdú agbénú kú nū tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
idu_Latn: N da aá kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú ācɛ nēe hīgwú aflɛ́yí ā nōo í le okónu bá ɔdōlé kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu géē bá ī ka kahíníī, Ɛɛ́! Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ajɛ nyā nōo mu ácí tá amānyā ā, je yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ kú Éden ā. Aígelī nēé le wúla tāajɛ kwú pīya alácɛ̄ ā, klla kwú pīya ɛga nēé ge hɛ́ ɔdɔ tū ɔɔ́ klla í lā anú yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
idu_Latn: N géē tū aéwɔhá wā í je Ubábīlɔn yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē kpo ácí bónū ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nēé géē je ɔ́ yíífi ā gā, é géē kpɛ́fú tá Ubábīlɔn ŋmá āyā dóódu kē í je ajɛ ā tá áncā.

eng_Latn: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ umíta ofigwáhāpa cigwó āyā dóódu ā. Ɔdɔ ā lɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ā kɔ̄ hī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́ mā tá.

eng_Latn: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá lɔfú lé īkpō kú ɔcí ā iháyí ɔ́mɛɛhɔ̄ ā glá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka á lɛ yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka lɛ ā, aɔ́cí kú aá géē gwíkpō nɛ̄hi. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔ́wɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī ā gē leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ kóō gbō iyī nū ŋmá unwalu, amáŋ aólíla ā í gbeyī gɔɔ ŋ́. É gē nwúleyīkwu nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussɛfatíya wɛ, ofu igwáahātá ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā ka ɔtū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kpóce ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā í gáā gbō uwā glá ŋ́. Otábɔ̄ kú Íjīpiti ā ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya uwēyī lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ákú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́dāŋ ka á kɛlā nyā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē bá í nū aá inya jāā gbó oocí.

eng_Latn: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ mla ɔnyā ā bɛ̄ɛka, álá nēé bī gáā ŋmó ā. Bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū nōo gē tómbli ga ipú ukpa kú ofītɛ́ igbledū ā.

eng_Latn: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the LORD God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā da Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū ajɛ kú Anátɔ̄tu. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō gekwú, amáŋ anúɔ í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ŋmó ɔ̄ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka anú ɔ́ɔ leyīkwu ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā á. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anú mɛ́mla ádā anúɔ má odúúdú ōwē tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī éyi lé ka ɛ̄cī éyi, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí ɔnyā nū ā, gāá da ɔ́ koó wɛ ɔdɔma, ó kē ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ géē yīipú, í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ eko kpií nōo gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
idu_Latn: É lɛ okónu, amáŋ é kɛlā glá ŋ́, é lɛ īkpēyí, amáŋ é mɛ́ɛbɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um gē má um ímálānyī, gē dɔ̄ɔ̄kā kú n̄ gekwú, kú iyē kú um kóō gebí ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you. 25 And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Uféro lɛ Umósīsi hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá gaá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Ayí aá kéē nyɔ̄ mla aá dúú. Amáŋ aá gáā kpó aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú aá nyɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́. É géē bá amānyā.

eng_Latn: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā alɛwa nɛ̄ aá má ohígbū Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā wɛ icííci nɛɛ? Ó tīile gbóó.

eng_Latn: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ Óndú ā nēe kwú ā, gēe héyī, í yēeyī igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ɔkpíyē kú uwā kllá í je héyī igbɔhá kpó ɛɛ́. Da odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ī gbiyɔ̄lā ipu únóji ā, kéē le kpó héyī, kéē gwíijē kú éeyē. Óndú ā géē ce klá ɔlékwū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú nōo ī ce klá ácí eyīoonyā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe tɛtɛ kwú gbojīgbojī ɛɛ́ mā, géē je héyī kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā dúú í gáā yá kú ɛdɔ alelékwū nyā kóō bɛ̄cɛ glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ācɛ gwu okónu klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
idu_Latn: A kwú uwā ú tayínū iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, ŋmá ipú ujɔ̄ kú ācɛ. A kwú uwā ú tayínū ɛga nāa í gbō uwā ŋmá ɛcá kú aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
idu_Latn: le ɔkɔ nēé ī gbā gā uwɔ ā pó. Ɔ́dāŋ keé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú nēé bī klla bīya íne kú uwɔ ā ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, koócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā pó, Óndú.

eng_Latn: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi Utɛ́dāsi, Ujúdasi kú Ugálīli cāŋjɛ eko ɔlɛ́-ōka, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ ōhī pi blla iyī nū. É kē le ɔ́ ŋmó dúú, ācɛ dóódu nēe kē yɛce ɔ́ ā le pahīla.

eng_Latn: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household.
idu_Latn: Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā tá ɔlɛ Obɛ́dɛdɔ̄m ɔyā ɛtá. Ɔwɔicō kē yɔ̄ ī hɔ́há ce Obɛ̄dɛdɔ̄m mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɛ í lɔhi, kéē lɛ um ma okwū ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um gaá ga únóji bōōbū, fíyɛ́ ō yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
idu_Latn: Ufēro mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, cɛ̄ ka ɛlā kú Ujósɛ̄fu ɔ́ɔ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehée, n géē cíla uwɔ ulé nū. Ń gáā je ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ń bī ije tá ɔ ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa. Ohígbū ka aá gē na eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú íkókwū mɛ́mla ocíbú, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ abɔ̄fú mɛ́mla unwū ɔdā o yá fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ā bá eyīpú uwā láyí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ anyōkɔ̄ɔma ā gē yúufi Ɔwɔicō ā, ó le ayí abɔ̄yī uwā kpó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
idu_Latn: Alɛɛcɛ dúúdú mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́, mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā ō yēeyī nōo kē yɔ̄ ɛcɛ ā le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛjī kú ɛhícō ā géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ jāā ga igelī nēé hī ka Énɔn nōo tū ɛjī mɛ́mla Udamáskúsi klla mɛ́mla Uhamáti ga ɛhícō kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā géē gáā māháyi pīyɛ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdōocābɔ̄ ā kwu ajɛ ɔnyɛ̄pa kú ɔwɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō má ɔwɛ nɛ̄ é géē nyɔ̄ ā, ó klla í tá ahámgbā kú nū ce acá. Ó í da ɛcí kú nū ɔ̄kā, klla í jila anyī kú ɛbɛ́ nōo le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí kú nū ā má.

eng_Latn: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kpó ikpɛ́cí ca ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā bá gē pā ɛcí, klla gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛ̄cī abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwá lɛ ɛyí púlla klla lɛ ɔnwū agba wā. Odúúdú uwá lɛ éwo wu klá ɛyi, lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiyē ɛɛ́.
