eng_Latn: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ Ujíyu lɔfú yá ɔdā dúúmā, nōo he uwá ɔtū mla aólɛlā kú uwá glá. É bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le kpɔ́fú kwu aólɛlā kú uwā klla le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
idu_Latn: A géē yá agbá kú ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ ugóolu lɛ ɛkpa ō bɔ́ɔ́tū ā, a í jíla ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ŋgbá.

eng_Latn: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú Óndú ā kwú Ugídīyɔn ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ opo tá kóō hī ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Abíyɛ̄sa igwú wā í yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá le Ɛláyíssa, ɔyí kú Ussáfati má, abɔ̄ ó bī ɛna igwɛ́ɛpa yɔ̄ í hɛ́hɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja gā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le úwé kú ɛhícō plla kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó wu ɔ́ iyē á.

eng_Latn: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ nēe le yɛ ligbó ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā cíkā ō gbɛlá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ōhī kú aá í gbɛlá ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ŋ́ nááná Ɔwɔicō géē yá kú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kéē jɛ́ɛyí nū piíí.

eng_Latn: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ácí mɛ́mla ɔdōlé nōo géē jɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla inu nɛ̄ a géē gbo anú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, n kwú Ujerúsālɛm í kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ nɛ̄ aéwo ɔhá dúúdú yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá.

eng_Latn: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ Ógu mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla odúúdu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ŋmó á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile ŋ́, é klla mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā yɔ̄ á, okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú aá nēe géē wā úklɔ́ ɛ̄cī usábāti ā í gbō agbla kú ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
idu_Latn: Íne ékpónú ā yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēé jégēdē ŋ́ le íne bīya á. É kōō wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu, ámāŋ ka éwɔhá nōo lā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ jé ɔdā nōó wɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō yúufi Óndú ɔkwɔɔkwɛ̄yi ā, alɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔwɛ dóódu ka alɔ pīya odúúdú ācɛ abɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí nū. Ɔwɔicō je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔda dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ā á. N kē leyīce ka aá je alɔ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ íne kú um, klla lɛ uwá tū, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíihɔtū tū um á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē yíihɔtū tū um, Ádā um géē yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄, n kē géē yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄, n kē géē ma iyī um fú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ka ayí nɔ̄nyā kú Usɛlofɛ́hādi ā géē lɛ ɔbá dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū. Amáŋ, ɔbá ā géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ī wɔ́tū aá, klla í tá ɛlā kú aá, gē cá aá ɛcá, gē ŋmó aá okónu ka aá wɛ ācɛ oyá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí, ohígbū ka aá gē tá ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwu ā, ákú aá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: For the LORD, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɔnyā mɛ́mla ɔbá oōtá gē wú um ɔtū. Ó gē wú um ɔtū eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá lɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā yá tá ɔnya nū. Aá lɔfú tīiyē kú aá híī nyíla okónu nɛ̄ aá ce le ɔnyā aá ka aá géē bá cíí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔfú cɛ̄ ɔkpani ɛpa ɛhɔ̄ mla ɔtū ékpónú igbo ékpónú glá ŋ́. Ohígbū koó géē wɔ́tū éyi, ɔhá ā kē í he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ámāŋ ó géē lɛ ɔtū tū éyi cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē leyī gwō ɔhá bónū. Aá gáā cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄, ká aá klla yɔ̄ ī lɛ ije ō dɔ̄ɔkā bla anú igbo ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ wɛ olíla, é klla jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Aɛ́cí ā le uwēyī je lɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá ojibó kú uwā ā. Ohígbū ka aɛ́cí nēé yá ŋmá oje ā í wɛ ɔdā ɔkwēyi ŋ́. É kē yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aógbɛhá ā í má īlī le wiiyē ŋ́ mā, é tóohɛ́ɛwa bā ī yɛ, bī ɛmiyɛ ipú bá ī ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, kwu otú, n géē yɔ̄ ī kpó ɛpɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, klla í yɔ̄ ī tíifu, ó kē í pó ɔkɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ aá géē hī aéwo nɛ̄ aá jé jéjéē ɛ́ ŋ́ mā igwú á, aéwo nēé jé aá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē kwinya wā ɛgiyí aá, í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aá. Ó í lɛ ā ohígbū ka ami, Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú, nɛ̄ aá ī gbā ā, nōo klla wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í tōō le gbla um ŋ́ mā, kwú ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú ɔcɛ́ í lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu ce ahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
idu_Latn: É bī omútāgā le ugóolu ca plɛ́kɛ́tɛ́ɛ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ hɛ́ fíílí-fíílí kéē bī ɔ̄ le tá tū ipú owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá mɛ́mla ipú īlī olɔhi nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iyē kú uwɔ lé ka Ujékɔ̄pu, amáŋ é gáā hī iyē kú uwɔ̄ ka Ujékɔ̄pu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. O ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū iyē kú uwɔ géē lé ka Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú Ísrɛ̄lu í ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
idu_Latn: Ehée, ó lɛ ā ŋ́! N̄ da aá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī bīya ā ŋ́, aá géē je yíifi ɔwɛ nēé je yíifi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.
idu_Latn: Otú le bī uwā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, eko nēé wā Ujɛ́būsi, Anɔ́ɔ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔkpani uwā ka aá le gbo igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujɛ́busi abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ uwá nū ācɛ kú Ufilístiya inya ŋmá Ugíbēyɔn jāā ga Ugɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
idu_Latn: Ubɛtúwɛlu, Uhɔ́ma, Usíklāgi.

eng_Latn: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɔnya ā bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū ā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aígbáanɔ ā le ɛbɛ́ kú uwā jāā gbéeko nōó le jɛ̄ uwā á.

eng_Latn: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, Umanásɛ, Ísāka, mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn ā, í gwu īyī uwā iyē yēŋēē ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é ba í lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā mla īnyī mla ucɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya le ɔkɔ gbā ohígbū uwā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, a gē mɛ́ɛbɛ dúú. A kē móōwē mɛ́mla unwalu nɛ̄ aógbɛhá bá ipú nū ā. A kē le tútū eko dóódu ká ā tá uwā abɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ otábɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, kwú īyī nū í gā uwɔ ɛɛ́. Awɔ kē húmáyī tá ayókwū abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
idu_Latn: Ucē nɛ̄ aá yá nyā, í cābɔ̄ ka aá yɔ̄ ī kɔ̄ ācɛ ígwíígwu ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔ́ɔmā léka ígwu kú ācɛ éyi lɔhi fíyɛ́ ígwu ɔhá á. Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá bī ɔtū yɔ̄ ī le hɛ́pɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē kpó abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɛbɛ́ ā ɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē mīyɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya nēé gwó, nōo kpó íne nōó bīya ā nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
idu_Latn: Íla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo wɛ ogwuda o yúuya, nɛ̄ ó jé ɔdā uwēyī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le odée nōó he um ɔtū ŋ́ lɛyíkwu aá. Á jɛɛga lɛ ɔnyā nēé hī ka Ujésɛ̄bɛl ɔ́ɔmā, nōo ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɔ̄nyā kú Ɔwɔicō ā. O ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nōó ī nwū ā, ó lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um plla tū íne o bīya kú ikpɔɔnya nōó wɛ ɔnyā uwá ŋ́ ō ce mɛ́mla o cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí.

eng_Latn: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ugádu da ɔ́ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die, both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ le ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwú yɔ̄ gē gwutá mla ɔnyā kú ɔ́mpā nū, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ɔnyā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē gwutá mla anú ā kpó ŋmó. Ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ géē mɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā glá á.

eng_Latn: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ uwá yálé, ohígbū kēé le íne kú uwɔ bīya, anɔ́ɔ é le pīyabɔ̄ gā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nyā, kócōō, lɛ ɔkɔ nē í gbā gā uwɔ ā pó.

eng_Latn: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
idu_Latn: Le kwu ŋmá únwū obɔ̄bí kú aɛ́drɔ́ nōo gē bī uwā tá āa. Lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ kwu o lā oyēeyī okpaakpa, cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, ācɛ kéē hi uwɔ ɔtū, lā ɛbɔ́ mla ācɛ nēe bī ɔtū oyéŋēē gē ba Óndú ā kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne ō yá uwā odée nɛɛ, ɔlá gē tá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yíífi. Ɔwɛ nyā nēé gē bī le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō yá uwā odée ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā, aá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔbíipú, ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ōkā ámāŋ ka ula ō yá, ámāŋ imálānyī ámāŋ ɛcá ō cá kpɔ́ bónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā ā má kéē lɛ ɔkwu anúɔ jé ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó fīyégbúlú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, gaá má gbo klá ikpó kú Ujísɔ̄si. Ipeyí ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā ó lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó le hɛ́tá bōōbū ā.

eng_Latn: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɛga kú ɔfú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá kéē bá ā í jɛ̄ uwā eyī ŋ́ mā, nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔwɔicō lɛ agbá ō yɔ̄ piyóó tū uwá ipú ajoodobū, ɛga nōó yɔ̄ gē lɛ uwá tū ī gbēyī ɛ̄cī nōó géē kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā kéē híī yá um ɔdā dúú ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá kē géē mīyɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī bī gé lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe le tēelihɔ ohígbū kaé le abɔ̄ kwu okwū, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gáā lé ucɛ kú onyatá nyā glá ŋ́. É le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni, anɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ajā gbo, anɔ́ɔ ɔbá nū gbɔɔ́ ō kpéyīce ɔ́, nááná nɛ̄ó kwú ɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ dúú ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ī cījáalí tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá ipú ɔwɛ dóódu nēe bá ā ŋ́, é géē hɛ́ anú mɛ́mla aíkonó kú nū tá ɛpléeko kú iháyí kú o je ɔdā cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá kóō híīī kwúcē igbīhi ohígbū ōwē nēé cɛ̄ lɛ aá má ā ŋ́. Aá abɔ̄yī aá jé ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ miya táajɛ lɛ alɔ kā alɔ í móōwē piíí.

eng_Latn: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā catāajɛ ā, ó le úklɔ́ yá lɔfú nɛ̄hi kéē lɛ ɔ́ ma gicō. É klla le inɔ̄ɔda kpó gwó kwu ɔdɔ ā ɛyí. Ó klla le aɔ́dɔ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cí ā kpó ma gicō ŋmá ajɛ. Ó klla le aóbō mɛ́mla aɔ́kplɛ́fú alɛwa nɛ̄hi kpó yá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tíkpa kú odōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla íne kú Óndú ā ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi igbīhāajɛ, ayí kú Ujóbu bá yɔ̄ ī lé ucɛ klla bā í gwó ejé ɔlɛ́ ɔ́kplá kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
idu_Latn: Ássa ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Ímna, Íssfa, Íssfi mɛ́mla Uberíya, mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nya éyi nōo lé ka Uséra.

eng_Latn: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Aáfādi mɛ́mla Uhɛ́lɛki ā ī gbo ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á. Ācɛ kú Ugamádi, kē ī gbo inɔ̄ɔda nēé ī ce ī gbāajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā á. Uwá gē kpó ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwā pla ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā. Uwá wɛ ācɛ nēe yá nāa héyīfuú á.

eng_Latn: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú íjééyī, wɛ ɔwɛ ogbiyēnɛɛ, odúúdú ɔwɛ kú nū klla wɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ipú ígbíli ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, ebilíi yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄ ojámá. Aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí bá abɔ́ɔ dúú, amáŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ wā gáā cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ā kwú pīya ga Uráma gaá kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáya nēé lɛ igá hɛ tū ɔ̄ ā. Ó le pīya ga Uhósa gāá ŋmɛ́yí ísu kú Umeditarénīya. Ó yɛ ga Umáhāla, Ákisību.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um, Ábsālɔm, ā bɛ́ɛ, ó yɔ̄ lɔhi? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Ágábáidu, Eyī yá um ka ɔdā nōo yá Ábsālɔm ā kóō yá odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Usófa wɛ, Usúwa, Uhánɛ̄fa, Ussúwalu, Ubɛ́ri, Ímra.

eng_Latn: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
idu_Latn: N da ācɛ ā, mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá kahíníī, Úklɔ́ ā le pahīla bá ɛgaligbó hī iyī uwā tá, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yá kú ālɔ̄ le kɔ̄ bá ɛgaligbó hī iyī alɔ tá ɛgiyí ɔdɔ kú igá ā.

eng_Latn: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, odée yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nāa géē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔkpá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tá ā í lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́. Ɔkpá oōjé nɛ̄hi gē jɛ̄ɛ̄jɛ̄, klla ī je ɔ̄cɛ híla.

eng_Latn: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ā, é géē je lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ odúúmā ŋ́, ɔdā nōó lɛ ā, é géē mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, enyi amɛ pɛ́ ga um cabácabá ɔwɛ dóódu, anɔ̄ kú olīifu kē kpɔ ga um.

eng_Latn: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
idu_Latn: Ó tá ācīije ɔhá lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdōōnīgbō, nɛ̄ ɔnyā éyi je wīya tɔhā mɛ́mla ámú igbō ɛtá gbéeko nōó lɛ odúúdú igbō ā nū ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi wɛ kéē géē yá oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé kwú agege kú nū í nyí, í cɔ̄lá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá yúklɔ́ kú nū kpɔ́, ó géē gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ōyá yēŋēē kú nū. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aálagbá ā í gē leyīkwu ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu gē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
idu_Latn: Ayí Ulífāyi géē pi ɔkpacáŋgelī kú uwá ŋmá apɛ́ wu abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā yɛ jīla biílí abɔ́ é bá gē gbō ɔ̄ ɛyi ā. É géē tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu bá ī gbō ɔ̄ ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ó géē nyɔ̄ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō bēé wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
idu_Latn: Ó le ka ipú odo kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úwé kú nū ōfūnū, n géē je hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē kú um.

eng_Latn: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
idu_Latn: É klla da ɔ́ kpɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ áluka kú aícɔ́ɔ́ja nēe kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā túbā kpɔ́ mɛ́mla áluka kú aɔ́nya kú ɛfú mɛ́mla áluka kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fu ɛdɔ ékpónú bɛ̄ɛka ákú aflɛ́yí ā túbá kpɔ́. É ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē nuunu tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ajɛ ɔlamu, cɛ́ɛ́ igbɛ́ɛmā, aá géē yá uwā lé piíí. Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ ā, jāhɔ̄ le ɛlā kú uwā pó anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā nēé ka ā yá á.

eng_Latn: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
idu_Latn: Ayí aá í yɛ í lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ā, ayááyí aá kē í yɛ í lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ikpō ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā. N kē í yɛ í cɛ̄ kéē kpó uwá yíifi gbógbóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti géē tá alácɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɛ́dɔm kē í je pīya ígbíli, í tá alácɛ̄ dúú. Ohígbū keé kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ Ujúda nēé yá ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā, kpó ŋmó bónū icííci á.

eng_Latn: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ Ujɛ́rīmɔtu.

eng_Latn: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
idu_Latn: Ucē okpaakpa kú uwɔ yɔ̄ piyóó. Íne kú uwɔ ā kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kahíníí, Ń tíne ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ō kwú ŋ́. Aá kwúcē ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú aá ka aá yēeyī.

eng_Latn: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi kwú Urútu ú ga ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɔnyā nū á. Óndú ā le ɔhá hɛ́ ce Urútu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ lɛ ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyílɔ éyi ma á.

eng_Latn: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Aá jahɔ̄ ká aá pó íbáā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bá ī dɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga dóódu ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā. É bá ī ka kahíníī, Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ Usáyɔn tá nɛɛ? Ɔcɛ́ kú Usáyɔn í klla yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tóohi ka, Ɔdíyá nēé kē yá um cɔ̄nū ŋmá lɛ aójíbó nēé yá mɛ́mla aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá nēé gē pá āa.

eng_Latn: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛhíícō ipú ɛgahi nɛ̄ o ōmá eyī kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje ɔdɔ ā. Oceyī kú nū ī tūufi ō má.

eng_Latn: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔ́ɔ híī kwú aá iyē gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī kpɛ́lāce iyī aá abɔ̄ aá je um lá wā amānyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā amānyā gbɔbū lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ lɛ oyēeyī kú ācɛ nyatá á.

eng_Latn: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kwú pɛ́ ga inu eyīpú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, le anɔ̄ pīya klá anú ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin da uwá ka ka anúɔ lɛ ita éyi kwu lɛ uwá. Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa kú ucɛ ā, nēé lɛyí nū ka lɛ anúɔ, anúɔ géē kpó otóngwō ofu cigwó mɛ́mla īlī nēé yíifa tū ɔ̄ ofu cigwó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ɔdāhá wɛ ɔtūnōbí lɛ ádā nū. Ádā kú ɔyí olíla í lɛ éeyē dúúmā ipú ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
idu_Latn: É le ojuju kú uwā yá klla le ujɔ̄ tū tū ɔcɛ́ ā, amáŋ, ó gáā lɛyí lɛ uwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
idu_Latn: Ébrahām ma Áyísīki, Áyísīki ma Ujékɔ̄pu, Ujékɔ̄pu ma Ujúda mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū ɔhá āa.

eng_Latn: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā gā ipú um, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú n cāŋjɛ háyi icō á. N pó ba ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gā um gɔbū kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá híī bī iyē kú um le gbɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá jé ka aá í gáā yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gbɔkpá kú nū ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́. Ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā gē bī uwēyī gé lɛ iyē kú um. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɛlā ka ó kē le yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā. Ɔ́da nɛ̄ ó je ā, nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
idu_Latn: Ubúki, Ússi, Userahíya.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ssɔ́m ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ufínēhasi, Udánīyɛ̄lu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Utáma.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kéē yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā eko dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū tū.

eng_Latn: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayínɛ́ nēe bá amānyā ā ī hokónu tū aá. Aá hokónu tū ɔ́mpa aá mla ɔtū ō má ɔtū nōo tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī gbajā ā. Ɔnyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī yá lɛ nɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ ī wā gaá cikpó nū ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá jɛ́ ō tíne aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aá géē pā lɛ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé ō yá ɔ̄ lɛ ā, ó kōō ɔnyā nōo wɛ ɔbákwuna ā kē ī nwū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ísɔ wɛ Ɛlífāasi, Uriyawɛ́lu, Ujéyus, Ujalám, mɛ́mla Ukóra.

eng_Latn: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
idu_Latn: Ɔgbɛ́fú kú aflɛ́yí ɔ́ɔmā, Ujonátan mla ɔyípóklóbīya ā ŋmó ācɛ ofu.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gbájí nɛ̄hi klla í tū ūwā ufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nōo í je uwá ɔtū gbájí nɛ̄hi, nōo klla í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá í gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ pī ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ugɔ́gu géē kpɛ́fú wā í gwū Ísrɛ̄lu ā, n géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
idu_Latn: Ó nyā alɔ tá ŋmá ɔdā nōo lɔfú ŋmó alɔ glá eko nōo yɛ ā. Ó kē í nyā alɔ ta ɛ̄cɔ̄bū. Alɔ lɔtūce ɔ́ kóō géē yɔ̄ ī nyā alɔ tá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ísāka ā wɛ: Utóla, Upúfa, Íyōbu, mɛ́mla Ussímrɔn.

eng_Latn: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ tá odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ é le ayí kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō leyīkwu um eyī ka aá má ɔ̄. Ń gáā kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
idu_Latn: Aá wā ɛ́ɛ́, aá nēe wɛ ācɛ olagbénú ā, aá jikwū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá dīíbá ohígbū ōwē nɛ̄hi nōo gáā wā ɛgiyí aá ā.

eng_Latn: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
idu_Latn: Kéē gwá ejé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mlanyī ɛhá mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n hī uwɔ igwú ā, aólɛlā kú um géē je pɛ́ kwu. N jé ɛ̄nyā lɛ ā ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Usámla gekwú anɔ́ɔ Ússɔlu ŋmá ajɛ kú Urɛ́hɔ̄bɔtu kú Uyúfrētīisi ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé á.

eng_Latn: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔcí nēé hī ufɛ́ɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhámɔn ā le gwó uwɔ, klla le ulóko kú Ulɛ́bānɔn le tá aflá kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
idu_Latn: nōo kē wɛ ɛkpa igwɛ́ɛtá ce ofu ɛtá ce ɛhɔ̄ , kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ā ú.

eng_Latn: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
idu_Latn: Olɔwá kú éyééye kú ipú aínu ɛháajɛ kú inīīcō ā wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce abɔ̄ ahāapa. Olicō kú nú wɛ ikpó éyi ce ɔtū éyi, ajɛ kú ɔtū inu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā cɔkpɛ́nú fíyɛ́ ɔdɔ kú inu abɔ̄yī nū á.

eng_Latn: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, ɔcɛ́ í yɔ̄ nōo gē gbō ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔnyɔɔnyɛ gē yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū lé ká anúɔ lɛ ijē kú nū pá, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ je ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛɛ, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gē da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́ɔ géē je lɛ anúɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ je lɛ anúɔ ŋ́, anúɔ géē je abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā ka ā yá ŋmá ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu kú uwā, é gē mafú keé jé ɔdā obɔ̄bí nēé cíkā ō yá mɛ́mla ɔdā olɔhi nēé cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ lɛ íne bīya, nēé le ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ́bí kóō bīya éyi kú íne kú Óndú ā, nōó jégēdē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā yɔ̄ á, eko nɛ̄ ayí Ulífāyi gā úklɔ́ ɛ̄cī Usábāti, āyā éyi ŋmá ipú ɛtá kú uwā géē bá ī gbō Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
idu_Latn: gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ē je ɔ́bíipú nāa bī ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. A kwú lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā dúú ɛɛ́. A kwú pīya ɔdā obī kwu ita kú ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm, Ufilístiya, mɛ́mla aóladóogbe kú uwɔ ɔhá nēe gē wú ɔtū uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ tá ahínyá ohígbū ka alɔ mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nōó tū oōjíliyē ŋ́, ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā alɔ gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔ́ mla ojīlīmā mla ufi.

eng_Latn: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛfu kú Usáyɔn kwu ōfōōfūnū klla tá alácɛ̄, Aógbo ōfōōfū uwā bá ī yɛ ipú alácɛ̄ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
idu_Latn: Aá nwū uwā kéē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n da aá ā. Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, n géē yɔ̄ mla aá eko dóódu jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwúcē hɛ um tá ɛpɔ̄bí, n klla géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔtū kpó ce ɔ̄cɛ, mɛ́mla ɔfú kú abɔ̄ kú nū ɛ̄pɔ̄bí dúú.

eng_Latn: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
idu_Latn: ebóo, īkpɛ̄ɛnū, opī, ɔmɔ́ɔ, mɛ́mla ɔblá.

eng_Latn: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n géē je agbénú kú Ujúda mla Ujerúsālɛm cīgbīhi lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
idu_Latn: Ogbo ábū ō lā ipú ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄, é lɔfú ŋ́ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ é kē ī gwó ɔlɛ́ uwā wu ɛplá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛdɔ ɔdōlé dúúmā í ŋmó ɔ̄ unwū ō lé ŋ́. Ɔdōlé nōo lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā nááná gē tū ɔ̄ agba.

eng_Latn: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uculo kú igbómína ā gē lɛ eko ucɛ ā, ó gē hɛ́ alagbá éyi nōo he ójīla ɔtū ā tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
idu_Latn: Aá leyí gwo íne kú Ɔwɔicō bónū, anɔ́ɔ aá gē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ nwū ā.

eng_Latn: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usiríya má ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le yálé ɛɛ́ mā, é lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gé lɛ ācɛ kú Usiríya nēe bá ogbeé kú isú kú Uyúfarētīisi ā lɛ uwá hīgwú. Ussófāki, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhadadésa, ɔcɛ́ kú Usóba kpó uwā trɛ̄yí wā á.

eng_Latn: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá aá eko nēé plla aá ajɛ kú Upéyɔ ā mɛ́mla ohígbū Ukɔ́sībi, ɔyínɔ̄nyā nēé ŋmó eko kú ōcē obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā, Ukápānɔm, é je uwɔ pīya ɔlɛ́ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aígelī nɛɛ? Ɔwɔicō géē tá uwɔ wāajɛ ga ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ.

eng_Latn: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú nū géē wɛ ɛhīlī, ɛtá ŋmá abɔ̄ éyi, ɛtá ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē ca ɔfú kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā tāajɛ, amáŋ ɔfú kú ɔ̄cɛ oyēŋēē mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā gē yɔ̄ ī nwuné tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kwú Íjīpiti ú catāajɛ, lɛ ɔ́ pīya alácɛ̄, klla kwú ācɛ nēe lā anú ā í kpó ŋmó, é géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā gē mafú ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔnū kú Áhābu ā géē yá jīla. Óndú ā le ɔdā nɛ̄ó cokónu kū nū bū okónu kú Ɛláyíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ó géē gbā ɔwɔ nōo ī gbō inu o lɛ ɔdɔ olɔfú ō tayínū kú igelī ā. Ó klla géē je oje ɔdɔ, oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ɔtángbédē mɛ́mla ɔdā agbénú ɔhá lɛ aɔ́wɔ, nɛ̄ aádáádā nū ī pā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gbēyī gbóógbó, nōó nwūla ɔwɛ gɛ ŋ́ mā, é kwú ɔyíigodó ú le ɔwɛ ā nwūla. Anɔ́ɔ é le má abɔ̄ ɔkpani uwā gekwú tá ajɛ dímm.

eng_Latn: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nēe ī yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka igwu nōo le ɔha lé tū iyē cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le ŋmó eyē nōo kwú iyīnū í ŋmó ā, Óndú ā ka anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ géē yá aá italā, nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá móōwē nɛ̄hi piíí.

eng_Latn: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi tɛtɛ le Ahínōwam nōo ŋmá Ujesirílu lɛ gbɔbū. Abígɛ̄lu klla kē kwú pīya ɔnyā nū ɔ́mpa.

eng_Latn: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Umówābu gē yá ɔbɔ́cɛ nɛ̄hi. N kē pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē gɔ̄, gē je īyī nū ka anúɔ wɛ ɔka nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je īyī uwā ce lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwó ede gā um ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya. Ó géē lɛ ɔkíkā ɛnɛ. Olīkpō kú nū géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Olɔwá kú nu géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ dúú, olicō kú nū géē wɛ eko abɔ̄ ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kē í hɛ́ um tá ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu. Ó kē í lɛ um tū ká n̄ gā ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō kú nū. Ocɛ̄tla mla owóofu kóō wɛ ákú nū eko dóódu! Aamí.

eng_Latn: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Ɛlā kú Óndú ā nāa ka ā lɔhi. Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ó kpéyī ce ka ɛbɔ́ mla ajɛ ō gbō lɔfú ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ eko kú anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá le ācɛnyā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nōo he uwá ɔtū ā, a klla kwú ɔhā kú um ú ŋmá ɛgiyí ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó kwu he ɔcɛ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ odúúdú ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ohile ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā kwú ɔdōkwɛyí kú ɔcányā ú kwu ɔ́ ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta le ɔcányā lé kwɛyí Ufássiti á.

eng_Latn: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā. Ká ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ ī lɛ abɔ̄ da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ ā kéē pó ɛ̄nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō he uwá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nōo cokónu kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ ācɛ nēe ī je odée lɛ uwá amáŋ é gē tū ācɛ nēé ī je ɔdā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā ufi ka é géē wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛtiyópiya éyi nēé hī ka Usɛ́ra ā mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū úlá igbíngbídi mɛ́mla úgbɔ́nya kú ɛfú ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le pɛ́ wā gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ujúda. É yɛ jāā wā Umárēssa.

eng_Latn: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbā ā, Óndú, méyīnyinyi um. Ká ā tá um abɔ̄, Óndú.

eng_Latn: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē kú éeyē, aá tɔ́ɔga lɛ Óndú, odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
idu_Latn: N géē klá ɛyí ɛfu kú umáari mɛ́mla ɛyí kú ufránkīnsɛnsi, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā nɛ̄ obū le kwu.

eng_Latn: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í klla gáā kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyī uwɔ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Lɛ oyēeyī kú alɔ tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ gbō kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Ánnāsi kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ Ukayáfāsi nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
idu_Latn: nēé lɛ eyī gwō íne kú um bónū, nēé lɛ ɔ́ tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́. Kwú ɔfulā mla ahilíki ogbō ɛyí kú uwɔ í plá bá ajɛ. Ɔdā dúúmā í klla gáā lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lɛ ā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É géē je aógbɛhá ce ɔcɛ́ klla í mīyɛ ācɛ nēe cɔcɛ́ ā ɔfú.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofahātá ce ahāanɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā, aá géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ̄mahātá ā, aá géē jīla tɔ̄há kpɔ́ kú aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá je ɔdā kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé gā um. Ó géē wɛ ɛ̄cī kú ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ aá í gbā um, aá gáā yúklɔ́ ɛdɔ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
idu_Latn: Ka lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ipú ígbíli kú Ukɛ́da ā, kéē gwéeye kéē gwíje, kéē tɔ́ɔga ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka eko otɛtɛ ā, ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, anúɔ í lé ɔdōlé ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū odúúdú íne nēé bīya, ōŋmá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ipéyī Óndú ā, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū ā.

eng_Latn: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ gaá da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ohígbū ami mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēe ī nwū ācɛ ipú ɔkpá nyā ā. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū tū alɔ ohígbū ka aádáádā alɔ í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē yá ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā ka ālɔ yá piíí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú aá géē má ɔcɛ́ kú aá mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī gbō ajɛ nōo tá kpátáā nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
idu_Latn: Aá kóō yɔ̄ ī yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛgɔhá yɔ̄ gē yúuya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋ́, aá nyɔ̄ í gwōtū ipú ɛlā kú ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́, aá kóō kpó abɔ̄ wu agada icííci ŋ́ amáŋ aá yúklɔ́ ka aá má lé. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tɛtɛ nwū aá á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá tū ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aɔ́da nyā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū he uwá nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é lé klla gwá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā á. É klla kwú Usólōmɔn ú cɔcɛ́ igbɔɔ́mpa kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā gā awɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. N le ɛya gwó gā awɔ, anɔ́ɔ n kē yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ohi kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔbá ámāŋ ka ɔnyā nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā ka anúɔ í nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, jɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó le lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, kwu ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā lɛ ɛga ō miya ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ɔwɔicō hī alɔ igwú kú alɔ bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyílɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka n gā ipú aá gē ka ucē nɛ̄ aá pó ŋ́, ile nyá nɛ̄ n tū lɛ aá ā. Ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka n bī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú gā um ā gé lɛ aá ámāŋ ka n bī ɔdā nɛ̄ n jé ā wā, ámāŋ ɛlā ɔkwɛ́yi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n wā í nwū.

eng_Latn: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɛlā kú um pó, nōó klla yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā ŋ́, ń gáā hɛ́pɔ̄ kú nū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ń wā gaá hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́, amáŋ n wā ká n̄ gáā nya ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ tá.

eng_Latn: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
idu_Latn: Unwalu kē le fíyɛ́ um ɔfú, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ n gbɛlá nɛ̄hi kwu ɔ́ gaá kwu, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó gē je unwalu gā um ɔtū lɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ ā wā í lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ujeremíya. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ uwá ā da uwá á. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nēé yá glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúmā kú uwá í pó ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
idu_Latn: É géē je īlī ōgbō ɛ́nyɔ́ nēé bī ɔdā ékpónú nēé le tá ɛ́fɔ̄du ā kwu ɛ́fɔ̄du, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya éékpó mla anú.

eng_Latn: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá í je ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ ā, é le odúúdú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nōo ŋmá ɛga dóódu nēé lā ā, hīgwú wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwéeyē klla gwíijē ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá. É bā ī gwó oké mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū tū ijē kú uwā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cɛ̄ kóō lɛ ā abālɔbányā ā, ohígbū koó cɛgbá ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā yá jīla. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū aɔ́wá kú icɔ́ɔci nōo gē jīla ɔlɛ́ uwā ā. Aá hokónu tū Epayɛ́nɛ̄tɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ o he um ɔtū, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo ŋmá ajɛ kú Ésīya nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Ukéni ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a ī cɔ̄nū, nɛ̄ eyī kú uwɔ i kplá gɔɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda kahíníī, Óndú, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū kú o tábɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujúda bá ī je ā. Lɛ uwá pīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma ohile ā. Nuunu lɛ uwá, Óndú ā, ka aá tá uwā abɔ̄ kéē lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
idu_Latn: Ussálum, ɔyí kú Ukóhōse otrɛ̄yí kú āyā kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Umísipa, le ɔwɛ kú obugā ā ma. Ó le Odūngwɔ̄wɛ gbā, klla le aóje o bī le gwū ɔwɛ yá kwu ɔ́. Ó klla lɛ ɔdɔ kú āyā kú Unjɔlɔ kú Uséla ā gwó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā gaá kwu ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́. Ó klla le ɔdɔ ā túgwó jāā gaá kwu agidigbé nōo yɛ gaajɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá pó ofūūnū ā wɛ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá alɔ ŋmó eko éyi ā, abālɔbányā ó gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ í lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ āa ɛɛ́, otɛɛtɛ ā ó tíne ō lɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gaajɛ ā, ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā nū ga igelī mɛ́mla aɛ́hɔ̄ nēe bá amānyā biílí ā, kéē í lɛ ɔdōlé dɔɔ̄kā má ī lé cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛga ogbɔga dɔɔ̄kā dúú, ohígbū ka amānyā wɛ ɛga nōo le fíyóó.

eng_Latn: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó gē yɛce íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla ádā nū Udéfīdi le táajɛ ā, ó le úklɔ́ kɔ̄ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe gē tá ācogwɛ́ɛya abɔ̄ ā. Ipú ijē ōgwó mla úklɔ́ ɔhá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla lɛ ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kɔ̄ ígwíígwu kú úklɔ́ kú uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā da ɔ́ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n má ka ó yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo cíkā kéē ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ka anúɔ kē í yá apíili ga ɛgiyí Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔ́ ŋmótū kú um lɛ ɔ́ tū nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ má ka ācɛ Usiríya ā ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yá anúɔ lé nɛ, ɔ́ɔ wā í tá anúɔ abɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ kē má ka ācɛ Ámɔn ā gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄ lé nɛ, anúɔ géē wā í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká e géē ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, uwá géē je aílī nēé le wiiyē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó plá bá ipú aínu kú um ā. Uwá í kpó úwé ɔhá wiiyē cɛ́ɛ́ ka īlī otīihɔ kú uwá ā kóō kpó ɛbí tū ācɛ ā, eko nēé géē ga ipú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je aɔ́cí ufáyin kú nū mla aɔ́cí ufígi kú nū, nɛ̄ ó ka ka aɔ́ya anúɔ ɔ́ɔ je cíla anúɔ ulé ā yíífi. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē je ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū ā pīya ígbíli nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí géē kpó uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ má cīce ɛga nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē cīce lɛ igbīhi pī ɔdɔ ā. Ujonátan cīce lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɔ́, Ábna cīce áklō éyi kú nū, anɔ́ɔ áklō ɔhá nōo wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gē cīce ā má tá áncā.

eng_Latn: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um gē gbɛlá ka n lɔfú lɛ ɔdā dóódu yá ká n̄ lɛ ɛyí bū kwu iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti.

eng_Latn: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
idu_Latn: Agōdō dóódu nōó gwutá, ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu nōó cīce anú eko ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Obadíya yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ā, ó lɛ Ɛláyíja má ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ jé á. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbo kláajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ nɛɛ, Óndú um Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kéē híī yá eko nɛ̄ owu gē bū afɔ́nɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ ka, Ó ŋmá abɔ̄ alɛɛcɛ, alɔ gē yúúfi ācɛ ā ohígbū ka odúúdú uwā cɛ̄ ka Ujɔ́ni ɔ́ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā nāa ka lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, tú kwajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le pīya ɔkwɛyi ícɛ.

eng_Latn: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū í yɔ̄ piyóó bɛ̄ɛka ɔyā ā, nōo wɛ ijáalí okpaakpa kú ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā je ɔtōōce lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi á. Ó kē ī je ɔfú ō bī le hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
idu_Latn: Ó géē mā ɔdōbɔbī ō yá tá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdā olɔhi. Ó í cēyītīkwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kóō yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa nū.

eng_Latn: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ Ulémūwɛ̄lu, aɔ́cɛ́ í gē gwá ejé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yá unwū ejé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō ī gwá ejé olɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē híī gbaājā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí ā, nɛ̄ Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um í cíkā ō gwéeyē eko nɛ̄ n má gwōnū ŋ́. N má gwōnū ɛɛ́, n kē í cāŋjɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. N yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ odobū abālɔbányā, amáŋ Óndú géē wɛ ɔlá ōfíyajɛ gā um á.

eng_Latn: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ aɔ́yī kú nū tá cē um ɛɛ́. Ɛ́fa kú nū ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ tū odúúdú iyē kú um. Ɔwɔicō le ɔdōtūufi kú nū hɔ́ɔgba lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔyí ijakī má le ce, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nāa gē je ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ tíne ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ajaajɛ, ɛ̄cī éyi ó géē mīyɛ odúúdú agbénú kú uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: kóō wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú, géē pɛ́ nyɔ̄, í tá Óndú ahínyá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je íne lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Habɔ̄ tá cíí, ɔkpani, iháyí ékpónú ōfōōfūnū. N géē bu ɔgɔ̄ tá ɔkwu nū cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ajɛ ɛyétutulu kpó tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu biílí.

eng_Latn: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gā ajɛ ipú ojuja kú ɔlá gaá háyi okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó hī Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umíriyam igwú wā iyɔ̄bū nū. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa ā gā iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá uwā oócí, eko nēé gā ɛgiyí ɔpɛ́ kú Usísi. Aá géē jīla mla uwá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɔpɛ́ nōo yɛ ígbíli nōo kwu Ujɛrúwɛ̄lu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū í he uwá mɛ́mla anú gɛ ŋ́ má. Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ lɛ ojīlīmā ɛga ɔhá, amáŋ ācɛ kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū í jé ojīlīmā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá abɔ́ɔ āa, ācɛ opeyī ɛpa yɛce ɔ́, gē dɛ̄gba hī ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ményinyi alɔ, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
idu_Latn: É klla nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Urítma.

eng_Latn: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
idu_Latn: N géē je oyēeyī kú um kwɛyí nū cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā bī kwɛyí nū. Kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī unwalu kú nū í ce um ɛyí, ɔ́dāŋ ka ń je ɔ́ cīgbīhi gé lɛ uwɔ oyēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
idu_Latn: A le ácí ŋmó tū ɔ̄ kóō jɛ̄, ó tá ɛgba lipú ga ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā, klla tá ābɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, Uhɛsɛkíya le odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ é le tá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē gbō ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin ā abɔ̄yī um eko dóódu á. N klla í kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄yī um eko dóódu. N géē gbō ɔ̄ɔ̄ kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ bīya ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́lɔn leyīkwu ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɛ́būlɔn á.

eng_Latn: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Eko nāa le pīya ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú ɛcɛ nyā, alɔ tíne ká ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ cīce gboce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú alɔ cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā cīce abɔ̄lúfīyē.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jíla igbō ā mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede ɛpa ā iyē lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɔdā otīihɔ kú Óndú ā lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Da ayínɛ́ uwɔ̄ kéē lɛ iyó kú uwā gbō ce aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū ā le kpaakpa ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gwéeyē. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū ā le yēŋēē ó gēe nwūla ɔ̄cɛ eyī péee kóō jé odée.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ géē jē awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā ānāānā. Iyó ā le gbɛnú ce uwɔ bá. Á gáā yá ɔ̄ ōfōōfū uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
idu_Latn: Umáhli, Umússi mɛ́mla Ujaásīya wɛ ayí kú Umérári.

eng_Latn: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anú nōo yá ɔkpánco mla ɛcɛ ā. Ó lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ojéeyī mla o jɔ́ɔ́dā mɛ́mla o tōhílīpú je lɛ Udéfīdi, nōo kē yɔ̄ ī tútū kóō le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ Óndú ā, mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú abɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, a le alɔ bī wā ajɛ nɛ̄ ó lɔhi gbo alɔ iyē nɛɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōlé í yɔ̄ ŋ́. Á klla je ajɛ kú úgwū mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin lɛ alɔ ŋ́. A kē gbɔɔ́ ō plla alɔ ɛɛ ɛ́ alɔ í wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tóohi kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā, óndú um, ɔcɛ́ Ubenhádādi, kwu ami mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n lɛ ā wɛ ákú uwɔ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū háyi pī ɔ̄ gē céyītīkwū ī kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ. Amáŋ Udéfīdi tá. Ó klla cɛ̄ lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā ā ɔ́ɔ nyīla uwá nwuné nwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ ā, ɛga úlúúlā ɔhá. Ká ɔ́ɔ hɔ́ɔhā ce uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ uwá ka anúɔ ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá uwā ohi kahínīī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá abɔ̄yī aá gē bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō ohígbū uculo kú aá ā mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú tīyē cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bá ɛbɔ́ mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ. Aá klla lɔfú tīye ká aá lā oyēeyī ōtīihɔ, ɔ̄cɛ nōó lā lɛ ā ŋ́ í gáā má Óndú alɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
idu_Latn: Aá kē lɛ ɔnya nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu géē ce ā tútū kú aá lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ɛ́bɔ́ gé lɛ Ufélīsi igbómína ā.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Le tútū ká ā móōwē dúú bɛ̄ɛka ícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
idu_Latn: Oyújulu nōo kwáhi nɛ̄hi ā, gbɛlá ka anúɔ jééyī nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ācɛ ahāapa nōo gē tóohi ɛlā kpaakpa glá ā á.

eng_Latn: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ icííci ī cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kéē je ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa pīya ɔdā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu. Ācɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā gē cē ɔdōbɔ̄bí mlɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē je ɔdōlé mlɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujɛ́sēbɛlu ka aá ɔ́ɔ le Unábɔ̄tu ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, lɛ abɔ̄ bī íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé kú uwɔ ká, ā cɛ̄ kóō hɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄ kwu ga ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō nɛ̄ ācɛ Umówābu bī ā, n géē yá uwā italā piíí. Ń gáā pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka é lɛ ojīlīmā ce okwū kú ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú fu ŋmá únóji, klla kwú ikpokwú kú nū ú yɔlá gbewo putuu á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le pɛ́ wā ɛcɛ ŋmá Ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, odúúdú uwā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le iyē kpó gwu, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e wɛ ígwu éyi amáŋ ka ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da uwá kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā gaá ce uwá ɛyí bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ce alɔ ɛyí eko aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ kú okpé nōo yɔ̄ ī wu fíyēē ɔkpáncō lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā le jí ɛɛ́. É le jí ɛɛ́! É le jí ɛɛ́, eko nɛ̄ aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛtá ɔhá ā le opo kú uwā tá.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔcɛ́ ā, kwú ɔkpá nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka lɛ Ubárukú nōó tá ā ú yɔɔlá ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ujeremíya. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
idu_Latn: Usɛkaríya da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ɔka kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n géē jé ka ɛlā nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi āa? Ohígbū ka n le gbo okplícī ɛɛ́, ɔnyā um kē le hīlókplícī dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ɔyí um, jé Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ gē gbā ā, ká ā gbā ɔ ɛ̄gbā mla ɔtū ékpónú. Ó jé odúúdú ɛlá nɛ̄ a ī gbo ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne ō yá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le tá ɛgiyí nū, ó géē mīyɛ awɔ. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwú pīyeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, ó géē cīgbīhi kwu uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
idu_Latn: Kwú uwā ú kpó wu aéliká neē yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ éyééye kú ede ā eko nēé ī je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka aɔ́gɔ̄ bá nēé ī bū oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ŋmá uwá. Ɛga nēé kē ī ja ugóolu klla ī na ɔ̄ péee ā yɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, A cɛ̄ ohígbū ka, n da wɔ ka, N má uwɔ útū ɔcí ufígi ā kɛ̄ɛ? A géē má ɔdā nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe má ɔ̄ ā kɛlā nyā ohígbū ka é gē yúufi aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ujíyu. Ohígbū kéē tɛtɛ le ka ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ cɛ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, é géē nū ɔ̄ ŋmá ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ohī bá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá, nēé cɛ̄ ŋ́. Ujísɔ̄si jé ācɛ nēé cɛ̄ ŋ́ mā mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē je ɔ́ lá ā ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlá ka ígbɔhá ŋmá ipú ofúlutu lɛ Ujóbu á. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ í gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ká n̄ lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um. Ó géē wɛ ɛga otīihɔ nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē bá gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, o ŋmá lɛ ɔtulalī o kpócu nɛ̄hi o je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́. Ó klla í wɛ ɛga nēé géē yɔ̄ ī je igbō ōtīihɔ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā piyóó, mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ géē gwɛ́ɛya kú aɔ́dā ō je yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, ɛ̄cī Usábāti mɛ́mla ucɛ kú Ɔyā Ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́cī ō tīihɔ ohile wɛ dúú. Óndú ā kē le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē yá lɛ ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ oje igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ le yá ā, obū le du ajɛ ɛga dóódu jāā gbó ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē cīgbīhi gā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, kwú aódōwīyē kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú nū nōó kpó wiyē ɛɛ́ kóō bēhé ga ipú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ú plla ŋmá iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó mā ɔ̄ tá bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda kē í ka, ka; Alɔ tɛtɛ pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Umówābu wɛ ācɛ ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ lɛ a, Alɔ jé kéē gē gɔ̄, klá ī gwō mla ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ, i je īyī wā ga icō, amáŋ oōgwō kú uwá dóódu a wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
idu_Latn: Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni leyī hɛ́ kwu ɔ́ klīklī, anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Pīyeyī má alɔ.

eng_Latn: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó nɛ̄ alɔ le pó ā, ɔtū kú alɔ kwu gbenyi, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú alɔ í klla lɛ ɔtū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá wɛ Óndú kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gē kpó aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā tá wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, eko ɔ́ɔmā, é géē jé ka ɛlā kú um ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli ā wɛ, aótrɛ̄yí úlā ɛpa cofigwó mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā, úlā ofɛnɛ cigwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó nēe bī ɔkplɛ́fu mɛ́mla óbō.

eng_Latn: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
idu_Latn: nōo kē wɛ iháyí ɔ́mahāanɛ nɛ̄ Uhósīī cɔcɛ́ ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya gaá miyɛ Usamérīya á. Ó kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú kpó ŋmá Usamérīya dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó ga ajɛ kú Asírīya. Ó kwú aóhī ú kpó lā Uhála ɛga nōo kwu ísu kú Uhábɔ ipú ajɛ kú Ugósan á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kpó ācɛ ohile kú uwā lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Umédesi.

eng_Latn: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi ā, n gē má uwā, n yɔ̄ ī má uwā ŋmá ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, É wɛ ewo nōo lā ōfōōfū uwā. É jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ hɔ́hā ce aá fíyɛ́ aéwo ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
idu_Latn: Ā géē da uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā ka, Aaádáádā aá kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí um, nyɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, klla gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. É lɛ igbīhi ce kwu um, é kllá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
idu_Latn: Ede kú ugóolu ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé pla oje udɔ wúlá wúlá tū ipú nū ā, ogbló mɛ́mla aíyó kú nū, ɔgbanjɛ o bī lɛ na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛga ō háyi kú nū.

eng_Latn: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tū ahɔ̄lá mɛ́mla ōwō nōo yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄lá ā wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ klá ācobɔ̄bíipū ā. Owu okwɔ́lá nēé gáā bī le yá uwā italā á.

eng_Latn: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ɔyí um, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā kóō yɔ̄ pī uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú gwó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
idu_Latn: Úgbéenyi gē yɛ eyī nū. Ulɛbíyātan, ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bī nɛ̄hi nāa yá kóō bēē hiijā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā lā ipú nū dúú.

eng_Latn: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi nyɔ̄ í tayínū ipácí á. Eko nɛ̄ ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gā ā, ɔcɛ́ má cīce kóō lé ucɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ owu kú ofúlɔcī gbɔɔ́ ō tá, nɛ̄ otū gbɔɔ́ ō bī, kwúcē, ohumɔtū. Pīyɛyí wā fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū ō kwinya ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ulúu nōo yɔ̄ ī kwinya ɛyí ɛfu okplókō kplokō ā.

eng_Latn: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
idu_Latn: Aá je eyī gicō kú aá leyī yaajɛ bilíbilí kú aá má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá gbɔɔ́ ō tūbá, kéē wā ɔlɛ́ ɛgiyí aá ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī á, a géē bī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá gwō klla í yɔ̄ ī yéeyī ūwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā nōo gáā lɛ ɔbá gē yéeyī aódūgbɔ nōó le yá ifa ā.

eng_Latn: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam, í lɔfú nōo gē yá ɔdā dúú tá Ábīja eko nɛ̄ ó yéeyī ā glá ŋ́. Igbīhāajɛ ā Óndú ā le abɔ̄ gɔ́ ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā cíkā ō yá ācɛ Ujúda italā ohígbū ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā piíí. N klla í gwō ɛdɔ ewo nyā ɔcí lɛ īyī um piíí.

eng_Latn: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
idu_Latn: É jahɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū ka eko ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēe gla ā, ó bī imabɔ̄ kú nū gē le yúklɔ́ idáagó.

eng_Latn: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí usɛ́da ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄ nōo cɛyí ákanaba igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nēe kwu ɔgba ɛtá ā nēé bī le gba inu aā.

eng_Latn: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ufílīpu le tá ajɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya ā, ó le ɔna kú Ɔkōolɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
idu_Latn: Alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ í lɛ ɔdā dúú ipú alɔ nōo je íkwu lɛ alɔ kú alɔ gbɛlá ka alɔ lɔfú yúklɔ́ nyā glá ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō je ɔfú lɛ alɔ ka alɔ le yúklɔ́ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gē cē īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, Urúbɛn le tá ɛhɔ̄ gaá le ɔcí nēé hī ka umándrēki pīyɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le bī gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, Ulɛ́ya á. Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu da Ulɛ́ya kahíníī, Kóocō, lɛ umándrēk ōhī kú ɔyí uwɔ je gā um káá.

eng_Latn: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi lɛ ā, ācɛ nēé jōōjīla ŋ́ mā nēé gē fu kéē je pīya aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya á, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nōo le yá jōōjīla piyóó ā fu ŋmá le ɛka nɛ̄ ó gbo igbīhāajɛ kú íne nōó je lɛ Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́ mā, lɔfú je odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi tá ipú unwalu glá. Amáŋ ācɛ ojéeyī ā, gē tá unwalu mla ákanya gɛcɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire unto her, that thou wouldest have her to thy wife;
