idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú má ɔ̄cɛnyā ōhéyīfuú nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tínē ō lɛ.

eng_Latn: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya kwú odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé tɛtɛ mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, o ŋmá Ékrɔn jāā ga Ugáti ā, ú kpó cīgbīhi lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́ má yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ámɔn eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Obóti á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu pīyɛyí ŋmá o nū ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā ínya, anɔ́ɔ é gaá le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Ufilístiya wúla tāajɛ, klla kwu iyó kú uwā kpó wu.

eng_Latn: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā gaá le da ayíkpó kú nū mla Upíta ka, ó yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ Ugálili gbēyī uwā. Aá géē má ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ da aá gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ nēé ŋmó ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le inya kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí únóji ā, bá í fīyégbúlú nɛ̄hi, ɔtū kú uwā le kpó wogodo. É kōō ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ufi yá uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usátu ā wɛ, Ɛliyonáyi, Ɛlíyāssibu, Umɛtánīya, Ujérēmɔti, Usábādi mɛ́mla Asísa.

eng_Latn: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Bethezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ussáfi, aá ga ajɛ ɔfiyɛ, tóohɛ́ɛwa mla uwēyī. Ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Isáanan ā í jámá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī ā glá ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ aá pó abɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ubɛtɛ́sɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī jikwū ā, aá géē jé ka ɛga nāa ī kwu tayínū í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
idu_Latn: N le ikwū je klá anú kóō tá um abɔ̄, n gwíijē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le tá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú Unábɔ̄tu ā bōōbū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
idu_Latn: Gbɔ̄ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ a ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kóō ma ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ géē yɛ ā fu lɛ alɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ alɔ cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē tū odúúdú aɔ́nya ɛfú kú uwā ā ufi, ka anúɔ klla í yá ká ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnya kú uwā ā kéē le kpó jɛɛ́lɛ́. Ó ka anúɔ géē gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda, amáŋ anúɔ géē kpó aɔ́nya kú aólɛlā kú uwā ā eyī pu.

eng_Latn: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko géē wā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, mla ayááyí kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ kú uwā. É géē yúufi Óndú ā klla í mīyɛ ɛhi olɔhi kú nū igbīhi ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdí wɛ ohi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ā? N lɛ ācɛ ulá igwáahāapa nēé lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ lɛ Ubáalu jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā tū lɛ iyī um.

eng_Latn: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
idu_Latn: Udóyēgu háyi abɔ́ɔ mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Usɔ́lu. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ má Udéfīdi eko nɛ̄ ó ga ɛgiyí Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔyí kú Ahítūbu ipú ajɛ kú Unɔ́bu ā.

eng_Latn: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ acígilí, Ábsālɔm gaá jīla mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi ōhī. Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ ī ce ɔnya kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í kwu bū ɔkwu ɔcí éyi, nēé hī ka ɔcí kú óoku, ipú ūpū ā, īnyīlɛyí kú nū gaá kwú jíla tū ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ā icō. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnya kú nū ā le inya kwu ī yɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm le jī playi icō ɔcí abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā híla ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ícɛ klla kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
idu_Latn: Ɛgwā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́, aá í gáā kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
idu_Latn: Uwá gee leyīkwu cɔɔɔ áncā lɛ a, é gēe kpó ayí obene ca klá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ piɛɛlɛ. É gēe je iyó kú uwá kpó wu ŋ́má inu, klá í ba i hɛ́ anyā uwá bá ajɛ, i ce ikpó uwá abɔ̄ ɔfú ipúeyī uwā; é ke gāa yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi aá jé ka aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ipú nū ā. Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō lā ipú aá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ka.

eng_Latn: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ó gē wú Ondú ɔtū. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó gē gwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā ŋmá ɔtū obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā géē je dobū, ɛnɔ í kē gáā cɛ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ofíyajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Óndú ā géē cɔcɛ́. Ó géē gbāajɛ ɛyí ɛfú kú usáyɔn, Ujerúsālɛm. Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā géē má ofíyajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nōo le kpaakpa ā, kéē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Aá blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo tīihɔ ā yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tá ɔ̄ ahínyá.

eng_Latn: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē wɔ́tū ɔdā ɛhīlī, ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ ɔdēelihɔ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni: Asárɛlu, ɔyí kú Ujérōham.

eng_Latn: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ācɛ kú aéwo kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kéē lɛ ācɛ Umówābu yálé mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔn tɔ̄há. Cɛ́ɛ́ Umówābu í klla gáā wɛ éwo gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá bá ɔpɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nōo lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɔlɛ́ nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tipéwɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í lɔtū, ó géē yɛ í he alɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ká alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ alɔ ipú ɔkpíyē cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ gaá lā mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Árɔ̄ni, Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu, kwú ocíbú ō fɔ́lá kú uwā ú, lɛ ɔlá fú tū ɔ̄, le ɔtulalī umuumu fú tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú lɛ Óndú ā. Amáŋ ɔlá nyā í tīihɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā í da uwá kéē bī ɔlá ɔ́ɔmā wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, É lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, É géē hī inu kú um ka ɛga ogbɔ̄ɔkɔ. Amáŋ aá lɛ ɔ́ yá ɛga otayínū kú ācohɛ́julúgwu.

eng_Latn: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta lɛ íhó hɛ́ kpɔ́. Eko lígíí le gla, ācɛ nēe māháyi abɔ́ɔ ā klla lɛ ɛlā kpóce Upíta kpɔ́ kahíníī, Á híhó ka anúɔ í wɛ éyi kú uwā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka a ŋmá Ugálili dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔdā nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ ka ā gaá le yá le pɛ́ le yɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo gáā yá nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ aá gbɔ̄bū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē yá ɛcɔ̄bū á.

eng_Latn: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í je Ɛláyíssa īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́ ícɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ka otú kɔ́ɔ̄ bī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó cīce pī Ujísɔ̄si ajaajɛ ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó yɛ gaá bū Usiríya mɛ́mla Usilísīya gē lɛ ɔfú tū ācɛ icɔ́ɔci nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā iyē.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
idu_Latn: Ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ, wā gaá tíne, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe bí ā nyatá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je igbāmkpa kú aá, ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu kú aá gwɛ́ɛya gā um. Aá géē je ayí aflɛ́yí kú aá gā um.

eng_Latn: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wɛɛlɛ kéē nyɔ̄ ga abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ajɛ ā jila lɔɔlɔhi ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
idu_Latn: Aá tɔ́ɔga kú aá gwéeyē kú aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā yɔ̄ gē yá lɛ ā, iháyí dóódu. Eko dúúmā nēé ga inu kú Óndú ā, gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā nɛɛ, Upɛnína gē yá Uhána cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ Uhána gē jikwū í gē lé ɔdōlé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí ācɛ ohile kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā, anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmó, kwú ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, kwu ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú uwā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā tɔ̄lá á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da aípɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā kéē lɛwa ɔkwɛ̄yi, é kē lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Kéē géē lɛ ajɛ fíyɛ́ ɛga éyi.

eng_Latn: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unéko lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujosíya kahíníī, Ɛfú nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í kpó ā, í wɛ ɛlā uwɔ, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā ŋ́. Ń wā gaá kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ n gáā kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú um. Óndú ā ka ami ɔ́ɔ kpɛ́fú ā fíyaa. Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla um ipú ɛfú nyā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú um oo n, ámāŋ Óndú ā géē je uwɔ yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛyí ɔ́ɔmā gā ā, ó géē leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋmá lɛ ɔfú nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā, mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Óndú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū géē lā ɛbɔ́ ohígbū ka aéwo dóódu géē jé ka ó lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, n géē mēnyinyi aá, í cɛ̄ lɛ aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ayááyí Ujékɔ̄pu ā, cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ aá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ujerúsālɛm nōo tá alácɛ̄ nyā, aá géē tá ɔ̄ gwó igbɔhá klla í gwó agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɛ̄gbā, ɔwɛ kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ gē yá aɔ́dā ɛbí alɛwa nōó he Óndú ā ɔtū ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kōō ī kpó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ipú ɔlá lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ó wɛ ikpó kú um ōfōōfūnū nāa géē na ā ŋ́, amáŋ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛyí kú um dúú.

eng_Latn: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
idu_Latn: Óndú, n gē wɔ́tū ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū uwɔ ā. Ācɛ nēe gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá uwɔ ā, n gē leyī gwō uwā bónū.

eng_Latn: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahímāasi, ɔyí kú Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya da Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ inya kwu nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā kā ɔcɛ́, ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā, kéē kahíníī, Ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ uwá ā yúklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú aɔ́dā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í yá ā kóō le lɔhi lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā opiyóó ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa kú aá bá gē doōcē klla kē le yá gbɛnɛkɛɛ ā. Ācɛ alɛwa kē le pɛ́ kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
idu_Latn: anúɔ wɛ Óndú ā á, anúɔ í gē cɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́, anúɔ klla le mu mla ihɔtū o yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā, anúɔ gē méyīnyinyi, klla ī je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā mɛ́mla ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄ ācɛ yá ā yɛ́ɛhi. Amáŋ anúɔ géē yá ācɛ o lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā italā piíí. Ó ka anúɔ géē yá ayááyí italā kú íne nɛ̄ ádā uwā bīya ā, o ŋmá ayááyí éyi ga ayááyí ɔ́mpa, ɔ́mɛɛtá, jāā ga ɔ́mɛɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ká n̄ lɛ acá bū bɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú wu ŋmá amānyā nyɔ̄ í mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛga éyi.

eng_Latn: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ nēe gē móowē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya lɛ uwá ā, kéē kwú iyī uwā ú tū Ɔwɔicō nōó gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́ mā abɔ̄ dúúdú mla ucē olɔhi ō yá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ eyī kú um le cēnyi mla agīje ā yɔ̄ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī tá um ɔtū lé glá ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔfú tá um ɔtū kwu ɔtū glá ŋ́. Olɛlā ā, lɛ um yálé ɛɛ́, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um í klla lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōo hile tá ajɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
idu_Latn: E ba i tútū kéē yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn omáaba. Alelékwū kú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ lɔfú ipú ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi a ba ī tútū ooya ɔɔ omaaba dúu. Aálelékwū a ba ī cāŋjɛ ŋmá akpa ɔcɛ́ kú uwá!.

eng_Latn: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ nōo bu ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā géē gbā ije kú ɛna ā lɛ óndú kú ɛbɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī okwu kú ɛbɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu kú ācɛ Ujíyu gē yúklɔ́ kú nū ɛ̄cī dóódu, anɔ́ɔ ó ge gwó ɛdɔ ɛya ékpónú ā ɛ̄cī dóódu igbɛ alɛwa, amáŋ ɛya ōgwó nēe bá nyā í kpó íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā bónū gbóógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aólɛlā le íbɔm cē tū aá ɛɛ́. Aá lɛ iyó ká aá kpó túbá.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ohi kpó gē lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Eko éyi, ácí ujē kú Ulébānɔn le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcí Usɛ́da kú Ulébānɔn ā kahíníī, Kwú ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ú lɛ ɔyí um kóō le lɛ ɔnyā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ́ kú ipácí gaá le yɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ácí ujē nyā ú ca tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī da aá abālɔbányā ɔdā nōo gáā yá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē cɛ̄ ka, Ami wɛ Anū nōo húmáyī yɔ̄ ā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé dúú ka aɔ́cɛ́ kú Asírīya le aéwɔhá alɛwa kpó yíífi, klla kwú aájɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā í ta alácɛ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́wɔ kú odúúdú aéwɔhá wɛ aójibó kú aɛ́cí nɛ, amáŋ Óndú ā yá ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
idu_Latn: ó géē cē oji nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ Óndú ā piíí, ayíka ɔbá nū ā tá, eko nɛ̄ ó pó oji nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ ojéeyī kú īkée ka ā kéē nwū uwɔ ɛlā. Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé lɛ ō ka ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le odúúdú ɔdōlé dóódu kú iháyí ahāapa ɔ́ɔmā ā, kpō tū ipú inu ipú aígelī. Ipú igelī dóódu ó le ɔdōlé nōo yɔ̄ ā kpó tū ipú inu ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ nōo yɛ abɔ́ɔ jīlatá biílí ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
idu_Latn: Utáyi mɛ́mla Usákɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubígifāyi mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛtá ce igwó.

eng_Latn: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
idu_Latn: O kwú ɛlā tū ɛmɛɛma mla ogbēyīcíí, géē lɔfú kwú ánya kú ɔcɛ́ tū glá. Ó klla ī wī ɛlā nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā yɛwuu.

eng_Latn: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the LORD: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
idu_Latn: Otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ā, cāŋjɛ igbo alɛwa cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā jikwū klá Ɔwɔicō. Lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ piya klá ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kéē ményinyi kú ayí uwɔ. Ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī kpó ūwā ŋmó bónū, ipú ɔ́kíka dóódu kú úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
idu_Latn: Olīkpō kú igá ā géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛpa ce ɛnɛ, olɔwá kú nū ā géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofu ce ɛpa, olicō kú nū ā géē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛpa ce āyā, é géē yá īlī ukɔ́tin ā mla īlī ulínin olɔhi nɛ̄hi. É géē bī uwɔ mɛ́mla ogbló kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā lɛ flla ukɔ́tin ā playi icō.

eng_Latn: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
idu_Latn: N tíne ká n̄ kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú aá nēe bīyíne eko nóō yɛ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile. N kɛlā nyā ɛpléeko nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí aá igbo ɔ́mpa ā. N klla kē í ka ɔ́ igbo ɔ́mpa kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ abɔ̄ ń yɔ̄ mla aá abālɔbányā ŋ́ mā. Eko ɔhá nɛ n géē wā ā, n géē yá odúúdú ācɛ nēe bīyíne ā italā.

eng_Latn: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi nēé ŋmó ɔnyā nū ā, tá uwā ohi ka anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔnyā anúɔ nyɔ̄ ga ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn gáā gbo.

eng_Latn: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aóklóbīya, nōo hīgwú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, lɛ ákanaba ɛpa bū tū kú ā lɛ ogbló pīya cíla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká olikpō kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ká ā le da ɔcɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú Umɔ́dɛkāyi ú tōōlī playi anú ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī óócí. Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɔfú ga ɔnū ucɛ ā mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́. Uháman má ka ɛlā nē é nwū anúɔ nyā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ákanaba ɛpa ā bū kwaajɛ le ogbló pīya cíla anú ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le hɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígbáanɔ ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ukpa kú ofītɛ́ ā. Ukpa ā le tá, alɔ kē le kwu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda le óbō mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Udéfīdi nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ā gē pó ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō. Ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ aá pó ɛlā nēe bá ā ŋ́ mā, wɛ ka aá í wɛ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ahɔ̄ gwō ɛlā nēé ka ā bónū, amáŋ ó da Ujáríyɔ̄si kahíníī, A híī yúufi ŋ́, cɛ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō kénékēē.

eng_Latn: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ijēnyi gē ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēé bá ī tíne ɔdōgwá, amáŋ nēé má ɔdā dúúmā gwá ŋ́, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwá. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā í gáā cīgbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔbá nū ā lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla kóō gaá nyɔ̄ ā, ó má odiyɔ̄ kú nū ā gwutá okómpíinu lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ lɛ abɔ̄ nāŋdaa klá ajɛ gaá kwu ɔwɛ kú inu ā.

eng_Latn: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
idu_Latn: É klla bá ī lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ é bá ī nyɔ̄ ā, é géē má Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, Ɔwɔicō kú aɔ́wɔ ɔhá Usáyɔn abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ ɔ́ɔ le ka lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um, n géē pīyeyī tá aá.

eng_Latn: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ cíkā ō cɛ̄tra uwɔ klla wóofu uwɔ, ohígbū kaa gē yíihɔtū tá alɔ eko dóódu, ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ glá.

eng_Latn: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla cɛ̄ lɛ Urésɔn, ɔyí kú Ɛlíyāda nōo kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔkpani nū, Uhádādēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Usóba ā, gbɔɔ́ ō bɛyíkwu Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
idu_Latn: A géē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá áyɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā ā. N kē í da aígbáanɔ kóō bēē bī ɔdōlé gé lɛ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā habɔ̄ aá tá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē má eyīnyinyi aá ŋ́. N géē yá aá italā kú ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā nɔ́ɔ yá aá italā nyā lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ olɛlā kú Ísrɛ̄lu odúúdú eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn yéeyī ā.

eng_Latn: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́mpa nū, Ujɛ́mīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi le kpó hídáagó dúú. Ujísɔ̄si da Usáyímɔ̄ni kahíníī, A yúúfi ŋ́, o ŋmá abālɔbányā, a géē yɔ̄ ī kwú ācɛ gé um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē kwú ɛbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ahāpōtú, ɔ̄cɛ éyi gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ olɔnyā ā gē wā ɛɛ́! Aá le bɛ̄cɛ kú aá gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
idu_Latn: Ijakī kú ipú ácí ā háyi ɛyí ɛfu lɛ ígblɛ́nyī playi ɛcɛ yɔ̄ ī fu owu kpoó kpoó bɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú kú ipú ácí a. Eyī kú uwā í mɛ́ɛbɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū kéē má ɔdōlé lé ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uríyelu lɛ ācɛ ofɛhīlī kpó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi kú Ukɔ́hāti ā wā.

eng_Latn: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyípōklóbīya ā lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ mla ɔtūnōbí, ohígbū koó lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
idu_Latn: Ussímrɔn-mérɔn, Ákisāfu.

eng_Latn: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nōo ī tūufi bá ī yá jīla ɔ́ tá biílí. Aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā kē bá ī kwūce ɔ́ eko dóódu, bɛ̄ɛka ewō nōo yɔ̄ ī nū ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī kwú ɔ̄ aīnu ikpó ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
idu_Latn: É tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ jé pélūū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla uwɔ. Alɔ wā kú alɔ lɛ ɔkpá gwá lɛ īyī alɔ, kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛka gbo mla uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
idu_Latn: Ń kōō ga Ujerúsālɛm ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ gbɔbū gā um ā ŋ́, amáŋ n le tá éwo nēé hī Árābu ā. Anɔ́ɔ n klla kwúcē ga Udamáskɔsi á.

eng_Latn: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
idu_Latn: yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Eyī yá um ka ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a í yá ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ ā jé ícɛ. Amáŋ á kē má ɔ̄ abālɔbányā glá ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, ācɛ alɛwa yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́cí ā ŋ́. Anú yá ɔdā dóódu á. Ó kē le Ísrɛ̄lu fu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wɛ ákú anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ ɛɛ́. Iyē nū lé ka Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ kú n̄ ka lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmííyē nyā ka, É kwú íne nāa bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́, fíyɛ́ o ka ka, kwu ipoto kú uwɔ ú, ká ā yāwu!.

eng_Latn: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Óndú alɔ nēé ka odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ohígbū nū ā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í yá ofídákā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nēé kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga Ubábīlɔn āa.

eng_Latn: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
idu_Latn: Okokoŋkofi, ogwugwu, idangblēnyi mɛ́mla ucē okwáapa.

eng_Latn: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ācɛ ā gē pā ɛcí kpɔ́. É gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā klla gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ ó je lɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, nɛ̄ ó hī ka Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásgādu wɛ, úlā ɛtá ce ofu ce ɛpa .

eng_Latn: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Áskɛ̄lɔn ā í má ɛ̄nyā klla í yúufi. Ācɛ Ugása dúú ā géē hīla ayīnu ipú ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nēé í yɔ̄ ī jé ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó géē wɛ lɛ ācɛ Ékrɔn dúú á. Eyīyōce kú uwā géē je pīya áncā. É í ŋmó ɔcɛ́ kú Ugása. Áskɛ̄lɔn géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā hile ipú nū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔyínɛnɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔyínɛ́nɔ̄nyā éyi í lɛ īlī o cɛgbá ō tū ohi ŋ́, nōo kē má ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ó ī lé ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, nōo gē gbō uwɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú, ikpo kú uwɔ nōo lɔfú abālɔbányā géē gbɔɔ́ ō gɔ́ gbeegbe. Ayīnu kú uwɔ géē je kpó fu lé ŋmá okónu, nɛ̄ á gáā má ayīnu o bī lɛ lé ɔdōlé gɛ ŋ́. Eyī kú uwɔ kwu dobū nɛ̄ á klla mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Á má ɔdā nēé bá ī yá ipú aígelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
idu_Latn: Íssmɛ̄lu wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī ce igwó ahāapa ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ipú íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi kú um nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄hi ā, lɛyíkwú aéwo ɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, Ɛ́dɔm. É bá ī gwéeyē abɔ̄ é gáā mīyɛ ajɛ kú um, kéē klla gaá kpó ajɛ ácí kú nū wu.

eng_Latn: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá nū ŋmá ipéyī nū á. Usedekíya le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
idu_Latn: Aájī ɛnɛ nōo bɛ̄cɛ eko nɛ̄ ajī ɛpa kú nū ā kwú kpó cē ā, kwɛyí ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū, nōo géē je kpó kɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ igbīhi ɔcɛ́ kú aflɛ́yí ā. É gáā lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ákú aflɛ́yí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú cigbīhi le tá abɔ́ɔ ā. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ yɛ ga ɛga nɛ̄ n kpó ɔ̄ tayínū ā, n má ka īlī ā kwú gbaáhingílí. Ó klla lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ odúúdu ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
idu_Latn: A gē gwō ka anúɔ le obugā bu klla le éŋkpɔ̄ gwá ajɛ kú éwɔhá. A gwó ka ikpó kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kwú ísu kú Unáyilu ú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n le aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kpó da aá, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ eko le yá, aá géē bla ka n kɛlā lɛ aá lɛyíkwu uwā. Ń da aá ɔdā nēe bá ā ŋmá aflɛ́yí ŋ́ ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
idu_Latn: Urebéka tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, N wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ubɛ́tūwɛlu, ɔyí kú Umílka, nōó ma lɛ Unáhɔ āa.

eng_Latn: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī gwó Ujerúsālɛm nōo wɛ igelī kú Ɔwɔicō ā mla ikpó ō táajɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ géē yúwēyī ō ka ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó má ā tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó klla gáā yá bɛ̄ɛka ó wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ámāŋ ka o lɛ úwé kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ wu iyē, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō plla ācɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɔfú yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄ka ipú ɔtū kú uwā ka, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú ka ɛlā ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ámāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔlá tɛ̄hɔ̄ wāajɛ gaá kwú iyɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ɛfú kú ɛyí ede ā, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú ede ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ede ā, mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɔ́glɔ́ nēé bū tú ede ā biílí ā ú kpó yī ŋmáajɛ kēklēkē.

eng_Latn: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
idu_Latn: Uhúram ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā le odúúdú ɛhī, ukɔ̄, ussɔ́bɛ̄lu kpó yá mla oje udɔ bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn da ɔ́ lɛ ā kpó yá dúú.

eng_Latn: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n le ka ka, ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú géē kwú, nɛ̄ á ka lɛ ɔ́, ká ō kwú ucē kú nū ā ú pīyabɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō le nyatá ŋ́, ó géē kwú ipú ɔ́bíipú kú nū ɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ oyī kú nū ā géē ce uwɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the LORD. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, ayíkpó ɔhá ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ Óndú ā má ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ayíka n lɛ ofu kú ágbe unɛ́ɛlu ā má abɔ̄ kú nū, klla ke lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú um wu ofu kú ágbe kú unɛ́ɛlu ā, klla kē lɛ abɔ̄ kú um wu áklō kú nū, ń gáā cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī, Óndú káā lɛ oyēeyī kú um nyatá, lɛ um hɛ́tá ohígbū ihɔtū nāa lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ aéwo nēe yɛ alɔ jīla tá ā bá ī nunnu tá iyī uwā kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú alɔ. Aólɛlā kú alɔ bá ī cá alɔ ɛcá.

eng_Latn: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
idu_Latn: Aá híī nyɔ̄ ŋ́. Óndú ā í yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́. Aólɛlā kú aá géē yá aá lé.

eng_Latn: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
idu_Latn: Olikpō kú inu nōo kwu iyɔ̄bū kú ɛga otīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ikpó igwáahatá.

eng_Latn: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔpíihɔ ka ā, Ó gē je ɛhi lɛ aógbɛhá nwuné nwuné. É géē blakwu ogbonɛnɛ kú nū ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
idu_Latn: N jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ jé ō yúklɔ́ ɔcí lɛ ā. Lɛ ígbɔ́ɔ́cí kú ulóko, ɔpí mɛ́mla usáyípurɛ̄ssi kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé um. N le tútū o tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛhɔ̄ wā í tá uwá abɔ̄ dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá ōfūūfū uwā ā, ayíkpó ā wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ í nū ebílíi ā bɛ̄cɛ glá ŋ́ mā āa.

eng_Latn: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
idu_Latn: Áafú nyā í lɛyí ŋ́! Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō í gē kɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́, ó lɛ ā ɔwɛ nyá nōó géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā glá ā.

eng_Latn: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú ɔkpáncō mla ɛcɛ ā bū ipú nū, ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī gē má mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ eyī í gē má ŋ́, kwu aɔ́cɛ́, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, aɔ́cɛ́ ogbāajɛ, mɛ́mla ācɛ o lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi ā. É yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu bū iyē nū, é kē yá uwā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā cofɛhɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn, ɔhá gaá lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ɛ́dɔm. Ayí nɛ̄ Íssi ma ā bá yɔ̄ á: Upélātiya, Uneyaríya mɛ́mla Uréfāya mɛ́mla Ussíyɛ̄lu ā kpó uwá trɛ̄yí nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, eko nōó le pīya iháyí úla ɛpa ce ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwó ā á.

eng_Latn: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth_Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh_Kiriathaim,
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɔmigwɛ́ɛnɛ ā, Ukedɔlayóma mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ nēe cɛ̄tɔ̄há mla anú ā, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ɔlɛ́ uwā gaá le Urefém yálé ipú Asstɛ́rɔ̄t-kanáyim, mɛ́mla Ususím nōo yɔ̄ ipú Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ɛ́mim nōo yɔ̄ ipú Ussafɛ̄-kīriyatáyim.

eng_Latn: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
idu_Latn: É yá alɔ ágbe igbīhi nɛ̄hi, le alɔ igbīhi hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē tá ɔgba ɛhɔ̄ idana ā.

eng_Latn: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi le odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá nyā jé ā, ó le īlī kú nū híla ipú íwɔtū mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí. Ó le īlī ekwu kpó wiiyē, le ewo gwu klá ɛyí, yɔ̄ gē jikwū, ī tɛ̄gá gbōō bū ɔtāhɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usúsa.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔna tá ka anúɔ le yálé ɛɛ́, ó lɛ ɔfú kú onyatá kú nū mafú lɛ ɛcɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ihɔ kú Óndú āgē í yɔ̄ īkpōɛyí kú nū, Ó í je íjééyī mla ɔdā o jé la ɔɔ mla Alelékwū kú ɔtu otūle mla ɔfú mla íkwu; ɔdā oōjé mla ufi kú Óndú āmla ojīlīmā ooje la Óndú a.

eng_Latn: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da odúúdu uwā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne kóō yɛce um, ó géē leyī gwu iyī nū bónū piíí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄cóonyɔ́kpá kú nū ú ɛ̄cī dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yɛce um.

eng_Latn: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é le ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn yálé klla kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi igbledu ɛɛ́. Aá jikwū ohígbū Ubábīlɔn. Aá bī ɛcí wā í tū uwā ágbe. Ekoōhī ágbe kú uwā lɔfú jé glá.

eng_Latn: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm aá má ɔ̄, aólɛlā kú aá bá ī wā ŋmá ɛhícō. Ācɛ neé kpó tū aá abɔ̄ ā bá iní? Ācɛ kú aá nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔbɔ́cɛ kú uwā nɛ̄hi a bá iní?.

eng_Latn: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyā ā klla ka tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ alɔ lā ajɛ Ujúda ā, alɔ gē yá igbō, ī ma ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka Ɔcányā kú ɔkpáncō ā, í kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́. Alɔ klla ī le ɔtulālī kwu ɔlá, ī le ejé fu ajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ ó ŋmá lɛ ō jé kú aɔ́bá alɔ, é kē cɛ̄ ɔ̄da nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu kwú cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu Ujonátan. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ɔyí kú akwuna, mla ɔnyā ɔdāhá, mla ɔnyā obɔ̄bí. Ń jé ka a kwú yɛce Udéfīdi ɔyí kú Ujése ā, a klla lɛ uwēyī je lɛ iyī uwɔ mla ɛ́nɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
idu_Latn: Eko kú aúcɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́cī kú aójīleyī ā, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā géē wɛ okoolo éyi blla ɛna éyi, ámāŋ omlede éyi dóódu. Ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwɛ́ɛya ā bī glá ā nɛ̄ ó géē bī blla ayí álá kú ɛya ā á. É géē bī ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ olífu blla okoolo éyi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ń gáā le okónu klá glá ŋ́! N gēe yɔ̄ í kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ ohígbu ka n yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū, ɔtū kē yɔ̄ í wú um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je ɔyínɛ́ kú ɔnyā uwɔ nɔ̄nyā pīya ɔnyā uwɔ, eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā uwɔ yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá nyā kpó yíífi dúúdú: ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri, Ukénan, Upɛ́risi, Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohígbū aá nēe wɛ ɔbá, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, aá géē yɔ̄ mla anyā aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā cíkā ō yɔ̄ lɛ ā. Aá yá mla uwá ɛmɛɛma abɔ̄ aá jé ka é lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka aá ŋ́ mā. Aá mɛ́mla uwá géē mīyɛ ɛhi kú oyēeyī opiyóó nōo wɛ alahá ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō á n. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá nēe wɛ ɔbá ā lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yá glá Ɔwɔicō géē pó ɔkɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá ge gbā ā glá.

eng_Latn: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ogbāājɛ nyā le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujudíya le tá Ugálīli ā, ó wā ɛgiyí nū gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wā gaá lɛ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā nyatá. Ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ ī kwú.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya lɛ inalegwu tá lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a klla kwú ami nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ádā um, Udéfīdi ā ú cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā um, nááná nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ n kē jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n géē bī lɛ gbō ācɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ubatsséba yɔ̄ í kɛlā mla ɔcɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gā inu.

eng_Latn: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
idu_Latn: N géē na uwá yēŋēē ŋmá odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá lɛyíkwu um ā, klla í je odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ŋmá lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nēé yá tū um ā yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn gbɔɔ́ o gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛyí ɛfu kú Umórīya, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí ádā nū Udéfīdi ā. Ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Arawúna, ɔ̄cɛ Ujébūsi, ɛga o wú īkpɔ̄dā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā alɛwa le yɛ um jīla tá bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā. É le yɛ um jīla tá dúúdú bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ajɛ kú Ubássan ā.

eng_Latn: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā le ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú onyatá ā pá, klla kwú ɛga otīihɔ kú nū ā ú kpó he ɛ̄hī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú nū ka lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é klla kwú ɛbɛ kú nū ā ú kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ a fíya-fíya.

eng_Latn: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ébram da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Woó, Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n géē jé koó géē wɛ ákú um āa.

eng_Latn: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū, amáŋ é ma ɛga ga ɛgiyí nū glá ŋ́ ohígbū ɛwa kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Eko éyi yɔ̄ ī wā nɛ̄ ajɛ o hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā, géē je lɔhi nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ jé eko fíyaa nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛplá í gáā táajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla eko nēé kē í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Īkpɔ̄cí géē kpɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ í gáā lɔfú je ɔ́ yá ejé kwɛyí ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́. Enyi kú īkpō kú ɔcí ufáyin nōo pīya ā, géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wāajɛ bū ɔpɛ́ kú ɛfu nɛ̄hi, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcí ā jɛ̄ bá ā.

eng_Latn: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīma mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú nū tá cāā nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ī má. Ācɛ ī má ɔfú kú nū, ó klla ī je éeyē lɛ ācɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ nēe bá Ujudíya ā kéē le kwu nyɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu. Ācɛ nēe bá ipú igelī ā kéē le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā kéē híīī ga ipú igelī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ujɛkolíya nōo ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ opo tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, aá lɛ ɛ̄cī kú okónu ō gwū tū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ojīleyī kú ɔkɔ ō gbā hī.

eng_Latn: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā tú hayi je ɔkɔ gicō lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ hī ācɛ nēe bá ɛyí ɔdɔ ā á. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ jāhɔ̄ ka ɛ́ɛ pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔ gē da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu táncā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ami, Udɛbɔ́ra wā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ gē nū uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ le uwá ŋmó klla mīyɛ álá kú anúɔ ŋmá okónu kú uwā. Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ka eko nɛ̄ odúúmā kú aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā kwú eyī í pīya kwu anúɔ nɛɛ, anúɔ gē lɛ abɔ̄ bī uwā īkpɔ̄kɔ gē je uwá ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nyá wā í kɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le lé, le éŋkpɔ̄ gwá ā, owu kú nū má kwu ɔhá. Ohígbū ka ó lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
idu_Latn: Ń klla cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin ā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ácí mɛ́mla ujē dúúmā yɔ̄, nōo gē bɛ̄yíkwu um nɛɛ, n géē nuunu tú ujē mɛ́mla ácí ɔ́ɔmā ā í kpó uwā yɔlá ŋmá anú bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not steal.
idu_Latn: Aá híī wūūwī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nōo gē gbō um ā, awɔ nɛ̄ n gē hīgwú á. Jáhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n gē je ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá um ohi. Ɔ́dāŋ ka, á tá um ohi ŋ́, ayíka n géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛgiyí um gaá háyi pī um, anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka, Ɔyínɛ́ um, Usɔ́lu, lɛ eyī nwūla ká ā mɛ́ɛbɛ. Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā n gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōplahɔ̄ mɛ́mla agbá ōtɔ̄ɔkɔ kwú uwɔ ú yá héyīfuú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ Ubábīlɔn ā, ká a gaá da uwá ɛlā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē ka lɛ uwá ā. Le da uwá ɔ́dāŋ ka é jāhɔ̄, amáŋ é jāhɔ̄ ŋ́ nááná.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Aá wɛ ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé klla í bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō! Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n gáā yɔ̄ mla aá gbojī, géē klá ī cībū aá gbojī lɛ ā ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ bī wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā da Óndú ā ɔdā nōó cíkā ō yá ā glá āa? Ɔnyɛ kē nwū Óndú ā ɛlā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD's thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔkpáncō nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā. Ó ka ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā kē wɛ ákú Óndú ā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
idu_Latn: Aá kóō gbɛlá ka amíɔɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́. N kē jé ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí kú ɛlā olɔhi ŋmá ɛlā obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé pūla ā, nōó wɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá ā ŋ́ mā, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aálá ā í wɛ ákú nū ŋ́ mā, eko nɛ̄ ó má ɔgwú gē wā, ó í habɔ̄ aálá tá le kwu. Anɔ́ɔ ɔgwú lɛ uwá pahīla le aóhī kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó tū ɛjī lɛ ísu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú nū ā. N klla yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó le etikpa nōo bī ɛcɛ háyi ā táajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
idu_Latn: Ɔkpani, a tɛtɛ da alɔ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ádā ámāŋ ka ɔyínɛ́ ɔhá ɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ā híī yɛ ligbō hɛ̄ um tá gɛ ŋ́. Wā fíyaa, í tá um abɔ̄. Awɔ gē tá um abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
idu_Latn: Ígbíli ā géē yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, klla í bū ácí mɛ́mla ɔcí. Ajɛ ikpākplā kú ígbíli ā í je bū aɔ́cí lɛwa lɛwa lɛbɛ̄ɛka ūpū ohéyīfuú kú ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā. Ó klla í je bū ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ lɔɔlɔhi bɛ̄ɛ̄ka ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ajɛ olɔhi kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ussárɔn ā. Odúúdú ācɛ géē má ɛgahi kú Óndū ā, mɛ́mla ɔfú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbā ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le iŋini ka lɛyíkwu Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ohi kahíníī, Óndú um, a bī iyē kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā, le cokónu gā um ka, Usólōmɔn, ɔyí um, ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí úwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ayínɛ́ um ohumɔtū, aá yɔ̄ í gɔbū mla ɔtōōce Ɔwɔicō, ká aá hayi lɔfú iyē nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú ī cɛ̄ lɛ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ŋ́. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī odée yɔ̄ gē yá ipú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yá lɛ Óndú ā, abɔ̄ aá le jé ka úklɔ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá yá lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā í bónū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
idu_Latn: Ussɛkaníya, ɔyí kú Ujáhasíyelu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usátu mɛ́mla ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: É géē hī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nóō géē hile Ujerúsālɛm, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu kóō wi ā, ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abālɔbányā ipɔ́ɔnū nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ bá anú géē je kɔ̄, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛtá kú uwā í bī abɔ̄ éyi, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa kē í bá abɔ̄ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
idu_Latn: Usɛ́lɛ̄ki nōo ŋmá Ámɔ̄ri ā. Unahárāyi nōo ŋmá Ubíírɔ̄ɔtu. Anú gē bī iyɛ́fú kú Ujówābu á.

eng_Latn: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ ɔtulālī kwu ɔlá lɛ Ɔcányā kú ɔkpáncō ā gɛ ŋ́ mā, alɔ í klla lɛ ɔdā dúúmā abɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ɛfú yɔ̄ i lé ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ, alɔ klla bá ī pɛ́ kwú ipú ɔkpɛta.

eng_Latn: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ā, Ujéhu le odúúdú aɔ́máapú kú Áhābu kpó ŋmó, o dúú kú uwá í hile ŋ. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ɛláyíja ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá ipíinu kú Áhābu á.

eng_Latn: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé hɛ́ ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā igbɔhá á. Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, Ɛlíyāssibu mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔ́mpa nū ā le ɔwɛ kú álá ā gwó, klla lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄. É klla kwú odūngwɔ̄wɛ ā ú kwu ɛga nōó tɛtɛ kwu ā. É klla le ɔdɔ hɛ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú jāā ga ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda kú ofɛhɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda kú Uhanánɛlu. É klla le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔdɔ ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ā le ɔ́da nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyāda je ā bī yúklɔ́. É kpó ācɛ ā yáwa ga ɔlɛ́ ŋmá úklɔ́ ícíícɛ Usábāti ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ī gwū ŋmá úklɔ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ī wā úklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī uwā yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
idu_Latn: Umerí gwííjē kahíníī, N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ŋmá odo kú um.

eng_Latn: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ le bū okómpinu kú Ákánjɔ̄, bɛ̄cɛ ga ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm. Ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ amíyɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄hɔ̄ nóō tū um ā tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ulóko géē jɛ̄ kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcí ujē kwu tɛtɛ ā. Ɔ̄cí upi géē jɛ̄ kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ánagbáagwu kwu tɛtɛ ā. Aɔ́cí nēe bá ā géē wɛ ɔdā ō bī le blakwu ɔfú mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú ami, Ɔwɔicō kú aá piyóó. Ó géē wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā hɛ́ ɔ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá cē, aá lé ucɛ kú nū ɛ̄cī ahāapa, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā. Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī omlɛ́nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā klla gā ɛgiyí nū, igbo ɔ́mpa. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ kpɔ́ klla da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lé ɔdōlé ohígbū ka iyāwu nɛ̄hi tá ɔbū lɛ ɔ́ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ohígbū ɔnɔ otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ágábá yɔ̄ ī kpó um ikpokwú ca ā. N gbɛlá ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī je oyēeyī kú um ŋmɛ́yí á nɛ.

eng_Latn: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
idu_Latn: ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, ācɛ ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā ācɛ ɛpa, nōo gē yúklɔ́ ā ɛ̄cī dóódu á. Áluka kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē bá í yúklɔ́ abɔ́ɔ, ɛ̄cī dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka iyē ā kóō wɛ āyā ékpó nɛɛ, iyē í kē í yɛ í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ékpónú piíí nēé ŋmó ayí um kpó uwā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí ā, nēé wā í je Agbliihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dā nɛ̄ n ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā yɔ̄ á. Usenakérīibu, ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ ī lɛ eyī gwū uwɔ bónū, kllá yɔ̄ ī yá uwɔ okónu.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú lɛwa nɛ̄hi, é klla i lɔfú ce alɔ abɔ̄ bá.

eng_Latn: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú Óndú ā lɛ owu nɛ̄hi tū wā ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́wá kú ígbáanɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛwá ɔkpá ā kpó gwu wā ŋmá okónu ísu. É wu licō ŋmá ajɛ fíyɛ́ ikpó ɛtá glá ŋ́. É le ce klɛ́ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɔlɛ́ ā bɛ̄ɛka iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī éyi ā.

eng_Latn: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
idu_Latn: Ó le eko o ma ɔyí tū, anɔ́ɔ ó kē le eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í kwú ā tū dúú. Eko nēé nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ yɔ̄ mɛ́mla eko nēé gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé nyi ā kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi í je íne lɛ aá ŋ́ nɛɛ, nááná anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúú kú ipú aá í lɛ íne ā tū ŋ́ má ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē tíne ká aá ŋmó um ā.

eng_Latn: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n má oyī kú Unábɔ̄tu amānyā ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē yá uwɔ dúú á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kwú okwū kú nū ú tá ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Unábɔ̄tu, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ oōlé gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī gwéeyē ī yɛhɛ. Ejé oōgwá kē í je éeyē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, amáŋ á gáā lɛ odóódu ūwā glá ɔ́dāŋ ka á lɛ ije ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ije kē ī yá ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé í kwú klla í má ɔdēlihɔ ā ɔlɛ́ nū ā, é géē je anú mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā nōó lɛ kpɛ́mm ā kpó yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Ohígbū ka, ó lɛ íne kú Óndú ā nyílá, klla lɛ ɔdā uwēyī yá Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Alɔ í nyɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ bēhé wā ɛgiyí nū ŋ́, ɔdāŋ nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ alɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā í nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ā, kwu odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe jé ka anyā aá ɛ́ɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛnyā nēe māháyi abɔ́ɔ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lā ɛháajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nēé hī ka Upátrɔ̄ɔsi ā lɛ ohi tá um. É kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá cá ɔ̄ ɛcá ā, ó lɛ ɛcá cíla ulé kú ɛcá ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ yá ɔ̄ ōwē ā, ó tū uwā ufi ka anúɔ géē yá uwā odée igbīhāajɛ ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā o kwú oyēeyi kú nū ú tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ tá Ubɛ́tɛlu, anɔ́ɔ é gāá cīce ipéyī Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. É jīkwū gbōmgbōm ipú ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ́ cɛ̄ mla ɛlā nɛ́ɛ ka ā ŋ́ ka odúúdú aá géē kɔ̄ iyo ā jōonjīlɛ̄. Kwu ācɛ nēé bá ɔlɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā géē kɔ̄ odúúdú iyō ā jōonjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ gáā kwú ɔ ú tayínū ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, kwu Uyúfrētīisi ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ ŋmó ācɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo cɛ̄ lɛ oyī yɔ̄ gē pɛ́ ipú úláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā tɔ̄há mla ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bī tū Óndú ā klla kpó ācɛ kú Ujúda ikpó tū ɔ̄ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
idu_Latn: N gáā hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛɛ́. Ká n̄ lɛ uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ga ajɛ olɔhi nōo wɛ ajɛ o gbiyē nɛɛ ā. Ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Upɛ́ris ācɛ Ujɛ́būs mɛ́mla ācɛ Uhám.

eng_Latn: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
idu_Latn: É bá ī tíne ō kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ohígbū ka é bá ī yúúfi uwā ohigbū Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn je yá igbómína kú Ujúda, nɛ̄ Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Unetaníya je ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē wā ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū le ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá, ɛ́ɛ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ áncā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ Ugíbēyi, cīce ɔkwu ɔcí nēé hi ka Utámārīsiki, ɛyí ɛfu lɛ óbō kú nū bī abɔ̄, aígabɔ̄ kú nū háyi jila anú tá. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka, é le Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ háyi bá gē cokē, amáŋ aótrɛ̄yí ā bá gē yá ɔ́ okónu kahíníī, Ó nya ācɛ ɔhá tá, kóō lɛ iyī nū nyatá ɔ́dāŋ ka anú wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu á.

eng_Latn: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Akpókónu kú uwɔ lɔnyɛ tū um lingɔɔɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú, ohumɔtū. Ígblɛ́nyī kú uwɔ lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka enyāmɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛnwú. Īlī ō tōōhí kú uwɔ lɛ odúúdú ocū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn.

eng_Latn: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá pó ɔkɛ̄lā kú itali nōo yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ kpáwáyí kpáwáyí ā, akā kú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄-ajɛ klákákláká, abɔ̄ é bá yɛ fíyo-fíyo ā, ikpó kú ɔnya ɛfú yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ ajɛ gidigba-gidigba.

eng_Latn: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ahɔ̄ ō pó ɛlā, kóō pó.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá Áhābu ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛfú ā wā ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́, ayíka ó wɛ Óndú ā kɛlā bū okónu kú um ā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ, aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ɛlā nɛ̄ um ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
idu_Latn: Bī aɔ́cí ɛpa nāa tá ɔkpá tū ɔ̄ ā ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú ācɛ ā ká ē má uwā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ cɔ̄nyā lɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igá kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā nwūla, ɛ́ɛ kwú uwā ú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe ŋmá ɔkwu kú ɔcɛ́, Udéfīdi ā. Aá tɛtɛ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū le wú um ɛɛ́. Aá klla gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū wú Ɔwɔicō kú um dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú uwā cɛ̄ kwɛyí ā, ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nōo ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā géē wā í nuunu tū uwā. Ó géē yá uwā lé klla í kpó uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, amānyā wɛ akpa ɔcɛ́ kú um á. N géē lā amānyā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, klla í gbō uwā piyóó. Kwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, amáŋ aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā í klla gáā je uwēyī lɛ iyē kú um nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā gbóógbóó ŋmá lɛ ɛcí ōpā mɛ́mla okwū kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā ōnyi amānyā gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ipí enyeenyi gaá ce ɔ́, ó kwú tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō í cē ɛ̄cī ā kpií ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yēeyī ŋ́. Amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ ó fu ā, ó lɛ ɛ̄cī ā cē kpií.

eng_Latn: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni lɛ aɔ́dā nēe yá kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ ā, ó lɛ ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa hīgwú.

eng_Latn: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ācɛ ā fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyééye ā, le uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ígbíli kú Upáran ga ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú nū, mā ō yá um italā. Ɔ́mpā kú nū, mā ō tū um ufi.

eng_Latn: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɛdɔ nū yá lɛ iyí nū. Ń gáā je ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ā má, ó kē le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī, nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛhīlī á.

eng_Latn: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn, ɔyí kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú abɔ̄ ú yá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbaala. Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwú ɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ú le ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
idu_Latn: Éyééye kú uwá a lɛ ɔdɔ yɛ ipú nū jīla tá. É kē lɛ ɛga ogwɔ́lá kú nū gwó kwu ɛháajɛ ɔdɔ ā biílí.

eng_Latn: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
idu_Latn: Usófa, a ka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ūwū nōo ce eyī enyi yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā. Ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ le okónu tá lɛ ajɛ nōo wɛ ákú nū ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā gaá yúklɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla ɔ́mpa awɔ kóō lɛ ɛlā dúú nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá kagwó ōfōōfū aá. Ā híī nyɔ̄ í ka ɔdā nōo tayínū ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalumúna ú lɛ anúɔ, ka anúɔ géē bī itali ujē lɛ gɔ́ uwā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ iyē kú uwā ɔ́ɔ le plla.

eng_Latn: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú aákwuna nɔnyīlɔ mɛ́mla aákwuna nɔ̄nya kú aíkpɛ́cí ā kpó nū ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ó klla lɛ aójibó kú aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aádā nū ma kwu ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
idu_Latn: É í kpó iyó dóódu nēé gē bī le yúklɔ́ abɔ́ɔ ā, ákánjɔ̄ ō bī fɔ́ɔlá, okoolo ō bī ŋmó odée ɔlá, oje o bī tá ɛbɛ́ ŋmá ɔlá, ussɔ́bɛ̄lu, agá mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ tū ipú īlī ā. Anɔ́ɔ é géē pīya ɔkpɛ́ɛwū olɔhi klá ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú aógbló ō lɛ bī ɔ̄ ā ú kpó wu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ojéeyī géē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā ɔkwu tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó gáā ményīnyinyi nū eko nɛ̄ ó gáā yá ɔ̄ italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄hi nōo klla jé ɔdā kú úklábɔ̄ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Uhúram nɛ̄ n géē je tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
idu_Latn: ó da ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gaá da ɔkpani aá, ɔcɛ́ ka, Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á. Ā híī yúufi ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ka ka ami ɔ́ɔ tá uwɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
idu_Latn: Ébram lā ajɛ kú Ukénan, anɔ́ɔ Ulɔ́tu kē lā ipú aígelī nēe bá ɔpɛ́ ā kwu Usɔ́dɔm ajaajɛ á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, gē ka á. Ó ka anúɔ géē tū italā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ kú anúɔ nēe wɛ ɛfú, ɔkpɛtā, aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí, mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí ā, gaá klá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, géē wā í je odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm kpó yíífi tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá, aá cɛ̄tra ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā, ó gēe ŋmó ācɛ dóódu nēe ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Ó gēe gwō aólɛlā kú nū ɔ́ci, ó gē je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ abɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe wɛ aópeyī ā abɔ̄, géē bī uwā bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā í bū jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. N géē je ɛga odobū tū uwā pīya ɔlá ofíyajɛ iyɔ̄bū uwā. N klla géē je aɛ́ga nēe le kplúkūkplukū ā cīla tū mɛɛ́lɛ́ lɛ uwá. Okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ uwá ā bá á. N kē í yá uwā jīla lɛ uwá piíí.

eng_Latn: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
idu_Latn: Éwo ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́. A le uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛga nēé bá gē cɔ̄fiyɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ a kwú uwā ú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á. A klla yá kú iyē kú uwɔ kóō le lóofu ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā. A klla le aéwɔhá mɛ́mla aɛ́cí nɛ̄é gē pā ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú uwā, abɔ̄ alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā yɔ̄ gē wā ā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ a hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ nēé bá gē cɛ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe gē pa ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um hīla, klla í kpó uwā yíífi ā le jí ɛɛ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācogbāálá, nēe ī kpó aálá nēé cíkā ō leyíkwu ā yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ tɔ́ɔkpá ā wɛ: Upárōssi, Upáhāti, Umówābu, Ɛlām, Usátu, Ubáni.

eng_Latn: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kpó ŋmó ā bá yɔ̄ á, Usíhɔn ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, Ógu ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ukénan ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́na ahāapa ɔhá le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ. É le nyinyi gányá gányá ā, ɛdɔ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ń má ajɛ kú Íjīpiti jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umáássa, Óndú ā géē je aá lɛ olɛlā éyi nōo í je aá yálé klla í mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Aotrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, géē nyɔ̄ í kwu tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ kú Adulám.
