eng_Latn: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɔdā dóódu í je unwalu lɛ alɔ gɛ ŋ́, alɔ kē bá ɛbɔ́, ā, cɛ́ɛ́ igbɛ ékpónú ífi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi géē wā í yá uwā! Ōwē ā géē wā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í leyīce ŋ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnɔ ɔ̄ma géē wā ɛgiyí ɔnyā nōo gáā ma ɔyí ā. É kē gáā kwu hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bá ī kwinya ŋmá Unínīfɛ waa bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɔ̄kā nōo je ca kpoó, gē pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ̄ ā. Ācɛ yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba hī iyī uwā igwú ka, Aá māháyi, aá māháyi Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í pīyeyī má igbīhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔtú kú Uféro yá lɔfú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ bī ɔtūkpūūlū bá ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā inya.

eng_Latn: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē hútu iyāwu kú uwā lɛ, eko dóódu nēé gē cālɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ojéeyī éyi yɔ̄ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó dɛ̄gba wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɔdɔ ā kahíníī Aá jāhɔ̄! Aá jāhɔ! Aá da Ujówābu kóō gā amānyā. N tíne ō kɛlā mla anú.

eng_Latn: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, n pó ɔkɔ kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ úlúúlā okoklo igbíngbídi! É hayi pī akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī le pɛ́ wā í da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā ká ā nyɔ̄ ga ɛga ɔhá, ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ Uhérɔ̄du tíne ō lɛ uwɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ kú Óndú ā géē bī ajɛ odobū wā, ɔ̄cɛ í gáā má ɔlá má ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Ó géē wɛ ɛ̄cī kú ajɛ odɔɔlúú, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í gáā fíyajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ewo fú ŋmá ɛga o pá ɛtɛ́ ā, é háyi ipéyī Uféro, anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔ́ tá gicō á. Ó kwú pīya ipí ínálēgbé nōo wā í ce odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú oyēeyī lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ ā. Ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ kéē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, álá éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nyɔ̄ í le ɛfú kpó tá aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla Ɛ́frem. Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ipú ákanya mɛ́mla ōwē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
idu_Latn: É le da Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ka odúúdú ācɛ ā le iyī uwā túbá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla áganá géē kpó uwā ŋmó. Ōcē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi géē kpó uwā ŋmó. N géē tū aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí obɔ̄bí kéē kwú uwā. Ɛgwā ō lɛ ɛ́fa obɔ̄bí géē kwú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Usámsin gwutá jāā gbó ahāpotú, anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ, kwú ɔcí kú ɔwɛ kú okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, le ɔ́ fu ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú mɛ́mla oje kú nū ā, kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔkɔ gāá tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɛ́brɔn á.

eng_Latn: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi le kwu gaá lɛ ejé ōmákáká cē tū isoso kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ɔcí lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē háyi kú aá má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɛláyíja ɔ́ɔ géē wā gaá je ɔ́ wā ajɛ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ágábáidu, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a wā gaá ma ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ gɛ? Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ wā gaá lá ɛga owíigwu kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā, oyá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ōcē obɔ̄bí ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī nēe bá ipú ɛwa ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Utíca, lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ayíkpó kú uwɔ kéē bá cíí.

eng_Latn: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta kwú ɔ̄ ú cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ, n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā dúú nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú inu olɔfú kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú Ussɛ́kɛm ā, le ɔdā nōo yá ā pó ā, é le kwu gaá tayínū ipú agbla kú Ubáal-kú-ɛka ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī lɛ ayí uwā dóódu ɔnyā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ayí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī ka ā, ka kwúcē lɛ uwá. É ka, Ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ bī ā le gbɛnú ce alɔ abɔ̄ bá ɛɛ́. Alɔ gē mɛ ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ géē yēeyī āa.

eng_Latn: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
idu_Latn: É jé koó kɛlā lɛ uwá ohígbū Ádā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú ācɛ ā pó uya nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɔkpáncō, uya ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú owu nōo yɔ̄ ī tá lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ uya ā yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ipú inu ɛga nēé bá ā á.

eng_Latn: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi nōo kɛlā gbōmgbōm ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, O ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū Ɔwɔicō géē lā mɛ́mla alɛɛcɛ. Ó géē lā pī uwā, é géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kē í yɔ pī uwā, ó kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā tū gē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ī cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ ajɛ éwɔhá ā lɛyíkwu Ussɛmáya, ɔ̄cɛ Unehɛ́lam ā. Da uwá ka nááná nɛ̄ ń tū Ussɛmáya ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ aá, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ aá lɛ ɔtūkpóce ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛyí ācīije nyā ka lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
idu_Latn: Ígbóoje kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ o táajɛ nēe í bá ɛháajɛ aɔ́kpá ā, ígbóoje ɛpɛɛpa nōo í bī ɛgōpiyɔkɔ́ kú ɔ́kpa ā háyicō é le yá dúú.

eng_Latn: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja kwú ɔyí ā ú wāajɛ ŋmá inīīcō ā gé lɛ ɔnyōkwū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔyí uwɔ le héyī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé yá ā le fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce ā! Ohígbū kéē kwú iyī uwā í lɛ Óndú ā aflɛ́yí, anɔ́ɔ oŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ā, é kwú iyī uwā í lɛ alɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
idu_Latn: Ami je abajá kú ācomáabajá pīya ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, klla ī je ācogwɛ́bā ā yá olíla á. Ami ī tá ɛlā kú ācojéeyī, klla yá ka íjééyī kú uwá kɔ́ɔ wɛ íla á.

eng_Latn: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛyí kú ita ā wɛ á. Īkpɔ̄dɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu pīyɛyí ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ɛga nɛ̄ ó nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā, anɔ́ɔ é le da ɔ́ ka, Udéfīdi ɔ́ klá ígbíli kú Éngēdi.

eng_Latn: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
idu_Latn: Ubérīya mɛ́mla Usséma wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá nēe lā Áíjālɔn nōo nū ācɛ kú Ugáti bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD's people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ā le ɛka gbo lɛ Óndú ā, ka aá géē wɛ ācɛ kú anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
idu_Latn: Aá cíkā ō jé ka ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ā, wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú Ébrahām fíyɛ́ ayí nɛ̄ ó ma abɔ̄yī nū á.

eng_Latn: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
idu_Latn: É ge jikwū kú otábɔ̄, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í tá uwá ohi ŋ́, ohígbū keé wɛ ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
idu_Latn: Ó jikwū gbōmgbōm nōo yá kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kéē le pó, é kē le da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Uféro lɛyíkwu ikwū nōó je ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
idu_Latn: Áhābu lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó hīgwú, le iyɔ́fú kpó. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ gɛcɛ gaá le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā cēce ígwu ɛpa leyī pīya kwu ācɛ kú Usiríya. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka igwú kú ɛwū ɛpa piyóo ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ uwā gblla ɛwa kú ācɛ Usiríya nēe nyīla bá ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu bɛ́ɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ mla ācɛ úlā o hile ā kpɔ́. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ klla le jɛ̄ ācɛ ofu igwó o hile ā, nēé klla bēé ɔkpá ā gɔbū glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.
idu_Latn: Ó Kéē híī méyīnyinyi ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, amáŋ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā gwó tónū bōōbū.

eng_Latn: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
idu_Latn: N klla le yá kéē le ɛfú kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā, tútū eko okpaakpa. Kéē klla lɛ ɛhi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄cí kú uwā nēe pīya aflɛ́yí ā kpó wā eko okpaakpa ā. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, blakwu odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n yá nyā, kú ā géē le ɔdā olɔhi yá gā um ohígbū uwā.

eng_Latn: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
idu_Latn: A híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ plicō ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú gbaagbénú ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ agbénú kú ɔlɛ́ nū le nwuné tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā wɛ ɛga ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ nēé fu táajɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ohígbū aúgbɔga dóódu nōó lā ipú uwā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó ɔwɛ kú ámiya, géē kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ga éyi kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ gwū ɔ́ci kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó ŋmó ā gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú nū ka, nōó lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n da aá ka, ācɛ ōhī kú aá nēe háyi amānyā abālɔbányā, í gáā kwú gbɔbū ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē cɔcɛ́ í wā ipú ɛcɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ cíkā ōlɔtūce ɔ́, nōo kē ī hɛ́pɔ̄ olɔhi ā. Ó géē je íne dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā yá alɔ ɛhi. Ó kē í na alɔ ŋmá obɔ̄bí kú alɔ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ géē kwú uwɔ abɔ̄, ka awɔ ɔ́ bī ɛlā tū ipú glá ŋ́, nɛ̄ uwēyī nōo í kwú uwɔ ā í gáā mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ pī aá, ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā. Ń gáā pīyeyī kú um ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ijē nēe lɔnyɛ fíyɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn gwó ā á.

eng_Latn: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɛlā kú uwɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi piyóó ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ um anú ci ō gwó, ohígbū ka n wɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja, n kē lɛ ācɛ alɛwa ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
idu_Latn: Ayí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔyípōklóbīya kú nū ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́yī ā ipú aháŋgbā kú ícɔ́ɔja ā.

eng_Latn: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya wɛ iháyí ahātá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu ce igwóléyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ujɛdída, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Adáya nōo ŋmá Ubóskatu ā.

eng_Latn: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē ō nādaa ī tá iyē abɔ̄ kóō lɔfú, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā o tīile dúú, amáŋ o nā okpíyē daa ipú alelékwū ā tīile ɔwɛ dóódu, ohígbū ka ó gē bī ile kú oyēeyī nyā mɛ́mla oyēeyī kú ɛcɔ̄bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ohe um ɔtū, n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká ɔdā dóódu kóō nyɔ̄ ɔbū lɔhi gā awɔ, ká iyē kóō lɔfú gā awɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu í yá odo kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɔlɛ́ á. Kpɔ́ɔ́kpɔ́ ɛwa nɛ̄hi le pɛ́ wā í jila, nɛ̄ ó jɛga lɛ Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū kéē kōō le ɔdōlé lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ō kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi, gē cījáalí ɔkwɛ̄yi á. Ɔ̄cɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gē cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
idu_Latn: Ó gē ményinyi ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mɛ́mla aólɛhá ā. Ó klla gē nya oyēeyī kú uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛtá ā, Ussádrāki, Uméssaki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo wɛ ō gbō píyɔ́kɔ́ɔ́ kpɔ́, le míya tá ipú īkpɔ̄tū kú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
idu_Latn: A yá kú ácí kóō bū lɛ aɛ́na, a klla je aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ alɛɛcɛ kéē hí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdōlé kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā ka Uhɛsɛkíya ka ɔ́ɔ híī cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē kpɔ́tūce ā plla anú cokónu lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔ yá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá nū lɔ̄tu ce ɔ́ dúúdú, ɛhá í kē gáā kwú ɔbá nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā, Ísimɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Unetaníya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ɛlíssāma, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, le tá Umísipa mla ācɛ igwó, gaá lɛ Ugɛdalíya mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá pī ɔ̄ ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí olɔhi í gē gwá ikpō obɔ̄bí ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcí obɔ̄bí gē gwá ikpō olɔhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú ɔ̄ ú hayi ɔlɛ́ Óbɛ́dɛ̄dɔm, ɔ̄cɛ Ugáti ā, anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gā Ujerúsālɛm hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ cɛ̄ ohígbū ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū nɛɛ, ɔ́ɔ kē í bī īkpēyī abɔ̄yī nū má ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ lɔfú yá glá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ákisi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, anúɔ géē je ɔ́ yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē gbō anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
idu_Latn: Ísu, ɔdíyá nāa kwinya nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā? Awɔ, ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á pɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é má ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá ō yá gɛ ŋ́ mā, aógbɛhá nyā bá ī ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ ce hile ā ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɔhá. É klla bá ī ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ohile kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Upíta yɔ̄ ī gbafíyóó kú ɔdā nōo géē wɛ ɛyí ɛbɛ nōó má ā, ācɛ nɛ̄ Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔ̄kā ɔlɛ́ Usáyímɔ̄n da, anɔ́ɔ é gaá háyi okómpīinu ɔlɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udelíla da Usámsin ɔ̄kā ka abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ka anúɔ yíihɔtū tá anúɔ, nōó je odo kú nū lɛ anúɔ ŋ́ māa? Ó klla ka ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ plla igbɛɛtá ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ́ ka ɛga nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū yɔ̄ ā lɛ anúɔ ŋ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, Ipú ɔdā nōó gē lé ɔdōlé ā nɛ̄ ɔdōlé gē ŋmá á. Ipú ɔdā olɔfú ā, nɛ̄ ɔdā olɔnyɛ gē ŋmá á. Ɛ̄cī ɛtá nááná, é ka ɛyí ita nyā lɛ ɔ́ glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tá ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō nwuné nɛ̄ ó klá odúúdú ɛcɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó yá tá alɔ ā nwuné lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gwó inɔ̄ɔda kwu ɛcɛ péee klla bū obugā alɛwa ohígbū kōó lɛ aálá alɛwa nɛ̄hi bá o yɛ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ikpɛ́fu ā mɛ́mla ajɛ o tá gbādāā. Abɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ he ɔ́ ɔtū kóō hí nɛ̄hi ā, ó le ɔfú tū aɔ́gɛ́ɛjí iyē kéē hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla o je ajɛ olɔhi kú aípɔ́lɛ́ ā kpó hɛ́ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
idu_Latn: lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē yá uculo kú ō je yá ye ŋēē kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛɛ lɛ agwú nɛ̄ é je ōcē ā ŋmó tū ɔ̄ iyē ā a. Ɛ̄cī nēé ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ka ōcē ā mɛ ɛɛ́ mā, é géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ā wā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ gáā ka ucē ɔhá nɛɛ, ayíka ó wɛ ācɛ ɛpa ámāŋ ācɛ ɛtá ōfōōfū uwā. É cíkā ō kɛlā ɔgbace ɔgbace. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi í yɔ̄ kóō cɔ̄ɔ̄wɔ kú ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī ka ā.

eng_Latn: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, aá cāŋjɛ, kú aá fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā. Eyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú aá le nyā ɛɛ́. Ɛgahi kú Óndú ā kē yɔ̄ ī fíyájɛ ce aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá gē fíyajɛ ce odée ā.

eng_Latn: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
idu_Latn: É wɛ alelékwū kú ebilíi nēe gē yá aɔ́dā o hídáagó. Aálelékwū ɛtá mbá ā gē gɛcɛ ɛgiyí odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā, kéē lɛ uwá kpó wā í jīla tɔ̄há ohígbū ɛfú nēé gáā kpó ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, é gā ajɛ Usísarīya ā. Abɔ̄ Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī gbēyī uwā ā, ó lɛ aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ aɔóklóbīya nū kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā fu kɔ́ɔ̄ ɔ̄ leyīkwu oōje lá kú ɔdōlé ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā kwú ɔ́ ú cē gwōnū klla kwú ɔ̄ ú da ŋmó ikpó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
idu_Latn: Ó klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga ísu kú Umeditarénīya. Umicimétāti yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ajɛ ā. Ɛjī kú ajɛ ā le pú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, gaá yɛ ga Utáánāti Ussílo klla gaá bū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga Ujanówa.

eng_Latn: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ábna ga Uhɛ́brɔn ā, Ujówābu lɛ ɔ́ bī ga okónu igá kú igelī ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó gáā kɛlā ōtayínū mɛ́mla anú ā. Ó lɛ ɛ̄wā gwū ɔ̄ ipú, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ujówābu ŋmó ɔ̄ ohígbū ɔyínɛ́ nū Ásāhɛlu nɛ̄ Ábna tɛtɛ ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
idu_Latn: N hī Ɔwɔicō igwú. N kē cɛ̄tra anú. Ó kē le um nyatá, ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ odúúdú ɔ̄kā kú nū ā kpó cīla kpɛ́mm. Ɔ̄kā kú nū dúúmā í lɔnɔ tū Usólōmɔn ō cīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
idu_Latn: Yá ɛ̄nyā kóō mafú lɛ uwá ka Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā ūwā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu, le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī bá ipú aá Usádisi nēe lɛ īyī uwā tū yēŋēē ŋmá íne o bīya. Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā géē bī úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ yɛ mɛ́mla um, ohígbū kéē cíkā.

eng_Latn: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛpa a le kwu gaá tayínū ɛyí ɛfu. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā tíne uwā ɛ̄cī ɛtá, ē má uwá ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
idu_Latn: Ācōlóhɔ́nyɛta ɔha kú ācɛ Ujíyu le pīya tɔhá mla ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ o leyīɛpa nɛ̄ Upíta yá ā, Ubánābasi kōō le pīya tɔ̄há mla uwá ipú ucē obɔ̄bí nyā dúú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ̄kā da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔdā nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ káā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá ī ka lɛyíkwu um ā.

eng_Latn: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn éyi yɔ̄, nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka, Ukíssi, ɔyí kú Abīyelu, ɔyí kú Usérɔ, ɔyí kú Ubékórati, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Afíya, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn. Ó lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
idu_Latn: Óndú, blakwu ɔdā nōo yá alɔ nyā, má alɔ, ka á má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwēyī kwú alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē yá ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu klla wɛ ífi. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ bá mla újí mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú ɔ́bíipú nōo yɔ̄ ī gɔbū tōōtū ɔ̄. Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ cokónu mla Asírīya, klla ī tá ɔ́sú anɔ̄ mla Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyā ahāanɛ ŋmá abālɔbányā N géē kwúcē wā. Cɛ́ɛ́ Usára ɔnyā uwɔ í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi. Usára bayi okómpīnu kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā igbīhī yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛnyā nɛ̄ a je gā um kóō yɔ̄ mla um ā je īkpō ɔcī ā gā um, nɛ̄ n lé á.

eng_Latn: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ aá le ɔdōlé kú ajɛ ā lé, aá géē kpó ōhī kú nū lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
idu_Latn: N tū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ɛhɔ̄ igbalɛwa kéē da aá ka, aá híī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n tū eyījii nyā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɛ í he um ɔtū ɔ́dāŋ ka odúúdú ācɛ le lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā glá. Amáŋ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ lɛ ɛhi kú nū ŋmá abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɛhi éyi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kē lɛ ɛhi ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá gáā kwu ɔcí kú nū, klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá kwú abɔ̄ mɛ́mla aíkpō kú nū, kwú uwā í kpó yi ɛɛ́. Ābɔ̄ kú nū a í gáā lɔfú glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē wɛ okwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ije kú ɔtūnōbí; é húmáyī gwó ɔ̄ klla gwó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
idu_Latn: Ubálam da uwá kahíníī, Aá le gbo amānyā gbóócí, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē da aá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē ka gā um ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā má klá mla Ubálam á.

eng_Latn: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da uwá kahíníī, Aá le Umu bī gē um. Anɔ́ɔ é le bī gē lɛ ɔ́ á, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya tū ipú ɛ̄hī á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, aá je lɛ ācɛ kéē lé mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é le lé klla le má ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɔ́ɔ́ yɔ̄ anú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó kwú lɔhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
idu_Latn: A yɔ̄ ī lɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi gā um. A klla bī odúúdú ofú kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī yá um ōwē.

eng_Latn: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā le tá ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó má ka ɔɔ́ yɔ̄ í yúufi nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, n le ɛyí cikwū le ɔdā nāa da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ yá ā yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā wɛ, Userúbābɛlu, Ujessúwa, Unehemíya, Usɛráya, Uriiláya, Umɔ́decáyi, Ubílissan, Umísipa, Ubígifáyi, Uréhum, mla Ubaána. Iyē kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla áluka kú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā nēé pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm mla Ujúda ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā bā á.

eng_Latn: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
idu_Latn: N bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, klla bī aā bū ipu ígbíli iháyí ofɛpa, klla kwú ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn ú lɛ aá, kóō le pīya ákú aá.

eng_Latn: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, leyīkwu ɛcɛ, jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi ká ā lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n gáā mafu gā uwɔ ā lɔɔlɔhi. Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé bī uwɔ wā amānyā ā yɔ̄ á. A géē ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdā dóódu nāa má ā.

eng_Latn: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
idu_Latn: N géē yá kéē lɛ uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā blakwu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda ā, ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā Usúsa ā klla le túbá, lɛ aólɛlā kú Ujíyu ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó Usúsa. Amáŋ é wu iyó kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
idu_Latn: Anú gē yá nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ī yā klá ajɛ ā. Anú klla í kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú Ujúda le gwá ŋmá anú. N yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú yíífi má tá alácɛ̄. Ācɛ klla í bá ī yá uwā okónu, klla í bī iyē kú uwā le tókónu lɛ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yá jāā kwu ícɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu lɛ Obadíya nōo gē leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ nū ā hīgwú. Obadíya wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aójibó kú Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ɔhá o hile dóódu nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya yá ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je īyī nū lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄si mɛ́mla ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mla Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Uyáwɛ, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā á. N cokónu mla aádáádā aá eko nɛ̄ n kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nēé wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā. N da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bī ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aá í cē ā wā gé lɛ Óndú á, amáŋ é gáā je ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede kú ocu kú nū kóō he Óndú ā ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛ̄nyā ka, anɔ́ɔ ó klla da uwá eko kpií kpɔ́ kahíníī, Oklóbīya alɔ Ulásārɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā, amáŋ n géē nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɔ́ héyī.

eng_Latn: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá tū Ɔkpíihɔ ka lɛ ā ā, Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo tíne ō gwo, kóō bī ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā le gwō.

eng_Latn: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ kú uwēyī kóō lɛ ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā kwú ŋ́. Yá ka aógbɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ɔ́ɔmā kéē cɛ̄tra uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē nwūla ɔwɛ kú ɔkpáncō tɔ́ɔtɛ́ gbōdōō lɛ aá ká aá bēé nyɔ̄ ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ōmɛ ŋ́ kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu má kéē le hɔ́ɔgba kú ɛfú igbīhi mɛ́mla iyɔ̄bū ā, ó lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī fu le hɔ́ɔgba ɛfú leyīkwu ācɛ kú Usiríya.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
idu_Latn: Aá géē hɛ́ aálagbá nēe bá ipú agbá odobū nɛ̄hi ā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ofíyajɛ kú ɛnɔ má eyī. É géē má ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi nēé í lé tɔ́ɔwɔɔwɛ abɔ̄ é géē yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ā. Ó kōō wɛ ɛyí ɛfu oŋmíkpākplā, é géē má ɔdōlé í lé kpɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aálá gē lé ɔdōlé tɔ́ɔwɔɔwɛ gē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ jāā kwiícɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
idu_Latn: ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē ka ka Ɔ̄cɛ Otīhiɔ nɛ̄ Ádā tū wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ɔ́ɔ gē ka ɛbí eko nɛ̄ ó le ka ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ku Ɔwɔicō ā?.

eng_Latn: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú alɔ, amáŋ é kē wɛ mla alɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ keé wɛ mla alɔ nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í bá ipú alɔ kpɔ́. Amáŋ uwá kē le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ kóō mafú lɛ ācɛ péee ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í yɔ̄ mla alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ le yā, éŋkpɔ̄ le cēenyi klá ɛcɛ, owu kē le tá klá ɛyí inu āa, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú wúlatāajɛ á. Ó wúlatājɛ mɛ́mla uya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
idu_Latn: É gē cɛ̄ lɛ ijēnyi mɛ́mla ɛmiyɛ gē kpó ayí ūwā ŋmó. Ayí ūwā bá ī ba ɔdōlé, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā cɛ̄ jē lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ yɔ̄ ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ, lɛ abɔ̄ flá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā? Ɛháajɛ ɔcí ápu ā, n lɛ uwɔ héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā, abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ ma uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēe je eyī gicō ā, é le má ka, é lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā míya ŋmá okónu únóji ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛna, álá, ámāŋ ijakī kú ɔ́mpa uwā má gwōnū, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ eyī kwū ɔ̄ tá ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi icō kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛtá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kpɔ́ á. Aólufa ā le ɔ́ yá ágbe dúú, é klla le ɔ́ tɛ̄cɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
idu_Latn: Ubéla ma ayí ɛhɔ̄ nēe bá ā: Ésbɔn, Úsi, Usíyɛ̄lu, Ujɛ́rīmɔtu mɛ́mla Íri. Odúúdú uwá wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā. É klla wɛ aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ɛwa kú uwá nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔ́ja glá ā wɛ, úlā ofɛpa cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ cofu cigwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ obɔ̄bí gē bū ŋmá njɔlɔ ékpónú nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ ā keē lɛ ɔ́ tá tāajɛ lɛ Ujɛhóyācin ka ó lɛ ayí dúúmā ŋ́. Lɛ ɔ́ tá koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá lɔhi eko kú nū ŋ́. Ohígbū koó gáā lɛ ayí dúúmā nēe géē lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā nū Udéfīdi ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yá ucɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, aúgbɔga ɔlɛ́ uwā, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe lā mɛ́mla uwá ā kéē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā, é bī ɔ́ŋgbá owú odufā le eliká kú ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā flá tū eliká kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā kóō ce ɔdōkwɛ́nyɔ́ ā icō kóō híī je wī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ása yá ā, é lɛ uwa kpó tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ása kwú hīla ā, ōcē kwú ɔ́ ikpó ú cē klla kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ́nyí.

eng_Latn: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́kpá ā wɛ ahātá, mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛhīlī, ɔ́kpa éyééye wu ígbóoje-otáajɛ ɛpɛɛpa.

eng_Latn: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē je ísu ŋmó ŋmáajɛ péee, klla ī je njɔlɔ ā ŋmó ŋmáajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ajɛ ā kwú pīya ígbíli icííci.

eng_Latn: And they did all eat, and were filled.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā le lé jɛ̄ iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ɔ̄cɛ ā bī gɛɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ tá klá anú le ɔ́ ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a mīyɛ abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ka anúɔ géē gbɛfiyɛ kú ulé kú nū.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ó le uwá nyatá ohígbū iyē kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū mafú.

eng_Latn: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhāsi da Uríya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kahíníī, Ɛyí ede nyā nāa gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄ci mɛ́mla ákú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ákú ɛbɔ́ mɛɛ́ á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā mī oyī kú odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ dóódu nēé bī í gwɛ́ɛya ā klá ɛyí ede ā. Amáŋ ede kú oje udɔ ā, géē wɛ ákú um ká n̄ bēé da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.
idu_Latn: Igbo alɛwa n gē cɛ̄ kéē yá uwā italā ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ dóódu, n kē ī cēyītīkwū ká n̄ yá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. N kē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwá nōo kōō cɛ̄ ga um ga ipú igelī kú aílɔ́wá ká n yá uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ nā ɔ̄na otū, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ nōo géē ka ɛyí ɔ̄na ā lɛ alɔ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛyí kú ɔ̄na ō ka wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ n. Aá da um ɔ̄na kú aá ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá klla kahíníī, N géē kwúcē uwɔ ɔkpani. Amáŋ lɛ ɛga je ga um ká n̄ nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ úŋmóō tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N má Ebilíi eko nōó míya wāajɛ ŋmá icō, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ olímanya ā.

eng_Latn: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nyā, n má aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛnɛ māháyi ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɛcɛ a, lɛ aówu nēe tá ŋmá ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɛcɛ ā kwútū cɛ́ɛ́ kú owu kóō tá klá ɛcɛ, ámāŋ ísu ámāŋ ɔcí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
idu_Latn: Uhátāki nyɔ̄ í le ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Ɛ́sta.

eng_Latn: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó ɔ̄, amáŋ é géē je ɔ́ héyī ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá. Ɔtūnōbí yá ayíkpó kú nū ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni da Umósīsi kahíníī, Kóocōō, ɔkpani um, ā yá alɔ italā ohígbū ucē kú ínoōbīya kú íla nɛ̄ alɔ yá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: Óndú pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā. Kócōō, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n ba uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá um abɔ̄, Ohígbū ka a lɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, a klla gē yá okónu nāa ce lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ke í cɛ ijáalí kú úklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ ó yá ā. Ó í wɛ ɔnyā nōo bī ayí nū jɛ̄ lɔɔlɔhi, klla gē miyɛ ugbɔga wā ɔlɛ́ nū lɔɔlɔhi, ó gē yúklɔ́ o tá iyinu wāajɛ lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá aɔ́mpānū. Ó klla ge tá ācɛ nēe lɛ unwalu abɔ̄, ó klla gē lɛ eko kú nū taajɛ i yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ jāā kwu ícɛ, aá tá īyī aá wā ajɛ ŋ́ kpɔ́. Aá ce um ojīlīmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ ipú ódúudú ɛcɛ í jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ bī abɔ̄ kú nū yá odúúdú ɔdā nyā ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni le okwutɛ kú nū ā fīyajɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú úmúlá kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kwú pīya ɛlɛ́ɛ́lá. Ɛlá ā kē le tū klá odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā í kwú ɔ̄ ú, kwú ofú í tū ɔ̄ iyē á anɔ́ɔ ó kwú píya ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Otínīyɛlu le tá ɔnɛ̄fú anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le Ukússan-rissátém, ɔcɛ́ kú Umɛsopotámīya ā yálé á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá móōwe ipú ígbíli iháyí ofɛpa jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī nyɔ̄ ɛ̄cī dóódu ā, ojuja kú Óndú ā klá uwá ɛyí ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā gē yá ojuju kéē nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí eko dóódu. Ɛga dúúmā nēé nyɔ̄, é bá ī hɛ́ unwalu táajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le bá lɛ Ujerúsālɛm, Ubɛ́tifáge mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tāni ā, é gā ɛfu nēé hī ka Ólīfu ā. Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga iyɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn nēe pīyɛyí wā mla uwá dúú ā wɛ: Usótāyi mɛ́mla Uhásoférēti mɛ́mla Upérūda.

eng_Latn: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
idu_Latn: É tɔ́kpá ka, ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɛga je lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ɛga dóódu kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā, kéē lɛ īyī uwā túbá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbō īyī uwā ɛyí. Ɔ́dáŋ ka ācɛ dúúmā bī iyɔ́fú gaá le unu nu tá uwá, ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛ íkwu kéē nuunu tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. É klla le ɔfú je kéē lɛ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla anyā uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā kpó ŋmó, kéē klla lɛ iyó kú uwá kpó wu.

eng_Latn: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n̄ lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nyā da aá, keé gē mīyɛ ɔcomɛ́ɛbɛ dóódu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú iháyí nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē je ga um ā, anɔ̄ kú ólīfu, ejé mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, n kwú kpó gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō licō, nɛ̄ ísu lipú lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ í jé ɔtū kú aɔ́cɛ́ ŋ́ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
idu_Latn: Ɔfú nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē je ā í lɔhi ŋ́! Aá je ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ka kahíníī, Ɔdōnīigbō ligii gē yá kú ámú kú igbō dúúdú kóō nū á ā.

eng_Latn: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ufi tū uwā. Lɛ yá kéē le jé ka, aá ɔ́ɔ wɛ alɛɛcɛ áncā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
idu_Latn: Íra nōo ŋmá igelī kú Ujɛ́ɛ ā kē wɛ éyi kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi dúú á.

eng_Latn: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí géē yá ɔ́dāŋ ka aá má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ kwúcē ga ɛga nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ā gē ka ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gē yēeyī ā, amáŋ ɛlā kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā wɛ ɛga otayínū kú ucē ɔ́bíipú.

eng_Latn: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
idu_Latn: Aá híī mīyɛ ije élí ŋmá ɛgiyí ācogwɛ́ɛya, aúlífāyi, ācogwíijē, ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā nōo gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé ɛdɔ aígbáanɔ dóódu nēe le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le igbō mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí ufáyin nēe le ŋmó nēé hī ka Uréyísin ā kɔ̄ miya odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ nū kpó nyɔ̄ gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi nēe tɛtɛ lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā gbɛlá ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ wā í yá aá lé, mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ ā glá ŋ́ nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Aópeyī mɛ́mla aócīkpó kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ofōofū uwá í gáā cɛ̄ ga uwɔ bēhé wā ipú igelī ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Umanásɛ yá ā, kwu ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā nēe kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā, é le odúúdú nū tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka anúɔ lɛ ācogbāājɛ fu gbō ācɛ ā klla da ācɛ ā kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ opo nɛ̄ ācogbāajɛ ā géē bá ī tá kéē pi aá ahɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ācɛ ā tá kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā jāhɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
idu_Latn: N géē cílá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ulé ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nēe yá ā. Aɔ́cɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú aéwɔhá alɛwa géē yá uwá lé, je uwá pīya aɔ́fiyɛ.

eng_Latn: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n kpó ɛhɛ mɛɛ mla uwá, ó gē yá uwā eyījii, ohígbū kéē kpéyīce ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ eyī kú um ŋmá lɛ ā gē tú uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɔ̄ icɔ́gbá ɔcɛ́ ka, Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
idu_Latn: N gē lé ewo ikɔkɔ ɔdōlé, agīje kú um klla le wīya tɔ̄há mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gwá ā.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ádā nōo ma uwɔ ā. Ā lɛ eyī gla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ bónū, eko nɛ̄ ó kwú hīla ókplícī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
idu_Latn: le odúúdu ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu hīīgwú tɔ̄ɔ̄há ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́mpa kú ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa ŋméeko nēé bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Ó le odúúdu iyē kú uwā kpó tá tū ɔkpá lɛ uwá gbaáluka ipɔ́ɔma éyééye. É le iyē kú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū ā tá tū ɔkpá, le uwá gbaáluka.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī lɛ eyī gwō ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm bónū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ɔmáapu uwā nɛ̄. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ eyī gwō ācɛ kú Íjīpiti bónū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Then it shall be, when he maketh his sons to inherit that which he hath, that he may not make the son of the beloved firstborn before the son of the hated, which is indeed the firstborn:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ le miya ka anúɔ gáā kɔ̄ agbénú kú nū lɛ ayí nū ā, ka ɔ́ gáā je ɔyí kú ɔnyā ōcɛ̄ ā fíyɛ́ ɔ́kplá ā, o ŋmá lɛ ō je ukpɛ̄ nōo wɛ ákú nū ā lɛ ɔyí ɔnyā ōcɛ̄ kú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gɔbū, yɔ̄ ī ka íne nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Óndú ā, n klla yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um kóō kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ú túgwó kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
idu_Latn: Ó gē cīce okómpíinu ɔlɛ́ unū, ámāŋ ka ɛga nōo licō fíyɛ́ kú ipú eyīpɔ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú odúúdú ulé nēé bī aá ā ú yá uwá ɛhi. Kwu ije, īkpɔ̄dā, ámāŋ ejé, ámāŋ anɔ̄ kú ólīfu. Aá kwú odúúdú ɔdā nēé le ce aá abɔ̄ ā, kwu ajɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwá, ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin, ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ólīfu, mla inu kú uwā ú kpó lɛ uwá bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta le yɛ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛ́yá ā pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ á. Ó le mu mla ɛbéenyi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ áluka nū wɛ ofahāapa cigwɛ́tá . Abɔ̄ ɛbéenyi alɛwa bá ipú ɛ́yá ā, nááná ā ɛ́yá ā í kē híla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
idu_Latn: Usɛrúbābɛlu ma Abíyudi, Abíyudi ma Ɛlíyākim, Ɛlíyākim ma Áso.

eng_Latn: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ucē olɔhi tá Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā í yɔ̄ ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ācɛ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú uwā bá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī kéē ŋmó ayínɛ́ uwā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú ɔyínɛ́ nū mla ɛ́yá ō kwú ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
idu_Latn: ka ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí éyi ŋmá ipú uwā, gbɔɔ́ ō ka ka ɛ́ɛ nyɔ̄ gaá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá, nɛ̄ uwá í jé ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, É jé ŋ́ nɛɛ? Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyā wɛ aógwuda nɛɛ? É bá í kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um yíífi ŋmáajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī je ɔdōlé lé ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í kē ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gē nwū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōó cíkā ō je lɛ ádā nū ámāŋ ka ɛ́nɛ́, amáŋ nōó kwú lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ.

eng_Latn: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ ā tá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ yɔ̄ á. Ó le lɛ ā kwú ābɔ̄ kú ajɛ ā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ú. Cɛ́ɛ́ n kē kwú ābɔ̄ ɔhá ú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ kɔ̄ hī iyī alɔ tá.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā ka.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
idu_Latn: Lɛ ukɔ́ nyā tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyíkwu ɔnyā dúúmā nɛ̄ ó yá ucē okpaakpa lɛyikwu ɔbá nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ije lá aájɛɛhɔ̄ ā, klla í lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá ajɛ, í gwū ɔ̄ mla ɔja, klla í hī aíjáalí. É géē yá lɛ ā ipú ajɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn nyā, mɛ́mla ipú aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ bá yɛ Ujerúsālɛm tá biíli ā. mɛ́mla aígelī kú Ujúda ā. É klla í yá lɛ ā aígelī nēe kwu ajɛ kú ɛyɛ́fu ā, ɛyí aóci ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda nēé hī ka Unɛ́gɛ̄bu ā. Le jé ka n géē je uwá cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ née lɛ apīicɛ ŋ́, nēe lɛ ūkwū wɛ aɛ́béelihɔ lɛ aá. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú uwā géē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, a gbɛlá ka ɛlā nɛ̄ a í ka nɛ̄hi ā í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ tá anúɔ ohi ŋ́ nɛɛ? Kɛ̄ɛ ka a gbɛlá ka anúɔ í yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɛ́, nɛ̄ alɔ í gáā dɛ̄gba tū uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ lɛ aá dúú ā. Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé da aá ka aá kóō yá ā yá kwɛyí, aá cíkā ō ka kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ icííci nɛ̄ n. Úklɔ́ kú alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, é cíkā ō cɛ̄tra alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
idu_Latn: Ó gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, aá le pīyabɔ̄ klla lɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ okpaakpa ā yá. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá lɛ ācɛ Uhíbru nēe wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū ā hɛ́tá. Aá kē lɛ um gbo ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
idu_Latn: É gē je iwélé ɛpa lá ɔkɔ́bɔ éyi, nááná odúú kú uwā í gáā míya wāajɛ glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ádā ā cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ a, kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́, á kē yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē wū uwá ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kócōō, lɛ um nyatá. Ohígbū ka éŋkpɔ̄ le yɛ gaá kwu um ɔkɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
idu_Latn: Uréhóbōwam ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwú iyī nū ú tú kwaajɛ lɔfú lɔfú nɛ̄hi á. Ó wɛ iháyí ofɛpa, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ klla gbāajɛ iháyí igwáhāapa Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ŋmá ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kóō kwú pīya ɛga nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ɛ́nɛ́ kú Uréhobōwam wɛ Unáama nōo ŋmá ajɛ kú Ámɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó dēē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ yɛɛ ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú ajɛ kú Ugalésīya mɛ́mla Ufrayigíya, yɔ̄ ī lɔfú tū odúúdú ayíkpó ā iyē.

eng_Latn: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu úklɔ́ ohídáagó nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Aá gbɛlá kwú úklɔ́ ohídáagó ā mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uháman ŋmá ɔnū ucɛ ā yɔ̄ í ga ɔlɛ́ ā, ɔtū he ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ó lɛ Umɔ́dɛkāyi má okómpinu ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ abɔ́ɔ. Umɔ́dɛkāyi í kōō cāŋjɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō ī túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū kóō hókónu tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ kpó. Anɔ́ɔ Uháman kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi ōhī fu kéē kpó ācɛ trɛ̄yí ipú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā iyɔ̄bú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ, ŋmá lɛ ō gwíijē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpáncō amáŋ ɛcɛ amáŋ ɔlékwū nōo lɔfú nwūla ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ipú nū má ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
idu_Latn: Ɛplá oje ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ ā, ó le tá ɔɔ́pu, anɔ́ɔ ó má ācɛ ɔhá māháyi á. Ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá húmáyī ú bá amānyā, nɛ̄ aá kē yá ɔdā dúúmā ícɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ójīla ā kahíníī, Ń má ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ō bī le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, N géē je ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka, ɔlɛ́ kú Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati ā, mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú Ubássa, ɔyí kú Ahíja ā, ohígbū ka a lɛ um ɔtū bīya, klla lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ́bíipú ō bī.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ aá nēe gē cɛgbá ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ kú Óndú ā. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē cɛgbá ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ kú Óndú ā?.

eng_Latn: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ussɛfatíya mɛ́mla Uhátilu mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Upocérēti, Uhásēbayim mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ami.

eng_Latn: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ a lɛ Odúúdú iyó kú uwá kpo ba í pɛ́ kwu bū ɔpɛ́ kú ígbíli a.

eng_Latn: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
idu_Latn: É túgagá nááná, é gáā pīya ɔcíkōtō ŋ́ ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ abɔ̄ bī uwā.

eng_Latn: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ūwā má gwōnū, ɔ̄mpa nū kē ī je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū, anɔ́ɔ ó má gwōnū, ó í bɔ̄bí lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ í kē yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka kpɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́, nōo lā ɔkpáncō ɛga nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo klla yēeyī piyóó ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N lā ɛga nōo tīihɔ klla licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, amáŋ n lā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tú īyī uwā wāajɛ, klla ī pīyabɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē lɛ ɔfú ɛyīpɛ̄ tū uwā iyē, ká n̄ klla tū uwá ɔtū kwú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: The priests said not, Where is the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe nwū ācɛ ɛlā kú um í kōō jé um, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé klla í dɔɔ̄kā um ŋ́. Aɔ́cɛ́ ogbāājɛ ā lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfu yá tá um. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā gē bī ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā le mɛ́ɛbɛ, klla ī nyɔ̄ ī gbā ɔdā nōó lɛ itene dúúmā ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ enyi gē pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū ā lɛ ahɛ tá klá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le yēŋēē, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í na īlī kú nū, lɛ iyē gwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ajɛ kú uwá ɔ́ɔ yɛ ga Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ísu kú Ugálílii ɛhíícō kú Ísu ɔmā nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā jāā gaá kwu ikpó ɛfu kú Upísga nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne ó nuunu tá uwɔ kóō lɛ uwɔ ŋmó, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ í gbō uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbō ije kú nū ā. Óndú ā í kpó aólɛlā kú uwɔ tá bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ítū gē tá ɛcɔ̄ tónū ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ adá kú Uféro ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ī Nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄ncɛnyā ā le yɛ gaá lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ kú ɔyí piíí ā hīgwú wā gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
idu_Latn: Ohílīpú mɛ́mla ɔdā ō jé kú uwɔ géē gbō uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Ulébānɔn kéē gaá lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ klá ajɛ lɛ anúɔ. Ó ka ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ géē wā í yúklɔ́ mɛ́mla uwá. Ɛdɔ ulé dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā, anúɔ géē cílá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Usólómɔ̄n da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kē jé ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ í jé ō hɛ́ ɔcí bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā í tú wāajɛ ŋ́ jāā ɛ̄cī ofahāapa ce igwó.

eng_Latn: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ɛcɛ géē dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ajɛ kú nū lɛ ā yɔ̄ ā? Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú ɔnū nɛ̄hi kú nū āa?.

eng_Latn: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu abɔ̄yī nū gbɔbū lɛ uwa. Ó túkpɛɛ́ igbo ahāapa abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī túbla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ísɔ ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
idu_Latn: Ipú Ujerúsālɛm, nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
idu_Latn: É lɛ okwū kú uwā kpó kwúcē nyɔ̄ ga Ussɛ́kɛm, lɛ uwá kpó nyī ipú únóji nɛ̄ Ébrahām bī ije nɛ̄hɛ́ lá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ayí kú Uhámɔ ipú Ussɛ́kɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔkɛ̄lā ā í wāajɛ kóō tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá aá abɔ̄ nɛ.

eng_Latn: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēé bī iyē kú um bá ī kā lɛ aá á. Ó wɛ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
idu_Latn: Ó gē wú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé ī le yá igbō ā mla igbóngbō piyóo ŋ́. Oyá kóō híī kpó ca ŋ́. Ó jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī lɛ aka kú úgbɔ́ɔnya yɛ ɔ́ nōó gáā je ikpó nū ā kpó ca bónū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Umáyíkalu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā, nōo wɛ ɔnyā Udéfīdi í ma ɔyí dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ oyēeyī le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē kpó Ɔwɔicō ɛpɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ péee. N géē kɛlā ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū yɔ̄ ī wú um lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
idu_Latn: N gē wɔ́tū uwā nɛ̄hi ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú um. N je uwá bɛ̄ɛka aólɛlā kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujésiríili gaá le ágbe kú nū ā tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú jé á. Ahasíya le tá abɔ́ɔ í má ɔ̄ kú ágbe kú nū ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā ga ajɛ mla usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ nēé tá aíne tū ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nū ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
idu_Latn: Aéwo ā gáā le túbá ka é nuunu tá ɔ̄, ŋmá ɛga dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛ́yá kú ofītɛ́ kú uwā tá, klla lɛ ɔ́ kwú ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
idu_Latn: utébulu mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū, mɛ́mla igbō nēé je lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
idu_Latn: Aíta lɔfú nwū ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē lā oyēeyī ipú ɔdā ō jé nɛ̄hi, ohílīpú, ucē okpaakpa, ɔkwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla ō leyī yɛ ɛlā ɔwɛ ojōnjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu le má ka, ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná ce Ɛfrém ɛyí ā, ó he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ádā nū ú ŋmá ɛyí kú Ɛfrém gaá ce ɛyí kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aéwo olɔfú nɛ̄hi géē cɛ̄tra awɔ. ācɛ kú aéwo obɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi géē yúufi uwɔ í lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú éyi kú ugóolu kú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā wɛ ɔdōōjé abɔ̄yīnū á. A géē tá iyī uwɔ wāajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ācɛ kú ɛlpéeko nyā í gáā pɛ́ kwú kwɛyí ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ā le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔtū kú um yéékpó ka o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔtūnōbí ŋ́ mā, ń gáā wā í má aá igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upássɔ ā wɛ, Ɛliyonáyi, Umáasīya, Íssimɛ̄lu, Unatánīyɛlu, Ujósābadi mɛ́mla Ɛlása.

eng_Latn: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó ohile ā le ɔ́kɔ ā pɛ́ ga okónu ɔkpá ā, yɔ̄ ī pi ɛya nōo le mu mla ɛbéenyi ā, ohígbū ka é ligbó lɛ ajɛ gɛ ŋ́. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē yá ācɛ nēe gē tíne ō yá ɔdā nōo í bī itene gé lɛ iyī uwá ōfōōfū uwā, nēe klla gē tá kéē yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé tíne ō yá piyóó ā italā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdōlé je lɛ ɔ́ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, é kē le je lɛ ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, mla ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, nēe gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla anú ā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔdēelihɔ kú ɔcɛ́ Íjīpiti kóō lé ɔdōlé mla ācɛ Uhíbru.

eng_Latn: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Áícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛwa nɛ̄hi bá ī wā ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō. Éwo kú ācɛ nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi éyí, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo alɛwa pīyatɔ̄há le tútū bá ī wā í kpɛ́fú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
idu_Latn: Abalɔ̄bányā Óndú ā wɛ Alelékwū ā, ɛga nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Óndú ā yɔ̄, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lɛ iyī uwā á.

eng_Latn: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, n géē ga ɛgiyí ɛyí ede kú uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō, Óndú, awɔ nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he um ā. N kē ī gwō ɛngwū ī cɛ̄tra awɔ, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubáni ā wɛ, Umáadi, Ámram.

eng_Latn: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
idu_Latn: bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ olufa kú iháyí iháyí ā. Ɔkpani nū í gáā yá ɔ̄ ōwē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ eyī yɔ̄ ī nyā ā, Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá háyi ɔ́kɔngɔ̄ ɔkpá ā. Amáŋ ayíkpó ā í jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē je pīya alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ aéwō ipácí ōfōōfū uwá géē lā anú á. Ó géē tūūfi nɛ̄hi ō má. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií nōo gē wā a, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá jé ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka aá lɛ um yá cɔ̄nū. N géē kɛpɔ̄ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā tū aá. N klla í cílá aá ulé kú ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nōó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, Ɔwɔicō géē tá ɔ̄ ohi. Ó géē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ipú éeyē ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ í kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī, Abālɔbányā ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē lɛ ācɛ kú eko nyā gbla anú ā? Ɔdí nēé gbla ā?.

eng_Latn: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
idu_Latn: Ó gēe he um ɔtú nɛ̄hi kéē lɛ um ɔkɔ nya cē ká n gekwú fíyɛ́ ō yēeyī, kwú nyinyi, kwú pīya ikpokwú ōfōōfūnū ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Eko lígíí le glla, Unáhāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔn gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Uhánɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé á.

eng_Latn: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tóohi kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka n le aéwo ā kpó ŋmó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē da aíkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin ā. Ami ōfōōfū um kē da uwá tāajɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē tá um abɔ̄ ŋmá ipú aéwo ā ŋ́. N bī ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi le da uwá tāajɛ. Ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ oyī kú uwā kē tá klá odúúdú īlī kú um ɛbɛɛbɛ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔkpíyē kú um lé, klla lɛ oyī kú um gwá, lɛ oyēeyī opiyó, anɔ́ɔ n géē je ɔ́ héyī ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ó géē wá odúúdú ɔnwū ɛyí, ɔnwū agba, odúúdú ɔnwū eyī mɛ́mla ɔnwū kú ɛga ɔhá kú nū. Ó géē na īlī kú nū, klla ī gwīiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ojéeyī mla olíla lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛɛ, olíla ā gē yɛhɛ, klla yɔ̄ ī cɛ́cá ōfōōfū nū.

eng_Latn: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Aɛ́gɔ́ éyi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ kwú, é kē yɔ̄ ī ma aɛ́gɔ́ ɔhá, amáŋ, ɛcɛ yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā kpɔ́.
