eng_Latn: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
idu_Latn: Ujowána, nɛ̄ ɔbá nū wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú Uhɛ́rɔ̄du ā, mɛ́mla Ususána mɛ́mla ācɛnyā alɛwa ohile nēe bī agbénú kú uwā le tá Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē dɛ̄gba tū aɔ́cɛ́ ī da uwā kéē wɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu, klla ī da aígabɔ̄ kéē wɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ɔ̄cí dóódu nāa tíne ɛyí ɛfu kú Ulébānɔn ā, alɔ géē hɛ́ uwā bá ajɛ ga awɔ. Alɔ klla í kpó uwá gbō bɔ́há, klla í kpó uwá ce eyī enyi gaá kwu ajɛ Ujópa, ɛga nɛ̄ aá géē kpó uwá ŋmá ga Ujerúsālɛm glá ā.

eng_Latn: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
idu_Latn: Ukénan á, Ukénan kē ma Umahalálɛ̄lu á, Umahalálɛ̄lu kē ma Ujárɛ̄di á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
idu_Latn: A gē je odúúdú ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kpɛ́mm ā kpó yíífi. A klla í tū ācoŋmɔ́ɔcɛ mɛ́mla ācopllācɛ ā eyījii.

eng_Latn: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
idu_Latn: aá gē gwō ka aá mɛ́mla ikwū ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛka gwá ɛɛ́. Ka aá mɛ́mla ɔlékwū ɔ́ɔ kē lɛ okónu ce lɛ īyī aá ɛɛ́. Aá bá ī gbɛlá ka eko nɛ̄ ámíyā nōo ī yíífi nɛ̄hi ā ɔ́ɔ géē wā ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔtū kpóce ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛpla ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ aá tū ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ā, ó kwú ŋmɔ́lá abɔ̄ é tá ɛgba gajɛ ŋ́ má ā.

eng_Latn: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ é da iyī uwā ka ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í kpó anɔ̄ ā bónū icííci ā mɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
idu_Latn: kóō ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Aá lɛ anɔ̄ oyēŋēē kú ólīifu bī wā ohígbū ō tū agege kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔlá kóō yɔ̄ gē cɛ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ojigógó. Kéē yá kóō yɔ̄ í cɛ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́futa le ɛhɔ̄ tū cīgbīhi fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔ̄ri.

eng_Latn: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ n klla géē leyīce ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ? Ɔnyɛ kē má ka um lɛ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū kpɔ́ ɛ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ nyā géē yɔ̄ gaá kwu ā? Óndú, ményinyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna ipú ígbíli. Ó kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā gllágwó ipú ígbíli. Aá lɛ íkpáŋdrā na kpaakpa tá lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
idu_Latn: Eyī ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú nū, ɛga nɛ̄ okómpinu kú nū yɔ̄ ā, olɔwá kú īlī ukɔ́tin ā kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofu ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛjī tū lɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla obū ŋmá lɛ ukpo nōó pi tū eyī ísu ā.

eng_Latn: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ébrahām mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Íssmɛ̄lu, le apī hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
idu_Latn: Uféro le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ yá āa? Ó lɛ odée nɛ̄ anúɔ í je lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne ō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū á nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó da Uféro kóō mā anúɔ tá, ká anúɔ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū gaá kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm á. Ɔtú kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu wú ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
idu_Latn: A géē gbolóce ɔfū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā kóō yá odúúdú úklɔ́ olɔfu kú uwɔ ga uwɔ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú kwu ŋmá Unáyōtu kú Uráma gaá da Ujonátan ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ā? Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛpɔ̄bí kú ádā nū ā? Ɔbíipú nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ bī tū ádā nū, nɛ̄ ɔ́ gē tíne ká ɔ̄ ŋmó anúɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ̄ géē gbɔbū ɛfú lɛ alɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔcomɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá Áhābu ohi kahíníī, Ayípōklóbīya kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú aígbómína kú ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí kú ajɛ ā géē gbɔbū ɛfú nyā á. Áhābu klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kē í wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja āa? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá Áhābu ohi kahíníī, Awɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka nyā ŋ́, n gbo īyī um ɛka ka, agblɔ̄cɛ́ nyā géē je gblífi gaá tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda klla le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Ɔwɔicō. É yá ka Óndú ā kóō kwú cɔ̄nū, ohígbū ka ɔ́bíipú nēé bī tū Ɔwɔicō ā fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā tɛtɛ bī ā á.

eng_Latn: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
idu_Latn: É klla ī yi ɔtulālí ɔlá lɛ ɛcí ā ɛyí ede. É gē gbla ucē kú ɛcí ō pá kú aéwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā yá. É bīya íne kú Óndú ā klla kē yá ucē kú ɔ́bíipú alɛwa nēe cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aɛ́cí nyā wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yúúfi uwā, nɛ̄ aá gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gā um, klla í je mlanyī um dúúdú āa? Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ cíí kú um í ka ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ gbojī ā, nɛ̄ aá klla le ojīlīmā ce um gɛ ŋ́ mā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú ɛhɔ̄ ā, klla lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tū nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ olufa ā kpɔ́. É lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíjé lɛ ágbe yá ɔ̄ ɛyí, klla lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē cɔcɛ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé klla lɛ uwá kpó bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā, ámāŋ ōcē obɔ̄bí, yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ā, ámāŋ, owu ámāŋ efūma gaá kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ú kpó yíífi, ámāŋ ka aólɛlā gaá le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ámāŋ ōcē yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ofɛtá cigwó bá abɔ́ɔ, kwu Ujaasáníya, ɔyí kú Ussafán. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwá lɛ ɔtulalī kwu ɔlá ipú ákánjɔ̄, klla bī ɔ̄ abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī tá ódūdū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé nɛ̄ aá géē bī gé lɛ Óndú ā á, o ka lɛyíkwu ɔdā ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā, aá géē bī ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ ó le ɛnyá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō géē yɔ̄ mla um, nɛ̄ a lɛ um gbō ga iyāwu kú um nyā ɛbɔ́, nɛ̄ a géē je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla īlī gā um.

eng_Latn: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ Ubálam ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Ubálam le ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwá. Ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōó bī le nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Ubálāki á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwā da uwá kahíníī, Áā kwinya ohígbū oyēeyī ká aá, aá pīyeyī má igbīhi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī māhayi ɔpɛ́ dúúmā ŋ́. Aá kwinya ga ɛyí ɛfu ā, ohígbū nɛ̄ aá géē je yíífi.

eng_Latn: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā gē nyɔ̄ ī gbā ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ede nēé fu céé lɛ iyī uwā mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔwɔnɔ̄nyā kú uwā nēé hī ka Ássera ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛyí kú aɛ́fu.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, Wā icō iyɔ̄bū amānyā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le ádā nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū kpó gaá lā ɛga nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Abɔ́ɔ kwu igelī nēé hī ka Urámēsses ā ajaajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Uféro je ɔ́da lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā eko dóódu klla yɛce Óndú ā kpaakpa mla ɔtū ékpónú. Ó klla le odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ ó je lɛ Umósīsi ā tū.

eng_Latn: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ ā nōó hīgwú á, ó hī ācɛ igwú ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ujíyu ōfōōfūnū ŋ́. Amáŋ ó hī ācɛ igwú ŋmá ipú aílɔ́wá dúú.

eng_Latn: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá uwā lɛ ohígbū ka é lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá Ísrɛ̄lu. É gē cikpó anyā kú ɔ́mpa uwā, klla ī bī iyē kú um le kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ń da uwá ŋ́ mā nēé ī ka á. N jé ɔdā nēé ī yá ā, n kē í cījáalí tū uwá.

eng_Latn: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá gē yúufi ɔkpacaŋgelī. Ācɛ nēe bī ɔkpacaŋgelī ā nɛ̄ n kē gáā kpó wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá á.

eng_Latn: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nāa ī tū ā, ohígbū ka a kē jé ucē kú um dóódu.

eng_Latn: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ nyā, ó kwú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā nɛ̄ ó cokónu ō je ā ú kpó lɛ alɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́, aɔ́dā nēe bá ā lɔfú yá ká ālɔ̄ hɛ́ ucē kú únwū nɛ̄hi kú aɔ́dā kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá ā abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ucē kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ka aá tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá lɛ anúɔ yá cɔ̄nū ŋmá lɛ ɛcí nɛ̄ aá bī abɔ̄ kú aá ma nɛ̄ aá ī pā ɔ̄ gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɔdōlɔnɔ yá īyī aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
idu_Latn: É je ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Usímīyɔn mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn ā lɛ uwá ŋmá lɛ ūlī nēé tá ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēe bá ā yá ká ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kóō le yá jīla. Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
idu_Latn: Utayicíkɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɔlóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa alɔ nōo he alɔ ɔtū, nōo cɛ̄ Óndú ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɔtú ékpónú ipú úklɔ́ nōo yá lɛ ɔ́ ā, ó géē da aá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōo húmáyī yá um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ āhɔ̄ kú um lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ka é gbēyī anúɔ. Ó keé gbēyī ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kpó ɛlā ce aéwo ā. Ó klla ka anúɔ le ɔtū kú anúɔ yéékpó kú anúɔ lɛ odúúdú aéwo mla aajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ túbá, ká anúɔ bī ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú anúɔ ā lɛ italā yá uwā. N géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi í kpó aéwo ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛtá, tú aɛ́pa kú aflɛ́yí ā ɔkwu, lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē gbā ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ojibó kú nū ɛ̄gbā, nōo klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ fukɔ̄ udɔ̄bū ámāŋ ka abɔ̄lɔ́ná.

eng_Latn: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n gbɛhá, ɛgbá ce um nɛ̄hi, ɔtū klla le bīya gā um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
idu_Latn: Awɔ kē wɛ ádā alɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á. Ɔdāŋ nɛ̄ ádáádā alɔ nēe lé ka Ébrahām mɛ́mla Ayísīki ā í kōō jé alɔ ŋ́, kē tá ka alɔ í wɛ ayí uwā ŋ́ nááná, awɔ ā kē wɛ ádā alɔ abɔ̄yī nū á. Awɔ kē húmáyī hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá īkííkée á.

eng_Latn: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
idu_Latn: Ó gē bɛ̄cɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī bɛ̄ɛka oklóbīya nōo lɛ ɔnyā bōōbū ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka oklóbīya nōo gáā kweyī kú inya ā.

eng_Latn: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
idu_Latn: Ucē olɔhi nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ gē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ alɔ iháyí dóódu á. Ɛga dúúmā nāa nyɔ̄, ɔdōlé le kpɔ.

eng_Latn: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ nyā, yá ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú nū mɛ́mla ákú ádáádā nū nēé bī klla kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cɛ̄ le Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū ā.

eng_Latn: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ klla kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá ipú ákanya mɛ́mla unwalu kú aá dóódu á. Amáŋ, ícɛ nyā aá tá um ɛɛ́. Aá klla da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ je lɛ aá. Ó lɔhi íbí, aá lɛ īyī aá túbá ipɔ́ɔma dóódu ipéyī Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, n wā ɛgiyí uwɔ, káā gbō um. Lɛ um hɛ́tá káā lɛ oyēeyī kú um nya ŋmá abɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē nū um inya ā.

eng_Latn: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔdā nēe íne ā í yá glá ŋ́ ohígbū ka ɔkpíyē i gbagbafú ā yá. Ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ínoōbīya nōo ī yúklɔ́ ipú ɔtū kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā, o ŋmá le o tū ɔyí abɔ̄yīnū, nōo wɛ ɛ́gbla kú ɔlɛɛcɛ nōo ī bīyíne ā wā ipú ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ íne nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ bīya ā kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā kahíníī, Aá má ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá bā í yá ā. Aá gē nyíla Usábāti ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō tīihɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
idu_Latn: Uféro, ɔcɛ́ ā le cɔ̄nū mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo geē je ejé lɛ ɔ́ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄coyíigbō ā.

eng_Latn: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
idu_Latn: Onɔwá ā gē je oje tá ɔlá. Eko nōó le kwú ɔlá yōō, ó kwú omútāgā ú cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī odúúdú ɔfú kú abɔ̄ kú nū lɛ ɔ́ na ɛdɔ ɔdā nōó tíne kóō wɛ ā. Abɔ̄ ó gē yɔ̄ ī na ɔwá nyā ā, ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kē ī jɛ̄ ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
idu_Latn: Aá í lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā ā.

eng_Latn: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
idu_Latn: Unówa le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú éyééye kú aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe le yēŋēē ā ú, kwú uwā ú gwɛ́ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛyí ede ā á.

eng_Latn: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
idu_Latn: É da uwɔ ka aɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄hi ō gwó lɛ aɔ́cí Usɛ́da alɛwa gbā tū ɔ̄ ā kwú fíyɛ́ ákú ācɛ ɔhá ā nɛɛ? Ádā uwɔ ī má lé klla má gwá nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū koó hɛ́pɔ̄ klla yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, ó kē í lɔhi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
idu_Latn: Ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ da aá ka ɛ́ɛ le aíjakī ā pīyɛ̄ ɛɛ́, amáŋ Usɔ́lu í da ɔmáapu ádā nū ɔdā nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ ō lé kú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ pī um ā, ń gáā yúufi ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í yá um ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nɛ̄ odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā le tū bá tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ipú ígbíli yɔ̄ ī yá ācɛ ubatísim, ó klla yɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ācɛ kéē lɛ ubatísim yá kóō mafú keé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam yá ā, ó lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔtū bīya ohígbū íne nōó bīya mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ɛcí ō pā ā.

eng_Latn: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī je ɔdā ōtīihɔ lɛ ewō ŋ́. É géē pīyeyī wā í tū aá iyē icíci. Aá híīī tá aɔ́ká kú aá bá iyɔ̄bū aókómɛ ŋ́, ohígbū kéē géē lɛ ikpó da uwá bá ajɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je odúúudú okónu nɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ā cīgbīhi gé lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā nēe gē yá uwā ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
idu_Latn: Kwú ayí kú Ulífāyi ā ú ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ká ā lɛ uwá iyē gwu yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gbɛlá kahíníī, Aɛ́nyā wɛ aólɛhɔ́cɛ, é kē wɛ ogwuda. É gē yá uce ólíla ohígbū ka é jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, tíne kéē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
idu_Latn: Óndú, ó lɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nāa ī nwū ɔ̄ odée ā, nāa klla ī nwū ɔ̄ íne otīihɔ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā pīyeyī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō kóō má ayí kú alɛɛcɛ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ nōo jéeyī, klla ī gbā anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ayí kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ɔtū kú Uféro kóō le lɔfú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nū aá inya ī dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ aá kwú. Amáŋ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá anú mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā, ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra um. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti géē jé ka n wɛ Óndú ā á. Anɔ́ɔ é kē le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, gáā jē lɛ uwá kéē lā ɛbɔ́ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe wɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ā ɛ́ɛ géē kɛlá nēe bá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka, Ɔwɔicō kú aádā alɔ le uwɔ fu ká ā jé ɔdā nōó miya kóō yá ā, ká ā má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū oyólɔhi ā, ká ā klla kē pó ɔkɔ kú nū, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gā awɔ abɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Alelékwū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ aá í lɛ aá yá ɔfiyɛ ká aá klla kwúcē ga ufi ō yá kpɔ́ gɛ ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, Alelékwū ā kwú aá ú pīya ayí Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū ā ī yá kú ālɔ̄ da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ádā! Ádā alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ kahíníī, N gáā kwú ɛɛ́, ile nyá nɛ̄ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā í tū gā um gɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɔlɛ́ Upíta, anɔ́ɔ ó má ɛ́nɛ́ ɔnyā kú Upíta gwutá agōdō. Áganá yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É lɛ ɔ́ tá táajɛ kahíníī, Ā híīī yá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā ojámá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ abɔ̄yī uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō, ká ā nuunu lɛ īyī uwɔ. Bla ka ācɛ nēé jé awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, bá ī yɛhɛ tū uwɔ ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, lɛ ɔ́da nyā je lɛ Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí dúúdú kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ikpɛ́lā yɔ̄, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē kɛpɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú um lɛ a. É géē yá odúúdú ucɛ kú ɛ̄gbā ōgbā um eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú uculo ā lɛ ā. É klla géē lɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n kéē yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā tū gā um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ā.

eng_Latn: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā é lɔ́fú tū ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā iyē. É kē bá ī tū uwā ɔtū kwɔtū kéē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le nwū uwā ka o ŋmá ōwē nɛ̄hi piíí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ géē gā ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá á.

eng_Latn: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ iháyí ɛhɔ̄ ga iháyí ofu, ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛhɛ̄ ofu. Ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa mā alɔ tá klla cīgbīhi kwu alɔ gbojī lɛ ā yɔ̄ āa? Á gáā blakwu alɔ igbɔhá glá gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ayípōklóbīya, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. Aá yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū kē í he aá.

eng_Latn: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā. Ó da ɔ́ kóō je igbō ɛhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N le íne kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ákú uwɔ bīya. Ń cíkā kéē hī um ka ɔyí uwɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
idu_Latn: Ébalu, Abímɛ̄lu, Ussɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
idu_Latn: É le jí ɛɛ́, ohígbū kéē yá ɛdɔ uc­ē nɛ̄ Ukéni yá ā. Ohígbū ije é gbɔɔ́ ō kā ɛdɔ kú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ubálam ka ā. É yá ɛdɔ kú īkpɛ̄yí olɔfu nɛ̄ Ukóra yá ā. É géē kpó uwā yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je Ukóra yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
idu_Latn: Ɛmiyɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɔfú iyē gɛ ŋ́. Ífi kē ī yá ɔ̄ eko dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oklóbīya ɔ̄cɛ gē kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uhérodīyasi wā ipú inu gaá lɛ ijē jē, anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kē le he Uhérɔ̄du mla aúgbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā ka, ɔdí nɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā? Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔdā dúú nɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá mɛ́ɛ̄ n̄, otú kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ géē bá yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā agōdō ékpó. É géē je ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú uwā, é kē í habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā tá.

eng_Latn: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú kú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā jikwū klla yēkwū igelī nyā, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo í lá iyó ɔ́hí kú uwā í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ukɛnán le pīya iháyí ofu ɛtá ce igwó ā, ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ nōo lé ka Umahálálɛ̄ɛlu.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ le ācɛ o yúfú wā í gbɔɔ́ ō wúla uwá tāajɛ, ī hɛ́ uwā éjulúgwu á. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɔfú nēe gē gbō iyī uwā ɛyí ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
idu_Latn: kwú ajɛ éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā ú lá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ije kú nū bī wā gaá tá iyɔ̄bū ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ujeremíya ú, kwú ɔ́ngbá ú tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú obugā kú Umalkíya, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Obugā ā yɔ̄ inu kú ācogbāajɛ kú ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ obuga ā ŋ́, ɔ́tɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́tɔ̄ ā le Ujeremíya hɛ́ gā ɛháajɛ piyɔ á.

eng_Latn: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
idu_Latn: ɛcí ōpa, imabɔ̄, eyījii ō tāācɛ, ikpɛ́lá ō yá, ímálanyī, ícɔ̄nū, oōkɔ̄ ígwíígwu útū ō hɛ́.

eng_Latn: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
idu_Latn: N gē gbēyī ká ā lɛ um nyatá, Óndú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
idu_Latn: Ń gāa yá Ujerúsālɛm italā gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nāa gekwú. N géē cɛ̄ gā awɔ ká ā nyɔ̄ í tá aádā uwɔ ipú ɛbɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ a lɛ ohi kú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kpó gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó yá ɛbɔ́ mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ nɛ̄ɛ, ayíka ācɛ Uhám nēe lā Ugíbeyɔn ā. Ó le ācɛ o hile ā kpó yálé kpɛ́mm ɔgbɛ́fú nɛ̄ ó kpó ā.

eng_Latn: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
idu_Latn: Asárīya, ɔyí kú Uhilkíya nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā wɛ Umésulámi, Usádɔ̄ku, Umeráyɔtu, Ahítūbu.

eng_Latn: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi kú uwɔ nwuné nɛ̄hi, a klla lɛ ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu, ɛga nāa yá aólɛlā kú uwɔ lé ā.

eng_Latn: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōlé dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lé nēé le éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛtɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā pīya tū ɔ̄, géē wɛ ɔdēelihɔ. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gwá glá nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛtɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, í je tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
idu_Latn: Umakéda, Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
idu_Latn: N jé ucē nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā. N kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē yíhɔtū tá īyī aá lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá háyi kpaakpa ga um lɛ ā ā. N jé úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá yá ohígbū um ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔ́tū gbojī ipú ōwē lɛ ā ā. N jé ka aá yɔ̄ ī yá abālɔbányā fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ yá obōōbū nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā.

eng_Latn: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú. A tīīhɔ, a klla tōo lɔtūce ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi! Eko nyá nɛ̄ a géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nēe kpó alɔ ŋmó ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ italā yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Óndú ā wɛ ɔlá ō fíyáajɛ kú um á. A le fíyáajɛ ga um ipú obū.

eng_Latn: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ajɛ kú Usísarīya ā, ó le yɛ ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá le okónu hɛ́ tū ācɛ kú icɔ́ɔci ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Ántīyɔ̄ku á.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi je lɛ uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ígbóje nɛ̄hɛ́ o táajɛ ofɛpa, ɛpɛɛpa wɛ ákú ɔ́kpa éyééye.

eng_Latn: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, aá lā oyēeyī kā aá eko nōo hile lɛ aá ɛcɛ nyā ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā, ó híī wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ tíne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, ācɛ ā lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ. É klla le ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú gwó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
idu_Latn: N yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛ̄nyā o yá kú aá mla uwá kú aá lɔtū lɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō wā í yíhɔtū tá iyī aá tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya tayínū jé kpócíí, nōo wɛ o lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū ā jé.

eng_Latn: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá gwɛ́ɛya nōo le kpaakpa ā lɛ Óndú ā. Kú aá kwú ɔtū kú aá ú ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
idu_Latn: Agbénú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē hágágā ī lɛ ā, gē hágágā ī mɛ fíyɛ́. Amáŋ agbénú ō lɛ ɛmɛɛma géē nyīla klla í gbojī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya le ɛlā kú uwā pó ā, ó le úwé kú nū híla, anɔ́ɔ ó kwu īlī ekwu ú kpó wiiyē á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ka anúɔ kwú ɔhā mɛ́mla okónu oōtá ú tá íyɔ̄bū uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le kpó hídáagó! Ufi lɛ uwá kwú, anɔ́ɔ é tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɔdā ō yéyījii nɛ̄ alɔ má ícɛ yɔ̄ dúú á á.

eng_Latn: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ń lɛ ɔkɔ dúúmā ō ka ŋ́. Ɔkɔ ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī gbā lɛ Ɔwɔīcō nōo ī kɛpɔ̄ tū um ā, kóō méyīnyinyi um á.

eng_Latn: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
idu_Latn: Ā híī nwúleyīkwū ō bī ɔdā dúúmā nāa má ā ga únɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nōo má odée ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, lɛ ijáalí kú uwɔ ŋmónyí bɛ́ɛ́gɛ? Abɔ̄ a géē yá lɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
idu_Latn: É wɛ ayí kú Abíhēlu, ɔyí kú Uhúri nɛ̄ ɛma kú ádáádā uwá gaá kwu Abíhēlu, Uhúri, Ujárōwa, Ugílɛ̄di, Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Ujessisáyi, Ujádo, Ubúsi.

eng_Latn: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔdā nɛ n je ka ó le kpaakpa, ń gáā bī ɛdɔ kú ōcē nɛ n tū klá ācɛ Íjīpiti ā lɛ yá aá italā ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá kú aá á.

eng_Latn: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, n má ɔkpáncō abɔ̄ ó le nwūla, anɔ́ɔ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ háyi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá nááná, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛlā um ōfōōfū um nɛ. Ó cíkā ó wɛ ɛlā aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɛ́nɛ́ nū kahíníī, Ísɔ, ɔyínɛ um, bū ɔnwū nɛ̄hi, ń kē bū ɔnwū nwuné ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unáaman kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka á mīyɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá abɔ̄ um ŋ́, ayíka a cɛ̄ kú n̄ lɛ iyo kú ɔjɛ nɛ̄ ijakī ɛpa géē bī ŋmá ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu glá ā miya gā um. Ohígbū ka o ŋmá abālɔbányā, ami, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ í gáā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka Óndú, Ɔwɔ̄icō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm āa, ɛmiyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uhoronéyim bá í dīíbáā ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gáā je uwā yíífi, klla í je ɔlɛ́ uwā tá alácɛ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ géē hī aá ka ācɛ ogwéeyē nēé lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá. Ohígbū ka ajɛ kú aá géē je pīya ɛga olɔhi nɛ̄ ācɛ í lā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si í cɛ̄ kóō nyɔ̄ mla anú ŋ́, ó da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ Kwúcē igbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ gá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ ka lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ményinyi nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó kɔ̄ ɛpa jōōnjīlɛ̄. Ɛga éyi wɛ ákú aícɔ́ɔja ā, ɛga ɔhá ā wɛ ákú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ahínyá dúú nɛ̄ alɔ ī tá Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ohígbū aá nōo ī jɛ̄ alɔ eyī glá ohígbū aá ŋ́. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gwéeyē nɛ̄hi iyɔ̄bū nū ohígbū aá ā.

eng_Latn: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā í klla jé ipɔ́ɔma nēé ŋmá gɛ ŋ́ dúú. É wɛ, Uhobáya, Uhákosi, mla Ubasílāyi, Ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubasílāyi lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubasílāyi kú Ugílɛ́di, klla kwú iyē kú ohilí nū ā ú ce ipɔ́ɔma kú nū.

eng_Latn: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan le da Udéfīdi ka ádā anúɔ gē tíne kóō je ɔ́ ŋmó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kwu iyī nū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ócí. Ó kóō lɛ kwu tayínū ɛga éyi kú ɔ̄ klá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ le ɛhɔ̄ tū, anɔ́ɔ é gaá le Adónīja bī ŋmá ɛgiyí ede ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā gaá tūkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū, lɛ ɔ́gbá tá ɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ o hile ā kéē ce ɛyí ígbɔ́cí mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú úgbéenyi ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɔ pɛ́ kwu wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
idu_Latn: N bī uwɔ le wúla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācocɔnya tāajɛ. N klla bī uwɔ le wúla aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē pɛ́ uwā ā tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
idu_Latn: A klla lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tútū nōo géē je uwɔ cɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm. A klla í ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka, awɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ɔdā nāa yɔ̄ í yá nyā, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi géē pó piíí. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami mɛ́mla awɔ kóō le jīla, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā gwó tū.

eng_Latn: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
idu_Latn: N gē tá Ɔwɔicō kú um ahínyá ojigógó ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nōó yá lɛ aá ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, n da ɔyípɛ ā ka, Nyɔ̄ ánáánūmā abɔ́ɔ, nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔyí ā kpó wā, ayíka kwu nyōōnyɔ̄, Óndú ā lɛ uwɔ nū nyɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu gā a, ācɛ Ujíyu nēe wā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā le jīla tū ɔ̄, gē cē ɛlā okwíyē alɛwa, nɛ̄ uwá í kē lɛ ijáalí dúú nōo lɔfú cɛ̄ ka ɛlā kú uwā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu wā gaá lɛ eyī pīya kla ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ le okónu hɛ́ tū ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ hɔ́hā ce anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ágábáidu ā. Ó ka anúɔ le jé ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔtū anúɔ ɔ́ɔ he ɔ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ ba ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ubássan, mɛ́mla ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔcī nōo yɛ jāā ga aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Usaléka mɛ́mla Édrēyi ā.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n da aá ka ayíka ucē okpaakpa nɛ̄ aá yá le fíyɛ́ ákú aítíca kú íne ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi ā, ámāŋ aá gáā ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
idu_Latn: Uhanámɛlu, ayínɛ̄ɛpa kú uwɔ, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ussálum, ɔmáapú ádā uwɔ ā, géē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ gáā da uwɔ ka ā lɛ ajɛ kú anúɔ nōo yɔ̄ Ánatɔ̄ɔtu ā lá. Ka abɔ̄ awɔ wɛ ɔmáapú anúɔ nōo kwu anúɔ ajaajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú á, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwɔ ka á lɛ ajɛ á lá.

eng_Latn: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
idu_Latn: É kwú utánki kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā ú ce ɔkíkā kú ɛháajɛ lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kē ī má ka ɛ́ɛ yá ucē okpaakpa tá ayókwū mɛ́mla anyōkwū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gē yíhɔtū tá ācɛ kú aéwɔhá nēe lā ajɛ kú uwá ā, klla ī jē ɔdōlé mɛ́mla īlī lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klā da Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á lɛ óbō ámāŋ ka ɔkpacaŋgelī amānyā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ cɔlɔ́ɔ́lá ā, ń bī iyɔ́fú dóódu ámāŋ ka ɔkpacaŋgelī kú um dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā pīyeyī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō lɛ alɔ má.

eng_Latn: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē hɛ́hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, gē lɛ ɔdōlé ō lé á. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī mīya úklɔ́ báajɛ áncā ā, wɛ olíla, ɛmiyɛ ī ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
idu_Latn: Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya lɛ ɔcí kú Usɛ́da, mɛ́mla ācɛ ogwɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄cí tū fu Udéfīdi kéē le agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū gwó.

eng_Latn: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kē lɔfú je ɛhi lɛ aá fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cɛgbá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ gē je aɔ́dā nēe ce aá ɛgbá ā lɛ aá ŋmá ɔwɛ dóódu ā, aá géē lɛ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá cɛgbá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē je nwuné nwuné le tá úklɔ́ olɔhi dóódu abɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, iní nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā? Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Á tū um ɔkwu ga ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā ā glá ŋ́, amáŋ a géē yɛce um igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā kwú ɔyípɛ̄ āa mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ú, ká ā kwúcē ga ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe tíne ō ŋmó ɔyípɛ̄ ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ámāŋ éwɔhá kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, nōo géē tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́ ɛbɛ́ ipácí ámāŋ ɔtɛ́ kú ígbáanɔ, nōó le ɛbɛ́ ámāŋ ka ígbáanɔ̄ ŋmó, ó í fu oyī kú nū bá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ajɛ gwu klá anú.

eng_Latn: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Ó klla yēeyī iháyí úlā ɛpa ɔhā kpɔ́. Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ bī ga ajɛ kú Ukénan, le ɔ́ nyi únóji kú Umakpéla, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umámre, ajɛ nɛ́ Ébrahām lá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Éfrɔn, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā, koó wɛ ajɛ nēé ī nyi okwū ā.

eng_Latn: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ ī lé ā gē yá kú Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄tra alɔ. Ocɛ̄tra kú nū ī yá ka alɔ lɛ eyīyōce.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílístiya wā gaá bá ɔpɛ́ kú Urefém ā.

eng_Latn: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī kóō lɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ itali gɔ́ ɔ̄, a géē yɔ̄ ī nya ɔ́ tá ŋmá ikwū nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā, gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē yá ucē okpaakpa lɛ ā, odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ gē má ɛgahi kú nū.

eng_Latn: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔfú kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n gē le nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ á. Ó lɛ ā, ɔ́ɔmā kē cābɔ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō gaá cɔ́cɛ́ ipú aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ nwūla lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpancō ā, ká alɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tū gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ɔdā o lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó ofɛhɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú okwúukwu í kwajɛ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ lɛlá kwú ɔ́ɔ dúú ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ italā yá ɔ̄ piíí. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō yá mla anú. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ má kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó piíí.

eng_Latn: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ éyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ádā nū ā hīgwú le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí yɔ̄ í yá ā mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaimzophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Ɛlkána. Ó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, ó kē lā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uráma, nōo yɔ̄ ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem ā. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú Ujérōham, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ɛlíhu ā, ɔyí kú Utóhi, ɔyí kú Usúfu.

eng_Latn: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
idu_Latn: Unikɔdímɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá ā géē yá glá ā.

eng_Latn: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó tíne kóō wā í tá ipú ayíkpó ā. Amáŋ é yúufi nū ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ kóō wɛ ɔyíkpó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ɛ́lpaalu ā wɛ, Usébadíya, Umésúlam, Uhíski, Uhɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ahāapa kú ɔyí ā le yá ā, é le pɛ́ wā gáā hɛ́ ɔyí ā apī. Anɔ́ɔ é gáā je ɔ́ hī Usɛkaríya nōo wɛ iyē ádā nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ɛyí kú aɔ́dā ɔlɛ́ acá oōbī wu ā, anɔ́ɔ n má odée bɛ̄ɛka akpa kú ɔcɛ́ nēé bī ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléko ɔ́ɔmā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn lɛ íbɔm ce tū Ujerúsālɛm, amáŋ eko nēé le pó ka aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ɛ́ɛ kwú bū ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti bēhé ī wā ɛɛ́ mā, é kwúcē igbīhi ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Usérūgu wɛ iháyí ofucigwó ā, ó le ɔyí éyi, nōó hī ka Unáhɔ ma.

eng_Latn: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ayínɛ́ nū ɛhɔ̄ nēe nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú ā mafú lɛ Uféro á.

eng_Latn: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā lɛ ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Ɛ́ri.

eng_Latn: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, tá alɔ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ alɔ nyatá. Lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá káā kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ú yá alɔ ɛhi, Ohígbū ojīlīmā kú awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ayí aflɛ́yí kú ɛna mɛ́mla álá kú uwā nēe wɛ ɔbá ā ú kpó báajɛ lɛ Óndú ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī ɛna ɔ́ɔmā yúklɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē wā álá ā ɔnwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
idu_Latn: N lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. N lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú inu kú ayí kú Uhánan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Igdalíya ā. Inu ā gbo ce inu kú aígabɔ̄ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi á. Inu ā kē yō icō kú inu kú ɔyí kú Umáasēyah, ɔ̄cogbɔɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ussálum ā.

eng_Latn: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ukanā nɛ̄hi gā lɛ uwá á, anɔ́ɔ é le kābɔ̄ hī iyī uwā tá á. Ubánābasi kwú Umáki ú bíyē le yɛ tá úgbéenyi nyɔ̄ Usáyíprɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū néē lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugígal á.

eng_Latn: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ Ujísɔ̄si le tá ipú ɔ́kɔ mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, N géē tū aá bá, odúúdú aá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe hile ā. N géē bī uwā í tɔ̄há lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nēe bá ī pīyɛyí wā inu ā. Lɛbɛ̄ɛka ipácí ɛga o lé ɔdōlé kú álá nōo le mu ā, ajɛ kú aá géē mu mla ācɛ alɛwa igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔyí nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē je lɛ ɔ́ bū ipú kú ɔnyā ā, kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ nū yá bɛ̄ɛka ipɔ́ɔnū kú Upɛrɛ́si, ɔyí kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Utáma ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
idu_Latn: Aá híī wūūwī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
idu_Latn: Ogbɛnú kú odúúdu ɔdā nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kpó wā ā, wɛ usɛ́kɛlu ofigwó.

eng_Latn: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
idu_Latn: É kwú ojīlīmā, mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō ā ú, lɛ ojibó kú ɛna nōo gē lé ácí ā.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú da um kahíníi.

eng_Latn: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kahíníī, N géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ um ɛga nɛ̄ um ŋmá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā. Eko nōó kwúcē nyɔ̄ ā, ó má bā ó táncā, é kē lɛ ɔ́ gwu klla le ɔ́ tútū.

eng_Latn: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
idu_Latn: Igelī nōo ācɛ pó ofu nū ɛbɛɛbɛ ā gaá tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ó tɛtɛ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
idu_Latn: N jé ka ami wɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā nááná, abɔ̄ le hɛ́ um iyē ícɛ. Ayí kú Userúyah le lɔfú ikpo ce um abɔ̄ bá. Ɔwɔicō kóō yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ ujɔ̄ tū kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē kwú ɔ̄ ipú ɛlā nōó í ka āa.

eng_Latn: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo húmáyī bī um yɛ ā lɛ um bī ga ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga aínu nēe pīyeyī kwu ɛhícō, kwu okómpinu kú ɛháajɛ kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā ajaajɛ ā. Aínu ɔ́ɔmā wɛ inu ōtīhɔ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó lɛ abɔ̄ mīya kwú ɛga éyi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú aínu ā.

eng_Latn: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá kwinya ŋmá ajɛ Ubábīlɔn. Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá éwo ɔ́ɔmā. Aá kóō wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēe géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá éwo ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka wɛ ka Ɔwɔicō le ɛka gbo lɛ Ébrahām anɔ́ɔ ó kē lɛ okónu ce ka anúɔ í lɛ ɔ́ tū. Íne nēé je iháyí úlā cofu cigwó Igbīhāajɛ ā, í lɔfú ŋmó ɛka nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ ī gbo ā nyí klla lɛ okónu nēé ce ā bīya glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá Usɔ́lu ohi kahíníī, N bī āyā éyi kú o kɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ kú īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́. N géē je ɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ í lɔfú pīyɛ̄ aíjakī ā glá ā mafú lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu, n géē pūla éwo éyi tū aá. É géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú aá tū ɔkwu, klla í lɛ abɔ̄ da aá ɛyí tāajɛ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú Uhamáti nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō ā jāā ga ɔkpá kú Arébīya, nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
idu_Latn: Ébram wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wū mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu.

eng_Latn: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ lɛ ɔkpíyē nōo lɛ ābɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí alɛwa nēe kē ī yúklɔ́ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá gaá tíne Ujeremíya cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ leyī kwu ɔ́ lɔhi. Aá yá ɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōó tíne ā yá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ɛbɛ́, ó gáā wɛ ɛ̄cī éyi, ámāŋ ɛ̄cī ɛpa ŋ́, ámāŋ ɛ̄cī ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, ámāŋ ɛ̄cī igwó ŋ́, ámāŋ ɛ̄cī ofu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ yá uwɔ ā ú yá alɔ ɛhi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ je ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ yá alɔ ā yá uwā ɛhi ā. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ ga ipú ojámá olɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́. Eko le yá nɛ̄ n gáā cāŋjɛ yá ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā ɛɛ́. Ń gáā lɛ eyī gwō ɔ́bíipú kú aá bónū, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē ményinyi aá ŋ́. N géē je ōwē kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā lɛ aá. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá bla ka Utáyítɔ̄si wɛ obíyē kú um. Ami mla anú yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há ohígbū olɔhi kú aá. Ācɛ o cɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ɛpa nēe bá gē nyɔ̄ mla anú ā kwɛyí aícɔ́ɔci, úklɔ́ kú uwā kē ī bī ojīlīmā gé lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le eyī pīya kwu ɔwɛ kú Ubássan, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, Ógu, gā ɛcɛ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kóō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ajɛ kú Édríyɛ.

eng_Latn: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí gē pó ɔ̄kā kú ɔdōōbɔ̄bí. Ɔ̄cɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kē ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ucē olɔhi nōo géē mafú lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ka aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá ī bīya ā. Aá híīī yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ iyī aá ka Ébrahām wɛ ádáádā aá ŋ́. N da aá ka Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɛ aɛ́cɔ̄ nēe bá nyā pīya ayááyí lɛ Ébrahām glá.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá nēe gē tū íne obɔ̄bí, mɛ́mla aá nēe klla tū íne nēe ī bī le pīya ācɛ tū ā.

eng_Latn: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō jé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n gē yá, ó kōō ī ka áluka ikpó nɛ̄ n gē fu ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ n da aá ka aá híīī lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í lé kú aá yēeyī ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka īlī nɛ̄ aá géē le wiiyē a ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Ɔwɔicō gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nēé gē gbā ā. Ɔwɔicō í gē tá ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔbī ā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā kóō híī cikpó ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā dúúmā gē cɛ̄ kú ɛbɛ́ dúúmā kóō cikpó nū ŋ́. Ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā gē jē ɔ̄cɛ tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
idu_Latn: Utímōti leyīkwu ɔdā nēé kpó tū uwɔ abɔ̄ āa. Ā híī nyɔ̄ gaá ka ɔ̄kā icííci mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ge táafu kú íla nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī gē hī ɔdōojé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ jila ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā ɔ́dāŋ ka odée ā le nyīla ipú īlī ā, kwú ɛdɔ kú ɔdā dúúmā nēé gē yá í le wiiyē ā, ayíka ó wɛ ɛdɔ úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká nōo ī nyīla ā nɛ. Ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ anú kwú tēelihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, é je Ujeremíya tá agbá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ kú nū ga ɛga dóódu ipú ācɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, Óndú nōo nya aá tá ā kahíníī, Ami ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Óndú aá á. Ami gē nwū aá ɔwɛ nōo géē lɔhi lɛ aá ā. N klla géē ma ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē yɛ ā fú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ í gáā yi uwɔ ɔlá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔyā ī yá uwɔ ɔdā dúúmā otú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le Umósīsi hīgwú ŋmá ipū Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ pɛtɛɛ ā, é le úcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō pó abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ídɛn ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā le pɛ́ kwu í tayínū igbīhi aɔ́cí, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híī má uwā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé ɔdā dúúmā nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí ŋ́, aá lé ɔdā dúúmā mla oyī kú nū ŋ́, aá lé ɛbɛ́ nēé ŋmó ŋmá lɛ o le ɔ́ ɔkɔ nyacē gbuúlú ŋ́, aá cikpɔ́nyā ɔhá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ iyī aá kwú cíí ŋmá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, ó géē lɔhi lɛ aá. Aá mŋ́móō.

eng_Latn: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éwɔhá nēé kpó wā í lā ajɛ kú Ujúda eko nēe kpó ācɛ kú Ujúda ga Ubábīlɔn ā, gbɔɔ́ ō yá kú ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe pīyɛyí ā, kóō gbenyi, é klla gbɔɔ́ ō tū uwá ufi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ kú aflāāflɛ̄yī ā mɛ́mla ɔwɔ kú igbīhāajɛ ā yā ŋ́ má. Aá bá ipú ɛcí ō pā uwēyī í kōō ī yá aá ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ olagwú éyi gā gaá lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ lɛ ɔ́ klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka a cɛ̄, a lɔfú yá um yēŋēē glá.

eng_Latn: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ísɔ le jé ka Áyísīki ɔ́ɔ le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Ujékɔ̄pu klla lɛ ɔ́ɔ tū nyɔ̄ ga Umɛsopotámīya kóō gaá lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ā. Ó klla le jé ka eko nɛ̄ Áyísīki hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ ā, ó le ukɔ́ tū ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ŋmá Ukénan ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ébrahām da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛ ɛlá wū ɛlā kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā glá ŋ́, é kōō gáā cɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
idu_Latn: kwu aálá, kwu aɛ́na, kwu aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí.

eng_Latn: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
idu_Latn: Alɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka Umósīsi nōo gē lɛ īlī klá eyī cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē híīī má oceyī kú eyī kú nū nōo yɔ̄ gē mɛtáajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gē má ka eyī kú nū yɔ̄ ī fiyajɛ gē ceyī. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú īlī ú klá eyī jāā gbéeko ɔhá nɛ̄ó le yɛ nyɔ̄ kóō kɛlā mla Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le jɛ̄ ā, ɛ̄cī éyi, ó le yɛ ga ɛcɛ, ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ācɛ Uhíbru, anɔ́ɔ ó má ɛgɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ī pi uwá abɔ̄fú kéē yúklɔ́ olɔfú ā. Ó kōō má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti éyi yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Uhíbru kú ɔlɛ́ Umósīsi éyi ijē lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
idu_Latn: N gē bī odúúdú ɔtū kú um lɛ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Óndú, n gē ka odúúdú úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú idáagó kú uwɔ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ da uwá kéē híī kpɛ́fú tá uwā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā je āyā kú ajɛ kú uwā dúúmā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ īkpō éyi kú nū. Ohígbū ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísɔ, kóō wɛ ákú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú nū ā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī móōwē yɔ̄ á. É kóō lɛ agbá kwu um bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā nááná, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kwú ɔna ō tá kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gāá je odée gwɛ́ɛya kú olétɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ nɛɛ, ó géē wɛ ɔbá ɛna nōó lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
idu_Latn: É klla kwú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla aúlífāyi ú kpó tū úklɔ́ kú uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Le da ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū kéē gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí aákpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā, ohígbū ka aɔ́fulā kú uwā lɔɔlɔhi ā géē kpó mīya wā ajɛ ŋmá uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ bī ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ká alɔ lɛ ā le yúklɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ lɛ alɔ lɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛhi kú alɔ wɛ ō bī olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɔ́ɔna nɛɛ, ālɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna í kwu ɛ̄jīla nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō í kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni lɛ okwutɛ kú nū nā pīya cíla éŋkpɔ̄ dóódu kú Íjīpiti á. Anɔ́ɔ aábaná le tū klɛ́ɛcɛ wā í klá odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
idu_Latn: A géē ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka gā uwɔ ā lɛ Árɔ̄ni, anú ā géē da ɔcɛ́ kóō mā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
idu_Latn: É da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Utíca, eko nyá nɛ̄ ɛnyā í yá ā? Ɔdí géē yá nōo í mafú ka eko kú ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka kóō í yá ā gā ɛɛ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔ́da kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔdōlɔhi lɔfú yá glá á.

eng_Latn: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ éwo ɔ́ɔmā mabɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé ī yá ā tá. N gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n ka ka n̄ géē yá uwā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ yá tayínū kpɛ́mm ā, Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ ca klɛ́ɛcɛ gēdēē.

eng_Latn: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
idu_Latn: Asriyɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ussɛ́kɛmu.

eng_Latn: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlā okónu kú um yá kóō ī ga iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋgelī nōo lulé nɛ̄hi ā. Ó kwú um tayínū ipú ɔtābɔ̄ kú nū, le abɔ̄ klá tū um. Ó lɛ um tútū kóō bī um le yúklɔ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tū ɔyī kú nū ulé ī je ɔ́ tayínū ipú aháŋgbā ā.

eng_Latn: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
idu_Latn: Íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā lɛwa íbí, Óndú. Lɛ okónu nāa ce ā yá, ká ā kwú aíne nɛ̄ n bīya í kpó yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu klla gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi Udéfīdi fíyɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwú Udéfīdi ú pīya olɛlā kú nū piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛbɛ́ ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ he lɔnyɛ gé um, ká n̄ le ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwɔ ipéyī Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! N hayi pī okompīinu gē lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔwɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú lɛ ɔkɔ kú um pó, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla ga um, n géē bēhé wā ipíinu ɛgiyí nū. N géē le ɔdōlé mɛ́mla anú, ó kē í lé mɛ́mla um.

eng_Latn: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ ó má Ujísɔ̄si háyi, amáŋ ó jé ká ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
idu_Latn: Ā híī mīyɛ ayípɛ̄ nɔ̄nyā kéē wɛ anyōkwū ipú icɔ́ɔci ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ unwū kú ɔkpíye kú uwā le nwuné, é géē dɔɔ̄kā ká e lɛ ɔbá. Ɛ̄nyā kē í yá kéē cīgbīhi ŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā kú Ujerúsālɛm, N le tá óbí, amáŋ n jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄hi, n le sunúúú bɛ̄ɛka otómbīye ā. N klla héyīfuú bɛ̄ɛka ukɔ́tin kú inu ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce uwá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ̄ɛ ma ayí alɛwa, kéē klla lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka ɔfú ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá iyē kú anúɔ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó pīyeyī má ójila ā, anɔ́ɔ ó dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ le abɔ̄ kwu úwé kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, le túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū, lɛ ɔ́ kwú bɔ́tū. Lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔbɔ́lā kú iyí uwā da. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Umósīsi á.

eng_Latn: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá nyɔ̄ í kwú ɛna ojɔ̄kwū ú kú aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ gwéeyē kú alɔ lé ucɛ!.

eng_Latn: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn nēé bī ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū yɔ̄ ī wā abɔ́ɔ á. Aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ofɛtá le ɔ́ yɛjīla tá yɔ̄ ī gbō ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú Ujɛ́futa á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla Umanásɛ klla pīyɛyí wā Umíspa ipú Ugílɛ̄di. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le yɛ gɔbū ga ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn á.

eng_Latn: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē je Umówābu pīya bɛ̄ɛka ocíbú ō bī le na abɔ̄ kú um. N klla ī tá áblákpá kú um ce Ɛ́dɔm cɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú nū á. N géē dɛ̄ɛgba ōgwú tū ācɛ kú Ufilístīya, kóō mafú ka n lɛ uwá yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: É bī Usólōmɔn ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū, nēé bī ɔcí nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú le gbā ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le aíkpɛ́cí kpó gwó Ujúda dúú. Ó klla lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ikpó kpó tū ɔ́bíipú ō bī tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā plla, nōo lɛ ohi nōo wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tá nɛɛ, ayíka anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ plá ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā je ohi ɔ́ɔmā á. Anúɔ kē géē je ɔ́ ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya le ācɛ kpó ŋmá aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn, Ukútan, Áfa, Uhámati, mɛ́mla Uséfāfém gaá kwú uwā ú kpó nyɔ̄ ú lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya, kwɛyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ é má lā anú á.

eng_Latn: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɛ̄cī ofɛpa igbīhi ikwū kú nū ā, ó hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ipú uwā igbo alɛwa nōo mafú péee nōó tū ō táafú nū ŋ́ kóō yēeyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. É má ɔ̄ igbo alɛwa, ó kē kɛlā lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, aá kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu. Aá da ɔ́ odúúdú unwalu kú aá, ohígbū ka anú gē leyīkwu alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá géē bī aálá le hīla ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ijakī dóódu ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá dɔɔ̄kā ō hīla ɔyí ijakī ā ŋ́, aá lɛ ɔ́ ɔkɔ cē. Amáŋ aá géē hīla ɔ́kplá kú aá dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le italā yá Uféro mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ohígbū Usárāyi, ɔnyā kú Ébram.

eng_Latn: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ejé nēe yá ŋmá ɛ́fa kú ɛgwā obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ okpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi éyi bá ī wā ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā nōo kwu ajɛ ɛhícō ā. É bá ī tútū ɛfú ŋmá ɛga oligbó ā gē wā.

eng_Latn: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ̄ wā gaá le abɔ̄ kwajɛ lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwa kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú agbá. Anɔ́ɔ é ké lē da uwá kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī kú ɔlɛ́ aá á.

eng_Latn: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ɔmɛɛtá kú Ísɔ nōo lé ka Oholibáma, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ána, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usíbīyɔn ā, ma ayí ɛtá lɛ Ísɔ. Iyē kú uwā lé ka Ujéyuss, Ujálam, mɛ́mla Ukóra.

eng_Latn: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
idu_Latn: Usóra, Áíjālɔn, mɛ́mla Uhɛ́burɔn.

eng_Latn: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, lɛ ɔ̄cogwíje éyi hīgwú gā um abālɔbányā. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ gē gwííjē klla í gwō ɛnwu tū ɔ̄ ā, ofú kú Óndú ā wā í klá Ɛláyíssa.

eng_Latn: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
