idu_Latn: Ó le ede kú ubáalu gwó kwu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ iyē kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ kéē gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
idu_Latn: Ugáálu klla da ɔ́ igbɔhá koó má ācɛ bá ī wā ajɛ ŋmá owúlatū kú ɛfu ā, aígwu ɔhá bá ī wā ŋmá ɔwɛ kú ɔkwu ɔcí kú óokú kú ɔ̄cɛ ogwɛ́ɛbā ā.

eng_Latn: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
idu_Latn: Ŋmífī nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí Uféro gaá bī iyē kú uwɔ lɛ kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā, nɛ̄ ó hímāyī yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ otɛtɛ á. Á kē yá ɔdā dúúmā ká ā hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpá nēé tá fu ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odɔlɛ́ ā le hɛ́gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔhá, ó kōō jeyī gicō kóō má ɔkpáncō glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ó le abɔ̄ gɔ́ ɔtū kú nū kóō mafú ɔtūnōbí, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō, ményinyi um, n wɛ ɔ̄cobīyíne.

eng_Latn: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
idu_Latn: Aínyílɔ́wɔ géē kpó míya wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō, é géē jíla ɔfú kú ɔkpáncō iyē.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
idu_Latn: Aá gáā yá ojibó dúúmā ɛ́gbla kú ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ámāŋ ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ámāŋ ka ipú éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ iyī aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si māhayi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kahíníī, Aá lɛ opeyī ā bī gé um. Eko nōó gā ajaajɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá wā í tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu ɛbɔ́ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ. Ó tɔ́ɔna lɛ aá aílɔ́wá nēe ligbó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kē tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe kwu Ɔwɔicō ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē gbonɛnɛ lɛ ɔyí nū lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yúufi nū ā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛyíkwu o je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō wā tāajɛ ipú únóji ŋ́ mā, N géē hɔ́hā otīihɔ nɛ̄ n ce Udéfīdi okónu nū ā ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī gē má ɛga nēé gē nyɔ̄ ā, amáŋ olíla í kē jé ɔ́ lɛ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔdā ékpónú gē yá ūwā á.

eng_Latn: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
idu_Latn: O yɛ ga ɛhícō ā, ajɛ ā kwú nyā lɛyíkwu Uhánātɔn. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í le ŋmɛ́yí ɔpɛ́ kú Ufitáhɛlu ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í gáā tá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yá ucē kpaakpa ā ŋ́. Ó kē gáā tá ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bī ā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra anú ohígbū odúúdú úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Aá cɛ̄tra anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó jājīlīmā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
idu_Latn: N da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, awɔ jé uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā wɛ ācɛ nēe wi ŋmá eko kú ákanya nɛ̄hi ā á. É lɛ awulú kú uwā kpó na, klla le yá kóō le pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ipú oyī kú Ɔyí álá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú je ohígbū ācɛ kú Asírīya ā. Ó kahíníī, É gáā lɛ ayááyí dúúmā nēe géē lé iyē kwu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē kpó ájibó kú aɛ́cí nōo bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú aá ā yíífi. N géē bū únóji bá ajɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Asírīya, ohígbū keé cíkā ō yēeyī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ kwú pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú itekwú ā. É wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí gwū iyī uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um gwutá ɔlɛ́ ohígbū ka iyē kú nū le ŋmó, ó klá yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ iyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Uhosíya kóō nyɔ̄ gaá i kagwo mla ɔnyā nōo wɛ akwuna klla ī gbaajā a. Ka ɔ́ɔ géē yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ yíihɔtū tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nááná nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ nēé ī gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā gaá yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā klla ī gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā lɛ ɛcí.

eng_Latn: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā da Usɔ́lu ka cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ lɛ Ujonátan nɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā ŋmó kɛ̄ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ehée, alɔ cokónu ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú ā nōo yēeyī ā ka, īnyīlɛyí ékpónú kú nū í gáā bí ŋmá ɛyí kú nū ŋ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ alɔ ícɛ nyā, Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó yá ɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā lɛ Ujonátan hɛ́tá, anɔ́ɔ é je ɔ́ ŋmó gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tá ācogwɛ́ɛya wā ajɛ, klla ī mīyɛ ācɛ nēe le íkwu nɛ̄hi kú íkée ā ɔfú.

eng_Latn: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū nēe bá ā ma ayí dúu. Ugɛ́ssɔn wɛ ádā kú Ulíbini mɛ́mla Ussímēyi á.

eng_Latn: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́dɔ, Ahíyo, Usékaríya mɛ́mla Umíklɔ̄tu nōo wɛ.

eng_Latn: And the way of peace have they not known:
idu_Latn: É jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lā ɛbɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
idu_Latn: Ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ ā géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ígbíli kú Usíni, ɛgiyí ɛjī kú Ɛ́dɔm ā, ɛjī kú ɛháajɛ ā géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú ísu ɔmā ā, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Owu gē tá ɛga dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ a gē pó úcɛ́ kú nū, amáŋ á jé ɛga nɛ̄ ó ŋmá ŋ́, á kē jé ɛga nōó gē nyɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēé bī Alelékwū ma ā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā géē wɛ ɛka nɛ̄ um gbo mɛ́mla uwɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ ga ayááyí uwɔ, ká aá kóō lɛ ɔ́ tū á. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ká aá dóódu géē hɛ́ apī.

eng_Latn: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gā Usíkilāgi ā, ó lɛ ōhī kú iyó nēe bī ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aóklóbīya nū, aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, yɔ̄ ī da uwá ka, ɛhi ā wɛ ákú uwā ŋmá ipú iyó kú aólɛlā kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ aá kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
idu_Latn: Usára lɛ uwá má, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ébrahām kahíníī, Lɛ ɔfiyɛ nyā mɛ́mla ɔyí nū ā nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́, ohígbū ka ɔyí ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā nyā í gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lúgwū mɛ́mla ɔyí um, Áyísīki, ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
idu_Latn: Ó tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔgālā anɔ̄ ofɛhɔ̄. Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cīce fíyaa, cɛ́ɛ́ ā le ofɛpa cigwó tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwā ā kwú íne kú um u nyílá, é klla lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔdā otīihɔ kú um ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É kllá jé ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā otīihɔ mla ɔdā nōo tīhɔ ŋ́ má gɛ ŋ́. É klla jé ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā oyēŋēē mla ɔdā oblínyī gɛ ŋ́. É lɛ ɛlá wu ɛ̄cī usábāti kú um ā ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛ ojīlīma ce um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ klla lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā ka ā, é kwúcē nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm, bá ī tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ga ipɔ́lɛ́ alɛwa kú ajɛ Usamérīya.

eng_Latn: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: É le ɔtū kú uwā yá lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā, ohígbū nēé í lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwā bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ kú íkée ā pó.

eng_Latn: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í lɔtūce ɔdā nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um gē ka ā ɔ́ glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ o je yíífi he uwá ɔtū á. Ɛlā olɔnyɛ nōo ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá okónu kú uwā gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɛ́, amáŋ ó gē plla ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwú.

eng_Latn: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo nā ɔkpáncō daa klla yá ɛcɛ, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ yēeyī ā, ka lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
idu_Latn: Óndú, nwū um ɛyí kú íne kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā jāā gaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da ācɛ ohile ā kéē híī bá abɔ́ɔ abɔ̄yī uwā ŋ́. Kéē nū aólɛlā kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tá uwā ŋmá igbīhi. Kéē híī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋ́. Ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ uwá yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ayí kú Ulífāyi í klla gáā bá ī kpó áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla iyó úklɔ́ kú nū ā yɔ̄ ī yɛ gicō gājɛ piyóó ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ga ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla ɔnyā kú Umósīsi, Usipóra nɛ̄ Umósīsi mā ɔ̄ tá igbīhi, ɔlɛ́ ádā nū ā.

eng_Latn: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá gɛcɛ, ohígbū ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā í kwú ŋ́, amáŋ ó yɔ̄ gē gbiyɔ̄lā. Amáŋ é le ɛhɛ yɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gbótú, é bá ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu um, klla bá ī tū ojuju tū um.

eng_Latn: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ń lɔfú yá ɔdā dúú ŋmá ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī um ŋ́. N gē hɛ́pɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da um lɛ ā. Ó lɛ ā ɛpɔ̄ kú um kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ohígbū ka ń gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú um ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔfu ō le eyī méeyī mla āhɔ̄ dúúmā glá, ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē.

eng_Latn: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
idu_Latn: klla bá ī gwíjē mla éeyē abɔ̄ ācɛ bá ī gwō uba mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla ɛ́mula ā.

eng_Latn: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā Ɔwɔicō géē je uwɔ tá ipú abɔ̄ kú um, n géē ŋmó uwɔ fīyɛ̄ ajɛ klla í je uwɔ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē je okwū kú uwɔ, ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā lɛ aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ícɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ɛcɛ géē jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā gáā yá aá dúú á, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá í je yá ɔyínɛ́ nū ɛhi ŋmá ɔtū kú nū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Issaka ā wɛ Unɛtánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúwa.

eng_Latn: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
idu_Latn: Unaómi tá uwā ohi kéē híī hī anúɔ ka Unaómi gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ hī anúɔ ka Umára Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā le ɔdā ohɔ́nɔ nɛ̄hi yá anúɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi da iyī uwā kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ miya kpɛ́ɛ́mm ā í yúklɔ́ dúúmā gɛ ŋ́. Má ɔ̄, ācɛ dóódu gē yɛce ɔ́ ɛɛ.

eng_Latn: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ejé lɛ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, n klla í tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ohígbū ka ó le um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō! Ó lɔfú yá kú aá yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū lɔfú-lɔfú, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka eko nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ aá ā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé mafú ŋmá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo tayínū ŋmá eko ígblé ígblé ā.

eng_Latn: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
idu_Latn: É gē gbēyī um bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē gbēyī ɔwɔ ā. É klla gē gbēyī um bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́glɛ̄ɛ̄jí nēe ī gbēyī ɔwɔ amōōmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta cāŋjɛ anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu ga únóji ā á. Ó túkpɛɛ́ anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā gwū igbogbo kú ahilíki ā ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ le hídáagó kú ɔdā nōo yá ā?.

eng_Latn: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ami nɛ. Aá yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe gē lɛ ojīlīma ce Óndú ā, klla gē lɛyítáájɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē yɛ ā, géē lɔfú dobū nɛ̄hi. Nááná, aá lɔtūce Óndú ā, kú aá gboló ce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō tá Óndú ahínyá ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ alɛɛcɛ, mɛ́mla ohígbū úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. Ó kahíníí, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē je ɔcí ufáyin ŋmá ūpū wā í yɔlá, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gáā je ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ma í gē bīyíne kú nū ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō gē gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí, ɔ̄cɛ ɔbɔ̄bí ā í kē gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn kē lɛ ohi kú odúúdú ɔ̄kā kú nū ā kpó tá ɔ̄. Ɔ̄kā dúúmā nōó da ā, í lɔnɔ tū Usólōmɔn ō cīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
idu_Latn: Utísa. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ā wɛ ofu cigwóléyi.

eng_Latn: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
idu_Latn: ó kéē gēe jé ka, Óndú ā í gáā nū aéwo nēe lɛ ajɛ ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó kéē géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa, ámāŋ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ámāŋ itali ámāŋ ujē ā lɛ uwá, nōo géē pla uwá ɔkɔ klla í cí uwā eyī. Ó ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā géē yá uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúmā kú uwā í hile ipú ajɛ olɔhi ā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
idu_Latn: Ōcē obɔ̄bí géē je odúúmā kú ayí ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nēe hile ā kpó ŋmó, anyā uwā í kē gáā jikwū uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le tútū kéē kpɛ́fú tá Ugíbɛ̄ya á.

eng_Latn: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé ɛga dóódu kú ɛbɛ́ ā ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō he ɔ́ ɔlá ŋ́. A lɛ ɔ́ pá, kwú īkpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla iklíkpó mɛ́mla iyípú ā.

eng_Latn: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ā, n kē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. N kē gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ um gē gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú, nwū um ɔdā nāa tíne ká n̄ yá ā. Bī um bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ unwalu ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū aólɛlā kú um nēe lɛ ɛwa ā.

eng_Latn: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
idu_Latn: Ó yúklɔ́ idáagó nwuné abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ í kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā ō hídáagó nyá nāa géē yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uwɔ ā? Ɔdí nāa géē yá ā?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ uculo kú ucɛ nyā gbɔɔ́, aá géē da ayí aá ka, aá gē yá ucɛ ā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔdā kú ífi ɛɛ́, ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ ɔ́ tū lɛ īyī uwā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū kú Óndú ā gāajɛ ŋmá ɔ́nū nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ ā uwá nyīla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ádáádā uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá cɛ̄ kā anúɔ gekwú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā, kóō lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá eko obɔ̄bí nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ádā alɔ miya ɔ́ lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujérobōwam da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Kóocōō le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ kú um yá lɔhi iyínū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ kú nū kwú yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
idu_Latn: Ébram le odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ā kpó gé lɛ ɔ́. Ó le uwá hɛ́ɛpa, kwú āyā éyi ú tá ɛgiyí ɔhá ɔgbɔɔgba. Amáŋ ó hɛ́ aígbáanɔ ā ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogbāājɛ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ uwá kpó wā, ó wɛ abɔ̄fú ŋ́, abɔ̄ uwá gē yúufi ācɛ ā kéē géē tɛ́cɔ̄ klá uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Udáni kwú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ojibó nɛ̄ Umíka gbā ā ú kpó ā, é le ɛfú kpó tá Uláyīssi, ɔlɛ́ kú ɛbɔ́ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ɛbɔ́, nēe lā ɔpɛ́ kú Ubɛ́trēhɔ̄bu ā. É le odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó klla le ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄, nōo wɛ ɛga olɔfú nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ī kwu tayínū ipú nū ā. Anú gē nya um tá á. Ɔwɔicō kú um gē gbō um ipú ɛbɔ́ á. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú kú um nōo gē nya um tá ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um ā.

eng_Latn: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
idu_Latn: Uwá bá okónu ísu kú Ánɔn jaa ga ɔbū ga igbīhi, í jé ɛga nēé gēe nyɔ̄ a ŋ, bɛ̄ɛka aígbáanɔ nēé lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá kpó a.

eng_Latn: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
idu_Latn: Ádīna wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhárim á. Uhekáyi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umeráyɔ̄tu á.

eng_Latn: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá ɔdōōlɔhi, Amáŋ ɔtū kú olíla gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ígbáanɔ nēé hī ka ɔtágláma ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ á. Ó cīgbīhi wā gɛ ŋ́, ó yɔ̄ ī wu gaajɛ gicō jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā le ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛfu gē je fu klla í je wúlatāajɛ, nɛ̄ ápátɛ́cɔ̄ í je kpó míya bónū ŋmá ɛyí nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
idu_Latn: É le ɔkɔ gbā le ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá hile ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá uwā ohi ka, Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ̄, kwú īyī nū ú tayínū ipú inu kú ɔdōlé nēé gwó bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
idu_Latn: Cɛ̄tra Óndú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Aamí.

eng_Latn: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔ̄kā ikwū kú Usɔ́ɔlu gé um Usíkilāgi gbɛlá ka anúɔ gē bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi gé um nɛn, n lɛ ɔ́ kwú, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ulé kú ɔkā olɔhi kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
idu_Latn: Nááná ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū anúɔ tá, nyɔ̄ í pā ojibó kú Ubáalu, mɛ́mla aɛ́cí ɔhá. Ó ka anúɔ í gáā hɛ́ uwā tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ijē nyā wɛ ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ācɛ kú Ujúda kē wɛ ɔcí ufáyin olɔhi kú nū, nōó tū ā á. Ó tíne ō má ucē okpaakpa ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, amáŋ ācɛ nēé bá ī ŋmó á. Ó leyīce kéē yá ucē kpaakpa, amáŋ ācɛ nēé bá ī yá ŋmó ā, nōó yɔ̄ ī pó ikwū ō je kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā yā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā cíkā ō lɛ odée klá ɛyí kóō mafú koó yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ íkwu kú ɔbá nū á.

eng_Latn: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū yɔ̄ ī yɛ gɔbū kpɔ́ ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi lɛ inya kwu wā í kwú okwúukwu í kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ itíca, ɔdí piíí nɛ̄ n géē yá ká n̄ lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ā.

eng_Latn: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā yí īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ, klla lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti nyɔ̄ í ba ɔnyā okpɛ́fú mla aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Ó géē yálé ēē? Ó géē bīya okónu ōce nyā í nyɔ̄ áncā lɛ a glá ā? Ó gáā lɛ a ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
idu_Latn: Ɔnyōkwū dúúmā nōó ga iháyí ofɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, a híī tá iyē kú nū tāajɛ ka ó wɛ ɔnyōwū ŋ́. Ɔnyōkwū abɔ̄yīnū géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔbá nū eko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī ā. O klla kē í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔbá igbeékpónú ōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
idu_Latn: Ujóbu tá Ɔwɔicō ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwá dɛ̄gba klla tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, ɔdā dúúmā nāa ka ā, alɔ géē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ámíyā nɛ̄hi ɔ́mpa ā mɛ ɛɛ́, amáŋ ɔ́mɛtá ā gē wā fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔyípōklóbīya ā ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ oyēeyī, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtu he uwá lɛ ā ó lɛ ɛjī ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
idu_Latn: É da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔtū he alɔ nɛ̄hi eko nōó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ alɔ ɔwɛ klla yɔ̄ ī ka ɛyí kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya lɛ ācɛ nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā blla klla le odúúdú iyó kú inu ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, kwu oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ugóolu , oje udɔ, ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá, áfū, ɛwɔ́, kwu iyó kú ɛfú kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó kpó tayínū ā, kpó mafú lɛ uwá. Ɔdā dúúmā í hile ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya í mafú lɛ uwá ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó pó abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔfiyɛ ā í gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lúgwū kú uwɔ ŋ́. Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ gáā lúgwū kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
idu_Latn: Óndú a kahíníī, N géē nwū uwɔ, ɔwɛ nāa géē nyɔ̄ ā, n gē nwū uwɔ ɛlā klla í ma ɔwɛ fú gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa bī unwalu wā í klā alɔ ā? Óndú ā kóō lɛ unwalu bī wā í klá awɔ ícɛ. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɛcɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ Ákan mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nɛ̄ ó lɛ á. É le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ kpɛ́m ā kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ojuja wā í klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ōceyī ŋmaá-ŋmaá ocābɔ̄ ka Óndú yɔ̄ ɛgée ā, wā í le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā tū mu.

eng_Latn: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána tá Uhána ohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá ɔdā dóódu nɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā. Ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ klá ɔlɛ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ amɛ̄ hɛ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ká ɔ̄ tá abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄ lɛ okónu nɔ́ɔ ce ā yá jīla. Anɔ́ɔ Uhána má klá ɔlɛ́ yɔ̄ gē bī ɔyí a jɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
idu_Latn: Unehemíya ka anúɔ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníi, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a pó abɔ̄ é bā í yá alɔ ɛbɛ́ abɔ́ɔ āa? Ká ɛbɛ́ nēé bā ī yá alɔ ɔ́ɔmā kóō gaá ce uwá ɛyí. Uwī kā o lɛ odúúdú ɔdā dúú nēé lɛ ā kpó ŋmáajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá kú ɛfú ga ajɛ kú éwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu eko ikwū kú Usɔ́lu ā, Usɔ́lu, kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya lɔfú lɔfú. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú klla lɔtū, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū.

eng_Latn: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi í gba ayí kú Ulífāyi áluka mla aípɔ́ɔma ɔhá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
idu_Latn: Ɛmiyɛ í gáā ŋmó uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gē ŋmó uwā gɛ ŋ́. Ɛnɔ kú eko olugbáagbá ā mla owu okwɔ́lá kú ipú ígbíli ā í gáā yá uwā ɔdā dóódu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē méyīnyinyi uwā abɔ̄ n géē bī uwā jé ɔwɛ ga njɔlɔ alɛwa nɛ̄ énkpɔ̄ yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.
idu_Latn: N le ka ka n géē nya aá tá, n kē le yá lɛ ā. N lɛ aá nyatá. Aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá dúúmā í kē yá ɔdā nyā ipú aá jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Aá wɛ aíjáalí kú um mɛɛ́ á. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka lɛ a á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Adá um, ɔtū nɛ̄ a le ce Ɔwɔicō ā, lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá. Nyō ɛbɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
idu_Latn: É le aɔ́kpá kú ɔcí ɛhɔ̄ nēé le uwɔ kpó kwu uwá, nēe géē bī ukɔ́tin ā playicō ā gbā. É le ugóolu ma plá icō kú aɔ́kpá mɛ́mla ogbló kú uwā. É klla le ígbóje-otáajɛ kú oje udɔ ɛhɔ̄ nēe géē bī aógbló ā háyicō ā yá dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī íjééyī kú nū kɛlā lɛyíkwu aá. Ó kahíníī, N géē tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá. É géē ŋmó aóhī kú uwā, é kē í kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ohile.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
idu_Latn: A géē yɛ ɔwɛ kú uwɔ ɛbɔ́, nɛ̄ á gáā lɛ ikpó gbo ɛcɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ojuja kwú gbɛnú ɔkpáncō, ó gē yá ɔwɔ wā ajɛ. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔcí tū nyɔ̄ ā, ajɛ abɔ́ɔ nōó gē tá á.

eng_Latn: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
idu_Latn: A híī bī ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē wɛ olíla ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nāa gē je īyī uwɔ ŋmó gbɔbū lɛ eko kú ikwū kú uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī je ikwū la ācɛ kú Umówābu! Ācɛ kú Umówābu kwú pɛ́ kwu ga ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Isoar, mla Eglat-sselísya ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ōhī kú uwá lɛ icō ɛfu tū gā ɔwɛ kú Ilúhit, lɛ abɔ̄ pīya klá ɛyí ba ī je ikwū abɔ̄ é ba ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ a; Ācɛ ōhī le kwu ga Uhoronéim lɛ abɔ̄ pīya klá ɛyí ba ī tū ɛgá okwū gbōmgbōm.

eng_Latn: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā tá ɔ́ ohi kahíníī, Óndú, ń cíkā ká ā wā inu ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́, amáŋ lɛ ɛlā okónu ka ōfūnū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā kóō le hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄ kóō pó.

eng_Latn: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā nyɔ̄ í le ojuju kú íjééyī kú nū ā ka lɛ ācɛ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú igelī ā kwú Usséba í ŋmó le ɔ́ ɛyí hɛ́ á. É kwú ikpɛ̄yí ā ú tá wāajɛ ɛgiyí Ujówābu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ opo tá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā á. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le cīgbīhi le pɛ́ tá ɔlɛ́ uwā á. Ujówābu kwúcē le tá Ujerúsālɛm ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá í yá lɛ ā, aá lɛ ede kú uwā ca tāajɛ, lɛ ɔ́kpa otīihɔ kú uwā yíífi ŋmáajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla lɛ ojibó kú anjɛnū kú uwā nēé hī Ássɛ̄ra ā hɛ́ tónū.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
idu_Latn: Okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ipú ajɛ Ubábīlɔn abɔ́ɔ ā, n pó ba Óndú ā kɛlā gā um, ɔfú kú nū kē gā iyē kú um.

eng_Latn: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Aá yúúfi ŋ́, aígwu nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ um, ó géē he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū kóō je ɛga lɛ aá kú aá cɔɔcɛ́ mla anú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
idu_Latn: N hī ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ um igwú, amáŋ é lɛ um plla klla tá kéē tá um abɔ̄. Ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um le pɛ́ gekwú ipú úláyi, eko nɛ̄ ē bá ī yɛ ipú úláyi yɔ̄ gē tíne ɔdōlé nōo géē tá oyēeyī kú ūwā gɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, alɔ kpó odúúdú agbénú nyā wā kéē bī le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka iyē kú uwɔ kóō lɛ ojīlíma lɛ. Amáŋ awɔ je odúúdú nū lɛ alɔ á. Awɔ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ eyīyōce kú ɔ̄cɛ í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, otū kú nū géē bīya. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó tíne ā le yá, ɔtū kú nū le mu mla éeyē.

eng_Latn: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Éhūdu lɛ ɛhi ā je lɛ Églɔn, ó da ācɛ nēe bī ɔdā ɛhi wā ā, kéē lɛ cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma nēe jé ō tɔ́kpa lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā lā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujábesi. É wɛ Utírati, Ussímīiti mɛ́mla Usúkati. Uwá wɛ ācɛ kú Ukéni, uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Urékābu gē lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ejé omákáká ā gwá ā, ó kahíníī, Ó mɛ ɛɛ́. Ó tá ɛyí kpɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó mā owu á.

eng_Latn: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
idu_Latn: É géē je ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā lé ɛ̄cī nēé gwɛ́ɛya kú ahínyá ō tá ā. Odúúmā kú nū í gaá hile gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
idu_Latn: Igbo ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛhɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ujíyu gɔ́ um ɔ́glɔ́ igbo ofucigwáahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ kú ejé kóō kwú aá ŋ́ ohígbū koó géē lɔfú lɛ aá pīya ācɛ ɔdāhá glá ā. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā je ɛga lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō kóō bī aá yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛpā kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ ékpó. Cɛ́ɛ́ é wɛ ɛpā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ékpó.

eng_Latn: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú odúúdú agbénú kú ācɛ ā nēé wu ā, mɛ́mla anyā uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā nēé kwú ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ā í kpó gé.

eng_Latn: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta lɛ ācɛ ā má ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aɔ́máapú um, Ísrɛ̄lu, abɔ̄ ó yá nɛ̄ aá le hídáagó ā, ámāŋ nɛ̄ aá kē leyīkwu alɔ glīglī bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó wɛ oŋmá ɔfú kú alɔ ámāŋ ka otīihɔ kú alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ yá ɔ̄ kóō yāwu ā?.

eng_Latn: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
idu_Latn: N jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā. N jé ka aá hīlaŋdɔ́ ŋ́ mā aa, aá kē kwɔ́ɔ́lá ŋ́. Ó géē yɛ í he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ka aá le kwɔ́lá ámāŋ ka aá le hīlaŋdɔ́.

eng_Latn: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá ācɛ kú eko nyā italā ohígbū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēé kpó ŋmó ŋmífī nōó yá ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka anúɔ le cɔ̄nū kwú usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ā ú tá fīyāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é kwú kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ abáábɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō le úklɔ́ nōó yɔ̄ ī yá ā yá mɛ ā, ó le mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa á.

eng_Latn: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ikpó kú ɔ̄coŋmíkpó playi dangla nɛ̄ ó tū ile lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ita nɛ̄ olíla gē kwu ā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
idu_Latn: Uhámɔ mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ussɛ́kɛm le tá okónɔɔwɛ kú ipú igelī ā, gaá le ɛlā ā kpó ka lɛ ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
idu_Latn: Alɛɛcɛ ohile kē le kpó bīya ohígbū ucē ō yá kú uwā. Ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kē le mu ācɛ ipú ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
idu_Latn: Aá gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā í mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gwó ā ŋ́ má ā? Ó wɛ ohígbū ka Óndú ā jé ka okónu nɛ̄ aá ce lɛ ɔnyā ɔ̄cī kú aá ā, aá lɛ ɔ́ nyílá ɛɛ́. Ɔnyā aá ā wɛ obíyē kú aá á, amáŋ okónu nɛ̄ aá ce lɛ uwá ā, aá lɛ ɔ́ bīya, nááná nɛ̄ aá cokónu ipéyī Ɔwɔicō, ka aá géē lɛ iyī aá tū cíí lɛ ɔnyā aá ā.

eng_Latn: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Abíyāta, éyi kú ayí kú Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki ā le kwu ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu í cɛ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ wɛ opeyī, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ abālɔbányā nēé lɛ ɔ́ eyī nwūla ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ācɛ nēe ma ɔ́ ā hīgwú.

eng_Latn: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágirīpa da Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si kahíníī, Ó géē he um ɔtū ō lɛ ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ā pó abɔ̄yī um. Anɔ́ɔ Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si kahíníī, Óócí, ā géē pó ɔkɔ nū.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɔkpancō wɛ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú um á. Ɛcɛ kē wɛ ɔdā olɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ kú um á. Ɛdɔ inu nyā nɛ̄ aá gáā gwó gā um glá āa? Ɛdɔ kú inu nyá nɛ̄ aá í gwó glá nɛ̄ n lɔfú lā anú glá āa?.

eng_Latn: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla kahíníī, N le okónu ce lɛ aá ka n géē je owu mɛ́mla ɛlā nōo í yɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá piyóó ā lɛ aá. Oŋmá eko nyā gɔbū ā, ɛlā kú um nɛ̄ n nwū aá í cíkā ō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónu kú aá ŋ́. Aá nwū ayááyí kú aá, kú ɛlā ā kóō híī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónu kú uwā ŋ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujósɛ̄fu gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā nū lɔɔlɔhi, ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ga ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ámōōmɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le íkókwū ā pīyɛ̄ ipú ɛkpa kú Ubɛ́njamīn á.

eng_Latn: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lā igelī ā, ipɔ́ɔma dúúmā nɛ̄ ó ŋmá ā, géē bī ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā le hɛ́hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē fú ōhī kú nū ŋmá anú, kóō wɛ ɛya nēé je lɛ Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó le ɔ́ tɔlá ɛyí ede ā. Ocu kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé nyā gē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n kpó aá ce acá bī aá wā amānyā lɛ iyī um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okpé gē kpó ayí nū ca acá ā.

eng_Latn: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
idu_Latn: É lɛ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ajɛ kú Ukénan ā kpó, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá Íjīpiti á. Ujékɔ̄pu le odúúdú ayááyí nū nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ā kpó ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ Uhússāyi hīgwú wā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kóō pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ géē gwéeyē, klla í jījē. N géē tú uwā ɔtū lé, klla í je ɔtūnōbí kú uwā pīya éeyē. N géē yá nɛ̄ ɔtū í he uwá.

eng_Latn: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
idu_Latn: Ofíyongoli, ká n̄ yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ká ā ŋmó ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú. Ofīyongoli, ɔ̄cɛ nōo hɛ́pɔ̄ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ nyā cíkā ō yá ɔdā olɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá á. Kwúcē igbīhi, Udéfīdi, ɔyí um. N gáā dɔɔ̄kā ō ŋmó uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka a tá ka anúɔ í ŋmó um otú mā kpɔ́. N húmáyī wɛ olíla. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n yá á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nɛ̄ ó cokónu nū gā uwɔ ā, yá gā uwɔ, nɛ̄ ó kwú uwɔ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā jé ɔdā nōó gē yá ā. Ó kē ī bī ámíyā gé lɛ ācɛ. Óndú ā le ka ka anúɔ géē je ōwē lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē tá uwá abɔ̄ ā ɛɛ́. Ó kē ī yá ɔdā nōó ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ŋmá ajɛ kú Ugerasɛ̄nesi mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ biílí ā da Ujísɔ̄si kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá, ohígbū ka ufi le uwā kwú nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɔ́kɔ anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ gbonɛnɛ lɛ ayí kú Ubasiláyi nōo ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ leyīkwu uwá. Ó ka ohígbū kéē gbonɛnɛ lɛ anúɔ eko nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ í kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Ábsālɔm, ɔyínɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū le bla keé lɛ ɔ́ tá kahíníī, Ɔtu caca kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ ī yi um ɔlá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ssɔn nōo wɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú Ulífāyi ā, ma ayí ɛpa: Ulíbini mɛ́mla Ussímēyi, é kē ma ayí alɛwa dúú.

eng_Latn: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Adá um kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odée ú kpó ga um ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ ā wɛ ā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ Ádā ā ōfōōfūnū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ádā ā wɛ ā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā tíne ō ma ɔ́ fú lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
idu_Latn: Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā, é géē yá kú uwēyī nɛ̄hi kóō lɛ uwɔ kwú, ikɔkɔ nēé í lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ ā. Awɔ abɔ̄yi uwɔ ā, gē gwá ejé ŋmá íkókwū kú ejé nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī lɛ nābɔ̄ gā awɔ ā. A í gwá ŋmá ipú nū piíí, ejé ā kē í kwú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā tóohɛ́ɛwa, kú ācɛ kéē má ohɛ́ɛwa kú uwɔ. É géē leyī gwō uwɔ bónū í klla gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ ŋ́. É klla í cɛ lɛ uwēyī í kwú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And sixteen thousand persons;)
idu_Latn: Ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nēé jé ācɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, wɛ úlā ofɛpa .

eng_Latn: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā í gē jɛga lɛ unwū kú ɔlɛɛcɛ kóō bī uwā tá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le Ujékɔ̄pu fu kóō kwú pīya ákú nū, kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē wɛ ɔdā abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ aá. Olɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um kē mīyɛ ā ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kwú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú Ɔkpíihɔ lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
idu_Latn: Óndú um, n lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē ka ŋ́. Ohígbū ka awɔ yá um ɔdānyā á. N géē yɔ̄ ī yɛ cécécé jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n kwú mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ɔnɔ nɛ̄ n má ā.

eng_Latn: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú gē héyī kwu ācɛ oyóbɔ̄bí ā, kóō lɛ uwá kpó yífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā blakwu uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka ka Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ ga um, aá nēe tíne ō yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, aá yɛ tííkpa kú ucē kú Ébrahām. Anú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄ nēé cē alɔ ŋmá anú ā á.

eng_Latn: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mla ɛcɛ í mɛ, amáŋ ɛlā kú um géē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē yá oblatū kú ucɛ nyā ɛ́pleéko eko nū iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa yá um ɔdɔ̄bɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛlā kú um í he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́ mā? Ɔdíyá nāa je iyó kóō bī ācɛ nēe bá nyā ce um ɛyí ā?.

eng_Latn: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
idu_Latn: Aá yúufi kú Óndú ā, ācɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe gē yúufi nū ā, gē lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēe ce uwá ɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
idu_Latn: Íbiha, Ɛlíssūwa, Ɛlipɛ́lɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā le Usámūwɛ̄lu má ā, ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, A wɛ ɔcɛ́ Usɔ́lu, ɔdíyá nāa pllá um ā? A wɛ ɔcɛ́ Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Unɛ́gɛ̄bu, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn, mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú Arába, mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú nū ā tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
idu_Latn: nēé ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi gbógbóō ŋ́ mā. Ācɛ nēe klla ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nááná nēé le ɔkpá gbo ā.

eng_Latn: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ajɛ ɛhícō ā bá abɔ́ɔ, ācɛ Usídɔn kē bá abɔ́ɔ dúú. Ɔfú kú uwā tɛtɛ wɛ ɔdā ufi. Amáŋ ícɛ nyā uwá gwutá ipú uwēyī ɔlékwu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Uwēyī kú ācɛ nēe gē ga ɔlékwū ā lɛ uwá kwú dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā klla gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā, gbɔɔ́ ō jéeyī ɛɛ́. Óndú ā lɔhi dúúdú klla le kpaakpa. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā jɛ́yí kú ɔdā lɔɔlɔhi, ó géē jé Óndú ā aflɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú um ú ga inu ɔtāhɛ̄ nōo wɛ ɛga otīihɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. O lɛ ɔwɛ̄ nōo yɛ wā ipú nū ā mīya. Ipú nū wɛ umíta ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú aá lɔfú yá aólɛlā ofɛhɔ̄ kú aá lé glá. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ofɛhɔ̄ kú aá lɔfú yá ācɛ úlā ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ lé glá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpani kú Ujósɛ̄fu le ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū ka lɛ ɔ́ ā pó ā, ó le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, N gáā yā ɔdā dúúmā eko nɛ̄ aúwī géē gáā je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ca, í ga ipú nū klla í je ɔ́ tēelihɔ ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ka eko nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ma, anɔ́ɔ yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄. Ó ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ bī ɔ̄ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú ajɛ kú úgwū kú nū ú lɛ Óndú ā, ɔlá kú nū géē wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áluka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē nyi tū ɔɔ̄ glá ā. Ó géē gbā īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó kú ajɛ nōo géē yá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ukílōgram ofu glá ā.

eng_Latn: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī gbēyī Óndú ā, mla odúúdú odo kú um kóō tá um abɔ̄, n kē lɛ ɔtū ce okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ipú ɛlā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le yɛ tá iyɔ̄bū Uféro klla le ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá ā. Árɔ̄ni le okwutɛ kú nū tá fīyajɛ iyɔ̄bū Uféro mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ okwutɛ ā kwú pīya ɛgwā á.

eng_Latn: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ódúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé pɛ́ kwú ā í je kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú Ubenhádādi bā í gbēyī kú ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú olɔhi dúúmā. Ikpíikpó nɛ̄ Áhābu ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɛlā nōó ka ā ú bī abɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ka Ubenhádadi, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da uwá kahíníī, Áá lɛ ɔ́ bī wā. Eko nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi gā ā, Áhābu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aóklóbīya kú ɔ̄colɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɔfú yɔ́tūnōbí eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄colɔnyā ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá glá āa? Amáŋ eko gē wā, nēé géē je ɔ̄colɔnyā ā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā é géē gwōkónu.

eng_Latn: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
idu_Latn: Ísāka, Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, aá nēe ī lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nēe gáā nyatá fíyaa ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má ā, é le hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ inya kwu gā ɛgiyí nū gaá lɛ okónu hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī hī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka, Ádā aá ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá lɛ Ádā ékpó, ó kē yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
idu_Latn: É lɛ okónu nēé ce mla Ɔwɔicō ā tū ŋ́. É tá ō lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ kú Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwá u kpó yíífi. Ó kwú ācɛ nēe hile ŋmá ipú uwā ú kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujúda dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aá gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ̄gbā ŋmá odúúdú ɔtū mɛ́mla odo kú aá. Aá gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá géē kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā otīhɔ nɛ̄ aá gē bī le yúklɔ́ kú Óndú ā kpó bá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
idu_Latn: Owu le úgbéenyi tá gicō licō licō, ó klla le ɔ́ tá wāajɛ ga ɛga olipú kú ísu kwuu. Ɔtū kú ācɛ o yúklɔ́ kú úgbényi kwú gbenyi ipú ufi.

eng_Latn: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta le híhó, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔnyā, ń kōō jé ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī yá ɛdɔ ufi ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó kéē blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā yá Uféro mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛ̄nyā yɔ̄ ī yá ā, ācɛ nēe bá ī gbēyī Usɛkaríya ā le hídáagó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó le gbojī ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Wā gaá cɔcɛ́ ɛcɛ amānyā. Ká ɔdā nɛ̄ a tíne ā kóō yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī yá ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka Umósīsi mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu abɔ̄yī uwa háyi amānyā bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga um nááná, N gáā ményinyi ācɛ nēe bá nyā ŋ́. Lɛ uwá nū ŋmá amānyā, kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá eyī kú um.

eng_Latn: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
idu_Latn: Á lɛ ɔdā dúú ipú ɛlā nyā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔtū kú uwɔ í le kpaakpa iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ uwá nū nyɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ódūdū nyɔ̄ ā, Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kéē le kpó yíífi ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔja gē ja ipú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya cíkā ō lɛ īlī ā kpó tɔ̄ɔ̄lá dúúdú ohígbū koó yɔ̄ ī nyīla.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā pó ā, ó le abɔ̄ miya kwu ɔ́ klla da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ nōó miya kwu ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā kwú ŋmɔ́cí kwu cíkáá, anɔ́ɔ ó klla je abɔ̄ ā cīgbīhi glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā lɛ ɛlā nōó ka ā pó, é kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ̄, ó yɔ̄ ī hī Ɛláyíja igwú.

eng_Latn: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ā, n gē kɛlá bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ̄ ā, n gē gbɛlá bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ̄ ā, n gē leyī miya ɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ̄ ā. Amáŋ abālɔbányā nɛ̄ n le pīya ijímkpa ɛɛ́ mā, n mabɔ̄ ucē kú ɔyípɛ ɔ́ɔmā tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
idu_Latn: Mā unwalu kú uwɔ tá ce Ɔwɔicō, ó kē í lɛ ɛlá kwu uwɔ. Ɔwɔicō, í gaá cɛ̄ kéē yá ācɛ olɔhi ā lé gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ɔkpáncō nōo kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ekwukwu kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá icō wāajɛ ā. Ó klla kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú akpáabana nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔkɔ ā klla kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔkɛ̄la kú aógwúmogwú alɛwa nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa bá gē gwō ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī kú ā má ɔ̄ ɛ́, ó Óndū, Leyī yi ɔ̄cɛ nāa yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā. Aɛ́nɛ́ nēe ma ayí cíka ō kpó okwū kú ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ūwā lé gɛɛ, ayí nēé bī jɛ̄ ipú ihɔtū leyīkwu uwá gɛɛ ā. É bá yɔ̄ ī kpó ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ŋmó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi abɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
idu_Latn: Aá híī lɛ ɔtū kú aá yá lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā aá yá ajɛ kú Umɛ́rība ā ŋ́. Óō klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄cī nēé yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ipú ígbíli kú Umása ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā géē jé ka ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā yɔ̄ pi uwā. Ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ iháyí éyi ce ɔyā ɛhīlī, yɔ̄ gē nwū ācɛ ā ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
idu_Latn: Olíla gē cɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó pó ā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ olohílípū ā gē leyī yɛ ikpó nēé gē fu ā.

eng_Latn: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, Udamáskɔ̄s í gāa wɛ ɔlɛ́ gbóógbóō ɛɛ gɛ ŋ́, ó gēe je pīya ɛyétutulu mla alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú um cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi lɛ inya ā kwu gaajɛ, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ mīyɛ ɛhi nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hī um igwú nū ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si yá ā.

eng_Latn: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbū klla le nyīla.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Upekāhiya yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain:
idu_Latn: Ó ka aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ācohɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwā, ɛ́ɛ géē ga ɛcɛ, ɛga nɛ̄ okwū ā tá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē miya ajɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí okwū ā, jāā ga aígelī nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛwū éyi ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú úwé kú Ujósɛ̄fu í wu oyī kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka eko nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, é lɛ aá bī bí kú aá pā aɛ́cí nōó yēeyī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
idu_Latn: Anú yɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ ɔdā dóódu á, anú bī ɔdā dóódu bɔ́há á.

eng_Latn: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ kwu ɔcɛ́ ā ámāŋ aígabɔ̄ kú nū dúúmā nēe pó ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā nēé jé lɛ uwá ā, í yúúfi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē hɛ́ uwá kō, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yá ɔtūnōbí kú ɛlā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gílagwó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛya kú ahínyá oōtá gwó ɛyí nū lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda kéē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
idu_Latn: Issmeráyi, Islíya mɛ́mla Ujóbābu.

eng_Latn: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Iháyí ahāapa kú ɔdā kú ɛhɔ̄ ō cabá géē yɔ̄ odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ci ikwū kú abɔ̄yīnū glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē ci ɛ̄cī ikwú kú nū eko nɛ̄ eyī ikwū kū nū le nyā glá ŋ́. Ikwū wɛ ɛfú nɛ̄ alɔ géē kpó piíí. Alɔ í gáā kwu hɛ ɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́. Ó lɛ ɔwɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ gáā pīya ɔ̄ tū, le kwu hɛ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá cɛ̄ um ijáalí ka n ka, Ami ā í wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le um tɛ̄hɔ̄ gbɔbū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni í gáā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n gē je lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́. Ó géē kwú. Ohígbū ka aá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa í lɛyitáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um Umɛ́rība ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ́ɛ bá yɔ̄ ī táafú mla uwá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
idu_Latn: Aá jé kóō cɛgbá ká ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō gekwú ohígbū ācɛ ā, ikoko nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔpu ā gé ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
idu_Latn: Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Usíkiri wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujúda, ɔyí kú Uhássēnuwa kpokónu ce ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛyí kú igwu ɔhá klla le bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛgiyí uwā, owu kú ipú ígbíli cɛ̄ lɛ aɛ́nyā kwú pīya igbóngbō.

eng_Latn: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
idu_Latn: É tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ gē da alɔ ɔ̄kā tɛnɛ́tɛnɛ́ lɛyíkwu ipɔ́nū kú alɔ ka, Ádā aá yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ̄? Aá lɛ ɔyínɛ́ ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛɛ? Alɔ kē cíkā ō cíla ɔ̄kā kú nū ā piíí. Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú jé koó í da alɔ ka alɔ lɛ ɔyínɛ́ alɔ bī wā ā a.

eng_Latn: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā kwú Ahásiya ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ámōōmɛ kú Ujɛhóram ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū. Ohígbū ka ācɛ Árābu ōhī le ācɛ kpó wā í lɛ odúúdú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ nēe wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ujɛhóram ā kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ Ahasíya nōo wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé mā ɔ̄ tá ā, anú lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Ádā nū mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó kú ɔyā ahāapa nyā ā wɛ ɛ̄cī nēe í yá uculo kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla íne ō bīya kú iháyí kéē kpó íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi á. Aá híī lé ɔdōlé dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, aá wā í le jīla tɔ̄há kú aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá je ɔdā kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé lɛ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um yɔ̄ Umíspa amānyā, kē í kwɛyí aá eko dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ga. Amáŋ aá nyɔ̄ í lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ tū abɔ̄ ā. Aá kóō yá ejé kú aá kpó tū. Aá kē tú anɔ̄ ólīifu, mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí bá.

eng_Latn: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō gē je oyēeyī á, ɔfú kú ɔ̄cɛ í yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Ɛlā nɛ̄ N ka lɛ aá ā wɛ alelékwū mla oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nāa le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛ ā abɔ̄yī uwɔ, a géē jé ŋmá ɛgiyí nū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ kpó ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
idu_Latn: N géē bī íjééyī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n jé ā le mafú ga uwɔ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá um ā lɛ́pɔ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kē le jīla tɔ̄há ŋmá ɔlɛ́ alɛwa nōo kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ ā, klla le ācɛ odoōcē mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí gē junwalu lɛ uwá kpó wā. É kē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kpó hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
idu_Latn: Umáhli ma ayí ɛpa: Ɛlísaa mla Ukíss.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ōfōōfūnū ā, ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ wā ī tá ɔ̄. Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kāhíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā ka amí ɔ́ɔ wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā piíí. Ó gáā bī ije lɛ fūla īkpɛ̄yí kú iyī nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó túblá anú kóō lɛ ɔtū má ɔ̄ ɔtū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ípī kú úwé kú nū pó á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ á. Ó kahíníī, Okpóocu olɔhi kú ɔyí um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ocu kú ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópi ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla álá ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Unatánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúwa.

eng_Latn: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
idu_Latn: Aá géē leyīkwu ɔɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi jāā gbó ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ā, eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē ŋmó álá kú uwā ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī yɛ ɔwɛ ā, é gā ɔgblɛga kú éŋkpɔ̄ éyi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nēé búdá ā kahíníī, Pīyeyī, má éŋkpɔ̄. Ɔdí géē ci ubatísim ō yá um mɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōlé je lɛ ayípɛ̄ ā kéē lé gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́. Ó lɔhi kú alɔ je ɔdōlé kú ayípɛ̄ tɛ́cɔ̄ gé lɛ aéwo ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ícɔ̄nū kú um, n le aéwo ā catāajɛ, klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bá ī túgagá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ejé gwá le ɔ́ kwú ā. Oyī kú uwā le pɛ́ klá ajɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
idu_Latn: Ó bī aícɔ́ɔja kú úgbɔ́nya úlā ɛtá mɛ́mla ācɛ o kpɛ́fu ɔnya úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o hile ɔhá nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwá í tōō gba áluka ŋ́ mā, gaá kwu aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄ ó plla ŋmá Ulíbīya, Usúkīm, mɛ́mla Ukússi kéē wā í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ohe um ɔtū, a gē lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ yéékpó ipú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ a gē yá lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā, óó kōō wɛ eko nēé wɛ aúgbɔga nááná.

eng_Latn: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Kwú odúúdú aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ā ú kpó kéē gɛcɛ mɛ́mla awɔ dúú. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ma ayí kéē nyīla ga ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my LORD, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi kahíníī, Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú um, Ń jé ō kɛlā lɔɔlɔhi ŋ́. Ń kē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ ō jé ō kɛ̄lā ŋmífī nāa gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā gā um ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N gē kɛlā ɛmɛɛma klla ī hɔ́gwū.

eng_Latn: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔfú tīīyē ka ɔ́ɔ̄ klla lɔtū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le ɛfú kpó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Ká ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá.

eng_Latn: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urútu pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū ā, ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɛ lɛ ɔ́ ɔyí anúɔ nɔ̄nyā? Urútu le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ubówāsi yá lɛ ɔ́ kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū.

eng_Latn: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
idu_Latn: Kwú ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n gē tū uwɔ ā ú fíyɛ́ agbénú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́. Kwú ɔdōojé kú um ā ú, ikɔkɔ ugóolu nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussálum, Áta, Utálimɔn Ákūūbu, Uhátīta mɛ́mla Ussóbāyi ā wɛ, ofɛhīlī ce igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē kú nū nááná lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka oje ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: N̄ lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi da aá mɛ́ n̄. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ, īkpɛ̄lā ékpó kú íne ā í gáā mɛ glá ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔdā nōó nwū ā le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ayínɛ́ nū ā bītá le úŋmóō tú uwā. Abɔ̄ é bá gē nyɔ̄ ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, aá yá ikpɛ́lā ɔwɛ nóó n.

eng_Latn: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā ā Uhɛ́ba, ɔ̄cɛ Ukéni ā, lɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gwó kwu Ukɛ́dɛssi ajaajɛ, ɔkwu ɔcí kú óokú nōo yɔ̄ kwu Usananím ā. Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ukéni ohile, ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhóbābu, ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔnyā kú Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ācɛ nēe lā ipú ácakpō kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gē ka ka, Ébrahām wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, ɛ́ɛ ké kwú odúúdú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ɔ́. Abālɔbányā, alɔ lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ajɛ ā wɛ ákú alɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
idu_Latn: N géē da ācɛ kú ɛhícō ā kéē mā ayí uwā tá. N klla í da ācɛ ɛháajɛ kéē bī uwá háyi abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Kéē lɛ ayí um nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí um nɔ̄nyā kpó kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo cɛ̄ lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipu ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄, klla je ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄ pīya njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɔŋmɔ́ɔcī nū ā, é le héyī, lɛ ɔkpá gwá lɛ īyī ūwā. Áyísīki le uwá bītá, anɔ́ɔ é i pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ámata nōo gē nyīla tū ɔkpíyē nɛ̄ ó gē jé ŋ́ mā a. Ācɛ ɛpa nēe gē kɛlā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ Uhumenáyɔ̄si mɛ́mla Ufilétūsi.

eng_Latn: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛpɔ̄ nɛ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, hɛ́ ā pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū kéē le jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ kwú íjééyī ú lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi Ɛ́lɔ̄n ā, Ábudɔn, ɔyí kú Uhílɛlu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upírātɔn gbō ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
idu_Latn: É móōwē nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá gē má ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ unwalu nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá gē lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Userúya gbɔɔ́ ō gbo ācɛ ā áluka á, amáŋ ó gbo uwá áluka kwɛyí ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō le italā yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mla ōcē obɔ̄bí ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi cɛ̄ lɛ Ujówābu gbaáluka ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é tá áluka ɔ́ɔmā tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄kā kú Udéfīdi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
