idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá Ɛláyíssa ohi kahíníī, A gbɛlá ka ɛ̄nyā jīla ācɛ ofɛhɔ̄ glá āā? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Je lɛ uwá kéē lé, ohígbū ka Óndú ā keé géē lé, ɔ́ɔ klla í hile kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī lɛ alɔ kwú dúúdú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gwutá lɛ īlī klá iyē ŋmá ɛyí wā ajɛ ā. Ohígbū ka alɔ mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔīcō kú alɔ ā bīya ɛɛ́. Alɔ í kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nōó ī ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ádā nū, Udéfīdi mīyɛ Ɛ́dɔm ā, nɛ̄ Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā nyɔ̄ gaá kpó okwū kú ācɛ nēe ŋmó ā nyi ā. Ó le odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ufínēhasi, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā da uwá kahíníī, Abālɔbányā aá jé ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla aá. A híī yíikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā ŋ́. Aá kē lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá ŋmá italā kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
idu_Latn: Á kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bīya ú yá uwā ɛhi, a klla kwú ucē obɔ̄bí dóódu nēé yá ā ú yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ nāa gbɛlá ka anúɔ húmáyī ī kɛlá lɛ ɔ́ klla ī yɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā? Ami Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nāa yɔ̄ í cɛ́ɛcá klla ī kɛlá klá um, í klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce um ŋ́ má āā.

eng_Latn: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi páápá túkpɛɛ́, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú kú alɔ á. A kē ī gbonɛnɛ lɛ alɔ. Á kē gáā nyá alɔ nēe gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, kóō le yá gā uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a kpɔ́tūce ā. Anɔ́ɔ ōcē kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kú otrɛ̄yí aícɔ́ɔja mɛ ɛplá eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í tíne ká aá kwáahi ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ tíne ká aá gbla ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā nēe klla lɔtūlé, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le okwutɛ kú nū nā kwu ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le yá kú owu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kóō tá ɛyí ajɛ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā jāā otú kpɔ́ɔcī. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú eyī nōo nyā ā, owu ā le aéfūma kpó gla wā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn í nū ācɛ kú Ujɛ́būsi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ujɛ́būsi ā lā tɔ̄há mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, alɔ híī yíihɔtū kú ígblɛ́nyī ámāŋ ákú akpokónu icííci ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ ī yíihɔtū nōo ŋmá lɛ ō yá abɔ̄ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē tū Utímōti nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí abɔ̄yī um nɛ̄ n kpɔ́tūce ipú oyēeyī kú ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ɛhɔ̄ fu aá á. Ó géē tū aá ɛlá kwu ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n lā oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ipú ōpīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, nɛ̄ n gē nwū ācɛ ipú odúúdú icɔ́ɔci ɛga dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
idu_Latn: Umósa, ádā kú Ubinéya. Ubinéya ma Uráfa nōo ma Ɛlísa, nōo ma Ásɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Ó hile lígíi, kéē lɛ um ŋmó mɛ́ɛnɛ, amáŋ, ń kē cīgbīhi ŋmá íne kú uwɔ ō le tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
idu_Latn: Ébram túkpɛɛ́ leyī pīya klá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ofɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄ í yá ɔdōōbɔbí ŋ́ má ikɔkɔ ācɛ ofɛpa ce igwó ā. A géē je odúúdú igelī ā yíífi ohígbū ka ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ipú uwā gɛ ŋ́ mā ā? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú kahíníī, N gáā je igelī ā yíífi ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ācɛ okpaakpa ofɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄ má abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ugóolu le yá ɛgocīce kú eyīnyinyi tū ikpati ā. Olikpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛhɔ̄ cigwó, olɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛtá ce ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Arawúna lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā má ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgowíikpɔ̄dā kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō tá ka n cɛ̄ kú aá nyɔ̄, mɛ́mla anyā aá mɛ́mla ayí aá. Aá bī ojuju obɔ̄bí ipú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le jé ka íne nyā wɛ ɔdā nōo ī yúklɔ́ ipú ɔtū kú um á, eko nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛɛ, ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē yɔ̄ kwu um ajaajɛ ō yá á.

eng_Latn: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ éyi yɔ̄ igelī éyi. Ó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kē ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
idu_Latn: É lɛ iyī uwā túbá lɛyíkwu Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Aá le yá fíyɛ́ abɔ̄. Odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ ákú Óndú. Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla éyééye kú alɔ, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē je iyī aá gicō fíyɛ́ ācɛ ohile kú ójila kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōplahɔ̄ kú ugóólu nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn mīyɛ ā, gbɛnú bɛ̄ɛka Ukílōgram ofu ā. Ɔká, agbá ōtɔ̄ɔkɔ, mɛ́mla ahilíki kú aɔ́cɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔdōōtɔ̄ɔkɔ kú aínyankwūlūmī í wɛ anú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the LORD, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú da um ka, Émɔ̄si, ɔdí nāa yɔ̄ ī má ā? Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Ɔcí ō le miya ɔdɔ kú inu. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú klla ka, Má ɔ̄, n géē je ɔcí ō le miya ɔdɔ kú inu nyā tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kóō mafú lɛ uwá ka é le kpaakpa ŋ́. Ń gáā pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄ ŋmá o yá uwā italā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā tá ɔ̄ igbīhi bá ī gwííjē bá ī gwō ɔdā ō bī le gwíije klla bā í jīije, bá í je ojīlīma ce Óndú ā. É bá ī gwō ɔkanga, uba, ɛ̄ngwū, ɔgalumpɛ̄, mɛ́mla aóje nɛ̄é gē gwo ā.

eng_Latn: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ í yá kú ayááyí uwā nēé pó íne ā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, kéē le pó. Ka ɛ́ɛ kē í kllɔcɛ́ ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í yēeyī gaá kwu ipú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú Ujɔ́dan nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā ā, ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla anyīlɔ, aá cēyītīkwū nwuné ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú ká aá jɛ̄ lɛ ā ká aá lɛ igwú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hī aá nɛ̄ ó klla lɛ aá fu ā, yá kóō wɛ ɔdā ō yɔ̄ piyóó ipú oyēeyi kú aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le yá lɛ ā, aá gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ cɛ̄ ā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā yá ŋmá ajɛ á. Ó le uwá kpó gé lɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ā kóō í má iyē nōó géē le ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Aá túbá tɔ̄há, ācɛ kú aéwɔhá ā. Odúúdú aá nēe hile ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá ā. Aá lɛ īyī aá kpó wā, odúúdú ācɛ nēé ī kpó aojibo kú ɛ̄cí kú uwā ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá ā, nēé klla í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɛcí nōó nya uwá tá glá ŋ́ mā. Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā wɛ aólíla nēé jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu nōo wɛ ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā le bá ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da alɔ ka alɔ̄ kwúce nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdōlé lígíí lā wā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ aíne nɛ̄ n je ā tū cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híī yá ɛdɔ kú ucē nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā gbɔbū lɛ aá yá ā ŋ́. Aá híī je iyī aá tēelihɔ oŋmá lɛ o yá ɛdɔ kú ucē elihɔ nēe bá ā ŋ́. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya yɔ̄ gē kpɛ́fú mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le ɛga nēé géē kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ́ kú ɛfú kú uwá ā miya á.

eng_Latn: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū ɛ́ ka n pīyeyī ka n nyɔ̄ ā, Unebusárādan da um kahiníīī, Kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ussáfan, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn je ɔ́ yá igbómína kú odúúdú aígelī kú Ujúda ā. Nyɔ̄ ka á gaá lā pī ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Amáŋ ɛga dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū nɛɛ, ayíka a nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhi yá um klla lɛ ɔdōlé je ga um, mābɔ̄ um tá ká n nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujásin mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa nū lɛ ɛfiyɛ gbo a é lɛ uwā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla kɛlā gā um kpɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tū um ukɔ̄ ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú, ka amíyɔ̄ yá ucē nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gē yá ŋ́. Ó da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú ɔ̄kā kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄kā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛtá nyā: Usámūwɛ̄lu, Unátan mɛ́mla Ugádi.

eng_Latn: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ géē ŋmíkpākplā gāá kwu āa? Aácí kē le kpó ŋmɔ́lá ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ. Aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ le pɛ́ kwú ŋmá ajɛ ká alɔ, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ā klla bá gē ka ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ má ɔdā nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
idu_Latn: Ń da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ yá Ujerúsālɛm ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ahāpōtú, ami mɛ́mla aóklóbīya um ōhī le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ. Ɛbɛ́ ofōōfūnū nɛ̄ alɔ bī ā, wɛ ijakī nɛ̄ n ce ɛyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī le Ujémīsi ɔyínɛ́ Ujɔ́ni ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu ká ā gaá háyi gbēyī um. Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī wā gaá yɛ, anɔ́ɔ ofúlutu nɛ̄hi nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā le aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kpó yíla ɛpa klla le aɛ́pátɛ̄cɔ̄ kpó ca kɛ́tɛ̄kɛtɛ̄ á. Amáŋ Óndú ā í yɔ̄ ipú ofúlutu ā ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ofúlutu ā mɛ ā, ajɛ le jíliyē klla kwú hɛ́wulu, amáŋ Óndú ā í yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ojīliyē mɛ́mla ohɛ́wulu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
idu_Latn: A le aóklóbīya um ɔtū gwū nēé jé ɛyí ɔdā dúúmā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, ā yá kéē yá um lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ó wɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā, ó géē lɛ iyī nū tū ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ Óndú ā. Ó gáā lé ɔdā dóódu nōo ŋmá ɔcí ufáyin ŋ́, kwu īkpō ámāŋ āpū kú nū.

eng_Latn: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɛdɔ ɔtū ɛ́gɛ́nyā eko dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē bá ī lɛ ojīlīma ce anúɔ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú anúɔ, ó ka ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ í yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ gɔbū lɔhi lɛ uwá mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú uwá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ā gē wā, nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ā géē kpó yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ácí ōŋmókókó ā. Ɔdā dóódu í gaá hile tá ajɛ ŋmá ipú uwā ŋ́. É géē je kpó yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ákú Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō cíkā ō yá ā. Ká aá kē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, ohígbū kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o-tá-acɛ alɛwa abɔ̄, kwu ami abɔ̄yī um dúú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kóō ka lɛ ācɛ kú ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n kɛlā lɛ aá ŋmá ɔkpáncō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú aálagbá ohile ā, ɔdā dóódu nōo yá abɔ́ɔ ā yɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú Ujósɛ̄fu.

eng_Latn: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó bá Óndú ā dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aá wā amānyā. Aá nēé gáā yá igeli a italā. Aá lɛ iyɔ́fú kú aá kpó wā.

eng_Latn: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ó gekwú, ó gáā kpó ɔdā dúúmā nyɔ̄ mla iyí nū ŋ́. Agbénú kú nū ā í gáā ga únóji mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Uládan ɛpa ɔhá ā, Usɛ́tan mɛ́mla Ujówɛ̄lu, klla ī leyīkwu ije mɛ́mla inu nēé gē kpiyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū ipú nū ā á.

eng_Latn: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō kwú um ú ŋmá ajɛ gicō. Ɔfú kú Óndú gaá klá um nɛ̄hi. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī je um ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ɔtū le bīya gā um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nāa lɛ eyī pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, ufi lɛ uwá kwú, eko dúúmā nāa mīyɛ owu kú uwɔ, é le pɛ́ gekwú, klla kwúcē ga ipú ajɛ nāa bī le yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utékowa ma āyā nōo gboce Usádɔ̄ku á. Amáŋ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, tá ka aá í gáā yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄coleyī kwu úklɔ́ je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ gicō ga abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ Otrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá, kóō kē je ɛga lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē pīyabɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē habɔ̄ íne nēé bīya ā tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā agwú kú Unáaman géē wā í klla awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛ́hási kwú gbagwú kwámm bɛ̄ɛka owú otutú ā, ŋmá iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
idu_Latn: Ká ɛhi kú aá kóō tayínū, cɛ́ɛ́ Ádā aá, nōo gē má ɔdā ōtayínū ā, géē cíla aá ulé.

eng_Latn: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
idu_Latn: Ó ge hɛ́ aólɛhá lé, ge wūwī, klla ī bī ɔdā dóódu nēé gáā le ce ɔ́ abɔ̄ ā, í klla ī je lɛ óndú nū gɛ ŋ́. Ó gē nyɔ̄ ikpɛ́cí gaá pā ɛcí.

eng_Latn: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu da uwá kahíníī, Ɔyí um í gaá nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá ŋ́. Ɔyínɛ́ nū gekwú ɛɛ́. Anú ōfōōfūnū hile mɛ́ɛ̄ ā. Odée lɔfú yá ɔ̄ ɔwɛ glá. N le hīla ɛɛ́, ɔtūnɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá géē bī gé um ā géē ŋmó um.

eng_Latn: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá géē dɔɔ̄kā ka, Ɔdí yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔyí nyā í móōwē kú ɔ́bíipú kú ádā nū ŋ́ mā? Ohi kú ɔ̄kā ā wɛ ka, ɔyí ā yá ɔdōlɔhi mla ɔdā okpaakpa. Ó klla lɛ íne kú um tū klá yɛce ɔ́ kpaakpa. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ mɛ́mla Ujeremíya kóō le kwu gaá tayínū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā jé ɛga nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ānɛ̄ o lɛ ikwú dóódu, nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, da ācɛ nēé lā Usáyɔn a kahíníī, Áá yá ufi kú ācɛ kú Asírīya a ŋ́, uwá ka ō yá aá ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti a náaná.

eng_Latn: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá gā ɛga owígwu kú Ukidɔn ā, aɛ́na nēe bá ī pi úgbɔ́ɔnya ā le túgagá, anɔ́ɔ Úsaa, gaá le Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā kwú, abɔ̄ ó gáā míya wāajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
idu_Latn: A gbɛlá ka uwá ɔ́ɔ géē lɔfú tū anúɔ iyē ɛfú ā glá, amáŋ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī yá ɛfú lé klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɛfú gē yá ɔ̄cɛ lé á. Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ yá uwɔ lé, ɔ́dāŋ ka é le yɛ mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá ɔ́ɔ le bēhé Ísu kú Usérēdi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da aá ka aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ikwū, ohígbū ka n kē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ. Lɛ um nyatá, ohígbū ka n wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, n klla lɔtūce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tū aá ukɔ́ nū ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō pllá iyī nū ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ɛdɔ íjééyī kú ɛcɛ nyā nɛɛ, ó cíkā ō le pīya olíla, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō le pīya ɔ̄cojéeyi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Unáhāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn ā da uwá ka anúɔ géē yá ɛbɔ́ mla uwá ɔwɛ ékpónú. Ɛ́ɛ cɛ̄ kú anúɔ lɛ uwá īkpēyī kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmúla, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ uwēyī je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
idu_Latn: É le okwutɛ kú uwā tá fíyajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛgwā. Amáŋ, ɛgwā kú okwutɛ kú Árɔ̄ni ā, kwú ɛgwā kú okwutɛ kú uwā ú kpó mulɛ.

eng_Latn: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá gē gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́, ī je aólɛlā kú nū nēe le yɛ ɔ̄ jīla tá ā kpó yi.

eng_Latn: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛya ā gwó kwɛyí ā, ó bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ éyi bá abɔ́ɔ nēe da Ujísɔ̄si lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ugálīli ōhī nɛ̄ Upáyílēti je ɔ́da kéē kpó ŋmó eko nēé bá ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɛkpa kú uwā nwūla ā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ le ɛkpa kú ije kú nū pīyɛ̄. Eko nēé le ije ā má ā, ufi le uwá mɛ́mla ádā uwā kwú.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da um kahíníī, Aínu ɛplɛ́ɛpa nyā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū. Ipú aínu nyā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe gē ga ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā gē lé ɛbɛ ɛya nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Abɔ̄ aínu nēe bá nyā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē kpó aɛ́ya mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā bá abɔ́ɔ. Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gwó kéē je ɔbíipú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ā, ákú okónu ōce mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gwó kóō le cīla ulé ā.

eng_Latn: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
idu_Latn: Ó gbla ádā nū yá gē pā ɛcí nɛ̄ ádā nū pā ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ́da kú uwɔ̄, ámāŋ, o tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Lɛ ɔtū lɛ ká ā lɔfú tīyē.

eng_Latn: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
idu_Latn: Óbalu mɛ́mla Abímɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ussɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aódungwɔ̄wɛ nɛ̄hi ā nwūla. Aá lɛ aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú íkée ā nwūla foóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā, kóō lɛ bēhe wā inu.

eng_Latn: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kē le ɔ́da je lɛ ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ɔkpáncō kē kwú nwūla bɛ̄ɛka ɔdūngwɔɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
idu_Latn: É tíne kéē tá uwā abɔ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nya uwá tá ŋ́. É hī uwɔ igwú, amáŋ á tá uwā ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka úklɔ́ nyā nɛ̄ aá ya ā géē cābɔ̄ ka aá lɛ alelékwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō, ācɛ kē géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá ka tɛ́ɛcɛ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ̄kōokɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. É klla géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá kɔ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā mla uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔhá nwuné nwuné lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ka ɔ̄kā nyā lɛ éwo dóódu. Bī ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna. Je otúta gicō kú ocābɔ̄, kú ā tɔ́ɔna. Ā je ɔdā dóódu tayínū ŋ́, amáŋ dɛ kahíníī, É lɛ Ubábīlɔn yálé ɛɛ́! É lɛ uwēyī je lɛ aɛ́cí kú Ubábīlɔn nēé hī ka Ubɛ́lu mɛ́mla Umárdūk ā ɛɛ́. É kwú aójibó kú aɛ́cí kú Ubábīlɔn ā í kpó ca bónū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú uwā dɔɔ̄kā ā kwú pīya aólɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́, ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ukɔ́ nēe bá nyā tū. Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka Árɔ̄ni kóō í ga ɛga otīihɔ ā, ó géē gwīiyē klla í yíifa kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú nū mla īlī nɛhɛ́, ikakí kpiíí, īlī ogbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́mla oláwoni.

eng_Latn: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa kē lɛ óbō kú nū miya kwu Ái jāā gbéeko nēe lɛ ācɛ kú Ái dóódu kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kpɔ́tūce ɛlā Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ aá táafú ŋ́, aá géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ɔcí ufígi nyā ā. Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā fūnū ŋ́, amáŋ aá géē lɔfú da ɛfu nyā glá ka, Kwú īyī uwɔ í fu ká ā kwú īyī uwɔ tá ga ipú ísu, ó kē í yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
idu_Latn: O yɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, aólɛlā gaá mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é le tá Uláyīssi gaá le ɛfú kpó tá uwā, le ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ajɛ ā tɔ̄ɔ̄kwu á. É gaá lā abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le iyē kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā pīya abɔ̄ ŋmá Uláyīssi ga Udán á. Iyē kú aádáádā uwā Udán nēé je ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
idu_Latn: É lā ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛbɔ́, é klla yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō í klla ī yá uwā italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wɛ ijáalí kú um ka n kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ n ka ka aá he um ɔtū ɔwɛ ékpó nɛ̄ aá he Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú da ebilíi ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a gē yɛ ā, a má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Ujóbu? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́. Ó gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa, í klla gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ɔ̄cɛ̄nyā le má ka īkpō ɔcí ā héyīfuú klla ī ŋmúnwū kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lé á. Ó má ɔ̄ ka ó klla wɛ ɔdā nēe gē je íjéeyī lɛ ɔ́ glá. Anɔ́ɔ ó le hɛ́ le lé á. Ɔnyā ā klla le je le ɔbá nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le lé dúú á.

eng_Latn: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: āyā ɔ́mpa kú uwā í bā í gbō ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, aóhile kú uwā géē bá Ɔwɛ kú Ikpíinu ā. Odúúdú ācɛ o hile ā í jīla ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú gɔ́ ɔ̄ igbo ofɛpa glá, amáŋ ó gáā fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka o gɔ́ ɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ o tá ɔ̄ wāajɛ ipú eyī ójīla.

eng_Latn: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utáya géē bī ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā gé lɛ uwɔ. Ācɛ olɔdu kē í bī agbénú kú uwā, géē bá ī tíne kéē má eyī olɔhi kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
idu_Latn: Aúwíndo ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá hɔ́ɔgba tū abɔ̄ ɛpa kú ɔdɔ ā. Aúwíndo pīyēyi tú iyī uwā klla hɔ́ɔgba ɛtá tū ɔdɔ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Utásisi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ajɛ kú aídɔ ā, kéē gbā ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ɛ̄gbā. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ussɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usíba kéē bī ɛhi wā í gbā ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Áta amáŋ ka Uhésekíya wɛ ofɛnɛ ce igwáahātá .

eng_Latn: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
idu_Latn: Uhódīya, Ubáni mɛ́mla Ubénīnu.

eng_Latn: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
idu_Latn: Upíta yāajɛ Ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ ā kpɔ́, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɔcɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ iyē kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé je ŋmá ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Usímīyɔ̄n, nēé je.

eng_Latn: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le yá lɛ aá. Ó le ɔ́wá kú aíju tū klá inu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, Uféro mɛ́mla inu kú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Aíju ā le ífi bī wā odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: O LORD, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
idu_Latn: Óndú, oŋmá lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ a gē yá ā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lā oyēeyī á. Oŋmá lɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n kē í lɛ oyēeyī dúú á. Ohígbū ka awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ hɛ́ um tá ŋmá ōcē klla cɛ̄ gā um yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā ó le ígwu kú ācɛ ɔdāhá kpó pī blīyī nū anɔ́ɔ é le ɛga má fu ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam, ɔyí kú Usólōmɔn nōo wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó jé ɔdā mɛ́mla ula bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
idu_Latn: gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka ń géē ga ɛga nōo dobū nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē nyɔ̄ í gē pīyɛyí wā gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā yá ɔ̄. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ nyī. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛpɔ̄bí kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ŋmó áncā ā kóō híī ce anúɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ, Udéfīdi ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā, wɛ o lɛyí táajɛ. Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kú ō gbɛhá ikɔkɔ ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ka ɔnyā ā kwɛyí ɔbíipú. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔnyā ā ga ɔkwu kú ómbilí, kwú ɔ̄wū ogbɛnú nɛ̄hi ā ú klá anú.

eng_Latn: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ eko nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu le lɔfú nɛ̄hi tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, é nū odúúdú ācɛ Ukénan ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ē kwú uwá ú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú uwá kéē yúklɔ́ lɛ uwá abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ a tíne ō yá ā, géē yá lɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tíne lɛ ā ā. ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ a nyɔ̄, ɔlá géē fíyajɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a ī yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í ka lɛyíkwu Ébrahām ádáádā odúúdú alɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ eko nɛ̄ Ulɔ́tu gaajɛ Usówa ā.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ó í bī ocibu kú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gē nū alɔ ipú. Ɔhā kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ jɛ̄ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
idu_Latn: Ɔtūnɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla éeyē mɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Umówābu ɛɛ́. N gáā cɛ̄ kéē yá ejé ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē yá ejé ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē tɔ́ɔga ohígbū éeyē gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē tū ōcē klá uwá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ɔ́ gáā hile ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n jámá lɛ íne bīya, ayíka n le tá ipú unwalu ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ucē okpaakpa yá nááná, n cɛ̄tra īyī um glá ŋ kpɔ́. Uwēyī le um kwú, n kē yɔ̄ ī móōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house, in the ears of all the people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ā bá i jāhɔ̄ ā, Ubárūku lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka lɛ ɔ́ ā jé ŋmá ipú ɔkpá ā. Ó jé ɛ̄nyā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ŋmá ipú inu kú Ugɛmaríya, ɔyí kú Ussafán, ɔmálotɔ́kpá ā. Inu kú nū ā kwu ɛhícō kú ɔwɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aɔ́dā piíí nyā nɛ̄ n kɛlā lɛ aá lɛyíkwu uwā eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ lɛyíkwu um ipú ɔkpá íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla ipú ɔkpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ipú ɔkpá kú Aíjē olɔhi ā géē yá jīla piíí.

eng_Latn: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ okwáhi tíne ɔdā dúúmā lɛ, ó gáā lɛ ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o cēyītīkwū ī yúklɔ́ olɔfú ā í tíne ā, ó géē lɛ.

eng_Latn: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Ujúda eee! Jāhɔ̄ ka a pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka á. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé ka nya wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó wɛ ɔtū kú um ká ā lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū aɔ́dā nēé ka ɔ́ɔma lɔfú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā, kéē kwú ɔtū kú uwā í kwu kú e yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā ōfūnū, aɔ́dā o lɔhi nēe géē tīile lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
idu_Latn: N kē í bī éwo nɛ̄hi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá iyē kú Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ā dúú, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔyí uwɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó uwā nyɔ̄ gáā ō hɔ́ɔkɔ bɛ̄ɛka ayí álá, mɛ́mla aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aómlede ā.

eng_Latn: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá ká ā le da uwá ké ē mā ɔdā nēé bá gē ka ɔ́ɔmā. Ohígbū ka ɔdā nēé bá gē nwū ā gē yá kú ipɔ́ɔnū alɛwa kéē lɔtū ce Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. É bī ɛnyā gē le yá ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā. Ɛnyā cíkā ō wɛ ɔdā uwēyī lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, awɔ nōo le kpaakpa ā, ī yá ka ɔwɛ kú ācɛ nēé ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā kóō le yá kpaakpa mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, abɔ̄ Usedekíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda bōōbū ā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā ga um lɛyíkwu Ɛ́lam.

eng_Latn: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
idu_Latn: Ohútu kú íkpɛ́lā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ō hɛ́bū kú ɔ̄kā nēé tū tū éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Kéē lɛ ɛlā ā trá gbɔbū kóō je ca klɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, kéē má kéē lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ je íne kú nū lɛ uwá ā, yá gaajɛ. Ó klla da uwá kéē híī tá ō bī íne kú Óndú ā yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ kā anúɔ klla lɛ ɛlā ékpónú ka lɛ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ka nyɔ̄ n̄.

eng_Latn: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí Átasásɛsi ɔcɛ́ ā, ga ɛgiyī Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo klla jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lā ɔkpáncō ā nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kócōō, mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ n bī wā gaá le tá uwɔ ahínyá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.
idu_Latn: É le Ujonátan mɛ́mla ɔyípóklóbīya ā hīgwú kéē wā icō abɔ́ɔ, ka aá lɛ odée nɛ̄ aá géē da uwá. Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da ɔyípóklóbīya ā kú ɔ̄ yɛce anúɔ. Ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ uwá yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, n lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ, n géē gwíijē klla í cɛ̄tra awɔ, mla odúúdú odo kú um.

eng_Latn: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔdíyá nāa ma um tá āa? N le ikwū je tū uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄, amáŋ á kē wā í tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na, aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú alɔ géē nyɔ̄ mla alɔ dúú. Odúúmā kú uwā í gáā hile igbīhi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ipú uwā ā, nɛ̄ alɔ gáā je ɔdōogwɛ́ɛya ŋmá le gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ɛ̄gbā á. Alɔ í jé ɛ̄nɛ̄ alɔ gáā bī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ɛɛ́ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ i táajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó wɛ ɔdā nēé yá ā ī tīifu ī jɔ́ɔnɔ ōfōōfūnū ā ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ nēe mīyɛ Alelékwū bɛ̄ɛka ɛhi kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ alɔ ā dúú, alɔ gē tíifu ipíípú, abɔ̄ alɔ gē gbēyī kóō kwú alɔ ú pīya ayí nū mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī okpíyē kú alɔ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
idu_Latn: Ó he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ká n̄ yá ɔdā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū, Ɔwɔicō kú um. Íne kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú um.

eng_Latn: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yá ká aílɔ́wá ā kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū kóō gē ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē cɛ̄tra awɔ ipéeyī aílɔ́wá, ká n̄ kē gwííjē ocɛ̄tra iyē kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lā ɛhíícō ā fu ɛɛ́. N géē bī ɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tá aéwo ā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Ó kē í lɛ ojīlīmā ce iyē um. Ó géē lɛ ikpó da aɔ́cɛ́ ɛyí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́tɔ̄ ā, klla í da uwá piyɔ́piyɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ omɔmɛ gē lɛ ikpó da ɔmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ aéwoɔhá nɛ̄ e lɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ wā ajɛ, ī mā ɔ̄ tá bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ̄ mla ūkwābɔ̄ kú nū mla ēpū kú nū géē pahīla klá ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ dóódu, kú ajɛ ā. Odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe húmáyī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɔkwu nū ā géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔkwu nū.

eng_Latn: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu nēé kwú lɛ Óndú ā piyóó, é gáā hīla anú ŋ́, é géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī wɛ aólɛlā nēe bá gē móōwē, ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā mɛ́mla ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu yēeyī le ayááyí kú Ɛ́frem, ɔyí nū má. É klla ma ayí kú Umákīyɛ, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umanásɛ tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ aá wɛ ācɛ o yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā, aá je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē je ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ɔyí aá. Ó lɛ ā, Ádā nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā í gáā je Alelékwū Ihɔ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ucɛ ɔhá dóódu kú aá, í wú um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka unwalu nɛ̄ aá ī je gā um ā. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú nū kōō le jē um dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
idu_Latn: É le ɔwɔ kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō nē é jé ā, cɛ̄ lɛ uwá okónu ucē kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ kéē géē jé ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā ka anúɔ klla gbɛlá ipú odo kú anúɔ ka okónu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ce ā ɔ́ɔ í cɛ̄ lɛ odo kú anúɔ í wāajɛ, ohígbū ka anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ̄ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋmá ɔdā olɔhi glá ā.

eng_Latn: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄ ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄, aá géē lɛ oyēeyī ŋmá iyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
idu_Latn: Aá le jīla tɔ̄há, ká aá pó, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɛ̄lā kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ádā aá.

eng_Latn: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛdɔ kú igbō nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ lé, í lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi í jéédé ŋ́ le aíne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi ā bīya.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é wɛ ɛpa gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɔkpíyē ékpó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le gbō bɔ́há, ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō fō uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
idu_Latn: Aá ka lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē bī anɔ̄ o lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ɔ́līfu ā wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú agege ā kóō kwu yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄ɔ̄lá piyóó.

eng_Latn: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā Ulákissi ā, aá kwú úgbɔ́ɔnya ā ú pla ɔ́nya igbīhi. Aá bī ɛdɔ kú odōbɔ̄bí éékpó nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá ā, anɔ́ɔ aá cɛ̄ lɛ Ujerúsālɛm le íne bīya á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
idu_Latn: Lɛ anɔ̄ ā mī klá uwá ká ā lɛ uwá yá tīihɔ dúúdú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ká ɔdā dúúmā nōo í lɛ iyē kwu ɔ̄ ā, é í je ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔdā ō tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā wɛ ohútu klɔɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ kú ōwē nɛ̄ ācɛ í má.

eng_Latn: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́mān mɛ́mla Ásāfu, mɛ́mla Étan, gē gwō anwa kú oje udɔ nɛ̄ ɔkɔ kú nū lipú ā á.

eng_Latn: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó le kwú ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔnyōkwū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á híīī jikwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Usímri, éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū nōo ge leyīkwu āyā éyi kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú Ɛ́la, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ujɔ̄ tū tū Ɛ́la. Ɛ̄cī éyi, ejé yɔ̄ ī kwú Ɛ́la, ɔlɛ́ Asáa, nōo wɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ nōo gē leyīkwu agbla kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē yá ɔdā nōo lɛ kpaakpa eko dóódu, amáŋ uwēyī nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī gé lɛ iyī alɔ á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi kú oyēeyī kú odúúdú alɔ nēe lā Ujúda mɛ́mla ipú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ a fíyákátā ga ipú aéwo oligbó mɛ́mla aéwo nēe kwajaajɛ, ohígbū ka alɔ í cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ é nyɔ̄ í tayínū ba ī gbēyī, abɔ́ɔ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ái, ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ái mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tɛlu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le gbo ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā da aá kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā yɔ̄ amānyā ámāŋ ánūmā a!, aá híīī cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: N gē bī éŋkpɔ̄ yá aá ubatísim, amáŋ anú ā géē bī alelékwū Ihɔ le yá aá ubatísim.

eng_Latn: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ā le jɛ̄ klla le amɛ̄ hɛ́. Ícíícɛ nɛ́ ɔyí ā hɛ́ amɛ̄ ā, Ébrahām le ucɛ yá klɛ́ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
idu_Latn: N kwú ajɛ ú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ uwá géē lā, klla le uwá bū tū ɛɛ́. É lā ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā ɛbɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā je unwalu lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē kpɛ́fú tá uwā í yá uwā ífi gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nēé tɛtɛ yá uwā.

eng_Latn: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā, ācɛ gēe pīya eyī wā ɛga īyī Ɔwɔicō nōo yá uwá a, Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a ka ootá-abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ Unetaníya.

eng_Latn: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da Udánīyɛlu kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́wɔ dóódu á. Anú klla wɛ Óndū kú aɔ́cɛ́ á. Ó klla ī ma ɔdōtayínū fú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, ohígbū koó yá ká ā lɔfú lɛ ɔ̄na kú um nyā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
idu_Latn: Ísu kú Unáyilu ā géē cē aábaná klá ɛcɛ nēe géē pɛ́ ga ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ipú inu ogbiyɔ̄lā kú uwɔ, ipú ɔlɛ́ kú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. É kōō í pɛ́ ga ipú ocíbú ō yá igbō kú uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka eko ɔ́ɔmāa í le kpií ŋ́ nɛɛ, é gáā nya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā, ó géē cē eko ā kpií.

eng_Latn: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé wā Ɛ́fēsɔsi ā, Upɔ́lu habɔ̄ Uprisíla mɛ́mla Akwíla tá abɔ́ɔ. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū le tá ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā gaá yɔ̄ ī miya ɛlā mla ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Ujísɔ̄si le tá ísu kú Ugálīli nōo wɛ ísu kú Utibérīyasi ā.

eng_Latn: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá jéeyi nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ aólíla á.

eng_Latn: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nū ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú uwá, hīla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
idu_Latn: Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu í gáā jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū he uwɔ lɛ, ámāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū bīya gā awɔ lɛ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Kirjatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ukɛriyatárim, Ucefíra, mɛ́mla Ubéerɔ̄tu wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwáahāapa ce ɛtá .

eng_Latn: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé lɛ ɔdā nēé túbá ā miya ā, ācɛ nēe kpó nwuné fíyɛ́ ā, í lɛ nwuné cabá fíyɛ́ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēé kpó nwuné ŋ́ mā, í kē lɛ nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ŋ́. Ó le jɛ̄ uwā yíílí. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kpó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lé glá ā.

eng_Latn: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ɔbɔ́cɛ ā ī ce Óndú ā ɛgbá ŋ́, amáŋ ó gē méyīnyinyi ācɛ nēe tá iyī uwā wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi tíne ō lɛ odée yá ɔ́mpānū icííci ŋmá lɛ ō kpó ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
idu_Latn: é lɛ ɔ pīya tū ɔdée lɛ ācɛ ā kéē lé. Amáŋ okónu nɛ̄ uwá le jé ɔ̄ má ā, é le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔdā ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ipú ɛ̄hī ɔ́ɔmā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ajɛ kú obū mɛ́mla ígbájí nɛ̄ ɔlá í gē fíyajɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɛbɛɛbɛ le dobū kpímm ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kwú cɔ̄nū á. Anɔ́ɔ ó dɔɔ̄ka kahíníī, Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ n yá āa? Ɔdí wɛ íne nɛ̄ n bīya ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē nū um inya ká ā lɛ um kwú āa?.

eng_Latn: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
idu_Latn: Ó géē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kwu ācɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
idu_Latn: Ɔtūnōbí le fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le īlī mɛ́mla aɔ́dōyíifa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kpó lɛ Urebéka. Ó klla je ɛhi nōo gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔyínɛ́ kú Urebéka mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, a géē je ɔbá ɛna éyi gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Ó klla í gwu ede ā iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ anɔ̄ kú ólīfu tū ɔ̄ kóō kwú tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ kpɔ́cíkpɔ́cí kú ayááyí kú Ísɔ á. Ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú Ísɔ, Ɛlífāasi, wɛ ádā kú ayí nēe bá aā: Utéman, Ómaru, Usɛ́fɔ, Ukɛ́nāsi.

eng_Latn: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Ukálɛ̄bu ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukénisi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda gā ɛgiyí Ujóssuwa Ugígalu gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka Ukadessi Ubánēya ohígbū anúɔ mɛ́mla anú lɛ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā abɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔmā wɛ Ɛlísu, ɔyí kú Ussidíyu.

eng_Latn: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le aícɔ́ɔja kú Ukússi ā yálé. Eko nɛ̄ Ása gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá uwā ā, é kwú pɛ́ kwu.

eng_Latn: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ ā gē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ɛ̄gbā, alɔ í pīya igbīhi kwu ɔ́ ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ alɔ, ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ayí kú Ulífāyi gē tá uwá abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: n géē kpó uwá lɛ aólɛlā kú uwá nēe gē tíne ō ŋmó uwā ā. Aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí géē kpó aókwū kú uwā lé.

eng_Latn: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔcɛ́ ā kóō lɛ́ɛcɛ piyóó. Ofū kú ɔcɛ́ kóō fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā. Ācɛ kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́ɔhā ce uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ce ɔcɛ́ ā, kéē klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kóō le lɔhi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄ géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é bɔ́tū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā dúú gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je ōwē lɛ Umówābu, é kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔkpáni, gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō híī kpó alɔ ŋmó ŋ́. Alɔ le jé ɛɛ́ ka, nááná nɛ̄ alɔ tɛtɛ bīya íne igbo alɛwa ŋmá igbīhi ā, alɔ klla le íne bīya kpɔ́, o ŋmá lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú abɔ̄yī alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī le nyíleyī ŋmá ɛlā Ɔwɔicō, oŋmá lɛ ucē kú íla nēe miyɛ cɛ̄ āa. Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́ɔhā ce aá.

eng_Latn: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
idu_Latn: Abísāyi, ɔyí kú Userúya lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, yálé ɔpɛ́ kú ɔmā ā, klla lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā úlā ofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
idu_Latn: Aá híī lé odóódu kú ipú aígbáanɔ̄ nēe bá nyā ŋ́. Aɛ́nyā kē í wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá:.

eng_Latn: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔdāŋ ka okwū ā gaá ce īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nēé gaá nyi ā, īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í gáā je tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá í gwōkónu ā tū. Aá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ hīgwú tɔ̄há! Aá lɛ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā túbá tɔ̄ɔ̄há, mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, kú aá jikwū klá anú.

eng_Latn: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá bī ɛhi kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí ā wā gé lɛ Óndú ā. Aá lɛ ɔ́ pá, lɛ ɔ́ gbā ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá bī wā.

eng_Latn: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
idu_Latn: Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ kú Uhɛ́ti, Usábādi, ɔyí kú Álāyi.

eng_Latn: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá gē yɛ́ɛ́bɛ́ āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá gē cōkónu gbɛdɛɛ tá ɔ̄ āa? Aá wɛ ayí kú ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ayí kú ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ujɛ́yɛlu mɛ́mla Umanásɛ gē tá ɔdā dóódu kú nū a tāajɛ lɛ ɔ́ á. Umaaníya gē leyīkwu uwá á. Odúúdú uwā wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
idu_Latn: Ń yá uwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ é je ukpa gbēyī um. É lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū tá ajɛ gbēyī um ká n̄ le míya tá ipú nū, nááná nɛ̄ ń yá uwā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó aólɛlā kú uwɔ, je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄, je ɔdā ōgwá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ dúúmā le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu nēé bá ī nunu tū iyī uwā, ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā í mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ gā okónōgwu kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú aólɛlā ā, kéē má anúɔ, ɔdā dóódu nēé má anúɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ā, kéē yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī kóō he uwɔ ɔtū. Ó géē je uwɔ gicō nɛ̄hi. Lɛ ɔ́ kwú bɔ́tū, ó klla í bī ojīlīmā gé lɛ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le igelī nɛ̄hi ā túgwó. Ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛga nēé kpó ajɛ tū ɔ̄ mu nōo yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛfu ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le ɛga ohile kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā túgwó á.

eng_Latn: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄hī ɔmɛ dóódu nēé bī le he ɛbɛ́ ā, é géē je ɔ́ ca. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛhī oje nēé bī le he ɔ́ á, é géē na ɔ́, klla lɛ ɔ́ cā mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ péee.

eng_Latn: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya kwú aéde nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda gwó kwu icō kú ɛyí inu kú ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ Áhāsi lā ā mɛ́mla ede nɛ̄ Umanásɛ, ɔcɛ́ ma kwu ódúdɛ̄cɛ ɛpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ú kpó ca tāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le imini ā kpó pīya tá tū ɔpɛ́ kú Ukídirɔn.

eng_Latn: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā wā inu ā kóō má aúgbɔga nēe bá ā, ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi, nōó le úwé kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā wiiyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó wā ipú uwɔ, Ujerúsālɛm, aɔ́cí nēé hī ka Upáyin, Ujúnīpa, mɛ́mla Usáyiprɛ̄si, nēe tū ɛgahi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā. É kē í lɛ uwá yá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā kóō le héyīfuú, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛga nɛ̄ um gē lɛ ikpó ce ā kóō kwú tū ɛgahi.

eng_Latn: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛ́sta le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā ohígbū ɛlā ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da nēé tá tāajɛ ā je. Ɔ́da ā kwú pīya ikwū Uháman mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó tōōlī playi icō á.

eng_Latn: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ koó lá ɔ̄ cīgbīhi ɛplá iháyí éyi ā glá ŋ́, ó gáā lɛ íkwu ō lá ɔlɛ́ ā cīgbīhi glá gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlɛ́ ā kwú pīya ɔdā kú ukpɛ́ kú agbénū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā mɛ́mla ayááyí kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É gáā je ɔ́ cīgbīhi eko kú ɔdā ō je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ń wā gaá kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋ́ nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í bīyíne ŋ́. Amáŋ abālɔbányā é lɛ ɔdā ōlɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ dúúmā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí Ubálam, le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó géē ka lɛ ɔ́ ā ka lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí Ubálāki á.

eng_Latn: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā mīyɛ Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nyíliyētá ipú uwā, gē ga ɛga dóódu kú Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ é le ɔ́ yálé nyā, ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ isu yɛ uwá jīla tá ā ge gɔ́ ipú ufi, okónu í klla gáā hɛ́ ācɛ a ohígbū ífi nɛ̄hi nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ɔhá kéē wɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́. Anú wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīma ā géē yá ucē ojīlīma. Ó kē ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ ɛlā okpaakpa eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ā yɛ ligbō gwō um tá ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō kú um, wā fíyaa í tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ tū ɛcɛ ā, ācɛ kú Unínīfɛ géē héyī kē í ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí, ohígbū kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí kú uwā abɔ̄ é lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujóna ka lɛ uwá ā pó ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ amānyā nōo fíyɛ́ Ujóna!.

eng_Latn: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
idu_Latn: Ó klla mīyɛ ajɛ nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛfu kú Uhálaki, ga Uséyɛ ā, jāā ga Ubááligadi, ɔpɛ́ kú Ulɛ́bānɔn, ɛháajɛ kú ɛfu kú Uhɛ́ɛmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta nōo le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ ka lɛ Óndú ā ka éyi ŋmá ipú igwó nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú nū ā, dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá gɛ ŋ́, ka aá kwú kpó lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, aéwɔhá, ayókwū mɛ́mla anyōkwū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je íne lɛ aá ɛɛ́. Ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je lɛ aá ā. Ka aá í je mlanyī íne dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú íne kú uwɔ nāa le kwu ajɛ ā le kpaakpa klla tōō lɔtūce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ī dɔɔ̄kā ā, wɛ ko ō tíne ɔdōbɔ̄bí kéē yá. Amáŋ, ācɛ o yá ɔdā olɔhi ā le bū tū kli, bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo tá ɛgba ga ipíípú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
idu_Latn: A le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá yá um okónu. A klla gwō tá um, ka anúɔ kpó aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya alɛwa kú anúɔ le Ulɛ́bānɔn yálé klla mīyɛ odúúdú aɛ́fu kú uwā tāabɔ̄. Ka anúɔ klla le yɛ ga ipíípú kú ūpū kú nū gaá lɛ aɔ́cí usɛ́da nēe jɛ̄ licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā mɛ́mla aɔ́cí Usáyíprɛsi nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpó hɛ́ klá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwɔ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa ge tá ifu ā? Da uwá ka, anɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī tíifu ohígbū ɔ̄kā nɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā ā gā, ipú kú odúúdú uwā géē je gbogodo, abɔ̄ í hɛ́ uwā iyē, ɔtū kú uwá í je gbenyi, okwúukwu kú uwá klla í fīyégbúlú. Eko le yá ɛɛ́, eko ā gā ɛɛ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā i ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
idu_Latn: Tíne íjééyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú tíne oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ka aɔ́dā agbénú ɔhá lɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó lɛ um yálé klla lɛ um ŋmó, alɔ géē je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá, amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n lɛ ɔ́ yálé klla lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, aá géē je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le abɔ̄ kwɔtū ɔtū kóō lɛ ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsalɛm ā wūlatāajɛ piíí. Óndú ā le ɔ́ŋgbá miya ɔdɔ kú igá ā cɛ́ɛ́, kóō má ka é kwú ɔ̄ ú wúlatāajɛ piíí. Ó klla kwú aólɛlā ā tū ŋmá o je ɔdɔ ā wúlatāaj ŋ́. Ó le igá nɛ̄ ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā má ɛga gaajɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm glá ŋ́ mā wúlatāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ɔdɔ kú igá ā yɔ̄ ī jikwū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile ā le ɔcɛ́, Ujówāsi bī tá jāā ga agbla kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́. Ujówāsi le bēé tá ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ogbāajɛ ā bá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the LORD came unto him,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le ɔdā nyā má ā, ó le hɛ́ ɔ̄ idáagó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ajaajɛ kóō le ɔ̄ má lɔhi lɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó pó ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā ka.

eng_Latn: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
idu_Latn: É klla lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Usíkilāgi mɛ́mla Umekóna mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujúdasi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Abālɔbányā ācɛ géē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā, ó géē yá kú ācɛ kéē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ idáagó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā yá jīla ā, ācɛ o tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu kwú ɔ̄ ú wāajɛ ŋmá ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú únóji á.

eng_Latn: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
idu_Latn: A klla gwō ka anúɔ bū aóbugā klla gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá uwá ipú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá alɛwa. A ka ka ikpó kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɛ́ɛ klla kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔkpá dóódu kú Unáyilu nōo yɔ̄ Íjīpiti ā ú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔyípóklóbīya kú Uhíbru éyi nōo yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla alɔ. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāajɛ ā. Alɔ le ɔ̄na kú alɔ kpó ka lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛyí nū kpó ka lɛ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si cɔcɛ́ ā, ipú ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Unísān ā, Uháman le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɛbā anwa nēé hī upúrim ā gwó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɛ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔyā nɛ̄ ó géē je odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu kpó ŋmó ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛtá kú ɔyā igwɛ́ɛpa, nēé hī ka Áda ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Úlam ma ɔyí éyi nōo lé ka Ubédan. É wɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugílɛ̄di, ɔyí kú Umákīyɛ, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī ā, géē lé úgwū kú ojīlīmā, amáŋ uwēyī géē kwú aólɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, íjééyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú úláyi gbōō, nōo klla yɔ̄ ī je ɔkɔ gicō yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú ōlihī ā.

eng_Latn: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
idu_Latn: Okónu ō tá, ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā mɛ́mla ɔfū ōlā le mu ɔ́ okónu. Ó gē bī unwalu gé lɛ ācɛ. Ɛlā obɔ̄bí í kē lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄ ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɛbɛ ā tūūfi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka á, N fīyégbúlú mla ufi.

eng_Latn: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
idu_Latn: n leyī ce ka n géē būce aá abālɔbányā, ká n̄ lɛ aá má eko nɛ̄ n gáā yɛ ga Usipéni ā, kú aá kē tá um abɔ̄ ká n̄ pīya tá ɔwɛ kú um, eko nɛ̄ n dēē klá mla aá lígíí.

eng_Latn: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo yá uwɔ klla yá ɔ́na kú uwɔ ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kahíníī, A yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka n lɛ uwɔ fūla klla lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Ami lɛ iyē ce uwɔ á. A wɛ ákú um nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ abɔ́ɔ ā wā kéē nuunu tá anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le inu nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ā yɛ jīla tá otú á. Ó kéē tíne ō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ odiyɔ̄ kú anúɔ bá ajɛ kwɛyí anúɔ jāā gbéeko nēé le odiyɔ̄ ā lá ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē mīyɛ ulé kú ɔdā nēé yá ā piíí. Ucē kú uwā piíí ā gáā tū ōcē klá uwá á.

eng_Latn: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
idu_Latn: É géē kwú uwɔ icō ce ipú abɔ̄ kú uwā, nɛ̄ á gáā gwōnū ɛ́ɛ́ nāa ī lɛ ikpó gbo ɛcɔ̄, gē yá iyī uwɔ ágbe ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
idu_Latn: nōó kwú mlanyí ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá ɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ uwɔ bī wā ɔlɛ́. Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē leyīkwu kpɔ́ kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kéē lɛ pɛ́ gekwú ɛ̄cī ékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, cāŋjɛ ká ā wā í tá um abɔ̄. Má ɛlā nyā abɔ̄yī uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Óndú cāŋjɛ, ká ā lɛ italā yá odúúdú aéwo ā. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bíipú nēe ī yá ibīyājɛ ɔ́ɔmā nyɔ̄ icííci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
idu_Latn: Ó gā ɛgiyí ayíkpó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má uwā bá ī gbɔlā, anɔ́ɔ ó da Upíta kahíníī, Ayíka aá leyī kwɛɛcɛ mla um áwa ékpó glá ŋ́ kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
