idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ iyē, ká ā lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ajɛ mɛ́mla ōcē, ká ā má ɔ̄. Ó géē ka atufú gā uwɔ ipéyī uwɔ cāā.

eng_Latn: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ɔtū klla í kpó aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa nɛ̄hi í nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá Íjīpiti, nōo lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tútū tá ajɛ ī gbēyī uwā ā. Ó klla í kpɛ́fú tá uwá nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ é gē plla ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā klla í yá ɔ̄ lé.

eng_Latn: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ú lé. Aá le ɔkpá tá ŋmá uwá iyē klla le aíkpokwú kú uwā kpó ca, klla le ɛbɛ́ kú uwā wā nyɛ̄ŋɛnyɛ̄ŋɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ nēé gáā kpó tū ipú ɛ̄hī ā.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee thence: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē bla ka, ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ uwá tá á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ anúɔ je ɔdā lɛ uwá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: In the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ipú Ujerúsālɛm. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā!.

eng_Latn: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
idu_Latn: Ussímēyi gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɛcɔ̄ klá Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīlatá ā.

eng_Latn: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le okónu ce ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá ā ɛ̄gbā mla ɔtú ékpónú mɛ́mla odo kú aá.

eng_Latn: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa ipú ajɛ ā bá ī gbɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, ó ka é bá ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla bá ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, bá ī wūwī klla bá ī gbaajā ipú ajɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ le odúúdú aíne kpó bīya.

eng_Latn: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yēeyī nááná a, awɔ gē kpó alɔ ga ɔgbɛ́fú klla í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gē yálé á. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā, le okónu ce ga awɔ ka, awɔ ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛdɔ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā āa? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyí nū kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɛga nōó kwu nyɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, ɔ́ɔ lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋmó iyī nū ŋmá lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ lɛ anúɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó ka anúɔ géē mīyɛ īkpɔ̄dā mla ejé kú anúɔ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Ó ka anúɔ klla í mīyɛ īlī ewulu mla īlī inyaŋgbɛ lɛ ɔ́ kóō le klá ohɛ́ɛwa kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
idu_Latn: Ayí igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú Uhɛ́mān ā: Ubukíya, Umatánīya, Usíyɛ̄lu, Ussébūwelu, Ujɛ́rīmɔtu, Uhananíya, Uhanáni, Ɛlíyāta, Ugidálti, Urómāmtiyɛ́sa, Ujóssbekássa, Umálɔti, Uhótɛ̄ɛ mɛ́mla Umáhāsíyɔ̄ti.

eng_Latn: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, é gé bá ī gwɛ́ɛya ō pá ɔlá lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú íne nɛ̄ Óndú je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó leyī pīya klá ajɛ le ɔkɔ gbā.

eng_Latn: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kwu ipú uwā abɔ́ɔ piyóó ā, aéwo ɔhá ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ nōo wɛ Óndú á ɔ́ɔ je ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē wɛ ákú um á.

eng_Latn: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Óndú gaá da um ka.

eng_Latn: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō tá ipú ɔtū kú ācɛ á, ó kē tīile kéē le ɔ́ nwū ɛlā ɔkwɛyi, kéē bī ɔ le yá kú alɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔhi ŋ́. Ó gē nā alɔ tá ɔwɛ, o kē īī nwū ācɛ ɔwɛ nēé géē lā oyēeyī kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oōcɛ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
idu_Latn: Úsi mɔyí éyi nōo yɔ̄ ā, Ísrahíya. Ísrahíya ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Obadáya, Ujówɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Isssíya. É wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔ́nū.

eng_Latn: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ íjééyī kú Ɔwɔicō i mafú koó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, oŋmá oyēeyī kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe mīyɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó, amáŋ ka ɔ́da kú Óndú mɛ́mla ɛlā kú íne dóódu kú Óndú ā nēé bīya á nɛɛ, a géē nwū ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá lɛ, eko kú ɛpɔ̄ ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī lɛpɔ̄bí kú íne kú Óndú ā ō bīya ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá nwū uwā lɛ ā ŋ́, aá mɛ́mla uwā géē jɛ̄ ɔlá kú ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ úklɔ́ kú aá yá lɔhi, aá gáā lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Unówa kahíníī, N le tútū ká n̄ kpó odúúdu alɛɛcɛ ŋmó ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ alɛɛcɛ le mu mla ɔ́bíipú ā, n géē je uwá mɛ́mla ɛcɛ kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
idu_Latn: Ó géē fú ɔtulalī ā tū ɔlá ipéyī Óndú ā, ódūdū kú ɔtulalī ā í klá ɔwū Ikpati kú Ɛka ā, í je ɔ́ tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, o yá kóó híī má ɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gekwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
idu_Latn: N le tútū ō lɛ ɛyí ce ikwū kú ɔdā nōo ī yá kóō yá.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu lɛ ɔ́da je ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ Umikáya kwú kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú kwúcē gé lɛ Ámɔ̄n, igbómína kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ga ɛga ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi éyi wā abɔ́ɔ, ó le yɛ gaá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú bū abɔ̄ ɔhá kú ɔwɛ ā le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā ka lɛ aá ā, n tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ́ ka lɛ aá igbalɛwa ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā n gáā ka lɛ aá kpɔ́, yɔ̄ ī jikwū ohígbū ka ɛlā ā kwú um iyē nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ ācɛ alɛwa kú aá nōo ŋmá lɛ ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī nēé lā ā, lɛ iyī uwā pīya aólɛlā kú ikwū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā klla kahíníī, É le ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu yáŋmó. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe kwú uwā aɔ́fiyɛ ā bá ī gbō uwá gɛɛ, í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt stand abroad, and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gbēyī ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyínɔ̄nyā ámāŋ ka ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí nɔ̄nyā kú ɔnyā dúú nɛ̄ a gē cikpó nū ŋ́. É lɔfú wɛ ɔmáapú uwɔ glá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya ɔmáapú uwɔ nɛ̄ a cikpó nū abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó kē klla ka ɔ́ ipú Aíjē olɔhi ɔhá ka, Á gáā cɛ̄ ká ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ká uwɔ kóō wā tāajɛ ipú únóji ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram da Ulɔ́tu kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ɔmáapú, ikpɛ́lā í cíkā ō yɔ̄ otāhɛ̄ ācogbāálá kú um mɛ́mla ákú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
idu_Latn: É lɛ um oyēeyī hɛ́ kpá, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́yí lɛbɛ̄ɛka áklɔ́kpɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá géē fu ŋmá ajɛ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē hɛ́ īlī kló ŋmá ɔcí nēé ī bī le tá īlī ā. N gbɛlá ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī je oyēeyī kú um ŋmɛ́yí nɛ.

eng_Latn: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lɛ ije tá ije ɔkwu lɛ éwɔhá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ije kplá anú ā, ámāŋ, kéē híī lɛ ije tá ije nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le kplá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔkwu ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē lɛ íne ā tū cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce uwá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ kéē lā ā.

eng_Latn: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
idu_Latn: Ó le eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yíihɔtū tū, ó le eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kē ī wɔ́tu ɔ̄cɛ tū dúú. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē kpɛ́fú yɔ̄, eko kú ɛbɔ́ ō yá kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Áhābu ofɛtá ce igwó lā Usamérīya. Ujéhu le ɔkpá tá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ o leyīkwu ayááyí kú Áhābu á. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujéhu tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ile kú unu nɛ̄ n nu tá ɛbɛ ipácí, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, ajɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi amānyā ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kéē je ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́, ó lɛ ā ayíka, Ālɔ̄ lé ucɛ, klla gwá ejé ohígbū ka óócí alɔ í kwú.

eng_Latn: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ā híī bī ɔwɛ éékpónú nāa lɛ yá ɔtulalī nyā lɛ yá ɛ́gbla kú nū lɛ iyī uwɔ ŋ́. Je ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō tīihɔ nēé je gā um ā.

eng_Latn: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ahi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Abudíyēlu mɛ́mla ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ugúni nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
idu_Latn: Aócīkpó géē tóombli gicō gajɛ bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū ā. Aódokónu klla í tɔ́ɔga ohígbū éeyē. Éŋkpɔ̄ géē cēenyi klá ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ígbíli, aɔ́kpá klla í pɛ́ bū ipú ajɛ ikpakpla ā.

eng_Latn: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ma ɛfu kwu ajɛ á. Anú klla kē yá owu á. Ó gē je ɛlá nɛ̄ ó gē gbo ā mafú lɛ ācɛ. Ó kwú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ú pīya ajɛ odobū. Anú gē gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ kpátáá nyá á. Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā abɔ̄yīnū yá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á.

eng_Latn: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ gbɔɔ́ ō kpéyīce ɔnyā nū ka ɔ́ɔ le ajā gbo tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le iyī nū iyē tēelihɔ eko nɛ̄ó yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū.

eng_Latn: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu klá mla ācocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō kú Ukɔ́rīnti ɛ̄cī alɛwa, anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla Uprísila mɛ́mla Akwíla le pɛ́ tá ipú úgbéenyi le pɛ́ tá Usiríya. Ipú ajɛ kú Ukenkiríya Upɔ́lu lɛ ɛyí plla ohígbū oji nōó tɛtɛ hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
idu_Latn: Ípú iháyí ɔ́mofu ce igwáahāānɛ kú ɔ́cɛ kú Ása ā, ōcē kú ikpó kwú ɔ̄ ikpó ú ŋmó. Nááná ā, ó kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ōcē kú nū ā kóō mɛ ŋ́ kpɔ́, amáŋ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɛgiyí aólobócí nɛ̄ eyī kú nū kwu á.

eng_Latn: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu eko nyā, ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó alɔ, íjēenyi gē ŋmó alɔ, áhingílí nɛ̄ alɔ gē le wiiyē mɛ́ɛ̄ á, é gē gɔ́ alɔ, alɔ bá gē yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ, amáŋ ayí uwɔ í lɛ íne kú um tū gɛ ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
idu_Latn: É yá ācɛ ōhī ɔdā uwēyī klla ŋmó uwā ijē, klla le agbá kpó kwu uwá, lɛ uwá kpó tū inu agbá.

eng_Latn: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ fu ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔmā éyi ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē kpó aɔ́dā kú ɛya ā gwɛ́ɛya klla í yá aɔ́dā ɔhá nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
idu_Latn: Ká ē kōō kwú iyī uwā í tayínū ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī Ukámɛ̄lu ā, nááná, n géē dɔɔ̄kā uwā ga abɔ́ɔ, klla í kwú uwā. É kōō kwú iyī uwā í tayínū okɛklɛ kú ísu ŋmá ɛgiyí um, nááná, n géē je íkwu lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú ipú ísu kéē kwú uwā ayīnu.

eng_Latn: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɛlā alɛwa ipú ācīije. Ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi le tá ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá nyi īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
idu_Latn: Ó le tá ɛcɛ ɛplá oje ahāanɛ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó má ācɛ ɔhá bá icííci ɔɔ́pu ā á.

eng_Latn: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī má icō, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā á. Oŋmá ohí wā ajɛ kú nū lɛbɛɛka ɔlá, oŋmá ohí ga icō kú nū kē yɔ̄ í fíyāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka udɔ nēé le nya ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Ámram ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá ā: Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi, mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā éyi, Umíriyam. Árɔ̄ni ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Unádābu, Abíhu, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Ítáma.

eng_Latn: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
idu_Latn: Uklɔdíyɔ̄si Ulisíyasi tá ɔkpá gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ o lɛ ojīlīmā Ufélīsi, Igbómína. N hokónu tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu da Usámūwɛ̄lu ka íni nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ka ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ́ gáā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá glá ŋ́ mā bá āa? É da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ aá kú aá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ ɔwɔ ā yā wā í klá ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ɛcɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ wɛ dúú. Ó le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ bá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā kpó ca tāajɛ kpɛ́m, ó klla le aɔ́cí kpó cē wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is an honourable man; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can shew us our way that we should go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Háyi ɛ́ɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō éyi yɔ̄ ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nyā. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó gē ka ā, gē yá jīla. Ālɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí nū, ekōhī, ó géē da alɔ ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú pīyɛ̄ aíjakī ā.

eng_Latn: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó ka ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ le obɔ̄bí nyī, anɔ́ɔ é le īkpō kú nū cē á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ le īkpō nɛ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú ūwā ɔ́ɔ nyī ā cē ɛ́ɛ́. Ó ka ohígbū ka é lɛ ɔtū kpó ce úgbɔ́nya ō kpɛ́fú kú ūwā mɛ́mla mla ɔkpacaŋgelī kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
idu_Latn: le pó ɔkpáncō, Óndú, ká ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā ká, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā ŋmó ɛpɔ̄bí. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kē lɛ italā yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kē lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ́pɔ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndū ā lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce eko igbīhāajɛ kú oyēeyī kú Ujóbu ā fíyɛ́ eko aflɛ́yí kú oyēeyī kú nū ā á. Ujóbu lɛ aálá úlā ofuciigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , aínyankwūlūmī úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , aɛ́na úlā ɛhɔ̄ , mɛ́mla aíjakī úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jɛ́yí ɔdā nōo le kpakpa ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í dɔɔ̄kā ō yɔ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
idu_Latn: Aá gwííjē, ka aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ka anú nya aógbɛhá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá yɔ̄ ī piya uwá tū ā á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba. Ayí nū le anú, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā kpó tū ipú ugbɔ́ɔnya nɛ̄ Uféro tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā ā.

eng_Latn: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú aɔ́wɔ mɛ́mla aójibó kú ɛcí kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ ó ma kwu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, í kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwú aéde kú ɛcí nēé kpó kwu ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā ú kpó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm gaá le uwá kpó tá bónū.

eng_Latn: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
idu_Latn: Ásāfu nōó je otrɛ̄yí kú uwā á, Usekaríya kē kpókónu ce ɔ́ á. Aɔ́há ā wɛ, Ujɛ́yɛlu, Usémīramɔ́tu, Ujehíyɛ̄lu, Umatitíya, Ɛlíyābu, Ubenáya, Obɛ́dɛ̄dɔm, mɛ́mla Ujéhīyɛlu bá ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū. Ásāfu yɔ̄ í gwó anwa kú oje.

eng_Latn: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
idu_Latn: Anú yá aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nēé hī ka ɔgwú, mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ugwū layīlayī, mɛ́mla ogbɔ̄lɛ́ gbēyī ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nēe kwu ɛhícō ā á.

eng_Latn: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́ɔ́wɔ géē je kpó wā í mɛ tāajɛ. Ɔkpáncō géē je hā ŋ́má icō bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī hā ipoto ā. Aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ī bá í fō wā ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ēpū oŋmó nēe gē wúla ŋmá icō ɔcí wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ubánābasi kwú ɔ̄ ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ bī wā gé lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le da uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu má Óndú ā ɔwɛ lɛ ā. Ó da uwá ka Ondú ā kē le ɛlā ka mla anú dúú. Ó klla da uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu bī iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si tɔ́ɔna pāālā ipú Udamásikɔ̄si lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɛ ī lɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ keé jé ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo gē mafú ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā kú ācɛ kéē yɛ ā fúlufúlu ŋ́, ikɔkɔ nēé lɛ ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā jé klla le cīgbīhi ŋmá olɛhɔ̄ otīihɔ nēé cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umerí le pó ā, ó nyāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó páápá le tá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔkpani, alɔ má ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī bī iyē kú uwɔ le nū ebilíi tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́má ipú kú ācɛ. Alɔ da ɔ́ kóō mā ohígbū koó wɛ éyi kú ipú ígwu kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
idu_Latn: N kwú odúúdú aéwo kú aá ú kpó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn kóō gbō aá abālɔbányā ɛɛ́. N kē géē yá ka aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā dúú.

eng_Latn: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kɛlā lɛ Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ká ami mɛ́mla awɔ̄ hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ n nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Aá géē leyīkwu cāāā bá ī mā um abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī cílá ajɛ Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nēé yá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: É ma Ujísɔ̄si Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m kú Ujudíya, eko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du ce ɔcɛ́ ā. Eko kpiíí ācɛ ojéeyī gā Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kéē wā í má ɔyí nēé ma ā.

eng_Latn: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú uwā le mu mla ɛlá ōbɔ̄bí, odo kú uwá yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá klla ī yá ojuju kú ɔ́bíipú piyóó.

eng_Latn: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú Óndú ā wɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi klla le kpaakpa. Ó kē ī yúklɔ́ kú nū dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lɔtūce ɔ́ glá.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ āpīicɛ kú uwā le kɛ̄ɛpa, nēe gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
idu_Latn: Usíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Uhaháya nōo gē na ɔwá kú ugóolu ā, ma ɔdɔ gboce uwá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á. Uhananíya nōo gē yá ɔtulālī ā klla ma ɔdɔ ā gboce ɔ́, ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā gāá kwu ɔdɔ olɔwá nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi pó iŋini nɛ̄ ɛwa ā gē ka ohígbū nū ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya le aídengéli tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé ā, ó le tá ɔlɛ́ Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujɔ́ni nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá kú nū lé ka Umáki, ɛga nɛ̄ ayíkpó alɛwa jīla tɔ̄há bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
idu_Latn: Aá gē plla iyī aá ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō icííci, aá cíkā ō bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ukúss ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Unímrɔ̄du nōo je pīya ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí kú ipú ɛcɛ nōo yálé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
idu_Latn: Ádā uwɔ pi alɔ yúklɔ́ abɔ̄fú lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɔfú je iyó kú ōwē ā ŋmá alɔ ɛyí, klla lɛ oyēeyī yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ alɔ lígíii, alɔ géē bá ɛháajɛ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
idu_Latn: Igbaáluka dúúmā nɛ̄ a ga ipú unwalu, ó géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄. Ó kē ī gbō uwɔ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ odúúmā í gáā kwu uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā yá kwɛyí ā, é le alɔ iyē gwu ŋmá íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā, o ŋmá lɛ ō je ɔkpíyē kú nū gwɛ́ɛya igbeékpónú ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le Urécɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ulɛ́ya hīgwú ga ipácí, ɛga nɛ̄ aálá kú nū bá ā.

eng_Latn: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
idu_Latn: Ó le eyī pīya má Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ nēe bá ɔpɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má ódūdū ŋmá ajɛ gicō bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū kú ɔlá kú útuló ā.

eng_Latn: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi nyā yá, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nwū um ɛlā. A kē yá uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē cokónu lɛ ācɛ lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ ka anúɔ gē yá ā ī lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi klla lɔnyɛ kú ayíné ká ē lā tɔ̄há ɛbɔ́ ipú ō pīyatɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n le iyī um kwú klá cíí ɛbɔ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo le amɛ̄ gwá mɛ bōōbū kwú ɛyí ú bá ɛ́nɛ́ nū ɔtū má cíí ā. ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ odo kú um gwutá cíí lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔfiyɛ nēé bá gē cɛ̄ ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó le kwú ɔ̄ iyē lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu kwú. Abɔ̄ é gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, ami mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí uwā gaá lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá, abɔ̄ n le jé ka ó wɛ ɔyí ajɛ kú Uróm ā.

eng_Latn: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
idu_Latn: é bā ī yɛ ŋmá éwo éyi ga ɔhá, ŋmá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éyi ga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ikpɛ́cí kú Ássɛ̄ra ú kpó ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ga eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ukídirɔn ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó tɔ̄lá, anɔ́ɔ é le ewo kú nū wú ɔjī kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ewo, anɔ́ɔ ó kwu ú pahīla klá ɛyí únóji kú aófulajɛ á.

eng_Latn: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā náána ā, Ujérobōwam í pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā ŋ́ kpɔ́. Amáŋ ó yɔ̄ í fu ācɛ nēé wɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ŋ́ mā kéē nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede nōo gwó ā kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu dóódu nōo tíne kóō wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, ó gē je ɔ́ klla í je ɔ́ pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, o ŋmá lɛ abɔ̄ ō le ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ tá anúɔ ohi eko ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ ā, ka aá géē yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki le ɔ̄kā da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ́ aá wā ɛgiyí um āa? Ó wɛ aá wɔ́tū um klla nū um ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi le tá ɛgiyí Abígɛ̄lu Ukámɛ̄lu, gāá le da ɔ́ ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ tū aá ɛhɔ̄ fu ɔ́ ká aá kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ kwú pīya ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
idu_Latn: Ɛjīkwɛjī lɛ alɔ nɛɛ, ayínɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī hɛ́ alɔ abɔ̄fú gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá eko kpiíí ā, alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ í yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́. Amáŋ alɔ yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu aá eko dóódu. Abɔ̄ aá kwú alɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, alɔ lɔfú tīiyē kú alɔ lɛ aá má kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.
idu_Latn: N gē tū ɔyípɛ éyi ɛhɔ̄ kóō gāá lɛ ɔyí ā kpó wā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n da ɔyípɛ̄ ā ka, Ɔyí ā kwu ajaajɛ abɔ́ɔ á, lɛ uwá kpó wā, ayíka a wā ɔlɛ́, unwalu dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ka, Ujése kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔyí éyi nōo jé ō gwō ɔdā ō gwííjē nɛ̄hi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɔtū klla jōklóbīya. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla wɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔhi nōo lɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ jé ɔwɛ ɛlā ō ka nɛ̄hi, Óndú, ɔ́ɔ klla yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ agbénú, ɛdɔ ógo mɛ́mla ocííbú ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí bá abɔ́ɔ á, é bī ugóolu le yá aóōhī, é bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ le yá aóōhī, é klla ke bī ɔmɛ le ma aóōhī dúú, o ke lɛ aóōhī nēé bī ɔcí le gbā uwā. Ó lɛ aógo ōhī nēé ge kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ eko nɛ̄ ugbɔga ojīlīmā gā. Ó kē lɛ aóōhī nēe ge kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlamu gā.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n kē jé ka ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ nōo géē má um gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kē í lé úgwū ajɛ ā. Ācɛ nēe kē yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ ā, kē í lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: He shall break also the images of Bethshemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɛcɔ̄ nēé le kwu ajɛ lɛ ɛcí ipú Uhɛliyopólīisi, nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā catāajɛ, klla í kpó aágbla kú aɛ́cí kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā yɔɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, álá éyi kú iháyí éyi kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdōgbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ nēé bī aɔ́dā ɛdɔ ékpó le yá uwā gɔ́ kwu ɛ́fɔ̄du, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔdā ékpó mla anú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, ohígbū ka Ébrahām lɛyítáajɛ gā um klla le odúúdú aíne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú um tū.

eng_Latn: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N géē yɔ̄ mla uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nāa lɛ ācɛ bītá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, a géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ɛfu nyā. Ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɔdocābɔ̄ gā uwɔ ka ami tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ɛgiyí aá ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú pīya ācɛ kú ɔlá ōfíyajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
idu_Latn: Élí nēé gē tá lɛ ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla itene nōó gē lɛ ŋmá ɔ́hi ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aígbómína kú ācɛ kú Árābu mɛ́mla ákú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
idu_Latn: Da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ aɔ́kpani uwā. Kéē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēé da uwá kéē yá ā, kéē kwú uwá ɔkɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé tíne ā hɛ́tá lɛ uwá, ɔ̄cɛ nēe tāgbá ohígbū abɔ̄ nōó lɛ ipú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó eko nēé bá yɔ̄ ī cīlɛ̄fú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú tū uwā abɔ̄ kéē yá ɔdā nōo he uwá ɔtū mla anú á.

eng_Latn: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɔdā olɔhi nāa yá ā tɔ́ɔna. N géē yɔ̄ ī ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē nya ācɛ tá lɛ ā eko dóódu, nááná nɛ̄ ń jé ɛyí nū dúúdú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ohílīpú klla jé odée, nōo lɛ ɛlā kú um pó, géē cɛ̄ klla í tá um ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe bī iyúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn Aá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdēelihɔ dúúmā ŋ́. Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ īyī a tū yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ssɔm wɛ ɛma kwu Usélɔ̄miti bū ipú ɔyínɛ́ nū Ɛlíyēsa. Ɛlíyāsa wɛ ádā kú Uréhabīya nōo ma Ujessíya, nōo ma Ujóram, nōo ma Usíkri, nōo ma Usélɔ̄miti ā.

eng_Latn: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá ɛcɛ igbɔhá ɛplá ɛnɔ o yɛ̄ɛyí mɛ́mla ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā. Ó yá ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ jeyī gicō má ɔkpáncō, ó í má péee ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā. Ɔkpáncō klla gē ma úklɔ́ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā fú péee.

eng_Latn: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufárisīi le jīla tɔ̄há ā, Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É klla nyɔ̄ í le unu nu tá ācɛ ogbáálá ā. É le aálá mɛ́mla inyankwūlūmī kú uwā alɛwa kpó. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Á gáā yá ká aúgbɔga nēe bá ɛga nēé gē lɔnyā kéē gwōkónu glá ŋ́ ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o lɔnyā ā yɔ̄ pi uwā ā.

eng_Latn: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya ka aá bá í ma ɔdɔ ā gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó ka ɔdɔ ā kwú jɛ̄ gaá kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ fíyaa, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā bá í nwúleyīkwū tū úklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Usisa Ɔgɔ́stɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Uróm ā lɛ íne tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ka odúúdú ācɛ kéē nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ iyē kú wā tá táajɛ.

eng_Latn: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja éyi kóō nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú Ujɔ́ni bī wā bōōbū. Ícɔ́ɔ́ja ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄, le tá ipú agbá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Ujɔ́ni ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
idu_Latn: A le fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ɔfú cɛ́ɛ́ ó gekwú. Eyī kú nū kē le kwúflá eko nōó gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
idu_Latn: É gē gbā ulé lɛ ācɛ nēe le úklɔ́ yá kwɛyí, é je ulé ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ɛhi ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó wɛ ɔdā nēé yúklɔ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā ú lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔ̄ le gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́, bá gē dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔwɛ tá lɛ ɔ́! Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu kwú pīya igbómína kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā nōo ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nōo le agbénú ā, nōó gē yāwu kú ɔdā dúúmā ga ɛga dóódu ŋ́ mā, géē yá ucē ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
idu_Latn: Ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ n gáā gbo mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ á. N géē je íne kú um tá ipú ɔtū kú uwā, klla í tá ɔ tū uwā ipú odo. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, é kē í wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛpa ā le ɔdā nōo yá ɔwɛ ā kpó ka lɛ uwá á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é jé ɔ̄ éjúuma klɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ eko nōo le igbo cē ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ínyílɔ́wɔ nōo ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā má āa, é gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohilí kú Umósīsi ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɔdā nāa gē yá nyā, á yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ̄ ɔwɛ okpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, í gáā lé ɔcɛ́, ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú je lɛ ācɛ nēe le kpaakpa ā gbóógbóō ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé, ācɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa ā klla lɔfú gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dúú ɔ́ ŋmó anúɔ unwū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ka anúɔ í klla jé ɔnyɛ kú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ anúɔ ī lé klla ī gwá ā gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ í kōō pó ɔkɔ kú ācɛ nēe gē gwííjē ā glá gɛ ŋ́ dúú. Ka anúɔ géē wɛ iyó ogbɛnú lɛ ɔ́ ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
idu_Latn: Ɛna ā wɛ úlā ofɛnɛ ce úlā igwó .

eng_Latn: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
idu_Latn: N géē hī únóji ka ádā um, klla í hī aɛ́kɔ̄ nēe í lé okwū um ā ka ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā nɛ̄ n gē nwū aá á. Ka Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, kwu igbo ú otú nēé yíbīyājɛ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
idu_Latn: Ōhī kú uwá wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja úlúúlā, ācɛ ɔhá klla gē leyīkwu ígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
idu_Latn: ayíka éē lɛ um abɔ̄ kpó cē, kéē lɛ uwá kpó fa ŋmá ácábɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N̄ kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya kɛɛ? A géē yá ká n yá uwá lé ēē? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Īī, kpɛ́fú tá uwá, n géē cɛ̄ ga uwɔ yá uwá lé.

eng_Latn: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú okónu aísu ā ŋmá á. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujáfɛ̄ti ipú ajɛ kú uwā ā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ lā ipú ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ipú aéwo kú nū yɔ̄ gē ka ucē kú nū.

eng_Latn: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
idu_Latn: Épafrāsi, nōo wɛ éyi kú ipú ígwu kú aá, nōo klla wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, hokónu tū aá. Ó gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɔfúlɔfú ohígbū aá ojigógó, ī ba Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá ká aá háyi kpaakpa lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe wɛ ijímkpa ipú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā ŋmá ɔtū ékpó, klla le tútū ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nō he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, abālɔbányā, gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá. Ācɛ ka ka eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá n gē yúwēyī, amáŋ ka n gē lɔtū eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ligbó. N dɔɔ̄kā ō gbonɛnɛ bɛ̄ɛka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é géē bī álá mla ɛna kú uwā i gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā kéē lɛ Óndú ā ɔtū gbo, amáŋ ó gáā mīyɛ ŋ́. Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hī uwā tá.

eng_Latn: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē lé ucɛ nyā a.

eng_Latn: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú ígwú ō gbo kú nū, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ohútu kú oyéeyī kú nū ga oŋmɛ́yí kú nū, é le ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpá nēé tá úklɔ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ɛtá ā má Ɛláyíja mla Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Ébrahām, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā, aá blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
idu_Latn: Blakwu ɔdā nāa jé ā eko dóódu. Ɔdā nāa jé ā, wɛ oyēeyī kú uwɔ á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā gbō ɔ̄ gɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
idu_Latn: Eko ōhī ojuja ā yɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ gaá kwu ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ ikpííkpó nɛ́ ojuja ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, é gē cālɛ́.

eng_Latn: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ ka ka alɔ í bīyíne dúúmā ŋ́, alɔ ī plla iyī alɔ. Ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā í kē yɔ̄ ipú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, aótrɛ̄yí ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ā hīgwú tɔ̄hā.

eng_Latn: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nōó fu ŋmá ajaajɛ ā ŋ́. Aá gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nēé ka ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu Ɛláyíja ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
idu_Latn: Ń kē gáā bīya okónu nɛ̄ n cɛ mla anú ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je ékpónú ŋmá ipú okónu nɛ̄ n ce ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tū ujɔ je ɔ́ ŋmó ā wɛ Usádi, ɔyí kú ɔnyā kú Ámɔn éyi nēé hī ka, Ussímīitu, mɛ́mla Ujehósābadi, ɔyí nɔnyā éyi kú Umówābu nēé hī ka, Usímīriti a.

eng_Latn: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā cɛ̄ ka aá bā ī kɛlā okpaakpa gbóógbóō ŋ́. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ikwū ŋmó um, ń gáā cɛ̄ gbóōgbóō ka n yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
idu_Latn: A géē yɔ̄ í yúufi kú ɛga o licó, á klá gáā yāwu lɔhi glá gɛ ŋ́. Īnyīlɛyí kú uwɔ géē je pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ dúúdú. Á gáā lɔfú yɔ̄ ī pi iyī uwɔ yɔ̄ ī yɛ glá gɛ ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, unwū kú ɔdā dóódu kú uwɔ géē mɛ. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ gē nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū kóō nyɔ̄ í mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ oyɔ́tūnōbí ā, géē bá ipú úláyi, bá ī jikwū, klla í yɔ̄ ipú ɔ́tūnōbí.

eng_Latn: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n géē lɛ ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lā ā cētá. Ɔ́wá kú aíju dúúmā í gáā ga abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. N géē yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā jé ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ipú ajɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?
idu_Latn: Aá gé ka ka ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpó ce Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ aá gē gbā ɔ̄ ā, ɔɔ́ wɛ áncā. É ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ wɛ itene kú íne kú nū nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ tū ā, ámāŋ ka, o mafú lɛ ɔ́ ka alɔ hīíjémā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n le tá abɔ́ɔ ā, n má aɔ́cí alɛwa kwu abɔ́ɔ, okónu ísu ā abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
idu_Latn: Ó je aíkpɛ́cí ā kpó ca tāajɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ujúda ā klla ī bá í pā ɛcí, bá ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí klla yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛcí.

eng_Latn: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō le eyīnyinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū má. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yú uwā ɛhi, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kpó uwā yíífi gɛ ŋ́. Igbo alɛwa ó le ícɔ̄nū kú nū kwú tū. Ó klla cɔ̄nū dúúdú lɛyíkwu uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca é lɛ ɔnyā nyā kwú abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gbaajā ā.

eng_Latn: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā tū Óndú ā ŋ́. Ó je uwā kéē wɛ áncā, é wɛ ɔdā dóódu tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da iyī ūwā kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi fu kóō kpó alɔ trɛ̄yí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
idu_Latn: Lɛ īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla anɔ̄, umu, ejé, nāa cokónu nū lɛ alɔ ā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Unínīfɛ, n géē yá uwɔ italā! N géē je uwɔ tóohɛ́ɛwa klla géē cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú aéwo ā, kéē má ohɛ́ɛwa kú uwɔ̄. É géē má ɛga otūwēyī kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda: Ɛlíhu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka: Ómri, ɔyí kú Umáyíkɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
idu_Latn: Īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ olɔhi nēé wu tɔ̄há mla owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mla owú nɔwā ā nēé le yá ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu kú igá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á. É klla bī inyilá le ijā he tū ɔ̄. Olīkpō kú ukɔ́tīn ā wɛ uyádi igwó, olicō kú nū wɛ iyádi ɛpa ce āyā bɛ̄ɛka ákú aúkɔ́tin kú igá ā.

eng_Latn: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
idu_Latn: Agbénú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ nɛ̄ ó bū ahɛ nū ŋ́, géē mɛ fíyaa. Ó kē gáā tīile lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
idu_Latn: lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojɛɛ́lɛ́ nōo bī ɔdā ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛfɔ́ɔ́lá mɛ́mla ɔyī nɛ̄ ɔlá kwu ɔ́ ā yɔ̄ ī le hijā ā.

eng_Latn: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
idu_Latn: Ofúlɔ̄cī blibli kú oŋmɔ́cī nū, gbɔbū kú eyī kóō nyā, Ujísɔ̄si cāŋjɛ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā. Ó nyɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā le tá ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ōfūnū, ɛga nɛ̄ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka kpɛ́mm ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɔdā dúúmā í wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ámāŋ ka o bī ācɛ nyíleyī ipú nū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɔdā ogbájí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔtū lɛ, gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā pāālā. Eko nɛ̄ Uprisíla mɛ́mla Akwíla le ɛlā kú nū pó ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɔlɛ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔwɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nwūleyī lɛ ɔ́ kpaakpa á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú a gē ka lɛ aá á. Igelī nyā lɛbɛɛka ɛ̄hī ō yá ɔdōlé gbóó. Amáŋ okwū kú ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ŋmó ā wɛ ɛbɛ́ ā nɛ̄. Ó wɛ aá ŋ́. Ń gáā mā aá tá amānyā ŋ́. N géē tá aá ɛcɔ̄ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā gē mīyɛ ómíci ɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́pɔ̄, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē mīyɛ ije ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē cɔ̄ɔwɔ kú īne ā, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā gē ka ɛbɛ nēé má lɛ ācɛ nēe gbā ije lɛ uwá ā. Nááná ā, é gē gbɛlá klla ī ka ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla aá. É gē kahíníī, Ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ɔ́ɔ yá alɔ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, kú ɔ́ɔmā kéē wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá ge yá um cɔ̄nū ŋmá lɛ ō pá ɛcí, klla í gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá Íjīpiti amānyā nɛ̄ aá wā í lā āa? Aá gē yá lɛ ā, aá géē je īyī aá kpó yíífi, nɛ̄ ācɛ gée bī iyē aá ī tókónū lɛ ācɛ, klla í bá ī yá aá okónu ipú éwo dóódu ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā géē ŋmá ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ga ipínu nɛ̄ kwu okómpinu nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā. Ó í háyi pi odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú okómpinu ā eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya ōpá ɔlá dúúdú, mɛ́mla ɛya ole yá ɛbɔ́ ā. Okómpinu abɔ́ɔ ā, ó géē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā lɛ Óndú ā klla í kwúcē ga ɛcɛ. Amáŋ é gáā gwū ɔwɛ ā ŋ́ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka kpɔ́ ka, Abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú alɔ ā le jé ka, alɔ le jé keé le ojuju yá lɛyíkwu alɔ ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, kē le ojuju kú uwā bīya ɛɛ́ mā, alɔ kē kwúcē gaá gbɔɔ́ ō ma ɔdɔ kú igá ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu lɔfú lɛ ā, klla ī miya éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá kú ācɛ ā kéē lɛ abɔ̄ gbɔtū ka aá ī kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī méyīnyinyi uwā ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋmá ajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Umósīsi tū uwā ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má ā, n má abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aéfūma ā je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ā kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n ka, Óndú, kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yá ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu lɔfú yēeyī lɛ glá ā? É kē le nyɛ́, é klla kē lɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
idu_Latn: Umáyíkɛ̄lu, Ísspa mɛ́mla Ujóha.

eng_Latn: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛga je lɛ Ujɛhóyākin kɔ́ɔ̄ le úwé kú agbá kú nū plla bá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔdōlé ɛyí útébulu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mla ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú um nyā, é géē je ɔcí éyi pla ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ nū, lɛ ɔ́ piyɔkɔ́ pílópíló, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔcí ā ú bū tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā púlú kwajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nū kwú pīya ɛyétutulu.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a géē gbō ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɔhi, lɛ ɛlā olɔhi ka lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ klla í cɛ̄ uwɔ́ ɛ̄hɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ le yɛ ipú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ ícɛ, ká n̄ le odúúdú aɛ́nɛ̄ e wɛ ohíkākā mɛ́mla aómlede nóbī, mɛ́mla aɛ́wū, nōo wɛ ohíkākā ā kpó yā ŋmá anú. Ɔ́ɔmā gáā wɛ ulé kú um á.

eng_Latn: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dā ōhī le pɛ́ gaajɛ olɔhi. Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le jɛ̄, é klla le īkpō olɔhi gwá. Éyééye kú uwā gwá īkpō ofɛhɔ̄ ofɛhɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā kú nū bī wā í ŋmɛ́yí yɔ̄ í kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ahɔ̄ opó ɛlā.

eng_Latn: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
idu_Latn: N gē gwíijē ī tá uwɔ ahínyá. N klla í ka odúúdú ɔdā nāa yá gā um ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, Óndú. Nááná aéwō ā kē ī lé iwili kú ɔdōlé nēe gē ŋmá ɛyí utéblu kú ɔkpani uwā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā kóō gwō, klla kɛlā nōo wɛ atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ íkwu yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ɔyā ofɛpa ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Íne nyā gē gbō odúúdú aá, kwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ámāŋ ka éwɔhá nēe lā ipú aá ā, ohígbū ka ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
idu_Latn: Okwáhi í gē má ɔdā agbénú nɛ̄ ó ī tíne ā ŋ́, Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo leyī tá úklɔ́ ā gē yúklɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi, gē pīyɛ̄ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā piíí eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ yɔ̄ icō. Otū gē bī, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā yúklɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
idu_Latn: Aá í je okoolo kú umu nɛ̄ anɔ̄ kú ólīifu yɔ̄ anú ā gwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla anú dúú. Ocu kú nū ī he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū. Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla íkpɔ́yí ɛtɛ́ ejé éyi.

eng_Latn: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
idu_Latn: Úwé kú ɔnwū inyankwūlūmī nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni gē le wiyē á, ó gē lɛ ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ gbō ɛ́nyɔ́, ɔdōlé kú nū wɛ efūma mla ɛnwú kú ipácí.

eng_Latn: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É bá ī yá ācɛ ɔhá ŋmó klla bá ī plla ācɛ ɔhá eko dóódu. Amáŋ é tá ō jé ka amíyɔ̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ gē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ipú nū ā, ɔlá kwú ɔ̄ ú yi tāajɛ ɛɛ́. Odúúdú aɛ́ga nōo he alɔ ɔtū ā, má tá alácɛ̄ dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ géē blakwu Óndú ā, klla í kwúcē wā ɛgiyí nū. Aéwo dóódu géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá géē yá, aá yá ɔ̄ ŋmá ipɔ́tū kú aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔ̄ lɛ Óndú āa, nōó wɛ o yá lɛ ācɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɛ̄cī otútū kú ucɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ únóji ā kwu abɔ́ɔ ajaajɛ ā, é kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú gwutá ipú nū lɛ ɔ́ gwū.

eng_Latn: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kwɛcɛ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ o ŋmá lɛ ikwū kú nū ā, ó kwú pīya ɔwɛ nōó í je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi, oŋmá lɛ ɛlā kú nū nēé cɛ̄ ā. Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ̄nyā kóō mafú ka anúɔ le kpaakpa. Eko nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɔtū lé, anɔ́ɔ ó leyī gwō íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā bónū á.

eng_Latn: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpā uwɔ, nōo lā kwu uwɔ ā kwú gbɛɛhá anɔ́ɔ ó kē tá iyī nū abɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́ má, aá géē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē tá ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú olufa abɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɔfú yɔ̄ ī lā kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ glá.

eng_Latn: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ má ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn géē bī aípɔ́ɔma éyi ohígbū Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, mɛ́mla ohígbū Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi kú um nɛ̄ n fu ŋmá odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ákú um ā.

eng_Latn: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi dɛ̄gba da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jāhɔ̄! Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā á. Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ékpónú ōfōōfūnū á.

eng_Latn: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe lɔfú ā mīyɛ ajɛ kú ācɛ nēe lɔfú ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ aóklóbīya uwɔ kē lā ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔ́nū nyā nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔ́ja glá ā wɛ úlā ofɛpa cigwó ce ācɛ ofigwó .

eng_Latn: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó géē he um ɔtu fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nēe wɛ anyōkwū ā lɛ ɔbá lɛ kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ma ayí, kéē ke leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ebilíi kóō má ɛga ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá ga ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan, anɔ́ɔ aá le ɛdɔ kú ɔcí o gwíikpō dóódu nyi, aá géē je ɔcí koó wɛ ɔcí elihɔ ipú iháyí ɛtá kú aflɛ́yí ɔ́ɔmā. Aá híī lé īkpō kú nū ɛpléeko nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́mɛtá kú iháyí ɔ́migwóléyi nɛ̄ alɔ bā ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da aá ka, n géē kɛpɔ̄ kú aálá nēe jɔ̄kwū klla lɔfú ā mɛ́mla aálá nēe kē lɔfú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Ɔwɔicō á, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ le pīya ācobīyíne á. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō í hɛ́ ɛpɔ̄hi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɛga je lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō kú ō nā alɔ tɔ́ɔwɛ, ó lɛ ā íne ā í labɔ̄ lɛ aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
idu_Latn: Ó le oklóbīya éyi kwú ŋmá Usúkɔ̄tu, ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ oklóbīya ā le odúúdú iyē kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ofɛtá cigwó ahāapa kú Usúkɔ̄tu ā kpó tá lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā gbɔɔ́ ō yá, aá māháyicō kpaakpa cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá je eyī gicō ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē wā í nya aá tá ānāānā.

eng_Latn: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū nɛ̄ n géē lɛ ɔdōlé lɛ nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ n géē ka ka á ce um ɛgbá gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ gbɛhá, n lɔfú nyɔ̄ í lɛ uwi wī, cɛ́ɛ́ n kē lɛ uwēyī kpó tū awɔ nɛ̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē je lɛ Óndú ā ohígbū aɔ́dā olɔhi kpɛ́mm nɛ̄ ó yá gā um āā?.

eng_Latn: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
idu_Latn: A híī cɛ̄ gā um tíne kú n̄ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́. A kē cɛ̄ ká n̄ nyɔ̄ í wɛ ɔ́wá kú ācɛ o yá odōbɔ̄bí cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ bɔ̄bíipú bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá yá kú ɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi kóō pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá ā. Aá yá kú uce okpaakpa kóō kpɔ.

eng_Latn: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
idu_Latn: N klla kwú aíkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ipú ɛcɛ ā ú kpó lɛ aá kú aá lé.

eng_Latn: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu kéē kpɛ́fú tú Ubábīlɔn ā, aá kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ kú Umerátéyim mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Upékɔ̄di ā. Aá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó klla lɛ uwá kpó yíífi. Aá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n da aá yá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyīlɔ ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū koó lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
idu_Latn: ka, ami, Óndú ā, gē ka ka n kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwā ɛɛ́. Ka n géē pi ɛ̄wā kú um ŋmá apɛ́ je odúúdú aá kpó ŋmó, kwú ācɛ olɔhi mla ācɛ obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwúcē nyɔ̄ igbo ɔ́mpa ā, Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ iyī nū mafú lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó klla yá kú Uféro kóō lɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ádā nū jé.

eng_Latn: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla odúúdú ojuju nōó lɛ ipú ɔtū kú nū, ohígbū eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ mɛ́mla eyīpú kú uwá ā, mɛ́mla inu okpíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū ā, mɛ́mla ɛga okpíyó kú ɛhi kú Óndú ā dóódu tū ā, ó le kpó mafú lɛ Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
idu_Latn: Égbúlú mɛ́mla ufi lɛ mu uwá ipú, ohígbū ɔfú kú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ. É bá cíí bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā, gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú uwɔ nāa nyatá ā gaá le pɛ́ le yɛ.

eng_Latn: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le yɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ i tá Ufilípayi, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Umasɛdónīya ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Uróm lā ā. Alɔ bá igelī nyā ɛ̄cī alɛwa.

eng_Latn: A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cohumɔtū, gē kpócu lɔhi tū um bɛ̄ɛka eko nōó gwutá ce ɛplá amɛ̄ ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔdā nēé ī le kwu ɛna ɔkɔ kéē bī ɔ̄ le hɛ́hɔ̄ ā yá ŋmá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔcí nēé ī kpó híla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ú wu īyī uwɔ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ɔ̄ ɛbɛ́, í tá ahɛ klá anú. É klla géē gá ɔ̄ itali, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, amáŋ é géē je ɔ̄ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá le gla.

eng_Latn: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɔ́ kwú yāajɛ yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɔ̄ mla alɔ, ohígbū ka ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ɛɛ́, otú kē gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɛɛ́ Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú inu kóō yɔ̄ mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā ú kpó gā um kwɛyí ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. A klla í kpó ayí aflɛ́yí kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ācɛ Ulífāyi gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwɛyí ayí ɛbɛ́ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
idu_Latn: Umáyíka kwú ojibó éyi ú, kwú ɔ̄ ú gwutá agōdō, kwú upílo kú ɔnwū kú ɛwū ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí, lɛ īlī pīya klá anú.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
idu_Latn: Ugadíyɛ ɔyí kú Usúsi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nōó kpó wā ga okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
idu_Latn: É géē gɔ́ itali, é kē í ŋmó ɔ̄. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá nēé ŋmó ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī usábāti ɔhá, Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ tá ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ éyi gaá nwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō. Ɔnyīlɔ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū le ŋmó tíiye.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le abɔ̄ kú nū nā daa gāá kwu um okónu. Ó da um kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, n kwú ɛlā kú um ú tá uwɔ okónu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ á gáā pɔ́ ahɔ̄ lɔhi ɛɛ́ nāa gē pó uya nōo ī yá úláyi ā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē pó uya kú ɔdɛ̄gɔ̄ nɛ̄ anyā yɔ̄ ī gbā ā glá gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē pó ijē kú anyā o gbɔ̄dā ɛgɔ̄ ā glá gɛ ŋ́. Uya kú aígbáanɔ géē yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ uwɔ eyī ŋmá īyɔ̄lā.

eng_Latn: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɔdā nōó bī ɔtū ā kwɛyí eko nɛ̄ eko okpaakpa ā le yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nōó yá nēe bá ipú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ipú ɛcɛ ā kpótɔ̄há kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
idu_Latn: Aáyā kú iyē nɛ̄ alɔ gbɛlá kéē cɛgbá íbí ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ alɔ gē leyīkwu uwá lɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ nēe wɛ aígabɔ̄, aótrɛ̄yí, mɛ́mla aígbómína kú uwɔ ā, cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ka, ipú ɛ̄cī ofucigwó nyā, ɔcɛ́ kóō lɛ íne tū ka, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛ̄ba ba ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔwɔ ɔhá, amáŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ, gwū awɔ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā tá, é gē je ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá.

eng_Latn: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ n lɛ eko tāajɛ lɛ ɔkwu ɔda nōo yá ā bū lɔɔlɔhi ŋmá ajaajɛ kú nū ā, n gbɛlá koó wɛ ɔdā olɔhi kú n̄ lɛ ɔ́ tá tāajɛ ɔgbɔɔgba gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēe bá āa ka kwɛyí ā, ó le yɛ mla ayíkpó kú nū le gla ɔgblɛga kú Ukídrɔn. Ɛhɔ̄ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú da ɔ́ ɛlā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ā glá. N géē tá aá ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa abɔ̄ kú aá kɛlā, n kē í da aá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í yá ā.

eng_Latn: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
idu_Latn: Ó tū uwā ukɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé ɛbɛ́ ā tooyī tooyī ŋ́, ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú ɔdā dóódu yɔ̄ ipú oyī ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híīī lé oyēeyī kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́nɛ̄ e géē bēhé igá nyā a, kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ um ka a.

eng_Latn: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔfú je kéē lɛ únóji ā gwū lɔfú lɔfú jāā gbó ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, ohígbū nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú nū géē nyɔ̄ í je ɔ́ uwī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ó le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwu ɛɛ́. Ká ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú ámōōmɛ ā kóō híīī le fíyɛ́ ákú aflɛ́yí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
idu_Latn: Éwo dóódu lɛ ofu Udéfīdi pó, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla yá ká éwo dóódu ā kéē yúúfi Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ mla ɛlā kú ɛpɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ífi á. Ó klla ka ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ anúɔ ŋmó ūwā ɔ́ɔ tá cāā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ eyī gē nyā péee ā.

eng_Latn: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ōtayínū éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā ká aá lɛ ɔ́ jé, aóklóbīya um, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé, alɔ í gáā ka ipú ɔtū kú alɔ ka, ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi alɔ jɔ́dā íbí ŋ́. Ɛlā ā yɔ̄ á, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í gáā yɔ̄ ī tá ka aá í gáā cɛ̄ ŋ́ piyóó nóó n, amáŋ ó géē yɔ̄ lɛ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ áluka kú aílɔ́wá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ā gā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kahíníī, Ayíbɛ awɔ ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á nɛɛ? Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá ka ka ami á n.

eng_Latn: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
idu_Latn: ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ o ŋmáajɛ ofúlɔ̄cī, nōo ī fíyáajɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ojuja í yɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ nōo gē cɛ̄ igbīhi eko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ le hɛ́ nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ácí ī gbɔɔ́ ō jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja gbā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí ā gbɔɔ́ ō foowu á, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú héyī á.

eng_Latn: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛ ācɛ ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá fu lɛ anúɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma dóódu, ká anúɔ lɛ uwá tū nyɔ̄ í lɛ āyā kú ajɛ nēé tíne ō lɛ ā má, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ohi kpó gé lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
idu_Latn: Aá nēé má lé nwuné abālɔbányā ŋ́ mā, ákú aá lɔhi. Ɔwɔicō í kpó odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cɛgbá ā lɛ aá! Aá nēe gē jikwū abālɔbányā ā, ákú aá lɔhi. Aá géē yɛhɛ!.

eng_Latn: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā ɛtá ámāŋ ka ɛnɛ nēe gē tū ācɛ kú ɛcɛ íwɔ́tū, nēé cībū uwā glá ŋ́. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á:.

eng_Latn: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, ɔyí um. Ó géē lɔhi gā uwɔ ipú ɔdā dóódu nāa gē yá ā. Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le yɛ kú nū, anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kē kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdāajɛ ā le nyɔ́nyí ɛga dúúmā, eyī ōpu, ikpó ō cē, ámāŋ ɛdɔ kú ɔ́nyí ɔhá dúúmā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā je ɔ́ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ŋ́.
