eng_Latn: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, é gáā lé ɔdā dúú nēé le lá ŋmá olihi ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ é lɛ ɔ́ na aflɛ́yí. É klla gē lɛ aíne alɛwa ɔhá nēé kpó lɛ uwá ā tū. Ɔdā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɛ okpaakpa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í le na ikókwū mɛ́mla ɛhī mla ógo udɔ mɛ́mla agōdō.

eng_Latn: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: N géē tá aá ɔtū le Ujerúsālɛm ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ gē já ɔyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ tɛtɛ jé ka ɛna nōo yēeyī ā, ɔ́ɔ gē dɔɔ̄kɛ̄lā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ óndú nū í kwú ɔ̄ wāajɛ ŋ́ má, ayíka óndú ɛna ā géē je ɛna oyēeyī kwɛyí ɛna lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ɛna kú nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē bī okwū kú ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē cēyītīkwū ī yúklɔ́ lɔfú nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kpóce Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā dúúdú, anú kē wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá kú odúúdú ācɛ á. O fíyɛ́ dúú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, N géē yá Amɔn, nōo wɛ ɛcí kú Utébes ā italā, mɛ́mla Íjīpiti mɛ́mla aɛ́cí ɔhá kú nū ā, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú nū. N kē í wā í yá uféro nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce ɔ̄ italā.

eng_Latn: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
idu_Latn: Aá wā í jāhɔ̄ gā um, odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē gbā Ɔwɔicō klla ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā. N géē da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá gā um ā.

eng_Latn: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu má gwutá ablīkpó kú nū gbɔ́ ɔ̄cī á. Amáŋ, ó cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī, ohígbū ka Ubówāsi í dɔɔ̄kā ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō jé ka ɔ́ɔ wā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú Ɔkpíihɔ ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū cɛ́ɛ́ ó gáā bɔ́há mla ɔnyā nū, anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa le pīya ɔkpíyē ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā, aá nēe gē lɛ ikpó da ācogbɛhá ɛyí tāajɛ, klla ī tíne kéē kpó ācogbɛhá yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
idu_Latn: Ujonátan, ɔmáapu ádā kú ɔcɛ́ Udéfīdi ā wɛ ɔ̄cojɔ́dā klla jé ō nwɛ̄lā nɛ̄hi. Anú mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Ujɛ́hīyɛlu gē nwū ayí kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔkpá á.

eng_Latn: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ italā yá aéwɔhá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da lɛ ā. Ɔdā nyā wɛ ojīlīmā lɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ̄ n. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú.

eng_Latn: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā obɔ̄bí dúúmā í gáā yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdā icííci ā, é géē kwú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
idu_Latn: N lɔfú gbo ikpokwú kú iyē kú um áluka glá. Aólɛlā kú um kē bá lɛ eyī hɛ́ tū um.

eng_Latn: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ nōo pɛ́ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā le gwū, ɔwɔ nōo yā ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā kē le hɛ́ í yā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ekōhī, aɛ́pɔ̄ ōhī ɔ́ɔ lɔfú le lɔfú tū ācohɛ́pɔ̄ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ ā kéē hɛ́ glá. Ó ka ɔdā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́pɔ̄ kú agbénú kú ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɛ ō lɛ, ámāŋ ka ágbe ō yá ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ o ō ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó jégēdē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo jégēdē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ le yá, ɛ́ɛ nyɔ̄ ɛga éyi nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ fu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ áhingílí ɔ́ɔmā plla ŋmá anú iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujóssuwa ka anúɔ kwú íne nɔ́ɔ bīya ā ú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ɛɛ́. N géē kpó úwé ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo tū ɛgahi ā gā uwɔ kú ā le wiyē.

eng_Latn: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le abɔ̄ nāŋ́daa ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lɛ um pi ŋmá ipú itekwú olipú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le da ācogwɛ́ɛya mla ayí kú Ulífāyi kéē yɛ ga aígelī nɛ̄hi dóódu gaá mīyɛ ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ dóódu kú Ujúda, ó kē ī yɛ lɛ ā iháyí dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī le glá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá. Ó da uwá kéē lɛ úklɔ́ ā yá fíyaa, amáŋ ayí kú Ulífāyi pi úklɔ́ ā ɔkwajɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
idu_Latn: N géē cē ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ kú aá nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā ɔkɔ. Ɔwɔ í gáā yá lɛ aá ŋ́. Ajɛ kú aá géē je ŋmó bɛ̄ɛka oje ā.

eng_Latn: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é ī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ yíífi ohígbū ka é jé kwu anúɔ ŋ́. Óndú ā klla ka abɔ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya tá kéē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú anúɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anúɔ géē tá ūwā, ka é wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú anúɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ klla í tá ayí uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó lɔhi, n kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, amáŋ ā híī je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
idu_Latn: ó gē da uwá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā, mɛ́mla ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
idu_Latn: É gē cījáalí kú ihɔtū kú uwɔ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú amānyā ā. A gē yá lɔhi ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ī tū uwā abɔ̄ kéē pīya tá ɔwɛ kú iyāwu kú uwā, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā yɛ nyɔ̄ ā, akā ɛnɛ ā ī nyɔ̄ mla uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā le wu ŋmá ajɛ nɛɛ, akā nyā gē wu mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nēé gē jāahɔ̄ tá ɔ̄cā kú ācɛ Ujíyu, ámāŋ́ ka aíne kú ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu um āa? Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ le kpó híhó koó wɛ aá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Upíta kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ɛwa kú ācɛ le yɛ jila awɔ tá, klla bá ī gbo klá awɔ.

eng_Latn: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ alɔ má uwɔ nɛ̄ a wɛ ugbɔga nɛ̄ alɔ leyīkwu uwɔ āa? Amáŋ ka a tóohɛ́wa nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ īlī tū uwɔ ohí āa?.

eng_Latn: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja má le íbɔm cē tū Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē jé kéē géē je ɔ́ catāajɛ eko kpiíí.

eng_Latn: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda, aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ um tū á. Amáŋ n le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ aá kpó yíífi ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka aá lɛ um yá cɔ̄nū mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ŋmá lɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá bá ī gwo lɛ Ubáalu ā.

eng_Latn: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu, ɔyí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, yɔ̄ í jɛ̄ téeyī olɔhi kú Óndú ā mla ákú alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
idu_Latn: Aákā kú utéblu ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka akā kú úgbɔ́ɔya ā. Oje udɔ nēé bī le yá oje ogblógbló mɛ́mla oje oyoolo kú akā ā mɛ́mla usipóku mɛ́mla uhɔ́bu kú nū á.

eng_Latn: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō jégēdē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ je koó wɛ ɔdīcííci ā fu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ācojéeyī ā. Ó kē fu ɔdā nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ je koó lɔfú ŋ́ mā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwēyī je lɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá ā, eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwōkónu, aá kóō lɛ anɔ̄ nya ɛyí kú aá, klla lɛ eyī kú aá na.

eng_Latn: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti le táajɛ kú Ukénan ɛgiyí ádā uwā, Ujékɔ̄pu á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ í yá uwá kéē jɛ̄ gɔbū nɛ̄hi ipú ɔdā dóódu nēe gē yá ā, mɛ́mla ipú úklɔ́ kú uwā dóódu dúú. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ma ayí alɛwa. Aɛ́na kú uwā géē nyīla nɛ̄hi. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla í lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Ɔtū géē he Óndú ā nɛ̄hi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá kú uwá kóō jɛ̄ gɔbū nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū he ɔ́, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá kú aádáádā uwā kéē jɛ̄ gɔbū eko kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
idu_Latn: Ébɛ̄lu kē le ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú álá kú nū nōo jɔ̄kwū lɔɔlɔhi ā bī wā í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kē mīyɛ ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ Ébɛ̄l gbā ɔ̄ āa á.

eng_Latn: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tɛtɛ gē yá unwōdōlé nɛɛ, ayíka a lɛ iyī uwɔ kwú tū.

eng_Latn: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ā wā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ahínyá ō tá Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā pó ā, é le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ohígbū ka é yɔ̄ í ka kahíníī, Ikpɛ̄yí kú nū le pīyeyī.

eng_Latn: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī pó ikwū ōje bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā. N klla yɔ̄ ī pó íbá bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī mɔyí aflɛ́yí kú nū ā. Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm bá ī jikwú klla bá ī nya, ī tíne ō fu owu. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā nōo le abɔ̄ kú nū nāńdaa yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ kahíníī, N le jí ɛɛ́! É ī wā í je um ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ɔcɛ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá nɛ̄ Óndú gē nā tá ɔwɛ ā. Ó gē nā ɔ̄ tá ga ɛga dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta yɛce ɔ́ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inagbá á. Ó jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī yá ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā eyī cāā ŋ́, amáŋ ó gbɛlá ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī nɔ̄ɔna nɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ eyī gwū aá bónū, ohígbū ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ aá ī nwū odée nɛɛ, aá gē je ɔ̄cɛ éyi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ācɛ o lɛ ɔtū obɔ̄bí. Amáŋ, ācɛ o yá olɔhi mɛ́mla o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, gē he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé oyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ oyī ā pīya bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē pīya éŋkpɔ̄ bónū klá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
idu_Latn: É kwú úwé ā ú bī gé lɛ ádā uwā, anɔ́ɔ é da ádā uwā kahíníī, Alɔ pīyɛ úwé nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ. Má ɔ̄ káá, ó wɛ ákú Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔyí uwɔ ā glá ā.

eng_Latn: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
idu_Latn: A géē tū um abɔ̄, ohígbū ka n yá ɔdā okpaakpa. A kē í cɛ̄ gā um klá ɛgiyí uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cojéeyī ā ka odúúdú ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ wɛ áncā! Ó klla ka odúúdú oyēeyī mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɔ́ɔ wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
idu_Latn: É cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi kéē lɛ eko ā jé, kéē klla lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yá lɛ ā jé. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ mla uwá ā yɔ̄ gē ka táajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē yá, ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē móōwē, amáŋ igbīhi ōwē nyā ó géē mīyɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔlɛ́ usétan le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu, o gáā lɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē kɔ̄ klla í mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
idu_Latn: É géē kpó aɔ́dā dóódu nēé gē bī le yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gbō ipú īlī odufā ā klla í je ɔkpɛ́ɛwū ā pīya klá anú, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɛyi ɔcí ō le bī ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo je inu ā lɛ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā ō fūla anú, ó géē cíla ulé nú klla í lɛ ije ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū miya lɛyíkwu ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aá má uwā, aɛ́nyā wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ á.

eng_Latn: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, ó gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N hokónu tū uwɔ, Utíca. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔtū má ɔ̄ ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé hī iyē uwā nyā wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ igwó kú Uháman, ɔyí kú Uhamedáta, olɛlā kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā. Amáŋ é wu iyó kú odúúmā kú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nāa géē ma iyī uwɔ fú lɛ alɔ ā, nɛ̄ á gáā ma iyī uwɔ fú lɛ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá le yɛ gɔbú, anɔ́ɔ aá ɔ́ɔ le fō ŋmá ɔwɛ kú Árába mɛ́mla Esiyɔngéba, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́máapú aá, ayááyí kú Ísɔ nēe lā Uséyɛ ā á. Anɔ́ɔ aá ɔ́ɔ kwú bū ɔwɛ kú ígbíli kú Umówābu ā á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni kwú ɛna ā ú gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya kú anú abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɔdā nēe bá ā pó ā, okónu í hɛ́ uwā gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ɛga je lɛ aéwɔhá ā dúú kéē pīyabɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
idu_Latn: Aá cāŋjɛ, kú alɔ nyɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā yá ibīyājɛ tū um ā gā ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n tɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā fu aá ā wɛ ka ń tíne ō wā í má aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka n ga eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔtū géē bīya gā um. Aá ā kē wɛ ācɛ piíí nēe géē yá kú ɔtū kóō he um á! N kē le jé kpɔcíí ka eko nɛ̄ ɔtū le he um, ɔtū kē í he odúúdú aā dúú.

eng_Latn: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ pó abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ka ka Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti nyā géē bīya amānyā, ó kē í pīya uculo nɛ̄ Umósīsi je lɛ alɔ ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
idu_Latn: Oklóbīya nāa jɛ̄ ā cɛ̄ gā uwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔbɔ́cɛ. Olofu kú ɛgahi kú uwɔ ā cɛ̄ gā uwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē olíla. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ uwɔ hɛ́ fīya ajɛ gblugudu, mā uwɔ tá tá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ ō le pi odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē je agbénú, ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ cɛgbá ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi. Amáŋ ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú nū ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ugbɔga gáā jɔ́ɔnyɛ nū á. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā. Ó lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da nyā jé ā, ācɛ dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu le aɛ́na, aálá, mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā dóódu mɛ́mla ejé kpó wā nɛ̄hi gé lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā dóódu kú uwā kpó wā.

eng_Latn: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
idu_Latn: Asírīya yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, únóji kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū, yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí. Ɛfú lé odúúdú uwá á.

eng_Latn: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄, nōo je īyī nū lá lɛ ɔdōōbɔ́bí ō yá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka Áhābu, nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū Ujɛ́sēbɛlu gē nwū ɔ̄ klla ī kwu ɔ́ ga ipú ɔdōōbɔ́bí ō yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá kē lɛ ɔ̄na ā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ka gā um glá, n géē yá aá ɛhi nɛ̄hi klla í lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi ce aá. Ó lɛ ā, aá lɛ ɔ̄na ā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ka ga um mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī bū okónɔɔwɛ kú ɛháajɛ ā ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okómpinu ā mīya. Ó wɛ ɔdā ékpónú mɛ́mla aókómpinu kú ɔdɔ kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ uwá ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da uwá kahíníī, N géē je owu tū aá ipú klla í kpó aá héyī igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɔkpáncō ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ á. Ɔkpáncō kú aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɛcɛ kú aflɛ́yí ā mɛ tāajɛ ɛɛ́, ísu kē gebí táajɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í klla gáā nwū ɔ́mpānū kú ɔ́ɔ jé ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka odúúdú uwā, kwu aóflaajɛ kwu ācɛnɛ̄hi, géē jé um. N géē je ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā yá uwā ɛhi. Ń klla gáā blakwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ nɛ̄ ɔbá ɔnyā ā tá oji nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū hɛ́ Óndú ā, ó géē móōwē kú ínoōbīya, abɔ̄ ó yá oji nɛ̄ ɔnyā hɛ́ ā jila ŋ́ ma.

eng_Latn: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛlá kwu íne kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um Umósīsi. Íne mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n tū aá, ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu, ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: I receive not honour from men.
idu_Latn: Ń tíne ká ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
idu_Latn: Ɛpɔ̄ ō hɛ́ í ŋmá ɛhícō ámáŋ ka ɛháajɛ ámáŋ ka, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ámāŋ ka ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, dɛ̄gba tū uwā nɛ̄hi ā, aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācɛ o ce ɔnya ā má gwōnū, le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ yá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔdā íwɔ́tū ajɛ kú Utábēra mɛ́mla Umása mɛ́mla Ukibrɔtu Uhatáfa.

eng_Latn: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́tin kú igá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɔ́kpa kú nú mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú nū, ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
idu_Latn: Umálkīram, Upedáya, Ussɛnása, Ujɛkamíya, Uhóssāma mɛ́mla Unedábīya.

eng_Latn: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
idu_Latn: N tíne o gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔwɔ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, n géē je ɔ̄cɛ nōo he uwɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋmó acígilí. A ka iŋini dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē jikwū, pɛ́ agīje dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
idu_Latn: N gē je amɛ̄ lɛ aá, kú aá gwá, ń je ɔdā olɔfú lɛ aá lé glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ohígbū ka aá jɛ̄ jɛ̄ ō lé ɛdɔ odōlé ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ abālɔbányā aá tútū ō lē ɔdā o lɔfú glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ kéē yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ tū alɔ ícɛ ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ alɔ yá lɛ ocīkpó nyā ā, aá klla dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ le hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá ā.

eng_Latn: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó ā, ó géē tá ayí Ulífāyi ɔhá abɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ kú uwā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā glá, amáŋ, ó gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē kɔ̄ úklɔ́ kú ayí Ulífāyi ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ajɛ olɔhi ā kwɛyí ācɛ nēe pó olɛhɔ̄ ā klla mīyɛ ɔ́ tū ipú ɔtū olɔhi kú uwā. É lɛ ɔ́ tá ɔtū jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ikpō gwá.

eng_Latn: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔtūkpɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ijakī kú ipácí ā, ɛ́ɛ le lé ga ɔwɛ nɔ́ɔ hi uwá ɔtū ā ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ ga Asírīya gáā dɔɔ̄kā ācɛ nōo í tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. É klla le ulé cílá aéwo ɔhá kéē gbō uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le okwutɛ ɔ́mpa nēé hī ka opīyatɔ̄há ā cē, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō mafú ka ɛma kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu kwú hɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
idu_Latn: N le uwá gbā putu klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ā. N lɛ ikpó da uwá ɛyí báajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē lɛ ikpó da ɔ́tɔ̄ kú úláyi báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
idu_Latn: Aá híīī lɛ ojīlīmā ce aɔ́kpani aá eko nēé lɛ eyī kwajɛ ōfūnū ŋ́ ohígbū koó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aá gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē ka ka aá gē yá ɔdā olɔhi íbí, amáŋ aá bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú aá le yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā bɛ̄ɛka ācocɛhɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
idu_Latn: É lé ucɛ kú ede o je tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa abɔ́ɔ. É klla kē lé ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa dúú. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, é le jīla, anɔ́ɔ é le ucɛ kú eko nēé yá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā lé.

eng_Latn: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Á gáā yúklɔ́ ga um icííci abɔ̄ a wɛ ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ um ā ŋ́. Da um ɔdā nōo géē wɛ ulé kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo mīyɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nyā ohígbū um, ayíbɛ ami nōó mīyɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōó mīyɛ um, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nōó mīyɛ dúú á. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó cɛgbá ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aá ā, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá le odúúdú ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ubáalu mɛ́mla ákú Ássɛ̄ra ā kpó hīgwú wā ɛyí ɛfu kú Ukámɛlu á.

eng_Latn: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
idu_Latn: é cíkā ō yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛyi kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēé mafu mla ɔtū ékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā lé ɔdōlé nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ɔdōlé ɔlamu tá.

eng_Latn: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
idu_Latn: Kwú okwutɛ nōo bayi iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká awɔ mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kú aá lɛ odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túbá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ikpēyī kú odúúdu uwā kóō má ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɛcɔ̄, éŋkpɔ̄ í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú nū. Ɔwɛ nyā nāa géē bī éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ɛcɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā ká uwá mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ká ɔlɛ́ uwā kéē gwá á.

eng_Latn: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā, gē tá íne nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bīya ā táajɛ, klla gē bī ɔ̄ bá ɔ̄cɛ nɛɛ, á géē yɛ í lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ ŋmɛ́ɛpɔ̄bí kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu kóō lɛ Ágāgi ɔcɛ́ kú Ámālēki ā bī wā ɛgiyí anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ágāgi bī ga ɛgiyí Usámūwɛ̄lu á. Ágāgi le ɛhɛ kwu ayīnu yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ka ɔnɔ kú ikwū ā lɛ gla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
idu_Latn: Óndú, jāhɔ̄ gā um ká ā tá um ohi, ohígbū ka n lɛ ɛgbá nɛ̄hi, ń kē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
idu_Latn: Aɛ́cɔ̄ mlɛ̄mlē kú ɔpɛ́ ā wɛ ɛcí nɛ̄ aá ī pā á. Aɛ́cɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá kpó ŋmá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ aá gē bī ejé wā í ce klá uwá, nɛ̄ aá klla ī kpó īkpɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá le gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā á. Aá gbɛlá ka odúúdú ucē kú aá ɔ́ɔmā he um ɔtū nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ le he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi, ó kē yɔ̄ ī kpó aɔ́dā olɔhi alɛwa lɛ alɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
idu_Latn: Ó klla mīyɛ ɔdā dóódu kú uwā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ámālēki kpó ā, kwu anyā nū ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ujábɛsi wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīma nɛ̄hi ipú ayínɛ́ nū á. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū hī ɔ̄ ka Ujábɛsi, ohígbū koó kahíníī, N ma ɔ́ ipú ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, a géē hī ayínɛ́ uwɔ Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā nēé hī ka Ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ményīnyi uwā ā igwú.

eng_Latn: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, géē ŋmó ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ákú aɛ́bɛ́, klla í yá aɔ́wɔ kú Íjīpiti ā italā. Ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí nēe géē lɔfú kwu ajɛ kli bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ nōo ī bī ikpínu háyi ā, ámāŋ ka aótrɛ̄yí nēe lɔfú kwa ajɛ kli bɛ̄ɛka ákanaba nōo ī bī inu háyi ā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ o í lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔtā ō bī kpɛ́fú ā. Ɛdɔ kú otrɛ̄yí dúúmā géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ amānyā ó klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, É gáā ga ipú ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n géē yɛ í je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ leyī gwɛ̄lā kú ɔcɛ́ ā bónū nɛ̄ anúɔ le Ábsālɔm ŋmó nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ éyi í yɛ í le ka lɛ ɔ́. . Ka anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ujówābu ā ɔ́ɔ kē gáā cɛ̄pɔ̄ anúɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kwú pīya ācɛ nɛ̄ aéwɔhá nēe lā kwu alɔ ā ī yá alɔ okónu ɛɛ́. É bá gē yɛhɛ tū alɔ klla gē yá alɔ ɛbɛ́!.

eng_Latn: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyá yá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ ɔdā ō bī lɛ kwu ita lɛ ācɛ ɔhá. É klla kē tá uwā táajɛ kéē wɛ ɔdā ōpi alɔ ahɔ̄. Ohígbū ka alɔ yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ oŋmɛ́yí kú ɔdā dóódu má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka lɛ ijakī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wɔ́tū uwɔ le iyó nɛ̄hi gbō ce ɔ́ anɔ́ɔ ó má gwōnū, tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú aá kwú ijakī ā ú je gicō ŋmá ajɛ. A híī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ icííci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá í cɛ̄ lɛ íne lɔfú gɛ ŋ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā kagwó mla iyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā plla aá ɔwɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka n tíne kú aá le jé kpɔ́cíí ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā í gáā wā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Ɔwɔicō, mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nōo ī tá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ yíífi ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ piíí ā le bɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ n má ā, aígabɔ̄ kú abɔ́ɔ lɛ ikápɛ̄ti luwɔluwɔ ā ná klá ajɛ, le ɔdōlé kpó ce ɛyí utéblu abɔ́ɔ bá í lé, klla bá ī gwá. Abɔ́ɔ é bá ī lé ucɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ acígilí, n pó ɔ̄cɛ éyi dɛɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔjā, aá cāŋjɛ, kú aá lɛ aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú aá tútū.

eng_Latn: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ōwē dóódu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ōtū íwɔ́tū ā ikɔkɔ nōó géē wɛ ɔdā ō he ɔ̄cɛ ɔtū, amáŋ ekɔ̄bū ó géē gwá īkpō lɛ ācɛ nēe lɔtū kwu ɔ́ ā, īkpō ā wɛ ɛbɔ́ nōo ŋmá lɛ ɔdā olɔhi ō yá.

eng_Latn: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyōkwū kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi kú ɔ́wá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā wā í da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Ɔkpani ɔbá um gekwú ɛɛ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a jé ā, okwūmā ɔbá um ā ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Amáŋ ó le ulé bī ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú á. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó bī ɔ̄ ulé ā gā gáā kpó ayí um ɛpa ā kéē cɔ̄ɔfiyɛ lɛ ɔ́ kwɛyí ulé nɛ̄ ɔbá um bī ɔ̄ ā ɛɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī, Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim yɔ̄ ā nɛ. É kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwu ɛɛ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi nyā gē yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā ka á lɛ ohi tá um.

eng_Latn: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
idu_Latn: Ó klla gē nwūla opeyī eyī. Ó gē je ācɛ nēe má gwōnū ā cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ. Ó kē ī yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe gē yá ucē okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yúklɔ́ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā kē í yá kú ɔtū kóō he Ɔwɔicō, ó klla kē í yá kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Ujonátan mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwá kwu Ugéba, ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn. Aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya kwu Umíkmāsi.

eng_Latn: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ussóbalu wɛ Alfán, Umánāhati, Ébalu, Uséfi, mɛ́mla Ónam. Ayí kú Usibíyɔn wɛ, Aíya mɛ́mla Ána.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ocíbú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī ā.

eng_Latn: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
idu_Latn: Ísɔ lɛ anyā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukénan. Uwá bá yɔ̄ á. Adá, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ɛ́lɔ̄n, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla Oholibáma ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ána, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usíbīyɔn, ɔ̄cɛ Uhám.

eng_Latn: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gáā cɛ̄ ka ɔdā nōo ī nyíliyē dúú kóō bēhé ga ipú igelī ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ucē ɛbí bɛ̄ɛka ɛcí ō pā, ámāŋ ka ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ í gáā ga abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́. Ācɛ nēé tá iyē kú uwā tū ipú ɔkpá kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā ōfōōfūwā géē bēhé ga ipú igelī ā glá á.

eng_Latn: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ nū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ga ipú ácí, ohílīpú kú nū klla kwú pīya ákú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí. Ó lā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí klla gē lé ácí mɛ́mla ēpū bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā. Ó klla gē gbo ɛcɛ áncā ipácí. Ébú gē ce klá anú ɛyí. Igbīhāajɛ ó le jé ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú klla fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ́ɔ gē gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, klla ī je ɔcɛ́ dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ce á.

eng_Latn: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka tū anúɔ ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́. Ka nááná nɛ̄ anúɔ í bīyíne ŋ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ yá ágbe, nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo bīya íne kú um ā, nɛ̄ n géē nya iyē kú nū ŋmá ipú ɔkpá kú um á.

eng_Latn: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
idu_Latn: N géē da ɔ́ ka aá wɛ ācogbāálá nēe gé leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ ka aá kē le aɔ́dāajɛ ká aá mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ákú aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ukɔ́ tū ayíkpó kú nū igwɛ́ɛpa kwɛyí ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá nwɛ̄lā klla gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ipú aígelī nēe kwú abɔ́ɔ ajaajɛ āa.

eng_Latn: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
idu_Latn: Ó le eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í tíne odée ā tū, ó kē le eko kú ɔdā ō bí tū dúú. Eko kú ɔdā ō le tū yɔ̄, eko kú ɔdā ō je tónū kē yɔ.

eng_Latn: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá glá ā lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe cɛgbá kú aá tá uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yā ŋ́, ajɛ kwú ŋmókókó. Ɔ́dāŋ nōó kē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi le yā, éŋ́kpɔ̄ kē lɛ ajɛ kpó.

eng_Latn: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa nū ā lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔtūlé gā um ka n géē cíla uwɔ ulé ā.

eng_Latn: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
idu_Latn: É le Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō yá kóō le nwuné fíyɛ́ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iyē nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ákú uwā a.

eng_Latn: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ádā um tíne á wɛ ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā má, nēe kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó. Anɔ́ɔ n géē kpó uwā héyī ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ tá Unásārēti, ɛga nēé bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɛ̄cī usábati, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē kú nū lɛ ā. Ó cāŋjɛ kóō jé ɔkpíihɔ tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu ŋmá Ubɛtsayída, nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ándru mɛ́mla Upíta ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām le ɛpɔ̄ kpó lɛ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ohígbū obugā éyi nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Wā gaá má aɔ́dā nēe kpó yíífi dúúdú nyā. Aólɛlā kú alɔ kwú ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla omlede nēé wɛ aɔ́dée kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ kú ācɛ ā ú kpó ŋmó. Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū le oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā bī gē lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ pīya klá ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā biílí á.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā nēé tū um ohi nyā ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ká ɛ́ɛ híī lé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́ ka ɔdēeliihɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā lá lɛ Uféro. Ɔkpɛtā cɛ̄ le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kéē kwú ajɛ kú uwā ú lá, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā ā nwuné klla bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ ā kwú pīya agbénū kú Uféro, ɔ̄cɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī ɔfú mɛ́mla íjéeyī kú nū yá ɛcɛ, klla nā ɔkpáncō daa á.

eng_Latn: For every man shall bear his own burden.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē bī iyó kú iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
idu_Latn: Amárīya ma Ahítūbu á.

eng_Latn: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́kpá nyā fu Utímōti, ɔyí um nōo he um ɔtū. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ádā ā mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ kú e ményinyi uwɔ kéē gbonɛnɛ gā uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla yá kú ā lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛɛnɛ ce úlā ahāapa ce ofigwo .

eng_Latn: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō kwú uwā ú lɛ únwū obɔ̄bí nōo ī bīya ācɛ. Ācɛnyā kú uwā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō cikpó uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ uwá nēe wɛ ācɛnyā gē cikpó ācɛnyā ɔ́mpā uwā á.

eng_Latn: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Woó! Óndú, blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gbā uwɔ ɛgbá klla yɛce ɔwɛ kú uwɔ kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔtū ékpónú lɛ ā ā. Ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā anú nɛ̄ n kē ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá ī jikwū klá Óndú ā okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi le ɔnyā Umídīyan éyi bī wā í ga inu kóō gwutá mla anú ipéyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
idu_Latn: n géē lɛ ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo gā uwɔ iyɔ̄bū kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ka Usólómɔ̄n, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ, géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí um ā tū.

eng_Latn: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄. Ó da uwá ka, Aá nyɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi a, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi nōo bī ɛtɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ géē jīla aá ɔwɛ, aá yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
idu_Latn: Unégebu, mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú ajɛ alī ā jāā gaá kwu Usɔ́wa a.

eng_Latn: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔfiyɛ ā le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔkpani anúɔ, ɔnyā mɛ́mla ayí anúɔ ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó dɔɔ̄kā kéē hɛ́ anúɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ ahāapa éyi bá, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyākwú kú uwā ā lɛ ɔnyā lɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú í ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi eko dóódu kú ɛlā ɔ̄cɛ kóō kwú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔtū ɔwɛ olɔhi, ó wɛ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
idu_Latn: Owú odufā nēé le tá odúúdú awulú nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ɛ́fɔ̄du ā á.

eng_Latn: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ka eyī yá anúɔ ká anúɔ kwú pīya ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le ɛdɔ ikpɛ́lā dúúmā nɛɛ, anúɔ géē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo nya alɔ tá bū Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Óndú alɔ ā. Anú ōfūnu nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛgahi, ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́, ɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu wɛ ákú nū gbɔbū nōó yá ɛcɛ ā, kwu abālɔbányā á, kwu eko nōo í wā piyóó á. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
idu_Latn: É ka aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā ohígbū ka aá gē yúufi ekɔ̄bū nɛ̄ ayááyí aá géē da ayááyí aá ɔ̄ká ka, ɔ̄dí ɔ́ gbo ákú uwā mla Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā?.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya da Uhilikáya, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e kpó okónu ce ɔ́ ā, mla ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, kéē lɛ odúúdú ɛcí kú ubáalu, ojibó kú ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā nēe hī ka Ássɛ̄ra ā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ nēé ma bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla iyó kú uwā dóódu ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú uwā ú kpó ga eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ uwá tɔlá ipácí kú Ukídrɔn, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ewo kú nū kpó ga Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
idu_Latn: Óndú ka anúɔ géē yá ɛga lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ anúɔ géē kpó uwā bá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bá céé kú uwā ɛbɔ́, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ dúú í gáā kwu uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ajɛ olɔhi ā, ohígbū keé gē kpɔ́tūce okónu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ce lɛ uwá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gáā kpó ayí alɛwa nɛ̄hi lɛ uwá lɛ ā jé, é géē cɛ̄ ka ami, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um ŋ́ má. É géē lɛ ojīlīma ce um, kllá í yúúfi um.

eng_Latn: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
idu_Latn: ádā kú Ussímēya ā. Ayááyí uwā lā ipú Ujerúsālɛm kwu aípɔ́nū ohile kú ipɔ́ɔ́ma kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Ujonátan le tá ipácí mla ɔyípɛ̄ éyi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu mla Udéfīdi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ okpáátá éyi yɔ̄ kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdā nyá yá ā ajaajɛ. Ó kē wɛ ajɛ kú Upúbliyɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlíidɔ ā. Ó mīyɛ alɔ klla yá alɔ ɔga lɔhi lɔhi ɛ̄cī ɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD was come into the camp.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya ā lɛ ɛgba ā pó, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Aá pó ɛgba nɛ̄hi nēé bā ī dɛ̄ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Uhíburu ā, ɔdí wɛ ɛyí ɛgba nēé bá ī dɛ̄ ā? Eko nēé le jé ka, ikpáti ɛka kú Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gā aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Uhíburu ā.

eng_Latn: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
idu_Latn: Ɔfú nyá nɛ̄ n lɛ ō yēeyī ɛɛ́ mā? Ɔdí wɛ eyīyōce kú um ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
idu_Latn: Woó, Uyáwɛ, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā! Awɔ bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔfúiyē kú uwɔ yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō á. Ɔdā dúúmā í lɔnɔ tū uwɔ ō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́fu le jíliyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Usínāyi, nōo kē wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
idu_Latn: Ikpó ɔnyā ɔhá gwū ɔnyā um tá ō ce lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄hi ā, nōo géē yi um í jē um yíífi. Ó klla í je ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n lɛ ā yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
idu_Latn: A he um ɔtū, Óndú. Awɔ gē lɛ ɔfū tū um iyē á.

eng_Latn: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Utáyítɔ̄si nōo hútu úklɔ́ kú ɛhi ō da nyā ipú aá ā, kóō yɛ gɔbū mla anú jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔ́ yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
idu_Latn: Nááná a cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ aéwo mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ dóódu nōo tɛ̄ɛjī kwu uwá ā yálé. É mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Uhɛ́ssibɔn, ɛga nɛ̄ Usíhɔn cɔcɛ́ ā. É klla mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ubássan, ɛga nɛ̄ Ógu cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n jé ōfōōfūnū ā lé ka Alelékwū Ihɔ ā gē kɛlā ga um igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu ka agbá mla ōwē gē gbēyī um.

eng_Latn: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā uwā géē lɛ ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí nōo kwu ɛga nōo wɛ ákú ayí ulífāyi ohile ā. Abɔ́ɔ kē í wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm í gáā cɛ̄ ka ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ géē yá glá ŋ́, ohígbū okónu kú ɛbɔ́ nēé ce mla uwá ā. Amáŋ ɛbɛ oōmá nyā géē bla ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā tū uwá, klla í pi uwā ahɔ̄ kéē géē kpó uwā kwú.

eng_Latn: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a húmáyī ményinyi kú ajɛ kú alɔ. A klla i yá kú Ísrɛ̄lu kóō jɛ̄ gɔbū igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
idu_Latn: ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ wɛ Unémūwɛlu mɛ́mla Udátan, mɛ́mla Abíram. Udátan mɛ́mla Abíram wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu fu á. É le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nyɔ̄ í wɛ ígwu obɔ̄bí kú Ukɔ́ra eko nēé gē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ aá kwú nyīla ipú ajɛ ā ɛɛ́, ācɛ í klla gáā kɛlā lɛyíkwu ikpati kú okónu ō ce kú um ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É gáā gbɛlá nū, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē blakwu ɔ́ ŋ́. É gáā cɛgbá nū, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yá ɔhá kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka íkpēkwīja kú oje ɔdɔ nēé ma bɛ̄ɛka ɔbá ɛna, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usamérīya gē gba ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, ɔ́ɔ gē wú anúɔ ɔtū. Ó ka anúɔ kpɔ́tūfúlú nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwá. Ó klla ka eko nyá nɛ́ɛ géē habɔ̄ ɛcí nēé gē pā ā tá ā?.

eng_Latn: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
idu_Latn: Ébú gē ŋá ŋmá icō ɛfu ápɛ́tácɔ̄ kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā jéjée ɛɛ́? Ɔkpá ohīlaŋdɔ́ nōo ī pɛ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɛ́mɔn ā ŋmó jéjée ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu klla lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɛgiyí Óndú ā igbɔhá kpɔ́ á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā lɛ ɔfú tū Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɔfú fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
idu_Latn: Alɔ kōō ī ka ā, omɛtɛ́ lɛ íkwu kóō bī ɔmɛ lɛ ma ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɔfú bī ámú kú ɔmɛ ékpónú le ma ɛtɛ́ ɛpa, éyi o bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ eko ɔkwɛ̄yi, anɔ́ɔ ɔhá ā o bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ eko ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī yá ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ ā, odúúmā kú nū í hile gɛ ŋ́. Alɔ le íne bīya ɛɛ́, ákú alɔ kē mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā Ɛláyíja gbɔɔ́ ō yá uwā ɛbɛ́ yɔ̄ gē da uwá kéē dɛ̄gba gágá, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔwɔ nɛ. Ka ekōhī ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kɔ̄kā, ámāŋ ɔ́ɔ kē le tá iyāwu, ámāŋ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ cɛgbá kéē lɛ ɔ́ héyī.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ka iŋini tá Umósīsi, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ gwá. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa géē ka iŋini tá um ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē jé Óndú ā má ā.

eng_Latn: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
idu_Latn: É le tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si anɔ́ɔ é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ lɔfú lɔfú kahíníī, A cíkā ō tá ɔ̄cɛ ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā wɛ: Ubéla, Ubɛ́ka, Ássbɛlu, Ugéra, Unaáman, Éhi, Uróssi, Umɔ́pim, Uhupím mɛ́mla Áādi.

eng_Latn: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
idu_Latn: Umísifa, Ucefíra, Umósa.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
idu_Latn: Aá géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá.

eng_Latn: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ otú ipú ɔ̄na kahíníī, Ujékɔ̄pu, Ujékɔ̄pu! Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ēēē, ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli ó klla gā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ dóódu wā ɛgiyí nū. Ó yāajɛ kla ī nwū uwā ɛlā.

eng_Latn: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō nēé pahila ohígbū oyáŋmó nōo gbɔɔ́ ohígbū Usitífin ā le pɛ́ jāā gaajɛ Ufinísiya mɛ́mla Usáyíprɔ̄si mɛ́mla Ántīyɔ̄ku, nyɔ̄ gē tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Aá dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá dɛ̄ glá ā. Aá lɛ okónu klá ŋ́. Aá jɔkɔ gicō bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī tá opo tāāā ā. Aá ka ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bī tū um ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ohílīpú gē jé ɔdā ŋmá ahɔ̄ nēé pi ɔ́ anú igbeékpónú ā, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nāa ŋmó olíla ije lɛ, ó gáā lɛ ohílīpú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
idu_Latn: Ohi nōó tá um ā yɔ̄ á, Ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ɔ́ɔmā, wɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nōo gē wā ipú ɛcɛ, nōo kē ī wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī odúúdú aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ohile ā tá. Ó gēe je odúúdú ɛcɛ catāajɛ klla í lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
idu_Latn: Uwá mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā, le pɛ́ ga ɔlékwū oyēeyī. Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ ā kwú okónu ú klá tū uwā kpim á. É kwú kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔtū bīya gā um nɛ̄hi lɛ āā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n lɛ unwalu nɛ̄hi lɛ āā? N géē lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, n klla géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú um, nōo ī hɛ́ um tá ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Ó gē ményinyi ācɛ nēe ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā ŋmá ayááyí ga ayááyí.

eng_Latn: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā n̄ da aá ka, é géē mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ŋmá abɔ̄ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ācɛ éwɔhá nēe géē gwá īkpō ɔkwɛ̄yi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da ádā nū kahíníī, É wɛ ayí um nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó gā um ajɛ kú Íjīpiti amānyā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Lɛ uwá kpó gé um ká n̄ lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwa keé lɛ ojīlīma ce Óndú ā, kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú uwā. Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā gē gbā Umɛsopotámīya mɛ́mla ajɛ Íjīpiti ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbā Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
idu_Latn: Amárīya, Umállūci, Uhátɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ nyā wɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ ā je á. Ɔ́dáŋ ka ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā Ujerúsālɛm ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í jīla ā ŋ́, é géē mīyɛ odúúdú agbénú kú nū klla í je ɔ́ nū ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Amásīya, a lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm yálé klla le uwá ca tāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ í cɛ̄ gā awɔ gɛ ŋ́ má. Ofu nāa lé ā kóō jɛ uwɔ mɛ́ɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā klá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ cíí. Ɔdíyá nāa gē pla unwalu nōo géē bī ífi wā í klá iyī uwɔ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka óndú nū ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, ó gáā gbā ulé nū ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá olufa nɛɛ, ɔ́lá kú nū kóō yɔ̄ ipú ije kú olufa ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anúɔ da Ujóssuwa kóō híī yúúfi uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā nuunu ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú íne ā ka, Ébrahām lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa. Éyi ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā, ɔhá kē ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo lɛ iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
idu_Latn: N géē yá aá bɛ̄ɛka ɛgɔ̄ ogbā ɔdā ā ɛyīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ayīnu nū gē lulé ā. Aá géē gbā aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi wā ajɛ klla í je uwá kpó yíífi. Aá géē je aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ catāajɛ nēé í lɛbɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ā.

eng_Latn: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwáahāanɛ ā wɛ Umálɔti.

eng_Latn: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nāa mīyābɔ̄ ugbɔga ka anúɔ gē cílá ulé nɛ̄ ó bī ā á, ā géē hííjémā. Ó gē lɔhi gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka á lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā jé olíla ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ikpala géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ufínɛ̄hasi, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā yá nyā, ń klla gáā cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó tá ka anúɔ í gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, ń táafú ayíka ami ōfōōfūnū um. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ń kpó uwā yíífi ipú ánya mɛ́mla ícɔnū kú um ŋ́ má yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
idu_Latn: É géē gwɛ́ɛya kú ínobīya ohígbū aɔ́dā nɛ̄ bá nyā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā hīīgwú kóō wā í lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ ɔnɛ̄pɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó wā í lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ kú ɔdā nōó má ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó pó ŋ́ má. É géē yá ɔ̄ italā.

eng_Latn: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe ce ɔnya ā da Alelékwū ō tɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo māháyi ipú aɔ́cí ā kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ɛcɛ jila tá kwɛyí ɛɛ́. Alɔ kē má ka odúúdú ɛcɛ bá ɛbɔ́ cíí.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī pī ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ogbɛhá nɛ̄ ɛgbá í ije í ce ɔ́ ámāŋ ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa uwā ámāŋ aílɔwá nēe lā ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā nēe lɛ úklɔ́ yá lɛ uwá tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
idu_Latn: N géē je ācopɛ̄cí mla aógwɛ́bā kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú aá, nɛ̄ aá klla gáā lɛ ācogwɛ́bā ipú aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
idu_Latn: N géē yá ācɛ kú Ujúda italā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā. N géē je ɔdā dúú nōo hile kú ɛ̄gbā nēé gbā Ubáalu ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā blakwu ācopɛ̄cí nēe gē pā ubáal lɛ ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá móōwē ipú ɔkpíyē eko nēé ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, aá gbla Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ipú ɛdɔ kú ucē nɛ̄ ó yá ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɛdɔ kú ōwē ɔ́ɔmā má, o gáā yɔ̄ gē bīyíne gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
idu_Latn: Ó yá ācɛ alɛwa eyījii, eko nēé má ɔ́ ā. É lɛ ɔ́ yá agbe, lɛ ɔ́ eyī tū mi ɛbɛɛbɛ, nōó kōō gbla ɔlɛɛcɛ fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ɔhá í yɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ ōhī gē junwalu lɛ aá, kē klla ī tíne kéē lɛ aá eyī pīya ŋmá ɔkōōlɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛtá kú ɔyā éyi ā, Uháman le odúúdú aɔ́málɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kpó hīgwú, klla lɛ ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ ā jé lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ tá okónu ucē kú ācɛ dóódu kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aígbómína mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú odúúdú ajɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú nū ā. É tá ɔkpá ā iyē kú ɔcɛ́, é klla le eliká kú ɔcɛ́ ā gbo ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
idu_Latn: Eko gē wā, ɛ̄cī ā le bá ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔlá ō je lá, mla ɔlá ō lá í gáā lɛɛyí ɛga dúúmā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē cɔ̄nū tū odúúdú ācɛ ā klla í yá italā ɔwɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka n géē kpó ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā yíífi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ka n géē yá ā. N kɛlā lɛ uwá, amáŋ é jāhɔ̄ ŋ́. N hī uwá igwú, amáŋ é cɛ̄ um igwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Usámsin le tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, nēé hī kú Ugása ā. Ó le akwuna éyi má abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpó nū ce á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɔtū kú Uféro le lɔfú, ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
idu_Latn: Ó ka aínu alɛwa nēe le mu mla agbénú mɛ́mla ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi, nōó wɛ uwá kpó tū ipú nū ŋ́ mā, anúɔ géē je lɛ uwá. Aóbugā nōó wɛ uwá bū ā ŋ́ mā bá ipú ajɛ ā ɛga alɛwa. Ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ólīifu nōó wɛ uwā tū ŋ́ mā bá anú. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú ajɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛdɔ ɔdɔ̄lé dóódu nēé dɔɔ̄kā ā lɛ gē lé ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē yá lɛ ā, é má um bā n lɛ iyē gwu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ɛwa í bá abɔ́ɔ ŋ́ mā ā, útú í ke hɛ́ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ɔkíka ɛnɛ, olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄, olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛnɛ cigwó.

eng_Latn: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé mīyɛ ije ā, é le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é da uwá lɛ ā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ̄kā nyā kā yɛ ajɛ ɛga dóódu kú Ujudíya jāā kwu ícɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ amɛ̄ kú aá gbáyígbáyí ka aá jikwū ohígbū ɔdā nōo géē yá ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
idu_Latn: Ó géē cē oji ā jīla lɛ Óndú ā piíí, ayíka ɔbá nū ā tá, eko nɛ̄ ó pó oji nɛ̄ ó cē ā.

eng_Latn: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é klla dɛ̄gba gágá fíyɛ́ á. É bī ɛ̄wā mla igwu o wɛ́yí le īyī uwā hɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uculo kóō yá kú ubáalu lɛ ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ oyī gbɔɔ́ ō bū uwā iyē.

eng_Latn: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā Ugádi le tá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi gaá da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ɛga nɛ̄ Arawúna gē wú igwu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu bɛ̄ɛka ami ā nɛɛ, ń yɛ í lɔfú ka ɔkɔ mɛ́mla anú. N géē yɛ í lɛ ɔkpá tá lɛ ɔ́, ka ami mɛ́mla anú kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ hɛ́ lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá kpɔ́ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
idu_Latn: É gē ka obɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, klla ī je ɔ́da kú ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ŋmá abɔ̄ gaá bū okónɔɔwɛ kú Ɛ́frem, mɛ́mla okónɔɔwɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄, gaá bū okónɔɔwɛ nēé hī ka ákú ɛbéenyi, klla gaá le bū ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda kú Uhanánɛlu mɛ́mla ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda nēé hī ka ákú ofɛhɔ̄ ā. Alɔ klla le yɛ ga okónɔɔwɛ nēé hī ka ákú aálá ā. Iyāwu kú ígwu kú alɔ ā gaá le ŋmɛ́yí okónu okónɔɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
idu_Latn: odúúdú ayípōklóbīya ā lɛ ɔtū yékpónú anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ i yɛ otú gaá kwú okwū kú Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ayí nū ú kpó ŋmá ɔdɔ kú Ubétissan. Anɔ́ɔ é gā Ujábesi, le uwá kpó tɔ̄lá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ bī gé lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni, mɛ́mla ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umélki, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Addi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukósam, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɛlmádam, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Éri.

eng_Latn: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
idu_Latn: Ile nyá nɛ̄ ojéeyī lɛ fíyɛ́ olíla ā? Olɔhi nyá nōó wɛ lɛ olɛɛhá kóō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lā oyēeyí kú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā. É ī gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ, klla bá ī cɛ̄tra iyē kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ igelī nēé hī ka Unínēye ā géē cāŋjɛ ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ í cījáalí tū ācɛ kú eko nyā. É kē géē ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí, ohígbū ka uwá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɛlā kú Ujóna nēé pó āa. Amáŋ n da aá ka ɔdā nōo fíyɛ́ Ujóna kē yɔ̄ amānyā abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā kóō híī yá aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
idu_Latn: Adónīja, Ubígifāyi, Adin.

eng_Latn: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtā le nwuné klla le bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, ɔdōlé í yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu, ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Ukénan ŋ́. Ɛmiyɛ cɛ̄ le abɔ̄ lɛ hɛ́ ācɛ kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ukénan ā iyē.

eng_Latn: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
idu_Latn: Aá pó abɔ̄ ācɛ nēe kwu ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm ā bá ī kā ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā gwō Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ci lɛ ā. Ɔwɔicō géē gwō Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ci ohígbū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū nēé je yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nēé bī le cíla alɔ ulé kú olɔhi ɔ́ɔmā ā yɔ̄ á. O lɛ alɔ kpó nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ nāa je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ojibó ɔwɔ kú ɔ̄cɛnyā kú Ássera mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ gbā kwaajɛ ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfu dóódu á.

eng_Latn: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā wɛ ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū eyōonyā á. É tá ō yɛ ɔwɛ nōo ɔlá gē fíyajɛ anú ā. É kē gebí ŋmá ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojiji ā, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yá a, wɛ áncā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ agbénú túbá, ó kē jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā lé agbénú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
idu_Latn: Ododó éyééye kóō kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú abɔ̄ ɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
idu_Latn: N gē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá íne nɛ̄ n tū lɛyíkwu ɛ̄cī nēé cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, í klla ī nyílá anú ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tá ka aá yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá géē mīyɛ ɛga olɔfú kú aólɛlā kú aá, kllá í ŋmó aólɛlā kú aá ā, ɔkpá í cēenyi klá ajɛ kú aá ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
idu_Latn: ācogbɔ̄cí, mɛ́mla ācɛ ogwíinu, mɛ́mla ācɛ ogbɛ̄cɔ̄ ā kéē lɛ lá ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nēé gbā bá ajɛ ā, mɛ́mla ígbɔ́cí ō cíla ɛyí ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mā ɔ̄ tá je bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
idu_Latn: É le ohépu kú ɔcí nēé hī upomégranēeti úlā nēé le playi agbá nēé hā tū aúpíla ā ɛyí ā kpó yá dúú.

eng_Latn: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
idu_Latn: É géē lé odúúdú ucɛ ā ipú inu nēé yá ɔdōlé āa. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō bī ɔdōlé ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋ́. Aá gáā ca ikpokwú dóódu kú ɛbɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɛwa kú ācɛ nēe jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā cɛ̄, áluka kú ācɛ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofīgwó ā .

eng_Latn: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn, ɔyí kú Ujówāsi gekwú eko nōó le hīla ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ nyi Unóji kú ádā nū, Ujówāsi ɔlɛ́ uwā, Ɔ́fra, nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Abíyɛ̄sa ā.

eng_Latn: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛbɛ́ yá ɔ̄ kwɛyí ā, é lɛ awulú ā púla, anɔ́ɔ é kwú úwé kú nū ú wu ɔ́ iyē á. É le ɔ́ bī gɛcɛ kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ īlī kú nū híla, klla kahíníī, Ó ī ka ɛbí ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā ijáalí ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā? Aá lɛ ɛbí kú nū pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē bī iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá le yá uwā ubatísim. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō dēē yɔ̄ mla uwá ɛ́ɛ́.
