eng_Latn: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É le ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ nyā kɔ̄ ígwíígwu klla lɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā je lɛ uwá bɛ̄ɛka ayí kú Ulífāyi ohile ɔ́mpa ūwā ā.

eng_Latn: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔlá klá ajɛ kú Umágɔ̄gu mɛ́mla aájɛ kú okónu ísu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ lā ɛbɔ́ ā. Odúúdú ācɛ kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
idu_Latn: Aá géē klá okómpīinu kú ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā otū mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ká aá bá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da aá ka aá yá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yá lɛ ā ŋ́, aá géē kwú. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne kú nū gā um ká yá ā.

eng_Latn: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
idu_Latn: É kwú mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄ ó yá, nēé má ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ́kpá á. É le úwé kú nū kɔ̄ lɛ iyī uwā. É le ūlī tá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē je āyā kú úwé kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
idu_Latn: É kwú awulú kú otómbíyē ú tá klá Ujísɔ̄si iyē, anɔ́ɔ é bī ujē lɛ ɔfla kú ɔcɛ́ yá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú wu ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nɛ̄ eyī kú uwā kwú Íjīpiti ō nyɔ̄ gaá lā abɔ́ɔ piíí ā, ɛfú géē lé uwā, ámāŋ́ ka ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí géē kpó uwá ŋmó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúmā kú uwā í gáā wi ŋmá ífi nɛ̄ n gáā yá kóō yá uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
idu_Latn: Apólosi le ɔ́ ŋmótū kóō ga Akáya, ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō nēe bá Ɛ́fēsɔsi ā le ɔtū tū ɔ̄ ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔkpá tá gé lɛ ayíkpó nēe yɔ̄ Akáya ā kéē mīyɛ anú. Eko nōó le táajɛ ā, ó tá ācɛ nōo ŋmá lɛ eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ka anúɔ í jééyī ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō ba Ɔwɔicō nōo ī je ŋmá ɔtū oyēŋēē, nōo ī kiífulá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ uwá gɔ́ igbo alɛwa ā, é lɛ uwá kpótū ijaló, é kē da ɔ̄cɛ ogbō-alagbá ā kɔ́ɔ̄ leyī hɛ́tū uwā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a le yá ka ɔfú iyē kú um kóō mɛ ɛɛ́. A klla kwú ācɛ ipíinu ɔlɛ́ um kpó ŋmó dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
idu_Latn: mla agbá kú oje udɔ ɛpa nēé lɛ ɔ́ jílatɔ̄há bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ngbá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú agbá ā ú kwu ɔ́ngbá kú oje udɔ ā nōo wɛ oōjílatɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá bū ipú Umísīya ā, anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ ga Utrɔ́wasi á.

eng_Latn: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alɔ le okónu gwū, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ka ó gbō alɔ ipú iyāwu kú alɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā pó, kllá le ohi tá alɔ á.

eng_Latn: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú mīyɛ ulé nɛ̄ ācɛ éwɔhá ɔ́ɔ bī ūwā ā. Ó ka amáŋ ɛ́ɛ híī mīyɛ ulé ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā nōo bī uwā ulé ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ nɛ̄ aádáádā ūwū lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá nyā, klla pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā ɔlɛ́ mla uwá dúú. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm mɛ́mla Unétōfa ā wɛ ofahāanɛ ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́, klla ī bīya íne ā? Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔ́ɔmā í gáā lɛyí lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā, n géē tá aá ohi. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a hī um igwú kú um tá aá abɔ̄, n géē cɛ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá habɔ̄ ōwē nɛ̄ aá gē yá ācɛ ā tá, nɛ̄ aá kē kpɛ́lāce uwá gɛ ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá klla kē kɛlā kú ɔ́bíipú lɛyíkwu ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ujerúsālɛm ɔ́ɔ wɛ igelī nōo nwuné nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ācɛ alɛwa í lā ipú nū ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē gwó ɔlɛ́ alɛwa tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
idu_Latn: Eko ucɛ kú onyatá ā, nōo wɛ ucɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, le bá ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú ɔ́ɔmā géē lé odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nēé plla ŋmá Itiyópiya, Ulídiya, Ulíbīya, Arabiya, kwu Ukúbu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um abɔ̄yī uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ōfōōfūnū nōó lá ŋ́ má. Ohígbū ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le ulé kú ɔdōlé nɛ̄ Uféro gē gbā lɛ uwá. Ɔ́ɔmā yá nēé je ajɛ kú uwā lá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
idu_Latn: N hī aá igwú ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó um ā, anɔ́ɔ aá je ɔdōlé gā um á. Eko nɛ̄ ijēenyi yɔ̄ ī ŋmó um ā, aá je enyi gā um gwá. N wɛ ugbɔga, aá kē lɛ eyī kwū um.

eng_Latn: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ um lɛ um ce ikpó, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó je amɛ̄ gā um gwá ā?.

eng_Latn: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgɔ kú ágábá ā yɔ̄ a? Igelī nɛ̄hi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛga nɛ̄ aágábá gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔyí uwā ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nyɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ɛga nɛ̄ ágábá mla ɔnyā ágábá ōfōōfū uwā gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ oōnyílá kú nū ā mɛ, ó géē gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú uwɔ géē gbɔɔ́ ō má ɔdā oyéyījii alɛwa. Á klla gáā gbɛlá lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē kɛlā kpaakpa ŋmá okónu glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
idu_Latn: Aójībó kú ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í kpó pīyeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí um ɛɛ́. Amáŋ n gbɛlá ō bī ohi kú um ā le pīya uwá ɛyí wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ɛwa ā le ŋmótu ipú ɔtū kú uwā ka Alesáŋda nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu fu ā, ɔ́ɔ jé odée lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōo yá ā, abɔ̄ é cē ɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ gbɔɔ́ ga iyɔbū ā. Anɔ́ɔ Alesáŋda yá uwā abɔ̄ pɛɛ, abɔ̄ ó tíne kóō kɛlā lɛ uwá ohígbū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
idu_Latn: N klla je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔkpá nōo le hā gblógbló yɔ̄ ī wu icō.

eng_Latn: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā géē bá í yɛ ipú ajɛ ā, bá ī jɔ́ɔnɔ, nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ klla ī yɔ̄ ī ŋmó uwā. Ipú ɛmiyɛ nōo gēe yɔ̄ í ŋmó uwá ā, é géē bá í ka atufú lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ kú uwā mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú uwá. Eko nēé ī tíne otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
idu_Latn: Uhámāti nōo tū ɛjī kwu Uhádirāki ā wɛ ákú nū dúú. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó wɛ lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn, nēe jéeyī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Udemitríyɔ̄si mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ mla anú ā lɛ odée nēé bī lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, inɛ̄pɔ̄ le nwūla bá abɔ́ɔ á, aɔ́cɛ́ ō hɛ́pɔ̄ ā lɔfú mīyɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā bōōbū glá. É lɔfú kpó ɛlā ce uwá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man's hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehéee, á hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē lɛ abɔ̄ da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛyí tāajɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē mīyɛ ɔdā dúúmā lé ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le iŋini nēé ka ā pó. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ kwú cɔ̄nū, le ɔkpá gbo.

eng_Latn: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ɔ́ɔ gaá lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄ í lā ajɛ ɔhá, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú uwā ā. Ka ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ géē má īkpɔ̄cí ufáyin le yá ejé, klla í má īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ í le yá igbō.

eng_Latn: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bá abɔ́ɔ aláadi alɛwa, bá ī kɛlā kú Ujísɔ̄si ā tɛ́ɛcɛ pāālā, Óndú ā le mafú ka ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi eko nēé kɛlā lɛyíkwu ogbonɛnɛ kú nū lɛ uwá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdīdáagó.

eng_Latn: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
idu_Latn: Je lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá odée ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kwú ɔdā kú uwɔ í kpó, ā híīī mīyɛ ɔ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ nū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, o yɔ̄ cíí wɛ ɔdā kú íjéeyī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú yá eko obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā á.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Eko nōo le kpaakpa gā um ā í yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ eko dóódu le kpaakpa lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ nōó le ā, aá híī leyī gwō ācɛ nēé hɛ́ bónū bɛ̄ɛka ābɔ̄ ɔcí ā ŋ́. Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ aá í gwō ā? Aá wɛ ābɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n, aá gē tá ɛgba ā abɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛgba ɔcí ā gē tá aá abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ nēe yēeyī eko kú Ádām í tá eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi yēeyī ā, le pɛ́ gekwú, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā í bīyíne ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádām bīya eko nōó tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne piíí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋmā. Ádām wɛ ɔwɛ éyi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wā ā, ɔwɛ ɔhá, ó kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē bī aá gā ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n géē je lɛ Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā. N géē je ajɛ ā lɛ aá kú ō wɛ ákú abɔ̄yí aá. Ami wɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tíne kéē klla lɛ ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā á.

eng_Latn: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upahatimówābu ā wɛ, ayí kú Ujéssuwa mɛ́mla Ujówābu ā. É wɛ úlā ahāapa ce ācɛ igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka iní nɛ̄ ihɔtū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ lɛ oklóbīya nū, Udéfīdi ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gɛ? Ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla oklóbīya nū ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pó ka Ujérobōwam ɔ́ɔ pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, é le jīla le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɛce ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi ŋ́, ayíka ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ōfōōfu uwá nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā cē uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ uwá ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē kplá aéwo alɛwa ije, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ gáā kplá ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú aéwo alɛwa, amáŋ, éwo dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
idu_Latn: Ujamútu, Ulákisi.

eng_Latn: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, odúúdú aá kóō yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo he aá ɔtū. Aá nyɔ̄ ī pā aɛ́cí kú aá. Amáŋ n gē pi aá ahɔ̄ ka, igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, n gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá bá ī je uwēyī lɛ iyē otīihɔ kú um mla ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ aá ī gbā aójibó kú aá gɛ ŋ. Amáŋ aá géē lɛyítáajɛ ga um piíí.

eng_Latn: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, ī bī ɔkplɛ́fú kú nū abɔ̄, ī kwinya gaá tū Ɔwɔicō iyē.

eng_Latn: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ mla um piyóo, ó cɛ̄ gā um le jéeyī fíyɛ́ aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe kwu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā géē kwúcē wā í lā, klla géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú Ufinísiya jāā ga ajɛ kú Usárefāti, cɛ́ɛ́ é gaá lā abɔ́ɔ. Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā, géē lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Unɛ́gɛ̄bu ā.

eng_Latn: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú agbénú nōó móōwē nū ā géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō le yá ɔdā dóódu lɛ īyī nū. Ó gáā jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú ile nōo lɛ ŋmá óbé nōó yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
idu_Latn: Ó kē lɔhi ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō nwū ogbēyī cíí nyā eko kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
idu_Latn: N pó ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā. Ó kahíníī, Ɔ́lá igbóngbó ocikāpā éyi wɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ kú ɛ̄cī odunkulu, igbóngbló igwu ɛtá kē wɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ kú ɛ̄cī odunkulu. Amáŋ a híīī kpó aɔ́cí kú olíifu mɛ́mla ákú Ufáyin bīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó ka ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ɔ́ɔ́ gáā lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ ā dúúmā mla ācɛ ā ŋ́. Ka ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ wɛ o yúklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó lɛ Óndú ā. Aipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ kē lɛ ajɛ kú uwā lɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ɛga nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta hīgwú mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ɛhīlī nyā: Uríyɛ̄lu, Asáya, Ujówɛ̄lu, Ussɛmáya, Ɛlíyēlu mɛ́mla Amínādābu.

eng_Latn: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī móōwē kú abɔ̄ nēé da ɔ́ ɛyí tāajɛ ā. Ó ka ka ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄ka otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēé tá ūwā abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī je ayí uwā gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede kú uwā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā dóódu gwɛ́bā bɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ofu ɛpa ce igwó nēe ŋmá Ujérīko ā le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa yá ā má ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alelékwū kú Ɛláyíja ā yɔ̄ ipú Ɛláyíssa dúú. Anɔ́ɔ é wā gaá le yɛ jīla anú ɔwɛ, klla túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bú nū.

eng_Latn: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛfú kpó tú odúúdú aéwo ā, ó gáā habɔ̄ Íjīpiti tá ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām je eyī gicō anɔ́ɔ ó le omlede má le ajī jī wu ɛplá aɔ́cí á. Ébrahām le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ omlede ā kwú anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o pá ɔlá lɛ Ɔwɔicō kwɛyí ɔyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú bɔkwu nū í jé fíya glá ā, ó fíyɛ́ ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ n nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm gaá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛhícō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ó le aéde mɛ́mla aójibó kú Ássɛra mɛ́mla íkpékwūja kpó ca tāajɛ. Ó klla le uwá gbā jāā gbéeko nēé kwú pīya umu. Ó klla le odúúdú aéde o yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ɛyí uwā lɛ ɛcí ā kpó ca dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ā á. Ulɔ́tu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ̄ nū nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú dúú. Ébram wɛ iháyí ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, eko nōó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Uháran āa.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan le tá ɛgiyí nū abɔ́ɔ gāá lɛ ɔ́ ɔtū tū kwu ɔtū, klla da ɔ́ péee ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī gbō ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū fu lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ ga ɛyí ɛfu, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ubɛ́tɛlu. Ubɛ́tɛlu yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, Ái kē yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā. Ó hī Óndú ā igwu, yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ́ ɛ̄gbā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā, ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí Ulífāyi kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ. A klla lɛ ācɛ kú ɔtū kú uwɔ kpó kwɛyí uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aéwo ɔhá nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā gē yá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛna éyi ámāŋ álá ahāapa bī wā ɛɛ́, lɔfú je iyī nū yá tīihɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ a hī ka aɔ́wɔ kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá ka ɛlā okónu áncā gē kwɛyí íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔfú kú ɛfú ō kpó nɛɛ? Ɔnyɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka ó wā í tá aá abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aá gē yīīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā.

eng_Latn: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm í lɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda fu ā gē gbō abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō í ka ɔkɔ kú alɔ lɛ ɔ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í lɛ íkwu gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔbá nū lɛ oji nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ā pó, nɛ̄ ó tá, ká ɔ̄ híī hóoji ŋ́. Ó gáā cē oji ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔbá nū tá, eko nɛ̄ ó pó oji nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ā. Óndú í je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ etikpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tá ajɛ ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe le awulú kpó wiyē ā, le túháyi, b­ī opo abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe wɛ ayí kú Ásāfu ā, kē háyi abɔ́ɔ, bī anwa kú oje abɔ̄ kéē gwíijē ō cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mafú lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī le odúúdú ācɛ nēé gē gbō aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛ̄gbā, klla gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú aíkpékwuuja ɛfulɛ́ɛfu ā kwú ɛɛ́. Odúúdú aɛ́cí gē tūkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, É le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ cē mɛ ɛɛ́, ɔnɔ̄ kē le fa ɛɛ́, amáŋ é kē nya alɔ tá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ inú ā dúúdú kwu iyī nū á, anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō le nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi jāā gbéeko nōó kwú pīya Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe lā Usamérīya ā bá ī pā ɛcí klla bá ī yá aɔ́wɔ lɛ iyī uwā kpɔ́. É le ɛcí kú uwá kpó bá ipú inu kú ɛcí nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tɛtɛ gwó bá abɔ́ɔ ā. Ígwu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛyí kú uwá lɛ ojibó ɛcí kú uwā kpó bá igelī nɛ̄hi nēé lā ā.

eng_Latn: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
idu_Latn: Lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ īlī kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a lā ipú nū ā nyīlɔwá, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ́ túkwaajɛ lɔfú.

eng_Latn: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aólɛlā kú um bá ī cē okónu tú um gbɛdɛɛ. N kwú pīya ɔdā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu īkpēyí kú aɔ́mpa um. N kwu pīya ɔdā ufi ɛgiyí ācɛ dóódu nēé jé um ā. Ācɛ dúúmā nēe lɛ um má úláyi, gē kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, aá nēe gē ka obɔ̄bí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ka ā, aá le hídáagó, ká aá le yíífi. Ohígbū ka n yá odée eko ká aá, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gáā cɛ̄ gbóógbóō glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú kōō lɛyí nū ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē lɛ ojīlīmā kú igabɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ce iyīnū glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū nōo ī fu ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya lɛ iyī nū glá ā lɛ ɔ́ fu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó fu Árɔ̄ni ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ kwúcē ga ɛgiyí ádā alɔ ā, alɔ le odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā kpó da ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aɔ́tángbédē tū ɔkɔ eko nēé ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rébu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē nuunu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kpɛ́fú ɛyí ɛfu kú Upérāsim mɛ́mla ipú ɔpɛ́ kú Ugíbiyɔn ā. Ó géē yá ɔdā nōo tíne ō yá ā nōo kē í yá eyījii nɛ̄hi. Ó kē í yúklɔ́ kú nū nɛ̄ ācɛ í kē lɛ eyī cē ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
idu_Latn: Unátan le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā kpó ka lɛ Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
idu_Latn: Ubáala Íim, Ɛ́sɛm.

eng_Latn: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
idu_Latn: Okónu kú olíla gē bī ikpɛ́lā wā ajɛ, okónu kú nū klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ gɔ́ ɔ̄ itali.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
idu_Latn: N gē cɛ̄tra awɔ, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ cíkā ō yúufi uwɔ, úklɔ́ kú uwɔ dóódu klla wɛ ɔdā nōo ī hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ idáagó. Á jé um lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í lɔhi jɛ̄ nɛ̄ uwá ī lā gɛ ŋ́. É bá ī yɛ ipú ígbíli, é yɛ ɛyí ɛfu, kē lā ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya da Uhɛsɛkíya ka, Ɔdōōcābɔ̄ kú ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā yɔ̄ á. Ɛyímā mɛ́mla ɛyí ɔ́há, aá géē cē klla í lé īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bū klla jé tá ipácí abɔ̄yī uwā. Amáŋ iháyí ɔmɛtá ā, aá géē nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nɛ̄ aá géē cē klla í lé mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔkpáncō ā tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu. É cɛyí ɔnya nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ úwé oŋmlɛ́ ŋmlɛ́ nɛ̄hɛ́ péee wiyē.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, ācɛ kú Ufilístiya nyɔ̄ gaá kpó iyó ŋmá iyē kú aókwū nēe bá ajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le okwū kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛtá ā má bá ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugílbowa á.

eng_Latn: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbō ɔ̄ gɛɛ kéē lɛ ɛga má fu ɔ́ á. É le ije gbā lɛ ācɛ ōhī kéē bī ula ga ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā. Amáŋ ɔdā nēé bī ɔtū ā wɛ kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā éyi cɛ́ɛ́ kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā kéē lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú gé lɛ igbómína nōo lɔfú klla le íkwu kú Uróm ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ɛgiyí ɛbɛ́ nēe bá nyā kéē wɛ ɔdōlé kú Óndú ā: odúúdú ijē nōo klá iyíipú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ga, ipɔ́lɛ́ nēé lɛ igá du tū ɔɔ nɛ̄hi a, é gēe je kwu ŋmá anú, je ɔɔ tá alácɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka alácɛ̄ kú aígelī kú ācɛ Uhám mɛ́mla Ámɔ̄ri, nēé kwu hɛ ɔɔ tá, eko nēé ba í kwu inya kú Ísrɛ̄lu a.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ lɔfú le tīihɔ gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ɛgiyí nū, ɛ̄cī dóódu kú ipú oyeeyi kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um, ká ā klla cɛ̄pɔ̄ um, lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēé í gbā awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ mā. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ o yá ucē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
idu_Latn: Ó kéē da uwá ka ipéyī kú aá cāā ā, aá má Óndú ā yúklɔ́ ōhídáagó mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō tūufi alɛwa ɛgīyí ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, kwu ɔcɛ́ kú uwá mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka, Ohóō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē pīya anúɔ tū, o ŋmá lɛ o bī ɛbɛ́ icííci wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ anúɔ, nááná nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛbɛ́ olɔhi nɔ́ɔ le hɛ́ anúɔ oji ā. Ó ka anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ gē yúufi anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú lá ayí kú aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú aá. Ɛdɔ ayí dóódu nɛ̄ uwá ma ipú ajɛ kú aá ā, géē wɛ agbénú kú aá.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Aá nēe lā ɔkpáncō nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kóō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ipú kú ɔnyā dóódu, nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ā gwū kéē mɔyí ŋ́, ohígbū Usára, ɔnyā kú Ébrahām.

eng_Latn: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó cɛ̄ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá jāā gbéeko nōó géē cíla ulé ā á.

eng_Latn: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō bīya, Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́ yíífi. Ohígbū ka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā tīihɔ, aá abɔ̄yī aá kē tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Jesus wept.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ikwū je.

eng_Latn: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé ɛɛ́. Ɔbíipú kú aá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ohɛ́kɔ kú ɔdɔ olicō nɛ̄hi nōo le fō playi i tútū ō wúla wāajɛ ā. Ó kē ī wúlatāajɛ acígilí igbeékpónú. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá géē je yíífi acígilí igbeékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
idu_Latn: N le aéwo ɔhá alɛwa nēe gē pá aɛ́cí nēe fíyɛ́ ákú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Usamérīya yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
idu_Latn: Ń tíne ká n̄ wā í lɛ aá má klókó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ icííci ŋ́. N miya ka n̄ wā í klá mla gbojī ajɛ ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā, Usétan! Ohígbū keé lɛ ɔ́ tátāajɛ ipú ɔkpíihɔ̄ kahíníī, Gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā ɛ̄gbā. Anú ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ a géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n wā Utrówāsi gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, n le ma ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla gā um ká n̄ yúklɔ́ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu nōó gbo ɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú nū ā, ó géē cíla ulé kú odúúdú nū. Eko nēé le ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, ó géē gbā ulé kú ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ā ɛga éyi ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ cɛyí ulé kú nū abɔ̄yīnū lɛ óndú nū piíí.

eng_Latn: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
idu_Latn: N kwú ɔfú kú um ú lɛ ɔ́ dúúdú ɛɛ́. N le íjééyī, ɛyí kú ɔdā ō jé mla ɔdā ímlɛ́ ō yá kpó lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ ímlɛ́ dóódu glá.

eng_Latn: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Usádusīi gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla iyī ūwā. Anɔ́ɔ ójila ā le kɔ̄ ɛpa á.

eng_Latn: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē gbɔɔ́ ō yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé cɔcɔcɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ nōo gē yā ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n je kóō le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjathjearim.
idu_Latn: É nyɔ̄ ī le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú cēce ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ukiríyat Ujēyarím, ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē hī abɔ́ɔ ka áaklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Udáni kwu eko nɛ̄ e tɔ́kpá nyā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū lɛ tá ɛfu kú Uhɛ́burɔn gaá kpɛ́fú tá uwā.

eng_Latn: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri, Uhɛ́ti, Upɛ́risi, Uhám mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi, nɛ̄ ayí uwá mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú uwá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú okónu nɛ̄ a ce lɛ ádā um, Udéfīdi ā, ícɛ nyā, a le ɔ́ yá jīla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēe bá nyā lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nēe gē yíífi eko nēé lɛ uwá bī yúklɔ́ kwɛyí. É wɛ aíne nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ tū mla ɔdōnwū kú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá má kwu ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri, ayááyi kú Ulɔ́tu ajaajɛ. Ó tū uwā ukɔ́ kéē híī junwalu ámāŋi ka o nuunu tá uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ í gáā je ajɛ dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwā ā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usáyímɔ̄ni mɛ́mla aɔ́mpānū le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ yɔ̄ gē dɔɔ̄kā nū.

eng_Latn: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi í je úgbáajɛ kú ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna dúúmā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔdā o tīihɔ nēé bī ā, é ge bī uwā ce ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gáā gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyā um nōo wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó yīipú lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka, Umáhá-Ssalal-Hassabasi.

eng_Latn: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nwɛ̄lā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Aá jé um, aá kē jé ɛga nɛ̄ n ŋmá ā ɔkwɛ̄yi? Ń bī ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī um wā nóó, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ aá jé ŋ́ mā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ jééyī á. Eko nēé lɛ ɛcɛ lé ligbó, é gē jɛ́yí odée.

eng_Latn: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le jé ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú anúɔ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, le anúɔ ikpó tú kwajɛ lɔɔlɔhi, klla yā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gɔbū lɔhi, ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ unú, Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
idu_Latn: Aá da Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe gē tokónu lɛ aá ā. Aá kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācɛ nēe gē yá aá ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mɛ́mla ihɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla olétɔ̄há kú Alelékwū Ihɔ kóō yɔ̄ mla odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
idu_Latn: pó ŋmá ɔkpáncō ká ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ aólɛla kú uwā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ohígbū uwā, ń gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ohígbū ācɛ ɛcɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ nāa kpó gā um ā, ohígbū kéē wɛ ákú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ó māháyi, ɛcɛ gē jíliyē. Eko nōo pīyeyī klé má ɛcɛ, aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō fīyɛ̄gbúlú. Aɛ́fu nēe húmáyī kwu ŋmá íkííkée ā kwú kpó hɛ́ ga ipú ajɛ. Aɛ́fu nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nēe wɛ ɔwɛ kú nū kú íkííkée ā.

eng_Latn: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔna tá ipú aígelī kú Íjīpiti nēé hī ka Umígidɔlu, mɛ́mla Umémfis, mɛ́mla Utapánhesi kahíníī, Aá tútū kú aá kpɛ́fú kú aá nya īyī aá tá, ohígbū ka ɛfú géē je odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ujohánan mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēé cɔ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ga ɛgiyí Ugɛdalíya Umíspa.

eng_Latn: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
idu_Latn: É gē bu aɔ́gɔ̄ kú oje ā ɛga nōo ligbó ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ lā ā. Ācɛ nēe ī ga iyāwu ā í kōō jé ɔwɛ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. É gē lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū uwā ohí ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā nyɔ̄ í bū oje ā á.

eng_Latn: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bī um wā í kɔkɔ kú um aflɛ́yí ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā gaá tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́, odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ kwu hē um tá. N ge gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō híī bī ɔ̄ lɛ kɛpɔ̄ tū uwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācoyɔ́dōbɔ̄bí ā géē yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ gaá kwu ā. Eko nyá nēé géē bá ī gwō ipú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé bá gē yá ā gaá kwu ā?.

eng_Latn: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
idu_Latn: Ó bī upíla le Agbla kú Aúpíla gwó. Olīkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofɛtá cigwɛ́hɔ̄, olɔwá kú nū kē wɛ ikpó ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄. Ó le áklɔ̄kpɛ gwó kwu ɔ́ iyɔ̄bū, le aúpíla kpó kwu ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ fīyɛ̄ klá aúpíla ā á.

eng_Latn: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
idu_Latn: Okwū kú anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ayípōklóbīya bá ipú úláyi gbɔnɔgbɔnɔ. Ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ aólɛla bī ɔkpacaŋgelī ŋmó ā. Á ményīnyi uwá ŋ́, a le uwá kpó ŋmó ɛ̄cī kú ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
idu_Latn: Ohí éyééye kú odúúdú īlī ā jōnjīlɛ, olīkpō kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa dúú.

eng_Latn: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔtū ō plicō kú uwɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́, ɔdí wɛ ile kú o yɔ̄ gē lɛ ɔtū plicō lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi āa?.

eng_Latn: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā kē he uwɔ ɔtū. A kē kwú ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ú kwu ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. A klla kē kwú ɔwɛ o yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔwɛ ō gwó ce ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa ú kwaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā ā bá ī cīlɛ̄fú tū aá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ágábá gē tōoji womwom kóō kwú ɛbɛ́. É kwú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá ú yíífi, klla kwú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú aá ú tá alácɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ nōo fíyɛ́ éyi kpó gwɛ́ɛya nɛɛ, ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nōo géē bá ɔ̄ iyē ā, géē wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áluka kú aɛ́bɛ́ ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ojīlīma ce ádā uwā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dóódu nēé í yá kóō le lɔhi lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú oyēeyī kú uwā kóō lɛ likpó ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujáfɛ̄ti ā wɛ Ugóma mɛ́mla Umágɔ̄g mɛ́mla Umadáyi mɛ́mla Ujáfan mɛ́mla Utúbal mɛ́mla Umessɛ́ki mɛ́mla Utíras. Uwá kē wɛ aádáádā kú aéwo nēe lé iyē uwā á.

eng_Latn: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
idu_Latn: Ulúkú, obócí nōo he alɔ ɔtū ā, hokónu tū aá, mɛ́mla Udɛ́masi dúú.

eng_Latn: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó igwóléyi ā le tá Ugálīli, ɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si cābɔ̄ lɛ uwá kéē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ cíkā le ɛdɔ ulé nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ka anúɔ géē tá Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ikpó gɔbū lígíī glá ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū nū yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í lɛ uwá kpó yíífi eko nɛ̄ ó ka ka anúɔ géē kpó uwā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
idu_Latn: Le ɔdā nōo wɛ ulé kú uwɔ ā ka gā um ká n̄ le cíla uwɔ.

eng_Latn: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄hi alɛwa, klla tū ɔcí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí tū ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
idu_Latn: Aákā ā bá ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́tángbédē ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwá klla lɛ akā ɔhá nēe hɛ́ uwá igbó áklō.

eng_Latn: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
idu_Latn: É le uwá ma igbɔhá! Ɛ̄nyā í ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā kú ɛcɛ nyā gē ma ɔyí ā ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū je uwá pīya ayí nū á.

eng_Latn: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhássum wɛ ofu igwóléyi ce ɛtá .

eng_Latn: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu ipú ajɛ ā, ācɛ géē bá ī yá ucē okpaakpa klla í bá ī kɛpɔ̄ kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, é gē hī abɔ́ɔ ka Upéresúsáa jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā. Udéfīdi kwú cɔ̄nū abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄hi ohígbū Úsaa nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é má ɔdā nēé leyīce nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka aɔ́kpá ā kwú ŋmó nɛ̄ uwá í má éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō bī īlī ŋmlɛ́ ŋmlɛ́ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ olɔhi le yíifa.

eng_Latn: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī le yá ɔdā dóódu á. Ó le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɛlā ā yá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujɛ́ta, ɔ́kplá kú nū ā kóō lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó á. Amáŋ ɔyí ā í pi ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá apɛ́ kóō ŋmó uwā glá ŋ́. Ó yɔ̄ gē yúúfi ohígbū koó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
idu_Latn: Ń cíkā ɔwɛ dúúmā lɛ odúúdú ogbonɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a mafú lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, okwutɛ kú um ōfōofūnū, nɛ̄ n bī hɛ́ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nyā igbó á. Abālɔbányā ā n le pīya ígwu ɛpa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
idu_Latn: Ó le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nyatá, klla le okónu ce mla uwá piyóó. Óndú tīihɔ, ó klla tūufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛ̄ ó pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ ó gē bīya ŋ́, dɛ̄gba tū ɔ̄ ipéyí odúúdú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci o hile, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ o hile kéē yúufi.

eng_Latn: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā nēe gē cikpɔ́nyā ā ŋ́, amáŋ ācoyúnwū ɔdā, ámāŋ ācowūwī ámāŋ ācɛ nēé ī pɛ̄cí ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka á túblá uwā ŋ́ kú aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ō ka ka aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛcɛ ā dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Ujɔ́ni háyi mla ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ábīja lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
idu_Latn: Aá gē gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ fíyɛ́ um á. Aá kē ī gbɛlá ka ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ā ɔ́ɔ mafú ka amíyɔ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá.

eng_Latn: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ugóolu kpó ŋmlá ŋmá odōngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, klla kwú kpó tū ɛhɔ̄ fu Usenakéribu.

eng_Latn: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi nōo gē tá ā. Ó géē wā kwūūū wā í ca klá ācobɔ́biipú ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄, nɛ̄ aá lɛyítáajɛ gā um nɛɛ, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá lé aɔ́dā olɔhi nēe í ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ̄ ā. Aábaná ā lɛ pɛ́ gekwú ŋmá agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Uféro mɛ́mla ipú ɔlɛ́ kú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olagbénú ā bā ī lɛ aóklóbīya ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ eko dóódu, amáŋ aóklóbīya lígíí nɛ̄ ogbɛhá lɛ ā, í kōō cɛ̄ yɔ̄ mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī lɛ īkpɛ̄yī olɔfú yá tá um ɛɛ́. Amáŋ abālɔbányā, aá kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔnyā ɛwū ámāŋ ɔnya álá wā gé lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne nōó bīya ā. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā Usámūwɛ̄lu gekwú ɛɛ́, odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ekwu kú nū yɔ̄ kwɛyí ɛɛ́. É klla kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi, ɔlɛ́ nū Uráma ɛɛ́. Usɔ́lu lɛ odúúdú ācogwɛ́bā mɛ́mla aɔ́hɛ ā kpó nū ŋmá ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú.

eng_Latn: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ gē pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tū. Ācɛnyā kē wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aá nēe ī gbō aá á. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, aótrɛ̄yí kú aá le aá bī bí ɛɛ́. É lɛ aá gbájí, nɛ̄ aá jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá gáā nyɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ojuju ká aá yá aɔ́mpa aá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Aá gwá ɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ucē nēe bá ā í he um ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ um bī ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā á. Ó lɛ um bī yɛ ga aɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ n má ka ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔhá yɔ̄ ɔ́kíkā dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú úklɔ́ kú Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla ɛma kú nū ā tá tū ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú Ussɛmáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɔkpá kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Íddo. Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla Ujérobōwam bá gē kpɛ́fú tá īyī uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē gɔ́ īlī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ce ɛyí ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā géē híla ŋmá ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla le híla fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le tá inu ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gāá lɛ ɔ́ má, nōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ hī ɔ̄ igwú wā ɛgiyí nū ŋ́, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí. Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ íne á. Ódúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ā jé íne ā. Ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē bī le yá íne nyā lé glá ā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le tá ɛgīyī ɔcɛ́, nōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ hī ɔ̄ ígwu ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ má klla le okwute ugóolu kú nū je gicō lɛ ɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ é gáā ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔyā éyi yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ í hī um igwú wā ɛgiyí nū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ abālɔbányā ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú alɔ í bɔ́há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ɛ́ɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī oyēeyī kú alɔ dóódu. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tútū lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ yá á.

eng_Latn: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
idu_Latn: Ó gē bī ɔ̄ okónu gbojī, í tíne ō mā ɔ̄ tá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔnyɛ kú nū kóō gbojī ipú okónu kú nū.

eng_Latn: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.
idu_Latn: N hííjémā nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je Usɔ́lu lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó bī ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n tū ɔ̄ ā yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Usámūwɛ̄lu le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikwū je klá Óndú ā otú gbó ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
idu_Latn: Igelī ā lɛ ɔ́gɔgɔ́ ɛnɛ nēe jōnjīlɛ̄ déyídéyí. Olɔwá mɛ́mla olīkpō kú nū jōnjīlɛ̄. Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bī ogbló nēé ī le miya odée ā lɛ ɔ́ miya. Olīkpō kú nū, olɔwá kú nū, mɛ́mla olicō kú nū wɛ ukilómīta úlā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;
idu_Latn: Igbómína ā le ɔkpá ā jé kwɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da Upɔlu ɛga nōó ŋmá āa. Eko nɛ̄ ó le jé ka ó ŋmá Usilísiya ā.

eng_Latn: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya yɛce ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla íne ō bīya kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Áhābu ā dúú. Ohígbū ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū Atálīya ā wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áhābu, ó kē klla wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yínɔ̄nyā kú Ómiri, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā nōo bī ɔ̄ ga ipú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
idu_Latn: Aá le jī ɛɛ́! Aá nēe gē hī ɔdōbɔ̄bí ka ɔdōōlɔhi, klla gē hī ɔdōōlɔhi ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Aá gē je ofíyajɛ pīya obū klla gē je obū pīya ofíyajɛ. Aá klla gē je ɔdā ohɔ́ɔnɔ ka ɔdā olɔnyɛ, klla gē je ɔdā olɔnyɛ ka ɔdā ohɔ́ɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan le ígwu kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya nēe bá Ugéba ā kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ Ufilístiya ohile ā le pó á. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɛhɔ̄ tū gā ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kéē lɛ opo kú ɛfú ō kpó tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācɛ Uhíburu kpó hīgwú wā í kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ tútū ō kwú ɛɛ́, ícɛ nyā nɛ̄ n le uwɔ má kē jé ka a yēeyī āa.

eng_Latn: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́mpa Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla aígbómína ā lɛ ojuju yá tɔ̄há le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu Udárīyɔ̄si, ɛyí kú uwɔ kóō tápátɛ̄cɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā yēeyī piyóó!.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, N le úklɔ́ éyi yá, ó kē le hɛ́ odúúdú aá idáagó.

eng_Latn: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔyá ɛhɔ̄, kú iháyí ɔ́migwáahāanɛ nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa cɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn, nōo klla ī nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā, le behé tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú bī ga ipú odúdɔlɛ̄ kú ogbla kú ɔlɛ́ Igbómína ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ohile nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā hīgwú á.

eng_Latn: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
idu_Latn: N pi uwɔ ahɔ̄ ka, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka á cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ ŋ́, n géē yá uwɔ italā o ŋmá lɛ ō tū ɔ́wá kú iju klá awɔ, aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Aíju géē tū ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mu. É klla í klá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ iyī aá tū cíí ŋmá ihɔtū kú ije ō yá. Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā kóō jɛ̄ aá eyī, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ka kahíníī, Ń gáā leyī gwū aá bónū ŋ́, ń kē gáā cīgbīhi kwu aá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛhīlī ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwo .

eng_Latn: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N gē kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ foóó ojigógó ipéeyī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ, n gē nwɛ̄lā ipú Agblīihɔ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi eko dóódu, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu dóódu gē jīla ā, ń ka ɔdā dúúmā otayínū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
idu_Latn: N jikwū gbōmgbōm klá Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō pó ɔkɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ɔ́dāŋ ka a tá ká anúɔ í jé ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gɛ ŋ́, a géē je mlanyī ɔdā nāa tɛtɛ jé ā.

eng_Latn: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
idu_Latn: Ussamúwa wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubíliga á. Ujehónātan wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussɛmáya á.

eng_Latn: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá kpɛ́m ā lɔhi. É cíkā ō tá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ miyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔ́dā dóódu ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unehemíya le ɔ́da je kahíníī, Aá lɛ odúúdú aókónɔɔwɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó gwu ŋmá ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Usábāti ā jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú nū. É klla gāá nwūla ɔwɛ ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Usábāti le gla. N le ācɛ kú um ōhī kpó kwāajɛ, kéē má ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī bī ɔdā dúúmā wā gāá je lá ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm ɛ̄cī Usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ , oje udɔ, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ɔhá nōó kpó ŋmá Ɛ́dɔm, Umówābu, Ámɔn, Ufilístiya mɛ́mla Ámālɛ̄ki nōo yálé ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
idu_Latn: É ka ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu ɔ́ yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ oyēeyī ā pó ŋmá ipú ɔlá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá pó ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō klla yēeyī kpɔ́ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā le ɛlā ka gā um igbo ɔmpa ŋmá ɔkpáncō ka amíyɔ̄ɔ̄ híī je ɔdā nōó tīihɔ ŋ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le yá tīihɔ ka ɔdēlihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Umíka nōo yɔ̄ Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
idu_Latn: É gē ga ipú aúnóji mɛ́mla aúnóji kú ɔgɛ̄cɔ̄ otú kéē da aálekwū kú ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā ɔ̄kā. É gē lé ɛbɛ́ okóome, klla í mū enyɛ̄bɛ́ nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí ā.

eng_Latn: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé ményinyi oklóbīya uwā eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́, í lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ, eko nɛ̄ ó le cɔ̄nū, ó géē yá aɔ́cɛ́ lé ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́ssbɔn mɛ́mla Ujésa mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
idu_Latn: A kē jé odúúdú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā. Ó kōō ɛ̄nɛ̄ alɔ bīya tayínū ā, a kē jé dúú.

eng_Latn: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
idu_Latn: ajɛ le okónu nwūla, kwu Udátan ú mulɛ, kwú okónu ú klá tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Abiram.

eng_Latn: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yá ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛhíícō nōó géē pó ā, géē tū ɔ̄ ufi nɛ̄hi eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ó klla géē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi, klla í ŋmó ācɛ alɛwa bónū.

eng_Latn: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó má ije jɛ̄ nōó ī lá ajɛ ā cīgbīhi ŋ́, ó géē yɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nōo lá ā jāā gbéeko kú ajɛ ō je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū. É géē je ɔ́ cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ɔ̄bɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú isosō ú, ká aá lɛ ɔ́ wu oyí nōo yɔ̄ ocíbú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ nya ɔcí kú odūngwɔ̄wɛ mɛ́mla ɔcí kú ikpɛ̄yí okómpíinu kú inu kú ɔlɛ́ aá. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í gáā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā ŋ́ jāā gbó oŋmɔ́ci nū.

eng_Latn: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka, ɔyí ɔbá ɔca ā. Ó háyi abɔ́ɔ pīya ɔdɔ, ó lɛ eyī bū uwíndo, klla lɛ eyī bū ɛplá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é le ɔtulalī umuumu ā fú tū ɔlá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ā leyīkwu ugóolu , oje udɔ mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ōhī ā, jāā gbéeko nēé le iyó ā bī ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é gē da ācɛ ɔhá ka, Aá híī túblá alɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu alɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka alɔ tīihɔ fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu alɔ. Ɛlā kú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē wú um ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ódūdū gē pɛ́ ga ɔ̄cɛ ɛnwū ā. Ícɔ̄nū kú um lɛyíkwu uwá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī yi nōó gē nyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu wɛ éwo kú ācɛ nēé lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́, é í lɛ íjééyī dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
idu_Latn: N tíne ká aá jé kéē lɛ ɔyínɛ́ alɔ Utímōti hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō gā amānyā fíyaa, ami mɛ́mla anú géē wā gaá má aá.

eng_Latn: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá ī ga amu ga anú ipú ígbíli, í jé ɔwɛ nēé í yɛ ga igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā nēé géē nyɔ̄ í lā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le tá Ugálīli eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛpa ā yá kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubaal-Uhánan gekwú ā, Uhádādi le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū, iyē kú ɔlɛ́ nōó lā ā lé ka Upɔ́wu. Iyē kú ɔnyā nū lé ka Umehɛtábɛlu, ɔyínɔ̄nya kú Umatrédi, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umésāhabu.

eng_Latn: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, alɔ gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Óndú ā klla í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔ́. Alɔ klla gē hɔ́lá kwu ulámpu kú Óndú ā ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu. Alɔ gē yá ɔ̄dā nɛ̄ Óndú ā jé ɔ́da ka ālɔ̄ yá ā. Amáŋ awɔ ā, kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē gwō ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā má ā, amáŋ ń gáā bī iyī um gwō ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ɛga nɛ̄ n kwáahi ā ōfūnū.

eng_Latn: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń je oyēeyī kú um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó tīile ga um ŋ́ mā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ōfōōfūnū ā wɛ ka n̄ lɛ úklɔ́ nōo kwu um ɔtū ā yá kwɛyí cɛ́ɛ́ ká n klla le úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si je gā um ā yá kwɛyí, nōo wɛ úklɔ́ kú o tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ohígbū eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usénaa wɛ, úlā ahāanɛ ce ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī ce igwó.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, klla lɛ íne kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā tū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gēe yá kéē lɔfú fíyɛ́ aéwɔhá dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ālɔ̄ híīī yɔ̄ gbɔlā icííci bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā ŋ́, amáŋ ká alɔ leyī kwɛcɛ, kú ālɔ̄ klla bēē gbeyīgɔɔ.

eng_Latn: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ɛtá.

eng_Latn: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē cɔ̄nū í kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā. Ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ jé ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu é le jīla tū um bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nōo ī cēenyi ā, é le um gwōtū ŋmá ɔ́kíkā dóódu.

eng_Latn: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
idu_Latn: Lɛ otúta miya kwu ɔwɛ Ujerúsālɛm. Aá kwinya nyɔ̄ í tayínū abɔ́ɔ, aá kpó eko bónū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ī bī ámíyā mɛ́mla ífi nɛ̄hi wā ŋmá ɛhícō.

eng_Latn: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛpa kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā, Ɛ́lídādi mɛ́mla Umédādi klá ɔlɛ́, é ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋ́. Alelékwū ā gā ipú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā dúú ɔlɛ́ uwā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
idu_Latn: Óndú, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā kóō géē wā ipú okónu kú um, ka n̄ géē ka ɔ́ dúú ā, a le odúúdú nū jé gbojī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nāa klá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā, ɛhá wā í klá uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācohéjulúgwu gē ca ɔwɛ klá ɔ̄cɛ ā. Úkpa géē wā ī kwú uwɔ abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o kwāajɛ kéē mīyɛ odée ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ abɔ̄fú ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é ŋmó ayí kú Ukɔ́ra ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔ̄ce obɔ̄bíipú ā ahɔ̄ pi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā ŋ́ má, ó géē kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú iyī nū, amáŋ ā lɛ īyī uwɔ nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcányā, Atálīya le uya nɛ̄ ācogbāājɛ ā bá ī yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā pó á, anɔ́ɔ ó páápá le yɛ tá ɛga nɛ̄ ɛwa jīla bá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔdā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá ā pó ā, ó kwú īlī kú nū ú híla.

eng_Latn: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá uwɔ ā, géē hɛ́ aéwo alɛwa ɛ́nyɔ́, í yá uwā eyījii. Eko nɛ̄ n géē miya ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um kwu uwá ā, aɔ́cɛ́ géē hɛ́ gliíglií ipú ufi. Ɛ̄cī nēé í je uwɔ catāajɛ ā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā géē yɔ̄ ī yúufi kú oyēeyī kú nū.

eng_Latn: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
idu_Latn: É kwú ācɛ nēe bá ā ú háyi iyɔ̄bū ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú ga ipú ūpū nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɛnwú le tū tū ɔcí ɛbɛɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ń kōō gáā yēeyī gbojī ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, eyī nɛ̄ n kpóce Óndú ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá aá italā ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tíne ō cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ nū tayínū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu da ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, nōo gē leyīkwu awulú nɛ̄ ācɛ o gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā gē wiiyē ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā a kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú nū wɛ oje udɔ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄, īnyīlɛyí kú nū le gwā, klla lɛ sunúúú bɛ̄ɛka ɔtágláma ā.

eng_Latn: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
idu_Latn: Ń tínē ká aá lɛ ɔdā dóódu tá ɔtū kóō junwulu lɛ aá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōó lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́ gē lɛ ɔtū kú nū tá úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ohígbū koó dɔɔ̄kā ō yá kú ɔtū kóō he Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwā yɔ̄ ī pīya uwá tū, anɔ́ɔ é kē bá ipú abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá wā kú alɔ ga ojuju. Náaná nɛ̄ óbíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā le aá iyē bīyā dúúdú ā. N géē je yá aá ɛhi dúúdu, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú yá yēŋēē bɛ̄ɛka owú otutú ā.

eng_Latn: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, ayíka aólɛlā kú um kéē nū um inya, kéē lɛ um kwú. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ um daŋmó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú okwū kú um u tá ajɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
idu_Latn: Ussémāya kpó ācɛ ofigwó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛlísāfan wā.

eng_Latn: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah,
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́yɛlu kwú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugíbēyɔn í kwaajɛ anɔ́ɔ ó gaá má lā anú abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔnyā nū lé ka Umáaka.

eng_Latn: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a yá ɔdā alɛwa. Íjéeyī nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā nāa bī le yá uwā á. Ɛcɛ le mu mla ɔdā nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ gē tá igwú kú anúɔ eko dúú nɛ̄ anúɔ le ɔ́ hīgwú. Ó da Ujówābu ka anúɔ tíne ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ágábáidu Udéfīdi kwɛyí anúɔ gaá lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ lɛ anúɔ ka, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Ugéssɔ āa? Ka ɔ́ɔ í yɛ í lɔhi fíyɛ́ ka anúɔ klla abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi má. Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí kú nū lé nɛɛ, ɛ́mba ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gē má ācɛ nēé tōō lɔtūce ŋ́ ɔ́ɔmā, é gē tū um íwɔ́tū, ohígbū keé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
idu_Latn: É da ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ohígbū ɛlā nāa da alɔ ā yá nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ka alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ le pó ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, alɔ cɛ̄ ka anú wā í hɛ́ ɛcɛ tá ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka Óndú ā géē bī aéwɔhá wā í nuunu tá uwā ŋmá ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Aéwo nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ pó ucē kú uwā jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē wā fúuu bɛ̄ɛka ucē ō je ugwū ā gáā kpó uwā.

eng_Latn: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, alɔ tíne ká ā le jé ka, alɔ le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Ujúda, kéē má ké bá ī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄hi ā, mla ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, mla ígbɔ́ɔ́cí o kpó wu ipú ɔdɔ. É kē lɔtū tá úklɔ́ ā bá ī yá ɔ̄ diili gɔbū lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
idu_Latn: N géē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ alɛwa yíífi, nɛ̄ ɔfú kú uwā í mɛ. N géē je úgbɔ́ɔnya ō kpɛ́fú kú uwā mla ācɛ o pɛ́ uwā ā kpó yíífi. Aɔ́nya o kpɛfú ā géē kwú. Ācɛ nēe gē ce aɔ́nya ā géē kpó iyī ūwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā eko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā ó kahíníī, Á tíne ɛya ō gwó mɛ́mla ɛhi ŋ́, amáŋ a lɛ ɔkpíyē tútū gā um.

eng_Latn: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
idu_Latn: Ó le aíkpɛ́cí nɛ̄ ádā nū Uhɛsɛkíya ca tāajɛ ā túgwó kpɔ́. Ó klla le aéde ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í pā ɔwɔ nēé hī Ubáalu ā ma. Ó kē le ojibó kú ɔwɔ nɔ̄nya nēé hī ka Ássɛ̄ra ā ma ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm yá ā. Umanáse gē gbā aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ̄gbā dúú.

eng_Latn: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ nwū ayí uwā aíne ā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kɛlā nū eko dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cīce ɔlɛ́ uwā, ámāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī yāwu ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gwutá yɔ̄ ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ámāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā aá gáā da um ɔ̄kā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā ā, ó géē je lɛ aá ŋmá iyē kú um.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē yúúfi Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, kéē klla bī iyē kú nū ōfōōfūnū lɛ cokónu dóódu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aɔ́lá o fíyajɛ kéē má kwu ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛ̄cī mɛ́mla otú kɔ̄, ka uwā kéē wɛ ɔdā ō mafú kú ɛyɛ́ɛyɛyí kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú. É klla í cābɔ̄ kú eko kú iháyí.
