eng_Latn: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
idu_Latn: Aákpa kú ɔcɛ́ ofucɛnɛ ɔhá le hɔ́ɔgba tū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú aflɛ́yí ā biílí. Anyākwɔ́cɛ ofucɛnɛ nēe lɛ úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ wiyē klla lɛ ukata kú ugóolu kwɛyí ā cīīce ɛyí aákpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpɛmm.

eng_Latn: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
idu_Latn: N hī ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um igwú, amáŋ ó tá um ohi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ n kōō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō tū um abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umáta le ɛlā nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ Umerí ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā hīgwú gɛɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka tū ɔ̄ ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Itíca ā yɔ̄ amānyā. Ó ī hī uwɔ igwú.

eng_Latn: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the LORD hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlá kwu odúúdú íne nɛ̄ um bīya ā, ó klla le odúúdú ūwā gbō tɔ̄ɔ̄há. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pla um ɔkɔ, anɔ́ɔ ogbɛnú kú nū yɔ̄ gē pi um wāajɛ á. Óndú ā kwú um ú tū aólɛlā kú um abɔ̄, ń kē fū ūwā iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi ā wɛ: Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukɔháti mɛ́mla Umerári.

eng_Latn: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
idu_Latn: Ká ō miya úklɔ́ ímlɛ́ lɔɔlɔhi cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje udɔ lɛ yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
idu_Latn: Ó kéē tɛtɛ hī abɔ́ɔ ka ajɛ kú ācɛ Urefém, iyē kú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ lā abɔ́ɔ ā, amáŋ ācɛ Ámɔni gē hī ɔ̄ ka Usamsumím.

eng_Latn: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóram wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛpa ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ á, ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ahātá. Ikwū kú nū í kōō kwú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā iyē ŋ́. É kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi igelī kú Udéfīdi, amáŋ é nyi ɔ́ ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm í yēekwu kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔ́ bī gɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Má ɔkpáncō káā ká ā lɛ aínyílɔ́wɔ ā gba áluka. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a gbo uwá áluka glá. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē lɛwa lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́lá kú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī hɛ́ ɔ́lá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le ikpó ɔnyā ɔmáapú ádā nū ce, ó le uwéyī je lɛ ɔmáapú ádā nū ɛɛ́. Uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa géē móōwē kú nū. É gáā ma ɔyí ŋ́ gbóógbóō ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ń wā ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ká n̄ gaá yá ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
idu_Latn: Óndú leokónu ce lɛ Udéfīdi klla lɛ ɔkpā ce īyī uwɔ, nɛ̄ á gáā tá nyílá glá gbóógbóō ŋ́ kahíníī, N géē je ɔyí uwɔ éyi ce ɔcɛ́, kóō gbō ajɛ eko nāa gēkwú.

eng_Latn: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
idu_Latn: N lɛ agbénú, ojīlīmā mɛ́mla oōjɛ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujówābu da Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ka Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɛ́ɛ̄ nyīla lɛwa ɛga ofɛhɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ abālɔbányā ā. Ka ɔ́ɔ kē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā tū kóō lɛ ɔ́ má. Ó klla le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka amáŋ, ɔdí ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ágábáidu ɔ́ɔ tíne ō gbo ācɛ ā álūka ā?.

eng_Latn: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Ohi kú nū wɛ ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ce mla uwá, mɛ́mla ádáádā uwā eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā nyílá.

eng_Latn: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ó da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú úwā ā. Ó ka íne nēé bīya ā, ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ikpó gbāājɛ klla má gwōnū.

eng_Latn: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gáā gwó inu, ó gē má cīce cɛ́ɛ́ ó gē lɛ ɔdā nōó gáā ŋmó tū ɔ̄ ā jé gbɔbū, ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō le jé ɔ́dāŋ ka ije nōó lɛ ā gwó inu ā glá.

eng_Latn: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Utibɛ́riyɔ̄si wɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, Upɔ́ntíyɔ́si Upáyílēti wɛ igbómína kú Ujudíya ā, Uhérɔ̄du wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ugálīli, ɔyínɛ́ Uhɛ́rɔ̄du nɔ̄nyīlɔ, Ufílīpu kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ituréya mɛ́mla Utrakónītisi, Ulisánīyasi kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Abilíni ā.

eng_Latn: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nōo ī gbō uwā ā géē kpó iyó kú nū ce ɔkɔ ajɛ odobū, klla í kwu bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé géē bū tá ɔdɔ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó géē gbō eyī kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ ka ó má ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā géē nyɔ̄ í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā igbɛɛtá ipú iháyí ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā, eko kú Ucɛ kú Onyatá, ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē mɛ́mla eko kú ucɛ kú Aáklɔ́kpɛ. Ó ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ nōo í wā ā, ká ɔ́ɔ géē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā wā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ aɛ́cī ɔ́ɔmā yá mɛ, klla má gwutá igbɔhá ce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ, ɛ̄cī ofɛpa. A í yá ɔ́ɔmā ká ā móōwē kú ɛpɔ̄bí kú ācɛ Ujúda. Ɛ̄cī dóódu géē kwɛyí iháyí éyi.

eng_Latn: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ ōhī tū ɔdu, ó kē le ācɛ ɔhá tɛ́ɛhá. Ó lɛ ācɛ ōhī tū gicō, ó kē le ācɛ ɔhá tū wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
idu_Latn: Alɔ leyīce kú odée kóō lɔhi lɛ alɔ, amáŋ ɔdā dúú í lɔhi lɛ alɔ ŋ́. Alɔ bá ī leyīce kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo ī yá alɔ ā kóō mɛ. Amáŋ ikoko ɔ́ɔmā ɔdōōtūufi nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī yá alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā le yá ī yɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya oyɔlá mɛ́mla ákú ɛbɔ́ ɛyí ede ā lɛ ācɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū géē he um mla aá. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nōo cīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa ā, gē jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú obɔ̄bí ŋmá olɔhi.

eng_Latn: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá gē cɛ̄ glá ā, aá nōo ī cɛ̄tra iyí aá ā, amáŋ aá gē tíne kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū ā kóō cɛ̄tra aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ kú um ipú aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Úklɔ́ kú Apólɔsi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gē jɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla amɛ̄ɛna, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ɛna nēé he ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔdōlé ā ú kpó bá iyɔ̄bú uwā á. Anú abɔ̄yī nū je ɔdōlé ā lɛ uwá lé ɔkwu ɔcí ā á.

eng_Latn: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, á gáā bī uwɔ okwú ɛbéenyi le kwú íkwu glá ŋ́. Á bī ɔŋ́gbá ɔlamu le gbō ikwú okónu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
idu_Latn: N lɔfú da ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ klla gē gwō ā, kéē lɛ okónu klá cíí, ohígbū ka ɔdā dúúmā í tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā glá ŋ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ā nɛ̄ ó gē bī lɛ kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
idu_Latn: bá yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Óndú ā le héyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí. Ó lɛ iyīnū mafú lɛ Usáyímɔ̄ni ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dáŋ ka, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dúúmā nēe hile bá ɛga dúúmā kú ajɛ nyā cɛgbá ō tábɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē kwúcē nyɔ̄ nɛɛ, aóladógbe kú uwā gēe tá uwā abɔ̄. Ācɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā, gēe je ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, udɔ, iyó ɔhá, mla aɛ́bɛ́ ō bī iyó lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé klla géē je ɛhi o ŋmá ɔtū éekpó lɛ uwá kéē bī ga Agblīhɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ígwu dúúmā hile ipú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōó ga Umíspa ɛga nɛ̄ aá jīla Óndú ā ŋ́ mā āa? Ohígbū kéē le ɔkpá gbo ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ í nyɔ̄ Umíspa ŋ́, aá géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
idu_Latn: Íddo, Ugínnetōyi, Ábīja.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwɔ ú wu apɛ́. Ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī le ŋmó ācɛ ā, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nēé géē le ŋmó uwā á.

eng_Latn: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
idu_Latn: Aá yúufi Ɔwɔicō káā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Aá gwéeyē ká aá tú iyī aá wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛgahi kú uwɔ, a ce ɔnya nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú cɛ́ɛ́ kú eyīnyinyi mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kóō le yálé. Ɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a lɛ ā gē cɛ̄ gā awɔ yálé.

eng_Latn: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ujɔ́ni wā ɛgiyí aá í ma ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá í yá ɔdā olɔhi fú lɛ aá, aá cɛ̄ɛlā nū ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ odɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla aákwuna cɛ̄ɛlā nū. Eko nɛ̄ aá kōō lɛ ɛ̄nyā má nááná ā, aá pīyabɔ̄ gaá cɛ̄ɛlā nū ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
idu_Latn: Ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ ā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú ísu ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ɔ́mpa aá tū ɔlɛ́, aá híī ka iŋiŋi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzibah.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhɛfusíba.

eng_Latn: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɔ̄ŋcɛ́nyā ā jɔ̄ŋcɛ̄nyā nɛ̄hi klla lɔhi ō má eyī. Ó wɛ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jéejéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó lɛ tá obugā ā, le éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ tū ɔjá kú nū omōōmu, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ayí kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā mɛ́mla ákú ɛka nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbo mla aádā aá eko nōó da Ébrahām ka, O ŋmá lɛ īkpō kú uwɔ ā é géē hɔ́hā ce ipɔ́ɔma dóódu kú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā tū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú aíne kú nū lɛ ā. O gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cɛ̄ ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā nyā.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock is carried away captive.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá jāhɔ̄ ŋ́, n géē jikwū ipíípú tayīnū ohígbū obɔ́cɛ kú aá. N géē jikwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ agīje kú um kē í pɛ́ ohígbū ka é kwú ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ú kpó kwú ɔfiyɛ ga ajɛ ewɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa kwinya, amáŋ ɔyíkpó ɔhá ā le inya kwu le gwú Upíta, anɔ́ɔ ó le táajɛ únóji ā gbɔbū á.

eng_Latn: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā ā wɛ ɔdā nōo cɛ̄gbá íjéeyī. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo jɛ́yí odée kóō lɛ ɛyí álūka nōo kwɛyí kú iye kú ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mpa ā bllatɛ̄ɛcɛ kóō lɛ ɔ́ jé. Ohígbū ka álūka ā kwɛyí iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ. Áluka ā kē wɛ úlā ce ofigwahātá ce ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛ igbō lígíí bī gē lɛ aá. Ó géē je ɔfú lɛ aá kú aá yɛ gɔbū ipú iyāwu kú aá. Ojīlīmā nɛ̄ aá le ce um á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bū ce ɔlɛ́ um ā. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā.

eng_Latn: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kéē blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yá Udátān mɛ́mla Abíram, ayí kú Ɛlíyābu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā. Ó ka ipéyī odúúdú uwā, ajɛ ɔ́ɔ le okónu nwūla kwú uwā mɛ́mla aíkonó, aɔ́fiyɛ, aɛ́bɛ́, aáklɔ̄kpɛ mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwā ú kpó mlɛ.

eng_Latn: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: O ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi géē kwu ā, ajɛ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, ajɛ kú ācɛ Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú igelī ā, ajɛ ohile nōo wɛ ákú ɔcɛ́ ā. Ajɛ kú ɔcɛ́ ā géē gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Ó kē tá lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ga ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya ā.

eng_Latn: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
idu_Latn: N jikwū igbalɛwa ohígbū ācɛ nēe bā ipú unwalu ā. Ɔtū kē bīya ga um ohígbū aólɛhá.

eng_Latn: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ oyēeyī le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō má um tá cíí ohígbu ka oyēeyī kú um le kpií ā, ó kē lɛ ile tū um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child was young.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu amɛ̄ hɛ́, nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́ bī jɛ̄ yɛɛ ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ga Ussílo. Ó bī ɔbá ɛna kú iháyí ɛtá éyi, mla Okoolo kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā igwó, mla ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ kú ejé éyi. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Usámūwɛ̄lu, ɔyí nū ā ú ga agbla kú Ɔwɔicō Ussílo á.

eng_Latn: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayí nū ā í yɛ tá íkpa kú ádā uwā ŋ́. Eyī kú uwā kwu itene nēé géē lé ā ōfōōfūnū. É gē mīyɛ ómíci lé ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ, é klla ī hɛ́ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
idu_Latn: N̄ ka ɔ́ igbɔhá kpɔ́, n jé keé le ɔ̄cɛ ā nú gā Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ .

eng_Latn: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Ukéyīla géē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu anúɔ ɔkwu tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Usɔ́lu? Ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ géē wā ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ pó ā nɛɛ? Ó klla ba Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu kú ɔ̄ lɛ ohi tá anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Usɔ́lu géē wā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ó gē yɛce ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ obɔ̄bíipú gē nwū ɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē yá ucē kú ācɛ obīyíne ŋ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē yɛ̄ mla ācɛ nēe í yá Ɔwɔicō okónu ŋ́ mā, ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda géē pīyatɔ̄há wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ éwɔhá, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú ɛhícō ā. É géē wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā uwā ká o wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá jila lɔɔlɔhi, aá géē le kpaakpa ā? Aá géē plla Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē plla ācɛ ɔlamu ā glá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ um gwēyī lɛ ɛyí búkwu um kpɔ́, aólɛlā kú aá géē wā í kpó aá ŋmó. Ami, Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā nɛ̄ odúúdú alɔ, ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá ā lɔfú bī Alelékwū Ihɔ ékpó wā iyɔ̄bū Ádā alɔ nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā á.

eng_Latn: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nēé ma ipú ɛcɛ nyā á nɛɛ? É lɛ uwɔ ma gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá aɛ́fu á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, ɔdí wɛ ita nyā, nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛlu gē kwu ā ka, Eko yɔ̄ ī yɛ, ɛbɛ nēé má ā kē yɔ̄ ī je pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé tá iyē kú uwā klla gbo uwá áluka ígwíígwu ā wɛ úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛtá, ce úlā ofu cɛɛtá ce ofigwáahāapa ce igwó .

eng_Latn: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ odúúdú ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī pó ɛlā kú nū ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
idu_Latn: Odōbī oje kwɔhá ɛnɛ kwu ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ikpó kú utéblu ā. Oje ékpó nēé bī le yá uwā á.

eng_Latn: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É gwutá mla ɔnyā nóó. É gē lɛ iyī uwā yá tīihɔ, ó kōō eko nēé gē ga iyāwu ɔlamu icííci, bɛlɛntɛɛ eko nyā nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī ga iyāwu okwíyē ɛ́gɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ lé ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē miya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ wɛ úlā igwáahātá ce ofahāanɛ ce igwáahāapa. Ācogwííjē kú uwā, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, wɛ ofu igwó.

eng_Latn: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ɛpa le ɛlā nōó ka ā pó ā, anɔ́ɔ é le yɛce Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē yɛce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, ká ɛ̄ɛ klla lɛ aíne kú nū tū. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, kú ɛ́ɛ klla cɛ̄ɛla nū.

eng_Latn: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ italā yá ācɛ ɔlɛ nū ŋmá lɛ o je uwá kpó ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá. Ó lɛ owu okwɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nōo ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā tū gaá kwú uwā í kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtá nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ukénan dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́kɛma nɛ̄hi klla yɔ̄ á. Aádā alɔ í má ɔdōlé dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, n géē tū ɔkpɛtā klá ajɛ ā. Ó wɛ ɔkpɛtā kú ɔdōlé ámāŋ ka ákú ijēnyi o ŋmó uwā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē wɛ ɔkpɛtā kú ɛlā kú Óndú ā ō pó.

eng_Latn: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je owu kú um tá ipú aá, klla í je aá kpó héyī nɛ̄ aá í yēeyī. N kē í cɛ̄ lɛ aá wā ī lā ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī aá ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā aá géē jé ka n cokónu ka n géē yá ɛ̄nyā, ka n kē lɛ ɔ́ yá ɛɛ́. Ami Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔdā nēé bá gē ka ā jé, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bá gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu o ka ka aá lɛ igbo ŋ́ māā? Aá jé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ ámāŋ ka, aá jɛ́ɛyí nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá jé ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aóndú ā ahínyá, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ kú nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ká ɔcɛ́ yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū tū uwɔ, á cāŋjɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka o yɔ̄ cíí kú uwɔ iyɔ̄bū nū ā gē tá ɔ̄ ɔtū wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwolímanya yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄ɔlá wɛ̄ɛcɛ manya manya ŋmá akpa ɔcɛ́ ā. Akpáabana kē yɔ̄ ī gbo gblágádáá ŋmá anú dúú. Ɛmu ahāapa nēe wɛ aálelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā bá ī cɔ̄ɔlá iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi iháyí ofɛtá cigwó ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ italā yá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwá ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwá. N géē je Ubábīlɔn yíífi klla í je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
idu_Latn: Awɔ fíyɛ́ ádā alɔ Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo je obuga ā lɛ alɔ, nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú nū gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá anú ā á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī gwū ɔ́mpa aá ɔcí ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kē lɛ ɛlā lɛ mla ɔ́mpa nū kóō kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je yá aá ɛhi ā, aá je yá ɔ́mpa aá ɛhi ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
idu_Latn: Ɔmáapu ádā kú Usɔ́lu lɛ ɔ́ má mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ́ɛ nyɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá bá gē dɔɔ̄kā aíjakī ā, abɔ́ɔ aá í má uwā ŋ́ mā, aá le yɛ gāá má Usámūwɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
idu_Latn: Ussóbalu wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Álfan, Umánāhati, Ébalu, Ussɛ́fo mɛ́mla Ɔ́nam á.

eng_Latn: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
idu_Latn: Aá ācɛ o yá ucē obɔ̄bí, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá géē bá ī líla lɛ ā piyóó ā? Eko nyā nɛ̄ aá géē kllɔcɛ́ kú aá jé odée ā?.

eng_Latn: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
idu_Latn: Ó le okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā yá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ohígbū koó tōō lɛ ɔtū ce klla ī yíihɔtū tá uwā eko dóódu. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā, le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú gē yá aólɛlā kú nū lé lɛ ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɔ̄ gē da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī cíla ɔ́ ulé kú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu alɛwa nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó ŋmó ā ɛɛ́. Ussímēyi da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú ajɔɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ú lɛ ɔyí nū, Ábsālɔm ɛɛ́. Ó da ɔ́ ka ífi ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ̄ ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄coŋmɔ́ɔcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá ā kpó lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, hīgwú ka á má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā géē cɛ̄ uwɔ igwú. Ɛgiyí aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nyá nɛ̄ a géē nyɔ̄ kú otābɔ̄ āa?.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
idu_Latn: Ujonátan da ádā nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ó géē kwú ā? Ɔdí nɛ́ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō jé íjéeyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka agbénú nēé le tayínū tɛtɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohígbū ufi kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ gēdēē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā nɛ̄, Utatɛ́nāyi igbómína kú uwā mɛ́mla Ussita Ubosɛnáyi ɔ́mpa nū ā, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ā le pɛ́ wā Ujerúsālɛm gáā da uwá ɔ̄kā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ ɔ́ɔ je ɔ́da lɛ uwá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá gē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú klla ī kpó iyó kú nū tū ipú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le ɔ́bíipú bī tū ɔ́mpa nū, nōó gā iyɔ̄bū ede kú uwɔ, amānyā lɛ ɛka gbo.

eng_Latn: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ká eyī kóō nyā dúú ā, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
idu_Latn: Amɛ̄ kú aɛ́na mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú uwā gē lɛ enyāmɛ̄ nɛ̄hi. Aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ákú uwā. Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā nyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ kú Ujúdasi nōo yɔ̄ úláyi nēé hī ka Okpaakpa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Usɔ́lu, ɔ̄cɛ kú Utásɔsi. Ó yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē tū ācɛ okwébényi alɛwa ɛhɔ̄ wā ka e lɛ ācɛ a kpó. N klá i tū aófītɛ́ alɛwa ɛhɔ̄ wā kéē tá ɔtɛ́ ācɛ nēe ba ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ dóódu a.

eng_Latn: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɛyí ɔdā nāa yá nyā da uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ nēé tá ō lɛyítáajɛ kpɔ́, n géē je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā yíífi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je Ussílo yíífi ā. N klla géē yá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá ā géē bī iyē kú igelī nyā le tókónu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da Ujɛhóssāfāti kahíníī, Ń le da uwɔ koó géē mɛ́ɛbɛ olɔhi lɛyíkwu um ŋ́ ŋ̄? Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí kú um nōó gē má klla gē ka piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
idu_Latn: Uwá géē gwííjē kú ɛyíkwū lɛ aā: É kwú éwo olófu nɛ̄hi nyā ú kpó yíífi ɛɛ́, ísu kwú aúgbéényi kú nū ú kpó gwu nyɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ Utáya wɛ óndú kú ísu, klla í tū odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu ā ufi á.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, a géē lɛ́ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gē kwú gbɔbū lɛ eko kú nū.

eng_Latn: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í mɛ́ɛbɛ jāā ga aɛ́ga nɛ̄ ɛcɛ ŋmɛ́yí ā, klla ī má ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
idu_Latn: N géē tá ɔyí ɛtá wā abɔ́ɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄, n yɔ̄ ī tá ɔyí lɛ odée ā.

eng_Latn: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ klla kahíníī, N kwú ɔlɛ́ ɔkpáni uwɔ ú gā uwɔ. Klla kwú anyā kú ɔkpani uwɔ ú kpó bá uwɔ ɔtū. N klla kwú ɔlɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ú gā uwɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛ̄nyā í jē uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ, á géē yɛ í le da um ká n̄ le kpó blá ɔ́ gā uwɔ fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ le tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu, ɛga nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa yɔ̄ ā. Eko nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa lɛ ɔ́ má ŋmá ɛcɛɛcɛ ā, ó da Ugɛ́hási kahíníī, Má ɔnyā kú Ussúnɛm ā yɔ̄ í wā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɛwa ā kahíníī, Aá wā, bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mla ogbló gaá kwú um bɛ̄ɛka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ohéjulúgwu ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɔyā ɛtá nɛ̄ alɔ klá abɔ́ɔ ā, alɔ le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ipú úgbéenyi nōo ŋmá Alesáŋdrīya, nēé hī kahíníī, Áplɛ́ Aɔ́wɔ nōo klá ɔlíidɔ eko ofū dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí yɔ̄ ipú nū ā lɛ ómbli tá kwu uwá, ɔfú kú nū le fíyɛ́ ákú uwā. Ó lɛ uwá yálé, lɛ uwá tóhɛ́ɛwa klla lɛ uwá yágbe, anɔ́ɔ é le inya kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ aálelékwū ahāapa ɔhá nēe bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ kpó wā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ uwá le bēhé ga ipú ɔ̄cɛ ā gaá lā tɔ̄há abɔ́ɔ á. Āhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā le bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ āa. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó géē lɛ lɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí kú eko nyā dúú á.

eng_Latn: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Ása lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ubássa, ɔyí kú Ahíja kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Utɛ́sa iháyí ofu cɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Árādi nēe yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ kú Ukénan ā le pó ka ayí Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ bá ī wā.

eng_Latn: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
idu_Latn: Ipú ayípōklóbīya nēé fú ŋmá Ujúda ā wɛ Udánīyɛlu, Uhananíya, Umíssɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Asárīya.

eng_Latn: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū géē hi Óndú ā ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n bī omlede úlúúlā? Kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔgālā kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu úlá ofu cigwó? N̄ kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú um í gwɛ́ɛya kú n̄ lɛ gbɛfiyɛ kú íne nɛ̄ ami abɔ̄yī um bīya ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Usɛlófɛ̄hadi ɔyí kú Uhɛ́fa ā í lɛ ayí nɔ̄nyilɔ ŋ́, ayínɔ̄nyā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ó lɛ á. Iyē kú uwā wɛ, Umáhla, Unɔ́wa, Uhɔ́gila, Umílka mɛ́mla Utɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá ɔ̄cɛ nōo da ɔ́ ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ um ā? Ānyɛ kē wɛ ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam kahíníī, Wā, Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ, ká ā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n lɛ ō ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
idu_Latn: Ɛtɛ́ kú ɔmɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, é í je ɔ́ ca. Ógo kú ɔcí dóódu nōó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, é géē na ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú ipú ísu ā mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi oyēeyī ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā yá. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá nɛ̄hi kwu aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá nyā, n kē le má ka, odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ ojéeyi gē yá ā bá ipú abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ó kōō wɛ ihɔtū ámāŋ ka iwɔ́tū kú uwā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe í yɔ̄ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Le da ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn, Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā kú Umanásɛ ā, kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á. É mā ācɛ o hile tá Ussílo ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan. Anɔ́ɔ ē gbɔɔ́ ō ga ipú ajɛ kú uwā nōo yɔ̄ Ugílɛ̄di, nēé je lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū Umósīsi ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
idu_Latn: Aá da um ɛ́ɛ́, iní nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni bī íkwu nōo gē bī le yá ācɛ ubatísim ā ŋmá ā? Ikwu ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō kɛ̄ɛ ka ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
idu_Latn: Ó le Ubáalāt, ɛga nɛ̄ ó gē kpó iyó kú nū tū ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nōó gē kpó ɔnya mɛ́mla úgbɔ́nya mla ācɛ o ce ɔnya kú nū tū ā kpó tú gwó. Ó klla kē le odúúdú ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ó tíne ō gwó Ujerúsālɛm, Ulɛ́bānɔn mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ ɛga dóódu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ó gē gbō ā túgwó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó klla tá ɛlā kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu le ujɔ tū tū Ujóram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo yɔ̄ Ujɛ́siríil ā. Ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ í tá ágbe nɛ̄ ó lɛ ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú, nɛ̄ ó kpó tá ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya, Uhasɛ́lu,Urámɔtu ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā. Ó géē yá ācɛ nēe yá aá ōwē ā italā.

eng_Latn: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le inu ɔhá gwó nɛ̄ ó gē kpó īkpɔ̄dā, ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu kú nū tū ɔ̄. Ó klla le ɛga o kpó aɛ́na, aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú nū tū ā gwó dúú.

eng_Latn: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
idu_Latn: Aá habɔ̄ uwā tá cīī. É wɛ aópeyī nēe ī bī aópeyī jé ɔwɛ nɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka opeyī gē bī opeyī jé ɔwɛ, uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa géē gwōnū tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄.

eng_Latn: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
idu_Latn: Mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ó yúklɔ́ idáagó ɔpɛ́ kú Usóyan ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ ā gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔ́hí, anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ile kú ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
idu_Latn: Á híīī yúúfi ōwē nɛ̄ a gáā má ā ŋ́. Mɔ́ɔ̄, ebilíi géē kpó ācɛ ōhī kú aá tū ipú agbá o yá kóō jé á má, aá kéē í móōwē jāā ɛ̄cī igwó. Aá kpɔ́tūce um kpɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ keé kōō lɛ aá ŋmó ohígbū nū nááná, n kē í je oyēeyī lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé ī le kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yálé ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ géē yɔ̄ símm bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yēkwu ā. Ɔkpáncō í je dobū. Óndú ā, lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́. Ó kē gáā pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó le ɔtū kú nū ŋmó tá ɛɛ́, ó kē gáā cīgbīhi ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya nēé gwó kú íne kú Óndú ā nōó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā wɛ Ɛlísɔ, ɔyí kú Ussidéyu, ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n.

eng_Latn: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ Ébrahām le pīya bɛ̄ɛka okwū dúúdú ā, o ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, nēé ma ayí nēe lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō mla ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu, nɛ̄ ó tōō ka ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé ā, ó kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú aá géē yá ibīyājɛ tū um.

eng_Latn: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
idu_Latn: Ufi mɛ́mla ɔnɔ lɛ uwá kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɔmā gáā ma ɔyí ā.

eng_Latn: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka, Óndú, uwá abɔ̄yī uwā kē jé ka n ga ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ gaá kpó ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā tū agbá klla ké ŋmó uwā ijē dúú.

eng_Latn: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ kóō yɔ̄ mɛ́mla alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ mɛ́mla ádáádā alɔ ā. Óndú ā kóō híī je mlanyī alɔ ɛɛ́ nōó gē cīgbīhi kwu alɔ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpó nōo kwu um ɔtū ā wɛ o bī Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā tɔ́ɔna ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í pó iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, o yá ká um gwó ce ikpínu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá le táajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄nyā le yá ɔkwɛ̄yí, ohígbū ka ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ cē gwōnū klla le ɔ́ da ŋmó ikpó ɔwɛ kú ɔdōlé ā.

eng_Latn: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó lɛ eyī gwō aógbɛhá ā bónū ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ ó gē leyī gwó ōwē mɛ́mla ɔnɔ kú uwā bónū ŋ́. Ó gáā cīgbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́, amáŋ, ó gē tá uwā ohi, eko dúú nēé hī ɔ̄ igwū kú otábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
idu_Latn: É le pɛ́ ga Ugílgalu, anɔ́ɔ é klla kwú Usɔ́lu ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú uwā abɔ́ɔ, iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā ɛga otīīhɔ ā á. É le ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ gwo abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu mla ācɛ ā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ipéyī Ondú ā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ í lɛ ajɛ ā má jāā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Éssikɔ̄lu, amɛ́ŋ é le ācɛ ā ɔtū pīyeyī ŋmá ō nyɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, N géē je ajɛ kú Ukénan gā awɔ, kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó cɛgbá ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ igɛ́mɛ́nti, ó híī wɛ ohígbū italā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yá aá ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ka odo ká aá da aá ka aá kóō yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
idu_Latn: Usásáki ma ayí nēe bá ā: Ísspan, Éba, Éliyɛlu.

eng_Latn: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔyí ōbībá dúúmā ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ŋmá ayááyí ɔ́migwó kú ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í gaá wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
idu_Latn: Aá dɔɔ̄kā, é géē je lɛ aá. Aá tíne, aá géē pīyɛ. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔwɛ, é géē nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Woó, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a yá ɔnyā nyā ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā? Ɔnyā nyā húmáyī leyīkwu um á, a kē kwú ɔyí nū ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔcányā, Ufássiti, bī wā kú ɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōkwɛyí kú ɔcányā kú nū kwɛyí. Ó kóō gaá lɛ ɔhi kú nū mafú lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aúgbɔga nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ pūla wā ɔnū ucɛ ā. Ohígbū ka Ufássiti jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ eko éyi eko nɛ̄ Uhesekíya, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Umáyíka, ɔyí kú Umɔ́rēssɛt ka ɛbɛ tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó da odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je Usáyɔn wúlatāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í je ajɛ hɛ́hɔ̄ cɛ̄tla tāajɛ. Ka Ujerúsālɛm ɔ́ɔ klla í je yíífi í tīkwū bá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛyétutulu ā. Ó klla kú ɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɔ́ɔ kwu ā ɔ́ɔ í je mu ácí mla aɔ́cí bɛ̄ɛka ipú ūpū.

eng_Latn: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú uwɔ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege nōo ī fíyajɛ iyɔ̄bū um kóō bī n jé ɔwɛ ā. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ gā um má ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo húmáyī kɛlā mla um ā ɔ̄kā ká, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ajī nēe bá nyā wɛ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá um ohi kahíníī, É kwɛyí kú aéwo ɛnɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nēe je ācɛ kú Ujúda, Ísrɛ̄lu, mla Ujerúsālɛm pahīla klá ɛcɛ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdā nēe bā ā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, n géē yá aá italā. Abɔ̄ n kē tútū kú n̄ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā, aá le tútū kú aá leyī méyī mla um.

eng_Latn: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ācogbāálá ā kā ā le kpó hídáagó.

eng_Latn: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
idu_Latn: Ka lɛ ɔ́ ka ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ gē ka lɛ ɔ́ á. Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, awɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkwu, ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú ísu kú Unáyilu ā, n kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwɔ ɛɛ́. A ka ísu kú Unáyilu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú anúɔ, ka anúɔ yá ɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
idu_Latn: Óndu ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ á ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ ā kéē fīyégbúlú. Ó cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aúcɛ́rōbim, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ɛcɛ ī jīliyē.

eng_Latn: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bī ɔja nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ejé ɛpa mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna dóódu, ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi ce āyā kú ejé mɛ́mla omlede éyééye. Aá géē lɛ íne kú ɛya ō gwó kú ɛci aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ā tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le ayí kú Ulífāyi fu céé lɛ Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da uwá kahíníī, Ɛnɔ kwu icō nɛ̄hi kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, eko nēé ī tú aálá bá ā í yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, aá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó lɛ aálá ā gwá kú aá lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄ í lé ácí.

eng_Latn: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nɛ̄ n húmáyī, gboló ce uwɔ ŋmífī nēé ma um ā. Awɔ kē húmáyī gbō um ŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma um á. N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra awɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō wā í kwú um, anɔ́ɔ n má akpa kú ɔcɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi cīīce anú ipú ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā ŋmá Árōwɛ ga ajɛ Umínīti, aígelī nɛ̄hi ofú, jāā ga Ébɛ̄lu Ukeramím. Ācɛ nōó ŋmó ā wɛ ɛnɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ kú Ámɔn yálé á.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É je Ukédessi mɛ́mla Udábērati ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka.

eng_Latn: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī le ɔ̄kā da Ujísɔ̄si eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē wā í ce ɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā. Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē wā í cɔcɛ́ ā, í gáā lɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ í má gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ugóolu nōo gbɛnú dēē nwuné ā, le yá ɔdā o lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyó kú nū.

eng_Latn: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ dóódu nēe gáā kwú ā. Ń lɛ ɔfú dóódu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, ó lā iháyí úlā ce ɛtá ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le tá ɛgiyí Udátan mɛ́mla Abíram.

eng_Latn: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
idu_Latn: É gē wā í lā ce uwá ɛyí jāā gbéeko nēé kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé nyi ā í kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ, jāā ga Ugása. É gē kpó odúúdú aɛ́na, aálá, aíjakī kú uwā. É gáā mā ɔdā dúúmā tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
idu_Latn: N géē tíne aálá nēe gebí ā, í kpó aɛ́nɛ̄ e yɔ̄ ī bī ā kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́, í tá ágbe kú aɛ́nɛ̄ e lɛ ágbe ā, klla í nya aɛ́nɛ̄ e gē doōcē ā tá. Amáŋ aálá nēe jɔ̄kwū klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, n géē je uwá kpó ŋmó, ohígbū ka ami ā wɛ ogbálá nɛ̄ ō gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa á.

eng_Latn: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma, aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja, aígabɔ kú ɔlɔ́cɛ́ ka aá ɔ́ɔ klla géē je ɛhi ā ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā tū ɔ̄ɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú inīīcō kú nū, nōo kwu ajaajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā kwu eyī kú ɛháajɛ kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɛ éyi tá bū agidigbé ga inīīcō kú ɔtāhɛ̄ ā, ó klla tá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga inīīcō ɔ́mɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu lɛ Unatánīyɛ̄lu má. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ le ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi tá ɔkpá ohígbū nū ipú ɔkpá kú íne mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā má ɛɛ́, Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ kú Unásārēti, ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu ā.

eng_Latn: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
idu_Latn: Áta, Uhesekíya, Ássɔ.

eng_Latn: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
idu_Latn: N kē le tútū ō kɛlā nɛ̄ n bī ɔtū ā ga uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: N géē yá uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ olɔfú nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tōō ca ŋ́ mā. Ā híī yúufi uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē tū uwɔ ufi dúúmā ŋ́, nááná nēé wɛ ācɛ oyíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā.

eng_Latn: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ikwū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā wɛ ɔdāhá tū ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī yíífi tāajɛ ā. Amáŋ ó wɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ nēé yɔ̄ ī nyatá ā.

eng_Latn: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā géē kwúcē wā wɛɛlɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ācɛ í leyīce ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwī gē wā wɛɛlɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɔkpáncō géē bī tāajɛ mla uya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá géē je aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā kpó ja bónū, é klla í je kpó yíífi, anɔ́ɔ ɛcɛ mla aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú nū kpɛ́mm ā í kpó gblífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
idu_Latn: aíkókwū mɛ́mla aɔ́gbanjɛ̄, aócíbú kú ɔtulalī, mɛ́mla aócíbú ōbī le fɔ́ɔlá, mɛ́mla aɔ́gɔ̄ nēé ī le odūngwɔ́wɛ kú eyīpú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wu ā. Odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, oje ɔdɔ nōó bī le yá uwā á.

eng_Latn: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā da uwá kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā. É géē kpó ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā háyi piíí ā. É géē bī ɛcɔ̄ nyā mla iyī uwā jāā ga ɛga nɛ̄ aá gaá ce áklɔ̄kpɛ otú mā ā.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi, álá éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
idu_Latn: Umálikīja, onɔwá kú ugóolu ā ma ɔdɔ ce ɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā gaá kwu inu kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla inu kú ācɛ o tɔ́ɔ́hí nēe bá okónu ɔwɛ kú Umákījadi, ɛ̄nɛ̄ e kwu inu-icō kú ɛhícō kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɔ́kíkā kú ɔdɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla kɛlā kahíníī, Aá híī gbɛlá ka ɔfú kú Óndú ā le nyɛ́ ō nya aá tá ŋ́. Ámāŋ koó pāhɔ̄ lɔhi nōó gē pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā kóō wā í tá aá abɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
idu_Latn: Ó le um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú aólɛlā kú um ā, mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū um ā. Ohígbū keé kē le lɔfú ce um bá.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
idu_Latn: abālɔbányā n géē je agbá nōo tū uwɔ abɔ̄ ā wī hɛ̄ uwɔ abɔ̄ tá, klla í hɛ́ uwɔ tá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó he uwɔ ɔtū ō nyɔ̄ Ubábīlɔn mla um, a lɔfú wā glá. N kē í lɛ ɛlá kwu uwɔ lɔhi. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka á tíne ō wā mla um ŋ́, odúúdú ajɛ nyā tá ga uwɔ. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ a tíne ō nyɔ̄, aá lɔfú nyɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
idu_Latn: Óndú, yá ká n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú um dúúdú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwēyī kóō kwú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Áhābu lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔyí kú Ása kwu pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu Ɛ́dɔm. Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm nēe lā Utɛ́man ā í klla jéeyī gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe gē nwū uwá ɛlā ā, í klla da uwá ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, Udéfīdi da ɔnyā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ le unwalu je lɛ ɔ́, ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā bī wā gé lɛ anúɔ, anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kē í yá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ klla gáā junwalu lɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛ́futa lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó lɛ īlī kú nū híla bónū ipú ɔtūnōbí anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Kpáyi, adá um ee! A le um ɔtū bīya ɛɛ́. Ɔdíyá nōó géē wɛ awɔ géē je ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ɔnɔ nyā gā um āa? N le okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā ɛɛ́, n kē í yá ɔ̄ piíí.

eng_Latn: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
idu_Latn: Obadíya klla da ɔ́ kpɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ tíne kú anúɔ nyɔ̄ í da ɔ́ ka anú, Ɛláyíja ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ó doōcē, ó hile lígíí kóō gekwú. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ eyīnyinyi iyī nū má. Ó wɛ anú ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ó ményinyi um dúú, ó nya um tá ŋmá ɔtunōbí nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ okómpinu kú ɛhícō nōo bū ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā mīya.

eng_Latn: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu gē dɔɔ̄kā úklɔ́ ō hídáagó kóō wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ uwá ka olɛhɔ̄ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ugríisi gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā ijéeyi nōo í cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ nyā nɛ̄ aá géē yɔ̄ ī yá, í blatū aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá le gbō bá aá abɔ̄, ámāŋ ka údɔ̄bū kú aá ā. Ó géē tú aá ɛlá kwu ɔ́, kú aá jé aíne kú Óndú ā tɛ́ɛcɛ, kú aá klla kllɔcɛ́ nū, ohígbū ka Óndú ā bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, le kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: A í gwá ɔ̄ mɛ dúúdú, í ca ɔ̄, klla ī bī ācáŋjɔ̄ kú nū le fā iyī uwɔ amɛ̄. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aídɔ ā gebí tāajɛ, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɛ́fu ā mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le íne bīya nɛ̄ aá le jé, ācɛ ōhī kú aá nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō gē nā tɔ́ɔwɛ ā ká aá lɛ ɔ́ nā tɔ́ɔwɛ mla ɔtū ogbonɛnɛ. Aá kē leyī kwɛcɛ kú aá abɔ̄yī aá ká aá ga ipú ojámá kú íne ōbīya ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ūwā kwɔ́lá nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú útuló ā. É gē kpó aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ŋmó ipú ícɔ̄nū kú uwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ le aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kpó ŋmó éyééye. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī ma iyī nū fú Ussílo kpɔ́, ó klla kē yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu ā kpɔ́, ɛga nɛ̄ ó má ɔ̄ klla kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā. Eko dúú nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu le ɛlā ka, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē ī pó.

eng_Latn: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɛlā nyā, Ɔglɛ́ɛjí nōo nyī ikpɔ́da téété ā, kē í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ téété. Ɔglɛ́ɛjí nōo kē ī fú tāajɛ nwuné ā kē ī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nwuné nwuné.

eng_Latn: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
idu_Latn: O cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o yá ólɔhi gbɛfiyɛ ā í lɔhi ŋ́. O yá ācɛ olɔhi italā kú ɔdā nēé jé ikpónū ŋ́ mā, wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
idu_Latn: Aólɔdu gē bī agbénū kú uwā lɛ gbō iyī uwā ŋmá unwalu dóódu, amáŋ ɛhá gē je ogbɛhá yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohí kahíníī, Habɔ̄ aókwū tá kéē nyi aókwū kú uwā. Awɔ ā nyɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
idu_Latn: Je ōwē mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí lɛ ɔ́ kwiyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gwō ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, klla gwō ipú abahi ā. Ohígbū koó yɔ̄ ī da īyī nū piyóó ka, Ami cīīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú um yɔ̄ ī gbāajɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú íkwu yɔ̄ á! Ń wɛ ɔnyōkwū ŋ́, ń kē gáā jé ɔtūnōbí kú ɔnyōkwū gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ abɔ̄ je gicō lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛɛ, á géē yɛ í kwú yíífi dúúdú ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ ka aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
idu_Latn: Ɛcī éyi, ami nōo wɛ Isíkēlu ā, yājɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī ipú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wā gaá yājɛ iyɔbū um gē tíne ō jé olekwu kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n lɛ ā kpó lɛ ācogbɛhá, nɛ̄ n kwú iyē kú um í gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ bī ɔ́ɔmā gwō, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá í he um ɔtū ŋ́, ń lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú iyó kú ede ā kpó yá. Aíyó ā wɛ, ocíbú plákátá, usɔ́bɛ̄lu, aágá, ɔgbanjɛ̄, ɛtɛ́, ukɔ̄, aóflēnjē ō fú ɔlá tū ɔ̄. É yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋmá oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
idu_Latn: Éburɔn, Uréhobu, Uhámɔn mɛ́mla Ukóna jāā ga Usídɔn.

eng_Latn: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔwɔ ɔ́ gáā yā lɛ uwá ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kwú ŋmó gɔ́ɔ́yí bɛ̄ɛka oje ā.

eng_Latn: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nyɔ̄ gaá le ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tá lɛ ācɛ nēe gekwú āá. Ikwū kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ákú alɛɛcɛ o hile ā ŋmá lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē ka tū ācɛ ā nɛ̄ n. É tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ uwá, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lá ipú alelékwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā.

eng_Latn: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kpó aíyó ā ŋmá Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla Umówābu, mɛ́mla Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla Ufílīstiya mɛ́mla aóhī nōó kpó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Uhádādēsa ā.

eng_Latn: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jé ɛ̄cɔ̄bū kú īyī nū ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tū abɔ̄ dóódu ā yēeyī kpɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N le ācɛ éwo odunkwulu alɛwa kpó yíífi ɛɛ́. N le aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā kpó yíífi klla le igá olɔfú mɛ́mla aínɔ̄ɔda ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwā ca tāajɛ. N le yá kú aúláyi kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kóō má táncā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í hile anú ŋ́. Aígelī kú uwā le pīya alácɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Ujɛhóyācin, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyākim, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Ó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī á, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ awɔ nōo wɛ Ujɛhóyācin kōō wɛ ɔká kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ n le bá abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um nááná, n géē hɛ́ uwɔ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ tónū.

eng_Latn: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, eko nɛ̄ á ŋmá ɛfú kú Usɛye ā, eko nɛ̄ a bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā, ɛcɛ le jíliyē, ɔwɔ le yā ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Éŋkpɔ̄ le pɛ wā ajɛ ŋmá ojuuja ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán mīyɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā aá lɔfú pīyatɔ̄há mla um ipú unu nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē nu ohígbū ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ unu ɛdɔ ékpó nɛ̄ aá má um yɔ̄ gē nu eko nōo yɛ ŋmá igbīhi ā, nɛ̄ aá kē pó abālɔbányā ka n kē yɔ̄ gē nunu gɔbū kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē kpó aúgbɔ́ɔnyā o kpɛ́fú bónū ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu. N klla í kpó aɔ́nya o kpɛ́fú ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm bónū dúú. N géē kpó aɔ́tā ō bī kpɛ́fú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Ɔcɛ́ kú aá géē ka aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gwó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bá ɛbɔ́. Ó géē gbāajɛ ŋmá ísu éyi ga ísu ɔhá. Ó klla í gbāajɛ ŋmá Uyúfarétīisi ā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ kpátáá ā.

eng_Latn: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
idu_Latn: Ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā kóō wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kpa kú ɔwɔ ā. Ɛlā kú um kóō kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ébú ā ajɛ. Ɛlā kú um géē yā bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ nōo ī yā klá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo bū ŋmá ajɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā. Bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ nōo gē mí kɛ́tɛ́kɛ́tɛ́ klá ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá háyi igbīhi Ujísɔ̄si, ɛgiyí ikpó kú nū, ó gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ agīīje kú nū klá Ujísɔ̄si ikpó. Ó bī īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū le agīje ā nya ŋmá ɔ́ ikpó, ó le okónu kwu ɔ́ ikpó anɔ́ɔ ó le anɔ̄ ihiméle ā cē klá anú ikpó á.

eng_Latn: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛhīlī mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā wɛ ipú ajɛ kú uwā dúú. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ussahasúma mɛ́mla Ubɛti Ussémessi. Ɛjī kú uwā kú ɛhícō ā yɛ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛfu kú Utábɔ yɛ ga ísu kú Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: And the men did so; and took two milch kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:
idu_Latn: É le ɔdā nēé da uwá ā yá. É kwú úgbɔ́ɔya ú fúlá tū ogbló nōo wū aɛ́na ɛpa o bī ayí ɛpa ā ɔkɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le ayí uwā kpó ga ipú igá ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
idu_Latn: N géē bī Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔtā kú ícɔ́ɔ́ja ā, n géē bī Ísrɛ̄lu yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́yī ā. N géē bī ācɛ kú Usáyɔn yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā, kéē nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka igbɔhá kahíníī, N géē bī Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn wā í je agbénú kú Íjīpiti yíífi kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ái le bɛ̄cɛ wā í nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu inya. Ɔlɛ́ uwá má tá áncā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē gbō ɔlɛ́ uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācogbāājɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nēe cíkā ō pi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ahɔ̄ ā, le kpó peyī ɛɛ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ewō nōo cíkā ō bá gē gbāajɛ, amáŋ é gwutá ajɛ icííci nēé fɔnū glá ŋ́. É bá ī gbiyɔlā, bá ī nɔ̄na. Iyɔlā he uwá ɔtū fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka eko éyi, aɔ́cí ɔ́ɔ le túbá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ īyī uwā. É da ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ka anú géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū, ó ī gbō ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ga ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
idu_Latn: Ofúlɔ̄cī é le Ujísɔ̄si bī ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Ukayáfāsi gā ipú agbla kú Upɔ́ntīyɔsi Upáyílēti. É tíne kéē bēhé ga ipú agbla ā ŋ́ ohígbū kéē tíne ō lɛ iyī uwā tīihɔ, ō yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú lé ɔdōlé kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā.

eng_Latn: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā tá áncā klla le ŋmó klōklō. ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā kwú ŋmɔ́lá ɛɛ́. Ajɛ kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ussárɔn nōo lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā, kwú ŋmókókó bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā ɛɛ́. Ēpū kwu wúla wāajɛ ŋmá aɔ́cí ipú ajɛ kú Ubássan mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Ukámɛlu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le odúúdú ɛlā kú ijē ā kpó jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usɔ́ɔlu gā ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú. Ó lɛ īlī kú nū híla, klla lɛ ewo kpó klá ɛyí kóō mafú ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔtūnōbí. Eko nōó ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ā, ó gaá wúla klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū lɛ okónu hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá wɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá kú ācɛ kéē má aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá wɛ ācɛ olɔhi ā Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā á. Ohígbū ka aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ācɛ je kéē wɛ ɔdā otīile nɛ̄hi ā, í wɛ ɔdā dúú ipéyī Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ le jīla ɔɔ́pu kéē gbɛ́lākwu, nɛ̄ n gaá cīce.

eng_Latn: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
idu_Latn: É gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā, ŋmá unwalu kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú le tá ipú unwalu kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ n cokónu nū gā uwɔ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu ā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ nū éyi, Ɛ́sta, nɛ̄ iyē kú Uhíburu kú nū wɛ Uhadása ā, yɔ̄ pī ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Ɛ́sta lɔhi klla jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄hi. Eko nɛ̄ ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū le pɛ́ gekwú ā, Umɔ́dɛkāyi le ɔ́ fō klla lɛ ɔ́ bī jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔyī abɔ̄ īyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ú ce iyī nū ga ɔcóonyɔ́kpá ɛga nōó kwú ā, o yá kú ālɔ̄ le hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfú kú ínoōbīya, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā kú alɔ yɔ̄ ā. Abɔ̄ é kwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ú nyɔ́kpá ā, alɔ le lɔfú iyē ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwóléyi ā wɛ Usíyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a géē nyīla glá ɛjī kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɔ́kíkā dóódu. Ayí kú uwɔ géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú aéwɔhá, é klla géē wā í lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā nēe tá alácɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
idu_Latn: Igbɛtá, n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, kóō kwú ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má nyā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um!.

eng_Latn: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aínu kú ɔnɔ̄ mɛ́mla ákú eko ofū ā wúla tāajɛ. Aínu nɛ̄ aá bī ayīnu adāgbá le yá uwā ifa ā, géē wúla tāajɛ. É klla géē kpó aínu nɛ̄hi kú aá yíífi.

eng_Latn: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anú ɔ́ɔ bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ nēe tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ tá anúɔ, kwú anúɔ ú tá tónū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le aójibó mɛ́mla aɛ́cí kpó ma lɛ īyī nū, gbɔɔ́ ō pá ɛcí klla yɔ̄ í yá anúɔ cɔ̄nū á.

eng_Latn: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi hī Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ka Óndú. Ó lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyākim wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé je ɔ́ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwóléyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Usébīda, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Upedáya nōo ŋmá Urúma ā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
idu_Latn: A yɛ ga ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē pɛ́ ŋmá ipú ísu ā jéejéé ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? A lɛ ikpó bá ɔkɛklɛ kú ísu jéejéé ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí ā tóohi kahíníī, Ń gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ Igbīhāajɛ ó le ɔtū pīyabɔ̄ cɛ̄ le yɛ.

eng_Latn: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gē bu ɔ̄gɔ̄ tū ipú ɛcɔ̄ ā, é ī leyī tá ɛcɔ̄ dóódu kē ī pīyɛ ɔdā agbénú dúúmā.

eng_Latn: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta ka abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó kōō wɛ keé géē ŋmó um mla awɔ piíí, ń gáā híhó ka ń wɛ ɔyíkpó kú uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ayíkpó ohile ā kē lɛ ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā ka dúú.

eng_Latn: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbō alɔ, anú kē wɛ ɔcóhɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ á. Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ á, ó kē ī nya alɔ tá.

eng_Latn: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū klá Umósīsi kóō tá uwā abɔ̄. Umósīsi le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ā ge nyí á.

eng_Latn: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í jé ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū, ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú á, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
idu_Latn: A kwaajɛ lɔɔlɔhi kpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí alī ā, amɛ̄ kú uwɔ le mulómuló bɛ̄ɛka oōgwá kú ódó ā.
