idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá bá ī wā ajɛ wɔɔlɔ aɔ́kíkā kú uláyi dóódu kú igelī ā. É bá ajɛ gbɔnɔkɔ ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ abɔ̄ hɛ́ uwā iyē lɛ ā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄ɛnū nɛ̄ ukpá kú ofītɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā. Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, le cɔ̄nū da uwá yɔ̄ ī yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ nēe lé ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofigwó ā. É gba ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ áluka tū uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, é gaá lā Upúnɔn.

eng_Latn: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
idu_Latn: Ó tá um ohi kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, gbɔɔ́ ká ā nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ohígbū ka ɛlā nēe bá nyā géē wɛ ɔdā ō le tayínū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko oŋmɛ́yí ā gā ā.

eng_Latn: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce, yá nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā Umósīsi kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ɔyā ɛtá eko nēé le ɔ́ ma ā, ohígbū kéē má ka ɔyí ā héyīfuú, é yúufi ō tá íne nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ tū ā nyílá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gáā lɛ ɔcí obene fu ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gáā lɛ ɔ́ tāajɛ olɔhi ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē yɔ̄ eko dóódu, klla yɔ̄ ī yá ká ō jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ a géē le gbla um āa? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔhá klla yɔ̄ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā kɛ̄ɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki ká ɔ̄ jāhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ká, ɔ́ɔ kɛlā nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ ɔkpani.

eng_Latn: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔcányā Ufássiti yɔ̄ ī yá ucɛ lɛ ācɛnyā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ubɛsálɛ́lu, ɔyí kú Úri mɛ́mla ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Uhɔ́ɔ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā, yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́dā kéē yá ā á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, alɔ gē tá uwɔ ahínyá, alɔ klla ī cɛ̄tra iyē ōgbɔ̄ɔlá kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
idu_Latn: Ó klla ī háyi ɔwɛ, úláyi, ōlīhī mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu, gē gbēyī ācɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī óócí ká ā gáā jīla Uféro eyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā da ɔ̄ ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Uhíbru ā ka, lɛ ɛga je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā um.

eng_Latn: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, cɛ um ɛgbá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ́ ī ce ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ijényi le ɔ́ ŋmó táajɛ ɛgbá ā. Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē nyɔ̄ í gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ipéyī uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
idu_Latn: É gē pla aéwɔhá wā ɛyí ɛfu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, é gē gwɛ́ɛya okpaakpa ā abɔ́ɔ. É gē lɛ agbénú kú uwā ŋmá ísu mɛ́mla ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu.

eng_Latn: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām ma ayí ɛpa. Áyísīki mɛ́mla Íssmɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, blatū um lɛyíkwu ihɔtū nāa lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā, ohígbū ka awɔ nɛ̄ n lɔtūce á. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, nwū um ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔlɛ́ kú ɛgiyí ɛfu ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú uwā, nááná nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ipú ūpū. Ó klla da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ yá péee, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ í lā anú, o ŋmá ɛyí éyi ga ɛyí ɔhá. Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ ācɛ Ukénan ā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ā, nááná néē kōō lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya ōkpɛ́fú kú oje klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē pɛ́ ga abɔ́ɔ í bī ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī nyɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́. Ohígbū ka odúúdú ajɛ kwú mu ácí mɛ́mla ujē trúnyáá.

eng_Latn: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ugɛ́ssɔn.

eng_Latn: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
idu_Latn: Aódūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ nɛ̄ kwu okónu ísu ā le kpó nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ufi nɛ̄hi le mu ācɛ nēe bá ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā ipú á.

eng_Latn: For he found her in the field, and the betrothed damsel cried, and there was none to save her.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ā te ɔ̄yípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā ā hɛ́ bá ajɛ ipácí, nááná nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā dɛ̄gba kú otábɔ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Da aéwɔhá, ká ā klla da ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ka aólɛlā bá ī wā ŋmá ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛga oligbó ɛ́ɛ. Aólɛlā nyā í dɛ̄gba ogwú lɛyíkwu aígelī kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu nēe bā nyā wɛ anú, Ussámiyɛ Ujatɛ́ Usóko.

eng_Latn: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
idu_Latn: N kahíníī, Aá wɛ aɔ́wɔ, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aá wɛ ayī kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā lɔfú le ije nɛ̄hɛ́ tīkwū klá ajɛ gónóó bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ ā. Ó kóō lɔfú lɛ īlī alɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Amáŋ n géē mabɔ̄ ācɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó tá Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ nēé túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ubáalu ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ Ussɛlúmiyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Usuríssadāyi, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn.

eng_Latn: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umɛ́rība, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu táafú mla Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ó ma iyī nū fú lɛ uwá ka anúɔ tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
idu_Latn: Ā híī nyɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā ce ɔ́ bá ajɛ ŋ́, ámāŋ ká o nyɔ̄ í cīce ce ɔ́ bá ajɛ yɔ̄ ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá uwɔ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ádā nōo le hīlókplícī mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ nēé ma lɛ ɔ́ eko kú ókplícī kú nū. Ɔyínɛ́ kú ɔyí ā gekwú, anú ōfōōfūnū yēeyī ŋmá inu kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ó kē he ádā nū ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ he uwɔ ɔtū ayíka a lɔtūlé lɛ ɔ́, a kē í gbonɛnɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ he uwɔ ɔtū, á gáā má ɔ̄ ímálānyí ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ á gē gwō tá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu kahíníī, Má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú um, Ubílha yɔ̄ á, le gbo mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔyí éyi ma ga um, ká n lɛ ɔyí lɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ anú mɛ́mla ayí nū kéē le pé ga inu ɔlɛ́ uwā, kɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɛ gwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kɛ́ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō pīya anɔ̄ ā tū ipú aɔ́já, nēé ba ā. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔjá dúúmā nōo kwú mu, ɔ́ɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄ ú háyi ɛga ɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ kɛ́ɛ̄ kwú ɔjá ɔhá ú.

eng_Latn: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
idu_Latn: Á gē bī unwalu ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ wā í tū um iyē eko dóódu. Ɔnū kú uwɔ lɛyíkwu um ā yɔ̄ í nwunē tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ eko dóódu. Ā ī kpó unwalu wā gaá klá um bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nēe le mlɛ́nyɔ́ le tútū ō kpɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu wā ipú ajɛ nyā ā, a lɛ ācɛ nēe lā amānyā ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ klla kwú ajɛ nyā ú lɛ ayí kú Ébrahām, oklóbīya uwɔ kóō kwú pīya ákú uwā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛplá iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Udárīyɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya ā, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɔ́mɛhīlī ā, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Uhágāyi gé lɛ Userúbābɛlu, ɔyí kú Ussiyatīyɛlu, nōo wɛ igbómína kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Ujɛhósādāki, Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
idu_Latn: Lɛ úgbéenyi gbā lɛ īyī uwɔ, ŋmá ɔcí olɔfú. Lɛ aínu gwó tū ipú úgbéenyi ā. A géē ma unɛ plla eyīpú mɛ́mla eyīyɛ̄ce kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhússāyi le ɛlā nōó nwū Ábsālɔm mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu nwū ɔ̄ dúú ā kpó ka lɛ Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta ācogwɛ́ɛya ā á.

eng_Latn: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwá, nōo bī ɔkābɔ̄ olɔfú kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā, bīya. É gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū iyāwu nōo yɛ ga ɛgiyí Ujóram ā, Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi. Abɔ̄ Ahasíya yɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ujɛhóramā, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu kóō lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Áhābu ā kpó yíífi dúúdú ā, Ujéhu ɔyí kú Unímissi gā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le tá ipú igelī dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ abɔ́ɔ mīyɛ aá, aá klá ɔlɛ́ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā ōfōōfūnū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ āa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da je lɛ uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá ā géē bā í gwííjē hīla abɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá ā, Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda le yɛ nyɔ̄ í le Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má.

eng_Latn: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛlā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ka, ayíka ń yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka, éyi kú ācɛ kú uwɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔkā ka ɔwɔ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ lɔtū nyɔ̄ gaá kpó éwo éyi ŋmá ipú éwo ɔhá ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ uwá ajɛ kú Íjīpīti ā jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Ó ka ipéyī uwā cāā, ɔ́ɔ bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔfú iyē kú nū le yá ācɛ Íjīpiti ōwē nɛ̄hi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā ō hídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōtūufi nɛ̄hi nēe yá ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kéē yúúfi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá da iyī uwā kahíníī, Alɔ le ɔdā nōo kwu alɔ ɔtū ā yá ɛɛ́. Alɔ kē le ɔ́ ŋmó tāajɛ dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú nū lɛ ɔ́ má gē yāwu eyī ísu ā, ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Alelékwū nɛ.

eng_Latn: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówāsi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ā le ujɔ tū kéē kwú Usekariya ú ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔ́, kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó tá ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
idu_Latn: Ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ɔyí ā le kpó hídáagó, amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si pī uwá ahɔ̄ kéē híīī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá Ugádi ohi kahíníī, Áhingílí, otá ɔnyɛpa yɔ̄ á. Amáŋ ó he um ɔtū kú alɛɛcɛ kéē yá italā um ŋ́. Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nu kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yá um italā, ohígbū ka anú ā gē méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē nyɔ̄ gaá le ka lɛ ācɛ ohile ā, amáŋ é cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, N géē yá Ujerúsālɛm lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkókwū kú ejé ā. Éwo nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā géē gwá ejé ā ŋmá anú, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā. Eko nēé í cīíbɔm tū Ujerúsālɛm ā, nēé géē cīíbɔm tū Ujúda dúú á.

eng_Latn: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
idu_Latn: Aá kōō híī nyɔ̄ gaá ce igbodí igwu ŋmá ajɛ kú aá ŋ́. Aá híī nyɔ̄ gaá tú īkpō ufáyin kú aá bá ŋmá ɔcí ufáyin nɛ̄ aá glá ābɔ̄ nū yá ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Ohígbū koó wɛ iháyí kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ kú ajɛ ā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áluka kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyééye kú Ujékɔ̄pu lɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je iyē kú nū pīya Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn kē pó ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa yá ācɛ kú Ujérīko mɛ́mla Ái ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da Ítāyi, nēe wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá, nōo klla kwu ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē nyɔ̄ mla aá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í klá mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gbɛka gā um ā, é hɛ́ okwū ɔyí ɛna ɛpa, gaá yāwu yɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ āyā ɛpa ā. Ɛyí nū le ka n lɛ uwá yá bɛ̄ɛka ɛnā ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ́dāŋ ka é le ɛka ā nyílá. Ó lɛ ā odúúdú ācɛ nēe nyílá ɛka nēé gbo ga um, í yá ɔdā nēé ka ā ŋ́ mā, n géē yá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɛna nēé hɛ́ ɛpa, bū ɔtāhɛ̄ āyā ɛpa kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ ā í ga ɛgiyí ācɛ glá ā ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō í tū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ ŋ́ mā ā? Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ó wɛ ɔdōlɔhi nɛ̄hi ka ācɛ kéē bī ɔkōōlɔhi ā wā.

eng_Latn: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācokwɛyí ɔcɛ́ ā bá igelī nēé hī ka Usówan. Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kē yɛ jāā gajɛ igelī nēé hī ka Uhéns ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā géē je ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ka ācɛ o tīihɔ. Ohígbū keé gē gwɛ́ɛya gā um. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo je aá tīihɔ ā, n kē tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam ta ācɛ nɛ̄ Ubálāki tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ubálāki géē je inu kú nū gā um, nɛ̄ ó kōō wɛ o tū mu omōōmu mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu , ń gáā tá íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú um je gā um ā glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka o yá ɔ̄ nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ o yɛ́ɛ́bɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē hī aá ka ayí nū.

eng_Latn: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.
idu_Latn: Urútu klla da ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū ka Ubówāsi ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka ó cíkā kú anúɔ tá abɔ̄ áncā ga ɛgiyí ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá anúɔ, Unaómi ŋ́. Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fú īkpɔ̄dā ā lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
idu_Latn: É le Uculo kú iyē ō gwu mɛ́mla aúculo ɔhá dóódu nēé tá ipú íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā yá kwɛyí. Ācogwíijē mɛ́mla ācogbāajɛ kú okónɔɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kē le úklɔ́ kú uwā yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla Usólōmɔn, ɔyí nū je íne lɛyíkwu uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhárim ā wɛ, Ɛlíyēsa, Usssíja, Umálikīja, Ussɛmáya, Ussímēyɔn.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ īlī ō lɛ klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɛgɔ́ igwóléyi tá ŋmá ɔnwū kú ɛwū.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛyí ɔ̄na kú uwɔ á. Ābɔ̄ ɛtá kú ɔcí nɛ̄ a má ā wɛ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ, le Uréhābu bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Anú mɛ́mla ádā nū, ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú abɔ̄ kóō kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ícɔ̄nū kú um lɛyíkwu Ubábīlɔn, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó géē tá alácɛ̄, klla í yá ācɛ dóódu nōo gáā yɛ gla anú ā eyījii.

eng_Latn: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aígwu kú aínyankwūlūmī alɛwa nɛ̄hi géē wā ŋmá ajɛ Umídiya mɛ́mla ajɛ Ɛ́fa. É géē wā ŋmá ajɛ Ussɛ́ba dúú. É kē í kpó ugóolu mɛ́mla ɔtulalī nēé hī ka ufránkinsɛ̄nsi ā wā. Ācɛ í bá ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā kú aɔ́dā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
idu_Latn: Aálá mɛ́mla ɛna nɛ̄ alɔ géē kpó ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́ kóō jɛ̄ uwā áā, kɛ̄ɛ ka odúúdu ɛbéenyi kú ísu nɛ̄ alɔ géē túbá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ó géē jɛ̄ uwā ā a.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
idu_Latn: Ayí nāa ma gā um ā, a kwú uwá í kpó gwɛ́ɛya oōyɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɛcí. Ajā ōgbo kú uwɔ ā í wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí jɛ̄ uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɛ̄ í yá uce kú íla piíí, amáŋ itali ō gɔ́ ɔ̄ géē nwū ɔ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó géē yá ucē olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka anúɔ géē tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda iyē, í nuunu tá ūwā bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā. Ó ka anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ géē je uwá fā nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ í mā uwā tá bá ajɛ. Ó ka nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ uwá pi nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔ́ yɔ̄ nōo lɔfú nya uwá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, le tá okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá le eyī pīya klá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ɛgahi kú Óndú ā gaá klá iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
idu_Latn: Ássīdɔ̄du mɛ́mla Ugása mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā bá anú, jāā gaá kwu ɛjī kú Íjīpiti, okónu Ísu kú Umeditarénīya.

eng_Latn: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ okwū kú uwá le míya ce ɔ́, eko nēé gekwú ā, í wɛ ɔdēelihɔ. Ó kōō wɛ ɔcí, īlī, ɛcɔ̄, ámāŋ ka ɔdā dóódu. Aá géē je ɔ́ fenyi ipú éŋkpɔ̄, ó géē wɛ ɔdēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ kóō je pīya ɔdā ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔyí nū ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɛcí kú nū ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm. Ó gē yá imabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔhɛ. Ó klla gē nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛbā dúú. Ó le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, ɛ̄nyā cɛ̄ le Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ulé kú íne nēé bīya ā gbā ɛɛ́, Óndú ā í klla gáā mā alɔ tá ipú ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, Óndú ā géē yá Ɛ́dɔm italā piíí, ó géē ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ piíí.

eng_Latn: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ aɔ́kpani ɛpa ɛhɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ó géē yíhɔtū tá éyi fíyɛ́ ɔhá. Ó kē í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ éyi cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē leyī gwō ɔhá bónū. Aá gáā lɔfú cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ije ɛhɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, ajɛ kú Ujɔ́pa, ɔyíkpó ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi yɔ̄, nēé hī ka Utabíta, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū le ka Udɔ́kasi. Ó le odúúdú eko kú nū táajɛ yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā olɔhi klla yɔ̄ ī tá ācɛ ogbɛhá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ anyā nēe bá nyā ŋmá aéwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyíkwu uwā kahíníī, Áá híī lɛ anyā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́. Ohígbū nɛ̄ é géē je ɔtū kú aá pīya ga ɛgiyí aɔ́wɔ kú uwá. Amáŋ anyā aéwɔhá he Usólōmɔn ɔtū nɛ̄hi kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
idu_Latn: Iháyí ofɛpa, ɔtū le bīya gā um lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ n kahíníī, É wɛ ācɛ ō yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, é klla ī tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ujonátan da oklóbīya nōo gē bī iyɔ́fú kú nū ā ka aá le beé ga ádɛ́fú kú ācɛ Ufilístiya. Amáŋ, Ujonátan í ka lɛ ádā nū Usɔ́lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
idu_Latn: Uhábakūku da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā kpɔ́ ka, Óndú ā, o ŋmá ohútu ā, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō ō tīihɔ kú um, nōo yɔ̄ piyóó á. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um nōo ī gbō um ā, a lɛ ācɛ kú Ubálīlɔn fu, le uwá pīya ācɛ ólɔfú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá alɔ italā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cāŋjɛ ɔcɔɔ̄cī kéē kpɛ́fú tá igelī nɛ̄hi ā igbledū. Eko nɛ̄ Ugáálu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ gā ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó yá uwā ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú í kwu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ojuja ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē yúklɔ́ kú uwā gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō le mu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔcɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mā anúɔ tá ká anúɔ ga ɔlɛ́ gaá kwú ɛga nɛ̄ únóji kú aádā anúɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ anúɔ bá ā. Ó kwú ɔyí nū, Ucímham, í lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ gbā ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó ka ɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú. Ka ɔcɛ́ ká ɔ̄ yá ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
idu_Latn: Adá kú nū ā da ɔyínɛ́ nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ádā alɔ yɔ̄ ī je hīla ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī kē yɔ̄ ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā nōo géē wā í lɛ alɔ ɔnyā kú ālɔ̄ ma ayí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujósɛ̄fu ā kahíníī, N cɛ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo je íkókwū ā ōfōōfūnū géē je pīya ɔfiyɛ kú um á. Ācɛ ohile kú aá í lé ɛpɔ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Wā icō ɛfu ɛgiyí um, abɔ̄ a klá amānyā a, N géē kpó isiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ n tá aíne o bī lɛ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ukɔ́ tū ɔ̄ ā gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá géē yá iyī aá héyīfuú ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔhi ká aá cíkā o wɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ō wɛ ipú ɔtū ká aá, ɔhi nōó gē ceyī ŋ́ kú ucē olɔhi mɛ́mla ogbēyīcíí. Ɛdɔ ɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nyā gē jɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō eyī á.

eng_Latn: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Awɔ, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ebilíi, awɔ olɛlā kú ɔdā olɔhi ō yá dóódu, a le mu mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ ō plá dóódu ā, ā yɔ̄ gē ka ka ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄!.

eng_Latn: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá gē wɔ́tū ācɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ o cē ijáalí okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
idu_Latn: Aá gē kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā í wā í yɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ je īkpɔ̄dā kú alɔ lá āa? Eko nyá nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī usábāti, géē yɛ kú ālɔ̄ je īkpɔ̄dā kú alɔ lá āa? Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ okoolo ca píyɔ́kɔ̄piyɔkɔ̄ lígíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lé itene nwuné āa? Alɔ klla í hɛ́ ɔlá tū aódée kú alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ hɛ́ ācɛ lé.

eng_Latn: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō lɛ um nyatá ā, ń má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá um ohi ŋ́. N hīīgwú kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō tá um abɔ̄, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú um abālɔbányā wɛ ka Uféro kóō lɛ ɔ̄cojééyī nɛ̄hi éyi fu, kóō leyīkwu ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má okwū kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā bá okónu ísu ā bɛɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
idu_Latn: ákú ɛpɔ̄, é jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɛpɔ̄ nēé ī ka ā ŋ́ ohígbū kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū otrɛ̄yí kú ɛcɛ nyā kwɛyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo wɛ opeyi, nōó klla kɛlā glá ŋ́ ohígbū kóō lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí, bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá á. Ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá anɔ́ɔ odokónu ā gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā klla gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
idu_Latn: Woó Óndú, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á. N géē je ojīlīmā lɛ iyē kú uwɔ, klla í cɛ̄tra awɔ. Ohígbū ka a le ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄hi yá. Aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a miya ŋmá íkée, a kē lɛ uwá yá jīla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a miya lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ije nēé cē bá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ujísɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu. ā tá bá ɔcí ikpɛ̄yí kú nū.

eng_Latn: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā wɛ olíla, ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá ā wɛ ācojéeyī.

eng_Latn: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú aá da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ká ɔ̄ jɛ̄ ɔlá, ká ɔ̄ kē lɛ ɔdōlé má i lé lɛ ipú nū Amáŋ nōo kē je ɔdā nōo cɛgbá kú oyēeyī dúú lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ ɔdí wɛ ile kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔcí nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka okwutɛ ā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú bī le miya ɔdā glá ú ga um anɔ́ɔ é da um kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ká ā lɛ Agblīihɔ nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ede ō gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí nū ā kpó miya cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gbaálūka.

eng_Latn: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: É géē lé ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla igbō nēe hile ipú ómblí ā, okómpinū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ipéyī um.

eng_Latn: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ā bɛ́ɛ, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá ka amí ɔ́ɔ wɛ ā? Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu á.

eng_Latn: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aá géē yúklɔ́ á, amáŋ aá yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ eko nēé gē hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ámāŋ eko nēé gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Urútu tá ɔ̄ ohi da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́ɔ híī da anúɔ kā anúɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū ɔ̄ tá ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ ká anúɔ nyɔ̄ mla anú. Urútu da ɔ́ ka ɛga dúúmá nɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ dúú á. Ɛga dúúmā nɔ́ɔ géē lā ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē lā dúú á. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ á. Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɔ́ɔ kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ ipú nū, nēé lɛ ɛnwū bī wā, a géē tá. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwɔ, ēpū ohɔ́nɔ gē lɔnyɛ tū uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā.

eng_Latn: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔpɛ kú Uhínɔm ā, é lɛ ede eyī gwó, nēé hī ka Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú uwā ŋmó klla kpó uwā yi ɔlá le gwɛ́ɛya. Ń je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē yá ɛgɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛlā kú nū kōō ī hɛ́ wā ipú ɔtū kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām kwú ɛfú ō bī gwɛ́ɛya ā ú ce Áyísīki ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ anú abɔ̄yīnū kwú ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛ̄wā ú kpó bī abɔ̄ á. Abɔ̄ nēé bá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ tɔ́há ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Éhūdu gekwú ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu klla le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɛgiyí Óndú ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kɛ̄yi, n da aá ka, īkpō eyē éyi wɛ ékpónú ōfōōfū nū kpɔ́, ń táafú ŋ́, ayíka é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ga ipú ajɛ, nɛ̄ ó gekwú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ īkpō alɛwa yá wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Ananíyāsi mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū Usafíra kwú ɔdā agbénú éyi nēé lɛ ā ú lá.

eng_Latn: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú alɔ géē cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ga ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɔfú le pīya ācɛ ékpó, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ gē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ jé ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū lɛ ā. Alɔ géē je jɛ̄ ŋmɛ́yí ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā, alɔ klla í je pīya ijímkpa ɔwɛ dóódu bɛ̄ɛka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
idu_Latn: Ubénjamīn, Umállūci mɛ́mla Ussɛmárīya.

eng_Latn: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a táafú gbojī lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó wɛ áncā lɛ á. Ó kē lɔhi gā uwɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā gwó kwɛyí klla lɛ odúúdú úklɔ́ kú nū ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, bī ɔdā nāa má nyā ɔtū lɔɔlɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī kwucē ga okónu ísu ā á.

eng_Latn: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka oŋmɛ́yí kú uwā gā ɛɛ́. Ká n̄ géē bī íwɔ́tū kú um le yá uwā ɛlā nɛ̄hi. Ká n̄ klla géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā. N géē cíla aá ulé kú ucē ɛbí kú aá.

eng_Latn: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Udéfīdi hī ɔ̄ ka Óndú, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ nōó wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū gɛ.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ká ā gaá lɛ ádā uwɔ nyi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā gbo ɔkpá lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe bá nyā leyīkwu ijē ō gwó kú ahínyá ō tá Ɔwɔicō á: Ujessúwa, Ubinúwi, Ukadimíyɛlu, Userebíya, Ujúda mɛ́mla Umataníya.

eng_Latn: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
idu_Latn: Aá leyī yɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ nēe gē lé ɔdā nēé le gwɛ́ɛya ā, gē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan ma Umérībáálu, nōo wɛ ádā kú Umíka ā.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le tá Ukapánɔm ā, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ éyi wā abɔ̄ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
idu_Latn: Unábi, ɔyí kú Ufɔ́fisi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé gē yáŋmó ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā má, ɔtū géē he uwá, ɔtū kē í tú kwu ɔtū lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ipú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā géē gbɔɔ́ kéē nyɔ̄ ígwíígwu, mɛ́mla Ɛlísɔ, ɔyí kú Ussɛ́deyɔ nōo gē leyīkwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúú ī gē cɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ ká abɔ̄yī nū glá ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō gē bī tá ā, gē cɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ojuja, é kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne mla ɔ́da nɛ̄ ó je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ɔkpāncō ā, kóō lɛ pɛ́ tū ɛga ékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛga ohile ā kóo le ŋmó. Ó kē le yá lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
idu_Latn: A géē gɔ́ awulú otīihɔ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ Árɔ̄ni, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ jōklóbīya, kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ocɛ̄tra.

eng_Latn: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā í yá odúúdu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tíne ā nōó gē je ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí le ɔnyɔɔnyɛ á.

eng_Latn: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá nēe í lā gboce ipɔ́ɔma nyā ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi. Otrɛ̄yí kú uwā wɛ Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Uréwɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
idu_Latn: É kwu īyī uwā lɔfú ká, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í fū uwā hī īyī uwā tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ cíkā ō hɔ́ɔkɔ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá o ŋmá lɛ ɔdā olɔhi nēé gē yá ā. Ɛnya ā le kpaakpa lɛ ācɛnyā nēe hī iyi uwā ka ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í pó ɔkɛ̄lā kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā ɛyí ɔpu gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ī pó ɔkɔ ijē kú ayípōklóbīya ā gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu le ɔ́da je kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ubáalu ā tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ le ojīlīmā je lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛ̄cī kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ubáalu ā tū á.

eng_Latn: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
idu_Latn: N da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka é cɛ̄ ɛ́mba é lɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá ā gbā gā um. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ā ŋ́, kéē bī. Anɔ́ɔ é le īkpīje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu cigwó gbā gā um kóō wɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ um yá ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ipɔ́lɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū aá abɔ́ɔ ā. Abɔ̄ aá le bēhé ā, aá géē má ɔyí ijakī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ce jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā wū ajɛ. Aá lɛ ɔ́ wī cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɔ́ bī wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta yɔ̄ Ujɔ́pa ɛ̄cī alɛwa ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī iyē nū ka Usáyímɔ̄ni, oyúklɔ́ ɔkpɛ́bɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, nēé le ɛpɔ̄bí kú íne éyi kú Óndú ā nēé bīya ā lé, nēé jégēdē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king's word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa kahíníī, N cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú Ussádrāki, Uméssāki mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo nōo tū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū wā í lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nēe lɛ ɔtū ce ɔ́ ā hɛ́tá, klla le ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ pīya ɛflɛ́ɛfu ā. É kwú oyēeyī kú uwá ú lɛ ikwū, ikɔkɔ nēé géē gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā gwū Ɔwɔicō kú uwā tá ā.

eng_Latn: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ, ipú eyīnyinyi mɛ́mla olɔhi kú uwɔ ā, kwú yá ācɛ nēe bá ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú uwā dúúdú, amáŋ nēé le yēŋēē ŋ́ mā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
idu_Latn: Ó gē tá ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄ ā, ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú háyi ipú ofū nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó ī tū ā glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ŋmá ayááyí ga ayááyí á. É wɛ Ussutéla, Ubɛrédi, Utáhāti, Ɛléyāda, Utáhāti.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa gē jɛ̄ gɔbū bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí alī ā, é klla í jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ulōko ā.

eng_Latn: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá ka anúɔ í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ oyɛce um ŋ́ ipéyī ācɛ, n kē í tá ka ń jé ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ iyɔ̄bū aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ gekwú, ó klla géē kwúcē wā oyēeyī igbɔhá glá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ? Odúúdú eko kú úklɔ́ kú oyēeyī kú um ā, n géē gbéyī eko olɔhi fíyɛ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ unwalu kú um nyā géē mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Oholibáma le Ujéyuss, Ujálam mɛ́mla Ukóra kpó ma. É ma odúúdú ayí nēe bá ā lɛ Ísɔ ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da uwá ka é lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ímíyóŋjō ā. N géē kpó odúúdú uwá wā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
idu_Latn: Uhílkáya wɛ ɔyí kú Ussálum, Ussálum wɛ ɔyí kú Usádɔ̄ku, Usádɔ̄ku wɛ ɔyí kú Ahítūbu.

eng_Latn: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, odúúdú ɛ̄cī kú nū ā le mu mla ákanya mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí, klla mla íwɔ́tū. Otú nááná, ɔtū kú nū í mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā dúú ā wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da uwɔ ka, otú mā, ofíílí ká ɔbúgwū kóō í tōgwú, a géē híhó ka anúɔ í jé um ŋ igbo ɛtá.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú a klla kahíníī, N géē bī ɔcɛ́ nōo fíyɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá dóódu ā, Unebúkádinēsa ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā wā í kpɛ́fú tá Utáya. Ó géē wā ŋmá ɛhícō mla ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi, mla ɔnyɛ̄ɛfú mla úgbɔ́nya, mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mla óbō.

eng_Latn: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē yá aá ŋmó ā, nɛ̄ n géē je ōwē ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwá á. Ācɛ nēe gē kpó aá gwutá ajɛ, gē lɛ ikpó da aá igbīhi tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá wɛ úmúlá nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yɛ ɛyí nū ipú uláyi ā, nɛ̄ n gáā yá uwā ōwē ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
idu_Latn: É kwú oyēeyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ú lɛ aá, eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ pīyatɔhā lɔɔlɔhi mla anú. Anú ā cɛgbá fíyɛ́ aálelékwū nēe gē gbāājɛ nēe lɛ íkwu ā á.

eng_Latn: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo leyīkwu ɔlá, ga ŋmá ɛgiyí ede ā. Ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo bī ɛwa ocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ olulé abɔ̄ ā káhíníīī, Bī ɛ̄wā ocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ká ā lɛ aíkpɔ̄cí kú ɔcí ufáyin kú ɛcɛ ā kpó cē, ohígbū ka aíkpɔ̄cí ā le pīya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́futa, ícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔtū nɛ̄hi ā ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú akwuna éyi. Ugílɛ̄di, ádā nū.

eng_Latn: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
idu_Latn: Óndú, gbō um ŋmá ɔfú kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, nēe ī yá ojuju kéē hɛ́ um gwōnū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: A kē le okónu nāa ce lɛ ádā um, Udéfīdi ā tū. Óndú, ā le okónu ce, anɔ́ɔ a kē le ɔ́ yá pélúú ícɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
idu_Latn: Ɛji ā yɛ gaajɛ ga ɛháajɛ ɛfu nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ɔpɛ́ kú Urefém, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ā. Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ó yɛ ga ɛháajɛ bū ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm ga aɛ́fu o kwɔhá, nēe ga ɛháajɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla yɛ ga njɔlɔ kú Ɛnrójɛ́lu á.

eng_Latn: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá, aá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani ā gē cɛgbá uwā. Ó géē habɔ̄ uwā tá ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Uhesekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, Uhesekíya lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō, klla gbɔɔ́ ō tíne kóō gbo Óndú ā ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó klla yá uwā ífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka anúɔ géē yá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ Ujeremíya ŋmó, ayíka alɔ tíne ka ífi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī bī gé lɛ iyī alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
idu_Latn: Ó le iyíipú mɛ́mla aíklíkpó ā na, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó yɔlá tɔ̄há mɛ́mla aɔ́dā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ohile ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
idu_Latn: N le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā, n klla le íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ɔ́. N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, awɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á, a kē tūufi, alɔ lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ. A ī lɛ okónu nɛ̄ a ce ā tū piyóó. A klla í ma ihɔtū nōó gē mɛ ŋ́ fú lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ a he uwá ɔtū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe klla gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a ka ā.

eng_Latn: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ahātá kú ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Udáriyɔsi lé ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya ā, Óndú ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Usekaríya nōo wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Usekaríya wɛ ɔyí kú Uberékiya, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Íddo ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Usímēyi yá nyā pó ā.

eng_Latn: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu le odúúdú ācɛ Usamérīya kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā lígílígí, amáŋ ami ā gáā gbā Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā fíyɛ́ ɔcɛ́, Áhābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ úklɔ́ nēe bá ī yá ā bá yɔ̄ á. Kéē tá ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā abɔ̄, eko nēe ī gbɛ̄gbā, kéē leyīkwu eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ mɛ́mla eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē leyīkwu ɔdā otīihɔ dóódu a kéē híī je ɔ́ tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá Ukadiss Ubanéya kéē nyɔ̄ gāá mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ā, ó ka amáŋ ɛ́ɛ yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ́da ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē tɛ̄yíwāajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwó ɛfú tū ɛyí ede, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔlá hɛ́ kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ga ɛcɛ nyɔ̄ gaá plla aéwo nēe bá ɛbɛɛbɛ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ kpátá ā. É gē hī aéwo nēe bá nyā ka Ugɔ́gu mɛ́mla Umágɔ̄gu. Usétan géē tū uwa bá kéē gaá kpɛ́fú. Ācɛ okpɛ́fú ā géē lɛ ɛwa bɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da uwá ɔ̄kā igbɔhá kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā ā? Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ Unásārēti ā.

eng_Latn: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ í ka lɛ ɔ́ ā da Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā géē ka ā nwū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí, aá yúufi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔdōlé kú aá nōo yɔ̄ ipácí ā wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ cɔŋgɔdɔ́ɔ́, aɔ́cí kē bā ī gwá īkpō kú uwā, ɔcí kú ufígi mla ɔcí ufáyin kē í gwá ikpó nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
idu_Latn: Ufi nɛ̄hi le um kwú ohígbū ɔnū nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá ī fu um ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú bá ī lɛ abɔ̄ da um ɛyí tāajɛ ā. É le unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya kpó í klá um. É le cɔ̄nū mla um klla ī wɔ́tū um.

eng_Latn: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ aá ōfōōfūnū, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī hɔ́hā ce aá ohígbū nū ā? Ācobīyíne ā nááná kōō ī yá lɛ ā dúú!.

eng_Latn: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla kē kahíníī, N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá kwú, kóō lɛ ukpa jē lɛ uwá eko kú ucɛ kú uwā, kéē má gwōtū ukpa, kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ italā yá uwā.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi, ɔcɛ́ gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi Ujerúsālɛm, amáŋ, é nyi ɔ́ ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Uhesekíya le ɔcɛ́ lé kwu ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Mla odúúdú aɔ́dīifa lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya gē lɛ wiiye eko nēé gē yúklɔ́ ɛga otīihɔ ā. Aɔ́dōwiyē ō tīihɔ kú Árɔ̄ni ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ákú ayīnɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam lɛ īyī nū tú kwājɛ lɔɔlɔhi ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, anú mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ile dúúmā lɛ Ɔwɔicō glá ā? Kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo jéeyī nɛ̄hi nááná í tīile dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄ ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
idu_Latn: lɛyíkwu aɛ́cī ucɛ kú nū nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē tūbá kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nwūla nwula yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kóō lɛ aá má. Ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū ka aá le pó ka iyē í lɔfú lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ayīnu kú uwā kpó cē tū uwā okónu. Ɔwɔicō lɛ ayīnu kú uwā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ágábá ā ɔ́ɔmā kpó cē.

eng_Latn: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igelī ā nwūla, cɛ́ɛ́ ka éwo nōo ī yá ucē okpaakpa, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú nū kē háyi kpaakpa ā kéē le bēhé.

eng_Latn: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
idu_Latn: É jikwū klá ɛ́nɛ́ ūwā ohígbū ɔdā nēé í lé mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé í gwá. É bá ī wā ajɛ gblugudu ipú úláyi bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé le uwá yágbe ā. Cɛ́ɛ́, é gē kwú ɛmɛɛma tū ɛ́nɛ́ ūwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā ā má hāyi ɛcɛ ā, ihɔtū kú Ɛ́sta gā ɔtū kú nū bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ ó je okwutɛ kú ugóolu kú nū ā gicō lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta le bēhé wā inu gaá le abɔ̄ kwu ɛhícō kú okwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī miya abɔ̄yīnū ā gē lɛ ā, ó tɛtɛ lɛ ɔ́ miya táajɛ kéē géē je Ujísɔ̄si tū aá abɔ̄, aá géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācobīyíne kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō ka anúɔ géē je uwɔ fu ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā dúúdú. A géē kwú iháyí nyā piíí ā ohígbū ka a le da ācɛ kéē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔkpá ā hā, kwú ɔ̄ ú kwúcē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yúklɔ́ abɔ́ɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má cīce á. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā le eyī kpó gbā kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwa ohi kahíníī, Aá jé ŋmá ɔkpá ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá eko nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá ɔdōlé ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ í ŋmó anú mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá í je lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi ā géē ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú ajɛ ā í nwuné lɛ ā. Aípɔ́ɔma nēe nwuné géē kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe lɛwa, aípɔ́ɔma nēé lɛwa ŋ́, aá géē kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé lɛwa ŋ́ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le pó ka ayí kú Ulában ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ gē ka kahíníī, Ujékɔ̄pu le odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe wɛ ákú ádā alɔ ā kpó ɛɛ́. Odúúdú agbénū kú nū ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
idu_Latn: N géē wā ɛgiyí aá eko nɛ̄ n le yɛ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Umasɛdónīya. Ohígbū ka n le miya ka n géē bū Umasɛdónīya piíí.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yāwu okónu ísu kú Ugálīli ā, ó má ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa, Usáyímɔ̄ni nēé hī ka Upíta ā, mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū Ándru. É bá gē tá ɛ́yá kú uwā tū ipú enyi, ohígbū ka uwá wɛ ācokwɛ́béenyi.

eng_Latn: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
idu_Latn: géē mīyɛ ɔ́ nwuné cabá eko nōo yɔ̄ nyā. Ó géē mīyɛ ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā, aɛ́nɛ́, ayí mɛ́mla ajɛ nōó ī bī le hɛ́hɔ̄, ɛga ofɛhɔ̄ fíyɛ́. É géē yá ɔ̄ ŋmó dúú, amáŋ ó klla géē mīyɛ oyēeyī opiyóó. ipú ɛcɛ nōo géē wā ā.

eng_Latn: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔnwū kú ɛwū le ohí kú īlī igwóléyi ā tá, kóō lɛ pīya īlī ō lɛ klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ámāŋ ɔyí ádā uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ŋ́. É kōō bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ ɛga éékpó mɛ́mla awɔ ámāŋ keé bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ ɛga éékpó mɛ́mla uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔ́dáŋ ka, ó wɛ Ɔwɔicɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ géē yɔ̄ ī lé, klla ī gwá, klla yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
idu_Latn: É pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ujóssuwa, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Odúúdú ācɛ í gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka úlā ɛhɔ̄ ámāŋ úlā ahāapa ce ofigwó kéē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ái. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ móōwē ga abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ācɛ kú Ái ā í lɛ ɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
idu_Latn: Ó kē ī nwūla abɔ̄ lɛ ogbɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le má kēé le iyī uwā tú wāajɛ ɛɛ́ mā, ó klla da Ussémāya igbɔhá kahíníī, Ohígbū kēé le okónu cɛ̄ íne nēé bīya ɛɛ́ mā, ń gaá kpó uwā yíífi gɛ ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ Ussíssāki ɛfú kpó tá uwā, uwá géē hile kpɔ́. Ń gaá cɛ̄ odúúdú ícɔnū kú um klá Ujerúsālɛm ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā tá ohi kahíníī, Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā bá ī bī iyē kú um lɛ kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ń tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē je ɔ́da dúúmā lɛ uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē kɛlā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́. Ɛbɛ nēé má nēé gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔmā, í ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́. Ɛbɛ nēé má ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, é kē wɛ ɛlá ōgbo kú ɔtū kú uwá áncā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
idu_Latn: Obadáya, ɔyí kú Ussémāya nɛ̄ aádáádā nū wɛ Ugálalu mɛ́mla Ujɛdútɔn. Ubɛrekíya, ɔyí kú Ása, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ɛlkána nōo lā aípɔ́lɛ́ kú Unétōfa ā.

eng_Latn: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
idu_Latn: Aá tū iyī aá wāajɛ ɛháajɛ ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē je aá gicō ipú ojīlīmā eko nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ alɔ ká ka ɔfú o bī yá Ubatísim kú Ujɔ́ni ŋmá abɔ̄ alɛɛcɛ, ācɛ ā géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá alɔ ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā cɛ̄ ka Ujɔ́ni ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Usáyɔn. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔnyā, é lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē kú uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ Ubenáya, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gaá lɛ Ussímēyi ŋmó á. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ kú Usólōmɔn lɛ ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kwú lɔɔlɔhi á.

eng_Latn: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē okpaakpa ā gē nyɔ̄ ɔlékwu ɛbɔ́. É í lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ eko nēé gekwū.

eng_Latn: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
idu_Latn: Ó le apī hɛ́ igbīhāajɛ, kóō mafú ka Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ anú wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū kóō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō kōō hápī. Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām le lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádáádā kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nōó kē mīyɛ uwá wā ɛgiyí nū nááná nēé hápī ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá kú ɔyí ā le yá ā, nēé lɛ̄ ɔyípɛnɛ̄ńcɛ́ ā apī hɛ́ ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú hī Ujísɔ̄si, iyē nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ je kéē le ce ɔyí ā gbɔbū kéē yīīpú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄! N lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔhá lɛyí kwu itene īnyī nɛ̄ aá i lé mla oyī kú ācɛ nōo ī pɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ā.

eng_Latn: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ipú áluka kú ukpɛ̄ kú ācɛ ā, Umósīsi kwú éyi ú ŋmá ipú ofɛpa ce igwó kú ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla, aɛ́bɛ́ ú lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe gē leyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā, ó yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ kú iyē nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó je eyī gicō le Ébrahām mɛ́mla Ulásārɔ̄si má bá ɛga oligbó á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, N jé ka aá géē kwu ita nyā ga um, Obócí lɛ iyī uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛ́. Aá klla í da um kahíníī, Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ pó ka a yá Ukápānɔm ā yá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ amānyā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga Utekówa gaá le ɔnyā ojéeyī nɛ̄hi éyi bī ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á. Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā gā ā, ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ula yá bɔ̄ɔ̄dā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yēekwu ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kwú úwé ekwu í wiyē. Ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ anɔ̄ nya iyē ŋ́, ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ klla ī yá ɛyí kú nū ŋ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá bɔ̄ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yēekwu ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ Ubenáya, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í lɛ Adónīja ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Ó le úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya cíkā ō yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kpó lɛ uwá, ó klla lɛ ɔfú tū uwá iyē kéē lɛ úklɔ́ ā yá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā, aá géē je ɛ̄gbā kú aá lɛ Óndú ā dúú, ŋmá ipú odúúdu ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó, nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Aá géē je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú aá nyā lɛ Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ka ā, Eko nōó gicō ɛga olicō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ó lɛ ācɛ nēé kwú ā kpó nyɔ̄ mla iyī nū, ó kē kpó ɛhi lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá nyā le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Ujudíya mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá nēe yɛ abɔ́ɔ jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ipéyī nū ɔyā í fíyajɛ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́, nɛ̄ aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ā í le péee tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ ōfōōfū anúɔ géē bī unwalu kú īkpɛ́lā ō trá kú uwā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
idu_Latn: É da aá kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā gā, ācɛ o yá ācɛ ɛbɛ í hɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ācɛ nēe gē yɛce únwū obɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō á jé ŋ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ī jɛɛ́lɛ́ ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ka ā nɛɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā, ayíka ohígbū Ɔwɔicō nɛ n. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā ŋ́ ayíka ohígbū aá nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gaá le okwú kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, nōo ŋmá Ujúda ā má tá ɔwɛ á. Ijakī ā mɛ́mla ágábá ā kē háyi pī ɔ̄ kpɔ́. Ágábá ā í je okwú kú nū lé ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē je ijakī ā ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛnɛ ce ofɛpa ce igwó .

eng_Latn: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
idu_Latn: Ó ka aɔ́dōōbɔ̄bí dóódu nēe bá ā géē wā í yá uwā, klla géē bá mɛ́mla uwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú yíífi ŋmáajɛ, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē lɛ odúúdú íne kú nū ā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a gē yɛ ā, n yɔ̄ mɛ́mla awɔ. N klla lɛ odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ yálé ga awɔ. N klla géē yá ká ā lóofu nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá dúúmā í lɔfú yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā ōhídáagó nɛ̄ Umósīsi yá ipéyī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ áafú gbɔɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu éyi ohígbū iyē ōgwu.

eng_Latn: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
idu_Latn: Akpa nōo yɔ̄ nyā le úbɔ́ o lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ ga icō ɛhīlī. É klla le īkpɛ̄yí kú ɔbá ɛna ma kwu igbīhi akpa ā icō. Ó klla lɛ ɛga ōlɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ nēé yá ofu kú aágábá ɛpa háyi ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
idu_Latn: É jé ɔnɔ kú ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É kē lɔfú iyē, é klla dōōcē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́ um tá klla ī le ojīlīmā ce um á. Anú lɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo ī gbō um ŋmá ákanya á.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa ā. Aá gē pīya anyōkwū tū gē mīyɛ aɔ́lɛ́ kú anyōkwū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ olīgbō ajɛ kú aá mafú ka aá wɛ ācɛ olɔhi. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā italā nēé géē yá ā géē fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
idu_Latn: É ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, kpó aádáádā aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔfiyɛ ajɛ Íjīpiti á. É ka aá má aɔ́dā idáagó nōó yá ā. É klla ka ó le aá gbō ɛbɔ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ aá bū ipú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā ɛdɔ ékpó nɛ̄ ádā aá yá āa. Anɔ́ɔ uwá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ í wɛ ayí obībá ŋ́, alɔ lɛ Ádā éyi, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gāá lɛ ɔkpá-ōhātū éyi má ipú ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ekbatána ipú aɔ́lɛ́ ō kwúbɔ́há kú Umɛ́dīya ā. Eko nēé le ɔkpá ā nwūla ā, é má ka é tɔ́kpá ā ka.

eng_Latn: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ lɛ tá ajɛ ɛɛ́, ó kwú yá yēŋēē. Ó géē lé ɔdōlé otīihɔ, nōo wɛ ákú nū ā.

eng_Latn: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ̄kā ka, Ɔwɔicō tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛɛ? Ó lɔwɛ ŋ́! Ami abɔ̄yī um, n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ébrahām, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipu icō kú ācɛ Ujúda ā, n géē yá uwā italā. É tá ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē nwū uwā ā. É klla lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú um ŋ́. Aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā gē gbā ā, le uwá bī nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ kú ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umefíbōssɛ̄ti nōo wɛ oŋmíikpó ā má lā Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū koó gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
idu_Latn: Ācogwíijē bá iyɔ̄bū nū, ācɛ nēe ī gwō ɔdā ōbī gwíijē ā bá igbīhi, áncɛ́nyā nēe bá ī gwō ɔjá bá ɔtāhɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je aɛ́cí kú aá nɛ̄ aá ma oje nɛ̄hɛ́ plá uwá iyē ā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ aá ma oje ɔdɔ pla uwá iyē ā kpó bónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka īmū ā. Aá klla í dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá eyī um.

eng_Latn: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
idu_Latn: É yɛ í lɛ alɔ kpó nyɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ī cēnyi ī kpó ācɛ nyɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ í yɛ í klá alɔ dúúdú ipú ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kpɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ o cɔ̄ɔwɔ kú ɔ̄na nōo ka anúɔ lɛ ijáalí kú ɔdā ōhídáagó éyi nōo gáā yá, ɔ́ɔ lɔfú hɛ́bɛ̄ɛcɛ ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
idu_Latn: náaná, ɔtū í he um nɛ̄ n klla í gwéeyē, ohígbū ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō gē nya um tá á.

eng_Latn: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya éyi nēe hī ka Uyutíkɔ̄si yāajɛ uwíndo. Iyɔ̄lā kwú ɔ̄ ú lipú lipú, abɔ̄ Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gbojī ajɛ ā. eko nɛ̄ iyɔ̄lā le fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā, ó le míya wāajɛ ŋmá inīcō ɔ́mɛtá ā. Eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ajɛ ā ó gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cotɔ́ɔna éyi lɛ ɔna tá gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Odúúdú ācɛ, aéwo mɛ́mla ucē dóódu, é le ɔ́da je lɛ aá ka.

eng_Latn: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú ayípōklóbīya nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú aígbómína kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbɔbū ɛfú á, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā gbo ce uwá á.

eng_Latn: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá gē leyīkwu ɛcɛ gē gbeyī ka ajɛ kóō gbɔɔ́ ō dobū. Ó kwú īlī ú klá īyī nū eyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gaá má anúɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu-ce-igwáahāapa nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākin klá ajɛ éwɔhá abɔ̄fú ā, ífílīmɛródāki le ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn lé. Ó kwú gbonɛnɛ lɛ Ujɛhóyākin, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú hɛ́tá ŋmá agbá á.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Áhābu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Eko dúú nɛ̄ a bī iyē kú Óndú ā gē kɛlā gā um, ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ a í ka gā um á. Igbɛɛmulá nɛ̄ n cíkā ō da uwɔ ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā āa.

eng_Latn: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nēé bī ugóolu , udɔ, oje nɛ́hɛ̄ le yá uwā ā, wɛ aɔ́dā nēé kpó bá céé lɛ Óndú ā. É géē kpó uwā bá ipú ɛga o kpó agbénú kú Óndú tū ā.

eng_Latn: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú nōo yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ nyā, ofōōfūnū tá um abɔ̄ glá á.

eng_Latn: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā ā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ācɛ ā le ikwū je klá Uféro ohígbū ɔdōlé. Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔdā dóódu nōó ka lɛ aá, aá yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
