idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɛdɔ ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí dóódu le pllá ācɛ nēé géē je kpó yíífi piíí, ohígbū kéē tá ō mīyɛ ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē bī le nya uwá tá ā.

eng_Latn: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ bōōbū gāá lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ábuna ɔyí kú Únɛ́ɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū gē gbo piíí ā jé. É le Usɔ́lu má, kwú iyɔ̄lā ú gbo tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū. Ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔ̄ ā gwutá jīla anú tá biílí.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
idu_Latn: Umerári ɔyí ɔmɛɛtá kú Ulífāyi ā ma ayí ɛpa: Umáhli mɛ́mla Umússi, aɛ́nyā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó da Óndú ā ka, ā híī mīyɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā bī wā ā ŋ́. Ń yá ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwā ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n ge mīyɛ ijakī kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
idu_Latn: Amásīya, Ussíya, Ujótam.

eng_Latn: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
idu_Latn: Iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō nōo je oyēeyi lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu āa, mɛ́mla iyɔ̄bū Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o cɛ̄ ijáalí olɔhi iyɔ̄bū Upɔ́ntɔ̄si Upáyílēti ā, n je ɔ́da gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
idu_Latn: A má ɔdā alɛwa, amáŋ á lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́. A gē pó ɔdā alɛwa, amáŋ á lɛ ɔtū tá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú odúúdú ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā mɛ́mla ɛhi ɔhá ā ú kpó tū ipú inu ā. É kwú Ukónanīya, ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā ú kóō leyīkwu iyó ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔyínɛ́ nū nōo lé ka, Usiméyi kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ leyīkwu iyó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ géē bī jé ka alɔ le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ka aéwo alɛwa gwó, ikpɛ́lā kú aéwo nēe lɔfú nēe bá ɛga oligbó mɛ́mla ɛga nōo kwu ajaajɛ. É géē je ɔkpacaŋgelī kú uwā na ɛnū é klá í je óbō kú uwā na ɛ̄wā nēé gē bī lɛ hɛ́ ɔcí ā. Aéwo, í gáā kpɛ́fú tá iyī uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, odúúmā kú uwā í gáā kllɔcɛ́ ɛfú ō kpó ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nyā Áyísīki pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubiyɛlaháyírɔ̄yi anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lā Unégēbu á.

eng_Latn: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī ŋmá abɔ́ɔ bū ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō ā biílí ga okómpinu nōo pīyeyī kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. N má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ wulɛ́wulɛ́ bū āyā ɛháajɛ kú okómpinu ā.

eng_Latn: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ka aá gáā nyɔ̄ í kpó wā abɔ̄yī aá ŋmá ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ aá jé mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Amáŋ aá géē ma áluka kú ubulúkwu ékpó nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ gɛ ma ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
idu_Latn: N géē gwéeyē klla í gwíijē ohígbū ɔdā nāa yá ā. N géē gwíijē í cɛ̄tra awɔ Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā yɔ̄ ī gicō ā, Umánōwa mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī ga ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ódūdū ā.

eng_Latn: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
idu_Latn: Īlī nēé hi ijā tū ɔ̄, nɛ̄ n kpó gā uwɔ ɔ̄, a kwú ɔ u pīya klá aójībó ā, klla kwú anɔ̄ ólifu mɛ́mla ɔtulalī nɛ̄ n je gā uwɔ ā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
idu_Latn: Unáfutāli ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Ujásīyɛlu, Ugúni, Ujɛ́sa mɛ́mla Ussálum. É wɛ ayí kú Ubílha.

eng_Latn: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli gaá má ɔcí ufáyin ā, Ɔ́daŋ́ koó gbɔɔ́ ō héepu ɛɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ā gbɔɔ́ ō héepu dúú ɛɛ́. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n géē je ihɔtū kú um gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē tɔ́kpá nyā gē lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá Ɛ́fēsɔsi, nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā háyi kpaakpa ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má aɛ́na ahāapa, ojɔ̄kwū mlɔ́mlɔ́ ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ísu kú Unáyilu ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō lé ácí.

eng_Latn: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ a le ámú kú igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā, kpó tū ipú ógo oyígbō, kwú īlī ú kpó gbō uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó ce ɔkɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
idu_Latn: É géē wā ajɛ Usáyɔn bá ī gwéeyē. Ɔtū géē yɔ̄ ī he uwá piyóó. É í bá ī gwíijē klla bá ī tɔ́ɔga ohígbū éeyē, ohígbū ka ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla unwalu í klla gáā yá uwá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē gwéeyē ka aá mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ulodɛ́ba ā, nōo wɛ áncā ā , é klla ī ka kahíníī, Ɔfú kú abɔ̄ kú alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ bī le mīyɛ Ukaném lɛ iyī alɔ á ā.

eng_Latn: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe hile ā le yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu wā aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā da iyī uwā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya yá alɔ lé āa? Ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kwú ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú bī wā ŋmá Ussílo, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kóō géē nyɔ̄ mla alɔ, kóō lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla le ɛlā ka lɛ Ujeremíya ɛ̄cī ɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú odúúdú aɔ́wɔ kú aéwɔhá nēé lɛ ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dōplahɔ̄ nēé le playi uwá ahɔ̄ ā ú kpó lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kwú uwā í kpó tayínū ɔkwu ɔcí nēé hī ka óoku, nōo kwu Ussɛ́kɛm ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
idu_Latn: N géē yá aá ɛ̄nyā piíí, aá ācɛ ɔ́bíipú nēe le túbá lɛyíkwu um ā. Ipu ígbíli amānyā, éyééye kú aá géē kwú. Ami Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́mpa ā kwú ɔnyā nū ú ɔnyōkwū. Ó kē gekwú í ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
idu_Latn: ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le ikpokwú kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla Ujonátan, ɔyí nū kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujábessi ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di. Ācɛ Ujábesi ā kpó okwu Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla Ujonátan ā uwī ŋmá ɔɔ́pu kú Ubɛti Ussán. Abɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufílīstiya kpó uwá playicō, eko nēé ŋmó uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
idu_Latn: Uwá wɛ aódée pií nɛ̄ n má okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba aflɛ́yí ā á. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aɔ́dée nyā le fu ŋmá ajɛ ga ipú owu, gē yɛ.

eng_Latn: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka eko dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ igbō ā lé nɛ̄ aá klla lɛ ejé kú ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Óndú ā gwá, ayíka aá yɔ̄ ī yá kú ācɛ kéē jé ikwū kú Óndú ā jāā gbéeko nōó í wā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujafán wɛ Ɛlíssa, Utássissi, Ukítim mɛ́mla Urodaním.

eng_Latn: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: É da uwá kéē lɛ ɛdɔ ācɛ obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēe bá Ugíbɛ̄ya ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú ucē obɔ̄bí ā ú ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu. Amáŋ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā í lɛ ɛlá wu ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla Ujohánan ɔyí kú Ukaréya mɛ́mla Asárīya, ɔyí kú Uhosáya mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā, ŋmá ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ga ɛnɛ̄hi ā ga ɛgiyí Ujeremíya á.

eng_Latn: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
idu_Latn: Aá dɛ̄ íbá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá je ikwū kú ɔ̄cɛ ootá aá abɔ̄, aá, Odúúdú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ufilístiya a. Aá yá ufi, Ofulutu mla ojuja kpímm gēe wā ŋmá ɛhíícō í klá aá ɛɛ́. Uwá wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nɛ ɔ̄cɛ ooyá ufi dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā í ka ɛma kú uwá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jé ɔkwu kú ádā uwá gɛ ŋ́ dúú. É kōō je ɛga nɛ̄ ádā uwá tɛtɛ lā Ujerúsālɛm ā gɛ ŋ́ dúú, é wɛ Uhábáya mɛ́mla Uhákōsi mɛ́mla Ubasīláyi .

eng_Latn: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Umerí lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā kéē yá ā yá kwɛyí ā, é kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ uwá Unásārēti kú Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: And they all forsook him, and fled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ayíkpó ā lé pɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá, le pɛ́ kwu.

eng_Latn: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce ɔ́ ā kóō le lɔfú jāā gbó ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híīī lé ɛpɔ̄bí ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si géē kwúcē wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó yá ɔdā nēé ī tókónu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, okónu ō tá lɛ ɔ́ í gáā kwú ɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka aígbáanɔ nōo gē wu gla ɔcí nēé ce ɔ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka nyā yá kú ācɛ Ujíyu kéē tíne fíyɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ohígbū keé ka ó wɛ íne kú usábāti ōfūnū nɔ́ɔ bīya ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó kla hī Ɔwɔicō ka ádā nū. O ŋmá ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ gē je iyī nū jōnjīlɛ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um, ɔnya. Eko géē wā, nɛ̄ aá gáā gba Ádā ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ɛfu nyā ámāŋ ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
idu_Latn: Ɛnwú ō lé nɛ̄hi í lɔhi ŋ́, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ocɛ̄tra nɛ̄hi í lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, le jī ɛɛ́. É géē yá uwā ɔdā nēé yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
idu_Latn: Ayí obībá nēe ŋmá ɛgiyí anyā ɔhá ā í tīile lɛ uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
idu_Latn: É klla mīyɛ Ugása, Ásskɛ̄lɔn, Ékrɔn mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nōo yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ kéē gaá lɛ aéde kú ubáalu mɛ́mla aéde nēé gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ɛyí uwā ā kpó ca tāajɛ. É le aíkpékwūja mɛ́mla aójibó kú Ássɛ̄ra ā kpó gbā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ pīya úmúlá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú úmúlá ā ú mī klá ɛyí únóji kú ācɛ nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ géē jé ká ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ā. Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N le okónu tá lɛ Ukénan! Ó géē wɛ ɔfīyɛ kú ayínɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ igbómína, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ óndú ajɛ fu kú ō yá ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí italā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kē cɛ̄tra ācɛ o lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā.

eng_Latn: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ka n gē tíne ō mīyɛ ɛhi icííci ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā n tíne kéē lɛ itene kú aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yá ā ka tū ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō nɛ̄ ācɛ Ámɔn bī ā, n géē yá uwā italā piíí, ń gáā je uwā ɛhi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko nēé bá gē kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ugílɛ̄di, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ajɛ kú uwā kóō nwuné ā, é yá ucē ɔbíipú nɛ̄hi, é bī ɔkacaŋgelī le yíla anyā ō yīipú ipú tɛ́ɛcɛ icííci.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛ́mba ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú igelī ɔ́ɔmā ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n géē kɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋmá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á. Úklɔ́ ō hídáagó nyā í yá óócí.

eng_Latn: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ í kwú ɔ̄ ú, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá kwú īkpɛ̄yí āgā ā ú á.

eng_Latn: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
idu_Latn: Umérayɔtu wɛ ɔyí kú Userahíya, Userahíya wɛ ɔyí kú Ússi, Ússi wɛ ɔyí kú Ubúki.

eng_Latn: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā géē yá ɔ̄ lɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Īkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó úlā ce ofɛpa cigwó. Ɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Olicō kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they gathered together to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpeh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le jīla Umísipa, le éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ lɛ enyi fu ajɛ iyɔ̄bú Óndú ā, é klla le okónu gwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. É kahíníī, Alɔ le íne kú Óndú ā bīya ɛɛ́. Umísīpa abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu je ɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
idu_Latn: Usánbālati mɛ́mla Ugéshem le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ gaá jīla aá eyīpɔ́lɛ́ éyi kú ajɛ kú Óno. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ula kú uwā nēé gbō kéē géē yá um ɔdée.

eng_Latn: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ le ikpɛ́lā yá tū īyī ūwā ipácí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē kɔ̄ uwá ŋ́ mā, éyi kú uwā ɔ́ɔ le odée fíyɛ́ ɔ́mpānū le ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ nū lɔhi glá ŋ́, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ó gáā leyīkwu icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō lɔhi glá āa.

eng_Latn: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Aá géē pó uya ɛyí aɔ́cí kú Ubálsam ā bɛ̄ɛka ikpó kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ī nɔɔwɔ ā. Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ɔmā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tū uwá. Ohígbū ka n le yɛ gbɔbū lɛ aá ī nyɔ̄ í yá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufílīstiya lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó yíihɔtū tū um ŋ́, í gáā lɛ ɛlā kú um tū ŋ́. Ɛlā nɛ̄ aá kē pó ā, í wɛ ákú um ŋ́, amáŋ é ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā um nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka anúɔ lɔfú lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá éwo ɔ́ɔma yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā yálé, anɔ́ɔ é je ɛga lɛ anú mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kéē bá ɔkpáncō gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tíne kóō lɛ oyēeyī kú nū tū céé, í je ɔ́ bí. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nóō kwú oyēeyī kú í tónu ohígbū um géē pīyɛ̄ oyēeyī kú nū.

eng_Latn: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
idu_Latn: Náaná ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kwú ɛlā um í gwō, bá í lɛ ɔtulalī kwu ɔlá lɛ aɛ́cí nēé lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́ mā. É le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ nēé cíkā ō yɛ ā ɛɛ́. É yɛce ɔwɛ kú íkée ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó cílatū ŋ́ mā nēé gē yɛ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n le má ka, ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ fíyɛ́ o yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ klla má abahi kú úklɔ́ kú nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ á. Ɔ̄nyɛ klla géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlékwū wɛ̄ɛcɛ kóō má ɔdā nōo géē yá eko nɛ̄ ó gekwú ā?.

eng_Latn: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, ɔyí um, pó ɛlā kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē lɛ oyēeyī ōlīkpó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
idu_Latn: Úmósīsi da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kwú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je ajɛ kú uwā lɛ uwá í kpó yíífi. Igbīhi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ aígelī mɛ́mla aínu ɔlɛ́ uwá, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má lā anú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bī wā gé lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ikpō nū ce á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó mīyɛ aɔ́dōplayi ahɔ̄ ā, ŋmá abɔ̄ uwa. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ kpó ja tɔ̄há kwú ú yá ojibó kú ɛna ugóolu lɛ uwá á. Ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɔ kú alɔ, nōo gbō alɔ ŋmá Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ gā uwɔ klá Ukréti, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ aɔ́dā nōo lɔhi ŋ́ mā kpó yá lɔhi. Ká ā klla bī ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā lɛ fu anyākwɔ́cɛ kú icɔ́ɔci kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ákanya mɛ́mla unwalu alɛwa géē wā í klá uwá. Ó ka amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ géē gwíijē ā kpɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ géē cījáalí tū uwā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ kpó uwā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ cokónu ō je lɛ uwá ā, anúɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ gē gbɛlá ā.

eng_Latn: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ohi tá um, ohígbū ka a lɔhi, a kē ī yíihɔtū tá um eko dóódu. Le ohi tū um ohígbū ka a gē ményinyi um.

eng_Latn: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
idu_Latn: Uhúram bī okolo kú oje udɔ le aúpíla ɛpa ma. Olīkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofucahāapa, oyɛjīlanú tá koolo kú nū wɛ ikpó igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cɛ̄ ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū ɔ́mpā aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
idu_Latn: A géē je mlanyī unwalu kú uwɔ ā, bɛ̄ɛka énkpɔ̄ ɔkpá, nōo le pɛ́ wā í yɛ ɛ́ɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Job spake, and said,
idu_Latn: Á géē yɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ eyī kú ɛ̄cī nēé ma um ā nyā fúlufúlu ŋ́. Eyī yá um kú otú nɛ̄ ádā um je ɛ́nɛ́ um ipú kú um ā kó ō yɛ̄ í bī fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utáma tá klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ pi anúɔ abɔ̄fú cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ yá ɔdā uwēyī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu jéjeé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ híī yá ucē kú olíla ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
idu_Latn: Ń yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne mla ije nōo wɛ ákú um glá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a gē mímálānyī ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ íjɛ́ɛ́lā jé āa.

eng_Latn: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
idu_Latn: Alɔ híīī ka iŋini ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā ka anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú ikwū le uwá kpó ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Udéfīdi í tīcō ga ɔkpáncō ŋ́, amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū ka, Óndú ā da Óndú um ka, Cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um.

eng_Latn: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
idu_Latn: É le íkōtō ofɛpa ce igwó gɔ́ kwu ohí aflɛ́yí kú ígwu aflɛ́yí kú īlī ā, mɛ́mla íkōtō ofɛpa ce igwó nēe jɔ̄njīlɛ̄ mla ohí ámōōmɛ kú ígwu ɔ́mpa ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄, o ŋmá lɛ o bī anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ lɛ mī klá anú mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú yá tīihɔ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔdí wɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu, nōo wɛ ɔdāhá klla le mu mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá ā. Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ō yá ucē ɔ́bíipú bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōó gē gwá ā.

eng_Latn: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, nááná nɛ̄ ó bī ɔtūnōbí gé lɛ alɔ klla yá alɔ ōwē ā, ó géē ményinyi alɔ ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í cɔ̄nū mla uwá ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ le yá lɛ ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē cīgbīhi kwu uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ lɛ uwá kpó yíífi. Ó klla ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí alɛwa géē yá uwā. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gbɔɔ́ ō yá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē jé ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
idu_Latn: Ukɛ́dɛ̄mɔtu mɛ́mla Uméfāati.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄ kóō pó ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ gē ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ucē nyá nɛ̄ aá yá yɔ̄ ā? Aá jé ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ āyā kú um nyā lɛ ɔwɛ nōó gē bī lɛ jé ɔdā ō tayínū ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
idu_Latn: Aá bɔ́tū lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nɛ̄ n le anɔ̄ tū uwā ɛyí ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī jámá yá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
idu_Latn: É ma odúúdú ayí ɛhīlī ā lɛ Udéfīdi eko nōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Uhɛ́brɔn iháyí ahāapa ce ɔyā ɛhīlī ā. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
idu_Latn: A géē kpó odúúdú ɔdōlé nēe bá ā ce Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ a da uwá kéē kwú uwā ú kpó gā um bɛ̄ɛka ɛhi nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɛhi ɔhá tá.

eng_Latn: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
idu_Latn: Adá kú Uféro le ómbilí ā nwūla anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ má ipú nū á. Ɔyí ā yɔ̄ ī jīkwū, ó le tū ɔ̄ eyīnyinyi. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ éyi kú ayí kú ācɛ Uhíbru nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔkpá kú Ayisáya ú lɛ ɔ́ á. Ó lɛ ɔkpá ā nāndaa anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛga nēé tá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, aójéeyī kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe gē nwū uwɔ ɛlā a bá iní? Ekōōhī uwá gēe da uwɔ ojuju nɛ̄ Óndú ānɛ̄ onwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a lɛ, a ɛyí kwu Íjīpiti a.

eng_Latn: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
idu_Latn: Ń kpɔtūce agbénú jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ije wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbolócē á jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nōo ka ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔkpá kú nū nɛ̄ ó tá lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā á. Ó lɛ aɔ́dā nōo tōō jé ɛyī uwā ŋ́ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá ā, nɛ̄ aógwuda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé háyi kpaakpa ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, gē pīya ɛyí nū abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē pīya ɛga o hile kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ ā. Ɔdā nēé yá nyā géē cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kpó uwā yíífi ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
idu_Latn: Ɔnɔɔtū nēé bá ī yá ā cɛ̄ lɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú ā nyíla tū ipú ajɛ ā. Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā hile lɛ uwá ŋ́. Kwu agbénú, mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú uwá dúúmā í gáā hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ami kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ɔ́bíipú kú aá yá aá ɛhi á. N kē í yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n wɛ ā. Ń gáā bī ɔ́biipú kú aá ɔtū lɛyíkwu aá ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko géē wā nɛ̄ ācɛ í gáā bī um gbɛka ka amíyɔ̄ wɛ, Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā kpá ayí alɛwa lɛ uwá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aɛ́na ámāŋ aálá kú uwā ī nyīla ŋ́. Ó ka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā yá lɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ bá ɛhɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī gbō ɛ̄wɛ̄ igwu, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄wɛ̄ igwu kú um, cāŋjɛ háyicō kpaakpa, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄wɛ̄ igwu ká aá le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá, klla le túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ákú um á.

eng_Latn: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
idu_Latn: N géē tū Asírīya ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nēe ī yá ucē tú um ɔtū ŋ́, klla ī yá um cɔ̄nū ā. N tū ɔ̄ wā í wúla uwa tāajɛ, kóō klla kpó agbénú kú uwā wu klla wī uwā uwī. Ó géē yá ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē le ikpó da ɔtɔ úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
idu_Latn: Alɔ í dɔɔ̄kā kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō ŋmó úklɔ́ kú alɔ okónu ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ cēyītīkwū kú alɔ híīī lɛ ɔdā nōo ī hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ gwōnū tá ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā akwuna éyi nōo lā ipú igelī ɔ́ɔmā le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi éyi. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔjá kú ɔmɛ nɛ̄ anɔ̄ ihiméle yɔ̄ ipú ā ú wā.

eng_Latn: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
idu_Latn: Apa, ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú bī abɔ̄ lɛ kwú éyi kú uwā glá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ gē má uwā agbla kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nēe kē kpɔ́tūce lɔfú lɔfú ā cíkā ō tá ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ mā abɔ̄ ipú unwalu kú uwā. Ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā nōo í he iyī alɔ ɔtū ōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ igbō ā hɛ́ ɔgba ɛpa. Ɛhīlī kóō bá ɔgba éyi, ɛhīlī ɔhá kóō bá ɔgba ɔhá, ɛyí utébulu kú ugóolu abɔ̄ɔ̄bɔ̄yī nū nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔkɔ́kllɔtū kú omlede kú abɔ̄ ō cɛyí kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú gā um, kóō wɛ ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ɛhi ɔhá tá. Āyā kú ɛbɛ́ nyā géē wɛ ákú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
idu_Latn: Alɔ má agbá ā abɔ̄ ó le gwu lɔɔlɔhi ā, alɔ kē má ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔ̄ ā abɔ̄ é kē háyi pī ɔwɛ dóódu ā, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla ā, alɔ í má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ipú inu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
idu_Latn: Ussɛlá wɛ éyi kú ayí kú Ujúda. Ayí nu wɛ Éri nōo le igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Uléka kwaajɛ ā. Uláada nōo le igelī kú Umáréssa nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ o tá īlī nēé hī ka ulínin ā kwaajɛ á. É lā Ubɛti Ássbēya.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Kwú Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n ú, ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú kwɛyí uwɔ glá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ o ŋmá lɛ ɛdɔ ɛlā éékpó kú nū ɔ́ɔmā nōo lɛ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ nōo yɔ̄ abālɔbányā tū gē gbēyī ká ɔlá kóō je uwá kpó yíífi á. É yɔ̄ gē lɛ uwá tū gbō ɛ̄cī nēé géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nēé jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā. Ó klla géē kpó uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄, nōo yɔ̄ ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā mɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí ā ú tɔ́ɔkwu kú ēpū éyi.

eng_Latn: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe cɛ̄ aá úfu kpɛ́m, ipú iháyí nɛ̄ ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú aéfūma, kpó aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá lé ā, cīgbīhi lɛ aá. Ami tū aéfūma, o tómbli, aóbīya ɔdā mɛ́mla aóhɛ́ ɔdā lé, nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi kú um a ɛhɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́ aá á.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki le odúúdú ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ pi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū, é géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́cí nɛ̄ alɔ húmáyī pā ɛyí aɛ́fu ā mɛ́mla uya wōōō ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dúú. É tá alɔ abɔ̄ ɔwɛ dúúmā glá ŋ́. Awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, ōfōōfū uwɔ tá alɔ abɔ̄ glá á.

eng_Latn: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō gē fíyajɛ ŋmɛ́ɛ̄mm ŋmá Usáyɔn igelī nɛ̄hi olɔhi kú nū ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū nɛ̄ ó yá iyī nū yēŋēē ŋ́, géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ, ohígbū ka é tá éŋkpɔ̄ kú oōyá yēŋēē ā klá anú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā tēelihɔ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó klá gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā bī ɔcúújē lɛ ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́ yá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ í wu ɔ́ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é kwú awulú kú ɔgalúlā bllábllá ú klá anú iyē á.

eng_Latn: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, é kwú Ujóna ú tá ga éŋkpɔ̄ ipú ísu á, anɔ́ɔ ísu á í tá úgbagwú gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni le ɛya kú iyē ō gwu kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā mɛ́mla ɛga ohile kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā gwó kwɛyí ā, ó géē bī opī oyēeyī nēé je lɛ Asásɛ̄lu ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ obū pīya klá īyī nū juuu bɛ̄ɛka áklɔ̄kpɛ. Ɔwɔ le tū kpúmm klá ɔ̄ nōo tōō má ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwúcē ŋmó oōnū Udéfīdi inya á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ nyɔ̄ kóō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya á. Má ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nēé gē hī abɔ́ɔ ka, Ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ɛga nɛ́ é kwu ŋmá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé kwú um ú héyī, n géē ga Ugálīli gbɔbū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ alelékwū mɛ́mla ɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ákú Ɛláyíja, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā. Ó géē wā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā wā ā. Ó géē ka aádā gwó mɛ́mla ayí uwā kpɔ́. Ó géē yá kú ācɛ nēé géē lɛyítāajɛ lɛ aíne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ká gbɔɔ́ ō lɛyítāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ okpaakpa ā. Ó géē lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu lɛ iyī nū ā tútū gbēyī eko nōó í wā ā.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da aícɔ́ɔja ā kahíníī, Aɔ́fiyɛ nɛ̄ aá kwú ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī bī uwā wā amānyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ le ɔ́bíipu bī tū Óndú ā jɛ̄ nōo cíkā ō yá alɔ italā dúú. Aá klla bá ī yá ɔdā nōo géē yá ká alɔ lé ɛpɔ̄bí tū ɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō yá kú Ujáfɛ̄ti kóō nyīla. Ipɔ́ɔma kú nū kóō lā ɔlɛ́ Ussɛ́m. Ukénan géē wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú Ujáfɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Unówa kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla odúúdú aɔ́dā oyēēyī, nēe lā ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta wā í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, igbɛmulá nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ géē yá um obɔ̄bí kwu nɛ̄ um géē jé yá ɔ́ ɛhi ā? Igbo ahāapa kɛ̄ɛ.

eng_Latn: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ Ugíbēyɔn, Uráma, Ubérɔtu.

eng_Latn: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō ī ményinyi alɔ nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ néē tá ɔ̄ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka Ɔwɔicō gē bɛ́yíkwu ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ, amáŋ ó ge ményinyi ācɛ nēe tá iyī uwā wāajɛ āá.

eng_Latn: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdā ajɛ kú aá dóódu. Aá abɔ̄yī aá géē je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ nū wā í gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alɔ nēe wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwɔ ā bá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ amānyā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
idu_Latn: Aúpíla ɛpa kú oje udɔ ā, éyééye kú nū olicō kú nū wɛ ɔkɛkɛ́ abɔ̄ igwáahātá. Olɔwá kú nū wɛ ɔkɛkɛ́ abɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū kē wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ kú Igbō Ánūŋ mā ā, ɛplá nēé gē ŋmó omlede kú onyatá, ā, ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka iní nɔ́ɔ tíne ká aá tútu lɛ ɔ́ kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā?.

eng_Latn: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
idu_Latn: Anú jíjééyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú ipú ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔmā kpɛ́mm á. Anú jíjééyī fíyɛ́ Étan, ɔ̄cɛ Ésrah mɛ́mla Uhɛ́mān, Ukálkolu mɛ́mla Udáda, ayí kú Umáhɔlu á. Ācɛ kú ɛga dóódu mɛ́mla ajɛ kú aéwɔhá nēe yɛjīla ɔ́ tá ā le ɔ̄kā kú íjééyī kú nū ā pó dúú.

eng_Latn: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ubéla, ɔyí kú Asási mɛ́mla ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Usséma nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujówɛ̄lu, nōo lā Árōwɛ, ipú ajɛ kú ɛhícō kú Unébo mɛ́mla Ubáalmēyɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí aá ā, n le yá gbɛnɛkɛɛ, iyē kú um yɔ̄ gē fīyégbúlú ohígbū ufi.

eng_Latn: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
idu_Latn: Aóhī kú uwā tíne kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī iyē ōgwu kú nū ā le jīla, kwu ákú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ, ámāŋ ɔyínɔ̄nyā, ó géē bī omlede kú iháyí éyi gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, kóō wɛ odée kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú. Ó klla géē bī ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ámāŋ ka okóohō kú odée kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí Ɛláyíja nōo ŋmá ajɛ Utíssbe ā gaá da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ga Usamérīya gaá jīla mɛ́mla Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um kú odúúdú aá kóō ka ucē ɔhá. Amáŋ eyī yá um fíyɛ́ kú odúúdú aá kóō lɔfú ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ. Olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ō ka tɛ́ɛcɛ tīilɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ka ucē ɔhá á, ń táafú ŋ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo í cɔ̄ɔ̄wɔ kú ɔdā nōó ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci tábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ cāŋjɛ yɔ̄ ī wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka ísu kú Unáyilu nōo le cēenyi ā yɔ̄ dúú?.

eng_Latn: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔcɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ, háyi pī upíla kú aɔ́cɛ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, aícɔ́ɔja le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá bá ī gbō ɔ̄, ācogwɛ́ɛya klla le yɛ ɔ́ jīla bá gē tá opo. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda klla bá abɔ́ɔ bá ī gwéeyē, bá gē gwííjē, bá gē jīījē, klla bá gē gwō odée. Ɔtūnōbí cɛ̄ lɛ Atálīya le ílī kú nū híla, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ kahíníī, Ibíyāajɛ nɛ oo! Ibíyāajɛ nɛ oo.

eng_Latn: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo wā ɛgiyí uwɔ Ubɛ́tɛlu, ɛga nɛ̄ a le anɔ̄ tū ɛcɔ̄ ɛyí, klla cokónu gā um ā. Abālɔbányā, cāŋjɛ ká ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ nyā, ká ā kwúcē ga ajɛ ɛga nēé ma uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
idu_Latn: É ka olíla nōo gē kpó abɔ̄ wu agada, í gē yá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, gē kwú ɛmiyɛ á.

eng_Latn: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēé cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla eko kú ucɛ ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā dóódu, odúúdú ācɛ ā géē wā í jīla iyɔ̄bū okómpinu ɔ́ɔmā géē tū kpɛɛ́ klla í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya nyā ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu mɛ́mla ɛya nɛ̄ aá í gwó ɛ̄cī dóódu mɛ́mla ejé kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
idu_Latn: da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā kahíníī, N gē bī iyē kú ami abɔ̄yī um lɛ gbɔkpá ka n géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá nyā, ɛ̄nɛ̄ á tá ō je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú uwɔ ā gā um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa cīgbīhi kwu alɔ lɛ ā Ɔwɔicō? A géē yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ piyóó nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū ā le ka gā um ka ami ɔɔ́ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī; N yíihɔtū nɛ̄hi klla lɛ ɛlá wu Ujerúsālɛm, ɔlɛ́ otīihɔ kú um ā.

eng_Latn: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
idu_Latn: É le abɔ̄, amáŋ é bī ɔ̄ le yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́, é lɛ ikpó, amáŋ é yāwu glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kē ka ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
idu_Latn: Ayíka n lɛ īyī um tū yēŋēē ŋmá ínoōbīya icííci nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
idu_Latn: Ó le ojuja pi klá ɔkpáncō, le ɔwɔ je lɛ ɛcɛ, klla le yá ká ácí kóō jɛ̄ ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō leyī gwū eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā bónū, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó je ɔ́da lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ɛga dóódu kéē le pīyabɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Abɔ̄ aá í kpɔ́tūce ɛlā kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá mafú ɔfú otīihɔ kú um fú iyɔ̄bū kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā, aá í gáā kpó uwā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n gē je lɛ uwá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man's sword shall be against his brother.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɛdɔ ífi dóódu le tū Ugɔ́gu ufi. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́. aícɔ́ɔja kú Ugɔ́gu klla í pīyeyī kwú īyī uwā, í kpó īyī uwā ŋmó mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔgbanjɛ kú oje udɔ yá nɛ̄ ɔkwu kú nū í wɛ oje udɔ. Kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ mla ede ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛyíkwu aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā yá kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kē le ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū yá bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá āá.

eng_Latn: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ anyā, ká aá ma ayí. Aá lɛ anyā lɛ ayí aá nɔ̄nyīlɔ, kú aá kpó ayí aá nɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔbá. Aá yá lɛ ā ká aá nyīla tā ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá híī mɛ tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ɔwɔicō géē ŋmó ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ɛpɔ̄bí eko nɛ̄ ó í kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yɔ̄ ipú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ ā á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū wogodo gā um lɛ ā, ó cɛ̄ gā um kwú ŋmɛ́nɛ̄hɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ, n kē le ɔdā dóódu ā kpó tū ipú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Usɛ́ti le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma nēé hī iyē kú nū lé ka Énɔ̄ss. O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō le gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
idu_Latn: Ujówābu tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Óndú kóō lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyīla fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā ɛga ofɛhɔ̄. Ágábáidu, odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́gɛ́dúú nēé lɛwa lɛ, wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ. Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a tíne ō yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí bī gé lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má ā, ó le ɔkɔ cɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄, lɛ okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si klla lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄, Ujísɔ̄si, ɔyí kú Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú! Ɔdí gbo ákú alɔ mɛ́mla awɔ a? N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ, a híīī yá alɔ italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́fiyɛ, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ nēe wɛ óndú aá kú ɛcɛ ā ipú ɔdā dóódu. Ó wɛ ojīlīmā kú eyīgoo bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ olɛ ojīlīmā cē ācɛ ipú eyī uwā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá ŋmá ipɔ́tū kú aá ohígbū ka aá gē yúúfi Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a géē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ ajɛ alɔ piií ohígbū ka odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, awɔ yá ɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
idu_Latn: Ujóyāda, ɔyí kú Upásēya mɛ́mla Umɛssúlam ɔyí kú Ubesodéya ma ɔwɛ kú Ujessána á É kwú ɔcí ō cíla ɔwɛ ā ú ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwú odūngwɔ̄wɛ ā ú kpó kwu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é kwú oje o gwū ɔwɛ ā ú kpó kwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ojuja kóō yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ ā mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛhíicō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kɔ̄ hīyī uwā tá.

eng_Latn: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ɔkpacaŋgelī kú aólɛlā kú um. Lɛ oyēeyī kú um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aéwo nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ayisáya ka lɛyíkwu aá nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n. Aá wɛ ācɛ o leyī ɛpa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tá ɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ɔwɔicō ka, Ācɛ nēe bá ā gē lɛ ojīlīmā kú ákpókónu ce um, amáŋ ɔtū kú uwā le ligbó gā um.

eng_Latn: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: A le aéwɔhá o pɛ̄cí ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí. A klla le ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kpó yíífi. A le iyē kú uwā ŋmónyí ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā piyóó.

eng_Latn: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú ācɛ, kéē bá hímm iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, ohígbū koó yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛga otīihɔ kú nū ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Abínādābu, kwú ɔ̄ ú hayi úgbɔ́ɔnya ɛ̄pɛ̄pɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í bī le kpó ɔdā dúú jééjéē ɛ́ ŋ mā. Anɔ́ɔ Úsaa mɛ́mla Ahíyo bá í gbō aɛ́na ɛpa nēe gē pi úgbɔ́ɔnya ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N géē yɔ̄ mla aá eko kpií, cɛ́ɛ́ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le aɔ́báagwu nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā fu, le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ayípōklóbīya ɛtá ā gbō kéē kwú uwā ú kpó tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ tū ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā.

eng_Latn: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē da Uhɛsɛkíya ka ɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka ɛlā kú okónu áncā gē kwɛyí ula mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ gē bī le kpɛ́fú ā glá nɛɛɛ? Ka ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ géē tá anúɔ abɔ̄ glá ɛɛ́, nōo gē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya āa?.

eng_Latn: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
idu_Latn: Kwu aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Umídīyan ā: Ɛ́fi, Urɛ́kɛm, Usɔ́ru, Uhɔ́ru mɛ́mla Urɛ́ba. É le Ubálam ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
idu_Latn: Amásīya le odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn kɔ̄ ígwíígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aótrɛ̄yí fu lɛ ígwu kú ācɛ úlā ɛpa cofu igwó , igwú kú ācɛ ofɛhɔ̄ . Odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu gɔbū ā wɛ ipú aícɔ́ɔja ā dúú. Odúúdú uwā wɛ ācɛ úlá bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofu igwáhāapa cigwó . Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā wɛ ígwu kú ayípōklóbīya nēe le tútū kéē bī óbō mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú, ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī le kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ojuju, klla gē miya ɛfú ō kpó lɔɔlɔhi ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ó géē nyɔ̄ gāá kpɛ́fú á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛ ācɛ o nwū uwɔ ɛlā olɔhi alɛwa lɛ ā, nāa kwu ō yálé ajaajɛ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tóohi kahíníī, Ehée, Óndú. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ń kē ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́ dúú. Nyɔ̄ o ŋmá abālɔbányā ā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kwú éwo kú aá nōo yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ā ú yíífi, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
idu_Latn: Ó gē le ɔfú ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū um iyē. Ó gē bī um jé ɔwɛ kú ucē olɔhi ō yá ohígbū ojīlīmā kú nū.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
idu_Latn: É tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā ohile nɛ̄ Abíjam yá ā tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo jāhɔ̄ gā um ā, géē yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Ó géē lā ɛbɔ́ nōó gáā yúufi ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā nōo géē yá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
idu_Latn: É kwú iyī uwā iyē ú tēelihɔ, o ŋmá lɛ ucē kú uwā. É klla kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔdā nēé ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
idu_Latn: aá lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɔ̄ kú icɛ̄bɔ̄ mɛ́mla íkpékwīja kú uwā ā ca tāajɛ, klla lɛ ikpɛ́cí kú uwā wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híīī yúúfi ŋ́, Usɛkaríya, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā pó ɛɛ́. Ɔnyā awɔ Ɛlísābēti géē ma ɔyínɔnyilɔ éyi gā uwɔ. Kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Ujɔ́ni.

eng_Latn: I am that bread of life.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ igbō kú oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ká n tá odúúdú ācɛ abɔ̄, ācɛ o nwūleyī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé nwūleyī ŋ́, ācɛ o jɔ́kpá mɛ́mla aógwuda.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā gaá kwú Usekaríya, ɔyí kú Ujehóyāda ú, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá háyi ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ géē má ɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ kahíníī, Óndú ā gē da aá ɔ̄kā, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá tá ō tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ ɔ́, nɛ̄ aá gē bī ífi wā í klá īyī aá ā. Abɔ̄ aá le igbīhi cē kwu Óndú ā, Óndú ā le igbīhi ce kwu aá dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē nā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá tá ɔwɛ ā, géē mīyɛ ahínyá ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ icííci ā.

eng_Latn: And the priests' custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
idu_Latn: É kwu eyī í gwū íne nōo lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya cɛgbá ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe gē wā í gwɛ́ɛya ā bónū. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā wā yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā nɛ, eko nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ ā ce ɔlá yɔ̄ gē wú ā, ayíkpó kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gē bī oje otɛ́ɛbɛ́ ŋmá ɔlá nōo kwāabɔ̄ ɛtá wā.

eng_Latn: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwu īkpɛ̄yí kú Ugolíyāti ā ú bī wā Ujerúsālɛm. Amáŋ, o kwú iyɔ́fú kú Ugolíyāti ā ú kpó bá ipú inu kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú kwúcē ga Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ é gaá bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá cɛ̄ ka aá wɛ opeyī nɛɛ, aá gáā lé ɛpɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ abālɔbányā aá ka aá gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛɛ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá le ɛpɔ̄bí lé kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
idu_Latn: Aflɛ́yí, aá géē jé ɛ̄nyā piíí ka eko ámōōmɛ ā, ācɛ nɛ̄ únwū obɔ̄bi kú ɔkpíyē gē bī tá ā, géē hɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ. É klla wɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ācɛ ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
idu_Latn: Ó le okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ ka, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kōō dɔɔ̄kā o hɛ́ ɛpa kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú anúɔ, anúɔ géē je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā nááná ā, aá ge gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā piíí, klla bá ī je īyī aá iyē tēelihɔ mla ayí aá ō kpó gwɛ́ɛya oōyɔlá lɛ aɛ́cí ā. Nááná ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gē wā í da ɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú um mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī á, ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá da um ɔ̄kā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kaā. Aá je unwalu mla ákanya gā um fíyɛ́ odúúdú aéwo ɔhá nēe yɛ aá jīla tá á, ohígbū ka aá tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um mɛ́mla ō le ɔ́da kú um. Aá klla bá ī yá ucē kú aéwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyí ŋ́, ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū í he ɔ́, o ŋmá lɛ o kpó ayí lɛ ɔ́. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
idu_Latn: Ká Ɛlísa kóō lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū wu ōhī kú oyī kú nū, kóō lɛ ɔ́ mī lɛyíkwu ɛgiyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā igbo ahāapa.

eng_Latn: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ujúda ā géē lā Ujúda piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ayááyí ā kē í lā Ujerúsālɛm piyóó.

eng_Latn: Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that is abomination before the LORD: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ, ɔbá aflɛ́yí kú nū ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ɔ́ igbɔhá glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ má ɔnyā ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú tēelihɔ ā. Ó klla ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔbá ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ igbɔhá, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ cíkā ō yá ɛdɔ kú íne ō bīya ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
idu_Latn: le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Eko nēé gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá nyā, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá cē, aá kóō kwú ɛ̄wɛ̄ kú aflɛ́yí ā ú gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
idu_Latn: Ohóō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ɔlɛ́ nū gbagbénú ŋmá lɛ itene nɛ̄ ó lɛ ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā. Nōo lɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gwó ka ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá anúɔ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
idu_Latn: n géē tá iyē kú aá tū ɔdɔ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um. É géē blakwu aá piyóó ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe ma ayí. E gáā je mlanyī iye aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
idu_Latn: Eko nēe le pó ā, é je ɔkɔ gicō tɔ̄há le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔkpani, awɔ nōo yá ɔkpáncō, ɛcɛ, ísu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
idu_Latn: É le ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi kpó kwu ɔ́ ɔgba ɛnɛ. Ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔgba kú aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Usádiyɔ̄si, Utɔ́pāsi mɛ́mla Ukábɔ̄nku.

eng_Latn: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nēé géē lɛ yá odúúdú úklɔ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um cē ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nēé je gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ ī yá igbō, ó géē je igbō kú aflɛ́yí ā lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā ōgbā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ hɔ́hā cē uwá mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ uwá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā kú uwá dóódu wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, ɛlā dóódu nēé ka ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, le da Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ka, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N kwú uwɔ ú ŋmá álá ōgbō ipácí, klla kwú uwɔ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
idu_Latn: Itébulu igwó nōo lɛ akā kú oje udɔ nōó yá mɛ́mla oje oplákátá ō cɛyí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
idu_Latn: Unɛ́ɛlu kú ugóolu nēé bī le yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-hɛ̄hi ā dúú á. Ogbɛnú kú unɛ́ɛlu nēé bī le yúklɔ́ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛpa ce igwó ā. É klla le ugóolu ma plla ɔdɔ kú aípíinu icō ā dúú.

eng_Latn: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
idu_Latn: A géē bī oje udɔ fíílí lɛ fúla odúúdú ogbló nōo yɛ igá ā jīla tá ā kwɔhá. É géē bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ yá uwɔ ā, é kē í bī oje udɔ lɛ yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ o lɛ ogbló ā wu ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī géē kwu ga ɛyí ɛfu bɛ̄ɛka okóhō nōo yúufi kwu ŋmá ɔpɛ́ ga ɛfu ā. Odúúdú uwā géē jikwū ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwá ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú anúɔ, ka anúɔ géē yá okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ ce mla ádā nū, Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla Ɛlísaa, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Ɔwɔicō Ádā um ā wɛ otábō kú um á. Ó ka ohígbū ka ó lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Uféro.

eng_Latn: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, nɛ̄ um fu ā, nōo he um ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ ɛlā nū gē he um ɔtū ā. N géē je Alelékwū kú um lɛ ɔ́. Ó kē í ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aéwo ka n géē nya uwá tá.

eng_Latn: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
idu_Latn: A géē yēeyī o ŋmá lɛ ō kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā wu agbénú kú uwā. A géē cɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ a tá ɛlā kú nū, a géē hɛ́ īyī uwɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ɔwɔicō klla le aálá, aɛ́na, aɛ́wū, aómlede mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ mɛ́mla agbénú ɔhá nɛ̄hi kpó lɛ ɔ́, nɛ̄ ó klla lɛ ɔlɛ́ kpó gwó lɛ uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā aá gā, aá géē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú um, n da aá ka ń gáā da Ádā ā ɔ̄kā kwɛyí aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā í nya um tá. Ó géē yá ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā lé klla í je uwēyī lɛ uwá. Ɔwɔicō géē ma ihɔtū kú nū, nōo ī yɔ̄ piyóó ā, mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa kú nū ā fú gā um.

eng_Latn: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
idu_Latn: O yá awanda í gē lɛ ɛlā tayínū glá ŋ́. Ā híī túbla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē kɛlā nɛ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufárisīi lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ayíkpó kú uwɔ gē yá ɔdā nōo gē bīya íne kú ɛ̄cī Usábāti.

eng_Latn: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Áma éyééye playi ɛplá upomégrānete éyééye yɛ awulú ā jīlatá biílí kú eko o yúklɔ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí nū ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá abɔ̄yī aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ aá eko dóódu ŋmá ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ n lɛ ikpó ba ajɛ Ésīya ā.

eng_Latn: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
idu_Latn: Userúbábɛlu nōo le ikpíinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā tá ajɛ ā, anú piíí ā gáā gwó ɔ̄ kwɛyí á. Eko nɛ̄ ó le gwó kwɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē cɛ̄ ka ami Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ uwēyī ɔ́ɔ géē kwú ācɛ kú Ujúda kú ɔtū nēé kpó ce aéwo nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í cíkā ō kpɔ́tūce uwá ŋ́ mā. Ó gáā tá uwā abɔ̄ dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu nōo kwú tēelihɔ, géē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Eko nyā nááná ā, ó kōō gáā lé ɔdōlé ōtīihɔ dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nōó le iyē gwā.

eng_Latn: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú um ú gicō ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, lɛ um bī ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ n má ka ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛga dóódu á.

eng_Latn: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā fíyá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ákátā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē tá ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ gē kpó úmúlá ā. N géē cīgbīhi kú um kwu uwá, í klla gáā tá uwā abɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ámíyā géē yá uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū ɔkpá a gēe gbo ɔɔ ōoná ipí abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ a. Ácí mla ujē í gbo ɔɔ oōbū ɔtūɔkpá a.

eng_Latn: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro má ka aábaná ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, ó lɛ ɔtū kú nū yá lɔfú kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ŋ́ kpɔ́ á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka ā.

eng_Latn: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe gē yá ā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugígal. Ó ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ gbɔɔ́ ō wú ɔtū ūwā ŋmá á. Ó ka ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā, anúɔ géē nū ūwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Anúɔ í kē gáā yíihɔtū ūwā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ka aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tú anɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́frem nēe bī aɔ́tā mɛ́mla ɔyī ā, le inya kwu ŋmá iyɔ̄bū aólɛlā kú uwā ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛ̄nyā, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gē cikpɔ́nyā, ɔ̄cɛ o yá unwū ɔnyā bɛ̄ɛka opī ā, ɔ̄co o yá ɔdīcííci, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yúnwū ɔdā nɛ̄hi í gáā lɛ ɛgá dúúmā ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē gbō ācɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, eko nōó gaá lā Umówābu ā, ó le Uhódɛssi lɛ klla le ayí ahāapa ma. Iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Ujóbābu, Usíbīya, Umésa, Umálkam.

eng_Latn: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
idu_Latn: kú íne ō bīya. Ó géē je aɔ́há mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya ā kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛpa cɛpa ŋmá ipú uwā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā á. Amássāyi, ɔyí kú Asárɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ássāyi. Aádā nū wɛ Umessílēmɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Ímma.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́futa tá uwā ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē kwú anúɔ í kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ gaá lɛ ɛfú ā kpó tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn, nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ācɛ ā yálé, ka anúɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā?.

eng_Latn: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
idu_Latn: Okpé gē gbēyī ká ā lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ kóō gwó ɔlɛ́ nū ce icō ágēnégēne kú ɛfu?.

eng_Latn: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē yá ɔdānyā kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ mā ucē ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā gaá le aɔ́dée kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā kpó yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ mɛ́mla ijē nōo ce ɛyí ede ā. Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā má ā, é dɛ̄gba le eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ āā, abɔ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ ā, é le tá Usɛlúsīya anɔ́ɔ é le tá ipú úgbéenyi ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gā Usáyiprɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
idu_Latn: Omulɛgwá, udɔ́, mɛ́mla ɛ́námbokpó, mɛ́mla okpé. Aá híī lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwā kéē ma nyīla, kú aɛ́béenyi kéē lɛ mu ísu, kú aígbáanɔ kéē kē lɛ lɛwa ipú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá nyā, ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu nēé hī ka Apólosi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Alesáŋdrīya ā, gā Ɛ́fēsɔsi. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojokónu nɛ̄hi, ó kē jɔ́kpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú hīla ókplící gbɔbū lɛ eko kú nu ɛɛ́. A klla le uwēyī je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Ó ka aíne ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú abɔ̄ ɔhá kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, ipú ɔpɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ pīyeyī kwu Ubɛ́t-péyɔ, ipú ajɛ kú Usíhɔn, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri, nēe lā Uhɛ́sbɔn, nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yálé eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpit ā.

eng_Latn: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi ka anúɔ le ɛfú kpó tú Urábba, anúɔ kē mīyɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā gē hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá āa ɛɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́cí ā da ɔcí nēé hī ka ufáyin ā ka ɔ́ɔ í lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá lé.

eng_Latn: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ jé ka anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cīce gē ba ɛ̄ba Okómpīinu Ohéyīfuú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔdā nēe yá lɛ ɔ́ ā le hɛ́ uwā idáagó klla yá uwā eyījii nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā da Ujeremíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī ka Ólīifu, nōo yɔ̄ kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ ā. Ó wɛ iyāwu kú ukilómīta éyi ŋmá ipú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú aá í lɔhi fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ugomóra ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá jāhɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú alɔ gē nwū aá ā.

eng_Latn: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okwū kú iju gē yá ká anɔ̄ ō kpóocu nɛ̄hi ā kóō nípī glá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ucē íla lígíí ī bīya iyē kú ɔ̄cojééyī mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi glá á.

eng_Latn: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
idu_Latn: Nááná, é kē lɛ ācɛ kú Utébīsi kpó ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ. Ɔ́kíkā kú úláyi dóódu, é le ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ̄ kú uwā gɔ́klɛ́ɛcɔ̄ le uwá kpó ŋmó icííci. É le agbá kwu aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā abɔ̄ klla le uwá kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe kwú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bīya íne kú Óndú ā, oŋmá o lɛ nwū uwā ɔdēelihɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gē yá eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē gbā aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ɛ̄gbā ā ŋ́.
