eng_Latn: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
idu_Latn: odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú okónu ísu ā géē pɛ́ wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyi akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā. É géē fu ɔfulā kú uwá ŋmá ɛyí, í plá otógwo ahilíki kú uwá ŋmá iyē, géē cīce ajɛ ba ī fīyɛ̄ godogodo, lɛ abɔ̄ ce agba ipú ufi. Ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá aá nyā géē tū uwá ufi, géē je uwá ipú gbogodo nɛ̄hi, nēe gáā lɛ ɔtū cāŋjɛ nyɔ̄ ī cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwá a glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ má ka ɛ́ɛ lɛlá kwu ɔ́ kéē lɛ odúúdu aíne, nɛ̄ amíy ɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ā tū.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī iyɛ́fú kú nū ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī pí kóō le gwū anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ ōpɛ́cí mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ā kéē híī gwéeyē, ka aá lɛ anúɔ ŋmó ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔyípōklóbīya ā í lɔtū lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gwū ɔcɛ́ ā kóō ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́ɔlu kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú īyī nū ú, lɛ īyī nū tá gwū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le īyī nū ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú aútíca kú íne ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Utíca, ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka nyā, ɛcá nɛ̄ a cá alɔ dúú á ā.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā lɔfú tū iyē le ɛfú kpó lɔfú lɔfú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í yálé á. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe hile ā le pɛ́ kwu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi. Áluka kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ úlā ofu ɛtá ce úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdāŋ ka á cɛ̄ ŋ́, alɔ í gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔnyīlɔ ā tū alɔ ukɔ́ ka anúɔ í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ wā ɛgiyí anúɔ ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í wā mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ayí kú Ábrahām ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, ɔ̄cɛ nōó fu ā.

eng_Latn: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kpɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le īkpō kú ufáyin kú uwá kpó hɛ́ ŋmá anū, ka ɛ́ɛ kwúcē igbɔ́mpa gaá hɛ́ kpɔ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ̄ habɔ̄ īkpō ufáyin nēe hile kwu ɔcí ā tá lɛ ayókwū, anyōkwū mɛ́mla aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔ̄nyɛ kōō wɛ Apólɔsi ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ kē wɛ Upɔ́lu ā? Alɔ wɛ ācɛ nēe ī cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄ icííci, nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú alɔ gē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ kóō yá ā.

eng_Latn: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɛ okómpīinu ga ipú igá ā, anú wɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá á.

eng_Latn: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ́nyí iyē í gáā túblá ɛyí ede ajaajɛ ámāŋ gwɛ́ɛya gā um ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le eyī pu, le ikpó ce, ámāŋ le ɛdɔ kú ɔ́nyí dóódu iyē.

eng_Latn: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kɛlā, klla fu ɔ́ á. Ami klla bī ɔ̄ wā ā, n kē í yá kóō yálé ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá.

eng_Latn: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī pií ā gáā je pīya italā lɛ aá á. Igbīhi nɛ̄ aá cē kwu um ā pií ā géē je pīya ɛpɔ̄bí lɛ aá á. Aá géē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔ́ɔnɔ klla bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ ā, kú aá ce igbīhi kwu ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā, nɛ̄ aá klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce um gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ami Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ ā dúú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
idu_Latn: A géē lɔfú ka ka ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, nááná ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɛlā anúɔ ŋ́, amáŋ Óndú ā nōo gē kɛpɔ̄ ā jé ɔtū kú uwɔ. Óndú ā má uwɔ, ó ī gbō uwɔ. Ó kē í cílá uwɔ ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú uwɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī eko dóódu piyóó, nōo yá ɔkpáncō, mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ísu, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú uwā ā, lɛ ɔkpá gbo á. Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ɔkwu opiyajɛ dúú í gáā yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
idu_Latn: N jé ka Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ka Óndú kú alɔ kē lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́wɔ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
idu_Latn: Ikpēyī kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege kú iye ā. Eko nɛ̄ ikpēyī kú uwɔ le gēdēē, odúúdú iyē kú uwɔ le mū mla ɔlá ofíyajɛ. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ikpēyī kú uwɔ í lɔhi ŋ́, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyē kú uwɔ géē yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ odobū.

eng_Latn: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ kwú ɛbɛ́ otīihɔ ú ŋmá ipú ɛbɛ́ nēe le gwɛ́ɛya ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú īlī kú nū á, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ īlī kú nū ɔ́ɔmā gaá kwu ɔdōlé dúúmā nēé yá ā, ejé, anɔ̄ ámāŋ ɛdɔ ɔdōlé dóódu, ó géē yá ká ɔdōlé ā kóō lɛ tīihɔ kpɔ́ nɛɛ? Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ̄kā nyā da ā, Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā tóohi kahíníī, Ehéee.

eng_Latn: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
idu_Latn: gbɔɔ́ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni tɔ́ɔna kú ubatísim ā jāā gaá kwu ɛ̄cī nēé je Ujísɔ̄si ga ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
idu_Latn: Ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtá géē ŋmó āyā éyi ŋmá ipú ɛtá kú aá ipú igelī ā. É géē bī ɔkpacańgelī le ŋmó āyā ɔ́mpa kú aá eyīyɛcɛ kú ipú igelī ā. Āyā ɔ́mɛtá kú aá ā, n gē kpó uwā patūla ga ɛbɛɛbɛ klla í bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nū uwá inya.

eng_Latn: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Kú ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā idáagó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé ɛga nōó ŋmá ā ŋ́, nááná ā, anú kē nwūla eyī kú um á.

eng_Latn: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nēe bá ipú icɔ́ɔci mɛ́mla alɔ nēe pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā cíkā ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō eko dóóu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Yá mla um nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ihɔtū nāa lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
idu_Latn: Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, N le ɔ̄na nā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ nōo lɔfú ka ɛyí nū gā um ŋ́. N pó ka, eko nēé lɛ ɔ̄na ka gā uwɔ, a gē ka ɛyí nū glá.

eng_Latn: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú kwu ajɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Umísipa mɛ́mla Ujessána, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ebɛnésa , ohígbū ka ó ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tá aá abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n cē igbō lɛ ācɛ úlā igwó kéē lé ā bɛ́ɛ, ómbilí omōomu kú iwili ɛmulá hile nɛ̄ aá túbá ŋmá ajɛ ā? É da ɔ́ ka ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, éyi kú aɔ́fiyɛ nēé kpó ŋmá Ujúda ā, í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā ŋ́. Ó gē gbā Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɛ̄gbā igbɛtá ɛ̄cī éyi.

eng_Latn: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá jísɔ̄s nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ŋmá lɛ ɔ́da kú nū mɛ́mla ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ alɔ lɔtūce ā.

eng_Latn: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ géē má ɔ̄ɔ̄, é í lɛ eyī yɛ ɔɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ é le jé ka amīyɔ̄, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um ā, yá ɔ̄ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú Ɔwɔicō kwu ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔlɛcɛ gē yá ā gɛɛ. Ó kē ī má ɔ̄ ɛga dóódu nōó ī nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā nōo wɛ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aláadi ā, eko nēé le ɔwɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā bá ā gwū ohígbū ufi kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ aá má ɔdā nēe bá ā gē yá, aá le jé ka eko ā má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́, ó má kwu okómpīinu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko lɛ yá kú Ɛlísābēti kóō ma ɔyí nū ā, ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma.

eng_Latn: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ ŋmó ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í ŋmó Ujonátan ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
idu_Latn: Le tá gé lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci nōo yɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ɛ́fēsɔsi ā ka ami nōo bī aínyílɔ́wɔ ahāapa abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um, nōo ī yāwu ipú aɔ́dā o lɛ agege ce uwá kú ugoolu ā, kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
idu_Latn: Usébādiya, Árādi, Ɛ́da.

eng_Latn: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā dúú kóō yá ɔdā dúú nōo géē tīile lɛ anú ā ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ó gbɛlá ɔdā nōo í tīile lɛ ācɛ ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
idu_Latn: Nɛ ɛgwā í gāa yá ɔyí obene ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ɔɔ̄daŋ ka ɔyí obene a lɛ abɔ̄ wu ogwiji okónu, yɔ̄ ī hi ijā mla anú náaná, o gaa kwu ɔɔ ayīnu ŋ.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
idu_Latn: A í da ɔ́ kahíníī, É wɛ ákú ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ̄, Ujékɔ̄pu nɛ. Ó kpó uwā wā kéē wɛ ɔdā kú ɛhi nōó kpó gé lɛ ɔkpani nū, Ísɔ. Ujékɔ̄pu abɔ̄yīnū yɔ̄ ī wā igbīhi alɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi lé ka ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí ī yā ā. Eko nyā nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ gē nyɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú á. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le Ujówābu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā tū nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ ɔhá á. É kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn, le uwá yálé. Anɔ́ɔ é klla le íbɔm cē tū igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Urábba ā á. Amáŋ Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū klá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē pa uwá hīla tū ipú aéwo dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē pɛ̄cí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbā ŋmá ɔcí ámāŋ ka ɛcɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Ɛcí nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā í pā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
idu_Latn: Aá le yá ka ukɔ́tin dóódu ā kéē jóonjīlɛ̄. Olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa, ō lɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nēé gbā um kpaakpa ŋ́ mā, aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um. Aá wɛ ákú um nɛ. N géē je ɔ̄cɛ éyééye ámaŋ ka ācɛ ɛpɛɛpa kú aá ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔmā dóódu. N klla í bī aá kwúcē wā Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, ācɛ í jɛ́ɛyí kú olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ígwu kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ígwu kú ācɛ nēe bá gē yíífi ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ádā uwā gekwú ā, ayínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu ka, Ujósɛ̄fu lɔfú yɔ̄ ī wɔ́tū alɔ kpɔ́, kē tíne ō lɛ óluma cíla alɔ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ákanaba ɛhīlī yá kú igbīhi, ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to his own place, that it slay us not, and our people: for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ékrɔn lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄, kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya ā kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ é da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī kpó alɔ mɛ́mla aíkonó kú alɔ ŋmó ŋ́. Ufi cɛ̄ le ɔtū kú odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, kwú wuklílicō, cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lā ipú ufi, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī yá uwā italā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ufílístiya le pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu lé ā, é le pɛ́ ga ɛcɛ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi ga ɛcɛ wā í jīla uwá ɔwɛ kéē kpɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā mɛ́mla inya oōnū owu nɛ. O lɔhi fíyɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔdā nāa lɛ ā, kóō jɛ̄ uwɔ, fíyɛ́ ō yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔdā ɔhá piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā wɛ, úlā igwɛ́ɛhīlī cofigwó .

eng_Latn: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ɔdōlé lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe yēeyī ā, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú ikpɛ́cí kú Utófɛ̄ti nōo kwu ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm ā ú nyílá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔwɔ nēé hī ka Umólēki ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń lɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu nóó, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ n lɛ ā, nɛ̄ n géē je gā uwɔ á. O ŋmá iyē Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄cɛ Unásārēti, yāwu.

eng_Latn: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
idu_Latn: N le īlī ekwu kpó wu iyē, é kē gbɔɔ́ ō yɛhɛ tū um.

eng_Latn: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bīya ācɛ ɔtū ā, í bīya um ɔtū ŋ́, amáŋ aá nōo bīya aá ɔtū á. Amáŋ ɔwɛ éyi, ó bīya ācɛ ōhī kú aá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā nɛ̄ ācogbāājɛ ā géē tɔ́ɔna ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Éfrem kahíníī, Aá wā ká ālɔ̄ ga Usáyɔn, gaá gbā Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó kwú Usedekíya eyī ɛplɛ́ɛpa ú kpó pu. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú agbá ú kwu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ú bī ga Ubábīlɔn á. Usedekíya tá agbá Ubábīlɔn abɔ́ɔ jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nōó kwú.

eng_Latn: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n kwú hīla ókplícī nɛ̄ īnyīlɛyí kú um kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ɛɛ́ mā, nááná ā, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ā cīgbīhi kwu um gɛ ŋ́. Yɔ̄ mla um, eko nɛ̄ n gē tɔ́ɔna kú úklɔ́ idáagó nāa yá mɛ́mla ɔfú kú uwɔ lɛ aɛ́gɔ́ kú eko ɔhá nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
idu_Latn: Mīyɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwá. Mīyɛ aílī nēe ī klá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyó kú uwā. Mīyɛ aínyankwūlumī kú uwā. Ācɛ ā kē í bá ī dɛ̄ ka, Ɔdōōtūufi bá ī yá ɛga dóódu mɛ́mla eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ Ohi kú odúúdú okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce á. Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōo ŋmá iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, alɔ gē ka ka Aamí ká alɔ je ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
idu_Latn: É gē kwú eko nēé wɛ ɛdrɔ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Oyēeyī kú uwā kē ī ŋmɛ́yí ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó ga iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó kú uwā, nēe lɔfú yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā glá ā gbaáluka.

eng_Latn: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ jé ɔdā nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, ipú eko kpíi, kú oyēeyī áncā kú nū ā? Oyēeyī nōo gē wā ī yɛ bɛ̄ɛka ojiji ā. Abɔ̄ o yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē jé ɔdā nōo í yá igbīhi nū, eko nōó gekwú ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá nyā wɛ ka ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa, ó híīī wɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, óō wɛ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
idu_Latn: Óndú mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, A cíkā nēe ī cɛtra uwɔ, lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ, klla cɛ̄tra uwɔ ohígbū ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ. Ohígbū ka awɔ yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odée á. Abɔ̄ a tíne kéē yɔ̄ ā nɛ̄ a kē yá odúúdú uwā á.

eng_Latn: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of God;) that thy land be not defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.
idu_Latn: okwū kú nū ɔ́ɔ gáā plicō ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē je ɔɔ́ nyi ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū ka, okwū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ playicō ɔcí gbó ɔ̄cī géē cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō í tókónu lɛ uwá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú okwū ā nyi cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī je ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá hɛ́gilígilí ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú aá í bɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n wɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
idu_Latn: Ó le ajɛ odobū kpímm nɛ̄hi ā klá īyī nū. Oōtū kú ɔwɔ kpúm le ɔ́ yɛjīlatá.

eng_Latn: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ísiha, Ukóhāti, Ulífāyi mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni le yɛ bū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ nēe yɛ jila ísu kú Ujɔ́dan tá ā, yɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ kahíníī, Aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā, ka n lɛ ubatisim yá aá, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kwú íne nɛ̄ áa bīya ā ú yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā háyī ɛhícō kú agidigbé ā Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, ádáádā uwɔ, mɛ́mla Áyísīki, ádā uwɔ á. N géē je ajɛ nɛ̄ a gwutá anú nyā gā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayááyí kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ojibó kú ɛcɔ̄ ámāŋ, ákú oje ma, yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā tayínū. Ɛcí ō pā ī wɔ́ Óndú ā ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ká ɔ́ɔ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
idu_Latn: n yɔ̄ gē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ojigógó ohígbū aá. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō n gē kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū aá.

eng_Latn: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma nyā géē lā ābɔ̄ ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Usúrīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Abíhēlu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā á.

eng_Latn: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā je abɔ̄ kú nū gicō le ɔkpá ce iyī nū ka, anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pɛ́kwú ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā tá Udéfīdi ohi ka, anúɔ í lɛ igbō ɔlamu dúúmā gwō igbō ōtīihɔ ā tá ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū í gwutá mla anyā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kéē lɔfú lé.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá dóódu, nɛ̄ Ujɛhówāsi yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwá wɛ, úlā igwáahātá ce ofɛhīlī ce igwáahāpa.

eng_Latn: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Unówa ā, n le okónu ce ka ń gáā bī éŋkpɔ̄ je ɛcɛ yíifi gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ n cokónu ícɛ ka ń gáā cɔ̄nū mla uwɔ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má. N gáā dɛ̄gba tū uwɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá uwɔ ōwē ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo yéeyī ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, n je abɔ̄ kú um gicō le ɛka gbo.

eng_Latn: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
idu_Latn: Aá gē mīyɛ omíci lé kú aá hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ācolɛpɔ̄bí ā, kú aá klla tá ō hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ācɛ nēe cíkā ō lɛ́pɔ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
idu_Latn: É ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, é klla ī yɔ́bɔ́cɛ klla ī gwō.

eng_Latn: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongaber.
idu_Latn: É le aúgbéenyi o ga ipú itekwú glá gwó tɔ̄há okónu ísu kú Ɛsīyɔngɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ gē ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō ojígógó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ahínyá kú alɔ lɛ, ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ, alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū aá.

eng_Latn: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the LORD stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú klla le ɛbɛ ɔhá mafú gā um kpɔ́. Ipú ɛbɛ ā, n má Óndú háyi pi ɔdɔ kú inu éyi nēé bī ɔcí ō le miya ɔdɔ kpaakpa le gwó ɔ̄. Anú abɔ̄yīnū ké bī ɔcí ō miya ɔdɔ kú inu abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē lɔfú tū aá iyē, ihɔtū nōo le lɛ aá gē tú aá ɔtūlé. Alelékwū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá cɛ̄ lɛ aá ī létɔ̄há. Aá kē gbonɛnɛ lɛ iyī aá, klla gē ményinyi iyī aá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le aónɔwá ɛnɛ nēe bī omútāgā abɔ̄ mafú gā um á.

eng_Latn: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá kú ɛcɛ ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayi nēé bá ipu ɔlígbánɔ̄ ā. N kwú agbénú kú uwá kpó ɛbɔ́, bɛ̄ɛka ayi kú ugwū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kpó á, nɛ̄ ugwū ā í gē tɔ́kɔ́ ŋ́ mā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē kwu um ɔkɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá aá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ géē móōwē nɛ̄hi nōo géē bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ odúúmā nɛ̄ ɛcɛ tɛtɛ má ŋmífī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ā, jāā gaá kwu abālɔbányā ā. Ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā í kē gaá lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ uculo ká aá kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi hɛ́tá lɛ aá eko kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā, aá tíne ká n̄ lɛ Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu hɛ́tá lɛ aá nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā gē yúufi ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā, é le ede ā tú ma kwu ɛga nōó tɛtɛ kwu gbɔ̄bū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō bī oje le yá ojibó ámāŋ ma ɛcí nōó tīile dúúmā ŋ́ mā ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ lɛ uwá nū ŋmá ipú uwā, klla bá ī cíla okwúlu tū uwā bɛ̄ɛka aúwī ā.

eng_Latn: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú Ufárisīi mɛ́mla aɔ́wá kú Uhérɔ̄du ōhī fu ga ɛgiyí nū kéē gbō ɔ̄ gɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú o ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nōo í ŋmá okónu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāanɛ ā wɛ ákú Abídan, ɔyí kú Ugídɛyɔn, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
idu_Latn: A le ɛjī tū lɛ uwá, nēé gaá pɛ́ gla anú wā ipú ɛcɛ í mīya ɔ́ tāabɔ̄ dúúdú glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
idu_Latn: Ahāpotú, n gē cāŋjɛ ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ, ohígbū ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti lɛ ɔ́dée tá, kwú ɔ̄ ú bá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā. Ɔdā nōó tá ā wɛ, Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ Unásārēti, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le bá lɛ eyīpɔ́lɛ́ ɛga nēé bá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, Ujísɔ̄si le yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ ī yɛ gɔbū kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔdōlé kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā tútū lɛ alɔ kú alɔ lé.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá lɔhi nɛ̄hi, aá nēe ɔdā nōo kwu aá ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā kóō le yá ā. Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ugídīyɔn bá ī tá opo kú uwā kpɔ́ ā. Óndú ā le yá kú aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā, kéē lɛ eyī kpó pīya kwu iyī uwā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó īyī uwā mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī á. É gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya lɛyíkwu Usárētán jāā ga Ubɛti Ussíta, jāā ga igelī kú Ébɛ̄lu Umehóla nōo kwu Utábāti ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
idu_Latn: Eko éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tīile dúú gā uwɔ ŋ́, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó tīile lɛ ami mɛ́mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
idu_Latn: É da um kahíníī, Alɔ í jé ɔdā nōo yá Umósīsi nyā nōo kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ŋ́, ohígbbu ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔwɔ nōo géē gbō alɔ yá lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú ubatísim mɛ́mla oyī kú nū nōó cēbónū nōo wɛ ikwū kú nū ā. Ó wā mla éŋkpɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ó wā mla éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla oyī. Alelékwū abɔ̄yī nū kē cījáalí ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ohígbū ka Alelékwū ā ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā géē yá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ aá, aá kē í lé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ō lé ā, aá klla í lā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́ssbɔn wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ Usíhɔn nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, nōo kpɛ́fú tá ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu tɛtɛ ā, Ó mīyɛ odúúdu ajɛ kú nū ŋmá ɛgiyí nū jāā ga ísu kú Ánɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu tóohi ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anú, Unaómi ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ anúɔ ā, anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
idu_Latn: Awulú nōó le wiyē ā wɛ oyōōyī cɛnyii. Iyē nēé ī hī ɔ̄ ā wɛ, Ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
idu_Latn: Unatánīyɛlu, Uráddáyi.

eng_Latn: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ówɔ́dā kú nū abɔ̄, kóō lɛ tá odúúdú ikpɔ̄da owu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ikpɔ̄da ā túbá tū ipú ɔbā. Amáŋ ó géē kpó igbómgbō tū ipú ɔlá nōó gē nyí ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
idu_Latn: Ita lɔfú yá kú ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī kóō jɛ́yí kú aódée tōō tū ɔ̄ glá. Ó klla gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ojɔ́dā jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ásāhɛlu yɔ̄ í nū ɔ̄ inya kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ábna lɛ igbīhi kú óbō kú nū gwū ɔ̄ ipú bɛ̄cɛ igbīhi á. Anɔ́ɔ Ásāhɛlu ga ajɛ gekwú á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aícɔ́ɔja ā nōo ga ɛga nɛ̄ okwú kú nū gwutá ā, gē gaá māháyi abɔ́ɔ cíí.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā ka aá le uwá yálé bɛ̄ɛka otɛtɛ ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ojuju yá kéē lɛ uwá plla wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā, wā ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce aádā aá mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ aá ipú ɔdā dóódu, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú aá abɔ̄ aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
idu_Latn: Ikpati kú ɛka kú Ondú ā yɔ̄ Ubɛ́tɛlu eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ufínɛ̄hasi, ɔyí kú Ɛlísaa, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Árɔ̄n gē leyīkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ owu tū le tá klá uwá, ácí ā gē je ŋmó, ododó ā kē ī wúla. Abɔ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu kē lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́frem klla ma ɔyí ɔhá le ka, Uréfa nōo wɛ ádā kú Uréssɛ̄fu, Utɛ́la, Utáhan.

eng_Latn: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ yá, éŋkpɔ̄ cēenyi klá ɛcɛ, owu tá klá inu ā, amáŋ ó wúlatāajɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū keé lɛ ikpó nū táajɛ ɛyí ɛcɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
idu_Latn: Ije kú éeyē kú uwá nēé bī uba mɛ́mla ɛ̄ngwū gē gwó ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ otrɛ̄yí éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ofɛpa ce igwó tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ Ɛláyíja hīgwú wā. É le yɛ, anɔ́ɔ é má Ɛláyíja cīce ɛyí ɛfu, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔcɛ́ ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ̄ gā.

eng_Latn: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú Óndú ā klá um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Cāŋ́jɛ ka a nyɔ̄ ga ɔpɛ́ ā. N géē kɛlā ga uwɔ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ubɛɛ́ra, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ Utiglat Upilésa, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kwú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū je tá agbá ajɛ éwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛyí táajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo fu ɔ́ kóō yúklɔ́ nyā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi lɛyítáajɛ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī úklɔ́ kú nū ipú inu ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka okwū kú odóódu kú uwā kōō le míya tá ipú ɛtɛ́, ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛtɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā géē je tēelihɔ. Aá kwú ɛtɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā í ca.

eng_Latn: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
idu_Latn: Lɛ īkpɛ̄yí ɛpa kú agbá ā fúlá tū agbá nēé jíla bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́ŋgbá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā ú kwu ɔ́ŋgbá ácábɔ̄ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɛfíbōssɛti, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu wā í jila ɔcɛ́ ɔwɛ á. Oŋmífī nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó na ikpó kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē gwīiyē, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō ī wā ɔnwū agba kú nū, ámāŋ na īlī kú nū ŋ́, jāā gaá kwu eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ká aá wā ɛ̄cīhɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n tá áa ohi.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛgiyí nū bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ ácí āa. Umósīsi má abɔ̄ ɔlá yɔ̄ ī yi ɔtāhɛ̄ ácí ā. Amáŋ, ácí ā í kē yɔlá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
idu_Latn: Ó klla wɛ ɔdā ō he ɔ́ ɔtū kóō yɔ̄ ī yá alɔ ōwē cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amasíya, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā, le ɛhɔ̄ tū gé lɛ Ujérobōwam, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka, Émɔ̄si mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ībīyājɛ yá tū uwɔ ɛɛ́ n. Ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ā lɔfú je ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ yíífi glá.

eng_Latn: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
idu_Latn: Ó géē bɔ́bí lɛ aá nēe gwutá agōdō abahi kú aá ā. Aá le abɔ̄ nānda, bá ī lé ucɛ kú ɛbɛ́ omlede mla ɛbɛ́ ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛna.

eng_Latn: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóyākin wɛ iháyí ahātá ɛɛ́ nōo lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á, ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm ɔyā ɛtá. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Unehústa, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ɛlinátan nōo ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
idu_Latn: N le ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka lɛyíkwu Íssmɛ̄lu ā pó ɛɛ́. N géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́, n géē kpó ayí alɛwa mɛ́mla ayááyí alɛwa lɛ ɔ́. Ó géē wɛ ádā kú aɔ́cɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa. N klla í yá kú ayááyí nū kéē lɛ pīya éwo nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā ā da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ágábáidu géē yá ɔdā lígíí nɛ̄ n gáā ba ā gā um glá, ó géē wɛ ɔdā ō he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ɔcɛ́ ā kóō cɛ̄ kú ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kóō yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɔtū lé ga um lígíí, ó kōō wɛ eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄la bɛ̄ɛka olííla ā. Aá kócōō lɔtūlé gā um.

eng_Latn: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
idu_Latn: Kwú eyī hī um tá eko kpiíí nɛ̄ n géē ce ahɛ mlɛ glá.

eng_Latn: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú yɛ tá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó kōō le ojibó kú ɔwɔ nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā ma kwaajɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu pīyɛyí ŋmá ipácí ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, Ulɛ́ya le inya kwu gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, A géē gwutá mla um otú mā, ohígbū ka n le ulé nū cíla mla umándrēk kú ɔyí um ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le gwutá mla anú otú ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ n gekwú á ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā. Anɔ́ɔ íne piíí nōo cíkā ō yá ká n̄ yēeyī ā, le ikwū bī gé umá.

eng_Latn: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mīyɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ ó bī gē lɛ ɔ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ɔ́ɔ híī ŋmúleyīkwū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā dúúmā nɔ́ɔ ka ā, anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ gē nuunu tá ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, yá ɔ̄ lé glá, amáŋ ó gáā yá ācɛ ɛpa lé glá ŋ́. Ɔ́ngbá ɛtá nēé le jíla tɔ̄há í gáā hɛ́ fíyaa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
idu_Latn: Anɔ̄ ō le tū agege, anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔtulalī umuumu ōkpóocu.

eng_Latn: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá pīyabɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú īyī aá ú gā um. Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yá lɛ ā ŋ́, n géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi da aá ohígbū aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yá ā. N géē kpó aá yíífi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo gē yi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā nyí ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And take the ark of the LORD, and lay it upon the cart; and put the jewels of gold, which ye return him for a trespass offering, in a coffer by the side thereof; and send it away, that it may go.
idu_Latn: Aá kwu ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú háyi ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya ā. Cɛ́ɛ́, aá klla kwú aójíbo kú ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ifú kú ugóolu nɛ̄ aá ma nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kéē wɛ ɛhi kú ínoōbīya ó je yɛ́ɛhi ā, ú kpó tū ipú ikpati nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi nēé hayi pī ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā. Aá kwú aɛ́na mɛ́mla iyó nēé géē kwu nyɔ̄ ā, ú nā tá ɔwɛ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
idu_Latn: É klla kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufílīstiya igbɔhá kpɔ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ugɔ́bu. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlhánan, ɔyí kú Ujáyɛ nōo ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛ̄hɛm ā lɛ Ugolíyāti, agwu nɛ̄hi éyi kú Ugáti, ŋmó á. Ogbló ō wu óbō kú agwu ā cɔkpɛ́nú bɛ̄ɛka ogbló kú ɔdā nēé gē bī lɛ tá īlī ā.

eng_Latn: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄pɔ̄bí mla ijē ō ŋmó wɛ italā nōo yɔ̄ ī gbēyī olíla nōo gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ uwā ko ipú ufi kú ɔdā dóódu néē géē má ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu kú ɔ̄nɛ̄ kóō gbo. Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu, ɛ́ɛ kē bá ī gbɔ̄kɔ kú eyī kóō le nyā.

eng_Latn: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n yɔ̄ ī wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛɛ́, ń yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ uwá bá ɛcɛ. Ádā otīihɔ, lɛ uwá tū o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú iyē kú uwɔ nāa je gā um ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú pīya ékpó mla ɔ́mpa uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami mla awɔ wɛ ékpó ā.

eng_Latn: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le híhó ka anúɔ í jé um ŋ́ ipééyī ācɛ, n géē híhó ka ń jé uwā ŋ́ iyɔ̄bū Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
idu_Latn: Uládan, éyi kú ayí kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā wɛ ádáádā kú ígwu nyā mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Ujɛ́hīyɛlu á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā géē yá Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū italā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya italā ā.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
idu_Latn: Usébūlɔn í lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi nōo ī tū ɛjī mɛ́mla Usáka ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbaáluka, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē je odée kwɛyí īkpɛ̄yí iyīnū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu kóō híī yá ɔ̄ eko nēé yɔ̄ ī gba ācɛ áluka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
idu_Latn: Utánki kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā ce ɛyí kú ɛna kú oje udɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nēé yá dúú ā. Ɛna ɛtá leyī pīya kwu ābɔ̄ ɛhícō, ɛtá kē leyī pīya kwu ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ, ɛtá lɛ eyī pīya kwu ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ɛtá ɔhá nōo hile ā kē leyī pīya kwu ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a jājīlīmā lɛ ā mafú ɔkpáncō. Cɛ́ɛ́, a klla lɛ ɛgahi kú uwɔ mafú odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyā ɛnɛ gaá le gla ā, Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé ɛ̄cī éyi, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ejé bī gé lɛ ɔ́ á. N le cɔ̄nū, lɛ eyī kwúhílá ká. Ɔcɛ́ ā í má um cɔ̄nū lɛ ā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
idu_Latn: Ɔgbanjɛ̄, ocíbú, ɔdā ó yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ipú nū, mɛ́mla ocíbú ōbī fɔ́lá kú ɛya ɛyí ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, oje ɔdɔ nēé bī le yá odúúdú uwā á. Ugóolu nēé bī le yá odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú āá.

eng_Latn: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɛ̄cī nēé je tá ā, Uhérɔ̄du le awulú ɔcɛ́ kú nū kpó wiyē, anɔ́ɔ o nyɔ̄ ī cīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
idu_Latn: Aá da Óndú ā kahíníī, Lɛ alɔ nyatá, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo ī nya alɔ tá ā. Lɛ alɔ yā tɔ̄há, ká ā lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ tá uwɔ ahínyá, ká alɔ klla cɛ̄tra iyē ōtiihɔ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ā pi odúúdú ācɛ abɔ̄fú, ācɛ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, aólɔdu mɛ́mla aólɛhá, ācɛ nēe lɛ īyī uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ, kéē lɛ uwá fukɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná amáŋ ka udɔ̄bū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō hīíjéma ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā nū Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa da ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, N lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ō yá mla awɔ ŋ́. Nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ gē ga ɛgiyí uwā ā? Amáŋ Ujóram da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ehée, Óndú ā kpó aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá nēe bá ā gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu kóō kpó uwā ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi, é géē hī ɔ̄ ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádáádā nū, Udéfīdi lé ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, íne kú uwɔ ā he um ɔtū fíyɛ́ ɛdɔ ugóolu dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā nēe wɛ ācɛ Usáyíprɔ̄si mɛ́mla Usayiríni ā, abɔ̄ é gā Ántīyɔ̄ku ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ Ugríisi dúú.

eng_Latn: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
idu_Latn: Ámíyā ɛpa nēe bá nyā yá aá ā. É kwú ɔlɛ́ aá ú wúlatāajɛ, klla kwú pīya alácɛ̄. Ɔkpɛtá klla lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá kpó ŋmó ohígbū ɛfú. Ɔcɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo ī méyīnyinyi aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó gaá kwú ā, Ujɛhówāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le tá ɛgiyí nū, gaá le ikwū je klá anú iyē kahíníī, Ádā um! Ádā um! úgbɔ́ɔnya mla ɔnya ku ɛfú kú Ísrɛ̄lu, awɔ gwutá yɔ̄ á ā.

eng_Latn: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígbáanɔ gē wu jīla ɔlɛ́ nū tá kóō gbō ayí nū nōó hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē gbō Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē bī ɔdā dúúmā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā ŋ́. É gáā yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā ŋ́, é géē le ɔ́ tū, kó ō wɛ ɛ̄cī otīhɔ lɛ Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je ɔ́da lɛ aádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Da ɔnyā ā kóō gā amānyā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā gā gaá māháyi okómpíinu á.

eng_Latn: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussɛssibássa wā gaá je ikpó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tá ajɛ á, anɔ́ɔ úklɔ́ ā kē húmáyī í yá ŋmíífī ɔ́ɔmā jāā kwiícɛ, amáŋ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā í kē gwó kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
idu_Latn: Ákú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī dɛ̄gba tū ɔ̄ kóō tá ɔ̄ tū ɔwɛ ā lɔhi! Ɔtū kóō híī wú uwɔ, eko nɛ̄ ó gē dɛ̄gba tū uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔ̄kā da ācogbāálá ā kahíníī, Aóklóbīya um, iní nɛ̄ aá ŋmá āa? Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ ŋmá Uháran.

eng_Latn: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Udíssɔn wɛ Uhɛ́mdan, Éssban, Itrán mɛ́mla Ukɛ́ran.

eng_Latn: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ Usɔ́lu hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ ká anúɔ bī ɔ̄ tá kú ɔ̄ nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ anú mla Usámūwɛ̄lu le tá uláyī kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu ce igwáahāanɛ nɛ̄ Ussíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Umenáhem, ɔyí kú Ugádi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā iháyí igwó ipú Usamérīya.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n tú uwɔ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ka ā bī ɛhi kú alelékwū Ihɔ nāa miyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō eko nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ ce wɔ ɛyí ā yúklɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujɛ́hōhasi yá ā, é le uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
idu_Latn: Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔhi klla jɔ̄ɔ̄ncɛ́nyā lɛ ā. Ihɔtū kú uwɔ lɔnyɛ íbí.

eng_Latn: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
idu_Latn: Alɔ yá ucē kú ɔ́bíipú lɛyíkwu uwɔ. Alɔ í klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne nāa je lɛ alɔ ā ŋ́. Alɔ í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne nāa je lɛ alɔ bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, kú aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlá kú nū. Aá híī cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ká ami tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ á. Ó gaá je odōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā yɛ́ɛhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɔtulalī okpócu dóódu nāa jé ā mī klá agōdō kú um ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
idu_Latn: Aá híī bī ɔdā ō miya ɔdā kú újí lɛ miya ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ ákú ɔdā ō gbɛnú ámāŋ ka ɔdā ō lɛwa.

eng_Latn: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē cíla anú ulé nū á. Ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati nyɔ̄ gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū kú ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm wā í jīla ā, eyiyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ujúda le yálé á.

eng_Latn: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī yá Alelékwū Ihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔtūnōbí ŋ́, ohígbū ká ɔdāŋ ka aá lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ ka aá wɛ ákú nū, nōo géē gbo aá cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdā dúú kóō yá aá ŋ́ jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nōó géē nya aá tá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N gē bɛ́yíkwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē ka ɔna ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. É gē ka ɔ̄na ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēe bá ā cāā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, í kōō lɛ ayínu da ɔ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é ī kpó uwā nyíleyī á. Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ń tū uwā ɛhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō ī je ɔ́da lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā, é tīile dúúmā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: Eyī le gbɛnú gā um ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n húmáyī leyītáajɛ yɔ̄ ī gbēyī okónu nāa ce gā um ka, anúɔ í wā gaá hɛ́ um tá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi tá Óndú ā ohi kahíníī, A bī ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti lɛ ɔdā nāa yá ācɛ kú uwɔ ipu ígbíli ā pó.

eng_Latn: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn gē gbō odúúdú aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nēe ŋmá ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi jāā ga ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya mɛ́mla o yɛ ga ɛjī kú Íjīpiti. Odúúdú aéwo ā gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ klla ī da ije ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ ɛpléeko nōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ujóbu kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
idu_Latn: N kwú ɔdā opla ɛnwū mla ɔdā opla ahɔ̄ í kpó gā uwɔ, klla kwú ɔfulā ohɛ́yīfuú ú klá uwɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki lā Arúma, anɔ́ɔ Usébulu le Ugáálu mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū, nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Ussɛ́kɛm á. É lā abɔ́ɔ glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe hile lígíí kéē kwú ikpɛ̄yí kú uwā ú tónū ohígbū um ā, ó wɛ ami ōfōōfū um ŋ́, amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ kú icɔ́ɔci kú aílɔ́wá ā gē tá uwā ahínyá nwuné nwuné.

eng_Latn: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
idu_Latn: Umíssma, Udúma, Umássa.

eng_Latn: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ā, ācɛ ōhī nēe pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ā le cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí nū mla ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā, anɔ́ɔ e da ɔ́ kóō lɛyí kú aíta ā ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa kú Óndú ā gā Usɔ́dɔm ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, Ulɔ́tu cīce okónɔɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Usɔ́dɔm ā. Eko nōó le uwá má ā, ó cāŋjɛ gaá jīla uwá ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ o túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe ī wā ɛgiyí um ā kéē lɛ iyī wā iyē gwu ámāŋ n géē yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
idu_Latn: Ōwē kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā géē nwuné nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ihɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ eko dóódu ā le yɛ uwá jīla tá biílí.

eng_Latn: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kwú ámú igbō aflɛ́yí ā ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ayíka odúúdú igbō ā wɛ ákú nū dúú. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē kwú ɛgba kú ɔcí ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ayíka ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ā kē wɛ ákú nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aá kwú pīya ācɛ nēe gē bɛ́yíkwu Ɔwɔicō. É klla kwú pīya aóklobīya kú ācohéjulúgwu ɛɛ́. É bá yɔ̄ ī leyītáajɛ ɛhi mɛ́mla ómíci nēé géē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ. É gē kɔkɔ lɛ ayókwū únɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ anyōkwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú Óndú ā, kú aá lɛ odúúdú nū yá jila, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, ami háyī pī obugā nyā yɔ̄ á. Eko nɛ̄ ɔyípɔ̄ŋcɛ́nyā éyi gā kóō hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄, n géē da ɔ́ kóō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ je gā ŋmá ipú ɔjá kú nū kú n le gwá.

eng_Latn: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
idu_Latn: É le ohí ɛhɔ̄ kú īlī ā gɔ́ kwɔhá kóō kwú pīya ígwu éyi, é klla le ɛhīlī kú nū gɔ́ kwɔhá kóō kwú pīya ígwu ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yɔ̄ pī ɔ́ yɛɛ, gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔtū kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ā gāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ipíinu ɔlɛ́ uwā géē lɛ agbénú, klla í lɛ ije. Ó klla í yɔ̄ ī yá lɔhi klla í yɔ̄ ī lɛ agbénú tōōtɔ̄ɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū, wā ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ipú aɛ́hɔ̄ ā. Ká ālɔ̄ gaá gbɔga eyīpɔ́lɛ́ ā otú gbɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n cokónu lɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ɔnyā awɔ, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla anyā uwā, ka n géē nyā aá tá.

eng_Latn: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔcɛ́ dúúmā í nyí aógbɛhá ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ŋ́, ó géē cɔcɛ́ gbojī ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wā gaá háyi abɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō hī ɔ̄ igwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē hī ɔ̄ igwú ā kahíníī, Usámūwɛ̄lu, Usámūwɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu tá ohi kahíníī, Kɛlā mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ gē jāhɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó le ɔ̄na éyi nā, nōo je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ó kōō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gbiyɔ̄lā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā nēe bá ā ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ, eko nōó yɔ̄ gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā Ukapánɔm ā.

eng_Latn: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um, ohígbū ka eyī kú uwɔ gē má ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɛlā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu le nwū nɛɛ, é gē mīyɛ ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā bɛ̄ɛka ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ā. Kwu Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Ábsālɔm gē bī ɛlā kú Ahítōfɛlu le yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām cɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ Éfrɔn ka ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛkpa kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛnɛ nōó ka ā gbā lɛ ɔ́ ipéyī ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ije o bī tɔ́ɔ́sú kú uwā lɛ ā ­ā.

eng_Latn: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Udíbɔn, mɛ́mla Unebo, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tdiblátéyim.

eng_Latn: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ɔdā dúúmā nōo ga okónu ā ī yɛ ga ipú cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla i bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya aɔ́mpānū ā géē leyīkwu ɛga nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, Ugíbēyɔn á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē ga ɔgbɛ́fu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ogbenjuwa ā. Ó bī ɔtū caácaá le tútū kóō nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú. Ó lɛ ɛgba ogwū dɛ̄, ó kē bī ɔfú kú nū le aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛbɛ yá ɔ̄ kwɛyí ā, é lɛ awulú kú otombíyē ā kpó ŋmá ɔ́ iyē, anɔ́ɔ é kwú úwé kú nū í kpó wu ɔ́ iyē á. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bītá ga ɛga nēé gáā je ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nōo tɛtɛ yēeyī, amáŋ nóō yēeyī gɛ ŋ́ mā géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔmahātá á. Amáŋ ó wɛ éyi kú ahāapa ā. Ó kē yɔ ī nyɔ̄ kéē je ɔ́ yíífi.

eng_Latn: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔfiyɛ ō cɛ̄ ajɛ Íjīpiti ā, ka n wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Aá géē tīihɔ ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā á, ká n̄ híī cɛ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó le tū um abɔ̄ kóō héyī bī ŋ́, amáŋ kā n̄ lɛ uwá héyī ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā kpɔ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ká ipí ā yɔ̄ ī nyīla, ó wɛ ōcē kú agwú nɛ̄. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ le tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīmā kú nū nwuné nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka a le ɔ́ tábɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Ɛgahi nāa je lɛ ɔ́ ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa le ɔ́ jé.

eng_Latn: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo lɛ āpīicɛ, nɛ̄ āpīicɛ kú nū í kɛ̄ɛpa ŋ́, nɛ ó kē gē lé ácí mlɛ, gē cē ɔ̄ wā okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ ŋ́, wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá géē je tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé ɛbéenyi dóódu nōo lɛ acá mɛ́mla āpū.

eng_Latn: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē yúúfi ā, n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá kwú ɛkpa éyi kú īkpīije ɔdɔ kú uwɔ ā ú tayínū ipú ajɛ á. Mīyɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
idu_Latn: A le uya mla úgbagwú kú īsu trá kéē yɔ̄ cíí dúú. A klla le uya mɛ́mla oōwu klíicō kú alɛɛcɛ trá, le ɔ́ kwú tū cíí dúú.

eng_Latn: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ka é géē je ojibó kú ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā ā ga Asírīya géē je ɔ́ gbā ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ɛ̄gbā, kóō wɛ ɔdá kú ojīlīma kú nū nēé bī gé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛfú. É géē kpó uwēyī tū Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí. Uwēyī klla géē kwú ɔ́, ohígbū ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
idu_Latn: Pó ifu nɛ̄ aálagbá ā bá ī tá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ káā bí ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ aólɛlā tútū kéē kpó ŋmó ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ igwó ɔhá hīgwú wā í cīce abɔ́ɔ dúú. Eko nɛ̄ uwá má cīce ā.

eng_Latn: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ gaá le da ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ bá mla anú ā. É bá yɔ̄ ī yɔ́tūnōbí klla bá yɔ̄ ī jikwū.

eng_Latn: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe jéeyī klla jé odée nɛ̄hi ā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
idu_Latn: É géē tá opo éyi táalúúúu. ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ aá lɛ opo ɔ́ɔmā pó ā, odúúdú ācɛ ā géē dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi, ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko ā géē je wúla wā ajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja ā géē bēé ga ipú ɔlɛ́ ā bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olɔdu mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī pīya alɔ tū ā, húmáyī yá alɔ ɛbɛ́ gbojī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
idu_Latn: É lɛ oje ɔdɔ ma plla ajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogbāājɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɛlā nēe bá nyā pó ā, ó le yá uwā eyījii ohígbū ka é jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nyā í ŋmɛ́yí lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
idu_Latn: N ka ipú ɔtū kú um kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ā. Ohígbū ka, ó lɛ eko kú ɛpɔ̄ tū lɛ ɔdā dóódu, mɛ́mla úklɔ́ dóódu kú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
idu_Latn: Ó le abɔ̄ yá lɛ uwā kéē bá cíí, ó kā uwā ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ināgbá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔdā nyā da Ujémīsi mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ alɔ ohile. anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɛga ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú aá nōo yɔ̄ ipú unwalu uu? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄. Ɔtū he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō gwííjē ocɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú klla yá ucē nɛ̄ ó le kpaakpa ŋ́. É wɛ ācɛ nēé tōō lɛ ɔtūce uwá ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɔtā nɛ̄ ó lɔhi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
idu_Latn: Ó gē nū aólɛlā kú nū inya fíyafíya lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū ī kwu ajɛ ŋ́ mā. Ɔdā dóódu í kē yá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé gē nwū ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ nēé gē pi uwá anú ā lɔhi lɛ uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é habɔ̄ ɔyí dúúmā tá kóō kwú ɔwɛ kú abɔ̄yī nū ú, ó gē kpó uwēyī tū ɛ́nɛ́ nū ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, oyēeyī le wú um ɔtū. Odúúdú ɔdā nēe yɔ̄ ipu ɛcɛ ā gē bī unwalu gé um. Odúúdú ūwā wɛ áncā, mɛ́mla owu oōnū inya nɛ.

eng_Latn: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, aútíca kú íne ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufarísīi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ okónu lɔfú lɔfú. É klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú a da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
idu_Latn: Ā híī mímálānyī kú agbénú nɛ̄ ācobīyíne gē lɛ ā ŋ́. Ɔtū kú uwɔ kóō kwu ufi kú Óndú ā ō yá.

eng_Latn: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ! Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le tútū, ohígbū ka aá í jé eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā le jīla tɔ̄há kéē téyī tá ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
idu_Latn: ayíka ó lɛ agwú obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ipú ɔkpíyē kú nū. ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka ka ɔ́ le tēelihɔ, ó gáā jila anú igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó tá péee koó le tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
idu_Latn: Lɛ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔnyā ōgbajā ā. Ā kōō híī túbla okómpíinu kú ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɔnyā ā bī nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ɛyí plá klla lɛ ūkwū abɔ̄ kú nū kpó cē.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da uwɔ ka, ayíka é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ma igbɔhá ámāŋ ó gáā má ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni bī éŋkpɔ̄ gē le yá ācɛ Ubatísim, amáŋ ofíílí ká ɛ̄cī alɛwa kóō yá, é géē bī Alelékwū Ihɔ yá aá Ubatísim.

eng_Latn: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
idu_Latn: Nááná n gē lɛ eyīyōce eko nɛ̄ n le blakwu ɔdā ékpónú nyā.

eng_Latn: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛwa ā le ɔ́ má ā ufi yá uwā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo je íkwu ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ lā ipú ɔkpíyē kú alɔ nōo ī kwú ā, ó gē yá kú alɔ tíifu, amáŋ ó wɛ ka alɔ tíne ō kwú kú alɔ híīī lɛ ɔkpíyē dóódu fúlufúlu ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ alɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē kwú ɔkpíyē kú ɔkpáncō ā wu alɔ iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔkpíyē nōo ī kwú ā le pīyabɔ̄ ga oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔ́ nū ā, ó kwú Udéfīdi ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cījáalí kú nū ka, N le má ka Udéfīdi, ɔyí kú Ujése, wɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū, nōo géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n tíne kóō yá.

eng_Latn: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
idu_Latn: Upálalu, ɔyí kú Usáyi ma ɔdɔ ŋmá ɔ́kíkā ā, mɛ́mla ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda kú ɛgiyí Agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā gaá kwu ɛgiyí ācogbāajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ipú nū ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aá lɛ iwili kú nū túbá ká ɔdā dúúmā kóō bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú icɔ́ɔci nēe bá ajɛ kú Ujúdíya mɛ́mla Ugálīli mɛ́mla Usamérīya lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ, é klla lɔfú lɛ fíyɛ́. É yēeyī ipú ufi kú Óndú ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā tá uwā abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é le nyīla ikpó ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, aá í gwéeyē piíí dúú cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ká um gwéeyē mla aá dúú.

eng_Latn: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú ká aá í móowē, óō híī wɛ ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā ŋ́, uwī nɛ̄ ó wī ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka íne nɛ̄ ó bīya a ŋ́, ámāŋ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá abɔ̄ ācɛ gē hī aá ka ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú ācɛ cīce lɛ Ujísɔ̄si yɛjīlatá biílí, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā bá ɛcɛ, ī tíne ō má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ kwú īkpɛ̄yí ā ú tá ipú oflēnje, kwú ɔ̄ ú gé lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí omlede nōo ī yɛce óndú nū cīīī, í jé kēé bī anúɔ nyɔ̄ gáā ŋmó ŋ́ mā. Ń jé ka ami nēé bá í tū ujɔ̄ kpɛ́mm ā tū um ā ŋ́. É bá ī ka ka. Alɔ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó eko nōó wɛ ɔyípōklóbīya ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē hɛ́ ɔcí wā ajɛ, eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gwá īkpō kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō klla blakwu ɔ́ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔyí ā, ká ā yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́! Abālɔbányā n jé ka a gē yúúfi Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ á tá ō je ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú ā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā kahíníī, Aá gē tíne kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ dúú nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú Ufilístiya ā gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi nɛ̄hi. Kwu ācɛ nɛ̄ gē kpɛ́fú ɔnya mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ɔlamu kú uwā ā, gbo ɔɔ́ ō fīyégblú ipú ufi. Ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō jíliyē, ipú kwú gbogodo lɛ uwá.
