eng_Latn: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īlī ā gbo uwɔ ohí kli ­ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda kéē bá um píyɔ́ɔ́ lɛ á. N yá ɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ ga um lóofu, nɛ̄ ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra um klla je ojīlīma gā um. Amáŋ é tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um.

eng_Latn: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ufígi kú uwá kpó ŋmó mla ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ mɛ́mla owu.

eng_Latn: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó má aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le jīla bá í yá ojuju. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkpani, n lɛ ɛhɔ̄ éyi ō cē gā awɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu dɔɔ̄kā ka ɛ̄nyá kú aá nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anú nɛ, ɔkpáni.

eng_Latn: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ami wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí ufáyin á, Ádā um wɛ ɔgɛ́ɛjí ō leyīkwu ɔcí ufáyin ā á.

eng_Latn: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ācīije kú ɔ̄conyiīkpɔ̄dā ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kpa kú ɔ́kíkā ā kwɔhá ŋmá ɛháajɛ jāā ga ɛhíícō. Aɔ́kpa ɛpa nēe je pīya ɔ́kíkā kú inū ā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gbā uwā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú ɔdā olɔhi ōyá kóō jɛ̄ alɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ í gbagbafú je cīgbīhi ŋ́, eko géē wā nɛ̄ alɔ géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā alɔ da alɔ kahíníī, Aá jé ka ɔnyā um ā ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa gā um.

eng_Latn: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
idu_Latn: Ká ā kwú odúúdú íne kú uwɔ nēé bīya ā mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nēé bī tū uwɔ ā ú yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ a yá kú aólɛlā kú uwā kéē gbonɛnɛ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔfú ú kpó ŋmá iyē kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ipú ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú nū. Ó tá kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú alɔ wā í kpɛ́fú tá alɔ ā. Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nu yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ klá alɔ blublu bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Ó le ɔdā dóódu kú alɔ kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a wā í le abɔ̄ tá um, anɔ́ɔ a klla le oyēeyī kú um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
idu_Latn: Kéē gebí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ajɛ je gwá tīiyē ā. Ācɛ kéē lɛ uwá da tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ácí nēe bū kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ayíkābɔ̄ kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná ā lɛ ­­ōhī kú anɔ̄ ā mī klá abɔ́ɔ igbāhāapa ipéyī Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔnyā ā le gbojī ō wā ā, ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ odúúdú uwā, anɔ́ɔ uwá lɛ iyɔ̄lā kpó gbo á.

eng_Latn: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, abɔ̄ n lɛ úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá ā yá kwɛyí ipú aígelī nēe bá amānyā ɛ́ɛ́ mā, abɔ̄ n kē húmáyī dɔɔ̄kā iháyí alɛwa ká n̄ wā í lɛ aá má ā.

eng_Latn: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ lɛ ā, nɛ̄ a ka anúɔ í má ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. A klla ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú anúɔ bī wā iyɔ̄bū nū klla yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ɔdā nōo géē yá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ń nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ufilístiya ā? A géē je uwá ga um ká n yá uwá lé? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, a géē yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma ā je īkpō ugóolu úlā ofɛpacigwó, mɛ́mla īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwó.

eng_Latn: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nōo lɛ īlī odufā, īlī nɔwā, mɛ́mla īlī ɔgalúlā, īlī ɔnwū kú ɛwū, mɛ́mla ɔkpá omlede nēé le tɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔ̄wá, ámāŋ ka ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ olɔhi ɔhá ā, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó wā á.

eng_Latn: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm wā gaá mīyɛ Ɛ́lāti ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Ujúda. É le ācɛ kú Ujúda kpó nū ŋmá Ɛ́lāti. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ā gaá lā Ɛ́lāti jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔcí kú ufáyin kú alɔ ā ú yíífi ɛɛ́, é klla kwú ɔcí ufígi kú alɔ ú lé ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́. É kwú ɔcí ā ú gwā āpū, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ abɔ̄ ɔcí ā kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá ɛla ɔkwɛ̄yi, ń gáā gwá enyi kú īkpō kú ɔcí ufáyin nya ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n géē gwá ɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ́wá kú aéfūma nōo klá ɛyí ɔdɔ kpɛm eko nɛ̄ iyē ī hīlaŋ́dɔ́ ā. Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gā ɛcɛ, é le pɛ́ wu nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɛga nēé pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
idu_Latn: A ka abɔ̄ kú anúɔ le péee, anúɔ í kē yá ucē obɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́. A klla ka anúɔ gē lā oyēeyī okpaakpa, ka anúɔ í kē gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo kwɛyí Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ó tū um ɛhɔ̄ ká n̄ yá ká ācɛ nɛ̄ ó fu ā kéē lɔtū ce ɔ̄, ká n̄ klla lɛ uwa bī ipú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ká alɔ gē nwū ā.

eng_Latn: Let brotherly love continue.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī yíihɔtū tá ayínɛ́ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá.

eng_Latn: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
idu_Latn: Usálmɔ̄n wɛ ádā kú Ubówāsi, Ubówāsi wɛ ádā kú Óbɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kahíníī, Amáŋ abālɔbányā, n géē ményinyi kú ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, klla í yá uwá ká ē agbénú kóō klla lɔhi lɛ uwá igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. N kē géē jimélī ohígbū iyē kú um nɛ̄ ó tōō le gbla iyē ɔhá ŋ mā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, n géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwɔ, n géē lɛ uwɔ tū ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a ī nyɔ̄. N géē je uwɔ kwúcē wāajɛ nyā. Ń gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hī uwɔ tá ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n géē yá gā uwɔ ā yá.

eng_Latn: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú īyī nū ú pīya olíla mla ojɛɛ́lɛ́ ɛgiyí uwā á. Eko dúúmā nēé gā ɛgiyí nū. Ó gē yɔ̄ í tɔ́kpá tū ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ágba klá ɔnwū agba kú nū wāajɛ klá.

eng_Latn: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
idu_Latn: Ɔbɔ́nyā ō yá, géē yá ká ɔbá ɔnyā kóō cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ó gáā mā ɔdā dúú tá ajɛ, eko nɛ̄ ó gē gwɔ̄ ɔ́ci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ kú íne igwó ā ú kpó tū ipú Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ogbló kú Ikpati ā kpó wu ipú aéliká kú ikpati ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄wū ú klá anú á.

eng_Latn: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó wɛ á. Ɛ̄cī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í yɔ̄ jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó géē wɛ eko kú unwalu lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wɛ ayáayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, amáŋ é géē nyá uwá tá ŋmá ipú unwalu ā.

eng_Latn: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ugébríyɛ̄lu nōo ī háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō á. Anú tū um ɛhɔ̄ ká n̄ bī ɔ̄kōolɔhi nyā gé lɛ uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD, and my work with my God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n ka, n lɛ úklɔ́ yá bónū áncā ɛɛ́. N klla bī ɔfú kú um lɛ úklɔ́ yá tū iyē áncā ɛɛ́. Nááná n lɔtūce Óndú ā ka anú nɛ̄ n yúklɔ́ ā lɛ ɔ́ á, ó kē í cíla um ulé kú úklɔ́ dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā.

eng_Latn: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ le pīyatɔ̄há mla aéwɔhá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nɛ̄ ó jé ɔlá lɔhi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
idu_Latn: N lɛ aɛ́cɛ, aɔ́ká ōtū abɔ̄ mla agbá ōtū ɔkɔ kpó tū uwɔ iyē.

eng_Latn: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ tá fīyajɛ. Abɔ̄ Umósīsi le ɔ́ tá fīyajɛ ā, ó kwú pīya ɛgwā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá ɔnyā nū nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá lɛ, le ajā gbo. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le ɔnyā nēé tá lɛ kē le ajā gbo dúú.

eng_Latn: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ aá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ɛɛ́, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá nyā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá géē wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ piyóó, é géē bá ī ce ɛfú klla í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
idu_Latn: Uréhum, Uhássābina, Umáasáya.

eng_Latn: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
idu_Latn: É géē bī átákwū mɛ́mla amɛ̄ nēé jíliyē ā wā eko nēé bī ijē wā kóō wɛ odée kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé gé lɛ Óndú ā. Aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā wɛ ákú uwɔ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gbóógbóō ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí nū nɔnyā éyi ú lɛ ɔ́ ɔnyā á. Ó ma ɔyí éyi lɛ ɔfiyɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, nōo lé ka Átāyi.

eng_Latn: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gwó kwɛyí á. Ɔcí nēé hī usɛ́da ā nēé bī le gwu ɛyí inu ā eyīipú á.

eng_Latn: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā lé kóō wɛ odúúdú ayí nɛ̄ Ébrahām tíyē ma ā wɛ ayí Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́, amáŋ ayí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ Ébrahām ā wɛ ayí nū á.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam gē ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, gaá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā, aídengéli ā géē kpó aɔ́kplɛ́fú tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú uwā í cīgbīhi nyɔ̄, eko nōo lɛ ɔkɔ gbā kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
idu_Latn: Usáyírɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kwú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, dóódu nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm, gāa bá inu ɛcí kú nū ā, ī kpó kwúcē igbīhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū, wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ōfōōfūnū ā gē gbō alɔ ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Ébɛ̄lu gwɛ́ɛya nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ Ukéni gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā á. O ŋmá lɛ ɛya nōó gwó ā, é cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi, Ɔwɔicō klla cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ijáalí ŋmá lɛ ɛhi kú nū nōó mīyɛ ā. Nááná nōó gekwú ā, ó gē kɛlā lɛ alɔ ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce kú nū jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ ɛyí hɛ́, le iyɔ́fú kú nū kpó. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga ipú ajɛ kú Ufilístiya dóódu, ka ɛɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā bī gē lɛ ɛcí kú uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ójīla ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn nēe hile bá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ kú Urímɔn ā, klla le da uwá ka ɛfú kú aá mla uwá ɔ́ɔ mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee, which are not of the cities of these nations.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā yá aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe lɛ ligbó lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā lā anú ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛdɔ ācɛ nēe bá ā í lɛ ā ŋ́, ohígbū kéē bá yɔ̄ ī jē ukpa tá ajɛ lɛ iyī uwā, uwá nɛ̄ ukpa nēé je pií ā kē gáā ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā úklɔ́ olɔhi tɛ́ɛcɛ cāā, ó kōō ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó tá cāā ŋ́ nááná, í ke tayínū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nēe bá ā yá ká ɛlā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ikpokwú kú nū dúúmā í gaá cē ŋ́ mā, kóō le yájīla.

eng_Latn: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um í wāajɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka ń má ɔyínɛ́ alɔ Utáyítɔ̄si abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ n le ńŋmóō tá ācɛ kú Utrówāsi anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ tá Umasɛdónīya á.

eng_Latn: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujémīsi, mɛ́mla Ujúdasi Isikáriyɔ̄tu, nōo je pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíbīyājɛ tū Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
idu_Latn: Umágipīyasi, Uméssūlam, Uhɛ́siyɛ.

eng_Latn: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛbɛ ámāŋ ɔ̄na kú nū ā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú cɛ̄. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔ kē lɔfú da uwá kéē wā í gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbā ɛ̄gbā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gaá háyi okónɔɔwɛ igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ koó yá uwɔ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí igbahāapa ɛ̄cī ékpónú, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛgiyí uwɔ igbahāapa ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, N le pīyabɔ̄ ɛɛ́, kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi piíí.

eng_Latn: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujannisi mɛ́mla Ujámbresi tá Umósīsi áafú ā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ge tá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛ á. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā í gē yúklɔ́ ŋ́, oōwɛ ɔ̄cōlóhɔ́nyɛtá kú uwā í tīile lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the LORD of the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá um ohi kahíníī, Aɛ́nyā wɛ ācɛ ɛpa nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu, le anɔ̄ tū uwā ɛyí kéē yúklɔ́ iyɔ̄bū Óndú kú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā piyóó ā á.

eng_Latn: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū aígabɔ̄ ā, é bá ī gwéeyē ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le uwá fu kéē cíkā nēé ī juwēyī lɛ uwá ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāsi lɛ Amásīya abɔ̄yī nū ā kwú. Ó klla le bēé ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm gaá le ɔdɔ kú nū wúla tāajɛ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú Ɛ́frem jāā ga ɔwɛ kú ɔ́kíkā kú ɔlɛ́ ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ó ca tāajɛ a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó úlā ce ofu igwó.

eng_Latn: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛhī kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ákú Ujúda ā géē wɛ otīihɔ lɛ Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē wā í gwɛ́ɛya ā, géē bī uwā le he ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nɛ̄ ó gwó ā ɛyí ɔlá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cotɔ́sú í gáā yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kpó ayí obene kú aá, gē je uwá kpó ca klá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
idu_Latn: É wɛ oyēeyī lɛ odo kú uwɔ̄, Oyéeyī kú ɔnyɛ mɛ́mla éeyē nēé gáā je gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Eko nēé gā ɛcɛ ā, é le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le īyī nū mafú lɛ ācɛ ā, yɔ̄ ī ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá ā gā ɛgiyí ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
idu_Latn: Ɛpláko kú ucɛ kú Onyatá ā, ó gē wɛ ucē kú Upáyílēti kóō hɛ́ olagbá éyi tá lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá cɛ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka nyā, ayíka aɔ́cɛ́ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi nēe gē cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā géē bá ī ce aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya bēhé aókómpinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ nyā á.

eng_Latn: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Amásīya í kē ŋmó ayí uwā mla uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ó yɛce íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi kahíníī, É gáā ŋmó ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ayí uwā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē ŋmó ayí kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bī kú ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ŋ́. É gē ŋmó ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā? Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó le tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ń má ɔdā ō bī le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛpɔ̄bí nóó.

eng_Latn: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
idu_Latn: Aá í tá ɛlā kú ebilíi, ká aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō lɔfúlɔfú, aá jé ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá nēe bá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ nyā, bá gē má ɛdɔ kú ōwē nɛ̄ aá bá gē má nyā dúú.

eng_Latn: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aɔ́kpani uwā kéē da uwá kahíníī, Ami Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbā ā, ka.

eng_Latn: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gē yá ōfōōfūnū ā, wɛ ō yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā ō lɛ ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkpaakpa ā gē lɛ odée eko dóódu, klla yɔ̄ ī je lɛ ācɛ ŋmá ɔtū kú nū.

eng_Latn: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbā ubáalu ɛ̄gbā klla gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔtū bīya bɛ̄ɛka ádáádā nū nēe tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yújulu mɛ́mla ācɛ o kwáahi cíkā ō kllɔcɛ́ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aɛ́yilɔ gē yá odée kú uwā lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jéeyī.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄bā ā, nɛ̄ aá tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu ɔ́ ka amíyɔ̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu aá ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé ō bɔ́lá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔcɛ́ bá ipú ómbilí ɔ́mɛtá ā, anɔ́ɔ aígbáanɔ yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, ká ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gē ka ka ɔyí oyeeyī ā wɛ akú anúɔ á, ɔyí nōo kwú ā ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ákū ɔ́mpa anúɔ.

eng_Latn: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwɛ́tá ā wɛ Ussébūwɛlu.

eng_Latn: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
idu_Latn: Asmáfɛ̄ti ŋmá Ussaálibɔn.

eng_Latn: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kóō yá kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō méyīnyinyi aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú Ubɛ́njamin mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ aá ɔhá ā í kwúcē igbīhi lɛ aá. Ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ ami nɛ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka ayí um géē kwú piíí nɛɛ, é géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ka ɔdā dóódu nōo lɛ iyē kwu ícɛ̄bɛ́ nēé ŋmó ā géē je tēelīhɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ ka oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā le tá klá ɔdōwiyē kú uwā dóódu, é géē na ɔ́ ɛga otīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya gē kwinya ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛɛ? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔfú bī ɔbɛ́ɛna hɛ́hɔ̄ eyī kú ísu glá āā? Amáŋ, aá le ɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā pīya ɛcí ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, aá klla kwú ɛpɔ̄hi ō lé, ú pīya ɔdā ohɔ́ɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwúcē wā í tá ācɛ ofu igwó nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bēé ɔkpá gɔbū ŋ́ mā. É le pɛ́ wā í jīla Udéfīdi ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le tá ɛgiyí uwā, le okónu hɛ́ tū uwá lɔɔlɔhi á.

eng_Latn: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ um lɛ ō ka ā. Ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ aá tá um ɔtū lé glá á.

eng_Latn: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla Usáfrɔn, Ukálāmɔsi, mɛ́mla Usinámɔn, ámāŋ ɛdɔ kú ɔtulalī dóódu.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ nōó yɛ okómpīinu ga ipú igá kú álá ŋ́, amáŋ nōó le icō ɔdɔ tū le yɛ ɔ́gba wā eyīpú wɛ uwī mɛ́mla ohéjulúgwu.

eng_Latn: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́drɔ́ nááná, ɛ̄jɛ̄ gē jɛ̄ uwā. Abɔ̄ kē ī hɛ́ ayípōklóbīya iyē dúú.

eng_Latn: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lāyi nɛ̄ ɛlā kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄hi ā, cīce okónu ɔwɛ leyīkwu ɔwɛ gɛɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā le ɔ̄kā kú ɛfú nōo lé uwā ā ca kllɛcɛ ga ɛga dúúdu kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō jikwu wōōō á.

eng_Latn: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ō ce um ojīlīmā ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ n gē tū ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ákú igbīhāajɛ klá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá, nɛ̄ n gē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ aá iháyí dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umikáya tā ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Oŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú nōo yēeyī ā, ɔdā dúúmā nōó ka gā um ā, nɛ̄ n géē ka á.

eng_Latn: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.
idu_Latn: Ehée, ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipú aá ōfōōfū uwā gáā nyɔ̄ í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā á, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔnia wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ é le Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nū ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro á.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Amɔ̄si le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Usíya yá, eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā tá tāajɛ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá ɛcī ɔ́ɔmā, yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í bī iyē kú aá eko nēé yɔ̄ ī hɔ́hā ce ācɛ. É géē ka ká Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ uwɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka Ɛfrém mɛ́mla Umanásɛ ā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu je Ɛ́frém gbɔ̄bū lɛ Umanáse á.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā ī kpó ɛlā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ce ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ó kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́ mā kóō gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
idu_Latn: É lā ipú ajɛ kú Ubássan mɛ́mla Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ácí kú Ussárɔn.

eng_Latn: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Abíjam gekwú anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Ása le ɔcɛ́ le kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi gā ajaajɛ ɔlɛ́, gáā lɛ ɛna kú ugóolu nēé ma ā má, mla ijē nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ ī jē ā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛcɔ̄ nēé tá aíne tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó bī ā kpó tá wāajɛ le uwá kpó ca.

eng_Latn: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
idu_Latn: A lɔfú je ɔlá bɔ́tū kú uwɔ, nɛ̄ ó gáā je uwɔ īlī yɔɔlá ŋ́ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō má akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwolímanya ā, mɛ́mla ɔkɔ kú opo mɛ́mla ódūdū nōo yɔ̄ ī tá ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā. Uwá bá yɔ i yúufi klla ī fīyégbúlú, anɔ́ɔ é má háyi ɛcɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ lɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí yá uwɔ, nyɔ̄ í le aɔ́dā nōó yá uwɔ ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla anú ɛpa ofōōfū aá. Ɔ́dāŋ koó le ahɔ̄ jē gā uwɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kwajɛ, ayíka aá lɛ pīya ayínɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú aójibó kú aéwo ɔhá nēé gē pā ā ú kpó bónū, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ákanya kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā gbɔɔ́ ō je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujɔ́ni le da Uhérɔ̄du, nōo wɛ igbómína ā péee ka ucē nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā í lɔhi ŋ́, ohígbū ka Uhérɔ̄du le Uherodíyāsi, ɔnyā kú ɔyínɛ́ nū yíla ŋmá ɔlɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ lɛ á. Ó klla yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí alɛwa dúú.

eng_Latn: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā da aá ɔ̄kā ka, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá í yá abɔ́ɔ, aá da ɔ́ ka ɔkpani ā ī dɔɔ̄kā nū, ó kē í je ɔ́ lɛ aá wā bōōbū.

eng_Latn: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
idu_Latn: Usákāyi wɛ úlā ce ofu igwáahātá.

eng_Latn: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, A kē jé ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ka íkée ka, Ācɛ obɔ̄bí ōfōōfūnū gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɛlā ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ka ipú ɛka nɛ̄ Óndú gbo ā ɔwɛ dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ uwá gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā í lɛwa ajɛ kú Ukénan eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, é klla wɛ aúgbɔga ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
idu_Latn: Ɔmā lɔhi amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔmā í lɔnyɛ ɔmā gɛ ŋ́, ó lɛ ɔwɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú yá ɔ̄ kóō lɔnyɛ ɔmā ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛtá lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli. Ukédisi nōo yɔ̄ Ugálíli ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú nū, , Uhámɔti Udɔ, mɛ́mla Ukátan, mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujoyánan, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Urésa, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɛrúbābɛlu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussēyatíyɛlu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unéri.

eng_Latn: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
idu_Latn: Utébulu mɛ́mla ɔcí kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū ɔhá ā. Igbō nēé gē je kú ɛ̄gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó géē ka ka anúɔ í wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ka anúɔ wɛ ɔgɛ́ɛjí nɛ̄. Ó klla í ka ka anúɔ húmáyī hɛ́ɛ́hɔ̄ ŋmífī nɛ̄ anúɔ wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā māháyi pī um abɔ́ɔ ā, n pó ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā kɛlā gā um ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā wā ká ā lɛ ukafután kpó wu uwá iyē.

eng_Latn: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
idu_Latn: N wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɛbɛɛbɛ̄, kwu ajaajɛ mɛ́mla ɛga oligbó.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
idu_Latn: A géē yá ɔ́n̄gbá kú oje udɔ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
idu_Latn: kwu ɛhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu, Usɔ́ɔlu nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, Ábna ɔyí kú Unɛ́ɛ, mɛ́mla Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Usérúya gē kpó gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, Usélɔ̄miti mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū ā gē leyīkwu ɛhi nyā á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ kú aéwo ɔhá igwó géē wā ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ékpónú gaá lɛ abɔ̄ bī okónōgwu kú awulú kú nū, géē da ɔ́, Ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ mla awɔ, ohígbū ka alɔ le pó ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
idu_Latn: Ohi kú ɛlā o tá ɛmɛɛma, gē cɛ̄ lɛ ícɔ̄nū ī mɛ. Amáŋ ohi ɛlā ō tá ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú kplúká gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū wú ɔ̄cɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, jāhɔ̄, ká ā pó ɛlā kú íjééyī mɛ́mla ɛyí odée ō jé kú um.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ āā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hī Óndú ā kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄, ó géē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du gekwú ā, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā éyi wā ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu ipú ɔ̄na ajɛ Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ Uhɛ́burɔn, lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú nū kpó ŋmó. É klla lɛ ācɛ kú aigelī nēe kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā kpó ŋmó. Ujóssuwa ka kē lɛ aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kpó yíífi dúúdú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá Églɔn ā. É mā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā tá yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Áyísīki gekwú ā, anɔ́ɔ ayí nū Ísɔ mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu lɛ ɔ́ nyi á.

eng_Latn: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó géē lɛ eko ámōōmɛ á. Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā géē wɛ̄ɛcɛ, é kē í yā ācɛ obɔ̄bí ā ŋmá ācɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
idu_Latn: Aá yíihɔtū tá Óndú ā, odúúdú ācɛ o yá uce kpaakpa kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Óndú ā gē gbō ācɛ nōo gē yɛce ɔ́ kpaakpa ā. Amáŋ ó kē i cílá ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā ulé kú ucē kú nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nāa gē nwū ā, gē nwū um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n géē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā lɛ ā. A kē í cíla um ulé olɔhi nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka n kwú iyī um ú táajɛ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kpó ede mɛ́mla ikpɛ́cí kú ācɛ o pā ɛcí ā yíífi ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í bī ɔtū ékpónú le gbā Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta, mɛ́mla Utɔ́mɔ̄si nēé hī ka Áplɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Unatánīyɛ̄lu, ɔ̄cɛ Ukéna kú Ugálīli ā, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa kú Usébēdi ā, mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa ɔhá bá tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
idu_Latn: Ā híī yá um italā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Akwū nāa yɔ̄ ī le tū um ā, gáā je um ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄, Óndú? Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ ā tóohi kahíníī, N wɛ Ujísɔ̄si nāa gē bɛ́yíkwu á.

eng_Latn: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ í lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́, anú abɔ̄yī nu í gáā lɛ ɔtūce alɔ ŋ́ dúú. Ohígbū ka ó gáā pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá o wɛ ɔhɔnyɛtá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
idu_Latn: Aá hɛ́ ɔdā dóódu mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē je yá ɔnyā ɛhi dóódu ā gā um, n géē je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ka lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
idu_Latn: Otū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn ipú ɔ̄na gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a dɔɔ̄kā ká n je ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē kpó omlede mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ólīifu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwá jíliyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɛhi nōo cɛgbá lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
idu_Latn: Ó pīyeyī má icō, anɔ́ɔ ó le aúnóji nēe bá ɛyí ɛfu ā má. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ le aíkpokwú nēe bá ipú aúnóji ā kpó wā ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó tū ɔlá ɛyí ede á. Ó bī ɔwɛ nyā le ede ā nyílá. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi ka eko kú ucɛ nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔcɛ́ ā háyi pī ede ā yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya ā kóō lɛ yá ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ujosíya pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ ó le únóji kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā má kwu ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, N le íne bīya ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka n lɛ íne kú Óndú ā bīya ń klla kē le ukɔ́ nāa tū um ā yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n le ufi ācɛ ā yá klla le ɔkɔ kú uwā pó.

eng_Latn: But ye are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó géē bɔ̄bí lɛ aá nēe cīgbīhi kwú um, í klla lɛ ɛlá wu Usáyɔn, ɛfu otīhɔ kú um ŋ́ mā. Aá klla gē nyɔ̄ ī pā aɛ́cí nēé hī ka Ugádi mɛ́mla Uméni ā. Aá gbɛlá ka ɛcí kú aflɛ́yí ɔ́ɔmā géē je ɛyí olɔhi lɛ aá. Ka ɔ́mpā ā ɔ́ɔ kē ī miya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya lɛ ɔkpá tá fu aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá, nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti tóohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu nɛɛ? Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya bī uwɔ wā ɛgiyí um á. Ɔdí nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā awɔ á, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú, ó lɛ ɔtū má ɔ̄ eyī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
idu_Latn: É kōō lɛ ijáalí kú ɛlā nēé kpó ce um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, nōo lɛ ɛlā kú okónu ō ce ā pó, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ī ka lɛ iyī nū ipú ɔtū kú nú ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í kōō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɛka ā ŋ́ nááná, ɔ́ɔ géē lɔhi lɛ anúɔ, ɛ́ɛ klla í hɔ́hā ce anúɔ. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá le tá ɛga nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ó da uwá ka uce nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔ́ɔmā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ūwā í kpó yíifi, kwu ācobɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔhi.

eng_Latn: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́kssan wɛ ádā kú Ussɛ́ba mɛ́mla Udɛ́dan á. Ayí kú Udɛ́dan wɛ Assúrim, Ulɛ̄tussím, mɛ́mla Uleyúmim.

eng_Latn: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
idu_Latn: A ka ka anúɔ lɛ okónu ce mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ fu ā ɛɛ́, Ka anúɔ le okónu ce lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Ukarími.

eng_Latn: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā je ɔdā dúúmā fūla anú ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó í je ɔ́ fūlabɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē je ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí fūla olɔhi ámāŋ je ɛbɛ́ olɔhi fūla obɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó kwú ɛbɛ́ éyi ú kwɛyí ɛbɛ́ ɔhá, ɛbɛ́ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā kwú pīya ákú Óndú ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.
idu_Latn: Amárīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē hɛ́pɔ̄ ámōōmɛ kú odúúdú ɛlā nōo yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛlā kú Óndú ā á. Ɛpɔ̄ o hile dóódu ɔhá ā, Usebadáya, ɔyí kú Íssimɛ̄lu igbómína kú Ujúda ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ámōōmɛ kú nū ō hɛ́ á. Āyā kú ayí Ulífāyi ā géē má ka ɛpɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ géē hɛ́ ā, ācɛ o lɛɛpɔ̄ ā í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ klla í bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ piíí. Aá lé ɔtū le ka aá lɛ ɛlā kú um nya bī yúklɔ́. Óndú ā kóō yɛce āyā nōo le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya kahíníī, Óndú, a lɛ um plla, n kē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ lɛ um plla ɔkwɛ̄yi. Abɔ̄ a lɔfú fíyɛ́ um ā, abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kē le fíyɛ́ ákú um ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ācɛ bá ī cokónu gbɛdɛɛ tú um. É klla bá ī ya um okónu eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Umósīsi gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ le íne bīya ɛɛ́, alɔ le iŋini ka tū Óndú ā mɛ́mla uwɔ. Gbɔ̄ɔ̄kɔ lɛ Óndú ā kóō kwú ɛgwā nyā ú ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ alɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔkɔ gbā ohígbū ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
idu_Latn: Ó gē jɛ̄ klla ī kwú bɛ̄ɛka ododó nōo ī nwūla ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, klla gē je ŋmɔ́lá tū ajɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā. Ó géē bí tāajɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojiji nōó gē yɔ̄ gbojī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
idu_Latn: Amínādabu wɛ ádā kú Unássɔn, Unássɔn wɛ ádā kú Usálmɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛhīlī ce úlā ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ um ɔtā cē bá um ɔtū, nɛ̄ ń yá ɔdā dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́ mā, eko dúú nēé lɛ um má, é yá um ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
idu_Latn: Eko kpíí le gla, Ujísɔ̄si gā ŋmá Unásārēti nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔlɛ́ okwubɔ́ha kú Ugálīli ā, anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni lɛ ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō kpó tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ipú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā kú ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā tá ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō híī lɛ ɔ́ ɔnyā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā géē gbā ije nōo jónjīlɛ mla ije ɔnyā ā lɛ ádā ɔyí nɔ̄nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfú kú Ugílibōwa eko ɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ n má Usɔ́ɔlu le óbō kwu ajɛ kóō bī īyī nū hayiicō. N kē má ka aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú mɛ́mla ācɛ o cɔnya ɛfú kú aólɛlā ā le kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ gáā kwú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu ā, n le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tá um abɔ̄. Ó kē le ohi tú um, kē le um tábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē jē ɔ́ yá ɔdā ō bī lɛ cābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā. Ó ka Óndú ā klla í bī okónu ō tá nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛka nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne ā lɛ yá ɔ̄ ɛlā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó ɛtá ā le hīlatá wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛwa kú ācɛ wā í jīla Ujísɔ̄si ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa ā géē gwéeyē eko nēé má ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú yá italā. É géē yɛhɛ klla í yá uwā okónu.

eng_Latn: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ohígbū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá tá um abɔ̄ ipú úklɔ́ kú ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā nɛ̄ n tá lɛ ācɛ ŋmá ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā jāā kwu abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
idu_Latn: Ahāpōtú ā, Óndú ā le odúúdú aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kpó ŋmó. O gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔyí kú Uféro nōo gáā lúgwū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, jāā ga ayí kú alagbá nōo yɔ̄ ipú agbá ā, kwú odúúdú ayí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
idu_Latn: Owu olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ī tá gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū, anɔ́ɔ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ācoyúklɔ́ kú úgbéenyi ā gbɔɔ́ ō tá iyó kú úgbéenyi ā tū ipú éŋkpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
idu_Latn: Aáklɔ̄kpīlī kú alɔ kwú gblífi ɛɛ́. Aɔ́ŋgbá nēé bī uwā kwú ajɛ ā kwú kpó hɛ́ ɛɛ́. Ayí alɔ dóódu ā le pɛ́ ī yɛ ɛɛ́. Ódúúmā kú uwā í yɔ̄ nōo gē pi áklɔ̄kpɛ kú alɔ ā kwu ajɛ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
idu_Latn: É gaá háyi ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī.

eng_Latn: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Umósīsi ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi á.

eng_Latn: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
idu_Latn: Ó plleyī tū iyī nū lɔɔlɔhi ipú ogigo ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ogigo ā ú táajɛ á, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú mlanyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
idu_Latn: amáŋ á gáā lé īkpō kú ɔcí nōo ī yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō jé ɔdā olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā ŋ́ Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ a i lé, a géē kwú.

eng_Latn: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lā oyēeyī kú um ŋméeko nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípoklóbīya ā. É jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lā odúúdú oyēeyī kú um lɛ ā, aflɛ́yí ɔtāhɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában le odúúdú ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ túbá lɛ ucɛ yá lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ami ā, ó wɛ ka ami jíjééyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú alɛɛcɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ma ɔdōtayínū nyā fú gā um ā ŋ́, amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ka awɔ ā kóō lɛyí nū jé, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē jé ɛlá nɛ̄ a gbo ipú odo kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
idu_Latn: Ká ā lɛ ɛga olɔnyɛ kú ɛbɛ́ ā nōo he um ɔtū ā he gé um, ká n̄ le lé. Cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú.

eng_Latn: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ga ɛcɛ nyɔ̄ í má ā? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ īlī ohéyīfuú wiiyē nɛɛ? Ācɛ nēé gē yíifa ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōo gwō ipú abahi ā gē lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́!.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kɛlā gā um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
idu_Latn: A kē ī kpó ígwu ɛpɛɛpa ɛga ahāapa kú aígbáanɔ, ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛdɔ kú uwā kóō yēeyī ipú ɛcɛ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tá īlī klla ī kpó lá. Ó klla ī kpó ɔdōgbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ lá lɛ ācotɔ́hí dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Lɛ uwíndo nwūla kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwíndo nwūla kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyī tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyī ā tá ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí kú oyálé nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā cɛ̄ gā awɔ yá ācɛ Usiríya lé ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. A gē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Usiríya Áfēki, jāā gbéeko nāa gē yá uwá lé klla í kpó uwā yíífi ŋmáajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī Ɔyí ɔ̄cɛ, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Utáya bá í gwéeyē ohígbū nū á. Uwá gē tá ɔga ka, É kwú Ujerúsālɛm ú yíífi ɛɛ́, ɔfú kú ɔ́su, ōtá kú nū ā mɛ ɛɛ́. Ó klla gáā kwu alɔ ɛga ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ klla má úklɔ́ ōhídáagó kú nū. Ka ɛ́ɛ má ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ucɛ ā lé kwɛyí ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́ ga a igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda gaá le ede kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā kpó ca kpɛ́mm. Ó klla le ɛcɔ̄ kú ɛcí, nēé ma kwu ajɛ, kwu ikpɛ́cí, kwu ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra nēé ma kwu ajɛ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛga o pā ɛcí kú ācopɛ̄cí ā kpó yíífi kpɛ́mm. É yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda jāā ga Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla Ɛ́frem, mɛ́mla Umanásɛ, é le odúúdú ɛcí kú abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla ikpɛ́cí kú uwā ā kpó ca tāajɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
idu_Latn: Óndú, odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe lɛ oyēeyī ā, a kē ī je ɔdōlé kú uwā lɛ uwá eko nēé cɛgbá nū ā.

eng_Latn: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ áluka kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti nēe géē yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ glá, nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni gbaáluka ā.

eng_Latn: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhasɛ́lu le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa gē jikwū ā gɛ, ɔkpáni? Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ohígbū ka n jé ɛdɔ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nāa gáā yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. A gēe je ɔlɛ́ uwá kpó yɔlá tāajɛ, a klla í kpó ayípōklóbiya nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋmó, a klla í ca ayípōbene kú uwā bá pɔ́tɔ́kɔ́ɔ́ icííci, a klla í kpó anyā oyīipú kú uwā ipú yíla.

eng_Latn: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
idu_Latn: Aá kē ī bā ī ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ka, Áá tá Óndú āahínyá, ka aá cɛ̄tra iyē kú Óndú a, ɔdā dóódu nōó yá a, aá yá ka oduudu aéwo ɔhá kéē le jé; Aá bī iye kú nu tá ɔna ipu ojīlīma, ɛgahi mla ocɛ̄tla nɛ o fíyɛ́ dúu á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé cīce abɔ́ɔ ā, ókpílícī ɔnyīlɔ éyi ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ yɔ̄ í wā ɔlɛ́, ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, amáŋ ó lā Ugíbɛ̄ya abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā cɛ̄ lɛ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda. N da ɔ́ kahíníī, Usedekíya, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a tíne ō yēeyī, ayíka a tú ɛyí wāajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, cɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Urécabu mɛ́mla Ubaána ɔ́ɔmā, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ Íssbɔ̄ssɛti. É faajɛ ɔlɛ́ ā eko nɛ̄ Íssbɔ̄ssɛti yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
idu_Latn: okwáajɛklá, ugwēenyi.

eng_Latn: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē tá uwá ohi ka, Ohígbū kēé kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nōo kpó aádáádā uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. É kwú ɔtū kú uwā ú lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā klla gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī ífi nyā wā í kla uwá mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé gwó lɛ anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā ā.

eng_Latn: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá kú ɔlɛ́ nū kwú pīya obū. Agege nōo hayi ablɛ̄yí kú nū ā ge mí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ ɔ́dáŋ ka ɛ́ɛ tá ō jāhɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ gɛ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó cíkā kú ālɔ̄ gwéeyē, kú ɔtū kóō wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ alɔ ohígbū ka ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nyā gekwú, abālɔbányā ó kē kwú héyī. Ó gebí, é kē lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
idu_Latn: Ódūdū tá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛnwū kú nū, ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá nōo ī yi ɔdā tāajɛ mɛ́mla ahɔ̄lá ō cɔ̄lá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū.

eng_Latn: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
idu_Latn: Inu kú ubulɔ́kwu ajɛ a má gwōnū ɛɛ́, amáŋ alɔ géē je inu ubulɔ́kwu kú ɛcɔ̄ gwū ɔkwū nū; é kwú ɔcí kú Usíkāmɔ ú tū ɛɛ́, alɔ gē tū ɔcí uloko kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá kwú igbō ā ú lɛ uwá. Ó klla yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā mla ɛbéenyi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛnyā ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ka ā le yá jīla. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ugálīli nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú um ipú ígbíli kú Usíni ā ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka iŋini tú um ohígbū éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umɛ́rība ā. Aá tá ō ma ɔfú otīihɔ kú um ā fú ipéyī ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ ā, aá ɔ́ɔ géē tíne nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ ɛfú kpó tú ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ gbɔbū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ jé dúú ā, anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dúúmā í gáā hile gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā ā wɛ ayááyí kú Ussɛ́m á. Iháyí ɛpa igbīhi kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo kpó ɛcɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ Ussɛ́m wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ ā, ó le ɔyí éyi, nōó hī ka Ápākssadi ma.

eng_Latn: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usekaríya ka anúɔ je eyī gicō igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ má aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya ɛnɛ nɛ̄ ɔnya ɛpɛɛpa gē pi ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aɛ́fu kú ugóolu ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛ ɔtū fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā, géē kpó iyɔ́fú kú uwā bónū í je pɛ́ kwu. Ɛlā kú ami, Óndú ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm jikwū tá ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ɔnɔ nɛ̄ alɔ bá ī jé ā nwuné nɛ̄hí. Ágbe kú alɔ nyā í gē jé ŋ́. Alɔ gbɛlá ka ōcē kú alɔ ā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɛ ɔtū lé glá.

eng_Latn: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujúda da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā pīya alɔ ahɔ̄ lɔfú lɔfú ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ í gáā má eyī olɔhi kú anúɔ ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́, alɔ ɔ́ɔ le ɔyínɛ́ alɔ ā bī wā mɛ́mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ámíyā í yá uwā eko nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā italā ā. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ nōo lɛ ɛtrɔ ipú obū ā. N kē ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ plá uwá gwōnū.

eng_Latn: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.
idu_Latn: Uwíndo nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ tá ɔdɔ kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú aínu ā, mɛ́mla ɔdɔ kú eyīpú nōo kwu ɛplá kú aínu ā. É lɛ ifotó kú alī kpó tū ɔdɔ nōo kwú ɛplá nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ō cēnyi kú ísu kú Ukíssɔn lɛ uwá kpó, éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ukíssɔn ɔ́ɔmā nōó gē tɔ́pɛ́ nɛ̄hi ā. N géē nɔwɔ, n géē nɔwɔ gɔbū mla ɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa aá kóō he aá ɔtū, ohígbū ka ihɔtū gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī je ínoōbīya yɛ́ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ iyī aá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ abɔ̄ aá bá ī yɛ ā? Ɔtū le bīya lɛ uwá abɔ̄ é māháyi cíí ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ yúufi ŋ́. Ádā abɔ̄yī anúɔ, Usɔ́lu, ɔ́ɔ gáā yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Ó klla da ka anúɔ jé péee ka ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ kē kpókónū ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda nyīla klla lé odúúdú ɔcɛ́ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
idu_Latn: Ācoyúklábɔ̄ a géē bī owú kú ugóolu , owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla owú nɔwā le gɔ́ īlī ā.

eng_Latn: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Kwúú mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, Ágábáidu, ká ā yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū mla anú. N kwú yá uwɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka, ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ijē nēé gē gwó ipú agbla kú uwā ā, géē je pīya ikwū ōje. Okwū géē bá bɛɛ́ɛ̄ ɛga dóódu. É géē kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ fɛ́yɛ́ eyīdūdū.

eng_Latn: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
idu_Latn: Umíka kwú ɔ̄ ú píya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó lā ɔlɛ́ Umíka á.

eng_Latn: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ayí Ulífāyi ohile ā, lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi nyā fu kéē yúklɔ́ kú ijē ō gwó mɛ́mla ɔdā ijē ō gwō ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā: Ásāfu, Uhɛ́man mɛ́mla Ujɛ́dūtɔn. É gē bá ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ipú ijē ō gwó mla ɔdā ō bī gwíijē nēe wɛ ɛ̄ngwū ɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla anwa kú oje. Ɛnyā wɛ iyē kú aígwu nēe gē bá í kpó ācɛ trɛ̄yí ipú ijē ō gwó mla ō gwō ɔdā o bī gwíijē tū ɔ̄, eko nēe ī gbɛ̄gbā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
idu_Latn: Ujɛdíyɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujóha, ayí kú Ussímri nōo ŋmá Utísi ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
idu_Latn: Uhússāyi klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ n lɛ ká n ka gā uwɔ ā, lé ka ā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá ŋmá odúúdú ajɛ kú uwā ɛgéégée lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ kóō lɛ uwá kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ádā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔhi ɔ́ fíyɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ koó klá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā ā. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛlā kú ɔtū kú um. N kē gbɛlá ka n lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō dúú.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Áhābu yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man's heart was given to it.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ kú aflɛ́yí ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, ó klla lɛ acá bɛ̄ɛka okpé ā. Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ɔ̄ ā, é kwú acá kú nū ā í kpó fu, kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō ŋmá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi icō bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔtū mɛ́mla ohílīpú kú ɔ̄cɛ ú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ká alɔ pɛ̄cí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā pā ā ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipu Ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, Ācɛ ā cīce ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō lé ucɛ, anɔ́ɔ é nyaŋ́jɛ gbɔɔ́ ō jīije ɔdīcííci á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá yúufi ŋ́. Aá māhayi cíí, kú aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá kóō nya aá tá ícɛnyā ā. Aá gáā má ācɛ kú Íjīpiti nēe bá nyā gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
idu_Latn: Ó gē gwō kahíníī, Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ um dóódu wɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
idu_Latn: Aítíca kú íne ōhī mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi á ī dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nēé í labɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ kéē kpɛ́lā ce Ujísɔ̄si ka ɔ́ɔ gē yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí. Anɔ́ɔ é leyī tá ɔ̄ gɛɛ ɔ́dāŋ koó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá ɛ̄cī usábāti.

eng_Latn: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi, nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Ulidíya, nōo ŋmá Utayatíra, ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo ī tɔ́hí īlī nōo wɛ oblúu bllábllá, nōo ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ ɔtū túkwu ɛlā nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī ka ā.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā ā tɛ́ɛcɛ, gwó abɔ̄, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā kē í gɔ̄ ācɛ klla gɔ̄ uwā igbo alɛwa. Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nyā gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, ó gē tū ufi, ó klla ī hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é le tá ipú ɔkpá kú Aíjē kú Ɛ̄gbā ka, Ká ɛga nōó lā kóō le tá alácɛ̄, ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō yɔ̄ nōo géē lā ipú ajɛ kú nū ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla tá ka, Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kóō kwú ɛga kú úklɔ́ kú nū ú.

eng_Latn: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yá lɔfúlɔfú mla ācɛ nēe gē yɛce únwū obɔ̄bí kú ɔkpíyē kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwā. É klla gē leyī gwō ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō bónū. Aítíca nēe bá nyā lɛ ɔtūkpɔ́ nɛ̄hi, e klla yúufi ŋ́, é klla lɛ ojīlīma ce aálelékwū nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ okónu nɛ̄ aá ī gwū nɛ̄ n géē mīyɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Aá lɛ agbá kú ɔ́bíipú wī ŋmá ācɛ ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄. Aá kē kwú ɔ́ŋgbá nɛ̄ aá le gbō ācɛ gē pīya uwá tū ā ū hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ ī pīyatū ā kéē le hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kōō le jīla le ujɔ̄ tū tū um náaná, n géē yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, aá le ɔdōlé lé, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yēeyī ā, aá cíkā ō le odée lé. Ó géē je ɔfú lɛ aá. Inyīlɛ̄yí éyi í gáā yíífi ŋmá ikpɛ̄yí kú odúúmā kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū ka é pó ka aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ɛ́ɛ bá ī wā.

eng_Latn: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn, ɔ́mpa uwá ā, tá uwá abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, klla kpó ɔdā alɛwa lɛ uwá. Oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ugóolu , oje udɔ, aálá, aɛ́na, aɛ́wū, iyó ɔdōlé, mla agbénú alɛwa ɔhá lɛ uwá kéē bī nyɔ̄ gaá gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī cɔ̄nū eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē hɛ́ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā tá ŋ́. Ohígbū koó kē le úklɔ́ yá lɛ uwá iháyí ɛhīlī, nɛ̄ ulé kú nū ā gbabɔ̄ nɛhí ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā kóō géē hɛ́ ɔhá ce uwá.

eng_Latn: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu nēé cɛ̄ ŋ́ mā ā, lɛ ɔtū kú aílɔ́wá ā wu klíicō, é kla lɛ uwá ɔtū bīya lɛyíkwu Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi.

eng_Latn: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú uwɔ ā ú kú ā nyɔ̄. Ó he um ɔtū ā yá nɛ̄ n je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ igbīhāajɛ nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n je gā uwɔ ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é kwú mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā fíyaa, anɔ́ɔ é klla gbēyī kéē má ɔdā nɛ̄ ó tíne kéē yá ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
idu_Latn: Aínu kú ācɛ ogbō ɔwɛ ā nēe wɛ ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa, é nwuné jōnjīlɛ̄. Aɔ́dɔ nēe tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwá ā cɔkpɛ́nú jōnjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā, aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú aá ka ká áá. Aá lɛ ɔdā ole cījáalí kú ɛpɔ̄ kú aá dóódu ā kpó wā í mafú.

eng_Latn: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
idu_Latn: Nwū ɔyí uwɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ó le jɛ̄, ó gáā nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
idu_Latn: Bla ka ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā, je ɛ̄cī kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ aá. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī ɛpa lɛ aá, ɛ̄cī ómɛhīlī ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō klá ɔlɛ́ nú kóō híī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ̄cī ómahāapa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Oōmá kú ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō, ɛyí ɛfu ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá, ɛyí ɛfu ipú eyī kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ klá um abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ n gbɛlá ka ikwū gā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
idu_Latn: Urebéka yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ Áyísīki yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ Ísɔ, ɔyí nū ā. Eko nɛ̄ Ísɔ le tá ipácí, gáā tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́ kóō ŋmó ɛbɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For it is the day of the LORD's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
idu_Latn: Ɛko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, klla í gwō aólɛlā kú ācɛ Usáyɔn ɔ́ci ā.

eng_Latn: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ācɛ ɔhá ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kē ī yá aá ɛhi. Ɔkwɔɔkwɛyi, aá géē mīyɛ ɔdā nēé le miya omōōmu nēé lɛ abɔ̄ da ɔ́ báajɛ, lɛ ɔ́ gwotū, klla ī ce klɛ́ɛcɛ ā. Okoolo nɛ̄ aá ī miya ɔdā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā, okoolo ékpó ɔ́ɔmā nēé géē bī le miya ɔdā lɛ aá dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyāda lɛ anyā ɛpa lɛ Ujówāsi. É ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a géē lóofu nɛ̄hi piyóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ géē bá ī ka kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā á, anú kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā kóō yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ géē kpó aólɛla kú uwā wā í wu uwá abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ufi cē tū uwā iyē jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le aólɛlā ā kpó ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da Ahíja, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nēé ī bī lɛ jé ɔtū kú Óndú ā bī wā ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā Ahíja bī ɔdā nēé ī bī lɛ jé ɔtū kú Óndú ā ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ā.

eng_Latn: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
idu_Latn: Mabɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ánya tá, kóō mīyɛ ulé kú ánya kú nū. Ámāŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ipú unwalu igbo éyi a klla géē nyɔ̄ í je ɔ́ igbo ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gáā je aá yíífi ā ga ɛɛ́. Ákú aá mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Ipú ɔ̄na kú um ā, n háyī pī ísu kú Unáyilu.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, Áa híī mā ō jikwū klá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ alɔ nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya.

eng_Latn: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
idu_Latn: Ussúpim mɛ́mla Uhósa gē gbō ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ussalɛ́cɛ̄ti gē gbō ɔwɛ nōo yɛ gicō āá. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā lɛ eko nɛ̄ uwá gē wā í gbāajɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá í má ɔdōlé ō lé ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ klla má ejé ɔlamu ámāŋ ejé olɔfú gwá ŋ́. Ó ka amáŋ nááná ā Óndú ā lɛ ɛgbá kú uwā dóódu yá lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nwū uwā ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ gē yá ā tá péee, é wɛ ajā ōgbo, īnyī ōblá, oyēeyī obɔ̄bí ō lā.

eng_Latn: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka awɔ gē gbō um á. A lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ kú inɔ̄ɔda olɔfū nɛ̄hi nōo ī gbō ācɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ aéwɔhá alɛwa géē wā í yɛ gla igelī nɛ̄hi nyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē bá í da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā ka Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ca igelī nɛ̄hi nyā tāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā āa.

eng_Latn: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
idu_Latn: Ā yúúfi ŋ́, uwēyī í gáā kwú uwɔ ŋ́. É kē gáā je uwēyī gā uwɔ gɛ ŋ́. A híí gbɛlá kwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ a yá eko nɛ̄ a wɛ ɔyípɔ̄ŋcɛ́nyā ā gɛ ŋ́. Ā híī gbɛlá kwu uwēyī nōo kwú uwɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā gɛ ŋ́. Kwú uwēyī nōo kwú uwɔ eko nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ōfōōfū uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyōkwū nɛ̄ ɔbá nū gekwú ā ú ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ ga Íjīpiti klla lā iháyí alɛwa abɔ́ɔ ā. Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti yá uwā mɛ́mla alɔ ōwē.

eng_Latn: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwúcē igbīhi gaá bá Ugígalu.

eng_Latn: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
idu_Latn: É le ogbló ɛnɛ gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya nēe géē bī ukɔ́tin ā playicō, é le ugóolu ma plá uwá iyē klla le uwɔ kú ugóolu kpó kwu uwá. Anɔ́ɔ é le ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛnɛ yá kéē bī aógbló ā bāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Ujeremíya ka, Óndú ā kóō cīijáalí ɔkwɛ̄yi kpɔ́cí tū alɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ a ī gbā ā, kā ālɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā ŋ́.
