eng_Latn: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn bī wā gaá le ɛfú kpó tá uwā. É le odúúdú ayípɔ̄klóbīya kú Ujúda ā kpó ŋmó, é kōō kpó uwā ŋmó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā dúú. É ményīnyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ācɛ Ujúda ŋ́, kwú anyākwɔ́cɛ, kwu ayípɛ̄, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, kwu ācɛ o doōcē mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé doōcē ŋ́. Óndú ā kwú odúúdú uwā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, klla le aóhile kú uwā kpó ɔfiyɛ.

eng_Latn: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
idu_Latn: A í yá ɛ̄nyā ɛ̄cī dóódu ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Cɛ́ɛ́ ede ā kwú yá tīīhɔ dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ámāŋ ka ɔdā dúúmā nōo lɛ iyē kwu ɔ́ ɔfú kú otīihɔ kú nū ā géē yá ɔ̄ odée.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Odōlé kú um wɛ kā n̄ yá ɔdā nōo tá ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, ká n̄ kē lɛ úklɔ́ kú nū yá mɛ.

eng_Latn: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ā híī yá um italā eko nāa le cɔ̄nū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kōō ī bī ánya le yá um italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ígwu ɔhá yɛ lɛyíkwu Ubɛ́ti Uhórɔn, ígwu ɔ́mɛɛtá ā yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛjī nōo pīyeyī kwu ɔpɛ́ kú Usebáyim mɛ́mla ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
idu_Latn: N jikwū nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ é má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cíkā kóō nwūla ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ámāŋ kóō má ipú nū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá kú ígblɛ́nyī kú ō yɔ̄ cíí glá ŋ́. Ó kē lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgwā obɔ̄bí í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā nyā le nyīla ga odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujɔ́pa, ācɛ alɛwa kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē jīla ɛcɛ iyē jāā ga etikpa kú nū. Ó klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ aɛ́cɔ̄ nōó ce ɛyí uwā jīliyē.

eng_Latn: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔtūnōbí mla obū, anɔ́ɔ ó le agbá nōo kwu uwá ā kpó hɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ tá. Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī nyɔ̄ mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwa nɛ̄hi ā kéē í nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ágábáidu, Udéfīdi, le ɔdā nōo yá ā pó ā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
idu_Latn: Ussálum, ɔyí kú Ukóre, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ɛbíyāsafu, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Ukóra ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóra gē gbō ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bū wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kpaakpa á. É mīyɛ úklɔ́ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yá ɔdā nēe he Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ɔtu ā, anú wɛ ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a ī da um ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ a cíkā ō yá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ōfōōfūnū lɔhi á. Anú kē wɛ Ɔ̄wɔicō á. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a tíne ká ā lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó, lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nōo gē nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ tāajɛ á. É géē ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa kú nū, klla í je aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Ubétlehɛ̄m da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá dɔɔ̄kā ɔyínɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā lɔɔlɔhi. Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ má, aá wā gaá le da um, ká n̄ gaá lɛ ɛ̄gbá gbā ɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nɛ. Ó kwú uwā í pīya ayí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú nū mafú lɛ uwá. Ó le oji cē uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú íne ú lɛ uwá á. É gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɔwɛ okpaakpa, ó kē cokónu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le yá ka ɔlá nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú ɛcōwō kóō yā bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō klá aígelī nēé hī ka Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra á.

eng_Latn: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ alɔ le úgbéenyi éyi má nōo yɔ̄ ī ga Ufinísīya ā, anɔ́ɔ alɔ le tá ipú nū le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ká aá, nɛ̄ aá kē ma ɔ́ opeyī ŋmá ipú á nɛɛ? Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
idu_Latn: Ándru, ɔyínɛ́ kú Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ipú ācɛ ɛpa nēe pó ɛlā kú Ujɔ́ni klla yɛce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
idu_Latn: Uwá wɛ ācɛ o ma ɛtɛ́ nēe lā igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Unetayím mɛ́mla Ugɛdɛ́ra á. Odúúdú uwā gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Óndú, lɛ eyī kú uwɔ nwūla kú ā má, lɛ ahɔ̄ kú uwɔ nwūla ká ā pó ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Usenakéribu tū wā í cá awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú, nōo yēeyī ā ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ Udamáskɔ̄si ā, igbómína nɛ̄ Arétāsi, ɔcɛ́ ā fu ā lɛ ācogbāājɛ fú bá okómpīinu nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā kéē lɛ um kwú.

eng_Latn: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ifa kú uwɔ yá yēŋēē ká ɔtū kóō he uwɔ. Lɛ anɔ̄ okpóocu tū ɛyí kú uwɔ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.
idu_Latn: É le ka lɛ Usɔ́lu kɔ́ ɔ̄ má ɔ̄ ɛ́, ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō bīya íne kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́, o ŋmá lɛ o lé ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ oyī yɔ̄ anú kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ ka é wɛ ācɛ o já ɔ̄cɛ kwu ɔwɛ, kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi míya gé lɛ anúɔ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
idu_Latn: É bī āgā mɛ́mla omútāgā lɛ odúúdú ɔcī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ kpó yíla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ɛga oligbó ā kéē cɛtra ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā nēe cikpó nū, klla gwō ipú ūnwū ikpɔ́nyā ō cē bɛ̄ɛka anú ā, géē tɛ̄gíkwu klla í dɛ̄ ohígbū igelī ā eko nēé lɛ ódūdū kú ɔlá nōó je ɔ́ yi ā má.

eng_Latn: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú aá owu géē kpó aótrɛ̄yí ká aá nyɔ̄, é kē géē kpó ācɛ nɛ̄ aá he uwá ɔtū, nēe ī tá aá abɔ̄ ā kpó kwú ga ɔfiyɛ. É géē yá aá ɛflɛ́ɛfu klla í je uwēyī lɛ aá ohígbū odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔcɛ́ kú Ái ā ú tōlī. Okwū kú nū kē playi icō ɔcí ā jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Abɔ̄ ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī ga ajɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē kwú okwū ā ú wā ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ e kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ́cɔ̄ tá okónɔɔwɛ igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. É lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tīkwū klá anú, īkwū kú ɛcɔ̄ ā, kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ̄ uwá fu cɔcɛ́ ɛyí ɛfu ā. É gē lé ɔdōlé nōo bū ajɛ ā, é ī gwá ɛnwú ŋmá ápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ī jɛ̄ ɛyí ajɛ ɛcɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó kú nū hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, N da aá ka ije nɛ̄ ɔnyōkwū ogbɛhá nyā le tá ipú ikpati ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ákú odúúdú ācɛ o hile á.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Má cīce kú ā jé ɔkpá ɔ́ɔmā lɛ alɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ubárūku lɛ ɔkpá ā jé lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ gaá nyi ádā nū ā, odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú Uféro, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya tū agbá ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aólɛlā gaá yá Ujerúsālɛm lé ā.

eng_Latn: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ n ge kɛlā lɛ aá klá ī ka igbalɛwa ā, aá jāhɔ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ aá bá ī yá odúúdú aúcē ɔ́bíipú ā kpɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī hī aá igwú ā, aá tá um ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa kú ucɛ ā, aá lɛ aɛ́drɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna ahāapa, aómlede ɛpa, mɛ́mla aómlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
idu_Latn: Aflá kú oje nɛ̄ ɔwá kú nū nwuné fíyɛ́ ikpó éyi ā cɛyí utéblu olakā ā. Oje ékpónú nēé le yá oje nōo kwu utéblu ā ikpó kéē lɔfú iyē ā mɛ́mla oje oplákátá ō cɛyí utéblu ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
idu_Latn: Eko kú unwalu nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um le yɛ um jīla tá nááná, n gáā yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā kú ɔ́kplá kú Ukálɛ̄bu, Uhɔ́ɔ ā lé ka Ɛ́frāti. Uhɔ́ɔ ma Ussóbalu, nōo wɛ ádā kú Ukɛ́riyat Ujeyarím ā ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ucē ō yá mɛ́mla ɛlá nɛ̄ ó ī gbō le yēŋēē. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē pā ɛcí klla ī gbo ɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
idu_Latn: É gē má úklɔ́ idáagó kú uwɔ ā ipú ɛga odobū ɔ́ɔmā nɛɛ? Kɛ̄ɛ ka é ī má olɔhi kú uwɔ ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ nēé kwú mlanyī uwā ɛɛ́ ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
idu_Latn: Āyā kú ɛhícō kú aínu ā, ɛpá tá abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛhɔ̄, īkpō kú nū kē wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó. Aókómpinu kú aínu ā kē pīya kwu āyā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā, lɛ okónu klá cíí ká n kɛlā.

eng_Latn: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
idu_Latn: Opiií ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gē bɔ̄bí lɛ ā á. Ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ é kē le ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā kē ī ŋmɛ́yí lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē jé ka ɛlā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛlā kú um, he uwɔ ɔtū ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka á nyɔ̄ mla alɔ ŋ́ mā ā? O yɔ̄ pī alɔ kú uwɔ ā, í mafú ka alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ācɛ o hile nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā tá.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, wɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Índīya jāā ga Etiyópiya ā. Ó gē gbō ɛyí ajɛ ofu ɛhīlī ce ahāapa ŋmá Usúsa.

eng_Latn: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ámɔn ú nyi ikpámílī kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Íssa á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujosíya lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gbɛlá lɛ ā, aá yɔ̄ ī lɛ eko tū ɔ̄ lɛ iyī aá gɔbū icííci nɛ̄, ohígbū ka aá lɛ má ka ɛlā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyī um í gáā lɛ ō opīyabɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
idu_Latn: Otú wɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɔlā á, otú kē wɛ eko nɛ̄ ejé gē kwú ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó ka ipú ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka lɛ uwā ā nááná, é kpɔ́tūce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Kwú ɔkpá ú, kú ā lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ga uwɔ, lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla odúúdú aéwɔhá ā tá tū ɔ̄. Lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n húmáyī í ka ga uwɔ, ŋmá ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ n gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā ga uwɔ, ŋmá eko nɛ̄ Ujosíya ce ɔcɛ́ ŋmá ā, jāā gaá kwu ícɛ tá.

eng_Latn: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayí um ā, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ācɛ éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ aá ā. Nááná nɛ̄ n tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tá ɔnyā nū, ka ó wɛ ɔnyā anúɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ka anúɔ í kē wɛ ɔbá nū gɛ ŋ́ mā. Aá da uwá kē mā ɛcí ō pā tá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā ō gbajā nōo klla yɔ̄ ī yá akwuna ā, cíkā ō habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá ā.

eng_Latn: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
idu_Latn: Ábna da Ujówābu kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ayípōklóbīya ōhī fu ŋmá āyā ɛplɛ́ɛpa kéē kweyī kú unu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ gbɛlá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ í tá aɔ́mpa alɔ ɔtū kwu ɔtū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔhá mɛ́mla o yá kéē yúklɔ́ olɔhi.

eng_Latn: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobīyíne ā le ɔbíipú bī nɛ̄, ó gē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ eyīpíípú kú ɔtū kú nū yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó yúufi kú Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē jɛ̄ ɔ̄ eyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ā wɛ ācɛ nēe háápī ɔwɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi á, ó wɛ uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka alɔ ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ohígbū ka alelékwū kú nū gē tá alɔ abɔ̄, alɔ kē gē gwéeyē ohígbū oyēeyī kú alɔ nōo le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, alɔ í kē kpɔ́tūce uculo kú ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi lɛ ācīije kú nū nyā pó ā, é jé kóō tá ācīije lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
idu_Latn: É bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi, aá lɛ uwá hɛ́ klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí igbāmkpa, eko nēé ī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Aá lɛ uwá ca báajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē ca ɔcí ufáyin báajɛ, ɛga nēé gē pí ejé dúúdú ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ejé ā gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ bónū ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.
idu_Latn: Ka aá í je odúúmā lé ŋmá anú eko nɛ̄ aá yēkwu ā ŋ́. Ka aá í je odóodu kú nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá eko nɛ̄ aá le tēelihɔ ā ŋ́. Ka aá í je odóodu kú nū yá ɛhi kú okwū dúúmā ŋ́. Ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā, ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka lɛyíkwu ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ā.

eng_Latn: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā Ɔwɔicō lɛ abɔ̄ okléeyī nɛ̄hi bī wā ɛgiyí uwa cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nēé ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛnɔ kóō bɛ̄cɛ ā. É gē tá ābɔ̄ ga ɛbɛɛbɛ kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
idu_Latn: É bī ɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú pi tá ipú ikpati klla kwú ɔ̄ ú bī gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn. É kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka ō klla pó oji oōtu kú nū ɛyí ɛfú kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā nyā ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si da alelékwū obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ipú iyē kú nū ā kahíníī, Le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā! Igbalɛwa alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā gē je ɔnyīlɔ nyā. Ācɛ gē lɛ odo ce ɔ́ klla ī lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá kwu ɔ́, amáŋ ó gē je odó ā cē klla je agbá ā kpó hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ i má ɛɛ́, kē i pó ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ alɔ bī le tɔ́ɔna lɛ aá dúú á, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá lɛ olétɔ̄há. Olétɔ̄há ká alɔ kē yɔ̄ ɛgiyí ádā ā mɛ́mla ɛgiyí Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɔtū kú ācɛ ā yá kóō le lɔfú. Jāā kwu ícɛ nyā é gē lɛ īlī ɛdɔ ékpó ɔ́ɔma klá eyī kpɔ́ eko dúúmā nēé gē jé ɛka nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ōfōōfūnū gē kpo īlī ā ŋmá ɔ̄ eyī ā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N lɛ íne bīya nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá nyā ɛɛ́. Kóocōō, kwú yá um ɛhi. Ucē kú olíla nɛ̄ n yá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ipú Ujerúsālɛm á. N le íkwu mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, anɔ́ɔ n le ācɛ alɛwa kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá kpó tū agbá. Eko nēé le ɛpɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó ka tū uwā nɛ̄, n gē ka dúú ka n cɛ̄ mla uwá.

eng_Latn: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Utáya. Ó yá ka aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ká ē kpó iyɔ́fú ogbɛnú nɛ̄hi nyɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɛyí kú uwā le kpó fakpá, nɛ̄ ácábɔ̄ kú uwā klla le kpó hípí ā. Amáŋ kwu ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā í lɛ ilɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ákanya kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Asúba gekwú ā, Ukálɛ̄bu lɛ Ɛ́frati lɛ. Ó ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ ɔ́. Iyē kú nū lé ka Uhúr.

eng_Latn: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ā yá, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ Ufílīstiya yálé, ó klla nū uwā ŋmá Ugéba jāā ga ɔwɛ kú Ugɛ́sa ā.

eng_Latn: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, n géē bī éwo olɔfú nɛ̄hi éyi ŋmá ɛga oligbó wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá. É wɛ éwo nōo húmáyī yɔ̄ ŋmá íkée. Aá kē gáā pó ucē kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē pó ɔdā nēé gē ka ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umídiya ɛpa, nēe lé ka Órebu mɛ́mla Usíibu, ā kwú. É le Órebu ŋmó ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú Órebu. É klla lɛ Usíibu ŋmó ɛga o pi ejé kú Usíibu. É klla yɔ̄ gē nū ācɛ kú Umídiya kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ikpɛ̄yí kú Órébu mɛ́mla ákú Usíibu kpó gé lɛ Ugídīyɔn, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā á.

eng_Latn: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
idu_Latn: Ń klla gáā je ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n da uwá ā, nēé klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Umósīsi je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
idu_Latn: ká ɛ̄cī éyi Ɔwɔicō géē lɛ ɔdā nōó yá ā abɔ̄yī nū wútá ŋmá agbá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī wa gɛ ŋ́, kéē lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ɔwɛ ohéyī fuú nɛ̄hi kú ayí Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le ɔtū lɛ gē kɛlā pāālā lɛ ācɛ ā, yɔ̄ ī mīya ɛlā mla uwá klla yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū kóō lɛ ācɛ ā ɔtū pīya tá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛhīlī kú ucɛ ā, aá géē kpó aɛ́drɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna ahātá, aómlede ɛpa, mɛ́mla aómlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan, nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá, kóō wɛ ákú aá ā, nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ lɛ úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ú gaá le yá tū ɔdɔ kú ipú inu ɔlɛ́ aá, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu ga ajɛ kú Íjīpiti gaá lā ajɛ kú Uhám á.

eng_Latn: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā gē wā ī nuunu tá um ɛɛ́. Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē tíne kéē je um ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ācɛ nēé jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ wɛ odée ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Ukɔ́ra, Udátan mla Abíram lā ā.

eng_Latn: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛka gbo gā um ícɛ, ka anúɔ í gáā je ipɔ́ɔma kú um, nōo ce um igbīhi ā kpó ŋmó ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī je iyē kú um mlanyī ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa uwā abɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le lā anú ɛbɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ yá abɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ lɔfú cigbīhi ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dā nēé yá ɔ́ɔmā ā, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu, igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. N kē í kɛpɔ̄ nyā tū ayááyí kú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya Urésin mɛ́mla Upéka, ɔyí kú Urɛmalíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ wā í kpɛ́fú tá Ujerúsālɛm. É le íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄, amáŋ é yá Ahási lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōó je iyī nū ce ɔ́ abɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é í ka áluka kú iháyí kú eko nōó je iyī nū cābɔ̄ ŋmá ā kwu eko kú ɔdā ō je cīgbīh lɛ óndú nū ā. Ó géē ka ɔ́lá kú ɔdā nēé í lɛ fūla anú ā ŋmá ulé nēé gē gbā lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering: and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
idu_Latn: Ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛya nēé ī gwó ohígbū ɔbíipú ā, ɛya nēé ī gwó kéē le cílā ulé ā, géē wɛ ɔdōlé kú ācogwɛ́ɛya á. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í je gā um ā kē í wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ da ádā nū kahíníī, Á lɛ ɔhā ékpónú gɛɛ ŋ́ n̄, ádā um? Lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce um dúú, ádā um. Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ je ɔkɔ gicō gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gáā gā ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ó da Usárāyi, ɔnyā nū ā, kahíníī, N jé ka a wɛ ɔnyā nōo lɔhi o má eyī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā olɔfú kú um, ŋmá abɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tu um ā. É kē le lɔfú fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla Óndú ā ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, mɛ́mla otú ofɛpa. Ó lé ɔdā dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō ī gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā kú íne igwó ā tá tū usiléti kú ɛcɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔtā kú uwɔ túce, a kē le tútū kú ā tá ɔyī kú uwɔ ɛɛ́ Ɔwo olímanya kú uwɔ ā le ɛcɛ yíla ɛpa nɛ̄ aísu le kpó yíla ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
idu_Latn: A le unwalu mɛ́mla ōwē tū klá um, nááná ā, a géē je ɔfú kú um cīgbīhi gā um. Á kē gáā yá ká n̄ kwú ga ipú únóji ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú ɛbɔ́ géē je ɔfú kú Usɛ́tan yíífi, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aá. Ɛbɔ́ kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō yɔ̄ kwu aá.

eng_Latn: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é má odúúmā ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ ocījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ alɛwa wā ā.

eng_Latn: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nyā, kē í lɛ iyī ūwā tū yēŋēē, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū le yēŋēē ā.

eng_Latn: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
idu_Latn: É gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ uwā, lɛ aínyílɔ́wɔ ā, klla gē lɛ ejé fu ajɛ lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā, ɛyí aínu nēe bá ipú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda. Odúúdú aínu ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɔdā nōo tēelihɔ bɛ̄ɛka Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti ā.

eng_Latn: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí olíla wɛ ɔtūnōbí lɛ ádā nū, ó klla wɛ íjémā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla íwɔ́tū lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nōo ma ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā klá Ugɔ́gu, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aéwo kú Umɛ́sɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Utúbalu ipú ajɛ kú Umágōgu ā. Kɛlā klá anú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
idu_Latn: Óndú í tá uwā abɔ̄ klla í hɛ́ uwá tá. Ó géē nya uwá tá ŋ́má abɔ̄ kú ācobɔ̄bíipū, ohígbū ka ācɛ okpaakpa ā géē kwu ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā kóō gbō uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɛwa ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā kú um yá mla ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá hī ka ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu āā.

eng_Latn: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ miya, ó kē wɛ umíta ofu igwáahāpa cigwo ā dúú. Āyā kú nū dóódu ā wɛ umíta ofigwáhāpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
idu_Latn: Awɔ gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ dóódu á, cāŋjɛ ká ā je ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ ācoyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɛ í he alɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó lɛ, abɔ́ɔ ā, alɔ gē lé ɛbɛ́ klla ī lé ɛdɔ ɔdōlé ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ dɔɔ̄kā a. Amáŋ, aá lɛ alɔ kpó wā ígbíli amānyā kú ɔkpɛtā kóō lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó bónū.

eng_Latn: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī kwūcē Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla alɔ yɔ̄ gē dɛ̄gba ī kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá ā wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō o lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú! É gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔwɛ nōó géē nya aá tá ā.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā wɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, opī ɛhɔ̄, aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Upagíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ɔ́cran ā.

eng_Latn: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄ce ī lɛ ojámá eko nɛ̄ ó le púla tá ukpa kú ɔdā nōó ī tíne lɔfú lɔfú abɔ̄yīnū ā.

eng_Latn: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ úklɔ́ kú ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe gē gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā á. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóra ā wɛ: Umɛssɛlɛmíya, ɔyí kú Ukóre nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ásāfu ā.

eng_Latn: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
idu_Latn: N géē mafú lɛ aá, ka ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ lɛ íkwu kóō je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi ipú ɛcɛ nyā glá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ iyē kú nū ŋmó ā kahíníī, N da uwɔ ka cāŋjɛ, kwú ákplata kú uwɔ̄ ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ga ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá tínē ō cɛ̄, ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ɛláyíja, nōo cíkā ō wā á.

eng_Latn: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ísu ā kwú cēenyi le aólɛlā kú uwā kpó, nɛ̄ odúúmā kú aólɛlā kú uwā ā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá je abɔ̄ kú aá gicō kú aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ɛga otīihɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ká aá klla cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
idu_Latn: É dɔɔ̄kā ō lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ohígbū keé le jé ka, aá nɔ́ɔ tá ācīije lɛ aá á. Amáŋ abɔ̄ ufi ɛwa ā gē yá uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ é mā ɔ̄ tá le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā gaá le kā ācɛ kú Asírīya ka, aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti, nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú Utɛháka, ɔcɛ́ kú Ukússi ā bá yɔ̄ ī wā í kpɛ́fú tá uwā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya le ɛlā ā pó ā, ó le ɔkpá tá fu Uhɛsɛkíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda le ohi tá uwá ka aá yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔmáapú aá nɛ. Ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō cɔ̄nū āa? Ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ́ kē cíla ulé kú ɔdōlé nɛ̄ aá lé abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ́ kōō je ɔdā dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bā í jé íne kú Umósīsi lɛ uwá ā, é le jé wā ɛga éyi nōo ka, Ācɛ kú Ámɔn, amáŋ ka Umówābu dúúmā í gáā wɛ ipú ācɛ kú Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, le héyī, ká ā bī ɔfú kú uwɔ le yá odée lɛ alɔ. Le héyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ īkée ā yá lɛ alɔ dúú. Awɔ je ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ísu nɛ̄hi, nēé hī ka Uráhābu ā ŋmó, je ɔ́ wā nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ á.

eng_Latn: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
idu_Latn: Ayí um, aá jāhɔ̄ ká aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā aá gē nwū aá ā pó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ohílīpú ō bī jɛ́yí ɔdā lɛ.

eng_Latn: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
idu_Latn: Owu gē tá ga ɛháajɛ, ó gē tá ga ɛhícō, ó klla gē tá biílí jāā gbéeko nōó kwúcē ga ɛga nōó tá ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā cāŋjɛ kóō nyɔ̄, amáŋ ádā odiyɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí, ce ɔ́ ɔkɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le gbo abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
idu_Latn: Kócōō, Ɔwɔicō, lɛ uwá fíyákátā bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá ā. Lɛ uwá gwu bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē gwu igbóngbō bónū ā.

eng_Latn: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
idu_Latn: Owu géē dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ɔ̄ okónu ā, klla yɔ̄ ī tá ɔjī tū ɔ̄ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that the LORD hath shewed me:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá cɔ̄nyā ŋ́, ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú gā um ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le uwá kpó kwú, le uwá kpó tū ijaló gbó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū á, ohígbū ka eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā géē wɛ ocíbú éyi kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nē ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó. Ɛ́plɛ́ɛpa géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyāssibu, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo gē leyīkwu inu okpíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tū a, wɛ oklóbīya kú Utobíya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ékpónú nōo yá um ā, anú yá ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um á. Anú yá ɔ́na kú ami mɛ́mla uwá ipú aɛ́nɛ́ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
idu_Latn: Ikpɛ̄yí kú uwɔ kwicō gɛ̄mm bɛ̄ɛka ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu ā. Īnyīlɛyí kú uwɔ nōo gbɔ̄ɔ̄lɔ̄ playi ajɛ ā wɛ onōbí sunúú yɔ̄ ī ceyī. Ɔhī kú inyilɛyí ā ōfōōfūnū kwú ɔcɛ́ ɔtū ú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka, ohígbū ɛka nɛ̄ anúɔ gbo lɛ uwá, nɛ̄ oyī kú ɛbɛ́ nēé le gwɛ́ɛya ā kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔja nēé ja klá ɛka āā. Ó ka anúɔ géē hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá ipú agbá kú ajɛ ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ ó tīile ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka obugā nɛ̄ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa le tútū le íbɔm cē tū um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wā í kpɛ́fú tú um, ɔtū í hɛ́ um ko, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aólɛlā ā gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá um nááná, n géē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, Óndú kú um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je āyā ɛpa ŋmá ipú ɛtá kú ācɛ kú ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā kpó ŋmó. Cɛ́ɛ́ āyā éyi ŋmá ipú ɛtá ā géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam ka ipú ɔtū kú īyī nū kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā lɔfú kwúcē wā í tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi glá.

eng_Latn: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú unwalu nēe yá uwā ā gē kwú ɔ́ iyē nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anú abɔ̄yī nū hɛ́ uwá tá á. Abɔ̄ uwá he ɔ́ ɔtū, nōó klla ī méyīnyinyi uwā ā, ó lɛ uwá nyatá. Ó kē húmáyī leyīkwu uwá ŋmífī íkée bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ gē leyīkwu ɔyí nōó bī abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu géē túbá tɔ̄ɔ̄há klla í fu otrɛ̄yí ékpónú kóō gbō uwā, é í wɛ ācɛ olɔfú klla lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī kú Ujésri ā géē nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya tɛɛtɛ le má ka Ujísɔ̄si wɛ ɔdā idáagó, anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā ohígbū nū á.

eng_Latn: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Umósīsi eko dóódu ā. Ká Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ mla Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í da uwɔ ŋmáajɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ka ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā géē yá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Alɔ da uwɔ ka habɔ̄ alɔ tá cíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ cɔfiyɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ó géē lɔhi lɛ alɔ fíyɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ cɔ̄fiyɛ ikɔkɔ ō wā í pɛ́ gekwú ipú ígbíli amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya lɔtū lɛ ɛlā ka kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā um ŋ́ mā le um pīyɛ̄. N kē lɛ iyī um mafú lɛ ācɛ nēé dɔɔ̄kā um ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ipú ígbíli kú ā gáā jīla Umósīsi ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gáā jīla Umósīsi ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ kwú bɔ́tū.

eng_Latn: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛlā nēé gē nwū uwɔ ā géē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ yá ucē olɔhi, nōo í yá káā he ācɛ ɔtū ō má. Ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́cɛ otɔ̄kɔ nōo gē je uwɔ héyīfuú ō má ā.

eng_Latn: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: iháyí ofɛpa. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Uhɛ́brɔn iháyí ahāapa, ó kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
idu_Latn: Álá kú uwā ā í gáā lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́. Ó í wɛ iháyí éyi, aá géē je álá amáŋ opī kú iháyí éyi ā ŋmá ipú aɔ́dājɛ kú aá glá.

eng_Latn: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
idu_Latn: Otū kú uwā le mu mla ɛdɔ ɔbíipú dóódu, obɔ̄bí, eyī ōkwu ɔdā, okónu ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dóódu. Uwá le mu mla imálānyī, é gē ŋmó ācɛ, gē yíkpɛ́lā, gē plla ācɛ, gē híla ācɛ, gē ka obɔ̄bí kú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
idu_Latn: Ussébūwelu nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔyí kú Umósīsi, Ugɛ́ssɔm ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe ī leyīkwu ije kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā da ācɛ nēé le búdá ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ojīlīma ce um ŋmá lɛ ō yá íne nɛ̄ n tū lɛyíkwu ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ācɛ í cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ aá klla gē yá ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ aá klla lɛ ɛka kú um ā tū kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ɛhi kú nū cēenyi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi klá alɔ. Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔ́dā dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá kē yɔ̄ amānyā nōo géē je ɛhi kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ō gwó kú Óndú ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
idu_Latn: Ujówābu le tá ɔlɛ́ ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā klá ā gaá le da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ícɛ nyā, a le uwēyī je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ, nēe nya oyeēyī kú awɔ mɛ́mla ákú ayí uwɔ mɛ́mla anyā uwɔ mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
idu_Latn: Aá le ikpīije éyi mafú gā um. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kahíníī, Ifotó mɛ́mla iyē kú ɔ̄nyɛ bá ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ákú Usísa.

eng_Latn: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó lɛ eyīnyinyi kú ami, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ má ɛɛ́! Oŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayááyí géē hī um ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ákú nū yá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, nēe gē yá ɔdā nōó tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ Ujísɔ̄si, ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ alɔ jé ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū āā? Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ka, N ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá gē tíne otábɔ̄, aɛ́cí kú aá ɔ́ɔmā í gáā tá aá abɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Owu nōo ī tá fɛɛlɛ ā géē cē uwá gwōnū glá. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce um ā géē lā ipú ajɛ ā, klla í lɛ ukpɛ̄ ɛyí ɛfu nōo wɛ ákú abɔyī um mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé gē wú īkpɔ̄dā ā géē mu mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé géē mu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɛga ō yá ejé ā.

eng_Latn: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É klla ŋmá Ubɛtigígalu, Ugéba, mɛ́mla Asimáfɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
idu_Latn: É ī gáā cīce agōdō olɔɔlɔhi, klla lɛ utéblu tá iyɔ̄bū uwā lɛ ɔtulalī mɛ́mla anɔ̄ nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā, kpó ce ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá inu mla anú gē tū ɔ̄ ɔtūlé ā má ɔ̄ bá ó nyāŋjɛ kpá le tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, é yɛce ɔ́, ohígbū kéē gbɛlá kóō gē nyɔ̄ únóji gaá jikwū abɔ́ɔ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta háyi abɔ́ɔ gē jɔ̄lá. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á wɛ éyi kú ayíkpó kú nū ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ń wɛ nóó.

eng_Latn: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú íjééyī lɔɔlɔhi, ká ā klla cēyītīkwū kú ā jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ íjééyī wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ gā ipú Uróm ā, é le ɛga je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lā ōfōōfūnū mɛ́mla ícɔ́ɔ́ja nōo gē gbō ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ oyódōbɔ̄bí, lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le bɛ̄cɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā gaá le aágwu nēé hī ka Ánākim ā kpó yálé ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu, ŋmá Uhɛ́brɔn, Udɛ́biri, Ánābu mɛ́mla oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛfu kú Ujúda mla Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ujóssuwa le uwá mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄si le ɔkɔ gbā klla le ikwū je klá Óndú ā ga ɔkpáncō kɔ́ɔ̄ wā í tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā yā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā lɛ ā. Ó lɛ ɛna yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú nū lɛ ā. Ó kē le ɔdā dóódu nōo ī pi yɛ ajɛ ā yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú nú lɛ ā. Ɔwɔicō le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
idu_Latn: Adónīkam wɛ ācɛ úlā ce ofahātá ce ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi, klla lɛ ojīlīmā. Ɛlā kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū í tū ɔ̄ ufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
idu_Latn: Ofíílí kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbā ipú ɔtū ā kóō mɛ ā, Urebéka fajɛ le ɔjá nōó gáā hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā ce ɔkɔ. Ó le tá obugā ā gaá le éŋkpɔ̄ pi. N da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kócōō jé éŋkpɔ̄ gā um ka n̄ gwá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
idu_Latn: A géē hɛ oyī kú ɛna ā klá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́kíkā kú ede ɛnɛ nēe hɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́kíkā kú āyā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ede ā, mɛ́mla akā nōo yɛ ɔ́ɔ biílí ā. Ɔwɛ nyā nēé géē je ede ā yá yēŋēē, í je ɔ́ pīya ákú um á.

eng_Latn: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
idu_Latn: É lɛ oje otīihɔ o bá odée nēé tɔ́kpá tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, É kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Óndú ā yá ŋmá ugóolu abɔ̄yīnū.

eng_Latn: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ íne kú um tū, n géē yɔ̄ ī yíihɔtū tū aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɛ íne kú Ádā um tū, nōó kē yɔ̄ ī yíihɔtū tū um ā.

eng_Latn: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó gáā lɛ ā ɔtāhɛ̄ aá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tíne kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ɔtāhɛ̄ aá, géē wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ohile ā a.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ Usáyīrɔsi, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ fu kú ɔ̄ wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Usáyīrɔs, n kwú ɔfú ú gā uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá aéwɔhá alɛwa lé. N gē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í nū aɔ́cɛ́ alɛwa ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā. Kú ā klla mīyɛ ɔfú mɛ́mla ɔfulā kú aɔ́cɛ́ alɛwa. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē nwūla odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú aígelī dóódu ga awɔ. Nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gaá gwū ɔwɛ tū uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si í tóohi dúúmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū wā gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ́ nū, ohígbū koó gē dɛ̄gba tá alɔ ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́fa ŋmá Umɛkéra, Ahíja ŋmá Upélɔn.

eng_Latn: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó ka anúɔ í gáā yá uwā italā ohígbū ajā nēé gbo ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā gē ga ɛgiyí aákwuna kú aíkpɛ́cí dúú. Ó ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ klla ī nyɔ̄ mla uwá, gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí dúú. Ó ka, ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwu ita ka Ācɛ nēé jééyī ŋ́ mā í je kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ má ā, n mágwōnū wɔɔlɔ bɛ̄ɛka okwū ā pī ikpó kú nū. Amáŋ ó kwú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū ú ce um, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Á yúúfi ŋ́. Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí á, ami kē wɛ ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si jé abɔ̄yī nū ka ayíkpó kú nū bá ī ka iŋini ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā yá kú aá le cɔ̄nū nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
idu_Latn: Iyɔ́fú nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī le kpɛ́fú kú alɔ ā í wɛ ɛdɔ kú iyɔ́fú kú ācɛ nēé je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā ŋ́, amáŋ é wɛ iyɔ́fú olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le yá olɛɛlā lé ā. Alɔ gē bī iyɔ́fú nyā le ca áafú ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si jé ɔdā dóódu nōo géē yá ɔ̄ á, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ɛcɛ gaá da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le jé ihɔtū á. Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwú oyēeyī kú nū tónū ohígbū alɔ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó cíkā nɛ̄ alɔ ī je oyēeyī kú alɔ tónū ohígbū ayínɛ́ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
idu_Latn: É kē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú alelékwū nōo nyɔ̄ mla uwá ā. Ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yīnū.

eng_Latn: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ anúɔ ipú ɔtū kú uwā ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ nēé géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ anúɔ ā, ɛ́ɛ gē lɛ iyī uwā fīyajɛ, bá ī jikwū bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o pā ɛcí ā. Eko nēé gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū īkpɔ̄dā mla ejé ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē yá iyī uwā ágbe bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o pā ɛcí ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ o kwu anúɔ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū gā Ujɛ́rīko, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ í nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā mla ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ā, opeyī éyi nēé hī Ubatímīyɔ̄si ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Utímīyɔ̄si cīce okónu ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ka n gbɔɔ́ ō yá únwū ō gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā jééjéē ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, da um ka amīɔɔ ga ɛgiyí Ussɛ́bna, ɔ̄cɛ nōo leyīkwu Agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, gāa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā nyā.

eng_Latn: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ odúúdú ɔdɔ ā kla, kwú ɔdā nēé kla ŋmá anú ā í kpó ga ɛga nēé gē kpó imū bá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
idu_Latn: Iyē ōyɔlá kwɛyí iyē ōyɔlá, ágbe kwɛyí ágbe, iyē ōplla kwɛyí iyē ōplla.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nēé kwú bēé ísu ā, Ɛláyíja da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Da um ɔdā nāa tíne ká n̄ yá ga uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ kéē je um ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔkpáni nū ohi kahíníī, Lɛ ukpɛ̄ ɔ́klɛ́ɛpa kú ɔfú kú alelékwu nɛ̄ a lɛ nōo géē je um pīya ɔ̄cɛ o kwɛyí uwɔ ā, je ga um.

eng_Latn: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā cíkā o jāhɔ̄ klla bá cíí, kéē kē tɛ́yí wāajɛ dúúdú abɔ̄ nēé bá gē jé odée ā a.

eng_Latn: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
idu_Latn: Asárɛlu, Ussɛlɛmíya, Ussɛmárīya.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē lɛ odúúdu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā yá.

eng_Latn: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔtū kóō he aá ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó yá aá ā. Ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, aá gwéeyē ohígbū ɔcɛ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nwū uwā ā. Kéē klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī blibli ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mla aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla odúúdú Ukánsulu ā lɛ ojuju kú uwa yá. É kwú agbá ú kwu Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄ í tū Upáyílēti abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Ó le Ámɔn yálé dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ámɔn gbɔɔ́ ō da ijɔ̄ɔ̄lɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ á. Ɔfú kú Usíya kwú nwuné nɛ̄hi klla le nyīla jāā kwu Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi nɛ̄hi, klla kwú ɔtū í plicō. Ó le ācɛ nēe bá mla anú mɛ́mla aálá, aɛ́wū, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aínyankwūlūmī ā kpó kɔ́ ígwu ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
idu_Latn: Aábaná ā géē pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. É géē hile ipú ísu kú Unáyilu ā ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le hɛ́bɛcɛ lɛ Ébrahām ɛgiyí aɔ́ci óoku kú Umámre ā. Ébrahām cīce okómpīinu kú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū eko kú iyē ō hɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ícíícī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
idu_Latn: N má aɔ́nya mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē ce uwā ā ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má ā. É bī oje oklɔ́ɔtū kpɛ́fú nōo tá ɔwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka oblíicéele mɛ́mla oduufā bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ōwō ā. Īkpɛ̄yí kú aɔ́nya ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄yí kú ágábá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá mɛ́mla ódūdū, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ōwō bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
idu_Latn: Ayípōklóbīya kú Usáyɔn ā cɛgbá klla gbɔɔ́lá lɛ alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ugóolu ā, amáŋ é je uwá abālɔbányā bɛ̄ɛka ɛtɛ́ ɔmɛ icííci ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
idu_Latn: N hī Ɔwɔicō, nōo jé ɔtū kú um ā ijáalí kú um, ka ń tíne kú aá pó ɛlā iwɔ́tū ŋmá ɛgiyí um gɛ ŋ́ mā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ń wā Ukɔ́rīnti ɛgiyí aá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē nwū aá ɛla īkpɛ̄lā éyééye éyééye, ɔgbɔɔbga ɔgbɔɔbga mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí ɛla īkpɛ̄yí ɛla á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá gwōnū. Ká aá géē lɛ ágbe. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ukpa kóō lɛ aá kwú, klla lɛ aá kpó pīya aálagbá.

eng_Latn: And when she is departed out of his house, she may go and be another man's wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ le ɔnyā ā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
idu_Latn: N le uwá fíyákátā ga ipú ācɛ kú éwɔhá nēé jé jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ofúlutu ī fíyɛ́ odée ákátā ga ɛga dóódu ā. Ajɛ olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ uwā má tá áncā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
idu_Latn: Ó klla bī ɛkpa kú ije le pūla aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofigwɛ́ɛpa cigwó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá ā í tōō híhó uwā ŋ́ má, ó cíkā ka aá bá cíí, ká aá yá ɔdā icííci dúúmā nɛ̄ unu egidi kú ācɛ gē nu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā wɛ aɔ́dāhá mɛ́mla aólíla. Aɛ́cí nēé gbā ŋmá ɔcí ā í nwū uwā ɔdā otīile dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a má koó lɛyí táajɛ gā uwɔ klla yɛce uwɔ kpaakpa ā, a le okónu ce mla anú. A lɛ okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ kú Ukéna, ajɛ kú ācɛ Upɛ́rīsi, Ujébusi, Uhám, Ámɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ugɛ́gassi lɛ anú mɛ́mla ayí nū ká ɔ̄ wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā nēé géē lā anú piyóó. Okónu nāa ce ɔ́ɔmā, a kē lɛ ɔ́ tū ohígbū ka a wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ō yá ucē nēe le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le jé ka, Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti ɔ́ɔ wā gáā yɛ áa, ó gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si! Ɔyí Udéfīdi! Ményinyi um.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ehée, Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ kwú Usólōmɔn ú cɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔtūce agbénú kú nū géē je wúla tāajɛ ŋmá icō wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ēpū kú ɔcí eko ɔnɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, géē yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ēpū kú ɔcí kú okónu ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
idu_Latn: Aá ményinyi ācɛ ɔhá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō, Ádā alɔ gē ményinyi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, ohumɔtū, a jɔ̄ɔ̄nyā nɛ̄hi. Īkpēyī kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ mla ihɔtū, ipú īlī ō kléeyī kú uwɔ. Īnyīlɛyí kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī jíliyē, yɔ̄ i hɛ́ kputu, bɛ̄ɛka ígwu kú aɛ́wū nēe bá ī wúla ɔpɛ́ kú Ugílɛ̄di wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū wu oyī kú ɛna ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá ukɔ́tin kú ede ā, igbo ahāapa.

eng_Latn: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́migwáahatá nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, ó kpó ācɛ úla ɛpa ce ofu cigwɛ́ɛpa ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Unátan mɛ́mla Ubenáya kéē lɛ uwá kpó hīgwú wā. Eko nēé le pɛ́ wā ipú inu ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Nááná n géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ícɛ, óócí mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī ɔhá. Ó le kpaakpa kéē lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ŋmó ɛga ɔhá gwu Ujerúsālɛm tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
idu_Latn: Aálelékwū obɔ̄bí bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyē kú ācɛ alɛwa dúú. É bá gē dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á! Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́da je kéē híīī kɛlā ŋ́, ohígbū kéē le jé ka anú wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á.

eng_Latn: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Túblá um, ká n̄ lɛ abɔ̄ ma uwɔ iyē, ɔyí um. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ jé ɔ́dāŋ ka a wɛ ɔyí um, Ísɔ, ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
idu_Latn: Da alɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Ó wɛ íne kú alɔ ō bīya kú ālɔ̄ da ije ɔlɛ́ lɛ Usísa, kɛ̄ɛ ka ó cíkā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
idu_Latn: Ɔdīyá nɛ̄ a gē má ɔjɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo tá eyī kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, amáŋ á kē lɛlá lɛyikwu ígbɔ́ɔcí nōo tá uwɔ eyī ā ŋ́ mā a?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla anú, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó le abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ klla yá ā, gē gɔbū kpaakpa klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Ó yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya klla tá ka anúɔí gbā ɔ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔdā dóódu nɔ́ɔ yá lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū, ŋmá eko nɛ̄ ɔbá nū ɔ́ɔ kwú ā, ɛ́ɛ le kpó ka lɛ anúɔ kpɛ́mm ɛɛ́. Ubówāsi ka anúɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú, Urútu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hi ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla éwo kú ɔlɛ́ nū tá lɛ ā. Ó ka, ɔ́ɔ klla gaá lā ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ jé jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ojuju kóō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí piyóó ā, é gē hī ɔ̄ ka ɔcɛ́ kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa ā lɛ opo kú nū tá. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfu nɛ̄hi, nōo yɔ̄ ī yɔɔlá ā, tá wā í tá ipú ísu nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā í tíne ō je ipíinu kú Udéfīdi yíífi ŋ́, ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ Udéfīdi ka ipíinu kú nū ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na kú uwā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ ɔhá kú uwā mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwā í gáā je pīya ákú alɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ká ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ mla uwā ōfōōfūnū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú é kéē lā mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ébram le Ukedɔlayóma mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ohile ā yálé yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú āa, ɔcɛ́ kú Usɔ́dɔm nyɔ̄ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ, ɔpɛ́ kú Ussáfe .

eng_Latn: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
idu_Latn: Aá je eyī gicō kú aá má ɛyí ɛfu dóódu. Ɛyí ɛfu dúúmā í táajɛ, nɛ̄ aá pā ɛcí anú ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka akwuna néē ī cīkpó nū ɛbɛɛbɛ ā. Aá klla bá ī tíne ɛcí nɛ̄ aá géē pā, bɛ̄ɛka akwuna nōo ī hayi áklō kú ɔwɛ yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ācɛnyīlɔ nōo í cikpó nū ā. Aá klla kwáajɛ gē tíne aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aá ī pā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Arébīya nēe ī héjulúgwu ipú ígbíli ā. Aá kwú ajɛ ā ú tɛ̄ɛlihɔ ŋmá lɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla akwuna ō yá kú aá.

eng_Latn: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
idu_Latn: Ébram kwú Usárāyi, ɔnyā nū, mɛ́mla Ulɔ́tu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ nū ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ Uháran ā ú kpó, anɔ́ɔ uwā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Ukénan á. Eko nēé gā ajɛ kú Ukénan ā.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
idu_Latn: N géē bī odúúdú ɔtū kú um le cɛ̄tra Óndú. N gwéeyē ŋmá ipú ɔtū dúúdú ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
idu_Latn: É yá alɔ ɛhi nwuné nwuné, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, é lɛ ɔdā dóódu nēe géē ce alɔ ɛgbá ā kpótū ipú úgbéenyi lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Ujóssuwa kahíníī, Le ācɛnyīlɔ ōhī fu lɛ alɔ, kéē nyɔ̄ gáā nuunu mla ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki óócí. N géē háyi ɛyí ɛfu kú Óndú ā lɛ okwutɛ ā bī abɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, n klla le ɛga yá lɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ Usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa, nɛ̄ ɛka nōó gbo mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ, eko nōó kpó uwá ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, bá ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ācɛ kú Ujúda yɛ lɛyíkwu igelī kú Udébiyɛ nēé hī ka Ukiriyati Usífa ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē cokónu mla uwá, o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya. Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ɔnya úlā ɛhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ géē má ācɛ ulá ɛhɔ̄ nēe géē ce ɔnya ā glá.

eng_Latn: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄hɔ̄ nyā lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn cɔhɔ́ɔ́há ka ɛfú ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋmá āyā dóódu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, aá lɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄lá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne lɛ ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá a.

eng_Latn: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usábāti le gla ā, Umerí kú Umágāda mla Umerí ɛ́nɛ́ Ujɛ́mīsi mla Usalómi lɛ anɔ̄ okpócu lá kéē géē nyɔ̄ í le nya okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si iyē.

eng_Latn: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ Umídiya yálé. Umídiyan í klla wɛ ɔdūufi lɛ uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ iháyí ofɛpa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn gekwú.

eng_Latn: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄lúfīyē kú uwɔ tá ɛháajɛ ɛyí kú um, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ kē yɔ̄ ī yɛ um iyē á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē bī iyē kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ká anúɔ le cogwo mɛ́mla uwá. Ka anúɔ géē kpó aɔ́nya obī kpɛ́fú úlā ɛhɔ̄ lɛ uwá, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ géē má ācɛ lɛwa ɔlɛ́ uwā nēe í ce aɔ́nya ā glá.

eng_Latn: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
idu_Latn: Usúfu, Ɛlkána, Umáhāti, Amasáyi.

eng_Latn: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
idu_Latn: Ń yá ikpɛ́lā tū ɔlɛɛcɛ ŋ́ mā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n gáā gbeyī cíí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
idu_Latn: N kwú ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ú ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē wɛ ákú um, ikɔkɔ ɔ́kplá kú aá dóódu ā, ācɛ Ulífāyi ā géē wɛ ákú um mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
idu_Latn: Ó le hɛ́ Óndú ā idáagó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄, nōo gē tá ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó bī ɔfú kú nū ā le uwá nyatá abɔ̄yī nū. Ó klla le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ uwá ŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ olɔhi nōó gē yá ɛlā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā cikpó akwuna nyā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ tū mu mla ajā ō gbo mɛ́mla ikpɔ́nyā ō ce ŋmá ɛgiyí nū bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nɛ̄ ejé le uwá kwú āá.

eng_Latn: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí alɛwa gáā le gla n gēe je ɔ́da lɛ ɔ́ ká ō gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ nēé kpó tɔ̄há kwúcē ŋmá ipú aéwo alɛwa, nēe kē lā ɛbɔ́, í yúufi ɛfú dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ó géē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ nēe lā ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe húmáyī tá ipú alácɛ̄ gbojī ɛɛ́ mā, amáŋ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā lā anú ɛbɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda nɛ̄ ó fu á. Ó klla le ɛfu kú usáyɔn nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā fu dúú.

eng_Latn: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
idu_Latn: Okwúukwu kú um le gbogwú ohígbū ɔkɔ ō gbā mla okónu nɛ̄ n gē gwū ā ɛɛ́. N le nyinyi gányá gaá hile ikpokwú ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ń yúklɔ́ kú Ádā um ŋ́, aá cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
idu_Latn: Á híī kwu gwū um tá lɛ aólɛlā kú um ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ācɛ o cījáalī ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu um, klla bá ī fu um ɔnū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, le okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ le eyī pīya kla ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Udánīyɛlu, kéē klla lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
idu_Latn: ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ō tɛtɛ yá īkpɛ̄yí-olɔfú tá Ɔwɔicō eko nōó lɛ ɔtū lé yɔ̄ gē gbēyī Unówa abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē gbā úgbéenyi ā. Ācɛ ahātá ōfōōfūwā nēe bá ipú úgbéenyi ā, nēé hɛ́tá ŋmá enyi nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɛbɛ́ nōo gekwú lé, ó kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ámāŋ éwɔhá, ó géē na īlī kú nū, klla í gwīiyē, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ kóō í je yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ abālɔbányā kú aá pi ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ híīī wɛ ayípɛ̄ nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kɔ nɛ̄ owu kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pīyabɔ̄ piyóó ā ge tá úgbagwú ga amu ga anú ā ŋ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē yá eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē plla ācɛ ka aá gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā á, ācɛ nēe gē yá kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nōó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ákú úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká kú īlī dúúmā ámāŋ ka inu.

eng_Latn: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
idu_Latn: Da uwá dúú kéē kwú aúgbɔ́ɔnya ú ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ohígbū ayí uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā, kéē lɛ ádā uwā bī wā.

eng_Latn: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ géē cīije dúúmā bá ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le fu ā? Ɔwɔicō Abɔ̄yī nu lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
idu_Latn: Uhúram le ɛtɛ́, ɔdofɔ́lá mɛ́mla ocíbú, kpó yá dúú. Odúúdú odée kú úklabɔ̄ kú oje udɔ nɛ̄ ó cokónū nū lɛ Usólōmɔn ka anúɔ géē yá kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú nū ā, ó le uwá kpó yá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔtū he um, n gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ n gē kɛlā. Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kwú, nááná, n leyīce ɔdā nɛ̄ awɔ Ɔwɔicō í yá ga um ā.

eng_Latn: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū yéékpó cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ ka ka Óndú alɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ otá alɔ abɔ̄, alɔ í kē gáā yúufi ŋ́. Ɔdí nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá alɔ glá ā.

eng_Latn: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, é klla kē tá kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, odúúdú ācɛ ā kéē kē cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛɛ́ mā wɛ ka é le ajɔ̄ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Umédes mɛ́mla Upɛ́siya ɛɛ́.
