eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, nyɔ̄ gaá le da ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā ka ami Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ɔ́ɔ ka uwá kéē gaá kllɔcɛ́ kéē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē lɛyítáajɛ gā um ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā le okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ yá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ íne ā tá ɛga dóódu kú Usúsa. Anɔ́ɔ é le aókwū kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uháman ā kpó tū ɔ́ŋgbá playi icō ɛcɛ, ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē má uwá.

eng_Latn: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Obadíya nyɔ̄ gaá le ka lɛ Áhābu, anɔ́ɔ Áhābu gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ gaá jīla mɛ́mla Ɛláyíja á.

eng_Latn: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je aɔ́cɛ́ ā pīya olíla, klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá í yɛ ipácí, í jé ɛga nɛ̄ uwá gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā.

eng_Latn: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, oŋmá lɛ ikwū ɔkpíyē kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā, ó le aá pīya aóklóbīya nū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá bī wā ɛgiyí nū ācɛ nēe tīihɔ, í lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, klla lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti á, Ó géē nuunu lɛ uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔbá ɛyī ā. É géē je aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yíífi, É klla í je ikpokwú kú uwā ca kwɛɛ́kwɛɛ́, É klla í je ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyí kú uwā kpó cē.

eng_Latn: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É bá ī ka iŋini ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhówāsi ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ Ubenhádādi yálé ɔgbɛ́fú igbɛ ɛtá á. Ó klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi mīyɛ eko kú Ujɛhóhāsi ádā kú Ujɛhówāsi ā cīgbīhi.

eng_Latn: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ihɔtū ohígbū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe yá ā. Aá bá ɛbɔ́ mla iyī aá.

eng_Latn: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ufí yá ayíkpó ā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ka lɛ ɔ́mpa uwā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ yɔ̄ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Owu mɛ́mla úgbagwú kōō ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujúdasi oyíbīyājɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Utíca, ami nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ka lɛ ā n.

eng_Latn: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
idu_Latn: Inu ákú abɔ̄yī nū, nōo kwu igbīhi Agbla Ɛgohɛ́pɔ̄ ā, é lɛ ɔ́ gwó bɛ̄ɛka aínu ohile ā dúú. Ó lɛ ɛdɔ inu ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā gwó lɛ ɔnyā nū, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā géē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū wā í kpɛ́fú tú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da ɔnyā ā ka anúɔ í gáā gwutá mla anú ŋ́ ɛ̄cī alɛwa, amáŋ kóō híī gbaajā gɛ ŋ́. Ká ō yɔ̄ cíí lɛ anúɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ kē í yɔ̄ cíí lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú úwé ekwu ú wu iyē, ká aá jikwū. Aá nēe wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɛyí ede ā, aá ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kú aá lɛ úwé ekwu kpó wu iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɔ́tūnōbí otú gbɔ́ɔcī! Ohígbū ka īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ejé í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá gē le gwɛ́ɛya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nāa géē hɛ́pɔ̄ obɔ̄bí gaá kwu āa, a klla í yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ɛpɔ̄hi lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aéwo kú nū yá lɔfú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, kéē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
idu_Latn: N tá Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ n cɛ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó kú um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā um cɛ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā ahínyá. N gē blakwu uwɔ ipú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n ge gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔtū mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
idu_Latn: o ŋmá lɛ ō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó cíkā ō lé ɔdōlé ōtīihɔ ŋ́ mā kóō le lé ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛpɔ̄bí, nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá ɔ̄ italā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á. Ami ā yá ká ɛya nēé gē gwó ā kóō tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
idu_Latn: Da alɔ ɛ́ɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ gē bīyíne kú alɔ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ijē ɔlɛ́ gbā lɛ Usísa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Uróm ā, kɛ̄ɛ koó cíkā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si bēhé nyɔ̄ ohígbū alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbɔbū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya piyóó, bɛ̄ɛka Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki ā.

eng_Latn: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá kɛla lɛ Óndú ā, ó po ɔkɔ éyi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛhíícō kú ɔ̄wū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aúcɛ́rōbim ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ubinúwi wɛ úlā ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gbɛlá ka n géē kpɛ́lā ce aá iyɔ̄bū Ádā ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nōo géē kpɛ́lā ce aá, Umósīsi nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Aá má inu nɛ̄hi nyā a? É gáā habɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ékpó tá cɛyí iyī uwā nēé gáā ce ɔ́ wāajɛ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
idu_Latn: É gē nyɔ̄ ī tayínu ipú aípɔ́lɛ́ ā, kéē há acɛ nēé yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā ŋmó bónū icííci. Ó yɔ̄ ī gbō ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ō gbō uwā ŋ́ mā gɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aá yɔlá tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ujē ōŋmókókó nōo klla le gbájí tɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā le kpaakpa, amáŋ n géē je ɔkwu kú ucē kú aá ɔ́ɔmā tɛ́ɛcɛ. Aɛ́cí kú aá ɔ́ɔmā í kē gáā tá aá abɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le da alɔ, ɔfú nyá nɛ̄ a lɛ ká ā yá aɔ́dā nēe bá ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ je ɔfú ā gā awɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú, bla ka aólɛlā kú uwɔ, bá ī yɛhɛ tū uwɔ. É lɛ ɛlá wu ɛlā kú uwɔ ŋ́, é klla bá ī leyī gwō uwɔ bónū.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anúɔ le ɔhā mɛ́mla okónu ō tá kpó tá lɛ uwá kéē jila je éyi ŋmá anú. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ā lɛ yá uwā ajɛ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā kpó uwā nyɔ̄ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ í blakwu aɔ́dā ɛpa nɛ̄ anúɔ kpó lɛ uwá kéē je éyi ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā lɛ ōhī nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kéē tá ā tá uwā, anɔ́ɔ é habɔ̄ uwā tá kéē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam kɛlā kahíníī, Ubálāki, ɔ̄cɛ kú Umówābu bī um wā ŋmá Usiríya, ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Ó kahíníī, Wā ká ā kɛlā kwɛyí um. Lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka awɔ húmáyī tá um abɔ̄ á. N gē yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē klla í yɔ̄ ī gwíijē ipú obobowú kú acá kú uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyí ugwū ī yɔ̄ ipú acá kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ Óndú le hīgwú ɛɛ́, le pīya ɔ̄cɛ olɛ iyī nū kú ɔlɛ́ Óndú. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ iyī nū nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú ɛɛ́ le pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú bī ije nēé ī le lá ámú kú igbō ékpónú ā, le cikpó akwuna glá. Amáŋ, ikpó ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ō ce, gē je odúúdú agbénú mɛ́mla oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ yíífi ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē nū aólɛlā kú uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, anɔ́ɔ ó le anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú nū, nyatá ŋmá ōcē kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ma ayí á.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēe géē tá ɛcō aflɛ́yí fiyɛ̄ ɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ohile géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá anú dúú á.

eng_Latn: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ jé ɔbá nū ā lɔɔlɔhi, ɛga dóódu, ó klla kē wɛ éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Usɛdɛkíya wɛ iháyí ofu ce éyi ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwóléyi.

eng_Latn: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
idu_Latn: Eyōonyā gē tū uwā ufi, amáŋ ɔdā otūufi kú otú ā le jé uwā iyē.

eng_Latn: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē bī Ísrɛ̄lu tá nyā lɛ uwá kpó bī, lɛ uwá kpó nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
idu_Latn: Usídɔn, Ámālɛ̄ki, mɛ́mla ācɛ Umówābu, tɛtɛ yá uwā ōwē. Ɛ́ɛ le ikwū je wā gaá klá anúɔ. Anúɔ í nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó je ɔkɔ gicō nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce ācɛ nēe jila abɔ́ɔ ā ka.

eng_Latn: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyá nɛ̄ alɔ í gwíijē kú Óndú ā ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá lɛ ā ā?.

eng_Latn: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
idu_Latn: É klla kpɛ́fú igbɔhá kpɔ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ugáti. Ɔbáagwu éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ ɛhīlī mɛ́mla ayíkīkpó ɛhīlī dúú.

eng_Latn: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upáyílēti yāajɛ úgādā ɛpɔ̄ kú nū ā, ɔnyā nū le ɛ̄hɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híīī yá ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka um móōwē alɛwa otú ipú ɔ̄na ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī yá uwēyī um mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē nwā ā, ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē híhó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ í wā ipú ɛgahi kú nū, mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Ádā mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛ agbá kpó kwu aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ā ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄. É klla í ce aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā odó.

eng_Latn: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le odúúdú úklɔ́ ā kpó yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cābɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
idu_Latn: Āá gē dɛ̄ íbá ka eko nyá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē mabɔ̄ ɛfú nōo yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ nyā tá āa? Óndú, kócōō, kwú ɔkpacaŋgelī kú uwɔ ú wu apɛ́ cíí mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
idu_Latn: Aá ka dúú kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ bī ede le gbɛka, ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɛka gbo ŋmá lɛ ɛhi nōo yɔ̄ ɛyí ede ā, ó géē yá ɛka kú nū ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.
idu_Latn: Udelíla le ɔ́ já gwutá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyɔ̄lā ú gbo. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ocucu ōgwá kú īnyīlɛyí kú nū ahāapa ā yá le oje-oyɛ́yí wu ɔ́ bá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka Usámsin, ācɛ Ufilístiya ɔ́ɔ gē wā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó pi īnyīlɛyí kú nū ā gblúu, kwú ɔ̄ ú wī á.

eng_Latn: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
idu_Latn: A pó eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá ojuju mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɔkpáncō ā nɛɛ? Awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ wɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ nōo jéeyī á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ kú Ulída mɛ́mla Ussárɔn ā le ɔ́ má, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú āá.

eng_Latn: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ipú ɛwa nēe pó ɛlā nyā kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
idu_Latn: A le uwá yá nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā eko kpií a, a kwú ɔfulā kú ofú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā ú kwu ɔ́ ɛyí, a klla kwú uwā ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kóō mafú lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ihɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, kóō yá ká aá gbolóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá nū ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā bɛ̄cɛ dúúdú ŋ́, ācɛ nēe géē hile ipú ajɛ ā géē wɛ ɛpɛ̄ ō bū tū aá eyī klla géē wɛ ujē ō kwu aá áklō. É géē je unwalu lɛ aá ɛga dúú nɛ̄ aá lā ā.

eng_Latn: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
idu_Latn: Umakinadébāyi, Ussássāyi, Ussaráyi.

eng_Latn: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú uwā géē lɛ abɔ̄ fú umu kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla anɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ anú mɛ́mla ɔtulalī umuumu nēe bá ɛyí nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔlá ɛyí ede ā kóō wɛ oblatū keé kwú odúúdú nū ú lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū í he Óndú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́, géē mīyɛ abɔ̄ ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, ka anɔ́ɔ gē cílá anú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
idu_Latn: N kē jé ka eko nɛ̄ n géē wā ɛgiyí aá, n géē wā ká n̄ yá kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō lɛ ɔhā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi hɛ́ ce aá.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ubássa yá ā mɛ́mla odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ɔtū ōlɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdā ohile nōó yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aígbómína ā gē je ɔdōlé lɛ aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú nū ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nańdaa kwu eyī ísu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā kóō kwú cīgbīhi.

eng_Latn: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛlá kwu ɔ́ kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēé tá ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi ā, kéē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū yá jīla. Ó klla da uwá ka é híī je mlanyī āyā dúúmā kú íne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á, kú aá híī wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ŋ́ má. Ɔfú nōo bī aá klá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, n lɛ ɔ́ catāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yāwu lɛ ɔkɔ kwicō gɛ̄mm.

eng_Latn: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ lɛ akā kú aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā ā le hɛ́ tāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī pi uwá abɔ̄fú mɛ́mla ákanya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē fu gɔbū á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kahíníī, Óndú ā gē nuunu tá alɔ, lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ālɔ̄ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá amānyā.

eng_Latn: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔfú nyā tū ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe ī nwū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu íne ā kahíníī, Aá kwú ikpáti kú Ɛka ā ú háyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn, ɔyí kú Udéfīdi gwó ā. Ó gaá cɛgbá kú aá yɔ̄ gē bī ɔ̄ ī yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ aá géē bá ī gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá mla ákú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄gbā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā kpó tɔ̄lá. Ohígbū kéē wɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā. Ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá nēé wɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma nēe lā Ugɛ́ba ā. Amáŋ, é lɛ uwá kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Umanáhāti. Ugɛ́ra, ádā kú Úsaa mɛ́mla Ahíhūdu ā kpó uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ, Ukíssīyɔn, Udábērati.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ da uwá kéē tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu wā agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú anúɔ eko nɛ̄ Usólómɔ̄n ɔ́ɔ í wā í cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú anúɔ ā. Ó ka anú ɔ́ɔ gáā lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí anúɔ á. Ó ka ohígbū ka Usólómɔ̄n nɛ̄ anúɔ fu kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ajɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, okóohō ā í má ɛga ō lɛ ikpó kwaajɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le wu cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí úgbéenyi ā. Unówa le abɔ̄ nā ga ɛcɛ, mīyɛ ɔ́ wā ipú úgbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ayínɛ́ nū nááná í lɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú igbīhi í cē kwú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le íne kú nū bīya á. É klla gbɔɔ́ ō pā aɛ́ci mɛ́mla aójibó nēé hī ka Ubáalu mɛ́mla Ássɛ̄ra ā.

eng_Latn: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, le Ujóssuwa je gicō nɛ̄hi ipéyī ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó cɛ̄ le uwá lɛ ojílīma ce ɔ́ ipú oyēeyī kú nū dúúdú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ojīlīmā ce Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔnyā éyi nɛ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí lā ipú iye kú nū, nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ doōcē iháyí igwáahātá. Ó le hā táajɛ í hayi kpaakpa fúlufúlu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kéē je ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú nū lɛ aá, klla yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n ka, ehée Óndú. Ohígbū ka ɔdā dúú nōo wɛ ɔdēlihɔ ámāŋ nōo blínyī í ga okónu kú um jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ihɔtū nāa ī yá tú um eko dóódu ā, lɛ aólɛlā kú um kpó ŋmó, ká ā klla lɛ odúúdú ācɛ o wɔ́tū um ā kpó yíífi, ohígbū ka n wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa géē lɛ ikpó gbo ɔ́ klla í gwōnū, í je yíifi ŋmá ajɛ. Ukpa ā géē kwú uwá.

eng_Latn: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
idu_Latn: Óndú cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu aéwo nēé jé uwɔ ka awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́, nēé klla ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ mā. É kwú alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ í kpó ŋmó, kwú alɔ í kpó yíífi dúúdú. É klla kwú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ é kwú uwā ú kpó lé ā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lɔfú jé ka ɔdā dúúmā tá ipú kú uwā ŋ́, ohígbū keé le gányá gányá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n le héyī á.

eng_Latn: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kahíníī, N húmáyī yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ, Óndú ā, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwúcē ŋmá ɛka nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla uwá gbo ā, é klla le ede kú uwɔ ā catāajɛ. É klla bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ami ōfōōfū um nōo hile ā, é kē yɔ̄ ī tíne ō je um ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
idu_Latn: É géē pīya īlī nɔ̄wá ā klá odúúdu ɔdā nēe bá nyā, klla í pīya ɔkpɛ́ɛwu ā klá anú, klla í je ɔcí ō le bī ɔ̄ ā ú wu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n géē je uwɔ yíífi ā, n géē je obū klá ɔkpáncō, klla í kpó aínyílɔ́wɔ ā dobū. Ɛnɔ géē gaá tayínū igbīhi ojuja, ɔyā í kē gáā fíyɛ́ ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ipú icɔ́ɔci ā, ó he um ɔtū fíyɛ́ ká n̄ kɛlā ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá odo kú um, nɛ̄ ācɛ géē jɛ́ɛyí nū nōo géē tá ācɛ ɔhá abɔ̄, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ n géē kɛlā úlúúlúla okónu ucē ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
idu_Latn: n géē tū ɔwɔ wā ajɛ gé lɛ aá eko nōo cíkā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ajɛɛhɔ̄ kú aá kóō yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, ka īkpɔ̄cí kú aá kéē gwá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācohumɔtū, aá bla kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá da aá eko nōo yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
idu_Latn: Ó gē pó uya otūufi eko dóódu. Eko nōó gbɛlá ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ā, ācɛ nēe ī héjulúgwu géē wā í tū ɔ̄ iyē.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ipú ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu pī Ujɔ́dan, ŋmá Ujɛ́rīko ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.
idu_Latn: yá italā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō yá ɔ̄cɛ nōó kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́ɔ ā. Ó ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gē cī ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ŋmá ísu kú Ánɔn ɛháajɛ ā ga Ujábɔ̄ku ipú ajɛ kú ɛhíícō nōo ŋmá ígbíli kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kwu ɔkpacaŋgelī kú Usɔ́lu ú playi úwé kú oje ā, anɔ́ɔ ó cēyītīkwū kóō fu ikpó, anɔ́ɔ ó fu ikpó glá gɛ ŋ́ má, ohígbū ka iyē nū í jé úwé oje ō lɛ wiyē ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ kpó plla á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tíkpa kú aádáádā nū, o ŋmá lɛ ɔ́bíipú ō bī tū Óndú ā mɛ́mla íne kú nū ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. N kē í leyīkwu aá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá kwú kpó hila ókplīcī le īnyīlɛ̄yí nɛ̄hɛ́ bū. Ami yɔ́ɔ́na kú aá á, n kē í leyīkwu aá. N géē tá aá abɔ̄ klla ī nya aá tá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.
idu_Latn: É ka abɔ̄ aá bá ī nyɔ̄ ipú ajɛ née bá ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le odúúdú ācɛ Ámɔn nōo lā anú ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā dúú. Ka anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá íkííkée ā, é lɛ ɛga éyi tútū nēé géē gwɔ́ɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya í yɔlá. É lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā bū lipú nɛ̄hi, ó klla lɔwá nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɛfú pla tū jāā kwɛ̄ɛcɛ licō gónóó ā. Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē mu ígblɛ́nyī ɔlā fuuu klá ɔ̄, í hɛ́ ɔlá kwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
idu_Latn: Atarɔ́tússófán, Ujasa, Ujɔgbéha.

eng_Latn: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ. É gwó uwā bónū ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ awɔ ā kē háyi lɔfú ohígbū ka a cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō. Amáŋ aá híī bī ɔ́ɔmā gwō ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá yúufi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Óndú ā lɛ Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi gaá le ácīije nyā tá lɛ ɔ́ ka, ācɛ ɛpa éyi bá igelī ékpónú. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā kē wɛ ogbɛhá.

eng_Latn: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ó le ɔdōlé lé, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛ́nyɔ́ má á. Ó yɔ̄ mla ayíkpó nēe bá Udamáskɔ̄si ā ɛ̄cī alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛlá kwu ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ kéē cíká ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ tū cíí lɛ anúɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā je ɔ́da lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
idu_Latn: Usekaríya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ído á. Uméssūlam wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugínnētɔn á.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da ayínɛ́ nū kahíníī, N gaá kwú ɛɛ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē leyīkwu aá. Ó kē í kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ nyā, ga ajɛ nōó cokónu ō je lɛ Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da aá ka Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā, í lɛ ɔdōwiyē nōo lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka aódodó nēe bá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū Íjīpiti, lɛ italā yá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ é le jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
idu_Latn: Aá, ācɛ nēé gē gbɔ ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ā, aá jé ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔya kú ɛcɛ nyā wɛ olɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ nōo le miya ka anúɔ í wɛ ɔya kú ɛcɛ nyā, kwú pīya olɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Usédekīya nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛbɛ́ tū Umikáya ahɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ alelékwū kú Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um wā í kɛlā ga uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
idu_Latn: Aúgbéenyi kú Uhíram nōo bī oje ɔdɔ ŋmá Ófɛri ā klla bī ɔcí nēé hī ujúnīpa mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi wā dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛ aɛ́fú ā, kwu ɛ́nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄hi, aáyɔ́kpá mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛga dúúmā kú ajɛ ā, nēé je kpó catāajɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe tá alácɛ, nɛ̄ aéwɔhá nōo yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá kpó wu klla gē yá uwā okónu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
idu_Latn: A tá ō je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gē ŋmó uwá ā. Á klla je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwá, lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ itene kóō yɔ̄ gē yēeyī kpɔ́ á? Ákú um ā, ɛyí kú oyēeyī wɛ o yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛhɔ̄. Ikwū kú um kē géē bī itene gé um.

eng_Latn: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
idu_Latn: Ogbɛhá wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú olɔdu nɛ̄, ācɛ nēe kplá ije ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ kú acɛ nēé kplá ije ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko o tū īkpō ufáyin ā bá ā gā ā, ó le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aólufa ā kóō mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ īkpō kú ufáyin kú nū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā gé lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ aólufa ā le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋmíije, le ɔ́ tū abɔ̄ áncā gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
idu_Latn: N lɛ īlī ekwu gɔ̄ wiiyē. Ɔwɔicō klla le um yálé dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ɛwa ā. Ayíkpó ā le pɛ́ tū ipú ɔ́kɔ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si húmáyī cīce ipú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú le yɛ á. Aɔ́kɔ ɔhá nyɔ̄ mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
idu_Latn: Ussɛ́kɛm da ádā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ kú Udáyína kahíníī, Aá kóocōō ká n̄ má eyī olɔhi kú aá, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá ka gā um, n géē je lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gwííje nyā ka, Bū ŋmá ajɛ obugā. Alɔ í gwííjē gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
idu_Latn: Ɛlúsāyi, Ujérīmɔtu, Ubéyalíya, Ussemárīya mɛ́mla Ussɛfatíya nōo ŋmá Uhárifu ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɔ́mpa nū, ohígbū kōó cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ó le ɛpɔ̄bí lé.

eng_Latn: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdu ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā géē má ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá fu kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛ́ɛ kē í yúúfi uwā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Ká lɛ uwá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka oyēeyī kú uwā he uwá ɔtū, ayíka kéē híī bī iyó dúúmā ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā ŋ́. É híī bī ɔdā dúúmā bēhé igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ɛ̄cī Usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē ce aɔ́nya nēe ī kwinya nɛ̄hi í le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú aá. Aá kwu mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Aá gbɛlá ka aɔ́nya kú aá gē kwinya nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ aɔ́nya kú ācɛ nēe gē nū aá inya ā géē kwinya fíyɛ́ ákú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kwú iyī uwā ikpó í kpó tū o gbā ubáalu kú Upéyɔ ɛ̄gbā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla uwá nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyā ō lɛ ɔbá lɛ oji hɛ́ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā le gbɔbū, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī gbēyī alɔ ajɛ kú Utrɔ́wasi.

eng_Latn: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
idu_Latn: É géē klá ɛyí ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā má ajɛ eyī glá ŋ́. É géē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nōo hile, nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā í bīya ŋ́ mā kpó lé. Kwu aɔ́cí nēe hile bá ī jɛ̄ ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ɛwa le tá ipú inu ā, anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ kóō lɛyí kú ācīije nɛ̄ ó tá ā ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī bēhé ga ipú igelī ā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi nōo bī ɔjá kú éŋkpɔ̄ géē jīla aá ɔwɛ. Aá tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ga ipú inu nōó í bēhé nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
idu_Latn: Cɛ̄ ká ālɔ̄ wɛ aóklóbīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádā alɔ tɛtɛ wɛ ā. Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ̄ nyā, n bī gaá yá uwɔ ɛhi. Ó lɛ ā, lɛ oklóbīya kú awɔ mɛ́mla Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú um.

eng_Latn: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá ā le yá ā, Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Ujudíya, ó yɔ̄ mla uwá abɔ́ɔ gē yá ācɛ ubatísim.

eng_Latn: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
idu_Latn: Ujonátan wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umáluci á. Ujósɛ̄fu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussebaníya á.

eng_Latn: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
idu_Latn: eko nēé le da ɔ́ ka íne nōó bīya á, ó géē bī ɔnyā ɛwū nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ ā da um ka amiyɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū ō bɛ́ɛpa ŋ́ ka n̄ nyɔ̄ mla uwá. Ayínɛ́ ɛhīlī nēé bá mbá ā tīkpó mla um ga Usísarīya, anɔ́ɔ alɔ le tá ɔlɛ́ Ukɔnélīyɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
idu_Latn: Ami Ujúudu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo klla wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú Ujémīsi gē tɔ́kpá fu ācɛ nēe he Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā ɔtū, nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē leyīkwu uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ, aá háyi lɔfú ipú ɔtōōce Ɔwɔicō kú aá, aá kóō lɔtū, aá lɔfú tīiyē.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ussálum yá ā, kwu ujɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tū ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu mā ō nū ācɛ ɔhá ā inya ā, ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū túbá lɛ uwá gbaáluka, anɔ́ɔ ó má ka, ācɛ igwáahāānɛ blā Ásāhɛlu nɛ̄ ɛfú ɔ́ɔ lé á.

eng_Latn: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híīī tū íne lɛ aá ohígbū ɔdōlé ámāŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í gwá ámāŋ ohígbū ɛ̄cī ō tīihɔ ámāŋ ka ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ámāŋ Usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi wā í klá ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm, nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ dóódu nōo géē pó ā í gwōoje wámm.

eng_Latn: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā í lā abɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́, ufi kú ɔ̄cɛ o kpó ūwā yíífi í gáā yá uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó le eliká kú ugóolu ō le je utébulu ā ŋmá ajɛ ɛnɛ yá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwá ú kpó kwu ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ikpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔ́na kú aá ā, eko nɛ̄ aá wɛ ɛdrɔ́ ā. Gbɔ̄bū ɛ́ɛ́ kú eko unwalu kú ókplícī kóō wā, nɛ̄ aá géē ka ka, aá í jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ mīyɛ ígbó igwó kú umáyisānū gē lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā. Ó klla da ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ lɛ ohi kpó gé lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
idu_Latn: Ojuju obɔ̄bí nēé gé tū ā lɛ ɛ́fa nōo lɔfú ŋmɔ́cɛ glá bɛ̄ɛka ákú aáyi kú ogwiji ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le ayi kú ogwiji lé, nōó le hɛ́ ipú kú nū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɔfú kwú glá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nōó lɛ lɛ o pīya ɔyí wɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ojuju obɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū klla gbɔɔ́ ō bū igbɔhá igbīhāajɛ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
idu_Latn: É cíkā kéē bá amānyā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ kéē kpɛlā ce um ɔ́dāŋ kéē bī ɛlā dúúmā lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ŋmá abɔ́ɔ fu odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā kéē gaá le jīla Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, é tíne ō bī ula lɛ Ujóssuwa plla. É nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdōlé tútū, le iyó gwó ce ijakī kú uwā. Iyó ā wɛ áhingílí, mɛ́mla ɛkpa nɛ̄ncɛ̄, mɛ́mla ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ gáā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ má eyī ā mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū ɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ ā lɛ anú mɛ́mla ayááyí nū, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ yɛce Óndú ā mla ɔtū ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá um ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwúcē, n géē mīyɛ awɔ cīgbīhi. A í wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ikɔkɔ o yɔ̄ ī mīyɛ ɛlā ɛflɛ́ɛfu mla ɛlā olíla ā, a géē yɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔna kú ɛhɔ̄ okpaakpa, a klla í wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ a í pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí uwɔ, á gāa cɛgbá o ga ɛgiyí wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
idu_Latn: Ussélōmiti, ɔyí kú Ujósīpíya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubáni mɛ́mla ācɛ ofaahātá.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
idu_Latn: Aókwū kú uwā géē bá ɛbɛɛbɛ ɛgiyí aójibó kú uwá mɛ́mla ɛgiyí aéde, mɛ́mla ɛyí aɛ́fu, mɛ́mla ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu nēé ge nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ācɛ ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
idu_Latn: A géē jééyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nāa jé ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū í he uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ odúúdu ācɛ kú uwɔ nēe bá nyā kpó ŋmó, aéwo nēé lɛ ofu kú ɔfú kú uwɔ pó ɛɛ́ mā géē ka.

eng_Latn: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ aígabɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kú nū á. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā wɛ Asárīya, ɔyí kú Usádɔ̄ku.

eng_Latn: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyí éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka, Usɔ́lu, nōo jōklóbīya nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo jōklóbīya bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anú klla jɛ̄ licō fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá géē lā amānyā, kú ayínɛ́ aá o hile kéē ga ɔgbɛ́fú ōfōōfū uwā kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ da Árɔ̄ni kóō lɛ okwutɛ kú nū fíyajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka úmúlá kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kóō kwú pīya ɛlá.

eng_Latn: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
idu_Latn: o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ icɔ́ɔci ā pīya ákú iyī nū ā, icɔ́ɔci olɔhi nɛ̄hi, ó le yēŋēē, ó lɛ ɛnyá ɛga dóódu ŋ́, ó lɛ ɛ́kpā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka iyē o kwányíhí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ eko éyi gaá yɛ nɛ̄ a wā ajɛ gaá yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nōo túufi nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ alɔ í leyīce ŋ́. Aɛ́fu kē bá ī jíliyē abɔ̄ a wā ā.

eng_Latn: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá dúúmā í klá yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka Umósīsi ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Óndú ā gē kɛlā mla anú leyīkwu eyī.

eng_Latn: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iyē uwɔ lé ka ɔnyɛ̄ nɛ̄? Ó tóohi kahíníī, Iyē kú um lé ka Igblíkútu. Ohígbū ka aálelékwū alɛwa pɛ́ ga ipú iyē kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le yɛ tá Upɛ́nūwɛ̄lu gaá lɛ ɛdɔ ɛ̄ba ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ba, amáŋ ɛdɔ ohi ékpónú nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usúkɔ̄tu tá ɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ācɛ Upɛ́nūwɛ̄lu tá ɔ̄ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
idu_Latn: Umējákɔn mɛ́mla Urákɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ nōo yɛ Ujópa jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
idu_Latn: Ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ́ alɛwa bá ɔlɛ́ Ádā um. N yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ gaá tú ɛga tū gbēyī aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, n géē yɛ í da aá dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
idu_Latn: A gē lɔfú da aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ eko nēé ī bɛ̄cɛ ā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi igwó mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwá, lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhati ā.

eng_Latn: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó odúúdú ayípōklóbīya ācɛ nɛ̄hi nēe jōklóbīya ā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja o ī ce ɔnya kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Ucaldíi nēe ŋmá Upékodu, Ussówa, mɛ́mla Ukowa ā, klla mɛ́mla ákú Asírīya ā wā í jīla tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí gē bī ɛlā kú íla kú uwā gwō. É gē bī únwū obɔ̄bí kú ɔkpíyē ī le kwú ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ gē kwu ŋmá oyēeyī kú ínoōbīya nēé tɛtɛ yɔ̄ anú ā.

eng_Latn: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Ó pīyeyī má igbīhi lɛ um má. Ó lɛ um hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ n le tá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó le ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíigbō kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ikpɛ̄yí hɛ́, kwú okwū kú nū ú playi ɔcí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu ka ā.

eng_Latn: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
idu_Latn: É géē pó uya kú āpīice kú aɔ́nya nēe pɛ́ ī wā ā. É klla í pó uya kú akā kú úgbɔ́ɔnya kákákáká. Aádā í kē gáā pīyeyī má ayí uwā glá ŋ́. Abɔ̄ kú uwā í je ŋmó tá uwā iyē dɛnglɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kpɔ́ kahíníī, Má gwutá ce abɔ̄lúfīyē kú uwɔ. N géē je ɛpɔ̄bí kú ewo kú Ísrɛ̄lu ce uwɔ ɛyí. A géē klá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄cī ofu igwáaháanɛ ce igwó, í yɔ̄ ī móōwē ɛpɔ̄bí kú uwā. N lɛ uwɔ tū ōwē kú ɛ̄cī éyi nāa géē móōwē ā kóō kwɛyí iháyí éyi kú odúúdú eko nēé géē móōwē ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́tin kú igá kú ede ā mɛ́mla aógbló kú nū mɛ́mla aígbóoje-otáajɛ kú uwā. Aúkɔ́tin kú okómpinu eyīpú ā mɛ́mla aɔ́ŋgbá kú uwā, aɔ́dōpiyɔ́ŋgbá kwajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyó nēé géē bī le yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ, Utímōti, a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō, le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí nēe bá nyā āa, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yɛce ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa klla lɔhi. Cēyītīkwū ká ā yúufi Ɔwɔicō, ká ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū. Yíihɔtū, lɛ ɔtū lé, cɛ́ɛ́ a klla kē gbonɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ukóhāti wɛ ipɔ́ɔma aflɛ́yí kú Ulífāyi nēé je aípɔ́lɛ́ lɛ uwá á. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā, é kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛtá lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Usímīyɔn mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā dúúmā í lɔnyɛ tū um ŋ́, ohígbū Umɔ́dɛkāyi nōo ī wā í cīce okómpíinu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ eko dóódu ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
idu_Latn: Kwu ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ dúú, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ōhī kú oyī ā kwu ajī kú ede kú ɔtulalī umuumu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú oyī ohile ā ú pīya tū ɛháajɛ kú ede nēé gē yi odée ɔló ɛyí nū ā, nōo yɔ̄ okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā í ce ɔcɛ́ ɛcɛ, ó kē í gbō ɛcɛ mla ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nɛ̄ ó ī hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē ŋmó ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Umówābu mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú ɛyí ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
idu_Latn: Ufi lɛ odúúdú uwá kwú eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má ā. Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ uwá bōōbū. Aá lɔtū lé, ami nɛ̄. Aá yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Uyírɔn, Umígidālelu, Uhórɛm, Ubɛtánáti, Ubɛti Ussēmēssi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā. O pīya tɔ̄há kú odúúdú uwā wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi igwáahāānɛ.

eng_Latn: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō wɛ alɔ ámāŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā í lɛ ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi nɛ̄ ó wɛ ékpónú mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ alɔ ka lɛ aá ā ŋ́, ń ba Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ōwē yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
idu_Latn: Unówa gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhá kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le okóohō ā tɛhɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ijē okónu hɛ́, ká aá gwō ɔdā ō bī gwíijē. Aá gwō ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla úmōlō.

eng_Latn: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá alɔ italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā ŋ́. Ó kē cíla alɔ óluma ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogbɔ̄wɛ gē nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́, aálá ā ke í pó ɔkɔ kú nū. Ó gē hī aálá kú nū iyē abɔ̄yī uwā, ó kē í kpó wā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ klla ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúúmā bɔ́tū lɛ olɛhɔ̄ dúú nɛ̄ anúɔ í tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, ɔ́ɔ géē kwú piíí. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla ka ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī iyē kú aɔ́wɔ ɔhá lɛ ɛlā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
idu_Latn: Ayí uwɔ le íne bīya ŋmá lɛ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kéē híī yá ŋ́ mā, anú yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá uwā italā kú ɔdā nēé yá ā á.

eng_Latn: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
idu_Latn: Ugíbeyɔn wɛ ofɛnɛ ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ayí kú Urúbɛ̄n ā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce ula ahāanɛ ce ofɛhīlī ce igwo .

eng_Latn: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tɛ́ɛcɛ gaá lɛ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ahāapa nēe kē bɔ̄bíipú fíyɛ́ anú abɔ̄yī nū kpó, anɔ́ɔ é gā gaá lā abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ āhɔ̄ kú igbīhāajɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā klla bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ āhɔ̄ aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā nēé hī ka Ukálɛ̄bu ā ka anúɔ géē je ɔyí anúɔ nɔ̄nyā, Ákīsa, lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ Ukiriyati Usífa ā yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā kwú pīya ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nááná nōó cɛgbá kú ɔtū kóō bīya lɛ aá ohígbū ɛdɔ kú ōwē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí alɛwa nɛ̄ aá má ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gáā le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ā yá á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le odúúdú ayí nū kpó hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwa kahíníī, Aá lɛ iyī aá túbá, ká n lɛ ɔdā nōo géē yá á ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
idu_Latn: N géē hɛ uwɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔfú kú ācɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā. Ami Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
idu_Latn: Aíhō igwɛ́ɛpa nēé bī le yá odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú aókonɔɔwɛ igwɛ́ɛpa ā á. É bī íhō éyééye le yá odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ éyééye. Ugóolu eyīnēēnū nōo gē ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā nēé bī le yá úláyi kú igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbaáluka á. É gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū mɛ́mla inu kú aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:
idu_Latn: Ó gbojī ŋ́, Ahítōfɛlu da Ábsālɔm kóō lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ācɛ úlā ofucigwó kpó cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ nū Udéfīdi inya otú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ubasíllāyi nōo ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di ā, gā ŋmá Urogélim wā í bī ɔcɛ́ tá, bēhé Ujɔ́dan dúú.

eng_Latn: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o híhó iyɔ̄bū ācɛ dóódu kahíníī, Ń jé ɔdā nɛ̄ a ī ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ɔdúúdú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti dóódu nēe bá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā géē kwú. O ŋmá ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú ɔcɛ́ ā nōo gáā lúgwū ɔcɛ́ kú ádā nū ā, jāā gaá kwu ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔfiyɛ nōo gē gbā īkpɔ̄dā ā. Ayí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aɛ́na ma ā géē pɛ́ kwú dúú.

eng_Latn: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī ōlikpó wɛ itene kú íjééyī nɛ. Agbénú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā wɛ itene nɛ̄hi kú íjééyī dúú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhánɔn lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kpó kwú, klla lɛ uwá āyā éyi kú ɔnwāagba kú éyééye kú wā kpó wā, klla lɛ īlī híla tū uwā iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá nū ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn: Ɛlíyɛ̄sa, ɔyí kú Usíkri. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn: Ussefatíya, ɔyí kú Umáaka.

eng_Latn: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
idu_Latn: Otu éyi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíigbō ā, le ɔ̄na ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nā. Amáŋ ɛyí kú ɔ̄na kú uwā ā kē wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ gáā da Usedekíya ka Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, Usedekíya, n géē je aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ nēe bī aíyɛ́fú bá ī kpɛ́fú ā tá ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā pīyeyī lɛyíkwu uwɔ. N kē géē kpó odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ ā mɛ́mla ákú aólɛlā bēhé tɔ̄há wā ipú igelī nyā.

eng_Latn: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí aɛ́fu ā nɛ̄ aá lɛ agōdō kú aá tá gē gwutá mɛ́mla aákwuna á. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ aá kē ī nyɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya, gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n gbɛlá tū ɛlā kú Ussɛmáya nyā, n le má ka, Ɔwɔicō í kɛlā lɛ Ussɛmáya ŋ́, amáŋ Utobíya mɛ́mla Usánbālati le omíci je lɛ ɔ́ lé kú ɔ̄ lɛ ukɔ̄ nyā tū um.

eng_Latn: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄dā ā le bū, gbɔɔ́ ō jɛ̄ ā, ácí ā le jɛ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kwu uwā ú pīya ɔfiyɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē ce ɛfú klla hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla o bī yúklɔ́ kú ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā. Jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā, é gē yúklɔ́ nyā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, N géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe kpɛ́lā ce uwɔ ā gā. Anɔ́ɔ Igbómína ā le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē bēē gbō ɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū kú Uhérɔ̄du.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
idu_Latn: Aá gaá má owu ámāŋ ka ɔwɔ ŋ́, nááná ā ɔkpa nyā géē je cēenyi, nɛ̄ aá mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú aá géē gwá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, kahíníī, Ó lɔhi kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā kóō yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ŋ́. N géē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ otábɔ̄ nōo cíkā lɛ ɔ́ yá lɛ́ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usára kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le éeyē mɛ́mla ɛhɛ bī gé um ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo le ɛ̄nyā pó, géē yɛhɛ mɛ́mla um.

eng_Latn: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ cīce bá ī lé ɔdōlé tɔhá mla anú ā lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ákú ācɛ nēe géē cīce í lé ucɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
idu_Latn: Óndú, gbɛlá kwu Udéfīdi ohígbū odúúdú ōwē nɛ̄ ó má ā.

eng_Latn: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: N kwú uwā ú lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Kéē yúklɔ́ gā um ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um. Kéē gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ífi mɛ́mla obɔ̄bí nōo géē wā ɛgiyí uwā, eko nēé túblá ɛga otīihɔ kú um a.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
idu_Latn: Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ācɛ gē hī obugā nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ukádɛss mɛ́mla Ubɛrēdi ā kahíníī, Obugā kú Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yēeyī nōo ī má um á.

eng_Latn: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
idu_Latn: Aá Abɔ̄yī aá jé, ayínɛ́ alɔ, ka aha nɛ̄ alɔ tá wā ɛgiyí aá ā í wɛ icííci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ajɛ Umówābu, mɛ́mla Ámɔ̄ri, mɛ́mla Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla aéwɔhá ā le pó ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī kéē lā Ujúda. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla kwú Ugɛdalíya ú yá igbómína kú Ujúda ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gē gbɛlá ɔdōlɔhi ipú ɔtū kú nū anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛlā olɔhi nōó gē ka á. Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí gē gbɛlá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ipú ɔtū kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛlā obɔ̄bí nōó gē ka á. Ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ odo kú ɔ̄cɛ ā nɛ̄ okónu gē ka wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
idu_Latn: Má ɔɔ̄, eko gē wā, nɛ̄ n géē yá ācɛ dóódu nēe gē lɛ abɔ̄ da aá ɛyí tāajɛ ā ōwē. N géē nya ācɛ onyɔ́nyí ā tá, klla í kpó ācɛ nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́. N géē je uwēyī kú uwā pīya ojīlīmā. Odúúdú ɛcɛ géē cɛ̄tra uwá.

eng_Latn: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ iyī alɔ, mɛ́mla inɔɔ̄da nōo í licō gaá kwu ɔkpāncō. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ iyē lé lɛ iyī alɔ o yá ká ālɔ̄ je pahīla ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú iyó nēé bī le gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō bī ɔ́ŋgbá kwaajɛ mɛ́mla igá kú nū ā, oje udɔ nē é géē bī lɛ yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um ka n yɔ̄ ipú Ádā ā, Ádā ā kē yɔ̄ ipú um. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō lɛ ā ŋ́, aá cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um ohígbū úklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē tá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā fu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka éeyē kú alɔ kóō le jīla.

eng_Latn: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ébú le ce klla ɔlɛ́ uwā otú nɛ, umaná ā gē wā ajɛ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni le ɛya nēe bá nyā gwó kwɛyí ā, ó le abɔ̄ kú nū je gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé hīlatá wāajɛ ā, é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū uwā kéē mīyɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ.

eng_Latn: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
idu_Latn: Ɔdāŋ ka aá cɛgbá aɔ́fiyɛ, aá lɔfú lá ŋmá ipú aéwo nēe lā kwu aá yɛ jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā géē da iyī uwā ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ gē je ɔfú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā á.

eng_Latn: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
idu_Latn: aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ aá mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ácí kú aá. Aá lɔfú lé ɔdā dúú nōo bū ŋmá ajɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔwɔ ɔhá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é má ɛga dúú nēé géē bū yɛ ga ipú inu ā glá ŋ́ ohígbū ɛwa ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō inu ā, le ɔdā ō fíyɛ́ inu ā kpó ŋmá ɛga éyi, lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ hɛ́ tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔnyīlɔ ā ú mla ákplata kú nū ú bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's sons.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ufilístiya ā nū uwā inya jāā gbéeko nēé gāá le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɔ́lu kpó kwú, le Ujonátan mɛ́mla Abínādabu mɛ́mla Umálkīssɔ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le tá ɛgiyí ācɛ Usúkɔ̄tu, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɛ́ɛ blakwu eko nēé tá ō tá anúɔ abɔ̄ āa? Uwá ɔ́ɔ ka aá í gáā je ɔdōlé dúúmā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú anúɔ ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwā ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kwú Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalumúna ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ācɛ ɛpa ā ɔ́ɔ bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Usímiyɔn ā wɛ: Ujemúwɛ̄lu, Ujamín, Ohádi, Ujakín, Usóha, mɛ́mla Ussáwulu, ɔyí ɔnyā kú Ukénan éyi.

eng_Latn: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
idu_Latn: O yɔ̄ ī gwíijē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē wú ɔ̄ ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka o yɔ̄ ī plla úwé ŋmá iyē eko ofū ā, ámāŋ o yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔmā tū ipí.

eng_Latn: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
idu_Latn: É gē kwu ita kahíníī, Eko kpií ā, ipú ūpū kú Ulɛ́bānɔn géē je pīya ajɛ ɔlamu ohɛ́hɔ̄ anú. Ajɛ ɔlamu ohɛ́hɔ̄ anú ā kē í je pīya ipú ūpū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōkpóce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ odúúdú aá je pīya ayí kú Ɔwɔicō á. Ɛ̄nyā lé ka aá má bɔ́há píyɔ́ɔ́ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
idu_Latn: N géē nū aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá eyī um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n nū aɔ́máapú aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lā ābɔ̄ ɔhá ā, bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá egiyí um ā.

eng_Latn: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
idu_Latn: ŋmá ɔtū ékpó abɔ̄ é géē má ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi ká aá mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
idu_Latn: Ó gē ka ɛyí ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā lɛ uwá gē mafú lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá ká Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō móōwē piíí, klla í héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ó klla gē da uwá kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ n gē da aá ɛlā kú nū nyā, anú wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó da ójila ā kéē lɛ kābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ keé le īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā fenyi ipú éŋkpɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ okwū kú uwā le míya ce ɔ́, īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā géē je tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ géē leyīkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā n géē nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ kléklé jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá le lɛwa ma ajɛ ā eyī.

eng_Latn: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
idu_Latn: N le ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ dóódu kú ajɛ ā kpó tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ gē lɛ ofúlutu bɛ̄ɛka ácí ā. N lɛ aá yíífi, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n lɛ ayí aá kpó ŋmó, ohígbū ka aá kwu ŋmá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí kú aá ā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ci gwō ācɛ kú Umídiya ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Eko nāa lɛ ɛ̄nyā yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a gekwú.

eng_Latn: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
idu_Latn: Le kwu ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, yāwu kú uwɔ ɔwɛ okpaakpa. Ikpó kú uwɔ kóō nyā ga amu ga anú ŋ́, ŋmá ɔwɛ kú okpaakpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi.

eng_Latn: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni le ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbɔbū le māfú ka anúɔ lɛlá kwu aílɔ́wá o ŋmá lɛ ō je ācɛ ŋmá ipú uwā kéē kwú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
idu_Latn: Oklóbīya kú uwī, wɛ olɛlā kú iyī nū fíyɛ́ dúú á. É géē yá ɔ̄ italā ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka tɛ́ɛcɛ únɛ́pɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō géē tókónu lɛ ɔ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka ó kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
idu_Latn: Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalumúna, aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa kú Umídiya ɛpa ā le pɛ́ kwu. Amáŋ ó nū uwā gāá le uwá kpó kwú. Ɛ̄nyā yá kú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kéē gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
idu_Latn: N géē mī éŋkpɔ̄ oyēŋēē klla aá, kllá í je aá yá yēŋēē, ŋmá ipú ɛci ōpā kú aá mɛ́mla ipú ucē ɛbí ɔhá dúúmā nɛ̄ aá yá nēe je aá tēelihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ā kē fíyaajɛ ipú obū, obū ā í kē nyí ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
idu_Latn: Ká odúúdú ācɛ nēe yá uwā, klla kpɔ́tū ce uwá ā, kéē kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka aójibó nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ipú ojuja nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ ā keé pó abɔ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla awɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é kē í kpɔ́tūce uwɔ o ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ohi kú ɛlā kú ācɛ ā kpó lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
idu_Latn: kéē leyīkwu igbō nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī gē lɛ Óndú ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla umu nēé gē bī yá igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā, igbō kú ɛya mɛ́mla umu nēé gē lɛ anɔ̄ ɔcí olīifu tū ɔ̄ ā, kéē miya iyó ɛ̄gbā kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā í yá um ɛhi, ɔkpáni. Óndú ā géē je uwɔ pīya ɔcɛ́, mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ dúúmā, ohígbū ka ɛfú kú Óndú ā nāa yɔ̄ í kpó yɔ̄ á. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka eko nāa gáā yēeyī gaá kwu ā, á gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nōó yá nyā, Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō ga ɛga ojīlīmā nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɔkpáncō ā Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē nōo fíyɛ́ iyē ɔhá dóódu ú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
idu_Latn: Ipú íne kú aá é lɛ tá ka, Ijáalí kú ācɛ ɛpa wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le da um lɛyíkwu ujɔ̄ nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá ī tū tū um, kéē ŋmó um ā.

eng_Latn: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē lɛ ɛyí tā ajɛ lɛ íne kú um klla ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ yá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā le kpaakpa, ó géē yēeyī. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umára ā, é gwá éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umára ā glá ŋ, ohígbū ka ó gē hɔ́ɔnɔ. Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Umára á.

eng_Latn: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Náána nōó wɛ éyi kú ígwu kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā, ó cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla ɔdā nēé ŋmótu klla lɛ ɔ́ yá gaajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
idu_Latn: Adónīja, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhágiti. Ussɛfatíya, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Abítalu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
idu_Latn: Ugolíyāti cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu Udéfīdi, anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya lɛyíkwu ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kōó nyɔ̄ í jīla mla anú.

eng_Latn: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ma í gē bīyíne ŋ́, ohígbū kóō wɛ ɛ́gbla kú Ɔwɔicō, abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ ádā nū ā, ó bīyíne glá ŋ́.
