eng_Latn: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
idu_Latn: Ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n má aflɛ́yí, eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ā.

eng_Latn: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō, géē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā piíí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gē cɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú icɔ́ɔci géē bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ā le cɛ̄hɔ̄ piíí, cɛ́ɛ́ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā, ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ó ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ofu mɛ́mla ɔfú wɛ ákú nū ā.

eng_Latn: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká n̄ kɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ō ka lɛ ā, ɔwɛ nōó géē cē uwā ahɔ̄ gēdēē.

eng_Latn: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
idu_Latn: N géē je ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukɛ́ni mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukɛ́nīs mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukádmɔn mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā Ujúda nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ayínɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ gaá lā mla ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Uhíra, nōo ŋmá igēlī nēé hī ka Adulám ā.

eng_Latn: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka Upelúsīyum, nōo wɛ igelī nēé lɛ igá olɔfú cē tū ɔ̄ɔ kú Íjīpiti ā, ká ō móōwē nɛ̄hi ŋmá lɛ ícɔ̄nū kú um. N kē í je ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá Utébēsi ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka n le cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ ádā um ɛbɔ́, eko ɔ́ɔmā awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um piyóó.

eng_Latn: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa mla ɔ̄colɔhi ā gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā. Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā kē ī wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó jéeyī ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kē gbɛlá ka anúɔ jééyī nɛ̄hi á, olíla abɔ̄yī nū lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ otīihɔ ā tū aklɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ abɔ̄ fú úmúlá kú ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā tū ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ó í cɛ̄ lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā je hɔ́ɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā lɛ oyēeyī abɔ̄yī nū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōo je oyēeyī lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū á, kóō lɛ oyēeyī abɔ̄yī nū á.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya gbɔɔ́ ō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm kóō ga ipú ajɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn, gaá mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú nū ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhássum ā wɛ, Umatɛnáyi, Umɛtáta, Usábādi, Ɛlífēlɛti, Ujeremáyi, Umanásɛ mɛ́mla Usímēyi.

eng_Latn: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔyā ahāapa ɛɛ́, nēé gáā kpó okwū kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā nyi kwɛyí, ká ē klla je ajɛ ā yá yēŋée igbɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gá lɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa ā á. Ó kahíníī, Áa nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ocíbú ahāapa kú ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō ā cē klá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi bī ije kú ucē ɔ́bíipú kú nū lɛ ajɛ éyi lá. Ipú ajɛ ā nōó míya ŋmá icō wā í le ca klá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ubu kú nū le ca klɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
idu_Latn: Ujéhūdi, Ubenebéraki, Ugáturīmɔni.

eng_Latn: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó je ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú nū ce ɔkɔ kóō yɛce um ŋ́, í gáā wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
idu_Latn: Ó le bēhé tá ipú inu kú Ɔwɔicō, kwú igbō nēé le gwɛ́ɛya le Ɔwɔicō ú, ó le lé, ó klla lɛ ōhī je lɛ ayíkpó kú nū kéē lé dúú. Nááná ó wɛ íne kú alɔ ō bīya kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu gwū ācogwɛ́ɛya ā tá kóō lé igbō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá hīgwú le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá lɔfú lɔfú kéē klla kɛlā ámāŋ o nwū ɔdā dúúmā fúlufúlu lɛyíkwu iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē cɛ̄ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá nēé tɛtɛ gbo uwā ɛ̄gbā jéjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ɛ̄hɔ̄. Aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī gbo uwā ɛ̄gbā gbóógbóō ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔɔ́, kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ káā gaá lɛ Árɔ̄ni bī wā mla iyī uwɔ. Amáŋ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ ā kéē gla ukpo ā wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́, ámāŋ n géē yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ujása mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ugílɛ̄di, āyā kú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn ā, jāā ga Árōwɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Urába ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā igbo ɔ́mpa á.

eng_Latn: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu cahāapa nɛ̄ Ása lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Usímri kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ajɛ kú Utɛ́sa. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī cīíbɔm tū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugibɛ́tɔn ajɛ kú Ufilístiya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá géē jé ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā o ŋmá lɛ ucē nēé gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwó gā le yɛ ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē gwéeyē ohígbū Ujerúsālɛm, ɔtū klla í he um ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā jikwū Ujerúsālɛm ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē dɛ̄gba kú unwalu abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ ísu, ó kē ī je ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ. Ó ī yá ka aísu nɛŋcɛ́ ā kéē le kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ. Ácí kú Ubássan le kpó yɔlá kwajɛ yéwúú. Aɔ́dā nēe jɛ̄ bá ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī ka Ukámɛ̄lu ā kwú ŋmɔ́lá yōō, anɔ́ɔ ododó kú Ulɛ́bānɔn le pɛ́ gekwú boolo á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ka n̄ lɛ ɛnyā da aá. Ń gáā lé ɔdōlé kú ucɛ ká onyatá nyā igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wā í cɔcɛ́ dúúdú, nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔdōlé kú ucɛ kú onyatá nyā kwɛyí nū ā le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é klla le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó wúla tāajɛ, le iyó kú uwá kpó.

eng_Latn: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ikwū kú ɔ̄cōbɔ̄bíipú í gē lɔnyɛ tū um ŋ́, amáŋ ó gé ē he um ɔtū ka ó le pīyabɔ̄ ka ó yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
idu_Latn: Énɔ̄ku kē mɔyí éyi, nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Irád. Irád wɛ ádā kú Umahūjáwɛ̄lu á. Umahūjáwɛ̄lu, ma Umɛtússɛ̄la á. Umɛtússɛ̄la ma Ulámɛ̄ki á.

eng_Latn: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le híhó kahíníī, Ń jé ŋ́, ń jé ɔdā nāa yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔwɛ nōo yɛ bū okómpīinu ga ɛcɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔbáagwu le ogwú tū á.

eng_Latn: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí géē bá ī lúlé tɔ̄há abɔ́ɔ. Aébilíi géē bá ī hī īyī uwā igwú abɔ́ɔ. Ekinibí géē yɔ̄ ī tíne ɛga ō gáā mlɛ́nyɔ́ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
idu_Latn: Aúgbéenyi nēe bá ī pɛ́ wā ŋmá ajɛ okónu ísu nɛ̄hi kú ɛga oligbó. Aúgbéenyi nēe ŋmá ajɛ Utássissi ā gbɔbū á. É yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō wā ɔlɛ́. É kē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu. Ó kē í bī ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi gé lɛ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā. Anú Uyáwe, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō lɛ kpla anú ŋ́ mā, yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aéwo kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
idu_Latn: Ɔgɛɛjí dúúmā í tá ipú úbɛ̄ ōtū piyóo nōó nyī īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā okpaakpa nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ujúda ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ í gáā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ anúɔ gē kwúcē mɛ́mla anú ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē lé klla ī gwá ɔdā dúúmā mɛ́mla anú abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yá ɔdā idáagó á. A le ɔfú kú uwɔ mafú ipéyī aéwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
idu_Latn: Áhāsi klla kwú ítēbulu o lɛ akā kú oje udɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le aíyó nēe bá ɛyí nū ā kpó kpɛ́mm. Ó kwú utánki kú oje udɔ ā ú ŋmá ɛyí ojibó kú ɛna kú udɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ utánki ā ce ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú utánki ā ú ce ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ kú ikpínu á.

eng_Latn: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā jé péee ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ́ je ajɛ olɔhi ā lɛ uwá, ohígbū kéē yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ o yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ágábáidu, Óndú ā ka a géē jé ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā o ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gáā yá ā. Mā ɔ̄, n géē lɛ okwutɛ nɛ̄ n bī abɔ̄ nyā fīyɛ̄ eyī kú ísu kú Unáyilu ā, ó kē í je pīya oyī.

eng_Latn: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda.

eng_Latn: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
idu_Latn: É ŋmó alɔ ije, é kpó alɔ tū agbá, ɛwa wuklíico lɛyíkwu alɔ, alɔ yúklɔ́ nōo kpó gla ɔfú kú alɔ, alɔ í gbɔlā lɔhi glá ŋ́, alɔ klla ī gbo ɛmiyɛ.

eng_Latn: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gáā tá ayááyí Ujékɔ̄pu ŋ́ mā. N kē í yá ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā eko dóódu. Le jé ka n géē je agbénú kú uwá cīgbīhi lɛ uwá klla í méyīnyinyi uwā.

eng_Latn: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe wɛ ɛgɔ kú nū eko ɔ́ɔmā le pɛ́ gekwú dúú. Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́gɔ́ ohile nēe wā igbīhi ūwā ā, í jé Óndú ā gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī jé ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ nōó yá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ ɛnɛ bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā nēe nyɛ́ nɛ̄hi, amáŋ nēé jééyī nɛ̄hi. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á:.

eng_Latn: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ɔhá ā wɛ ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔhá ā lɛwa, ohígbū ka é le pɛ́ gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é gɔbū mla úklɔ́ kú uwā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
idu_Latn: N mīyɛ ije ŋmá ɛgiyí aícɔ́ɔci ɔhá kéē tū um abɔ̄ ká n̄ yúklɔ́ lɛ aá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, ɛ̄nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka éjulúgwu nɛ̄ n hɛ́ uwā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tá aá abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhāti ī yá igbō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Uségubu ma Ujɛ́ɛ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi ofu cɛtá kú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
idu_Latn: Ā híī wī ogbɛhá uwī ŋ́, ohíghū ka ó wɛ ogbɛhá, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē pīya ācɛ nēé lɛ otábɔ̄ ŋ́ mā tū únɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū, Áyísīki, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Túblá um ká ā lɛ ɔtū má um ɔtū, ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ ayíkpó kú nū ā gɔbú kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcí ufíg kóō nwū aá ɛlā. Eko nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ kú nū kwú pīya ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄, nɛ̄ ēpū kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō lū, aá jé ka ɔnɔ̄ í ligbó ō fa gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɛ́lāyi gē hɛ́ ɔhā ce Ɛlkána mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū gē kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō je ayí ɔhá lɛ aá bū ipú kú ɔnyā nyā, nɛ̄ ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā géē kwɛyí ɔyí nɛ̄ ó je lɛ Óndú nyā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́, é gē cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ujeremíya le ije kú ekwu mla ikwu ayidɔ kú Ujosíya tá tā ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ije ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya ijē uculo kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú uwā, kwu ācɛnyā kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, kéē gwííjē nyā eko dúúmā nēé gē blikwū kú nū. Ijē nyā yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ikwū ayidɔ kú Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā aá géē jé ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpó mla Ádā um, aá kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpó mla um, n kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpó mla aá.

eng_Latn: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó odúúdú uwā lɛ ācɛ nēe gē tíne ŋmó uwā ā. N géē kpó uwā tū ipú abɔ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū. Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā ācɛ géē lā Íjīpiti kpɔ́ ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lā abɔ́ɔ gbɔbū ā. Ami Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
idu_Latn: Ujémīsi mla Ukífasi mla Ujɔ́ni, ācɛ nēé je bɛ̄ɛka ákanaba ā le jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ je úklɔ́ kú ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi nyā gā um á, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā é le abɔ̄ je lɛ ami mɛ́mla Ubánābasi kéē mafú keé cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla alɔ. Alɔ cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ka ami mɛ́mla Ubánābasi ká ālɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí aílɔ́wá, ká uwá ā kéē kē ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu ā.

eng_Latn: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gāajɛ ɛga o wú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Átādi, nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā, é bá gē yɔ́tūnōbí gē tɛ̄gíkwū klla jikwū nɛ̄hi. Ujósɛ̄fu klla yɔ̄ ekwū kú ádā nū abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kahíníī, Ó le yá kwɛyí ɛɛ́! Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ámōōmɛ á. Ami wɛ ohútu mɛ́mla oŋmɛ́yí ā. N géē je éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī je oyēeyī ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ijēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋmá njɔlɔ kú énkpɔ̄ nōo ī je oyēeyī ā alahá.

eng_Latn: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā géē fíyajɛ ŋmɛ́ɛ̄ɛ̄ɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā. ɛnɔ klla géē fíyajɛ pée igbo ahāapa fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē fíyajɛ lɛ ā. Ɔdānyā géē yá eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā í yɔ̄ ī tá ágbɛ nōó yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā klla í yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ uwā tá ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ayí kú Ulífāyi í lɛ ɔdā úgwū dúúmā ipú ayínɛ́ uwā ohile ā ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Ó ka úgwū kú uwā ɔ́ɔ wɛ, ɛya nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē gwō lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ce okónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
idu_Latn: É le Usɔ́ɔlu ɛyí hɛ́, le aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú nū kpó, anɔ́ɔ é le olɛhɔ tū mɛ́mla uwá ga ɛga dóódu kú ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya kéē nyɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ɛcí kú ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ipácí kú Usɔ́fim, ɛyi ɛfu kú Upísga. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó le ede ahāapa ɔhá gwó dúú, klla le ɔbá ɛna éyi mɛ́mla omlede éyi gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí éyééye kú ede ahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
idu_Latn: N jé ka aá wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɔtū ce aá glá ŋ́. Aá klla kē húmáyī yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ŋmífi nēé má aá ā. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ aá pó ɔdā dúúma lɛyíkwu ɔdā nyā fúlufúlu, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī jé ɔ́ ŋ́ má. Ɔ́ɔmā kē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā kú nū dúúmā í wā ipú ahɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ n má olɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ īlī ō le wiiyē ŋ́, nōo ofu gáā je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ jégēdēē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɛcɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā a, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmóɔ̄cɛ. É géē je ɔ́ ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔkpá kú Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú ígbíli ka, Aá lɛ ɔwɛ ā gllayá lɛ Óndú ā, aá lɛ ɔwɛ ikpó nā kpaakpa lɛ ɔ́ kóō yɛ!.

eng_Latn: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kahíníī, Aá gwō abɔ̄ klla tá ómbili gicō, ká aá gwéeyē, ohígbū ka aá wɔ́tū Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ká ā gaá ka lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ka, Ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ aá pi ahɔ̄ lɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká āá pó ɛlā, aá gáā jɛ́yí ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē pó ā ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ aá pléyī lɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká āá mɛ́ɛbɛ, aá gáā má ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujɛhósāfati klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ klla gē da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí nū glá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: A géē má ajɛ ā ŋmá ɛga oligbó, amáŋ á gáā bēhé ga ipú ajɛ, nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
idu_Latn: Ményīnyi um, Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ihɔtū nāa ī mafú eko dóódu ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē ményinyi ācɛ íbí ā. Kwú óbíipú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n bī nyā ú yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe lɔfú iyē ā í cɛgbá obící ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ nōo ī doōcē ā cɛgbá obocí á.

eng_Latn: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ̄nyā oŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ nōó tɛtɛ miya ɔ́ táajɛ ogbɔɔ́ ŋmá ohútu ā. Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōó bī le yá ɛ̄nyā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā le yɛ, é kē le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ ó má ā, ó le ācɛ kú Ukéniti ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛga nɛ̄ aá lā ā, É yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ ígbáanɔ nōo ce ágēnégēne kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ i ga Umasɛdónīya ā, n da uwɔ ka ā klá Ɛ́fēsɔsi. Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe bá ge nwū ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. N dɔɔ̄kā ká ā lɛ ɔcí hɛ́ lɛ uwa kú e mā.

eng_Latn: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Usɛráya, ɔyí kú Uhílikīya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uméssūlam, aádáádā nū ohile ā wɛ: Usádɔ̄ku, Umérāyɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Ahítūbu, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá ā, nēe ī lé ēpēēpū ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔyínɛ́ aá ɔhá ā? Aá nēe ī lé ɔdā dóódu ā, ɔdíyá nāa gē leyī gwō ayínɛ́ aá o hile bónū ā? Ohígbū ka odúúdú alɔ géē háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō kóō hɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kéē kē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́, ayíka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá kē lɔtūce ɔ́ ā kē wɛ áncā, é kē je íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā yá aá ɛhi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ipéeyī kú ācɛ ā, Ujóssuwa le íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi tɛtɛ je lɛ uwá ā, tá tū ɛcɔ̄ éyi nēé lɛ oje o bī gbɛ̄ɛcɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umágbīsi wɛ, ofu ahāapa ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ, é lɔfú ŋmó um, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā n géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhi kú oyī nēé cē bá ɛyí ede kú ɛya nɛ̄ aá gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ka aá lɔtūce ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka n gekwú, ɔtū he um cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwéeyē mla odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ohútu kú odée, n gē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó í ŋmɛ́yí lɛ ā ā. Oŋmá eko íkée ā, n lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛɛ́. N ka ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya géē yá piíí. N kē í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ō yá ā piíí.

eng_Latn: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ā géē yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́tūce kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū kē le yēŋēē ā géē lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔmā tū ocíbú ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ éyi ka aá le bī gē um. Anɔ́ɔ é le bī gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í wā kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ kóō cɛ̄ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄, kóō kē je oyēeyī kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā o le ōfūla ācɛ alɛwa ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le kwu ŋmá ɔkpacaŋgelī kú Uhásɛ̄lu, ɔkpacaŋgelī kú Ujéhu géē je ɔ́ ŋmó. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē le kwu ŋmá ɔkpacaŋgelī kú Ujéhu, Ɛláyíssa géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
idu_Latn: E gēe bī ɔyī mla ɔta kú uwá je aóklóbīya kú Ubábīlɔn kpó ŋmó, uwá í gāa méyīnyinyi kú ayípɛ̄, amáŋ ayí obene ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujɛhóssāfati, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu tá um ɛɛ́, a géē wā mla um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛfú kpó tá ɔ̄ kɛ̄ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóssāfati tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami mɛ́mla awɔ wɛ ācɛ ékpónú nɛ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā. Aɔ́nya o bī kpɛ́fú kú um kē wɛ ákú uwɔ dúú. N géē nyɔ̄ mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā kóō wá ijē ŋmá anú gaá yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā, ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi gē wā í háyi ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā gaá gwɛ́ɛya ā ɛyí, gē da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɛbɛ́ je lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ká ɔ̄ pá lé, ohígbū ó ka anúɔ ɔ́ gáā lé ɛbɛ́ nōo le jé ɔlá ŋ́, amáŋ ɛbɛ́ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o yá okpaakpa géē yɔ̄ ī má lé piyóó, amáŋ ɛmiyɛ géē yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄cobɔ́bíipú ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ dóódu kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ádā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ŋ́, ayíka ó ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ádā nōo tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.
idu_Latn: ka ɔnyā okwūma ā ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ɔyínɛ́ ɔbá nū ā ipéyī anyākwɔ́cɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄ kwú ikpó áblákpá kú nū éyi ú plá, lɛ ahɛ mī ɔ̄ eyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ɔ̄cɛ nōó tá ō ma ɔyí lɛ okwūmā ɔyínɛ́ nū ā á.

eng_Latn: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ára wɛ, úlā ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā pó ɔkɔ kú nū ipú úláyi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛlā nēé ka lɛyíkwu Udánīyɛlu ā pó ā, ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́, ó je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ó yá ɔwɛ dóódu ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gbó otú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ Udánīyɛlu hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aéwo ā gē tū ujɔ̄ obɔ̄bí tɔ̄há ā? É gē yá ojuju icííci.

eng_Latn: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
idu_Latn: Ó je ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpīje ɔdɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi. Ó je ɛkpa ɛpa kú īkpīije ɔdɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē je ɛkpa éyi kú ikpīije ɔdɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mɛtá ā á. Ó je lɛ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá iyāwu á.

eng_Latn: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛ ɔcɛ́ dúúmā ō gbō uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni bá yɔ̄ ī tíne ajɛ nēé géē mīyɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lā anú. Ohígbū ka é í lɛ ajɛ dúúmā kú abɔ̄yī uwā ipú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
idu_Latn: Lɛ okónu dóódu nōo gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā gwū ká. Lɛ okónu kú ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nēe klla ī leyī gwū ɔ̄cɛ bónū, nōo gē cá ācɛ okpaakpa ɛcá ā gwū ká dúú.

eng_Latn: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwúcē í tá ipú ɔ́kɔ mla ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gā ogbeé ɔhá kú óókpoó ā á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóssāfāti klla da Áhābu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ gē da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí nū gɛ ŋ́ ŋ̄.

eng_Latn: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā nōo gē ga ipú okónu ā gē bīya ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nōo gē ŋmá okónu ā gē bīya ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ipí enyeenyi ā le jé kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kpɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ ā géē ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka anúɔ lɔfú lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí tɛ̄hɔ̄ gáā bá ī ŋmó ācɛ ā, klla kwú ajɛ ā ú pīya ɛga otūufi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ ɔtū yɛ anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔcɛ́ ohi ka, ɔ́ɔ kē jé ka anúɔ wɛ ocīkpó. Ka anúɔ da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ijakī tútū lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ le yɛ mɛ́mla anú. Amáŋ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ kē le anúɔ plla.

eng_Latn: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
idu_Latn: Ó géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú aéwɔhá ā, klla í kpó ācɛ alɛwa ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, nɛ̄ aókwū kú uwā í tīikwū kláajɛ gónóó. Ó kē í yá odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ nyā lé.

eng_Latn: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu ce ahāapa nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ussíya, ɔyí kú Amásīya lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé.

eng_Latn: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána, Ujówɛ̄lu, Asárīya, Usefaníya.

eng_Latn: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yá uwɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā? Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kpó odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā ga awɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Abɔ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā, á le ɔdā ō bī gwō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é bá yɔ̄ gē dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ́kpá, anɔ́ɔ igbīhāajɛ ā ɛgba nēe dɛ̄ ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le yálé.

eng_Latn: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, íne nɛ̄ aá kpó tá ācɛ abɔ̄ ā, lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō yá kóō tīile gɛ ŋ́. Ó kē lɛ aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí ɔhá alɛwa ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá gē yá.

eng_Latn: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kpɔ́ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ o nɔ̄ɔ̄na dúúmā nōo gē da uwá kéē yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti nēé wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā, wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ gē tíne ō kpó uwā nyíleyī ŋmá oyēeyī nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá kéē lā ā. Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā Ussímēyi, ɔyí kú Ugɛ́ra, ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda nwúleyīkwū ŋmá Ubahúrim gaá jīla Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́, ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ga úgbéenyi ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ alɔ gā ocojonjlɛ kú Ukáyɔ̄si oŋmá ɔ̄cī nū ā. Oŋmá ɔ̄cī nū alɔ gāājɛ Usámɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī nōo gboce ɔ́ ā, alɔ gā ajɛ Umilétɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
idu_Latn: Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nōo lɛ agbénú ŋ́ mā kéē gwéeyē eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ je gicō.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda mīyɛ kóō wɛ ajɛ kú úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá í lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́ mā, odóódu kú uwā nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū, nēe bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, í gáā ga ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
idu_Latn: É géē gwu ācɛ alɛwa iyē yēŋēē. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe bɔ̄bíipú ā, í gáā jɛ́ɛ́yí nū ŋ́. É géē bá ī bɔ̄bíipú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ bū. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe jééyī ā ōfōōfū uwā gáā jɛ́ɛ́yí nū á.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā oyēeyī ā, aá jāhɔ̄. Aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kwú aálá kú um í kpó kwú, lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó lé ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka é lɛ ācɛ o gbo uwá ŋ́. Ācogbāálá kú um ā í tíne aálá ā ŋ́. Uwá bá ī lɛ ɛlá kwú īyī uwā, í lɛ ɛlá wu aálá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó kwú īlī kú nū ú híla. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú īlī ekwu ú kpó wu iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe bá gē yɛ ā má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó le īlī ekwu klá iyē.

eng_Latn: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛgiyí ede ā gaá lɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā gwó cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ede ā gwu. Ó géē je ōhī kú oyī kú ɛna mɛ́mla opī ā wā í kwu aájī kú ede nēe kwu ɔ́kíkā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ olíla le cɔ̄nū, ācɛ gē jé bōōbū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē lɛ eyī gwō ɛlā afūlūmā bónū.

eng_Latn: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
idu_Latn: A bī íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé kú uwɔ ā le gbagbénú kú ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá koó géē tētēyi lɛ ajɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra fíyɛ́ igelī ɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄cī ɛ̄pɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔdā dóódu nāa ī yá ā, blakwu Óndú ā, kóō lɛ ɔwɛ okpaakpa mafú gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ipú ɛcɛ gē je mlanyī nū, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla blakwu ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā piyóó, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yēeyī ā, n géē yɔ̄ ī gwíijē í cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú um, odúúdú eko nɛ̄ n géē yēeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
idu_Latn: Ń nyɛ̄ ŋmá íne nōó je ga um ā ō yá ŋ́, amáŋ n lɛ ɔdā nōó da um ka amíyɔ yá ā tá ɔtū, ō yá ɔ̄ kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē ka gā uwɔ ā, ɔkpani ūm? Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ í kɔɔkɔ lɛ ā ā? Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ í ŋmla iyī alɔ ŋmá ɛ̄nyā ā? Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔkwu ālɔ í ca klɛ́ɛcɛ ícɛ ɛɛ́. Odúúdú alɔ kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwɔ ɛɛ́, ó gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé má íkókwū kú uwɔ ipú ɛkpa kú nū ā ōfōōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɔdā dúúmā tá ije nóō le kplá ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwu ŋ́, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē mīyɛ omíci lé kóō cɛ̄ ijáalí tū ɔ̄cɛ áncā ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā jíla ɔ̄cɛ ɛgɔ́ɔ́mā iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Ujatiyɛ, Ɛ́ssitemōwa.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
idu_Latn: Ɔcogwɛ́ɛya ā géē tá ɛlā kú ɔhɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛka ā tū ɔkpá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú na tū éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ ā.

eng_Latn: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, ó géē yá okónu nōó ce gā um ka ayááyí um géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́ ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó, ɔ́dāŋ kéē leyí kwɛcɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
idu_Latn: Ulífāyi ma ayí ɛtá: Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukɔ́hāti mɛ́mla Umerári. Uwá wɛ aádáádā kú aípɔ́ɔnū nēé lé iyē kwu uwá á. Ulífāyi wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī ce igwáahāapa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú á.

eng_Latn: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Usɔ́lu le ádɛ́fú kú nū kwu ɔkwu ɔcí kú Upomégranēeti ipú ajɛ kú Umígrɔn nɛ̄ ó lɛ igbó lɛ Ugíbēyi ŋ́ mā. Ācɛ nēe bá pī ɔ̄, abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ulá ce ofu igwó .

eng_Latn: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
idu_Latn: Óndu Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā lɛ ɔfú je gā um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ um, kú aá bēē cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla iyī aá ipú ɛlā dúú nɛ̄ aá ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híīī kɔ̄ ígwíígwu ŋ́. Aá cɛ̄ tɔ̄há dúúdú, ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í gbɛlá mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā.

eng_Latn: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú iháyí ā géē wɛ iháyí otīihɔ lɛ aá. Aɔ́dā nēe bū ŋmá ajɛ ā abɔ̄yī uwā ā ōfōōfū uwā ā nɛ̄ aá gaá lé á.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá cíí. Ó yá ɛnyā kóō le ɔkpíyē kú um tútū gbēyī eko nēé géē nyi um ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā géē wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aá géē bī le tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄koolɔhi ā á.

eng_Latn: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alelékwū éyi ga ɛcɛ gaá da Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē nyɔ̄ í plla anú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔn bá ī kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu bū ɛpá éyi ā, Óndú ā le yá kú ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ kóō yā klá uwá abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī ga Asɛ́ka ā. Ɛwa kú uwá nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ŋmó ā klla fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmó ā á.

eng_Latn: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le aɔ́lá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄hi ɛpa yá á. Ó le ɛnɔ nōo wɛ ɛnɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú ā yá kóō fíyajɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔyā nōo wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kóō fíyajɛ otú. Ó kē le aínyílɔ́wɔ yá dúú.

eng_Latn: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
idu_Latn: Anyā ojéeyī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā tá ɔ̄ ohi, ó klla da īyī nū igbalɛwa ka.

eng_Latn: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
idu_Latn: É wā ŋmá Ɛ́frem ga ipú ɔpɛ́ ā, igbīhi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla ācɛ kú nū. Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā wā ŋmá Umákiyɛ, aígabɔ̄ ā ŋmá Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu gē pɛ́ klá ɛcɔ̄ ī je ɔ́ lé. Ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi gē kpó ajɛ nyɔ̄. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ a gē yá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gē leyīce ō yēeyī gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nyā géē bá ī gbɛlá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gaá kwu ā?.

eng_Latn: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɔdā dúú nōó géē le cíla anú ulé ŋ́ mā ā, óndú nū je ɔ́da kéē kwú anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla ayí nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā ú kpó lá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ije ā le cíla ulé nōó bī āa.

eng_Latn: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú tīihɔ ŋmá eko nēé bī ɔ̄ wā ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā. Lɛ ákánjɔ̄ ō fɔ́ɔ́lá kú ācɛ nēe kwú ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú kwú ɔ̄ ú na oje oplákátá ō bī le klá ɛyí ede ā. Kóō wɛ ahɔ̄ ō pi lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ ɔwɛ á, ɔkwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla oyēeyī á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā ɛgiyí Ádā um glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ó yɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ssɔn ma ayí ɛpa: Uládan mɛ́mla Ussímēyi.

eng_Latn: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Umósīsi ōfōōfū nū nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē kɛlā bū okónu kú nū á nɛɛ? Ó kē ī kɛlā lɛ alɔ dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā pó á.

eng_Latn: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɛ̄cī kú ajɛ odobū mɛ́mla ajɛ odɔɔlúú, ɛ̄cī kú ojuja mla ajɛ odobú. Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja le nāŋdaa klá aɛ́fu ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́wá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú aéfūma nēe yɔ̄ gē pɛ́ wā a. É le nyīla bá ɛyí ɛfu bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ odobū nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔdā dúú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nyā í yɔ̄ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔdā dúú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nyā í kē gáā yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
idu_Latn: Aá ī he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ eko nōó ī blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá le tútū ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú nū lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ɔ́ lɛ mla ojīlīmā mla ɛyí otúwāajɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ɛnɛ ce úlá éyi ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
idu_Latn: o ga amu ga anú kú aá ajɛ aɛ́fu ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ ɛɛ́, ka aá kóō kwú eyī ú pīya kú aá yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛhíícō.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ma ayínɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ, amáŋ, odóódu kú uwā í gáā wɛ ákú uwā ŋ́, ohígbū ka aólɛlā kú uwā géē kpó uwā alagbá kú ɛfú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá ā, Ohɔ́nyɛtá le Alelékwū Ihɔ cē klá aá. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú nū yɔ̄ ipú aá ā, aá klla cɛgbá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ī nwū aá ɛlā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Alelékwū Ihɔ kú nū ī nwū aá ɔdā dóódu, nōo kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, nōó wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔdā nōó ī nwū aá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ɔ́mpa kú iháyí ɔ́mpa nēé wā í jīla ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Userúbābɛlu mɛ́mla Ujessúwa mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda o hile mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá nēe pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm mla uwá ā, le abɔ̄ kpó tū úklɔ́ ō yá dúú. É le odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu gɔbū ā fu kéē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ō tú gwó ā.

eng_Latn: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, acígilí, éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya ā le ɔyī tá gicō gaá gbo Áhābu ɔcɛ́ ā iyē ɛga nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú gaá kwɔhá ā kli. Anɔ́ɔ Áhábu, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛgba dɛ̄ hī ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē pɛ́ úgbɔ́nya kú nū ā kahíníī, É le ágbe yá um ɛɛ́, leyī pīya pápá cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ le kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem: Uhóséya, ɔyí kú Asásīya. Ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Umanásɛ: Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Upédáya.

eng_Latn: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɔ́ɔmā ā, Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, klla lɛ Useráya, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Usɛfaníya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo kpó okónu ce ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ɛtá ɔhá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nēe cɛgbá nɛ̄hi ā kpó alagbú.

eng_Latn: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɛ̄nyā ú pīya íne, lɛ ɔ́ jé lɛ ācɛ dóódu ipú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ Ujíyu ā kéē géē lɔfú nuunu tá aólɛlā kú uwā glá, ipú ajɛ ɛga dóódu nēé géē wā kéē gaá je uwá kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ nyɔ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ gāá mīyɛ Usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tá ɛka nōó gbo mla uwá ā tū ɔ̄ ā. Ó ka anúɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, nɛ̄ anúɔ í lé ámāŋ gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ihɔtū nɛ̄ a ī mafú gā um eko dóódu ā nwuné bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɛ jāā gaá kwu ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gɔ̄ ka anúɔ jé odée nɛ̄hi ā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē leyī yɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō kwú iyē í ce ɔyí ā ka Ujedidíya, ohígbū koó he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū kú aá téeyī olɔhi kú Ɔwɔicō oŋmá o lɛ ɔtū tá ɛ̄cī mla ɔyā mla eko mla iháyí gē je uwá keé cɛgbá!.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníí, Ícɛ nyā, n géē gbɔɔ́ ō je uwɔ gicō ipéyī kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla Umósīsi ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla awɔ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka ó cɛgbá kéē lɛ ɔ́ yá gbla ayínɛ́ nū ɔwɛ dóódu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō le pīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya o ményinyi ācɛ nōo ī yúklɔ́ kú nū ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ inyílɔ́lɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gwu.

eng_Latn: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú um kwú du anɔ́ɔ n yɔ̄ ī jikwū tɛ́ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ákpáŋdēde ā. N kē yɔ̄ ī jikwū tū ɔkɔ humhum bɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā. Eyī le gbɛnú ga um ohígbū eyī nɛ̄ n le tíicō piyóó yɔ̄ ī tíne otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Óndú, n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu nɛ̄hi. Lɛ um hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: N gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá kwu ucē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá ā, n le pīyabɔ̄, ká n̄ géē gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú iyē ō gwu mɛ́mla ákú o je yɛ́ɛhi kú íne ō bīya ɛyí ede, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da Éfrɔn ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a cɛ̄, n géē je ije kú ajɛ ā gā uwɔ. Mīyɛ ije ŋmá um abɔ̄ um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n bēē nyi okwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, awɔ húmáyī wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ŋmá ajaajɛ á, A hɛ́ alɔ tá igbo alɛwa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le Ujékɔ̄pu tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Umɛsopotámīya ɛgiyí Ulában, ɔyí kú Ubɛ́tūwɛlu, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Áram, klla wɛ ɔyínɛ́ kú Urebéka, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla Ísɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi, eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ Umídiya ā kahíníī, Lɛ cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe tíne kéē ŋmó uwɔ ā, le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
idu_Latn: N gēe bū ɔ̄ tū ajɛ ká bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé ī hɛ́ tū ajɛ ā. Ó kē í bī ojīlīmā gé lɛ odúúdú ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je oje kóō lɔfú ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí ā. Oje udɔ kē le fɔkɔfɔkɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo le wa ā tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
idu_Latn: Ussáfāti, ɔyí kú Uhóri ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn.

eng_Latn: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú ŋmá ipú ɛkpa kú nū, kwu ɔ̄ ú wu ítū kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ítū ā tá lɛ ɔ́ á. Ɛcɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ipú ítū ā gaá le tá ipú Ugolíyāti údɔ̄bū plí, gebí tá ɔ̄ īkpɛ̄yí. Anɔ́ɔ Ugolíyāti má gwōnū wā ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ígbɛ́fú nɛ̄hi ā, lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ ó kpó aɔ́yī kú aólɛlā mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú mɛ́mla ɔkpacaŋgelī mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyɛ́fú kú uwā cē á.

eng_Latn: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Árɔ̄ni ka, Lɛ ɔwɔ yá lɛ alɔ, nōo géē gbō alɔ. Umósīsi nyā nōo kpó alɔ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, alɔ í jé ɔdā nōo yá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi mīyɛ igbō ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tɛ́ɛcɛ bōōbū á. Ó kē wɛ otú.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa ā, é kpó Umássalu, Ábudɔn mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́.

eng_Latn: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú okónu ísu ā aɔ́cí ɛdɔ alɛwa nēé gē lé géē bá ī jɛ̄. Ēpū kú uwā í gáā ŋmó ŋ́, é géē bá ī gwá īkpō kú uwá eko dóódu. É gē bá ī gwá īkpō ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɔyā dóódu ohígbū ka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gē pɛ́ tū uwā. Ācɛ gē lé aíkpō kú aɔ́cí ā, klla í bī ēpū kú aɔ́cí ā le tū ɛcí lɛ ācɛ ká ō hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá ōcē kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
idu_Latn: Okómpinu éyi yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú nū, nōo yɛ ga Ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ā le mīya ŋmá okónɔɔwɛ kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā ga okónɔɔwɛ kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā. Ó wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ofu kú uwɔ í yɔ̄ piyóó, ācɛ géē bá ī kɛlā í hí iyē kú uwɔ ŋmá eko tá eko.

eng_Latn: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē bū ɔkwu ɛlā nēe bá ā ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ kóō he ɔ́ ɔtū kóō ga nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm gaá lɛ ɔkɔ kú nū ka abɔ́ɔ lɛyíkwu ɛlā nēe kpó ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā klá okónu ŋ́ ohígbū Ujerúsālɛm. Ń gáā yɔ̄ cíí ŋ́ jāā gbéeko neé lɛ Ujerúsālɛm nyatá nōó má yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, gbɔɔ́ ō fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nēé hɛ́ kwu ɛmu otú nōo yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
idu_Latn: Wā í lɛ ɔcí kú Ufáyin nāa tū klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ je jɛ̄ lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā nyatá.

eng_Latn: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
idu_Latn: Ɔgwā wā í le yɛ ɛɛ́, ɔwɔ kwú hɛ́, klá mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū géē lā ɔpɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukénan lā abālɔbányā ā. Aá gbɔɔ́ ŋmá amānyā óóci kú aá yɛ lɛyíkwu ígbíli bū ɔwɛ kú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ogwɛ́ɛyá ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, unwalu kú ádɛ́fú kú Ufilístiya yɔ̄ í nyīla tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ka ɛga í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá gē da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ eyī yɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ a lɛ lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā lɔɔlɔhi, ka alɔ má ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā tɔ̄ɔhá.

eng_Latn: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔfú jégēdē le íne kú Óndú ā bīya o ŋmá lɛ o mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa nū le ce ɔ́ abɔ̄ ā tɔ̄ɔ̄kwū, ámāŋ koó kwú odée kú nū uwi uwī, ámāŋ koó lɛ ɔ́ pīya tū.

eng_Latn: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kē leyīce ka n géē má uwɔ ānāānā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ kē í lɛ okónu kwu okónu.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́. Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá gaá da ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ kéē ga Ugálīli, abɔ́ɔ nēé géē má um á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ iháyí ofɛtá cigwó yá Ubábīlɔn, n géē méyīnyinyi aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka n lɛ aá kpó cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ amānyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cokónu lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā pó a, Alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā í kwú ɔ̄ ú dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ éyi nēe lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō lɛ Usitífin nyi, é kē jikwū nū gbōmgbōm nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
idu_Latn: Le ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fu. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyééye ā.

eng_Latn: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú ipú íwɔ́tū kú uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ dóódu kéē le jé ka Ɔwɔicō gē gbō Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ka anú klla gē gbāajɛ jāā ga ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ga Ubahúrim ā, ɔmáapú Usɔ́ɔlu éyi nēé hī ka Ussiméyi, ɔyí kú Ugéra ā gā ɛcɛ gaá jīla Udéfīdi ɔwɛ, yɔ̄ í cá Udéfīdi ɛcá, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í wā ā.

eng_Latn: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē mafú inīcō nɛ̄hi éyi, nēé lɛ ɔ́ yíifa lɛ ɔ́ tútū táajɛ ā lɛ aá. Aá lɛ abɔ́ɔ tútū gbēyī alɔ.

eng_Latn: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi lɔfú gwōnū ce ɔhɔ́ɔ́há igbo ahāapa glá, ó kē í cāŋjɛ igbo ahāāhilapa ā. Amáŋ unwalu kú igbeékpónú jɛ̄, nōo géē je ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī gē yúúfi ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā lɛyíkwu uwá, nōo cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā le tūtū kóō kpó uwā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Ó ka amáŋ, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ anúɔ eko ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kē í je obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú uwā yá ā yá uwā ɛhi. Ohígbū ka odúúdu ācɛ nēe nyíleyī ā bīya íne nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufilístiya bá āyā kú ɛfu éyi, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kē bá āyā kú ɛfu ɔhá. Ɔpɛ́ tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ɛfu ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ géē fu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ bɛ̄ɛka anúɔ ā ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gé lɛ uwá á. Ó ka anúɔ géē da ɔ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í ka lɛ uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ géē da uwá odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What meaneth the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lāyi lɛ uya ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da ka ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú uya nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī yá ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā le inya kwu gaá le ɔ̄kā ā kā Ɛ́lāyi á.

eng_Latn: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú uwā géē na īlī kú nū, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā igbɔhá kpɔ́ ka aá nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ayínɛ́ aá, ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn kpɔ́ɔ̄, kɛ̄ɛ kā aá kwúcē mɛ́ n? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ohi tá uwā kéē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú. Ohígbū ka óócí ā, anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Éwɔhá dúúmā nōo lā ipɔ́ɔma dúúmā, géē mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma nɛ̄ ó lā mɛ́mla uwā ā. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔdɔ , anyā ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayí nū nōo lɔfú iyē fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpó lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī wɔ́tū ācɛ ɔhá, yɔ̄ ipú ajoodobū ā, ó kē ī yɛ ipú ajoodobū, ó jé ɛga nɛ̄ ó ī nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ajoodobū ā lɛ ɔ́ eyī kpó pu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóyākim wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā: Umeráya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Useráya á. Uhanánīya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujeremíya á.

eng_Latn: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ eko nēé le áafú tá mla iyī uwā gɔbū gigbīhi ā, igbīhi ɛlā éyi nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu ka ā. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ka lɛ aádáádā alɔ bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ayisáya le kpaakpa!.

eng_Latn: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Utáma ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔyí ádā nū, Ámnɔn, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le ɔdōlé yá lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛlā ka kwɛyí ā, Ujémīsi tóohi kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ um, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um.

eng_Latn: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
idu_Latn: Ésa, ɔyí kú Ujésuwa, otrɛ̄yí kú Umísipa ma ɔdɔ kú āyā ɔhá nōo yɔ̄ ɛga o kpó iyɔ́fú tū á. Ó ma ɔdɔ ā jāā gaá kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ā pīyeyī ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Óndú le ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ í yá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm ā yá mɛ, ó géē yá ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya italā ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī gwō klla yɔ̄ ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē híīī bīyíne kú ikpɔ́nyā ōce ŋ́ mā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛnyīlɔ dóódu, kéē lɛ ɔnyā abɔ̄yī uwā lɛ. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛnyā kóō kē lɛ ɔbá abɔ̄yī uwā lɛ.

eng_Latn: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ó jé ka amíɔɔ í lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́. N kē le īyī um tū ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá.

eng_Latn: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ōhī kú nū géē wā í je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú tēelihɔ. É géē je ɛya nēé gē gwó lɛ Óndú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi eko dóódu ā ci, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔdā kú ɛbɛ ohéyē ū ce icō ɛyí ede.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā lé odúúmā kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄, ɛ̄nɛ̄ é le pá ɔlá ámāŋ igbō kú nū, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá le odée kú ɛya ā bī gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gbɔbū. Ayááyí aá géē lɛ aíne nyā tū piyóó.

eng_Latn: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛ́cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔwɔ o límanya yɔ̄ i límanya ŋmá amu ga ánú. Ó wɛ ɛdɔ nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú nū í yɔ̄ jééjéē ipú ɔ̄kā kú ígblé kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
idu_Latn: Ulɔ́tu le bɛ̄cɛ wā ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, le ɔwɛ pi gwū igbīhī iyīnū.

eng_Latn: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
idu_Latn: Má ɛga nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gaá gwōnū tá ā. É gwōnū klá ajɛ gblágádáá. É klla cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko kú oō gbɔɔ́ kú ɔgwā kú iháyí ɔhá, eko nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ gē ga ɔnɛ̄fú ā, Ujówābu lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó gaá kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ Ámɔ̄n, lɛ ajɛ kú uwā wúlatāajɛ. Ó klla gaá le íbɔm cē tū Urába, nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwā ā. Amáŋ Udéfīdi klá Ujerúsālɛm eko ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́. Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpɛ́fú tú Urába kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi.

eng_Latn: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā mafú gā awɔ ka n cíkā ō méyīnyinyi ācɛ kú Unínīfɛ fíyɛ́. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwā, kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ mla ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ úlā ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ɛwa kú aɛ́bɛ́ ka ē lɛ ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā le ɔ́dā je lɛ Ugídīyɔn kéē cāŋjɛ kéē kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Umídiya ā. Ka anúɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
idu_Latn: Āyā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ede ā lɛ abɔ̄ ɛnɛ nēe jóonjilɛ̄ dúú. Abɔ̄ kú nū dóódu wɛ umíta ahāapa. Akā nōo wɛ usentímīta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ ce ɔ́ okónu biílí. Ɔ́glɔ́ kú ɔkwu nū ā wɛ usentímīta ofɛpa cigwó. Agidigbé nōo yɛ gicō kú ede ā yɔ̄ āyā kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kóō lɔfú nɛ̄hi, nēe géē yá kéē nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu inya, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ í cɛ̄tra um o ŋmá oyálé nɛ̄ n gáā yá ɔcɛ́, aícɔ́ɔja kú nū mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú ɛfú mɛ́mla ācɛ o pɛ́ úwā.

eng_Latn: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda le ɛgba ogwú dɛ̄ kwaáá. Anɔ́ɔ Ábīja gbɔbū ɛfú ā á. É le ɔfú kpó kwū ācɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le Ujérobōwam mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó yálé ipéyī Ábīja mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē tíne ō hɛ́pɔ kpaakpa. Ɔtū kē ī wú um lɛyíkwu uwī o wī mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú N géē cílá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ulé kpaakpa, klla í cokónu nōo í yɔ̄ piyóó mla uwá.

eng_Latn: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
idu_Latn: Ami Ujémīsi, n cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄, n klla kē cɛ̄ Óndú, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛhɔ̄ dúú. N hokónu tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe pahila bá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
idu_Latn: Da aígbáanɔ mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ka eko nɛ̄ n kwú odúúdú ācɛ ā í kpó ŋmó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ā, kéē géē lé ɛbɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́ dóódu nēé géē lé glá, klla í gwá oyī jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó lɛ uwá kwú bɛ̄ɛka ejé ā.

eng_Latn: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā le Ugáálu má háyi okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, é cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛga nēé tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
idu_Latn: Ákáyídéémā ā, Ó wɛ ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ó wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ádā um, amáŋ ó wɛ ákú ɛ́nɛ́ um ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ ɔnyā um á.

eng_Latn: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā ō yɔlá dúúdú nyā ipéyī um pīyɛ okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n gē jīla mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ká n̄ kɛlā gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé kwú uwā í kpó fu ŋmá ajɛ, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā jé kéē bá abɔ́ɔ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amásīya da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka ulé kú ācɛ ā nɛ̄ anúɔ gbā ā bɛ́ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē je ije nōo fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kwúcē lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
idu_Latn: N da uwā kahíníī, Ɛ́bɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá gē má á. Ɛbā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá klla ī gwó ā. Aá géē ka ka ɛlā kú um nɛ, amáŋ ń kɛlā dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
idu_Latn: Aókónɔɔwɛ kú igelī ā í gáā gwū ŋ́. É géē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ eko dóódu ohígbū ka otú í gáā bī abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
idu_Latn: Unwū olɔfúlɔfú kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá ī ma ɔyí kú ínoōbīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnya ī ma ɔyí ā. Ínoōbīya, eko nōó kē le jɛ̄ kwɛyí ɛɛ́, ó gē bī ikwū opiyóó wā.

eng_Latn: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
idu_Latn: Upíta tóohi kahíníī, O ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ ewɔhá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ayíka ācɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā í cíkā ō da ijɔ̄ɔ̄lɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí ā á. Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda wɛ Ukálɛ̄bu ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ í tíne ō bī íne yúklɔ́ gɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā íne ā í klla tīile dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā le fíyɛ́ ācɛ okpaakpa abɔ̄ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é le ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ā gbájí.

eng_Latn: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubánābasi mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu kwúcē ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm eko nēé lɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā yá kwɛyí ā. Uwá mla Ujɔ́ni, nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá kú nū lé ka Umáki ā tīīkpó wā á.

eng_Latn: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
idu_Latn: Ó hɛ́ aólɛhá nēe jikwū klá anú mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā tá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ɔdōlé, amáŋ, aá gáā nū ipú ŋ́, ɛmiyɛ géē yɔ̄ ī ŋmá aá kpɔ́. Aá géē kpó aɔ́dā nyɔ̄ í tayínū, amáŋ é gáā tá abɔ́ɔ cíí lɛ aá ŋ́, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá kē kwú tayínū, n kē í tū ɛfú wā í je uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ɛɛ́ mā, anúɔ gwōkónu klla jikwū ohígbū ka anúɔ ka ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɔfú méyīnyīnyi anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔyí ā kóō híī kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n nōo húmáyī tá Umósīsi abɔ̄ ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú nū ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ uwá anú ci ɔkpani.

eng_Latn: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ. Aá cɛ̄tra ɛgahi mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Ujérīko le pó ka ācɛ ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā otú ɔ́ɔmā gáā jila ajɛ ā wɛɛlɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Mīyɛ ayí álá ahāapa nyā. Oŋmá ɛ̄nyā ā, a géē cɛ̄ mɛ́mla um ka amíyɔ̄ bu obugā ā á.

eng_Latn: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ó lɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ íne ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla uwá abɔ́ɔ pī uwā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ jé íne ā, ɛ́ɛ ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ abɔ̄yī uwā glá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
