idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄ɔ, ícɛ nyā, n géē lɔfú tū uwɔ iyē í gbō uwɔ nɛ̄ a í lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī nēé ce igá tū ɔ̄ɔ̄, mɛ́mla ákanaba nēé yá ŋmá oje mɛ́mla ɔdɔ nēé bī oje udɔ le gwó ā. Odúúmā ká aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda, aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda, ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ujúda ámaŋ́ ka odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda í gáā fū uwɔ iyē ŋ.

eng_Latn: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Óbɛ́dɛ́dɔm bī ācɛ ofɛtá cɛpa wā, nēe géē gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
idu_Latn: Ulában tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó lɔhi ká n je ɔ́ gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ n géē je ɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá. N cɛ̄ lɛ ā, klá mla um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Ma ayí alɛwa ká ā nyīla, aéwo alɛwa géē ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Ayááyí uwɔ alɛwa géē lé ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́wɔ kpɛ́mm ā ahínyá, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ kú nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
idu_Latn: Uhárim, Umérēmɔtu, Obadáya.

eng_Latn: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ úlúúlā bā abɔ́ɔ, nēe gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄. Ācɛ úlúúlā okokolo háyi iyɔ̄bū nū abɔ́ɔ dúú, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé gbo uwá áluka glá ŋ́ mā, bá iyɔ̄bū nū. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō kɛpɔ̄ á, anɔ́ɔ é le aɔ́kpá ā nwūla á.

eng_Latn: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le má ka ɛlā nēé ka ā lɔhi, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ le ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kú uwā.

eng_Latn: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛnya ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ nōo lɔfú gwō iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kahíníī, N géē yá oklóbīya tá Uhánɔn ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá tá ádā nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ gaá ce ɔ́ abīyē kú ikwū kú ádā nū á. Eko nɛ̄ uwá ga ajɛ Ámɔn klla ga ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ a.

eng_Latn: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
idu_Latn: A da um ka amīyɔ jāhɔ̄, abɔ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā. A ka amíyɔ yá ka amíyɔ cíla ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ a géē da um ā.

eng_Latn: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ lɛ aá kú aá je pīya Itíca abālɔbányā, nááná aá klla cɛgbá kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō klla nwū aá ŋmáajɛ kpɔ́ ɔdā aflɛ́yí nēé nwū aá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā. Ikoko nɛ̄ aá í lé ɔdōlé olɔfú ā, ó cɛgbá ká aá gwá amɛ̄ kpɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá abɔ̄yī aá gē pīya ayínɛ́ aá nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā tū, klla gē hɛ́ uwā éjulúgwu.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nā kwu ɔkpáncō cɛ́ɛ́ obū nɛ̄hi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ glá ā kóō wā í klá odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄ n géē tá tū ɔkpá fu aá, amáŋ ń tíne ō tá ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔkpá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n leyīce ka n géē wā ɛgiyí aá ká ālɔ̄ lɛ iyī alɔ má īkpēyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká éeyē kú aá kóō le jīla.

eng_Latn: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
idu_Latn: Eko nāa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um ícɛ nyā ā, a géē jīla ācɛ ɛpa ɔwɛ kwu únóji kú Urécɛ̄lu ajaajɛ ipú Usɛ́lūsa ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn ā. É géē da uwɔ ka, aíjakī nāa yɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā ā, é le uwá pīyɛ̄ ɛɛ́, ka ádā uwɔ í lɛ ɛlá wu unwalu kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā uwɔ eko dóódu, ka iní nɛ̄ n géē pīyɛ̄ ɔyí um āa.

eng_Latn: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, aá híī ŋmó ɔ́mpa aá okónu icííci ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē ŋmó ɔyínɛ nū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá okónu ámāŋ ka o ka obɔ̄bí kú nū, íne ā nōo gē ŋmó okónu klla gē ka obɔ̄bí kú nū abɔ́ɔ á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nāa ka íne ā í lɔhi ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ ka á gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ a kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmó ɔ̄ okónu.

eng_Latn: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔkpá gbo lɛ alɔ, ó klla kē le okónu ce lɛ alɔ dúú. Aɔ́dā ɛpa nēe bá ā í tōō pīyabɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ nēe kwu nyɔ̄ í tayínū ɛga iyínū ā, ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ, ohígbū ka alɔ lɔfú fúla abɔ̄ tū okónu nōó ce ā nōo wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayí nū ā ɔ̄kā ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bū nyɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔwɛ nōó bū nyɔ̄ ā mafú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmá, ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. Abɔ̄ a gē gbɛlá ka anúɔ jéeyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá um. Ó klla le mafú ka anúɔ bɔ̄bíipú, í klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um ŋ́ fíyɛ́ odúúdú aéwo nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā. Ó tá íne kú um, í klla yɛce ɔ́da kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uhám wɛ Ukúss mɛ́mla Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Upút mɛ́mla Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē mīyɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ anyōkwū lɛ ā tɔ̄ɔ̄kwu, é gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ o likpo ajɛ, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē jé uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ɔwɔicō í yá uwa italā olɔnɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ a í má ɛka ocɛyí kú uwɔ ɛgiyí nū ā, é géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ nēe bá nyā ā wɛ ijáalí. Tíne ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ákú uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú kpó. Ujékɔ̄pu í kē jé ka Urécɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ je ɛka ocɛyí kú Ulában uwī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛɛ́ kú ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā kóō le lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, ó le inɔ̄ɔda gwó kwu Ɔwɛ kú ɔ́kíkā mɛ́mla Ɔwɛ kú ɔpɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ā pīya yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
idu_Latn: Eko gē wā, nɛ̄ aá géē jikwū klá Óndú ā, amáŋ ó gáā tá aá ohi ŋ́. Ó gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gáā gbā eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
idu_Latn: Óndu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ eko nōó le ɛlā kámla Ébrahām kwɛyí ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
idu_Latn: É da uwá kɛ́ɛ̄ híī yá īkpɛ̄yī olɔfú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā ōhī yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ kéē kwú īyī uwā ú lɛ Óndú ā, kɛ́ɛ̄ mā īyī uwā tá abɔ̄ kú nū. Ó kéē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū, nōo le tīihɔ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī cɔ̄nū mla uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdūngwɔwɛ ɛpa gbā ŋmá ɔcí ólīifu. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó kwu okónpīinu kú inu ɛga nōo tíhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā. É le odée nōo le kɔnɔbɔ ā yá kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā. É gē lé klla í gwá, ɔtū kē he uwá nɛ̄hi eko kú Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ iwili kú igbo mla ɛbéenyi nōo hile nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā kpó ŋmá ajɛ ā, wɛ ómbili igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
idu_Latn: Nááná ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu klla géē lɛ ācɛ alɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú ipú ísu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í miya anú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē gbo ɔ́ áluka glá ŋ́. Abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō hī ūwā ka, aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́. Amáŋ eko ɔ́ɔmā ó géē hī ūwā ka ayí kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī.

eng_Latn: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um má aólíla nēe lā bɛ̄ɛka é yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, n le okónu tá lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá bōōbū.

eng_Latn: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó le ojibó kú ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā nēé hī Ássɛ̄ra ā ma, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Usólōmɔn ohígbū nū kahíníī, Ipú Ujerúsālɛm nyā mɛ́mla ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n je ŋmá ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ajɛ o hɛ́hɔ̄ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́. Ka ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ gáā jɛ̄ anú glá ŋ́. Ó ka ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ajɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra, Ádima mɛ́mla Usēboyíím nɛ̄ Óndú ā je kpó yíífi eko nōó cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
idu_Latn: É da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ́ kɛ́ɛ kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, ayínɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā nēé kwú ga ajɛ éwɔhá ā, ó géē méyīnyinyi uwā í mā uwá tá wā ɔlɛ́. Ohígbū ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā wɛ Óndú kú ɛhi mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi nɛ̄. Ó gáā je eyī kú nū tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, eko nɛ̄ aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí nū, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē tá aá ŋ́. Ó géē mīyɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
idu_Latn: Óndú, abālɔbányā, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ, okónu nɛ̄ a gē ce ā í gē tɔ́lá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ a kē le okónu nyā ce gā um á.

eng_Latn: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, kwú ɔtū kú nū ú pīyabɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó ka, Ń gáā yá odúúmā kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā le ɛlā nyā pó ā, ɔtú kwu bīya lɛ ɔ́, ohígbū koó lɛ agbénú nwuné nwuné.

eng_Latn: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē bī Asírīya le je ōwē lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
idu_Latn: Ó gē bī ācɛ nēe tá iyī ūwā wāajɛ ā jé ɔwɛ kú okpaakpa ā. Ó klla ī nwū uwā ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nya ā tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń lɛ ɔbá nóó. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, A kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ka anúɔ í lɛ ɔbá nóó ā.

eng_Latn: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ kú ɛbɛ nēé má nyā lɛyíkwu igelī nēé hī ka Utáya ā. Áá tū ɛgíkwū ipú ɔtūnōbí, aá nēe gē yɛ ipú úgbéenyi eyī ísu ā. Utáya nōo wɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ úgbéenyi gē wū ajɛ ā kwú yíífi ɛɛ́. Inú dóódu mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ úgbéenyi gē wū ajɛ kú igelī ā kwú yíífi má tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ aúgbéenyi kú aá bá ī pīyɛyí ŋmá Usáyíprɔs ā, aá lɛ ɔ̄kā ā pó.

eng_Latn: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
idu_Latn: Ami ā ń jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā nóo. Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tíne ká n̄ lɛ ɔ́ mafú lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ n wā gē bī éŋkpɔ̄ yá ācɛ ubatísim á.

eng_Latn: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ákú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ā kwú pīya ákú Ébrahām kóō kwú pīya ajɛ o nyi okwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ ɔkwu kú íne nēé bīya ā gā ɛcɛ, ójīla ā géē bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbɛ́ɛna kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne nēé bīya ā. É géē bī ɔ́bɛ́ɛna ā wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ŋmá iyē nū ā, ācɛ í kē jé ɔ̄ éjúuma eko nɛ̄ ó wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
idu_Latn: É lɛ opo tá ɛɛ́, odúúdú ācɛ kē kwú tútū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā ga ɔnɛ̄fú glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka íwɔ́tū mla ɔnū kú Óndú ā klá ācɛ dóódu bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da Urécɛ̄lu ka anúɔ wɛ ɔmáapú ádā nū. Ó ka anúɔ klla wɛ ɔyí Urebéka. Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu le inya kwu gaá le ka lɛ ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá kahíníī, Áá híī yúúfi ŋ́, n gáā je iyī um kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Umaárāti, Ubɛt-Ánɔ́tu, mɛ́mla Ɛlitékɔn. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛhīlī mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā í jé ɔ̄ éjúuma ka anú wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī jɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka nɛ̄ ācɛ gē jé tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛ̄cī Usábāti dóódu ā ŋ́. Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɛpɔ̄bí nēé ŋmó ɔ̄ ā lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɔfú kú uwɔ mafú ɔfú nāa bī le nuunu lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
idu_Latn: Ɔyī kú uwá lulé nɛ̄hi, é kē le ɔtā kú uwá túce ɛɛ́. Ikpó kú aɔ́nya ɛfú kú uwá kwu ajɛ kitaa bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā. Akā kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú uwā kē ī pīyeyī fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka ofulútu ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uháman fíya, kɔ́ɔ̄ ɔ̄ wā kú aá gaá wɛ aúgbɔga kú ucɛ kú Ɛ́sta, nōó yɔ̄ gē yá lɛ aá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Uháman le tá ɔnū ucɛ kú Ɛ́sta, nōó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ā, Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla anú. Ó klla le yá kú ɛlā dóódu nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu ka ā, kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ í gē jɛ̄ odúúmā kú uwá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ ikpó gbo ajɛ ŋ́. Odúúmā kú uwā í gē gbiyɔ̄lā ce ɛyí ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́. Īlī ō le gbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ kú uwā í gē wī ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ngbá áblákpá kú uwá dúúmā gē hɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ā wā kéē tá ɔ̄ ɔtūlé, amáŋ ó tá koó mīyɛ ɔtū o túlé. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N géē kwú ipú ekwu nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú ɔtūnōbí kú ɔyí ūm ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó yēkwu ipú ɔtūnōbí kú ɔyí nū Ujósɛ̄fu ā gɔbū kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
idu_Latn: Uhása Ussúwalu, Ubála, Ɛ́sɛ̄m.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, kéē gbā anú ōfōōfūnū ɛ̄gbā. Ó da uwá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī iyē kú nū ōfōōfūnū le cokónu.

eng_Latn: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā, n géē yá kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri kéē kwúcē wā ahɔ̄ olɔhi nēé bá gbɔbū ā kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo le ɔlá hɛ́ kwu agege kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ í háyi ipú ɔgālā ámāŋ ka útāŋgōdō ŋ́. Ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ɔ́ ce ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussálum mɛ́mla Áta, mɛ́mla Utálmɔn mɛ́mla Ákūūb mɛ́mla Uhátīya, mɛ́mla Ussóbāyi ācɛ ogbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ, ofɛhīlī ce igwáahāanɛ .

eng_Latn: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
idu_Latn: Aá gē bī ógo nɛ̄hi lɛ gwá ejé. Aá klla ī le ɔtulalī nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā tū iyē, amáŋ aá kē yɔ́tūnōbí ohígbū Ísrɛ̄lu nōo je yíífi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
idu_Latn: Udán, Unáfutáli, Ugádi mɛ́mla Ássa.

eng_Latn: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
idu_Latn: Ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛci ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ le hɛ́ enyi bēhé ga ogbeé ɔhá kú óókpoó ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔkpani, alɔ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú alɔ ā gbaáluka ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í bí ŋmá ipú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya amáŋ íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe tɛtɛ bá gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlá gbo lɛyíkwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ɔtū kú um kwú bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ikpokwú kú iyē kú um kwú wi ŋmá ɔhá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ɛlā otīihɔ nōo ka ā cɛ̄ gā um yɔ̄ ī túgagá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ogwéjé nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́ gē je mlanyī ɔyí nū nōo yɔ ī gwá amɛ̄ kú nū ā glá ā, kóō híī yíihɔtū ɔyí nōó ma ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔ́dāŋ ka aɛ́nɛ́ kōō le mlanyi ayí uwā nááná, ami ā í gáā mlanyī aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, nɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ ī gbō ɔkpá, é gáā ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
idu_Latn: Ipú eyī kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, nōo géē wā í ce ɔcɛ́ kóō géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ oyēeyī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kwú ā, n pi uwɔ ahɔ̄ lɔfúlɔfú.

eng_Latn: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ekɔ̄bū, a géē jé ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Eko nɛ̄ a géē wā í jila ulé kú um āa, ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛwū dúúmā nōó híkākā ŋ́ ámāŋ álá nōó wɛ onōbí ŋ́, a géē jé keé wɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ um kpó uwī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn gekwú ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya kpɔ́. É gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ojibó kú Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā kpɔ́. É le ɛka gbo kwú Ubáalu ú pīya ɔwɔ kú úwā.

eng_Latn: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alɔ lɛ Utímōti, ɔyínɛ́ alɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aá, alɔ mɛ́mla anú ī yúklɔ́ lɛ Ɔwɔicō gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá á. Alɔ tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fú aá kóō yá kú aá lɔtū lɛ fíyɛ́ ipú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá, aálá kú um nɛ̄ n gē je ɔdōlé lɛ aá ā, wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ami kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ dúú á ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n ka n géē gwó éwo ámāŋ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ dúúmā gicō, klla í bu ɔ́ tū á.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná, ó lɛ ɔdā o lɔhi éyi nāa yá. A le odúúdú aɔwɔ mɛ́mla aíkpɛ́cí kú Ássɛ̄ra kpó ca ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujúda. A klla cēyītikwū káā yɛ tá ɔdā nōo kwu Óndá ā ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú nū le ɔ́ hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū á. Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, A wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ obɔ̄bíipú. N habɔ̄ odúúdú ulé ɔ́ɔmā tá gā uwɔ ohígbū ka a gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: A géē kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú um ā gē kwú ā, ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ mā. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɔ́da je ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Umówābu, aá nēe gē pā ɛcí nōo lé ka Ukémosi ā, aá le jí ɛɛ́. É kwú aá í yíífi klla kwú ayí uwā kpó kwú aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ éwɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Alɔ ā ɔkpáncō wɛ ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī alɔ á. Alɔ bī ɔtū nwula nwula gē gbēyī ohɔ́nyɛtá kú alɔ, Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, kóō wā ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá ipú ísu pūtūputupūtū bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī wú ā. Ó klla gē yá ka isú kóō wū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄hī kú anɔ̄ nōo ce ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔlɛ́ aá pīya alácɛ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe yɛ aá jīla tá ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe í wā í yɛ ɔwɛ pi aá ā géē bá ī yá aá okónu.

eng_Latn: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kē leyīkwu uwá klla bī ɔtū ékpónú leyīkwu uwá. Ó klla bī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó jé ā lɛ gbō uwā ɔwɛ olɔhi.

eng_Latn: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
idu_Latn: Ó le Ɛlíyākim nōo gē leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ nū ā, mɛ́mla Ussɛ́bina, ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpá ā, mɛ́mla ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya éyi, tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ayisáya ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄si, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Hath not my hand made all these things?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ami abɔ̄yī um yá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā dúú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
idu_Latn: Odóódu kú alɔ nēé í má íkókwū ā ɛgiyí nū ā, é í je ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ohile kú alɔ kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
idu_Latn: Ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le nyīla kwú lɛwa nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofu ce ahāapa kú ɔyā ɛpa ā, ajɛ le ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
idu_Latn: Ami, nááná ā, é kwú um abɔ̄fú ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ um nɛ n. Íjípiti amānyā nááná ā, ń yá ɔdā dúúmā nēé cíkā ō je um tá agbá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Umósīsi ɛyí ɛfu kú usáyínāyi ā kóō.

eng_Latn: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu o je ācɛ nēe kwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Aá jé ŋmá ɔkpá kú Umósīsi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɛga nēé kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ gē yi ipácí nɛ̄ ácí ā í je yi tāajɛ ŋ́ mā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, mla Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki, mla Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu á ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
idu_Latn: Aá nēe ī tɔ́ɔna ɔ̄kā olɔhi lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, aá tīcō nyɔ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā mla odúúdú ɔfú kú aá. Aá hī ācɛ Usáyɔn igwú gbōmgbōm, Aá yúúfi ŋ́, aá ka tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm lɛ ācɛ aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā kahíníī, Áá mɔ́ɔ̄, Óndú kú aá gē wā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
idu_Latn: Ádā, lɛ ojīlīmā ce um abālɔbányā, ɛdɔ ojīlīmā nāa le ce um gbɔbū ká ā yá ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le odúúdú ɛlā kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā nwū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Unebo wɛ, ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, Óndú ɔ́ɔ géē nū aéwo dóódu nēe bá iyɔ̄bū uwā ā ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā, abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī wā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ajɛ kú aéwo nōo nwuné klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ aólɛlā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, aá nyāŋjɛ ká aá kpɛ́fú tá uwā, ká aá ŋmó ācɛ ā, kwu aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā nēe kōō ī yúklɔ́ gā um ā. Ācɛ ohile ā géē je fíyákátā . Ó da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá ā ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ aálá ā kē le fíyákátā. Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ɔfú kwu ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
idu_Latn: A gē bī ācɛ kú uwɔ tá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cogbāálá ā. Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umósīsi gē leyīkwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó lɛ ā, aá le pīya ayááyí kú Ébrahām ɛɛ́, aá kē í mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ ayááyí kú Ébrahām ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Igabɔ̄ kú um dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā? Eko nyā, Uháman yɔ̄ í wā agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā bōōbū, kóō gaá da ɔcɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ Umɔ́dɛkāyi tōolī playi ákanaba nōó bū kwaajɛ lɛ ogbló cíla anú ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gáā pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ alɔ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā mīyɛ ajɛ nōo wɛ ákú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ kú uwɔ í gáā gaajɛ ŋ́, ɔyā kú uwɔ í kē gáā gɔɔkpá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ a géē bī yɔ̄ ī lɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ piyóó á. Ɛ̄cī kú ɔtūnobí kú uwɔ ā géē mɛ.

eng_Latn: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ge bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ tá ajɛ ā, gē je míya tū ɔ̄. Ɛgwā kē í kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔdɔ ca kpló ā.

eng_Latn: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú uwā ā le he Uhámɔ mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ussɛ́kɛm ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Udéfīdi lɛ ɔkpá tá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Uríya ɛhɔ̄ fu Ujówābu ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ukɔ́ nēe bá nyā tū uwā mɛ́mla aíkonó ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō ŋmó uwā okónu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɔfú tū ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ā iyē kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā lɔɔlɔhi, anɔ́ɔ áluka kú ācɛ nēe ī cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō gē lɛwa tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú um ŋmá álá ō gbō, anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka, Nyɔ̄ gaá cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ga um, ká n̄ ka ɛla ga uwɔ ka á pó. N géē da uwɔ ɛyí ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī kú um má ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.
idu_Latn: Ejé ā í tōō gwá kwɛyí ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ ā kllā lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá í tū ejé ā, ka ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kóō gwá ejé ā í kwu ɛga nōo he ɔ̄ ɔtú ā.

eng_Latn: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā kóō híī lɔtūce īyī nū kú anúɔ gbɛ nɛ̄hi ŋ́. Amāŋ ó yɔ̄ ī pla īyī nū.

eng_Latn: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
idu_Latn: Ó pīyeyī má ācɛ nēe cīce pīyī ɔ̄ biílí ā anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ bá amānyā yɔ̄ ā!.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ lɛ ífi nɛ̄hi nyā yá ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gáā yá uwā olɔhi kpɛ́mm nɛ̄ n cokónū nū lɛ uwá ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, é kwu aákpa kú ɔcɛ́ ū kpó kwaajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo húmáyī yēeyī piyóó ā, gaá cīce ɛyí éyi kú aákpa ā. Īlī kú nū wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kwɛ́mm bɛ̄ɛka áfū ā. Īnyīlɛyí kú nū tɛ́ɛ́hɛ́ kɛ̄lííí bɛ̄ɛka owú otutú ā. Ikpó kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā kwu aákā nēe bá ī cɔ̄lá blublu.

eng_Latn: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni le yá fíyaa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu ga ipú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ó má ōcē obɔ̄bí le bɛ̄cɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá ā ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ umu kú ɔtulalī fú tū ɔlá. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya gwó kwɛyí ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aálá ā bá abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, ó klla géē kpó aɛ́wū ā bá abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aópeyī ō bī aópeyī jɔ́ɔwɛ ā. Aá gē ka kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā bī Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā le ɛka gbo, ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā bī ugóolu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā le ɛka gbo, ó géē yá ɛka nōó gbo ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ ipú ɔlɛ́ ā, eko nɛ̄ ó le iyāwu yɛ ipú nū ɛ̄cī odumkulu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō ka lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, é géē je Unínīfɛ yíífi.

eng_Latn: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
idu_Latn: É le aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ nēe bá ā kpó lɛ ayááyí kú Árɔ̄ni. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á: Uhɛ́brɔn, Ujatɛ́ mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulíbna, Ɛ́sstɛmōwa mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ̄cī kú aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī oyēŋēē ā ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ó gē yɛ anú ŋ́. Ó le nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī, ámāŋ ó jé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá uwɔ nyā le yá odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu ā eyījii klla í hɛ́ uwá idáagó. Kwu aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwá bá ī yúufi, ufi ā klla yɔ̄ ī mafú eyī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ? Ācɛ nɛ̄ n tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ aá ā lɛ aá pīyatū nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ananíyāsi tóohi kahíníī, Óndú, n tɛtɛ le ɔ̄kā kú ɔ̄cɛ ā pó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ alɛwa ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɔ́dā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nōó yá ācɛ otīihɔ kú uwɔ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
idu_Latn: Īkpɛ̄yí kú ágábá igwɛ́ɛpa nēé yá kwu ɛga ōyɛ gicō kú nū ā lɛ eyī pīya kwu íyī uwā. Ɛdɔ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū nyā í yɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki nōó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Ulífāyi ŋ́ mā, mīyɛ éyi ŋmá ipú igwó ŋmá abɔ̄ Ébrahām, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ á, Ébrahām wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū géē gbō ācɛ ā ɛyí lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛga otayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí owu mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi ā. É géē yá ɛgbá kú ācɛ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nōo gē pɛ́ ipú ígbíli ā. É kē í tú ācɛ ā ɔtū lé lɛbɛ̄ɛka obobowú kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔcí dóódu í kwu ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne kú um.

eng_Latn: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ɔdā dóódu yá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
idu_Latn: Īlī ukɔ́tin kú ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ekābɔ̄ ɛtá, mɛ́mla ogbló ɛtá mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū kú Uféro yá lɔfú kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Uféro í jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́ má, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
idu_Latn: Ó wā í pla uwɔ, kóō má ɔdā nɛ a gēe yá mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ Ádām nɛ̄ ebilíi plla a ŋ́, ɔnya nɛ̄ ebilíi plla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē bī ulámpu le jíla Ujerúsālɛm. N géē yá ācɛ nēe jɛ̄ iyī uwā klla lɔtūce iyī uwā ā italā. Ā­cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē ka lɛ iyī ka, Óndú ā í gáā yá ɔdā dúú ɔwɛ ɔhá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ubássa ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔdā nōo gē yá nyā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó habɔ̄ igá o hɛ tū Uráma ā tá.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ á ŋ́, A lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ācɛ kē jé uwɔ ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi lɛ āā.

eng_Latn: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá gaá bī igbō kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tá um ahínyá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gwō ohígbū ɛya nɛ̄ aá gwó cabá fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é cɛgbá ā. Ohígbū ka ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā he aá ɔtū ō yá á.

eng_Latn: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla alɔ le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Ujémīsi, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī anyākwɔ́cɛ ā ké bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ācɛ Ulífāyi, ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ācogwííjē, ācɛ ɔlamu ohile mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, má lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD's passover.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ā, ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú nū géē wɛ ucɛ kú eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā nya aá tá á.

eng_Latn: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ lɛyítajɛ táajɛ lɛ aíne, nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē je Uprisi ícɛ nyā. N kē í nū ācɛ Ámɔn, Ukénan, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Uprisi, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi ŋmá ajɛ ā hī lɛ ā, abɔ̄ aá gē yɛ gɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi ā ka, eko nēé mīyɛ ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó, nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē bī gé lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ ákú aá ā. Aá géē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú nū lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aíne nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ge ŋmó eko nɛ̄ aá géē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā tū, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē mīyɛ ɛya kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā. Ó gē gwɛ̄lá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá ipú agbá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛgɔhá kú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēé klla tá kahíníī, É géē je eyī má ɔ̄cɛ nēé lɛ óbō gwō ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé mā uwā tá ipú aéwo ā, géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōlé ipúúpū ámāŋ ka ipácí ā. Ó le bēhé ga ipú aálá ā le uwá kwú kwú uwā ú híla nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. É leyīce ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔ́ɔ lɔfú hɛ́ aá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le bēhé tá inu ā, ācɛ opeyī ɛpa ā gā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá cɛ̄ ka n lɔfú yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ba ā glá āa? Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Īī, Óndú.

eng_Latn: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ kaé kwú uwī ā ŋ́, é géē bī ɔ̄cɛ nēe lɛ ije, ámāŋ ɔdée tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā, wā agblīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɛka gbo kaó wɛ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ je ije ámāŋ ka ɔdée ā uwī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, ohígbū ka, igbīhi nɛ̄ ádā nū gekwú ā, odúúdú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Áhābu ā kwú pīya ācɛ o nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā. Ɛ̄nyā bī ɔ̄ ga ipú íne kú Óndú ā ō bīya, nōo kē bī ɔ̄ wāajɛ dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aódodó kú ipácí gē jɛ̄ lɛ ā. É gē yúklɔ́ ī tá īlī lɛ iyī uwā ŋ́. Amáŋ n da aá koó kōō Usólōmɔn nōo lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā, í lɛ īlī nōo lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka īlī nɛ̄ aódodó nēe bá nyā gē le wiiyē ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ŋmá odúúdú aéwo, mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma, mɛ́mla aúcē mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ācɛ̄ géē héyī kwu aókwū kú uwa ɛcí ɛtá ce ohɛ́ɛpa kú ɛ̄cī éyi. É gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kpó uwā nyi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛgɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú nū gɔ́ kwɔhá ékpónú, aá klla lɛ ɛgɔ́ ɛhīlī kú nū ā gɔ̄ kwɔhá ékpónú. A klla í cē ɔ́mɛɛhīlī ā bá ɛpa ce iyɔ̄bū kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le alɔ yá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éwo kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, kú alɔ kē cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ ádā nū ā ɛhɔ̄. Aamí.

eng_Latn: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
idu_Latn: O cē olɔhi klá iyī ɔ̄cɛ ōfōofū nū gē kpó unwalu wā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔtūce Óndú ā géē jāgbénú.

eng_Latn: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá jāhɔ̄ ga um ŋ́, Óndú ā géē bī aéwɔhá, nōo gē ka ucē ɔhá le kɛlā lɛ aá klla le nwū aá ɛlā.

eng_Latn: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
idu_Latn: É je igelī nɛ̄hi kú Aába nēé gē hī ka Uhéburɔn, nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɛfu kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla ipácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́dāajɛ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā.

eng_Latn: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí nū á, anɔ́ɔ Ubálam da ɔ́ kahíníī, N le ede ahāapa gwó klla le ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla omlede éyééye gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā, Umósīsi le okónu ce gā um ka ajɛ dúú nɛ̄ n lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ ā, ó géē wɛ ákú um mɛ́mla ayí um, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ pīya úgwū kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ā gwó okómpinu mɛ́mla odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwā kwu okónɔɔwɛ mɛ́mla odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um, nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ékpónú ōfōōfūnū tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla uwá á. É je uwēyī lɛ iyē kú um nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá í tōō le gbla anú ŋ mā ŋmá lɛ ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi dóódu nɛ̄ uwá gē yá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n le cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwá kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka awɔ ā, Óndú, a ce ɔcɛ́ klla lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú odúúdú ācɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
idu_Latn: N géē tū Onesímɔ̄si, ɔyínɛ́ nōo he um ɔtū nōo ī yúklɔ́ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó ā ɛhɔ̄ mla anú. Ó wɛ éyi kú ígwu kú aá. Uwá géē da aá ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ī yá amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi lɛ ā wɛ kéē cɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tá ānāānā ā í wɛ ka alɔ yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra iyī alɔ igbɔhá ŋ́. Alɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔhá ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ alɔ ī cɛgbá ɔkpá nōo ī cɛ̄tra alɔ lɛ aá ŋ́. Alɔ í kōō cɛgbá ɔkpá ŋmá ɛgiyí aá nōo ī cɛ̄tra alɔ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi kwú ogbló ú wu ɔ́, kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔkɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gbafíyóó ɛ̄cī éyi kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usɔ́lu géē je um ŋmó nɛ̄ u. N géē le kwu ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ajɛ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ó le pó ka ami ɔ́ɔ yɔ ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ufilístiya, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ō tíne um.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Umósīsi kahíníī, Awɔ géē kɛlā lɛ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ géē pó glá mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Amáŋ ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ alɔ géē pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō yá aólɛlā kú um nēe ī bɛ̄yíkwu um ā italā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ukálɛ̄bu ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ācɛ Ukɛriyati Uséfa yálé, anúɔ géē je Ákisāfu, ɔyí anúɔ nɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n gáā ményīnyinyi uwá ŋ́. N géē yá uwá ɔdā nēé yá ācɛ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
idu_Latn: N jé aá lɔɔlɔhi, n lɛ ɔtūce aá, oyēeyī kú alɔ ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Óndú ā gē yá ká n̄ lɛ ɔtūce aá ka aá gáā gbɛlá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī um tá ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō í yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī junwalu lɛ aá ā italā.

eng_Latn: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Usiríya klla le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú hilo ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá kpɔ́. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ŋmó ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú Usiríya ā, úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ . É klla ŋmó ācocɔnya kpɛ́fú kú uwā, úlā ofɛhɔ̄ . É klla lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā, Ussóbāki ā yá ágbe, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā klla géē mu aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm bá gē hijā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu klla da uwá gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ kahíníī, N le da aá piíí ka Ɔwɔicō le olɛhɔ̄ nōó ka ka anúɔ géē nya ācɛ tá ā tū fu aílɔ́wá ɛɛ́. É géē jāhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē nuunu tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā, klla ī je ɔ́ yá ɔdōcābɔ̄, klla í je ɔ́ ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ jé ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Usára kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī kpó īkpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó lɛ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nōo géē cābɔ̄ mafú lɛ ācɛ nēe bá mɛ́mla uwɔ ā ka á jíkpó ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē jé ka á yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
idu_Latn: Aá ka Ɔwɔicō gē je ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá ā ɔ́ɔ yá ā tū gbēyī ayí uwā. Ɔwɔicō cíkā ō lɛ ulé cílá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā abɔ̄yī uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ keé lɛ ɛlā klɔ́ɔcɛ́ ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Ujúda ā kwúcē mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā le tá ɔlɛ́ nū, nyɔ̄ í le ɔdōlé lé mɛ́mla anú á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni lɛ ɔlá hɛ́ kwu aágege ā, kwú uwā ú kpó ce kéē fíyajɛ ga iyɔ̄bū kú ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ŋmá ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ, é géē cīce í lé ucɛ ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
idu_Latn: Áram ma Ammínādābu, Ammínādābu ma Unáhssɔn, Unáshɔn ma Usálmɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
idu_Latn: Owú ō tígbígbili nyā géē tá aá ɛlá kwu odúúdu íne kú um. Aá í wɛ ákú um dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ede kú ɛcɔ̄ nēé bī oje le yúklɔ́ anú jééjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ gwó.

eng_Latn: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɛcɔ̄ ō gbā le ɔwɛ ŋmó tū um, ó klla le ɔwɛ kú um yá kóō híī tōō yɛ ga um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū nāa ī yá tū um ā, gē ma ɔwɛ fú gā um á. Okpaakpa kú uwɔ gē bī um jé ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ bī ɔdōmiya ɔdā okpaakpa ā le mīya ɔdā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yēeyī līgbó ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, gáā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
idu_Latn: Ami ā jé ɔ̄, ohígbū ka n ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, anú abɔ̄yī nū tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó le ɔcɛ́ á. Ó kē ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ nū wɛ Asúba, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ussɛ́lihi.

eng_Latn: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ um má lɛ ā, wɛ ka ācɛ nēe hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí, klla nyi īkpō kú ɔ́bíipú ā, géē cɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú unwalu mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú á.

eng_Latn: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
idu_Latn: O piyóó ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāanɛ kú ɔyā ɔ́mɛnɛ kú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔkpɛtā le kwú ācɛ ā iyē nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ ɔlamu nēe bá ipú igá ā í má ɔdā dúúmā lé ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
idu_Latn: É ya ɔ̄ cɔ̄nū ohígbū ɛga o pɛ̄ɛcí alɛwa kú uwā, é klla cɛ̄ lɛ ánya yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwā ohígbū aójibó kú aɛ́cí nēé gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aɛ́pā lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, aígbáanɔ kē lɛ ɔlɛ́. Amáŋ ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ um gē lā kú abɔ̄yī n ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gā ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla odúúdu ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ipú ígbíli kú Upáran ipú Ukádɛssi. É le ohi kú iyāwu kú uwā kpó lɛ uwá mɛ́mla odúúdu ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É klla le ikpɔ̄cí kú ajɛ ā mafú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄, alɔ yɔ̄ ī gicō, ī ga Ujerúsālɛm ɛga nēé géē kwú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔcɛ, í je ɔ́ tū aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla ācɛ ō nwū íne abɔ̄. É kē í ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí, kéē le ɔ́ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tū aílɔ́wá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō gbo lɛ anúɔ, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔmáapú aá nōo cíkā ō gwɔ̄ɔ́ci ā kóō gwō ɔyí anúɔ ɔhá nóō yēeyī ā ɔ́ci, je ɔ́ ŋmó gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, le okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ klla le ɔkpá gbo ka īnyīlɛyí ékpónú kú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɔ́ɔ gáā wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔkpá ō gbō ɛ́nyɔ́ gbō ɛ́nyɔ́, klla lɛ ɔdée oheyīfuú gbo ɛyí bɛ̄ɛka aótrɛyí kú aícɔ́ɔja o ce ɔnya kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
idu_Latn: N jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā. Nááná nɛ ɔfu kú aá í nwuné ŋ́ mā, aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ā kē háyi kpaakpa ga um. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē gwū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
idu_Latn: A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je ɔ́da kú nū, klla ī yá ka ɔwɔ kóō límanya ŋmá ipú ojuja ā?.

eng_Latn: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usɔ́lu cēyītīkwū kéē lɛ icɔ́ɔci ā yíífi, ó kē ī ŋmá inu éyi ga inu ɔhá gē kwú ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā kéē kpó uwā tū agbá.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú. Jāhɔ̄ gā um! Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Otú í gáā bī abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, agege ámāŋ ka ɛnɔ í kē gáā cɛgbá gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū kú Óndú Ɔwɔicō géē wɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ kú uwā ā. É kē í cɔcɛ́ oŋméeko téeko piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é páápá le yɛ á. Eko nēé lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Umerí pīyɛ̄ ā, é má bā ɔyí ā gwutá ipú ikpati ō lɛ ɔdōlé kú ɛbɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wā ōjīla kú ācɛ kú Óndú ā dúú á. Ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja ikpó nēe géē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kpɛ́fú ā, nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ, ulá bá ɛga ulá ɛpa ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
idu_Latn: Aá géē bá ī ka ɛlā ɛflɛ́ɛfu ga um gbóógbóō nɛ? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá gē tóohi piíí ā?.

eng_Latn: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔfú je ɔ́da lɛ ɛnɔ, nɛ̄ ɛnɔ í gáā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē fíyajɛ ŋ́. Ó kē lɔfú yá ka aínyílɔ́wɔ kóō fíyajɛ otú ŋ́ glá.

eng_Latn: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
idu_Latn: É jíijéyī, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É bá ī yá ucē obɔ̄bí dúúdú, anɔ́ɔ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ flúflú gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá gē ka ka ɛbɛ nāa gē má ā mɛ́mla olɛhɔ̄ nāa gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ā lɛyíkwu iháyí alɛwa nōo gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ yɔ̄ ī límanya gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɛcɛ tá péee, akpáabana kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī gbo gblágádáá, anɔ́ɔ ɛcɛ le jíliyē á.

eng_Latn: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
idu_Latn: Ábīja mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū le āyā kú úlā igbíngbídi kú aícɔ́ɔja o lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā le jīla bá okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛwū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā je á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
idu_Latn: Ádā nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ká ā gaá lɛ ayínɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla aálá ā kpó jila, ɔ́dāŋ keé bá lɔhi. Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ohi kpó gé um. Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū lɛ ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ɔpɛ́ kú Uhɛ́brɔn. Ujósɛ̄fu gāajɛ Ussɛ́kɛm.

eng_Latn: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
idu_Latn: Aá kpó aóje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā wu nyɔ̄. Aá kpó aúgóolu wu nyɔ̄. Ohígbū ka Unínīfɛ gbo agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si wā gaá da uwá kahíníī, É kwú ɔfú dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ú kpó gā um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n bī Ubéélsēbul gē nū alelékwū obɔ̄bi tɛ́ɛcɛ, ɔdí nɛ̄ ācɛ o yɛce aá gē bī le nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ ā gɛ? Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā uwá géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ka ā.

eng_Latn: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ubábīlɔn, ga ajɛ ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gaá cīce ajɛ pɛtɛɛ ipú úmlá. A tɛtɛ lɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyilɔ ŋ́ mā. A wɛ igelī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yálé jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ á le mlɔ́mlɔ́ klla lɔhi iyē lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka a kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ abālɔbányā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā Ugóssɛn, ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. É kē le gbagbénú nɛ̄hi klla ma ayí alɛwa abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa lɛ ā é kwú āyā ká ajɛ kú Ujúda ú lɛ Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujefúne nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā. Ó mīyɛ Uhɛ́brɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Aába ádā kú Ánāki, agwu ā.

eng_Latn: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ á. Ádā alɔ, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, Alɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká ā yá ká ācɛ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce iyē otīihɔ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya ka ɔtūnōbí kú anúɔ í loō mɛ ŋ́, ó ka ɔtū kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ kē le bīya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú uwā iyē nɛ̄hi, o fíyɛ́ dúú ohígbū ɛlā nōó ka kéē gáā má eyī kú anúɔ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bītá ga ipú úgbéenyi á.

eng_Latn: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yá glá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
idu_Latn: Ígwu kú ācogwíijē ɔ́mpa ā: Ásāfu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā á. Ɛma kú nū nōo yɛ gaá kwu Ulífāyi ā wɛ, Ásāfu, Ubɛrɛkíya, Ussímēya.

eng_Latn: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nēé je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ ā, é ŋmó aɔ́bɛ́ɛna ofɛhɔ̄, aálá ofigwó, mɛ́mla aómlede úlā, kpó gwɛ́ɛya kú ínoōbīya kwɛyí ɔkwu kú Ísrɛ̄lu igwɛ́ɛpa dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
idu_Latn: Agbá nēé tū um ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛyínɛ̄hi ayínɛ́ um ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā lɔtūce Óndú ā fíyɛ́. É kē yúúfi gɛ ŋ́, é lɔtū lɛ gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ pāāla eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá ká aá lɛ ɛka nɛ̄ um gbo mɛ́mla ā tū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a le da ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
idu_Latn: Amásīya lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm úlā ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó ɔpɛ́ nēé hī ka ɔpɛ́ kú ɔmā ā. Ó klla mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usɛlá ŋmá ɛgiyí uwá ɔgbɛ́fú, ó kwú iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú ce ɔ́ ka, Ujókutíli jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bá āyā éyi kú ɛfú ā, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kē bá āyā ɔhá kú ɛfú ā. Ɛfu ā kē lɛ uwá kɔ̄ hīyī uwā tá. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bā yɔ̄ ī hágágā kéē le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, nēe kwu uwá ajaajɛ, klla gáā kwú uwā ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá kē le ɔdā nēe bá ā má ɛɛ́, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá kē ī kɛlā nōó lɛ ɛyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:
idu_Latn: Woó, Ágábáidu, Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ádā uwɔ Unebúkádinēsa yá ɔcɛ́ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi á. Ó klla je ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yīnū cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ, ohígbū koó yá kú ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aéwɔhá kéē lā tɔ̄há bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū ékpó ā. Ikwū kú nū ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā lɛ ikpɛ́lā nōo kɔ̄ uwá hɛ̄ iyī uwā tá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ ā catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uya kú uwā nwuné lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ācɛ nēe bá í gwéeyē ámāŋ ka ācɛ nēé bá gē jikwū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā í ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā í má ówē nēe bá nyā kpɛ́mm cɛ́ɛ́ kóō ga ipú ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi kē ī wɛ ootá gbóóló bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Asírīya la aóhile kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá abɔ́ɔ a, kéē bɛ̄cɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɛ a tɛtɛ tá la uwá gbóóló ŋmá Íjīpiti, eko nēé būɛcɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ a.

eng_Latn: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē lɛ Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ. Aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
idu_Latn: É géē je átákwū kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɛbɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ŋmá ipú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ nēé gwɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī je álá ámāŋ ka ɛwū, ó í bī ɔbá nōó lɛ ɛcá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ n géē lé ɔdōlé, n yɔ̄ gē jikwū. Ɛgíkwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tū ā í lɛ ō mɛ ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka, ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ hi anúɔ ka ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ā? Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔhi ŋ́, anúɔ í táafú ŋ́, ayíka Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá ī hókónu tū ayínɛ́ ā ōfōōfū uwā, ɔdí wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá āa? Ācɛ nēe í pa ɛcí ā nááná gē yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
idu_Latn: É le akā ɛnɛ yá kwu ikpó kú utéblu ā, ó wu oje gblógbló nēé ma tɔ̄há mɛ́mla utéblu ā. Olɔwá kú aákā a wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce okɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔtūce odúúdú íne kú uwɔ ā glá. Aólɛlā kú um bá ī yá um ŋmó mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā bá um.

eng_Latn: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ikpó kōō kahíníī, Ohígbū ka ń wɛ abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, ń wɛ ákú iyē ā gɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄nyā í yá kóō híīī wɛ āyā kú iyē ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
idu_Latn: Aá ŋmó anyākwɔ́cɛ, ayípōklóbīya, áncɛ́nyā, aɛ́nɛ́ mla ayípɛnɛncɛ́. Amáŋ, aá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ína yɔ̄ anú údɔbū ŋ́. Aá gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um amānyā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó Aótrɛ̄yí nēe māháyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi abɔ́ɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ō gbo ókplícī gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ gē jééyī ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛcɛ ō lé gbojī gē yá ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō jé ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra ɔnyā ā, ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā. Ó cɛgbá kú odúúdú ācɛ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ kú iyē kú um ú kpó fā klɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó klla le ikpokwú kú um kpó ca tīipú.

eng_Latn: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta le hīlatá i tá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ami nɛ̄ aá gē dɔɔ̄kā á. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá wā ā.

eng_Latn: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, Uhɛ́brɔn.

eng_Latn: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: N le ɔdā dóódu nēé ī yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā má ɛɛ́, amáŋ odúúdú uwā wɛ áncā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī nū owu inya kóō lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ eyīnyinyi um má, o yá ká Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si kóō ményinyi um eko nōó yɔ̄ ī yá mla um, ɔ̄cɛ nōo bīyíne fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú pīya ɔdā ocābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nōo ŋmá abālɔbányā géē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ujísɔ̄si, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mīyɛ oyēeyī opiyoo.

eng_Latn: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
idu_Latn: A kwu ojuuja nōo cɔkpɛ́nú nɛ̄hi í hā tū iyī uwɔ, nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbā ā gaajɛ uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
idu_Latn: Yá kú alɔ nēe wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, kú ālɔ̄ má úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā. Ipɔ́ɔma kú alɔ kóō má ɛgahi mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ ajɛ géē nwū uwɔ dúú. Aɛ́béenyi kú ísu klla í ka gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o lɛ ánya nɛ̄hi gē hɛ́ unwalu mɛ́mla ikpɛ́lā nɛ̄hi tá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ń tíne ō yá ŋ́ mā, ɛ̄nyā mafú ka íne ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē ga Íjīpiti nyɔ̄ í tíne otábɔ̄ ā le jī ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē kpɔ́tūce ɔnya mɛ́mla úgbɔ́ɔ́nya obī kpɛ́fú, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja okpɛ́fú ɔnya kú Íjīpiti. Amáŋ é gbɛnú ce Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē da Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ tá aá abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
idu_Latn: Anyā, ayí, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú alɔ géē bá ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugílɛ̄di amānyā.

eng_Latn: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá kwú gbogodo ohígbū uya kú isu nōo yɔ̄ í pɛ kwūūū mla owu nōo yɔ̄ ī wā kwūūū a ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Gāa. Anɔ́ɔ Upíta le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ́kɔ ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō yāwu eyī éŋkpɔ̄ wā lɛyíkwu ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú klá ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ga ipú obugā kú ígbílí nyā, ká ālɔ̄ híī yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ipú ojuju nōó yɔ̄ ī yá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú kwúcē gé lɛ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi yá lɔɔlɔhi ipú úklɔ́ kú nū dóódu, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi da Óndú ā kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, ń jé ō kɛlā lɔhi ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Uféro géē jāhɔ̄ gā um glá ā.

eng_Latn: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Utrafɛ́na mɛ́mla Utrafósa, ācɛ nēe ī yúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā. Aá hokónu tū Upɛ́sīsi ɔ̄cɛ o he um ɔtū, nōo yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɛ́fɔ̄du o bī le jé ɔtū kú Óndú ā, bī ge um. Anɔ́ɔ Abíyāta le bī ge lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í gē ci īyī nū ícɔ̄nū ɔ́dāŋ nōó le cɔ̄nū ŋ́. Ó kwú aólɛlā kú nū nēe tá ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ísu nɛ̄hi, nēé hī ka Uráhāabu ā, abɔ̄ kóō bɛ̄yíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā í yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú ɛwa nɛ̄hi ā, nōo klla kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka owuluwulu kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá icō wāajɛ, mɛ́mla ɔkɛ̄lā kú akpáabana nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī gbo klla gbo ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ālɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō! Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kú alɔ ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ á!.

eng_Latn: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
idu_Latn: Uhána yɔ̄ í kɛlā ipú ɔtū kú nū, okónu kú nū ofōōfūnū yɔ̄ í jíliyē á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ í ka ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́lāyi gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka ejé ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ā, géē yɔ̄ kpɔ́. Ɔdā nēé le yá ɛɛ́ mā, nēé géē yá igbɔhá kpɔ́ á. Ɔdā dúúmā í wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ipú ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē tū fu uwá ā. Da uwá kahíníī, Aólɛlā kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gwō klla í gwéeyē ka, aɛ́fu kú íkée ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ákú aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpani, a kē da alɔ ka alɔ lɛ ɔ́ bī wā amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oŋmɛ́cī ɔ́mā a aótrɛ̄yí ācɛ Ujíyu gbɔɔ́ ō tū ujɔ̄ kéē géē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó má ɔ̄cɛ Itiyópīya éyi nōo i búdá, igabɔ̄ kú Ukándesi, ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā o bī ije lɛ ɔcányā kú Itiyópīya. Ó wā Ujerúsālɛm gaá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Aá ga ɛga otīihɔ nēe yɔ̄ Ubɛ́tɛlu mla Ugígalu ā, kú aá nyɔ̄ ī bīyíne, kú ínoōbīya kóō nwuné tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄. Aá bī ɛbɛ́ wā gaá gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, aá klla bī ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó wā ɛ̄cī ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
