idu_Latn: Ń je ɔ̄kā kú onyatá nyā tayínū ipú ɔtū kú um ŋ́, amáŋ n gē ka ɔ̄kā ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī yá ucē okpaakpa lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nāa klla ī tú uwā abɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ipú ójīla kú odúúdú ācɛ kú uwɔ Óndú, ń klá okónu tū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī yá ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi, klla ī yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ eko dóódu lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ɔdā nōó húmáyī ī dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ā yá, anɔ́ɔ ó le yá kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōtayínū nōó tɛtɛ miya táajɛ ka anúɔ géē yá kwɛyí nɛ̄ alɔ í jé gbɔbū ŋ́ mā mafú lɛ alɔ ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ nɛ̄ a má lɛyíkwu ɛya ō gwó kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nēé ka ɛyí nū ga uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā géē yá lɛ ā ɔkwɛ̄yi. Amáŋ kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ, ohígbū ka eko nōó géē yá ā, í bá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Ébrahām kahíníī, O ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū, á gaá hī ɔnyā uwɔ ka Usárāyi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ iyē nū í wɛ Usára.

eng_Latn: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n nwū aá mɛ́mla ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna kú nū lɛ aá ā, ń bī ɛlā o jé ō ka mɛ́mla íjééyī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ le yá kú aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, n cɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kú um aá bū ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú ɔfú kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā tū Óndú ā ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka o wúla té kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā nɛ̄. Odúúdú aájɛ idɔ kú ɛcɛ nyā ā í gbɛnú ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka úmlá ā tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD, that were valiant men:
idu_Latn: Asárīya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ofɛnɛ ɔhá ā le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ lɛ ádā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā nɛɛ? Kɛɛ keé ma ébú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ma ayí āa?.

eng_Latn: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́kplá kú nū, Ámram ā wɛ ádā kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni á. Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ā bá ī yúklɔ́ kú ɔdā otīihɔ piyóó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. É géē gwɛ́ɛya klla í yi ɔtulali ɔlá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, klla í yɔ̄ í hɔ́hā ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bī iyē kú Óndú ā eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kóō le hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá abālɔbányā kú ālɔ̄ má ɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ géē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū! Ācɛ ɛpa nēé nyɔ́kpá mla anú ā kōō cá ɔ̄ ɛcá dúú.

eng_Latn: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā nyā lɛ Ujeremíya kóō ka lɛyíkwu Ubábīlɔn, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá piíí ɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yúklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔwɛ kú íjééyī nwū uwɔ ɛɛ́. N lɛ uwɔ bī bū ɔwɛ oyēŋēē mɛ́mla okpaakpa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Da alɔ, abɔ̄ a yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a tá odúúdú ɛlā nyā tū ɔkpá lɛ ā a? Ujeremíya ka gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a tá ɔ́ tū ɔkpá á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí igwáahātá nɛ̄ Ujosíya lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó lɛ ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpá kú únɛ́pɔ̄, Ussafán, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Asálīya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Umesúlam tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
idu_Latn: Kú odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā kóō lɔfú lɔhi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ōfūnū lɔfú yá kú aá yá ɛ̄nyā glá á, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ kéē lɔfú lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō, kéē klla cɛ̄tra iyē nū.

eng_Latn: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
idu_Latn: Ó le iyɔ̄lā gbo ɔtú, ó le héyī. Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ gicō gaajɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ɛplá eko nyā īkpō ā le bū yɔ̄ gē jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Nááná o jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īkpō ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó bū klla yɔ̄ gē jɛ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n cē igbō lɛ ācɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ceofigwó ā, ómbili omōomu kú iwili nōo hile ā ɛmulá nɛ̄ aá túbá ŋmá ajɛ ā? É da ɔ́ ka igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ kɔ́ ɔ̄ kwú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó ga Ujerúsālɛm, kɔ́ ɔ̄ gaá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā túgwó ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ aá bá ī tá Ádā ā ahínyá, nōo yá ká aá le cíkā ō lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú úgwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe lā ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
idu_Latn: Ása ma Ujehósāfati, Ujehósāfati ma Ujóram, Ujóram kē ma Osíya.

eng_Latn: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujéhu yɔ̄ í bēé igá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, ó da Ujéhu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa wā amānyā a, awɔ Usímīri, ɔ̄cɛ oŋmó ɔkpani nū.

eng_Latn: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɛga je lɛ uwa kéē nyɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tū ipú aókóome ā á. Abɔ̄ é le pɛ tū ipú aókóome ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔwá kú aókóome ā nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ulá igwó ā le kwu ga ɛháajɛ ɛfu gaá le pɛ́ tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́, ń tíne ō kpó aá ŋmó bónū ámāŋ je igelī nɛ̄hi nyā yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé pīyɛyí, é géē kpó odúúdú aójibó kú aɛ́cí nēé gē ma ā bónū.

eng_Latn: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā uwá kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú gáā tá lɛ ɔ̄, amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le kwu tayínū, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ úlā ofɛtá kú uwá kpó tū úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā géē bá ī tá ɔkpá tū ajɛ, klla í bá ī hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōlé ā kú ɔ̄ lɛ ɛga kú ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ā ú bī wā.

eng_Latn: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
idu_Latn: N géē je gbīhi cēkwu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aólɛlā kú aá kóō lɛ aá yálé. Ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū aá ā gáā gbō aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ ā á. Aá géē yúúfi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá géē yɔ̄ ī kwinya nááná nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í nū aá inya ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ éyi kú aótɛ̄hɔ̄ úlúúlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo gē tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ ā, nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā, jɛ̄ ō ma ɔdā nōó cíkā ō yá fú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é kahíníī, Ó híīī wɛ eko ucɛ ā ŋ́ ohígbū nɛ̄ ācɛ géē cīlɛ̄fú.

eng_Latn: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
idu_Latn: É géē wɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nōo lɔfú ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, é klla gáā lɔfú gbō aéwɔhá dúúmā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē je uwá yá ɔplɛ́ca nēé klla gáā lɔfú dúúmā da éwɔhá ɔdā dúúmā ō yá glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kwú tū ŋmá ō kwu hɛ̄ anúɔ tá, mɛ́mla ō je īyī uwā iyē tēelihɔ mla ɔbíipú kú uwá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwá ká ɛ̄ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, ka anúɔ kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá. Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ojuju tū ka aá géē wā í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ útú hɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔbá ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú aádáádā uwā Umanásɛ, ɔyí kú Ujósɛ̄fu, anɔ́ɔ ajɛ kú uwā yɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú ádā uwā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And said, My LORD, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Óndú um, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā kú um he aá ɔtū, aá híī gla ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ aá í gáā māháyi ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aéwo ā tútū kéē kpɛ́fú tā ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. Lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umédīya, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú aéwo nɛ̄ uwā í gbō ā.

eng_Latn: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cokónu ka alɔ géē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí nɔ̄nyā nēé hī ka Ɔcányā kú ɔkpáncō ā, klla géē lɛ ejé fu ajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ kē gáā yá á. Alɔ géē lɛ ɔtulālī kwu ɔlá lɛ ɔ́ klla í le ejé fu ajɛ lɛ ɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú alɔ, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ gē yá eko nɛ̄ alɔ lā aígelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ gē lɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi, ó gē lɔhi lɛ alɔ, alɔ í klla lɛ unwalu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Ɛlísa, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí ɔhá kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ufilístiya wā í kpɛ́fú tá Ísrɛ̄lu nɛɛ, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū gē yá uwā lé fíyɛ́ eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí ohile kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usɔ́lu mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gē kpɛ́fú ā. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā Udéfīdi gbɔɔ́ ō lóofu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē gbɔbū lɛ uwá. Anú abɔ̄yī nū ɔ́ɔ géē nuunu lɛ uwá á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó nuunu lɛ uwá, Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā kē bá pī alɔ amānyā. Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ā ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ cíkā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ alɔ pó ā lɔɔlɔhi á, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dúú kóō je alɔ ɔtū ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛcɔ̄ túbá, Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ tīkwū bá á. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdōlé lé, ɛga nēé tú ɛcɔ̄ bá āa.

eng_Latn: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
idu_Latn: Ōhī kú aálelékwū nēe bá ɔkpáncō nēé hī ka ayí kú Ɔwɔicō ā, le má ka ayínɔ̄nyā kú alɛɛcɛ ā héyīfuú, é le pɛ́ wā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ aɛ́nɛ̄ o he uwá ɔtū ā ɔnyā.

eng_Latn: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔnyā ā yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ gé lɛ ɔ́ ā, ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ igbō amáŋ ka ɔdōlé dúúmā bī bá éŋkpɔ̄ ā gē um dúú.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
idu_Latn: Bōōbū nɛ̄ Ujeremíya lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kó ō ka lɛ ācɛ ā ka mɛ ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā gāá lɛ ɔ́ kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, A géē kwú piíí!.

eng_Latn: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ojéeyī gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū eko ɔnɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔyí nōo gē gbiyɔ̄lā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú ɔcí omīya ajɛ kú nū ā ú lɛ umíta ulā ce ofɛhɔ̄ mīya lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Ó lɛ um bī bū ipú ɔkpá ā abɔ́ɔ. Éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú um oŋmíkpālī.

eng_Latn: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, N géē lɛ abɔ̄ bī aá lɔfú, kú aá lɛyítáajɛ gā um, ipú okónu nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla aá ce lɛ iyī alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo hile nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā wɛ ɔyí nū ékpónú nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā. Igbīhāajɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú abɔ̄yīnū tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí aólufa ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka, anúɔ jé ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ ojīlīmā cē ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kɛlā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ó klla ī yá ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ōwē í lɛ abɔ̄ da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ. Ó géē yá abɔ̄ dóódu cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú íne kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō gē bī le gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā í pīyabɔ̄. Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō kē ī bá ɛháajɛ ɔfú kú nū iháyí ɛtá ce ɔyā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē kú aá tá Óndú ā ahínyá, aá gwō ɛ̄ngwū lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Uhósīī, ɔyí kú Ɛlā lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔyí kú Áhāsi le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé.

eng_Latn: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm klla le ɛfú kpó wā í gwū ācɛ kú Ujúda klla le ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā kpó kwú bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā ga Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé yá nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ Ukússan-rissátém, ɔcɛ́ kú Umɛsopotámīya kóō lɛ uwá yálé á. É bá ɛháajɛ nū iháyí ahātá.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Abíssāyi mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ka ɔyí abɔ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gē tíne ō ŋmó anúɔ yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ má. Ó lɛ ā ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Ubénjāmin nyā yá ā ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō hɛ́ uwā idáagó ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cá anúɔ ɛcá á, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ mā ɔ̄ tá ká ɔ̄ cá anúɔ ɛcá á.

eng_Latn: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ubálāki ā, ó má ka ó háyi ɛgiyí ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú nū ā kpɔ́, mla odúúdu anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, É géē je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ tū ācobīyaíne kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄, é géē je ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá é géē je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n má gwutá ka n gbīyɔ̄lā nɛɛ, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka otú ā klla kwú līkpō tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ā. N gē yɔ̄ ī pīya kpánákpáná yɔ̄ ī gbēyī eyōōnya, yɔ̄ ī gbɛlā ka eko nyá nɛ̄ eyī géē nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
idu_Latn: Ujóram da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ úgbɔ́ɔnya kú um tútū ga um. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ tútū á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram mɛ́mla Ahasíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ í jīla anú ɔwɛ. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá bī úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá jīla Ujéhu ɔwɛ ipú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú Unábɔ̄tu á.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɛdɔ ɔwɔ dóódu kú ācɛ nēe lā kwu uwá ā, é híī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā gā um igbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó ka anúɔ géē nuunu tá ūwā bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ ā, ka anúɔ géē kwāajɛ ɔwɛ gbēyī ūwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ayínɛ́ ohumɔtū, aá he um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, abɔ̄ aá kwú um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Aá yá ká n̄ gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, n kē ī bī aá gwō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi! Oŋmá odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka, ayínɛ́ ohumɔtū, aá cɛ̄ lɛ agbafú gbo aá ŋ́, aá háyi kpaakpa lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛlā obɔ̄bí ka lɛyíkwu ami nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā, é lɔfú je yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛhi glá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛlā obɔ̄bí ka lɛyíkwu Alelékwū Ihɔ, é gáā je yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
idu_Latn: Ɛlam yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, aúnóji kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ nū kē yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá biílí. Ɛfú lé odúúdú uwá dúú á. Uwá í wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ jāā gbéeko nēé ga ɔlékwū. Éko nēé yēeyī ā, é tɛtɛ gē tū ācɛ ufi ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Amáŋ ícɛ nyā, é gekwú uwēyī kē lɛ uwā kwú ɔlékwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó má ācɛ alɛwa kú aɔ́wá nēé hī ka Ufárisīi mɛ́mla Usádusīi bá ī wā kóō yá uwá Ubaptísim ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá, ugbɛ kú ogwijii, ɔ̄nyɛ da aá ka aá kwu hɛ̄ ícɔ̄nū nōo gē wā ā tá āa?.

eng_Latn: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó dɔɔ̄kā ō fūla anú nɛɛ, ó géē lɛ ije ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛyí ɔ́lá nū.

eng_Latn: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
idu_Latn: N má ka íjééyī lɔhi fíyɛ́ íla á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá ofíyajɛ lɔhi fíyɛ́ obū ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyá nɛ̄ ádā anúɔ yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá yɔ̄ á. Ó ka é má abɔ̄ eyī ɔ́ɔ gbo anúɔ gɔɔ, abɔ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɛnwú lé ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka anúɔ klla le lɔfú fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe tá uwā igbīhi bá í tá opo ā bá yɔ̄ á: Asaríya, Ɛ́sra, Umessúllam.

eng_Latn: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
idu_Latn: Omiya kú abɔ̄ ɛnɛ kú ɛyí ede ā jóonjilɛ̄. É wɛ umíta ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
idu_Latn: Urémɛ̄ti, Ɛnganim, Ɛnháda mɛ́mla Ubɛtipássɛ̄si.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a géē wɛ ijáalí kú nū ká ā ka lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔdā nāa má, nāa kē pó ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ɔ̄cɛ; ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā í lɛ ilē dúúmā gā um ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka o ímíyóŋjō kú oje, udɔ, ugóolu , mla oje nɛhɛ nēé gē mā ɔ̄ tá bá ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
idu_Latn: A gē gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā le yēŋēē ā. Amáŋ a gē gbūula tū ācɛ igbájí ā.

eng_Latn: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
idu_Latn: Uféro lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú kú nū mɛ́mla aíjɔ́ɔja kú nū tútū.

eng_Latn: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄ bá mla anú lɛ eyī pīya kwu odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ái ā. É lɛ ádɛ́fú kú uwá gwó ɛhícō kú ajɛ ā abɔ́ɔ, ɔpɛ́ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ uwá mla ācɛ kú Ái.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔ́ɔmā í cābɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē ba í lé ɔdōlé nōo le nyílá, ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ n gáā nū uwá nyɔ̄ ipú uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā le nyílá, ó géē tēelihɔ kú nū ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, géē je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aódée kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn yá bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā í tōō mīyɛ ogbɛnú kú uwā ŋ́. Aódée ɔ́ɔmā wɛ aúpíla ɛpa ā, okpómōlóolo ole éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú oje udɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nēe bī ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā olɛ akā nēé ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ ce ā.

eng_Latn: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu tá Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā, é kwú pīya aólɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ ɛ̄nyā kwú pīya ɔdā nōo tá aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā abɔ̄. Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu, ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu kpɔ́ ohígbū okónu nōó ce lɛ aádáádā uwā ka anúɔ í wɛ oklóbīya uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ, Óndú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á, cɛ̄pɔ̄ um ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā. Lɛ um hɛ́tá, ohígbū ihɔtū nāa ī mafú eko dóódu ā mla olɔhi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ɔyí kú ɔnyōkwū, nōo yɔ̄ í lɛ ɛlá kwu Ɛláyíja ā, gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē. Ó doōcē ā jāā gbéeko nōó gekwú.

eng_Latn: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á. Ɛga dóódu nōo kwu ɔ́ yɛ jīla tá biílí icō kú ɛfu wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, ó cɛgbá kú ālɔ̄ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū aá eko dóódu. Ahínyá nɛ̄ alɔ tá aá nyā le kpaakpa, ohígbū ka aá yɔ̄ ī lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá gē yíhɔtū tá iyī aá ā klla yɔ̄ ī lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla le Usámūwɛ̄lu hīgwú igbo ɔ́mɛtá. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla cāŋjɛ kpɔ́ le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Ɛ́lāyi gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, awɔ kē hī um igwú á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́lāyi le jé ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í hī ɔyí ā igwú á.

eng_Latn: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɔcɛ́ ō hɛ́pɔ̄ újí fu, kóō hɛ́pɔ̄ kú olɛlā kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká olɛlā kú anú abɔ̄yīnū éyi kóō lɛ ɛlā kpó ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwu cālɛ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ é gbo iyāwu kú uwā ŋmá ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi á. Ojuja ā wā í klá ajɛ ígbíli kú Upáran.

eng_Latn: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ géē yá kú ācɛ nēe pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá kéē yúúfi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ gáā cé yá ucē ɔ́bíipú ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa le odúúdú ācokpɔ́cíkpɔ́cí dóódu kú Ujúda ā kpó ga Ubábīlɔn. Ɛwa kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ó kpó nyɔ̄ ā wɛ úlā ofu, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ o yúklábɔ̄ kē wɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó, aónɔwá nēe wɛ ācɛ o lɔfú ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá.

eng_Latn: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa piyóó. Ó gáā mlanyī úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá yá lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ma ihɔtū nɛ̄ aá lɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā fú ipú o tá ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá aɔ́mpa aá abɔ̄, nɛ̄ aá klla yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ uwá kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.
idu_Latn: É kwú okwū kú Ábsālɔm ú tá ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ éyi ipu ūpū, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ tīkwū klá anú á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohile le pɛ́ kwu le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ánatōtu wɛ ofu ɛhīlī ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu nēe wā Íjīpiti mɛ́mla anú ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā wā mla aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
idu_Latn: N tá uwā ohi ka alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ Uróm ā í gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nēé kpó ɛlā ce ɔ́ ā ɛpɔ̄bí gbɔbū kú ālɔ̄ jɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō leyī mééyī mla ācɛ nēe kpó ɛlā ce ɔ́ ā kóō kɔkɔ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: É bī owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔwā le aɔ́dōwīyē ohéyīfuú nɛ̄hi gɔ́ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ɛ̄nɛ̄ é géē lɛ wiiyē eko nēé gē yúklɔ́ ɛga otīihɔ ā. É le aɔ́dōwīyē gɔ́ lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cābɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Udímina, mɛ́mla Unahála, mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɔ́daajɛ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, odúúdú aéwo ā, ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā, kéē pó ocɛ̄tra nāa ī cɛ̄tra ɔ́ ā ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
idu_Latn: Á le ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛcá kú uwɔ mafu ga uwɔ ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Á klla cɛ̄ ka anúɔ í gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gē fu otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ŋmá ipú ācɛ ā kéē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kwɛyí ācɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō kwɛyí ācɛ ā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé, ká ā klla kē lɛyí nū jé. Oŋmééko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da kéē lɛ Ujerúsālɛm túgwó igbɔhá ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā géē wā ā, iháyí ahāapa bá ɛga ahāapa géē wā í gla. É klla í tá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla úláyi kú nū gwó igbɔhá kpɔ́, é klla í hɛ́ igá olɔfú jīla anú tá. Ó géē yɔ̄ iháyí ofɛtá cahāapa, amáŋ eko nyā géē wɛ eko kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ɛɛ́. Ádā uwɔ kē lɛ ɛna ojɔ̄kwū ā ŋmó ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayí nēé ma ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má nōó lɔhi lɛ uwá fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe kwú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe yēeyī á. Ohígbū ka uwá nēé wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, í má ɔdōbɔ̄bī nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō dā Ɛláyíja kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā le ɛga je lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu māháyi icō agidigbé ā le abɔ̄ yá lɛ ācɛ ā pɛɛ. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ odúúdú uwā mā uya ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ uwá ɔkɔ kú ucē kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N húmáyī yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ, amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwúcē ŋmā ɛka nɛ̄ awɔ Óndú ā gbo mla uwá ā. É klla le ede kú awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā catāajɛ. É bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā kpó ŋmó. Ami ōfōōfū um nōo hile ā, é kē yɔ̄ ī tíne ō je um ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
idu_Latn: Kwu ísu mɛ́mla ajɛ nɛ̄ ó yá ā, anú gē gbō uwā á.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū wɛ ocíbú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó. Ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nū wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
idu_Latn: N géē tū aá nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá ā ufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá í kwinya eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkɛ̄lā kú ēpū nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ŋmáajɛ pó. Aá géē kwinya bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī nū aá inyā ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Aá kē í gwōnū nááná nɛ̄ olɛlā dóódu í kōō túbla aá ajaajɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā lɛ aá nyatá, aá le nyatá ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ wɛ unwalu kú nū āa? Ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ má ɔ̄ ka anúɔ wɛ ɔnyōkwū, ka ɔbá anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí nōo gboce Éhūdu ā wɛ Ussámga, ɔyí kú Ánāti. Anú ā hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá á. Ó yá lɛ ā ŋmá lɛ ō bī ɔcí pílóó, nēé ī bī le kwu ɛna kóō yāwu ā, le ŋmó ācɛ ula ce ofigwó kú ācɛ Ufílistiya.

eng_Latn: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú ma ayí ofɛhɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó lɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ, ó lɔfú yēeyī gbéeko nōó le gbo ókplícī. Ɔ́dāŋ nōó má ukpɛ̄ kú éeyē kú nū ŋ́, nɛ̄ ayí ā í nyi ɔ́ okwū kú ojīlīmā ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā, n ka ɔyí obene nēé ma nōo gekwú ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ofu ce éyi kú ɔyā ahāapa kú iháyí ɔ́mpa kú eko nɛ̄ Udárīyɔsi wā í cɔcɛ́ ā. Óndú ā le ɛlā ɔhá ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́, Uhágāyi kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā ga ɔ́ ā wɛ ajɛ kú aɛ́fu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́. Ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē yā anú eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu tóohi kahíníī, Óndú um, a jé ka ayípɛ̄ ā í lɔfú iyē lɛ ā ŋ́, n klla kē ī gbɛlá kwu aálá, mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ uwá pikpaa kú iyāwu ō yɛ ligbó ɛcī ékpónú ōfōōfūnū, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɛ́bɛ́ ā géē je pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɔnyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā bī odo kú uwɔ ga ɔwɛ kú nū ŋ́. Ā híī yɛce ɔ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa ī tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu tɔlɔ́tɔlɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
idu_Latn: Je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ba uwɔ odée āa. Á híīī nyí ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne kóō kplá ɔdā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le bīya gā um eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔdā nēé yá ācɛnyā kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā má ā.

eng_Latn: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē kú um kwú tóóbí fiyuu yɔ̄ ī fō bónū, iyē kú um klla le kwɔ́lá gbáyíí ā.

eng_Latn: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
idu_Latn: Uwá lɛ Úklɔ́ kú ɔcí dóódu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á. Ɔcí ō kwaajɛ, ɔcí ō gba ɔlɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔcí aflá kú nū. Úklɔ́ dóódu nōo lɛ iyē kwu āyā ɛ̄nyā wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Utáya, anɔ́ɔ ó le bū ipú Usídɔn, bū ipú ajɛ kú aɔ́lɛ́ igwó, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá óókpóo kú Ugálīli á.

eng_Latn: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í je iyī nū tū ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí igbɔhá lɛ Óndú ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó gáā ka eko kú aflɛ́yí ā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū kaó le iyē nyíilá. Ó géē bī omlede kú iháyí éyi wā kú ɛya nēé í gwó kú ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ó lé ā.

eng_Latn: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
idu_Latn: Ānyɛ ā, kē wɛ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? É wɛ aálelékwū nēe ī cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄ nōó kē tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē tá ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í nyatá ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ nēe kpéyīce Óndú ā, ó gē lɔfú ɛyīpɛ̄ tū uwá iyē eko dóódu. É géē wu bɛ̄ɛka idu ā. É géē kwinya, ɛ̄jɛ̄ í gāa jɛ̄ uwá ŋ́. É géē yāwu, ikpó í gāa gbogbwú lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
idu_Latn: Umánōwa cāŋjɛ le yɛce ɔnyā nū ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kɛlā lɛ ɔnyā anúɔ á nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ ka anúɔ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ gē lé ɔdōlé gē nū ipú ā, klla gē yúklɔ́ ɔgwū ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ tɛtɛ gē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, ɛmiyɛ í ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔnyā nōo wɛ ɔdɔma ā, le ayí ahāapa ma ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɛ́nɛ́ kú ayí alɛwa tɛtɛ ā, í lɛ odúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō í ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ŋ́, ó kē wɛ aá ōfōōfu aá mīyɛ ɛlā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
idu_Latn: O nwula ɛlā kú uwɔ nāa gē nwū um ā kóō tú um eyī péee. Ó klla gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī jɛ́yí odée péee ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá ī fíyajɛ ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ péee ā. Ó klla gē je ogwuda pīya ojééyī.

eng_Latn: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, ācɛ nēe bá ī yá um ɛbɛ́ ā wɛ ɛnɛ̄ńcɛ́ kú um. Ācɛ nɛ̄ aádā uwā wɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu, nɛ̄ n gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá tá aéwō kú um abɔ̄ gbō aálá gā um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā le uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú īyī uwā, mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ ā yá. É le ákú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú okónɔɔwɛ kú nū ú kpó yá dúú.

eng_Latn: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā gē lɛ agbénú odúúdú oyēeyī kú uwā. É klla ī kwú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka awɔ Ɔwɔicō, le okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā pó ɛɛ́. A kē le ɔdā nōo wɛ úgwū kú ācɛ nēe gē yúufi uwɔ ā je gā um ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
idu_Latn: Aíne nēé je lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́, é wɛ ofu kú ɔdā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā. Ɛdɔ kú ɛya ékpó ā nēé gē gwó piyóó á, oŋmá iháyí éyi ga iháyí ɔhá. Amáŋ ó gwu ācɛ nēe ī wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā iyē kpaakpa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔcɛ́, mīyɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gaá nwū uwɔ nyā ā. Mā íne nɛ̄ a gē bīya ā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lā oyēeyī olɔhi mɛ́mla oyēeyī okpaakpa. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ményīnyi kú aógbɛhá, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē yɔ̄ ī gɔbū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ācɛ ā dúú kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ojuja má yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄,obōōbū aá í ka ka ɔwɔ gáā yā ɛɛ́. Ó kē ī yā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
idu_Latn: Ujúda da ayínɛ́ nū ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdī wɛ itene nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɛ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ ɔyínɛ́ alɔ ŋmó kwú tayínū āa?.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! ami, Upɔ́lu da aá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ aá apī hɛ́, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá í tīile lɛ aá fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, N hɔ́hā ce Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo yá ka ɔyí um éyi kóō mīyɛ ɔkwu ɔcɛ́ kú um ícɛ nyā, ipéyī um ā.

eng_Latn: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄ je ɔ́da kéē habɔ̄ ikpaŋkini kú nū tá kwaajɛ ā. Ɛ̄nya cābɔ̄ ka a géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ a lɛ Ɔwɔicō jéjúma ka anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō ā gē gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
idu_Latn: É bá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du gekwú. Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛlā kú Óndú ā, nōó ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi ā kóō le yá jīla. Ó kahíníī, N hī ɔyí um igwú ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcɛ́, Ubatisséba da Usólómɔ̄n, ɔyí nū nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú Abíssāgi, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ussúnem ā ú le Adónīja, ɔyínɛ́ nū cɛ́ɛ́ kóó kwú pīya ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ulɛ́ya tá Ujékɔ̄pu ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í lɛ ukpɛ̄ dúú ɔlɛ́ ádā alɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ó géē he ācɛ ɔtū, é géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ klla géē wafa lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
idu_Latn: Alɔ pó ka a yɔ̄ í wá aálá kú uwɔ ɔnwū. Eko nɛ̄ ācogbāálá kú uwɔ̄ húmáyī klá mla alɔ ā, alɔ í yá uwá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ álá kú uwá dúúmā gē bī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ eyī gwō uwɔ bónū, klla í pīya īmū klá awɔ, a géē je pīya ɛbɛ ohéyī lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe yúklɔ́ ā, wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā le yēŋēē, nēe yúklɔ́ kpaakpa ɔwɛ nōo cíkā ā. Ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe leyīkwu úklɔ́ ā wɛ Ujáhāti mɛ́mla Obadáya, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri, Usekaríya mɛ́mla Uméssūlam ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhati gē leyīkwu ācoyúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ō gílayá ā á. .

eng_Latn: Give us this day our daily bread.
idu_Latn: Je ɔdōlé nɛ̄ alɔ cɛgbá ɛ̄cī nyā ā lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
idu_Latn: N gēe je ācɛ kú Asírīya kpó ŋmó, je uwá kpó yá ífi ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. N klá í lɛ ikpō da uwá ɛyí bá ajɛ, ɛyí ɛfú kú um. N gēe hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá ŋmá agbá mla iyó mla ákanya nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asírīya gbō ce uwá a.

eng_Latn: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ohe um ɔtū, ā híī gbla ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ŋ́, amáŋ gbla ɔdā olɔhi yá. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdā olɔhi wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí í má Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ō plla aá, nɛ̄ Uhɛ́sɛkíya gē plla aá kú ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēnyi kóō lɛ aá kpó ŋmó bónū ā ŋ́ nɛɛ. Ó gē da aá ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ígwu kú ācɛ o bī iyɔ́fú nēe ŋmá Ubábīlɔn, Usírīya, Umówābu mɛ́mla Ámɔn kpó tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ujúda, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka bū okónu kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ka ánúɔ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí nēé hɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ gē lɛ ōhī kú nū kpó gwɔ́ɔ́lá kéē jɛ̄ ámāŋ kéē le yá ɔdōlé. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ōhī kú ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā piíí ú le ɛcí gbā klla gbɔɔ́ ō pā ɔ̄. É bī ɔcí ā le ojíbó gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ é túkpɛɛ́ gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
idu_Latn: Ó klla géē cɛ̄ gā awɔ yá ucē ɔwɛ olɔhi, ó klla í gbō uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bī ōhī kú oyī kú ɛna ā ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
idu_Latn: ífílīmīródāki le ojīlīmā ce ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le āhɔ̄ kú ojīlīmā je lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá nēe bá ajɛ ɔfiyɛ Ubábīlɔn, ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ɛ́nɔ̄ss le pīya iháyí ofu ɛnɛ cigwó ā, ó lɛ ɔyīnɔ̄nyilɔ éyi lɛ nōó hī ka Ukɛnán.

eng_Latn: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
idu_Latn: N jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā bɔ̄bí lɛ ā. N kē klla jé áluka ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā. Aá gē mīyɛ ómíci, gē kɛpɔ̄ újí tū ācɛ ogbɛhá, cɛ́ɛ́ aógbɛhá ā í gáā lɛpɔ̄hi únɛ́pɔ̄ kú aá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
idu_Latn: N kē da uwɔ ka a wɛ Upíta. Ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nyā nɛ̄ n kē í gwó icɔ́ɔci kú um ce á. Ɔfú kú ikwū í kē gáā yá ɔ̄ lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm italā, n géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ ojéeyī kú uwá ā yíífi, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā jéeyī ipú uwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Ándrɔníkɔ̄si mɛ́mla Ujúnīyasi, ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ɔ́mpa um nōo yɔ̄ agbá mla um. Uwá wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ eyī jé lɔɔlɔhi ɔtāhɛ̄ acotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, uwá kē je pīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá gbɔbū gā um á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
idu_Latn: Kɛlā kú um lɛ uwá kpɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka é po, amáŋ ka é tá ká é pó nááná. A kē jé ká é wɛ ācɛ nēe gē yīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú.

eng_Latn: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ubákosi mɛ́mla Usísɛ̄ra mɛ́mla Utéma.

eng_Latn: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le ɛlā kú nū pó ā, é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɛ́ alɔ, a lɔfú jé úlúúlā kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe je pīya ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā, ā kē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú uwā í bī Íne ā le hiijā ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábáti dóódu, Árɔ̄ni géē kpó igbō ā bá ɛyí utébulu iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā piyóó, kwɛyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ɛka nōo yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
idu_Latn: É í jɛ̄ gicō lɔɔlɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ácí kú ɔgwā ā. Ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo bū kwu okónu ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ɛ̄nyā má ā, ó le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ ó tá ayí nū nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ á.

eng_Latn: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī le gla ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwu Upíta mla Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni ú, le yɛ tá ɛfu olicō éyi, ɛga nēé bá ofōōfūwā cíí. Abɔ̄ é bá abɔ́ɔ ā, iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si kwú pīyabɔ̄ ipéeyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
idu_Latn: Aá le ɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó ka lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā pó ɛɛ́. Ɔdí wɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī hɛ́ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ ā? Odúúdú uwā cɛ̄ tɔ̄há lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí anɔ́ɔ é kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ gē da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú uíne kú nú. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔtú, mɛ́mla odo kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ádáádā aá, Ébrahām mɛ́mla Usɛ́ra, nēe ma aá ā. Eko nɛ̄ n hī Ébrahām igwú ā, ó lɛ ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ n le ɔdā olɔhi yá lɛ ɔ́, klla lɛ ayí alɛwa kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá da uwá kahíníi, N yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ń má ɛga ga abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nóó. Ń gáā ma úklɔ́ ā tá wā í má aá glá nóó.

eng_Latn: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le má ka ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ɔ́ɔ héyīfuú nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ihɔtū kú nū ú bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔkɔ olɔnyɛ le ɛlā da ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And they said, If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel, send it not empty; but in any wise return him a trespass offering: then ye shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.
idu_Latn: É tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā ohi kahíníī Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú ikpati okónu ōce kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú cīgbīhi, aá géē je ɔ́ cīgbīhi mla ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā nēe géē cíla ulé kú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā piíí. Aá híī je ɔ́ cīgbīhi abɔ̄ áncā, nɛ̄ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā í gáā bula anú nyɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ ka ā yá, ōcē kú aá géē mɛ, aá í jé ɔkwu ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yá aá italā á.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, A géē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ, kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Íssmɛ̄lu, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ōwē nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī má ā jé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú ubáalu ā ka abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛwa ā, ɛ́ɛ kwú ɛna éyi ú gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ wā kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó ce ɛyí ɛfú ā. Ó da uwá kéē hɛ́ ɔlá kwu ɛfú ā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hī iyē kú ɔwɔ kú uwā kóō lɛ ɔlá tū wā í kwú ɛbɛ́ ā ú kpó yi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le yá kéē bá ɛbɔ́ ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ aádáádā uwá lɛ ā. Aólɛlā kú uwá ékpónú í lɔfú háyi iyɔ̄bū uwā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō nwuné lɛ ā! Íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōojé kú Ɔwɔicō ī mɛ glá ŋ́! Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í jɛ́yí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī miya ɛlā kú nū ŋ́! Ɔ̄nyɛ jɛ́yí ɔwɛ nōó ī yá odée kú nū ā?.

eng_Latn: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: ó ka anúɔ í je ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ anúɔ aflɛ́yí wā í jīla anúɔ ɔwɛ, eko nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú lɛ ācɛ Ámɔn yálé ā, ka anúɔ géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
idu_Latn: É le lé klla lɛ ipú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā le iwili ā túbá á. É kē le mu ómblí ahāapa.

eng_Latn: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ kéē le jé ka Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū, ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ka ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú ɔ́ɔ́ yɔ̄ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
idu_Latn: bɛ̄ɛka ukpa nōo ī kwú ɛbɛ́ ā. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī ā géē wā í ce odúúdú ācɛ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē yá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā okónu eko dóódu, gē leyī gwū ɛlā kú uwā ā bónū klla í yɛhɛ tū uwā jāā gbéeko nēé cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla uwá nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ é má ɛga ō kwu nyɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ícɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ɔnū kú Óndú ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ɔkpani n lɛ ɔ́da kú uwɔ ā yá jila ɛɛ́ n. Amáŋ ɛga yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: Rejoice evermore.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā gbɔɔ́ ō táafu mla iyī uwā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄nyɛ kú ipú uwā nɛ̄ ācɛ cíkā o ka ká anú ɔ́ɔ cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛcí nōó gbɔɔ́ ō pā ā í bɔ̄bí tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, ó gaá le odúúdú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Ó kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú gwu klla le ede kú ɛcí kpó ma kwaajɛ ɛga dóódu kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í nyɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē yá kú ācɛ ā kéē yúúfi uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā fū uwā iyē glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdōlé kpó wā kéē lé, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N gaá lé ɔdōlé ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔkwu iyāwu kú um ā ka lɛ aá. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ka mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kā a le yēŋēē klla ī yá ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi, Ɔwɔicō géē cāŋjɛ wā í tá uwɔ abɔ̄, klla í je odúúdú agbénú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú uwɔ ā kwúcē gā awɔ, kóō wɛ ulé kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya kahíníī, Ācɛ kú ɔkpáncō, aá tɔ́ɔga, ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ kóō gwéeyē! Ɔkɔ kú ijē nēé yɔ̄ ī gwó ā kóō ce ɛyí aɛ́fu gbōō. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā móōwē nɛ̄hi. Ó kē le eyinyinyi uwā má klla le uwá ɔtū túlé dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā da uwá kéē yá ā, ka é le ɔ́ yá ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú nū.

eng_Latn: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā, é géē je ōhī kú uwá kpó ga ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn abɔ̄fú klla í je uwá kpó búdá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Ábīja lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛpa ce úlā ofu igwó kpó, anɔ́ɔ Ujérobōwam kē le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛhɔ̄ kpó dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́hōhasi le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó gbā ā pó á, ohígbū ka, ó le ɔdōbɔ̄bí mla ucē kú ɔbíipú nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usiríya bá gē yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́tin kú eyīpú mɛ́mla eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú nū biílí ā mɛ́mla ɛyí ede, mɛ́mla úklɔ́ dóódu nōo liyē kwu āyā ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
idu_Latn: É le um yɛ jīla tá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnwú gē kɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ í yɛjīla ɔ́ tá ā, é kwú yɔlá bɛ̄ɛka ácí ugba ā. N le uwá kpó yíífi o ŋmá ɔfú kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó le ifu nɛ̄ aálagbá ā bá ī tá ā pó á. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ācɛ nēé ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó ā hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ ā tá kéē jahɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu ka lɛ uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ehée. Amáŋ alɔ tíne ɔcɛ́ nōo géē gbō alɔ.

eng_Latn: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi ɔhá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá alɛɛcɛ ā, wɛ o bá ī lé, mɛ́mla o klla bá ī gwá, klla bā ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī ipú odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ūwā nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī yúklɔ́ kú aá dóódu ŋ́. Amáŋ aá le jīla kú aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ aá lā ipú ɛcɛ ā, ipɔ́ɔma kú aá dóódu géē lɛ íne nyā tū ogbóógbóō ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā ú háyi ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, lɛ eyī pīyakwu utébulu ā.

eng_Latn: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oklóbīya ɔ́ɔmā da ɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpɛ́ɛ́m ɛɛ́. Ɔdí ɔhá klla cɛgbá nɛ̄ n gē yá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ.

eng_Latn: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa ā bī ɔtū ékpó le jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ufílīpu ka ā ohígbū ɔdōcābɔ̄ nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóyākim ma ayí ɛpa, nēe lé ka Ujɛhóyākin mɛ́mla Usedekíya.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē je ɔfú gā um, ó klla ī lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē. Ó kē lɛ um nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king, live for ever.
idu_Latn: É da ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kahíníī, Ágábáidu kóō yēeyī piyóo!.

eng_Latn: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
idu_Latn: Ācogbāálá ā gē jikwū tɛ́ɛcɛ, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī je ácí nɛ̄ aálá kú uwā gē lé ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā ō má ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē kɛlā bū okónu kú um ā lɛ aá. Ohɔ́nyɛtá í kwáahi eko nōó ī yá mla aá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó ma ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū fú ipú aá.

eng_Latn: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, é gáā pó ijē kú ogwúmogwú mɛ́mla ācogwííjē mɛ́mla ācɛ o tá ɔkpancīlē mɛ́mla ācɛ o tá opo ipú uwɔ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. É gáā má ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ dúúmā ipú uwɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā ō gbā ɛgɔ̄ í kē gáā yɔ̄ ipú uwɔ gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā nyā géē wɛ ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú ohútu kú iháyí lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā yíihɔtū tū um ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n yíihɔtū tū aá dúú á. Aá yɔ̄ ī lɛyítáajɛ ga um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yíihɔtū tá aá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka ɔ́ɔ gáā kwú ɛɛ́, igbīhi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gekwú, ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ gáā yɛce anúɔ kpaakpa gɛ ŋ́. Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ géē je ɛka nɛ̄ anúɔ mla uwá gbo ā bīya, géē je mlanyī anúɔ, klla í gbā aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ o pɛ̄ɛcí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīya ajɛ kú uwā ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípōklóbīya ā, Ɔwɔicō wɛ oklóbīya um. Ó kē ī lɛlákwu um.

eng_Latn: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
idu_Latn: Ményinyi alɔ Óndú. Ményinyi alɔ. Ohígbū ka é le uwēyī je lɛ alɔ fíyábɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo bī íwúɔtū gēe yá ācɛ ŋmó, klá í je ōwē nɛ̄hi la éwo dúúmā nōo le yálé a.

eng_Latn: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ alɔ géē bū ga ɛfú nyā ā? Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɛ kú ígbíli kú Ɛ́dɔm ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da ācɛ a ka amáŋ é gáā gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ó tīihɔ, ó gáā je ínoōbīya yá uwā ɛhi áncā ŋ́. Ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ ɔhá búla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā a.

eng_Latn: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Unaómi ā le áncɛ́nyā kú Umówābu ɛpa lɛ ɔnyā. Éyi kú anyā ā lé ka Ɔpa, iyē kú ɔhá ā kē wɛ Urútu. Igbīhi nēé lā Umówābu bɛ̄ɛka iháyí igwó ā.

eng_Latn: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
idu_Latn: Jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī mla ɔnyā o he uwɔ ɔtū nāa lɛ ipú ɛcɛ nōo wɛ áncā nyā ā. Jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú ɛ̄cī dóódu kú ɛcɛ áncā nyā mla ɔnyā uwɔ ā. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā ōfōōfūnū wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ga uwɔ ipú odúúdú úklɔ́ kú uwɔ ipú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Le tá fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Utiyatíra ā ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ īkpēyī kú nū ī cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā, nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū kē ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ nēé ī na ɔlá ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ajɛ kú Usísarīya, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄ bītá ga ajɛ kú Utásɔsi.

eng_Latn: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uráma mɛ́mla Ugéba wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwóléyi ce éyi .

eng_Latn: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ussafán kwú ɔkpá ā ú bī gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ klla le ohi kú úklɔ́ nēé yá ā kpó lɛ ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Alɔ le ɔdā dóódu nāa je ɔ́da ká ālɔ̄ yá ā kpó yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ugríísi, Utúbalu, mɛ́mla Umésēki gē je aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla aíyó nēé yá ŋmá udɔā lá gā awɔ kwɛyí iyó ɔ́sú kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ oŋmá lɛ ō je pīya ɔ̄cɛ nēé tokónu lɛ ɔ́ Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ alɔ fūla ŋmá okónu nɛ̄ Íne ŋmó alɔ ā. Ohígbū keé lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, É lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé lɛ ɔ́ tōlī playi icō ɔcí.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
idu_Latn: Áhāsi wɛ ádā kú Ujɛ́hōda nōo wɛ ádā kú Aleméti, Asmáfɛ̄ti, mɛ́mla Usímri á. Usímri ma Umósa.

eng_Latn: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, á cíkā ō bī ɛlā áncā, nōó lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́ má le táafú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwú oyēeyī kú nū ú tónū o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ā, ó yá ɛ̄nyā ŋmá lɛ ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōó tá ā, igbīhi nōó bī éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá yēŋēē ā.

eng_Latn: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogbɔ̄cí ā lɛ ɔcí hɛ́, lɛ ɔ́ miya klla lɛ ɔgba pi yɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tíne ō gbā ɔ̄ lɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ gbā ojibó kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ohéyīfuú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla kwú ɔ̄ ú hayi ipú inu ikpɛ́cí.

eng_Latn: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú Óndú yɔ̄ mla uwá, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa nēe cɛ̄ ā kwú pīya tá Óndú ā ɔkwu á.

eng_Latn: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
idu_Latn: É je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō nuunu tú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō kóō yá uwā lé. Ɔwɔicō je íkwu lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma dóódu, éwo dóódu, ucē dóódu mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
idu_Latn: Aá yɛ bū okómpinu opíyéké ā bēhé wā ipú oyēeyī, ohígbū ka okómpinu nōo yɛ ga ɔlíkɔtɔ ā lɔwá. Ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga ipú ífi ā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ō yɛ, ācɛ alɛwa kē ī yɛ ɔwɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī nya kóō tú abɔ̄ bī uwɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú alɔ, a kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu alɔ, klla cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ īyī uwā tū yēŋēē ohígbū keé ciikpɔ́nyā jééjé ɛ́ ŋ́. É gē tú Ɔyí álá ɔkwu ɛga dúú nōó nyɔ̄ ā. É lɛ uwá fula ŋmá ipú ācɛ ohile, uwā ā kē wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēé je kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá ā á.

eng_Latn: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ijakī kú uwɔ lɛ um má, le kwu ŋmá ɔwɛ igbo ɛtá. Ɔ́dāŋ kōó kwu ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í le uwɔ ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ n habɔ̄ ijakī ā tá.

eng_Latn: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛ́gɛ́nyā í tɛtɛ yɔ̄ jéjéē ɛɛ́ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó klla gáā yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nuunu lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N géē gwɔ̄ɔ́ci, n géē gwɔ̄ɔ́ci kú ɔdōbɔ́bí nɛ̄ aá yá ā. Ó klla kahíníī, Óndú alɔ géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
idu_Latn: Ó géē gwá ejé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo í je ɔ́ eyī pīya ɔnɔ̄wá yōō, Ayīnu kú nū í je pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ oŋmá lɛ amɛ̄ ɛna ō gwá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá ipú inu gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɛláyíssa ɔkpáni nū, anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nāa nyɔ̄ ā, Ugɛ́hási? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ í ga ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Nááná ācɛ nēe ī kwinya nɛ̄hi ā í kwu glá ŋ́. Aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā í kē gáā wi ŋ́ dúú. É túgagá má gwōnū ɛhícō, kwu ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi ājaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
idu_Latn: Ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu néē tá tū ɔkpá ā wā í klá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó le kwú uwā ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ é dɔɔ̄kā kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le okónu tá lɛ ɔlɛ́ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, amáŋ ó kē le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe le Upɔ́lu bíyē ā lɛ̄ ɔ́ bītá jāā gaajɛ Átɛnsi. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga Uberíya mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu tū kéē le ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti kéē wā í tá anúɔ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
idu_Latn: Ujehowáhāsi wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛtá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm ɔyā ɛtá. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhamútali, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujeremíya nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulíbina ā.

eng_Latn: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla ī gwɛ́bā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā, n géē yá ɛlā nɛhi. Aá klla gáā wɛ ojīleyī kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛɛ́, nēe géē tá iyē kú aá tū ipú aíyē kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́. Aá kē gáā kwūcē ga ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē jé ka ami Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe gē jīla ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, mɛ́mla Afíya ɔyínɛ́ alɔ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla Akípɔ̄si ícɔ́ɔ́ja ɔ́mpa alɔ ipú úklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla lɛ ohumɔtū, amáŋ ó kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le yɛ ɛɛ́. Odo kú um gebí tū um ipú, eko nōó kɛlā ā. N tíne nū, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄ ŋ́, n hī ɔ̄ igwú, amáŋ ó cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā eko nɛ̄ ɔbá nū yēeyī ā, é géē hī ɔ̄ ka ogbajā, ɔ́dāŋ kóō gaá yɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔbá nū gekwú, ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ̄nyā nōo lɛ iyī nū ɛgiyí íne ā, é kē gáā hī ɔ̄ ka ogbajā ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō lɛ ɔbá ɔhá lɛ.

eng_Latn: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
idu_Latn: mla opi éyi, kú ɛya kú ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá Upíta le híhó, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔbúgwū lɛ ogwú tū.

eng_Latn: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā má, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó yɔ̄ Udótan.

eng_Latn: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kwu hīla ókplícī nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwú ɔyí nū Usólōmɔn ú cɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́ nōó kwú á.

eng_Latn: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú gē pla unwalu klá ācɛ, amáŋ ɛlā okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ge nya ɔ̄cɛ tá.

eng_Latn: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ húmáyī lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ, klla húmáyī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ, Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu ā je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sins, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó gbā ā mla ohi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicó tá ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ ó bīya, mla ucē okpaakpa kú nū, kwu aíkpɛ́cí dóódu nɛ̄ ó gwó ā, mɛ́mla ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra nɛ̄ ó ma kwu ajɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú aójibó kú ɛcí nɛ̄ ó ma kwu ajɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó pīyabɔ̄ á, é le odúúdú uwā kpó tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ōgbo kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ géē kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā wā í kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā abɔ́ɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācogbāálá gē kpó aálá kú uwā wā ɛga nēé í lúlé ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā géē lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú nū kwu ajɛ tū igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛga dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācogbāálá gē kwú ajɛ lɛ aálá kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
idu_Latn: Ábīja nū aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu inya jāā gaá mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ōhī kú ācɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu, Ujessána, Éfrɔn mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó je aíkpɛ́cí ā kpó ca tāajɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā bá í pā ɛcí klla í gwɛ́ɛya gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛcí kpɔ́. Ujɔ́tam le okómpīinu nɛ̄hi kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gwó.

eng_Latn: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn kwú hīla ā, anyā nū le ɔ́ ɔtū pīya kwu aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ō pā. Ó klla yɛce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā kpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka ádā nū, Udéfīdi ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.
