idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɔfú gwīiyē ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ glá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ cīgbīhi ga ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā.

eng_Latn: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gē kpó ācɛ trɛ̄yí ŋmá lɛ otábɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kéē híī já Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā má, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ já ɔ̄ má Umása ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄, aólɛlā kú uwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yíkpɛ́yí olɔfú ɛɛ́. Ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū uwɔ ā cāŋ́jɛ bá ī bɛ́yí kwu uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya kahíníī, Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nēé ka ka ɔhɔ́nyɛtá ā géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi ā?.

eng_Latn: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le eyī kú Uhága nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó le obugā kú éŋkpɔ̄ éyi má á, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ gaá le ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā tū omōōmu mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le je lɛ ɔyí ā le gwá á.

eng_Latn: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ápākssadi wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā, ó le ɔyí éyi, nōo hī ka Ussɛ́la ma.

eng_Latn: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
idu_Latn: N má odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ɛcɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī lɔfú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ o hile bá ī móowē ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe bī ɔfú mɛ́mla íkwú ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācɛ ā kéē bī ɛ̄cī kú ícɛ mɛ́mla óócí lɛ iyī uwā iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbo um ɛ̄gbā. É í kpó īlī kú uwā na.

eng_Latn: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ɛlá nɛ̄ ācobɔ́bíipú ā gē gbo ā, Amáŋ ɛlā kú ācɛ oyēŋēē ā gē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá géē cɛ̄ ī lɛ okónu ká aá klá cíí, aá yɛ í le mafú ka aá jéeyī.

eng_Latn: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ayínɛ́ nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ká ā ga Ujudíya ká ayíkpó kú uwɔ kéē má úklɔ́ nāa yɔ̄ ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɔhi. N géē cokónu mɛ́mla uwɔ ɔwɛ ékpónú. A géē bī Umáyíkalu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā gé um, eko nɛ̄ a géē wā í má um ā.

eng_Latn: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, a híī cɔ̄nū tū alɔ piyóó ŋ́. Ā híī yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu ɔ́bíipú kú alɔ piyóó ŋ́. Kóocōō, leyī yɛ ɔ́ lɛ alɔ kú ā ményinyi alɔ. Alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔga ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lé ka Usáyímɔ̄n ā, ó ī yúklɔ́ ɔkpɛ́bɛ́, nɛ̄ inu ɔlɛ́ nū kwu okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwū kú Ujósuwa ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā ka ipɔ́ɔma kú aá nyá géē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ukénan aflɛ́yí āa?.

eng_Latn: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Uhám wɛ, Ukúss, Íjīpiti, Ulíbiya mɛ́mla Ukénan.

eng_Latn: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā n má alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi. Ɔlá nōo fíyaajɛ yɛjīla ɔ́ tá ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ tá péee.

eng_Latn: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
idu_Latn: É klla le ayí kú Ulífāyi ofu igwóléyi nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kpó úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ aádáádā uwá mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá ā, kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ kéē wā í kwu ācɛ ohile ā dúú. Ɛ́sra lɛ iyē kú odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi ā tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí nɛ̄ Ifīlmɛ́rɔ̄daki lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, ó gbonɛnɛ lɛ Ujɛhóyākim, nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá agbá á. Ɔdānyā yá ipú ɛ̄cī ofu cɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā igwɛ́ɛpa kú iháyí ɔ́mofu cigwáahāapa ŋmá iháyí nēé kwú Ujɛhóyākim gaá tá agbá Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu gáā kɛlā ā, Ugalíyo da ācɛ Ujíyu kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōó yá ámāŋ íne nōó bīya nɛ̄hi á nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í má ɔdā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ jāhɔ̄ diili lɛ aá ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le gbo mla anú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
idu_Latn: amáŋ, é ī tá ɔdōlé kú uwā tū, eko ɔnɔ̄, gbēyī eko ogwā.

eng_Latn: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
idu_Latn: Aá géē tɛgíkwū í hīla aīnu eko nɛ̄ aá í má Ébrahām mɛ́mla Ayísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā bá ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ é kē lɛ aá nū tɛ́ɛcɛ!.

eng_Latn: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ijakī ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami wɛ ijakī nāa húmáyī ce ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N yá uwɔ lɛ ā jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehée.

eng_Latn: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ussíya gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílí kú aɔ́cɛ́, ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́tam, ɔyí nū le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ikpɛ́lā ā gē plla ɔ́mpānū, klla ī bī ɔ̄ ga ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla lɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu lɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ gɔbū nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí gwííjē kahíníī, Ɔyí álá nēé ŋmó ā cíkā nēé ī cɛ̄tra ɔ́ ohígbū koó lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla agbénú, mɛ́mla íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔfú iyē, mɛ́mla ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ofu nɛ̄hi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ klla cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le kpó bɔ́há ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī fō uwā ŋmá iyī uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
idu_Latn: Unesíya mɛ́mla Uhátīpa.

eng_Latn: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umanásɛ mla Ɛ́frem gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ɛfú tū īyī uwā, uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa klá kwú eyī ī pīya kwu Ujúda, kpó ɛfú ī gwō ɔ̄. Náaná íwɔtū kú Óndú ā í mɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́, ó lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nandaa gáā je ōwē lɛ uwá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ mɛ́mla Ádā alɔ abɔ̄yīnū mɛ́mla Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si kéē lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ alɔ kú alɔ gā ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
idu_Latn: Ó le ipú yɔ̄ le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi ma. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kwú uwēyī ú ŋmá um ɛyí o ŋmá ō je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ gā um.

eng_Latn: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
idu_Latn: Aígelī ɔhá klla bá abɔ́ɔ, nēe lé ka, Uséna, Uhadássa, Umigidágadi.

eng_Latn: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ā kpó wā amānyā, nááná nēé kpó ɔdā dúú uwī ŋmá ipú agbla ŋ́ mā, é klla kē kɛlā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ɛláyíja ɔ̄kā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
idu_Latn: Akú nū lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōó jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, nááná nɛ̄ ó lɔfú yēeyī iháyí úlā ɛhɔ̄ ā. Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa bá yɔ̄ ī ga ɛga ékpónú eko nēé gekwú.

eng_Latn: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
idu_Latn: É yá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ohígbū ɔ̄cɛnyā ŋ́, amáŋ é yá ɔ̄cɛnyā ohígbū ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ajɛ kú Ugóma mɛ́mla Ubɛ́togāma nēe ŋmá ɛhícō ā bá pi ɔ̄ɔ̄. Ācɛ kú aéwɔhá alɛwa kē bá pi ɔ́ lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubárāki yɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā Usisɛ́ra ā, Ujáyɛ̄lu wā í jīla nú ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō wā abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā ā mafú lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá inu mɛ́mla anú, anɔ́ɔ ó má Usisɛ́ra abɔ̄ ó gekwú tá ajɛ, oje o bī pi áklɔ̄kpɛ kwu ajɛ ā kwu ɔ́ ɛyí bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ jé, ɔ́dáŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē mīyɛ ɔkwu um ā géē wɛ ojéeyi, amáŋ ka olíla ā? Nááná, anú gáā wɛ óndú kú odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n móōwē nū klla yúklɔ́ nú ipú íjééyī kú um ipu ɛcɛ á. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā mla owu oōnū inya nɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɔfú Usáyɔn, anú lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á, ó klla lé ɔcɛ́ kú aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ abālɔbányā lɛ aá á, aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔtū nōbí, amáŋ n géē má aá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́, ɔtū klla géē he aá. Cɛ́ɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā je éeyē kú aá ŋmá ɛgiyí aá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, jāhɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka gā uwɔ ā ká ā gbɛlá kwú odúúdú nū.

eng_Latn: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā abɔ̄yīnū nēé yá ágbe ā gekwú nɛɛ, italā kú nū géē wɛ oyēeyī kwɛyí oyéeyī.

eng_Latn: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ābɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ede ā, ipéyī Óndú ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē pīya oyī kú nū kla ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē bá ī gbɛlá ɔlɛ́ nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ā nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í lɛ ɛga má kwúcē le yɛ.

eng_Latn: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ̄, le yɛ ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā, gáā lɛ ɔdā dóódu má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da uwá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ucē kú Onyatá ā tútū á.

eng_Latn: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gáā cē ɔcí nēé lɛ ɔ́ cē ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā yá ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé gbɛnyigbɛnyi mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé lɔfú iyē ŋ́ mā dúú á. Ó géē yá lɛ ā jāā gbéeko nōó le yá ká ɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi kóō mīyajɛ tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ge wī uwā uwī ŋ́, amáŋ kéē mafú ka aá wɛ ācɛ olɔhi nēe ge tɛ́yí wāajɛ. Kéē klla wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ɔwɛ dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ipú ɔdā dóódu kéē cɛ̄tra ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo nya alɔ tá ā gē nwū ā.

eng_Latn: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hɔ́hā cɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ um á. Ɔwɔicō le ɛka gbo ga um piyóó ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ɔdā dóódu kú nū le gwótū lɔhi, ó kē gáā bīya ɛka nōó gbo ā gbógbóō ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō géē tá um abɔ̄ piíí. Ó kē géē yá ka odúúdú aɔ́dā nyā nɛ̄ n kpéyīce ā kéē le yá.

eng_Latn: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā kóō mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gáā kwú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi. Aá nwū um mɛ́ɛnɛ. Aá da um ɔdā nɛ̄ um yá bɔ̄bí ā. N géē klá cííí, í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ká aá.

eng_Latn: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, abɔ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu oyíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā gbɔɔ́ ō da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nāa yɔ̄ í yá ā ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
idu_Latn: Ó wā ɔlɛ́ nū, amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū í mīyɛ anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í da aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kéē leyīkwu uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā í yɛhɛ tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, ohígbū ka ó jé ka ɔ́ gáā gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó uwā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ tɛtɛ le abɔ̄ pi aá ahɔ̄ ka aá kóō híī nwɛ̄lā ŋmá lɛ iyē nyā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá nwū ā le mu Ujerúsālɛm kwɛcɛ ā. Aá tíne ká aá je oyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ā ce alɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
idu_Latn: Aá mɔ́ɔ, alɔ gē ga Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́. É géē je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ tā otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne abɔ̄. É géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ ɔ́da je ícɛ, ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu, éwo dóódu mɛ́mla ucē dóódu nōo lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ka lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō kú Ussádrāki, Uméssaki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo, é géē je ɔ́ fā kɛ́tɛ̄kɛtɛ̄ oyēeyī, é klla í je ɔlɛ́ nū tá alácɛ̄. Ohígbū ka ɛdɔ ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄, nōo lɔfú hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ ɛtá ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
idu_Latn: Kwú um ú ka ālɔ̄ le kwu ŋmá amānyā, kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú um, ká ā lɛ um bī ga inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Alɔ géē gwéeyē tɔ̄há kú ɔtū kóō he alɔ ipú ihɔtū kú uwɔ, N géē cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ ā. Anú lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ejé olɔhi ī he ācɛ o gwá ejé ɔtū lɛ ā á. Ó yéyīji ŋ́, a he odúúdú ayípáncɛ́nyā ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, ɛkɔ̄ nēe gē lé ɛbɛ́ uwá ā í gē kwú ŋ́, ɔlá nōo gē yi uwá ā í kē gē nyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā je aíne kú uwā nyā lɛ Umósīsi, ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi kóō je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kéē bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú uwā gé lɛ anúɔ ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ fíyɛ́ o yɔ̄ ī lé, klla í gwá, yɔ̄ í jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yúkɔ́ nū ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n má ka ɛhi ɛ̄nyā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wā ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi. Ó cāŋjɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ nōo tá ce Ɛ́dɔm ā. Ó gē cɛ̄ klla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋmá ɛfu kú Upáran. Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ulá ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ bá mla anú, ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá kē yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū.

eng_Latn: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ipú okónu ékpó nyā nɛ̄ alɔ ī le tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá á, anú nɛ̄ okónu ō tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kē ī ŋmá anú dúú á. Ayínɛ́ um, ɛ̄nyā í cíkā ō lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá Urítma, gaá lā Urimɔn-perɛ́si.

eng_Latn: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
idu_Latn: Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɔdɔ kú aínicō ā wɛ umíta ɛpa ce āyā. Ɔwɛ éyi yɛ ga ipú aínu kú ābɔ̄ ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔhá klla yɛ ga ipú aínu kú ābɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ ā dúú. N má ka ɔwá kú aínu ā kwu ikpó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ umīta ɛpa ce āyā biílí jīla. Oŋmá ajɛ gicō kú nū ā wɛ umíta ɛtá, gáā jónjīlɛ̄ mɛ́mla etikpa kú aínicō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɛga nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aínu nēe kwu ɛháajɛ kú Agbīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ga ɛgiyí aínu kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā wɛ umíta igwó, pīya cíla áklō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
idu_Latn: É le ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu kɔ̄ ɛga ɛpa. Umanásɛ mɛ́mla Ɛ́frem. Amáŋ Umósīsi í je ajɛ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ŋ́. Ayíka ɔlɛ́ nēé gē lá anú ōfōōfūnū ā mɛ́mla ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwā gē lé ácí ā.

eng_Latn: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
idu_Latn: A yɔ̄ ī ka ka ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ cɛ̄ klla ī kaā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi á. A klla ī ka ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ má anúɔ ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá má ɔdōcābɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā ō hídáagó ŋ́ nɛɛ, aá géē yɛyí cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
idu_Latn: N jé ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā éyi nēé je gicō ga ɔkpáncó ɔ́mɛtá ā, iháyí igwɛ́ɛnɛ nōo yɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nyā yá ā, koó yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíyē ga ɔkpáncō nɛ́ɛ́, ń jé ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɛbɛ nōó wɛ á nɛɛ, Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū jé á.

eng_Latn: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
idu_Latn: Udáni, Ujósɛ̄fu, Ubɛ́njamīn, Unáfutāli, Ugádi mɛ́mla Ássa.

eng_Latn: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ kú Usáyɔn kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔcɛ́ kú aá gē wā ɛgiyí aá! Ó le iyīnū túwāajɛ klla cɛyí ijakī éyi mɛ́mla ɔyí ijakī.

eng_Latn: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ Uhassábīya mɛ́mla Ujéssáya tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerári mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú uwá ofu.

eng_Latn: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
idu_Latn: Bī ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū uwɔ ā ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ eko dóódu. Lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū eyīnyinyi aá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō má ā abālɔbányā, ācɛ Ujíyu le ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Ɔwɔicō, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ eyīnyinyi uwā má abālɔbányā dúú.

eng_Latn: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu nōo jōklóbīya bɛ̄ɛka Ábsālɔm ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Oŋmíicō kwaajɛ, ó lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umówābu ā wɛ úlā ahāapa ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé má bá ɛbɔ́ nɛɛ, é klla gbɔɔ́ ō bīya íne kú uwɔ kpɔ́. A klla cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwá kéē lɛ uwá yálé kpɔ́. Eko dúúmā nēé le pīyabɔ̄, klla lɛ ɔkɔ gbā gā uwɔ kú ā lɛ aá nyatá nɛɛ, a kē í pó ɔkɔ kú uwá ɔkpáncō. Cɛ́ɛ́ a klla le uwá nyatá. O ŋmá eko tá eko, a gē pó ɔkɔ nēé gbā gā awɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kē le eyīnyinyi uwā má, le uwá hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o ŋmó ācɛ bá gē gicō ga ajɛ ipɔ́lɛ́ ā, Alɔ le ɛyí cikwū eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ bá ī tíne ɔdōlé ipú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
idu_Latn: É le ikpó inu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi tá ajɛ ipú ɔyā ɛpa kú ɔyā kú Usífu, ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ, nɛ̄ Usólɔ́mɔn je pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá lā ɛga dúúmā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē lā ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛháajɛ otúta kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É kē í pīyeyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ŋmá ɛga dóódu nēé í lā ā.

eng_Latn: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē ga iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī ɛtá ga ipú ígbíli ā piíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó páápá, le tá okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ā le tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ubáala nēé hī ka Ukɛríyati Ujeyarím dúú ā, ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. É nyɔ̄ gáā je Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, nōo kwɛyí ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ɔtāhɛ́ aúcérūbim ā yɔ ā, ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ unwalu yɛ uwɔ jīla tá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ufi gē mu uwɔ ipú hile acígilí ā á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá géē nwuné nɛ̄hi, nōó géē jɛ̄ aá ipú iháyí dóódu. Aá klla géē je ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ kú aá kpó bónū ŋmá ɔbá kú aá, kú ɛga kóō tá lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
idu_Latn: Ubendéka wɛ igbómína kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Umákasi, Ussáálubím, Ubetissémɛ̄ssi mɛ́mla Ɛ́lɔ̄n Ubɛtiánan.

eng_Latn: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛya ā gwó mɛ ā, Udéfīdi bī iyē kú Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eliká kú ɛkpa o bɔ́ɔ́tū ā fúlá tɔ̄há mla ɔ́ŋgbá ublúu éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛkpa o bɔ́ɔ́tū ā kóō ce ɛhícō kú ɔdōkwɛ́ɛ́nyɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kúō híī wī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ka lɛ ācɛ kwɛyí á, ó le yɛ tá Ukápānɔm.

eng_Latn: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
idu_Latn: É kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ ā kpó ŋmó mɛ́mla ācɛnyā dúúmā nēe lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jé ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ébrahām kē lɔtū lé piyóó ā, ó kē mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ō je lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
idu_Latn: É gáā ŋmá ācɛ nēe pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si abālɔbányā ɛpɔ̄bí dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bī ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā nyā gé lɛ Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā nōo í bī ɔ̄ ga ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
idu_Latn: É wā í nuunu tá um eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú unwalu ā. Amáŋ, Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā yá um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: Uhosíya, ɔyí kú Unún ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frēm.

eng_Latn: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le íne bīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ yá ā ɛɛ́. Alɔ le ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú íjééyī nɛ̄ ɔglɛ̄ɛjí ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ohílīpú kú Óndú ā nwuné nɛ̄hi. Íjééyī kú nū kē í fíyɛ́ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
idu_Latn: Ogbāājɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, gā ká ɔyí um kóō kwú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, n géē gwō ɔ̄ ɔ́ci. Ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, n géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā je ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú lɛ Óndú ā, ɔtū kē he uwá nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je lɛ Óndú ā nɛ̄hi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le álá ŋmó nɛɛ, n géē mīyɛ ufu ā ce iyī um ɛyí. Ń gē je uwá gé lɛ uwɔ gē kɔkɔ ka ń jé ɔkwu kú ikwū kú uwā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. A le ukɔ́ tū ka ɔdā dóódu nēé kwú uwī otú mɛ́mla ɛnɔ, amíyɔ̄ lɛ ulé nū cílá.

eng_Latn: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
idu_Latn: É gē yá ojuju obɔ̄bí ipú ɔtū kú uwā eko dóódu. É klla gē tū ikpɛ́lā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ámāŋ éwɔhá nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā lɛ ɛbɛ́ dúúmā nōo fu oyī bónū ŋmá iyē nū ŋ́ lé, n géē cīgbihi kwu ɔ́, ó kē gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā da aá ka aá kwú pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ucē ɔbíipú kú aá mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā. É da aá ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le yá lɛ ā, aá géē lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ je lɛ aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá, kóō wɛ ákú aá piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ okónu kú um klá, ń gáā ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ ōwē kú um kē yɔ̄ ī nwuné tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm bī ɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi le gwō Ujúda ɔ́ci. Ɔ́ci nēé gwō Ujúda ɔ́ɔmā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
idu_Latn: É gbo úklɔ́ nyā ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ɔ́mɛhīlī kú iháyí ɔ́mpa kú eko nɛ̄ Udárīyɔ̄si cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
idu_Latn: A da ɔ̄cɛ kɔ́ɔ̄ kwúcē ga ɔdā nɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ wɛ ā, a kwú ɔ̄ ú kwúcē ga úmúlá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ gā ɛga ō gbo gbɔ́ɔcī ā, alɔ le ɛkpa kú alɔ nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ije kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ ce ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā ipú ɛkpa kú nū ā. Alɔ le ije ā bī wā gé lɛ uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá Ugálīli ā, Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, É géē je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ tá ācɛ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oje ɔdɔ, oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔlamu mɛ́mla ɔmɛ kú nū ā le kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, kwú pīya úmúúmúlá bɛ̄ɛka úmúlá kú ɛgowíīkpɔ̄dā eko ɔnɔ̄ ā. Owu le odúúdú nū kpó bónū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lɔfú má iwili kú nū dúúmā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛcɔ̄ nōo je ojibó nyā wúlatāajɛ nyā kwú píya ɛfu nɛ̄hi nōo mīyɛ odúúdú ɛcɛ tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā ābɔ̄ ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Ahíyēsa, ɔyí kú Ammíssādayi.

eng_Latn: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
idu_Latn: É le ojibó kú ubáalu mɛ́mla agbla kú nū ā kpó yíífi, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɛga okwū emī tū ɔ̄ jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
idu_Latn: N gē nū aólɛlā kú um inya klla í yá uwá lé. Ń gē māháyi ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
idu_Latn: Ó leyīce ka anúɔ í má iwili kú ɔdōlé nōo í wāajɛ ŋmá itéblu kú ɔlɛ́ olagbénú ā. Aéwo kōō ī wā ī pla ámata kú nū nyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For ye are our glory and joy.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄, aá wɛ ācɛ nēe yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwó á, aá kē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwéeyē á.

eng_Latn: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɛ ujɔ̄ tū klla wā ī da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, alɔ tíne ká ā le jé, ka íne kú ācɛ Umédes mɛ́mla Upɛ́sīya dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kwú abɔ̄ ū tá ɔ́ ɛɛ́, ó gē pīya abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ tííkpa kú ádā nū ipú ɔdā okpaakpa ō yá īpéyī kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā yá ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mofucɛhɔ̄ nēé kpó alɔ abɔ̄fú ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā. Iháyí ɔ́ɔmā iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́nɛ ŋmá eko nēé je Ujerúsālɛm catāajɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɔfú kú Óndú ā gā ipú iyē um nɛ̄hi, klla kwú um ú nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ukúss kwú pīya ádā kú Unímrɔ̄du. Unímrɔ̄du wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ nōo je pīya ɔ̄cɛ o lɔfú kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
idu_Latn: É lɛ acá ɛpa kú okpé kpó lɛ ɔnyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le wu ga ɔlɛ́ nū ipú ígbíli, ɛga nēé géē leyīkwu ɔ́ iháyí ɛtá ce ɔyā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Udéfīdi ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gekwú, anúɔ géē je ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū éyi cɔcɛ́. Ó ka anúɔ klla í yá kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
idu_Latn: Áso ma Usádɔ̄ku, Usádɔ̄ku ma Acím, Acím ma Ɛlíyūdi.

eng_Latn: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gaajɛ ā, ācɛ nēe lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɛdɔ ōcē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā, le uwá kpó wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā, lɛ uwá kpó hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
idu_Latn: Umáki, Arístākɔsi, Udímāsi mɛ́mla Ulúkú, ācɛ úklɔ́ ɔ́mpā um ī hokónu tū uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é le yɛ tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, gaá yɔ̄ ī nwū ācɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya āa mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá pī ɔ̄ ā le ójīla ohɛ́pɔ̄ mla odúúdú ukánsulu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā hīgwú tɔ̄há, é le ɛhɔ̄ tū ga agbá kéē lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kpó wā.

eng_Latn: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
idu_Latn: N bī ɔ̄ wā gé lɛ ayíkpó kú uwɔ, amáŋ é kē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD unto the people that asked of him a king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdú ɛlā kú Óndú ā, kpó da ācɛ nēe gē tíne ɔcɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
idu_Latn: Ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá le obugā ɔhá bū kpɔ́, amáŋ é yá ikpɛ́lā ce ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Urēhɔ̄bɔ̄t nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ Ɔwɔicō le ɛga yá lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Alɔ géē nyīla ajɛ nyā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó ī lɛ ā nāa kē je um ɔ́mpa awɔ, mīyɛ anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē mīyɛ um ā.

eng_Latn: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, Uhɛsɛkíya gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē, ó hile lígíí kóō gekwú piyóó. Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ɔyí kú Amɔ̄si le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá má ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tútū, ohígbū ka a géē kwú, á gáā bū ōcē nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
idu_Latn: Aá má ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká aá kóō híī yá unwū ɔnyā bɛ̄ɛka opī ā ŋ́, ámāŋ kóō híī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó ī yúufi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ísɔ nōo kwú ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú nū í lá ohígbū ɔdōlé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ ā géē wá ɔnwū kú nū, í mā ɛga nɛ̄ ipí ā yɔ̄ ā tá. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
idu_Latn: N le odúúdú ɛlā nōo gē kwú um iyē ā ka lɛ ɔ́, n klla le odúúdú unwalu kú um ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, habɔ̄ ikpaŋkini kú nū tá kwaajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú agbá kú oje olamu mɛ́mla oje udɔ ā í kwú ikpaŋkini ɔcí ā biílí. Má ɔ̄ tá kwu ipácí abɔ́ɔ. Ébú kóō cē klá ɔ̄cɛ ā, kóō lā ipácí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lé ēpū mɛ́mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ijē, íkplí, mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā, ó le uwá kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú da Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔmahatá ā, Usólómɔ̄n da ācɛ ā kéē pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ācɛ ā le cɛ̄tra ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le éeyē gwó ga ɔlɛ́ uwā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ eko nɛ̄ó gē lɛ ɔlá kwu agege ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā. É géē yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔtulalī ō fú tū ɔlá nyā nɛ̄ó gáā hɔ́kɔ tēēnyi ŋ́ jāā ga ayááyí gbéeko nɛ̄ó ī mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē yēeyī līgbō ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā jē lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ ācɛ nēe gē da Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ mā aá tá cíí. Ka anú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ yá aá ɔdā dóódu glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā ú wu apɛ́. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ɛga nēé yá aá piíí ā. Ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma aá ā, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ n géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yá ɔtūnōbí ohígbū ayínɛ́ uwā, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn. Anɔ́ɔ é ka ipɔ́ɔma éyi ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
idu_Latn: Okónu kú alɔ le mu mla ɛhɛ, alɔ kē bá yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē. Anɔ́ɔ aéwɔhá bá ī ka ɔtāhɛ̄ iyī uwā kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi yá lɛ uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nwū ɛwa ā ɛlā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā fíyaa, ohígbū ka ācɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, le nyíleyī ɛɛ́, klla le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kwú pīyeyī ŋmá aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ā, gaá lɛ ojibó ma lɛ īyī uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Eko éyi géē wā nɛ̄ eyī géē yá aá ká aá lɛ ɛ̄cī ékpónú kénéke kú eko nɛ̄ ami, Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē yɔ̄ mla aá má, amáŋ aá gáā lɔfú má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ugígalu le tá ɛga nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū á. Ācɛ nēe hile ā le pɛ́ yɛce Usɔ́lu abɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā. É le yɛ ŋmá Ugígalu ga Ugíbēyi ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn. Usɔ́lu lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó jila, é lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlā ce ofu igwó ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ɔ́ klla í gwū ɔwɛ tū īlī nɛ̄ odée ā yɔ̄ anú ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
idu_Latn: Ayí uwā nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī jɛ̄ kwɛyí uwá ā, nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa hɛ́ uwā apī á, ohígbū ka é hɛ́ uwā apī jéjéē ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da Uháman kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ fíya kú ā lɛ awulú mɛ́mla ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpó wā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ aɔ́dā nāa ka ā yá lɛ Umɔ́dɛkāyi, ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā. A géē má ɔ̄ cīce okómpinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄kā pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ gē hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē. Anɔ́ɔ ó wā ŋmá igbīhi nū ŋmá ipú ɛwa gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úwé kú nū á.

eng_Latn: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā ā géē je kpó yíífi tāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛha gē tū īlī gē je ɔ́ lé tāajɛ ā. Amáŋ n géē nya aá tá piyóó. N kē í cɛ̄ lɛ aá yɔ̄ ī yálé ŋméeko téeko piyóó.

eng_Latn: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ofucɛnɛ nyā gē gwííjē klla gé gwū ɔdā ō bī gwííjē nɛ̄hi. É lɛ uwá nwū jé mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ɔ́mpa uwá lɔɔlɔhi. Odúúdú uwá nēe gē gwííjē nyā ā pīyatɔ̄há, uwá wɛ ofigwɛ́ɛnɛ ce ācɛ ahātá .

eng_Latn: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
idu_Latn: nááná nɛ̄ ɔyípōklóbīya ā kōō ŋmá agbá gaá ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ámāŋ nɛ̄ ó kōō tɛtɛ wɛ olɛhá.

eng_Latn: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā igwóléyi kú iháyí ɔ́mofɛpa nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, Umósīsi le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kóō da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó da uwá. Ó ka aɛ́lā nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nēé bá ipú ígbíli, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. É bá ɔpɛ́ kú Arába kwu Usúfu ajaajɛ, ɔtāhɛ̄ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Upáran mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Utófɛ̄lu, Ulában, Uhásɛ̄rɔtu mɛ́mla Udisáhābu.

eng_Latn: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ā má ka ɔcɛ́ ā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā, ācɛ ā tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í lɛ ukpɛ̄ dúúmā ipú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi ŋ́. Ālɔ̄ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔyí kú Ujɛ́se ā tá. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, oo! Udéfīdi, leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́ɛ́ oó! Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yáwaa ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ācɛ nōo ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā, ohígbū ka ije nēé cē bá um ā. Amáŋ n kē í yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó miya kóō yá ā mafú lɛ Umósīsi, ó klla le úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó yá ā mafú lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ acá kú Ucérōbim ɔhá nɛ̄ olikpō kú acá kú nū kē wɛ ikpó ahāapa dúú ā kē le nāŋdaa gaá kwu ɔdɔ, anɔ́ɔ acá ɔhá, nōo kē wɛ ikpó ahāapa dúú ā le nwūla gaá kwu acá kú Ucérōbim kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.
idu_Latn: É géē je odúúdú ajɛ nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugɛ́ba nōo yɔ̄ ɛhíícō ā, ga Urímmɔn ɛháajɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā cīlatū. Ujerúsālɛm géē hile kwu licō fíyɛ́ ajɛ dóódu nōo yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā. Igelī nɛ̄hi ā géē yɛ ga ɔwɛ kú ɔ́kíkā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ éyi kwu aflɛ́yí ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ o yɛ ŋmá inɔ̄ɔda o gbāajɛ kú Uhanánelu ga ɛga o yá ejé kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́migwáahātá nɛ̄ Ujɛhóssāfati lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ujɛhóram, ɔyí kú Áhābu le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé Usamérīya. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ iyē kú um, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ um fu ká n̄ bī ɔ̄kōolɔhi gé lɛ ācogbɛhá. Ó lɛ um tɛ̄hɔ̄ ká n̄ da ācɛ nēe bá agbá ā kéē lɛ uwa hɛ̄tá ɛɛ́. Ká n̄ da ācopeyī kéē lɔfú mɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Ká n̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé gē yá uwā ōwē ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā háyi, ɛga nēé je lɛ uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ulífāyi, ācogwíijē ā háyi leyī pīya kwu uwá, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī gwííjē klla bá ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā mla ɔdā ō bī gwííjē nɛ̄ Udéfīdi kpó lɛ uwá ā. É bá í gwííjē kahíníī, Ihɔtū kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi nwū uwā eko dúú nɛ̄ ó gē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā mla ije ō gwó kú ahínyá ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī tá opo abɔ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu o hile kē háyi abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɔ kú inu kú ɛháajɛ kú eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú inu a cɔkpɛ́nú, umíta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ āyā kú umíta kú ikpō kú nū. Inu klla bá nɛ̄ ipú nū wɛ umíta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo hile ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ da anúɔ ɔ̄kā ka anúɔ kwú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí í kpó lɛ uwú. Ó klla da uwá ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ūwā ɛ́ɛ bá abālɔbányā ā kéē nya uwá tá ā?.

eng_Latn: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yēeyī klla lɛ ɔtūce um, í gáā kwú ŋ́ piyóó. A cɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā a.

eng_Latn: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
idu_Latn: Īkpō kú inu eyīpú, ɛga nēé hī ka ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ ikpó ofu ce igwó nōo jōnjīlɛ̄ mla ɔwá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi abɔ̄yīnū ā. Ó klla le oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄hi ma plla ɔdɔ kú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Aá habɔ̄ ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ tá kéē wā ɛgiyí um, aá híīī nū uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ.

eng_Latn: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, ācɛ kú Ufilístiya bā gē kpɛ́fú tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ikpɛ́fu kú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā. É mīyɛ Ubɛti Ussímɛ̄ssi, Áíjālɔn, Ugɛdɛ́rōti mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usóko, Utímina, mɛ́mla Ugímso, mɛ́mla odúúdú ígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ujúda klla má lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Umósīsi gé.

eng_Latn: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́lāce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, klla yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū mla uwá piyóó gɛ ŋ́. Ó le lɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́nyɔ́ géē hɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nɛ̄ n yá ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
idu_Latn: N mágwōnū gblugudu, anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ nōo da um ka, Usɔ́lu, Usɔ́lu, ɔdíyá nāa ī yá um ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu lā ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, Urúbɛn gaá le ikpó Ubílha ce. Ubilha wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú Urécɛ̄lu, nōo ma ayí lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le jé ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á. Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu wɛ igwɛ́ɛpa eko nyā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ ā lɔfú. É lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ igá hɛ́ tū uwā. Alɔ klla má aípɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Ánāki, nēe wɛ aɔ́báagwu ā.

eng_Latn: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá kwinya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Aá kwinya kú oyēeyī kú aá ŋmá ipú nū ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi gáā je ɔ́ yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
idu_Latn: Aíta nɛ̄ n gáā kwu lɛ aá nyā wɛ ákú Usólōmɔn, ɔyí kú Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
idu_Latn: Odóódu kú uwā í má ije gbā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa ka ije ā kóō yá uwā ɛhi mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ɛ̄nyá kú ipú ācɛ ɛpa nēe bá mbáa géē yíhɔtū tá ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ije yá uwā ɛhi nyā fíyɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da uwɔ ka, alɔ gē kɛlā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ jé, alɔ kē í cɛ̄ ijáalí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ má. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá kē tútū kóō mīyɛ ijáalí kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛfú nēé kpó ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufílístīya klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú igbɔhá kpɔ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ugɔ́bu. Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Usibɛkáyi nōo ŋmá Uhússa ā ŋmó agwu nēé hī ka Usáfu ā á.

eng_Latn: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ, Ɔwɔicō, lā ipú ɛcɛ mla alɛɛcɛ glá āā? Odúúdú ɔkpáncō ā í bī uwɔ glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gwó nyā géē jɛ̄ uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
idu_Latn: Aá gáā túkpɛɛ́ lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā ūwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā gé yɔ́bɔ́nyā. N gē yá ācɛ nɛ̄ wɔ́tū um ā italā, klla gē yá ayááyí uwā ga ayááyí ɔ́mɛtá, ga ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ italā.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ipí ā le lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā, nɛ̄ ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ kwú pīya odo, ó géē ka ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ le tēelihɔ. Ó wɛ ōcē agwú kú ɛyí ámāŋ agba ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ aéwɔhá nɛ̄ n pa aá hīla nyɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ n klla lɛ aá túbá tɔ̄há, n géē mīyɛ ɛya oōyɔlá kú aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aéwɔhá le má ka ami ɔ́ɔ tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú bī gé lɛ Usekaríya yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī olulé, gɔ̄ ācɛ paá paá paá, ga abɔ̄lɔ́ná mla abɔ̄lúfīyē mɛ́mla ɛga dóódu nāa pīyeyī kwu.

eng_Latn: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú ijē kú nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é kpó ijē ŋmá ipú kú álá nēé ŋmó kú ɛya kú olétɔ̄há ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó le ɔ́ kpó yɔlá tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔdōlé ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya nēé je lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bī ɔwɛ nyā le gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā. Cɛ́ɛ é kwú íne nōó bīya ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́, eko kú um í kē yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je unwalu lɛ iyī uwɔ ohígbū ācobɔ̄bíipú ŋ́. Ā híī hɔ́ɔkɔ kú ɔdā dóódu kú ācɛ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, É gáā je uwɔ lɛ uwá ŋ́. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ka ā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū um fu uwɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē lɔhi gā uwɔ, é kē gáā ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ā kwú mlanyī Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ufílīstiya, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu, mla Usisɛ́ra otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhaásɔ kpɛ́fú tá aádáádā aá lɛ uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō, aá jahɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā. Ayí nɛ̄ n bī jɛ̄ abɔ̄yī um ā gbɔɔ́ ō yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um, klla ī bɛ̄yíkwu um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
idu_Latn: Ɔpɛ́ kú Usídim ā le mu mla ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ukolotā, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra ā bá yɔ̄ ī kwu ā, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā bá ī míya tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ ācɛ ohile ā le kwu ga ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dúú gwū anúɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄copllɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka, eko nōó yēeyī ā. Ó kahíníī, Igbīhi ɛ̄cī ɛtá, n géē héyī.

eng_Latn: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Odúúdú aá nēe nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tá ā, aá kwúcē wā. N géē hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá ɔdā nōo ī yá nɛ̄ aá yɛce um kpaakpa glá ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Īī, alɔ géē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ, Óndú ā, ohígbū ka awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á.

eng_Latn: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
idu_Latn: É le ojuju obɔ̄bí tū klla gē kahíníī, Alɔ le ojuju obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi gbō tá ajɛ ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā má ɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jɔ́ɔkwu alɔ glá ŋ́. Odo mla ɔtū kú ɔlɛɛcɛ lipú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
idu_Latn: Aá maabɔ̄ odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ ɔtū mla odo ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá tíne ō kwú āa.

eng_Latn: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka, ɛpɔ̄ kú um wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ohígbū ka ń yɔ̄ ōfōōfū um ŋ́, amáŋ Ádā nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Itáma, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni ā, kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛyí kú aá fíyɛ́, aá kē híī híla īlī kú aá ŋ́ ká ācɛ kéē jé ka aá yēekwu ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le yá lɛ ā, aá géē kwú. Óndú ā kē í cɔ̄nū da odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa aá ā lɔfú yéekwu kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔlá nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā kpó ŋmó nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
idu_Latn: É ka ɔyí ā ká ɔ̄ kwú oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú lɛ Unaómi, kɔ́ɔ̄ klla leyīkwu ɔ́ eko kú ókplícī kú nū. Ohígbū ka ɔnyā ɔyí nū nɔ́ɔ yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā, le ɔyí kú ɔyí ma lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́. É da ɔ́ ka anú ā, ɔ́ɔ kōō yá odée lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa lɔfú yá lɛ ɔ́ glá ā.

eng_Latn: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
idu_Latn: O má éyi kú uwá gē ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí cāā. É gē bɔ̄bíipú kú uwā tɛ́ɛcɛ péee bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Usɔ́dɔm ā. É yá ɔdā dúúmā tayínū ŋ́. É le jī ɛɛ́, uwá kē pla unwalu nyā klá iyī uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábna le tá ɛgiyí anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gaá da uwá kahíníī, Ó gbojī ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ aá húmáyī tíne ka Udéfīdi kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla gaá da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Aɔ́nya nyá bá yɔ̄ ā, Óndú um? Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ gē kɛlā mla um ā kahíníī, N géē ma ɔdā nōó wɛ ā fú gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
idu_Latn: Anú nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce á, ń kē gáā yúufi ŋ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ áncā yá um glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ n géē bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú uwɔ ā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla um mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
idu_Latn: Aíkpékwīja kú ɛcí kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́dā nēé í yá le kwu ɛhɔ̄ kú abafú kó ō tū aígbáanɔ ufi ā nɛ. É kɛlā glá ŋ́. Ācɛ gē kpó uwā yɛ, ohígbū ké ē yāwu abɔ̄yī uwā glá ŋ́. Aá híī yúúfi uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka é yá aá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā glá ŋ́. É kē yá ɔdōōlɔhí lɛ aá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
idu_Latn: Ń pi aá ahɔ̄ ohígbū ɛya ɔlamu mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú nɛ̄ aá gē gwó gā um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ āā, alɔ í fu ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo í cījáalí ka Ujísɔ̄si le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, kóō mīyɛ ɔkwu kú Ujúdasi. Ó í wɛ éyi kú ipú ācɛ nēe wɛ ɔ́wá kú alɔ ɛpléeko nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yɛ ɛga dóódu mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
idu_Latn: É le ka lɛ Udéfīdi ka ācɛ Ufilístiya ɛ́ɛ bá ī kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ukéyīla, é klla da ɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ bá ī kpó īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā nēé cē bōōbū ā uwī.

eng_Latn: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é tá uwá ohi ka, aá le okónu ce lɛ uwá lɔfú, iyē kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ka aá í gáā yá uwā ɔdā dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ le cɔ̄nū, ohígbū ka anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda ā, le ɛfú kpó tá Ísrɛ̄lu, klla mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anúɔ géē pīya ōwē klá uwá bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā má gbo klá ajɛ gblugudu iyɔ̄bū Ɛláyíssa, lɛ eyī pīya kláajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí nū ú nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā pīya uwá tū ŋ́. O yá kóō gbō uwā ā, ó dɛ̄gba tū aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, A gē ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū olɔhi kú um nɛɛ? Ó géē he um ɔtū, ɔ́dāŋ ka odúúdu ācɛ kú Óndú ā wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē je alelékwū kú nū lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ā? É tóohi kahíníī, Ó cíkā kóō gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, N le ōwē kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe bá Íjīpiti ā má ɛɛ́. N klla le ikwū nēé je ohígbū ōwē nɛ̄ aɔ́kpani uwā gē yá uwā ā pó ɛɛ́. N jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ōwē nēé yɔ̄ ī má ā.

eng_Latn: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ɔwɔicō ɔ̄kā ka anúɔ lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē lā ā gwó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
idu_Latn: N klla í yɔ̄ ī yá īyī um olíla klla í je uwēyī lɛ īyī um fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ n. N géē tū wā ajɛ īkpēyī kú uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ n géē jɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ a gē kɛlā uwá ā ɔ́ɔmā eyī nɛ̄hi, nēé klla í lɛ ojīlīma ce um.

eng_Latn: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē lɛ ɛlá kwu ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ajɛ ā klla géē wɛ ákú uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
idu_Latn: É kōō le tá ajɛ kú aólɛlā kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā, nááná, n géē je ɔ́da lɛ aólɛlā ā kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó abɔ́ɔ. N leyī hɛ́kwu uwā kú n kpó uwā yíífi, ó wɛ ka n gáā tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du kahíníī, N cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ Ujɔ́ni ikpɛ̄yí hɛ́, amáŋ ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, nɛ̄ n gē pó aɔ́dā oyéeyījii lɛyíkwu ɔ́ nya ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū kóō lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má eyī á.

eng_Latn: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, eko nɛ̄ alɔ wā í ka ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá aflɛ́yí ā, alɔ í wā í kɛlā okónu ofūnū ŋ́, alɔ bī ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ le yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó alɛwa ɔtāhɛ̄ aá, alɔ kē mafú lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ cɛ̄ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yí kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛ ā. Aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ lā lɛ eko nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipú ā. Alɔ yá ɔ́ɔmā kú olɔhi kú aá.

eng_Latn: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī tíne kéē lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́. Ācɛ nēe kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ka aá wɛ ācɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka alɔ nááná nēé kē wɛ ŋ́ mā ā, le plla tá ipú ígwu kú alɔ wɛɛlɛ kéē wā ī bɔkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ ī nyíliyētá ipú opīyatɔ̄há kú alɔ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ alɔ pīya ɔfiyɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu ka ā.

eng_Latn: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
idu_Latn: Abiyálbɔn nōo ŋmá Ubɛt Arába. Asmáfɛ̄ti nōo ŋmá Ubáruhim ā.

eng_Latn: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Upéka, ɔyí kú Urɛmalíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ujɔ́tam, ɔyí kú Ussíya le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé dúú.

eng_Latn: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nōó lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ā ka lɛ uwá ā, ó lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Ujɔ́pa.

eng_Latn: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī cokónu dúúmā mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́. Ó kéē kwú aéde kú aɛ́cí kú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā í catāajɛ. Amáŋ, ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ā, é yá ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá kéē híī yá ŋ́ mā, nēé gē yá á.

eng_Latn: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ í gē móōwē kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā fíya ŋ́ mā, ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ ācɛ gē tútū kéē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ íne kú uwɔ nyā pó ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú uwɔ nɛ̄hi nyā, ɔnyā dóódu géē yɔ̄ ī lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔbá nū ɔwɛ dóódu. Ɔ́dáŋ ka ɔbá nū kōō wɛ olɔdu ámāŋ olɛɛhá.

eng_Latn: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ kpó, anɔ́ɔ é cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ aɔ́mpa nū ijē, klla gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔdōlé klla gbɔɔ́ ō gwá ejé mɛ́mla ācɛ ogwéjé fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōce ā nɛ̄ alɔ jé kéē yá ɛcɛ nyā ŋmá lɛ ɛlā okónu kú Ɔwɔicō, é kē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē má ā ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ í má ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla Uhɛ́burɔn. Ó le tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tɛtɛ yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá, é yɔ̄ ī lɔnyā igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ukéna kú Ugálīli. Ɛ́nɛ́ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō í tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ, n géē yɛ í gekwú le tá ɔlékwū gbojī ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ ōhī nēe bá abɔ́ɔ cāŋ́jɛ le pɛ́ wā ɛcɛ á. É da odúúdú ojíla kú ācɛ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ í ka ka, aá má ɔ̄ o, ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ yɔ̄ á ā? Ehée, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā tɛtɛ le yá íkííkée gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ma alɔ á.

eng_Latn: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá, aóklóbīya um ā, gē pllá um klla ī já um bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́kpá nēe gē je ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í yā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔnyā ɔ́mpa lɛ, ó géē yɔ̄ ī je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdōlé mɛ́mla īlī ō tōōhí mɛ́mla ukpɛ̄ kú íkwu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔbá lɛ ɔnyā aflɛ́yí kú nū ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ alɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɔtū ɛ́ɛ nōó kɛlā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Īī gbóó, é tá ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū alɔ. Ācɛ nēe gē hɛ́hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē cē í wú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, cíkā ō yúklɔ́ kú uwā yɔ̄ gē leyīce ka aá lɔfú lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā, le tútū kéē kpɛ́fú ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ. Ujóssuwa kē le gbo ɔpɛ́ abɔ́ɔ otú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúú í kpla uwā ɛhá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā nōo lɛ ajɛ ámāŋ ka inu ā, kwú uwā ú kpó lá, anɔ́ɔ é le ije kú nū kpó tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísaa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, géē leyīkwu odúúdú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú agege kú nū, ɔtulāli mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄da, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ō tū ɛyí mɛ́mla ɔdɔ̄há dóódu nēé le tīihɔ lɛ́ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile dóódu nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
idu_Latn: É kē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ācɛ oŋmó ŋ́, ámāŋ ka imabɔ̄ kú uwā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ajā nēé ī gbo ā mɛ́mla ikpɔ́nyā nēé gē ce ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ka uwī nēé gē wī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nōo pīyɛyí wā mla uwá ŋmá aípɔ́ɔma kú Udeláya mɛ́mla Utobíya mɛ́mla Unekóda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Utelméla mɛ́mla ācɛ Utelihása mɛ́mla Ucérūbu mɛ́mla Ádām mɛ́mla Immer.

eng_Latn: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ka ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, é géē gbā Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɛ̄gbā. Ɛ́ɛ klla í gbā ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ anúɔ géē je ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ohilí nū tá úŋmóō, anɔ́ɔ ohilí nū ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ uwá má, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛga néē bá ā ka lɛ Ujóssuwa á.

eng_Latn: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
idu_Latn: Agidigbé yɛ gicō ga inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā. Ɔwá kú nū wɛ wɛ umíta igwó, ipú kú nū kē umíta ɛhīlī. Aúpíla ɛpa bá ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa kú okónɔɔwɛ ā. Éyi yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ kú nū, éyi kē yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta yá ɔ̄ abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Da alɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōó gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mla aítíca kú íne ā yá Ujísɔ̄si ɛbɛ́ dúú á. É bá yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ aɔ́mpa uwā ka Ó nya ācɛ ɔhá tá, amáŋ ó nya iyīnū tá glá ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí alɛwa gaá le gla ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā géē tū ujɔ̄ tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya, klla í je ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū lɛ ɔ́ kóō le pīya ɔ̄nyā nū. Amáŋ, ujɔ̄ nēé tū nyā í gáā gbojī ŋ́. É géē je ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nú ā mɛ́mla ɔbá nū ā mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe géē nyɔ̄ Usiríya mɛ́mla anú ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
idu_Latn: É géē je Usedekíya ga Ubábīlɔn. Ó kē í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le yá mɛ mla anú. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóó kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn nááná, ó gáā yá uwá lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
idu_Latn: Ómri mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwúcē ŋmá Ugibɛ́tɔn nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ Utɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó wā í pīya tū ɔ̄ kpɔ́. Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ yá lɛ ā kpɔ́. É klla le yá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā igbo ɔ́mɛtá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um á. Ami yá aá á, Ísrɛ̄lu. Ami kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔkōōlɔhi ā lɔfú lɛ ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē gwéeyē ohígbū aá. Amáŋ n tínē ká aá jé ɔdā nōo lɔhi, amáŋ aá kwú pīya ogwuda ɛgiyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá.

eng_Latn: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da uwá ka anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā, ayí uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā ōfōōfū uwā géē bá ajɛ, nɛ̄ anúɔ kɔ̄ lɛ uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
idu_Latn: Uhananíya, ɔyí kú Ussɛlɛmíya mɛ́mla Uhánɔn, ɔyí ɔ́mɛhīlī kú Usálāfu klla ma ɔdɔ gboce ɔ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ igbo ɔ́mpa kú āyā kú ɔdɔ nēé ma á. Uméssūlam, ɔyí kú Ubérekíya ma āyā kú ɔdɔ nōo kwu iyɔ̄bū ɔlɛ́ nū ā á.

eng_Latn: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le má ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ācɛ ohile ā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka Udánīyɛlu, Uhananíya, Umíssɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Asárīya ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā í kpó bá kéē wɛ ācɛ nēe í tá ohi ɛlā kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔ́ ā ú kwúcē wā āhɔ̄ kú nū kóō je ejé lɛ ɔ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā wɛ ɔdā ō bī nwū alɔ ɛlā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ eyīyōce lɛ ŋmá lɛ ɔtū ō lé mɛ́mla ɔtū ō tū kwu ɔtū nɛ̄ ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ī je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ aólɛlā alɛwa, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í kē pīya igbīhi kwu alɔ ŋ́, eko nēé lɛ alɔ cē gwōnū ekoōhī, alɔ kē ī cāŋ́jɛ í gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, eko géē wā, eko ā kōō gā ɛɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ogekwú géē pó ɔkɔ kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ācɛ nēe kē pó ā géē yēeyī.
