eng_Latn: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe hɛ́ apī nááná ā, í lɛ íne ā tū abɔ̄yī uwā ŋ́. Amáŋ é tíne ká aá lɛ apī hɛ́ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwō ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú uculo kú ɔkpíye ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē kpó aótrɛ̄yí nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ uwá nēe ī nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē wā ī wu ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le tá inu ā, é bōōbū le yɛ ga inu eyīpú, ɛga nɛ̄ Íssbɔ̄ssɛti yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā lipú lipú ā. É le ɛwa gwū ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ ikpɛ̄yí hɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú īkpɛ̄yí ā ú le yɛ otōōtú ɔ́ɔmā gaá bū ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan jāā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
idu_Latn: Ɔmáapú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ā géē gwɔ́ɔ́ci kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēé ŋmó ā, O ŋmá lɛ o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔmáapú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo hi aá igwú kú aá kwú pīya ákú nū ā, kē í yá ɔ̄ glá, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔtūce ɔ́ glá.

eng_Latn: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɛ gɔbū lígíí ā, ó kwú okwúukwu ú kwajɛ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kahíníī, Ádā um, ɔ́dāŋ́ koó tɔ́ɔtɛ́, yá kéē kwú íkókwū nyā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Nááná ā, ó wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā gáā yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ a tíne ā kóō yá.

eng_Latn: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā gā uwɔ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um nyatá fíyaa. Gbō um ká ā lɛ um nyatá bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda ɔkplɛ́fú ō kwu nyɔ̄ kú um á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uféro da uwa ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ Óndú ā nɛ̄ n géē pó ɔkɔ kú nū, nɛ̄ n géē cɛ̄ lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ āa? Ń jé Óndú ā ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē cɛ̄ lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ ipú um ā, n kē ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ ipú odúúdú Akáya nōo lɔfú ka ka n híīī gwō ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́ nɛɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kɛpɔ̄, klla í ka aéwo nɛ̄hi alɛwa gwó. É géē kpó aɔ́kpacaŋ́gelī o bī kpɛ́fú kú uwā kpó na aɛ́nū ō bī hɛ́ɛ̄hɔ̄. É klla í je aóbō kú uwá kpó na aɛ́wā ō bī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄. Aéwo í klla gáā kpɛ́fú tú ɔ́mpā uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É klla gáā kllɔcɛ́ ɛfú ō kpó ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ okónu ce ipú ígbíli abɔ́ɔ ka, ń klla gáā bī uwá ga ipú ajɛ olɔhi lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdāajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú, nɛ̄ n cokónu nū lɛ uwá ka n géē kpó uwá nyɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
idu_Latn: Alɔ ka ɛ̄nyā oŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo yá kú alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
idu_Latn: É yá ɔdā ōcābɔ̄ kú nū ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā, ó klla yá ɔdā idáagó alɛwa ipú ajɛ kú Uhám.

eng_Latn: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá ō bī miya ɔdā bī abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa le tá Udamáskɔ̄si eko nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā yɔ̄ gē doōcē ā. Eko nēé le da ɔcɛ́ ā ka Ɛláyíssa ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā tá ɛ́nɛ́ nū ohi ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ba anúɔ ka anúɔ kwú Abíssāgi ú lɛ Adónīja ā? Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɛ́nɛ́ nū kóō kē í yɛ í le ba anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ kē kwú ɔcɛ́ ú lɛ Adónīja ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ lé béekpóó dúú. Ó ka abɔ̄ aá kē ī ka nááná, anú ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú anúɔ á. Abíyata, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla Ujówābu ɛ́ɛ kē yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔnū nāa cɛ̄ ā. Odúúdú iyē kú um í lɛ ɔbɔ́lā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin, but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu klla le óbō tá kā anúɔ lɛ Udéfīdi bū kwu ɔdɔ, amáŋ Udéfīdi le fō beé, anɔ́ɔ óbō ā gāá kwu ɔdɔ kli. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le plá wɛɛlɛ, kwú kwu á.

eng_Latn: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Uhilikáya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɔkpá ɔhá je gā um kpɔ́ Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkpá ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le túbla Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ lɛ ɔ́ má eyī ā, ó le ikwū je ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
idu_Latn: Aígelī kú ajɛ Ubábīlɔn kwú pīya alácɛ̄,nōó tōō má eyī ŋ́. Ó kwú pīya ajɛ íkpākplā bɛ̄ɛka ipú ígbíli, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā anú, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē bū ɔ̄ ipú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aɔ́dā ō cābɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ yɛ nyɔ̄ kpó kwaajɛ ɔwɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cābɔ̄ ɔwɛ lɛ aá. Aá tíne ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá yɛ nyɔ̄ ā. Aá kwúcē bū ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí wā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Aá lɛ bɛ̄ɛka ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ ó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā tū ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā lɛ ɔ́ ā. Aá kwúcē wā aígelī nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá anú ā.

eng_Latn: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā ōhilókplícī nɛ̄hi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē nū le ka Ána, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ufánūwɛlu nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa da ācɛ ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ahāapa nēe bī opo kú ajī ɛbɛ́ ā má gbɔbū yɔ̄ í tá opo. Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā kē yɛce uwá.

eng_Latn: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
idu_Latn: Umaná ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄cí lígíí-lígíí, ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ mla odo ā.

eng_Latn: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne ká ā nya oyēeyī kú nū tá, ó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwú oyēeyī kú nū í tónú ohígbū um mɛ́mla ohígbū ɔkōōlɔhi ā, é géē nyá ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ōhī kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, aá gē tíne um, ó wɛ ohígbū úklɔ́ ō hídáagó kú um nɛ̄ aá má ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ka aá le igbō lé lɛ ipú nū ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
idu_Latn: klla gē je ijē tū akwunugba. Ó géē yēeyī nɛɛ? Ehée! Ó gáā yēeyī ŋ́. Abɔ̄ ó gē yá odúúdú aúcē ɛbí nyā á, ó géē kwú. Anú ŋmó īyī nū á.

eng_Latn: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lā iháyí úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄kā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísɔ nēé hī ka Ɛ́dɔm ā á.

eng_Latn: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Áá lɛ Ubatisséba hīgwú ga um. Anɔ́ɔ ó gā ipú inu gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō je ayí igwɛ́ɛnɛ nyā mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɛtá lɛ Uhɛ́mān, nōo wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ, ka anúɔ géē kpó ayí nyā lɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú je lɛ Uhɛ́mān.

eng_Latn: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
idu_Latn: Otú odúúdú aíkpokwú kú um gē lɔnɔ tū um. Ɔnɔ nōo ī cɛ̄ gā um móōwē, í kē ī mɛ ŋ́ otú gbɔɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam kahíníī, Ɛhɔ̄ kú Ubálam ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ, ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē mɛ́ɛbɛ yēŋēē ā.

eng_Latn: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ o hile ā, je ŋmá ipú agbénú o lɛ cabá kú uwā. Amáŋ anú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o kwɛ́há lɛ ā, ó kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔlɛ́ kwɛcɛ ā ú tá ɔ̄. Ije kú oyēeyī kú nū nɛ̄ ó je tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, aá nēe gē gbā Óndú ā, aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
idu_Latn: Ahímāasi nōo lɛ Ubásēmati, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usólōmɔn ɔhá ā, wɛ Ugbómína kú Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
idu_Latn: Ɔtulalī yɔ̄ ī kpóocu īlī kú uwɔ kwūū. Ācɛ ogwíijē, gē gwíijē gā awɔ, ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ nāa yíifa mla ayīnu adāgbá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ aá ka wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó lɛ ā, aá le tútū kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ipéyī Óndú ā ŋmá amānyā.

eng_Latn: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē tū ínálēgbé klá uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tū klá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ó klla ka odúúdú iyē kú uwā géē je pīya ipíípí. Ó ka ikplɔ́fú géē cē klá uwá iyē nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔ klla í cɛ̄ lɛ iyē í wá uwā nɛ̄hi. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ɛcí ō yá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa nēe cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā le pɛ́ wā gaá lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe húmáyī ī yá ā kpó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ufarísīi ā, aá gē nyā iyɛ̄cɛ kú ikókwū mɛ́mla ocíbú kú aá. Amáŋ eyīpú kú aá le mu mla ɔdābɔ̄fú mɛ́mla ɔbíipú.

eng_Latn: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ kú ā nyɔ̄ ga Unínīfɛ, ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ā, cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
idu_Latn: Éwɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ a hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ nēé bá ī cɛ̄ ā, klla kwú uwā ú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ɛcɛ pó ofu uwɔ kú ɔdā ohídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a yá lɛ uwá ā. A lɛ ācɛ kú uwɔ kpó hɛ́tá ŋmá Íjīpiti klla lɛ aéwɔhá kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ nyā hīla uwá tá.

eng_Latn: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
idu_Latn: Aá je ahɔ̄, Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ. Aá lɛ eyī tá ajɛ kú otúta kú ɔdā oocēabɔ̄, nēé gāa je ga icō ɛyí ɛfu a. Aá jāhɔ̄ la ofulutu, nōo gē tá wā kwūūū á.

eng_Latn: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá gwííjē kú aá, gwéeyē, ācɛ kú Usáyɔn. N géē wā í lā ipú aá.

eng_Latn: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda gwutá ajɛ ipú ɔtūnōbí, Ujerúsālɛm kē yɔ̄ ī jikwū kéē wā í tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ádā nū tá, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N jé ɔyí um. N jé. Ayááyí kú Umanásɛ ā géē pīya éwo nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ géē nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ á. Ayááyí kú nū géē je pīya aéwo nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ olufa ā lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā má ā, é ka lɛ īyī uwā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olúgwū á, aá wā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ká úgwū kú nū kóō le pīya ákú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Ákisi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ oklóbīya anúɔ nɛɛ, ɔ́ɔ kwú igēlī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi ú lɛ anúɔ kú anúɔ lā anú. Ó ka ó lɔhi ka anúɔ mɛ́mla anú lā tɔ̄há ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ágábáidú ŋ́, ɔkpani.

eng_Latn: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, lɛ alɔ nyatá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ alɔ kwúcē wā ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ tá awɔ nɛ̄ iyē kú uwɔ tīihɔ ā ahínyá, ká alɔ bá ī gwíije ī cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n lɛ aá ɔtū bīya, ó lɛ ā, ɔ̄nyɛ̄ kē í yá kú ɔtū kóō he um mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Aá piíí nɛ̄ n bīya ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um nōo wɛ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ dúú ā, n klla wɛ ijáalí kú ōwē nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá má ā, n kē géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔfú kú nū nɛ̄ ācɛ dóódu géē má ānāānā ā. N gē lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú icɔ́ɔci nēe bá ipú aá ā kéē leyīkwu ígwu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó tū uwā ipú icɔ́ɔci ā.

eng_Latn: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Upɔ́lu, le ɔ́ bī wā iyɔ̄bū aígabɔ̄ kú igelī ā, nēé hī ka Arɛyopágɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Á géē lɔfú da alɔ ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nāa gē nwū nyā glá ā?.

eng_Latn: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́, Usólōmɔn lɛ agbénú klla jíjééyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
idu_Latn: káā má ɛdɔ ajɛ nɛ̄ó wɛ ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā, ɔ́dāŋ keé wɛ ācɛ okwáahi amáŋ keé wɛ ācɛ olɔfú, ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛwa ámāŋ keé le ligíí.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú je īyī uwɔ ka anúɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi glá, amáŋ Óndú ā gáā kpákli bī uwɔ je uwɔ tá ɛcɔ̄ tónū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
idu_Latn: É lɛ iyē kú ipíinu dóódu nyā tá tāajɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ nēe ī yá kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā, Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya le kwu ajɛ lɛ ā. É géē yúklɔ́ nyā ipú ɛyí ōtáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ jila má gbɔbū, Ɔwɔicō í gáā kɛpɔ̄ tū alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔcí gbā ce okónu nū biílí nɛ̄ olɔwá kú nū géē wɛ ayíkābɔ̄ éyi. A klla géē ma ugóólu klá anú biílí dúú.

eng_Latn: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le bēhé wā ipú ɔ́kɔ ɛgiyí uwā, anɔ́ɔ owu ā mɛ tāajɛ miyooo á. Ayíkpó ā le kpó hídáagó.

eng_Latn: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu lɛ Ussɛrɛ́sa mɛ́mla Uregɛmɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō hɔ́hā ce uwá.

eng_Latn: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū nōo gē yá kú ālɔ̄ bá ɛbɔ́ ā, kóō yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́ dúúdú, eko dóódu. Óndú ā kóō yɔ mla odúúdú aá kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā ōhī kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ úwé ɛpa kóō kwú éyi í kpó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ŋ́ mā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɔdolé kóō kɔ̄ ɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, kwú ɔtū kú uwɔ ú gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yɛ tá íkpa kú um.

eng_Latn: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ fíyaa ga ɛgiyí ádā um, kú aá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu ɔyí uwɔ ka lɛ á. Ɔwɔicō lɛ um pīya ɔkpani kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Wā ɛgiyí um, ā kpó eko bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, odúúdú aá í gáā je pīya aítíca glá ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé ka Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ olɔfú tū alɔ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe gē nwū ɛlā kú nū ā fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā gē gbɛlá ka ije ká aá gē gbō aá ŋmá unwalu bɛ̄ɛka igá o lɔfú o lico nɛ̄hi kú igelī nɛ̄hi nōo gē gbō ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā má ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē bū ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā máfú lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ínoōbīya kú uwɔ kpó bónu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ojuja nyɔ̄ ā. N kē kwú ɔ́bíipú kú uwɔ í mlányi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ébú gē bítāajɛ ā. Kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um, ohígbū ka n lɛ uwɔ fūla ká ā le hɛ́tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔkpɛtā tū klá ajɛ kú uwā, klla kwú odúúdú ɔdōlé kú uwū í kpó.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhówāsi gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ipú únóji kú ɔcɛ́ Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ ɔyínu Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
idu_Latn: N le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla aéwo o yá ɔbɔ́cɛ nēe bá cíí ipú ɛbɔ́ ā abālɔbányā ā. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū lígíí mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā yá ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē móōwē fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ehée, ó lɛ ā ŋ́! Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ uwɔ ŋmó, n géē gwō ɔ̄ ɔ́ci mɛ́mla ikpɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ahāapa ŋmá ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le Ukéni fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ Ukéni má, kóō híī ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ā lɔfú yá gā uwɔ glá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Ācɛ nɛ̄ a húmáyī nyɔ̄ ī má piyóó ipu odúúdú oyēēyī kú uwɔ ā, odúúdú uwá géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gwū uwɔ tá, ga ɔwɛ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā. Odúúmā kú uwā í gáā hile nōo géē nya uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ā híī je um ŋmá amānyā abālɔbányā ɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ je hīla ŋ́. Óndú, a yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá le ɛya gwó igbeékpónú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā, ɛya ōgwó nōo tīile piyóó, anɔ́ɔ ó má cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔyínɔ̄yīlɔ ā lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛyitáajɛ lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ŋ́, í gáā má oyēeyī ŋ́, amáŋ ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō géē yɔ̄ ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācopúgbényi ā tíne kéē le kwu ŋmá ipú úgbéenyi ā, é kwú ɔ́kɔ ā pi tá ipú éŋkpɔ̄ le ula yá ka aá nyɔ̄ gáā kpó ánkɔ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū kú úgbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo yɔ̄ ī tōoje ā. Ācohɛ́pɔ̄ kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka odumú kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nɛ̄ ágágā ō hɛ́ í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ habɔ̄ ikpokwú éékpó tá gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
idu_Latn: N gē cījáalí lɛ iyī um, Ádā nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā kē í cījáalí gā um.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwu úgbáajɛ kú aɔ́bá ɛna mɛ́mla aɔ́bá ɛna ā ú kpó lɛ ayí Ulífāyia.

eng_Latn: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwá á. É géē pīyatɔ̄ha ɛháajɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá ékpónú, klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um dóódu kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
idu_Latn: Odo kú um yɔ̄ ī gbēyī Óndú ā fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāajɛ otú gē gbēyī kú eyī kóō nyā ā.

eng_Latn: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Usólōmɔn gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Ástārɔtu, ɛcí kú ācɛ kú Usídɔn ā, mɛ́mla Umílkom, ɛcí kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn ā, ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo géē ca Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, nōo kē í gwó ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá glá ā, lɛ iyī uwɔ hɛ́tá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, gā ajɛ ŋmá ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
idu_Latn: Aá géē ka ɔ́lá kú nū oŋmá áluka kú iháyí nɛ̄ ajɛ ā géē lɔfú yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ glá ā gaá kwu gbɔbū lɛ iháyí kú ohabɔ̄ ajɛ tá ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ āhɔ̄ kú um lɛ ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Ɛnɔ gē cɛ̄ um ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ofū kē ī ŋmó um otú. N kē ī gbiyɔ̄lā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ohílīpú kú um kwúcē wā ɛgiyī um, é le ojīlīmā kú um, ɛgahi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um kpó cīgbīhi gā um. Aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yi kú ɔlɛ́ um le um tá omáabā. Anɔ́ɔ é kē kwú ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ kú um ú kpó gā um mɛ́mla ojīlīmā nōo fíyɛ́ ákú otɛtɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá nɛ̄ n tá fu aá ā lɛ aá ɔtū bīya, amáŋ ń híjémā ka n tá ɔkpá ā ŋ́. Ó kwú um iyē eko kpiíí dúú, ohígbū ka n le jé ka ɔkpá ā lɛ aá ɔtū bīya, nááná nɛ̄ aá cɔ̄nū gbojī ajɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛnyā ɔhá dóódu. Ó klla le ɔhá hɛ́ ce ɔyí nɛ̄ a géē ma ā.

eng_Latn: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū unwalu alɛwa nēe yɔ̄ ī yá um ā, n le ikwū je klá Óndú.

eng_Latn: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā jajikpáakpáa, lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔ́ iyē á.

eng_Latn: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔtū kú um kwú gbenyi ā, a kē yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā. É le ukpa jē tayínū gbēyī um ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
idu_Latn: A lɛ owu tū klá ísu, ó kwú tīkwú háyicō gónóó, ó maháyi icō kpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ ā. Ɛga nōo liipú fíyɛ́ kú ipú ísu ā le ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ kloklo.

eng_Latn: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le bū ipú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛfrēm ā gāá bū ipú ajɛ kú Ussálim, amáŋ é má aijakī ā ŋ́. É klla gāá le bū ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn, amáŋ é má aíjakī ā ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú, klla ī yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ó klla jé ɔ̄ yá óbé ije nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū ɔtōoce kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄ ó gáā ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔdōbɔ̄bi nāa yá ŋ́, ācɛ ōhī í ge jahɔ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔtū kú uwa ge ŋmó uwá ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é le yá kú ɔtōōce kú uwa kú o le gbliífi.

eng_Latn: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá ŋmá ɛjī kú Íjīpiti ɛháajɛ kú Uhámati gaá bū ɛhícō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka uwá kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā bī wā ŋmá Ukɛríyati Ujeyarím wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le eyī hɛ́ kwu uwá, yɔ̄ ī leyīce ka anúɔ géē lɛ ɔdée ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
idu_Latn: É klla kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ ayí ōhī kú ipɔ́ɔ́nu kú Ukóhāti ā ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem dúú.

eng_Latn: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē nyɔ̄ ī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ā gē kpó unwalu alɛwa klá iyī uwā N gáā pā aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō ī hē iyē kú uwā ŋmá okónu kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ujɔ́ni wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ipú ɔkpíihɔ á. É tá kahíníī, N géē tū ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um kóō nyɔ̄ gbɔbū ga awɔ kóō lɛ ɔwɛ tútū gbēyī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi da otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú nū ā ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nyá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́tro, ádā ɔnyā kú Umósīsi lɛ ɛya o yɔlá. dúúdú gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni wā mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, gaá lɛ ɔdōlé lé mla ohilí kú Umósīsi ipéyī Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípōklóbīya éyi lé ka Usɔ́lu, ó kē cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ŋmó Usitífin ā. Anɔ́ɔ oŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā oyáŋmó nɛ̄hi le hútu lɛyíkwu icɔ́ɔci nōo yɔ̄ ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā kwú pahīla bá ɛbɛɛbɛ kwu ajɛ kú Ujudíya mɛ́mla Usamérīya. Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ōfōōfū uwā bá ɛga ékpó mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
idu_Latn: N géē ya uwā ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ aéwɔhá géē yúúfi. É í je pīya ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ í yá uwā okónu, í yá uwā ɛbɛ́, klla í bī iyē uwā le tókónū lɛ ɔ́mpā uwā. Abɔ̄ ó gáā lɛ ā lɛ uwá ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ n géē fíyá uwā ákátā nyɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a gē má um abālɔbányā, amáŋ á gáā má um ŋ́ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. A géē tíne um, amáŋ n géē gekwú le yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. É í je Ujerúsālɛm yíífi piíí ohígbū kóō wɛ igelī kú ācɛ o ŋmó ācɛ. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄hī nɛ̄ ipú nū le tɛ́kla nēé kē na ɛ́kla ā ŋmá anú ŋ mā. É gē kpó ɛbɛ́ a ŋmá anú éyééye gbéeko nɛ̄ odúúmā í gáā hile ipú ɛ̄hī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána ma ayí ɛpa: Amasáyi mɛ́mla Ahímɔ̄tu.

eng_Latn: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
idu_Latn: Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ō yá nɛ̄hi gē je ɔ̄cɛ yíífi. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kē leyī gwō ācɛ bónū nɛɛ, é géē tá uwɔ wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
idu_Latn: É lá ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú nū ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Uhɛ́ti.

eng_Latn: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā dóódu í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ Umósīsi tá tāajɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa í jé ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ó jé ɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ, kwu aéwɔhá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lā Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa yɔ̄ i jé ɔkpá kú íne nyā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn géē wā í ce íbɔm tū ɔ, kéē kpó ācɛ alɛwa ŋmó ā, aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā nááná í gáā lɔfú tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛ ɔbá lɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá, ajɛ kú uwā ā í je pīya ákú ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú alɔ kwú cē nyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ka ayááyí kú Udéfīdi ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ī cɔcɛ́ piyóó ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi géē wā, nɛ̄ ɛyí ɛfu, ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kwu ā géē wɛ ɛga o cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā. Aéwo alɛwa géē bá ī pɛ́ ga abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔyínɔnya ékpó kú nū nōo wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa ā, yɔ̄ í kwú. Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ɛwa kú ācɛ ā yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ klá anú ŋmá áklō dóódu.

eng_Latn: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ jāā kwu ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ́ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī kú uwā má ámāŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ kú uwā pó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ká é lɛ ɔyí éyi ma la alɔ ɛɛ́; é kwú ɔyí éyi ú lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Igɛ́mɛ́nti ce ácábɔ̄ kú nū; é kē í hī iyē kú nū ka, Ɔwɔicō Idáagó, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, Ádā ogbéegbé ɛcɛ, Ɔcɛ́ kú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ahātá ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū le tū ā, ó gē ga Ubɛ́tɛlu gaá gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā, gáā ya ucɛ kú ɛcí nōó le kwu ajɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔfú kú ɛcɔ̄ ifa ō gbā kóō kpó kwu īlī, ákú ɔcí ōgbā mɛ́mla ɛdɔ úklábɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfu fíyɛ́ dúú kahíníī, Abɔ̄ aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka lɛ aá ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄gbā okónu nēé gē gbā um á. É gē nwū íjééyī kú ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó wɛ íne kú um āa.

eng_Latn: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū lé, ācɛ Ufílīstiya, aá kpɛ́fú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyīlɔ ā, ámāŋ alɔ kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ācɛ Uhíburu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔkplɛ́fú ofu igwó kú ugóolu nēé ca báajɛ pátáká nōo gbɛnú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú īkpīje nēé hī usɛ́kɛlu úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛta ce ɛhīlī ā.

eng_Latn: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū klla le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔgɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō hī Usɔ́lu igwú kahíníī, Óndú um. Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu pīyeyī le ɔ́ má ā, Udéfīdi túkpɛɛ́ le okónu kú ojīlīmā hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā, kē kwu um ajaajɛ, ɔ̄cɛ lɔtūce odúúdú íne kú nū ā glá.

eng_Latn: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɛɛ́, le ɔdā olɔhi yá ɛɛ́. Ó mafú gā uwɔ ka Óndú ā le ɔdā olɔhi yá gā uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
idu_Latn: Ísu éyi gē pɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ídɛn nōo gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɛhɔ̄ ā. O ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ ā ísu ā kwú kɔ̄ le pīya ísu ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
idu_Latn: Odo mla iyē kú um lɔfú kwáahi glá, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔfú kú um á, anú ōfōōfūnū ce um ɛgbá á.

eng_Latn: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um bá ī cá um ɛcá eko dóódu. Ācɛ nēe ī yá um okónu ā, klla bá ī bī iyē kú um gē le tókónu lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And his father in law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
idu_Latn: Ádā odiyɔ̄ ā kóō yɔ̄ mla aá yɛɛ ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ mla uwá ɛ̄cī ɛtá. É lé ɔdōlé klla gbo abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmá, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. É géē jé lɛ ā ohígbū ka n lɛ uwá kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, anɔ́ɔ n klla lɛ uwá túbá klla kpó uwá kwúcē wā ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā. Ń klla habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá tá abɔ́ɔ ŋ.

eng_Latn: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ n le glá uwá ā, n lɛ ɔ́ má. N gāá bī ɔ̄ kli, n klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ipú inū kú ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ um, ipú īnu ɛga nēé ma um piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, aá lɛ iyī aá tū ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛcí.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá gáā lé ɛbɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le ŋmó ŋ́, ikɔkɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ aéwɔhá ā kéē lé.

eng_Latn: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú áluka kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ákú ayí kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn ā wɛ, ofigwáahāanɛ ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā da uwá ka, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya tíne kóō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya lɔtūce ɔ́ lɛ ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ̄cī éyi, Ujósɛ̄fu le yɛ tá ipú inu gaá yúklɔ́ kú nū, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
idu_Latn: N le īlī agōdo kú ulínin o lɛ ukɔ́lɔ olɔhi kú Íjīpiti kpó nā klá agōdo kú um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabeshgilead to the assembly.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé dɔɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ ŋmá aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōó ga Umíspa ŋ́ mā, é le jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ŋmá Ujábɛssi ipú Ugílɛ̄di nyɔ̄ Umíspa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ o bīyíne plla uwɔ nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā í lɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ō je lɛ aádáádā uwā, Ábrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā.

eng_Latn: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ā mla ɔdā nōo yá ɔwá kú aókóome ā, le ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó ka lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cí dóódu ɔnyɔɔnyɛ gē nyɔ̄ ī kpó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgbá kú nū lɛ ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi, ɔdā nōo hile bá ajɛ ā kwú kpó ja tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um yɔ̄ ī yɛ fíyaa, ɔdōōlɔhi dóódu í kē yá gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ugása le jé ka Usámsin ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ. É le abɔ́ɔ yɛ jīla tá, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī gbēyī nū okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í yá uya ŋ́, é bá símm. É da īyī uwā ka aá gbēyī gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī gbɔɔ́ ō nyā ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi kú alɔ lɛ ɛma okpaakpa lɛ mla Ɔwɔicō ohígbū opīyatɔ̄há kú alɔ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá ɛ̄nyā ā anɔ́ɔ é le má ka alɔ wɛ ācobīyíne ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā wɛ ā, ɔ́mā lé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ī cɛ̄lā kú íne ō bīya kɛ̄ɛ? Ó lɛ ā gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
idu_Latn: Ómíci ō je lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcí imabɔ̄ ā lɛ ācɛ nēe gē je ā. É gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá gē dɔɔ̄kā ā glá.

eng_Latn: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le um nyatá ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um ā. A kē cɛ̄ ga um wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aéwo alɛwa kpɔ́. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ń tɛtɛ jé ŋ́ mā, kwu pīya ācɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
idu_Latn: Á gaá yúufi aálelékwū obɔ̄bí nēe gē yɛ otú ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē yúufi ámíyā nōo ī yá acígilí ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um. N géē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka, Mā um tá cííí, ká n jikwū ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, nēe pɛ́ kwú ā. Á hii tá um ɔtūlé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka agwú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwú, é géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ā wā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ikwú kú Ábna pó ā, ó kahíníī, Óndú ā jé ka ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā í lɛ abɔ̄ ipú ikwū kú Ábna ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi le pó ka ācɛ le túbá ígwíígwu okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā bá ī jīkwu ā. Ó le kwú Umósīsi iyē nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá jāhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aá gē pó ŋ́. Aá kē mā ucē obɔ̄bí kú aá, ō gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō kwu ícɛ nyā, eko dúú nēé jé ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi tɛ́ɛcɛ, īlī gē klá ɔtū kú uwā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí géē hɛ́ alɔ ŋmá ihɔtū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá glá ā? Ɛ́kɛma kɛ̄ɛ ka íwɔ́tū, kɛ̄ɛ ka oyáŋmó, kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔkpɛtā, kɛ̄ɛ ka ohɛ́ɛwa, kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔdā ō kwu ikwū ajaajɛ ámāŋ ka ikwū kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā le jé igbīhāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é kwú nū Usedekíya ɔcɛ́ ā, jāā gbéeko nēé gáā lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ipú ajɛ kpátáá nōo kwu pīyɛ Ujérīko ā. Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā le fíyákátā hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ga ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, íne nɛ̄ n gē tá fu aá kpɔ́ɔ́kpɔ́ abālɔbányā ā wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, ohígbū keé ī má ɔkwɛ̄yi kú íne nyā bū ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá mla ipú aá. Ohígbū ka ajoodobū ā yɔ̄ gē mɛ ɛɛ́, ɔlá-ofíyajɛ kú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā yɔ̄ gē fíyajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē kpɛ́lā ce um ā? Aá kē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um á.

eng_Latn: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
idu_Latn: Usáyɔn, ɛyí ɛfú kú Ɔwɔicō ā, licō lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Igelī nɛ̄hi, ɔlɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā gē bī éeyē gē lɛ odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
idu_Latn: Eko otɛtɛ ā, ó cɛ̄ ka éwo dóódu kéē yāwu ɔwɛ kú ɔtú uwā.

eng_Latn: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
idu_Latn: N dɛ̄gba hī Óndú ā igwú, n le ɛ̄ba ba ɔ́, kóō tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD, and made vows.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā yúufi Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi á. É le ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú ā klla le okónu ce ka aá géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá ā kahíníī, Māháyi ká ālɔ̄ má ɔ̄ ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɛláyíja géē wā gaá nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
idu_Latn: A klla í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu nēe bī igabɔ̄ éyi ámāŋ́ ka ɔhá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā géē bá ɛbɔ́ cíí. Ká ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ gē lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi ce Ɔwɔicō, ká ālɔ̄ yá ucē olɔhi.

eng_Latn: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le tá inu ā, eko nēé gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄ ā, géē je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú yāwu ɛyí ahɔ̄lá nɛ̄ ó gāa yi ɔ́ ikpó ɔlá ŋ́ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
idu_Latn: Íssmɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ igwó ā lɛ ɔkpacāŋ́gelī kú uwā kpó pi ŋmá apɛ́ kwú Ugɛdalíya ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔkpani, n géē klá amānyā kú n̄ cɔ̄ɔ̄fiyɛ kwɛyí ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛwa ā le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ɔtū le wú uwā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Átɛ̄misi kú ācɛ Ɛ́fēsɔsi nwunééné á.

eng_Latn: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó pīyɛ um ŋ́, gē yá iyī nū ágbe nɛ̄ n. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē wɔ́tū um, ayíka ikwū he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔfú lā ɔlɛ́ nū nōó tɛtɛ lā ā, eko nēé lɛ ōwō mi klá ɔlɛ́ ā kéē lɛ ōcē ā ŋmó bónū.

eng_Latn: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá ɔ̄ ohi ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí ā kahíníī, N má aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pahīla klá ɛyí ɛfu bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ō gbō uwá ŋ́ mā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ka, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o gbō uwá ŋ́, kéē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm gē yá mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē bī ɛpɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ hɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ uwá á. Ó bī ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā le ɔtū kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu pi wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu wɛ ákú um, kwu oyēeyī kú aɛ́nɛ́ mla aádā, mɛ́mla ákú ayí uwā. ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē kwú á.

eng_Latn: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
idu_Latn: Ubássan wɛ ɛfu nɛ̄hi nōo nwuné klla lɛ ɛga opílópíló alɛwa.

eng_Latn: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā wɛ otú nɛ̄ Óndú ā leyīkwɛcɛ gɛɛ kóō lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. É géē leyīkwɛcɛ otū gbɔ́ɔ̄cī iháyí dóódu, kóō kwú pīya uculo kú oblatu kú ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā ohígbū ɔdā nōó yá ɔ́ɔma, o ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyi ga ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Umébo ɔhá ā wɛ ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé í je Ubábīlɔn yíífi ā, é géē pó uya kú nū ā jāā ga ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛcɛ jīliyē ā. Aéwo ɔhá kē í pó íbáā nēé ī bá ī dɛ̄ Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
idu_Latn: Eyī kóō gbo aá gɔɔ mɛ́ɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bīyíne kú Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. N ka ɛ̄nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá kú uwēyī kóō kwú aá ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī kú aá í jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá nēé gē bī le já oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mla ugóolu má á. Amáŋ Óndú ā gē jé ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ má á.

eng_Latn: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
idu_Latn: Aá híī bī obɔ̄bí le cíla ulé obɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ aá cēyītīkwū kú aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ka kóō wɛ ɔdā olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú aɔ́dōwiyē kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ú kpó wu Árɔ̄ni iyē, ukafután, awulú nēé í wiiyē ɛháajɛ ɛ́fɔ̄du, ɛ́fɔ̄du abɔ̄yīnū, ɛkpa o bɔ́ɔ́tū, mɛ́mla ɔdōkwɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
idu_Latn: É kwú Unínīfɛ ú yíífi, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tá ipú nū gɛ ŋ́, ó kwú tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ufi cɛ̄ le ɔtū kú ācɛ kwú kpó wogodo ɛɛ́, okwúukwu kú ācɛ yɔ̄ í fīyégblú kpákpákpákpá. Ɛ́nyɔ́ hɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ abɔ̄, Ikpēyī kú ācɛ kwú kwányíhí.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā kahíníī, Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī kú unwalu mla ɛcá ō cá alɔ, mla uwēyī ō je lɛ alɔ. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔnyā ō yīīpú kwú ɛɛ́, amáŋ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā í má ɔ́fú nɛ̄ ó bī gbōkwici ma ɔyí ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá ā, ɛga kú uwɔ klla í tá fíyɛ́, nyɔ̄ gaá tayínū ɛga nāa tayínū eko nɛ̄ ɛlā nyā gbɔɔ́ ā. Nyɔ̄ gāá klá pí ɛcɔ̄ nēé tīkwū bá ā.

eng_Latn: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ mla aá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛ̄cī dóódu, aá kē kwú um ŋ́. Amáŋ eko nyā wɛ eko kú aá, eko nɛ̄ ebilíi, ɔ̄cogbaajɛ kú ajodobū cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē kwú ipú ajɛ Umówābu abɔ́ɔ, ka anúɔ í gáā bēhé ísu ā ŋ́. Ó ka amáŋ uwá ā, ɛ́ɛ gáā bēhé gaá mīyɛ ajɛ o yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
idu_Latn: Aá bá ī ka kahíníī, N le gbagbénú, ó kē le lɔhi ga um ɛɛ́. Aɔ́dā nēe ce um ɛgbá ā, n ké lɛ uwá kpó lɛ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá táncā, tēyīnyinyi, gbɛhá, peyī, klla tóohɛ́ɛwa lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbā aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ɛfu olicō, aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla útū ɔcí ōlū jugwu dóódu kpó ca tāajɛ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, n géē yɔ̄ ī je ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. N klla í je odúúdú uwā kpó nū ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Óndú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayí kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ɔ́ɔmā tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um dúú. É tá ō lɛ íne mla ɔ́da kú um, nōo gē bī oyēeyī gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā tū. É klla lɛ aɛ́cī nēé ī yúklɔ́ ŋ mā tá nyílá. N le tútū ō yá uwá ɛlā abɔ́ɔ ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū mla uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú uwá ú kpó ŋmó ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ le ajī ɛbɛ́ ɛnɛ má á.

eng_Latn: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ kú Aáklɔkpɛ ā gē gbɔɔ́ ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā. Ɔcɛ́ ā gē kpó aíyɛ́ɛya ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā kú ɛya nēé ī gwó ohígbū ɔ́bíipú, ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ákú anɔ̄ olífu ā le gwɛ́ɛya ɛ̄cī dóódu kú ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa kú ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē nū ācɛ nēe cíkā ō wɛ ācɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā bɛ̄cɛ ga ipú ajoodobū eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ. Abɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā géē jikwū klla í hīla ayīnu ipú ɔnɔ nēé í jé ā.

eng_Latn: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu da Amása kahíníī, A gbɛhiii, ɔmáapú um? Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu gaá le abɔ̄lɔ́ná bī ɔnwū agba kú Amása cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ bá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ojuja kpúm pi klá uwá ɛyí, ó klla kwú ɔlá ōfíyajɛ nɛ̄hi ú gbɔbū lɛ uwá kóō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mɛ́ɛbɛ otú.

eng_Latn: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Urésen nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Unínīfɛ mɛ́mla Ukála, nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā, gwó.

eng_Latn: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nēé nyatá ā í jé ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛwa nɛ̄hi bá abɔ́ɔ, Ujísɔ̄si kē le púla wɛɛlɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ɛ̄cī nēé gáā kpɛ́fú ɔ́ɔmā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā í lɛ ɔkpaccŋgelī, óbō ámāŋ ka iyɔ́fú ɛdɔ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, ayíka Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Ujonátan ōfōōfū uwā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
idu_Latn: Agbénú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ nɛ̄hi ā, í gáā tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ɔwɛ dúúmā glá ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ikwū kú nū gā. Amáŋ, okpaakpa mɛ́mla olɔhi gē nya ɔ̄cɛ tá ŋmá ikwū ámōōmɛ glá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, da ɛgwā ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá nyā, n le okónu tá lɛ awɔ ofōōfū uwɔ ŋmá ipú aɛ́bɛ́ dóódu ɛɛ́. Ókónu ō tá ā wɛ ka o ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū a géē lɛ ɔtū mɛ́mla ipú kú uwɔ pi ajɛ, úmúlá kē géē wɛ ɔdōlé kú uwɔ piyóó, ipū oyēeyī kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kahíníī, N le ɔ́da mɛ́mla ɛga je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ācogwɛ́ɛya, aúlífāyi, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm mla awɔ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
idu_Latn: Ása kwú odúúdú ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ádā nū Ábīja kpó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū je ā ú kpó bá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ínyíláɔwɔ dóódu kú ɔkpáncō a í gāa fíyajɛ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛnɔ géē je du obū, ɔyā í klá gāa fíyajɛ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nu gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū, é tá kéē mā ikwū ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ uwā.

eng_Latn: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nyā wɛ ádáádā alɔ Áyísīki. Eko nōó le jɛ̄ kwɛyí ā, ó le Urebɛ́ka lɛ, anú ma áplɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā eko dóódu. Odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā kéē cɛ̄tra anú piyóó.

eng_Latn: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ nū, klla kwu ɔ̄ ú kóō leyīkwu odúúdú agbénú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ gē yāwu ipú obū otú, ó géē gwōnū, ohígbū ka ɔlá-fíyajɛ í yɔ̄ mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
idu_Latn: Lɛ alɔ nyatá mla ɔfū kú uwɔ, pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ā yíihɔtū tá uwā ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ īyī nū tū wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɛ́ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā, ayíka anú nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
idu_Latn: Otū éyi, n lɛ ɔna obɔ̄bí nā, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbiyɔ̄lā lipú lipí ā.

eng_Latn: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɔhá í kōō cɛ̄ ka n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́, o lɛ áafú ŋ́, n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛgiyí aá. Ohígbū ka aá nēe le pīya ācɛ kú Óndú ā wɛ ijáalí ka n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyi.

eng_Latn: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ úklɔ́ kú Ujɔ́ni gáā mɛ ā, ó da ācɛ ā ka, Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka um wɛ ā? Ń wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ā ŋ́ Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē wā igbīhi um, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ń cíkā ká um plla áblákpá ŋmá ikpó kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: N le ɔ́ ŋmótū ka n géē kpó ūwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ é yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ōwē nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ uwá kpó ga ajɛ o lɔhi. Ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan, ācɛ Uhám, ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Upɛ́risi, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla Usébūsīt.

eng_Latn: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa ka lɛ ā, ɛpllá eko kú iháyí ɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó lɛ ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma.

eng_Latn: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
idu_Latn: Aá gē ka ka aá jéeyī ohígbū kā aá jé íne kú um ā. Amáŋ ācotɔ́kpá nēe ī cɔ̄ɔwɔ íne ā kwú íne kú um ā ú pīya ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je ābɔ̄ okpíyē kú aá dúúmā táajɛ kéē bī ɔ̄ le bīyíne ámāŋ́ ko bī ɔ̄ le bɔ̄bíipú ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá kwú iyī aá ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú iyī aá ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō dúúdú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī aá lɛ yúklɔ́ kú ɔdā nōo lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
idu_Latn: Ɔdōklá anú kú ɔkpá omlede nēé le ɔ́ tɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔ̄wá, mɛ́mla ákú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ɔhá olɔɔlɔhi mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin.

eng_Latn: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛlā ɛ́plla gē ŋmá okónu kú nū eko dóódu á. Ó gē yá ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ o jéeyī mɛ́mla ákú ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujúda le oklóbīya nū Uhíra tɛ̄hɔ̄ mla ɔyí ɛwū ā gé lɛ ɔnyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō mīyɛ ɔdōcabɔ̄ nōó je lɛ ɔ́ āa, Uhíra í má ɔnyā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le odúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gwu, le inalegwu tá klá anú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya kú ɔdā ō je yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú ijē kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛya kú olétɔ̄há ɛbɔ́ gwó abɔ́ɔ á. Ohígbū ka ede kú oje udɔ nɛ̄ ó gwó ā í jɛ̄ odúúdú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā mɛ́mla ɛya kú ijē ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ̄ nōo lɛ ɔdā ō kwu ɛjī ajɛ kú anú mɛ́mla ákú ɔ́mpa nū fu tónū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ká ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ojuja klá uwā ɛyí ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, gē bī uwā jé ɔwɛ, ó je ɔ́kpa kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ lɛ uwá otú cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī uwā jé ɔwɛ otú.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í ga aípɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá nēe bá amānyā biílí ā. N cíkā ō tɔ́ɔna lɛ uwá dúú, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n wā á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú kóō leyī kwɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híīī gwōnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
idu_Latn: Ó géē cɛ̄ ga uwɔ yɛhɛ, klla tɔ́ɔga ohígbū éeyē kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé tá ipú kú ɛfú kú Óndú ā ka, igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Uwáhēbu, ipú ajɛ kú Usúfa mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú ísu kú Ánɔn.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Umósīsi kwú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā ú kwaajɛ kwɛyí, nɛ̄ó lɛ ɔ́ gwu klla le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anú mɛ́mla odúúdu iyó kú nū, mɛ́mla ɛyí ede mɛ́mla odúúdu iyó kú nū kéē kwú tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya lɔtūce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ujúda í lɛ ɔcɛ́ dúúmā bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó kōō kwu eko oŋmá igbīhi kú nū mɛ́mla igbīhi ikwú kú nū ā, é lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á pó áluka ije nēé cē bá uwɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ɔnyā ā le jé ka anúɔ le hɛ́tá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le bɛ̄cɛ, yɔ̄ ge yúufi ī fīyégbúlú. Ó kwú okwúukwu ú kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔdā nōo yá a kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē leyīkwu agege nōo cɛyí ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́ kú ugóolu á. Ó klla í má kóō yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ eko dóódu ipéyī Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ká n̄ tɔ́kpá gé lɛ aá lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī da gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nēe bá Ujudíya ā.

eng_Latn: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
idu_Latn: Lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔ̄kā gē lɛ ádā um ka, é le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma lɛ ɔ́ āa.

eng_Latn: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ a klla yɛce íne nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Udéfīdi bū okónu kú Ugádi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, mɛ́mla Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Ó le ācɛ Ulífāyi kpó bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, le aódōbīgwíijē kpó bī abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
idu_Latn: Ɛcá mɛ́mla ɛlā ō kwu odo nyaá gē ŋmá okónu kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɛ odée éyi nōo hile nɛ̄ a cíkā ō yá kpɔ́. nyɔ̄ gaá kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā ú kpó je lá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā kwú ije nū í kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācogbɛhá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɛ̄nyā yá, a géē lɛ agbénú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwúcē wā í le pīya ɔyíkpó kú um.

eng_Latn: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: É í bī ɔyí ɔbá ɛna éyi, mɛ́mla ɔdā kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā. É klla í bī ɔyí ɔbá ɛna ɔhá kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
idu_Latn: Ó da Udéfīdi ka aólɛlā kú aá le lɔfú fíyɛ́ aá. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā wā í le unu nu tá aá ɛcɛ péee á. Ó ka amáŋ aá le uwá nū nyɔ̄ ga okónɔɔwɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
idu_Latn: Aá méyīnyinyi ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtū obɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú Ugolíyāti, ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya nāa ŋmó ɔpɛ́ kú Ɛla ā tá amānyā. Ó wɛ oōgbō īlī bayi igbīhi ikpáti okónu ōce kú Óndú ā. Ɔkpacáŋ́gelī ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ amānyā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ɔhá dúú í klla fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, kwú gā um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā gā uwɔ ā, Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
idu_Latn: A géē cɔ̄nū mla alɔ piyóó nɛɛ? Ɔnū kú uwɔ í gáā mɛ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n le jé ka Óndú ā gē yá kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu lɛ alɔ ā kóō le yálé ɔgbɛ́fú. Ó tú ɔ̄ ohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō ōtīihɔ kú nū. Ó kē bī ɔfú kú nū nɛ̄hi ā le aólɛlā kú nū yálé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā alɔ jé ka é tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēe yɔ̄ ipú íne ā tāajɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē má ɔdā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ŋ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá ī bū ipú ísu kú unwalu kú uwā, n géē tú úgbagwú kú ísu ā ɔtū wāajɛ. N klla í je ɛga nōo lipú fíyɛ́ dúú kú ísu nēé hi ka Unáyilu, ā ŋmó kīklīkīī. N géē je uwēyī lɛ ācɛ Asírīya nēe gē yá ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ̄ ā. N kē í yá kú ɔfú kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā kóō mɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, É géē lá okoolo ɛpa kú īkpɔ̄da usɛ́kɛlu ékpónú, é klla kē í lá okoolo kú umu ɛhīlī usɛ́kɛlu ékpónú, eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā oócí, okónu igá kú Usamérīya ā.

eng_Latn: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā yɔ̄ pī aá, ó klla lɛ ɛbɔ́ je lɛ aá ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā ká aá āyā dóódu ɛɛ́. Ó cɛ̄ ga um le odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ nyā ā yálé, uwá klla kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá mɛ́mla ákú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ōcɛgbá nēe bá nyā wɛ ɛlā kú Ulémūwɛ̄lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Umása, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū nwū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Ó gwó ede ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā je lɛyíkwu oōgwó kú ede ā lɛ ā. Aá géē bī ɛcɔ̄ nēé bī ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā lɛ gbā ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā lɛ gwó ede ga um. É géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyi ede ā, lɛ Óndú ā, é klla í je ɛhi kú ɛbɔ́ kú uwā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛpa ā gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgiyí Ujóssuwa á. É le odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá uwā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɔ́ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɛhīcō kú ede ā, ɛga nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ō je yɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
idu_Latn: ācɛ ōhī nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ī yá yɔ̄, aá yɔ̄ í wī ijakī ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú kpó kéē tá fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
idu_Latn: Usátu wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
idu_Latn: Ujulu nōo kwú ācɛ ōhī ā í kōō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ abɔ̄ cē ɔná ŋmá ógo bī ga okónu kú abɔ̄ iyī uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
idu_Latn: Aókwū kú ācɛ Ujúda nyā í wɛ ɔdōlé lɛ aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā yɔ̄ nōo gē nū uwā ŋmá ɛbɛ aókwū ā ō lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́ɔ géē habɔ̄ ádā nu mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kwú pīyatɔ̄há mla ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
idu_Latn: Uhɔ́ram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́sa wā í ta Ulákisi abɔ̄, amáŋ Ujóssuwa le anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hile ipú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ī wā abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ohígbū koó lɛ íne tū nɛɛ, ayíka ó wā abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ lɛ okónu ce lɛ Ébrahām ka anúɔ í hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ ŋ. Amáŋ oŋmá lɛ okónu nōo ce ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cokónu nū ā lɛ Ébrahām á.

eng_Latn: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
idu_Latn: Ó gáā cɛ̄ cokónu mɛ́mla awɔ, ka anúɔ gē cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ píyoo ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
idu_Latn: Ádā ō yá olɔhi, ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā í jé uwɔ ŋ́, amáŋ n lɛ uwɔ jé ɛɛ́, aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ā kē le jé ka awɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔdōklá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ú nā klá anú. É klla kwú ɔdōklóodēe kú iyɛ̄ɛcɛ ā ú nā klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
idu_Latn: Aá gēe kpó aɔ́dā nēe bá ā lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī uwā le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē hɔ́hā ce ami mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ um dúú.

eng_Latn: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla igbō ā kpó ce ɛyí ɛcɔ̄, ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔhɔ̄ kú nū ā pīya klá anú. Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé gē nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́, ɔtū kú ācɛ ā í je pīyeyī ga ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda. É í je um ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ é kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
idu_Latn: Ómri bī ɔ́bíipú tū Óndú ā fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ nēe cɔcɛ́ gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
idu_Latn: A pó, abɔ̄ nēé cá um ɛcá ā dúú, Óndú. A kē jē ujɔ mɛ́mla ojuju kú uwá lɛyíkwu um dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
idu_Latn: Aá Jāhɔ̄! Ācɛ nēe gē gbā ebilíi ɛ̄gbā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ebilíi, amáŋ nēe ī kɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ka aá wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā, n géē yá kéē wā í lɛ okwúukwu kwaajɛ iyɔ̄bū aá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le jé ka aá he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ofōōfūnū nēé gē kā lɛ aá. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ ɛlā kú uwā, n géē yá kéē lɛ aá ɔkwu fu ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá ga ɛga oligbó. N géē kpó aá nū ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, nɛ̄ aá í je kpó yíífi.
