eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, n géē je ōwē lɛ ɔ́ kú okónu nɛ̄ ó bī iyē kú um gbo ɛka ka anɔ́ɔ géē le tū, nōo klla je bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Eko gē wā nēé géē tū Ujerúsālɛm gwó kóō le pīya igelī nɛ̄hi kú um. É géē gwó ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda nēé cē ī gbōajɛ kú Uhanánɛlu lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ga okómpinu kú ɔ́kíkā ā.

eng_Latn: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
idu_Latn: Ká ācɛ nēe yá uwā ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá nēe gē lɛ ɔtūce uwá ā, kéē kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām le inya kwu ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛgiyí Usára gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ okoolo kú umu ɛtá mīya fíyaa kú ā lɛ igbō yá fíya.

eng_Latn: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́ɛ ka Áhāsi kóō yá ɔdā nōo he ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ɔtú ā, ó kwú ikpó kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó fu. Ó klla le ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ōfōōfūnū gē bū wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gwū.

eng_Latn: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā gaā lā ígbíli kú Usíni.

eng_Latn: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔbáagwu éyi nēé hī ka Íssbībēnɔ̄bu nōo bī óbō kú oje udɔ nōo gbɛnú gaajɛ ukílōgram ɛtá ce āyā ā, nōo klla bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā, gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔfú ŋmó Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, glá.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka kéē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kpó ga ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú inu ā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō bēhé ga ipú inu gaá má úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā. Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā ŋ́, odóódú aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú inu ā í je pīya ɔdēelihɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le bēhé ga ipú inu ā klɔ́dɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ kpɔ́ gáā lɛ ɛdɔ ɔkɔ nōó tɛtɛ gbā gbɔbū ā gbā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā a gē yá alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ á wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ á jé alɔ ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ jéjéē ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tū ācɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú uwá í lɔfú ŋ́ mā iyē, ká a klla lɛ ācɛ nēe ikpó kú uwā ā bā ī fīyégbúlú lɛ uwá ā ikpó tú kwajɛ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kahíníī, Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá bɔ̄bíipú jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Aá ma abɔ̄ ɔnɔɔtū mɛ́mla opīyatū tá. Aá yá ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla okpaakpa ā. Aá klla nū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú uwá ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da aá ɛ̄nyā á.

eng_Latn: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā gē bīya ɔ̄cɛ á. Amáŋ o lé ɔdōlé mla abɔ̄ nēé na ŋ́ mā í gē bīya ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bī le yá ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā yɔ̄, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō ékpónú ā gē je ɔfú lɛ ācɛ kéē bī le yá ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī lɛ ije tá ije nɛ̄ aá le kplá uwá ā ŋ́ ámāŋ kéē gbā fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá le kplá uwá ā ɔkwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
idu_Latn: Anyā aá, ayí aá, mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ kú aá géē bá amānyā, amáŋ, ācɛnyīlɔ kú aá nēe lɔfú kpɛ́fú glá ā géē kpó iyɔ́fú kú uwā tū iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bēhé Ujɔ́dan ā gaá tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, N kwú ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ tū aá nōo cɛ̄ lɛ aá móowē nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ aá háyi kpaakpa glá ŋ́ mā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ɛɛ́. Aá klla gáā móōwē ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gbógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
idu_Latn: Ípī kú owu nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá okónu kú um ā gē wú ɔnyā um ɔtū. Ayínɛ́ um í kóō cɛ̄ ō túblá um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka é gē dɔɔ̄kā ɛbɛ oōmá ŋmá ɛgiyí ígbɔ́cí. Ka ígbɔ́cí kóō géē da uwá ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā ō jé ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ō lɛ ɔbá, nōo je pīya akwuna ā, le kwu ga ɛgiyí aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kɛlā gɔbū. Ó kahíníī, Ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā géē wɛ ōgwū ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī kú ipú aláadi nēé gē yúklɔ́ ā. Amáŋ é géē nwūla anú ɛ̄cī nēé gē yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú ɔyá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú aá túgagá klla gwōnū klá īyī uwā. É bá gē da īyī uwā kahíníī, Aá cāŋ́jɛ fíyaa kú ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ le kwu kú aólɛlā kú alɔ kéē ŋmó alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmó um ijē, ó klla ŋmó um ijē, tū um akwū nɛ̄ ó ményinyi um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
idu_Latn: Ásɛ̄lu ma ayí ɛhīlī nēe bá ā: Asríkam, Ubokéru, Íssmɛ̄lu, Ussɛ́rīya, Obadáya mɛ́mla Uhánan.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē je ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ gā uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbō ajɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usáyɔn, a klla í gbāajɛ kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
idu_Latn: Gbō um ŋmá íne nɛ̄ n gē jégēdēē gē bīya ā. Á cɛ̄ lɛ íne ō bīya ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, ká n̄ kē lé ɛ̄pɔ̄bí uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n cɛ̄tra iyī um, ocɛ̄tra kú um wɛ áncā. Ádā um wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄tra um á, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá ka ka ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lɛ íne nyā tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā kɛlā nyā á.

eng_Latn: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli í nū ācɛ nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ubɛtánāti ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. É lā mlá uwá jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā, amáŋ é wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú ācɛ Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ kú ipú aá ka gbɔbū ka ɔdānyā ɔ́ɔ géē yá ā? Cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ jé ka ɛlā kú aá le kpaakpa ā. Odúúmā kú aá í kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ gbɔbū ŋ́ má, aá yá fiíi ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú ā Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kéē hɔ́hā ce aá, kéē yá kú aá lɛ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jāā ɛháajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ubalātibéya nēé gē hī ka Uráma ā, wɛ ipú ajɛ kú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka iháyí nōo hile ā í lɛ ɛwa ŋ́, ó géē ka ɔ́ mɛ́mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ije ōhī gbā ŋmá anú ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ iháyí nōo hile ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yúúfi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ kpɛ́fú tá uwá ŋmá igbīhi, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēe bá ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ igbīhi ā kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N̄ lɛ ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi da aá, aá géē má ɔkpáncō abɔ̄ ó le nwūla, cɛ́ɛ́ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō bá yɔ̄ ī gicō klla yɔ̄ ī wā ajɛ ɛyí Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ucɔ hɛ́ ā, Ujísɔ̄si da Usáyímɔ̄n Upíta ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Usáyímɔ̄n, ɔyí Ujɔ́ni, a yíihɔtū um fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā ā? Upíta cīla kahíníī, Īī, Óndú. A jé ka n yíihɔtū uwɔ. Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Je ɔdōlé lɛ ayí álá kú um.

eng_Latn: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóna yɔ̄ ipú ɛbéenyi nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī ɛtá, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ɛ̄cī ɛtá mɛ́mla otú ɛtá á.

eng_Latn: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
idu_Latn: Aígwu kú ācogwɛ́ɛya klla ma āyā ōhī nōo yɛ ga ɛhícō kú Ɔwɛ kú ɔnya á. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwā ma ɔdɔ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ kéē le pīya ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla um wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ā. Ádā! kéē le piyatɔ̄há mla alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n pīyatɔ̄há mla uwɔ nāa kē pīyatɔ̄há mla um ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kú ɛcɛ géē cɛ̄ ka awɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni kwú okwutɛ ā ú kpó bá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā iyɔ̄bu kú Ikpati kú okónu ō ce ā.

eng_Latn: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
idu_Latn: É géē tá iyē kú ɔyí éyééye kú Ujékɔ̄pu tū éyééye kú ɛcɔ̄ ā kóō kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā da Ujóssuwa ka ehée, aá géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
idu_Latn: Aá í jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔdā nēe wɛ elihɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā o le yēŋēē mɛ́mla ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú aɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē lé, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá gáā lé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gā gaá bī ɔdōwiyē kú aókwū ā, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ lá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka ā ā.

eng_Latn: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le jé ka Árɔ̄ni ɔ́ɔ gekwú ā, odúúdu uwā le ekwu kú Árɔ̄ni yɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ofu cigwó.

eng_Latn: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
idu_Latn: Ófɛ mɛ́mla Uhafíla mɛ́mla Ujóbābu. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ā wɛ ayí kú Ujɔ́ktan.

eng_Latn: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya klla da ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā, n má Óndú ā cīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, le yɛ jīla ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udɛlíla bī ɛdɔ ɔńgbá ɔ́ɔmā le Usámsin gbō, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ Ufilístiya kpó tayínū inu igbɔhá. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ̄ hī Usámsin ka ācɛ Ufilístiya í wā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Usámsin lɛ ɔ́ngbá ā kpó hɛ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka owú ā.

eng_Latn: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá āa? Ohígbū koó wɛ Udamáskɔ̄si wɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usírīya ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Udamáskɔ̄si í kē lɔfú fíyɛ́ Urésin, ɔcɛ́ ā glá ŋ́. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n lɛ ō ka lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ ka ipú iháyí ofɛtá cɛhɔ̄ nōo ī wā ā, é géē yá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé klla í je uwá catāajɛ dúúdú. Nēé gáā lɔfú wɛ éwo kú abɔ̄yī uwā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōō wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka aá lɛyítáajɛ ga um ŋ́ kú aá hɛ́ ācɛ Uhíbru ɔ́mpa aá ā tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je ohɛ́tá tá lɛ aá. Ɛdɔ ohɛ́tá nɛ̄ n géē je lɛ aá ā wɛ ka n géē ma aá tá kú aá pɛ́ kwú ipú ɛfu, ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí. N géē je aá pīya ɛbɛ ohéyī lɛ odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā wɛ ayááyí kú Ísɔ, ádā kú ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm nēe lā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usésyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ opeyī mɛ́mla ācɛ ocīkpó wā ɛgiyí nū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ gē blakwu ihɔtū nāa ī yá tá alɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔcɛ́ ā kwú āyā kú ajɛ kú nū dúúmā ú yá ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ɛhi. Ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē wɛ ákú ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā gbógbóó ipú agbénú kú ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāājɛ ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ujɛhóyāda ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ ā kpó gē lɛ ɔ́ á. Ígwu nōo gē yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī usábāti mɛ́mla ígwu nɛ̄ ó yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
idu_Latn: Inu ā le mu mla ācɛ. Kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufilístiya ā bá abɔ́ɔ. Ācɛ nēé bá ɛyí inu ā bá ī má ijā kú Usámsin ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka, ācɛ ulá ahāapa ce ofigwó ā.

eng_Latn: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā le kwu tá ipú ígbíli ga ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tútū gbēyī nū ā, nēé géē leyīkwu ɔ́ ɛ̄cī ulá ɛtá ce ofɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā bá ī kwinya nyɔ̄. Ācɛnyā nēe bá ɔlɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔdā nēe kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā lɛ ajɛ ā je lɛ uwá, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má lā ipú nū ɛbɔ́, nɛ̄ unwalu ɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwá dúúmā wā ɛgiyí uwā gɛ ŋ́, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ā kpó ŋmó, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í klla gáā blakwu uwā ipú ɛcɛ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aólɛlā kú um ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí, mɛ́mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú uwá dóódu. Lɛ italā yá ūwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá um ohígbū íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā. N yɔ̄ ī tíifu ipú owē, mɛ́mla unwalu. Ɔtū kú um le gbenyi.

eng_Latn: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛbɔ́ kú nū nōó tōō jɛ́ɛyí nū ŋ́ mā je lɛ aá, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú ī gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔtū mɛ́mla odo kú aá glá ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā lɛ ā ohígbū ka aá le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔtū kú Óndú ā kóō lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó bī Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa le uwá hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ayíkpó kú uwɔ kéē lɛ ɔ́ nū tɛ́ɛ́cɛ, amáŋ é nū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū uwɔ ā, é gē gwéeyē ɛ̄cī dóódu. É klla í cɛ̄tra awɔ ohígbū olɔhi kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi wɛ ɔyí kú Ujése, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɛ́frāti, nōo ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā. Ujése ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahātá. Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lé ɔcɛ́ ā, Ujése kwú híla nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
idu_Latn: Koócōō, jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bī tū uwɔ ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Lɛ ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā nwū uwā kéē yá. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā, ká ā lɛ ɔwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ nyā, nɛ̄ a je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā gā um igbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.
idu_Latn: N tɛtɛ da ɔ́ ka, n géē yá ipíinu kú ɔlɛ́ nū italā piyóó, ohígbū ka ayí nū le um iyē bīya. Ɛ́lāyi kē jé, amáŋ ó kē cɔ̄nū dɛ̄gba tū uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD's house should be built.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Uhágāyi kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā ka eko ɔ́ yá nɛ̄ aá géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: É nyi uwá okwū kú ojīlīmā bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cɛ́fú kú īkée ā ŋ́. É nyi ācɛ ojīlīmā ɔ́ɔmā lɛ odúúdú iyɔ́fú kú uwā kpó tū uwá iyē ɛɛ́ nēé nyī uwá ga ɔlékwū ā. É kwú aɔ́kpacaŋ́gelī kú uwā í tá ɛháajɛ kú ɛyí kú uwā, kllá kwú ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwá ú klá uwá ɔtū. Aɔ́cɛ́fú nyā lɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ tɛtɛ gē yúufi uwā.

eng_Latn: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā igwó kú uwā gē bá ī gbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ācɛ úlā igwó kú uwá ɔhá ā gē bá ī gwíijē ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mla ɔdā ō bī gwííjē dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kpó bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kéē bī gwííjē lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n héyītū uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ uwá ɔkwu fu ŋmá ajɛ, lɛ uwá wúlātāajɛ, lɛ uwá bī wāajɛ, klla kpó uwā yíífi tɛtɛ ā, ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē lɛ ɛlā kwú uwá dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ uwá būtū, ká n̄ klla lɛ uwá tūgwó.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
idu_Latn: Ayíbɛ, ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā bī ikwū gé um mɛ́ɛ á ŋ́? Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́! Ínoōbīya yɔ̄ ī yá ká n̄ gekwú á. Ikwū bī ɔdā nōo lɔhi le um ŋmó, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛdɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ínoōbīya wɛ kpócíí ā mafú, anɔ́ɔ íne nēé je ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō bīyíne gɛ ŋ́ mā a, klla cɛ̄ lɛ íne ōbīya kwú pīya ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá kú alɔ le jé ka alɔ wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Anú klla fu alɔ tá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ awɔ, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ cíí ā, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ō tīihɔ ā, gā ajɛ ŋmá Ɔkpáncō gaá kahíníī, Lɛ ɔcí ā tú wā ajɛ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ yíífi, amáŋ habɔ̄ ikpaŋkini kú nū tá kwaajɛ, lɛ agbá kú oje ɔlamu mɛ́mla oje udɔ ā kwú ɔ́ biílí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā habɔ̄ tá kwu ipácí abɔ́ɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ébú kú ɔkpáncō kóō cē klá ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ó géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí iháyí ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú, é pīyeyī yɛjīla, amáŋ é má ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā gɛ ŋ́, Ujísɔ̄si ōfōōfūnū yɔ̄ mla uwá mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí í gē wā ŋmá ipú ajɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ unwalu gē bū ŋmá ipú ajɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
idu_Latn: Alɛɛcɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu áncā nɛ̄, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄hi, í lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́. Lɛ uwá jámá ká ā má ɔ̄, é wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. É le fékéé bɛ̄ɛka ēpū ā.

eng_Latn: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Umɛssɛlɛmíya bī ācɛ igwáahātá wā dúú.

eng_Latn: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá nyɔ̄ fíyaa gaá da ayíkpó kú nū koó le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwu ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā ó yɔ̄ ī ga Ugálīli gbɔbū lɛ aá ɛɛ́. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ aá géē má ɔ̄ á! Aá blakwu ɔ́ ka n le da aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ébram kwú ɔtū í kpóce Ɔwɔicō, ɔtū le he Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ Ébram kpóce ɔ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ háyi kpaakpa tū anúɔ ɛɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
idu_Latn: Éwo éyi ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō gā gáā kpɛ́fú tú Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́. É kē í je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́. Kwu ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ géē kwinya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, eko nyā nɛ̄ aá í bá ī ga amu ga ánú gaá kwu ā? Aá gáā hayi kpaakpa ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá kóō le jé ka n géē yá ka ɔdā ɛyípɛ̄ kóō le yá ipú ɛcɛ. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā yɔ̄ ī gbō ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá ɔnyā nū, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ohígbū ajā nōó gbo, nōó lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá lɛ, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ o cikpó ɔnyā ɔhá nōó wɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ kú ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem a í jē uwā ŋ́ nɛɛ, kéē nyɔ̄ ga ipú ūpū cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ajɛ kla lɛ iyī uwā ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Upɛrísi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Uréfem.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Uféro lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú aábaná ā ú kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí um mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. N géē cɛ̄ ká ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ dúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo lɛ agbénú mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔfú, mɛ́mla oduudu ācɛ ɔha, kwu aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lɛ īyī uwā ā, le pɛ́ tayínū ipú aɔ́gɛ̄cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔkwu aɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kú aɛ́fu ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ uwá bá í nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ā, ɔ̄kā gaá le kā Udéfīdi ka Ábsālɔm ɔ́ɔ le odúúdú ayí nū kpó ŋmó. É da ɔ́ ka odúúmā kú uwá ɔ́ɔ hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēé je bɛ̄ɛka otrɛyí kú icɔ́ɔci nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā í lɛ ɔdā dúú nēé ī ka tū ipú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna nū ā ŋ́. N ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ɔdā nēé wɛ í lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ō yá mla um ŋ́; Ɔwɔicō í gē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ wɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ kóō hɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
idu_Latn: É ka ācɛ Asírīya í nya aá tá glá ŋ́, ɔnya o kpɛ́fú ō lɛ ɔ́ɔ́ kē gbō aá glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ gē hɛ́ aá tá glá ŋ́. É ka aá í gáā da íkpíkwīja nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ bī abɔ̄ kú aá yá ā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É ka Óndú, ɔ́ɔ gē ményinyi kú ayókwū.

eng_Latn: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
idu_Latn: N géē yá awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ, odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ italā ohígbū odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā. Kwu awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda dúúmā í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ n pi aá anú ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ífi nɛ̄ n ka ka n géē yá kéē yá ā, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwā yá aá.

eng_Latn: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
idu_Latn: Ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī ékpónú kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, wɛ okolo umu úlā igwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó , okolo kú īkpɔ̄dā úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
idu_Latn: Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú utánki kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā wɛ, īkpō kú ayíkābɔ̄ éyi. Ɔ̄wū kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka okónu kú ikókwū ā, okónu kú utánki ā le cē wɛ̄ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka oō nwūla kú ododó ā. Utánki nyā lɔfú bī ɔgālā kú éŋkpɔ̄ úlā ahāanɛ ce ofu igwáahātá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ italā yá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohígbū nū á.

eng_Latn: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
idu_Latn: A le ohi tá um, a klla da um ka amiyɔ̄ yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá ā, aá géē mī éŋkpɔ̄ kú iyē ō gwu ā klá uwá.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
idu_Latn: Óndú géē tá ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā le gbenyi ā abɔ̄, ó klla géē je ācɛ nēe má gwōnū ɛɛ́ mā ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ójila ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu yá ā má ā, é je ɔkɔ kú uwā gicō anɔ́ɔ é ka ɔkɔ Ulayikónīya kahíníī, Aɔ́wɔ ā le pɛ́ wāajɛ gé lɛ alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n géē kwúce ga ɛgiyí ádā um ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā í wā mɛ́mla um ŋ́ mā? Ń kōō leyīkwu ádā um eyī glá ŋ́, ohígbū ɔkpɔkplɔ nōo í wā í klá ádā um ā.

eng_Latn: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a jé ka alɔ gē bū ipú oyēeyī bɛ̄ɛka aúgbɔga nōo wā í yɛ ā, bɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádáádā alɔ lɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī kú oyēeyī kú alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojiji nōó gē yɔ̄ gbojī ŋ́ mā nɛ. Alɔ í kwú ānānā.

eng_Latn: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
idu_Latn: Aókómpinu kú igelī nyā, géē lé iyē éyééye kú aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Aókómpinu ɛtá kú āyā kú ɛhícō ā, géē lé iyē ka okómpinu kú Urúbɛ̄n, okómpinu kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla okómpinu kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
idu_Latn: Ebilíi da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē kpó odúúdú ɔfú mɛ́mla ɛgahi nyā gā awɔ. É le odúúdú uwā kpó ga um, n kē lɔfú je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
idu_Latn: Ɛliyónāyi ma ayí ahāapa nēe bá ā, Uhodafíya, Ɛlíyāssibu, Upeláya, Ákūbu, Ujohánan, Udɛláya mɛ́mla Anáni.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo lā ipú enyi, nōó lɛ acá mɛ́mla āpū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ gáā lé ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ ɛbéelihɔ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ í yɔ̄ ŋméko-téeko piyóó. Ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nāa gē bī le gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
idu_Latn: É gē cɛ̄ túblá uya kú ipú igelī ŋ́. É gē pó ācɛ ī dɛ̄gba tū uwā kéē yá uwá kéē yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ɔtū kú aá kóō le mu mla ɔlá ofíyajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē má aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá leyīce nōo wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hī aá igwú nū, aɔ́dā nōó cokónu ō je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. É wɛ aɔ́dā otīile nēe géē hɛ́ ācɛ idáagó.

eng_Latn: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nēé bá, ɔdā dúúmā nēé gē yá, ami wɛ ijē nēé bī okónu yɔ̄ ī gwó á.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛyí ō túwāajɛ lɛ Óndú ā wɛ ohútu kú íjééyī ō jé á. Ó gē yá kú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū ā kéē jé ɔdā nōo lɔhi. Ācɛ cíkā ō cɛ̄tra Óndú eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
idu_Latn: Ɔdée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū wɛ ogigo, nōo tá pāā á tá iyɔ̄bū kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ nēe lɛ aíkpēyī alɛwa kɔ̄ klá uwá iyɔ̄bū mɛ́mla igbīhi ā le yɛ akpa kú ɔ̄cɛ ā jīlatá ɔkíka éyééye.

eng_Latn: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá iyē nū ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Cɛ̄ ká n̄ nyɔ̄ mla awɔ. Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ nū nyɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
idu_Latn: Olíla lɛ eyīyōce fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ̄ dúúmā nōo gē hágágā ɛlā ō ka á.

eng_Latn: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ cɛgbá ŋmá ɛgiyí ūwā eko dóódu ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ihɔtū. Ó koó wɛ ɛya ō gwó ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ klla tíne kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kéē je anúɔ fíyɛ́ ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā Ulában kwú aópī mɛ́mla aɔ́nyɛ̄wū nēe híkaka ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kwu uwá iyē ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aálá nōbí ā í kpó ŋmá ipú aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū. Ó kwú uwā í kpó lɛ ayí nū kéē leyīkwu uwá lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ínoōbīya kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē kwú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ukpa gē kwú odée ā. Amáŋ ɔtū kú ācɛ okpaakpa wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, é klla géē yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɛyí kú ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ka é géē wā ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá éyi nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú ɛhícō ā, gaá kpó odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ Ujúda ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
idu_Latn: Aá híī mīyɛ omíci ŋ́, ohígbū ka omíci gē pu ɔ̄cɛ eyī kóō híī mā ɛlā okpaakpa ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā píyeyī klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le táajɛ, nɛ̄ otú le bī ā, ɔlá ō tódūdū nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛtɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛmu nōo yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄lá le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá le bū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kɔ̄ báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā gɔbú kpɔ́ á. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú bī gé lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó géē lɛ abɔ̄ fú umu ā mɛ́mla anɔ̄, mɛ́mla otulalī ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwá yɔlá ɛyí ede ā, kéē wɛ ɔdā nēé je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū ī he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛna nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ma ā ú ca, le ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔ̄lá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gba umuumu mɛlíí á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ wīya tɔ̄há mla éŋkpɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nū gwá.

eng_Latn: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́, nɛ̄ iyē um lé ka Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ka n géē yá kú ejé kóō lɛ aɔ́cɛ́,mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aójéeyī kú uwā kpó kwú. É géē gbiyɔ̄lā nēé gáā héyī ŋmá anú glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ ŋmá igbīhi gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okónogwu kú úwé kú Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā oyī nōó yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ā mɛ yīīlī á.

eng_Latn: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē má ɔkɔ í ka ipéyī nū glá aā?.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā, n yɔ̄ ī je ikwū la ɔci Ufáyin kú Isibma, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í je ikwu la ɔci Ufáyin kú Ujása a. Agīje kú um yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ohígbū Uhɛ́sbɔn mla Ɛlíle, ohígbū ka uwá í má ɔdā ɛhɔ̄ dúúmā cē ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he uwá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
idu_Latn: ka uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ɛ́ɛ géē ga ɛga nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācohɛ́pɔ̄ nēe ce eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā ka.

eng_Latn: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
idu_Latn: ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā ɔ́ɔ yɛ bū ajɛ kú ācɛ Umówābū bū ɔwɛ kú Ári.

eng_Latn: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú uwā kwú kpó gbenyi ipú ufi, é ba ī pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nēé tayínū ā bá ī fiyégbúlú kpákpákpá.

eng_Latn: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gāajɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Umáhāneyím, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ unwalu lɛ um yɛ jīlatá biílí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē cīíbɔm tū ɔ̄cɛ ā, a gē lɛ um tū oyēeyī. A gē bɛ́yíkwu aólɛlā kú um nēe gē cɔ̄nū mla um ā, a klla gē bī ɔfú kú uwɔ le hɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō le alɔ ahɔ̄ pi lɔfú lɔfú ɛɛ́. Ó kahíníī, Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gē wú um ɔtū. Ń je aɔ́lɛ́ kú abahi nēé gwó lɛ iyī uwā a ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. N géē je igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā nōo wɛ Usamériya, ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwā a mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ n kpó iyɛ́fú kú um bá ā nwūla ɛɛ́. N le cɔ̄nū lɛ uwá kpó ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, lɛ úklɔ́ ō yá ajɛ Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú alɔ le tútū ō ga ɔgbɛ́fú nɛ̄ Óndú ā gbɔbū ā. Alɔ géē bēé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, í kpɛ́fú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ íne nēe bá nyā tū piyóó. Aá géē yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu nyā igbeéyi iháyí ká aá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iyē gwu ŋmá odúúdú íne nēé bīya kpɛ́mm ā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū uwā ukɔ́ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.
idu_Latn: Uséda kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúúmā ī tū o le gbla anú ŋ́. Ɔcí ɔhá dúúmā, kwú ɔcí ufíg dúúmā i kwajɛ, kwā ābɔ̄ kpɔ́cíi klla héyīfuú bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ŋ́. Ɔcí dúúmā nōo í yɔ̄ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo héyīfuú bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will give him the morning star.
idu_Latn: N klla í je ínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ eko nɛ̄ eyī gē nyā ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ kéē nyɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulífāyi lɛ ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ Ujísɔ̄si á. Ācodɔlɛ́ alɛwa nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá wɛ ipú aúgbɔga ā dúú.

eng_Latn: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
idu_Latn: É tū ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɛhɔ̄ wā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, iyē nū wɛ Ujɔ́ni.

eng_Latn: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ó le kpaakpa lɛ ācɛ nēe jɛ́yí odée ā. Ó klla tá péee lɛ ācɛ nēe jé odée ā.

eng_Latn: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū lɛ abālɔbányā, aá dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá lɛ iyē kú um ŋ́. Aá dɔɔ̄kā, aá géē mīyɛ, ká éeyē kú aá kóō le mu.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
idu_Latn: A géē yá eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā ú kpó kwu ɛháajɛ ɛkpa ō bɔ́ɔ́tū kwu okónōgwu nōo gboce ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ofíyajɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o géē wā ipú ɛcɛ gaá fíyaajɛ klá ācɛ dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
idu_Latn: É le okónu ce ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē tá anyā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú omlede ú wā kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ oyī ā he ɔdōlé ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ pīya klá ajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē cē éŋkpɔ̄ bónū klá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
idu_Latn: Ó je eyī gicō anɔ́ɔ ó má ācɛ ɛtá māháyi iyɔ̄bū í ligbó lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ má. Eko nōó le uwá má ā, ó le inya kwu ŋmá okómpīinu ā gaá jīla uwá ɔwɛ. Ó túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú uwā túbá ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā. iháyí ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá dóódu.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya bī ā, n géē yá uwā italā. É le odúúdú ewɔhá kpó kwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó lá, lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ī je ɔfiyɛ lá ā.

eng_Latn: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ anyā úlā cofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ . Anyā ɔlɛ́ nū nōó ī cikpó uwā ā kē wɛ ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ anyā nū ā lɛ ɔ́ ɔtū pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ufígi kóō lɛ odée nwū aá káá. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō lū nɛ̄ ēpū gbɔɔ́ ō wɛ̄ɛcɛ, aá jé ka ɔgwā le bá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
idu_Latn: Amásīya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda yēeyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ igbīhi nɛ̄ Ujɛhówāssi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
idu_Latn: N má íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a lɛ lɛyíkwu um ā. N kē lɛ ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ nɛ̄ a ka lɛyíkwu um ā pó ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē je uwɔ o bī kwú ɛbéenyi wu uwɔ ɛnwū. N klla í kpó agbá wū uwɔ okónu. N géē je uwɔ kwúcē bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a yɛ wā piíí ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔbá nū hīgwú kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ mla um fíyaa, ká n̄ ga ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa, n géē kwúcē wā ānāānā.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ga okónu ɔwɛ kú inu olɔfú kú ɔkplɛ́fú ā, kóō tɔ̄lá á.

eng_Latn: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō géē yá uwá lé.

eng_Latn: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
idu_Latn: É géē tú aɛ́ga nēé catāajɛ nēe húmáyī tá alácɛ̄ ā gwó. É klla géē tú aígelī nēé wúlatāajɛ ŋmá īkííkée ā gwó.

eng_Latn: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, ɔ́dāŋ́ koó he uwɔ ɔtū, nɛ̄ n kē he uwɔ ɔtū, nɛ̄ ó kē le kpaakpa iyɔ̄bū uwɔ nɛɛ, kócōō lɛ ɔ́da je cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā lɛ ɔ́da kú Uháman ā ci. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔyí kú Uhamedáta kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ágāgi je kéē kwú ācɛ Ujíyu í kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋmá ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā, kóō híī yúklɔ́ ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki kwú Usára ú cigbīhi lɛ Ébrahām mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
idu_Latn: Údrō kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkókwū yoolo ā. Éjé kóō híī ŋmó ŋmá anú ŋ́. Ohí kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄wɛ̄ igwu nēé lɛ ododó gbō ɔ̄ biílí ā.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ó géē je ɔ́ yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo í leyīkwu odúúdú agbénú kú nū.

eng_Latn: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ofu kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ oyēeyī piyóó, nɛ̄ ó ī kwú ŋ́ mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ eyī í má ɔ́ glá ŋ́, anú ofūnū wɛ Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu! Aamí.

eng_Latn: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é yá uwēyī ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ā, lɛ ōmiya kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mafú lɛ uwá péee. Kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gwó ɔ̄ lɛ ā, aókónɔɔwɛ ō ga ipú nū mɛ́mla ō bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́gɔgɔ́ kú nū lɛ a. Kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é kpó aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú nū ā bá ā mɛ́mla odúúdú íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū. Lɛ odúúdú nū tá tāajɛ lɛ uwá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɔdā dóódu kú nū péee, nēé géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú nū dóódu ka ā.

eng_Latn: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
idu_Latn: Ɔwolímanya, ɛcɔ̄ ɔwɔ, ébú, mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi nōo gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú nū ā, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujónādāabu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ kú Udéfīdi ā, da ɔ́ ka Ágábáidu, ɔ́ɔ wɛ odúúdú ayí nū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kpó ŋmó ā ŋ́. Ka Ámnɔn ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ kwú á. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ má īkpéyī kú Ábsālɔm, ɔ́ɔ lɔfú jé ka ɔ́ɔ le ɔtū kú nū yéékpó kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā oŋmífī nɛ̄ Ámnɔn hɛ́ Utáma, ɔyínɛ́ nū, báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
idu_Latn: Aá kwinya ŋmá Ubábīlɔn. Aá kwinya kú oyēeyī kú aá. Aá yá kéē kwú aá í kpó ŋmó ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ŋ́. Eko nyā, n yɔ̄ ī gwó uwā ɔ́ci, klla ī yá uwā italā nōo cíkā lɛ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ́ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɛla nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ nwū ipú ɔkpá ā ŋ́, néē klla lɛ ojilima ce iyē ohídáagó mɛ́mla iyē ōtūufi kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ a gē yá ipéyī Ɔwɔicō ā géē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ lɔfú iyē. A klla gáā yúúfi gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe gē pīya awɔ tū ā kwú ligbó gā awɔ ɛɛ́. É klla gáā lɛ abɔ kwu uwɔ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ó le ɔdā olɔhi yá lɛ alɔ. Aá bī ābɔ̄ ɔcí kú aá gwéeyē yɛjīla ede kú nū tá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujúda ipú ipɔ́ɔnū ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Ussɛ́la, Upéres, Uséra, Usera, Uhísrɔn, mɛ́mla Uhámul.

eng_Latn: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ yá ā blatū um. Aá wā ka alɔ ga ɔnū ɛpɔ̄. Aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú aá ka, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá le mafú ka aá ɔ́ɔ lé ɛpɔ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ijáalí kú nū ɛɛ́ mā ā, ó bī okónu abɔ̄yī nū cɛ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
idu_Latn: Ɔdānyā géē wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ lɛ aá ka aá jé ka n géē yá aá italā, í kpó aá yíífi Íjīpiti amānyā piíí, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n fu aá ɔnū ā.

eng_Latn: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi ka, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ kwú Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ú kpó tū aá abɔ̄ dúú ā, nɛ̄ aá ŋmó uwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hile ɔlɛ́ uwā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
idu_Latn: Ó yá um ká n̄ gwutá ipú abahi lɛbɛ̄ɛka álá nōo gwutá ipácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ā. Ó ī bī um jé ɔwɛ ga ɛgiyí éŋkpɔ̄ péee nōo yɔ̄ himm ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā uwá ɛ́ɛ le kpó da anúɔ ka anúɔ kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú anúɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ŋmó ɔ́mpānū ā ú tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó kwɛyí ɔ́mpānū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ŋmó ā. Ɔnyā klla da ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tíne ā yá, ɛɛ́mba ɛfɔ́ɔ́lá ékpónú kú anúɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ je nyí á. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ klla gáā hile nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē lé iyē kú ádā uwā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ka ācɛ ɛ́ɛ́ klla gáā blakwu ɔbá anúɔ ipú ɛcɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, N géē je ígbɔ́tū lɛ Uféro cɛ́ɛ́ ó gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ n géē yá aɔ́dōtūfi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne ō táafú ɛlā nyā, ayíka ō le jé ka alɔ ámāŋ ka icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō í lɛ ucē ɔhá ō bī le gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
idu_Latn: N ma oyī ā tá abɔ́ɔ, ɛga nōo gáā tayínū glá ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gē má ɔ̄, o yá ká ɔtū kóō wú um nɛ̄ n géē gwō ɔ̄ ɔ́ci ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
idu_Latn: É tá ohi kahíníī, Ó ce Óndú ā ɛgbá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā géē lɛ uwá pīya ācɛ nēe gbɔbū lɛ aéwo alɛwa, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā wɛ ācɛ nēe tá igbīhi ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá ī jɛ̄ piyóó, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā túwāajɛ gbóógbóō ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne nɛ̄ anúɔ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā le ojuju tū ka aá géē lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā tū ipú ɔyā ɔ́mpa ā.

eng_Latn: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā géē hile, ācɛ kē í wi ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm piíí. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kwú abɔ̄ ú kwu ɔtū kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá piíí.

eng_Latn: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ alɔ dúú á. Eko nɛ̄ alɔ í jɛ́yí ɔdā dúú lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā aálelékwū nēe gē gbō ɛcɛ nyā ā lɛ alɔ yá ɔfiyɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú ɔtū kú nū ú kpóce agbénú nɛ̄hi kú nū, ka Ɔwɔicō kóō híī gbō anúɔ ŋ́ māa. Ó gē kpɔ́tūce ɔbíipú kú nū kóō gbó ɔ̄ ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, aá gwéeyē, ɔtū kóō he aá, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá yá lɛ aá ā. Ó le ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí je lɛ aá ɛɛ́, n klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔgwā le gbo nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́. Ó klla le ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ákú igbīhāajɛ ā je lɛ aá, bɛ̄ɛka eko otɛtɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
idu_Latn: N̄ da aá koó lɛ ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, aá géē je yíífi ɔwɛ ékpónú nēé je yíífi ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujahásīyɛlu kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ka, Aá híī yúufi ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē gbenyi lɛ aá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yúufi o leyī méyī mla aícɔ́ɔja kú aéwo ɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɛfú ō kpó ā ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ, ó wɛ ákú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi abɔ̄ alɔ bá gē nyɔ̄ ɛga ogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, ɔyípɛ̄nɔ̄nyā ɔfiyɛ éyi nōo lɛ anjɛnū nōo ī cɛ lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́ɛbɛ ā le yɛ jīla alɔ ɔwɛ. Ó gē yá ije nɛ̄hi gé lɛ aóndú nū ŋmá lɛ o má ācɛ ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.
idu_Latn: É ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ádā uwā ámāŋ ka ayínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ wā í lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kpó lɛ aá, aá géé da uwá kéē kócōō kéē lɛ aɛ́nyā kpó lɛ aá mɛ́ɛ̄. Ohígbū ka aá í mīyɛ uwá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā abɔ̄fú ɔgbɛ́fú kéē wɛ ɔnyā aá ŋ́. É klla ka abɔ̄ ó wɛ uwá kpó lɛ aá ŋ́ mā, é nyíla okónu nēé ce ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nā kwu ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ obū nɛ̄hi kpímm wā í klá odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ géē yúklɔ́ kú ɛga otīīhɔ ā ōfōōfū nū á, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā kóō híī wā ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
idu_Latn: Ń géē mā ɔ̄ tá je bū ácí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gāa tá eyī tá aɔ́cí ufáyin ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē hī ɛhɔ̄ tū ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó géē je bū ujē mɛ́mla ácí. N kōō gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yā klá anú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni gekwú. É lɛ ɔ́ nyi Ugíbɛ̄ya, ɔlɛ́ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem, nēé je lɛ ɔyí nū Ufínēhasi ā.

eng_Latn: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka okónu ō hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ wɛ ɔdā ékpó mla opīyatɔ̄há ipú ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ohígbū Onesímɔ̄si, nōo wɛ ɔyí um ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n klá agbá mla anú ā, n le pīya ádā nū ipú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā yɛ ŋmá āyā ɔhá kú Usáridi ā, yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛjī kú Ucísilɔtábɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó ga Udabérati klla yɛ gicō ga Ujáfīya.

eng_Latn: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
idu_Latn: Aá nɛ̄ Ujóbu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ aá á, ó ka gā um ŋ́. Amáŋ ń gáā tā ɔ̄ ohi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tá ɔ̄ ohi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, ācɛ kú Ufilístiya le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí ɛfú kú Ugílbōwa. É ŋmó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu alɛwa abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ohile kú uwā, kwu Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olagbénú ā tóohi kahíníī, Ehée, ádā um, Ébrahām, ɔ́ɔmā í jɛ̄ ŋ́! Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ga ɛgiyí uwā glá, é géē mabɔ̄ íne o bīya tá.

eng_Latn: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ajɛ nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā kpó yálé. O gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ubááligadi ɔpɛ́ kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ga ɛfu kú Uhaláki ɛháajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm. Ujóssuwa le ajɛ nyā kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
idu_Latn: Ɛlitólādi, Ucésilu, Uhɔ́ma.

eng_Latn: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya le da otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú úgbɔ́nya ā kahíníī, Aá yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, n táafú ŋ́ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
idu_Latn: Ijēenyi géē ŋmó ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayípōklóbīya nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
idu_Latn: Anú ā gbō um klla ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ um á. Ó gē gbō um klla ī hɛ́ um tá, anú nɛ̄ n lɔtūce koó í yá ká n̄ lā ɛbɔ́ á. Anú gē yá aéwɔhá ā lé klla kpó uwā bá ɛháajɛ um á.

eng_Latn: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá yálé klla le odúúdú agbénú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā kpó ga ɔlɛ́ nū á. Kwu aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ma ā.

eng_Latn: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā dúúdú ācɛ ā yá ka Udéfīdi kóō lɛ ɔdōlé lé, amáŋ Udéfīdi le ɛka gbo kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ um ŋmó ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔdōlé lé gbɔbū ɛɛ́ ka ɛnɔ kóō ga ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
idu_Latn: Ipéeyi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā, ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā cāŋjɛ háyicō, kwú ipoto kú nū ú, anɔ́ɔ ó nwúleyīkwū nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā le kpó hídáagó dúúdu, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Alɔ ī má ɔdā dúú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nyā jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē yíiɔtū tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā mla ɛjɛɛ̄jī ɔtū mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwā kéē nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē fu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú éyi kú álá ámāŋ ka ɛna kú uwa ú gwɛ́ɛya kú ucɛ kú Onyatá ā lɛ ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka kéē bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
idu_Latn: A híī gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ tū anúɔ klla yɔ̄ ī yá anúɔ italā ohígbū ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gē gbā ɔ̄ kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ oyēeyī olɔhi he ɔ́ ɔtū, nōo gē cɛgbá oyēeyī olīkpō. Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ nōo dɔ̄ɔ̄kā kóō jé ɔ̄nyɛ kú oyēeyī?.

eng_Latn: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
idu_Latn: A bī abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā Óndú, anɔ́ɔ a le aólɛla kú uwɔ catāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
idu_Latn: É ŋmó Upassandáta, Událifɔn mɛ́mla Asipáta.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, A wɛ Itica kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ á jé ɔdā nēe bá ā ŋ́ kpɔ́ɔ̄ áā?.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, ɔtū nāa le ce um ā lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā í wɛ ɔkpani kú ɔkpíyē kú nū ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔbá nu wɛ ɔkpani nū á. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ɔbá í wɛ ɔkpani kú ɔkpíyē kú nū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔnyā nū wɛ ɔkpani nū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko géē wā, nēé gáā hī abɔ́ɔ ka, Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti amáŋ ka ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ é géē hī ka ɔpɛ́ nēé í hɛ́ ācɛ ɔkɔ nɛhi. É ī kpó okwū ācɛ nyī ɔpɛ́ abɔ́ɔ, ohígbū ka ɛga ɔhá dúúmā í gáā táajɛ nēé gē nyī okwu ācɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ o yá ɔdā ímlɛ́ nɛ̄ n je íjééyī lɛ uwá ā kéē lɛ awulú otīihɔ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú um, Árɔ̄ni ā gɔ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
idu_Latn: O fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kwu aóklóbīya um, nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce uwá ā, nēe gē lé ɔdōlé ɔlɛ́ um ā, lɛyí bú kwu um dúú.

eng_Latn: But the hand of the LORD was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them, and smote them with emerods, even Ashdod and the coasts thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le italā nɛ̄hi yá ācɛ kú Ássīdɔdu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ó yá uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā jīla tū uwā ā italā nɛ̄hi, o ŋmá lɛ o tū ōcē obɔ̄bí kú apú alɛwa nɛ̄hi klá uwá.

eng_Latn: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kéē lā ɛbɔ́ ipú Ujerúsālɛm, ká ācɛ nēe lā ipú aágblɔ̄cɛ́ ā kéē bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku, ɔyí kú Ahítūbu mɛ́mla Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔyí kú Abíyāta wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú nū á. Useráya wɛ ɔmálɛ otɔkpá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogbāājɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Eyī gē nyā ānāānā, amáŋ otú kē í bī kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a tíne ō dɔɔ̄kā kpɔ́, ayíka a kwúcē wā igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō ga Usamérīya. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ɛga nēé hī áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ācogbāálá ā.

eng_Latn: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe pɛ́ gaá yɛ ā ka obɔ̄bí kú nū nɛ̄hi. É jíla ɛyí ī ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ā híīī miya odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú abɔ́ɔ í lɛ aílɔ́wá, nēe géē lɛ ikpó da igelī kú Ɔwɔicō ā tāajɛ ɔyā ofɛpa cɛpa.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufilístiya mɛ́mla ācɛ Árābu lā kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ukússi lā ā ajaajɛ okónu ísu ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ uwá ɔtū je gicō lɛyíkwu Ujɛhóram, anɔ́ɔ é cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
idu_Latn: O ŋmɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa kú ɔkpɛtā ā, ɔnyā ā kwúcē wā Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá ajɛ kú Ufilístīya. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ kwú ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɛ ɔlamu kú anúɔ ú kwúcē lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔfú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā ɔcɛ́ kú nū le tū aá ufi. Ufi nū géē kwú aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu nēé lā ipɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gē lɛ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā nēé hī kú Áda tū kóō wɛ eko omlɛ́nyɔ́, mla ɛ̄cī kú éeyē, mla ɛ̄cī nēe gē kɔ̄ ɔdōlé gé lɛ ācɛ nēe lā kwu uwá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ ɔ á. Ɛ̄cī nēé je aólɛlā kú uwá kpó yálé ā.

eng_Latn: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu, ámāŋ éwɔhá nēe bá ɔlɛ́ aá, kwú ɔyí nū dóódu ú lɛ ɛcí nēé hī ka Umɔ́lɛ̄ki ā kéē bī ɔ̄ le yá ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ dúúmā eko nēé gē gbō ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē tɛ́ɛ́cɔ̄ klá anú cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gekwú.

eng_Latn: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
idu_Latn: n géē je aá kpó ŋmá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá ā. N klla í cīgbīhi kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nāa gwó gā um nyā ā. Ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu géē bī Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ kwiita klla í leyī gwū ɔ̄ bónū.

eng_Latn: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛ̄cī kú otutū, ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā kē gáā gbɔɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ olɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ aálá alɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ó cɔ̄nū ŋ́, kóō lɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ éyi je lɛ anúɔ nōo lɔfú mafú lɛ anúɔ ka anú wɛ Óndú ā ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
idu_Latn: N géē je íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōjé ā gā uwɔ. N klla í je agbénú, nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ dúúmā í lɛ jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā lɛ gɛ ŋ́ mā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya kwú eyī kú nū ī pīya kwu ɔdɔ, ɛyí agōdō kú nū lɛ igbīhi cē kwu ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.
idu_Latn: lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ Ujeremíya bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú inū kú ācogbāajɛ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ussafán ā abɔ̄ á. É ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ɔlɛ́ nū ɛbɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya lā abɔ́ɔ ipú ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mɛhīlī nɛ̄ Ɛlísābēti yīīpú ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ugébrīyɛ̄lu, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Unásārēti nōo wɛ éyi kú igelī kú Ugálīli ā.

eng_Latn: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú ā da ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Odúúdú aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ kwu ɔ́ ō lɛ ā le pɛ́ gebí tāajɛ ɛɛ́. Aágbénú mɛ́mla aɔ́dā o tū ɛgahi kú uwɔ ā mɛ ɛɛ́, á kē gáā má uwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes:
idu_Latn: Ébrahām tá ɔ̄ ohi kpɔ́ kahíníī, Kócō, ā cɔ̄nū abɔ̄ n lɔtū yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gā uwɔ kpɔ́ ā ŋ́, Óndú. N wɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ icííce nōó lɛ íkwu ō ka ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ uwá kpó ŋmá eyī kú nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ pi uwá ahɔ̄ bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā ga ajɛ kú Asírīya á. É bá abɔ́ɔ jāa kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
idu_Latn: Ā híī lé ɛnwú nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɛ̄jīla nōo ce uwɔ ɛgbá ā ŋ́. O lé nɛ̄hi kú ɛnwú gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gē gba.

eng_Latn: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō ī mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū kóō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū nɛ̄ n, ó wɛ ohígbū kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā yá ŋmá umu, nēé bī ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ohígbū keé nū uwā ŋmá Íjīpiti acígilí, é je ɛga lɛ uwá kéē yá ɔdōlé dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, gbō um, ká ā lɛ um hɛ́tá. A cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú um ŋ́, ohígbū ka awɔ nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um tábɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́mpa kú Udánīyɛlu ā mɛ́mla aígbómína ofɛhīlī ā gbɔɔ́ ō tíne ɔwɛ nēé gē má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Udánīyɛlu gē yúklɔ́ ipú āhɔ̄ kú nū, ipú ajɔ̄ɔcɛ́ ā. Amáŋ é má ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ Udánīyɛlu yā ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ka ka ɔ́ɔ nyíleyí ɔwɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
idu_Latn: É le mafú ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ aádáádā alɔ ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, é le ācɛ dóódu nēé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, yá ɛdɔ kú italā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔdā nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aɔ́dā ɔ̄há alɛwa bá nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá, nɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛ uwá dúúdú tá nɛɛ, n gbɛlá ka odúúdú ɛcɛ í gáā bī ɔkpá nēe géē tá ɔ̄ tū ipú nū ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú uwā nēe gē gwííjē nyā kɔ̄ aígwu ofucɛnɛ. Ígwu dóódu gē lɛ ācɛ ofucɛnɛ ipú nū. Iyē kú aígwu ofucɛnɛ nyā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí, nēe gē leyīkwu ígwíígwu dóódu ā bá á. Ígwu kú aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ásāfu. Ígwu ɔ́mpa wɛ ígwu kú Ugɛdalíya.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ɛláyíja kahíníī.

eng_Latn: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Usamérīya wā ɛgiyí nū ā, é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ahínyá, a wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi! Abɔ̄ a le yá lɔhi ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nyā ā, n géē kpó aígelī igwó gā uwɔ ká ā leyīkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī, ó wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe gekwú ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā yēeyī tū ɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu da ɔ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ayínɛ́ ā kpó wā inu gé lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu á.

eng_Latn: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ́ɛ géē cɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē tū lɛyíkwu uwá ā ɛhɔ̄. Ó ka ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēēnyi géē ŋmó uwā. Ɛgbá kú ɔdā dóódu géē ce uwá. Ó ka Óndú ā géē yá uwā ōwē ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú kpó yíífi ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá í gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ tɛtɛ ā nɛ̄ ó wɛ eko dóódu á, kwu ícɛ kwu óócí.
