eng_Latn: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ le apī hɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ koó le pīya ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Ɔ̄cɛ í gē le pīya ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ohígbū koó lɛ apī hɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú aátámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā á. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ atámɔ̄kpá le okónu kú ɛya ō gwó ce fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ó cokónu kú nū ā. Ó í yá odúúdú ɔdā ó cokónu nū ā pií.

eng_Latn: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
idu_Latn: Ódúúdú ācɛ nēe ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ aá tá ɛɛ́. É kē lɛ ɛlá wu aá gɛ ŋ́. Ami ā kē le ɔfú kpó kwu aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ olɛlā gē kpɔ́fú kwu olɛlā kú nū nōó gē méyīnyinyi nū ŋ́ mā. Italā nɛ̄ n yá ā nwunē nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá lé ā nwuné. Ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā klla kē nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ nuunu tá Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ klla le yálé. Ó jikwú klla da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ cɛ anúɔ. Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ gā ɛgiyí Ujékɔ̄pu Ubɛ́tɛlu gáā lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
idu_Latn: É le bēhé Ujɔ́dan ga Ujérīko. Ācɛ kú Ujérīko nuunu tá uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔn, Upɛ́risi, Ukɛ́nan, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Ugerísayi, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla Ujɛ́busi kpɛ́fú tá uwā ā. Amáŋ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le odúúdú ācɛ ā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
idu_Latn: Da alɔ, Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄nyɛ fíyɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄ ahɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kɛlā nēe bá nyā ipéyī Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ, ka aádáádā aá wɛ ācobɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ ajɛ kú Arám, ɛ́ɛ kē lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bī aíkonó kú uwā nyɔ̄ í lā ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Áluka kú uwā nōo nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā le lígíí ā, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ le nyīla kwú píya éwo nɛ̄hi, klla kwú lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
idu_Latn: Aígbáanɔ ā le pɛ́ wā í bá ajɛ, ipú uwā ɛga nēé ce áklɔ̄kpɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n da uwɔ ka, ɔtú mā, gbɔbū ka ɔbúgwū kóō tōgwú igbɛ ɛpa ā, a géē ka igbɛ ɛtá ka anúɔ í jé um.

eng_Latn: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā abɔ̄ a gbɛlá kóō géē lɔtūce ɔlɛɛcɛ nōó yá ŋmá ɔmɛ ā, nōo wɛ ajɛ, nēé klla lɔfú je ɔ́ catāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛha āa?.

eng_Latn: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
idu_Latn: Igbo amōōmɛ, ó gaá gwutá ɔ̄cɛ olɛ agbénú, eko nōó kwú heyī ā, ó klla lɛ agbénú dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
idu_Latn: Usɛ́tɔ, ɔyí kú Umíkɛlu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwā kéē híī yúúfi uwā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla uwá. Ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ í yúúfi nū dúú.

eng_Latn: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
idu_Latn: Ó le ígwu kú aíju mɛ́mla abaná tū klá ajɛ Íjīpiti, nēe kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī odée kú uwā í kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē yíhɔtū tū uwā klla í hɔ́hā ce uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyīla nɛ̄hi klla géē lɛ ayí alɛwa. Ó klla ka ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ igwu, ejé, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólífu ā. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ í hɔ́hā kú aɔ́dāajɛ ce uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ ɛdɔ kú ɔhā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu kú nū lɛ ádáádā aá ā ce aá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔnyā ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ŋ́, ɔnyā ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ uwá le yɛ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ ā, owu ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu cɛ̄, abɔ̄ ó lɛ aláadi kú ogwéeyē kú ɔnyā ō lɛ ā yá āa, anɔ́ɔ Ulában kwú Urécɛ̄lu ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúú yá um ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ohígbū ka n le kwu wā í ce uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
idu_Latn: N kpéyīce ka aá géē le jé ka n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú uwā í kpó tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī uwā le yá uculo kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō. Aóje nɛhɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu nōó kpó ŋmá aéwɔhá nōó yálé ā wɛ ipú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And they could not answer him again to these things.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā í má ohi tá ɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni le ede ma iyɔ̄bū ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ucɛ géē yɔ̄ óócí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ̄ gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ nyā tīile nɛ̄hi lɛ aá nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, amáŋ ācɛ nēé cɛ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ o gwíinu tá kóō lɔhi ŋ́ mā, klla kwú pīya ɛcɔ̄ o cɛgbá nɛ̄hi nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si jeyī gicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má ɛwa nɛ̄hi gē wā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄, ó da Ufílīpu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ alɔ géē lá igbō ŋmá ká ācɛ nēe bá aá kéē lé ā.

eng_Latn: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
idu_Latn: É kwú pīya aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi gē cē ɔ̄ gē nū ɔ́wá kú ācɛ o wā í wu ɔlɛ́, ohígbū kéē wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe wɛ ɔka kú ɛfú ō kpó.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,
idu_Latn: Ó ka amíyɔ̄ da uwá kahíníī, Ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka, aá abɔ̄yī aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī kú Ujúda ā ífi lɛ ā ā. Jāā kwu ícɛ nyā, uwá tá alácɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē lā ipú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa géē kwú, é géē nyi uwá, aɛ́kɔ̄ kē í je uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa kpó lé.

eng_Latn: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
idu_Latn: Ukedɔlayóma, ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́lam, mɛ́mla Utídal, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugoyím, mɛ́mla Ámrāfɛlu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ussína, mɛ́mla Árīyɔ̄ku, ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛllása. Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛnɛ lɛyíkwu aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Klla yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ ŋmaáŋmaá mla ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá nōo ī mafú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā í klla kwúcē nyɔ̄ gaá yúklɔ́ kú uwā ipú nū glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́lu nēe bá í gbāājɛ Ugíbēyi, ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn ā, má ācɛ kú Ufilístiya le gbájí, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī kwinya ga amu ga anú.

eng_Latn: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō mla um ā, ami abɔ̄yī um jé kpɔcii, ka aá abɔ̄yī aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄hi. Aá jé aɔ́dā nēé bá nyā lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō nwū ācɛ ɔ́mpa aá.

eng_Latn: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é da Unaómi ka ehée, aá géē pɛ́ nyɔ̄ mla anú ga ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā gē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā. É klla í pā ɛcí kú uwā kpɔ́. Jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ayááyí uwā gē yá ucē ɛdɔ éékpó ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā le ɛlā nɛ̄ n géē ka ā da um ɛɛ́. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, Ɔwɔicō da um ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā á.

eng_Latn: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kóocōō pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ā. Kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ú yá alɔ ɛhi Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ. A kpó eko bónū gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū iyē nɛ̄ a lé ā. Ohígbū ka igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm nyā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bā anú ā wɛ ákú uwɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíssāma, Ɛlíyāda mɛ́mla Ɛlífɛ̄lɛ̄ɛti.

eng_Latn: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, N bī ācīije le da aá aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, amáŋ eko gē wā, nɛ̄ ń gáā kɛlā lɛ aá ipú ācīije gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ n géē da aá ɛlā lɛyíkwu Ádā ā pélúú.

eng_Latn: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é le ɛgba dɛ̄ klá uwá á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Udáni ā pīyeyī, da Umíka ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄? Ɔdí gbo nɛ̄ ɛwa ā ɛ́ɛ cē klá ɛcɛ gɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā lɛ ācɛ túbá ŋmá odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔcí nɛ̄ Ubássa gē bī le hɛ́ igá tū Uráma ā kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄ ú hɛ́ igá tū Ugɛ́ba mɛ́mla Umísipa.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
idu_Latn: Nááná a jé ka amíyɔ í lɛpɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ nōo gē hɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
idu_Latn: É lɛ uwā yá ubatísim ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛla ā, ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Umósīsi ipú ojuja mɛ́mla ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē yá odúúdú ɔdānyā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ igbalɛwa.

eng_Latn: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
idu_Latn: Aílɔ́wá ā le cɔ̄nū, ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ a gáā ma ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ fú ā le yá ɛɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ a géē kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā le yá ɛɛ́. Eko le yá nɛ̄ a géē gbā ulé lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, nēe wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwā, kwu ācɛ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ɛɛ́. Eko ga nɛ̄ a géē ŋmó ācɛ nēe gē kpó ācɛ ŋmó ipú ɛcɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā, n géē mafú lɛ odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā ka n lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ka ń klla tōō le gbla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́. É kē í jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā cíkā ō lā mla ɔnyā nū ɔwɛ nōo tīihɔ mɛ́mla ɔwɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
idu_Latn: N le ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ ā mafú lɛ ācɛ nāa kpó gā um ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ ā. É wɛ ákú uwɔ, awɔ kpó uwá gā um á, é kē lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
idu_Latn: Ó kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ń má ɔnyā ā ŋ́. Ācɛnyīlɔ kú abɔ́ɔ ka akwuna dóódu í lā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
idu_Latn: Ó kē lɛ uwá kpó wā ɔlɛ́ nū, lɛ ɔdōlé je lɛ uwá. Anú mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
idu_Latn: A le akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ kwu ajɛ ŋmá ígblé, a yɔ̄ tɛtɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛcɛ kóō gbo ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ́ yíhɔtū tá uwā klla fu uwá ohígbū kéē lɛwa fíyɛ́ aéwɔhá kú ipú ɛcɛ ā ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē wɛ ācɛ nēe nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ábsālɔm klla da Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ géē cɛ̄ ka ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ, Ámnɔn ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá āā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá āa?.

eng_Latn: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Ujísɔ̄si ā lɛ ajɛ ma, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ nya um eyī á, ó da um ka n̄ nyɔ̄ Usáyílomi gaá lɛ iyē gwā. Anɔ́ɔ n ga nyɔ̄, gaá lɛ iyē gwā á. Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ nyi kwɛyí ā, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā da ayí nū ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ anúɔ gekwú, é kwú okwū kú anúɔ ú gwutá pī okwū kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ anúɔ nyi mɛ́mla anú ipú únóji éékpó.

eng_Latn: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi nyā a? Anú wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla lɛ ɔfú ɛfú ō kpó nɛ̄hi āá. Ó klla gē yálé ɔgbɛ́fú piyóó.

eng_Latn: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
idu_Latn: Anyā ā kwú pīya ɔtūnōbí lɛ Áyísīki mɛ́mla Urebéka.

eng_Latn: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō í tóohi ŋ́ náaná, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó kwú īyī nū í tayínū, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Alelékwū kú um ī gaá yɔ̄ ipú alɛɛcɛ piyóó gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔkpíyē nōo gē kwú. Amáŋ, ɛ̄cī kú nū géē wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le da uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō húmáyī yɔ̄ mla um ipú ɛlā nyā lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó húmáyī tá um abɔ̄ lɛ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ka gā um klla yá gā um ā. Anɔ́ɔ é tá um ohi kahíníī, Alɔ cɛ̄, ká ālɔ̄ lɛ igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā túgwó igbɔhá. Anɔ́ɔ é le tútū kéē gbo úklɔ́ kú igá ō gwó kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
idu_Latn: Ubárāki lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli kpó hīīgwú wā Ukɛ́dɛssi. Ācɛ úlā-ofu-cɛhɔ̄ yɛce ɔ́. Udɛbɔ́ra kē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, tá kéē pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka lɛ uwá. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā é kwú ɔtū kú uwā í gwū ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
idu_Latn: Aá nōo wɛ ayíkpó kú um ā, kóō lɛ olɛhɔ̄ nyā mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū um ā gbō, klla kwú ɔ̄ tū.

eng_Latn: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
idu_Latn: Aá í je opī éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú ínoōbīya, mɛ́mla ɛwū nēé je gwɛ́ɛya kú iyē ō gwu kú ācɛ ā dúú. Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā mla ɛya kú ejé.

eng_Latn: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
idu_Latn: Ulában tóohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ucē kú alɔ amānyā kú ɔyínɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔbá gbɔbū lɛ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo hile kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ géē wɛ ákú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū. Ó tīihɔ ābɔ̄ é je ɔ́ ŋmá ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nyi iháyí ɔ́mahātá ā, nááná, aá géē bā ī lé ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ kú aá nɛ̄ aá cē iháyí ɔ́mɛhīlī ā kpɔ́. Aá kē í lɛ ɔdōlé jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá nyi iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē da ɔ́mpa uwā kahíníī, A má ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā? Ó wā gāa cá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛcá nɛ̄ n. Ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ cokónū ká anúɔ í je agbénú nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla adá kú anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó glá kóō kwú pīya ɔnyā nū. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í gáā gbā ije ɔlɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocījáalí ɛpa ā pó ɔkɔ éyi dɛ̄gba kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpáncō kahíníī, Aá wā icō amānyā. Abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā bá gē má uwā ā, é yɛ ipú ojuja le pɛ́ tá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó gē doōcē, Óndú ā géē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄, klla ī nya ɔ́ tá ŋmá ōcē kú nū ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú hɛ́ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Udéfīdi ā, é kwú Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati ā ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā. Ujérobōwam le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu eyí pīya ŋmá oōgbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá plla tū ɔ́bíipú ō bī tū Óndú á.

eng_Latn: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ­o tɔ́kpá tū ɛcɔ̄ tíne kóō bī oje o lɛ ɔkɔ́ lɛ iyē kú ayínɔ̄nyilɔ kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā tá tū ɛcɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɛcɔ̄ ā ɔkwu ú kwu ugóolu .

eng_Latn: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si pi uwá ɔhā lɔfú lɔfú kéē híī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ odée je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lé.

eng_Latn: Then Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tóohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ekōhī ŋ́ ó géē lɔfú lɛ ikpínu ā táajɛ anɔ́ɔ ó le má ka anúɔ í gwó inu ā kwɛyí glá gɛ ŋ́ má. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛnyā í yá lɛ ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe má ɔdā nōó yá ā géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā okónu.

eng_Latn: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um ka kahíníī, Alɔ le ɔ́ yálé ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Ā cɛ̄ gā um gwōnū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwéeyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔma, ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ami abɔ̄yī um nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɛyí bú kwu aá. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá í yá aá ōwē ipēyī aéwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, abɔ̄ aá ke cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, Óndú kú ɔfú, ɛgahi mɛ́mla ocɛ̄tla ā, aá híī je ɔ̄cɛ éyi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá má ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, ācɛnyā, ayípɛ̄ mɛ́mla aúgbɔga dóódu nēe lā ɔlɛ́ uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú uwā kéē pó íne ā abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī jé ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kllɔcɛ́ ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē nwú ā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē ā kahíníī, Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Umáyíkɛ̄lu, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōo gē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā géē bɛ̄cɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko kú unwalu mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ífi nēé yá ipú ɛcɛ ā jéejée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā gbɔɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēé tá iyē kú uwá tū ipú ɔkpá kú Ɔwɔicō ā, géē nyatá.

eng_Latn: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ācoyúklɔ́ ā í lɛ ɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá ī gwōkónu, aá híīī lɛ eyī hɔ́ɔnɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ oleyīɛpa ā ŋ́. Ohígbū keé gē le eyī kú uwā kwúfúlá ká ācɛ kéē jé ka uwá yɔ̄ ī gwōkónu. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, uwá mīyɛ ulé kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ tīile ā, odúúdú ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ā kpó kwú, klla le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyó kú ipú aínu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā géē kpó odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū ā kwú. Ó géē kwú ācɛ dóódu nēe gē wɔ́tū nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn jé íjééyī fíyɛ́ ācɛ ojéeyī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla Íjīpiti kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
idu_Latn: Otú kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, Usɔ́lu le ācogbāajɛ kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi, kéē nyɔ̄ í gbō ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Amáŋ ɔnyā kú Udéfīdi Umáyíka le da ɔbá nū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ kwu otú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, óócí, ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya okwū.

eng_Latn: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kéē kwū ikpati kú okónu ōce ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ā. É le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛplá ahāpotú, Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi bá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ yɔ̄ ī gwííjē lɛ Ɔwɔicō, aálagbá ohile ā kē bá gē pó tā ɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ eko kpiíí nɛ̄ Ábna nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, Ujówābu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ɔhá kú Udéfīdi ā pīyɛyí ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú wā ɔlɛ́ bī iyó nɛ̄ é kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Ábna í yɔ̄ Uhɛ́brɔn eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ, ohígbū ka, Udéfīdi mā ɔ̄ tá le yɛ ɛbɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
idu_Latn: É yɔ̄ gē lɛ okónu kwu um iyē, klla ī ka kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í kē gáā tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ le ɔdōlé ā lé klla lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ gwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔmā ipú klla yāwu ɛ̄cī ofɛpa ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhórebu, ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Umikáya, ɔyí kú Ugemaríya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ussafán le ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā nɛ̄ Ubárukú yɔ̄ í je ŋmá ɔkpá ā pó.

eng_Latn: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nuunu tá uwā le uwá kpó ŋmó tīkwū klá ajɛ gónóó. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú Étam ā.

eng_Latn: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú igelī ā, nɛ̄ īkpō kú odúúdú nū wɛ umíta úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofu igwɛ́ɛpa cigwó . Aókómpinu ɛtá í bá abɔ́ɔ. É géē lé iyē ká, okómpinu kú Ugádi, okómpinu kú Ássa, mɛ́mla okómpinu kú Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.
idu_Latn: N yá ɔdā nyā cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā, o ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kéē le jé ka ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ gwū um tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
idu_Latn: É ge ka ka aá jé Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ ucē ó yá kú uwa í mafú ka é jé ɔ́ ŋ́. É gē wɔ́tū ɔdā olɔhi, é kē lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfu, e cíkā lɛ úklɔ́ olɔhi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ugbɛ kú ogwiji ā, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá géē kɛlā olɔhi glá āa, nɛ̄ aá wɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí āa? Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ā nɛ̄ okónu gē ka wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ́ɔmā lé ka itíca kú íne dúúmā nōo le nwū jé lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádɔ̄lɛ́ nōo ī kpó ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nōo ī kpó odée kú nū tū ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ɔ́yínɛ́ Upɔ́lu ā ka, Ācɛ Ujíyu ā le miya ka aá géē ba awɔ ká ā lɛ Upɔ́lu bī hīlatá ga ɛgiyí ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā óócí, bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé gáā bɔkwɛ̄lā ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ā ohígbū ka uwá tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú um nɛ̄ n tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá igbalɛwa bū okónu kú aíkonó kú um, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Aá nēe wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ aéwɔhá ícɛ nyā í kē jāhɔ̄ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
idu_Latn: Udɛbɔ́ra, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Urebéka gekwú abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ nyi ɔkwu ɔcí óoku, ɛháajɛ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú iyē í ce abɔ́ɔ ka ɔcí óoku kú ikwū ō je.

eng_Latn: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nōó le lɛ ā, Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē je ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ aá. Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi le ipú yɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Eko nōó lɛ ɔyí ma, é géē hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Imánūwɛlu.

eng_Latn: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ le opo kú ɛfú nēé tá ā pó ipú igelī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó gáā yúufi ŋ́ mā a? É gáā je igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā yíífi icííci glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́, Óndú ā tū ācɛ ā ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔyípɛ́ obene ā, ó lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ī leyīkwu ɔ́ klla bá ī leyīkwu agbénú ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū nɛ̄ ó í lúgwū agbénú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í gaá pā ɛcí o ŋmá lɛ o ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú uwā ɛcɛ lɛ ebilíi nōo gbla ɛwū ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lɛ íne nyā tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá géē je lɛ ɔ́ géē kwu ɛkpa ofigwɛ́ɛnɛ ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́, ɛkpa kú īkpɔ̄dā úlā ɛhɔ̄. Oli kú anɔ̄ kú ólīfu úlā ɛhɔ̄, mɛ́mla ɔmā mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā kú uwá ɔhá dóódu nēé í cɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gē wā ajɛ eko ōhī gaá jíla éŋkpɔ̄ ā iyē. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le tá ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā aflɛ́yí eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ jíliyē, ó lɛ nyatá ŋmá ōcē dúúmā nōó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
idu_Latn: Ámɔn le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ádā nū Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwutá ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm, kwu ayípɛ̄ kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ, le pɛ́ gaá le yɛ ɔlɛ́ ā tá.

eng_Latn: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā okplícī ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi lā Ubɛ́tɛlu. Anɔ́ɔ ayí nū gā ɔlɛ́ gaá le ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi nōo ŋmá Ujúda wā í yá Ubɛ́tɛlu ā mɛ́mla ɛlā nōó ka lɛ Ujérobōwam, ɔcɛ́ ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē cɔ̄nū fíya ŋ́, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú īyī nū tū glá, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɛfú kpó le igelī nɛ̄hi éyi yálé mīyɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔkwu á.

eng_Latn: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nɛ̄ iyē kú lé ka Ádām ā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ā cɛ̄, le ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyā awɔ da uwɔ ā yá ā. Nɛ̄ a kē le īkpɔ̄cí nɛ̄ n ka ā híī lé ŋ́ mā lé ā. N le okónu tá lɛ ajɛ ohígbū uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́. A géē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī oyēeyī kú uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā má ɔdōlé lé ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́cī nū ɛwa nēe háyi ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu ā, má ka ɔ́kɔ ékpó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á, é kē le jé ka Ujísɔ̄si í ga ipú ɔ́kɔ ā mla ayíkpó kú nū ŋ́, amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ōfōōfū uwā.

eng_Latn: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
idu_Latn: Usíkiri, éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔyí kú Áhāsi Umaásēya ŋmó, mɛ́mla Asiríkam otrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́, mɛ́mla Ɛlkána nōo kpókónu ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú ɔ̄ ú abɔ̄ aá kú aá kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú aá lɛ ā. ācɛ Ujíyu ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í lɛ íkwu ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ojigógó ka aá géē má ɛ́nyɔ́ nōo géē bī aá bū ipú aɔ́dā nōo géē yá mɛ́mla ɛ́nyɔ́ nɛ̄ aá géē bī háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi lé ka ɛ̄cī éyi eko nɛ̄ aódɔlɛ́ alɛwa mɛ́mla ācobīyíne ā wā kéē pó ɛlā kú Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
idu_Latn: Olíla nōo lɛ okónu kú nū klá cíí, é gē je ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ jéeyī, ohígbū ka ó lɛ okónu kú nū klá, klla yɔ̄ cíí.

eng_Latn: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó klla gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Ubáalu ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínnɔm, klla kwú ɔyí abɔ̄yī nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ú ŋmó gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɛcí kú ubáalu ā dúú. Ó klla yɔ̄ í yá ucē kú ācɛ ōpɛ̄cí kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā hīla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ́ɔ é yɔ̄ gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ā da Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā ka amíyɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka n gáā je igelī nyā tá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́. Ó kē í je ɔ́ yɔɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
idu_Latn: Á lé tɔ̄há mla aɔ́cɛ́ ōhɛ́pɔ̄ újí ŋ́, nēe gē je ɛga lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó le kpaakpa ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
idu_Latn: É géē je odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yíífi, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú odúúdú aéde kú uwá mɛ́mla aójibó nēé ī gbā ā í kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. É géē kpó aéde kú ɔtulalī kú uwá kpó yíífi odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá klla ma ā kē í bí tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lɔ̄n, Utímina, Ɛ́krɔn.

eng_Latn: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ Ánāsi aflɛ́yí. Anú wɛ ádā kú ɔnyā kú Ukayáfāsi, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú ā kóō má aá mla eyī olɔhi kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō je ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō he aá ɔtū, aá bī ukwɔ olɔfú nɛ̄hi lɛ iyē gwā, nááná n géē yɔ̄ ī má ɛpɔ̄bí kú aá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu pi ɔtā kú nū liiŋooo mla odúúdú ɔfú kú nū le ɔyí bū Ujóram ɛgiyí ácábɔ̄ gaá kwu ɔtū kli. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram má gwōnū tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je íli mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ lɛ aá klla í kpó ɔkpíyē klá aá iyē. N géē je owu tū aá ipú, géē je aá kpó héyī ká aá yēeyī. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
idu_Latn: Ipú inu ā abɔ̄yī nū, é le ɔcí nēé hī Uséda ā kpó bá ɔ̄ iyē, anɔ́ɔ é klla le oje udɔ olɔhi ma plla anú. É le ofu kú ɔcí alī mɛ́mla ákú agbá yá tū ɔ̄ oje udɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
idu_Latn: Ó bī agbá ō jítɔ̄há kú oje lɛ ija he tū ikpɛ̄yí icō kú aúpíla ā.

eng_Latn: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛnyā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā, ó géē lɔfú tū aá iyē, nɛ̄ aá gáā lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́, kú aá le tīihɔ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ mɛ́mla Ádā alɔ, eko nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ ī wā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú nɛ̄ Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla Ujérobōwam kpó ā klla yɔ̄ ī gɔbū eko kú Ábījam kpɔ́ jāā gbéeko nōó kwú.

eng_Latn: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá bá ī tá ɛlā kú um, nɛ̄ aá í lɛyítáajɛ ga um ŋ́ kpɔ́, n géē yá aá italā ɔ́klá ahāapa.

eng_Latn: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa ámāŋ ācɛ ɛtá le jīla ohígbū um, n géē yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Gbonɛnɛ lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
idu_Latn: Ayīnu kú uwɔ tɛ́hɛ́ kwɛ́mm bɛ̄ɛka ígwu kú aálá nēé lɛ uwá iyē gwā ā. Odúúdú uwa jōōnjīlē kpligidi, odúúmā í fu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá iyɔ̄bū hī uwā tá lígíí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú okwúukwu ú kpó tāajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́dāŋ nōó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛ, ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ nyatá ŋmá eko kú ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́mahātá ā: Usibekáyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Userá, nōo ŋmá Uhússa ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí ígwu ɔ́mahātá ā á.

eng_Latn: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
idu_Latn: N má ka ɔdā nōo lɔhi ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā, wɛ o yɔ̄ ī lé mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ī gwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú odúúdú úklɔ́ nōó gē yá ipú ɛcɛ ā, eko kú oyēeyī kpii nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ohígbū ka, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā, kóō hɔ́hā ce Ussɛ́m! Ukénan kóō wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ipú ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ nēé kpó lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, wɛ igwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
idu_Latn: N bī odúúdú ɔtū kú um le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ um hɛ́tá gé lɛ aá fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é gwéeyē, klla cɛ̄tra ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēé fu kéē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ā cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ká ā klla cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohútu kú ɔdōojé á. Aólíla leyī gwō íjééyī mɛ́mla ɛlā nēé ī nwū uwā ā bónū.

eng_Latn: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya lā a, ācɛ nēe gē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ yúklɔ́ nyā kpaakpa ā wɛ, Íden, Uminiyámin, Ujésuwa, Ussemáya, Amárīya, mɛ́mla Usékanīya. É gē kɔ̄ ɛhi nyā jōōnjīlē lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi dóódu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
idu_Latn: A géē je odúúdú ijē nōo klá ɛyí iyíípú ā, ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā, ikpílí ɛpa mɛ́mla ijē nōo klá anú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ uwá kpó yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede kóō wɛ ɛya ō gwó gā um.

eng_Latn: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōo gē yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā, gē yá eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka kóō yá ā. Eko kú ɔdā dóódu nēe yā ipú ɛcɛ nya ā yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó leyī gwū ɛlā nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ nwū ɔ̄ ā bónū. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ɛlā ā miya mɛ́mla aɛ́gɔ́ nū nōó jɛ̄ mɛ́mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka íne nōo í ŋmó ācɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɛgahi ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ, ayíbɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú íne nōo gē nyā ācɛ tá ā kē í lɔhi lɛ ā!.

eng_Latn: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé lɛ unwalu dúúmā ŋ́ mā gē yá ācɛ nēe bá ipú unwalu ā okónu. Aá bá ī je unwalu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī móōwē tɛtɛ ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
idu_Latn: Ugáálu dɔɔ̄ka ka ɛdɔ ācɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ Ussɛ́kɛm abɔ́ɔ ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē gbā Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ɛ̄gbā āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ fúlufúlu āa? Kóō wɛ ɔyí kú Ugídīyɔn áncā, ka Usébulu ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ igabɔ̄ kú nū á. Ó kéē cɛ̄ ācɛ nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Uhámɔ, nōo wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ Ussɛ́kɛm ɛhɔ̄. Ó ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā āa?.

eng_Latn: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́nɔ́ŋgblɔ̄ nēé yá bɛ̄ɛka ododó ā kē le pīya jíla aúpíla ā ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ úklɔ́ kú aúpíla ā gaá mɛ á.

eng_Latn: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
idu_Latn: Ébram da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɔhi, ó wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú uwɔ, yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ Usárāyi yá Uhága ōwē nɛ̄hi nōo yá kú Uhága kóō le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lā iháyí úlā ce ɛtá ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó klla Le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔlōlé mɛ́mla ɔdōowiiyē ɛ́ɛ́, ɔ́ɔmā cíkā ō jɛ̄ alɔ.

eng_Latn: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ncɛ́ éyi, nōo yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ikpō amɛ̄ kpiíkpií abāābɔ̄ Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá lɛ ɔ́, eko nɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ óklóbīya í wā í táaha nū ā?.

eng_Latn: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ alɛwa nāa yá ā, nwuné nɛ̄hi Óndú, ɛlá nāa gbo ā kē lipú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra awɔ eko dóódu klla ī wóofu iyē kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da uwɔ, Ujehóyakim, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, abālɔbányā, ka ɔyí uwɔ dúúmā í klla gáā lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lé ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. É géē je okwū kú uwɔ tɛ́cɔ̄ tá ɛcɛ, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛnɔ géē yɔ̄ í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɔlɛɛ́nɔ, nɛ̄ ébú géē yɔ̄ ī ce klá anú otú.

eng_Latn: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
idu_Latn: É le úgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū ā na okónū éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá kú Usamérīya ɛga nɛ̄ aéwō gaá le oyí kú nū planyɛ̄, aákwuna klla le iyē gwā tū abɔ́ɔ dúú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka ka ɔ́ɔ̄ géē yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ī kwú ācɛ nēe jéeyī ā abɔ̄ ipú ula kú uwá bɛ̄ɛka ukpa ā. Ɔwɔicō í gē cɛ̄ lɛ ula ká ācopllɔ̄cɛ ā yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tíne ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n da aá ā nɛ, aá wɛ ācɛ obɔkwu ɔdā tayínū.

eng_Latn: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: É géē pa aíkpokwú ā hīla bɛ́ɛcɛ nɛ̄ ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ géē cɛ̄ uwā. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā béeyī ā, ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔmā he uwá ɔtū nēé ī gbā, klla í pā, gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ uwá á. É gáā tá aíkpokwú ā bá kéē kpó uwā nyī ŋ́. Aíkpokwú ā géē bá ɛcɛ áncā bá ī wā tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka īmū ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba ŋmá ipú ɛwa ā kahíníī, Utíca, n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ, lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um nyatá gā um, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ékpónú kú um á.

eng_Latn: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
idu_Latn: É tá kéē bī aíne kú nū le yúklɔ́. É klla kē leyī gwō ɛka nɛ̄ ó gbo mla aádáádā uwā bónū. É klla kē je ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó pi uwá anú ā ka ɔdā dóódu ŋ́. É gbā aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛ̄gbā, anɔ́ɔ é kē kwú pīya ācɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dúú á. É klla kwú yɛce ucē kú aéwo nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá biílí ā, gē mafú ka ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū kéē híī gbla uwá yá ŋ́ mā í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um nɛɛ, abahi géē yɔ̄ ī ca aá bá eko dóódu, bɛ̄ɛka ísu nōó gē cēenyi eko dóódu ā. Olɔhi géē yɛ í wā kwūūū lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá obene kú um, n húmáyī móōwē, klla kwu ikwū ajaajɛ. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú ōwē nāa ī je gā um ā le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
idu_Latn: Ɔfiyɛ nōo kwú pīyɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ. Olíla nōo lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ó tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ācohéjulúgwu ɛpa nyɔ́kpá mla Ujísɔ̄si, éyi yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná anɔ́ɔ ɔhá ā kē yɔ̄ abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le aíne nēe bá nyā kpó lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Aá kóō híī cikpó ɔmáapú aá dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú ā kóō tá uwɔ abɔ̄ eko nāa yɔ̄ ipú unwalu. Ká anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, kóō gbō uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
idu_Latn: Ń jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ kú ācɛ nēe nwū um ɛlā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē pó klla ī lɛ ɛlá wu ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ o nwū um odée ā, nwū um ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔbá lɛ íkwu ō da ɔnya kóō yá ɔda dúú glá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ íkwu ō da icɔ́ɔci kóō yá ɔdā dúú glá ā. Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo nya ācɛ icɔ́ɔci kú nū tá á, icɔ́ɔci ā kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpíyē kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Upíta, n da uwɔ ka ɔbúgwū í gáā togwú ícɛ nyā dɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a géē híhó igbɛ ɛtá ka anúɔ í jé um jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā olɛ ɔbá í lɛ iyī nū ŋ́ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔbá nū yēeyī ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔbá nū gekwú, ó le hɛ́tá kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúú nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōó ī lɛ ā kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó géē tū ile lɛ aá ká n̄ nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ń nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́, otɔ́tūlé ā í gáā wā ɛgiyí aá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n le yɛ, n géē tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fu aá.

eng_Latn: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
idu_Latn: anyākwɔ́cɛ ofucɛnɛ ā má gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō nōo cīīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ukata kú uwā fu ŋmá ɛyí kwú uwā í kpó tá bá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā. cɛ́ɛ́ é gē gwííjē kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú aá ā owē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra awɔ Óndú, nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ yá ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ísɔ, nēe lā ɔlɛ́ ɛfu kú Ɛ́dɔm ā. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ le ācɛ kú Uhóri kpó yíífi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má lā anú. É lā abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je lɛ Uhilikáya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ ohile nēe bá ā; Ahíkam, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussafán, Ácībɔ, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umíkáya mɛ́mla Ussafán ɔmále kú únɛ́pɔ̄, mɛ́mla Asáya nōo gē leyīkwu ɔcɛ́ ā ka.

eng_Latn: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nēé nyɔ̄, é ba ī bī uwēyī gé lɛ iyē kú um nɛ̄ iyē ɔhá dúúmā í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ, ohígbū ka ācɛ gē bá ī ka, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā, amáŋ é lɛ uwá nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwá nɛ̄ ó je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
idu_Latn: Óndú nōo lā Usáyɔn, nōo yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō ā, kóō hɔ́hā ce aá.

eng_Latn: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
idu_Latn: A le okónu nāa ce lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā bīya ɛɛ́. A kwú ukata kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ú tá ga ipú ɔ́tɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
idu_Latn: Ó da um kahíníī, Le beé nyɔ̄ ka á má ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nēé bá ī yá amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛlā kú ācɛ nēe lɛ iyī uwa kwelūbi nēe miya ká aá gáā lɛ iyī aá ŋ́ mā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā le má ka anúɔ í yá ucē olɔhi lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛnya ā ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ koó má ka unwū ɔnyā ō lɛ le lɔfú tū anúɔ iye, nōo gbɛlá ka aá lɛ iyī aá lɛ nɛɛ, ayíka é lɛ iyī uwā lɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tíne ō yá ā. Ínoōbīya dúú í yɔ̄ ipú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé, le uwēyī je lɛ uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
idu_Latn: Aá nya, kú aá klla tíifu, ācɛ kú Usáyɔn kú aá jikwū, ayínɔ̄nyā kú Usáyɔn lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɔma, gáā ma ɔyí ā, ohígbū ka abālɔbányā ā géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú igelī, gaá lā ipɔ́lɛ́ o tɛ́ɛcɛ gēdēē. Aá géē ga Ubábīlɔn. Amáŋ Óndú ā géē nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú aá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
idu_Latn: ucē.

eng_Latn: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpani nū ā lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdā nēé yɔ̄ ī ka lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā wɛ ɔkwɛyi nɛɛ? Á gáā leyīkwu agbénú kú um gɛ ŋ́. Lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a ŋmó agbénú kú um ā kpó ka ga um dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú ɔ́dāŋ koó lɔhi, ámāŋ koó bɔ̄bí. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ka ā, nōó wɛ á.

eng_Latn: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
idu_Latn: É kē le oyēeyī ā mafú, alɔ kē lɛ ɔ́ má, alɔ kē cījáalí kú nū, alɔ kē bī oyēeyī ā nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́, nōo tɛtɛ yɔ̄ mɛ́mla ádā ā, nēé kē mafú lɛ alɔ ā i tɔ́ɔna lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔyí ā kóō jɛ̄ kóō géē jé ɔdā olɔhi ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, ó géē yɔ̄ ī lé anɔ̄ kú ijē kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛnwú.

eng_Latn: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū ī je íne klla lɔfú kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ glá ā. Anú ōfūnū lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ klla kē lɔfú nyā ācɛ tá glá á. Aá lɛ íkwu ká ā kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔ́mpa aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
idu_Latn: ó kōo wɛ aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ nēe lā kwu uwá ajaajɛ ámāŋ ka aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ nēe lā ɛga oligbó ā.

eng_Latn: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
idu_Latn: É kē í jé aá, ka aá wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā, ka aá klla wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ kú Ɔwɔicō. Aá géē jɔ́ɔnyɛ agbénú kú aéwɔhá ā, klla í yɔ̄ ī gɔ̄ ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lé ɔda dóódu ā, kóō híī leyī gwō ɔ̄cɛ nōó ī lé ŋ́ mā bónū ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōó kē ī lé ŋ́ mā, kóō híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lé ā okónu ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ anú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí ohilí nū Ujɛ́tro, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N tíne ká n̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe bá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā jila. Ká n̄ lɛ jé ɔ́dāŋ ka é yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́tro da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó géē kpó aólɛlā kú nū yíífi dúúdú bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nōo gē cēenyi gē kpó ɔlɛ́ ācɛ ā. Ó géē nū aólɛlā kú nū inya jāā gbéeko nēé le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
idu_Latn: Ó pīyeyī lɛ ācɛ ā má biílí, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nāndaa. Ó le yá lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ā kwú ya lɔfú klla kwú yá mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ami wɛ anú a a, é kwúcē yɛ igbīīgbīhi gaá gwōnū bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
idu_Latn: ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan jāā ga ɛháajɛ, gaá kwu ajɛ kú Árōwɛ nōo yɔ̄ okónu ísu kú Ánɔn ā, ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla Ubássan, ɛga nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi mɛ́mla Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ lā ā wɛ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Uhasɛ́lu mīyɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é hī Ubánābasi ka Uséyɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é hī Upɔ́lu ka Uhémēsi ohígbū ka anú wɛ ɔkɛ̄lā kú ācɛ ɛpa ā á.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the LORD, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n má ka ācɛ ā bá ī yúufi ā, n cāŋjɛ klla da uwá kéē híī yúufi kú aólɛlā kú uwā ŋ́. N da uwá kéē blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā tūūfi lɛ ā. Ó géē kpɛ́fú lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya wā í le abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ á. Ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū wā í le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ Udamáskɔsi, é le Urésin, ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya ā ŋmó. É klla le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó kwú, kwú uwā ú piya alagbá kú ɛfú ga ajɛ kú Ukɛ́ru.

eng_Latn: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá lɛ uwá. Eko nēé le lé klla le gwá ā, ó le uwá kpó nū nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya. Ó ŋmífi ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ kú Usiríya í klla wā í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
idu_Latn: É géē bá ī tíne ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Usáyɔn ā, klla í bá ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā. É géē je īyī uwā pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, í gbɛka mla um, nōo géē yɔ̄ piyóó, nēé klla gáā bīya anú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
idu_Latn: N gē je agbénú lɛ ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tá um ā. N klla gē tū inu ɔlɛ́ uwā mu mla ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ agbénú.

eng_Latn: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ifotó kú aɔ́cí alī mɛ́mla aúcérūbim kpó tū ɔdɔ kú eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, jāā gaá kwú icō kú odúúdú aókómpinu ā. Ifotó kú Ucérūbim mɛ́mla ákú alī ā gboce iyī uwā éyééyé lɛ ā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdɔ ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aúcérūbim ā lɛ eyī ɛpā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla tá ācīije alɛwa ɔhá lɛ uwá igbɔhá. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
idu_Latn: É gē kpó agbénú kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé lɛ ā lá, anɔ́ɔ é gē kɔ̄ ije kú nū lɛ odúúdú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgbá kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
idu_Latn: Usúsa, ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā, ācɛ Ujíyu ŋmó aólɛlā kú uwā úlā ce ofu ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ, eko nɛ̄ ɔlá le ɔkpíyē kú ɔ̄cɛ yi, nɛ̄ eyī nū ā kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ɔnɔ̄wá mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
idu_Latn: Ó kē he Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla alɔ ɔtū kú alɔ je iyó ogbɛnú fíyɛ́ aíne nēe cɛgbá mbá nyā ce aá ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɛ jāā ga ɛjī kú Ámɔn mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn, Usíhɔn, gē gbō ŋmá Uhɛ́sibɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le igbo ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa ā kpó, ó jeyi ga ɔkpáncō le ahínyá ta Ɔwɔicō ohígbū uwa, le uwá kpócē, anɔ́ɔ ó kwu uwā í kpó lɛ ayíkpó ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
idu_Latn: A lɔfú gbɛlá ka anúɔ le abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ami nōó lɔfú ŋ́ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ le gbogwu ga um ā tū īyī ɔ̄ ɛɛ́ m.

eng_Latn: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígbáanɔ nēe gē wu ɔkpáncō ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dā oyéeyī dóódu nēe lā ipácí ā kē wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
idu_Latn: Ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ Ujísɔ̄si dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Ɛlɔ̄yi, Ɛlɔ̄yi, lamá sabaktáni? Nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Ɔwɔicō kú um, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔdíyá nāa je mlanyi um ā.

eng_Latn: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
idu_Latn: Aá wā ka alɔ nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ nēe bá nyā, nēe gbɛlá ka aá ɔɔ́ bá ɛbɔ́ ā. É cē igá tū ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋ́ māa, ɛɛ́ nōó gē lɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ mɛ́mla igodó dúúmā ŋ́. Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ foóó.

eng_Latn: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā yá ɔdōlé dúúmā ɔlɛ́ aá ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
idu_Latn: Kwu ācɛnɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ̄ yɔ̄ ī tíne ō bī ɔwɛ újí le lɛ ije. Kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya bá ī plla ācɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, N kwú uwɔ ú yá igbómína kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
idu_Latn: Ó le ugóolu ā ma plla ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔcí nēé le gbā ɔ́ ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ o yɛ ga okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ācoyúklábɔ̄ le ofu kú ucérūbim hijā tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ugídīyɔn tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ā nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yá ā á. Ka olígíí nɛ̄ uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem yá ā, ɔ́ɔ fíyɛ́ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ yá ā á.

eng_Latn: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kú aflɛ́yí kú nū ma. Ó lɛ ɔ́ gbō mla īlī ō le gbō ɔyípɛ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú gwutá ipú ikpati ō lɛ ɔdōlé kú ɛbɛ́ tū ɔ̄, ohígbū ka ɛga í jɛ̄ uwā inūgbɔga ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ ka aá í gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ ka aá géē gbō ɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū, kú aá kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ é le Usámsin gbō mla ɔ́ŋgbá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
idu_Latn: A le um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú unwalu dóódu ɛɛ́. A kē klla má ka a lɛ aólɛlā kú um yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ hī Óndú ā, ó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá Ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī bá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn mɛ́mla Ujɛrúsālɛm nēe géē kwu, ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu ā géē wɛ ācɛ nēe í hile oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le tá ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ru, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú abɔ́ɔ, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ kú iháyí ɔ́mofɛɛpa nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛcɛ gēe je yíífi klla í pīya alácɛ̄. Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubálāki le pó ka Ubálam ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī wā ā, ó nyɔ̄ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Áru, igelī nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ okónu ísu kú Ánɔn, ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ācɛ Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
idu_Latn: A le ɔcí ufáyin éyi bī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti lɛ aéwɔhá kpó nū ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ a kwú ɔ̄ ú tū ipú ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā yá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī ŋmó ācɛ nēé jégēdē ŋmó ācɛ ŋ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī klla lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujéhu yá ā, kwu úklɔ́ kú ɔtū ōlɛ kú nū, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
idu_Latn: É géē mīya āyā éyi kú ajɛ ā nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa, ɔwá kú nū kē ī wɛ ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄ tá ajɛ nēé géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ákú Óndú abɔ̄yī nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
idu_Latn: Okokonkofí gē mābɔ̄ ayi kú nū tá ipú ɔjɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka idɔlá kú ajɛ kóō hɛ́ klá anú.

eng_Latn: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm, Umówābu, mɛ́mla Ámɔ̄ri le gwá.

eng_Latn: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nōo kē lɛ agbénú ā kóō gwéeyē eko nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū gāajɛ. Ohígbū ka agbénú ī mɛtāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ododó kú ɔcí ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo cɛgbá ā wɛ ka aá yēeyī ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá dɔɔ̄kā kú aá yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n wā í má aá glá ɔ́ɔmā lɔhi, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ń wā glá ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā kē lɔhi. N géē pó ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ka aá bī ɔtū ékpó le yá ɔdā ɛdɔ ékpó mɛ́mla odo ékpó nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í gáā jíla aá iyē ŋ́, abɔ̄ aá bá yɔ̄ ī nunu tɔ̄há ohígbū ɔtōōce Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ŋmá ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ogbló ā géē wɛ ahātá mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛhīlī kú uwā. Ígbóoje-otáajɛ ɛpɛɛpa bá ɛháajɛ éyééye.

eng_Latn: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
idu_Latn: Ɔbá dóódu cíkā ō yíhɔtū tá ɔnyā nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yíhɔtū tá ācɛ icɔ́ɔci anɔ́ɔ o kwú oyēeyī kú nū tónu ohígbū nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aá wā ipú ígbíli kú aéwo ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n kē ī ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí ipéēyī aá cāā.

eng_Latn: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa nēe lɛ úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ wiiye cīce ajɛ, éyi yɔ̄ ablɛ̄yí, ɔhá yɔ̄ ablīkpó kú ɛga nēé lɛ okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si gwutá ā.

eng_Latn: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ń tīile dóódu gɛ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔjá kú ejé nōo le gbokwū ā. Nááná ń kē je mlanyī íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ojéeyī gē cɛ̄ lɛ ádā nū gwéeyē. Amáŋ ɔyí olíla gē lɛ eyī gwū ɛ́nɛ́ bónū.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn wɛ aípɔ́ɔnū kú Usérēdi, Ɛ́lɔ̄n, Ujahlíli.

eng_Latn: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si klla kahíníī, Ó géē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ aá nēe lā ipú abahi ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Usáyɔn ā, mɛ́mla aá nēe gbɛlá ka aá bá lɔhi Usamérīya ā. Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú éwo nɛ̄hi nyā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tá uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
idu_Latn: É dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a wā í junwalu lɛ alɔ ā? A wā gaá yá alɔ italā gbɔbū lɛ eko ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
idu_Latn: Aá jɛ úklɔ́ olɔfú fíyɛ́ lɛ uwá kéē yá, aá híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, N cɛ̄, Óndú. Anɔ́ɔ ó tɛ́ɛyí-kpɛɛ́ le ɔ́gbá tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyíkpó nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yíihɔtū nū ā da Upíta kahíníī, Óndú ā nɛ̄ n. Eko nɛ̄ Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta pó kóō wɛ Óndú ā, ó lɛ īlī kú nū kpó klá iyē ohígbū kóō le iyī nū wɛ́ɛwa gbɔbū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ómbli tá tū ipú éŋkpɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okpé gē wu licō licō lɛ glá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgwā gē pi ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ glá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úgbéenyi gē jé ɔwɛ ipú itekwú glá ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ gē yíihɔtū tá iyī uwā lɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē blakwu aíne ā ipú ɔtū kú uwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ aíne ā gbō bá ácábɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla údɔ̄bū kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yɔ̄ ī blatū uwá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu, ayí kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla ayí kú Umanásɛ mīyɛ ajɛ nyā kóō wɛ úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ mā ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ tá, nɛ̄ alɔ bá ī gbā ɔwɔ kú aéwo ɔhá ɛ̄gbā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka ohi nɛ̄ ɔnyīlɔ ā tá ā le kpaakpa, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á ligbó lɛ ō bēhé ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. Igbīhi ɛnyā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔtū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā dúú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī mɛ́mla ojɔ́dā gē tíne ó jé ɔdā tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, amáŋ, o cīce bɛ̄ɛka ogwuda ā, he ācɛ ɔdāhá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
idu_Latn: Aádā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́, aá híīī yá ayí aá cɔ̄nū ŋ́. Aá le yá lɛ ā, ɔtū kú uwā géē je gbenyi, nēé gaá lɛ ɔtū yá ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ācogbāálá.

eng_Latn: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
idu_Latn: Ó cíkā ká ā méyīnyinyi kú ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ményinyi kú uwɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɛlā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ī yá alɔ nyā, í kwú uwɔ iyē ŋ́ nɛɛ? Á gáā yá ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā mā alɔ tá kú ālɔ̄ bá ī móōwē fíyɛ́ ɛ́nyɔ́ kú alɔ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
idu_Latn: Utéra wɛ iháyí ofigwó ce ɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú ajɛ kú Uháran á.

eng_Latn: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔkpá ajɛ ā tá, lɛ abɔ̄ tú ɔ̄ klla lɛ aíjáalí hī. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ije miya ɔdā nēé ī bī le miya anú ā kwú kpó lɛ Uhanámɛlu á.

eng_Latn: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ofītɛ́ gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ mu obīlifu kú nū ā, nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā le mu mla iyó nēé plla ācɛ mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā ā. Ɔ́ɔma yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé je gbagbénú klla je pīya ācɛ nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó je īkpɔ̄dā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ánplā, nēé hī ka umaná ā lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpáncō kéē lé.

eng_Latn: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ nyatá, o klla lɛ alɔ fu ká alɔ wɛ ācɛ o lā oyēeyī otiihɔ. Ó wɛ ohígbū úklɔ́ kú abɔ̄yī alɔ yá ɛɛ́ nōo yá ɛnyā ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ihɔtū mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ miya táajɛ ā ōfūūnū nɛ̄ n. Alɔ le he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū táajɛ gbɔbū nōo yá ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ó lɛ ācɛ ɛpa nēe bī ɔ̄cɛ o kplá ācɛ ije éyi ulé. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi bī ɔ̄ īkpīije nɛ̄hɛ́ ulá cofɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ɔhá ā bī ɔ̄ ofɛpacigwó.

eng_Latn: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú ka odúúdú úklɔ́ idáagó kú Óndú ā tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú cɛ̄tra anú kwɛyí glá ā?.

eng_Latn: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:
idu_Latn: Alɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya, alɔ le ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē kú ɔ́bíipú yá. Alɔ le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá uwɔ klla lɛ igbīhi ce kwu uwɔ. Alɔ klla kwúcē ŋmá íne mɛ́mla ɔwɛ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɛ̄lā kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ cɛyí éŋkpɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō kú ocɛ̄tra gē gbo akpáabana, Ɔkɔ kú nū cīgwū eyī ísu nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá híīī je uwá bɛ̄ɛka olɛlā ā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá pi uwá ahɔ̄ abɔ̄ é wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpā aá.
