eng_Latn: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē je ɔ́da, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu cīla, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē cīla igwu ipú ɔlīyalīyā ā. N cīla uwā ŋmá ipú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nyā, ká n̄ lɛ aɛ́nɛ̄ ó tīile ŋ́ mā yā ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó lɛ lɛ ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū á nɛɛ, ayíka ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ ɔnyā dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujɛhóssāfāti ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda le yɛ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Urámɔtu kú ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko kpiī ā, ɔnyā kú ɔkpani nū ā gbɔɔ́ ō hɔ́ɔkɔ Ujósɛ̄fu. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō da ɔ́ kóō gwutá mla anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá háyi ɛga nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ gē háyi ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le okónu ce ka anúɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, klla í lɛ odúúdú íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū tū mla odúúdú ɔtū, odo, ɔfú mɛ́mla ɛlá ō gbo kú anúɔ. Ó ka anúɔ klla í bī odúúdú ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne ā le yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
idu_Latn: Mīyɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, kéē bī uwā yúklɔ́ kú ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ nēé gē yá ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
idu_Latn: Ódúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē lā ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, ebilíi ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ga icō ɛfu olicō nɛ̄hi éyi. Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwā mafú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
idu_Latn: N géē je aójibó mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ okwu ajɛ kú ɛcí kú aá kpó yíífi, nɛ̄ aá klla gáā túkpɛɛ́ lɛ okwúukwu kwu ajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá bī abɔ̄ kú aá yá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lɛ aɔ́dōbɔ̄bí ɛpa yá ɛɛ́. Éyi wɛ ka é kwú igbīhi ú ce kwu ami, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi nōo ī pɛ́ ā. Ɔ́mpā wɛ kéē klla lɛ obuga nōo le ca nɛ̄ ó bī éŋkpɔ̄ dúúmā glá ŋ́ mā bū lɛ īyī wā.

eng_Latn: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ ā ka o wɛ ohilí kú ɔcɛ́ í wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ wɛ ogbɛhá, anúɔ í klla wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó gekwú kóō kwú igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mā, ɔfú kú ínoōbīya dúú í lɛ ɔ́da ɛgiyí nū gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā ó yēeyī yɔ̄ ī lé tɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ō tū ɔlɛ́ ɔkɔ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ kúo tá gicō kú aɔ́kpá ā, ŋmá okónōgwu éyi kú Áklɔ̄kpīhɔ ga okónōgwu ɔhá.

eng_Latn: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kplá ije mɛ́mla ɔdōlé ŋmá ɛgiyí um dúú, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé kplá ije mɛ́mla ɔdōlé ŋmá ɛgiyí aɔ́mpa um dúú á. Ālɔ̄ kwú odúúdú ɔdā nēé kplá ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ ā ú yá uwá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
idu_Latn: N klla da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla um ā ɔ̄kā ka iní nēé gē je ómbilí ā nyɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
idu_Latn: Ádā uwɔ, Usólōmɔn yá alɔ ōwē nɛ̄hi. Ó klla le iyō ogbɛnú nɛ̄hi gbōce alɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a géē tū iyó ogbɛnú kú ádā uwɔ ā wāajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ yá fékéé lɛ alɔ, nɛ̄ a klla í dēē yá oyēeyī kú alɔ kóō le tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ alɔ, alɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ, nɛ̄ a géē gbō alɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ a yɔ̄ í kpó ayí um gáā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí áa?.

eng_Latn: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ mla odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ géē lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wu iyé piíí. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú, kéē kē mā ucē ɔ́bíipú mla ucē kú obɔ̄bí ō bī tá.

eng_Latn: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi wɛ ádā kú Óbɛ́di. Óbɛ́di kē wɛ ádā kú Ujése.

eng_Latn: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī ka ā glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ a ī cɛ̄ okónu ucē ɔhá ā í le pélúú ŋ́. Ayíka aá yɔ̄ gē kɛlā tū ipú inu áncā.

eng_Latn: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
idu_Latn: Ákú uwā lɔhi ɔ́dāŋ nōó wā í lɛ uwá má le tútū, ó kōō wɛ ahāpōtú ámāŋ ka ofúlɔ̄cī nōó wā á!.

eng_Latn: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
idu_Latn: É géē je odúúdú aálagbá ā nēe bá gē dɛ̄ kú ɔnɔ kú ɔkpíyē ā kpó hɛ́tá ānāānā. É gáā kwú ipú agbá ŋ́, é klla í lɛ ɔdōlé dóódu nōo ce uwá ɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
idu_Latn: Adáma, Uráma, Uhásɔ.

eng_Latn: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ācɛ kú aéwo nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā ā, pó ɛlā kú ācogwɛ́ɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ó da uwá ka amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá aɔ́dā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ gē yóklóbīya mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo klla ī kɛlā ogbonɛnɛ ŋmá okónu.

eng_Latn: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
idu_Latn: N da aá ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ alɛwa kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tíne kéē má ɔdā nɛ̄ aá má ā, amáŋ é má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́. É kē tíne kéē pó ɔdā nɛ̄ aá pó ā, amáŋ é pó ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā ga iyāwu ā. Amáŋ gbɔbū kóō ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā, ó kwú ɔlɛ́ nū í tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū abɔ̄. Ó da ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɛ̄nɛ̄ o í gbō ɔwɛ ā kóō leyī kwɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, Ulebīyatan nōo wɛ ɛgwā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā géē yɔ̄ ī nya kpánákpáná, í yɔ̄ ī pīya klikli kóō kwu. Amáŋ Óndú ā géē bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū olɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla otūufi nɛ̄hi ā í yá italā ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipú ísu ɔ́ɔmā italā. Ó í ŋmó ɔɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Usamérīya ā gē gbā ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé ŋ́ ɛ̄gbā, amáŋ alɔ ācɛ Ujíyu ā jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nya ācɛ tá ŋmá iyē kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated for the firstborn, by giving him a double portion of all that he hath: for he is the beginning of his strength; the right of the firstborn is his.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́kplá kú nū ā ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ āyā ɛpa kú agbénú kú nū, abɔ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū í wɛ ɔnyā ōcɛ̄ kú ádā nū ŋ́ nááná ā. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ géē je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔ́kplá ā lɛ ɔ́kplá kú nū piíí.

eng_Latn: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ í yɛ ɛyí ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ kú Usamérīya. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā éyi dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Tá um abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a húmáyī gwō bɛ̄ɛka olíla, klla ī yá ojuju kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛɛ, háyi cíí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā gbɛlá.

eng_Latn: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
idu_Latn: Alɔ bī ije ɔhá abɔ̄ wā í lá ɔdōlé. Alɔ í jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ije kú alɔ tá ipú ɛkpa kú alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le da uwá kéē ga ɛcɛ ŋmá ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō ga ojuju mla iyī uwā yɔ̄ ī kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi kpó gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, kéē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, nōo le tēelihɔ bēé wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ ɛlā nyā ka ga um ipú acīije.

eng_Latn: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ka ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū ā ú wu apɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā ú wu apɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú nū géē yá ā. Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā géē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā, ka ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē kweyī mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yi kú ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya nēe nyɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nɛ̄ uwá ɔ́ɔ bá ī kpɔ́tūce ācɛ Íjīpiti ka ɛ́ɛ kpó aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla aɔ́nya wā í tá uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, alɔ í lɔtū gla gɛ ŋ́, abɔ̄ alɔ í wā gaá má aá glá ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ alɔ le miya ka alɔ bá ōfōōfū alɔ ipú ajɛ kú Átɛns.

eng_Latn: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ kú uwā kóō kwú pīya ífi lɛ uwá. Ucɛ o tīihɔ kú uwā ā kóō kwú pīya ukpa lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Udánīyɛlu bī wā kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá. É le Udánīyɛlu kwú wā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nɛ̄ ágábá wɛ omōōmū nū ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da Udánīyɛlu kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu ā, kóō lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ yá ojuju klla bī odúúdú ámíyā nyā wā í klá Utáya, nōo gē gbō aéwo alɛwa āa? Ɔnyɛ miya ɛnyā tū Utáya nōo ācotɔ́sú kú nū le ojīlīma fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ āā?.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ nyīla ɛgiyí um lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī mɛ́mla ācɛ ōhī kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda tū nēe í lé úgwū ajɛ kú ɛyí aɛ́fu kú um. Ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu, nēe gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā géē lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo gbɔbū ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ um, Ísɔ le gbɛyí mla awɔ ɔwɛ, nōó dɔɔ̄kā ka, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔkpani uwɔ ā? Iní nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔkpá nɛ̄ n tá fu aá ā, n da aá ka aá kóō híīī yɛ tɔ̄há mla ācɛ nēe ī cikpɔ́nyā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɛga je lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā kéē yá ɔdīcíci dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā tíne ā, é gē yá ɔdā ōtūwēyī mla ɔ́mpa ūwā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ána wɛ, Udíssɔn. Udíssɔn kē wɛ ádā kú Uhámran, Éssban, Itrán mɛ́mla Ukɛ́ran.

eng_Latn: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
idu_Latn: Éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú umu mɛ́mla omlede éyééye.

eng_Latn: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóbābu gekwú ā, Uhúsam nōo ŋmá ajɛ kú Utéman ā le ɔcɛ́ lé.

eng_Latn: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá ayínɛ́ um, aá híī yá ucē kú ɔ́bíipú nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́cí wɛ áncā, ɔdā dúúmā nēé ī yá ā kē wɛ ɔdā ɛflɛ́ɛ́fu. Aójibó kú aɛ́cí ā í lɔfú dúúmā ŋ́, í klla tīile dúúmā ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu áncā ā.

eng_Latn: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛ̄pɔ̄bí ŋmó uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ a klla lɛ italā yá uwā. Lɛ yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ujɔ̄ mɛ́mla ojuju kú uwá piíí ā, kóō lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ŋmáajɛ. Óndú ā lɛ uwá nū ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. Ohígbū īkpɛ̄yí olɔfū nēé yá ā mɛ́mla íne alɛwa nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ ó le nyɔ́nyí ā, ó gáā túbla ukɔ́tin kú igá kú ɛga otīihɔ ā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka otúblá ede ā ŋ́. Ó gáā nyílá ɔ́dā otīīhɔ nēe bá nyā iyē ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yá uwá tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē hī aá ka Ɔkpani ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔkpani ékpó, anú kē wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úbi gē cɛ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄lá yēeyī ā, nɛ̄ ɛfú kē ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔlá gē cɛ̄ ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o hɛ́ unwalu tá ajɛ gē mu ɔlá tū ɛlā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
idu_Latn: Bī ɔfú kú uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ alɔ nyatá. Lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbā ā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ nāa yíihɔtū tá uwā ā kéē le hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya mɛ́mla ańcɛ́nyā alɔ o he alɔ ɔtū kú Ukɔ́rīnti! Alɔ kɛlā lɛ aá ŋmá ɔtū ékpó kú alɔ. Alɔ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ nwulā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ŋ́ jé ō yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛbɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ɔmā yá, Ɔwɔicō í je um yíífi fíyaa fíyaa.

eng_Latn: O LORD, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
idu_Latn: Eko nōo ŋmá igbīhi ā, a gē cɛ̄ɛ̄pɔ̄ alɔ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ā híī cɔ̄nū mla Ujerúsālɛm igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Igelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú uwɔ nōó wɛ á. Odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aéwo nēe lā kwu alɔ ā géē yɛhɛ tū alɔ, klla í má alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔdāhá klla í yá alɔ okónu ohígbū íne ō bīya kú alɔ mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā wɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄, mɛ́mla aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú Ussɛlúmīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúríssadāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí a lɛ Ujehúdi, ɔyí kú Unetaníya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Ussɛlɛmíya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú ɔyí Ukúsi, tɛ̄hɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ gaá da Ubárūku ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔkpá ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔɔ́ jé lɛ ācɛ ā bī wā. Anɔ́ɔ Ubárukú lɛ ɔkpá ā bī nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
idu_Latn: Náaná ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jāhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē pó ɛlā kú um nēé ī ka ā ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú fíyɛ́ aádáádā aá á.

eng_Latn: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ojiji kwúcē ga igbīhi ikpó igwó á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ācɛ nēe bá nyā, ó he uwá ɔtū ō kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí um nɛ̄hi, é kwú īyī uwā tū glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū í he um lɛyī kwu uwá ŋ́. N géē blakwu ɔdā obɔ̄bí nēé yá a, klá í yá uwā italā ohígbū íne nē é bīya ā.

eng_Latn: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu le ɔkɔ kú nū ka kahíníī, Ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúú lɛyíkwu íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu ámāŋ ka o yá unwalu dúú lɛyíkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ámāŋ ka o yá ɔdōbɔ́bí lɛyíkwu Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Uróm ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́da nyā je lɛ uwá gā um lɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla yā ɔdā ɔhá nōo gē bīya íkwu mɛ́mla iyē kú ɔcɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í ga ɔgbɛ́fú mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile klla í gbɔbū ɛfú ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ uwá kpó wā í lā ajɛ nōo wɛ ákú uwā ā. Abālɔbányā ā, aíkonó kú alɔ lɔfú lā amānyā, aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ igá cē tū ūwā nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ē bá abɔ́ɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá má, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kóocōō lɛ odée fīyɛ̄ anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā cɛ̄ lɛ odée fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ le ágbe yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ámɔn ā le pɛ́ kwu gaá tayínū ipú ɔgɔ kú Umakéda.

eng_Latn: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nya ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, á lɛ ɔdā ō pi éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́, obugā ā kē liipú, iní nāa géē bī éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi ā ŋmá ā?.

eng_Latn: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú wā í jīla Ujerúsālɛm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi, nōo wɛ Usáyɔn ā ú ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā odúúdú uwā lɛ ɔtū lɛ, le ɔdōlé lé abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā uwā da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó í lɛ á nɛɛ, aá le ɛkpa kú aá tū mu mla aɔ́dā olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú kpó gé lɛ igbómína ā. Aá bī anɔ̄, ɛnwú, okwumɛ́, mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄cí kú Upistákiyɔ mémla álmɔ̄ndu.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aá le yɛ tá ɛgiyí oklóbīya nū ahāpōtú gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Oklóbīya um, lɛ igbō ɛtá kplá um káá.

eng_Latn: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā ā í bī omlede ā wā glá ŋ́, ō géē bī okóhō ɛpa, ámāŋ ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa, éyi wɛ ákú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú, ɔhá wɛ ákú ɛya kú íne ō bīya. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kwɛyí nū, nōo géē je ɔ́ iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
idu_Latn: Amásīya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda yēeyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ igbīhi ikwú kú Ujɛhówāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ Ébrahām eko nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ɔ́ ā yɔ̄ á, Ɛpléeko nyā iháyí ɔhá n géē kwúcē wā, Usára kē í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ka n bī obɔ̄bí le cílá oklóbīya um dúúmā ulé ámāŋ ka n le ɔdā olɔnɔ yá olɛlā kú um icííci, nɛ̄ ó yá um ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le uwá ikpó na kwɛyí ā, ó kwú awulú kú nū ú klá iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gáā cīce á. Ó da uwá ɔ̄ka kahíníī, Aá jɛ́yí ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
idu_Latn: Awɔ, ɔyí um, é géē hī uwɔ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. A géē gbɔbū lɛ Óndú ā, ká ā lɛ ɔwɛ nōó í yɛ tútū.

eng_Latn: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Uhíram klla lɛ ācɛ o pɛ́ aúgbéenyi kú nū ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ o pɛ́ aúgbéenyi kú Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ ka anúɔ gaá kpó aɛ́fu nēe bī ɔkpáncō hayi ā fu, é gē yúufi nɛ̄hi, gē fīyégbúlú bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ufi gē yá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
idu_Latn: É lɛ úwé kú nū púla, anɔ́ɔ é kwú awulú nɔ̄wá ú wu ɔ́ iyē á.

eng_Latn: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
idu_Latn: Okónu kú uwɔ kóō híī hágágā ɛlā ō ka ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ gē ŋmúleyīkwū okónu ō ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, a kē yɔ̄ ɛcɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ á gáā yá glá ŋ́, ā híī ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī nēe māháyi abɔ́ɔ ā le ɛlā nōó ka pó, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā gē hī Ɛláyíja igwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ ŋmó tá ō yá ucē nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gē yá ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā le yá jīla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ tɛtɛ le tū Udéfīdi okónu kóō ka lɛyíkwu Ujúdasi, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ācɛ wā í kwú Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé lɛ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yá ubatísim kwɛyí ā, ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ alɔ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá cɛ̄ ipú ɔtú kú aá ka n le pīya ɔ̄cocɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛɛ́, ayíka aá wā í gbɔga ɔlɛ́ um. Ó yá jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ alɔ ɔtū pīyeyī gaá le gbɔga abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
idu_Latn: Bī ɛhi kú ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ nāa lɛ ā yúklɔ́, ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je gā awɔ eko nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kɛlā, nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwɔ ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú íne ā pīya tɔ̄há ipú ɛlā ékpó. Ɛlā ā kē yɔ á: Oladógbe kú uwɔ géē he uwɔ ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka iyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí ádā nū gaá cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ Óndú ā le kwajɛ ā á. Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄ dóódu, kē yɔ̄ ī yá lɔhi. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
idu_Latn: Blá aɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ kú ami abɔ̄yī um kpó lɛ ɔ́, kóō le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. N yá lɛ ā ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ n lɛ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Nááná ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ohígbū aá nɛ̄ n je ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ nēe jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí Uloko ā, klla lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔci nēe hī ka usɛ́da ā, ca tāajɛ dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō gē je ɔfú gā um á. Ó lɛ ikpó kú um yá lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ákú ikpɛ̄ɛnu ā, ó klla kwú um ú tū céé īkpɛyí kú aɛ́fu.

eng_Latn: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó kwu um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ká n̄ le ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā tá lɛ aá nēe bá Uróm ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ dóódu nēe bá mla ami ā hokónu tū odúúdú icɔ́ɔci kú Ugalésīya.

eng_Latn: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī olīkpó wɛ ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ o yá olɔhi mɛ́mla okpaakpa nɛɛ n. Īnyīlɛ̄yí nɛ̄hɛ́ wɛ ukata kú ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa nɛɛ n.

eng_Latn: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í yá imabɔ̄ ámāŋ ka, ɛcí, ámāŋ ka ɔhɛ dúúmā klá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu glá ŋ́. Abālɔbányā ācɛ í kɛlā lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ nɛ̄ Ulɔ́tu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā. Óndú ā da Ébram kahíníī, Leyī yi ɛga dóódu o ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ a háyi āa oŋmá ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ njɔlɔ gē bū éŋkpɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ piyóó ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm gē bī ɔ́bíipú eko dóódu á. N gē pó ɔ̄kā ka ācɛ nēe bá ī lɔnɔɔtū klla bá ī kpó ācɛ yíífi ipú igelī ā eko dóódu. N kē yɔ̄ ī má ācɛ nēé yá ágbe mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ī kwú ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔtū gē he um nɛ̄hi ká n̄ móōwē ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ó wú um ɔtū gɛ ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ōcē kōō yɔ̄ gē yá um, nēe yɔ̄ gē yá um ōwē, ámāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ ń lɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́ nááná, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī yá um ōwē, nɛ̄ ɛ́kɛma yɔ̄ gē yá um ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ n lɔfú iyē ŋ́ mā, eko ɔ́ɔmā nēé ge wā í lɔfú tū um īyē á.

eng_Latn: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́da nɛ̄ Ɛ́sta je ohígbū íne kú Upúrim ā, tá tū ipú ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
idu_Latn: Īnyīlɛyí kú nū gwā nɛ̄hi. É gē wá ɔ̄ ɛyí igbeyí iháyí dóódu, eko nɛ̄ īnyīlɛ̄yí ā le gwā līkpō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi le doobū klla kwú gbɛnú nɛ̄hi. Īnyīlɛ̄yí ā gē gbɛnú bɛ̄ɛka ukílōgram ɛpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē miya odée ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ka ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ wɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō, nāa kōō gē gbɛlá kwu uwá ā, ámāŋ ka alɛɛcɛ icííci, nāa ī lɛ ɛlá kwu uwá ā?.

eng_Latn: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
idu_Latn: Ígwu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú aɛ́bɛ́ ō lɛ ikpó ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ō lɛ āpū mɛ́mla ígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō bá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ da uwá kéē lɛ ɔkwu kú ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ gē tayínū piíī ā bu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wā í lɛ ohi nū kpó gé lɛ anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ mla uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó klá abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́, anúɔ géē je ɔ́ ca tāajɛ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ o tíne nū ipú odúúdú Ujudēya náaná, anúɔ le tútū kú anúɔ tíne nū.

eng_Latn: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
idu_Latn: Ɛlayénāyi, Usiletáyi, Ɛlíyēlu.

eng_Latn: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá bá gē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kpɔ́ ā, ó cāŋjɛ da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔtāhɛ̄ aá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo í tá ɛcɔ̄ klá anú.

eng_Latn: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tíne kú ālɔ̄ blakwu úklɔ́ idáagó kú nū nɛ̄hi ā piyóó. Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ, ó klla ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcí olɔhi gē gwá īkpō obɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ó kē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcí obɔ̄bí gē gwá īkpō olɔhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ka á gaá da Uhɛsɛkíya ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwɔ, Udéfīdi ā, lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā pó ɛɛ́. N klla lɛ agīje kú uwɔ má dúú ɛɛ́. N gēe yá ka ā klla yēeyī iháyí igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Aá le yá lɛ ā, ɔtū géē he aá ka aá le Óndú ā jé. N géē yá kú odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce aá. Aá klla gē lé olɔhi kú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu nōo wɛ aádáádā aá ā. Ami nōo wɛ Uyáwe ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
idu_Latn: É yá aójibó kú aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā, ŋmá ugóolu mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́. É kē wɛ úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, oleyīɛpa, kwú ígbɔ́ɔcí nōo tá uwɔ eyī ā ú gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē mɛ́ɛbɛ pélúú ká ā je ɔjɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo tá eyī kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ayíkpó ā bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nēé gwó ɔ̄ mla aɛ́cɔ̄ nēe lɔhi ō má eyī ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nēé bī wā í le yá Ɔwɔicō ɛhi ā lɔhi lɛ ā ā. Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
idu_Latn: Uhádadi, ɔyí kú Ubédādi nōo ŋmá Áfīt, nōo yá ācɛ Umídiya lé ɔgbɛ́fú kú Umówābu ā le ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄tra īyī uwɔ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nōo kōō wɛ ugbɔga ā, géē cɛ̄tra awɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí ā tá ohi kahíníī, N cíla ije nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n je pīya ɔyí ajɛ kú Uróm á. Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ami ā é ma um ɔyí ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā cɔlá kú ɛ́ɛ lé ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ cīgbihi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā o ŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū.

eng_Latn: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ayí ɛhīlī bá ɛcɔ̄ éyi, iyé kú ɛhīlī ɔhá bá ɛcɔ̄ ɔhá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔgba kú ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó gáā lɛ eko nēé lɛ ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá olékwū á. Eko nēé nyi iyē ɔ́ɔmā, ó wɛ iyē nōo gekwú. Eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, ó gáā kwú glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ujósuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n lɛ mu mla íjééyī, ohígbū ka, Umósīsi le ɔ́ fu kóō kwɛyí nū, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú á. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ujóssuwa, klla lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō nōó je lɛ uwá bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ā tū.

eng_Latn: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ígwu kú uwɔ túbá yɔ̄ ī bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́ á, ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́, ɔnyɛ wɛ Árɔ̄ni ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē ka iŋini tú ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ijēēlihɔ gwó lɛyíkwu Utáya.

eng_Latn: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N le owu okwɔ́lá tɛ̄hɔ̄ klá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá kóō le uwá ŋmɔ́lá tāajɛ. Efúma kwú odúúdú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá, ɔcí ufígi, ɔcí nēé hī ka ólífu ā ú kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ. Náánā, aá cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
idu_Latn: É géē hɔ́hā ce odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ oŋmá ɛgiyí ayááyí uwɔ, ohígbū ka a lɛyítáajɛ ga um.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam lɛ Umáhālati ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujɛ́rīmɔtu, ɔyí kú Udéfīdi lɛ, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Abíhēlu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ujése.

eng_Latn: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N kɛlā lɛ aá eko nōó lɔhi lɛ aá ā, amáŋ aá ka aá jāhɔ̄ pó ɛlā kú um ŋ́. Aá kē húmáyī tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋmífi nɛ̄ aá wɛ ɔyípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ aíne nyā a tū. Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā ŋ́, é géē lɛ́pɔ̄bí cɛ́ɛ́ é gekwú, ohígbū keé tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne ōtīihɔ ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á, n le uwá yá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aɔ́máapú uwɔ, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ Ulífāyi ā kpó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ mla uwɔ, gē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ géē yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe hile ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ā, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔhá kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
idu_Latn: gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Aá í je umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé wīya tɔ̄há mla anɔ̄ kú ólīfu, okoolo ɛtá gwɛ́ɛya mla ɔbá ɛna éyééye. Aá í lɛ okoolo ɛpa kú umu gwɛ́ɛya mla omlede éyééye.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Aá le aéwo alɛwa ca tāajɛ klla le uwá ɔlɛ́ wu, ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ áa ŋmó ā, mɛ́mla ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá uwā ā, ācɛ nōo hile ā géē je aá wu.

eng_Latn: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usiríya mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu bá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwá le eyī hɛ́ kwu īyī uwá ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu le aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛpa cigwó kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujeremíya tá agbá ipú inu kú ācogbāajɛ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā kpɔ́ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ igbo ɔ́mpa.

eng_Latn: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
idu_Latn: Aútíca kú íne ā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā tíne kéē le ɔ́ kwú ɔkwɔɔkwu, ohígbū kéē le jé ka aá nōó tá ācīije nyā lɛ aá á. Amáŋ ufi ācɛ ā gē yá uwā.

eng_Latn: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ami ɔ̄cojéeyī ā, húmáyī wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō kɛpɔ̄ kú um mɛ́mla awɔ. Óndú ā géē gwū uwɔ ɔ́ci gā um á. Amáŋ abɔ̄ kú um í gáā kwu uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ uwá ipú ígbíli gbɔbū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wā ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
idu_Latn: Aá wā í cɛ̄ um ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Óndú ā lɛ ojīlīmā nwuné nɛ̄hi. Aá wā kú ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
idu_Latn: Omlede nɛ̄ a má mɛ́mla aájī ɛpa ā, kwɛyí aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Umɛ́dīya mɛ́mla Upɛ́sīya.

eng_Latn: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Ása wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ubássa kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí Unádābu á.

eng_Latn: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
idu_Latn: Ukína, Udimɔ́na, Adádā.

eng_Latn: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n tíne ká aá le jé, ayínɛ́ um, ka igbo alɛwa nɛ̄ n le miya ka n gē wā ɛgiyí aá, odée gē ce um anú. N tíne ká n̄ yá ká aá yɛce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aílɔ́wá ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí nēe ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Uféro, gáā le ikwū je klá anú kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa gē yá alɔ ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ Ujosíya nōo lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā klla gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā mla odúúdú ɔtú mla ɔfú kú nū, klla yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ka ā bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ ɔhá dúú í klla wā igbīhī nū nōo yá odée gbla anú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya le ɛlā kú ɛbɛ nōó má ā ŋmɛ́yí abɔ̄ ó kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo yá ā yɔ á. Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ā le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā gā uwɔ. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū lɛ ɔ́ ka ka ífi mɛ́mla oyáŋmó ɛ́ɛ géē hɛ́jīla awɔ ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā ī le kpaakpa ŋ́. Ācɛ gēe nyɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é wā lɛ ā. Úklɔ́ ō yá bónū áncā ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o yúklɔ́ bónū lɛ owu, cɛ́ɛ́ kōó owu kóō je ɔ́ mu bónū áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
idu_Latn: Aíjáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ alɛwa wā ī cīije bá ɔ̄, amáŋ ijáalí kú uwā í wɛ ékpó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le tá ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī ka ɛfu kú Olīifu ā, yɔ̄ í jikwū. Ó lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ áncā klla lɛ īlī klá ɛyí, kóō cābɔ̄ ɔtūnōbí kú nū. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɛce ɔ́ ā lɛ īlī klá ɛyí kú uwá klla bá ī jikwū dúú.

eng_Latn: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miyɔ ɔ́ lɛ ā. Ó tū um ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ ká n̄ kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá lɛyíkwu oyēeyī nɛ̄ ó cokónu ká o je lɛ alɔ nēe ge yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá géē lɛ íne nyā tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛ ɛgahi nyā ā? Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Ubárābasi hɛ́tá lɛ uwá á. Eko nōó lɛ Ujísɔ̄si gɔ́ kwɛyí ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
idu_Latn: Ó tínē ká ācɛ dúúmā kéē cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka anú abɔ̄yī nū jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ó má ka ācɛ ɛtá ā í klla má ohi dúúmā tá Ujóbu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ aéwo ā kpó yíífi, ka ɛ́ɛ híī yɛce ɛcí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē pā ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ikwū lɛ uwá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ gē gbā aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ɛ̄gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ gbla uwá yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō gbo ā, ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū yɔ̄ gē ka ka otú ɔ́ɔ gaá bī ɛɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ aá bá ā í kē kwu ɔlɛ́ dúúmā ajaajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó wɛ opií kú aá le tútū eko dóódu, ohígbū ka Ɔyí kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ eyī ce ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ma abɔ̄ olɔhi ō yá kú nū ā tá, anɔ́ɔ ó klla gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ́bíipú á, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú ā, ayíka ó kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ugóolu ma plá anú ɛyí, klla le ugóolu ma ce okónōgwu nū biílí.

eng_Latn: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
idu_Latn: Ede ō yi ɔtulalī umuumu ɔlá ɛyí nū mɛ́mla ogbló kú nū, anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ, ɔtulalī umuumu o kpóocu, ukɔ́tin o klá ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n má ācɛ Ujúda bā í pí enyi ŋmá īkpō Ufáyin ɛ̄cī Usábāti. Ācɛ ōhī kú uwá bī aíjakī bā í kpó īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé, ufáyin, Ufígi. mɛ́mla iyó ɔhá ga Ujerúsālɛm ɛ̄cī Usábāti dúú. N kē lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi kéē híī je ɔdā dúúmā lá ɛ̄cī Usábāti gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka odúúdú uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē gbō uwā ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā ī je aíyɛ́ya kú ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú, ɛya kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛya kú ejé kwu ɛyí odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, eko kú ucɛ kú ɔyá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ gē yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla aúcɛ kú uwá ɔhá ā á. Anú géē je aíyɛ́ya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gwó eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔbíipí bī, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú, mɛ́mla ɛya ole yá ɛbɔ́, kéē kwú ɔbíipú kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu tóohi kahíníī, Igbō nōo fíyɛ́ ikpō égō ofigwó lɔfú jɛ̄ ūwā glá, ɔ́dāŋ keé lé lígíílígíí.

eng_Latn: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
idu_Latn: Lɛ īkpēyí kú um nwūla cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ má ɔdā idáagó kú uwɔ ŋmá ipú ɔkpá íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
idu_Latn: Ga ɔlɛ́ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. N cokónu ka n géē cíla awɔ ulé, amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ ulé nāa í yɛ í mīyɛ ā ci ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú ācɛ ɛpa bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla anú. É wɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
idu_Latn: Opi éyi kú ɛya kú ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
idu_Latn: Aá pó ɛlā kú uwá a ŋ́! Aá tú ɛyí wāajɛ kú aá cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛhɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē yēeyī! Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá yá lɛ ā ŋ́, igelī nyā géē je pīya alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da anúɔ ka anúɔ géē yīipú gē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi. Ka anúɔ híī gwá ejé ɔlamu, ámāŋ kú ejé ō kwú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ gē lé ɔdōlé elihɔ dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔyí anúɔ gáā ma ā wɛ ígwu kú Unásárēti, lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá eko nēé í ma ɔ́ jāā gbéeko nōó í kwú ā.

eng_Latn: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
idu_Latn: N géē le ɔtū eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū, ohígbū ka n le íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya. Amáŋ, igbīhāajɛ ā ó géē cɛ̄ɛ̄pɔ̄ um, klla í je odōbɔ̄bí nēé yá alɔ ā pīya olɔhi. Ó géē bī um wā ipú ɔlá ōfíyajɛ, alɔ géē yēeyī cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó í nya alɔ tá ā.

eng_Latn: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
idu_Latn: óō híī gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē mīyɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī ba ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í je ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō éyi amáŋ ka ɔhá lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ, ohígbū kóō tīile lɛ odúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le má ka ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ó lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ olagbénú kéē je pīya ācɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō!.

eng_Latn: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá bī wā ā kóō gbō ɔtū kú aá, ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nēé hī aá igwú tɔ̄há ipú iyē ékpó á. Aá kē yɔ̄ ī tá ahínyá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā lé klla le ipú nū. Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛgbá kú uwá je le uwá.

eng_Latn: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔwɛ kú ajɛ íkpākplā tá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bū ipú ísu Ācɛ nēe bā gē nū uwā ā, le pɛ́ gebí ipú ísu. É le pɛ́ ga ipú enyi gɔɔlii bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nōo gē mīya ŋmá ɛcɛ ga ɔkwu isú ā.

eng_Latn: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le okónu ce klla le ɔkpá gbo ka anúɔ géē je ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
idu_Latn: Le da ɔ́ ka, n le okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ ka n géē yɔ̄ mla anú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā klla í hɛ́ uwā tá ohígbū Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má aálelékwū oblínyī ɛtá nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aklé ā bá gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā, ŋmá okónu kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́mpa ā mɛ́mla okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
idu_Latn: Oje udɔ nēé bī le yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ o lɛ ɔ́kpa wu ɔ́ á. É kē bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ le yá uwɔ, aógbló mɛ́mla ɔdōklá icō kú aógbló á. Ogbló kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé bī le flá aɔ́kpá ā kwɔhá á.

eng_Latn: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
idu_Latn: É géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, nōo lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē ga ɛgiyí aíkpékwūja ŋ́, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé gē gbā aɔ́wɔ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uhɛsɛkíya. Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ Uhɛsɛkíya le pɛ́ gaá jīla uwá ɔwɛ. É wɛ Ɛlíyākim ɔyí kú Uhilkíya, nōo leyīkwu agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, Ussɛ́bina ɔmálɛ kú únɛ́pɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla Ujówa ɔyí kú Ásāfu nōo gē leyīkwu ɔkpá ɔ̄kā kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla aíyó kú ɔkpá ɔhá dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n gē lɛ odúúdú aíne kú uwɔ tū ā, ucē obɔ̄bí dóódu ō yá, gē wú um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē pi éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó klla gē je ɔ́ pīya ɔwɔ nōo gē yā klá ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛtá nɛ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ŋmó nyā wɛ ayááyí kú aɔ́báagwu kú Ugati dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá klla í bī ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ce ohɛ́pa kú ejé. Ocu kú ɛya nēé gwó nyā he Óndú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá gē je ácí mɛ́mla ácí nōo le ŋmó ā yi ŋmá ajɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛgba kú aá géē je wa, ohéepu kú aá géē je ŋmó, klla í gwó bónū. Ohígbū ka aá tá íne kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Aá klla lɛ ɛlá wu ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gáā cālɛ́, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū géē ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Kwú ukɔ́tin kú iyɔ̄bū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú wā ajɛ, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya klla ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
idu_Latn: A géē cē uwā bɛ̄ɛka īlī ogbɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā, é géē pīya uwá abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka īlī. Amáŋ aá gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, á gē kwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá ācɛ kú Ukéniti, é géē kpó aá yíífi, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asírīya géē wā í je aá kpó kwú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa da Ugɛ́hási kahíníī, Da ɔnyā ā ɔ̄kā, ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá lɛ ɔ́, ohígbū unwalu kú um kpɛ́mm nɛ̄ ó húmáyī bī ce iyī nū ā. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī je ɔdōlé ga um piyóó ā? Eko ōhī ó gē tíne ká n̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́, amáŋ ka otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā gáā lɛ ɛlā olɔhi éyi ka lɛ uwá ohígbū nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n cɛgbá ā, n le lɛ ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um amānyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, é géē ma ocābɔ̄ kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ fú ɔkpáncō. Eko ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛcɛ géē bá ī jikwū, abɔ̄ é géē má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ gē yɔ̄ ī wā ɛyí ojuja kú ɔkpáncō mla ɔfú, mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
idu_Latn: É kwú acá kú uwá ú nāńdaa kwu wu ŋmá ajɛ, abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má uwā ā, aákā ā kē nyɔ mɛ́mla uwá dúú. É māháyi kpiíí ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ɛhícō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká eko nɛ̄ aá géē kwu ā kóō tá eko ɔgwā ámāŋ ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
idu_Latn: Ó kpó odúúdú ijē kú ɔbá ɛna kú ɛya nōó gwó kú íne nōó bīya ā ŋmá anú, mɛ́mla ijē nōo klá iyíipú ā.

eng_Latn: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aádáádā alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔbɔ́cɛ klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá īkpɛ̄yí o lɔfú tá uwɔ. É tá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē yá aá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ohígbū ka aá wɛ ákú um, ohígbū kéē jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú Ujówāsi ɛpa, le ujɔ tū tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó ɔlɛ́ Umílo ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Usíla ā.

eng_Latn: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í j­āhɔ̄ lɛ acomɛ́ɛbɛ, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nēe bī iyē kú uwɔ kɛlā lɛ aɔ́cɛ́, aígabɔ̄, aádáádā alɔ, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ajɛ kú alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā ācɛ ɛpa nōo ī yɛce Ujísɔ̄si bá yɔ̄ ī ga eyīpɔ́lɛ́ nēé hī ka Emáyɔ̄si ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukilómīta igwóléyi ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔyí um, Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ Ɔwɔicō fu á, amáŋ ó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ klla lɛ ohílīpú ɔyípɛ̄. Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ lɛ̄ ō yá ā wɛ ɛnɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā í wɛ ɔlɛ́ ō lā kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
idu_Latn: Ń lɔtūce ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um kéē nya um tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ le da ɔ́ kéē kwú Umikáya ú tá agbá kéē je igbō lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ pīyɛyi ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ma ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú nū fú cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú alɛɛcɛ kéē le nyatá.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fīyɛ̄ dúú ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā gē cɛ lɛ aá ŋ́. É gē cɛ̄ lɛ aá gē lɛ eyīyōce ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ɛbɛ nēé ī má ā ŋmá ɛlá nēé gbo ipú odo kú uwā ā. Ó wɛ ami kɛlā lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci nōo wɛ okpíyē kú nū ā á, anú kē wɛ ohútu kú oyēeyī kú ɔkpíyē ā á. Anú wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú aflɛ́yí nēé je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɔdā dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ébrahām ā le ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó túkpɛɛ́ le eyī pīya kláajɛ, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.
idu_Latn: Wā mla um kú ā má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, gē yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ tɔ̄há ga Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufilístiya le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā túbá kéē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá Ísrɛ̄lu. É le jīla Usɔ́ko, nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi kú Ujúda ā. É le ádɛ́fú kú uwá kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usɔ́ko mɛ́mla Asɛ́ka ipú ajɛ kú Ɛfɛsi-Udamím.

eng_Latn: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ ā mafú gā um. Lɛ um nyatá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu gā um lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄ lɛ Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Ka ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tú Ujerúsālɛm ā kéē jɛ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú má ɔnyā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ glá ā? Anú gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ ayīnu adāgbá mɛ́mla ɔtāngbédē dóódu á.

eng_Latn: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā ā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá géē hī ɔ́mpa nū igwú wā í gwéeyē kú ɛbɔ́ mla oōbá ɛbɔ́ kú aá. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔcí kú ufígi géē yɛ aá jīla tá.

eng_Latn: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
idu_Latn: Ɔtu he uwá nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ipú ɔ́kɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́kɔ ā ga ajɛ ɛga nēé yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú anɔ̄ ú pīya klá anú ɛyí ká uculo kú abɔ̄ ō cɛyí ā kwú ŋmɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē blakwu ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ó koó wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā nēé tūkɔ́ ā ŋ́, ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā nɛ̄. Ó klla da uwá kéē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ma ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū fú ā.

eng_Latn: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n le okónu ce ka n géē je ajɛ olɔhi o yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nyā lɛ aá kóō wɛ ákú aá ā, n géē je ɔ́ lɛ aá. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. N le aá fō tá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí hɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ā tá.

eng_Latn: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā lɛ otōmbíyē mɛ́mla awulú nɔ̄wá yōōō wiyē. Ó lɛ ɔdōyíifa kú ugóolu mɛ́mla ɔká mɛ́mla íhō mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá kpó klá iyē jágbáá. Ó bī ikókwū kú ugóolu abɔ̄ nōo le mu mla ɔdīcíci,mɛ́mla ucē ɛbí, mɛ́mla ɔdēelihɔ̄ nōo ŋmá lɛ ajā nōó gē gbo ā.

eng_Latn: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ um ŋmó ɔ́dāŋ ka ń yá ka okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce lɛ Udéfīdi ā kóō le yá jīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn, Unebusárādan lɛ um hɛ́tá, Uráma ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka gā um. É lɛ agbá kpó kwu um abɔ̄ mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm mla ācɛ kú Ujúda nēé ba í kpó alagbá ga Ubábīlɔn ā gbɔbū.

eng_Latn: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
idu_Latn: Aájī igwó nɛ̄ a má ā kwɛyí aɔ́cɛ́ igwó nēe lé ɔcɛ́ ɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ é géē je íkwu lɛ uwā kéē lé ɔcɛ́ eko kpiíí mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Usɔ́lu tá ka anúɔ í gáā lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ɛpa a le ɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē kú ō lɛ ɔdōlé lé. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄, cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ, má cīce agōdō.

eng_Latn: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ayí ɔhá nɛ̄ anyā ɔlɛ́ nū nōo ī cikpó uwā ā ma lɛ ɔ́ nēé bá ipú ayí nēé cɔ̄ɔ̄cí nyā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Udéfīdi klla le ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nōo lé ka Utáma.

eng_Latn: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Óndú ā tɛtɛ le ka, ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ géē lā ipú ojuja mɛ́mla obū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
idu_Latn: Ohóliba klla yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ lipú lipú, ipú unwū ācɛnyīlɔ nɛ̄ ó ī yá ā mɛ́mla ajā nɛ̄ ó ī gbō ā. Ó lɛ ifotó kú aótrɛyí kú ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn nēé kpó tū ɔdɔ, nēé lɛ ɛwɔ́ nɔ̄wá nya ɔ́ ā má.

eng_Latn: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōó má ije lá oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ka ugóolu ŋ́ mā, kwú ɔcí nōó gáā wā ŋ́ mā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ lɛ ojibó nōó gáā mīya gwōnū glá ŋ́ mā gbā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwá kéē lɛ ɛ̄cī kú Upúrim mɛ́mla ucɛ kú nū ā tū eko kú nū. É kéē yá ɛ̄nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ɛ̄cī nēé gē gwōkónu mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ é gē yɔ́tūnōbí ā. Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā mɛ́mla Umɔ́dɛkāyi tá ɔkpá nyā klla je ɔ́da nyā tɔ̄ɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ anúɔ ka.

eng_Latn: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
idu_Latn: Aúgbéenyi kú nū í yɛ mɛ́mla ákú Uhíram. Iháyí ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá dóódu aúgbéenyi kú nū ī pīyɛyí gē bī iyó nēe bá ā gé lɛ ɔ́: oje ɔdɔ , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, aīnu adāgbá, afūlɔ mɛ́mla ɛkā.

eng_Latn: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú Óndú ā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá hile ligíí o je uwá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
idu_Latn: Ó klla bī ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú piíí nɛ̄ ádáádā nū tɛtɛ bī tū Óndú ā. Ɔtū kú nū í le kpaakpa mla Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā ŋ́. Ó yá ucē nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā mla ɔtū ékpónú bɛ̄ɛka ádáádā nū, Udéfīdi á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā ɔlɛ́ aflɛ́yí ā wɛ, úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛhɔ̄, ce ofigwáahātá.

eng_Latn: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
idu_Latn: Ká Óndú ā kóō cāŋjɛ, ka aólɛlā kú nū kéē kwú fíyákátā. Ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū nū ā, kéē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n jé aá, n kē jé ka aá yíihɔtū tá Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD's passover.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē lé ɛbɛ́ ā yɔ̄ á, aá lɛ ɛ́nyɔ́ kú aá gbō, lɛ áblákpá kú aá kpó wu ikpó, kwú okwutɛ kú aá ú bī abɔ̄, aá géē lé ɛbɛ́ ā ipú ínwúleyī kwū. Ó wɛ Ucɛ kú eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá.

eng_Latn: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Óndú ipú unwalu kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú ákanya kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū kóō yɔ̄ ŋmá ísu éyi ga ísu ɔhá, ŋmá ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ í yá lɛ ā glá ŋ́, n táafu ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ odúúdú aálá ā le túbá tɔ̄há nēé lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā míya ŋmá okónu kú obugā ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú kpó éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ aálá ā gwá glá á.

eng_Latn: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
idu_Latn: Ānyɛ wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē cɔ̄nū tū uwā iháyí ofɛpa ā? Ó cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ nēe bīyíne nēe kwú báajɛ ipú ígbíli ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gaá háyi ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ ā píbá ā, ɛpla kú ɔdɔ kú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin nēé le ɛcɔ̄ hɛ́ igá tū abɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
idu_Latn: Umerí Umagadalíni mla Umerí ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujémīsi má ɛga nēé je ɔ́ gwutá ā.

eng_Latn: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Awɔ, Óndú, yá ɛcɛ ŋmá ohútu á, a kē bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ le ɔkpáncō yá.

eng_Latn: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka oŋmá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ jé uwá ā, ɛ́ɛ húmáyī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, O my LORD, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi kahíníī, Óndú um, Kóócōō tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɛhɔ̄ nyā.

eng_Latn: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ ka alɔ húmáyī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō eko nɛ̄ alɔ ka koó je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē gáā je ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́, ayíka Ɔwɔicō í kē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ɔlékwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā da Ubówāsi ká ɔ̄, lɛ ajɛ ā lá ā, ó kwú ikpó áblákpá kú nū éyi ú plla lɛ Ubówāsi.

eng_Latn: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā, lɛ abɔ̄ tū uwɔ abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔfú tū uwɔ iyē. N gē da uwɔ ka a yúúfi ŋ́, ka n géē tá uwɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā, gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ yálé glá á. Ɔtū aá he ɔ́, ihɔtū kú nū kē í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ je oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá. Ó gē gwííjē gbōmgbōm klla í gwéeyē ohígbū aá.

eng_Latn: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le kagwó mɛ́mla ācoyúklɔ́ ā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā cɛ̄ ɔkɔ́bɔ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɛ̄cī éyi ā, ó lɛ uwá tū ga ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ enyi gē pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ō gwó ā, gaá kwɛjī ɛga éyi, jāā gbéeko kú iháyí ɔ́mpa kú eko nɛ̄ Udáyīrɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē le gbo pī núɔ abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ klla pó ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndā ā géē ka kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ eyī pīya kwu aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ká ā cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú um lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē jikwū gbōmgbōm ā? Ɔdí yá ɛ́ɛ́ nāa yɔ̄ ī móōwē bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā? Óhígbū ká á lɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́, aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ klla le pɛ́ gekwú nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
idu_Latn: A lɔfū je gā um, ká n̄ nuunu tá aólɛlā kú um. A klla lɔfú je gá um ká n̄ lɛ ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ca bēhé.

eng_Latn: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
idu_Latn: Óndú, aɔ́dā nɛ̄ a yá ā klla wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ tū uwɔ, nɛ̄ a klla ī cokónu nɛ̄hi nyā ga um lɛyíkwu ayááyí kú um kú eko ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nōó bá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā á. Óndú, a yɔ̄ ī yá um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā éyi ā.

eng_Latn: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā gáā le pīya tɔ̄há mla Ujóram, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá le ɛfú kpó tá Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya. Aícɔ́ɔja kú ābɔ̄ ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa gaá gbɛyí ipú Urámɔ̄tu nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le Ujóram yá ágbe ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ nyā yá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da gā uwɔ lɛ ā. Á gáā gbagbafú ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ā géē ga ɔlɛ́ uwá ɛbɔ́, abɔ̄ nēé le ɛpɔ̄ kú uwā ka lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
idu_Latn: Éeyē yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jéeyī, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ohílīpú ō jɛ́yí ɔdā lɛ.

eng_Latn: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Unássɔn, ɔyí kú Ammínādabu, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ n géē kpó aá abɔ̄fú glá Udamásikɔ̄si gaá lā ɛga ɔhá gwū ɔlɛ́ aá tá. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kɛlā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ nēe bá ā le pīya tɔ̄há kéē gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unaómi da Urútu ka ɔ́ɔ gbēyī cíí mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, jāā gbéeko nɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā nōo géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɛlā ā má. Ó ka Ubówāsi ɔ́ gáā mlɛ́nyɔ́ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɔ́ɔ lɛyí kú ɛlā ā má.

eng_Latn: O LORD, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya tóohi kahíníī, Óndú, n jé cāā ka ā géē tíne ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. A yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ italā klla gáā kpó uwā ŋmó mɛ dúúdú ɛɛ́. Nááná é lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́, é kē tá ō pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, le ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ́ɔ ka ɛ́ɛ le pīyabɔ̄. Ká ɛ̄ kwúcē ŋmá ipú ɛ̄cī ōpá kú uwā, ká ɛ̄ klla lɛ eyī pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí aójībó otīihilɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ má Udóyēgu ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ jé ka ɔ́ɔ géē ka lɛ Usɔ́lu piíí. Udéfīdi ka anúɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, pɛ́ kwú á.

eng_Latn: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛnyā ā, Óndú ā géē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ayí uwɔ, anyā uwɔ italā. Ó klla í kpó agbénú kú uwɔ yíífi ŋmáajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā páápa le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka, anúɔ tíne kú ɔ̄ lɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim hɛ́ tá ipú oflēnjē gé lɛ anúɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
