idu_Latn: Ɛ́lpaalu ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Éba, Umíssam mɛ́mla Ussémēdi. Ussémēdi gwó aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Óno, mɛ́mla Ulódu mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
idu_Latn: N tíne kú aá le jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē yúklɔ́ lɔfú nɛ̄hi ohígbū aá mla ohígbū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá Ulayodísīya, mla ācɛ dóódu nēé jé um eyī jééjé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And if the man be poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ogbɛhá, ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī īlī ōcabɔ̄ ā otū gbɔ́ɔcī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī ka ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ aá, n̄ da aá ka, ācɛ néē cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um ā, úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, é géē yá ɔ̄. É kōō í yá aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ī kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ádā um.

eng_Latn: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdiyá nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ í cɛ̄ ká alɔ yá ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je catāajɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé le tá ɔlá nōo yi jāā ī je gbo umu, klla í je gbo ewo ā.

eng_Latn: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
idu_Latn: Udánīyɛ̄lu, Ugínētɔn, Ubáruku.

eng_Latn: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ga ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ujehóhānan, ɔyí kú Ɛlíyāssibu gaá le gbo abɔ́ɔ gbó ɔ̄cī. É bā í yɔ́tūnōbí kú íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɛyí nɛ̄ é le táajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā. Ɛ́sra í lé ɔdōlé ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá um ohi ka anúɔ gē nyɔ̄ gaá miya Ujerúsālɛm, ká anúɔ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ olīkpō mla olɔwá kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka abɔ̄ ācɛ géē ka ka ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gē kpó ācɛ lé klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ayí kú ācɛ nēe lā anú ā kéē pɛ́ kwú ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Utóla ma ayí ɛhīlī nēe bá ā, Ússi, Urefáya, Ujérīyɛlu, Ujamáyi, Íbisām, mɛ́mla Ussémūwɛlu. É wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔ́nū kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Utóla á. Uwá wɛ aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū nɛ̄hi á. Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á, ɛwa kú uwá wɛ úla ofɛpa cigwɛ́hīlī cofigwó .

eng_Latn: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā má ā, ó da ɔnyīlɔ ā ka, N kwú íne nɛ̄ a bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ucɛ nyā ɛ̄cī ahāapa ipú iháyí dóódu. Aá géē lɛ íne kú ucɛ nyā tū lɛ ayááyí kú ɔlɛ́ aá jāā gā ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
idu_Latn: Woó, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, n jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ a máfú gā um ā wɛ ohútu kllɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ kú ɔdā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄ a gáā yá. Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ámāŋ ɛcɛ, nōo lɔfú yá ɔdā ōhídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a gē yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kahíníī, Óndú nōo hɛ́ um tá ŋmá ūkwū kú ágábá mɛ́mla ūkwū kú ɔgwú ā, géē hɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya, olufíyé nyā a. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄, Óndú ā kóō yɔ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē hɛ́ oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ā wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā ɔnyīlɔ ā cāŋjɛ ipéyī odúúdú uwā, kwú ákplata nōó húmáyī gwutá anú ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ yɔ̄ ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá á.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó kahíníī, Aá gaá lé ijē kú ɛna, álá, ámāŋ ɛwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛlísāfan, Usímri mɛ́mla Ujeyɛ́lu nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu Usekariya mɛ́mla Umɛtánīya.

eng_Latn: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, n pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n má ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gbaálūka glá ŋ́, nēe ŋmá éwo mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ācɛ mɛ́mla ucē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí dóódu á. É hayi iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla iyɔ̄bū kú Ɔyí álá ā lɛ awulú nɛ̄hɛ́ wiyē. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā bī ánkpálī abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí. Ka ɛlā lɛ uwá ká ā da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da uwá ka, Ákú aá mɛ ɛɛ́, aá ācogbāálá nēe ī gbō Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Aá gē leyīkwú īyī aá, amáŋ aá lɛ ɛlá wu aálá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ obɔ̄bíipú nyā ka ā ā.

eng_Latn: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abígɛ̄lu túkpɛɛ́ kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nɛ, n le tútū ká n̄ nyɔ̄ í na ikpó kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
idu_Latn: Óndú, eko nyá nāa géē yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu um áncā lɛ ā gaá kwu, nɛ̄ aá gáā tú um abɔ̄ ŋ́ māā? Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwā. Lɛ oyēeyī kú um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ aágábá nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í gē mīyɛ ācɛ nēe gē cɛ̄tra iyī uwā ā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó gē cɛ̄tra ācɛ nōó mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā, aá je ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Usísa lɛ Usísa, amáŋ aá je aɔ́dā nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ayí uwɔ ā lɛ íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da mɛ́mla okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā tū, é géē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
idu_Latn: Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, ɛcɛ géē je doobū, odúúdú ācɛ kē í bá ipú obū nɛ̄hi kpímm. Amáŋ ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ klá aá bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
idu_Latn: É gē lá aúgbɔ́ɔnya ŋmá Íjīpiti dúú. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn gē kpó aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla ɔnya ā í lá lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla Usiríya. É gē lá úgbɔ́ɔnya éyi ije nɛ́hɛ̄ úlā ɛpa cofigwó, ɔnya éyi kē wɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofaháapa cɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ ka ka alɔ í bīyíne ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, alɔ ī lɛ ɔ́ yá ɔ̄cɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄, alɔ í kē mīyɛ ɛlā kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ le unu nu, le ɔnyā ō yīipú dúúmā yá ágbe, nɛ̄ó lɛ ɔyí plla, nɛ̄ ɔdā ɔhá dúú í yá ɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔ̄ ágbe ā, géē gbā ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔbá ɔnyā ā ka ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ o kɛpɔ̄ ā cɛ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ayí Ulífāyi ā, Ukonaníya, Ussémāya, mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū Unatánɛlu, Uhassábīya, Ujéyɛlu, mɛ́mla Ujósābadi klla bī ayí omlede mɛ́mla ayí ɛwū úlā igwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó , mɛ́mla aɛ́na úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ gé lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi kéē bī le gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ jéeyī, íjééyī ā, géē tīile lɛ ɔ́, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá íjééyī, anú gáā móōwē nū á.

eng_Latn: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē fūla ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nōo wɛ ɛbéelihɔ dóódu mla ɔlá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ije ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɔ́láā ɛyí. Ɔ́dāŋ keé hīla anú ŋ́, é géē je ɔ́ lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́lá ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
idu_Latn: Eko néē ga ɛga owu igwu kú Unákɔn ā, aɛ́na ā le túgagá, anɔ́ɔ Ússa gāá kwú abɔ̄ í bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē yá Uféro mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū italā éyi kpɔ́. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó mā aá tá kú aá nyɔ̄. Á kú ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, anú abɔ̄yī nū gáā nū aá bɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ŋmá amānyā á.

eng_Latn: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ulé kú um mɛ́ɛ́ ā? Ó wɛ ɛga nēé je gā um ká n̄ tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ alahá ā. Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ gē yá ɛ̄nyā ā, ń yɔ̄ gē dɔɔ̄kā odúúdú ukpɛ̄ kú um nɛ̄ n cíkā ō lɛ ohígbū ka n wɛ ɔ̄cotɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwá kéē lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā nwūla, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ gē lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ jé péee ka, Óndú ā kwú ajɛ a ú lɛ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́, ɔtū kú odúúdú ācɛ abɔ́ɔ ā le gbogodo mla ufi ohígbū alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
idu_Latn: Ɛlitéke, Ugibɛ́tɔn, Ubáalāti.

eng_Latn: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú bī ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á. Ayí Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kwú Áklɔ̄kpɛ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ú mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó nēe bá ipú nū ā ú kpó dúú.

eng_Latn: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū gwó bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ nū ɔkpáncō ā. Ó lɛ ɔ́ bū tū kli, bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɛ abɔ̄yīnū nɛ̄ ó yá kóō yɔ̄ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, ayíkpó kú nū le bla ka ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ le ɛlā nyā ka, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ ɔdā nēé tá tū ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā mɛ́mla ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka ā á.

eng_Latn: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄ a jɛ̄ dúú yɔ̄ ā? Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áblákpá cíkā gā uwɔ ikpó lɛ dúú ā. Átákwū kú uwɔ yɔ̄ yōōlō, bɛ̄ɛka, úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ o jé ō yúklɔ́ abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ɔ́mpa aá wā ipú ɔtū kú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá mīyɛ aá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛhi kú alelékwū kpó lɛ aá abɔ̄ aá bá gē gbēyī Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔfú kú Ujísɔ̄si mafú āá.

eng_Latn: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā. Lɛ eyī pīya má alɔ, ká ā má unwalu mɛ́mla ōwē nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipú nū ā. Má ōwē kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi nōo lé iyē kwu uwɔ ā. Alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, ohígbū ka a gē ményīnyi ɔ̄cɛ, ó wɛ ka alɔ gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
idu_Latn: Ujɛramīīlu, ɔ́kplá kú Uhɛ́srɔn ā ma ayínɔnyīlɔ ɛhɔ̄. Iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Urám, Ubúna, Orén, Osém mɛ́mla Ahíja.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúmā kú aíne ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ̄ kē híī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
idu_Latn: N gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ kú igelī ā, ipú úláyi mɛ́mla ɛplá dúúdu. N nyɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtú ā. N tíne nū, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō tá ahɛ klá anú, é kwú onugbo ā ú ŋmá abɔ̄ nū, lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
idu_Latn: Utɔ́yi, ɔcɛ́ kú Uhámati le pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhádādēsa ā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē kɔ̄ ipɔ́ɔma ipɔ́ɔma ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwā nōo wɛ iháyí ofu cigwó gɔbū ā, é géē kɔ̄ ɛhi nyā mīya anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú nū lɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moreshethgath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda, aá lɛ úŋmóō tá ācɛ kú Umɔ́rēssɛti kú Ugáti abālɔbányā. Igelī kú Ákisību í gáā wā í tá aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē yɔ̄ amānyā ká ālɔ̄ bī Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā gé lɛ aá. Ɔwɔicō le okónu nōó ce lɛ aádáádā alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ odúúdú aíkókwū nēé kpó ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó gē lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄, mɛ́mla anyā nū mɛ́mla anyā ōcikpó kú nū bī aíkókwū ā le gwá ejé á.

eng_Latn: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ŋmó ɛbɛ́ je bī gé um ígbée āa? O lé kú um kwɛyí bōōbū ā nɛ̄ ā wā yɔ̄ á. N kwú ɔhā kú um ámōōmɛ ā í hɛ́ ce ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ó kē í wɛ ákú nū piyóó.

eng_Latn: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ka n yɔ̄ gē mabɔ̄ ācɛ ɔhá tá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je iyó ce aá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ abɔ̄ aá lɛ nɛ̄hi eko nyā ā, ó lɔhi kú aá cíkā ō tá ācɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ ɛgbá gē ce uwá ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
idu_Latn: Kwú oyī o hile nōo yɔ̄ ɛyí ede ā ú mla anɔ̄ kú abɔ̄ ō cɛyí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú mī klá Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ɔdōwiyē kú nū mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔdōwiyē kú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ anú, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdōwiye kú uwā le kpó tū cíí gā um.

eng_Latn: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gaá cɔcɛ́, ācɛ gē kpó iyī uwā tayínū, amáŋ eko dúúmā nēé gekwú, ācɛ okpaakpa ā géē bá ī jɛ̄ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɛ́ya kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ɛhi olɔhi je gā um ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā ā ɔbá um géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um, ohígbū ka n le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛhīlī ma lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Usɛ́būlɔn.

eng_Latn: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ okónu ɔwɛ kú Óndú á, ācɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa kú Ɔwɔicō ā, gáā bēé nú á.

eng_Latn: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nɛ̄ a má abɔ̄ nōo gaá tɔ́kpá nyā tū ɔdɔ á.

eng_Latn: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
idu_Latn: Aá híī da īyī aá ka aá ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācɛ nēe jéeyī ā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō ofōōfūnū géē tá Ujóbu ohi piíí á. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu dúúmā í tá ɔ̄ ohi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ujeremíya, le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbā ā, kéē lɛ eje tū mu odúúdú ɔjá kú ejé ā. É géē tóohi ka aá ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ jé ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō le ejé tū odúúdú ɔjá kú ejé mu.

eng_Latn: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo húmáyī yɔ̄ ŋmá íkííkée ā wā gaá le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Eko gā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō gáā mīyɛ ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrāɛl ā ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ gáā bēhé Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gáā mīyɛ ajɛ kú aéwɔhá, ācɛ nēe nwuné klla lɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Ācɛ nɛ̄ aígelī kú uwā ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, é klla lɛ igá kú ɔdɔ nōo licō í kwu ɔkpáncō ā hɛ́ tū uwā.

eng_Latn: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
idu_Latn: N le tútū ō mīyɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā eko dóódu, nááná nēé bá yɔ̄ ī yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfu piyóó, klla bá ī yá ucē ōbɔ̄bí klla bá ī yá ɔdā ɔtū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ede kú Ɔwɔicō ā í je gblífi. Ācɛ géē bá yɔ̄ ī tɛ̄gíkwū klla géē yɔ̄ ī jikwū dududu. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi ā géē wɛ oyōōyī bɛ̄ɛka ede nēé gē pīya oyī klá ɛyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā n̄ yɔ̄ kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ kpɔ́, a le abɔ̄ tū um abɔ̄lɔ́ná.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ ó gē yá ipú, ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō, kwu ísu mɛ́mla itekwú á.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, mīyɛ um dúú. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē mīyɛ um ā, kē mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ācɛ onwū íne ā yɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ó pó ɔdā nēé ka ā. Ó le jé ka ohi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si tá ācɛ Usádusīi ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ohi okpaakpa. Anɔ́ɔ ó wā í lɛ ɔ̄kā éyi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Íne nyá wɛ íne nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ í hɔ̄hā ce uwā ipú ajɛ. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā gbɛhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ɔ́ɔmā gē dɛ̄gba bɛ̄ɛka aágábá nēe gē tōoji eko nēe lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kwú bá ī kpó nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
idu_Latn: Úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ ámāŋ ka émúká lɔfú yɔ̄ īlī dóódu, ó kōō wɛ īlī nēé hɛ́ ámāŋ ka īlī nēé tá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é ī kɛlā kú ɛcɛ, ɛcɛ kē ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ Ohóla wɛ ákú um ā, ó yɔ̄ í yá akwuna kpɔ́ klla yɔ̄ ī yúnwū aɔ́ya nū nēe wɛ ācɛ Asírīya ā.

eng_Latn: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le ikpó ɔnyā ɔyí nū ce, é géē kpó uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ŋmó. Ɛfiyɛ kú ikwū kú uwā géē ce iyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄kā da kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō gbla anú ā.

eng_Latn: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, a má ɔ̄da nōo yɔ̄ gē yá āa? Má ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī yá amānyā ā, bá ī nū um nyɔ̄ piyóó ŋmá ɛga otīihɔ kú um ā ā. A klla géē má ɔdá uwēyī ɔhá fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, é nyɔ̄ gaá gwutá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔtū ōlɔfú kú aá nɛ̄ Umósīsi je íkwu lɛ aá kú aá tá anyā aá. Amáŋ ó lɛ ā ŋmá uhútu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta cāŋjɛ le yɛ mla uwá. Eko nōó gā ajɛ ā, é le ɔ̄ bī ga inīcō. Odúúdú anyōkwū ā háyi pī ɔ̄ bá ī jikwū, anɔ́ɔ é le úwé ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɛhícō nɛ̄ Udɔ́kasi gɔ́ lɛ uwá eko nōó yēeyī ā kpó mafú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔtū kú um le bīya nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka ɔtunōbí nōo lɔfú ŋmó um glá ā ī yá um. Aá bá amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, aá gbɔlā nóó.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo gē hɛ́ aá tá ā, nōo kē yá aá ā ka ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo yá ɔdā dóódu á. Ami ofōōfū um nā ɔkpáncō daa klá ɛyí ɛcɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē tá um abɔ̄ yá ɛcɛ nōo tá kpátáá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Ācɛ dóódu, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
idu_Latn: N cíkā ō mīyɛ ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdōgwá ohígbū úklɔ́ kú um.

eng_Latn: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
idu_Latn: Cāŋjɛ abālɔbányā, Óndú Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ káā lɛ bēhé wā ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ́ kú uwɔ nyā, ɛga nēé kwú ikpati kú ɛ ka kú uwɔ ā ú háyi ipú nū ɛɛ́ mā. Lɛ ɔhā kú uwɔ hɛ́ ce ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwɔ ipú odúúdú ɔdā dúúmā nēé gē yá ā. Ká odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nāa yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odo kú um le gbenyi ohígbū ákanya nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú nū, nɛ̄ n kē le lé ligbó lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā, n hī uwɔ igwú, Óndú. Lɛ um bī ga ɛga nāa í gbō um ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ó le pīya ikpɛ́la kú ɛlā okónu mɛ́mla iyē mla íne kú aá ā, aá tá eyī tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ aá. N tá ka n wɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú ɔdā nēe bá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ukádɛssi. Anɔ́ɔ é gā ipú ígbíli, ɛyi ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄! N géē wā ānāānā! N géē bī ulé kú um wā ká n cíla ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ulé kú ɔdā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je catāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛtɛ́ nōo ī ca klá ajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, nɛ̄ ákánjɔ̄ kú nū dúúmā í gē hile, nēe gē bī le fú ɔlá ŋ́, ámāŋ nēé gē bī le hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ugídīyɔn le ɔ̄nā nyā pó mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ā, ó le okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē gā aáklɔ̄kpɛ ɛ́fú kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá da uwá kéē cāŋjɛ ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aá lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Umídiya kpó yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufilístiya le uwá má. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ācɛ Uhíburu nēe bá nyā bā í yá amānyā ā? Anɔ́ɔ Ákisi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā lé ka Udéfīdi, éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usɔ́lu. Ó lā mla um gbojī ɛɛ́, ó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí alɔ ŋmífī nɛ̄ ó wā í lā mla alɔ ā jéjēe ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē je ācobīyíne ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. É klla géē je ayááyí nū kpó ŋmó bónū ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
idu_Latn: Yá ka ajɛ ā kóō yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bá ī yá ucē okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔnɛ̄, ācɛ gē bá ī yúúfi nū klla í bá gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Ó géē wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka ísu nōo le cēenyi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wā ā, nɛ̄ owu nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī kpó ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
idu_Latn: Umérári ma ayí ɛpa: Umáhli mɛ́mla Umússi. Umáhli ma ayí ɛpa, Ɛlísaa mɛ́mla Ukíss.

eng_Latn: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da uwá kéē lɛ odúúdú ɔdīifa kú ugóolu kú uwā kpó gé um. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī nēe lɛ ugóolu ā. É lɛ uwá kpó wā gé um. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó tū ɔlá lɛ ɔ́ ja, le ɛna nyā ma lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Unówa, mɛ́mla ayí nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ ipu ígwu ɛtá gɛɛcɛ ɛháajɛ kú Ujówābu, Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu, mɛ́mla Ítāyi nōo ŋmá Ugáti ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu éyééye. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá dúú á.

eng_Latn: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo kwu éŋkpɔ̄ ajaajɛ, nɛ̄ ébú gē cē klá abɔ̄ kú nū otú gbɔ́ɔcī ā.

eng_Latn: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ojéeyī ā géē bá ī fíyajɛ péee bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpáncō ā. Ācɛ nēe gē nwū ācɛ kéē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā géē bá ī fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka aínyíláɔwɔ ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ikpati gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya ā. Olīkpō kú nū kóō wɛ, ɔwá kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyā, olicō kú nū kóō wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
idu_Latn: Aá bá ī híhó ka aá je iyī aá tɛ̄ɛlihɔ ŋ́. Ka aá klla pā ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ī híhó nū āa? Aá má ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ɔpɛ́ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá kóō lɛ eyī yɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā inyankwūlūmī nōo le nyílá yɔ̄ gē kwinya gicō gajɛ yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔbá dúúmā nōo í ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōó lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́ klá uwá klla í tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔyī kú um lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ eyī gwō ɛ̄cī kú ɔdā nōo gbɔɔ́ lígíí nyā bónū, géē gwéeyē, eko nēé lɛ úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Userúbábɛlu bī abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gɔbū ā má. Aágege ahāapa ā wɛ īkpēyī kú Ɔwɔicō nēe bá í má odúúdú ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ je lɛ uwá nɛɛ, ó gē tábɔ̄ kóō lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā gē yēeyī gaá kwu ā. Óndú ā gē ményīnyi uwā ohígbū nēé géē bá ī tíifu ipú ōwē mɛ́mla abɔ̄ nēé le da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomora ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bi, anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔlá lɛ uwá kpó yi gbewo á. Ɔwɔicō bī ɔwɛ nyā le uwā yá ɔdā ō bī le kwu ita kú ɔdā nōó géē yá ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
idu_Latn: N jé ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicɔ̄ yá ā géē yɔ̄ piyóó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í je ɔdā dúúmā tá ɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō je ŋmá anú glá ŋ́ má. Ɔwɔicō yá uwá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ ká é yúufi nū.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē je ojuju kú uwá tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā le jī ɛɛ́! É lɛyí bá ajɛ bá ī yá ɔdā nēé miya tayínū ā wɛɛlɛ. É klla bá ī gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ má aá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ícɛ nyā, é le pīya gbɔɔ́ ō bɛ́yíkwu ipɔ́ɔ́nu kú ádā anúɔ ɛɛ́. Ó klla da uwá kéē le ayí nū ofɛtá cigwó kpó ŋmó ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ékpónú. Ka ohígbū ka ɔyí obībá kú nū, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki wɛ ɔmáapu uwā ā, ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ussɛ́kɛm.

eng_Latn: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ ujíyu ámāŋ ka Ugríisi dúú í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ɔfiyɛ ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄yīnū dúú i yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛnyā ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúú í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú aá le pīya ācɛ ékpónú ipú o bɔ́há píyɔ́ɔ́ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda kwu Ujowáhāsi, ɔyí kú Ujosíya ú le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú lé ɔcɛ́ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ á. Ɔdā dúúmā í lɔnɔ tū um ō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Umakéda gā Ulíbna gaá le ɛ́fú kpó tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Kulɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ nɛ̄ n má ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ikpokwú mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ iyē kú um á. N géē hī ɔ̄ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā ohígbū keé je ɔ́ ŋmá iyē kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá ā wɛ Ɛlíyābu, ɔyí kú Uhɛ́lɔn, ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
idu_Latn: Ujáhāti, Ugɛ́ssɔn mɛ́mla Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
idu_Latn: Īī, n gbagbénú nɛ̄hi, klla lɛ íkwu fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ bá Ujerúsālɛm gbɔbū gā um ā. N lɔtūce íjééyī kú um dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē bī odúúdú aíne ā le yúklɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dóódu kóō yɔ̄ ī gɔbū lɛ uwá lɔhi lɔhi. Ó kéē kē í yēeyī likpō ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, N gēe bī ámíyā mla ákanya mla ōwē wɛ̄ɛcɛ; klá í je ōwē la ācɛ o bɔ̄bíipú dóódu, ohígbū oyábīya kú uwá. Ācɛ ooyá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ dóódu a, n gēe tá uwá wā ajɛ, klá í je ōwē la ācɛ oogɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔ́bíipú dóódu.

eng_Latn: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
idu_Latn: N le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ n le odúúdú iyó kú Utobíya kpó tá bónū ŋmá ipú inu ā á.

eng_Latn: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔkpá tá ga uwɔ ɔnɛ́pɔ̄, cēyītīkwū kú awɔ mɛ́mla anú ká aá lɛ iyī aá kagwó gbɔbū ká ā ga únɛ́pɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ ka á kagwó mɛ́mla anú gbɔbū ŋ́, ó géē pī uwɔ ga iyɔ̄bū ɔcóohɛ́pɔ̄ nōo géē je uwɔ tū idáhandā abɔ̄. É kē í je uwɔ tā agbá.

eng_Latn: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé, eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ iháyí ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu ce ahāanɛ. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū lé ka, Ábīja, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usekaríya.

eng_Latn: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Urútu da Unaómi ka anúɔ nyɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔpla īkpɔ̄dā nōo gē hɛ́ ācɛ nēe gē cɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā abɔ̄ wāajɛ ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo géē cɛ̄ ká anúɔ tá ɔ̄ igbīhi Unaómi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄, ɔyí anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā le pɛ́ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā, gaá le ucɛ yá lé. É klla le ucɛ ā kɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔhá dúú. É bá gē gwéeyē, ohígbū ka é le ɛyí kú ɔkpá kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō nēé jé lɛ uwá ā jé.

eng_Latn: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
idu_Latn: Ó kwú igbō éyi ú ŋmá ipú ómblí kú igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ nēé je lɛ Óndú ā, mɛ́mla igbō éyi nēé wīya mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla égblú éyi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó ce ɛyí kú ijē mɛ́mla iklíkpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ācocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ í nwuné ŋ́. Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú nōo wɛ Óndú kú ɛhɔ̄ ā kóō lɛ ācocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kpó wā fíyɛ́ kéē géē lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kpó cē.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n le ɛlā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ka, lɛ ijáalí kú ɛlā obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā cɛ̄ tū um. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n ka á, ɔdíyā nāa lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ um ā.

eng_Latn: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
idu_Latn: Anú hɛ́ um idáagó fíyɛ́ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā á. Ami nōo yá ɔ̄ ā lɔfú ŋmó ɔ̄ glá ā á.

eng_Latn: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
idu_Latn: Íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī bīya ā, tɛ́ɛcɛ cāā, nɛ̄ ācɛ k­ē jé ka Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ tū uwa piíí. Amáŋ ó lɛ ācɛ ōhī yɔ̄ nɛ̄ íne nēé bīya ā í tɛ́ɛcɛ cāā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko Igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
idu_Latn: N ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ, abālɔbányā n yɔ̄ ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛcɛ ā ī nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ádā ā.

eng_Latn: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ um hɛ́tá cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ le lɔfú iyē dúúdú. Lɛ um hɛ́tá cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lā ɛbɔ́ cííí. Awɔ nɛ̄ n gē cɛ̄tra á.

eng_Latn: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ń jɛɛ́lɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ Igbómína ɔ̄cojīlīmā, Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si. Eyī gbum gɔɔ abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nyā.

eng_Latn: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
idu_Latn: Ā je ɛga lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá tá ɔyí ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē kpó uwé ɛfú dúúmā wiyē ŋ́. Ā hɛ́ ayípōklóbīya dúúmā kú uwá tá ŋ́. Kwú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá ú kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. Aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yá ka odúúdú aéwo nēe lā kwu Ujúda ā kéē yúufi ō nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē má kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi je lɛ uwá ā. Kéē yíihɔtū tá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā. Ó ka é yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, kéē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ aíne kú nū, kéē yɛ ɔwɛ kú nū kpaakpa, kéē klla gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā mla odúúdú odo mla ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si cīce ɛyí ɛfu nēé hī ka Olīifu ā, lɛ eyī pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ Upíta mla Ujémīsi, mla Ujɔ́ni mla Ándru le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í tá ɔ̄ ɛkwūbá. É da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko nēé le Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda má ā, odúúdú uwá kwú eyī ú pīya kwu ɔ́ gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu tá ɔ̄ ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aéwo nēe lā kwu aá ajaajɛ biílí ā wā í yá aá ɔdōōtūufi. Odúúdú aá í pɛ́ kwu. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá géē yɔ̄ ī kwinya kú oyēeyī kú nū, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ nōo gáā tú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēe fíyákátā ā bá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ Ubɛ́tāni ɔlɛ́ Usáyímɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ lagwú ā.

eng_Latn: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father's house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā le ɔgwu nū tá nyɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔɔ́ bī wā ɔlɛ́ á. Ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛpa kpó mla aíjakī ɛpa. Ɔnyā ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā būla wā ɔlɛ́ ádā nū. Eko nɛ̄ ádā kú ɔyínɔ̄nya ā le ɔ́ má ā, ó le ɔ́ būla lɔɔlɔhi wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yálé. É ŋmó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu úlā ofɛpa cigwó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá yɛ gɔbū lígíí, gaá lɛ gbo Ugíbɛ̄ya ámāŋ ka Uráma.

eng_Latn: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
idu_Latn: É da iyī uwā ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nēé géē yá o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ anyā lɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe hile ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā. É ka aá lɛ okónu ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ka aá í gáā je ayínɔ̄nyā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔlá le fíyajɛ klá ɔdā dóódu, ɛdɔ kú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā í yɔ̄ ajodobū gɛ ŋ́, ó má tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD's anointed. And now see where the king's spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.
idu_Latn: A má gwōnū ipú úklɔ́ kú uwɔ ɛɛ́, Ábna, é cíkā kéē lɛ uwɔ ŋmó, abɔ̄ á kē gbō ɔcɛ́, ɔkpáni uwɔ ɛyí glá gɛ ŋ́ mā. Má ɔ̄, iní nɛ̄ óbō kú ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ā? Iní nɛ̄ ɔjá nōo hayi pī īkpɛ̄yí kú nū ā yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá nɛ̄ Usímri yá ā, kwu ɔ̄kā kú ibiyājɛ nōó yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē kwu ga aɔ́gɛcɔ̄, klla í bū ɔgɔ ipú ajɛ nyɔ̄ í kwu tayínū eko nɛ̄ Óndú géē wā í jīla ɛcɛ iyē ā. É klla í kwu ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū, klla gē wā mla ɛgahi kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: É géē leyīkwu odúúdu iyó kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Klla í yúklɔ́ kwɛyí ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā dúúmā nēé le mafú péee ɛ́ɛ í yɔ̄ ajodobū gɛ ŋ́. Ó má tɛ́ɛcɛ gēdēē ɛɛ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ka, Ogbɔlā, le héyī, ká ā le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō yá kú ɔlá kóō fíyajɛ klá uwɔ.

eng_Latn: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kó kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ Óndú ā bōōbū nɛ̄ iháyí kú ɔdā o je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā gaá yɛ, ó géē gbā odúúdú ije nōo wɛ ɔ́lá nū ā.

eng_Latn: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú oyēeyī kú um nɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā bī um jé ɔwɛ ō yɛ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában tá Ujékɔ̄pu ohi kahíníī, Ayínɔ̄nyā nēe bá nyā wɛ ayí um, ayí nēé ma ā wɛ ayí um, aɔ́dāajɛ ā wɛ ákú um, odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ a má amānyā ā wɛ ákú um. Amáŋ ícɛ nyā ó lɛ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ n yá glá nōo í bī ayínɔ̄nyā kú um mɛ́mla ayí kláajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ɔdā nēé kpó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā wɛ, ocíbú kú ugóolu kóō bī le mīyɛ ɛhi ā wɛ, ofu cigwó. Ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ō bī le mīyɛ ɛhi ā wɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó. Aócíbú ɔhá wɛ ofu cahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔyí ā kóō géē tá ɔdōbɔ̄bí cɛ́ɛ́ kóō je ɔdōlɔhi ā, é je ajɛ kú aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa nɛ̄ aá gē yúufi uwā nɛ̄hi ā yíífi. Eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā aɔ́cɛ́ ā í kē gáā yēeyī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ubetasimáfeti ā wɛ ofɛpa ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híī wā ajaajɛ ŋ́, lɛ áblákpá kú uwɔ plla ŋmá ikpó. Ohígbū ka, ɛga nāa háyi ā, wɛ ɛga otīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
idu_Latn: Kwú éeyē kú o nyatā nāa nya um tá ā ú cīgbīhi gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá um ká n lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ɛ́lim gaá lā okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
idu_Latn: Óndú, uwá lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́, é le ɛgogwɛ́ɛya kú uwɔ ca tāajɛ ɛɛ́. Ami ōfōōfū um wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo hile mɛ́ɛ̄ á, é kē ī dɔɔ̄kā ō je um ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē pɛ́ kwú ɛcɛ péee. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ úklɔ́ kú uwɔ ká ā da alɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá ā. Ɔdá dúúmā nāa géē yá ā, alɔ í tá uwɔ igbīhi géē yá ɔ nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
idu_Latn: Á cɛ̄ ka n yɔ̄ ipú Ádā ā, Ádā ā kē yɔ̄ ipú um ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka lɛ aá ā, ń ka ŋmá ɔfú kú um ŋ́, amáŋ Ádā nōo yɔ̄ ipú um ā gē yúklɔ́ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
idu_Latn: Aóhile kē bá yɔ̄ á, Unóga, Unéfegi, Ujafíya.

eng_Latn: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa géē gbɔbū lɛ Óndú ā, klla í tá ɔwɛ tū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ɔdíyá nāa gē yɔ̄ ī je ihɔtū kú uwɔ lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔnyā ɔhá gē lɔnyɛ tū uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɔnyā uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā bī ga ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gwó lɛ ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
idu_Latn: Leyī yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um lɛwa lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é wɔ̄tū um bɔ̄bíbɔ̄bí lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē cɛ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá géē je pīyeyī wā ɔwɛ kú alɔ, o ŋmá lɛ o hɛ́ odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ aá apī.

eng_Latn: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udɛbɔ́ra tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú, amáŋ é gáā je ojīlīma kú oyálé ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi yá Usísɛ́ra lé. Anɔ́ɔ Udɛbɔ́ra gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ga Ukɛ́dɛssi mɛ́mla Ubárāki á.

eng_Latn: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gáā je uwá tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí ayí alɔ ŋ́. Alɔ géē ka lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú alɔ nōo gboce alɔ ā lɛyíkwu ɔfú mɛ́mla úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi kú Óndú mɛ́mla ɔdā idáagó dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe bá Ujudíya ā kéē le kwu ga ɛyí ɛfu.

eng_Latn: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
idu_Latn: ŋmá ajɛ kwú icō kú ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ucē kú olíla nāa yá abɔ́ɔ á. Á lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ je ga uwɔ ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dáŋ ka, a lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ̄ í cɛ̄ gā awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ ā í géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ami kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá nōo ī hɛ́ aá tá á. Ami wɛ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ámōōmɛ á. Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gwū um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔnyā ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla anú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m gāá klá abɔ́ɔ ɔyā ɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, jāā kwu ícɛ nyā, é hī ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā kahíníī, Ajɛ kú oyī.

eng_Latn: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
idu_Latn: Ayí Ulífāyi dóódu nōo wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ géē gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ kú nū ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā alɔ jé ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmá ā, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā gā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā jé ɛga nōó ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ipɔ́lɛ kú éwo dóódu kpó yá ífi, je ɔlɛ́ uwá pīya alácɛ̄, í klá cɛ̄ la alagbá kú aéwoɔhá a ga ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋ mā yɔ̄ á?.

eng_Latn: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.
idu_Latn: Ámnɔn lɛ oklóbīya éyi, nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Ujónādāabu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ kú Udéfīdi, Ussáma. Ujónādāabu lɛ ula obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā kē í cīíbɔm tū uwā klla í mīyɛ ajɛ ā jāā kwu ɔdɔ kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ ā. Aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ā í kē gáā kpɛ́fú gɔbū glá gɛ ŋ́, kwu aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú kú uwā ā, í gáā lɔfú dúúmā kéē kpɛ́fú gɔbū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá bī gé um nááná, ń gáā mīyɛ ŋ́. Ń gáā mīyɛ aɛ́bɛ́ ojɔ̄kwū nɛ̄ aá kpó bá, kú aá gáā je gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
idu_Latn: Á lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú useda kú Ulébanɔn ā. Ó gwá ābɔ̄ héyīfuú héyīfuú, klla gbo obobowu nɛ̄hi. Ó kē jɛ̄ jāā gáā kwu ojuja.

eng_Latn: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwā klla yɛ ŋmá Uhɛ́ssibɔn, ga Urámati Umísipɛ, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tōnim. Ó klla ŋmá Umáhánem ga ɛjī kú Ulódēba.

eng_Latn: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
idu_Latn: É yɛ ga ɔwɛ ga ácí, bá ī túgagá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā. Nááná nēé jé ō pɛ́ úgbéenyi nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācoyúklɔ́ úgbéenyi ā jé ā í tá uwā abɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú aá bī obɔ̄bí le cíla ulé kú obɔ̄bí ŋ́. Amáŋ eko dóódu aá cēyītīkwū kú aá yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ iyī aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm jikwū gbōmgbōm abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi bá ī pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ā. Ɔcɛ́ kwú bēhé ɔkpá kú Ukídrɔn, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yɛ lɛyíkwu ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ yɛ jīla tá mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, mla ɛ́plla. Ó ka ācɛ kú Ujúda ɛ́ɛ bá ī yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá anúɔ nōo tīihɔ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá nyā kē lɛ ojīlīmā fíyɛ́ aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá Utesalónīka á, ohígbū ka uwá ā mīyɛ ɛlā ā lɔfú lɔfú. É kē ī jila ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ɛ̄cī dóódu kéē má ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
idu_Latn: Da uwā kéē yá ɔdā olɔhi, kéē lɛ agbénú kú úklɔ́ olɔhi nēe ge yá āa. Kéē nwūla abɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ī ce uwá ā. Kéē le tútu kéē kɔ̄ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá ā mla ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē pó ɛlā ōnwū ŋ́ mā, ɛhá mɛ́mla uwēyī géē kwú ɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē jé ɔdā ŋmá ahɔ̄ nēé pi ɔ́ anú ā, géē lɛ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.
idu_Latn: Ukóre, ɔyí kú Ímna nōo gē gbō ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, gē mīyɛ ɛhi nyā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē kɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ alɛwa nēe pīyabɔ̄ ŋmó ɔwɛ o gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, gbɔɔ́ ō yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, lɛ ācɛ alɛwa plla tū ɔdā icííci nɛ̄ é gē nwū ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umerí Umagdalíni mɛ́mla Umerí ɔhá ā bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ lɛ eyī pīya fu únóji ā.

eng_Latn: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ukɔ́tim nēe kɔ̄ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, Áklɔ̄kpīihɔɛ ɔhá yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, é hī ɔ̄ ka ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē nwū ɛlā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ó da ɔ̄kā éyi kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ onwū íne ā gē ka ka ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Udéfīdi ā?.

eng_Latn: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɔfú lé ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya gā um, kwu ɔdōlé kú ɛya ɛ̄nɛ̄ o tīihɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ akpáabana le gbo igbo ahāapa ā, n gáā tá ɔdā nōó ka ā tū ɔkpá, anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ ŋmá ɔkpáncō kahíníī, Kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ akpáabana nōo gbo igbo ahāapa ā ka ā ú tayínū. A híīī tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli ā wɛ Ahíra, ɔyí kú Ɛ́nan.

eng_Latn: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē ŋmó ije kú aá tū ɔdā nōó wɛ ɔdōlé abɔyī nū ŋ́ mā ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bá ī yúklɔ́ ohígbū ɔdā nōó gáā nū aá ipú ŋ́ mā ā? Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um lɔhi lɔhi kú aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá í lé aɔ́dōlé nōo lɔhi fíyé dúú ā.

eng_Latn: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
idu_Latn: Iháyí nōo gboce ɔ́ɔmā ā, é le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā je ɛ̄nyā tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ gɛ ŋ́, ɔkpani ālɔ. Odúúdú ije kú alɔ mɛ ɛ́ɛ́, odúúdú aɔ́dāajɛ kú alɔ kē wɛ ákú uwɔ. Ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ géē je gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ ayíka ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla ajɛ kú alɔ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anɔ́ɔ n le aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā nēe gáā yá ā ka lɛ aá táajɛ gbojī gbojī gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá á. N yá ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá má okónu ō ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ ka aɛ́cí kú aá ɛ́ɛ yá aódée ā lɛ aá ŋ́. Ohigbu nɛ̄ aá géē ka ka aójibó kú aá nēé yá ŋmá ɔcí mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é yá ŋmá oje ā ɛ́ɛ yá uwā á.

eng_Latn: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aíne kú ɛya o yɔlá, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā, ɛya kú íne ō bīya, ɛya kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé, ákú abɔ̄ ō ce ācɛ ɛyí mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔdōlé ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú awulú kú nū ú plla bá ajɛ, kwú ogōdōgōdō ú kpó le ɛ́nyɔ́ kú nū gbō á.

eng_Latn: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛɛ? N jé ka n kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ojɛɛ́lá ā, amáŋ n kē wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi fíyɛ́ uwā! N yúklɔ́ lɔfúlɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā. É tū um agbá igbalɛwa. É ŋmó um ijē igbalɛwa fíyɛ́ uwā kɔ́ɔ́. N kwu ikwū ajaajɛ ojigogo fíyɛ́ uwā kɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Ussɛfátīya, ɔyí kú Umátan, mɛ́mla Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Upássɔ, mɛ́mla Ujɛ́hūkalu, ɔyí kú Ussɛlɛmíya mɛ́mla Upássɔ, ɔyí kú Umalkíya le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ā pó. Ó yɔ̄ ī da uwā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ocɛ̄tra kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu. Aamí.

eng_Latn: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe ge tínē kéē jɛ agbénú ā ga ipú ojámá mɛ́mla o gwōtū ipú ukpa kú ɔdā otíne alɛwa kú olíla nōo lɔfú yá uwā ɔdōobɔ̄bí gla, ó klla lɔfú pi uwá wāajɛ ga ífi mɛ́mla ɔlékwū glá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n géē je aá da báajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē bá ī tíifu bɛ̄ɛka úgbɔ́nya, nēé le iyó nɛ̄hi kpó ce ɔ́ nōo yɔ̄ ī jíliyē klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kákáká ā.

eng_Latn: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ó yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gekwú, nɛ̄ó lɛ ɔmáapú dóódu nēé géē cíla ulé nyā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, é géē gbā ulé ā lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya. Ulé nɛ̄ó géē gbā nyā í gáā ci omlede nɛ̄ó géē bī le gwɛ́ɛya, kéē lɛ ɔ́ yá yēŋēē ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ó yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi gē wā nēé géē gwó ijē nyā ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda: Igelī kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ī gbō alɔ ɛyí, klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yálé á, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú igá gē gbō igelī ā.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Uketúra, ɔnyā ōcikpó kú Ébrahām ā wɛ Usímran, Ujókssan, Umédan, Umídiyan, Ísbaki, mɛ́mla Ussúwa. Ujóksan lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa nēe lé ka Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Udɛ́dan.

eng_Latn: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
idu_Latn: Ó tá ɔkpá nyā igbīhi nēé lɛ Ujɛhóyācin, ɔ̄cɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācoyúklábɔ̄ mɛ́mla aónɔwá ā kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ ewɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī éyi, Udéfīdi le héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá icō kú agbla kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yɛ icō abɔ́ɔ ā, ó lɛ ɔnyā éyi má tóohɛ́ɛwa yɔ̄ í gwīīyē. Ɔnyā ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
idu_Latn: Utáma le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ gaá kwú īlī ā ú kpó ŋmá eyī, klla kwú īlī ɔ̄nyōkwū kú nū ú wiyē.

eng_Latn: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si otú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, alɔ jé ka a wɛ Itíca nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔfú yá aɔ́dā o hídáagó nāa gē yá ā glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ɛgiyí ɛbɛ́ nēe bá nyā lɛ Óndú ā: odúúdú ijē mɛ́mla iyíipú nū.

eng_Latn: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ɔ́da lɛ ɛcɛ. Ɛlā nōó ka ā, kē ī le yá fíya.

eng_Latn: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
idu_Latn: eko ɔ́ɔ́mā, n géē je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā. N klla í je igbīhi cē kwu inu nɛ̄ n hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ ícɛ ka iyē kú um géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōó klla í wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā. Ísrɛ̄lu géē je pīya ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ í bī le kwu ita, ācɛ dóódu kē í yá ɔ̄ okónu.

eng_Latn: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lā gboce uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Unatánīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usúwa.

eng_Latn: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
idu_Latn: Ó géē nya ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī agīje ŋmá īkpēyī kú uwā. Ikwū í gáā yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ í gáā yēkwu gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ í gáā jikwū gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ í kē gáā jɔ́ɔnɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aɔ́dā otɛtɛ ā le pɛ́ i yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛlá kwu ɔ́ kú aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kɛlā ā. Ohígbū kóō le bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe tá ō pó ɛlā kú Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ eko nōó kɛlā lɛ uwá ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī gbɛlá ka aá lɔfú kwu glá eko nɛ̄ aá tá kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kɛlā ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, alɔ le pīya aólíla. Amáŋ aá wɛ ācojɔ́ɔdā ohígbū o pīyatɔ̄há kú aá mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā! Alɔ le gbagbafú amáŋ aá le pīya ācɛ olɔfú! É leyī gwō alɔ bónū, amáŋ é le ojīlīmā je lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Abíhēlu mɛ́mla Umɔ́dɛkāyi klla le ɔkpá ɔhá tá kpɔ́ ohígbū ɛ̄cī mɛ́mla ucɛ kú Upúrim nyā klla le abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the LORD of all the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá um ohi ka e géē ga ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɔkpáncō ā, é wā bōōbū ŋmá iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú kú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā é habɔ̄ ɔ́kɔ ā mɛ́mla ádā uwā tá, gaá yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
idu_Latn: É je ajɛ kú Ána mɛ́mla Ubíl-am mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā ā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
idu_Latn: N géē je uwá pīya éwo ékpónú ipú ajɛ ā, ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É géē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ékpónú nōo géē gbō uwā. É klla gáā wɛ éwo ɛpa ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ uwá gē kɔ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɛpa gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄na nɛ̄ n nā āa.

eng_Latn: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā lɛ ɔnyā okwū, amáŋ ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔbá nū tá ɔ̄, nōo le tēelihɔ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka akwuna ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē lɛ ɔyípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā nōó je ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jéjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le ikpɛ́lā yá mla ɔ́mpā nū, nɛ̄ó bī ɛcɔ̄ ámāŋ akwū lɛ tū ɔ́mpā nū ā, lɛ ágbe yá ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ó yá ɔ̄ ágbe ā gwutá ajɛ ōcē.

eng_Latn: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nāa í ka kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ga ɔlékwū .

eng_Latn: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛpa ámāŋ ka ācɛ ɛtá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ā cíkā ō kɛlā, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ohile ā kē leyī yɛ ɛlā nēé ka ā.

eng_Latn: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
idu_Latn: Igbō ōŋmókókó nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lé ɛbɔ́ ā lɔhi fíyɛ́, ō nyɔ̄ í lé ucɛ nɛ̄hi ipú inū nōo le mu mla unwalu nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ le kɔ̄, bá gē táafú ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
idu_Latn: Ó géē nya uwɔ tá ŋmá okónu ō kwiyē dóódu. Ó klla í nya uwɔ tá eko ífi dóódu.

eng_Latn: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
idu_Latn: Oōnwuné mla ojīlīmā kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē wu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ā. É gáā ma ayí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, anyā uwā í gáā yíipú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī yíipú ayípɛ̄ dúú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ owútígbíngbili playi okónogwu ɛnɛ kú úwé kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ábsālɔm, lɛ ɔ́ má ā, ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka Ámnɔn, ɔyí ádā nū, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́báajɛ kɛ̄ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mā ikwū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú ɔtū ú ŋmá anú. Ka ɔyí ádā nū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ kpɔ́ á, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Utáma má lā ɔlɛ́ Ábsālɔm, ɔyínɛ́ nū á. Amáŋ ó yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ipú ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla ka kahíníī, N géē cɛ̄ ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ká e gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ká n nyīla ɛwa kú uwā. N kē í yá ɔdā nēé ba ā lɛ uwā igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. N klla géē nyīla ɛwa kú uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aálá ā.

eng_Latn: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́tam wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū Urésin, ɔcɛ́ kú Usírīya, mɛ́mla Upéka, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tá Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē nū aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ nyā. Ó géē yá ká aá móōwē nɛ̄hi, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í hile gɛ ŋ́. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í le aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yá ācɛ ogbō ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo í wā nɛ̄ alɔ kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́ti-nímra, mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tihára ā tú gwó igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
idu_Latn: É ka aá klla cēyītīkwū kú aá lɛ Óndú ā jé. É ka ɔ́ɔ géē wā ɛgiyí aá piíí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ eyī í nyā piíí ā, é ka ɔ́ɔ géē wā ɛgiyí aá piíí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í yā piíí, kóō kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko kú abālɔbányā, Ɔwɔicō í leyī gwō íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā bónū gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō mafú ka anúɔ ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa. Ó gē mīyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si ā wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛya kú nū nōó gwó ā, ó le ɔdée kú ɛya kú ācɛ ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Ó kwú ɛwū nēé gáā je gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya kú ācɛ ā ú ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá mla ɛya nōó gwó kéē kpó íne nōo bīya ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ā.

eng_Latn: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē gbōmgbōm lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē gbō alɔ ā. Aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otú ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā gaá da Unátan kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
idu_Latn: Ikpíikpó ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛlā ā le cɛ̄ ɛyí Unebúkádinēsa. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nū ŋmá ipú ācɛ, gaá yɔ̄ ī lé ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā ipácí á. Iyē kú nū kwú bū ɔnwū bɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ ā, ébú cē klá anú iye jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó kwú bū efū bɛ̄ɛka ɔgɔ ā. Ūkwū kú nū kwaajɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔgɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
idu_Latn: Ami yá nōó líla á. Ami í klla je íjééyī lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
idu_Latn: É géē tū odúúdú aéwo bá iyɔ̄bū nū, ó géē kɔ̄ uwā, éyi ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔhá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē kɔ̄ aálá ŋmá ɛgiyí aɛ́wū ā.

eng_Latn: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ajā gbo klla lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó ɛɛ́. É gbaajā ŋmá lɛ aɛ́cí nēé pā ā. É kē ŋmó ayí nēé ma gā um ā. É lɛ ayí um ā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu wā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá gaá lá igwu ā dúú, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ukénan dúú.

eng_Latn: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ anyā ŋmá ɛgiyí aéwɔhá ā, kla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē kú ɛcí ō pā kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī kɛlā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ aá kɛlā olɔhi nōo géē tīile lɛ ācɛ, ɛlā nōō géē tá uwā abɔ̄ kéē jɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgbá kú uwā lɛ āa cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nɛ̄ aá géē ka āa kóō le pīya ɔhā lɛ ācɛ nēe í pó ā.

eng_Latn: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu yɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā, ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya le tū wā ajaajɛ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, amáŋ, ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā le akpáabana nɛ̄hi gbo ŋmá ɔkpáncō klá ācɛ Ufílīstiya ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Ó kwú uwā ú kpó gbájí, anɔ́ɔ é le fíyákátá bá ī kwu ohígbū ufi.

eng_Latn: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
idu_Latn: Okoolo éyi mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyééye.

eng_Latn: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ anyōkwu dɔ̄ɔ̄kā otábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, a gē lɛ uwá tá abɔ̄ áncā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. A kōō ī pīya ayókwū tū dúú.

eng_Latn: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
