idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ cāŋjɛ ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī gáā je amɛ̄ lɛ ɔyí anúɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ má ka ɔyí ā wɛ okwū á. Ó klla ka abɔ̄ anúɔ leyīkwu ɔ́ cíí ā, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ má ka ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ wɛ ɔyí nɛ̄ anúɔ ma ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka īnyīlɛ̄yí kú ɔ̄cɛ kwú kpó gbɛ́lé ŋmá ɔ̄ ɛyí, iyɔ̄bū ámāŋ ka igbīhī, o fakpá nōó fakpá á, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
idu_Latn: Ikpati ā tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya ā, Ahíyo kē tá iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbaálá gē leyīkwu álá kú nū ā. Ɔdā dúúmā í kē gáā ŋá um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é je igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu nēe gwó kwu Umɔ́du ā yɔlá tāajɛ ŋ́, ayíka Uhásɔ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa je tɔ̄lá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kwú aúnóji, ɛga nēé nyi okwū kú aá ā í kpó nwūla, klla kwú aá í kpó bɛ̄cɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é bá gē kwinya ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛga dúúmā nēé le pó koó yɔ̄ nɛɛ, é gē bī ācɛ odoōcē o gwutá ɛyí ákplata gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ohígbū uwā á. É le ɔ́ bītá ga ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ é lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi éyi pīyɛ̄, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá kwú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā ú kpó lá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá ɔ́ɔmā lá á.

eng_Latn: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
idu_Latn: Eko nyā wɛ iháyí ɔmɛɛhɔ̄ nēé kwú Ujɛhóyākim abɔ̄fú ga ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um ka amiyɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú ācɛ nēe bá ā yá lɔfú ká. Ó ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ uwá yá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī bī ahɔ̄ kú uwā le pó ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ó ka amiyɔ̄ lɛ uwá eyí kpó pu, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē bī ikpēyī ā lɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ jɛ́ɛyí ɔdā dúúmā. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī kwúcē wā ɛgiyí anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ uwá nyatá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛlā kú um nēe bá ā pó klla lɛ uwá yá, n gē lɛ ɔ́ gbla ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī nōo gwó inu kú nū ce ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
idu_Latn: Má adāgbéenyi ká ā má ɔ̄. Ami yá ɔ̄ á. Ami kē yá uwɔ á. Ó gē lé ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā.

eng_Latn: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī blibli ɛ̄cī dóódu ācɛ gē pɛ́ gā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kéē pó ɛlā kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n ka, A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛɛ, Óndú? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka, Ami Ujísɔ̄si nāa gē yáŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unehemíya kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, n má cīce gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū. Ɛ̄cī alɛwa, n yɔ̄ í yá ɔtūnōbí kú ɛlā nyā. Ń lé ɔdōlé ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n kōō ī gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ n gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníi.

eng_Latn: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka.

eng_Latn: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú nū, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a ī cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nyā mla ācɛ nāa bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā?.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe tá igbīhi abālɔbányā ā géē je pīya ācɛ aflɛ́yí. Ācɛ nēe wɛ aflɛ́yí abālɔbányā géē je pīya ācɛ o tá igbīhi.

eng_Latn: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ugáti klla le uwá yálé. Ó mīyɛ Ugáti, anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ géē gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā gē kɛlā lɛ ɔ́mpa uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā le ahɔ̄ jē, klla le ɔdā nēé ka ā pó. Ɔkpá nēé tá iyē kú odúúdú ācɛ nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā, ce iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le jé péee ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄ka anúɔ kóō je anúɔ ŋmó. Udéfīdi má klá Uhóres ipú ígbíli nōo kwu Usífu ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ keé gbɔ́ɔ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā, Óndú ā géē yā í cɔ̄nū klá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā kóō je uwá kpó yíífi dúúdú. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nōo yɔ̄ pī uwā ā ɔ́ɔ gē yɔ́bɔ́nyā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ le tá ipú odúúdu ajɛ ā lɛ ɔ́ jīla, le ɔ́ tá tāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ē kɔ̄ ɔ̄ ɛga ahāapa lɛ̄ ā. É klla le iyē kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā kpó tá. Anɔ́ɔ ē pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ujóssuwa Ussílo á.

eng_Latn: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛpa lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n wɛ awɔ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í gaá le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, klla í lɛ unwalu kú um ka klá ajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nēé ka nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n. Ācɛ cíkā ō mīyɛ ɛlā ā cɛ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā kóō wā í nyā ācobīyíne tá. Ami a kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aá tɛ̄hɔ̄, koó gaá lɛ ɔyínɛ́ aá ā bī wā. Ācɛ ohile kú aá ā géē bá agbá amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú ɛdɔ̄ kú ācɛ nɛ̄ aá wɛ ā jé. Oŋma lɛ oyēeyī kú Uféro ā, ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, aá wɛ ācɛ obɔkwu ɔdā tayínū nɛ.

eng_Latn: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N jé ka Óndú ā kwú ajɛ ā í lɛ aá ɛɛ́. Ufi kú aá gē yá odúúdú alɔ. Ɔtū kú odúúdú alɔ kwú gbenyi ohígbū aá ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king's son.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā, Ujɛhóyāda, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ a kpó hīgwú wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ klla le ɛka gwá lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Ujówāsi, ɔyí kú Ahasíya ā mafú lɛ uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō yá ka, Īī kú aá kóō wɛ Īī ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ká Ehée kú aá kóō kē wɛ Ehée ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɔdā dúúmā nōo le fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ami ā, eko nēé lɛ um je gicō, n géē pi ācɛ dóódu wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ kú nū nōo bī ɔtā ā í jiliyē ŋ́, abɔ̄ kú nū kē lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, í lɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē á. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu nōo gē leyīkwu ɔ́ klla gē gbō ā á.

eng_Latn: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo gē ka ɛbɛ kú ɛbɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ á, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā nōó ka lɛ yá yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ n ka ka íjééyī lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔfú á. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɛlá wu íjééyī kú olɛhɔ́cɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē jahɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
idu_Latn: Aólɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé lɛ agbénú dúúmā ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ Unebusárādan mā uwá tá Ujúda á. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ajɛ mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kpó lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
idu_Latn: N géē nyīla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ŋmá ísu kú Umeditarénīya jāā ga ísu kú Uyufarétīisi.

eng_Latn: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo gbla ɔ̄cɛ ā, le abɔ̄ nā daa, anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ̄ kwu um ákpókónu á. Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má nyā lɛ um iyē catāapū. Ó yá ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú.

eng_Latn: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ a ohígbū ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um ŋ́ mā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ, nōo gē nya uwɔ tá á. N le ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kwɛyí uwɔ, ká n̄ lɛ uwɔ fūla. N kē le ācɛ kú Itiyópīya mɛ́mla Usɛ́ba ā kpó fūla oyēeyī kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.
idu_Latn: ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā géē kpó ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí kú nū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cē ā, tū ipú ómbilí, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ kwú ómbilí ā ú ga ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ fu kéē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā āa.

eng_Latn: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, ɛga olicō fíyɛ́ dúú ā, í gáā cíla um ulé olɔhi kú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi cījáalí ka Óndú Ujísɔ̄si le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, Ɔwɔicō klla le ɔhā nɛ̄hi hɛ́ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gēe kwinya nyɔ̄ ga éyi kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā. Ó klla ka ka eko nɔ́ɔ gā abɔ́ɔ, ɔ́ɔ géē ga ɛga ohɛ́pɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ okómpīinu kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔkwu kú iyawu kú nū ā ka lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ bēhé ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó í klá ā mafú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā olɔhi nēé nwū uwɔ ā, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā miya ɔdā dúúmā, ámāŋ ka o nyɔ̄ gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
idu_Latn: Ó cíkā ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ icɔ́ɔci ŋ́ mā cíkā ō ka olɔhi kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī gwō tū ukpa kú ebilíi kú uwēyī kóō lɛ ɔ́ kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sta tá ɔcɛ́ ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dáŋ ka ɔcɛ́ cɛ̄ nɛɛ, ayíka ó lɛ ɛga je lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu kú ɔdā nēé yá ícɛ nyā kéē klla le yá óócí kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ okwū kú ayí kú Uháman ā kpó tū ɔ́ŋgbá playi icō.

eng_Latn: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
idu_Latn: É kwú okwū kú nū ú ce ɔnya le ɔ́ bī jāā wā Ujerúsālɛm gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámilíī kú aɔ́cɛ́ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛ́ɛtá kú ucɛ ā, aá kpó aɛ́drɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna igwóléyi, aómlede ɛpa, mɛ́mla ayí omlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ igwɛ́ɛnɛ gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, é kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā í yíífi ɛɛ́, o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Uhɛ́ssbɔn ga Udíbɔn. O ŋmá Unássim gā Unɔ́fa nōo kwu Umedéba ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwóléyi wɛ Ɛlíyāssibu, ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa wɛ Ujákim.

eng_Latn: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
idu_Latn: anɔ̄ ō le tū agege, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ɔtulalī ō le tū ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí mɛ́mla ɔtulalī ō kpóocu.

eng_Latn: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá, aá le túbá kú aá jāhɔ̄. Odúúmā kú aɛ́cí kú aá ā lɔfú ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā glá ā āa? É lɔfú ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ fu ā, ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gáā kpɛfú tá ācɛ Ubábīlɔn glá ā? Ó géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne kóō yá.

eng_Latn: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
idu_Latn: É ka amáŋ, aá í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá ɔnyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, aá le ɛka gbo klla le okónu tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ le ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn lɛ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā lɛ.

eng_Latn: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔfiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, noó lá ije kú nū, ámāŋ nēé ma ɔlɛ́ nū ā, géē lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya gē mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Usíya lé ɔcɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī ā, ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cɛpa. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ujekolíya, nōo ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē kwúcē ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gaá da ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
idu_Latn: Kwu ācɛ nēe ŋmá Upɛ́sīya, Itiyópīya, mɛ́mla Ulíbiya, nɛ̄ ē bá pi anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā, é kē bī ɔkplɛ́fú mla ɔdōkwɛyí kú oje.

eng_Latn: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
idu_Latn: Ó jé Ujékɔ̄pu éjúuma ŋ́, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ kú nū wɛ ɔnwɔ̄ɔ̄nwū bɛ̄ɛka ákú Ísɔ, ɔyīnɛ̄ nū ā. Abɔ̄ ó gáā hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
idu_Latn: Uhádādi gekwú. Ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm le kɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, Utímna, Álfah, Ujétehi.

eng_Latn: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔtū kú ācɛ nēe bá ā í lɛ kplákplá ŋ́. É lɛ ahɔ̄ kú uwā gwū, nōo yá kéē pó ɛlā ŋ́, é kē lɛ eyī kú uwá kpó klá. Ɔ́ɔmā yá kéē híīī bī uwā mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, kéē kē bī ahɔ̄ kú uwā pó ɛlā ŋ́, kéē bī ɔtū kú uwā jé odée ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē wā ká n̄ lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, á ka lɔhi ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ a ka anúɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ipéyī Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō híī piyɔtū ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā kú ɛcɛ kōō ī he aá ɔtū ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛcɛ he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔtū, ayíbɛ ihɔtū kú ádā ā í yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, N cokónu ga awɔ ka ícɛ nyā a géē yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō mla um.

eng_Latn: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le pó ka ucē kú ikpɔ́nya oce ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ ipú aá. Ɛdɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ í kē gáā pó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ŋ́. É da um ka ɔnyīlɔ éyi gē gbo mla ɔnyā ádā nū!.

eng_Latn: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām kahíníī, Kócōō, ā cɔ̄nū ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ n lɛ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gā uwɔ kpɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ācɛ ofu má abɔ́ɔ bɛ́ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá Ébrahām ohi kahíníī, Ohígbū ācɛ ofu ā, n gaá je ɔ́ yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
idu_Latn: Ekohi ŋ́, ádā um géē lɛ abɔ̄ ma um iyē, ɔ́dāŋ nōó le má ka amíyɔ̄ gē plla anúɔ, ó géē tokónu gā um. Ó kē gáā wɛ o hɔ́hā ce um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ, lɛ iyē gwá, lɛ anɔ̄ nya iyē, le ɛyí fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le úwé ɔhá kpó wiiyē á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛga ō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, anɔ́ɔ ó gáā le ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā á. Eko nōó pīyɛyí wā ipú agbla ɔcɛ́ ā, ó le ɔ̄kā ɔdōlé da, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lé ɔkwɔɔkwu nēé le bī gē lɛ ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, alɔ bī ahɔ̄ kú alɔ le pó ɛ́ɛ́, aádáádā alɔ kɛlā lɛ alɔ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ dúú. Ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ipú ígbíli eko kú uwá íkííkē ā.

eng_Latn: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ anú abɔ̄yīnū cɛ̄ lɛ Udéfīdi lɛ unwalu hɛ́ gé lɛ uwá á. Óhígbū ka Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda gbaáluka á.

eng_Latn: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
idu_Latn: É tīile dúúmā gā um ŋ́. Ohígbū ka uwá ī lɔfú abɔ̄ dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū í gē mɛ gbóógbóō ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛbɛ ō má, ucē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ō ka mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ jé nɛ̄hi ā í mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē gbō ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ī yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā tá ɔ̄ ahínyá kú úklɔ́ nōó yá ā ŋ́. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā, mɛ́mla owu ō nū inya nɛ.

eng_Latn: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
idu_Latn: N wɛ oklóbīya kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā, mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa klla da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ íyí aá iyē gwu, ohígbū ka óócí, Óndú ā géē yá ɔdā ōhídáagó ipéyī aá.

eng_Latn: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
idu_Latn: Opī éyi kú ɛya kú ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú ɛɛ́ mā le ŋmúla ŋmá ɔfú kú ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je odúúdú ɔfú kú uwɔ cikpɔ́nyā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē je odúúdú ije kú uwɔ ŋmó tū anyā ŋ́. É le aɔ́cɛ́ alɛwa kpó yíífi ŋmá ɛcɛ nyā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ gē tú uwɔ abɔ̄ á, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ ŋmá ɔkpáncō á. Ó gē hɔhā ce uwɔ nɛ̄ a géē lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī pɛ́ ŋmá ɛga olipú kú ipú ajɛ ā. Ó géē hɔhā ce uwɔ nɛ̄ a í ma ayí alɛwa.

eng_Latn: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bā ī kwu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā gaá dɔɔ̄ka ɛga nɛ̄ abɔ̄ í gáā kwu uwá ŋ́ mā gaajɛ kú Uhɛ́sbon, ɛga nɛ̄ Usihɔn tɛtɛ cɔɔcɛ́ ā, amaŋ é kwú ɔlɛ ā ú tɔ̄ɔlá.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā lá ipú aígeli nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá ā, ɛ́ɛ lɔfú pó.

eng_Latn: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɛtiyópiya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulíbīya í lɛ aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa mɛ́mla úgbɔ́nya mɛ́mla ɔnya ɛfú mɛ́mla ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya ŋ́ nɛɛ? Abɔ̄ a kpɔ́tú ce Óndú ā eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó cɛ̄ ga uwɔ lɛ uwá yálé.

eng_Latn: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó. Akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū kwu kóō kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛplá oje ahāanɛ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nēé je Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ́kpá á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
idu_Latn: N géē gbō uwɔ ɔ́ŋgbá nɛ̄ á gáā pīyeyī ga ɛga dúúmā glá ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī kú íbɔm nāa cē tū Ujerúsālɛm ā le yá mɛ.

eng_Latn: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mā ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū tá Umówābu, anɔ́ɔ é bá abɔ́ɔ odúúdú eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ ī tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ āá.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō ményinyi odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
idu_Latn: Aá híī gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ̄gbā gwū um tá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē yɔ́bɔ̄nyā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā, abɔ̄ iyē kú um kē lé ka Oyɔ́bɔ́nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Ó ka alɔ̄ le cālɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ gɔbū mla iyāwu kú alɔ, ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla odúúdú aípɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá nēe lā kwu uwá ā. Ajɛ nōo ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan, ga ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ajɛ nōó lɛ ɛfú ŋ́ mā, gā ɛháajɛ, jāā ga okónu ísu kú Umeditarénīya. Ó ka ālɔ̄ yɛ ga ajɛ kú Ukénan, ka ālɔ̄ klla gla aɛ́fu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn jāā ga Ísu nɛ̄hī kú Uyúfrētīisi ā.

eng_Latn: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn gē bī aígbɔ́ɔcí nɛ̄hi kú Usɛ́da wā í gbā Udéfīdi ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gaá le gla Amfipólīsi mɛ́mla Apoloníya ā, anɔ́ɔ é gā ajɛ Utesalónīka ɛga nɛ̄ Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ācɛ Ujíyu éyi yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Umídiyan wɛ Ɛfá, Ɛ́fa, Uhánɔ̄ku, Abída mɛ́mla Ɛ́ldaa. Odúúdú aɛ́nyā wɛ ayí kú Ukɛtúra.

eng_Latn: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
idu_Latn: Ubɛsálilu bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēe hile ŋmá ɛ̄nɛ̄ é le yúklɔ́ ā le yá aógbló, aágá kú ogbló ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́dōklá icō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ukelíya, Ákisību, mɛ́mla Umaréssa. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ahāanɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le yá i yɛ ā, n má ɛbɛ ɔhá abɔ̄ ɔdūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ éyi le nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ɔkpáncō. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ nōo kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka opo nɛ̄ n pó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ga um aflɛ́yí ā kahíníī, Wā icō amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛ ɔdā nōo géē yá igbīhāajɛ ā mafú ga uwɔ.

eng_Latn: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē bī iyē kú nū tɔ́ɔna Usáyɔn, klla í cɛ̄tra anū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
idu_Latn: Ussɛ́m, nōo wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujáfɛ̄ti ā, wɛ ádáádā kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ɛ́ba á É ma ayí nēe bá ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɛ ipú ígbíli iháyí ofɛpa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ nōo gē kpɛ́fú glá ipú uwā nēe bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, lɛ pɛ́ gekwú. Ohígbū ka é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔkɔ kú Óndú ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tókónu lɛ uwā ka, odúúmā kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā ga ipú ajɛ nōó cokónu lɛ uwá ā ŋ́. Ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōlé yɔ̄ anú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ gē miya ɛlā mla uwá lɛyíkwu ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yá, o cīyɔ̄cɛ-bī, mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā, ufi le Ufɛ́līsi kwú, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā ɛ́ɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛga lɛ, n géē hī uwɔ igwú.

eng_Latn: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yɔ̄ gē yɛ ipú ɛhɔ̄ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, áluka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lé glá ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē cē á, amáŋ ká ɛ̄ɛ híī bī ɛ̄wā le hɛ́ odúúmā ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóram, ɔyí kú Ujɛhósāfati, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, lɛ ayínɛ́ ɛhīlī nēe bá ā, Asárīya, Ujéhīyelu, Usekaríya, Asariyáhu, Umíkɛlu mɛ́mla Ussefatáya.

eng_Latn: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu kú ɛháajɛ gē bī ɔwɔ wā ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ awanda ō ya gē bī ikpɛ́lā wā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā le cēnyi klá ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔnyā ā kóō gbɛlá kwu ɛlā nɛ̄ anúɔ da ɔ́ ā, kɔ́ɔ̄ klla gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɔ́ɔ géē yá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, ámāŋ, ɔ́ɔ géē bɔ̄bí lɛ aá mɛ́mla ɔkpani aá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔ gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ipú iháyí ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá dóódu, ɛ́ɛ géē je ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā dóódu lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayókwū, anyōkwū, mɛ́mla aéwɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔdōlé nōo ce uwá ɛgbá ō lé ā ipú igelī dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ā.

eng_Latn: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔkɔ ā le ɛlā ka kwɛyí ā, Ujísɔ̄si háyi ōfōōfūnū mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ayíkpó ā le okónu klá tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēé má ā, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā nēé má ɛyí ɛfu eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Nááná, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā kpó yá lɛ uwá ā, ɔtu í he ɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɛyínɛ̄hi kú uwā ŋ́. É le pɛ́ gekwú anɔ́ɔ okwū kú uwā le fíyákátā bá ɛga dóódu kú ipú ígbíli á.

eng_Latn: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya tá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ahínyá kú ɔdá nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū da anú mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugáálu, ɔyí kú Ébēdi gā Ussɛ́kɛm mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm kwú ɔtū ú kpó ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
idu_Latn: A cíkā ō kwú ije kú um ā ú tū ɛga nēe ī kpó ije tū nēé hī ka ubánki ā, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ n kwúcē ká n̄ mīyɛ ije kú um mɛ́mla ije nōo ga ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
idu_Latn: Ó le ogbló nēé bī le je ede ā ŋmá ajɛ yá ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya. Ó le oje udɔ ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
idu_Latn: Ugɔ́gu, awɔ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe yɛce uwɔ wā ā géē pɛ́ kwu ɛyí aɛ́fú kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Aígbáanɔ nōo ī wu icō ā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí géē kpó okwū kú aá lé á.

eng_Latn: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛdɔ ɔdōlé nōo ī he ádā nū ɔtū ā yá, anɔ́ɔ ó le bī wā gé lɛ ádā nū á. Ó kahíníī, Ádā um, cāŋjɛ ká ā lé ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ŋmó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō ka, Ipú ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā n géē cē Alelékwū kú um klá ācɛ dóódu. Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá géē mɛ́ɛbɛ, klla í kacɛ̄. Ayípɛ̄ oklóbīya kú aá kē í mɛ́ɛbɛ, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá kē í nɔɔ̄na.

eng_Latn: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, aéwo alɛwa géē hídáagó eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má Okónu í klla gáā hɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo ā ŋ́. Ohígbū kéē géē má, klla í jɛ́yí ɔdā nēé tɛtɛ jé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́cɛ nēe klla bɔ̄bíipú ā, bá yɔ̄ ī yá aógbɛhá ŋmó. Ukpa nēé kpla gbēyī ācɛ ɔhá ā, kóō lɛ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ajɛ kpó tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́pɛ́, kóō le mu, kéē lɛ uwá jétū. Lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aɛ́fu nɛ́ncɛ́ cílatū jonjilɛ mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́. Ajɛ nōo le kpɔ́gɔ̄kɔ́gɔ̄, klla le kplúkūkplukū ā, é gēe cíla nū tū mɛ́ɛlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ da uwɔ ā, lɛ ɔ̄ yá. Alɔ lɛ ācɛ ɛnɛ, nēe le oji ce.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē lá ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ géē lé klla í gwá ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tíne ō yá ā wɛ o lɛ yɛ bū ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā, nɛ̄ o má eyī kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka eyī ōnyā ā? Ó jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā bɛ̄ɛka ɔyā nōo yɔ̄ ī fiyajɛ ā, klla lɔhi ī ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ ā. A klla héyīfuú bɛ̄ɛka aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi nēe le hɔ́ɔgba bá ī nɔɔwɔ mɛ́mla otúta ā.

eng_Latn: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄n Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā á.

eng_Latn: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam le yɛ mla Ubálāki ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhúsōtu.

eng_Latn: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ussɔ́lu gekwú anɔ́ɔ Ubaalhánan, ɔyí kú Ácībɔ mīyɛ ɔkwu nū.

eng_Latn: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aá yá lɛ īyī aá ā bá āa? Ɔ́dāŋ́ nēé nya aá tá glá, ká é kē nya aá tá eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá bá ipú unwalu ŋŋ. Woó! Ācɛ kú Ujúda, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá lɛwa lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛcí nɛ̄ aá gē pā ā lɛwa lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá Usáyɔn ā bá ī fīyégbúlú kpákpákpá ipu ufi. É bá ī dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛpɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo gē yi piyóo ā. Ɔ̄nyɛ ipú alɔ í wi ŋmá ipú ɛdɔ ɔlá nyā glá āa.

eng_Latn: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, ɔhá nōo pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm mla uwá dúú á, wɛ, Uhíha, Uhásūfa, Utabāwɔtu.

eng_Latn: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda. Ó ka ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā pīyɛyí ga ipɔ́lɛ́ nū. Uwá mɛ́mla aíkonó kú uwá húmáyī í lā Ubábīlɔn, ŋmífī nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, kpó uwā nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛla kú uwā gwōtū, anɔ́ɔ é mā ō nū uwā inya ŋ́ jāā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ugíbɛya. É yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā abɔ̄ é bá ī nū uwā inya ā.

eng_Latn: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
idu_Latn: Ahínādabu, ɔyí kú Íddo wɛ Ugbómína kú Umahánēyim.

eng_Latn: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
idu_Latn: N lɔfú je ojuja nōbí pīya klá ɔkpáncō juu, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ í lɛ úwé ekwu nōbí wiyē eko nōó yēekwu ā.

eng_Latn: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohi kú Ufílīstiya bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu , oje udɔ, mla aɔ́dā ɔhá wā í yá Ujehósāfati ɛhi. Ācɛ Árābu bī aálá úlā igwáahāānɛ, ce ofɛhɔ̄ , mɛ́mla aɛ́wū úlā igwáahāānɛ ce ofɛhɔ̄ wā í yá Ujehósāfati ɛhi.

eng_Latn: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tōō lɔtūcē ŋ́, gē bī ācɛ ga ipú unwalu, amáŋ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo le kpaakpa gē bī ɛbɔ́ gé lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū gē wā í gwɛ́ɛya mla ádā nū nɛɛ, ɛ́nɛ́ nū gē gɔ́ awulú nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá ká aá lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo tayínū ā jé. Amáŋ ɛgiyí ācɛ ohile ā, é gē bī ita le kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi o tayínū ā lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ kéē kōō plleyī nááná é gáā má ɔdā dóódu ŋ́, é gē jāhɔ̄ nááná, é gáā jɛ́yí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā da Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ayíkpó kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdā nōó nwū ā.

eng_Latn: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
idu_Latn: Nááná nēé gē bī iyē kú um le gbo ɔkpá ā, é gē yá ɛlā nēé ka ka aá géē yá ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
idu_Latn: Upíta mɛ́mla ayíkpó ɛpa ɔhá ā lɛ iyɔ̄lā gbo liipú. Amáŋ é le héyī, lɛ oceyī nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ācɛ ɛpa nēe háyi pī uwɔ̄ ā má.

eng_Latn: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá háyi le tútū mla ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā kwú ɛ́nyɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá okwɛ́nyɔ̄ ā, o yɔ̄ gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ojigógó ā kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú o klá ɔtū kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō lé ɔdōlé kú ēpēēpū mla ācɛ nōó he uwá ɔtū ikɔkɔ ō nyɔ̄ í lé ɛbɛ́ o lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ɛga nēé ī wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
idu_Latn: É tá ka aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aójibó kú Ubáalu mɛ́mla Ásitātɛsi ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔcí éyi tū kóō gbo bobowú ce Ujóna, cɛ́ɛ́ kú iyē kóō gbo ɔ́ nɛɛ. Ɔtū le he Ujóna nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔcí nyā.

eng_Latn: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā túkanā ámāŋ o dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́. É gáā pó ɔkɔ kú nū úláyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
idu_Latn: N géē wɛ ádā nū, ó kē í wɛ ɔyí um. N gáā mā ō yɔ̄ ihɔtū nū eko dóódu ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá Usɔ́ɔlu, nɛ̄ n kē je ɔ́ táajɛ ká ā lé ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kpoókpoó nɛ̄ íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé í blla anú ŋ́, í lɔhi ŋ́. Á gbeyī cíí ŋ́, gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ipú unwalu.

eng_Latn: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔyínɔ̄yīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ ijáalí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ā ipú ɔtū kú nū. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, lɛ ɔ́ yá okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛɛ́, ohígbū koó mīyɛ ijáalí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But neither so did their witness agree together.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō uwá, abɔ̄yī uwā ā, ijáalí kú uwa í wɛ ékpó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
idu_Latn: Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a, gēe tū ōcē klá ācɛ nēé bá ī lé ɔdōlé ɛbɔ́ ícɛ nyā. Ɔlá gēe yɔ iyē kú uwá yɔ i yi piyóó.

eng_Latn: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yúklɔ́ kú nū ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nōo ī leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā. Alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka inu ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ lɔtū lɛ klla lɛ ɔtū ká alɔ yéékpónú kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ī ceyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo gē tū olíla ɛhɔ̄ ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ o gwó iyī nū ikpó tónū ā. Unwalu nāa gē bī gē lɛ iyī uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
idu_Latn: Óndú, má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yíihɔtū kú íne kú uwɔ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ, lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū, ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī yíihɔtū eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka nēe bā nyā cɛ̄ le ācɛ Ujíyu kwú kɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta mɛ́mla ɔyíkpó ɔhá kwūce Ujísɔ̄si. Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā jé ɔyíkpó ɔhá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúce Ujísɔ̄si ga ipú agbla kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē wā ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpancō, ɛga nōó lā ā. Ó í gaá je ōwē lɛ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ohígbū ɔbíipú kú uwā. Ācɛ nēé ŋmó tayínū ipú ɛcɛ ā kpɛ́mm ā, Óndú ā géē je ɔkwu nū tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ajɛ í klla gáā je ācɛ nēé kpó ŋmó wɛɛlɛ ā tayínū glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō nōo géē cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ um. Īī, ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ icō abɔ́ɔ nōo ī ka ka amíyɔ le kpaakpa á.

eng_Latn: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu le jɛ̄ ācɛ ɛjɛ̄ nɛ̄ okónu í ka ɔ́ glá ŋ́. Eyī í cɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ ī tá ɛlā ō pó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ má ɔ̄, anúɔ lā inu abɔ̄yīnū nēe bī ɔcí usɛ́da le gwó amáŋ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kē háyi ipú ádá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a le yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a kahíníī, Ɔdā nyā géē yá Ubábīlɔn á. Ó géē bī,í klla gáā tū bɛ̄cɛ igbɔhá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ífi nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá kóō yá ɔ̄ ā. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka ā kwɛyí amānyā.

eng_Latn: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ óndɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da éyi kú uwā kahíníī, Oklóbīya um, ń yá uwɔ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Á cɛ̄ ɔkɔ́bɔ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ɛ̄cī éyi mɛ́mla um ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá nēe bá Ɛ́fēsɔsi ā le ɔdā nōo yá nyā pó, anɔ́ɔ ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā á. Anɔ́ɔ é wóófu iyē kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā le ɔna tá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda kéē nyɔ̄ ga Uráma kéē gaá lɛ ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́cí mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó nɛ̄ Ubássa bī le hɛ́ igá tū Uráma ā kpó wā. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá le odúúdú iyó ā gwó wā ajɛ kú Ujúda á. Anɔ́ɔ Ása kwú iyó ā ú kpó ce igá tū Umíspa mɛ́mla Ugɛ́ba, aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā á.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcánya, Ɛ́sta kahíníī, Usúsa ōfōōfūnū ā, ācɛ Ujíyu ŋmó ācɛ úlā ce ofu ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uháman igwó ā. Ācɛ nēé ŋmó ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā, í gáā lɛ ō jé áluka uwā ŋ́. Ɔdí ɔhá nāa klla gē tíne ɛɛ́? Da um ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nāa tíne ɛ́ɛ́ mā. N géē je ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
idu_Latn: Nááná, ó le um pīyatū, le ulé kú um pīyabɔ̄ igbo igwó. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ kóō yá um ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
idu_Latn: Ó ma uwá tá ipú abɔ̄ kú aéwɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe gē wɔ̄tū uwā ā, gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ íkwu lɛyíkwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, oŋmá ipú ajɛ nēé lɛ ā, é géē je aígelī nɛ̄hi ōhī lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi kéē lā. É klla í je ajɛ ácí nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā í lúúlé pīya yɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi jīla tá lɛ uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálāki da Ubálam kahíníī, A tá ka anúɔ í tókónu lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā ŋ́ mɛɛ́, ámāŋ ā híī hɛ́ ɔhā ce uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn klla ka kpɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔma ka amáŋ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ ā, ɔ́ɔ le ɛbɔ́ je lɛ anúɔ ipú ajɛ ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ í lɛ ɛfú dúúmā nɛ̄ anúɔ gē kpó ipu ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ kú anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ í lɛ olɛlā dúúmā ɔhá nɛ̄ anúɔ gē kpɛfú tú ɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ géē lɛ́ɛcɛ í bū ajī nɛ̄ ó gáā kwú ŋ́ māā? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ce īyī nū ō ga ipú únóji glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um á gēe jɛ̄ gɔbū. É klla géē je ɔ́ gicō klla í lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó odúúdú aɛ́cí kú uwá yíífi dúúdú ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ ɛgwā kú oje udɔ ma, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ɔcí icō. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛgwā lɛ ɔ́ kwú, nɛ̄ ó je eyī gicō lɛ ɛgwā kú oje udɔ ā má, ó géē nyatá ŋmá ɛ́fa kú ɛgwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
idu_Latn: Ukɛdɛssi, Édrēyi, Enhásɔ.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá, ācɛ Ufárisīi! Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka únóji nēé fukɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ í kē jé ɔ́ ŋ́, gē yɛ ɛyí nū gē je iyī uwā tēelihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ aá ŋmá lɛ ō yɔ̄ ī tíne ɛcí nɛ̄ aá í pā ɛɛ́. Náaná aá kē gáā mlɛ́nyɔ̄ ŋ́. Aá gē gbɛlá ka aɛ́cí kú aá ɔ́ɔmā gē je ɔfú lɛ aá á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄jɛ̄ í gē jɛ̄ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
idu_Latn: Īlī ō hɛ́ inu ɛpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā le hɛ́ɛpa ŋmá icō wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Óndú ā nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ klla ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ga uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ujɔ́ni ɛyí hɛ́ ipú agbá ā á.

eng_Latn: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā gē pīya ācɛ ɔtū kéē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɔwɛ nōó wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ka lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā gaá mīyɛ aɛ́ga nēé ī bū behé kú ísu ā, klla kwú ɛga nɛ̄ aácí bū kwu ɔtɔ kú okónu ɔkpá ā ú tū ɔlá ɛɛ́. Ufi lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ipú gbogodo ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
idu_Latn: Ífi eyī géē kwūce ɔhá. Ɔkā kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wā ahɔ̄ kú aá cɔhɔ́ɔ́há. Aá géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ tá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kéē da aá ɛbɛ nēé má ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā í gáā nwū ācɛ íne ā glá gɛ ŋ́. Anyākwɔ́cɛ ā í gáā má ɛlā dúúmā nēé gē nwū ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́ kú ugóolu ā, agege kú nū, odúúdú iyo kú nū mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú agege ā.

eng_Latn: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
idu_Latn: N lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, pīyɛ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔcɛ́, oŋmá lɛ anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ kú um nēé le tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
idu_Latn: Ádā kú Upúbliyɔ̄si gwutá agōdō, ófú mɛ́mla ɔ́fɛ́ɛgbɛ̄ gē yá ɔ̄. Upɔ́lu le yɛ tá ipú inu le ɔkɔ gbā, kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ nyatá.

eng_Latn: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú ajɛ o jīliyē ā mɛ́mla ajɛ ohɛ́wulu ā, ɔlá wā í le yi gaá mɛ, amáŋ Óndú ā, í yɔ̄ ipú ɔlá ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɔlá ā mɛ tāajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja pó ɔkɛlā lígíi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛlā ō ka tū ɔ̄cɛ ahɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka á kwú ɔgbamgbam kú oje u gwū ɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwɔ mla igelī ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ kú oje ā. Lɛ eyī pīya kwu ifotó kú igelī nāa kpó ɔ́ɔmā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ íbɔm ce tū ɔ̄ ā. Ó kē ī wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um ka amíyɔ̄ da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ge je ɛga lɛ aá ká aá je oyēeyī ámāŋ ka ikwū.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á. N bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ká n̄ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son,
idu_Latn: Unún, wɛ ádā kú Ujósuwa.

eng_Latn: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá le okónu ce ga um, Aá lɛ ɔkpá gbo ŋmá iyē kú īkpɛ̄ɛnū nōo gē kwinya nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ulúu kú ipácí, ka aá gáā je unwalu lɛ alɔ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔnyɛ kú īyī alɔ jé kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, a kwú ɔyí omlede ɔ́mpa ā ú gwɛ́ɛya ɔwɛ ékpónú nāa yá ákú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, mɛ́mla ejé ā dúú. Ó géē wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé, ocu kú nū í he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja cɔnya ŋmá ajɛ kú Ɛlam bī ɔyī mɛ́mla ɔtā kú uwá wā. Aícɔ́ɔja klá wā ŋmá ajɛ kú Ukɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́kplɛ́fú kú uwā tútū dúú.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le Usáyɔn fu ɛɛ́, ó kē tíne kóō lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi ó yá ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je Umɔ́dɛkāyi gicō ipú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya lɛ ā, tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya.

eng_Latn: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā ɛgiyí um glá ŋ́ ayíka Ádā nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔ́ pi wā nɛ, anɔ́ɔ n géē je ɔ́ héyī ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But ye have not so learned Christ;
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ī cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́. Anú kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā á.

eng_Latn: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm, Umówābu, Ámɔ̄ri, Utáya, mɛ́mla Usídɔn, bū abɔ̄ kú ācokwɛyí uwā nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā Ujerúsālɛm, ɛgiyí Usedekíya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
idu_Latn: ó gē je uwēyī lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá uwā ōwē klla gē yá kéē móōwē ipú ígbíli icííci ā.

eng_Latn: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ā háyi ɛcɛɛcɛ ɛgoligbó, Umósīsi ōfōōfūnū túbla ódūdū odobū nɛ̄hi ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Umísipa ipú ajɛ Umówābu, gaá da ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu ka anúɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kú ádā anúɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ anúɔ kéē wā í lā mla anú jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá lɛ anúɔ ā má.

eng_Latn: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā miya uwá ɛga ahāapa. Ó ka Ujúda lā ajɛ kú nū o yɛ ga ɛháajɛ ā, Ujósɛ̄fu géē lā ajɛ kú nū o yɛ ga ɛhícō ā.

eng_Latn: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ uculo kú ɛka kú apī ō hɛ́ kpó lɛ Ébrahām á, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ é lɛ Áyísīki ma ā, Ébrahām lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá. Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki le Ujékɔ̄pu ma le ɔ́ apī hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nēe wɛ ohútu kú ipɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ma klla uwá apī kpó hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ pií kóō bɛyíkwu uwɔ, kóō bī unwalu gé lɛ uwɔ. Ipéeyī uwɔ, n géē kpó anyā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔhá. Ɔnyīlɔ ɔ́ɔmā géē cikpó uwā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ gēdēē.

eng_Latn: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ n ka ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔnɔ kú ɔtū nɛ̄ n lɛ ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
idu_Latn: É le ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ le otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufílīstiya ā ŋmó, ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya ɛ́ɛ bá ī wɔ́tū nū ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā cīgwú kú opo kú ɛfu nēé pó ā. É le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu Ugígalu.

eng_Latn: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
idu_Latn: Á jé ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Udéfīdi yēeyī, á gáā wɛ ɔcɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu gbóógbóō ŋ́ nɛɛ? Nyɔ̄ kú ā gaá lɛ ɔɔ́ bī gé um, ó géē kwú piíí.

eng_Latn: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔ́ɔmā pó ā, ó le tá ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí ā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔyí ajɛ kú Uróm nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a lɛ ɔbá igbɛhɔ̄ ɛɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ nāa yɔ̄ mla anú abālɔbányā í kē wɛ ɔbá uwɔ ŋ́. A kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ipú ɛ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
idu_Latn: É ka ipɔ́ɔma ékpónú kóō híī hɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ ŋmá ipú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā ohile ā ŋ́. É ka aá géē dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kéē géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
idu_Latn: Ujádāyi ma ayí ɛhīlī. Iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Urégem, Ujɔ́tam, Ugéssan, Upélēti, Ɛ́fa mɛ́mla Ussaáfu.

eng_Latn: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
idu_Latn: É yá Ubábīlɔn italā ohígbū koó lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔhá ō ŋmó. Ó kē lɛ́pɔ̄bí ācɛ ō ŋmó ɛbɛɛbɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā, a gaá kwú ɔwɛ kú ínoōbīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú. A klla lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ikpó kpó tū ínoōbīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú ō bī. Anɔ́ɔ é yɛce Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Áhābu mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú nū nēe lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá igbīhi í cɛ̄la Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā. A klla kōō le ayínɛ́ abɔ̄yi uwɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi fíyɛ́ uwɔ kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ācɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe gē lɛ okónu nēé ce ā tū ā, ɔtū kú uwā gē he Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ajɛ kú ɛnyā, oōgwōnū kú nū a, odúúdú ɛcɛ i bá ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú ɛbɔ́, klá í gwó ijē kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, ye, nor your fathers.
idu_Latn: N yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ācɛ kú aígelī ɔ́ɔmā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo cɛ̄ gā um le cɔ̄nū. É gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá, klla gbā aɛ́cí, nɛ̄ uwá ámāŋ́ aá ámāŋ́ aádáádā aá í jé jééjéē ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ le aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya wā í le ɛfú kpó gaá gwū Ujúda á. É le Umanásɛ kwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwɔ ú wu ɔ́ ɛnwū klla kwú agbá ú kpó kwu ɔ́ ikpó mla abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī móōwē piyóó āa? Nɛ̄ ágbe kú um ā í gē jé ŋ́ mā a? Ā tíne o lɛ um já kwu ɔwɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nōo ge je ŋmó ɔnɔ̄ ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā lɛ Usɔsténesi, otrɛ̄yí kú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā kwú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíjē iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ Ugalíyo í lɛ ɛlá wu ɛ̄nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kē má abɔ̄ ɔnyōkwū ogbɛhá éyi wā ī kpó andelī ɛpa tū ipú ikpati ɛhi ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá wɛ ɔfiyɛ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ aá wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú Ɔwɔicō. Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá kē wɛ ayí kú nū ā, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Ɔwɔicō géē kpó odúúdú úgwū kú nū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le Urécɛ̄lu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ulában, ɔyínɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā, má mla aálá kú Ulában ā, ó gaá le ɛcɔ̄ ā míya ŋmá okónu obugā ā, klla le éŋkpɔ̄ kpó lɛ aálá kú Ulában le gwá.

eng_Latn: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ okwū kú ádā nū, ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, ámāŋ ɔyínɛ́ nū dóódu. Ó gáā túblá uwá ŋ́. Ó géē je ɔ́ iyē tēelihɔ, ohígbū kaó je iyī nū tá ɛ́yɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yá lɛ ā á. É lɛ uwá kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ uwá bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛfú a yɔ̄ í hɔ́lá kpɔ́ ā, Áhābu gwutá bayi úgbɔ́nya kú nū mla oyī cakpaa lɛ eyī pīya kwu ācɛ Usiríya. Abɔ̄ ɛnɔ le táajɛ ā ó gekwú.

eng_Latn: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi gā ɛgiyí nū ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē á.

eng_Latn: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
idu_Latn: A yúúfi ŋ́, n yɔ̄ pi uwɔ. Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á, ɔdā dúúmā kóō tū uwɔ ufí ŋ́. N géē lɛ ɔfú tū uwɔ iyē klla í tá uwɔ abɔ̄. N géē bī ɔfú kú um le gbō uwɔ klla í cɛ̄ ga uwɔ yálé.

eng_Latn: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le igelī nɛ̄hi ā tɔ̄lá mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, ayíka ɔdā nēé bī oje udɔ, ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ yá ā mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu. É le aɔ́dā e bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpó wā í kpó bá ipú inu, ɛga ō kpó ɔdā agbénú kú Óndú tū ā.

eng_Latn: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú í lɛ unwalu dúúmā ícɛ nyā ɛɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ eko kpiií gbɔbū ka iháyí éyi kóō mɛ́, aá géē bá ī fīyēgbúlú ohígbū ka ɔcí ufáyin í gáā gwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē hɛ́ īkpɔ̄cí lé ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ó wɛ iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó, ó géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá úklɔ́ ō yá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
idu_Latn: Ede o gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá ɛyí nū, mɛ́mla oje udɔ o pla fíílífíílí nēé gē lɛ wu ɔ́ áklō, ogbló kú nū mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū, ɔgbanjɛ o le na abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛga ō háyi kú nū.

eng_Latn: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ aɛ́gba kú nū ī wā ŋmá ipú ajɛ, jāā nɛ̄ aábɔ̄ kú nū kē ī je ŋmókókó ā.

eng_Latn: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó wā í tá alɔ ajɛ Assósi ā, alɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú wā ipú úgbéenyi. Anɔ́ɔ alɔ gā Umitilín á.

eng_Latn: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a tá alɔ nɛɛ? Á gáā nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú mla aícɔ́ɔja kú alɔ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
idu_Latn: Ó kē má eyīgoo yá alɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ uwā ŋ́, amáŋ ó je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū.

eng_Latn: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
idu_Latn: Ń yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ī móōwē, nōo kē hī um igwú kú otábɔ̄ ā ɔdōbɔ̄bí jéjéē ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔgwā le gbo iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ kú Usírīya gaá le ɛfú kpó tá Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm anɔ́ɔ é le uwá yálé klla le ɛyí nɛ̄hi kú uwā kpó ŋmó. É le iyó kú uwā kpó ga Udamáskɔsi.

eng_Latn: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka íne kú Umósīsi ā lɔhi ɔ́dāŋ ka é bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ ɔwɛ nōo cíkā a.

eng_Latn: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um ā yɔ ɛháajɛ ācɛ oliíkwu fíyɛ́ um. N kē lɛ aícɔ́ɔja bá ɛháajɛ um. N gē da ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō gā, ó gē wā. N kē ī da ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kóō nyɔ̄, ó kē ī nyɔ̄. N kē ī da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um kóō yá odée, ó kē ī yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá bī unwalu nyā wā gé lɛ īyī aá á, ohígbū ka aá kwú igbīhi í ce kwu ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ká aá ā. Aá kwúcē hɛ um tá, eko nɛ̄ n kpó aá trɛyí yɔ̄ ī bī aá jé ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
idu_Latn: Ó yá kú ɔkpá kóō le cēenyi ŋmá ipú ɛcɔ̄ ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ. Ó klla yá kú éŋkpɔ̄ kóō pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin ā māháyi le jīla tū Ábna ɛyí ɛfú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
idu_Latn: Ubálāki da Ubálam kahíníī, Wā mla um, ká n̄ lɛ uwɔ bī ga ɛga ɔhá, eko ōhī ó géē he Óndú ā ɔtū ká ā lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gā um ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē bī okoolo újí le miya īkpɔ̄dā lɛ ācɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n géē je yá uwā ɛhi lɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
idu_Latn: Aá má ka ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm le ca aɛ́ga alɛwa. Aá kē le éŋkpɔ̄ kpó tayínū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ō kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū nōo cīce pīyɔ̄ dúú ā, cɛ̄ɛ̄lā mɛ́mla ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ um ba ā. Ó da um ɔ̄kā ka eko nyā nɛ̄ n géē pīyɛyí wā eko nɛ̄ n le yɛ tá abɔ́ɔ ā? N lɛ eko ā ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó le alɔ nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, n kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō piyóo. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú um glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē ci um úklɔ́, nɛ̄ n gē yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ bī gé lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí kóō lɛ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu uwá. Amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ācɛ nēe kpó ayípɛ̄ ā wā ā.

eng_Latn: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ijē ā ú kpó ce ɛyí amɛ̄ ā, kwú uwā í kpó ce ɛyí ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā í kpó yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ā á.

eng_Latn: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā le fō ŋmá ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kóō cikpó ɔ̄cɛnyā ā tá, anɔ́ɔ é gē yúnwū ō cikpó ācɛnyīlɔ ɔ́mpa ūwā á. Ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ bá ī yá ɔdōtūwēyī mla ɔ́mpa ūwā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō í yá uwā ɛdɔ kú italā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔdā nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ācɛ kú uwɔ nyatá, hɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú uwɔ ā. Lɛ pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ a leyīkwu uwá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔ̄nyɛ géē gbɔga ipū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ glá āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē lā ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú uwɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔɔ́ ō yúúfi, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ amānyā tūufi lɛ ā! Amānyā í wɛ ɛga dúú ɔhá gwō inu kú Ɔwɔicō tá ŋ́. Amānyā wɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu yɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ kú ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka tū ipɔ́ɔma kú Áhābu ā. Eko nɛ̄ ó gā abɔ́ɔ ā, ó ma Ahasíya mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda ōhī mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú ádā kú Ahasíya nēe yɛce ɔ́ wā í má Ujóram ā. Ujéhu le odúúdú uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ikpati kú ɛka ā bī wā ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɛgba kú éeyē dɛ̄ nɛ̄hi, nōo le ajɛ jíliyē.

eng_Latn: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Usólōmɔn, ɔyí nū klla lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gwó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da um kahíníī, A géē nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu aéwo alɛwa, ācɛ alɛwa, aúcē alɛwa mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ alɛwa tɛ́ɛcɛ piíí kpɔ́ ɛ́.

eng_Latn: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā géē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ayɔ́kpá nōo yɔ̄ pī ɔwɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɛ́nyɔ́ má ipú kóō yá aólɛlā kú nū lé.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē yá ká ē kpɛ́fú tú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Umówābu nēé cē igá tū uwā gē gbāajɛ nū ā, mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ē lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tjéssīmɔtu, Ubaalmēyɔn mɛ́mla Ukiriyatáyim ā.

eng_Latn: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
idu_Latn: Ó le ka lɛ iyinū ka, Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n kōō lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úwé kú nū kénékēē n géē lɛ ɔbɔ́lā.

eng_Latn: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ kē wɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā? Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēe gē ka ka Ujísɔ̄si í wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ n. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɛ́yíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī je Ádā ā mɛ́mla Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā híhó.

eng_Latn: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
idu_Latn: Icɔ́ɔ́ci ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Icɔ́ɔ́ci ā wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā dúúdú, Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū mīyɛ ɔdā dóódu tābɔ̄ abɔ̄ dóódu ɛga dóodu.

eng_Latn: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
idu_Latn: É kpó anyókwū mɛ́mla ayókwū ŋmó, é klla gē kpó aúgbɔga nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú alɔ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá gā ā, ayíkpó kú nū klla le jīla ipú inu igbɔhá, Utɔ́mɔ̄si kē yɔ̄ mla uwá. Ujísɔ̄si gā kpɔ́ eko nēé lɛ ɔwɛ gwū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā, ó kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
idu_Latn: Gbɛlá ka ā má ɔ̄. Ɔwɔicō je ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ŋmó jéejée ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Kɛ̄ɛ ka a má ɛga nōó je ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ucē olɔhi yíífi jéjée ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá híī mlanyī ɔdā ékpó nyā ŋ́ ācɛ o he um ɔtū, ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā ɛ̄cī éyi lɛbɛ̄ɛka iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó, iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄cī ékpónú ā. Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa wɛ ékpónú tū Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
idu_Latn: Ujē mɛ́mla ukpa bá ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄coyódōbɔ̄bí, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú nū he ɔ́ ɔtū, kóō túblla ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti, mɛ́mla aɔ́nya ɛfú, mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú uwā yíífi ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī nā uwā inya ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó cɛ̄ lɛ ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ tū ipú ɔ́kɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bēhé nyɔ̄ ga Ubɛtisayída nōo yɔ̄ ogbeé ɔhá kú óókpoó ā gbēyī nū, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē nū ɛwa ā ga ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
idu_Latn: Ulé nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē mīyɛ ā, ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā. Ɔdā nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā, nāa gē mīyɛ á.

eng_Latn: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ kpɛ́mm ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔkpíihɔ ā kpó ka lɛ uwá, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔkpá kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
idu_Latn: Náaná, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ami ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ī gbā gā awɔ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n ba uwɔ ā yá gā um.

eng_Latn: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, were there.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, Ɛlkána gē ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū gē ga Ussílo, ɛga nɛ̄ ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi ɛpa, Uhófīni mɛ́mla Ufínīhasi, wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā, gaá gbā Óndú ā nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔhá í yɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā kóō klla gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ukɔ́ra lɛ odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ ā túbá háyi lɛ eyī pīya kwu Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú ɛgahi kú Óndú ā le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ɛgiyí ójila kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ācɛ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā, géē hídáagó kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá uwā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá í yá uwā okónu, klla í yá uwā ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
idu_Latn: Olɔnyɛtum mɛ́mla ɔnyā um, eyī omɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla agbá nɛ̄ a le tɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, kwú um odo ú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
idu_Latn: Eko kú iháyí kú ɔdā ō je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā, é géē je ajɛ ā cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé lá ŋmá abɔ̄ nū aflɛ́yí ā ámāŋ ka ayááyí nū.

eng_Latn: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
