idu_Latn: ka ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú kú aɛ́gɔ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔma ɔ́ gáā má ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu lɛ aádáádā uwā eko eyī ā ɛ́ɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē yɔ̄ gē tá aá ɛlá kwu aɔ́dā nēe bā nyā ojígógó, nááná nɛ̄ aá kōō jé uwā klla kē háyi kpaakpa ipú ɔkwɛ̄yi nēé nwū aá ā.

eng_Latn: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó kwú ajɛ ā ú lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, nōó fūla ɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā gbɔbū ŋ́. É gáā lɛ íkwu ō fūla anú igb ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ox or his sheep go astray, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛla gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ le ɛna ámāŋ, álá kú ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛlu, ɔmáapú uwā, má le hábɔ̄ yɔ̄ gē kwu, kéē híī lɛ eyī gwū ɔ̄ tá ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú gé lɛ óndú nū.

eng_Latn: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.
idu_Latn: Unaómi da Urútu ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi abɔ̄ nɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Ubówāsi gaá yā īkpɔ̄dā mla ācɛnyā ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā. Ó da ɔ́ ka ācɛ ɔ́ɔ lɔfú tínɛ́lā nū eko nɔ́ɔ le yɛ tá ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, ó lɛ ɔcɛ́ éyi nōo lé Ubábīlɔn, nɛ̄ iyē ké nū lé ka Ubɛ́lssása. Ɛ̄cī éyi ó le ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aígabɔ̄ kú nū, úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó kpó hīīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī gwá ejé tɔ̄ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá ayínɛ́ alɔ, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā kóō híīī jɛ̄ aá ɛ̄jɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
idu_Latn: Ó tīile dúúmā ŋ́ ká ā cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī gē yúklɔ́ olɔfú jāā gbó ahāpōtú, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nyɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā, o yá ká ā lɛ ɔdōlé má kwú lé ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū eko nēé ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ Árɔ̄ni ka, eko nɛ̄ó gáā lɛ ɔlá kwu agege ā, kóō lɛ ɔ́ ce ɔwɛ nɛ̄ agege ahāapa ā géē fíyajɛ ga iyɔ̄bū kú ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn da uwá kéē wɛ ayínɛ́ anúɔ, ayí nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ anúɔ ma ā nɛ. Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ keé yɛ í ŋmó ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ nɛɛ, anúɔ í kē yɛ í ŋmó uwā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
idu_Latn: Yá ɔdā lɛ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a dɔɔ̄kā kéē yá ga awɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa kú Ámɔn nēe lā ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā, ɔcɛ́ Usíhɔn kú Uhɛ́ssibɔn mɛ́mla Ógu kú Ubássan, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o lā Ásstārɔtu ā.

eng_Latn: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
idu_Latn: Ugbé kú nū kwu gáyí bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ulóko ā. Íli kú ikpó kú nū kē lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ géē ŋá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, é géē bá ī yúufi, í kē gáā tá ɔ́mpā uwā abɔ̄ glá ŋ. É kē í nyinyi jāā í je pɛ́kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú nū ka Ujósɛ̄fu.

eng_Latn: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
idu_Latn: Aá géē jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú ójīla, ɔdā nōo tīihɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áyísīki le hīlókplícī nōó mɛ́ɛbɛ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ Ísɔ, ɔyí nū ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um! Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
idu_Latn: Aínu kú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dɔ kú ɛplá kú nū wɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla aókómpinu ɔhá ā. Aúwíndo bá ipú aínu kú nū dúú. Odúúdú íkpō kú nū wɛ umíta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄. Ɔwā kú nū wɛ umíta igwó ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem da Ugídīyɔn ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nēé hī aá igwú eko nēé nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Umídiya ā ŋ́ mā? É cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā. Ɔtū kú uwā le bīya.

eng_Latn: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbɛ́nyā ā, aá gáā nwúleyīkwū kwinya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē gbō aá ŋmá áklō dóódu. Ó klla í bī aá jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
idu_Latn: É le tá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gaá ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da Umósīsi kóō lɛ ajɛ je lɛ aá ipú aɔ́máapú ádā uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ úgwū kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je lɛ aɔ́máapú uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ajɛ je lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je lɛ aɔ́máapú uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ tū Umósīsi ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ákú uwɔ lɔhi, awɔ nōo cɛ̄ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu ka anúɔ géē gā awɔ ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔ̄ ɔkwɛyi ā!.

eng_Latn: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu klla kwú odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Áhābu mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū nēe lā Ujésiríili ā ú kpó ŋmó. Ó le aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aóklóbīya nū, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú nū kpó ŋmó dúúdú, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū géē mafú lɛ ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ wɛ idáagó lɛ āa, ó géē yá lɛ ā bōōbū.

eng_Latn: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔnyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōo yá eko kú Unówa ā.

eng_Latn: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ábīja ɔyí kú Ujérobōwam gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē.

eng_Latn: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, uwá nēe wɛ ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, kéē lɛ ɔtū kpóce Ɔwɔicō kú ūwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē ga ɛgiyí nū. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ abɔ̄ bī ihɔtū mla ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbēyī Ɔwɔicō kú ūwā cíí.

eng_Latn: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sra le íne ā jé lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpá ā. Ó le eyī pīya kwu ɛyíyɔ́pu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Okómpinu kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ó jé ɔ̄ ŋmá ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī gbó ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā kē le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
idu_Latn: ɔ́ɔ jé ka ohígbū ɛfú nɛ̄ ádā anúɔ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í kpó ojigógó ā, ɔ́ɔ gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā glá ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū ā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi kú Umówābu mɛ ɛɛ́. Aólɛlā a mīyɛ Uhɛ́sbɔn, klla lɛ ujɔ̄ tū ō je Umówābu yíífi ɛɛ́. Igelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú aójɛɛ́lɛ́ ā géē tá hímm, Aícɔ́ɔja ā gē cētū lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi gē kpó ɔlɛ́ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ uwá gē kwú ikwū agbaagbɔ gbɔbū lɛ eko kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
idu_Latn: Koócōō, lɛ ahɔ̄ je lɛ uwá ɔkpáncō, ká ā kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká a kwú uwá ú kwúcē wā ajɛ nɛ̄ a je lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kóō le odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū Usáyɔn ā yálé, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwá nū nyɔ̄ ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwū ɛɛ́ mā í gē lɛ ɛlá wū ɔdā nōo gē yá ācɛ ipíinu kú nū, eko nōó gekwú hɛ̄ uwá tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú, yɔ̄ ī túgagá ga ɔwɛ ga ácí ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā jé īyī uwá ŋ́ ohígbū ɛfú nɛ̄ n gáā tū ācɛ nyɔ̄ gáā kpó tú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, A le hīla ɛɛ́, ayí uwɔ í yɛce ɔwɛ kú uwɔ̄ ŋ́, abālɔbányā, lɛ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ alɔ kóō gbō alɔ bɛ̄ɛka odúúdú aéwo ɔhá nēe lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm géē nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí aɛ́cí nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá ā, nyɔ̄ í jikwū klá uwá kéē tá uwā abɔ̄. Amáŋ aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā í gáā lɔfú hɛ́ uwā tá eko nɛ̄ unwalu gā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē kɔkɔ kú ɔdā nēé yá ā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo le tútū ō hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ oyēeyī mla ācɛ o gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā mla ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi, amáŋ, ń nyīleyī ŋmá íne kú uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
idu_Latn: É gē dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ka ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā. Ka itene nyá nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ géē le ŋmá lɛ ɔkɔ ō gbā lɛ ɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa nɛ̄hi gaá le jīla Ujerúsālɛm ipú ɔyā ɔ́mpa ā kéē gaá lé ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄cɛ o dɔlɛ́ éyi nēé hī ka Ulífāyi má cīce ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛga nōó ī yúklɔ́ kú nū ā. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um.

eng_Latn: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ tá ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ussɛ́kɛm, le ikpō kú ufáyin kú uwā kpó hɛ́, le ejé yá ŋmá anú, klla le ucɛ yá. É le tá ipú agbla kú ɛcí kú uwā gāá le lé, klla le gwá, klla kɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kū ācɛ kéē géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú ipú ɔkpá íne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ Uhilikáya, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā pīyɛ̄ ā, Ujosíya le odúúdú aɔ́hɛ, ācɛ ogwɛ́bá mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛcí mɛ́mla ede kú ɛcí, mɛ́mla ojibó kú ɛcí nēé gē gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā kpɛ́m ā kpó ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
idu_Latn: Tá alɔ abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu aólɛlā kú alɔ, ohígbū ka otábɔ̄ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ wɛ áncā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, oŋmɛ́yí kú éwo kú uwā éyi ga ɔhá, le jé ka Usámūwɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yɔ̄ í yá ā, Unehemíya ka anúɔ í yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́, ohígbū ka ipú iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ Átasásɛsi cɔcɛ́ ā, n kwúcē ga ɛgiyí nū gaá ka lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ yɛ í kwu lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je eko ga um lɛ ā. Eko kpií ā, n mīyɛ ɛga ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
idu_Latn: Olagwú ā géē lɛ áhingílí wiyē klla í mā īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū tá kóō wá ɔ̄ ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó g­ē leyīkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ó géē lɛ odée klá eyī jāā kwu ákpókónu ɛhícō, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɔdēelihɔ, ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ eko a gā, kéē i je ajɛ ā cīgbīhi lɛ ācɛ kú Óndú ā, odóódu kú aá í gáā lɛ ukpɛ̄ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je aúcɛ kú nū mla aúcɛ kú iháyí iháyí mɛ́mla aúcɛ kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā mla éeyē ō gwó kú ɛ̄cī usábāti kú uwā bī wā oŋmɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n gā ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ n le da uwá ka, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu aá, nɛ̄ é lɛ ɔ̄kā da um ka, Ɔdí wɛ iyē nū ā? Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē ka lɛ uwá āa.

eng_Latn: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
idu_Latn: Ó yá kú ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā, kóō yɔ̄ ī wu gicō bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí kú ɔnya ā. Ó yá kú ɛfu kú Uhɛ́mɔn kóō yɔ̄ ī tá ómbli bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛyī ā.

eng_Latn: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é yɔ̄ gē kpɛ́fú ipú ajɛ ā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ā á. Ipú ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í bī ɔkplɛfú ámāŋ ka óbōŋ.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
idu_Latn: Ámíyā géē yá uwɔ, nɛ̄ imabɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā í kē gáā ci ɔ̄ ō wā glá ŋ́. Ámíyā nɛ̄hi géē yá uwɔ acígilí. Ó gáā le ɛdɔ imabɔ̄ dúú nɛ̄ a í yá nōo lɔfú ci ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ ōwē ā gē pi uwá abɔ̄fú kéē ma áluka kú ubulɔ́kwu nēé tɛtɛ ī ma ɛ̄cī dóódu bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti tɛtɛ ī kpó ácí ihili lɛ uwá abɔ̄yī uwāā.

eng_Latn: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē kpó uwā ga ipú ajɛ olɔhi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu lɛ aádáádā uwā lɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ í má ɛdɔ ɔdōlé dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ dɔɔ̄kā í lé. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lā gbiyēnɛɛ. Ó ka amáŋ ɛ́ɛ í nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē tá anúɔ klla í bīya ɛka kú anúɔ mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le Ujɛhóyāda mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya o hile ā kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Oŋmífi iháyí ofu ce ɛtá nyā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá tá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá ɛga dúúmā ŋ́ mā a? Aá híī mīyɛ ije dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá bī gɛ ŋ́. Ije dúúmā nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ā, aá kwú kpó wā, kú aá bī le tá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá.

eng_Latn: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā ɛpa éyi bá.

eng_Latn: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, n̄ da aá ka é géē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ɔkpáncō ohígbū ɔ̄cobīyíne ékpó nōo le pīyabɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ācɛ olɔhi ofɛnɛ cigwáahāanɛ nēé cɛgbá ō pīyabɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka a lɛ íkwu je lɛ ɔ́ kóō gbō ācɛ dóódu ā, kóō je oyēeyī opiyóó lɛ ācɛ dóódu nāa kpó lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn á. Ācɛ ā le uwá kpó tōlī ɛyí ɛfu ipéyī Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ uwá ahāhílahāapa ā le pɛ́ gekwú tɔ̄há. É kpó uwā ŋmó ɛpléeko nēé gē gbɔɔ́ ō cē īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé hī ka Ubáli ā.

eng_Latn: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō ékpónú yɔ̄ á, aá yá lɔhi. Aébilíi kē cɛ̄ lɛ ā, klla kē ī yúufi nū ī fīyégbúlú dúú.

eng_Latn: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó gaá kwú ikpó ú ce agidigbé kú inu gáā ticō ā, aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú ɔ̄ ú cɔɔkɔ ohígbū ka ɛwa ā í tōō kwútū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le ohi tá ɔ̄ dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n yá bɔ̄bí ā ɔkpani? Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka anúɔ í má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí um ŋ́, ŋmífī nɛ̄ n gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ jāā í kwu ícɛ ā. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ń gáā nyɔ̄ mla awɔ, ɔkpáni um mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú um gaá kpɛ́fú tá aólɛlā kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ipú iyē kú uwā ā lɛ ɔ́ má nɛɛ, é gē gwōnū iyɔ̄bū nū ī dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Awɔ ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
idu_Latn: Useráya, Asárīya, Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ípɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi eee! Aá yá ka aá hɛ́pɔ̄ kpaakpa ɛ̄cī dóódu. Aá lɛ ācɛ nēé gē pīyatū ā hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gē pīya uwá tū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yá lɛ a ŋ́, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ká n̄ cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo gáā loō mɛ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄hi nōo ī yi nōó tōō nyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
idu_Latn: Aá í yá ɛ̄nyā mɛ́mla ɛya kú ejé, mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛ̄cī dóódu kú aá.

eng_Latn: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa ā wɛ ákú Ahíra, ɔyí kú Ɛ́nan ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka amáŋ, ihɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ lɛ ádáádā uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá kóō lɛ uwá fu, ikɔkɔ ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ó da uwá ka uwá ɛ́ɛ kē wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ fu ā á.

eng_Latn: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti tɔ́kpá nyá gé lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ipú icɔ́ɔci kú Utesaloníka nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá híīī mīyɛ ɔdā dúú ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ íne ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.
idu_Latn: N pó uya ce ɛyí aɛ́fu gbōō. Uya ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ikwū nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī je, bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū ka é le igbīhi cē kwu Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: N le iŋini ká ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā pó ɛɛ́. Le ka lɛ uwá ka ipú ajɛ odobū fulufulu kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, é géē lɛ ɛbɛ́. Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, é géē lɛ igbō nōo í nū uwā ipú. Anɔ́ɔ é géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛ ɔmáapú nōo í lá ajɛ cīgbīhi ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ ā lɔfú je gbagbénú ɛ̄cī éyi glá, nōó lɔfú lá ɔdāyīnū cīgbīhi glá.

eng_Latn: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
idu_Latn: Aá mabɔ̄ ɔnɔɔtū, ɔtūkpoókpoó, mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū tá. Aá kē mabɔ̄ ɛgba ō dɛ̄ tū ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛcá ō cá uwā, mɛ́mla obɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ ō ka tá.

eng_Latn: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɛlá koó le kpaakpa, amáŋ, ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɔfú ŋmɛ́yí ɔlékwū glá.

eng_Latn: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ mīyɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā, alɔ jé péee ka alɔ géē mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu ka anúɔ í je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā alɔ jé lɔfú péee ka Ɔwɔicō géē yá ká ālɔ̄ wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔdā dóódu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipū ā kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔ̄coŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nū nyɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ábsālɔm le kwu ɛɛ́. Ícɔ́ɔ́ja nōo gē gbāajɛ ā le ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ má bá ī wúlatū wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛfu kú Uhoronéyim ā. Anɔ́ɔ ícɔ́ɔja ā le tá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi gaá le ɔdā nōó má ā ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, n kwú īlī kú um hīla ipú ɔtūnōbí klla kwú ɛyí mɛ́mla ɔnwú agba kú um ú plla. Anɔ́ɔ n má cīce ipú ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ɔtū nōo bīya gā um ā.

eng_Latn: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile tine ō lɛ ukpa jē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā ohídáagó éyi yá lɛ aá ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ á. É géē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē ī héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛta piíí.

eng_Latn: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ogbɛnú kú aócíbú kú ugóolu ā ke lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ā.

eng_Latn: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipú ācɛ nēe bá gē lé ɔdōlé mla anú ā í jé ɔdā nōo yá nōó kɛlā nyā lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
idu_Latn: Usálmɔ̄n nōo ŋmá Ahohi ā. Umahárīya nōo ŋmá Unetófa ā.

eng_Latn: And all the men were about twelve.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka igwɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
idu_Latn: Álá nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā nāa géē ŋmó á. Lɛ ɔlá gwó tū ɛ̄hī ɔkwu cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla íkpokwú ā kā é wú, klla le jé.

eng_Latn: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm kwú Amása ú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwɛyí Ujówābu, nōo nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ á. Amása wɛ ɔyí kú Ujéta ɔ̄cɛ Íssmɛ̄lu ā. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū lé ka Abígɛ̄ɛlu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Unáhāsi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Userúya, ɛ́nɛ́ Ujówābu.

eng_Latn: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyī ā kpó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyī ā kpó á. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔyī ā tá kwu ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔyī ā tá kwa ajɛ igbɛ ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú nū Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni le ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Óndú, a tíne kú alɔ lɛ ɔlá hīgwú ŋmá ɔkpáncō kóō lɛ uwá yi nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē má ɛnyá kú īyī nū ŋ́. Óndú, le um hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛnyá kú um nɛ̄ ń jé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi únóji kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ayí nū klla jikwū nū gē ka kahíníī, Kpái, ɔyínɛ́ um, ɔyínɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nēe bá ikpó ɛfu ā wɛ, Ɛssitáyɔlu, Usóra, Ássīna.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko kpiī le yɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe gē yá igbō lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɔdā iwɔ́tū yá ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hɛ́ igá olɔfú tū uwā kú Udíbɔn, Atárɔ̄tu mɛ́mla Árōwɛ.

eng_Latn: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kpó aɔ́dā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ ī ŋmó uwā ā kéē lé, klla ī nū ācɛ olɛ agbénú ā nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ áncā.

eng_Latn: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá abɔ́ɔ. É klla le ācɛ ɛpa ɔhá nyɔ́kpá mla anú, ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá yɔ̄ abɔ̄lúfīyē.

eng_Latn: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le tá ɛcɛ ā, ó má ɔfiyɛ ɔ́mpa nū ɔhá nōo bī ɔ̄ ijē bɛ̄ɛka úlā ɛhɔ̄ ā. Ó lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɔkɔ, gbɔɔ́ ō pi ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ulé nɛ̄ a bī um ā cílá.

eng_Latn: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā yá ā. Ó gē gbēyī eko nōó géē yá uwā italā ā.

eng_Latn: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
idu_Latn: N jé, ɔkpani um, ka n le ɔ́bíipú bī tú uwɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nēe wā í jīla Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ɔwɛ ícɛ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka odúúdú aígelī nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā, é le igá kú ɔdɔ nōo lɛ icō nɛ̄hi hɛ́ tū uwā. Odúúdú uwā lɛ aódōngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú oje mɛ́mla aógbló kú oje o cíla aódōngwɔ̄ɔwɛ ā kpɛ́mm. Ó lɛ aípɔ́lɛ́ alɛwa ɔhá bá abɔ́ɔ nēé hɛ́ igá tū uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a í gbō um, klla ī hɛ́ um tá. Ɛlá nāa le kwu um ā, kwú um pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́. Ɔfú kú uwɔ kē lɛ um tū ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú nɛ̄hi. A klla lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ igbo igwó kpó mɛ́mla owunā mɛ́mla ɔjá kú ɛnwú ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē da ɔ́ ɔdā nōo géē yá ɔyí ā.

eng_Latn: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá aólɛlā kú lé á, ālɔ̄ lé ucɛ, kú ālɔ̄ gwéeyē ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā nōo ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ámāŋ yɔ̄ í cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nōo lɛ odée klá ɛyí gē je uwēyī lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nyā bá ipú ígwu kú um dúú. É wɛ Ɛlíyākim, Umáasēya, Uminiyámin, Umikáya, Ɛlíyōnāyi, Usekaríya mɛ́mla Uhananíya bá í tá opo dúú.

eng_Latn: And give occasions of speech against her, and bring up an evil name upon her, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I found her not a maid:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ká bá ɔnyā ā ka, eko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ ā, anúɔ má ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jé gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wā ɔlɛ́ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le tá Ubáalu Upérāsim gaá lɛ ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya yálé abɔ́ɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú ā le bū ipú aólɛlā kú um ga um bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo le cēenyi wā í yɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, o kwú iyē ce abɔ́ɔ ka Ubáalu Upérāsim .

eng_Latn: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ā híīī bī alɔ ga ipú ojámá nɛ̄hi ŋ́, Amáŋ lɛ alɔ nyatá ŋmá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ára wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwáahātá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá le Alelékwū Ihɔ ā cē klá aá bɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú aá kē jé ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
idu_Latn: N le ka kahíníī, N géē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n géē yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ígblɛ́nyī kú um kóō cɛ̄ gā um bīyíne ŋ́. N géē klá okónu kú um cíí ká n̄ kɛlā dúúmā, eko nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā bá ajaajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī alɔ nēe bá ipú úgbéenyi ā wɛ ācɛ ofigwɛ́tá cigwɛ́hīlī.

eng_Latn: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra anú, é kē í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́. Óndú ā tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lɛwa fíyɛ́ dúú ā le yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu gaá le īyī uwā kɔ̄ ígwíígwu Ubáaltáma ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe tayínū yɛ jīla Ugíbɛ̄ya tá ā, le tá bɛ̄cɛ pláka acígilí ŋmá ɛga nēé tayínū kú uwā ipú ɛcɔ̄ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔ́bíipú nēé géē bī eko dóódu. É gē méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
idu_Latn: É géē kpó ajɛ tū ɔpɛ́ dóódu, kóō le mu ɔ́, é géē cīla ɛfu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛfu nɛ̄hi tū piíí. É géē nā ɔwɛ okwúgɔ̄kwugɔ̄ kpaakpa piíí é kē géē cīla ɔwɛ okplókōkplokō tū kóō le yá mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ piíí.

eng_Latn: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usɔ́lu mla ācɛ a mā Ágāgi, mɛ́mla aálá, aɛ́na, mɛ́mla aómlede olɔhi tá oyēeyī, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā olɔhi ɔhá dóódu. Ó wɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā ā nɛ̄ ó kpó yíífi ā ŋ́. Aɔ́dā nēé lɔhi ŋ́ nēé klla kē tū ile ŋ́ má, nēé kpó yíífi á.

eng_Latn: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro le ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ Umósīsi ŋmó. Amáŋ, Umósīsi le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū le yɛ gaá lā ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Umídiyan.

eng_Latn: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa da aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, mɛ́mla Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī bī ɔkpá nyā wā oŋmɛ́yí abālɔbányā ā, ayínɛ́ um, aá ńŋmóō! Aá nya kú aá lɛ ɛnyá ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā ŋ́. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū aá ā. Aá cɛ̄ɛlā kú iyī aá. Aá lā ɛbɔ́ mla iyī aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō nōo yíhɔtū tá alɔ nōo klla ī yá kú alɔ lɛ ɛbɔ́ ā géē yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
idu_Latn: N géē je ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ olɔhi lɛ uwá, nōo géē yá ká ɔkpɛtā kú ō ŋmó uwā ɔhá gɛ ŋ. Aéwɔhá ā, í gáā yá uwá eyī ŋɔɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
idu_Latn: Ami Uyáwɛ, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka aá gbɛlá ka Áhāabu, ɔyí kú Ukoláya mɛ́mla Usedekíya, ɔyí kú Umaásēya ɛ́ɛ́ wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ abɔ̄ é bá ī bī iyē um kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ aá ā. N géē kpó uwā tū Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, abɔ̄. Ó kē í kpó uwā ŋmó ipééyī aá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a húmáyī yá um ka n̄ móōwē ɛ̄cī odunkwulu. É kē ī yá um italā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
idu_Latn: bū Ubɛti Uhɔ́gla. Ɛjī kú ɛháajɛ ā gaá ŋmɛ́yí ɛga nɛ̄ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gaá pɛ́ tū ipú ísu Ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō kú ádā um, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki í yɛce um ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔkwɔɔkwɛyi á géē yɛ í lɛ um nū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ abɔ̄ áncā. Ɔwɔicō le ōwē mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú abɔ̄ kú um má, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nōó ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí otú ɛ́nɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujóbu le kpaakpa, í klla yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ tū īyī nū ā, aóklóbīya nū ɛtá ā mā ō tá ɔ̄ ohi.

eng_Latn: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé wā kéē má Ujísɔ̄si ā, é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí alɛwa ipú nū ā má. O cīce abɔ́ɔ lɛ úwé wiyē, eyī klla le gbo ɔ́ gɔɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le kpó hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́ga nɛ̄ ayááyí kú Áyísīki gē gwɛ́ɛya ā, géē je gblífi tāajɛ. É géē kpó aɛ́ga o tīihɔ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpɛ́mm ā yíífi. N kē í héyī kwu ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ujérobōwam, ɔcɛ́ jāā gbēeko nēé lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɛya kú aɔ́bá ɛna, ákú aómlede ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
idu_Latn: N yá aá lɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē nyi īkpō kú ɔcí Ufáyin nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ó lɛ ā ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá je pīya aɛ́flɛ́ɛfu bɛ̄ɛka īkpō kú ɔcí ufáyin kú ipácí nōó lɔhi ŋ́ mā āa.

eng_Latn: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá cíka ō lā ipú ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ aá gwó lɔɔlɔhi ā, nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā kē le catāajɛ kpɔ́ ā?.

eng_Latn: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ, ń má ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́, n tíne nū, amáŋ ń pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé dɔɔ̄kā ɔcɛ́ á, Ɔwɔicō kwú Usɔ́lu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukíssi, ɔ̄cɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn, ú lɛ uwá. Ó gbō uwā iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó klla le jé ka Umɔ́dɛkāyi ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā, ó le tútū kóō yá ɔdā ɔhá fíyɛ́ ō yá Umɔ́dɛkāyi ōfōōnū italā. Ó le miya kóō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá odúúdú ajɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɔ́dɛkāyi ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Amáŋ n má ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ le wī bá ī yāwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔlá ā, ɔlá ā í kē yá uwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Oōmá kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyí kú ɔwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bū ajɛ kú uwā ŋ́ mā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pīyeyī, nyɔ̄ í le yɛ ɔwɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ó wā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya éyi nēé hī ka Usáyíka, kwu ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu je lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū Ujósɛ̄fu ā.

eng_Latn: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā léka é gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, nááná ā, é gē pā ɛcí kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē kú aéwo nēé kpó uwā ŋmá wā ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ̄kā da uwá kahíníī, Aá jɛyí ita nya ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔwɛ nyá, nɛ̄ aá géē jɛ́ɛyí ita dóódu gílá ā gɛ.

eng_Latn: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ kú aflɛ́yí ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā. Ɔ́mpa ā gbla ɔbɛ́ɛna. Ɔ́mɛtá ā lɛ eyī nōo gbla ákú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā. Ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā gbla okpé nōo yɔ̄ gē wu ā.

eng_Latn: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā kú ɛya nēé géē yɔ̄ ī gwó ɛ̄cī dóódu, nēe géē je ɔ́ yɔlá dúúdú, nēé kē wɛ ɛya nēé gwó aflɛ́yí ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi, nɛ̄ ocu kú nū he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ga ipú ɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ ga ɛháajɛ le tá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nēé cē igá olɔfú tū ɔ̄ nēé hī ka Utáya ā. É klla yɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá aígelī kú ācɛ Uhám mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ Ukénan. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá le iyāwu kú uwā ŋmɛ́yí ipú ajɛ kú Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n kwú mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ga awɔ eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā, klla lɛ um yá cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla odúúdú ucē ō yá kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā mla ɔdā dóódu nāa yá ā. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n cílá ulé kú odúúdú nū á. Ɔdí yá nāa klla nyɔ̄ ī gbaajā kwu odúúdú ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi ɔhá nāa yɔ̄ ī yá āā? Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ihɔtū á, ó wɛ ka alɔ yíihɔtū tū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, amáŋ anú yíihɔtū tū alɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó tū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ kóō le pīya iyó ōgwu inyílɔ́lɛ́ kú alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í kɛlā mla ayínɛ́ nū ā, Ugolíyāti kú Ugáti kwú bɛ̄cɛ, wā í cá ɛcá ɛdɔ ékpónú nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē cá ā, anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔkɔ kú nū pó á.

eng_Latn: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēe gāājɛ ā, é lɛ ācɛ kú icɔ́ɔci ā hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī uwā yá ā kpó ka lɛ uwá, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ aílɔ́wá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otú le bī ā, ɔ́kɔ ā yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ óókpoó ā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ajɛ ɔlamu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá mɛ́mla ɔnyā, aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔlɛ́ aá, aá cíkā ō yɛ yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ o gwutá mla anú ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kwú kwu ŋmá Ugáti abɔ́ɔ, le tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōo kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Adulám ajaajɛ ā. Eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū o hile le pó ka, ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, é le pɛ́ wā í bá mla anú.

eng_Latn: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, É géē kpó odúúdú anyā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ ā ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ubábīlɔn. Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā í gáā kwu hɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́. Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn géē kwú uwɔ alagbá, é kē í je igelī nyā tū ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō nyīla bá ɛbɛɛbɛ kú ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā, é kē bá ī ma ayínɔ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka, Ɔwɔicō gē nwū odúúdú uwā odée. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛlā kú Ádā ā pó nōo klla lɛ ɔ́ jé, géē wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
idu_Latn: Ó klla dɔɔ̄kā ō lɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi kú nū ā kɔ̄ mla alɔ nōó ményinyi alɔ ā. Alɔ nōó le tútū kóō kɔ̄ ɛgahi mla ojīlīmā kú nū mla alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
idu_Latn: A híī dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔdíya nɛ̄ eko íkée ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ abālɔbányā ā ŋ́. ohígbū ka, íjééyī dúúmā ī yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄kā nāa da nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujéhu le ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujɛ́robōwam bī tū Óndú ā nɛ̄ ó klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ā bī. Ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ojibó kú ɛna ɛpa nɛ̄ Ujɛ́robōwam ma, kpó ce Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla Udán ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
idu_Latn: N lɔfú ka n géē je éwo amáŋ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ éyi fu ŋmá ajɛ, je ɔ́ catāajɛ, klla í je ɔ́ yíífi.

eng_Latn: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíya nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá nyā ōfōōfūnū kwúcē wā í tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n tɔ́kpá nyā fu aá eko nɛ̄ ń yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́ mā á. Ó lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká eko nɛ̄ n gaajɛ ɛgiyí aá, ká n̄ híīī bī ɔfú nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ga um ā le lɔnɔ ɔtū lɛ aá ŋ́. Ɔfú ā wɛ ká n̄ bī ɔ̄ le yá kú aá jɛ̄ gicō. Ó wɛ ka n̄ bī ɔ̄ le híla aá tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujɔ́tam yá ā, é le uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ o lɛwa nɛ̄hi tū wā í kwú ɔlɛ uwā ú wúlatāajɛ igbledū, nɛ̄ íbáā gē dɛ̄ ipú aɔ́lɛ́ uwā. Kóō le lɛ ā ohígbū kéē lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bu tá gā um ká n̄ míya tá ɔ́, klla lɛ ukpa kpla táajɛ gā um kóō lɛ um kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, ŋ́ŋmá, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nēé gbā gā uwɔ ā ɔkpáncō ɛga nɛ̄ a lā ā, ká ā méyīnyinyi uwā.

eng_Latn: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛyíkwu ɛka ō gbo ā wɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nyā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a kwú pīya olɛlā kú um, lɛ um gbō, nɛ̄ n kwú nyinyi hile ikpokwú mɛ́mla ɔkpá ōfōōfūnū ɛɛ́. Ācɛ bī ɔ́ɔmā í cījáalí tū um ka amīyɔ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Ka amíyɔ lé ɛpɔ̄bí kú ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í má ā á.

eng_Latn: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú le uwá kpó wā ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, nēe lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ācɛ ā kpɛ́fú tá uwā, amáŋ é le ācɛ ā yálé, klla mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā. Óndú ā klla le uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aójibó kú ɛcí kú nū ā ca tāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Ɔlá géē je aɔ́dā dóódu nēé í je lɛ aákwuna kú ikpɛ́cí ā kpó yíífi. Odúúdú aójibó kú ɛcí kú igelī ā í je pīya eyētutulu ipú alácɛ̄. Usamérīya ī cɛgbá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ohígbū kóō bī ɔ̄ le yá uculo kú ɛcí ō pā kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ aólɛlā kú uwā ā géē kpó uwā ga ɛga ɔhá gaá yá akwuna kú ikpɛ́cí.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, jāhɔ̄ gā um, ká ā pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú, éeyē nāa je gā um ā, fíyɛ́ éeyē nēé lɛ eko nēé lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā cɛ̄tra ɛ̄nyā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔdā nōó yá ā yɔ̄ á. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, é bū ígbíli gaá bū ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ gā Ukɛ́dɛssi.

eng_Latn: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī tū iyi uwɔ kwu ɔ̄cā icííci nōo ge bɛ́yí kwu ɔkōolɔhi ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cā nēé tīile nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī cā ŋ́ mā. Yɔ̄ gē kllɔcɛ́ ká ā yɔ̄ ī nū iyē daa ipú alelékwū o yá ká ā géē lā oyēeyī olɔhi kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
idu_Latn: Ubatisséba túkpɛɛ́ lɛ okónu hɛ́ tū ɔcɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne ka anúɔ yá lɛ ɔ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē má ka, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē fu kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā, géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē fu lɛ uwá. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔyí ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī je éwɔhá lé ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
idu_Latn: A yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ipú ɔ́sú nāa ī tá ā jāā nāa kwú ɛga ōgbā ɔkɔ kú uwɔ ā ú nyílá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ ɔlá tū klá igelī kú uwɔ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ piíí, kwú ɔ̄ ú yi tāajɛ. Ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī má uwɔ ā, a kwú yi kwú gbo ewo dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ uya kú ajī ɛbɛ́, opo, ɛ̄ngwū ɔgalúmpɛ̄, ufíyé, áma, mɛ́mla uba, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō bī gwíijē dóódu ā pó ā, odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aéwo mɛ́mla ucē dóódu túkpɛɛ́ le ɛ̄gbā gbā ojibó kú Unebúkádinēsa, nōó ma kwu ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń tíne ká n̄ kpó eko kú uwɔ bónū gɔbū gɛ ŋ́ mā, n gē ba uwɔ ká ā bī ogbonɛnɛ kú uwɔ lɛ ɔkɔ kú alɔ nyā pó lígíí lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
idu_Latn: Óócí ɛpllá eko nyā, n géē tū ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɛhɔ̄ fu uwɔ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ubénjamīn, a géē lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó géē hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya. Ohígbū ka n le ōwē kú uwā má ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ikwū nēé je ā, gā ɛgiyí um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam ka, ānyɛ wɛ ācɛ nēé bá ī túbá ɛhíícō yɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú nū le aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ó gē ma ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́ mā fú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó fu ā. Ó ma ɛdɔ kú ihɔtū ɔ́ɔmā fú lɛ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ayááyí nū piyóó.

eng_Latn: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ mīyɛ ɛga ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ ka anúɔ tá ācoyúklɔ́ ā igbīhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ yā īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo géē hɛ́ ācɛ o cɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā abɔ̄ wāajɛ ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ húmáyī ī yúklɔ́ ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā kwu eko nyā. Ka, oklɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ nɔ́ɔ gáā mlɛ́nyɔ́ lígíí ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ á.

eng_Latn: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
idu_Latn: Kó ō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ɔdōbɔ̄bí, kóō yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi. Kóō cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um í kē gáā gbō um ɔwɛ dóódu glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka n lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ okwápī ōhī bá lɛ ā ŋmá eko nēé ma uwá. Ācɛ okwápī ōhī nēé bá uwā udá kē bá. Ācɛ ōhī bá nēé kē lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́ ohígbū ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú mīyɛ ɛlā nyā glá kóō mīyɛ.

eng_Latn: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo gēe wɛ Ihɔtū kú nū a, wɛ ō yá ufi Óndú āmla ɛyí oōtá ajɛ la Óndú a.

eng_Latn: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unáaman le yɛ mla aɔ́nya, mɛ́mla ugbɔ́nya kú nū gaá māháyi okómpinu ɔlɛ́ Ɛláyíssa.

eng_Latn: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔyá ahāapa ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ uwá dóódu. Ɛ̄cī éyi kú ɔyá ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, odúúdú ācɛ ā gaá le jīla ɔpu kú ɔwɛ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā kú Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ é da Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo klla jé íne nɛ̄hi ā, kóō kwú íne kú Óndú ā nōó je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ā, ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú īkpīje ofu cigwó ā ú gbā tū ɛga o kpíje tū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ikpīje ofu cigwó nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɛlá ka ó cíkā lɛ úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá ā í pīya tú ipú ɛkpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yúklɔ́ lɔfú ā gē gbiyɔ̄lā lɔhi otú glá, nááná nēé lɔfú má ɔdōlé lé nīipú glá, ámāŋ ka é lɔfú má lé nīipú glá ŋ mā. Amáŋ agbénú kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔdu ā, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gbiyɔ̄lā otū glá ŋ́. Ó yɔ̄ ī junwalu lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
idu_Latn: Ujówābu mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá abɔ́ɔ ɔyā ɛhīlī jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwa kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, aólɛlā kú um bá ī nuunu tú um. Uwá nēe bá ī nuunu tá um ā lɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nū le ɔnyā lɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
idu_Latn: A í fu aígabɔ̄ ɔhá nēe leyīkwu ajɛ ā, é kē í mīyɛ ɛga eyí ŋmá ɛga ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nōo í yá ɛplá iháyí ahāapa kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cabá ā.

eng_Latn: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
idu_Latn: N tɛtɛ pó ɔdā alɛwa ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gbɔbū ɛɛ́. Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gē tá um ɔtū lé ā, aá bá ī cɛ̄ ga um má ɔnɔ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, wɛ eko kú ofū nɛ̄hi. Ɔcɛ́ ā cīce inū nɛ̄ ó ī yɔ̄ eko ofū ā iyɔ̄bū ɔlá.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko géē wā nēé gáā hī amānyā ka ɔpɛ́ kú Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti ámāŋ ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínɔm ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, é géē hī amānyā ka ɔpɛ́ nēé ī hɛ́ ācɛ ā ɔkɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nyi, Óndú ā géē yá ka ɔwɔ kóō yā tū ɔ̄ɔ̄. Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá í yá lɔɔlɔhi nɛ̄ aá géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú aá kē í má ácí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi í lé.

eng_Latn: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne, nɛ̄ Umósīsi je lɛ alɔ ā, Anú wɛ agbénú nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔtū lé ká ā lɔfú tīyē, ohígbū ka awɔ gáā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē lé úgwū kú ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ūnū lɛ aádáádā uwā ā á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ōwē nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá gē má, nēé má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ō tá uwá abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔ̄cɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Usiríya ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ísrɛ̄lu má bá ɛbɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ bá ā.

eng_Latn: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
idu_Latn: Ádā! A le uwá kpó gā um ɛɛ́, n tínē kéē bá mla um ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā kú um nāa je gā um ā má ohígbū ka a yíihɔtū tū um gbɔbū nēé yá ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father's house?
idu_Latn: Aíjakī kú uwɔ nēe bī ícɛmɛtá ā, kóō híī je unwalu gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka é le uwá pīyɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce Ísrɛ̄lu ɛgbá abālɔbányā fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nɛ̄ ó wɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú ádā uwɔ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
idu_Latn: Á gáā yúufi aócē obɔ̄bí nēe gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ otú ā ŋ́, ámāŋ aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí nēe gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́nɔ péee ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
idu_Latn: Nááná nēé dɔɔ̄kā kéē ga ɛyí ɛfu ā kpɔ́ ā, Umósīsi, amáŋ ka Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā í fu ajɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ ā mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū géē nunu tū aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú aá ā géē je aá wúla tāajɛ. Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá ā, odúúdú ācɛ géē jé ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ́ɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka anúɔ lɛ iháyí ofu ɛhīlī lé ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ka anúɔ í lɔfú leyīkwu uwá glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kē le da anúɔ ka, anúɔ í gáā bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛnɛ gā abɔ́ɔ, lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ iyē kú nū le ŋmó ā tá ipú ákplata gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
idu_Latn: É le áklɔ̄kpɛ cēce ikpó ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔwɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ okómpinu kú nū le píyéké ā, wɛ ɔwɛ nōo kē yɛ ga oyēeyī á. Ó klla lɔnɔ, ācɛ o ligíí kē í píyɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da um ka, aínu ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛga ō yá ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ī yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā í lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ gē wā í gwó ā ce ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da Usɔ́lu kahíníī, Udéfīdi gbɔ̄ɔkɔ tá um, klla mīyɛ ɛga le tá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka, á gbɔbū lɛ ikpati kú okónu ōce kú, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ga ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, cɛ́ɛ́ éyééye kú aá kóō kwú ɛcɔ̄ éyi ú ce ɔkɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Isóan wɛ aólíla. Ācɛ nēé ge nwū Íjīpiti íjééyī fíyɛ́ dúu a géē je pīya aólíla. Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛɛ́ nēé gēe da ɔcɛ́ ka aá, Uféro ka ɔɔ mīyɛ ɔkwu kú ācɛ o jé ɔdā kú íkée a gɛ?.

eng_Latn: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ mla awɔ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwɔ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ alɛwa wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um igelī nyā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ōhī nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá uwā italā ŋ́, náána nɛ̄ n le italā yá, uwā yá aá italā má, aá gbɛlá ka ń gáā yá aá italā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N géē yá aá italā piíí bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē pī ɔ̄cɛ ejé ā.

eng_Latn: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
idu_Latn: Ussaharayím tá anyā nū ɛpa nēe bá ā: Uhússim mɛ́mla Ubaára.

eng_Latn: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ka a géē tá um ohi. Pīyeyī má um Óndú ká ā jáhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
idu_Latn: kwú ayíkābɔ̄ kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū ú wu anɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá abɔ́ɔ igbahāapa ipéyī Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
idu_Latn: É da Umósīsi kahíníī, Únóji í bá Íjīpiti ŋ́ nɛɛ? A kpó alɔ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā ipú ígbíli amānyā kú ālɔ̄ gáā kwú nɛɛ? Ɔdí nāa yá alɔ yɔ̄ ā? Nɛ̄ a kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti āa?.

eng_Latn: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
idu_Latn: É da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā ka ɔ̄nyɛ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā nyā ā. É le ɔkwu nū bū, anɔ́ɔ é le jé ka Ugídīyɔn, ɔyí kú Ujówāsi ɔɔ́ yá á.

eng_Latn: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nēé kwú tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ, é géē bī ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ péee. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé lɛ ácí ŋmó klá anú nēé gáā pīyɛ ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ gēdēē ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umɛtɛtíyas, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Émɔ̄si, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unáhum, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ésli, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unagáyi.

eng_Latn: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ ɛgba kú nū kwú wā, nɛ̄ ó gáā gwá ikpō glá gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ó ka é gáā lɛ ayí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kōō lɛ ayí lɛ nááná, anúɔ géē kpó ayí nēe he uwá ɔtū ā ŋmó bónū.

eng_Latn: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔni ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Unémūwɛlu, Ujámín, Ujakín mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā nēé flla alɔ á, ŋmá lɛ ō je íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā yá alɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa ā wā gaá ka kahíníī, Ɔkpani, n le ikpīije ugóolu ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá itene būla ɛ̄nɛ̄ a je ga um ā.

eng_Latn: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki, mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu á? Ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ okwú ŋ́, amáŋ ákú ācɛ oyēeyī nɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi nōo wɛ opeyī ā, lɛ eyīpú kú íkókwū mɛ́mla ocíbú nā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú uwā kóō le yá yēŋēē dúú.

eng_Latn: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le uwá ahɔ̄ pi ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aá jāahɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi, ń kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú tá Usáyɔn, nōo géē yá ká ācɛ kéē gwōnū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo kē lɔtūce ɔ́ ā, uwēyī í gáā kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Udárīyɔsi, ɔyí kú Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ Uméde ā, lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā mɛ, é géē ŋmó ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ā icííci, nááná nɛ̄ igelī ā í kōō wā abɔ̄ nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā géē je igelī nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó yíífi tāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpá ī cēnyi gē kpó odée yíífi ā. Ɛfú géē yɔ̄ gē kpó jāā gbó oŋmɛ́yí kú eko ífi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tútū ā.

eng_Latn: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
idu_Latn: N yíihɔtū tá ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tá um ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē tíne um ā, gē má um.

eng_Latn: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó le da uwá ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ le héyī ā, é cɛ̄ ɛlā nōó ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n da aá ka ācɛ nēe gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā, géē má odée lé klla ī má odée gwá lɔɔlɔhi. Amáŋ aá ā, ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēēnyi géē ŋmó aá. Ɔtū géē he ācɛ nēe ī cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ ā, amáŋ uwēyī géē kwú aá ā.

eng_Latn: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā íla ō ka kú olíla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī jē táajɛ gbēyi iyī nū, kóō je iyī nū yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: A géē pó ācɛ bá ī yú uya kú éeyē, mɛ́mla uya kú ɔnyā ō lɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē bī ɛhi ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um wā gáā tá um ahínyá. É géē bá ī ka ka Tá Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ahínyá dúú. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē yá olɔhi. Ó kē ī yíihɔtū eko dóódu piyóó. N géē je agbénú kú ajɛ nyā kwúcē lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Ujérobōwam ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ gēe je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbō ɛga dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōo ī ŋmá okónu kú uwā ā bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyī nēé lɛ gwɛ̄ɛ́fa ā. É gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ eko dóódu. É bī okónu gē kɛlā kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ īyī uwā, amáŋ é gē miya kéē nyɔ̄ í kwāajɛ ɔwɛ gbēyī ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
idu_Latn: Aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú uwā lɛ ābɔ̄ ɛpa kwu ɔhá nēé gē nwūla ɔtāhɛ.

eng_Latn: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɔcí kú akésiya le ede gbā. Ó lɛ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ. Olīkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó éyi ce āyā, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó éyi ce āyā, olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛtá. Ajī nōo kwu ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú nū ā wɛ oō yá tɔ̄há ékpónú mla anú.

eng_Latn: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
idu_Latn: Aá cokónū kú aá lé tɔ̄há mla ācɛ kú ipú ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā lɔfú lɛ pīya ukpa kú ikwu lɛ aá glá.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɛlā ā ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le uwá túbá ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu, okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛgiyí Ujɛ́rīko ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
idu_Latn: Ubálāki kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi le abɔ̄ kú nū fīyɛ̄ ɔhá gbáyíí, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ubálam kahíníī, N hī uwɔ igwú kú ā gaá tókónu lɛ aólɛlā kú um, amáŋ igbo ɔ́mɛɛtá nāa hɔ́hā ce uwá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unábalu tá ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi ā ohi kahíníī, Udéfīdi ii? Ɔnyɛ̄ wɛ Udéfīdi ā? Ń pó ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɔ́ jéjēe ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔlɛ́ alɔ nyā le mū mla aɔ́fiyɛ nēe bá gē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí óndú uwā ī yɛ abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lā abɔ́ɔ aflɛ́yí ā, é gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ aágábá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō kpó uwá ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
idu_Latn: Ā híīī bī ɛyí kú aá le gbɛka ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá lɔfú yá īnyīlɛ̄yí éyi kú aá, kwu ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ onōbí, glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
idu_Latn: Oje gē tū oje ulé á, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē wɛ ɔlá kú ɔ́mpā nū á.

eng_Latn: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N jē ɔdōlé gā uwɔ, kwu anɔ̄, umu mɛ́mla ɛnwú olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Amáŋ a kwú uwá ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí, yɔ̄ ī tíne ó má eyī olɔhi kú aɛ́cī kú uwɔ ā. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla Óndú ā eko ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā lɛ uwá. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ bá ī yúúfi kú ɔlá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ lɔtū ga ɛyí ɛfu ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ ɛcɛ ā á. Īkpō olɔhi ā ke wɛ ācɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Amáŋ ácí ā wɛ ācɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
idu_Latn: Blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú um le kpií lɛ ā. Ɔmɛ mɛ́mla ajɛ nāa kē le yá odúúdú alɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ jégēdēē le íne bīya eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā jé ɛɛ́ mā, ó lɛ ɛya dúú nēé géē gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō jé ɔ́ yá alɔ ɛhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
idu_Latn: Eyīyōce kú ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gwéeyē, amáŋ acobɔ̄bíipú í lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé gē leyīcɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n leyīce abahi ā, ákanya nɛ̄hi wā ā. Eko nɛ̄ n gbēyī ofíyajɛ ā, obú wā á.

eng_Latn: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá fu obugā éyi nɛ̄ ígwu kú aálá ɛtá gwutá pī ɔ̄ ajɛ abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ́ɔ nēé gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ aálá ā gwá á. É le ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi éyi gwū okónu obugā ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ a géē wútá ŋmá ɛka ā wɛ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka a le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēé tá ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka āa.

eng_Latn: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔfú kpó í kwu ācɛ kú Ujúda. Ó gbɔɔ́ ō tú Uráma gwó, yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ igá olɔfú tū ɔ̄. Ó klla le ɔwɛ nōo ī yɛ ga Ujúda klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā ŋmó, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ga ipú Ujúda ámāŋ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā gē ga ɛga ékpónú. Úmúlá nɛ̄ odúúdú ūwā ŋmá á, ipú úmúlá ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ odúúdú ūwā gē nyɔ̄ á. Odúúdú ūwā kē í je pīya úmúlá igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é jé ɔkwu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma nēé ŋmá ŋ́ mā, é mīyɛ uwá tá ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā géē gbēyī ikwū amáŋ ó gē wā ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́. É klla í tíne ō kwú fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē tíne agbénú dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.
idu_Latn: N géē yá odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yá uculo bɛ̄ɛka ācopɛ̄cí, ī tómbli gla okómpinu ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe klla gē wūwī, gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ inu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔkpani uwā tū mu mla iyó nēé wu ā italā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā má kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, aólɛlā kú aá géē wu agbénú kú aá ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm. É klla í kpó aɔ́dā nēé wu ā kɔ̄ ipéyī aá.

eng_Latn: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēé le ɔ́ gbaáluka ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ó wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbu ā géē gbā ɛ́gí ije nyā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
idu_Latn: Unikɔdímɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kéē ma ɔ̄cɛ igbɔhá eko nōó le gbɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ɛɛ́ ā? Ó géē lɔfú kwúcē ga ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū igbo ɔ́mpa kéē ma ɔ́ kɛ̄ɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
