idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ á le da uwɔ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācogwɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú anjɛnú ā, nēe gē kɛlā nwununwunu, klla ī tíifu ā, kéē lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā lɛ aá. Aá híī pó ɛlā kú uwā ŋ́. N gbelá ka ācɛ cíkā ō da Ɔwɔicō nēe ī gbā ā ɔ̄kā nɛ. Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī da aókwūmā ɔ̄kā ohígbū ācɛ nōo yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
idu_Latn: Aígbáanɔ géē wā í pɛ́ ce ɔcí ā nōo hɛ́ tá ajɛ ā. Aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí kē ī yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɛyí ūkwābɔ̄ kú nū nēe bá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄! Aótrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ Ujékɔ̄pu, mla aótrɛ̄yí kú inu kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá cíkā ō jé ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, lɛ um jila, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā má ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nōó le ɛlā nyā ka ā, ó le abɔ̄ kú nū mɛ́mla ikpó kú nū mafú lɛ uwá?.

eng_Latn: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kó ō tá uwā abɔ̄, é le okónū cē ɔdā nēé yá kahíníī, Alɔ le íne bīya ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka alɔ kwu pīyeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, Óndú, alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō pā ɛcí kú Ubáal mɛ́mla Ástārɔtu. Kóocōō, lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú alɔ, ká ālɔ̄ géē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā piyóó mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ kwú pīya ācobīyíne. Odúúdú ucē olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá ā í tīile dóódu ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka áhinglí nōo le blínyī eyī dóódu ā. Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú alɔ, alɔ kwu yíífi ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka aépū nēe ī ŋmókókó eko nɛ̄ aɔ́cí gē ga ɔlɔ́ɔwɔ eko ɔ̄nɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ owu gē gwu bónū ā.

eng_Latn: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā í gáā túblá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ ká é bī ikwū gé lɛ iyī uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka ā ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí ŋmá ipácí. Eko nēé le ɔdā nōo yá pó ā, ó le húúwā ohí nɛ̄hi klla wú uwā ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. O ka ka Ussɛ́kɛm ɔ́ɔ le ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujékɔ̄pu hɛ́báajɛ ā, ɛcá nōó cá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. É cíkā ō yá ɔyí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le ɛga nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā je lɛ Óndú ā nɛɛ, aá gáā lé ɛpɔ̄bí eko nɛ̄ aá kwú ɛga o hile ā ú lé ŋ́. Amáŋ, aá híī nyíla ɔdā ɛ̄gbā otīīhɔ nyā ŋmá lɛ o lé gbɔbū ká aá je lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́. Aá géē kwú ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ nēe lā Usamérīya ā géē fīyégbúlú ohígbū ufi, klla ī yēkwu kú ojibó kú ɛna kú oje ugóolu nōo yɔ̄ Ubetafín kú uwā, nōo yɔ̄ Ubɛ́tɛlu ā. Ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē pā ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā ā, géē jikwū ohígbū nū. É géē jikwū eko nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú ɛna kú oje ɔdɔ ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, nēé gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā, lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū tá ajɛ gbēyī um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
idu_Latn: Ā híīī je īyī uwɔ tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ŋ́. N yɔ̄ ipú unwalu nɛ̄hi, lɛ ohi tá um abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē jé ka a yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē, nɛ̄ ɔtū í gáā he ɔ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó gáā yá olɛlā kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā italā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi Usáyírɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn ā, ó le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu, kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tūgwó Ujerúsālɛm, ɛga nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɛya ɔhá lɛ Óndú ā. Olicō kú nū géē wɛ ikpó ofɛtá, ɔwá kú nū kē í wɛ ikpó ofɛtá lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ ami yɔ̄ ī yēeyī kpɔ́ ā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā ipú um mɛ́ɛ́ á. Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n kē yēeyī abālɔbányā ā, n lā ŋmá ɔtōkpóce Ɔyí Ɔwɔicō nōo yíihɔtū tá um klla cɛ̄ gekwú o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ um nyatá a.

eng_Latn: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú īkpɛ̄yí kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́mpa ā lɛ odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ofu kú ágbe nōo cíkā ō ŋmó ɔ̄ glá ā, amáŋ ágbe obɔ̄bí bɔ̄bí ā le jé ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ le kpó hídáagó, anɔ́ɔ é bá ī yɛce ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Usiríya le ɛdɔ kú ekwukwu nɛ̄hi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú uwā bá gē kwinya ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Usiríya gbɛlá ká ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá le aɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla Íjīpiti kpó pūla wā mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kéē nuunu tá aá.

eng_Latn: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ofɛɛtá ce igwó ā pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú aá géē wā ī lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yíhɔtū tá aá lɛ ā jé, nááná nɛ̄ aá gáā jé ɔ̄ dúúdú glá ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́ɔmā ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá je gbla Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ lɛ ejé gwá mu eyī ā, ó da Ɛ́sta kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā nāa tíne klla cɛgbá ā, da um. N géē yá ɔ̄ ga uwɔ. Ó kōō wɛ ō je āyā éyi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um nāa tíne á, n géē je ɔ́ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
idu_Latn: N le pīyatɔ̄há mla uwa, a kē le pīyatɔ̄há mla um, kéē le pīya ɔ̄cɛ ékpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kóō le jé ka awɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á. Ká ɛcɛ kóō kla le jé ka a yíihɔtū tū uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yíihɔtū tū um ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla ayíkpó ohile kahíníī, Aá híīī ci ɔ́ anú ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ olɛlā kú aá ŋ́ kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā nēe kwúcē ŋmá ɛcí o pā wā í gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄gbā ā, lé ɔdōlé kú ɛya ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yēeyī ā, ó wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ. Ó kē jé oji nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ɔwɔicō le oji cē ɔ̄ ka anúɔ géē je éyi kú ayááyí nū lé ɔcɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī lé ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔyí ā nyāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yāwu í yɛ bilíbilí ipú inu á.

eng_Latn: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií le gla, ó le jɛ kwú pīya ɔcínɔ̄kwū. Ó kwu abɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aígbáanɔ gē wā í gwó ɔlɛ́ uwā ce ābɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī ŋmó ācɛ ɔhá ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā kú Ujérobōwam le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔbá nū ka ā á. Ó le tá Ussílo, ɔlɛ́ kú Ahíja. Eko nyā, Ahíja í mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū koó le hīla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ācɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra mɛ́mla aígelī nēe yɔ̄ kwu uwā ajaajɛ ā. É yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā, bá ī yá unwū obɔ̄bī kú ikpɔ́nyā ōce mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ikpɔ́nyā ōce nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwu ákú ācɛ ɔlamu tá. Ɔlá lɛ aígelī nēe bá nyā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ipú uwā ā kpó yi tāajɛ piyóó. Ōwē nyā kóō wɛ ahɔ̄ nēé gē pi ācobīyíne anú á.

eng_Latn: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a móōwē ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ́ɔmā kóō híī tū uwɔ uwēyī ŋ́, amáŋ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū ka a líiyē kwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō tū íne ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ eyīnyinyi kú nū ī nwuné fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla tɛtɛ le ka ɛgɔhá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú í habɔ̄ ācɛ ōhī tá lɛ alɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ, alɔ í géē yɛ í le lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī kú Usɔ́dɔm ā, alɔ kē í yɛ í le lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī kú Ugomóra ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ gbo playi iyɔ̄bū kú ɔláwonī ā ɔ́ŋgbá ubulúu.

eng_Latn: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ōtáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ wɛ ɔhā mɛ́mla olɔhi nɛ̄ um lɛ á.

eng_Latn: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn le ɛfú kpó wā í gwū ācɛ Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ajɛ kú Ujúda abɔ̄fú á. Iháyí ɛtá, ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujɛhóyākim bá ipú abɔ̄ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla Unebúkádinēsa. Anɔ́ɔ oŋmɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá ā, Ujɛhóyākim le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Unebúkádinēsa ka, anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ōjéeyī gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū gē he ádā nū. Ɔyí olíla, gē bī ɔtūnōbí gé lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi ipú ɔ̄na kahíníī, N jé ka a yá ɛ̄nyā ŋmá ɔtū oyēŋēē kú uwɔ. Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ń cɛ̄ gā uwɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ dɛ̄ɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ íne kú um bīya ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē yɛce anúɔ, ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ācɛ Umówābu, aólɛlā kú uwā yálé ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é yɛce Éhūdu gaá mīyɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Umówābu gáā bēhé Ujɔ́dan ā. É cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ Umówābu dúúmā bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ ujɔ̄ tū ká alɔ lɛ ɔdā éyi yá Ujeremíya. Ācogwɛ́ɛya bá nēe géē bá ī tū alɔ ukɔ́ eko dóódu. Alɔ lɛ ācojéeyī eko dóódu nēe géē nwū alɔ ɛlā. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔhá kē bá nēé géē bá ī cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā lɛ alɔ eko dóódu. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kpó ce ɔ́. Ālɔ̄ kē híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nōó gē ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, What is the thing that the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́lāyi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwɔ ā? Ā je ɔdā dúúmā kú nū tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyī um ŋ́. Óndú ā géē yá uwɔ italā nɛ̄hi ɔ́dāŋ́ ka á ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó da uwɔ ā gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
idu_Latn: Ń lɛ ɛbɔ́ ŋ́. Ń lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́. Unwalu kú um í kē mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄hi nōó lɛ lɛ alɛɛcɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā idáagó nōó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī alɛwa úgbéenyi ā yɔ̄ ī yɛ tiiti. Ó le kwú alɔ iyē nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gā ajɛ Unídɔ̄si á. Abɔ̄ owu í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ ŋ́ mā, alɔ le pɛ́ gla Usálmɔ̄n eyī igbīhi owu lɛyíkwu Ukrɛ́ti.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usímri le má ka ɛ́ɛ́ mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́ mā, ó le yɛ tá ipíinu eyīpú olɔfú kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā gaá lɛ ɔ́ tū ɔlá klá iyī nū. Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ā kwú ɔ́ ú ŋmó tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ́ tayínū eyīpú kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā iháyí ɛhīlī. Eko ɔ́ɔmā Atálīya kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aɔ́bá ɛna kú nū ā ú, le uwá kpó ŋmó, lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú uwā wā nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, lɛ ɔ́ kpó tɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ fu odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá yɛce Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé géē yá aɔ́bá ɛna kú nū á. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā kwú pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá le jīla tɔ̄ɔ̄há ɛga ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ um á, ɔnyɛ ɔhá kē ī ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí glá āa? Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē kpɛ́lā ce um ā géē mɛ tāajɛ, bɛ̄ɛka īlī nɛ̄ ɛha kwú lé ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a le ɔdā idáagó alɛwa yá lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. A miya ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi alɛwa tū alɔ. Ń kē gáā ka uwá tɛ́ɛcɛ dúúdú glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka é lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛcí kú íbɔm nāa cē tū Ujerúsālɛm ā mɛ, kwú āyā éyi kú īnyīlɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ɔnwū ɔ́ɔmá ú ka á kwú ɔ́ u yɔɔlá ipú igelī ā. Kwú āyā ɔhá ú ka a lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́ mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī abɔ̄ a géē yɔ̄ ī yɛ gicō gajɛ eyīyɛcɛ kú igelī ā. Kwú āyā ɔ́mɛtá ā ú kpó tá gico ɛbɛɛbɛ kú owu kóō kpó uwā. N kē í nū uwá inya mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī abɔ̄yī um.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛgbā ā géē yá ā yɔ̄ á. N géē je ɔcí ohɔ́nɔ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē lé, klla í je ɔdōgwá nōo í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ lɛ uwá kéē gwá.

eng_Latn: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ ga um gē pó ɛlā kú nū, ń kē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē kwúcē hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ɔkpíyē kú aá wɛ āyā kú ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N̄ kwú āyā kú ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ú cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú bɔ́há mla akwuna nɛɛ? Ó lɔɔwɛ ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá gáā lé igbō nōo gē nū ŋ́. Ɔdōnīgbō dúúmā ámāŋ ka igbō nōo gē nū kóō híī yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Umakíyɛ ɔyí kú Umanásɛ gaá le ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā mīyɛ tū abɔ̄, le ācɛ kú Ámɔn nēe lā anú ā kpó nū bɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ujísɔ̄si háyi okónu ókpoó kú Ugenésāreti, ɛwa kú ācɛ le yɛ jila ɔ́ tá, bá ī kwɛga ga iyɔ̄bū nū, kéē pó olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōó yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ā a.

eng_Latn: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ nōo wɛ Usedekíya ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe géē wi ŋmá ɛfú, ɔkpɛtá mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí ā, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, mɛ́mla aólɛlā kú aá nēe tíne ō ŋmó aá, kóō lɛ aá kpó kwú. Unebúkádinēsa í ŋmó awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ā. Ó gáā ményinyi ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē ma abɔ̄ odúúmā kú aá tá ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
idu_Latn: Ɛga olipú, amáŋ ɛga odobū dúúmā í yɔ nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú gē tayínū ŋmá ɛgīyī nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, ó wɛ ami da uwɔ ka ā bī ífi mɛ́mla ámíyā wā í klá uwá ŋ́. Ń gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū eko kú unwalu a lɛ uwá ŋ́. Óndú ā jé ɛ̄nyā, a jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā.

eng_Latn: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ alɛwa, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā le kpó hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē kpó aíkpɛ̄yí kú aólɛlā kú nū ca piíí, ācɛ nēe tá kéē kwúcē ŋmá ínoōbīya kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī ɔfú kú nū le ísu nɛ̄hi ā kwú tū abɔ̄. Ó bī íjééyī kú nū le ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ísu ā, nēé hī ka Uráhābu ā, ŋmó.

eng_Latn: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ má klla cɛ̄ ka, ɔ́dáŋ keé kwú igelī nɛ̄hi ā í gwó klla kwu ɔdɔ kú igá kú nū ā ú gwó mɛ, Ágábáidu, á klla gáā fu ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīsi ā iyē ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē gbō uwā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ nēe gē kpó ɛka tū uwā ɛyí kwɛyí ācɛ nēe gekwú ā. Ɔdíyá nēé gē yá lɛ ā ɔ́dāŋ kéē le jé ka ācɛ nēe gekwú ā í gáā héyī gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n, lɛ ācɛ ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ wɛɛlɛ ŋmá Ussítim. Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄, kú aá lɛ ajɛ ā jila lɔɔlɔhi, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko. Eko nēé gā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujérīko, é gaá le gbɔga ɔlɛ́ akwuna éyi nēé hī ka Uréhābu.

eng_Latn: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, aá nēe gbɛlá ka aá jé odée ā. Ofíoongoli ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kóō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ nēe géē ka lɛ aá kahíníī, Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ anūmā! ámāŋ ka Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ amānyā! Amáŋ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ámāŋ kōō nyɔ̄ gɛcɛ í dɔɔ̄kā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú ajɛ ā gáā lɛ á! Aklóbīya mla áncɛ́nyā géē bá ī jɛ̄ lɔfú ŋmá o lé ɔdōlé kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé nēé í gwá ā.

eng_Latn: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
idu_Latn: Umósisi da uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī kpó ɔdōlɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ikwū mɛ́mla oyēeyī bá lɛ uwá kéē je éyi ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔcɛ́ ā cāŋjɛ mla igbómína ā mɛ́mla Ubenísi mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ajɛ mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú ucɛ kú Onyatá á. Ugbɔga dóódu í gáā wɛ ipú uculo kú ucɛ kú Onyatá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó lɛ īyī nū, anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā gwó dúú á.

eng_Latn: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
idu_Latn: kócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nēé í gbā gā awɔ ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā pó, ɔ́dāŋ kēé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá le ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ Ukérēti ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ kú Ujúda, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukálēbu ā wúla tāajɛ. Ó ka ka aá le Usíkilāgi tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ odúúdú uwá, kwu aádā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí, ɛyí gbo ɔhá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē ca aɔ́já kú ejé klá īyī uwā ā. N gáā mɛ́nyinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē pi ɔtū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu ī ci um ŋmá ō kpó uwā yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
idu_Latn: Ami lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ufáyin á, aá kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ābɔ̄ nū á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla um, nɛ̄ n kē yɔ̄ ī piyatɔ̄há mla anú, géē gwá īkpō nwuné nwuné, ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ kóō wɛ ami ŋ́, aá lɔfú yá ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī gbo ɔ́ gɔɔ ā, ó kahíníī, Odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ olufa kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um gē lé ɔdōlé gē nū ipú klla gē tá. Anɔ́ɔ n yɔ̄ amānyā nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā gáā je ŋmó yɔ̄ɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
idu_Latn: N má kéē kpɛ́lā ce ɔ́ ohígbū íne kú uwā, amáŋ ó wɛ ɔdā nēé cíkā ō hɛ́ ō ukpa ámāŋ ka o tū ɔ̄ agbá ŋ́. Ɛlā nēé kpó ce ɔ́ ā yɛ lɛyíkwu íne kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi gaá bá Ukíbrɔ̄tu hataáfa.

eng_Latn: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa gē gbagbénú, amáŋ agbénú kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē mɛ tāajɛ eko kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, aá géē kwú bɛ̄ɛka alɛɛcɛ ā, oyēeyī kú aá klla í ŋmɛ́yí bɛ̄ɛka otrɛ̄yí dóódú ā.

eng_Latn: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī eyī Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī bū ipú ɛhɔ̄ īkpɔ̄dā éyi ɛ̄cī Usábāti. Ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō cē īkpɔ̄dā ā lé á.

eng_Latn: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Apɛ́lɛsi nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá cɛ̄ ɛlā nū ohígbū ɛyí nōó le táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Aá hokónu tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Aristɔbɔ́lɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, wā káā gá lɛ um nyatá. A gē yá odúúdú aólɛlā kú um italā. Ohígbū ka, é klla lɔfú dúúmā nēé ī yá um ɔdā dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā le iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda kpó wu, mla ákú aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda klla kwú odúúdú nū ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
idu_Latn: N yá ká a le jɛ̄ gām bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo lɔfú iyē ā. A kwú jɛ̄ licō klla lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɔ́ncɛ̄nyā nōo lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā. A le yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔyípɔ́ncɛnyā nōo lɛ amɛ̄ tū gwɛɛ́ gwɛɛ́ klla lɛ īnyīlɛ́yí bū nɛ̄hi ā, amáŋ a tá ohɛ́ɛwa nōbí nōbí.

eng_Latn: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ā le pɛ́ kwu gaá tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi ā le yā mɛ.

eng_Latn: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ayí kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ayókwū, anyōkwū, mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ agbénú dóódu ipú uwā ŋ́ mā. Ó ka ɔdā dóódu, nōo ce uwá ɛgbá ā, ɛ́ɛ géē wā í je ŋmá anú. Ó da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, kóō géē hɔ́hā ce uwá ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́gɛ́ dúú, nɛ̄ éwo kú uwā ɔ́ɔ í yēeyī gáā kwu lɛ ā, ka ɛ́ɛ híī yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē tá aéwo ɔ́ɔmā abɔ̄, kóō lɔhi lɛ uwá gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbo ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā, úklɔ́ kú nū í lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō kú aá gē yá ɔdā nōó cokónu ka anúɔ géē yá ā. Ɔwɔicō ī yá ɔdā nōo lɛ kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
idu_Latn: Uhóssēya, Uhananíya, Uhássubu.

eng_Latn: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ācɛ Ufárisīsi ohí kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ohígbū kóō gē lɛ íne kú ɛ̄cī usábāti tū ŋ́. Amáŋ aígwu ɔhá kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ obīyíne gē yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā glá ā? Anɔ́ɔ é le kɔ̄ ohígbū ɛlā ā a.

eng_Latn: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipū ā, gē bīya ojuju kú aógbɛhá ā. Amáŋ Óndú ā gē gbō uwā ŋmá unwalu á.

eng_Latn: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
idu_Latn: Kɛlā lɛ uwá ká ā da uwá ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē ka lɛ uwá ā. Ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu nōo kwú ɔtū kú nū ú lɛ ɛcí, ī cɛ̄ lɛ aójībó ā ī yá ká ɔ̄ bɔbíipú tōōtɔɔ, lɔfú wā í da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú um ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu olekwu kú um. Amáŋ ami abɔ̄yī um géē tá ɔ̄ ohi nōo cíkā lɛ aójībó kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.
idu_Latn: Ɛlá alɛwa ō gbo gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ī nɔ̄ɔ̄na ɔbɔ̄bí, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛlā alɛwa ō ka gē bī ɛlā kú íla wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Unówa, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ lígíí bī wā kú aá lɛ ikpó na cɛ́ɛ́ aá le mlɛ́nyɔ́ lígíí ɔkwu ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
idu_Latn: É le ikpokwú kú uwá kpó nyɔ̄ í nyi ɔkwu ɔcí kú Utámārisiki ipú ajɛ kú Ujábesi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le okónu gwū ɛ̄cī ahāapa á.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
idu_Latn: A le oyēeyī kú um yá kpií. Eko kú oyēeyī kú um í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ ŋ́. Ɔkwɔɔkwɛyi nɛ̄, oyēeyi kú ācɛ dóódu lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu ā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā da ɔcɛ́ ka anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō tá ɔyī lɛ aá ŋmá ɛyí ɔdɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ le ācɛ ōhī kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpó ŋmó á. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ŋmó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ éyi, nōo yá ucɛ kú ɔnyā ō lɛ lɛ ɔyí nū.

eng_Latn: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ nyɛ́ lɛ uwá ā mɛ́mla aólɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā géē gwéeyē igbɔhá kpɔ́, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ń jé o kɛlā ŋ́. Amáŋ n jé odée lɛyíkwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā. Alɔ yá ɛ̄nyā tá aá eyī péee igbalɛwa mɛ́mla āyā dóódu.

eng_Latn: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ géē má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī wā ipú ojuja mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛgahi.

eng_Latn: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā lɛ Utáma pi tá ɛcɛ lɛ ɔwɛ gwū á. Utáma le awulú okwajɛ wulu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ ō líkpō wiiyē. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdōwiīyē kú ɔyí-ɔ́cɛ́ nɔ̄nyā nōó lɛ ɔbá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kú eko ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nēé fu ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ā híī yɔ̄ ge táafu bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā ŋ́, a híī yɔ̄ gē ka ɛma o likpō likpō ā ŋ́, ā ke yiikpɛ́lā mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Ā nuunu ohígbū íne ā ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā í tīile ŋ́, e wɛ ɔdā áncā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa gbɔɔ́ ō pó olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Óndú ā ohígbū ɔdā o yēeyījii nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ohílīpú kú aá pīyabɔ̄ kéē lɛ éyééye kú aá yá Ubatísim, o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē habɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā tá lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kē í mīyɛ ɛhi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ anyōkɔ́ɔma ā gē yúufi Ɔwɔicō ā, ó le ɔdā olɔhi yá lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Uhíbru ā bá ī nyīla klla ī lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
idu_Latn: Ó nyɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú nū Ussílo, ɛga nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lā mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
idu_Latn: Ó le Ujehóyāda, otrɛ̄yí kú uwā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á tū ayí Ulífāyi ɛhɔ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ gaá mīyɛ ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́ mā ā? Ije nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú da uwá kéē géē gbā iháyí dóódu, kú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ā.

eng_Latn: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ayááyí nū kéē lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā nēe kwu icō gē fíyajɛ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu wā ɛgiyí uwā gaá jila uwá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ó má ka ɔtū kú uwā le wuklícō.

eng_Latn: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwɔ bū uwɔ alagbá klla í cɛ̄ lɛ ɛbéenyi kú ipú ísu kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kwu uwɔ āpū ká. N géē je awɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛbéenyi nēe kɔ̄ klá uwɔ āpū ā kpó pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ísu kú Unáyilu.

eng_Latn: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
idu_Latn: aɛ́nɛ̄ e lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā á. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū lɛ iyē ā kpótɔ̄há ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ géē je ojīlīmā lɛ aáyā nēé cɛgbá ojīlīmā ŋmā fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gēe je ōwē la Íjīpiti, amáŋ ó gēe nya uwá tá uwá gēe pīya ɛyí wā ɛga īyī Óndú a, Óndú ā í pó ɔkɔ oogbā kú uwá klá í nya uwá tá.

eng_Latn: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
idu_Latn: Ó gē ma odée fú lɛ uwá, klla ī tū uwā ufi nɛ̄hi ō yá kóō lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
idu_Latn: Aá yá iyī aá ɛbɛ́ ká aá le líla. Aá lɛ īyī aá eyī gbō ká aá le peyī. Aá wīyējé kú aá túgagá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ejé le aá kwú ā, nááná nɛ̄ aá gwá ejé ɔlamu ámāŋ ka ejé olɔfú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le miya mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ nēe bá iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó gwū. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá le abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
idu_Latn: N kwú ɔtū kú um ú yékpónú ká n̄ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú uwɔ eko dóódu, jāā gbēeko nɛ̄ n kwú.

eng_Latn: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ, aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka okwū ā ɛgiyí ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ohígbū īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄ ā yá tá ɔ̄ mɛ́mla íne kú nū nɛ̄ aá bīya ā.

eng_Latn: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá um kú n̄ lɔfú á. Anú yá ka ɔwɛ kú um kóō wɛ ɛbɛ́ɛ́bɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ wā gáā nya ācɛ nēe bī ā tá.

eng_Latn: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
idu_Latn: Óndú klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Áhābu dúúmā nōo géē kwú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ewō géē je okwú kú nū kpó lé. Ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e kē í kwú ipácí ā, aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā géē je okwū kú uwá kpó lé á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā gbɔɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄, Umósīsi gē kahíníī, Canjɛ Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aólɛla kú uwɔ kéē le fíyákátā, kú ācɛ nēe géē wɔ́tū uwɔ ā kéē kwinya ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yálé, ohígbū keé le ɔtū kpóce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi, lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nēe yá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kpó kā lɛ ɔ́ kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Ije nɛ̄hɛ́, amáŋ ugóolu kú uwā í gáā lɔfú nya uwá tá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ācɛ ā gla ŋ́. Odúúdú ɛcɛ ā géē je kpó yíífi mla ɔlá kú ícɔ̄nū kú nū. Ó géē je odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā kpó yíífi eko nēé leyīce ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujɛhóssɛ̄ba, ɔyí ádā kú Ahasíya ā, nōo wɛ ɔnyā kú Ujehóyada ā, kwú Ujehóssɛ̄ba, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔcɛ́ ā ú ŋmá ipú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ nēé gáā kpó ŋmó ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gáā tayínū ipú inu ɛga o gbiyɔ̄lā éyi kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔnyā éyi kóō leyīkwu ɔ́. O je ɔ́ tayínū nyā le ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ikwū kú Atálīya.

eng_Latn: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka úlā ahāapa ce ofigwó ā le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Ái. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ái le uwá kwu gbuulu, le uwá nū inya ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́kplá kú Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyínɛ́ Ujɛramīīlu ā, lé ka Umésa ā. Umésa ma Usífu á. Usífu ma Umárésa. Umárēsa wɛ ádā kú Uhɛ́brɔn á.

eng_Latn: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā cílokwúlu kahíníī, Ó kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā, ó wɛ ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
idu_Latn: Aá híī mlanyī olɔhi ō yá lɛ ācɛ ŋ́, ká aá kɔ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā mla ācɛ ɔhá. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛdɔ kú ɛya ogwó nōo gē he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Ɛ́ru mɛ́mla Ónan, amáŋ Ɛ́ru mɛ́mla Ónan le pɛ́ gekwú ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kwú aɔ́dā ō bī gwíijē kú alɔ ú kpó playi ɔcí okónu ɔkpá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Aáfādi, ācɛ kú Uséma mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Uhámāti.

eng_Latn: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā í gáā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ipɔ́ɔma éyi ga ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá ŋ́. Ipɔ́ɔma éyééye géē yɔ̄ ī lúgwū kú agbénū kú iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Leyī kwú aéwo, nēe yɛ aá jīla tá biílí ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Ɔdā nāa géē má ā í hí uwɔ idáagó. N gáā yá odée, nɛ̄ eko nāa le pó, á gáā cɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, lɛ ɔdā nāa miya ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ ka anúɔ gaá yá ā ka gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ cɛ̄ uwɔ ɛhɔ̄, ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī yá ká ɔtū kóō he uwɔ. Bla ka a le éwo nyā fu kóō wɛ ákú abɔ̄yī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɛpa ā wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ohígbū ka ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í je ɛhi alahá lɛ ācɛ ā í wɛ ékpónú mla íne nɛ̄ Ádām bīya ā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ācɛ alɛwa le pɛ́ gekwú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú bīya ā. Amáŋ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī ma eyīnyinyi kú nū fú ā lɔfú fíyɛ́, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔwɛ nōó bī le je ɛhi alahá lɛ ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi o ŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ā, bī le ma eyīnyinyi fú ā.

eng_Latn: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
idu_Latn: Aólíla ōfōōfū ūwā gē ka ipú ɔtū kú uwa kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í yɔ̄ ŋ́ má. Odúúdú uwā gē yá ɛdɔ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í tíne ā ŋ́. Aá lɔfú má ɛdɔ ōwē nɛ̄ n gáā má piíí ā glá āā? N géē kwú ohígbū o yáŋmó mɛ́mla ōwē. Aá le tútū kú aá kwú lɛ āā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
idu_Latn: Aá je abɔ̄ kú aá nōo le gbagbafú ā gico, ká aá lɔfu tū okwúukwu kú aá nēe ī fīyēgbúlú ā iyē!.

eng_Latn: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
idu_Latn: A le otú yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ipú obū ā nɛ̄ odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ā gē wɛ̄ɛcɛ ī lúlé á.

eng_Latn: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
idu_Latn: Ó géē wɛ ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛyitáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā. Íne ā kahíníī, yíihɔtū tá ɔ́mpa awɔ bɛ̄ɛka iyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú Óndú ā nɛ. Ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ágábá tɛ̄hɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka lɛ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ahínyá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔhi. Ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
idu_Latn: Olíla í cíkā ō lā oyēeyī kú abahi ŋ́. Ɔfiyɛ í cíkā ō wɛ otrɛ̄yí ámāŋ ka o wɛ ɔkpani kú ācɛ nɛ̄hi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Igbómína ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, ó cɛ̄ ɛlā kú Óndú ā, ɔdā nēé gē nwū lɛyíkwu Óndú ā klla kē le hɛ́ ɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ o je iyī ce ɔdā nēé wɛ ŋ́ ma, géē yɔ̄ i gɔbū ŋmá obɔ̄bí ga obɔ̄bí tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, é gē pllá ācɛ, ācɛ ke í plá uwá.

eng_Latn: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka a kwú pīya ɔyínɛ̄ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, nōo gwá amɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nōo ma um ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ uwɔ má uláyi, n lɔfú lɛ ɔtū mū uwɔ ɔtū, nɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, A híī ma eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú nū, ámāŋ ɔhi mɛ́mla ojoklóbīya kú nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka n tá kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́, ohígbū ka, ami Óndú ā í gē má ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē má ɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Olɛɛcɛ gē má eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ōfōōfūnū, amáŋ ami, Óndú ā gē má ipú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́futa lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di túbá nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem, klla le uwá yálé. Ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem tɛtɛ le ka ka uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ugílɛ̄di nēe bá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ ā, wɛ ācɛ nēe kwu ŋmá ajɛ kú ācɛ Ɛ́frem.

eng_Latn: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ le ā ó cíkā ō gekwú, ohígbū ó ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ulá ce ofu igwó ā le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ukéyīla bōōbū. Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ le kwu ŋmá Ukéyīla ā, ó klla nyɔ̄ Ukéyīla ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kahíníī, Ɔyí gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā nū. Ɔfiyɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce óndú nū. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ami wɛ ádā aá á nɛɛ, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce um ŋ́ mā ā? Aá le eyī gwō um bónū, nááná, aá gē da um ɔ̄kā ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ gē le eyī gwū uwɔ bónū āa.

eng_Latn: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nyi nɛɛ, ācɛ kú Umídiya gē wā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki, mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā gē wā í kpɛ́fu tá uwā.

eng_Latn: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ īkpīije éyi bī gé lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ifotó mla iyē kú ɔ̄nyɛ bá ɔ̄ ā? É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ákú Usísa nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
idu_Latn: Udánīyɛlu yɔ̄ āhɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú nū nyā jāā gaá kwu iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄s je pīya ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá kóō le yɔ̄. Ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá ā kē má yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka aá he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū nɛ̄hi ayínɛ́ alɔ, ɔ́ɔmā yá nōó lɛ aá fu klla lɛ aá fukɔ̄ lɛ iyī nū á.

eng_Latn: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ kéē bī tāajɛ fíyɛ́ o je ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú íne ā ŋmónyí.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Oklóbīya um, yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a wā amānyā ohígbū nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é wā gaá lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú, bī ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōó yá nyā le tá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ n gā ā, n géē tū ɔ̄ ɛlá kwu ɔdā nōó yá ā, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nōó ka lɛyíkwu alɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó ī ka ā. Ó wɛ ɔdā nyā ōfūnū nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā ŋ́, ó gē mīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá wā ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́ mā a, ó klla gē cɛ̄ ká ācɛ ɔhá kéē mīyɛ ācɛ ā tū ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋ́. Ó klla gē kóō lɛ ācɛ ā kpó nū ŋmá ipú icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpani kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo jé ula nɛ̄hi nyā cɛ̄tra anú ohígbū ula kú nū. Ó kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ayí kú ɛcɛ nyā jé ula ō yá mɛ́mla ɔdā kú ɛcɛ nyā fíyɛ́ ayí kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ á.

eng_Latn: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
idu_Latn: Aígelī kú Árāba, Umídin, Usɛkáda, bá ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ipí kú ɔkpíyē ā wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, noó kē lipú fíyɛ́ ɔkpíyē ɛga ohile ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔnwu kú nū í je pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ ā ipú inu ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
idu_Latn: Alɔ bá ī pó ijē kú ocɛ̄tra ŋmá ɛga oligbó yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa. Amáŋ, ami ā í lɛ eyīyōce dúúmā ŋ́. N le jī ɛɛ́. Ācoyíbīyajɛ ā bá ī yíbīyājɛ gɔbū kpɔ́. Ibīyājɛ kú uwá kē yɔ̄ ī bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ klla kwú alítā nɛ̄ anúɔ le tū ohí ā ú, lɛ ɔ gwó bónū, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē gwō ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo cokónu lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́ tū ŋ́ mā bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gwō alítā nyā bónū ā. Ɔwɔicō géē mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā. Ó klla í cɛ̄ lɛ aá tá abɔ̄ áncā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ójila nēe jīla bá abɔ́ɔ ā cɛ̄ duu ka Amɛn, anɔ́ɔ é le cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ā lɛ okónu nɛ̄ é ce yá.

eng_Latn: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō bī ɛlā icííci kú íjéeyī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ lɛ aá pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū ŋ́. É bī ɔdōnwū kú ɔlɛɛcɛ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí aálelékwū nēe yɔ̄ ī gbō ɛcɛ ā, ɔdōnwū ā í ŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú eko kú uwā táajɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ gē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ koó jé ɔ̄ kéē kwɛyí ɔkpíyē mɛ́mla oyī kú Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́ eko nōó í lé klla gē gwá ŋmá íkókwū ā, ayíka Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɔ̄ italā.

eng_Latn: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ímma wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa cigwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā géē yá ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó kú uwā kéē kwinya ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā yɔ̄ í nuunu lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka enyi nōo yɔ̄ gē pɛ́ ā mɛ ámāŋ koó yɔ̄ í pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū kpɔ́. Ó kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le ikpó gbo ajɛ, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ le hɛ́ ɔ̄ iyē, nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jé ɔ̄, ɛlā nɛ̄ a gē ka lɛ ɔ́ ā gē je ɔfú tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā iyē, kóō cāŋjɛ háyi.

eng_Latn: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kéē géē yá Ujówābu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú nū italā piyóó ohígbū ācɛ nōó kpó ŋmó ā. Amáŋ Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ayááyí kú Udéfīdi nēe gē cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē yá ka ɔdōlé kóō yā wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Ācɛ ā kē í nyɔ̄ í tú ɔdōlé kú ɛ̄cī ékpónú ōfōōfūnū bá. N géē bī ɔwɛ nyā le jé uwā má, ɔ́dāŋ ké géē lɛyitáajɛ lɛ ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n géē tū ā.

eng_Latn: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí kwú ŋmó kwú cē wā ajɛ, ācɛnyā gē kpó uwā le kwu ɔlá. Ohígbū íla kú ācɛ nyā ā, nēé jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō nōo yá uwá ā, í gāa méyīnyinyi uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nōo gē yá olɔhi dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
idu_Latn: Agbénú ō lɛ gē plla ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ejé gē plla ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ācɛ oyúnwɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́cɛ ā í gáā mlɛ́nyɔ̄ nū glá ŋ́, Unwū ɔ̄dā ō yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɔlékwū nɛ̄ ó gē mu ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́ɔmā yá nēé ī mīyɛ ajɛ tāabɔ̄ ŋmá éwo éyi ga éwo ɔhá, o yá kéē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā pīya ācɛ ɔdā abɔ̄yi ūwā.

eng_Latn: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ ɛlā dúúmā nɛ̄ n nwū uwā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēe gē mīyɛ ahɔ̄ dúúmā nɛ̄ n pi uwá anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le íkwu je lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū ohile ā. Kóō klla nwū ācɛ nēe ī nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā ā íjéeyī.

eng_Latn: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
idu_Latn: N gē cɛ̄tra uwɔ igbo ahāapa ɛ̄cī ékpónú, ohígbū ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nāa gē hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da Udéfīdi ka adá kú anúɔ Umérabu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ á. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū. Amáŋ Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē lɔtuce, nɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú kú Óndú ā lɛ anúɔ piyóó. Usɔ́lu gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya géē je ɔ́ ŋmó mɛ́ɛ̄ á, cɛ́ɛ́ ó wɛ anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gē yúufi ka alɔ géē nyɔ̄ í gbo ɛcɔ̄ ā, é le ánkɔ ɛnɛ nōo ŋmá igbīhi kú úgbéenyi ā tá wā í táajɛ ipú éŋkpɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ gbā le Ɔwɔicō kú eyī kóō le nyā.

eng_Latn: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔhá nēe yá jɛ̄ o yúklɔ́ nyā ŋ́ mā ŋ́. É gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ó wɛ ɔdā ɔ́hi nēé lɔfú yá ije o le lé ɔdōlé ŋmá anú glá ā. Amáŋ alɔ ā gē lɛyítáajɛ, alɔ kē ī yúklɔ́ kú alɔ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó. Alɔ gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi oŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō má ɔ̄ fú lɛ alɔ ā, abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, alɔ klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya le jīla, lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ́ kú ɛfú kú uwā kwu pī igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ussúnɛm, Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū le aáklɔ̄kpɛ́ kú ɛfú kú uwá kwu ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugílibōwa.

eng_Latn: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ aá le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ agbénú kú ɔdā dóódu kpó lɛ aá, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé lɛyíkwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá gē tɔ́ɔna nū tɛ́ɛcɛ dóódu glá ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gā um kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyíkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ká ē klla lɛ eyī yɛ omiya kú nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka uwēyī ká ō lɛ uwá kwú ohígbū ucē ɔ́bíipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le igbō mɛ́mla eje nōó he ā je lɛ Ísɔ á. Ó le lé le enyi gwá, anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ kú nū á. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ísɔ leyī gwō ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú nū bónū á.

eng_Latn: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Ísāka ā kahíníī, Ka ɔ́hí nɛ̄ Usébūlɔn gē tá ŋmá ísu ā kóō ga ɔ́ lɛ ɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú agbénú kú Ísáaka kóō nyīla ipú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.
idu_Latn: É tá uwá ohi kéē wā ká aá gaá kpɛ́fú tā Uláyissi. É ka aá le ajɛ ā má ɛɛ́, ó kē lɔhi nɛ̄hi. É da uwá kéē bá abɔ́ɔ áncā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ká aá nyɔ̄ fíyaa. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they set them up Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
idu_Latn: Ojibó kú Umíka ā kwu abɔ́ɔ eko dóódu, ɛ́gɛ́ eko nɛ̄ Áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ Ussílo í kwu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
idu_Latn: A géē blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yá ucē lɛ a, o géē tū uwɔ uwēyī, eko nɛ̄ adá uwɔ, mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kwúcē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ. N géē kpó uwá gā uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ā, nááná nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā í wɛ āyā kú okónu nɛ̄ n ce gā uwɔ ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ācɛ nēé kɛlā nū lɛ uwá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā, é géē mɛ́ɛbɛ. Ācɛ nēé pó ɛlā ohígbū nū jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā géē jɛ́yí ká ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n nya oyeēyī kú uwɔ tá ícɛ nyā, ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ ákú um nyatá, ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú. Kóō klla lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le aígabɔ̄ ɛnɛ ā fu cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ īlī kpó lɛ ācɛ nēe tóohɛ́ɛwa, mɛ́mla áblákpá, mɛ́mla ɔdōgwá mɛ́mla ɔdōlé kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, ŋmá ipú aíyó nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. É le anɔ̄ tū ágbe kú uwā, é klla le ācɛ nēe gbagbafú ā kpó ce ijakī kú uwā. É le odúúdú ācɛ nēé kwú ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā, kpó kwúcē le tá ajɛ kú Ujérīko, igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔcí alī. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ uwā Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔdōōjé nɛ̄ agbénú olɔhi alɛwa ī mu ipú ínu éyééye á.

eng_Latn: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka íne ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Amáŋ ami ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu icííci nɛ̄ n, ɔ̄cɛ nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú lá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā lɛ ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá le jīla eko kú Ucɛ kú Aáklɔ́kpɛ ā, ipú ɔyā kú Etánim, nōo wɛ ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa ā á.

eng_Latn: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ gaá da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Udéfīdi kahíníī, Ó wɛ awɔ gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ga um ká n̄ lā anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔdā olɔhi ō yá le yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí lé.

eng_Latn: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, ɔcí dúúmā ɔhá, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nē é kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu lɛ ā, í klla gáā jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka anú ā, ɛɛ́ nōo ī gáā kwu ojuja gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú ɔcí ā géē gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛcɛ ā, klla í pɛ́ ga ɔlékwu ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe kwú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
idu_Latn: Aá géē kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛhīlī ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó jégēdē ŋ́ le ɔcɛ́ ŋmó, lɔfú kwu nyɔ̄ glá. Aá klla í kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ofɛpa blá aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú enyi ā, ó má ɔkpáncō le nwūla, anɔ́ɔ alelékwū Ihɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā yɔ̄ ī wāajɛ gaá ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ga Ugíbēyi ā, ígwu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ gaá jīla anú ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú, alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú ɔ́ ú, anɔ́ɔ, ó gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ mla uwá klla gbɔɔ́ ō jīījē mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ukúss ā kē gāajɛ, gaá da ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, n bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi gé lɛ uwɔ. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ uwɔ hɛ́tá ícɛ nyā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēé cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu uwɔ á ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ úláyi, pī ɛga nɛ̄ ɔnyā éyi lā ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ pī inu ɔlɛ́ ɔnyā ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwɔ, ɛga nēé géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ ā, da uwá ka, amíyɔ̄ kahíníī, Ōcē kē í kpó ācɛ ōhī kú uwā ŋmó. Abɔ̄ nēé ge nyɔ̄ ā, ācɛ ōhī, ɛfu géē je uwá kpó ŋmó. Abɔ̄ nēé géē nyɔ̄ ā, ɔkpɛtā géē je uwá kpó ŋmó. Abɔ́ɔ nēé géē nyɔ̄ á, é géē kpó ācɛ ohile ā kéē wɛ aálagbá kú ɛfú nyɔ̄ ajɛ éwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya nyā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujehóyākim, nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, yá ā.

eng_Latn: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, ó géē bī okóhō ɛpa mɛ́mla ɔklɛ́ɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayí Ulífāyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhāti mɛ́mla Ukóra ā cāŋjɛ le ɛgba dɛ̄ gbōmgbōm le cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū yɛ otú gbɔ́ ɔ̄ci ŋmá Ugígal kéē nyɔ̄ Ugíbeyɔn, kéē gáā nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn acígilí.

eng_Latn: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla Ācɛ Ufárisīi lɛ ójila ohɛ́pɔ̄ hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ā gē yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ alɛwa.

eng_Latn: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
idu_Latn: Aógwugwu géē gwó ɔlɛ́ uwā, í tá ayi, í hɛ́ ayí, klla í bī ayí uwa jɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ. Aɔ́ɔgɔ géē bā ī jīla abɔ́ɔ. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kē lɛ ɔbá nū ámāŋ ka ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ úlā ofɛpa ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ ɔyípɛ̄ oklóbīya ā tū kwúcē le abɔ̄ pí ɔ́ ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Ā híī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka a lɛ ɛlā nyā ka gā um ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
idu_Latn: N lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́ɛyīpɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú aá. N kē yɔ̄ ī hī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔlɛɛcɛ dóódu igwú.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, eko nɛ̄ aá le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ tíne ō yá ɔdā nōo ī he Óndú ā ɔtū, ɛga dúú nɛ̄ alɔ bá ā, ka alɔ kōō bá ipú ɔkpíyē kú alɔ kpɔ́ oo amáŋ ka alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, ācɛ kú Uhám le tá Ugɛ́ra gaá lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ācɛ abɔ́ɔ nēé gwó kwu ajɛ ā kpó catāajɛ. É lɛ uwá kpó nū ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, klla má lā abɔ́ɔ piyóó ohígbū ka ácí yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aálá kú uwā géē lé.

eng_Latn: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nōo je Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū klla lɛ ɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kpó lɛ ɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, ká aá klla cɛ̄ ka ɛlā nōó ka ā géē yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛga nēé hi ka Ákōklō ɛyí ā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Uróm le Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla aúwī ɛpa ā nyɔ́kpá abɔ́ɔ. Uwī éyi yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū, ɔhá kē yɔ̄ abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ odée nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ka odée nɔ̄wá mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ gaá kwú ɛgiyí ínálēgbé ā, ó géē ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ Ujerúsālɛm, ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛ ɔ́ ā. Da ɔ́ ka, É ma uwɔ ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan. Ádā uwɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ámɔn, ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Uhɛ́ti.

eng_Latn: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le ɔ́kpa kú ojuja ā má okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, odúúdú ācɛ ā gē túkpɛɛ́ ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má aódée nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka, aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú owu nɛ̄hi ā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka alɛɛcɛ ā amáŋ.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú Óndú ā gbɔɔ́ ō kpɔ́ɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē eko nōó yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usóra mɛ́mla Ɛ́ssitāwolu ɛgiyí ɛga nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ń cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yá ŋ́, ámāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ n lɛ efūma tū gaá kwú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ú kpó lé, ámāŋ n lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klā ajɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o kwáahi eko nēé je ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá ā. Amáŋ oŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō ā Ohɔ́nyɛtá yēeyī kpɔ́. Alɔ ā dúú ā, le kwáahi ipú ōpīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ alɔ gā Ukɔrinti wā í le yá mla aá, alɔ géē pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo yēeyī ā cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ géē lɛ ɛdɔ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nēe í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā, omlɛ́nyɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāāpa ā, hile lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā géē yɔ̄ mla aá eko kpiíí. Aá yāwu eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, ká obū kóō lɛ aá kwú ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yāwu ipú obū, í jé ɛga nɛ̄ ó gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń gáā mā ō kɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē mā ō gwíijē cɛ̄tra anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
idu_Latn: É le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aíyó kú nū, aágá kú nū, aɔ́kpá kú nū, aógbló ō tōkónu ɔlɛ́ kú nū, aɔ́kpa kú nū mɛ́mla aígbóoje-otáajɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā alɛwa kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā, é klla mīyɛ ajɛ kú nū ŋmá ɛhíícō kú ísu kú Ámɔn ga ɛhíícō kú Ujábɔ̄ku jāā ga ajɛ kú Ámɔn, ohígbū ka Ujása wɛ ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn á.

eng_Latn: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛbɛdimɛ́lɛ̄ki le tá inu okpíyó tū kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā gáā lɛ aáhingílí kpó, kwú uwā í kpó tū ɔ́ngbá lɛ ɔ́ tá ga ajɛ gé lɛ Ujeremíya á.

eng_Latn: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
idu_Latn: Aólɔdu ā le aíkonó kú uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í tíne éŋkpɔ̄. É le tá obugā ā, é má éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́. É kwú ɔjá ú wā ɔlɛ́ áncā. Ɔtū kú uwā le bīya, ó klá yá uwā eyījii. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú abɔ̄ ú pīya klá eyī ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbō Ísrɛ̄lu ā, í gē gbiyɔ̄lā cɛɛyí ŋ́, amáŋ ó gē leyī gwɛcɛ gɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
idu_Latn: N tóohi kahíníī, Aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ wɛ aólíla. É da Óndú ɔ̄kā kóo bī uwā jé ɔwɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ nēé gwōnū dúúdú, nēé kē je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ kpó fíyákátā ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
idu_Latn: Blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nwuné lɛ ā. Anú jé ō nwū ɔ̄cɛ odée fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī nwū ɔ̄cɛ odée ā á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄ji aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Usɛkaríya yá kpɛ́mm ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó aɛ́cɔ̄ o gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā kwu ɔ́: uberile, ukánēliyan mɛ́mla ujáspa kwu ɔgba ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā. É kpó uwā kwu ugóolu ojílatɔ̄há ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nyɔ̄ gaá da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, N géē hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá úklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ aá bá gē yá lɛ ācɛ kú íjīpiti nyā. N géē je abɔ̄ ōlɔfú kú um ā gicō lɛ yá uwā italā nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ aá hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
idu_Latn: Aá gē je ijē kú ɛbɛ́ lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwɛ́ɛya kú aá, aá klla ī je ejé lɛ uwá kéē gwá. Kéē wā í tá aá abɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ, kéē kwinya wā í hɛ́ aá tá.

eng_Latn: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
idu_Latn: Kwú íjééyī ú bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ā. Ká ɛyí ɔdā ōjé kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka oklóbīya uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā ka kwɛyí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka lɛ aá nyā pó tū ahɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi! É géē je ami, Ɔ̄yínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
idu_Latn: Óndú nū ā le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá kéē yá ɔ̄ ōwē jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ odúúdú ulé ā cílá ā.

eng_Latn: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
idu_Latn: A jé ɔwɛ ga ɛga nɛ̄ n gē yá kú ɔwɔ kóō límanya ŋmá ā, ámāŋ nɛ̄ owu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī gē tá ŋmá āa?.

eng_Latn: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
idu_Latn: N jé cāā ka ōwē nɛ̄ alɔ ī má abālɔbányā í wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ ɔ́ gbla ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi nēé gáā je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udáyírɔ̄si lɛ ohi kú ɔkpá kú uwá tá gē lɛ uwá kahíníi, Utatɛ́nāyi igbómína kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi, Ussɛ́ta Ubósenāyi mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyī úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
idu_Latn: É gē bá ī kɛlā olɔhi kú Utobíya iyɔ̄bū um eko dóódu. Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla gē ka lɛ Utobíya ɛlā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ Utobíya yɔ̄ í tɔ́kpá fu um eko dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē tū um ufi.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
