idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda cāŋjɛ mla ɛgba, gbɔɔ́ ō nū ācɛ Ufilístiya inya jāā ga Ugáti mɛ́mla okónu igá kú Ɛ́krɔn ā. Ācɛ Ufilístiya nēé yágbe ā bá ajɛ ɔwɔɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Ussarem jāā ga Ugáti mɛ́mla Ɛ́krɔn.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē lé ɔdōlé ipú inu ɔlɛ́ Umátīyu ā, ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācobīyíne alɛwa yāajɛ mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
idu_Latn: Ufi ī yá um ohígbū kóō í bɔ̄bí lɛ alɔ kéē le ɛlā kpó ce alɔ ka alɔ ī dɔɔ̄kā ō cīlɛ̄fú, alɔ í kē gáā má ɔkɔ olɔhi ka nóó n.

eng_Latn: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da aá ohígbū ācɛ o héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ā wɛ ayí kú Ulíbini mɛ́mla Ussímēyi.

eng_Latn: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē je ɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē bī le gbō ācɛ. É í cɔcɛ́ géē bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi le gbō odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā kpɛ́mm. Ɔfú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwā nyā í gáā mɛ gɛ ŋ́. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ ā í cɛ̄ ūwā ɛhɔ̄ klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti le ɛbɔ́ yá mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā piíí, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú abɔ̄yīnū ā, kú aá lā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē má oyēeyī okpaakpa nōo géē yá kú ɔtū kóō he Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhīlī ce úlā ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ kú Íjīpiti éyi hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācogbāálá ɔhá ā á. Ó klla lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ pi lɛ alɔ klla le kpó lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ kú alɔ le gwá.

eng_Latn: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
idu_Latn: Ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa ā lɛ odúúdú ayíkpó ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ é da uwá kahíníī, Ó cíkā nɛ̄ alɔ ī habɔ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō tá ká ālɔ̄ kɔ̄ ɔdōlé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ucɛ nyā géē blatū alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbō bá abɔ̄ amáŋ o gbō bá údɔ̄bū kú alɔ ā. Ó géē blatū alɔ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā le kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
idu_Latn: ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá ī leyī gwū um bónū lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛcá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe wɔ́tū um ā gē cá um ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Uhɛsɛkíya mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda le īyī uwā tú wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā í klla yá ācɛ Ujúda italā gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya kwú á.

eng_Latn: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nōo le jīla ā gā ā, ɔdā nōo jīla ŋ́ mā géē bī tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
idu_Latn: Ufi nɛ̄hi le um kwú. Ojīlīmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ī le ce um ā mɛ bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ mu ā. Eyī nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ce ka n gē yálé ā mɛ bɛ̄ɛka ojuja nōo ī je kpó owu ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aádáádā aá yá um cɔ̄nū ā, n lɛ ífi tútū gbēyī uwā, ń pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nēé le kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū lé ga um, ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā ka. Eko nɛ̄ n le ka kwɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú yá um okónu gɔbū.

eng_Latn: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Oyī kú nū kóō ce alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ nēe lā ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e lā ɛyí ɛfu, ikpó ɛfu, mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ ā jāā kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ ē la pī ísu kú Umeditarénīya ā ga ɛhícō kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā, lɛ ɔ̄kā, kú ācɛ Ái nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa yálé ā pó. Aɔ́cɛ́ nēe pó ā bá yɔ̄ á: ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́ti, Ámɔn, Ukénan, Upɛ́risi, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi.

eng_Latn: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé nōo klla gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da ɔ́ kóō yá ā gajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: úlā ahātá .

eng_Latn: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, ohígbū ojámá nōo géē yá, nōo í yá kú aá bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō. Odo le tútū amáŋ ɔkpíyē ā le gbagbafú.

eng_Latn: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
idu_Latn: Yá ká ayínɔ̄nyilɔ kú alɔ kéē jɛ̄ lɔfú eko ɔyípōklóbīya kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo jɛ̄ lɔfú ŋmá ajɛ ā. Ká ayínɔ̄nyā kú alɔ kéē lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka aúpíla nēé le yá ɔ́kíkā kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ifa ā.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi Urámɔ̄tu nōo yɔ̄ Ugílɛ̄di nōo klla wɛ , Umáhanēm.

eng_Latn: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okpé gē nwū ayí nū kéē wu ā, ó gē nā acá kú nū áŋda gē kwú ayí nū ce ɔ́ eko nēé gbɔɔ́ ō míya. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē gbō ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī gwōnū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi yɔ̄ ī yá um bɔ̄dā nɛ̄ géē kwú ā. Aá bá amānyā kú aá leyī kwɛɛcɛ mɛ́mla um.

eng_Latn: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
idu_Latn: Ń lɛ aójɛɛ́lɛ́ ce um bá ŋ́ nɛ̄ aá gē bī ɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí um kóō yá ucē kú ɛ́lɛ́ kú nū ā iyɔ̄bū um āā.

eng_Latn: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
idu_Latn: Ɔnū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ ā í gáā mɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔdā nōo bī ɔtū ō yá ā yá kwɛyí. Igbīhāajɛ ā, aá géē jɛ́yí ɔdā nyā péee.

eng_Latn: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ubérīya wɛ Ahíyo, Ussássāki, Ujɛ́rɛ̄mɔtu.

eng_Latn: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And it came to pass, as the ark of God came to Ekron, that the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us, to slay us and our people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ugáti kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá kú Ufílīstiya nēé hī ka Ékron ā. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ó gā ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, ācɛ kú Ékrɔn ā gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū, gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ kéē kwú ikpati ɛka kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú bī wā ɔlɛ́ aá, kóō gaá je odúúdú aá kpó ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī iyē nū ka, Ugolíyati ā ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ugáti ā, le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Ufilístiya wā gē lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔtū eko dóódu. Ó klla gē cá uwā ɛcá ī je lé ícííci. Ó jɛ̄ licō fíyɛ́ ikpó ahāapa kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
idu_Latn: É kōō le ujɔ̄ tū dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tū ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufáyin kú uwā ŋ́. Ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá ā nyi tū ɔ̄, ka ɛ́ɛ gáā lé ɔdā nēé nyi tū ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē lé īkpɔ́cí kú ufáyín ā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ odúúdú nū kwú pīya ákú Óndú ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyā ahāapa ā géē gla ā, é géē fu ācɛ kéē bá ī yɛ ī jila ajɛ ā ga ɛbɛɛbɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká e géē kpó okwū ɔhá dúúmā nēe géē hile bá ɛcɛ ā nyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ē kwú ajɛ ā ú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gāājɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ācɛ icɔ́ɔci mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā mīyɛ uwá lɔɔlɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī uwā yá ā kpó ka lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē bī ɛcá ī ka obɔ̄bí kú ɔdā dúú nēé jɛ́ɛyí nū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ aɔ́dā nēé jɛ́ɛyí uwā bɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ nēé gē gbɛlá ŋ́ mā gē jé ɛyí ɔdā ā, wɛ aɔ́dā nēe gē kpó uwā yíífi á.

eng_Latn: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
idu_Latn: Aá le ɔdā nōo géē yá oócí ā ka lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ le jé ɔ́dāŋ ka aá wɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Aá lɛ ɔdā olɔhi éyi ámāŋ ɔdā obɔ̄bí éyi yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ mɔ́ɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔ́ má cɛ́ɛ́ okónu í hɛ́ alɔ ŋ́, ufi nɛ̄hi kē lɛ ālɔ̄ kwú.

eng_Latn: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá. Aá híī lé ɛbɛ́ kú uwā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó gbā ojibó nyā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, é géē je ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ ga ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā.

eng_Latn: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn lɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nū gāá lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu a kahíníī, Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔlɛ́ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú nyā, aá kóō híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔda dúúmā kú uwā ŋ́, ohígbū nēé géē kpó aá yíífi bónū mla ācɛ obɔ̄bí nyā.

eng_Latn: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti klla lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á gáā cīla ɔ̄kā dóódu ŋ́ mā? Jāhɔ̄ tá odúúdú ɔdā nēé kpó ce uwɔ ā!.

eng_Latn: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
idu_Latn: É géē je agbénú kú uwā kpó wu klla í je aɔ́lɛ́ kú uwā tá alácɛ̄. É gáā lā ipú inu alɛwa nēé bá ī gwó ā ŋ́. É klla kē gáā gwá ejé kú ɔcí ufáyin nēé yɔ̄ ī tū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē ka ā wɛ ka aá híīī lé tɔ̄há mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo hī iyīnū ka ɔyínɛ́ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, amáŋ nōó gē cikpɔ́nyā ámāŋ gē yúnwū ɔdā, ámāŋ gē pɛ̄cí, amáŋ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī bīya ācɛ ɔhá iyē, ámāŋ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gwá ejé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ámāŋ wɛ ācowūwī. Aá kōō híīī cīce lé ɔdōlé tɔ̄há mla ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne kóō le mafú yēŋēē lɛ ācɛ nōó cokónu lɛ uwá ā, ka ɔtū kú anúɔ í gáā pīyaabɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā, ó lɛ ɔkpá gbo.

eng_Latn: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ āa, eko nɛ̄ Upíta le tá Ujerúsālɛm ā, ācɛ ōhī kú ipú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú apī ō hɛ́ aílɔ́wá ā le ɔdā ka tū ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya lɛ Ubárūku, ɔyí kú Unérīya hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ā ka lɛ Ubárūku, anɔ́ɔ́ ó lɛ uwā tá tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ klla da ɔ́ ká ɔ́ɔ blakwu Ussímēyi, ɔyí kú Ugɛ́ra, nōo ŋmá Ubahúrim, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ cá anúɔ ɛcá nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ anúɔ ga Umahanayím ā. Ó ka amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wā í jīla anúɔ ɔwɛ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, anúɔ bī iyē kú Óndú ā le okónu ce lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ í gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, abɔ̄ kú nū gáā bī ɔyī nēé tá iyē kú Ujerúsālɛm tū ɔɔ́ ā. Ɔ́ɔmā ī da ɔ́ ka ɔɔ̄ lɛ ɛgba kú ɛfú dɛ̄, kéē nyɔ̄ í gbɔɔ́ ō ca ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm. Ká ō kwú otúta kú ɛfú ā ú kwu ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ō lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū tū ɔ̄ lɛ íbɔm ce tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mofɛpa cigwó, ɛ̄cī éyi igbīhi Usábáti ɔ́mahāapa ā, aá lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛhɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɔhá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ odahɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó klla kɛlā glá ŋ́ bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
idu_Latn: É géē yá ɔdā nēe bá ā ohígbū kéē jé Ádā ā ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēe kē í jé um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúdasi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le yɛ tá ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ákú aídengéli kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ nōó géē yíbīyājɛ tū Ujísɔ̄si cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú tū uwā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō lɔfú je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, kóō lɛ ɔhā kú ɛbɔ́ hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
idu_Latn: Oohile kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lígíii a, gēe kwúcē wā ɛga īyī Ɔwɔicō kú uwá, nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a píii.

eng_Latn: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti le tá ipú agbla ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ujísɔ̄si hīgwú lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ahínyá, a géē leyīkwu aígelī ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ami abɔ̄yī um géē nyɔ̄ mla awɔ, n kē í je omlɛ́nyɔ́ ga uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka kpɛ́mm nyā wɛ olígíí kú ɔdā nɛ̄hi nōó yá ɛɛ́ mā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ pó ā wɛ oŋiniŋini kú ɔdā nōó yá ā. Ɔnyɛ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla gbɛ lɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔfú tū aálá nēe kwáhi ā iyē ŋ́. Aá nyā aɛ́nɛ̄ e ī doōcē ā tá ŋ́. Aá tá ágbe kú aɛ́nɛ̄ ágbe yá uwá ā ŋ́. Aá pīya aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ī bí ā ɛyí wā ɔlɛ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá klla tine aɛ́nɛ̄ e gebí ā ká aá kpó uwā wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá gē bī ɔnɔɔtū le gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je Ísrɛ̄lu pīya ɔnyā anúɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í kɛlā ā, ka anúɔ í yá ucē okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔkwɛ̄yi mla anú, Ó ka anúɔ í yíihɔtū nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ tū ɔ̄. Anúɔ klla í ményīnyi nū.

eng_Latn: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gē yá odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā, nɛ̄ ń kē ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, aá gbɛlá ka ami ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka aá ā nɛɛ. Amáŋ abālɔbányā, n géē gbɔɔ́ ō pi aá ahɔ̄, géē je odúúdú ɛlā yá téeyī péee lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ iyɔ̄lā lɛ aá eyī kwú nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe cíkā ō wɛ eyī ōmɛ́ɛbɛ́ kú aá, eyī kpó gbō ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛhɔ̄, kóō híīī wā ɔlɛ́ gaá je úwé kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá ka ɔ̄na ā gā um ŋ́, n géē yá odúúdú aá italā. Aá le ojuju yá klla cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ká aá lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā gā um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka aá gbɛlá ka eko kpiíí, odée géē je pīyabɔ̄. Aá lɛ ɔ̄na ā ka gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē jé ka aá lɔfú ka ɛyí nū gā um glá.

eng_Latn: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbīgwíijē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ Udéfīdi bī le gwííjē ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā klla háyi abɔ́ɔ mla opo kú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
idu_Latn: ohígbū kéē jɛ́ɛyí kú úklɔ́ o hídáagó kú ɔwɛ nɛ̄ igbō mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa ā le jɛ̄ ācɛ úlá igwɛ́ɛpa cofigwó ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔtū kú uwā le lɔfú, é klla cɛ̄ ɛlā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Yɔ̄ amānyā gbēyī um, ohígbū ka Óndú le ɛhɔ̄ tū um ga Ubɛ́tɛlu ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ Óndú ā yēeyī ā, nɛ̄ awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ klla yēeyī ā, ń gáā cīghīhi gwū uwɔ tá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le tá Ubɛ́tɛlu á.

eng_Latn: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n habɔ̄ ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ō yá tá, klla kwú igbīhi ú ce kwu oōgɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Ń gbɛlá ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nōo fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄hi nōo le fíyɛ́ ɔdā ō jé kú um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
idu_Latn: Aíkpō nēé nyi ajɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā, kwɛyí ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā āa, nōo kē mīyɛ ɛlā ā ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā mla éeyē.

eng_Latn: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
idu_Latn: Ínoōbīya ā bī íne ā, lɛ um plla, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikwū bī gé um á.

eng_Latn: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
idu_Latn: O lɔhi o bī le gwɔ́ɔ́lá ofōōfūnū. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛyí ɛplɛ́ɛpa kwú kpó yɔlá, nɛ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū le pá fiyuu, a klla bī ɔ̄ le yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi igwɛ́ɛtá lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka, Unáfutāli, Ássa mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ajɛ kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwɔhá ā, le yɛ um jīla tá, amáŋ o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Óndú ā, n le odúúdú uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kē lɛ aíne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú anúɔ tū eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ íne kú anúɔ tū, klla yá ucē nōo he anúɔ ɔtū ā, ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ mla anú klla í gwó ɔlɛ́ ɔkwɛ̄yí lɛ ɔ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē má ka ayááyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ géē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́ igbīhi nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu le yɛ tá ɛga nēé gē tá īkpɔ̄dā owu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ Íssmɛ̄lu kwú aɔ́fíyɛ́ ā lɛ Ujohánan mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja má ā, ɔtū he uwá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
idu_Latn: Ássa lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nōo lé ka Usɛ́ra.

eng_Latn: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔhá, ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá Ubaalssalíssa lɛ igbō kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ofu bī gē lɛ Ɛláyíssa mla ɔcí igbāmkpa ō hile nēe wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ dúú ā. Ɛláyíssa da Ugɛ́hási kɔ́ ɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́wá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kéē lé.

eng_Latn: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī hī uwɔ igwú, lɛ um nyatá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
idu_Latn: Aá géē wi ŋmá ipú ɔlá kú ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́daŋ ka aá gē kɛlā klla ī yá ucē okpaakpa. Aá híī bī abɔ̄ kú aá le pīya ācɛ tū mīyɛ uwā ije, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē mīyɛ omíci lé ŋ́. Aá híī cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī tū ujɔ̄ ō nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ o nyɔ̄ í yá ɛdɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá kē cɛ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá í wɛ ipú kú aálá kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē pīyɛ ɔtángbédē ŋmá aɛ́cɔ̄ kú ipú ajɛ, é kē ī pīyɛ ugóolu ŋmá ipú úmlá kú nū.

eng_Latn: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Áhābu le yɛ kóō lé ɔdōlé cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kē gwá odée dúú ā, Ɛláyíja le tá icīīcō kú ɛfú kú Ukámɛlu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó túkpɛɛ́ wāajɛ le eyī bū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú okwúukwu kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛcɔ̄ nōó le ɛyí ce ɔ́ ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwaajɛ kóō lɛ pīya ɔdā oblatū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le anɔ̄ pīya klá anú ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē nya aógbɛhá tá ŋmá ikwū, ó klla í hɛ́ uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe ī pīya uwá tū ā.

eng_Latn: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
idu_Latn: Ā híī lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā bīya ŋ́, ohígbū ka a ī gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔfú lé ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé dóódu glá. Ɔdōlé dóódu lɔhi ō lé ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ ó bɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō yá ɔdā nōo í yá kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kóō bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ayí kú Ulífāyi ā lɛ íkwu kéē lá odée kú uwā cīgbīhi eko dóódu glá ipú aígelī nēé je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le gbɛnú ce uwɔ ā, a le cē, le bū tū uwā ipú ácáabɔ̄ bēhé, klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ohí cē.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ámāŋ ka o lɛ abɔ̄ da ɔ́ ɛyí tāajɛ ŋ́. Aá bla ka aá tɛtɛ wɛ ācɛ éwɔhá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn klla lɛ ācocɛɔ̄ kú inu ā úlā ofu ahātá ce ulā ɛhɔ̄ . Ācɛ nēe kē í kpo ɛcɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́ ā wɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce igwó .

eng_Latn: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī usábāt ó gbɔɔ́ ō nwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā. Ācɛ alɛwa bá abɔ́ɔ, é le kpó hídáagó eko nēé pó ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ í nwū ā. Anɔ́ɔ é dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ó bī aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋmá? Íjéeyī nɛ̄hi nyá nēe je lɛ ɔ̄ lɛ ā dúú? Iní nɛ̄ ó bī ɔfú ō le yúklɔ́ idáagó kú nū ŋmá ā?.

eng_Latn: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka awɔ, Óndú ā, le ɔfú je lɛ ɔ́. Ó gē gwéeyē, ohígbū ka a cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄ le yálé.

eng_Latn: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
idu_Latn: Ńááná, éŋ́kpɔ̄ lígíí jɛ̄ ō yá nōó géē lū klla í jɛ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē lɛ íne kú um tū klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú um nɛ̄ Umósīsi je lɛ uwá ā, ayíka ń gáā nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ucɛ kú onyatá kú ācɛ Ujíyu le bá ā, Ujísɔ̄si le tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh a man's life to pledge.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ odée kplá ɔ̄cɛ, ka ɛ́ɛ híī je ɛgɔ̄ ōgbā ɔdá kú nū ká ɔ̄ wɛ ɔdōcabɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɛgɔ̄ kú nū ú lɛ ā, ayíka ɛga o lé ɔdōlé kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gwū tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
idu_Latn: É gēe nā abɔ̄ kú uwá daa bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo nā abɔ̄ daa gáā tágwā ā, yɔ̄ í tíne ɔwɛ nēé í kwu. Amáŋ Óndú ā géē je uwēyī lɛ uwá, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú uwá ɔ́ɔmā géē wāajɛ. Óndú ā géē tū ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō wā mla umu kú īkpɔ̄dā kú okoolo éyi nēé le wīya tɔ̄há mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ ólífu.

eng_Latn: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
idu_Latn: Aá píyɛga kú aá le yɛ bū ɔwɛ opíbá ā. Ohígbū ka ācɛ alɛwa géē nya cidaa kéē le bū ɔ̄, amáŋ é gaá bū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔkpíihɔ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ odúúdú ɔdée kpó bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú nū. Ɛ̄nyā téeyi péee ka ɛlā nōó ka kahíníī, Odúúdú odée, é ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū nōo kpó odúúdú odée bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne ō gwō, kóō gwō ka anúɔ jé um klla jé ipú um. Ó lɔfú gwō ka anúɔ jé ka ācɛ ī he um ɔtū piyóó, ka n gē yá ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla ɔdā nōō le kpaakpa ā ipú ɛcɛ nyā a. Ohígbū ka aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā he um ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kwú ɛ̄wā ú kóō ŋmó ɔyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
idu_Latn: Ó gáā lɔhi lɛ ɔyí dúúmā nōo lɔtū da ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ka ɔdíyá nēe ma anúɔ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ wɛ nyā āa? Ɔdíyá nēé kōō ma anúɔ dɛ̄ɛ̄ āa ŋ?.

eng_Latn: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um lɛ ohɔ́ɔnyɛtá nɛ̄ a je lɛ odúúdu ācɛ ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ okónu kú aá klá cíí ká n̄ kɛlā kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nōo géē wā í yá um nɛɛ kóō wā í yá um.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ yá lɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi lɛ anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n má Ɔyí álá ā ce ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn á. Ācɛ úlā ofigwáahātá nēe bī iyē kú Ɔyí álá ā mɛ́mla iyē kú Ádā nū fu uwá ukɔ̄ udɔbu ā bá mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē da uwá ka, Ń jé aá fúlufúlu ŋ́. Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, aá nēe gē bɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Ukɔ́ra kahíníī, Awɔ mɛ́mla aígwu kú uwɔ, mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni, aá gā iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú ā óócí ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayí nū kéē lɛ ijakī kú anúɔ tútū lɛ anúɔ. É le ijakī ā tútū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē da Ɔwɔicó ka ɔ́ɔ, mā aá tá cíí, ka aá ɔ́ɔ tíne ō jé ɔdā nōó tíne ka aá ɔ́ɔ yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kpó bɛ̄cɛ wā. É lɛ īkpēyī amáŋ é wɛ opeyī kpɔ́. É lɛ ahɔ̄ amáŋ é wɛ odahɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Uhesekíya le ɛhɔ̄ ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ayisáya ā.

eng_Latn: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá nyā le um kwú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, klla tíne kéē lɛ um ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
idu_Latn: N gē kɛlā lɛ aá abālɔbányā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē kɛlā lɛ ayí nū ā. Aá yíhɔtū tū alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ yá tū aá ā.

eng_Latn: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ujedáya, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ Ujósuwā ā, úlā ɛpa ce ofu ahātá ce ɛtá .

eng_Latn: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
idu_Latn: N má ka īkpō kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā wɛ umíta ofu, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta ɛhɔ̄. Ɔ́kika ɛnɛ ā jōnjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
idu_Latn: Ń gáā lɔtūce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɛlá ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka íne kú Ɔwɔicō ka ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
idu_Latn: ayíka ó cíkā ō bī le je ojīlīmā lɛ ádā nū gɛ ŋ́. Aá bī ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā le eyī gwū íne kú Ɔwɔicō bónū, ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī nwū abɔ̄yī aá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū uculo kú aá, aá lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō yɛ́ɛflɛ́ɛfu.

eng_Latn: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
idu_Latn: Íifu klla le ipú yɔ̄ kpɔ́ le Ébɛ̄lu nōo wɛ ɔyínɛ́ kú Ukéni ma. Eko nēé le jɛ̄ ā, Ébɛ̄lu kwú pīya ɔ̄cogbāálá amáŋ Ukéni kē wɛ ɔglɛ́ɛjí.

eng_Latn: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī ɔmɛɛtá á.

eng_Latn: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufilístiya wā í le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kwu Ujúda, le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ulɛ́hi.

eng_Latn: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū kpó higwú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nōó yá ā kpó ka lɛ uwá. Ufi le ācɛ ā kwú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ kwúcē ɔ́. Ācɛnyā nēe bá yɔ̄ ī tɛ̄gíkwū nɛ̄hi ohígbū nū ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
idu_Latn: Abídan, ɔyí kú Ugídiyɔni leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn á.

eng_Latn: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
idu_Latn: Kwu aólɔdu mɛ́mla aólɛhá géē pɛ́ kwú ipú ajɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā kpó uwā nyi, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē yēkwu kú uwá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gāa lɛ īlī ekwu wiiyē ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ge púla ɛyí kú ekwu ō yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá nū ga ɔlɛ́, yɔ̄ ī da uwá kéē ga ɔlɛ́ le gbo agbénú nɛ̄hi. Agbénú kú aɔ́dāajɛ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje ɔlamu mɛ́mla aódōwiyē alɛwa. Ó da uwá kéē lɛ aɔ́dā nēé mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā ā kɔ̄ mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá ɔlɛ́ uwā á. Umósīsi tɛtɛ kwú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú lɛ āyā éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Ujóssuwa klla kē tɛtɛ kwú ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú lɛ āyā ɔhá kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā, tɔ̄há mla aípɔ́ɔma ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
idu_Latn: Ōcē ōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi géē wā í klá aɔ́nya, aɛ́na, aínyakwūlūmī, aíjakī mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛbɛ́ kú aólɛlā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n gē da aá kú aá lɛ ɔtūlé. Ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í gáā yíífi ŋ́ ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka úgbéenyi ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujohánan, ɔyí kú Ukaréya ā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ Ujúda nēe hile pīyɛyí ŋmá éwo dóódu, ɛga nēe pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ í lā ā kpó á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwú íkókwū kú éŋkpɔ̄ ohīlaŋdɔ́ ékpó lɛ éyi kú ācɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú nēe bá āa kóō gwá ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um, n da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē mīyɛ ulé kú nū piíí.

eng_Latn: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔkpani uwā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá í gáā māháyi igelī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ abɔ́ɔ í wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā ɛpa cofigwó wā mɛ́mla anú ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njāmin. Usíba, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu ā wā mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ofu kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É kōō gāajɛ Ujɔ́dan gbɔbū lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lɛ Usedekíya eyī kpó pu klla lɛ agbá kpó kwu ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ɔ̄ ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Áhāsi yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
idu_Latn: N géē cokónu ā mla awɔ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ a le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ okwū kú uwā lɛ míya ce ɔ́, ó kōō wɛ acɔ̄lá, ó géē je tēelihɔ. Aá kē í je acɔ̄lá ɔ́ɔmā ca.

eng_Latn: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nyā le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
idu_Latn: Ojuju nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā í tīile ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbóŋgbō ā. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā wɛ áncā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo le ŋmó ā. Owu kú aá piií géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā nōo géē je aá yi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā gē je uwēyī lɛ ɔbá nū, ɔ́dāŋ koó ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ámāŋ koó yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nōó lɛ odée klá ɛyí ŋ́. Ɔdā dúú í kē wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū mla ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo lɛ ɛyí kú nū plla ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
idu_Latn: N géē ma ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō fú ga uwɔ. N géē nwū uwɔ ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́krɔn mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ yɔ̄ anú dúú.

eng_Latn: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
idu_Latn: N géē yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá, klla lɛ amānyā tēelihɔ abɔ̄ é bá ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ā. Kwu ācɛ ā, kwu aádáádā uwā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda ā í jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. É ŋmó ācɛ nēé yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ alɛwa amānyā.

eng_Latn: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
idu_Latn: Ōwē nɛ̄ ō ī ga ajɛ odo ā, gē nū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋmá odo á. Itali ā kē í na eyīpú kú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
idu_Latn: Usárāyi wɛ ɔdɔma, í kē mɔyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ kú igbō nōó ī nū ŋ́ mā ā, ayíkpó ā wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a tíne ká ālɔ̄ tútū gā uwɔ ká ā lé ucɛ kú onyatá āa.

eng_Latn: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
idu_Latn: Ipú alácɛ̄ kú aígelī ā géē je mu ácí, nɛ̄ ayí ɛwū mɛ́mla álá géē bá í lé ácí mɛ́mla ēpū ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
idu_Latn: Nááná alɔ tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ kú íjééyī lɛ ācɛ nēe le pīya ijímkpa ipú alelékwū ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā. Amáŋ alɔ í bī íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā lɛ nōo kōō gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ dúú ɛ́ɛ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ aɔ́já nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ejé wɛ omōomū uwā mɛ́mla íkókwū kpó ce iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ipɔ́ɔmā kú Urécābu. Anɔ́ɔ n da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ejé gwá.

eng_Latn: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka á gáā habɔ̄ um tá ɔlékwū ŋ́, á kōō gáā cɛ̄ ká ɔkpíyē kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ kóō wā tāajɛ ipú únóji ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, alɔ lɛ ɛnyā kllɔcɛ́ gbojī dúú ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā, ká ā lɛ ɔ́ jé ohígbu īyī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umefíbōssɛ̄ti, ɔyí kú Ujonátan nōo wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā, gā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ ó má gbo kláajɛ iyɔ̄bū Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɔ́gbá tú ɔ̄ á. Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka Umefíbōssɛ̄ti, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
idu_Latn: A gē gbō ɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ igá gē yɛ jīla ɔlɛ́ tá biílí ā. A klla gē hɔ́ɔhá ce odúúdú úklábɔ̄ kú nū, klla lɛ aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū nyīla klá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nú, eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ɔkpá kwú cēenyi yɔ̄ í pɛ́ ŋmá āyā kú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, gaá le odúúdú ajɛ ā mu.

eng_Latn: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: O ŋmíífī aádáádā alɔ, alɔ húmáyī bīyíne klla bá ī lɛ́pɔ̄bí uwɔ piyóó. Ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ ī bīya ā, alɔ, aɔ́cɛ́ kú alɔ, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú alɔ húmáyī wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú éwɔhá piyóó. É kpó alɔ ŋmó bɛ̄ɛka ugwū ā. É klla gē kpó alɔ iyó wu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. É klla kpó alɔ kwú tū agbá ga ɔlɛ́ uwā nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ kú uwā. Uwēyī húmáyī kwú alɔ jāā kwū ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
idu_Latn: Okómpinu éyi kwu oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛplá nōo yɛ ga ɛga otīihɔ ā. Ɔwɛ ɔhá yɔ̄ dúú nōo tá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛplá nōo yɛ ga ɛga ōtīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kpó yálé ɔgbɛ́fú, ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ gē kpɛ́fú lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔtū lé ɛnwú nōo ma tū ɔcí nɛ̄hi nyā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka é yɔ̄ gē yúufi ɛka nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu gbo tū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Userūyah mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi le jīla mɛ́mla uwá abɔ́ɔ, okónu njɔlɔ kú Ugíbeyɔn ā. Ígwu éyi cīce ābɔ̄ éyi, ígwu ɔhá cīce ābɔ̄ ɔhá leyī pīya kwu īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
idu_Latn: Uhágalu kwɛyí ɛfu kú Usayínāyi ajɛ kú Arébīya. Ó kwɛyí Ujerúsālɛm kú abālɔbányā, ohígbū ka anú mla ayí nū wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ.

eng_Latn: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú alɔ le yɛ tá únóji ā anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛnyā ā ka lɛ ā yíílí, amáŋ é má okwū kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ikpokwú kú uwā géē bá ajɛ okónu únóji bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí nēé le yílá kɛ́tɛ̄-kɛtɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ alelékwū kú aá géē lūgwū í wā ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, ó géē tū Ujísɔ̄si ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ ó fu lɛ aá ā ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi ɔ́ɔmā le tá ɛgiyí Áhābu gaá da ɔ́ kā ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usiríya ka ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɛfu nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ajɛ ɔlamu ŋ́ mā, ɔ́ɔma anúɔ géē yá kú ācɛ ā kóō lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā ā kpó yálé. Cɛ́ɛ́ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ géē jé ka anúɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ eyī gbō anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Hɛ́ce káá! Ɔ̄nyɛ fīyɛ̄ uwɔ odée ā.

eng_Latn: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́lá kú oyēeyī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ nwuné fíyábɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cílá Ɔwɔicō ije nwuné nōo gaajɛ ɔ́lá kú oyēeyī kú iyī nū.

eng_Latn: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
idu_Latn: Ó ka nááná nɛ̄ uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í kōō lɛyí táajɛ lɛ anúɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā, ká ācɛ Ujúda kéē híīī yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. É ka é híī tá uwā ɔkwu ga Ugígalu, amáŋ ka Ubɛ́tafín gaá gbā ɛ̄gbā icííci ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē bī iyē kú Óndú nōo yēeyī ā lɛ cokónu abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, Udéfīdi da Abíssāyi kahíníī, Usséba gáā yá alɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ Ábsālɔm má n. Lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú um kpó ká ā nū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nōó nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ aígelī nēé le igá cē tū ɔ̄, nōó klla géē le hɛ́ alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwú Óndú ā ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, ó kē géē bī ɔfú kú nū je alɔ héyī dúú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
idu_Latn: Okɔkɔ nēé géē lɛ ɔtūlali tū iyē ā, é géē bá í ná ipī. Okɔkɔ nēé géē lɛ ɔkpá ohéyīfuú kwú ɛ́nyɔ́ ā, é géē lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá gbō uwā ɛ́nyɔ́. Okɔkɔ nēé géē bū inyilɛyí olikpō ā, é géē pla ɛyí kú uwā. Okɔkɔ nēé géē bī īlī olɔhi yíifa ā, áhingílí nēé gáā le wiyē á. Ɔhi kú uwā géē mɛ. Uwēyī kē í kwú uwā.

eng_Latn: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó jé ɔdā dóódu, nɛ̄ uwá gē yá ā. Otú, ó gē je uwá tá ajɛ klla ī je uwá catāajɛ.

eng_Latn: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya ɛɛ́. Alɔ géē lɛ okónu cē íne nɛ̄ alɔ mɛ́mla aádáádā alɔ bīya ā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā cēenyi jāā gbéeko nōó kwú aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú, nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā í kpó mule á.

eng_Latn: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu le Uféro mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū má bá ī yɛ lɛyíkwu uwá ā, ɔtū kú uwā kwu wogodo, anɔ́ɔ é le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tú uwā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aéwɔhá, aá jāhɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá jé ɔdā nōo gáā yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á. Óndú ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nɛ̄ Ubatissɛ́ba, ɔnyā kú Uríya ma lɛ Udéfīdi ā, kóō gbɔɔ́ ō doōcē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔdā dóódu yá nōo ī dē je um gicō lígíii nɛ̄ɛ, a kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ágábá gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́tɛ́ um ō je um yíífi. Á kóō í yúklɔ́ idáagó, ka á yá um ɔdā olɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
idu_Latn: N gáā tū éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ɛhɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ nōo géē cēenyi klá odúúdú ɔdā oyēeyī nēe í kpó uwā yíífi. Ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ ā géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n gē má íne ɔhá ipú ɔkpíyē kú um, nōo gē nuunu tá íne kú ɔtū kú um ā, nōo kē je um yá alagbá kú ínoōbīya ā, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíyē kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
idu_Latn: Uféro tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá nyɔ̄ gáā gwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, ipú ígbíli. Amáŋ aá gáā nyɔ̄ ligbó ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
idu_Latn: O bī ɛla kú um wā ŋmɛyí ā, ɛlá ōgbo mɛ́mla ucē ká aá cíkā ō wɛ ékpó. Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá cíkā ō he aá ɔtū, aá gbonɛnɛ, ká aá tú iyī aá wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípóklóbīya ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔdā dúúmā nɔ́ɔ tíne ō yá, anúɔ yɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í blakwu alɔ, ó géē hɔ́hā ce alɔ. Ó géē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá híī ga ɛgiyí ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ ka ācogwɛ́bā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le yá lɛ ā, aá géē je tēelihɔ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē kwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yíbīyājɛ tū um ā, ī tū um eyīnyinyi. Ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka é ma ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aɛ́na ahāapa nēe wɛ ojɔ̄kwū iyē mlɔ́mlɔ́ ā le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ísu kú Unáyilu bá ī lé ácí.

eng_Latn: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū ɔhá dúúmā je īyī nū iyē tēelihɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ ó lɔfú lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ámāŋ ka ádā nū, ayí nū ámāŋ ayínɛ́ nū nɔnyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā dúúmā nɛ̄ é lɛ ɔbá ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi bōōbū gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, á cokónu klla gbɛka ga um ka, Usólōmɔn, ɔyí um ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Adónīja je pīya ɔcɛ́ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nōó kwú iyī nū ú je lá ā, ó lɛ íkwu ō lɛ iyī nū fūla glá. Ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ lɔfú fūla anú glá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ugóolu nēé bī omútāgā cabɔ́há ā le yá ojibó kú Ucérūbim, tū áklɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē háyi áklɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ikpati ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.
idu_Latn: Aá háyi ɛga nɛ̄ aá bá āa, aá géē má ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú ācɛ nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū pi, lɛ ɔ́ gɔ̄ ɔfiyɛ kú otrɛ̄yí ācogwɛ́ɛya éyi ahɔ̄, lɛ ɔ́ ahɔ̄ hɛ́ táajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛjī kú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔnū kú Ɛ́frem ā. Ɛjī kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Atárɔ̄tu Ádda ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī á, lɛyíkwu ɛhícō kú Ubɛt Uhórɔn.

eng_Latn: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ocíbú kú nū ā ce tū ipú ísu nɛ̄hi ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka oyī kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gekwú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe yēeyī ipú ísu nɛ̄hi ā kpɛmm ā le pɛ́ gekwú á.

eng_Latn: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ā, le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā túbá tɔ̄há wā gáā le ɛfú kpó tá Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
idu_Latn: A klla kwú um ú ŋmá ajɛ lɛ um tá tónū, ohígbū ánya mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, ācɛ géē bī ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo yá aá ā lɛ yá ocābɔ̄ kú ífi, é klla í gwíijē kú ikwūayidɔ nyā lɛ aá, Alɔ le yíífi dúúdú! Óndú ā kwú ajɛ kú alɔ ú ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ācɛ nēe kwú alɔ abɔ̄fú ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa kwúcē igbīhi wā Uhásɔ, klla mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā tābɔ̄ klla bī ɔkpacaŋgelī le ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ā ŋmó. Ohígbū ka anú ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí klla wɛ olɔfú kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka á má ɔdā dúúmā ka ŋ́, ayíka a lɛ okónu klá cíí, ká n nwū uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē jééyī lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā á. Ó le italā nɛ̄ ó í yá ajɛ kú Uhádirāki mɛ́mla igelī kú Udamáskɔ̄si ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛɛ́. Eyī kú Óndú ā kwu odúúdú alɛɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kwú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
idu_Latn: Ó je aóbócí ā ɛ̄cī ofɛpa kéē lɛ ɛcí nya okwū ā iyē cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī bīya ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ eko nōó gē je kéē lɛ ɛcí nya okwū iyē á. Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti yɔ̄ ekwu kú nū ɛ̄cī ofɛtá cigwó.

eng_Latn: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
idu_Latn: É géē je ɔ́ tū ācɛ Uróm abɔ̄, nēe géē yá ɔ̄ okónu, klla í tá ahɛ klá anú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ugádi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Udéfīdi ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uríya gā ā, Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá í yá ɔgbɛ́fú lɛ ā da ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya pla uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɛ́ uwá tá ŋ́. Ka aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá dóódu nyá ɔ́ɔ nya ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ka ɛ́ɛ pó jéjée ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā nū kpó le Ɔwɔicō ā í kwúcē ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kwu oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū je lɛ Óndú ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā nēe bá gē yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā jāhɔ̄, amáŋ ka é jāhɔ̄ ŋ nááná, é géē jé ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ le yɔ̄ ipú aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó í cɔcɛ́ ā, Ujúda géē lɛ onyatá, Ísrɛ̄lu kē í lā ɛbɔ́. É géē hī iyē nū lé ka, Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, yɔ̄ ī bī abɔ̄ kú um le tá okónu ōhɛ́ tū aá nyā á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē tá iyē kú um tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔkpá kú um á.

eng_Latn: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄, ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá koó géē gwéeyē ohígbū nū fíyɛ́ ofɛnɛ cigwáhāanɛ nēé héyībī ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
idu_Latn: Útú le hɛ́ ɛga dóódu kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō cīlɛ̄fú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi á. Ācɛ le inya pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛga dóódu gaá le Upɔ́lu kwú le ɔ́ pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā é le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpó kwu.

eng_Latn: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aɛ́pā mɛ́mla aéwo ipácí mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ elihɔ̄ gáā lā Ubábīlɔn á. Ācɛ dúú í klla gáā lā Ubábīlɔn gbóógbóō ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Last of all the woman died also.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yēeyī ipú iyē kú um nyā ā, n géē má Ɔwɔicō piíí, nááná nɛ̄ ōcē kwú ɔkpíyē kú um lé dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
idu_Latn: Á jé ŋ́ nɛɛ? É tɛtɛ da uwɔ ŋmá íkée ŋ́ nɛɛ? Á pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ hɛ́ ɔkwu lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ gā um kwú eyī í hɛ́ kwu uwá, anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwā ú kpó cālɛ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā ga ipú ajɛ kú aólɛlā á. Igbīhāajɛ, eko nɛ̄ ayááyí aá le iyī uwā tú wāajɛ, nēé lɛ italā yá uwā kú íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bɛyíkwu um lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
idu_Latn: Á tɛtɛ pó ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ miya ɔ́ tū lɛ ā ŋmá íkée ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? N kē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n miya ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́. Ami je ɔfú gā uwɔ ká ā lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi alɛwa nēé cē igá tū uwā ā wúlatāajɛ klla lɛ uwá pīya alácɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
idu_Latn: le ka lɛ ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Aá le īyī aá tīihɔ, ohígbū ka ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā, éŋkpɔ̄ géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, āyā éyi kú nū géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ga ísu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, āyā ɔhá géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ga ísu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Ó í yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ eko ɔnɔ̄ ga ɔgwā iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ipú unwalu, Ɔwɔicō, jāhɔ̄ tá ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī fu uwɔ ā. N gē yúufi kú aólɛlā kú um, lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocibu ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó. Ɔtulalī géē wɛ omōōmu nū.

eng_Latn: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
idu_Latn: Ó gē pá ɛcí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē lé ɛya nēé gwó lɛ ɛcí ā ŋ́. Ó klla gē cikpó ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ó gē gwutá mla ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
idu_Latn: A gē gbō ísu, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, klla ī trá úgbagwú kú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú ācoplɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
idu_Latn: Aá le tútū kú aá cīije bá ɔyínɛ̄ aá eko dóódu. Aá ba ī tíne kú aá yá unwalu tá ɔ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá kóō héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā í kē wā tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
idu_Latn: Le da Usedekíya ka, Aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti bá ī wā ɔwɛ gáā tá uwɔ abɔ̄, amáŋ é klla géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lɔtū da ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ipéyī nū ka ucē nōó ī yá ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē lɔtū cíla anú ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nō ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Ukɔ́ra kahíníī, Aá pó, ayí kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka alɔ lā ipú ɛcɛ kú ācɛ nēé jé Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā, amáŋ alɔ í bī ɔtū kú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nēé jé Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā le kpɛ́fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe gē tókónu lɛ ádā uwā, nɛ̄ e klla ī tókónu lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
idu_Latn: Eyīyōce ɛ́gɛ́nyā í kē já alɔ kwɔwɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi lɛ ā mafú o ŋmá lɛ ō je Alelékwū-Ihɔ nōo wɛ ákú nū ā lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa má āa? Anɔ́ɔ n tóohi ka ɔkpá nōo le hā gblógbló ā yɔ̄ ī wu icō. Olīkpō kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofu. Olɔwá kú nū wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwó.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da Ulában kahíníī, Kwú ɔnyā um, Urécɛ̄lu ú gā um mɛ́ n, ká n gbo mɛ́mla anú. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ a tū um ā le jīla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm, aá bá yɔ̄ áā? Igelī nɛ̄hi nōo tɛtɛ le yēŋēē gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka akwuna yɔ̄ á ā? Ācohɛ́pɔ̄ kú aá tɛtɛ gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá tɛtɛ lā oyēeyī nōo le yēŋēē. Amáŋ abālɔbányā ācoŋmáācɛ kwú lɛwa ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛ́srɔn kwú pīya iháyí ofɛtá ā, ó gaá lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Umákīyɛ, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ugílɛ́di lɛ. Ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā ma Uségubu lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ má ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, a le lɔfú iyē ɛɛ́. Ā bīyíne gɛ nóo, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ géē yá uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é cīce bā í lé ɔdōlé ā, ɛlā kú Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā.

eng_Latn: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ nōo gbɔbū lɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā wā ā, ɔfú kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ iyē kú um nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Óndú ā kwú ɔfú ɛlā ōka ú gā um.

eng_Latn: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɛpɔ̄ hɛ́ kpaakpa, ɔtū gē hi ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā. Amáŋ eyī kē cá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
idu_Latn: ɛga nōó yɔ̄ ɔyā ɛtá ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī tútū kóō ga Usiríya ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó le jé ka ācɛ Ujíyu lɛ ujɔ tū tū anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ miya ka anúɔ le cīgbīhi bū Umasɛdónīya.

eng_Latn: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gē yá nyā í lɔhi ŋ́. Aá cíkā ō yúufi Ɔwɔicō kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jɛɛga lɛ aólɛlā kú aá, aólufíyé ā kéē yá aá okónu klla lɛ okónu kwu aá iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ le aá le anú, ayí nū mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yálé, le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa ā yɛjīla anú, abɔ̄ é le pó ka ó le ɔdā ō hídáagó nyā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
idu_Latn: Aá klla yá ɛ̄nyā kú aá gbēyī ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū kóō wā ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ā. Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nyā wɛ Ujísɔ̄si, nōó je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā. Anú ā gē nyā alɔ tá eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá ācɛ italā, ohígbū koó le cɔ̄nū ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛɛ́, n pó abɔ̄ uwá bá ī ka ka aá géē ga Udɔ́tan. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu nū ɔgwu ayínɛ́ nū ga Udɔ́tan, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá má abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu géē bá ī kpó iyɛ́ya nyā gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
idu_Latn: n gē je īlī nēé bī ɔnwū aálá kú um tá ā lɛ ɔ́ kóō le wiiyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó gē cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
idu_Latn: le aíne nyā kpó lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ámāŋ ka éwɔhá nōo lā ajɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, lɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú bī wā, ó kōō wɛ ákú oji ō cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ámāŋ ɛya o je ŋmá ɔtū kú nū, ɛbɛ́ ā kóō híī lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um fīyɛ̄ ajɛ ipú ɔ́tɔ̄ kwɔ. Ɔwɔicō lɛ um tú wāajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmāā é ma ka Ɔwɔicō kwú úklɔ́ kú ō tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛ aílɔ́wá ā ú tū um abɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé hɛ́ apī ŋ́ mā a, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é je úklɔ́ kú ɔna ō tá kú ɔkōōlɔhi lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu tū Upíta abɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
idu_Latn: É gáā kpɛ́fú ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē kpó ācɛ yíífi gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē je odée wúlatāajɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. A géē lɛ iyē ce igá kú uwɔ ka Onyatá. A klla í hī aókónu igá kú uwɔ ka Ocɛ̄tra.

eng_Latn: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kóō híī nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā ŋmá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da odúúdú ācɛ ā, kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka íkée á, ó ka aádáádā aá lā ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi, gē gbō aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. Éyi kú aádáádā aá ɔ́ɔmā wɛ Utéra, ádā kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla Unáhɔ.

eng_Latn: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka Óndú ā kóō mīyɛ uwá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā, kóō kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ádáádā uwā, Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú āgēe nā abɔ̄ kú nu daa gāa je ohile kú ācɛ ɔlɛ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu a kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú Asírīya, Íjīpiti, Ipátros, Itiópīa, Ɛlam, Isína, Uhamát mla odúúdú ajɛ kú okónu ísu a.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le ajɛ nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī gaá kwu ísu kú Umeditarénīya ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá mīya ŋmá abɔ̄ aólɛlā ā mɛ́mla ajɛ kú aéwo nɛ̄ aá kōō mīyɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā, kpó kɔ̄ lɛ uwá kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umɛlkísɛ̄dɛ̄ki nɛ̄ ō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Usalɛ́m, klla wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, le igbō mɛ́mla ejé bī gé lɛ Ébram.

eng_Latn: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
idu_Latn: É le ɛ́yá ā tá anɔ́ɔ é le ɛbéenyi alɛwa nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kwu nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ɛ́yá kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō kpó híla.

eng_Latn: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu pīyɛyí ŋmá Umɛsopotámīya ɛbɔ́ wā igelī kú Ussɛ́kɛm ajɛ kú Ukénan ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū cē kwu ipú ajɛ nōo kwu igelī ā ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kwú iyīnū ú lá lɛ uwá ká ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄, ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá ká ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ icííci eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā le yá.

eng_Latn: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām le gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Áyísīki kōō gekwú, nááná Ɔwɔicō lɔfú je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū glá kpɔ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā, Ébrahām mīyɛ Áyísīki oyēeyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Ujɛhóram ā, ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm kwú hɛ́ ŋmá Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīya éwo kú abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa ā gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámilíī kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Usékarīya le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwú ocíbú ɔtulalī ā ú, lɛ ɔlá fú tū ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛyí ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá wāajɛ gaá tá ipú ɛcɛ á. Akpáabana gbo klla gbo gblágádáá, ɔwɔ límanya maa, maa, maa, ajɛ klla jíliyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
idu_Latn: O pīya ɔtū abɔ̄ nyā í ŋmá abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo hi aá igwú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Oŋmífī nɛ̄ n bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ń fu igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma dúúmā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēé géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Amáŋ n le Udéfīdi fu kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and twelve.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na ā wɛ, úlā ofɛɛnɛ ce úlā igwó Ukpɛ kú Óndú kē wɛ ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: n yɔ̄ ī jɔ́kpa ihɔ ā, yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ohígbū iháyí ofɛtá cigwó nɛ̄ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā géē tá alácɛ̄ lɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá nōo wɛ ɛ̄cī kú oblatū kú ɛ̄cī nēé ma Uféro ā, ó le ucɛ yá nɛ̄hi lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó le ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ejé lɛ ɔ́ ā mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíigbō ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá agbá, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó wā iyɔ̄bū kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
idu_Latn: Ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o miyɛ ugbɔga lɔɔlɔhí, ɔdā olɔhi ō yá í he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ó í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cīiyinu bī glá, ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdā o kpaakpa, ɔ̄cɛ o tīihɔ, o klla í wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
idu_Latn: Owu kú nū le ojuja kpó nyɔ̄, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpáncō tá péee. Ó bī abɔ̄ kú nū klla lɛ ɛgwā obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī pi kɔnɔ́kɔnɔ́ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōtūufi, mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɔ̄, mɛ́mla ukpa bá ī gbēyī ācɛ kú Umówābu á.
