eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɛtá le gla ā, aɔ́fiyɛ ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ Ussímēyi le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Ugáti, Ákisi, ɔyí kú Umáaka. Eko nɛ̄ Ussimēyi le pó ka ɛ́ɛ bá Ugáti ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kē da uwá kahíníī, Ń kē gáā da aá ɛga nɛ̄ n bī íkwu ō le yá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
idu_Latn: Tíne Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔfú kú nū, kú ā yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū nū yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī má alɔ, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, pīyeyī má alɔ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ká ā wā í lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ofōōfūnū ā nēé nya ɔ̄cɛ tá glá á, ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ nyā ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu nōo nya alɔ tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
idu_Latn: Ujobu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíniīī, A gē kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā. Ɛlā kú olíla nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī ka á. Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔdōōlɔhi bī gé lɛ alɔ, alɔ ī mīyɛ. Ó lɛ ā, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ alɔ gē tá eko nōó lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí bī gé lɛ alɔ āā? Ipú odúúdú ōwē nōó má nyā, Ujóbu í bīyíne ŋmá lɛ ō ka ɛlā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ŋmɔ́lá ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú óoku nōó má énkpɔ̄ ŋ́ nōo yɔ̄ ī kwú eko ɔnɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ujósɛ̄fu ka N dɔɔ̄kā ká ā ga Ussɛ́kɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ uwɔ bá gē gbāálá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá klɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Ɛ́sta, klla lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū kpó hīīgwú wā ɔnū ucɛ ā. Ó klla lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā. Ó klla le ɛhi kpó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ cíkā ō yá ɛhi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
idu_Latn: Aá nɛ̄ Ujerúsālɛm he aá ɔtū ā, aá gwéeyē mɛ́mla anú, ká ɔtū kóō he aá ohígbū nū. Odúúdú aá nɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā he aá ɔtū ā, aá gwéeyē mɛ́mla anú ícɛ. Odúúdú aá nēe tɛtɛ bá ī yá ɔtūnōbí ohígbū nū ā, aá gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: Óndú Ujísɔ̄si kóō je ɛhi nɛ̄hi kú nū ā lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō Aamí.

eng_Latn: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
idu_Latn: é géē nya oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́máapú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ā. É kē í je oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā kwúcē igbīhi ga igelī nɛ̄hi okwinya ɔ̄ci nyɔ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ ó kwu nyɔ̄ ā. Ó í lā abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya eko ɔ́ɔmā ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
idu_Latn: Ó géē je éyi kú aígbáanɔ ɛpa ā ŋmó ipú aklɛ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū yɔ̄ péee ā.

eng_Latn: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ɔhá géē lé igbīhi ūwɔ, nōó gáā lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā glá ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ɔhá nōo wɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nōo géē lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ klla géē gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
idu_Latn: É bī obɔ̄bí gē le cílá um ulé kú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ n yá ā. Odo kú um má tówódō icíici.

eng_Latn: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ŋmá ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā nēé géē bī le hɛ́ ɛpɔ̄hi ga uwɔ á. O ŋmá ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā nēé kē géē ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa da ācɛ ā kéē híī yúufi ŋ́. Kéē lɛ ɔtū lɛ, ohígbū ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā yá odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka éwo éyi géē wā faaa lɛyíkwu Umówābu bɛ̄ɛka ɔgɔ nōo wā gáā je ɔyí ugwū ā.

eng_Latn: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá yá ubatísim, ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā. É le ācɛ úlā ahāapa ce ofigwó gba áluka uwā.

eng_Latn: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
idu_Latn: Aá í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī wā igbīhi alɔ. Ujékɔ̄pu yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kahíníī, Ɛhi nɛ̄ n kpó gé lɛ ɔ́ nyā géē yá kú ɔtū kú nū kóō gbo. Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ má ɛɛ́, ó géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ɔ̄ ā yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í tū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ kóō gaá ŋmó ɛcɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́, amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛcɛ nyatá nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, ó wɛ ojīlīma kú Ujɛhóssāfāti ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ŋ́ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í má uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n kōō ī ka ɔdā dúúmā gā uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē je uwēyī lɛ odúúdú aólɛlā kú um. Cɛ́ɛ́ acígilí, ígbájí cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ uwá le bēé okómpinu kú ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, uwá géē kpó īlī nēé hī ka ulínin wiiyē. Uwá í gáā lé ɔdā dúúmā nēé yá ŋmá owú wiiyē eko nēé gē yúklɔ́ ódúúɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ámāŋ ka ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi abɔ̄yī nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kóō pó ɔ̄kā éyi, nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ cīgbīhi ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ n cɛ̄ lɛ uwā bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, n le ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti abɔ̄ cē ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ igbogbo gbō abɔ̄ kú nū ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū ɔ̄ ɔkɔ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ ā playi anú ɛ́ɛ ká o pi ɔɔ́, ka ó fúlá, ɛɛ́ kóō bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú lɛbɛ̄ɛka aágábá nēe ī tōoji klla ī wɔ́ɔha, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je uwá okónu klá, klla ī je uwá aínu kpó ce ā.

eng_Latn: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a lɛ tá abɔ́ɔ, da ɔ́ kóō leyī kwɛcɛ. Ó kē híī lɛ ɔtū plicō ŋ́, ɔdā dóódu kóō híī junwalu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Urésin, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya mɛ́mla Upéka ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, amáŋ é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfú ō kwɔɔlá ɛpa nɛ̄ ɔlá genyí ŋmá uwá nōo gē tá ódūdū icííci nōó yá ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī aá nɛ̄ aá gē le ɔdōlé klla í gwá ejé ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híīī yá ɛ́gɛ́nyā ipú ojīleyī kú aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā ī mafú ka aá gē leyī gwū icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō tá, anɔ́ɔ aá gē yá kú uwēyī kóō kwú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá odée ī ce uwá ā á. Ɔdí nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ká n̄ ka lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā ā? N cɛ̄tra aá nɛɛ? N gáā cɛ̄tra áa glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo géē yúufi Óndú ā. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ klla í yúufi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ pi tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá igeli ā, lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ aíjáalí ā lɛ úwé kú uwā kpóbá ajɛ ɛgiyí ikpó kú ɔyípōklóbīya éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kɛlā ka, aá jɛga lɛ Alelékwū kóō nā aá tɔ́ɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá í gáā yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ō ī ŋmó ɔlɛɛcɛ unwū ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
idu_Latn: Ó kē bɔ̄bí ka ācɛ kéē ka ɛlā obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu úklɔ́ kú alɔ nyā. Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ géē gbɛlá ka agbla kú ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄nyā Átɛ̄misi ā í cɛgbá gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ klla kē í je ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ odúúdú Ācɛ Ésīya mɛ́mla ɛcɛ dúúdú gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā ka ɔdā ɛflɛ́ɛfu, é kē í nyí ɔ̄ ojīlīmā.

eng_Latn: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ikpīije ugóolu igwó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
idu_Latn: Ipú ufi kú um, n klla kahíníī, Ɔlɛɛcɛ dúúmā í tōō lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kéē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́, ó lɛ ā, alɔ í lɛ olɛhɔ̄ dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ ī tɔ́ɔna nū lɛ aá ŋ́. Aá kē lɛ ɔdā ó lɔtūce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja úlā ɛhīlī ce ofu igwó gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā í wɛ éwɔhá ámāŋ ka aúgbɔga kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá gɛ ŋ́. Abālɔbányā aá le pīya ayí ajɛ ékpó mɛ́mla ācɛ éwo ékpónú mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram kwú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū ú pīyeyī gbɔɔ́ ō kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujéhu, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ahasíya kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ o yíbīyājɛ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Upɛ́rissi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Urefém.

eng_Latn: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka á cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ ŋ́, n géē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ italā bū ɔwɛ kú aábaná ō tū klɛ́ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛhi kú ucē ɔhá ō ka wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā. Ó wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛhi kú olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ō ka tɛ́ɛcɛ wɛ ákú ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó wɛ ákú ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ijēēnyi gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó Usámsin nɛ̄hi á. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī Óndú ā igwú, da ɔɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ le ācɛ yálé nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́, ka ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ ijēēnyi kóō ŋmó anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, aólufíyé ā kéē wā í lɛ anúɔ kwú nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da Ujɛhósāfati kahíníī, Ń tɛtɛ da uwɔ ka ó gē kɛlā olɔhi lɛyíkwu um ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdōbɔ̄bī kú um nɛ̄ ó gē ka piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú tá aípɔ́ɔma kú Uhágri, Ujétɔ, Umápiss mɛ́mla Unódābu.

eng_Latn: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā tɛtɛ mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā. Ajɛ kú uwā ā yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ogbeé kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
idu_Latn: Ubásɛmāti, ɔnyā ɔ́mpa kú Ísɔ ā ma ɔyí éyi lɛ ɔ́. Ó lé ka, Uréyūwɛlu. Uréyūwɛlu ma ayí ɛnɛ. É wɛ, Unaháti, Usɛ́ra, Ussáma, mɛ́mla Umíssa.

eng_Latn: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Unesíya, mɛ́mla Uhatífa.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile dóódu nɛ̄ Ujɛhóram yá ā, é lɛ uwā tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
idu_Latn: Ń yɔ̄ gē yɛce ɔ́da kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá eko nɛ̄ n gē gwō ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́. N yɔ̄ gē yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā.

eng_Latn: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í má íjéeyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tīile lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú Ubenhádādi da ɔ́ ka aá pó ka aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu wɛ ācɛ nēe ī ményīnyinyi ācɛ. É ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛga je lɛ aá ká aá lɛ ewo kpó klla ɛyí lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla lɛ ɔ́ngbá kpó kwú ɔkɔ kú aá nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É ka ekoōhī ɔ́ɔ géē ményīnyinyi anú nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, nēé gáā je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ō yá ucē olɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukata o klá ɛyí kú ɔbá nū ā. Amáŋ ɔnyā nōo gē bī uwēyī gé lɛ ɔbā nū ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ōcē obɔ̄bí ipú ikpokwú kú ɔbá nū ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔyípōklóbīya éyi lɛ uwá má. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í le ka lɛ Ábsālɔm á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú pɛ́ kwu gaá tayínū ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo yɔ̄ Ubahúrim á. Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ obugā éyi nōo kwu ɔlɛ́ nū ajaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ uwá nyɔ̄ í tayínū ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Aá kwú mlanyi, odúúdú ucē ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aádáádā aá, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ uwá, mɛ́mla aá abɔ̄yī aá yá ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúlāyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udárīyɔs, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā lɛ ɔkpá tá fu odúúdú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla aéwo, mɛ́mla ucē dóódu, nōo lā ipú ɛcɛ ā kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū móōwē dúú eko nōó kwú igbɛ ékpónú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bīya ā, ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi kwɛyí ācobīyíne, ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ alɔ kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō. É le ɔkpíyē kú nū ŋmó, amáŋ é kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ipú alelékwū nōó gē kwú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
idu_Latn: Awɔ bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ yá um klla bī um háyi á. Je ɛyí kú ɔdā ōjé gā um. cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kllɔcɛ́ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utáma le tá ɔlɛ́ ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ámnɔn, ɛga nōó gwutá agōdō ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú umu ú anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ igbō yá ipéyī nū á.

eng_Latn: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
idu_Latn: N je ɔ́da amānyā ícɛ kú aá tá uwā abɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ túgwó. É géē gbā ije kú nū ŋmá ije élí kú ajɛ kú um dóódu nɛ̄ aá géē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka úklɔ́ ā kóō híī māháyi eko dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, ācɛ í klla gáā kwu ita ka, Aádā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ lé aíkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin omákáká á, amáŋ ayīnu kú ayí uwā kwú ijile ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a kwú pahīla klá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ Íjīpiti, bá ī tíne ácí ihili ā.

eng_Latn: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
idu_Latn: É gē hɛ́ uwá égō éyi, ɛ́ɛ́ kē tū āgā mɛ́mla ussɔ́bɛ̄lu ulé, égō ɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ kéē tū ɛnū mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō bī hɛ́hɔ̄ kú uwā ulé.

eng_Latn: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū kwú amɛ̄ mɛ́mla átákwū kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi ā ú ŋmá ipú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kpó lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū á. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ukpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í je lɛ uwá piíí, o ŋmá eko tá eko piyóó á.

eng_Latn: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogbɔ̄cí ā da onɔwá ā kahíníī, Ahínyá úklɔ́, úklɔ́ ā lɔhi íbi. Cɛ́ɛ́ é bī ukúsa lɛ ojibó kú ɛcí hɛ́ tū odée nōó gáā míya gwonū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ákpláka kú ɔdā o le hɛ́hɔ̄ kú um ú wu īyī aá ɔkɔ, kú aá klɔ́ɔcɛ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ um, ohígbū ka n gbonɛnɛ klla tū ɔtū wāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kóō lɛ omlɛnyɔ̄ lɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni abɔ̄yī nū kōō cɛ̄ dúú, anɔ́ɔ eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ yúbatísim ā, ó yɔ̄ mla Ufílīpu. Úklɔ́ ō hídáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ufílīpu yá ā le hɛ́ ɔ̄ idáagó.

eng_Latn: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
idu_Latn: Oflɔ́cí blibli kú ɛ̄cī Aláadi, ācɛnyā ā le pɛ́ tá unóji ā. É bī anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā okpócu nēé tɛtɛ tútū ā.

eng_Latn: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí éyi nɛ̄ n má ipú ɛcɛ nyā, wɛ ka, ikwū ékpónú gē ŋmó odúúdú ācɛ á. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ yēeyī ā, ɔtū kú uwā le mu mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí, mɛ́mla íla, amáŋ igbeékpónú, é gekwú ŋmá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ kē mīyɛ alɔ lɔɔlɔhi. Ɔwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yā, anɔ́ɔ ajɛ kwú hīlaŋdɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔlá gwó lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ jɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
idu_Latn: Íne nēé tū kahíníī, Ā híī gbaajā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka o cikpɔ́nyā ɔhá ŋ́, ā híī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, ā híī wūwī ŋ́, ā híī leyīkwu ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋ́, odúúdú aíne nēe bá ā, mɛ́mla aíne ɔhá dúúmā nēé je ā, gaá ŋmɛ́yí ipú ɛlā ékpónú nyā, Yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔ́mpa uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī yíihɔtū tá iyī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔbá ā í yá aɔ́dā ɛtá nēe bá nyā glá ŋ́, ó í habɔ̄ ɔnyā ā tá kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū, ó gáā mīyɛ ije īkpɛ̄yí nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔyíkpó nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā má abɔ̄ é háyi ā, ó da ɛ́nɛ́ nū kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́, má ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
idu_Latn: Ubɛnáya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe gē gbō Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū á. Ayí kú Udéfīdi ā kē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ le aéwo ɔ́ɔmā lā ipú ajɛ ā á. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó cɛ̄ le Ujósuwa yá uwā lé ŋ́ má, nɛ̄ anú, nōo wɛ Óndú ā í kē nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ obōōbū nɛ̄ Ujósuwa kwú ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
idu_Latn: Aámɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā héyīfuú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayí ɔblá nēe wɛ áplɛ́ ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ocālɛ́ kú aá le yá, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti ā géē wā í kpó iyó otīihɔ nyā, eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū le iyó ā gwótū le ɔ̄ gbō kwɛyí. Amáŋ, ayí kú Ukɔ́hāti kéē híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdā nēe bá nyā ŋ́, ohígbū nēé í kwú. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti, eko dóódu n­ɛ̄ aá gáā fu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Ísɔ, é le agbénú kú aá kpó wu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā wɛ: Atáya, ɔyí kú Usíya ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Usékarīya. aádáádā nū ɔhá ā wɛ, Amárīya, Ussɛfatíya, mɛ́mla Umahalálelu, ayí kú ɔyí kú Ujúda, Upɛrɛ́si.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū um kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́ Ujúda cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gáā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n gē ka ɛ̄nyā lɛ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́ ámāŋ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔbā ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla anyōkwū ā, koó lɔhi fíyɛ́ lɛ aá kú aá yɔ̄ gē lā ofōōfu aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú opo ú, ká aá tá le cɛ̄tra ɔ́. Aá gwō ɛ̄ngwū nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla inengé, kú aá cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
idu_Latn: ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ í lɛ́pɔ̄hi ɛlā ā. Amáŋ Ágábáidu ɔ́ɔ fu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō pó ɔkɔ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro kwú iyɔ̄lā ī gbo kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄na ɔhá nā kpɔ́ á. Ipú ɔ̄na ā, ó má ɛyí kú igwu o cɛyí nɛ̄hi ahāapa bá ī jɛ̄ kwú ɔcí igwu ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ géē bī iyē kú anúɔ kɛlā lɛ uwá. Ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tá kóō bī ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā yúklɔ́ anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā italā.

eng_Latn: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá okónu nōó ce ā mɛ́mla okónu nɛ̄ ó le táajɛ ā ŋmá eko tá eko ga ayááyí úlúúlā.

eng_Latn: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Ó jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔyí um yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. N géē nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ́ má ɛ́ɛ́ ká n kwú.

eng_Latn: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
idu_Latn: É je ɛhi nyā tū ɔ kpɔ́, ohígbū ō gwó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Igbō oje ɔdɔ úlā igwɛ́ɛpa ce igbō ofigwó ce. Igbō oje nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ofucɛ̄hɔ̄ . Igbō oje udɔ úlā ofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu úlā ofigwɛ́ɛpa cigwó .

eng_Latn: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD, even thou only.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā á. Ó lɛ ā, lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā kéē le jé ka awɔ ōfōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ kɛlā lɛ uwá, ó klla kɛlā alɛwa ɔhá yɔ̄ ī lɔfú tū uwā iyē yɔ̄ ī da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ iyī aá nyatá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī yá italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gáā yá ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú gbɛhá, anɔ́ɔ ó tíne ó kwú ajɛ kú nū ú lá á. Ɔmáapu nū nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā géē lá ajɛ ā cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ nēe bá nyā wɛ aɛ́béelihɔ lɛ aá. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú uwā géē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
idu_Latn: Uhótam ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Usófa, Ímna, Ussɛ́lɛss mɛ́mla Ámalu.

eng_Latn: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri ā wɛ Uhósa nōó kē ma ayí ɛnɛ ā: Ussímri nɛ̄ ádā nū je ɔ́ yá otrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā, nááná nōó wɛ ɔ́kplá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le úklɔ́ ō hídáagó nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yá ā má ā, é kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ācɛ í jē ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ka ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔnyīlɔ nēe plá ikpó eyí kú áblákpá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nēé le miya kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú, é géē kwú ɔ̄ piíí. ɔ̄cɛ dúú nēé le miya ka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nēé géē bī le ŋmó ɔ̄ á, ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nēé géē bī le ŋmó ɔ̄ piíí á. Ɛnyā ī mafu ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō cíkā ō lɔtūlé kéē háyi kpaakpa lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá piíí.

eng_Latn: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
idu_Latn: É le ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bītá anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ ga Ántīiyɔ̄ku, ɛga nēé lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ígwu kú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā túbá ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔkpá ā ú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ujíyu, nēe lā Utesalɔ́nīka, le pó ka Upɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā Ɔwɔicō ajɛ Ubéríya dúú ā, é klla le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, gbɔɔ́ ō tū ɛwa ā okónu gē da uwá kéē yíkpɛ́lā.

eng_Latn: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔ́ jila nɛ̄ ōc­ē ā í nyīla ga ɛga dúúmā ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā le pɛ́ i yɛ. É yɛ ŋmá ipɔ́lɛ́ éyi ga ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ ācɛ klla yɔ̄ í hɛ́ ācɛ ā tá ŋmá ōcē ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄ ká ɛ̄nyā kóō lɛ yá, aá géē nyíla ajɛ nɛ̄ aá lā anú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó gē nyíla ajɛ. Ɔwɛ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē gwu ajɛ nōo nyíla ŋ́, ayíka o lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n kōō bī íkwu nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā le gwō ligíí nááná, uwēyī í gáā yá um ŋ́. Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā je íkwu ā lɛ alɔ lɛyíkwu aá. Ó wɛ ka alɔ bī ɔ̄ lɛ aá yíífi ŋ́, amáŋ o bī le ma aá gicō nɛ.

eng_Latn: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kahíníī, N géē gwō agblɔ̄cɛ́ lɛ īyī um nōo géē lɛ aínicō nēe lɔwá nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ aúwíndo yá tū ɔ̄, lɛ ɔcí Usɛ́da kpó gbā bá ɔdɔ kú nū, klla lɛ ɛwó nɔwa plā ɔdɔ nú yōōō.

eng_Latn: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá nū ŋmá inɛ̄pɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
idu_Latn: N kwú odúúdú ɔfú kú um ú tá lɛ ō ma ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ń tú ɔdā agbénú dúúmā tū lɛ iyī um ŋ. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ mla um ā, kē yúklɔ́ kú ɔdɔ ō ma āa.

eng_Latn: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá tú kwu aɔ́dā nēe bá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, amáŋ ó híīī wɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ amānyā ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kóō wā ɛgiyí aá ā pó. Ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɔtūcaca nōó lɛ kóō yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ alɔ da ɔ́ á, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ iyī nū fu kóō nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uféro nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā nēe yá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɔdā dúúmā dúú ā, é lɛ uwá kpó hɛ́ klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ácí ā. Óndú géē je uwá mu owu bónū ipú íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi kú nū, eko nēé kōō yēeyī nááná ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ōwē má nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū mla uwá, ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ é ŋmó ipú ajɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ uwá gbɛ̄gbā je ajɛ ā tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n húmáyī ka ā wɛ ɔ̄na nɛ̄ a nā ā. Amáŋ alɔ géē ka ɛyí nū lɛ ɔcɛ́ abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
idu_Latn: Uwēyī í gē yá aá ŋ mā, anāānā, aá da um ka, Ádā alɔ, awɔ yíihɔtū tá alɔ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ayípɛ̄ obene á.

eng_Latn: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgiyí Ufílīpu anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, alɔ tíne ká ālɔ̄ má Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā í gáā cɛ̄ ka oklóbīya dúúmā kóō kwu ŋ́, Ó kē gaa meyinyi kú anyōkwū mla ayókwū dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā í jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ma, é kllá bī ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi. Ɔdā dóódu nēé gē ka, kllá ī yá ā, wɛ obɔ̄bí. Náaná íwɔ́tū kú Óndú ā í gáā mɛ ɛɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ó géē nā abɔ̄ kú nū daa í je ōwē lɛ uwá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe tayínū ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ fíyaa kwú pahīla tū ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugíbɛ̄ya ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄, cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyí ā kóō fīyégbúlú kpákpá, anɔ́ɔ ó gā ɛcɛ ŋmá iyē kú nū á. Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ ā gwutá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka okwū ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ gbɛlá kɔ́ɔ̄ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ádā ā í kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ó kwú ɛpɔ̄ dóódu ú kpó tū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
idu_Latn: A bī ɔfú kú uwɔ lɛ aéwɔhá nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā. A klla lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bu tū ipú ajɛ ā. A le italā yá aéwɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kwú gbagbénú ā.

eng_Latn: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛfú a gbo ɔ́ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, eko nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ofu cigwɛpa nēe wā í cē ɔ̄ kpɛ́fú ā, le ejé gwá cɛɛnyi ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Aá nēe wɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi, aá lɛ īyī aá iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kē lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá ā yá tīihɔ dúú. Aá lɛ ɔdā nōo je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tēelihɔ ā, kpó bónū ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ nɛ̄ n lɔtūce á, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā yá um lé kú uwēyī kóō kwú um ŋ́. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um gwéeyē tū um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō yá ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ eko kú íkííkée nēé pó ɛlā kú nu ŋ́ mā italā dúú. Ó le enyi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi tū klá uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwā kpó ŋmó á. Amáŋ ó lɛ Unówa nōo tɔ́ɔna kú ācɛ kéē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā hɛ́tá, anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ahāapa ɔhá.

eng_Latn: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
idu_Latn: N lɛ odúúdú īne kú nū ā tū. Ń yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfū tá ɔ́da kú nū dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Ó í je omlede ā gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā mɛ́mla ómbilí kú igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē kpó ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ejé kú nū ā lɛ Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhíram klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá tū fu Usólōmɔn ka anúɔ le ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tū wā ā pó ɛɛ́. Ó ka anúɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā, ka anúɔ klla í hɛ aɔ́cí ā klá ajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ iháyí ɔ́mofu ce igwɛ́ɛta ce ahātā igbīhi nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ŋmá Ukadiss-Ubanéya á. Ó ka odúúdú ɛ́gɔ́ kú ācɛ nēe kpɛ́fú eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́kwú kpɛ́mm ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ cokónu ka ɛ́ɛ géē pɛ́kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anúɔ gbɛlá ka, ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya géē wā í kpɛ́fú tá anúɔ Ugígalu ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ klá ā. Ó klla ka anúɔ í kē póofu Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ anúɔ gbɛlá ka, anúɔ géē lɛ ɛya ā gwó á.

eng_Latn: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni cījáalí kahíníī, N má Alelékwū Ihɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóohō ā ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá cɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ iyē gwā ókpoó kú Usáyílomi . Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le iyē gwá, anɔ́ɔ ó pīyɛyí gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a jé um nɛ̄hi nyā, kōō le ce um bá ɛɛ́, ó le fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄ ō jɛ́yí nū.

eng_Latn: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ká aólɛlā kú um kéē gekwú acígilí. Kéē lɛ uwá hɛ́ ɔ̄gɔ̄ tū oyēeyī, Ɔdōbɔ̄bí yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, ɔtū kú uwā klla kē bɔ̄bí dúú.

eng_Latn: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
idu_Latn: Cānjɛ Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā cɛ̄pɔ̄ um. Cāŋjɛ, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ká ā lɛ ɔkɔ kú um ka.

eng_Latn: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa wɛ ɔcɛ́ á, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛwa í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔcɛ́ í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá eko nēé ŋmó Ébɛ̄lu gā eko nēé ŋmó Usɛkaríya, ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛyí ede mɛ́mla ɛga otīihɔ ā. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n da aá keé géē yá ācɛ kú eko nyā italā ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla uwá, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú Ujerúsālɛm ā le pɛ́ tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkpá Ɛka kú Óndú ā, nēé pīyɛ̄ ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá iyɔ̄bū odúúdú uwá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā i yá lɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó ya lɛ nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā géē yá jīla mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ka kóō í yá piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Aá géē yúklɔ́ kú aá ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī, amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ ɛ̄cī kú Usábáti, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá géē mlɛ́nyɔ́. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā aá gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ aá géē túbá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Ɛ̄cī kú Usábāti ā wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ kú Óndú ā ɛga dúú nɛ̄ aá lā ā.

eng_Latn: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n gē hī uwɔ igwú, wā í tá um fíyaa. Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ɔkɔ kú um eko nɛ̄ n gē hī uwɔ igwú ā.

eng_Latn: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
idu_Latn: A klla gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ gē cɔ̄nū í yá ɔ̄cɛ italā ŋ́. Koó kē ī lɛ ɛlá wu ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ā lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
idu_Latn: Lɛ íne je lɛ Árɔ̄n mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā ka, ɛya ō yɔlá ā géē ce ɛyí ede ā otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, ɔlá kú ɛyí ede ā kē í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ bá ī gbaflɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ ī ŋmó ɔ̄ ā. Alɔ leyītáajɛ ka Ɔwɔicō í wā í tá alɔ abɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe bá ī lɛ abɔ̄ da alɔ ɛyítāajɛ ā, alɔ í kē má ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā í nyɔ̄ í nuunu tá aéwo ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ ī nuunu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá wā gé um ŋmá ipú ajɛ aéwɔhá ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ɛhi nēé gē bī gé um ā. É géē kpó uwá ce ɛyí aɔ́nya ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, aínyankwūlūmī mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí wā ɛyí ɛfu kú um, nōo wɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē kpó ɛhi kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwá tū ipú aɔ́dā yēŋēē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi ā le iyī uwā yá yēŋēē ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā, klla le īlī kú uwā na. Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni kwú uwā ú lɛ Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya ojíliyē ā. Árɔ̄ni le ɛya gwó kwɛ́yí uwā kúō lɛ uwá yá yēŋēē klla kwú uwā ú yá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ísɔ kahíníī, N le lɛ jɛ̄ iyī um ɛɛ́, ɔyínɛ́ um. Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā kpó tū lɛ iyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō bī iyē kú um lɛ gbɛka ipú ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí mɛ́mla okpaakpa. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā le lɛ ā, odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā géē da um ka amíyɔ̄ hɔ́há ce aá. É klla í bá ī gwō ohígbū ka é le um jé.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: He must increase, but I must decrease.
idu_Latn: Anú ā kóō kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ o cɛgbá fíyɛ́ um kɔ́ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ami ā kóō híī cɛgbá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í gáā nyā ācɛ nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā tá, ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔlékwū ŋ́. Anúɔ í klla gáā hɛ́ ūwā tá ŋmá ɔfú kú ikwū ŋ́. Ó da ikwū kóō bī ōcē obɔ̄bí kú nū ā wā. Ɔlékwū, kóō bī ífi kú nū ā wā. Ka anúɔ í klla gáā ményīnyi ācɛ nɛ̄ bá ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaohnecho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Lɛyíkwu Íjīpiti. Ɔwɔicō ka ɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu aícɔ́ɔja kú Uféro Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti, nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn yálé ɔgbɛ́fú, ipú Ukákēmisi nōo kwu ísu kú Uyúfrētīisi ajaajɛ ā, ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú í yēeyī gbojī ɛɛ́, nēé géē hīla klla í gbagbénú ā?.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, aá kɛ̄la nēe bá ā. Ádā, alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛyi ā. Wā í cɔ̄cɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbo odúúdú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
idu_Latn: Ákú uwɔ mɛ ɛɛ́. Ocatāajɛ kú uwɔ ā wɛ ɛ́dɔ obɔ̄bí ā. Ɛ́nyɔ́ le hɛ́ lɛ odúúdú aéwo nēe jé uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ádā uwā le úwé ā jééjúuma ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Īī úwé kú Ujósɛ̄fu nɛ, ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le ɔyí um ŋmó ɛɛ́. É le ɔyí um Ujósɛ̄fu híla cɛkɛcɛkɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
idu_Latn: Oōmá eyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́nya ā. É gē kwinya fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ o ce ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ussímēyi ā wɛ, Ujákim, Usíkri, Usábudi.

eng_Latn: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū le miya ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kóō wɛ ɛ́gbla kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
idu_Latn: Upíta yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mla Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī ga inu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ alɛwa má jīla abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ i tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Uláyīssi á. É le má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ā lā ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄ abɔ́ í wā í kwu uwá glá ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Usídɔn ā. É lā ligbóligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Usídɔn. É kōō tīpú tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́. É lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo ce uwá ɛgbá ā.

eng_Latn: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ń je unwalu lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́. Amáŋ, awɔ mɛ́mla inu kú ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ gē je unwalu lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ohígbū ka aá kwúcē ŋmá íne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá nyɔ̄ í gbā ubáalu ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma ahāanɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔdā úgwū kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
idu_Latn: Ó híī hɛ́ aá idáagó ŋ́, ayínɛ́ um, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ī wɔ́tū aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le bū ipú ufi, ɔtū ō wuklíicō mɛ́mla ífi ɛɛ́. Aólɛlā kú alɔ le alɔ kpó ŋmó klla le odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā í kpó bīya.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
idu_Latn: Eko nōo le iŋini kú uwá nyā pó ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú cɔ̄nū mla uwá á. Ó le ɔlá tū wāajɛ klá uwá, klla kwú cɔ̄nū tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɔtūlé piíí dúú. Aá háyi kli, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē wā ā má kwajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē nyɔ̄ í jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā le nyīla tū inu ā nɛɛ, ayíka inu ā kwú tēelihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɛ̄nyā! Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó cɛ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lé ɔcɛ́ oyēeyī kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ ā ŋ́, í gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
idu_Latn: Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhōyáda ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nōo gē gbō Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū á. Ayí kú Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī uwā klla lɛ āhɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ipú úklɔ́ kú ɔcɛ́ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
idu_Latn: Ó gē ca um tū ajɛ āyā dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē ca ɔlɛ́ jāā gbéeko nōó mɛ tāajɛ ā. Ó lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ um leyīce ā fu ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē fu ɔcí ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū, odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē bá hímm iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ōlé agege ce ɔ́ igwó ā nōo gē háyi iyɔ̄bū kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nēé le ɛhɔ̄ háyi ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ, nɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ klla háyi ābɔ̄ ɛhícō, mɛ́mla ododó, mɛ́mla agege, alápā ō bī je ahɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ bī obɔ̄bí le cíla ulé kú olɔhi, obɔ̄bí í gáā mɛ ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ nū gbóógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kwú íne nɛ̄ é bīya nyā ú kpó tayínū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄kā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo ge lɛ áfū nɛ̄hɛ́ nya ɔdɔ nōbí iyē ā. E gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla í kɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ áncā. Nááná, é ka aá ɔɔ́ kē ba ī kɛlā kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Amáŋ ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā í ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ebilíi le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu yɔ̄ ī bɛ́yíkwu īyī uwā, ɔwɛ nyá nēé í bá tɔ̄há piyóó glá ā? Aá ka ami ɔ́ɔ gē nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ ohígbū ka Ubéélsēbulu jé ɔfú gā um á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú owu nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō tá eyī ísu, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́kɔ ā gáā pīya tū ipú enyi á. Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū yɔ̄ gē gbiyɔ̄lā.

eng_Latn: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
idu_Latn: É bá gē yíkpɛ́lā mɛ́mla o bá gē táafu ojigógó. É gē gbɛlá olɔhi glá gɛ ŋ́. É lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛyi dóódu ipú kú uwā gɛ ŋ́. É gē gbɛlá ka ɛ̄gbā ōgbō Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔwɛ ō bī le yá ije nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ óndú ɔlɛ́ ā nyāŋjɛ lɛ ɔdūngwɔ̄wɛ ā gwū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá háyi okómpīinu iyɛ̄cɛ gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔwɛ gē ka kahíníī, Lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla lɛ alɔ, ɔkpani! Ó géē tá aá ohi kahíníī, N jé aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
idu_Latn: N da uwɔ ka a géē klá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔkɔ́bɔ ámōōmɛ kú olóofī ā cíla.

eng_Latn: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
idu_Latn: Ó le obū tū wā í klá ɛcɛ, kwú ɛcɛ ú dobū. Amáŋ ācɛ Íjīpiti í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ákisi, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú Usíkilāgi ú lɛ ɔ́ á. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā Usíkilāgi kwú pīya ɔlɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ owu okwɔ́lá nɛ̄hi kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā tū klá Ujóna, anɔ́ɔ Ujóna gáā hɛ́kwú ohígbū ɛnɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ klá anú ɛyí ā. Eyī yá Ujóna kóō gekwú, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ó lɔhi ká n̄ gekwú fíyɛ́ oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ulífāyi éyi lā ipú ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú ipɔɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem. Ó lɛ odiyɔ éyi Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m, ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósuwa yēeyī gāá kwu lɛ ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Igbīhi nōó gekwú ā, é klla bá ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ, nēe má ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā lɛ pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni bá gē nyɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
idu_Latn: É lɛ ikpékwúja kú ɛna ma lɛ īyī uwā, anɔ́ɔ é ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔwɔ kú aá nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛcá nēé cá uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ tíipíípú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá awanda ga amu ga ánū ā wɛ olíla.

eng_Latn: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu gekwú, eko nōó wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ cigwó ā á. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcí nya okwū kú nū ā, le ɔ́ tū lɔɔlɔhi cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī wa ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ikpati á.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, aá híīī gbɛka fúlufúlu ŋ́. Aá kōō híīī bī ɔkpáncō gbɛka ŋ́ ohígbū koó wɛ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē wā ŋmá igelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ipɔ́lɛ́ nɛ́ncɛ nēe yɛ Ujerúsālɛm jīla tá ā. É géē wā ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamin, ŋmá ikpɛ́fu, ɛyí ɛfu, mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda. E géē bī ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú, kú īkpɔ̄dā, ɔtulalī mɛ́mla ɛya kú ahínyá ō tá wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um.

eng_Latn: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gbɔɔ́ ō ka ije ā, é hī ɔ̄cɛ éyi igwú gé lɛ ɔ́, nōo bī ɔ̄ ɛkpa ije úlūūlā.

eng_Latn: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ojámá dúú nōo ī yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō bīyíne, gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ɔ̄cɛ ā kóō híī ka ka, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yá anúɔ ojámá ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdā dúú í já Ɔwɔicō má kóō yá obɔ̄bí glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā eko nɛ̄ ōcē gbɔɔ́ ō habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é tóohi kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ̄, ɛplá oje éyi kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ nɛ̄ iyē ōkwɔ́lá ā habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá á.

eng_Latn: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
idu_Latn: Ā híī má ɔ̄cɛ o lɔnɔ ɔtū ímálānyī ámāŋ ka o yúnwū odée kú nū ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō ī gbla uwá yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ éyi wā í yɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le okwú kú nū ā má tá ɔwɛ á. Ágábá mɛ́mla ijakī ā kē háyi pī ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá Ubɛ́tɛlu gaá le ɔdā nēé má ā ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
idu_Latn: Ujohánan, Ɛlsábādi.

eng_Latn: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá le cāālɛ́, ayí kú Ulífāyi ā géē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um á. É klla í je ɔ́ kwaajɛ ɛga ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ­ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo túblá anú géē kwú.

eng_Latn: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Umérāri wɛ Umáhili, Ulíbini, Ussímēyi, Ussá.

eng_Latn: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
idu_Latn: N lɛ okónu ce mla aá ka, éŋkpɔ̄ í gaá je odúúdú aɔ́dā oyēēyī ā yíífi igbohá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Éŋkpɔ̄ í gáā je ɛcɛ ā yíífi igbohá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla yēeyī iháyí úla ɛpa ce ofuciigwó ɔhá kpɔ́ á. Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhā dúú.

eng_Latn: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N géē da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɔdā nāa yá ā, n géē cɛ̄tra awɔ ipú ōjīla kú uwā.

eng_Latn: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má nyā hɛ um ohí nɛ̄hi, ó klla je unwalu gā um.

eng_Latn: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
idu_Latn: Ísu nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā kéē gwó kwūūū. Ājɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, kéē gwéeyē ká ɔtū kóō he uwā.

eng_Latn: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū ayínɛ́ nēe bá Ulayodísīya, mɛ́mla Unímfa mɛ́mla ācɛ icɔ́ɔci nēe bá inu ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
idu_Latn: É ma ɔdɔ kú igelī ā ce ɛyí aɛ́cɔ̄ kú ikpíinu igwɛ́ɛpa. É le iyē kú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ɔyí álá ā éyééye tá tū aɛ́cɔ̄ ā éyééye.

eng_Latn: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n má ipú ɛcɛ ā wɛ ka, ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ nōo kwinya fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ nyā, gē mīyɛ uloko ā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē yálé ɔgbɛ́fú ā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ācɛ nōo jéeyī fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē lɛ̄ agbénú ā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cíkā ō lé ɔcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē cɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́. Iyɔ̄nɔ ámáŋ ka iyaōolɔhí lɔfú yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú uwā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da uwá ka odúúdú uwā kéē háyí ɛga nēé háyi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ mɛ́mla Ujonátan kóō háyi ɛga ɔhá. É tá ɔ̄ ohi ká ɔ̄ yá ɔdā dúúmā nɔ́ɔ má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā, gbonɛnɛ lɛ alɔ, kéē lā ajɛ ā kéē tá ɔ́hí ipú nū, ohígbū ka ajɛ ā jɛ̄ uwā. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā, ká ālɔ̄ je ayí alɔ nɔ̄nyā lɛ uwá kéē lɛ.

eng_Latn: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ yá ká ā yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí á nɛ, lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Ohígbū ka ó géē lɔhi gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ká āyā éyi kú iyē kú uwɔ kóō le bīya, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ odúúdú iyē kú uwɔ géē ga ipú ɔlá kú ɔlíkɔtɔ.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Ahíja le uya kú ikpó kú nū pó yɔ̄ í wā inu ā, ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā inu mɛ́ɛnɛ, ɔnyā kú Ujérobōwam. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá īyī nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ɔhá ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā obɔ̄bi nɛ̄hi ō ka mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ! Ohígbū ka n géē tū aólɛlā obɔ̄bí wā ipú aá gaá nuunu tú aá. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́gwā olɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í bī ɔdā dúú le tá úwā ɛyí wāajɛ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ádā nū da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī, Aá pápá lɛ awulú nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā kpó wā í wu ɔ́ iyē. Aá kwú eliká ú wu ɔ́ abɔ̄, aá kwú áblákpá ú wu ɔ́ ikpó.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ aflɛ́yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu gekwú. Eko ɔ́ɔmā Udéfīdi nyɔ̄ í le ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki yálé kē kwúcē wā Usíkilāgi, ɛga nōó lā eko ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ó klá ɔlɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā alɔ lé umaná ipú ígbíli, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ó je igbō lɛ uwá ŋmá ɔkpáncō kéē lé.

eng_Latn: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó yá um bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ nēe wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kpó bá ɛga ámōōmɛ kú ɔgba ā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé lɛ uwá ŋmɛpɔbí, nēé kē í kpó uwā ŋmó ipéyī ójīla kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla alɛɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nēé gē hī ɛ̄cī ā ka Upúrim ā yɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ɔkpá nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi tá mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā.

eng_Latn: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ le gbájí ipú igelī ā, igelī ā klla kwú catāajɛ. Ācɛ le pɛ́ kwu gaá tayínū inu ɔlɛ́ uwā, lɛ ɔwɛ kpó gwū tū īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni ma ayí nɔ̄nyilɔ ɛnɛ. Iyē kú uwa wɛ Unádābu nōo wɛ ɔ́kplá ā, Abíhu, Ɛlísa mɛ́mla Utáma.

eng_Latn: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ kú um ipú aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cɛ nōo jé ō gwíinu lɔɔlɔhi, nōo lɛ ikpíinu táajɛ ā. Úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cohɔ́ɔdɔ, nōo gē gwó inu ce ɛyí ikpíinu ā. Amáŋ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kóō leyī kwɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó í gwíinu ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa, nōó bī abɔ̄ kú nū le ɛlā nōó ka lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɔlá, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ jīla mla anú īkpɛ́fu ā tū ɔ̄ á ú lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
idu_Latn: N da īyī um ka n géē yēeyī gboji géē gbo ókplícī, klla í kwú ɔlɛ́ um ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla ayí nɛ̄ Óndū ā kpó ga um ā wɛ aɔ́dōcābɔ̄ kú olɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ oji nū lɛ Óndú ā, ń táafú ayíka ádā nū yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī hóoji ā, nɛ̄ ó kē ka ɔdā dúú ŋ́, ó lɛ ā oji ā yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá bī jé ɔwɛ okpaakpa jāā ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
idu_Latn: Ulé kú olɔhi ō yá wɛ oyēeyī, amáŋ, íne obīya gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá ínoōbīya éyi ga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá ācɛ kú ajɛ Ukénan lé. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yá uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi gwó ipú ígbíli, mɛ́mla ede nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá ɛyí nū ā yɔ̄ Ugíbīyɔn, jāā kwu eko ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
idu_Latn: Óndú ālɛ ɔkpá ce īyī nū klla lɛ ɛka gbo lɛ a ɛɛ, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n mia a, gēe yá píii; ɔdā nɛ̄ n lɛ abɔ̄ nū kwu ɔtū a gēe yá píii.

eng_Latn: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́kɔ pɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄ ámāŋ ka ahāapa ā, igbeékpónú é má Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī yāwu eyī ísu lɛyíkwu ɔ́kɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi.

eng_Latn: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
idu_Latn: kéē gwíije cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ɔcɔɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɔnɔɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
idu_Latn: ɛháajɛ kú inu ɛpa kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɛ́yí kú inu ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ gbo ɔ́ ā, ɔwɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nōo tá ga eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú ɛga otá pée kú eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó kpó ɔdā ɛhi lɛ ayí kú anyā ɔhá nōó lɛ ā. Eko nōó yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó le uwá nū ŋmá ɛgiyí Áyísīki, ɔyí nū, ga ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é kwú igbīhi í cēkwu um, anɔ́ɔ é gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá á. É le um yá cɔ̄nū ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá nyā. N le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́. Ń kē gáā kpó ɔlá ŋmá ɔtū lɛ ɔ́ gwó ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
idu_Latn: Ami Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka a lɛ ɔkpá tá fu odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā, mɛ́mla Usefaníya, ɔyí kú Umaásēya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya igbɔhá kpɔ́. Aá da Usefaníya ipú ɔkpá ā ka.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē wɔ́tū aá ohígbū um.

eng_Latn: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá ka ɔcɛ́ kú uwā mɛ́mla uwá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ aígabɔ̄ ā ōfōofū uwā, nɛ̄ ɔkpani anúɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ nyā fu uwá ā nɛɛ? Ó kóō lɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ nēe cīce ɛyí ɔdɔ ā dúú nɛ. Ohígbū ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ géē kpó emī kú īyī uwā le, klla í gwá encílé kú īyī uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ aígabɔ̄ ā géē yá dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
idu_Latn: É le iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya tá eko kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá nya: Ɛlíyāssību, Ujóyāda, Ujonátan, mɛ́mla Ujadúwa. É tá iyē nyā tāajɛ kwɛyí eko nɛ̄ Udáyírɔ̄si wɛ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upésīya ā.

eng_Latn: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yá ka ācɛ aéwɔhá kéē wī uwá uwī. Ká ācōbɔbíipú ɔɔ́ géē kpó odúúdú agbénú kú uwā klla í je ɔ́ nyílá.

eng_Latn: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā ohígbū aɔ́cí kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā, kwu ɔcí nēé hī ka uháyísɔ̄pu nōo gē tá klá ɔdɔ ā dúú. Ó kɛlā ohígbū aɛ́bɛ́, aígbáanɔ, mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ō lɛ āpū mɛ́mla aɛ́béenyi.

eng_Latn: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: É bī ugóolu nēé ca báajɛ pátáká ā nōo gbɛnú bɛ̄ɛka ákú īkpīje nēé hi usɛ́kɛlu úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛta ce ɛhīlī ā, le yá éyééye kú aɔ́kplɛ́fú nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ yá ā. Ó kwu odúúdú uwá ú kpó bá inu kú ūpū ɛga ōjīla kú Ulébānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu lɔfú yá ɔwɔ lɛ iyīnū glá āa? Ehée ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔwɔ yá lɛ iyīnū, ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɔwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ uwá bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ lā ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É kē yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē, ká ɔtū kóō kē he aá, ohígbū ka ulé kú aá nwuné ɔkpáncō. Aá kē jé ka ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé kē yá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gbɔbū lɛ aá ā ōwē icíci dúú á.

eng_Latn: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
idu_Latn: Ahítūbu wɛ ɔyí kú Amárīya, Amárīya wɛ ɔyí kú Asárīya, Asárīya wɛ ɔyí kú Umérayɔtu.

eng_Latn: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka aúgbɔga ā géē bá ī lɛ ije nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē le kplá uwá, amáŋ uwá ā í gáā lɛ ije nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í lɛ kplá aúgbɔga ā ŋ́. Ó ka igbīhāajɛ ā, aúgbɔga ā géē je pīya ācɛ nēe í gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ gekwú, aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí gáā je ɛbɛ́ kú uwā lé á. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gáā hile ipú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē nū aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ hɛ̄ okwū kú uwā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ojuja yá kóō yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ ā mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛhícō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kɔ̄ hīyī ūwā tá á.

eng_Latn: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī cɛ̄ ka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ a lɛ ipú aá, kóō le pīya ajodobū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka amáŋ anúɔ le odúúdú ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ā bī yúklɔ́ kpɛ́mm, anúɔ kōō le ɔcɛ́ kú Ámālēki, Ágāgi kwú oyēeyī wā, klla le ācɛ Ámālēki ohile ā kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ɛhícō, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn. N géē bī uwā wā í kpɛ́fú tá ajɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā anú, klla mɛ́mla odúúdú aéwo nēe lā kwú Ujúda ajaajɛ ā. N géē je éwo nyā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú nū, mɛ́mla aéwo nēe lā kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā yíífi, nōó géē wɛ ɛbɛ o héyī. Ó kē í tá alácɛ̄ piyóó, nɛ̄ ācɛ kē í yá uwā okónu.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
idu_Latn: Á cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, aóladóogbe kú uwɔ nēe ī yunwū ɔnyā nɛ̄hi ā, ge gwutá mla uwɔ. A bī akwuna oōyá kú uwɔ nyā í yá um ɛlā íwɔ́tū.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa wā í junwalu gā um ā? Ɔdíyá nāa wā í yá um ká n̄ cīgbīhi ā? Usɔ́lu tóohi kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ipú unwalu nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya gáā wā í kpɛ́fú tá um, Ɔwɔicō kē le igbīhi cē kwu um. Ó klla tá um ohi ɔwɛ dúúmā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Kwu ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄na, amáŋ ákú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ. Anú yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n wā í hī uwɔ igwú kú ā da um ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ā á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gā ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā í mīyɛ aá ŋ́, nēé ke jāhɔ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ kú aá lɛ úmúlá kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ gwō bónū ŋmá áblákpá kú aá. Ɔ́ɔmā í mafú lɛ uwá ka Ɔwɔicō géē yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, íwɔ́tū kú um géē je wī wā í klá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Ó géē je uwá kpó yíífi ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ā. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú ajɛ ō gbō nēé le tū ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóra mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Umɛrári abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́ssɔn mɛ́mla Áram mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ofɛtá abɔ̄fú. É mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujɛ́ɛ mɛ́mla Ukénan mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe kwu uwá ajaajɛ ā dúú. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umákīyɛ, ádā kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu cigwáahātá nɛ̄ Ása lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Áhābu ɔyí kú Ómri kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó gbō Ísrɛ̄lu Usamérīya iháyí ofu cɛpa.

eng_Latn: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú alɔ, kwu ami mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ohile ā, tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā ā. Olɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá kē mīyɛ cɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
idu_Latn: Íkókwū nyā, nɛ̄ ɔkpani gē bī lɛ gwá ejé á. Ó klla gē lɛ ɔ́ má ācɛ ɛbɛ. Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yá yɔ̄ á n.

eng_Latn: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
idu_Latn: Adonibɛ́sēki lɛ inya kwu, amáŋ é nū ɔ̄ inya gāá lɛ ɔ́ kwú. É le ocúgbɔ̄du íkpó mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄du kú abɔ̄ kú nū kpó gwó.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aínɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɔfú bēhé ísu ā, gāá mīyɛ ajɛ nēé gáā bēhé ga ɔɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
