idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō jéeyī klla lɛ ɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í bɛ̄yíkwu ɔ́, ká ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō yálé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu í gáā lé ijē ámāŋ oyī kú ɛbɛ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē le tū piyóó, ɛga dóódu nēé lā.

eng_Latn: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī ofɛpa cahātá ā kpó lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ipú inu ɛcí kú uwā nēé hī ka, Udégɔn ā. É gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi pī ojibó kú ɛcí kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
idu_Latn: Ujósuwa, nēé kē hī ka Ujɔ́stɔ̄si ā, hokónu tū aá. Ācɛ ɛtá nēe bá ā wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ōfōōfūwā nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nēe bá ī yúklɔ́ mla um ohígbū ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō á. É tū um abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
idu_Latn: ó kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú á, le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
idu_Latn: Aádáádā alɔ gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɛyí ɛfu nyā, amáŋ aá ācɛ Ujíyu ka ka Ujerúsālɛm ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔ cíkā kéē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ Óndú ā je á, Óócí wɛ usábāti, ɛ̄cī otīihɔ kú ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá úklɔ́ dóódu ō yá. Aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ŋmɔ́lá glá ā, ŋmɔ́lá. Aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá le cɔlá glá ā cɔlá, aá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo hile ā kpó bá gbɔ́ɔ́cī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄, odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ámɔn, nēe bá ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ukénan nēe lā pīya ísu ā, le pó ka, Óndú ā le éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ hīla ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē bēé á, ɔtū kú uwā kwú kpó gbenyi, ipú le gbogodo lɛ uwá. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í klla lɛ ɔtū gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ufi kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé bá ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
idu_Latn: Uhúr ma Úri á. Ɔyí kú Úri wɛ Ubásālelu.

eng_Latn: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gē gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi ā, klla ī yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, ɛ́ɛ ī pa ɛcí ɛháajɛ ɔkwu kú ɛdɔ aɔ́cí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ayí nɔ̄nyā kú uwā le pīya akwuna, anyā ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ūwā klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbaajā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
idu_Latn: N pó uya kú acá kú uwá eko nēé ī wu ā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú ísu. Uya kú uwā klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka uya kú ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, mɛ́mla ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Eko dúú nēé mā oōwu nɛɛ, é kwú aácá kú uwá ī cē klá.

eng_Latn: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ije kú uwɔ kóō le yíífi mla awɔ, ohígbū ka a gbɛlá ka a géē bī ije le lá ɛhi kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ Ujóssuwa hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ipēyī odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú tīyé, ka ɔ́ɔ klla lɔtūlé, ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā kpó ācɛ nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā kéē mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cokónu ō je lɛ aádáádā uwā á.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Alússi gaá lā Urefidím, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ā í má éŋkpɔ̄ gwá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka amíɔɔ wā ɛgiyí anúɔ ká amíyɔ lɛ anúɔ ŋmó. Ó ka ohígbū keé lɛ ágbe yá anúɔ nɛ̄hi, anúɔ yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi, ka amáŋ anúɔ í kē kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛwa ā má ā, ó le tá ɛyí ɛfu. Eko nōó má yāajɛ ā, ayíkpó kú nū gā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
idu_Latn: ka ń gaá je owú ékpónú ámāŋ ɔ̄ŋgbā kú áblákpá, ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ákú uwɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū nɛ̄ a géē ka igbīhāajɛ kahíníī, Ami je Ébram gbagbénú á.

eng_Latn: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
idu_Latn: Hápápá wā í tá um abɔ̄, Óndú ā, awɔ nōo ī hɛ́ um tá ā.

eng_Latn: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
idu_Latn: Akpókónu kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛwɔ́ ā. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ a ī kɛlā, ó lɔhi oōmá nɛ̄hi. Ábáa kú uwɔ ī ceyī mlómló ŋmá ipú īlī ō kléeyī kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā oócí, a géē bī īkpīje nɛ̄hɛ́ ékpónú le lá okoolo kú umu ɛhīlī mla ákú īkpɔ̄dā ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ije nɛ̄hi ga iyāwu ā, ó gáā wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ jāā ga aláadi ɛpa.

eng_Latn: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, á tá klla pīya igbīhi kwu ɔcɛ́ nāa lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí klla fu je ce ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́. Lɛ ɛlá kwu ihɔtū kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́ nāa lɛ lɛ ádā um, Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá fú gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó yá ɛcɛ ā, o yá kóō bī ɔ̄ le nya aá tá, abālɔbányā nɛ̄ ɛcɛ ī wā oŋmɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Ampliyátɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ oklóbīya um nōo pīya tɔ̄há mla um ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Óndú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á ī jɛ́lɛ́. Amáŋ ó bī ɛlā nōo ī ka ā kpɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alelékwū kú nū nɛ.

eng_Latn: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, anyā uwā cíkā lɛ uce olɔhi, é gáā wɛ ācɛ o híla ācɛ ŋ́, amáŋ é cíkā o gbeeyī cíí, ɔtu kú uwā kóō le yēŋēē ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti nōo wɛ ɔnyā Usólómɔ̄n ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī kú Udéfīdi, le tá ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū nɛ̄ ɔbá nū gwó ā, Usólómɔ̄n le ajɛ kpó tū ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ o ŋmá ɛgiyí íne nɛ̄ ínoōbīya má ɛga je ɛdɔ kú únwū ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí tá ipú ɔtū kú um á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō wɛ íne ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ínoōbīya í géē yɛ í lɔfú dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, ācɛ kú Ámɔn, Umówābu, Ɛ́dɔm le ɛfú kpó í gwū alɔ ɛɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, á cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bū ipú ajɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é le cēbla ajɛ ā biílí, anɔ́ɔ é kpó ācɛ ā yíífi ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le kpó hídáagó ɔwɛ nōó bī íkwu le nwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
idu_Latn: Eko īkée, nɛ̄ aá nyɔ̄ gáā lā bɛ̄ɛka aúgbɔga ajɛ Íjīpiti ā, aá nyɔ̄ abɔ̄yī aá ā, Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ nyā, ācɛ Asírīya gaá lɛ aá kwú abɔfú, é kē gbā ɔdā dúúmā ikpɛ̄yí kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
idu_Latn: Nwū ɔyí uwɔ ɛlā, ká ā pi ɔ́ ahɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka á yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ayíka a yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō je iyī nū yíífi.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Uhúram, nōo lā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáya, nōó wɛ ɔ̄coyúklábɔ̄ kú oje udɔ nɛ̄hi ā hīgwú wā.

eng_Latn: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ íkókwū kú ugóolu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēé bī le tū ejé lɛ ācɛ á. Ejé nōó kpó klɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā í tōō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amásīya le ɛhɔ̄ kú ɛfú tū fu Ujɛhówāsi ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kɔ́ɔ̄ wā ká aá leyī méyī ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
idu_Latn: É le aɔ́nɔ́ŋgblɔ ā yá bɛ̄ɛka ododó ā. Olīkpō kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó ɛhīlī ā.

eng_Latn: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Udéfīdi kpɔ́ kahíníī, A yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyā tayínū, amáŋ ami ā, n géē yá kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔdūwēyī nyā kóō yá du uwɔ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ gēdēē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
idu_Latn: Ujówēla mɛ́mla Usebadíya, ayí kú Ujɛ́rōham ŋmá Ugɛ́dɔ.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kahíníī, Ā da um ká amíyɔ̄ tá ācɛ nēe bá nyā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
idu_Latn: A jáglīmā, a klla lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, a lóofu klla tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi, a klla lɛ ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́. Odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō ā wɛ ákú uwɔ. Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ á. Awɔ kē fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
idu_Latn: Umáta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Īī, Óndú. N cɛ̄ ka a wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo gáā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpani nū tíne kóō yá ŋ́ mā, nááná nōó lɛ odée yá nēé cíkā ō gɔ́ itali ohígbū nū, italā kú nū géē wɛ ka é gáā gɔ́ ɔ̄ nwuné ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō gē leyīce ɔdā nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká n ka ɔdā dúúmā, n tíne ō ka aflɛ́yí ka, n tá Ɔwɔicō kú um ahínyá ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ aá ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ yɔ̄ ī pó ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
idu_Latn: É da uwá ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́dāŋ nēé blakwu íne nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ bīya eko nɛ̄ aá bá Upéyɔ, nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yá aá italā bū ipú ōcē nɛ̄ ɔ́ tū klá aá āā. É kée kōō gwu aá iyē ŋmá anú dúúdú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nēé fu ɔ́ ɔkɔ̄ nyā mɛ́mla iyē kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́mpa ā ámāŋ ka álūka nōo kwɛyí iyē kú nū ā ŋ́, í gáā lá ɔ́lá glá ŋ́, ó kē gáā je ɔlá lá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko kú ɔdā ō je cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū kú iháyí ɔhá ā, ó géē je pīya ákú Óndú ā piyóó. Ó géē wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ í pɛ̄ ŋmá ɛhícō wā ā, kwú tīkwū gicō bá ɛga ékpónú jāā ga ɛga oligbó kwu ɛga nēé hī ka Ádām, igelī nɛ̄hi nōo kwu Usáretan ā. Enyi ɛ̄nɛ̄ o gē yɔ̄ í pɛ́ ga ɛháajɛ gā ísu ɔmā ā kwú hɛ́ dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ācɛ ā kéē le bēhé ga ɛga nēe kwu Ujérīko ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
idu_Latn: Ussifúfam mɛ́mla Uhúfam.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, n géē kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ aá kpó uwā lá nyɔ̄ ā. N klla géē yá aá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ā híī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ alɔ tá ŋ́, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ. Ohígbū ka a jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ gē lā ipú ígbíli lɛ ā. Á kē í yɔ̄ ī bī alɔ jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū cɛ̄ ŋmá igbīhi lɛ āa, ó kwú āyā kú ɔlá nū ā í tayínū. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ohile ā bī wā gé lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē yá okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ ce lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ í je ɔ́ pīya ákú anúɔ ā jīla. Ɔ́ɔ kē í cɛ̄ ka anúɔ wɛ Óndú nū.

eng_Latn: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē da um kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ádā um mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú um á, awɔ gē gbō um klla gē hɛ́ um tá á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē nuunu lɛ aá. Aá kóō bá cíí mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄hi nōó lɛ lɛ alɛɛcɛ eko dóódu ā, mɛ́mla ohígbū ɔdā idáagó nōó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, nōo lé ka Usáyímɔ̄n jé ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Usáyímɔ̄n, n lɛ odée gáā da uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Usáyímɔ̄n kahíníī, Īī utíca, da um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ucē nōo lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Eko nyá nāa géē wā ɛgiyí um ā? N géē lā oyēeyī oyēŋēē mɛ́mla okpaakpa ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
idu_Latn: Ācogbāálá bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, bá gē gbō aálá kú uwā ipácí otú.

eng_Latn: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ce igwáahāanɛ eko nōó hɛ́ apī ā.

eng_Latn: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ Ádā ā je gā um ā géē wā ɛgiyí um. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wā ɛgiyí um, ń gáā nū ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɛyí utéblu ā. Ó klla lé ɔdōlé ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa kú ucɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔtū le bīya lɛ ɔ́, ohígbū ka ádā nū lɛ uwēyī je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā pó, ká ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔkwu nū bū lɔɔlɔhi, ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā yá.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
idu_Latn: Ɔnɔ nɛ̄ n jé ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ um. Otú dóódu, agīje le cēnyi tá agōdō kú um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpā gē cēenyi ā, ohígbū ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je ā. Upílo kú um klla kwú gbenyi cɛkpɛɛ mla agīje kú um.

eng_Latn: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ ɔdōplayi ahɔ̄ kú uwā kpó plla ŋmá ahɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó gé lɛ Árɔ̄ni á.

eng_Latn: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá iháyí ofu ga iháyí ofɛtá ā, ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu kwú ɛcɔ̄ éyi ú kwu ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ólīifu cē klá ɔ́ ɛyí kwú ɔ̄ ú tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Óndú ā má aá abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ɔdā nōo ī tū ɔ̄ íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi ā. Ó má aá, abɔ̄ aá bá ī pā ɛcí klla bá ī yá icɛ̄bɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu mɛ́mla ipú ácí ā. Ucē bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ō yúnwū ɔnyā klla ī da ɔnyā ɔ́mpa nū ɛlā kóō cikpó nū āa. Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, ákú aá mɛɛ. Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá kē í le yēŋēē kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ gɛ?.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, pīyeyī má ɛháajɛ. Tɔ́ɔna obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ūpū kú ɛháajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka.

eng_Latn: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
idu_Latn: Ahítūbu ma Usádɔ̄ku, Usádɔ̄ku ma Ussálum.

eng_Latn: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya ōkpɛ́fú úlā ɛtá cofigwó mɛ́mla aɔ́nya kú ɛfú ulā ofu cigwó . Ó lɛ aóhī kú uwā kpó bá Ujerúsālɛm. Aóhī kú uwá ba aígelī ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔwɛ kú íne nɛ̄ n ca tāajɛ ā gwó gicō kpɔ́, ayíka n yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ihɔtū kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá ō pi búla oyēeyī kú ɔtū ō tá Ɔwɔicō ō gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā, aá klla géē je ihɔtū búla ɔtū kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá ō pi.

eng_Latn: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í lɛ Ugóma, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Udíblém lɛ á. Ɔnyā ā le ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé kwú um ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, n géē ga Ugálīli gbɔbū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, ɔnyā kú ɛnyā kú uwā nōó í wɛ ā gɛ? Ohígbū ka uwā ahāhílahāapa ā lɛ ɔ́ ɔnyā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
idu_Latn: Ká Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ā, kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce aá.

eng_Latn: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
idu_Latn: É í mīya ɛga ɔhá kú ajɛ gboce ɛga nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ā, nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa, nɛ̄ ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄. Ɛga kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohile ā géē lā anú á.

eng_Latn: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ eko dóódu ā mafú gā um. Lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe kwu wā í táyínū ɛgiyí uwɔ ā nyatá ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí eko kpií nyā ā? Alɔ í jɛ́yí ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ogbló okpaakpa kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya.

eng_Latn: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó jé ula ā, ó kē ī bī ula le plla ācɛ. Ó géē gwō klla í yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ, klla ī je ācɛ alɛwa kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ icííci. Ó géē lɛ abɔ̄ gbɔtū lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ nōo fíyɛ́ dúú klla ī nyílá iyē kú nū. Amáŋ é géē je ɔ́ yíífi ɔwɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú ɔlɛɛcɛ í gaá kwu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: Ká ācɛ nēe gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā, kéē wā ɛgiyí um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē kllɔcɛ́ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā, jé ɛdɔ ɛlā nōo gē gbɔtū nɛɛ, amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú ī kɛlā nōo gē bīya ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, n le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwɔ ikpíkpó, a kē yá lɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a wā ā. Abɔ̄ ó lɛ á, odúúdú alɔ bá iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō amānyā ká ālɔ̄ pó ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwɔ ka ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Ágábáidu ɔ́ɔ kōō le Usádɔ̄ku, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, mɛ́mla Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔcɛ́ ɛyí ā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ bíiyē. É kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tóohi kahíníī, É lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ɔkpíihɔ kahíníī, Ó wɛ igbō ōfōōnū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lé le yēeyī ā ŋ́, Amáŋ ó cɛgbá ɛlā dóódu nōo ŋmá okónu kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ajɛ ā kɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú tū Umósīsi ukɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē tū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ádā um cokónu lɛ aá gé lɛ aá. Amáŋ aá géē gbēyī ipú igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm amānyā jāā gbéeko nēé gáā lɛ ɔfú nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā tū aá iyē.

eng_Latn: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
idu_Latn: Ikwū le yɛjīla um tá biílí bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú itekwú ā. Ó hile lígíí kóō kwú um mlɛ.

eng_Latn: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ká ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ojigógó kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛya nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī gwó, o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē yá kéē lɛ alɔ nēe yēeyī eko ɔ́ɔmā túba tɔ̄há mla uwá ipú ojuja cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ jīleyī mla Óndú ā ipú owu. Cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ géē bá pī Óndú ā eko dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá gē bā ī da alɔ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú aá yɔ̄ āa? Óndú, le aéwo nēe ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā yá italā, kéē lɛ ɔ́ má.

eng_Latn: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā nwūla, le aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm, Uhɛ́brɔn, Ujámut, Ulákisi, mla Églɔn ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kɛlā okónu ucē ɔhá géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú ɛhi kú ɔwɔ ō cɛ̄ kú ucē nōó ká ā ú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē kú ācɛ géē kwúcē ga ipú ajɛ ɛga nōó ŋmá ā. Owu kú ɔ̄cɛ kē í kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo je owu ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ ī kɛlā kwɛyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ī bī alɔ le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá ā. Alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kwɛyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ka aá kóō le kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le pó ka Ahítōfɛlu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ pi Ábsālɔm ā, ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu ɔ́ɔ í nwū ā pīya ɛflɛ́ɛfu.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Aspɛ́nāsi da Udánīyɛlu kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ ā je ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ejé nɛ̄ aá gē gwá ā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū wā á. Ɔ́dāŋ koó le má ka á lɔfú iyē klla jɔ̄kwū bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ohile ā ŋ́, ó géē je um ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ cīce ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā cīce anú ā, géē na īlī kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ iyē gwā. Ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aútíca kú íne bá yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū kéē lɛ ɔwɛ nēé géē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmó wɛɛlɛ ā jé, amáŋ é gē yúúfi ācɛ ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
idu_Latn: Óndú, pīyeyī má ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā má alɔ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nōo tīihɔ klla lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi ā. Á pi ɔtū alɔ ká ā bī ɔfú kú uwɔ le cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ alɔ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Á lɛ ɛlá wu alɔ ká ā klla méyīnyinyi alɔ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli, Ássa mɛ́mla āyā ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú Umanásɛ ā kpó hīīgwú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, kéē nū ācɛ kú Umídiya inya á.

eng_Latn: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni le yɛ gaá kwú okwū ā ú lɛ ɔ́ nyi. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le da Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā wɛ ká n̄ le pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɛdɔ ɔfú nōo je Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā lɛ, ká n̄ kē lɛ ɛdɔ ōwē nōó má ā má, ká n̄ kwú ɛdɔ ikwū nōó kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
idu_Latn: Ádā alɔ gekwú ipú ígbíli, ó ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ŋ́, ó wɛ ígwu kú Ukɔ́ra nōo yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā ŋ́, ó kwú ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ó bīya abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
idu_Latn: kwú ɔdōgbɛ́nyɔ́ ú gbō uwā ɛ́nyɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ā kwú ɔdōkwɛyí ú kpó kwu uwá ɛyí. Ɔwɛ nyā nāa géē lɛ abɔ̄ ce Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɛyí á. Uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā géē gwɛ́ɛya gā um piyóó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē cɛ̄ aíne, lɛ uwá tū klla bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ í lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ce mla uwá ā tū, klla í ma ihɔtū kú nū nōó ī mɛ ŋ́ mā fú lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ bá gē gwéeyē ɛga dóódu kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū ka, o ŋmífī eko kú Usólōmɔn, ɔyí kú Udéfīdi ā, ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā í yá Ujerúsālɛm jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si ā n jé ɔ̄, Upɔ́lu ā n kē jé ɔ̄ dúú, amáŋ aá ā wɛ ānyɛ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɛhi nɛ̄ ó bī wā ú kpó lɛ Usólōmɔn. Aɔ́dā kú ɛhi á kē bá á: oje udɔ, anɔ̄, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ugóolu mɛ́mla ɛdɔ iyó ɔhá dóódu. Ɛdɔ anɔ̄ okpócu nɛ̄ ɔcányā kú Ussɛ́ba je lɛ Usólōmɔn ā, ɛdɔ nū ɔhá í yɔ̄ gbóógbóō ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ācɛ nēé fu ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Odúúdú uwā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le úklɔ́ yá iháyí ahāapa ohígbū Urécɛ̄lu á. Amáŋ ó wɛ eko kpií tū ɔ̄, ohígbū ka Urécɛ̄lu le he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ pllá aá kú aá lɔtūce Óndú ā ŋ́. Aá híī gbɛlá ka Óndú ā géē nya aá tá ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē ci alɔ, aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya oō wā í mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati, ɔcɛ́ ā pīyɛyí gā Ujerúsālɛm ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ahātá le gla nōó kɛlā nēe bá nyā ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwú Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla Ujémīsi ú le tá ɛyí ɛfu kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá wɛ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔtōōce ŋ́! Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ mla aá gaá kwu ā? Eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē cībū aá gáā kwu ā? Lɛ ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú uwɔ ā bī gé um.

eng_Latn: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
idu_Latn: Ó hī adá kú nū ā lé ka Ujɛmáyíma. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o wɛ ɔmace kú adá ā lé ka Ukɛsíya. Ó kē hī ɔ́mɛɛtá kú ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ā lé ka, Ukeren-hápūku.

eng_Latn: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū um ā, géē túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū um ipú ufi. N géē yá uwā italā piyóó.

eng_Latn: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
idu_Latn: N géē je ajɛ ā tá alácɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔfú nēe gē yá ɔbɔ́cɛ̄ kú nū nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā mɛ. Odúúdú aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē je pīya ipácí nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɔtū yɛ bū ɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ īkpō kú Alelékwū ā wɛ ihɔtū, éeyē, ɛbɔ́, ɔtū oōlé, ogbonɛnɛ, olɔhi, ɔtōkpóce.

eng_Latn: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipū ā géē bá ī gwéeyē gaá kwu ā? Óndú?.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ Umósīsi kē je íne kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ ɔkpá tá lɛ ɔnyā nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá ɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā kú Usamérīya éyi wā gáā pi éŋkpɔ̄. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Je éŋkpɔ̄ gā um ká n̄ gwá.

eng_Latn: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Ɛ́sra, a í bī íjééyī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ je gā awɔ ā, ká ā lɛ aótrɛ̄yí, aígabɔ̄, mɛ́mla ācohɛ́pɔ̄ fu kéē gbo odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā. O ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú aá lɛ á. A géē nwu ācɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ó jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a ī yá ká ayínɛ́ uwɔ kéē lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya ohígbū ka a ī lɛ abɔ̄ kwɔtū ō lé ɛdɔ kú ɔdōlé éyi piíí, ó lɛ ā ɔdā nāa ī yá ā mafú ka á yíihɔtū tá ɔyínɛ́ ɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. Ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdōlé nāa ī lé ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwú ohígbū ā yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔdā dóódu kpó tútū kwɛyí ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ā le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí úklɔ́ kú uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwú okwū kú nū ú tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú cīgbīhi ga Ujerúsālɛm á. É kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́, Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda kwú ɔyí nū Ujehowáhāsi ú le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kwú ­ɔ̄ ú lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā nū Ujosíya á.

eng_Latn: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē wā ŋmá Usáyɔn, ó géē nū odúúdú ucē kú ɔ́bíipú ŋmá ipú ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
idu_Latn: A í je Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā háyi ipú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú īlī ú klá iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī jikwū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó le ayínɛ́ nū éyééye kwú bɔ́ɔ́tū, klla jikwū klā uwā. Anɔ́ɔ igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ayínɛ́ nū gbɔɔ́ o kɛlā mɛ́mla anú mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá kpó tū ɔ́ŋgbá ácábɔ̄ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā kéē kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni géē bī iyē kú uwā acá, cɛ́ɛ́ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā í blakwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ojigógó.

eng_Latn: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ okónu kwu ɔ́mpa nū iyē ŋ́ mā nɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē yá oklóbīya nū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó klla ī yá awanda tū aɔ́mpa nū ŋ́ mā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā géē wā dúú ā. Ó kē ī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ̄ eko nāa gē ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ó lɔhi ká ā ga abɔ́ɔ gaá jāhɔ̄ kú ā kē kllɔcɛ́ fíyɛ́ ó ga abɔ́ɔ gaá gwɛ́ɛya bɛ̄ɛka aólíla, nēé jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ujékɔ̄pu, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ le tá ɛgiyí Ísɔ, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ. Anú mla ācɛ ūlā, nēe bá pī ɔ́ ā, bá ī wā gaá jīla uwɔ ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē tū ɔlá ga ajɛ kú Ujúda, klla í je igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú Ujerúsālɛm ā yɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā kú ɔtū ō lɛ kú Ubenáya, éyi kú ipú Aícɔ́ɔja ofu cigwó ā á.

eng_Latn: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, n géē kpó ayááyí ga uwɔ nēe géē lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ kú ɔkpáncō ámāŋ ka ikpɔ̄ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu nɛ̄hi ā. É géē yá aólɛla kú uwā lé klla í mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ kóō fīyégbúlú iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Ɛcɛ ā háyi kli, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í fu ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
idu_Latn: Ɔyíkpó kú nū ɔhá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, jɛga gā um ká n̄ gaá lɛ ádā um nyi gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udeláya, Utobíya, mla Unekóda ā wɛ, úlā ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce ɛpa.

eng_Latn: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, abɔ̄ otrɛ̄yí ā tíne kóō bɔkwu ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu kpó ce ɔ́ ā, ó le agbá wī ŋmá Upɔ́lu abɔ̄. Ó le íkwu je lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla odúúdú aúkánsulu ā kéē le jīla. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Upɔ́lu bī wāajɛ, kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
idu_Latn: Yá ka ācɛ nēe le agīje kwu eyī abɔ̄ é bā ī nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, kéē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mla éeyē mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛcí ōpā kú uwá mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ipú ɛcí ōpā mɛ́mla íne ō bīya ɔhá ā. Ubássa mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ɛ́la lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔtū bīya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, le tayínū, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ le íne kú nū mafú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá mɛ́mla ayááyí kú aá í bī íne ā yúklɔ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, a gē bɔ̄bíipú lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛ́tá ā ɔ́mpa awɔ, a klla gē yá ɔtū kú uwā nōó lɔfú ŋ́ mā ágbe. A kē yɔ̄ gē bīyíne lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā abɔ̄ a gē yá ɛ̄nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, ē tá ohi ka aá ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ ā ɔkwɛyi. Ohígbū ka aá jé ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā le da Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ká ɔ̄ kwú odúúdú ajɛ ā ú lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū ā kpó ŋmó. É ka aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā, ohígbū ufi uwā mɛ́mla ufi kú oyēeyī kú aá nɛ̄ aá yá ā nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē da uwá ɛpɔ̄ nēe hɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá ɛ́ɛ géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā í da uwá ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu kéē gbɔ̄ ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
idu_Latn: Aá cāŋjɛ ká aā nyɔ̄, ohígbū ka ɛga omulɛ́nyɔ́ kú ɛbɔ́ í yɔ̄ amānyā gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, īnyī mɛ́mla ínoōbīya, nōo gē je ɔ̄cɛ yíífi ā, lɛ amānyā tútū kóō je ɔ́ yíífi dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ɛ́nɔ̄k yɛ́ɛma klla létɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō iháyí ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá igbɔhá kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla aá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n tū aá ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo ī kpó aéwo yíífi gbɔɔ́ ō wā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo gē wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga otayínū kú nū ā ɛɛ́. Ó gē wā í je ajɛ Ujúda yíífi. É géē je aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda ā kpó catāajɛ nēé í tá alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
idu_Latn: Ope kú ikwū ā ŋmá lɛ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bīya ā, íne nēé gē bīya nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí íne nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ā.

eng_Latn: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn, je Ujehóyākin, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla ígwu kú ācɛ nēé kpó ɔfiyɛ ga Ubábīlɔn ā, Umɔ́dɛkāyi yɔ̄ ipú ācɛ nēe kpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá eko nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni bēhé ga ipú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā kóō gaá yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā, jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ bɛ̄cɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā yɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ŋ́. Eko nōó le uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú īyī nū, ákú ayípɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ákú odúúdú ójīla ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le okónu ce mɛ́mla eyōōnyā mɛ́mla otú cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yɔ̄ eko kú uwā. Ɔdā ɔdū dúú lɔfú bīya okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla uwá ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dōōbɔbí ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í nya alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ̄ nēe bá gē yá alɔ ŋmó ā ŋ́ má. Alɔ leyīce ka alɔ í má ɔlá ofíyajɛ kú alɔ̄ mɛ́ɛbɛ, amáŋ obū nɛ̄ alɔ bá ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
idu_Latn: É kwú iyī uwā ú lɛ ɔwɔ nɛ̄ aéwɔhá ī gbā, nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā. É bá ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú ajɛ kú Upéyɔ. É klla bá ī lé ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ nēé yéeyī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɔtūce aá ɛgiyí ije nōo wɛ agbénú kú ɛcɛ nyā glá ŋ́, ɔ̄nyɛ géē lɛ agbénú ɔkwɛyí ā tū aá abɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Aɛ́bɛ́ ɛnɛ nɛ̄ a má ā, wɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɛnɛ ɔhá nēe géē wā ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú aéwo lɛ ejé olɔfu kú unwū obɔ̄bí kú nū gwá ɛɛ́. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā le ikpó nū ce. Ācotɔ́sú nɛ̄hi kú ɛcɛ ā le gbagbénú ŋmá lɛ unwū ɔdā kú nu nōó ī kwú tū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɛyí inu ɔlɛ́ nū kóō híīī wāajɛ ga ipú inu gaá kpó iyó kú nū ŋ́. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kóō híīī kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
idu_Latn: Ā híla ɔfiyɛ iyɔ̄bū ɔkpani nū ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ó gē tá okónu gā uwɔ, nōo géē cɛ̄ gā awɔ móōwē.

eng_Latn: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā le íkwu je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kéē kwú Upɔ́lu ú bī wā ipú ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ gɔ́ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔkwu ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu bá yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā jé.

eng_Latn: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔci kú Ésiya kpɛ́mm ī hokónu tū aá. Akwíla mɛ́mla Uprisíla mɛ́mla icɔ́ɔci nēe ī jīla tɔ̄há ɔlɛ́ uwā ā ī hɛ́ ɛdɔ kú okónu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ī hɛ́ ā tū aá.

eng_Latn: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le bá lɛ okompinu kú igelī ā, ɛwa kú ācɛ kwúcē okwu éyi yɔ̄ ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú igelī ā. Ɔnyīlɔ nōo kwú ā wɛ ɔyí ékpónú kú ɔnyōkwū éyi. Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ igelī ā tá ɔ̄nyā ā ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔtū le he ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛlā ɔ̄cɛ kē lɛ he ɔ́ ɔtū, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojuja nōo gē bī ɔwɔ wā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē hɛ́hɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ gē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɛcɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mīya, īkpō kú nū wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó. Oŋmá igbīhi kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá bū ɛga nōo tá áncā ā jāā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú inu ā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, wɛ umíta ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti klla le da uwá igbo ɔmɛtá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Amáŋ ɔdōōbɔbí nyá nōó yá ā? Ń má ɔdā dúú nōó yá nōo cíkā kéē ŋmó ɔ̄ ní. N cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́ gɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá kóō nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā da īyī uwā ɔ̄kā ka ɔ̄nyɛ géē kpó aá tɔ̄ɔkwu ga ɔgbɛ́fú gaá nuunu mla ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri āa? É ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē kpó aá tɔ̄ɔkwu ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā, géē je pīya otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ka ipɔ́ɔma kú aá kéē le jé ka n yá ká ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lā ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā, eko nɛ̄ n kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā á.

eng_Latn: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka ɛnɔ kóō bɛ̄cɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē yɔ̄ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā ā, aá lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē ɔ́bíipú dóódu kpó bónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Aá tū iyī aá wāajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá mīyɛ ɛlā kú nū nōó nyi tū ipú ɔtū kú aá, nōo lɔfú nya aá tá glá ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām wɛ iháyí ofu ahātá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le hīlókplícī nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú á.

eng_Latn: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ gē bīya íne kú uwɔ ojigógó, alɔ klla kwú igbīhi í cē kwu uwɔ. Ɔbíipú kú alɔ le alɔ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí. Alɔ jé ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ yá á.

eng_Latn: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, āyā dóódu á. Ɔyā dóódu, ígwu kú ācɛ úlā ofɛtá gē bá ī yúklɔ́ ipú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā ɛháajɛ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā á. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya Isárgon, lɛ ɔ́da je la oduudu a ootrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, nēe kpó ɛfú wā í gwū Ássdɔd ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Ufilístiya, nēe kē lɛ Ássdod, yálé a.

eng_Latn: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ugóssɛn, Uhólɔn, mɛ́mla Ugílo. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi igwóléyi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwá nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔma ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛyi nɛ̄ n, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā dɛ̄gba tū uwa lɔfúlɔfú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē le lɔfú cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā bēé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔyā éyi. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá lā Ugígalu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujérīko.

eng_Latn: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ā lɛ ɔtū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlā kwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, lɛ ɔtū mɛ́mla eko kú uwɔ táajɛ ká ā yɔ̄ ī yá uwā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kéē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī jɛ gɔbū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
idu_Latn: Kɛ̄ɛ ka aá ī leyī gwū Ɔwɔicō bónū ohígbū kóō gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ó kē yá aá italā ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ aá le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ŋ́. Ó gē cībū aá gbojī ajɛ ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ ī yá ká aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
idu_Latn: Uwā wɛ ācɛ piíí nēe gē ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu iyē olɔhi nēé je lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá āá.

eng_Latn: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā nwūla ā, ódūdū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ódūdū kú ácí ugbá ā tá ŋmá anú. Anɔ́ɔ ódūdū nōo ŋmá anú ā kwú ɛbɛɛbɛ í dobū fiyuu, nɛ̄ ɛnɔ í cɛ̄ bū ɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā cāŋjɛ kla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a tóohi kú ɔdā nēé cīije nū bá uwɔ ā lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iwili kú igbō kú eyē ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ lé hile ā túbá, anɔ́ɔ ó le kpó mu ómblí igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔnyilɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ gā, ó lé, ó klla gwá, anɔ́ɔ aá kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́! Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o gwá ejé fíyɛ́ abɔ̄. Ó wɛ óklóbīya aódɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācobīyíne!.

eng_Latn: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
idu_Latn: Ó yā uwā ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā. Ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó hī uwā ka ɔlɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā olɔhi he uwɔ ɔtū. Ɔdā obɔ̄bí í kē he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā fu uwɔ á. Ó le yá ká ā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi, fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́mpa awɔ á.

eng_Latn: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó géē lɔhi kéē da uwɔ ka a wā gāá cīce icō amānyā, fíyɛ́ ō da uwɔ ka ā cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛga nāa cīce iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, A lɛ ɔ́ má ɛɛ́, anú gē kɛlā mla awɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le tá icō ɛfu éyi anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā ā hīgwú gé lɛ iyīnū. É le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nu.

eng_Latn: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛnyā aá kwú ɔdā nōo yá ā ú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Aá tá ɔ̄ ɔtū kwu ɔtū cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō híīī bīya lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo ī yá kóō cīgbīhi ŋmá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, é habɔ̄ ɛ́yá kú uwā tá, anɔ́ɔ é yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujérīko gā Ubɛ́tɛlu. Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ayípɛ̄ ōhī ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā wā gē yá ɔ̄ okónu gē kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ opllɛyí lé, nyɔ̄ opllɛyí lé.

eng_Latn: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Ása le aícɔ́ɔja úlā bá ɛgiyí úlā ce úlā ofu igwáhāapa ce igwó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, mɛ́mla úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn. É bī óbō mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwā. Odúúdú uwā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja olɔhi nēe klla lɛ ɔtú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā kú ejé ā bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
idu_Latn: Isu kú Unáyilu mla ísu kú aá ɔhá dóódu a gé je kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. N klla lɛ igbīhi ce kwu éwo nɛ̄ n fu kóo wɛ ákú um ā ɛɛ́. N kwú ācɛ nēe he um ɔtū ā í kpó bá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
idu_Latn: N le tá ɛhícō gāá bū okónu ɔkpá kú ɔcɛ́ ā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ijakī nɛ̄ n ce ɛyí nū ā í má ɔwɛ yɛ ipú ɔ́tɔ mɛ́mla ácí ā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū yá ɛcɔ̄ ā á, anú klla tá aíne ā tū uwá á.

eng_Latn: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
idu_Latn: Ó géē ŋmó omlede ā ɛga nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ákú ɛbɛ́ ō yɔlá dúúdú ā. Ó í yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ɛya kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé ā mɛ́mla ákú íne ō bīya ā wɛ̄ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó kē tīihɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ kú aá géē wā iyɔ̄bū um gáā gbā ami Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ̄gbā igbɛtá ipú iháyí piíí.

eng_Latn: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū túbá, klla le uwá hɛ́ bá ígwíígwu kú úlā ɛpa ce ofigwú mɛ́mla ofɛhɔ̄ . Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí je lɛ aígwíígwu ā á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄, é le ɔ̄kā bī wā ɛɛ́, Ācɛ éwo éyi nōo kwu ɛhícō bá ī yúuya nɛ̄hi bá ī wā kwuuu. Aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā géē je aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda pīya ipú alácɛ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ aéwo ipácí géē lā.

eng_Latn: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn je Utáya tá alácɛ̄ je ɔ́ pīya ɔlɛ́ kú ɛbɛ́ ipácí á. Ó wɛ ācɛ Asírīya yá Utáya ífi ā ŋ́. Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn cīíbɔm tū uwā mla inɔ̄ɔda klla ca ɔlɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā tāajɛ á. Uwā kē je igelī ā wúlatāajɛ, je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, ń gē dɔɔ̄kā itene kú abɔ̄yī um ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū itene kú ācɛ alɛwa, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le nyatá.

eng_Latn: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúú nēé nyɔ̄ ā, é gē habɔ̄ ífi mɛ́mla ɔdā ō cataajɛ tá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
idu_Latn: Ó gē da īyī nū kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá um gbóógbóō ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō ī ga ipú unwalu dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ nōo wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā cíkā ō tá ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ wɛ ācɛ o yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há ipú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ā? Ó da uwá ka anúɔ í jé nóó.

eng_Latn: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī wā ā, ó í yá kú ofiyajɛ kú nú kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄woolímanya ā, ɔlá gē cɛ̄ maámaá ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú ɛga dóódu í cɛ̄tra ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ayíkpó kú nū kéē da ācɛ ā kéē lɛ iyī uwā kɔ̄ ígwíígwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cīce ɛyí ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ká a gaá lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túbá tɔ̄há. Ká ā da uwá ka, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛgiyí uwɔ. Da uwá ka n gā ɛgiyí uwā gaá le ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Íjīpiti yɔ̄ ī yá uwā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔcí géē jɛ̄, le ēpū klla gwá īkpō lɛ aá igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, géē wā ɔlɛ́ ānāānā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ wɛ Óndú kú usábāti á.

eng_Latn: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ícɛ nyā, n lɛ ufi kpó tū aéwo kú ɛcɛ nyā ipú ohígbū aá. É géē pó ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu aá, é kē í gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú ohígbū ufi aá.

eng_Latn: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usɔ́lu lɛ ujɔ̄ kú uwā ā jé. É gē gbō okónu igá kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā otú mla ɛnɔ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
idu_Latn: Le ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ā, ka lɛ ācɛ ā. Da uwá ka n ka, N wɛ olɛlā kú aá, aɛ́fu kú Ɛ́dɔm. N géē je aá tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this is that king Ahaz.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ unwalu ā le tá ágēnégēne kú nū ā, o klɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ nɛ̄ Áhāsi ɔcɛ́ kú Ujuda, jé ō bīya íne gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ yá ā yɔ̄ á. Ó ka amíyɔ̄ gāá lɛ īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ ōyɔ́ɔgɔndu lā kú amíyɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔ́ɔgɔndu. Amáŋ ó da um ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ wu éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwá kpó ŋmó ígbíli abɔ́ɔ, ɛga nēé nu uwa inya wā ā. É klla, kwúcē ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ái gaá lɛ ācɛ o hile ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa le ayí kú Usedekíya kpó ŋmó ipéyī nū. Ó klla le aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujúda kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
idu_Latn: Ehɛ́ɛ! ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, ucē kú aá tɛtɛ lɔhi nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ā. Ucē kú aá klla tɛtɛ lɔhi nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ejé olɔhi nɛ̄hi ā, amáŋ abālɔbányā, ucē kú aá kwú bɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ejé nēé le énkpɔ̄ cē tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kwú ɔ̄ ú bīya ā.

eng_Latn: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aígabɔ̄ kú um ā le pó ka ami mɛ́mla awɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ̄kā kā, é géē wā í da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ka ā. É géē cokónu ga uwɔ ka aá gáā ŋmó uwɔ ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ odúúdú ɔ̄kā ā ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lé ka Unáaman. Anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya á. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛnɛ̄hi. Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya klla í lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Óndú ā bī Unáaman le yá aólɛlā kú ācɛ Usiríya lé. Ó wɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔfú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó lɛ agwú.

eng_Latn: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ odée klá ɛyí ŋ́, ayíka ó lɛ ɛyí kú nū wā tāajɛ béekpóó. Abɔ̄ ó kē wɛ ɔdūwēyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā kóō lɛ ɛyí kú nū plla tāajɛ ā, ayíka ó cíkā ō lɛ odée klá ɛyí kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yi ɛna ɔlá ā géē na īlī kú nū klla í pīya éŋkpɔ̄ klá iyī nū iyē, ámāŋ ó géē yɔ̄ iyē oōtéelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ á, N géē kpó ɔdā dóódu yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn ā kpó hīgwú klla da uwá ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá lɛ uwá āa? Ó ka anúɔ tíne ō lɛ odée yá lɛ uwá kwɛyí ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá uwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū nyɔ̄ ga odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē gbā ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ā le pɛ́ wā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í hile ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ó wā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tū ipú inu kú Ubáalu. É le mu inu ā jāā kwɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
idu_Latn: Ítrɛyám, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Égla, ɔnyā Udéfīdi ɔhá. É ma odúúdú ayí nēe bá nyā lɛ Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyā ɛtá le gla ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi da Ujúda kahíníī, Utáma, ɔnyā ɔyí uwɔ le ajā gbo ɛɛ́. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ó kē le ipú kú ajā yɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ kéē lɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ! Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ipú ɔ́wá kú aókóome ā á. Odúúdú aókóome ā le kwu ga ukɔngɔ̄ kú ísu ā le pɛ́ tá ipú ísu, anɔ́ɔ é gebí ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
idu_Latn: A má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ móōwē ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti lɛ ā. A klla lɛ ɔkɔ nē é gbā gā awɔ okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā pó.

eng_Latn: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɛbɛ́ ɛna ohile ā ú, mɛ́mla ɔkpá kú nū mɛ́mla ícɛ̄bɛ́ kú nū mɛ́mla aájīlīpú kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú yɔlá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne kú nū lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ límanya ŋmá ipú ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīsi ōhī mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne ōhī nēe wɛ ipú ɔwá kú uwā ā ka iŋiní lɛ ayíkpó kú Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī lé klla í gwá mɛ́mla ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācobīyíne āa.

eng_Latn: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ó ŋmó mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnya kú Umídīyan ā wɛ Usímīri, ɔyí kú Usálu, otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
idu_Latn: Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujówābu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ofu cigwó ā á. Anú ōfōōfūnū bī óbō kú nū le nuunu tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kē le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ohígbū koó wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya, nōo gēe yá kéē kpó íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī le pɛ kwúcē igbīhi ŋmá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ gebí ipú áafú ō tá kú olílā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī oŋmɔ́cī nū ā, Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā cāŋjɛ ŋmá Usítim le pɛ́ wā okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan yɔ̄ í gbēyī kéē bēé nū.

eng_Latn: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
idu_Latn: Aaádáádā uwā í jāhɔ̄ gā um, ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē pó ɛlā kú um ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, é yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tú um. É gáā jāhɔ̄ ga um ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē klɔcɛ́ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ācoyímabɔ̄, ācogwɛ́ɛbā, mɛ́mla aɔ́hɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī bī aínyílɔ́wɔ lɛ jé ɔdā nōo ī yá ā, kpó hīgwú wā, kéē wā í lɛyí ɔ̄na ā ka lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ wā ī māháyi iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó ā í jɛ́yí aɔ́dā dúú nēe bá ā ŋ́. É kē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jɛ́yí kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋ́. É kē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ Ufárisīi igbɔhá kahíníī, Ami wɛ ɔlá-ofíyajɛ kú ɛcɛ á, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɛce um, ó gáā yāwu ipú obū ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē lɛ ɔlá-ofíyajɛ kú oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Uféro kahíníī, N wɛ iháyí ofɛɛhīlī cigwō. Aíháyí ā í lɛwā ŋ́, klla le mu mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Ó gaajɛ iháyí nɛ̄ aádáádā um yēeyī ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, ó kē ī lɛ eyī gla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Ó kē lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nōó jé ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ éwo ɔ́ɔmā í lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́, klla bá ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ń gáā yá ɔdōlɔhi nɛ̄ n ka n géē yá lɛ uwá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ Ébrahām kpóce Ɔwɔicō ā nōó bī le hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
idu_Latn: Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujehoyáda nōo ŋmá Ukábsíila ā, wɛ ícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔfú nɛ̄hi ɔhá dúú. Ó yá ɔdā kú ɔtū ō lɛ alɛwa. Ó ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄hi ɛpa kú ācɛ Umówābu. Ó kōō ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ éyi nyɔ̄ gaá le ágábá ŋmó ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nɛ̄ ofū gē ŋmó nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya klla lɛ aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa nɛ̄hi tɛhɔ̄ ŋmá Ulákisi kóō gaá kpɛ́fú tá Uhɛsɛkíya Ujerúsālɛm. Aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ɛtá kú nū ā kpó uwā nyɔ̄ á. Eko nēé gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, é gaá mīyɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ-o-tá-īlī bá ā tū abɔ̄, okónu ɔ́gilɔ́ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ī bū ŋmá njɔlɔ kú ɛhícō wā ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ mla uwá. Eko nōó le bá lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā, otrɛ̄yí ā le oklobīya nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔkpani, a híīī junwalu lɛ iyī uwɔ ŋ́. Ń wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi jɛ̄ nɛ̄ a cíkā ō wā ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
idu_Latn: Ká ō kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō je igbō mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ um pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn ā wɛ, úlā igwáahāapa cofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō gbāajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ācɛ nēe bá ā gbɔɔ́ ō gbāajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm gbo ce iyī ūwā á.

eng_Latn: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Udɛ́dan, aá kwinya nyɔ̄ í tayínū. N géē je ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísɔ yíífi ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka eko ga nɛ̄ n gáā yá uwā italā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
idu_Latn: Ōhóō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē da ɔcí kahíníī, Le héyī! nōo gēe da ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó kɛlā glá ŋ́ mā kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ! Ojibó kú ɛcí lɔfú ma ɔdā dúúmā fú gā uwɔ glá ā? Nááná nɛ̄ aá lɔfú lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu ma plá nū ā, ó kē yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These things command and teach.
idu_Latn: Tū uwā ukɔ́ nēe bá nyā, ká ā klla nwū uwā aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā a.

eng_Latn: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Userúbābɛlu mɛ́mla ami, Unehemíya gē gbō ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, gē je ɛhi nēé cíkā ō je kú ɛgbá kú ɛ̄cī dóódu kú eyī ō kwu ācogwíijē mɛ́mla ācogbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ákú ayí ulífāyi. Cɛ́ɛ́ aúlífāyi ā gē je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā nēé mīya ā lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayááyí kú Árɔ́n ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ohilí Umósīsi le ɔdā nɛ̄ Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ ācɛ ā má ā, Ó da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ ācɛ ā yɔ̄ ā? Ɔdíyá nāa cīce ōfōōfū uwɔ, nɛ̄ ācɛ le jīla tā uwɔ ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gbó otú ā.

eng_Latn: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Jerúsālɛm, eko nɛ̄ aá géē ma ɔdɔ kú aá nōo ca ā géē wā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, é géē nyīla ɛjī kú ajɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le aɔ́kplɛ́fú ofigwó yá. É kē le oje ɔdɔ nōo gbɛnú kú nū wɛ ukílōgram ahāapa ā ma bá éyééye kú uwā iyē.

eng_Latn: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam dúúmā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē kwú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ewō ɔ́ɔ géē je okwū kú nū lé á. Aɛ́nɛ̄ e kē í kwú ipácí ā, aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ́ɛ géē je okwū kú uwā kpó lé. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni kahíníī.
