eng_Latn: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
idu_Latn: É kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō miya mla iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ālɔ̄ í yá lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si āa.

eng_Latn: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
idu_Latn: Ámíyā nɛ̄hi kú aflɛ́yí ā mɛ ɛɛ́. Amáŋ má ɔ̄, ámíyā nɛ̄hi ɛpa gē wā kpɔ́ ɛ́!.

eng_Latn: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
idu_Latn: Igbɛ ɛtá ācɛ kú Uróm bī ogbló gɔ́ um ɔ́glɔ́. Ācɛ kē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá um igbɛ éyi. Igbɛ ɛtá úgbéenyi nɛ̄ n yɛ anú ā le ca tū enyi. Igbɛ éyi n tá eyī enyi yɔ̄ gē yɛ icííci ɛ̄cī odunkulu.

eng_Latn: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔkpá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn je lɛ uwá ā, ú lɛ aígbómína kú ɛyí ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú uwá. Eko nēé lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé ā, aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ klla le ɛhi kú ije yá ācɛ Ujíyu ā, kú otábɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ómbilí kú igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́ mā, igbō kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄, mɛ́mla igbō obákánjɔ̄ nēé le anɔ̄ pīya klá anú ɛyí, mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ejé.

eng_Latn: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
idu_Latn: Adá kú Uféro gā ɔkpá gaá gwīiyē, anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū bá okónu ɔkpá ā biílí. Igbeékpónú ó pīyeyī le ómbilí nōo háyi ipácí okónu ɔkpá ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō nyɔ̄ í kwú ɔyí ā ú wā.

eng_Latn: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ: Ído, ɔyí kú Usekaríya. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamin: Ujaásīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ábna.

eng_Latn: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
idu_Latn: Ébrahām yɔ̄ gē kpɔ́tūce kpɔ́, ɔtū kú nū í kē bɛ́ɛpa lɛyíkwu okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔtū nōó le ce Ɔwɔicō ā lɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó le mafú ka Ɔwɔicō wɛ idáagó á.

eng_Latn: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
idu_Latn: Uménāhem mīyɛ ije nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ olije kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kpó ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛpa ce igwó lɛ ɔ́, ká ɔ̄ géē kpó lɛ Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya. Anɔ́ɔ Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kwúcē ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ajɛ ā, ámāŋ koō lā anú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otú kú nū ā Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí Usólōmɔn abɔ́ɔ ipú ɔ̄na gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa tíne ká n̄ je ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ n kwúcē wā, Ujerúsālɛm á. Eko nɛ̄ n le pó ka Ɛlíyāssibu kwú inu éyi kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ Utobíya ā, okónu í kōō hɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni kahíníī, Ɔkpani, alɔ tíne ɛbéenyi otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī mā amáŋ alɔ í kē kwú ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ abɔ̄ ā le ka ā, alɔ géē tá ɛ́yá ā gā enyi mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nōó lɛ ɔ́da je nɛ̄ɛ̄, aɛ́cɔ̄ ɔwɔ ā kwú gbenyi tū ajɛ. Ó cɛ̄ le owu le tá, cɛ́ɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē mafú ka aá gē dɔɔ̄kā odée lɛ iyi aá ofunu ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ohígbū ka aá géē bī iyī aá gwō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋ́. Aá tá iyī aá wāajɛ ipú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá gē yá lɛyíkwu ɔ́mpa aá ā, aá gbɛlá ojigógó ka ācɛ ɔhá ɔɔ́ yá ɔdā olɔhi fíyɛ́ aá á.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aá nēe wɛ aútíca kú íne ā! Aá kwú ɔyígodó nōo géē nwūla odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú inu nɛ̄ ɔdōojé lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ā yɔ̄ ā. Aá abɔ̄yī aá í bēhé ga ipú nū ŋ́, aá ke cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá yɔ̄ gē cēyītīkwū kéē bēhé ā bēhé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá le iyē gwá ipú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan igbo ahāapa, agwú kú uwɔ géē mɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɛgba dɛ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛhi, anɔ́ɔ ó mā owu á.

eng_Latn: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
idu_Latn: Eko le gla lígíí ā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Umówābu mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ Ámɔn mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ ohile nēe cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla uwá ā, ācɛ kú Umɛ-Unāti, le pɛ́ wā í le ɔfú kpó wā í gwū ācɛ Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ eyīnyinyi kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú má lɛ olɔhi yá lɛ ɔ́ nááná, ó gáā kllɔcɛ́ ō jé okpaakpa ō yá ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ó kōō yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yá okpaakpa nááná, ó í yɔ̄ gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kpɔ́. Ó kōō gáā jé ojīlīmā kú awɔ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
idu_Latn: Alesáŋda, onɔwá kú oje ā yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, Óndú géē cíla anú ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi ka, N géē da aá ɔ̄kā ékpónú, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ̄kā ā cīla, n géē da aá ɛga nɛ̄ íkwu nɛ̄ n bī le yá ɔdā nēe bá ā ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: A ka ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ɛ́ɛ kwú ajɛ nyā yíífi, nōo gáā tá alácɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ipú ígbíli nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ɛbɛ́ í lā ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lá ajɛ ā, ācɛ klla géē lá aájɛɛhɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nyā kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
idu_Latn: Aá pīyeyī biílí kú aá má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá le túbá tɔ̄há gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́ ɛɛ́. Ayí aá nɔnyīlɔ ā géē ŋmá ɛga oligbó wā, é kē géē kpó ayí aá nɔnyā ce abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄nɛ́ŋcɛ́ wā.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD's anointed, and be guiltless?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ híí lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ kōō ī kɛlā ō ŋmó ɔ̄ dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́. Ó da ɔ́ ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu ā italā.

eng_Latn: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla aútíca kú íne ā í cɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́ni kóō yá uwā ubatísim ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ipú ɔwɛ nyā é tá kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ujérīko ā wɛ, ofigwáahāpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
idu_Latn: A géē bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ, kóō tá ɛháajɛ ogbló ā, kóō bī uwā kwɔhá.

eng_Latn: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū uwā ukɔ́ lɛ ā, aígelī nɛ̄hi nōó tíne ā nēé je lɛ ɔ́ á. É kē wɛ, Utimínāti, Uséra, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o yɔ̄ ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem ā. Ó le igelī nɛ̄hi ā túgwó, anɔ́ɔ ó má lā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́daŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā hile ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Usɔ́ɔlu nɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ géē méyīnyinyi nū ohígbū Ujonátan n?.

eng_Latn: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ōfōōfūnū géē wā icō ɛfu ajaajɛ ɛgiyí um á. Ācɛ ohile ā í kōō gáā túbla ɛfu ā dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
idu_Latn: É gaá da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Da alɔ, awɔ wɛ anú nōo cíkā ō wā á nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ̄ ká alɔ leyī táajɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
idu_Latn: Ukénasi, Utéman, Umíbsa.

eng_Latn: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā ā le nyīla ga ɛga dóódu ā, Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ ɔwɛ kú inū nēé kpó ɔdōlé tū ā nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō je ɔdōlé lá lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā le nwuné nɛ̄hi ajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
idu_Latn: Ó hile ɛ̄cī ɛpa kú ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú onyatá mla ucɛ kú Igbō Ánūŋ kóō yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla ācɛ o nwū íne bá yɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nēé géē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú wɛɛlɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó tayínū, kú ācɛ kéē jé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
idu_Latn: Usekaríya kahíníī, Aá lɛ aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú aá kpó nwūla, ācɛ Ulɛ́bānɔn, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔlá kóō kpó aɔ́cí kú Uséda kú aá yi tāajɛ!.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníi, Ícɛ nyā, n kwú uwēyī ō ka ka aá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā ú ŋmá aá ɛyí ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, é kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ ka Ugígalu jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofaahāapa ce úlā ɛtá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
idu_Latn: Á lɛ ɔŋ́gbá bū ɔ̄ ɛnwū, klla je uwɔ tū ɔ̄ alagba glá ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ébram kahíníī, Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔdí ɔhá nɛ̄ a kē í je gā nɛ̄ n kē lɛ ɔyí ŋ́ mā ā. Ɛlíyɛ́sa, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Udamáskɔ̄si ā kē gáā lúgwū um á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá uwā ohi kahínīī, Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka Ɛláyíja géē wā gbɔbū kóō lɛ ɔdā dóódu gllayá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, Óndú alɔ, ācɛ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú klla lɛ ɛgahi lɛ ā, ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē cɛ̄ lɛ ífi yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū ō plicō lɛyíkwu unwalu kú oyēeyī í gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gwéeyē ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɛlā ogbɔtū nɛɛ gē bī éeyē wā ipú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā ofigwáahātá māháyi iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́, iyɔ̄bū aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā mɛ́mla iyɔ̄bū anyākwɔ́cɛ ā. É bá gē gwííjē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ éyi, nɛ̄ uwá ōfōōfūwā nwū glá ā. Ó ŋmá ipú odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā, uwá ōfōōfūwā nēé fula ā.

eng_Latn: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
idu_Latn: A má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Áhābu tá īyī nū wā ajɛ iyɔ̄bū um lɛ ā? Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ īyī nū tū wā ajɛ iyɔ̄bū um ɛɛ́ mā, ń gáā bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyā wā eko nōó yēeyī ā ŋ́, amáŋ n géē bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā wā í klá ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ eko kú oyēeyī kú nū.

eng_Latn: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
idu_Latn: Alɔ le odúúdú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄ alɔ bī wā ā, gbaáluka klla lɛ ɔ́ miya. Anɔ́ɔ alɔ le odúúdú nū tá tū ɔkpá á.

eng_Latn: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: ɛga nɛ̄ ó gē kpó ɛyínɛ̄hi ɔdōlé mɛ́mla iyó kú nū tū ā. Ó le aótrɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kpó bá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
idu_Latn: Je ejé olɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā kwú ɛɛ́ mā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū nōbí nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
idu_Latn: Eko kú unwalu, ó géē gbo um ɛyí. Ó kē í je um tayínū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Ó klla í je um háyi ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄.

eng_Latn: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄na nɛ̄ n nā a yɔ̄ á. Ubɛltessása, lɛ ɛyí nū ka gā um mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Odúúdú ācojééyī kú ɔlɛ́ um ā, í ka ɛyí nū gā um glá ŋ́. Amáŋ awɔ ā, ka ɛyí nū gā um glá. Ohígbū ka alelékwū kú aɔ́wɔ otīihɔ ā yɔ̄ mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
idu_Latn: Ákú abɔ̄yī um, ɔnyā um, a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ nēé lɛ ɔ́ gwū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá í gē ga ɔ́ ŋ́ mā. A klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ kú ami ōfōōfū um, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔhá í gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá anú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ īyī um mafú lɛ uwā íkée gaá da uwā kahíníī, Aá he um ɔtū piyóó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n húmáyī ma ihɔtū fú lɛ aá eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, n le ɛlā dóódu ka mɛ ɛɛ́. Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛlā a yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́ á. Aá yúufi Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ íne kú nū tū, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ á.

eng_Latn: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔhá igbīhāājɛ, ɔfú kú Óndú ā gā ipú iyē um, anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā, kwú um ú gáā kwú ajɛ ɔpɛ́ éyi á. Aíkpokwú kú ācɛ nēe le ŋmókókó bá ɔpɛ́ ā láyí ɛbɛɛbɛ bɛɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le Ucɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpɛ ā yá lɛ Óndú eko ɔ́ɔmā. Ɛwa kú ójileyī ā bá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, oŋmá okómpīinu kú Uhamáti jāā gaá kwu áyɔ́kpá kú Íjīpiti ā, ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, jāhɔ̄ gā um, ká ā híī mlanyī ɛlā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka gā awɔ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they laid the ark of the LORD upon the cart, and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods.
idu_Latn: É kwú ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú háyi ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya ā, mla ojíbó kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ōcē apú mla ákú ojibó kú ifú nēé bī ugóolu ma ā, kpó tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā alɔ jé ka a jé ɔdā dóódu, ó kē cɛgbá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē da uwɔ ɔ̄kā ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́. Oŋmá ɛ̄nyā alɔ cɛ̄ ka a ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
idu_Latn: Ami ā gē ba Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, n le íne bīya, le uwɔ yá cɔ̄nū ɛɛ́, ményīnyi um ká ā lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ōcē.

eng_Latn: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē bī le ka ācɛ gwó mla iyī nū ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā é cēyītīkwū kéē kwú ɔwɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ uwá ā í kwajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é yɛce ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē bī le hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ācɛ ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōó géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɛplá eko kú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā nēé ī nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu ŋ́ mā da.

eng_Latn: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē pɛ́ ŋmá anú wɛ̄ɛcɛ āa? Ɔnyɛ gē tá ɔwɛ lɛ akpáabana āa?.

eng_Latn: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ita kú ɔcí nyā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɔcí kú Éden dúúmā í klla jɛ̄, lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka anú ā ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ícɛ nyā, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́cí ɔhá dóódu kú Éden ā, ó géē nyɔ̄, ɔlékwū gaá yɔ̄ mla ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ɛfú ā. N le ka ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ a á.

eng_Latn: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī leyīkwu Ujísɔ̄si ā yá ɔ̄ okónu, é klla ŋmó ɔ̄ ijē.

eng_Latn: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ ulé kú odúúdú ɛcá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá cá uwɔ ā, cílá uwá ɛga ahāapa.

eng_Latn: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā lā abɔ́ɔ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra, eko nēé je uwá yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ kē le ɔdā nōo ka ā pó ɛ́ɛ́! Alɔ í cɛgbá ijáalí dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó bī íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó jé ā le yá ɔkpáncō, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ipú unwalu nɛ̄hi klla húmáyī móōwē ā, nááná ā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɔfú kpɔ́ ā, lɛ alɔ ɔtū tū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le íne ā tá tū ɔkpá kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwú ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi éyi í kwu ajɛ, ɔkwu ɔcī kú Óoku nōo kwu pī Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā géē wɛ ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó ā. Ó géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā le tū mu mla ódūdū nɛ̄hi kpúm ā, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɛ ipú ɔlá gāajɛ ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ódūdū ā yɛ tíicō bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū ɔlá kú ácí ugba ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ɛfu ā le jīliyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá lɛ ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú, abɔ̄ nōó i lɛ ā Ɔwɔicō í hɛ́pɔ̄ ká aá, géē yá aá italā olɔnɔ ɛ̄cī nōó géē cɔ̄nū í hɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɛɛcɛ dóódu ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɛ́ya kahíníī, N gwéeyē ohígbū ka ācɛnyā géē hī um ka éeyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Ássa.

eng_Latn: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mla aítíca kú íne lɛ ɔdā nōó yá ā pó. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā ɔwɛ nēé géē ŋmó ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
idu_Latn: Awɔ gē tíne ɔdōlé lɛ ágábá mɛ́mla ayí uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lé ā.

eng_Latn: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī bū ipú itekwú nɛ̄hi ā, n géē yɔ̄ pi uwɔ. Ísu ā í gáā fíyɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄ klla je uwɔ bí glá ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī yāwu bū ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔlá náaná, ɔlá ā í gáā yi uwɔ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā gē yá uwɔ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ohígbū ɔfú kú nū ā. Aá bī ɔdā kú ɛya ogwó wā iyɔ̄bū nū. Aá gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā ā ipú otīihɔ kú nu. Aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú ɛgahi mɛ́mla otīihɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā ca, ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá n géē gwó ɔ́ gicō.

eng_Latn: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛga je lɛ aá kú aá le bū ajɛ kú nū. Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bū ajɛ kú nū ŋ́. É le ɛhɔ̄ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu tá dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má bá Ukɛ́dɛssi á.

eng_Latn: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi gē je ɔ́da olɔnɔ nɛ̄hi nyā yɔ̄ ā dúú āa? Anɔ́ɔ Áriyɔ̄ku le ɔkwɛ̄lā ā ka lɛ Udánīyɛlu á.

eng_Latn: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówāsi le da ācɛ Ulífāyi ā kéē lɛ ikpati nēé géē kpó ije nɛ̄ ācɛ í da ā tū ɔ̄ ā gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
idu_Latn: Alɛɛcɛ, eko nyá nɛ̄ aá géē nyí um ojīlīmā gaá kwu ā? Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá gē bá ī yíihɔtū kú aɔ́dā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu mɛ́mla ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gaá kwu ā?.

eng_Latn: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éwɔhá dúúmā nōo kwú īyī nū ú lɛ Óndú ā, kóō híī ka ka anɔ́ɔ jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ wɛ ipú éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nēé le búdá ā kóō híī ka, ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo le ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
idu_Latn: Ó jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ka ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ufi yá anú mla ācɛ ohile ɛpa ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū í jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó nwū ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ufi nōo yá uwā ā í kē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (As it is written in the law of the LORD, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ā Odúúdú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí dóódu mɛ́mla ɔyí ɛbɔ́lɛ́ aflɛ́yí dóódu nōo wɛ ɔbá, é géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɔfu cɛtá ā wɛ Umáhāsíyɔti.

eng_Latn: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
idu_Latn: Ikpokwu kú nū lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka oje udɔ ā, Ikpó kú nū kē lɛ ɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ígbó oje ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yɔ̄ gē tá aá abɔ̄ ā, ó cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ká n̄ yēeyī kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɔkwɔɔkwɛ̄yi ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá tá ɛcɛ nyā, é géē tá ɔ̄ ɔkpáncō. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá kē cɛ̄ ɛcɛ nyā, é kē í cɛ̄ ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
idu_Latn: A bī Usódom ī le kwu ita eko nāa gē yá ɔbɔ́cɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, géē da aá ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē yá īyī aá ɛdɔ ɔ̄dōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā ā. Aá tíne kú odúúdú aá, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄, mɛ́mla ayípōobene, kóō kwú kpó yíífi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í gáā hile gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ kú aá í jāhɔ̄ kóō pó ɛlā nyā āa? Oŋmá ícɛ gɔbū, aá géē jāhɔ̄ klla í nwū odée ŋmá ɔdā nōo yá ā ā?.

eng_Latn: Remember Lot's wife.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nōo yá ɔnyā kú Ulɔ́tu ā!.

eng_Latn: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jī ɛɛ́. Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ofu kú nū yɔ̄ ī je cá ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔfulā kú ododó, nōo kwu ɛyí kú aótrɛ̄yí kú nū nɛ̄ ejé le kwú ā. É lɛ ɔtulali kpó tū ɛyí kú ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ kú uwá ā, amáŋ ejé lɛ uwá kwú bá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé le pɛ́kwú ā.

eng_Latn: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu lɛ ínálēgbé nēe kwú jé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
idu_Latn: Iŋini yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ ā fíyɛ́ abɔ̄ ohígbū nū. Ācɛ ōhī kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ. Ācɛ ɔhá kahíníī, Ehée, ó gē bī ācɛ bī.

eng_Latn: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ géē je ɔyínɛ́ nū lɛ ācɛ kéē je ɔ́ ŋmó. Ádā kē í je ɔyí nū lɛ ācɛ kéē je ɔ́ ŋmó. Ayí ke í cāŋ́jɛ lɛyíkwu ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwā, klla géē yá kéē lɛ uwá ŋmó.

eng_Latn: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko kú Usámga, ɔyí kú Ánati ā, ɛplá eko kú Ujáyɛ̄lu ā, ācɛ nōo ī ce kɔdúú mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya ī ga iyāwu ā, í klla bū ɔwɛ gbóóló ā, bū ipú ajɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ o ga iyāwu bá ī hɛ́ bú ɔwɛ ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ le bēhé Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ je lɛ alɔ ā. Ayááyí kú Ísɔ, nēe lá Ɛ́dɔm ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Umówābu, nēe lā ipú Ári ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le bū ipú ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
idu_Latn: Ukɛ́nāsi, Utɛ́man Umíbsa.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je āhɔ̄ kú ojīlīma lɛ ɔ́ ipú ācɛ o lɔdu ā. Ó kē ī lɛ ukpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā. Ohígbū koó kwú oyēēyī kú nū ú tónū klla mīyɛ italā nɛ̄ ācobīyíne cíkā ō má ā í ce iyīnū. Ó gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācobīyíne.

eng_Latn: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
idu_Latn: N le íne kú uwɔ bīya, awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ nɛ̄ n bīya íne kú uwɔ klla yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a je kóō wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Ɛpɔ̄ dúú nāa ka tū um, a lé ɛpɔ̄hi. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, awɔ lɛ́pɔ̄hi kú ɛpɔ̄ nāa ka tū um á. Á kē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú ɛpɔ̄bí nāa ŋmó um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ede ŋmá ɔcí o pátákáá. Ó kē í lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n mafú gā uwɔ ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
idu_Latn: É gaá le da Usɔ́lu ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ klá Unáyōtu ajɛ kú Uráma.

eng_Latn: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ Ussiyɛbíya mɛ́mla Uhassábīya fu mla ācɛ igwó ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
idu_Latn: Adonibɛ́sēki ka aɔ́cɛ́ ofɛtá cigwó nɛ̄ ocúgbɔ̄du īkpó mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄du abɔ̄ kú uwā le kpó gwó ā géē wā í yā iwili kú ɔdōlé lé ŋmá ɛháajɛ itébulu kú anúɔ. Ó klla ka ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ le ulé kú ɔda nɛ̄ anúɔ yá ā cíla anúɔ ɛɛ́. É kwú ɔ̄ ú ga Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
idu_Latn: Wā ká ā gaá má ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā, ká ā má ɔdā ō yéeyījii nɛ̄ ó yá ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ géē lā ɛbɔ́. É kē ī bá cíí nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í klla gáā kwú uwá iyē ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Aá gbēyī ká n̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē ka lɛyíkwu aá ā pó ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí hile ká n yá ipu ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú um nyā, nɛ̄ n yá ɛɛ́ ŋ́ mā? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ n leyīce ɔ́ kóō gwá īkpō kú ufáyin olɔhi, nōó gaá gwá īkpō omákáká āa?.

eng_Latn: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
idu_Latn: Urécɛ̄lu da ádā nū ka, a híī cɔ̄nū mla um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń cāŋjɛ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N yɔ̄ eko ɔ̄yā kú um. Ulában le ɛga dóódu tíne ɛka ocɛyí kú nū ā, amáŋ ó má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛgbá kú um ā, a kē pó ifu nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tá ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
idu_Latn: É kahíníī, Ācɛ igbīhāajɛ nēe bá ā yúklɔ́ áwa ékpó ōfūnū, amáŋ a kē lɛ ije gbā lɛ uwá jōnjīlɛ̄ mɛ́mla alɔ nēe hímáyī yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī ā dúúdú ipú ɛnɔ okwɔ́lá ā.

eng_Latn: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu gē cɛ̄tra awɔ Óndú, ohígbū kēé pó ofu ɔfú kú uwɔ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ. A gē bī ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nāa gē ka a le gbō ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
idu_Latn: É klla tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ohi igbɔhá kahíníī, Ágábáidu kóō lɛ ɔ̄na ā da alɔ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, alɔ ī ka ɛyí nū gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
idu_Latn: Ūlī nēé tá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kɔ̄ aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ igwó nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ lɛ o hɛ́ ɛpa kú ācɛ ohile kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhāti á.

eng_Latn: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa klla je ɔdɔ kú nū a wúla tāajɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē yɛ ɔwɛ abālɔbányā géē yɔ̄ í hɛ́ aíkpó nū uwī.

eng_Latn: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ le okónu nwūla kwú uwā ú kpó mulɛ nēé le pɛ́ gekwú mla Ukɔ́ra mɛ́mla ígwu kú uwā eko nɛ̄ ɔlá kú Óndú ā je ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó kpó yíífi ā. Ɛ̄nyā ā le pīya ahɔ̄ nēé pi ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu anú á.

eng_Latn: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
idu_Latn: É jɛga lɛ ācɛ nēe pó ɔkōōlɔhi aflɛ́yí ā kéē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́, ohígbū kéē kpɔ́tūce ɛlā kú omlɛ́nyɔ̄ nēé gaá je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́. Ó le ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō jɛga lɛ uwá ká mlɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
idu_Latn: Ń gáā ga ɔlɛ́ um, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwutá agōdō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ ā klla ī da Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ga ɔlékwū ŋ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ lɛ ɔdā nōo yá nōó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔwɔ ohɔ́gwā kwu ipú ojuja, anɔ́ɔ ó í wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ipɔ́lɛ́ mla okónu ɔkpá ā, é géē kpó uwá ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú nyā. Olɛlā ā géē bū ɔbā klla í tū ɔ̄kā í hɛ́ ɔdɔ kú ɛfú a tū ipɔ́lɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cɛ̄ ká ɛdɔ kú ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēé gē nwū ā kóō lɛ aá nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā ŋ́. Ogbonɛnɛ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ gē lɛ ɔfú tū alɔ ɔtū klla ī tá alɔ abɔ̄, amáŋ o yɔ̄ ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú ɔdōlé í tá alɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
idu_Latn: Tá ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē gbō uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka, ɔdɔ olɔfú nōo yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi jīla tá ā. Amáŋ ikpɛ́lā ō yá mla anú, géē hɛ́ uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū bɛ̄ɛka odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi kú igelī nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú nū lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
idu_Latn: Īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ olɔhi nēé bī le yá odúúdú ukɔ́tin kú igá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a dɔɔ̄kā kú alɔ tá ɔ̄ tū ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm le ɔ̄kā da Ahítōfɛlu ka abɔ̄ aá gaajɛ ɛɛ́ mā ā, ɔ́ɔ̄ da anúɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, anú mla Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ kú Usáyímɔ̄ni mla Ándru.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē jikwū lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Umówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukɛ́hɛ́rɛs ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
idu_Latn: Uhássɛm ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ugísɔn, Ujonátan, ɔyí kú Ussági, ŋmá Uhára.

eng_Latn: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa kwú Ugɛdalíya, ɔyí kú Ahíkam, ɔyí kú ɔyí Ussafán ú yá igbómína kú Ujúda, kóō leyīkwu ācɛ nēe hile nēé je kpó ga Ubábīlɔn ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā kē le tútū ō yá alɔ italā. A kē le italā ā yá alɔ ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka a gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā eko dóódu. Alɔ í kē cɛ̄ jāhɔ̄ gā uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
idu_Latn: Usánōwa, Adulám mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwá. É lā Ulákiss mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ nōo kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā, Asɛ́ka mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú uwá. Ācɛ kú Ujúda ā lā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ubiyɛssíba ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ kú Uhínom ɛhícō.

eng_Latn: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Usiríya kú Udamáskɔsi le aícɔ́ɔja tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá tá Uhádādésa abɔ̄ ā, Udéfīdi le ɔfú kpó kwu uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ úlā ofɛpa cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba hī uwɔ igwú mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um. Lɛ ohi tá um Óndú, n géē lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Amáŋ acígilí é géē kpó aólɛlā kú aá nēe wā í kpɛ́fú tá aá gwu bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē kpó úmúlá bónū ā. É klla í kpó aícɔ́ɔja o lɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā gwu bónū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē gwu igbóngbō kú ocikāpā bónū ā. Ó í yá acígilí mla eko nɛ̄ aá leyīce ɔ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō klla cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, é géē pɛ́ kwú ipú ogwuda kú uwá, klla í bēhé ísu nōo ī kpó ācɛ nēe gekwú nyɔ̄ ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
idu_Latn: Ami bī abɔ̄ kú um lɛ ikpó kú ɛcɛ nyā tá ajɛ á. Ami kē nā ɔkpáncō daa klá ɛyí ɛcɛ á. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō hīīgwú, é gē pɛ́ wā í le jīla iyɔ̄bū um bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
idu_Latn: A wɛ ɔfiyɛ eko nɛ̄ a mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā ā? Ā lɛ ɛlā wu ɔ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔwɛ má nɛ̄ a géē wɛ abɔ̄ nōo lɛ iyī uwɔ glá, ayíka a lɛ ɛga nū yá.

eng_Latn: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá í bá ī ka lɛ aɔ́mpā nū mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū wɛ ka, Ɔdí wɛ ohi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tá ā? Amāŋ ka, Ɔdí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā?.

eng_Latn: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī gā ā, aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋmúleyīkwū tū Ulɔ́tu kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā kwú ɔnyā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ɛpa nēe bá amānyā ā ú kpó, ká ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá híī je yíífi ipú italā nēé gáā yá igelī nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kóō tɛ́ɛhá ikɔkɔ ō lɛ agbénú ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú.

eng_Latn: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é gbɔ́ɔ ō yúufi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú nū yɛ ga ɔkpá kú Ukána. Aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛháajɛ kú ɔkpá ā wɛ ákú Ɛ́frem, náana nēé kōō bá ajɛ kú Umanásɛ ā. Ɛjī kú Umanásɛ gaá yɛ bū ɛhícō kú ɔkpá ā gaá ŋmɛ́yí ísu kú Umeditarénīya.

eng_Latn: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
idu_Latn: Aɛ́cí bá láyíí ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā. É klla bá gē pā aɛ́cí nēé bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá ā.

eng_Latn: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū é kwúcē igbīhi nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Aícɔ́ɔja habɔ̄ ācokpɛ́fɔ́nya ā kéē nyɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
idu_Latn: Áta wɛ ācɛ, ofɛnɛ ce igwáahātá, é gē hī ipɔ́ɔma nyā ka Uhesekíya dúú.

eng_Latn: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
idu_Latn: Udɛlíla le Usámsin já kwú Usámsin ɛyí ú ce átákwū le ɔ́ plla. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyɔ̄lā ú gbo á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó le oōgwá kú ɛyí kú Usámsin ahāapa ā kpó wā á. Ɔnyā ā gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄ ōwē, ohígbū ka ɔfú nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alelékwū Ihɔ géē wā í ɛgiyí uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē wā í klá awɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔyí nɛ̄ a í ma ā géē tīihɔ, é kē géē hī ɔ̄ ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, alɛɛcɛ wɛ ékpónú, odúúdú ūwā ī ka ucē ékpónú. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohútu kulɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ kú ɔdā nēé géē yá glá á. Ɔdā dóódu nēé dɔɔ̄kā ō yá abālɔbányā, é géē yá ɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ lɛ ɛga nɛ̄hɛ́ ipú okpíyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyākim wɛ iháyí igwáahātá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm ɔyā ɛtá ce ɛ̄cī igwó. Ó klla le íne kú Óndú ā bīya dúú.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu le ɛcɔ̄nyā kpó, enyi nōo gē pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū wɛ ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
idu_Latn: Ó géē je anɔ̄ ōhī nōo hile ɔtābɔ̄ kú nū ā mɛ́mla oyī ōhī, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ákpáhɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná, ocúgbɔ̄ɔdu abɔ̄lɔ́ná, ocúgbɔ̄ɔdu ikpó kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ka tɛ́ɛcɛ koó kwú yá yēŋēē ɛ́ɛ́ má.

eng_Latn: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nēé lā ā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Uméssa lɛyíkwu Uséfa ga ɛfu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā.

eng_Latn: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kpa ɛnɛ nōo wu ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje udɔ ā, bī uwā háyicō á. Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé le yá uwɔ, ɔdōklá icō kú uwā mɛ́mla aógbló ā á.

eng_Latn: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nēe bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
idu_Latn: Ń kɛlā nyā ohígbū odúúdú aá ŋ́. N jé ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu ā, amáŋ ká ɛlā nēé ka ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lé igbō kú um ā, kwú ɛyí ú bú kwu um ɛɛ́ kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ajɛ jíliyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ āyā éyi ŋmá ipu okɔ̄ ɛga igwó kú igelī ā le gbliífi á. Ācɛ úlā igwáahāapa ce ofigwó le pɛ́ gekwú. Ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ācɛ ohile ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā á.

eng_Latn: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ ɔ̄ tá gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔwɔ kú aéwo ɔhá ɛ̄gbā, ó géē pīyeyī kwu uwá klla í yá uwā italā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā yíífi, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó kōō tɛtɛ lɔhi lɛ uwá nááná.

eng_Latn: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
idu_Latn: Óndú kú ɛbɛ́ ā í gáā jila ɔ́ kóō má ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla olɔhi kú ɛbɛ́ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé k­ōō je ɔ́ fūlabɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó kōō kwú ɔ̄ ú fūlabɔ̄ mla ɛbɛ́ ɔhá, ó lɛ ā, aɛ́bɛ́ ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā géē wɛ ákú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é kē je ɔ́ fūla glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
idu_Latn: Umefíbōssɛ̄ti lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi nēé hī ka Umíka. Anɔ́ɔ o ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, odúúdú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Usíba kwú pīya ācōcɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Umefíbōssɛ̄ti á.

eng_Latn: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nɛ̄ ayí uwā lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwá ka ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú aíne nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ tū ā ā?.

eng_Latn: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother's house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ é gā ɔwɛ ā, Unaómi da uwá kéē le pɛ́ cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā, kéē gáā bá mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwā. Ó da uwá ká Óndú ā kóō yá olɔhi lɛ uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ anúɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ nēe le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
idu_Latn: Aá je ɔdā nōo ce aɔ́mpa aá nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɛgbá ā lɛ uwá. Aá mīyɛ ayínɛ́ aá ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe wɛ ugbɔga ā wā ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, n le ayínɔ̄nyā ɛpa, nēé jé ācɛnyīlɔ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Aá háyi ká n le uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ aá kú aá yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he aá ɔtū mla uwá. Aá híī yá ācɛ nēe bá ā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka é wɛ ugbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamongog.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je okwū Ugɔ́gu mɛ́mla aókwū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó nyi ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ́ɔ, ipú Ɔpɛ́ kú ācɛ o ga iyāwu, nōo kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísu kú ɔmā ā. Aúnóji ā géē ŋmó ɔwɛ tū ācɛ nēe ī yɛ abɔ́ɔ ga iyāwu ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é géē hī ɔpɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā ka, Ɔpɛ́ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ugɔ́gu.

eng_Latn: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm klla lɛ uwá yálé. É lɛ ācɛ ā kpó ŋmó, lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔyí ā abɔ̄ ú, anɔ́ɔ ó ka Talita kúmi nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Ɔyínɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, n da uwɔ ka, nyāŋjɛ.

eng_Latn: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le ayípōklóbīya alɛwa nēé jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu oyēeyī ŋ́ mā má. Amáŋ n má éyi nōo wɛ olíla abɔ̄yī nū ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gbɔɔ́ ō yá aá ōwē igelī éyi, aá le kwu nyɔ̄ igelī ɔhá. N̄ lɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi da aá. Aá gáā yɛ odúúdú igelī kú Ísrɛ̄lu jíla gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ le ńŋmóō tá ɔ́mpa nū, anɔ́ɔ alɔ le tá ipú úgbéenyi abɔ̄ ācɛ ā kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
idu_Latn: É hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka Ɛ́ssikɔ̄lu ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́ abɔ́ɔ kú oōgwá kú ikpɔ̄cí kú ajɛ ā ŋmá á.

eng_Latn: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka gɔbū lɛ ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm kahíníí, Amáŋ a lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔhi mla ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nāa jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi nyā gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō kwú uwɔ ɔya ká ō cikpó uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ú kwu ɔkpáncō ɛɛ́, anú wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ɛga dóódu, klla ī gbō ɛga dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi olɔhi dóódu mɛ́mla ɛhi dúúmā nōo ī jōōjīla ā, gē ŋmá ɔkpáncō, ó ī wā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo yá ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ, nōó lɛ opīyabɔ̄ gbóógbóō ŋ́ mā. Ó gē jíliyē ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē pīyeyī tá ɛga ɔhá ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ obū kóō wā í klá alɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ ligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Umíka hī aɔ́mpa nū igwú gbɔɔ́ ō nū uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tá uwā á. É lɛ ācɛ kú Udáni ā kwú.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu da iyī uwā kahíníī, Iní nōó tíne ō nyɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ í gáā má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā ā? Ó tíne ō nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu nēe le pahīla ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ugiríiki ā, kóō nwū ācɛ Ugiríiki ɛlā kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya, aígbómína kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́. Aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, le iyɔ̄lā kpó gbo piyóó ɛɛ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kwú pɛ́ kwu ɛyí aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ pahíla ga ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛyí nū bɛ̄ɛka aálá, nēé má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā pī uwá ɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
idu_Latn: Kwu ede nyā ú háyi eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ukɔ́tin, nōo playi iyɔ̄bū kú ikpati kú Okónū ōce ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ n géē jila mla aá á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ássa wɛ: Ímna, Íssfa, Íssfi, Ubɛríya mɛ́mla Uséra, ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā. Ayí kú Ubɛríya wɛ Uhɛ́ba mɛ́mla Umálkīyɛlu.

eng_Latn: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
idu_Latn: É le ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛtá ce igwó kpó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ipú agbla kú ojibó kú Ubáalu, ɛka ocɛyí kú uwā. Ó bī ije nyā, le ācɛ oyúfú kpó gāá blla iyī nū iyē.

eng_Latn: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ eliká kú ugóolu ɛnɛ ɔhá nēé gē bī le je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā yá kwu ikpó ɛnɛ kú nū ā. Eliká ɛpɛɛpa kwu áklō kú ābɔ̄ éyééye.

eng_Latn: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá nōo tá kwu Uhɛ́sbɔn mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔci Ufáyin nōo kwu Isibma, é kwu ɔ u yá ífi; ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔci Ufáyin ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ uwá gē yá ejé kú ɔcɛ́ ŋmá, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē gwá, nɛ̄ ejé gē kwú ɔɔ a. Otɛtɛ a, ɔci Ufáyin a gē tá ɔkɔ jāa ga ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Ujása, ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ipú ígbíli a, jāa ga abɔ̄ ɔhá kú ísu ookwú a.

eng_Latn: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubígfāyi wɛ, úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
idu_Latn: Yá ka ācɛ nēe gē tá okónu lɛ ɛ̄cī ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē yá imabɔ kéē je ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ísu nɛ̄hi ā héyī ā, kéē lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛgɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
idu_Latn: N klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō wā í lā ipú odo kú aá eko dóódu oŋmá lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ aá géē le ce ɔ́ ā. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō he aá ɔtū nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ aá í gáā mɔ̄ɔ̄tá ipú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ipú aéwo ā. N géē gwíijē í cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
idu_Latn: Umɛtánīya, ɔyí kú Umíka, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Usábadi, ayí kú Ásāfu. Anú gē kpó ācogwíijē trɛ̄yí kéē gwííjē eko nēé gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ā. Ubakibukíya kpókónu ce Umɛtánīya á. Ábuda, ɔyí kú Ussamúwa ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ugálalu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujédūtun.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi á. Ujɛdɛ́ya, ɔyí kú Ussébūwelu, ɔyí kú Ámram.

eng_Latn: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyí ɔyínɛ́ Upɔ́lu nɔ̄nyā lɛ ujɔ nēé tū ā pó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ le bēhé tá ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja gaá le da Upɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá géē bī ɔdā ole miya ogbɛnú kú odée mɛ́mla okoolo ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi le mīya ɔdā.

eng_Latn: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ákú ɔdā dóódu nōo le hɛ́mi ámāŋ ka ínálégbé á.

eng_Latn: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
idu_Latn: Ikpɛ́lā gē nū ācobīyíne inya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē nū ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nū inya ā, Oōjɛ̄ gɔbū wɛ ulé kú ɔ̄cɛ oyólɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa á.

eng_Latn: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ācɛ alɛwa wā í le pɛ́ bá ipú inu ā nɛ̄hi nōo yá kú ɛga dúú kóō jɛ̄ ācɛ gɛ ŋ́, jāā klá iyɔ̄bū ɔwɛ kú inu ā. Ujísɔ̄si kē yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ ā túbá, le tútū kú ojīleyī otīihɔ, aá lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ túbā, aá lɛ ayípɛ̄ túbá. Kwu ayí ō gwá amɛ̄ dúú, kwu aɔ́bá kú ɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla anyā uwā, í nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le yɛ gɔbū ipú iyāwu kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó ga ajɛ kú ācɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā á.

eng_Latn: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, eko nɛ̄ alɔ bá mla aá ā, alɔ tɛtɛ le da aá táajɛ kéē í yá alɔ ōwē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá je lɔɔlɔhi ā, é lɛ ōwē ā yá alɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
idu_Latn: Ikwú, iní nɛ̄ a yálé ā? Ikwú, iní nɛ̄ ope kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kū úklɔ́ o lígíí nɛ̄ olíla yá ā gē jɛ̄ ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé ɔwɛ o yɛ ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛ agbénú lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nāa gē je ɔdōlé lɛ okónu alɛwa lɛ á. Ile nāa lɛ ŋmá anú ōfōōfūnū ā wɛ o yɔ̄ ī má agbénú ā fōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
idu_Latn: Kóō géē gbō uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, ŋmá ɛga ɔnyā nōo ī bī ɛlā okónu kú nū le plla ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá ā, aá géē ma ɔ̄ tá lɛ ācɛ ɔhá. N géē yá aá ká aá gbā aólɛlā kú aá ɛ̄gbā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́ ma. Ohígbū ka, ɔnu kú um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄ ó gē nyí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́mān mɛ́mla Ujɛ́dūtun gē leyīkwu opo mɛ́mla anwa kú oje mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɔhá nēé ī le gwííjē ā eko dúú nēé gē gwííjē ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā á. Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujɛ́dūtun klla ī gbɔ̄ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú aádā alɔ le yá ká Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá ŋmó pla ɔcí ā kóō le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā tá wāajɛ á. Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā nōo wɛ Ɛgwā kú ígblé ɔ́ɔmā, nēé hī ka ebilíi ámāŋ ka Usétan, nōo plla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ á. É lɛ ɔ́ tá wāajɛ gā ipú ɛcɛ, mɛ́mla odúúdú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó kpó trɛ̄yí ā.

eng_Latn: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ aɔ́dée ōhī nōó he um ɔtū ŋ́ lɛyíkwu aá. Aá lɛ ācɛ ōhī ipú aá nēe yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ Ubálam nwū ā. Ó nwū Ubálāki ɔwɛ nōo í bī le plla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō. Ó plla uwá kéē lé ɛbɛ́cí, kéē klla bīyíne ŋmá lɛ ikpɔ́nyā nēé wɛ ɔnyā uwā ŋ́ ō ce.

eng_Latn: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā le tá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū mla ayí nū. É le ɔwɛ gwū, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō pīya anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu ā tū aɔ́já áncā ā, éyééye ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayí nū géē bī wā gé lɛ ɔ́ lɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɛcí ā kpó ŋmó ɛyí ede nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpokwú kú uwá kpó tɔ̄lá ɛyí ede ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si pó kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú nū tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ má, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, A lɔtūce Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ āā.

eng_Latn: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú agīje le jɛ̄ eyī kú um ɛɛ́. Odo kú um yɔ̄ ipú ɔnɔ. N le gbagbafú ipú ɔtūnōbí ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí olugwulugwu bá ī hɛ́kwú ipú úláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dí bá gē pɛ́ wā wuuu bɛ̄ɛka ojuja yɔ̄ ā dúú? Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka aókóohō nēe bá ī pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́ ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ ɛgahi bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ɔbá ɛna ā. Ó lɛ ajī olɔfú ɛpa bɛ̄ɛka ɛyī kú ipácí ā. Ɔfú kú nū wɛ ācɛ úlúúlā kú Umanásɛ, mɛ́mla úlúlúúlā kú Ɛ́frém ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛyī gē bī ajī kú nū lɛ gwū aólɛlā kú nū ā, nɛ̄ Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ gáā gwū aólɛlā kú uwā lɛ, í kwu uwá ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
idu_Latn: Óndú, méyīnyinyi alɔ ohígbū ka awɔ nɛ̄ alɔ kpéyīce á. Lɛ ɔfú tū alɔ iyē ɛ̄cī dóódu, ká a kē nya alɔ tá eko nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ipú unwalu.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́ɔhā cē ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄ ō yɔ̄ ī wā ā, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ádā alɔ Udɛ́fīdi ā! Odúúdú ojīlīmā kóō ce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
idu_Latn: N gē yá ucē nāa tíne ā eko dóódu. Ń kē nyíleyī ŋmá anú jéjée ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā ō labɔ̄ bá ɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí ā da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, N lɛ ajɛ lá, ó kē cɛgbá ká n̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ má. Kócōō lɛ ɛga je gā um.

eng_Latn: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛwa ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, ɔwɔ klla yɔ̄ í yá nɛ̄hi. Alɔ í māhayi ipú ɔwɔ nyā amānyā yá ɛ̄nyā glá ŋ́. Ɛlā nōo yɔ̄ nyā í wɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄cī ɛpa mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī ɛtá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka alɔ alɛwa bīya íne nyā á.

eng_Latn: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Aá má ka aá híīī lɛ eyī gwū éyi kú ayí nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe bá ā bónū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n̄ da aá ka, aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā bá ɔkpáncō gē má Ádā um eyī eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ucē kú ɔ̄cɛ le he Óndú ā ɔtū, ó gē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla aólɛlā kú nū kéē bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē blakwu ācɛ nēe gē móōwē ā. Ó gáā mlanyī ikwū nēé gē je ā ŋ́. Ó kē í yá ācɛ nēe gē yá uwā ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā italā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lé klla gwá mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gekwú kóō tá ɔ̄ ɔtū lé ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā pi ɔtū nū, tá ɔ̄ ń ŋmá ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū kwú á.

eng_Latn: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ le okwū kú ɔnyā anúɔ wá le ɛbɛ́ nū kpó kɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó ka ācɛ ā le ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔdā ecē yá ipú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛwa ŋ́ lɛ klla í lɔfú ŋ́ lɛ ā nááná ā, aá yúúfi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka n géē tá aá abɔ̄. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í tōō le gbla um ā, gē nya aá tá á.

eng_Latn: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, ayínɛ́ um o he um ɔtū, Ɔwɔicō í le ācɛ ogbɛhá kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā nēé wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kéē jɛ̄ agbénú ipú o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū fíyɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ka ó klla le uwá fu kéē lúgwū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄ ó cokónu ō je lɛ ācɛ nēe yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kōō gbɛlá ka n ŋ́ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdōlé ŋ́ mā? Aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔdōnīgbō kú ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Usádusīis.

eng_Latn: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
idu_Latn: Ipú eko kpiíí ōfōōfūnū odúúdú agbénú ā le kpó yíífi. Odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ aúgbéenyi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yɛ ipú aúgbéenyi, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ úgbéenyi ā, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē lé ŋmá úklɔ́ nēe gē yá eyī ísu ā, māháyi ɛcɛɛcɛ ɛgaligbó.

eng_Latn: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
idu_Latn: ami bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú um nɛ̄hi, bī ogblábɔ̄ kú um le yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū, kwú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo he um ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ n kē gē je ɛcɛ lɛ ɔ́ kóō gbō á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē pīya ōhī kú anɔ̄ ā tū ɔtābɔ̄ kú abɔ̄lúfīyē ā.

eng_Latn: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: É kwú uwā ú kpó kwu ɔ́ŋgbá ácábɔ̄ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du kéē bī lɛ blakwu áipɔ́ɔmā igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Úmósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
idu_Latn: Ígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā dúúmā í jé ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé ī bū oje ŋmá anú ā ŋ́. ēpū dúúmā ī kē má ɔ̄ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bī ā, n géē yá uwā italā. É kwú ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi mla ācɛ okpaakpa, nēé má ije cíla ulé nēé bī ŋ́ mā, ú lá ga ɔfiyɛ. É gē je aógbɛhá ā fūlabɔ̄ áblákpá nēé lá ā kwɛyí ije.

eng_Latn: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ ahɛ tá tāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ajɛ ma ŋmá ahɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ma plá opeyī ā eyī á.

eng_Latn: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwú ɛ̄nyā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu ɔhá le yá ɔ̄, ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄ a í bī gé um ā í je um ŋmó, abɔ̄ n le hīla ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu le jé ka abɔ̄ Ábsālɔm ɔ́ɔ kwú Ágábáidu, Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ éyi má mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo cīīce ɛyí nū. Eko nōó le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ gebítāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá uwā ohi da uwā ɔ̄kā ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, Ámɔ̄ri, Ámɔn, Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
idu_Latn: Ń má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ímálānyī kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ugóolu ámāŋ úwé kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé je úklɔ́ lɛ aígwu ofucɛnɛ kú ayí kú Ulífāyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɔgbɔɔgba á. Aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Ujɛhóyāribu, ɔ́mpa wɛ Ujɛdáya.

eng_Latn: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē kú ɛgahi kú iyē kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n yɔ̄ ī kɛlā nēe bá ā lɛ aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā. N géē cɛ̄tra úklɔ́ kú um, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um. Óndú, a cɛ̄ gā um le aólɛlā kú um kpó yálé. A klla le um gbō ŋmá ɛgiyí ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
idu_Latn: É gaá lɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kpó kwú klla lɛ uwá kpó bá agbá kú ójīla ā.

eng_Latn: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:
idu_Latn: N lā ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ lɔɔlɔhi, n klla yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ubálam, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ bī wā ā, ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē mɛ́ɛbɛ yēŋēē ā.

eng_Latn: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
idu_Latn: Ó gē hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe lɔnɔɔtū ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī pīya uwá tū ā. Oyēeyī kú uwā ce ɔ́ ɛgbá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yɛ bū ipú oyī kú uwā, ka aéwō kú ɔlɛ́ aá kéē pla oyī ā nyɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é planyɛ̄ lɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ aá bī wā iyɔ̄bū aígabɔ̄ kéē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ámāŋ ka iyɔ̄bū aɔ́cɛ́ ámāŋ ka aótrɛ̄yi, aá híīī lɛ ɛlá wu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē kɔkɔ, ámāŋ kā ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā le aícɔ́ɔja, mla ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnyā mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá le íbɔm cē tū igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā otú éyi.

eng_Latn: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ á jé um ŋ́ mā, n lɛ ojīlīma nɛ̄hi ce uwɔ. N fu uwɔ ce, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā abɔ̄. É wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu kéē wɛ ákú um nɛ.

eng_Latn: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
idu_Latn: Ó le Uféro mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja mla aúgbɔ́nya ɛfú kú nū ā kpó tá tū ipú ísu. Aótrɛ̄yí olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ gebí ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
idu_Latn: Awɔ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ ā géē yɛ jíla igelī nɛ̄hi ā tá dúúdú igbo éyi ɛ̄cī, ipú ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē pi aá ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔdɔ ca ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú aá ú tá tɛ́ɛcɛ ga Uhámɔn. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ōwē má yɛɛ, Ɔwɔicō nōo yíihɔtū tá alɔ ojigógó ā, nōo hī aá igwú ká aá gaá lā ɛgiyí nū piyóó ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, géē yá ká aá le jōōjīla ipú alelékwū. Ó géē yá kú aá lɔtu ce ɔ̄ lɔfú fíyɛ́, ká aá háyi kli, ká ɔdā dúú kóō jíla aá iye ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Áhāsi tóohi kahíníī, Ń gáā dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōcābɔ̄ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n ge jē Óndú ā má ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ūlī kú Ujóssuwa kwú nēé je ajɛ lɛ uwá ā, wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, nor of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē híī pīya ayókwū mɛ́mla aúgbɔga tū ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē mīyɛ īlī kú anyōkwū kwɛyí ɛ́kplá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujohánan, ɔyí Ukaréya mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ā tá ō pó ɛlā kú Óndú ā, ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujúda ā piíí á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo má gwōnū klá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ nyā, géē ca kɛ́tɛ̄kɛ́tɛ̄. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ā géē míya ce ɔ́ ā, ó géē je ɔ́ gbā munuu.

eng_Latn: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā da Usíba ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú Umɛfíbōssɛti ā, kwú pīya ákú anú nōo wɛ Usíba ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usíba da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, n wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ, ɛlā kú um kóō he uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá kéē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ka anú ōfōōfūnū jājīlīmā fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ɛgahi kú nū le fíyɛ́ okpancó mla ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo leyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, nyɔ̄ í da ɔ́ ka, anúɔ wā í lɛ okónū cɛ̄ ɔ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ ā, ka anúɔ le bēhé i tá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cókónu ō je lɛ aádáádā anúɔ ka anúɔ í je lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
idu_Latn: ádā um gē nwū um ɛlā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gē ka kahíníī, Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka gā uwɔ ā, ā híī mlanyī nū ŋ́. Yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē yéeyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́sa, Uhódu, Ussáma, Ussílissa, Ítrán mɛ́mla Ubɛ́ɛra.

eng_Latn: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya um bá ī yá um okónu. N gē pɛ́ agīje abɔ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka Ɔwɔicō kóō tá um abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ācɛ ā kpó ŋmó ā, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujékɔ̄pu ohile ā gaá le igelī ā kpó wu kwɛyí ɔyínɛ́ uwā nēé je uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo wā ŋmá ɔlɛ́ kú aɛ́fu wā í kā ka ɛbɔ́ ɔ́ɔ gā ɛɛ́ mā lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Ó wā í ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ le ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm nyatá ɛɛ́. Ó klla ka ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
idu_Latn: A géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛwa kú ipɔ́ɔma dóódu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ukɔ́ tū uwā lɔhi lɔhi, kú ɔ̄ klla le mafú lɛ uwá ɔwɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā géē gbō uwā ā, mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
idu_Latn: Ó gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lé, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē wī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā uwī ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nēé le ce ɔ́ abɔ̄, ó gē je kwúcē lɛ óndú nū. Ó gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwá ā klla í lɛ īlī tū ācɛ nēe tá ohɛ́ɛwa ā ohí.

eng_Latn: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
