idu_Latn: Ó géē je āyā éyééye kú ɛdɔ kú aígbō ɛtá ā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā. Ohile ā géē wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo gé cē oyí kú ɛbɛ́ ā klá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ wɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ n tíne á, n cokónu ká n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahaanɛ kú ɔyā ā ga ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwó, tū céé kóō kú wɛ ɛ̄cī kē omlɛ́nyɔ́. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā lɛ okónu kwu ɔdā dúú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá lɛyíkwu unwalu kú um, ó géē tū um ufi nɛ̄hi. Cɛ́ɛ́ iyē kú um dúúdú gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú.

eng_Latn: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɛjī kú ajɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ga Umáreya, gaá kwu Udabēssɛ́ti mɛ́mla ɔkpá nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujókinéyam ā.

eng_Latn: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́, Ujówāsi wɛ iháyí ofu ce ɛtá nááná ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā í tá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ínoōbīya kóō lɔ́ɔcɛ́ odo ká aá ŋ́. Alɔ kē jé ka alɔ í kwú piíí, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ híī bī Unwɔ̄dā ō yá kú iyē kú alɔ le yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, A géē je oyēeyī kú uwɔ táajɛ gā um m? Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da uwɔ ka, ɔbúgwū í gáā tōgwú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a géē híhó igbɛ ɛtá ka anúɔ í jé um ŋ́ mā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ōcē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ kpó odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ nēe lā igelī nyā ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū gaá háyi ipú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā olɔhi ō pó ŋmá ɛga oligbó, lɛbɛ̄ɛka enyi ohīlaŋdɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔtɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛgoligbó gē gwá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔyí álá ā lɛ ɔja ɔ́mahāapa ā fō ŋmá ɔkpá ā, ajɛ yɔ̄ hímm, ugwū í tɔ́kɔ̄ ŋ́ ɔkpáncō ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka okɔ́ ɛpa kú áwa éyi ā.

eng_Latn: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áriyɔ̄ku páápá le Udánīyɛlu bī ga iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kahíníī, N lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi má ipú aɔ́fiyɛ kú Ujúda nēe bá nyā nōo lɔfú ka ɔ̄na mɛ́mla ɛyí nū lɛ Ágábáidu glá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nu kahíníī, Aá háyi ɔnyɛ̄pa kú ɔwɛ ká aá má ɔ̄. Aá dɔɔ̄kā kéē ma ɔwɛ kú íkée ā fú lɛ aá. Aá klla tíne ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ nōo géē bī aá ga ɛga ɔdōlɔhi ā yɔ̄ ā. Aá yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kē í lā ɛbɔ́. Amáŋ ācɛ ā tá kahíníī, Ehé, alɔ í gáā yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā lā Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ o hile ā le ūlī tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē fu ipɔ́ɔnū éyi ŋmá ipú ipɔ́ɔnū igwó kéē nyɔ̄ í lā Ujerúsālɛm. Cɛ́ɛ́, ācɛ ohile kú uwā ā, géē nyɔ̄ í lā aígelī nɛ̄hi ohile kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ú wu ɔ́ abɔ̄, mɛ́mla ɛga omlɛ́mlɛ́ kú ɔkɔ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú aá kóō wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ojigógó abɔ̄ aá pīyatɔ̄há mla Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi nēé tá iyē kú uwá tāajɛ ipú inu dóódu kú ācɛ kú uwá nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu gabū ā á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwá nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu gɔbū ā lɛ úklɔ́ nēé gē yá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
idu_Latn: N leyī hɛ́ tū ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ n má ɛbɛ́ ō lɛ ikpó ɛnɛ, ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ipácí, aɔ́dā ō lɛ ipú piyajɛ mɛ́mla ígbáanɔ kú ipácí.

eng_Latn: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ga ā, ācɛnyā ahāapa gēe híla abɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛnyílɔ́ ékpónú, í da ɔ́ kāhíníīī, Alɔ gē je ɔdōlé lɛ īyī alɔ klla í lɛ īlī tū īyī alɔ ohí. Amáŋ, kóocōō, cɛ̄ ka alɔ lé iyē kú uwɔ káā a wɛ ɔbá alɔ á ōfōōfūnū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka uwēyī ka á má ɔbá lɛ ŋ́ mā kóō kwú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ɔbɛ́ɛna ā ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ í yɔlá abɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je ɔbɛ́ɛna kú íne ō bīya ā yɔlá ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya nēé gwó kóō kpó íne nɛ̄ ójīla bīya ā nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
idu_Latn: N géē je ōwē lɛ Ugɔ́gu ŋmá lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ oŋmó. Ɛcɔ̄ ɔwɔ, ofulutu,ɔlá mɛ́mla ōwō géē yā klá Ugɔ́gu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācɛ aéwɔhá alɛwa nēe yɛce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpā um, n tíne ká aá le jé ka ɛdɔ ōwē nɛ̄ n má ā cɛ̄ lɛ úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā le jɛ̄ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī gbɛlá ka um wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā gaá ŋmó íne ā ámāŋ ka ɛlā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā nyí ŋ́. Ń wā gaá ŋmó íne ā nyí ŋ́, amáŋ ká n̄ lɛ uwá yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū bá gē nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ó gā eyīpɔ́lɛ́ éyi, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā éyi nēé hī ka Umáta ā mīya uwá wā ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.
idu_Latn: Ukpɛ̄ kú Óndú ŋmá ipú ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nēé jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ŋ́ mā wɛ ofu ce igwó ɛpa ŋmá úlā ofɛpa .

eng_Latn: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ā kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gbonɛnɛ lɛ alɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ táaha wā ɛgiyí aá ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɛcí ō pā wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ká aá gaá gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛyí nōo yēeyī ā ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
idu_Latn: N pó ɔkā kú ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī hɔ́hā ce uwá ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō ga ipú ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ahɔ̄ nēé pi ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā ŋ́, í gáā wā ɛyí ede í yi umu kú ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́. Ohígbū nēé géē je yíífi bɛ̄ɛka, Ukɔ́ra mɛ́mla ācɛ ígwu kú nū ā. Ɛlísa lɛ odúúdu ɔdā nyā kpó yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne lɛ ɔ́ bū okónu kú Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ nāa yá ā gē je ɔdā nāa cɛgbá ā gā uwɔ. Ɔtū géē he uwɔ, ó kē í lɔhi gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n lɛ ijáalí kú abɔ̄yī um nōo fíyɛ́ ákú Ujɔ́ni, ohígbū ka úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Ádā um je gā um ká n̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá mɛ̄ ā, úklɔ́ ā nɛ̄ n kē yɔ̄ gē yá abālɔbányā á, úklɔ́ ā gē cē um ijáalí ka Ádā um ɔ́ɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, ɔdā dóódu nēé da aá, aá lɛyítáajɛ, klla lɛ uwá yá. Amáŋ aá híīī gbla ucē kú uwá yá ŋ́. Ohígbū keé ī ka, amáŋ é ī yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔtū kú odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda pīyatɔ̄há kwú pīya ékpónú. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ ká anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē le pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
idu_Latn: Ugóolu nēé bī le yá odúúdú íkókwū kú nū á. Anú nēé klla bī le yá odúúdú iyó kú ɔdōlé kú agbla kú ójīla kú Ulébānɔn ā dúú á. Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā eko kú Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í gáā nū aéwo dúúmā nēe bá ipú ajɛ kú uwā eko nɛ̄ Ujósuwa ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā bɛ̄cɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
idu_Latn: Uwá gēe pīya tɔ̄há, kpó ɛfú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ a, klá í je ācɛ nēe lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī a wúla tū ajɛ. Uwá gēe yá ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, mla Umówābu lé. Ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri gēe je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwá klá í lɛyítáajɛ la uwá.

eng_Latn: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ éyééye kú ācɛ nēe bī ɔkpani nū ulé ā hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū. Ó le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí ā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a bī ɔkpani um ā.

eng_Latn: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ́ɔ́ja ékpónú kú aólɛlā kú aá géē nū ācɛ úlā ɛpa cofigwó kú aá inya. Aícɔ́ɔja ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā piyóo jɛ̄ nēe gē nū odúúdú aá inya behé ɔlɛ́ aá. Ɛwa kú aá géē gaá hile lígíí lɛbɛ̄ɛka otúta nōo kwu ɔcí nū kwu ɛyí ɛfu cééé ā.

eng_Latn: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aíne nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ odúúdú uwā eko nɛ̄ aá jīla tɔ̄há ikpɛ́fu ā bá abɔ́ɔ á. Ó klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kɛlā gbōmgbōm nɛ̄hi ŋmá ipú ɔlá mɛ́mla ojuja nɛ̄hi ā, ó ka ɔ́ɔ je aíne ā mɛ́mla íne ɔhá lɛ uwá āa. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ tá tū isiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si leyi pīya tá ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ōfōōfūnū uwā kahíníī, Aá gwéeyē, aá nēe má aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá má ā.

eng_Latn: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ otōhílípú ā gē lɛ eyī yɛ odée ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē yá á. Amáŋ olíla i bī íla kú nū tɔ́ɔna, klla gē ma iyī nū fú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
idu_Latn: Óndú kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá kú ɛnɔ kóō gaajɛ ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí, kú ajɛ kóō kwú dobū ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē fu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í gbɔ̄ ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā lɛ uwá ipú odúúdú ajɛ nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā í lā ā.

eng_Latn: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā tayínū kéē kwú um ú yíífi, amáŋ n gē gbɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ a gekwú, nēé lɛ uwɔ nyī mɛ́mla ádáádā uwɔ, n géē je ɔyí uwɔ éyi cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí uwɔ, klla í bū ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū tū kli.

eng_Latn: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Umówābu, aá lɔtūce ɔfú mɛ́mla agbénú kú aá. É géē yá aá abɔ̄yī aá lé, klla í je Ukémosi, ɛcí kú ā, ga ajɛ éwɔhá. É géē kwú odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɛcí kú aá ɔ́ɔmā nyɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
idu_Latn: Ó kē kpéyī ce ka Upɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ géē je ómíci lɛ anúɔ. Anú yá nōó gē tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ kóō kɔ̄kā lɛ ɔ́ eko tééko á.

eng_Latn: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔwɛ ā, ɔkwɔɔkwu nēé lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō pó ā, usétan gaá le ɛlā ā kpó ŋmá ipú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú um ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga ɛgiyí ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, n má ācɛ ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujaananáya, ɔyí kú Ássɔ mɛ́mla Upetaláya, ɔyí kú Ubenaíya, nēe wɛ aótrɛyí kú éwo ā, wɛ ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń bī odúú kú íkwu nyā yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Ń kē yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kú n mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ ā lɛ iyī um ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, n̄ gekwú gbɔbū! N gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú ci um íkwu ō bī iyī um gwō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
idu_Latn: Óndú le ohi tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka, N géē kpó īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé mla anɔ̄ lɛ aá. Ó kē í jɛ̄ aá klla í nū aá ipú. Ń gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú aá iyɔ̄bū kú aéwɔhá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
idu_Latn: Unɛ́ɛ wɛ ádā kú Ukíss nōo wɛ ádā kú Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ aflɛ́yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu āá. Usɔ́ɔlu ma ayí ɛnɛ. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á: Ujonátan, Umálkīssuwa, Abínādābu mɛ́mla Essbáalu.

eng_Latn: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔcí kú uwíndo ā mɛ́mla ɔcí kú okómpīinu ā lɛ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ. Aúwíndo hɔ́ɔgba ígwu ɛtɛ́ɛ́tá klla lɛ eyī pīya kwu īyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka le da um ka n lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā bītá ga ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, amáŋ á kē da um ɔ̄cɛ nōo í lɛ um bíyē ā ŋ́. A ka anúɔ jé um lɔɔlɔhi, ɛlā um kē he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le pó géē yúúfi, ká ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā kóō lɔtū yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ipú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
idu_Latn: ó kéē má kéē híī gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ́bɔ́cɛ je mlanyī Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nōo kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nōo wɛ ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú ācɛ ā da ɔ́ ka ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ́ odúúdú aá, ɛmiyɛ ɔ́ɔ klla yɔ̄ ī ŋmó aá ɛɛ́, amáŋ ádā nū ɔ́ɔ le ɛka gbo tū aá, kahíníī, Okónu ō tá kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔdōlé wu okónu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, a le tútū káā nyɔ̄ gaá nuunu tá íkwu kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū je lɛ ayááyí kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. A le aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa mɛ́mla ojibó ɛna kú ugóolu nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam yá le aá ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔwɔ kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī kú Óndú ā éyi, Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā wā í kwú um ú. Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄hi éyi, nōo kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka opo ā, igbīhi um.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á cɛ̄ ohígbū ka a le má ɛɛ́ ā nɛɛ? É lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ nēé má ŋ́ nááná nēé cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ádā um ōfōōfūnū gē mīya eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā géē yá á, ó wɛ ɛlā aá kú aá jé ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē dɔ̄ɔka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ dɔ̄ɔka nū lɔfú-lɔfú ŋmá ɔtū éékpó kú uwā ɛ́ɛ géē pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
idu_Latn: Áyísīki da Ísɔ kahíníī, N kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya óndú uwɔ ɛɛ́. N klla kē kwú odúúdú ayínɛ́ nū ā ú kpó pīya ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛɛ́. N klla kē le īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé kpó lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ɔdí ɔhá hile nɛ̄ n géē yá gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Íjīpiti géē pɛ́ kwú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé ŋmó ɛfú ā dúú. Ikwū le tútū ō je odúúdú uwá kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n gekwú eko nōo wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ cigwó ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ á cɛ̄ ɛlā kú um ŋ́ mā, o ŋmá abālɔbányā ā, á gáā kɛlā glá ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā le yá le yɛ. Ohígbū ka ɛlā kú um géē cɛ̄ piíí eko nɛ̄ eko le yá.

eng_Latn: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ipí olɔnɔ nɛ̄hi tū klá Ujóbu iyē dúúdú á. Ipí ā klá Ujóbu iyē ŋmá ɔtīkpō jāā ga akplata kú ɛyí kú nū.

eng_Latn: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ lɛ ɔfulā ohéyīfuú je lɛ ācɛ nēe yēekwu ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā, ikɔkɔ ewo nēé fú klá ɛyí ā. Ká n̄ yá kéē gwéeyē ikɔkɔ ɔtūnōbí nēé bá ī yá ā. Ká n̄ yá kéē bá ī gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ikɔkɔ ɔtū nōó he uwá ŋ́ mā. Ó géē lɛ ā o yá kéē le pīya ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá, nēe ī yá ucē okpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí nēe le gbagwu nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ í má ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ɔdā nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu lā ajɛ kú Íjīpiti iháyí īgwáahāapa. Anɔ́ɔ o pīyatɔ̄há kú iháyí kú nū kē wɛ iháyí ofahāapa cahāapa á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Adá um, ɔtū nāa le ce Ɔwɔicō ā cɛ̄ lɛ ōcē kú uwɔ mɛ ɛɛ́. Nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, kú aa lɛ ɔbɔ́lā lɛ ŋmá ōcē kú uwɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lé ucɛ igbɛɛtá ipú iháyí.

eng_Latn: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ujísɔ̄si klla i hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ ayíkpó kú nū okónu ísu kú Utibérīyasi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
idu_Latn: É dīíbá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le ɔkɔ cē, amáŋ é pó ɔkɔ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē pó ohi dúúmā ŋ́. É pó ɔkɔ kú ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okwɛyí éwo ā géē wā ŋmá Íjīpiti ācɛ kú Itiyópiya géē je abɔ̄ kú uwā gicō kpɛ́tɛ́ɛ́ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛbɛ oōmá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mla abajá ō pllá ācɛ ō má í gáā yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ ba ɔyí ā ŋmá abɔ̄ nū, ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ba ŋmá abɔ̄ nū ā, ɔ́ɔ kē kwú lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
idu_Latn: É lɛ ācɛ tū wɛɛlɛ ga Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá á.

eng_Latn: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú nū á, ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ká ālɔ̄ kē ī yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je ɔ́da lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ɔbá uwɔ le miya kú aá já Alelékwū kú Óndú ā má ā? Ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ í nyi ɔbá uwɔ ā bá okómpīinu ɔ̄wɛ, é kē í je uwɔ nyɛ̄ ɛcɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, n le ifu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ ī tá ohígbū uklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ nēé bá yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā má pó ɛɛ́. N le blakwu okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
idu_Latn: Omiya kú aínu kú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ ɛtá nōo yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ɛplá ā, aɔ́dɔ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā mɛ́mla inu nōo kwu oŋmɛ́yí kú okómpinu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú nū ā, wɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla ákú okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Opīyatɔ̄há kú olīkpō kú ɔwɛ ā wɛ umíta ofu ce ɛhɔ̄. Ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú ipú ɛwa ā dɛ̄gba tū ɔ̄ kóō yɔ̄ cíí. Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ fíyɛ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí kú Udéfīdi, ményinyi um.

eng_Latn: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ, amáŋ á mā alɔ tá ipú ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ ā ŋ́. A le yá ká ālɔ̄ má téeyī olɔhi kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Upɛ̄sīya. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ kā ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ajɛ kú alɔ, ká ālɔ̄ klla lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, túgwó. Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo húmáyī tá alácɛ̄ ā. A kē klla yá ká ālɔ̄ lā Ujúda amānyā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē ga Ukéna kú Ugálīli igbɔhá, ɛga nōó le éŋkpɔ̄ pīya ejé ā. Ogbāājɛ éyi yɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū gē doōcē ajɛ Ukapánɔm.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gaajɛ ā, Ujóssuwa da uwá kéē lɛ okwū kú uwá kpó wāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ē lɛ okwū kú uwá kpó tá tū ɔ̄gɔ̄ néē tɛtɛ tayínū anú ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi míya gwū okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā. Ɛcɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā gwū ɔ̄ jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi tū iyī uwā ā, í gáā jéeyī gbóógbóō ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē jé odée fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
idu_Latn: É lɛ odúúdú ācɛ abɔ̄ kpó ŋmó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile ŋ́. É klla lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Unówa, Udánīyɛlu, mɛ́mla Ujóbu lā abɔ́ɔ nááná, oyēeyī kú abɔ̄yī uwā ofōōfūnū, nɛ̄ olɔhi kú uwā gáā nyā tá á. Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gēe má uwɔ v abɔ́ɔ a, gēe kpééyī kwu uwɔ klá ī hɛ́ idáagó kú uwɔ, ka; Ɔcɛ nōo jīla ɛcɛ iyē, mla ajɔ̄ɔcɛ́ dóódu, klá yá ka ɛcɛ kéē fīyégbúlú a yɔ̄ a.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ mīyɛ ɔnyā ɔyínɛ nū le ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyā nū, ó le ɔdēeliho yá ɛɛ́, klla le uwēyī je lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū ā. É gáā ma ɔyí ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nēé í kwú.

eng_Latn: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ēpū nēé hī ka Udili ce, ó gē bī ogbló nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ le fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄. Ó wɛ ígbɔ́cí ŋ́. Ogbló nɛ̄hi nōó ī le fīyɛ̄ ɛ̄pū nēé hī ka Ukumín ā á. Ó wɛ akā kú ugbɔ́ɔnya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācoyúklɔ́ alɛwa tū ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā kéē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú aígbóoje-otáajɛ ā ú kpó báajɛ, le aɔ́kpá ā kpó wu uwá kwajɛ, le aógbló ō tū okónu ɔlɛ́ ā ú kwu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú aɔ́kpa ú kpó kwajɛ á.

eng_Latn: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō Ádā kwú ojīlīmā, ɛgahi, ocɛ̄tra mɛ́mla ɔfú ú kpó lɛ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá eko nɛ̄ ɔkɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ gē kahíníī, Ɛnyā wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nōo he um ɔtū á, ɛlā nū kē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ eyī kú uwɔ kē nwūla ā gɛ.

eng_Latn: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ ōhī géē kpó ayínɛ́ uwā lɛ̄ ācɛ kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, aádā ōhī kē í kpó ayí uwā lɛ ācɛ kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Ayí ōhī géē bɛ́yíkwú ācɛ nēe ma uwá aá, kē í ŋmó uwā.

eng_Latn: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
idu_Latn: Ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ācɛ icɔ́ɔci dóódu mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu nēe pó ɔdā nēe yá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn nēe wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɔ́ɔlu abɔ̄yī nū wɛ, Úlā ahāapa cofigwó . Ācɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn alɛwa aóhī ā yɛce Usɔ́ɔlu jāā ga ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú um ú bɛ̄cɛ wā odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ o lɛ um bī ga ɛgiyí aɔ́lɛ́ ɛpa nēe bá ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É ligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí inu nōo kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, N cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ wā í jīla um ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo bɛ́yíkwu oyēeyī kú uwɔ, Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē bɛ́yí kwu oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhárim wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó ce igwáahāapa .

eng_Latn: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Ubálam kahíníī, Á gáā nyɔ̄ mla uwá ŋ́, á gáā tókónu lɛ ācɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū kēé le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú í jégēdē ŋ le íne bīya, ó géē je ɔnyā ɛwū kú iháyí éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́nya, aúgbɔ́ɔnya ɛfú mɛ́mla ācɛ o pɛ́ ūwā, nū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu jāā gbéeko nēé gā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē hī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um igwú, n géē tū uwā bá tɔ̄há. N le ɔ́ ŋmó tū ipú ɔtū kú um ka n géē hɛ́ uwā tá ɛɛ́. N klla í yá kéē le nyīla īkpō ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá mla um ā mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, amáŋ é pó ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo kɛlā gā um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē gbo ucē obɔ̄bí ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ uwā. É gbɔɔ́ ō nyíleyī klla gbɔɔ́ ō kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé ma uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó kóō da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka, Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́dúú ā tɛtɛ le cɔ̄nū mla aádáádā uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gē je ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ wɛ ā ŋmá lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ gē gbɛlá ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka eko éyi alɔ kɛpɔ̄ tū Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā dúú, amáŋ alɔ í gē yá lɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛfú ā yɔ̄ ī hɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā, Áhābu gwutá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū yɔ̄ í fu oyī ŋmá ágbe ā. Oyī kú nū ā le pɛ́ klá ɔkwu kú úgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ ā, Áhābu gekwú.

eng_Latn: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, aá cɛ̄ lɛ únwū nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lɛ eko nɛ̄ aá pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā kóō yɔ̄ mla aá kpɔ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
idu_Latn: Ujósuwa da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē ga ɔlɛ́ uwā, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ le yɛ gaá kwú ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú nū ú á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nōo géē lɛ ɔhā bɛ̄ɛka uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Odóódu kú uwā ɔ́ gáā wɛ ɔdɔma ŋ́, kwu ɛna kú uwā í gáā wɛ ɔdɔma ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi má abɔ̄ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū bá ī le ahɔ̄ bá iyī uwā ahɔ̄ ā, iyē le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da uwá ka ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ ka ɔyí ā gekwú ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā le yɛ gaá le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja ka lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔnyōkwū ā lé ɔdōlé ā ɛ̄cī alɛwa á.

eng_Latn: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anɔ́ɔ Usíhɔn mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hi ka Uhɛ́sbɔn ā gaá nuunu tá aá igelí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujáhāsi ā.

eng_Latn: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
idu_Latn: Aá pó ɛlā kú Óndú ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɛlā kpó ce aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú ajɛ ā, ohígbū ka aá í yá ūcē nōo lɛ kpaakpa ipéeyī Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́. Aá klla ī gbonɛnɛ lɛ aɔ́mpa aá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ɔwɔicō ipú ajɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Igbīhāajɛ ā, é kwú ɔtū kú uwā í pīyabɔ̄, klla gáā lɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā nēé hɛ́tá ā kpó kwúcē kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Háyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n je ɔ́da gā uwɔ ka ā ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda, nēe gē wā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ abɔ́ɔ ā. A híī je ɛlā dúúmā tá ajɛ ŋmá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da um ka, inu nōo pīyeyī kwú ɛháajɛ ā wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
idu_Latn: Ujówāsi wɛ iháyí ahāapa ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú um le cēenyi mla agīje, ohígbū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēé kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū tū uwā ɔtū kéē yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ Userúbábɛ̄lu, ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussíyatiyɛlu, igbómína kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí nɔ̄nyilɔ kú Ujɛhósādāki, mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ, kwu ācɛ nēe hile ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá ajɛ ɔfiyɛ ā, gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ le tá ɛgiyí Ágábáidu Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ kwɛyí anúɔ. Ámáŋ Ujówābu í wā ɛgiyí nū ŋ́. Ó klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujówābu igbɔhá kpɔ́, Ujówābu klla tá ō wā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Urútu ka eko nɛ̄ Ubówāsi ɔ́ɔ gaá gwutá, ɔ́ɔ lɛ eyī bī ɛga nɔ́ɔ gáā gwutá ā. Eko nɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gbiyɔ̄lā, ɔ́ɔ je īlī nɛ̄ Ubówāsi le klá iyē ā gicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ má gwutá igbīhi nū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē da ɔ́ ɔdā nɔ́ɔ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó lɛ ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túbá okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
idu_Latn: Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō hɔ́hā ce uwɔ. Ɔhā kú Ɔwɔicō ā kóō yɔ̄ mla odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
idu_Latn: N ka ipú ánya mɛmla ícɔ̄nū kú um ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ajɛ géē jīliyē nɛ̄hi Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ánatōtu wɛ, ofɛhīlī ce ahātá .

eng_Latn: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi je úklɔ́ kú ijē ōgwó lɛ Ásāfu, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi, aɔ́mpānū á, kéē gwíijē iyɔ̄bū kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ nū ā le iyó kú uwā kpó ce aíjakī kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni wā ā, ó lé ɔdōlé ŋ́, ó kē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ācɛ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, ɛlā icííci dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ka, é géē ka ɛyí nū ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, Ábsālɔm mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ā gaajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́. Ahítōfɛlu yɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
idu_Latn: N klla le íne kú ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ uwá í gáā yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā je lɛ uwá kóō wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ kú okónū nɛ̄ n ce mla uwá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aɛ́cī ɔ́ɔmā kóō blatū uwā ka ami nē o wɛ Óndú ā fu uwá kéē wɛ ákú um ofōōfū um á.

eng_Latn: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla anú á. É tíne kéē jé ɔ́dāŋ koó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔdā ō hídáagó éyi yá nōo í mafú ka Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄ wā ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá nyā le tútū ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē nyɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ā gē nyɔ̄ gaá yúklɔ́ kú uwā ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n lā oyēeyī kú um ipú ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla owu ō hīlatá, ŋmá lɛ ɔtū ō bīya gā um piyóó. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ um ohígbū odúúdú unwalu kú um ā ɛɛ́. Ikpokwú kú iyē kú um gē je kpó gbogwú dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú oyī ā ú, le ɔ́ mī klla ācɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Okónu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ce mla aá eko nɛ̄ó je aíne ā, oyī nyā he ɔ́ gwū á.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá bá abɔ̄ kú ɔfú kú uwā mɛ́ɛnɛ, ka ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ó he uwá ɔtū ā kéē yá aá.

eng_Latn: Quench not the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Aá gwū ɔwɛ tū Alelékwū Ihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ohile ā ga ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ŋ́, aá lɛ uwā pi wā ɔwɛ okpaakpa, amáŋ aá leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ kú aá cɛ̄ lɛ uwā kpó ínoōbīya tū aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɛlā nɛ̄ ohilí nū ka ā pó.

eng_Latn: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tíne ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nōo jɔ̄ɔnyā klla lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú, odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ é gaá lɛ Abíssāgi, nōo ŋmá ajɛ kú Ussúnɛm ā má á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú bī gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umɛfíbōssɛ̄ti gā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gaá jīla ɔcɛ́ ɔwɛ ā, ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Umɛfíbōssɛ̄ti, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á nyɔ̄ mla um ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: N géē je Ísu kú Unáyilu ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ, klla í je Íjīpiti tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Aéwɔhá ā géē je odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti catāajɛ. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ ācɛ eko dóódu ā, yɛ gaá kwu ɔkpáncō, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ ā yɛ jāā gaá kwu ojuja.

eng_Latn: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
idu_Latn: Íra mɛ́mla Ugárēbu ŋmá Ujatɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Anyā, aá tɛ́ɛyí wāajɛ lɛ aɔ́bá aá, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá á, abɔ̄ aá le pīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi pīyeyī má amu má anú, abɔ̄ ó má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ó le ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti ā ŋmó, kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ipú ɔjɛ.

eng_Latn: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Ulífāyi mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ ūwā í bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí. Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Usímēyi abɔ̄yī ūwā mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā í bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é le ajɛ je lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā kú uwā a. É kwú ajɛ kú Ugílɛdi ú lɛ ācɛ o hile kú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
idu_Latn: Ayáyí kú ɔlɛ́ Upálu ā wɛ Ɛlíyābu.

eng_Latn: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, nēe wɛ ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ̄, ohígbū ka aá jé Ádā á. N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, aɛ́nɛ̄ e wɛ aádā ā, ohígbū ka aá jé anú nōo yɔ̄ ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā. N yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá fu aá, ayípōklobīya, ohígbū ka aá lɔfú, ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō kē lā ipú aá, aá kē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā yáŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
idu_Latn: N géē ma abɔ̄ ɔfú mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū kú um fú lɛ aá, eko nɛ̄ n géē tá aá bá klla í kpó aá kwúcē ŋmá odúúdú ipú ajɛ aéwo ɔhá nɛ̄ n pa aá hīla nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá ɛna nēé bī gáā le gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ɔ́ɔmā, a géē je ɔ́ nyɔ̄ ga eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, nyɔ̄ ī je ɔ́ yɔɔlá dúúdú ɛga nɛ̄ n géē mafú ga uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa mīyɛ odúúdu agbénú kú ugóolu nēé kpó wā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nyílá. Aá lɛ ipú nū mu mla okwū. Aá gbo úklɔ́ kú aá. Anɔ́ɔ ē gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ācɛ nɛ̄ bá ipú igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n klla má ɛbɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ ā. Ó lɛ acá ɛnɛ kú aígbáanɔ kpó kwu igbīhi. Ɛbɛ́ nyā ā lɛ ɛyí ɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ íkwu mɛ́mla ɔfú kpó lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú alɔ géē háyi iyɔ̄bū Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ̄cóhɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ. Ó géē kɛpɔ̄ tū alɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbā ulé lɛ alɔ ámāŋ kóō yá alɔ italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yá ā lɛ ā. Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē yá ɛ̄nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā olɔhi ámāŋ ka ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ yá ipú oyēeyī kú nū ipú ɛcɛ ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛcɛ ŋmá éŋkpɔ̄ ā, é má ɔlá ahā gē cɛ̄, ɛbéenyi mɛ́mla igbō ce ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá igelī kú Udáni mɛ́mla ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ɛ́frem bá ī bī ɔ̄kā obɔ̄bí wā kéē bá ī kpó aá yíífi á.

eng_Latn: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmá aígelī ɛga nōó yá ɛyínɛ̄hi úklɔ́ idáagó kú nū ā ɛpɔ̄bí, ohígbū ka uwá í pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɛlísābēti lɛ okónu nɛ̄ Umerí hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ā pó ā, ɔyí nōo yɔ̄ ipú kú nū ā jíliyē lɔfú lɔfú. Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū Ihɔ kwú Ɛlísābēti ú.

eng_Latn: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
idu_Latn: Udɔ́ okónu ɔkpá, Ugóyim ipú Ugálili mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó gē téeyī wāajɛ, má ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ n gē nū uwā tɛ́ɛcɛ á nɛ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe wɛ ɔwa kú aá ā gē nū uwā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā? Ācɛ nēe wɛ igwú kú aá piií ā gáā ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Usdusīi nēe ka ka ācɛ í gáā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́ mā, le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka.

eng_Latn: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Ugádi le tá ɛgiyí nū gaá le ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā da ɔ́ á. Ugádi le ɔ̄kā da Udéfīdi ka ɛ̄nyá kú ɔwɛ ɛtá nyā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē je ā? Iháyí ɛtá kú ɔkpɛtā ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Ámāŋ ka aólɛlā kú nū kéē bá ī yá ɔ̄ lé ɔyā ɛtá. Kɛ̄ɛ ka ōcē obɔ̄bí kóō ŋmó ācɛ ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ̄cī ɛtá? Ó da ɔ́ Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ miya ipú odo kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ jé ohi nɛ̄ anúɔ géē bī gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya gaá le ɔfú kpó kwu Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó le íbɔm cē tū Usamérīya á. Iháyí ɔ́mɛtá kú íbɔm nɛ̄ ó cē tū Usamérīya ā.

eng_Latn: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.
idu_Latn: Umíka le ɔ̄kā ɛga nōó ŋmá ā da ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m, ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda. Ka anúɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ géē lā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubárāki mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá uwā ā, Óndú ā lɛ ígbájí bī wā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usisɛ́ra mɛ́mla ācɛ opɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ Usísɛ́ra má hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū, gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya īkpó á.

eng_Latn: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ajɛ nōo le ŋmíkpākplā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ácí gē bū ŋmá anú wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
idu_Latn: Aá yúufi Óndú ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá méyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ í gē ce ɛlā bá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē cɛ̄lā kú ómíci oō mīyɛ lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísa ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bī ūlī ō tá kéē jé ɔtū kú Óndú ā lɛyikwu ajɛ ō kɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é bī ɔwɛ nyā le ajɛ kpó kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu Ussílo, okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je uwá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó le uculo nōo gē je ɔ́ iyē gwu ā yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú yá yēŋēē. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú ɔnyā nōo ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔyínɔ̄nyā á.

eng_Latn: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ he uwɔ ɔtū, á gáā yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ihɔtū ō yá wɛ o lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íne āá.

eng_Latn: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
idu_Latn: Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú abɔ́ɔ ā le úgbéenyi nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gē pɛ́ abɔ̄yī uwā ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Usólōmɔn. Uwá mla ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Usólōmɔn le tá ajɛ kú Ófiri gaá le ugóolu bī gé lɛ Usólōmɔn. Ɔ́lá kú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā fíyɛ́ ɛkpa ije ofu ɛhɔ̄ ce igwó.

eng_Latn: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú nēe je pīya ācoliije ŋmá ɔ́hí nēé tá ipú igelī ɔ́ɔmā géē hayi ɛcɛɛcɛ, ohígbū keé gē yúúfi kéē híīī wɛ ipú ōwē kú nū ā ŋ́. É ge jikwū klla í tɛ̄gíkwū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā géē yá kú aólɛlā kú uwā kéē kwinya ŋmá iyɔ̄bū aá. Ó gē nū uwā nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ nēé géē bá ī wā ā. Kéē géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā cokónu lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā géē leyī gwu aɔ́wɔ, nɛ̄ aádáádā nū pā ā bónū, mɛ́mla aɔ́wɔ nōo he ācɛnyā ɔtū ā. Ó gáā pó ɛlā kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū koó géē gbɛlá ka anúɔ nwuné fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja lɛ ɔ́ gɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ n habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá kóō nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men: and the people lamented, because the LORD had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ŋmó ācɛ kú Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi ofɛtá ce igwó, ohígbū keé feyīkpeéé le ipú ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā má. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le ekwu yɔ̄ ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ alɛwa kpó ŋmó ŋmá ipú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi lɛ o ŋmá lɛ o yá aólɛlā kú uwɔ lé klla le uwá kpó yíífi ŋmáajɛ. A le cɔ̄nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ōkwɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā. A kē le aólɛlā kú uwɔ kpó yɔlá ŋmáajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé wɛ ácí ā.

eng_Latn: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
idu_Latn: Ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gbo ā lipú lɛbɛ́ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tá ɛga o lipú nɛ̄hi kú ipú itekwú ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo jɔ́dā nɛ̄hi lɔfú pi ɔ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē pi éŋkpɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō ā wɛ ákú Óndú ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄, amáŋ ó kwu ɛcɛ ā ú lɛ alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege nōo gē yi klla gē fíyaajɛ lɔɔlɔhi eko kpiíí ā. Ó tīile lɛ aá ɔtū kē he aá.

eng_Latn: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ádā um le bá ō kwú ā, ó cɛ̄ gā um le ɔkpá gbo lɛ ɔ́ ka n géē nyi ɔ́ ipú únóji nōó tútū ajɛ kú Ukénan ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɛga je gā um ká n̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ádā um nyi, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwúce igbīhi wā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé yá nyā le tū Óndú ā íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Amásīya kóō da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nēé gē pā ɛcí kú éwɔhá nɛ̄ ó kōō nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū glá ŋ́ mā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā da ɔ́ ka anúɔ le jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le tútū kɔ́ɔ̄ je ɔ́ yíífi ɛɛ́, anú ɔ́ɔ yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ kɛlā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nāa nɔ̄ɔ̄na lɛ, mla ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nāa yúklɔ́ áncā lɛ, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nāa jé ō kɛlā lɛ, a cíkā ō yúufi Ɔwɔicō piíí.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
idu_Latn: Aúgbɔ́ɔnya bá ajɛ olɔhi oyá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ujúda ā lɛwa láyí. Aícɔ́ɔja ce ɛyí ɔnya kú uwá lɛ eyī pīya kwu okónɔɔwɛ kú igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
idu_Latn: Kéē yēeyī, amáŋ é gēe yɔ̄ í ce ɛfú lɛ aá klla í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ aá. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohi nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá á.

eng_Latn: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, jāhɔ̄ gā um, ká ā jééyī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ odo kú uwɔ̄ tá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le jīla mla Umósīsi ɛga nēé gbo otú ɔwɛ o yɛ ga Íjīpiti ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō tíne ō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācobɔ̄bíipū ā kwú ɔyī ú kwu ɔtā, le ɔtā tú ce le abɔ̄ ɔyī kpó ŋanaa, kéē tá cē ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa otú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
idu_Latn: Aá yúklɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá má ɔdōlé lé. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cīce yɔ̄ ī kɛlā icííci, aá géē je kpó gbɛhá icííci.

eng_Latn: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē yá nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē bá ī lé ɔdōlé nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā cabácabá. N kē í je ɔdōlɔhi nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um cɛgbá ā le uwá jɛ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us, how was this wickedness?
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, ācɛ Ubɛ́njamīn le pó ka, odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le jīla Umíspa. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā da ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā ɔ̄kā kóō ka lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ abɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā géē wɛ ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya ga ɛhícō jāā ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔwɛ ō yɛ ga Uhamáti gáā bū ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo je ɛbɔ́ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu ka anúɔ géē je lɛ uwá ā. Ó klla kē le odúúdú okónu nɛ̄hi nōó ce bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā yá jīla ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ipú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aádā alɔ mɛ́mla alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā nōo kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ipú ígbíli ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ɛlā nōo yēeyī nēé je lɛ alɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi má lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ɛbɔ́, Ɔwɔicō kē lɛ omulɛ́nyɔ́ je lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū.

eng_Latn: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
idu_Latn: Aíkpēyī kwu aóje nēe cíla aákā ɛnɛ ā ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
idu_Latn: Ā híī ŋwúleyīkwū ká a lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ̄cɛ ɛyi je úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ā híī wɛ ipú ínōbīya kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋ́, lɛ iyī uwɔ tū yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa mīyɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ó kwú Ujɛhósādaki ú ga Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ nōó kpó ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó yɔ̄ gē lɛyítáajɛ gā um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó le táajɛ abālɔbányā, nōó klla gē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n ka ipú íne kú um ā, n géē yá kóō cɔcɛ́ gbojī, ayááyí nū kē í lé ɔcɛ́ igbīhi nū dúú.

eng_Latn: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɛjī kú ajɛ kú aá ŋmá ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, jāā ga ísu kú ācɛ Ufilístiya, ohígbū ka n géē je ɔfú lɛ aá kú aá yá uwā lé ɔgbɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ uwá kpó nū ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ gē ka obɔ̄bí kú nū, yá ɔ̄ ōwē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi klla kōō cá ɔ̄ ɛcá bɔ̄bíbɔ̄bí dúú. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le eyīnyinyi um má ohígbū ka ń cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ń kē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé cíká ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ nēé í le tū lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó keé gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka uwá, ámāŋ ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ámāŋ ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā, ɔfiyɛ kú uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ámāŋ ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, ámāŋ aɛ́na kú uwā, ámāŋ aúgbɔga dóódu nōo lā ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nēe ŋmá ipíinu kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, aá jāhɔ̄ ka aá pó ɛlā nyā. Aá ī bī iyē kú Óndú ā gbɛka, klla ī ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ ī gbā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbā ā. Amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ aá ka ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, í klla le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
idu_Latn: N le okónu tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó yúklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ŋmá odúúdú ɔtū mɛ́mla ɔfú kú nū ŋ́. N kē le okónu tá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó bī ɔkpacāŋ́gelī le gɔ̄ ācɛ klla le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē da Ujóssuwa ka aá géē gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ̄gbā. Ka aá kē í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū.

eng_Latn: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, kwú ɔkpá ɔhá ú kú ā lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ɔkpá kú aflɛ́yí ā tá tū ɔ̄ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá le ɔ́ ahɔ̄ pi ka ɔ́ɔ túbla abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya ā tayínū ipácí abɔ́ɔ bá ī gbēyī nū.

eng_Latn: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ́nɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ádā nū í jé ka Óndú ā ɔɔ́ yɔ̄ ī bī ɔ̄ ga abɔ́ɔ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī tínē ɛga nōó géē bū gaá nuunu tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā. Ācɛ Ufilístiya ā bá ī gbō ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikɔkɔ nōó í yá lɛ ā, ó cɛ̄ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó kú nū kóō mabɔ̄ āhɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōó yɔ̄ gbɔbū ā tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyī nū ú yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ó kōō le pīya ɔlɛɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kē má ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yá ɛhi ɔnyā kú ɛ́ɛ lɛ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ gáā gwutá mla ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē gwó inu, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ gáā lā anú ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ufáyin, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ gáā lé īkpō kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Aá í lɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ um ka aá cíká ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā tū piíí, ohígbū ka ó wɛ ɛ̄cī kú um. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔ́ nyílá, lɛ úklɔ́ yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
idu_Latn: Ɛhícō kú utébulu o lɛ akā ā lɛ oje okokolo éyi nēé le cɛyí nū. Oje ā le tú wɛ̄ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ikpó éyi ce āyā ā. Ɛga nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú nū ā kē wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce o kɔ̄ ɛga ɛnɛ oŋmá ābɔ̄ éyi ga ābɔ̄ ɔhá. É kē bī ofu kú ēpū o jíla tɔ̄há le yá ɔ̄ ifa. Oje oplákátá ā lɛ ɔ́gɔgɔ́ ɛnɛ, ó wɛ okokolo ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá gbɔɔ́lá fíyɛ́ iwélé alɛwa á.

eng_Latn: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tá alácɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ mlɛ́nyɔ́ dúúdú abɔ̄ aá géē bá ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aólɛlā géē kpó aá nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
idu_Latn: O da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɛlā mɛ́mla ucē kú um he uwɔ ɔtū ɔkwɛ̄yi, Óndú, n géē gbɔ̄kɔ gā uwɔ ká ā nyɔ̄ mla alɔ. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā likpɛ̄yí olɔfú íbí, amáŋ kwú ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla íneōbīya kú alɔ í yá alɔ ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā mīya alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ajɛ ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ ā, géē je pīya ákú uwā. Ó ka ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ígbíli ɛháajɛ ā jāā ga ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ɛhíícō ā, mɛ́mla oŋmá Ísú kú Uyúfrētīisi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ga ísu kū Umedítāráníya ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɛbɔ́ lɛ, ayíka ɔkpíyē kú nū kē í lɛ ɔbɔ́lā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ī mímálānyī klla gē cɔ̄nū eko dóódu lɛyīkwu ācɛ ɔhá, ucē nyā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ōcē obɔ̄bí nōo kwú ikpokwú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
idu_Latn: Obadíya klla da Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, a gē da um ka amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í da ɔkpani um Áhābu, ka anúɔ Ɛláyíja ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ amānyā, ó géē je um ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ á, Aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī ā kú aá lɛ ɔwɛ túgllayá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēe bá ī pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā. Aá lɛ aɛcɔ̄ kpó tá bónū, ká aá lɛ ikpāŋdrā yá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú otúta ú kwu icō ká aéwo ā kéē má.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā klla kɛlā ɔhá kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi tū ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm, nɛ̄ n yá uwá italā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ nɛ̄ n gáā yá aá ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le pɛ nyɔ̄ gaá lā Íjīpiti á. Aá géē wɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī, ācɛ í bī iyē aá le tókónu lɛ ācɛ, é klla í yá aá ɛbɛ́. Aá kē gáā má ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá eyī gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō géē tū ojuja gaá klá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn ā, mɛ́mla ɛyí kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē jīla abɔ́ɔ ā, ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Ó klla géē tū ódūdū mɛ́mla ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá nōo géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ klá uwá otú. Ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō géē klá odúúdú igelī ā géē yɔ̄ ī gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
idu_Latn: Keé lɛ ɔ́ nyi, kéē kē kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú Ɔkpíihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ um Ufílīmɔn, n gē tá Ɔwɔicō kú um ahínyá eko dóódu nɛ̄ n le blakwu uwɔ eko nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ aa.

eng_Latn: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
idu_Latn: Ó má gwutá mla ɔnyā nū igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ klla le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma á. Ó hī iyē nū ka, Uberíya.

eng_Latn: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɔkpá ā gaá le ɔmā ā fú tū ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka á, N lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nyā yá yēŋēē ɛɛ́, ó klla gáā ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē plla ɔnyā dúúmā ɔyí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́ kéé híī je ɛbɛ́ onyɔ́nyí dúú gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdēelihɔ ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ Umikáya bī wā bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
idu_Latn: Aá géē fu aígelī nɛ̄hi ō kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē kwu nyɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó jégēdēē ŋ́, le ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kéē ka kahíníī, Ɔdā ɔ́bíipú dóódu nɛ̄ Ubábīlɔn yá alɔ ā kóō mīyɛ ulé nū. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ nēé ŋmó ā, oyī kú uwā kóō ce Ubábīlɔn ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
idu_Latn: Eyīnyinyi kú uwɔ nwuné nɛ̄hi Óndú, lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kú uwɔ ā ka, ká ā lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū.

eng_Latn: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú opī éyi ú gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ōbīya, eko dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā gáā kɛpɔ̄ tū ɛcɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cíkā ō kɛpɔ̄ tū ɛcɛ á, aá lɔfú kɛlā ligíī gwó glá ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá yá kú ɔtū kóō le he um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ aá gē gbɛlá ɛdɔ ékpó ā, nɛ̄ aá gē yíhɔtū tá iyī aá ɔwɛ ékpó mɛ́mla aá bī ɔtū ékpó mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ocɛ̄ tɔ̄há ékpó ā.

eng_Latn: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
idu_Latn: N kē le okónu ce lɛ uwá ka n géē je ajɛ kú ācɛ Ukénan ā lɛ uwá, ajɛ nɛ̄ é géē lā ipú nū bɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga ā.

eng_Latn: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó bá ajɛ ohígbū íbɔm nēé gáā cē tū aá ā. Aá lɛ inɔ̄ɔda ɔkplɛ́fú kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bá ɛyí nū gē kpɛ́fú ā tútū! Aá lɛ ɔmɛ o bī ma ublɔ́kwu da, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔdā ō bī ma ublɔ́kwu tútū!.

eng_Latn: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́na ahāapa ɔhá le pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ísu ā. É le nyinyi gányá gányá ā. É gaá háyī pī aɛ́na ojɔ̄kwū ahāapa ā okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
idu_Latn: Unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya géē yá ɔ̄ ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ éyi gē kpɛ́fú tú aólɛlā kú nū gē yá uwā ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ, aá gwéeyē. Aá ka lɛ aéwo dóódu ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
idu_Latn: Aá bla ká aá mīyɛ ugbɔga wā ɔlɛ́ aá. Ó lɛ ācɛ nēe yá lɛ ā nēe mīyɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́ nēé jé ŋ́ dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ā híī yɛ mla ɛdɔ ká ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kōō ī ga ɛga dúú mla uwá ŋ́. Lɛ ikpó kú uwɔ hɛ́ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nyɔ̄ ɔkpáncō jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ayíka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō wāajɛ ā nɛ, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ ka aá jé ɛgɛ́nɛ̄ anú, Ágábáidu ɔ́ɔ húmáyī tíne ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kɔ́ ɔ̄ wā ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ́ɔ lɛ Udéfīdi kwú piíí.

eng_Latn: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ í gwíijē lɛ Óndú ā piyóó ipú odúúdú oyēeyī kú um. N klla í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú um piyóó.

eng_Latn: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
idu_Latn: Ugóolu ā nōo le yāŋāāā je kpó cá yɔ̄ áā? Ugóolu ā je pīyabɔ̄ yɔ̄ áā? Aɛ́cɔ̄ otīīhɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā wɛ ó pahīla klɛ́ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kē gbō um otū gbó ɔ̄cī eko nɛ̄ n gwutá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā, anɔ́ɔ n kē le héyī ɛbɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ofɛhīlī ce ahātá kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja o jɔ́dā nɛ̄hi. Otrɛ̄yí kú uwá wɛ Usábudíyɛlu.

eng_Latn: But Job answered and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóbu tóohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o le eyīnyinyi kú ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā má, óndú nū ā lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá klla kwú ulé ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ ayípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā nēé lɛ ɔbá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā gē nyɔ̄ í yá ɛ̄cī ōblatu ipú iháyí dóódu, ɛyí ɛfú kú Ugílɛ̄di á. E nyɔ̄ ī yēkwu mɛ́mla o yɔ́tūnōbí kú adá kú Ujɛ́futa ɛ̄cī ɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
idu_Latn: Usakíyɔ̄si nyāŋjɛ anɔ́ɔ ó da Óndú ā kahíníī, Po mɛ́ɛ̄ n, ɔkpani! N géē je āyā éyi kú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛpa kú agbénú kú um lɛ ācogbɛhá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka n le ɔcɛ dúúmā pīyatū mīya anú odée nɛɛ, n géē gbā ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ɔ́klá ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
idu_Latn: Kwúcō! Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá wɛ éwo nēe bɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi. Ɔ́bíipú cɛ̄ lɛ aá le gblīgwū icíici. Aá tá ami Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Aá kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ami nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í tōō le gbla um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ogbló ofu gbā, kú ābɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
idu_Latn: Uhúrāyi ŋmá ɔlɛ́ kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ugáássi, Abīyelu ŋmá Ábāti.

eng_Latn: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le úmúlá wu klá ɛyí bá ī jikwū klla yēkwu kú igelī ā á. É bá ī ka kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ó kwíyē lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā íbí! Ó wɛ ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛ aúgbéenyi nēe gē yɛ ísu nɛ̄hi ā, gē yá ije kú uwā ŋmá agbénú kú nū. Ipú eko kpiíí ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī agbénú kú nū le kpú yíífi.
