eng_Latn: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
idu_Latn: É géē bī ɔ̄cɛ ā wā Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɛka gbo ka ó wɛ anúɔ je ɛna, ámāŋ álá ā uwī ā ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, óndú nū géē cɛ̄ ka ufu ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ anúɔ á, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā tá ɔ̄ ā í gáā gbā ulé nūŋ́.

eng_Latn: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
idu_Latn: Abíjam cɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda iháyí ɛtá Ujerúsālɛm. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Umáaka, adá kú Ábsālɔm.

eng_Latn: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū ɔ̄cɛ ō wú gē tū ikpɛ́lā klá ɛcɛ, amáŋ ihɔtū gē leyī gla obɔ̄bí alɛwa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ā bónū.

eng_Latn: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī kú aá gē ka kahíníī, Óó gē tá ɛlā olɔfú mla ɛlā o kwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔtū nyá tū ipú ɔkpá kú nū íbí. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yīnū yɔ̄ ɛgiyí alɔ nɛɛ, ó lɔfú iyē ō má eyī ŋ́. Ó klla jé o kɛlā olɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: N géē cīla aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ lɛ īkpāndrā yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē yɛ.

eng_Latn: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ kú ipú aá géē cīje bá um ka ami ɔ́ɔ bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō glá āa? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɔdí kē yá nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú Ubenhádādi da ɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɛyí ɛfu nɛ. Ɛfu ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá aá lé ɔgbɛ́fú á. É ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɛfú kpó tá uwā ajɛ ɔlamu, aá géē yá uwá lé.

eng_Latn: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
idu_Latn: eko ɔ́ɔmā, ó lɛ ɛlā ā jila, ó má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íjééyī tīile lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ mɛ́mla anú á.

eng_Latn: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ami ōfōōfū um māháyi abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ohéyī nyā á. Ipú kú um le gbogodo, ɔfú dúúmā ī yɔ̄ ipú um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, īkpēyī kú um kwú pīya ɔhá, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klá jé um glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́lu mɛ́mla Unɛ́bɔ, aɛ́cí kú Ubábīlɔn ā kwú pīya ɔdā icííci. É lɛ uwá kpó gbō ce ɛyí aɛ́bɛ o bī iyó. É kē le pīya iyó ogbɛnu nɛ̄hi ce aɛ́bɛ́ ā nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ uwā.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋmó ācɛnyīlɔ ɛnɛ nyā nēe wɛ ayááyí kú aágwu kú Ugáti ā á.

eng_Latn: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á tá um ohi ŋ́ nɛɛ? Á jé ka n lɛ íkwu ō hɛ́ uwɔ tá, mɛ́mla íkwu ō lɛ uwɔ nyɔ́kpá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
idu_Latn: Inu nyā lɛ aúwíndo áklō kú nū dúúdú. É lɛ ɔdɔ ā yá ifa mla ifotó kú alī.

eng_Latn: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
idu_Latn: Ń yɔ̄ ī ba uwɔ ka lɛ uwá kpó ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ká lɛ uwá gbō ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē lɛ anjámī wu ɔnya okónu o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ lɔfú pīya odúúdú iyē kú ɔnyā ā eyī ga ɛga dúú nɛ̄ alɔ dɔɔ̄kā ā glá.

eng_Latn: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā gbla ɛlā lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá kwu ɔcí ufígi mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cí ohile.

eng_Latn: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ éwo éyi nōo bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, le cē klɛ́ɛcɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā, kéē mīyɛ ɔ́ tābɔ̄. Ó dɔɔ̄kā kú n̄ lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá lɛ ɔ́, eko ōhī anúɔ géē lɔfú kpɛ́fú tá uwā, yá uwā lé klla kpó uwā nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú nū ā glá.

eng_Latn: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi kahíníī, O ŋmá ɔfú kú otrɛ̄yí kú alelékwū obɔ̄bí nōó gē nū alelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú aá kpó wā ipú inu o kpó iyó tū jōōjīla, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔdōlé kóō yɔ̄ ipú inu kú um. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ um jáamá kú aá má ɔ̄, n géē nwūla uwíndo kú ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ cē ɛhi mɛ́mla ɔhā kú um klá aá Cabácabá.

eng_Latn: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan wɛ ádā kú Uméríbaálu nōo wɛ ádā kú Umíka á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni lɛ Ɛlíssēba, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ammínādabu ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Unáhsɔn lɛ. Ó ma ayí ɛnɛ lɛ Árɔ̄ni: Unádābu, Abíhu, Ɛlísaa, mɛ́mla Ítāma.

eng_Latn: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nēe má ā wɛ ɛgba nɛ̄ n dɛ̄ abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā ka, Ohígbū ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū nēe gē kɛpɔ̄ tū um iyɔ̄bū aá ícɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Ó gekwú anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m á.

eng_Latn: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ ā kahíníī, Awɔ, ɔyí um, ɔyí ō bá ɔtū kú um, ɔyí kú ohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā lɛ Óndú ā. Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā da uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Usádusīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba ī jɔkɔ gicō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ aítíca kú íne ōhī kú ɔwá kú ācɛ Ufárisīi cāŋjɛ kē kahíníī, Alɔ ā í má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́. Ekōhī alelékwū ámāŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kē kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ɔkwɛyi.

eng_Latn: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū lɛ um yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí gē fa ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ó lɛ aīnu kwú akpokónu lɛyíkwu um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó gē wɔ́tū um, klla lɛ eyī kú ícɔ̄nū gbā kwu um gɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ mla ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú uwā ā géē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú Ubábīlɔn, nēe géē ŋmá ajɛ ɛhícō ā géē wā í je ɔ́ yíífi.

eng_Latn: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú eko nɛ̄ ayípáncɛ́nyā kú Ussílo ɛ́ɛ gē wɛ̄ɛcɛ í jīījē eko kú ucɛ ā, kéē le tápláká wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō lɛ ɔnyā éyi kwú abɔ̄fú ga ɔlɛ́ nū, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ oŋmá-ajɛ ā, ó yɔ̄ i fíyajɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó gā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ubétlehɛ̄m, ipú ajɛ kú Ujudíya, Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda jé ka igelī kú aá cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā ohígbū ka otrɛ̄yí éyi géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī kú aá nōo géē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ulé gbā, ká ā mīyɛ abɔ̄ um. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔhá í yɔ̄ nōo yá ɔdā nyā ga um glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Owu ofu kú nū ī tɔ̄lá. Ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū.

eng_Latn: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, n lɛ abɔ̄ tɛ́yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá kú aá yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ami ā, ohígbū ka ami abɔ̄yī um le pīya bɛ̄ɛka aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ā í labɔ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́ mā. Aá yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bi dúúmā eko nōo yɛ ā ŋ́, amáŋ abālɔbányā aá ī yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā da uwá kahíníī, N lɛ ɛlā kú aá ā pó ɛɛ́, n kē í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ba lɛ ā. Ohi dóódu nōó tá aá, ń kē gáā lɛ ɔdā dúúmā tayínū lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
idu_Latn: Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ géē doōcɛ̄ kú ɔdīpú nōo géē yɔ̄ ī je uwɔ ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
idu_Latn: O bɔ̄bí gā um abɔ̄ n lā ipú aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā ipú ācɛ olɔnɔtū kú Umɛ́ssɛ̄ki ámāŋ ipú ācɛ kú Ukéda ā.

eng_Latn: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
idu_Latn: ó wɛ obū ŋ́. Ń mā ō dɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́ nááná nɛ̄ obū nɛ̄hi klá um eyī, í cɛ̄ ga um mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
idu_Latn: É tá ɔkpá nyā fu odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu, klla lɛ ɔ́ kpó kɔ̄ ga odúúdú ɛyí ajɛ ofu ɛhīlī ce ahāapa kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́siya ā. É tá tū ɔkpá nyā ka, ācɛ Ujíyu kéē lā ɛbɔ́ klla lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ami ā, n géē gbēyī Óndú ā ohígbū ka n jé ka ó géē nya um tá. Ɔwɔicō kú um kē í pó ɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔdāajɛ nɛ̄hi, ajɛ kú Ugílɛdi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá lā ajɛ ā jāā kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ūpū nōo tá jāā gaá kwu ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi ā.

eng_Latn: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, aá híīī yá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ oleyī ɛpa āa ŋ́. Ohígbū keé gē tíne kéē háyi ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ mɛ́mla áklō kú uláyi kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká ācɛ kéē má uwā. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka uwá mīyɛ ulé kú uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ́ɛ! Ogbeé kú ísu kú Ukúss a, Ajɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nēé ba ī pó uya kú owu.

eng_Latn: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu da Ugídīyɔn kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú aá. Anú mɛ́mla ayááyí kú nū, nōo géē gboce ɔ́ ā. É ka ɔ́ɔ le aá nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Umídiya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā, n le jé ka Óndú ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔwɔ dóódu kpɛ́mm á, ohígbū ka ó lɛ ācɛ kú nū hɛ́tā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti o yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ, nēe bá ī yá uwā ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ede ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í gbā aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ̄gbā kpó gwó kwu odúdɔ̄lɛ́ ɛpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ enyi ī pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú nū ā, géē na īlī cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ iyē gwā, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔwɛ máfú lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla ācɛ Umanásɛ le yɛ gāá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ma ɛga nēé bū wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā fú lɛ uwá ā ōfōōfūnū hile yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛlā kú ɔdā dúúmā le kwú um iyē, a gē tá um ɔtū lé, klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū gē he um.

eng_Latn: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le pɛ́ ga odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda mɛ́mla ɔkpá nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū tá ā. É gē da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kɔ́ɔ̄ géē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí ācɛ ohile kú uwā nēe kwu ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā.

eng_Latn: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Agōdō dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā cīcē ámāŋ koó gwutá anú ā kwú pīya ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Asárīya mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya o hile ā leyīkwu ɔ́ údɔ̄bū cíí ipú ufi, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nū ga ɛcɛ fíyaa ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā le italā yá ɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é lɛ ɔ̄cɛ apī hɛ́ ɛ̄cī usábāti o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī nyílá íne kú Umósīsi ŋ́, aá gē cɔ̄nū tū um ohígbū ka n le yá kú ōcē kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō mɛ dúúdú ɛ̄cī usábāti ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú aá nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē nyīla í je pīya ipɔ́ɔma. Ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē nyīla í je pīya éwo nɛ̄hi. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á. Eko nɛ̄ eko le yá, n géē yá ka odúúdú ɔdā nyā kóō le yá fíyaa.

eng_Latn: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɔyí ɛna, álá, ámāŋ ɛwū ma. Ó géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɔŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá gɔbū ā, Óndú ā lɔfú mīyɛ anú kú ɔdā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú glá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā aá kē jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ ami ā jé ɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n ka ka ń jé ɔ̄ ŋ́, ayíka n wɛ ōcokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka aá ā. Amáŋ n jé ɔ̄, n kē í lɛ ɛlā kú nū tū.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya klla kɛlā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le da aá, ācɛ Ujúda nēe hile lígíí ā, ka aá híī pɛ nyɔ̄ í lā ajɛ Íjīpiti ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá le jé ka n lɛ abɔ̄ pīya aá ahɔ̄ ícɛ nyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísaa í ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ Ukíss ma ɔyí éyi nōo lé ka Ujɛramīīlu.

eng_Latn: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta gbɔɔ́ ō ka lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́, alɔ habɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu tá gbɔɔ́ ō yɛce uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē nā abɔ̄ kú um daa í jē ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá ā yíífi. N géē je ɔlɛ uwā tá alácɛ̄ ŋmá ɛháajɛ kú ígbíli a jāa ga ɛhícō kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Uríbla á. N gáā ce ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, lā a tá ŋ́. Eko ɔ́ɔmā odúúdú ācɛ ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē yíihɔtū tá odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā eko dóódu. Nwū um íne kú uwɔ, Óndú.

eng_Latn: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um yɔ̄ ī wā oŋmɛ́yí fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka úgbéenyi nōo ī yɛ éŋkpɔ̄ fíyaa ā. Ó klla wā í yɛ fíya bɛ̄ɛka ɔgɔ nōo wā gáā je ugwū ā.

eng_Latn: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukénan mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ugígāssi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujɛ́būsi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ uwá yálé, ācɛ kú Íjīpiti a géē jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi klla lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē tá Usólōmɔn abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛnyā, Ujóbu lɛ ɛlā ka ka anúɔ híjémā ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ anúɔ mā anúɔ ā. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛlā kú abālɔbányā ā, n pi aá ahɔ̄ ká aá lɛ iyī aá hɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe bá ā, ká aá kē habɔ̄ uwā tá cíí. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nēé miya klla yá nyā ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ, ó géē mɛtāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
idu_Latn: ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá kē wɛ ákú aɔ́kpá kú ābɔ̄ ɔhá, ɛhɔ̄ wɛ ákú igbīhi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá kahíníī, Aá wā gaá má ɛ́ga nɛ̄ ajɛ ā tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ikpó ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī nyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā kú nū ce, aá géē nū uwā ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ŋmá ipú aá. Ohígbū ka uwá le íne kú iyē ō tū yēŋēē bīya.

eng_Latn: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
idu_Latn: Aógbɛhá dóódu nōo gē jikwū gaá tū um kú otábɔ̄ ā, n gē tá uwá abɔ̄, ī hɛ́ uwá tá. N klla ī tá ayókwū nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá uwá abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ um yá ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔfú kú nū jē ga um bū ipú ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nōó je ga um ā.

eng_Latn: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
idu_Latn: N géē yɛ í lɛ ɔkɔ kú um ka lɛ ɔ́, klla lɛ ɛpɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ n lɛ ō ka ā ka lɛ ɔ́ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: How hath the LORD covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, ipú ícɔ̄nū kú nū, le Ujerúsālɛm fɔnū ka anúɔ í yá ɔ̄ italā. Aɔ́dā nōo he ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú píya ɔdā kú ífi. Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɔ̄nū ā, ó kwú igbīhi í cē kwu Ujerúsalɛm nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō lɛ ikpó ce kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
idu_Latn: ayíka ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ igwu amáŋ ka ocikāpā gē bū, ajɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kóō kwú bū ɔha mɛ́mla ujē. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujóbu yɔ̄ ī ka ā mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ alɔ í lɔfú i tá iyālɔ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā, Ohɔ́nyɛtá gekwú ohígbū alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔ́bíipú ā eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ka ɔ́ɔ cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ɛplá ácí ujē ā. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā pó.

eng_Latn: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya da ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ Ulɛ́bānɔn gáā dīíbáā. Aá dɛ̄gba ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ubássan. Aá dīíbáā ŋmá ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Umówābu ohígbū ka é kwú odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī tá aá abɔ̄ ā í yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn kwu ita úlā ahāapa cofigwó , klla tá ijē fíyɛ́ úlā ɛpa cofigwó .

eng_Latn: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ īkpɔ̄dā ōhī le pɛ́ bá ajɛ olɔhi, īkpō ā le bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le jɛ̄, le cɛyí mla īkpɔ̄dā alɛwa. Ɛga ōhī lɛ īkpɔ̄dā ofucigwó, ɔhá ofɛtá, anɔ́ɔ aóhile ā lɛ īkpɔ̄dā ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
idu_Latn: É bá ī yá ucē nyā yɔ̄ ī yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi yɛ jīla tá kwu ɛnɔ kwu ɔtú. É cɛ̄ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā le mu mla ucē obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwɛ́nɛ kú ɔyā éyi ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē gbo ucɛ kú onyatá ō yá. Ɛ̄cī ahāapa, odúúdú ācɛ géē bá ī lé igbō nōo ī nū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
idu_Latn: A le ucɛ kú um tútū gā um, ɛga nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um géē má um. A le anɔ̄ ōkpóocu tū um ɛyí. A yá um ɔmáabá kú ugbɔga ojīlīmā. A géē yɔ̄ ī yá olɔhi gā um klla í yɔ̄ ī ményinyi um eko dóódu. Íkókwū nɛ̄ um gē gwá ejé ŋmá anú ā le mu yɔ̄ ī pīya bónū.

eng_Latn: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ límanya, uya nɛ̄hi yá, akpáabana gbo klla gbo, ajɛ klla le jíliyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ɛdɔ ajɛ nōo jíliyē ɔ́ɔmā í yá jééjée ŋmífī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá alɛɛcɛ ā ɛ́ ŋ́. Ajɛ nōo jíliyē ɔ́ɔmā bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ he um ɔtū, n kē lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ́, n géē gbɛlá tū íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
idu_Latn: Áa háyi ɛga ɛyɛ́ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí yí hɛ̄ ācɛ ā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ Usekaríya nɛ̄ o gē nwū ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā yēeyī gaá kwu ā, ó le ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔīcō. Ɔdā nōo yá nɛ̄ ó gē le ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then said they, What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him? They answered, Five golden emerods, and five golden mice, according to the number of the lords of the Philistines: for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛdɔ ɛ̄gbā nyá nɛ̄ alɔ géē je tɛ̄hɔ̄ búla anú nyɔ̄ āa? É tá ācɛ ā ohi kahíníī, Ɛ̄gbā kú ojibó kú ōcē apú ā kú ugóolu ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ojibó kú ifú nēé bī ugóolu ma ɔ́ ɛhɔ̄. Éyééye kú uwā géē kwɛyí kú aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufílīstiya ā. Ohígbū ka, é tū ōcē apú ā ɛhɔ̄ klá odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄ ka abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō gbonɛnɛ ā nōó klla ī kɛpɔ̄ olɔfú tū ācɛ ā. Ó gē kɛpɔ̄ olɔfú tū ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, amáŋ ó gbonɛnɛ lɛ aá, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yɔ̄ ī gɔbū ō yá ɔdā nōo í yá kóō gbonɛnɛ lɛ aá, Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ nōó lɛ ā ŋ́, ó géē hɛ́ aá bónū dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le bēhé tá ipú Ujérīko anɔ́ɔ ó kē yɔ̄ ī yɛ bū ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man's life) to employ them in the siege:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī kpó aɔ́cí nōo gē gwá īkpō kú igelī nɛ̄hi nēé yɔ̄ ī tíne ō mīyɛ ā hɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka íbɔm ā le gbojī nááná ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē lé īkpō kú aɔ́cí ā, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ híī kpó aɔ́cí ā yíífi ŋ́, ohígbū ka aɔ́cí ā ɛ́ɛ́ wɛ aólɛlā kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le yɛ ligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ, nōo le wu ligbó hɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ā.

eng_Latn: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
idu_Latn: É géē gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɛga ocīce kú eyīnyinyi kú nū ā. É klla í yá ɔdā ocīce mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō yá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ifa.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le tá Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī igelī ā le hútú. Ācɛ ā bá ī dɔ̄ɔkā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ ā, da uwá kéē wā ɔlɛ́ anúɔ. Kéē híī gbo ɛyɔ́pu abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛga je lɛ uwá kéē kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā eko dóódu. Ɛpɔ̄ nōo ce uwá abɔ̄ bá ā, nēé géē bī wā gé lɛ uwɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le tɔ́ɔtɛ́ gā uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é cē uwɔ bī iyó ā.

eng_Latn: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
idu_Latn: Aá kpɛ́fú tá Ubábīlɔn ŋmá āyā dóódu kú aá kwú aɔ́bā nēé ī kpó aíkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ tū igelī ā í kpó ca. Lɛ aíyó kú nū ā tīkwū klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī yá ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Aá lɛ Ubábīlɔn yíífi dúúdú, aá mā ɔdā dúúmā tá ipú nú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD's servant?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā klla yɔ̄ nɛ̄ eyī kú nū pu fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um gɛɛ? Amáŋ nɛ̄ ahɔ̄ kú nū du fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, nɛ̄ n gē tɛ̄hɔ̄ āa?.

eng_Latn: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
idu_Latn: Ń gē yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ń dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ n gē yá á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ adá kú Uféro ā da ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Kwú ɔyí nyā ú nyɔ̄, ká ā lɛ ɔ́ bī jɛ̄ gā um. N géē cíla uwɔ ulé. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā kwú ɔyí ā ú kóō bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá, nēe wɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí āa, jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē je ɛhi olɔhi lɛ ayí aá lɛ ā, ó lɛ āa Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā i gáā je ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēe da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ohígbū kú Ucɛ kú Onyatá ā, ācɛ alɛwa cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, abɔ̄ é le ɔdā ō hídáagó nōó yā ā má ā.

eng_Latn: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú ɔdā ɔ́ɔ wɛ áncā! Ó klla ka odúúdú oyēeyī mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɔ́ɔ wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ uwá má ɔlɛ́ uwɔ āa? Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ɔlɛ́ um ā, é le uwá má ɛɛ́. Ɔdā dúúmā í tayínū ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ ń mafú lɛ uwá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
idu_Latn: N géē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka A gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē má ā nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ ka a gē jɛ́yí odée bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ī jé āa?.

eng_Latn: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā. ohígbū ka ó yá ɔdā idáagó! Ó bī ɔfú iyē kú nū le yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nya um tá ā da um ka āmí ɔ̄ɔ́ kwú ipoto kú um ká n̄ yāwu.

eng_Latn: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyípɛ̄ éyi ú gaá háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā. Ó kwú ɔyí ā ū ce abɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka.

eng_Latn: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
idu_Latn: Owu nɛ̄hi gē tá wā í je ācobɔ̄bíipú kpó ŋmá ajɛ. Amáŋ, ācɛ oyólɔhi nēe gē yá ucē okpaakpa ā, ɔdā dúúmā í gē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɛta ā wɛ Usákɔ.

eng_Latn: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ményinyi ɔyí um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ohígbū ka ó gē jajikpáakpáa. Ó ī móōwē fíyábɔ̄. Ó ī míya tá ɔlá ojigógó, ó ke ī míya tá éŋkpɔ̄ ojigógó.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā da Ufílīpu kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā nyɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ ga ɔwɛ nōo ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Ugása ā.

eng_Latn: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ icīīcō ɔkpáncō ā, nɛ̄ a má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ bá icīīcō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cikpó ɔ̄nyā ɔyí uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
idu_Latn: n géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu aá, cɛ́ɛ́ n klla í yá aá italā nōo í bɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi igbahāapa fíyɛ́ ákú otɛtɛ ā.

eng_Latn: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām lɛ éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdā dóódu nōó kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā kpó lɛ Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki á. Ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí kú iyē aflɛ́yí kú nū ā wɛ, Ɔcɛ́ kú ɔdā okpaakpa ō yá, abɔ̄ nōó kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ɛga nēé hī ka Usálɛm dúú ā, ɛyí kú iyē kú nū ā klla wɛ Ɔcɛ́ kú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá ō hɛ́blu gē je ácí yi tāajɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ucē ɔbɔ̄bí kú ācɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā géē kpó uwā yíífi lɛ ā á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gáā ce ífi kú uwā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
idu_Latn: É pɛ́ gla ɛyí ɛfú, ga ɔpɛ́ kú ɛfu, ga ɛga nāa yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē húmáyī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu je lɛ alɔ ā. Alɔ mɛ́mla anyā alɔ, mɛ́mla ayí alɔ, í gwá ejé jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā. Ó lā ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti, ɔkpani nū.

eng_Latn: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja lɛ īyī nū náŋdaa kwú ɔtū ú klá ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā igbɛɛtá. Ó klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kahíníī, Kóocōō, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, kwú ɔyí nyā ú héyī ká ā kwú odo kú nū ú kwúcē gé lɛ ɔ́ kóō yēeyī igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú Ujósɛ̄fu kwú he Upɔ́tīfa ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú abɔ̄yī nū á. Ó klla kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nōó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya le da uwá ɔdā dóódu nōo pó Ubárukú jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kplɛfú kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhadadésa bī ā, Udéfīdi mīyɛ klla kwú kpó ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔbū ā, eko nɛ̄ ayí aá lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí ucɛ nyā ā da, aá géē tá uwā ohi ka, Óndú ā bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū le kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ tɛtɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ a kwu anɔ̄ ā ú pīya klla anú ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ a da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ka anúɔ̄ lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kú ɔ̄ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka á lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla ká ā kwú kwu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ bōōbū. A klá abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka íne nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔnɔ nēe í jɛ́yí nū kéē lɛ uwá tū glá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki wā gáā le ɛfú kpó tú uwá Urefidím.

eng_Latn: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu le pó ka Usséba ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ā, é le pɛ́ i yɛ gaá le íbɔm cē tū igelī nɛ̄hi ā. É le ógbudu ma bá ɔdɔ kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ odée gɔ́ ɔdɔ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ wúla wāajɛ á. Ācɛ ohi kú uwá klla gbɔɔ́ ō bū ɔgɔ tá ikpo kú ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú wúla wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
idu_Latn: Ó le um yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó ī tá ɔyī cē ɔ̄ɔ̄ eko nōó ī nwū ɔ́tá ā. Ó le ɔyī tá cē um ŋmá ɛga dóódu. Ó klla le ɔyī tá cē um íkplí, lɛ um ɔhɛ ca bónū. Nááná ó ményinyi um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ móōwē, ohígbū ō tú aá ɔtūlé, klla nyā aá tá nɛ. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ ɔtú túlé, ó gē tú aá ɔtūlé ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú, ɛ̄nyā gē yá ká aá lɔtūlé abɔ̄ aá bá gē má ɛdɔ ōwē ékpó nɛ̄ alɔ má ā.

eng_Latn: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nēe lɛ agbénú abālɔbányā dúú ā, aá le jí ɛɛ́. aá mīyɛ ɔdā olɔhi kú aá kwɛyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
idu_Latn: Ōhī kú ikpɔ̄dā ā le pɛ́ bá ajɛ kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, e kwú yɔɔlá tāajɛ ohígbū ka ajɛ ā í lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī ga Ubɛtsáyída ā, anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu á. Ó mīyɛ uwá, le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ odoōcē ā hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
idu_Latn: N le abɔ̄ bī uwɔ mla odúúdú ɔfú kú um. Abɔ̄ olɔfú kú uwɔ ā kē í gbō um.

eng_Latn: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
idu_Latn: Anú géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gā um á. Ó géē wɛ ɔyí um, n géē wɛ ádā nū, ayí nū í lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu ā kwú ɔ́kpllá kú nū, nōo géē lé ɔcɛ́ igbīhi nū ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā lɛ ɔwɔ kú Umówābu. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má ā le tū uwā ufi nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
idu_Latn: É kwu lɛyíkwu ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. É bá í tóómbli gla ɛyí igá ā, é tīicō ga ipú aínu ā, klla ī yɛ bū uwíndo bɛ̄ɛka aúwī ā.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da Áhābu kóō nyɔ̄ gaá lé ɔdōlé mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka anúɔ pó bā ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í gwō.

eng_Latn: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ dúúmā nēe kpó ɔtū ce Ukúss mla Íjīpiti a gēe lɛ ɛyī kwu ajɛ ipú uwēyī; Eyī ooce mla ɔtū oōce kú uwá dóódu a gēe je pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
idu_Latn: Ó gēe gbō ācɛ kú nū mla ooyēŋēē mla ookpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
idu_Latn: É lé Ujísɔ̄si bī ga ɛga éyi nēé hī ka Ugɔ́ɔ́gɔ̄ta ā, nɛ̄ ɛyí kú iyē ā lé kahíníī, ɛga kú ákōklō ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
idu_Latn: Ussáma nōo ŋmá Uhára ā. Ahíyam, ɔyí kú Ussára nōo ŋmá Uhára ā.

eng_Latn: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ dúúmā í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ŋ́, Óndú, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í yá ɛdɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ ā gē yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá kú odúúdú ācɛ kéē kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka alagbá a ohígbū ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ. Ɛ̄cī kú unwalu mla ákanya, Ɛ̄cī kú ífi mla ɔdā ō wúla tāajɛ, Ɛ̄cī kú ojuja mla ajɛ odobū. Ɛ̄cī kú ajɛ odobū mla ajɛ odɔlúú.

eng_Latn: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, yá kú ɔcɛ́ ā kóō lɛ aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé. Lɛ ohi olɔhi tá alɔ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ hī uwɔ igwú.

eng_Latn: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē bá Ujerúsālɛm ɛyí ɛfú kú Usáyɔn, nōo géē hile ā pií ohígbū ka Óndú ā tɛtɛ le ɔ́ ŋmótá ka ɔ́ɔ í yá ɔ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahíja lɛ úwé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú nū nōó le wiyē ā plla, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ híla, le ɔ́ kɔ ɛga igwɛ́ɛpa á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um, anɔ́ɔ a kwú ɔnyā kú Uríya ú pīya ɔnyā uwɔ á, ikwū ɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lá géē yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú Óndú ā eko ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í yá ā ka ɔ́ɔ le lɔhi lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí kú uwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ī lā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ká ɔ́ɔ le pīya ákú uwā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ húmáyī yɛ ā, anúɔ yɔ̄ pi ɔ̄ɔ̄. Ka anúɔ klla cɛ̄ le ɔ́ le odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé. Ó ka anúɔ klla géē yá ká iyē kú nú nōo wɛ Udéfīdi ā ká ɔ̄ lófu nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí nɛ̄hi kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kóō lɛ ɔtū kú uwā jila gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lé igbō ā ámāŋ gwá ŋmá íkókwū ā.

eng_Latn: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī lɛ ohílīpú jɛ̄ nēe gē jé ɔwɛ nēé ī yɛ ā, amáŋ aólíla gē plla iyī uwā, gē gbɛlá ka aá jé ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu leyīyōce á. Awɔ kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē nya alɔ tá ŋmá ámíyā ɛ̄cī éyi á, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a í yá bɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga ɛyiyí alɔ āa? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga nōo wā í bū ɔlɛ́ alɔ nɛ̄ ó lɛ gbo otú ékpónú ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́, mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú nū. Agege mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ō lɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛnɛ ā lɛ opo kú nū tá. Ɔdée le yá āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ɛnɔ, mɛ́mla ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ āyā éyi ŋmá ipu okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ɔlá kú uwā í fíyáajɛ gɛ ŋ́ má. Ɔlá dúú í fíyáajɛ āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ɔlɛɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá ŋmá ōwē mla ɔnɔ mla ákanya kú uwá, mla úklɔ́ oolɛɔfú kú abɔ̄ kú ɔfiɛ́ nēé kwu uwá bá ɔɔ, yá abɔ́ɔ ɔfú a.

eng_Latn: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
idu_Latn: Usɛ́lɛ̄míya kwú ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Usekaríya nōo gē nwū ɛlā olɔhi piyóó ā kwú ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō ā ú.

eng_Latn: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ohépu kú uwā mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú uwā, géē wɛ ugóólu ékpónú, nēé bī omútāgā na tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
idu_Latn: Ɔda ɔhá nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē yá mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā iyē ā wɛ, o kpó ijē kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ lé ā yɔlá dúúdú, mɛ́mla o pīya ijē kú ɛya ā klá ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā. O ŋmá ɛ̄nyā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu gekwú. É kwú okwū kú nū ú ga Usamérīya gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi.

eng_Latn: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ gáā lɛ anyā alɛwa ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē je ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgīyí Óndú ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kē gáā kpó aɔ́dā agbénú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu lɛ iyī nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
idu_Latn: Ahíra, ɔyí, kú Ɛ́nan gē leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwū kú Ébrahām ā, Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Áyísīki, ɔyí nū, nōo lā pīyɛ Obugā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo má um āa.

eng_Latn: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɔyā igwó ɛpa ā, eko nōó yɔ̄ ī yāwu icō kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú um gē bī tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū ā ɛɛ́, odúúdú iyē kú um yɔ̄ ī je yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī lɛ abɔ̄ mla aɔ́dā nōó tīile ŋ́ nɛ ācɛ gē yá ā ŋ́, é wɛ aɔ́dā kú ajodobū nɛ̄ n. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá yá ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ péee kú ācɛ kéē má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
idu_Latn: É le ɛlā olɔhi nwū uwɔ nāa tá, a gē bī unwalu gé lɛ iyī uwɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ ka, a yɛce ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā, a géē nyatá.

eng_Latn: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Ubálāki ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu tútū ō yá aá ā, mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ubálam ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ubéyo tá ɔ̄ ohi lɛ ā. Blakwu ɔdā nōo yá ŋmá ɔwɛ kú Usittím ga Ugígalu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá géē jé úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá, o yá kú um lɛ aá nyatá ā.

eng_Latn: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
idu_Latn: Ebilíi cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu, tíne ō bí unwalu gé lɛ uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Udéfīdi kwu nyɔ̄ í ka ka anúɔ géē gbo ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu áluka á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē tū eko nɛ̄ aá gbɔɔ́ ō cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dā kú aá. Aá klla í lɛ ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ tū eko nɛ̄ aá gē tú īkpɔ̄cí kú aá bá.

eng_Latn: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
idu_Latn: Ó má Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄ ó gaá yɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá má Ɔyálá kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
idu_Latn: Eko nōó yɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ ɛhíícō ā, ń kē má ɔ̄ ŋ́. Eko nōó klla le pīyeyī le tá ɛháajɛ ā, ń kē má ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
idu_Latn: Usára lé iháyí ofahāapa ce ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
idu_Latn: Ɛliyonáyi, Ujaákɔ̄ba, Ujessoháya, Asáya, Adiyélu, Ujésīmiyelu mɛ́mla Ubenáya.

eng_Latn: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni ā kahíníī, Udáni hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Ubássan bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí kú ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ahāanɛ kú ɔyá ɔ́mɛnɛ kú iháyí igwóléyi nɛ̄ Usedekíya ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, é lɛ ɔdɔ kú igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ca kwú bēhé wā ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
idu_Latn: kócōō, Óndú lɛ ɔkɔ nēe í gbā gā awɔ ā pó ŋmá ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ káā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā yálé.

eng_Latn: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
idu_Latn: Ɔgɛ́ɛjí nōo cēyītīkwū nɛ̄hi, géē má ɔdōlé lé. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī kpó eko bónū nɛ̄ ó yá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ɛmiyɛ géē ŋmó ɔ̄, ɛhá klla í kwú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī wī ɔ̄ ā, aá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó ce Óndú ā ɛgbá.

eng_Latn: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
idu_Latn: N kwú igbīhi kú um ú tá ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ī gɔ́ um itali ā. N kē lɛ ábáa kú um tá lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ī fu um ɔnwū agba ā. Ń kē nyɛɛ hɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā tá ŋ́ eko nēé cá um ɛcá, klla ī tá ahɛ klá um eyī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn, mɛ́mla Ujúda, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ɔtū tū uwā ɔtū kéē nyɔ̄ ā, le tútū kéē nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm, gáā lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā túgwó.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá ā. Ipéyī Uféro mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, Árɔ̄ni je okwutɛ ā gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔɔ́ fīyɛ̄ eyī éŋkpɔ̄ kú Unáyilu ā, anɔ́ɔ ísu ā kwú pīya oyī á.

eng_Latn: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
idu_Latn: aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ámɔn da Uhánɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka ɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka ohígbū ojīlīmā kú ádā nū nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā í ce ɔɔ́ abīyē á nóó. É ka amáŋ ɔ́ɔ tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ wā í jila igelī nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ uwā lɔɔlɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ géē wā í lɛ aá kpó ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ klla mīya ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú uwā le tá ipácí kóō gaá le ēpū hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔcí ufáyin kú ipácí má, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ gbɛ́ mɛ́mla ógo apɛ lígíí alɛwa kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ɔ́ kpó hɛ́ tū ipú apɛ nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī he ā, amáŋ ó jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ a ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó le jé ā.

eng_Latn: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ odo mɛ́mla ɔtū kú uwā yá kéē híī jɛ́yí ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. O jāā í kwu ícɛ nyā é ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé klla kōō bī ahɔ̄ kú uwā lɛ pó ɛlā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́futa le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ayí ádā nū, gaá lā Utóbu á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ó lɛ ígwu kú ācɛ oliikpó olɔfú nēe gbɔɔ́ ō yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um gwéeyē tū um eko kú unwalu kú um ŋ́. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gwō ohígbū abɔ̄ kú um nōo wāajɛ nyā ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
idu_Latn: Aá ka kahíníī, É jé ɛga lɛ alɔ ká alɔ yá ɔdā dóódu. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, amáŋ ó wɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu ī tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ ā ŋ́. É je ɛga lɛ alɔ ká alɔ yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu. Amáŋ ó wɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu ī tīile ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔn ā wɛ Ussɔlumíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Usúríssādayi.

eng_Latn: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɔ̄bɔ̄bí he uwɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ɔdā olɔhi á. Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla he uwɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ō ka á.

eng_Latn: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, da um ka anúɔ í gáā je ɔbíipú kú aá nyā yá aá ɛhi gbóógbóō ŋ́ jāā gbēeko nɛ̄ aá kwú.

eng_Latn: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
idu_Latn: É géē nwū uwɔ klla mafú gā uwɔ, ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla okpaakpa wɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ uwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ka ā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔkwu kú ɔkwɛ̄yi nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔdā dúúmā bū wā, a lɔfú bī ohi okpaakpa mla ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gé lɛ uwá glá.

eng_Latn: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó igwó ohile ā lɛ ɛlā ā pó ā, é le kpó cɔ̄nū mla Ujémīsi mla Ujɔ́ni.

eng_Latn: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī gbɛlá ka n wā gaá bī ɛbɔ́ wā ipú ɛcɛ ā ŋ́. Ehé! ń wā gaá bī ɛbɔ́ wā ŋ́, amáŋ n wā í hɛ́ ācɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, olīkpō kú ukɔ́tin ā wɛ uyádi ofucɛhɔ̄. Ó kē lɛ ɔ́kpa igwó mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ o wu ɔ́ nēé í wu kwaajɛ, mɛ́mla uwɔ mɛ́mla ogbló kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
idu_Latn: Ássa géē lɛ ukpɛ́ éyi. Anú í tū ɛjī kwú Udán ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā má ɔ̄cocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwicō ɔ́mpa nū eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī bīyíne nɛ̄ ó ŋmɛ́yí tá ikwū ŋ́, ó cíkā ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo kē í je oyēeyī lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ɛ̄nyā lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe bīyíne nɛ̄ ó ī ŋmɛ́yí tá ikwū ŋ́ mā ā. Amáŋ ó lɛ ínoōbīya nōo ī bī ikwū wā, ń da aá ka aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā, ɛ̄cī nēé í kpó aá ŋmó ā gē wā ɛɛ́. Eko le bá nɛ̄ aá klla gáā bá i yá ucɛ gē tɔ́ɔga ɛyí aɛ́fú ā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ aá géē bá ī dɛ̄ íbá ipú ígbáji.

eng_Latn: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá iyī uwā wāajɛ klla gē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tōō lɔtūce ā, amáŋ, lɛ abɔ̄ wu ajɛ ká ā má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka a géē má ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá?.

eng_Latn: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
idu_Latn: Anyā ā wɛ Umerí Umágādalíni, Ujowána, mɛ́mla Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujémīsi. Uwá mɛ́mla anyā ɔhá le aɔ́dā nēe yá nyā kpó ka lɛ ayíkpó ā.

eng_Latn: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ je gicō gáā yá mla uwá ɛɛ́, amáŋ é má ɔ̄ ŋ́. Óndú, le mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛ ɛlá wu alɔ lɛ ā. Yá ká uwēyī kóō lɛ uwá kwú. Ɔlá nɛ̄ a tútū tá ajɛ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ ā kóō lɛ uwá yi.

eng_Latn: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
idu_Latn: Umáasīya, Ubíligāyi mɛ́mla Ussɛmáya.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ tá Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú alɔ kpó alɔ híla ayīnu lé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí gē yá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, le aɛ́na ahāapa ā kpó ŋmó aflɛ́yí, aálá ahāapa ā gbocē ɔ́, aómlede ahāapa ā gboce ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le oyī kú ɛbɛ́ nēé kpó gwɛ́ɛya ā mī klá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
idu_Latn: Aúcē mɛ́mla aógwugwu mɛ́mla aɔ́tágláma, klla mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ ipácí ɔhá géē lā anú mɛ́ɛ ā. Óndú ā géē je ɔɔ́ fíyákátā, klla í je ɔɔ́ tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ kú nū le ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
idu_Latn: ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēé ma ɔ́ fú lɛ uwá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó le ɔ́ mafú lɛ alɔ nēe wɛ ijáalí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ɛɛ́ mā ā, alɔ nēe lé klla gwá mla anú eko nēé je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá lɛ ɔ́ má cīce ɔkwu ɔcí nēé hī ka óoku ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka anú wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Ujúda á nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ ohi ka, Īī, anúɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, ó lɛ ayíkpó kú nū hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa fu ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
idu_Latn: A híī ŋmó uwá ŋ́ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē je mlanyī. Lɛ uwá fíyákátā mla ɔfú kú uwɔ ā, ká ā lɛ uwá yálé, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo gē gbō alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ Uríya tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē límanya ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, gē cɛ̄ gā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī méyīnyinyi nū ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ̄coŋmɔ́cɛ ɔ́ɔmā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛlu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā dóódu kóō nyɔ̄ gɔbū lɔhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: É le pīyeyī ŋmá ɔwɛ, nɛ̄ n je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē yɛce ā ɛ́ɛ́. É le ɛna kú ugóolu ma, gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɛɛ́. É klla gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́, gé kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aɔ́wɔ kú alɔ nōo kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Amáŋ, N géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú éwo nēé gē cɛ̄ uwā ɛhɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā é géē pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá éwo ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē gba um ɛ̄gbā amānyā.

eng_Latn: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ká owu kóō tá ŋmá ɛ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄cī wā ɛyí aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nāa yá ā géē wā í túkpɛɛ́ɛ́ gā uwɔ, é kē í wā í cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da īyī uwā kahíníī, Alɔ í yá lɔhi ŋ́, ícɛ nyā wɛ ɛ̄cī kú ɔ̄kā olɔhi, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ okónu klá kpɔ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, ōwē géē wā í ce alɔ ɛyí. Ó lɛ ā nɛɛ ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ̄kā nyā ka ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra kwú odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū ú tá kóō klɔ́ɔcɛ́ íne kú Óndú ā, mla ō yɔ̄ í yá klla í lɛ íne ā tū. Ó klla yɔ̄ ī nwū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu odúúdú íne kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú nū dóódu.

eng_Latn: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um wɛ ɛga otayínū kú aúwī mɛ́mla ācohéjulúgwu nɛɛ? Amáŋ n húmáyī má ɔdā nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti mɛ́mla aɔ́dīifa kú ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́. Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɔfú iyē kplákplá, ɔdā dúúmā í yá odóódu kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwá cɛ̄ tɔ̄há, klla le okónu ce tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
idu_Latn: É í gɔ́ īlī olɔhi nɛ̄hi, īlī otīihɔ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɔwɛ̄ gwu tū Ujeremíya agblɔ̄cɛ́ abɔ́ɔ. Ó tá ipú inu nɛ̄ ācogbāajɛ ā gē bá ā abɔ́ɔ. Ɛ̄cī dóódu, é gē bī igbō éyi gē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɛga nēé gē yá igbō ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ igbō ā mɛ ŋmá odúúdú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē lɛ íne kú nū tū, yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla anú, ó kē yɔ̄ ī piyatɔ̄há mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ kē ī bī le jé ko ó yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla alɔ ā, oŋmá lɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ nōó je lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōó ka ā le he uwá ɔtū anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ ka aá géē gbā ije lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Urefidím, ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ōmɛɛtá nēé bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, é gā ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi.

eng_Latn: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ̄nyā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá tútū kéē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā cíkā ō yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá ká ācɛ icɔ́ɔci nēe wɛ ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kéē jɛ̄ ipú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī páhɔ̄ ayíkā ō pó ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé gē pīya tū ā, lɛ ɔtūce Óndú, ɔtū kē he uwá, uwēyī í gāa kwú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Íne nōó bīya nyā cɛ̄ le ajɔ̄ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔgba kú ɔcɛ́ ō lé kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam gaá kwú ŋmɛ́yí mla ífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ akwuna nɛ̄ odúúdú aótrɛyí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā bá ī cikpó nū. Unwū ācɛnyīlɔ nɛ̄ ó ī yá ā klla lɛ ɔ́ bī nyɔ̄ í lɛ īyī nū iyē tēelihɔ ŋmá lɛ aɛ́cí kú Asírīya ō pā.

eng_Latn: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n kwú Ujerúsālɛm ú ká iyē kú um kóō yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, n klla le Udéfīdi fu kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōlé ā kwú átákwū mla ɔkɔ́klɔtū ā ú ce iyɔ̄bū Usɔ́lu á. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu ká ɔ̄ má ɔdā nɛ́ɛ le tū gbēyī nū ā ce iyɔ̄bū nū á. Ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lé, ka ɛ́ɛ le ɔ́ tū gbēyī nū jāā gbéeko ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ géē lé ɔdōlé mla aúgbɔga ā. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɔdōlé lé mla Usámūwɛ̄lu ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
idu_Latn: Lɛ aɛ́pā ā kwú lɛ alɔ. Aɛ́pā nɛncɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā gē je ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú alɔ bīya ā, eko nɛ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō héepū ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nyā Ujísɔ̄si gekwú eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú igelī ā dúú, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ō bī oyī kú nū le alɔ iyē gwu ŋmá íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā.

eng_Latn: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū í lɔfú ipú ɛlā nyā ŋ́ mā, lɛ awɔ nōo ka anúɔ je odée ā má yɔ̄ gē lé ɛbɛ́ ɛcí ipú inu ɛcí. Ɛ̄nyā í gáā lɔfú tū ɔ̄ iyē kóō lé ɔdōlé icɛ̄bɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ipú unwalu, n gē tá iyī um ɔtūlé, ohígbū ka okónu nāa ce gā um ā je oyēeyī gā um á.

eng_Latn: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
idu_Latn: N géē da Ɔwɔicō ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā. N géē hayi iyɔ̄bū nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le pīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ŋmá o lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā. Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔnyā ā bī wā í lā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ inu kú abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔdɔ nōo yɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā tá ā gwó mɛ.

eng_Latn: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
idu_Latn: Olīkpō kú eyīpú ká Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ikpó ofɛta, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu. Olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu cigwó.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka gɔbū ka, Óndú ā nōo wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā, ɔ́ɔ da ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lɛ eyī gwū ɔ̄ bónū klla ī wɔ́tū nū nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo klla wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā kahíníī, Aɔ́cɛ́ géē má aá, kllá í cāŋjɛ lɛ aá, í je ojīlīma ce aá. Aótrɛ̄yí nēe ī gbāajɛ ā klla géē tū ɛyí kpɛɛ́ lɛ aá, í lɛ ojīlīma ce aá. Ó géē yá lɛ ā piíí, ohígbū ka Óndú ā nōo tōō lɔtūce ā, le aá fu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu íkée mɛ́mla eko otɛtɛ. Aá da aádā aá ɔ̄kā kéē da aá ɔdā nōo yá ā. Aá da anyākwɔ́cɛ ɔ̄kā kéē kā aá ɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo yá eko nōo yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī jé ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um má, ɔ́dāŋ ka é gbɛlá pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ nyā géē yá uwá.

eng_Latn: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔwɛ kú alɔ jila má, ká ālɔ̄ má ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kéē blakwu ɛbɛ ō céyi nēé bī eyī kú uwā má, mɛ́mla ɔdā ōhídáagó mɛ́mla úklɔ́ ōhídáagó mɛ́mla abɔ̄ olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ bī lɛ hɛ́ uwā tá ā. Ó ka ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ Óndú ā, bī le kpó ācɛ Íjīpiti yíífi ā nōó gáā bī le yá ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá gē yúúfi uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā lé á.

eng_Latn: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Kwú ɔyī ú kwu ɔtā ká ā kpó abɔ̄ ɔtā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ̄ ɔtā kpó á.

eng_Latn: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá Ujísɔ̄si ohi ka, aá í jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo je íkwu lɛ Ujɔ́ni kóō yá ācɛ ubatísim ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ń kē gáā da aá ɔ̄cɛ nōo je íkwu gā um nɛ̄ n bī yá aɔ́dā nēe bá mbáa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔni lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ Alelékwū Ihɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Amɔ̄si le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uhɛsɛkíya kahíníī, Abɔ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka lɛ á. N le ɔkɔ nāa gbā gā um ohígbū Usenakéribu, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ é bá ī nyɔ̄ inu ā, é da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ī leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ Ujósɛ̄fu ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
idu_Latn: Uládan ma ayí ɛtá: Ujɛ́hīyɛlu, Usetán mɛ́mla Ujówɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá fu kú aá kwú pīya ákú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tīihɔ, ká aá klla he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, aá ményinyi ācɛ, aá gbonɛnɛ, aá tú ɛyí wājɛ, aá bɔ́ ipɔ́tū kú aá, aá kē gbeyīcíí.

eng_Latn: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
idu_Latn: Aá je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ijēnyi gē ŋmó uwá, nēe kwu wā ɛgiyí aá a. Ācɛ kú ajɛ kú Utéma ā, aá je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nēe kwinya ɛfú, nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā.

eng_Latn: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi gēe tá ŋmá Íjīpiti ga Asírīya. Ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄hi ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā í ba í yɛ fu īyī uwa; aéwo ɛpa ɔ́ɔmā í gbā ɔkɔ la Óndú ā tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛmiyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ á, ó cɛgbá ɔdā nōó í lé. Amáŋ eko nēé yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōlé ā, obócádēde gbɔɔ́ ō je ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
idu_Latn: Elitólādi, Ubɛ́tulu, Uhoráma.

eng_Latn: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ocābɔ̄ kú olɔhi kú uwɔ mafú gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwēyī kóō lɛ ācɛ nōo gē tū um eyījii ā kwú. Eko nēē le má ka awɔ lɛ um ɔtū túlé klla le um tábɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igabɔ̄ kú Usenakéribu ā le ɛgba dɛ̄ tá ɔ̄ okónu Uhíbru kahíníī, Aá pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya yɔ̄ í ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó je ajɛ ā lɛ Óndú ā igbīhāajɛ, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē hɛ́ ɔ́lá nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ije kú iháyí nōo hile kú ajɛ ō cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū kú igbɔhá ā lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́lá ā tú wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
idu_Latn: Ó ka íne ā ɔ́ɔ́ yɔ̄ ogbēē ɔhá kú itekwú ŋ́. Ka uwá ɔ́ɔ́ cíkā ō dɔɔ̄ka ka ɔnyɛ í hɛ́ itekwú ā igbó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gaá lɛ íne ā bī gé lɛ aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le pó ahɔ̄ ká aá lɔfú lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ikwū je ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔcí éyi mafú lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ɔcí ā tá ga ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú pīya éŋkpɔ̄ olɔhi ō gwá á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū jámá klla lɛ íne mla ɔ́da je le uwá ka.

eng_Latn: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ŋmá Ugílgalu wā Ubókim gāá da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka amúɔ kwú uwā ú kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu nū lɛ ádáádā uwā ā. Ó ka anúɔ í gáā nyílá ɛka nɛ̄ amúɔ gbo mla uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhɛsɛkíya lɛ ɔ́da je kéē gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú. Abɔ̄ é gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya bōōbū ā, ācɛ bī opo, ɛ̄ngwū, uba, ɔgalúmpɛ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔ́dōbīgwíijē kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō gwííjē ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ ɔkpíye ékpó, alɔ klla kē lɛ ɛdɔ Alelékwū ékpó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce odée nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hī alɔ igwú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē hɛ́ iyī uwā gɛcɛ ŋmá ācɛ ohile, ācɛ nēe gē yá ucē bū ɔdā nēé gē gbɛlá ŋ́ mā ā, é klla lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā í tū ɛ̄cī nōó í kɛpɔ̄ tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ŋ́ mā? Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, í gē má ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ tū ācobīyíne ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu bī īkpɔ̄dā, enyi ɛnwú, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí ólifu mla ɔtulalī le cíla uwɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔmɛɛnɛ klla ī wā, nōo géē lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka oje ā, ohígbū ka oje gē je ɔdā dóódu ca klla ī je ɔ́ pīya ewo bɛ̄ɛka oje o gbɔ̄ɔda nōo gē ca odée klla ī je ɔdā dóódu gbā umu ā.

eng_Latn: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu le hīlatá wāajɛ gaá kwu ɔtū ú bá ɔ̄ ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá híī yúufi ŋ́ ó yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcí nēé hī ka ufígi ā tá uwā ohi ka gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā aá ā, ayíka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ klla gáā gwá īkpō olɔnyɛ kú anúɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, aádáádā alɔ nēe mīyɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā uwā le ɔ́ kpó mla iyī uwā eko nēé yɛ mla Ujóssuwa nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ajɛ kú aéwo nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nū ŋmá ajɛ ā hīla uwá abɔ̄ é yɛ ī wā ā. Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú pīya aóklóbīya mɛ́mla áncɛ́nyā kú aúwī dóódu nɛ̄ aá má ā. Aá klla gē yɛ mla ācɛ nēe ī cikpó anyā nōó wɛ anyā uwā ŋ́.
