eng_Latn: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
idu_Latn: Uhassabíya, Usserebíya, Ujessúwa, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukadimíyɛlu, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ɔ́mpa uwā, yá kéē lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi ohile ā kɔ̄ ígwu ɛpa nēe géē gwíijē ō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ipú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ígwu ɛpɛɛpa gē bā í gwííjē ī cɛ̄tra, klla í tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē jikwū klá um ā? Da ācɛ ā kéē yɛ gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
idu_Latn: Odúúmā kú uwá nōo gē wā ā, gē bī ɛhi kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, anɔ̄, aɔ́nya, otóŋgwō mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aíjakī gé lɛ ɔ́. É gē wā lɛ ā iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, odúúdú ācɛ nēe jé uwɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ, ohígbū ka awɔ, nōo wɛ Óndú ā í gē cīgbīhi kwú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo í wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ká ā tú uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, a le ɛlā nwū ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ɔdā nɛ̄hi, ɛcá nɛ̄ ó gáā cá uwɔ á. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nā tá ɔwɛ, ó lɛ odée yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
idu_Latn: Umídiyan ma ayí ɛhɔ, Ɛ́fa, Ɛ́fɛ, Uhánɔ̄ki, Abída, mɛ́mla Ɛ́ldaa.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi igbɔhá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nāa le tá Íjīpiti, má ka a lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā ō hidáagó dóódu, nɛ̄ n je gā uwɔ ā yá ipéyī Uféro. Amáŋ n géē je ígbɔ́tū lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gā ɛgiyí nū, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā híī nyɔ̄ Íjīpiti ŋ́. Lā ajɛ nɛ̄ n géē ka gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ gwéeyē ka ɔtū kóō he alɔ nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ̄ cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā ā! Eko nɛ̄ Ɔyí álá ā gáā lɛ ɔnyā ā le yá ɛɛ́, ɔnyā nōó gáā lɛ ā kē lɛ īyī nū tútū ī gbēyī nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbú ipú ɔkpá ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛlā nyā nēé ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄. N kahíníī ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī dɔɔ̄kā ka ō wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci, úklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā á.

eng_Latn: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gē mīyɛ ómíci lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa eyī pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē tá ɔyī kú nū lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwá yá ágbe acígilí.

eng_Latn: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
idu_Latn: Ā híī miyɛ ije nēé lɛ ce bá anyākwɔ́cɛ cɛ̄ icííci ŋ́, ń táafu ŋ́, ācɛ ɛpa ámāŋ́ ka ācɛ alɛwa lɛ ijáalí cɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō bī íkókwū kú ejé olɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo kwɛyí ícɔ̄nū kú nū ā abɔ̄. Ó géē pīya anú tū ipú odée, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú gwá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ódūdū le mu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ohígbū ojāglīmā mɛ́mla ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í bēhé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā glá ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aámíyā nɛ̄hi ahāapa nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa bī ā le yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo lé ka Ujéhu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uhanáni. Ɛ̄cī éyi, Óndú ā gaá lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwu Ubássa kóō le da ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ipú iháyí kú ajɛ o je kwúcē lɛ óndú nū, eko nēé géē je odúúdú ajɛ nēé je lá ā cīgbihi lɛ aóndú uwā ā, ajɛ kú ayínɔ̄nyā kú Usɛlofɛ́hādi ā í je pīya ákú ipɔ́ɔma nēé lɛ ɔbá nyɔ̄ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ufu lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú alɔ cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ kóō nyīla bɛ̄ɛka áluka kú ɔjɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbo ɔjɛ áluka glá, ayíka ó géē gbo ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ áluka glá.

eng_Latn: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
idu_Latn: Uwá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ kú Unásārēti ā wā gaá yɔ̄ ī yɛ á.

eng_Latn: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n jikwū klá uwɔ, ká ā lɛ um tábɔ̄. Óndú, awɔ ī gbō um á, awɔ wɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n cɛgbá ipú oyēeyī kú um á.

eng_Latn: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
idu_Latn: N jé ká aá lɛ īkpɛ́yí olɔfú nɛ̄hi, ka ɔtū kú aá klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kē kwú eyī í kwu ɛya mɛ́mla ɛhi nɛ̄ n cɛgbá ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā? Ɛ́lāyi, ɔdíyá nāa le ojīlīma ce ayí uwɔ fíyɛ́ um, anɔ́ɔ a cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le kpó jɔ̄kwū o ŋmá lɛ ō je ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gē bī ge um ā kpó lé ā?.

eng_Latn: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā jɔ̄ɔnyā klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō leyīkwu ɔcɛ́ klla í gwutá pī ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔ́ iyē kwɔ́lá á. Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ í cikpó nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē bī ɔfú kú nū géē hɛ́pɔ̄, klla í na ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā yēŋēē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá gē na oje ā. Ó klla í na ɛpɔ̄bí nɛ̄ Ujerúsālɛm lé ohígbu oyí kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ipú nū ā bónū.

eng_Latn: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ ɔfú kú ínoōbīya nɛɛ aá géē je iyī aá ka aá gekwú ɛ́ɛ́, amáŋ aá yɔ̄ ī yēeyī ī lé tɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō ipú opīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ úklɔ́ kú ācɛ o tá opo, ācɛ o tá ɛ́mula mɛ́mla ācɛ o gwíijē mɛ́mla ɔdōgwíijē ā kéē bī ɔtū ékpó le gwííjē tɔ̄há cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā lɛ ā, Ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔhi ihɔtū opiyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā kú nū yɔ̄ piyóó. Anɔ́ɔ ojuja kwu cē klá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kpímmm.

eng_Latn: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē je aá kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ɛfú ipú ajɛ kú aá nyā piíí ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aá le jé kú ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ŋmífī ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ kú ɛhícō kú Ísrɛ̄lu húmáyī bɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
idu_Latn: A klá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ tú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kpɔ́. Á cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
idu_Latn: Ó da Uhásɛ̄lu, éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā kahíníī, Kwú ɔdɛ̄hi ú káā ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā káā gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ ka n géē wī ŋmá ōcē nyā.

eng_Latn: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
idu_Latn: N jé ka Óndú ā yēeyī ɔkwɛ̄yi! N cɛ̄tra anú nōo gē gbō um ā! N gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ɔwɔicō nōo ī nya um tá ā lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā gaá le ka lɛ ɔbá nū ka Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō éyi ɔ́ɔ wā ɛgīyí anúɔ, ɔ́ɔ tūufi oōmá. Eyī kú nū ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndá ā. Ó ka anúɔ í da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɛga nōó ŋmá ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kē hī iyē kú nū lɛ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá ā, é lɛ úwé kú nū kɔ̄ lɛ iyī uwā ŋmá lɛ ūlī ō tá.

eng_Latn: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya omɛ́ɛbɛ ā le yɛ.

eng_Latn: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhérɔ̄du, óndáajɛ kú Ugálīli, lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ī yá ā pó ā, ó le yá ɔ̄ eyījii nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī bá yɔ̄ í ka ka Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim ɔ́ɔ le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́. Ulúk .

eng_Latn: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā géē wɛ iháyí kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ dúúdú kú ajɛ ā, iháyí nēé kwú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄. Aá gáā nyi ɔdā dúú tū ajɛ ā iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aa géē gwó ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī dúúmā, ɔdōjé dúúmā, ojuju dúúmā, i gáā tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Óndú ā leyī hɛ́ kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
idu_Latn: N klla í kpó aɔ́dā nɛ̄ á ba ŋ́ mā ga awɔ. Ipú odúúdú oyēeyī kú uwɔ, n géē kpó agbénú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā gā awɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔhá dóódu lɛ ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gā ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ á. Ó he Usɔ́lu ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔ̄cɛ o bī iyɔ́fú kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
idu_Latn: O gbolóce ɔ̄cɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu nɛ̄ ó tōō lɔtūce ŋ́ eko kú unwalu mla ámíyā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka o lé ɔdōlé mla ayīnu nōo gáā fu, ámāŋ ka o yāwu mla ikpō obɔ̄bí nōó gáā kwu ajɛ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá ádā nū ohi kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, n húmáyī yúklɔ́ gā uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā iháyí alɛwa. Ń kē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tū uwɔ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Á kē je ɔyí ɛwū ékpó gā um kú ami mɛ́mla aóklóbīya um ka alɔ báajɛ gwéeyē lé ucɛ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ipú aá a aádā géē lé ɛbɛ́ ayí uwā, ayí kē í lé ɛbɛ́ aádā uwá. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá, í yá aá ōwē klla í je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēe hile ā pahīla ga ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
idu_Latn: Aá mā alɔ tá ka alɔ lā ipú ajɛ kú aá, ka aá lɛ alɔ gbō ŋmá ɛga īyī ācɛ nēe tíne ooje alɔ yá ífi a. Ooyaŋmó mla ífi gēe mɛ, ācɛ nēé ka e ba i je ajɛ kú alɔ a yá ífi ŋmá ajɛ nyā gē nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú amɛ̄ ā ú, lɛ ɔ́ jíliyē cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le pīya ɛya nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú Umósīsi ŋmá ipú ɛbɛ́ omlede kú abɔ̄ ō le ce ɛyí kú Árɔ̄n á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú je íne lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
idu_Latn: Méyīnyinyi um, Óndú. Má ōwē mɛ́mla ákanya nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um tū klá um, nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má nyā. Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ikwū, Óndú.

eng_Latn: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
idu_Latn: Ó le yá Upáyílēti eyījii, abɔ̄ ó pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā. Ó le otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́ssɔn ma ayí ɛpa, Ulibíni mɛ́mla Ussímēyi.

eng_Latn: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ebílíi kē ī nū ebilíi tɛ́ɛcɛ, ó lɛ ā ayíka ó yɔ̄ ī nuunu tá īyī nū ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū í gáā háyi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ga ipɔ́lɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū aá. Aá géē má ijakī nēé lɛ wū ɔcí mɛ́mla ɔyí nū yɔ̄ pī ɔ̄. Aá lɛ ɔ́ wī kú aá lɛ uwá kpó gé um.

eng_Latn: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kwu ɔ̄cɛ ā ú ōfōōfūnū gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ójīla, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ayíkābɔ̄ ú wu ɔ́ ahɔ̄, ó lɛ ahɛ tá tū ayíkābɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwú ɔnyīlɔ ā ígblɛ́nyī á.

eng_Latn: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi, Ujéhu, ɔyí kú Uhanáni le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Ujɛhósāfati, ɔcɛ́ gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, A gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa o nyɔ̄ í tá ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo gē wɔ̄tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ nɛɛ? Ɔdā nāa yá nyā cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla awɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́lam ā wɛ, Umɛtánīya, Usekaríya, Ujéhīyelu, Ábudi, Ujérēmɔti mɛ́mla Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ɔdōlé nyā ɛga otīihɔ ā, ohígbū koó wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú aá ŋmá ipú ɛya kú ɔdōlé nēé je lɛ Óndú ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ Óndú ā da um lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔyí um, lɛ ɛlā kú um nyā pó. Cāŋjɛ, ká ā le kwu ga ɛgiyí Ulában, ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ nōo yɔ̄ Uháran ā.

eng_Latn: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō, a nwuné, a klla tūufi, a lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi. A gē lɛ okónu nāa ce mla ācɛ nāa he uwá ɔtū, nēe klla ī lɛyí táajɛ gā awɔ ā, tū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī, kóō tá ɔdōlé kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tū. Ó gē kɔ̄ úklɔ́ lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ahɔ̄lá fú tū ɔ̄, ká aá lɛ ɔtulalī tū ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ɔ́ ú ga ɛyí ede. Alɔ géē má ɔ̄cɛ nōo tīihɔ ā eko ɔ́ɔmā. Aá le yá fíyɛ́ abɔ̄, ayí kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ péee, lɛ iyó kú uwɔ gwó bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ nōo ī nyɔ̄ ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká e má uwɔ. Yá ké e má uwɔ ɔnɔ̄nɛ̄ yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka a gē ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔfú klla gē yálé eko dóódu. kwu ācɛ nēe gē plla ācɛ, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé gē plla ā, bá ipú abɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ami fu aɔ́máapú uwɔ ācɛ Ulífāyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē wɛ ɛhi gā uwɔ á. É kwú uwā ú kpó gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ okónu ce gā um, ka aá í gáā ŋmó ami mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ um, mɛ́mla ádā um, mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami gē je ācɛ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á. Ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um, géē yēeyī, nááná nēé gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē yá aɔ́dā ɛ́gɛ́nyā eko nɛ̄ ɔcí wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, é géē yá ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā eko nɛ̄ ɔcí le ŋmókókó.

eng_Latn: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē yá lɛ ā ohígbū keé wɛ ācɛ otīīhɔ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó klla da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwā fu ŋmá ipú odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
idu_Latn: Ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ n lɛ etikpa kú ɛcɛ kwu ajɛ āa? Ɔ́dāŋ ka a jé ɔdā íbí, da um mɛ́ɛnɛ!.

eng_Latn: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
idu_Latn: N kē jé ka a gē jāhɔ̄ gā um eko dóódu, amáŋ n kɛlā nyā ohígbū ācɛ nēe háyi amānyā ā, kéē cɛ̄ ka awɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ofu cigwó mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ofu cigwó. Ó kwú ayínɔ̄nyā kú nū ā ú kpo lɛ ɔbá ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá, ó lɛ anyā lɛ lɛ ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
idu_Latn: Ébēdi, ɔyí kú Ujónátan ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ádām mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛpa ce igwó.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔfú kú uwā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ā, Óndú, nōo gē yɔ́ɔtū nwula nwula kéē ga iyāwu otīihɔ ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nōo kpó ūwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Ó ka anúɔ géē yá ká ɛ́ɛ lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ igbɔhá bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ wā ɛgiyí ūwā ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
idu_Latn: Ń tíne ojīlīmā kú iyī um ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā ká n̄ lɛ ojīlīmā lɛ. Anú ā gáā hɛ́pɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē je Umówābu yíífi, nōó klla gáā wɛ éwo ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū kóō yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um.

eng_Latn: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
idu_Latn: Aá kwú mlanyi ɛlā ōtɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ɔtūkwɔtū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ayí nū ā nɛɛ? Ó kahíníī, Ɔyí um, ā híī je italā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ī yá uwɔ ā ɔdā nɛ̄ńcɛ̄ ŋ́, eko nōó le uwɔ nā tɔ́ɔ́wɛ ō híī bīya awɔ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó ka eko nɛ́ɛ le tá ajɛ olɔhi, le ɔdōlé lé, le ipú nū ā, ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ klla kwú mlanyī anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ācɛ Umówābu húmáyī lā ɛbɔ́, nēé kpó uwā ga ajɛ kú ɔfíyɛ́ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Umówābu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo yɔ̄ í wú ipú ɔjá pɛ̄túuu ā nɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó le ŋmá lɔhi, klla yɔ̄ ī kpóocu kú nū kpɔ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ éwo kú aá yɔ̄ ī yá lɔhi, klla lɛ abɔ̄ flla tū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;
idu_Latn: N le odúúdú ācɛ ā iyē gwu yēŋēē, ŋmá ucē kú éwɔhá dóódu nēé kpó abɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā. N klla le íne je lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kóō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yúklɔ́ kú nū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
idu_Latn: A wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɛ́nɛ́ ā uwɔ ɔkwɛ́yi. Ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ wɔ́tū ɔbá únū mla ayí nū. A lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā, nēe gē wɔ́tū ɔbá mla ayí uwā dúú ā. Awɔ, mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyā nēe kwɛyí aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ā, lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti, ádā aá kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka aá bá yɔ̄ ī yúufi kú ācɛ Ujúda ɛ́ɛ́ má, ó lɛ ā, aá klla í nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufilístiya, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ Ukéyīla hɛ́tá āā?.

eng_Latn: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ ā, ó jɛga lɛ ācɛ dúúmā bēhé ga inu ā gwū Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla Ujɛ́mīsi, mɛ́mla Ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ kú ɔyí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā mafú ka kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú nū ā klla gē yɛce Ujísɔ̄si kpaakpa ā cíkā ō lɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je ɔ́da lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Uhilkíya mɛ́mla ācɛ ā le yɛ gaá le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛnyā omɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā éyi nōo lé ka Uhúlda nōo lā ɔlɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ɔbá nū lé ka Ussálum, ɔyí kú Utokáti, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uhasíra nōo gē leyīkwu úwé mɛ́mla awulú nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni kē yɔ̄ gē yá ācɛ ubatísim dúú Ayénɔn nōo yɔ̄ kwu Usálim ajaajɛ ā, ohígbū ka éŋkpɔ̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ íbí. Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa wā ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni abɔ́ɔ, ó kē yá uwā ubatísim.

eng_Latn: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unaómi da Urútu ka ɔnyā kú ɔyínɛ́ ɔbá nū ɔ́ɔ le cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ā, ɔ́ɔ le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́futa le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn kéē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí wɛ unwalu kú aá mɛ́mla anú ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wā í nuunu tá ācɛ ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
idu_Latn: Ó gbo ɛ̄cī alɛwa ŋ́, ɔyí nɛŋcɛ́ ā kwú ukpɛ̄ kú agbénú kú nū ú kpó lá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ije ā ú nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ á. Ó le tá ɔlɛ́ ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi, ɛga nōó kwú ije ā í ŋmó bónū oŋmá lɛ o lā oyēeyī oŋmó ije bónū icííci.

eng_Latn: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí ga ayááyí géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. É kē í bá í kɛlā kú Óndú ā lɛ ayí nēé géē ma ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā.

eng_Latn: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ í yɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ āyā kú iyē kú alɔ nōó lɔfú ŋ́ tū alɔ ā í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
idu_Latn: Aá géē kpó odúúdú īkpō kú ɔcí gā um bɛ̄ɛka odée kú ɛya gā um kóō wɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gwó tá um ahínyá á.

eng_Latn: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā ɛpa géē yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄dā ɛgɔ̄ tɔ̄hā. É géē je éyi kú uwā nyɛ̄ɛ̄, é kē í habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā tá.

eng_Latn: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka íne kú Umósīsi í yá ɔdā dúúmā jīla glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō le yá kú ālɔ̄ leyīce ɔdā nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́, nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ túblá Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī gbō aɔ́dāajɛ kú ohilí nū Ujɛ́tro nōo wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ācɛ Umídiyan ā. Ó le aɔ́dāajɛ ā kpó le hɛ́ ígbíli igbó, anɔ́ɔ é gā ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu nōo wɛ ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ka ɛdɔ aɛ́bɛ́ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí, ɛnɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kéē wā í bá ipú ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú uwá nēe tɛtɛ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā géē kpó héyī ŋmá ipú únóji. Ācɛ ōhī kú uwá géē nyɔ̄ í yēeyī piyóó, ācɛ ɔhá ā géē nyɔ̄ ipú ōwē mɛ́mla uwēyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
idu_Latn: Ó pa aɛ́cí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē lé ɔdōlé kú ɛya nēé gwó lɛ ɛcí ā ŋ́. O kē ce ikpó anyā ācɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ŋ́ tá ō je ɔdā ōtīihɔ nōó cíkā ō je lɛ Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́, ó le íne bīya. Ó géē bī omlede ámāŋ opī nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ gé lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé. Ɔlá kú nū géē wɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́lá kú nū Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ cíkā ō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā Ulɔ́tu le ayí nu nɔ̄nyā ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā jipú.

eng_Latn: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, eko nēé le uwɔ hīgwú, nyɔ̄ gaá cīce ɛga nōo tū wāajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo hī aá igwú ā kóō wā ɛgiyí aá gaá da uwɔ kahíníī, Wā icō amānyā, oklóbīya um, ga ɛga o lɔhi fíyɛ́ nyā. Ɛ̄nyā géē bī ojīlīmā gē lɛ aá ipéyī ācɛ ohile nēé hīgwú dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í le ɔ̄kā da ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kē le he ɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
idu_Latn: A le má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá um ŋmó lɛ āa, mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ōwē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nɛ̄ n ma āa. A jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nɛ̄ é yá um ipú Ántiyɔ̄ku, Ikoniyium mɛ́mla Ulistra ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ e yá um ŋmó bɔ̄bíbɔ̄bí lɛ a! Amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú odúúdú uwā kpɛ́m.

eng_Latn: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ n gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Aá gbɛlá ka ɛ̄nyā í yá kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ohígbū ka ācɛ géē má ɔ̄ péee ka Ɔwɔicō gē yá ɔdōlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ ā jeyī má icō anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Īī, n gē má ācɛ, amáŋ é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēe bá ī yāwu ā.

eng_Latn: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
idu_Latn: N da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ipéyī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ka anúɔ wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um. Ami, Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bu aálelékwū-ōtɛhɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ka n jé ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kahíníī, N lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá ígbíli kú Ukɛdɛmɔ́tū gaá fu ɔcɛ́ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn ipú ɛbɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
idu_Latn: É ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gē le tayínū ā. É kē ī cɛ̄tra aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛyí kú aɔ́dā ō tayínū nēé gē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ péee ā.

eng_Latn: Go and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ujeremíya, da Ɛbɛdimɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cɛ Itiyópīya ā, ka ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísraɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ka n géē yá a, n géē je igelī nyā yíífi. Ó wɛ ɔdōōlɔhi nɛ̄ n gáā yá igelī nyā ā ŋ́. Eko nōó í yá ā, a kē í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ géē má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
idu_Latn: Icíícɔ́mā piíí ā Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ā gaá yāajɛ okónu ísu.

eng_Latn: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
idu_Latn: É le odúúdú iyē kú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tá tū ipú ɔkpá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā bá ipú ɔkpá kú aɔ́cɛ́ lɛ ā. É le ācɛ kú Ujúda kpó ga Ubábīlɔn ŋmá ajɛ kú uwá ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā.

eng_Latn: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aéwoɔhá nēe lā kwu aá jīla tá nēe géē hile ā géē jé ka ami, Óndú ā, gē tū alácɛ̄ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi gwó klla í hí í nyi ipú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ nēe le mu ácí ā. Ami Óndú ā lɛ okónu ce ka n géē yá ɛnya ɛɛ́, n kē í yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ā, aá gáā má um gɛ ŋ́, eko kpií ɔhá kpɔ́, aá géē má um.

eng_Latn: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā jé odúúdú ujɔ̄ nēé tū gáā ŋmó um ā. Ā híī je ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ā yá uwā ɛhi ŋ́. A kē híī je ínōbīya kú uwā yá uwā ɛhi ŋ́. Lɛ uwá bīyatāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā bī ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ le yá mla uwá.

eng_Latn: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyābu ɔ́kplá kú nū ā le pó abɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ í kɛlā mla ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɛlíyābu le cɔ̄nū mla Udéfīdi nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ wā abɔ́ɔ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɔ́ɔ habɔ̄ aálá o hile lígíi ɔ́ɔmā tá lɛ ɔ́ ipácí ɛ́ɛ́, nɔ́ɔ gē wā amanyā ā? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ jé ikpɔ́tū kú nū mla ɔdā ō je cɛyí kú nū, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ wā abɔ́ɔ gaá má ɛfú nēé yɔ̄ ī kpó ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli ā, é le ācɛ ā bī tá ga ɔwɛ mɛ́mla aíjakī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujótam gē yúúfi ɔyínɛ́ nū Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ā, ó le kwu gāá lā Ubíyɛ.

eng_Latn: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú uwɔ í gáā lé ka Ébram ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē lé ka Ébrahām, ohígbū ka n le uwɔ pīya ádā kú aéwo alɛwa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄hi ɔhá le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ipú ɔkpáncō á. Ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi éyi yɔ̄, nōo wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá, kē lɛ ɛyí ahāapa mɛ́mla ajī igwó. Ó klla lɛ ukata kwu éyééye kú aɛ́yí ahāapa ā.

eng_Latn: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛga amānyā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú n̄ yúklɔ́ ō tīile, nááná nɛ̄ aólɛlā alɛwa bā kéē ci um úklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi, amáŋ alɔ í jé ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le tá ipú inu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛwū éyi ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ he, klla bī okoolo kú umu igwó lɛ igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā yá. Ó kwú ɛbɛ́ ā ú kpó tū ómblí klla kwu igbō ā ú kpó tū ipú ɛbɛ́ ā, le bī gé lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ɔkwu ɔcí kú óoku abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ nɛ̄ ó yá ā kē he um ɔtū. Ɔtū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kē he um.

eng_Latn: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
idu_Latn: Ā híī kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá um ā, n géē yá ɔ̄ piíí, ámāŋ ka, N géē cílá anú ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá um ā piíí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
idu_Latn: Olíla dúúmā nōo mīyɛ abɔ̄ kú ulé kú ugbɔga ka anúɔ géē cílá, cíkā nēé gē je odúúdú agbénú kú nū kpó kwɛyí ulé ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔkpacaŋgelī kú aá pi wu abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbō ɔcɛ́, Ujówāsi ɛyí, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Aá le ɔ́ jīla tá. Aá nyɔ̄ mla anú ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ó gē nyɔ̄ ā, kwu inu kwu ɛcɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo túbla aá, áa lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó bōōbū.

eng_Latn: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
idu_Latn: N le ɔdā nōo lɔhi klla le kpaakpa ā yá ɛɛ́, á híī habɔ̄ um tá lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá um ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, le da ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya, ka ɔdā nyā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛ ɔɔ́ á. Da ɔ́ ka, Abɔ̄ ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ le mu uwɔ ipú hile ā, a ka anúɔ wɛ ɔwɔ nɛ. A ka anúɔ cīce akpa ɔcɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā, aísu ɔ́ɔ kē le yɛ anúɔ jīla tá biílí. A lɔfú ka ka, anúɔ wɛ ɔwɔ glá, amáŋ á kē wɛ ɔwɔ ŋ́. A wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu, nōo lɛ ɔkpíyē gē kwú ā, nááná nāa gbɛlá ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ jéeyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛ alɔ pīya tɔ̄há mla anú ipú ikwū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú nū ā, é géē pīya alɔ tɔ̄hā mla anú ipú ohéyī ŋmá ɔlékwū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú nū piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a gē ka ɔdā tū Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ̄ tóohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā cɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ Uhámɔ mɛ́mla Ussɛ́kɛm bī wā ā, anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā apī kpó hɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Áá mɔ́ɔ̄. N kwú ikpíinu olɔfú nɛ̄hi í tá ajɛ Usáyɔn ɛɛ́. Ɛcɔ̄ nōo kē gáā kwajɛ kpɔ́cíí kú ikpíinu ā kē wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ nēé le jámá, nōo kē tōō kpɔ́tūce. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce ɔɔ́, uwēyī gáā kwú ɔ̄ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
idu_Latn: N géē yíihɔtū tá Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó ī pó ɔkɔ kú um, ó gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n je tú ɔ̄ kóō tá um abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔ́ɔlá ɔhá nēé gbā ā mɛ́mla aígbɔ́cí kú usɛ́da, nēé gbā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ miya uwá táajɛ lɛ ā, nēé bī le hɛ́ ɔdɔ kú aínu ā gicō kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó le lɛ ā, ayíka a mafú ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīmā klla lɛ ojīlīma. Le mafú ka anúɔ nwuné, ācɛ ɔ́ɔ kē ­ī le ojīlīmā ce anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīmā kú Ujésiríili le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu tá tū ɔkpá gé lɛ uwá ā yá ā á.

eng_Latn: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ikwū le yɛ jīla um tá bɛ̄ɛka ukpa ā. Ɔnɔ kú ikwū kē le um kwú. Ufi gē yá um, ɔtū kú um klla plicō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Lɛ iyē kú Árɔ̄ni tá tū okwutɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi. Ohígbū ka okwutɛ éyi géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma dóódu.

eng_Latn: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē gbō ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā klla í lɛ oyēeyī kú uwā tū. Óndú ā géē yá kóō gwéeyē ipú ajɛ ā. Ó gáā mā ɔ̄ tá ipú abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́máapú um mɛ́mla aóklóbīya um le pɛ́ kwu hɛ̄ um tá.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā gē yá ka ígbíli kóō jíliyē. Ó ī jīla ígbíli kú Ukádɛssi iyē dúú.

eng_Latn: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it not into his mind?
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka Ɔwɔicō í jé lɛyíkwu ɔtulālī nɛ̄ aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú aá, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aá, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá gē le kwu ɔlá lɛ aɛ́cí ipú aígelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, klla gbɛlá kwu ɔ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka aá, Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi, tá kóō yɛce Óndú ā abālɔbányā, ó géē mā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá ipú ígbíli, é géē je kpó yíífi. Ífi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē í ce aá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhābu ce ɛlā kú uwā, le uwá tá úŋmóō á. Eko nēé le yɛ ā, ó kwú īlī nɔ̄wá gbō playi uwíndo kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ú tá agbá, ohígbū ka é jé ɔdā nēé géē yá ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aa kwú mlanyī Ɔwɔicō nōo hɛ́ aa tá klá í gbō aa, lɛ aa tū bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ a; okɔkɔ nɛ̄ aa gēe gbā ɔkɔ la ɔɔ á, aa gēe gbā ɔkɔ la ɔwɔ nɛ̄ aa hɛ́ tū bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú éwɔhá a.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwā hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, ohígbū koó wɛ abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa ā cokónu á.

eng_Latn: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le ɔkɔ gbā kwɛyí ā, ɔlá ŋmá ɔkpáncō gāajɛ gaá kwú iyó ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā mla ɛya nēé gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ú kpó yi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ ɔlá ō ceyī ŋmáŋmáŋmá kú ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō le mu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri ā, mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébulɔn. Ujókníim, Ukárati.

eng_Latn: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó klla í bī ɔyí ɔbá ɛna éyi, álá éyi, mɛ́mla omlede kú iháyí éyi, kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya kahíníī, Ɔkpáncō, gwéeyē, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́ yá ɛɛ́. Ajɛ, tɔ́ɔga gbōmgbōm. Aɛ́fu mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́cí nōo bá ipú ūpū ā, ijē kóō kwu aá okónu dúú. Ohígbū kú Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́tá ɛɛ́, é klla géē cɛ̄tra anú ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú Ahítōfɛlu ā le he Ábsālɔm mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ɛlífāasi wɛ, Utéman, Ómaru, Úsefi, Ugátam, Ukénasi, Utímna mɛ́mla Ámālɛ̄ki ā.

eng_Latn: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yá okónu nɛ̄ aá ce ā jīla ŋ́, ó wɛ íne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ aá bīya á. Aá le jé ka ɔkwu kú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā í wɛ̄ɛcɛ, é kē í yá aá italā ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nōó cɛ̄ nōó klla cɛ̄ ka anúɔ géē bī éŋkpɔ̄ gé lɛ aínyankwūlūmī kú um, ayíka anú nɛ̄ a fu kóō wɛ ɔnyā kú ɔyínɔ̄yilɔ kú ɔkpani um á.

eng_Latn: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē wɔ́tū ɔdā olɔhi, klla ī yíihɔtū kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Aá nēe le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um wá ɔkpá oyēeyī klla lɛ ícɛ̄bɛ́ wā ŋmá ikpokwú kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá jé Ulában, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Unáhɔ? É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ jé ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Usɔ́ɔlu éyi yɔ̄ nēé hī iye nū ka Usíba. É le da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ eko nōó ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ā, Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ Usíba áā? Anɔ́ɔ Usíba lɛ ɔgbá tá ɔ̄ ka anúɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
idu_Latn: É kē í lā ipú abahi, klla í jɛ̄ gɔbū. Ayí uwā géē lɛ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ Óndú ā, ó géē lɛ ɔ́ gbā umuumu piíí. Ó í lɛ anɔ̄ kú īkpō ɔcí nēé hī ólīifu ā mɛ́mla ɔtulalī tū ɔ̄ piíí.

eng_Latn: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ācɛ ōhī gē táafú ka, aá kóō yá ɔdōbɔ́bí kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɛ o lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ā. Ācɛ ōhī le ɛcá cá um ɔkwɛ̄yi, é le ije cē bá um ka ami ɔ́ɔ bī ɛlā nyā tɔ́ɔna piíí á! Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ uwá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, ɛdɔ nōo cíkā lɛ uwá āa.

eng_Latn: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD's house.
idu_Latn: Aá géē ka ka, É lɛ uwēyī je lɛ alɔ lɛ alɔ yá ɛflɛ́ɛfu ɛɛ́. Alɔ í yá ɔdā dúúmā glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ aéwɔhá le behé tá aɛ́ga otīhɔ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōó yɔ̄ mɛ́mla um ŋ́, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɛ́yíkwu um. Ɔ̄cɛ nōó kē tú ɔ̄ bá mɛ́mla um ŋ́, gē fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ákátā.

eng_Latn: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū ú lá ɔfiyɛ ā, é gáā hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
idu_Latn: Kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ ācɛ i gáā má obɔ̄bí dúú anú ŋ́ cɛ́ɛ́ aólɛlā kú uwɔ kéē má obɔ̄bí dúú ka lɛyíkwu uwɔ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwēyī kóō lɛ uwá kwu ohígbū ɛyí nɛ̄ é bú kwu uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ lɔtūce ā kéē kɛlā glá ŋ́. Ó klla gē je ohílīpú ŋmá ɛgiyí anyākwɔ́cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō wɛ Ádā aá á, n géē yɛ í he aá ɔtū, ohígbū ka n ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō bōōbū wā, ń bī ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī um wā nóó, amáŋ anú tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, kwú ɔtū kú nū ú pīyabɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó ka, Ɔdā nāa má ā, í gáā yá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
idu_Latn: N le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ inu a gwu, kéē klla lɛ iyó ō bī yúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ɛhi kú īkpɔ̄dɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī ā, kpó kwúcē wā í bá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And the elders of that city shall take that man and chastise him;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, géē lɛ ɔbá ɔyí nū ā kwú lɛ ɔɔ́ gɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū yá Ujísɔ̄si okónu klla yá ɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ Uhérɔ̄du cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū lɛ awulú olɔhi kpó klá ɔ́ iyē, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ́ ú kwúcē gé lɛ Upáyílēti á.

eng_Latn: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛcɛ lɛ ɔnyā a tábɔ̄. Ajɛ lɛ okónu nwúla anɔ́ɔ ó kwú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ŋmá okónu kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā í mlɛ á.

eng_Latn: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le cīgbīhi mla anú ga Ugíligalu á. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ī lā oyēeyī kú nū ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le tá ipú unwalu, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bī ikpó abɔ̄yī nū gaá gwōtū ukpa, nɛ̄ ukpa ā kē ī kwú ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ jīla ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɔwɛ, nōo da alɔ ka ālɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ̄ kwúcē gaá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka ā da uwɔ. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ́ yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ, nɛ̄ awɔ gē tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá da Ubáalsébubu, ɛcí mɛ́mla ɔwɔ kú Ékrɔn ɔ̄kā á mɛ́ɛ̄ ā ŋ́? Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, awɔ ɔ́ɔ̄ gáā wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí agōdō ōcē kú uwɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ géē kwú piíí.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eliká kú ugóolu nēé géē bī le je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ kē bī ɔ̄ ī yɛ ā yá kwu ikpó ɛnɛnɛ́ɛnɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú eliká ɛpɛɛpa kóō bá abɔ̄ éyééye.

eng_Latn: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
idu_Latn: Ujúda nááná ā í le íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwá tū ŋ́ dúú. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ bɔ́tū ā nēé yɛce á.

eng_Latn: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē í je uwá yɔlá ā, géē na īlī kú nū klla í gwīiyē, ɛ́ɛ́ ka ó wā ipú ɛga nēé lā ā.

eng_Latn: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tá ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jāhɔ̄ gā um, eko nɛ̄ n gē kɛlā lɛ uwá, ká n̄ pī uwá ahɔ̄ ā ŋ́. É ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú klla tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ a tū um fu uwá ā. É gē yɛhɛ tū olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ a tū um ka amíyɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ā. Ó klla he uwá ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá kóō lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔdā nɛ̄ a lɛ ā lɔfulɔfu jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n cīgbīhi wā.

eng_Latn: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔtū lɛ uwá kéē lɛ um jé, ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. É géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, ohígbū ka é géē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um ŋmá odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe gē gbāajɛ kú ɛga okpó iyó tū nōo yɔ̄ okómpíinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bá yɔ̄ á: Umataníya, Ubakibukíya, Obadáya, Uméssūlam, Utálimɔn mɛ́mla Ákɔ̄bu.

eng_Latn: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú úkpɛ̄cí kú aá ā ú háyi igbīhi odūngwɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá. Aá kwú mlanyī um, kwú īlī kú aá í plla, le icō agōdō olɔwá kú aá ā tū mɛ́mla anyā nɛ̄ aá ī gbā ije lɛ uwā kú aá cikpó uwā ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ unwū kú aá da aá á.

eng_Latn: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhúram klla lɛ ítēbulu nōo lɛ akā igwó ma ŋmá oje udɔ á. Olīkpō kú éyééye kú uwá ā wɛ ikpó ɛhīlī, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ, ikpó ɛhīlī, anɔ́ɔ o licō kú nū kē wɛ ikpó ɛnɛ ce āyā.

eng_Latn: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ n lɛ uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, é lɛ ɛlá wu um ŋ́. É kōō ka ka iní nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo kpó alɔ trɛ̄yí bū ipú ígbíli nōo wɛ ajɛ kú úmúlá mɛ́mla aɔ́gɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Óndú nōo kpó uwā ŋmá ajɛ nōo le ŋmíkpākplā klla bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔtū bū ipú ígbíli ɔ́ɔmā jéjéē, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī lā anú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ īkpō ā le jé, ɔgílɛjí ā bī ɛwa gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ ɔ̄, ohígbū ka eko o cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ le yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o gbō ɔ́wá kú aókóome ā le kwu nyɔ̄ gaá le ɔ̄kā ā ca klɛ́ɛcɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́ga nɛ̄ ācɛ o hɛ́hɔ̄ bá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ka lɛ odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je á.

eng_Latn: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
idu_Latn: Ó le yá kú ācɛ dóódu nēe kwú uwā aɔ́fiyɛ ā, kéē ményinyi uwā.

eng_Latn: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī yúúfi ācɛ nēe gē ŋmó ɔkpíyē, amáŋ nēé lɔfú ŋmó odo glá ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá yúúfi ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɔfú ī je odo mɛ́mla ɔkpíyē yíifi ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ glá ā.

eng_Latn: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ géē lɔfú le kpaakpa, klla le yēŋēē ipéyī Ɔwɔicō glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔdā nēe ī gbɛlá ā jé ā, ó kahíníī, Ɔtū ō kpóce Ɔwɔicō kú aá nyɛ́ íbí. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī ka mɛ́mla īyī aá ka aá lɛ igbō ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
idu_Latn: É kōō lɛ ipú pi yɛ ajɛ oo, ámāŋ kéē ī yɛ ikpó ɛnɛ oo, ámāŋ keé lɛ ikpó alɛwā.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da ɔyípɛ ā kahíníī, Kwú wā fíyaa, ā gbojī nóó. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípɛ̄ ā le ɔyī ā kpó jāā wā kwú uwā ú kpó gé lɛ Ujonátan á.

eng_Latn: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
idu_Latn: N má aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa nēe gē māháyi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ opo ahāapa kpó lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uménāhem gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ́ ú nyi á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Upekāhiya le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
idu_Latn: Lɛ italā kú ɔdā nēé yá ā yá uwā. Lɛ italā kú ucē nēé yá kpɛ́mm ā yá uwā. Kwú ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ uwā ā ú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ cɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī ka lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā. Amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ aá gē ka nyā í lɛ ā ŋ́. Ó ma ɔkwɛ̄yi ā fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄ ō gē gbō aógbɛhá ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá, ámāŋ ka ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī tōōji kóō kwú ɛbɛ́ lé ā.

eng_Latn: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ Ɛlkána le ɛya kú nū gwó lɛ Óndú ā nɛɛ, ó gē je āyā kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú nū éyi lɛ Upɛnína. Ó klla gē je āyā éyééye lɛ ayí nū dóódu, amáŋ ó gē je āyā ékpónú lɛ Uhána.

eng_Latn: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi kɛ̄ɛ.

eng_Latn: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
idu_Latn: É bɔ̄bí klla tūufi nɛ̄hi. Ipú ɔbɔ́cɛ kú uwā ā, ɔdā nōo he uwá ɔtū ā nēé gē yá á, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í ci uwá anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
idu_Latn: Īlī ukɔ́tin kú áklō kú ɛga o bēé wā inu ā kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ekābɔ̄ ɛtá mɛ́mla ogbló mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ á yúúfi ō bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ le ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu, lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ō le tū agege, mɛ́mla anɔ̄ ō tīihɔ, mɛ́mla ɔtulali umuumu okpóocu kpó wā.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
idu_Latn: Aá híī méyīgoo je ɛpɔ̄ pīyeyī klá ajɛ eko nēé gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cogbɛhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
idu_Latn: Anú mla aícɔ́ɔja olɔnɔɔtū nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā géē wā í je ajɛ Íjīpiti ā wúla tāajɛ dúúdú. É í kpó ɔkpacaŋ́gelī le kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Íjīpiti, kē í ŋmó ācɛ, nɛ̄ okwū í bá ɛbɛɛbɛ láyí ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nōo ī pɛ́ úgbéenyi ā da íyī uwā kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ūlī tá, ká ālɔ̄ jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú nū ī bī unwalu nyā gé lɛ alɔ ā. É le ūlī tá, anɔ́ɔ ūlī le Ujóna kwú á.

eng_Latn: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄na nā, anɔ́ɔ ó má agidigbé nōo ŋmá ajɛ ga ɔkpáncō. Ó má aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ bá ī gbo agidigbé gicō klla bá ī gbo ɔ́ wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú ɛcɛ amānyā alɔ í lɛ igelī nɛ̄ alɔ ī lā piyóó glá ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ gē tíne igelī nōo gē wā ā.

eng_Latn: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
idu_Latn: Ɔdī nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ álá ofɛhɔ̄ géē yá, ɔ́dāŋ ka éyi kú álá ā le héyībí āa? Ó gáā habɔ̄ ofɛnɛ cigwáhāanɛ ā tá ɛyí ɛfu kóō nyɔ̄ í tíne ɛ̄nɛ̄ o bī ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú cɔ̄nū mla Ákisi klla da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ kwúcē ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɔ́ɔ je lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ga ɔgbɛ́fú mla aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú je eyī pīya kwu aá ɔgbɛ́fú ā glá. Ɔwɛ nyā klla yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ ɛlā nū klla í he ɔkpáni nū ɔtū igbɔhá fíyɛ́ ō kpó aá lɛ ɔkpáni nū ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nēé mafú gā um nyā, lɔfú yá ká n̄ je iyī um gicō nwunééné glá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ híīī je iyī um gicō ŋ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ōcē kú ɔkpíye nōo lɔnɔ bɛ̄ɛka ujē ō kwu ācɛ úklɔ́ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā í kwu um áklō. Ōcē nyā gē yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ebilíi kóō yá ká n̄ je iyī um gicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé yá kpɛ́mm ā mla ɔdā nēé nwū ācɛ ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
idu_Latn: Efūma nyā kwú ēpū, ɔcí mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ú kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēe kē yɔ̄ í ma ɔdɔ ā lɛ ɛ̄wā kú nū tūlé wu ɛ́nyɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē tá opo ɛfú ā, kē klá pī um.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da uwá kéē lɛ odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ubáalu ā kpó kwú. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá kwu ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó kwú á. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja le uwá kpó wā ɔkpá kú Ukíssɔn gaá lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā, lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā ɔkwɛyi nēé nwū uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ a miyɛ cɛ̄ ā kli, abɔ̄ a jé ācɛ nēe nwū uwɔ aɔ́dā nēe bá āa.

eng_Latn: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
idu_Latn: Olɔhi nāa tútū lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yúufi uwɔ klla ī lɛ ojīlīma ce uwɔ ā nwuné nɛ̄hi. Odúúdú ācɛ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔhi lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē gbō ācɛ dóódu nēe lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ kpaakpa ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abígɛ̄lu kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nyɔ̄ í tá Unábalu, nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɛdɔ kú ucɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē yá glá ā. Ó lɛ ejé gwá mu eyī, anɔ́ɔ Abígɛ̄lu í ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, jāā gbó oŋmá ɔ̄cī nū á.

eng_Latn: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
idu_Latn: N gáā gwōnū ɛɛ́, n kē yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
idu_Latn: É le tútū kéē kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubɛ́njamīn. Anɔ́ɔ é le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kpó kwāajɛ leyīkwū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugíbɛya.

eng_Latn: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ā, ācɛ géē wā í tá ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā abɔ̄ lígílígí. Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī nēe géē wā í tá uwā abɔ̄ ā géē bá ī yá ula í yá ákú ɔtū kú abɔ̄yī uwā icííci.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
idu_Latn: Éwo dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwā kéē gwéeyē. Ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ uwá fu kéē wɛ ákú nū ā gwéeyē n.

eng_Latn: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā, lɛ oyēeyī nyā, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́, í lɛ oyēeyī nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kē lā okónu kú ísu ā, kéē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
idu_Latn: Usopéta, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ubéríya, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Upírɔ̄si mɛ́mla Arístākɔsi mɛ́mla Usekóndɔsi, ācɛ kú Utesalónīka mɛ́mla Ugáyɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ kú Udábi mɛ́mla Utímōti, mɛ́mla Utayikíkɔ̄si mɛ́mla Utrofímɔ̄si, ācɛ kú Ésīya, tīkpó mla anú.

eng_Latn: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ébrahām, mɛ́mla odúúdú aílɔ́wá nēe bá ipú aá, nēe ī gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā a. Alɔ nēé tū olɛhɔ̄ nōo ī nya ɔ̄cɛ tá nyā fu alɔ á!.

eng_Latn: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unáaman lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ā, ó le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gaá le ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, awɔ nōo ce ɔcɛ́ ɔkpáncō ā, nɛ̄ n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usáyímɔ̄ni Upíta kwūcē ɔ́ wā, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipú únóji ā. Ó má īlī ahilíki nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé le gbō ɔ̄ ā bá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
idu_Latn: Koócōō lɛ ɔkɔ nōó gbā ā pó ɔkpáncō, nɛ̄ a lā ā, ká ā kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄. Awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ jé ɛlá nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē gbo ipú kú nū á. Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, yá mla ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ le yá lɛ ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē tū ɔwɔ kóō yā tū ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā eko nōo cɛgbá āa. Ɔwɔ aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɔwɔ kú igbīhāajɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā.

eng_Latn: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: É kwú ede nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔládúúdú ɛyí nū ā ú háyi iyɔ̄bū ukɔ́tin ā. É le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā gwó ɛyí nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lé ucɛ otīihɔ nēe bá nyā eko kú nū.

eng_Latn: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā ményinyi um, ká ā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē nyā kú n̄ lɛ óluma cílá uwá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
idu_Latn: Eko, nɛ̄ odúúdú uwá kwú bēhé ga ogbeé ɔhá ā, ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gaá gbɔbū lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Amānyā, n géē yá ka odúúdú ojuju kú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā kóō le pīya áncā. N géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā yá uwá lé klla í kpó uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú amānyā. N kē í yá kú aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí kéē kwú aókwū kú uwā kpó lé.

eng_Latn: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ododó gē kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ ujē ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cohumɔtū ā lɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú anyā ohile á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests' offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ dóódu, nōo géē hile ā géē nyɔ̄ í ba ije ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā kóō bī le lá ɔdōlé lé. Ó klla í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɛga je lɛ anúɔ kú anúɔ tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ipú úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē yɔ̄ í yá ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ ɔdōlé má lé.

eng_Latn: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ā, í gbolóce íjééyī kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ó gbolóce ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: úlā ɛhīlī ce ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce ofɛpa ce igwó .

eng_Latn: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ukádɛssi gaá lā ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ru kwu okónu ogwu kú Ɛ́dɔm ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ iyē kwu okwū géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɛhi nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kpó ŋmá ɛfú nēé yálé gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jāāhɔ gā um, odúúdú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ā jé.

eng_Latn: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
idu_Latn: Ámáŋ aá gbɛlá kwu aúgbéényi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é nwuné nɛ̄hi ā, nɛ̄ owu olɔfu nɛ̄hi kē ī pɛ́ ɔ̄ ā, nááná, óci nɛŋ́cɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄copúgbényi ā ī bī le nā ɔ̄ tá ɔwɛ ga ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ó tíne á.

eng_Latn: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká nōo bá īlī nēé bī owú wu, amáŋ īlī nēé tá ɔcí, mɛ́mla īlī kú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē jé ɔ́dāŋ koó le ɔdōwiyē ō tēelihɔ ámāŋ koó le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ le pɛ́ gla ísu nōo yɔ̄ eyī ánūmā kú Usilísiya mɛ́mla Upamfilíya ā, alɔ gā Umayíra kú Ulisíya.

eng_Latn: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē gbonɛnɛ lɛ a ā, ó kōō gáā yá ācɛ dóódu nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē je ɔlá nōo kwu agege lígíi ā nyí ŋ́. Ó klla géē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa kú ucɛ ā, ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī gwéejé nɛ̄hi mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aídibo ahāapa nēe gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā kpó hīīgwú. É wɛ Uméhūman, Ubísita, Uhabóna, Ubígita, Abágita, Ussɛ́ta mɛ́mla Ukákasi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
idu_Latn: N pó alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nyā géē yá ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ɛ̄cī úlā ɛhɔ̄ cofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, nēé gáā gwɛ́ɛya ŋ́ má. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú kwúcē wā āhɔ̄ nōó tɛtɛ wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti tɔ́kpá nyā fu ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ipú icɔ́ɔci kú Utesaloníka ā. Alɔ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ádā ā mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ɔwɔicō kóō yá olɔhi lɛ aá, kóō klla yá kú aá lɛ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛdrɔ́ ɔbá ɛna ɛpa, omlede éyi, mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede kú iháyí éyi ahāapa kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Ocu kú nū í he Óndú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa le odúúdú ajɛ nyā mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kpó lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ómahāapa ā, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā le yɛ kéē gaá yá ɔdōlé ā, uwá í má odúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīkwu uwá kú aá gbō uwā lɔɔlɔhi gbéeko nɛ̄ aá le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Aá lɛ ɔ́ miya ipú inu kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
idu_Latn: Alɔ le pó ka ācɛ ōhī kú alɔ gáā kɛlā nōo le aá ɔtū wuklíicō, ó kē junwalu lɛ aá ipú odo, nááná nōó wɛ alɔ je íkwu lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujékɔ̄pu ga ɛga nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī ɛtá ā. Ujékɔ̄pu kē leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ ohile kú Ulában ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā má ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ aá í kwu nyɔ̄ í tayínū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
idu_Latn: Ōwē nɛ̄hi géē yɔ̄ ga uwɔ, Ukorásin! Ōwē nɛ̄hi wɛ ákú uwɔ dúú Ubɛtsayída! Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā o hídáagó nēé yá ipú aá, nēé yá ipú aígelī kú Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn ā nɛɛ, ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ géē yɛ í má cīce, lɛ úwé ekwu kpó wiiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ é le ewo mī klá iyī uwā iyē, kóō mafú lɛ ācɛ ka é le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ é bīya ɛɛ́!.

eng_Latn: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka ā, Ujóbu lɛ ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
idu_Latn: É klla le ɔdā ō klá ede ɛpa ɔhá yá kpɔ́, é yá éyi ŋmá ɔkpá omlede otɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔwá, ɔhá ŋmá ɔkpá kú ɛbɛ olɔhi nɛ̄hi ā nē é géē lɛ ɔ́ klá eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tóohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ nyā yá ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá íne nɛ̄ um jé lɛ uwā ā. É tá ō lɛyítáajɛ ga um. É kē cɛ̄ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tū uwá ukɔ́ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́nyī um tɛtɛ ā yɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá oklóbīya nū yɔ̄ á. Ó le okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā tēelihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
idu_Latn: Óndú ka, N géē je ákanya mla ámíyā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, ká uwēyī kóō kwú aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá í bá ī gwéēyē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
idu_Latn: Amɛ̄ kú aɛ́bɛ́ ā í ce nɛ̄hi nēe í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í lɛ enyāmɛ̄ nwuné nōo í jɛ̄ ɔ̄ cabá. Ācɛ kɛ́tɛ̄kɛtɛ̄ nēe géē hile ipú ajɛ ā, géē bá ī lé anɔ̄ kú enyāmɛ̄ kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛnwú.

eng_Latn: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD's anointed.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō má ɔ̄ abɔ̄yīnū ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú wā í wu anúɔ abɔ̄ wɛɛlɛ ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā. Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ōhī da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, amáŋ anúɔ tá ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔkpani anúɔ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā n jé ka ɔdā dúúmā nāa dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, ó gē je ɔ́ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bī gɔbū ŋmá ɛga ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le tá ipú ígbíli kú Ussɔ́ á. É yɛ ipú ígbíli ɛ̄cī ɛtá, é má éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá lɛ alɔ ā, aá cēyītīkwū ká aá kwú aúcē olɔhi ō yá ú búla ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, aá kē kwú ɔdōōjé ú búla aúcē olɔhi ō yá.
