eng_Latn: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā í cɛ̄ kóō yɛce um wā ajɛ nyā ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ? Ó lɛ ā, n kwú ɔyí uwɔ í cīgbīhi ga ajɛ nɛ̄ a ŋmá ā kɛ̄ɛ.

eng_Latn: This is the LORD's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
idu_Latn: Óndú yá ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ nyā á. Ó kē le hɛ́ alɔ idáagó, ó klla yá alɔ eyījii nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá yá ágbe, é géē yá ɔ̄ ɛdɔ kú ágbe éékpó nōó yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ubárūku, ɔyí kú Uneríya ā tū uwɔ okónu lɛyíkwu alɔ á. Ó yá kéē lɛ alɔ kpó tū ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn, kéē lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó ámāŋ́ kéē lɛ alɔ kwú aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ ɔlɛ uwá nɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je awɔ mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu kpó lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya. Óócí, awɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ géē wā í lā mla um. Óndú ā í kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya óócí.

eng_Latn: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.
idu_Latn: Únóji kú ɔnyɛ kwu yɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ubɛ́tɛlu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Únóji kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Ujúda wā í kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi í wā í yá ɔdā nāa yá ede nyā ā, yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
idu_Latn: A je ɔ́da lɛ ojuja, kóō yā ɔwɔ klá uwɔ cɔcɔcɔ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔma, aá nēe wɛ ācogbāálá ā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā, nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, gē ka lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
idu_Latn: Āyā dóódu kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu lā ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mla Umɛ́dīya ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wā gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ācɛ Ujíyu dúúmā, odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu ā gē pīya tɔ̄ɔ̄há ī nūunu tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi ācɛ Ujíyu ā ɛga dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄, nōo géē ŋmó uwā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ gē ŋmá ajɛ, klla gē gaajɛ ī pīyɛyi fíyafíya ga ɛga nōó ŋmá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya da ɔ́ kahíníī, N má aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pahīla klá ɛyí ɛfu bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, ka, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā í lɛ otrɛ̄yí ŋ́, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō ga ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē gā ɛgiyí ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɛce ɔ́ ā. Ó gaá māháyi iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N le jé ɛɛ́ ka, Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúú í yɔ̄ ɛga dúúmā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ōfōōfūnū nɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, miyɛ ɛhi nyā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú kɛlā gā um lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ipú aígelī nēé hī ka Umígidɔlu, mɛ́mla Utapánhes, mɛ́mla Umémfīisi mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nēé hī ka Upátrɔ̄ɔsi ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umerári ma Umáli mɛ́mla Umússi á.

eng_Latn: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, odúúdu īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó gē nwūla eko ŋ́ mā, í kē je yíífi ŋ́, ohígbū ka é gē nwūla igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē wā igbīhi um ā lɔfú fíyɛ́ um kɔ́ɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n lɔhi jɛ̄ nɛ̄ n kōō ī tukpɛɛ́ í wī ɔ́ngbá kú áblákpá kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nōó lɛ okónu gwū ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ ā, ɛmiyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.
idu_Latn: Ó da Urútu ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē cíla anú ulé kú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔ́ yá ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɔ́ɔ wā ɛgiyí nū ā kóō gbō ɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ cíla anú ulé olɔhi ā omōōmu.

eng_Latn: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ó gā ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa ā, ó gáā wúla klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū klla gaá bī ɔ̄ ikpó. Ugɛ́hási gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa, amáŋ Ɛláyíssa da Ugɛhási ká ɔ̄ habɔ̄ tā cíí, ka ɔ́ɔ má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī wú ɔ̄ ohígbū unwalu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ anúɔ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
idu_Latn: Alam Umɛ́lɛ̄ki, Ámādi, mɛ́mla Umíssalu. Ajɛ kú uwā kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, gaá kwu Ukámɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ussíhɔ-Ulíbínāti.

eng_Latn: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ n má eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wā í je Ujerúsālɛm yíífi ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ n má okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ā. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ īyī um tá fīyɛ̄ ajɛ gblugudu, kwú eyī pīya klá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē tū uwɔ anú lé ā í jɛ̄ uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Alɔ kē kɛlā ga awɔ ɛmɛɛma kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Therefore because the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ ā lɔfú lɛ ā, útuló le kwɔ́lá nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ígblɛ́nyī kú ɔlá ā kwú ācɛ nēe gáā kpó uwā tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ tū ipú ɔlɛ́ kú útuló ā ū kpó yi, le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
idu_Latn: Aádā mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ í bɛ́yíkwú iyī uwā. Aɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā kē í bɛyíkwu iyī uwā. Aɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá mɛ́mla anyā ayí uwā géē bɛyíkwu iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aá, nēe gē lɛ íne ā tū cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ aá hɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Aá le hɛ́ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í ményinyi aá.

eng_Latn: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ aádáádā aá le ɛlā íwɔ́tū yá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō ā, Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn lɛ uwá yálé klla lɛ uwá kpó kwú ga ajɛ kú ācɛ Ucaldíi. Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú wúla tāajɛ klla kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. É klla kwú ācɛ kú Ujúda ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛ̄nyā ā nɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ka ā le yá jīla á. Ó kahíníī, Ó lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē kú alɔ. Ó lɛ ōcē kú alɔ kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
idu_Latn: Uládan, Ammíhūdu, Ɛlíssāma.

eng_Latn: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
idu_Latn: Usɛkaríya da uwá kéē lɛ usiléeti bī gé lɛ anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá tū ɔ́ kahíníī, Iyē kú nū lé ka Ujɔ́ni. Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā le kpó hídáagó á.

eng_Latn: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
idu_Latn: Ń tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe bá nyā ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, náaná é bá ī hápápá nyɔ̄ gaá cɛ̄hɔ̄. Ń ka ɛlā dúúmā lɛ uwá ŋ́, náaná é ba ī ka ɛbɛ nēé ka aá ɔ́ɔ má.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka n̄ da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nēé lɛ okónu ce Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ā, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Ufíkɔl le cīgbīhi ga Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ otá-ɔtāhɛ̄ í cɛgbá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū ge yúklɔ́ nyā á, ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ota-ɔtāhɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le tá Ɛ́siyɔngɛ́ba mɛ́mla Ɛlɔ̄ti okónu ísu kú Ákwāba ā, ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā má ka Ujékɔ̄pu í lɛ ihɔtū lɛ Ulɛ́ya bɛ̄ɛka Urécɛ̄lu ā ŋ́ mā, ó le ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ Ulɛ́ya kóō ma ɔyí, amáŋ Urécɛ̄lu wɛ ɔdɔma.

eng_Latn: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
idu_Latn: Aá má ipɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo kwu ɔ́ɔmā a? Ó kwu um ajaajɛ fíyɛ́. Ká ālɔ̄ lɛ kwu ga abɔ́ɔ cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ le wi. Ó kē wɛ ipɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
idu_Latn: Aá pó ācīije ɔhá. Ádɔ̄lɛ́ éyi yɔ̄, nōo hɛ́hɔ̄ ufáyin. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ igá hɛ́ tā ɔ̄, klla lɛ ɛga ō yá ejé bū ipú nū á. Ó lɛ ɔdā ce, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá olufa lɛ ācɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá iyāwu á.

eng_Latn: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ um ihɔtū nāa lɛ ā, cɛ̄ gā um gwéeyē nɛ̄hi, ó klla lɛ um ɔtū tú kwu ɔtū. A le ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá alɛwa ɔtū tū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā kú iháyí ɔhá, a géē bī ɔyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehée ɔkpani, ā híī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gā um ŋ́, ohígbū ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unún ā géē kɔ̄ ajɛ ā lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
idu_Latn: Á híī ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú, mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe ī lɛ ɛhɛ kwu ayīnu lɛ ogwiji tá ipú ā.

eng_Latn: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
idu_Latn: N lɔtūce ka n géē tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ fú aá ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ n le jé kpɔ́cíí kéē géē hɛ́ um tá ámāŋ ka n géē yɔ̄ agbá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um. Ó kahíníī, Ācɛ Umówābu ka ka Ujúda ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, N cíkā ō je íne nɛ̄ aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā bīya ā yá aá ɛhi ŋ́ má. Aá nyɛɛ hɛ̄ um tá klla bá ī gbā aɛ́cí nēé wɛ ɔdā ɔ̄kwɛyí ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā. N je ɔdōlé lɛ aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá le lé lɛ ipú nū. Amáŋ ɔdā nēé le cíla um ulé mɛ́ɛ ā wɛ ka é bá ī gbaajā, ācɛnyīlɔ ā kē bá ī kwu ɔgba ɔlɛ́ aákwuna kéē gwutá mla uwá.

eng_Latn: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
idu_Latn: Ŋmífī nēé gwó igelī nyā jāā gáā kwu ícɛ ā, é húmáyī yá um cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi piyóó. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē je ɔ́ yíífi ŋmá ipéyī um.

eng_Latn: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Uménāhem yɔ̄ í wā ŋmá Utɛ́yísa ā, ó kwú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Utápūwa mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla ā ú kpó ŋmó. Ohígbū kēé tá kóō cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́. Ó le odúúdú anyā ōyīipú kú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ipú kpó yíla tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ úlā igwó āa. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá nū ga ɔlɛ́ eko nēé lɛ ɔdōlé lé kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unátan tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ a bī ipú ɔtū ā, yá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ um gáā yá ā gē yɔ̄ piyóó ŋmá ɔfú kú um ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá gáā bá ī lɛ ayááyí, nēé kē gáā mlanyī aá ŋ́ piyóó lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛ gɔbū ligíí ā, ó lɛ ayínɛ́ ɛpa ɔhá má, Ujɛ́mīsi mla Ujɔ́ni, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi. É bá ipú ɔ́kɔ kú uwā gē glá ɛ́yá kú uwā yá.

eng_Latn: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
idu_Latn: Bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi nōo gē tá úgbéenyi nɛ̄hi úgbagwú eyī itekwū ā.

eng_Latn: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ébrahām yɔ̄ ī gbēyī igelī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya klla le gwó, igelī nɛ̄ ikpóōtáajɛ kú nū le kpɔ́cíí.

eng_Latn: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē bī uwā le yá kú anúɔ jé ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ gē yɛce ɔwɛ kú anúɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā yɛce ā.

eng_Latn: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Éhūdu le bɛ̄cɛ lɛ ɔwɛ pi gwū, kwú igodó ú kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
idu_Latn: Ogbló le yá ɔ̄ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí ā. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē tá óbō mɛ́mla ɔdájī lɛ́ ɔ́, ó gē lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu, iháyí ofu cɛtá. Ó gekwú anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi Ussámɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Árɔ̄ni yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. É pīyeyī má ígbíli ā, anɔ́ɔ é má ɔlá ōceyī nɛ̄hi ō mafú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ipú ojuja á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ īlī odufā tíígbíngbli tū okónógwu kú iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ígwíígwu kú ukɔ́tin ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa gē jē íkōtō tá ajɛ lɛ ígbáanɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kē yɔ̄ ī má uwɔ á, ó gáā cɛ̄ túbla íkōtō ɔ́ɔmā ŋ.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n tíne ā, n lɛ. Ɛhá kú ɔdā dúúmā í kwú um ŋ́. N le ɔnyɛ kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n tíne ā jé. Ɔtū klla he um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu kóō gwá ejé dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ ka ō ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
idu_Latn: Eko le yɛ lígíí, ɔnyā kú Ujúda, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ussúwa ā gekwú. Eko nōó le ekwu kú ɔnyā nū yɔ̄ kwɛyí ā, anú mɛ́mla oklóbīya nū, Uhíra kú Adúlam ā le tá ajɛ kú Utímna, ɛga nɛ̄ uwá bá ī wá aálá kú Ujúda ɔnwū ā.

eng_Latn: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú, íne kú uwɔ yɔ̄ piyóó, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā tīihɔ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ó kē í tīihɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ka aɔ́dā nēe yá nyā, Ɔwɔicō le ohi tá Ujóbu ŋmá ipú owu nɛ̄hi éyi. O kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
idu_Latn: Acogwɛ́ɛya nēe yúklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kéē tū ɛgíkwū klla í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ka, Óndú, ményinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aéwɔhá leyī gwō alɔ bónū klla yá alɔ okónu yɔ̄ ī ka, Íní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú aá yɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ ijáalí kú nū kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya piyóó, bɛ̄ɛka Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki ā.

eng_Latn: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú uwá ka aá lɛ aíkonó alɛwa nɛ̄hi, aá gē cɛgbá igbāmkpa amáŋ ígwu kú aá lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
idu_Latn: É bá ī cēyītīkwū yɔ̄ gē yá kú Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ odée ka cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛlā kpó ce ɔ́ koó lɛ íne kú Umósīsi bīya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ɔdā olɔhi nōo cíkā ō yá, nōó kē yá ŋ́, ó wɛ ínoóbīya.

eng_Latn: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ámɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nāa lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ gē yá abālɔbányā, yá ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi mla odúúdú ɔfú kú uwɔ, ohígbū ká, únóji nāa gē nyɔ̄ á, úklɔ́, íjééyī mɛ́mla ohílīpú, mla ɔdōōjé ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā gaá kwú ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó ɔhá o hile nēe bá ī yi ɔtulalī ɔlá ipú ákánjɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā í yi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
idu_Latn: n géē blakwu okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla awɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā oyēeyī ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ í kē gáā cēenyi gáā je ɛcɛ yíífi igbohá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú í leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nu lɔhi glá ŋ́, ofíyɛ́dúú ācɛ nɛ̄ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ékpó mla anú ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā tá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́, anú klla bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó pó ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu ā í jɛ̄ aá ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ kú Ukénan nēe lā ajɛ ɔlamu ā, lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya ōkpɛ́fú kú oje, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e lā Ubɛti Ussán mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla anú tá ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe la ɔpɛ́ kú Ujesiríli ā.

eng_Latn: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
idu_Latn: Alɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ alɔ, kú aá jé ojīlīmā ɔkwɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ ipú aá ā, nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aá, klla ī nwū aá ɛlā lɛyíkwu oyēeyī kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, da ācɛ ā ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ aá gaá je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí nū, odúúdú ācɛ wɛ aólíla, é kē jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe gē má ojíbó kú aɛ́cí ā wɛ aólíla, bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́cí ā. Ohígbū ka aɛ́cí nēé yá ɔ́ɔmā, wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, é kē lɛ oyēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ gē yá lɛ a, ɛ̄nyā ī yá kú Óndú ā kóō mímálānyī. Alɔ kē jé ka alɔ í lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ pīya gaá lɛ āyā ɛhícō kú nū miya. Ó wɛ umíta ofu igwáhāpa cigwó dúú.

eng_Latn: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki nēe hile bá abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ga abɔ́ɔ ā kpó ŋmó ŋmá ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, anɔ́ɔ é má lā abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, Usɔ́dɔm wɛ ka anú mla ayīnu nɔ̄nyā yá ɔbɔ́cɛ, ohígbū ka é gē má lé, ī má gwá klla lā ipú abahi mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́. Amáŋ é lɛ ɛlá kwu aógbɛhá mla ācocābɔ̄nyɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukéda mɛ́mla aájɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄ Uhásɔ gē leyīkwu, nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn yálé ā. Óndú ā kahíníī, Cāŋ́jɛ kú aá nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ukéda cɛ́ɛ́ ka á kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ú yíífi.

eng_Latn: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ohígbū koó wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, ó géē mīyɛ ɛdɔ ulé ékpó mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa, ó géē mīyɛ ɛdɔ ulé ékpó mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm, a lɔhi nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ ácí ō lúlé kú aálá ā. Amáŋ n géē je uwɔ yíífi.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu ce igwó ga iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó ā, nēe géē ga ipu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú ɛga ō yɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gaá yúklɔ́ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ajɛ ā géē jíliyē. Ācɛ nēe lā anú ā, í gáā yɔ́tūnōbí klla yēekwu ŋ́ nɛɛ? Odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu géē túgbagwú, í hɛ́ gicō lógólógó klla í wāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ísu nēé hī ka Unáyilu ā.

eng_Latn: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
idu_Latn: N pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gwō lɛyíkwú um klla cá um ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka n jōonjīlɛ̄ mla ācɛ nɛ̄ aá je ka uwá wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe fíyɛ́ dúú nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, gaá lā ɛhícō kú āyā ɔhá kú ísu kú Ánɔn, ígbíli nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛyí ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, ohígbū ka o ŋmá ísu kú Ánɔn ā wɛ ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ācɛ Umówābu mɛ́mla Ámɔn á.

eng_Latn: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
idu_Latn: N lɛ uwá ŋmó ɛpɔ̄bí ohígbū ucē nēe yá mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nēé lā oyēeyī lɛ ā, klla kwú uwā í kpó pahīla tū ipú aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odúúdú ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu bī wā oŋmɛ́yí cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ éwo ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛpa pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yīnū. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó yá kú ācɛ kéē bá ɛbɔ́ mla iyī uwā á.

eng_Latn: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
idu_Latn: aá kwú éyi kú ayí kú Áhābu nōo cíkā o lé ɔcɛ́ ā ú cɔcɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá nuunu kú aá nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le yɛ gaá lɛ ajɛ ā jila bū ígbíli kú Usín jāā ga Uréhɔ̄bu ga okónu ɔwɛ kú Uhámāti.

eng_Latn: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ kéē je mlanyī Óndú ā nōo hɛ́ uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti, ɛga nēé tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ o ce ɔnya fíya ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔnya ce gaá le ɔ́da nyā kpó kɔ̄ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ ā. É klla lɛ íne ā jé klla kwú ɔ̄ u bá ɛcɛ Usúsa, ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā.

eng_Latn: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔ̄cɛ nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū ā nɛ̄ ó gē nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā klla ī pi ɔ́ ahɔ̄ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē nwū ɔyí ɔtū kú nū ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ubatísim kú Ujɔ́ni wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā. Ó klla da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo gē wā igbīhi nū, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
idu_Latn: Anú nōo cīce ɛyí akpa ɔcɛ́ ā ɛhícō kú oyoolo kú ɛcɛ, ɔkpáncō ā, yá ɛcɛ á. Ó kē ī má odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkpangā ā. Ó lɛ ɔkpáncō nāŋdaa klá ɛhícō ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ipoto ā, ámāŋ ka ɛpɛ̄ nēé ī tá ī le fīyɛ̄ áklɔ́kpɛ nēé ī lā anú ā.

eng_Latn: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ucɛ̄faramóni, Ófini, mɛ́mla Ugéba. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛpa mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
idu_Latn: A géē gɔ́ awulú kú owú ublúu dúúdú nōo géē yɔ̄ ɛ́háajɛ kú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra jɔ́kpá nɛ̄hi klla jé íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōó je lɛ Umósīsi ā nɛ̄hi. Abɔ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ɛ́sra lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce ɔ̄ ā, ɔdā dúúmā nōó ba ŋmá ɛgiyī ɔcɛ́ ā, ó le kpó lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
idu_Latn: Uhánɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usánōwa ma ɔwɛ kú ɔpɛ́ ā á. É le Odūngwɔ̄wɛ ā gbā, kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ kwu ā. É klla le oje nēé géē bī lɛ gwū ɔwɛ ā kpó kwu ɔ́. É klla le ɔdɔ kú igá ā ma bɛ̄ɛka umíta úlāce ofɛpa ā jāā gaá kwu ɔwɛ kú útrīmū ā.

eng_Latn: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
idu_Latn: Lɛ tútū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī óócí cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā gaá jīla mla um ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le tá ɛyí ɛfu, anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū gaá cīice pī ɔ̄ biílí.

eng_Latn: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ákú aá lɔhi, ohígbū ka eyī kú aá ī mɛ́ɛbɛ. Ahɔ̄ kú aá kē páhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ofɛtá cigwó ā pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si mla éeyē nɛ̄hi gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ā kōō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ alɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ le iyē ká uwɔ hī lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
idu_Latn: N ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka aá he um ɔtū ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔwɔicō jé ka aá he um ɔtū!.

eng_Latn: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɔ́ jila, nōó le má ka ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ í je pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ínálēgbé ā í kē lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā ŋ́, nōó le kwú turuturu, ó géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ a le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á. Ohígbū ka a gē ka ka ísu kú Unáyilu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú anúɔ, anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le odúúdú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yá kwɛyí ā, odúúdú ɛ̄gbā kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla iyó ɔhá nɛ̄ ádā nū Udéfīdi kpó lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā ú kpó tū ɛga ōkpó iyó kú ɛ̄gbā tū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
idu_Latn: Ké ē wɛ ācɛ nēe gē cē iyī uwā bī glá, kéē tīihɔ, é kē í wɛ anyā olɔhi nēe ge lɛyí táajɛ lɛ aɔ́bá uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúú kó ō ŋmó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā okónu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
idu_Latn: Anú gē gbō um klla ī nya um tá á. Anú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú kú um á, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá um lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
idu_Latn: O tú iyī uwɔ wāajɛ ká ā wɛ ɔlɛhɔ́cɛ kpɔ́ ā, lɔhi fíyɛ́ o gaá tá ipú ācɛ ō gɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kɔ̄ agbénú ō kpó uwī mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛwa nɛ̄hi wā í le jila tɔ̄há. Eko nɛ̄ ɔdōlé kú uwā mɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ayíkpó ā hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka.

eng_Latn: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
idu_Latn: Ɔyípɛ̄ éyi yɔ̄ amānyā nōo bī igbō eyē ɛhɔ̄ mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa. Ɛ̄nyā jɛ̄ ɔdí ipú ɛwa ɛ́gɛ́nyā glá.

eng_Latn: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
idu_Latn: Kéē lɛ ádā uwā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó wā amānyā. N géē je ajɛ nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, lɛ ācɛ nēe lɔfú klla ī yúufi Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ ɔtūce uwá glá, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe géē tá kéē miyɛ omíci ā fu. Kéē lɛ ācɛ ā kɔ̄ úlúúlā, mɛ́mla ofɛɛhɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ofɛpa cigwó ofɛpa cigwó, mɛ́mla igwíígwó kéē gbō uwā.

eng_Latn: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya klla kahíníī, Ipɔ́ɔ́ma kú Ujékɔ̄pu, aá pó ɛlā kú Óndú ā ooo! Odúúdú aípɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jāhɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cohumɔtū, a jōklóbīya nɛ̄hi, a gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi. Ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ā gáā wɛ agōdō kú alɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
idu_Latn: Humm, Óndú, eko nyá nāa gáā cɔ̄nū mla alɔ í kwu āā? A géē yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū mla alɔ klla í yɔ̄ ī yá alɔ ɛlā piyóó nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ugóolu ma plá ogbló ā. Kú ā lɛ eliká kú ugóolu yá tū ɔ̄, nōo géē bī ogbló ā. A í ma ugóolu plá ogbló ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ̄ ā, ó má ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ɔhá, Ujémīsi, ɔyí Usébēdi mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ujɔ́ni. Uwá mɛ́mla Usébēdi, ádā uwā bá ipú ɔ́kɔ yɔ̄ gē tá ɛ́yá kú uwā tū. Ó le uwá hīīgwú.

eng_Latn: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē pó ɛlā nēé nwū uwā ā, yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī á, amáŋ, ācɛ nēe gē tá kéē pi uwá ahɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, géē nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ Ujehóyākim lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Unebúkádinēsa ɔcɛ́ kú Ubálīlɔn wā gaá le ɛfú kpó tú Ujerúsālɛm, le íbɔm cē tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ɔ́ɔmā, eyījiii kóō yá ācɛ nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā, kéē yúúfi klla fīyēgbúlú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká okónu kóō hɛ́ uwā ŋ́ Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
idu_Latn: Ubálam da Ubálāki kahíníī, N gē ga ɔlɛ́ um ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛɛ́, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ nyɔ̄ ā, n géē pi uwɔ ahɔ̄ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ekɔ̄bū ā.

eng_Latn: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá eko nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó anú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá pī ɔ̄ ā ŋmá ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū bá ɛgiyí ɔdōlé ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Eko nyā ebilíi tɛɛtɛ le nwū tū Ujúdasi Iskárīyɔ̄tu, ɔyí Usáyímɔ̄ni ɔtū kóō mīyɛ ije ce īkpɛ̄yí Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
idu_Latn: A gē ka kéē kwú ajɛ nyā ú yíífi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ka ɛbɛ́ dúúmā í gáā lā anú gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā ɔkwɛ̄yi ɔkwɔɔkwu nyā. Amáŋ ipú aígelī kú Ujúda mɛ́mla úláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm nɛ̄ ācɛ í lā anú ŋ́ ma, ācɛ géē yúuya kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa kwú ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa nēé kpó ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú kpó kwaajɛ Ugígal.

eng_Latn: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū wɛ ācoyípú, nēé lɛ ɛlá wu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋ́. É klla tōō lɛ ɔtūce ŋ́. Ācogwɛ́ɛya kú uwā gē je ɔdā nōo tīihɔ ā nyílá. É klla gē je íne gbájí klla ī cɛ̄tra ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lé itene ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā lɛ ɛbɔ́ ɛga dúúmā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ kē gáā lɛ ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ uwá ɔ́ɔ géē hī ka ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā bá ipú unwalu, ákanya, ɔtū ō gbenyi, mɛ́mla á leyīce ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá Usóra mɛ́mla Éssitāwolu ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā le ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nēé má ā da uwá.

eng_Latn: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwáahāapa ā wɛ Ujossbékássa.

eng_Latn: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn wɛ ipɔ́ɔma aflɛ́yí nēé je ajɛ lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa le ūlī tá āá. Ajɛ kú ācɛ Ubɛ́njamīn ā yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu ɛhícō.

eng_Latn: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ nū kē lé ka Ujúbalu. Anú ā kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí ká ācɛ nēe gē tá ɔkpancílé mɛ́mla ācɛ o gwō ɛ̄ngwū á.

eng_Latn: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cɛ̄ Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, ɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ Useráya, ɔyí kú Uneríya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Umahséya. Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Usedekíya wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Useráya yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla anú, anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya lɛ ɔ́da ōhī je lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ ami ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nāa í ka lɛ uwá á. Ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Ami tú um ɛhɔ̄ fu aá á.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū gē nabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó kú uwā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ ka kahíníī, Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā lɛ ō ka ā. Ɛdɔ ámíyā nɛ̄ n géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yá amānyā í fíyɛ́ abɔ̄, nōo géē yá ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo géē pó ā eyījii.

eng_Latn: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
idu_Latn: Ń da aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā ɔ̄kā ŋmá eko nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī yɛ ā ka, ɔ́dí yá nɛ̄ aá bī ɔcí usɛ́da gwó inu gā um ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
idu_Latn: N géē yá aá italā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. N géē yá aá italā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá kwú na yōŋōō bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē le oje tá ɔlá gē na īnyī kú nū ŋmá ɔ̄ iyē ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. Ó kahíníī Igelī kú ācɛ o ŋmó ācɛ nyā géē je yíífi piíí. Ami abɔ̄yī um gáā tū ɛfú kú ɔlá īkwū bá ajɛ láyí á.

eng_Latn: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō gā ipú iyē kú um, kwú um cāŋ́jɛ háyi icō á. Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ká ā gáā lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū īyī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī bēé ɔwɛ ā gā Ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā á. É lɛ ipú inū ofu cigwó gwó kwu ɔdɔ kú Ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. Iyɔ̄bū aínu ɔ́ɔmā ā ó lɛ ɛga éyi ajɛ nēé lɛ ɛcɔ̄ kpó wu ɔ́, lɛ ɔ́ plla.

eng_Latn: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām abɔ̄yī nū da um ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ nɔ̄nyā á. Ɔnyā ā abɔ̄yī nū da um ka anúɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū dúú. N yá ɛ̄nyā ŋmá ɔtū oyēŋēē kú um, n yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ipú ɛ̄lā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā, alɔ kwú pɛ́ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Alɔ kwú ugóolu , oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ú kpó lɛ Umérɛ̄mɔtu, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ɔyí, kú Uríya ā. Ɛlísaa ɔyí kú Ufínēhasi mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ɛpa, Ujósābadu ɔyí kú Ujéssuwa mɛ́mla Unoyádīya, ɔyá kú Ubínūni kē bá abɔ́ɔ mla ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Ubálam ú ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Upéyɔ nōo lɛ eyī pīya kwu ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
idu_Latn: Ujéhu, Asárīya.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu, é bá ī da ɔ́ ká ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gāá túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Uháman, amáŋ ó tá, ohígbū koó kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu, ń kē gáā túkpɛɛ́ lɛ Uháman glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ Uháman, ɔ́dāŋ́ koó géē yɔ̄ í leyīkwu ucē kú Umɔ́dɛkāyi nya icííci.

eng_Latn: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Usára abɔ̄yī nū mīyɛ ɔfú kóō yɔ̄ ipú eko nɛ̄ ó le gla ipú ō yɔ̄ nááná, ohígbū ka ó cɛ̄ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo cokónu lɛ anúɔ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lɔtūce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ odúúdú aígabɔ̄, ācojɔ́dā, aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄, aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígbómína kú odúúdú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó hīīgwú tɔ̄há kéē wā. Ó kéē wā ɛ̄cī nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya klla í je ojibó nyā kwaajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú ijē kú ɛna ā ŋmá ipú nū, í je ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á gáā na um ikpó gbóógbóō ŋ́. Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ń na uwɔ ikpó ŋ́, ayíka á kē wɛ ɔyíkpó kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á híīī da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nóó, amáŋ nyɔ̄ kpaakpa gaá lɛ iyē uwɔ mafú lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ uwɔ jila. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le mafú lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ keé le uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛ́ɛ́ mā, lɛ ɛya nɛ̄ Umósīsi je ɔ́da kú nū ā gwó.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce uwɔ ŋmá Usáyɔn. Kóō yá ká ā lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē yɔ̄ ī lɔhi lɛ Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ā má, eko nāa í yéeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla um, ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla aá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ ɔcí í lɔfú gwá īkpō abɔ̄yī nū glá ŋ́ mā, ń táafú ŋ́ ó kwu ɔcí ufáyin ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ aá lɔfú gwá īkpō glá ŋ́ dúú á, ń táafú ŋ́ aá yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla um.

eng_Latn: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ɔyí uwa nɔ̄nyā, nōó lɛ ɔbá ŋ́, nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwa nɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gekwú nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyínɔ̄nyilɔ ŋ́, ayínɔ̄nyā kú nū géē lé úgwū kú nū piíí á.

eng_Latn: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā je ɔfú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē le gbō ɛcɛ ā lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ó kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu fu ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ leyīkwu ɛcɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá le aáklɔ̄kpɛ cē kwaajɛ ɔpɛ́ kú Ugɛ́ra. Ó gaá lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Áyísīki le obugā ɔhá bū, é klla le ikpɛ́lā yá ce ɔ́ɔmā ā kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki klla kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ kpɔ́ ka Sitna, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ olɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
idu_Latn: Eko gēe wā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gēe je odúúdú ɔdā ifa kú áncɛ́nyā kú Ujerúsālɛm ā nēé bī gē yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā kpó. Ó géē kpó aɔ́dōtīikpó, aɔ́dōgbɛ̄ɛyí mɛ́mla aɔ́dōtɔ̄ɔkɔ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
idu_Latn: Ijē ā kahíníī, N gbɛlá ka n géē kwú eko ɔyípōklóbīya kú um nyā nɛmm. Cɛ́ɛ́ n le tá ɔlékwū, ká n lā oyēeyī ohile ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: É kwú Umówābu mɛ́mla aígelī kú nū í yíífi ɛɛ́. É kwú ayípōklóbīya kú nū, nēe wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ fíyɛ́ dúú ā í kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ami, Ɔcɛ́ nōo lé ka Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā é kwú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ú gwɛ́ɛya igbɛ ékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ íne nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa bīya ā kpó nyɔ̄. Ó géē wā igbɛ ɔ́mpa, ó gáā wɛ ohígbū ínoōbīya gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe bá yɔ̄ ī gbēyī nū ā nyatá.

eng_Latn: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
idu_Latn: Ń yɛ í yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ nēe lɛ aínu kú uwā tú mu mla oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ɛhɔ̄ ce úlā igwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
idu_Latn: É le ɔtū kú uwā yéékpó kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa ŋ́. É lɛ okónu nēé ce mla anú ā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn da Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ le ka ka anúɔ géē bī anúɔ Ugídīyɔn yúklɔ́ o hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá ā.

eng_Latn: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
idu_Latn: É bī ɛcɔ̄ ɔgba ɛtá le ɔgba éyi kú ɔcí aflá kú usɛ́da tá ɔtāhɛ̄ le odúúdū ɛcɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gwó.

eng_Latn: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
idu_Latn: N klla le pó ka ācogwíijē, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi, o yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi le pɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi Ujerúsālɛm ā nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ɔlɛ́ uwá gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ɛhɔ̄, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā í je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá lé jē uwá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka aílɔ́wá, nōó hɛ́ apī ŋ́ má, lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ íne ā ka ā tū, ó lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē je uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé le apī hɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ uwá pahīla ga ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ igelī nēé yɔ̄ ī gwó kwú ci á.

eng_Latn: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
idu_Latn: Aúgbɔ́ɔnya úlā ofɛnɛ cɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja nēé gaá pula ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Umáaka ā wā í le aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kpó ce kwu ajaajɛ kú Umédēba. Ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄n le tútū ɛfú ú kpo ŋmá odúúdú aígelī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu yɔ̄ gē kpó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā ŋmó ā, Obadíya le ofɛhɔ̄ kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ā, kpó tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄, lɛ uwá kɔ ígwíígwu, ofɛpa ce igwó ofɛpa ce igwó. Ó klla yɔ̄ gē je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ōhī kahíníī, Aá gbɛlá ka ācɛ Ugálīli nēe yá uwā odée ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka uwá wɛ ācɛ nēe bīya íne fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ Ugálīli ohile á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
idu_Latn: Óndú, odúúdú ɛlā nēe yɔ̄ ī kpóce um ā ká ō lɛ um kwú, ɔ́dāŋ ka ń gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ń gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ohígbū aólɛlā kú um, eko nēé bá ipú unwalu mɛ́mla ákanya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā anyā nēe tīihɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā, gē tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ aɔ́bá uwā, ɔwɛ nyā nēé gē le yá iyī uwā héyīfuú á.

eng_Latn: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.
idu_Latn: Usíya le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, abɔ́ɔ ó háyi le ocíbú kú ɔlá kú ɔtulalī ā wu abɔ̄ kpɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, agwú kwú bɛ̄cɛ gaá bá ɔ̄ údɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
idu_Latn: Umɛtánīya, Umatɛnáyi, mɛ́mla Ujáásu.

eng_Latn: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
idu_Latn: Otú ā, ācɛ gē ca inu kú ācɛ, nyɔ̄ ī wūwī. Amáŋ é gē kwu tayínū ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ohígbū ka ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ í je uwā iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
idu_Latn: Uwá da ācɛ kú Ujúda kahíníī, Da alɔ ɔdā nɛ̄, alɔ gēe yá a. Lɛ alɔ gbō ka a lɛ alɔ tū bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo gē gbo obobowú klá ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ ɛnɔ á. v ka alɔ mlaɛ́nyɔ̄́ obobowú kú uwɔ. Alɔ kwú pīya alagbá kú ɛfu ba ī kwu, í tíne ɛga ootaínū ɛɛ́, kwú alɔ u tayínū ɛga dúúmā nɛ a gē pīɛ̄ la alɔ a.

eng_Latn: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ āa odúúdú ajɛ kú Usiríya le ofu kú nū pó. Anɔ́ɔ uwá bī odúúdú ācodoōcē gé lɛ ɔ́, ācɛ nēe lɛ ōcē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, ācɛ nɛ̄ iyē gē fu uwā, ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ abɔ̄ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí, ācɛ nɛ̄ ajikpáakpáa gē yá uwā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ iyē kú uwā le ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le odúúdú uwā hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ n gē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá nyā lɛ īkpɛyí olɔfú, é klla pó ahɔ̄ um ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ kú ā nyɔ̄ í le da uwá ɔdā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ ā é gē yá ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ kú aɔ́tangbédē oheyīfuú kú uwá ā, amáŋ é klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpó uwā le yá aójibó nēe wɛ ɔdā ɛbí, nēé ī gbā ā. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā klla kwú agbénú kú uwā ā ú pīya īmū mla ɔdēlihɔ lɛ uwá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, a yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛ ā, á gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́. Oyēeyī kú uwɔ í gē ŋmɛ́yí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka aá nɛ̄ n, aá yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ eyīyōce á, aá kē wɛ ācɛ nēe yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ kē ī gwéeyē á, aá kē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ í gwó kú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā iyɔ̄bū Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá eko nōó í kwúcē wā á.

eng_Latn: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
idu_Latn: Ka ācɛ kú Íjīpiti gbɔɔ́ ō yá aá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá aá kú aá yúklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ.

eng_Latn: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ, kwú ɛna ámāŋ álá, ámāŋ ijakī ú tá ɔ́mpa nū, nɛ̄ ó gekwú, ámāŋ ka é kwú kpó uwī eko kú ɛfú, nɛ̄ ijáalí dóódu í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
idu_Latn: Ó gē he uwá ɔtū kéē yāajɛ ɛga ojīlīmā eko kú ucɛ, mɛ́mla o yāajɛ iyɔ̄bū ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī gwá amɛ̄ kpɔ́ wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ olugwulugwu, nōó jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɔdā o lɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
idu_Latn: N géē tá ɛ́yá kú um klá ɔ́, klla í kwú ɔ̄. N géē bī ɔ̄ ga Ubábīlɔn, ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ucaldīyān. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ó í kwú ā, amáŋ ó gáā má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
idu_Latn: Alɔ cɛ̄, klla jé ka a wɛ Ɔ̄cɛ otīihɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla yēeyī iháyí úla ɛpa ce ofɛpa kpɔ́ á. Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛwa ā dɛ̄gba tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmó, ká ā lɛ Ubárābasi hɛ́tá lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
idu_Latn: É ka ɔdā dúúmā í gē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū yɔ̄ ī yá ācɛ ɔhá italā ā ŋ́. É klla ī hɛ́ uwá tá eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī cɔ̄nū ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ā ka ā, ó kwú igbō ú, le ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō iyɔ̄bū odúúdú uwā ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ cē anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō lé á.

eng_Latn: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú okwū kú nū ú ce ɔnya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́, ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
idu_Latn: Uwá nēe wā mɛ́mla Ujɛ́hōyāda ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā wɛ, úlā ahāanɛ cofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔkpani um ɔ̄kā ka, Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā í cɛ̄ kóō wā mɛ́mla um ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n gē yá mla íkpékwīja ā? Ami ā gē pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gbā ā, klla gē leyīkwu aá má. Ami ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī usáyipurɛ̄si nɛ̄ ēpū kú nū gē wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ cɔŋgɔdɔ́ɔ́ piyóó á, ɛgiyí um nɛ̄ ɔhā kú aá gē ŋmá á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí ā gē gwá īkpō ā.

eng_Latn: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhilikáya, Ahíkam, Ácībɔ, Ussafán, mɛ́mla Asáya le tá ɛgiyí ɔnyā éyi nōo wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, nēé hī ka, Uhúlida, nōo lā ɛga ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ɔbá nū lé ka Ussálum ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Utíkifa nōo klla wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Uháhasi ā, gē leyīkwu aáwulú nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É le ɔdā nōo yá ā kpó cāabɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ gā um le ɛcɔ̄ lé mla ayīnu nōo cɛ̄ le ayīnu kú um kwu kpócē tū um ipú okónu. Ó klla cɛ̄ ga um má gwutá ipú úmúlá kóō mafú ka ń wɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú kwú ɔbá ɛna ámāŋ álá ú uwī, nɛ̄ó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, ámāŋ nɛ̄ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lá, ó géē bī aɔ́bá ɛna ɛhɔ̄ le gbā ulé kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, ámāŋ aálá ɛhɔ̄ le gbā ulé kú álá éyi.

eng_Latn: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā gaá cīce pīya Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ um wɛ, woó, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um wɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nyā lɛ alɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
idu_Latn: N géē bī aá ga ɛga únóji nyɔ̄ í lā abɔ́ɔ mla ācɛ kú íkée ā. N géē yá ká a klá ipú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, ipú ífi opiyóó mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gekwū ɛɛ́ mā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, ācɛ í klla gáā lā ipú uwɔ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa í wā í lā ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā igbɔhá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɛga nɛ̄ aá gē pɛ̄cí ɛyí ɛfu kú aá wúlatāajɛ, géē je ede otulalī umuumu ā catāajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ okwū kú aá kpó tɛ́cɔ̄ ce aójíbó kú ɛcí kú aa nēe ca bá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jāhɔ̄. Ícɛ nyā, aá gáā ga ɔgbɛ́fú ɛɛ́. Aá híī yúúfi aólɛlā kú aá ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē wuklícō klla ī gbenyi lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujóssuwa Ugígal kóō je mlanyī á ŋ́ ɔkpani, ka ɔ́ɔ wā bōōbū gaá tá aá abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá nyatá. É ka odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ámɔn nēe bá ɛyí ɛfu ā, ɛ́ɛ le pīya tɔ̄há gáā kpɛ́fú tá aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
idu_Latn: É lɛ ahɔ̄, amáŋ é pó ɛlā glá ŋ́, é lɛ ɛnwū amáŋ é píípī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
idu_Latn: Ikoko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū kú aá kóō kwu ō jɛga lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō le ɔcɛ́ lé oyēeyī kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bá ī yá ɔdā nōó tíne kú aá yá ā fíyɛ́ ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le yá lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō géē kpó aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ ɛ̄nyā ŋ́ nááná, eko nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, alɔ lɛ ádā nēe yá alɔ italā, alɔ kē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwá. Alɔ í gáā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ádā kú aálelékwū fíyɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yēeyī ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do: but they did them not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá mɛ́mla aádáádā aá í jāhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛyítáajɛ ga um ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ká aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú nū da ɔ́ kóō yá ā. Aá kē le okónu nɛ̄ alɔ ce ā tū ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá odúúdú aá italā nēé miya ipú okónu ō ce ā.

eng_Latn: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
idu_Latn: Ó ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ayí um, aá nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu ká aá yi ɔtulalī ɔlá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá klla gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɔ́ ā, aá híī ci úklɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā ō yá ɛ̄cī dúúmā ŋ́. Aá kpó ācɛ tɔ̄ɔkwu cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usánbālati lɛ éyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um igbo ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ mla ɔkpá nēé hɔja klá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
idu_Latn: Awɔ hɔ́hā ce aɔ́cɛ́ kú alɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ eko nēé lā ipú ajɛ olɔhi nāa je lɛ uwá ā. Amáŋ, é kwúcē ŋmá íne kú uwɔ ō bīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
idu_Latn: É kwú iyɔ́fú kú nū ú kpó playi inu ɛcí kú uwā nēé hī ka, Ássitārɔtu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwu okwu kú Usɔ́lu ú playi ɔdɔ kú Ubɛ́tissan.

eng_Latn: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka ā. Ó le bá lɛ Ujerúsālɛm eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ā bá ī leyī táajɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ̄ɛcɛ bóobū. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá anɔ́ɔ ó le ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
idu_Latn: Uhárīfu wɛ ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni oyábatísim gē gwōkónu klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ojigógó. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú ācɛ Ufarisīsi gē yá dúú á, amáŋ ayíkpó kú uwɔ gē lé, ī gwá eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ajɛ bū, lɛ ɛcɔ̄ kpó yā ŋmá ipu ajɛ ā, klla lɛ īkpō kú ufáyin nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpó tū tū ɔ̄. Ó le inɔ̄ɔda gwó kwu ɛhɔ̄ ā nēé géē bá ī gbō ɔ̄. Ó klla lɛ ɛga o yá ejé bū ipu ɛhɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ eko nōo leyītáajɛ ka ufáyin kú ɛhɔ̄ ā kóō gwá ikpō kú ufáyin olɔhi ā, ikpō kú ufáyin omákáká nōó gwá á.

eng_Latn: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā kú Unówa lɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Unówa ōfōōfūnū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okpakpa nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, nōo yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū eko ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó yɛ́ɛma klla létɔ̄há mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
idu_Latn: ­Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi cice okónu obugā ā, ayínɔ̄nyā ahāapa kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Umídiya ā le pɛ́ wā gáā pi éŋkpɔ̄ tū ipú ɔdā ō bī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ lɛ aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wu kú ádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó má ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā ígwíígwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā. Alelékwū ihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú.

eng_Latn: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
idu_Latn: N bī oyēeyī kú um ipú abɔ̄ kú um klla lɛyí cīkwū eko dóódu, nááná ā, ń kē gwɛ̄lá hī íne kú uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
idu_Latn: N géē je ede kú uwá kpó wúla tāajɛ mla ede dóódu nēé ge lɛ ɔtulalī kwu ɔlá ɛyí nū ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā, é í kpó uwá ŋmó iyɔ̄bū ɛcí kú uwá.

eng_Latn: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
idu_Latn: N géē cíla uwɔ ulé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, klla géē yá ɔdā dúúmā nāa da um ka um yá ā. Wā káā lɛ okónu tá lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ga um.

eng_Latn: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
idu_Latn: Ikwū wɛ oŋmɛ́yí kú odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipū mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe tá ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
idu_Latn: É le agōdō, ocíbú, aklɛ, īkpɔ̄dā nēé hī ka uwíiti ā, ubáli, umu mɛ́mla ejé kpó wā.

eng_Latn: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu uwɔ eko nɛ̄ uwá le jīla ɛgiyí ɔdɔ kú igelī ā ámāŋ okónpinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā. É gē da iyī uwā ka, Alɔ nyɔ̄ ká ālɔ̄ gáā pó ɛlā kú olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā wā ā.

eng_Latn: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē pa ācɛ kú Íjīpiti hīla ga ajɛ kú aéwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā da um kahíníī, Ā jikwū ŋ́. Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Ágábá nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā, Ɔ̄cɛ Olɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo wɛ Ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Udɛ́fīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, le yálé ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó kē le íkwu lɛ nōó ī fō ɔja ahāapa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ā nwūla.

eng_Latn: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā odiyɔ ā í tíne ō gbo abɔ́ɔ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é gbo iyāwu kú uwā mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ɛpa ā, mɛ́mla aíjakī ɛpa nēé lɛ anjámī wū uwā okónu ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n gáā hī nyā miya kléklé jōōjīlɛ̄, ustákte o kpócu lɔɔlɔhi, ónīka, ugábānɔm mɛ́mla ufránkīnsɛnsi.

eng_Latn: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē wū aíkpɔ̄cí kí ufáyin, ó ge ma abɔ̄ aíkpɔ̄cí ōhī tá kwu ɔ́. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aúwī ga otú, é gé kpó ɔdā nēe he uwá ɔtū ōfōōfūnū nɛ.

eng_Latn: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kú Usayírīni mɛ́mla ákú Aálesáŋdrīya mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e ŋmá Usilísīya mɛ́mla Ésīya nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ācɛ nēé hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ ā, cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla Usitífin.

eng_Latn: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim ga, yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ kú nū. Ó gwōkónu, ó kē gwá ejé ŋ́. Aá kóō lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí!.

eng_Latn: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā gā Ubɛ́tɛlu, ká ā gaá lā abɔ́ɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ā lɛ ede nɛ̄ a í gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí nū gwó lɛ ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo wā ɛgiyí uwɔ, eko nɛ̄ a kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, Ísɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka aólɛlā kéē kpɛ́fú tú Ɛ́lam ŋmá ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka owu nōo yɔ̄ ī tá ŋmá ābɔ̄ dóódu ā. N géē yá lɛ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú nū kwú pahíla gáā tayínū ipú éwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔyíkpó kú nū ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ oŋmá éko ɔ́ɔmā ɔyíkpó ā kwu ɛ́nɛ́ ā ú kóō gaá lā ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ ācɛ kú Ujábɛssi ipú Ugílɛ̄di lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya yá Usɔ́ɔlu ā pó ā.

eng_Latn: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
idu_Latn: Aálelékwū oblínyī ā gē dɛ̄ gbōmgbōm cɛ́ɛ́ é le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ alɛwa nēé bá ipú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ iyē kú uwā le ŋmó mɛ́mla aócīkpó ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees ,) and were filled with indignation,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá pī ɔ̄ ā le mu mla ímálānyī.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ōhī kú oyī kú ɛya nēé gwó kú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé ā, lɛ ɔ́ kwu ákpáhɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄ɔdu kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná, mɛ́mla ocúgbɔ̄ɔdu ikpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔtū mɛ́mla odo ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ uwá. N géē je ɔtū kú uwā nōo lɔfu bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄,ī cɛ lɛ uwā yá īkpɛyí olɔfú ā ŋmá ipú kú uwā. N klla í je ɔtū luwɔluwɔ bɛɛka ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́, nōo ī cɛ lɛ uwā lɛyítáajɛ ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kéē yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yɔ̄ lɛ eko nēé mīyɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
idu_Latn: Aá le jī ɛɛ́! Aá nēe wɛ ɔbá itɔ kú ejé ō gwá ā. Aá klla wɛ ɔka kú ejé olɔfú ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí ō pīyatɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
idu_Latn: É gē juwēyī gā um eko dóódu. Uwēyī kē le um kwú dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
idu_Latn: Asárīya, Ujohánan.

eng_Latn: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Ákú uwɔ le kpaakpa fíyɛ́ ákú um á, ohígbū ka a bī olɔhi le cíla um ulé, amáŋ n kē bī obɔ̄bí gē lɛ cíla awɔ ulé.

eng_Latn: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
idu_Latn: É ka aá wɛ ācɛ Uhíbru nɛɛ? N kē wɛ dúú. Uwá wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛɛ? N kē wɛ dúú. Uwá wɛ ayááyí kú Ébrahām nɛɛ? N kē wɛ ɔyí nū dúú.

eng_Latn: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
idu_Latn: Kóócōō lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ le bū ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Alɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú alɔ í gáā nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ ga ipú ɛhɔ̄, ámāŋ ka ipɔ́lɛ́, ámāŋ ipácí kú aá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́. Alɔ géē kwu ɔwɛ ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá í gáā mā Óndú ā tá nyɔ̄ í gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā géē yá uwā lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kóō cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ō cɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlamu ɛhɔ̄ jé.

eng_Latn: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
idu_Latn: É ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gā Unahálīyɛlu. É klla ŋmá Unahálīyɛlu gā Ubámótu.

eng_Latn: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
idu_Latn: Ooyá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem kéē híī má ɛga kwu ŋ́ mā, ācɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di gaá mīyɛ ɛga nēé gē bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɛ́frem dúúmā tíne kóō kwu nɛ́ɛ, é gē mīyɛ ɛga kéē bēhé ísu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di gē dɔɔ̄kā koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɛ́frem nɛɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ nōó tá.

eng_Latn: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
idu_Latn: A kwú ācɛ kú uwɔ ú kpó lá alahá mla ije olígíí, bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé gbo ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
idu_Latn: Āa híī bī igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ wā eko nɛ̄ aá bī ɛbɛ́ wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya gā um ŋ́. Ijē kú ɛbɛ́ nēé bī wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya gā ā um kóō híī hile gbó ɔ̄cī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo gē gbō uwā. Anú wɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ī leyīkwu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā á. Iyē kú nū okónu Uhíbru lé ka Ábādɔn. Ókónu Ugríisi iyē nū ā lé ka Apólīyɔn. Ɛyí nū wɛ Obīyɔdā.

eng_Latn: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɔdōnīigbo ogbɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ kú ínōobīya ɔ́ɔmā ú ŋmá ipú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le yá yēŋēē. Anɔ́ɔ aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ámú kú igbō ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔdōnīigbo dúú í yɔ̄ anú gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n kē jé ka aá kē wɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ucɛ kú eko onyatá ā le yá ɛɛ́, abālɔbányā nēé kwú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo wɛ ɔyí álá kú onyatá kú alɔ ā ú gwɛ́ɛya ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gaá háyi pī Upíta anɔ́ɔ ɔlá le fíyaajɛ ināgbá ā á. Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ Upíta áklō kpɛɛkpɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ héyī, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ fíya fíya. Anɔ́ɔ agbá ā le wī ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɔdā nōó cíkā ō yá ā yá kwɛyí ā, abālɔbányā ó lɔfú nya odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā tá piyóó glá.

eng_Latn: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā Ujóssuwa kwú hīlokplícī ɛɛ́. Óndú ā kē da ɔ́ kahíníī, A le hīla, klla kwú gbo ókplícī ɛɛ́, amáŋ ajɛ hile nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ á mīyɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā cɛ̄, n géē wā ɛgiyí aá eko kpiíí, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔfú kú ācɛ nēe bá gē gɔ̄ ā ŋmá ā jé, kóō híīī wɛ ɔdā nēé ka ā ōfōōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
