idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya, aúlífāyi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā ɔlɛ́ ā, kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄. É gwéeyī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyi kú ɔ̄cɛ í gē gbojī ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka owu ā nɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ gē bí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ojiji ā nɛ n.

eng_Latn: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo gē lé ɛbɛ́ ā, le yɛ jīla um tá ɛɛ́. Ayīnu kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka óbō mɛ́mla ɔyī ā. Ígblɛ́nyī kú uwā kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄wā ōlúlé nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄kā tū tū aísu kéē bá ɛga ékpónú. Ó kwú éŋkpɔ̄ kú itekwú í kpó tū ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
idu_Latn: Jāā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ká ē ī yɛce ucē nēé yá ā. É klla ī kpɔ́tūce ɔdā dúúmā nēé ka ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya mīyɛ ācɛ nōo tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā lɔɔlɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ odúúdú agbénú kú nū dóódu ā kpó mafú lɛ uwá á. Kwu oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu, kwú aɔ́dā nōo ī kpóocu mɛ́mla ɔtulalī, klla mɛ́mla aíyɛ́fú kú nū dóódu nēe bá aɛ́ga nēé kpó iyó kú nū tū ā. Ó tū ɔdā dúúmā kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū a nōó mafú lɛ uwá ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi fu ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujɛríya úlā ɛhīlī cofigwɛ́hɔ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú úklɔ́ ú le uwá kéē leyīkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄gɛ̄nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gē lā mɛ́mla īyī uwā á í kpó tū uwá abɔ̄. Ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urútu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō yá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, Ubówāsi le ukɔ́ tū ācoyúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ ā kéē jɛɛga lɛ ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ bēhé yā īkpɔ̄dā ōhī nōo kōō bá pī ɛ̄wɛ̄ īkpɔ̄dā nēe bá ajɛ ā. Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ɔ̄ dɛ̄gba tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé géē wā i je uwɔ ŋmó ā, a géē yɔ̄ ī ka ka anúɔ wɛ ɔwɔ kpɔ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄? Eko nāa kwu eyī ú kwu eyī mla ācɛ nēe géē ŋmó uwɔ ā, eko ɔ́ɔmā, a géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu, á gáā wɛ ɔwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā gē kwú ācɛ mla uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā wɛ ɛbéenyi ā. É gē pi uwá nyɔ̄ ipú ɛ́yá kú uwā, klá gē gwéeyē kú ɔdā nēé kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá pó ijē kú ikwāyidɔ nɛ̄ n gáā gwó lɛ aá ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
idu_Latn: Okónɔ̄wɛ dóódu, a yɔ̄ ī yó ucē akwuna, lɛ ɔhi mla ɔ́ncɛ́nyā ōjɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā yá ɛflɛ́ɛfu. A gē gbaajā tá ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē wā í yɛ ā. A yɔ̄ ī yá akwuna tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, odúúdú aá nēe wɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē pó ikwū kú otábɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gē je ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé je eyī gicō ā, é má ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā gwū Ujísɔ̄si tá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhalɛ́lɛlu ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Usífu, Usífa, Utírīya mɛ́mla Asárɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ nōo ge wūwī kóō mabɔ̄ uwī ō wī tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbo úklɔ́ nōó géē yɔ̄ gē yá, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɔfú tá ācogbɛhá ā abɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō géē je yá yēŋēē ŋmá iyē oōtēelihɔ ā, é géē fú ewo kú ɛna nɔ̄wá nēé yɔlá kóō kpó íne nēé bīya ā nyɔ̄ ā, tū ipú ɛtɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ ká ācɛ nēe gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bá ācɛ ɔhá ā kéē jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kóō wā í le yá ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú uwā kóō kwú kpó pu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, ká ōwē kóō lɛ uwá ohí pú wāajɛ dɔɔlɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gbā ami, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ̄gbā, n géē hɔ́hā kú ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔhā kú éŋkpɔ̄ ce aá, cɛ́ɛ́ n klla lɛ ōcē kpó ŋmá ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya gekwú ā, ɔyí nū Ubenhádād lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya lé.

eng_Latn: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ, ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā, ó wɛ ka n gē tá íne ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ɔkpá fu uwɔ ŋ́, amáŋ íne nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ā ka ālɔ̄ yíihɔtū tū ɔ́mpa alɔ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, ɛ́ɛ híī yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tɛtɛ gē yá ā ŋ́. Ó ka o gbɔbū lɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ húmāyī gbā Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ̄gbā ɔwɛ nōo he uwá ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔtū ō tū kwu ɔtū á. Ó wɛ ɔtū ō tū kwu ɔtū ā kú alɔ ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔtū nōo he Utáyítɔ̄si ā klla cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gwéeyē fíyɛ́ kpɔ́. Ó da alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ anú lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yá kú ɔtū kú nū kóō wāajɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
idu_Latn: Obɔ̄bíipú ā leyī kwúfúlá ká yɔ̄ ī yúula, amáŋ ācɛ okpaakpa gē lɛ ɔtū ce iyī uwā ɔwɛ nēé gē yɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébulɔn wɛ ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́mɛɛtá nɛ̄ ūlī kwú kéē je ajɛ lɛ uwá á. Ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa je lɛ uwá ā yɛ jāā ga ɛháajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usárīdi.

eng_Latn: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā le aúpíla kú oje udɔ ā, ede kú oje udɔ, mɛ́mla utánki kú udɔ, mɛ́mla ɛna kú oje udɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ utánki ā ce ɛyí uwá ā, mɛ́mla utéblu ō lɛ akā kú oje udɔ ā kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le odúúdú nū kpó ga Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
idu_Latn: Aá jé Óndú ā má, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā má ɔ̄ ka, Óndú ā lɔhi íbí. Ɔtū he ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē gbō ā.

eng_Latn: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ kwinya nyɔ̄ gaá da ɔyípōklōbīya nōo bī ɔdā ōmiya odée abɔ̄ ā ka, ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ géē lɛwa Ujerúsālɛm nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm í gáā hɛ́ ɔdɔ jīla igeli nɛ̄hi ā tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
idu_Latn: N gaá yɔ̄ ipú ɛbɔ́ ɛɛ́, n géē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ipú ójīla kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umánōwa kwú Ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛwū éyi ú mɛ́mla umu, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya gwó ɛyí ede kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā lɛ Óndú ā, nōo gē yá ɔdā ohídáagó ā á.

eng_Latn: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá gbɛlá kwu ukɔ́ nɛ̄ alɔ tū aá ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n bī ɔcí oplákátá nēé hī ka ɔcí kú usɛ́da ā le bá ɔdɔ kú inēyīpú ā ŋmá ajɛ jāā kwu aflá kú icō inu ā. Ó le ɔcí nēé hī ka usáyípɛ̄si pla tā ajɛ kú ipú inu ā.

eng_Latn: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujɛ́hōhasi ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu móōwē abɔ̄ kú Uhasɛ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla anú, ka ɔ́ɔ yúúfi ŋ́, kóō gáā kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éyi kú ipú uwā le jé ka iyē kú anúɔ kwú lɔhi ɛɛ́ mā, ó le cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si, lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Abɔ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá kē wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú um ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ufi í cɛ̄ gā um lɔtū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá Óndú ā ohi ka, N géē nyɔ̄ í yá cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kéē má ɔ́ ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka, Nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔ́ plla mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ó í kwú ɔ̄ gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
idu_Latn: É le ɔcányā ā kwú nyɔ̄, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú nū bá gē jikwū, gē lɛ abɔ̄ gɔ́ ɔtū klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka okóohō ō yɔ́tūnōbí ā.

eng_Latn: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú alɔ lɛ ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā cē klá um gbɔɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó ŋmá ihɔtū nɛ̄hi nyā a, nɛ̄ n miyɛ ɔtōōce nōo wɛ ákú alɔ ipú opiyatɔha mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
idu_Latn: Anyā kú aéwɔhá he Usólōmɔn ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uféro lɛ mɛ́mla anyā nōó lɛ ŋmá Umówābu, Ámɔn, Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla Usídɔn.

eng_Latn: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā, lɛ awulú kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Árɔ̄ni ā plla ŋmá ɔɔ́ iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú klá Ɛlísa ɔyí nū iyē ohígbū ka Árɔ̄ni géē kwú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
idu_Latn: Aá wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yēeyī, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gā ɛgiyí Óndú ā ŋ́, ó géē hɛ́ wɛ́ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá, í je ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnu kú Ujósɛ̄fu yi tāajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ nōo í nyí ɔlá kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
idu_Latn: Ā híī lé ɔdōlé kú ɔ̄cɛ oyúkpɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē yá unwōdōlé nɛ̄ ó gē je lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é kwú aá ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ mā, aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá tū aɔ́dā nēe bá ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yājɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Unóji kú unwɛbɛ́. Ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ ā nēé nyi okwū kú ācɛ o yúnwɛ̄bɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni lɛ ɔ̄kā nyā pó ā, e gā gaá kwú okwū nū nyɔ̄ í nyi.

eng_Latn: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe gbɔbū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tīigbīhi ā bá ī dɛ̄ kahíníī, Owóofu yɔ̄ lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi! Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ gē wā ā. Owóofu kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɛga olicō fíyɛ́ dúú ā ā.

eng_Latn: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, Usedekíya da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ Ujeremíya bī wā gé lɛ ɔ́, ɛgiyí okómpinu ɔmɛɛtá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N gáā da uwɔ ɔ̄kā éyi. N tíne ka a lɛ odúúdú ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí kú ɛlā ā da um.

eng_Latn: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ enyi gē pɛ́ ŋmá agada kú ā í na abɔ̄ ŋ́, nōó le abɔ̄ kwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá á, ɔ̄cɛ nōó le abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā gē na īlī kú nū cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ iyē gwā, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
idu_Latn: É gē nwū uculo nōó yɔ̄ ipú íne nɛ̄ alɔ gē le tū ŋ́, abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ ācɛ Uróm ā.

eng_Latn: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ācɛ kē í hī ɔ̄ igwú kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ ɔ́dāŋ ka é cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ŋ́ mā ā? Ɔwɛ nyá nēé kē í cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē pó olɛhɔ̄ ā jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā? Ɔwɛ nyá nēé kē í pó olɛhɔ̄ ā ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú í bī ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
idu_Latn: Ódūdū yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛnwū kú nū, ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ojuju tū gaá lɛ ajɛ kú ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ éyi lá mla ije ā kéē le nyī okwū kú aúgbɔga.

eng_Latn: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ka aá gē cē oōgwá kú ɔci Ufáyin dúu a; ɛɛ́ ka ɔci Ufáyin ka o wúla ēpū, nōó hɛ́ bónū dúu a, ɛɛ́ ko ó gēe pīya a, Aólɛlā a gēe wā, í je Isudán kpó, je uwá kpó yá ífi kló, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄wā nōo gē gwó abɔ̄ kú ɔci Ufáyin tónū a.

eng_Latn: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtū kpóce Óndú ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í fu ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kōō ī jíla ɔ́ iyē glá ŋ́ dúú á. Amáŋ ó kwajɛ kli piyóó.

eng_Latn: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā pó, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔkwu nū bu lɔɔlɔhi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā yá ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ iháyí úlā ce ofu cigwó ɔ́ɔmā ā le yá jīla ā, odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú Ujɔ́ni wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si gaá dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíya nɛ̄ alɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi gē gwōkónu ojigógó, amáŋ ayíkpó kú uwɔ̄ í gē gwōkónu ŋ́ mā āa.

eng_Latn: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú, le héyī, ɔdíyá nāa yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā ā? Cāŋjɛ, ā tá alɔ tónū piyóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce Uhána, nɛ̄ ó klla le ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛtá mɛ́mla ayí nɔ̄nyā ɛpa kpó ma. Usámūwɛ̄lu yɔ̄ í jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú úklɔ́ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n tá uwɔ ahínyá mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um, N yɔ̄ ī gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ iyɔ̄bū aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
idu_Latn: Ejé wɛ ɔdā nōo ī yá ɔ̄cɛ íwɛ́wɛ. Ó klla ī je ɔ̄cɛ yá olíla. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú wɛ olíla mɛ́mla ɔdāhá.

eng_Latn: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu aɔ́cɛ́ kú ipú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛhícō ā, mɛ́mla ákú aɔ́pɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ɛháajɛ kú isú kú Ugalíli ā. Ó klla le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu aɔ́cɛ kú okónu ísu, nēe yɔ̄ kwu Udɔ ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá uwā ohi ka Umíka ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ pūla cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú nū. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gē gbā ije lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujéhu gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi Usamérīya, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujɛ́hōhasi lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
idu_Latn: A lɛ um yɛ jīlatá biílí bɛ̄ɛka igá nōo ī gbō um ā. A klla kē lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ bī um eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka um le únwū ɔnyā ɔ́mpā um yá, nɛ̄ n gaá yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nū ō cikpó nū.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā ipéyī Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú íne nōó bīya ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ká n̄ da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ā.

eng_Latn: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a jegicō lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu lɛ alɔ, aéwɔhá ā géē pɛ́ kwu í kpó fíyákátā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔnyā ā ú cīgbīhi lɛ Ébrahām abālɔbányā, ó géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū uwɔ ohígbū koó wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ. cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē yēeyī. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka áa je ɔnyā nū cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, le jé péee ka awɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ákú uwɔ ā géē pɛ́kwú.

eng_Latn: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū, Ugíbēya. Ācɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá ɔtū ā le yɛ mla anú.

eng_Latn: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
idu_Latn: Ɛpleko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē kɛlā nyā ā, olɛhɔ éyi ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Ujáríyɔ̄si wā í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ā gekwú ɛɛ́. Ɔdíyá nāa í junwalu lɛ Itíla ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Utobíya māháyi pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi tū ɛlā ā kahíníī, Ɛdɔ ɔdɔ nyá nēé géē gwó glá āa. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛpā kōō le yɛ ɛyí nū, ó géē je ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ ogwuda ā kóō wā. Ó da aólíla ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gē gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ami Óndú ā ŋ́, kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
idu_Latn: A géē da Uféro kahíníī, Ami Óndú ā kahíníī, Ísrɛ̄lu wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú um á.

eng_Latn: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó le bla kwu okónu nōó ce le Ébrahām mɛ́mla ayááyí kú nū ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
idu_Latn: ohígbū koó kwú pīya ɔdēelihɔ ɛɛ́. Ń gáā je ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le lé éyi, ka ó wɛ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
idu_Latn: É gē lɛ obɔ̄bí cíla ulé kú olɔhi ŋ́. Blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí uwɔ gáā kɛlā ohígbū uwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ káā híī yá mla uwá ipú ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ é lɛ ukpa kpla táajɛ gbēyī um, kéē lɛ um kwú.

eng_Latn: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ tá nyɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ó klla yɛ jāā ga ɛga o ligbó kú ɛháajɛ ga Ísu kú ɔmā mɛ́mla o yɛ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ikpɛ́fu kú Upísga.

eng_Latn: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
idu_Latn: Ami ā, nōo wɛ alagbá abālɔbányā ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄ ā gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ká aá lā ɔwɛ nōo cíkā lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya lɛ aá ká aá lā eko nōó hī aá igwú ka aá kwú pīya éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔ́dā o hile ɔhá nɛ̄ Amásīya yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mla Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔfiyɛ ā yēeyī ɛ̄cī éyi ámāŋ ɛ̄cī ɛpa, é gáā yá óndú ɔfiyɛ ā italā ŋ́. Ufu kú agbénú kú nū nōo cē ɔ̄ ā kwɛyí italā.

eng_Latn: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ka Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu géē lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ gā um. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu kē í cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ka n wɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ okónu cē gā um, anyā kú Ujerúsālɛm, Ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ohumɔtū má, aá géē da ɔ́ ka unwū kú ihɔtū kú nū gáā ŋmó um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ,lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, gē ka ā da aótrɛyí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ā. Da uwá ka amíyɔ ɔ́ɔ ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo yēeyī ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, n gáā cɛ̄ gā uwɔ da um ɔ̄kā dúúmā ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
idu_Latn: Ami lɛbɛ̄ɛka okómpīinu á, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo bēhé ŋmá iyí um géē nyatá, ó géē ga eyīpú klla í wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ó klla géē má ácí í lé.

eng_Latn: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛcɛ le jíliyē klla le fīyégbúlú á. Aɛ́fu le kpó jíliyē jāā kwu etikpa kú uwā. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kwúcē igbīhi gā Udɛ́biri gaá le ɛfú kpó tá uwá.

eng_Latn: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla gbēyī ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhā kpɔɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okóohō ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ kpɔ́ á. Igbɛ́nyā, ó pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le aúpíla ɛpa kú oje udɔ ma. Éyééye kú uwā wɛ ikpó ofu ce ahāapa. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó kwu iyɔ̄bū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Éyééye kú uwā lɛ ogbló ō cíla anú nēe wɛ ikpó ahāapa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ami, nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā. N kē í hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā géē wā í kpɛ́fú tá Íjīpiti, amáŋ é géē yá kóō lɛ cīgbīhi abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔnū dúúmā le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu nēe bá gē nunu tū iyī uwā ipɔ́ɔnū ɔ́ɔmā í mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nēe bá nyā í wɛ ákú ācɛ Ulífāyi, é kē í lā anú. Ajɛ o lúúlé kú ɛna ā géē wɛ ákú ɛna mɛ́mla álá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ oklóbīya le pɛ́ wā gaá lɛ ɔ́ gbō, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ cabɔ̄ gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú ōcē obɔ̄bí ā, Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
idu_Latn: É jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɔdā olɔhi ō yá ŋ́ ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Ádā um, aá kē gáā má um glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ le Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é pó dúú ā. Amáŋ ɛlā nēé ka lɛ uwá ā í tīile lɛ uwá ŋ́, ohígbū kéē kpɔ́tūce ɛlā kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ nēé gaá je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā ŋ́, ayíka ē lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ́. Óndú alɔ, wā!.

eng_Latn: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da Ɛ́sta ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ gáā yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā glá ā? Iní nōó yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
idu_Latn: A nū um ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ŋ́. A kē je alelékwū ihɔ kú uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá yúúfi ŋ́, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā. Ɔtū kú aá kóō hɛ́ aá ko ŋ́. N géē hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá ajɛ ɛga oligbó ā. N kē í hɛ́ ayí aá tá ŋmá ɛga nēe bá gē cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ ā. Aá nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄bu ā géē kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ aá gaá lā ɛbɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla gáā tū aá ufi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo je ajɛ ā lɛ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā kóō fūla anú. Ó géē cíla ulé nú klla í lɛ ije ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ācojééyī ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nɛ̄ ogbāálá gē bī le pīya álá kú nū ɛyí ā. Ita nēé le túbá tɔ̄há gē yɔ̄ piyóó bɛ̄ɛka, oje nēé ge hɛ́ tū ɔcí ā. É ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ ɔ̄cogbāálá kú odúúdú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nēé gā Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm. Eko nēé gā ajɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gbɔɔ́ ō gwéeyē ohígbū ō wā kú uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyā kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā dɔɔ̄kā ka Unaómi ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi áā?.

eng_Latn: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔtulalī kú uwɔ ī kpóocu nɛ̄hi, O hī iyē kú uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtulālī nōo ī ōkpóocu nɛ̄hi gē mīyɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ tū abɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá nɛ̄ odúúdú ayípáncɛ́nyā gē yíhɔtū tū uwɔ piíí á.

eng_Latn: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gbɔɔ́ ō wā í kpɛ́fú ā, ācɛ Usiríya ā kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ le odúúdú aíne mɛ́mla ɛlā nōo nwū uwā ā tá tū ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ā. Ó da uwá ka eko nēe le bēhé ga ipú ajɛ nōo ī yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, cokónu nū lɛ aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī alɛwa ó le iyī nū mafú lɛ ācɛ nēe tīkpó mla anú ŋmá Ugálīli gā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ācɛ nēe kē wɛ ijáalí kú nū lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó hīgwú wā Ujerúsālɛm kéē gaá lɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā bī wā ɛga nōó tútū ā á.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ká Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō yɔ̄ gē je ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú nū ā lɛ odúúdú aá.

eng_Latn: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
idu_Latn: N gē tɔ́kpá fu aá, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, ohígbū keé habɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā tá lɛ aá ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: É le awulú nɛ̄hɛ́ kpó lɛ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é da uwá kéē lɔtūlé kéē mlɛ́nyɔ̄ lígíí kpɔ́ ɛ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ áluka kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa uwa mɛ́mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa uwā, ɛnɛ é gáā ŋmó bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā le jīla.

eng_Latn: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
idu_Latn: Aókómpinu igwɛ́ɛpa nēé gē bū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī kú Ujerúsālɛmā. Ó géē gbɔɔ́ ŋmá āyā ɛhícō kú igelī. Īkpō kú ɔwɛ nyā géē wɛ umíta úlā-ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā um, Ébrahām, mɛ́mla ádā um, Áyísīki, pó ɔkɔ kú um! Awɔ da um ká n̄ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ ádā um mɛ́mla ɛgiyí aɔ́máapú um á. A kē ka ka anúɔ géē yá um lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛnɔ kwú icō kóō fíyaajɛ eyī ōnyā á. Anú klla fu ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ kéē fíyaajɛ otú á. Anú gē tú ísu úgbagwú nōó ī cūwūu wūūū á. Iyē kú nū lé ka Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ipú úgbɔ́nya kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú úgbɔ́nya kú nū ɔhá ga Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á. É kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ikpámílī kú aádáádā nū ā. Ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm yēkwu kú nū ɛ̄cī alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ olɔfú kú ōwē cɛ̄ lɛ agbafú le gbo uwá, é klla má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ajɛ nēe hile nɛ̄ á mīyɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má: odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ugɛ́ssɔn.

eng_Latn: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ ɔ́ má kwɛyí, a géē kwú bɛ̄ɛka Árɔ̄ni, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú aógbló ā ú kpó bū eliká éyééye kú áklō kú ede ā. Ɔcí oplákátá nēé lɛ yá ede ā á. Ó kē lɛ ɔ́ kpípú cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄gɔ̄ tá ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedec king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
idu_Latn: Adonisédēki, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm le pó ka Ujóssuwa ɔ́ɔ le Ái yíífi dúúdú klla lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú nū ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā. Ó klla pó ka, ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn ɔ́ɔ le ɛbɔ́ yá mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe lā ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií nyā, Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, a lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔfiyɛ nɛ̄ alɔ bá gē cɛ̄ klla le alɔ kpó wā í lā ajɛ otīīhɔ nyā. Abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ nááná ā, a le oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ je lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā gē lɛ ɔtū tú uwá ī tíne á. Ádā aá kē jé ka aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ce aá ɛgbá.

eng_Latn: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD's anger come upon you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē nū á ŋmá amānyā, bɛ̄ɛka igbóngbō nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ga ɛbɛɛbɛ ā. Ɛ́ɛ́ kú ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kóō wā í klá aá, Gbɔbū lɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú géē ma ícɔ̄nū kú nū fú.

eng_Latn: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
idu_Latn: Ń gē bī eko kú um nyɔ̄ í cīce yɛhɛ mla ācɛ áncā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n jé ɔnyɛ mla ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́. Ipú ɛyí o tá ajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ ā, n klá kú um ofōōfū um le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi táajɛ.

eng_Latn: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
idu_Latn: Utímōti ɔ̄coyúklɔ ɔ́mpa um mā gē hókónu tū aá, kwu Ulusíyɔ̄si mɛ́mla Ujásin mɛ́mla Usosipáta, aɔ́mpa um ī hókónu tū aá dúú.

eng_Latn: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
idu_Latn: Ananíyāsi otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ogwɛ́ɛya ā je ɔda lɛ ācɛ nēe háyi pī ɔ̄ ā kéē lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ okónu.

eng_Latn: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
idu_Latn: A géē je íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā yá um ɛhi klla í kpó uwā tayínū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē kpó odée tū ipú ɛkpa ī je tayínū ā. Ā gēe je odúúdú ucē ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ n yá ā, cēklá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá le odúúdú ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu hīgwú wā í jīla mɛ́mla um ɛyí ɛfu kú Ukámɛlu, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya úlā cofɛpa cigwó kú ubáalu, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya úlā kú Ássɛ̄ra nēe gē lé ɔdōlé ɛyí ítēbulu kú Ujésēbɛlu ā.

eng_Latn: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ okónu icííci ce ipéyī Ɔwɔicō, kóō yá olɔhi o, kóō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó lɛ, ó le ɛpɔ̄bí lé ɔkwɔɔkwu nōó le ɔdā nōó yá ā jé ā.

eng_Latn: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnya ɛfú mɛ́mla ācɛ o kpɛ́fú ɔnya, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ Uféro a pɛ́ ga ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, Óndú ā lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ bī wā í klá uwá. Amáŋ, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yāwu ɛyí ajɛ o ŋuaŋ mókókó, ɔtahɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā klla pīya ɔkɔ da ɔnyā ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ unwalu kú uwɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔnyā nyā da um ka aá ká ɔ̄ kwú ɔyí um ú ŋmó, kú aá kwú ɛbɛ́ nū ú he lé, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kɔ́ɔ̄ géē je ɔyí nū he lé ɛ̄cī ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú akā ɛnɛ nyā wɛ ɛdɔ ékpónú. Éyééye kú uwā yɔ̄ ī cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā. Éyééye kú akā ā klla lɛ akā ɔhá nēe kwu ɔ́ɔ pīya cíla anú.

eng_Latn: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
idu_Latn: Ó géē gbā agbénú nōó lɛ bū ɔwɛ ují ā kwúcē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē gba ɔdōlé nōó le lé ā wā ɛcɛ ā. Ɔwɔicō géē mīyɛ ɔ̄ odúúdú nū kwúcē.

eng_Latn: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
idu_Latn: Ó má ɔdōlé kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, ɛga ōcice kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, īlī ōwu iyē yúklɔ́ kú uwā, īlī kú ācɛ nēe bá gē cɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū ā, mɛ́mla ɛya nɛ̄ ó gē gwó ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Okónu í kōō hɛ́ ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē má ɔdā dúúmā ka ŋ́. Ó le hídáagó lɛ abɔ̄ caagba cíí.

eng_Latn: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
idu_Latn: Ó géē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ, a kē í hī iyē nū ka UJÍSƆ̄SI. Ohígbū ka anú géē nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá íne nēé bīya á.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kɛlā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, aá gáā kwu ita nyā ɔhá ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gē kplá ɔ̄dā, é kē ī cíla ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ okpaakpa ā gē jɛ́ɛlā. É klla gē nwūlabɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ géē leyīkwu uwá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Ó ka, ɛ́ɛ géē nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā ipú ajɛ ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ í ma nyīla bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ufáyin ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lóofu bɛ̄ɛka ejé kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ otú le bī ā.

eng_Latn: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n gē gwɛ́ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ɛyí ede, nōó gwó lɛ Óndú ā, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū igbɛɛtá ipú iháyí. Ó klla gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gwó kwɛyí á.

eng_Latn: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyípɛ ā í jé ɔdā dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ í yá ā ŋ́. Ujonátan mɛ́mla Udéfīdi ōfōōfū uwā jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ í yá ā á.

eng_Latn: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ipú iháyí igwáahātá nɛ̄ Ujosíya lé ɔcɛ́ ā, Ísrɛ̄lu le ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé iyɔ́bū Óndú ā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, kócōō lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n gē je ka ā tá um abɔ̄ ā pó.

eng_Latn: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
idu_Latn: Adá ma Ujábalu, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ é bī īlī gwó á. Anú klla wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yi nōo gbɔ̄ɔ ō bī aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Usedekíya lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujeremíya, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ ɔ́ ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā wɛɛlɛ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ dúúmā fu alɔ? Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya tóohi kahíníī, Īī, Ɔwɔicō tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu aá gbóó. É géē je uwɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá aɔ́dā nēe ī yá uwā eyījii cɔhɔ́ɔ́há. Ācɛ nēe gbɛlá ka aá jíjééyī ā géē je pīya aólíla. Ɔdā nēé jé ā í je pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
idu_Latn: N jé ka aá lā ɛga nɛ̄ ebilíi ce ɔ̄cɛ ā ā. Aá háyi kpaakpa ga um, aá klla kē kpɔ́tuce um kpɔ́. Nááná nōó wɛ ipéeyi aá cāā nēé ŋmó Ántīpasi nōo ucē mɛ́mla ɛlā kú nū ī cīijáalí kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yɛce um ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ebilíi lā á ā.

eng_Latn: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā ufi wā í klá uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi nōo ī tá eko nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ī yā ā. Eko nɛ̄ ámíyā gaá klá awɔ, le uwɔ ɔtū wuklíicō ā, n kē í yɛhɛ tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɛ́sta nyā ā.

eng_Latn: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frēm ā wɛ úlā ofigwɛ́ɛtá ce úlā igwó ce ofigwo . É géē wɛ ígwu ɔ́mɛɛtá nēe bɛ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
idu_Latn: Ami kpó aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú ɛfú wā í nū aá inya á. Amáŋ n lɛ uwá kpó pi tū ɛháajɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā. É má gwōnū, é kē cāŋjɛ glá gɛ ŋ́. É le pɛ́ gekwū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá gē nyí ā.

eng_Latn: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī tū um ufi nɛ̄ ń lɛ īyī um ŋ́ mā, ń má okónu dúúmā ka ɔkɔ mɛ́mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ojuja ā yɔ̄ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, é gáā nyɛ̄ɛ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ é bá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
idu_Latn: Óndú ékpó yɔ̄ á, alɔ kē lɛ ɔwɛ ékpó nɛ̄ alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, ɛdɔ ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō ékpó nēe kpó tū alɔ ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká n̄ lɛ ijē gwó ga awɔ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū ā mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin hī tá ɛyí ɛfu, nɛ̄ ajɛ kú nū lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā ka, ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú Umanásɛ ā le ede gwó kwu Ugílīlɔtu, ābɔ̄ kú āyā kú Ujɔ́dan nōo wɛ ákú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
idu_Latn: N gaá yá ɔdā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē túbla ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
idu_Latn: Ó gā ɛga otīhɔ éyi eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le táajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le gbo abɔ́ɔ á. Ó má gwutá kwú ɛyí ú ce ɛcɔ̄ kóō gbɔlā.

eng_Latn: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyāba nōo ŋmá Ussaálbɔn ā. Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujássen. Ujonátan.

eng_Latn: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, ó lā iháyí úlā ce ofuciigwó. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nēe wɛ ijáalí kú ɔtóōce lɛ alɔ yɛ jīlatá biílí bɛ̄ɛka ojuja āa, ká ālɔ̄ lɛ aɔ́dā dóódu nēe ī gbájí tū alɔ ikpó ā mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íne nēe ī he alɔ ɔtū ōbīya ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ yéékpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ kwinya nēé tū lɛ alɔ ɔgbínya nēe yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē ohígbū ka aá lɛ eyīyōce. Aá lɔ́tūle eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ī junwalu lɛ aá. Aá híī hɛ́ bené ŋmá ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá ī gbā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
idu_Latn: Ɛyīnyinyi kú ɔnyīlɔ ā le mu Ujísɔ̄si ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó nā abɔ̄ daa lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N tíne, le yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je okónu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ce ā nyílá, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ ŋ́ māa?.

eng_Latn: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
idu_Latn: Eyī ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, olīkpō kú īlī ukɔ́tin ā kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofu ce ɛpa, mɛ́mla ogbló igwó mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ igwó.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā, gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā wɛ úlā igwáahātá ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī mla ɔdōojé nēé gē bī le gwó ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔkpá ce iyī um ka ń gáā hɔ́ɔkɔ ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwó ɛdɔ ɛya ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ocu kú nū í he Óndú ā ɔtū. Aá í gwɛ́ɛya kú ejé aā ɛ̄cī dóódu dúú.

eng_Latn: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Uréhum mɛ́mla Ussímss­­āyi mīyɛ ohi kú ɔkpá nēé tá ŋmá ɛgíyí ɔcɛ́ Átasásɛsi ā, é le yɛ bōōbū gaá lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bā í gwó igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, úklɔ́ ā ci.

eng_Latn: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
idu_Latn: Ucérūbim ɔhá wɛ ōmiya ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá nɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, anúɔ le eko éyi tū, nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá uwā italā, ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ́ɛ bá ī yá ā dúú. Nááná nɛ̄ anúɔ tínē ō yá ɔdōlɔhi lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka otɛtɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā da odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛmla ācɛ ā kahíníī, É cíkā ō lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā, kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó. Ohígbū koó lɛ ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu igelī nyā. Aá abɔ̄yī aá kē pó ɛlā nōó ka ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a lé umaná ā iháyí ofɛpa jāā gbéeko nēé wā ajɛ kú Ukénan, ɛga nēé lā ā.

eng_Latn: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā okpóocu olɔhi nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá fu tū ipú ɔlá kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛya nōó gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ocu kú nū gē nyíla ga ɛgiyí ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ gē nyatá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ gē bí ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka ɔ́dāŋ keé kwú ɔ̄cɛ ú lɛ Óndú ā kóō yá jīla kú okónu nēé ce ā, é géē fūla ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā glá, ŋmá lɛ ō cílá ije nōo yɔ̄ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ í wɛ ɛlā nū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da Ussímēyi ká ɔ̄ cá anúɔ ɛcá ā, ɔnyɛ ɔ́ɔ lɛ íkwu ō da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá lɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ ōtīkwū bá nyā mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú oblatū nyā wɛ ijáalí kú alɔ. Ń gáā gla ɛcɔ̄ ō tīkwū bá ámāŋ ka ɛcɔ̄ ō blatū nyā gaá kpɔ́fú kwu uwɔ ŋ́. Á kē gáā gla uwá gaá kpɔ́fú kwu um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
idu_Latn: Óndú ālɔfú kú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú a bī wā ooŋmóɛyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ ā da alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛhīlī ā kahíníī, Lɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛnɛ nēé gbōbáajɛ ísu nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Uyúfarētīisi ā, hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā géē bɛ́yíkwu Ujúda í je ɔ́ yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ̄cɛ ā ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ í dɔ̄ɔka ka ɔ́ɔ́ blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ŋmó Ahímɛ́lɛ̄kii ɔyí kú Ujerúbēssɛ̄ti lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ í da ɔ́ ka ɔnyā éyi ɔ́ɔ tá ɛgɔ̄ o gbɔ̄dā kpó ŋmá ɛyí ɔdɔ kú Utébēs wāajɛ wā í ŋmó ɔ̄ á. Ó ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ klla í ka kpɔ́ ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ túblá ɔdɔ ā lɛ āa? Ujówābu klla da ɔ́ ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ le da ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɛfú ɔ́ɔ le ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Uríya, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā lé dúú.

eng_Latn: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálá nɛ̄ aágábá bá ī nū uwá inya, ī fíyá uwā ákátā ā. Aflɛ́yí ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā le ɛfú kpó tú uwá. Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, klla wā í je uwá yíífi ámōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
idu_Latn: O yá ɛɛ́ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō jé eko kú úklɔ́ kú nū ā, odúúdú uwá, kwu ayípɛ̄ kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ, kwu ācɛ nēe gē klɔɔcɛ ā, odúúdú uwá gē tū ūlī ɛ́ɛ́, nēé gē jé eko kú úklɔ́ kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aɔ́dōōyēeyī nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ō cɛ̄ ā, le wu wā ɛgiyí um, bī ahɔ̄lá nōó jē ŋmá ipú ɔlá kú ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe pó ɔdā nōo yá ā lɛ ɔ́ tɔ́ɔtu bá gē dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɔyí nyā géē wɛ eko nōó le jɛ ā? Ohígbū koó céyēgēdē ka ɔfú kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú Ulífāyi, ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerári ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā á. É géē yúklɔ́ kú uwā ā ɛháajɛ kú Utáma, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ɛkpa o bɔ́tū kú īlī lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kóō bī lɛ jé ɔdā, nōo wɛ ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ɔdā ékpónú nāa bī le yá ɛ́fɔ̄du ā, mla ɛdɔ kú ijā o he tū ɔ̄ éékpó ɔ́ɔmā, nēé géē he tū ɔ̄ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu le tá ipú inu ɛgiyī ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi gaá le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kóō lɛ eko je lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ géē lɛ ɔ̄na ā mɛ́mla ɛyí nū ā kpó ka lɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ka é bī īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yá ejé nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he uwá. Mɛ́mla anɔ̄ nōo í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gwéeyē, klla mla ɔdōlé nōo ó cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ lɔfú iyē ā.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā kóō yá ā wɛ ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ ahɔ̄ pi lɔfú lɔfú klla da ɔ́ ka.

eng_Latn: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe má ɔdā nōo yá ā le da ācɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ, Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um ā kē í tá um ohi.

eng_Latn: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
idu_Latn: N wā ká n̄ yá ká ā lɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nōo gáā yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū ā jé. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛbɛ oōmá lɛyíkwu ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nɛ n.

eng_Latn: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ogbɛhá ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ayíka ɔyí álá ékpónú ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lā ā. Ó kē lɛ ɔyí álá ā bī jɛ̄. Ɔyí álá ā jɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayí nū. Ó gē je ɔdōlé kú anú abɔ̄yīnū lɛ álá ā lé. Álá ā klla ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ikókwu kú ɔ̄cɛ ā abɔ̄yīnū. Ka ɔnyīlɔ ā ɔ́ɔ je álá ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū āa.

eng_Latn: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo mīyɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ó géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá úklɔ́ kú nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá úklɔ́ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú yɔ̄ ī kpó eyīyɛcɛ kú igelī, ɔkpɛtá mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí kē bá ī ŋmó ācɛ ipú igelī ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ eyīyɛcɛ ipú ɛhɔ̄, ɛfú géē je ɔ́ lé. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ipú igelī ā, ɔkpɛtá mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí géē je ɔ́ɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ójīla okɛpɔ̄ ā bá gē tíne ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kéē cɛ̄ tū Ujísɔ̄si, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú ikwū nɛ̄ n húmáyī je kéē wā í tá um abɔ̄ ā le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. Ɔkɔ kú um kwú ŋmó ɛɛ́. Agīje kwú eyī kú um í kpó mi, ohígbū ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je gē tíne ɔ̄cɛ nōo í wā í tá um abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le bīya lɛ ayíkpó ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā éyééye kahíníī, Ami nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ɛcɔ̄ ɔtángbéde le gwó inɔ̄ɔda kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ ācogbāajɛ gē ce ā. N klla ī bī ɛcɔ̄ nōo gē fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá, í le yá aókompinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. N klla ī bī ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá le gwó ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
idu_Latn: Aá híī hɛ́ inyīlɛ̄yí kú aá áklō ikpɛ̄yí, ámāŋ gbɛ́ ɔnwū kú aá wāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī je ɔ́da lɛ aícɔ́ ja kú nū. Aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā, lɛwa nɛ̄hi, é klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā í wā ā wɛ ɛ̄cī ō tūufi nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄nyɛ géē bū ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā glá?.

eng_Latn: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú um gwutá agōdō ā, ocu kú ɔtulalī kú um kpó klá anú kpɛmm.

eng_Latn: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
idu_Latn: Odōtayínū kú ɔ́bíipu nyā gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ tayínū dúú ɛɛ́, ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā í gáā yá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī kwú odée ā tū kóō yá ŋ́ mā ŋmá ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ aláadi ahāapa ka, ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ācīije ɔhá tá lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi īkpɔ̄dā olɔhi tū ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā, gē ga Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m o ŋmá eko ga eko gē nyɔ̄ ī leyīkwu aálá kú ádā nū.

eng_Latn: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugílɛ̄di, ɔyí kú Umákīru, ɔyí nɔ̄nyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umanásɛ, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ujóɛ̄fu ā, le tá ɛgiyí Umósīsi mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu gaá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ otáabɔ nēe bá nyā lɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā yá lɔɔlɔhi, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá o hile géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, é klla í kɛlā mla íkwu lɛyí kwu ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
idu_Latn: Ó fíyaajɛ ga ɛga dóódu mla ɔlá mla oceyī nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwohɔ́gwā ā. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ofíyaajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi nōo ī mafú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ má ā, n má gwutá ajɛ kwú eyī í pīya klá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ í kɛlā. Ɛnya ā mafu ɛgahi kú Óndú á.

eng_Latn: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
idu_Latn: É kē ī tá ɛgba jāā gaá bī aɛ́cɔ̄ nēé tikwū bá ā, klla ī tá ɛgba yɛ pi ápátɛ́cɔ̄ tá biílí.

eng_Latn: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ogbló ofu nēe í wu ígbóoje-otáajɛ ofu, nɛ̄ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔ́kpa nēé yá mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā géē bī ɔ̄ háyi.

eng_Latn: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gāājɛ Usírākɔsi, alɔ yá ɛ̄cī ɛtá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
idu_Latn: Ká odúúdú ayááyí nū kéē le pɛ́ gekwú ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ, ká iyē kú nū kóō gebí tāajɛ dúúdú ipú aɛ́gɔ́ ɔ́mpa nēe gbocē ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá ma ɔ̄ tá céé. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ ā? Ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi nōó yá ga um á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ébrahām kahíníī, É kpó ɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ce ācɛ Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra. Ɔ́bíipu nēé bi ā kē le nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ifu kú ɔnɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tá mɛ́mla ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ipú nū ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī yɔ̄, nōo ge tá um ɔtū lé ŋ́. Ɔtū le he odúúdú aólɛlā kú um ohígbū unwalu mɛ́mla ífi nēé bī wā í klá um ā. Óndú ā, lɛ ɛ̄cī nāa cokónu nū ā bī wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ōwē yá aólɛ̄la kú um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n má dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ɛháajɛ ɛga oligbó ā wɛ ákú uwā. Aá ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kwu ɛjī kú Ɛ́dɔm ā wɛ, Ukabusíli, Ɛ́da mɛ́mla Ujágu.

eng_Latn: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm lā Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ɛpa, nōó bī ikpēyī kú nū le má ɔcɛ́, ádā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú uwɔ ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé yá uwɔ í lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nāa gbo ɔ́bíipú ō bī ā.

eng_Latn: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ísu mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú uwá dóódu í pīya oyī. Ó klla yá kú ɛbéenyi kú uwá dóódu kéē le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ̄nū kú alɛɛcɛ dóódu ā gē yá ká ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra uwɔ fíyɛ́. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛfú í je kpó lé ŋ́ mā, géē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā eko kú aúcɛ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
idu_Latn: Aá nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá yá aá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, aá bī obɔ̄bí le cíla ulé obɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwá ŋ́, aá ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí ká ācɛ nēe gē ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí ká aá ā ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā da Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce uwá, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā kú aá yá á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí nēe gāa hile ipú ajɛ a gē le téteté a, nɛ̄ ɔyípɛ̄ éyi gēe gbo uwá Áluka glá.

eng_Latn: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ le íne kú anúɔ alɛwa tá tāajɛ lɛ uwá, amáŋ é tá íne ā, gē má íne ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ɔhá nēé jé uwā jéjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔcí, ácí mɛ́mla ēpū mɛ́mla ɔcí nōo gē gwā īkpō ā, kéē le bū ŋmá ajɛ, kéē gwá īkpō kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwa lɛ ā. Ó kē le yá lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi Íbisan ā, Ɛ́lɔ̄n ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn kwú pīya ɔcohɛ́pɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí igwó.

eng_Latn: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbaálá ī gbō aálá ā. Ó klla bī uwā jé ɔwɛ bū ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni ā wɛ ācɛ Úlá ofɛtá cigwóléyi ce ācɛ ofigwó nēe le iyɛ́fú ō kpo nwū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
idu_Latn: O yɔ̄ yɛɛ ā, áyɔ́kpá ā kwú ŋmó ohígbū ɔwɔ nōó yā tū ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é hī ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ peyī ā igwú igbo ɔ́mpa, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ okónu ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō ka anúɔ í kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi. Alɔ jé ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o bīyíne.

eng_Latn: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í háyi iyɔ̄bū aólɛlā kú uwá nuunu tá uwā glá ŋ́ má. É le pɛ́kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwā, ohígbū ka é kwú pīya ɔdā kú ífi ɛɛ́. N klla gáā yɔ̄ mla aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔdēelihɔ ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú aá.

eng_Latn: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ācɛ olagbénú ɛhi, amáŋ gē pīya aógbɛhá tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ agbénú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, géē je gbɛhá igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛcī ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́ɛ cɛ̄ ka Óndú ā ɔɔ́ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ okónu ce ka aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū, klla í lɛ uwá tū.

eng_Latn: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Ugílɛ̄di, Uhamóléketi ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Íssɔ̄du, Abíyɛ̄sa mɛ́mla Umáhila.

eng_Latn: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, Usólōmɔn gē lɛ oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū fíyɛ́ ígbó oje úlā éyi ce ofu igwɛ́ɛta ce ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ bōōbū, nōo gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō gbɔɔ́ ō bū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō tá ɛgba kwu ajɛ lɔfú dúú, nɛ̄ owu olɔfú gē tá ī je ɔ́ fu tónū ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ owu mu uwá nēé gē je kpó yíífi dúú á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mpa kú ɛfú ā, Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ācɛ Ulákisi yálé bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o yá Ulíbna lé ā. É kē mā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā tá ŋ́ dúú. É le uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíya nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā? Aá cāŋjɛ kú aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá já aá má ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Udéfīdi kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ kahíníí, N gē má Óndú ā iyɔ̄bū um eko dóódu, ɔdā dúú í gáā tū um ufi glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
idu_Latn: Ó tá ācīije ɔhá lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpō kú kú ɔcí nɛ̄ é hī Umɔ́stāādi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ́ nyi ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
idu_Latn: É gē lá aúgbɔ́nya ŋmá jīpiti wā, īkpīje nēé hī usɛ́kɛlu úlā éyi ce ofu igwó kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́. É kē ī lá ɔnya éyi mla usɛ́kɛlu ofahāapa ce igwó. Iyē kú uwā nēé gē yɛ ŋmá ga ɛgiyí aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Usiríya á.

eng_Latn: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā hīgwú ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū dóódu ká, Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá kóō kwú ɔyí álá amáŋ opī kú iháyí éyi ú cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú aá ká aá lé ucɛ kú Onyatá ā.

eng_Latn: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
idu_Latn: É le jīla tɔ̄há kéē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nāa tɛtɛ le miya táajɛ kóō géē yá ā yá, a lɔfú miya ɔ́ ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā glá ohígbū ɔfú mɛ́mla ɔdā nāa cɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ nēe bīya íne klla gē bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́ ā kpó yíífi. Ó kē í kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe cīgbīhi kwu ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ­ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛyíkwu ayí Ulífāyi ā yá kpɛ́mm. Ayí kú Ulífāyi ā géē lɔfú yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɛháajɛ kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ ɔkɔ ō lɛ ɛyí bū ɔ̄. É bī owú lɛ ɔkɔ kú nū ā wu lɔfú nɛ̄hi kóō híī híla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ohígbū uwā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɔ̄nū mla anúɔ klla le okónu tá lɛ anúɔ ka anúɔ í gáā bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ajɛ olɔhi ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n géē cɔ̄nū tū aá, í yá aá ōwē āa, aéwɔhá ā, í má ɔ̄, ufi nɛ̄hi géē kwú uwā. Ɔ́ɔmā kē ī nwū uwā ɛlā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, uwēyī géē kwú aá, aéwɔhá ā kē í yá aá ɛbɛ́. Ami, Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, aá le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, klla lɛ ācɛ kpó kwāājɛ ohígbū uwā, otū mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī kɛlā nōo gē tūwēyī, ɛlā obɔ̄bí, amáŋ ɛla icííci ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá tū Ɔwɔicō ahínyá kú ɔdā nōó yá lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ anú ōfōōfūnū jɛ́yí ɔdā dóódu, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā. Aamí.

eng_Latn: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
idu_Latn: N lɔfú ka ucē kú alɛɛcɛ ámāŋ ákú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ glá, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kú ɔ̄cɛ í he um ɔtū ŋ́, ɔkɛ̄lā kú um géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágōgō ō yúuya icííci amáŋ ka anwa kú oje icííci ā.

eng_Latn: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyēlu, Óbɛ́di, mɛ́mla Ujaásīyɛ́ ŋmá Umésba.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ka, Umósisi ɔ́ɔ je íne ɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwá ohígbū ɔtū ō lɔfú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ōhī le pɛ́ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm wā Ántīyɔ̄ku.

eng_Latn: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ kú uwɔ géē cīgbīhi wā amānyā, eko kú ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ kú uwɔ ā. Ohígbū ka ń gáā nū ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ŋmá ajɛ ā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ íne nēé bīya lɛ nwuné nɛ̄hi cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ italā yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya āa géē ka kéē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ kú inu nɛ̄ odée ā yɔ̄ ā fu wɛ̄ɛcɛ, kéē klla kwú uwá ú tá ga ɛga o tēelihɔ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da odúúdú ācɛ ā, kwu ācɛnyā ā, kahíníī, Aá pó ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú aá, nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe bá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū, nēe lɔfú ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ā gbaáluka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā wɛ:.

eng_Latn: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
idu_Latn: . Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā ú pīya ɔcɛ́ anɔ́ɔ ó pīyɛyí gā ɔlɛ́ á. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ igwó ā hīgwú gé lɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ itene nēé lɛ ŋmá ɔ́hí kú uwā ā jé.

eng_Latn: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies, and the LORD thy God hath delivered them into thine hands, and thou hast taken them captive,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le aólɛlā kú uwā yálé ɔgbɛ́fú, ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lɛ ācɛ ā kpó kwú wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ yɛ mla ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū yɔ̄ ipú ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, alɔ ī lɛ olétɔ̄há mla iyī alɔ, oyī kú Oyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū Ujísɔ̄si kē le alɔ na ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā.

eng_Latn: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ í gáā wɛ ɛdɔ kú ācɛ nēe kwúcē igbīhi, nēé lɛ uwá yíífi ā ŋ́. Ikoko ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō anɔ́ɔ ó le alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá ucɛ kú onyatá kú Óndú ā, ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā éyi.

eng_Latn: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the LORD for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usáyímɔ̄n tóohi kahíníī, Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā ohígbū um, ká ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ká ā kóō wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔkpɛtā klá aá nōo í kpó aá yíífi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyī géē lɔnɔ tū ɔ̄cɛ iyē ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ géē ŋmó aá á. N kē gáā je ɔdōlé lɛ aá ŋ́.
