eng_Latn: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
idu_Latn: A híī yá olɔhi glɛjī ajɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē jíjéeyī nɛ̄hi glɛjī ajɛ ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nāa gē ŋmó iyī uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
idu_Latn: Ó le eliká kú ugóolu ɛnɛ ō bī je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ, yá kwu ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɔdā nēé le oje udɔ wúlá wúlá pla tū ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ oyɔ́dābɔ̄fú, ɔdíyá nāa gē bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí nāa yá ācɛ olɔhi ā gwó āa?.

eng_Latn: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: ācɛ nēe lɛ áfū nya ɔdɔ ā ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɛbɔ́ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ka Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā i ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gē je ajɛ lɛ aéwo dóódu á, Anú gē ka ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ cíkā ō lā á. Ó lɛ ɔwɔ o gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā je lɛ éwo dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gaá háyi okómpinu kú ɛga nēé bá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ ka, Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe yɛce Óndú ā kéē le pɛ́ wā abɔ̄ nyā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi gaá le jīla tū ō biílí.

eng_Latn: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
idu_Latn: Aá gē yá odée bɔ̄ɔdā nēé le Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kɔ̄ ɛga alɛwa nōó, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ŋ́ mā. Upɔ́lu wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé hɛ́ bá ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá á nɛɛ? É kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū aá ɛyí ká aá le pīya ācɛ o yɛce Upɔ́lu nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ajɛ kú uwā nyīlɔwá tōōtū ɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nōó cokónu lɛ ádáádā uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔcɛ́, ágábáidu, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ka a jāhɔ̄ gā um, ka lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā da uwɔ nyā yá. Kóocōō, a je um kwúcē ga agbá ɔlɛ Ujonátan ɔhá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a kwú um kwúcē ga inu agbá ɔ́ɔmā ɔhá kpɔ́, ayíka n géē kwú abɔ́ɔ piií.

eng_Latn: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, bī iyē kú Óndú ā lɛ ɔkpá gbo ce īyī nū ka Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ ka Adónīja ɔ́ɔ kwú ohígbū ɛ̄ba nōó ba ā ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
idu_Latn: Aá le odúúdú ɔdā nōo cɛgbá ā lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Aá le jāgbénú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Aá le pīya ɔcɛ́ nááná nɛ̄ alɔ í wɛ ŋ́ má ā? Ó lɔhi, eyī yá um kú aá le pīya ɔcɛ́ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ pīyatɔ̄ha mla aá.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gáā kpó ācɛ ā ŋmá úklɔ́ āa? Aá bá ipú úklɔ́ kú aá cíí.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníi Cāŋjɛ, ɔdíyá nāa lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayínɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla aóklóbīya mɛ́mla aáncɛ́nya Ujóbu tɛtɛ ā, wā í lé klla gwá mɛ́mla anú ɔlɛ́ nū. É lɛ abɔ̄ ce Ujóbu iyē, klla tá ɔ̄ ɔtū lé ohígbū odúúdú unwalu, mɛ́mla ákanya nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ nēe yá ɔ̄ ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá je ije mɛ́mla eliká kú oje ɔdɔ lɛ Ujóbu.

eng_Latn: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛɛcɛ nōó le yēŋēē ŋ́ mā í gáā ma ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yēŋēē glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú ācɛ Ujúda ā, klla je omíci lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú igɛ́mɛ́nti kú Upɛ́sīya kéē lɛ úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ci. É bā í je unwalu nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá eko nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si wɛ Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Udáyírɔsi je pīya ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
idu_Latn: N géē wā í tū ācɛ Ubábīlɔn iyē bɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ūpū nɛ̄hi kú Ujɔ́dan ā gaá kwaá lɛ ɔwá kú aálá nēe bá ī lé ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ kwu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā. Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn kē í kwinya igbledū ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ n kē lɛ otrɛ̄yí nōo he um ɔtū fu kóō gbō abɔ́ɔ. Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā glá? Ɔnyɛ kē lɛ abɔ̄ gbō um ɔtū glá āa? Ɔcɛ́ nyá kē bɛ̄yíkwu um glá ā?.

eng_Latn: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n hɛ́ uwɔ oji nū ā gā awɔ, ipéyī odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
idu_Latn: Aá wā, kú ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, kú alɔ gwíijē kú éeyē lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī gbō alɔ, klla ī nya alɔ tá ā.

eng_Latn: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla kahíníī, Ń gáā blakwu íne nēé bīya ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kē kwú āyā kú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n kóō wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí igwáahāapa nɛ̄ Upɛ́ka, ɔyí kú Urɛmalíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Áhāsi ɔyí kú Ujótam le ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé.

eng_Latn: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu, Ulɛ́fāyi nēé ma Usáyíprɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā hī ka Ubánābasi ā .

eng_Latn: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Usɛ́kɛm mɛ́mla Ubɛtimílo le pīya tɔ̄há le pɛ́ ga ɔkwu kú ɔcí óokú nōo kwú pīyɛ ɔ́kpa kú ɛcí nōo kwu abɔ́ɔ ā, gāá kwú Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ú yá ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē je ōhī kú oyī kú ɛya nēé gwó ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ā le nya aɔ́cí kú odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́cí kú odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú okómkpinu nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú ɔkpá nyā n gē tá ɔdā ōhī tɛ́ɛcɛ péee, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tū aá ɛlá kwu āyā kú ɔkpá nyā. N lɔtū ohígbū úklɔ́ ɛfiyɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō jē gā um.

eng_Latn: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā nōó lɛ ā. Ó le hɛ́ Ísu nēé hī ka Uyúfrētīisi ā bēhé, lɛyíkwu ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú úwé ú wiyē, ká ā kwú áblákpá kú uwɔ ú wu ikpó. Ó le yá lɛ aá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú úwé eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú uwɔ ú wiyē, ká ā yɛce um.

eng_Latn: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛpa bá gē nuunu, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā tíne ō tá ɔbá nū abɔ̄ o ŋmá lɛ o gaá bī apī kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ gē nuunu mlá ɔbá nū ā.

eng_Latn: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɛhīlī le gla ā, anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɔtū kú nū yéékpónū kóō lɛ odée yá. Anɔ́ɔ ó gáā le pīya tɔ̄há mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ nēe bá ā: Asárīya ɔyí kú Ujɛ́rōham, Ísimɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ujehóhānan, Asárīya ɔyí kú Óbɛdi, Umaásēya ɔyí kú Adisáya mɛ́mla Ɛlíssāfati, ɔyí kú Usikiri.

eng_Latn: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
idu_Latn: Aágábá igwɛ́ɛpa klla háyi abɔ́ɔ, éyééye ā háyi ɛyí íkpó, kú ɛga ōyɛ ga icō kú akpa ɛhīlī ā. É leyī kpó pīya kwu akpa ā. Ɛdɔ akpa nyā í yɔ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔhá jéjée ɛ́ɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ um géē hɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu tá glá āa? Ipɔ́ɔma kú um í lɔfú ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aípɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ á. Ami í kē cɛgbá ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um á.

eng_Latn: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya kwú kwu gaá tayínū ɛga éyi Usamérīya. Anɔ́ɔ é tíne nū gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gé lɛ Ujéhu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó, é nyi okwū nū ipú ojīlīmā kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ádā nū Ujɛhósāfati nōo yá ɔdā dóódu kóō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipíinu kú Ahasíya í hile nōo géē lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ oblatū kú ɛ̄cī nēé ma Uhérɔ̄du ā le yá ā, Uhérodīyasi lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ó húmáyī dɔɔ̄kā ā má. Anɔ́ɔ Uhérɔ̄du lɛ ucɛ yá klɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú igɛ́mɛ́nti, mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīmā kú Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Óndú ā kɛlā, gē hī odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā igwú ŋmá ɛga dóódu wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu kú eko nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam je pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ása lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda lé.

eng_Latn: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
idu_Latn: Ā cījáalí tū ɔ́mpa uwɔ icííci ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ce ɔ́ icííci ŋ́.

eng_Latn: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
idu_Latn: É gē ka kahíníī, Ōcē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi gē yá ɔ̄ á, ó klla gáā wi ŋmá ōcē nyā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhíram mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Usólōmɔn nyā, ɔtū he ɔɔ nɛ́hi. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā klla tá ɔ̄ ahínya. Anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ je ɛdɔ ɔyí ójéeyī nyā lɛ Udéfīdi, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú éwo nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyā kwɛyí nū eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa nēe bá ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ yɔ̄ ī pi uwá ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Aá híīī ga ɛgiyí éwɔhá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kē ī ga aígelī kú Usamérīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
idu_Latn: É géē fūla aɔ́kplá ā, eko nēé le pīya ɔyā éyi. Ɔ́lá kú oōfūla kú uwā ā wɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
idu_Latn: mla ikpɔ́nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē cē, eyī ōkwu ɔdā ācɛ, ɛdɔ kú odōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá, ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā bī ācɛ ɔhá iyē, ɔbɔ́ōcɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ í ya, ɔdā kú olila nɛ̄ ācɛ í yá ā.

eng_Latn: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
idu_Latn: Ó jé ɔdā dóódu hɛ̄ ɔnɔ kú ɔkpíyē kú nū mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí kú īyī nū tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
idu_Latn: É le hɛ́ óókpoó ā igbó gā ajɛ kú Ugenésareti, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ́kɔ kú uwā ú wāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ojuju yá mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú ígwíígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja úlā ɛpa cofigwó mɛ́mla ofɛhɔ̄ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū géē gwó lɛ Óndú ā á, eko nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā ɛyí kóō kwú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya á. Ɛ̄cī nēé le abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí ā, ó géē bī okoolo éyi kú umu ojōnjīlɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē miya ikpɔ̄dā kú ɛcí dóódu ā. É géē bī āyā éyi kú nū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, āyā ɔhá kú nū ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
idu_Latn: A géē tá īlī ō klá odée ɛpa ɔhá kpɔ́, éyi kú nū kóō wɛ ɔkpá kú omlede ō kpó bá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ o tɛ̄ɛ̄tū nɔ̄wá mla ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ olɔhi nɛ̄hi ɔhá, nōo géē klá iyɛ̄cɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē híī nwūla ɔwɛ kú igelī ā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī ɔ́ɔ le nyā lɔɔlɔhi. Ó ka anúɔ klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gbɔɔ́ ō gaajɛ, kéē lɛ ɔwɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó gwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ igodó kpó kwu ɔ́. Kéē klla lɛ ogbló kú ɔwɛ ā kpó wu ɔ́. Unehemíya ka anúɔ klla da uwá kéē lɛ ācɛ fu ŋmá igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm kéē bá í gbāajɛ okónu ɔwɛ dóódu. Ká ē klla bá ī yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā biílí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bēē jīla ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwú alɔ ka ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ kú uwá ā, dɔ̄ɔkā kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ijē gwó lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Aá lɛ ijē gwó lɛ alɔ lɛyíkwu Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá híīī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ó yá ká alɔ mafú ka alɔ le yá lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ ŋ́, amáŋ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔdā okpaakpa, nááná nōó lɛbɛ̄ɛka alɔ mágwōnū ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si ka ɛ̄nyā kú Upíta kóō le jé ka ɛdɔ kú ikwū nɛ̄ ó géē kwú ā í yá kú ācɛ kóō lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō. Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka kwɛyí ā, ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū wu ipú oyī ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ mī klá iyɔ̄bū ukɔ́tin ā igbo ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú iháyí kú ɔkpɛtā ā kóō wā ā, Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa, nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū, Asɛ́nāt, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Upɔtifɛ́ra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Uhɛliyopɔ́lis ā ma lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá híīī yúúfi ŋ́! N bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi wā gē lɛ aá, nōo géē yá kú odúúdu ācɛ kéē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ igbīhi ɛ̄cī igwó ā, kú aá lɛ alɔ mɛ́mla ayípōklóbīya nōo gē lé ɔdōlé olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kpó í miya ɔhá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a géē má lɛ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ a géē yá mla alɔ piyóó á.

eng_Latn: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Mla ocíbú kú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó nōo géē le mu mla ɔtulalī.

eng_Latn: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je aɔ́lɛ́ uwā, mɛ́mla aájɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā kpó lɛ aólɛhɔ̄ kú uwā. N gē bī ɔfú kú um le yá ācɛ nēe lā ipú ajɛ nyā ā italā.

eng_Latn: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, aá géē jɛ́yí ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā, ohígbū ka odúúdú aá jé íne ā lɔɔlɔhi. Íne ā gē nā ācɛ nēe yēeyī ā tɔ́ɔwɛ eko nēé yēeyī ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Utɛ́ra gaá lā Umítīka.

eng_Latn: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N wɛ ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna ipú ígbíli. Aá lɛ ɔwɛ kú Óndú ā gllágwó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú aá, géē je agbénú mla ɔdu mla ije ɔ́sú kú aá ā kpó. E géē je ɔdɔ kú aá pīyeyī klá ajɛ, klla í je inu abahi kú aá ā kpó fíyákátā klá ajɛ. É géē kpo ɛcɔ̄, ɔcí, mla oje mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá le gwó inu ā kpó tá tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
idu_Latn: Ó klla le da uwá ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda kú iháyí dóódu ā, é géē lɛ ɔ́ tū kóō wɛ ɛ̄cī omlɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́mla éeyē mɛ́mla ucɛ ō lé.

eng_Latn: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé gē kpó iyó úklɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdōlé kú nū bá mɛ́mla aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū tū ā tú gwó. Ó gwó odúúdú ɔdā dóódu nōó tíne ō gwó ā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē le tá Unásārēti mla uwá á. Ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kpó tū ipú ɔtū kú nū.

eng_Latn: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē má ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne nōó je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ayááyí kú ayí kú Unówa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā, mɛ́mla aéwo kú uwā lɛ ā á. O ŋmá aéwo nyā, nɛ̄ ācɛ nyīla klɛ́ɛcɛ igbīhi kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo kpó ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
idu_Latn: Usekaríya ɔyí kú Ubébāyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubébāyi mɛ́mla ācɛ ofu ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kahíníī, N yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka ń gbɛlá ka ācɛ o yúúfi Ɔwɔicō bá amānyā ŋ́, keé géē ŋmó um cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔnyā um ā.

eng_Latn: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
idu_Latn: Ami nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú ipú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá á, nááná Ɔwɔicō kwú ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ nyā ú gā um kú um tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā lɛ aílɔ́wá lɛ́yíkwu ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ alɔ jé ā.

eng_Latn: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
idu_Latn: Ukɛ́dɛssi, Ujokinéyām, ipú Ukármelu.

eng_Latn: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
idu_Latn: A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aólɛ̄la kú um wɔ́tū um lɛ klla le ujɔ̄ tū tū um kéē je um ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔmā éyééye kéē bá mla uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē tú uwɔ abɔ̄ ā bá á. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ā wɛ Ɛlísɔ ɔyí kú Ussɔ́diyu.

eng_Latn: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi igwó ɔhá kpó lɛ ɔ́ kéē yúklɔ́ ɛháajɛ kú nū. Ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ujɛ́hīyɛlu, Asárīya, Unáhātu, Ásāhɛlu, Ujɛ́rīmɔtu, Ujósābabu, Ɛlíyēlu, Ísmākiya, Umáhati, mɛ́mla Ubenáya. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá nyā, Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Asárīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā fu uwá tū úklɔ́ ā kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ayípɛ̄ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó hī uwā lɛ ā, wɛ alɛɛcɛ nēe lɛ ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ iyē mɛ́mla oyī kú ācɛ ɔlamu, Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ipú ɔkpíyē kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā nōó kwú glá á, o yá kóō lɛ Ebilíi, nōo bī ɔfú kú ikwū ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā tū aúgbéenyi ga Íjīpiti, nááná nōó tíne kéē ga abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē kpó iyī uwā lá aɔ́fiyɛ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā. Ó ka amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gáā dɔɔ̄kā ō lá uwā ɔ́fiyɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: É klá odúúdú ajɛ ā gbéeko nɛ̄ ajɛ ā kwú pīya onōbí juu. É kwú odúúdú ɔcí, ikpɔ̄cí nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā mā ɔ̄ tá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔcí kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā ú kpó lé ŋmáajɛ. Ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ cɔɔ́ɔ́ ā í hile ajɛ kú Íjīpiti gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gekwú, ācɛ gē blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē gwéeyē, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gekwú, ācɛ gē mlanyī nū fíya.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó. Ɛplɛ́ɛpa nōo géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā wā gáā gbā um ɛ̄gbā eko kú ucɛ dóódu ā, ācɛ nēe bēé wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bū okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā, í nyɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bū okómpinu kú ɛháajɛ ā. Ācɛ nēe bēé bū okómpinu kú ɛháajɛ ā géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ bɛ̄cɛ bū okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā bū ɔwɛ ékpónú wā Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, klla bū ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā ga ɛcɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é le bū éyi wā inu nɛɛ, é géē bū ɔhá ā ga ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Wā, n géē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu Uféro kóō lɛ ɛga je gā awɔ ká ā lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó bɛ̄cɛ, ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kwu aólɛhá, kwu aólɔdu, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā, kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm le tá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ohígbū keé bá ī yúufi kú ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú nɛ̄hi, a klla ī yá ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄hi, awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
idu_Latn: N le yá bɛ̄ɛka odahɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tá ohi ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ glá ŋ́ mā, ohígbū ka ó pó ɛlá nēé gē ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
idu_Latn: Ulában klla kahíníī, Ká Óndú ā kóō leyīkwu alɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ le fō gwiyī alɔ tá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é hī abɔ́ɔ ka Umíspa.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Ó tá ka anúɔ í yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ gē yá anúɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋmá lɛ o kpɛ́fú tá anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ í hɛpɔ̄ kú anúɔ mɛ́mla anú á. Ó kē í hɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔn ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Émɔ̄si tá Amasíya ohi kahíníī, Ń kē tɛtɛ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kē ī wɛ ɔyí kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ n wɛ ɔ̄cogbaálá mla ɔ̄cɛ o leyīkwu ɔcí kú ufígi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ó dɔ̄ɔ̄ka ō yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó miya ā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the LORD is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
idu_Latn: Nááná, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gē ka ka, Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá a í lē kpaakpa ŋ́. Aá gbɛlá ka ɔwɛ kú um ɔ́ɔ́ le kpaakpa ŋ́, amáŋ ɔwɛ kú aá í le kpaakpa ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, o yɔ̄ ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú oyēeyī ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ á. Ohígbū ka, ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ, nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ o yɔ̄ í lé mɛ́mla oōgwá ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóō he ɔ̄cɛ ipú oyēeyī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á. Ɔ́bíipú kú aá má tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛɛ́, ācɛ dóódu kē lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí kú aá má ɛɛ́. Aá gē ma ɔ́bíipú kú aá fú, ipú ucē oōyá kú aá dóódu. Aá lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé, é kē géē kpó aá kwú bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā.

eng_Latn: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú éwo dóódu ā gáā le jīla mla ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ébrahām gē gbā ā, Óndú ā nōó lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. É klla lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
idu_Latn: A le yá kú ɔwɔ kóō yá nɛ̄hi klá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, o yá ká ajɛ ā nōo le ŋmókókó ā kóō le tīile kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ éyi le ɔ̄coŋmíyē éyi tá agōdō gé lɛ ɔ́. Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é kpɔ́tūce lɛ ā má ā, ó da ɔ̄coŋmíyē ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔtūlé, é kwú íne nɛ̄ a bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ je íne ā lɛ aá á. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi ā, kóō híīī bīya ŋ́. Ami, Óndú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɔfú lé aákpá ōbū efū o yēŋēē dóódu glá.

eng_Latn: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
idu_Latn: Epu kē í je okwu kú nū lé. Ó jé ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmó anúɔ.

eng_Latn: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tū ɛcɛ ā fíyábɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú nū ā, ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce ɔ́ í gáā yíífi ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka odúúdú ɛcɛ ɔ́ɔ géē je pīya alácɛ̄, mɛ́mla ígbíli, amáŋ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā je ɔ́ yíífi dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī ya akwuna kú nū nɛ̄ ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Íjīpiti, ɛga nēé jé ɔ̄ ɔnyā ā kpɔ́. Ŋmá eko nōo gbo ɔɔ́ ō híkpó amɛ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ gbo ɔ́ ō cikpó nū, klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá mla anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī yá mla akwuna ā á.

eng_Latn: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer; and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɛ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú āyā kú Ujafulɛtáyi jāā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ubɛ́t Uhórɔn. Ó ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga Ugɛ́sa gaá ŋmɛ́yí isú kú Umeditarénīya.

eng_Latn: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, jāhɔ̄ kú ā pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú, abɔ̄yī nū ka ā. Aá ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ híī tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Aá klla ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē má ohɛ́ɛwa kú uwɔ uwēyī kē í kwú uwɔ ipéyī uwā. Ohígbū ka n géē gwū uwɔ ɔ́ci piíí, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā ci um anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcɛnyā, ɔdíyá nāa gē jikwū ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ nāa gē dɔɔ̄kā ā? Ó gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔgɛ́ɛjí kú ɛhɔ̄ ā nɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá amānyā nɛɛ, da um ɛga nāa je ɔ́ tá ā, ká um kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yúufi ofū nōo í ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū eko owu ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó le īlī ká ofū tá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tɛtɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛhɔ̄ tū gāá fu Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔ̄ri, nōo lā Uhɛ́ssbɔn ā, kóō lɛ ɛga je lɛ aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le bū ipú ajɛ kú nū ɛbɔ́ ga ipú ajɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, n pi ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ahɔ̄ ka, Aá yɛce íne nɛ̄ aádáádā aá tū ā ŋ́. Aá yá uculo kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē je īyī aá īye tēelihɔ mla aɛ́cí nēé pā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
idu_Latn: A géē tíne ācɛ nēe ī nuunu tú uwɔ ā, amáŋ á gáā má uwā glá gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka odúúmā kú uwá í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ūlī tá ohígbū uwā, anɔ́ɔ ūlī ā lɛ Umatáyāsi kwú á. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ ka tū ipú ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ igwóléyi ā á.

eng_Latn: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ uwā ijáalí ka ó kwu uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi kéē cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄, amáŋ é jé ɔwɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nēé gē bī lɛ cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá tīihɔ. Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē je īyī aá tū gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá géē wɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú um ōfōōfū um á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā nū Amásīya yá ā.

eng_Latn: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
idu_Latn: Aá híīī bī égō ámāŋ ɔkɔ́bɔ ámāŋ ije dóódu ipú alítā kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gáā bī Upɔ́lu ga ipú ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja ā, ó da otrɛ̄yí ā kahíníī, N̄ lɛ ɔdée da uwɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ ŋŋ? Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á jé ō ka ucē kú Ācɛ ugríisi nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔlɛcɛ, n kwú uwɔ ú yá ɔ̄cɛ ogbāājɛ kú éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ahɔ̄ ōpi dúúmā nāa géē pó ŋmá ɛgiyí um, a géē ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
idu_Latn: É klla le ɔdungwɔ̄wɛ ɛpa ɔhá nēe gē cē bá īyī uwā ā gbā nmá ɔcí usáyíprɛ̄si.

eng_Latn: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
idu_Latn: íkplí kú nū mɛ́mla ijē nōo klá anú ā, mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā wá ŋmá anú.

eng_Latn: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛfu kú Ussɛ́fa ā, é gaá lā Uharáda.

eng_Latn: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Okónu ɛdɔ ékpó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce nyā nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ ā leyīce ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē yá lɛ uwá ā nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ɛnɔ mla otú á. Ohígbū ɔtōkpóce nyā, ágábáidu, nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu mbáa kpɛ́lā ce um á!.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya bī íwɔ́tū nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ lɛ ācɛ Ujúda ŋmá īkííkée ā lɛ ɔ́ci gwō uwá klla ī tíne ō je uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ālɔ̄ ka ka Ɔwɔicō í gē yá ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́ kɛ̄ɛ? Ó lɔwɛ ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ícɔ́ɔja ékpónú kú aólɛlā kú uwā yá ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó lé āa? Nɛ̄ ācɛ igwó kú aólɛlā kú uwā yá ācɛ úlā ofɛɛpa ce igwó kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lé āa? Ɛ̄nyā yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nōo ī gbō uwā bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ̄cɔ̄ ā, habɔ̄ uwā tá lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā le uwá yálé á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē je ɛbɛ́ kú nū lé ɔlɛ́ uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē lé ɛbɛ́ ipácí ɔhá lɛ́bɛ̄ɛka īkpɛ̄nū ámáŋ ka ɔ́wa ā.

eng_Latn: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rabsaris, and Nergalsharezer, Rabmag, and all the king of Babylon's princes;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebusárādan mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ɔhá nēé hī ka Unebúsāsban, Unágalu Sarɛ̄sa mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí ɔhá kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ipú okpaakpa. Kóō gbó ācɛ nēé gē piyatū ā ipú ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā Ɔwɔicō ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā, ó kē i je ɔtū olɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Ohɔ́nyɛtá gā bɛ̄ɛka otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nēe yɔ̄ amānyā tɛtɛ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nōó yúklɔ́ ipú nū ā nwuné fíyɛ́, ó klla le jōōjīla fíyɛ́. Ó wɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nēé bī abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ gwó ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā lé kōō wɛ ipú aɔ́dā nēé yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ. Ɛlā kú uwɔ he ɔ́ ɔtú nɛ̄hi, anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó je uwɔ ce ɔcɛ́ á, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā bī iyē kú nū le gbāajɛ. Ohígbū koó yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu klla tíne ōle uwá tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwɔ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ káā bī ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa le gbō uwā á.

eng_Latn: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ígwú hī ɔ̄ ka alɔ kɛpɔ̄, nōó cɛ̄ nááná, ń gáā cɛ̄ koó le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
idu_Latn: É klla gē gbō ɛ́yá kú uwā ɛ̄gbā klla gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá dúú, ohígbū ka ɛ́yá kú uwā ā gē je ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nēé gē dɔɔ̄ka ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī gē gbo ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ije gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí ā, Itene kú íjééyī lɛ óndú nū ā, wɛ ka ó lɛ oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī ɔ́ɔmā tū.

eng_Latn: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō jéeyī, kóō klla jɔ́ɔdā, ikɔkɔ ō lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
idu_Latn: Óndú, má ōwē nɛ̄ n gē má ā, ká ā lɛ um nyatá, ohígbū ka ń gwɛ́lā hī íne kú uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ pīyeyī abālɔbányā, abɔ̄ kú Óndú ā lɛ uwɔ kwú ɛɛ́, eyī kú uwɔ géē pu anɔ́ɔ á kē gáā mɛ́ɛbɛ gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko éyi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ébú mɛ́mla obū gaá klá anú. Anɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ ī lɛ abɔ̄ maajɛ ī dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō bī ɔ̄ jé ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
idu_Latn: Aá da Akípɔ̄si kahíníī, Lɛ ɔtū kwu úklɔ́ nɛ̄ a mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ yá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ nyā Óndú, ā le okónu nāa ce ā yá jīla ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka n le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí Udéfīdi, ádā um. N klla cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ awɔ, Óndú ā cokónu lɛ ā. N le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gwó lɛ awɔ, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kwú eyī í gwū ɛlā nɛ̄ anyākwɔ́cɛ nwū ɔ̄ ā bónū, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí aɛ́gɔ́ nū nɛ̄ ó jɛ̄ tɔ̄há ŋmáajɛ mlá uwá ā, gaá da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī mlanyī aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu géē yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé klla í je uwá yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá á. Ká Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Áluka kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá le gwɛ́ɛya gā um í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā tū um ŋ́. Ehé! ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú aómlede o yɔlá dúúdú ā mɛ́mla ijē kú aɛ́bɛ́ ojɔ̄kwū kú aá le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú oyī kú aálá mɛ́mla opī nɛ̄ aá gē le gwɛ́ɛya gā um ā klla le jɛ̄ um dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, gbɔbū lɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ugása ā, Óndú ā kɛlā gā um lɛyikwu Ufílístiya.

eng_Latn: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē kɛlā nēé gbo tayínū ā tɛ́ɛcɛ péee. Ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi géē yá uwɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacańgelí nōo gē gwu ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē pīyɛ̄ íjééyī ŋmá? Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē jé ɛyí odée ŋmá?.

eng_Latn: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
idu_Latn: Ítāyi, ɔyí kú Uríbāyi ŋmá Ugíbēya, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, Ubenáya ŋmá Upírātɔn.

eng_Latn: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ ācɛ nēe ī ka iŋini mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī ŋmó ācɛ ɔhá okónu. É bá gē yá ɔdée ohígbū unwū obɔ̄bí kú uwā ōfōōfūnū. É gē bī iyī uwā gwō nɛ̄hi klla gē yá ācɛ ɛbɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ odée lɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ije nēé le gba áluka klla lɛ ɔ́ miya ɛɛ́ mā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ije ā lɛ gbā ulé lɛ ācogbɔ̄ɔcí mɛ́mla ācɛ o ma inu.

eng_Latn: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ le íne kú uwɔ bīya, anɔ́ɔ íne nēé bīya nyā cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā gaá lɛ uwá yálé klla kwú uwá ú kpó kwú ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā ga ajɛ kú éwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ipú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mpa nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, é kwú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā ú kwajɛ.

eng_Latn: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
idu_Latn: A gē je iyó kú uwɔ lá lɛ ācɛ Ubɛtogáma, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó aɔ́nya oōce, aɔ́nya opi úgbɔ́nya, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ aɔ́nya nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē ce ā le cíla uwɔ ulé.

eng_Latn: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú úklɔ́ ōwē kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le tá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ é da uwá kahíníī, Uféro le ka ka anúɔ í gaá kpó ácí ihili lɛ aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na ojɔ̄kwū nɛ̄hi igwó. Ɛna ɔlamu ofu. Aálá ofɛhɔ̄, ikpɛ́ɛnū, ɔblá, ɔ́wa, mɛ́mla aúgwu mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ ɛdɔ ɛ́yɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugíbba wɛ, ofɛnɛ ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
idu_Latn: Ń cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yā eko nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú áá cɛgbá ɔwɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋ́. N gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi éyi, ń kē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ ā yá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá ŋ́. Ɔwɔ ī yá tū ajɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ éyi, ó kē ī yā tū ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ɛga ɔhá ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́, ajɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó yā tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, kwú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛ̄nyā ofūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄gɔ̄ o lipú nɛ̄hi tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú alɔ mɛ́mla awɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe tíne ō yɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ wā ɛgiyí aá, í gáā wā glá ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē gáā yɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá wā ɛgiyí alɔ glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
idu_Latn: Āhɔ̄ kú aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cɛ kú ipú acīije nēé tá ā. Ó tíne ō gbo ɛyí agōdō nōó jɛ̄ ɔ̄ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó klla tíne ō bī átu nōo le nyɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄ɔ̄ le klá iyē.

eng_Latn: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū mla ádā nū, oyēeyī kú nū gē mɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá kú agege gē mí ajɛ odobū ā.

eng_Latn: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ ōhī kpó wā kéē cē ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, é kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā í habɔ̄ ɛlā ō ka lɛyíkwu ɛga otīihɔ nyā mɛ́mla íne ā tá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɛka gbo gā um, Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛka gbo lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu tɛyí kpɛɛ́ le ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
idu_Latn: Eko gē wā nɛ̄ odúúdú aá géē je aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aá bī abɔ̄ ɔ́bíipú kú aá yá ŋmá oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ lɛ īyī aá ā kpó bónū.

eng_Latn: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɔdā nāa yá ācɛ Umídiyan, Usiséra mɛ́mla Ujábin, kwu ísu kú Ukíssɔn ā yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
idu_Latn: Asspɛ́nāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēé búdá ā, le iyē ɔhá kpó ce uwá. Ó hī Udánīyɛlu ka Ubeltessása, ó hī Uhananíya ka Ussádīrāki, ó hī Umíssɛ̄lu ka Umɛ́ssaki, ó klla hī Asárīya ka Abɛ́dinēgo.

eng_Latn: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́dan wɛ ɛjī kú nú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī á. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ɛjī kú ajɛ nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn mīyɛ kóō wɛ ukpɛ kú ajɛ kú úgwū kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú kú Utássīss nōo ī yɛ ipú aúgbéenyi ā, aá jikwū. Ohígbū ka Utáya nōo wɛ ɛga olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá kpɔ́tūce ā, kwú yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔkpíihɔ ká lɛ ā, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tú bá nwuné ā, í lɛ cabá ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōó tú bā nwuné ŋ́ mā í kē lɛ nyɛ́ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī leyīkwu ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā le cɔ̄nū ka Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄cɛ hɛ́tá ɛ̄cī usábāti, anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aá cíkā o yúklɔ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá wā ipú ɛ̄cī nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kéē hɛ́ aá tá, amáŋ ó híīī wɛ ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́ɛnyā le yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú inu ā mɛ́mla oyī kú igbáanɔ ā, éŋkpɔ̄ péee ā, igbáanɔ oyēeyī ā, ɔcí kú usɛ́da ā, ābɔ̄ kú uháyísɔ̄pu mɛ́mla owú ɔgalúlā ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe nū ipú abālɔbányā ā, aá le jí ɛɛ́. Ɛmiyɛ géē ŋmó aá. Aá nēe ī yɛhɛ abālɔbányā ā, aá le jí ɛɛ́. Aá géē ya ɔtūnobí klla í jikwū!.

eng_Latn: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé iyɔ̄bū ami, Uyáwɛ olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nēé ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā. Amáŋ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō le gbla um ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā, í cigbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
idu_Latn: Aflɛ́yí ā ayíkpó kú nū í jɛ́yí aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā eko nēé yá ā ŋ́, amáŋ eko nēé le Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɔwɛ nōo yéyījii nɛ̄hi ā, é le bla kéē le aɔ́dā nēe yá ā tá tāajɛ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū, ó kē le yá tá ɔ̄ yíílí.

eng_Latn: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
idu_Latn: Kéē kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú ācɛ, kéē ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí ohígbū uc­ē ɔbíipú nēé yá ā, mɛ́mla ohígbū ɛlā o bɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācobīyíne nēé je Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ gē ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú wā í le ɔdōlé lé klla le ejé gwá mɛ́mla anú. Anɔ́ɔ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú á. Ó klla le yɛ tɛ́ɛcɛ nyɔ̄ gaá le gbo mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gbō ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā ikɔɔkɔ o nyɔ̄ í gbo ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
idu_Latn: Ó híī hɛ́ uwɔ idáagó ohígbū ka n da uwɔ ka, É géē ma uwɔ igbɔhá piíí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ kā o ka lɛ ā, aóklóbīya ohe alɔ ɔtū, alɔ jé kpɔ́cíí ka ɛlā ā í liyē kwu aá ŋ́. Alɔ jé ka aá géē lɛ aɔ́da olɔhi fíyɛ́ nōo ī wā eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nya aá tá ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ī lɔhi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, ofíyajɛ kú ɔkpancō ā yɔ̄ ī ceyī. Ó yɔ̄ ī ceyī ŋaáŋaá nōó tū ō leyīkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Owu kē le odúúdú ɔkpancō ā gwu péee ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nyá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ eko dúúmā kahíníī, Cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ yá uka ō lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ kú uwɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄na ā ka lɛ ádā nū dúú, anɔ́ɔ ádā nū le ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ̄, da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka. Ɛdɔ ɔ̄na nyá yɔ̄ ā dúú? A gbɛlá ka ami, ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ géē wā í lɛyī kwu ajɛ gā uwɔ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē ma ogbonɛnɛ kú nū fú, o ŋmá lɛ ō cē agbénú klá ācɛ ōhī. Ó wɛ úklɔ́ ō yá lɔfú kú ɔ̄cɛ ōfōōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the saints salute you.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nēe bá amānyā ā ka āmíyɔ̄ hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē bá ī ka ka, É géē cíla ācɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa ulé ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi gbóó. Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ nōo gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɔ́kpá nyā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ aɔ́bá mɛ́mla aɔ́nyā kahíníī, Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā anyā, aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aɔ́bá aá dɔɔ̄kā ká aá yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔbá dúúmā nōó po ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ ucē olɔhi ká aá lɔfú yá kéē je pīya ācɛ o pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō glá. Ó kōō cɛgbá kú aá kɛ̄lā okónu lɛ uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū kéē géē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD's house; and said to all the people,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í cɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ nyā ā. N nyɔ̄ gāa háyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā klá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce alɔ ɛɛ́, ka odúúdú ācɛ, ɛga dóódu kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
idu_Latn: Usímīyɔn mɛ́mla Ulífāyi wɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ éékpó. É bī iyɔ́fú kú uwā le yúúfú.

eng_Latn: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umídiyan lɔfú fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le inya uwā kwu i pɛ́ tayínū ipú aɔ́gɛ̄cɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛyí aɛ́fu.

eng_Latn: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔdōlé lé, ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā í gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
idu_Latn: N da uwá kahíníi, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔfú gāá kwu lɛ ā, alɔ bá í fūla ayínɛ́ alɔ, ācɛ Ujíyu nēe je iyī uwā lá lɛ ācɛ éwɔhá ā. Abālɔbányā, aá klla bá ī pi ayínɛ́ aá, ācɛ Ujíyu ɔ́mpa aá abɔ̄fú kéē je īyī uwā kpó lá ɔfiyɛ lɛ aá. Aótrɛ̄yí ā í kōō má okónu kɛlā ŋ́, é bá cíí icííci.

eng_Latn: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔyā ɔ́migwó, kú iháyí ɔ́migwó nēé kpó alɔ ga ajɛ Ubábīɔn abɔ̄fú ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú Uhɛ́brɔn nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ukénan ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām jikwū klla yɔ̄ ekwu kú Usára á.

eng_Latn: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā yá kú ācɛ ogekwú kéē le héyī nɛ̄ ó klla í je oyēeyī lɛ uwá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā géē je oyēeyī lɛ ācɛ nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ka o jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ, Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācɛ ā kpó nyɔ̄ ga ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi, nōo géē yá kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kóō kwú tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
idu_Latn: Uhasasúwalu, Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, Ubisiyotíya.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ujóbu kwɛyí ā, Óndú ā da Ɛlífāasi kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū da awɔ mɛ́mla aóklóbīya awɔ ɛpa ā. Ohígbū ka aá kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóbu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ahāapa nɛ̄ a má abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um ā, mɛ́mla ákú aɔ́dā o lɛ agege ce uwá ahāapa ā yɔ̄ á. Aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ahāapa ā kwɛyí ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔci ahāapa ā. Aɔ́dā o lɛ agege ce uwá ā kwɛyí aícɔ́ɔci ā.

eng_Latn: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, óndú kú alɔ, ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ. Ɔwɔ kóō lɛ uwɔ ɛyí tū ápátɛ́cɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī bli kú ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aláadi, é le tá únóji ā ɛplá nɛ̄ ɛnɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ ɛnɛ kú nū ā géē jōonjīlɛ, nɛ̄ ōmīya kú abɔ̄ dóódu ā wɛ umíta úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofigwɛ́ɛ́pa cigwó .

eng_Latn: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
idu_Latn: N géē yá kú ɔtū kú aólɛlā kú aá kóō lɛ wuklíicō, N géē nū ācɛ Uhɛ̄fi, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ukénan, mɛ́mla ācɛ Uhám hīla aá abɔ̄ aá géē yɔ̄ ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔmā, lɛ ami mɛ́mla ayí um fu ká ālɔ̄ lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó. Ó kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ú kú ɔcɛ́ kóō yɔ̄ ī ŋmá ipú uwā piyóó. Ó klla kwú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um, ka abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ géē ŋmá á. Oŋmípú odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um ā, ó kwú um ú ka amíyɔ̄ géē lé ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, n ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē kwú Ubábīlɔn, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ nōo je ɔ́ ce ɔcɛ́ ā lā ā. Ohígbū ka ó lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ó ce mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā bīya.

eng_Latn: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ábsālɔm le kwu le tá ɛgiyí Utálmāyi, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́ssɔ. Udéfīdi yēkwu kú Ámnɔn, ɔyí nū ā, gbojī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ ka oŋmá eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wā í lā ipú ajɛ ā, ācɛ o yá ɔdābɔ̄fú ɛ́ɛ húmāyī kpɔ́fú kwu uwá, amáŋ ó ka ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ gáā yá da uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ cokónu lɛ Udéfīdi ka anúɔ géē lɛ ɔ́ tū céé ŋmá abɔ̄ kú odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū, klla géē kpó ayááyí lɛ ɔ́ nēe gē bá ī lé ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ Umósīsi le bēé ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɔ́kpa kú Ojuja gē gáā klá ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā gē kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi ŋmá ipú ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi wā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ipú ígbíli á. É jé ō bī óbō, ɔkplɛ́fú mɛ́mla ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi. É tūūfi ō má eyī nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, klla ī kwinya nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ogbo.

eng_Latn: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujosíya le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm kpó hīgwú wā gaá le jīla.

eng_Latn: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe í lá aálá ā gē kpó uwā ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yá ūwā italā ŋ́. É kwú ɛbɛ́ kú ūwā ú lá, anɔ́ɔ é ka aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, aá kwú gbagbénú ɛɛ́! Ācɛ nēe gē gbō aálá ā nááná ā í ményinyi ūwā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the LORD God.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu, ɛplá ucɛ ɛtá nēe bá ā, odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú aá géē wā iyɔ̄bū ami Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá gaá gbā um ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú íne ā pó ā, odúúdú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū. Anɔ́ɔ Unehemíya nōo wɛ igbómína ā, mɛ́mla Ɛ́sra ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo jé íne nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe bā gē cɔ̄ɔwɔ kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō nyā lɛ uwá ā, da odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníi, Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, aá gáā yá ɔtunobí, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē jikwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī bī ɛkpa ámāŋ úwé ɛpa ámāŋ áblákpá ámāŋ ɔcí okwajɛ iyāwu kú aá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄coyúklɔ́ cíkā ō lɛ odée ŋmá úklɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aótrɛ̄yí kú Usúkɔ̄tu ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá géē je ɔdōlé dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, nēé kwú Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usalumúna ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē ga ɔlɛ́ nū kóō bɛ̄cɛ oyēeyī glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó klla ī má ɔwɛ o yɛ wā oyēeyī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā dúú. É le ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa, Uhófīni mɛ́mla Ufínɛ̄hasi kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nyā gwá, ijēēnyi géē ŋmó ɔ̄ igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ekwu kú nū gwā ā, Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔɔ́, kwú ɔ̄ ú bī wā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔnyā nū á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyí éyi ma lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, á. Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yá ā í he Óndú ā ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ wɛ ayí kú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ̄, alɔ í wɛ ācɛ o bɔkwu odée tayínū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ kwú ajɛ nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di ga Ísu kú Ánɔn ā ú lɛ inu kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla inu kú Ugádi. Ó ka ɛjī kú uwā ɔ́ɔ kwu ɛháajɛ kú ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu ā. Ísu kú Ujábɔ̄ku ā wɛ ɛjī kú uwá ɛhíícō á, ɛga ōhī kú ísu ā wɛ ɛjī kú uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri á.

eng_Latn: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa géē wā iyē kú um, géē yɔ̄ ī ka, Ami wɛ anú á, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ācɛ alɛwa bī nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
idu_Latn: N géē cē Alelékwū kú um klá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú um ipú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. É kē í kacɛ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā ā, ofū í gáā ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ajɛ géē hīlaŋdɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohɔ́nɔ fíyɛ́ ikwū éyi nɛ̄ um má ā yɔ̄ á. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā. Ihɔtū kú nū nōo ī mafú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā bɛ̄ɛka ukpa ā. Abɔ̄ kú nū nōo le ce uwɔ ɔkɔ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́yá nōo gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā lɔfú nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛnyā glá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā ā géē kwú ācobīyíne tulúu bɛ̄ɛka ítū ā.

eng_Latn: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gaá kwú igbogbo ú gbō eyī gaá háyi ɔwɛ gbēyī Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā í yɛ á.

eng_Latn: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
idu_Latn: a bī Alelékwū Ihɔ kɛlā bū okónu kú ádā alɔ ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá ī kpɔ́tū fúúlú ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ gē tū ujɔ̄ nōó tīile ŋ́ mā a?.

eng_Latn: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēé tá ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si ŋ́, nɛ̄ íne he uwá ɔtū kéē bīya ā ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo lɛ ɛlā kú um pó nōó bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā gwó inu nōó bū ɔ̄gɔ ikpíinu ó táajɛ ŋ́ mā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpá le cēenyi klá inu ɔ́ɔmā, ó kwú ca bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ ó le catáajɛ dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ɛka kú aflɛ́yí ā í tīile ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ oyī nōo wɛ ijáalí kú ikwū ā má.

eng_Latn: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
idu_Latn: bá ī jikwū nɛ̄hi ohígbū uwɔ. É lɛ úmúlá wu klá ɛyí, klla bá ī lɛ īyī wā mīya ewo bá ī dɛ̄ gbōō.

eng_Latn: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ka ɛ́ɛ tá anúɔ ohi ka aá ɔ́ɔ le íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya ɛɛ́. Aá géē nyɔ̄ gāá kpɛ́fú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá je ɔ́da lɛ aá lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā le gbō kú ɛfú á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
idu_Latn: Umáasīya, ɔyí kú Ubárūki ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ukólihōse. Aádā nū ɔhá ā wɛ, Uhásīya, Adáya, Ujóyāribu mɛ́mla Usekaríya, odúúdú uwá wɛ ayí kú Uséla, ɔyí kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā, nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, nū ŋmá ajɛ kú Ukénan hī lɛ uwá abɔ̄ uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá gē wā ipú ajɛ ā. Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ klla kwú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā í lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
idu_Latn: aá géē kɛlā lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bēé ísu ɛyí ajɛ oŋmíkpākpālā ā.

eng_Latn: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
idu_Latn: A géē hāyí leyīkwu cɔɔ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aólɛlā géē wā í ca aódūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igelī kú aá cā tāajɛ ā. Aá kē bɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka aéwɔhá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā, ācɛ nēe kpó agbénú kú Ujerúsālɛm nyɔ̄, nēe gwó ɛbā anwa kéē lɛ agbénú ā kpó kɔ̄ ŋmá ajɛ lɛ iyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ nōo gē gwó kwūūū nyā gē hɛ́ um ɔtú ko.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gā ɛyí ɛfu, ɛga nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā abɔ́ɔ ā, oklóbīya nú éyi nēé hī ka Uhússāyi, ɔ̄cɛ Ááki wā í tá ɔ̄, lɛ īlī kú nū híla klla lɛ ajɛ fú klá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Wā ká ālɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́. Awɔ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ ā. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ā hāyi ɛcɛ āa? N le inu tútū gbēyī uwɔ klla lɛ ɛga tútū lɛ aínyankwūlūmī kú uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tíne kéē ŋmó um ā, le ukpa kpla gbēyī um ɛɛ́. Ācɛ nēe tíne ō yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā yɔ̄ ī fu um ɔnū ka aá í je um yíífi. É mlɛ̄nyɔ̄ ō tū ujɔ̄ obɔ̄bí tū um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nēé kwú anɔ̄ nyā ú lá égō nɛ̄hɛ̄ ofigwó, kéē kwú ije kú nū ú lɛ aógbɛhá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
idu_Latn: Utáya nōo le mu mla éeyē nēé le kwu ajɛ ŋmá íkée ā yɔ̄ ā kɛ̄ɛɛ? Igelī nōo gē fu ācɛ kú nū nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ajɛ kú éwɔhá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mīyɛ aéwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ajɛ ā yɔ̄ ā ā?.

eng_Latn: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
idu_Latn: Olíla gē bī ɛlā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu le gbo ɛlā kú nū ŋmáajɛ. Ó kē í ŋmó ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā ɛyí mla ɛlā ɛ́lɛ́ ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē je ɔ́da kéē lɛ éyi kú aígbáanɔ ā ŋmó ipú aklɛ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ oyēŋēē yɔ̄ ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kahíníī, Aá lɛ odo kú aá pīyabɔ̄, ohígbū ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō le kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa le ajɛ ā kpó kɔ̄ lɛ uwá kwɛyí ā, é le ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
idu_Latn: Aá gē leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ayí kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á. Aɔ́nya kú ɛfú, aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hɛ́ igá tū uwā ā bá ipú abɔ̄ kú aá. Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ɔkpá nyā gā abɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛgba kú aá tá lipú ga ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cí gē yá ā, abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbū ā, aá gboló ce ɔ́ fíyɛ́, kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kóō jíliye ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é nwū aá lɛ ā. Aá kóō bá ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔdōtayínū ā mafú lɛ Udánīyɛlu ipú ɔna otú á. Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu le cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō klla le ahínyá tá ɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwā jé ka aɔ́wɔ kú aá ɔ́ɔ kwáahi, í lɔfú nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
idu_Latn: É géē hókónu tū uwɔ̄ klla í kpó igbō ɛpa gā uwɔ, nāa géē mīyɛ.

eng_Latn: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
idu_Latn: ó lɛ ā, n géē yá uwā italā kú íne kú um nēé bīya ā. N géē yá uwā ōwē nɛ̄hi kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā jónjīlɛ klla wɛ ɛdɔ ékpónú. Éyééye kú uwá lɛ acá ɛpa, īkpō kú uwā wɛ ikpó ɛtá, ɛga nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ acá kú uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā wɛ ikpó ɛnɛ ce ɔtū ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā géē lé ɛpɔ̄hi, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyā ā le ajā gbo, amáŋ ɔnyā ā géē móōwē kú íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
idu_Latn: Aá pīyɛyí wā ɛga nɛ̄ aá géē lā ɛbɔ́ ā. Aá nēe bá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, nēe lɛ eyīyōce ā. N da aá abālɔbányā, ka n géē cíla aá ulé kú ífi kú aá ɔ́klá ɛpa! N klla í hɔ́hā ce aá ohígbū odúúdú ōwē nɛ̄ aá má ā.

eng_Latn: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel's father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.
idu_Latn: ka ɔnyīlɔ nōo hɛ́ ɔ̄ báajɛ ā géē cílá ádā kú nyā ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛpa cigwó, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ncɛ́nyā ā kwú pīya ɔnyā nū, ohígbū koó lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ báajɛ le gwutá mla anú abɔ̄fú. Ó ka ɔ́ klla gáā tá ɔnyā ā gbóógbóō ipú oyēeyī kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔgba ɔ́mpa ā wɛ ɛ́mɛ̄rādi, usáfāya mɛ́mla udáyímɔ̄ndi.

eng_Latn: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ádā nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ lɛ ā ŋmá yɔ̄ ā? Ádā nū tóohi ka oŋmífī nɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
idu_Latn: N bī ɔ̄ le cā ācogbāálá mɛ́mla aálá kú uwá tāajɛ. N klla bī uwɔ le ca ācohɛ́hɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́nā nēé ī bī le hɛ́hɔ̄ ā tāajɛ. N kē bī uwɔ le ca aígbómina mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
idu_Latn: A géē nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔnyā ōgbajā nōo ī bī ɛlā olɔnyɛ kú okónu kú nū lɛ plla awɔ tū ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ í ka ka aá í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá í jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Áhābu gekwú ā, Umésa tá ka anúɔ í gbā ɛ̄gbā abɔ̄fú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu gē tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā, kóō gwéeyē. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbolóce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ā kóō gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ātū um fu Íjīpiti a, Ondū a ce ɛyí ojuja yɔ̄ ī wā Íjīpiti kwūūū ɛɛ́. Ó yɔ̄ ī wā fíyaa, ɛcí kú Íjīpiti gēe fīyégbúlú iyeɔbū nū. Ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti kwú gbogodo.
