eng_Latn: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
idu_Latn: É kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le igbīhi cē kwu ɔ́ ɛɛ́, ālɔ̄ nū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
idu_Latn: Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, a le yēŋēē, á klla lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nāa cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ yēeyī ícɛ kpɔ́ mla íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā. Alɔ géē ka íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ga awɔ, kócōō kwú yá alɔ ɛhi. Alɔ í kōō cíkā ō wā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ ohígbū íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ inu abɔ̄yī nū ā mīya. Āyā kú nū dóódu wɛ umíta igwó. Inu ā kē kwu igbīhi inu ɔtāhɛ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Amānyā ā, tīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tíne ō kwúcē, aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um. Aá kwú aɛ́cí nɛ̄ aá ī pā ā, nēe ī wú um ɔtū ā í kpó bónū, ká aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka anúɔ géē tá ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm nēe lā ipú alácɛ̄ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔtū lé. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ kú nū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā, pīya ajɛ olɔhi o hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ le hɛ́ɛ́hɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ídɛn ā. Ɔtū géē he ācɛ ā, é kē í gwéeyē. É klla í bá ī gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra um klla í tá um ahínyá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó ɛna mɛ́mla opī kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā, nōó bī oyī kú uwā ga ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā gaá gwɛ́ɛya o kpó íne ō bīya kú ācɛ ā nyɔ̄ ā yɔlá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā. Ó géē kpó ɔkpá kú uwā, ícɛ̄bɛ́ kú uwā mɛ́mla ajīlīpú kú uwā yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
idu_Latn: Aá géē da ádā um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ um lɔfú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti amānyā mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá má kpɛ́mm ā. Aá páápá nyɔ̄ í lɛ ádā um bī wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācobɔbíipú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ísu nɛ̄hi nōo gē tá úgbagwú ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úgbagwú kú ísu nɛ̄hi í gē yɔ̄ cíí ŋ́, gē kpó ɔ́tɔ mɛ́mla imū wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
idu_Latn: N tɛtɛ cɔ̄nū mla uwá, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla eyī ō le kwɔdā kú uwá. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ n yá uwā ōwē, je igbīhi ce kwu uwá á. Nááná é kē bá yɔ̄ ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú klla bá yɔ̄ ī yá ucē nōo he uwá ɔtū ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú anúɔ ú butū ka anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kē yɔ̄ ī yá ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú anúɔ kóō jɛ̄ gicō ohígbū ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otóótú ɔ́ɔmā, é kwú Ubɛ́lssása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ujeremíya, nyɔ̄ í le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, ka n yɔ̄ ī yá ojuju obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu uwá klla yɔ̄ ī tútū o yá uwā unwalu. Lɛ da uwá kéē mā ucē ɔ́bíipú ō yá tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
idu_Latn: Aá géē hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ í nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú aá klla í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ipú iháyí ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya um, mɛ́mla aɔ́mpa um í cē túblá um gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ipí kú um ā. Kwú aɔ́máapú um piíí ā, gē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí um dúú.

eng_Latn: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
idu_Latn: Kwú aɛ́hi nɛ̄ Uhɛ́lidāyi. Utóbīja, mɛ́mla Ujɛdáya bī wā ú, kú ā nyɔ̄ bōōbū ga ɔlɛ́ Ujosáya, ɔyí kú Usafɛníya. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá nyā pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
idu_Latn: Alɔ klla da uwá ɔ̄kā, iyē kú uwá dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ géē le ācɛ nēe wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe bá ī yúklɔ́ ā jé.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī ka ipú ɔtū kú uwā ka ācɛ ā lɛ lɛwa fíyɛ́ aá nēé gáā nū uwā ŋmá ajɛ ā glá ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, ipú ɛ̄cī ékpó aámíyá nɛ̄hi kú ōcē mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtā géē yá ɔ̄. Ɔlá géē je ɔ́ yi ohígbū ka Óndú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄, kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka aá blakwu igbō ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ úlá igwɛ́ɛpa lé ā ŋ́, mɛ́mla áluka ómblí kú iwili nɛ̄ aá túbá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu má Udéfīdi abɔ́ɔ ó yɔ̄ í nyɔ̄ í nuunu tá Ugolíyāti ā, ó da Ábna otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ábna, ɔyí kú ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ ɔyípɛ̄ nyā wɛ ā? Ábna da ɔ́ ka ɔcɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó, ka anúɔ í jé ɔyí kú ɔ̄cɛ nɔ́ɔ wɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aɔ́dā ɛtá nēe géē yɔ̄ gajaajɛ. É wɛ ɔtōōce, eyīyōce mɛ́mla ihɔtū. Amáŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ihɔtū.

eng_Latn: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, é géē je uwɔ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ pií, Ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē gwō uwɔ ɔ́ci klla í cíla uwɔ óluma kú ɔdā nāa yá alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayí kú Ulífāyi ā géē lā yɛ jīla Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō túblá anú, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē pūla ɔnū kú Óndú ­ā klá ayí Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ.

eng_Latn: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka álá ámāŋ ka ɛwū nēé bī wā kú ɛya kú olétɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ á nɛɛ, ó lɔfú wɛ ɔbá ámāŋ ɔnyā glá. Amáŋ ó gáā lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ŋmá ipú nū ísu kú éŋkpɔ̄ ōhíjēnyi géē pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gā gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ákplata ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔ́ cɛyí ā māháyi cíí. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔyípōklóbīya, n ka cāŋjɛ.

eng_Latn: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kwú ɛdɔ kú ojīlīmā nēé gē lɛ ce aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ú ce aógbɛhá ā.

eng_Latn: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
idu_Latn: É hī uwɔ igwú, a kē le uwá nyatá. Awɔ nēé kpɔ́tūce á, á kē cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔdée fīyɛ̄ ádā nū ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā, kwu ácí kú nū le pɛ́ tū ipú kú Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ijē le klá tū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā, nōó yá kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō má oje kú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Éhūdu í pi ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋ́. Ó wu Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, ipú gāá bɛ̄cɛ igbīhi, anɔ́ɔ ubu kú nū kwú pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya klla le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā dúú, ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébāti bī klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ujeremíya, ā tíinalegwu ga um ohígbū ācɛ nēe bá nyā ŋ́. Ā jikwū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛyíkwu uwā ŋ́. A ba um ɛba lɛ uwā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń gáā jāhɔ̄ ga awɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
idu_Latn: Aá le cīgbīhi abālɔbányā gaá yúklɔ́, é gáā kpó ácí ihili lɛ aá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Náaná ā aá géē ma áluka ubulɔ́kwu nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ gē ma ɛ̄cī dóódu ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nyā nēé ma Umósīsi á, ó wɛ ɔyí nōo lɔhi nɛ̄hi. É bī ɔ̄ ɔyā ɛtá ɔlɛ́ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo nyɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ī nuunu tá ɔ̄, í gáā yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́ glá ŋ́? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yá ɔ́ɔmā ipú ɛcɛ nyā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú eyī nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī lɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ ā mla ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ gē bī le pó ɛlā ú kpó lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā kéē lɛ ɔdā nāa tíne kéē yá ā jé. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú aéwo kéē le jé ka a lɔfú ō nya uwá tá glá.

eng_Latn: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ odúúdu ɛlā kú ācɛ ā pó ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ kpó ka lɛ Óndú ā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ aɛ́wū ā le iyī ūwā ce iyɔ̄bū kú ogbló kú ɔcí ā nɛɛ, é gē ma ayí nēe tína cílɛ́cílɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e híkākā ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
idu_Latn: Ígblɛ́nyī nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī le tá Óndú nōo wɛ ádā ā ahínyá ā, anú piíí ā nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī le tókónu obɔ̄bí lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá gbla iyī nū ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhāsi wɛ iháyí ofu ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī dúú. Ó yɛ tííkpa kú aádáádā nū Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n yá ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ gā uwɔ ā, a kē le ohi tū um. Óndú nwū um íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū da Úsaa bōōbū ohígbū abɔ̄ nōó le kwu ɔ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
idu_Latn: Iyó nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú kú uwá mɛ́mla aólɛlā kú uwā nēé yálé ā wɛ aínyankwūlūmī úlā ofɛhīlī cɛhɔ̄ , aálá úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofigwɛ́ɛpa cɛhɔ̄ , aíjakī úlā ɛhɔ̄ , ācɛ nēé kwú aálagbá kú ɛfú ā kē wɛ, úlā ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce ula igwó .

eng_Latn: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yɔ̄ ī bī ɔdā nɛ̄ n nwū mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá pó ŋmá okónu kú um mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá má um yá abɔ̄yī um ā le yúklɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ ācɛ ā géē yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, ācɛ nēe bá nyā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ébú kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ ó gē yɔ̄ gbó ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ŋ́ mā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbóngbō kú īkpɔ̄dā, nɛ̄ owu gē kpó bónū ŋmá ɛga owíīkpo-ɔ̄dā ā. Ó klla ka ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ódūdū, nōo yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ajīlɛ̄yí inu ā.

eng_Latn: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
idu_Latn: Ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā wɛ ka aá ményinyi ācɛ ɔhá, amáŋ ó wɛ ɛbɛ́ ō je gwɛ́ɛya gā um ŋ́, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá jɛ́yí ɔdā nōo ka nyā ā, aá géē yɛ í ŋmó ācɛ nēe lɛpɔ̄ɔhi ā ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā da aá ka, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē je ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā lɛ aá kóō wɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
idu_Latn: Woó! Óndú, eko nyá nɛ̄ n géē jikwū klá uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄ gaá kwu, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē pó ɔkɔ kú um, ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nya alɔ tá ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe bá ī yá alɔ nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ofɛtá cigwó ā gaá le gla, Óndú ā í cɛ̄ lɛ Utáya klla í kwúcē ga ipú ɔsú otá kú nū ā igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Igelī ā klla í gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́su mɛ́mla odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī je īyī nū lá lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kéē gbo mɛ́mla anú ā.

eng_Latn: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú kwú acígilí otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī glá. Ɔwɔicō gē fīyɛ̄ ācɛ odée wā ajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ é gekwú. Ó lɔnɔ tū Ɔwɔicō ō ŋmó ācɛ olɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cīce akpa ōtīihɔ kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ó gē gbō odúúdú aéwo.

eng_Latn: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti le tá ɛgiyí uwā ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛlā nyá nɛ̄ aá kpó ce ɔ̄cɛ ā a.

eng_Latn: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
idu_Latn: Óndú, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā, ká ā pó ikwū ō je kú otábɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú piíí gē kwú ɔ̄ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ō kɛlā okpaakpa ā, gē nya īyī nū tá ŋmá unwalu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ahāanɛ nōo wɛ ɔyā nēé hī ka Ukísilēfu kú ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nɛ̄ Udáriyɔ̄si wɛ ɔcɛ́n­­ɛ̄hi ā, Óndú kɛlā lɛ Usekaríya ka.

eng_Latn: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
idu_Latn: Íssmɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá Umíspa pī Ugɛdalíya ā kpó ŋmó dúú, mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn nēe bá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya kwu aɛ́na úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó mɛ́mla aálá úlā ahāapa cofigwó ú kpó lɛ uwá kéē le gwɛ́ɛya ā, aígabɔ̄ kú nū klla kpó aɛ́na úlā ɛpa cofigwó mɛ́mla aálá úlā ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄ . É le ācogwɛ́ɛya alɛwa iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú yá yēŋēē dúú.

eng_Latn: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
idu_Latn: Ń ka ŋ́ nɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ gē yúufi nū á. Ó kē ī lɛ eyī gla ācɛ nēe gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ jéeyī ā tá, klla lɛ ɛlá wu uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ébram wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ce igwáahāanɛ ā, Óndú ā lɛ iyī nū mafú lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á. Lɛyítáajɛ gā um cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nōo lɛ kpaakpa eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé gē nwū uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le jééyī dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē je opī ɛpa lɛ Árɔ̄ni kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla omlede éyi kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ yálé klla le uwēyī je lɛ uwá ipéyī uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
idu_Latn: É lā amānyā klla le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú ojīlīma kú uwɔ gwó ɛɛ́. Ohígbū kēé kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ái lɛ ācɛ kɔlɛ́ Ujóssuwa ā má abɔ́ɔ ā, é le tútū fíyaa. Anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū le pɛ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ ga ɔpɛ́ abɔ́ɔ kéē nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɛga ékpónú nēé tɛtɛ nuunu tá uwá ā. Ó kē jé kéē géē nuunu tá anúɔ ŋmá igbīhi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
idu_Latn: É klla gáā hī uwɔ kahíníī, É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō gē hī ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ka Alácɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ iyē uwɔ géē wɛ Ɔtū nū he Óndú ā. É kē í hī ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ka Ɔnyā nōo he ɔbá nū ɔtū. Ohígbū ka ɔtū uwɔ he Óndú ā. Ó kē í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔbá ā lɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi kóō je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, Ohígbū okónu ō ce mɛ́mla oji ō hɛ́ lɛ Óndú ā, kú ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ō táajɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, mɛ́mla ɔnyōkwū, mɛ́mla ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔbá nū tá ɔ̄, mɛ́mla ɔnyā ō lɛ ɔbá ā.

eng_Latn: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
idu_Latn: Lɛ iyɔ́fú kú uwɔ kpó tū iyē, ɔcɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi, a tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi, a klla lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
idu_Latn: Okwutɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n je ā, géē lū blɔblɔ. Ɔwɛ nyā, n géē bī iŋini nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hímáyi ka tú uwɔ ā wā oŋmɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó le kwu ohígbū kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé pūla, ó lɛlá wu aálá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra iyē kú Óndú ā, oŋmá abālɔbányā jāā ga eko nɛ̄ ó ī mɛ ŋ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
idu_Latn: Óndú ōfōōfūnū tá um abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācoyódōbɔ̄bí nyā á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄! N géē wā ānāānā. Ákú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɛbɛ́ nēe má nyā ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
idu_Latn: É le uwá kpó yálé ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā klla lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá kpó ŋmó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ē yá ācɛ Ulákisi ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhābu le Ɛláyíja má ā, ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ nōo ī je unwalu lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ á nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú cɛ̄ lɛ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Usɛ́kɛ̄m kwú gbɛlá á. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi éyi kwú inu ɔlɛ́ nū nōo yɔ̄ ipɔ́lɛ́ ā ú lá, anɔ́ɔ ó fūla anú ŋ́ má. É géē je ɔlɛ́ ā cīgbīhi lɛ ɔ́ ipú iháyí kú ɔdā ō je kwúcē igbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā. Ohígbū ka ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi lɛ ipú igelī ā wɛ ákú uwā piyóó ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē híī yúúfi uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ géē bítāajɛ, amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uhɛsɛkíya tóohi ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ohígbū koó gbɛlā ka ɛyí kú olɛhɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ka ɛbɔ́ ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ anúɔ í cɔcɛ́ gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko le yá nēé gáā kpó uwā wā iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ Asspɛ́nāsi le uwá kpó wā iyɔ̄bū Unebúkádinēsa á.

eng_Latn: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ka aɔ́cɛ́ nēe géē hɛ́pɔ̄ ā kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ ɔwɛ okpaakpa. Ó klla í je ɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtūolɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gbō okómpīinu kú igá kú igelī ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō bēhé wā ipú igelī ā gaá kpɛfú tú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
idu_Latn: Itíca Umósīsi le tá tū ɔkpá lɛ alɔ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyínɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ gekwú hī ɔnyā nū tá, nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyí dúú ŋ́, ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ cíkā kóō kwú ɔnyā ā ú ɔnyōkwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō ma ayí lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū nōo kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And the cart came into the field of Joshua, a Bethshemite, and stood there, where there was a great stone: and they clave the wood of the cart, and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Úgbɔ́ɔnya ā yɛ jāā gaá gā ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Ujóssuwa, nōo lā Ubɛti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gáā māháyi pī ápátɛ̄cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi éyi abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le ɔcí nɛ̄ é le gbā úgbɔ́ɔnya ā kpó yíla, le aɛ́na ɛpa ā kpó ŋmó, kwú uwā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi le tá ɛyɔ́ɔ́pu kú Okónɔɔwɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā gaá cīce abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔmáapú kú Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ubówāsi kɛlā nū lɛ Urútu ā wā gaá yɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú kɔ́ɔ̄ wā amānyā oklóbīya anúɔ kɔ́ɔ̄ má cīce. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā gaá cīce á.

eng_Latn: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aálá ā í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbō uwá ŋ́ mā, é kwu uwā pahīla, anɔ́ɔ aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí bá ī kwú ī ŋmó uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
idu_Latn: Ɛjī klla le pīya biílí ɛga nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ubáala ā lɛyíkwu ɛfu kú Ɛ́dɔm. Ó yɛ gaá bū ɛhícō kú ɛfu kú Ucésālɔn ga Ubɛti Ussímɛ̄ssi gaá le gla Utímina.

eng_Latn: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā í nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú inu nōo kwu okómpinu nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā ga eyīyɛ̄cɛ ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ ó bū wā inu ā.

eng_Latn: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi ā le ɔ́da je ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā jé ɛga nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄, kóō le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, kéē lɛ ɔ́ kwú abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē kpó aéwo ā yíífi, abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tú uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā kú ɛ́ɛ má lā anú.

eng_Latn: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nōo ma ɔ̄ ā í blakwu ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ɛkɔ̄ géē je okwū kú nū lé, é klla ī je yíífi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé le hɛ́ wāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o ma ayí, aá híīī ka ɔdōōbɔ̄bí le ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ aá ŋ́, aá kē yá uwā ɔdā dúúmā nōo géē yá kéē cɔ̄nū mla aá ŋ́ ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá bī uwā jɛ̄ kú aá nwū uwā ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá piíí ā abɔ̄ aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
idu_Latn: Kwú iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti lé ka, Agidigbé nōo ī yúuya, amáŋ nōo gē kpó īyī nū eko bónū ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē je uwá pīya aólíla, klla í pu uwá eyī, í bī ígbájí wā oyēeyī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwú iyī nū ú tēelihɔ ohígbū koó nā ɔ̄na abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gwutá mla ɔnyā, ka ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ í klá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā bá ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ nēé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā ká aá le fō í bá ɛgɛyɛ́yí. Aá lɛ iyī aá tū ŋmá ɔdēelihɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē mīyɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó jé ka oŋmá ímálānyī nēé bī ɔ̄ gé lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á, nōo gē gbō um á. Awɔ kē ī hɛ́ um tá á. A klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú, nōo gē gbō um ɛyí ā. A klla ī nuunu ga um lɛbɛ̄ɛka iyɛ́fú olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā. A klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛga nēé gwó lɔfú kú um nɛ̄ n gē kwu tayínū ipú nū. Awɔ klla wɛ ohɔ́nyɛtá kú um, nōo gē hɛ́ um tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ nēe tíne ō ŋmó um á.

eng_Latn: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ō leyīce, klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá ka, Ówukpōō anú wɛ ɔhɔ́nyɛtá ā gɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú alɔ gā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ɛɛ́ māa, alɔ lɛ ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō má ɛɛ́. O ŋmá ɛlā nēé ka ipú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā, alɔ le je ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si míyɛ ɔfú ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ikwū ɛɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ yá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ alɔ kú alɔ lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó lɛ.

eng_Latn: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
idu_Latn: Aá klla géē je opī éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú ínoōbīya, cɛ́ɛ́ aá bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú ācɛ ā yá béekpóó.

eng_Latn: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
idu_Latn: A géē méyīnyinyi alɔ igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. A géē je íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā tá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ báajɛ, klla í je ɔ́ tá ga ɔkɛklɛ kú ísu.

eng_Latn: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyi nū a le jɛ̄, o gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́tɛ́ mɛ́mla aágábá ɔhá ā dúú. Ó kē lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ō lé kllɔcɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō, Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ cɛgbá ká ālɔ̄ yēeyī bɛ̄ɛka ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā kpó lɛ alɔ. Ó yá ɛnyā ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ jé ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ā. O klla hī alɔ igwú kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔfú mɛ́mla ucē olɔhi ō yá kú nū lɛ.

eng_Latn: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
idu_Latn: Á lá ɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a kōō bī ugóolu mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ nááná.

eng_Latn: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sta tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā eko nɛ̄ aá kwú ajɛ ú lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa aá, ámāŋ ka aá le ajɛ lá ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, aá híī yá iyī aá ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō je Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á. Alɔ kē jé kóō géē je alɔ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o je Ujísɔ̄si héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā. Ó kē géē kpó alɔ mɛ́mla aá ga iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē jé ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka Ujísɔ̄si nyā, nɛ̄ aá nyɔ́kpá ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je pīya Óndú mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
idu_Latn: Usímīyɔn í lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi nōo ī tū ɛjī mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le aálelékwū nēe ī gbāājɛ, klla lɛ ɔfú ā yá lé ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā, mīyɛ uwá ɔfú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwēyī kpó tū uwā ɛyí ipéyī ójīla, abɔ̄ ó lɛ agbá kwu uwá abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī pi uwá tá iyī nū ɔkwu yɔ̄ ī gbogwú ā.

eng_Latn: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
idu_Latn: A lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū odúúmā kú uwā kéē yúklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ ga uwɔ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
idu_Latn: Aá wɛ ɔdāhá lɛ ā nɛɛ? Aá gbo oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú aá ŋmá ɛgiyí Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka aá í yēeyī gaajɛ mla ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī aá glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Umósɛ̄rɔtu.

eng_Latn: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
idu_Latn: É géē wā í gwéeyē klla í gwííjē gbōmgbōm ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn. Ɔtū kē í he uwā ohígbū ɔdōōlɔhi nɛ̄ um géē yá lɛ uwá ā. É géē gwéeyē lɛyīkwu īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄, mɛ́mla ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄, mɛ́mla ayí aálá, aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aɛ́na. Ó géē lɔhi lɛ uwá oyēeyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ nēé gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ yɔ̄ ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ miya ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Usséba, ɔyí kú Ubíkiri, nōo ŋmá Ɛ́frem ā ɔ́ɔ le ācɛ kpó trɛ̄yí gē bɛ̄yíkwu Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā. Ujówābu klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kwú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā ú lɛ aá, aá géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da Ujówābu ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē je īkpɛ̄yí kú ɔ̄cɛ ā tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ wā ajɛ gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
idu_Latn: Ulódu, mɛ́mla Óno, mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú ācoyúklábɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá Ubámɔ̄tu ga ɔpɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ kú ācɛ Umówābu, nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú ɛfu kú Upísga, nōo leyīkwu ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíyē kú aɔ́dā oyēeyī í wɛ ɛdɔ ɔkpíyē ékpó ŋ́. Alɛɛcɛ lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɔkpíyē kú uwā, aɛ́bɛ́ lɛ ákú uwā, ígbáanɔ lɛ ákú uwā, ɛbéenyi kē lɛ ɛdɔ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ogbɛhá gē kɛlā ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, amáŋ olagbénú ī kɛlā aflūmā mɛ́mla íkwu.

eng_Latn: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ujowáhāsi wɛ iháyí ofu cɛtá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó ce ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm ɔyā ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta le ɔ́ má ā, ó da Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ̄cɛ ā bɛ́ɛ.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam, ɔyí kú Usólōmɔn wɛ iháyí ofɛpa ce éyi ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda iháyí igwáahāapa Ujerúsālɛm, igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu ŋmá odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ɛga nōó ka ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā á. Ɛ́nɛ́ kú Uréhobōwam wɛ Unáama nōo ŋmá Ámɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ká n̄ kwúcē ga ipú ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ɛpléeko nōo gaá yɛ, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī leyīkwu um lɔɔlɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujérobōwam klla lɛ ucɛ kú ɛya éyi kwu ajɛ ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ahātá, bɛ̄ɛka ɛdɔ ucɛ nēé gē yá Ujúda ā. Ó gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛna kú oje ɔdɔ nōó yá ā ɛyí ede kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā. Ó klla le ācogwɛ́ɛya kpó bá Ubɛ́tɛlu ɛga nōó gwó, ɛga kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, lɛ okónu ɔhá nāa ce lɛ ádā um Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nāa ka ka, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ayááyí kú nū, ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛyí táajɛ klla yɛ tíkpa kú íne ká anúɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ yɛ klla yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ da ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
idu_Latn: Ussímɔn ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā: Ámnɔn, Urína, Ubenhánan mɛ́mla Utílɔn. Íssi ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá: Usóhɛ̄ti mɛ́mla Ubɛnsóhɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá nēe gē bī ɔtū éékpó gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce um ā, eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, é géē nya aá tá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɔ gē fíyajɛ ɔkpáncō ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa géē nyīla ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá lɛ dúú á. Idɔlá kú ɛnɔ ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ágbe kú aá kóō jé. Ó kē í yá kú ōcē kú aá kóō mɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́, aá gbɔɔ́ ō nyīliyē tá géē yɔ̄ í hɛ́ɛkwɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí ɛna nēé lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ tá ŋmá áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nyā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá kwú klla le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á. O yá kóō le pīya Óndú ká ācɛ nēe yēeyī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gekwú.

eng_Latn: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
idu_Latn: Íla mɛ́mla ogwuda í cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā jé ɔdā nēé bá ī yá ā ŋ́. Eyī kú uwá le gwū, ohílīpú kē le nyɛ́ lɛ uwá ō jé ɔkwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū uwɔ ā ŋ́ māa? Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kōō kpó aɔ́dā nēe bá ā ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú wā ɔlɛ́ dɛ̄ɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ kó ō je pīya atufú nāa jégēdē yá Ɔwɔicō āa.

eng_Latn: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Ohóō yɔ̄ lɛ aá nēe lā okónu ísu ā. Éwo kú ācɛ kú Ufilístīya, Óndú ā le ɛpɔ̄ ka tū aá ɛɛ́. Ó géē kpó aá yíífi jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā hile ɔlɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ um jīla ā, é tíne kéē lɛ um hɛ́tá, ohígbū kéē má ɔdā dúúmā nōo cíkā lɛ ikwū ipú ɛpɔ̄ kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
idu_Latn: Ákú alɔ ā, ó lɛ ɛjī nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú gwō kwu. Alɔ gē gwō kwɛjī ɛgiyí úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya lɛ alɔ ā. Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá ipú aá ā wɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē lɛ ɔlá hɛ́ kwu agege ī kwú ɔ̄ ú tayínū ámāŋ kóō kwú ɔgālā í pīya klá anú ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó gē je ɔ́ ce ɛyí ɔdā olɛ agege ce ɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ eko nēé lē bēhé wā ipú inu.

eng_Latn: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um hígwú kahíníī, Óndú, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
idu_Latn: Ami, ōfōōfū um wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́. N gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ, n kē í je oyēeyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. N gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ágbe, n klla ī tá ɔ̄cɛ ágbe. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē bɛyíkwu um ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɛlā kú Ujísɔ̄si ā wɛ ka Ulásārɔ̄si gekwú, amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛyíkwu omlɛ́nyɔ́ ipú iyɔ̄la ōgbo.

eng_Latn: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú ɔcɛ́ ā, é gē cɛ̄ lɛ ejé ī kwú ɔcɛ́ mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bá ī líla tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a lɛ inalegwu tá ga um lɛyíkwu Usenakérīibu, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā.

eng_Latn: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá tāajɛ ā le yá kú ācɛ alɛwa kéē lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā jé. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī piyóó ā le ka ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ɔ́ɔmā jé dúú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú odúúdú uwā kéē cɛ̄ klla lɛyítáajɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā kéē lɛ Ujeremíya gɔ́, kéē lɛ ɔwɛ gwu tū ɔ́ ɔlɛ́ kú Ujonátan, ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā é kwú ɔlɛ́ nū í pīya inu agbá.

eng_Latn: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ cɛ̄tra ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ abɔ̄yī nū ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ í lā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujɛhósāfati lā Ujerúsālɛm nááná ā, ó gē nyɔ̄ ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bá ā gaá má uwā ojigógó. Ó gē yɛ ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba ɛháajɛ jāā ga okónōgwu kú ɔlɛ́ ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ ā kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
idu_Latn: n le Ujísɔ̄si má abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī da um ka, Gbo ɔ́ páápá ká ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ fíya fíya ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, ohígbū kéē gáā mīyɛ ijáalí nāa gáā cɛ̄ ohígbū um ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
idu_Latn: Ɔyī kú uwɔ nāa tá ce um ā le tá ipú iyē kú um ɛɛ́. Abɔ̄ kú uwɔ kē le um fīyɛ̄ wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā igbo ɔmɛtá kahíníī, Usáyímɔ̄ni, ɔyí Ujɔ́ni, a yíihɔtū um? Upíta le mu mla ɔtūnōbí ohígbū kóō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā igbɔ ɔmɛtá kahíníī, A yíihɔtū um m? Anɔ́ɔ ó cīla ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, a jé ɔdā dóódu, á je ka n yíihɔtū uwɔ. Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Leyīkwu aálá kú um.

eng_Latn: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
idu_Latn: Uwá gaá mīyɛ ɛga kú uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ayí kú Ulífāyi kwú oyī kú ɛya nēé gwó ā ú lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ mī klá ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ń mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ā. Óndú, ɛ̄cī dóódu, n gē hī uwɔ igwú klla ī je abɔ̄ kú um gicō kú n̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu tóohi kahíníī, Ó kōō wɛ eko kpií ámāŋ eko dóódu n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ka ó wɛ awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ ŋ́, Amáŋ odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī pó ɛlā kú um ícɛ ā kéē le lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā dúú, amáŋ í tíne ká ā wɛ olagbá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú um, nɛ̄ aá lɛ okónu nɛ̄ n ce mla aá ā bīya.

eng_Latn: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
idu_Latn: Ami yɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ ísu á. Eko nɛ̄ ó yá um ā, éŋkpɔ̄ ī yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when thou art come in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and possessest it, and dwellest therein;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, gáā je lɛ uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ má lā anú.

eng_Latn: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ūwā jé ō nuunu mla ɔkpacaŋgelī. É wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛfú ō kpó le jé ūwā iyē ɛɛ́, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá lɛ ɔkpacaŋgelī kú nū ce átákwū yɔ̄ ī gbāajɛ otú ohígbū aólɛlā.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.
idu_Latn: Lɛ da uwá ka, a yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga um ka amíyɔ̄ je anúɔ tá agbá ɔlɛ́ Ujonátan igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ í tíne kóō nwū alɔ ikpɛ̄lā éyééye, ɔgbɔɔgba ɔgbɔɔgba mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí ɛlā īkpɛ̄yí ɛlā.

eng_Latn: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le ɔ̄na nā otú ɔ́ɔmā. Ó má ɔ̄cɛ Umasɛdónīya éyi háyi yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ̄ kahíníī, Le yɛ wā Umasɛdónīya gaá tá alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ gē je ɔ́ cīgbīhi gé lɛ uwɔ. Ɔyí ɔtū kú um ī wā abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
idu_Latn: Oyī kú aógbɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā ce aá ɛyí. Ohígbū ka aá ŋmó uwā nááná nɛ̄ uwá í wɛ uwī ŋ́ mā. Nááná nɛ̄ aá ī yá ɔdā nēe bá ā kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā odúúdú alɔ yá ucē ɛdɔ ékpó bɛ̄ɛka uwá ā, ālɔ̄ bá gē yá aɔ́dā dúú nēe kwu alɔ ɔtū o yá ā, alɔ gē yá ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē ámāŋ ka aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ɔtū kú alɔ gbɛlá ā. Abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu bɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ohile ā, ó wɛ ɔdā nōo gē ci ŋ́ Ɔwɔicō í yá alɔ italā ohígbū koó le cɔ̄nū mla alɔ ohígbū íne kú nū nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
idu_Latn: Upássɔ, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāajɛ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, le ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujeremíya yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ā pó kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: ímálanyī-ɔka, ejé oōgwá nwuné fíyɛ́ abɔ̄, ɔdīcíci kú uwū ō yá, mla ɔdā ō lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́dā nēe bá ā. Ká n̄ tū aá ukɔ́ ohígbū ɔdā nēe bá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ tū aá ukɔ́ lɛ ā ā, ka ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdā nēe bá ā í gáā lúgwū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ísu ɔ́mɛɛtá ā lé ka ísu kú Utígīrīsi, nōo gē pɛ́ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Asírīya ā. Ísu ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā lé ka ísu kú Uyúfārétīisi.

eng_Latn: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē cikpó uwɔ kpɛ́mm ā wā í tɔ̄há, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e he uwɔ ɔtū mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ mā. N géē kpó uwá wā í jīla tū uwɔ klla í je īlī plá ŋmá uwɔ iyē ká a má tá ohɛ́ɛwa, cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú uwá kā e má ohɛ́ɛwa nōbí nōbí kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe gáā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ā le hɛ́ gɛcɛ hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā. Ufi gbɔɔ́ ó yá otrɛ̄yí ā dúú, ohígbū kóō le jé ka Upɔ́lu wɛ ɔyí ajɛ kú Uróm mla ohígbū ka ó le agbá kwu ɔ́ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
idu_Latn: nēe wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó ga iháyí ofɛpa ce igwó, nēe yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā glá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
idu_Latn: É le ukɔ́tin kú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā yá mla īlī nēé hī ka ulínin ā mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú īlī ɔhá. É klla le ɔ́ tɛ̄tū odufā, ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla ɔnɔ̄wá. É le ijā kú ofu kú ucérōbim wu tū ukɔ́tin ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ eyī le nyā ā, ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā lɛ idáhandā tū nyɔ̄ kahíníī, Lɛ ācɛ ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔyí kú Ujése wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi. Anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu fu, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó kē tá ije olɔnyɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ɛlā ámōōmɛ kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē ká aá wóofu klla cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, odúúdú ācɛ okpaakpa kú Óndú ā. Aá blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ anú nōo tīihɔ ā yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá tá ɔ̄ ahínyá.

eng_Latn: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔkpíihɔ kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nēe lé ka Ádām ā, é lɛ ɔ́ yá ɔ̄cɛ oyēeyī. Amáŋ Ádām ámōōmɛ ā wɛ alelékwū nōo í je oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā ō yá ā í junwalu gā um ŋ́! Ɔtū he um lɛyíkwu ɔ́. Ɔdā ékpó nōo cɛgbá ā wɛ ka, é bī ɔwɛ otɔ́ɔtɛ́ dóódu le tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Amáŋ ó kōō wɛ o tɔ́ɔna ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá oo ámāŋ ka ohígbū itene nēé í dɔɔ̄kā á nɛ̄ oo. Ɔtū géē yɔ̄ gē he um.

eng_Latn: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
idu_Latn: É géē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ga odúúdú kú ɛcɛ kóō wɛ ijáalí lɛ éwo dóódu. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ ā le yá.

eng_Latn: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē lɛ ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú i yá lɛ ā, ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ géē je ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā hégbe cɛ́ɛ́ ejé ā kwú pɛ́ bónū, ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā kē í je yíífi.

eng_Latn: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujáriyɔ̄si kahíníī, Ā híīī yúúfi ŋ́. Lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔyí uwɔ í hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
idu_Latn: A ī yá ɔbɔ́cɛ nɛ̄hi, Ubábīlɔn. Amáŋ a í lɛ ikpó gbo ajɛ klla í gwōnū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā tá uwɔ abɔ̄ je uwɔ cāŋjɛ ŋ́. N géē tū aípɔ́lɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ɔlá, ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ ā géē je yɔɔlá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ā gē tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā ī tū uwā ukɔ́ eko dóódu, ohígbū kōó tíne kóō lɛ uwá mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū nyatá ŋmá ífi.

eng_Latn: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū géē he um ká n yɔ̄ ī yá uwá lɔhi, n kē í bu uwá tū ipú ajɛ nyā piyóó, ŋmá odúúdú odo kú um.

eng_Latn: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le abɔ̄ nāndaa lɛ okwutɛ kú nū miya kwu eyī kú ísu ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā bī owu olɔfú kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī lɛ enyi kú ísu ā nū ga igbīhī, le ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ɔwɛ le tá bū ipú ísu ā. Owu ā tá otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔkwu kú ísu ā í pīya ajɛ íkpākplā á.

eng_Latn: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú aɛ́bɛ́ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí dóódu, ɛbɛ́ nēe yēeyī ā, ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ mla ɛbɛ́ ipú ácí, ɛnɛ̄hi mla ɛnɛŋcɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú aígbáanɔ dóódu le pɛ́ ga ipú úgbéenyi mla Unówa.

eng_Latn: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
idu_Latn: Aá dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā nōo lɔhi kú aá yá. Aá híīī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yēeyī. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā kóō géē yɔ̄ pī aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ pī aá ā.

eng_Latn: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē wā mɛ́mla aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ipú ɛgahi kú Ádā um. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē cíla ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō anɔ́ɔ n má ɔnya nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ce ɛyí nū ā bī ɔ́tā. É kwú ukata kú ɔcɛ́ ú lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔkpáncō cɛyí ɔnya ā ga ipú ɛcɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yálé gbɔbū ɛɛ́, nōo kē í yá aólɛlā kú nū lé kpɔ́ ɛ́.

eng_Latn: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ nōo gē yá klá aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bá gē jɛ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ísu nōo gē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ācɛ Ujíyu éyi, nēé hī ka Usikífa, bá gē je ɔ́da lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí kéē le bɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ Ɛlíssāma, ɔyí kú Ammíhūdi, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frēm.

eng_Latn: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
idu_Latn: N jé ɛ́kɛma kú aá. N kē jé ka aá gbɛhá. Amáŋ ákú aídééma ā, aá gbagbénú nɛ̄hi. N jé aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe je īyī uwā ka aá wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu, nááná nēe wɛ ŋ́ mā, ka lɛyíkwu aá ā. Amáŋ é wɛ ígwu nēe gē gbā ebilíi ɛ̄gbā. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ebilíi ā.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
idu_Latn: É bī aɛ́na úlā ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ , mla aálá úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nēé bī le gwɛ́ɛya kú olétɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ a kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayí ofu cigwó, nēe gē ce aíjakī ofu cigwó. É lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ofu cigwó, ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, nēé gē hī ka aípɔ́lɛ́ kú Ujáyɛ ā jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti le pó kēé kwú Utáya ú yífi ā, ó géē kwu uwá iyē, klla í hɛ́ uwá ohí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, aɛ́nɛ̄ é ma ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ ó bī ije lá ŋmá éwɔhá ā, le apī kpó hɛ̄ mɛ́mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Íjīpiti, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu gā ɛgiyí ayínɛ́ nū ā, é le ɔ́ úwé olɔhi olabɔ̄līkpō ā plla.

eng_Latn: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ ga agbla kú ubáalu ā gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú wúla tāajɛ. É kwu ede mla ojibó kú nū ú kpó ca, klla kwú Umátan ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ubáalu ā ú ŋmó iyɔ̄bū ede kú ubáalu ā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
idu_Latn: N kē í je uwēyī nōo í kwú aá piyóó lɛ aá. Uwēyī ɔ́ɔmā í kē gáā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá aá īkpɛ̄yí gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɛ nēé lā ā lɔhi ámāŋ koó bɔ̄bí, ɔ́dāŋ keé lā áklɔ̄kpɛ ámāŋ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ igá hɛ́ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ā? Alɔ wɛ ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka aá ā nɛ, ācɛ nēe ī kwú bɛ̄ɛka aá ā dúú. Alɔ bī Ɔ̄kōolɔhi gé lɛ aá, ká aá habɔ̄ ɔdā icííci nēe bá ā tá, ká aá pīyeyī tá Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ísu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā wā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpáni ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ka awɔ ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā ōnwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nyā, á gaá yá ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á gáā yá ɔdā lígíí nɛ̄ ó da uwɔ ka, Lɛ iyē gwá ká ā kwú yá yēŋēē ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ íne lɛyíkwu aɛ́bɛ́, aígbáanɔ, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe lā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā oyēeyī dóódu nōo gē pi yɛ ajɛ ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
idu_Latn: Arawúna kwú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá í kpó lɛ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā kóō mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ a í gwó āa.

eng_Latn: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta mɛ́mla ɔyíkpó ɔhá ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ lɛyíkwu únóji ā.

eng_Latn: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
idu_Latn: Óndú, iní nɛ̄ ocābɔ̄ kú ihɔtū nāa tɛtɛ lɛ ā yɔ̄ ā? Iní nɛ̄ okónu nāa ce lɛ Udéfīdi ā yɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ gē gbō um kllá i je ɔfú gā um á. A gē tá um abɔ̄ eko kú unwalu. Odúúdú éwo ā géē pɛ ŋmá ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ wā í da uwɔ kahíníī, Aádáádā alɔ a í lúgwū ɔdā dúúmā gwū aɛ́cí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tá ŋ́. É kē wɛ ɔdā dúúmā gwū icɛ̄bɔ̄ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
idu_Latn: Aá klla ī ka kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō wā í yá ɔdā nōó ka anúɔ gē wā í yá ā fíyaa, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alɔ má ɔ̄. Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í tōō le gbla anú ŋ́ mā kóō yá ɔdā nōó miya ā, ka alɔ má ojuju kú ɔtū kú nū.

eng_Latn: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le cɔ̄nū, klla lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ācoŋmácɛ ā kpó ŋmó, kéē klla lɛ igelī kú ɔlɛ́ uwā tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
idu_Latn: Uréhum, nōo wɛ igbómína ā, mɛ́mla Ussímssāyi, nōo wɛ ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá kú odúúdú ajɛ ā, lɛ ɔkpá ā tá ce Ujerúsālɛm gé lɛ Átasásɛsi.

eng_Latn: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ ka, Ācɛ nēé yálé ā géē leyī gwū ācɛ nēe yá uwā lé ā bónū, í klla ī yá ūwā okónu ka, a le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ákú ūwɔ ŋ́ mā kpó tū lɛ iyī uwɔ. Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá gáā bá ī gbagbénú ŋmá lɛ o mīyɛ ɔdā ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄fú ā gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayínɛ́ nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbō alɔ kɛ̄ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é klla wɔ́tū nū fíyɛ́ ohígbū ɔ̄na kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ɛlā nōó ka lɛyíkwu uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dā o hile kú ígwú ō gbo kú Ábīja ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ka mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā, é lɛ uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Íddo.

eng_Latn: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
idu_Latn: N géē je íkwu lɛ ācocījáalí kú um ɛpa nēe géē lɛ úwé ekwu wiyē ā. É géē cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ɛplá ɛ̄cī úlā ɛtá ce ofɛtá ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
idu_Latn: Ipú oyēeyī kú alɔ ā, alɔ lɛyīce ikwu ojigógó ohígbū ka alɔ gē cɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ɛhɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ oyēeyī kú Ujísɔ̄si ma ipú iyē kú alɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī kwú ā.

eng_Latn: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n yúklɔ́ kú um ŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n je abɔ̄yī um, ó lɛ ā n cíkā ō leyīce ulé nēé í gbā gā um. Amáŋ n gē yúklɔ́ ohígbū kéē pī um bá ɔ̄. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū je úklɔ́ nyā tū um abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
idu_Latn: Koócōō lɛ ahɔ̄ jē ɔkpáncō ɛga nɛ̄ a lā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nōó ba uwɔ ā ká ā lɛ ɔ́ yá lɛ ɔ́ɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē géē lɛ uwɔ jé klla í lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu gē yá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla géē jé ka amíyɔ gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā gā uwɔ amānyā kéē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ipú nú ā.

eng_Latn: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā, í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o wɛ odée ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yá kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kóō jɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē jɛ́yí kú ɔdā otayínū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó géē je lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ ŋ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó lɛ nááná ā, é géē mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
idu_Latn: N jé ɛlá obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá ī gbo lɛyíkwu um ā, mɛ́mla ojuju nɛ̄ aá gē yá ka aá yá um ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ bī eyī kú uwā má ɔdā nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā ōhídáagó nōó yá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Awɔ, Óndú ā géē ce ɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja úlā ɛpa cofigwó ā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi, le tá ɔlɛ́ Obɛ́dɛ̄dɔm gaá kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɛdɔ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā, ɔkwu fu ŋmá ipú ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá wā í gwɛ́ɛya lɛ anú nōo wɛ Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD's.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ dóódu wɛ ákú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō je ɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɔdā ɛhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ ɔyí ɛna ámāŋ ɔyí álá, ámāŋ ka ɔyí ɛwū, ó wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
idu_Latn: Aínyankwūlūmī kú uwā wɛ úlā ce ofu cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Aíjakī kú uwā wɛ úlā igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ofu igwóléyi.

eng_Latn: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n italā yá ācɛ ā ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwā, kwú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwá í tá alácɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ufáyin nōo gwá īkpō alɛwa ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gbo agbénú nwuné lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gwó ede kú aɔ́wɔ lɛ á. Ó klla ka ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ajɛ kú ūwā ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nwuné lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé yá ɔ́kpa kú aɛ́cɔ̄ nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā lɔhi tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le ohi tá ɔ̄ ka anúɔ tá ka ɔ́ɔ̄ bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi dúúmā ga ɛga dúúmá ŋ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú bī ɔ̄kā nyɔ̄ gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɛ̄cī ɔhá dóódu glá, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔcɛ́ kwú á.

eng_Latn: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
idu_Latn: Aá híī jikwū kú ɔcɛ́ nōo gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē yēkwu kú nū ŋ́. Amáŋ aá jikwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔcɛ́ nēé kwú ɔfiyɛ bī nyɔ̄ ajɛ aéwɔhá ā. Ohígbū koó gáā pīyɛyí ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wā ɔlɛ́ ī má ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ádā nū gbóógbóō ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli kwú ɛyí ú cikwū ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ okónu ce nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ kéē lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá kē í lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: N géē jíla odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ agbénú kú uwā kpó wā amānyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ n le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū mu mla agbénú.

eng_Latn: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá aípɔ́lɛ́ nēé cē igá tū uwā ŋ́ mā, é géē je uwā bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ kú ipácí ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ lɛ ā lɔfú lá ɔdāyīnū cīgbīhi glá, é kē í kpó uwā cīgbīhi eko nēé gē je ɔdā cīgbīhi lɛ óndú nū ā.

eng_Latn: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔlɔ nɛ̄ ó ī bū éŋkpɔ̄ ŋ́, é klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojuja nɛ̄ owu nɛ̄hi ī kpó ga mu ga anú ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛga odobū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā tútū gbēyī uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, ɔtū kú nū í kē wɛ ékpónú ɛgiyí ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ákú ádā nū, Udéfīdi lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔtūce Ɔwɔicō, Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ā lɛ lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi ā, ó géē lā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi lɔfú lɔfú ka, Aá jámá da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā nóó n.

eng_Latn: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
idu_Latn: Ébram yɛ ipú ajɛ le tá ajɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm, ɛgiyí ɔcí nēé hī ka óokú kú Umɔ́re ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ Ukénan bá ipú ajɛ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá híī ka iŋini ɔtāhɛ̄ iyī aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
idu_Latn: Ɛlá ō gbo kú olíla wɛ ínoōbīya eko dóódu. Ācɛ gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔdā ɔhá ō yá gwū ācɛ ō jijitēyī tá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá abɔ̄yī aá í yɔ̄ aflɛ́yí ká aá bī ɔ̄ wā ŋ́ mā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, lɛ italā yá alɔ, ohígbū ka alɔ í bī ɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ cíkā ō bī ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujabín lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú oje úlā ɛpa cofɛhɔ̄ . Ó bī ɔnɔɔtū mɛ́mla abɔ̄fú le gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofu. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō lɛ aá tábɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka.

eng_Latn: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
idu_Latn: Adá le Ɛlífāsi ma. Ubasɛmāti le Uréyūwɛlu ma.

eng_Latn: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō í tíne ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa ō ka ŋ́, ó yɛ í gbō ɛcɛ glá ŋ́. A géē ŋmó Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla ī kɛpɔ̄ kpaakpa ā ɛpɔ̄bí glá nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
idu_Latn: N le ɔtū lé mla ācogbāálá ɛtá ɔhá nēe gē wɔ́ɔ́tū um ā gɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwā ú nū, ipú ɔyā éékpónú á.

eng_Latn: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usátu wɛ, úlā ɛpa ce ofu ahāapa ce ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
idu_Latn: N tíne ká ā gbɔkpá ā ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ā ka, anúɔ í gáā lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɔyí um ŋmá ipú ayínɔ̄nyā kú Ukénan nɛ̄ um lā ipú uwā nyā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɛ́cí dóódu nɛ̄ ádā nū je kpó ca tāajɛ ā, ó le odúúdú uwā kpó gwó. Ó le ede kú ubáalu gwó klla le ojibó kú ɔwɔ nɔ̄nyā, Ássɛ̄ra ma kwu ajɛ. Ó klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ̄gbā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ása lɛ ɛlā kú ɛbɛ oōmá kú Óbɛ́di, ɔyí kú Asárīya nyā pó ā, iyē kú nū kwú lɔfú. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú odúúdú ɛcí nōo bá ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda, Ubɛ́njamīn mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ ā ú kpó bónū ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ede kú Óndú ā nōo yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tū gwó.

eng_Latn: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, é le tá ɛga nēé hī ka aóbugā, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Lɛ ācɛ a tuba tɔ̄ɔ̄há, n géē je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Unebúcádnēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn le ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ ma. Olicó kú nū wɛ ikpó ofu cigwó, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpō ɛhīlī. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ajɛ ŋmɛ́ɛɛ kú Udúra ipú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ í fīyégbúlú kpáákpá, a cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kpoókpoó yɔ̄ ī yá um nɛ̄hi, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ o pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnyā nōo gē nyɔ̄ ɔnɛ̄fú ō kpó ā.

eng_Latn: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú abɔ̄yī nū gwó dúú. Ó gwó inu ā iháyí igwɛ́ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwó kwɛyí á.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urebéka mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā cāŋjɛ gaá cɛyí aínyankwūlūmī kéē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ébrahām ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́gɔ́ éyi nēe yēeyī eko éyī ā, ga aɛ́gɔ́ ɔhá nēe gboce uwá ā, géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra úklɔ́ kú uwɔ. É klla kē í bī úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā tɔ́ɔna.

eng_Latn: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔwɛ ŋmó tū um kú n kwu ŋ́, kéē lɛ um bī wāajɛ dúúdú. É kē cɛgbá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ō tá uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ehée, ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ aá gē fu ácí ā, aá lɔfú fu ikpɔ̄dā ā ōhī dúú.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya klla ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ ka gɔbū kahíníī, N géē bī owu nōo ī kpó ɔdā yíífi wā í je Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Ubábīlɔn yíífi.

eng_Latn: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
idu_Latn: Alɔ í tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá eko dóódu ohígbū aá piíí, ayínɛ́, nēe he Óndú ā ɔtū. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá fu kú aá wɛ ācɛ aflɛ́yí nēé nyatá ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū lɛ aá yá ācɛ o tīihɔ kú ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá lɔtūkpóce ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ā géē ka lɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛbɛ́ klla yá uwā olíla lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄ n yá ipéyī uwā o yá kú ā jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ācɛ Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn, anɔ́ɔ ígwu kú uwā éyi le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí nū kóō tá uwā abɔ̄, ohígbū ka éwo kú uwā gē lɛ ɔdōlé kú uwā ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Aflɛ́yí é le ɔya kpó tá Ublástɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ o leyīkwu agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
idu_Latn: N géē ma ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá í yúúfi nū ā fú lɛ aá. Aá yúúfi Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó kwɛyí, lɛ íkwu ō je ɔ̄cɛ tá ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ā. Aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um, anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá í yúúfi nū piíí á.

eng_Latn: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū gē je ɛbɔ́ lɛ odo kú um á. Anú nɛ̄ n kē lɔtūce á.

eng_Latn: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī pa ɛcɔ̄ hīla yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tú ɛcɔ̄ bá kē yɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē lɛ ɔtū má ācɛ ɔtū yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē tá ɔtū gɛcɛ hɛ̄ īyī ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá tá kē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
