idu_Latn: Aá tɛtɛ gē kpó ácí ihili lɛ uwá, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ma ubulɔ́kwu á. O ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, uwá géē kpó ihili abɔ̄yī uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nēé í ma ubulɔ́kwu mɛ́ɛ á.

eng_Latn: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bā ī nyɔ̄ āa, Ɔwɔicō le ufi tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe kwu abɔ́ɔ ajaajɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é nū uwā inya glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā le ɛlā ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́, bá ī ka ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā, Ɔwɔicō géē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú iyē nū.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá gwū um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā ī nyɔ̄ ī tú ɔ̄ bá, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ wú ɔjī klla lɛ ɔ́ gbā ɛgɔ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔlá ipú ɛ̄hī. É ge yá igbō ŋmá anú. Ɔnyɛ kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nēé yá mla anɔ̄ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ íne je lɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ā kahíníī, A géē lé īkpō ɔcí dóódu kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Usáyímɔ̄n! Usáyímɔ̄n! Jāhɔ̄! Ebilíi le ɛga mīyɛ kóō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aá jámá, kóō lɛ ɔdā olɔhi fō gɛcɛ ŋma obɔ̄bí, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔglɛ́ɛjí gē tá igbómgbō kú igwu owu ŋmá īkpō nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka anúɔ nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kpɛ́fú tá uwá ipú ajɛ ā á. Ó ka anúɔ le ācɛ ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá klla kwú ajɛ kú uwā ú lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ikwū mɛ́mla ɔlékwū kpó tɛ́cɔ̄ ga ipú ókpoó kú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā klā Ɛ́dɔm ɛyi.

eng_Latn: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
idu_Latn: Ó í je aójibó kú oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā kú ɔdu kú ɔdɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú aɔ́wɔ kú uwā kpó kwú cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti mɛ́mla iyī ūwā. Igbīhi kú eko kú ɛbɔ́ kú iháyí alɛwa ā.

eng_Latn: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó kwú ánya kú nū tū glá ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī nɛ̄hi nēé wúla tāajɛ, nɛ̄ igá dúúmā nōo gē gbō ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā yá kú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ayisáya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ka ā kóō le yá jīla. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Usɛ́fɔni, Uhággi, Ussúni.

eng_Latn: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le okónu nōo ce lɛ Ujéhu kahíníī, Ayí uwɔ géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu igbīhi uwɔ jāā ga ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā, yá jīla á.

eng_Latn: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je eyīyōce lɛ aógbɛhá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ okónu kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gwū.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, a cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā lɛ uwá yálé klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbō uwā bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā. Ipú unwalu kú uwā ā, é le uwɔ hīgwú kú ā wā í tá uwā abɔ̄. A kē lɛ ohi tá uwā ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Abɔ̄ a gē méyīnyinyi uwā nɛ̄hi ā, a le aótrɛ̄yí nēe nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā kpó gé lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ aɛ́ga nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē yɔ̄ ipú ɔwá kú icɔ́ɔci ā kpó lɛ uwá. Ɛga kú aflɛ́yí ā wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄, ɛga ɔ́mpa wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, ɔ́mɛtá wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe ī nwū ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ohídáagó gboce uwá. Ācɛ nēé je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē ā gboce uwá. Ācɛ nēe í tá ācɛ abɔ̄, ámāŋ nēe gē ma ɔwɛ fú lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe í ka aúcē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā kwúcē uwá.

eng_Latn: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ ɛpa géē bá yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ipú ɛhɔ̄. É géē je ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú uwā, é kē í habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā tá.

eng_Latn: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
idu_Latn: Adin wɛ ācɛ úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nēe yá aálelékwū otɛhɔ nēe bīyíne ā, Ɔwɔicō í mabɔ̄ uwā tá ŋ́, ó le italā yá uwá. Ó lɛ uwá tá tū ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ, ɛga nēé lɛ agbá kwu uwá ipú ajoodobū jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kú aá géē kahíníī, Īī, amáŋ é gwó ābɔ̄ ā bónū kéē yá ɛga gā um.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n cījáalí lɛ iyī um nááná, ijáalí kú m wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ohígbū ka n jé ɛga nɛ̄ n ŋmá mla ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ aá jé ɛga nɛ̄ n ŋmá mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ n gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
idu_Latn: A lɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwɔ nāŋ́daa, kwu aólɛlā ā kwú uwɔ ú kpó mule.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a le nyɛ́ tū īyī uwɔ eyī nááná ā, ó wɛ awɔ wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Óndú ā le anɔ̄ tū uwɔ ɛyí kú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtōōce kú uwā í lɔfú ŋ́ mā, n le yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtōōce kú um í lɔfú ŋ́ mā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú n lɛ uwá bī gé lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē yá bɛ̄ɛka ɛdɔ kú ācɛ dóódu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ācɛ ōhī kú uwá nyatá bū ɔwɛ dúúmā nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dā ōhī le pɛ́ tū ɛplá ápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ ajɛ ɔlamu í nwuné ŋ́ mā ā. Īkpɔ̄dā le bū wɛ̄ɛcɛ fíyaa, abɔ̄ ajɛ ɔlamu í cɔkpɛ́nú ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń gicō ga ɛgiyí Ádā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ká ā da uwá ka, n gē gicō ɛgiyí Ádā um mɛ́mla Ádā aá, Ɔwɔicō kú um mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā da ācɛ nēe gē gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ka aá leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́. Aá kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um í nū klá ɛcɛ, klla lɛ uwá pahīla bɛ̄ɛka aálá. N géē héyītū aá, í yá italā ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nēé mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla Ussílo, le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ pi kwaajɛ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu í kwú ɔtū kú nū tū glá gɛ ŋ́ ipēyī ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú uwā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú inu. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔhá í yɔ̄ ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu eko nōó da ayínɛ́ nū ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
idu_Latn: Ásɛlu ma ayí ɛhīlī. Iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Asríkam, Ubokéru, Íssmɛ̄lu, Uséyarīya, Obadáya, mɛ́mla Uhánan.

eng_Latn: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó le īlī ā na, anɔ́ɔ odée ā í yɔ̄ anú gɛ ŋ́, ó géē na īlī ā igbɔ́mpa, cɛ́ɛ́ īlī ā kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Oto kú umu ā í gáā mɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīifu nōo yɔ̄ ipú oli ā gē ŋmó ŋ́, jāā gbɛ́ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē tū ɔwɔ wā í yā klá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ ɔ́ ŋmótū ka aá nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛfú kpó tú Ujúda cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá ɔtū wuklíicō. Cɛ́ɛ́ ipú ufi kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā, aá ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Utábíilu ú cɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
idu_Latn: Upedáya ma ayí ɛpa. É kē wɛ Userúbābɛlu mɛ́mla Ussímēyi. Userúbābɛlu ma Umésūlam mɛ́mla Uhananíya ā, mɛ́mla adá kú nū, Ussélómīti.

eng_Latn: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
idu_Latn: É cɛ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá géē yɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le aólɛlā kú alɔ kpó yálé. Ó le yá kú ālɔ̄ gbō aéwo dóódu.

eng_Latn: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ gē túblá Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, anú nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ nōo yēeyī nɛ̄ ācɛ o ma inu tá tónū kóō lɛ ɔhí ŋ́ mā, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ má ka ó lɔhi, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú á.

eng_Latn: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɔ̄cī nū, é cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu ā kéē kpɛ́fú. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, alɔ lɛ tútū ō ga ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu nū lɛ alɔ ā ɛɛ́, alɔ le íne bīya.

eng_Latn: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nēé le owu nyi, ɛ́ɛ géē cē ofúlutu. Ó klla ka īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó jé ŋ́, ka é gáā lɛ ɔ́ yá igbō glá ŋ́. Óndú klla ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ kōō le jé, nááná aéwo ɔhá gáā je ɔɔ́ lé á.

eng_Latn: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ussáwulu gekwú ā, Ubaal-Uhánan, ɔyí kú Ácībɔ lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, uwá abɔ̄yī uwā ā, kéē le pīyeyī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē igbīhi ga ipú ígbíli nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó, nōo géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ācɛ ōhī yɔ̄ ī ka, Alelékwū obɔ̄bí yɔ̄ ipú nu.

eng_Latn: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu Issbɔ̄ssɛti ā lɛ ācɛ ɛpa nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ nēe ī nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tú aípɔ́lɛ́ ī yɛ. Iyē uwā lé ka Ubaána mɛ́mla Urécabu, ayí kú Urímɔn. É wɛ ācɛ igelī nēé hī ka Ubéerɔtu, ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin ā. É ka Ubéerɔtu nyā tū ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjāmin.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
idu_Latn: Ó pi aá ahɔ̄ kú aá cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya pllá aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka Uhɛsɛkíya í nya aá tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umédiya plla tū ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́, ohígbū kóō tíne ō je ācɛ Ubábīlɔn yíífi. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tínē ō gwō ɔcí kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū nɛ̄ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn je yíífi ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔyī kú aá tūlé! Aá kwú aɔ́kplɛ́fú kú aá kpó!.

eng_Latn: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usedekíya da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō pó ɔ̄kā kú alɔ nyā ŋ, cɛ́ɛ́ abɔ̄ í gáā kwu oyēeyī kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī géē ŋmá ipú ígwu kú aá géē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō kpó tū ɔkwu nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ alɔ i pīya tɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, apī ō hɛ́ ámāŋ ka apī á hɛ́ ŋ́, í tīile dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nōo tīile ā wɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō nōo ī mafú ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ ō yá.

eng_Latn: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugáálu le uwá má, anɔ́ɔ ó da Usébulu koó má ācɛ nēe bá ī wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā. Usébulu tá ɔ̄ ohi kéē wɛ ācɛ ŋ́, kéē wɛ ojiji kú ɛyí ɛfu nɛ.

eng_Latn: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
idu_Latn: Aá le īkpīje nēé gē bī le da ije ɔlɛ́ ā mafú gā um! Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ikpīje éyi ú gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
idu_Latn: Inu kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, nōó hī ka, Agbla Ɛgohɛ́pɔ̄ ā, yɔ̄ anú dúú. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ Usólómɔ̄n gē cīce ī hɛ́pɔ̄ á. Ó le ɔcí nēé hī ka usɛ́da ā hɛ́ bá ɔdɔ kú nū ŋmá ajɛ jāā kwu aflá kú icō.

eng_Latn: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā, á híī yúufi uwā ŋ́ ámāŋ ka ɔdā nēé géē ka ā. Ucē ō yá kú uwā lɛyíkwu uwɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka a yɔ̄ ipú uje ámāŋ ka lā ipú aɛ́na ocɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā náaná ā, ā yúufi ɔdā nɛ̄ āce o yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā géē ka ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gēe yúufi eyī kú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le íjééyī, ɔdōōjé, ohílīpú, mɛ́mla ɔkpá ō jé nɛ̄hi kpó lɛ uwá. Ɔwɔicō klla kwú ɛbɛ oōmá, mɛ́mla ɛyí kú ɔna ō jé ú kpó blla anú lɛ Udánīyɛlu.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē kpó ācɛ ā yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ yá Usíhɔn mɛ́mla Ógu, aɔ́cɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ klla je ajɛ kú uwā yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā, aá tɛtɛ yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó le eyīnyinyi aá má ohígbū ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu yá ā.

eng_Latn: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔwɛ ŋmó tū um, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ gā um gaá yɛ ŋ́ má. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā le dobū tū um.

eng_Latn: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
idu_Latn: É klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ ka ka ālɔ̄, ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ɔkpɛtá nōo yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā géē je alɔ kpó ŋmó bónū. Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ kē cīce amānyā, alɔ géē pɛ́ kwú dúú. Ó lɛ ā, ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Usiríya ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé le alɔ ŋmó, ayíka alɔ kē le pɛ́ gekwú, ɔ́dāŋ́ kēé kē ŋmó alɔ ŋ́, ayíka alɔ kē í yēeyī.

eng_Latn: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō ka, n géē gbɛka nyā lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ n kwú íne nēé bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le táajɛ kú Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn á.

eng_Latn: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ odée kplá ācɛ nɛ̄ aá leyice kéē lɔfú je odée ā kwúcē lɛ aá glá ā, ɔdiyá nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cíkā ō hɔ́hā ce aá ā? Ācobīyíne nááná gē lɛ ije kplá ācobīyíne gē leyīce kéē í gbā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ije ā lɛ uwá!.

eng_Latn: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā ka kéē kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū aá ɛyí cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le pīya ayíkpó kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
idu_Latn: Uhúram klla le ɔgbanjɛ̄ igwó yá, éyééye kú nū cɛyí utéblu o lɛ akā ā éyééyē. Oŋmá ābɔ̄ okónū kú ɔgbanjɛ̄ ā ga ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛhīlī, éyééye kú nū lɔfú bī ɔgálūwā kú énkpɔ̄ ofigwóléyi glá.

eng_Latn: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gē bī olɛhɔ̄ nōo gē mafú lɛ ācɛ ɔwɛ nēé lɔfú lā oyēeyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi glá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le yá lɛ ā, n géē lɛ ɔdā ō labɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ká n̄ bī aá gwō ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē wā ā. Ohígbū ka ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá gbla ā géē mafú ká ɔfú nɛ̄ n le tīiyē mɛ́mla úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá ā í bónū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ka ɛ́ɛ lɔhi klla yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mīyɛ ajɛ kú ācɛ ā ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē nū ācɛ ā bɛ̄cɛ, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā bɔ̄bíipú. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla tíne ō lɛ ɛka nōó gbo mla ádáádā uwā, Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the LORD our God shall call.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō cokónu ā lɛ aá mɛ́mla ayí aá mɛ́mla ācɛ dóódu nēe bá ɛga oligbó, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū hīgwúā.

eng_Latn: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
idu_Latn: Uhélebu, ɔyí kú Ubaána ŋmá Unetófa ā. Ítāyi, ɔyí kú Uríbāyi nōo ŋmá Ugíbēya, ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjāmin ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ákú uwɔ lɔhi, Usáyímɔ̄ni, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujɔ́ni, ohígbū koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ma ɔ́ fú gā awɔ ā ŋ́, amáŋ Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka amíyɔ̄ da uwá ka anúɔ Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔjá kú ɔmɛ nyā ca klá ajɛ nōó tōō gllayá gɛ ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē je ācɛ nēe bá nyā mɛ́mla igelī kú uwā yíífi á. Ācɛ géē kpó aókwū kú uwā nyi ɔpɛ́ kú Utɔ́fɛ̄ɛti, ohígbū ka ɛga ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ nēé gē kpó aókwū ā nyi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi nyā piíí nɛ̄ ācɛ ā tá yɔ̄ ī da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yá uwɔ otrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ohɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ ā? Anú ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī abɔ̄ kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōó má ipácí ā le ɔ́ fu klla lɛ ɔ́ yá otrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ohɔ́nyɛtá á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá wā ā, íne ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ gē nā alɔ tá ɔwɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛpɔ̄ɔhi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ami, Óndú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, aá géē kwú, aá kē gáā kwu hɛ́ ikwū abɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Aá gē ŋmó ācɛ, ācɛ kē géē ŋmó aá.

eng_Latn: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
idu_Latn: Anú gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ aéwɔhá ā lɛ eyīyōce á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
idu_Latn: A le ācɛ nēe gē gbā uwɔ ā ahɔ̄ pi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā nōo yá uwā lé ā.

eng_Latn: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
idu_Latn: Ágábá nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɛ́bɛ kpɛ́mm, nɛ̄ ó ī yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó gā iyɔ̄bū Áhābu ā, ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Umikáya n̄ nyɔ̄ mla Ujɛhósāfati gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di kɛ̄ɛ kā n̄ híī nyɔ̄ ŋ́? Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, a géē yálé. Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ gā uwɔ yá uwā lé gbóóó.

eng_Latn: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ugbé nēé gē le cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛna o cɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ugbé kú uwā nyā nēé gē bī le yá ācɛ ōwē ɔyā ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, úklɔ́ kú ede mɛ́mla ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ úklɔ́ kú uwɔ, ohígbū ka n kwú ɛhi kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ú gā uwɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo túblá ɔdā otīihɔ ā géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá kú ālɔ̄ kē lɛ iyī alɔ lɛ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ālɔ̄ háyi lɔfú, kú ālɔ̄ klla je iyī alɔ yá ɔfiyɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, A yɔ̄ í ka lɛyíkwu igelī nyā ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɔ́ɔ géē kpɛ́fú tú ɔ́, í yá ɔ́ lé ohígbū ɔkpɛtā nōo yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ā. Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, uwá kéē leyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um mɛ́mla odúúdu iyó kú nū. É géē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā ŋmáajɛ mla odúúdu iyó kú nū, klla í je ɔ́ kwaajɛ, é klla í lā yɛ jīla anú tá.

eng_Latn: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
idu_Latn: Woó, Ɔwɔicō, bla ka oyēeyī kú um lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ. Ń gáā má olɔhi dúúmā glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó klla lɛ ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ gwó ɛyí ede ā. Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu á, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ í nyí ɔlá kú ihɔtū glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ o cēenyi í lɔfú gwu ɔ́ bónū glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú agbénú kú nū í kpó tū ihɔtū, o jɛ̄ ɔ̄ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔtū lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā géē je tá alácɛ̄, nōó géē nyɔ̄ í lā aígelī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā ŋ́, nēe gáā wúlatāajɛ dúúdú ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si ta ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔnyīlɔ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ um yá ɔ̄cɛ ohɛ́pɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ o kɔ̄ úgwū lɛ aá ɛplɛ́ɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Abígɛ̄lu lɛ Udéfīdi má ā, ó kwú hīla tá ŋmá ɛyí ijakī kú nū gaá lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gaá kwú ā, ó da Usólōmɔn, ɔyí nū ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo tá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ nwū aá nyā, ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó yɔ̄ ī tá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ ī tá Ɔwɔicō nōo je Alelékwū ihɔ kú nū lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā ahɔ̄ pi, nōo kwúcē ŋmá ucē ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā ŋ́, ó géē kwú ipú ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā. Oyī kú nū í gáā ce uwɔ ɛyí ŋ́. Ayíka a lɛ īyī uwɔ nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē yá Usamérīya italā ohígbū īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄ ó yá tá anúɔ ā. Ó klla ka ācɛ kú Usamérīya ɔ́ɔ géē pɛ́kwú ɔgbɛ́fú. Ka é géē kpó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ūwā, í tá ūwā fīyajɛ kéē pɛ́kwú. É kē í klla je anyā ō yīipú kú uwā ipú yíla klá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhúram kwú aúpíla ɛpa ā ú kpó bū tū okómpīinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó hī ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kwu ɛháajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ka Ujákin, ó kē hī ɛ̄nɛ̄ o kē kwu ɛhícō ā, ka Ubówāsi.

eng_Latn: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ́ɛ yíhɔtū tá aúgbɔga. Ohígbū ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā tɛtɛ wɛ aúgbɔga ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti eko éyi dúú.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
idu_Latn: Ujúda géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi gboce Urúbɛ̄n ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Bla ka n géē je ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ bī gé um, nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā ŋ́ mā yá uwɔ ɛhi. N géē kpó uwā gā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ kéē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka odúúdú aá wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlá ofíyájɛ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Alɔ í yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe gē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā kú uwa otú ámāŋ ka ipú ajoodobū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
idu_Latn: Ébrahām túkpɛɛɛ́ leyī pīya klá ajɛ le ɛhɛ yɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da īyīnū kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ ɔyí eko nōó wɛ iháyí ofɛhɔ̄ glá ɛ́ɛ̄? Usára nōo wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ ce igwó ā mɔyí glá ɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
idu_Latn: ó géē bī ɛbɔ́ wā. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asíriya wā gaá ca ɔlɛ́ alɔ kéē ca ɛga olɔfú kú alɔ ā, alɔ géē tū aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ nēe lɛwa jɛ̄ kéē gaá nuunu tū uwā.

eng_Latn: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comáɛbɛ ɔhá dóódu í yá ɛdɔ ɔ̄dā ō hídáagó, nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī Umósīsi yá lɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ɛ́ɛ́ gé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
idu_Latn: Úmósīsi ka aá le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tá aá abɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔ tá kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nēé je, ɔ́ɔ kōō tá aá ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, aá kē í má ɔlá ōceyī nɛ̄hi ō mafú ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā. Ó le iŋini nɛ̄ aá gē ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā pó ɛɛ́. Ɔdí wɛ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ aá gē ka iŋni tá alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ klla géē yá ɔ̄ italā ohígbū eko nɔ́ɔ je mlanyī anúɔ nyɔ̄ ī yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ Ubáal ā, nɛ̄ ó je agbá kú nū tū ojibó kú ɛcí ā ɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ í tá aɔ́ya nū ɔkwu ā. Ó ka anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā kɛlā ā á.

eng_Latn: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le bīya lɛ Uhérɔ̄du, ɔ̄cɛ́ ā, amáŋ ohígbū ɔkpá nōó gbo ā, mɛ́mla aúgbɔga kú nū ā, ó le ɔ́da je kéē kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyā dɔɔ̄kā ā ú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
idu_Latn: A géē pīya ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi kú ejé klá ɛyí ede ā mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɔyí omlede kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, aá yɛ Usáyɔn biílí, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbā inɔ̄ɔda-ɔkplɛ́fú kú nū áluka.

eng_Latn: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū wɛ umíta úlā ɛ̄hɔ̄ ce ofígwɛ́ɛpa cigwó ā, aókómpinu ɛtá í bá abɔ́ɔ. É géē lé iyē ka okómpinu kú Ujófɛ̄fu, okómpinu kú Ubɛ̄njamin mɛ́mla okómpinu kú Udán.

eng_Latn: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujósɛ̄fu tá klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔkpanī um ī lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā dúúmā ɔlɛ́ nyā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ amānyā. Ó klla kwú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā ú kpó tū um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā ga ipú nú ā, ɔ́ lɛ̄bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ŋmá ā ŋ́. Ó ka Íjīpiti ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nyi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ klla gē nyɔ̄ ī móōwē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdōnīgbō dóódu kóō híī yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ɔyí ajɛ ámāŋ ugbɔga lɛ igbō nēé le ɔdōnīgbō tū ɔ̄ ā lé, ó gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
idu_Latn: Ufi ī yá um, ka eko nɛ̄ n gā abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́, ɔdā ékpó nōo yá aflɛ́yí ā géē yá kpɔ́. Ka Ɔwɔicō géē yá kú um yúwēyī aá. Ufi í yá um ohígbū ka n géē jikwū ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē yɔ̄ ī bīyíne kú Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ ékpó ŋmá eko nōo yɛ ā, nēé kē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔdīcííci, ikpɔ́nyā ōce, ajā ō gbo mɛ́mla únwū ɔkpíyē ɛdɔ̄ obɔ̄bí ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí otūwēyī nēé yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ eyī gáā nyā, Upɔ́lu le ɔkɔ gbā le odúúdú uwā kéē lɛ ɔdōlé lé. Ó da uwá kahíníī Aá húmáyī gbēyī ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á, aá kē lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubárūku lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé lɛ uwá ā, ufi le uwá kwú, anɔ́ɔ é pīyeyī má īyī uwā á. É da Ubárūku kahíníī, Alɔ géē kpó ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā nyɔ̄ í da ɔcɛ́ piíí.

eng_Latn: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si, Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ā gbā ā pó ɛɛ́, ó kē le ɛhi kú uwɔ nāa ī yá ācogbɛhá ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ŋ́, lɛ ɔdōlé otīīhɔ nyā a lé icííci, nōó jé ŋ́. Ó géē cíla ulé nū lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya fíyɛ́ ɛga ofu ŋmá ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄ á, Anú géē hɛpɔ̄hi lɛ ācɛ ōhī, kē ī ŋmó ācɛ ōhī ɛpɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n gā ɛgiyí uwɔ ká ā gbō um ɛɛ́. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwēyī kwú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a hī um ka ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú í lɔhi ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū lɔhi á.

eng_Latn: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ n má ɛɛ́ mā, wɛ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɛɛcɛ yá kpaakpa, amáŋ ācɛ kwú īyī ūwā ú yá gbájí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka é lɛ opo tá, ohígbū ka aólɛlā ā le wu klíicō, lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, bɛ̄ɛka aúcē nēe yɔ̄ ī pīya kéē wāajɛ gaá je ɔyí ugwū ā. Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɛ́ɛ le okónu nɛ̄ anúɔ ce mla uwá ā nyíla klla le íne kú anúɔ bīya.

eng_Latn: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukénan nēe lā ɛyí ɛfu ā le unu nū tá uwā, le uwá yálé, klla le uwá nīinya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā ga Uhɔ́ma.

eng_Latn: But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɛ̄nyā ā, ɔyínɛ́ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā éyi gē bī ɔyínɛ́ ɔhá ga únɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ŋ́ mā kéē kɛpɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:
idu_Latn: Ɔcányā ā le uya nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū yá ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le bēhé ga inu ɛga kú ucɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ágábáidu, Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ uwɔ ɛyí tápátɛ́cɔ̄! Ɛlā nyā kóō híī je unwalu gā uwɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ eyī kú uwɔ gē je pīya ɛdɔ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ufi gē yá um, Ohígbū nɛ̄ ɔdā nōo yá Íifu kóō bīyíne ā géē yá aá. Ɛgwā bī ula ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ plla le íne bīya. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ufi gē yá um kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá kú ɔdōōbɔ̄bī ō yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ŋmá odúúdú ɔtū ékpó gɛ ŋ́ nóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛcí éyi ɛ̄cɔbū ā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē yá ka Umówābu kóō kwúcē wɛ ahɔ̄ olɔhi kpɔ́. odúúdú ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā mla ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ka ɔɔ́ géē yá Umówābu á. Odúúdú italā nēé gaá yá Umówābu ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ agbá tū uwā, nēé bá ī móōwē.

eng_Latn: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēe tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá íne mɛ́mla ɔkpá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā bī ācɛ jé ɔwɛ jāā gaá kwu eko kú Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim ā. Óŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā, é húmáyī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú ācɛ bá gē kwɛga nɛ̄hi kéē bēhé ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄fú.

eng_Latn: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ajɛ kú uwā ɛhícō ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ujɔ́dan gaá bū ɔpɛ́ kú ɛhícō kú Ujérīko, mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ gaá bū ipɔ́lɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu jāā ga ipú ígbíli nōo kwu igbíli kú Ubɛtáfén ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kwú ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú gaá háyi ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛháajɛ kú aúcɛ́rōbim ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
idu_Latn: A lɔfú je ɔkpáncō nāŋdaa klá icō kóō yɔ̄ ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā glá áa?.

eng_Latn: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
idu_Latn: Ɔtulalī mla anɔ̄ okpóocu gē yá ka ɔtū kóō he uwɔ, amáŋ unwalu gē je ɛbɔ́ kú odo kú uwɔ pahīla.

eng_Latn: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kwú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá nyā ú kpó kwu ɔ́ lɛ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla Uhɛ́burɔn nēé tɛtɛ je lɛ uwá ā. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
idu_Latn: lɛ ayí kú Árɔ̄ni nēe wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukóhāti nōo ŋmá Ulífāyi ā. Uwá nēé je ajɛ lɛ uwá aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ anɔ̄ otīīhɔ yá ŋmá aɔ́dā mbá a, anɔ̄ nēé wīya tɔ̄há bɛ̄ɛka ɔtulalī ā. Ó géē wɛ anɔ̄ ōtīihɔ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ayááyí alɛwa gā uwɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo géē yá kéē je pīya aéwo. Ayááyí uwɔ ōhī géē wɛ aɔ́cɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila ipí ā, ɔ́dāŋ koó nyīla ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɛga nōo gē wá ɔ̄ ā, í gbɔɔ̄gɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɔkpíyē ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
idu_Latn: Ó má cīce kóō lé ɔdōlé mla uwá. Ó kwú igbō ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō. Ó le ɔ́ ce, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ogbló nēé gē lɛ bī ikpati ā yá ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ugóolu ma plá anú iyē.

eng_Latn: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō jila úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ó yá ā má kóō má ɔ̄ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɔhi, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɔfú gwō kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá abɔ̄yī nū ā. Ó gáā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ā gbla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.
idu_Latn: Upedáya, ɔyí kú Upárōssi gbɔɔ́ ō ma ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá kwu ɛgiyí ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ nōo kwu Ɔwɛ kú éŋkpɔ̄ mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda nōo tá wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá jé ɔdā nēé tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācogwínu tá ā, le pīya ɛcɔ̄ o cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú kú áklō inu ɛɛ́. Óndú ā yúklɔ́ nyā á, Ó kē wɛ ɔdā ō hídáago nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō má?.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujékɔ̄pu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Áyísīki, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ébrahām, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Utéra, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unáhɔ.

eng_Latn: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alelékwū ā lɛ ɔ́ kwú nɛɛ, ó gē lɛ ɔ́ fíyaajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ okónu kú nū gē cūūwū. Ó gē hīla ayīnu, cɛ́ɛ́ iyē kú nū gē ŋmó cikɔ́ɔ́. N da ayíkpó kú uwɔ kéē lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā nū tɛ́ɛcɛ, amáŋ é nū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nwū ācɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō klla kē yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā, aótrɛyí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aútíca kú íne mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā le pɛ́ wā.

eng_Latn: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ hɛ́tá ŋmá ikwū mɛ́mla ɔlékwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nyatá ŋmá ísu nōo ī kpó ācɛ nēe gekwú nyɔ̄ ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ cɛ̄ kwú abɔ̄ ú tá ɔkpá kú íne ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
idu_Latn: Unaómi mɛ́mla anyā ayí nū ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Ujúda tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú uwā nēe gē kpó ɛdɔ ɛfú dóódu tá aólɛlā kú uwā glá ā wɛ, úlā bá ɛga ulā, ce úlā ofu igwáahātá ce ahātá ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
idu_Latn: É géē je ɔfú lɛ ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā kéē yúklɔ́ o hídáagó nēe bá nyā, o ŋmá lɛ iye kú um é géē nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá ipú iyē kú ācɛ, é géē kɛlā okónu ucē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
idu_Latn: Ísɔ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ igbɔɔ́mpa nōó pīya um tū yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ó yéyījii ŋ́, iyē kú nū lé ka Ujékɔ̄pu ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó mīyɛ um ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ, anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā, ó klla mīyɛ ɔhā kú um yɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ádā nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Á lɛ ɔhā dúúmā nɛ̄ a gē hɛ́ ce um gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē lɛ ije, ɔwɛ nōó le kpaakpa ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ nōo ge hɛ́ ayí, nōo wɛ anú tá ŋ́ má. Eko nōó gáā jɔ́nyɛ kú oyēeyī kú nū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ agbénú ā mɛ. Igbīhāajɛ ā, ācɛ í má ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ olíla nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē je uwɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō ā ɛgiyí Uféro. Árɔ̄ni ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ géē wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N cɛ̄, nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, ń gaá je ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā yíífi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ olɔdu éyi lɛ eliká kú ugóolu wu abɔ̄ klla lɛ úwé olɔhi wiiye le bēhé wā ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú aá, nɛ̄ ogbɛha o lɛ áhingílí wiiyē éyi kē le bēé wā ipú inu ā dúú.

eng_Latn: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
idu_Latn: Ɛplá ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, é bī ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí lā ipú uwā ā wā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aálelékwū ā nū ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú ɛlā kú nū. Ó kē lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe gē doōcē ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
idu_Latn: Aóklóbīya um bá ī yɛhɛ tū um klla bá ī yá um okónu, nááná nɛ̄ n gē yá ucē kpaakpa, í klla yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ gbɔbū ɛ́ ka ɔdā nyā kóō yá ā, ó lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī tū m ohi eko nɛ̄ um lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā nɛ̄ n géē yá odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē hɛ́ apī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛka kú um ka lɛ ā, amáŋ nɛ̄ ucē kú uwā í kwu ɛka ā ŋ́ mā italā. Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé hɛ́ apī ŋ́ mā tū um.

eng_Latn: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī kú ondū a gē wā. Ɛ̄cī obɔ̄bí kú íwúɔtū nɛ̄hi kú Óndú āɔ́ɔmā. Ó gēe je ɛcɛ pīya ígbíli, klla í jē odúúdú ācɛ ooyá oyábīya mla ācɛ obíɔbíipú a kpó yá ífi.

eng_Latn: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā otūufi nɛ̄hi ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō gwō tá ipú abɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́, agege nōo gē yɔ̄ í cɛ̄ piyóó iyɔ̄bū ede kú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, odúúdú uwá wɛ oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhāsi kwú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla ákú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā ú kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá yá ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó le ācɛ ōhī kú uwá ŋmó nɛɛ, ācɛ o hile kú uwā gē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí nū. É gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu aóklóbīya kú Ujóbu ɛtá ā dúú, ohígbū ka abɔ̄ é máfu lɛ Ujóbu ka anú ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā glá ŋ́ mā, é lɛ ɔ́ yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā.

eng_Latn: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ái nēé ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā a, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ ā wɛ úlā ofu ce igwó.

eng_Latn: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
idu_Latn: Aá géē mā uwā tá kéē wɛ úgwū kú ayí aá, nēé géē cɛ̄ aá ɛhɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē yēeyī gaá kwu lɛ ā. Amáŋ, aá gáā lɔnɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpá aá klla yá uwā ōwē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kahíniī, N géē yá uwɔ ōwē nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ a yipú, a klla í jɔ́ɔnɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ a í mɔyí. Nááná a ɔbá uwɔ géē he uwɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi, ó kē í wɛ ɔkpani uwɔ.

eng_Latn: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ lɛ ā, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í le kpaakpa tū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔcɛ́ Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, kwú odúúdú agbénú kú Uháman olɛlā kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā ú kpó lɛ Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā ā. Ɛ́sta klla le da ɔcɛ́ ā ka Umɔ́dɛkāyi ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔmáapu ádā anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā, é lɛ ɛga je lɛ Umɔ́dɛkāyi kɔ́ɔ̄ wā iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ oōtēelihɔ ā lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ dúú. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ kwú iyī nū iyē ú tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn kwú Usedekíya, ɔyí kú Ujosíya ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwɛyí Ujɛhóyācin, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyākim.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
idu_Latn: N klla í yá ka aólɛlā kú ācɛ igelī nyā kéē kwú odúúdú agbénú kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔdā ōtiile dúú nēé lɛ ŋmá úklɔ́ kú uwā kwu ákú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda dúú ā kpó abɔ̄fú ga ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gā ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ɔ́fra, gāá cīce ɔkwu ɔcí óokú, nōo wɛ ákú Ujówāsi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Abíyɛ̄sa ā. Ɔyí nū, Ugídīyɔn yɔ̄ gē wú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kú Umídiya kéē má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ ɔkpacaŋgelī kú um í kwúcē gaá wu apɛ́ kú nū cíí glá, nɛ̄ n kē lɛ úklɔ́ je lɛ ɔ́ kóō yá āa? Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n mabɔ̄ ɛfú nyā tá glá āa? N kē le ɔ́da je kéē kpɛ́fú tú ācɛ nēe bá Ásskɛ̄lɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.
idu_Latn: Uríbla abɔ́ɔ ā, ipééyī Usedekíya, ó kwú ayí kú Usedekíya í kpó ŋmó. Ó klla le odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umíriyam gwíijē lɛ uwá ka, Gwííjē lɛ Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó le yálé ɔgbɛ́fú nɛ̄hi. Ó le ɔnya mɛ́mla ācɛ o cɔnya ā kpó tá tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin mla ɔ́ŋgbá kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ bīílí kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé géē bī le je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā kwu ajɛ ā. Úklɔ́ ɔhá dóódu nōo lɛ iyē kwu āyā nyā ā, uwá gáā yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, N lɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄ n gē lé, nɛ̄ aá jé ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwá da ɔ́ ka, Óndú, anúɔ mɛ́mla ɔnyā ɔ́mpa anúɔ nyā lā ipú inu ékpónú á. Ó ka anúɔ le ɔyí ma eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ inu mɛ́mla anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛcɛ fīyégbúlú klla jīliyē. Aúpíla kú ɔkpáncō jīliyē yɔɔ́yɔɔ́ ga iyɔ̄bū ga igbīhi ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé wā í lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka lɛ Usɔ́lu ā, ó le ígwu kú ācɛ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄. É klla gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu klla le ígwu ɔmɛɛtá tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄, é klla gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka. Ámɔ̄si, Ɔdí nāa yɔ̄ ī má ā? Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Ómblí kú īkpɔ̄cí nōo le pīya. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka, Īkpɔ̄cí ā kwɛyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu, eko nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā italā le yá ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄cí gē pīya kú ācɛ kéē lé ā. Ń kē gáā pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu italā ō yá uwā gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le pó ka ɔ́ɔ gē doōcē ā, ó yɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ ó klá ā kpó, jāā ɛ̄cī ɛpa.

eng_Latn: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ̄cogbāajɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá hayi ɛyí inɔɔ̄da kú okónu igá kú igelī ā, kóō ka ɔdā nōó má ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú nū ā géē wɛ ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó mɛ́mla ɔgbanjɛ̄ nē ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó. Ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nū géē wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Ujówābu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ka ɛ́ɛ gaá lɛ Ábna bī wā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ŋmá ɛgiyí obugā kú Usíra á. Amáŋ Udéfīdi í jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ í yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn kwú eyī ú pīya kwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō hɔ́hā ce uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē kɔkɔ kú iyī um eko nɛ̄ ācɛ í ŋmó um okónu á.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n tíne kóō yɔ̄ ī yēeyī gbéeko nɛ̄ n géē wā bɛ́ɛ́gɛ, ɔdí wɛ ɛlā uwɔ gɛ? Awɔ ā, yɛce um.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
idu_Latn: Ó le ohi tá ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujɔ́ni ā kahíníī, Kwúcē nyɔ̄ í da Ujɔ́ni ɔdā nɛ̄ aá má mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá pó ā. Ācɛ opeyī gē mɛ́ɛbɛ, ācɛ ocikpó gē yāwu, é lɛ aólagwú ā hɛ́tá, aódahɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō páhɔ̄, é lɛ ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, é klla ke lɛ ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi tá lɛ ācogbɛhá.

eng_Latn: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
idu_Latn: N géē nyā aá tá ŋmá ipú ɔdā dóódu nōo gē je aá iyē tēelihɔ ā. N géē je ɔ́da kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá kóō yá nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā í klla gáā ŋmó ipú ajɛ kú aá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
idu_Latn: Á gáā pīyɛ íjéeyī ŋmá ɛga nōo lipú fíyɛ́ dúú kú itekwú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú eko kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujówāsi mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī ā, ó yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū eko dóódu, ohígbū ka Ujɛhóyāda ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā yɔ̄ gē nwū ɔ̄, ɔdā nɛ̄ ó géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá má mbá ā, eko géē wā nēé gáā mabɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ékpónú tá cɛyí ɔhá nēé gáā ca ɔ́ tāajɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ɛga dóódu ā gbɔɔ́ ō táafu mɛ́mla iyī uwā bá gē ka ka Ágábáidu Udéfīdi, ɔ́ɔ hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú aá á. É da ɔ́mpa uwā ka ɔ́ɔ le aá hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya. amáŋ ɔ́ɔ kē le kwu ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ohígbū Ábsālɔm.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lɛ ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā tū kóō wɛ ojumɛlá kú ɛka kú uwā mla um.

eng_Latn: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
idu_Latn: Omiya aínu kú ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú nū ā mɛ́mla inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́dɔ kú eyīpú kú nū ā wɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla aókómpinu ɔhá ā. Uwíndo yɛ̄ jīla aínu kú nū ā tá, klla mɛ́mla inu nōo kwu okómpinu ā dúú. Īkpō kú nū wɛ umíta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā, ó má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō cāā eko nɛ̄ obócádēde je ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, aá gbɛlá ka n géē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú bɛ̄ɛka ná italā nōo fíyɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ ŋmó ipú eko nōó yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ɔlɛ́ nū. N géē gwō aá ɔ́ci kú ikwū kú nū, klla í jé aá yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Ímnah Íssifi mɛ́mla Ubɛríya.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ owú tígbígbili cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá kú oblú flá tū éyééye kú nū playi okónōgwu kú úwé kú uwā. É géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɛ̄nyā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
idu_Latn: Ipú ihɔtū kú uwɔ nōo ī mɛ ŋ́ mā, a bī ɔfú kú uwɔ lɛ ācɛ kú uwɔ nāa hɛ́tá ā bī jé ɔwɛ ga ɛga nōo wɛ ákú uwɔ nāa lā ā.

eng_Latn: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um, n hī uwɔ igwú ɔlɛɛnɔ, á kē tá um ohi ŋ́, n klla hī uwɔ igwú otú, amáŋ ń kē lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá oklóbīya nū ɛbɛ́, gē jē ukpa lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ūwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ kú ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā kóō kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɛya nēé gwó lɛ ɔ́ ā. É da ɔ́ kóō kwú odúúdú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi, kóō klla lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē cɛ̄tra anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cokónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, Óndú um, pīyeyī má um, ká ā tá um abɔ̄. Lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē, ámāŋ n gáā kwú ga ɔlékwū ɛɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpīije ā, bī ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpīije ɔhá wā anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú, a je ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpīiije gā um, n lɛ ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá lɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yá lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le ícɛ̄bɛ́ ohile mɛ́mla ɔkpá kú ɛbɛ́ ā kpó yɔlá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ámōōmɛ, kú um ā bá yɔ̄ á, ayínɛ́ um, aá gbɛlá kwu aɔ́dā nēe yɔ̄ gē yá nēe lɔhi ofūnū, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá cíkā ō cɛ̄tra uwá, aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dúú í lɛ iyē kwu ɔ́ ŋ́, aɔ́dā nēe géē yá kú eyī kú ācɛ kóō hɔ́ɔkɔ nū, aɔ́dā o le kpaakpa eyī Ɔwɔicō, aɔ́dā nōó lɛ ɛnyá dúú ŋ́, aɔ́dā nēe he ācɛ ɔtū, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɛlá olɔhi lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
idu_Latn: Lɛ oyēeyī je ga m, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ cɛ̄tra uwɔ, yá ka íne kú uwɔ kóō tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ācɛ nēe bá mla anú ā ka anúɔ géē ma ucē kú oklóbīya ɔcɛ́ fú lɛ Uhánɔn ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā nū Unáhāsi mafú lɛ anúɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ í ce ɔ́ abīyē kú ikwu kú ádā nū á. Eko nēé gāajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́gwā, klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ugbɛ kú ogwiji ā, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka aá géē kwu, nēe gáā ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí je aá tá ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī ka ka, alelékwū obɔ̄bí kóō le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā!.

eng_Latn: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
idu_Latn: É le ukɔ́tin ō klá okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā yá mla īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé wu tɔ̄há mla owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā, mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá. É klla le ijā kú ifotó kú Ucérūbim he tū ɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king's matter.
idu_Latn: N tá uwɔ ahínyá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ádáádā um gbā ɛ̄gbā ā. Ohígbū ka a kwú íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔfú ú gā um. A kē le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gbā gā uwɔ ā pó. Anɔ́ɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē da ɔcɛ́ ā, a le ka lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aólɛlā kú alɔ bá ī cá alɔ ɛcá, klla bá ī yá alɔ okónu.

eng_Latn: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, ka ucē kú alɔ lɛyíkwu aá nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā le yēŋēē, le kpaakpa, í klla lɛ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ dúú í bī le ŋmó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
idu_Latn: Cɛ̄tra Óndú ā! Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔtū kú uwā yéékpó kéē kpɛ́fú. Ācɛ ā fu iyī uwā ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā mɛ́mla éeyē, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé nyɔ̄ ga ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē tokónu lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í tókónu lɛ uwá ŋ́ māa? Ámāŋ ka obɔ̄bí kú uwā, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā í ka lɛ ā ŋ́ māa?.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da Ujɛhóssāfāti ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla um í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Urámɔtu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó ta Áhābu ohi kahíníī, Eko dúú nɛ̄ a le tútū ká ā nyɔ̄, n géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla awɔ. Aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya kú um géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla awɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi klla da uwá kéē lɛ īkpɔ̄dā ōhī pi báajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ipú ɛ̄wɛ̄ īkpɔ̄dā ā. Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká ɔ̄ junwalu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛplá oje igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ gbɔbū lɛ ɛ̄cī kú ōtútū kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ Ujíyu kahíníī, Aá má ɔcɛ́ kú aá.

eng_Latn: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le pó ipú ígbíli ā ka, Unábal ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í wā aálá kú nū ɔnwū.

eng_Latn: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, n jé kpɔ́cíí ka Ɔwɔicō nōo gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ olɔhi nyā ipú aá géē yɔ̄ gē yúklɔ́ ā gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū, jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́yí ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si í pīyɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
idu_Latn: Ami gbɔbū lɛ ɛfu á, n yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kpó aɛ́fu kwú ɛgiyí uwā á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā Uféro mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā le kpó héyī. É bá gē jikwū nɛ̄hi ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ohígbū ka ɔlɛ́ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ okwū kú ɔyí aflɛ́yí í tá anú ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā klla da um kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, n géē je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwā nēé kpɔ́tūce, nōo he uwá ɔtū ō má nɛ̄hi klla he uwá ɔtū ō nyɔ̄ ipú nū ɔ́ɔmā yíífi ŋmá ipú uwā. N klla géē kpó ayí uwā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
idu_Latn: N bī okónu kú um yɔ̄ ī jé odúúdú íne nāa je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ éyééye gbōmgbōm.

eng_Latn: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō gwéeyē nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ísu ā má yɔ̄ cíí. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, okónu ɔkpá ɛga nēé tíne ō wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā gē kɛlā olɔhi ŋmá okónu wɛ̄ɛcɛ, amáŋ é cíkā ō lɛ ígblɛ́nyī kú ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kpó hɛ́ ŋmá uwá okónu.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukúss wɛ Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Uhafíla mɛ́mla Usábta mɛ́mla Urááma mɛ́mla Usabtɛ́ka. Ayí kú Urááma wɛ Ussɛ́ba mɛ́mla Udɛ́dan.

eng_Latn: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
idu_Latn: Ó klla mīyɛ odúúdú aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwā. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā lɛ uwá pīya tá ɔbū, anɔ́ɔ é ka aɔ́dāajɛ ā wɛ ákú Udéfīdi mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi cɛ̄ kóō yɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujétro kwú adá kú nū, Usipɔ́ra ú lɛ Umósīsi kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá eko kú ayípōklóbīya kú alɔ ā, aólɛlā kú alɔ ā, yá alɔ ōwē nɛ̄hi, amáŋ é kē kpó alɔ yíifi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ádáádā alɔ bīya íne á, é kē bá amā abālɔbányā gɛ ŋ́. Nááná alɔ kē bá ī móowe kú íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo tīile nɛ̄hi ā kóō lā dúúdú ipú aá, kóō yá kú aá le gbagbénú ipú íjééyī dóódu. Aá nwū iyī aá ɛlā kú aá kē tū iyī aá ukɔ́ mla odúúdú íjéeyī. Aá gwííjē ɛ̄gbā, aá gwííjē ocɛ̄tra, mla ijē kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō. Aá gwííjē lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá tá ɔ́ ahínyá ipɔ́tū kú aá.

eng_Latn: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɛyí í kpó plá ohígbū uwɔ, kwú īlī ekwu ú kpó wiiyē, bá ī yá ɔtūnōbí, bá ī jikwū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ɛgiyí nū ŋ́, ɔdā dúúmā nōo wā ɔtū kú nū nōo kē he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, nōó gē yá á, kwu ipú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ce ɔ anú glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá yɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā jila, ohígbū ka n géē je ɔ́ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tá ō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄, nāa bī uwā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gekwú ohígbū aóklóbīya nū, ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka ó lɛ ihɔtū ɔhá dúú nɛ̄ ó mafú fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le tá ɛgiyí Uféro, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Uhíbru ā kahíníī, Eko nyá nāa géē tá ka anúɔ í gáā tú iyī uwɔ wā ajɛ gā um ŋ́ gaá kwu ā? Mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá kéē nyɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gaá gbā um ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Ahasíya kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā gē yá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ ágbe nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā í wɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā. É bá ī ka ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ le lɔhi ɛɛ́, nááná nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í lɔhi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔ̄bū kpɔ́ ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē má kéē bī aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā lɛ yúklɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yēeyī kéē ma nyīla īkpō ācɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu nū lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ā, é hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka, Utabéra, ohígbū ka ɔlá kú Óndú ā yi ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā, Óndú ā géē tɔ́jī í hī aícɔ́ɔja igwú kéē pɛ́ wā wūū ŋmá Íjīpiti bɛ̄ɛka ijū nēe pɛ́ wūū ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā. Ó klla hī ācɛ Asírīya igwú kéē pɛ́ wā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gē nwū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó géē bī le tá ádā ámāŋ ɛ́nɛ́ nū abɔ̄, amáŋ anɔ́ɔ ó klla ka, anúɔ lɛ okónu ce ka anúɔ géē je ɛ̄nyā lɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú gáā tū ígbíli, ipú ajɛ oŋmókókó mla ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
idu_Latn: N lɛ Utakíkɔ̄si tɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ ga Ɛ́fēsɔsi.

eng_Latn: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ́da je, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā le jīla, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwá í kpó tū úklɔ́ ō yá. Ācɛ ōhī kú uwá gē gbā ɛcɔ̄ kóō bī le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ké ē lɛ ka lɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ háyi ikpɛ́fu nɛ̄ ódūdū nɛ̄hi kú ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī tá ɔlá blublu ŋmá icō nū ga icīīcō ga ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
idu_Latn: Aá hɛ́ ācodoōcē kú igelī ā tá ŋmá ōcē kú uwá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá da ācɛ abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō wā í kwu uwá ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
idu_Latn: Ogbɛnú kú ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyééye ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, ogbɛnú kú odúúdú ɔgbanjɛ̄ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛɛtá ce igwó. Ogbɛnú kú odúúdú aócíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu úlā ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nēé gáā yá ācɛ Umówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔn italā ā ohígbū ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ mɛ́mla oōgɔ̄ kú uwā ā yɔ̄ á. Mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gwō klla ī cá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ami Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛcá.

eng_Latn: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda ā géē mīyɛ Ɛ́dɔm tābɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ é gaá lā abɔ́ɔ. Ācɛ nēe lā ikpó ɛfu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā, géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú Ufilístiya ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē lā ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Usamérīya. Ācɛ kú Ubéjamīn ā géē lā ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jikwū abɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī nyi īkpɔ̄dā ā, géē gwéeyē í tɔ́ɔga abɔ̄ ó géē yɔ̄ ī wā ɔlɛ́ mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōó í cē ā.

eng_Latn: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi ā wɛ Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Udɛ́yūwɛlu.

eng_Latn: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
