idu_Latn: Amáŋ n má ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ipú ɛcɛ ā glá ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bɔkwu nū kóō jɛ́ɛyí nū lɛ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cojéeyī dúúmā ka anúɔ jé ɔ̄ nááná, ó gáā jɛ́ɛyí nū gbóógbóō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, Uhérɔ̄du mɛ́mla Upɔ́ntíyɔ̄si Upáyílēti le jīla igelī nyā tɔ̄há mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nōo tīihɔ ā, nāa je pīya Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Usólōmɔn ka.

eng_Latn: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
idu_Latn: ācɛ nēe bā í ma ɔdɔ ā igbīhi. Ācɛ nēe bā í kpó iyó úklɔ́ lɛ ācɛ ō ma ɔdɔ ā bī abɔ̄ éyi gē le kpó iyó, é kē bī abɔ̄ ɔhá le bī iyɔ́fú.

eng_Latn: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, a lɛ okónu cɛ̄ ucē ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ a yá ā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, klla lɛ okónu ce ka anúɔ í klla gáā yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Ujɔ́ni kwú, kéē lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó gbō, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄ í tá agbá. Uhérɔ̄du yá ɛnyā ohígbū Uheródīyasi, ɔnyā ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ufílīpu nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígbómína, aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā bá í tá ācɛ Ujíyu abɔ̄, ohígbū ka é bā í yúufi kú Umɔ́dɛkāyi.

eng_Latn: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē lɔfú yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o he Óndú ā ɔtū ā, kú aá yá ɔdā nōo í yá kú ɔtū kóō he Óndú ā. Aá gé­ē yá ɔdā olɔhi ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē jé Ɔwɔicō tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
idu_Latn: Umátiyu mɛ́mla Utɔ́mɔ̄si, Ujémīsi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Álfīyɔsi, mɛ́mla Usáyímɔ̄n nōó hī ka ɔ̄cɛ ojímélí ā.

eng_Latn: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ádā nū ā. Ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá pīyabɔ̄, úwé kú aá ō híla kóō mafú ɔtūnōbí ō yá kú aá ōfōōfūnū í jɛ ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔtū tú wāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwúcē wā ɛgiyí ami nɛ̄ wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá. N gbonɛnɛ klla gē ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ. Ń klla gē cɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́, n klla gē yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄cɛ gbojī ajɛ. N klla kē le tútū eko dóódu kú n̄ je ɔ́bíipu nɛ̄ ācɛ bī ā, yá uwā ɛhi. Ó wɛ ka o yá uwā italā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ébram lā ajɛ kú Ukénan iháyí igwó ā, Usárāyi ɔnyā kú Ébram kwú Uhága, ofiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú nū nōo ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ú lɛ Ébram, ɔbá nū, kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ Ugéssɔ ā, anúɔ le okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē wā í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́brɔn, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ kwú anúɔ ú kwúcē wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubébāyi wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwóléyi ce ɛpa .

eng_Latn: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī wā í le cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla anú kē cɛ̄ ɛlā nōó ka ā. Udiyonisíyɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi nēé hī ka Udamárīsi, mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá mla uwá ā wɛ ipú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá alɔ ɛbɛ́ ipéēyī kú aɔ́mpānū mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú Usamérīya ā gē kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aɛ́flɛ́ɛfu, ācɛ Ujíyu nyā gbɛlá ka aá gē yá glá ā? É gbɛlá ka aá géē gwó igelī ā glá nɛɛ? É gbɛlá ka, o ŋmá lɛ ɛya ō gwó, aá géē je úklɔ́ ā yá kwɛyí ɛ̄cī ékpónú nɛɛ? É gē gbā ɛcɔ̄ ō bī gwó ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ipú ɛyítutulu kú inu nōo le yɔlá glá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
idu_Latn: Aá géē wɛ ācɛ otīihɔ, kú aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ofōōfū um, ohígbū ka ami Óndú ā tīihɔ, n klla lɛ aá fō ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ācɛ ohile tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká āā wɛ kú um ofōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: N géē lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū eko dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Itiyópiya, aá wɛ ipú uwā dúú. É géē bī ɔkpacańgelī le ŋmó aá.

eng_Latn: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ɔtū í gē jɛ̄ gicō ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ okónu kú nū lɛ mu mla ɛcá mɛ́mla ɛlā obɔ̄bí, gē ga ipú unwalu nɛɛ n.

eng_Latn: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
idu_Latn: Ɛháajɛ kú ede, ŋmá icō kú nū kwu ɔkwu nū ā wɛ umíta éyi. Āyā nōo gboce ɛháajɛ ā tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ā le hɛ́ ga igbīhi ŋmá ogwu kú nū biílí usɛntímīta ofɛpa cigwó. Olicō kú nū kē wɛ umíta ɛpa. Āyā ɔhá nōo gboce āyā ɔ́ɔmā icō ā le hɛ́ ga igbīhi ŋmá ogwu kú nū ā wɛ usentímīta ofɛpa cigwó dúú.

eng_Latn: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
idu_Latn: É le Uhámɔ mɛ́mla ɔyí nū, Ussɛ́kɛm ā kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Udáyína, ɔyínɛ́ uwā ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ Ussɛ́kɛm, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn géē dīíbá tá ɛcɛ ka é kwú Áyi í yíífi ɛɛ́! Anyā kú Urába, aá kwú īlī ekwu í wiiyē kú aá yēkwu. Aá kwinya gicō gajɛ kú aá jikwū. Ohígbū ka é kwú ɛcí nɛ̄ aá ī pā, nēe lé ka Umílkom ā ú abɔ̄fú ga ajɛ éwɔhá ɛɛ́. Kwu anú mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā le kwú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya iyē nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kú aá yɔ̄ amānyā nōo gē yɛce ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
idu_Latn: Uféro le Ébram hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá um yɔ̄ ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á da um ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔnyā anúɔ ŋ́ mā ā?.

eng_Latn: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Udánīyɛlu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɛpa ɔhá fu kéē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú aígbómína ā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla má ka, ācɛ ā ɔ́ɔ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ ka ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
idu_Latn: N géē bī aéwo nēe bɔ̄bíipú fíyɛ́ dúú ā wā í mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ aá tābɔ. Ācɛ olɔfú kú aá fíyɛ́ dúú, nɛ̄ aá ī bī uwā gwō ā, í gáā lɔfū eko ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́. N kē ī kpó aéwo ɔhá wā í je aɛ́ga ogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú aá nyílá.

eng_Latn: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔkpáncō kpó fáa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē kpó ukɔ́tin ŋmá ɔwɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gāajɛ, ɔwɔ kē le tū klá ɔ̄ ikpó kpímm.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu, nɛ̄ n kwú ojuja ú klá ɛcɛ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ le hɔ́gwā.

eng_Latn: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
idu_Latn: Ulúkú ōfōōfūnū yɔ̄ mla um mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Dɔɔ̄kā Umáki kú awɔ mɛ́mla anú ká aá tīkpó wā, ohígbū ka ó géē tū um abɔ̄ ipú úklɔ́ kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó uwɔ, klla í je uwɔ nyi ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ aísu nāa lā ā.

eng_Latn: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka ipú ɔdā dóódu Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō gē yúklɔ́ ohígbū olɔhi kú ācɛ nōó he uwá ɔtū ā, ācɛ nōó hīgwú o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔdā nōo bī ɔtū ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
idu_Latn: Aá híīī cɛ̄ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmá lɛ o ka aá géē tū iyī aá wāajɛ píīī, klla gē gbā aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ī lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɛbɛ nōó má, nōo yá kú odo kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le nū pītīī mla ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ nááná nōó ī ka ka anúɔ tú ɛyí wāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ kú Uhíbru jīla mla alɔ, le iyī nū mafú lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Mā alɔ tá kú ālɔ̄ ga iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī ɛtá, ipú ígbíli kú ālɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛya gwo lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ó gē bī ōcē obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɛfú lɛ kpó alɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ikpó ámāŋ abɔ̄ kú nū le ŋmó tíiyē.

eng_Latn: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka ɔdā nōó má ā tɛ́ɛcɛ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ācɛ kú aéwɔhá nēe bá ogbeé ɔhá kú ísu nɛ̄hi ā. Aá nēe lā ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi ā. Ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́nɛ́ um kóō ma um ā, Óndú ā le um fu kú n̄ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū. Ó kwú iyē ú ce um kwaá.

eng_Latn: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ odúúdú ācojééyī kú Ubábīlɔn kpó wā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ ɛyí ɔ̄na nyā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ géē bá ī lɛ abɔ̄ mu ajɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ bɛ̄ɛka aópeyī ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā jé ɔwɛ kú uwā glá ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá ā ŋ́. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá ī pīya uwá tū klla ī wī uwā uwī, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā yɔ̄ nōo géē tú uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, Óndú ā ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō kpɛ́lāce ācɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ka ífulá tū uwā ŋ́. Ó ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ikpɛ́lā mla uwá á.

eng_Latn: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Igbo alɛwa, ó le uwá hɛ́tá. Amáŋ īkpɛ́yí olɔfú he uwá ɔtū ō yá tá Óndú á, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá je kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.
idu_Latn: Ákisi lɛ Udéfīdi hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N lɔfú gwá ɛka ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo yēeyī ā ka, a húmáyī lɛyítáajɛ gā um. Ó géē he um ɔtū ka aá le tá ɔgbɛ́fú ā gāá lɛ ɛfú nyā kpó. Ń má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí uwɔ, ŋmífī nāa wā í lā mla um ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ aɔ́cɛ́ ɔhá ā í cɛ̄ kú ā nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú ā mla alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N le má ka ádā aá í gbonɛnɛ gā um bɛ̄ɛka otɛtɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō kú ádā um ā yɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn lɛ ɔ̄kā pó lɛyíkwu aícɔ́ɔja nyā, abɔ̄ kē hɛ́ ɔ́ iyē. Iyē kē le gbɔlá yōō lɛ ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnya nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umetúsēla, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɛ́nɔ̄ki, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujárɛ̄di, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umahalalíili, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ukayínan.

eng_Latn: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Utímōti gā ɛgiyí aá, aá mīyɛ ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi ká aá lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́, ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n gē yúklɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā nōó gē yá dúú á.

eng_Latn: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ugbé kú nū lɛ āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú álūka kú aínyílɔ́wɔ pi wāajɛ ŋmá icō, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá tá wāajɛ wā ipú ɛcɛ á. Ó háyi iyɔ̄bū ɔnyā ā cɛ́ɛ́ eko dúú nōó lɛ ɔyí ma bōōbū kóō kwú ɔyí ɔnyā ā ú kwú lé.

eng_Latn: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
idu_Latn: É bá í ka iŋini tá um kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í nwū āa? Ɔnyɛ cɛgbá olɛhɔ̄ kú nū, nōó yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ā? Olɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā lɔhi lɛ ayí obene nēe hɛ́ amɛ̄ bōōbū.

eng_Latn: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gbɛlá kú ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ bá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā, gē pi ɛ̄cī wā ajaajɛ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le kwáhi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, klla ī yúújulu nɛ̄ ó glá ɛyí inu kú nū yá glá ŋ́. Inu ɔlɛ́ nū géē nu klá anú, cɛ́ɛ́ inu ā kwú wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ŋ́, nēé gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ ayí uwā ɔnyā.

eng_Latn: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā gē dɔɔ̄ka ɛdɔ ɔcomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe lɛ mu mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛ́plá, nēe klla ī ka, N mɛ́ɛbɛ ka ejé mɛ́mla ejé olɔfú géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī hɔ́há ce Obɛ́dɛdɔ̄m mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā, ohígbū Īkpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā nōo tá ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi gaá kwú Ikpáti kú Óndú ā ú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ kú Obɛ́dɛdɔ̄m wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā á. Odúúdú ācɛ ā bá ī gwéeyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
idu_Latn: Usára nōo wɛ ɔnyā kú ɔkpani um, Ébrahām ā, mɔyí éyi lɛ ɔ́, eko nōó le hīla ā. ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā nōó kpó ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
idu_Latn: Awanda lɔnyɛ nɛ̄hi. Ó ī he alɔ ɔtū ō je mulɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
idu_Latn: Uhásɔ, Uráma, Ugítayím.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa le tá ɛgiyí uwā anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Amānyā í wɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ aá gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ɛ̄nyā í wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Aá yɛce um ká n̄ lɛ aá bī ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá gē dɔɔ̄kā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa lɛ uwá kpó ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya á.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú, Utóla mɛ́mla Upúwah.

eng_Latn: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔhá Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Olagbénú éyi yɔ̄, nōo lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi nōo gē leyīkwu agbénú kú nū lɛ ɔ́. É lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā kpɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ī ŋmó ije kú ɔkpani nū bónū.

eng_Latn: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka lɛ uwá kwɛyí ā, ó má klá Ugálīli.

eng_Latn: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yíhɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ó gē gbō ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú nū ā. Alɔ gē túkpɛɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū nū klla ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gē yúufi nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gáā wā í yá ɔ̄ á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā gē lɛ ɔdā nōo kwu ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ā, amáŋ ɔdā nēe tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ufi fíyɛ́ ā nēé gáā lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ tū aótrɛ̄yí ā ukɔ́ kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ īkpɛ́lā, nōo géē bɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ā. Ó ka anúɔ klla da uwá kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ dóódu kpaakpa. Ó kōō wɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ɔyínɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla aúgbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛlā nyā pó ɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu. Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le mafú ka anúɔ fu á o ŋmá úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā idáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá bū abɔ̄ nū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá abɔ̄yí aá jé ā.

eng_Latn: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā kóō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā dóódu kagwó mla iyī nū. Ɔwɔicō yá ɛbɔ́ nyā ŋmá ikwū kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá ɛcɛ ámāŋ ɔkpáncō ā kagwó mla iyīnū á.

eng_Latn: This is the first and great commandment.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú mɛ́mla ákú aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
idu_Latn: Ánābu, Ɛssitémōwa, Ánim.

eng_Latn: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā le mu mla éeyē mɛ́mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá abɔ̄yī aá, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá ka ka n wɛ āa.

eng_Latn: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kóō wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ obɔ̄bíipú, anɔ́ɔ ó ka ipɔ́tū kú nū kahíníī, Óndú um le eko kpó bónū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ɔyí nū, Ujɛramíilu, mɛ́mla Usɛráya, ɔyí kú Asrīyɛlu mɛ́mla Ussɛlɛmíya, ɔyí kú Abudíílu ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ Ujeremíya, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ubárūku, ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú nū ā kwú. Amáŋ Óndú ā kwú uwā í tayínū.

eng_Latn: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá jila ajɛ, nēe pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla ohi ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú iyāwu kú uwā ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ka iŋini tá Óndá ā á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó ŋmó ipú ígbíli á.

eng_Latn: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú nū, ŋmá Utápūwa ga ɔkpá kú Ukána klla gaá ŋmɛ́yí ísu kú Umeditarénīya. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ajɛ nēé je lɛ aípɔ́ɔnū kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Urúbɛ̄n, ayí kú Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā kú ayí kú Umanásɛ le bēhé mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú kú uwā mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ohi tá ɔ̄, klla le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka, Ábna, ó wɛ awɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nā á gbō ɔkpáni uwɔ, ɔcɛ́ lɔhi glá ŋ́ mā ā? Ó gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ éyi le bēhé ga ádɛ́fú ā, gáā je ɔkpani uwɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá aílɔ́wá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́. Aá kē tɛtɛ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ílɔ́wá ō wɛ ajɛ éwɔhá wɛ ā, ohígbū ka aá tɛtɛ wɛ aílɔ́wá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā hɔ́hā ce uwá ɔwɛ dóódu. Amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla éeyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kóō yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ tá lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā hī ɔ̄ igwú ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne nɛ̄ n gē nwū ipú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔci á.

eng_Latn: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utatɛ́nāyi, igbómína ā, mɛ́mla Ussɛtá Ubosɛnáyi mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ ā, lɛ odúúdú ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je lɛ uwá ā yá klla lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́da ā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ aá eyī cāāā ŋmá ipú ɔlá ɛyí ɛfu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ká ɔtū kóō he ācɛ okpaakpa ā, kéē gwéeyē ipéyī Óndú ā. Kéē lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́, kéē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē.

eng_Latn: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ igwó éyi bá ipú ācɛ ā nēe da Íssmɛ̄lu kahíníī, Kóocō ā je alɔ kpó ŋmó ŋ́. Alɔ lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄,mɛ́mla umu, mɛ́mla anɔ̄, mɛ́mla ɛnwú kpó tayínū ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó mābɔ̄ uwá ā tá á.

eng_Latn: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
idu_Latn: É gwííjē elihɔ gā uwɔ ka, Ɔnyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka Utáya nōo tá Símmm ipú ísu nyā āa?.

eng_Latn: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
idu_Latn: É bá ī tū ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā ulé ká ē bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́. É tū ɔɔ́ ulé ká ē je ɔ tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ oŋmó ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛlā nyā, Udéfīdi lɛ ācɛ Ufílīstiya yálé dúúdú nēé lɔfú dóódu ipú ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó klla mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ kú Umetɛgáma ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā ō ga ipú unwalu ŋ́, ayíka ó leyī kwɛcɛ lɛyíkwu ɛlā nōo í ka ā.

eng_Latn: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá wɛ ákú ɛcɛ nɛɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛcɛ ā géē yɛ í yíihɔtū tū aá abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá wɛ ákú nū ā. Amáŋ ami fu aá ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā a á. Aá kē wɛ ákú ɛcɛ ā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ami fu aá ŋmá ɛcɛ á, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛcɛ ā gē wɔ́tū aá má.

eng_Latn: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o táabɔ̄ ipú icɔ́ɔci ā cíkā ō lɛ ɔnyā ékpónú, é kē í bī ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
idu_Latn: É tɛtɛ le igbīhi cē kwu uwɔ, klla wɔ́tū uwɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kōō gē bū ipú uwɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ n géē yá ká ā kwú héyifuú nɛ̄hi. A kē géē wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ éeyē géē yɔ̄ eko dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔcí o kwu ajɛ kú nū ú wu abɔ̄, le ɛcɔ̄ ŋlóŋló ɛhɔ̄ yá ŋmá ɔtū ɔkpá, ó kwú kpó tū ipú ɛkpa kú ɔ̄cogbāálá kú nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwu ítū kú nū ú wu abɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le túbla ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya ā ajaajɛ á.

eng_Latn: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó lɛ abɔ̄ tū Ɔwɔicō ɔtū, klla lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔtū lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ, dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm kahíníī, Óndú, ā je íne nēé bīya nyā ce uwá ɛyí nóó. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, ó mā owu.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka anúɔ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cíkā ó jé ā nwū uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ lɛ ā. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ aíne ā tū eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le tá ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā bēhé nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔdā nōó he um ɔtū ŋ́ lɛyíkwu aá. Aá yíhɔtū abālɔbányā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ yá eko nɛ̄ aá je pīya ācɛ kú um bōōbū ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kú ipú uwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nwūla eyī kú ópeyī ā, í lɔfú yá ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō kwú ŋ́ glá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ami a klla géē da aá ɔ̄kā dúú, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ohī nū cīla um n géē da aá ɛdɔ íkwu nɛ̄ n lɛ nɛ̄ n bī gē yá ɔdā nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó da Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū. N kē í yíhɔtū tú ɔ̄cɛ nōo he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, Usɔ́lu kwú Udéfīdi ú wá í lā mla iyī nū. Ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ apī hɛ́ oo, ká ɔ̄cɛ í hɛ́ apī nóo, ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɔdā dúú iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɔdā nōo cɛgbá ā wɛ ācɛ kéē lɛyítáajɛ le aíne kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā kú nū, nɛ̄ aá kē lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā yá, n géē nuunu tú odúúdú aólɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛ Alelékwū ā ŋ́, í gáā mīyɛ ɛhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ī jɛ́ɛyí uwā fúlufúlu ŋ́, é wɛ ɔdāhá tū ɔ̄. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ Alelékwū ōfōōfūnū jɛ́ɛyí uwā glá á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā. Ó cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ɔkpancō, yɔ̄ ī má klla yɔ̄ ī leyī yɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ayí kú alɛɛcɛ bá ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
idu_Latn: É habɔ̄ aókwū kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá lɛ aépu mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí kéē kpó uwā lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ a jé nɛ̄ alɔ í jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā? Ɛdɔ ohílīpú nyá nɛ̄ a lɛ, nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nwū ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ī kɛpɔ̄ kpaakpa lɛ ā. Ká ā klla lɛ ɛlá ɔkwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ nwū ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó lɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē kú ipú kú nū lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
idu_Latn: É hɛ́ um apī ɛ̄cī ɔ́maahāapa, ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ádā um wɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ádā um ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamin, ádáádā um húmáyī wɛ ācɛ Uhíbru, n yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu ka ka n̄ yá ā abɔ̄ n wɛ ɔwá kú Ufarisīi ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le bēhé tū ipú Ujerúsālɛm, le yɛ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ó yɛ bilíbilí ipú nū lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kpó má. Amáŋ abɔ̄ otú gbɔɔ́ ō bī ā, ó kwúcē wā í tá ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ga Ubɛ́tani á.

eng_Latn: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í ka lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nēe bá ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ lɛ alɔ, ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ géē bɛ́yí kwu alɔ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si jé kéē ī tíne kéē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá bā gē leyī yī ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ka eko kpií aá gáā má um gɛ ŋ́, eko kpií aá kē í má um kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ufilístiya ā le ɛdɔ ɔ́ngbá ɔ́ɔmā bī gé lɛ Udelíla, anɔ́ɔ ó le Usámsin gbō á.

eng_Latn: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́lāyi da Uhána kahíníī, Eko nyá nāa géē wīyējé nyā gāá kwu ā? Mā ejé ōwīyā tá, kú ā gbēyī gɔɔ.

eng_Latn: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwúcē gāá le ɛlā nɛ̄ Unábalu ka ā, ka lɛ Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn le ɛga éyi gwó lɛ Ukɛ́mɔ̄ssi, ɛcí icííci kú ācɛ Umówābu ā, kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gwó lɛ Umólɛ̄ki, ɛcí kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri ā, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ujerúsālɛm ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gáā ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ucɛ kú Onyatá ā ɛga dúúmā kú ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá leyī kwɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē yá lɛ ā a! Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ lɛ íne bīya, le da ɔ́ ka ɔdā nōó yá ā í lɛ ɔhi ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó le pīyabɔ̄ kwú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
idu_Latn: a kē í yɛ í le jé piíí, ohígbū ka a jé ɔdā otayínū dóódu kú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Eko dúúmā nāa gē kɛlā gā um ipú iyē kú Óndú ā, kɛlā ɔkwɛ́yi gā um. Igbɛ ɛmulá nɛ̄ n géē da uwɔ ɛlā nyā á ā.

eng_Latn: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
idu_Latn: Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mla ayí Ulífāyi ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma dóódu nēe má Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn gwó ā. É gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū eko nēé yɔ̄ ī lɛ etikpa kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā táajɛ igbɔhá ā. Amáŋ ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá abɔ̄ ā, bá í gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
idu_Latn: Ulában kɛlā kpɔ́ ka, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ōwē yá ayí um nɔ̄nyā ámāŋ ka a lɛ anyā ɔhá lɛ, nááná nɛ̄ ń má uwɔ glá ŋ́ mā, bla ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī má alɔ.

eng_Latn: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Okónu kú nū lɔnyɛ lingɔtɔɔɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā. Ɔdā dóódu kú nū lɔhi nɛ̄hi, klla ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ohumɔtū, nōo kwu um ajaajɛ ā lɛ ā á, anyā kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubárāki tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anúɔ. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ nōó gáā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anúɔ ŋ́, anúɔ í gaá nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ó le ɔyí nū má gwutá agōdō, alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔɔ́ iyē ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
idu_Latn: Bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ ɛna mla ɔgwú gēe ba í lé úlé tɔ̄há, nɛ ayí uwā kē í gwutá tɔ̄há ɛga ékpónú ɛbɔ́ a. Nɛ ágábá kē ī gbo ɔɔ oolé ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɛna a.

eng_Latn: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kwu ɛhi kú um ú tá gbēyī um ɛɛ́, ɛhi kú oyálé nɛ̄ ó gē je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē lā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā. Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo wɛ ohɛ́pɔ okpaakpa ā géē je ɛhi kú um gā um ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō géē je ɛdɔ kú ɛhi ékpó lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ o hile nēe bá gē gbēyī lɔfú lɔfú kóō kwúcē wā a.

eng_Latn: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́, gaá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm ka ā ka lɛ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi á. Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ábsālɔm á. Ó le tá ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ mīyɛ ɔ́ le ɔ́ kwú bá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā ményinyi ayí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ dúú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔbá ɔnyā akwuna ā í gáā ményinyi ayí kú ɔnyā ā ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū keé wɛ ayí kú ajā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ūwā gbo ā, mɛ́mla ayí kú akwuna ō yá kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: É géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nāa gáā ka lɛ uwá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ awɔ mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Uhíbru ā le jīla mla alɔ ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā ā, alɔ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ, kú ālɔ̄ ga iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī ɛtá, ipú ígbíli, ká alɔ gaá lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɔ́ɔhā ce uwá ā géē lā ipú ajɛ ā. Amáŋ ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tókónu lɛ uwá ā, é géē nū uwā ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD's anger.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe tú iyī aá wāajɛ ipú ajɛ ā, nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā. Aá kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, Aá kóō yá ucē okpaakpa, kú aá klla tá iyī aá wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Ekōhī, ó géē hɛ́ aá tá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ó gáā ma ícɔ̄nū fú ā.

eng_Latn: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ nyā ā wɛ ācɛ ulá ahātá cofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
idu_Latn: Eko kú aɔ́cɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō géē je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔhá kwu ajɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā je ɔ́ yíífi glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ néé géē yɔ̄ ɔ̄ lé glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔhá géē mīyɛ ɔ́ tābɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ó géē je odúúdú aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ohile ɔhá ā kpó yíífi tāajɛ dúúdú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gaá yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
idu_Latn: N géē je awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kpó yíífi bónū dúúdú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unébati ífi dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwɔ yá otrɛ̄yí ká ā gbō odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā, ká ā klla wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ. Awɔ wɛ īkpɛ̄yí kú oje ɔdɔ kú ojibó ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le ɔ́ pīyɛ̄ ā, ó le áncɛ́nyā nū mɛ́mla aóladógbe kú nū kpó hīgwú tɔ̄hā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔtū he um ícɛ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka īkpīije kú um nōo bī ā, n le ɔ́ pīyɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Aá gwéeyē mla um.

eng_Latn: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē yá ɛ̄nyā mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛci aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā a, mɛ́mla ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā. Aá klla géē gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ákú ejé dúú. Ocu kú nū í he Óndú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
idu_Latn: N géē hayi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, ó kē ī nya um tá, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú dóódu, í lɔfú hayi iyɔ̄bū nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gēe ka ka, ɔdā nɛ̄ ami ɔ́ɔ ī yá ā ɔ́ le kpaakpa ŋ́. Amáŋ ó lɛ ā ŋ. Ɔwɛ kú uwā í le kpaakpa ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
idu_Latn: Aá lā ɛbɔ́ mla ɔ́mpa aá. Aá híī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ aá tíyē kwu ācɛ nēe gbɛhá ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō híī gbɛlá ka anúɔ je odúúdú ɔdā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ mla Uháman klla le yɛ gáā lé ucɛ mla Ɛ́sta.

eng_Latn: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
idu_Latn: Ó le inu ihɔ nēé hī ka ɛga otīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā gwó eyīpú. Olīkpō kú abɔ́ɔ wɛ ikpó ahāanɛ. Ó bī ɔcí lɛ eyīpú kú inu ohile ā kɔ̄ hɛ̄ ɔhá tá, ŋmá ajɛ jāā kwu icō.

eng_Latn: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ugídelu mɛ́mla Ugáha mɛ́mla Ureháya.

eng_Latn: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Uhám, ācɛ kú Ákī, ācɛ kú Usíni.

eng_Latn: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó mā aógbɛhá fíyɛ́ dúú ā nēé lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ má tá ipú Ujerúsālɛm kéē ŋmó ácí tū aɛ́hɔ̄ kú ugrépu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ uwá apī hɛ́ kwɛyí ā, odúúdú éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu klá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwá cíí, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ apī kú uwā le kpó jé.

eng_Latn: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū géē lɛ ɔ́ wu īkpō eko dóódu nēé gē ga Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um, ámāŋ ga ɛyí ede gáā yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, Ɛga Otīihɔ kú um ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n híī je uwá kpó ŋmó ohígbū kaé tóohɛ́ɛwa ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne otáajɛ piyóó kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyilɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ācɛ ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā kéē gáā jīla Ɔwɔicō eyī. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá háyi ikpó kú ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
idu_Latn: Kɛ̄ɛ ka aá í je ɛna ocɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔyí aá nōo ba aá ayīgwū?.

eng_Latn: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔtū kú um kpóce uwɔ dúúdú, Óndú, n géē gwíijē kú n̄ cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ɛga nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó, ákú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ejé, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā, ayí aflɛ́yí kú ɛna ámāŋ álá, kwu ɛ̄gbā ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ cokónu nū lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ́ɛ híī lé ɛga nēé lā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé klla pīyeyī má ɔ̄ ā, é cɛ̄tra ɔwɔ kú uwā kahíníī, Ɔwɔ kú alɔ kwú olɛlā kú alɔ ú tá abɔ̄ kú alɔ ɛɛ́. Ó gwō alɔ ɔ́cí, lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ kpó ŋmó kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lɛ odée gbō ɛna nōo gē wú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ uwá okónu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ohígbū ācɛ Ujíyu ā ōfūnū nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si í kwú ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū kóō lɛ ayí kú Ɔwɔicō, nēe le pahīla bá ɛga dóódu ā pīya tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ábna nyi Uhɛ́brɔn á. Udéfīdi nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā jikwū gbōō nɛ̄hi okónu únóji kú Ábna, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kē jikwū lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa cɛ̄ gā um gē má ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā. Ɛga dúú nɛ̄ n pīyeyī nyɔ̄, ífi, ucē obɔ̄bí, ikpɛ́la mɛ́mla unu mɛ́mla áafú le um yɛ jīla tá biílí.

eng_Latn: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
idu_Latn: N géē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē nōo mu um ipú, abɔ̄ n géē gwó ɔdā ō bī gwíijē gā uwɔ ā. N géē bī odúúdú odo kú um lɛ gwíijē gā uwɔ ohígbū ka a le um nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ o nwū ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā í lɔfú ŋ́ ɛlā, itíca kú aógwuda. A lɔtūce ka ohígbū ka a jé íne ā, a le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu jé dúúdú, ɛlā nāa ka ā kē wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi dúúdú mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú ami nɛ̄ wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo bɔ̄bíipú tū um nɛ̄hi ā. N kē í je ɔ́ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú, amáŋ ń gáā kpó ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā yíífi dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce Ébram kahíníī, N hɔ́hā ce awɔ Ébram oŋmá iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
idu_Latn: É tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ébrahām wɛ ádā alɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá wɛ ayí kú Ébrahām ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛɛ, aá géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ébrahām yá ā.

eng_Latn: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
idu_Latn: Unikɔdímɔ̄si, éyi kú uwā, nōo wā ɛgiyí nū eko éyi ā, da uwá ka.

eng_Latn: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā nēe bá nyā ī dɔɔ̄kā kéē jé odée, amáŋ é kē gáā je ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
idu_Latn: Kwú éyi kú aómlede ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ a da Árɔ̄ni mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwā kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā lé ijē kú ɛbɛ́ nōo gekwú abɔ̄yī nū, ámāŋ ijē kú ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le ŋmó ŋ́. Amáŋ é lɔfú bī ɔ̄ le yá ɔdā ɔhá glá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
idu_Latn: Ɛcí ō pā ī wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā tū ācɛ Ujúda ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ajā ō gbo í gē tū ɔ̄ uwēyī ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é kwú ajɛ ā ú tēelihɔ, ŋmá lɛ o pā ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ é le kwaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
idu_Latn: É gē nwūla okónu kú uwā gbādāā lɛyíkwu um, cīije bá um kahíníī, Ɛhɛ̄ɛ, Ɛhɛ̄ɛ, Alɔ má uwɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ.

eng_Latn: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā dúú, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛdɔ ācɛ dóódu fu ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe géē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ uwá aíkpɛ́cí dóódu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ígblɛ́nyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́fa oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛgwā obɔ̄bí ā. Ɛlā nōo gé ŋmá okónu kú uwā ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́fa kú ɔ́fúlɔ́kpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya ā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Urefém ā gaá mīya abɔ́ɔ tū abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
idu_Latn: Aá le alūka aínu kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ka, anɔ́ɔ aá kwú ōhī kú uwā í kpó catāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá bī aɛ́cɔ̄ kú uwā le gwó aɛ́ga nēe catāajɛ kú ɔdɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Aá nēé hīgwú ka aá le pīya ācɛ kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, wɛ ipú uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔtū kú uwɔ ú ŋmá ihɔtū kú ɔnyā ɔhá dóódu, ayíka ákú um ōfōōfūnū. Ā klla bī ɔnyā ɔhá dúúmā bɔ́ɔ̄tū gɛ ŋ́, ayíka ami ofōōfūnū um. Ihɔtū lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ikwū ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ɔbɔ́nyā ō yá kē lɔnɔɔtū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikwū abɔ̄yī nū, mɛ́mla únóji ā. Ó gē hɛ́ wulu bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá, nōo gē yi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá owu ā.

eng_Latn: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā mā ō yíihɔtū ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā gbóógbō ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ mā ō yíihɔtū Usɔ́ɔlu, nɛ̄ anúɔ je ɔ́ táajɛ ŋmá ɔcɛ́ kú anúɔ je anú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Udéfīdi ā cɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú lɛ odúúdú iyɔ́fú kpó tīiyē yɔ̄ gē gbō ɔlɛ́ nū, odúúdú agbénú kú nū bá ɛbɔ́ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī nɛ̄ um gē lā ɔyā alɛwa nyā í tīile dóódu ŋ́. Ŋmá otú ga otú, n yɔ̄ ī má ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō bī oje lɛ ɛlā kú um ā tá tū ápátɛ́cɔ̄, nōó géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gbóōgbóō!.

eng_Latn: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
idu_Latn: A jé ipú ɔtū kú um. A kē wā ɛgiyí um otú dúú ɛɛ́. A kē le um jila má dúúdú ɛɛ́, a kē má ka ń bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ipú ŋ́. Ń kē gáā ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋmá okónu kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄. Amáŋ aólufa ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíijē dúú, le ɔdūwēyī yá ɔ̄, lɛ ɔ́ nū nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ áncā.

eng_Latn: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
idu_Latn: Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā yíbīyājɛ tū um ā cīce amānyā pī um yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé!.

eng_Latn: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko géē wā, nɛ̄ n géē tá ācɛ nēé yá uwā italā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā, nēe klla ī móowe ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ā bá.

eng_Latn: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu ā, le ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ya ācɛ kú Ámɔn ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le pó ka é lɛwa nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
idu_Latn: Anú abɔ̄yī nū wɛ iyó ōgwu inyílɔ́lɛ́ kú alɔ á, amáŋ ó wɛ ílɔ́lɛ́ kú alɔ ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ inyílɔ́lɛ́ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ ī cɛ̄ ā wɛ ka Ɔwɔicō kwú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, ó lɛ ā ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī yɔ̄ ī ka kéē gáā je ācɛ nēe gekwú ā héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Adónīja bī aálá, omlede, ɛna lɛ ɛya gwó ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú ɛgwā nōo kwu Unrōgɛlu ajaajɛ ā. Ó lɛ odúúdú ayí kú Udéfīdi ɔhá ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Udéfīdi nēe ŋmá Ujúda ā kpó hīgwú wā ɔnū ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú igelī ā le ɛlā nyā pó ā, ɔtū kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā le wuklíicō.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
idu_Latn: A géē gwéeyē, ɔtū klla géē he uwɔ, ācɛ alɛwa kē í gwéeyē mla uwɔ eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ ma.

eng_Latn: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā khíníīī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwēyī gē kwú uwī, eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ uwēyī gáā kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ á. Uwēyī géē kwú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya klla mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu iyī uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā nāa gē nwū ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a yɔ ī yá aɔ́dā ɛpa nēe bá nyā glá, a géē lɔfu nya iyi uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē jāhɔ̄ gā awɔ ā tá glá.

eng_Latn: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ bī ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ nwū uwā iyāwu ō yɛ á. Amáŋ, é ka ɛ́ɛ́ jé kwu anúɔ ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ leyīkwu uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā bī ɔfú kú nū lɛ okónu ce, klla le ɔkpá gbo lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛɛ́. Ó kahíníī, Aólɛlā kú aá í gáā wā í mīya ajɛ kú aá tābɔ̄ kéē kpó aíkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá lé, klla kpó ejé kú aá gwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma ā, í lɔfú iyē ŋ́. Oyēeyī kú nū wɛ unwalu unwalu. Ó kē ī gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ ā, gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ bá ɔ̄. Ɛ̄la ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ gē bī ífi wā.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kpani, n má ka iyāwu kú alɔ nyā géē bī ámíyā mla ífi nɛ̄hi wā, iyó mɛ́mla úgbéenyi ā géē je kpó yíífi, oyēeyī kú ācɛ kē í pɛ́ yíífi dúú.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɛlā ɔkwɛyi ka Ɔwɔicō géē méyīnyinyi Usɔ́dɔm fíyɛ́ igelī ɔ́ɔmā!.

eng_Latn: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ussálum, ɔyí kú Ujábɛs le ojuju tū tū ɔcɛ́, Usɛkaríya, le ɔ́ ŋmó, ajɛ kú Ublíim. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí ú nū á.

eng_Latn: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, cāŋjɛ háyi icō iyɔ̄bu odúúdú uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, A lɛ ijáalí nēé cɛ̄ tū uwɔ ā pó ɛɛ́. A lɛ ɔdā dúú nāa í ka a.

eng_Latn: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó bī ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nōo tū uwēyī fíyɛ́ dúú ā. O ŋmá le ɛcí nōó pā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri, nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá nēe nɛ̄ wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko nēé bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́la gekwú, Ujóbābu, ɔyí kú Usɛ́ra ŋmá ajɛ kú Ubósra mīyɛ ɔkwu nū.

eng_Latn: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ɔ́mpā ā mla ihɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe gē yɛce Atálīya, ɔnyā obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla akwuna ɔ́ɔmā, le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bīya. É klla le iyó otīihɔ kú nū ōhī kpó gaá gbā ubáalu ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Amásīya yálé, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā kwú pɛ́ kwu ga ɔlɛ́ uwā á.

eng_Latn: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá okónu kú ágábá ā. Lɛ odo kú um nyatá ŋmá ajī kú ɛyī ā.

eng_Latn: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ujɔ̄ tū tɔ̄há kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ē géē lɛ kwú Ujísɔ̄si cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó tayínū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í mīyɛ aá ŋ́, ámāŋ koó pó ɛlā kú aá ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ aá gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá inu ámāŋ igelī ɔ́ɔmāa, aá lɛ úmlá nēe bá ikpó kú aá ā gwō bónū.

eng_Latn: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
idu_Latn: Ó le yá kú ācɛ Íjīpiti kéē gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, kéē yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɔdōbɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛnyīlɔ ā, aá le kwú ŋmá ikpɔ́nyā ō ce. Ine ɔhá dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bīya ā í lɛ abɔ̄ kwú ɔ́ ɔkpíyē ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē cikpɔ́nyā ā gē bīya ɔkpíyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
idu_Latn: Anú ā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē tū ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ á, anú klla yá ɔwɔ olímanya á, anú klla ī tū owu klá ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ó le ɔ́ tū ā.

eng_Latn: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, éyi kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí Ujósɛ̄fu ipú ɔ̄na gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ kú ā kwú ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ú ká ā le kwu ga ajɛ Íjīpiti. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gbéeko nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ka a nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Ohígbū ka Uhérɔ̄du géē tíne ɔyí ā kóō lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛba ɔmā kú ɛcɛ á, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔmā í lɔnyɛ gɛ ŋ́, ɔdí nēé géē le tū ɔ̄ kóō klla lɔnyɛ āa? Ó tīile dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é gē je ɔ́ pīya bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kē ī yɛ ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí aálá kú ɔlɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bí āa.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ācɛ Ujíyu nēe cɛ̄ɛlā nū ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um, aá géē wɛ ayíkpó kú um ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
idu_Latn: Ó hútu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ayisáya tá tāajɛ ā Ɔwɔicō ka, N géē tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um gbɔbū gā uwɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔwɛ kú uwɔ tútū gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
idu_Latn: N le italā nɛ̄ n gáā yá uwā ā miya táajɛ dúú ɛɛ́. N kē klla le ɔ́ tá táajɛ ɛɛ́. Ń gáā lɛ eyī gwō ɔdā nēé yá ā tá ŋ́. N géē cíla uwá ulé.

eng_Latn: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
idu_Latn: íkplí mɛ́mla ijē kú íkplí ā, mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ í gáā bá ipú ajɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ŋ́. Aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí kú ipácí dóódu í gáā yá uwɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú aíkonó kú Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla ayí uwā nēe pīyɛyí mla uwá ā wɛ, ofigwáahāanɛ ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Ishbosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
idu_Latn: Íssbɔ̄ssɛti, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu, wɛ iháyí ofɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nēé je ɔ́ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó gbō Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ɛpa. Amáŋ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā yɛce Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā lé ka, Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki, iyē kú ɔnyā nū lé ka Unayómi, iyē kú ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ā lé ka, Umálɔn mɛ́mla Ucílīyɔn. É ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frāti. Eko nēé lā Umówābu yɛɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō kweyī kú ɔdā dóódu cíkā o lɛ iyī nu tútū táajɛ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē mīyɛ ɔfla kú oyálé nōó gē lɛ́ɛcɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ alɔ gē yúklɔ́ ohígbū ɔfla nōo gē lɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ olíla í jé glá ŋ́ má, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́ í gáā jɛyí nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dúú nēe lɛ ɔtūce Óndú ā, géē lé úgwū kú ajɛ ā. Amáŋ é géē nū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
idu_Latn: N géē nyīla ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi nēe gē yúklɔ́ iyɔ̄bū um ā bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ nōo bá ɔkpáncō ā, mɛ́mla ɔjɛ kú ísu, nēe tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú ucɛ ā lɛ okónu kwu éŋkpɔ̄ nōo je pīya ejé ā, nɛ̄ ó jé ɛga nɛ̄ ó ŋmá ŋ́ mā otrɛ̄yí kú ucɛ ā le olɔnyā ā hīgwú.

eng_Latn: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ aóndú kú ɔfiyɛ ā, aá yá ucē nōó cíkā ā lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá, aá híīī yɔ̄ gē tū uwā ufi ŋ́, aá bla ka aá mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá lɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ékpó ɔkpáncō nōo wɛ ɔkpani kú aá ɛplɛ́ɛpa, nōó gē méyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ eko nōó ī kɛpɔ̄ tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gē je ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ba ā lɛ ɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tíne odée ā géē lɛ ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā, é kē í nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔwɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
idu_Latn: Ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla oŋmá lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ le ce ɔ́ ā, alɔ í gē kpéko bónū kú ālɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka alɔ lɔtū yéékpó koó géē mīyɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔkɔ ā, ó má ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le tū ɔ̄ eyīnyinyi, ohígbū keé lɛbɛ̄ɛka álá nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o leyí kwu uwā ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nwū uwā ɔdā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
idu_Latn: Ikpɛ́yí olɔfú ō yá tá Ɔwɔicō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ínoōbīya kú ɔhɛ ō yá ā, Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ō yá lɛbɛ̄ɛka íne obīya kú ɛ̄cī ō pā ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tá ɛlā kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́ mā, anú abɔ̄yī nū kē tá uwɔ káā wɛ ɔcɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
idu_Latn: É cíkā ō cɛ̄tra ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā jājīlīmā lɛ ipú ójīla kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Kéē cɛ̄tra anú ipéeyī ójila kú anyākwɔ́cɛ.

eng_Latn: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā le jī ɛɛ́. Ó ka uwá ɛ́ɛ gē tū ujɔ̄ klla yá ojuju nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ŋmá ɔtū kú anúɔ ŋ́. Ka ée gē lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá, gē cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔda nɛ̄ anúɔ í tíne ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ ée bá ī yá ɔdōobɔ̄bí éyi ga ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
idu_Latn: É gē bīya ācɛ iyē, é gē tū Ɔwɔicō eyījii, é gē lɛ ojīlīmā cē ācɛ ŋ́. É gē gwō ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔcɛ. É gē hútū ɔwɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, é ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ācɛ nēe ma uwá ā.

eng_Latn: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄, ká um wā ɛgiyí aá mla éeyē, ká n̄ dēē lūgwū abɔ̄ n géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ mla aá ā.

eng_Latn: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ eyī yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Ujeremíya. Ó kē wɛ ɔyí kú Uhílikíya, nōo wɛ éyi kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Anátɔ̄tu ipú ajɛ kú Ubénjamini ā. Ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá nyā ā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ɔ́ɔmā ka āa.

eng_Latn: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
idu_Latn: N géē wɛ ádā aá, aá kē géē je pīya ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú um, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, yá ɔtūnōbí ohígbū ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ō yá ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya ā. Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā ka lɛ ɔ́. Da ɔ́ ka, A tɛtɛ wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́. A tɛtɛ joklóbīya klla jíjééyī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ádā uwɔ yɔ̄ ā? Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Aá jé um ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kē jé Ádā um ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ um jé nɛɛ, aá géē lɛ Ádā um jé dúú.

eng_Latn: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
idu_Latn: Ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni nēe lā aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé kpó lɛ uwá mla ajɛ ácí kú uwā ā, wɛ ācɛ nēe kɔ̄ ukpɛ̄ kú ɛhi ā lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā nēé tá iyē uwā tū ɔkpá kú ayááyí kú Árɔ̄ni ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the LORD; for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Askelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā, lɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ugóólu kú ōce apú ɛhɔ̄ nyā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ Óndú ā kóō cíla ulé kú ínoōbīya kú uwá. Éyééye kwɛyí aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ufílīstiya nēe bá ā, Ugása, Ásikēlɔn, Ugáti, Ássīdɔdu mɛ́mla Ékrɔn.

eng_Latn: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kēé le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ eyī pīya kwu ajɛ nyā nāa je lɛ aádáádā uwā, mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi nyā nāa fu ā, mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gwó gā uwɔ nyā.

eng_Latn: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa le ɔkɔnyɔ obɔ̄bí má ɔ̄, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ uwēyī le Uhásɛ̄lu kwú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú Ɛláyíssa fōtíikwū blu icííci, gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ agīje blublu.

eng_Latn: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā habɔ̄ aá tá bɛ̄ɛka ayí okwū ā ŋ́, n géē wā ɛgiyí aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé mīyɛ ɔkpá kú Ujéhu ɔ́mpa ā, aígabɔ̄ kú Usamérīya ā le odúúdú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Áhābu ofɛtá cigwó ā kpó ŋmó, le uwá ɛyí kpó hɛ́ tū ómbilí kwú tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ujéhu, Ujésiríili.

eng_Latn: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá dóódu wɛ ínoōbīya, amáŋ ó kē lɛ ínoōbīya nōó kē ī ŋmɛ́yí tá ikwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ofucɛnɛ ā gwííjē kahíníī, A cíkā ō kwú ēpɔ̄kpá oōhā ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔja kpó fō ŋmá anú. Ohígbū keé lɛ uwɔ ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ a bī íkwu kú uwɔ nōo wɛ ɛya nɛ̄ a gwó ā lɛ ācɛ fūla lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋmá Ipɔ́ɔma dóódu, ŋmá ucē dóódu mɛ́mla ewo dóódu mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ācɛ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ je unwalu lɛ alɔ ŋmá áklō dóódu, amáŋ alɔ í kē cɔ̄nyā ŋ́, ɔda dóódu le yá alɔ jígbáá, amáŋ alɔ í kē je ɔtū tónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Áfa le ojibó kú Uníbihāsi mɛ́mla ákú Utátāki ma. Ācɛ kú Uséfāfem gē je ayí uwā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú uwā nēé hī ka Adramélēki mɛ́mla Anamélēki ā.

eng_Latn: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
idu_Latn: Ó ī tū um iyē klla ī yá um ágbe alɛwa, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ícɔ́ɔja nōo gē nuunu tá olɛlā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
idu_Latn: Ɛlífāasi mɛ́mla Ubíldāadi mɛ́mla Usófa lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da uwá ā yá. Anɔ́ɔ, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Ujóbu gbā ā pó á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, Ujɛ́ta, Umérɛ̄di, Éfa mɛ́mla Ujálɔn. Umérɛ̄di lɛ Ubítīya, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā lɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nēé hī ka Umírīyam ā ma. Ó klla le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa nēé hī ka Ussammāyi mɛ́mla Íssba ma. Íssba wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Éstēmowa ā kwaajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kē ŋmó Usitífin nōo kɛlā lɛ ācɛ lɛyíkwu uwɔ ā, n kē māháyi ajaajɛ kē cɛ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, n klla kē leyīkwu úwé kú ācɛ nēe ŋmó ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a le gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā, nāa lɛ ohi olɔhi tá uwá, é géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ klla í lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
idu_Latn: Utéblu kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla Utéblu kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ dóódu nēé géē kpó igbō kú ɛgba kú Óndú ā ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
idu_Latn: É da ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā kéē nyɔ̄ gáā tayínū ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin ā.

eng_Latn: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
idu_Latn: E nyɛ̄ɛ̄ Ukɛhɛláta gaá lā ɛfu kú Ussɛ́fa.

eng_Latn: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ā ipú inu kú Ɔwɔicō. N lɛ ɔtūce ihɔtū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
idu_Latn: N gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nōó mafú ga um ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ yá ā. N kē tá ɔdā nōó gē nwū um ka amíɔ̄ɔ̄ yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n géē gwííjē í cɛ̄tra uwɔ, n géē gwɛ́ɛya gā uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n cokónu nū ā yá jīla. Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū gē nya ɔ̄cɛ tá á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ā tá Ébrahām ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
idu_Latn: Ápākssadi kwū pīya ádā kú Usséla, Usséla kē kwū pīya ádā kú Ɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ofu ɛtá ce igwó piyóó nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ipú ɛcɛ nyā á. Alɔ gē ga iháyí ofu ɛnɛ, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Nááná, ɔdā nɛ̄ iháyí ā gē bī gē lɛ alɔ ā, wɛ ɔtūnōbí mla unwalu. Oyēeyī gē mɛ fíyaa cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ kē le wu le yɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Ébrahām.

eng_Latn: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē lɛ ā, ācɛ dóódu gē lɛ ejé olɔhi ā tū lɛ ācɛ le gwá gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ eko nēé le gwá lɛ ipú nū, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē bī ejé obɔ̄bí ā wɛ̄ɛcɛ kilɔ́dɔ́ɔ́ á. Awɔ ā lɛ ejé olɔhi ā tū jāā gbéeko nyā.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
idu_Latn: N da uwɔ ka a géē klá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔkɔ́bɔ ámōōmɛ kú olóofi ā gbā.

eng_Latn: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá nōo yɔ̄ ī wu icō fíyēlíí ipú ɔkpáncō á. Ó bī olɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo ī mɛ ŋ́ mā wā gaá ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ, kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ, mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́ma, mɛ́mla ucē, mɛ́mla éwo.

eng_Latn: And in every province, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā, ɛga dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔkpá kú ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ nyā jé, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū wōōō. É gwōkónu, gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, jikwū, klla yɔ́tūnōbí. É kpó īlī ekwu wu iyē le ewo gwu klá ɛyí, klla má gwutá ipú ewo dúú.

eng_Latn: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam le yɛ tá ɛgiyí anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe gbā ádā nū eko nɛ̄ ádā nū yēeyī ā, gaá lɛ ɛlā ā miya mɛ́mla uwá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ohi nyá nɛ̄ n cíkā ō tá ācɛ āa.

eng_Latn: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī lé ɛbɛ́ ókóme ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ je uwá ɛbéelihɔ. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ āpīice nēe le kɔ̄ ɛpa dúú, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ gē lé ɔdōlé mlɛ, í ce ɔ̄ wā ipú okónu, klla ī lé kpɔ́ ŋ́. Ó da uwá kéē híī lé ɛ́ɛ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko géē wā nɛ̄ n géē tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tú igelī kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nēé hī Urába ā. É kē géē je igelī ā wúlatāajɛ, nōó í tá alácɛ̄. É kē í kpó aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá ā yɔɔlá tāajɛ. Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ísrɛ̄lu géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwá kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe mīyɛ uwá anú ā.

eng_Latn: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
idu_Latn: N lɛ okónu tɔ́ɔtɛ́ yɔ̄ ī yíjēnyi kú ɛlā kú uwɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī yíjēnyi kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í klla lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ipú ɔdā dóódu ā, a tōō lɛ ɔtūce, Óndú.

eng_Latn: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n leyī pīya kú um má ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ga um ā, anɔ́ɔ n lɛ aɔ́dā o lɛ agege cɛyí uwā ahāapa nēé bī ugóolu yā má á.

eng_Latn: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ami, Óndú ā, géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā á. Ɔcɛ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á. N le ka ɛɛ́.
