eng_Latn: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yá lɔhi íbí, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi nēé cíkā ō lɔtūce ɔ́, a lɛyítáajɛ ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́, n géē je uwɔ pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo í leyīkwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi. Wā í gwéeyē mɛ́mla um.

eng_Latn: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā! Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔglɛ́ji éyi le tɛ́ɛcɛ gáā nyi īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
idu_Latn: A gē dɔɔ̄kā ō mafú ka amíyɔ í ka ɛpɔ̄ kpaakpa ŋ́ nɛɛ? A gē ŋmó um ɛpɔbí ka a lɛ́pɔ̄hi nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í pó ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ɔhá, ámaŋ má Ɔwɔicō ɔhá dúúmā gwū uwɔ tá nōo gē yá ɛdɔ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ a gē yá lɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūcē uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ Ɛlísa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni ā, kóō kwú ákánjɔ̄ kú oje udɔ o fɔ́ɔ́lá ā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí okwū kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔlá je yi ā, kóō lɛ ahā kú ɔlá ā pīya klá ɛga ɔhá ohígbū ka ákánjɔ̄ kú oje udɔ ā tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā má ka anúɔ í lɛ ɔyí ā tayínū glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ó kwú ómblí, nēé tá ácí nē é hī ka upápīrɔ̄si ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ácí kpó tū ɔ̄, lɛ unɛ kú ukoluta ja klá ɔ́ ɔkwu. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔyí ā ú tá ipú nū, kwú ɔ̄ ú cɛyí ácí kú okónu ɔkpá ā.

eng_Latn: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɛlā nɛ̄ aɛ́gɔ́ nū nwū ɔ̄ ā le tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā um gbō iyó ogbɛnú ce aá nɛɛ, n géē je iyó tū ɔ̄ fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó gbō ce aá ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ádā um bī itali ɔlamu gē gɔ́ aá nɛɛ, n géē bī itali nōo lɛ ujē le gɔ́ aá.

eng_Latn: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwe ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, n da aá, ka aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō gē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔ̄cobīyíne ékpó nōo le pīyabɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ é gā ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ɔ́ ā, Ébrahām le ede gwó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛfú pla tū ɛyí nū á. Ó le ɔyí nū, Áyísīki ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄ gbō, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ū cɛyí ɛfú kú ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú Ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, N kɛlā ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō. Alɔ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, anú yá nɛ̄ alɔ kē ī kɛlā ohígbū ka alɔ cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō dúú á.

eng_Latn: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ula yɔ̄ ī plla aéwɔhá ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó yɔ̄ ī lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄, nááná nɛ̄ éwo nōó gē gbō í nwuné ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá géē bá ī gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, aá géē jīla cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Amáŋ aá gáā yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɛ̄cī dóódu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu, ma ɔyīnɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū wɛ Umefíbōssɛti. Ó wɛ iháyí ɛhɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ádā nū, Ujonátan, kwú á. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄kā ikwu kú aádā nū ā ga ŋmá igelī kú Ujɛsiríili ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó kwu. Amáŋ eko nōó kwú ɔ̄ ú yɔ̄ í hápápá gē kwu ā, ɔyí ā hɛ́ ɔ̄ abɔ̄ wāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú nyɔ́nyí, í yāwu glá gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
idu_Latn: Aá gē cikpɔ́nyā ɔkwu ɔcí nēé hī ka óoku ā dóódu, ɛga nɛ̄ aá gē pɛ̄cí ā. Aá lɛ ayí aá kpó ŋmó gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú ɔpɛ́ kú ɛháajɛ kú aápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɔ́mɛ úlā cofɛnɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, nōo wɛ iháyí ɔ́mɛnɛ nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn cɔcɛ́ ā, ipú ɔyā ɔ́mpa nēé hī ka Usíbu ā, Usólōmɔn gbo úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ō gwó.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gā ɛgiyí nū abɔ́ɔ á, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla uwɔ, a kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōo lɔfú okpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó gbo ɔ́ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí kú ācɛ Usiríya nɛ̄ ō gáā yá ɔ̄ lé ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka ɛcí kú ācɛ Usiríya ɔ́ɔ tá uwá abɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nēé yá anúɔ lé á. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ géē tá anúɔ abɔ̄ dúú. Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yā le ífi bī wā í klá anú mɛ́mla éwo kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And the officers shall speak further unto the people, and they shall say, What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted? let him go and return unto his house, lest his brethren's heart faint as well as his heart.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aótrɛ̄yí ā ɛ́ɛ géē da ācɛnyīlɔ ā ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ ī bɛ́ɛpa lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yúúfi ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ká ɔ̄ lɛ cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī kpó ufi tū ācɛ ohile ā iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó ɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ámāŋ éwɔhá nōo lā ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo lɛ ɛcá cá Ɔwɔicō, odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā géē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá anú, í je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, We are passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m, ka aá kē ī ga ɔlɛ́ aá, ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu ā kú Ɛ́frem. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í mīyɛ aá wā ɔlɛ́ nū í gbo gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ máā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄, aá kóocōō kú aá kwú ajɛ kú aígelī nēe bá ā ú lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ ga ogbēé ɔhá kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lé ka Ayisáya. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú Amɔ́si. Aɔ́dā nēé tá tū ɔkpá nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú lɛ ɔ́ lɛyíkwú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ó mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ɛpléeko ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usíya, Ujɔ́tam, Áhāsi mɛ́mla Uhɛsɛkíya wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda ɔgbɔɔgba ā.

eng_Latn: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
idu_Latn: N gbo Ɔwɔicō, nōo yēeyī ā, anú nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā okpaakpa nōo cíkā gā um ā yá um ŋ́ mā. Anú klla cɛ̄ gā um yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ ipú oyēeyī kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
idu_Latn: Ussímēya, Uhágiya mɛ́mla Asáya.

eng_Latn: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú tá uwā lɔfú lɔfú jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ufilístiya le jila Áfēki. Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē le jīla bá ɔpɛ́ kú Ujesiríl pī njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
idu_Latn: Inu kú ɛga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛplá ā yɛ ga odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó lɛ inu ɔ́ɔmā mīya, ó má ka ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta igwó.

eng_Latn: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ lɛ ɔdā nōó yá ā má ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ jɛ́yí odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ le yɛ mla anúɔ, ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ iyó lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mahātá nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ ā, ó wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ó gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā nū Udéfīdi ɛ̄gbā. Eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ iháyí ɛnɛ yá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō je ínu, ede mɛ́mla ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra mɛ́mla ɛcí ɔhá dóódu nēé ma kwu ajɛ ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú aíkonó kú Usólōmɔn nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ mla uwá dúú ā wɛ, Usótāyi, Usófɛ̄rɛti, Upɛrída.

eng_Latn: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ ohile ā gē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, eko dóódu, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi ɔ́ɔ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ̄ ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ ā gaá túkpɛɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Uháman ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla ádā um ā, nɛ̄ n kē wɛ ɔyí ékpónú kú ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā um ā.

eng_Latn: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē, ayínɛ́ um, eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú ojámá ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí yɔ̄ gē yá aá.

eng_Latn: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē yɔ̄ pi alɔ abɔ́ɔ mla ɔfú mɛ́mla ojīlīma kú nū. Abɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ aísu mɛ́mla aɔ́kpá olɔwá nɛ̄hi í yɛ alɔ jīla tá. Amáŋ aúgbéenyi obī kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi kú aólɛlā ā í kē gáā yɛ uwá bēhé wā ɛgiyí alɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē ba Ɔwɔicō kú ɛbɔ́ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó kú alɔ, ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú, kóō cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ wā í lɛ aá má eyī cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō lɛ ā kpó lɛ aá ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɔtucē Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔhā nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā hɛ́ ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kwú á.

eng_Latn: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛ uwá āa, otrɛ̄yí kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ éyi gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú um gekwú ɛɛ́. Wā ká ā gaá lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ce ɔ́, ó kē ī je hēyī.

eng_Latn: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
idu_Latn: Aóhile ā wɛ Ucésedi, Uháso, Upíldassu, Ujídlāfu mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tūwɛlu.

eng_Latn: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa kōō kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti wā ajɛ obɔ̄bi nyā, nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā í gáā jɛ anú glá ŋ́ mā ā? Amānyā í wɛ ajɛ nōo lɔfú yá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ɔcí ufáyin, ámāŋ ka upomégrenēetí í yɔ̄ amānyā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gwá kōō ī yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú ígwu kú aógwuda, ká ā géē yēeyī. Wā gāá yɛce ɔwɛ kú ɔdōōjé.

eng_Latn: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē wɔ́tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yɔbɔɔ̄cɛ̄ ā. Ó kē gáā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwu ŋmá italā nɛ̄ ó gáā yá uwā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔlɛɛcɛ ā le iyē kpó ce odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō ā á. Amáŋ ipú uwā, odóódu í yɔ̄ nōo ī wɛ otábɔ̄ nōo cíkā lɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
idu_Latn: Anú ā gē leyīkwu ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī āyā kú ɔkpíyē ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwɔhá lɔɔlɔhi ŋmá opīyatɔ̄há kú āyā kú ɔkpíyē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Ó klla gē tábɔ̄ kú āyā kú ɔkpíyē dóódu kéē yúklɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yá ā. Odúúdú iyē ā géē jɛ̄ klla í ma iyī nū gicō bɛ̄ɛka inu ā oŋmá lɛ ihɔtū.

eng_Latn: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛlā kú íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé mɛ́mla ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē da uwá ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, ɔcɛ́ ā le má kéē jé ɔdā, é jééyī, klla ī tóohi ɛlā lɔhi, ɛga igwó fíyɛ́ ācoyímabɔ̄, aógwɛ́bā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācojɔ́dā ohile nēe bá Ubábīlɔn dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si bī ɔ̄kā nēé da ɔ́ ā le tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Íne nyá nɛ̄ Umósisi je lɛ aá lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ tɛ́cɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ wāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ujésɛ̄bɛlu ú tɛ́cɔ̄ wāajɛ ŋmá inīīcō. Anɔ́ɔ ōhī kú oyī kú nū le tá klá ɔdɔ mla aɔ́nya ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujéhu le ɔnya mɛ́mla ugbɔ́ɔnya kú nū pɛ́ gaá yɛ ɛyí okwu kú ɔnyā ā á.

eng_Latn: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ācɛ Ujíyu gāajɛ. Ɔtū klla he uwā nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé le ɛfú yálé ā.

eng_Latn: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gē tíne ɔlɛ́ nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́, ɔ́ɔmā léka ɔlɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō. Anɔ́ɔ ó tū Ɔwɔicō uwēyī kéē hī ɔ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋ́ má, ohígbū ka ó lɛ igelī tútū gbēyī uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si cāŋjɛ, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔnyā, ācɛ nēe kpɛ́lā ce wɔ ā bá iní? Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í ŋmó uwɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɛfu nyā, ó géē je ɔdā nēé le klá odúúdú aéwo ɛyí mɛ́mla īlī ekwu nōo húmáyī klá odúúdú ācɛ eyī ā kpó híla bónū.

eng_Latn: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kwú eyī kú nū ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́, nááná, n géē lɔtūce Óndú ā, klla í leyīce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, n lɔtū gbɔ̄ɔkɔ nyā gā awɔ, ohígbū ka a lɛ aɔ́dā nɛ̄hi mbá máfú lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ. A klla le da um ka a géē kpó ayááyí um pīya aɔ́cɛ́ igbīhi um.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá uwɔ ká owu ā kóō mā ō tá āā? Ohígbū ka owu ā yɔ̄ ī tá lɔfú lɔfú fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ka kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō pó ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā klla pi Umanásɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ahɔ̄, nááná, é tá kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udáni wɛ Uhɔ́ssim.

eng_Latn: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ odúúdú aá géē kpɔ́fú kwu ɔ̄cɛ éyi, nɛ̄ ó lɔfú ŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī wúla tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó géē je omlɛ́nyɔ̄́ lɛ aá nēe yɔ̄ ī móōwē abālɔbányā mɛ́mla alɔ dúú. Ó géē yá ɛ̄nyā eko nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si géē wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō í ma iyī fú ā. Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā í wā mla anú.

eng_Latn: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujɛ́futa tá uwā ohi kéē wɔ̄tū anúɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo yá kéē kōō le anúɔ nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ádā anúɔ. Ka ɔdíyá nēé wā ɛgiyí anúɔ eko unwalu kú uwá aā gɛ?.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, alɔ nēe wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe bá amānyā wɛ ofɛpa cigwó. Lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í tíne ɔkpani uwɔ, ekōhī Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɛyí ɛfu éyi amáŋ ɔpɛ́ éyi. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá uwā ohi ka Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ yá aá ā í yá uwā ɛhi, Ádā aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, géē je ákú aá yá aá ɛhi dúú.

eng_Latn: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujówābu í cɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ yɔ̄ í yá ā mla anú ŋ́ mā, ó gbo ācɛ kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn áluka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ācɛ o jéeyī kéē dɛ̄gba tū uwɔ, fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔdāhá kéē gwíijē ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī jahɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ onɔ̄ɔ̄na ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā le jé uwā má cɛ́ɛ́ kóō má, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ piyɔtū anúɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋmá ipú odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á. Olɛhɔ̄ nyā wɛ ákú ɔcɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ē bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwá tá ɔcɛ́ ā ohi kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í yɔ̄ ipú alɔ ŋ́. Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gē da ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdā dóódu nāa gē ka ā á. Ó kōō kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ a gē ka inu eyīpú kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nāa gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
idu_Latn: É gē bū oje ɔlamu ŋmá ajɛ, é kē ī na oje upu ŋmá ɛcɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
idu_Latn: Upéresi ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa: Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Uhámulu.

eng_Latn: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū Ihɔ lɛ ɔfú tū Udéfīdi iye kóō ka, kahíníī Óndú ā ka lɛ óndú um ka, cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um amānyā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ kpóbá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi éyi nɛ̄ n má ipú ɛcɛ ā yɔ̄ á, ācɛ gē kpó ije kú uwá tū gbēyī eko kú ɛgbá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā tíne ō gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄yī nū lɛ Óndú ā, kwu ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya ole yá ɛbɔ́, é géē nwūla okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī nōo yɛ ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā lɛ ɔ́. Ó í gwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā ɔwɛ ékpónú nōo gē bī gwɛ́ɛya ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n kéē yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā. É í je okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā gwū eko dúúmā nōo kwucē le tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ kwú lɛbɛ̄ɛka alɔ ā ɛɛ́. Ó le ɔdɔ̄lɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí jé ɛɛ́ A yá ó lɛ ɛga má fu īkpō kú ɔcí nōo gē je oyēeyī opiyóó ā, je le lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá yɛce aíne mɛ́mla uce nɛ̄ n tū aá ukɔ́ kú aá yá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē yá lɛ ā, aá géē nya oyēeyī kú aá tá. Ami ā wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔlá lɛ úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú yi tāajɛ, ufu lɛ ɔ́ cɛ̄. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū géē nyatá, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī oyēeyī kú nū kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlá icííci ā.

eng_Latn: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔdāajɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ŋmó, ó géē je ɔdāajɛ ɔhá cíla ulé nū. Íne ā wɛ ka, oyēeyī kóō kwɛyí oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gē mímálānyī obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā, nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ká aá ī cē olɔhi kwu iyī nū ōfūnū, óō híī gwō ka anúɔ jééyī ŋ́, ámāŋ ka o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ce ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdu eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ cokónu ka anúɔ í wɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā, é gáā lɛ igwu o wɛ́ɛ́yí kwu ɔ́ ɛyí ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó je iyī nū tá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí lɛ Óndú ā le yá jīla. Īnyīlɛyí kú nū géē wɛ oōmutū nɛ̄hi klla géē le gwá cíkpácíkpá.

eng_Latn: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
idu_Latn: N klla má ɛyí kú igwu ahāapa ɔhá, nɛ̄ owu kú ígbíli kwú uwā ú pīya igbóngbō.

eng_Latn: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Eko kú Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Uhágri le uwá kpó ŋmó klla mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā jāā kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
idu_Latn: ayíka Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ, ɔ̄cɛ Ukéniti ā, mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n, nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ōfōōfū uwā.

eng_Latn: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
idu_Latn: Ó he uwɔ ɔtū, klla wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ ŋmá ɔtū kú uwɔ ká ā yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nyā ga um, ká ā klla le óócí kú um mafú ga um.

eng_Latn: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɛdɔ ayí alɛwa ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́yī alɛwa ipú ahámgbā ā, lɔhi nɛ̄hi. É gáā yá ɔ̄ lé eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó gbɛyí mla aólɛlā kú nū ɔɔ́pu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
idu_Latn: Uféro Unéko, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā kwú Ɛlíyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosíya ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwɛyí Ujehowáhāsi. Ó klla kwú iyē kú nū ú pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá Ɛlíyākim ga Ujehóyākim. Unekó, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā kwú Ujehowáhāsi ú ga Íjīpiti. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ó kwú á.

eng_Latn: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má aákpa kú ɔ̄cɛ alɛwa á. Ācɛ nēé je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ ā cīīce ɛyí uwā. N má odo kú ācɛ nēé hɛ́ uwā īkpɛ̄yí ohígbū ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā, mɛ́mla ohígbū ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nēé tɔ́ɔna nū ā dúú. É tá ō gbā ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ojibó kú nū ɛ̄gbā. É kē cɛ̄ kéē fu uwā ukɔ̄ kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā abɔ̄ ámāŋ ka udɔ̄bū kú uwā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō kwú uwā í héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū yēeyī, anɔ́ɔ é kē cɔcɛ́ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá bá ī gbāajɛ iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó á.

eng_Latn: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ucɛ kú aá, aá gē gwá ejé klla gē gwō ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla uba mɛ́mla icháka mɛ́mla ɛ́mla ō tá. Amáŋ aá lɛ ɛlā wu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ɔ́migwó kú iháyí ɔ́mahāanɛ nɛ̄ Usedekíya ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Unebúkádinēsa, ɔ́cɛ kú Ubábīlɔn gā mɛ́mla odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū wā í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
idu_Latn: Lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tú iyī uwɔ wāajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ulé nɛ̄ ó ī gbā gā awɔ ā wɛ agbénú, ojīlīmā mɛ́mla oyēeyī ō likpō ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a bɔ̄bíipú ā yá nɛ̄ a gē kɛlā nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī ka nyā á. A bī ɛlā okónu kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī plla ɔ̄cɛ icííci.

eng_Latn: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē yá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu italā klla í jīla uwá iyē bɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo kwu ipú enyi, nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ gē jīla ɔ́ iyē ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē je ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmá ajɛ olɔhi, nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ aádáádā uwā klla í kpó uwā pahīla gla ogbeé kú ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi, ohígbū keé le Óndú ā yá cɔ̄nū oŋmá lɛ ojibó kú ɛcí nēé ma lɛ īyī uwā mɛ́mla ɛcí kú Ássɛ̄ra nēe yá lɛ iyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú tá īlī ō wu iyē ŋmá ɔnwū kú aálá kú uwɔ ā. A kē lɔfú kpó aɛ́wū ōhī lá, ká ā bī ije ā lɛ lá ajɛ glá.

eng_Latn: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā Óndú ā le tútū yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ka aá wā ɛgiyí nū kóō méyīnyinyi aá kpɔ́. Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka Óndú ā gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa eko dóódu. Éeyē yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nēe kwu ɔtū kú uwá u kpó ce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, le īlī kú ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ yá lɛ Ádām mɛ́mla Íifu, ɔnyā Ádam ā.

eng_Latn: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ayááyí gā uwɔ n­ēe géē lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā. N géē je odúúdú ajɛ nyā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ. Odúúdú aéwo géē da um ka n̄ lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n hɔ́hā ce ayááyí uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
idu_Latn: Ó gē fu aɔ́cɛ́ ɔfulā ɔcɛ́, ī je uwá tá ajɛ ŋmá ɔcɛ́, klla í je uwá pīya aɔ́fiyɛ.

eng_Latn: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwa wɛ, úlā ofu ahāanɛ ce úlā éyi ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Usáyɔn, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, géē cɔcɛ́ piyóó. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aá ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá mɛ́mla ajɛ ɔhá dóódu wā ipú ajɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā, le túbá klla le aólɛlā kú uwā úlā ofu ahāanɛ ce úlā ahāapa ce ofigwó kpó ŋmó ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā. Amáŋ é wu iyó kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú olɛlā kú uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
idu_Latn: N má ocábɔmafú kú íjééyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo jɛ um eyī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ gbɔɔ́ ō kwú Udéfīdi, anɔ́ɔ ó ka eyī ɔ́ɔ yá anúɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō gaá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ gé lɛ anúɔ ŋmá obuga kú okónu igá kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ le gwá.

eng_Latn: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ Ubálam má ā, ó le ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ā má, anɔ́ɔ ó ka ka ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ɔ́ lɔfú fíyɛ́ odúúdu aéwo á, amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā, é géē je uwá yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔyíkpó éyi yɔ̄ Udámásikɔ̄si, nēé hī ka Ananíyāsi. Óndú ā da ɔ́ ipú ɔ̄na kahíníī, Ananíyāsi. Anɔ́ɔ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, Óndú.

eng_Latn: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
idu_Latn: Ipéyī aádáádā uwā, Ɔwɔicō yúklɔ́ idáagó ɔpɛ́ kú Usóyan, ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
idu_Latn: Aá, gwíijē lɛ Óndú kú aá cɛ̄tra anú. Aá tɔ́ɔna kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē nya alɔ tá ɛ̄cī dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kpó aɔ́cɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi bá ajɛ ŋmá ɔcɛ́ kú uwā, klla ī je aólɛhɔ́cɛ gicō.

eng_Latn: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
idu_Latn: Ipácí mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā, kéē gwéeyē. Aɔ́cī mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú uwā géē tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē dúú.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aá géē má uwá, ɔtū kē í he aá nōo kē í cɛ̄ lɛ aá gwéeyē. Ohígbū kéē géē kpó agbénú nɛ̄ aúgbéenyi ī kpó bū eyī aísu nɛ̄hi ā gé lɛ aá. É kē í kpó agbénú kú aéwɔhá ā wā gé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtulalī umuumu fú tū ɔgba éyééye kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé nēé gwó lɛ Óndú ā. Kóō kwɛyí igbo nēé le gwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
idu_Latn: Ubákosi, Usisɛ́ra, Utéma.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í nyí ɔ̄ ije ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ abɔ̄ nwūla lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ije ā kplá anú ɛjīla nōó dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nyá kú aɛ́pa nēe bá ā yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā nū tíne āa? Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ákú aflɛ́yí ā nɛ. Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ācodɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla aákwuna géē nyɔ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō gbɔbū lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
idu_Latn: Ń tíne kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka n yɔ̄ ī bī ɔkpá le tū aá ufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
idu_Latn: ó nya alɔ tá ohígbū olɔhi dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ yá abɔ̄yī alɔ ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó ményinyi alɔ icííci nɛ̄ n. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā bū ipú Alelékwū ihɔ nɛ̄ ó le na alɔ yēŋēē ā. Ó lɛ alɔ ma igbo ɔ́mpa klla lɛ alɔ yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n da aá ka, n yɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ Ébrahām.

eng_Latn: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ íne kú um tū, ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, abɔ̄yī um yá aá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
idu_Latn: É í gbā utébulu mɛ́mla odúúdú iyo kú ɛyí nū, ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú iyo kú nū mɛ́mla ede kú ɔtulalī ā.

eng_Latn: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
idu_Latn: É géē kpó ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā yíífi piyóó, é géē lɛ uwá fō gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híīī jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú nū lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé bá ɛga oligbó ā géē doōcē, í pɛ́ kwú. Ācɛ nēe kwu ajaajɛ ā, ɛfú géē lé uwá. Ācɛ dúúmā nēe géē hile ā, ɔkpɛtā géē je uwá kpó ŋmó. Odúúdú uwá géē jɛ̄ ɔlá kú ícɔ̄nū kú um.

eng_Latn: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a lɛ italā yá ācɛ kú uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ é bá ipú ɔnɔ ā, é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ klla jikwū klá awɔ á.

eng_Latn: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā, é le da ɔ́ ka Ábna ɔ́ɔ wā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ kē mā ɔ̄ tá le yɛ ɛbɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācɛ nēe lɛ awulú kú uwā na péee ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi. É géē lɛ íkwu ō lé īkpō kú ɔcí nōo īkpō kú nū gē je oyēeyī ā. É klla géē bū aókonɔɔwɛ ā ga ipú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aláadi eko nɛ̄ alɔ le jīla tɔ̄há ká ālɔ̄ cē igbō lé ā, Upɔ́lu le ɛlā ka mla uwá, abɔ̄ ó tíne kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā piyóó gbó ahāpōtú.

eng_Latn: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ á í lɛ ɛga ogwuta dúúmā ŋ́, é kwú okwū kú uwɔ u tá ɛcɛ ka ó kwú wā bónū. É lɛ okwū kú aícɔ́ɔja nēé ŋmó ɛfú a tū ikwū klá okwū kú uwɔ ɛyí, ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄.

eng_Latn: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn lɛbɛ̄ɛka omútāga nōo je odúúdú ɛcɛ wúlatāajɛ. Amáŋ anú abɔ̄yī nū kwú cē, le yíla bónū icɛ ɛɛ́. Ɔdā nōo yá Ubábīlɔn nyā, yá ācɛ éwo dóódu eyījii.

eng_Latn: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē yá ācɛ Ujúda italā ohígbū ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā piíí. N géē gwō ɛdɔ éwo nyā ɔ́ci kú abɔ̄ īyī um piíí.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē pó ɛlā kú Óndú ā ŋ́, náaná nōó yɔ̄ ī tū ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe ī cɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tū uwā fu aá ā.

eng_Latn: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ayínɔ̄nya kú Usɛ́lōfɛhadi ka ā le kpaakpa. Aá lɛ ajɛ je lɛ uwá pī aɔ́máapú kú ádā uwā, kú úgwū kú ádā uwā kóō wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the LORD thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the LORD thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the LORD thy God loved thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka amáŋ, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ́ jāhɔ̄ lɛ Ubálam ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ nōó géē tá okónu lɛ uwá ā, ɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō hɔ́hā ce uwá, ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ he Óndú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛyíkwu ede kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛga nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú igelī kú Usamérīya ā géē yá jīla piíí.

eng_Latn: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
idu_Latn: Uwá cāŋ́jɛ bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē le yɛ tá Ujerúsālɛm á. Abɔ́ɔ ā, é má ayíkpó igwóléyi mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá mla uwā le jīla tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
idu_Latn: Aá ī dɔ̄ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi nōo gē bɔ̄bíipú ā yɔ̄ gɛ.

eng_Latn: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi dóódu nēe pīyeyī kwu īyī uwā ā, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɛhícō ā. Éyééye kú okómpīinu ā lɛ otrɛ̄yí nōo gē leyīkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā lɛ íbɔm cē tū odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda ā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā bū ga ipú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. É kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í kpó ɔfiyɛ ga ajɛ éwɔhá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
idu_Latn: Áhābu klla le ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra ma. Áhābu yá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔtūnōbí fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usádrāki, Uméssaki mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ohi kahíníi, Ágábáidu, alɔ í cɛgbá ō kɔkɔ ga uwɔ ipú ɛlā nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpokwú ágáa kú ijakī éyi, nōó kwú gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má. Ó túkpɛɛ́ kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔ̄, le ācɛ Ufilístia úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ akpacáŋgelī bī gé lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ akpacáŋgelī ā bī gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī ā le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ̄ kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Lɛ ɛka gbo gā um gbɔbū ka a géē je ukpɛ̄ kú ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú uwɔ ga um. Ísɔ le ɛka gbo kwú ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú nū ú le Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Udáni lɛ iyē kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá Uláyīssi ga Udáni, iyē kú ádáádā uwā, ɔyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā.

eng_Latn: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu gekwú mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɛtá ā, mɛ́mla ɔyípōklobīya o bī iyɔ́fú kú nū ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tɔ̄ɔ̄há, ɛ̄cī ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā ayíkpó kú nū pīyɛyí gā. É le hídáagó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē kɛlā mla ɔnyā ā. Nááná ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa ī kɔ̄ɔkā mla anú ā ŋ́? Amāŋ Ɔdíyá nāa gē kɛlā mla anú ā ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā nū uwá inya gaá lɛ Usedekíya kwú ajɛ kpátáá, nōo kwu Ujérīko ajaajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn Unebúkádinēsa, nōo yɔ̄ igelī nēé hī ka Uríbla, ipú ajɛ kú Uhámāti ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, Unebúkádinēsa lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, yɔ̄ ī bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ikwū kú iyī nū nɛ. Aá ma ɔ̄ tá, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kōō jé ɛ̄cī ámāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā í wā ā ŋ́. Aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔkpáncō ámāŋ kú Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā í kōō jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ dúú. Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā ōfōōfūnū jé ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá da Ujérobōwam ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ fu ɔ́ ŋmá ipú ācɛ ohile ā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ je ɔ́ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on), but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá gā okónōgwu kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu ká ɔ̄ da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ká ɔ̄ gáā lɛ gla aá gɔbū kú ɔ̄ lɛ ikpó hɛ́ce lígíí. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le ikpó hɛ́ce gɔbū lígíí yɛɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu ká ɔ̄ māháyi ɛga éyi lígíi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō mafú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
idu_Latn: N klla ī dɔɔ̄kā kpɔ́ ka, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í jɛ́ɛ́yí nū ŋ́ ɔkwɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛɛ? Umósīisi abɔ̄yī nū nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo tóohi ā kahíníī, N géē hɔ́hā ce aéwo nēé wɛ éwo ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kpópú uwā. N géē hɔ́hā ce aílɔ́wá olíla cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā wɛ úlā ofɛhɔ cigwóléyi, cofigwáahātá . É le ɔwɛ nēé gē bī ɔkpacaŋgelī mɛ́mla óbō mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú mɛ́mla ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī kpɛ́fú lɛ ā nwū uwā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, A lɔfú lɛ um nyɔ́kpá glá ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō je ɔfú ɔ́ɔmā gā uwɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo je um gā uwɔ ā anú lɛpɔ̄bí kú ínoōbīya fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ le ukpa lɛ alɔ kwú, a klla kwú iyō ogbɛ́nú nɛ̄hi ú ce alɔ igbīhi.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ahínyá. Aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā tɛ́ɛcɛ, kú aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ka ɔdā nōó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē lɛ āyā éyi ŋmá oōkɔ̄ ɛga ɛhīlī kú okoolo éyi kú umu gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu. É géē wīya umu ā tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɛga éyi ŋmá oōkɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ olífu. Íne kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā nyā géē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
idu_Latn: Ó je ɛga lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú ɛcí ā kéē túblá ede kú Óndú ā ŋ́. Amáŋ é je ɛga lɛ uwá kéē lé igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī gé lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yá ɔdā nōó miya lɛyíkwu um ā jīla. Ó kē lɛ ojuju alɛwa lɛyíkwu um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ō yɛhɛ tū ɔ̄ ohígbū kéē jé ka ɔyí ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo háyi abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla uwá ā gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kóō lɛ ɛyí ɛbɛ nyā ka gā um. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛyí nū ka gā um dúúdú á.

eng_Latn: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í cɔ̄nyā lɛ uwá jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔkōōlɔhi ā tū lɔhi gbēyī aá.

eng_Latn: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ohi tá uwɔ lɛyíkwu ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka nyā.

eng_Latn: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú Uhádādēsa ā le má ka Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ lɛ aá kpó yálé ā, anɔ́ɔ é nyɔ̄ í le ɛbɔ́ yá mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu á. É klla má bá ɛháajɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, klla gbɔɔ́ ō da ije ɔlɛ́ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Usiríya í lɛ ɔtū nyɔ̄ í tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn abɔ̄ igbɔhá glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ācɛnyā kú Ujerúsālɛm gē gɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. É gē yāwu lɛ ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɛnwū kwu icō gɛ̄mm, klla ī yá eyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī gbajā ā. É klla bá ī hɛ́ ɔkwu tá ɔwɔɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔká nēé le tū ikpó ā bá ī yúuya jēgējēgē ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aéwɔhá kpó uwā mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá, ɛga nɛ̄ uwá, ámāŋ ka aádáádā uwā í lā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē pā ɛcí nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbā mla ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú igbō ā ú, ó lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɔ́ kpó cē nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ uwá, yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú um nēé je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō kwɛyí aá ā á. Aá yá ɛ̄nyā ká aá bī le blakwu um.

eng_Latn: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ō yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā, n le hɛ́kwú gwutá ajɛ kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ abɔ̄ bī um, kwú um ú cāŋjɛ háyi icō á.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je iyī nū gicō, Ɔwɔicō géē tū ɔ̄ wāajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ iyī nū tū wāajɛ, ó géē je ɔ́ gicō.

eng_Latn: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ipú ukpɛ̄ nōo wɛ ákú aícɔ́ɔja ā, aá géē je éyi ŋmá ipú úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ dóódu kú ācɛ, ɛna, ijakī, álá, mɛ́mla ɛwū lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú Óndú ā kwu ācɛ ō yá okpaakpa. Ó gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nēé gē je ā.

eng_Latn: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛtá mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi. Ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā lé ka Utáma. Ó jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
idu_Latn: N bī ōwē nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá ā le aá jámá ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē na oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā. Amáŋ aá kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nōó ī tīile eko nēé le ɔ́ na ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Uhɛ́srɔn nōo lé ka, Ukálɛ̄bu ā, le ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujɛ́rīyɔ̄tu lɛ. Ó ma ayí ɛtá lɛ ɔ́: Ujɛ́sa, Ussɔ́bābu mɛ́mla Ádɔn.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da uwá kɛ́ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ipú ācɛ ā kɛ́ɛ̄ da uwá kɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ álá mɛ́mla ɛna kú uwá kpó wā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ŋmó uwā klla í lé ɛbɛ́ kú uwā ɛgiyí anúɔ abɔ́ɔ. Ó kéē híí bīya íne kú Óndú ā o ŋmá lɛ o lé ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ oyī yɔ̄ anú ŋ́. Ɔtú ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú uwá le ɛna mɛ́mla álá kú uwā kpó wā í ŋmó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā nōó ī leyīkwu ɛcɛ gɛɛ, ī tíne ɔdá nōó gē kwú lé á.

eng_Latn: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó mɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ó lɛ ajɛ nya um eyī, n lɛ iyē gwā, anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā, n kē ī mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ tábɔ̄ áncā ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ uwā wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā kwúcē nyɔ̄ lɛ dúú á. Ɛdɔ úklɔ́ dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ yá nááná, é gáā má ɔdā dúúmā je ŋmá ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this will we do, if God permit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄, alɔ yɛ gɔbū. Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá á.

eng_Latn: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
idu_Latn: É lɛ unwalu miya tū lɛ ɔwɛ nōó ī lā oyēeyī kú nū ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī jē ukpa tayínū ipú ajɛ gbēyī ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,
idu_Latn: Oyēeyī kú uwɔ le kpií lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nōó le bɛ̄cɛ ā, ó kɛlā lɛ uwá glá gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le jé koó lɛ odée má ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Anú abɔ̄yī nu gbɔɔ́ ō yábɔ̄ lɛ uwá abɔ̄ ó kɛlā lɛ uwá glá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí mɛ́mla ayááyí kú ɔlɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu nēe wā ajɛ Íjīpiti mɛ́mla anú ā wɛ ofɛtá ce ɛhīlī. Anyā kú ayí nū í wɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔnɔ ká alɔ gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ í kwú ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ íne tū. Ekōhī ɔ̄cɛ géē lɔtū í kwú ohígbū ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ glá.

eng_Latn: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yá aɛ́cí klla ī pá ɛcí ā wɛ ɛflɛ́ɛ́fu. Aɛ́cí nēe kē he uwá ɔtū ō yá ɔ́ɔmā í kē tīile dúúmā ŋ́. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē pā ɛcí nyā, wɛ aópeyī mɛ́mla aógwuda. Uwēyī kē í kwú uwā piíí.

eng_Latn: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aéwo alɛwa le túbá lɛyíkwu aá. É kahíníī, Ujerúsālɛm géē je yíífi piíí! Alɔ géē má ka Usáyɔn géē je wúla tāajɛ piíí.

eng_Latn: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N le ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tū klá ācɛ Íjīpiti ā. N le ayípóklóbīya kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, klla kwú ɔnya ɛfú kú uwā í kpó nyɛ̄ɛ̄. N cɛ̄ lɛ ípī kú okwū kú ɔlɛ́ aá le mu aá ɛnwū. Nááná, aá cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nēe lɛ agbénú kú Alelékwū nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛtɛ́ nēé ma ɔmɛ ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē je ka ɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō, ó wɛ ákú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā dɔɔ̄kā ō fūla odóódu kú nū, ó gé cíla ulé nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá nū lɛ ā. Ó klla í lɛ ije ofu ŋmá ipú ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛyí ɔ́lá ā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ɛfú á kpó lɛ? Ka ga um. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ inya kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Ɛfú klla le ācɛ alɛwa kú uwá lé. Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ɔyī nū Ujonátan le pɛ́ gekwú dúú.

eng_Latn: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya dóódu géē leyīkwu ije nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ ó gē yúklɔ́ lɛ uwá gē bī wā a. É gē bī ije ā le tú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá.

eng_Latn: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú iyinū ú bɔ́há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā le pīya ékpónú mla anú ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyāŋjɛ ahāpōtú gaá kwú ɔyí anúɔ ú ŋmá iyɔ̄bū anúɔ, eko nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ í gbiyɔ̄lā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú gwutá iyɔ̄bū iyī nū á. Ó klla da ɔcɛ́ ka ɔnyā ɔ́mpa anúɔ ā klla kwú okwū kú ɔyí nū ā ú gaá gwutá iyɔ̄bū anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā géē yā ācɛ nēe hile ā eyījii, abɔ̄ ó géē yá lɛ glá ā, amáŋ ó gáā lɔnɔ tū um ō yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ɔŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Ébrahām cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔdōlé ú mɛ́mla ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ kú éŋkpɔ̄ ú kpó lɛ Uhága á. Ó kwú ɔyí nū ú bá ɔ̄ ɔnya, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ á. Uhága nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō gaajɛ gicō ipú ígbíli kú Ubiyɛssɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ wu ocíbú mla um ā gáā yá ibīyājɛ tū um á.

eng_Latn: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛlā kú Udéfīdi pó ā, é le ka lɛ Usɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá leyī kwɛcɛ, ohígbū ka aá jé eko nɛ̄ ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā í wā ā ŋ́, ó lɔfú wā ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ámāŋ ahāpotú ámāŋ ka ɔbúgwu aflɛ́yí, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ōmiya kú ede, nēé bī ɔdā ole miya odée ékpónú nēé le mīya Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā le miya ɔ́ á. É lɛ ɔ́glɔ́ na ɛháajɛ kú ede ā biílí, nɛ̄ olipú kú nū wɛ usentímīta ofɛpa cigwó, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ usentímīta ofɛpa cigwó. Akā ce ɔ́ okónu ɛcɛ yɛ biílí nɛ̄ icō kú nū ŋmá ajɛ kē wɛ isentímīta ofu cɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛlá wu ísu ō cēenyi ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan le pɛ́ klá anú eyī nááná, ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ncɛ́nyā kú éwɔhá nōo wā mla Unaómi ŋmá ajɛ Umówābu ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlíyākim, mɛ́mla Ussɛ́bina mɛ́mla Ujówa le úwé kú uwá kpó híla ipú ɔtū nōbí, klla nyɔ̄ í lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ Usiríya ka ā kpó ka lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, A wɛ ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ? Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aá ŋmá aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aóklóbīya um, aá kwú ɛbéenyi dúúmā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehéee.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
idu_Latn: É le aɛ́na ahāapa mɛ́mla aálá ahāapa kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká Óndú ā kóō géē tá ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe bī ɔ̄ ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō ga Uhásɛ̄rɔtu, ɛga ɔhá nēé gwó ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācoyíimabɔ̄, ācógwɛ́bā, mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, mɛ́mla ācojɔ́dā ŋmá ínyílɔ́wɔ le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí um. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔ̄na nyā ka lɛ uwá, amáŋ é ka ɛyí nū gā um glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Udamáscɔsi lá iyó ɔ́sú mɛ́mla agbénú ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, klla kpó ejé kú Uhɛ́lbɔn mɛ́mla owú kú Usáha ī cíla uwɔ ulé uwā.

eng_Latn: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ Uhíbru lá, ó géē yúklɔ́ lɛ aá iháyí ɛhīlī. Aá géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá iháyí ɔ́mahāapa ā, nɛ̄ ó gáā gbā ɔdā dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā, n géē yá ka ācɛ kú Ɛ́lam kéē klla kwúcē wā ahɔ̄ olɔhi nēé bá gbɔbū ā kpɔ́. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á.

eng_Latn: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
idu_Latn: N húmáyi lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā, ohígbū ka awɔ ī nwū um á.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ olɔnyā ā tóohi kahíníī, Ń kōō jé aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
idu_Latn: É gē je aɔ́cɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka é wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn nēe bá ā, wɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá aígabɔ̄ ɛbɛ́. Igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hɛ́ igá olɔfú tū ɔ̄ ā, gē tū uwā ɛhɛ, ohígbū keé gē tū ógbudu tū ɔdɔ ā iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ icō ɔdɔ ā tū nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ igelī ā.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.
idu_Latn: É yúufi nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔwɔ éyi gā aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú uwā ɛɛ́. Alɔ gebí ɛɛ́. Ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā í yá alɔ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwa ohi kahíníī, É tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá íne ká aá ka Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aá wɛ aɔ́wɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ kú Ujɛ́būsi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ugígāssi.

eng_Latn: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī gbɔɔ́ ō tá ahɛ klá anú. É le ɔ́ eyī gbō, anɔ́ɔ é le abɔ̄ gɛ́ ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ gē da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́ɔ jé ɔ̄cɛ nɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ gɛ́ ɔ̄ āā? Ācogbāājɛ mīyɛ ɔ́, lɛ abɔ̄ fīyɛ̄ ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, lɛ anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú Abíssāgi, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ussúnɛm ā ú lɛ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kwú pīya ɔnyā anúɔ. Ó ka anúɔ jé ka Usólōmɔn ɔ́ɔ gáā tá ɛlā kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ícɔ̄nū kwú ɔ ɛgba ú fu ŋmá ajɛ. Klla lɛ ɔ́ tá fīyɛ̄ ajɛ. Owu nōo ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kwú īkpō kú nū ú ŋmókókó. É lɛ ābɔ̄ kú nū kpó cē, é le ŋmó, é klla lɛ uwá kpó yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ajɛ oplákátá kú ɛyí ɛfu kú odúúdú ajɛ kú Uhéssibɔn. Ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn gē gbō ɔ̄ ŋmá Uhɛ́ssibɔn ā. Umósīsi le ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umídiyarā kpó yálé. Ajɛ ā wɛ Ɛ́fi, Urɛ́kɛm, Usɔ́ɔ, Uhɔ́ɔ, mɛ́mla Uréba, odúúdú uwā kē tɛtɛ gbāajɛ ā lɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ Uhéssibɔn ā.

eng_Latn: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔkpɛtā mla Aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí klá aá, nēe í kpó ayí aá ŋmó ŋmá aá abɔ̄. Ōcē obɔ̄bí géē kwú aá, ɛfú kē í lé aá. Ami, Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē háyi iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ kú ɛfu kú Uhɔ́rɛ̄bu ā. A géē lɛ okwutɛ ā fīyɛ̄ ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā, éŋkpɔ̄ géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá anú lɛ ācɛ ā kéē gwá. Umósīsi le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yá ipéyī anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ wɔ́tū Ujékɔ̄pu nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ádā nū kwú ɔhā ú hɛ́ ce Ujékɔ̄pu. Ísɔ ka ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ádā um géē kwú ānāānā, é kē í bá inīkwū nū. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē ŋmó ɔyínɛ́ um, Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō gaá lɛ uwɔ kwú, kwú uwɔ ú tá agbá, klla lɛ uwɔ bī wā ɔnɛ̄pɔ̄, ɔnyɛ̄ yá abɔ́ɔ, géē ci ɔ́ anú glá āa?.

eng_Latn: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Urécɛ̄lu wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ bī uwā jɔɔ́ɔwɛ ipú iyawu oligbō bū ipú ígbíli, iháyí ofɛpa nēe yɛ ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ bī ōwē le já uwā má, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá gbɛlá ō yá ā. Ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ uwá géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
idu_Latn: Nwū um, ká n̄ lā o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú uwɔ ka lɛ ā. Ohígbū ka awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um, nōo gē nya um tá á. N kē lɔtūce ce uwɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá ī yá ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá bá í yɛhɛ, bá ī yá ucɛ. Aá ŋmó aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá. Aá bá í lé, ī gwá, gē ka kahíníī, Alɔ lé, ka alɔ gwá! Ohígbū ka oócí ā, alɔ géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē jé olɛhɔ̄ nyā nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā kóō le lɔhi. Ákú ācɛ nēe kē í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ ā ka ā kéē le lɔhi. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā géē yá ā le kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā ipú aɔ́dā o lɛ agege ce uwá ā. Ó lɛ awulú nōo kwu ɔ́ ikpó wiye. Ó kē lɛ ɔdōgbɛ̄ɛ́nyɔ́ nēe bī ugóolu yá ā kwú ɔtū.

eng_Latn: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ ā í kpó iyíípú mɛ́mla iklííkpó igbīhi kú nū na. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya í je ɛya ā lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú uwā ú kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede ā. Ocu kú nū gē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
idu_Latn: É le acá kú uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa nāndaa kwu īyī uwā klla lɛ ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ yá. Ɛga dúúmā nēé ge yɛ nyɔ̄, é gé yɛ tɔ̄há, í gē pīyeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛ̄nyā má gbɔɔ́ ō yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū géē he aá. Ó ī yá aá ka iyē kóō lɔfú lɛ aá nɛ̄hi. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ géē jé ka ami nōo wɛ Óndū ā gē tá ācɛ dóódu nēe gē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā abɔ̄. N kē ī cɔ̄nū tū aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ um lɛ ō yēeyī ā mɛ ɛɛ́, odúúdú ojuju kú um ā kwú kpó bīya ɛɛ́. Odo kú um kē le bīya dúú.

eng_Latn: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ā le yá jīla, ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ujósɛ̄fu ā le yá jīla klla le mafú kóō wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ogbonɛnɛ lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā. Ó lɔnyɛ ō pó, ó klla ī lɔfú tū ɔ̄cɛ iyē.

eng_Latn: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nēe gē je ɔklɛ́bɛ́tɛ lá ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔdā nēe bá ā kpó. Aá híī yá inu kú Ádā um bɛ̄ɛka inu oōtɔ́hí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unatánīyɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā olɔhi dóódu ŋmá Unásārēti wɛ̄ɛcɛ glá āā? Anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Wā gaá má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdā nāa miya gáā yá mafú lɛ Óndú ā kóō lɛ ɔ́ má gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nāa miya gáā yá ā lɛ kwú ɔ̄ gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɛ̄nyā, é lɛ ɔtū mɛ́mla odo kú aá yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
idu_Latn: A géē je ekabɔ̄ ofɛpa ce igwó o hile kú olīkpō kú ābɔ̄ éyééye kú īlī ā playi áklō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā kóō má klá anú.

eng_Latn: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka inu dóódu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwó ɔ̄, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō gwó ɔdā dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le cīgbīhi ga ipɔ́ɔma kú nū, ga ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɛgiyí agbénú kú nū.

eng_Latn: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī Upɛ́ntīkɔ̄si le yá ā, odúúdú ācocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā bá tɔ̄há ɛga ékpó.

eng_Latn: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu ōhī le pɛ́ ŋmá Ántiyɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Ikónīyɔm anɔ́ɔ é gaá lɛ ācɛ ā ɔtū pīya tá iyī uwā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ tá klá Upɔ́lu á. Abɔ̄ é gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, é lɛ ɔ́ pi tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá igelī ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nēé ma ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā? Alɔ má ínyílɔ́wɔ ocābɔ̄ kú nū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Alɔ kē wā gaá tá ɔ̄ ɔ́gbá.

eng_Latn: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ ka a cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū, ó géē bī uwɔ ga ɔlékwū. Ɔwɛ kú nū gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
idu_Latn: aá gé híhó ka aá ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bíipú dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō í cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu alɔ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí, í yá aá italā nɛ̄hi ohígbū íhó nɛ̄ aá hɛ́ ka aá ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bíipú dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī bū okómpinu kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā ga ipɔ́ɔnū eyīpú ā. Ó lɛ okómpinu ā mīya, ó kē wɛ ɔdā ékpónú mɛ́mla aókómpinu ɔhá ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a géē yá um lɛ ā, méyīnyinyi um kú ā lɛ um ŋmó igbo ékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ ń gáā yɔ̄ ī má ɔplɛ́ca lɛ ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā alɔ yɛ gaajɛ Urejíyum. Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ɛdɔ owu éyi, nōo ŋmá ɛháajɛ ā, gbɔɔ́ ō tá, anɔ́ɔ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄ci ɔ́mpa ā alɔ gā Uputéyoli.

eng_Latn: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ gē límanya eko dúúmā nōó lɛ ácihóo tá. Īkpēyī kú nū kē ī cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnɔ nōo ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā n lɛ okwúukwu kú um kwajɛ lɛ Ádā alɔ nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, anɔ́ɔ é tá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā, é kē kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī nɛ̄ Óndú ā mafú ā ipéēyī ójīla ā. Upɔ́lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā le ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā kpó nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ɛ̄cī dóódu ipú inu nɛ̄hi kú Utáyīrānɔsi.

eng_Latn: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ inu lígíí éyi gwó kwu ɛyí inu kú alɔ ā lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ kwú agōdō, úgādā, agege ú kpó tá ɔ̄ mɛ́mla utébulu éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ó gā amānyā kóō wā í gbɔga anú.

eng_Latn: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ odije ɔlɛ́ ōhī le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū kóō lɛ uwá yá ubatísim, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Utíca, ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ í yá gɛ.

eng_Latn: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē kpó abɔ̄ ce ɛna ā ɛyí ipēyī Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
idu_Latn: Aígbómína kú nū igwɛ́ɛpa ā gē bī ɔdōlé gé lɛ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā gē bī ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɔdōlé ɔyā éyééye.

eng_Latn: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
idu_Latn: A bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ le yá aúklɔ́ idáagó mɛ́mla aɔ́dōōcābɔ̄ alɛwa nōo tū ācɛ Íjīpiti ufi, anɔ́ɔ a lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ uwɔ kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ajɛ Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu nyā gē pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ā, ɛdɔ ɛbɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ alɛwa mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi dúúmā géē lɛ oyēeyī. Ohígbū ka éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu nyā í nyɔ̄ í je éŋkpɔ̄ kú ísu nɛ̄hi kú ɔmā ā yá lɔhi. Ɛga dúúmā nōo gē pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ā, ó gē bī oyēeyī gé lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēe yá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ā tíne kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, ohígbū ka ɔfú yɔ̄ í bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔ́ iyē yɔ̄ í hɛ́ odúúdú uwā tá.

eng_Latn: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
idu_Latn: Ubenáya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyāda nōo ŋmá Ukábsɛ́lu ā klla wɛ ipú aícɔ́ɔ́ja olɔtū nɛ̄hi ā dúú. Ó yá ɔdā kú ɔtū ōlɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ó ŋmó aótrɛ̄yí ɛpa kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Umówābu ā. Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko ɔgwā nɛ̄ ofū gē ŋmó nɛ̄hi ā, ó le tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ gaá le ágábá éyi ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ híī yúufi ŋ́, ɔdí nɔ́ɔ má ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā ka anúɔ má alelékwū yɔ̄ í wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ oŋmá eko kpiíí ŋmá abālɔbányā gɔbū ā, é géē je ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
idu_Latn: Úmúlá nɛ̄ ɔnya kú uwā gáā tá ā, ó géē klá aá bá ajɛ. Uya kú ɔnya kú uwá mla ɔnya nēe ba ī pi úgbɔ́nya kú uwā ā, géē bá ī jíla ɔdɔ kú aá iyē, abɔ̄ é bá ī bū ɔwɛ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú aá bá ī kpó aa yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɛka kú aflɛ́yí ā lɛ íne kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā mɛ́mla ɛga o gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ipú ɛcɛ nyā dúú.
