eng_Latn: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu ka anúɔ gē cokónu ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ́ yēeyī, nōo kē cɛ̄ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé ā. Ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɔ́ɔ géē lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ínoōbīya ā, ɔ́ɔ géē kwú. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ɔ́ɔ kóō wɛ ɔyí anúɔ, Ujonátan nááná. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tá ɔɔ̄ ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
idu_Latn: É bá ī nyi okwū kú aɔ́kplá kú uwā nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó ŋmó ā. Oŋmá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá nyā, ó le mafú lɛ uwá ka anúɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ dóódu kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
idu_Latn: Lɛ ahɔ̄ jē gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ohi tá um, ɛ̄jɛ̄ ōwē le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ōwē nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē má ā géē je uwá pīya aójɛɛ́lɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka, Nyɔ̄, n géē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ɛga oligbó ligbó ga ɛgiyí aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Eko gē wā nɛ̄ n géē yá okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda ā jīla.

eng_Latn: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa nēe gē yímabɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔkpá kú uwā kpó tɔ̄há, lɛ uwá tɔ̄lá iyɔ̄bū ācɛ dóódu. Eko nēé lɛ ije nēé lá aɔ́kpá ā gbaáluka ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛkpa égō nɛhɛ́ ofɛpa cigwó ā.

eng_Latn: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔɔ́ ō yá únwū kú ācɛnyīlɔ nɛ̄ apī kú uwā nwuné lɛbɛ̄ɛka apī kú ijakī, nɛ̄ e ī tá iyē láyí bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔbá ɔnya ā.

eng_Latn: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú uwā nēé hī ka, Uhabóna ā da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Uháman yɛ jāā gaá lɛ ákanaba nɛ̄ olicō kú nū wɛ ikpó ofɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, bū tū ɔlɛ́ nū, lɛ ogbló pīya cílá anú ɛyí kóō géē je Umɔ́dɛkāyi, nōo nya oyēeyī kú ɔcɛ́ tá ā, tōoli playi anú dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́da je kahíníī, Aá lɛ Uháman abɔ̄yī nū tōolī playi anú.

eng_Latn: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēe bá nyā í nwū odée ŋ́ nɛɛ? É wɛ aógwuda lɛ ā nɛɛ? É bá yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um éjulúgwu piyóó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá ī gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
idu_Latn: É géē bá í nū alɔ inya jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ pɛ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwá. É kē í gbɛlá ka, alɔ ɔ́ɔ bá í kwu hɛ̄ aá tá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ kwu aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
idu_Latn: Igbɛ alɛwa, é gē gbō ɔ̄ ikpó mla abɔ̄, amáŋ ó gē kpó agbá ā hɛ́ eko dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ odó ā kpó ca ŋmá iyīnu ikpó. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lɔfú jɛ̄ nōo ī bī ɔ̄ bá ajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó abɔ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi da ɔ́mpa nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ a má ipú ɔ̄na nyā gáā yá gaá kwu āa? Eko nyā nɛ̄ íne ō bīya ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā géē kwɛyí ɛya okpaakpa nēé gē gwó lɛ Óndú ā ɛ̄cī dóódu ā í ŋmɛ́yí āa? Eko nyā nēé géē lɛ ikpó da aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tāajɛ í gaá kwu āa.

eng_Latn: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé ka ipú Íne ā í ka ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí gwū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu nū igbɛ alɛwa ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ mīyɛ íne nōo lɔfú ka uwá gwó mla Ɔwɔicō glá nɛɛ ó lɛ ā a ayíka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē yēeyī piyóó oŋmá lɛ o lɛ íne ā tū.

eng_Latn: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ɛgiyí okómpīinu kú inu ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́ɛ, bī oje lɛ ɔ́ ahɔ̄ bū, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā piyóó ipú oyēeyī kú nú. Ó ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú uwā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu iyó kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, inu okpíyótū kú ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū ā: Asmáfɛ̄ti, ɔyí kú Adiyélu. Ɛga okpó iyó ohile kú ɔlɔ́cɛ́ tū ā; Ujonátan, ɔyí kú Usíya.

eng_Latn: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō yá ucē kpaakpa dúúdú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā gē yá ucē kpaakpa dúúdú ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le ayípɛ̄ ā hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá jɛga lɛ ayípɛ̄ kéē wā ɛgiyí um. Aá híīī ci uwá o wā ɛgiyí um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayípɛ̄ nēe bá nyā lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
idu_Latn: Ɛlífāasi ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛhɔ̄. Uwá bá yɔ̄ á: Utéman, Ómaru, Usɛ́fɔ, Ugátam mɛ́mla Ukɛ́nāsi.

eng_Latn: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nāa lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nwūla, a lɛ ɛgbá kú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe yēeyī ā yá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
idu_Latn: Aá hɛ́ ācɛ odoōcē tá, aá hɛ́ ācɛ nēe gekwú eyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Aá yá ká ācɛ olagwú kéē le yá yēŋēē. Aá nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ. Alahá nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ŋmá ɛga Ɔwɔicō á, aá kē je lɛ ācɛ alahá.

eng_Latn: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, é jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ɔtū kú Óndú ā ŋ́, é jɛ́yí ojuju kú Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́. É kē jé ka ɔɔ́ lɛ aá túbá kóō yá aá italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē tú ɛ̄wɛ̄ igwu bá kéē wú ɔ̄ ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áyísīki kahíníī, Lɛ ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔdōlé ā bī gé um ká um lé. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ lé kwɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔdōlé ā bī gé lɛ ɔ́, klla le ejé bī gé lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá dúú á.

eng_Latn: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ojɔ́dā lɛ eyī kú nū kwu ɔdā kú íjééyī, amáŋ eyī kú olíla gē yɛ ga ɛga ɔhá kú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aólagwú ā le pɛ́ wā okónōgwu kú aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Usiríya ā, é le pɛ́ tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ éyi. É le ɔdōlé má, anɔ́ɔ é le lé klla le gwá. É kpó ije nɛ̄hɛ́, ije ɔdɔ, mɛ́mla īlī. Anɔ́ɔ é le aɔ́dā nēé wu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ kpó nyɔ̄ í tayínū á, anɔ́ɔ é klla le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ kpɔ́. É le pɛ́ tá áklɔ̄kpɛ ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ é kē le ɔdā éékpónú ɔ́ɔmā yá kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
idu_Latn: Ó gē fíyɛ́ ojuju mɛ́mla ula kú ācoyúula ā ákátā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ abɔ̄ kwú ɔdā dúúmā ipú ula kú uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, aá cēyītīkwū kú ɔlá kú aá kóō fíyáajɛ iyɔ̄bū ācɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má úklɔ́ olɔhi kú aá, kéē cɛ̄tra Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, lɛ alɔ nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Asírīya, cɛ́ɛ́ ka odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ kéē géē le jé ka, awɔ Óndú ā, awɔ ōfōōfūwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
idu_Latn: Ubenáya klla ka ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā humáyī yɔ̄ mla Ágábáidu ā, kóō yɔ̄ mɛ́mla Usólōmɔn lɛ ā dúú, kóō lɛ ofu lé fíyɛ́ ádā nū, Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
idu_Latn: Uwá le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Ubálam, anɔ́ɔ é ka, Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ kahíníī, Ɔdā dúúmā kóō híī ci uwɔ oōwā ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a géē lɔfú lɛ ɔtū yá ékpónū, nɛ̄ uwēyī í gáā yá uwɔ ŋ́. Ufi dúúmā í klla gáā yá uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
idu_Latn: Lɛ italā yá uwā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā. Lɛ uwá yálé ipú íwɔ́tū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: A géē ŋmó ije nyā ɛlɛ́ɛ́lá, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ aɔ́bɛ́ɛna, ɔyí álá, omlede, ejé mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kpó lá. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ɛyí ede kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
idu_Latn: Alɔ le tá úgbéenyi ŋmá Utrɔ́wasi anɔ́ɔ alɔ le yɛ kpaakpa le tá Usamótrēsi, anɔ́ɔ oŋmáɔ́ɔ̄cī nū alɔ le yɛ tá Unēyapólisi.

eng_Latn: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ uwá bá ī yá ɛmiyɛ nɛ̄hi ā, n géē yá ucɛ lɛ uwá. É kē í lé, klla í gwá ejé kóō le uwá kwú nēé í bá ī gwéeyē. É géē gbiyɔ̄lā nēé klla gáā héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā glá gbógóōō ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
idu_Latn: N kwú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēé bī gé um ā ú kpó lɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā piyóó. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwā nōo le yēŋēē lɔfú lé.

eng_Latn: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe wā í yɛ ɔwɛ ā ge cíla okwúlu tū aá. É gē tɔ́ɔcɔ́ klla ī mī ɛyí jigijigi tū Ujerúsālɛm. É gē ka kahíníī, Igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́ mā nōo klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ āa? Odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ gwéeyē ohígbū Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ ede gwó ɛyí ɛfu kú Ébalu lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
idu_Latn: Ébrahām da Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ka Íssmɛ̄lu kóō wɛ ɔyí nōo í lúgwū kú um mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ okónu nyā ce lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mla íne, kóō wɛ ɛka nōo yɔ̄ piyóó lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
idu_Latn: É le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ gaá je okóohō ɛpa ámāŋ ka ɔklɛbɛ́tɛ ɛpa gwɛ́ɛya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nēé ka ipú íne kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā klla kahíníī, Ífi alɛwa géē yá aá ce ɔhɔ́ɔ́há.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ ikpó da ágábá ɛyí báajɛ ámāŋ ka o lɛ ikpó da ogwiji bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
idu_Latn: Uhélesi nōo ŋmá Upélēti ā. Íra,ɔyí kú Ikéssi nōo ŋmá Utékōwa ā.

eng_Latn: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
idu_Latn: É tá ɛma kú uwā nyā, eko nɛ̄ Ujótam, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, cɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla Ujérobōwam ɔ́mpa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
idu_Latn: É géē tū ɛwa kú ācɛ okónu ká e tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwɔ. É klla í bī aɔ́kpacaŋgelī kú uwā je uwɔ hɛ́ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ.

eng_Latn: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ iháyí ofu cɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ nyā á. Ó kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā iháyí éyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Atálīya, ɔyínɔ̄nyá kú Áhābu, mɛ́mla ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Ómri, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ Umikáya hīgwú bōōbū á.

eng_Latn: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya, ícɛ nyā n lɛ íkwu je ga uwɔ lɛyíkwu odúúdú aéwo mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́. N le uwɔ fu ká ā fu uwá ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ, ká ā klla wúla uwá tāajɛ. N le uwɔ fu ká ā kpó uwá yíífi, ká ā klla lɛ uwá bī wāajɛ. N klla fu uwɔ ká ā gwó uwā, ká ā klla yá kéē jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄kā da uwá kahíníī, Aá dɔɔ̄kā kú um lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā hɛ́tá lɛ aá nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
idu_Latn: Óndú ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, anúɔ géē je ucē kú ācɛ pīyabɔ̄ ga ucē nōo le yēŋēē, nɛ̄ odúúdú uwā í bī lɛ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ anúɔ ōfōōfū anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ é gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ó keé géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anúɔ ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Utáyítɔ̄si Ujɔ́stɔ̄si, nōo ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā. Ɔlɛ́ nū yɔ̄ kwu Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ́ɔ ā, ó po ɔdā nōó tōō ka tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́, aɔ́dā nɛ̄ okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu í ka ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujóssuwa ɔyí kú Unún mɛ́mla Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ ōfōōfū uwā yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nú, aá cɛ̄tra anú. Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ɔ̄ ohi ŋ́, ohígbū kēé bá gē táafu mla iyī uwā ɔwɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ipú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
idu_Latn: amáŋ Ɔwɔicō ka ālɔ̄ híī lé īkpō kú ɔcí nōo kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ó klla da alɔ ka ālɔ̄ kōō híī lɛ iyē kwu ɔ́ ŋ́ o yá ka alɔ híī kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nya uwá tá kahíníī, É wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ. N kē jé cāā keé gáā já um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwōkónu, aá le ɛyí cē gbaajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ēpū ácí ā. Aá klla gē nā īlī ekwu klá ajɛ gē fú ewo klá anú kú aá gwutá ɛyí nū. Ɛdɔ okónu nɛ̄ aá ī gwū nyā í he um ɔtū á nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
idu_Latn: Ó jé cāāā ka anúɔ í gáā kwu ŋmá ipú unwalu glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ó jé ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɔ́ɔ bī ɔkpacāŋ́gelī yɔ̄ í gbēyī nū kóō je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nōo kwɛyí alɔ nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ahi nɛ̄ alɔ kwú ā kwú ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Ebilíi lɔfú tīyē le yá kóō lɛ íne bīya ɔwɛ dóódu nōó lɛ já alɔ má ā, amáŋ ó kē bīyíne ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD's priests.
idu_Latn: Ó le ka lɛ Udéfīdi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu je ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ā kpó ŋmó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya kahíníī, Óndú ā kɛlā nyā gā um, bōōbū nɛ̄ Ujehóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosáya je pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē ŋmó klla í je oyēeyī á, anú gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū klla í je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū á.

eng_Latn: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu gbɛlá ipú ɔtū ka anúɔ lɛ Udéfīdi bū kwu ɔdɔ ká mɛ́ɛ̄ n. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú óbō ā ú le ɔ́ tá lɛ Udéfīdi igbo ɛpa á. Amáŋ Udéfīdi kē fɛ̄fú hīla lɛ ɔ́ igbo ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, aá híīī junwalu lɛ īyī aá ɔtū lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ óócí géē lɛ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka óócí lɛ unwalu alɛwa ákú abɔ̄yīnū. Unwalu kú ɛ̄cī dóódu jɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Ó cɛgbá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í je unwalu kú ɛ̄cī ɔhá kwu ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n pīyeyī má aɛ́cí ā, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í nwū ācɛ ɛlā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í kē cīla ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ n da uwá ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
idu_Latn: Ugásam, Úsaa, Upásīi.

eng_Latn: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni dóódu nōo le nyɔ́nyí í gáā gwɛ́ɛya gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro cɛ̄ ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bū ajɛ kú Ufilístiya ŋ́, nááná nōó le kpií ā. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le má ka aá géē kpɛ́fú ɔwɛ, é géē pīya ɔtū kú uwā abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú cīgbīhi ga Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lā abɔ́ɔ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā ka, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ohile ā bɛ́ɛ? Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka ádā uwā wɛ ā? Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwu akwukwú nēé gē kpó kahíníī, Usɔ́lu kwú pīya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ dúú nɛɛ? Aá.

eng_Latn: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ um, n bī iyē kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ihɔtū kú Alelékwū Ihɔ ā, ká aá lɔfú tū iyē nwuné nwuné, ká aá lɛ abɔ̄ fúlɔhá mla um kú ālɔ̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi, ipú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mpa, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
idu_Latn: Aókwū kú uwā géē bá ajɛ úláyi kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ɛga nēé je Óndú uwā nyɔ́kpá ā. Iyē ācīije kú igelī ɔ́ɔmā lé ka Usɔ́dɔm ámāŋ ka Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ! Ɔtū nɛ̄ a le ce Ɔwɔicō ā le uwɔ hɛ́tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le um nyatá ŋmá ikwū, le agīje nya ŋmá um eyī, ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá um lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ tá ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā nɛ̄ ɛgbá ɔ́ɔ ce ɔ́ abɔ̄ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya lɛ ɔkwu ɔdā nyā bū ā, é le jé ka Usámsin ɔɔ́ kē yá ɔdā nyā á, ohígbū ka ádā ɔnyā nū, ɔ̄cɛ Utímna ā, ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔnyā nū ú lɛ oklóbīya Usámsin. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufilístiya le yɛ gaá le ɔnyā ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā nū mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ ádā nū ā kpó yɔlá tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
idu_Latn: Aá, anyā nēe cīce ipú abahi gɔdɔgbɔɔ í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í kwú aá iyē ŋ́ mā, aá jegicō ka aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gáā ka ā.

eng_Latn: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá um, n kwú ɔtū ú kpóce Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā, ó klla gē je ɔdōgwá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka, n gbɔ́ɔ ō ka uwá, é lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɔjɛ kú ísu. Eko nɛ̄ n kwú héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā, n yɔ̄ mla awɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lɔfú klla lɛ ɔfú iyē tútū gáā kpɛfú tá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē yā klá uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā mɛ́mla ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi ā. Ó klla í kpó uwā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nōo ī cēnyi nɛ̄hi ī kpó ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā ō yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ gwó lɛ Óndú ā á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nōó gbā ohígbū ajɛ ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ōcē obɔ̄bí á mɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛya gwō gā uwɔ nááná, ɔ́ɔmā í kē wɛ ɔdā nōo ce uwɔ ɛgbá ā ŋ́. Ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú í kē wɛ ɔdā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ̄wū kú ugóolu yá klá anú. Olikpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛtá ce āyā, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da Árɔ̄ni kahíníī, Le ka lɛ ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē wā ajaajɛ gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Ohígbū koó le iŋini nēé ka ā pó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
idu_Latn: N géē bī oyēeyī ōlīkpō le cíla ɔ́ ulé, n géē nya ɔ́ tá.

eng_Latn: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, é hímáyī yá aá ōwē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē wú igwu mla ogbló ā, amáŋ ícɛ ā, n le ɔ̄kā olɔhi nɛ̄ n pó ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ tónū icííci ā.

eng_Latn: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka ā wɛ, ofigwó . Ācɛ nēe bá nyā jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu cíkā ō yá ā klla í yā ɔ̄ eko.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
idu_Latn: Ami ōfōōfū um wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gwū um tá gɛ ŋ́. Nááná nɛ̄ á jé um ŋ́ mā, odúúdú ɔfú nɛ̄ a cɛgbá ā, n géē je gā uwɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
idu_Latn: Kwú ije nyā ú lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū.

eng_Latn: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī ka ā yɔ̄ ā, ayínɛ́ um, ɔdā nōo lɛ ɔkpíye mla oyī í gáā lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā nōo ī kwú í gáā lɛ ukpɛ kú iyē nōó gē kwú ŋ́ mā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ujúdasi, oyíbīyājɛ ā, kē jé abɔ́ɔ dúú, ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū gē jīla abɔ́ɔ ojigógó.

eng_Latn: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lā ɔlɛ́ otīihɔ kú nū ā wɛ ádā kú ayókwū á, anú klla ī gbō anyōkwū ŋmá unwalu á.

eng_Latn: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Ébrahām lá ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ā, nēé nyi anú mɛ́mla Usára ɔnyā nū á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da alelékwū nōo ī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɛpɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Usétan, lɛ okónu klá cíí. Óndú ā nōo fu Ujerúsālɛm ā, kóō lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó uwɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛfú nēé nú ŋmá ipú ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɛlā ka cɛ̄ lɛ owu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ā á. Anɔ́ɔ owu gáā le tá ipú uwā, anɔ́ɔ uwá kwú kpó héyī, yēeyī klla cāŋ́jɛ háyi icō á. É lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi, nēe géē wɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja glá.

eng_Latn: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ohi ka anúɔ gē dɔɔ̄kā njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄, ohígbū ka ajɛ nɔ́ɔ je lɛ anúɔ ā wɛ ajɛ íkpákplā. Anɔ́ɔ Ukálɛ̄bu kwú ajɛ ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ nɛ̄ njɔlɔ bá anú ā ú lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā ipú igelī ā í lɛ ojīlīmā ce aɛ́nɛ́ aá mɛ́mla aádā aá ŋ́. Aá gē yá aúgbɔga nēe lā ipú aá ŋmó. Aá klla gē yá ayíyókwū mla anyōkwū ucē obɔ̄bí, ī pīya uwá tū.

eng_Latn: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upíta yɔ̄ ī ka ɛ̄nyā ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā wā í ce ɛyí kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ede ɛpa gwó bá ódúdɛ̄cɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbā aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū ā jōklóbīya klla lɔfú iyē, Ó kwɛcɛ yōlīī ipú ācɛ úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú nū ā, ayínɛ́ alɔ, aá le nwū ŋmá ɛgiyí alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē lā nɛ̄ ɔtū géē he Ɔwɔicō ā. N jé dúú ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī lā á. Alɔ bī iyē kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá klla tú aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū ka aá yá lɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N géē nyɛ̄ɛ, aá géē dɔɔ̄kā um, amáŋ aá géē kwú ipú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā. Aá lɔfú wā ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é habɔ̄ ánkɔ kú úgbéenyi ā tá ga ipú ísu, é kē lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá nōo gbō óci o pɛ́ úgbéenyi ā kpó wī. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú īlī nɛ̄hi ā ú púla, klla lɛ ɔ́ nāndaa ká owu kóō ga ipú nū kóō gbɔɔ́ ō kwu úgbéenyi ā ga ɛgiyí ɔjɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā tá kéē cɔ̄ɔnyā, amáŋ ka ɛ́ɛ ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē nuuunu nɛɛ, ó ka aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kéē lɛ íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyā nōó ma á nɛɛ, ó géē tēelihɔ ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛnɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ eko kóō nyílá kú ɔyɔ̄ɔ̄yā kú nū ā. Ó géē yɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ofɛtá ce ɛhīlī kpɔ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gáā gwu ɔ́ iyē ŋmá oyī nōo ŋmá ɔ̄ iyē ā á.

eng_Latn: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ayí uwɔ ohi nēé ma ga uwɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā, é géē je uwá kpó ga Ubálīlɔn, anɔ́ɔ é klla géē bá uwā udá nēé géē bá í yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn piyóó.

eng_Latn: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:
idu_Latn: É géē hɛ́ ɔdɔ kú nū mla ɔgba kú ɔcí éyi nōo í cɛyí ogba ɛtá kú ɛcɔ̄ dóódu. Ije nēé kē í bī le gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā gēe ŋmá Agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ­ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
idu_Latn: A í je ɔláwonī gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí, a klla i je oje ugóolu plɛ́kɛ́tɛ́ɛ́ nēé tá odée tū ɔ̄ ka, ákú Óndú ā kwu ɔláwonī ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ébram le tá Íjīpiti ā, ācɛ Íjīpiti le má ka ɔnyā ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi o má eyī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ mafú péee ka é géē jíla aɔ́dā néē yá ā iyē klla í kpó uwā ŋmá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aɔ́dā nēé jíliyē glá ŋ́ mā í báajɛ.

eng_Latn: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
idu_Latn: wɛ, úlá bá ɛga úlā ɛpa ce úlā ofɛpa ce igwó ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
idu_Latn: Italā nɛ̄ ācɛ alɛwa kú aá yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdā nyā jɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi tá ohi kahíníī, Odúúdú alɔ gáā nyɔ̄ á. Alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ nɔ̄nya, mɛ́mla aɛ́na, aálá, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā. Ohígbū ka alɔ géē yá ucɛ klɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Óndú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujeremíya, awɔ ā kóō cāŋjɛ ká ā le tútū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nyɔ gaá lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka gā uwɔ ā da uwá. Ā híī yúúfi uwā ŋ́, ámaŋ́ n géē tū uwɔ ufi nɛ̄hi ipéyī uwā.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ ācɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce úlā ɛhīlī ce ofigwo .

eng_Latn: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olɔtū nɛ̄hi ā bá í dɛ̄gba ī tíne otábɔ̄. Ācokwɛyí alɔ nēe bá ī tíne ō yá ɛbɔ́ ā bá ī jikwū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Udáni kē yɔ̄ pī aúgbéenyi. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa klá okónu ísu, é lā bá okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem yɛ ga ɛháajɛ. Ákú Umanásɛ kē yɛ ga ɛhícō. Ísu kú Umeditarénīya kē wɛ ɛjī kú nū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á. Ajɛ kú ācɛ Ássa yɛ ga ɛhícō kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ Ísáka lā ga ɛhícō kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó le bla ka é wɛ alɛɛcɛ nēe gē kwú icííci nɛ. É klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu nōo gē tá wā ī yɛ nōo ī mɛ tāajɛ icííci ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch:
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, Ubárūku.

eng_Latn: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ayí nɛ̄ Ulīya ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ajɛ kú Umɛsopotámīya mɛ́mla ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā, Udáyína ā. Ayí ā tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyā ā wɛ ofu cigwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aígbáanɔ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā lé ŋ́ mā bá yɔ̄ á: ɔgɔ, ēpū.

eng_Latn: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́háti ā wɛ ayí kú Ámram, Ísīha, Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Usíyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla da Ujonátan kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó cɛ̄ ayíka ó gáā ŋmó um ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó kwú cɔ̄nū, le jé ka ó le tútū ō ŋmó um.

eng_Latn: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo gē fíyaajɛ ipú obū lɛ ācɛ olɔhi ā. Ó ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ, ó gbonɛnɛ, ó klla ī hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔdā nēé bá ī ka ā pó ā, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, kéē nyɔ̄ í da ācɛ kú Ujúda ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē wɛ ācɛ ámōōmɛ nēe gē bī anúɔ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā cigbīhi wā agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú anúɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, alɔ habɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu tá gbɔɔ́ ō yɛce uwɔ ɛɛ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ kē í lɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
idu_Latn: Ó pīya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tū ŋ́, Ó wī ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā uwī ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nēe bī gáā ce ɔ abɔ̄ ā, ó gē je kwúcē lɛ óndú uwā. Ó gē je ɔdōlé lɛ aógbɛhá klla lɛ īlī tū ācɛ nēe tá ohɛ́ɛwa ā ohí.

eng_Latn: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ úgla kpó gē lɛpɔ̄bí kú ínoōbīya, úgla ō kpó kē wɛ ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā je ajɛ ā lá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ piyóó ŋ́, ohígbū ka ajɛ ā í wɛ ákú aá ŋ́. Ó wɛ ákú ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ. Aá kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka éwɔhá nēé jɛga lɛ aá ká aá hɛ́hɔ́ ipú ajɛ ā nɛ n.

eng_Latn: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ a géē da ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ kahíníī, Ká n̄ kwú ɔjɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo tá uwɔ ipú eyī ā ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ ígbɔ́ɔcí kē tá awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ eyī āa?.

eng_Latn: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ami yá ka ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ká ō tū ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ufi ā. Amáŋ é géē je anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, klla í kpó uwá nyi ipú únóji gáā bá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēé wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
idu_Latn: É gē da ācɛ kú uwɔ bá ajɛ, Óndú, é ī pīya ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú uwɔ ā tū.

eng_Latn: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nyā géē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ ā nōo í wɛ ákú ɔcɛ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔcɛ́ ā kóō klla pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tū gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ó ī mā ajɛ ohile ā tá lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlamu ā mɛ́mla aódɔlɛ́ cɛ̄ lɛ Ujɔ́ni le ubatísim yá uwā anɔ́ɔ o bū ipú ɔwɛ nyā é lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábna lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn kahíníī, Awɔ cíkā ō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ nyā á. Lɛ okónu ce mɛ́mla um, ká n yá ká ā kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, nōo leyīkwu agbénú kú ɔkpani nū ā, le aínyankwūlūmī igwó kú ɔkpani nū kpó, mɛ́mla ɔdā ō je yá ɔnyā ɛhi dóódu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔkpani nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ le yɛ tá Umɛsopotɛ́mīya, igelī nɛ̄ Unáhɔ lā ā á.

eng_Latn: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā, Óndú ā lɛ ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki yá ádā nū oŋmá lɛ ayínɛ́ nū ofɛtá cigwó nōó kpó ŋmó ā cila anú.

eng_Latn: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ī lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ pi ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Udéfīdi da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Ujɛ́būsi ā géē je pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Usérūya gbɔbū ɛfú á, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ nɛ̄hi, ɛ̄cī nēé géē gwōkónu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gaá yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Aá géē lɛ íne nyā tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unún mɛ́mla Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ, ācɛ ɛpa ŋmá ipú ācɛ o bɔkwu ɛlā tayínū ā le īlī kú uwā híla tīiyē ohígbū ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aótrɛ̄yí ká aá o ŋmá o yá ɔdā nēé da aá ka aá yá ā. Ohígbū kéē gē mlɛ́nyɔ́ ō leyikwu aá ŋ́, ohígbū kéē géē kɔ́kɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é leyīkwu aá lɛ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá é géē yúklɔ́ kú uwā mla éeyē, ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá ŋ́, é géē yúklɔ́ kú uwā mla ɔtūnōbí, ɔ́ɔmā í kē gáā tīle lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ɔ́ɔ le ɔcɛ́ tū lɛ iyī uwā, anúɔ í kē jé ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́. É bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ le íkpékwīja ma lɛ iyī ūwā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē je kpó yíífi ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, géē nyɔ̄ mla aá. Ó kē géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá í yá aólɛlā kú aá lé.

eng_Latn: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa gēe tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄ ka e kwúcē wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú āje la uwá a. Abɔ́ɔ á aéwo ɔhá kē í wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, kē í ba i gbā Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ̄gbā. Ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu aɔ́fiyɛ a, Ísrɛ̄lu gēe kwú ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwá dúu. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē í wɛ ɔcɛ́, klá í gbō ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ yá uwá lé, klá ya uwá ŋmó a.

eng_Latn: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí nēe gē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja ā gā ɛgiyí Umósīsi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kɛlā gā um gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī, Aɛ́jī kú ajɛ nēé géē kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bá yɔ̄ á. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujófɛ̄fu géē lɛ āyā ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá ɔtū kú nū nōo gbonɛnɛ ā nōó yá alɔ ŋmá lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ le pīya īkpō aflɛ́yí kú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá á.

eng_Latn: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ōwē má nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō kpɔ́, ɔ́ɔmá gē cābɔ̄ ka aá lɔfú bū ipú ɛdɔ ōwē dóódu glá.

eng_Latn: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́ɔtā nɛ̄hi kú uwá nēe lɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā, é géē pɛ́ kwú ŋmá ajɛ ā gáā hile kɛ́tɛ̄kɛ̄tɛ̄. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Isrɛ̄lu ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
idu_Latn: ipú ajɛ kú Uhamáti eko ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ɔcɛ́ ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ uwá gɔ́ abɔ́ɔ klla lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā í kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ga ajɛ éwɔhá á.

eng_Latn: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
idu_Latn: Inu ɔ́ɔmā gáā kwú oŋmɛ́yí kú okómpinu nōo kwu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ajaajɛ ā. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú oŋmɛ́yí ánáánūmā kú nū ā wɛ umíta éyi.

eng_Latn: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
idu_Latn: Má ɔɔ, Ɔwɔicō wɛ onyatá kú um á, N gēe lɛ ɔtū oōkpóce, klá í lɛ ɔtū ce ɔɔ, nɛ n gāa yá ufi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Óndú a, Ɔwɔicō a, anú wɛ ɔfú kú um mla ijē oogwo kú um á, ó kwú pīya onyatá kú um dúu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kpani, aá yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nōo cíkā lɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá. Aá bla ka aá abɔ̄ aá kē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ Ɔkpani kú aá nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔtūce ɔfú kú uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō. Awɔ gē gbō um á, Ɔwɔicō kú um.

eng_Latn: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le īlī kú nū híla, ipú ɔtūnōbí, klla kwú īlī ekwu ú tá klá iyē. Anɔ́ɔ ó yēkwu kú ɔyí nū ligbó ajɛ nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
idu_Latn: Aflɛ́yí kú ɛlā ā, é da um ka aá le kɔ̄ ígwíígwu nēe bá ī bɛ̄yíkwu iyī aá eko nɛ̄ aá gē jīla ipú icɔ́ɔci. N kē gbɛlá koó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ācɛ nēé tá iyē kú uwā tū ipú ɔkpá kú oyēeyī gbɔbū nēé yá ɛcɛ ā ōfōōfū uwā í gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ má. Ɔkpá ā wɛ ákú Ɔyí álá nēé ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, úklɔ́ ō kpó ācɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wi ŋmá unwalu ā, kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ uwā kéē kwú pīya éwo kú abɔ̄yī uwā kpɔ́ ā, í nwuné ce uwɔ abɔ̄ fúlufúlu ŋ́. Amáŋ n géē je uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ lɛ aéwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka a lɛ ɔfú kú um nōo ī nya ācɛ tá ā bī ga odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
idu_Latn: Aíne, ɔ́da, ukɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdōnwū nēe bá ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
idu_Latn: ācɛ olɔtū kú uwā nɛ̄hi ā, gaá kwú okwū kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū ú kpó ga Ujábɛssi. É kwú uwá ú kpó nyi ɔkwu ɔcí kú óoku éyi, klla lɛ okónu gwū ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gā ɛgiyí um igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Je eyī gicō ká ā má ɔdā ɔhá nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ le hɛ́ um iyē ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n húmáyī gbēyī ká ā nya um tá ā. N kē lɔtūce ɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
idu_Latn: Íne ɔ́mpa nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ɛ̄nyā ā, ɔ́mpa kú aá kóō he aá ɔtū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá he iyī aá ɔtū ā. Ó lɛ íne dúú nōo fíyɛ́ íne ɛpa nēe bá nyā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú āda um kahíníī, Kwú usiléeti nɛ̄hi ā ú ká ā lɛ ɔkpá tá tū ɔ̄ kplɔkplɔ kahíníī, Umáhá-Ssalál-Hassabasi.

eng_Latn: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ɛ̄nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú aéwo, ɛdɔ kú ācɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ o ka ucē dóódu gē yúúfi nū klla ī fīyégbúlú iyɔ́bū nū á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄ nɛɛ, ó gē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó. Ɔcɛ dúúmā nōó tíne kóō yēeyī, ó gē yēeyī. Ó klla ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ó kē ī je uwēyī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
idu_Latn: Ucē obɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú wɛ ukpa nōo gē kwú ɔ̄ á. Ukpa kú ɔbíipú nēé gē bī piíí ā gē kwú uwā á.

eng_Latn: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ, je íjééyī gā um, ká n̄ jɛ́yí aɔ́dā nāa gē nwū ā.

eng_Latn: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um, n gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ká n̄ lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
idu_Latn: Íkplí mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā.

eng_Latn: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
idu_Latn: Tíne ɔkpá kú Óndú ā, ká ā jé ɔ̄ ká ā má ɔ̄. Odúúdú uwā í bá abɔ́ɔ piií. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā kē í lɛ ɔbá ámāŋ ka ɔnyā uwā piií. Óndú ā lɛ ɔ́da je ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ á ɛɛ́, Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū je ɔ́da á, alelékwū kú nū kē kpó uwá wā í bá tɔ̄há abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n kahíníī, Ká Urúbɛ̄n kéē yēeyī, nááná nēé lɛ ɛwa ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ádā um yá ajɛ kú aéwo ɔhá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Iní nɛ̄ aɔ́wɔ kú aéwo dóódu nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā bá, nēé lɔfú nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú um glá ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
idu_Latn: Ugóolu ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́cɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nēé hī ka óniks mɛ́mla ɔdā okpóocu nōo ī ŋá nēé hī ka udélīyum bá ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ gaá da ɛpā ɔ́ɔmā kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ, n klla yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ācɛ tá ŋmá ōcē ícɛ mɛ́mla ócí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛcí ɔ́mɛtá ā, n géē yúklɔ́ kú um kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja ā le ɔ́da nēé je lɛ uwá ā yá gaajɛ. É kwú Upɔ́lu ú le ɔ́ bī jāā ga Antipátrīsi otú.

eng_Latn: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō yíihɔtū tá aá piyóó klla gbonɛnɛ lɛ aá. Ami abɔ̄yī um kē í yá aá lɔhi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá nyā.

eng_Latn: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā nɛ̄hi éyi nɛ̄ ācɛ Ukréti gē hi ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi eko nɛ̄ ó kahíníī, Ācɛ Ukréti wɛ ācɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄ piyóó, lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí obɔ̄bíipú, ācɛ ujúlu nēé bayi ce ɔdōlé piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācɛ ulífāyi ogwɛ́ɛya da odúúdú ācɛ ā ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ahɔ̄ je lɛ aá, uwá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pó ɛlā kú aá. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla da uwá ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ kwú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛ̄nyā má ā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ka o gbájí tū iyī wā ikpó ŋ́. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ jé ɔwɛ kú nū. É gē cēgbɔɔ bū ipú ɔbā bɛ̄ɛcɛ. ɔdā dúúmā í ŋmó ɔwɛ tū uwā ō bū ɔbā ā bɛ̄ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
idu_Latn: Ayíka, Óndú ā géē tá alɔ tónū piyóó nɛɛ? Ó klla gáā ményinyi alɔ igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olagbénú ā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga awɔ ádā um, Ébrahām ká ā lɛ Ulásārɔ̄si tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ ádā um.

eng_Latn: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
idu_Latn: Oyúnwū odée, ma ayí nɔ̄nyā ɛpa. Iyē kú uwā ɛplɛ́ɛpa lé ka. Je gā um. Aɔ́dā ɛtá ámāŋ ka ɛnɛ bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā, nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ ɔdā ō lɛ í jɛ̄ uwā ŋ́. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á:.

eng_Latn: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
idu_Latn: A lɛ ōhī kú aílī kú uwɔ ā kpó le yá aíkpɛ́cí kú uwɔ ifa. Bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ā, a ī cɛ̄ ī gwutá mla ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo wā.

eng_Latn: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ō lɛ acá ɛpa nēe kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ nēé hī ka Ucérūbim ā, háyi ɛhícō kú ikpati ā, cɛ́ɛ́ acá kú uwā gbobobowú ce ɔ̄wū kú ikpati nēé hī ka ɛga oōyājɛ kú eyīnyinyi ā. Abālɔbányā í wɛ eko nɛ̄ alɔ ī kɛlā liyɛ́liyɛ́ lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā éyééye glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Utáya ōhī lā Ujerúsālɛm, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛdɔ iyō dóódu kpó wā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi gáā je kpó lá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛ̄cī Usábāti.

eng_Latn: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ aólíla yá um ɛbɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ he uwɔ ɔtū á gáā yɔ̄ í gwéeyē eko nōo lɛ ɔdōōbɔbí yá ŋ́, ámāŋ a géē gwéeyē eko nōo lɛ ɔdā okpaakpa yá.

eng_Latn: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó géē mafú ka n wɛ idáagó ohígbū kóō géē da aá ɔdā dúú nōó í pó ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā.

eng_Latn: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dóódu kú ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lé á. é ké í lé ɛbɛ́ ā ɛga otīihɔ ā, ohígbū É fi koó tīihɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Arawúna mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛnɛ bá ī wā ikpɔ̄dā ɛɛ́ nēé má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le kwu gaá tayínū á.

eng_Latn: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé kóō lɔhi klla ī kɛlā ɔkwɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ipú uwā fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí kú ujē nɛ̄ ó tīile ŋ́. Eko ā gā ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ Óndú géē yá ācɛ ā italā ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó pi uwá ahɔ̄ bū okónu kú ācogbāajɛ nēe wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Abālɔbányā é le gbájí.

eng_Latn: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā, ucɛ ā gbɔɔ́, ó kē ī lé ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ aá gáā lé á.

eng_Latn: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī usábāti éyi, Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ éyi.

eng_Latn: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
idu_Latn: Ɛliká nɛ̄é géē lɛ ogbló nōo géē bī utébulu ā wu ɔ́ ā kóō kwu ɛgiyí akā nōo ce okónu nū ā ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛpa gwutá agōdō tɔ̄há, iyē géē kwɔ́lá tū iyī uwā iyē. Amáŋ, abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú géē gwutá lɛ nɛ̄ iyē géē kwɔ́lá lɛ ɔ́ lɛ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le hídáagó á. É klla kahíníī, Ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nyá yɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ owu mɛ́mla úgbagwú kú ísu gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ āa.

eng_Latn: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū, ó gē yá ɔbá nū lɔhi, ó gē yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogbāálá ā lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ka lɛyíkwu ɔyípɛ̄ ā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá aɔ́wɔ kú oje ugóólu ámāŋ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā tɔ̄há mla um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
idu_Latn: Ó géē pó ɔkɔ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, nēé lɛ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ó kē í tá uwā ohi.

eng_Latn: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
idu_Latn: Aá kllɔcɛ́ kú aá yá ucē olɔhi, Aá má ka ācɛ gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa. Aá tá ācɛ nēé bá ī yáŋmó ā abɔ̄. Aá cɛ̄pɔ̄ anyōkwū mɛ́mla ayókwū.

eng_Latn: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Aá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ nōo wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, húmáyī wɛ ācogbāálá ŋmá eko ayípɛ̄ kú alɔ jāā kwu ícɛ nyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ wɛ ā. Ɔwɛ nyā géē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá bá ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn á. Ujósɛ̄fu kɛlā nyā ohígbū ka ācogbāálá dóódu wɛ ɔdēelihɔ lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu Unáfutāli kahíníī, Óndú ā le ɔhā nɛ̄hi hɛ́ ce Unáfutáli, oŋmá lɛ o téeyīyolɔhi kú Óndú ā. Ajɛ kú uwā yɛ ga ɛháajɛ, ŋmá ísu kú Ugálílii ā.

eng_Latn: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Elísa mɛ́mla Udéfīdi háyi kli ipú ācɛ Ufilístiya abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ é nuunu tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā yálé á.

eng_Latn: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka okónu nōó ce ā wɛ ɛbéelihɔ nēé nōó lɔhi ō je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā géē bī ɛbɛ́ ā gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē nīipú ɔdā nēé yúnwūnū ā, abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī lé kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é pi ɛlā kéē nyɔ̄ í tíne nū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó le uwēyī kú uwá yá. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ uwá nēe wɛ ācɛ ofɛpa cigwó a le yɛ gaá tíne Ɛláyíja á. É tíne nū ɛ̄cī ɛtá amáŋ é má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ oolɛɔhi a mla ūpū a gēe je kpó yá ífi dúúdú, ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ōcē ooŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē je ɔ̄cɛ yá ífi a.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē je odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī tɔ́yī nɛ̄hi kú Ɛlam, nēe wɛ ɔfú kú nū ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
idu_Latn: ámāŋ koó le odée nōo bí ā pīyɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā, le ɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gbo ka anúɔ í pīyɛ ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
idu_Latn: É le ukafután ā gɔ́ lɛ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ jé kéē kwú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́, ó gáā kwú gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́. Ikwū í klla lɔfú dúúmā ɛgiyí nū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi kwú odúúdú oōmiya kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá lɛ ā, kwu inu okpíyó tū ɔ̄ kú nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ínu kú áklō kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ínu ɔhá dóódu kú nū, ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē je íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bīya yá ɔ̄cɛ ɛhi ā í lɛ Usólōmɔ̄n á.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwutá mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ kú ɔnyā nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē kwúcē igbīhi gaá le mlɛ́nyɔ́ iyɔ̄bū kú Upihahírɔ̄tu, ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Umígidɔlu mɛ́mla ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, iyɔ̄bū kú Ubálu-Uséfɔn.

eng_Latn: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ayíkpó kú nū le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, lɛ odée lé ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
idu_Latn: Lā ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwɔ, klla géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ. N géē je odúúdú ajɛ nyā gā uwɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ. N géē le okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ádā uwɔ Ébrahām ā tū.

eng_Latn: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í cɛgbá ɔkwu ɛlā dúúmā ō bu ɛ́ɛ́ kóō je ɔcɛ́ éyi tá ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ kóō klla je ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá cɔcɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó gāa mahayi iyɔ̄bū um cííí. N yɔ̄ gē má odée, n plla eyī tū ɔ̄ amáŋ n jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ éyi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé le tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́, amáŋ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ā tóhɛ́ɛwa péee, klla tɛ́ɛcɛ áncā ikpēyī kú nū. Anú ā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ alɔ í kɔɔkɔ kú uklɔ́ kú alɔ iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda ɛtá, nēe pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gaá jīla mla uwá ɔwɛ ā wɛ: Ɛlíyākim, ɔyí kú Uhilkíya. Anú gē leyīkwu agblɔ̄cɛ́ á. Ussɛ́bina, nōo wɛ ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpa kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Mɛ́mla Ujówa, ɔyí kú Ásāfu. Anú gē leyīkwu ɔdōōtátāajɛ dóódu kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
idu_Latn: Unówa mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū, mɛ́mla anyā ayí nū le pɛ́ ga ipú ɔwú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ipú ífi kú éŋkpɔ̄ o cēenyi nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kéē kwú anúɔ ú tá ijaló gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi ā géē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā hɛ́ ā, n lɛ íkwu je lɛ uwá kéē bī ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n géē tū ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gé lɛ Usísa.

eng_Latn: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Oyī nōo bá okómpinu ā géē wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nōo géē mafú ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ aá bá ā. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ oyī ā má, n géē hɛ́gla aá, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá aá, eko nɛ̄ n géē ŋmó ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ úlā ahāapa cofigwó kú Ujúda ā le tá ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú Étam ā, gaá da Usámsin ka ɔ́ɔ jé ka ācɛ Ufilístiya gē gbō aá déēē? Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá aá yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin tá uwā ohi ka ɔdā nēé yá anúɔ ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ yá uwā á.

eng_Latn: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Kwú ohɛ́pa o hile kú īlī ā ú playi igbīhi kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtú, amáŋ ó yá bɛ̄ɛka aádáádā nū Udéfīdi ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó yá bɛ̄ɛka Ujówāsi ádā nū ā.

eng_Latn: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é má ɔdā dúúmā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́ má. Ohi nōó tá ā le hɛ́ uwā idáagó, anɔ́ɔ okónu í hɛ uwā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le da um ɛ́ɛ́ ka n lé ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō pīyɛyí bū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n bū wā ā ga ɔlɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwú iyī uwā í pīya aólɛlā kú um áncā nɛ̄ ń yá uwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, le lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ nōo klla gē wɔ́tū um áncā nɛ̄ um yá uwā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā le lɛwa nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.
idu_Latn: Urútu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ gbonɛnɛ lɛ anú, nááná nɛ̄ anúɔ í kōō gaajɛ éyi kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú nū ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Aá kwú ɛ̄nyā ú lé ícɛ ohígbū ka ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī usábáti kú Óndú ā. Aá gáā má ɔdōlé ā dúú ajɛ ícɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ikakí kú īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ gɔ́ lɛ uwá, kóō ŋmá ohi gaá kwu átákwū ka uwā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē má ohɛ́ɛwa kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ɔtu kú uwā kóō le yá ékpónú ipú ucē nēé ī yá ā. Ɔ́ɔmā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá géē bá ī lɛ ojīlīmā ce um piyóó, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le lɔhi lɛ uwá, mɛ́mla ugbɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, Ujékɔ̄pu he um ɔtū, amáŋ Ísɔ í he um ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó he ɔ́ ɔtū, nōó mīyɛ owu kú nū nōo ī je oyēeyī lɛ alɛɛcɛ ā kwúcē.

eng_Latn: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujábɛsi le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce anúɔ, ka ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄hi je lɛ anúɔ dúú. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mɛ́mla anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ anúɔ gbō ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ í jé ɔnɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā nōó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ nū ā yá lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa da ācɛ ɛpa nēé tɛ́hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í jila ajɛ ā kahíníī, Aá ga ɔlɛ́ akwuna ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cokónu lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uféro tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Aá kwáahi íbí, aá í klla dɔ̄ɔka ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá wā gaá da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ le ɛga je lɛ aá kú aá nyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá á.

eng_Latn: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ híī habɔ̄ ucē kóō tū iyī alɔ bá tɔ̄há ā tá ŋ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o le pīya ucē kú ācɛ ōhī ɛɛ́ mā ŋ́. Amáŋ ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtū tá aɔ́mpa alɔ ɔtū, ofíyɛ́ dúú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé ka ɛ̄cī ā le bá ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā ā nū ga inu, anɔ́ɔ ó le óbō gwū uwā ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa bá ajɛ á. Oŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá nyā, ōcē obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá kwɛyí ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɔkpáncō gaá cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā le ɔyí ma dúú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Ubenámmī á. Anú wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
idu_Latn: Á cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú um kéē kwú um ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é kē yá um lé jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
idu_Latn: O ŋmífī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma um ā, awɔ nɛ̄ n gboló ce á. Ŋmífī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma um ā, awɔ húmáyī wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um á.

eng_Latn: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
idu_Latn: A gē jila anú ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu, klla ī jé ɔ̄ má eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka anúɔ klá ɛyí ɛfu ɔ́ɔmā ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ tɛtɛ klá eko kú ákú aflɛ́yí ā. Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ anúɔ igbɔhá kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kpó uwā yíífi gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
idu_Latn: Ó le igá kpó hɛ́ tū aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda eko nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā. Iháyí alɛwa ó kpɛ́fú mla ɔcɛ́ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɛbɔ́ je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
idu_Latn: É géē lɛ ikpó da ɔdā nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí ogwéjé kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ́ kú nū ā bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ipú ɔdā dóódu, ohígbū ka ɛnyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē tíne ŋmá ɛgiyí aá nēe wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ayááyí uwā kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā nēe í wā igbīhi uwā ā mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe ŋmá ɛga oligbó ā, géē má ka Óndú ā le ɛ́kɛma mɛ́mla ōwē bī wā í klá ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī nɛ̄ aá géē yúklɔ́ á. Amáŋ, ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá cíká ō yúklɔ́ ŋ, nɛ̄ aá í le tū lɛ Óndú á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ úklɔ́ dúúmā yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, é géē ŋmó ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ okpɛ́fú kú aá ā, kéē bēhé ga ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, Óndú ā géē wɛ ogbénjūwā kú uwā á. Ó í kpó ɔfú kwu aólɛlā kú alɔ klla í nuunu tá uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó lɛ uwá yálé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n kwú aéwɔhá ā ɔkwu ú fu ŋmá ajɛ ā, n géē ményinyi uwā. N kē í kpó aéwɔhá ā kwúcē ga ipú ajɛ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo klá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nyā kpɔ́, ɛfú géē lé ɔ́, ámáŋ ka ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí géē ŋmó ɔ́ɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nyā, gáā cɔ̄nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn, nēe bá í cīíbɔm tū igelī nɛ̄hi nyā abālɔbányā ā, é kē gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ikwū ā, ó géē wi.

eng_Latn: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú nū kéē túkpɛ́ɛ̄ iyɔ̄bū nū, kéē cɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ, nōo gē fu owu kú oyēeyī ā le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa kéē lɛ ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn ā kpó gé lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da uwá ka ɔdíyá ɛɛ́ nɛ́ɛ plla aá ā? Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ da aá ka, aá lā ɛga olígbó, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ kē lā ajaajɛ amānyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ bá abɔ́ɔ yɛɛ ā, alɔ le iyó kú alɔ tútū, anɔ́ɔ alɔ le yɛ tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyá ā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí kú umángolo lɛ ipú aɔ́cí kú ūpū ohile ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cohumɔtū ā lɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛnyīlɔ ohile á. Ó he um ɔtū ká n cīce obobowú kú nū, īkpō nōó ī gwá ā lɔnyɛ tū um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um le wu klá icō. Ɛ̄cī dóódu n yɔ̄ ī móōwē gbóōgbóō.

eng_Latn: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
idu_Latn: N hī uwɔ igwú Óndú, n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ kahíníī, Aá tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɔtūlé! Aá tú uwā ɔtū lé!.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne kóō yɛce um, ayíka kóō leyī gwū iyī nū bónū kóō kē kwú ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú nū ú kóō yɛce um.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le gwutá mla ɔmáapú ádā nū ámāŋ ɔmáapú ɛ́nɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā, uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa géē móōwē kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
idu_Latn: odúúmā kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā í gáā yēeyī kóō ga ɔlɛ́ ā ŋ́. É le ɛgahi kú um mɛ́mla úklɔ́ o hídáagó nɛ̄ n yá Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ipú ígbíli ā má, amáŋ é le um jámá igbo alewa, anɔ́ɔ é klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ áluka kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yálé ā ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja lɛ ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yálé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Ádām klla lɛ iháyí úlā ɛpa ɔhá lé. Ó lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
idu_Latn: Ó ca aɛ́ga olɔfú ā tāaje klla kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ yíífi. Ācɛ gē yúufi, klla ī bɔ̄kwu klíiyē eko dúúmā nōo lɛ oji tū.

eng_Latn: Then spake Haggai the LORD's messenger in the LORD's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhágāyi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā, ka Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ mla uwá.
