eng_Latn: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā le íne bīya abɔ́ɔ ikɔkɔ nēé gwɛ́ɛya okpaakpa kú ɛ̄cī dóódu ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔwɛ kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā tēelihɔ. Ajī nyā le yálé ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, é klla lɛ ɛlá wu ɛlā nɛ̄ ó gē nwū uwā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
idu_Latn: Aá túblá Ɔwɔicō, ó kē í túbla aá. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ kú aá na, ācobīyíne. Aá lɛ ɔtū ká aá tū yēŋēē ācɛ o leyīyɛpa.

eng_Latn: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā ōhī kú ígwu kú alɔ wā í lɛ alɔ ɔtū wuklíicō ofúlɔ̄cī mā. É le tá unóji kú nū.

eng_Latn: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó kpó ayí uwa ŋmó ŋ́. Ɔhígbū ka, ó yɛce ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ipú íne kú Umósīsi kahíníī, É gáā je ayí kpó ŋmó ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ádā uwā bīya ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē je ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ŋmó ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ayí uwā bīya ā ŋ́. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē kwú ikwū kú íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā dóódu nēé ba ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Íjīpiti ā, é le kpó lɛ uwá. Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le kpó agbénú kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, anú nɛ̄ ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ le yálé ā.

eng_Latn: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mahāapa ā lɛ opo kú nū tá, anɔ́ɔ n pó aɔ́kɔ nēe bá ī kɛlā gbōmgbōm ipú ɔkpáncō. É kahíníī, Ɔfú nēé gē bī le gbō ɛcɛ ā wɛ ákú Óndú alɔ mɛ́mla ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōó fu ā abālɔbányā, ó kē í cɔcɛ́ eko dóódu piyóó.

eng_Latn: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú nēé gē kpó ímíyóŋjō kú oje, udɔ, ugóolu mla oje nɛhɛ bá ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā. Íwɔ́tū mla ɔnū kú um í je uwá ja, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá kú útuló ī je ímíyóŋjō kpó ja ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra klla kahíníī, Anɔ́ɔ okónu ísu nēé hī ka Aháfa ā, n le ɔ́da je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā, ké­ē lɛ okónu gwū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, kéē tá īyī uwā wāajɛ ipéyī Ɔwɔicō, kéē ba Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ, mɛ́mla iyó mɛ́mla agbénú kú alɔ gbō ga ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū géē he uwɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka a ī blakwu ɔdā nēé gē nwū ā, nāa klla ī bī okónu kú uwɔ ī ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ glá.

eng_Latn: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma nēe lā Ukɛ́riyat Ujeyarím ā, Íttrīti, Upúti, Usúma mɛ́mla Umissra, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usóra mɛ́mla Éstāwolu dúú á.

eng_Latn: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga ā ɛgiyí ayínɛ́ um. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um je um bɛ̄ɛka éwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
idu_Latn: Éyi kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ́ má, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ka lɛ Ujówābu ka anúɔ le Ábsālɔm má playicō ɔcí, nēé hī ka ɔcí kú óoku ā.

eng_Latn: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ ī lé ŋmá abɔ̄ uwɔ ā, alɔ bī ɔ ulé ō má ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í nyá uwɔ ojīlīmā kú uwɔ ŋ́, Ágábáidu. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ágábáidu, alɔ gē da ɔcɛ́ ka.

eng_Latn: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ géē yēeyī piyóó ā wɛ kéē jé awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, é kē jé Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nāa tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
idu_Latn: Ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā, n géē hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe lɛ íkwu ikpɛ̄yí kú uwā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē hɛ́ úkplākā nēé ī le cíla ɛna ɔkɔ kóō hɛ́hɔ̄ ā. É klla gáā wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú aéwɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
idu_Latn: Unatánīyɛlu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Itíca, awɔ ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á. Awɔ ā wɛ Ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ga Ugílīlɔtu nōo kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ajaajɛ ā, é le ede ɛnɛ̄hi nōo klla lɔhi nɛ̄hi éyi gwó abɔ́ɔ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē bēhé ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
idu_Latn: Ágábá gē tōoji ipú ūpū icííci, ɔ́dāŋ koó má ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ó í kwú lé ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔyí ágábá gē ka ɔdā tɔ̄ɔkɔ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó kwú ɛbɛ́ dúúmā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn, Ugádi mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā, tá aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā ohi lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ gaá háyi ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kú aá gbɔɔ́ ō nwū ācɛ ɛlā lɛyíkwu oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nyā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē cɛ̄tra awɔ, ipú aéwo dóódu. N géē gwéeyē í cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklábɔ̄fú kú Usólōmɔn dúúdú ā wɛ úlā cofahāapa cigwó .

eng_Latn: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
idu_Latn: Efūma, é lɛ ɔcɛ́ nōo gē gbɔbū lɛ uwá ŋ́, amáŋ é kē ī kpɔ́ iyī uwā kwu ɔgbā ī yɛ tɔ̄há yíílí.

eng_Latn: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó gē jāhɔ̄ gā um ā, n géē hī iyē kú nū eko nɛ̄ n géē yēeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī je ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā í blakwu Ujósɛ̄fu gɛ ŋ́. Ó kwú mlanyī nū dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: É klla kpó ɛnwú, ēpū, aálá, ijē kú ɛna, gē lɛ Udéfīdi ka anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lé. Anɔ́ɔ é da Udéfīdi ka aá jé ka ɛmiyɛ mɛ́mla ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ācɛ ā, ɛ̄jɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ klla le jē uwā ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ lɛ uwɔ hīgwú wā ɔlɛ́ nū gaá lé ɔdōlé, anɔ́ɔ a lɛ ɔ́ ka ŋmó ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ ka anúɔ í nyɔ̄, lé ɔdā dúú nēé bī gé lɛ uwɔ ā. Á híīī dɔɔ̄kā ɛga nōó ŋmá ā ŋ́, ohígbū ɔtū ō junwalu gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya da ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu ɔcɛ́ ā kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ēpū kú ɔcí ufigi ŋmɔ́lá, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gba bá ínálēgbé kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Ó ka ínálēgbé ā ɔ́ɔ í je jé.

eng_Latn: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aá le pīya ɛdɔ kú ācɛ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Óhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ipú Umasɛdónīya mɛ́mla Ugríisi cíkā ō má gbla á.

eng_Latn: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Ó le ɔnyīlɔ éyi yɔ̄ nōo lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
idu_Latn: Ɔcí ujē mɛ́mlā ácí ujē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí géē bū ŋmá ajɛ ga uwɔ á. Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo bū ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ a gáā lé á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said, Alas, O LORD God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa kahíníí, Woóó, eléélelé. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔdíyá nāa kōō bī ācɛ ā bēhé Ujɔ́dan dɛ̄ɛ̄ ā? A bī alɔ wā ká ā kpó alɔ lɛ ācɛ kú Ámɔn kéē kpó alɔ yíífi nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā, alɔ í kē yɛyí bá ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan ā mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá habɔ̄ ɛfú ō kpó mla iyī aá tá, ká aá cɛ̄ ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Odúúdú aéwɔ ā gē cɛ̄tra um, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā gē ka ka ami ɔ́ɔ fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
idu_Latn: Ami, Uyáwɛ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā gē pi aá ahɔ̄ ka aá cɛ̄ ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla aógwɛ́bā nēe bá ipú ā kéē púla aá ŋ́. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄́na nēé ī ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ nā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā, nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē da ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ka owu okwɔ́lá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī tá klá uwá ŋmá ipú ígbíli. Ó gáā wɛ owu nōo gē tá ɛmɛɛma nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē tá igwu owu ipú nú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gē nwúleyīkwū wā í yɛ fíyaa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu gē tá wā í yɛ́ fíyaa ī bí tāajɛ ā. Ɔfú iyē kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ojibó ku ɛcí nɛ̄ ī gbɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
idu_Latn: Arawúna da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, kwú ajɛ ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ Óndú ā. Kwú aɔ́bɛ́ɛna nɛ̄ um gē le hɛ́hɔ̄ ā ká ā kwú gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā ō yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ā. Kwú úkplākā mɛ́mla ápɔ́tɔ́cí nɛ̄ n le wu uwá ɔkɔ gē bī hɛ́hɔ̄ ā ú dúú ká ā le gwɔ́ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ wɛ ipú ɛ̄nyā ā, ohígbū ka ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí í yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá ŋ́. Óndú ékpónú ā wɛ Óndú kú odúúdú ācɛ á. Ó kē je agbénú kú nū lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē ba ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́njamīn ma ayí ɛhɔ̄ gboce īyī wā. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á: Ubéla, Ásbɛ̄lu, Ahára.

eng_Latn: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
idu_Latn: Ɛlísāfan, ɔyí kú Usíyɛ̄lu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā á.

eng_Latn: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
idu_Latn: Aálá kú um ɔhá ā gē lé ácí nɛ̄ aá lɛ ikpó da ɔɔ́ tāajɛ ɔ́ɔmā, klla ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá bū gbɔdɔɔ ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
idu_Latn: Ń cɛgbá aɛ́na ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē cɛgbá opī ŋmá ipú aɛ́wū kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aákpá nēe lɛ efū gē wu, nēe lɛ ikpó fíyɛ́ ɛnɛ, wɛ ɔdēelihɔ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Usabéya wā í tū alɔ iyē, bī ɔkpacāŋ́gelī kwú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ í kpó ŋmó, klla kwú aɛ́bɛ́ ā í kpó uwī á. Ami ōfōōfū um kwu wā í da uwɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtū ká aá yéékpó, kú aá yúufi ŋ́. Aá híī yúufi kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya, ámāŋ ka aícɔ́ɔja kú nū nɛ̄ ó kpó tɔ̄ɔkwu ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ mla alɔ ā, nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ mla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
idu_Latn: Ó í je ɛfu nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kpó cīla tū.

eng_Latn: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ujúda, aá bī ɛ̄nyā wā í klá īyī aá á ŋmá lɛ ucē kú aá nɛ̄ aá yá ā á. Ɔdā olɔnɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī yá nyā wɛ ōwē kú italā nɛ̄ aá gē má ohígbū ɔbíipú kú aá. Ó kē ī kwú aá iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ ɛ̄wā gwū aá odo bēhé ā.

eng_Latn: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū nōo hɛ́tá kweé kweé okónū nū ā í gáā je lɔhi ŋ́. Aɔ́ɔmā gē bá abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ē wɛ ɛga nēé ī bu ɔmā ŋmá.

eng_Latn: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kpó ɛga olɔfú mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔfú yíífi.

eng_Latn: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
idu_Latn: Āyā kú uwā éyi, pīyeyī kwú ɛga nōo wɛ umíta igwó, nōo tá áncā yɛ pi Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Āyā ɔhá kē pīyeyī kwú úbɔ́ kú odúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. É gwó aɔ́lɛ́ ā ce ɔhá āyā ɛtá. Āyā éyééye yɛ ga igbīhi fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ce ɛyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ agbla kú Ɔwɔicō gē lé tɔ̄há mla ikpɛ́cí kú ācopɛ̄cí gɛ? Ohígbū ka alɔ ā wɛ agbla kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā á! Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ka ā. Ó kahíníī, N géē gwó ɔlɛ́ um ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. N géē lā mla uwā. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, é kē í wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugɛ́hási kwú ɔdōlé ā ú kpó ce iyɔ̄bú uwā á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā, é le lé, lɛ ipú nū, ɔdōlé ā klla hile kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā ka aá le íne kú nū bīya ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā klla gāá bá ī pā ojibó kú Ubáalu, ɔwɔ ɔhā ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo i kɛlā ŋmá ɔfú kú iyī nū, gē tíne owóofu kú iyī nū. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē tíne owóofu kú Ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ í yɔ̄ ipú oyēeyī kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, da ɔ́ ka ɔnyā nū géē má ka, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ da ɔ́ ā, kóō lɛ ɔ́ yá.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó lɔhi ō yá lɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gáā bī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā, wɛ ɔdēēlihɔ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔdēlihɔ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā gwɛ́ɛya ipéyī uwā, é í tá ɛcɔ̄ klá alɔ.

eng_Latn: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, É kōō jé ō yá ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́. É le iyó nēé nū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ abɔ̄fú ā, tīkwū klá inu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
idu_Latn: Agbénú nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú ā bá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ uwā. É gē bī ɔdā ō miya ɔdā kú újí ī le miya ɔdā. Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ɔdā nōo wú um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
idu_Latn: N jé gbojī ɛɛ́ ka, a tū aíne kú uwɔ ā, kéē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi, Árɔ̄ni, Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ofɛtá cigwó kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le tíicō ɛfu ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
idu_Latn: É gē yéeyī, klla gē yá abɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ, ō yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē plla ācɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
idu_Latn: Yá kéē le jé ka, awɔ ofōōfū uwɔ ā wɛ Óndú, nōo ī gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā bīya ā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē je íne nōó bīya ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Umu nōo hile ā wɛ ákú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ā.

eng_Latn: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cíkā ō pīya ɔyínɛ́ nū, ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, tū ipú ɛlā nya ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē yá ācɛ ó yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ tɛtɛ tū aá ukɔ́ lɔfúlɔfú ā.

eng_Latn: This image's head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
idu_Latn: Oje ɔdɔ nēé bī le yá ɛyí kú ojibó nyā á. Oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé bī le yá abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔtū kú nū á. Oje udɔ nēé bī le yá ohí mɛ́mla átákwū kú nū á.

eng_Latn: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe le ɛlā kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō pó nēé jɛ́ɛ́yī nū ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka aíkpō nōo hábɔ̄ í tá ɔtāhɛ̄ ɔwɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ā gaá lɛ ɔ́ nū ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú á, ń gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, é kpó aá, nēe wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, yíífi dúúdú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é lɛ opo kú ɛfú tá Ugíbēya, kéē lɛ opo tá Uráma, kéē lɛ ɛgba kú ɛfú dɛ̄ Ubɛtáfin. Ó ka ācɛ kéē ga ɔgbɛ́fú, ācɛ kú Ubɛ́njamin.

eng_Latn: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
idu_Latn: Adína, ɔyí kú Ussísa .

eng_Latn: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛlá kwu aógbɛhá ā bɛ̄ɛka ádā uwā ā. N klla ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ aúgbɔga eko nēé lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ō ka.

eng_Latn: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wɛ oklóbīya kú ācɛ dúúmā nēe gē yúufi nū ā. Ó kē í da uwá okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ yá, ámāŋ nɛ̄ alɔ bī le cílá Umɔ́dɛkāyi ulé kú ɔdā olɔhi nōó yá nyā ā? Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í yá ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ géē tū ɛdɔ ōcē obɔ̄bí ɔhá néē tá tū ɔkpá kú íne ā ŋ́ mā klá uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ kwú kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɛlā nɛ̄ ó í ka lɛ Ubálāki ā da ɔ́ á, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ubálāki kú ā lɛ ɛlā nyā da ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā. Ó klla le yɛ tá ikpó kú ɔ́bíipú kú ádā nū, Áhābu ā, mɛ́mla ákú ɛ́nɛ́ nū Ujɛ́sēbɛlu mɛ́mla ákú Ujérobōwam, nōó bī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ipú ɔ́bíipú ō bī tū Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
idu_Latn: N gaá je ɔdā dúú fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ayípōklóbīya nēe nyɔ̄ ī kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla um ā lé ā, mɛ́mla ukpɛ̄ kú ācɛ nēe ga ɔgbɛ́fú mɛ́mla um ā ŋ́. Cɛ̄ kú Ánɛ mɛ́mla Ɛ́sskɔl mɛ́mla Umámre kéē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā kpó.

eng_Latn: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noon day as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
idu_Latn: Alɔ bá ī yɛ lɛ abɔ̄ ma ɔdɔ bɛ̄ɛka opeyī ā. Alɔ bá ī tíne ɔwɛ bɛ̄ɛka opeyī nōó mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ mā. Alɔ bá ī lɛ ikpó gbaajɛ ī hɛ́ gadágadá ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ péee bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ bá ī yɛ ajoodobū ā. Ācɛ kú ipú alɔ nēe cíkā ō lɔfú kpɔ́cíí ā bá bɛ̄ɛka aókwū cɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my LORD, and I know not where they have laid him.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcɛnyā, ɔdíyá nāa gē jikwū ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ohígbū kéē kwú Óndú um ú, ń kē jé ɛga nēé lɛ ɔ́ tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi ka Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í kpó odúúdú uwā ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́ kú eyī kóō nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́ɔ má ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ mā? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ kē yɛ í lɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó kpó lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔkpá ōkwɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
idu_Latn: Lɔfú tīīyē ká ā yɔ̄ ī yá odúúdú imabɔ̄ mɛ́mla o pā aɛ́cí kú uwɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ. A kē húmáyī bī uwá yúklɔ́ ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwɔ ā. Ekōōhī, é lɔfú tá uwɔ abɔ̄, nɛ̄ a géē lɔfú tū aólɛlā kú uwɔ ufi kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdíyá ɔ̄ ágbe ɔtū mɛ́mla igbīhi yɔ̄ dúú ā, ó géē tá ohi ka, ágbe ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ yá anúɔ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aóklóbīya anúɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, aá lɛ ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú uwā dúúmā nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jé ɛɛ́ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó yá aínyílɔ́wɔ ā, ó le áluka nēé í wɛ ā miya táajɛ gbɔbū, ó kē le iyē je lɛ éyééye kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa nēe bī aócíbú ahāapa ā gā ɛgiyí um, gaá da um kahíníī, Wā cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ mafú ga awɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gáā yá akwuna olōofu nɛ̄hi ā italā ā. Anú wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nēé gwó kwu pī aísu alɛwa ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n tíne ká aá le jé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛnyīlɔ dóódu á, ɔbá wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ɔnyā nū, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the LORD: and Samuel cried unto the LORD for Israel; and the LORD heard him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu kwú ɔyí omlede nōo gē gwá amɛ̄ kpɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ mā ú, ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā, ohígbū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ó gbā ā pó á.

eng_Latn: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɛlá wu ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō pi uwá ŋ́ mā, habɔ̄ aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā bá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
idu_Latn: N da uwá kahíníi, Anyā éwɔhá nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn lɛ ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō á. Amáŋ anú lɔfú, le ojīlīmā klla fāajɛ fíyɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ kú éwo dóódu ā. Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi klla kwú ɔ̄ u pīya ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu, nááná anyā éwɔhá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ má gwōnū tá ipú íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
idu_Latn: Uhádóram, Úsalu, Udíkla.

eng_Latn: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
idu_Latn: Ábna pīyeyī má igbīhi, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Awɔ nɛɛ Ásāhɛlu? Anɔ́ɔ Ásāhɛlu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ami nɛ.

eng_Latn: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ká Uféro géē gbɛlá ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɛ́ɛ le jī bá ipú ígbíli ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
idu_Latn: Aá bla gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ? N da aá odúúdú ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka íne ā í yɔ̄ ɔkpancō ŋ́. Ka uwá ɔ́ɔ́ cíkā ō dɔɔ̄ka ka ɔnyɛ í gicō abɔ́ɔ gaá bī ɔ̄ wāajɛ gé lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá pó ahɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá mla ɔnyā kú ɛdɔ kú ɛbɛ́ éyééye le pɛ́ tá ipú úgbéenyi ā mla Unówa.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu, ācɛ Ulífāyi ā gē je ikpati ā gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā. Eko dúú nɛ̄ ó kwú mu, ɔmálɛ otɔ́kpá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā mla ɔ̄cɛ okwɛyí kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā gē le ije ā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó le ɔ́ gbaáluka klla kwú ikpati ā ú kwúcē ga ɛgīyí nū. É le ije nēé gē bī le yúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ nwuné ŋmá ɔwɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu ɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ Ussíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Upéka, ɔyí kú Urɛmalíya le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé dúú. Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ipú Usamérīya iháyí ofu.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: É ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ajɛ kú uwā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā anú ŋ́ nɛɛ, ɛ́ɛ̄ wā ipú ajɛ kú Óndú ā ɛga nɛ̄ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú nū kwu ā. É ke í je ajɛ lɛ uwá abɔ́ɔ ipú aá. Amáŋ kéē híī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā ŋ́. Ámāŋ o lɛ alɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ō yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā, ohígbū ede nɛ̄ aá nyɔ̄ í gwó kóō búla ákú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá iyē ā.

eng_Latn: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛnyā bá gē nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā, aóhī kú ācogbāajɛ ā kwúcē gā igelī ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe yá kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áhāsi pīyɛyí ŋmá Udamáskɔsi ā, ó má ka, Uríya ɔ́ɔ le ɛdɔ ede ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā gwó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔjá nēé ma ŋmá ɔmɛ éyi lá. O klla da um ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ aóhī kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā, mɛ́mla aóhī kú aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó tū ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ ojīlīmā je lɛ ayí nū nááná, anú ā í klla jé ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ keé kōō lɛ ayí nū tū wā ajɛ, ó klla jé ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
idu_Latn: Ó ka ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ̄cɛ ā klla wɛ Udéfīdi, nɛ̄ ācɛnyā ɛ́ɛ gē gwéeyē ohígbū nū klla í gwííjē ka Usɔ́lu ŋmó ācɛ úluulā, amáŋ Udéfīdi ŋmó ācɛ úlúúlā ɛga igwó ā.

eng_Latn: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
idu_Latn: Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā wɛ ɛjī kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n á. Aɛ́nyā wɛ, aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé je lɛ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn kéē wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, ɔyí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā, géē yɔ̄ mla ācɛ Ulífāyi eko nēé géē mīyɛ ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó nyā, nēé gē bī gaá yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi. Ayí kú Ulífāyi kē í kpó ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó nyā bá inu ɛga o kpó ɔdɛhi nyā tū kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ jé koó yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɛ̄ba ba ɔ́, alɔ jé kpɔ́cí ka alɔ í lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ gē ba ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe wā Ugíligalu ka ɛ́ɛ̄ bī ɔcɛ́ tá bēhé ísu ā, gaá jīla Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔwɛ okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ lɛ ɛlá ká ga uwɔ lɛyíkwu aíkpó kú aíkwu, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú klla lɔhi ō má lɛ a ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ íne nyā tū eko dóódu. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē mi éŋkpɔ̄ kú oōyá yēŋēē klá ɔ̄cɛ ā iyē ā géē na īlī kú nū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu éŋkpɔ̄ ā géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ alɛɛcɛ gē tíne ō yá ā gē bɛ́yí kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō tíne ká ālɔ̄ yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō tíne ká ālɔ̄ yá ā gē bɛ́yí kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ alɛɛcɛ tíne ō yá ā á. Alɔ alɛɛcɛ mla Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō wɛ aólɛlā, gē bɛ́yí kwu iyī alɔ, ɛ̄nyā í cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tíne ō yá ā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
idu_Latn: É le okónu kú uwā nwūla gbādāā lɛyíkwu um bɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo nwūla okónu yɔ̄ ī tū oji, gē tíne ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ó í fā lé ā.

eng_Latn: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ koó tíne ō mīyɛ ajɛ ā cīgbīhi lɛ uwá. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔwɔ kú uwā, Ukɛ́mɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá ā ɛ́ɛ bī ɔ̄. Amáŋ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá je lɛ aá ā, aá géē bī, klla í lɛ ɔ́ tū.

eng_Latn: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ɔpɛ́ kú ɛbɛ ōomá. Ɔdí yɔ̄ ī yá ā? Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ogwéeyé nū ɛyí inu kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ gē nyɔ̄ le bá lɛ Udamásikɔ̄si ā, ɛplá ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí, igbɛ ékpó ɔlá ōceyī nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɔkpáncō, le cɛ̄ jīla um tá.

eng_Latn: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔgba ɔ́mɛɛtá ā wɛ, Ujásínti, ágēti éyi, mɛ́mla ametíyīsti.

eng_Latn: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é lɛ ukɔ́ tū uwā ipú ɔ̄na kéē híīī pīyɛyí bū ɛgiyí Uhérɔdu ŋ́ mā ā, é kwúcē le yɛ ɔwɛ ɔhá ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
idu_Latn: Ó gē pi ébú klá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka īlī ō lɛ klá iyē gbiyɔ̄lā ā. Ó klla le ébú mī klá ajɛ tuúú bɛ̄ɛka ewo nēé le mī ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya da uwá kéē nyɔ̄ í da Ayisáya ka, ícííci ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ákanya yɔ̄ ī yá aá, ɔ́ɔ klla wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé bá ī yá aá italā. É ka uwēyī ɔ́ɔ lɛ aá kpó kwú. É ka éwo kú ɔlɛ́ aá ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā oyīpú nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú, nōó kē lɔfú gbōkwicii nōó gē mɔyí ā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ kú nū le jɛ̄ lɔfú klla kwú pīya okwutɛ kú ɔcɛ́. Ó jɛ̄ licō nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó gáā kwú ojuja glá. Ācɛ dóódu má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó bū ēpū klla jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē hɛ́ lɛ uwá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ɔ̄ lɛ yúklɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ka é kē ī gbɛlá ka anúɔ géē blakwu odúúdú obɔ̄bí kú uwā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ, íne nɛ́ɛ gē bīya nɛ̄ ɔ́ le uwá yɛ jīla tá ā tá anúɔ eyī péee.

eng_Latn: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄, aódahɔ̄! Aópeyī, aá plleyī lɔɔlɔɔhi ka á mɛ́ɛbɛ!.

eng_Latn: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu í jé ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó ma iyīnū fú lɛ ɔ́ jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē bēhé ga ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan gaá kpɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú agbénú kú alɔ lɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan amanyā, abɔ̄ Óndú ā ī gbɔbū ɛfú lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábāti éyi, Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ nōo bū ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dā. Abɔ̄ ayíkpó kú nū bá gē yɛ mla anú ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō cē īkpɔ̄dā ā lé.

eng_Latn: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé cíkā ō lɛ ɔtū ce ɔ́, nōo jéeyī, nɛ̄ óndú nū géē fu kóō leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, kóō je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá eko ā?.

eng_Latn: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
idu_Latn: É le īkpɔ̄cí kú ajɛ ā hɛ́, le bī abɔ̄ gé lɛ aá. Anɔ́ɔ é da aá ka ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá je lɛ aá ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā nēe gē gbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā wɛ ofigwó ce ācɛ igwɛ́ɛpa. É le iyē kú uwā tá tā ajɛ oŋmá lɛ aípɔ́lɛ́ nēé lā ā. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Usámūwɛ̄lu, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ je úklɔ́ nyā tū ádáádā uwā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
idu_Latn: Anú nya um tá ŋmá ɔlékwū á. Ó ményinyi um le ɔhā hɛ́ ce um.

eng_Latn: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.
idu_Latn: É le ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā hɛ́bū. Abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn le yɛ Ujerúsālɛm jīla tá nááná ā, odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujúda ā kwú pɛ kwu otú. É le kwu bū ɔwɛ kú ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ gaá kwú bū ɔwɛ nōo yɛ í kwu ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ é le kwu lɛyíkwu ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā ka ā, ɔtū nwula nwula gbo ō yá ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, éyi kú ipú aá géē yá ibīyājɛ tū um.

eng_Latn: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá kpɔ́ ó klla le ipú yɔ̄, le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá ma lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Usséla. Ujúda yɔ̄ Áksību eko nēé ma ayí nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n le mafu lɛ aéwɔhá ɔ́ɔmā ka iyē kú um nēe je uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ ā, í tōō le gbla iyē ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, é géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́. N géē bī uwɔ mafú lɛ aéwo dóódu, ka ń tōō le gbla ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé yɔ̄ ī gwū okónu klla yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā kahíníī, Aá habɔ̄ Ubánābasi mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu tá gā um ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n fu uwá kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujɛ́hōhasi dúúmā í hile fíyɛ́ ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya ofɛpa ce igwó, mla úgbɔ́ɔnya igwó mla aícɔ́ɔja īkpó úlā ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya kwú aóhile ā ú kpó ŋmó klla lɛ uwá nya tū ipú úmúlá.

eng_Latn: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú um kwú gbo ɛkɔ̄ mɛ́mla ipí nɛ̄hi. Aípí ā kwú kpó tū ifu, klla kwú hɛ́bū yɔ̄ í pɛ́ ifu kɔtɔɔɔ.

eng_Latn: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ é kōō ka ɛma kú uwā kwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu glá ŋ́ mā, wɛ ācɛ úlā ce ofu ahātá ce igwɛ́ɛpa .

eng_Latn: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá nēe lā ipú ajɛ ā gē tíne kéē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō da ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo tōō lɔtūce ā, ká n yá ɔdā olɔhi ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē ī gbo ɔkpá ā géē bī iyē kú ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo tōō lɔtūce géē le gbo ɔkpá ɔ́ɔmā. Unwalu nēe tɛtɛ yá aá ā mɛ ɛ, n kē kwú mlanyī kpɛ́mm ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Umíkīlɔtu, ádā kú Ussímēya. Ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lā Ujerúsālɛm kwu ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā ɔhá nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, tá um abɔ̄, lɛ um nyatá ohígbū ka a gē yíihɔtū um eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
idu_Latn: Awɔ a Abɔ̄yī uwɔ, leyi kwɛcɛ gɛɛ ohígbū Alesáŋda, ohígbū ka ó ŋmó olɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ okónu lɔfúlɔfú. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ́ le kpaakpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ okpaakpa ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ ŋmáaŋmaá ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ peke peke, yɔ̄ ī nyí ā.

eng_Latn: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
idu_Latn: Kwú omlede éyi í gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔhá ā ú gwɛ́ɛya ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu n gē ŋmó ɛna éyi, álá ɛhīlī, mɛ́mla ugwū alɛwa. N klla í he ejé ɛ̄cī igwó dóódu. Amáŋ abɔ̄, nɛ̄ n jé iyó mɛ́mla ákanya kú ācɛ ā, ije kú ɔdōlé nyā nɛ̄ n cíkā ō mīyɛ, nɛ̄ o kē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ami nōo wɛ igbómína ā ń da uwá kéē je ga um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē bī italā nɛ̄hi le já ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um má ká n̄ lɛ uwá yá yēŋēē, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē le oje tá ɔlá gē ja ɔ́ kéē na ɔ́ ā. Ohígbū ka, ɔdā ɔhá dóódu í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ n géē yá lɛyíkwu ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā, da ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka ā wɛ ɔdā nōo ka Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbā ā. ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ da alɔ ā, ó cíkā nēé gē ŋmó ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olohílípū olɔhi gē kwú ánya kú nū tū. Ó wɛ ɔdā ojīlīmā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō leyī gwō ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī yá ā bónū.

eng_Latn: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
idu_Latn: Aá kē cɛ̄ wā ɛgiyí um ká n̄ je oyēeyī opiyóó nyā lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Uséyɔ̄si nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū kú igelī ā bī ɛna nēé le o tátɔ̄há kú ododó tū uwā ɔkɔ ā wā okómpinu, anɔ́ɔ anú mla ɛwa kú ācɛ ā tínē kéē lɛ ɛya gwó lɛ ayíkpó ā.

eng_Latn: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma nyā géē lā ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nēé le tīihɔ céé, kú ɔdā ɛ̄gbā lɛ Óndú ā, géē wɛ ákú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwá ā wɛ, Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, Ussɛ́ba, Umoláda.

eng_Latn: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: É bá ī ka kahíníī, Aamí! Alɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ klla tá ɔ̄ ahínyá piyóó piyóó. Ohígbū koó jáglīmā nɛ̄hi, jéeyī nɛ̄hi, lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi, lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi, klla lɛ ɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
idu_Latn: Ipééyī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu abɔ́ɔ ā, Usólōmɔn nyɔ̄ gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū ede le abɔ̄ kú nū nāŋdaa kwu icō kóō gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her, Fear not; for thou hast born a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard it.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í kwú eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ma ɔyí ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī kɔ́ ɔ̄ ɔma ā da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔtū lé ká, ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ nɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī ma á. Amáŋ ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔnyā ā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē tá ɔ̄ ohi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
idu_Latn: Upíta tóohi kahíníī, Ó gē da gbóó. Eko nēé gā inu ā, Ujísɔ̄si wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo kɛlā á. Ó kahíníī, Ɔdī nɛ̄ a gbɛlá ā, Usáyímɔ̄n? O ŋmá abɔ̄ ānyɛ nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ nyā gē mīyɛ ulé, amáŋ ijɔ̄ɔ̄lɛ́ āa? O ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā kɛ̄ɛ ka ācɛ ewɔhá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, n yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā ɛ̄pīpɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā kōō yɔ̄ ī yá ɛɛ́. Aá mɔ́ɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ? N géē tá īkpāŋdrā bū ipú ígbíli, klla í yá ka ísu kóō pɛ́ ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī gbɛlá ka ogblábɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī uwā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bī le lɛ agbénú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi ā háyi ofūnū le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō, n tá uwɔ ahínyá ohígbū ka ń wɛ ɔ̄cuújí ŋ́, ń wɛ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ o cikpɔ́nyā ɔhá, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ohile ā ŋ́. N tá uwɔ ahínyá ohígbū ka ń lɛbɛ̄ɛka odɔlɛ́ nōo háyi ánūmā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Uhága, ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā kú Usára, nōo ma lɛ Ébrahām ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, a cɛ̄ lɛ éwo kú alɔ le nyīla ɛɛ́. A lɛ ɛjī kú ajɛ kú alɔ nyīla tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ āyā dóódu. Ɔ́ɔmā ā kē lɛ ojīlīma bī gé lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
idu_Latn: Ami ā wɛ Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyí ɔlɛ́ Upɛ́tūwɛ̄lu. Olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je gā um ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācōtɔ́hi kú Umídiya ā gāajɛ uwā ā, ayínɛ́ nū le ɔ́ pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú obugā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú lá īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofu lɛ ācɛ kú Íssmɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ajɛ Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
idu_Latn: Aákā nēe bá nyā wɛ ɛdɔ éékpó mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ n má bá ipú ɛbɛ aflɛ́yi kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō nɛ̄ ācɛ Udamásikɔ̄si ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usiríya bī ā. Ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ā, n géē yá uwā italā piíí, ń gáā habɔ̄ uwā tá ŋ́. É le ācɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di yíífi bɛ́ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē wú igwu mla ogbló kú oje ā.

eng_Latn: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
idu_Latn: Ó hī ācɛ ā igwú wā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá pó, kú aá kē jé ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: But Solomon built him an house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usólōmɔn gwó inu lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ōfōōfū uwā géē lé ɔdōlé otīihɔ dúúmā á. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu í gáā lé ŋ́, kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo lā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó le tá ɔlɛ́ ī gbā ijē lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá ā, eko nɛ̄ aá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, aá le tá inu eyīpú. Eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔwɛ gwū, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ádā aá, nōo yɔ̄ ɛga otayínū ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ádā aá nōo ī má ɔdā otayínū ā, kē í cíla aá ulé.

eng_Latn: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ agbénú kú oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé tōō gbaálūka mɛ ŋ́. Aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú nēé lɛ ā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kwū aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na ú kpó lɛ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa le ɛka gbo lɛ īyī uwā á.

eng_Latn: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá ā géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ɛyí ede ā eko dóódu, ó híī nyí gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
idu_Latn: N le tútū ɔkɔ kú um ō ka ɛɛ́, n kē jé ka Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄hi gā um.

eng_Latn: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā le uwā kpó ga ipú abahi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē kpó aɛ́na ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ga ɔpɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
idu_Latn: Óndú a lɔhi lɛ ācɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ klla lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛɛnɛ ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n géē nū aéwo bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū aá. N géē nyīla ɛjī ajɛ kú aá gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā mīya ajɛ kú aá ɛpléeko kú ucɛ ɛtɛ́trɛ́tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ aɔ́cɛ́ wɛ ipú ayínɔ̄nyā kú agbla kú uwɔ ā, ɔcányā ā kē māháyi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú akpa ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ bī ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ugóolu le ifa yá.

eng_Latn: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
idu_Latn: Ó le ogbló ā gba ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya le ugóolu ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ abɔ̄ aá gē yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyá ā, kú aá yɔ̄ ī ba Ɔwɔicō kóō tá aá abɔ̄. Ipú ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ aá bī abɔ̄ gē yá ā, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē lɛ ā. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, aá cīgbīhi ŋmá ɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá gē gbā ā ŋ́. Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, aá bēē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
idu_Latn: odúúdú ācɛ lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiyē ipu ɔlɛ a, ɔpu dóódu, mla ajīlɛ̄yí inu dóódu a, ācɛ ba i je ikwu okwū.

eng_Latn: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔtū nɛ̄ aá le ce ā kōō le ligíí bɛ̄ɛka īkpō ɔcí umɔ́stādi ā, aá lɔfú da ɔcí umúlbɛ̄ri nyā ka, Lɛ iyī uwɔ fu ŋmáajɛ tɛgba tɛgba cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā nyɔ̄ í kwú iyī uwɔ í kwu ipú ísu. Ó kē í yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ka ā.

eng_Latn: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́yī kú uwɔ lúlé, é ī bū odo kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ. Aéwo ā bá ī gwōnū iyɔ̄bū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi yá gā um, ɔdā dóódu í kē tōo le gbla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔdā nēé yá nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā, oyī kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēé je gwɛ́ɛya ā géē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ó kwú iyīnū ú gwɛ́ɛya okpaakpa lɛ Ɔwɔicō o ŋmá lɛ alelékwū nōo ī kwú ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ oyī kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē gwu ɔtū kú alɔ ŋmá aɔ́dā obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla uculo ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ gbā Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ajɛ kú Íjīpiti kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē ka ā. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú nū. Aá nwū ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē yɔ́tūnōbí lɛ ā. Aá nwū ácɛ́nyā aá ijē elihɔ nɛ̄ é í gwó ɛyíkwū ā.

eng_Latn: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
idu_Latn: Ɛmiyɛ gē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō yúklɔ́ lɔfú. O yá kóō lɛ ɔdōlé má lé, lɛ ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe jé Ujísɔ̄si lɔɔlɔhi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā nēe kwúcē ɔ̄ ŋmá Ugálīli ā, háyi ɛcɛɛcɛ kéē má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: É klá í bī ɛ̄wā kú uwá i je ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ a kpó ŋmó. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Itaya géē jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ga ɛga oligbo nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ aá kwú uwā í kpó lá lɛ ācɛ kú Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
idu_Latn: Ukélɛ̄bu, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ussúha, ma Uméhɛ ōfōōfūnū. Uméhɛ wɛ ádā kú Ɛ́sstɔn.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka n géē kpɛ́fú tá Ufilístiya, í je uwá yíífi. N géē kpó ācɛ Ukɛ́rɛ̄ti ŋmó, klla í je ɔdā dúúmā nē o hile yēeyī ipú ajɛ kú Ufilístiya ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ kú aá ā, ɔnyā dóódu í gáā plla ɔyí, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔnyā dóódu gē wɛ ɔdɔma ŋ́. N géē yá kú aá lɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā géē yá piíí, ohígbū ka, aá le yɛce ucē obɔ̄bí kú ɔcɛ́ ómri mɛ́mla ákú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, ɔcɛ́ Áhābu. Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē gɔbū gē yá dúú á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē kpó aá yíífi, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ géē lɛ eyī gla aá bónū, ācɛ kú ɛga dóódu í gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa bī abɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā? Ó kahíníī, Okwutɛ nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í gáā jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ŋ́. É gáā má ɔwɛ dúúmā ō kwu ŋ́. Ikwū ōfōōfūnū wɛ eyīyōce kú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n gā abɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́mpa nēe ŋmá Umasɛdónīya ā, ń tíne kéē wā í le jé ka ɔdā ɛhi kú aá í tútū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā le yá lɛ ā, uwēyī géē kwú alɔ nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ kpóce aá ā. Ó lɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ n géē ka uwēyī nōo géē kwú aá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.
idu_Latn: Utáma da ɔ́ ka anúɔ ā, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ í leyīkwu ācɛ eyī glá ā ohígbū uwēyī āa? Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anú ā bɛ́ɛ, ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ géē kpó okllúu tá ɔ̄. Ó ka anúɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, ka anúɔ jé ka ɔ́ɔ géē je anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyā.

eng_Latn: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēe yíihɔtū tá um ā n géē nya ɔ́ tá. N klla í gbō ɔ̄ ohígbū ka ó cɛ̄ ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
idu_Latn: Aíkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ajɛ kú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā kwɛyí ācɛ nēe le olɛhɔ̄ ā pó mīyɛ cɛ̄ mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́. Amáŋ ɛlā ā í ga ipú ɔtū kú uwā ŋ́. Ɛlā ā yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú uwā eko kpií. Amáŋ eko nēé le ojámá yá uwā kéē má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, é tá ka aá pó ɛlā ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔ́ má yɔ̄ ī wā ɛcɛɛcɛ ā, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē wāajɛ uwā ā, é le ujɔ̄ tū, le miya kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo ī cījáalí kú ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, nōo klla wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ nyā ā, kóō je ɛhi ŋmá lɛ ihɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá dúú. Owóofu mɛ́mla odúúdú íkwu kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo ī yíhɔtū alɔ, klla lɛ alɔ hɛ́tá ŋmá íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā ŋmá lɛ ikwū nōó kwú ohígbū alɔ ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē móōwē, ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, ó géē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ ā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
idu_Latn: Aá tá um, lɛ igbīhi cē kwu um ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n lɛ abɔ̄ kú um nāńdaa lɛ aá ca tāajɛ. Ohígbū ka ɛ̄jɛ̄ ō kwú íwɔ́tū kú um tū le jɛ um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lé ka Ananíyāsi lā abɔ́ɔ, ɔ̄cɛ o yúufi Ɔwɔicō nōo gē lɛ íne kú alɔ tū, ó klla kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā ka olɔhi nū.

eng_Latn: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
idu_Latn: Á géē yīīpú, géē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi. Kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu le iŋini ka ce ɔ́ ohígbū ɛlā nōó ka kahíníī, Ami ā wɛ igbō nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu lɛ ɛna, ámāŋ omlede, ámāŋ opī ŋmó ipú ɛ́ga nēé lā ā ámāŋ eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
idu_Latn: Ahíyam, ɔyí kú Usáka ŋmá Uhára, Ɛláyīfalu, ɔyí kú Úri.

eng_Latn: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cojéeyī ā kahíníī, N jé aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā klé klé, abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tíne ō jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ i hīlaŋdɔ́ anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ mla aídengéli ā lɛ ɔlá gwó, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē jɛ̄ ɔlá á. Upíta háyi pī uwā dúú yɔ̄ gē jɛ̄ ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
idu_Latn: Lɛ igá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā yá mla ukɔ́tin kú īlī onɛkɛnɛkɛ olɔhi, īlī kú owú nɛkɛnɛkɛ ā. Olīkpō kú ukɔ́tin kú ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā kóō wɛ ekābɔ̄ ofɛpa ce ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
idu_Latn: A kahíníī, N̄ gwutá lígíí ɛ́ɛ́, n̄ dē nākpaa ɛ́ɛ́, n̄ dē lɛ abɔ̄ gwɛ́kā cɛyí ká n̄ mlɛ́nyɔ́ lígíí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
idu_Latn: Itekwú nōo nwuné klla lɔwá ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ dúú. Ɔdā alɛwa, kwu ɛnɛ̄hi kwu ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ lā ipú itekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ odúúdú okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ uwá ā tū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó géē yá uwā italā dóódu lɛ á, ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛyítáajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a cīce gáā lé ɔdōlé mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi dúúmā, lɛ ɛlá kwu ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
idu_Latn: Upíta yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɛbɛɛbɛ, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī éyi ó gā ɛgiyí ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō nēe lā ajɛ kú Ulída ā.

eng_Latn: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
idu_Latn: N kē í yúklɔ́ ō hɛ́ ācɛ idáagó ipú ɔkpáncō ɛhícō, n klla í ma ɔdocābɔ fu ipú ɛcɛ ɛháajɛ ɔkpáncō, oyī mɛ́mla ɔlá mɛ́mla odúúdú géē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: ká a kwú uwá ú kpó gē um. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē mi ɔmā klá uwá, klla í je ɛbɛ kú uwá kpó yɔlá gā um dúúdú ká ō wɛ ɛ̄gbā kú um.

eng_Latn: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ofɛtá cigwó bá ɛga ahāapa ā wɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū kóō hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ̄ uwɔ mɛ́mla igelī otīihɔ ā tá ŋmá íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya ā. É géē je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi, klla í lɛ ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kwaajɛ Ujerúsālɛm. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɛbɛ nɛ̄ a má kú iháyí ofɛtá cigwó ā géē cɛ̄. É klla í je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kwaajɛ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í kɛlā lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ɔlɛ́ kú Ujáyírɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī leyīkwu ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, wā í da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyā ā gekwú ɛɛ́, á je unwalu lɛ utíca ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ɔ́ eko nɛ̄ ó kóō kwúcē ga Íjīpiti ā kpó ka lɛ Árɔ̄ni. Ó le ɔdā ō hídáagó nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kóō yá ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ipú aá eko dóódu yɔ̄ gē yá ká ɔtū kóō he aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ɔdā nōó dɔɔ̄kā kú aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ussáma háyi ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā kli, anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ kú Ufilístiya ā kpó ŋmó á. Óndú ā klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le aólɛlā kú uwā yálé nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ó lɛ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwā, kahíníī, É géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔyí um nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā.

eng_Latn: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē ca odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Udamásikɔ̄si ā tāajɛ, klla í kpó ācɛ nēe lā ɔpɛ́ kú Afɛ́n mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ubɛtɛ́dɛn ā yíífi. É géē kpó ācɛ kú Usiríya bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā ga ajɛ kú Ukɛ́ri.

eng_Latn: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka nááná nɛ̄ anúɔ le uwá bī jɛ̄, klla lɔfú tū uwā iyē ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ bá gē yá ojuju obɔ̄bí tū anúɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
idu_Latn: Ujámuti, mɛ́mla Enigánim, mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú uwā.

eng_Latn: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ lɔfú mīyɛ ɛlā nyā cɛ̄ gllá ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó wɛ ákú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá ofōōfūwā nɛ n.

eng_Latn: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔfú je lɛ ɔ́ kóō hɛ́pɔ̄, ohígbū kóō wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā gwɛ̄ɛlá hī íne kú uwɔ tá gbóógbóō ŋ́, ohígbū ka anú nāa bī le yá um nɛ̄ um yéeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ má.

eng_Latn: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
idu_Latn: Ó he um ɔtū ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ, ohígbū ka íne kú uwɔ he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tɛtɛ le da Umósīsi lɛyíkwu ɔdā ā. Umósīsi kē klla le da Ujóssuwa, anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa kē le abɔ́ fúlá tū ɛlā nēé da ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē le ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ā yá jīla á.

eng_Latn: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
idu_Latn: Da ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, nōo cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí Udéfīdi ā ka, anū mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ Ujúda nēe gē wā ipú agblɔ́cɛ́ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu ka abɔ̄ anúɔ géē yá ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ā Óndú? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ le pó, ɔ́ɔ géē je anúɔ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Kwu ɔyí omlede éyi ú bī nyɔ̄ mla īyī uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ káā da ɔ́ ka anúɔ gáā nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka, ɔdí nɛ̄ n gē má yɔ̄ āa? É bá ī kwinya cīgbīhi mla ufi ɛɛ́. É bá ī yá aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā lé, é kē báyī yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɛɛ́. Ufi í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá má igbīhi um. É bá ī kwinya cīgbīhi būū mla odúúdú ɔfú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he Íjīpiti nɛ̄hi, eko nēé le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú uwā ā, ohígbū kēé yúufi uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
idu_Latn: A gē nya ācɛ nēe tū īyī uwá wāajɛ ā tá. A kē ī tá ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
idu_Latn: abɔ̄ uwá bā í yɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne lɛ ā. É gē yá odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kéē yá ɛga dóódu ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka aá ī tá Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ klla ī gbā ɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī ka mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ī plla ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: N géē je ígblɛ́nyī kú uwɔ gɔ́ bá akpakó kú uwɔ nɛ̄ á gaá kɛlā glá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ á géē pi ācɛ o yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā ahɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā túblá okwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ ipú Ujerúsālɛm nōo yá umácíni ō tá ɔyī mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é gē bī tá ígbɛ́cɔ̄ ŋmá ɛyí inɔ̄ɔda mɛ́mla ɔ́kíkā kú ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le lóofu kwu ɛga dóódu á. Ó klla kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ o lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa le pɛ́ ta ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni kóō lɛ ubatisim yá uwá. Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nēe bɔ̄bíipú bɛ̄ɛka ɛgwā! Ɔ̄nyɛ̄ pi aá ahɔ̄ ka aá kóō kwu ŋmá italā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá ācɛ obɔ̄biipú ā?.

eng_Latn: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
idu_Latn: Unaára ma Ahússam, Uhéfa, Utémɛ́ni, mɛ́mla Uháahassatári lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɛlā nɛ̄ n da aá, Ɔfiyɛ í gē jājīlīmā fíyɛ́ óndú nū ŋ́ mā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē yá um ŋmó, é géē yá aá ŋmó dúú. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū ā tū, é géē lɛ ɛlā kú aá tū dúú.

eng_Latn: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
idu_Latn: N da aá ka aá gbɛlá kpaakpa ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyá cɛgbá fíyɛ́ āa? Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē ma ɛtɛ́ ā kɛ̄ɛ ka ɛtɛ́ nōó gē ma āa? Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú ɔdā nēé bī ɔmɛ ma ā kóō lɔfú da ɔ̄cɛ nōo ma ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ awɔ bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ma um ā ŋ́ glá āā? Kɛ̄ɛ ka ɛtɛ́ géē lɔfú da ɔ̄cɛ nōo má ɔ́ ā ka Á jé ɔdā nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄, ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ géē je dobū tū aá, nɛ̄ aá klla má uwá lɔhi gɛ ŋ́ mā. Nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē wɛ oōtū ipú eyī kú aá juu, eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu um bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá gē cɛ̄ klá ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ó gē yá um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ olɛlā kú nū fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ tú wāajɛ, a gē ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú uwā. Amáŋ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōó gē bī le hɛ́ uwā tá á.

eng_Latn: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá pó ka odóódu kú aɔ́wɔ kú éwɔhá, nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla aádā um je kpó yíífi ɔ́ɔmā, nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alɔ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɔtūce ka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɔ́ɔ géē nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alɔ gllá ā?.

eng_Latn: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ gā ipú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é ka ucē alɛwa, klla tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa ā kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nōo ŋmá Unásārēt kú Ugálīli ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
idu_Latn: Ujehōwāssi le Amásīya kwú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɔlɛ́ nū Ujerúsālɛm. Abɔ́ɔ ā ó gaá le ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm kpó wúla tāajɛ ŋmá okónu igá kú Ɛ́frem jāā ga okónu ɔ̄kíkā kú igá ā, ipéeyī Amásīya. Olīkpō kú ɛga nɛ̄ ó ca ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka uyádi ofigwó ā.

eng_Latn: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n kɛlā kú nū ka, Ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē wā igbīhi um, nōo fíyɛ́ um kɔ́ɔ́, ohígbū koó yɔ̄ gbɔbū gā um.

eng_Latn: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kócōō, pó ɔkɔ kú um eko nɛ̄ n hī uwɔ igwú. Ményīnyi um ká ā tá um ohi.

eng_Latn: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó wɛ ācɛ nēe jé íne ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je keé wɛ ācɛ okpaakpa ā ŋ́, amáŋ ācɛ nēe bī íne ā le yúklɔ́ ā nēé hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā, ó í bī aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄, aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú Ɛlíssāma, ɔyí kú Ammíhūd á.

eng_Latn: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
idu_Latn: Uhállōhesi, Upíliha, Ussóbɛ̄ku.

eng_Latn: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kwú aópī á ú kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú oyī kú nū ú pīya klá ɛyí ede ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ wɛ ɛya nēé gwó kú Óndú ā kóō je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi. Ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá kéē le ɛya kú ɔdā ō yɔlá dúúdú ā gwó kóō lɛ íne nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bīya ā kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo ī yá kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔtōōlé ā mɛ́mla o tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔtū kwu ɔtū ā kóō yá kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá kóō yá ɛdɔ ucē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛyíkwu aɔ́mpa aá.

eng_Latn: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
idu_Latn: Aá le da ācɛ nēe ī pā ɛcí ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ aɛcí ā yá ɛcɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́. É géē je kpó yíífi ŋmá ɛháajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ alɔ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā lɛ ofu alɔ pó ka alɔ yɔ̄ ī wā ā, é yɛ ŋmá ɛga oligbó bɛ̄ɛka Olihī kú Apíyɔ̄si mɛ́mla ɛga nēe í hī ka inu-ugbɔga ɛtá ā, gaá jīla alɔ ɔwɛ. Eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu lɛ uwá má ā, ó tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, ɛ̄nyā kē le ɔ́ ɔtū tū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ nū ŋmá ipú ācɛ nēe yēeyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ga ipú ajɛ odobū kú ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Udíbɔn-gádi gaá lā Álmɔn-deblatém.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli, nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū nēe kē lɔfú ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ, nɛ̄ aá jé Ɔwɔicō lɔɔlɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā ā, aá wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú aálelékwū nēé wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
idu_Latn: Nɛ̄ aá géē gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ámāŋ ka ákú o yá jīla kú okónu ō ce, ámāŋ ka ɛya nɛ̄ aá gē gwó eko kú ucɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú iháyí kú aá ā. Aá lɔfú bī ɔbá ɛna, ámāŋ ka omlede ámāŋ ka álá gé le Óndú ā, kú ocu kú nū kóō he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ohútu mɛ́mla okwutɛ kú oyēeyī, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi fu, nōo géē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā.
