eng_Latn: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔna nyā tá ipú aéwo dóódu. Aá le tútū kú aá kpɛ́fú, aá lɛ ācokpɛ́fú kú aá tútū, aá lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú aá tútū kú aá nɔɔwɔ nyɔ̄!.

eng_Latn: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá ī tíne kú aá kwú anyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ákú Ujerúsālɛm ú kpó pīya ɔfiyɛ kú aá. Aá jé ka aá abɔ̄yī aá le íne kú ami nōo wɛ Óndú bīya dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nāa géē fu ayí Ulífāyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ká ē í wɛ ákú um á.

eng_Latn: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ɔ̄nyɛ géē bī um ga igelī nɛ̄hi, nēé cē igá tū ɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē bī um tá ga Ɛ́dɔm ā?.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, adá ā da ɔyínɛ́ nū nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ami gbo mla ádā alɔ otú ɛ́nɛ̄ á. Ālɔ̄ yá kóō lɛ ejé gwá otú mā kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gaá gwutá mla anú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ká ālɔ kóō lɛ ɔyí lɛ ŋmá iyē nū.

eng_Latn: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
idu_Latn: Ubasíllāyi le hīla nɛ̄hi. Ó wɛ iháyí ofɛnɛ. Ó lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi. Anú klla kpó ɔdōlé gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ eko nɛ̄ Ágábáidu yɔ̄ Umáhāneyim ā á.

eng_Latn: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā kwú ɔcɛ́ iyē nɛ̄hi, eyī kú nū kwú pīya ɔhá fíyɛ́, ipú kú nū kwú gbogodo, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōo kwú odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū iyē lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla je ɔ́da kéē lɛ ɔ́ nwū ācɛ kú Ujúda á. . Ó jikwū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
idu_Latn: Ucérūbim éyééye géē háyi áklɔ̄ éyééye kú ɔ̄wū kú ikpati ā. A géē yá odúúdú uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wɛ ékpónú tɔ̄há kwɔhá mla ɔ̄wū nū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú uwá ā, ó da Áhābu ka Unábɔ̄tu ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kwú ajɛ ɛhɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tá ō je lɛ ɔ́ ā ú mɛ́ɛ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Igbīhāajɛ ā áncɛ́nyā ɔhá ā le pɛ́ wā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Óndú, Óndú, lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́burɔn kē wɛ ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ kú Ukenīsi jāā kwu ícɛ nyā. Ohígbū ka ó lɛyītáajɛ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ a klla ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó gbā ojibó ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́, é géē je ɔ́ tɛ́cɔ̄ ga ipú ɔlá kú útuló ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
idu_Latn: Wā mɛ́mla um ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn, ɔnyā um. Wā ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn mɛ́mla um. Wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Amána, ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usénɛ́ɛ mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Uhɛ́mɔn, ɛga nɛ̄ aágábá mɛ́mla ɛjɛ lā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú aá nēe lā ɔkpáncō ā, aá gwéeyē. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ísu ā le jí ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ebilíi gāajɛ gaá tá ipú aá ɛɛ́. Ó le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, ohígbū koó jé ka eko ɔ́ɔ hile kpiíí lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
idu_Latn: É le yɛ ŋmá okónōgwu éyi kú ɔlíidɔ ā ga okónōgwu ɔhá jāā wāajɛ Upáfɔ̄si ā, ɛga nēé má ɔ̄cɛ ujíyu oyímabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ éyi nēé hī ka Uba-Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kahíníī, Aá yá ucē okpaakpa, aá klla yá ucē ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ohígbū ka n géē wā gaá nya aá tá ānāānā.

eng_Latn: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
idu_Latn: Aútíca kú íne ōhī ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, A kɛlā lɔhi íbí utíca.

eng_Latn: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔ gē yá tāajɛ oŋmókókó kú ácí kóō lū kpɔ́ ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā yá lɛ mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē bu uwá tū kli bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā.

eng_Latn: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu, eko nɛ̄ ó gáā kwú ā, le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ayí kú Ujósɛ̄fu nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyééye abɔ̄ ó túkpɛɛ́ gboce okwutɛ kú nū yɔ̄ ī tá Ɔwɔicō ɔ́gbá ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le tá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄ kéē yá ojámá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je īyī aá tēelihɔ ŋmá lɛ o lé odóódu kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
idu_Latn: Utánki kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú oje udɔ, mɛ́mla ɛna kú oje udɔ igwɛ́ɛpa nē é le utánki kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā ce ɛyí nū ā kpó yá kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
idu_Latn: Ayí nēé ma lɛ Udéfīdi Ujerúsālɛm ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ussámūwa, Ussɔ́bābu, Umátan, Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú Óndú ā nɛ. Ó kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, é gáā je īyī uwá lá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē híī méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ipú ɛdɔ ɛlā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ó ka italā kú nū ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ oyēeyī kóō kwɛyí oyēeyī, eyī kóō kwɛyí eyī, ayīnu éyi kóō kwɛyí ayīnu éyi, abɔ̄ éyi kóō kwɛyí abɔ̄ éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ikpó éyi kóō kwɛyí ikpó éyi.

eng_Latn: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ajɛ nyā lá ŋmá ɛgiyí Uhanámɛlu, ɔyínɛ̄ɛpa kú um ā á. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ije oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛtá cigwó gbā lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō, yɔ̄ ipú um Ohígbū ká Óndú ā lɛ um fu ce, ká n̄ kɔ̄ɔ̄kā olɔhi ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aólɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā. Ó lɛ um tɛ̄hɔ ká n lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū le bīya lɛ uwá ā ɔtū tú kwɔɔhá. Ká n tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ nēé kwú ā, kéē le uwá hɛ́tá ɛɛ́. Ká n̄ kē tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ nēe bá agbá ā, kéē lɛ ɔwɛ agbá ā nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ uwá kéē bɛ̄cɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le da uwá kéē híīī yá ácí ámāŋ ēpū ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ámāŋ ka ɔcí dúúmā ɔdā dúú ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ nēe fukɔ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō udɔ̄bū ŋ́ mā nēé í yá uwā odée á.

eng_Latn: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
idu_Latn: Aá yá ucē nēe géē mafú ka aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa lɛ odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há ajɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm. Anyākwɔ́cɛ, aótrɛ̄yí, aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá ga iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ pɛ́ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā kéē wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔfú da uwɔ kahíníī, Wā í lé, kú ā gwá. mla anú glá. Amáŋ igwú nɛ̄ ó gē hī uwɔ abɔ̄ ā, í ŋmá ɔtū kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhósāfati gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā lɛyikwú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda kéē lɛ okónu gwū.

eng_Latn: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔwɛ ā túglāyá cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ aɔ́dōgbájí tū ācɛ ikpó kpó ŋmá ɔwɛ gbēyī ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nēe í pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
idu_Latn: Usímīyɔn da Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó da Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔyí nyā fu kóō yá kú ācɛ alɛwa kéē gwōnū, ó klla kē í yá kú ācɛ kéē jegicō ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdocābɔ̄ nōo géē pī ācɛ ahɔ̄ ā. Ācɛ alɛwa géē tá ɛlā kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
idu_Latn: É le nyā ŋmá ɔwɛ gā igelī nɛ̄hi ā gaá gbo. É le tá igelī ā gaá cīce ɛyɔ́pu kú ɔlɛ́ ā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í da uwá kéē wā í gbo ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔyī ā géē gwū ɔ̄ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū bɛ̄cɛ igbīhi kú nū. Ɔkɔ́ kú ɔyī nōo ī ceyī ā kē í bū ɔ̄ anyī bēhé. Cɛ́ɛ́ ufi nɛ̄hi kē lɛ ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ācɛ nōo pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda eko nyā ā wɛ, úlā ofu ɛhīlī ce igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofu igwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō ka anúɔ géē yá uwā italā. Ó ka anúɔ gēe plla ācɛnyā kú Usáyɔn ɛyí, klla gēe je uwá tóohɛ́ɛwa piií.

eng_Latn: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a gē tá ācɛ kú uwɔ ohi, a gē mafú lɛ uwá ka anɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē je ínoōbīya yá ɛhi á. Nááná nāa yá uwā italā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
idu_Latn: Epu mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipú ácí a gēe ba í kpó okwū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Isudán lé a. Kwu ɔnɔ̄ kwu ɔgwā, aígbáanɔ, ēpū mla aɛ́bɛ́ gēe ba í lé okwū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Isudán pióo.

eng_Latn: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aípɔ́ɔma nēe gboce uwá ā kéē jé ɔ̄, nēé klla í nwū ayí uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
idu_Latn: N má ka aákā ɛnɛ ā gbla īyī uwā. Éyééye kú uwá yɔ̄ pi éyééye kú aódée ɛnɛ ō lɛ acá oōbī wu ā. Aákā ā lɛbɛɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aákā ɔhá hɛ́ uwā igbó ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā gaá kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā, ó kē ī kɛlā lɛ uwā ipú olihī ɛ̄cī dóódu, ó klla ī kɛlā lɛ ācɛ nēe hɛ́dēēlē í yɛ abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ um ɔfú cē tū, eko kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú um, klla kwú oyēeyī kú um ú yá kpií.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
idu_Latn: Alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya, ācɛ Ulífāyi, ācogbo Okómpíinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ācogwííjē kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, odúúdú ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú alɔ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā klla lɛ īyī alɔ kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú éwɔhá nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú alɔ ā, alɔ mɛ́mla anyā alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ nēe jɛ́ɛ́yí ɔdā glá ɛɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um, odúúdú alɔ í gáā nyɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ohígbū nōó géē je pīya iyó wu ɔ̄ ɔkɔ. Ábsālɔm í cɛ̄ ŋ́, nááná ā, ɔcɛ́ í kē cɛ̄ ŋ́ dúú. Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ í lé ucɛ ā ɛbɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da Ábsālɔm kóō nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē wɛ ijáalí kú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla ipú Ujerúsālɛm dúú. É lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá kóō gekwú.

eng_Latn: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā í kwu ga ɛgotayínū kú nū nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú nū ā, amáŋ é ī yá ɔ̄ lé, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kwú pīya oŋmɛ́yí kú nū.

eng_Latn: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, tūufi nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó géē lɛ ɔfū tū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū iyē klla gē je íkwu lɛ uwā. Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But God raised him from the dead:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
idu_Latn: Eko gēe wā, nɛ ācɛ kú Israɛl nēe hile a í gāa gbɛnú ce aéwo nēe je uwá yá ífi a gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ, é gēe lɛ ɔtū ce Óndú a, Ɔwɔicō ká uwá, Ɔwɔicō otīihɔ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a.

eng_Latn: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī yá ojuju kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā tū ɔ́mpā uwɔ, nōo lā kwu uwɔ nōo klla lɔtūce uwɔ nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú piíí ā gē je ɔ́ yíífi á. Ohígbū ka ó tá kóō yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi lɛ ɛlā nyā ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwɛyí ā, é kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā ú ga ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́, gaá le ɛcɔ̄ tá klá anú lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bī ɔwɛ nyā le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū Umósīsi ukɔ́ kú nū ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usácāyi wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwáahātá .

eng_Latn: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū ɔ ohígbū íne nōo bīya ā. Ijakī nɛ̄ ó gē kɛlā ŋ́ mā, bī ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu le kɛlā lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ubálam ucē ɛ́lɛ́ kú nū ɔ́ɔmā ci á.

eng_Latn: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá nēé gáā bī le yá uwā ōwē ā géē yɔ̄ gē yi piyóó. Ōwē kú ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ojíbó kú nū ɛ̄gbā ā, mɛ́mla ákú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ nēé lɛ iyē kú ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā fu uwá ukɔ̄ ā í lɛ ō jɛga lɛ uwā kéē mlɛ́nyɔ̄ ŋ́, kwu otú kwu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōó gwutá anú ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó cīce anú, eko nōó yɔ̄ ī nyílá ā, géē je pīya ɔdēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oyēeyī cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ɔdōlé á. Ɔkpíyē kē cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ īlī á.

eng_Latn: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo wā ā, ī bī ɛhi gé lɛ ɔ́. Aɔ́dā ɛhi bɛ̄ɛka, oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔdɔ , oje udɔ, iyɛ́fú, anɔ̄ ōkpóocu, aɔ́nya, aíjakī. É gē yá lɛ ā iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
idu_Latn: Aólíla mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔdāahá nēé lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá Óndú kú aá ā yɔ̄ áā? Anú wɛ ádā aá, nōo yá aá ā á. Anú yá aá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá je pīya éwo ícɛ á.

eng_Latn: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya nɔ̄wá ɛpa bá ī pi Úgbɔ́ɔ́nya kú aflɛ́yí ā. Aɔ́nya nōbí bá ī pi ɔ́mpa ā.

eng_Latn: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɔkpáncō yíla ɛpa gā ajɛ, ká ā gā ajɛ, lɛ ikpó da ɛyí aɛ́fu ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē tá ódūdū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Abíyāta, ɔyí kú Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki kwu wā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi Ukéyīla ā, ó le īlī nēé gē lɛ klá ikpáti ɛka kú Óndú ā kpó wā mla anú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
idu_Latn: A í ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ anɔ̄ otīihɔ nɛ̄ aá géē bī lɛ yúklɔ́ gā um piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá he aá ɔtū lɛ ā pó.

eng_Latn: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē pīyɛyí wā ŋmá ɛga oligbó. É géē wā ŋmá ɛhícō, é kē í wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. É klla kē í wā ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usínim.

eng_Latn: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
idu_Latn: N má odúúdú ācɛ nēe lá ipú ɛcɛ ā, n le má ká ipú ayípōklóbīya kú ɛcɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ipú uwā nōo géē mīyɛ ɔkwu ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
idu_Latn: Aá híīī kpó agbénú tū lɛ īyī aá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ɛha mɛ́mla ɛ́kla gē bīya agbénú. Ācɛ owūwī kē ī ca ɔwɛ gaá kpó uwī.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.
idu_Latn: Kócōō, lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ nyā yá. Ká n̄ lɛ ɔdōlé yá gā uwɔ. A géē lé ɔdōlé cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā le lɔfú iyē nāa géē yāwu ga ɔlɛ́ glá.

eng_Latn: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn ma Uréhobōwam. Uréhobōwam ma Ábīja, Ábīja kē ma Ása.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Aá cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Aá cɛ̄tra anú ipú ɔkpáncō nɛ̄hi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā í yá kwɛyí bōōbū ā, ācɛ ɛtá nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um ŋmá Usísarīya ā gāājɛ ɔlɛ́ ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ bá ā.

eng_Latn: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ge pīya aógbɛhá tū ā, gē cá Ɔwɔicō nōo yá aógbɛhá ā ɛcá. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gbonɛnɛ lɛ aógbɛhá ā, gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ami ā? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō le ka péee ipéyī um abālɔbányā. Ɔ̄nyɛ ka odúúdú ɔdā nōó géē yá ŋmá ohútu yɛ jāā ga ámōōmɛ ā glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
idu_Latn: É í je agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā tá alácɛ̄. Ācɛ géē je pɛ́ kwu ŋmá igelī kú ɔlɛ́ aá nɛ̄ ācɛ tɛtɛ wɛ omōōmū nū ā. Aɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄hi nēé gwó inɔ̄ɔda tū uwā nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja gē ce ī gbāajɛ ā, géē je pīya alácɛ̄ piyóó. Aíjakī géē bá ī hijā abɔ́ɔ, aálá kē ī bá ī lúlé abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu le tá ɛgiyī otrɛ̄yí kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá nɛ̄ Asspɛ́nāsi fu kóō leyīkwu uwá ā, gāa da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ijē elihɔ kú ɔtūnōbí nyā gwó lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyā éyi ā, anɔ́ɔ Unáhāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn le tá Ujábesi, ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di gāá mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujábesi da Unáhāsi ka ɔ̄ lɛ ɛbɔ́ yá mla aá, ka aá í gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ mīyɛ ijáalí ká ācɛ, ijáalí kú Ɔwɔicō fíyɛ́ á. Ɔwɔicō kē le ijáalí nyā cē lɛyíkwu Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
idu_Latn: N le okónu ce nɛ̄ n géē yá ɔ̄ píī, ka n géē lɛ íne okpaakpa kú uwɔ tū.

eng_Latn: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
idu_Latn: Ipú ojīla tɔ̄há kú icɔ́ɔci, ācɛnyā cíkā ō bá cíí. É jɛɛga lɛ uwá kéē kɛlā ŋ́. É cíkā ō tɛ́ɛyí wāajɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ijakī géē mɔyí ɔ̄cɛ glá, ayíkā olíla géē jééyī glá.

eng_Latn: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā māháyi lɛ akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā yɛjīlatá biílí. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá gbo klá ajɛ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
idu_Latn: É ma ayí ɛtá. Ujéyusi, Usimárīya mɛ́mla Usáham.

eng_Latn: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujohánan mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ā, le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ Íssmɛ̄lu yá nyā pó á.

eng_Latn: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ āyā ohile kú ajɛ kú Óndú nyā, nɛ̄ īkpō kú nū wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā, nɛ̄ ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ ukilómīta ɛpa ce āyā ā, í wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē wɛ ákú odúúdú ācɛ ā. É géē lā abɔ́ɔ, í kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā lúlé ipácí kú nū klla bī ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā yá ɔdā dóódu glá. Igelī ā kē géē kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́, ka odúúdú ācɛ ɛ́ɛ géē pɛ́ kwú ɛ̄cī éyi pií. Ɔnyā ā ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le pīya klá ajɛ, ɔ́ɔ klla tōō kpó ŋmá ajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́ mā, ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā á. Ó ka nááná nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ gē je okwū héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ŋ́ mā, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ɔwɛ ká ɔ́ɔ̄ je ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
idu_Latn: Aá yá kóō lɔhi lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n yá kéē kpó aá aɔ́fiyɛ nyɔ̄ ā. Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga um lɛyíkwu ɔɔ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ó yɔ̄ lɔhi, aá géē bá lɔhi dúú.

eng_Latn: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
idu_Latn: N géē ŋmó ācɛ nēe ī yɛce ɔ́ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aícɔ́ɔci ā le jé ka n jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɛlá ā mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé gē dɔɔ̄kā ā. N kē géē je lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā lɛ ɔdā nōó yá āa.

eng_Latn: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ nyīla ŋmá igelī kú Arówɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ pī okónōgwu kú Ánɔn, gaá yɛ ga ɛhícō kú ɛfu kú Usíhɔn, anú wɛ ɛfú kú Uhɛ́mɔn á.

eng_Latn: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
idu_Latn: Otóótú ɔ́ɔmā ayínɛ́ ā lɛ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi tíkpó ga Uberíya. Abɔ̄ é gāājɛ ā, é le tá ipú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú aá ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ lɛ ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá bū ipú aéwɔhá wā ɛga nɛ̄ aá bá ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le tá ɔlékwū í klla cɛ̄tra awɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó ī tá uwɔ ahínyá glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má. Okwū í klla kpɔ́tūce okpaakpa kú uwɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛ́sra kahíníi, Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, kú aá klla bī Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú ā wóófu. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā le abɔ̄ kú uwā kpó gicō klla tóohi ka, kóō le yá lɛ ā, kóō le yá lɛ ā. É le okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ, túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Óndú ā ɛgbā.

eng_Latn: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā le pɛ́ wā.

eng_Latn: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
idu_Latn: Igelī nɛ̄hi ā le yíla āyā ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī kú odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ nyā le kpó yíífi á. Ɔwɔicō le blakwu Ubábīlɔn nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le ōwē má ohígbū ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kú nū ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé ī pī ɔ̄ ejé ā.

eng_Latn: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
idu_Latn: É kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā nēe lɛ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā ú tá abɔ̄ áncā ɛɛ́. Odúúdú uwā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ɔfú mɛ́mla íjéeyī kú ɛfú kú uwā kwú pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpancō ahínyá, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōó lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlé nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
idu_Latn: É da iyī uwā kahíníī, Aá wā kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ubulɔ́kwu ma, kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ pá lɔfúlɔfú. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aúbulɔ́kwu ma kwɛyí ɛcɔ̄ á, klla bī ukolotā kwɛyí ɔ́tɔ̄ kéē bī aúbulɔ́kwu ā kwɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, É lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpíihɔ ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ igbō ōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lé kóō yēeyī ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
idu_Latn: N gáā kwu ita lɛ aá, n klla í ka ɛyí ita kú íkée ā.

eng_Latn: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
idu_Latn: Igbɛ ɔmɛtá kpɔ́, ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ɛdɔ ígwu kú ācɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ɔ́ɔmā gaá le okwúkwu kwaajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ɛláyíja, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, kócōō méyīnyinyi alɔ ká ā je alɔ kpó ŋmó ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
idu_Latn: Lɛ íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdā ō jé mɛ́mla ohílīpú je gā um, nɛ̄ n géē bī le gbō ɛwa nāa kpó gā um nyā. Ámāŋ abɔ̄ n í yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē gbō ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nāa kpó ga um nyā glá ā.

eng_Latn: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
idu_Latn: Árōwɛ, Usífimōtu, Ɛ́ssitemōwa.

eng_Latn: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ ka dúú ka, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne kóō tá ɔnyā nū, kóō le ɔkpá kú ɔnyā ō tá je lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Uhátāki, éyi kú aídibo nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ ɔ́ ā, hīgwú, lɛ ɔ́ tɛhɔ̄ fu Umɔ́dɛkāyi, kóō gāá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yēkwu gē yɔ́tūnōbí nɛ̄hi nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
idu_Latn: ŋmífī nēé wā ipú ajɛ nyā nɛ̄ n kpó ācohɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ uwá kéē gbō uwā ā. Amáŋ n cokónu ka n géē yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé dúúdú. Udéfīdi, n kē yɔ̄ ī da uwɔ ka, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, abɔ̄yī um géē je ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwɔ kwajɛ kóō wɛ ipíinu nōo géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
idu_Latn: Únóji ī nū ipú jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ eyī í cɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɔlá hɛ́ kwu agege kwú odée í klá anú ámāŋ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi útāngōdō ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔdā ō le agege ce ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ī mɛ́ɛbɛ abɔ̄ é gē bēhé wā ipú inu ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi le ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā tá ipú igelī kú Udábe anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ alɛwa pīya ayíkpó á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga Ulístra, é le tá Ikónīyɔm mɛ́mla Ántīyɔ̄ku kú Upisídiya.

eng_Latn: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
idu_Latn: Ahítōfɛlu gē nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā á, anú mɛ́mla Uhussáyi, nōo ŋmá Áki ā, nōo klla wɛ oklóbīya kú ɔcɛ́ ā, gē nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā dúú.

eng_Latn: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: N le ɔ́ ŋmó tū ipú ɔtū kú um ka n̄ lɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ijééyí mɛ́mla íla ō lá ā jé. Amáŋ, n le má ka odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ō yá nyā wɛ áncā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ o nū owu inya, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ā nááná kōō gē ce um ojīlīma. Kwu aógbo mɛ́mla aókokoŋkofí géē cɛ̄tra um ohígbū ka ami gē je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá ipu ígbíli á. Ami klla yá nɛ̄ ísu gē cēenyi ipú ajɛ íkpakplā ká n̄ je éŋkpɔ̄ ōgwá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ n fu ā á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛ̄cī ofɛpa ā, Unówa le ɔwɛ kú úgbéenyi ā nwūla.

eng_Latn: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, nēe wɛ ācɛ Ukénan ā, le ācɛ nēe bá ī yúculo kú ɛyíkwū ipú ɛga o wú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Átādi má ā, é da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti bá gē yá yɔ̄ á. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé le iyē ce abɔ́ɔ ka Ébɛl Umisrém.

eng_Latn: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Abígɛ̄lu páápá le igbō ofu igwó yá fíya, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ kú ejé ɛpa, igbō ofu igwó ā, mla ɛbɛ́ kú aálá ɛhɔ̄ nēé le pá ɔlá ɛɛ́, mɛ́mla okoolo igwáahāpa kú āmplā, mla igbō ofu igwó ocúkɔ́ɔ́ kú aíkpɔ̄cí Ufáyin nēé hī ka Uréyisin ā ofɛhɔ̄, īkpō kú Ufigi nēé le mabɔ́há ofɛhɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó ce aíjakī á.

eng_Latn: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca,alɔ jé ka, a gē kɛlā ɔkwɛyi, í gē lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gbɛlá ā ŋ́. Á gē méyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ā gē nwū ācɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ lɛ ācɛ ā. Le ka lɛ alɔ, ó le kpaakpa kú alɔ da ije ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi Usísa ā, kɛ̄ɛ̄ koó cíkā ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Aá má odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā? Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ó lɛ ɛcɔ̄ dúú yɔ̄ amānyā nēé géē mabɔ̄tá ce iyī uwā icō ŋ́. É géē míya ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā wāajɛ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ gē leyī kwɛcɛ kú alɔ yá kú iŋini dúú kóō bɛ̄cɛ lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ gē leyīkwu ɛhi kú ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
idu_Latn: Ayíka, Ɔwɔicō kwú mlanyī ō ményinyi alɔ ɛɛ́ nɛɛ? Ícɔ́nū miyɛ ɛga kú eyīnyinyi kū nū nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kóō.

eng_Latn: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, Ugébríyɛlu, nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ má ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má gbɔbū ā, le wu wā ɛgiyí um. Eko nōo wā nyā, wɛ eko nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɔ́migwó kú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ alɔ bá ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo kwu ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gā ɛgiyí um. Ó gáā da um kéē lɛ Ujerúsālɛm catāajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
idu_Latn: Ó bī omútāgā le Ucérūbim ɛpa yá ŋmá ugóolu .

eng_Latn: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpáni um, jāhɔ̄ gā um. Ami nāa géē ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí á.

eng_Latn: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
idu_Latn: Ményīnyi um Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ka é bá ī nu um unu. Aólɛlā kú um bá ī yá um ŋmó eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
idu_Latn: N lɛ eyī ce uwɔ ká ā nya um tá Óndú, n kē ī yá ɔdā nāa ka ipú íne kú uwɔ ā jīla.

eng_Latn: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gáā lɛ anyā ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá nēe lā ipú alɔ mɛ́mla ipú ajɛ kú alɔ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
idu_Latn: Ufi mla ɔnɔ gēe je uwá ipú gbogodo; bɛ̄ɛka, ɔnɔ kú ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔɔ kwú a. Ipú ufi mla ooga kpaakpa a, é gēe kpó eyī kwu īyī wā eyī ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá nēé tá ā kahíníī, Ami Uréhum, igbómína kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla Ussímssāyi, Ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú alɔ, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ɔhá nēe ŋmá Érēki, ācɛ Ubábīlɔn, mɛ́mla ācɛ Usúsa nēe ŋmá ajɛ kú Ɛlam ā.

eng_Latn: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
idu_Latn: Ó he uwá abɔ̄yīwā ɔtū kéē yá lɛ ā, ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi é cíkā ō yá lɛ ā. Ohígbū ka ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛ ɔhā kú Alelékwū kú uwā kɔ̄ mla aílɔ́wá ā, o lɛ ā aílɔ́wá ā cíkā ō bī agbénú kú uwā kú ɛcɛ nyā le tá ācɛ Ujíyu ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwu pīya tá ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ Ussímēyi bá ogwogwu kú ɛfu ā yɔ̄ ī cá uwā ɛcá klla yɔ̄ ī tá ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla úmúlá klla uwá á.

eng_Latn: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā géē tókónu lɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ŋmá anú ā.

eng_Latn: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udánīyɛlu bī íjéeyī le ɔ̄kā da Áriyɔ̄ku, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbāajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ nēé fu kóō kpó ācojéeyí kú Ubábīlɔn ŋmó ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔ í yā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē tū owu nɛ̄hi áncā mɛ́mla oflútu klá uwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kwú kpó yíífi ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ámɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Umówābu gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́dɔm. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú eyí í pīya kwu īyī uwā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó iyī uwā á.

eng_Latn: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ ā, aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́, amáŋ abālɔbányā aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Eko éyi Ɔwɔicō í ményīnyi aá ŋ́, amáŋ abālɔbányā, Ɔwɔicō gbɔɔ́ ō ményīnyi aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ahítōfɛlu gekwú ā, Ujɛhóyāda, ɔyí kú Ubɛnáya, mɛ́mla Abíyāta, gē nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlā kwɛyí Ahítōfɛlu á. Ujówābu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ klla í je ɔ́da lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
idu_Latn: É klla cɛ̄ ka odúúdú ayí igbīhi kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ācɛ Ujíyu dóódu, ɛga dóódu nēé bá ā cíkā ō blakwu ɛ̄cī kú Upúrim nyā klla í lɛ ɔ́ tū piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
idu_Latn: N je ɛga lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔ́ tū eko nɛ̄ ɔyā éyi le gla, ikɔkɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛɛnɛ kú ɔyā ɔ́mpa ā. Kéē lé ucɛ ā mɛ́mla igbō nɛ̄ó gē nū ŋ́, mɛ́mla ēpū ohɔ́ɔnɔ.

eng_Latn: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ kē í bī unwalu gē lɛ īyī nū bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ínyí ɔlá gē tá ŋmá ipú ɔlá gicō ā.

eng_Latn: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ahāapa, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā géē bī opo, é géē gbɔbū kú ikpati kú okónu ōce ā. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, awɔ mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ā géē yɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā jīla tá igba ahāapa, ācogwɛ́ɛya kē í bá yɔ̄ ī tá opo ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ulébāna mɛ́mla Uhágāba mɛ́mla ayí kú Ákūbu.

eng_Latn: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra iyī alɔ ɛgiyí aá igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ehée, ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tíne ō yá ā wɛ o yá ká aá le jé lɔɔlɔhi ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō bī alɔ gwō ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē je ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē tá ācɛ nēe ī kɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o má eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛ, nóō wɛ uce kú nū ŋ́ mā, ohi.

eng_Latn: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
idu_Latn: Aógbló nēé wu ɔ́ ā le likpō nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū Ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā lɔfú má ɛyí kú uwā glá, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má uwā ŋmá ɛcɛ glá ŋ́. Aógbló ā kē bá abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
idu_Latn: E dɔɔ̄kā kéē je pīya ācɛ onwū íne kú Umósīsi, amáŋ é jɛɛyi kú ɛla ká abɔ̄yī uwā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, Amáŋ koō jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nēé i kɛlā ohígbū nū mla ɔtū ékpó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwɔ yá ɔdā ocābɔ̄ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɔdā ufi nɛ̄hi, ɔ́ɔmā ī wɛ oŋmɛ́yí kú uwɔ á. Ācɛ gēe tíne uwɔ, amáŋ é gáā má uwɔ gbóógbóó gɛ ŋ́. Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ aá í ka lɛ ācɛ ā kóō lɔhi ō pó ahɔ̄. Aá cíkā ō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē tá ācɛ dóódu ohi ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō tá. Ń gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā glá ŋ́. Ohígbū koó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyī kú ācɛ nēe lɛyícikwū nyɔ̄ í hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ā gé um ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ō gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja ɛtá olɔfú ā yá á.

eng_Latn: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔmálɛ éyi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, n géē yɛce uwɔ ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le tá Íjīpiti ā, ācɛ Umídīya ā, kwú Ujósɛ̄fu ú lá lɛ Upɔ́tīfa, otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
idu_Latn: Ákú aá, ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, aá lɛ igbīhi cē kwu Ɔwɔicō, le pīya aólɛlā kú nū, yɔ̄ ī nuunu tū ɔ̄ bū ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá bī ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kē lɛ āyā kú ajɛ ā je lɛ āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄ wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í gē cɔ̄nū fíya ŋ́, amáŋ, ó lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ó gáā habɔ̄ ācɛ nēe lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā tá nyɔ̄ icííci nōó gáā yá uwā italā ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē yāwu, owu nɛ̄hi gē tá kwu ɔ́ ɔkwu, ojuja ā wɛ úmúlá nɛ̄ ikpó kú nū gē wuklíicō á!.

eng_Latn: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kóō leyīkwu ɛcɛ gɛɛ ohígbū ɔyā nū. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō kē lɔtūce ɔyínɛ́ nū ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔyínɛ dóódu yɔ̄ í plla ɔyínɛ́ nū bɛ̄ɛka Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kē yɔ̄ ī bī ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ le híla ɔya nū.

eng_Latn: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
idu_Latn: Ń wɛ abɔ̄ nōo lɛ iyī um ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ń wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ń le Ujísɔ̄si, Óndú ālɔ má ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛɛ? Aá wɛ ācɛ kú Óndú ā ícɛ oŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
idu_Latn: É gē da ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā kahíníī, Áá mā alɔ ɛbɛ gɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē da alɔ ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa á ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛdɔ kú ɛlā nōo gē he alɔ ɔtū ō pó ā, nɛ̄ aá géē ka lɛ alɔ á. Ó kōō wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nááná.

eng_Latn: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó bá Ɛ́dɔm, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm ga ɛháajɛ kú Udéfīdi klla gbɔɔ́ ō télí lɛ Udéfīdi á. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gē ga ɛfú ā, Óndú ā gē cɛ̄ le ɔ́ yá ācɛ lé eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
idu_Latn: Le cɔ̄nū da ācɛ nēe gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ uwēyī je lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé ga ajɛ kú Ubɛtsáyída ā, ācɛ éyi le opeyī éyi bī gé lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
idu_Latn: É gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Urefidím gaá lā ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usírīya gē lá iyó agbénú alɛwa kú uwɔ ā. É kē ī kpó ɛdɔ īlī ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ mɛ́mla ohéyīfuú ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí alɛwa, klla mɛ́mla aɛ́cɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi le cíla uwɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ nāa kpó lá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le jīla tɔ̄há ā, Upáyílēti da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá tíne ká n̄ hɛ́tá lɛ aá ā, Ubárābasi kɛ̄ɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si nēé hi ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
idu_Latn: Óndú da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka oŋmífī ɛ̄cī kú Ugíbēya ā nēé húmáyī ī bīya íne á. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ó lɛ ā, ɛfú í cíkā ō wā í je uwá ca tāajɛ, Ugíbēya ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nyá nɛ̄ aádā aá ī yáŋmó ŋ́ mā? É le ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe wā í ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ācōtɛ̄hɔ oyókpaakpa éyi yɔ̄ ī wā ā kpó ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā aá le ibīyājɛ yá tū ɔ̄ le ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛhi nēé kpó wā ā nwuné lɛ ā má ā, é cɛ̄tra Óndú ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
idu_Latn: Aá klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ijakī kú ipácí nɛ̄ ígbíli le jé ɔ̄ɔ̄ iyē ā. Ó klá ī hípī owu yɔ̄ ī tíne ɔbá. Eko dúú nōo ī tíne ɔbá nōo í ce ɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kwú ɔ̄ɔ̄ klá cīī glá ŋ́. Ɔbá dúúmā nōo tínē ō ce ɔ́ ā, í gáā cɛ̄gbá ō je unwalu ō dɔ̄ɔka nū lɛ īyī nū dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́. ohígbū ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ɔbá tíne ō ce ɔ́, ó gē je īyī nū tá ajɛ lɛ ɔ́ piíí.

eng_Latn: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ojámá dúú nēe yá aá ā wɛ ɛdɔ kú ojámá ɔlamu nōo gē wā ī yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō gē lɛ okónu nōó ce ā tū. Ɔwɔicō í gáā já aá má fíyɛ́ ɔfú kú aá ŋ́. Ó géē lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē kú aá lɔtūlé, ó klla géē ma ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá géē yɛ bɛ̄cɛ ā fú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé gáā hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō, o ŋmá lɛ ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā dɔɔ̄kā ā ŋ́, amáŋ íne ā gē yá ká ācɛ kéē jé ka aá le íne bīya.

eng_Latn: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá koó géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? N da aá, ó lɔfú wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi koó gáā cɛ̄ nyāŋjɛ je igbo ā gā awɔ ohígbū ka awɔ mɛ́mla anú wɛ oklóbīya nɛɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē cāŋ́jɛ í je odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ a cɛgbá ā ga uwɔ ohígbū ka á yúwēyī o yɔ̄ ī bā odée ā piyóo ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ nōo wɛ ɔ́nyī um mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwu um ajaajɛ ā, yɔ̄ ī yá ɛlā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ géē fu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi bɛ̄ɛka anúɔ ā, ŋmá ipú uwā. Ó ka ɔyínɛ́ uwā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ōwā kú nū ōfōōfūnū ā tá alɔ ɔtūlé ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tá ɔ̄ ɔtū lé lɛ nōó bī wā í kā alɔ ā. Ó da um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ eyī um yɔ̄ gē ce aá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá híjémā kú unwalu nɛ̄ aá je ga um ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá le tútu ō cɛ̄pɔ̄ um lɛ ā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū he um abālɔbányā fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn da ɔ́ ka ɔkpani, ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ lɔfú da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā glá ā, ɔdí ɔ́ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā gē yá aá ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá kpɔ́. Ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄ ádáádā aá gē da aá ka, Ōndú ā ɔ́ɔ gē yá ā bɛ́ɛ, ɔwɛ nōó le kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā bɛ́ɛ? Ó ka Óndú ā le igbīhi cē kwu aá, anɔ́ɔ ó mā aá tá ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Umídiya kéē yá aá ɔdā nēe he uwá ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ami yá uwā ā ŋ́. Ó kē wɛ ami ma uwá ā ŋ́. Ɔdíyá nāa da um ka ami ɔ́ bī uwā ipú abɔ̄ kú um bɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē bī ɔyí ō gwá amɛ̄ abɔ̄ ā, ga ajɛ nāa cokónu nū lɛ aádáádā uwā ā?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le owu nɛ̄hi kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ efūma ā kpó gla ga ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā. Efūma ékpónú í hile ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
idu_Latn: Ó klla bī oje udɔ ā lɛ ɔgba ɛpa kú ikpō kú ɔcí nēé hī ka upɔmegrɛ́nēeti ā ma tū uwā dúú.

eng_Latn: Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ kwú īlī otōhí kú nū éyi ú pīya klá ajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú īlī ō tōhí kú nū éyi ú pīya klá ajɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi le īkpɔ̄dā fú tū ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú okoolo ofɛhɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ce Urútu ɛyí á. Urútu pīyɛyí wā Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm mla īkpɔ̄dā ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo yá ɔkpáncō klla je ɔ́ nāŋdaa klá ɛyí ɛcɛ ā á. Anú yá ɔ́na kú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ipú nū á. Anú klla je oyēeyī mɛ́mla owu kú oyēeyī lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ̄ á. Anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā le ufi yá ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā, anɔ́ɔ é le aɔ́fiyɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā kpó tū ipú inu.

eng_Latn: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā le ɛlā nēé ka ā yá. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā le ɔnyā éyi kwú ŋmá ipú ayípáncɛ́nyā nēe bá ī jīījē Ussílo ā, klla le ɔ́ bī ga ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ é le cīgbīhi ga ɔlɛ́ uwā klla lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā túgwó, má lā anú á.

eng_Latn: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó kwú alɔ ú héyī ŋmá ikwū kú alelékwū cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ géē gbāājɛ mla anú ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óócí wɛ ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ á, ɛga kú uwɔ géē táncā ɛyí utéblu kú ɔlɛ́ ádā um.

eng_Latn: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
idu_Latn: N hi odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ igwú ka, aá pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí um cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá le nyatá. Ami ōfōōfū um wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī ā ga ɛyí ɛfú nōo yɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ aá hīgwú kú aá wā gaá lé ucɛ kú ɔnyāolɛ, aá híīī nyɔ̄ gaa cīce ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā ŋ́. É lɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ hīgwú dúú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā le bī gé lɛ ɔ́, kóō le lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē kwú.

eng_Latn: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda tá ami nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, gaá bá ī gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yá um cɔ̄nū ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá ā. N cāŋjɛ ipú ícɔ̄nū lɛyí kwú Ujerúsālɛm, ɔnū kú um lɛyíkwu uwá ā í gáā mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ odúúdú ācɛ wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kē ī wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ámāŋ ka ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ō hídáagó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā, amáŋ ɔtū kú olíla í lɛ íjééyī dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tū Ɔwolímanya bū odúúdú ɔkpáncō, amáŋ ɔkɛklɛ kú ísu ā tá ipú obū kpímm.

eng_Latn: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
idu_Latn: ábúbīyɛ̄, íkwu mɛ́mla anyínyā ā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Umósīsi á.

eng_Latn: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aɔ́dée ā lɛ eyī ɛnɛ. Éyi wɛ eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ, ɔ́mpa wɛ eyī kú ɛna, ɔ́mɛtá wɛ eyī kú ágábá, ɔ́mɛnɛ kē wɛ eyī kú okpé.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtá kú iháyí ɛtá kɛɛ Kɛ̄ɛ ka a géē yɔ̄ ī kwinya hɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ ɔyā ɛtá? Ámāŋ ka ɛ̄cī ɛtá nɛ̄ Óndú ā gēe bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū le je ocē obɔ̄bí wā ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū géē yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛbɛɛbɛ kú ipú ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ohi nyā nɛ̄ a géē je, ká n̄ tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?
idu_Latn: Aɛ́cɔ̄ nyā kē í blatū ācɛ, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā. Ekɔ̄bū nɛ̄ ayí aá lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí kú ɛcɔ̄ nyā.

eng_Latn: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā wɛ ka aá lɛ iyī aá tū ŋmá o yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé, yɔ̄ ī gwá ejé, ámāŋ ka o yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo í yá kú ayínɛ́ aá kéē bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó gā ɛgiyí alɔ ā, ó kwú ɔkpōkwɛ́nyɔ́ kú Upɔ́lu ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ iyī nū ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄ gbō. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ka á, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu géē gbō ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔkpókwɛ́nyɔ́ nyā ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm á, é klla géē je ɔ́ tū aílɔ́wá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the LORD, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā tóohi kahíníī, N géē tū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um wā gaá tá ɔwɛ tū gā um. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā nɛ̄ aá lɛ eyī táajɛ nū ā géē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū acígilí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá húmáyī lɛ eyī ce ā, géē wā í tɔ́ɔna kú okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā.

eng_Latn: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
idu_Latn: Ohumɔtū ā, le tá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcí kú ubálusam gē jɛ̄ ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī je ɔdōlé lɛ aálá kú nū ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā, klla yɔ̄ ī yā ododó.

eng_Latn: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē kɛpɔ̄ kpaakpa. Ó klla gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
idu_Latn: Ó í yá fíyaa bɛ̄ɛka eyī ōcēbeé ā eko nēe le opo amōōmɛ ā tá. Ohígbū ka eko nēé lɛ opo tá, é géē je ācɛ nēe kwú ā héyī, kéē kwú gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́. É kē í pīya odúúdú alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Óndú ā, nōo nya Ébrahām tá ā lɛ ɛlā nōó ī ka lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó kahíníī, Uwēyī í klla gáā kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛ ɛyí kwajɛ ipú uwēyī ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ágbe, amáŋ anú kē í tá ágbe nōó yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā á. Ó gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ágbe, amáŋ́ ó klla í hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá.

eng_Latn: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ocābɔ̄ kú Ubatísim nōo nya alɔ tá abālɔbányā á. Ó wɛ ō na inyī ŋmá iyē ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ákú okónu ɔkwɛ̄yi ō ce lɛ Ɔwɔicō o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú nōo je Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ í gbō ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā, aígabɔ̄ kú Upɛ́sīya le ŋmótū ka aá í gáā yá ɔdā dóódu ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔkpá tá fu Udárīyɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā klla mīyɛ ohi kú nū.

eng_Latn: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éwo dúúmā le íne bīya, ó gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ éyi ga ɔcɛ́ ɔhá lɛɛlɛwa. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nā ācɛ ojéeyī mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔhi, mɛ́mla ācɛ ojɔ́dā gāá cɔcɛ́, éwo ā géē lɔfú, klla í háyi kpaakpa ipú ɛbɔ́ gbojī.

eng_Latn: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cojéeyī ōfōōfūnū géē jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā dóódu á. Ijéeyī kú ɔ̄cojéeyī gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ī cɛ̄ɛhɛ mɛɛ, ó klla ī yá ká eyī nēé kwúflá ā kóō gā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
idu_Latn: amíyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm. Ó kahíníī. Ujerúsālɛm, n blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛyítáajɛ gā um kpaakpa eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwɔ lɛ ā. N blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yíihɔtū um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ í yíihɔtū ɔbá nū ā. N klla blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yɛce um lɛ ipú ígbíli, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ɔ̄ jéjéé ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ aádá úlā ofɛhɔ gwó lɛ aɔ́nya kú aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū. Ó klla le ɛga ō lɛ ɔnya wū ajɛ anú, úlā ofɛpa cigwó gwó.

eng_Latn: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gbonɛnɛ, klla lɔhi. Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ī ményinyi.

eng_Latn: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
idu_Latn: Aá géē tū ɔdōlé ā bá lɛ iyī aá, ipú ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī ā, amáŋ ɛ̄cī ómahāapa ā, wɛ ɛ̄cī kú omlɛ́nyɔ, odúúmā í gáā yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aéwō nēe yúnwū ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔdōlé dúúmā í gē jɛ̄ uwā ŋ́ mā. Odúúdú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācogbāálá nēé jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Ɔdā dúúmā nēe he uwá ɔtū ā, nēé gē yá á. Ile kú īyī uwā ofōōfūnū nēé gē tíne á.

eng_Latn: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni da odúúdú uwā kahíníī, N gē bī éŋkpɔ̄ le yá aá ubatísim, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi gē wā nōo fíyɛ́ um kɔ́ɔ́. N kōō yá olɔhi jɛ̄ nɛ̄ n kē ī wī ɔ́ŋgbá kú áblákpá kú nū ŋ́. Ó géē bī Alelékwū Ihɔ mɛ́mla ɔlá le yá aá ubatísim.

eng_Latn: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda ī yá īpéeyī um ŋmífī nēé gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄. É gē yá um cɔ̄nū piyóó mla ɔdā nēé bī abɔ̄ kú uwá yá ā.

eng_Latn: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka é kwú ɔdā nēé yá ā ú pīya ɔdā ɛflɛ́ɛfu, ɛ̄nyā í wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó dɔɔ̄kā ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ miya kóō le lɛ ā. Nááná ā Ɔwɔicō leyī ce.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Apólosi yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ukɔ́rīnti ā, Upɔ́lu le yɛ bū ipú aɔ́lɛ́ nēe bá eyīpú ā gāājɛ kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi abɔ̄yī nū. Abɔ́ɔ nōó má ayíkpó ōhī á.

eng_Latn: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani ācɛ nōo gáā ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō í gáā lɛwa ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ohi tá uwā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
idu_Latn: É le ɔcí ō tū ɔlɛ́ ɔkɔ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, ɛhɔ̄ wɛ ákú aɔ́kpá kú ābɔ̄ éyi kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
idu_Latn: N wā ká n yá kú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kóō bɛ́yíkwu ádā nū, ká ɔyínɔ̄nyā kóō bɛ́yíkwu ɛ́nɛ́ nū, ká anyā ayí kéē bɛ́yíkwu ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá uwā.

eng_Latn: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le ɛfú cē yɔ̄ ī kpó ɔ̄ tū ipú ɔlá, anɔ́ɔ idɔlá kú ɔlá ā le ɛgwā éyi nū bɛ̄cɛ. Ɛgwā ā gaá playi Upɔ́lu abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ ācoyúklɔ́ alɛwa. Ācɛ alɛwa bá nēe géē gbā ɛcɔ̄, ācogwíinu mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄ɔcí. Mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ācɛ ō yá ɛdɔ úklábɔ̄ dóódu kú.

eng_Latn: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, aá nēe wɛ ayípōklóbīya ā, aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ dúú, ká aá cɛ̄ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa aá ɛhɔ̄ mla ɔtū otú wāajɛ, ohígbū ka ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō gē bɛ́yí kwu ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́cɛ, amáŋ ó gē gbonɛnɛ lɛ ācɛ o tū iyī uwā wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá gē kpó ɔdā alɛwa ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
idu_Latn: É kē í je ɔ́ tā ācɛ éwɔhá abɔ̄ kéē juwēeyī lɛ ɔ́, klla í gɔ́ ɔ̄, kē klla í hɛ́ ɔ̄ tū ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá. Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ é géē je ɔ́ héyī ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná nōó wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ōwē nōó má ā, lɛ ɛlā nwū ɔ̄ kóō lɛyí túwāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
idu_Latn: nēe nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī okpaakpa ō lā, nēe gaá yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú ajɛ odobū kú ínoōbīya ā.

eng_Latn: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú bá ī yɛ ɛga dóódu. Odúúdú ācɛ bá ī cɛ̄tra ɔdōbɔ̄bī nɛ̄ ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, aá nēe wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ā. Aá jāhɔ̄, aá ācɛ nēe wɛ ācogbāajɛ ā. N géē gwííjē, n géē gwō ɔdā olɔnyɛ tū ijē lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú odúúdú aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā kpó bá ɛgéégéyi iháyí dóódu.

eng_Latn: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n ka ka, Obū ōfōōfūnū kóō wā í klá um mɛ́ɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ofíyajɛ nōo yɛ um jīla tá ā kóō kwú pīya otú.

eng_Latn: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
idu_Latn: Ipú odúúdú iyāwu kú uwá ā, ojuja kú Óndú ā kla Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ɔlá kē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ɛyí kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā otū.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla kahíníī, N ményinyi ācɛ nēé kwú ipú ígbíli ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī tíne ɛga nēé ī lā ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé géē kpó ācɛ kú Ufílístiya yíífi ā gā ɛɛ́. Eko nēé gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ dúúmā wi nōo gē tá Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā le yá ɛɛ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē kpó ācɛ kú Ufílístiya yíífi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe ŋmá ɔlɛ́ idɔ kú ísu kú Ukréti ā.

eng_Latn: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ aólɛlā lɛ íbɔm cē tū igelī kú nū, ó ka ɔ́ɔ í hígbū ɛmiyɛ í je ɔyí obene nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ma ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā ŋmó lé mɛ́mla abí kú nū dúú. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō gáā kɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ɔbá nū nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, ámāŋ ka odóódu kú ayí nū nóō hile ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí ɔ̄cɛ, le ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ka ajɛ kú uwá a, í tīhɔ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē je ōwē lɛ ɔ́ ipú íwɔ́tū mla ɔnū kú um.

eng_Latn: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
idu_Latn: lɛ ācɛ fu kéē lɛ ɔkpá kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aádáádā uwɔ tá tāajɛ ā jila. A géē má ka ācɛ ā wɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, nēe klla í je unwalu lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ dóódu ŋmíífī íkée ā. É wɛ ígwu kú ācɛ nēe tōō gbō ŋ́. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé je igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā yíífi ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔhi lɛ aá ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú aá géē bá ī lɛ ojīlīma ce Ɔwɔicō, gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, klla ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú nū, nɛ̄ aá klla í yɛce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce uwá lɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugɛ́rīsim, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā italā lɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Éba ā.

eng_Latn: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro gaá le ɔkɔ gbā le Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā da Ugádi ka ɔ́ɔ da Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā ɛgowíīkpɔ̄dā kú ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú Arawúna ā.

eng_Latn: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kóō wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ, nōo le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ, ó kē cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ alɛwa kpó wā gé lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aálelékwū ā lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ā túbá ɛgéégée, ɛga nēé hī okónu Uhíbru ka, Amágɛ̄dɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayínɔ̄nya kú Usɛlofɛ́hādi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā ā, amáŋ nōó bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo má iyī nū ipú ogigo kóō jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
idu_Latn: N géē tū uwá bá ɔwɛ ékpónú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbálá gē tū álá kú nū nēe pahīla ā bá kllá ī lɛ ɛlá kwu uwá ā. N géē tá odúúdú uwá bá, ŋmá ɛga dóódu nēé pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ɛ̄cī kú obū mɛ́mla ífi ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā, lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mpa nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ á, le ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
idu_Latn: N da uwɔ ka, ihɔtū nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā mafú ā, cābɔ̄ kéē kwú íne alɛwa nōó bīya ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ɛɛ́. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nēé je olígíí yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ā gē ma ihɔtū olígíí fu.

eng_Latn: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ, aá gwíijē kú éeyē lɛ Óndú, kú aá cɛ̄tra anú, aá tɔ́ɔga cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gwíijē kú aá gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ géē yɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ agbénú kú nū yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ayááyí Usɔ́ɔlu nɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāapa kpó lɛ aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ uwá kpó tōlī ipéyī Óndú ā ipú igelī kú Ugíbēya, igelī nɛ̄ Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā fu ā tɛtɛ lā ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá uwá ohi ka anúɔ géē kpó uwā lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó ī lɛ ā, ɔyínɛ́ um, yá ká n̄ lɛ odée lɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, abɔ̄ nāa wɛ ɔyínɛ́ ipú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, le yá kú ɔtū kóō he um.

eng_Latn: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdídáagó alɛwa ɔtāhɛ kú ācɛ ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā gē jīla ɛ̄cī dóódu ipú inu nēé hi ka okómpīinu Áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Usólōmɔn ā.

eng_Latn: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ōcē lɛ eyī kú uwɔ pu, odúúdú iyē kú uwɔ géē yɔ̄ ipú obū. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī fíyáajɛ ipú uwɔ ā le pīya obū, ó lɛ ā obū ā géē bɔ̄bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests'.
idu_Latn: Ije nēé gbā kú ɛya kú ínoōbīya mɛ́mla ákú ɛpɔ̄bí ō lé ā, é bī ɔ́ɔmā wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ŋ́. Ɛdɔ ije ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
idu_Latn: Aá ga ɔlɛ́ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá da ācɛ ā kéē lɛ iyó kú uwā tútū, ohígbū ka, ipú ɛ̄cī ɛtá nyā, alɔ géē bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nyā gaá mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
idu_Latn: Ó bī ita le nwū uwā ɔdā alɛwa. Ó da ācɛ ā ka.

eng_Latn: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
