idu_Latn: Ɔdí bī aúpíla nēe bī ɛcɛ hayi āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛ ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔ́kíkā kú etikpa kú ɛcɛ kwu ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ o tá opo ā í tá opo kɛlā péee ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā tútu ɛfú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
idu_Latn: A géē gbā ogbló ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí kú akésiya nēé lɛ ugóolu ma plá anú, nēé klla lɛ uwɔ kú ugóolu yá playi anú. A klla í yá ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ ogbló ā.

eng_Latn: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ícɔ́ɔ́ja nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ádā kú Usádɔ̄ku ā wɛ, ofu cɛpa.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, é le da Ébrahām ka Umílka, ɔnyā ɔyínɛ́ nū, Unáhɔ, ɔ́ɔ lɛ ayí ahātá ma lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́gɛ́nyā mla éwɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, é kē jé íne kú nū ā ŋ́. Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla í tá īyī uwā ohi kahíníī, Ohígbū kéē kwú igbīhi í pīya kwu Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nōo kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá mīyɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ é gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ā ɛ̄gbā á. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā bī odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nyā wā í klá uwá á.

eng_Latn: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú um, a géē ma ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ alɛwa, kéē lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā uwɔ lé ā. É kē í gbō odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
idu_Latn: Ā híī kɛlā kú íjééyī kú uwɔ ipú eyī olíla ŋ́, ó gáā lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó ī jé ile kú ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí mla íjééyī kú uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ɔgwú nááná gē je amɛ̄ lɛ ɔyí nū gwá, amáŋ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɔ̄bíipú lɛ ayí ūwā bɛ̄ɛka okokoŋkofí ā.

eng_Latn: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
idu_Latn: Ó kwú Upíta mla Ujémīsi mla Ujɔ́ni ú kpó nyɔ̄. Unwalu mla ɔtunōbí nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Óndú um, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, gáā kpó ɔdā dóódu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā kpɔtūce ā, ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda ɛɛ́. Ó klla í kpó ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é jé ɔkwu kú ádā uwā gɛ ŋ́ mā, é mīyɛ uwá tá ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Óndú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
idu_Latn: É híī lɛ ɛlá wu iyó kú uwā nōo bá igbihi ā ŋ́. Aɔ́dā nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti géē wɛ akú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú éyi kú aɛ́na kú oje ɔdɔ ā ú ce Ubɛ́tɛlu, ó klla kwú ɔhá ú ce Udáni.

eng_Latn: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Uhanáni le tá ɛgiyí Ása gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a le gboló ce ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya klla kwú ɔtū ú kpó ce ɔ́, nɛ̄ á klla kpɔ́tū ce Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ gɛ ŋ́ mā, aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni tá Umósīsi ohi kahíníī, Ɔdāŋ ka n kwú odée kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya kú uwā ú lé ícɛ nyā. Óndú ā í cɛ̄ ɛ̄ɛ̄? Ācɛ ā le odée kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ákú o yɔlá dúúdú ā bī gé lɛ Óndú ā ícɛ, náaná, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā le yá um.

eng_Latn: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
idu_Latn: da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā igbɔhá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdí nāa gē yá ācɛ ubatísim ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka á wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, ámāŋ Ɛláyíja, ámāŋ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi da ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le bɛ̄ɛcɛ kóō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki á. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Uhɔ́ɔ le yɛ tá ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
idu_Latn: nōo wɛ ádā kú Ubinéya á. Ubinéya ā ma Uréfāya nōo ma Ɛlísa nōo ma Ásɛ̄lu ā á.

eng_Latn: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka amáŋ, ohígbū uwā ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le cɔ̄nū mla anúɔ, ɔ́ɔ tá kóō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ gbā a. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔ́ɔ koó jɛ̄ ɛɛ́, ka anúɔ kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā lɛ anúɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
idu_Latn: Ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, oōgɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú ā wɛ ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ obɔ̄bí gē mīyɛ ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ uwá ā. Ācɛ ō yá olɔhi ā géē mīyɛ ulé kú ɔdā olɔhi nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ pīyɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin nōo yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ipú ígbíli ā. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ má aádáádā ūwā aflɛ́yí ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka oōpīya kú īkpō aflɛ́yí kú ufígi ā. Ó ka amáŋ, eko nɛ́ɛ gā ɛyí ɛfu kú Upéyɔ ā, ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā Ubáal ɛ̄gbā, anɔ́ɔ eko kpií ɛ́ɛ kwú cá anúɔ eyī bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́wɔ nēe he uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
idu_Latn: A géē bī ugóólu nɛ̄ ogbɛnū kú nū wɛ ukílōgram ofu cigwáahātá ā lɛ yá ɔdā o lɛ agege ce ɔ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú iyo nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Ufíkɔlu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā le tá ɛgiyí Ébrahām, gaá kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ pī uwɔ ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
idu_Latn: ayíka ācɛ ɔhá kéē kwu ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ n nyi ā í lé, ámāŋ ká ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ī jɛ̄ gā um ā kóō le bīyatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka ē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛ uwá ā. Da uwá ka ɔtū ɔ́ɔ he uwá eko nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā tēelihɔ, nēé je ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá alácɛ̄, klla kpó ācɛ kú Ujúda nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá abɔ̄fú ā.

eng_Latn: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bī ga ipú ígbíli, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
idu_Latn: N hɛ́wɛ̄cɛ ɛgiyí Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ka n we Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Amáŋ ń bī iyē ō tīīhɔ kú um nōo le ka Óndú ā le ma iyī um fú lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
idu_Latn: Ayí nū géē gbo ɛfiyɛ kú ɔdā kú aógbɛhá nōó kpó uwī ā.

eng_Latn: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Amása í má ɔkpacaŋ́gelī nɛ̄ Ujówābu le bī abɔ̄lúfīyē ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā gwū ɔ̄ ipú plū. Ajīlīpú kú nū kwú pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ dúúdú, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā á. Ujówābu í klla cɛgbá ō gwū ɔ̄ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā igbɛpa gɛ ŋ́. Ujówābu mɛ́mla Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ nū, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔ́ɔ ō nyɔ̄ í nū Usséba gɔbū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
idu_Latn: Lɛ anɔ̄ tū uwā ɛyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a le tū ádā uwā ɛyí ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya gā um. Anɔ̄ nēé le tū uwā ɛyí nyā géē je uwá pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya piyóó.

eng_Latn: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ cē Óndú ā oji ŋ́ nááná, ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ íne ōbīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
idu_Latn: Le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ojuju ɔbɔ̄bí kú uwɔ̄ nyā, ká ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɛlá obɔ̄bí nāa gbo nyā í yá uwɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́cī nū, a géē je opī nōo lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔ́bíipú. A géē bī oyī kú nū le gwu ede ā yēŋēē, ɔwɛ ékpónú nāa mī oyī kú ɔbá ɛna ā klá ede ā.

eng_Latn: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá o he um ɔtū, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú pllá aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū le ijē gwó cɛ̄tra anú á.

eng_Latn: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é kwú um tá ipú ómblí bū uwíndo wāajɛ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ n le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú igɛ́mɛ́nti a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú nōo yɔ̄ ī híla ɛbɛ́ nōo ŋmó ā cɛ́kɛ̄cɛkɛ̄ ā. É ba í ŋmó ācɛ, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ké ē kwú gbo agbénú mla ɔdu.

eng_Latn: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, yɛce Usséba, ɔyí kú Ubíkiri, le pɛ́ i yɛ á. Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ujúda ā yɛce ɔcɛ́ kú uwá kpɔ́, ŋmá Ujɔ́dan jāā ga Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó le hɛ́ ɔ̄ idáagó. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nēe yɛce ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka ń kōō má ɔ̄cɛ dúú ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ká ācɛ kéē gbɔlā ā, Uréhābu le tá icō ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā lé oyī kú ɛbɛ́, ámāŋ ka ákú ígbáanɔ dúúmā, ɛga dúú nɛ̄ aá lā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú autéblu pīyatɔ̄há, é wɛ ahātá nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ā ɛyí uwā á. Ɛnɛ bá ipú inu ā, ɛnɛ kē bá ɛcɛ kú inu ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ bá ɛcɛ gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē kɛlā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō ā le ikpó ɛhīlī fu ā, Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā da uwá kéē māháyi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla ɔyí ɛna otījē kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā ɛ́ɛ ga Íjīpiti ā, ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ ofɛtá ce igwó ōfōōfūnū, amáŋ, eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ma nyīla bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
idu_Latn: Ɛga piíí nēé da uwá ka, Aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́ mā ā, abɔ́ɔ nēé géē hī uwā ka ayí Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī ā á.

eng_Latn: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ō gbā í he ɔ́ ɔtū ŋ́. Ó gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú odúúdú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄, mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄cí kú ajɛ ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛpā lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄, ígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō kē lɛ ɔlɛ́. Amáŋ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ í lɛ ɛga dúúmā nōó gē lɛ ɛyí wu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da aá ka, aá yíhɔtū tū aólɛlā kú aá, ká aá klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū ācɛ nēe ī yá aá ōwē ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
idu_Latn: Ó í bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo í yá kú ācɛ ɔhá kéē bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ó wɛ opií ka aɔ́dā ōhī bá nēe géē yá kú ācɛ kéē yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí. Amáŋ ó í bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ojámá ā géē ŋmá ɛgiyí nū āa.

eng_Latn: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
idu_Latn: Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ubássa ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kpɛ́fú tú īyī uwā jāā gbéeko nēé i pɛ kwú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúu, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu a ka; Ujonádāābu, ɔyí kú Urécābu géē lɛ ayááyí nēe géē bá í gbā um ɛ̄gbā piyóó.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu ma ayí igwɛ́ɛpa. Uwá kē bá yɔ̄ á: Urúbɛ̄n, Usímīyɔn, Ulífāyi, Ujúda, Ísāka, Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo í hile ŋmá nú ā wɛ ákú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ āyā kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā oyɔlá nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú á, abɔ̄ nēé je ɔ́ ŋmá ipú ɔdōlé nēé je lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said, I will swear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām kahíníī, N gbo ɔkpá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú okónu ú kwu Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, Ɛ́lāyi kwú míya ga igbīhi ŋmá úgādā nɛ̄ ó cīce okónu ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gaá le ɔkɔ tāajɛ, le ɔkɔ ā cē. Ó kwú pīya ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ, ó klla kwú gbɛ nɛ̄hi, ōgwōnū kú nū ɔ́ɔmā kwú ɔ̄ ɔkɔ ú cē, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á. Ó kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu trɛ̄yí iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ glá á.

eng_Latn: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ nōo yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, n géē yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kóō le lɔhi lɛ Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi kpɔ́, alelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā wā í klá Usɔ́lu, eko nɛ̄ ó cīce ɔlɛ́ nū, lɛ óbō wu abɔ̄, nɛ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í gwō ɛ̄ngwū lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he put them all together into ward three days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú uwā kpó bá agbá ɛ̄cī ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā kú Utekówa ā ga ɛgiyí Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, ó gaá gbo klāajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ágbá tá ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ágábáidu, tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ámrāfel wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ussína ā, Áriyɔ̄ku, ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛllása, mɛ́mla Ukedɔlayóma, ɔcɛ́ kú Ɛ́lam, mɛ́mla Utídal, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugóyim.

eng_Latn: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ikpó ɛbɛ́ ce ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē cikpó ɔnyā ā, é géē kpó anú mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
idu_Latn: N géē da uwɔ ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā. Ɔcɛ́ éyi nōo lɔfú klla lɛ íkwu nɛ̄hi géē bɛ̄cɛ. Ó kē ī gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄hi éyi. Ó klla í yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū alelékwū ā kahíníī, Yɔ̄ cíí, ká ā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔnyīlɔ ā! Alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ ɔnyīlɔ ā tá fīyajɛ iyɔ̄bū uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú nū á, amáŋ ó klla yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ijáalí koó yúklɔ́ lɔfú kóō tá aá mla ācɛ nēe bá Ulayodísīya mɛ́mla Uhiyerapólīsi ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
idu_Latn: Ācotɔ́sú kú aá lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā, amáŋ, abālɔbányā, é mɛ ŋmá ajɛ, bɛ̄ɛka aéfūma nōo le acá nwūla lɛ wu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
idu_Latn: Aá tá ɔ́sú ga Uspéni gē mīyɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔlamu, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ aóje ɔhá kú ɔ́lá kú iyó agbénú nɛ̄hi nāa lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
idu_Latn: Á híī gwō ohígbū oócí ŋ́, ohígbū ka á jé ɔdā nōo géē yá ŋmá abālɔbányā gāá kwu ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Amásīya, a yɔ̄ ī gwō ka anúɔ lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm yálé, ɔ́ɔmā kóō jé uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā klá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mla ɔbɔ́cɛ kú uwɔ cíí mɛ́ n̄. Ɔdíyá nāa gē nyɔ̄ ī pūla unwalu nōo géē bī ífi mɛ́mla ikwū wā í klá uwɔ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē gbɛlá iyi uwā ōfōōfūnū, é í yá unwū ije, ācɛ í bá ī hágágā, ācɛ géē yɔ́bɔ́bɔ́cɛ nɛ̄hi, ācɛ géē jīiyi uwā eyī, ācɛ í gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í gáā jɛ̄ uwā eyī ŋ́, ācɛ géē je pīya ācɛ o cɛ́ɛcá, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā tīihɔ tū uwā gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ géē tá ka aá gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ n yá aá bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ aícɔ́ɔci ohile āa? Ń táafú ŋ́ abɔ̄ ń da aá kú aá bī ije tū um abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā nɛɛ? Aá kócōō kwú ɔdōōbɔ̄bī nɛ̄ n yá ɔ́ɔmā í yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nēé géē je mlanyī Utáya iháyí ofɛtá cigwó. Iháyí ofɛtá cigwó wɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē yēeyī gaá kwu ā á. Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ɔ́ɔmā gaá le gla, ahɔ̄ kú Utáya géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka akwuna nēé le tū ije ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛpa kú ejé. Ocu kú ɛya nyā he Óndú ā ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ojīlīmā nyā je lɛ aá mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi o hile ā, abālɔbányā ɛga kú ɔcogwɛ́ɛya ā, nɛ̄ aá gē dɔɔ̄kā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Umósīsi Okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā eko nɛ̄ ōcē obɔ̄bí ā mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔbá ŋ́, jégēdē ámāŋ kōō jégēdē ŋ́ lɛ oji hɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá lɛ ɔbá lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
idu_Latn: É géē je īlī odufā ā pīya klá ede kú oje ɔdɔ ā, klla í je ɔkpɛ́ɛwū olɔhi ā í pīya klá anú, klla í je ɔcí ō le bī ɔ̄ ā wu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da aálá ā ka ń gáā leyīkwu uwá gɛ ŋ́. Aálá nōo í pɛ́ kwú nɛɛ, kéē pɛ́ kwú, aɛ́nɛ̄ o í pɛ́ bí nɛɛ, kéē pɛ́ bí. Aɛ́nɛ̄ e í hile ā géē kpó aɔ́mpa uwā yíífi.

eng_Latn: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: ámāŋ ācowūwī ā, ámāŋ ācɛ o yúnwū ɔdā ámāŋ ācogwéjé nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā ámāŋ ācɛ nēe ī bī ācɛ ɔhá iyē ámāŋ aúwī dúú í gáā lúgwū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú aá kéē bī ɔkɔ ékpónú le wóófu Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ádā kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē yá ācɛ kú Ujúda kéē le pīya ācɛ olɔfú. N géē hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá. N géē ményinyi uwā klla í kpó uwā wā ɔlɛ́. É géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nɛ̄ ń tá uwā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, géē pó ɔkɔ nēé í gbā gā um ā, n klla kē í tú uwā ohi.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn yá kpɛ́mm ā, mɛ́mla íjééyī kú nū ā, é lɛ uwá kpó tá tū ipú ɔkpá ígwú ōgbo kú Usólōmɔn.

eng_Latn: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
idu_Latn: N lɛ aá bī wā ipú ajɛ nōo lɔhi lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá jɔ́nyɛ kú īkpɔ̄cí kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdōōlɔhi kú nū. Amáŋ abɔ́ɔ aá gā ipú ajɛ kú um ā, aá kwú ajɛ ā ú tɛ̄ɛlihɔ. Aá klla kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ um je lɛ aá ā ú pīya ɔdā ō tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī yá ɛcí ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kōō lé ɛcí tīīyē ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ́ɔ́hɛ ámāŋ yá ɛ́dɔ̄ imabɔ̄ dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo gē yá alɛɛcɛ ā, gē yá aɛ́bɛ́ dúú á. Ācɛ gē kwú, aɛ́bɛ́ kē ī kwú dúú. Odúúdú ūwā gē fu owu ékpónú, éyi í olɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔhá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka oyēeyī wɛ áncā lɛ odúúdú ūwā.

eng_Latn: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ kú ipú aá, nɛ̄ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ gē da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā igbō, nōó géē je ɛcɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
idu_Latn: Ó hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka Ubɛ́tɛlu. Iyē kú igelī ā ɔ́ɔmā tɛtɛ wɛ Ulɔ́si.

eng_Latn: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ámnɔn lɛ ula yá ka anúɔ gē doōcē. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá gwutá agōdō ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é nwū ɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ádā nū, Ágábáidu, Udéfīdi, le yɛ nyɔ̄ gaá má ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ kóocōō ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ Utáma ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wā í lɛ ɔdōlé yá lɛ anúɔ ipéyī anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ ɔdōlé ā tū anúɔ okónu abɔ̄yīnū.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā le cɔ́nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ujúda ohígbū ka Umanásɛ tɛtɛ le ɔ́ yá cɔ̄nū o ŋmá lɛ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bī tū Óndú ā. Ɔnū kú Óndú ā í mɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le uwá kpó yálé. É ŋmó uwā klla nū uwā jāā ga Usídɔn nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla Umisrefotámeyim, jāā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɔpɛ́ kú Umíspa. É ŋmó uwá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aólɛlā ā í hile gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɛmiyɛ ŋmó uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó je Umaná lɛ uwá kéē lé. Ɔdōlé nɛ̄ uwá mɛ́mla ádáádā uwā í lé jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nwū uwā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔdōlé ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ í lé kéē yēeyī ā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔlɛɛcɛ cɛgbá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā.

eng_Latn: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ɔhá dúúmā ɛ́ɛ má ɔwɔ kú uwā kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɔlá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ pó ā, kéē klla yēeyī jéjéē ɛɛ́ ɛ̄ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā Ádā ā yíihɔtū tū um, ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ ká n̄ gekwú o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ klla yēeyī igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ā ahínyá, ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɔhi, ihɔtū kú nū kē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn, Usíhɔn kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́dɔm kwú pīya éwo kú abɔ̄yī uwā ŋmífī ɔ́ɔma. Eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, ācɛ kú Ulíbina kwú hɛ́ ŋmá Ujúda dúú.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ipú íwɔtū kú nū ā ó ményinyi Ujúda ŋ́, le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ūwā dóódu kpó yíífi tāajɛ. Ó le ɛga nōo yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē kwu nyɔ̄ eko nēé gē kpɛ́fú tú ūwā ā wúla tāajɛ ipú ícɔ̄nū kú nū. Óndú ā le ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú nū tú wāajɛ í bá ɛhájɛ ācɛ o hile.

eng_Latn: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, nɛ̄ ɔtū he uwá kéē bī ɔdā dóódu wā, ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́da lɛ Umósīsi kóō yá ā, le ɔdā dóódu kú ɛ̄gbā kú uwā, kpó wā gé lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death: for as when a man riseth against his neighbour, and slayeth him, even so is this matter:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā yá ɔ́yncɛ́nyā ā ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ́ bīyíne dúúmā nōo cíkā kéē ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́. Íne ā wɛ éékpónú mla íne kú eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ unu nu tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila nū kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ koó le ipí enyeenyi má, ó géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kóō le tēelihɔ ohígbū koó wɛ agwú.

eng_Latn: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gáā lɛ inu ā jila, nōó le má ka úwɔ́ɔhɔ̄ mɛ́mla émúká ā ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ gɔbū gɛ ŋ́ eko nēé le ɔ́ plla ā, ó géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka inu ā ɔ́ɔ le yá yēŋēē ɛɛ́, ohígbū keé kwú odúúdú émúká ā í kpó kla bónú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le odúúdú ícɔ̄nū kú nū pīya klá alɔ dúúdú. Ó le ɔlá hɛ́ kwu Ujerúsālɛm, ɔlá ā kwú ɔ̄ í yi tāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ kú Usamérīya éyi yɔ̄ ī bū ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ga iyāwu. Eko nōó lɛ ɔnyīlɔ ā má ā, ó le tū ɔ̄ eyīnyinyi.

eng_Latn: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya lɛ ígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja tɛ̄hɔ̄ kú é nyɔ̄ gaá gbō ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga, Umíkmāsi ā.

eng_Latn: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū le he ayíkpó ā nɛ̄hi, é klla le hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá cɛ̄ koó wɛ anú ɔkwɛyí ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔdā dúúmā amānyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í lé déē?.

eng_Latn: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔyā éyi nɛ̄ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónu ísu kú ɔ́gilɔ́ kú Aháfa, gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ yɔ̄ mla alɔ klla yɔ̄ í gbō alɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú alɔ, mɛ́mla ācɛ obɔ̄bí nēe kwāajɛ ipácí bā í gbēyī alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó um nɛɛ, ń gáā ka lɛ aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúdú ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā wɛ ákú um.

eng_Latn: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É gē kpó ije nɛ̄ Ulífāyi nēe gē gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe gē wā í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā lɛ Uhilikíya, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ Upáyílēti gē yɔ́tūkpoókpoó kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū géē he uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ Ubárābasi hɛ́tá lɛ uwá á. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si gɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tū uwā abɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
idu_Latn: É gē wā mɛ́mla aɛ́na, mɛ́mla áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā. Ɛwa kú uwā nēe ī wā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ bɛɛ̄ka aéfūma ā. Ɛwa kú uwā mɛ́mla aínyankūlūmī kú uwā nēe pɛ́ wā ā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́. É gē wā ī je ajɛ ā tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē mā ɔ̄ ɔnyā odiyɔ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó uwā lɛ uwá, amáŋ kéē híī yá ɔdā uwēyī mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā tá ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka Urútu, ɔ̄cɛnya kú Umówābu, ɔnyōkwū kú Umálɔn ā kwú pīya ɔnyā anúɔ dúú ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ agbénú ā tū iyē kú aókwūmā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ipɔ́ɔma mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwā í yɔ̄ ī gɔbū lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ipú ɔlɛ́ kú uwā. Ó ka odúúdú uwā ɛ́ɛ wɛ ijáalí kú ɛ̄nyā ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
idu_Latn: Úgbagwú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nōo lɔfú yá ɔ̄cɛ odée glá ā, le pɛ́ kwūūū wā í klá um báajɛ, bɛ̄ɛka úgbagwú kú itekwú nōo le cɔ̄nū ā, ámāŋ ka éŋkpɔ̄ ō pɛ́ wāajɛ lɔfú lɔfú ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī ka ā. Ó cokónu kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ alɔ nēe wɛ, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í kwúcē ga ipú ucē kú íla kú alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā Uhérɔ̄du, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ugálīli ā, le ofu kú Ujísɔ̄si pó.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā olɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. É géē yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā piyóó. ó kē í yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ. Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū ā wɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, odúúdú nū kē le kpaakpa eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
idu_Latn: Lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cotákwū ā, n gē tū iyē kú um akwū klla gē kwu ɔkpíyē kú um tū kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā. Ó lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ, ufi í yá um, ohígbū nɛ̄ n le ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ka lɛ ācɛ ɔhá kwɛyí nēé géē tá um ka ń yá jīla ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ulákisi gā Églɔn, le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá uwā.

eng_Latn: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
idu_Latn: N géē blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā Óndú. N géē blakwu ɔdā idáagó kú íkée kú uwɔ nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bā í kpo ije ā gɛɛcɛ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, kéē gaá le yúklɔ́ ā, Uhilikíya le ɔkpá kú íne kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Umósīsi ā pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó tū agbá ɔlɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbājɛ ā, ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n géē kpó ayí Ulífāyi ā kwɛyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū ā, géē lɛ oyēeyī ōlīkpō ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka á lɛ íne nyā tū glá ŋ́, ayíka a géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
idu_Latn: Usitífin nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi klla le ɔfú nɛ̄hi je lɛ ɔ́ ā, yá ɔdā idáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄hi alɛwa ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ka lɛ ohilí nū, odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá Uféro mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, ohígbū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ ōwē dóódu nɛ̄ ó má ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú á nya uwá tá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛlá gbo tū ɔ kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ aɛ́na kú oje ɔdɔ ɛpa ma, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá húmáyī nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm nyɔ̄ í gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā gbojī jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá má aɔ́wɔ kú áa nēe kpo áa bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā bá á.

eng_Latn: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Umanásɛ le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nyā yá, nɛ̄ ó klla yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn nēe bá gbɔbū lɛ ɔ́ ā yá ā, nɛ̄ ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda le ɔ́bíipú kú ɛcí ō pā bī ā.

eng_Latn: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā í klá éyi kú ayí Ulífāyi nōo háyi abɔ́ɔ mla uwá ā, iyē nū lé ka Ujahásīyɛlu, ɔyí kú Usekaríya. Ó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu, anɔ́ɔ ó ŋmá ɔkwu kú Umɛtánáya, Ujɛ́yɛlu mɛ́mla Ubenáya.

eng_Latn: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
idu_Latn: É yá ɛ̄cī ɛtá abɔ́ɔ klla bá í lé ɔdōlé klla bá í gwá, ohígbū ka ayínɛ́ uwā ā le tútū ō mīyɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄nya ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, je éŋkpɔ̄ nyā gā um, ká ijēēnyi kóō híī ŋmó um gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ híī bēē wā amānyā gaá pi éŋkpɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ācɛ ɛhīlī, ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō ā, ācɛ ɛnɛ, ɔwɛ kú ɛháajɛ ā, ācɛ ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ákú Usísa nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá je ɔdā nēe wɛ ákú Usísa ā lɛ Usísa. Aá kē je aɛ́nɛ̄ e wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ɔwɔciō.

eng_Latn: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dóódu gē tíne kéē téeyī olɔhi kú ācɛ nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ dóódu gē je iyī uwā ka aá wɛ oklóbīya kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá ɛhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kwú ɛcɔ̄ ú kwaajɛ ɛyí únóji kú Urécɛ̄lu kéē bī lɛ blakwu ɔ́ á. Ɛcɔ̄ ā kē kwu unóji kú nū jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ alɛwa kéē lɛ odée jé ohígbū ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ okwɛyí Ohɔ́nyɛtá á, nááná nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ agbá abālɔbányā ā, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēé kwú íne nɛ̄ ó bīya ā í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi, nēé klla habɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó yá ā tá lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
idu_Latn: Olɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ ɔtūce Óndú, fíyɛ́ ō lɛ ɔtūce aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ɔlamu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya le ɔ́ má ā, é le ayípōklóbīya ofu cigwó tū nyɔ̄ í bá mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, abɔ̄ o cīce mɛ́mla aítíca kú ācɛ Ujíyu, yɔ̄ gē jāhɔ lɛ uwa klla yɔ̄ ī da uwá ɔ̄kā.

eng_Latn: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā alɛwa ŋmá ɛgiyí aɛ́cí mɛ́mla aógwɛ́bā, amáŋ, ohi nēé gē tā uwā ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛlā icííci nɛ̄ ó lɛyí ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe gē ka ɛyí ɔ̄na ā, gē bī aá nyíleyī. Ɔtū nēé tá aá anú lé ā, wɛ áncā nɛ n. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ ā bá ī yɛ gicō gajɛ bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēe pɛ́ gebí ā. É bá ipú unwalu, ohígbū ka é lɛ otrɛ̄yí nōo gē gbō uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔtōōkpóce Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú ā. Aá géē bī ɔkplɛ́fú nyā le nyí ɔlá kú ɔyí ō cɔ̄lá nɛ̄ ebilíi ī tá lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ okónu ō tá lɛ ācɛ ɔhá he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, kéē lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ́ dúú. Ó tíne ō hɔ́ɔhā cɛ ācɛ ɔhá ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō híī hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá kwú ojīlīma ú ce ɔ̄cɛ o yá ifa lɔhi ā fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aá gē da ɔ́ ka óo wā í cīce ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú amānyā, amáŋ ó kē da ogbɛhá ā ka, háyi abɔ́ɔ, ámāŋ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ cīce ajɛ amānyā pi ikpó kú anúɔ.

eng_Latn: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, aá nuunu tá ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā. Amáŋ á jé ka ukpa nɛ̄ n jē ga uwɔ ā lɛ uwɔ kwú ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
idu_Latn: Ussɔ́wulu ma Ussálum, nōo ma Umíssma ā á.

eng_Latn: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi lɛ uwa hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ ā le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɛlā ka mla uwá.

eng_Latn: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
idu_Latn: N gē ka aíne nɛ̄ um bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ, ohígbū keé cɛ̄ lɛ ufi gē yá um.

eng_Latn: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n má ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā bá ī yá ā wɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī. É bá gē cikpó anyā nēe wɛ anyā uwā ŋ́, klla bá ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. É ī cɛ̄tra ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cɛ̄ pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá obɔ̄bí nōō ī yá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā uwá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ Ugomóra ā.

eng_Latn: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́mahāapa nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa tá ūlī je ajɛ lɛ uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán.

eng_Latn: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ŋ́. Ń kwu ŋ́. Nááná Iríja í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó lɛ ɔ́ kwú ga ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí ā.

eng_Latn: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálāki da Ubálam kahíníī, Wā mla um ká ālɔ̄ ga ɛga ɔhá, ɛga nāa géē má ācɛ ōhī kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gā um.

eng_Latn: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
idu_Latn: Ó tíne ɔyínɛ́ nū Usáyímɔ̄ni aflɛ́yí. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ lɛ Umɛsáyíya ā má ɛɛ́ .

eng_Latn: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú um tá ipú agbá kú ōwē, ɔnɔ, mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le da Ugɛ́hási, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā kóō gaá lɛ ɔnyā ā hīgwú wā. Eko nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā gā ā.

eng_Latn: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n da uwɔ ɛlā kú ɛcɛ, nɛ̄ á cɛ̄ ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó lɛ nāa géē cɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛlā kú ɔkpáncō da uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce Unówa mɛ́mla ayí kú ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwā kahíníī, Áā ma ayí lɛwa kú aá nyīla ga odúúdú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī ɔmɛtá ā, é bī abɔ̄ uwā lɛ iyó úklɔ́ kú úgbéenyi ā kpó tá tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
idu_Latn: Á klá cíí glá ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ísu nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī túgbagwú ā. Á gáā wɛ aflɛ́yí gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka a le agōdō kú um nyíla. A gaá le gbo mla ɔnyā nɛ̄ n gē gwutá mla anú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
idu_Latn: Kwú uwā ú kpó ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá bá iyɔ̄bū kú ikpati ɛka, ɛga nɛ̄ n géē jīla mla awɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá Umísipa, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ ohígbū aá.

eng_Latn: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī gē yúula ka aá lɛ ije, amáŋ é kē lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔhá yúula ka aá gbɛhá, amáŋ é kē lɛ ije mɛ́mla agbénú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛcɔ̄ gbō playi ɔ́ŋgbá kéē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā lipú lɛ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le jé ka ó wɛ umíta ofɛpa. Eko le gla lígíí é klla le ɔ́ miya kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é klla le jé ka ó wɛ umíta ofucigwó.

eng_Latn: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
idu_Latn: Unwalu yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú um mɛ́mla odúúdú iyē kú um nɛ̄hi. Óndú, eko nyá nāa gē gbēyī gaá kwu ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá um abɔ̄ āa?.

eng_Latn: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbō ɛcɛ mla ucē okpaakpa, klla ī bī ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla okpaakpa kɛpɔ̄ tū alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujúda ā cɛ̄ ka aá le íne bīya klla le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Óndú lé ɛpɔ̄hi kú igbīhi nɛ̄ ó cē kwu alɔ āá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ ka, Nyɔ̄ ɛbɔ́. Amáŋ, abɔ̄ Unáaman le yɛ kpií ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́. Ó kahíníī, Ísrɛ̄lu, blakwu ɔdā nēe bá nyā. A wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ. Ami yá uwɔ ka wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um á. N kē gáā mlanyi uwɔ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ a gē kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō í jé ɔdā nōo ī yá ā glá ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō í kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā glá ŋ́ ohígbū ka ojuja odobū lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ ŋmá ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo ī hɛ́ ɛpɔ̄hi gā um ā kwu um ajaajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔtū kpó ɛlā dúúmā ce um glá āa? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō wā ká ālɔ̄ kɛpɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo tíne ō bɛ̄yíkwu um, kóō wā í leyīkwu um eyī mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udelíla má ka ɔ́ɔ le odúúdú ɔtū kú nū ka lɛ anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū gāá lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ufilístiya ā kpó hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ wā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, ohígbū koó le odúúdú ɔtū kú nū kpó ka lɛ anúɔ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ wā mɛ́mla ije nēé gáā gbā lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ipú, kwú aɛ́fu ā í mulɛ bɛ̄ɛka ikpó ofucɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ, kú aá leyīkwu ɔdōnīgbō kú ācɛ Ufárisīi mɛ́mla ācɛ Usádusīis.

eng_Latn: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n kwú cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwɔ ɛɛ́ mā, n géē cɛ lɛ uwá yá mla awɔ ipú ícɔ̄nū kú uwā. É géē kpó uwɔ ɛnwū mɛ́mla ahɔ̄ hɛ́, klla í bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ dúúma nēe hile oyēeyī. É géē kpó ayí uwɔ kwú aɔ́fiyɛ, klla í je ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ohile kpó tū ɔlá oyēeyī.

eng_Latn: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
idu_Latn: Nááná, Urúbɛ̄n, ɔyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā ma ayí ɛnɛ. É wɛ Uhánoku, Upálu, Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Ukámi.

eng_Latn: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Íjīpiti wɛ Ulúdim mɛ́mla Anamím mɛ́mla Ulehabím mɛ́mla Unāftuhím.

eng_Latn: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, uwá í gáā wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um gɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ uwá gē túblá ɔdā otīihɔ dúúmā ámāŋ ka ɔdā otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú kú um ā ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ōwē kú aúcē ɛbí nēé yá ā á.

eng_Latn: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā í gē cē ɛdɔ ácí ɔ́ɔmā tū ipú abɔ̄ kú nū, ámāŋ ka ó tá ɔ̄ bá ɛ̄wɛ̄ɛ̄wɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, n kwú eyī ú kwaajɛ cíí, okónu í kōō hɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tɛ́ɛcɛ bá ī wú ahɛ ɛha bɛ̄ɛka ewō nēe bá ī yɛ gicō gaajɛ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔfú kú nū mafú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, oŋmá lɛ ajɛ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ ó je kpó lɛ uwá kéē lúugwū nū ā.

eng_Latn: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujúdasi, éyi kú ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā wā á. Ó wā mla ɛwa kú ācɛ nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya mla aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ fu tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā. É bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mla ogbló abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N da aá ka ɛhi nɛ̄ ɔnyōkwū ogbɛhá nyā je ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ákú odúúdú ācɛ ɔhá ā á.

eng_Latn: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko kú ikwū kú nū le bá āa, ó le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú abɔ̄ í wu um agada ká ā lɛ okónu ce gā um ka á gáā je um nyi ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɔdā ōlɛ agege ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ka ipú Ɔkpíihɔ ā, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tíne ō gwō, kóō gwō kú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ acá bū bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ā, le wu ga ɛga oligbō fíyɛ́ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ámāŋ ka n gaá lā ɛga oligbó fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē yá kú ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā kéē móōwē, é klla í jé ɔnɔ iyē. Ó í kē í gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu aflɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gaá ce aílɔ́wá.

eng_Latn: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn gɔbū mla ɛlā kú nū ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ádā um Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le miya ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā lɛ awɔ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ihɔtū ō yá tū Ɔwɔicō wɛ ka ālɔ̄ lɛ íne kú nū tū. Íne kú nū í kē lɔnɔ ō le tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
idu_Latn: Woó Ujerúsālɛm! Ujerúsālɛm! Ācɛ kú uwɔ lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kpó ŋmó, klla bī ɛcɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēé tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwā ā kpó ŋmó. Igbɛmlá nɛ̄ n tíne kú n lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ túbá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ugwū gē kpó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū tū ɛháajɛ acá kú nū ā. Amáŋ é jɛga ga um ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
idu_Latn: Ó le igelī nɛ̄hi ā yálé klla mīyɛ ɔ́ tābɔ̄. Ó le ɔcɛ́ kú uwā kwú klla mīyɛ aígelī kú uwā nēe kwu uwá ajaajɛ ā. Ó le odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá aɔ́cɛ́ kú Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Ulíbina ā, nɛ̄ ó yá aɔ́cɛ́ kú Udɛ́biri mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá ba ɔdā dúúmā ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācɛ kú um ā, n géē yá ɔ̄ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā okónu áncā í gáā nwū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛlā ŋ́. Ó pó ɛlā kú uwɔ ā dúú nɛ, amáŋ ó gáā bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō á, aá lɔtūce ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ Ulífayi dóódu nōo cɛ̄ lɔfú ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ga ɛga ékpónú nēe gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ́gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́tro kahíníī, N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo nyā aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Uféro mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā. N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā nōo nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá ɔfiyɛ ā!.

eng_Latn: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ iyíipú nū mɛ́mla aíklíkpó kú nū ā kpó na éŋkpɔ̄ ā, Umósīsi kwú odúúdú ɛbɛ́ kú omlede ā ú yɔlá kóō wɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā nɛ̄ ocu kú nū í he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n géē ba Ádā ā kóō je otɔ́tūlé ɔhá lɛ á, nōo géē yɔ̄ mla aá piyóó.

eng_Latn: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ō jé ācɛnyīlɔ tū ɔ̄ kú ɔnyā ōgbajā ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukpa ā lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó he Óndú ā ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá má ēpū kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō lu, aá jé ka ɔnɔ ɔ́ɔ le bá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko dúú nɛ̄ unwalu gaá ce uwá nɛ, é kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō gaá gbɔɔ́ ō dɔɔ̄kā nū gbéeko nēé lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ alɛwa hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ odoōcē yɔ̄ gē kwɛga ga ɛgiyí nū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
idu_Latn: Ó da ācɛ nēe jīla anú eyī ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā um gbō iyó ogbɛnú kú ōwē ce aá nɛɛ, n géē gbō iyó ogbɛnu fíyɛ́ ce ɔ́ lɛ aá kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó bī itali le ŋmó aá ijē nɛɛ, n géē bī itali ɛdɛ le ŋmó aá ijē.

eng_Latn: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
idu_Latn: Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ abɔ̄ ɔyā ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā gbɔɔ́ ō hɔ́hā ce Óbɛ́dɛ̄dɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla odúúdú úklɔ́ nōó gē yá ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
idu_Latn: Uwá kē ī wɔ́tū uwɔ dúú, géē je odúúdú agbénú mla iyō kú uwɔ nāa yúklɔ́ kú nū ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ ā kpó, klla géē pllá īlī ŋmá uwɔ iyē, je uwɔ ɔkwu tɛ́ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ā. Únwū ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla akwuna ō yá kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ igbō nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō á. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka igbō nɛ̄ aádáádā aá lé, nēé pɛ́ gekwú ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ igbō nyā lé géē yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá bī ɛlā nēe bá nyā le tá iyī aá ɔtūlé.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē yá kéē yá aólɛlā kú uwā nēe gē nuunu tá uwā ā lé. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē ŋmá abɔ̄ éyi wā gaá nuunu tá uwā, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ géē kwinya ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā ga abɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujúda ga Uhɛ́brɔn abɔ́ɔ gāa lɛ anɔ̄ tū Udéfīdi ɛyí kóō kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. É le da Udéfīdi ka ācɛ kú igelī nēé hī ka Ujábessi ipú ajɛ Ugílɛ̄di ā, ɛ́ɛ nyi okwū kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayí nū á.

eng_Latn: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ka éyééye kú aɔ́dée ā lɛ abɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔ̄cɛ ā ɛháajɛ acá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Utéra wɛ iháyí ofɛtá ce igwó ā, ó kwú pīya ádā kú Ébram mɛ́mla Unáhɔ mɛ́mla Uháran.

eng_Latn: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā jājīlīmā klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi, íjééyī kú nū í tōō le miya ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
idu_Latn: É le ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kpó ŋmó icííci. Ayí uwā nēé je kpó ŋmó je gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú Ukénan á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā oyī kú ayípɛ̄ ā kwú ajɛ ā ú tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɔtūce ɔ́ lɛ ā má ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmííyē ā kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um, é kwú íne nāa bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, uwēyī lɛ um kwū, ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā. N kē le pīyabɔ̄ abālɔbányā, klla lɛ úmlá mɛ́mla ewo wu klá ɛyí ká n̄ ma ɔtūnōbí fú ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu gā um lɛ ā, ā cɛ̄ gā um gwōnū ŋ́. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú je jé um iyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ tɔ́ɔkpá nēé tā ā, aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Unehemíya, igbómína kú alɔ, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uhálikāliya, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Usedekíya lɛ abɔ̄ tɔ́ɔkpá ɔ̄ gboce ɔ́ á. Ācɛ ɔhá nēe bá nyā lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá ā ce īyī wā ŋmá ipú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā:.

eng_Latn: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
idu_Latn: Aíyó ɔ́hí kú uwā nōó tɛtɛ ī lā ā wɛ ugóolu, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ogbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́, mɛ́mla ɔká, mɛ́mla íhō, mɛ́mla īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ o ceyī ŋmɛɛ́ŋmɛ́ɛ, mɛ́mla īlī otōmbíyē, mɛ́mla ahilíki, mɛ́mla īlī nɔ̄wá yōōlō, mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛdɔ ɔcí okpóocu, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé bī ayīnu adāgbá yá ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé bī ɔcí ogbɔɔ́lá le gbā ā, mɛ́mla oje udɔ, mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hɛ́ nēé ī le gwó ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwɔ, bá í cá ɔcɛ́ nāa fu ā ɛcá, Óndú. Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ó nyɔ̄, é bá í cá ɔ̄ ɛcá.

eng_Latn: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá ɔnyā lɛ íkwu kóō cɛ̄ oji nɛ̄ ɔnyā nū hɛ́ ā, ámāŋ ka oōtá kú oji dóódu nɛ̄ ɔnyā hɛ́ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛyítájɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ā klla le uwa kpó yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gboce ɔ́ ā wɛ Ɛlísaa, ɔyí kú Udódo nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ahóhi ā. Ɛ̄cī éyi anú mɛ́mla Udéfīdi ōfōōfū uwā leyī méyī mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ufilístiya nēe túbá kéē kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ohile le yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔdā nēé ka ā jé ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī junwalu lɛ ɔnyā ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ɔdā olɔhi nōó yá gā um á.

eng_Latn: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um, nɛ̄ aá lɛyí táajɛ le íne kú um, nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā klla gbɔɔ́ ō pā ɛcí.

eng_Latn: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le héyī ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, é má ɛnɔ yɔ̄ í tá ce éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kóō kwú tɔ́wá bōō bɛ̄ɛka oyī ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ohilí kú Umósīsi, ācɛ Ukéni ā, le yɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujérīko, igelī nēé hī ka igelī kú ɔcí alī ā, ipú ajɛ ɛfā kú ɛháajɛ kú Árādi ipú Ujúda. É nyɔ̄ í lā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki.

eng_Latn: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kwú eyī ú gwū ɛlā kú anyākwɔ́cɛ ā bónū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛlā olɔnɔ fíyɛ́ ka lɛ ācɛ aā á.

eng_Latn: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú okwúukwu í kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ujísɔ̄si, anɔ́ɔ ó le ahínyá tá ɔ̄ á. Ɔnyīlɔ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Usamérīya.

eng_Latn: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
idu_Latn: É géē lɛ úklɔ́ kú iyó nēe bá nyā ō bī.

eng_Latn: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú alɔ í jé ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo gáā da alɔ ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛcɛ nyā ga ɛgiyí ádā nū ā le yá, ɛcī éyi gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lé ucɛ kú onyatá. Ó húmáyī yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kē yíihɔtū tū uwā jāā ga eko ámōōmɛ á.

eng_Latn: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
idu_Latn: A kwú itekwú ú klá ɔ́ iyē bɛ̄ɛka awulú ā, éŋkpɔ̄ klla kwú aɛ́fu ā ú mulɛ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄nyā ā, aá ī cībéenú ce īyī aá ka aá wɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ācɛ nēe ŋmó ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ kaó jégēdē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ ó wɛ ámíyā nɛɛ, ó lɔ́fú kwinya ɔ́ci ga ɛga nɛ̄ n géē mafú lɛ aá ā. Abɔ̄ í gáā kwu ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ ī gwō ohígbū nū mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ó wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́! Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ alɔ í cíkā ō gwō ŋ́ mā a? Ó wɛ ohígbū ka alɔ gē lɛ íne ā tū nɛɛ? Ehéee, amáŋ ohígbū ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ohi nōó tá um ā wɛ, Odúúdú ɔdā nōo ce uwɔ ɛgbá ā wɛ ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú um nɛ̄ n gē je gā awɔ ā nɛ̄. Ohígbū ka ɔfú kú um gē lɔfú nɛ̄hi ipú ācɛ nēe kwáahi ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ka n̄ je iyī um gicō ohígbū á lɔfú iyē ŋ́ kú um, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔfú kú Ɔwɔicō kóō gbō um ɛyí.

eng_Latn: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufílīstiya kpó hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ é da uwā ɔ̄kā ka, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē yá mla Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā? Anɔ́ɔ é tá uwā ohi ka, Aá kwú ɔ̄ ú bī ga Ugáti . Anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú bī ga abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gē gbēyī ɛ̄cī kú Óndú ā, aá cēyītīkwū ká aá yá ká ɛ̄cī ā kóō gā fíyaa, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔkpáncō géē yɔlá klla í je gbliífi ā, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ idɔlá géē je aɔ́dā nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā kpó ja bónū ā.

eng_Latn: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko dúúmā nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā hɛ́ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá, kéē jɛ̄ ga ɔbū lɔhi ɔhá nɛɛ, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ kē ī má ipú uwā ā wɛ obíipú mla uce obɔ̄bí kú uwā. É gē hɛ́ iyī uwā lé, gē ca inu kú ācɛ, nyɔ̄ ī wūūwī, klla ī hɛ́ ācɛ éjulúgwu úláyi ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔdā nɛ̄ um gáā ka nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a le tayínū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ á. N jé ka a kē yɔ̄ ī yá ojuju ō yá um ɔdā nēé bá nyā.

eng_Latn: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Udánīyɛlu ā yɔ̄ ekwu aláadi ɛtá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Uhumáti, Uhɛ́brɔn, mɛ́mla Usíyɔ. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ahāanɛ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwá nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ nū yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm, ó kē lā ɛyí ɛfú kú Usáyɔn.

eng_Latn: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔɔ́ ō ka atufú lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ī bīya iyē kú nū mɛ́mla iyē kú ācɛ nēe lā ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka, Ugássɔm, nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, N wɛ ugbɔga ipú ajɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka, Nyɔ̄ gicɔ̄ ɛfu kú Abarím kú ā gaá lɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ n géē je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā má.

eng_Latn: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ, Ujédāya, ɔyí kú Ujoyárību mɛ́mla Ujácin.

eng_Latn: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā kwú, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ é kwú okwū kú nū ú tá tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin ā.

eng_Latn: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
idu_Latn: Anú ōfōōfūnū gē gbō um klla gē nya um tá á. Anú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú kú um á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā yá um lé glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Usádɔku kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā ofōōfū uwā géē wā ɛgiyí um gaá gbā um ɛ̄gbā á. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā je ɔ́da nyā á. Aá géē je ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna lɛ uwá ka é je gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ā.

eng_Latn: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá, yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē da uwɔ ka ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
idu_Latn: Aá kē híī je omlɛ́nyɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nōó kwú Ujerúsālɛm ú tú glayá klla kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya igelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ géē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce ká ā gbō um á. Ā cɛ̄ kú uwēyī kóō lɛ um kwú ŋ́. Abɔ̄ a kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē yá ucē okpaakpa ā, lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ híīī lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú ikpɔnyā ɔhá ō ce ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā lɛpɔ̄bī nū nɛ̄ ipú ɛcí ékpónú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ úlā ofɛpa cigwáahāapa cofigwó kú uwá kpó ŋmó ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
idu_Latn: Aá da um ɛ́ɛ́, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá ga ɛcɛ nyɔ̄ gáā má āa? Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ nɛɛ? Īī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ̄, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá má ā nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛlā wu ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó géē yá uwā italā, klla í je uwá kpó yíífi piyóó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Ubássa lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujérobōwam. Ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujérobōwam ā kpó ŋmó jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá nyā, é géē kpó uwēyī tū odúúdú uwā ɛyí, klla ī tá uwā wāajɛ. Ɔwɔicō, ā híī je yá uwā ɛhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó gé lɛ Ujóssuwa, mɛ́ma odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwu uwá u kpó bá iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́kpa kú oje udɔ ofu nēe wu ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje udɔ ofu nēe lɛ uwɔ mɛ́mla ogbló nēé yá mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ā bī ɔ̄ háyi a.

eng_Latn: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔdā ojīlīmā ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ īyī nū tū cíí ŋmá ikpɛ́lā, amáŋ olíla gē yíkpɛ́lā eko dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Ulífāyi cāŋjɛ, mabɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu kú nū tá, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu á.

eng_Latn: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, n tíne ka aá jé ka ń gáā yá ɔdā nyā ohígbū aá ŋ́. N tíne ka aá yá uwēyī ohígbū ucē dóódu nɛ̄ aá bá ī yá ā. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄, eko a le yá, n gēe hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá ipú abɔ̄ mla ɔfú kú Asírīya; é klá gāa lɛ agbá mla ákanya kú uwá uwɔ aá ɔkɔ ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā ga um igbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce ā Énɔ̄ku í kwú ŋ́, amáŋ é kwú ɔ̄ ú oyēeyī ga ɔkpáncō. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í jé ɛgiyí nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō. Ofíílí kéē je ɔ́ nyɔ̄ ā, é cɛ̄ ijáalí lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā yá.

eng_Latn: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
idu_Latn: N gē tá Óndú ā ahínyá eko dóódu. N géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá áyɔ́kpá kú Éngēdi jāā ga áyɔ́kpá kú Enegléyim ā, ācokwɛ́bényi gē bá okónu ísu nɛ̄hi ā. É í nā ɛ́yá kú uwá daa klla ɛcɛ ká ō ŋmó. Ɛdɔ ɛbéenyi alɛwa gē bá abɔ́ɔ bɛ̄ɛka ákú ísu nɛ̄hi kú Umeditarénīya ā.

eng_Latn: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, é géē yá uculo kéē lɛ uwá iyē gwu ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwā kóō le yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: A géē móōwē kú ɔdā icííci mɛ́mla ucē ɛbí nāa yá ɔ́ɔmā. Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
idu_Latn: Īī, ácí gē ŋmó, ododó kē ī cá, amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ka ā í géē pīyabɔ̄ gbógbóōō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō lɔfú ō je ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú ā pi nyɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cāŋ́jɛ, oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa da Ákan kahíníi, Ɔyí um, lɛ ojīlīma je lɛ iyē kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā cɛ̄tra anú. Kóocōō, da um abālɔbányā ɔdā nāa yá ā. A híī je ɔ́ tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
