idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú iyó mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ā tīkwū bá ɛyɔ́ɔ́pu. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú nū kpó yɔlá, kóō wɛ ɛya nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gwó lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā tú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā gwó igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ aá le yɛ tá ipú igelī dóódu nēé mīyɛ aá, aá kóō lé ɔdā dúú nēé je lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébulɔn: Íssmáya, ɔyí kú Obadíya. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli: Uhóséya, ɔyí kú Ásrīyɛlu.

eng_Latn: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
idu_Latn: Ā je mlanyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī cá ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nyā ɛcá ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtū lé kpɔ́ lɛyíkwu odúúdú ɛcá nɛ̄ aéwɔhá ā cá um ā.

eng_Latn: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ ísu kú Ujɔ́dan abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa le yá kwɛyí. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Umósīsi je ɔ́da lɛ Ujóssuwa lɛyíkwu á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā páápá le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
idu_Latn: É gáā yɛce ugbɔga ŋ́. É géē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ohígbū kéē jé ɔkɔ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla anúɔ kóō gaá lɛ ɔdōlé lé.

eng_Latn: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwú, kwú abɔ̄ í bī ɔ̄ lɔfú lɔfú á.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le da odúúdú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá mla anú ā kahíníī, Aá le ɔwɔ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ aá bī ā kpó bónū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ īyī aá iyē gwu yēŋēē. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le īlī oyēŋēē kú aá kpó wiyē.

eng_Latn: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
idu_Latn: Úsi wɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí á. Ubúsi wɛ ɔyí nōo gboce ɔ́ á. Ukémūwɛlu, nōo wɛ ádā kú Áram, gboce Ubúsi á.

eng_Latn: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ dúúmā í klá gāa lā alácɛ̄ kú nū gbóógbóō glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ; ācɛ oonyīla eyī kú v a i gāa lɛ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwa kwu ajɛ abɔ́ɔ glá ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ oogboalá dúúmā gēe kpó álá kú nū nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ í la ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
idu_Latn: Usɛdɛkíya lɛ Ujɛ́hūka ɔyí kú Ussɛlɛmíya, mɛ́mla Usɛfaníya, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Umaásēya ā tɛ̄hɔ fu Ujeremíya gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Gbɔ̄ɔ̄kɔ lɛ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā lɛyíkwu alɔ.

eng_Latn: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā lɛ ā. Ádina wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda á. Aícɔ́ɔja úlā bá ɛgiyí úlā, ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó , bá ɛháajɛ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
idu_Latn: Abíssāyi, ɔyínɛ́ Ujówābu, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwā lé ka Userúya ā, wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú ofu cigwó ā á. Anú ōfōōfūnū bī óbō le kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Ɔ́ɔmā yá nōó lóofu ipú Aícɔ́ɔja ofu cigwó ā á.

eng_Latn: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā lɔfú yá uwɔ lé gbóógbō glá ŋ́ ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla Umósīsi ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē yɔ̄ mla awɔ á. N gáā jé uwɔ kwɛjí ɔwɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je mlanyī uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá jɛ̄ gɔbū ká aā túblá Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo gē yíihɔtū tū aá, kú ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ gē túblá anú ajaajɛ, o yá ká ālɔ̄ jɛ̄ fíyɛ́. Ālɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra anú ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ojīlīma ce Ohɔ́nyɛtá abālɔbányā mɛ́mla eko nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́ mā. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le tūblā Áyísīki ádā nū ajaajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū le abɔ̄ ma ɔ́ iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔkɛ̄lā ā wɛ ákú Ujékɔ̄pu, amáŋ, abɔ̄ ā wɛ ákú Ísɔ.

eng_Latn: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
idu_Latn: Usánōwa, Ɛngánim, Utápūwa, Ɛ́nam.

eng_Latn: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē tū ɔwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ī yá klá ɛcɛ á. Ó lɔfú tū ɔ̄ kóō yá ācɛ italā. Ó klla lɔfú tū ɔ̄ kóō yá olɔhi lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
idu_Latn: Aá le jī ɛɛ́! Aá nēe gē cāŋjɛ ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī, gē gbɔɔ́ ō gwá ejé olɔfú ā. Aá kē í gwá ejé jāā ga āhāpōtú gbēeko nōó lɛ aá kwú.

eng_Latn: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
idu_Latn: N je eyī gicō má aɛ́fu ā, iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í tá um abɔ̄ ā géē wā ŋmá ā?.

eng_Latn: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
idu_Latn: Ɔcányā kú éwo nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā géē cāŋjɛ ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ géē cījáalí tū ācɛ kú eko nyā. Ó kē géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí. Ohígbū koó ŋmá ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi kóō gaá pó ɛlā kú íjééyī kú Usólōmɔn. Amáŋ n da aá ka ɔdā nōo fíyɛ́ Usólōmɔn kē yɔ̄ amānyā abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, abɔ̄ é yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ le bá lɛ Ujópa ā, Upíta le tá inicō ɛplá ɛnɔ oyɛ̄ɛyí ā kóō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ī gbō aéwo ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Anú tū ɛgahi fíyɛ́ dúú ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki le tá Utébēs, le íbɔm cē tū igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ā gē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā gē yá ucē kpaakpa lɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛlā nāa í ka ā, géē máfú ka a jɔ́dā.

eng_Latn: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
idu_Latn: Ó le eliká kú ugóolu nēé géē bī lɛ je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ā yá kwu ɛháajɛ kú okónōgwu nū. Ɛpɛɛpa yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ éyi lɛ eyī pīya kwu iyī ūwā.

eng_Latn: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Awɔ ɔ̄cɛ oleyīɛpa! Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá gē wī ɔbá ɛna ámāŋ ka ijakī kú nū ŋmá ɔcí gē bī ɔ̄ gaá gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ɛ̄cī usábāti.

eng_Latn: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
idu_Latn: A le yēŋēē, lɛ ācɛ nēe le yēŋēē ā. Amáŋ, a gē yá mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ucē kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ācɛ Ugríisi bá ipú ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ɔnū ucɛ gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú leyī gwō ɛ̄nyā bónū, aá leyī gwō ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā bónū.

eng_Latn: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ, éyi kú ɔmáapú ɔnyā ā géē lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí ádā nū. Ó ī kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya. É géē bēhé ga igá olɔfú kú ɔlɛ́ uwā í yá uwā yálé.

eng_Latn: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá jē lɛ uwá ā, amáŋ aá, ācɛ nēe bá nyā í lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ohígbū koó le yálé, klla le aícɔ́ɔja alɛwa kpó ŋmó ā, amáŋ ó gáā yɔ̄ ī yálé píyóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ, n lɛyí cíikwū ɛ̄cī dóódu! N yɔ̄ ī gɔ̄ ohígbū aá, ipú opīyatɔ̄há kú alɔ mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, Óndú alɔ ā, anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n ka ɛ̄nyā tɛ́ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
idu_Latn: N géē hɛ́ ɔhā ce uwá klla í yá ké ē lā yɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú um ā tá biílí ɛbɔ́. N géē je ɔwɔ lɛ uwá eko nɛ̄ ó cē ɛgbá ā abɔ́ɔ. Ɔwɔ ā géē yā cabácabá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ufínēhasi, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí igwó nēe ŋmá odúúdu aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le ɛlā nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛn, Ugádi mɛ́mla āyā kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ ā ka lɛ uwá ā pó ā, ɛlā ā le nū uwā ipú.

eng_Latn: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā bá ī cɛ̄tra um eko dóódu, n kē yɔ̄ ī lɔfú iyē eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā Ukapánɔm ā, ācodɔlɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gā ɛgiyí Upíta. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca kú aá í gē da ije ɔlɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ɛga dóódu nēé géē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi nyā ipú ɛcɛ, é géē kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyā nyā yá ā, kéē bī le blakwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ iyē kú ádā alɔ cíkā ō bí ŋmá ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā? Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ ó ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ŋ́ mā nɛɛ. Aá lɛ ajɛ je lɛ alɔ pi aɔ́máapú kú ádā alɔ.

eng_Latn: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nɛ̄ n leyīce á. N húmáyī lɔtū ce uwɔ ŋmífī nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
idu_Latn: Aá híīī mlanyī ŋ́, ayínɛ́ um, ɔdā nōo yá aádáádā alɔ eko nēé tá Umósīsi ɔkwu ā. Ojuja gbō uwā ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ le hɛ́ ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā igbó ga abɔ̄ ɔhá mɛɛ́lɛ á.

eng_Latn: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le tá abɔ́ɔ ā, ó má ɔcɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ māháyi pī upíla kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uculo kú ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ uwá lɛ ā, ācogbāājɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ o tá opo ā le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá. Ācɛ ajɛ ohile ā, bá í tá opo, bá gē jīījē, é klla bá gē gwéeyē. Anɔ́ɔ Atálīya lɛ īlī kú nū híla, le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka, Ibīyājɛ. Ibīyājɛ.

eng_Latn: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā í mīyɛ aá ŋ́, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ úmlá nōo bá aá ikpó ā gwō bónū kóō mafú lɛ uwá ka Ɔwɔicō géē yá uwā italā.

eng_Latn: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā le um bī bū okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā ga iyɔ̄bū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gáā māháyi ɛcɛ. Abɔ̄ n tá eyī wā ajɛ le ɛbɛ má á, n má ka ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā le mu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ īyī um tá fīyɛ̄ ajɛ gblugudu, kwú eyī ú pīya klá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kē í je igelī nyā lɛ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. É kē í mīyɛ ɔ̄ tū abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
idu_Latn: nōo géē jila anú. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛga nɛ̄hɛ́ ō mi dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú ɔkpíyē kú nū, nōó kwú ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ ú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, nɛ̄ enyi yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ɛga nōo mi ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ā nōo yá ɔkpáncō ā, anú wɛ Óndú á. Anú yá ɛcɛ, yá ɔ́na kú nū klla je ɔ́ kwu kli á. Ó yá ɛcɛ kóō tá áncā ŋ́, amáŋ ó yá ɔ̄ kú ācɛ kéē lā anú. Anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ka kahíníī, Ami wɛ Óndú ā á. Ɔwɔ ɔhá dúúmā í yɔ̄ gwū um tá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le da ācɛ ā kéē gā ɔlɛ́ ā. Ó le yɛ tá ipú ɔ̄kɔ klla le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nēé hī ka Umagádan ā.

eng_Latn: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra anú piyóó kóō lɔfú tōōtū ɔ̄. Ɛgahi kú nū kóō le mu odúúdú ɛcɛ. Aamí, Aamí.

eng_Latn: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā je ɔ́da lɛ owu nɛ̄hi ā kóō tá cɛ́ɛ́, kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā kóō tá úgbagwú nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le aɛ́gwā obɔ̄bí tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ácɛ alɛwa kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā, odúúdú agbénú nɛ̄ ācɛ kpó ce aá abɔ̄ ā, aá géē je uwá kpó cīgbīhi lɛ aóndú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si māháyí anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú wā. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ opeyī ā hīgwú á.

eng_Latn: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le je lɛ ɔ́ le gwá kwɛyí ā, ɔyínɔ̄nyā ā klla kahíníī, N géē hɛ́ lɛ aínyankwūlūmī kú uwɔ dúú jāā gbéeko nēé le gwá mɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa pīyeyī le ɔkɔnyɔ má uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó bī iyē kú Óndú le okónu tá le uwá. Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́bɛ́ o bɔ̄bí ɛpa le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ūpú gaá kwú ayípɛ̄nɔ̄nyīlɔ ofɛpa cɛpa ú kpó híla nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka ka ācɛ aéwɔhá dúúmā nēé wɛ ācɛ kú um ā ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́, í gáā ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā gɛ ŋ́. Kwu ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe bá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā má ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī yāwu klla ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udánīyɛlu le jé ka, ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kwú abɔ̄ ú tá íne ā ɛɛ́ mā, ó le yɛ tá inīcō kú ɔlɛ́ nū, le uwíndo kú nū nōo pīyeyī kwu Ujerúsālɛm ā nwūla. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú okwúukwu ú kwaajɛ gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā igbɛtá ɛ̄cī dóódu. Ó klla gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
idu_Latn: N yúklɔ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le gbagbafú. Otú alɛwa ń gbɔlā ŋ́. Ɛmiyɛ ŋmó um, ijēnyi éŋkpɔ̄ kē ŋmó um. Ojígógó ń gē má odolé jē um ŋ́, ń lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n gē gbo ŋ́, ń kē má īlī ō wiiyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ɛwa ā tóohi kahíníī, Itíca, n bī ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú um gé lɛ uwɔ, ohígbū ka ó lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kɛlā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Abālɔbányā a géē má ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá Uféro ā. N géē pi ɔ́ abɔ̄fú kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nyɔ̄. Abɔ̄fú nɛ̄ n géē bī ɔ̄ le nū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king's meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā klla le ɔ́da je kéē bēē je āyā kú ɔdōlé olɔhi nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū gē lé mɛ́mla ejé nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē gwá ā lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī dóódu. É géē nwū uwā ɔkpá iháyí ɛtá. Igbīhi iháyí ɛtá nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē kpó uwā wā í mafú lɛ ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urécɛ̄lu le Ujósɛ̄fu ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ā, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ulában kahíníī, Mā um tá ká n̄ nyɔ̄ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
idu_Latn: Aá ī dɔɔ̄kā odée, amáŋ aá lɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá le tútū o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ. Aɔ́dā olɔhi ōhī kwu aá eyī ká aá lɛ, amáŋ aá lɛ uwá glá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gē yíkpɛ́lā klla ī nuunu. Aá lɛ ɔdā ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka aá ba ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujɔ́ni le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ā, Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛ ā lɛyíkwu Ujɔ́ni. Ó kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aá ga ipú ígbíli ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni ā, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá leyice ka aá géē má ā? Ēpū ácí nōó lɔfú iye ŋ́ nɛ̄ owu gē pú ga ɛga dóódu ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ íla kú ācɛ ōhī lɛ uwá bī ga ipú ífi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔtū gē wú uwā lɛyíkwu Óndú.

eng_Latn: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kéē í cɛ̄ í ce um ijáalí, é jé ŋmá eko aflɛ́yí ka n wɛ ɔ́wá kú Ufárisīi nēe leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā húmáyī fu alɔ ɔnū ka anúɔ í yá ā, ó le ɔ́ yá piíí ɛɛ́. Ó ményinyi alɔ ŋ́ le alɔ kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ le alɔ ahɔ̄ pi táajɛ gbɔbū ka anúɔ í yá ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛla kú alɔ kéē lɛ alɔ yálé, ó klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdā nōo wā í klá alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācɛ o glla inu yá, ācɛ o gbā ɛcɔ̄. É klla í bī le lá ɔcí mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ nēé bī le glla odée yá. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ije ā le cíla ulé kú aɔ́dā ɔhá dóódu nōo cɛgbá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi mɛ́mla Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ, odúúdu ajɛ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámɔn ā, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ógu ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan, jāā kwu ajɛ kú aéwo dóódu mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ n wā ā, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n hīgwú, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í tá um ohi ŋ́ mā? Aá gbɛlá ka ń lɔfú nɛ̄ n gē hɛ́ aá tá klla ī nya aá tá ŋ́ nɛɛ? N da aá kú aá jé ka n lɔfú nɛ̄ n gē je ɔ́da lɛ aítekwú mɛ́mla aísú kéē je ŋmó ŋmáajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛgiyí uwā kwú pīya aígbíli, nɛ̄ aɛ́béenyi nēe bá ipú uwā ā gē pɛ́ kwú, ī níípi ohígbū kú éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
idu_Latn: Uwá wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ n yá lɛ īyī um á, é kē í gwíijē í cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ojuja klá isú bá ajɛ ɔkpancō, klla lɛ ɔ́ dobū kpimm á.

eng_Latn: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ nēe lé ā wɛ úlá igwó. É gbo ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ áluka tū uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu ɔmɛtá ā wɛ Umerári. Ɛma kú nū yɛ gaá kwu Ulífāyi ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā, Étan, Ukísi, Ábudi, Umálūci.

eng_Latn: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Lɛ odúúdu ācɛ nēe wɛ iháyí ofu ce igwó gɔbū ga ofɛpa ce nēe lɔfú yúklɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā glá ā gbaáluka.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá Umósɛ̄rɔtu ā, é gaá lā Ubɛne-jaákan.

eng_Latn: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
idu_Latn: Aá híī lɛ ogbló wu abɔ̄ gē lɛ gbō ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kpó tū aá abɔ̄ ā ŋ́, amáŋ aá yá ɔdā nēé géē má gbla glá.

eng_Latn: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
idu_Latn: Aútéblu ɛnɛ kú ipú inu ā nēé gē na ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nēé ī yɔlá ā ɛyí nū ā, é gbā uwā ŋmá ápátɛ́cɔ̄. Olicō kú uwā wɛ āyā kú umíta. Ɛyí uwā wɛ isentímīta ofɛtá cigwɛ́hɔ̄ ābɔ̄ kú uwā dóódu. É lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēé gē bī le ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ā, kpó bá ɛyí autéblu ā.

eng_Latn: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ákan tá ɔ ohi kahíníi, Ákú ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, n le íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu bīya. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n kē yá ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ géē yā klá ūpū ā, nɛ̄ igelī ā kē ī je catāajɛ gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ, híī bīya íne kú Óndú ā o ŋmá lɛ o yá ojibó kú ɔdā dúúmā lɛ iyī uwā fúlufúlu ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɛ́gbla kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ ī kɔ̄kā, yɔ̄ ī tá ɛlā kwu ā, Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yīnū wā ŋmá igbīhi gaá gbɔɔ́ ō tíkpó mla uwá.

eng_Latn: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
idu_Latn: N lɛ īyī um gbo, ka igelī nēe lé ka Ubósra ā géē je pīya ɛbɛ́ ohéyī, mɛ́mla ipú alácɛ̄. Ācɛ géē yá ɔ̄ okónū, klla í bī iyē kú nū le tá okónu lɛ ācɛ. Aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā géē je pīya ipú alácɛ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ā kéē lɛ iyī uwā iyē gwu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká lɛ tútū ō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā. Anɔ́ɔ é le īlī kú uwā kpó na á.

eng_Latn: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
idu_Latn: Ulɛ́ya le ipú yɔ̄ le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma. Ó kahíníī, Óndú ā le unwalu kú um má ɛɛ́. Abālɔbányā ɔbá um géē yíhɔtū tá um mɛ́ɛnɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó hī iyē nū ka Urúbɛn.

eng_Latn: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujówɛlu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ka á.

eng_Latn: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla da Umósīsi kahíníī, Da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka Ami, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki, Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ fu uwá á. Iyē kú um yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ogbéegbé ɛcɛ á, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē blakwu um ógbéegbé ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma dóódu mɛ́mla áluka kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ā. Ipɔ́ɔma kú Upárōssi wɛ úlā ɛhɔ̄ ce ofahātá ce igwɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔgbanjɛ̄ kú oje udɔ mɛ́mla ɛga oháyi kú nū yá ŋmá ogigo kú ācɛnyā, nēe géē yúklɔ́ okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɛgwā kú oje udɔ ā ma, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwu ɔcí icō á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛgwā le ɔ̄ kwú nɛ̄ ó je eyī gicō lɛ ɛgwā kú oje udɔ ā má, géē nyatá ŋmá ɛ́fa kú ɛgwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó má yēeyī, ó klla gáā kwú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá le bēhé ga ipú inu dúúmā, aá da ɔ́ ka ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da ācɛ ɔlɛ nū nēe bá Ubábīlɔn a kahíníī, Aá le wi ŋmá ikwū kú ɛfú ɛɛ́. Aá nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ u, aá gbēyī ŋ! Náaná nɛ̄ aá bá ligbó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ aá, aá gbɛlá kwu ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, kú aá blakwu Ujerúsālɛm dúú.

eng_Latn: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umídiya, Ámālɛ̄ki mɛ́mla aípɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, le pahīla bá ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka efūma ā, mɛ́mla aínyankūlūmī, aɔ́nya kú ɛfú kú uwā lɛ ɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Óndú cɛ̄ ká n̄ le bēhé Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ajɛ olɔhi kú ogbeé ā má. Ajɛ olɔhi kú ɛyí ɛfu ɔ́ɔmā, mɛ́mla ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da uwá kahíníī, Aá pó ɛlā kú um, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú aá, ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē ma iyī um fú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ipú ɔ̄na ámāŋ ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ ó má.

eng_Latn: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ássa lā mla uwá jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɔkpá nyā, abɔ̄ é nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū eko ɔ́ɔmā kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo wɔ́tū ācɛ Ujɛ́būsi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ wɔ́tū uwā ā, nɛ̄ eyī yá anúɔ kú anúɔ kwú uwā í kpó ŋmó ā ā? Ayíka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ká ɔ́ɔ bū okónu ɔ̄gɔ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ī bū wā ipú igelī ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ́ɔ gaá lɛ āconyɔ́ɔ́nyí nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpó ŋmó. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛɛ́ nēé gē ka kahíníī, Aópeyī mɛ́mla aócīkpó mɛ́mla āconyɔ́ɔ́nyí í gáā ga ipú inū kú Óndú ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá gwéeyē, ká aá gwíijē gbōmgbōm, Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá gwéeyē mla odúúdú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
idu_Latn: Ákú um mā, n géē gwō ohígbū Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛyí ɔcóonyɔ́kpá ā ōfōōfūnū. Ohígbū ikwū kú nū ɛyí ɔcóonyɔ́kpá ā, aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ gekwú ɛgiyí um, ami abɔ̄yī um kē gekwú ɛgiyí aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Aá bī ukɔ́tin ɛgɔ́ igwó kú aá le yá eyīpú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú um ā ifa. Aá géē bī owú nēé hī ka ulínin ā mɛ́mla owú oblú, owú ublúcéelé, owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá lɛ wu ukɔ́tin ā. É géē bī abɔ̄ ɔka hiijā kú ifotó kú ɔdā ō lɛ acá nēé hī ucérūbim ā tū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkplɛ́fú nōo ī gbō um klla hɛ́ um hɛ́tá á. A tá um abɔ̄ kwú um pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhága hī Ɔwɔicō, nōo kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō nōo gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ā, ohígbū koó da iyī nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, N le Ɔwɔicō má ɔkwɛ̄yi, anɔ́ɔ n klla yēeyī kpɔ́ áā.

eng_Latn: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ ó gē pó ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bī ɛgwā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka o pó ɛla kú ɔ̄cɛ o bī imabɔ̄ gē le plla ɛgwā ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja le túblá ācɛ ā ajaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nɛ̄ ɔtū kú aá géē wɛ ɛpɛɛpa gaá kwu ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō á nɛ, aá yɛce ɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ubáalu nɛɛ, aá yɛce ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā í tá ɔ̄ ohi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
idu_Latn: Uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā géē lā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um Ujékɔ̄pu ā, ajɛ nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá lā ā piyóó. Ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā géē gbo uwá piyóó.

eng_Latn: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, A yá lɔhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ɔtú kú uwɔ káā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi gā um ā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔ́da je lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo ī leyīkwu ɔlɛ̄ nū ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɛkpa kú ācɛ ā tū mu mla ɔdōlé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bī lɛ glá ā. A í je ije kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ce ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā kú nū ipú ɛkpa kú nū.

eng_Latn: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
idu_Latn: É ma ayí ɛpa lɛ Éba. Éyi lé ka Upélēgi . Iyē kú ɔyí nū ɔhá ā lé ka Ujóktan.

eng_Latn: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ mā tá lɛ ā á, ó kē í nyā uwɔ tá ɔ́dāŋ ka á yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
idu_Latn: N gē bī aópeyī jé ɔwɛ, klla ī bī aócīkpó ā yɛ.

eng_Latn: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
idu_Latn: Ó gē nya uwá tá ŋmá ikwū, klla ī lɛ oyēeyī kú uwā tū eko kú ɔkpɛtā.

eng_Latn: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔnyā ā ɔ́ híī gwá ejé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē lé ɔdōlé elihɔ dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ anúɔ da ɔ́ ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā.

eng_Latn: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
idu_Latn: Alɔ gē yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ yēeyī. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ ɛcá cá alɔ nɛɛ, alɔ gē hɔ́hā ce uwá, eko nēé í yá alɔ ōwē nɛɛ, alɔ gē lɔ́tū.

eng_Latn: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
idu_Latn: Awɔ Udánīyɛlu ā, háyi kpaakpa lɛ Óndú ā jāā ga oŋmɛ́yí. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā, a géē kwú, amáŋ a géē héyī cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā mīyɛ ulé kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ a yá ā, ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ mɛ́mla eko oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
idu_Latn: Ohilí kú Umósīsi, Ujɛ́tro, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Umídīyan ā, lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā pó.

eng_Latn: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā í gē kwú ikwū agbaagbɔ ŋ́. Amíyā í gē híkpó du uwá ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō í gē cɔ̄nū da uwá ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá móōwē gbóōgbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD's.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ n le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, n géē gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ Óndú ā. Akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ ā géē mɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā le jé ka ɛcɛ ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
idu_Latn: Aóladógbe mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū le pó ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā olɔhi yá lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ odúúdu uwā gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá lɛ ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔcí kú ufígi í kōō gwá ŋ́, nɛ̄ īkpō kú ɔcí ufáyin dúúmā í kōō kwu ɔcí nū ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ā, í kōō gwá īkpō ŋ́, nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā í kōō yá ŋ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kōō le pɛ́ gekwú, nɛ̄ aɛ́na le pɛ́ gekwú ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpā nū lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ā má ā, ó kwú uwā iyē nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo yá ā da óndú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ ká ālɔ̄ le bū ipú ajɛ kú aá. Alɔ géē yɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi ā gbóóló. Alɔ í gáā nyā ga abɔ̄lɔ́ná ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē nyā ga abɔ̄lúfīyē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ɛpa nēe bá ipú inu ā, nā abɔ̄ daa wɛ̄ɛcɛ, le Ulɔ́tu pi wā inu, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔwɛ gwū á.

eng_Latn: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ á cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yā ŋ́, ohígbū íne kú uwɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pīyabɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú eyī í pīya kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nyā, lɛ īyī uwā tū wāajɛ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ lɛ ɔkɔ gbā ga awɔ.

eng_Latn: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka kóō lɛ aígbáanɔ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ ɛpa kpó tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔcí kú usɛ́da, owú ɔgalúlá, mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka uháyísɔ̄pu ā.

eng_Latn: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
idu_Latn: É gē cílá ācɛ olɔhi ā ulé kú ɔdā nēé gē yá ā. Amáŋ, ɛmiyɛ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá gē ŋmó ācɛ o plla ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu ká ɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɛlā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ó wɛ anú nōo wɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu nɛ́ɛ tá ā ŋ́, amáŋ anúɔ nēé tá ka anúɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu pīyeyī kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Usámūwɛ̄lu ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔtū ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ je lɛ Usɔ́lu, odúúdú ɔdā ōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu je lɛ ɔ́ ā, le kpó yá jīla ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē gbō alɔ klla gē je ɔfú lɛ alɔ á. Ó le tútū kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄ eko kú unwalu.

eng_Latn: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔmɛɛtá ā nōo gboce ɔ́ɔmā ā wɛ Ussáma, ɔyí kú Agíi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Uhára. Ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya le pɛ́ i jīla Uléhi, ɛga nɛ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kú eje yɔ̄ ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le inya kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ufilístiya.

eng_Latn: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Aá ga igelī ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ éyi ā ku aá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Utíca ā ka, eko kú anúɔ le bá ajaajɛ ɛɛ́, ka anúɔ géē lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā tɔ̄há mla ayíkpó kú anúɔ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tá uwɔ ɛcɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ ɔhá nōo lɔwá nɛ̄hi. A géē kwú abɔ́ɔ pi aúgbɔ́ɔ́nya ohéyīfuú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nēé í kpó bīya ā. A gē je uwēyī lɛ ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ ɔcɛ́, ɔkpani uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
idu_Latn: N da uwɔ kahíníī, Habɔ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um tá kóō nyɔ̄ gáā gbō um ɛ̄gbā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a tá kú ō híī nyɔ̄ ŋ́, n géē ŋmó ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ aflɛ́yí kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nyɔ̄ gaá le anɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā okpócu o nya okwū ā iyē tútū á. Ɛ̄cī usábāti ā, é mlɛ́nyɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛ̄cī dēē yɛ ā, Ufélīsi mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū Udurusíla, nōo wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā le pɛ́ wā. Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū kéē lɛ Upɔ́lu bī wā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ahɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄ ó kɛlā ohígbū ocɛ̄ɛla kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá glá ká aá yɔ̄ gē blakwu aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā eko nɛ̄ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ísrɛ̄lu éyi nēé nū ŋmá Usamérīya ā gaá lā Ubɛ́tɛlu, ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ í nwū ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛyí kú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ um má nyā wɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú n̄ má ɔ̄cɛ éyi gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū um.

eng_Latn: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄li le jīla, anɔ́ɔ é wā í le jīla tɔ̄ɔ̄há ɛgiyí Usámūwɛ̄lu, Uráma á.

eng_Latn: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe fíyɛ́ ofɛpa ipú uwā bá ipácí gē gbōgɛɛ kéē géē lɛ Upɔ́lu ŋmó. É kē lɛ iyī uwā gbō tɔ̄há ŋmá lɛ ɔkpá nēé gwá ka aá gáā lé ámāŋ o gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Abālɔbányā é kē le tútū ɛɛ́ gē gbēyī uwɔ ká ā le okónu nwúla lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
idu_Latn: N gēe je ojuju mla ujɔ kú uwá dóódu a bīya, klá í je uwá ɔtū gbenyi. Uwá gēe ba í da ɛcí kú uwá ka ɔɔ tá aá abɔ̄, klá í ba í nyɔ̄ ga ɛga īyī ācɛ ācogwɛ́bā mla anjɛnū ka ɛɛ ka ɛlā la ācɛ nɛ e gekwú ɛɛ́ mā la aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka alelékwū kú uwa a ka ɛɛ da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gēe yá a.

eng_Latn: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ Ujóssuwa wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū kú Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin da uwá ka ɔwɛ nēé gē yá ucē ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ áā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkpá gbo ka anúɔ géē gwō uwā ɔ́ci kú ɔdā nēé yá ā. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ci ā gwó uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya gekwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́, bū okónu kú Ɛláyíja lɛ ā. Abɔ̄ Ahasíya í lɛ ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́ mā, Ujóram, ɔyínɛ́ nū lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū. Ujóram lé ɔcɛ́ nyā ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Ujɛhóssāfati lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ awulú kú nū híla, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Alɔ í cɛgbá ijáalí dóódu gɛ ŋ́!.

eng_Latn: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́béenyi, aígbáanɔ, aɛ́bɛ́ ajɛ,kwu ɛnɛ̄hi kwu ɛnɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lā ipú ɛcɛ ā géē fīyēgbúlú ohígbū ufi um. Aɛ́fu í jīliyē, aɛ́cɔ̄ í ca munumunu wā ajɛ, aɔ́dɔ géē je kpó wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē yá ŋmá anú ā.

eng_Latn: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ n yɔ̄ í má aɛ́bɛ́ ɛnɛ nyā a, n má akā ɛnɛ kwu ajɛ pi uwā. Akā éyééye kwu ajɛ pi éyééye kú uwá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī okoolo ɛpa, ɛnɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ipú ɛkpa kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alelékwū oblínyī le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ó ī yɛ ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ í yɔ̄ ŋ́ gē tíne ɛga omlɛ́nyɔ́. Eko nōó kē má odúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da aígabɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī, Aá jé ka otrɛ̄yí nɛ̄hi éyi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ kwú ícɛ yɔ̄ á ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí Uféro. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ká aá gáā gbā Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ̄gbā amáŋ ānyāānyɛ gáā nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um ipéyī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Eko nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ pī éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umɛ́rība, nōo kwu Ukádiss, ipú ígbíli kú Usín ajaajɛ ā. Aá tá ō lɛ ojīlīma ce um, ipéyī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aéliká nēe ī bī ogbló ā, nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bī le je utébulu ā ŋmá ajɛ ā kpó kwu okónōgwu kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A jé ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n wā ā? N wā gaá ma ɔdā nēé tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā fú gā awɔ. Amáŋ abālɔbányā, n géē kwúcē īgbīhi gaá nuunu tá alelékwū nōo gē leyīkwu Upɛ́sīya ā. Igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā ā, alelékwū ō leyīkwu Ugirísi ā géē wā.

eng_Latn: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū ka ipú ɔkpá kú Aíje ā kahíníī, Óndú ā ka lɛ Óndú um kahíníī, Cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um amānyā.

eng_Latn: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nyi ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛga ofɛhɔ̄ kú ɔdā nōó nyi ā cē iháyí ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu géē lā ɛbɔ́. É géē lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ajɛ nōo le mu mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé ā, mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ébú gē cē klá ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nōo kwu okónu ɔkpá, yɔ̄ ī jɛ ā nɛ̄. Ɔcí nōo gē tá ɛgba gā ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ɔkpá ā nɛ. Ó gáā yúufi eko nɛ̄ ɔnɔ̄ le fa ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ēpū kú nu, i gáā ŋmó, wúla ŋ́. Amáŋ o géē wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ piyóó. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í yá ŋ́, ó lɛ ɛlá wu ɔɔ́ ŋ́, o yɔ̄ ī gwá ikpō piyóó.

eng_Latn: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
idu_Latn: N kwú uwɔ í pīya alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ otūufi nɛ̄hi nōo ī gbō odée A lā ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú um, klla ī yāwu ipú aɛ́cɔ̄ nēe ī fíyaajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é gáā yɛ gɔbū ligbo mla ucē íla kú uwā ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko kpii ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē jé ɛdɔ ācɛ nēé wɛ ā. Ɔdā ékpó nōo yá Ujannisi mɛ́mla Ujámbresi ā.

eng_Latn: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔdɔ̄fú dúúmā gɔ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, ɔ̄cɛ nōo jégēdēē le ɔdɔ̄fú gɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā wāajɛ ā, kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ. É géē ŋmó ɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.
idu_Latn: Jāa gbéeko nɛ̄ ó ga okómpinu kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Ó bēé ga ipú inu ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ īlī ekwu wiiyē í gē ga ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ójīla ā le aícɔ́ɔja úlā ofu cigwó tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. É tū uwā ukɔ́ kéē nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujábɛssi kpó ŋmó, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujótam yá kpɛ́m ā, kwú ɛfú nɛ̄ ó kpó mɛ́mla ɔdā olɔhi ɔhá nɛ̄ ó yá ā, é lɛ uwá kpó tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
idu_Latn: Óndú blakwu ɛlā nāa da Umósīsi ka, Ɔ́dáŋ ka aá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, í lɛyítáajɛ ga um ŋ́, n géē je aá pahīla tū ipú éwo dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anyā ōcɛ̄hɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ayí uwā le pɛ́ wā ajaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le túkpɛɛ́ lɛ Ísɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
idu_Latn: Uporáta, Adalíya, Aridáta.

eng_Latn: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
idu_Latn: É kōō lɛ ayí ma nááná, ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ayí ā, ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, nɛ̄ ɔyí dúúmā í gáā yēeyī ŋ́. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ igbīhi cē kwu uwá ā, ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi géē yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.
idu_Latn: A tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā eko nɛ̄ á je ācɛ kú Ámālēki mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā, yíífi dúúdú ŋ́ mā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē yá uwɔ lɛ á yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú igbō nōó ī nū ŋ́, nēé gē hī ka ucɛ kú onyatá ā le bá ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔláwonī ú gbō ɔ̄ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔdée kú ugóolu nōo cābɔ̄ keé kwú ɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā, ú bá ɔláwonī iyɔ̄bū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔtú yɔ̄ ī he uwá nɛ̄hi ā, é ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ Usámsin hīgwú lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō hiijā lɛ aá. Anɔ́ɔ é le Usámsin bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá inu agbá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ijā he lɛ uwá á. É cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ má háyi ɛplá ákanaba ɛpa kú ɛga nēé jīla bá ā.

eng_Latn: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
idu_Latn: Ósini, Ɛ́ri.

eng_Latn: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ kú ɔtū-ōle kú Ubenáya, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ipú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ofu cigwó ā bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
idu_Latn: É bī oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu le ɔ́ yíifa. É klla bī aikwúsa lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ kwú ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō míya gwōnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
idu_Latn: Kpáyi, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú ijē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē ŋmó aá ā í gē jɛ̄ aá ŋ́ mā āa? Nɛ̄ aá klla bá yɔ̄ gē yá īkpɛ́yí olɔfú kpɔ́ āa? Aá má iyī aá ŋ́ nɛɛ, īkpɛ̄yí kú aá wɛ ágbáágbe. Odo kú aá í gbɛlá olɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka, a lɛ ɔ̄kā kú íla cíla, ayíka awɔ abɔ̄yi uwɔ wɛ olíla bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo dɔɔ̄kā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o ŋmá eyī ō nyā foó kú ɛ̄cī dóódu, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ otú le bī nɛ̄ aínyílɔ́wɔ gā ɛcɛ ɔkpáncō, āyā éyi kú alɔ yɔ̄ gē ma ɔdɔ, āyā ɔhá gē gbāājɛ le tútū le óbō bī abɔ̄ kéē kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
idu_Latn: Ipú Enrimmɔ́n, Usóra, ipú Ujámūtu.

eng_Latn: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikpɛ́lā gbɔɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācogbāálá kú Ébram mɛ́mla ācogbāálá kú Ulɔ́tu á. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā ācɛ Ukénan mɛ́mla ācɛ Upɛ́rīss lā ajɛ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
idu_Latn: ń gáā leyī yá iyɔ̄lā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē héyī bené kú iyɔ̄lā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū dóódu gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā klla gē yúufi nū. Ó gē yá ācɛ Ujíyu ogbɛhá ɛhi kpɔngɔɔ ojigógó, ó klla gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwɔ ka, Má ɔ́, n géē je olɛlā kú uwɔ tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ káā yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā mla anú á. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ yɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ okónōgwu kú ikpó kú awulú kú Usɔ́lu hɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
idu_Latn: É gē jé ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī nɛ̄hi ā ŋmá lɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā ō jé kú nū. Ɔ́dāŋ kōó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā, ɛlā ā gē ga iyē, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē mīyɛ cɛ̄ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ yɔ̄ ī wā, ó kē lɛ okónu klá ŋ́. Ɔlá yɔ̄ ī yi iyɔ̄bū nū, ofúlutu nɛ̄hi le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ācɛ ā kpó cīgbīhi wā ipú ajɛ kú uwā, é géē ka igbɔhá kpɔ́ ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aígelī kú nū ā kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce ɛyí ɛfu otīhɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ɛga otīhɔ, nōó lā ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ūlī ō tá ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, le aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: N gē ka ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā le plla wɛɛlɛ i tá ipú aá ɛɛ́. Ōwē nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɛdɔ ācɛ nēe bá nyā, é lɛ ɔ́ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú Ɔkpíihɔ eko otɛtɛ nōo yɛ ā. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄kā kú ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ ā kéē yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí kú uwā. É klla tá Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo wɛ Ɔkpani mɛ́mla Óndú nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ōfōōfūnū ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ɔ́wá kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa gē leyīkwu uwá ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ lā ā kwú nyɛ́ lɛ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
idu_Latn: Ubálāki le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ubálam ka lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú kpó gwɛ́ɛya, éyééye ɛyí ede abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ōcē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tū klá uwá, mɛ́mla ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o he um ɔtū, abɔ̄ aá lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā jé gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ mā, aá leyī kwɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ obɔ̄bí ā kéē plla aá tū ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā nōo géē yá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ aá háyi kpaakpa ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
idu_Latn: Ujésuwa, ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla ɔmáapú nū, mɛ́mla Ukádimīyelu mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla ayí kú Ujúda klla gaá wɛ ipú ācɛ nēe leyīkwu o túgwó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ géē kwu ŋmá italā nēé í yá alɔ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ í lɛ ɔtū kú alɔ tá ɔwɛ kú idáagó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ō bī le nya alɔ tá ā ŋ́ mā a? Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū ka ɔwɛ nōó le nya ācɛ tá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ aflɛ́yí á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā kú nū cɛ̄ ka óo wɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛoyúklɔ́ abɔ̄ nēe bá ipú aá ā, géē wā í yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā.

eng_Latn: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɛfú, abɔ̄ é bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī mɛ́mla ɔtā gáā ŋmó uwā ā, mɛ́mla ɔdōtūufi kú ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce, eko nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu gáā kwú ā, nōó kɛlā lɛyíkwu oōnyɛ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋmá Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē nyi ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja ā gā gaá le ikpó kú éyi cē, é klla lɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mpa nēe nyɔ́kpá mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si ā cē.

eng_Latn: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó gē dɔɔ̄kā kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra aíne mɛ́mla ɔdā nōó gē nwū ā. Ó kē ī tíne kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce aíne ā.

eng_Latn: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel's father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā, odiyɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛpa nēe wā mɛ́mla anú ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ā, ádā odiyɔ̄ ā da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ɔ̄, otú ɔ́ɔ le bī ɛɛ́. Kéē le gbo abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī kpɔ́. Ó ka ajɛ ɔ́ɔ kwú dobū ɛɛ́. Ó kéē bá abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú iyī uwā. Óócí ɛ́ɛ́ kéē cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī kéē nyɔ̄ iyāwu kú uwā ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɛbɛ́ lɛ nɛ̄hi bá ī lé ā, Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū le ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá uwá, ó gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā bónū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
idu_Latn: ācɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú ɔlɛ́ nū ɔhá. Ācɛ ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ussɛmáya, Asárɛlu, Umilálāyi, Ugilálāyi, Umaáyi, Unetánɛ̄lu, Ujúda mɛ́mla Uhanáni. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá nyā bī ɛdɔ ɔdā ō bī gwíijē dóódu nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛtɛ gē bī le gwííjē ā abɔ̄. Ɛ́sra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o jé íne nɛ̄hi ā bī ígwu nyā tá á.

eng_Latn: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔ̄ gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ abɔ̄ fú ɔ̄ omōōmu kú ɛya kú ōblatū nēé je lɛ Óndú ā. É kē í je ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede kóō wɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú. Ó wɛ ɛya kú íne ō bīya bónū.

eng_Latn: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú aɔ́da kú ɛhi nōó bī gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ú kpó lɛ ɔ́ á. Aɔ́dā ɛhi ā wɛ igbo ije ɔdɔ ofɛhīlī aɔ́dā ōlɛ ɔdōlé lɔnyɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kpó aɛ́dɔ kú aɔ́dā ōlɛ ɔdōlé lɔnyɛ nōó kpó lɛ ɔ́ ā, lɛ Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō gā ɛgiyí Ubálam otú, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ā wā lɛ uwɔ hīgwú kpɔ́, nyɔ̄ mla uwá, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā da uwɔ ā, nāa géē yá á.

eng_Latn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō yɔ̄ kwu odúúdú aá. Aamí.

eng_Latn: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka o ŋmá lɛ eyīyōce kú alɔ nēé nya alɔ tá á. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ leyī ce ɔ́ ā má, ɔ́ɔmā lé ka ɔdā ō leyī ce ɔ́ í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄nyɛ gē leyī ce ɔdā nōó ī má ɛɛ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwá kéē le ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛ uwá ā jé. Da uwá ka idu nɛ̄hi éyi yɔ̄, nōo bū efū ohéyīfuú nɛ̄hi. Acá kú nū nwuné, lɔwá klla líkpō. Ó le wu ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn gáā bī ābɔ̄ ágēné gēne kú ɔcí nēé hi Usédar ā.

eng_Latn: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ukáline kú aá gáā má ɔ̄. Aá ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhamáti nōo nwuné nɛ̄hi ā, aá klla ga Ugáti nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ufilístiya ā. Éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ákú Ujúda lɔhi fíyɛ́ uwā á nɛɛ? Ajɛ kú uwā nwuné fíyɛ́ ákú aá.

eng_Latn: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: O da ɔ́ ka, Ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nāa lɔtūce ɔ́ ā pllá uwɔ cokónu gā uwɔ ka Ujerúsālɛm ɔ́ɔ́ gáā ga ipú abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú, aá nēe wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ufi kú Usólómɔ̄n gbɔɔ́ ō yá Adónīja nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi á. Ó le kwu ga Agblīihɔ ā gaá bī aájī kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwɔ nōó lɛwa eko nɛ̄ n wā ŋ́ mā, kwú nyīla nɛ̄hi ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kē le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ, ɔwɛ dóódu nɛ̄ n pīya nyɔ̄ ā Abālɔbányā ā, n cíkā ō gbɔɔ́ ō tíne ɔdā abɔ̄yī um lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛɛ, ayíkpó kú um géē yɛ í le unu nu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī je um tū ācɛ Ujíyu abɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ehée ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um í yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
idu_Latn: N bī ikpēyī kú abɔ̄yī um lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD's.
idu_Latn: aá géē je ayí aflɛ́yí kú aá lɛ Óndú ā, kwu ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú aá ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ōcē obɔ̄bí tū klá ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ōcē ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gaá kwu eko nōó je ā. Ó yɔ̄ ɛbɛɛbɛ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá igelī nēé hī ka Udáni, nōo kwu oŋmɛ́yí kú ajɛ ā ɛhícō ā, jāā gaá kwu igelī kú Ubiyɛssɛ́ba nōo kwu oŋmɛ́yí kú nū ɛháajɛ ā. Ōcē obɔ̄bī ā le ācɛ úla ofu ahātá cē úlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá í yíihɔtū, óō wɛ ihɔtū ɔkwɛ̄yi. Aá tá ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí, aá lɛ abɔ̄ flá tū ɔdā nōo lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā le jé koó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá lɛyíkwu Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim á.

eng_Latn: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
idu_Latn: A je eyī kú uwɔ tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí um eko kú ákanya mɛ́mla unwalu kú um ŋ́. Óndú, jāhɔ̄ gā um, ká ā lɛ ohi tá um fíya eko nɛ̄ n gē hī uwɔ igwú ā.

eng_Latn: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
idu_Latn: A lɛ um tá ga ɛga nōo lipú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ga ɔ́kɛklɛ kú ísu ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ le yɛ um jīla tá, anɔ́ɔ ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú úgbagwú wā í klá um dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ka ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ le ɔ́ miya ka anú mɛ́mla Usíba gáā kɔ̄ agbénú kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā á.

eng_Latn: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ ōkpóocu ō le tū ɛyí kú Árɔ̄ni, nōo ī pɛ́ ŋmá ɔ́ ɛyí klá ɔ́ ɔnwū agba klla pɛ́ jāā ga ɔkɔ kú úwé kú nū dúú ā.

eng_Latn: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē tá um abɔ̄ ā, uwēyī í gáā kwú um ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔtū lé ká, ohígbū ka n jé ka uwēyī í gáā kwú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá agblɔ̄cɛ́, le tá ipú inu kú ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí ā bá ā. Ɛlíssāma, ɔmálotɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla Udeláya, ɔyí kú Ussɛmáya, mɛ́mla Ɛlnátan, ɔyí kú Ákibɔ, mɛ́mla Ugɛmaríya, ɔyí kú Ussáfan, mɛ́mla Usedekíya, ɔyí kú Uhananíya mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí ɔhá bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́migwóléyi ā: Ubenáya ŋmá Upírātɔn, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu nyā á.

eng_Latn: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ. Alɔ kpó eyī klla uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka otrɛ̄yí nɛ̄hi ā. Kwú okwū ɔnyā uwɔ ú nyɔ̄ í nyi ipú únóji olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ āa. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú ipú alɔ í gáā tá ō je únóji kú nū gā uwɔ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kwú okwu ɔnyā awɔ í nyi.

eng_Latn: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛwa kú ācɛ nēe bá ā nēé jé íne ā ŋ́ mā nɛ, é kē lɛ okónu tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
idu_Latn: Ń gē klá ɛga éyi tɔ̄há mla ācɛ o hɛ́ ācɛ lé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ mla ācɛ ō yá obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla aóleyɛpa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujéhu kahíníī, Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n tíne ka ā yá ipíinu kú Áhābu mɛ́mla ayí kú Áhābu mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú kú nū ā, a le uwá kpó yá ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, o ŋmá ayí uwɔ jāā ga ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ kú uwɔ ā géē bá í lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú um, blakwu odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā kú nū nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá géē cokónu mla uwá ā, ekōhí ŋ́ aá kē lā kwu alɔ ajaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da ācɛ ā ka eko nyá nɛ́ɛ géē gbēyī gaá kwu ɛ́ɛ́ kéē bēhé gaá mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā je lɛ uwá ā?.

eng_Latn: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá nōo í lā gboce ipɔ́ɔma nyā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn, otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Abídan, ɔyí kú Ugídiyɔn.

eng_Latn: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, abɔ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, n géē cílá aá ulé ohígbū ícɔ̄nū mɛ́mla īmálányī mɛ́mla íwɔ́tū kú aá lɛyíkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā. Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yá aá italā.

eng_Latn: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
idu_Latn: Olíla gē ka ɛlā íla klla ī gbɛlá obɔ̄bí kóō yá ɔdā nōó he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ŋ́ mā. Ó ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛyíkwu Óndú ā. Ó ī je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā ā ŋ, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē je ɔdōgwá lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ijēnyi gē ŋmó uwá ā gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
idu_Latn: O yɛ lɛyíkwu ɔdōlé kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ō yúklɔ́ ā, n géē je ɛkpa úlā bá ɛga ofigwɛ́ɛpa cɛhɔ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dā, ɛkpa úlā ɛhɔ̄ kú umu, mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ejé úlā ba ɛga úlā kpó tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá.

eng_Latn: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a le ɛpɔ̄bí ŋmó um ā, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ n cíkā ō kllá í nyɔ̄ í ka ɔkɔ kú um bónū áncā āa?.

eng_Latn: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ajɛ kú Arúma ka Ugáálu, ɔyí kú Ébēdi mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū gā Ussɛ́kɛm, kéē gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ī gbā ā, aá ka íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ɔ́mpa aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācɛ ɔ́mpa aá, ká Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔdoōcē ā hɛ́tá. Ɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā gē gbā í yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nēé yá aá ubatísim ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka é lɛ aá nyi mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. É kē le aá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ipú ubatísim oŋmá ɔfú kú ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Ɔwɔicō nōo je Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne bū okónu kú Umósīsi lɛ ā, é le uwá fu kwu úklɔ́ kú uwā, ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. É klla le uwá gbaáluka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ itali kwu ɔyí nū iyē ŋ́, ayíka ó gē wɔ́tū ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yíihɔtū tá ɔyí nū ā, géē má ka o lɛ itali kwu ɔ́ ɔkwu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó i lɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n hɛ́pɔ̄ ā wɛ ka ālɔ̄ híī junwalu lɛ aílɔ́wá nēe pīyeyī tá Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yúúfi ŋ́, n géē je ɔdōlé lɛ aá mɛ́mla ayí aá. Anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɛlā ō gbɔtūnɛɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā le uwá ɔtū tú kwɔtū á.

eng_Latn: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
idu_Latn: Aá leyī yɛ ɔ́ abɔ̄yī aá kú aá má ɔ̄ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛnyā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛgba ipú ɛwa cíkā ō lɛ odée klá ɛyí kɛ̄ɛ kóō le klá ɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, ācobɔ̄bíipú ā í má obū nēé gē tayínū gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɔfú ō yá ācɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ kú ukámlin, mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ aɔ́tangbédē ɔhá nēé géē je wu ipú awulú kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla ɛkpa o bɔ́tū nē é hī ka ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
idu_Latn: Uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā ī gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā piyóó á.

eng_Latn: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kéē je mlanyī ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe bá mɛ́mla uwá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka uwá í lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ dúúmā ipú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí nyā le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ ga Ukapánɔm ā, ó lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ ōhī kú ācɛ Ujíyu tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔ́ kéē da ɔ́ kóō gā gaá lɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ināgbá ā, é le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ Ulidíya. É le ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō má abɔ́ɔ, é le ɛlā ō tū ɔ̄cɛ ɔtū kwɔtū ka lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é kē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ohile ā yɔ̄ gē ka lɛ ā dúú kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá uwā, a géē yá uwá lé. Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di lé.

eng_Latn: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
idu_Latn: Ŋméeko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le ikpó inu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū tá ajɛ ā, odúúdú úklɔ́ ā yɛ lɔhi jāā ga ajɛ.

eng_Latn: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo géē yá kóō jɛ̄, ísu kē tá yɛ ipú ajɛ yɔ̄ ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɔkwu. Ísu ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ɔcí ā kwu ā yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ā le dɛ sɔɔ ā. Aɔ́kpá nēe pɛ́ ŋmá ísu ā klla kwú cēenyi tá ɔkwu odúúdú aɔ́cí ɔhá kú ipú ūpū ā.

eng_Latn: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ n géē jīla mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá ōceyī nɛ̄hi ā géē je abɔ́ɔ yá tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
