idu_Latn: Á yɛ í yá ka ɛ̄cī nēé ma um ā kóō le dobū kpímm. Ojuja odobū í yɛ í klá ɔɔ́ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ajɛ odobū ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ gē tū ācɛ ufi ā.

eng_Latn: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá wɛ odúúdú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ ā eko nōó yɛ ipú ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kpó ɔwɔ ā tū ipú ojuja omōomu, éŋkpɔ̄ ɔwɔ ā í kē yíla ojuja ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ahítōfɛlu da Ábsālɔm ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá cikpó odúúdú anyā ɔlɛ́ ádā nū nɛ̄ ádā nū mā uwā tá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē le jé ka ádā nū ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú olɛlā kú nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ nēe gē yɛce anú nōo wɛ Ábsālɔm ā, ɔɔ́ kwú lɔfú iyē.

eng_Latn: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ má ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ le iyī uwā iyē tēelihɔ mla ɛcí nēé gē pā ā.

eng_Latn: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
idu_Latn: Ádā uwā yá uwā ɛhi nɛ̄hi kú ugóolu , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla agbénú nɛ̄hi ɔhá. Ó klla kwú éyééye kú uwā ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú éyééye kú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hɛ́ igá o lɔfú nɛ̄hi tū uwā ā. Amáŋ abɔ̄ Ujɛhóram wɛ ɔ́kplá ā, Ujɛhósāfati ɔcɛ́ ā, kwú ɔ̄ cɔcɛ́ kwɛyí iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā wā ipú ajɛ kú ádā uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya Ɔwɔicō kú uwā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá kú ɛ́ɛ gbagbébnú nɛ̄hi, klla í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá je lɛwa nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aádáádā uwā.

eng_Latn: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aígbómína, mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ dóódu kú ācɛ ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā gaá le jīla tū uwā, anɔ́ɔ é má ká ɔlá ā í lɔfú yá uwá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́. Ɔlá í kōō yi ɛga dúúmā mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúmā kú uwá ŋ́. Kwu īlī kú uwā, iyē, mɛ́mla īnyīlɛyí kú uwā mɛ́mla ɛga ɔhá dúúmā kú ūwā í kōō níípī kú ɔlá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
idu_Latn: Otɔ́tūlé ā géē wā, anú kē wɛ Alelékwū nōo ī ma ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō fú lɛ aá á. Anú ā kē ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā á. N géē tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā ā fu aá, ó géē kɛlā lɛ aá lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó ka anúɔ géē ményinyi ācɛ kú Ujúda klla géē hɛ́ uwā tá. Ó ka amáŋ, ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ ɔwɛ kú ɛfú ō kpó nēé ī bī ɔkpacaŋgelī ámāŋ ka ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔyī, ámāŋ ka ɔnya mɛ́mla ācokpɛ́fú ɔnya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu je ɔdōlé lɛ ádā nū mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú aíkonó kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áluka kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ó lɔhi aá gwíijē kú aá cɛ̄tra anú, ohígbū ka ó gbonɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
idu_Latn: N géē lɔtū ī kɛlā ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá bī um yá ŋmá ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka mla úklɔ́ nɛ̄ n yá ā, nōo le yá ká aílɔ́wá ā kéē lɛyí túwāajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, aá híīī cɔ̄nū gɛ ŋ́, ámāŋ yá unwū ɔdā ámáŋ wɔ́tū ācɛ gɛ ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɛlā obɔ̄bí ō ka mla ɛlā ɔdāhā ō ka kpó bónū ŋmá okónu kú aá.

eng_Latn: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ŋmó ɛlā kú nū ɛyí á, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó wɛ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē kpó agbénú bá lɛ iyī uwā, amáŋ é kē lɛ agbénú ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ má á.

eng_Latn: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
idu_Latn: É géē je ɔdɔ kú utáya wúla tāajɛ klla í je inɔ̄ɔda olicō kú nū ca tāajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē je odúúdú úmúlá kú nū ā kpó gwu bónū gáā hile igbɛ́cɔ̄ ō gbā kú nū ā piyóó mla ápɛ́tɛ́cɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá Usedekíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm kpɔ́ ā, klla mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e pɛ́ kwu ga Íjīpiti ā bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. N géē yá uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka aíkpō ufíigi obɔ̄bí nēe tōō lé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otrɛ̄yi kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú abɔ̄ ú tū ɔyí ā abɔ̄, abɔ̄ é le tá ɛkwūbá ā, ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa lɛ gáā ka ga um ā.

eng_Latn: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔtū lé bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā, ká ā cāŋjɛ ka cīla um ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ n gáā da uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄hi ŋmá ipú ísu kú Úlāyi ā kahíníī, Ugébríyɛlu, lɛ ɛyí kú ɔdā nōó má nyā ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō ŋmó ɔwɛ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí, ká n̄ lɛ abɔ̄ kú um kwu ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu nɛɛ n.

eng_Latn: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā um ɛ̄gbā ŋmá odúúdú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
idu_Latn: Óndú, abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ licō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ alɔ nááná, a gē lɛ ɛlá kwú ācɛ nēe tú iyī uwā wāajɛ ā, amáŋ ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ̄ í kē tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōó lɛ í gē jɛ̄ ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó gáā kpó ɔdā dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū tayínū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́dɔm, ohígbū ka a lɔnɔɔtū lɛ aɔ́máapú uwɔ nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā, é géē je aá kpó yíífi nɛ̄ aá í gáā lɛ ojīlīmā gɛ ŋ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
idu_Latn: N géē mafú lɛ aá ka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ lɛ íkwu ipú ɛcɛ nyā ō je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā uwā yá ūwā ɛhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄coŋmíyē ā kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ, ka ā kwú agōdō kú uwɔ ú ká ā ga ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í lɔtūce aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ŋ́. Ɔkpáncō nááná í kōō le yēŋēē tū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kwú īkpō kú Umɔ́sāadi í nyɔ̄ í nyi ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɔdā nēé nyi ā le jɛ̄ kwú pīya ɔcí nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ aígbáanɔ wā ī lɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gwó ce abɔ̄ nū á.

eng_Latn: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
idu_Latn: Ubánābasi mɛ́mla ami wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe cíkā ō yúklɔ́ kú abɔ̄yī uwā kéē le lá ɔdōlé lé ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā, ā géē hīla lɔɔlɔhi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a géē kwú á. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ uwɔ nyi ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó lɛ eyī yi ōwē mɛ́mla ákanya mɛ́mla ɔnɔ kú uwā, eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ikwū nēé je ā pó ā.

eng_Latn: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya le jīla tɔ̄há mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ujɔ̄ tū á. É le ije nɛ̄hi je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā anɔ́ɔ é da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gaá kwú ajī kú anɔ̄-ō-tɛ̄yí ā ú ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ anɔ̄ ā tū Usólōmɔn ɛyí. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ opo tá, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Oyēeyī kú Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, kóō yɔ̄ gbojī ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
idu_Latn: Ɔda nɛ̄ n gáā ka ga uwɔ abālɔbányā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá klá ī lé, ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ɔcɛ́ ɔ́mɛɛnɛ klla í lé, anú ā í lɛ ije mɛ́mla agbénú fíyɛ́ odúúdú uwā á. Ipú ágēnégēne kú ɔfú mɛ́mla agbénú kú nū ā, ó géē kpó ikpɛ́lā kwu ācɛ kú Ugirísi.

eng_Latn: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da uwá kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā, ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá mla Ujísɔ̄si nēé hī ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā kahíníī, Kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ aótrɛ̄yí icííci ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ aólɔdu fíyɛ́ aólɛhá ŋ́, ohígbū ka anú yá odúúdú ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú Ukénan kéē lɛ ɔ́ jila tayínū á. Ó lɛ iyē kú Uhosíya ɔyí kú Unún pīyabɔ̄ ga Ujóssuwa.

eng_Latn: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
idu_Latn: A híī tíne otú, eko nɛ̄ odúúdú éwo gē je yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā, kóō bī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ohígbū íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, Ádām, bīya ā nɛ̄ ikwū wā í gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó alɛɛcɛ piíí á. Amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, yá ā lɔfú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hī fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú nōo bīyíne ā yá ā. Ɔwɔicō le odúúdú ācɛ nōó ményinyi uwā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā kagwó mla iyī nū icííci. É géē yɔ̄ í lɔfú iyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
idu_Latn: a yɔ̄ gē ka ka, anúɔ le jí ɛɛ́. Ka amíyɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ ɔtūnōbí tū unwalu nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ā ɛɛ́. A klla ka ifu nɛ̄ anúɔ ī tá ā ɔ́ɔ le jɛ̄ anúɔ, anúɔ í kē lɛ omúlɛ́nyɔ́ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē cē ajɛ kú ɔ́mpā uwā tū ákú uwā. Ācɛ nēe bá piíí ā bá ī kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú ācɛ ɔhá uwī, ī bī uwā jɛ̄ mɛ́mla ákú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā wā gaá lɛ ɔ́ héyī. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, nya alɔ tá, alɔ gáā yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla eyī ɛnɛ mɛ́mla acá ɛnɛ kú uwá ā, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú uwá klla lɛ abɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɛnɛ ɛháajɛ aácá kú uwā. Abɔ̄ éyééye kwu ɛháajɛ acá éyééye.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
idu_Latn: N le nyɛ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ń tá uwɔ ohi glá ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō. N kwú abɔ̄ ú klá okónu kú um ka n mā ɛlā ō ka ŋ.

eng_Latn: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ tū wāajɛ, é klla nyí ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄hi. Ɔ̄nyɛ géē lɔfú jé ipɔ́ɔma kú nū glá ā? Ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú nū gaá mɛ ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ odúúdú aálá ā gaá le túbá abɔ́ɔ, ācogbāálá ā gē míya ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋmá okónu obugā ā kéē lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó lɛ aálá ā gwá. Ācogbāálá ā gē je ígbɛ́cɔ̄ ā míya ce okónu obugā cīgbīhi ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo dɔɔ̄kā kóō wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aá, ó géē wɛ ɔfíyɛ kú ācɛ ohile.

eng_Latn: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē je ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔlɛ́ kóō lā anú ŋ́ má. Ó klla gē kpó aálagbá ŋmá ipú agbá gē je uwá gbo agbénú. Amáŋ, ācɛ nēe gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ā gē lā ipú alácɛ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le Udéfīdi bī ga ɛgiyí uwā á. É wɛ ō pahīla klá ɛga dóódu, bá í lé, bá í gwá klla bā ī gwéeyē kú agbénú nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā. Agbénú kú ācɛ Ufilístiya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda.

eng_Latn: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Upíta gáā bēhé ga inu ā, Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si jīla anú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ pī ɔ̄ ikpó kóō gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um lɛ ā ā, anɔ́ɔ Uhanámɛlu, ɔyínɛ̄ɛpa kú um, gā ɛgiyí um ka amíyɔ̄ gáā lɛ ajɛ ā lá ohígbū ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ íkwu ō lá ajɛ ā kwúcē á. Ɔ́ɔmā cɛ̄ ga um le jé ka Óndú ā kā n lɛ ajɛ ā lá ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
idu_Latn: Igelī dúúmā í gáā hile nēé gáā je yíífi ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Kwu ɔpɛ́, kwu ajɛ kpátáá, é géē je odúúdú uwā yíífi. Ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ka ā á.

eng_Latn: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ádā ā tíne ka n yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē le jé ka n yíihɔtū tá Ádā um. Aá caŋ́jɛ ká ālɔ̄ nyɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá lɛwa fíyɛ́ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Aá kē tíne ō kpó uwā ŋmá úklɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba kahíníī, O kwú gblífi ɛɛ́! Ubábīlɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi ā kwú gbífi ɛɛ́! Aébilíi mɛ́mla aálelékwū oblínyī lā Ubábīlɔn abālɔbányā á. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛdɔ aígbáanɔ oblinyi nēe he ācɛ ɔtū ŋ́ mā lā ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá klla ga, gaá da Ujóbu kahíníī, Akpáabana ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ajɛ í lɛ odúúdú aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́wu, mɛ́mla ācogbāálá kú uwɔ ā kpó yi ŋmá ajɛ. Ami ōfōōfū um kwu wā í da uwɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Upahatimówābu ā, é wɛ, Ádīna, Ukélalu, Ubénaya, Umaaséya, Umɛtánīya, Ubɛsalélu, Ubinúwi mɛ́mla Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ, anɔ́ɔ é má lā anú á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō dobū ā, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwū ɔwɛ kú igá kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ń jé ɛga nēé nyɔ̄ ā gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá nyɔ̄ fíya, aá lɔfú kwú uwā ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú aádáádā nɛ̄hi ā. Ohɔ́nyɛtá ipú ɔkpíyē kú ɔlɛɛcɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā. Odúúdú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nōo ī leyīkwu ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu ā. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
idu_Latn: É le Ulɔ́tu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ kú Ébram, nōo lā Usɔ́dɔm ā mɛ́mla odúúdú agbénú kú nū kpó, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
idu_Latn: Ācōtɔ́sú ŋmá aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Uháran, Ukáne, Ídɛn, Ussɛ́ba, Ássɔ, Ukílmadi ā tá ɔ́sú mla uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, da alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú aá yá aá ōwē ŋmá eko kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú aá jāā gáā kwu ícɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ lɛ oyī ā na ŋmá uwɔ iyē, lɛ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nɛ̄ é hī ólīfu ā kpó nyā uwɔ iyē á.

eng_Latn: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Unínīfɛ mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le miya ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kéē lɛ okónu gwū. O ŋmá ācɛ nɛ̄hi ga ācɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, kéē lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiyē, kóō mafú keé le pīyabɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mla otú dóódu ó gē yɛ gicō gajɛ ɛplá aúnóji. Ó klla ī yɛ ga ɛfu, yɔ̄ gē dɛ̄gba, gē bī ɛcɔ̄ le hɛ́ iyīnu iyē.

eng_Latn: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nēé hī iyē nū ka Umíka. Ó lā ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem.

eng_Latn: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, É géē yá ami nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā ōwē nɛ̄hi, anyākwɔ́cɛ mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla aítíca kú íne géē tá ɛlā kú nū. É géē je ɔ́ ŋmó, amáŋ é géē je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá.

eng_Latn: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Óndú, iní nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā í yá ā? Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ okwu tá ā, nɛ̄ ēpū gē jīla bá á.

eng_Latn: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā, kwu ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛnyā, kóō híī wɛ akwuna kú agbla kú ɛcí dúúma ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ géē kpó aɛ́cí nēé bī oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ yá gē gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā ā bónū lɛ aífú mɛ́mla aúdɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yá okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ ī je ɔ̄cɛ pīya odokónu, ámāŋ odahɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō mɛ́ɛbɛ, ámāŋ gē je ɔ́ pīya opeyī ā? Ó wɛ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá túblá ajɛ kú ayí kú Ámɔ̄ri, ámāŋ yɛ lɛyíkwu ajɛ nōo tá lɛyíkwu Ísu kú Ujábɔ̄ku, ámāŋ ka aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛfu mɛ́mla o yɛ ga ɛga ohile nɛ̄ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ tū aá ukɔ́ ka aá kóō híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Awɔ da ɔ̄kā nyā abɔ̄yī uwɔ á kɛ̄ɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi le odée da uwɔ lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́tūwɛlu wɛ ádā kú Urebɛ́ka á. Umílka ma ayí ahātá nyā lɛ Unáhɔ, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ébrahām á.

eng_Latn: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō lɛ ā nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í yɔ̄ ī móōwē ojigógó oŋ́mífī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ā. Ikoko ɔ́ɔmā, abālɔbányā nɛ̄ eko kú aɔ́dā dóódu yɔ̄ ī wā í ŋmɛ́yí ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ó wā igbeékpónú ōfōōfūnū kóō kwú iyī nū ú gwɛ́ɛya, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ í jé ɔdā ō yá ipú ɛlā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó ka anúɔ í tíne kú ɔlɛɛcɛ dúúmā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá anúɔ italā ŋ́. Ka Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yá anúɔ italā, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ gē méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu mla aíkonó kú nū gā ajɛ Íjīpiti ā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti yá uwá ōwē ā, aádáádā aá le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tá uwā abɔ̄. Ó lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá le uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwā ú lā ipú ajɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, n gē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É wɛ éwo nōo lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá um ɛɛ́. Uwá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aádáádā uwá nēe húmáyī yā īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um ā.

eng_Latn: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō ka ífulá kú ágbe nōo yá aá ŋ́. Ágbe ā í tōō tá kóō kwú jé ŋ́. N yá aá italā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ohígbū ka ɛ́pɔ̄bī nɛ̄ aá lé ā nwuné nɛ̄hi. Ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ā klla kē nwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
idu_Latn: Unínīfɛ, ɔ̄cɛ éyi le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ojuju kú ɔbíipú tū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú ó gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ á, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá tá Ujísɔ̄si ɔkwu gē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá á. Eko nɛ̄ ɛwa ā le ɔ́ má ā, odúúdú uwā tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá dúú.

eng_Latn: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwū kú Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ā, Utóla ɔyí kú Upúwa, ɔyí kú Udodo wā í lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́tá. Ó ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka, ó lā Ussámɛ, ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
idu_Latn: Ami yá ɛcɛ, klla yá alɛɛcɛ bá ipú nū á. Ami bī abɔ̄ kú um le nā ɔkpáncō daa klá ɛyí ɛcɛ á. Ami lɛ íkwu klla gē je ɔ́da lɛ ɛnɔ, ɔyā mɛ́mla odúúdú aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ ā kéē wā ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe géē má uwɔ ā, géē yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. É géē ka, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, Unínīfɛ je yíífi klla má tá alácɛ̄ yɔ̄ɔ̄! Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ményinyi nū gɛ? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē dɔɔ̄kā ō tú ɔ̄ ɔtūlé gɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ā klla le pīya ga ɛháajɛ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛfu nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó yɛ lɛyíkwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ukiriyati Ubáalu , nōo wɛ ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda a. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛjī kú nū kú ābɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
idu_Latn: klla í yá uwā italā lɛ á. Uwá le kwu ŋmá ɔlá éyi ɛɛ́, amáŋ ɔlá piíí gáā kpó uwá yi á. Eko nɛ̄ n géē yá uwā italā ā, aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ kōō híī túkpɛɛ́ lɛ uwá dɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ gē yɔ́bɔ́nyā nɛ̄hi. Ó ka anúɔ gē je íne o bīya kú aádā ce ayí uwā ɛyí. O ŋmá ayááyí ɔ́mɛɛtá ga ɔ́mɛɛnɛ kú ācɛ nēe gē tū anúɔ eyījii ā.

eng_Latn: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē wā ɛgiyī nū Ujérīko, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ń da aá ka aá kóō híī nyɔ̄ ŋ́ ŋ̄.

eng_Latn: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ alɔ tútū ohígbū opīyabɔ̄ nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Alelékwū kú nū ú lɛ alɔ kóō wɛ ɔdā o kwajɛ kú odúúdú ɔdā nōó kpó bá gbēyī alɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ācɛ bā í gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú ɛyí ɛfu ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja olɔfú nɛ̄ Udéfīdi lɛ á. Ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí ā wɛ Ujósēbu Ubássébeti, nōo ŋmá Utácēmɔn ā. Anú wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú, Aícɔ́ɔja ɛta ā á. Ó bī óbō le kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ úlā ɛpa , lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú ɛ̄cī ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú uwɔ̄ le mulɛ́mulɛ́ kwu gɔ̄mm bɛ̄ɛka ayīnu adāgbá ā. Īkpēyī kú uwɔ ī ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ njɔlɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhɛ́ssibɔn, nōo kwu okónu igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā. Ɛnwū kú uwɔ̄ kwu gɛ̄mm bɛ̄ɛka Inɔ̄ɔda kú Ulɛ́bānɔn, nōo kwu Udamásikɔ̄si ājaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan da Udéfīdi ka, ɔdā dúúmā nɔ́ɔ ka ā, anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aótrɛ̄yí ā, ɛ́ɛ géē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo gwó inu ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ kē je ɔ́ tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ ga ɔlɛ́. Ka ɔ́dāŋ nōó nyɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nēé lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú bɛ́ɛ, ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ gáā lā ipú ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ífi, mɛ́mla ámíyā, mɛ́mla ákanya géē yá uwā eko nēé leyīce ŋ́ mā. Ágbe nɛ̄ ó gáā jé ŋ́ mā, géē je uwá kpó yííji ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Ɔdī yā nɛ̄ aá bī ɔtūnōbí gé um o ŋmá lɛ ō da ɔnyīlɔ ɔ́ɔmā ka aá lɛ ɔyínɛ́ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ahāanɛ kú ipú iháyí ɔ́mpa nɛ̄ Udárīyɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́ ā, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le ɛlā ɔhá ka lɛ Uhágāyi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ ā ka.

eng_Latn: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ um gbla anú glá āa? Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā jōnjīlɛ mɛ́mla um kɛ̄ɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
idu_Latn: Ó ī he uwá ɔtū kéē hokónu tū uwā ipú ōlihī, ká ācɛ kéē klla hī uwā ka Itíca.

eng_Latn: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Urécabu mɛ́mla Ubaána ŋmó á. É lɛ uwá aíkpó odajɛ mɛ́mla aábɔ̄ kpó hɛ́, kwú kpó pla icō okónu ɔkpá nōo yɔ̄ Uhɛ́brɔn ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú īkpɛ̄yí kú Íssbɔ̄ssɛti í gaá nyi únóji kú Ábna Uhɛ́brɔn abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
idu_Latn: N jé ohílīpú nēé ī gbo ā mɛ́mla ucē nēé ī yá ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē wā í tá ācɛ kú odúúdú aéwo mɛ́mla ucē ā bá. Eko nēé le túbá, é géē má ɔdā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n bī ɔfú kú um yá glá ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Usára ɔnyā uwɔ yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ó yɔ̄ ipū áklɔ̄kpɛ.

eng_Latn: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
idu_Latn: Aá bī íjééyī lɛ yá ɔdā dóódu ipú ācɛ nēé wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ŋ́ mā ā, ká aá bī ɛga dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā le yúlɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
idu_Latn: Anú, Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á, anú ī hɛ́pɔ̄ ɛga dóódu ipú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
idu_Latn: Aá gē jé uwēyī gā um īyɔ̄bū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, cɛ́ɛ́ ka é je umu lígíí mla igbō lígíí lɛ aá. Aá bī ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā bá ī le ŋmó ācɛ nēé cíkā ō kwú ŋ́ mā, kē gē habɔ̄ ācɛ nēé cíkā ō yēeyī ŋ́ mā tá kéē yēeyī, ohígbū ká uwá kē ī cɛɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá eko ígblé nɛ̄ ó je ikpó kú ɛcɛ nyā táajɛ ā, ó bī abɔ̄ kú nū le odúúdú ɔkpáncō mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā kpó yá.

eng_Latn: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú um kwú kpó mi, n mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi glá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ikwū nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú um gē cɛ̄ gā um je ā.

eng_Latn: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N tá abɔ̄ áncā wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ um, abɔ̄ áncā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n kē í tá eko nɛ̄ um kwú ŋmá ɛcɛ á. Óndú, awɔ je ɔdā dóódu gā um á, a kē mīyɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋmá ɛgiyí um ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō, n cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
idu_Latn: Ɛlkána lɛ anyā ɛpa, Uhána mɛ́mla Upɛnína. Upɛnína ma ayí alɛwa, amáŋ Uhána wɛ ɔdɔma.

eng_Latn: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɔhā nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ géē hɛ́ ce uwɔ ā nwuné fíyɛ́ aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ŋmá ɛfu nōo kwāájɛ piyóó. Aɔ́hā nēe bá nyā kéē wɛ ákú Ujósɛ̄fu. Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔhā nyā hɛ́ ce Ujósɛ̄fu nēé kwú ɔ̄ yá otrɛ̄yí kú ayínɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī kpó odée yíífi ā bá ɛga dóódu. É bī ɔfú kú uwā bá ī le pīya ācɛ tū, klla bá ī plla ācɛ ipú úláyi.

eng_Latn: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɛlá kóō lɔhi fíyɛ́ kéē cá ɔ̄ ɛcá ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá fíyɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī agbénú kú Íjīpiti, ohígbū kóō leyī kú nū kwu ulé nōó í mīyɛ ɛ̄cɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka ɔ̄cɛ nēé hī ka Ābɔ̄ ā géē jɛ̄ gɔbū monómonó ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ó gáā tū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā gwó igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ eyī yɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá um ā cɛ́ɛ́ okónu í gáā hɛ́ aá ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā kóō cɛ̄ lɛ aá lɛ okónu klá cííí.

eng_Latn: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī pɛ́ úgbéenyi ā kwú kwu hɛ̄ odúúdú aúgbéényi kú uwā tá. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú uwā kwú pɛ́ bɛ̄cɛ gaá hayi okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
idu_Latn: Aá tá Óndú ā ahínyá, ká aá dɛ̄ hī iyē nū eko dóódu. Ka ɔdā nōó yá ā lɛ odúúdú aéwo kú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
idu_Latn: Eyī kú Óndú ā kwu ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó klla ī gbō uwā, ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ uwá eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ ádáádā kú aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa ā á. É kē le iyē kú kpó ce aípɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́ga nēé lā ipú aáklɔ̄kpɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a nwuné lɛ ā mafú ɔkpáncō. Ká ā lɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú uwɔ mafú lɛ odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
idu_Latn: A kē jé ka eko nɛ̄ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ uwɔ tá ā, igbīhāajɛ alɔ kē le pīyabɔ̄ tíne ō kwúcē wā. Abɔ̄ ā lɛ ɛlā nwū alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ yá eko nɛ̄ alɔ wɛ ayípɛ̄ ā jé ā, uwēyī lɛ alɔ kwú nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ alɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kpó klá eyī, le ɛyí kpó kwaajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī nwū um ɔdā nɛ̄ n jé ā ŋmá ɔdā nēé klɔ́ɔcɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí aádáádā uwá ā á.

eng_Latn: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
idu_Latn: Ká ɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ncɛ kú uwā ā kóō gwá aíkpɔ̄cí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā ā, ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ géē yɛ lɔhi ipú ajɛ ā lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā.

eng_Latn: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upáyílēti má koó lɛ ile dúúmā ō ce uwá piíí piíí gɛ ŋ́ mā, ohígb­ū ka egidi gbɔɔ́ ɛɛ́ mā, ó kwú éŋkpɔ̄ ú lɛ abɔ̄ nā ipéyī ójīla ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Abɔ̄ kú um í yɔ̄ oyī kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́ nyā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́ɔmā kóō wɛ ɛlā kú aá.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the LORD hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄ n lɛ, nēe lɛ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā jijitēyī klla le uwá kpó yá begebege. Ó le aícɔ́ɔja ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē lɛ ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ um kpó yíífi. Óndú ā le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um wú ŋinii ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē wú igwu ā.

eng_Latn: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo klla ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā nɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ o gē kɛlā ɔ̄kwɛyi ŋmá ɔtū kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔfú kú um tá ipú ɔtū kú aá, klla í má ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um klla yɛce odúúdú ɔ́da nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
idu_Latn: Ugamálīyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Upɛdássɔ gē leyīkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ á.

eng_Latn: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
idu_Latn: É je ɔfiyɛ nōo jéeyī, gē cēyītīkwū ī yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi ā yá otrɛ̄yí kú ɔyí ɔlɛ́ nōo wɛ ɔdāhá. É kē í kɔ̄ úgwū ékpó lɛ anú mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ ā jōōjīlɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
idu_Latn: Ubenáya mɛ́mla Ujahásīyɛlu, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá í tá opo eko dóódu iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
idu_Latn: Ó ka aádáádā anúɔ ɛ́ɛ kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ugósan, Uháran, mɛ́mla Urésēfu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ídɛn nēe lā Utɛlása ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ á. Ó ka aɛ́cí kú odúúmā kú aéwo ɔ́ɔmā í hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aɔ́cɛ́ otɛtɛ kú Asírīya ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufílīstiya ā háyi abɔ́ɔ, le ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā yá ā má kwɛyí, anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē ga Ékrɔn ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
idu_Latn: Usíkiri wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ábīja á. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Uminiyámin. Upílitāyi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umowadíya á.

eng_Latn: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē fu uwɔ ɔkwu ŋmá ɛga kú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ a cīce ā, klla í bī uwɔ wā ajɛ ŋmá āhɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a ce ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
idu_Latn: Nááná ā, Ɔwɔicō í je ajɛ dúúmā lɛ Ébrahām kóō wɛ ákú nū ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ īkpō éyi nááná. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le okónu ce ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ ā lɛ anú mɛ́mla ayááyí nū, nááná nōó ma ɔyí eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ le ɛ̄nyā pó ā, alɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Upɔ́lu ká ɔ̄ híī nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
idu_Latn: Upíta le abɔ̄ nāndaa, kwú ɔ̄ ú nyāŋjɛ háyicō. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō mɛ́mla anyōkwū ā kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ mafú lɛ uwá kóō oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ aɔ́máapú anúɔ, ācɛ ékpónú mɛ́mla anúɔ. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē wɛ ācɛ ámōōmɛ nēe í bī anúɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu lɛ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujonátan yá ā da ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ lé enyi ɛnwú lígíii, ka anúɔ yɔ̄ á, ka anúɔ cɛ̄ ka anúɔ géē kwú.

eng_Latn: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Udéfīdi kahíníī, Wā ká n̄ kwú ɛbɛ́ kú uwɔ ú lɛ aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí kéē lé.

eng_Latn: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā má cīce kwu ɔgbɔɔgba, ipú ígwíígwu kú ofɛhɔ̄ ofɛhɔ̄ mla igwú kú ofɛpa cigwó ofɛpa cigwó á.

eng_Latn: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā le ɛkpa kú uwā nwūla kpó.

eng_Latn: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē jikwū yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yɛɛhɛ ā kē yɔ̄. Eko kú ɔtūnóbī yɔ̄, eko kú ɔtūnɛ̄hɛ́ kē yɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yɔ́tūnōbí yɔ̄, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē jīījē kē yɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
idu_Latn: Ɔyípōklóbīya nōo wɛ olɛhá, klla jééyī, lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔcɛ́ nōo wɛ olíla nōó gē mīyɛ ɛlā nēé gē nwū ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔnū cɛ̄ tū ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔmā anɔ́ɔ n ka, É gē lɛyí táajɛ gā um ojigóógó ŋ́, é klla kē tá kéē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ aíne kú um.

eng_Latn: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Ighīhāajɛ, Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kwú ublɔ́ɔku kú ɔmɛ ú, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā a lɛ ifotó kú igelī nōo lé ka Ujerúsālɛm ā kpó tū ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá pó, aɛ́fu, aá nōo wɛ etikpa opiyóó kú ɛcɛ ā, aá jāhɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄ kú Óndú ā! Ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó yɔ̄ ī kpó ɛlā ce Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unátan tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá yá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔtū kú nū ā ō yá. Ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
idu_Latn: Íjééyī lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɛdɔ iyɔ́fú dóódu á, amáŋ ɔ̄cobīyíne ékpónú gē bīya ɔdā olɔhi alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ipú odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, n le ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú nū fu kéē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yúklɔ́ ɛyí ede, kéē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ úwé kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya wu iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē da um ɔ̄kā. N klla le ɛga je lɛ uwá kéē klla lé ŋmá ɛya nēé gwó ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa ɔhá gbā bɛ̄ɛka ákú aflɛ́yí ā, mɛ́mla ikpati kú ɔcí nōó géē lɛ usiléeti ā tá ipú nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wā icō ɛfu ɛga anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, é le yɛ ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā bá ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū, mɛ́mla ɔgalúmpɛ̄, klla bá ī tá opo, klla bá ī gwō uba mɛ́mla úmōlō, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē gwííjē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá.

eng_Latn: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ gebí bɛ̄ɛka aálá ā, Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ kwú eyī ú pīya kwu ɔwɛ kú abɔ̄yīnū yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄. Amáŋ Óndú ā kwú ɔ́bíipú kú odúúdú alɔ í kpó ce ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ Usánbālati le pó ka alɔ nōo wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā gbɔɔ́ ō ma ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm igbɔhá ā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá alɔ ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
idu_Latn: Awɔ Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛyí ā, awɔ kē cokónu nɛ̄hi nyā gā um á.

eng_Latn: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
idu_Latn: É le bū ɛháajɛ ā ga Uhɛ́brɔn. Ahíman, Usséss­ayi mɛ́mla Utálimāyi nēe wɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú aágwu nēé hī ka Ánāki ā, lā abɔ́ɔ. É le Uhɛ́burɔn gwó iháyí ahāapa gbɔbū lɛ Usówan kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ā híī yúufi uwā ŋ́, a kē jé ka n yɔ̄ pī uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú um gbō uwɔ. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ yá mɛ́ɛ̄? Ó ka anúɔ í kōō lɔfú dɔɔ̄kā áncā ŋ́ dúú?.

eng_Latn: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bi dúúmā yá uwɔ ámāŋ ka ó bī uwɔ ulé dúúmā, lɛ ulé ā ka gā um ká n̄ bī uwɔ ulé.

eng_Latn: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛnɛ ce ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ɔ́ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í lɛ ɔdā dúú amānyā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka igbō ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa.

eng_Latn: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
idu_Latn: Ó le ukɔ́ tū ācɛ nɛ̄ ó fu ā kahíníī, Aá géē yúklɔ́ kú aá ipú ufi kú Óndú ā, klla í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le abɔ̄ kpó pīya klá eyí, yɔ̄ gē jikwū gbōmgbōm, yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Kpái, ɔyí um, ɔyí um Ábsālɔm! Ábsālɔm ɔyí um eee.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ohi kahíníī, Ami nɛ̄, aá géē má ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā abɔ̄ ó géē wā ɛyí ojuja kú ɔkpancō ā!.

eng_Latn: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
idu_Latn: Aólɛla le ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe yɔ̄ Ujerúsalɛm ā, kpó abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ūwā ga ajɛ kú éwɔhá, abɔ̄ é lɛ otábɔ̄ dúú gɛ ŋ́ mā. É kōō lɛ ajɛ dúú nēé ī hī ákú ūwā gɛ ŋ́. Aólɛlā kú ūwā ā le uwá yɛjīlatá biílí, é kē lɛ ɔwɛ nēé ī kwu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔhi ga uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá odúúmā kú ūwā glaajɛ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yúufi Ɔwɔicō, géē bū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā ā gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ, nōo lɔfú bī okónu ō tá gē lɛ ɔ́ klla í cɛ̄ lɛ ipúkpánū yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi glá ā.

eng_Latn: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú lɛ Uhábakūku, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́wū kú ipácí ī lā ɛyí ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ eko éyi nɛ̄ ācɛ cīlɛ̄fú le unu egidi nu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmó. É lɛ uwá kpó tāagbā. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā wɛ .

eng_Latn: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ācɛ okɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yí ā, gáā lé úgwū ajɛ kú alɔ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm dúú ā wɛ, Usálu, ɔyí kú Uméssūlam, ɔyí kú Uhódāfiya nōo wɛ ɔyí kú Uhasenúwa ā.

eng_Latn: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ túkpɛɛ́ lɛ okwúukwu kwaajɛ ipú o tú iyī alɔ wāajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, alɔ lɛ eyīyōce ka ó í nya alɔ tá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
idu_Latn: É le eliká kú ugóolu ɛpa yá, kwu uwā ú kpó kwu ɛháajɛ kú ɔ́kíka ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā, okónōgwu eyīpú nōo gboce ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o he um ɔtū, n lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ō yɔ́ɔma gáā ma ɔyí ā, n gē jé ɛdɔ ɔnɔ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ohígbū aá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá kwú pīya ācɛ o yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ ā géē lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ eko kú Ulɔ́tu ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé, gē gwá, bá yɔ̄ ī lá ɔ́lá, bá yɔ̄ ī je ɔlá lá. É bá yɔ̄ ī nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ klla bá yɔ̄ ī gwó inu.

eng_Latn: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu cāŋjɛ, kwú ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū ú anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō uwā ɔwɛ dóódu, nɛ̄ ikpokwú kú odúúmā kú uwā í kōō gáā ce ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
idu_Latn: Aá kwu ga ipú aɔ́gɛ̄cɔ̄, ámāŋ ka aá bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ kú aá tayínū ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū ɛɛ́. Ó kē í wā mla ɔfú mɛ́mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā má bā ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ gē kɛlā mla Ugɛ́hási, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɛláyíssa ā, klla yɔ̄ ī da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kú odúúdú úklɔ́ idáagó nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa yá ā.

eng_Latn: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē bī obɔ̄bí piíí kú aólɛlā nēe gē gbō um gɛɛ ā, le cílá uwá ulé. Óndú lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ohígbū ka a tōō lɛ ɔtūce.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ Ujeremíya lɛyíkwu aéwɔhá ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí. Ɛlā nōo ka ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ā bá ā.

eng_Latn: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umɛrári.

eng_Latn: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔfú je lɛ uwá kéē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔwɔ yá ŋ ɛpléeko nēé bá ī cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. É lɔfú lɛyíkwu aŋ́jɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄, kéē je uwá pīya oyī. É klla lɔfú kéē tū aámíyā nɛ̄hi ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí dóódu klá ɛcɛ igbalɛwa ɛ́gɛ́ dúúmā nōo he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā klla bī ɛlā okónu í ka kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá gā klla gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwá nɔ̄nyā ā bā í lé ucɛ klla bá ī gwá ejé ɔlɛ́ ɔ́kplá kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɛlā ka nááná, ɔnɔ nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī jé ā í mɛ ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ okónu klá nááná, n kē yɔ̄ ī jé ɔnɔ ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
idu_Latn: Aá géē túbá ká aá gbā um ɛ̄gbā ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú aɛ́cī nēe bá ā. Aá híī yúklɔ́ kú ɛ̄cī kú aá nɛ̄ aá gē yá ɛ̄cī dóódu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
idu_Latn: mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛga ocíce kú ojīlīmā ī he uwá ɔtū kéē cīce ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛga ojīlīmā ō cīce eko kú ucɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
idu_Latn: Aá ka tɛ́ɛcɛ Ugáti nóó, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ úláyi kú Ásskɛ̄lɔn ŋ́! Ohígbū nɛ̄ ayínɔ̄nyā kú Ufílīstiya géē gwéeyē. Ohígbū nɛ̄ ayínɔ̄nyā kú ācɛ opɛ̄cí ā géē gwéeyē!.

eng_Latn: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
idu_Latn: É klla lɛ Úklɔ́ je lɛ ayí kú Ámram, Ísiha, Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Usíyɛ̄lu ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
idu_Latn: Ayí ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá ā gē bá ī hijā kwinya yɛ bɛ̄ɛka ayí álá ā. Ayípɛ̄ ā gē jījē.

eng_Latn: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ ga um, ohígbū ka a jé ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá um ā.

eng_Latn: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā, lɔfú yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā gɔbū kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ucē icíci ā kē lɔfú yɔ̄ ī yá ucē icíci gɔbū kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī yá ucē olɔhi kóō bēē yá ucē olɔhi gɔbū kpɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lā oyēeyī otīihɔ kóō bēē tīihɔ gɔbū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Ukéni, Ugíbēya, mɛ́mla Utímīna. É wɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi igwó mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ uwá jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔ̄kā kú uwɔ pó ɛɛ́, ka alelékwū kú aɔ́wɔ otīihɔ ā yɔ̄ ipú uwɔ, a jééyī, a jɔ́ɔ́dā, klla lɛ ohílīpú.

eng_Latn: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
idu_Latn: Ó kpó aéwo alɛwa yíífi, klla kpó aɔ́cɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi alɛwa ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka á gáā nyɔ̄ mla alɔ ŋ́, ā cɛ̄ kú alɔ fu ajɛ ŋmá amānyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
idu_Latn: Ikókwū nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī le lé ɔdōlé ihɔ, nɛ̄ alɔ ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ohígbū nū ā, eko nɛ̄ alɔ gē gwá ŋmá ipú nū, oyī kú Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ alɔ gē kɔ̄ gwá abɔ́ɔ á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í kɛla ā. Anɔ́ɔ igbō nɛ̄ alɔ gē ce lɛ iyī alɔ ā, eko nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé, alɔ yɔ̄ í kɔ̄ ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā lé.

eng_Latn: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū gē he Óndú ā, eko dúú nɛ̄ ācɛ olɔhi gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, amáŋ ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ obɔ̄bí gē bī wā ā, ī wú ɔ̄ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛlā nēé ka nyā, ɔcɛ́ ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ odúúdú ācojéeyī kú Ubábīlɔn ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ékpónú yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá á. Anɔ́ɔ ó géē mīyɛ ācɛ wā ɛgiyí nū ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Usólōmɔn ka ɛdɔ ɔlɛ́ nyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó lɛ anúɔ á ā? Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, é gē hī abɔ́ɔ ka, ajɛ kú Úkábulu jāā kwu eko nɛ̄ é tá ɔkpa nyā a.

eng_Latn: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá kwu odúúdú ɔdā nōó má eko nɛ̄ ācobīyíne yá ɔ̄ ɔdōbɔ́bí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kú aá gbagbafú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwúcē ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Kwu aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ā gē jikwū klá awɔ, ohígbū ka aáyɔ́kpá kpɛ́mm ā kwú kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́, ɔlá klla kwú odúúdú ácí kú ígbíli ā ú kpó yi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ā nōó mī oyī klá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé gē bī le gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá lɛ iyī aá yá tīihɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú nōo hī aá igwú ā tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ ōhī kú aá kéē kwú ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā ú, cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ ahāapa ká ācogwɛ́ɛya ahāapa ɔhá ā kéē bī opo kú ajī ɛbɛ́, iyɔ̄bū kú ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
idu_Latn: Upélatīya, Uhánan, Anáya.

eng_Latn: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa ā le cētū ipú uwā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā ijē. Ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā lɛ otógwō kú uwā híla ŋmá uwá iyē, anɔ́ɔ é le íkwu je kéē bī itali le uwá gɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ayí kú Ulífāyi ā wɛ, Ujosábādi, Ussímēyi, Ukeláya, nēé gē hī ka Ukélita dúú ā, Upétahīya, Ujúda mɛ́mla Ɛlíyēsa.

eng_Latn: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi īkpō kú ɛpɔ̄ újí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔglɛ́ɛjí gē nyi īkpō ā, ífi gáā wɛ ukpɛ́ kú nū á, cɛ́ɛ́ ó méyī mɛ́ɛbɛ lɛ abɔ̄ da ācɛ ɔhá ɛyī tāajɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ á, Nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Asírīya kē lɔfú klla lɛwa nɛ̄hi ā, é géē je uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n tɛtɛ cɛ̄ lɛ aá móōwē, amáŋ aá gáā móōwē igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā má cē nwuné ŋ́, ohígbū ka efūma géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ nyí ā kpó lé ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD's anointed is before him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ā, Usámūwɛ̄lu leyīkwu Ɛlíyābu, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyí, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú fu kéē lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kú ō wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā háyi iyɔ̄bū um yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ipú ɛlā kú nū kahíníī, N lɛ ɛcɔ̄ o tīile nɛ̄hi éyi piyɛ, ɛ̄nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē le kwu ɔkíkā kú Ujerúsālɛm, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá nɛ̄ n fu ā, uwēyī ī gáā kwú ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le abɔ̄ nāndaa kwu ɔ́ iyē anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N cɛ̄, le yá yēŋēē. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó le hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē kú nū.

eng_Latn: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Unétōfanū wɛ, ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
idu_Latn: É géē kpó ɛbɛ́ nēé wā ā ce ɛyí ɔlá, īkpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ijē kú ɛbɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ujówābu mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ nū, Abíssāyi, ŋmó Ábna le gwū ɔ́ci ohígbū ɔyínɛ́ uwā, Ásáhɛlu nɛ̄ Ábna ŋmó ipú ɛfú nēé kpó Ugíbēyɔn āá.

eng_Latn: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú alɔ le mu mla aɔ́dāajɛ. ikpó ɛfu ā kē le mu mla ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ń géē yɛ í le wu nyɔ̄ í lā ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔmā ohile ā géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ ákú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Ubɛ́njamin géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi nōo í gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníí, Ɔlɛcɛ, le aúcē ɛbí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ujerúsālɛm yá ā mafú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kpɔ́tūce ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá abɔ̄ nū, ó géē je ɔ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ije ā ŋmó tū ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū abɔ́ɔ, ó kōō wɛ ɛbɛ́ ɛna, ɔyí álá, ejé mɛ́mla uburukutu. Cɛ́ɛ́ uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwā kéē lé klla yá abahi lɛ iyī uwā kú ɔtū kóō he uwá ipéyī Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nwū ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī ɔwɛ nyā tá, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Óndú alɔ Jísɔs Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔwɛ o gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā kú alɔ ge nwū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n géē má uwɔ eyī, Óndú, ohígbū ka ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́. Eko nēé le um héyī, n géē má uwɔ eyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujábesi ipú Ugílɛ̄di ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya yá Usɔ́lu ā pó ā.

eng_Latn: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu le Ugolíyāti má ā, odúúdú uwā le pɛ́kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, ohígbū ka é gē yúufi nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú da um kahínī.

eng_Latn: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
idu_Latn: É lɛ Ikpati ā bī wā í tá ipú ádá, nɛ̄ Udéfīdi gwó lɛ ɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú olétɔ̄há gwó lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,
idu_Latn: Mɛ́mla ācɛ kú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Uhóma, Ubórāssan, Átāki.

eng_Latn: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó alɔ mla agbénú kú alɔ cīgbīhi wā Ujɛrúsālɛm ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄na nɛ̄ alɔ bá yɔ̄ ī nā a.

eng_Latn: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā, le tá Ugíbēyɔn gaá gwɛ́ɛya. Ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ nēé gē gwɛ́ɛya fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ó kē ī kpó aɛ́bɛ́ úlā ɛpa cofigwó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú uwá a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo yɔ̄ ī tū oji giyí ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā. É lɛ ācɛ a kpó ŋmó, kwú odúúdú ije mla agbénú kú uwá nēé glá ā ú kpó. Ipú ācɛ oōŋmó kú uwá a, é kwú anyā alɛwa ú pīya anyōkwū.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó wɛ awɔ gaá gwó ɔ̄ gā um ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ éyi, gáā gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gā um á.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra Óndú ā ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú um dúúdu, ā kē je mlanyī odúúdú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ó yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the body is not one member, but many.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka iyē ā í lɛ āyā ékpó ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ ó lɛ āyā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
idu_Latn: N jé ka a jé ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu, ɔtū kē í he uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yí. N kpó odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā gé uwɔ ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú. N má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔtū he ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nēe jīla bá ā abɔ̄ uwá bá í bī ɛhi nyā gé lɛ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi le ɔ́da je lɛ Ujówābu mɛ́mla Abíssāyi mɛ́mla Ítāyi kahíníī, Ohígbū um ā, aá kóocōō, aá yá ɔyí um, Ábsālɔm, ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja ā kē pó ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ je lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā.

eng_Latn: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē fu ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo géē lɛyítáajɛ gā um, nōo klla géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n géē da ɔ́ ā. N géē je ipɔ́ɔma éyi lɛ ɔ́ nōo géē yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ n fu ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ nōo lɛ ɔnya ā yá lɔhi, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́ mā yá lɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē je yá uwā ɛhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ a.

eng_Latn: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ádā ŋ́, ó lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ ŋ́, ó klla lɛ ipɔ́ɔma ŋ́. Ó lɛ eko nēé ma ɔ́ ŋ́, ó kē lɛ eko nɛ̄ oyēeyī kú nū kē í mɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ abɔ̄ ó le lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
idu_Latn: Igbómína kú Ujúda ā da uwá ka, é gaá lé ɔdōlé kú ɛya dúúmā néē gē gwó lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bī Úrim mɛ́mla Utúmmim lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le okónu hɛ́ tū uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō ka lɛ uwá ɔgbace ɔgbace ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɔ̄ yá ɔtāhɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Kwú odúúdú omlede ā ú yɔlá ɛyí ede ā kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé. Ocu kú ɛya nyā he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé māháyi, aákā ā kē māháyi. Eko nēé le wu, aákā ā kē ī yɛ mla uwá. Ohígbū ka aódée ā ī bī aákā ā yúklɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú otú nyā nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛ um, nɛ̄ n kē ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, gaá háyi ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ā, ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ó le um yá aflɛ́yí, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyā nɛ̄ á kē kwú ije kú um ú tá ɛga nēé ī kpó ije tū ā ŋ́ mā ā? Cɛ́ɛ́ ń géē yɛ í le itene lɛ ce ɔ́ ɛyí eko nɛ̄ n pīyɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu le ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō ka anúɔ gāá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ yá uwā lé nɛɛ? Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í tá ɔ̄ ohi ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī yɔ̄ ipú ɛcɛ nyā, kwu aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwo ɔhá, í cɛ̄ ká olɛ̄la ɔ́ɔ lɔfú bēé igá kú Ujerúsālɛm gā ipú ɔlɛ́ ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ é hī ka Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki nyā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Usálɛm mɛ́mla ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Eko nɛ̄ Ébrahām yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ɛga nōó yá aɔ́cɛ́ ɛnɛ lé ā, Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki jīla ɔ́ ɔwɛ lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)
idu_Latn: É ka aá le abɔ̄ tɛ́yɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicɔ̄ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. É ka ɔ́ɔ jé ɔdā nōo yá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gwó ede ā. É ka aá tíne kú odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɔ́ jé lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kahíníī, N lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄pɛ̄, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ń wā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́li wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umɛ́tāti, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ulífāyi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umélki, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujánāyi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujósɛ̄fu.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ojuju nɛ̄ n tū lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá ācɛ kú igelī kú Utɛ́man ā. Kwu ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, é géē kpó uwá pi nyɔ̄, é kē í je ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú Ábsālɔm le pɛ́ wā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā gaá da ɔnyā ā ɔ̄kā ka iní nɛ̄ Ahímāasi mɛ́mla Ujonátan bá ā? Ɔnyā ā da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ le bēhé ísu le yɛ tá ipú ígbíli ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā dɔɔ̄kā uwá gbógbógbó. Abɔ̄ é má ayípóklóbīya ɛpa ā ŋ́ mā, é kwúcē le tá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɔbū ga ɛgiyí Ísɔ, ɔyínɛ́ nū, ajɛ kú Uséyɛ, ipú ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā alɛwa kpó ŋmó, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú ā lɛ uwá á. É lā ipú ajɛ kú wā ā jāā gbéeko nēé kpó uwā aálagbá ga ajɛ aéwɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya géē yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū. Ó géē yɔ̄ ī gwō ka anúɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á, ka anúɔ klla nwuné fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ dóódu á. Ó kōō í ka ka anúɔ fíyɛ́ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū nōo yá ɔdā dóódu ā dúú á. Ó géē lɔfú yá ɛ̄nyā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē yá ɔ̄ italā. Ɔwɔicō ī yá ɔdā dóódu nōó tútū lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā jīla piíí.

eng_Latn: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yɛhɛ tū aogbɛhá ā, gē cá Ɔwɔicō nōo yá uwā ā ɛcá. É géē yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē gwéeyē ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo gē yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā italā piíí.

eng_Latn: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī alɛwa le gla ā, ācɛ Ujíyu lɛ ujɔ̄ tū kéē ŋmó ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.
idu_Latn: Ó géē nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, é gē je ɔ́ ga ɛga nēé bá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tū Ussaássigāsi, idibo nōo gē leyīkwu anyā ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā abɔ̄. Ó klla gáā ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ayíka ɔ̄cɛ́nyā ɔ́ɔmā he ɔcɛ́ ā ɔtū nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū lɛ iyē nū hī, kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ajɛ ā, ó le odúúdú ɛlā kú íne a jé tɛ́ɛcɛ, kwu ɔhā mɛ́mla okónu ōtá kú nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nēé tá tū ipú íne ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ɔdā nōo kwu uwɔ ɔtū ā, nɛ̄ ikɔkɔ nāa í ba ije, agbénú, olóófu, oyēeyī olīkpō, amáŋ ikwū kú aólɛlā kú uwɔ, a lɛ íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōjé ba, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā géē lɔfú gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ n je uwɔ pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ígbáanɔ nōo yēeyī ā hɛ́tá ga ipácí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā lɛ uculo kú iyē ō gwu kú inu ā yá ɔkwɛ̄yi, cɛ́ɛ́ inu ā kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā yɔ̄ ī tú ɔ́mpa uwā īyī uwā abɔ̄ klla ī tá īyī uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umémūkan tá ɔcɛ́ ā ohi kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɔcányā, Ufássiti cɛ́ɛcá klla leyī gwu ɔ́ bónū ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó lɛ ɛcá cá odúúdú aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā, klla leyī gwū uwā bónū.

eng_Latn: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
idu_Latn: Ó klla lɛ ɔdā ocíce kú oje udɔ yá tū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ɔdā ɔhá kú ugóolu ɛyí ede, mɛ́mla utébulu nēé gē lɛ igbō kú ɛ̄gbā kú Óndú ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ohígbū úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá yá nōó nyā aá tá ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í bī ɔ́ɔmā le gwō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɔhi, ó gē yíihɔtū tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū piyóó. Ó kē ī lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā tū ŋmá eko tá eko piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
idu_Latn: N gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, n kē cīgbīhi kwū Ɔwɔicō kú um nyɔ̄ í bɔ́bíipú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, Óndú ā kɛlā gā um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í kē í yɛ í kwú um ú ŋmó, igbo ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɛláyíja nɛ. Ācɛ ɔhá klla ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcomɛ́ɛbɛ éyi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú íkée ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n bī aádáádā aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ó wɛ aɛ́hi mɛ́mla aɛ́ya nɛ̄ n je íne lɛ uwá kú nū ā nóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ o gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ígbíli ɛháajɛ kú ɛfu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn jāā ga ísu nɛ̄hi, ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, gaá bū ajɛ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti ga ísu kú Umeditarénīya ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
idu_Latn: nōó ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā gaá lɛ ɔkɔ gbā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá tá iyī aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū, aá klla tū iyī aá abɔ̄, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ í yá abālɔbányā ā.
