eng_Latn: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔlá klá Íjīpiti, Upelúsiyum kē í yɔ̄ ipú ɔnɔ mɛ́mla ákanya. Ɔdɔ kú Utébēsi ā géē je ca klá ajɛ, ɔkpá kē ī cēenyi tū igelī ā.

eng_Latn: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ipú ɔkpíhɔ kahíníī, N gē tū ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ɛhɔ̄ gbɔbū gā uwɔ, nōo géē tá ɔwɛ kú uwɔ yá gbɔbū gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ eko ā gā ā, n géē yá Ujerúsālɛm bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ō gbɛnú nɛ̄hi ā, nɛ̄ éwo dóódu nōo dɔɔ̄kā ō je ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ, géē yá iyī nū ágbe. Odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ géē pīyatɔ̄há kéē kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ eliká ā má, mɛ́mla oje otābɔ̄ abɔ̄ kú ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā ā, klla lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Urebéka ɔyínɛ́ nū ka ā pó ā, ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ébrahām, abɔ̄ ó máhāyi pī aínyankwūlūmī ā ɛgiyí obugā ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nwū ā, nɛ̄ ó bī ɔ̄ tīīpú ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā í jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá nwū tīīpú, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ Ádā mɛ́mla Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ɛplɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɛhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le kpaakpa kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu ā, gē cɛ̄ lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā gbagbénú. Amáŋ okónu kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gē je igelī nɛ̄hi ā yíífi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo gekwú í gē kwúcē wā oyēeyi gɛ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka ojuja nōo gē bí tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Ahímāasi.

eng_Latn: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ábsālɔm mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú cē kwu Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nōó lɛ ɛ̄cī kú onyatá kwajɛ á, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kú ācɛ kéē lɛ oyī mī klá odūngwɔ̄wɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alelékwū-ō-ŋmɔ́cɛ kéē híī ŋmó ayí aflɛ́yí kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
idu_Latn: N kwú iyī um ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā leyīkwu um. Awɔ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo le kpaakpa ā, lɛ um hɛ́tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda da ádā nū kahíníī, Mā ɔyí ā tá ga um, kú ālɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ bōōbū. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō kwú ɛmiyɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāŋdaa ga eyī ísu ā, lɛ abɔ̄ jíla aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā iyē ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē kwu aígelī olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ukénan ā í yíífi ŋ́má ajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
idu_Latn: Ujɛsirili, Ujókidéyam, Usanówa.

eng_Latn: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá yɛce um, n géē je aá pīya ācɛ nēe í kwú ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ gē kwú ɛbéenyi ā.

eng_Latn: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ acígilí, n má ācɛ ā bá ī wā ce ɛyí aɔ́nya ɛpɛɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogbāajɛ ā lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm kahíníī, É kwú Ubábīlɔn ú yálé ɛɛ́. É le odúúdú aójibó kú ɛ̄cī kú nū ā ca bónu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, le yɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe gē yúufi Óndú ā jīlata, klla ī hɛ́ uwá tá.

eng_Latn: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ gē lɔfú yɛhɛ klá íwɔ́tū ɛyí glá. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ éeyē ā kē mɛ, ɔtūnōbí ā kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ́ŋgbá kú ugóolu ɛpa ā ú flá tū eliká ɛpa ā.

eng_Latn: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, odúúdu ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā le tútū kéē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwá kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ācɛ le ofíyajɛ kú ɛgahi nōo gē mafú ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɛgée ā má. Ó le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛcɛ wā í ce ɛyí Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: Ó tíne ō bū Okómpinu kú Ujerúsālɛm nēé hī ka Okómpinu kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā. Amáŋ eko nōó ga Okómpinu ā, Iríja, ɔyí kú Ussɛlɛmíya, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Uhananíya, nōo wɛ otrɛyí kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ī gbō ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā, lɛ ɔ́ kwú tū, da ɔ́ ka, A yɔ̄ ī kwu ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ayí lɛ lɛwa, é géē kpó odúúdú uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. Ayí nū í gáā má ɔdōlé lé jɛ̄ gbóógbóō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi wā ɛgiyí nū gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka awɔ wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á, da aɛ́cɔ̄ nēe bá nyā kéē le pīya igbō.

eng_Latn: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ eko dóódu ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ oyēeyī abɔ̄yī nū á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra awɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā jé ucē mɛ́mla áafú dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu gē tá ā lɔɔlɔhi. Ó lɛ ā n gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ kā lɛ ahɔ̄ jē gā um pɛtɛɛ.

eng_Latn: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ mīyɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá kéē lā ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má lā ipú nū. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē cɛgbá ɔcɛ́ nōo géē gbō uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ odúúdú aéwo nēe yɛ uwá jīlatá ā lɛ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú a da Umósīsi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya nū uwā inya jāā gaá gbéeko nēé le uwá kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é le ayí Usɔ́ɔlu ɛtá nēe bá ā kpó ŋmó: Ujonátan, Ammínādābu mɛ́mla Umálkīssūwa.

eng_Latn: For John was not yet cast into prison.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā é kwú Ujɔ́ni tá agbá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofu cɛpa kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā gē yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Adáya, ɔyí kú Ujérōham, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Upélālíya. Ádáádā nū wɛ, Ámsi, Usekaríya, Upássɔ mɛ́mla Umálikīja.

eng_Latn: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē cēyītīkwū eko dóódu ká n̄ lɛ ɔtū ōbɛ́ɛpa ipú oyēēyī kú um ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla alɛɛcɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
idu_Latn: Eko nyā, Unebúkádinēsa abɔ̄yī nū gā Ujerúsālɛm eko kú íbɔm ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ā híī yúufi ŋ́, Upɔ́lu, a géē háyi iyɔ̄bū Usísa piíí, má ɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō kē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe yɛ mla awɔ ā kpó gā awɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
idu_Latn: É le Ujísɔ̄si kwú anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ bī ga ɔlɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā á. Upíta le hɛ́ce igbīīgbīhi yɔ̄ gē yɛce uwá.

eng_Latn: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.
idu_Latn: Unaómi da Urútu ka Ɔwɔicō ká ɔ̄ hɔ́hā ce Ubówāsi. Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ gē lɛ okónu nɔ́ɔ ce mla ācɛ nēe pɛ́kwú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe oyēeyī ā tū. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Urútu ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔmáapú aá ajaajɛ. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ klla wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo gē je aá anyōkwū glá dúú.

eng_Latn: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń lɛ íkwu ō fu ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná ámāŋ ka abɔ̄lúfīyē kú um ā ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē je ɛga o cīce ā lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ó tū ɔ̄ tū gbēyī uwā ā á.

eng_Latn: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ Ubɛsálilu, Oholíyābu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ dóódu nēé kpó ɔfú lɛ uwá, nēe tútū kéē tábɔ̄ ā kpó hīgwú. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kéē gbo úklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le íne ā tá tāajɛ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi ā, nēe gē bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gbɔ̄ɔkɔ abɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Woó, Ɔwɔicō, ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ucē ɔ́bíipú nyā á. Ami je ɔ́da kéē gbo ācɛ áluka á. Ācɛ nēe bá nyā í yá ɔdā dúú bɔ̄bí ŋ́. Óndú ā, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú um ā, yá ami mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ um italā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā má ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
idu_Latn: Ó tá um ohi kahíníī, Óndú ā, nɛ̄ n himayī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā, géē tū alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kóō yɛ mɛ́mla uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ iyāwu kú uwɔ yá lɔhi. A géē lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɔyí um ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ādā alɔ miya ipú ɔtū kú nū ā, ó lɛ aá yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Alelékwū ihɔ lɛ abɔ̄ ce aá ɛyí, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwu íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si nēé nyɔ́kpá ā. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce aá fíyɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
idu_Latn: Awɔ wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n gē tayínū á. Awɔ gē gbō um ŋmá ipú unwalu á. A le um yɛ jīla tá mla ācɛ nēe bá gē gwéeyē, yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔga ohígbū ka a le um hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
idu_Latn: Otú ɛ̄cī éyi, Ujósɛ̄fu le ɔ̄na nā. Eko nōó le ɔnā ā ka lɛ ayínɛ́ nū ā, é wɔ́tū nū fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
idu_Latn: N géē lā abɔ́ɔ pī uwā. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá, uwá kē ī wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī cēyītīkwū kóō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si wɛ ā má, amáŋ ó mɛ́ɛbɛ bū acá kú ɛwa nēe yɛ jīla Ujísɔ̄si tá ā glá ŋ́ ohígbū ka ó wɛ ima.

eng_Latn: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
idu_Latn: Ufi nɛ̄hi nōo yá ācogbāājɛ ā yá kéē fīyégbúlú, anɔ́ɔ é gā ajɛ wɔɔlɔ bɛ̄ɛka é le pɛ́ gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
idu_Latn: Aá ka kēé géē kwú ayí aá je uwá yá ɔfiyɛ, amáŋ n géē bī uwā wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá tá ā. Ó kē í wɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄ n géē da aá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́, amáŋ aá gáā bī uwā glá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le pīya biílí le bū ígbíli lɛyíkwu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le iyē kwú mla iyɔ́fú, le tútū kú ɛfú eko nēé bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le bēé ga ipú únóji ā, é má ɔyípɛ̄ oklobīya nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi yāajɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ipú unóji ā, lɛ awulú nɛhɛ̄ pélúú wu iyē. É le hɛ́gilígilí.

eng_Latn: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n má ā wɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ igá ɔdɔ gwó tū ɔ̄ yɛ jīla tá. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú ɔcí ōmiya ajɛ kú nū, nōo wɛ umita ɛtá ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔdɔ ā mīya á. Olɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ɛtá, ocɔkpɛ́nú kú nū kē wɛ umíta ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛ̄cī gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka Ísrɛ̄lu kóō géē lɛ ɔcɛ́ ōgbāajɛ ā, Ɔkpɛtā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m kú Ujúda kwú ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ú le pɛ́ gaá lā Umówābu.

eng_Latn: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛbɛ́ kú ucɛ kú nū ŋmó ɛɛ́. Ó kē le aɔ́dā ō yá ejé lɔnyɛ kpó tū ɔ̄ dúú ɛɛ́. Ó kē le ɔdōlé kú nū tútū báajɛ dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si yēeyī piyóó ā, anɔ́ɔ é je úklɔ́ kú ɛya ōgwó kú nū ā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄hi ɔhá nōo yéyījii ɔkpáncō. Aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ahāapa bī aámíyā nɛ̄hi ahāapa nēe wɛ ákú ámōōmɛ ā abɔ̄. Eko nɛ̄ aɛ́nyā le yá kwɛyí, ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō kē kwɛyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
idu_Latn: Kéē kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka igbí nōo gē je ja tāajɛ ŋmá ipú ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Kéē kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔyí nōo gekwú tá ɛ́nɛ́ nū ipú, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ma ɔ́, nɛ̄ ó yēeyī má ɛnɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ o lɔfú ā bá ī ce uwā nɛɛ, Ujékɔ̄pu gē kpó aógbló bá iyɔ́bū ūwā ɛga nēe ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é gē ce iyí ūwā ɛplá aógbló ā.

eng_Latn: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
idu_Latn: Ayíka ádā uwā, ɛ́nɛ́ uwa, ɔyí uwa nɔ̄nyīlɔ, ɔyí uwa nɔ̄nyā.

eng_Latn: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū gāājɛ ogbeé kú óókpoó kú Ugálīli ipú ajɛ kú Ugerása.

eng_Latn: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛwa kú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ā wɛ úlā ofigwáahāanɛ ce úlā igwɛ́ɛtá ce ofigáahātá .

eng_Latn: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā le Upɔ́lu bītá nyɔ̄ okónu ísu, amáŋ Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti bá Uberíya kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
idu_Latn: Ó fu Usáyímɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ Ándru. Ó fu Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni, Ufílipu mɛ́mla Ubatolómiyu.

eng_Latn: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nōo lā kwu uwɔ ā, kwú gbɛhá, nōó kwú iyī nū ú ce aá abɔ̄, aá gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yúklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ ɔnyā kú Usáyímɔ̄ni gwutá agōdō yɔ̄ ī doōcē kú áganá, ɔ̄cɛ éyi le da Ujísɔ̄si lɛyíkwu ɔ́ obōōbū nɛ̄ ó wā ā.

eng_Latn: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko éyi Óndú ā, kwú Ébrahām aádáádā alɔ ú ŋmá ajɛ kú Uyúfarētīisi, bī ɔ̄ bū odúúdú ajɛ kú Ukénan. Ó ka anúɔ kpó ayááyí alɛwa lɛ ɔ́. Ó ka anúɔ kōō je Áyísīki lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n géē je igbō nwū ɔhɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́ ā wɛ anú á. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ igbō ā nwū ɔhɔ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Ujúdasi ɔyí Usáyímɔ̄ni Iskárīyɔ̄tu á.

eng_Latn: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ koó hile iháyí alɛwa nɛɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é miya ɔ́ lɛ ā, ó géē gbá ije kóō fūla kú nū lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ígbíli pīya ɔkpá nɛ̄hi, ó klla í je ajɛ íkpākplā pīya njɔlɔ.

eng_Latn: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti gbo ɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a tútū la Ujúda a, uwá gēe ba ī yá ufi kú Ujúda pióo.

eng_Latn: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā gē kɛlā gā um kahíníī, A kɛlā icííci ɔ́ɔmā lɛ alɔ ŋ́. A kē tɔ́ɔna lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā lɛ alɔ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō í gáā je uwēyī lɛ alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō cīgbīhi kwu Ɔwɔicō nōo ményinyi ācɛ ā ŋ́. Aá leyī kwɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá kóō je pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ohɔ́nɔ nōo í ci aá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, kóō híī bū ipú aá ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko nōó le jɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí ī jɛ̄ ā, ó géē bī ɛ́fa kú nū le bī ācɛ nyíleyī.

eng_Latn: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá kpó kɔ̄ igwíígwu anɔ́ɔ́ ó kwú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyééye í yá otrɛ̄yí kú aígwu éyééye. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Áá beē nyɔ̄ gɔbū gā um, amáŋ aá lɛ ɛpá tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ígwu éyééye ā.

eng_Latn: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
idu_Latn: Ā je um yíífi mla ācobīyíne ā ŋ́. Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ híī kwú mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyilɔ ú kpó cɛyí ijakī, kwú okwutɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kóō je ā ú bī abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é kwúcē le tá Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le úklɔ́ kú uwá yá kwɛyí ā, é kwú oje udɔ, ugóolu , mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nōo hile ā ú kpó lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ujehóyāda, anɔ́ɔ é bī ɔ̄ le yá ocíbú mɛ́mla iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā igbɔhá á. Eko nɛ̄ Ujehóyāda yēeyī gaá kwu ā, é bá ī gwɛ́ɛya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ajɛ ā géē lɛ ɛdɔ kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ nɛ̄ aá je lɛ ɔ́ glá ŋ mā.

eng_Latn: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn lɛ ācɛ ā kpó ga ɔkpá, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔɔ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ nēe géē lɛ ígblɛ́nyī tá éŋkpɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ewō ā kɔ̄ hɛ̄ ācɛ nēe géē lɛ okwúukwu kwu ajɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umikáya da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā yēeyī ā, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da um kā ami ɔ́ɔ ka ā, ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gaá ka á.

eng_Latn: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɛnū ō hɛ́hɔ̄ kú aá ú na ɔkpacaŋ́gelī. Aá kwú ɛ̄wā ō bī cē īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ú na óbō. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwáahi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú aá ā, géē nuunu piíí.

eng_Latn: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā lɛ um hīgwu wā ɛkwúbá, da um kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ a ī gbā ā ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ nyā yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Ása, ɔcɛ́ ā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Jāhɔ̄ gā um, ɔcɛ́ Ása, awɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mla ācɛ kú Ubénjamīn. Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla awɔ eko dúú nāa yɔ̄ mla anú. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a tíne nū, ó géē wā gaá yɔ̄ mla uwɔ, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a kē kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu ɔ́, ó kē géē cīgbīhi kwu uwɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
idu_Latn: Aá kpɔ́tū ce ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú aá, aá ī yá ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi, odúúdú aá klla ī gbaajā. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄, aá gē gbɛlá ka ajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ákú aá āa.

eng_Latn: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
idu_Latn: É géē kpó uwā yíífi ipú ɔlikɔtɔ, ohígbū ka ɔdā nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ uwá abɔ̄yī uwā dɔɔ̄kā lɛ ɔkpíyē kú uwā ā. É gē kɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kú ɔdā ōhī nēé gē yá ā, nēe cíkā ō wɛ ɔdā ō tū uwā uwēyī. É yɔ̄ gē gbɛlá kwu o yɔ̄ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu má gwutá gbɔ́ɔ̄cī. Ó cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cí, le ɔwɛ kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā nwūla. Ó yɔ̄ ī yúufi ō ka ɛbɛ nɛ̄ ó má ā lɛ Ɛ́lāyi.

eng_Latn: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó le bēhé tá ipú inu ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō. Eko nɛ̄ Abíyāta wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú igbō nēé je lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ú lé klla lɛ ōhī kú nū je lɛ aɔ́mpānū á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ lɛ ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ōfōōfūnū lɔfú lé igbō ā glá á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le yá kú ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn ā kóō le wuklíicō abɔ̄ nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú ācɛ bá ī wā a. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó uwā nɛ̄hi ajɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn, klla nū uwā jāā ga ɛyí ɛfu, gaá bū Ubɛti Uhórɔn, klla nuunu tá uwá jāā ga ɛháajɛ kú Asɛ́ka mɛ́mla Umakéda ā.

eng_Latn: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
idu_Latn: Óndú le ahɔ̄ jē, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō pó ɔkɔ kú otábɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
idu_Latn: Usísa.

eng_Latn: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa géē má ɛfu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ka anúɔ í lā piyóó ā ímálānyī ā?.

eng_Latn: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo bī olɛhɔ̄ ā wā ā tá Ɛ́lāyi ohi ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ufílīstiya. Ɛ́ɛ kē le aá yálé bɔ̄bí bɔ̄bí. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ayí nū ɛpa ā, Uhófīni mɛ́mla Ufínīhas ā, ɛfú ɔ́ɔ le uwá lé. Ācɛ Ufílīstiya ɛ́ɛ klla mīyɛ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi mɛ́mla Utímōti kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō. Olɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā í kē pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá īī ga ehée ŋ́. Ó wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá leyīce ā ŋ́, ó wɛ īī kú Ɔwɔicō eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: ka ā lɛ íne ā tū, ká ā híī mlanyī odúúmā kú nū ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē wā āa.

eng_Latn: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
idu_Latn: N le ɔdā ɔhá má ipú oyēeyī nyā nōo wɛ áncā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nōo ī pīya ācɛ ɔhá tū ā géē móōwē odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū, eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ uwá lɛ ɔ̄kā da ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ amíyɔ yá aá aɔ́dā nēe bá āa, Ujeremíya, le da uwá ka, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ e nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá gaá bá ī gbā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛ̄gbā ā, ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé géē gbā ācɛ aéwɔhá ɛ̄gbā ipú ajɛ kú aéwɔhá dúú á.

eng_Latn: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayááyí nū gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔtulalī mɛ́mla ɛya kú ɔdā ō yɔlá ɛyí ede á. Úklɔ́ kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Ɔwɔicō dúúdú ipú ɛga nōo tīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú mɛ́mla ɛya nēé gē gwó nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī je íne ō bīya yá uwā ɛhi ā. É gē yá odúúdú aɛ́nɛ̄ o bā ā oŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō, mafú lɛ uwá lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ ɛplá iháyí ékpónú ŋ́. Ohígbū nɛ̄ ajɛ ā géē má tá áncā, nɛ̄ ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí alɛwa géē le nyīla ca aá bá.

eng_Latn: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
idu_Latn: Ujessúwa wɛ ádā kú Ujóyākim nōo ma Ɛlíyāssibu, nōo kē ma Ujóyāda ā.

eng_Latn: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū cāŋ́jɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ é yɛce ɔnyīlɔ aā.

eng_Latn: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le pó abɔ́ɔ ka, Usímri ɔ́ɔ le ibīyājɛ yá tū ɔcɛ́ klla le ɔ́ ŋmó ā, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá kwú Ómri, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá ú cɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
idu_Latn: Éeyē yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe lā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, nēé bá ī gwíijē ōcɛ̄tra uwɔ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
idu_Latn: Aá géē bá ī gwōnū klla iyī aá eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú yɔ̄ ī nū aá inya ŋ́. Aá kē gáā lɔfú kpɛ́fú tú aólɛlā kú aá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujɛhósāfati, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di ā.

eng_Latn: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Ahúsāti, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ā, mɛ́mla Ufíkɔlu, nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, gā ŋmá Ugéra gaá má Áyísīki.
